In both countries, farmers display aversion to strategic uncertainty, rely heavily on beliefs about their neighbors' actions when deciding whether to participate, and systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low. These common findings across such different settings suggest that the underlying mechanisms are not context‐specific but instead reflect more general features of decision‐making under strategic interdependence, lending support to the external validity of our findings. The results highlight key psychological and economic barriers to cooperation and offer policy‐relevant insights for designing interventions to enhance participation in voluntary area‐wide pest management programs. While voluntary coordination can enhance pest management effectiveness and be pareto‐optimal, the success of the collective action depends on overcoming farmers' reluctance to participate. The evidence that farmers systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low highlights a key behavioral barrier that can lead to coordination failures. Interventions that mitigate strategic uncertainty and build trust among participants—such as targeted subsidies or technical assistance—could encourage participation among farmers who would otherwise be unwilling to engage in coordinated efforts. Beyond the immediate application to pest and weed resistance management, our findings contribute to a broader understanding of cooperative behavior among farmers in the presence of strategic uncertainty.
10.1002/aepp.70109.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们与美国佛罗里达州柑橘种植户及阿根廷大豆种植户合作开展了两项框架田野经济实验，旨在探究农户参与病虫害与杂草协同治理的意愿。尽管两国农业情境存在显著差异，但研究发现惊人的行为共性：两国农户均表现出对战略不确定性的规避倾向，其参与决策高度依赖对邻居行为的信念，且即便机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功的概率。这些跨情境的共性发现表明，潜在机制并非情境特异性，而是反映了战略依存条件下决策的普遍特征，从而支持了研究结论的外部有效性。研究结果揭示了阻碍合作的关键心理与经济壁垒，为设计提升自愿性区域病虫害协同治理项目参与度的干预措施提供了政策启示。尽管自愿协同能提升病虫害治理效率并实现帕累托最优，但集体行动的成功取决于能否克服农户的参与惰性。农户在机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功概率的证据，凸显了导致协同失灵的关键行为障碍。通过定向补贴或技术援助等缓解战略不确定性、建立参与者信任的干预措施，可促使原本不愿参与协同行动的农户加入。除直接应用于病虫害抗性治理外，本研究还为理解战略不确定性下农户合作行为提供了更广泛的理论视角。
10.1002/aepp.70109.title: Voluntary Collective Action to Address Growing Agricultural Challenges in Two Countries: Experimental Insights and Commonalities
10.1002/aepp.70109.title_zh: 两国应对日益严峻农业挑战的自愿集体行动：实验洞见与共性

10.1002/aepp.70110.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Federally subsidized crop insurance is a cornerstone of U.S. farm risk management, yet policies with the greatest share of participation only trigger indemnities after losses exceed 15%. Supplemental insurance was introduced to cover part of this deductible, but participation remains largely unchanged. Using 1,005,245 sub‐county aggregated insurance observations and applying novel calibration and simulation methods, we show that low participation in supplemental coverage limits risk reduction potential. While basic insurance provides a foundation, adding supplemental policies meaningfully improves downside risk reduction and income transfer. Although these gains involve higher premiums, a benefit‐per‐premium analysis still favors broader use. These results reflect potential program impacts conditional on adoption, recognizing that actual participation depends on farmer preferences, risk perceptions, and institutional constraints.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70110.abstract_zh: 联邦补贴作物保险是美国农业风险管理的基石，但参与率最高的保单仅在损失超过15%后才触发赔付。补充保险旨在覆盖部分免赔额，但参与率基本未变。利用1,005,245个次县级汇总保险观测数据，并应用新型校准与模拟方法，我们发现补充保险的低参与率限制了风险降低潜力。虽然基础保险提供了保障基础，但增加补充保单能显著改善下行风险降低和收入转移效果。尽管这些收益伴随更高保费，但每单位保费收益分析仍支持更广泛使用。这些结果反映了在采用条件下的潜在项目影响，同时认识到实际参与取决于农户偏好、风险感知和制度约束。
10.1002/aepp.70110.title: Low Participation and Risk Reduction Potential of Supplemental Crop Insurance in the United States
10.1002/aepp.70110.title_zh: 美国补充性农作物保险的低参与率与风险降低潜力

10.1002/aepp.70111.abstract: ABSTRACT Biosecurity trade restrictions are commonly framed as preventive measures, yet in many settings they function primarily as policies of delay: they impose immediate market costs while only postponing the arrival of biological risks. This paper evaluates that intertemporal tradeoff using the 2024–2025 US suspension of live cattle imports from Mexico in response to the northward spread of New World Screwworm (NWS). We estimate a vector autoregression (VAR) using monthly data from 2004 to 2025 to characterize pre‐ban dynamics in feeder cattle prices, Mexican import volumes, fed cattle prices, and feed costs, and construct counterfactual forecasts for prices and trade flows absent the border closures. Translating these costs into a simple break‐even framework shows that under an annual endemic‐loss assumption of $10 billion, each additional month of border closure would need to delay endemic NWS establishment by approximately 4 months to be welfare improving.
10.1002/aepp.70111.abstract_zh: 摘要 生物安全贸易限制通常被视为预防性措施，但在许多情境下，它们主要发挥延迟政策的作用：这些限制在施加即时市场成本的同时，仅能推迟生物风险的到来。本文利用2024-2025年美国因新世界螺旋蝇（NWS）向北蔓延而暂停从墨西哥进口活牛的案例，评估了这一跨期权衡。我们基于2004年至2025年的月度数据，估计了一个向量自回归（VAR）模型，以刻画禁运前架子牛价格、墨西哥进口量、育肥牛价格及饲料成本之间的动态关系，并构建了无边境关闭情形下价格与贸易流的反事实预测。将这些成本转化为简单的盈亏平衡框架后显示，在每年10亿美元的地方性损失假设下，边境关闭每延长一个月，需将NWS地方性建立推迟约4个月，才能实现福利改善。
10.1002/aepp.70111.title: Delaying the Inevitable? U.S. Screwworm Closures and Feeder Cattle Market Dynamics
10.1002/aepp.70111.title_zh: 推迟不可避免之事？美国螺旋蝇检疫封锁与架子牛市场动态

10.1002/aepp.70112.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Using an enhanced Computable General Equilibrium (CGE) model (GTAP‐BIO), this study assesses how the expansion in demand for Electric Vehicles (EVs) and the reduction in exports of agricultural products induced by trade disputes negatively affect US agriculture. It then evaluates the extent to which producing Sustainable Aviation Fuels (SAFs) from corn and soybeans could mitigate these effects. Results show that EV expansion reduces gasoline demand, suppresses corn production, lowers farm incomes, and generates idled capacity, including increases in uncultivated cropland. Export tariffs further amplify these effects. Expansion in SAF produced from corn and soybean could partially limit these consequences.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70112.abstract_zh: 摘要：本研究采用增强型可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型（GTAP-BIO），评估电动汽车（EV）需求扩张及贸易争端导致的农产品出口减少对美国农业的负面影响，并进一步分析利用玉米和大豆生产可持续航空燃料（SAFs）在多大程度上能够缓解这些影响。结果表明，电动汽车扩张降低了汽油需求，抑制了玉米生产，减少了农业收入，并导致产能闲置，包括未耕种农田面积的增加。出口关税进一步放大了这些效应。扩大以玉米和大豆为原料的可持续航空燃料生产可在一定程度上限制上述后果。
10.1002/aepp.70112.title: U.S. Agriculture, Biofuel Markets, and Trade: Challenges and Opportunities
10.1002/aepp.70112.title_zh: 美国农业、生物燃料市场与贸易：挑战与机遇

10.1002/aepp.70113.abstract: Sustainable agricultural practices such as cover cropping can improve soil health, water quality, and carbon sequestration, yet U.S. adoption remains limited due to economic and operational barriers. We evaluate market and economic impacts of integrating perennial groundcover into U.S. corn and soybean production under six yield and cost scenarios. Results show that impacts depend on whether yields are maintained and costs remain stable. Under the most optimistic scenario, long‐term outcomes remain close to or slightly above baseline levels. In contrast, scenarios involving yield losses or sustained cost increases generate negative economic outcomes, highlighting the importance of agronomic performance and cost control.
10.1002/aepp.70113.abstract_zh: 覆盖种植等可持续农业实践能够改善土壤健康、水质和碳封存，但由于经济和操作障碍，美国对其采用仍然有限。我们评估了在六种产量和成本情景下，将多年生地被植物整合到美国玉米和大豆生产中的市场和经济效益。结果表明，影响取决于产量是否得以维持以及成本是否保持稳定。在最乐观的情景下，长期结果仍接近或略高于基准水平。相比之下，涉及产量损失或成本持续增加的情景则产生负面经济结果，凸显了农艺表现和成本控制的重要性。
10.1002/aepp.70113.title: Integrating Perennial Groundcover in Corn and Soybean Acres: Impacts on U.S. Agriculture
10.1002/aepp.70113.title_zh: 将多年生地被植物整合到玉米和大豆农田：对美国农业的影响

10.1002/aepp.70114.abstract: ABSTRACT This study analyzed post‐COVID‐19 trends in food prices in Brazil and projected changes through 2026. Time series from the 2017/2018 Household Budget Survey, the National System of Consumer Price Indexes, and the Continuous National Household Sample Survey were analyzed using Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) models. Between 2018 and 2024, prices of ultra‐processed food products (UPFP) decreased by 16%, while unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients increased, narrowing the price gap. The nominal prices of food groups rose more than nominal household income between 2018 and 2024, particularly for unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients. Projections indicate that UPFP will remain the cheapest group by 2026, reinforcing barriers to healthy diets and supporting tax policies.
10.1002/aepp.70114.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究分析了巴西在新冠疫情后的食品价格趋势，并预测了截至2026年的变化。研究利用2017/2018年家庭预算调查、国家消费者价格指数体系以及连续全国住户抽样调查的时间序列数据，采用季节性自回归积分滑动平均模型（SARIMA）进行分析。2018年至2024年间，超加工食品（UPFP）价格下降了16%，而未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料的价格则有所上涨，从而缩小了价格差距。2018年至2024年间，各类食品的名义价格涨幅超过了名义家庭收入，尤其是未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料。预测显示，到2026年，超加工食品仍将是最便宜的类别，这加剧了健康饮食的障碍，并为税收政策提供了支持依据。
10.1002/aepp.70114.title: Food Price Trends and Projections in Brazil (2018–2026): Implications for Access to Adequate and Healthy Food
10.1002/aepp.70114.title_zh: 巴西食品价格趋势与预测（2018-2026年）：对获取充足健康食品的影响

10.1002/aepp.70115.abstract: This study examines how rural households in Ethiopia adjust their livestock market participation in response to moisture conditions. Using contemporaneous and lagged measures of hydrological stress, the analysis distinguishes between sheep and goat markets to capture species‐specific responses. The results show that adjustment is driven primarily by lagged moisture conditions, although some contemporaneous effects are also evident. Favorable past moisture significantly increases participation in sheep markets, while responses in goat markets are smaller and less consistent. Transaction volumes respond only weakly, indicating that hydrological stress affects primarily the extensive margin of market participation. Responses also vary across agroecological zones. The findings suggest that livestock adjustment to hydrological stress is gradual and species‐specific, reflecting ecological dynamics and differences in resilience across livestock species.
10.1002/aepp.70115.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了埃塞俄比亚农村家庭如何根据水分条件调整其牲畜市场参与行为。通过使用同期和滞后的水文压力指标，分析区分了绵羊市场和山羊市场，以捕捉不同物种的特定反应。结果表明，调整主要由滞后的水分条件驱动，尽管部分同期效应也较为明显。过去有利的水分条件显著增加了绵羊市场的参与度，而山羊市场的反应较小且一致性较低。交易量反应较弱，表明水文压力主要影响市场参与的广延边际。不同农业生态区的反应也存在差异。研究结果表明，牲畜对水文压力的调整是渐进且具有物种特异性的，反映了生态动态及不同牲畜物种在韧性上的差异。
10.1002/aepp.70115.title: Slow to Respond: Lagged Adjustments to Moisture Conditions in Small Ruminant Markets
10.1002/aepp.70115.title_zh: 反应迟缓：小型反刍动物市场对水分条件的滞后调整

10.1002/aepp.70116.abstract: In the efforts being made by governments to reduce pesticide use, subsidies are an important instrument to encourage farmers to adopt more sustainable practices. Yet, their effectiveness remains uncertain due to diverse designs and contexts. To date, there are no studies that provide systematic synthesized evidence on the potentially heterogeneous effects of subsidies on pesticide use. The present study addresses this gap by conducting a meta‐analysis of 39 empirical studies (208 models) from the EU and other developed countries that examine the effects of subsidies on (i) direct measurement of pesticide use and (ii) indirect measurement of pesticide use based on the adoption of pesticide‐reducing practices. Using probit meta‐regressions and qualitative appraisal, we find two key results. First, for EU studies, Pillar I and Pillar II subsidies from the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) have opposite effects on pesticide use: Pillar II subsidies are more likely than Pillar I subsidies to reduce pesticide use. Second, if we consider studies from both the EU and the US, subsidies that target adoption of whole‐farm systems or bundles of practices outperform those targeting a single practice in reducing pesticide use. We provide some policy recommendations for policy design and highlight future research priorities.
10.1002/aepp.70116.abstract_zh: 在各国政府减少农药使用的努力中，补贴是鼓励农民采纳更可持续做法的重要工具。然而，由于设计多样和情境差异，其有效性仍不确定。迄今为止，尚无研究提供关于补贴对农药使用可能存在的异质性效应的系统性综合证据。本研究通过荟萃分析39项来自欧盟及其他发达国家的实证研究（共208个模型），填补了这一空白，这些研究考察了补贴对（i）农药使用的直接测量及（ii）基于采纳减农药实践间接测量农药使用的影响。运用概率元回归及定性评估，我们得出两个关键结果。第一，就欧盟研究而言，共同农业政策（CAP）下的第一支柱和第二支柱补贴对农药使用具有相反效应：第二支柱补贴比第一支柱补贴更有可能减少农药使用。第二，若考虑欧盟和美国的研究，针对采纳整个农场系统或实践组合的补贴在减少农药使用方面优于针对单一实践的补贴。我们为政策设计提供了一些建议，并强调了未来研究的优先方向。
10.1002/aepp.70116.title: Assessing Government Subsidies for Reducing Pesticide Use: A Meta‐Analysis
10.1002/aepp.70116.title_zh: 评估政府补贴减少农药使用的效果：一项元分析

10.1002/aepp.70117.abstract: This study investigates the decline in Bureau of Land Management (BLM) grazing allotments, authorized Animal Unit Months, across eight Intermountain states (Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, Utah, Wyoming) from 1980 to 2022, examining the role of drought and structural change. Using outlier detection and structural break tests, we identify a concentrated regime shift in the early 2000s, with seven of eight states experiencing a statistically significant break between 2000 and 2003. Post‐break allotments declined by 11% regionally, ranging from 8% in New Mexico to 27% in Colorado. Outlier analysis reveals substantial heterogeneity in the nature of shocks, with Idaho and Utah experiencing permanent level shifts, Colorado a temporary change, and Wyoming multiple shocks of all types. To quantify drought impacts, we estimate a fixed effects model with a lagged dependent variable and a state‐specific structural break dummy. Results show that a one‐unit decrease in the Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI) reduces allotments by 0.5% immediately and by 3.6% in the long run under sustained drought. The break dummy is negative and highly significant, indicating a permanent 6.5% reduction in allotments following the early 2000s drought that is not explained by drought or market variables alone. This suggests that factors beyond drought have reduced grazing capacity. A sustained severe drought (three‐unit PDSI decrease) would permanently remove approximately 893,000 Animal Unit Months (AUMs) annually from the region, equivalent to 149,000–179,000 cow‐calf pairs and representing between $9 million and $27 million in lost forage value at private lease rates. These findings support reforms to drought relief programs to account for lagged and permanent effects, flexible permitting mechanisms for temporary drought, and long‐term adjustment assistance for permanent reductions. State‐specific heterogeneity in drought impacts implies that, while BLM already administers grazing at state and district levels, further differentiation of drought relief and permit flexibility based on state‐level vulnerabilities may improve effectiveness.
10.1002/aepp.70117.abstract_zh: 本研究调查了1980年至2022年间美国土地管理局（BLM）在八个山地州（亚利桑那州、科罗拉多州、爱达荷州、蒙大拿州、内华达州、新墨西哥州、犹他州、怀俄明州）放牧配额（授权动物单位月）的下降趋势，并考察了干旱与结构性变化的作用。通过异常值检测与结构性断点检验，我们识别出21世纪初存在集中的制度变迁：八个州中有七个在2000年至2003年间出现统计显著的断点。断点后区域放牧配额平均下降11%，各州降幅从新墨西哥州的8%到科罗拉多州的27%不等。异常值分析揭示了冲击性质的显著异质性：爱达荷州与犹他州经历永久性水平位移，科罗拉多州为暂时性变化，而怀俄明州则遭遇多种类型的多重冲击。为量化干旱影响，我们构建了包含滞后因变量与州特定结构性断点虚拟变量的固定效应模型。结果显示：帕尔默干旱指数（PDSI）每下降1个单位，放牧配额在短期内立即减少0.5%，在持续干旱条件下长期累计减少3.6%。断点虚拟变量为负且高度显著，表明21世纪初干旱后放牧配额永久性减少6.5%，这一降幅无法仅由干旱或市场变量解释，暗示干旱以外的因素削弱了放牧承载力。持续严重干旱（PDSI下降3个单位）将导致该区域每年永久性减少约89.3万动物单位月（AUMs），相当于14.9万至17.9万对母牛-牛犊组合，按私人租赁费率计算，牧草价值损失达900万至2700万美元。这些发现支持对干旱救济计划进行改革，以纳入滞后与永久性效应、建立临时干旱的灵活许可机制，并为永久性减少提供长期调整援助。干旱影响的州际异质性表明，尽管BLM已在州与地区层面实施放牧管理，但基于州级脆弱性进一步差异化干旱救济与许可灵活性，可能提升政策有效性。
10.1002/aepp.70117.title: Drought, Structural Breaks, and the Economics of Public Land Grazing: Evidence From the Intermountain West
10.1002/aepp.70117.title_zh: 干旱、结构性突变与公共土地放牧经济学：来自美国西部山间地区的证据

10.1002/aepp.70118.abstract: Using the agent‐based model SWISSland, we simulate farm‐level responses and interactions under two institutional shocks: tariff reductions and direct payment reductions. Using a framework we developed, we assess resilience capacities, resilience attributes, and the provision of private and public goods, following the shock. Results indicate that valley farms are vulnerable to tariff reductions and mountain farms to direct payment reductions. Payment cuts cause minor changes in private and public goods provision, while tariff reductions reduce provision levels. It shows that different shocks require different resilience attributes, underscoring the need for ex‐ante resilience assessments to develop targeted measures strengthening farm resilience.
10.1002/aepp.70118.abstract_zh: 基于主体模型SWISSland，我们模拟了两种制度冲击下的农场层面响应与互动：关税削减与直接支付削减。运用我们开发的框架，评估冲击后的韧性能力、韧性属性以及私人与公共产品的供给。结果表明，山谷农场易受关税削减影响，而山地农场则对直接支付削减更为敏感。支付削减对私人与公共产品供给的影响较小，而关税削减则降低了供给水平。这表明不同冲击需要不同的韧性属性，凸显了开展事前韧性评估以制定针对性措施、增强农场韧性的必要性。
10.1002/aepp.70118.title: Ex‐Ante Assessment of Farm Resilience to Institutional Shocks: A Modeling Approach
10.1002/aepp.70118.title_zh: 制度冲击下农场韧性的事前评估：一种建模方法

10.1002/aepp.70119.abstract: The USDA's Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) delivers environmental benefits to society by enrolling cropland and grasslands to reestablish or safeguard long‐term vegetative cover. In recent years, the CRP has dramatically increased grassland enrollment while cropland enrollment has been in steady decline. This paper uses descriptive analysis, multivariate regression analysis, and a spatial comparison of participant incentives to assess the relationship between these two CRP signup types. We argue that while these two programs do not compete administratively under current trends, these enrollment patterns could tighten competition between the programs in future periods if total enrollment approaches a shared cap.
10.1002/aepp.70119.abstract_zh: 美国农业部保护储备计划（CRP）通过将农田和草地纳入计划以重建或保护长期植被覆盖，为社会带来环境效益。近年来，CRP的草地纳入面积大幅增加，而农田纳入面积持续下降。本文采用描述性分析、多元回归分析以及参与者激励的空间比较，评估这两种CRP签约类型之间的关系。我们认为，尽管在当前趋势下这两个计划在行政管理上并不存在竞争，但如果总纳入面积接近共同上限，这些纳入模式可能会在未来阶段加剧计划间的竞争。
10.1002/aepp.70119.title: Complementary or Competitive? Emerging Interactions Between Restoration and Protection in the Conservation Reserve Program
10.1002/aepp.70119.title_zh: 互补还是竞争？保护储备计划中恢复与保护之间的新兴互动

10.1002/aepp.70120.abstract: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) strengthens the agricultural risk coverage (ARC) and price loss coverage (PLC) programs by aligning program parameters more closely with recent market dynamics and allows for an expansion in program acres. This study projects the increases in ARC‐County and PLC payments for corn, soybeans, and wheat under OBBBA, compared with those under the 2018 Farm Bill. Total projected program payments would increase by $4.65 billion for crop year 2025 and $1.30–$2.13 billion for crop year 2026 (depending on the relative enrollment rates), with high regional heterogeneity. JEL Classification: Q14, Q18
10.1002/aepp.70120.abstract_zh: 《一项宏大美丽法案》（OBBBA）通过使项目参数更贴近近期市场动态，强化了农业风险覆盖（ARC）和价格损失覆盖（PLC）项目，并允许扩大项目面积。本研究预测了在OBBBA下，相较于2018年农业法案，玉米、大豆和小麦的ARC-县及PLC支付额的增长情况。预计2025作物年项目总支付额将增加46.5亿美元，2026作物年将增加13亿至21.3亿美元（具体取决于相对参保率），且存在显著的区域异质性。JEL分类：Q14, Q18
10.1002/aepp.70120.title: Expanded Farm Safety Net Payments Under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act
10.1002/aepp.70120.title_zh: 《大美丽法案》下扩大农业安全网支付

10.1002/aepp.70121.abstract: Rational actors constantly incorporate information into their decision‐making behavior. Since there is often a time lag between the announcement of a policy and its implementation, an important question arises: when do rational actors incorporate new information into their market behavior, at the announcement or at the implementation of a policy? We investigate this question using the easing of trade tensions between China and the United States, marked by the “Phase One” trade deal announced in December 2019 and signed in January 2020, as a considerable positive trade shock. Focusing on two key events, the announcement of substantial tariff reductions on December 13, 2019, and the signing of the trade deal in January 2020, this study examines how both the announcement and the implementation of reduced trade barriers affected agricultural companies' stock prices. We employ an event study approach using data from the MSCI ACWI Select Agriculture Producers Investable Market Index to assess market reactions. The findings are consistent with the hypothesis derived from the conceptual framework, showing that rational market actors incorporate information at the announcement stage, not only at the implementation of a policy. However, sub‐industry analyses indicate that a subset of sub‐industries drives the aggregate effect, while additional heterogeneity analysis shows that the magnitude of the effects differs across continents. These findings are relevant for policymakers, businesses, and economists seeking to understand the broader economic implications of international trade agreements in general, and trade disputes in particular.
10.1002/aepp.70121.abstract_zh: 理性行为者不断将信息纳入其决策行为之中。由于政策从宣布到实施往往存在时间差，一个关键问题随之产生：理性行为者是在政策宣布时还是实施时，将新信息融入其市场行为？本文以2019年12月宣布、2020年1月签署的“第一阶段”贸易协议为标志的中美贸易紧张局势缓和作为一次显著的正向贸易冲击，对此问题进行探究。研究聚焦于两个关键事件——2019年12月13日宣布大幅削减关税及2020年1月贸易协议的签署，考察贸易壁垒降低的宣布与实施如何影响农业企业的股价。我们采用事件研究法，利用MSCI ACWI精选农业生产者投资市场指数的数据评估市场反应。研究结果与概念框架推导出的假设一致，表明理性市场行为者在政策宣布阶段即纳入信息，而非仅在政策实施时。然而，子行业分析显示，总体效应由部分子行业驱动，而进一步的异质性分析表明，效应大小在不同大洲间存在差异。这些发现对政策制定者、企业及经济学家理解国际贸易协定（尤其是贸易争端）的更广泛经济影响具有参考价值。
10.1002/aepp.70121.title: Rational Expectations and Market Timing: An Event Study of the China–United States Phase One Trade Deal
10.1002/aepp.70121.title_zh: 理性预期与市场择时：中美第一阶段贸易协议的事件研究

10.1002/aepp.70122.abstract: The California dairy industry has experienced considerable consolidation over the past 30 years. During this period, there has also been substantial technological innovation, implementation of the state's Low Carbon Fuel Standard program, and rapid adoption of anaerobic digesters. This apparent correlation has fueled concerns that anaerobic digesters are causing consolidation. We test for a causal relationship between digesters and consolidation using synthetic differences‐in‐differences. Our findings dispute the theory that digesters are causing consolidation.
10.1002/aepp.70122.abstract_zh: 加州乳制品行业在过去30年间经历了显著的整合。在此期间，该行业还出现了大量技术创新、州低碳燃料标准项目的实施，以及厌氧消化器的迅速普及。这种表面上的相关性引发了担忧，认为厌氧消化器正在导致行业整合。我们采用合成双重差分法检验了消化器与整合之间的因果关系。我们的研究结果反驳了消化器导致整合的理论。
10.1002/aepp.70122.title: The Cow or the Credit: Causal Relationship Between California Dairy Herd Consolidation and Anaerobic Digesters
10.1002/aepp.70122.title_zh: 奶牛还是信贷：加州奶牛群整合与厌氧消化器之间的因果关系

10.1002/aepp.70124.abstract: Recent food price inflation has placed substantial pressure on household budgets, food security, and mental well‐being. Using Household Pulse Survey data, we combine k‐modes clustering and Double Machine Learning to identify distinct household coping groups and examine differences in how households respond to rising food prices across groups. Results show that higher food prices are associated with increased grocery and prepared meal spending, elevate risks of food insufficiency, and worsen mental health conditions, with heterogeneity across coping groups. Households employing moderate substitution strategies show limited buffering, while those using more intensive coping behaviors remain highly vulnerable, highlighting the need for policy responses that address the multiple, co‐occurring dimensions of hardship including food access, financial strain, and mental health, rather than any single dimension in isolation.
10.1002/aepp.70124.abstract_zh: 近期食品价格通胀对家庭预算、食品安全和心理健康造成了巨大压力。利用家庭脉搏调查数据，我们结合k-modes聚类和双机器学习方法，识别出不同的家庭应对群体，并考察各群体在面对食品价格上涨时应对方式的差异。结果显示，食品价格上涨与杂货和预制餐支出的增加相关，提升了食品不足的风险，并加剧了心理健康问题，且不同应对群体之间存在异质性。采用适度替代策略的家庭缓冲效果有限，而采用更密集应对行为的家庭仍高度脆弱，这凸显了政策应对需针对多重、并发发生的困境维度——包括食品获取、经济压力和心理健康——而非孤立地处理任何单一维度。
10.1002/aepp.70124.title: Behavioral Coping With Food Price Inflation: Patterns Among U.S. Households
10.1002/aepp.70124.title_zh: 美国居民家庭应对食品价格通胀的行为策略模式

10.1002/aepp.70126.abstract: As the public engagement arm of the land‐grant mission, we argue that Extension faculty in US agricultural economics departments face an identity crossroads as they struggle for institutional support. Specifically, we argue that Extension economists function as boundary‐spanning professionals within academic structures that often devalue applied engagement. Drawing on a 2025 survey of 125 members of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association, this study examines how Extension is defined, practiced, and valued across career stages. Responses indicate broad conceptual agreement that Extension serves as a bridge between research and application, emphasizing stakeholder engagement, decision support, and public communication. However, faculty and graduate students differ in how they frame Extension's institutional role. Graduate students describe it as adaptable and stakeholder‐driven, while faculty anchor it in structured, metric‐based frameworks tied to the Cooperative Extension System. Quantitative and qualitative analyses demonstrate that Extension appointments are perceived as less prestigious than research or research‐teaching roles, exposing persistent status penalties and institutional misalignment in tenure and promotion evaluation. We conclude that current university recognition systems incentivize faculty investments away from Extension and thus require structural changes to advance Extension's part of the tripartite land‐grant mission, particularly in how Extension outputs are evaluated for tenure and promotion.
10.1002/aepp.70126.abstract_zh: 作为土地赠予使命的公共参与分支，我们认为美国农业经济学系的推广教师正面临身份十字路口，因他们在争取机构支持时遭遇困境。具体而言，我们主张推广经济学家在常轻视应用型参与的学术结构中扮演着跨界专业人士的角色。基于2025年对农业与应用经济学协会125名成员的调查，本研究考察了推广在不同职业阶段如何被定义、实践及评价。回应显示，广泛的概念共识认为推广是研究与应用之间的桥梁，强调利益相关者参与、决策支持及公共沟通。然而，教师与研究生在构建推广的机构角色方面存在差异。研究生将其描述为适应性强且以利益相关者为导向，而教师则将其锚定于与合作社推广体系相联系的、基于结构化指标框架之中。定量与定性分析表明，推广职位被视为不如研究或研究-教学职位有声望，揭示了在终身教职与晋升评估中持续存在的地位惩罚及机构错位。我们得出结论，当前大学认可体系激励教师投资偏离推广，因此需要结构性变革以推进推广在土地赠予三重使命中的部分，特别是在终身教职与晋升中如何评估推广成果方面。
10.1002/aepp.70126.title: Extension Economists: Valued in Mission, Penalized in Practice
10.1002/aepp.70126.title_zh: 推广经济学家：使命受重视，实践遭冷遇

10.1002/aepp.70127.abstract: The Livestock Mandatory Reporting Act of 1999 was enacted to facilitate price reporting and increase market transparency. With immense structural change in the cattle industry, current practices of reporting weighted average prices are becoming less meaningful. Recent studies indicate that with the collection of additional data beyond what is currently available under the act, hedonic modeling may hold potential to facilitate more meaningful price reporting. This study revisits the issue using transaction level prices from four beef packers and finds incorporating the recommended information improves hedonic models' representation of prices. Though improved model specification enhances coefficient consistency, with particularly promising results for quality grades, remaining variation in sign and significance of other daily estimated coefficients undermines the approach's ability to inform intuitive premiums and discounts for some characteristics. Future research may explore on balance the relative merit of further improvement in data collection, model specification, and increasing observations with longer multiday rolling regressions to facilitate price reporting.
10.1002/aepp.70127.abstract_zh: 1999年《牲畜强制报告法案》旨在促进价格报告并提高市场透明度。随着养牛业经历巨大结构性变革，当前报告加权平均价格的做法正逐渐失去意义。近期研究表明，若在该法案现有基础上收集更多数据，特征价格模型可能有助于实现更具意义的价格报告。本研究利用四家牛肉加工企业的交易层面价格数据重新审视此问题，发现纳入推荐信息可改善特征价格模型对价格的呈现。尽管改进的模型设定增强了系数一致性，尤其在质量等级方面结果颇具前景，但其他日常估计系数的符号和显著性仍存在波动，这削弱了该方法为某些特征提供直观溢价和折价信息的能力。未来研究可权衡进一步改进数据收集、模型设定以及通过延长多日滚动回归增加观测值的相对价值，以促进价格报告。
10.1002/aepp.70127.title: Hedonic Modeling for Fed Cattle Price Reporting and Market Transparency
10.1002/aepp.70127.title_zh: 联邦牛价格报告的享乐模型与市场透明度

10.1002/aepp.70128.abstract: Cultural capital influences a wide range of social and economic outcomes, yet quantitative measures suitable for policy analysis remain limited. We develop county‐level cultural capital indices for the US based on Bourdieu's framework of objectified, embodied, and institutionalized cultural capital. Using publicly available data and partial least squares regression, we construct six composite indicators capturing local cultural resources, institutions, norms, heritage, creative activities, and infrastructure. As an empirical application, we examine their association with Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) take‐up. Several components of cultural capital are significantly associated with SNAP take‐up rates, suggesting the indices capture meaningful place‐based variation relevant to policy analysis.
10.1002/aepp.70128.abstract_zh: 文化资本影响着广泛的社会与经济结果，然而适用于政策分析的量化测量手段仍然有限。我们基于布迪厄关于客观化、具身化及制度化文化资本的理论框架，为美国构建了县级文化资本指数。利用公开可得的数据及偏最小二乘回归方法，我们构建了六个综合指标，用以捕捉地方文化资源、制度、规范、遗产、创意活动及基础设施等方面的情况。作为实证应用，我们考察了这些指标与补充营养援助计划（SNAP）参与率之间的关联。文化资本的若干组成部分与SNAP参与率显著相关，这表明所构建的指数捕捉到了与政策分析相关且有意义的地区差异。
10.1002/aepp.70128.title:
Constructing and Validating New County‐Level Cultural Capital Indices for Applied Policy Analysis: Evidence From
                    <scp>SNAP</scp>
                    Take‐Up
10.1002/aepp.70128.title_zh: 构建并验证用于应用政策分析的县级文化资本新指数：来自SNAP参与率的证据

10.1002/ajae.70036.abstract: Abstract Global demand shifts and supply chain interventions have the potential to reduce palm oil's environmental footprint, especially in otherwise unregulated plantations. This ultimately depends on deforestation reacting to prices in upstream, complex plantation–mill systems. We produce the first microeconomic panel of geolocalized palm oil mills, and we model their influence on palm plantations across Indonesia where the issue is most critical. We leverage our data granularity and the nature of the value chain to isolate downstream mill‐gate price shocks that are exogenous to deforestation upstream. We find a positive elasticity to the mill‐gate price of crude palm oil, in general and in two specific cases of unregulated deforestation—for smallholder plantations and for illegal industrial plantations. However, smallholder deforestation decelerates as palm fruit prices increase. These results inform the design of fair and effective conservation policy.
10.1002/ajae.70036.abstract_zh: 摘要 全球需求变动与供应链干预措施有潜力减少棕榈油的环境足迹，尤其是在其他方面未受监管的种植园中。这最终取决于森林砍伐对上游复杂种植园-加工厂系统中价格的反应。我们构建了首个地理定位棕榈油加工厂的微观经济面板数据，并模拟其对印度尼西亚（这一问题最为严峻的地区）棕榈种植园的影响。我们利用数据粒度及价值链的性质，隔离出对上游森林砍伐而言外生的下游加工厂门口价格冲击。我们发现，粗棕榈油加工厂门口价格的正向弹性普遍存在，且在两种未受监管的森林砍伐特定情形下尤为显著——即小农种植园和非法工业种植园。然而，随着棕榈果价格上涨，小农砍伐速度有所减缓。这些结果为制定公平且有效的保护政策提供了参考。

10.1002/ajae.70037.abstract: This paper estimates the racial, ethnic, and gender inequities in aggregate governmental funding to field and specialty crop farmers over 2002–2017 using a well‐matched subset of the USDA Agricultural Census microdata. I employ a coarsened exact matching model to compare most similar farmers, differentiated by Black race, Hispanic ethnicity, Asian race, and woman gender. I find that Black farmers received more funding than comparable white farmers in 2012 at both the federal and state/local levels but did not have significant differences in other years. I also find that Hispanic farmers received less federal funding in 2007 than non‐Hispanic White farmers and more state and local funding in 2012, while women have funding differences in both directions over time and in particular received more conservation funding than men. Ultimately, this paper does not find broad evidence of inequities in governmental payments for racial, ethnic, or gender minorities in the matched subset of field and specialty crop farmers. I conclude with additional ways that potential inequities could be tested by future studies.
10.1002/ajae.70037.abstract_zh: 本文利用美国农业部农业普查微观数据中匹配良好的子集，估算了2002年至2017年间政府向大田作物和特种作物种植户提供的总体资金中存在的种族、民族及性别不平等现象。我采用粗化精确匹配模型，比较了在黑人种族、西班牙裔民族、亚裔种族及女性性别方面有所不同的最相似农户。研究发现，在2012年，黑人农民在联邦及州/地方层面获得的资金均多于可比白人农民，但在其他年份无显著差异。同时，2007年西班牙裔农民获得的联邦资金少于非西班牙裔白人农民，而在2012年获得的州及地方资金更多；女性农民的资金差异随时间呈现双向变化，特别是在保护资金方面，她们获得的资金多于男性。最终，本文在匹配的大田作物和特种作物种植户子集中，并未发现政府支付在种族、民族或性别少数群体中存在广泛不平等的证据。最后，我提出了未来研究可能测试潜在不平等的其他途径。

10.1002/ajae.70038.abstract: This paper is motivated by the observed discrepancy between rising price volatility and declining hedging demand in the European Union Emission Trading System (EU ETS). To investigate whether the effectiveness of carbon futures as hedging instruments persists under varying scenarios, this paper evaluates the evolving price risk in the EU carbon market and examines the role of hedging in managing the risk. It investigates tail risk (corresponding to adverse market shocks occurring under rare events) and its temporal evolution over successive phases of EU carbon policy. Price risk is assessed empirically based on a quantile vector autoregression model of marginal price distributions along with a copula evaluation of the joint distribution of futures price and spot price. Applied to EU Allowance market over the period of 2008–2023, we find that: (1) the price distributions of both spot and futures market exhibit heavy‐tailed and leptokurtosis properties, thereby highlighting the significance of tail risk under changing policy schemes, such as the four phases of the EU ETS and shifting emission and energy policies; (2) decomposing the cost of risk across quantiles, we show that the risk located at the lower tail of the price distributions plays a dominant role; (3) we propose a novel Minimum Cost‐of‐Risk method based on the quantile vector autoregression, which more effectively evaluates the overall hedging performance in terms of cost of risk reduction compared to the traditional Minimum−Variance method.
10.1002/ajae.70038.abstract_zh: 本文源于对欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）中价格波动加剧与对冲需求下降之间观察到的差异的思考。为探究碳期货作为对冲工具的有效性在不同情境下是否持续，本文评估了欧盟碳市场中不断演变的价格风险，并考察了对冲在风险管理中的作用。研究聚焦于尾部风险（对应于罕见事件下不利市场冲击）及其在欧盟碳政策各连续阶段中的时间演变。价格风险基于分位数向量自回归模型对边际价格分布进行实证评估，并结合copula方法评价期货价格与现货价格的联合分布。应用于2008年至2023年间的欧盟配额市场，我们发现：（1）现货和期货市场的价格分布均表现出厚尾和尖峰特征，从而凸显了在政策方案变化（如EU ETS的四个阶段及排放和能源政策的转变）下尾部风险的重要性；（2）通过跨分位数分解风险成本，我们表明位于价格分布下尾部的风险起主导作用；（3）我们提出一种基于分位数向量自回归的新型最小风险成本方法，与传统最小方差方法相比，该方法在风险成本降低方面能更有效地评估整体对冲绩效。

10.1002/ajae.70039.abstract: Abstract Ecolabels aim to promote sustainable production practices, but their effectiveness in incentivizing producers remains debated, particularly in settings where there are groups of producers being certified. This reflects similar challenges as in other producer programs, such as generic marketing and quality programs. In the case of fisheries, for instance, the evidence with respect to the existence of price premiums at the producer level is mixed. This is partly due to limited access to upstream data that captures variations in market demand for ecolabeled products. This study uses firm‐level data from the Norwegian cod supply chain, encompassing purchase and sales prices over 8 years for two firms, to assess if a premium is associated with the ecolabel of the Marine Stewardship Council (MSC). Our data highlight that the firms handle both MSC‐certified and uncertified cod, indicating that certification is one of several product attributes. We find that there is a premium associated with the MSC label and that it is passed upstream. In addition, product form, size, and market destination significantly influence value distribution, and regional market variation shows substantial premiums in Northern and Western Europe but none in Eastern Europe.
10.1002/ajae.70039.abstract_zh: 生态标签旨在促进可持续生产实践，但其激励生产者的有效性仍存争议，尤其是在涉及生产者群体认证的情境下。这反映了与其他生产者计划（如通用营销和质量计划）类似的挑战。以渔业为例，关于生产者层面是否存在价格溢价的证据并不一致。部分原因在于获取上游数据的途径有限，这些数据能够捕捉生态标签产品市场需求的变化。本研究利用挪威鳕鱼供应链的企业层面数据，涵盖两家企业8年间的采购和销售价格，以评估海洋管理委员会（MSC）生态标签是否与溢价相关。我们的数据表明，这些企业同时处理MSC认证和未认证的鳕鱼，表明认证仅是众多产品属性之一。我们发现，MSC标签确实与溢价相关，且该溢价向上游传递。此外，产品形态、规格和市场目的地显著影响价值分配，区域市场差异显示北欧和西欧存在显著溢价，而东欧则无溢价。

10.1002/ajae.70040.abstract: Abstract Despite its implications for global food security and sustainability, quantitative analysis of consumer food waste across countries and over time is scarce. We examine food waste dynamics across 145 countries from 1995 to 2013 by modeling uneaten calories as a form of household‐level technical inefficiency, using an input distance function within a panel stochastic frontier framework. Unlike prior studies that rely on production functions, our input‐oriented specification reflects consumer behavior by treating body mass as a predetermined level and analyzing the calories required to sustain it—aligning the specification with consumer behavior. The panel structure allows decomposition of inefficiency into time‐invariant (persistent) and time‐varying (transient) components and clarifies development‐related factors associated with food waste. Our results show that persistent inefficiency is the dominant source of household food waste, with fruit and vegetable consumption associated with higher overall levels of transient inefficiency. We find evidence of an inverted‐U (Kuznets‐style) relationship, where food waste tends to rise at lower income levels but declines as countries become wealthier. Between 1995 and 2013, global food waste increased by an estimated 336 million metric tons, with middle‐income countries—particularly Brazil, Russia, India, and China—accounting for a large share of the rise. This novel application establishes a foundational, generalizable framework for longitudinal, indirect measurement of food waste across spatial scales and levels of aggregation. Additionally, by decomposing inefficiency into persistent and transient components, this framework enables dynamic computable general equilibrium and partial equilibrium simulations, integrated with life‐cycle assessment, that distinguish structural changes from short‐run shocks.
10.1002/ajae.70040.abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管消费者食物浪费对全球粮食安全和可持续性具有重要影响，但跨国家、跨时间的定量分析仍然稀缺。我们通过将未消耗卡路里建模为家庭层面技术无效率的一种形式，利用面板随机前沿框架中的投入距离函数，考察了1995年至2013年间145个国家的食物浪费动态。与以往依赖生产函数的研究不同，我们的投入导向规范通过将体重视为预定水平并分析维持该体重所需的卡路里来反映消费者行为——从而使规范与消费者行为保持一致。面板结构允许将无效率分解为时间不变（持久性）和时间变化（暂时性）成分，并阐明与食物浪费相关的发展因素。我们的结果表明，持久性无效率是家庭食物浪费的主要来源，水果和蔬菜消费与较高水平的整体暂时性无效率相关。我们发现了倒U型（库兹涅茨式）关系的证据，即食物浪费在较低收入水平时趋于上升，但随着国家变得更加富裕而下降。在1995年至2013年间，全球食物浪费估计增加了3.36亿公吨，其中中等收入国家——尤其是巴西、俄罗斯、印度和中国——占据了增长的大部分份额。这一新颖的应用建立了一个基础性、可推广的框架，用于跨空间尺度和聚合层面对食物浪费进行纵向、间接测量。此外，通过将无效率分解为持久性和暂时性成分，该框架能够实现动态可计算一般均衡和局部均衡模拟，并与生命周期评估相结合，从而区分结构性变化与短期冲击。

10.1002/ajae.70041.abstract: Abstract Growing recognition of biodiversity's role in supporting agricultural productivity has prompted economists and other scholars to quantify the “productive value” of crop biodiversity using observational data from real‐world conditions. We present the first meta‐analysis of that literature, drawing on 158 estimates from 52 observational studies published between 1998 and 2025. Overall, crop biodiversity exhibits a positive and statistically significant effect on agricultural productivity, with an average elasticity of 0.75—meaning a 1% increase in crop biodiversity (proxied by diversity indexes) raises agricultural outcomes by 0.75%. Yet, this average masks considerable heterogeneity across and within studies (standard deviation of 1.23). Complementary meta‐regression analyses attribute much of this heterogeneity to differences in research settings: biodiversity indexes based on species richness yield larger effects than evenness‐based ones, profit‐related outcomes show stronger associations with biodiversity than production‐related ones, and instrumental variable estimates exceed those from other methods. We further detect signs of selective reporting in our sample, with published estimates clustering just above conventional significance thresholds. Adjusting for this bias reduces average effects substantially, though the corrected evidence still points toward a positive—though more modest—productive value of crop biodiversity.
10.1002/ajae.70041.abstract_zh: 摘要 生物多样性在支撑农业生产率中的作用日益受到认可，促使经济学家及其他学者利用现实世界条件下的观测数据，量化作物生物多样性的“生产价值”。我们对该领域文献进行了首次元分析，基于1998年至2025年间发表的52项观测研究中的158个估计值。总体而言，作物生物多样性对农业生产率表现出正向且统计显著的影响，平均弹性为0.75——这意味着作物生物多样性（以多样性指数为代理）每增加1%，农业产出将提高0.75%。然而，这一平均值掩盖了研究内部及研究间显著的异质性（标准差为1.23）。补充的元回归分析将这种异质性大部分归因于研究设置的差异：基于物种丰富度的生物多样性指数所产生的效应大于基于均匀度的指数；与利润相关的产出结果显示出比生产相关结果更强的生物多样性关联；工具变量估计值则超过其他方法所得结果。我们进一步检测到样本中存在选择性报告的迹象，已发表估计值聚集在常规显著性阈值略上方。对此偏差进行调整后，平均效应大幅降低，尽管修正后的证据仍指向正向——但更为温和——的作物生物多样性生产价值。

10.1002/ajae.70042.abstract: Abstract Germany's Renewable Energy Sources Act (REA), enacted in 2000 and subsequently amended, subsidized national renewable energy production with fixed feed‐in tariffs for renewable energy sources (RE) from wind, solar, and biogas. Empirical studies suggest that the policy was creating windfall effects for landowners and attribute farmland use homogenization to the policy. Empirical evidence, however, lacks a comprehensive and systemic analysis of the REA impact on farmland values, farm structures, and farmland heterogeneity. To understand the policy's impact channels, we propose five hypotheses, build a spatial price theory‐informed structural equation model (SEM) and test it on a rich dataset of land transactions and land uses for the Federal State of Brandenburg, 2005–2018. The SEM uncovers direct impact channels on farmland prices from an increased willingness to pay more in proximity to wind turbines and biogas plants, and on farmland heterogeneity by incentivizing maize‐based homogenous crop rotations. Indirect impact channels for biogas promotion on land prices via altering the farm structure reveal additional and larger impacts than previous studies suggested. Approximately 9% of the price increase could be attributed to the RE expansion over the study period. Future policy amendments should take such a systemic perspective and counteract adverse effects.
10.1002/ajae.70042.abstract_zh: 摘要 德国《可再生能源法》（REA）自2000年颁布并历经修订，通过为风能、太阳能及沼气等可再生能源（RE）设定固定上网电价，对国内可再生能源生产给予补贴。实证研究表明，该政策为土地所有者带来了意外收益，并将农田利用的同质化归因于此政策。然而，现有实证证据缺乏对REA影响农田价值、农场结构及农田异质性的全面系统性分析。为理解该政策的影响渠道，我们提出五项假设，构建了一个基于空间价格理论的结构方程模型（SEM），并利用勃兰登堡州2005年至2018年间丰富的土地交易与土地利用数据对其进行检验。SEM揭示了直接的影响渠道：靠近风力涡轮机和沼气厂区域的土地支付意愿增加，从而推高农田价格；同时，政策通过激励以玉米为主的同质化轮作模式，影响农田异质性。对于沼气推广通过改变农场结构间接影响土地价格的渠道，本研究发现其影响程度较以往研究更为显著且规模更大。在研究期间，约9%的价格上涨可归因于可再生能源的扩张。未来的政策修订应采取此类系统性视角，并应对不利效应加以遏制。

10.1002/ajae.70043.abstract: Abstract Understanding how information and/or information systems can help reduce the spread of foodborne illness, especially among vulnerable populations, is of first‐order policy relevance. In 2008, the South Korean government introduced an early warning system for foodborne illness outbreaks in all schools. This action was in response to a 2006 outbreak that sickened over 3600 students in 46 schools in the greater Seoul area. The EWS mandates schools track food items and suppliers such that schools can be alerted when an outbreak occurs. This study evaluates the effects of this warning system using administrative panel data in South Korea for 10 school years (2002–2011). We find the areas that had a higher pre‐policy prevalence of foodborne illness had the largest decrease in foodborne illness‐related costs after the implementation of the Early Warning System. In general, outbreaks of foodborne illness (of any type) fell by about 18.5% and the overall number of cases fell by 0.4%. When we compare changes in illnesses in schools versus other food sources (e.g., homes or restaurants) we find less evidence that the EWS reduced illness. Back‐of‐the‐envelope calculations indicate that the EWS reduced the annual cost of foodborne illness by at least $0.4 million per year, upwards of $2.9 million.
10.1002/ajae.70043.abstract_zh: 摘要 理解信息和/或信息系统如何有助于减少食源性疾病的传播，尤其是在弱势群体中，具有首要的政策相关性。2008年，韩国政府在所有学校引入了食源性疾病暴发早期预警系统。此举是对2006年一次暴发的回应，该次暴发导致首尔周边地区46所学校的3600多名学生患病。EWS要求学校追踪食品项目和供应商，以便在暴发发生时能够向学校发出警报。本研究利用韩国10个学年（2002-2011年）的行政面板数据评估了这一预警系统的效果。我们发现，在政策实施前食源性疾病患病率较高的地区，在早期预警系统实施后，与食源性疾病相关的成本下降幅度最大。总体而言，任何类型的食源性疾病暴发下降了约18.5%，总病例数下降了0.4%。当我们将学校中的疾病变化与其他食品来源（如家庭或餐馆）进行比较时，几乎没有证据表明EWS减少了疾病。粗略计算表明，EWS每年将食源性疾病成本至少减少了40万美元，最高可达290万美元。

10.1002/ajae.70045.abstract: Our general interest is in global trade loss from livestock pathogens, specifically exports. We adopt a causal inference approach that considers animal disease outbreaks over time as non‐staggered binary treatments with the potential for switching in (infection) and out of treatment (recovery) within the sample period. The outcome evolution of switchers and non‐switchers identifies the treatment effects. Using a recently proposed dynamic difference‐in‐differences estimator, we estimate the treatment effects that decompose into “infected” (switch in) and “recovered” (switch out) effects. As a case study, we investigate the global impacts of foot and mouth disease outbreaks on meat exports using panel data across 178 countries from 1996 to 2016. We find that the outbreak decreases meat export by 19,000 to 48,000 metric tons per year (14% ‐ 35% of the mean annual meat export) in the 5 years following an outbreak, which is brought about by a decline in the infected countries' meat exports, while the disease‐recovered countries do not fully regain the export losses even after 5 years. The average total effect is estimated at about 54,000 metric tons per outbreak over 5 years following an outbreak, resulting in an export revenue loss of $141 million. Asymmetric post‐infection and post‐recovery trade losses imply a significant disease burden on the endemic regions. Regional decomposition of treatment effects reveals that while the magnitude of export loss is greater for the non‐endemic regions, the relative magnitude (compared to the mean annual export per country) is many times higher in the endemic regions.
10.1002/ajae.70045.abstract_zh: 我们的核心关注点在于牲畜病原体导致的全球贸易损失，特别是出口方面。我们采用因果推断方法，将样本期内动物疫病爆发视为非交错二元处理，并允许在处理状态（感染）与非处理状态（恢复）之间转换。通过比较转换者与非转换者的结果演变来识别处理效应。利用一种近期提出的动态双重差分估计器，我们估计了分解为“感染”（进入处理）和“恢复”（退出处理）效应的处理效应。作为案例研究，我们利用1996年至2016年间178个国家的面板数据，探讨了口蹄疫爆发对肉类出口的全球影响。研究发现，爆发后5年内，肉类出口每年减少19,000至48,000公吨（占年均肉类出口量的14%至35%），这源于感染国肉类出口的下降，而疫病恢复国即使在5年后也未能完全弥补出口损失。平均总效应估计为每次爆发后5年内约54,000公吨，导致出口收入损失达1.41亿美元。感染后与恢复后贸易损失的不对称性表明，地方性流行地区承受着显著的疾病负担。处理效应的区域分解显示，虽然非地方性流行地区的出口损失绝对值更大，但在地方性流行地区，相对损失（与各国年均出口量相比）高出数倍。

10.1002/ajae.70057.abstract: This study examines the impact of soil erosion on agricultural land values in the United States (US) Midwest. Based on a novel county‐level panel data set with information on soil erosion levels and agricultural land values covering five census years (1997, 2002, 2007, 2012, and 2017), we separately investigate the direct effect of two types of soil erosion—water and wind erosion—on county‐level average agricultural land values. Linear panel fixed effects econometric models and a number of robustness checks are used to achieve the study objective. We find that increasing soil erosion levels have a statistically significant negative impact on agricultural land values at the county level. Our findings confirm that damages to the soil from water or wind erosion are capitalized into lower farmland values. The study provides new insights in terms of further understanding the economic damages due to soil erosion and the likely benefits from soil erosion control.
10.1002/ajae.70057.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了美国中西部土壤侵蚀对农业土地价值的影响。基于一项新颖的县级面板数据集，该数据集涵盖了1997年、2002年、2007年、2012年和2017年五个普查年度的土壤侵蚀程度与农业土地价值信息，我们分别考察了两种类型的土壤侵蚀——水蚀和风蚀——对县级平均农业土地价值的直接影响。为实现研究目标，我们采用了线性面板固定效应计量经济模型及多项稳健性检验。研究发现，土壤侵蚀程度的加剧对县级农业土地价值具有统计上显著的负面影响。我们的结果证实，水蚀或风蚀对土壤造成的损害会资本化为较低的农田价值。本研究为深入理解土壤侵蚀造成的经济损失及土壤侵蚀防治可能带来的效益提供了新的见解。

10.1002/ajae.70058.abstract: The online food delivery (OFD) industry has witnessed substantial global expansion. In this study, we examine how OFD platforms in China affect the food safety conditions of restaurants. Given the difficulty quantifying food safety, we first propose a machine learning approach to construct a restaurant‐specific food safety risk indicator based on online customer reviews. The approach features high‐frequency continuous measurements with complete geographic coverage. We also conducted an event study and found that the food safety risk in restaurants decreased significantly in response to OFD platforms, with the effects concentrated in the five quarters including the entry period. Our mechanism analysis suggests that this improvement might come from extended market information, strengthened market competition, and heightened supervision and regulation. The impact is also more pronounced for chain restaurants, restaurants that are relatively popular and expensive, and restaurants offering low‐risk food items.
10.1002/ajae.70058.abstract_zh: 在线餐饮外卖（OFD）行业在全球范围内经历了显著扩张。本研究考察了中国OFD平台如何影响餐厅的食品安全状况。鉴于食品安全难以量化，我们首先提出一种基于在线顾客评论的机器学习方法，以构建餐厅特定食品安全风险指标。该方法具有高频连续测量和完整地理覆盖的特点。我们还进行了事件研究，发现OFD平台的进入显著降低了餐厅的食品安全风险，且该效应集中在包括进入期在内的五个季度内。机制分析表明，这一改善可能源于市场信息的扩展、市场竞争的加强以及监管力度的提升。此外，该影响对于连锁餐厅、相对受欢迎且价格较高的餐厅以及提供低风险食品的餐厅更为显著。

10.1002/ajae.70059.abstract: Abstract Crop insurance is undoubtedly an extremely valuable element in protecting agricultural businesses, but in many cases standard indemnity‐based products have had very low uptake due to high transaction costs elevating premiums to unaffordable levels. Index insurance options in which coverage is written on a publicly observable “trigger” (involving much lower transaction costs) have begun to fill the void. In almost all of the previous economics literature on index insurance, the only variable that the insurance demander is permitted to choose is the payment to be received should the index trigger value be verified. However, it is clear that the trigger value itself is an integral element in the contract, and it is an element about which the insurance demander has clear preferences. In this article, we analyze the optimal demand for index insurance under the assumption that the demander can choose both the payment to be received if the index trigger is satisfied and the trigger value itself. We find that there is always an interior solution to this problem. We also consider the market equilibria that emerge under a variety of settings in regard to the position of the insurer. The article is cast within the scope of insurance for frost damage to a crop, but all of the results are directly applicable to any peril for which a publicly observable signal exists. The article shows that allowing the demander to choose both indemnity and trigger value should increase uptake of index insurance products.
10.1002/ajae.70059.abstract_zh: 摘要 农作物保险无疑是保护农业经营中极具价值的要素，但在许多情况下，基于标准赔偿的保险产品因高交易成本导致保费升至难以负担的水平，其参保率一直很低。以公开可观察的“触发值”为基础（涉及较低交易成本）的指数保险选项已开始填补这一空白。在以往几乎所有关于指数保险的经济学文献中，保险需求方唯一被允许选择的变量是当指数触发值得到验证时应获得的赔付金额。然而，显然触发值本身是合同的一个组成部分，且保险需求方对此具有明确的偏好。本文在假设需求方既能选择指数触发条件满足时应获得的赔付金额，又能选择触发值本身的情况下，分析了指数保险的最优需求。我们发现该问题始终存在内部解。我们还考虑了在保险公司所处位置的各种设定下出现的市场均衡。本文以农作物霜冻损害保险为背景展开，但所有结果直接适用于任何存在公开可观察信号的灾害类型。研究表明，允许需求方同时选择赔付金额和触发值应能提高指数保险产品的参保率。

10.1002/ajae.70060.abstract: Abstract Federal and state‐owned public lands occupy a significant proportion of many U.S. urban regions, contributing to two highly‐valued, nontradable goods: viewscapes and outdoor recreational opportunities. Yet, public lands have not been adequately addressed in the urban quality‐of‐life (QOL) literature. We argue that much of the previous literature has (1) used a geographic level of aggregation that has not been extensive enough to capture all the public lands that influence wage and housing equilibria, (2) often defined public lands measures too narrowly and has excluded over 50% of public land influencing hedonic equilibria, and (3) has rarely attempted to control for public lands endogeneity when quasi‐experimental approaches are infeasible. Using GIS and Census data for U.S. urban areas, along with instruments rooted in the 19th century land disposal policies, we estimate how publicly owned federal and state lands contribute to urban QOL. Our preferred specifications are based on Bureau of Census defined Combined Statistical Areas that are linear in public land variables, and the results are robust regardless of geographic aggregation and model specification. Welfare calculations indicate that the annual urban household willingness‐to‐pay estimate for a one percent increase in public land ranges between $80.58 and $130.29. Our study contributes to the literature by establishing land grant railroads as an exogenous instrument for public lands and by providing a framework for evaluating the welfare consequences of proposed land exchanges and other changes in land ownership or management.
10.1002/ajae.70060.abstract_zh: 摘要：联邦和州所有的公共土地在美国许多城市区域中占据显著比例，为这些地区贡献了两种高价值且不可交易的商品：景观视野和户外休闲机会。然而，公共土地在城市生活质量（QOL）文献中尚未得到充分探讨。我们认为，以往文献大多存在以下问题：（1）使用的地理聚合层级不够广泛，未能涵盖所有影响工资和住房均衡的公共土地；（2）对公共土地的定义往往过于狭窄，排除了超过50%影响特征均衡的公共土地；（3）在准实验方法不可行时，很少尝试控制公共土地的内生性。利用美国城市区域的GIS和人口普查数据，以及根植于19世纪土地处置政策的工具变量，我们估算了联邦和州公共土地对城市生活质量的贡献。我们偏好的规格基于人口普查局定义的合并统计区，这些区域在公共土地变量上是线性的，且结果在地理聚合和模型规格变化下均保持稳健。福利计算表明，公共土地每增加1%，城市家庭年支付意愿估计在80.58美元至130.29美元之间。本研究通过将土地赠予铁路确立为公共土地的外生工具变量，并为评估拟议土地交换及其他土地所有权或管理变更的福利后果提供框架，为文献做出了贡献。

10.1002/ajae.70061.abstract: Abstract While multiple factors explain low adoption rates of improved varieties by small‐scale farmers in sub‐Saharan Africa, a key supply‐side constraint is the limited availability of seed embodying new traits in the volume, quality, price, and timeliness required by farmers. This constraint is partly attributable to classical failures in the market for seeds and traits. Historically, governments have remedied this failure by allocating public resources to varietal improvement and seed distribution. In 2011, the Government of Ethiopia launched a novel experiment—the direct seed marketing approach—to encourage private seed investment in the country's seed system and to reduce the state's footprint in the system. Direct seed marketing incentivized seed companies to sell directly to farmers rather than through state distribution channels. This study provides the first quantitative assessment of the impact of direct seed marketing based on key indicators of a robust seed system: access to seed and farm‐level productivity. Using a quasi‐experimental difference‐in‐differences approach suitable to handling variation in treatment timing, we find that direct seed marketing increased the share of farmers purchasing fresh maize seed by 15 percentage points. It also raised the quantity of maize seed purchased by 45% and improved maize yields by 18%. In contrast, direct seed marketing had no effect on wheat seed purchases and yields. These crop‐specific differences likely reflect underlying differences in the reproductive biology of maize and wheat, highlighting the importance of crop‐specific policy design, institutional arrangements, and market development strategies to accelerate the adoption of improved varieties.
10.1002/ajae.70061.abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管多种因素解释了撒哈拉以南非洲小农户对改良品种采用率低的原因，但一个关键的供给侧制约因素是以农民所需的数量、质量、价格和及时性提供体现新性状的种子供应有限。这一制约部分归因于种子和性状市场中的典型失灵。历史上，政府通过将公共资源分配给品种改良和种子分销来弥补这一失灵。2011年，埃塞俄比亚政府启动了一项新颖的实验——直接种子营销方法——以鼓励私营部门在该国种子体系中的投资，并减少国家在该体系中的足迹。直接种子营销激励种子公司直接向农民销售，而非通过国家分销渠道。本研究基于稳健种子体系的关键指标——种子获取和农场层面生产力——首次对直接种子营销的影响进行了定量评估。采用适合处理处理时间变化的准实验双重差分方法，我们发现直接种子营销使购买新鲜玉米种子的农民比例提高了15个百分点。它还使购买的玉米种子数量增加了45%，并将玉米产量提高了18%。相比之下，直接种子营销对小麦种子购买和产量没有影响。这些作物特异性差异可能反映了玉米和小麦生殖生物学上的根本差异，凸显了作物特异性政策设计、制度安排和市场发展战略在加速改良品种采用方面的重要性。

10.1002/ajae.70062.abstract: Abstract Poor animal health is a central concern in modern livestock production. Despite the necessity to incorporate animal health in efficiency analysis, the theoretical and empirical developments are limited on this subject. This article appropriately characterizes the axiomatic properties of animal health within a production framework. We treat animal health as a weakly disposable output with characteristics of an input and an output, which permits computing animal health‐adjusted efficiency measures and shadow prices of animal health. The application considers 980 observations of Swedish dairy farms over the years 2009–2016. We use a Benefit‐of‐the‐Doubt approach for assessing animal health, which captures its multiple dimensions with weights being optimized for each farmer. Applying a random sample‐split procedure within a Data Envelopment Analysis framework, we statistically verify the extent to which inclusion of animal health in the production framework changes the efficiency estimates. The results show that including animal health in production analysis increases the average efficiency estimates from 0.900 to 0.973, a finding that largely also holds in a statistical sense. The shadow prices of animal health are mostly positive, which indicates a general willingness to accept lower levels of production for higher levels of animal health. Our findings suggest the importance of incorporating animal health into efficiency analysis.
10.1002/ajae.70062.abstract_zh: 摘要 动物健康水平低下是现代畜牧生产中的一个核心问题。尽管在效率分析中纳入动物健康因素十分必要，但相关理论与实证研究在此领域的发展仍较为有限。本文在生产框架内恰当地刻画了动物健康的公理性质。我们将动物健康视为一种弱可处置产出，兼具投入与产出的特征，从而能够计算经动物健康调整的效率测度及动物健康的影子价格。应用部分基于2009年至2016年间瑞典奶牛场的980个观测数据。我们采用“怀疑利益”方法评估动物健康，该方法通过为每位农户优化权重来捕捉动物健康的多维特征。在数据包络分析框架内应用随机样本分割程序，我们从统计上验证了将动物健康纳入生产框架对效率估计的改变程度。结果表明，将动物健康纳入生产分析后，平均效率估计值从0.900提升至0.973，这一发现在统计意义上也基本成立。动物健康的影子价格大多为正，表明普遍存在以较低生产水平换取较高动物健康水平的意愿。我们的研究结果表明，将动物健康纳入效率分析具有重要意义。

10.1002/ajae.70063.abstract: This paper develops a new framework for quantifying cost pass‐through in a small open economy by estimating firm‐level markup responses to agricultural import price shocks. We show theoretically that markup adjustments depend on firms' reliance on imported inputs and demand curvature, generating heterogeneous inflationary effects across firm types. For empirical implementation, we postulate a Leontief production structure that expresses pass‐through elasticity as a function of observed markup behavior and imported crop dependence. Using data on 10,911 South Korean food manufacturers from 2000 to 2021, we document considerable market power and increasing polarization in markups, particularly led by high‐markup firms. Markup elasticities under strategic pricing decisions differ across sectors and firm types, with particularly strong effects for non‐large firms exhibiting low reliance on imported crops. Our firm‐level pass‐through measure reveals stable aggregate patterns over time but uncovers considerable heterogeneity—most notably, rising pass‐through among firms less dependent on foreign crops. These findings illustrate how cost shocks propagate through strategic pricing and underscore the importance of firm heterogeneity in evaluating equilibrium pass‐through.
10.1002/ajae.70063.abstract_zh: 本文开发了一个新框架，用于量化小型开放经济体中的成本传导效应，通过估计企业层面应对农业进口价格冲击的加成率反应。我们从理论上证明，加成调整取决于企业对进口投入品的依赖程度及需求曲率，从而在不同类型企业间产生异质性的通胀效应。在实证实施中，我们假设一个列昂惕夫生产结构，将传导弹性表示为观测到的加成行为与进口作物依赖度的函数。利用2000年至2021年间10，911家韩国食品制造企业的数据，我们记录了显著的市场力量及加成率日益两极化的趋势，尤其以高加成企业为主导。在战略定价决策下，加成弹性因行业和企业类型而异，其中对进口作物依赖度较低的非大型企业影响尤为显著。我们的企业层面传导指标揭示了随时间稳定的总体模式，但同时也发现了显著的异质性——最值得注意的是，对外国作物依赖度较低的企业传导率上升。这些发现阐明了成本冲击如何通过战略定价传播，并强调了企业异质性在评估均衡传导中的重要性。

10.1002/ajae.70064.abstract: Abstract Large‐scale land reforms constitute a substantial redistribution of wealth and reallocation of agricultural land, which is a major form of asset and production input in developing countries. While land redistribution (from the rich to the poor) remains a highly controversial issue, extensive evidence on its effect is limited. Using the most comprehensive global dataset on land reforms available to date, we investigate the impact of redistributive land reforms on agricultural productivity, along with the resulting structural change in the economy. First, we document that these reforms reduce per‐hectare agricultural output and agricultural mechanization by a statistically significant and quantitatively large amount. Second, these effects get worse with repeated redistributions, underpinning the potentially detrimental impact of ownership insecurity arising from frequent redistributions. Third, we find that the employment share of agriculture increases while the shares of industry and service sectors decrease. Importantly, this reallocation of labor occurs despite falling labor productivity in agriculture, which to begin with is lower than in industry and services, suggesting a reduction in real GDP.
10.1002/ajae.70064.abstract_zh: 摘要 大规模土地改革构成了财富的实质性再分配和农业用地的重新配置，而农业用地在发展中国家是资产和生产投入的主要形式。尽管土地再分配（从富裕者到贫困者）仍是一个极具争议的问题，但关于其影响的广泛证据却十分有限。利用迄今为止可用的最全面的全球土地改革数据集，我们研究了再分配性土地改革对农业生产率的影响，以及由此产生的经济结构变化。首先，我们记录到这些改革显著且数量上大幅降低了每公顷农业产出和农业机械化水平。其次，这些效应在反复再分配中加剧，凸显了频繁再分配所引发的所有权不安全感可能带来的不利影响。第三，我们发现农业的就业份额增加，而工业和服务业部门的份额减少。重要的是，这种劳动力重新配置发生在农业劳动生产率下降的情况下，而农业劳动生产率本就低于工业和服务业，这表明实际国内生产总值有所减少。

10.1002/ajae.70065.abstract: ER (KSS) program, a 6-month, school-based intervention evaluated through a clustered randomized control trial in rural Appalachia to reduce sugar-sweetened beverage (SSB) consumption among 7th-grade students. KSS includes a classroom-based student component (KSS-S) grounded in the Theory of Planned Behavior and health literacy, and a caregiver component (KSS-C) delivered through two-way text messaging to modify household beverage practices. Using structural equation modeling grounded in a Stackelberg household production framework, we estimate how behavioral strategies, health literacy, and caregiver-child decision-making jointly shape students' SSB intake. Stronger behavioral intentions are associated with a 5.30 oz/day reduction (p<0.01), and the caregiver decision index (capturing household rules, availability, and role modeling) corresponds to a 16.41 oz/day reduction. KSS-S reduces intake by 6.42 oz/day (p<0.05), largely through a direct pathway (6.23 oz/day, p<0.05). KSS-C reduces intake by 4.22 oz/day, primarily through caregiver-mediated effects (3.36 oz/day). Combined, both components reduced students' SSB consumption by 10.64 oz/day (36% from baseline) (p<0.01). We use the estimated structural parameters to simulate hypothetical SSB tax scenarios, finding that KSS achieves reductions comparable to those generated by modest tax rates. This suggests that school-based behavioral interventions like KSS can function as complementary or alternative policy tools. By identifying causal mechanisms and enabling counterfactual policy simulations within a unified framework, the structural approach provides richer policy insights than average treatment effects alone.
10.1002/ajae.70065.abstract_zh: ER（KSS）项目是一项为期6个月的校本干预，通过集群随机对照试验在阿巴拉契亚农村地区评估，旨在减少七年级学生的含糖饮料（SSB）消费。KSS包括基于计划行为理论和健康素养的课堂学生组成部分（KSS-S），以及通过双向短信传递以改变家庭饮料实践的家庭照护者组成部分（KSS-C）。基于Stackelberg家庭生产框架，运用结构方程模型，我们估计了行为策略、健康素养及照护者-儿童决策如何共同影响学生的SSB摄入量。更强的行为意图与每日减少5.30盎司相关（p<0.01），而照护者决策指数（涵盖家庭规则、可得性和榜样作用）对应每日减少16.41盎司。KSS-S使摄入量每日减少6.42盎司（p<0.05），主要通过直接路径实现（每日减少6.23盎司，p<0.05）。KSS-C使摄入量每日减少4.22盎司，主要通过照护者中介效应（每日减少3.36盎司）。两者结合，将学生的SSB消费每日减少10.64盎司（较基线下降36%）（p<0.01）。我们利用估计的结构参数模拟假设的SSB税收情景，发现KSS实现的减少效果与适度税率产生的效果相当。这表明像KSS这样的校本行为干预可以作为互补或替代的政策工具。通过在统一框架内识别因果机制并进行反事实政策模拟，结构方法比仅依赖平均处理效应提供了更丰富的政策洞见。

10.1002/ajae.70066.abstract: Abstract Experimental methods have gained significant traction in agricultural economics in recent decades through the growing use of laboratory experiments, lab‐in‐the‐field studies, and experimental designs embedded in online surveys. However, replicability remains a persistent challenge and a critical benchmark for rigor in experimental economics research. Previous studies showed a strong correlation between statistical power and replicability, highlighting the importance of combining sample size with optimal study design to maximize power in experimental economics research. Despite power analysis being well established in randomized controlled trials, experimental economists have had to rely on rules of thumb (e.g., allocate equal number of subjects to each group), which may not guarantee optimal power. In this study, we propose an adaptive treatment assignment procedure to improve statistical power in experimental studies, using an experimental design that updates the researcher's beliefs about the standard deviation ratio of outcomes under different treatments. We simulate experimental data collection under different updating rules to test the expected gains in power compared to the naïve (conventional) method of equal treatment assignment. Our results show significant gains in power under our proposed adaptive procedures compared to equal treatment assignment. These gains in power are directly proportional to the standard deviation ratio between treatments. Importantly, the power achieved under our proposed adaptive treatment assignment procedures was consistently almost identical to the maximum theoretical power achievable given the study parameters. We thus provide a practical and easy‐to‐use tool that can help researchers optimize treatment assignment in their experimental studies to maximize power.
10.1002/ajae.70066.abstract_zh: 摘要 近几十年来，通过实验室实验、实地实验室研究和嵌入在线调查的实验设计的日益普及，实验方法在农业经济学中获得了显著关注。然而，可复制性仍然是实验经济学研究中一个持续的挑战，也是衡量严谨性的关键基准。以往研究表明，统计功效与可复制性之间存在强相关性，凸显了在实验经济学研究中将样本量与最优研究设计相结合以最大化功效的重要性。尽管功效分析在随机对照试验中已得到充分确立，但实验经济学家不得不依赖经验法则（例如，将相同数量的受试者分配到各组），这可能无法保证最优功效。在本研究中，我们提出了一种自适应处理分配程序，以提高实验研究中的统计功效，该实验设计会更新研究者对不同处理下结果标准差比率的信念。我们模拟了不同更新规则下的实验数据收集过程，以检验与朴素（传统）等量处理分配方法相比，功效的预期提升。我们的结果显示，与等量处理分配相比，我们提出的自适应程序在功效方面有显著提升。这些功效提升与处理间的标准差比率成正比。重要的是，在我们提出的自适应处理分配程序下实现的功效，始终与给定研究参数下可达到的最大理论功效几乎一致。因此，我们提供了一个实用且易于使用的工具，可帮助研究人员优化其实验研究中的处理分配，以最大化功效。

10.1002/ajae.70067.abstract: This paper explores within‐country variations in food price dynamics and food poverty estimates by employing local market price data and national consumer price index (CPI) data. Our results show that national CPI data may be useful for approximating national trends but they fail to detect and identify spatial variations in local trends, which have relevant welfare implications. Indeed, sourcing cereal prices from local markets, instead of national CPI statistics, leads to classification divergences in 9% of food poverty predictions, with a substantial variation in estimation errors across countries. Our findings thus underscore the need for the systematic collection of local price data to ensure effective policymaking, such as adjusting social transfers to better reflect local differences and optimizing the allocation of social funds.
10.1002/ajae.70067.abstract_zh: 本文通过运用地方市场价格数据与全国居民消费价格指数（CPI）数据，探讨了食品价格动态及食品贫困估计的国内差异。研究结果显示，全国CPI数据虽有助于近似反映全国趋势，但无法捕捉和识别地方趋势中的空间差异，而这些差异对福利具有重要影响。实际上，若从地方市场获取谷物价格而非依赖全国CPI统计，会导致9%的食品贫困预测出现分类偏差，且各国间的估计误差差异显著。因此，我们的研究结果强调了系统收集地方价格数据的必要性，以确保政策制定的有效性，例如调整社会转移支付以更好地反映地方差异，并优化社会资金的分配。

10.1002/ajae.70068.abstract: Abstract Perennial crops are economically important. They contribute to food security, providing essential nutrients that are often lacking in annual crops, and provide additional environmental benefits compared with annual crops. Despite their importance, empirical research on the impacts of climate change and adaptation on perennial crops remains limited. We model the phenological characteristics of major perennial crops in California and take adaptation into consideration to estimate the effects of temperature and precipitation on yields in both the short run and long run. Our findings indicate that weather impacts vary across the four phenological phases—dormancy, bloom, fruit development, and fruit maturity. Specifically, warming during the dormancy phase reduces walnut yields and warming during the bloom phase reduces almond yields in both the short‐run and long‐run. These long‐run negative impacts suggest that adaptation has not offset the adverse effects of winter warming on these crops. On the other hand, warming in the fruit maturity phase positively affects almond yields, especially in the long run, suggesting that adaptation has taken advantage of rising temperatures to increase almond yields. Our findings provide valuable insights for targeted adaptation strategies to enhance the resilience of perennial crop production in the face of climate change.
10.1002/ajae.70068.abstract_zh: 摘要 多年生作物在经济上具有重要意义。它们有助于粮食安全，提供一年生作物往往缺乏的必需营养素，并且与一年生作物相比具有额外的环境效益。尽管其重要性不言而喻，但关于气候变化及其适应对多年生作物影响的实证研究仍然有限。我们模拟了加利福尼亚州主要多年生作物的物候特征，并将适应措施纳入考量，以估算温度和降水对短期及长期产量的影响。研究结果表明，天气影响在四个物候阶段——休眠期、开花期、果实发育期和果实成熟期——之间存在差异。具体而言，休眠期升温会降低核桃产量，而开花期升温则会降低杏仁产量，在短期和长期内均如此。这些长期负面影响表明，适应措施尚未抵消冬季升温对这些作物的不利影响。另一方面，果实成熟期升温对杏仁产量产生积极影响，尤其是在长期内，这表明适应措施已利用气温上升来提高杏仁产量。我们的研究为制定有针对性的适应策略提供了宝贵见解，以增强多年生作物生产在气候变化面前的韧性。

10.1002/ajae.70070.abstract: Abstract Trade liberalization is central to development strategy in low‐ and middle‐income countries, yet its social costs, particularly for poor rural households, remain poorly understood and rarely offset by policy. Greater openness to trade generates benefits through lower prices, product diversity, and export earnings, but heightened import competition can reduce income and employment in exposed sectors, potentially increasing crime by lowering the opportunity cost of illicit activity. Rising agricultural import competition is particularly concerning given that poverty in the developing world is disproportionately rural and that large shares of the labor force depend on smallholder farming. Here, using panel data from 887 Colombian municipalities and a shift‐share instrumental variables approach, we show that the U.S.‐Colombia Free Trade Agreement of 2012—by intensifying import competition in corn and beans—raised home burglaries and robberies of individuals by 16% and 6%, respectively, while reducing business robberies by 13%. Crime impacts were concentrated in Andean municipalities and non‐coca‐producing regions, reflecting the vulnerability of smallholder traditional corn producers to a surge of cheap U.S. imports and the limited economic alternatives available in those areas. Unlike prior studies from Mexico and Brazil, we find non‐robust evidence of impacts on homicides—a divergence explained by Colombia's context of de‐escalating armed conflict, which dampened extreme violence while leaving economically motivated property crime fully exposed. These results call for agricultural trade agreements to be explicitly paired with rural safety nets and labor market policies capable of preventing trade‐induced shocks from translating into elevated crime and deepened rural inequality.
10.1002/ajae.70070.abstract_zh: 贸易自由化是中低收入国家发展战略的核心，但其社会成本，尤其是对贫困农村家庭的影响，仍鲜为人知且很少通过政策加以补偿。更大的贸易开放度通过降低价格、增加产品多样性和出口收入带来益处，但进口竞争的加剧可能减少受冲击部门的收入和就业，并通过降低非法活动的机会成本而潜在地增加犯罪。鉴于发展中国家的贫困问题主要集中在农村地区，且大量劳动力依赖小农耕作，农业进口竞争的加剧尤为令人担忧。本文利用哥伦比亚887个市镇的面板数据和转移份额工具变量方法，研究表明2012年《美国-哥伦比亚自由贸易协定》通过加剧玉米和豆类进口竞争，使入室盗窃和个人抢劫分别上升了16%和6%，同时使商业抢劫下降了13%。犯罪影响集中在安第斯山脉市镇和非古柯生产地区，反映了小农传统玉米种植者对美国廉价进口激增的脆弱性以及这些地区有限的经济替代选择。与先前来自墨西哥和巴西的研究不同，我们发现对凶杀案影响的证据并不稳健——这一差异可归因于哥伦比亚武装冲突逐步降级的背景，这一背景抑制了极端暴力，却使出于经济动机的财产犯罪完全暴露。这些结果要求农业贸易协定必须明确配套农村安全网和劳动力市场政策，以防止贸易引发的冲击转化为犯罪率上升和农村不平等加剧。

10.1002/ajae.70071.abstract: Abstract Immigrants can be more vulnerable to economic downturns and, during periods of economic hardship, more likely to experience food insecurity compared to natives. This study examines the differential effect of the unemployment rate on the probability of being food insecure among diverse groups of immigrant households relative to natives in the United States. Since the unemployment rate is not randomly determined for households, we use an identification strategy based on shift‐share Bartik instruments which exploit exogenous spatial variation in industry employment shares and national industry growth rates. We find that increases in the unemployment rate raise the probability of household food insecurity, with noncitizen immigrants disproportionately affected compared to both natives and naturalized citizens, likely reflecting their more limited access to safety‐net programs. Noncitizen immigrant cohorts from countries with high proportions of less‐skilled workers, or those arriving during economic downturns, are more likely to experience food insecurity than both native‐born individuals and naturalized immigrant citizens. Higher education partially mitigates the impact of unemployment on household food insecurity, particularly for U.S. immigrant noncitizens. Our findings highlight the need for targeted measures to support at‐risk immigrant groups disproportionately vulnerable to short‐term economic shocks.
10.1002/ajae.70071.abstract_zh: 摘要 移民在经济衰退时期可能比本土居民更加脆弱，并且在经济困难时期更易遭受食物不安全问题。本研究探讨了美国不同移民家庭群体相对于本土居民，失业率对食物不安全概率的差异化影响。鉴于失业率并非随机分配给家庭，我们采用基于转移份额巴蒂克工具变量的识别策略，利用行业就业份额和全国行业增长率的空间外生变化。研究发现，失业率上升会增加家庭食物不安全的概率，其中非公民移民受到的影响尤为显著，相较于本土居民和入籍公民，这很可能反映了他们获取安全网项目的机会更为有限。来自低技能工人比例较高国家或经济衰退期间抵达的非公民移民群体，比本土出生个体和入籍移民公民更易遭遇食物不安全。高等教育在一定程度上缓解了失业对家庭食物不安全的影响，尤其对美国非公民移民而言。我们的研究结果强调了采取针对性措施支持那些易受短期经济冲击影响的移民群体的必要性。

10.1002/ajae.70072.abstract: Irrigation is widely recognized as a key driver of agricultural productivity and rural economic development, yet credible evidence on its impacts, mechanisms, and long‐term economic returns remains limited due to endogenous irrigation investments. Leveraging the timing of government irrigation investments and longitudinal household survey data spanning 15 years, we investigate how irrigation affects agricultural productivity. We find that irrigation investment increased the share of irrigated farmland by 11.0 percentage points, which in turn raised per‐area output by 14.9%, net agricultural income by 15.6%, agricultural total factor productivity by 13.7%, and per‐labor output by 36.2%. These effects are driven by four key mechanisms: increased use of high‐productivity inputs, expanded cultivation area, labor reallocation from farm work to off‐farm work, and mitigation of drought damage. The induced land expansion and labor reallocation explain the substantially larger increase in per‐labor output. A cost‐effectiveness analysis suggests a high return to irrigation investment, with approximately half of the return stemming from labor reallocation that increased off‐farm income. These results provide strong evidence that irrigation investment plays an important role in improving agricultural productivity and accelerating rural transformation, with benefits extending beyond the farm by influencing labor markets.
10.1002/ajae.70072.abstract_zh: 灌溉被广泛认为是农业生产力与农村经济发展的关键驱动力，然而由于灌溉投资的内生性问题，关于其影响、机制及长期经济回报的可靠证据仍然有限。利用政府灌溉投资的时机以及跨越15年的纵向农户调查数据，我们研究了灌溉如何影响农业生产力。研究发现，灌溉投资使灌溉农田比例提高了11.0个百分点，进而使单位面积产出增加14.9%，农业净收入增加15.6%，农业全要素生产率提高13.7%，人均产出增加36.2%。这些效应由四个关键机制驱动：高生产率投入品使用增加、种植面积扩大、劳动力从农业向非农就业重新配置，以及干旱损害缓解。土地扩张和劳动力重新配置共同解释了人均产出更大幅度的增长。成本效益分析表明，灌溉投资回报率较高，其中约一半的回报来自劳动力重新配置所增加的非农收入。这些结果有力证明，灌溉投资在提升农业生产力和加速农村转型中发挥重要作用，其效益通过影响劳动力市场而延伸至农业领域之外。
10.1002/ajae.70072.title: Irrigation investments and agricultural productivity in Northern China
10.1002/ajae.70072.title_zh: 中国北方灌溉投资与农业生产力

10.1002/ajae.70073.abstract: Abstract Discrete choice experiments are increasingly being used to estimate land managers' willingness to accept participation in incentive‐based environmental programs. This is a specific application of discrete choice experiments: the estimation of willingness to accept for a private good (program participation) where respondents have to make trade‐offs between payments and the business costs required to improve the provision of the (environmental) public good targeted by the program. Previous reviews fail to provide methodological insights into the use of discrete choice experiments in this valuation context. In this study, we conduct a review of 80 studies (containing up to 93 sample‐based observations) published in the Web of Science Core Collection, all of which apply discrete choice experiments to examine land managers' (farmers' and foresters') willingness to accept for participating in incentive‐based environmental programs. Based on this systematic review, we report quantitative information on key features regarding policy settings, experiment design and implementation, and willingness to accept results. We conclude that many of the analyzed studies do not follow best practices for discrete choice experiments in particular and stated preference methods in general. We also use a construct validity indicator to assess whether willingness to accept estimates align with expectations about land managers' utility. The results from the meta‐analysis show that special care should be taken in applications that focus on Africa, include contract design attributes, and use in‐person surveys, among other features. Recommendations are provided to enable practitioners to obtain more accurate welfare estimates for better policy‐making support.
10.1002/ajae.70073.abstract_zh: 摘要 离散选择实验日益被用于估算土地管理者参与激励型环境项目的接受意愿。这是离散选择实验的一种特定应用：估算对私人商品（项目参与）的接受意愿，其中受访者必须在支付金额与改善项目所针对的（环境）公共物品供给所需的经营成本之间进行权衡。以往的综述未能为这一估值情境下离散选择实验的使用提供方法论见解。在本研究中，我们对Web of Science核心合集收录的80项研究（包含多达93个基于样本的观测值）进行了综述，这些研究均应用离散选择实验来考察土地管理者（农民和林务人员）参与激励型环境项目的接受意愿。基于这一系统性综述，我们报告了关于政策设定、实验设计与实施以及接受意愿结果等关键特征的定量信息。我们得出结论，许多被分析的研究并未遵循离散选择实验的最佳实践，总体上也未遵循陈述偏好方法的最佳实践。我们还使用构念效度指标来评估接受意愿估计值是否与土地管理者效用的预期一致。元分析结果表明，在聚焦非洲、包含合同设计属性以及使用面对面调查等特征的应用中，应特别谨慎。我们提供了相关建议，以帮助实践者获得更准确的福利估计，从而更好地支持政策制定。

10.1002/ajae.70074.abstract: Abstract Marshallian agglomeration is typically attributed to input–output linkages, labor market pooling, and knowledge spillovers; however, empirical evidence on how these mechanisms operate in agricultural settings remains limited. This paper examines whether and how China's agricultural geographical indications certification fosters agricultural agglomeration. Exploiting the staggered rollout of this certification system since 2008 as a quasi‐natural experiment, we employ a staggered difference‐in‐differences design and find that certification significantly promotes county‐level agricultural agglomeration, primarily through strengthened input–output linkages: it encourages the colocation of upstream producers and downstream processors and deepens local production networks. In contrast, we find no significant effects through labor market pooling or knowledge spillovers. The agglomeration effects are concentrated in plant‐based certifications and are stronger in counties with better market access and transportation infrastructure. Overall, our findings extend Marshallian agglomeration theory to agriculture and provide new causal evidence on how agricultural geographical indications certification contributes to agricultural agglomeration as part of broader sectoral structural transformation.
10.1002/ajae.70074.abstract_zh: 马歇尔式集聚通常归因于投入产出关联、劳动力市场共享和知识溢出；然而，关于这些机制在农业情境中如何运作的经验证据仍然有限。本文考察中国农产品地理标志认证是否以及如何促进农业集聚。利用自2008年以来该认证体系分阶段推行的准自然实验，我们采用交错双重差分设计，发现认证显著促进了县级农业集聚，主要通过强化投入产出关联实现：它鼓励上游生产者与下游加工商共同选址，并深化本地生产网络。相比之下，我们未发现劳动力市场共享或知识溢出的显著效应。集聚效应集中于植物类认证，且在市场准入和交通基础设施较好的县更为显著。总体而言，我们的研究将马歇尔式集聚理论拓展至农业领域，并为农产品地理标志认证作为更广泛部门结构转型的一部分如何促进农业集聚提供了新的因果证据。

10.1002/ajae.70076.abstract: This paper derives a firm‐level threshold, the Herfindahl Neutral Point, from the standard concentration index used in merger review. At this threshold, a marginal expansion leaves the index unchanged. Firms below the threshold reduce concentration when they expand; firms above it increase concentration. We derive exact formulas for discrete capacity additions and define bridging amounts that measure how far each firm sits from the threshold. Applying this framework to monthly federally inspected hog slaughter data from 2004 to 2024, we show that the sharp rise in concentration in 2016 is driven by acquisitions at firms that were near the threshold and then crossed it, while the subsequent partial decline reflects sustained growth among mid‐tier packers operating below it. The 2015 acquisition of Cargill's pork business illustrates how bridging amounts organize merger analysis within a standard concentration screen. Reallocating the $34.7 million in federal capacity grants awarded to hog‐sector processors under a targeting rule based on this threshold lowers the 2024 national hog packing Herfindahl–Hirschman Index by about 147 points relative to the pre‐award baseline. The framework requires only market shares and the baseline concentration index.
10.1002/ajae.70076.abstract_zh: 本文从并购审查中使用的标准集中度指数出发，推导出一个企业层面的阈值——赫芬达尔中性点。在该阈值处，边际扩张不会改变指数值。低于该阈值的企业扩张时会降低集中度；高于该阈值的企业扩张则会提高集中度。我们推导出离散产能增加的确切公式，并定义了衡量每个企业距离该阈值远近的“桥梁量”。将该分析框架应用于2004年至2024年联邦月度生猪屠宰数据，我们发现2016年集中度的急剧上升是由接近阈值并随后跨越该阈值的企业收购所驱动，而随后的部分下降则反映了在该阈值以下运营的中型加工企业的持续增长。2015年嘉吉猪肉业务的收购案例展示了“桥梁量”如何在标准集中度筛查框架内组织并购分析。基于该阈值的目标规则，将联邦向生猪行业加工商提供的3470万美元产能拨款重新分配，可使2024年全国生猪屠宰赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数相较于拨款前基线降低约147点。该框架仅需市场份额和基线集中度指数。
