10.1002/ajae.70076.title: The Herfindahl neutral point: A firm‐level threshold for managing market concentration with evidence from US hog packing
10.1002/ajae.70076.title_zh: 赫芬达尔中性点：基于美国生猪加工企业数据的市场集中度管理阈值

10.1002/ajae.70077.abstract: Preferential trade agreements (PTAs) contain various non‐tariff provisions, yet identifying their trade effects remains challenging because these commitments are high‐dimensional and strongly correlated within agreements. We estimated a theory‐consistent structural gravity model with domestic flows for 26 agricultural subsectors over 1988–2017 and employed a plug‐in Elastic Net‐penalized PPML approach to isolate the provisions that systematically shape agricultural trade. The procedure identifies 13 provisions that are particularly important for agricultural trade, spanning trade facilitation, SPS/TBT disciplines, and rules on competition and subsidies. After accounting for the impact of preferential tariff rates, a generic PTA indicator is still estimated to increase trade by 20%. This effect is absorbed once the identified provision bundle is included, demonstrating that trade patterns under PTAs are primarily shaped by specific non‐tariff commitments. The results point to clear channels: facilitation and transparency provisions are trade‐promoting, whereas stronger reliance on international standards is associated with lower trade, consistent with compliance‐cost mechanisms.
10.1002/ajae.70077.abstract_zh: 优惠贸易协定（PTAs）包含多种非关税条款，但由于这些承诺具有高维特征且在同一协定内高度相关，识别其贸易效应仍具挑战性。我们基于1988-2017年26个农业子部门数据，采用包含国内贸易流的理论一致性结构引力模型，并运用插件式弹性网络惩罚泊松伪最大似然估计法，筛选出系统性影响农产品贸易的条款。该程序识别出13项对农产品贸易尤为重要的条款，涵盖贸易便利化、卫生与植物卫生措施/技术性贸易壁垒（SPS/TBT）纪律以及竞争与补贴规则。在控制优惠关税税率影响后，通用PTA指标仍显示贸易增长20%。当纳入已识别的条款组合后，该效应被完全吸收，表明PTA下的贸易模式主要由特定非关税承诺塑造。研究结果揭示了明确的作用渠道：便利化与透明度条款促进贸易，而对国际标准的更强依赖则与贸易下降相关，这与合规成本机制相一致。
10.1002/ajae.70077.title: Preferential trading in agriculture: New insights from a structural gravity analysis and machine learning
10.1002/ajae.70077.title_zh: 农业优惠贸易：基于结构引力分析与机器学习的新见解

10.1002/ajae.70078.abstract: Common‐pool resources—such as collectively‐owned grasslands—are often overused and depleted until effective conservation strategies are put into place. We conducted a lab‐in‐the‐field experiment to examine the performance of different management strategies on the sustainability of common‐pool grassland management in China. We designed three experimental interventions—reward, punishment, and communication—to evaluate how to cost‐effectively promote grassland conservation. Results reveal that the communication treatment is as effective as the reward and punishment treatments in promoting grassland conservation. However, unlike the reward treatment, communication does not require external funding or create income inequality among herders, and unlike the punishment treatment, it avoids undesirable impacts such as reducing herders' net payoffs. A mechanism analysis suggests that our communication treatment shifts herders' focus from exploitation to conservation. Our results indicate that incorporating communication interventions into grassland management strategies could improve their overall performance.
10.1002/ajae.70078.abstract_zh: 公共池资源——例如集体所有的草原——往往因过度使用而枯竭，直至有效的保护策略得以实施。我们开展了一项实地实验室实验，考察不同管理策略对中国公共池草原管理可持续性的影响。我们设计了三种实验干预措施——奖励、惩罚和沟通——以评估如何以成本有效的方式促进草原保护。结果表明，沟通干预在促进草原保护方面与奖励和惩罚干预同样有效。然而，与奖励干预不同，沟通干预无需外部资金支持，也不会在牧民之间造成收入不平等；与惩罚干预不同，它避免了降低牧民净收益等不良影响。机制分析表明，我们的沟通干预将牧民的关注点从开发利用转向保护。研究结果表明，将沟通干预纳入草原管理策略可提升其整体绩效。
10.1002/ajae.70078.title: Performance of reward, punishment, and communication in common‐pool resource management: Evidence from grassland conservation in China
10.1002/ajae.70078.title_zh: 奖励、惩罚与沟通在公共池塘资源管理中的绩效：来自中国草原保护的证据

10.1002/ajae.70079.abstract: Individual Fishing Quotas (IFQs) have the potential to lead to higher ex‐vessel prices by reducing market gluts and improving product quality. While IFQs have been introduced in a number of fisheries in recent decades, few causal studies investigate their price effects. Using synthetic control methods on US reef‐fish fisheries, we show that IFQs significantly increase prices for red snapper, red grouper, gag grouper, yellowedge grouper, scamp grouper, and tilefish. We also find significant positive price spillovers to adjacent, untreated fisheries. A primary challenge to unbiased estimation using synthetic control is treatment spillover, which can contaminate both never‐treated units in the donor pool and to‐be‐treated units in a staggered implementation. When control (donor) units are subject to these spillovers, this can lead to either attenuation or divergence of the causal estimate, depending on the empirical setting. To address this estimation challenge, we propose a framework relying on economic theory (market arbitrage and product substitution) and empirical analysis (e.g., market integration or demand estimation) to inform both donor selection and the timing of the treatment start date. As a result, our proposed structure improves the accuracy of synthetic control estimates, as shown by a small Monte Carlo experiment. Furthermore, by pre‐identifying contaminated units, our framework allows for the direct measurement of the spillover effects themselves.
10.1002/ajae.70079.abstract_zh: 个人捕捞配额（IFQs）可能通过减少市场过剩和改善产品质量来提高离岸价格。尽管近几十年来多个渔业已引入IFQs，但关于其价格效应的因果研究仍较为匮乏。通过在美国礁石鱼类渔业中应用合成控制方法，我们发现IFQs显著提高了红鲷鱼、红石斑鱼、黑斑石斑鱼、黄边石斑鱼、斑纹石斑鱼和方头鱼的价格。同时，我们还发现IFQs对邻近未受政策影响的渔业产生了显著的正向价格溢出效应。使用合成控制方法进行无偏估计的主要挑战在于处理溢出效应——这种效应可能污染供体池中从未受处理的单元，以及在分阶段实施中即将受处理的单元。当控制（供体）单元受到这些溢出效应影响时，因果估计可能产生衰减或发散，具体取决于实证环境。为应对这一估计挑战，我们提出一个基于经济理论（市场套利与产品替代）和实证分析（如市场整合或需求估计）的框架，以指导供体选择和处理起始时间的确定。通过小型蒙特卡洛实验验证，我们提出的结构显著提升了合成控制估计的准确性。此外，通过预先识别受污染的单元，该框架还能直接测量溢出效应本身。
10.1002/ajae.70079.title: An economic approach to mitigating spillover bias in synthetic control methods: An application to the price effects of fishing quotas
10.1002/ajae.70079.title_zh: 减轻合成控制法中溢出偏差的经济学方法：以捕捞配额价格效应为例

10.1002/ajae.70080.abstract: Dark sky conservation is increasingly popular, requiring facility upgrades and community cooperation. This study assesses its economic benefits at Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve, a Gold Tier International Dark Sky Park. Through on‐site surveys, we collected data on visitor behaviors, expenditures, and night sky perceptions. We introduced a continuum of contingent night sky brightness levels based on visitors' home locations and measured changes in visitation. Our Travel Cost‐Contingent Behavior analysis shows that each unit increase in nightlight decreases visitation by 0.05 days over 5 years. Using a weighted Latent Class Negative Binomial (LCNB) model, we estimate consumer welfare losses under escalating nightlight pollution scenarios. If the park's night skies matched an average rural, suburban, or urban area, visitors' consumer surplus would fall by about 3%, 23–24%, and 42–44%, respectively. These results underscore the substantial economic value of preserving dark skies.
10.1002/ajae.70080.abstract_zh: 暗夜保护日益受到重视，这需要设施升级和社区协作。本研究评估了大沙丘国家公园与保护区（国际金级暗夜公园）暗夜保护的经济效益。通过实地问卷调查，我们收集了游客行为、消费支出及夜空感知数据。基于游客居住地的光污染水平，我们构建了连续性的条件夜间天空亮度梯度，并测量了游客量的变化。旅行成本-条件行为分析显示，夜间灯光每增加一个单位，五年内游客量将减少0.05天。采用加权潜类负二项模型，我们估算了夜间灯光污染加剧情景下的消费者福利损失。若公园夜空亮度分别达到普通乡村、郊区或城市水平，游客消费者剩余将分别下降约3%、23-24%和42-44%。这些结果凸显了保护暗夜天空的巨大经济价值。
10.1002/ajae.70080.title: Contingent behavior modeling for dark skies valuation at Great Sand Dunes National Park
10.1002/ajae.70080.title_zh: 大沙丘国家公园暗夜天空评估中的条件行为建模

10.1002/ajae.70081.abstract: This paper examines how a natural disaster, the Dust Bowl, shapes occupational choices in farm households across generations. Using full‐count US census data, I find that young adult sons shift away from self‐employed farming toward wage farm work and nonagricultural sectors after the Dust Bowl. Younger children with affected farming parents are more likely to leave agriculture and earn higher income. Migration and schooling serve as mechanisms, and New Deal relief spending mitigates the Dust Bowl's effects. Overall, the Dust Bowl accelerated occupational reallocation among younger children of farmers and contributed to US mid‐20th century structural change.
10.1002/ajae.70081.abstract_zh: 本文考察了自然灾害“沙尘暴”如何跨代塑造农户家庭的职业选择。利用美国人口普查全量数据，我发现沙尘暴后，年轻成年儿子从自营农业转向雇佣农业劳动和非农部门。受影响的农民家庭中，年幼子女更可能离开农业并获得更高收入。迁移与教育是作用机制，而新政救济支出缓解了沙尘暴的影响。总体而言，沙尘暴加速了农民年轻子女的职业再配置，并推动了美国20世纪中期的结构性变革。
10.1002/ajae.70081.title:
Natural disaster and intergenerational occupational choice in agriculture: Evidence from the
                    US
                    Dust Bowl
10.1002/ajae.70081.title_zh: 自然灾害与农业代际职业选择：来自美国沙尘暴的证据

10.1002/ajae.70082.abstract: Voluntary agricultural land retirement programs are widely recognized for their environmental benefits, yet their economic effects, particularly on labor markets and land tenure, remain less understood. This paper examines the short‐ and long‐term impacts of the first large‐scale US land retirement initiative, the historical Conservation Reserve Program, introduced under the 1956 Set‐Aside Act. Between 1957 and 1960, the program enrolled more than 30 million acres under 3‐, 5‐, or 10‐year contracts, which then expired gradually through 1970. Using a newly digitized Conservation Reserve Program enrollment database linked to agricultural census data from the 1950s through the 1970s, we find that counties with medium and high enrollment intensity experienced statistically significant declines in tenant‐cultivated land relative to low‐enrollment counties during the program's active years. In medium‐enrollment counties, tenant‐operated land declined by roughly 0.6 percentage points, while high‐enrollment counties experienced declines of approximately 1.6 percentage points nationally. The proportion of tenant farm operators also fell in both medium‐ and high‐enrollment counties. These effects were larger and more persistent in the South, especially in counties with higher shares of nonwhite farm operators and sharecropping.
10.1002/ajae.70082.abstract_zh: 自愿性农业土地休耕项目因其环境效益而广受认可，但其经济影响——特别是对劳动力市场和土地保有权的影响——仍鲜为人知。本文考察了美国首个大规模土地休耕计划——1956年《预留法案》下设立的历史性保护储备计划——的短期与长期影响。1957年至1960年间，该计划以3年、5年或10年合同形式纳入了超过3000万英亩土地，这些合同随后于1970年前逐步到期。通过将新数字化的保护储备计划登记数据库与20世纪50年代至70年代的农业普查数据相关联，我们发现：在项目活跃期，中等和高强度登记县相对于低登记县，租佃耕地面积出现了统计上显著的下降。在全国范围内，中等登记县的租佃经营土地面积下降约0.6个百分点，而高登记县则下降约1.6个百分点。中等和高登记县的租佃农场经营者比例也同步下降。这些效应在南方地区更为显著且持久，尤其在非白人农场经营者及分成制佃农比例较高的县份表现突出。
10.1002/ajae.70082.title: Consequences of land retirement policies on agricultural labor and land tenure: Evidence from the historical Conservation Reserve Program in the United States
10.1002/ajae.70082.title_zh: 土地休耕政策对农业劳动力和土地保有权的影响：来自美国历史性保护储备计划的证据

10.1002/ajae.70083.abstract: To evaluate the role played by startup companies in the innovation ecosystem of US agriculture, we compile a unique dataset of 6024 new entrants founded 1987–2019 that details their financing lifecycles, annual economic performance, and patenting activities. One‐third of the firms in the sample have observable signs of contributing to innovation, including patenting and external financing such as grants and venture capital, thus characterizing them as startups. Such startups and their financing have grown substantially over the period studied. We use discrete‐time survival analysis to test factors related to firms receiving venture financing as well as to firms achieving successful financial exits. We find those firms that file for patents have higher likelihood of receiving financing than those that do not. Patent filings also increase the relative probability of a successful financial exit, which takes place primarily through mergers and acquisitions. In about a third of such exits, startups are acquired by corporate incumbents in agriculture well positioned to scale up and commercialize those startups' innovations for US agriculture. Importantly, a substantial portion of firms in the sample are still too young to have attained venture financing let alone a financial exit.
10.1002/ajae.70083.abstract_zh: 为评估初创企业在美国农业创新生态系统中的作用，我们构建了一个包含1987-2019年间成立的6024家新企业的独特数据集，详细记录了其融资生命周期、年度经济绩效及专利活动。样本中三分之一的公司展现出可观测的创新贡献迹象，包括专利申请及获得赠款、风险投资等外部融资，从而被界定为初创企业。此类初创企业及其融资规模在研究期间显著增长。我们采用离散时间生存分析法，检验影响企业获得风险融资及实现成功财务退出的因素。研究发现，提交专利申请的企业获得融资的可能性高于未申请企业。专利申请同时提高了企业成功实现财务退出的相对概率，此类退出主要通过并购完成。在约三分之一的退出案例中，初创企业被农业领域具备规模化推广及商业化能力的现有企业收购，从而将其创新成果应用于美国农业。值得注意的是，样本中相当比例的企业仍处于发展初期，尚未获得风险融资，更遑论实现财务退出。
10.1002/ajae.70083.title: The role of venture‐financed startups in innovation for US agriculture
10.1002/ajae.70083.title_zh: 风险投资支持的初创企业在美国农业创新中的作用

10.1002/ajae.70084.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We introduce a fully nonparametric estimator to estimate willingness to pay (WTP) using contingent valuation (CV) data. Traditional methods such as the probit model are used because of their roots in utility theory as well as their ease to implement. However, they are limited by their reliance on strict parametric assumptions, such as linearity and the requirement that the researcher pre‐select important covariates. While these methods are widely used, they may fail to capture complex relationships, particularly in situations involving nonlinearity or interactions among variables. This paper introduces Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) as a flexible, nonparametric way to estimate WTP from CV studies. Using a simulation study, we demonstrate that BART is competitive with traditional models under strict data‐generating assumptions. When the underlying data‐generating process is more complex, BART outperforms traditional models and even other machine‐learning models. Moreover, BART automatically incorporates individual heterogeneity into estimation, making it more informative than traditional nonparametric estimators. We illustrate the breadth of the model's benefits with an empirical application estimating WTP to develop an Invasive Species Rapid Response Fund in the Hawaiian Islands. We find WTP distributional differences along the margins of gender, age, and income. We also construct willingness to pay curves out of Monte Carlo Markov Chain (MCMC) draws and calculate posterior means and credible intervals using empirical cumulative distribution functions (CDFs). We find these WTP to be lower than those from the probit. Future natural extensions of BART make this method a compelling alternative for estimating WTP in CV experiments.</jats:p>
10.1002/ajae.70084.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种完全非参数估计方法，利用条件价值评估（CV）数据来估计支付意愿（WTP）。传统方法如probit模型因其植根于效用理论且易于实施而被广泛使用。然而，这些方法受限于严格的参数假设，例如线性关系以及研究者需预先选择重要协变量的要求。尽管这些方法应用广泛，但在涉及非线性或变量间交互作用的复杂情境中，可能无法捕捉真实关系。本文引入贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）作为一种灵活的非参数方法，用于从CV研究中估计WTP。通过模拟研究，我们证明在严格的数据生成假设下，BART与传统模型表现相当。当底层数据生成过程更为复杂时，BART优于传统模型甚至其他机器学习模型。此外，BART自动将个体异质性纳入估计，使其比传统非参数估计器更具信息量。我们通过一项实证应用展示了该模型的广泛优势，该应用估计了夏威夷群岛建立入侵物种快速响应基金的支付意愿。研究发现，WTP在性别、年龄和收入边际上存在分布差异。我们还利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）抽样构建了支付意愿曲线，并通过经验累积分布函数（CDFs）计算后验均值和可信区间。结果显示，这些WTP估计值低于probit模型的结果。BART未来的自然扩展使其成为CV实验中估计WTP的有力替代方法。
10.1002/ajae.70084.title: Not just a random forest: Using Bayesian additive regression trees to estimate willingness to pay to protect critical habitat
10.1002/ajae.70084.title_zh: 不仅仅是随机森林：使用贝叶斯加性回归树估计保护关键栖息地的支付意愿

10.1002/ajae.70085.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper examines the causal effects of a school feeding program on maternal empowerment and household consumption in rural China. Exploiting the staggered implementation of the Student Nutrition Improvement Program, we find that the program significantly reduces maternal time spent on housework, improves maternal labor market performance, and enhances maternal decision‐making power within nuclear households. The augmented bargaining power translates into shifts in household consumption toward female‐prioritized goods, including more nutritious foods, clothing, and housework‐related appliances. However, these positive effects on maternal empowerment are diminished in multigenerational families, where grandparents can assist with childcare responsibilities.</jats:p>
10.1002/ajae.70085.abstract_zh: 本文考察了学校供餐计划对中国农村地区女性赋权及家庭消费的因果效应。利用学生营养改善计划的分阶段实施，我们发现该计划显著减少了母亲的家务劳动时间，改善了母亲在劳动力市场的表现，并增强了母亲在核心家庭中的决策权。这种议价能力的提升促使家庭消费转向女性优先商品，包括更营养的食品、衣物及家务相关电器。然而，在多代同堂的家庭中，由于祖父母可协助承担育儿责任，这些对女性赋权的积极影响有所减弱。
10.1002/ajae.70085.title: School feeding, maternal empowerment, and household consumption
10.1002/ajae.70085.title_zh: 学校供餐、女性赋权与家庭消费

10.1002/ajae.70086.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Lifting smallholder farmers out of poverty depends largely on boosting their agricultural operating incomes, a persistent challenge despite numerous efforts. This study evaluates the impact of China's “E‐Commerce into the Countryside” (ECC) program—the first and largest e‐commerce initiative in the developing world—on both the level and distribution of smallholders' farm earnings. Employing a quasi‐experimental design, we find that the ECC program significantly increases household per capita agricultural operating income. We show that this gain is driven by expanded market access through online sales, which facilitate income growth via three primary mechanisms: operational scale expansion, higher output prices, and a shift toward high‐value‐added crops. However, these benefits are unevenly distributed. The program also widens the income gap among smallholders, a disparity largely attributable to pre‐existing differences in human, productive, and digital capital. Our findings highlight that e‐commerce policies, while potent for income generation, require complementary measures to mitigate disparities that arise from heterogeneous initial endowments.</jats:p>
10.1002/ajae.70086.abstract_zh: 摘要：使小农户摆脱贫困在很大程度上取决于提高其农业经营收入，尽管付出了诸多努力，这仍是一项长期挑战。本研究评估了中国"电子商务进农村"（ECC）计划——发展中国家首个也是规模最大的电子商务举措——对小农户农业收入水平及分布的影响。采用准实验设计，我们发现ECC计划显著提高了家庭人均农业经营收入。研究表明，这一增长源于通过在线销售扩大市场准入，并通过三种主要机制促进收入增长：经营规模扩大、产出价格提高以及向高附加值作物转型。然而，这些收益的分配并不均衡。该计划还扩大了小农户之间的收入差距，这种差距在很大程度上可归因于人力资本、生产资本和数字资本的既有差异。我们的研究结果表明，电子商务政策虽能有效促进收入增长，但需要配套措施来缓解因初始禀赋异质性而产生的差距。
10.1002/ajae.70086.title: When e‐commerce meets smallholders: Boosting incomes and widening gaps in rural China's anti‐poverty policy
10.1002/ajae.70086.title_zh: 电子商务遇上小农户：中国农村扶贫政策中的收入提升与差距扩大

10.1002/ajae.70088.abstract: Excessive water use for irrigation can accelerate the depletion of water resources, undermining agriculture's resilience to weather‐related shocks. Understanding how farmers make water use decisions is essential for developing effective water management policies. This study investigates the effect of crop insurance participation on water use in the High Plains Aquifer region, using crop‐specific irrigation data and unit pumping costs for groundwater extraction. Building on work by Deryugina & Konar and Sloggy et al., we examine the question of moral hazard in input use, analyzing how water use responses to insurance participation vary with changes in groundwater pumping costs. To address endogeneity between water use and insurance participation, we employ an instrumental variable approach using base premium rates that are determined before farms make production and insurance decisions. We find that insurance participation increases per‐acre water use, but the magnitude of this effect declines as pumping costs rise. At the average pumping costs, a one percentage point increase in insurance participation leads to a 0.4% increase in per‐acre water use. At the 95th percentile of pumping costs, the marginal effect of insurance participation is negligible and close to zero. Our results suggest that water pricing policies should account for indirect effects through insurance participation to avoid the inefficient use of water resources.
10.1002/ajae.70088.abstract_zh: 灌溉用水的过度使用可能加速水资源枯竭，削弱农业应对天气相关冲击的韧性。理解农民如何做出用水决策对于制定有效的水资源管理政策至关重要。本研究利用特定作物的灌溉数据和地下水抽取的单位泵送成本，探讨了高平原含水层区域作物保险参与对用水的影响。在Deryugina & Konar和Sloggy等人研究的基础上，我们考察了投入品使用中的道德风险问题，分析了用水对保险参与的响应如何随地下水抽取成本的变化而变化。为处理用水与保险参与之间的内生性问题，我们采用工具变量方法，利用农场在生产及保险决策前确定的基准保费率作为工具。研究发现，保险参与增加了每亩用水量，但这一效应的规模随泵送成本上升而减小。在平均泵送成本下，保险参与率每增加一个百分点，每亩用水量增加0.4%。在泵送成本的第95百分位数处，保险参与的边际效应可忽略不计，接近于零。我们的结果表明，水价政策应考虑通过保险参与产生的间接效应，以避免水资源利用的低效率。
10.1002/ajae.70088.title: Crop insurance and irrigation behavior: The conditional role of pumping costs
10.1002/ajae.70088.title_zh: 农作物保险与灌溉行为：抽水成本的调节作用

10.1002/ajae.70089.abstract: This study is the first to evaluate the impacts of farm labor scarcity on producers in the United States across different crop production systems. Between 2002 and 2017, we disentangle the effects of labor scarcity from the impacts of rising commodity demand, technological change, and supply of other inputs on labor market outcomes. We leverage insights from a stylized theoretical framework, that shows labor market outcomes depend on these market forces and structural parameters like factor‐specific productivity changes, factor supply and substitutability. We implement a two‐step novel empirical strategy. First, we use constrained optimization approach to simultaneously estimate changes in input‐biased factor productivity, labor substitutability and price elasticity of labor supply for key Farm Resource Regions. Our estimates show that labor productivity in the Fruitful Rim region has stagnated relative to field crop dominant systems during our study period. This underscores the differences in capacity to adjust to labor shortages across production systems. Second, we use the first‐step estimates and a spatially explicit partial equilibrium model, to identify the responsiveness of wages and employment to reduced supply of farm workers. We find that a 1% annual decline in farm labor supply can increase hiring costs by 7.4% for specialty crop growers and 5.9% for field crop producers over the course of a decade. These can be further aggravated if trade policies increase demand from domestic producers and immigration policy further accentuate farm worker shortages. Addressing labor scarcity will be key to ensuring the long‐term sustainability and resilience of the agricultural sector.
10.1002/ajae.70089.abstract_zh: 本研究首次评估了美国不同作物生产体系中农业劳动力短缺对生产者的影响。在2002年至2017年间，我们将劳动力短缺的影响与大宗商品需求上升、技术进步及其他投入品供给对劳动力市场结果的作用区分开来。我们借助一个风格化理论框架的洞见，该框架表明劳动力市场结果取决于这些市场力量及结构性参数，如要素特定生产率变化、要素供给和替代性。我们实施了一种新颖的两步实证策略。首先，采用约束优化方法，同时估计关键农业资源区域中投入偏向型要素生产率变化、劳动力替代性及劳动力供给价格弹性。我们的估计显示，在研究期间，丰饶边缘地区的劳动生产率相对于以大田作物为主的系统停滞不前。这凸显了不同生产系统在适应劳动力短缺能力上的差异。其次，我们利用第一步估计结果及一个空间显式局部均衡模型，识别工资和就业对农业工人供给减少的响应。我们发现，农业劳动力供给每年下降1%，十年内可使特色作物种植者的雇佣成本增加7.4%，大田作物生产者增加5.9%。若贸易政策增加国内生产者需求，且移民政策进一步加剧农业工人短缺，这些影响可能进一步恶化。解决劳动力短缺问题将是确保农业部门长期可持续性和韧性的关键。
10.1002/ajae.70089.title: Farm labor scarcity and its uneven impacts on crop producers in the United States
10.1002/ajae.70089.title_zh: 美国农业劳动力短缺及其对农作物生产者不均衡的影响

10.1002/ajae.70090.abstract: Agrodealers play a critical role in rural economies, selling essential inputs for agricultural production, stocking new products, and providing farmers with technical advice. However, uncertainty can discourage them from stocking newer, less familiar products, limiting the availability of innovative technologies and leading to market failures and low‐innovation equilibria. We provided Kenyan agrodealers with a 10% price discount on new, drought‐tolerant maize hybrids. The discount increased the likelihood that the agrodealer stocked the new hybrids and increased the share of the new hybrids in overall sales. In an information‐deprived environment, the discount encouraged dealers to gather more information about the seeds and increased agrodealers' sales effort.
10.1002/ajae.70090.abstract_zh: 农业经销商在农村经济中扮演着关键角色，他们销售农业生产所需的基本投入品，储备新产品，并向农民提供技术咨询。然而，不确定性可能阻碍他们储备更新、更不熟悉的产品，从而限制创新技术的可获得性，导致市场失灵和低创新均衡。我们向肯尼亚农业经销商提供了10%的价格折扣，用于购买新的耐旱玉米杂交种。这一折扣提高了经销商储备新杂交种的可能性，并增加了新杂交种在总销售额中的占比。在信息匮乏的环境中，折扣促使经销商收集更多关于种子的信息，并增强了经销商的销售努力。
10.1002/ajae.70090.title: Improving access to new technologies: An experiment with Kenyan input sellers
10.1002/ajae.70090.title_zh: 改善新技术获取渠道：针对肯尼亚农资经销商的实验研究

10.1002/ajae.70091.abstract: Firms may under‐ or over‐invest in risk management from the social planner's perspective, resulting in a negative externality on other economic agents in the supply chain. The externality of risk management is particularly relevant for agrifood supply chains, which frequently experience disruptions and play a primary role in preventing major social losses from food insecurity. The magnitude of the externality depends on the structure of the supply chain. We build a theoretical model to characterize such externalities in US food supply chains where intermediary firms choose output quantities and investments in managing risks. The model allows for flexible market structures and interdependence of risk management among firms. Risk interdependence captures the unique feature of biotic hazards (e.g., animal and plant diseases) in agrifood supply chains, where the effectiveness of a firm's risk management depends on peer firms' behavior. We offer novel insights on the role of risk interdependence in driving the externality in risk management under different market structures. We show that private firms invest less than the socially optimal level under perfect competition, but risk interdependence and market power introduce complex incentives in risk‐reducing investment that shape the externality. In particular, when investments are complements across firms and firms possess strong market power in production but limited coordination in risk management, private investment may equal or even exceed the socially optimal level.
10.1002/ajae.70091.abstract_zh: 从社会规划者的视角来看，企业在风险管理上的投资可能不足或过度，从而对供应链中的其他经济主体产生负外部性。风险管理的这种外部性在农业食品供应链中尤为突出，因为该供应链频繁遭受中断，并在防止粮食不安全带来的重大社会损失中扮演关键角色。外部性的规模取决于供应链的结构。我们构建了一个理论模型，用以刻画美国食品供应链中的此类外部性，其中中间商企业选择产出数量并进行风险管理投资。该模型允许灵活的市场结构以及企业间风险管理的相互依存性。风险相互依存性捕捉了农业食品供应链中生物性危害（如动植物疫病）的独特特征，即企业风险管理的有效性取决于同行企业的行为。我们提供了关于风险相互依存性在不同市场结构下驱动风险管理外部性作用的新见解。我们表明，在完全竞争条件下，私营企业的投资低于社会最优水平，但风险相互依存性和市场力量引入了复杂的风险削减投资激励，从而塑造了外部性。特别是，当企业间的投资具有互补性，且企业在生产中拥有强大市场力量但在风险管理上协调有限时，私营投资可能等于甚至超过社会最优水平。
10.1002/ajae.70091.title: Risk management externalities in agrifood supply chains
10.1002/ajae.70091.title_zh: 农产品供应链中的风险管理外部性

10.1002/ajae.70092.abstract: Crop insurance is an important instrument to protect farmers against extreme weather events. Many countries provide subsidies for crop insurance products to make insurance more affordable for farmers. The Federal Crop Insurance Program in the United States and major European crop insurance programs such as in Spain, Italy, and France focus on subsidized multi‐peril crop insurance contracts that cover losses from various natural hazards (e.g., hail, wind, drought, frost). We study how making premium subsidies more flexible and allowing farmers to buy subsidized single‐peril contracts affects insurance demand. We theoretically show that single‐peril subsidies are more effective than multi‐peril subsidies at increasing insurance demand against specific perils. Single‐peril subsidies may, however, crowd out insurance demand against other risks, when risks are correlated. Using a series of premium subsidies introduced by different German states aimed at increasing frost insurance demand of winegrowers, we compare the effects of subsidies for single‐peril (frost only) insurance contracts to the effects of subsidies for multi‐peril (hail and frost) insurance contracts. We empirically show that both subsidies lead to a similarly strong increase in frost insurance demand. We also find that single‐peril frost insurance subsidies do not crowd out hail insurance demand which is in line with our theory as frost and hail are independent risks. Our results demonstrate that allowing for more flexibility in contract choices can make subsidy programs more effective without reducing coverage against other, uncorrelated risks.
10.1002/ajae.70092.abstract_zh: 农作物保险是保护农民免受极端天气事件影响的重要工具。许多国家为农作物保险产品提供补贴，以使农民更能负担得起保险。美国的联邦农作物保险计划以及欧洲主要的农作物保险计划（如西班牙、意大利和法国）侧重于补贴型多重风险农作物保险合同，这些合同覆盖各种自然灾害（如冰雹、风灾、干旱、霜冻）造成的损失。我们研究了使保费补贴更加灵活并允许农民购买受补贴的单风险合同如何影响保险需求。我们从理论上证明，在增加针对特定风险的保险需求方面，单风险补贴比多重风险补贴更为有效。然而，当风险相关时，单风险补贴可能会挤出对其他风险的保险需求。利用德国各州推出的一系列旨在提高葡萄种植者霜冻保险需求的保费补贴，我们比较了单风险（仅霜冻）保险合同补贴与多重风险（冰雹和霜冻）保险合同补贴的效果。我们实证表明，两种补贴均导致霜冻保险需求出现类似的显著增长。我们还发现，单风险霜冻保险补贴并未挤出冰雹保险需求，这与我们的理论一致，因为霜冻和冰雹是独立风险。我们的结果表明，在合同选择上允许更大的灵活性可以使补贴计划更加有效，同时不会减少对其他不相关风险的保障。
10.1002/ajae.70092.title: Premium subsidy designs and crowding out of insurance demand
10.1002/ajae.70092.title_zh: 保费补贴设计与保险需求挤出效应

10.1002/jae.70021.abstract: This paper studies empirical discrete‐choice games with incomplete information under nonparametric specifications of both the payoff function and the distribution of private information. It relaxes the standard global equilibrium assumption —under which players follow equilibrium strategies for all realizations of the control variables—and introduces a weaker local equilibrium assumption that requires the equilibrium restriction only for some, but not all, realizations. Under this maintained assumption and standard exclusion restrictions, I derive the testable implications of the global equilibrium hypothesis and establish the nonparametric identification of all unknown functions in the model. This paper also discusses settings where the local equilibrium condition applies. The method is illustrated through a Monte Carlo experiment and an empirical application examining the competition between KFC and McDonald's in China. The estimation results strongly reject the global equilibrium assumption.
10.1002/jae.70021.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在不完全信息下的经验性离散选择博弈，其中支付函数和私人信息分布均采用非参数设定。它放宽了标准的全局均衡假设——该假设要求玩家对所有控制变量实现值都遵循均衡策略——并引入了一个较弱的局部均衡假设，仅要求在某些而非全部实现值上满足均衡约束。在此维持假设和标准排除性限制下，我推导出了全局均衡假设的可检验含义，并确立了模型中所有未知函数的非参数识别性。本文还讨论了局部均衡条件适用的情境。该方法通过蒙特卡洛实验和一项关于肯德基与麦当劳在中国竞争的实证应用进行了说明。估计结果强烈拒绝了全局均衡假设。

10.1002/jae.70040.abstract: This paper analyzes how interaction effects can be consistently estimated under economically plausible assumptions in linear panel models with a fixed ‐dimension. We advocate for a correlated interaction term effects (CITE) estimator and show that it is consistent under conditions that are not sufficient for consistency of the interaction term effect estimator that is most common in applied econometric work. Our paper discusses the empirical content of these conditions, shows that standard inference procedures can be applied to CITE, and analyzes consistency, relative efficiency, inference, and their finite sample properties in a simulation study. In an empirical application, we test whether labor displacement effects of robots are stronger in countries at higher income levels. The results are in line with our theoretical and simulation results and indicate that standard interaction term effect estimation underestimates the importance of a country's income level in the relationship between robots and employment and may prematurely reject a null hypothesis about interaction effects in the presence of misspecification.
10.1002/jae.70040.abstract_zh: 本文分析了在固定维度的线性面板模型中，如何在经济上合理的假设下一致地估计交互效应。我们提倡使用相关交互项效应（CITE）估计量，并证明在应用计量经济学工作中最常见的交互项效应估计量的一致性条件不充分的情况下，CITE仍能保持一致。本文讨论了这些条件的实证内容，展示了标准推断程序可应用于CITE，并通过模拟研究分析了其一致性、相对效率、推断及有限样本性质。在实证应用中，我们检验了机器人对劳动力替代效应是否在高收入国家更为显著。结果与我们的理论和模拟结果相符，表明标准交互项效应估计低估了国家收入水平在机器人与就业关系中的重要性，并可能在存在设定误差时过早拒绝关于交互效应的原假设。

10.1002/jae.70041.abstract: The rise of machine learning (ML) is one of the most prominent developments in applied econometrics in the past decade. The focus of much economic analysis is causal, rather than prediction, and Belloni et al. (2014) demonstrate how ML methods can be used in causal inference. This paper undertakes a narrow and wide replication of the Monte Carlo and empirical examples presented by Belloni et al. (2014). We discuss practical implications of this replication for the use of double ML methods in applied econometric research.
10.1002/jae.70041.abstract_zh: 机器学习（ML）的兴起是过去十年应用计量经济学领域最显著的发展之一。许多经济分析的重点在于因果推断，而非预测，Belloni等人（2014）展示了如何将机器学习方法应用于因果推断。本文对Belloni等人（2014）提出的蒙特卡洛模拟和实证案例进行了狭义与广义的复制研究。我们探讨了此次复制对于在应用计量经济学研究中使用双重机器学习方法的实际意义。

10.1002/jae.70044.abstract: The international co‐movement of interest rates reflects correlated business‐cycle fluctuations, largely driven by demand shocks. Monetary policy in advanced economies follows domestic mandates—inflation and the output gap—and does not respond to foreign policy shocks. We derive this result from a Bayesian structural panel vector autoregression with informative priors, homogeneity restrictions on contemporaneous relations, a hierarchical Minnesota prior with cross‐sectional shrinkage, and a factor structure for structural shocks.
10.1002/jae.70044.abstract_zh: 国际利率的联动反映了商业周期波动的相关性，这主要由需求冲击驱动。发达经济体的货币政策遵循国内任务——通胀和产出缺口——并不对外国政策冲击作出反应。我们通过一个带有信息先验、同期关系同质性限制、具有横截面收缩的分层明尼苏达先验以及结构冲击因子结构的贝叶斯结构面板向量自回归模型得出这一结论。

10.1002/jae.70046.abstract: This paper leverages free‐form textual responses from a key manufacturing survey to create sentiment indexes that mirror categorical measures from the same survey and also contain predictive content—both in and out‐of‐sample—for manufacturing output. We use textual data from the Institute for Supply Management to compare sentiment metrics based on dictionary and deep learning natural language processing methods. The best performing sentiment measures classify comments based on fine‐tuned deep learning models. To add interpretability, we apply Shapley decompositions to show that a relatively small number of words—associated with very positive and very negative sentiment—account for much of the variation in the aggregate sentiment index.
10.1002/jae.70046.abstract_zh: 本文利用一项关键制造业调查中的自由文本回复，构建了反映同一调查中分类指标的情绪指数，并包含对制造业产出的预测内容——无论是样本内还是样本外。我们使用供应管理研究所的文本数据，比较基于词典和深度学习自然语言处理方法的情感指标。表现最佳的情感度量基于微调深度学习模型对评论进行分类。为增强可解释性，我们应用Shapley分解，表明相对较少的词汇——与非常积极和非常消极情绪相关——解释了总体情绪指数的大部分变动。

10.1002/jae.70047.abstract: ABSTRACT Words matter for predicting tail risks. We propose an attention mechanism embedded in a quantile factor model, yielding information that is quantile‐specific, target‐specific, and horizon‐specific. We establish new asymptotic results and show empirically that targeted textual data improve quantile forecasts of exchange‐rate returns and industrial production growth relative to strong benchmarks and other conditional‐quantile models. Bigrams and trigrams drive these gains, extending evidence that collocations enhance forecasting. A portfolio‐management application yields better allocations and higher risk‐adjusted performance. Robustness checks include a synthetic‐misinformation stress test, which shows that fabricated news does not create spurious predictability. Results are consistent across targets, horizons, and both rolling and recursive schemes.
10.1002/jae.70047.abstract_zh: 摘要：词汇对于预测尾部风险至关重要。我们提出了一种嵌入分位数因子模型中的注意力机制，该机制能够生成针对特定分位数、特定目标及特定时间跨度的信息。我们建立了新的渐近结果，并实证表明，相较于强基准模型及其他条件分位数模型，针对性的文本数据能显著提升汇率收益率和工业生产增长的预测精度。二元词组和三元词组是这些改进的主要驱动力，进一步证实了搭配词能够增强预测能力的观点。一项投资组合管理应用实现了更优的资产配置和更高的风险调整后绩效。稳健性检验包括一项合成错误信息压力测试，该测试表明，虚构新闻不会产生虚假的可预测性。结果在目标、时间跨度以及滚动和递归方案中均保持一致。

10.1002/jae.70048.abstract: ABSTRACT There is an ongoing debate about the buffer‐stock saving hypothesis. This paper develops a formal test of the hypothesis by examining the sub‐unity of the marginal propensity to consume out of permanent income (MPCP). Our test relies on a novel estimator of the average derivative of a nonparametric consumption model, using constructed measures of latent permanent income shocks that accommodate nonparametric income distributions. Following Li and Vuong (1998), we use a Kotlarski‐based approach to account for asymmetric errors, which is crucial for testing buffer‐stock behavior. Applied to the US Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) data, our test rejects a unit MPCP, providing empirical support for buffer‐stock saving.
10.1002/jae.70048.abstract_zh: 摘要 关于缓冲储备储蓄假说的争论仍在持续。本文通过检验永久收入边际消费倾向（MPCP）是否小于1，对该假说进行了正式检验。我们的检验依赖于一种非参数消费模型平均导数的创新估计方法，利用构建的潜在永久收入冲击度量，以适应非参数收入分布。遵循Li和Vuong（1998）的研究，我们采用基于Kotlarski的方法来处理非对称误差，这对于检验缓冲储备行为至关重要。应用于美国收入动态面板研究（PSID）数据后，我们的检验拒绝了MPCP等于1的假设，为缓冲储备储蓄提供了实证支持。

10.1002/jae.70049.abstract: This paper extends the vector autoregression framework by introducing a flexible distributional regression that models multivariate time series without imposing restrictive parametric distribution assumptions. We develop a distributional impulse response function that captures the future effect of distributional disturbances within the system, providing a more detailed view of dynamic heterogeneity. We propose a straightforward estimation method and establish its asymptotic properties under weak dependence assumptions. Our model, in an application to U.S. economic data, exhibits strong forecasting capabilities compared to existing alternatives. By examining distributional interactions and monetary policy impacts, particularly during the Great Recession, we uncover complex macroeconomic dynamics.
10.1002/jae.70049.abstract_zh: 本文通过引入一种灵活的分布回归方法，扩展了向量自回归框架，该方法在不施加严格参数分布假设的情况下对多元时间序列进行建模。我们开发了一种分布脉冲响应函数，用以捕捉系统内分布扰动的未来效应，从而更细致地揭示动态异质性。我们提出了一种简便的估计方法，并在弱依赖假设下确立了其渐近性质。在应用于美国经济数据时，我们的模型展现出相较于现有替代方法的强大预测能力。通过考察分布交互作用及货币政策影响，尤其是在大衰退期间，我们揭示了复杂的宏观经济动态。

10.1002/jae.70050.abstract: A collection of time series are “related” if they follow similar stochastic processes and/or they are statistically dependent. This paper proposes a related time series (RTS) forecasting model that exploits these relationships. The model's foundation is a set of univariate Gaussian autoregressions, one for each series, which are then augmented to incorporate stochastic volatility, heavy‐tailed innovations, additive outliers, time‐varying parameters and common factors. The model is estimated and forecasts are computed using Bayesian methods with hierarchical priors that pool information across series. Computationally efficient MCMC methods are proposed. The RTS model is applied to three datasets and yields encouraging pseudo‐out‐of‐sample forecasting results.
10.1002/jae.70050.abstract_zh: 一组时间序列若遵循相似的随机过程及/或存在统计依赖性，则被视为“相关”。本文提出了一种相关时间序列（RTS）预测模型，利用这些关系进行预测。该模型的基础是每个序列对应的一元高斯自回归模型，随后通过引入随机波动性、重尾创新、加性异常值、时变参数和共同因子进行扩展。模型估计及预测采用贝叶斯方法，并利用跨序列信息汇聚的分层先验。文中提出了计算高效的MCMC方法。RTS模型应用于三个数据集，产生了令人鼓舞的伪样本外预测结果。

10.1002/jae.70051.abstract: This paper investigates whether the effects of monetary policy shocks on real exchange rates have changed over time and, if so, whether these changes stem from shifts in transmission mechanisms or from variation in the volatility of the shocks themselves. Using a time‐varying parameter VAR with stochastic volatility for six small open economies, we first show that a constant‐parameter VAR with stochastic volatility provides the best fit to the data in all six cases. We then employ an identification strategy that combines short‐ and long‐run restrictions to isolate monetary policy shocks, and we evaluate its robustness using high‐frequency monetary policy surprises as external instruments. Our results support Dornbusch's overshooting hypothesis in most countries. However, uncovered interest parity is frequently violated, as foreign excess returns diverge from zero following monetary policy shocks. Finally, we document a substantial decline in the volatility of monetary policy shocks since the 1990s, leading to a reduced contribution to exchange rate and macroeconomic fluctuations.
10.1002/jae.70051.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了货币政策冲击对实际汇率的影响是否随时间发生变化，若确实如此，这些变化是源于传导机制的转变，还是冲击本身波动性的变化。通过采用带有随机波动性的时变参数VAR模型，针对六个小型开放经济体，我们首先发现，在所有六个案例中，常数参数VAR结合随机波动性对数据的拟合效果最佳。随后，我们运用结合短期与长期限制的识别策略来隔离货币政策冲击，并利用高频货币政策意外作为外部工具评估其稳健性。研究结果在多数国家支持了多恩布什的汇率超调假说。然而，利率平价条件频繁失效，表现为货币政策冲击后外国超额回报偏离零值。最后，我们记录了自1990年代以来货币政策冲击波动性的显著下降，这导致其对汇率及宏观经济波动的贡献度降低。

10.1002/jae.70052.abstract: We propose a method for defining, identifying, and estimating the marginal treatment effect (MTE) without imposing the instrumental variable (IV) assumptions of independence, exclusion, and separability (or monotonicity). Under a new definition of the MTE based on reduced‐form treatment error that is statistically independent of the covariates, we find that the relationship between the MTE and standard treatment parameters holds in the absence of IVs. We provide a set of sufficient conditions ensuring the identification of the defined MTE in an environment of essential heterogeneity. The key conditions include a linear restriction on potential outcome regression functions, a nonlinear restriction on the propensity score, and a conditional mean independence restriction which will lead to additive separability. We prove this identification using the notion of semiparametric identification based on functional forms. And we provide an empirical application for the Head Start program to illustrate the usefulness of the proposed method in analyzing heterogenous causal effects when IVs are elusive.
10.1002/jae.70052.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在不施加工具变量（IV）的独立性、排除性和可分离性（或单调性）假设的情况下，定义、识别和估计边际处理效应（MTE）的方法。基于与协变量统计独立的简化形式处理误差的新MTE定义，我们发现，在没有IV的情况下，MTE与标准处理参数之间的关系仍然成立。我们提供了一组充分条件，确保在本质异质性环境中所定义的MTE的可识别性。关键条件包括对潜在结果回归函数的线性限制、对倾向得分的非线性限制，以及导致加性可分离性的条件均值独立性限制。我们利用基于函数形式的半参数识别概念证明了这一识别。我们还提供了一个针对“领先起步”项目的实证应用，以说明在IV难以获得时，所提方法在分析异质性因果效应中的实用性。

10.1002/jae.70053.abstract: This paper compares the statistical and economic performance of state‐of‐the‐art high‐frequency (HF) based multivariate volatility models with a simpler, widely used alternative, the Exponentially Weighted Moving Average (EWMA) filter. Using over two decades of 100 U.S. stock returns (2002–2023), we assess model performance through a Global Minimum Variance portfolio optimization exercise, with and without short‐selling restrictions across multiple forecast horizons. We find that the EWMA model cannot consistently be outperformed by more complex HF‐based volatility models at the daily and weekly forecast horizons, even delivering significant utility gains when including transaction costs due to a favorable balance between turnover and ex‐post portfolio volatility. At the monthly horizon, the EWMA remains competitive against most of its competitors. Our findings hold across alternative specifications, including different estimation window lengths, portfolio sizes and smoothing parameter values, emphasizing the continued relevance of parsimonious volatility specifications, such as the EWMA model, in realistic investment settings.
10.1002/jae.70053.abstract_zh: 本文对比了基于高频数据的先进多元波动率模型与一种更简单且广泛使用的替代模型——指数加权移动平均（EWMA）滤波器的统计及经济表现。利用2002年至2023年间超过二十年的100只美国股票回报数据，我们通过全球最小方差投资组合优化练习评估模型表现，涵盖多个预测期限，并考虑有无卖空限制的情况。研究发现，在日度和周度预测期限上，EWMA模型无法被更复杂的高频波动率模型持续超越，甚至在考虑交易成本时，由于换手率与事后投资组合波动性之间的有利平衡，能带来显著的效用增益。在月度期限上，EWMA模型仍能与大多数竞争对手保持竞争力。我们的结论在不同规格下均成立，包括不同的估计窗口长度、投资组合规模和平滑参数值，强调了在现实投资环境中，如EWMA模型这类简约波动率规格的持续相关性。

10.1002/jae.70054.abstract: The effects of monetary policy shocks are regularly estimated using high‐frequency surprises in asset prices around central bank meetings as an instrument. These studies, insofar as they explicitly model the relationship between instrument and structural shock, assume a constant relationship between the instrument and the monetary policy shock. By allowing for time variation in this relationship, we show that only a few distinct periods are informative about monetary policy shocks. Therefore, we build a narrative for instrument‐based identification. For the instrument in Gertler and Karadi, the effect on the (log) price level is almost 50% larger than the standard specification would suggest.
10.1002/jae.70054.abstract_zh: 货币政策冲击的效应通常通过中央银行会议期间资产价格的高频意外变动作为工具变量进行估计。这些研究，在明确建模工具与结构性冲击之间关系时，假设工具与货币政策冲击之间存在恒定关系。通过允许这种关系随时间变化，我们表明仅有少数几个特定时期对货币政策冲击具有信息量。因此，我们构建了一个基于工具识别的叙事框架。对于Gertler和Karadi所使用的工具，其对（对数）价格水平的影响比标准规格所暗示的要大近50%。

10.1002/jae.70055.abstract: We propose a simple approach to treatment effect estimation in panel data that is valid when the number of time periods is small and the parallel trends condition is violated due to the presence of interactive fixed effects. The procedure allows the covariates to be affected by treatment and enables separation of the part of the estimated treatment effect that is due to the covariates from the part that is not. The asymptotic properties of the new approach are established, and their accuracy in small samples is investigated using Monte Carlo simulations. The procedure is illustrated using as an example the effect of increased trade competition on firm markups in China. We estimate that about half of the impact of China's entrance into the WTO on markup dispersion came from the changes in industry‐level productivity.
10.1002/jae.70055.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在面板数据中估计处理效应的简便方法，该方法在时间期数较少且因存在交互固定效应而违反平行趋势假设时依然有效。该程序允许协变量受处理影响，并能将估计处理效应中归因于协变量的部分与不归因于协变量的部分分离开来。我们确立了新方法的渐近性质，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟研究了其在小样本中的准确性。以中国贸易竞争加剧对企业加成率的影响为例，对该程序进行了说明。我们估计，中国加入WTO对加成率离散度影响中，约有一半来自行业层面生产率的变化。

10.1002/jae.70056.abstract: We present four novel tests of equal predictive accuracy and encompassing á Pitarakis (2023, 2025) for factor‐augmented regressions. Factors are estimated using cross‐section averages (CAs) of grouped series and our theoretical findings are empirically relevant: asymptotic normality, robustness to an overspecification of the number of factors, tractability of different degrees of predictor persistence, and invariance to the location of structural breaks in the loadings. Simulations reveal good local power properties of our tests. We apply them to the novel EA‐MD‐QD dataset by Barigozzi et al. (2024b)—which covers the Euro Area as a whole and its primary member countries—and show that factors offer predictive power.
10.1002/jae.70056.abstract_zh: 我们提出了四种新颖的预测精度相等性及包含性检验，参照Pitarakis（2023, 2025）的方法，应用于因子增强回归。因子通过分组序列的横截面平均值（CAs）进行估计，我们的理论发现具有实证相关性：渐近正态性、对因子数量过度设定的稳健性、不同预测变量持久性程度的可处理性，以及对载荷中结构断点位置的不变性。模拟实验显示我们的检验具有良好的局部功效特性。我们将这些检验应用于Barigozzi等人（2024b）的新颖EA-MD-QD数据集——该数据集覆盖整个欧元区及其主要成员国——并表明因子具有预测能力。

10.1002/jae.70057.abstract: Double/debiased machine learning (DML) uses for estimating an average treatment effect (ATE) a double‐robust score function that relies on the prediction of nuisance functions, such as the propensity score, which is the probability of treatment assignment given covariates. Estimators relying on double‐robust score functions are highly sensitive to errors in propensity score predictions. Machine learning algorithms have been found to produce models that often overestimate or underestimate these probabilities. Several calibration approaches have been proposed to improve probabilistic forecasts of machine learners. This paper explores their integration into the DML framework, showing via simulations that using calibrated propensity scores significantly reduces the root mean squared error of ATE estimates in finite samples while preserving DML's asymptotic properties.
10.1002/jae.70057.abstract_zh: 双重/去偏机器学习（DML）利用双稳健得分函数来估计平均处理效应（ATE），该函数依赖于对干扰函数的预测，例如倾向得分——即在给定协变量条件下接受处理的概率。依赖双稳健得分函数的估计量对倾向得分预测中的误差高度敏感。研究发现，机器学习算法生成的模型往往高估或低估这些概率。已有多种校准方法被提出以改进机器学习模型的概率预测。本文探讨了将这些方法整合到DML框架中的可行性，并通过模拟实验证明：在校准倾向得分后，有限样本中ATE估计的均方根误差显著降低，同时DML的渐近性质得以保持。
10.1002/jae.70057.title: Improving the Finite Sample Estimation of Average Treatment Effects Using Double/Debiased Machine Learning With Propensity Score Calibration
10.1002/jae.70057.title_zh: 使用倾向得分校准的双重/去偏机器学习改进平均处理效应的有限样本估计

10.1002/jae.70058.abstract: This paper revisits the empirical analysis of Nakamura and Steinsson (2014). I reconstructed and extended the original dataset to cover the period 1966–2019, harmonizing two major sources of data: the Defense Contract Action Data System (DCADS) and USAspending.gov. I discuss how to aggregate these contract‐level data to better capture spending more directly tied to domestic stimulus. Estimated multipliers are slightly lower in narrow replications but increase when incorporating later fiscal episodes. I also assess the validity and stability of cross‐sectional estimates. While some heterogeneity exists, dispersion in state‐level responses remains within reasonable boundaries, especially when accounting for dynamic persistence.
10.1002/jae.70058.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了Nakamura与Steinsson（2014）的实证分析。我重构并扩展了原始数据集，将研究时段覆盖至1966-2019年，整合了两大主要数据来源：国防合同行动数据系统（DCADS）与USAspending.gov。我探讨了如何聚合这些合同级数据，以更精准地捕捉与国内刺激直接相关的支出。在狭义复制中，估计乘数略低，但纳入后期财政事件后有所上升。我还评估了横截面估计的有效性与稳定性。尽管存在一定异质性，但各州层面响应的离散程度仍处于合理范围内，尤其是在考虑动态持续性之后。
10.1002/jae.70058.title: Reassessing the Cross‐Sectional Fiscal Multiplier: Evidence From U.S. Defense Procurement, 1966–2019
10.1002/jae.70058.title_zh: 重新评估横截面财政乘数：来自美国国防采购的证据（1966–2019）

10.1002/jae.70059.abstract: A common VAR approach is to identify responses to TFP news shocks by maximizing the variance share of TFP over a long horizon. We find that these TFP max share estimators tend to be biased in large samples when applied to data generated from DSGE models with shock processes that match TFP moments in the data, especially in the presence of TFP measurement error. We propose an alternative max share news estimator that reduces this bias and the RMSE of the impulse response estimates, even when there is sizable measurement error in the news variable. When applying this estimator to U.S. data, we find that news shocks are slower to diffuse to TFP and have a smaller effect on real activity than implied by the TFP max share estimator.
10.1002/jae.70059.abstract_zh: 常见的VAR方法是通过最大化全要素生产率（TFP）在长期内的方差份额来识别对TFP新闻冲击的响应。我们发现，当将这种TFP最大份额估计量应用于由DSGE模型生成的数据时（该模型的冲击过程与数据中的TFP矩相匹配），尤其是在存在TFP测量误差的情况下，这些估计量在大样本中往往存在偏误。我们提出了一种替代性的最大份额新闻估计量，该估计量能够减少这种偏误以及脉冲响应估计的均方根误差（RMSE），即使新闻变量存在显著的测量误差。当将此估计量应用于美国数据时，我们发现新闻冲击对TFP的扩散速度比TFP最大份额估计量所隐含的更慢，且对实际经济活动的影响更小。
10.1002/jae.70059.title: Estimating Macroeconomic News and Surprise Shocks
10.1002/jae.70059.title_zh: 估算宏观经济新闻与意外冲击

10.1002/jae.70060.abstract: This paper replicates Chen and Kung's 2019 analysis ( The Quarterly Journal of Economics 134(1): 185–226). Inspecting the data reveals that nearly one‐third of transactions (388,903 out of 1,208,621) are perfect duplicates of other rows, excluding the transaction number. The analysis of the data sans duplicates replicates their statistically significant princeling effect, robust across various specifications. Further analysis reveals a disagreement between Chen and Kung's text and code: The paper's “logarithm of area” is actually area () divided by one million. This therefore necessitates a reinterpretation of the estimation results, revealing that the princeling effect is extremely large.
10.1002/jae.70060.abstract_zh: 本文复制了Chen和Kung（2019）在《经济学季刊》上的分析（第134卷，第1期，第185-226页）。检查数据发现，近三分之一的交易记录（1,208,621条中的388,903条）在排除交易编号后，与其他行完全重复。对去除重复后的数据进行分析，复制了他们统计上显著的“太子党”效应，该效应在各种设定下均保持稳健。进一步分析揭示了Chen和Kung文中与代码之间的不一致：论文中的“面积对数”实际上是面积除以一百万。因此，这需要对估计结果进行重新解读，表明“太子党”效应极为显著。

10.1002/jae.70061.abstract: This paper studies estimation of causal effects in a panel data setting. We introduce a new estimator, the Triply Robust Panel (TROP) estimator, that combines a flexible model for the potential outcomes based on a low‐rank factor structure on top of a two‐way‐fixed effect specification, with unit weights intended to upweight units similar to the treated units and time weights intended to upweight time periods close to the treated time periods. We study the performance of the estimator in a set of simulations designed to closely match several commonly studied real data sets. We find that there is substantial variation in the performance of the estimators across the settings considered. The proposed estimator outperforms Two‐Way‐Fixed‐Effect (TWFE) or Difference‐In‐Differences (DID), Synthetic Control (SC), Matrix Completion (MC) and Synthetic‐Difference‐In‐Differences (SDID) estimators. We investigate what features of the data generating process lead to this superior performance and assess the relative importance of the three components of the proposed estimator. We have two recommendations. Our preferred strategy is that researchers use simulations closely matched to the data they are interested in, along the lines discussed in this paper, to investigate which estimators work well in their particular setting. A simpler approach is to use more robust estimators such as SDID or the new TROP estimator, which we find to substantially outperform TWFE/DID estimators in many empirically relevant settings.
10.1002/jae.70061.abstract_zh: 本文研究面板数据设定下的因果效应估计问题。我们提出一种新的估计量——三重稳健面板（TROP）估计量，该估计量结合了基于低秩因子结构的灵活潜在结果模型（该模型建立在双向固定效应规范之上），并引入旨在提升与处理单元相似性的单元权重，以及旨在强化接近处理时间段的时期权重。我们通过一系列与多个常用真实数据集高度匹配的模拟实验，评估该估计量的表现。研究发现，不同设定下各估计量的表现存在显著差异。所提出的估计量优于双向固定效应（TWFE）或双重差分（DID）、合成控制（SC）、矩阵补全（MC）及合成双重差分（SDID）估计量。我们进一步探究数据生成过程中哪些特征导致了这种优越表现，并评估该估计量三个组成部分的相对重要性。我们提出两项建议：首选策略是研究者应按照本文讨论的思路，针对其关注的数据进行高度匹配的模拟实验，以确定在特定设定下表现良好的估计量；更简便的方法是采用SDID或新型TROP估计量等更具稳健性的估计量，我们发现这些估计量在许多实证相关设定中显著优于TWFE/DID估计量。
10.1002/jae.70061.title: Triply Robust Panel Estimators

10.1002/jae.70062.abstract: We introduce a dynamic factor correlation model whose core methodological innovation is a variation‐free parametrization of dynamic factor loadings, inspired by the generalized Fisher transformation. The model accommodates time‐varying correlations, heterogeneous heavy tails, and dependent idiosyncratic shocks. Applied to a Small Universe of 12 assets and a Large Universe of 323 stocks, the factor structure induces a sparse idiosyncratic correlation matrix with dependencies concentrated within subindustries, enabling scalability to high dimensions under a sparse block structure. Both factor loadings and correlations vary substantially. Allowing for heterogeneous heavy tails via convolution‐ distributions yields sizable improvements relative to Gaussian and multivariate‐ benchmarks.
10.1002/jae.70062.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种动态因子相关模型，其核心方法论创新在于受广义费舍尔变换启发的动态因子载荷的无变化参数化方法。该模型能够适应时变相关性、异质性厚尾以及相依的特异性冲击。将该模型应用于包含12项资产的小型资产池和包含323只股票的大型资产池时，因子结构产生了一个稀疏的特异性相关矩阵，其中依赖性集中在子行业内，从而在稀疏块结构下实现了对高维度的可扩展性。因子载荷与相关性均表现出显著变化。通过卷积分布允许异质性厚尾的存在，相较于高斯基准和多元基准，带来了显著的改进。

10.1002/jae.70063.abstract: The external validity of regression discontinuity designs is crucial for informing policy but is rarely examined in applied work. To advance empirical practice, we propose a joint inference procedure for the treatment effect and its local external validity, captured by the treatment effect derivative (TED), within a robust bias correction framework. We further introduce a locally linear treatment effects assumption, which extends the scope of the TED and enables identification and the construction of a uniform confidence band for extrapolated effects. These methods apply to most empirical studies. Empirical illustrations demonstrate their practical usefulness.
10.1002/jae.70063.abstract_zh: 断点回归设计的外部有效性对于政策制定至关重要，但在应用研究中却鲜少被检验。为推进实证实践，我们提出了一种在稳健偏差校正框架内，对处理效应及其局部外部有效性（由处理效应导数TED衡量）进行联合推断的方法。我们进一步引入局部线性处理效应假设，该假设扩展了TED的适用范围，并能够识别外推效应并构建其一致置信带。这些方法适用于大多数实证研究。实证案例展示了其实际应用价值。
10.1002/jae.70063.title: Joint Inference for the Regression Discontinuity Effect and Its External Validity
10.1002/jae.70063.title_zh: 断点回归效应及其外部有效性的联合推断

10.1002/jae.70064.abstract: I provide a precision‐sampler‐based replication of the multivariate unobserved component stochastic volatility outlier‐adjusted model of Stock and Watson (2016) applied to inflation in the United States and the Euro Area (EA). I find a substantial post‐2020 increase in trend inflation for both the United States and the EA, and estimate end‐2024 trend inflation at 2.3 and 2.0 percent, respectively.
10.1002/jae.70064.abstract_zh: 本文基于Stock与Watson（2016）提出的多变量不可观测成分随机波动异常值调整模型，采用精确采样器方法进行复制，并将其应用于美国和欧元区的通胀分析。研究发现，2020年后美国和欧元区的趋势通胀均出现显著上升，预计2024年底的趋势通胀率分别为2.3%和2.0%。
10.1002/jae.70064.title: Multivariate Trend Inflation in the United States and the Euro Area
10.1002/jae.70064.title_zh: 美国和欧元区的多元趋势通胀

10.1002/jae.70065.abstract: We examine how parental income and family structure during childhood and adolescence affect adult income, emphasizing the timing of these effects. Using an ordered multinomial probability model with functional covariates, we find that these familial influences are strongest in middle childhood and adolescence. We also uncover a complementary relationship in the effects of income and family structure trajectories during key developmental periods. By flexibly controlling for personal and family characteristics using nonparametric methods, our approach effectively handles high‐dimensional covariates. The results advance the understanding of intergenerational income mobility and highlight the long‐term importance of early‐life familial conditions for adult economic success.
10.1002/jae.70065.abstract_zh: 本文考察了童年及青少年时期的父母收入与家庭结构如何影响成年后的收入水平，并重点分析了这些影响的时间节点。通过采用含函数协变量的有序多项概率模型，本研究发现这些家庭因素在童年中期及青少年时期的影响最为显著。同时，研究揭示了关键发育阶段中收入与家庭结构轨迹的互补效应。借助非参数方法灵活控制个人及家庭特征，本模型有效处理了高维协变量问题。研究结果深化了对代际收入流动性的理解，并凸显了早期家庭环境对成年后经济成就的长期重要性。
10.1002/jae.70065.title: The Effects of Parental Income and Family Structure on Intergenerational Mobility: A Trajectories‐Based Approach
10.1002/jae.70065.title_zh: 父母收入与家庭结构对代际流动的影响：基于轨迹的方法

10.1002/jae.70066.abstract: This paper introduces a novel method to adaptively design randomized experiments. For randomized experiments with a pilot stage, or multistage experiments, Hahn et al. (2011) propose an adaptive experimental design that adjusts the next stage's propensity score based on data from the previous stages. This paper discusses how the discretization of covariates affects the precision of the estimation of the average treatment effect (ATE) through the estimated propensity score for the next stage. Also, this paper proposes an algorithm using the bootstrap technique to find the optimal level of discretization of covariates. Monte Carlo simulations and an application with actual data show that the suggested method performs well.
10.1002/jae.70066.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种自适应设计随机实验的新方法。针对包含预实验阶段或多阶段随机实验，Hahn等人（2011）提出了一种自适应实验设计，该设计基于前一阶段的数据调整下一阶段的倾向得分。本文探讨了协变量离散化如何通过下一阶段估计的倾向得分影响平均处理效应（ATE）估计的精度。同时，本文提出了一种基于自助法（bootstrap）技术的算法，用于确定协变量的最优离散化水平。蒙特卡洛模拟及实际数据应用表明，所建议的方法表现良好。
10.1002/jae.70066.title: Optimal Covariate Discretization in Adaptive Randomized Experiments
10.1002/jae.70066.title_zh: 自适应随机实验中的最优协变量离散化

10.1002/jae.70067.abstract: This paper studies heterogeneous mixed‐frequency panel data models, focusing on linear specifications that allow heterogeneity in both aggregation weights and slope coefficients. To address potential correlations between the heterogeneity and the covariates, we first show that, under additional normalization conditions, the mean‐group estimator delivers consistent and asymptotically normal slope estimates but biased weights estimators. As an alternative, we propose a correlated random effects estimator using a generalized Mundlak specification. We further discuss the implementation of these two estimators when covariates are observed at substantially higher sampling frequencies. Monte Carlo simulations are conducted to assess their finite‐sample properties. As an empirical illustration, we revisit the impact of temperature fluctuations on economic growth using the proposed framework.
10.1002/jae.70067.abstract_zh: 本文研究异质性混频面板数据模型，重点关注允许聚合权重和斜率系数均存在异质性的线性设定。为应对异质性与协变量之间的潜在相关性，我们首先证明：在额外标准化条件下，均值组估计量能够获得一致且渐近正态的斜率估计，但权重估计量存在偏误。作为替代方案，我们提出采用广义Mundlak设定的相关随机效应估计量。进一步讨论了当协变量以显著更高采样频率被观测时，这两种估计量的实施方法。通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估其有限样本性质。作为实证例证，我们运用该框架重新考察了气温波动对经济增长的影响。
10.1002/jae.70067.title: Estimation of Heterogeneous Panel Data Models With Mixed Sampling Frequencies
10.1002/jae.70067.title_zh: 混合采样频率下异质性面板数据模型的估计

10.1002/jae.70068.abstract: We introduce an overidentification test of two alternative assumptions to identify the average treatment effect on the treated in a two‐period panel data setting: unconfoundedness and common trends. Under unconfoundedness, treatment assignment and post‐treatment outcomes are independent, conditional on control variables and pre‐treatment outcomes, which motivates including the pre‐treatment outcomes in the set of controls. Under common trends, the trend and the treatment assignment are independent, conditional on control variables, motivating a Difference‐in‐Differences (DiD) approach. Given the non‐nested nature of these assumptions and their often ambiguous plausibility in empirical settings, we propose a joint test using a doubly robust statistic that can be combined with machine learning to control for observed confounders in a data‐driven manner. We discuss causal models satisfying either common trends, unconfoundedness, or both assumptions. Applying the proposed method to publicly available datasets, we find that the test rejects the null hypothesis in two out of four cases.
10.1002/jae.70068.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种过度识别检验方法，用于评估两期面板数据中识别处理组平均处理效应的两种替代假设：无混杂性与共同趋势。在无混杂性假设下，处理分配与处理后结果在控制变量和处理前结果条件下相互独立，这促使将处理前结果纳入控制变量集。在共同趋势假设下，趋势与处理分配在控制变量条件下相互独立，这推动了双重差分法的应用。鉴于这两种假设的非嵌套性质及其在实证情境中常存的模糊合理性，我们提出一种联合检验方法，采用双重稳健统计量，可结合机器学习以数据驱动方式控制观测混杂因素。我们讨论了满足共同趋势、无混杂性或两者兼具的因果模型。将所提方法应用于公开数据集后，发现检验在四个案例中有两个拒绝了原假设。
10.1002/jae.70068.title: A Joint Test of Unconfoundedness and Common Trends
10.1002/jae.70068.title_zh: 无混淆性与共同趋势的联合检验

10.1002/jae.70069.abstract: ABSTRACT Peer influence on effort devoted to some activity is often studied when effort is unobserved, and the researcher instead observes an outcome that combines effort with other shocks. For instance, in education, achievement measures such as GPA reflect both effort and idiosyncratic GPA shocks. We propose an alternative approach that circumvents this approximation. Our framework distinguishes unobserved shocks to GPA that do not affect effort from preference shocks that do affect effort levels. We show that peer effects estimates obtained using our approach can differ significantly from classical estimates (where effort is approximated) if the network includes isolated students. Applying our approach to data on high school students in the United States, we find that peer effect estimates relying on GPA as a proxy for effort are 40% lower than those obtained using our approach.
10.1002/jae.70069.abstract_zh: 摘要 当努力程度不可观测，而研究者仅能观察到结合了努力与其他冲击的最终结果时，关于同伴效应对某项活动投入程度的影响研究往往面临挑战。例如在教育领域，GPA等学业成就指标既反映努力程度，也包含个体特有的GPA冲击。本文提出一种规避此类近似处理的新方法。我们的分析框架将不影响努力程度的不可观测GPA冲击与确实影响努力水平的偏好冲击进行区分。研究表明，当社交网络中存在孤立学生时，采用本方法获得的同伴效应估计值可能与经典方法（将努力程度近似处理）存在显著差异。通过将本方法应用于美国高中生数据，我们发现，以GPA作为努力程度代理变量的同伴效应估计值，比采用本方法获得的估计值低40%。
10.1002/jae.70069.title: Identifying Peer Effects in Networks with Unobserved Effort and Isolated Students
10.1002/jae.70069.title_zh: 识别未观测努力与孤立学生网络中的同伴效应

10.1002/jae.70070.abstract: Instrumental variables are a popular tool to infer causal effects under unobserved confounding, but choosing suitable instruments is challenging in practice. We propose gIVBMA, a Bayesian model averaging procedure that addresses this challenge by averaging across different sets of instrumental variables and covariates in a structural equation model. This allows for data‐driven selection of valid and relevant instruments and provides additional robustness against invalid instruments. Our approach extends previous work through a scale‐invariant prior structure and accommodates non‐Gaussian outcomes and treatments, offering greater flexibility than existing methods. The computational strategy uses conditional Bayes factors to update models separately for the outcome and treatments. We prove that this model selection procedure is consistent. In simulation experiments, gIVBMA outperforms current state‐of‐the‐art methods. We demonstrate its usefulness in two empirical applications: the effects of malaria and institutions on income per capita and the returns to schooling. A software implementation of gIVBMA is available in Julia.
10.1002/jae.70070.abstract_zh: 工具变量是在存在未观测混杂因素时推断因果效应的常用方法，但在实践中选择合适的工具变量颇具挑战性。我们提出gIVBMA方法，这是一种通过结构方程模型中对不同工具变量集和协变量集进行平均化的贝叶斯模型平均程序。该方法能够基于数据驱动选择有效且相关的工具变量，并增强对无效工具变量的稳健性。我们的方法通过尺度不变先验结构扩展了先前研究，并兼容非高斯结果变量和处理变量，比现有方法具有更高灵活性。计算策略采用条件贝叶斯因子分别更新结果方程和处理方程的模型。我们证明该模型选择程序具有一致性。模拟实验表明，gIVBMA优于当前最先进方法。我们在两个实证应用中验证其实用价值：疟疾与制度对人均收入的影响，以及教育回报率。gIVBMA的软件实现已发布于Julia平台。
10.1002/jae.70070.title: Bayesian Model Averaging in Causal Instrumental Variable Models
10.1002/jae.70070.title_zh: 因果工具变量模型中的贝叶斯模型平均

10.1002/jae.70071.abstract: We propose a unified framework for interpreting and comparing a broad class of synthetic control (SC) methods. Our framework is built on an analysis of a mean‐squared prediction error (MSPE) bound for the counterfactual predicted by a generic SC method, without imposing a specific outcome model. Using this framework, we develop a generalized SC method that provides a more comprehensive regularization of the MSPE bound than several existing SC methods. Through simulation studies and placebo analyses, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in predicting the counterfactual.
10.1002/jae.70071.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个统一框架，用于解释和比较广泛类别的合成控制（SC）方法。该框架基于对通用SC方法预测的反事实均方预测误差（MSPE）边界的分析，且无需设定特定结果模型。利用此框架，我们开发了一种广义合成控制方法，相较于现有多种SC方法，该方法对MSPE边界实现了更全面的正则化。通过模拟研究与安慰剂分析，我们验证了所提方法在反事实预测中的有效性。
10.1002/jae.70071.title: Regularization of Synthetic Controls for Policy Evaluation
10.1002/jae.70071.title_zh: 政策评估中合成控制法的正则化

10.1002/jae.70072.abstract: We build on Modestino et al., who analysed “opportunistic upskilling” during the 2007 recession in the US, by extending their approach to European labour markets following recent economic shocks. Using a comprehensive dataset of online job postings (2019–2023) and an instrumental variable approach leveraging Ukrainian refugee inflows, we find that increases in labour supply have a significant positive effect on both education and experience requirements. Our findings reinforce the idea that employers opportunistically upskill labour demand in different but challenging macroeconomic contexts. The identification of such patterns, however, depends on the presence of a plausibly exogenous shock to labour markets.
10.1002/jae.70072.abstract_zh: 我们基于Modestino等人对2007年美国经济衰退期间“机会性技能提升”的研究，将其方法拓展至近期经济冲击后的欧洲劳动力市场。利用2019-2023年在线招聘信息的综合数据集，并采用以乌克兰难民流入为工具变量的方法，我们发现劳动力供给增加对教育及经验要求均产生显著正向影响。研究结果进一步印证了雇主在不同但严峻的宏观经济背景下会机会性地提升劳动力需求技能水平的观点。然而，此类模式的识别依赖于劳动力市场是否存在合理外生冲击。
10.1002/jae.70072.title: Opportunistic Upskilling in European Labour Markets—Evidence From a Wide Replication
10.1002/jae.70072.title_zh: 欧洲劳动力市场中的机会性技能提升——基于广泛复制的证据

10.1002/jae.70073.abstract: ABSTRACT We estimate the first time‐varying, county‐level index of housing supply elasticities across the United States, using a structural vector autoregression model with sign restrictions to identify the effect of a positive demand shock. This index reveals four features of the supply curve in different local housing markets. First, supply elasticities are low, on average, generating faster price growth than housing unit growth for most of the country. Second, there is significant variation in elasticities across counties, both urban and rural. Third, elasticities have declined in more counties than they have risen over time, particularly in large urban markets. Fourth, these new estimates predict housing quantity growth better than previous models in the literature.
10.1002/jae.70073.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们利用带有符号约束的结构向量自回归模型识别正向需求冲击效应，首次估算了美国各县级住房供给弹性的时变指数。该指数揭示了不同地方住房市场供给曲线的四个特征：第一，平均而言供给弹性较低，导致全国大部分地区房价增速快于住房单元增速；第二，城乡各县之间的弹性存在显著差异；第三，随时间推移，弹性下降的县数量多于上升的县，尤其是在大型城市市场；第四，相较于文献中的既有模型，这些新估计值能更准确地预测住房数量增长。
10.1002/jae.70073.title: Housing Supply Elasticities: A Structural Vector Autoregression Approach
10.1002/jae.70073.title_zh: 住房供给弹性：结构向量自回归方法

10.1002/jae.70074.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We analyse fiscal policy in resource‐rich economies using a novel Bayesian regime‐switching panel model. The identified regimes capture pro‐ or countercyclical fiscal behaviour by allowing regime‐specific shifts in the average fiscal stance, while the switches between the regimes have the interpretation of changes in fiscal policy. Applying the model to a panel of sixteen oil‐producing economies, we show that fiscal policy has alternated between a procyclical and countercyclical regime multiple times over the sample. Furthermore, we find that fiscal policy is more volatile in the procyclical regime and that the probability of being in the procyclical regime is higher for OPEC countries than for non‐OPEC countries. We also show that following either an increase or decrease in oil revenues, the growth in government expenditures is mostly increasing, suggesting an upward bias in expenditures in oil‐producing countries. These are new findings in the literature.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70074.abstract_zh: 摘要：我们采用一种新颖的贝叶斯体制转换面板模型，分析了资源丰富经济体的财政政策。通过允许平均财政立场发生体制特定转变，识别出的体制捕捉了顺周期或逆周期的财政行为，而体制间的转换则被解释为财政政策的变化。将该模型应用于由16个石油生产经济体组成的面板数据，我们发现在样本期内，财政政策多次在顺周期与逆周期体制之间交替。此外，我们发现顺周期体制下的财政政策波动性更大，且石油输出国组织（OPEC）国家处于顺周期体制的概率高于非OPEC国家。我们还表明，无论石油收入增加还是减少，政府支出的增长大多呈上升趋势，这暗示石油生产国存在支出向上偏倚。这些是文献中的新发现。
10.1002/jae.70074.title: Fiscal Policy Regimes in Resource‐Rich Economies
10.1002/jae.70074.title_zh: 资源丰富经济体的财政政策体制

10.1002/jae.70075.abstract: ABSTRACT Lévy processes are widely used in financial modeling due to their ability to capture discontinuities and heavy tails, which are common in high‐frequency asset return data. However, parameter estimation remains a challenge when associated likelihoods are unavailable or costly to compute. We propose a fast and accurate method for Lévy parameter estimation using the neural Bayes estimation (NBE) framework—a simulation‐based, likelihood‐free approach that leverages permutation‐invariant neural networks to approximate Bayes estimators. We contribute new theoretical results, showing that NBE results in consistent estimators whose risk converges to that of the Bayes estimator under mild conditions. Moreover, through extensive simulations across several Lévy models, we show that NBE outperforms traditional methods in both accuracy and runtime, while also enabling two complementary approaches to uncertainty quantification. We illustrate our approach on a challenging high‐frequency cryptocurrency return dataset, where the method captures evolving parameter dynamics and delivers reliable and interpretable inference at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional methods. We investigate nearly a decade of high‐frequency Bitcoin returns, requiring less than one minute to estimate parameters under the proposed approach.
10.1002/jae.70075.abstract_zh: 摘要 莱维过程因其能够捕捉高频资产收益数据中常见的间断性和厚尾特征，在金融建模中得到广泛应用。然而，当相关似然函数不可用或计算成本高昂时，参数估计仍面临挑战。我们提出了一种基于神经贝叶斯估计（NBE）框架的快速精确莱维参数估计方法——这是一种基于模拟的无似然方法，利用置换不变神经网络来近似贝叶斯估计量。我们贡献了新的理论成果，证明在温和条件下，NBE可得到一致估计量，其风险收敛至贝叶斯估计量的风险水平。此外，通过针对多个莱维模型的大量模拟实验，我们表明NBE在精度和运行时间上均优于传统方法，同时还能实现两种互补的不确定性量化方法。我们以具有挑战性的高频加密货币收益数据集为例进行方法验证，该方法能够捕捉动态变化的参数特征，并以传统方法计算成本的一小部分提供可靠且可解释的推断。我们研究了近十年高频比特币收益数据，在提出的方法下，参数估计耗时不足一分钟。
10.1002/jae.70075.title: Fast Likelihood‐Free Parameter Estimation for Lévy Processes
10.1002/jae.70075.title_zh: 莱维过程的快速无似然参数估计

10.1002/jae.70076.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study proposes specification tests for interference structure in causal inference with spillovers. We focus on experimental settings in which the treatment assignment mechanism is known. To test whether a given exposure mapping adequately summarizes the true interference structure, we develop conditional randomization tests by utilizing the hierarchical relationship between the null and alternative exposure mappings. When there are multiple candidate exposure mappings of interest, we propose a sequential specification testing procedure that controls the false discovery rate. Through extensive simulation exercises, we demonstrate that our tests have desirable size properties and satisfactory power. To illustrate the proposed methods, we revisit two existing social network experiments: One on farmers' insurance adoption and another on anti‐conflict education programs.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70076.abstract_zh: 本研究针对存在溢出效应的因果推断中的干扰结构，提出了设定检验方法。我们聚焦于处理分配机制已知的实验场景。为检验给定的暴露映射是否充分概括了真实的干扰结构，我们利用零假设与备择假设暴露映射之间的层级关系，开发了条件随机化检验。当存在多个感兴趣的候选暴露映射时，我们提出了一种序贯设定检验程序，该程序能够控制错误发现率。通过大量模拟实验，我们证明所提出的检验具有理想的尺度性质与令人满意的检验功效。为说明所提方法的应用，我们重新审视了两项现有社交网络实验：一项关于农民保险采纳行为，另一项关于反冲突教育项目。
10.1002/jae.70076.title: Conditional Randomization Tests for the Specification of Interference Structure
10.1002/jae.70076.title_zh: 干扰结构设定的条件随机化检验

10.1002/jae.70077.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper proposes a simple smooth specification test for the propensity score in the spirit of Neyman (1937). We derive a particular restriction on the propensity score and construct the specification test based on it. Using the density‐weighting method, we transform the original specification testing problem into a test of the joint significance of the generalized Fourier coefficients. We propose a novel projection method to eliminate the parameter estimation effect arising from estimating unknown nuisance parameters. The proposed test is shown to follow a standard  distribution under the null hypothesis and to possess nontrivial asymptotic power against local alternatives that converge to the null at the parametric rate , where  is the sample size. To enhance the practical applicability of the procedure, we further introduce a data‐driven selection method for determining the testing order, enabling automatic selection based on the observed data. Compared to existing methods, our test does not suffer from the “curse of dimensionality” faced by Shaikh et al. (2009); at the same time, our test is both asymptotically pivotal and more computationally efficient than that of Sant'Anna and Song (2019). Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed test yields satisfactory empirical size and power. Compared with previous tests, our test exhibits comparable overall performance and delivers clear improvements in some cases, especially for high‐frequency alternatives. Two empirical applications further illustrate the practical applicability of our proposal, examining propensity score specifications in the Soviet 156 Program and the US Job Corps Program.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70077.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于Neyman（1937）思想的倾向得分平滑设定检验方法。我们推导出倾向得分的一个特定约束条件，并据此构建设定检验。通过密度加权方法，将原始设定检验问题转化为广义傅里叶系数联合显著性检验。我们提出一种新颖的投影方法，以消除未知冗余参数估计带来的参数估计效应。所提出的检验在原假设下服从标准分布，并对以参数速率收敛于原假设的局部备择假设具有非平凡渐近功效（其中为样本量）。为增强方法的实际应用性，我们进一步引入数据驱动的检验阶数选择方法，实现基于观测数据的自动选择。与现有方法相比，本检验不存在Shaikh等（2009）面临的"维度灾难"问题；同时，本检验既具有渐近枢轴性质，又比Sant'Anna和Song（2019）的方法计算效率更高。大量模拟表明，所提检验具有令人满意的经验水平和功效。与以往检验相比，本检验在整体表现上相当，并在某些情形下（尤其是高频备择假设）展现出明显改进。两项实证应用（苏联156工程和美国职业训练团项目）进一步验证了本方法的实际适用性。
10.1002/jae.70077.title: A Smooth Specification Test for the Propensity Score
10.1002/jae.70077.title_zh: 倾向得分的平滑设定检验

10.1002/jae.70078.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>How do labor market institutions shape the transmission of government spending shocks and macroeconomic volatility? We develop a theoretical model in which labor market institutions affect fiscal transmission through their effect on wage rigidity, job separation, and matching frictions. We estimate an interacted panel vector autoregressive model for 16 OECD economies and study how macroeconomic responses to government spending shocks vary with institutional labor market characteristics. In line with our theoretical predictions, we show that institutions that stabilize employment and wages tend to reduce output volatility and attenuate the response of output and employment to government spending shocks.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70078.abstract_zh: 劳动力市场制度如何影响政府支出冲击的传导机制及宏观经济波动？我们构建了一个理论模型，其中劳动力市场制度通过影响工资刚性、岗位分离和匹配摩擦来作用于财政传导机制。基于16个OECD经济体的交互面板向量自回归模型估计，我们研究了宏观经济对政府支出冲击的反应如何随劳动力市场制度特征而变化。与理论预测一致，我们发现稳定就业和工资的制度倾向于降低产出波动，并削弱产出和就业对政府支出冲击的反应。
10.1002/jae.70078.title: Labor Market Institutions, Fiscal Multipliers, and Macroeconomic Volatility
10.1002/jae.70078.title_zh: 劳动力市场制度、财政乘数与宏观经济波动

10.1002/jae.70079.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper explores the existence of network externalities in link formation games of incomplete information. It extends the structural estimation method in Leung (2015) to games where links are undirected and proposals are only partially observed. We provide an econometric characterization of the proposed two‐step estimator and document its performance through a simulation exercise. When the estimation method is applied to data on risk‐sharing arrangements in a Tanzanian village, results indicate that indirect connections matter.
10.1002/jae.70079.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文探讨了不完全信息链接形成博弈中网络外部性的存在性。我们将Leung（2015）的结构估计方法扩展至链接无向且提议仅部分可观测的博弈场景。我们提出了所设计的两步估计量的计量经济学特征，并通过模拟实验验证其性能。将该估计方法应用于坦桑尼亚某村庄风险分担安排的数据后，结果表明间接连接具有显著影响。
10.1002/jae.70079.title: Estimating Network Externalities in Undirected Link Formation Games
10.1002/jae.70079.title_zh: 无向链接形成博弈中的网络外部性估计

10.1002/jae.70080.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>While existing work shows COVID‐19 stay‐at‐home (SAH) policies decreased mobility on average, we lack evidence regarding heterogeneity in policy effectiveness across US counties. To uncover potential heterogeneity, we implement a novel two‐stage approach. First, we employ recent advances in synthetic control estimation and inference to obtain and bound both time‐average and county‐specific treatment effects. Next, we use a local linear forest to explain observed heterogeneity using county‐level predictors. This procedure reveals substantial variation in policy effectiveness and identifies predictors of policy effectiveness which can be used to target future SAH policies.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70080.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>现有研究表明，新冠疫情居家令政策平均降低了人口流动性，但关于该政策在美国各县间有效性的异质性证据尚不充分。为揭示潜在异质性，我们采用了一种新颖的两阶段方法。首先，利用合成控制估计与推断的最新进展，获取并界定了时间平均效应及县级特定处理效应的边界。其次，通过局部线性森林模型，运用县级预测变量解释观测到的异质性。该流程揭示了政策有效性的显著差异，并识别出可用于未来居家令政策精准施策的预测变量。</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70080.title: Deniers and Compliers: Unpacking the Heterogeneous Effectiveness of U.S. Stay‐at‐Home Mandates During the COVID‐19 Pandemic
10.1002/jae.70080.title_zh: 否认者与遵从者：解析美国COVID-19疫情期间居家令的异质性效果

10.1002/jae.70081.abstract: ABSTRACT We propose a method to identify the anticipated components of macroeconomic shocks in a structural VAR. We include empirical forecasts about each time series in the VAR. This introduces enough linear restrictions to identify every structural shock and to further decompose each one into “news” and “surprise” shocks. We estimate a VAR on U.S. time series using forecast data from the SPF, CBO, Federal Reserve, and asset prices. Unanticipated fiscal stimulus and monetary policy shocks have typical effects that match existing evidence. In our news‐surprise decomposition, we find that news drives around one quarter of U.S. business cycle volatility. News explains a larger share of the variance due to fiscal shocks than for monetary policy shocks. Finally, we use the news structure of the shocks to estimate counterfactual policy rules, and compare the ability of fiscal and monetary policy to moderate output and inflation. We find that coordinated fiscal and monetary policy are substantially more effective than either individually.
10.1002/jae.70081.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出一种在结构向量自回归（VAR）中识别宏观经济冲击预期成分的方法。我们将各时间序列的经验预测纳入VAR模型，由此引入足够的线性约束，从而识别所有结构性冲击，并进一步将每个冲击分解为“新闻”冲击与“意外”冲击。我们利用美国国会预算办公室（CBO）、美联储、资产价格及专业预测者调查（SPF）的预测数据，对美国时间序列进行VAR估计。研究发现，未预期的财政刺激与货币政策冲击的典型效应与既有证据一致。在新闻-意外分解中，新闻冲击解释了美国经济周期波动约四分之一的方差。相较于货币政策冲击，新闻冲击对财政冲击方差的解释份额更大。最后，我们利用冲击的新闻结构估计反事实政策规则，并比较财政政策与货币政策在平抑产出与通胀方面的效力。结果表明，财政与货币政策的协调配合比单一政策显著更有效。
10.1002/jae.70081.title: Identifying News Shocks From Forecasts
10.1002/jae.70081.title_zh: 从预测中识别新闻冲击

10.1002/jae.70082.abstract: We estimate the causal effects of macroprudential policies on the entire distribution of GDP growth for advanced European economies using a narrative‐identification strategy in a quantile‐regression framework. While macroprudential policy has near‐zero effects on the center of the GDP‐growth distribution, tighter policy brings benefits by reducing the variance of future growth, significantly boosting the left tail while simultaneously reducing the right. Assessing a range of channels through which these effects materialize, we find that macroprudential policy particularly operates through ‘credit‐at‐risk’: it reduces the right tail of future credit growth, dampening booms, in turn reducing the likelihood of extreme GDP‐growth outturns.
