We show that the core is non-empty and strictly contains the set of competitive equilibrium payoff vectors that coincides with the set of solutions of the dual q -assignment problem, where q is the total capacity of the middlemen.
10.1007/s00182-026-01007-y.abstract_zh: 我们考察一个三边市场，其中每对买卖双方只有在存在中间人连接时才能获得利润。该利润不依赖于中间人的身份，且每位买方和卖方最多只能参与一项合作关系，而中间人则可建立多项合作关系，直至其容量上限。我们证明，核心非空，并严格包含竞争均衡支付向量集合，该集合与对偶q-分配问题的解集一致，其中q为中间人的总容量。
10.1007/s00182-026-01007-y.title: Assignment markets with capacitated middlemen: core and competitive equilibria
10.1007/s00182-026-01007-y.title_zh: 具有容量限制中间人的指派市场：核与竞争均衡

10.1007/s00182-026-01008-x.abstract: We consider two-stage parallel contests with a finite set of agents, as well as a finite set of heterogeneous contests with varying winning prizes. In the first stage, each agent simultaneously chooses in which contest he wants to compete, and in the second stage, the agents who chose the same contest compete against each other in a contest for a single prize. We first assume a general Tullock contest success function with nonlinear cost functions, and then we present an algorithm that converges to equilibrium, namely, the algorithm organizes the allocation of homogeneous or heterogeneous agents of two types, each with a different cost of effort, among the contests until no agent wishes to change his current contest. Later, we assume the Tullock contest success function with linear cost functions, and we show that for homogeneous agents, our model and a potential game are equivalent, allowing us to explicitly characterize the subgame perfect equilibrium with pure strategies.
10.1007/s00182-026-01008-x.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个包含有限数量参与者的两阶段并行竞赛模型，以及一系列奖品各异的异质性竞赛。在第一阶段，每位参与者同时选择想要参加的竞赛；在第二阶段，选择同一竞赛的参与者们为争夺单一奖品而相互竞争。我们首先假设采用具有非线性成本函数的通用Tullock竞赛成功函数，随后提出一种收敛至均衡的算法，即该算法组织同质或异质的两类参与者（每类具有不同的努力成本）在竞赛间进行分配，直至没有参与者希望更换其当前竞赛。接着，我们假设采用具有线性成本函数的Tullock竞赛成功函数，并证明对于同质参与者，我们的模型与一个势博弈等价，从而能够明确刻画纯策略下的子博弈完美均衡。
10.1007/s00182-026-01008-x.title: An algorithmic analysis of parallel contests

10.1007/s00182-026-01009-w.title: Hotelling bound: pricing and location with reservation prices
10.1007/s00182-026-01009-w.title_zh: 霍特林边界：保留价格下的定价与选址

10.1007/s00182-026-01010-3.abstract: This paper considers a natural ruleset for playing a partisan combinatorial game on a directed graph, which we call Digraph placement. Given a digraph G with a not necessarily proper 2-coloring of V(G), the Digraph placement game played on G by the players Left and Right, who play alternately, is defined as follows. On her turn, Left chooses a blue vertex which is deleted along with all of its out-neighbours. On his turn Right chooses a red vertex, which is deleted along with all of its out-neighbours. A player loses if on their turn they cannot move. We show constructively that Digraph placement is a universal partisan ruleset; for all partisan combinatorial games X there exists a Digraph placement game, G, such that $$G = X$$ . Digraph placement and many other games including Nim, Poset Games, Col, Node Kayles, Domineering, and Arc Kayles are instances of a class of placement games that we call conflict placement games. We prove that X is a conflict placement game if and only if it has the same literal form as a Digraph placement game. A corollary of this is that deciding the winner of a Digraph placement game is PSPACE-hard. Next, for a game value X we prove bounds on the order of a smallest Digraph placement game G such that $$G = X$$ .
10.1007/s00182-026-01010-3.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种在有向图上进行党派组合博弈的自然规则集，我们称之为有向图放置（Digraph placement）。给定一个有向图G，其顶点集V(G)具有一个不一定正常的2-着色，由玩家Left和Right交替进行的Digraph放置博弈定义如下：轮到Left时，她选择一个蓝色顶点，该顶点连同其所有出邻点一起被删除；轮到Right时，他选择一个红色顶点，该顶点连同其所有出邻点一起被删除。若某玩家在其回合无法行动，则该玩家输掉游戏。我们构造性地证明，Digraph放置是一个通用的党派规则集；对于所有党派组合博弈X，存在一个Digraph放置博弈G，使得$$G = X$$。Digraph放置以及包括Nim、偏序集博弈、Col、Node Kayles、Domineering和Arc Kayles在内的许多其他博弈，都是我们称为冲突放置博弈的一类放置博弈的实例。我们证明，X是冲突放置博弈当且仅当它与某个Digraph放置博弈具有相同的字面形式。由此推论，判定Digraph放置博弈的胜者问题是PSPACE-hard的。接下来，对于博弈值X，我们证明了使得$$G = X$$的最小Digraph放置博弈G的阶数的界。
10.1007/s00182-026-01010-3.title: Digraph placement games

10.1007/s00199-026-01714-3.abstract: In a coordination game with multiple Pareto ordered equilibria and population uncertainty, we show that group size helps select a unique equilibrium, for reasons reminiscent of the global games literature. A critical mass phenomenon emerges at equilibrium. Group size has an emboldening effect on participants.
10.1007/s00199-026-01714-3.abstract_zh: 在具有多个帕累托排序均衡和人口不确定性的协调博弈中，我们证明群体规模有助于选择唯一均衡，其原因与全球博弈文献中的观点相似。均衡中出现了一个关键多数现象。群体规模对参与者具有鼓舞效应。

10.1007/s00199-026-01715-2.abstract: We formulate three sets of axioms to measure inequality of opportunity. First, the basic axioms that any relative measure should satisfy. Second, axioms that capture the ex ante perspective, focusing on inequality between individuals with different circumstances. Third, axioms that capture the ex post perspective, focusing on inequality among individuals with the same responsibility characteristics. Based on these axioms, we characterize the ex ante and ex post classes of inequality of opportunity measures. We also discuss how well existing measures in the literature adhere to the axioms.
10.1007/s00199-026-01715-2.abstract_zh: 我们构建了三组公理来度量机会不平等。第一组是任何相对度量方法均应满足的基本公理。第二组公理捕捉事前视角，聚焦于不同环境禀赋个体之间的不平等。第三组公理捕捉事后视角，聚焦于具有相同责任特征个体之间的不平等。基于这些公理，我们刻画了事前与事后两类机会不平等度量方法。同时，本文还探讨了现有文献中的度量方法对这些公理的遵循程度。
10.1007/s00199-026-01715-2.title: An axiomatic approach to the measurement of inequality of opportunity
10.1007/s00199-026-01715-2.title_zh: 机会不平等测度的公理化方法

10.1007/s00199-026-01716-1.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic game-theoretic framework to analyze security competition between two states that can invest in a technology to eliminate their rival. Extending the canonical one-shot game, our model incorporates a negotiation (settlement) stage and assumes effective diplomacy, which rules out payoff-dominated equilibria. We fully characterize equilibrium behavior across all discount factors and compare outcomes under high and low elimination costs. The dynamic structure reveals why, even with optimal coordination, long-lasting disarmed peace is rare. By combining the dynamics of military escalation with the constraints of effective diplomacy, the model rationalizes historical cycles of peace, arms races, and conflict. Our approach identifies strategic mechanisms that restrict the sustainability of disarmament and clarifies the conditions under which arms races or conflict become inevitable, offering a deeper understanding of the recurrent nature of international conflict under repeated interaction.
10.1007/s00199-026-01716-1.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个动态博弈理论框架，用于分析两个国家在投资消除对手技术时的安全竞争。在经典单次博弈的基础上，我们的模型引入了谈判（和解）阶段，并假设有效外交排除了收益占优均衡。我们全面刻画了所有折现因子下的均衡行为，并比较了高消除成本与低消除成本下的结果。动态结构揭示了为何即使在最优协调下，持久的非武装和平也极为罕见。通过将军事升级的动态过程与有效外交的约束相结合，该模型合理化了和平、军备竞赛与冲突的历史循环。我们的方法识别出限制裁军可持续性的战略机制，并阐明了军备竞赛或冲突不可避免的条件，从而在重复互动背景下为理解国际冲突的反复性提供了更深刻的洞见。
10.1007/s00199-026-01716-1.title: The elusive quest for disarmed peace: contest games and international relations
10.1007/s00199-026-01716-1.title_zh: 寻求解除武装和平的艰难探索：竞争博弈与国际关系

10.1007/s00199-026-01717-0.abstract: We study an agency model with two independent projects each of which is owned by a principal. Under exclusive agency, each principal uses a different agent, whereas under common agency, all principals use the same agent. A project’s outcome depends on the agent’s hidden effort. We show that, even in the absence of physical linkages between the projects, a principal benefits from providing information on her project outcome to the other principal under common agency (rather than benefiting from receiving the information ), whereas no such benefits arise under exclusive agency. That is, under common agency, an information sharing principal can take advantage of the other principal’s using the shared information. As a result, sharing information becomes each principal’s dominant strategy, provided that the other principal uses the shared information in a Pareto-optimal way. We show that using a common agent is optimal when information can be shared.
10.1007/s00199-026-01717-0.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含两个独立项目的委托代理模型，每个项目由一位委托人所有。在独家代理模式下，每位委托人雇佣不同的代理人；而在共同代理模式下，所有委托人雇佣同一代理人。项目的产出取决于代理人的隐性努力。研究表明，即使项目之间不存在物理关联，在共同代理模式下，委托人通过向另一位委托人提供自身项目结果的信息（而非接收信息）能够获益，而这种收益在独家代理模式下并不存在。也就是说，在共同代理模式下，共享信息的委托人可以利用另一位委托人对共享信息的使用。因此，只要另一位委托人以帕累托最优方式使用共享信息，信息共享将成为每位委托人的占优策略。我们证明，当信息可以共享时，使用共同代理人是最优选择。
10.1007/s00199-026-01717-0.title: Information alliance in common agency
10.1007/s00199-026-01717-0.title_zh: 共同代理中的信息联盟

10.1007/s00199-026-01718-z.abstract: This paper examines the effects of differences in sectoral compositions between countries on the liberalization of global tariffs in the coalition-proof Nash equilibrium sense. Using a static tariff-setting game with endogenous trade agreements, I develop a competing exporters model with three countries that differ in their sectoral compositions. I consider two settings that are differentiated by the type of trade agreements that countries can sign: free trade agreements (FTAs) and multilateral trade agreements, i.e., no FTAs. I study both symmetric and asymmetric differences in sectoral compositions across countries and find that, contrary to earlier results based on economic size asymmetries, FTAs act as stumbling blocks to the multilateral trading system when countries sufficiently differ in their sectoral compositions. This result is caused by the existence of a free riding incentive. Lastly, I show that permitting internal tariffs in FTAs typically strengthens the free riding incentive under symmetric sectoral differences, and in the asymmetric case may either mitigate or exacerbate the stumbling-block problem depending on countries’ sectoral compositions.
10.1007/s00199-026-01718-z.abstract_zh: 本文考察了国家间部门构成差异对全球关税自由化的影响，在联盟证明纳什均衡的意义上进行分析。通过一个具有内生贸易协定的静态关税设定博弈，我构建了一个包含三个部门构成不同的国家的竞争性出口商模型。我考虑了两种设置，其区别在于国家可以签署的贸易协定类型：自由贸易协定（FTAs）和多边贸易协定，即无自由贸易协定的情况。我研究了国家间部门构成的对称和不对称差异，并发现，与先前基于经济规模不对称的结果相反，当国家在部门构成上存在显著差异时，自由贸易协定成为多边贸易体系的绊脚石。这一结果源于搭便车激励的存在。最后，我表明，在对称部门差异下，允许自由贸易协定中的内部关税通常会增强搭便车激励，而在不对称情况下，则可能根据国家的部门构成减轻或加剧绊脚石问题。
10.1007/s00199-026-01718-z.title: How do sectoral compositions affect the impact of FTAs on global tariff liberalization?
10.1007/s00199-026-01718-z.title_zh: 部门构成如何影响自由贸易协定对全球关税自由化的作用？

10.1007/s00199-026-01719-y.abstract: We present a new multivariate distribution with Pareto distributed tails and maxima. Compared to uncorrelated univariate Pareto distributions, it features one additional parameter that governs the covariance of its realizations. We argue that it has a number of aggregation properties that make it useful for applied work alongside multivariate Gumbel and Fréchet distributions. In particular, it is well suited for applications with a participation threshold. Finally, we show that this distribution is indeed valid by proving a general result about n-increasing functions.
10.1007/s00199-026-01719-y.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的多元分布，其尾部及最大值服从帕累托分布。与不相关的单变量帕累托分布相比，它增加了一个参数，用于控制其实现值的协方差。我们认为，该分布具有若干聚合性质，使其在应用工作中与多元Gumbel和Fréchet分布同样有用。特别是，它非常适合具有参与门槛的应用场景。最后，我们通过证明关于n递增函数的一般性结果，表明该分布确实是有效的。
10.1007/s00199-026-01719-y.title: A Multivariate distribution with Pareto tails and Pareto maxima
10.1007/s00199-026-01719-y.title_zh: 具有帕累托尾部和帕累托最大值的多元分布

10.1007/s00199-026-01720-5.abstract: We build a model of policymaking under the threat of unrest. A policymaker chooses how much effort to spend on a public good; effort is unobservable and the outcome conditional on effort is uncertain. A group of citizens protest if the outcome falls short of a reference point; the reference point is determined endogenously by expectations about the outcome and by the intensity of emotions. We show that the effects of stronger emotional reactions on policymaker’s effort and the probability of protest are nonmonotonic and depend on the group’s ability to inflict damage. Equilibrium may require the policymaker to randomize between providing some effort or no effort at all, in order to temper citizens’ expectations, in which case strong emotional reactions are counterproductive. Optimal emotional reactions are fine-tuned to minimize the probability of protest.
10.1007/s00199-026-01720-5.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个在骚乱威胁下的政策制定模型。政策制定者需决定投入多少精力用于公共品供给；其努力程度不可观测，且努力所对应的结果具有不确定性。当公共品供给结果低于某个参照点时，公民群体便会发起抗议；该参照点由对结果的预期及情绪强度内生决定。研究表明，情绪反应的增强对政策制定者努力程度及抗议概率的影响呈非单调性，且取决于群体造成损害的能力。均衡状态下，政策制定者可能需要在"付出一定努力"与"完全不努力"之间进行随机化选择，以调节公民预期——此时强烈的情绪反应反而适得其反。最优情绪反应需精准调校，以最小化抗议发生的概率。
10.1007/s00199-026-01720-5.title: Why Do People Protest? A Theory of Emotions, Public Policy, and Political Unrest
10.1007/s00199-026-01720-5.title_zh: 人们为何抗议？情绪、公共政策与政治动荡的理论

10.1007/s00199-026-01722-3.abstract: We study the effect of prudence on optimal prevention in two periods with Kreps and Porteus (1978) and Selden (1978) (KPS) preferences. We use consumption smoothing as the benchmark and consider risk-averse decision-makers. In this framework, prudence has a positive effect on prevention, generalizing findings of Menegatti (2009). We extend this result to risk lovers and comparative risk aversion. When saving is endogenized, the preference over the timing of uncertainty resolution becomes irrelevant for prevention, and only the curvature of marginal utility matters. This result allows us to identify a class of decision-makers who are prudent in the KPS model but whose prevention effort coincides with that of a risk-neutral agent. Our findings highlight that the structure of intertemporal preferences critically shapes the link between prudence and prevention.
10.1007/s00199-026-01722-3.abstract_zh: 本文研究在Kreps与Porteus（1978）及Selden（1978）（KPS）偏好框架下，审慎性对两期最优预防行为的影响。以消费平滑为基准，我们考察风险厌恶型决策者。在此框架中，审慎性对预防行为具有正向促进作用，从而推广了Menegatti（2009）的研究结论。我们将该结论拓展至风险偏好型决策者及比较风险厌恶情形。当储蓄内生化时，不确定性解决的时间偏好对预防行为不再具有影响，仅边际效用曲率发挥作用。这一发现使我们能够识别出KPS模型中具有审慎性、但其预防努力水平与风险中性主体一致的决策者群体。研究结果凸显跨期偏好结构对审慎性与预防行为关联性的关键塑造作用。
10.1007/s00199-026-01722-3.title: Disentangling risk and time for optimal prevention
10.1007/s00199-026-01722-3.title_zh: 分离风险与时间以实现最优预防

10.1007/s00199-026-01723-2.abstract: We introduce a new, powerful, and easy-to-use solution concept called simple forward induction which is implied by strategic stability in generic finite multi-sender signaling games. We apply this concept to infinite monotonic signaling games and show that a unique simple forward induction outcome exists and is non-distorted by asymmetric information. We also show that, in this class of games, the non-distorted outcome is the limit of stable outcomes of finite games. Hence, in this sense, we characterize stable outcomes in this class of games. The definition of our solution concept can be easily extended to arbitrary extensive-form games.
10.1007/s00199-026-01723-2.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖、强大且易于使用的解概念，称为简单前向归纳法，该概念在一般有限多发送者信号博弈中由策略稳定性所蕴含。我们将这一概念应用于无限单调信号博弈，并证明存在唯一的简单前向归纳结果，且该结果不受信息不对称的扭曲。我们还证明，在此类博弈中，非扭曲结果是有限博弈稳定结果的极限。因此，在此意义上，我们刻画了此类博弈中的稳定结果。我们的解概念定义可轻松推广至任意扩展式博弈。
10.1007/s00199-026-01723-2.title: Simple forward induction in monotonic multi-sender signaling games
10.1007/s00199-026-01723-2.title_zh: 单调多发送者信号博弈中的简单前向归纳

10.1007/s00199-026-01724-1.abstract: Berge equilibrium offers an alternative to Nash equilibrium in game theory, emphasizing cooperative stability rather than individual optimization. Despite recent interest, a systematic study of Berge equilibria in finite normal form games is still lacking, with fundamental questions like existence remaining open. This paper characterizes Berge equilibria through a polynomial system of equations, enabling computational algebra and algebraic geometry methods to analyze them. Algorithms based on Gröbner bases determine the existence and computation of Berge equilibria. Furthermore, we show that the set of games admitting completely mixed Berge equilibria is contained within a determinantal variety, whose dimension we explicitly bound from above.
10.1007/s00199-026-01724-1.abstract_zh: 伯格均衡为博弈论中的纳什均衡提供了一种替代方案，强调合作稳定性而非个体最优化。尽管近期研究兴趣渐增，但有限正规型博弈中伯格均衡的系统性研究仍显不足，诸如存在性等基本问题尚未解决。本文通过多项式方程组刻画伯格均衡，从而能够运用计算代数和代数几何方法对其进行分析。基于格罗布纳基的算法可判定伯格均衡的存在性并实现其计算。此外，我们证明存在完全混合伯格均衡的博弈集合包含于某一行列式簇中，并给出了该簇维数的显式上界。
10.1007/s00199-026-01724-1.title: Berge equilibria – an algebraic approach
10.1007/s00199-026-01724-1.title_zh: 伯格均衡——一种代数方法

10.1007/s00199-026-01725-0.abstract: This paper studies the impact of the order of senders in a sequential Bayesian persuasion game on the receiver’s equilibrium utility. We find that it is always optimal for the receiver to put the more aligned sender before the less aligned sender. Comparative statics analysis shows that when we restrict to senders who are comparable (i.e., a sender is more aligned than the other sender), as the degree of misalignment between senders increases or as the number of senders increases, the receiver’s equilibrium utility may (weakly) decrease. In addition, we find that when senders are comparable, the sequential game performs no worse than the simultaneous game in terms of information disclosure.
10.1007/s00199-026-01725-0.abstract_zh: 本文研究了序贯贝叶斯说服博弈中发送者顺序对接收者均衡效用的影响。我们发现，将更契合的发送者置于较不契合的发送者之前，对接收者而言总是最优的。比较静态分析表明，当限制在可比较的发送者之间（即一个发送者比另一个更契合）时，随着发送者间不契合程度的增加或发送者数量的增加，接收者的均衡效用可能（弱）下降。此外，我们发现当发送者可比较时，序贯博弈在信息披露方面不劣于同时博弈。
10.1007/s00199-026-01725-0.title: Optimal sender ordering in sequential persuasion
10.1007/s00199-026-01725-0.title_zh: 序列说服中的最优发送者排序

10.1007/s00199-026-01726-z.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    This paper develops a tractable model of wishful thinking that captures both the benefits and costs of optimistic biased beliefs and the behaviors they induce. Building on Bratcha and Brown (2012) and Caplin and Leahy (2019), we propose a two-stage framework in which a decision maker selects actions and belief structures under uncertainty, balancing subjective utility against the cost of departing from prior beliefs. The cost is formalized using a
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$\phi $$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mi>ϕ</mml:mi>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    -divergence–based belief distortion function, encompassing measures such as Kullback–Leibler, reverse Kullback-Leibler, and Pearson
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$\chi ^2$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:msup>
                            <mml:mi>χ</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                          </mml:msup>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    distances. Our contributions are threefold: (i) we characterize optimal beliefs, showing they twist prior probabilities toward high-utility states across a broad class of divergences; (ii) we link WT behavior to risk-seeking actions via convex risk measures; and (iii) we introduce cognitive censoring and cognitive emergence, capturing extreme beliefs. Methodologically, the model provides new insights into how optimistic beliefs reshape decision-making, extending the theoretical foundations of WT and opening avenues for future research.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s00199-026-01726-z.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个易于处理的愿望思维模型，同时捕捉了乐观偏差信念及其所引发行为的收益与成本。在Bratcha与Brown（2012）以及Caplin与Leahy（2019）的研究基础上，我们提出了一个两阶段框架：决策者在不确定性下选择行动与信念结构，在主观效用与偏离先验信念的成本之间进行权衡。该成本通过基于ϕ-散度的信念扭曲函数形式化，涵盖Kullback-Leibler散度、逆Kullback-Leibler散度以及Pearson χ²距离等度量。我们的贡献有三方面：（i）刻画了最优信念的特征，表明在广泛的散度类别中，最优信念会将先验概率向高效用状态扭曲；（ii）通过凸风险度量将愿望思维行为与风险寻求行动联系起来；（iii）引入认知审查与认知涌现概念，捕捉极端信念。在方法论上，该模型为乐观信念如何重塑决策提供了新见解，拓展了愿望思维的理论基础，并为未来研究开辟了方向。
10.1007/s00199-026-01726-z.title: Wishful thinking is risky thinking
10.1007/s00199-026-01726-z.title_zh: 一厢情愿是冒险的思维

10.1007/s00199-026-01727-y.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    We derive conditions for individual choices and
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$ \epsilon $$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mi>ϵ</mml:mi>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    -equilibrium prices to be inferred from a finite set of market data in the following sense: Although potential observations are infinite, inference can be attained and known to have been attained after a finite number of observations. While we first examine the case of observations on an individual’s demand at different prices and incomes, our primary focus is on equilibrium, where only profiles of individual endowments and associated equilibrium prices are observable. Our main result is that finite inference is possible in the equilibrium setting if one wants to infer either individual choices or the
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$ \epsilon $$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mi>ϵ</mml:mi>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    -equilibrium correspondence.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s00199-026-01727-y.abstract_zh: 我们推导了从有限市场数据推断个体选择与ε-均衡价格的条件，其含义如下：尽管潜在观测数据是无限的，但推断可以在有限次观测后实现，且可被确知已实现。我们首先考察不同价格与收入下个体需求的观测情形，但主要关注均衡状态——此时仅能观测到个体禀赋分布及其对应的均衡价格。主要结论是：若需推断个体选择或ε-均衡对应关系，则在均衡设定下有限推断是可行的。
10.1007/s00199-026-01727-y.title: Exact inference from finite market data
10.1007/s00199-026-01727-y.title_zh: 有限市场数据的精确推断

10.1007/s00199-026-01728-x.abstract: I extend the canonical cheap talk model to a continuous-time setting in which a biased sender privately observes the state and strategically chooses when to communicate, while a receiver decides when to stop waiting and act. Waiting is costly because both players discount future payoffs. In equilibrium, information is gradually revealed through strategic silence: the sender’s silence at certain times signals valuable information, allowing the receiver to update her beliefs continuously. This generates an unraveling process in which increasingly high types are revealed over time under positive bias, and increasingly low types are revealed under negative bias. Learning remains incomplete, however, because waiting costs eventually induce the receiver to stop and make an educated guess. I derive conditions for the existence of this dynamic revelation equilibrium and show that strategic timing can enhance information transmission and receiver welfare relative to static cheap talk. I also show that multiple senders with opposing biases accelerate learning and increase the extent of revelation.
10.1007/s00199-026-01728-x.abstract_zh: 我将经典的廉价交谈模型扩展到连续时间框架中，其中，有偏见的发送者私下观察状态，并策略性地选择沟通时机，而接收者则决定何时停止等待并采取行动。等待是有成本的，因为双方都会对未来收益进行折现。在均衡状态下，信息通过策略性沉默逐渐揭示：发送者在特定时刻的沉默传递了有价值的信息，使接收者能够持续更新其信念。这产生了一个逐步揭示的过程，在正向偏见下，随时间推移，越来越高的类型被揭示；在负向偏见下，则是越来越低的类型被揭示。然而，学习过程并不完全，因为等待成本最终会促使接收者停止等待并做出有根据的猜测。我推导了这种动态揭示均衡存在的条件，并表明，与静态廉价交谈相比，策略性时机选择能增强信息传递并提高接收者的福利。我还证明，多个持有对立偏见的发送者会加速学习过程并增加揭示的程度。
10.1007/s00199-026-01728-x.title: Silence speaks volumes: dynamic cheap talk over a static issue
10.1007/s00199-026-01728-x.title_zh: 沉默胜千言：静态议题上的动态廉价交谈

10.1007/s00199-026-01729-w.abstract: Using constructive order-theoretic techniques, we characterize the set of minimal state-space recursive competitive equilibria (RCE) in the canonical small open economy model of sudden stops with price-dependent collateral constraints. In addition, we develop a computable theory of the existence of RCE, as well as a complete constructive theory of equilibrium comparative statics of the entire set of RCE relative to ordered changes in important deep parameters of the economy. Using recent results on iterative monotone comparative statics, we also provide a new iterative approach to checking whether particular RCE are "order stable" relative to ordered changes in the deep parameters (and satisfying the correspondence principle). Finally, we give sufficient conditions for the uniqueness of RCE, and these sufficient conditions are extremely strong relative to applications of these models in the quantitative applied literature.
10.1007/s00199-026-01729-w.abstract_zh: 利用构造性序理论技术，我们刻画了在具有价格依赖抵押约束的典型小开放经济突然停止模型中，最小状态空间递归竞争均衡（RCE）的集合。此外，我们发展了一个关于RCE存在性的可计算理论，以及一个完整的构造性均衡比较静态理论，该理论涉及整个RCE集合相对于经济中重要深层参数的有序变化。借助迭代单调比较静态的最新成果，我们还提供了一种新的迭代方法，用于检验特定RCE相对于深层参数的有序变化是否“序稳定”（并满足对应原理）。最后，我们给出了RCE唯一性的充分条件，这些条件相对于这些模型在定量应用文献中的应用而言极为严格。
10.1007/s00199-026-01729-w.title: Dynamic complementarities and multiple equilibria in open economies with collateral constraints
10.1007/s00199-026-01729-w.title_zh: 抵押约束下开放经济体的动态互补性与多重均衡

10.1007/s00199-026-01732-1.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We analyze competition in service markets with unit demand prone to adverse selection, such as secured lending and car insurance markets. Incumbent firms learn their customers’ types over time and can price discriminate accordingly. We prove existence of a unique set of mixed strategy equilibria where firms randomize prices over a bounded continuous support. Incumbents earn positive rents. Increased competition through firm entry does not benefit customers if firms know portfolio compositions of competitors. If firms only possess information regarding the aggregate industry client composition, horizontal mergers may reduce industry rents, a finding with implications for competition policy in information-intensive industries.</jats:p>
10.1007/s00199-026-01732-1.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文分析了存在逆向选择风险的单元需求服务市场中的竞争问题，例如担保贷款和汽车保险市场。在位企业会随时间推移了解客户类型，并据此实施价格歧视。我们证明存在一组唯一的混合策略均衡，其中企业在有界连续支撑集上随机定价。在位企业可获得正租金。若企业知晓竞争对手的资产组合构成，则通过企业进入加剧竞争并不会使客户受益。若企业仅掌握行业整体客户构成的汇总信息，横向并购可能降低行业租金——这一发现对信息密集型行业的竞争政策具有启示意义。
10.1007/s00199-026-01732-1.title: Competition on service markets with unit demand and learning
10.1007/s00199-026-01732-1.title_zh: 单位需求与学习效应下的服务市场竞争

10.1007/s00199-026-01733-0.abstract: Wealthier, risk-averse buyers pay more to speed up transactions in competitive search markets. This, coupled with forward-looking intermediaries who hold vacant homes overnight, implies that a credit expansion produces a boom in prices that slowly recedes over time. This boom is due to a combination of two effects. First, search and matching frictions imply that buyers are willing to pay a higher price to trade faster, not only to consume housing services. Second, the fact that intermediaries are forward-looking implies that trading probabilities today depend on the future evolution of prices. Since agents forecast that prices are higher than in the initial steady state, they turn to trading today. Our theory produces a boom in prices that slowly recedes and a gradual rise of homeownership rate.
10.1007/s00199-026-01733-0.abstract_zh: 更富裕且风险规避的买家在竞争性搜索市场中愿意支付更高价格以加速交易。这一现象，加之持有空置房屋过夜的具有前瞻性的中介机构，意味着信贷扩张会引发价格繁荣，随后随时间缓慢回落。这种繁荣源于两种效应的结合。首先，搜索与匹配摩擦意味着买家不仅为了消费住房服务，还为了更快达成交易而愿意支付更高价格。其次，中介机构的前瞻性意味着今日的交易概率取决于价格的未来走势。由于主体预测价格高于初始稳态水平，他们转向今日交易。我们的理论产生了价格缓慢回落及住房拥有率逐步上升的繁荣景象。
10.1007/s00199-026-01733-0.title: Credit and inventories in illiquid housing markets
10.1007/s00199-026-01733-0.title_zh: 流动性不足的住房市场中的信贷与库存

10.1007/s00199-026-01734-z.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    In many expert–decision maker settings, information is richer than the language used to convey it. Motivated by this communication friction, we study Bayesian persuasion when the sender is constrained to use
                    <jats:italic>k</jats:italic>
                    messages. We show that the sender’s value is given by a
                    <jats:italic>k</jats:italic>
                    -point analogue of concavification, which we call
                    <jats:italic>k</jats:italic>
                    -concavification. An optimal information structure can be chosen with affinely independent posterior support, allowing the problem to be reduced to a lower-dimensional persuasion problem and then solved by standard concavification. We derive a tight bound on the value of communication capacity that applies to general persuasion games: the gain from a
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$(k+1)$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mrow>
                            <mml:mo>(</mml:mo>
                            <mml:mi>k</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mo>+</mml:mo>
                            <mml:mn>1</mml:mn>
                            <mml:mo>)</mml:mo>
                          </mml:mrow>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    <jats:sup>st</jats:sup>
                    message is at most
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$2/(k-1)$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mrow>
                            <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                            <mml:mo>/</mml:mo>
                            <mml:mo>(</mml:mo>
                            <mml:mi>k</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mo>-</mml:mo>
                            <mml:mn>1</mml:mn>
                            <mml:mo>)</mml:mo>
                          </mml:mrow>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    times the value attainable with
                    <jats:italic>k</jats:italic>
                    messages. Finally, we solve a class of belief-threshold games in which the receiver chooses between a safe default and several risky actions, the sender gets zero from the default and the same positive payoff from any risky action, and a risky action is taken only when the corresponding posterior probability exceeds a threshold. We characterize the optimal coarse information structure, derive comparative statics in the prior and the threshold, and extend the analysis to heterogeneous thresholds and heterogeneous sender values across risky actions.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s00199-026-01734-z.abstract_zh: 在许多专家与决策者互动的场景中，信息本身比用于传递信息的语言更为丰富。受这种沟通摩擦的启发，我们研究了当发送者被限制只能使用k条信息时的贝叶斯说服问题。我们证明，发送者的价值由k点版本的凹化（称为k-凹化）给出。通过选择仿射独立的后验支撑，可以构建最优信息结构，从而将问题简化为低维说服问题，并通过标准凹化方法求解。我们推导出适用于一般说服博弈的沟通能力价值的紧界：从第(k+1)条信息中获得的增益最多为使用k条信息时可实现价值的2/(k-1)倍。最后，我们求解了一类信念阈值博弈：接收者在安全默认选项与多个风险行动之间进行选择，发送者从默认选项中获得零收益，从任何风险行动中获得相同的正收益，且仅当相应的后验概率超过阈值时才采取风险行动。我们刻画了最优粗糙信息结构，推导了关于先验和阈值的比较静态分析，并将分析扩展到风险行动具有异质性阈值和异质性发送者价值的情形。
10.1007/s00199-026-01734-z.title: Persuasion with Coarse Communication

10.1007/s00199-026-01735-y.abstract: We study the symmetric volunteer’s dilemma with binary actions and cost sharing, where the volunteering cost is split equally among volunteers. In the one-shot game, all pure-strategy Nash equilibria involve a single volunteer, while Pareto optimality allows any non-zero number. In the infinitely repeated game, all Pareto optima can be sustained in a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium based on a grim-trigger strategy: trivially under undiscounted payoffs, and provided the discount factor exceeds a threshold under discounted payoffs. This threshold is non-monotonic in the number of volunteers; it is zero with one volunteer, highest with two, and decreases with both more volunteers beyond two and more players. Thus, the scope for tacit cooperation is universal with one volunteer, minimal with two, then improving as more join in, all the way to universal again only in the limit with more and more players and volunteers. Considering efficiency, scope for cooperation and equity/focality as criteria, the grand coalition of volunteers emerges as the best cooperation scenario.
10.1007/s00199-026-01735-y.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有二元行动和成本分担的对称志愿者困境，其中志愿者成本由所有志愿者平均分担。在一次性博弈中，所有纯策略纳什均衡都只涉及一名志愿者，而帕累托最优则允许任意非零数量的志愿者。在无限重复博弈中，所有帕累托最优状态都可以通过基于冷酷触发策略的子博弈完美纳什均衡得以维持：在无折现收益下显然成立，而在有折现收益下，需满足折现因子超过某一阈值。该阈值随志愿者数量呈非单调变化：当只有一名志愿者时为零，两名志愿者时最高，随后随着志愿者数量超过两人以及玩家数量增加而下降。因此，隐性合作的范围在只有一名志愿者时具有普遍性，在两名志愿者时最小，随着更多人加入而改善，直到在玩家和志愿者数量趋于极限时再次达到普遍性。综合考虑效率、合作范围以及公平性/焦点性等标准，志愿者的大联盟成为最佳合作情景。
10.1007/s00199-026-01735-y.title: On the repeated volunteer’s dilemma with equal cost sharing
10.1007/s00199-026-01735-y.title_zh: 关于成本均摊下的重复志愿者困境

10.1007/s00199-026-01736-x.abstract: People often deviate from Bayesian updating by processing information in an optimistic manner. In such optimistic information processing, people tend to selectively incorporate information that is favorable to them. Furthermore, it is known that such selective belief updating imposes psychological costs on them. In this paper, we model optimistic belief updating with psychological costs and provide axiomatic foundations for it. Our model includes Bayesian updating as a special case while allowing for a unified axiomatization of various forms of optimistic information processing by modifying certain axioms.
10.1007/s00199-026-01736-x.abstract_zh: 人们往往通过乐观的方式处理信息，从而偏离贝叶斯更新。在这种乐观的信息处理过程中，人们倾向于有选择地吸收对自己有利的信息。此外，已知这种选择性信念更新会给他们带来心理成本。在本文中，我们构建了带有心理成本的乐观信念更新模型，并为其提供了公理化基础。我们的模型将贝叶斯更新作为特例包含在内，同时通过修改某些公理，实现了对各种乐观信息处理形式的统一公理化。
10.1007/s00199-026-01736-x.title: Costly Bayesian optimism
10.1007/s00199-026-01736-x.title_zh: 昂贵的贝叶斯乐观主义

10.1007/s00199-026-01737-w.abstract: The rational behavior of a coalition requires the informational precondition that its members take into account the behavior and beliefs of others. In noncooperative games, we define Bayesian coalitional rationality as a mode of collective behavior that no coalition of players wishes to change, in the sense that there is no coalition-wise common belief that mutual gains can be achieved through a tacit coalitional agreement. We establish a fundamental possibility result: the assumption of Bayesian coalitional rationality and common belief of Bayesian coalitional rationality is attainable in a finite model. Under a belief-richness condition, this assumption characterizes the solution concept of Bayesian coalitional rationalizability. Our approach also provides a novel notion of individual rationality in game situations where players may be uncertain about their own types and strategy choices.
10.1007/s00199-026-01737-w.abstract_zh: 联盟的理性行为要求一个信息前提，即其成员需考虑他人的行为与信念。在非合作博弈中，我们将贝叶斯联盟理性定义为一种集体行为模式，即任何玩家联盟都不希望改变现状，其含义在于不存在联盟层面的共同信念，认为通过默契的联盟协议可以实现相互增益。我们确立了一个基本可能性结果：贝叶斯联盟理性及对其的共同信念假设在有限模型中是可实现的。在信念丰富性条件下，这一假设刻画了贝叶斯联盟理性化的解概念。我们的方法还为玩家可能对自身类型和策略选择不确定的博弈情境提供了一种新颖的个体理性概念。
10.1007/s00199-026-01737-w.title: Bayesian Coalitional Rationality in Games: An Informational Foundation
10.1007/s00199-026-01737-w.title_zh: 博弈中的贝叶斯联盟理性：一个信息基础

10.1007/s00199-026-01738-9.abstract: Although this may seem a paradox, all exact science is dominated by the idea of approximation. Bertrand Russell.
10.1007/s00199-026-01738-9.abstract_zh: 尽管这看似矛盾，所有精确科学皆受近似思想所主导。——伯特兰·罗素
10.1007/s00199-026-01738-9.title: Compact spaces of continuous preferences

10.1007/s00199-026-01739-8.abstract: This paper proposes a non-cooperative game of network formation in which creating access to the network – for oneself and others – is a public good. Link formation therefore reflects a trade-off between the social value of links and their private cost. The paper characterizes the architecture of strict Nash networks. Strict Nash equilibria are either flat or hierarchical. Flat equilibria consist of a wheel (i.e., a directed cycle) that may or may not encompass all agents. Hierarchical equilibria are trees in which some agents act as intermediaries between otherwise disconnected groups. When the cost of link formation is sufficiently low, the exhaustive wheel is the unique equilibrium architecture and best-response dynamics converge to it with probability one. For intermediate costs, multiple equilibrium architectures coexist and can be Pareto-ranked: the exhaustive wheels dominate the non-exhaustive ones and the empty network, and trees dominate the empty network.
10.1007/s00199-026-01739-8.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种网络形成的非合作博弈模型，在该模型中，为自己及他人创建网络接入具有公共品属性。因此，链接形成反映了链接的社会价值与其私人成本之间的权衡。本文刻画了严格纳什网络的架构特征。严格纳什均衡要么是扁平结构，要么是层级结构。扁平均衡由轮状结构（即有向环）构成，该结构可能包含所有参与者，也可能不包含。层级均衡则呈现树状结构，其中部分参与者充当原本互不相连群体之间的中介。当链接形成成本足够低时，全覆盖轮状结构是唯一的均衡架构，且最优反应动态以概率1收敛于此结构。在中等成本条件下，多种均衡架构并存且可进行帕累托排序：全覆盖轮状结构优于非全覆盖轮状结构及空网络，而树状结构优于空网络。
10.1007/s00199-026-01739-8.title: Endogenous network formation with diffusion incentives
10.1007/s00199-026-01739-8.title_zh: 具有扩散激励的内生网络形成

10.1007/s00199-026-01740-1.abstract: We develop a two-country trade model with sequential production in which a technologically backward economy exports intermediates in exchange for final goods from a technologically advanced economy. The advanced country can raise welfare by imposing import tariffs on intermediates, whereas export tariffs on intermediates or import tariffs on final goods are ineffective for the backward economy. Instead, the backward economy resorts to a quantitative export constraint, diverting part of its labor force into a less efficient autarkic production process. We show that non-cooperative policy choices reduce trade and lower welfare in both countries, underscoring the need for a trade agreement. To sustain mutually beneficial liberalization after prior tariff reductions, however, an agreement may have to link tariff cuts to the removal of export constraints, particularly when lifting these constraints is costly for the backward economy.
10.1007/s00199-026-01740-1.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含序贯生产的两国贸易模型，其中技术落后的经济体出口中间品，以换取技术先进经济体的最终产品。先进国家可以通过对中间品征收进口关税来提高福利，而对落后经济体而言，对中间品征收出口关税或对最终产品征收进口关税则无效。相反，落后经济体转而采取数量性出口限制，将部分劳动力转移至效率较低的封闭式生产过程中。我们证明，非合作的政策选择会减少贸易并降低两国福利，凸显了贸易协定的必要性。然而，在先前关税削减之后，为维持互利的自由化，协定可能必须将关税削减与取消出口限制挂钩，尤其是在解除这些限制对落后经济体而言成本高昂的情况下。
10.1007/s00199-026-01740-1.title: Trade policy in a model of sequential production
10.1007/s00199-026-01740-1.title_zh: 序贯生产模型中的贸易政策

10.1007/s00199-026-01741-0.abstract: CvdN equilibrium extends ratio equilibrium to local public good economies. A key and unique feature of CvdN equilibrium is that jurisdictions are fully endogenized, where the equilibrating factor is agents’ agreement on public good levels and the sharing of public good production costs. We show equilibrium existence and sorting behavior for a large class of public good economies. We furthermore elucidate how key aspects of the economy influence the nature of CvdN equilibrium, including the role of consumption preferences, jurisdictional preferences, and properties of the public good production function. These factors make possible different equilibrium jurisdiction structures, including the grand coalition, only singletons, or intermediate-sized jurisdictions, as well as jurisdictions with homogeneous or heterogeneous membership. Usefully, because it fully endogenizes jurisdiction formation, CvdN equilibrium offers a unified approach to economies with local public goods and those with global public goods, and it facilitates investigation into the underlying factors of an economy that lead to public goods being provided locally or globally. Our model can provide microfoundations for multiple concepts from the literature, including homophily, segregation, sorting, and small-group effectiveness.
10.1007/s00199-026-01741-0.abstract_zh: CvdN均衡将比例均衡扩展至地方公共品经济。CvdN均衡的一个关键且独特之处在于，辖区完全内生化，其均衡因素在于代理人对公共品水平及公共品生产成本分摊的共识。我们证明了在广泛类别的公共品经济中均衡的存在性与分群行为。此外，我们阐明了经济的关键方面如何影响CvdN均衡的性质，包括消费偏好、辖区偏好以及公共品生产函数特性的作用。这些因素使得不同的均衡辖区结构成为可能，包括大联盟、仅单个成员、或中等规模辖区，以及同质或异质成员构成的辖区。有用的是，由于完全内生化辖区形成，CvdN均衡为地方公共品经济与全球公共品经济提供了统一的分析框架，并有助于探究导致公共品在地方或全球层面供给的经济深层因素。我们的模型可为文献中的多个概念提供微观基础，包括同质性偏好、隔离、分群及小群体有效性。
10.1007/s00199-026-01741-0.title: Existence and nature of CvdN equilibrium

10.1007/s00199-026-01742-z.title: Competing sellers in security-bid auctions under risk-averse bidders
10.1007/s00199-026-01742-z.title_zh: 风险厌恶投标人下证券竞价拍卖中的竞争性卖方

10.1007/s00199-026-01743-y.title: Multivariate majorization in mechanism design
10.1007/s00199-026-01743-y.title_zh: 机制设计中的多元优化

10.1007/s00355-026-01651-z.abstract: We introduce public-good auctions, a versatile framework addressing auction scenarios where players benefit not only from winning themselves but also when their competitors win. Distinct from private-good auctions, public-good auctions feature prizes as public goods enjoyed by all players and allow them to choose from multiple prizes. Demonstrating broad applicability, public-good auctions can be applied to various economic models, including auctions with externalities, and combinatorial auctions. The framework effectively explains unconventional situations marked by conflicting incentives between cooperation and competition and diverse behaviors, such as free-riding, cooperation, strategic voting, and multiple targeting, which are unobserved in traditional auction settings. Using a two-player model, we present four main results regarding the existence, characterization, and uniqueness of equilibrium payoffs.
10.1007/s00355-026-01651-z.abstract_zh: 我们引入公共品拍卖这一通用框架，用以处理拍卖场景中玩家不仅从自身获胜中获益，还从竞争对手获胜中获益的情形。与私人物品拍卖不同，公共品拍卖的特点在于奖品作为公共品为所有玩家所共享，且玩家可选择多个奖品。该框架展现出广泛的适用性，可应用于多种经济模型，包括具有外部性的拍卖和组合拍卖。此框架有效解释了传统拍卖环境中未观察到的、以合作与竞争之间激励冲突为标志的非常规情境及多样化行为，如搭便车、合作、策略性投票和多重目标设定。通过一个双玩家模型，我们提出了关于均衡收益的存在性、特征化及唯一性的四项主要结果。

10.1007/s00355-026-01652-y.abstract: We study a one-to-one matching market where the population is fixed. If some exogenous reason disrupts a worker-firm pair in a stable matching, can equilibrium in the market be restored? We present an algorithm that models this situation as a re-stabilization process involving a vacancy chain. Each step of the algorithm is a link of such a chain. We show that the length of this vacancy chain is intimately connected with the lattice structure of the set of stable matchings of the market. Namely, this length can be computed by considering the cardinalities of cycles in preferences derived from the initial and final stable matchings involved.
10.1007/s00355-026-01652-y.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个固定人口的一对一匹配市场。若某种外生原因破坏了稳定匹配中的一对工人-企业组合，市场均衡能否得以恢复？我们提出一种算法，将此情形建模为涉及空缺链的再稳定化过程。算法的每一步即为此链的一个环节。我们证明，该空缺链的长度与市场稳定匹配集合的格结构密切相关。具体而言，此长度可通过考虑由所涉及的初始和最终稳定匹配推导出的偏好中循环的基数来计算。

10.1007/s00355-026-01655-9.abstract: We provide the first asymptotic analysis of the Boston Mechanism under equilibrium play in random markets. We provide two results. First, while 63% of students receive their first preference under truthful reporting–outperforming any other known mechanism in the literature–this rate converges to zero in any Nash equilibrium of the corresponding preference revelation game as the market size grows. Second, we show there exists a Nash equilibrium where the average student receives a dramatically inferior assignment: in markets with 1,000 students, the average placement shifts from the 7th choice (under truthfulness) to the 145th choice, representing a change from logarithmic to nearly linear average rank.
10.1007/s00355-026-01655-9.abstract_zh: 我们首次对随机市场中均衡行为下的波士顿机制进行了渐近分析。我们提供了两项结果。第一，尽管在真实报告下，63%的学生能获得其首选偏好——这一比例超越了文献中任何其他已知机制——但在相应的偏好揭示博弈中，随着市场规模扩大，这一比例在任何纳什均衡下都趋近于零。第二，我们证明存在一个纳什均衡，其中平均学生获得的分配结果显著恶化：在拥有1000名学生的市场中，平均分配位置从第7选择（在真实报告下）移至第145选择，这标志着平均排名从对数级转变为近乎线性级。

10.1007/s00355-026-01663-9.abstract: We consider a team contest in which players make efforts to compete with other teams for a prize, and players of the winning team divide the prize according to a prize-sharing rule. Assuming that players differ in their abilities and their abilities are observable, we analyze which team structure realizes by allowing players to move across teams. A team structure is stable if there is no successful head-hunting opportunity. We show that if all teams employ the egalitarian sharing rule, then the complete sorting of players according to their abilities occurs, and inter-team inequality becomes the largest. In contrast, if all teams employ a substantially unequal sharing rule, there is a stable team structure with a small inter-team inequality and a large intra-team inequality. This result illustrates a trade-off between intra-team inequality and inter-team inequality in forming teams.
10.1007/s00355-026-01663-9.abstract_zh: 我们考察一种团队竞赛，其中队员为争夺奖品而与其他团队竞争，获胜团队的队员依据某种奖品分配规则分享奖品。假设队员能力各异且这些能力可被观察，我们分析允许队员跨团队流动时，何种团队结构得以实现。若不存在成功的挖角机会，则团队结构是稳定的。我们证明，若所有团队采用均等分配规则，则队员将按能力完全分层，团队间不平等达到最大。相反，若所有团队采用显著不均等的分配规则，则存在一种稳定的团队结构，其团队间不平等较小而团队内不平等较大。这一结果揭示了团队形成过程中团队内不平等与团队间不平等之间的权衡关系。
10.1007/s00355-026-01663-9.title: Formation of teams in contests: tradeoffs between inter- and intra-team inequalities
10.1007/s00355-026-01663-9.title_zh: 竞赛中团队的形成：团队间与团队内不平等之间的权衡

10.1007/s00355-026-01665-7.abstract: Whether in education, performance reviews, or elections, grades serve as tools for assessment, yet the universality of their meanings remains an open question. When voting under majority judgment, voters assign verbal grades such as “excellent, very good, good, fairly good, acceptable, insufficient, to reject” to each candidate. The meaning of these grades should be clear and consistent across all voters. Balinski and Laraki (2011) describe this as a “common language” and claim that the grade labels convey absolute meaning. This paper tests the assumption of absolute meaning by examining whether the meaning of a grade depends on the grading scale (i.e., framing effect) in a political context. We conducted an online experiment (N = 1955) in which participants voted for candidates to the French presidential elections under majority judgment with grading scales with different numbers of grades. Our findings indicate that the grade distributions obtained by candidates are significantly influenced by the grading scales available to voters. Our data therefore rejects the assertion that grades convey absolute meaning, showing instead that their interpretation depends on the number of grades available.
10.1007/s00355-026-01665-7.abstract_zh: 无论是在教育、绩效评估还是选举中，评分都作为评估工具，但其含义的普遍性仍是一个未解之谜。在多数判断投票制下，选民对每位候选人给予诸如“优秀、很好、好、较好、可接受、不足、拒绝”等口头评分。这些评分的含义应当对所有选民清晰且一致。巴林斯基和拉拉基（2011）将此描述为“共同语言”，并声称评分标签传达了绝对意义。本文通过考察在政治情境下，评分的含义是否依赖于评分量表（即框架效应），来检验绝对意义的假设。我们进行了一项在线实验（N=1955），参与者使用不同评分等级数量的评分量表，在多数判断规则下对法国总统选举候选人进行投票。研究结果显示，候选人获得的评分分布显著受到选民可用的评分量表影响。因此，我们的数据否定了评分传达绝对意义的论断，表明其解释依赖于可用评分的数量。
10.1007/s00355-026-01665-7.title: Do grades have absolute meaning? An experiment on majority judgment
10.1007/s00355-026-01665-7.title_zh: 成绩具有绝对意义吗？多数判断实验

10.1007/s00355-026-01666-6.abstract: We study the problem of aggregating individual preferences into a collective ranking without ties (a linear order) over a finite set of alternatives. We introduce a framework that constructs such rankings from supermajority rules, defined by a threshold parameter $$\alpha \in \left[ 1/2,1\right) $$ . For each $$\alpha $$ , we consider the binary relation of defeats from pairwise comparisons and apply two closure operations—the transitive closure and the Suzumura-consistent closure—to eliminate cycles. We then study the sets of linear orders that respect these relations; that is, linear orders that preserve all strict defeats while extending them to a complete ranking. To avoid the arbitrariness of fixing a single $$\alpha $$ , we take the intersection across all $$\alpha $$ . This yields two sets of linear orders: the T-order set (from the transitive closure) and the S-order set (from the Suzumura-consistent closure), both always nonempty, the former is a subset of the latter, and jointly capturing the full spectrum of supermajority rules. We show that this perspective unifies prominent methods: the Schulze method coincides with the T-order set, the Split Cycle method with the S-order set, and every outcome of the Ranked Pairs method lies within the S-order set. Moreover, every linear order in the S-order set satisfies the extended Condorcet criterion and the strong Pareto principle. Our results thus place these methods within a common supermajority-based framework and clarify their relationships.
10.1007/s00355-026-01666-6.abstract_zh: 本文研究如何将个体偏好聚合为有限备选方案集合上的无并列集体排序（线性序）。我们提出一个基于超多数规则构建此类排序的框架，该规则由阈值参数 $$\alpha \in \left[ 1/2,1\right) $$ 定义。对于每个 $$\alpha $$，我们考虑两两比较中产生的击败二元关系，并应用两种闭包运算——传递闭包和铃村一致闭包——以消除循环。随后，我们研究尊重这些关系的线性序集合；即，在保留所有严格击败关系的同时将其扩展为完整排序的线性序。为避免固定单一 $$\alpha $$ 的任意性，我们取所有 $$\alpha $$ 的交集。由此得到两组线性序：T-序集（来自传递闭包）和S-序集（来自铃村一致闭包），两者均非空，前者为后者的子集，且共同涵盖超多数规则的完整谱系。我们证明，这一视角统一了多种主流方法：Schulze方法等同于T-序集，Split Cycle方法等同于S-序集，而Ranked Pairs方法的每个结果均属于S-序集。此外，S-序集中的每个线性序均满足扩展的孔多塞准则与强帕累托原则。因此，我们的研究将这些方法置于统一的超多数规则框架下，并厘清了它们之间的关联。
10.1007/s00355-026-01666-6.title: Respecting linear orders for supermajority rules
10.1007/s00355-026-01666-6.title_zh: 尊重超多数规则下的线性顺序

10.1007/s00355-026-01667-5.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We use laboratory experiments to analyze decentralized decision-making in one-sided matching markets. We find that subjects tend to make decisions in line with most theoretical models, as their offering and accepting decisions are mainly guided by the objective of improving upon the status quo. In consequence, markets move towards satisfying blocking pairs making the number of remaining blocking pairs diminish and the aggregate payoffs increase over time. Overall, the theoretical solutions of absorbing sets and stable matchings to the roommate problem are supported by the experimental results. However, not all matchings in an absorbing set have the same power of attraction in the experimental laboratory. The theoretical property of P-stability refines absorbing sets as predictors of final outcomes.</jats:p>
10.1007/s00355-026-01667-5.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>我们通过实验室实验分析单边匹配市场中的分散决策。研究发现，受试者的决策行为与多数理论模型一致，其出价与接受决策主要受改善现状目标的引导。因此，市场会朝着满足阻塞对的方向演进，使得剩余阻塞对数量随时间递减，总收益逐步提升。总体而言，室友问题中吸收集与稳定匹配的理论解得到了实验结果的支撑。然而，在实验室环境中，吸收集内的不同匹配并不具有同等的吸引力。理论上的P稳定性性质能够进一步精炼吸收集作为最终结果的预测指标。</jats:p>
10.1007/s00355-026-01667-5.title: Experimental results on the roommate problem

10.1007/s00355-026-01668-4.abstract: We study the structure of random ordinal Bayesian incentive compatible (OBIC) rules. We restrict attention to some special class of priors that we call “uniform-like” priors. We consider a class of priors, called top uniform priors: for any two alternatives a and b, a prior is top uniform if the aggregate probability (under the prior distribution) of preferences with respectively a and b at the top are the same. Over the unrestricted domain the uniform prior is a member of this class. We consider a class of random voting rules—random vote share rules, a generalization of plurality rule. For top uniform priors and arbitrary domains, Theorem 4.1 shows that every top monotonic and symmetric random vote share rule is OBIC. Over a domain satisfying some natural “richness” condition, we demonstrate that if a symmetric and strongly top responsive random vote share rule is OBIC with respect to some prior, then that prior must necessarily be a top uniform prior. We also provide some analogous results for veto share rules that are probabilistic generalizations of anti-plurality rule.
10.1007/s00355-026-01668-4.abstract_zh: 我们研究了随机序数贝叶斯激励相容（OBIC）规则的结构。我们关注一类特殊的先验分布，称之为“类均匀”先验。我们考虑一类称为顶部均匀先验的先验：对于任意两个备选方案a和b，若在先验分布下，分别以a和b为顶部的偏好总概率相同，则该先验为顶部均匀先验。在无限制域上，均匀先验属于此类。我们考虑一类随机投票规则——随机投票份额规则，这是多数规则的推广。对于顶部均匀先验和任意域，定理4.1表明，每个顶部单调且对称的随机投票份额规则都是OBIC的。在满足某些自然“丰富性”条件的域上，我们证明，若一个对称且强顶部响应的随机投票份额规则相对于某个先验是OBIC的，则该先验必然为顶部均匀先验。我们还为否决份额规则提供了类似的结果，这些规则是反多数规则的概率推广。
10.1007/s00355-026-01668-4.title: On the ordinal Bayesian incentive compatibility of vote share and veto share rules
10.1007/s00355-026-01668-4.title_zh: 关于投票份额与否决份额规则的序数贝叶斯激励相容性

10.1007/s00355-026-01670-w.abstract: In the spatial model of voting, the yolk and LP (linear programming) yolk are important solution concepts for predicting outcomes for a committee of voters. McKelvey and Tovey showed that the LP yolk provides a lower bound approximation for the size of the yolk and there has been considerable debate on whether the LP yolk is a good approximation of the yolk. The problem was partially resolved for arbitrarily large committees (as the number of voters goes to infinity) but remains open when there are few voters, which is standard for most committees. In this paper, we show that for an odd number of voters in a two-dimensional space, the yolk radius is at most twice the size of the LP yolk radius and we show that this bound is tight—there exists a family of instances where the LP yolk radius will differ from the yolk radius by a factor arbitrarily close to 2. We also show that (1) even in this setting, the LP yolk center can be arbitrarily far away from the yolk center (relative to the radius of the yolk) and (2) for all other settings (an even number of voters or in dimension k \ge 3), the LP yolk can be arbitrarily small relative to the yolk. Thus, in general, the LP yolk can be an arbitrarily poor approximation of the yolk.
10.1007/s00355-026-01670-w.abstract_zh: 在空间投票模型中，蛋黄（yolk）与线性规划蛋黄（LP yolk）是预测委员会投票结果的重要解概念。McKelvey与Tovey证明线性规划蛋黄为蛋黄规模提供了下界近似，但关于线性规划蛋黄能否有效近似蛋黄的问题一直存在激烈争论。该问题在委员会规模趋于无穷大时已得到部分解决，但在标准委员会常见的少量投票者情形下仍悬而未决。本文证明：在二维空间中奇数投票者情形下，蛋黄半径至多为线性规划蛋黄半径的两倍，且该上界是紧的——存在实例族使得线性规划蛋黄半径与蛋黄半径的比值可任意趋近于2。我们同时证明：（1）即便在此设定下，线性规划蛋黄中心与蛋黄中心的距离（相对于蛋黄半径）可任意大；（2）在其他所有设定中（偶数投票者或维度k≥3），线性规划蛋黄相对于蛋黄可任意小。因此，一般而言，线性规划蛋黄对蛋黄的近似效果可能极差。
10.1007/s00355-026-01670-w.title: On the approximability of the yolk by the LP yolk in the spatial model of voting
10.1007/s00355-026-01670-w.title_zh: 空间投票模型中蛋黄由线性规划蛋黄逼近的可近似性

10.1007/s00355-026-01671-9.abstract: Tournaments are well studied objects in economic theory. Copeland (1951 A reasonable social welfare function. Tech. rep., Mimeo, University of Michigan USA")) provides an intuitive way to select alternatives from a tournament, the Copeland set . As a tournament solution, the Copeland set possesses many desirable properties and has been widely studied. Rubinstein (1980 Ranking the participants in a tournament. SIAM J Appl Math 38:108–111")) axiomatizes a method to rank alternatives from a tournament which is based on their Copeland scores . This paper analyzes the Copeland set from a revealed preference perspective. A choice procedure where a decision maker has a fixed underlying tournament and selects the Copeland set from every menu is behaviorally characterized.
10.1007/s00355-026-01671-9.abstract_zh: 锦标赛是经济理论中研究较为深入的对象。Copeland（1951，《一种合理的社会福利函数》，技术报告，密歇根大学，美国）提出了一种从锦标赛中筛选备选方案的直观方法，即Copeland集。作为一种锦标赛解概念，Copeland集具备诸多理想性质，并得到了广泛研究。Rubinstein（1980，《锦标赛参与者排序方法》，《SIAM应用数学杂志》第38卷，第108–111页）基于Copeland得分公理化了锦标赛备选方案的排序方法。本文从显示偏好视角分析Copeland集。研究对一种选择程序进行了行为特征刻画：在该程序中，决策者拥有固定的潜在锦标赛结构，并从每个备选菜单中选取Copeland集。
10.1007/s00355-026-01671-9.title: Copeland choice rules

10.1007/s00355-026-01672-8.abstract: We consider a standard model of cheap talk when the receiver has the option to verify the sender’s message at some cost. Verification entails a trade-off for the receiver: learning the state perfectly versus not paying the cost of verifying. An equilibrium partition consists of a mix of verified and unverified intervals, similar in structure to Bijkerk et al. (2018). We analyze a subset of equilibria with exactly one unverified interval. Fixing the informativeness of the equilibrium and the bias between sender and receiver, we show that, for a small bias, joint welfare is non-monotonic in the cost of verification, and for larger biases, it is always increasing in the cost of verification. Further, when costs decrease to the point where informativeness increases, welfare increases discontinuously. Finally, joint welfare is also non-monotonic in the bias between the sender and receiver. Our results suggest that the introduction of a verification technology may have both non-monotonic and discontinuous effects on societal welfare, depending on its cost and the conflict of interest between the agents.
10.1007/s00355-026-01672-8.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个标准的廉价交谈模型，其中接收者可以选择支付一定成本来验证发送者的信息。验证对接收者而言涉及一种权衡：完美了解状态与不支付验证成本之间的选择。均衡分割由已验证和未验证区间的混合构成，其结构与Bijkerk等人（2018）类似。我们分析了一类恰好包含一个未验证区间的均衡子集。在固定均衡的信息量和发送者与接收者之间的偏差时，我们证明，对于较小的偏差，联合福利在验证成本上是非单调的；而对于较大的偏差，联合福利总是随验证成本增加而增加。此外，当成本降低到信息量增加的程度时，福利会不连续地上升。最后，联合福利在发送者与接收者之间的偏差上也是非单调的。我们的结果表明，验证技术的引入可能对社会福利产生非单调且不连续的影响，这取决于其成本以及双方之间的利益冲突。
10.1007/s00355-026-01672-8.title: On verifiable cheap talk and social welfare
10.1007/s00355-026-01672-8.title_zh: 关于可验证廉价谈话与社会福利

10.1007/s00355-026-01673-7.title: The subtlety of optimal paternalism in a population with bounded rationality
10.1007/s00355-026-01673-7.title_zh: 有限理性群体中最优家长式干预的微妙性

10.1007/s10058-025-00383-3.abstract: We study matching markets in which each man has a common value for all women and a private value specific to each woman. We introduce a new class of procedures, which is a novel way of studying the deferred acceptance mechanism. These procedures can be replicated by another procedure, in which a woman proposes to a random man in each step. Envy in a matching market is bounded by envy in this class of procedures, in which there is just one woman and two types of men. In large markets, envy goes to zero; moreover, the deferred acceptance mechanism is approximately strategy-proof.
10.1007/s10058-025-00383-3.abstract_zh: 我们研究匹配市场，其中每位男性对所有女性有一个共同价值，并对每位女性有一个特定私人价值。我们引入了一类新的程序，这是研究延迟接受机制的一种新颖方式。这些程序可以通过另一种程序复制，在该程序中，女性在每一步向随机男性提出建议。匹配市场中的嫉妒程度受限于这类程序中仅有一位女性和两类男性的嫉妒程度。在大市场中，嫉妒趋于零；此外，延迟接受机制近似于策略证明性。

10.1007/s10058-025-00385-1.abstract: We investigate how robust approval-based multiwinner voting rules are to small perturbations in the votes. In particular, we consider the extent to which a committee can change after we add/remove/swap one approval, and we consider the computational complexity of deciding how many such operations are necessary to change the set of winning committees. We also consider the counting variants of our problems, which can be interpreted as computing the probability that the result of an election changes after a given number of random perturbations of the given election.
10.1007/s10058-025-00385-1.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了基于批准的多人胜选投票规则对选票微小扰动的稳健性。具体而言，我们考虑在添加、移除或交换一个批准后，委员会可能变化的程度，并研究决定需要多少次此类操作才能改变获胜委员会集合的计算复杂性。我们还考虑了问题的计数变体，这可以解释为计算在给定选举经过一定数量的随机扰动后，选举结果发生变化的概率。

10.1007/s10058-025-00386-0.abstract: How can we assess the diversity of a group of decision makers? Identifying decision makers with their preferences, we address this question by applying the multi-attribute approach developed by Nehring and Puppe (2002) to sets of preferences. Specifically, we provide a repertoire of alternative models to measure the diversity of sets of preferences. The proposed models are purely ordinal and are characterized in terms of the different properties that a preference order need to satisfy in order to contribute to the diversity of a given set of preference orderings.
10.1007/s10058-025-00386-0.abstract_zh: 如何评估一组决策者的多样性？通过将决策者与其偏好相对应，我们运用Nehring和Puppe（2002）发展的多属性方法来解决这一问题，并将其应用于偏好集合。具体而言，我们提供了一系列替代模型来衡量偏好集合的多样性。所提出的模型纯属序数性质，并通过偏好序需满足的不同属性来刻画，这些属性决定了偏好序对给定偏好序集合多样性的贡献。

10.1007/s10058-025-00388-y.abstract: We analyze optimal budget institutions for local governments in a scenario where local public goods generate positive interregional externalities, such as environmental protection. There is a central government (referred to as the center) and two regions. Each region possesses private information regarding the extent of beneficial spillovers it experiences from the public goods provided by the other region. To achieve constrained efficiency, it is necessary to address these externalities while also tackling the center’s self-selection issue in the presence of asymmetric information. One way to implement the optimal solution under asymmetric information is through a simultaneous-move equilibrium. The center can set a minimum debt level for the region that generates higher spillovers and impose a Pigouvian tax on the region benefiting more from spillovers, subsequently transferring the revenue as a subsidy to the other region. Alternatively, a sequential-move equilibrium can implement the asymmetric information optimum with the additional condition that the follower region’s optimal debt choice is concave in the leader region’s debt choice.
10.1007/s10058-025-00388-y.abstract_zh: 我们分析地方政府在地方公共品产生正向跨区域外部性（如环境保护）情境下的最优预算制度。存在一个中央政府（简称中心）和两个地区。每个地区对于从另一地区提供的公共品中获得的有利溢出程度拥有私人信息。为实现受限效率，必须解决这些外部性，同时应对信息不对称条件下中心的自选择问题。在信息不对称下实施最优解的一种方式是通过同时行动均衡。中心可以为产生较高溢出效应的地区设定最低债务水平，并对从溢出中受益更多的地区征收庇古税，随后将税收收入作为补贴转移给另一地区。或者，顺序行动均衡可以在附加条件下实施信息不对称最优解，即跟随地区的最优债务选择是领导地区债务选择的凹函数。

10.1007/s10058-025-00390-4.abstract: Preference reversal (PR) occurs when individuals reverse their preferences between safe and risky bets depending on the elicitation method (e.g., direct choice vs. certainty equivalence). Although prior research has rarely examined the influence of relative payoff ratios between bets on choice preferences and PR, this meta-analysis synthesizes data from 22 experiments or treatments across 13 studies, comprising 326 unique scenarios (N = 1,947). The mean effect sizes were close to zero, but substantial heterogeneity emerged across studies. Several idiosyncratic moderators—including probability and payoff structures and design features—appear to shape when choice preferences and PR are more likely to occur.
10.1007/s10058-025-00390-4.abstract_zh: 偏好反转（PR）现象指的是个体在安全赌注与风险赌注之间，依据不同的诱导方法（如直接选择与确定性等价）而逆转其偏好。尽管以往研究鲜少探讨赌注间相对支付比率对选择偏好及PR的影响，本元分析综合了13项研究中22个实验或处理组的数据，涵盖326个独特情境（N = 1,947）。平均效应量接近零，但研究间存在显著异质性。若干特定调节变量——包括概率与支付结构及设计特征——似乎决定了选择偏好与PR更可能发生的条件。

10.1007/s10058-025-00391-3.abstract: In 2021 we issued a call for papers for a special issue on “Contests: Theory, Evidence and Applications.” We received an enthusiastic response from scholars across a range of fields. The ten articles selected for this volume survived a rigorous peer review process and span a wide range of topics in the growing literature on contests.
10.1007/s10058-025-00391-3.abstract_zh: 2021年，我们为“竞赛：理论、证据与应用”特刊发出了论文征稿通知。来自多个领域的学者反响热烈。本卷精选的十篇文章经过严格的同行评审流程，涵盖了竞赛这一日益发展的文献中广泛的主题。

10.1007/s10058-025-00392-2.abstract: We analyze the re-placement mechanism implemented in Türkiye for reassigning doctors to residency programs after scoring errors were realized. By law, initial placements based on faulty scores are acquired rights, prohibiting re-placement to less favorable programs. This setup requires balancing fairness for doctors with improved rankings, preserving acquired rights, and adhering to program capacities. Our analysis focuses on the two-step serial dictatorship mechanism implemented by the Center for Assessment, Selection, and Placement (CASP) to address this problem. We show that the CASP mechanism violates fairness, such that higher-scoring doctors may justifiably envy the assignments of lower-scoring peers. Yet, when doctors adopt a weakly dominant strategy and truncate preferences below their initial placements, a more lenient notion of q-fairness is satisfied. Additionally, we show how manipulation incentives under the CASP mechanism lead to excessive deviations from target capacities. We propose the Acquired Rights Adjusted Serial Dictatorship (AR-SD) mechanism to prevent strategic manipulation and minimize deviations. Furthermore, we describe simple modifications to the CASP mechanism that render it equivalent to AR-SD. Finally, simulations using total deviations as a metric show that AR-SD consistently achieves fewer deviations than the CASP mechanism.
10.1007/s10058-025-00392-2.abstract_zh: 我们分析了土耳其在发现评分错误后，为重新分配医生至住院医师项目而实施的重新安置机制。根据法律，基于错误评分的初次安置被视为既得权利，禁止将医生重新安置至较不理想的方案。这一设定要求在改善排名的医生公平性、维护既得权利以及遵守项目容量之间寻求平衡。我们的分析聚焦于评估、选拔与安置中心（CASP）为解决此问题而实施的两步序列独裁机制。我们证明，CASP机制违反了公平性，使得得分较高的医生可能合理地对得分较低同行的分配产生嫉妒。然而，当医生采取弱主导策略并将其偏好截断至初次安置之下时，一种更为宽松的q-公平性概念得以满足。此外，我们展示了CASP机制下的操纵激励如何导致对目标容量的过度偏离。我们提出了既得权利调整序列独裁（AR-SD）机制，以防止策略性操纵并最小化偏离。进一步，我们描述了将CASP机制简单修改后使其等同于AR-SD的方法。最后，使用总偏离度作为指标的模拟显示，AR-SD始终比CASP机制实现更少的偏离。

10.1007/s10058-026-00398-4.abstract: A variation of a cheap talk game is considered in which the preferences of a special interest group conflict with those of a policymaker if she is benevolent; however, she may be corrupt. The interest group, which knows the state of the world, sends a message to the policymaker and may also exert costly lobbying effort for its preferred policy to be adopted. We show that expected welfare, which is the same in all PBE, is decreasing in the probability that the policymaker is corrupt. Surprisingly, it decreases faster when this probability is above one-half, suggesting that corrupt behavior will be tolerated only up to a certain level.
10.1007/s10058-026-00398-4.abstract_zh: 本文考虑了一种廉价交谈博弈的变体，其中特殊利益集团的偏好与政策制定者（若其廉洁）的偏好相冲突；然而，该政策制定者可能腐败。利益集团知晓世界状态，向政策制定者发送信息，并可能为其偏好的政策被采纳而付出代价高昂的游说努力。我们表明，在所有完美贝叶斯均衡（PBE）中相同的预期福利，随政策制定者腐败概率的增加而递减。令人惊讶的是，当这一概率超过二分之一时，福利下降得更快，这表明腐败行为仅在达到一定水平之前才会被容忍。

10.1007/s10058-026-00399-3.abstract: Cooperative game theory has proposed different notions of powerful players. For example, big-boss games (Muto et al. 1988) and clan games (Potters et al. 1989) are particular cases of veto games (Bahel 2016). The present paper extends these veto games by assuming that there is a given subset of powerful (or essential) players, but only a few (as opposed to all) essential players are required for a coalition to have a positive group value. The resulting games, which are called r -essential games, encompass convex games (Shapley 1971) and veto games. We show that r -essential games have a nonempty core. We give a recursive description of the core. Moreover, it is shown that the core and the bargaining set are equivalent for r -essential games. An application to networks is provided.
10.1007/s10058-026-00399-3.abstract_zh: 合作博弈理论提出了不同形式的强参与者概念。例如，大老板博弈（Muto等，1988）和宗族博弈（Potters等，1989）是否决博弈（Bahel，2016）的特例。本文通过假设存在一个给定的强（或关键）参与者子集，但联盟只需少数（而非全部）关键参与者即可产生正群体价值，从而扩展了这些否决博弈。由此产生的博弈被称为r-关键博弈，它涵盖了凸博弈（Shapley，1971）和否决博弈。我们证明r-关键博弈具有非空核，并给出了核的递归描述。此外，研究表明对于r-关键博弈，核与议价集是等价的。本文还提供了在网络中的应用。
10.1007/s10058-026-00399-3.title: Essentiality of degree r in cooperative games with transferable utility
10.1007/s10058-026-00399-3.title_zh: 可转移效用合作博弈中程度r的必要性

10.1007/s10058-026-00400-z.abstract: We consider auctions with N “weak-valued” bidders and an 𝑁 + 1 -th bidder who is “strong.” The auction is a “tournament” in which the weaker players bid to win the right to compete with the strong bidder. The sealed bids of all players are binding and the winning bid of the weaker players is entered in a second-price contest with the bid of the strong player. As we already noted in Anderlini and Kim (2024a), the tournament design of the auction generates “overbidding” by the weaker bidders. This is due to the fact that the only way for a weak bidder to win the auction is to win among the weak bidders. We let the values of the strong bidder converge in distribution to an atom above the upper end of the distribution of the weak bidders. If the rest of the distribution is drained away from low values sufficiently slowly, the auction’s expected revenue is arbitrarily close to the one obtained in a Myerson (1981) optimal auction. The auction design is “detail free” — no specific knowledge of the distributions is needed in addition to the identity of the stronger bidder. No information about the actual value of the limit large atom is required. This is important since mis-calibrating by a small amount an attempt to implement the optimal auction can lead to large losses in revenue.
10.1007/s10058-026-00400-z.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个包含N个“弱价值”竞标者以及一个第N+1位“强”竞标者的拍卖场景。此拍卖采用“锦标赛”形式，其中较弱的参与者竞标以争取与强竞标者竞争的权利。所有参与者的密封投标均具有约束力，而较弱参与者的获胜出价将与强竞标者的出价一同进入第二价格竞赛。正如我们在Anderlini和Kim（2024a）中已指出的，这种锦标赛式拍卖设计会导致较弱竞标者出现“过度出价”现象。这源于弱竞标者赢得拍卖的唯一途径是在弱竞标者群体中胜出。我们让强竞标者的价值在分布上收敛于一个原子，该原子位于弱竞标者价值分布的上端之上。如果分布其余部分从低价值端以足够缓慢的速度被抽离，拍卖的预期收益将任意接近Myerson（1981）最优拍卖所获得的收益。该拍卖设计是“无需细节”的——除了强竞标者的身份外，无需对分布有具体了解，也无需知晓极限大原子的实际价值。这一点至关重要，因为试图实施最优拍卖时，即使校准偏差微小，也可能导致收益大幅损失。
10.1007/s10058-026-00400-z.title: Tournament auctions with a strong limit bidder
10.1007/s10058-026-00400-z.title_zh: 强限制竞标者参与的锦标赛拍卖

10.1007/s10058-026-00401-y.abstract: In multi-winner elections, the goal is to select a pre-given size committee of members from a given set of candidates. We define the concept of T-power of a majority-group of voters (Total majority-power or Total tyranny-power) as the ability of the group to guarantee, under a given voting rule, that all the committee members belong to its favorite candidates, regardless of the preferences of the other voters. In this case, we say also that such a voting rule is exposed to T-power. This situation can be considered extreme and worrying in democracy. In this paper, we examine the T-power under classes of multi-winner scoring rules. We focus on some common rules, and it turns out that BLOC rule ( k - k -Approval) is totally exposed to T-power, that is, any majority-group of any size has T-power under this rule. On the other hand, CCR, k -Plurality and k -Inverse-Plurality rules are almost notexposed to it, that is, no majority of any size has T-power. These last rules may provide some protection for minority groups in the sense of preventing T-power.
10.1007/s10058-026-00401-y.abstract_zh: 在多赢家选举中，目标是从给定候选人集合中选出预先设定规模的委员会成员。我们定义多数选民群体的T-权力（总多数权力或总暴政权力）为：在给定投票规则下，该群体能够确保所有委员会成员均来自其偏好的候选人，而无论其他选民的偏好如何。在此情况下，我们也称该投票规则暴露于T-权力之下。这种情形在民主制度中可被视为极端且令人担忧。本文研究了多赢家计分规则类别下的T-权力。我们聚焦于若干常见规则，发现BLOC规则（k-k-批准制）完全暴露于T-权力，即任何规模的多数群体在此规则下均拥有T-权力。另一方面，CCR、k-复数制与k-逆复数制规则几乎不暴露于T-权力，即任何规模的多数群体均不拥有T-权力。这些规则在防止T-权力意义上可能为少数群体提供一定保护。
10.1007/s10058-026-00401-y.title: The T-power of a majority under multi-winner scoring rules
10.1007/s10058-026-00401-y.title_zh: 多数在多胜者计分规则下的T权力
