10.1007/s10058-026-00402-x.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在选民偏好满足直线单交叉性，或更一般地，满足中位数图（这类图包括树和网格等）上的单交叉性时，在Chamberlin–Courant投票规则下确定获胜委员会的复杂性。对于直线情形，Skowron等人（2015）描述了一个O(n²mk)算法（其中n、m、k分别表示选民数、候选人数和委员会规模）；我们证明一个简单的改进可将时间复杂度提升至O(nmk)。随后，我们通过将问题归约为具有Monge-凹权重的完全有向无环图的k-链路路径问题，进一步改进了这一界，从而对任意失真函数获得了O(n^{1+o(1)}m)算法，并对Borda失真函数获得了近乎线性的算法。对于树形结构，我们指出了Clearwater等人（2015）提出的算法中存在的问题，并针对该情形同样开发了一个O(nmk)算法。对于网格结构，我们提出了一个关于最优解结构的猜想，并描述了一个在该猜想成立时能找出获胜委员会的多项式时间算法；同时，我们解释了如何将该算法转化为一个正确性不依赖于该猜想的双准则近似算法。
10.1007/s10058-026-00402-x.title: Proportional representation under single-crossing preferences revisited
10.1007/s10058-026-00402-x.title_zh: 单交叉偏好下的比例代表制再探讨

10.1007/s10058-026-00403-w.abstract: This paper investigates the conditions under which mergers between corporate social responsibility (CSR) firms are both privately profitable and socially desirable. We develop a Cournot model of quantity competition with product differentiation, featuring both CSR and non-CSR firms. CSR firms engage in observable CSR investment, which affects consumer willingness to pay depending on the level of CSR cognition in the market. We analyse a two-stage game in which CSR firms decide whether to propose a merger and a (myopic) Antitrust Authority (AA) determines whether to authorise it. Our results show that the profitability and approval of such mergers crucially depend on the degree of product differentiation and consumer sensitivity to CSR. When products are sufficiently complementary (or weakly substitutable) and CSR awareness is high, the merger increases both firm profits and consumer surplus, leading to regulatory approval. However, when the merger induces the exit of non-CSR competitors and products are homogeneous, a divergence emerges between private and social incentives, with the AA often blocking otherwise profitable mergers. These findings provide novel insights into merger policy design in settings where ethical competition and market power coexist.
10.1007/s10058-026-00403-w.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了企业社会责任（CSR）企业之间的合并既具有私人盈利性又具有社会合意性的条件。我们构建了一个包含产品差异化的数量竞争古诺模型，其中同时包含CSR企业与非CSR企业。CSR企业进行可观察的CSR投资，该投资根据市场中CSR认知水平影响消费者的支付意愿。我们分析了一个两阶段博弈，其中CSR企业决定是否提议合并，而（短视的）反垄断机构（AA）决定是否批准该合并。我们的结果表明，此类合并的盈利性与批准与否关键取决于产品差异化程度和消费者对CSR的敏感度。当产品充分互补（或弱替代）且CSR意识较高时，合并既增加企业利润又提升消费者剩余，从而获得监管批准。然而，当合并导致非CSR竞争对手退出且产品同质时，私人激励与社会激励之间出现分歧，反垄断机构往往阻止原本有利可图的合并。这些发现为在伦理竞争与市场力量并存的背景下设计合并政策提供了新颖见解。
10.1007/s10058-026-00403-w.title: Strategic corporate social responsibility and merger decisions
10.1007/s10058-026-00403-w.title_zh: 战略性企业社会责任与并购决策

10.1007/s10640-026-01080-7.abstract: We study the impact of a policy mix, consisting of an emissions tax and an R&D subsidy on both abatement technology improvement (R&D) and technology adoption. In an upstream industry with market power (monopoly or duopoly) an improved abatement technology is developed for polluting downstream firms that are subject to the aforementioned policy mix. These firms can adopt the new technology, which has different value for each firm, leading to product differentiation. First, we study the optimal policy, which includes output subsidies. Next, we examine second-best policy mixes, such as emission taxes and R&D expenditure subsidies, for different market forms. We identify novel aspects of these policy mixes. For instance, in a monopoly, the optimal second-best policy must account for the intra-marginal benefits of adopting firms. In a duopoly, the policy mix must also address strategic under- or overinvestment by upstream technology developers.
10.1007/s10640-026-01080-7.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种政策组合的影响，该组合包括排放税和研发补贴，旨在促进减排技术的改进（研发）及其采纳。在一个具有市场力量（垄断或双头垄断）的上游行业中，为受上述政策组合约束的污染型下游企业开发了改进的减排技术。这些企业可以采纳新技术，而该技术对每家企业具有不同的价值，从而导致产品差异化。首先，我们研究了包含产出补贴的最优政策。接着，我们考察了不同市场形态下的次优政策组合，如排放税和研发支出补贴。我们识别出这些政策组合的新颖方面。例如，在垄断情况下，最优次优政策必须考虑采纳企业的边际内收益。在双头垄断情况下，政策组合还必须应对上游技术开发者的策略性投资不足或过度投资问题。

10.1007/s10640-026-01085-2.abstract: We examine the timing of timber harvesting, when neighboring forest stands interact through windthrow risk. Positive adjacency externality stems from the sheltering effect of tall trees whereas negative externality stems from a windthrow-prone border created by clear felling or wind damage. We model wind damages as catastrophic, which call for immediate salvage harvest and regeneration. We augment previous optimal rotation results by extending the analysis to a dynamic harvest policy, where harvest age depends on the age of the neighboring stand. We examine both an efficient equilibrium and an inefficient noncooperative Markov perfect equilibrium. In the efficient equilibrium, where the externality is internalized, harvest is delayed when the neighboring stand is mature. This delay provides shelter by postponing harvest-created border risks. In the noncooperative equilibrium, the shelter is not provided, yet the harvest age adapts to increased risk-levels due to the border effect. We numerically test the magnitude of the border effect under various model assumptions and find that pricing the carbon externality makes the harvest policy more responsive to the adjacency externality.
10.1007/s10640-026-01085-2.abstract_zh: 本文研究了相邻林分因风倒风险相互作用时，木材采伐时机的选择问题。正向邻接外部性源于高大树木的庇护效应，而负向外部性则源于皆伐或风灾造成的易风倒边界。我们将风灾建模为灾难性事件，要求立即进行救伐和更新。通过将分析扩展至动态采伐政策（其中采伐林龄取决于相邻林分的林龄），我们完善了以往的最优轮伐期研究。我们同时考察了有效均衡和低效的非合作马尔可夫完美均衡。在外部性内部化的有效均衡中，当相邻林分成熟时，采伐会被推迟。这种延迟通过推迟采伐造成的边界风险来提供庇护。在非合作均衡中，庇护效应缺失，但采伐林龄会因边界效应导致的风险水平上升而调整。我们通过数值模拟检验了不同模型假设下边界效应的规模，发现对碳外部性定价会使采伐政策对邻接外部性更加敏感。
10.1007/s10640-026-01085-2.title: Adjacency Externality and the Timing of Timber Harvesting – The Case of Windthrow Risk
10.1007/s10640-026-01085-2.title_zh: 邻接外部性与木材采伐时机——以风倒风险为例

10.1007/s10640-026-01086-1.abstract: Pigouvian taxes are often unpopular among the general public. We test the effectiveness of pro-tax social information in increasing support for such taxes. In a lab experiment that involves a market game with externalities, we provide subjects with information about other participants’ views about the “right thing to do” (voting, or not, for the tax policy). We also elicit personal, normative, and positive beliefs. Our findings demonstrate a causal effect of social information provision on subjects’ support for the tax, and that subjects’ changes in beliefs is a causal mechanism through which this increased support for the tax is made possible. We therefore highlight the important role of beliefs in voting behaviors and the acceptability of Pigouvian taxes.
10.1007/s10640-026-01086-1.abstract_zh: 庇古税在公众中往往不受欢迎。我们通过实验检验了支持税收的社会信息在提升此类税收支持度方面的有效性。在一个涉及外部性的市场博弈实验室实验中，我们向受试者提供了关于其他参与者对“正确做法”（即是否投票支持税收政策）看法的信息。同时，我们也收集了个人信念、规范性信念和实证性信念。研究结果显示，社会信息的提供对受试者支持税收产生了因果效应，并且受试者信念的变化是实现这一税收支持度提升的因果机制。因此，我们强调了信念在投票行为及庇古税可接受性中的重要作用。
10.1007/s10640-026-01086-1.title: Harnessing Social Information to Improve Public Support for Pigouvian Taxes
10.1007/s10640-026-01086-1.title_zh: 利用社会信息提升公众对庇古税的支持

10.1007/s10640-026-01088-z.abstract: Residential energy use is a major contributor to total energy consumption and CO 2 emissions, and energy costs can take up high shares of household spending. In this context, we make three contributions to the literature. First, using a discrete choice experiment with 1,389 prospective homebuyers in Sweden, we investigate how homebuyers account for energy efficiency of buildings compared to other attributes when looking for a new home. Second, we elicit forecasts from a sample of 252 realtors whom we ask to predict homebuyers’ preferences, allowing us to shed light on the role these important mediators play regarding energy efficiency in the housing market. Third, we estimate how providing prior information on homebuyers’ choices affects realtors’ forecasting accuracy. For homebuyers, we find that energy efficiency ranks low overall. Realtors’ forecasting accuracy is lower for the energy efficiency attribute. Providing realtors with more prior information has sizeable positive effects on forecasting accuracy, and information also affects self-reported difficulty of and confidence in the forecasts.
10.1007/s10640-026-01088-z.abstract_zh: 住宅能源使用是总能源消耗和二氧化碳排放的主要来源，能源成本在家庭支出中占据较高比例。在此背景下，我们为相关文献做出三项贡献。首先，通过对瑞典1389名潜在购房者进行离散选择实验，我们研究了购房者在寻找新住房时如何权衡建筑能效与其他属性。其次，我们收集了252名房地产经纪人的预测样本，要求他们预测购房者的偏好，从而揭示这些重要中介在住房市场能效方面所扮演的角色。第三，我们评估了向房地产经纪人提供购房者选择的先验信息对其预测准确性的影响。研究发现，购房者对能效属性的整体重视程度较低。房地产经纪人对能效属性的预测准确性也较低。向房地产经纪人提供更多先验信息能显著提升预测准确性，同时信息还会影响其自我报告的预测难度和信心水平。
10.1007/s10640-026-01088-z.title: Realtor Forecasting Accuracy on Homebuyer Preferences for Energy Efficiency
10.1007/s10640-026-01088-z.title_zh: 房地产经纪人关于购房者能效偏好预测的准确性

10.1007/s10640-026-01089-y.abstract: This paper argues that military buildups lead to a significant rise in greenhouse gas emissions and can disrupt the green transition. Identifying military spending shocks, I use local projections to show that a percentage point rise in the military spending share leads to a 0.9–2% rise in total emissions, as well as a 1% rise in emission intensity, depending on the economy’s overall emission intensity. Using a dynamic production network model calibrated for the US, I find that a permanent shock of the same size would increase total emissions by between 0.25% and 1.38%, and emission intensity by between 0.12% and 1.06%. The empirical analysis tentatively suggests that green patenting may be reduced by 10–25% following such a shock, and the model suggests that investment in renewables could be crowded out by defence spending under certain circumstances, hindering the energy transition. I show in a directed technical change model that crowding out green innovation could result in the growth rate - not just the level - of emissions becoming higher. These effects can significantly raise climate damages. Depending on the social cost of carbon and the composition of a military spending shock, I estimate that permanently doubling the military spending share in the US in 2017 (equal to 3.3% of GDP) would have led to climate damages equivalent to between 0.05–1.81% of US GDP per year.
10.1007/s10640-026-01089-y.abstract_zh: 本文认为，军事扩张会导致温室气体排放显著增加，并可能阻碍绿色转型。通过识别军事支出冲击，我采用局部投影法证明：军事支出占比每上升1个百分点，总排放量将增加0.9%-2%，排放强度将上升1%（具体幅度取决于经济体的整体排放强度）。基于为美国校准的动态生产网络模型，我发现同等规模的永久性冲击将使总排放量增加0.25%-1.38%，排放强度提高0.12%-1.06%。实证分析初步表明，此类冲击后绿色专利数量可能减少10%-25%；模型则显示，特定条件下国防支出可能挤出可再生能源投资，阻碍能源转型。在定向技术变革模型中，我证明挤出绿色创新可能导致排放增长率（而非仅排放水平）上升。这些效应将显著加剧气候损害。根据碳的社会成本及军事支出冲击的构成，我估算：若2017年美国军事支出占比（相当于GDP的3.3%）永久性翻倍，由此导致的气候损害将相当于美国GDP的0.05%-1.81%/年。
10.1007/s10640-026-01089-y.title: The Green Peace Dividend: The Effects of Militarisation on Emissions and the Green Transition
10.1007/s10640-026-01089-y.title_zh: 绿色和平红利：军事化对排放与绿色转型的影响

10.1007/s10640-026-01090-5.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    In March 2020, Luxembourg became the first country to make public transport free. We use this unique setting to evaluate the policy’s impact on transport emissions using a synthetic difference-in-differences framework. We use spatial emissions data to construct a panel of NUTS 2 regions in the EU from 2016 to 2022. We estimate an average reduction of 5.9% in road transport CO
                    <jats:sub>2</jats:sub>
                    and overall road transport GHG emissions, with larger effects for NO
                    <jats:sub>x</jats:sub>
                    . These findings are robust against confounding shifts in working from home and commuting patterns, vehicle fleet electrification, and the localized effects of the COVID-19 pandemic. Complementary event-study evidence from automatic traffic counters and air quality stations through 2023 corroborates our findings and suggests larger effects on weekends.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s10640-026-01090-5.abstract_zh: 2020年3月，卢森堡成为首个实现公共交通免费化的国家。我们利用这一独特政策场景，采用合成双重差分框架评估该政策对交通排放的影响。通过使用空间排放数据，我们构建了2016至2022年欧盟NUTS 2区域的面板数据。研究发现，该政策使道路交通二氧化碳及整体道路交通温室气体排放平均降低5.9%，对氮氧化物的减排效果更为显著。这些结论在控制居家办公与通勤模式变化、车辆电动化进程以及新冠疫情局部影响等混杂因素后依然稳健。基于2023年自动交通计数器与空气质量监测站的补充事件研究证据进一步佐证了我们的发现，并表明该政策在周末的减排效应更为显著。
10.1007/s10640-026-01090-5.title: Zero Fare, Cleaner Air? The Causal Effect of Luxembourg’s Free Public Transportation Policy on Transport Emissions
10.1007/s10640-026-01090-5.title_zh: 零票价，更清洁的空气？卢森堡免费公共交通政策对交通排放的因果效应

10.1007/s10640-026-01091-4.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Using BoardEx (2000–2017), we create a dynamic network connecting firms and board directors in the United States. We use the Environmental Protection Agency’s Toxics Release Inventory to measure environmental performance at the director and firm-level. We first examine how candidates’ environmental performance and networks affect their probability to be appointed to the board. We find that firms are likely to appoint influential directors with good environmental records and similar characteristics. We then show that directors’ past environmental records affect their current firm’s chemical releases. We address endogeneity concerns related to directors’ appointments and firms’ environmental performance by modeling directors’ network formation.</jats:p>
10.1007/s10640-026-01091-4.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>本文利用BoardEx数据库（2000–2017年），构建了一个连接美国企业与董事会成员的动态网络。我们采用美国环境保护署的有毒物质排放清单，从董事与企业两个层面衡量环境绩效。首先，我们考察候选人的环境绩效及其社会网络如何影响其被任命为董事会成员的概率。研究发现，企业倾向于任命具有良好环境记录且特征相似的影响力董事。其次，我们证明董事过往的环境记录会对其当前任职企业的化学品排放量产生影响。通过构建董事网络形成模型，我们解决了董事任命与企业环境绩效相关的内生性问题。</jats:p>
10.1007/s10640-026-01091-4.title: Director Appointments, Boardroom Networks, and Firm Environmental Performance
10.1007/s10640-026-01091-4.title_zh: 董事任命、董事会网络与企业环境绩效

10.1007/s10640-026-01092-3.abstract: The transition to carbon-neutral residential heating poses extraordinary policy challenges to societies in Europe and beyond. In this paper, we study the electoral consequences of an amendment to the German Building Energy Act (GEG) aimed at phasing-out fossil-based heating systems. We use granular building stock data to approximate heterogeneity in household compliance costs and apply difference-in-differences and triple difference models to estimate its impacts on vote shares at the municipal level. For the state elections in Bavaria and Hesse, we find relative gains for the far-right (+2.4 pp) and conservative opposition parties (+6.5 pp) and losses for the incumbent federal government parties (−2.9 pp) in the baseline specification of our model. For the latter two, the effects are more pronounced in rural municipalities. These findings highlight the importance of holistic climate policy approaches that account for salient and heterogeneous costs to mitigate political backlash.
10.1007/s10640-026-01092-3.abstract_zh: 向碳中和住宅供暖的转型对欧洲及其他地区的社会构成了特殊的政策挑战。本文研究了德国《建筑能源法》（GEG）修正案（旨在逐步淘汰化石燃料供暖系统）的选举后果。我们利用精细的建筑存量数据来近似衡量家庭合规成本的异质性，并采用双重差分和三重差分模型，估算该修正案在市级层面对政党得票率的影响。在巴伐利亚和黑森州的州选举中，我们的基准模型结果显示，极右翼政党得票率相对上升2.4个百分点，保守派反对党得票率上升6.5个百分点，而联邦执政党得票率下降2.9个百分点。对于后两者而言，这种效应在农村地区更为显著。这些发现凸显了采取整体性气候政策方法的重要性，该方法需考虑显著且异质性的成本，以减轻政治反弹。
10.1007/s10640-026-01092-3.title: The Electoral Impact of Housing Climate Policy: Evidence from Germany
10.1007/s10640-026-01092-3.title_zh: 住房气候政策的选举影响：来自德国的证据

10.1007/s10640-026-01093-2.abstract: We present a simple model showing how income inequality and the income elasticity of demand jointly shape the tax progressivity of indirect taxes, with rising inequality increasing the regressivity of taxes on necessities. We test the model’s predictions by analyzing the Swedish carbon tax on transport fuel. We find that the tax becomes increasingly regressive over time, closely tracking rising income inequality. We also show that the relative incidence shifts from regressive to progressive when using annual expenditure rather than annual income as the welfare measure, as expenditure is more evenly distributed. A cross-country analysis of gasoline taxes in high-income nations further supports our findings, establishing a strong correlation between higher inequality and greater regressivity. Our model helps policymakers identify when complementary redistributive measures such as lump-sum transfers may become necessary.
10.1007/s10640-026-01093-2.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简约模型，揭示收入不平等与需求收入弹性如何共同塑造间接税的累进性：不平等加剧会提高必需品税的累退性。通过分析瑞典交通燃料碳税，我们验证了模型预测：该税种的累退性随时间推移持续增强，与收入不平等加剧趋势高度吻合。研究还表明，当采用年度支出（而非年度收入）作为福利衡量指标时，相对税负分布从累退转为累进——因为支出分布更为均衡。对高收入国家汽油税的跨国分析进一步支持了我们的发现：不平等程度越高，累退性越强。该模型有助于政策制定者识别何时需要配套实施一次性转移支付等再分配措施。
10.1007/s10640-026-01093-2.title: Tax Progressivity of Carbon and Gasoline Taxes: The Role of Income Inequality
10.1007/s10640-026-01093-2.title_zh: 碳税与汽油税的累进性：收入不平等的作用

10.1007/s10640-026-01094-1.abstract: This study examines an under-explored implication of population ageing: its relationship with environmental outcomes at the country level and environmental attitudes at the individual level. The analysis introduces a novel classification of environmental outcomes, distinguishing between action-requiring and nature-concerning dimensions based on the degree of civic engagement necessary for their realisation. Using panel data from a broad set of countries over the period 1995–2018, population ageing is shown to be associated with improvements in environmental outcomes that require limited civic engagement, while no systematic relationship is observed for outcomes that rely on active public participation. Complementary evidence from individual-level survey data for 2005–2016 indicates that ageing societies exhibit lower levels of environmental engagement, without a corresponding decline in underlying environmental concern. The findings contribute to the literature on demographic change and environmental performance by highlighting the role of civic engagement as a mediating mechanism and suggest that ageing societies may face specific challenges in sustaining participatory forms of environmental action.
10.1007/s10640-026-01094-1.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人口老龄化一个尚未充分挖掘的影响：其在国家层面与环境结果、个体层面与环境态度之间的关系。分析引入了一种新的环境结果分类方法，根据实现这些结果所需的公民参与程度，将其区分为“需要行动型”和“关注自然型”两个维度。利用1995–2018年间多个国家的面板数据，研究发现人口老龄化与那些需要有限公民参与的环境结果的改善相关，而对于依赖公众积极参与的环境结果，则未观察到系统性关联。基于2005–2016年个体层面调查数据的补充证据表明，老龄化社会中的环境参与水平较低，但潜在的环境关注并未相应下降。这些发现通过强调公民参与作为中介机制的作用，为人口变化与环境绩效的相关文献做出了贡献，并表明老龄化社会在维持参与式环境行动方面可能面临特定挑战。
10.1007/s10640-026-01094-1.title: Population Ageing and the Environment: A Comparative Study of Nature-Concerning and Action-Requiring Outcomes
10.1007/s10640-026-01094-1.title_zh: 人口老龄化与环境：自然关注型与行动需求型结果的比较研究

10.1007/s10640-026-01095-0.abstract: In regions with low soil fertility, smallholder farmers often clear forest to sustain agricultural yields. This pattern becomes more problematic where forest regrowth is slow, contributing to local forest loss and global environmental challenges such as climate change and biodiversity decline. This paper presents findings from a framed field experiment that examines how different types of monetary incentives affect forest-clearing decisions in northern Namibia, a semi-arid region with negligible forest regrowth. We implemented a common-pool resource game with 518 smallholder farmers across 25 villages, in which a forest stock declines dynamically based on participants’ clearing decisions, without immediate regrowth. The game spans three periods: a baseline without incentives, an intervention period where participants receive either individual rewards, collective rewards, an individual fee, or no incentives (control group), and a post-incentive phase. This setup allows us to assess both the immediate effects of incentives and their persistence after incentive removal. All incentive types reduce clearing compared to the baseline, but not significantly more than in the control condition, where clearing also declined – an unexpected trend likely linked to features of the dynamic game design. Incentive effects largely dissipate after removal, with no strong evidence of lasting motivational crowding-in or crowding-out. Overall, our results suggest that moderate payments may be insufficient to sustain cooperation in persistent resource dilemmas. More broadly, they highlight the importance of multifaceted analysis including control conditions and careful experimental framing in field-laboratory studies, coupled with caution in generalizing findings to other settings or policy applications.
10.1007/s10640-026-01095-0.abstract_zh: 在土壤肥力较低的地区，小农户常通过砍伐森林来维持农业产量。当森林再生缓慢时，这种模式会加剧问题，导致局部森林损失及气候变化、生物多样性下降等全球性环境挑战。本文基于一项框架田野实验，探讨不同货币激励类型如何影响纳米比亚北部（一个森林再生几乎为零的半干旱地区）的森林砍伐决策。我们针对25个村庄的518名小农户开展了一项公共池资源博弈实验：森林存量根据参与者的砍伐决策动态下降，且无即时再生。实验分为三个阶段：无激励基线期、干预期（参与者分别获得个人奖励、集体奖励、个人费用或零激励（对照组））以及激励后阶段。该设计使我们能够评估激励的即时效应及其在激励取消后的持续性。所有激励类型均比基线期减少了砍伐行为，但并未显著优于对照组——对照组砍伐量同样下降，这一意外趋势可能与动态博弈设计特征相关。激励效应在取消后基本消失，未发现持久的动机挤入或挤出效应。总体而言，我们的结果表明，适度支付可能不足以在持续性资源困境中维持合作。更广泛地看，本研究凸显了在田野实验室研究中纳入控制条件、谨慎设计实验框架并进行多维度分析的重要性，同时需警惕将结论推广至其他情境或政策应用。
10.1007/s10640-026-01095-0.title: Introducing and Terminating Monetary Incentives in Non-Regenerating Forests: Insights from a Framed Field Experiment
10.1007/s10640-026-01095-0.title_zh: 非再生森林中货币激励的引入与终止：来自框架田野实验的启示

10.1007/s10640-026-01096-z.abstract: This paper examines which country should undertake forest restoration when production and deforestation jointly degrade environmental absorption capacity. We develop a two-country dynamic game in which a forest owner derives revenues from deforestation while a non-owner benefits from production; both generate emissions, but only deforestation directly reduces carbon sink efficiency. Restoration is costly and subject to inertia. Consistent with international governance frameworks, the restoring country commits to a predetermined restoration path, while the non-restorer may either commit or retain strategic flexibility. Under homogeneous strategies, long-run environmental outcomes are independent of which country restores. Under heterogeneous strategies, however, the allocation of restoration responsibility becomes crucial: assigning restoration to the producer may aggravate environmental degradation and lead to history-dependent, potentially irreversible dynamics, whereas assigning it to the deforester mitigates opportunistic behavior and promotes more stable outcomes. A novel finding is that history-dependency is both control-specific and parameter-dependent: the deforester’s deforestation and restoration controls exhibit strong Skiba behavior robustly across parametric regimes, while the producer’s emissions exhibit weak Skiba behavior when economically dominant but become more sensitive to initial conditions when the deforester dominates. These results reflect an asymmetry in transmission channels and suggest that robust environmental protection requires aligning restoration responsibilities with forest ownership.
10.1007/s10640-026-01096-z.abstract_zh: 本文探讨当生产与毁林共同削弱环境吸收能力时，应由哪个国家承担森林恢复责任。我们构建了一个两国动态博弈模型：森林所有者通过毁林获取收益，而非所有者则从生产中获益；两者均产生排放，但只有毁林行为直接降低碳汇效率。森林恢复成本高昂且存在惯性。遵循国际治理框架，恢复国承诺执行既定恢复路径，而非恢复国可选择承诺或保留战略灵活性。在策略同质化情形下，长期环境结果与恢复责任归属无关。然而在策略异质化情形下，恢复责任的分配变得至关重要：将恢复责任分配给生产国可能加剧环境退化，并引发依赖历史路径且可能不可逆的动态过程；而将其分配给毁林国则可抑制机会主义行为，促进更稳定的结果。一项新发现表明：历史路径依赖性既具有控制特异性又具有参数依赖性——毁林国的毁林与恢复控制在不同参数区间均表现出显著的Skiba行为，而生产国的排放控制在经济主导时呈现弱Skiba行为，但在毁林国主导时对初始条件更为敏感。这些结果反映了传导渠道的非对称性，并表明稳健的环境保护需要将恢复责任与森林所有权相匹配。
10.1007/s10640-026-01096-z.title: Restoration Responsibility in a Dynamic Game of Deforestation, Production, and Pollution Accumulation
10.1007/s10640-026-01096-z.title_zh: 毁林、生产与污染累积动态博弈中的恢复责任

10.1007/s10640-026-01097-y.abstract: This study investigates how target-based performance evaluation affects the spatial allocation of environmental enforcement. Using China’s ambient air quality monitoring network as a quasi-experimental setting, we combine high-frequency firm-level emissions data and a difference-in-differences design. We document a 12.6% reduction in nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions among polluting firms located near newly established monitoring stations, relative to more distant firms. This disparity reveals a strategic reallocation of enforcement effort by local governments to improve visible air quality metrics tied to career incentives, rather than to achieve broad pollution abatement. While such selective enforcement helps jurisdictions meet top-down performance targets, it creates a “monitoring-proximity paradox,” whereby regulatory effort becomes spatially concentrated.
10.1007/s10640-026-01097-y.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了基于目标的绩效评估如何影响环境执法的空间配置。以中国环境空气质量监测网络为准自然实验场景，我们结合高频企业级排放数据与双重差分模型展开分析。研究发现，相较于距离较远的企业，新建监测站点周边污染企业的氮氧化物排放量下降了12.6%。这一差异揭示了地方政府为改善与职业晋升激励挂钩的显性空气质量指标，而非实现广泛污染减排所采取的策略性执法资源再配置行为。尽管这种选择性执法有助于辖区完成自上而下的绩效目标，却形成了"监测邻近悖论"——即监管力度呈现空间集聚特征。
10.1007/s10640-026-01097-y.title: Strategic Enforcement Distortion Under Target-Based Environmental Governance: Spatial Heterogeneity in Pollution Mitigation and Policy Implications
10.1007/s10640-026-01097-y.title_zh: 目标导向环境治理下的策略性执法扭曲：污染减排的空间异质性与政策启示

10.1007/s10640-026-01099-w.abstract: This study evaluates the impact of the Pilot Free Trade Zones (PFTZs) on the carbon emissions of enterprises located within the zones. By manually identifying PFTZs’ boundaries and employing a spatial regression discontinuity (SRD) design, we find that the establishment of the PFTZs significantly reduces the carbon emission intensity of enterprises within the zones. This conclusion remains valid across a series of robustness tests. Mechanism analysis reveals that the PFTZs drives emission reductions by intensifying market competition, stimulating green technology innovation, and alleviating financing constraints. Furthermore, heterogeneity analyses indicate that these effects are more pronounced in heavily polluting industries, technology-intensive enterprises, non-state-owned enterprises, and areas with a larger scale of construction. This study provides a vital theoretical basis for China’s green and high-quality development strategies in the current context of carbon reduction.
10.1007/s10640-026-01099-w.abstract_zh: 本研究评估了自由贸易试验区（PFTZs）对区内企业碳排放的影响。通过手动识别自贸区边界并采用空间断点回归（SRD）设计，我们发现自贸区的设立显著降低了区内企业的碳排放强度。该结论在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析表明，自贸区通过加剧市场竞争、激发绿色技术创新以及缓解融资约束来推动减排。此外，异质性分析显示，这些效应在重污染行业、技术密集型企业、非国有企业以及建设规模较大的区域更为显著。本研究为当前碳减排背景下中国绿色高质量发展战略提供了重要的理论依据。
10.1007/s10640-026-01099-w.title: The Establishment of Pilot Free Trade Zones and Carbon Emissions
10.1007/s10640-026-01099-w.title_zh: 自贸试验区设立与碳排放

10.1007/s10640-026-01100-6.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We estimate the impact of catastrophic wildfires on suicide. Leveraging an eight-year panel of county-by-month restricted-use mortality data for California, we find that catastrophic wildfires that destroy at least 2% of a county’s housing stock cause a 47% increase in the suicide rate (roughly nine excess suicides) in the six-month aftermath of an event. Exploring sources of heterogeneity, effects are largely driven by men. Mechanisms are explored and suggest that suicide results from the loss of property and direct loss of life, rather than smoke exposure. These findings suggest that wildfires may be deadlier and more expensive than previously thought.</jats:p>
10.1007/s10640-026-01100-6.abstract_zh: 我们估算了灾难性野火对自杀率的影响。利用加州按县-月划分的八年限制使用死亡率面板数据，我们发现，在事件发生后的六个月内，摧毁一个县至少2%住房存量的灾难性野火会导致自杀率上升47%（约增加9例自杀）。在异质性来源的探索中，影响主要由男性驱动。机制分析表明，自杀源于财产损失和直接生命损失，而非烟雾暴露。这些发现表明，野火可能比先前认为的更具致命性和更高成本。
10.1007/s10640-026-01100-6.title: Catastrophic Wildfires & Suicide

10.1007/s10640-026-01101-5.abstract: We study whether the net zero transition (NZT) affects loan pricing in the energy and utilities sectors of the loan market. We find that firms with higher levels of overall NZT disclosure experience a lower cost of debt in the loan market, controlling for loan-specific and firm financial characteristics. This effect is economically and statistically significant in Europe, but not in North America or emerging markets, and becomes more pronounced after the 2015 Paris Agreement. We also identify relevant NZT actions contributing to such a relation. Firms disclosing clear emission reduction targets aligned with the Paris Agreement enjoy lower loan spreads. Additionally, environmental R&D expenditure and improved energy efficiency policies are associated with lower loan spreads. Moreover, effective governance actions, such as environmental management training and ESG-linked executive compensation, help mitigate climate risks and lower loan spreads.
10.1007/s10640-026-01101-5.abstract_zh: 本文研究净零转型是否影响贷款市场中能源与公用事业部门的贷款定价。在控制贷款特定特征与企业财务特征后，我们发现净零转型整体披露水平较高的企业在贷款市场中的债务成本较低。这一效应在欧洲具有经济和统计显著性，但在北美或新兴市场并不显著，且在2015年《巴黎协定》后更为突出。我们还识别出促成该关系的相关净零转型行动：披露与《巴黎协定》一致的明确减排目标的企业享有较低的贷款利差；此外，环境研发支出与能源效率政策的改善也与较低的贷款利差相关。同时，有效的治理行动（如环境管理培训及与ESG挂钩的高管薪酬）有助于缓解气候风险并降低贷款利差。
10.1007/s10640-026-01101-5.title: Corporate Net Zero Transition and Financing Cost: Evidence of Impact from the Global Energy and Utilities Sectors
10.1007/s10640-026-01101-5.title_zh: 企业净零转型与融资成本：来自全球能源与公用事业部门的冲击证据

10.1007/s10640-026-01102-4.abstract: We present a valuation framework for measuring the non-market net operating surplus associated with threatened wild species preservation for monetary ecosystem accounting . We use the Simulated Exchange Value ( SEV ) method, which estimates the maximum benefit that could be internalized in a hypothetical market using the demand simulated from a choice experiment, a given market supply, and an assumed market structure. The choice experiment estimates willingness to pay (WTP), in addition to current tax-funded costs, for achieving different stock levels of wild species across threat categories defined by the International Union for Conservation of Nature Red List. We apply this framework to the valuation of threatened waterbird species preservation in the coastal wetlands of the southwestern Iberian Peninsula. The results show that WTP increases as the number of threatened species decreases, with the critically endangered species generating the highest WTP and no statistically significant differences between vulnerable and endangered species. Based on our preferred model, we estimate a SEV of the net operating surplus of €2,850 per hectare per year for the current stock levels of threatened waterbird species. The equivalent variation estimated for the same stock level is €4,108 per hectare per year.
10.1007/s10640-026-01102-4.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种估值框架，用于衡量与受威胁野生物种保护相关的非市场净经营盈余，以服务于货币化生态系统核算。我们采用模拟交换价值（SEV）方法，该方法通过选择实验模拟的需求、给定的市场供给以及假定的市场结构，估算在假设市场中可内部化的最大收益。该选择实验估算了除当前税收资助成本之外，为实现国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）红色名录所定义的不同威胁类别野生物种存量水平而支付的意愿（WTP）。我们将此框架应用于伊比利亚半岛西南部沿海湿地受威胁水鸟物种保护的估值。结果显示，随着受威胁物种数量的减少，WTP增加，其中极危物种产生的WTP最高，而易危物种与濒危物种之间无统计学显著差异。基于我们的优选模型，我们估算出当前受威胁水鸟物种存量水平的净经营盈余SEV为每公顷每年2850欧元。同一存量水平下估算的等价变差为每公顷每年4108欧元。
10.1007/s10640-026-01102-4.title: Integrating Threatened Biodiversity in Monetary Ecosystem Accounting: Choice Experiments and Simulated Exchange Values
10.1007/s10640-026-01102-4.title_zh: 将受威胁生物多样性纳入货币化生态系统核算：选择实验与模拟交换价值

10.1007/s10640-026-01103-3.abstract: The consensus view among economists is that carbon prices, in order to be efficient, must be the same across the globe. But when there are inefficiencies in the allocation of capital so that countries are subject to different discount rates, we show that efficient carbon prices must be different across countries. This is a consequence of Hotelling’s familiar argument on the price of a non-renewable resource: it must grow at the rate of the next best use of marginal funds, which is equal to the country’s discount rate. If different countries discount at different rates, their carbon prices ought to grow at different rates as well. If they grow at different rates, they can’t be the same all of the time, as first-best carbon prices are. The computational climate policy literature has so far avoided this conclusion by altering time preferences in a country-specific way through time-varying Negishi weights. We show that the use of such weights causes inefficient policy prescriptions and, furthermore, has the particularly undesirable consequence of incorrectly discounting future consumption more in countries with high growth rates. The existence of inefficiencies in the savings process—causing differences in discount rates—is well-known and should be acknowledged head on in climate policy analysis. Doing so results in global mitigation policy with carbon price paths for different countries growing (efficiently) at different rates.
10.1007/s10640-026-01103-3.abstract_zh: 经济学家普遍认为，碳价格若要实现效率最优，必须在全球范围内保持一致。然而，当资本配置存在效率损失，导致各国面临不同的贴现率时，我们证明有效的碳价格必须因国而异。这一结论源于霍特林关于不可再生资源价格的经典论证：碳价格必须以边际资金次优用途的增长率上升，而该增长率等于该国的贴现率。若不同国家的贴现率存在差异，其碳价格也应以不同速率增长。由于增长速率不同，碳价格便无法像最优状态那样始终保持一致。现有气候政策计算文献通过引入随时间变化的尼格希权重来调整各国的时间偏好，从而回避了这一结论。我们证明，使用此类权重会导致政策建议缺乏效率，并产生尤为不良的后果——在高增长国家中，未来消费被错误地以更高贴现率折现。储蓄过程中的效率损失（导致贴现率差异）是公认现象，气候政策分析应直面这一问题。如此制定的全球减排政策，将使不同国家的碳价格路径以（有效的）不同速率增长。
10.1007/s10640-026-01103-3.title: On Differentiated Carbon Prices and Discount Rates
10.1007/s10640-026-01103-3.title_zh: 差异化碳价格与贴现率研究

10.1007/s10640-026-01105-1.abstract: This paper analyzes the taxation of emissions in the presence of two institutional frictions common in developing countries. First, credit markets are underdeveloped in terms of both access to credit and borrowing conditions. Second, limited state capacity restricts the operation of the tax system. The analysis shows that the second-best emissions tax reflects both marginal environmental damages, as in the Pigouvian principle, and the effectiveness of taxation in reducing pollution. Credit market frictions hinder the adoption of clean technologies and increase emissions, which would, in isolation, call for a higher Pigouvian tax. However, these frictions may also reduce the responsiveness of emissions to taxation by limiting firms’ ability to adopt cleaner technologies, thereby lowering the optimal second-best tax. To capture these mechanisms, the paper distinguishes between two types of distortions: collateral-based, productivity-independent differences in access to credit, and cash-flow–based borrowing constraints. The optimal tax responds differently to each type of distortion.
10.1007/s10640-026-01105-1.abstract_zh: 本文分析了发展中国家普遍存在的两种制度性摩擦对排放征税的影响。其一，信贷市场在信贷获取渠道与借贷条件方面均存在欠发达特征；其二，有限的国家能力制约了税收体系的运行效能。研究表明，次优排放税既需遵循庇古原则反映边际环境损害，又需体现税收在减少污染方面的有效性。信贷市场摩擦会阻碍清洁技术采用并增加排放量，单就这一效应而言，本应要求更高的庇古税。然而，这些摩擦通过限制企业采用清洁技术的能力，可能同时削弱排放对税收的响应弹性，从而降低最优次优税率。为捕捉上述机制，本文区分了两种不同类型的扭曲：基于抵押品且与生产率无关的信贷获取差异，以及基于现金流约束的借贷限制。最优税率对这两种扭曲的响应方式存在显著差异。
10.1007/s10640-026-01105-1.title: Revisiting Pigouvian Taxes Under Credit Constraints and State Capacity Limitations
10.1007/s10640-026-01105-1.title_zh: 信贷约束与国家能力限制下的庇古税再探讨

10.1007/s10640-026-01106-0.abstract: Hydrogeological disasters are an increasingly important source of fiscal stress for local governments, yet evidence on how municipal budgets adjust to these events remains limited. This paper estimates the fiscal effects of hydrogeological State of Emergency declarations on Italian municipal budgets over 2016–2022, exploiting their staggered timing across municipalities. We find that treated municipalities increase both total revenues and total expenditures after first exposure. The response is primarily investment-led, with capital expenditures accounting for the largest estimated component of the adjustment while current expenditures remain broadly unchanged. The largest changes in expenditure composition involve civil protection activities and sustainable development. On the revenue side, the adjustment is driven mainly by capital revenues and intergovernmental transfers. We further examine municipal heterogeneity using an ex-ante measure of fiscal resilience based on debt-service burden and tax autonomy. Municipalities with lower debt-service burden display sharper immediate fiscal adjustments, whereas tax autonomy matters more for sustaining the fiscal response over time. The weakest responses are observed among municipalities combining high debt-service burden with weak tax autonomy. Overall, the evidence suggests that hydrogeological emergencies trigger a structured, investment-led fiscal response, but that pre-existing fiscal conditions shape local governments’ capacity to absorb and manage these disaster-related fiscal pressures.
10.1007/s10640-026-01106-0.abstract_zh: 水文地质灾害日益成为地方政府财政压力的重要来源，然而关于市政预算如何应对这些事件的证据仍然有限。本文利用2016至2022年间意大利各市镇宣布水文地质紧急状态的交错时间安排，估计了其对市政预算的财政影响。我们发现，首次经历此类事件后，受影响的市镇总收入和总支出均有所增加。这一反应主要以投资为导向，资本支出构成调整中最大的估计组成部分，而经常性支出基本保持不变。支出结构变化最大的领域涉及民防活动和可持续发展。在收入方面，调整主要由资本收入和政府间转移支付驱动。我们进一步利用基于债务负担和税收自主权的事前财政韧性指标考察了市镇间的异质性。债务负担较低的市镇表现出更明显的即时财政调整，而税收自主权对维持财政反应的持续性更为重要。在债务负担高且税收自主权弱的市镇中，财政反应最为微弱。总体而言，证据表明水文地质紧急事件触发了结构化的、以投资为导向的财政反应，但既有的财政状况塑造了地方政府吸收和管理这些灾害相关财政压力的能力。
10.1007/s10640-026-01106-0.title: Floods, Public Budgets and Fiscal Resilience: Evidence from Italian Municipalities
10.1007/s10640-026-01106-0.title_zh: 洪水、公共预算与财政韧性：来自意大利市政的证据

10.1007/s10640-026-01107-z.abstract: Existing evidence shows consumers are willing to pay for labeled environmental attributes. However, there is a gap regarding whether consumers have a willingness to engage (WTE) with detailed information. The European Union’s circular economy action plan provides for a new Digital Product Passport (DPP), holding information including embedded emissions, components and materials, chemical substances, and instructions for repair, disassembly and sustainable disposal. In our theory, a green consumer decides how much to engage with information that helps them mitigate their environmental damage from consumption, given a cognitive or time cost. We test the model using a lab experiment where environmental attributes of a good are only available through a DPP. We find education on the DPP’s purpose is key to increasing revealed WTE with a DPP. This is driven by those with a lower stated WTE; participants with a high stated WTE interact with the DPP regardless. Engagement with the DPP increases knowledge and willingness to pay (WTP), as the DPP reveals favorable environmental information. We find no evidence of positive spillovers from the DPP (no further shifts in environmental orientation or increased subsequent behavior), but we find evidence that increases in WTP due to the DPP, and exposure to the DPP, lead to a negative spillover in a subsequent behavior (environmental donation). We further contribute novel measures of stated and revealed WTE, and demonstrate their value in understanding consumer behavior in a theoretically informed manner. Our study provides insights for field testing and rollout of a DPP or similar.
10.1007/s10640-026-01107-z.abstract_zh: 现有证据表明，消费者愿意为标注的环境属性支付费用。然而，关于消费者是否愿意参与（WTE）详细信息方面仍存在研究空白。欧盟循环经济行动计划规定了新的数字产品护照（DPP），其中包含嵌入排放、组件与材料、化学物质以及维修、拆解和可持续处置说明等信息。在我们的理论中，绿色消费者在面临认知或时间成本的情况下，决定投入多少精力去接触有助于减轻其消费对环境损害的信息。我们通过实验室实验检验该模型，实验中商品的环境属性仅能通过DPP获取。我们发现，对DPP目的的教育是提高揭示性WTE的关键因素，这一效应主要由那些声明WTE较低的参与者驱动；而声明WTE较高的参与者无论是否接受教育都会与DPP互动。与DPP的互动增加了知识水平和支付意愿（WTP），因为DPP揭示了有利的环境信息。我们未发现DPP存在正向溢出效应的证据（环境取向无进一步转变或后续行为无增加），但发现DPP导致的WTP增加以及接触DPP，会在后续行为（环境捐赠）中产生负向溢出效应。我们进一步贡献了声明性和揭示性WTE的新颖测量方法，并展示了其在理论指导下理解消费者行为方面的价值。我们的研究为DPP或类似机制的实地测试和推广提供了见解。
10.1007/s10640-026-01107-z.title: From Willingness to Engage to Demand: A Behavioral Experiment on Green Consumer Information in a Digital Product Passport
10.1007/s10640-026-01107-z.title_zh: 从参与意愿到需求：数字产品护照中绿色消费者信息的行为实验

10.1007/s10640-026-01108-y.abstract: We estimate the effect of the staggered adoption of carbon pricing policies across the globe between 1990 and 2017 on per capita $$\text{CO}_2$$ emissions from fossil fuel combustion. We use recent econometric techniques robust to treatment effect heterogeneity. Our dynamic treatment effect estimations indicate gradual adjustments after implementation, resulting in a 19 to 23 percent decrease in $$\text{CO}_2$$ emissions after 10 years. These effects were primarily driven by resource substitution rather than improvements in energy efficiency and were not driven by short-term responses to carbon prices. Our results are robust to controlling for the potential effects of renewable energy policies. These results highlight the role of carbon pricing policies in steering medium-term expectations and complementing the climate policy mix.
10.1007/s10640-026-01108-y.abstract_zh: 我们估算了1990年至2017年间全球范围内碳定价政策分阶段实施对化石燃料燃烧产生的二氧化碳人均排放量的影响。我们采用了近期对处理效应异质性稳健的计量经济学技术。动态处理效应估计显示，政策实施后调整逐步进行，十年后二氧化碳排放量下降了19%至23%。这些效应主要源于资源替代，而非能源效率的提升，并且并非由对碳价格的短期反应所驱动。我们的结果在控制可再生能源政策潜在影响后依然稳健。这些发现凸显了碳定价政策在引导中期预期及补充气候政策组合中的作用。
10.1007/s10640-026-01108-y.title: The Effectiveness of Carbon Pricing: A Global Evaluation
10.1007/s10640-026-01108-y.title_zh: 碳定价的有效性：全球评估

10.1007/s10640-026-01109-x.abstract: This paper introduces the Comparative Travel Expenditure (CTE) method, a novel approach to derive exchange values for recreation-related ecosystem services (RES) compliant with the System of Environmental Economic Accounting - Ecosystem Accounting framework. Our approach builds upon the environmental economic literature by modifying the established travel-cost method in order to only consider market transactions to estimate the expenditures directly attributable to RES. By comparing the recreation demand of two sites with different ecosystem conditions, the CTE method allows us to estimate the difference in price driven by such differences in ecosystem conditions, thereby isolating the exchange value of RES for accounting purposes. To illustrate the CTE method, we conduct an empirical estimation of the RES exchange value of an Italian marine protected area, estimating that 66% of the travel expenditures incurred by tourists are driven by marine and coastal ecosystems, which significantly contribute to the local economy.
10.1007/s10640-026-01109-x.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的“比较旅行支出”（CTE）方法，旨在推导符合《环境经济核算体系-生态系统核算》框架的休闲相关生态系统服务（RES）交换价值。该方法在环境经济学文献基础上，通过修改既有的旅行成本法，仅考虑市场交易来估算直接归因于RES的支出。通过比较两个生态系统条件不同的地点的休闲需求，CTE方法使我们能够估算由生态系统条件差异引起的价格差异，从而为核算目的分离出RES的交换价值。为说明CTE方法，我们对意大利一个海洋保护区的RES交换价值进行了实证估算，结果显示，游客旅行支出中有66%由海洋和沿海生态系统驱动，这些生态系统对当地经济贡献显著。
10.1007/s10640-026-01109-x.title: The Comparative Travel Expenditure Method for Ecosystem Accounting
10.1007/s10640-026-01109-x.title_zh: 生态系统核算的比较旅行支出法

10.1007/s10640-026-01110-4.abstract: This paper explores heterogeneous individual valuations of an important amenity, climate mildness, using a traditional Rosen-Roback empirical framework. It does so by including interaction terms between the amenity and worker characteristics in an hedonic wage regression that also includes a housing-price measure. The results suggest that non-young workers (those in the mid-age and old groups) value a mild climate more than do young workers, matching the usual view that the tolerance for cold weather declines with age. The findings also suggest that, like their highly educated counterparts, workers with low education levels also highly value a mild climate, with workers in the middle range of education having a lower valuation. These findings, which contradict the view that only better-off individuals care about amenities, could reflect the lower burden in mild weather of the manual work done by the less educated. In addition to presenting these empirical findings, the paper further contributes by presenting new analytics for the Rosen-Roback model in a setting with individual heterogeneity.
10.1007/s10640-026-01110-4.abstract_zh: 本文运用传统的罗森-罗巴克实证框架，探讨了工人对一项重要宜居条件——气候温和度的异质性评价。通过在特征工资回归中加入该宜居条件与工人特征的交互项，并同时纳入房价指标，本文进行了分析。结果显示，非年轻工人（中年及老年群体）对温和气候的重视程度高于年轻工人，这与通常认为的耐寒能力随年龄增长而下降的观点相符。研究还发现，与高教育水平工人相似，低教育水平工人同样高度重视温和气候，而中等教育水平工人的评价则相对较低。这些发现与仅富裕人群关注宜居条件的观点相悖，可能反映了温和天气下低教育水平工人从事体力劳动负担较轻的情况。除呈现这些实证发现外，本文还通过在个体异质性情境下对罗森-罗巴克模型进行新的分析，进一步做出了贡献。
10.1007/s10640-026-01110-4.title: Heterogeneous Individual Valuations of a Mild Climate
10.1007/s10640-026-01110-4.title_zh: 异质性个体对温和气候的估值

10.1007/s10640-026-01111-3.title: The Tragedy of the Commons in the Presence of Regime Shift Risk
10.1007/s10640-026-01111-3.title_zh: 制度变迁风险下的公地悲剧

10.1007/s10640-026-01113-1.title: Cleaner Domestic Growth from a Globalization-Oriented Big Push: Evidence from China’s Belt and Road Initiative
10.1007/s10640-026-01113-1.title_zh: 全球化导向的大推动与更清洁的国内增长：来自中国“一带一路”倡议的证据

10.1007/s10640-026-01114-0.title: Humid Heat, Health, and Behavioral Adaptation: Evidence from China
10.1007/s10640-026-01114-0.title_zh: 湿热、健康与行为适应：来自中国的证据

10.1007/s10797-026-09947-7.abstract: This study investigates how increased female representation in executive positions within local governments affects municipal expenditures. We leverage a 2014 reform in Italy that mandated 40% gender quotas in the executive councils of municipalities with more than 3000 residents. To isolate the impact of gender quotas from other policies active at the same population cutoff, we employ a difference-in-discontinuities approach. We document that the policy effectively increases female representation in local governments, bringing younger, less politically experienced female politicians into executive councils. We find that increased female representation shifts resources away from culture and toward education, with spending shares rising by 25% for preschool and decreasing by 47% for culture. This indicates that including more women in executive roles can influence the allocation of municipal resources, even if it does not alter total spending levels.
10.1007/s10797-026-09947-7.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨地方政府行政职位中女性代表比例提升对市政支出的影响。我们利用意大利2014年实施的一项改革，该改革规定居民超过3000人的市镇行政委员会中女性配额须达到40%。为将性别配额的影响与同一人口阈值下其他政策的作用区分开来，我们采用断点回归差分法。研究证实，该政策有效提升了地方政府中的女性代表比例，使更年轻、政治经验较少的女性政治家进入行政委员会。我们发现，女性代表比例的提高促使资源从文化领域转向教育领域，学前教育支出份额上升25%，而文化支出份额下降47%。这表明，即使不改变总支出水平，增加女性在行政职务中的参与也能影响市政资源的分配格局。
10.1007/s10797-026-09947-7.title: Gender quotas in municipal executives: reallocating public spending in Italy
10.1007/s10797-026-09947-7.title_zh: 市政行政中的性别配额：意大利公共支出的重新分配

10.1007/s10797-026-09954-8.abstract: This paper examines how the Kansas tax experiment, which eliminated state income taxes on pass-through entities between 2012 and 2017, affected firms’ debt payment behavior, a key indicator of liquidity constraint. Using establishment-level data from the National Establishment Time Series (NETS) and exploiting the geographic discontinuity in the Kansas City metropolitan area, we estimate the causal effect of the reform using a spatially anchored difference-in-differences framework. The results show that eliminating pass-through income led to a measurable, but temporary, improvement in the timeliness of debt payments. The average duration of delayed payments was reduced by one-third in the baseline model. The effects were heterogeneous and significant in small and non-publicly listed establishments.
10.1007/s10797-026-09954-8.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2012年至2017年间堪萨斯州税收实验（该实验取消了穿透实体州所得税）对企业债务支付行为（流动性约束的关键指标）的影响。利用国家企业时间序列数据库（NETS）中的企业层面数据，并借助堪萨斯城都市区的地理断点特征，我们采用空间锚定双重差分框架估计了该改革的因果效应。结果表明，取消穿透实体所得税显著但暂时地改善了债务支付的及时性。在基准模型中，延迟支付的平均时长减少了三分之一。该效应在小型及非上市企业中呈现异质性且更为显著。
10.1007/s10797-026-09954-8.title: Do tax cuts ease liquidity constraints?
10.1007/s10797-026-09954-8.title_zh: 减税是否缓解了流动性约束？

10.1007/s10797-026-09956-6.abstract: We use essential cookies to make sure the site can function. We also use optional cookies for advertising, personalisation of content, usage analysis, and social media, as well as to allow video information to be shared for both marketing, analytics and editorial purposes.
10.1007/s10797-026-09956-6.abstract_zh: 我们使用必要的Cookies以确保网站正常运行。同时，我们也使用可选的Cookies用于广告投放、内容个性化、使用分析及社交媒体功能，并允许视频信息在营销、分析和编辑目的下进行分享。
10.1007/s10797-026-09956-6.title: Correction: The political economy of in-kind versus cash redistribution in Europe
10.1007/s10797-026-09956-6.title_zh: 更正：欧洲实物与现金再分配的政治经济学

10.1007/s10797-026-09957-5.abstract: In sub-Saharan Africa, the adoption of mobile money has grown substantially during the past decade, becoming an important driver of financial inclusion in the region. At the same time, many governments have introduced taxes on mobile money transfers, which may discourage use and encourage a return to cash-based transactions. In several countries, these taxes have been highly salient to taxpayers following public debate and subsequent rate reductions. This paper examines the effect of tax salience on the use of mobile money. Drawing on a lab experiment with small business owners in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, we randomly vary whether participants are reminded of an existing mobile money tax when making incentivized choices between receiving payments in cash or via mobile money. We find that increasing the salience of the tax significantly reduces the share of participants choosing mobile money. Evidence from a post-experiment questionnaire indicates that participants were well informed about the tax, suggesting that the effect does not operate through lack of knowledge.
10.1007/s10797-026-09957-5.abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲地区，过去十年间移动货币的采用率显著增长，成为该地区金融包容性的重要推动力。与此同时，多国政府引入了针对移动货币转账的税收，这可能抑制其使用并促使人们回归现金交易。在若干国家，经过公众辩论及随后的税率下调，这些税收对纳税人而言高度显著。本文探讨了税收显著性对移动货币使用的影响。基于在坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆与小微企业主进行的实验室实验，我们在参与者于现金与移动货币收款方式之间做出激励性选择时，随机改变是否提醒他们现有移动货币税收的存在。研究发现，提高税收显著性显著降低了参与者选择移动货币的比例。实验后问卷的证据表明，参与者对税收了解充分，暗示该效应并非通过信息缺乏发挥作用。
10.1007/s10797-026-09957-5.title: Tax Salience: Experimental Evidence from Tanzania
10.1007/s10797-026-09957-5.title_zh: 税收显著性：来自坦桑尼亚的实验证据

10.1007/s10797-026-09965-5.title: Correction to: How much to pay for tax certainty? The role of advance tax rulings for risky investment under loss offset and tax uncertainty
10.1007/s10797-026-09965-5.title_zh: 更正：为税收确定性支付多少？损失抵补与税收不确定性下预约定价安排对风险投资的作用

10.1007/s10797-026-09969-1.abstract: This study examines the causal impact of tax education on property tax compliance in Benin. Utilizing a randomized controlled trial, two distinct interventions—deterrence and persuasion—were implemented to evaluate their effectiveness. The findings indicate that both approaches significantly and positively influence taxpayer behavior compared to those who received no intervention. However, the deterrence treatment demonstrates a stronger causal effect than the persuasion approach. A formal Clogg-Paternoster test confirms that the difference between the two treatments is not statistically significant at conventional levels. Therefore, assignments were made with the same intensity. Moreover, taxpayers exposed to deterrence measures paid, on average, 30.19% more than those in the control group, representing an additional 9,588 XOF. A cost-effectiveness analysis suggests that the deterrence-based intervention yields higher returns per unit of implementation cost compared to the persuasion approach.
10.1007/s10797-026-09969-1.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了税收教育对贝宁房产税遵从度的因果影响。通过随机对照试验，实施了两项不同的干预措施——威慑与劝导——以评估其有效性。结果表明，与未接受任何干预的对照组相比，这两种方法均显著且积极地影响了纳税人的行为。然而，威慑处理显示出比劝导方法更强的因果效应。正式的Clogg-Paternoster检验确认，在常规显著性水平下，两种处理之间的差异在统计上并不显著。因此，任务分配以相同强度进行。此外，接触威慑措施的纳税人平均比对照组多支付30.19%，相当于额外缴纳9，588西非法郎。成本效益分析表明，基于威慑的干预措施每单位实施成本产生的回报高于劝导方法。
10.1007/s10797-026-09969-1.title: Incentives versus deterrent measures and tax compliance of landowners in Benin: a randomized controlled trial approach
10.1007/s10797-026-09969-1.title_zh: 激励与威慑措施对贝宁土地所有者税收遵从的影响：一项随机对照试验研究

10.1007/s10797-026-09971-7.abstract: This paper utilizes detailed transaction-destination-level data from Finland for years 2013-2019 to examine how multinational enterprises adjust transfer prices to shift profit from high tax countries to low tax countries. Employing a triple difference strategy that leverages variations in corporate income tax rates and affiliate ownership, I provide robust evidence that multinational enterprises underprice exports to low tax destinations. Additionally, my findings suggest that transfer pricing serves as a complementary channel of profit shifting, as firms more prone to other profit shifting mechanisms also underprice their exports more. Furthermore, I provide evidence that firms with more affiliates as well as firms with tax haven affiliates transfer misprice more. My results also suggest asymmetries: while there is clear evidence of transfer mispricing in exports to low tax destinations, there is no consistent evidence of transfer mispricing in imports.
10.1007/s10797-026-09971-7.abstract_zh: 本文利用芬兰2013-2019年间详细的交易目的地层面数据，考察跨国企业如何调整转让定价以将利润从高税国家转移至低税国家。通过采用三重差分策略，利用企业所得税税率及关联企业所有权的差异，我提供了有力证据表明跨国企业对低税目的地的出口存在定价偏低现象。此外，研究结果显示，转让定价作为利润转移的补充渠道，那些更倾向于采用其他利润转移机制的企业，其出口定价偏低程度也更大。进一步地，我证明拥有更多关联企业以及设有避税天堂关联企业的公司，其转让定价偏差更为显著。研究结果还揭示了不对称性：尽管对低税目的地的出口存在明确的转让定价偏差证据，但在进口方面并未发现一致的转让定价偏差证据。
10.1007/s10797-026-09971-7.title: Exploring heterogeneity and asymmetries in transfer pricing: evidence from Finland
10.1007/s10797-026-09971-7.title_zh: 探索转让定价中的异质性与非对称性：来自芬兰的证据

10.1007/s10797-026-09973-5.abstract: This paper examines whether the energy transition supports tax revenue mobilization in developing countries. Using a newly constructed Multidimensional Energy Development Index and a panel of 52 developing economies over the period 2000–2019, we analyze the relationship between the energy transition and tax revenue aggregates—including total, direct, indirect, and trade taxes—as well as fiscal effort. Results show a statistically significant and economically meaningful positive relationship between the energy transition and all tax revenue components. Further analysis suggests that this relationship operates through improved energy access, higher economic activity, productivity gains, and enhanced human development. These findings challenge concerns about potential fiscal burdens associated with the energy transition, indicating that green energy–oriented policies can strengthen fiscal sustainability in low- and middle-income countries and support inclusive energy and environmental tax reforms. Finally, we propose policy recommendations aimed at helping decision-makers in these countries reconcile environmental and budgetary challenges.
10.1007/s10797-026-09973-5.abstract_zh: 本文考察能源转型是否有助于发展中国家调动税收收入。利用新构建的多维能源发展指数以及2000年至2019年间52个发展中经济体的面板数据，我们分析了能源转型与税收收入总量——包括总税收、直接税、间接税和贸易税——以及财政努力之间的关系。结果显示，能源转型与所有税收收入组成部分之间存在统计上显著且经济意义重大的正相关关系。进一步分析表明，这种关系通过改善能源获取、提高经济活动水平、提升生产率以及促进人类发展来实现。这些发现对能源转型可能带来财政负担的担忧提出了质疑，表明绿色能源导向型政策能够增强低收入和中等收入国家的财政可持续性，并支持包容性的能源与环境税收改革。最后，我们提出政策建议，旨在帮助这些国家的决策者协调环境与预算挑战。
10.1007/s10797-026-09973-5.title: Can energy transition strengthen tax revenue mobilization in developing countries? Empirical evidence and policy implications
10.1007/s10797-026-09973-5.title_zh: 能源转型能否增强发展中国家的税收动员？实证证据与政策启示

10.1007/s10797-026-09974-4.abstract: This paper examines how technological advancements in mobility—specifically, the rise of e-commerce—alter the landscape of tax competition. Previous studies typically present a monotonic relationship in which regions with larger populations impose higher tax rates. However, in reality, this relationship does not always hold. We develop a model of commodity tax competition with e-commerce and show that local tax rates can have a non-monotonic relationship with regional populations. To be more precise, when online shopping is available, the relationship between tax rates and population sizes follows a U-shaped curve: the region with the moderate population has the lowest tax rate, while areas with small or large populations set higher tax rates. This U-shaped relationship arises from the dual effects of e-commerce: changing tax bases and intensifying tax competition. This result holds regardless of how widespread e-commerce becomes, illustrating how the availability of virtual mobility reshapes traditional spatial competition.
10.1007/s10797-026-09974-4.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了移动性技术进步——具体而言，即电子商务的兴起——如何改变税收竞争的格局。以往研究通常呈现一种单调关系，即人口较多的地区设定较高的税率。然而，现实中这种关系并不总是成立。我们构建了一个包含电子商务的商品税收竞争模型，并表明地方税率与地区人口之间可能存在非单调关系。更确切地说，当在线购物可用时，税率与人口规模之间的关系呈U形曲线：人口适中的地区税率最低，而人口较少或较多的地区则设定较高的税率。这种U形关系源于电子商务的双重效应：改变税基和加剧税收竞争。无论电子商务普及程度如何，这一结果均成立，从而展示了虚拟移动性的可得性如何重塑传统空间竞争。
10.1007/s10797-026-09974-4.title: E-commerce Reshapes Tax Competition: U-shaped Tax Rates with Respect to Populations
10.1007/s10797-026-09974-4.title_zh: 电子商务重塑税收竞争：人口规模与税率呈U型关系

10.1007/s10797-026-09975-3.abstract: The existing literature shows that women are generally more likely than men to pay taxes. However, there is less consensus on gendered responses to interventions designed to boost compliance among non-payers, and the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. In this study, we exploit a field experiment designed to increase property tax compliance to investigate this gender disparity. Because female- and male-led households differ along many dimensions, including preferences, household structure, and economic resources, we interpret the female–male contrast as the joint product of these channels rather than the effect of gender alone. Within this framing, the cross-sectional baseline gap in compliance is descriptive, while the within-gender treatment effects of the experimental messages are causally identified by random assignment. Our findings confirm that taxpayers in female-led households are more diligent in paying taxes than those in male-led households at baseline. Notably, while receiving a deterrence letter encourages women to pay earlier, it does not increase their overall compliance; men, in contrast, show a marked improvement in overall compliance upon receiving the same letter. We also find that the size of the tax bill influences women’s compliance behavior (the likelihood of payment after treatment rises significantly for smaller tax bills) but has no similar effect on men. Survey data targeted at the same population suggest that, although women may be more motivated to pay (they perceive higher enforcement risk and exhibit higher tax morale) they also face tighter liquidity constraints, lower and less stable income, and a stronger perception that the tax is excessive. These patterns are consistent with a simple analytical model that links compliance to tax morale, risk aversion, and budget constraints, and in which liquidity-constrained taxpayers remain at a corner solution unresponsive to enforcement messages. The findings highlight how tax policies and enforcement procedures can exacerbate post-tax income inequality between genders, particularly in low-enforcement contexts where the tax base is weakly correlated with current income.
10.1007/s10797-026-09975-3.abstract_zh: 现有文献表明，女性通常比男性更倾向于纳税。然而，关于旨在提高未缴税者合规性的干预措施是否存在性别差异反应，学界尚未达成共识，其潜在机制仍不明确。本研究利用一项旨在提高房产税合规性的实地实验，探究这一性别差异。由于女性主导家庭与男性主导家庭在偏好、家庭结构及经济资源等多个维度存在差异，我们将男女对比解读为这些渠道共同作用的结果，而非单纯性别效应。在此框架下，横截面基线合规差距属于描述性分析，而实验信息在性别内部的处理效应则通过随机分配实现因果识别。研究结果证实，在基线水平上，女性主导家庭的纳税人比男性主导家庭更勤于纳税。值得注意的是，虽然收到威慑信函会促使女性提前缴税，但并未提高其整体合规率；而男性在收到相同信函后，整体合规率显著提升。我们还发现，税额大小影响女性的合规行为（小额税单处理后支付概率显著上升），但对男性无类似效应。针对同一人群的调查数据表明，尽管女性可能更有纳税动机（她们感知到更高的执法风险并表现出更强的纳税道德），但同时也面临更紧的流动性约束、更低且不稳定的收入，以及更强烈的税负过重感知。这些模式与一个将合规性关联至纳税道德、风险规避及预算约束的简单分析模型一致，在该模型中，受流动性约束的纳税人处于角点解状态，对执法信息无反应。研究结果凸显了税收政策与执法程序如何加剧性别间的税后收入不平等，尤其是在税基与当前收入弱相关的低执法环境中。
10.1007/s10797-026-09975-3.title: Willing but unable to pay? Gender, preferences, resources, and tax compliance
10.1007/s10797-026-09975-3.title_zh: 愿意但无力支付？性别、偏好、资源与税收遵从

10.1007/s10797-026-09976-2.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We propose a novel measure of fiscal policy divergence based on public budget data. First, we quantify policy similarity across municipalities based on the cosine similarity of their budget allocations, showing strong correlations with geographic proximity and differences in socio-demographic characteristics. Next, we predict budget similarity out-of-sample using a flexible machine-learning model trained on pairwise differences in local characteristics, defining fiscal divergence as the municipality-year average absolute prediction error. In an empirical application to 8000 Italian municipalities (2000–2015), we show that electoral-cycle patterns are concentrated on the expenditure side of the budget: expenditure divergence is lower in pre-electoral years than in election years, whereas revenue divergence follows a different and less stable pattern.</jats:p>
10.1007/s10797-026-09976-2.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于公共预算数据的财政政策分歧新测度方法。首先，我们利用各市预算分配的余弦相似度量化政策相似性，发现其与地理邻近性及社会人口特征差异存在强相关性。其次，通过基于地方特征成对差异训练的灵活机器学习模型，对样本外预算相似性进行预测，并将财政分歧定义为市-年层面绝对预测误差的平均值。在对意大利8000个市镇（2000-2015年）的实证分析中，我们发现选举周期模式集中于预算支出端：选举前年份的支出分歧低于选举年份，而收入分歧则呈现不同且较不稳定的模式。
10.1007/s10797-026-09976-2.title: Fiscal policy divergence

10.1007/s10797-026-09977-1.abstract: This paper examines whether the Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax reduces bank profitability and regulatory capital, and for which banks the effects are strongest. We use a quarterly exposure-based difference-in-differences design around 2024Q1, where treatment intensity is defined by pre-2024 low-tax exposure among in-scope banks. The analysis uses a quarterly bank-level panel for 2014–2024 and exploits predetermined cross-sectional heterogeneity in low-tax exposure while controlling for bank and quarter fixed effects. The headline estimates show that post-2024 profitability and capital buffers decline more for high-exposure banks: profit after tax falls by about 2.2 basis points of assets per quarter and Tier 1 buffers by about 0.09 percentage points in the baseline specification. Higher low-tax exposure is not interpreted as vulnerability per se. The downside channel is concentrated where high pre-reform low-tax exposure coincides with limited initial capital headroom: event-study, placebo, matched-sample, and split-sample evidence all point to larger post-2024 capital-buffer compression for thin-buffer banks. Overall, the results indicate modest average effects but meaningful tail risk for banks that combine high minimum-tax exposure with thin initial capital buffers.
10.1007/s10797-026-09977-1.abstract_zh: 本文考察了支柱二全球最低税是否降低了银行盈利能力和监管资本，以及哪些银行受到的影响最为显著。我们采用基于季度暴露水平的双重差分设计，以2024年第一季度为政策节点，将受覆盖银行在2024年前的低税暴露程度定义为处理强度。分析基于2014-2024年银行层面季度面板数据，利用预先确定的低税暴露截面异质性，同时控制银行和季度固定效应。主要估计结果显示，2024年后高暴露银行的盈利能力和资本缓冲下降幅度更大：在基准设定中，税后利润每季度下降约2.2个基点（以资产计），一级资本缓冲下降约0.09个百分点。较高的低税暴露本身并不被解读为脆弱性。其负面传导渠道集中于改革前低税暴露较高且初始资本缓冲空间有限的银行：事件研究、安慰剂检验、匹配样本和分样本证据均表明，资本缓冲薄弱的银行在2024年后资本缓冲压缩幅度更大。总体而言，研究结果表明平均效应温和，但对于初始资本缓冲薄弱且面临较高最低税暴露的银行而言，存在显著的尾部风险。
10.1007/s10797-026-09977-1.title: Bank capital and the minimum corporate tax
10.1007/s10797-026-09977-1.title_zh: 银行资本与最低企业税

10.1007/s10797-026-09978-0.abstract: As income rises, the risk of disability in old age declines, while life expectancy increases. These correlations strengthen the case for public long-term care (LTC) insurance over public pension systems. However, this perspective shifts when considering family solidarity—specifically, the informal care provided by spouses and children to elderly relatives. When viewed through the lens of altruistic caregiving motives, the argument for social LTC insurance becomes more nuanced. The interplay between formal and informal care is a key factor in shaping optimal policy. In this paper, we demonstrate that when family members reliably provide informal care, the design of a comprehensive public LTC system depends on the existence of a private insurance and on the degree of substitutability between informal and formal care.
10.1007/s10797-026-09978-0.abstract_zh: 随着收入水平的提升，老年残疾风险趋于下降，而预期寿命则相应延长。这些关联性强化了公共长期护理保险相较于公共养老金体系的优势。然而，当考虑到家庭团结——特别是配偶及子女对老年亲属的非正式照护时，这一视角便有所转变。从利他主义照护动机的角度审视，社会长期护理保险的论证变得更为复杂。正式与非正式照护之间的相互作用，是塑造最优政策的关键因素。本文证明，在家庭成员可靠提供非正式照护的前提下，全面公共长期护理体系的设计取决于私人保险的存在与否，以及非正式照护与正式照护之间的可替代程度。
10.1007/s10797-026-09978-0.title: Public pensions and LTC insurance with family solidarity
10.1007/s10797-026-09978-0.title_zh: 家庭团结视角下的公共养老金与长期护理保险

10.1007/s10797-026-09979-z.abstract: I take a simple model of linear taxation of labour income and append to it the possibility that the chosen tax schedule triggers conflict in society. I demonstrate theoretically that, under certain assumptions, the resulting set of efficient tax schedules is a proper subset of the set of efficient tax schedules in a standard model without the possibility of conflict. Then, I show in a numerical example that the former set can be much smaller than the latter.
10.1007/s10797-026-09979-z.abstract_zh: 我采用一个简单的劳动收入线性税收模型，并加入所选税收方案可能引发社会冲突的可能性。理论上证明，在特定假设下，由此产生的有效税收方案集合是标准模型中无冲突可能性下有效税收方案集合的一个真子集。随后，通过数值示例展示，前者集合可能远小于后者。
10.1007/s10797-026-09979-z.title: Efficient taxation of labour income under the threat of conflict
10.1007/s10797-026-09979-z.title_zh: 冲突威胁下的劳动收入有效课税

10.1007/s10797-026-09980-6.abstract: Challenging long-standing norms is how we, as academics studying matters of taxation, make progress: by consuming, or in some cases, replicating prior studies, and reaffirming—or contradicting—their results. Otherwise our science stagnates and our voices become irrelevant to those in government and the business world who form the economic policies we track and hope to influence. Over the course of seven years attempting to correct a simple misunderstanding of an accounting standard, my colleague and I repeatedly demonstrated how an error in measuring income by jurisdiction had influenced the entire debate about the profit-shifting behavior of multinational firms and their use of tax havens. Through our lengthy and ultimately, we believe, successful challenge to the status quo, we learned several important lessons about academic research as a profession, concerning both the role of the community and the role that each individual in the system plays in the pursuit of truth and insight. Throughout the process, our goal was to enact productive change, not to provoke an argument. In that light, we believe our challenge to the status quo will have two lasting impacts: First, when using datasets that attempt to measure the income by jurisdiction of any multinational firm, researchers will now pay more attention to the underlying accounting methods used in the collection of the data. Second, our time-consuming and oftentimes frustrating experience reveals the importance of cross-disciplinary research and better communication between academic accountants and economists.
10.1007/s10797-026-09980-6.abstract_zh: 挑战长期存在的规范，正是我们这些研究税收问题的学者取得进步的方式：通过消化吸收，或在某些情况下复制先前的研究，并重申或反驳其结论。否则，我们的科学将停滞不前，我们的声音对政府及商界中那些制定我们追踪并希望影响的经济政策的人而言，将变得无关紧要。在长达七年的时间里，为了纠正一个对会计准则的简单误解，我和同事反复证明了按司法管辖区衡量收入的一个错误如何影响了关于跨国公司利润转移行为及其利用避税天堂的整个辩论。通过我们漫长且最终我们认为成功地挑战现状的过程，我们学到了关于学术研究这一职业的几个重要教训，涉及社群的作用以及体系中每个个体在追求真理与洞察中所扮演的角色。在整个过程中，我们的目标是推动建设性的变革，而非挑起争端。基于此，我们相信我们对现状的挑战将产生两个持久影响：第一，当使用试图衡量任何跨国公司按司法管辖区收入的数据库时，研究人员现在将更加关注数据收集中所采用的底层会计方法。第二，我们耗时且常常令人沮丧的经历揭示了跨学科研究以及学术会计师与经济学家之间更好沟通的重要性。
10.1007/s10797-026-09980-6.title: Shaking giants: tax accounting, profit shifting, and the slow art of challenging the status quo
10.1007/s10797-026-09980-6.title_zh: 撼动巨头：税务会计、利润转移与挑战现状的缓慢艺术

10.1007/s10797-026-09981-5.abstract: We study optimal nonlinear income taxation when productivity depends negatively on labor supply (labor-supply-dependent productivity, LSDP). Relative to a benchmark model with fixed productivities, we find that LSDP leads to higher optimal marginal tax rates, especially for higher-income individuals, and greater redistribution. The key mechanism is that, under LSDP, marginal taxation becomes a more effective screening instrument.
10.1007/s10797-026-09981-5.abstract_zh: 本文研究了当生产率与劳动供给呈负相关（即劳动供给依赖型生产率，LSDP）时的最优非线性所得税问题。与生产率固定的基准模型相比，我们发现LSDP会导致更高的最优边际税率，尤其是对高收入群体而言，并带来更强的再分配效应。其关键机制在于，在LSDP条件下，边际税收成为一种更有效的筛选工具。
10.1007/s10797-026-09981-5.title: Optimal redistribution with labor supply dependent productivity
10.1007/s10797-026-09981-5.title_zh: 劳动供给依赖型生产率下的最优再分配

10.1007/s10797-026-09982-4.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The digitalisation of tax payments is a growing policy priority in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in Africa, where revenue mobilisation remains a challenge. This study examines the impact of digital tax payments on compliance, leveraging a 2021 zero-cash-handling mandate in Eswatini. Using administrative tax data, we evaluate two key questions: (i) how voluntary adoption of digital payments affects compliance and (ii) the impact of mandating digital tax payments. We employ a staggered difference-in-differences (DiD) approach for voluntary adoption and a treatment-intensity DiD strategy to assess the mandate’s effects. Voluntary adoption significantly improves compliance, reducing late payments by 19–20% points (25–30 per cent reduction) and increasing payment accuracy (paying the tax liability in full) by 5.6% points (20 per cent), but for strictly digital payments only. Effects on tax amounts paid are less consistent, but the fully controlled broad-digital specification implies an increase of approximately 32%. The mandate, by contrast, eliminated cash payments and is associated with an approximately 17% increase in tax paid on average. While companies pay more taxes, they also worsen their payment accuracy, while individuals are more likely to pay their tax liabilities in full after adoption. These findings highlight distinct compliance patterns between voluntary adopters and those compelled by enforcement. The results underscore the importance of designing digital tax policies that account for taxpayer heterogeneity and behavioural responses to maximise compliance gains.</jats:p>
10.1007/s10797-026-09982-4.abstract_zh: 税收数字化是低收入和中等收入国家日益重要的政策优先事项，尤其是在收入动员仍面临挑战的非洲。本研究利用斯威士兰2021年实施的零现金处理指令，考察数字税务支付对合规行为的影响。通过行政税收数据，我们评估两个关键问题：（i）自愿采用数字支付如何影响合规性；（ii）强制推行数字税务支付的影响。我们采用交错双重差分法分析自愿采用行为，并运用处理强度双重差分策略评估强制指令的效果。自愿采用显著改善合规性：严格数字支付方式使逾期付款减少19-20个百分点（降幅25-30%），全额缴纳税款准确率提高5.6个百分点（增幅20%）。但对纳税金额的影响一致性较弱，全面控制的广义数字支付模型显示增幅约为32%。相比之下，强制指令完全消除了现金支付，平均纳税额增加约17%。企业虽缴纳更多税款，但支付准确率下降；而个人在采用后更可能全额缴纳税款。这些发现揭示了自愿采用者与强制执行者之间的差异化合规模式。研究结果强调，设计数字税务政策需考虑纳税人异质性和行为反应，以最大化合规收益。
10.1007/s10797-026-09982-4.title: Cashless tax systems: voluntary vs. mandated digital payments in Eswatini
10.1007/s10797-026-09982-4.title_zh: 无现金税收系统：斯威士兰自愿与强制数字支付的比较

10.1007/s10797-026-09983-3.title: How the U.S. child tax credit has benefited children over time: historical trends in eligibility, poverty, and income inequality
10.1007/s10797-026-09983-3.title_zh: 美国儿童税收抵免如何长期惠及儿童：资格、贫困与收入不平等的历史趋势

10.1007/s10797-026-09984-2.abstract: The literature on the profit-shifting activities and strategies of multinational enterprises (MNEs) has focused predominantly on developed economies. The experience of developing countries may differ, however, because they often employ preferential tax regimes which could substantially alter MNEs’ profit-shifting incentives. This paper studies MNEs of China, the largest developing country, and examines an implicit profit-shifting strategy, risk shifting, while explicitly incorporating China’s preferential tax policies into the empirical analysis. As a common practice in transfer pricing planning, MNEs shift profits to lower-tax jurisdictions by reallocating the operating risk embedded in intra-firm transactions. We find that when the tax rate differential between China and a foreign country increases by 10%, the risk remaining in the Chinese parent firms declines by 10% from the mean value. In addition, risk shifting into China is more pronounced than risk shifting out of China, which highlights the important role of preferential tax policies of China. The results are robust to alternative risk proxies including strategic risk and to alternative approaches to risk measurement. In particular, the estimated effects are stronger among firms with higher levels of intangible assets, inventory, or accounts receivable, where R&D risk, market risk, inventory risk, and credit risk are more likely to be salient.
10.1007/s10797-026-09984-2.abstract_zh: 关于跨国企业利润转移活动与策略的研究文献主要聚焦于发达经济体。然而，发展中国家的经验可能有所不同，因为它们常采用优惠税制，这可能会显著改变跨国企业的利润转移动机。本文以最大发展中国家中国的跨国企业为研究对象，在实证分析中明确纳入中国优惠税收政策，考察一种隐性利润转移策略——风险转移。作为转让定价规划中的常见做法，跨国企业通过重新分配公司内部交易中的经营风险，将利润转移至低税率管辖区。研究发现，当中国与外国之间的税率差异每增加10%，中国母公司留存的风险较均值下降10%。此外，风险向中国转移的效应强于风险从中国转出的效应，这凸显了中国优惠税收政策的重要作用。该结果在使用战略风险等替代风险指标及不同风险测量方法时依然稳健。特别地，在无形资产、存货或应收账款水平较高的企业中，研发风险、市场风险、存货风险及信用风险更易凸显，其估计效应更为显著。
10.1007/s10797-026-09984-2.title: Risk shifting of Chinese multinational enterprises
10.1007/s10797-026-09984-2.title_zh: 中国跨国企业的风险转移

10.1007/s10797-026-09985-1.abstract: In 2012, Kansas exempted pass-through business income from the state individual income tax. We examine the reform’s causal effect on entrepreneurial labor supply using a difference-in-differences design with Current Population Survey and American Community Survey microdata, modeling selection into self-employment with a Heckman selection model. The reform reduced weekly hours among the self-employed in the short run, with the response concentrated among the unincorporated self-employed, the group most directly exposed to the exemption. In our preferred selection-corrected estimates, the reform reduced annual labor supply among unincorporated self-employed workers by roughly 19 to 89 hours, depending on the dataset. The effect attenuates and does not persist. These findings suggest that the Kansas reform did not increase entrepreneurial effort on the intensive margin, despite its stated goal of promoting business activity. 10.1007/s10797-026-09985-1.abstract_zh: 2012年，堪萨斯州将穿透型企业收入从州个人所得税中豁免。我们利用当前人口调查和美国社区调查的微观数据，采用双重差分法并结合赫克曼选择模型对自雇就业的选择进行建模，考察了该改革对创业劳动供给的因果效应。改革短期内减少了自雇者的每周工作时间，且这一反应主要集中在直接受豁免影响的非公司制自雇群体中。在我们偏好的经选择校正的估计中，改革使非公司制自雇工人的年劳动供给减少了约19至89小时，具体取决于所使用的数据集。该效应随时间减弱且未持续存在。这些发现表明，尽管堪萨斯州改革旨在促进商业活动，但并未在集约边际上增加创业努力。这是订阅内容的预览，请通过机构登录以查看访问权限。
10.1007/s10797-026-09985-1.title: The effect of the Kansas tax reform on self-employment hours worked
10.1007/s10797-026-09985-1.title_zh: 堪萨斯州税制改革对自雇工时的影响

10.1007/s10797-026-09986-0.abstract: This paper examines whether standardized system specifications improve the fiscal efficiency of local governments. Although ICT has been widely promoted through e-government initiatives to improve government operations, the effectiveness of system standardization has received limited attention. We study Japan’s Regional Information Platform (RIP), a standardized system specification that facilitates interoperability across municipal administrative systems and weakens vendor lock-in. Building on a model of municipal procurement under switching costs, we show that standardization reduces expenditure through two channels: weakened vendor lock-in that lowers system costs, and improved cross-departmental interoperability that reduces labor input. Using variation in RIP adoption across Japanese municipalities, we estimate difference-in-differences models and find that RIP adoption substantially reduces per capita total expenditure. These findings suggest that e-government outcomes depend not only on ICT adoption itself but also on whether administrative systems are standardized and interoperable.
10.1007/s10797-026-09986-0.abstract_zh: 本文考察了标准化系统规范是否能够提升地方政府的财政效率。尽管信息通信技术（ICT）已通过电子政务倡议被广泛推广以改善政府运作，但系统标准化的有效性却鲜少受到关注。我们研究了日本的区域信息平台（RIP），这是一种标准化系统规范，旨在促进市政行政系统间的互操作性并削弱供应商锁定效应。基于一个考虑转换成本的市政采购模型，我们证明标准化通过两条渠道降低支出：一是削弱供应商锁定从而降低系统成本，二是改善跨部门互操作性从而减少劳动投入。利用日本各市町村RIP采纳情况的差异，我们估计了双重差分模型，发现RIP采纳显著降低了人均总支出。这些研究结果表明，电子政务的成效不仅取决于ICT采纳本身，还取决于行政系统是否标准化且具备互操作性。
10.1007/s10797-026-09986-0.title: Financial impacts of standardized system specifications: evidence from japanese municipalities
10.1007/s10797-026-09986-0.title_zh: 标准化系统规范对财政的影响：来自日本地方政府的证据

10.1007/s10797-026-09987-z.abstract: Motivated by the introduction of digital services taxes (DSTs) in several European countries and the widespread use of revenue-based taxes where profit taxation is imperfect, this paper studies whether targeted output or commodity taxes can serve as surrogate profit taxes when firms avoid corporate taxation – such as by shifting profits to low-tax jurisdictions. The answer is a qualified yes. Output taxation of tax-avoiding firms is optimal when the resulting reduction in output mitigates tax avoidance. I derive an augmented inverse-elasticity rule showing that the optimal output tax decreases with the demand elasticity (as in the classic Ramsey rule) but increases with the output elasticity of profit shifting and the degree of foreign firm ownership. When nonlinear labor income taxation is available, zero output taxation arises only under restrictive ownership conditions – namely, identical ownership shares across household types and full domestic ownership of firms – which are unlikely to hold in practice, particularly in open European economies. In these cases, the optimal tax system combines distortionary profit taxes with non-uniform output taxes. Finally, I establish a complementarity theorem: Whenever the optimal tax system includes a distortionary profit tax, output taxes are also part of the optimal policy mix. These results provide a welfare-based perspective on the role of DSTs as second-best instruments in environments characterized by profit shifting and international ownership.
10.1007/s10797-026-09987-z.abstract_zh: 受欧洲多国引入数字服务税（DSTs）以及利润税不完善环境下普遍采用基于收入的税收的启发，本文研究当企业规避公司税——例如通过将利润转移至低税率辖区——时，针对性的产出税或商品税能否作为利润税的替代工具。答案是有限度的肯定。当对避税企业征收产出税能通过减少产出而缓解避税行为时，此类税收即为最优。我推导出一个增强的逆弹性法则，表明最优产出税随需求弹性下降（如同经典拉姆齐法则），但随利润转移的产出弹性及外国企业所有权程度上升而增加。当非线性劳动所得税可用时，零产出税仅在严格的所有权条件下成立——即各家庭类型间所有权份额相同且企业完全由国内所有——这些条件在实践中难以满足，尤其在开放的欧洲经济体中。在这些情况下，最优税收体系结合了扭曲性利润税与非统一的产出税。最后，我确立了一个互补性定理：只要最优税收体系包含扭曲性利润税，产出税也必然是最优政策组合的一部分。这些结果为DSTs在利润转移和国际所有权环境中的次优工具角色提供了基于福利的视角。
10.1007/s10797-026-09987-z.title: When are digital services taxes optimal? Output taxes and profit shifting
10.1007/s10797-026-09987-z.title_zh: 数字服务税何时最优？产出税与利润转移

10.1007/s10797-026-09988-y.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Richard Musgrave et al.’s “Distribution of Tax Payments by Income Groups” (1951) provided the first postwar estimates of the distribution of the fiscal burden, concluding the tax system was not as progressive as statutory rates suggested. Drawing from original archival material, we reconstruct the intellectual context of Musgrave’s study, the methodological debates it gave rise to, and assess its legacy in public finance. The study’s legacy is examined through the rise of econometric estimation, applied general equilibrium modeling, and microdata-based approaches, as well as its influence on policy institutions in the USA and abroad. Despite major advances in data and modeling, we argue that key issues raised by Musgrave—particularly the definition of the income basis and the incidence of the corporate income tax—remain unresolved. The enduring lack of consensus on a uniquely best method highlights both the empirical and normative challenges at the heart of distributional analysis and explains the study’s continued relevance in contemporary debates on taxation and income inequality.</jats:p>
10.1007/s10797-026-09988-y.abstract_zh: 理查德·马斯格雷夫等人于1951年发表的《按收入群体划分的税收负担分配》提供了战后首批财政负担分配的估算，结论表明税收制度并未如法定税率所显示的那样具有累进性。基于原始档案材料，我们重构了马斯格雷夫研究的学术背景、由此引发的方法论争论，并评估了其在公共财政领域的遗产。通过计量经济学估计、应用一般均衡模型以及基于微观数据的方法的兴起，并结合该研究对美国及海外政策机构的影响，我们审视了这一遗产。尽管数据与模型取得了重大进展，但我们认为马斯格雷夫提出的关键问题——尤其是收入基础的定义以及公司所得税的归宿——仍未得到解决。对于唯一最佳方法长期缺乏共识，凸显了分配分析核心中的经验与规范挑战，并解释了该研究在当代税收与收入不平等辩论中持续的相关性。
10.1007/s10797-026-09988-y.title: On the 75th anniversary of Musgrave’s distribution of tax payments by income groups
10.1007/s10797-026-09988-y.title_zh: 穆斯卡夫按收入群体划分税收负担分配理论75周年纪念

10.1007/s10797-026-09989-x.abstract: This paper empirically investigates the causal effect of subsidies on reshoring in Taiwan. The Taiwanese government has provided subsidies to Taiwanese firms to encourage them to relocate their factories from China back to Taiwan. Using the matched data between firm-level business information and the list of subsidy recipients from 2016 to 2023, we investigate how subsidy recipients change their behavior in both China and Taiwan. To mitigate the bias introduced by the selection mechanism in this subsidy, we employ the doubly robust difference-in-differences method. As a result, we found that this subsidy program has not induced reshoring or relocation of export base from China to Taiwan. Although some recipients expanded their production facilities and increased domestic sales, these changes were not significant enough to increase production and employment in Taiwan. These findings suggest that financial incentives alone are insufficient to offset the structural advantages of established production networks in China.
