10.1007/s10797-026-09989-x.abstract_zh: 本文实证研究了补贴对台湾地区企业回迁的因果效应。台湾当局向本地企业提供补贴，鼓励其将工厂从中国大陆迁回台湾。通过匹配2016至2023年间企业层面商业信息与补贴接收方名单的数据，我们考察了补贴接收方在中国大陆和台湾地区的行为变化。为缓解该补贴选择机制带来的偏误，我们采用双重稳健双重差分法。结果表明，该补贴计划并未促使企业从中国大陆向台湾回迁或转移出口基地。尽管部分受补贴企业扩大了生产设施并增加了内销，但这些变化尚不足以显著提升台湾地区的生产与就业。这些发现表明，仅凭财政激励不足以抵消中国大陆成熟生产网络的结构性优势。
10.1007/s10797-026-09989-x.title: Subsidies for reshoring: evidence from Taiwan
10.1007/s10797-026-09989-x.title_zh: 回流补贴：来自台湾的证据

10.1007/s10797-026-09990-4.abstract: Value-added tax (VAT) is the largest source of tax revenue for many developing country governments, and sales-based registration thresholds are a ubiquitous design feature. Yet, empirical evidence on the mechanisms through which these thresholds alter firm behaviour remains scarce. Using administrative tax data from West Bengal in India, we study the behavioural responses of firms to a turnover threshold for compulsory VAT registration. By exploiting variation in the tax discontinuity at the registration threshold across firms and over time, we show that tax incentives, rather than compliance costs, drive the observed bunching of firms below the threshold, and their associated revealed preference for a simplified tax scheme. The limited role for VAT compliance costs relative to a simplified tax regime has important implications for the design of small business taxation and for the optimal level of VAT registration thresholds.
10.1007/s10797-026-09990-4.abstract_zh: 增值税（VAT）是许多发展中国家政府最大的税收来源，而基于销售额的注册门槛是一种普遍存在的设计特征。然而，关于这些门槛如何改变企业行为的实证证据仍然稀缺。利用印度西孟加拉邦的行政税收数据，我们研究了企业对强制性增值税注册营业额门槛的行为反应。通过利用注册门槛处税收不连续性在企业间及时间上的变化，我们表明，是税收激励而非合规成本，驱动了观察到的企业聚集于门槛以下的现象，以及它们对简化税制的显性偏好。相较于简化税制，增值税合规成本的作用有限，这对小企业税收设计及增值税注册门槛的最优水平具有重要启示。
10.1007/s10797-026-09990-4.title: Tax incentives, compliance costs, and VAT registration: evidence from India
10.1007/s10797-026-09990-4.title_zh: 税收激励、合规成本与增值税登记：来自印度的证据

10.1007/s10797-026-09991-3.abstract: This research consolidates three views of property tax incidence into a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model and analyzes the effects of property tax shocks on housing markets. We show that the elasticity of substitution between residential housing (owner-occupied) and investment housing (non-owner-occupied) plays an important role for the incidence of the property tax. When applying the model to Taiwan’s housing tax reform, the results indicate that the implementation of a hoarding tax on investment housing fails to curb the investment housing price; the tax effect is passed on to the residential housing price when investment housing and residential housing are considered as complements. A tax on residential housing can effectively moderate residential housing consumption and residential housing prices.
10.1007/s10797-026-09991-3.abstract_zh: 本研究将财产税归宿的三种观点整合至动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型中，并分析了财产税冲击对住房市场的影响。研究表明，自住型住房与投资型住房（非自住型）之间的替代弹性在财产税归宿中发挥关键作用。将该模型应用于台湾地区住房税制改革时，结果显示：对投资型住房征收囤房税未能有效抑制其价格；当投资型住房与自住型住房被视为互补品时，税收效应会转嫁至自住型住房价格。对自住型住房征税则可有效调节自住型住房消费及其价格水平。
10.1007/s10797-026-09991-3.title: Property tax incidence and housing market in Taiwan
10.1007/s10797-026-09991-3.title_zh: 台湾房产税归宿与住房市场

10.1007/s10797-026-09992-2.abstract: This paper examines the interaction between labor-market institutions and commodity tax-base design in an open economy with imperfect competition. We develop a two-country Cournot model in which a domestic firm bargains over wages with a monopoly labor union, while the foreign firm operates under a competitive labor market. Governments choose commodity tax rates under either the destination or the origin principle. We show that the welfare effects of unionization are systematically tax-base dependent. Under the destination principle, consumption-based taxation does not correct the production distortion induced by union wage bargaining, placing the unionized country at a disadvantage. Under the origin principle, production-based taxation directly interacts with union-induced cost distortions, yielding regime-specific welfare outcomes that depend on trade costs and the competitive wage. The analysis highlights tax-base design as a key institutional margin shaping strategic interaction and welfare in unionized oligopolies.
10.1007/s10797-026-09992-2.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在不完全竞争的开放经济中，劳动力市场制度与商品税基设计之间的相互作用。我们构建了一个两国古诺模型，其中国内企业与垄断工会进行工资谈判，而外国企业则在竞争性劳动力市场下运营。各国政府在目的地原则或原产地原则下选择商品税率。研究表明，工会化的福利效应系统性地依赖于税基设计。在目的地原则下，基于消费的税收无法纠正工会工资谈判导致的生产扭曲，使工会化国家处于不利地位。在原产地原则下，基于生产的税收直接与工会引发的成本扭曲相互作用，产生取决于贸易成本和竞争性工资的特定制度福利结果。分析凸显了税基设计作为影响工会化寡头垄断中战略互动与福利的关键制度维度。
10.1007/s10797-026-09992-2.title: Unionized oligopoly and tax principles
10.1007/s10797-026-09992-2.title_zh: 工会化寡头垄断与税收原则

10.1007/s10797-026-09993-1.abstract: This paper uses a survey experiment embedded in the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement (SHARE) for Luxembourg – a representative sample of the population aged 50 and above in the country – to show how provision of information influences elicited support for inheritance taxation. While support is low in generic, direct questions about inheritance taxation, support increases when respondents are asked to express views about linear tax rates with explicit tax exemption thresholds and when information is provided about how tax revenues will be used – especially if respondents are told revenues will be used to improve the quality of basic education. This information effect acts even in a setting in which the focus is on inheritances from parents to children and in a country with low inheritance taxation. The effect is however only relevant for respondents who are initially opposed to a tax.
10.1007/s10797-026-09993-1.abstract_zh: 本文利用嵌入卢森堡健康、老龄化与退休调查（SHARE）中的一项实验性调查——该调查为该国50岁及以上人口的代表性样本——揭示了信息提供如何影响受访者对遗产税的支持度。在关于遗产税的通用直接问题中，支持度较低；但当受访者被要求对具有明确免税门槛的线性税率表达看法，并被告知税收收入将用于改善基础教育质量时，支持度显著上升。即便在关注父母向子女继承遗产的情境下，以及遗产税税率较低的国家中，这一信息效应依然存在。然而，该效应仅对最初反对遗产税的受访者具有显著影响。
10.1007/s10797-026-09993-1.title: The role of information in eliciting support for inheritance taxation: experimental evidence from Luxembourg
10.1007/s10797-026-09993-1.title_zh: 信息在激发对遗产税支持中的作用：来自卢森堡的实验证据

10.1007/s10797-026-09994-0.abstract: We exploit a natural experiment in Uruguay to estimate tax pass-through and test for asymmetric price adjustment. In June 2023, the government eliminated VAT (22%) and excise taxes on bottled water in response to an unprecedented drought emergency. Both taxes were reinstated two months later. The legal perimeter of the exemption covered mineral waters and sodas only, so flavored waters—sold on the same shelf by the same firms—remained fully taxed, providing a sharp within-category placebo and an unusually tight control group. Using weekly price data from a large supermarket chain, we find price responses broadly consistent with full tax pass-through and symmetric adjustment in magnitude, with estimated pass-through rates of approximately 106% at the tax cut and 112% at the reinstatement. Pass-through is uniform across container sizes. Flavored waters exhibit no price response at either transition, and using them as the sole control group reproduces the baseline estimates. Data from precios.uy , a mandatory price-reporting platform covering 634 retailers, show that full and symmetric pass-through extends to the market at large; the speed of adjustment, however, differed across transitions, with an immediate and universal price cut but a staggered price increase.
10.1007/s10797-026-09994-0.abstract_zh: 我们利用乌拉圭的一项自然实验来估算税收传导效应并检验价格调整的非对称性。2023年6月，为应对前所未有的干旱紧急状况，政府取消了瓶装水的增值税（22%）和消费税。两个月后，这两项税收重新恢复。免税的法律范围仅涵盖矿泉水和苏打水，因此调味水——由同一企业销售、摆放在同一货架——仍保持全额征税，这提供了一个精准的品类内安慰剂对照组和异常紧密的控制组。利用一家大型连锁超市的周度价格数据，我们发现价格反应大致符合完全税收传导和幅度对称调整的特征，估算的税收传导率在减税时约为106%，在恢复征税时约为112%。传导率在不同容器规格间保持一致。调味水在两个政策转变节点均未表现出价格反应，且将其作为唯一控制组时，基准估计结果得以复现。来自强制性价格报告平台precios.uy（覆盖634家零售商）的数据显示，完全且对称的传导效应扩展至整个市场；然而，调整速度在不同政策转变间存在差异：减税时价格立即且普遍下降，而恢复征税时价格则呈现阶梯式上涨。
10.1007/s10797-026-09994-0.title: Retail price responses to a temporary tax holiday: evidence from Uruguay’s water emergency
10.1007/s10797-026-09994-0.title_zh: 临时税收假期对零售价格的反应：来自乌拉圭水危机的证据

10.1007/s10797-026-09995-z.abstract: We estimate the short- and long-run impacts of a property tax reform in New York City (NYC) on the construction of new rental apartments. The reform, announced in 2006 and implemented in 2008, imposed new requirements to claim a property tax exemption. To estimate the short-run impacts, we use the delay between the announcement and the implementation of the reform to estimate the excess housing starts in response to a future property tax increase. We find that the tax reform induced excess building starts of 10,735 new rental units, equivalent to 1% of the 2007 rental housing stock. To estimate the long-run impacts, we use a difference-in-differences (DiD) strategy comparing census tracts in regions where the new requirements to obtain the tax exemption were stringent vs. tracts in regions where the new requirements were lenient. We find that the tracts with new strict requirements built 0.58 to 0.81 (22.25 to 22.75) more new buildings (new rental units) relative to the comparison group census tracts. These estimates represent 0.3x to 0.4x (2.4x to 2.5x) the median number of new buildings (rental units) per census tract per year in the 2003–15 sample period. Our findings yield two conclusions. First, a property tax reform can increase residential investment in the long run, even if a grace period produces a temporal boom and bust in construction. Second, local tax policy is a key determinant of housing supply in cities with high density and land scarcity.
10.1007/s10797-026-09995-z.abstract_zh: 我们估算了纽约市房产税改革对新建租赁公寓的短期与长期影响。该改革于2006年宣布，2008年实施，对申请房产税豁免提出了新要求。为估算短期影响，我们利用改革宣布与实施之间的延迟期，评估了因未来房产税增加而引发的超额住房开工量。研究发现，税收改革促使新增开工10，735套租赁住房单元，相当于2007年租赁住房存量的1%。为估算长期影响，我们采用双重差分策略，比较了获得税收豁免新要求严格与宽松地区的普查区。结果显示，新要求严格地区的普查区相对于对照组，多建设了0.58至0.81栋新建筑（或22.25至22.75套新租赁单元）。这些估计值相当于2003-2015年样本期间每个普查区每年新建建筑（租赁单元）中位数的0.3至0.4倍（2.4至2.5倍）。我们的发现得出两点结论：第一，即使宽限期导致建筑活动出现暂时繁荣与萧条，房产税改革仍能在长期内增加住宅投资；第二，在人口密集、土地稀缺的城市中，地方税收政策是住房供应的关键决定因素。
10.1007/s10797-026-09995-z.title: The impact of property tax incentives on residential investment
10.1007/s10797-026-09995-z.title_zh: 房产税激励对住宅投资的影响

10.1007/s10797-026-09996-y.abstract: We study labor supply and savings responses to an increase in the full pension eligibility age in the context of South Korea. Using a regression discontinuity design, we document the causal effects of the change on several potential margins of adjustment. We find clear evidence of delayed benefit claiming, consistent with studies in other settings. However, we find little to no statistical evidence of changes in labor supply, in contrast with previous literature. We also find no significant changes in savings or spending. These muted responses may be, in part, because the South Korean pension is relatively new and benefit replacement rates are comparatively modest.
10.1007/s10797-026-09996-y.abstract_zh: 我们研究了韩国提高全额养老金领取资格年龄对劳动供给和储蓄行为的影响。利用断点回归设计，我们记录了该政策变化在多个潜在调整维度上的因果效应。我们发现明确的证据表明，人们延迟了福利申领，这与在其他情境下的研究结果一致。然而，与先前文献相比，我们几乎没有发现劳动供给变化的统计证据。同时，储蓄或支出方面也未出现显著变化。这些温和的反应可能部分归因于韩国养老金制度相对较新，且福利替代率相对较低。
10.1007/s10797-026-09996-y.title: Labor supply and savings responses to increasing the full pension eligibility age in South Korea
10.1007/s10797-026-09996-y.title_zh: 韩国提高全额养老金领取年龄对劳动供给与储蓄的影响

10.1007/s10797-026-09997-x.title: Incomplete VAT rebates, trade misreporting, and export tax evasion: evidence from China’s resource-based products
10.1007/s10797-026-09997-x.title_zh: 不完整增值税退税、贸易瞒报与出口逃税：来自中国资源型产品的证据

10.1007/s10797-026-09998-w.abstract: This study examines public pension reform in a small open economy model where households fully finance education. Departing from previous studies that assume fully publicly funded education, we introduce loan interest subsidies on education in the presence of intergenerational transmission of human capital, which enables an earlier phase-out of pay as-you-go (PAYG) pensions in a Pareto-improving way. We extend the analysis to a closed economy where wages and interest rates are endogenously determined. By incorporating general equilibrium effects through factor prices, we show that loan interest subsidies make a Pareto-improving, gradual reduction of PAYG pensions feasible even in closed economies. This result highlights the efficiency gains from linking pension reform with educational loan support, in contrast to prior studies that overlook private education spending or factor price adjustments.
10.1007/s10797-026-09998-w.abstract_zh: 本研究在一个家庭完全承担教育融资的小型开放经济模型中考察公共养老金改革。与以往假设教育完全由公共资金资助的研究不同，我们在人力资本代际传递的背景下引入教育贷款利息补贴，从而能够以帕累托改进的方式更早地逐步取消现收现付（PAYG）养老金。我们将分析扩展至工资和利率内生决定的封闭经济。通过纳入要素价格的一般均衡效应，我们表明，即使在封闭经济中，教育贷款利息补贴也能使帕累托改进的、渐进式削减PAYG养老金成为可行。这一结果凸显了将养老金改革与教育贷款支持相联系的效率收益，与先前忽视私人教育支出或要素价格调整的研究形成对比。
10.1007/s10797-026-09998-w.title: Linking educational loan subsidies to pay-as-you-go pension reforms
10.1007/s10797-026-09998-w.title_zh: 教育贷款补贴与现收现付养老金改革的联动研究

10.1007/s10887-022-09216-2.abstract: This research develops an expanded unified growth theory that incorporates the endogenous accumulation of physical capital, population, human capital, and technology. The model incorporates a complementarity between physical capital and human capital and can be extended to a multi-country setting with international technology diffusion. The analytical characterization of the mechanisms behind the observed patterns of long-run growth and comparative development delivers a consistent explanation for a large set of seemingly unrelated empirical facts. A quantitative multi-country version of the model matches various empirical regularities of long-run growth dynamics and comparative development patterns that have previously been studied in isolation. The findings also shed new light on the role of the demographic transition for convergence patterns, the specification of cross-country growth regressions, technology spillovers, and the secular stagnation debate.
10.1007/s10887-022-09216-2.abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个扩展的统一增长理论，该理论将物质资本、人口、人力资本和技术的内生积累纳入分析框架。模型引入了物质资本与人力资本之间的互补性，并可扩展至包含国际技术扩散的多国情境。通过对长期增长与比较发展模式背后机制的分析性刻画，该模型为一系列看似无关的实证事实提供了统一的解释。该模型的量化多国版本能够匹配此前被孤立研究的长期增长动态与比较发展模式的多项实证规律。研究结果还揭示了人口转型对趋同模式、跨国增长回归设定、技术溢出效应以及长期停滞争论的新启示。
10.1007/s10887-022-09216-2.title: The Empirics of Economic Growth Over Time and Across Nations: A Unified Growth Perspective
10.1007/s10887-022-09216-2.title_zh: 经济增长的实证研究：跨时间与跨国界的统一增长视角

10.1007/s10887-024-09245-z.abstract: This paper assesses the impact of the Protestant Reformation on wealth distribution and inequality in confessionally divided Germany, between 1400 and 1800. The Reformation expanded social welfare, but provided it in a particularistic way to “deserving" poor and natives only. This gave Protestantism an ambiguous character in terms of redistribution and its impact on inequality. I develop a theoretical framework of this trade-off between welfare expansion and particularistic provision, and test its implications empirically, using a difference-in-differences and an instrumental variable strategy. In line with the theoretical framework, the analysis documents that the Reformation exacerbated inequality overall by making marginal poor people relatively poorer. This increase in inequality was driven by the introduction of new particularistic poor relief policies in Protestant communities. Economic growth was unlikely to be large enough to compensate poor strata for their losses. Protestantism emerges as an underappreciated driver of preindustrial inequality, long before the onset of industrialisation and modern economic growth.
10.1007/s10887-024-09245-z.abstract_zh: 本文评估了新教改革对1400至1800年间宗教分裂的德国财富分配与不平等状况的影响。改革扩大了社会福利，但仅以特殊主义方式提供给“值得”的穷人和本地居民。这使得新教在再分配及其对不平等的影响上呈现出矛盾特性。我构建了一个理论框架，探讨福利扩张与特殊主义供给之间的权衡，并采用双重差分法和工具变量策略对其含义进行实证检验。与理论框架一致，分析表明改革通过使边缘穷人相对更加贫困，总体上加剧了不平等。这一不平等加剧源于新教社区引入的新型特殊主义济贫政策。经济增长不太可能足以补偿贫困阶层所遭受的损失。新教由此显现为工业化及现代经济增长开始之前，一个未被充分认识的工业化前不平等驱动因素。

10.1007/s10887-024-09250-2.abstract: We propose a generalized R&D-based economic growth model that incorporates endogenous human capital accumulation in terms of education and health and the public provision of healthcare and basic science. The government taxes households to pay for healthcare personnel and basic researchers. These employees are not anymore available for applied research and for final goods production. Thus, important tradeoffs emerge for economic growth and welfare with respect to government spending policies. While increasing public spending on health and basic research may decrease economic growth and welfare in the short run, we show that they foster economic growth in the medium run and tend to raise long-run welfare when compared to actual levels of spending in Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) countries. In addition, since public funding for healthcare tends to be rather high in most rich countries, the overall public spending shortfall is lower than previous research has shown. Our results highlight the importance of understanding the tradeoffs involved when deciding adequate public funding for healthcare and basic research.
10.1007/s10887-024-09250-2.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个基于研发的广义经济增长模型，该模型将教育与健康方面的人力资本内生积累，以及医疗保健和基础科学的公共供给纳入考量。政府向家庭征税以支付医疗保健人员和基础研究人员的费用。这些员工不再能从事应用研究和最终商品生产。因此，政府支出政策对经济增长和福利产生了重要的权衡。虽然增加公共支出于健康和基础研究可能在短期内降低经济增长和福利，但我们表明，在中期内它们能促进经济增长，并且与经合组织（OECD）国家实际支出水平相比，倾向于提高长期福利。此外，由于大多数富裕国家在医疗保健上的公共资金往往较高，总体公共支出缺口低于先前研究所显示的水平。我们的结果强调了在决定医疗保健和基础研究适当公共资金时理解所涉及权衡的重要性。

10.1007/s10887-025-09253-7.abstract: We develop novel indices of cultural similarity among ethnic groups derived from their oral traditions. We find that variation in these indices significantly affects currently observed pairwise disparities in income per capita, even after controlling for measures of geo-climatic, historical, religious, and linguistic barriers. We also propose an empirical exploration of the mechanisms linking folklore similarities to income differences. These findings lend support to the relevance of knowledge, information and technological transfers across people and societies in the diffusion of development.
10.1007/s10887-025-09253-7.abstract_zh: 我们基于各民族口头传统构建了文化相似性的新指数。研究发现，这些指数的差异显著影响当前观察到的两两之间的人均收入差距，即便在控制了地理气候、历史、宗教及语言障碍等因素后依然如此。我们还提出了一种实证探索，用以考察民俗相似性与收入差异之间的关联机制。这些发现支持了知识、信息和技术在人群与社会间传播对发展扩散的重要性。

10.1007/s10887-025-09262-6.abstract: Numerous studies have tested Kuznets’ hypothesis of a hump-shaped relationship between inequality and industrialization by regressing the Gini coefficient on the level and square of per capita income. Here, we examine Kuznets’ original idea that inequality first increases and then declines when workers move from agriculture to manufacturing. We collect sectoral wage and employment data for 17 advanced countries over the period 1800-2020 and compute the ‘Kuznets Gini’ as the Gini coefficient that results from changes in sectoral employment shares and the sectoral wage differential. We show the hump-shaped path of the Kuznets Gini and establish, in panel regressions, that inequality arising from sectoral migration has been an important determinant of overall income inequality.
10.1007/s10887-025-09262-6.abstract_zh: 众多研究通过将基尼系数对人均收入水平及其平方项进行回归，检验了库兹涅茨关于不平等与工业化之间呈驼峰形关系的假说。在此，我们考察库兹涅茨的原始构想，即当劳动力从农业向制造业转移时，不平等先上升后下降。我们收集了17个发达国家在1800年至2020年间的部门工资和就业数据，并计算“库兹涅茨基尼系数”，该系数源于部门就业份额变化及部门工资差异。我们展示了库兹涅茨基尼系数的驼峰形路径，并通过面板回归证实，由部门迁移产生的不平等一直是总体收入不平等的重要决定因素。

10.1007/s10887-025-09264-4.abstract: We examine the long-term regional development effects of the Taiping Rebellion (1850–1864), one of the deadliest civil wars in human history and a critical juncture in China’s path toward modernity. Our analysis shows that some areas under the control of the Taiping regime experienced important institutional changes, including stronger land property rights, greater local fiscal capacity, and enhanced social capacity. We find that these areas exhibit enduring development outcomes, reflected in higher economic activity, larger fiscal revenues, stronger civic norms, and lower mortality during the Great Famine (1959–1961). The results suggest that violent conflicts have left lasting imprints on development by shaping local institutions in ways that influenced the evolution of property rights, fiscal capacity, and social cohesion, factors that could account for China’s enduring regional disparities.
10.1007/s10887-025-09264-4.abstract_zh: 我们考察了太平天国运动（1850-1864年）——人类历史上最致命的内战之一，也是中国迈向现代化进程中的关键转折点——对区域长期发展的影响。分析显示，太平天国政权控制下的某些地区经历了重要的制度变迁，包括土地产权强化、地方财政能力增强以及社会能力提升。我们发现，这些地区展现出持久的发展成果，体现在经济活动水平更高、财政收入更充裕、公民规范更强，以及在大饥荒（1959-1961年）期间死亡率更低。研究结果表明，暴力冲突通过塑造地方制度，在产权演变、财政能力和社会凝聚力方面留下深远影响，这些因素或可解释中国持续存在的区域差异。

10.1007/s10887-026-09268-8.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    A central question in economics is how talent is allocated across elite professions and whether access is shaped by family ties or by open, standardized systems of selection. We study these questions in Western classical composition, a setting in which family background historically influenced entry through both inherited skill and inherited privilege, and where rich biographical records make it possible to trace selection over multiple centuries. Using data on more than 16,000 composers from 450 CE to the present, we identify dynastic ties from
                    <jats:italic>Grove Music Online</jats:italic>
                    and measure prominence by biographical entry length. Dynastic composers are 15–21 percent less prominent than non-dynasts, conditional on country and birth cohort, and this discount is driven by descendants: founders perform about as well as non-dynasts, while descendants perform significantly worse. Archival manuscript evidence from the
                    <jats:italic>Répertoire International des Sources Musicales</jats:italic>
                    yields similar results, suggesting that the pattern is not an artifact of editorial selection. In the twentieth century, however, the dynasty discount reverses, consistent with the transition from informal, family-based entry to more standardized selection through conservatory training. Consistent with this interpretation, dynasts are less likely to have formal training mentioned in their biographies, more likely to be described as advancing through family connections, and face a smaller dynasty discount in regions and periods with conservatories. Taken together, the findings suggest that expanded access to standardized training can weaken inherited advantage, reshape elite formation, and improve talent allocation, with broader implications for long-run innovation and economic performance.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s10887-026-09268-8.abstract_zh: 经济学的一个核心问题是，人才如何在精英职业中分配，以及这种分配是由家族关系还是开放、标准化的选拔体系所塑造。我们以西方古典音乐创作为背景研究这些问题，在这一领域中，家族背景历来通过继承的技能和继承的特权影响从业者的进入，而丰富的传记记录使我们能够追溯跨越多个世纪的选拔过程。利用从公元450年至今超过16,000名作曲家的数据，我们从《格罗夫音乐在线》中识别出家族纽带，并通过传记条目长度衡量其知名度。在控制国家和出生队列的条件下，家族作曲家比非家族作曲家的知名度低15%至21%，这一折扣主要由后代驱动：创始人的表现与非家族作曲家相当，而后代的表现则显著更差。来自《国际音乐文献资源总目》的档案手稿证据得出了类似结果，表明这一模式并非编辑选择的产物。然而，在20世纪，家族折扣发生了逆转，这与从非正式的、基于家族的进入方式向通过音乐学院培训进行更标准化选拔的转变相一致。与这一解释一致的是，家族作曲家在其传记中提及正式培训的可能性较低，更可能被描述为通过家族关系晋升，并且在有音乐学院存在的地区和时期面临较小的家族折扣。综合来看，这些发现表明，扩大标准化培训的获取渠道可以削弱继承优势，重塑精英形成，并改善人才分配，这对长期创新和经济表现具有更广泛的意义。
10.1007/s10887-026-09268-8.title: What’s in a name? Dynasties, selection, and talent allocation among classical composers
10.1007/s10887-026-09268-8.title_zh: 名字里有什么？古典作曲家中的家族传承、选拔与人才配置

10.1007/s10887-026-09270-0.abstract: Since the mid-1990s computing revolution, the U.S. economy has exhibited several striking regularities. Labor productivity growth has slowed below its historical trend following a decade-long boom, while the labor share has declined. Computing technologies are characterized by rapid obsolescence, and U.S. data suggest that aggregate capital obsolescence has accelerated since their widespread adoption. I study the macroeconomic implications of this acceleration using an endogenous growth model in which the economy transitions to a new equilibrium with a higher obsolescence rate. As capital designs become obsolete sooner, the value of future payoffs to capital innovation initially falls. The economy responds with a temporary productivity boom driven by faster skill accumulation, which partially restores innovation profitability. Over time, however, efficient capital per efficient labor declines. Under factor complementarity, this scarcity depresses the labor share by raising flow profits accruing to capital designs relative to skills. Resources are redirected from skill creation toward short-lived capital innovation, ultimately slowing long-run growth. The calibrated model produces productivity and labor-share dynamics broadly consistent with the data, and the paper advances the obsolescence channel as one plausible account of these trends.
10.1007/s10887-026-09270-0.abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代中期计算革命以来，美国经济呈现出若干显著规律性特征。在经历长达十年的繁荣期后，劳动生产率增速已放缓至历史趋势线以下，同时劳动收入份额持续下降。计算技术具有快速过时的特性，美国数据表明，自其广泛普及以来，总体资本过时速度已显著加快。本文通过构建内生增长模型研究这一加速现象对宏观经济的影响，在该模型中经济将向具有更高过时率的新均衡状态过渡。随着资本设计过时速度加快，资本创新未来收益的现值最初出现下降。经济通过技能积累加速形成暂时性生产率繁荣作为应对，这在一定程度上恢复了创新盈利能力。然而，单位有效劳动的有效资本存量随时间推移持续下降。在要素互补性条件下，这种稀缺性通过提高资本设计相对于技能所获得的流动利润，压低了劳动收入份额。资源从技能创造转向短寿命资本创新，最终导致长期增长放缓。校准模型产生的生产率与劳动份额动态与数据基本吻合，本文提出过时渠道作为解释这些趋势的合理机制之一。
10.1007/s10887-026-09270-0.title: Technology overload? macroeconomic implications of accelerated obsolescence
10.1007/s10887-026-09270-0.title_zh: 技术过载？加速淘汰的宏观经济影响

10.1007/s10887-026-09271-z.abstract: Nineteenth-century social reformers promoted the establishment of kindergartens to facilitate the integration of immigrant children in the U.S. society. Exploiting newly collected data on historical kindergarten statistics, we evaluate the impact that the roll-out of the first kindergartens in U.S. cities had on immigrant families. We find that immigrant women exposed to kindergartens experienced a significant reduction in fertility. Their offspring were more likely to attend school, less likely to work during adolescence, and went on to have fewer children as adults. Kindergarten exposure also helped children of non-English-speaking households to acquire English proficiency, thereby illustrating the importance of kindergartens in the social integration of immigrant families. The observed fertility decline, in response to higher returns to education, is consistent with a child quantity–quality tradeoff.
10.1007/s10887-026-09271-z.abstract_zh: 十九世纪的社会改革者倡导建立幼儿园，以促进移民儿童融入美国社会。利用新收集的历史幼儿园统计数据，我们评估了美国城市首批幼儿园的推广对移民家庭的影响。研究发现，接触幼儿园的移民女性生育率显著下降。她们的子女更有可能入学，青少年时期工作的可能性较低，并且成年后生育的子女数量更少。幼儿园的接触还帮助了来自非英语家庭的儿童掌握英语能力，从而凸显了幼儿园在移民家庭社会融合中的重要性。观察到的生育率下降，是对教育回报提高的响应，与子女数量与质量权衡相一致。
10.1007/s10887-026-09271-z.title: Froebel’s gifts: how the kindergarten movement changed the immigrant family
10.1007/s10887-026-09271-z.title_zh: 福禄贝尔的恩赐：幼儿园运动如何改变了移民家庭

10.1007/s11127-026-01396-4.abstract: When single member plurality electoral rule is used, Duverger’s “law” posits prevalence of a “two-party system”. This system often has been construed to mean that Laakso-Taagepera effective number of parties is close to 2.0. But this can be misleading because N = 2.0 can result not only from 50–50-0 but also from 66.6–16.7–16.7. A safer index of “two-partyness” has been developed for district votes, but the issue is even more complex at the nationwide level. Here the Duvergerian ideal for seats in a single election is not stalemate (50–50-0) but a tilted balance: a comfortable majority, yet also vigorous opposition. Also needed are alternation in power and long-term parity in number of elections won. This study develops indices of closeness to these four ideals and applies them to a dataset. Results confirm a Duverger’s tendency, but it is too early to proclaim a Duverger’s law.
10.1007/s11127-026-01396-4.abstract_zh: 当采用单一成员多数决选举规则时，迪维尔热的“定律”预设了“两党制”的主导地位。这一制度常被解读为拉索-塔格佩拉有效政党数接近2.0。然而，这种解读可能具有误导性，因为N=2.0不仅可能源于50-50-0的分布，也可能来自66.6-16.7-16.7的情况。针对选区选票，已开发出更安全的“两党性”指标，但在全国层面，问题则更为复杂。在此，单次选举中议席的迪维尔热理想状态并非僵局（50-50-0），而是一种倾斜的平衡：既拥有舒适的多数，又存在有力的反对派。此外，还需要权力的交替更迭以及长期内赢得选举次数的均等。本研究开发了衡量接近这四种理想状态的指数，并将其应用于一个数据集。结果证实了迪维尔热的趋势，但宣称其为迪维尔热定律尚为时过早。
10.1007/s11127-026-01396-4.title: Duverger’s tilted balance: “Two-party system” operationalized
10.1007/s11127-026-01396-4.title_zh: 迪韦尔热的倾斜平衡：“两党制”的操作化

10.1007/s11127-026-01401-w.abstract: This study utilizes locations of underground publications, known as samizdat , to analyze the impact of access to political knowledge on shaping institutional change in the German Democratic Republic during 1989–1990. Survival analysis reveals that regions with greater underground press activity were significantly more likely to experience protests following the fall of the Berlin Wall on November 9, 1989. This delay can be attributed to the increased repression of dissent. However, support for regime change did not necessarily translate into support for rapid German reunification, as evidenced by the voting results of the 1990 democratic elections. Although samizdat did not appear to coordinate the initial protests, it played an informational role in shaping preferences toward gradual institutional change. Finally, in addition to its information function, underground press activities were instrumental in forming opposition that challenged the non-democratic regime, thereby determining the onset of democratization.
10.1007/s11127-026-01401-w.abstract_zh: 本研究利用地下出版物（即“萨米兹达特”）的地点分布，分析政治知识获取对1989–1990年德意志民主共和国制度变革的影响。生存分析显示，在1989年11月9日柏林墙倒塌后，地下出版活动更为活跃的地区更有可能发生抗议活动。这一延迟可归因于对异见行为加强的压制。然而，对政权更迭的支持并不必然转化为对快速德国统一的支持，1990年民主选举的投票结果即为明证。尽管萨米兹达特似乎并未协调最初的抗议活动，但它在塑造偏好渐进式制度变革方面发挥了信息作用。最后，除信息功能外，地下出版活动在形成挑战非民主政权的反对派方面也至关重要，从而决定了民主化的启动。
10.1007/s11127-026-01401-w.title: Loose bricks in the wall: Underground press and political opposition in non-democracies
10.1007/s11127-026-01401-w.title_zh: 墙上的松砖：非民主国家的地下媒体与政治反对

10.1007/s11127-026-01403-8.abstract: In his 1958 classic, The Theory of Committees and Elections, Duncan Black proposes the following lexicographic choice rule: for any set of feasible candidates, and any profile of voters’ preference relations, choose the strong Condorcet winner if it exists, and select the set of Borda winners otherwise. We provide a novel axiomatic characterization of this proposal. We do so by means of the social welfare functions that underlie the rule’s choices, and the use of axioms that emphasize what is common and what is different in the spirit of the amply debated proposals made by these two eighteenth-century authors.
10.1007/s11127-026-01403-8.abstract_zh: 在邓肯·布莱克1958年的经典著作《委员会与选举理论》中，他提出了以下字典序选择规则：对于任何可行的候选人集合及任何选民偏好关系分布，若存在强孔多塞赢家，则选择之；否则，选取博尔达赢家集合。我们对此提议提供了一种新颖的公理化特征描述。我们通过支撑该规则选择的社会福利函数，并运用强调这两位十八世纪作者广泛讨论提案中共同点与差异点的公理来实现这一目标。
10.1007/s11127-026-01403-8.title: A characterization of Black’s voting rule
10.1007/s11127-026-01403-8.title_zh: 布莱克投票规则的一个特征刻画

10.1007/s11127-026-01404-7.abstract: Milton Friedman, in the 1960s, was convinced that John Cowperthwaite, the British official overseeing Hong Kong’s economic policy, was conducting the most radical experiment in economic history. A staunch classical liberal within the British civil service, Cowperthwaite aggressively resisted government intervention, believing that free markets fueled growth. His influence was amplified by British domestic politics and the nature of colonial rule, making him a uniquely powerful figure. In this paper, we use the Synthetic Control Method (SCM) and Synthetic Difference-in-Differences (SDID) to assess whether Cowperthwaite truly constrained government expansion and whether his policies drove economic growth. In other words, we test whether Friedman overstated Cowperthwaite’s impact. We find strong evidence that Cowperthwaite limited government growth but had no visible effect on economic growth. We link these results to Hong Kong’s land policies, their impact on government size metrics, and more even-handed assessments of Cowperthwaite’s policy decisions.
10.1007/s11127-026-01404-7.abstract_zh: 20世纪60年代，米尔顿·弗里德曼确信，负责香港经济政策的英国官员约翰·考珀斯韦特正在实施经济史上最激进的实验。作为英国文官体系中坚定的古典自由主义者，考珀斯韦特强烈抵制政府干预，坚信自由市场能推动增长。英国国内政治与殖民统治的特性放大了他的影响力，使其成为一位拥有独特权力的关键人物。本文采用合成控制法（SCM）与合成双重差分法（SDID），评估考珀斯韦特是否真正限制了政府扩张，以及他的政策是否推动了经济增长。换言之，我们检验弗里德曼是否夸大了考珀斯韦特的影响。研究发现，考珀斯韦特确实限制了政府规模增长，但对经济增长并无显著影响。我们将这些结果与香港的土地政策、其对政府规模指标的影响，以及对考珀斯韦特政策决策更为公允的评价联系起来。
10.1007/s11127-026-01404-7.title: An almost laboratory experiment: John Cowperthwaite and Hong Kong’s economic prosperity
10.1007/s11127-026-01404-7.title_zh: 一个近乎实验室的实验：约翰·考珀斯韦特与香港的经济繁荣

10.1007/s11127-026-01405-6.abstract: We study women’s underrepresentation in science by experimentally examining gender imbalance in music composition and whether it is due to unfair judgment in evaluative settings. We invite composition faculty to rate new compositions associated with randomly assigned gendered names along with live recordings directed by the same conductor. We find no evidence of gender bias against women, and in fact compositions associated with female names are rated higher than those associated with male names. Further, reviewers do not favor compositions by composers of their own gender. We find suggestive evidence that male faculty and senior faculty favor female composers in both overall and structured evaluations. These findings should be interpreted with caution, as the study’s external validity is limited by the modest response rate and demographic composition of respondents.
10.1007/s11127-026-01405-6.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究音乐创作中的性别失衡现象，探讨其是否源于评审环境中的不公正判断，以此考察科学领域中女性代表性不足的问题。我们邀请作曲系教师对随机分配性别化名字的新作品进行评分，并同时提供由同一指挥家指挥的现场录音。结果显示，我们没有发现针对女性的性别偏见证据，事实上，与男性名字关联的作品相比，女性名字关联的作品获得了更高的评分。此外，评审者并未偏好与自己性别相同的作曲家。我们发现有提示性证据表明，男性教师和资深教师在整体及结构化评价中均更倾向于女性作曲家。然而，这些发现应谨慎解读，因为研究的回应率及受访者人口构成有限，限制了其外部有效性。
10.1007/s11127-026-01405-6.title: Gender bias in competitive music composition evaluation: an experimental study
10.1007/s11127-026-01405-6.title_zh: 竞争性音乐创作评估中的性别偏见：一项实验研究

10.1007/s11127-026-01406-5.abstract: I study the economic consequences of cultural diversity within political organizations. Using manually collected data on 25,568 members of county-level standing committees of the Chinese Communist Party and the Chinese Industrial Enterprise Database from 1998 to 2013, I find that cultural diversity in county standing committees significantly reduces industrial output. I further identify potential mechanisms: greater committee diversity is associated with lower government and capital construction spending, slower and weaker responses to public appeals, and lower labor and capital inputs as well as enterprise investment. Moreover, counties with more culturally diverse standing committees exhibit lower nighttime light intensity and reduced per capita GDP. Overall, these results highlight a potential limitation of China’s current political organizational structure and institutional arrangements.
10.1007/s11127-026-01406-5.abstract_zh: 我研究了政治组织内部文化多样性的经济后果。基于手动收集的1998年至2013年间中国共产党县级常务委员会25568名成员数据及中国工业企业数据库，发现县级常委会的文化多样性显著降低了工业产出。进一步识别出潜在机制：委员会多样性程度越高，政府与基建支出越低，对公众诉求的响应速度与力度越弱，劳动与资本投入及企业投资也相应减少。此外，文化多样性更高的县级常委会所在地区，夜间灯光强度与人均GDP均有所下降。总体而言，这些结果揭示了中国现行政治组织结构与制度安排可能存在的局限性。
10.1007/s11127-026-01406-5.title: The economic consequences of cultural diversity in political organizations
10.1007/s11127-026-01406-5.title_zh: 政治组织中文化多样性的经济后果

10.1007/s11127-026-01407-4.abstract: Adam Smith’s account of medieval towns in Book III of The Wealth of Nations remains one of the most influential analyses of how commerce transformed feudal Europe. This paper formalizes Smith’s argument as a game between kings, lords, and towns. The king-town alliance emphasized by Adam Smith emerges when towns are wealthy enough to offer fiscal and military support but lords remain a serious threat. However, when kings become excessively predatory, towns may ally with lords (as in the Magna Carta crisis); when towns are too weak to offer substantial support, kings ally with lords instead (as in Eastern Europe). A dynamic extension shows that the king-town equilibrium is self-undermining: commercial growth erodes lordly military power through Smith’s “diamond buckles” mechanism, eventually enabling royal absolutism. In contrast, the king-lords equilibrium is self-reinforcing, suppressing urban development and preserving feudal institutions. The framework highlights how small differences in initial urban development could generate dramatically different long-run trajectories and illuminates both the brilliance and the limitations of Smith’s conjectural history.
10.1007/s11127-026-01407-4.abstract_zh: 亚当·斯密在《国富论》第三卷中对中世纪城镇的论述，至今仍是分析商业如何改变封建欧洲最具影响力的理论之一。本文将斯密的论点形式化为国王、领主与城镇之间的博弈模型。当城镇足够富裕，能够提供财政与军事支持，而领主仍构成严重威胁时，斯密所强调的国王-城镇联盟便会形成。然而，当国王变得过度掠夺性时，城镇可能与领主结盟（如《大宪章》危机时期）；当城镇过于弱小、无法提供实质性支持时，国王则转而与领主结盟（如东欧地区）。动态扩展模型表明，国王-城镇均衡具有自我削弱性：商业增长通过斯密的“钻石扣带”机制侵蚀领主的军事力量，最终促成君主专制。相反，国王-领主均衡具有自我强化性，抑制城市发展并维系封建制度。该框架揭示了初始城市发展的微小差异如何导致截然不同的长期演化路径，并阐明了斯密推测性历史理论的洞见与局限。
10.1007/s11127-026-01407-4.title: Adam Smith and the role of the towns in feudal Europe
10.1007/s11127-026-01407-4.title_zh: 亚当·斯密与封建欧洲城镇的角色

10.1007/s11127-026-01408-3.abstract: This study examines the causal effects of anti-corruption reforms on wealth concentration. Using data from the World Inequality Database, the World Governance Indicators, and V-Dem across more than 150 countries, I employ a staggered difference-in-differences approach to identify the impact of sustained drops in measured corruption on wealth distribution. Sustained anti-corruption reforms significantly reduce wealth concentration at the top while increasing shares at the bottom of the distribution. Ten years after implementation, the top 1% wealth share falls by approximately 2 percentage points and the top 10% share by 1.5 percentage points, while the bottom 50% share rises by 0.4 percentage points and the bottom 20% share by 0.15 percentage points. These effects emerge gradually, becoming statistically significant within four years of reforms and persisting throughout the observation period. The results are robust across alternative estimators, alternative corruption indicators, and specifications that control for lagged dependent variables, national income, the top 1% income share, political violence, and inflation. A synthetic control analysis of Georgia illustrates how reforms disrupt elite patronage networks, while the subsequent policy reversal caused distributional gains to stagnate. The findings extend the political economy literature by showing that elite-disrupting mechanisms dominate offsetting concerns about informal redistribution and that reforms reshape wealth distribution through expanded access to financial services and property rights rather than through direct fiscal transfers.
10.1007/s11127-026-01408-3.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了反腐败改革对财富集中的因果效应。基于来自世界不平等数据库、世界治理指标及V-Dem项目覆盖150多个国家的数据，我采用交错双重差分法识别腐败程度持续下降对财富分配的影响。持续的反腐败改革显著降低了顶层财富集中度，同时提高了底层群体的财富占比。改革实施十年后，顶层1%人群的财富份额下降约2个百分点，顶层10%人群下降1.5个百分点，而底层50%人群的财富份额上升0.4个百分点，底层20%人群上升0.15个百分点。这些效应逐步显现，在改革实施四年内达到统计显著性，并在整个观测期内持续存在。该结果在替代估计量、替代腐败指标以及控制滞后因变量、国民收入、顶层1%收入份额、政治暴力与通货膨胀的模型设定中均保持稳健。对格鲁吉亚的综合控制分析表明，改革如何瓦解精英庇护网络，而随后的政策逆转导致分配收益停滞。本研究拓展了政治经济学文献，揭示精英瓦解机制主导了对非正式再分配问题的抵消性担忧，且改革通过扩大金融服务与产权获取渠道（而非直接财政转移）重塑财富分配格局。
10.1007/s11127-026-01408-3.title: Political power and wealth distribution: how anti-corruption reforms reshape inequality
10.1007/s11127-026-01408-3.title_zh: 政治权力与财富分配：反腐败改革如何重塑不平等

10.1007/s11127-026-01409-2.abstract: Economic and political decisions are increasingly made in international organizations (IOs). A distinctive feature of many IOs is that they operate under a system of rotating leadership (e.g. a committee chair that rotates annually). Despite the widespread use of such systems and their potential value to interest groups, we know surprisingly little about how interest groups respond to rotating leadership in IOs. Using both micro- and macro-level data on the economic performance of commercial lobbyists in the European Union, I show that interest groups respond strategically to short-term shifts in leadership. Specifically, when a country takes over the rotating EU Council Presidency, interest groups increase their use of commercial lobbyists to gain access to policymakers from the presiding country.
10.1007/s11127-026-01409-2.abstract_zh: 经济与政治决策越来越多地在国际组织（IOs）中作出。许多国际组织的一个显著特征是，它们采用轮值领导制度（例如，委员会主席每年轮换）。尽管这种制度被广泛采用，且对利益集团具有潜在价值，但我们对利益集团如何应对国际组织中的轮值领导制度知之甚少。利用欧盟商业游说者经济表现的微观与宏观层面数据，我揭示了利益集团会策略性地应对短期领导权更迭。具体而言，当一个国家接任欧盟理事会轮值主席国时，利益集团会增加对商业游说者的使用，以获取与主席国政策制定者接触的渠道。
10.1007/s11127-026-01409-2.title: Lobbying and rotating leadership

10.1007/s11127-026-01410-9.abstract: We study the incentive effects of vertical equalization transfers in France. Using a reform in 2017 that tightened eligibility criteria for an equalization grant, we analyze how grant losses affect municipal budget choices. Drawing on a large panel of urban municipalities covering the 2014–2024 period, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences framework to identify the causal impact of grant losses. We first show that, on average, municipalities substitute grants with local tax revenues. Second, political factors reveal heterogeneity in responses. Left-wing municipalities increase spending and simultaneously raise taxes and debt. In contrast, right-wing municipalities increase taxes but consolidate debt. Municipalities led by narrowly elected mayors pursue stronger fiscal discipline, reducing expenditures and debt. Political fragmentation within municipal councils generates patterns consistent with coalition bargaining.
10.1007/s11127-026-01410-9.abstract_zh: 我们研究了法国纵向均衡转移支付的激励效应。利用2017年一项收紧均衡拨款资格标准的改革，我们分析了拨款损失如何影响市政预算选择。基于覆盖2014—2024年期间的大型城市面板数据，我们采用交错双重差分框架来识别拨款损失的因果影响。我们首先表明，平均而言，市政当局用地方税收收入替代拨款。其次，政治因素揭示了反应的异质性。左翼市政当局增加支出，同时提高税收和债务。相比之下，右翼市政当局增加税收但巩固债务。由微弱优势当选的市长领导的市政当局追求更强的财政纪律，减少支出和债务。市政委员会内部的政治碎片化产生了与联盟谈判相一致的模式。
10.1007/s11127-026-01410-9.title: When the money stops: fiscal and political reactions to changing grant eligibility
10.1007/s11127-026-01410-9.title_zh: 当资金停止：对拨款资格变化的财政与政治反应

10.1007/s11127-026-01411-8.abstract: When natives realize that their country’s welfare system includes immigrants, they may prefer high-income immigrants to low-income ones because the former will contribute more to the system because of its redistributive nature. We examine this causal effect using a novel survey experiment. In the experiment, we randomly assign half of the respondents to receive information designed to increase their perception that the national healthcare insurance system includes immigrants. Subsequently, we assess respondents’ preferences for different types of immigrants through a conjoint experiment. Our findings reveal that the treatment reduced preferences for low-income immigrants but increased preferences for high-income immigrants. Furthermore, these effects were observed only among those who did not perceive an increase in foreign workers as a threat to their job security. Thus, concerns about the welfare system and job insecurity should not be considered in isolation. Overall, the results indicate that institutional design (particularly the redistributive structure of welfare systems) shapes political preferences regarding immigration policy.
10.1007/s11127-026-01411-8.abstract_zh: 当本地居民意识到本国的福利体系涵盖移民时，他们可能更倾向于高收入移民而非低收入移民，因为前者由于福利体系的再分配性质，将为该体系贡献更多。我们通过一项新颖的问卷调查实验来考察这一因果效应。在实验中，我们随机分配一半的受访者接收旨在增强其认知——即国家医疗保险体系包含移民——的信息。随后，我们通过一个联合实验评估受访者对不同类型移民的偏好。研究结果显示，该处理降低了对低收入移民的偏好，但增加了对高收入移民的偏好。此外，这些效应仅出现在那些不认为外籍工人增加对其工作安全构成威胁的受访者中。因此，对福利体系的担忧与工作不安全感不应被孤立考虑。总体而言，结果表明制度设计（尤其是福利体系的再分配结构）塑造了关于移民政策的政治偏好。
10.1007/s11127-026-01411-8.title: Welfare state and natives’ preferences for immigrants’ types
10.1007/s11127-026-01411-8.title_zh: 福利国家与本地居民对移民类型的偏好

10.1007/s11127-026-01412-7.abstract: Liberal democracies increasingly curtail civil liberties in response to cultural tensions. I show that such repression can be conceived as a Pigouvian political externality: governments enjoy immediate political benefits from reduced social tension but systematically undervalue long-run costs of institutional erosion. The externality arises because finite tenure and reduced post-tenure valuation make politicians discount institutional quality more steeply than society. I formalize this mechanism in a dynamic linear-quadratic model in which repression lowers visible tension today while degrading future institutional quality, and I derive a closed-form “social cost of repression,” analogous to the social cost of carbon in environmental economics. Pigouvian logic, typically used to diagnose market failure, is here applied to a government failure in democratic self-regulation. I then characterize a class of market-based instruments—sovereign “democracy covenant” bonds, whose coupon rates rise automatically when civil-liberties indices deteriorate—that embed the shadow cost of repression into borrowing costs and thereby better align short-run political incentives with long-run democratic resilience.
10.1007/s11127-026-01412-7.abstract_zh: 自由民主政体在应对文化紧张局势时，日益限制公民自由。本文论证此类压制可被理解为一种庇古式政治外部性：政府从社会紧张局势缓解中即时获得政治收益，却系统性低估制度侵蚀的长期成本。这种外部性源于有限任期与离任后价值折损，导致政治家对制度质量的折现率高于社会整体。本文通过动态线性二次模型形式化该机制——压制行为在降低当前显性紧张的同时，持续削弱未来制度质量，并推导出类似环境经济学中"碳社会成本"的"压制社会成本"闭合解。通常用于诊断市场失灵的庇古逻辑，在此被应用于民主自我规制中的政府失灵。进而，本文刻画了一类市场型工具——主权"民主契约"债券，其票面利率随公民自由指数恶化自动攀升——通过将压制的影子成本内化至借贷成本，使短期政治激励与长期民主韧性实现更优校准。
10.1007/s11127-026-01412-7.title: Democratic backsliding as a Pigouvian political externality
10.1007/s11127-026-01412-7.title_zh: 民主倒退作为庇古式政治外部性

10.1007/s11127-026-01413-6.abstract: This primer provides a systematic introduction to proportional representation (PR) electoral systems for scholars and students unfamiliar with their mechanics and political consequences. PR is now used for legislative elections in approximately 118 countries, making it the world’s most common family of electoral systems. However, its formal structure and political effects are often poorly understood outside specialist communities. The primer covers the main families of apportionment algorithms (quota, divisor, and ranked-choice methods), the principal types of PR electoral systems (list PR, STV, mixed, and semi-proportional), and their key structural components, including district magnitude, thresholds, measures of disproportionality, volatility, and the effective number of parties. It surveys major empirical regularities, including Duverger’s Law, the impact of district magnitude on party fragmentation, women’s and minority representation, voter turnout, and coalition formation, before turning to paradoxes and problems, including apportionment paradoxes and the Balinski–Young impossibility theorem, STV Non-Monotonicity and the No-Show paradox, spoilers and ballot-position primacy effects in list PR, and overhang seats and decoy parties in mixed compensatory systems. The primer concludes that every apportionment method is formally flawed, that institutional parameters interact with strategic behavior in ways that frequently produce unexpected outcomes, and that the empirical regularities anchoring the field rest on identification strategies that are vulnerable to the endogeneity of electoral institutions. A Glossary of key concepts is included as an Appendix.
10.1007/s11127-026-01413-6.abstract_zh: 本导论为不熟悉比例代表制（PR）运作机制及其政治后果的学者与学生提供了系统性入门介绍。目前约有118个国家在立法选举中采用比例代表制，使其成为全球最普遍的选举制度家族。然而，其正式结构及政治影响在专业领域之外常被误解。本文涵盖席位分配算法的主要类别（配额法、除数法与排序选择法）、比例代表制的主要类型（名单比例代表制、单一可转移投票制、混合制与半比例代表制）及其关键结构性要素，包括选区规模、门槛、比例性失衡指标、波动性及有效政党数。在探讨悖论与问题前，本文梳理了主要经验规律，包括迪韦尔热定律、选区规模对政党碎片化的影响、女性与少数群体代表性、选民投票率及联盟形成机制；随后转向分配悖论与巴林斯基-杨不可能定理、单一可转移投票制的非单调性与缺席悖论、名单比例代表制中的搅局者与选票位置优先效应，以及混合补偿制中的超额席位与掩护政党。本文结论指出：每种分配方法均存在形式缺陷；制度参数与策略行为互动常产生非预期结果；支撑该领域的经验规律所依赖的识别策略易受选举制度内生性问题影响。附录包含关键概念词汇表。
10.1007/s11127-026-01413-6.title: Proportional representation primer

10.1007/s11127-026-01414-5.abstract: This paper investigates why Imperial Japan’s promising Taishō-era democracy (1905–32) experienced a gradual descent into militarism that culminated in the collapse of party government and the effective subordination of civilian authority to the military by the late 1930s. Building on North et al.’s (2009) framework, I argue that this democratic reversal was driven by a failure to consolidate civilian control over the instruments of violence. Facing the existential threat of Russian expansion, civilian elites made a deliberate decision to empower the military at a moment when civilian institutional control over the armed forces was weak and the military technology being adopted concentrated coercive power in a professional officer corps insulated from civilian oversight. This combination produced a substantial probability of eventual military takeover, which was realized over the following three decades as each remaining instrument of civilian authority was tested and broken in turn. This trajectory is contrasted with that of Britain, where civilian institutional control over the military had been consolidated two centuries before industrial warfare arrived. Comparable military technologies were later absorbed there into an existing civilian chain of command and kept under civilian direction. I identify a distinct pathway of democratic backsliding and demonstrate that the strength of civilian institutional control and the character of available military technology at the moment of military empowerment are critical determinants of whether democracy endures.
10.1007/s11127-026-01414-5.abstract_zh: 本文探讨为何日本帝国颇具前景的大正时代民主（1905–1932年）逐渐滑向军国主义，最终导致政党政府崩溃，并在1930年代末期使文官权力实质上从属于军方。基于诺斯等人（2009年）的分析框架，本文认为，这一民主倒退的根源在于未能巩固文官对暴力工具的控制。面对俄国扩张的生存威胁，文官精英在文官对军队的制度性控制薄弱、且所采用的军事技术将强制力集中于不受文官监督的职业军官团之际，刻意做出了强化军方的决策。这种组合导致军方最终接管政权的概率显著上升，并在随后的三十年间逐一检验并瓦解了剩余的文官权威工具。本文将此路径与英国进行对比——英国在工业战争到来前两个世纪便已巩固了文官对军队的制度性控制。后来引入的同类军事技术被纳入既有文官指挥体系，并始终处于文官主导之下。本文识别出一条独特的民主倒退路径，并证明：在军事权力被赋予的时刻，文官制度性控制的强度与可用军事技术的特性，是决定民主能否存续的关键因素。
10.1007/s11127-026-01414-5.title: Imperial Japan, civilian control, and democratic reversal
10.1007/s11127-026-01414-5.title_zh: 日本帝国、文官统治与民主逆转

10.1007/s11127-026-01415-4.abstract: Violence is often viewed as an intrinsic feature of illicit markets, driven by competition, disputes, and predation. We argue that the connection between violence and markets is not exclusive to illicit markets and that in the absence of strong institutions these factors exist ubiquitously. Using an estimator of spatial concentration, we document the empirical relationship between violence and markets in the Fourteenth Century. We then employ a large language model to analyze the coroner’s accounts of the era’s homicides, finding that many of these incidents were driven by avoidable escalations of business-related disputes. Employing a difference-in-differences estimator for spatial concentration, we proceed to causally identify the impacts of the introduction of London’s first professional police force in the nineteenth century on this concentration. We find that the police force’s introduction led to a 54% reduction in the degree of concentration of violence around marketplaces. Our findings suggest that it is not the nature of the commodities being sold in illicit markets that drives violence, but is rather the absence of formal institutions of enforcement and dispute resolution.
10.1007/s11127-026-01415-4.abstract_zh: 暴力常被视为非法市场的固有特征，源于竞争、纠纷与掠夺。我们认为，暴力与市场之间的联系并非仅限于非法市场，在缺乏强有力制度的情况下，这些因素普遍存在。利用空间集中度估计方法，我们记录了十四世纪暴力与市场之间的实证关系。随后，我们运用大型语言模型分析该时代验尸官记录中的凶杀案，发现许多此类事件源于商业纠纷的可避免升级。采用双重差分估计器分析空间集中度，我们进一步因果识别了十九世纪伦敦首支职业警察部队的引入对这一集中度的影响。我们发现，警察部队的引入导致市场周边暴力集中度下降了54%。我们的研究结果表明，驱动暴力的并非非法市场所售商品的性质，而是缺乏正式的执法与纠纷解决制度。
10.1007/s11127-026-01415-4.title: Murder in the Marketplace

10.1007/s11127-026-01416-3.abstract: Political coercion directed against non-state moralities can serve as a tool for generating legitimacy. Does the efficacy of political coercion in producing legitimacy vary with its intensity? Using Freedom House, V-Dem, and Polity5 indices as proxies for coercive intensity, together with data on regime legitimacy and survival, we find that a mid-level range of coercion is ineffective in generating legitimacy. Relatively few regimes operate in this intermediate zone, and those that do exhibit lower legitimacy and higher instability risks. In contrast, shifts away from this suboptimal range-toward either higher or lower coercion levels-correlate significantly with gains in legitimacy. Time-series analysis of authoritarian regimes reveals a recurring pattern: gradual reductions in coercion that drift into this inefficient mid-range, followed by sharp increases. This dynamic suggests that coercion carries substantial exogenous costs such as economic and reputational costs and that delayed feedback on its legitimacy effects produces overshooting. Drawing on historical cases such as the USSR, we argue that moderate coercion proves inefficient due to an intrinsic negative reaction to coercion, or coercion resentment.
10.1007/s11127-026-01416-3.abstract_zh: 针对非国家道德的政治强制可成为合法性生成的工具。政治强制在产生合法性方面的效力是否会随其强度变化？通过使用自由之家、V-Dem和Polity5指数作为强制强度的代理变量，结合政权合法性与存续数据，我们发现中等强度的强制区间无法有效生成合法性。相对较少的政权处于这一中间地带，而处于该区间的政权表现出较低的合法性和较高的不稳定风险。相反，偏离这一次优区间——无论是向更高还是更低强制水平移动——与合法性提升显著相关。对威权政权的时间序列分析揭示了一种反复出现的模式：逐步降低强制力度会滑入这一低效的中间区间，随后出现急剧的强制升级。这一动态表明，强制会带来显著的外生成本（如经济成本和声誉成本），而对其合法性效应的延迟反馈会导致过度调整。借鉴苏联等历史案例，我们认为，由于强制会引发内在的负面反应（即强制怨恨），温和的强制被证明是低效的。
10.1007/s11127-026-01416-3.title: The inefficiency of moderate political coercion: a cross-country comparison of coercion intensity, state legitimacy, and regime stability
10.1007/s11127-026-01416-3.title_zh: 温和政治强制力的低效性：强制强度、国家合法性与政权稳定性的跨国比较

10.1007/s11127-026-01417-2.abstract: In societies where ethnic identity is salient and political institutions are weak, parties often promise ethnicity-specific public goods during elections – promises that voters view with skepticism. These strategies involve a trade-off between mobilizing co-ethnic voters and alienating others. Weak institutions increase the rent from office and lower the cost of reneging on promises. This paper analyzes equilibrium policy outcomes when candidates value both winning and implementing their preferred ethnicity-specific public goods, with deviations from announced platforms being costly. It provides a complete characterization of equilibrium policy implementation across all possible configurations of party ideal platforms. We find that even with low positive costs of non-commitment and office motivation, parties choose to announce their ideal platforms in equilibrium, regardless of bias alignment. This “ideal implementation zone” contracts as non-commitment costs and office motivation increase. When parties have opposing ethnic biases, the zone expands for the majority-biased party and contracts for the minority-biased one as the majority’s size increases. Additionally, we find that the higher provisioning of ethnic public goods is more likely in poorer societies characterized by a large majority group and weak political institutions.
10.1007/s11127-026-01417-2.abstract_zh: 在族群认同显著且政治制度薄弱的社会中，政党往往在选举期间承诺针对特定族群的公共产品——而选民对此类承诺持怀疑态度。这些策略涉及在动员同族选民与疏远其他选民之间的权衡。制度薄弱增加了执政的租金，并降低了违背承诺的成本。本文分析了当候选人既重视赢得选举又重视实施其偏好的族群特定公共产品，且偏离已宣布纲领需付出成本时的均衡政策结果。我们提供了在所有可能的政党理想纲领配置下均衡政策实施的完整刻画。研究发现，即使背弃承诺的成本和执政动机较低且为正，政党在均衡中仍会选择宣布其理想纲领，无论偏见方向如何。这一“理想实施区间”随着背弃承诺成本和执政动机的增加而收缩。当政党具有对立的族群偏见时，随着多数群体规模的增大，偏向多数群体的政党的区间扩大，而偏向少数群体的政党的区间缩小。此外，我们发现，在由庞大多数群体和薄弱政治制度所表征的较贫困社会中，族群公共产品供给水平更高的可能性更大。
10.1007/s11127-026-01417-2.title: Ethnic bias, commitment and public good provisioning
10.1007/s11127-026-01417-2.title_zh: 民族偏见、承诺与公共品供给

10.1007/s11127-026-01418-1.abstract: In his latest book, Dr. Aris Trantidis offers a new theory of clientelism. Supported by a careful reconceptualization of the term that avoids both conceptual stretching and excessive narrowing, and drawing on evidence from case studies that normally remain underexamined in the wider public choice literature, such as Greece and Argentina, the author describes how clientelism is a fundamental force in liberal-democratic politics, holding electoral politics and public policy hostage to the interests of a caste of clients and rendering constitutional limits on clientelist power obsolete (Trantidis 2024). In the author’s words, “Clientelism refers to the provision of resources and advantages by political actors—the patrons—to their clients through an agreement in which these benefits are made conditional on the beneficiaries’ political support in return” (p. 6). The reciprocal transaction in the definition avoids conceptual stretching by excluding pork-barrel politics, which does not demand anything in return from constituencies (p. 8). Furthermore, it distances clientelism from general interest-group politics, which is a broader category that can include lobbying without an obligation on the part of the patron (p. 9). Moreover, it does not conceptually narrow clientelism to electoral dynamics alone. Past public choice articles have tended to analyze patron-client relations and interest group politics only to the extent they affect electoral processes. For example, one study examines systems in which political parties are dedicated to clientelist exchange, purely through electoral strategies of vote-buying and turnout-buying (Gans-Morse et al. 2014). By contrast, Trantidis makes an original contribution to the field by expanding our view of clientelism to arenas that do not ordinarily fall under scholarly scrutiny. These arenas constitute a layer of horizontal links across clients in various institutions (labor unions, state-owned enterprises, private companies), all interacting with public administration, parties, and individual patrons (p. 27). Such horizontal connections are important to highlight, Trantidis argues, because they represent a “preselectorate”, in that securing influential clients from such sectors determines who will have the resources to compete and win an election and select for the type of policy platform which must satisfy clients before traditional vertical relationships between policymakers and the electorate ever enter the picture (pg.45). Two empirical examples, Greece (p. 55) and Argentina (p. 66), are of utmost importance to Trantidis because they illustrate how clientelist interests override even the necessity of resolving a fiscal crisis (Argentina) or reversing known policy failures (Greece).
10.1007/s11127-026-01418-1.abstract_zh: 在其最新著作中，阿里斯·特兰蒂迪斯博士提出了一种关于庇护主义的新理论。通过对该术语进行细致的重新概念化，既避免了概念过度延伸，也防止了过度狭隘化，并借鉴了公共选择文献中通常较少考察的案例研究证据，如希腊和阿根廷，作者阐述了庇护主义如何成为自由民主政治中的一股根本力量，使选举政治和公共政策受制于一群庇护对象的利益，并使对庇护权力的宪法限制形同虚设（Trantidis 2024）。用作者的话说，“庇护主义指的是政治行动者——即庇护者——通过一种协议向其庇护对象提供资源和优势，这些利益以受益人提供政治支持作为回报为条件”（第6页）。该定义中的互惠交易排除了猪肉桶政治，从而避免了概念延伸，因为猪肉桶政治不要求选区提供任何回报（第8页）。此外，它使庇护主义区别于一般的利益集团政治，后者是一个更广泛的范畴，可以包括游说活动，而不要求庇护者承担义务（第9页）。再者，它并未在概念上将庇护主义局限于选举动态。以往的公共选择文章往往仅在影响选举过程的范围内分析庇护者-庇护对象关系和利益集团政治。例如，一项研究考察了政党致力于庇护交换的制度，纯粹通过买票和买 turnout 的选举策略来实现（Gans-Morse et al. 2014）。相比之下，特兰蒂迪斯通过将我们对庇护主义的视野扩展到通常不受学术审视的领域，为该领域做出了原创性贡献。这些领域构成了各机构（工会、国有企业、私营公司）中庇护对象之间的横向联系层，所有这些都与公共行政、政党和个别庇护者互动（第27页）。特兰蒂迪斯认为，这些横向联系值得强调，因为它们代表了一个“预选选民群体”，因为从这些部门获得有影响力的庇护对象决定了谁将拥有资源和能力来竞争并赢得选举，并选择必须满足庇护对象的政策平台类型，而这一切都发生在政策制定者与选民之间的传统纵向关系进入视野之前（第45页）。两个实证案例，希腊（第55页）和阿根廷（第66页），对特兰蒂迪斯至关重要，因为它们说明了庇护利益如何甚至凌驾于解决财政危机（阿根廷）或扭转已知政策失败（希腊）的必要性之上。
10.1007/s11127-026-01418-1.title: Aris Trantidis, Clientelism. Shaftesbury Road, Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2025. iv + 84 pages. USD 23 (paperback)

10.1007/s11127-026-01419-0.abstract: This article examines the ontological foundations of two major strands within the field of public choice: the Virginia school, led by James M. Buchanan, and the Bloomington school, represented by Elinor and Vincent Ostrom. Although their early collaboration was guided by a shared ambition, we argue that any attempt to subsume these two strands under a single theoretical framework is problematic. It risks overlooking a fundamental ontological divide regarding the nature of collective action and the so-called ‘constitutional moment.’ Buchanan’s framework, centered on exchange among rational individuals and the principle of unanimity, sharply contrasts with the Ostroms’ institutionalist approach, which emphasizes reciprocity and the formation of “communities of shared understanding” as the basis of collective action. These ontological differences underpin distinct methodological commitments to individualism, and ultimately entail important nuances in their approaches to public governance. Whereas Buchanan focuses on protecting individual liberty from government intrusion, the Ostroms highlight individuals’ capacity to engage directly in the governance of the public sector. In sum, since differences emerge at a fundamental level of their theoretical frameworks, any attempt to integrate them inevitably risks a reductive interpretation. Bloomington, after all, is not in Virginia.
10.1007/s11127-026-01419-0.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了公共选择领域中两大主要流派的本体论基础：以詹姆斯·M·布坎南为首的弗吉尼亚学派，以及以埃莉诺和文森特·奥斯特罗姆为代表的布卢明顿学派。尽管他们早期的合作源于共同的抱负，但我们认为，任何试图将这两大流派纳入单一理论框架的做法都是有问题的。这可能会忽视关于集体行动本质及所谓“立宪时刻”的根本性本体论分歧。布坎南的理论框架以理性个体间的交换及一致同意原则为核心，与奥斯特罗姆夫妇的制度主义路径形成鲜明对比，后者强调互惠以及“共享理解社群”的形成作为集体行动的基础。这些本体论差异支撑了各自对个体主义方法论的不同承诺，并最终在其公共治理方法上体现出重要细微差别。布坎南侧重于保护个体自由免受政府干预，而奥斯特罗姆夫妇则强调个体直接参与公共部门治理的能力。总之，由于这些差异出现在其理论框架的根本层面，任何整合尝试都不可避免地面临简化解读的风险。毕竟，布卢明顿并非弗吉尼亚。
10.1007/s11127-026-01419-0.title: Why Bloomington is not in Virginia: Contrasting the social ontologies, methodologies, and governance theories of the Ostroms and Buchanan
10.1007/s11127-026-01419-0.title_zh: 为何布卢明顿不在弗吉尼亚：奥斯特罗姆与布坎南的社会本体论、方法论及治理理论之对比

10.1007/s11127-026-01420-7.abstract: Academic institutions and governance bodies are implementing rules that restrict the use of AI tools in research. This paper develops a formal interest-group theory of AI-tool governance in science, modeling such rules as the endogenous outcome of organized conflict within the scientific community over policies adopted by journals, funders, departments, and professional associations. Scientists differ in how much they gain from AI tools, while rank-relevant rewards, such as publication opportunities, grants, promotions, prizes, and professional recognition, depend partly on relative standing. Even when AI tools raise aggregate knowledge production, scientists with smaller AI-related productivity gains can invest resources to secure restrictions that compress rivals’ rank advantages. The equilibrium likelihood of restriction, lobbying expenditures, and rent dissipation are characterized in closed form in a Tullock contest framework. The model yields a welfare wedge: because rank-based rewards are privately valuable and partly positional, the chosen rules can be excessively restrictive relative to the social optimum. The mechanism is most relevant where governance bodies retain substantial discretion over rule-setting and where scientists cannot easily avoid restrictive policies by shifting to other venues. Restrictions are more likely when disclosure, sanction, or reputational concerns about AI use are more prominent, and when scientists favoring stricter rules are better represented in rule-setting bodies or better able to coordinate pressure for restriction. When scientists’ average net private gain from permissive AI use is positive, restrictions are also more likely when rank incentives are steeper and when AI increases the relative-performance advantage of high-complementarity scientists. The analysis yields testable predictions that distinguish this interest-group account from a public-interest account of AI-tool governance.
10.1007/s11127-026-01420-7.abstract_zh: 学术机构和治理主体正在实施限制研究中使用人工智能工具的规定。本文发展了一个关于科学中人工智能工具治理的正式利益集团理论，将这些规则建模为科学界内部围绕期刊、资助机构、院系及专业协会所采纳政策而发生的组织化冲突的内生结果。科学家在从人工智能工具中获益的程度方面存在差异，而与排名相关的奖励，如发表机会、资助、晋升、奖项和专业认可，部分取决于相对地位。即使人工智能工具提高了总体知识生产，那些人工智能相关生产率收益较小的科学家也可能投入资源以争取限制措施，从而压缩竞争对手的排名优势。在塔洛克竞争框架下，限制的均衡概率、游说支出和租金耗散均以闭式解形式刻画。该模型产生了一个福利楔子：由于基于排名的奖励具有私人价值且部分具有地位性，所选择的规则相对于社会最优状态可能过度严格。该机制在治理机构对规则制定保留实质性自由裁量权、且科学家无法通过转向其他场所轻易规避限制性政策的情况下最为相关。当关于人工智能使用的披露、制裁或声誉担忧更为突出，且支持更严格规则的科学家在规则制定机构中代表性更强或更能协调施加限制压力时，限制更可能发生。当科学家对允许使用人工智能的平均净私人收益为正时，若排名激励更为陡峭，且人工智能增加了高互补性科学家的相对绩效优势，限制也更可能发生。该分析产生了可检验的预测，将这一利益集团解释与人工智能工具治理的公共利益解释区分开来。
10.1007/s11127-026-01420-7.title: An interest-group theory of AI-tool governance in science
10.1007/s11127-026-01420-7.title_zh: 人工智能工具治理的利益集团理论

10.1007/s11127-026-01421-6.abstract: This paper examines the impact of political connections on firms’ make-or-buy decisions, focusing on outsourcing intensity. We develop a stylized model to illustrate two mechanisms. For small buyers, political connections mitigate bargaining disadvantages and increase the buyer’s share of revenue, which strengthens incentives to undertake headquarters investment and thus raises the attractiveness of outsourcing (a bargaining-power channel). For large buyers, political connections may increase the reputational costs of opportunistic behavior, thereby reducing hold-up risk, encouraging supplier investment, and increasing outsourcing (a reputational-discipline channel). For buyers of intermediate size, political connections have little effect, as such firms neither face severe bargaining disadvantages nor strong reputational constraints. Using data on Chinese listed firms from 2010 to 2020, we find evidence consistent with these mechanisms: political connections are associated with higher outsourcing intensity for small and large firms, while the relationship is weak for medium-sized firms.
10.1007/s11127-026-01421-6.abstract_zh: 本文考察了政治关联对企业自制或外购决策的影响，重点关注外包强度。我们构建了一个简化模型以阐述两种机制。对于小型买方，政治关联缓解了议价劣势，增加了买方在收入中的份额，从而强化了进行总部投资的激励，进而提升了外包的吸引力（议价能力渠道）。对于大型买方，政治关联可能增加机会主义行为的声誉成本，从而降低套牢风险，鼓励供应商投资，并促进外包（声誉约束渠道）。对于规模居中的买方，政治关联影响甚微，因为此类企业既未面临严重的议价劣势，也未受到强烈的声誉约束。利用2010年至2020年中国上市公司数据，我们发现了与这些机制相一致的证据：政治关联与小型和大型企业的外包强度呈正相关，而对中型企业而言，这一关系较弱。
10.1007/s11127-026-01421-6.title: Political connections, contract imperfections, and firm outsourcing
10.1007/s11127-026-01421-6.title_zh: 政治关联、合同不完全性与企业外包

10.1007/s11127-026-01422-5.abstract: We theoretically and empirically explore club-based promotions in hierarchical organizations. A game-theoretic model shows that strategic ambiguity in promotions—more specifically, an incentive scheme in which only top performers who pass a relative-performance threshold are eligible for promotions—may outperform single-prize tournaments in terms of both effort and leaders’ flexibility over personnel. Selection among threshold passers is independent of their performance and the discretionary choice of the leaders. Analysis of local officials’ career records in hierarchical governments in China over a 16-year period validates the existence of club-based patterns in governmental promotions. Thresholds are more lenient for higher-ranked positions and when relative performance is harder to measure.
10.1007/s11127-026-01422-5.abstract_zh: 我们从理论与实证两个维度探讨了层级组织中的俱乐部式晋升机制。一个博弈论模型表明，晋升中的策略性模糊——具体而言，即一种激励方案，其中只有超过相对绩效门槛的顶尖表现者才有资格获得晋升——在努力程度和领导者对人事安排的灵活性方面，可能优于单一奖项竞赛。门槛通过者的选拔与其表现无关，且不受领导者的自由裁量影响。对中国层级政府中地方官员16年职业生涯记录的分析，验证了政府晋升中俱乐部式模式的存在。门槛对于更高层级的职位以及相对绩效难以衡量时更为宽松。
10.1007/s11127-026-01422-5.title: The promotion club

10.1007/s11127-026-01423-4.abstract: Few mafia traditions have endured as long or been shared as widely as the pizzo . The pizzo was and is a customary payment collected from clients by Italian mafias in exchange for private protection. The value of the pizzo was vulnerable to two sources of dissipation. First, excess competition for clients from other mafiosi . Second, evasive behavior from clients themselves. I argue that Italian mafias created de facto property rights to limit those losses. To limit competition, mafias in Italy defined client ownership via territorial delineation. To limit opportunism by clients, mafias tailored pizzo terms in proportion to clients’ latitude for opportunism. Historical evidence from New York mafias and Italy’s retailing and construction industries supports my thesis.
10.1007/s11127-026-01423-4.abstract_zh: 很少有黑手党传统能像“保护费”（pizzo）那样持久且广泛流传。保护费过去是、现在依然是意大利黑手党向客户收取的、以换取私人保护的惯例性费用。保护费的价值面临两种损耗来源：其一，其他黑手党成员对客户的过度竞争；其二，客户自身的规避行为。本文认为，意大利黑手党通过创设事实上的产权来限制这些损失。为限制竞争，意大利黑手党通过地域划分界定客户所有权；为限制客户的投机行为，黑手党根据客户投机行为的空间量身定制保护费条款。来自纽约黑手党以及意大利零售业与建筑业的历史证据支持了本文论点。
10.1007/s11127-026-01423-4.title: Organized thuggery

10.1007/s11127-026-01424-3.abstract: The Borda count offers a promising alternative to counteract the growing polarization of party systems by incentivizing moderate party strategies. However, empirical evidence on the Borda count is still lacking. This paper presents results from an online survey conducted in the aftermath of the 2025 German federal election, in which respondents were asked for their vote choice under a Borda count system. Participants were randomly assigned to one of two conditions: in the first, they could rank up to three out of seven parties; in the second, they could rank all seven parties. The findings show that more ranks considered, the more fragmented the election result. It also shows that the Borda count has mixed effects on policy congruence between voters and parliament. Respondents’ overall acceptance of the Borda rule was moderate to negative, with many of the objections cited were based on misconceptions about the system’s consequences.
10.1007/s11127-026-01424-3.abstract_zh: 波达计数法通过激励政党采取温和策略，为应对政党体系日益加剧的两极分化提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，关于波达计数法的实证证据仍然匮乏。本文基于2025年德国联邦大选后开展的一项在线调查，呈现了受访者在波达计数法下的投票选择结果。参与者被随机分配到两种情境之一：第一种情境中，他们最多可对七个政党中的三个进行排序；第二种情境中，他们可对所有七个政党进行排序。研究结果表明，可排序的政党数量越多，选举结果越分散。同时，波达计数法对选民与议会之间的政策一致性产生了混合效应。受访者对波达规则的整体接受度处于中等偏负面水平，且许多反对意见源于对该制度后果的误解。
10.1007/s11127-026-01424-3.title: How voters choose under the Borda rule: evidence from a post-election survey experiment in Germany 2025
10.1007/s11127-026-01424-3.title_zh: 博尔达规则下选民如何选择：来自德国2025年选举后调查实验的证据

10.1007/s11127-026-01425-2.abstract: This paper applies the economic approach to the history of Christianity in the religious environment of the Roman Empire, a ground already covered by Stark, Ekelund and Tollison. We show that Greco-Roman religion was not in decline and was not threatened by Christianity either in terms of numbers or influence, but it was a fragile system because it lacked a professional priestly class with an interest in its continuance; hence, when the emperors raised Christianity to state religion, it was doomed. Christianity rose slowly and inconspicuously, struggling to extricate itself from its Jewish apocalyptic beginnings; it was not a superior doctrine, and specifically not a superior afterlife promise, that drove its growth in its sectarian centuries. Rather, Christians were able to achieve a distinctive doctrinal identity and organizational unity only when Toleration offered them both opportunity and incentive to become a universal religion, and the emperors bet on that. On this reading, for all it was hell-bent on destroying paganism, Christianity emerged as its killer only by accident.
10.1007/s11127-026-01425-2.abstract_zh: 本文运用经济学方法，探讨了罗马帝国宗教环境中基督教的历史，这一领域已有Stark、Ekelund和Tollison的研究基础。我们指出，希腊罗马宗教并未衰退，也未在人数或影响力上受到基督教的威胁，但它是一个脆弱的体系，因为缺乏一个对其存续有利益关联的专业祭司阶层；因此，当皇帝将基督教提升为国教时，它便注定消亡。基督教缓慢而不显眼地兴起，艰难地摆脱其犹太末世论起源；并非其教义更为优越，特别是并非其来世承诺更为出色，推动了其在教派世纪的成长。相反，只有当宽容政策为基督徒提供了成为普世宗教的机会和激励时，他们才能实现独特的教义认同和组织统一，而皇帝们则押注于此。据此解读，尽管基督教一心要摧毁异教，但它成为异教的终结者纯属偶然。
10.1007/s11127-026-01425-2.title: The rise of Christianity, the demise of Greco-Roman religion, and economics
10.1007/s11127-026-01425-2.title_zh: 基督教兴起、希腊罗马宗教衰落与经济学

10.1007/s11127-026-01426-1.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>How does district magnitude affect the quality of political representation? The Condorcet Jury Theorem (CJT) predicts that majority decisions improve with group size when members vote independently and are more likely than not to be correct. We test whether this aggregation mechanism applies to political decisions by examining whether larger legislative delegations better reflect constituent preferences. Nominal district magnitude often overstates the number of independent decision-makers because of party discipline. We therefore introduce effective district magnitude as a measure that more accurately captures the number of independently voting politicians within a constituency. Using 263 Swiss referenda (1992–2024) matched to parliamentary decisions, we find that the probability that a majority of a district’s delegation aligns with the preferences of its constituents increases with (effective) district magnitude, consistent with the CJT. The CJT aggregation mechanism closely predicts delegation-constituency congruence only for effective, not nominal, district magnitude. Our results provide empirical evidence that the CJT applies to representative democracies. They also show how party discipline limits the advantages of larger districts.</jats:p>
10.1007/s11127-026-01426-1.abstract_zh: 选区规模如何影响政治代表质量？孔多塞陪审团定理（CJT）预测，当成员独立投票且正确概率超过50%时，多数决策的质量随群体规模增大而提升。我们通过考察更大规模的立法代表团是否更能反映选民偏好，检验这一聚合机制是否适用于政治决策。由于政党纪律的存在，名义选区规模往往高估独立决策者的数量。为此，我们引入有效选区规模这一指标，以更准确地衡量选区内独立投票政治家的实际数量。通过将1992-2024年间263项瑞士公投结果与议会决策进行匹配，本研究发现：选区代表团多数意见与选民偏好一致的概率随（有效）选区规模扩大而上升，这与CJT的预测一致。CJT聚合机制仅在有效选区规模（而非名义选区规模）下能精确预测代表团与选民的偏好一致性。本研究为CJT适用于代议制民主提供了实证证据，同时揭示了政党纪律如何限制大选区优势。
10.1007/s11127-026-01426-1.title: Party discipline, representation, and the condorcet jury theorem
10.1007/s11127-026-01426-1.title_zh: 党纪、代表性与孔多塞陪审团定理

10.1007/s11127-026-01427-0.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Ranked choice voting (RCV) is one of the fastest-growing electoral reforms in the United States, yet few scholars have considered the degree to which RCV could be improved with a different elimination procedure. This paper examines RCV with three different elimination procedures: plurality elimination, negative plurality elimination, and Borda elimination. After some analytical observations, we examine how often RCV with each of these procedures violates three criteria separately: the Condorcet winner criterion, independence of eliminated alternatives, and monotonicity using data from RCV elections in the United States as well as simulated data from the Impartial Culture condition with some trailing rankings removed. Our results show that while there are few differences in US election data, Borda elimination consistently outperforms the traditional plurality elimination by a statistically significant amount in our simulations. Nevertheless, the magnitude of those difference are often small.</jats:p>
10.1007/s11127-026-01427-0.abstract_zh: 排序选择投票（RCV）是美国发展最快的选举改革之一，但鲜有学者探讨通过不同淘汰程序改进RCV的可能性。本文研究了三种淘汰程序下的RCV：简单多数淘汰、反向多数淘汰和波达淘汰。在分析性观察之后，我们分别检验了每种程序下的RCV违反三项标准的频率：孔多塞胜者准则、淘汰替代方案独立性以及单调性。研究数据来自美国RCV选举的实际数据，以及移除部分尾部排名的“公正文化”条件模拟数据。结果表明，尽管在美国选举数据中差异较小，但在模拟中，波达淘汰在统计上显著优于传统简单多数淘汰。不过，这些差异的幅度通常较小。
10.1007/s11127-026-01427-0.title: Ranked choice voting with different elimination procedures
10.1007/s11127-026-01427-0.title_zh: 不同淘汰程序下的排序选择投票

10.1007/s11127-026-01428-z.abstract: Which industries lobby the most? I study whether an industry’s position in the production network is associated with reported federal lobbying. The argument is that supplying many downstream customers creates two forces. A policy that helps a supplier can raise privately appropriable stakes when downstream benefits are partly capitalized back to the supplier through derived demand, supplier surplus, contracts, or preservation of customer relationships. The same downstream reach also expands the set of beneficiaries that can free-ride. The model therefore predicts a hump-shaped relationship between downstream reach and focal-industry lobbying. Using a panel of 71 U.S. industries from 1999 to 2023, I find a nonmonotone pattern in mapped LDA lobbying expenditures. The pattern appears in every annual cross-section and is stronger on spending among active industries than on lobbying entry. The estimates are descriptive and apply first to mapped spending. Only about one-third of reported spending maps cleanly to industries, and partial-identification bounds show that inference becomes weaker once the unmapped remainder is taken into account.
10.1007/s11127-026-01428-z.abstract_zh: 哪些行业游说支出最高？本文研究行业在生产网络中的位置是否与其联邦游说报告存在关联。核心论点在于：为众多下游客户供货会形成两种作用力。当下游收益通过派生需求、供应商盈余、合同关系或客户关系维护等渠道部分资本化回流至供应商时，有利于供应商的政策可能提升其可私人占有的利益规模。但同样的下游覆盖范围也会扩大可搭便车的受益群体。据此，模型预测下游覆盖范围与焦点行业游说支出呈驼峰型关系。基于1999年至2023年71个美国行业的面板数据，我发现映射至LDA游说支出的数据呈现非单调模式。该模式在每年度横截面数据中均存在，且对活跃行业游说支出的影响强度大于游说进入行为。这些估计结果具有描述性特征，首先适用于可映射的游说支出。在报告的总游说支出中，仅约三分之一能清晰映射至具体行业，而部分识别边界显示，一旦考虑未映射的剩余部分，推断效力将显著减弱。
10.1007/s11127-026-01428-z.title: Downstream centrality and industry lobbying in production networks
10.1007/s11127-026-01428-z.title_zh: 生产网络中的下游中心性与行业游说

10.1007/s11127-026-01429-y.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between voter turnout and elec0737toral polarization. While much of the existing literature focuses on how polarization affects turnout, we analyze the next step in the causal chain: how turnout shapes electoral outcomes. We propose a simple theoretical model in which turnout depends on voters’ aversion to the expected governing coalition, which increases with the distance between the voter’s ideal point and the anticipated policy platform. This generates heterogeneous participation across the ideological spectrum, leading to a compositional reweighting of the electorate. When the governing coalition is expected to be centrist, centrist voters are underrepresented while voters at the ideological extremes are overrepresented, resulting in higher levels of observed electoral polarization. We test the theoretical predictions empirically, using municipality-level data from Dutch general elections. The results show that turnout has systematically heterogeneous effects across parties depending on their ideological position, with more extreme parties benefiting disproportionately from lower turnout. Consistent with the theory, lower turnout is associated with higher levels of electoral polarization. These findings highlight a compositional mechanism through which turnout influences electoral outcomes, resulting in a distorted picture in which electoral polarization exceeds what would be implied by the underlying distribution of ideological preferences in the population.
10.1007/s11127-026-01429-y.abstract_zh: 本文考察了选民投票率与选举极化之间的关系。现有文献多聚焦于极化如何影响投票率，而我们则分析因果链条中的下一步：投票率如何塑造选举结果。我们提出了一个简洁的理论模型，其中投票率取决于选民对预期执政联盟的反感程度，这种反感随选民理想点与预期政策立场之间的距离增加而增强。这导致意识形态光谱上的参与不均，进而引起选民构成上的重新加权。当预期执政联盟趋于中间派时，中间派选民的代表性不足，而意识形态极端选民则过度代表，从而使得观察到的选举极化水平升高。我们利用荷兰大选的市级数据对理论预测进行了实证检验。结果显示，投票率对不同政党具有系统性异质性影响，取决于其意识形态立场，极端政党在低投票率下获益不成比例。与理论一致，较低的投票率与较高的选举极化水平相关联。这些发现揭示了一种构成性机制，通过该机制投票率影响选举结果，导致选举极化超过人口中潜在意识形态偏好分布所隐含水平的扭曲景象。
10.1007/s11127-026-01429-y.title: Turnout and the distortion of representation: the case of electoral polarization
10.1007/s11127-026-01429-y.title_zh: 投票率与代表性扭曲：选举极化的案例

10.1007/s11127-026-01430-5.abstract: Sociological rational choice theory (SRT) is a theoretical approach that values scientifically driven, theoretically grounded research, combining the methodological individualism and instrumental microfoundations used in economics with models of institutions, networks, and norms from sociology. Inspired by the public choice movement, SRT sought to apply rational choice theory to non-market behavior and the collective results of that behavior. At the time of its inception, SRT distanced itself from social exchange theory and the main lines of social network analysis. Whereas exchange theory readily incorporated network concepts and rooted itself in social psychology, advocates for rational choice pursued a strategy based on strong assumptions about individual rationality combined with a more flexible conception of bounded rationality. Despite being promoted by leading sociologists, SRT never attained a position at the center of the discipline, and debate on rational choice gradually died out. Mounting criticism of the rational action model in philosophy, cognitive psychology, and behavioral economics also took a toll on the appeal of rational choice and the confidence of its practitioners. Nevertheless, we conclude on an encouraging note.
