While American sociology has shown declining interest and involvement in SRT, new directions drawing on social network analysis, experimental methods, and efforts to adapt the dual-process framework of behavior show great promise. To some extent, rational choice sociology informs a vital part of the discipline in the United States and particularly in Europe.
10.1007/s11127-026-01430-5.abstract_zh: 社会学理性选择理论（SRT）是一种重视科学驱动、理论扎实的研究方法，它将经济学中的方法论个人主义和工具性微观基础与社会学中的制度、网络和规范模型相结合。受公共选择运动的启发，SRT旨在将理性选择理论应用于非市场行为及其集体结果。在其创立之初，SRT与社会交换理论及社会网络分析的主要流派保持距离。交换理论易于融入网络概念并植根于社会心理学，而理性选择的倡导者则采取了一种基于个体理性强假设与有限理性更灵活概念相结合的策略。尽管得到了顶尖社会学家的推崇，SRT从未成为学科核心，关于理性选择的辩论也逐渐消退。哲学、认知心理学和行为经济学中对理性行动模型的日益批评，也削弱了理性选择的吸引力及其实践者的信心。尽管如此，我们以鼓舞人心的结论收尾。虽然美国社会学对SRT的兴趣和参与度有所下降，但借鉴社会网络分析、实验方法以及适应行为双过程框架的新方向展现出巨大潜力。在某种程度上，理性选择社会学为美国，尤其是欧洲的学科重要组成部分提供了启示。
10.1007/s11127-026-01430-5.title: Sociological rational choice theory: retrospect and prospect
10.1007/s11127-026-01430-5.title_zh: 社会学理性选择理论：回顾与展望

10.1007/s11127-026-01431-4.abstract: Political agency models predict that officials with higher continuation values of office exert greater effort when observable performance is tied to career rewards. We test this prediction in China’s top-down cadre system, where the 2012 leadership reshuffle following the 18th Chinese Communist Party Congress coincided with the elevation of PM2.5 reduction to an explicit cadre-evaluation criterion. Using data from Chinese prefecture-level cities between 2008 and 2015, we implement a difference-in-differences design comparing cities led by first-term and reappointed leaders. We find that post-2012, first-term leaders achieved larger PM2.5 reductions than reappointed leaders. This gap reflects first-term leaders’ longer career horizons and weaker pre-existing capture relationships with incumbent polluters. Consistent with multitask incentive theory, first-term leaders exert greater effort on measurable, fast-acting administrative instruments such as production restrictions, while green subsidies and technological innovation show no significant term-stage difference. The paper provides new evidence on political agency, regulatory capture, and multitask incentives in top-down bureaucratic systems.
10.1007/s11127-026-01431-4.abstract_zh: 政治代理模型预测，当可观测的绩效与职业回报挂钩时，拥有更高任职延续价值的官员会付出更多努力。我们在中国自上而下的干部体系中检验了这一预测，该体系中2012年第十八届中国共产党全国代表大会后的领导层换届恰逢PM2.5减排被明确纳入干部考核标准。利用2008年至2015年间中国地级市的数据，我们采用双重差分设计，比较首任与连任领导所在城市的表现。研究发现，2012年后，首任领导所在城市的PM2.5降幅大于连任领导所在城市。这一差距反映了首任领导更长的职业前景以及与现有污染企业之间较弱的既有俘获关系。与多任务激励理论一致，首任领导在可衡量、见效快的行政手段（如生产限制）上投入更多努力，而绿色补贴和技术创新方面则未显示出显著的任期阶段差异。本文为自上而下官僚体系中的政治代理、监管俘获及多任务激励提供了新的证据。
10.1007/s11127-026-01431-4.title: New brooms sweep cleaner? political term and air pollution governance
10.1007/s11127-026-01431-4.title_zh: 新扫帚扫得更干净？政治任期与空气污染治理

10.1007/s11127-026-01432-3.abstract: Governments increasingly use pilot experimentation before national policy rollouts, but this strategy introduces policy uncertainty until reforms are permanently institutionalized. We study how resolving this uncertainty affects asset prices, exploiting China’s 2020 revision of the Land Management Law, which elevated previously experimental rural land reform pilots into a binding national legal framework. Using difference-in-differences estimates on land transactions in Deqing County from 2015 to 2022, we find that legal institutionalization increased rural construction land prices by 12.3%. This effect emerged immediately after institutionalization and gradually faded, consistent with belief updating and supply adjustment. Heterogeneity analysis supports the credible commitment channel: markets with greater state-owned enterprise (SOE) participation during the pilot phase show smaller effects, as state-owned enterprises’ privileged access to policy information had already driven prices toward uncertainty-free levels; and industrial land with 50-year tenure responds more strongly than commercial land with 40-year tenure, reflecting greater renewal risk exposure under shorter contracts. These findings highlight the asset-pricing costs of policy uncertainty and the value of credible commitment in transition economies.
10.1007/s11127-026-01432-3.abstract_zh: 各国政府在推行全国性政策之前，越来越多地采用试点实验的方式，但这一策略在改革永久制度化之前引入了政策不确定性。我们研究了消除这种不确定性如何影响资产价格，利用中国2020年《土地管理法》修订作为自然实验，该修订将此前实验性的农村土地改革试点提升为具有约束力的国家法律框架。通过对德清县2015年至2022年土地交易的差分估计，我们发现法律制度化使农村建设用地价格提高了12.3%。这一效应在制度化后立即显现并逐渐消退，与信念更新和供给调整相一致。异质性分析支持可信承诺渠道：试点阶段国有企业参与度较高的市场效应较小，因为国有企业获取政策信息的特权渠道已使价格趋近于无不确定性水平；此外，50年产权的工业用地比40年产权的商业用地反应更为强烈，反映出较短合同期限下更大的续期风险敞口。这些发现凸显了政策不确定性的资产定价成本以及转型经济中可信承诺的价值。
10.1007/s11127-026-01432-3.title: From pilots to law: policy uncertainty in rural land reform and land prices in China
10.1007/s11127-026-01432-3.title_zh: 从试点到法律：中国农村土地改革中的政策不确定性与土地价格

10.1007/s11127-026-01433-2.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We examine the effect of media freedom on public expenditure efficiency using a panel of 134 advanced and developing countries from 1994 to 2016. Our findings provide robust evidence that greater media freedom significantly enhances government spending efficiency. This effect is more pronounced in countries with higher levels of democracy, per capita income, human capital, internet access, and strong fiscal rules. Furthermore, we show that media freedom primarily influences efficiency through reduced corruption, increased transparency and accountability in the public sector, and stronger electoral competition. These results underscore the vital role of media freedom in fostering good governance and efficient public resource allocation, particularly in a context where press freedom is declining and fiscal constraints are tightening.</jats:p>
10.1007/s11127-026-01433-2.abstract_zh: 我们利用1994年至2016年间134个发达与发展中国家的面板数据，考察了媒体自由对公共支出效率的影响。研究结果提供了稳健证据，表明更高的媒体自由显著提升了政府支出效率。这一效应在民主水平、人均收入、人力资本、互联网接入程度较高以及财政规则严格的国家更为显著。此外，我们证明媒体自由主要通过减少腐败、提升公共部门透明度与问责制、以及增强选举竞争来影响效率。这些结果凸显了媒体自由在促进善治与公共资源高效配置中的关键作用，尤其是在新闻自由持续衰退、财政约束日益收紧的背景下。
10.1007/s11127-026-01433-2.title: Press freedom and government spending efficiency
10.1007/s11127-026-01433-2.title_zh: 新闻自由与政府支出效率

10.1007/s11127-026-01434-1.abstract: I document declining trust in the Executive and Legislative branches of the US federal government from 1972 onwards. Data are from General Social Survey questions asking whether respondents “have a great deal”, “only some,” or “hardly any” confidence “in those running these institutions”. Net confidence (percentage difference between “great deal” and “hardly any”) in the two branches has declined continually from nearly zero in the early 1970s, accelerating substantially from the 1990s on. Different processes drive this decline for each branch. Partisan and ideological opponents of the President increasingly distrust the incumbent while supporters are roughly neutral. Trust in the US Congress has been eroding more uniformly across all parties and ideologies. In recent years net confidence has been around -30 for the Executive and -45 for Congress. This profound distrust (10 times as many have hardly any v a great deal of confidence in Congress) is widely shared across main socio-demographics, such as age, gender, income, etc., though the decline is steeper for older and white respondents. The decline is also greater than for other institutions, including until recently the third branch (Supreme Court). I close by discussing implications for research in public choice.
10.1007/s11127-026-01434-1.abstract_zh: 本文记录了自1972年以来美国联邦政府行政与立法部门公信力持续下降的趋势。数据来源于综合社会调查中关于受访者对"这些机构管理者"信任程度的问题，选项包括"非常信任"、"部分信任"和"几乎不信任"。两部门的净信任度（"非常信任"与"几乎不信任"的百分比差值）从20世纪70年代初接近零的水平持续下滑，自20世纪90年代起加速恶化。不同部门公信力下降的驱动机制存在差异：总统的党派与意识形态反对者对其不信任程度持续加深，而支持者基本保持中立；美国国会的公信力则在所有党派与意识形态群体中呈现更均匀的侵蚀态势。近年来，行政部门的净信任度约为-30，国会约为-45。这种深度不信任（对国会"几乎不信任"的受访者数量是"非常信任"的十倍）广泛存在于年龄、性别、收入等主要社会人口学群体中，但老年群体和白人受访者的下降幅度更为显著。与其他机构（包括近期之前的第三部门——最高法院）相比，其下降幅度也更为突出。本文最后探讨了该现象对公共选择研究的启示。
10.1007/s11127-026-01434-1.title: The long decline of trust in democratic institutions
10.1007/s11127-026-01434-1.title_zh: 民主制度信任的长期衰退

10.1007/s11127-026-01435-0.abstract: This paper studies how social identification reshapes the political economy of law enforcement. In a two-class economy with property crime, individuals choose whether to offend, vote over the detection probability under majority rule, and choose whether to identify with their class or with the encompassing nation. In the absence of identity concerns, class-specific material preferences over enforcement depend on victimization exposure, tax incidence, and the option value of offending. With class identification, voters place greater weight on the relative payoff of their own group, so social identity amplifies the underlying distributive conflict. With national identification, voters place greater weight on aggregate payoffs, compressing preferred enforcement levels across groups. Endogenous identity choice produces distinct political regimes and can generate multiple equilibria: societies in which class differences are more salient in identity space are more likely to sustain class identification and more extreme enforcement outcomes, whereas higher national prestige favors national identification and policies closer to the aggregate benchmark. An extension in which offending carries an action-based social deviance cost preserves the main mechanism and shows how compliance norms can reinforce class-based identity.
10.1007/s11127-026-01435-0.abstract_zh: 本文研究社会认同如何重塑执法领域的政治经济学。在一个存在财产犯罪的两阶级经济体中，个体需选择是否犯罪、通过多数决规则投票决定犯罪侦破概率，并选择认同自身阶级或包容性国家。在缺乏身份认同的情况下，阶级间对执法的物质偏好差异取决于受害风险、税收负担及犯罪的机会成本。当存在阶级认同时，选民更重视本群体的相对收益，因此社会认同会加剧潜在的分配冲突。当存在国家认同时，选民更重视总体收益，从而压缩不同群体间的偏好执法水平。内生身份选择会产生不同的政治体制，并可能形成多重均衡：在身份空间中阶级差异更显著的社会，更易维持阶级认同并导致更极端的执法结果；而国家声望越高，则更有利于国家认同及更接近总体基准的政策。本文扩展模型引入基于行为的犯罪社会越轨成本，在保留核心机制的同时，揭示了合规规范如何强化阶级认同。
10.1007/s11127-026-01435-0.title: Social identification and equilibrium law enforcement

10.1007/s11127-026-01436-z.abstract: Government schooling is ubiquitous. Average government spending on education (World Bank 2026a) as a percent of GDP was 4.04% in 2022, approximately twice the average government spending on the military in the same year (World Bank 2026b). The folk justification for such a policy is that education is an in-kind transfer of $1 from the wealthy to more than $1 worth of human capital to the impoverished. Casual conjectural history presumes that such redistribution is a result of democratization, the native demand for the “great leveler” to be provided to the masses. Simple readings of history only pass the first glance OLS (ocular least squares) tests. Augustina Paglayan, in Raised to Obey: The Rise and Spread of Mass Education (2024) gives a new lens to this routinely overlooked topic and puts the history into sharper focus. The book establishes the origins of government schooling as prior to democratization. She argues that the provision of education to the lower orders was not elite altruism but a project to indoctrinate and pacify uncooperative lower classes. She makes her argument with a comprehensive description of the timing of government schooling relative to democratization, shows relationships with the timing of civil unrest and these policies, and digs further into several major case studies in Europe and South America.
10.1007/s11127-026-01436-z.abstract_zh: 政府办学无处不在。2022年，全球政府教育支出占GDP的平均比例为4.04%（世界银行，2026a），约为同年政府军事支出平均水平的两倍（世界银行，2026b）。对此类政策的普遍辩护是，教育是一种实物转移，即从富裕阶层向贫困阶层转移1美元，却创造出价值超过1美元的人力资本。随意的推测性历史叙述假定，这种再分配是民主化的结果，是民众对“伟大均衡器”提供给大众的内在需求。对历史的简单解读仅能通过初看时的“肉眼最小二乘法”（ocular least squares）检验。奥古斯丁娜·帕格莱扬在《被教导服从：大众教育的兴起与传播》（2024）一书中，为这一常被忽视的话题提供了新的视角，使历史更加清晰。该书确立了政府办学的起源早于民主化进程。她认为，向底层民众提供教育并非精英阶层的利他主义，而是一个旨在灌输思想并安抚不合作下层阶级的项目。她通过全面描述政府办学相对于民主化的时间顺序，展示这些政策与内乱时机的关联，并深入探讨了欧洲和南美洲的几个主要案例研究来论证其观点。
10.1007/s11127-026-01436-z.title: Review of Raised to Obey: The Rise and Spread of Mass Education by Augustina Paglayan
10.1007/s11127-026-01436-z.title_zh: 《服从教育：大众教育的兴起与传播》评介——奥古斯蒂娜·帕格拉扬著

10.1007/s11127-026-01437-y.abstract: Majoritarian democracy is widely regarded as the canonical procedure for converting heterogeneous individual preferences into collective decisions, yet its welfare properties are far more fragile than legal and political theorists suggest. This paper contributes to the literature on the limits of majoritarianism by applying a spatial voting model to demonstrate that the conditions under which majoritarian democracies produce efficient outcomes are narrowly constrained by the structural features of majority rule itself. We formalize a multidimensional policy environment in which voters bargain over both the policy vector and lump‑sum transfers. We show that—even with transferable utility among members of the majority coalitions—the equilibrium chosen by the pivotal majority is generally off the Pareto frontier. Taken together, these results establish an impossibility theorem for majority rule in multidimensional policy spaces: whether coalitions are stable or cyclical, simple majority voting fails to maximize aggregate welfare. Political externalities imposed on minorities systematically exceed the surplus gains accruing to decisive majorities, and vote trading cannot redress the loss. Institutional remedies—supermajority thresholds, agenda control, or issue-bundling constraints—are therefore necessary conditions for approaching efficiency under democratic decision-making.
10.1007/s11127-026-01437-y.abstract_zh: 多数主义民主被广泛视为将异质性个体偏好转化为集体决策的典范程序，然而其福利属性远比法律与政治理论家所认为的更为脆弱。本文通过应用空间投票模型，论证了多数主义民主产生有效结果的条件受到多数规则自身结构特征的严格限制，从而为关于多数主义局限性的文献做出贡献。我们形式化了一个多维政策环境，其中选民就政策向量与一次性转移支付进行讨价还价。我们证明——即使在多数联盟成员之间具有可转移效用的情形下——由关键多数所选择的均衡通常偏离帕累托前沿。综合来看，这些结果确立了多维政策空间中多数规则的不可能性定理：无论联盟是稳定的还是循环的，简单多数投票均无法最大化总体福利。施加于少数群体的政治外部性系统性超过决定性多数所获得的剩余收益，且选票交易无法弥补这一损失。因此，制度性补救措施——如超级多数门槛、议程控制或议题捆绑约束——是民主决策接近效率的必要条件。
10.1007/s11127-026-01437-y.title: The efficiency paradox of majoritarian democracy

10.1007/s11127-026-01438-x.abstract: This paper unifies public choice and public finance accounts of the flypaper effect under fiscal capacity as a common moderator, thereby organizing previously separate explanations into a single comparative-static framework. Using panel data on Chilean municipalities (2001–2021), we find that the flypaper response declines monotonically with fiscal capacity, from a transfer elasticity of 0.92 in the lowest-capacity quintile to statistical indistinguishability from zero in the highest; own-revenue elasticities show the opposite pattern. The gradient is robust to controls for municipality size and across alternative specifications. We read it as a regime statistic of a permanent institutional configuration with centrally fixed tax rates and formula-based intergovernmental grants, not as a treatment effect. The framework integrates the marginal cost of public funds from public finance with electoral accountability and soft budget constraints from public choice, each yielding the same prediction of monotonic decline. Uniform allocation rules amplify rather than neutralize the asymmetries they were designed to address, with implications for the design of intergovernmental transfer systems in developing countries. 10.1007/s11127-026-01438-x.abstract_zh: 本文将公共选择与公共财政对粘蝇纸效应的解释统一于财政能力这一共同调节变量之下，从而将此前相互独立的解释整合至一个比较静态分析框架中。利用智利市政当局的面板数据（2001-2021年），我们发现粘蝇纸效应随财政能力单调递减：在财政能力最低的五分之一组中，转移支付弹性为0.92，而在最高组中，该弹性在统计上与零无显著差异；自有收入弹性则呈现相反模式。这一梯度关系在控制市政规模变量及采用不同模型设定后依然稳健。我们将其解读为一种制度配置的体制性统计特征——该配置包含中央固定税率与基于公式的政府间转移支付——而非处理效应。该框架将公共财政中的公共资金边际成本与公共选择中的选举问责及软预算约束相整合，三者均得出单调递减的相同预测。统一分配规则非但未能抵消其旨在解决的不对称性，反而加剧了这种不对称，这对发展中国家政府间转移支付体系的设计具有启示意义。本文为订阅内容预览，请通过机构登录以获取访问权限。
10.1007/s11127-026-01438-x.title: Fiscal capacity and the flypaper effect
10.1007/s11127-026-01438-x.title_zh: 财政能力与粘蝇纸效应

10.1007/s11127-026-01439-w.abstract: This study examines how the interregional rotation of provincial Political and Legal Affairs Commission (PLAC) secretaries affects interregional market integration in China. Using province-pair panel data from 2003 to 2015, we find that a PLAC secretary’s prior work experience in another province significantly enhances market integration between the current and previous jurisdictions. The effect strengthens with longer prior tenure, consistent with regional favoritism in judicial enforcement. This mechanism is corroborated by analysis of civil court verdicts, which show that firms from connected provinces are more likely to receive favorable rulings. No similar effects are observed for other provincial officials at the same level. Moreover, the regional-favoritism effect is significantly weaker when the PLAC secretary has formal legal education or prior central-government experience, and it diminishes markedly after the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China in 2012, when a sweeping anti-corruption campaign was launched.
10.1007/s11127-026-01439-w.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨省级政法委员会书记的跨区域轮岗如何影响中国区域间市场整合。利用2003年至2015年的省份配对面板数据，我们发现，政法委员会书记在其他省份的先前工作经验显著促进了其当前与先前任职地区之间的市场整合。这一效应随着先前任职时间的延长而增强，与司法执行中的区域偏袒现象相符。通过对民事法庭判决的分析，这一机制得到了佐证，显示来自关联省份的企业更有可能获得有利判决。对于同级别的其他省级官员，未观察到类似效应。此外，当政法委员会书记具备正规法律教育背景或先前在中央政府的工作经验时，区域偏袒效应显著减弱；而在2012年十八大后，随着大规模反腐运动的开展，该效应也明显降低。
10.1007/s11127-026-01439-w.title: Rule of law or rule of ties? Interregional rotation of law enforcement officials and market integration in China
10.1007/s11127-026-01439-w.title_zh: 法治还是关系网？执法官员跨区域轮岗与中国市场整合

10.1007/s11127-026-01440-3.abstract: Subnational governments operating under the same federal fiscal arrangements often make markedly different tax policy choices. Research explains this variation through vertical relationships between subnational and national governments, horizontal relationships among subnational governments, or both, and along either economic or political logics. This study offers a unifying analytical framework integrating these dimensions and logics to help scholars locate their research within the wider literature, identify adjacent processes that may interact with or confound their focal mechanisms, and specify appropriate empirical strategies. I illustrate the framework’s value through analysis of Mexico’s state vehicle ownership tax (2008–2024). Situating the analysis within the framework yields three competing arguments about how horizontal economic and political logics interact. Spatio-temporal analysis shows that partisan competition, not geographic proximity, is the primary channel of horizontal tax policy interdependence. This partisan effect is conditional on neighbors’ tax activity, but in an unexpected way: it is strongest where neighboring states hold their taxes steady and weakest where they are cutting most heavily. The case demonstrates the framework’s usefulness in revealing new substantive findings and prompting new theoretical questions.
10.1007/s11127-026-01440-3.abstract_zh: 在相同联邦财政安排下运作的次国家级政府，往往制定出截然不同的税收政策选择。现有研究通过次国家级政府与中央政府间的纵向关系、次国家级政府间的横向关系，或两者兼而有之，并遵循经济或政治逻辑来解释这种差异。本研究提出一个整合这些维度与逻辑的统一分析框架，帮助学者在更广泛的文献中定位自身研究，识别可能与其核心机制相互作用或产生混淆的邻近过程，并制定适当的实证策略。通过分析墨西哥州级车辆所有权税（2008-2024年），本文展示了该框架的价值。将分析置于该框架内，可得出关于横向经济与政治逻辑如何相互作用的三个竞争性论点。时空分析表明，党派竞争（而非地理邻近性）是横向税收政策相互依存的主要渠道。这种党派效应取决于邻州的税收活动，但以出人意料的方式呈现：在邻州保持税率稳定的情况下效应最强，而在邻州大幅减税时效应最弱。该案例证明了该框架在揭示新实质性发现和引发新理论问题方面的实用性。
10.1007/s11127-026-01440-3.title: Beyond free riding or free racing: a framework for understanding subnational tax policy interdependence
10.1007/s11127-026-01440-3.title_zh: 超越搭便车或竞相逐底：理解次国家级税收政策相互依赖的框架

10.1007/s11127-026-01444-z.abstract: Evaluation systems often seek to reduce bias, prevent manipulation, preserve relevant information, maintain comparability, and treat candidates equally, but these fairness goals can conflict. This paper develops a framework for understanding such trade-offs in expert evaluation—including peer review, grant panels, academic hiring, and artistic competitions—where quality is multidimensional and legitimate disagreement among evaluators is possible. We treat the choice among evaluation procedures as a problem of constitutional design: rules must be selected before the specific candidates, evaluators, and circumstances that will test them are known. Classical music competitions are our primary analytical setting because their rules, scores, and controversies make these trade-offs unusually visible, but the framework applies to other settings in which expert judgments are aggregated under incomplete information. The framework highlights two core tensions: information control and outlier rules. First, when information is both quality-relevant and identity-revealing, procedures that suppress bias-relevant cues may also remove information with genuine evaluative content. Second, because sincere minority judgment and strategic manipulation can generate similar observed score patterns, score-based exclusion rules may reduce manipulation while limiting legitimate dissent. Two further trade-offs concerning transparency and standardization are developed as illustrations. The analysis shows that no procedure can eliminate all vulnerabilities at once. Beyond this design implication, the framework also helps explain why evaluation rules differ across stages and settings, and why well-intentioned reforms may create new vulnerabilities.
10.1007/s11127-026-01444-z.abstract_zh: 评估体系往往力求减少偏见、防止操纵、保留相关信息、维持可比性并平等对待候选人，但这些公平目标之间可能相互冲突。本文构建了一个框架，用以理解专家评估中的此类权衡——包括同行评审、资助评审小组、学术招聘和艺术竞赛——在这些场景中，质量是多维度的，且评审者之间存在合理的意见分歧。我们将评估程序的选择视为一项宪法设计问题：规则必须在具体候选人、评审者及可能检验这些规则的情境被知晓之前选定。古典音乐比赛是我们的主要分析场景，因为其规则、评分和争议使这些权衡异常清晰可见，但该框架同样适用于其他在信息不完整条件下汇总专家判断的情境。该框架突出了两个核心张力：信息控制与离群值规则。首先，当信息既与质量相关又揭示身份时，抑制偏见相关线索的程序也可能移除具有真实评价内容的信息。其次，由于真诚的少数派判断与策略性操纵可能产生相似的观察得分模式，基于得分的排除规则可能在减少操纵的同时限制合法的异议。另外两个关于透明度和标准化的权衡作为示例加以阐述。分析表明，没有任何程序能同时消除所有脆弱性。除这一设计启示外，该框架还有助于解释为何评估规则在不同阶段和情境中存在差异，以及为何出于善意的改革可能引发新的脆弱性。
10.1007/s11127-026-01444-z.title: Fairness trade-offs in expert evaluation: information, judgment, and procedural design
10.1007/s11127-026-01444-z.title_zh: 专家评价中的公平性权衡：信息、判断与程序设计

10.1007/s11127-026-01445-y.abstract: This paper examines how local governments adjust public budgets following immigration-induced demographic change. It argues that office-seeking incumbents reallocate fiscal resources towards newcomers if these are expected to become voters within a short time horizon. Such adjustments are constrained by uncertainty within governing coalitions over who will capture any resulting electoral gains. The argument is evaluated using data from 290 Swedish municipalities between 2014 and 2023. Empirically, the analysis relates annual changes in budget shares across 11 expenditure categories to annual changes in the local non-EU foreign-born population share. The findings show that larger increases in the non-EU population share are associated with budgetary reallocation towards spending areas that are particularly relevant to these groups. Ideological differences between left- and right-leaning governing coalitions do little to condition these reallocations, whereas broader coalitions exhibit weaker fiscal adjustment. The paper contributes to public choice and political economy research by showing that fiscal responses to demographic change take the form less of uniform expansion than of strategic budget recomposition, and that such adjustment is weaker where coalition partners are uncertain about the distribution of electoral gains.
10.1007/s11127-026-01445-y.abstract_zh: 本文考察了地方政府如何根据移民引发的人口结构变化调整公共预算。研究认为，谋求连任的现任官员会倾向于将财政资源重新分配给新移民群体，前提是这些群体有望在短期内成为选民。此类调整受到执政联盟内部不确定性的制约——各方难以预判谁能最终获取由此产生的选举收益。基于2014至2023年间瑞典290个市镇的数据，本文通过实证分析将11类支出项目的年度预算份额变化与当地非欧盟裔外国出生人口占比的年度变动相关联。研究发现，非欧盟裔人口占比增幅较大的地区，其预算会向与该群体特别相关的支出领域倾斜。左翼与右翼执政联盟之间的意识形态差异对此类预算调整的影响甚微，而更广泛的执政联盟则表现出较弱的财政调整力度。本文对公共选择与政治经济学研究的贡献在于：揭示财政对人口结构变化的反应并非表现为均等扩张，而是呈现战略性预算重组特征；同时指出，当联盟伙伴对选举收益分配存在不确定性时，此类调整的力度会显著减弱。
10.1007/s11127-026-01445-y.title: Office-seeking under demographic change: immigration, coalition government, and municipal budget reallocation in Sweden
10.1007/s11127-026-01445-y.title_zh: 人口变化下的职位追求：瑞典的移民、联合政府与市政预算再分配

10.1007/s11127-026-01446-x.abstract: A classic exchange between Tullock (1973: 1256–1257.")) and Parks (1975: 225–226. https://doi.org/10.1086/260317 .")) debated whether universities should concentrate research support on senior or junior faculty. Both made their arguments informally. We formalise the two positions and then ask which conclusions survive when the scarce input is AI compute rather than secretarial help. Under complementary inputs, aggregate-output maximisation favours juniors, while minimum-output objectives favour seniors. With AI modelled as a more substitutable input, greater substitutability alone does not reverse the junior-favouring allocation when faculty differ only in career incentives. Only the perfect substitutes limit removes the junior advantage by making the department indifferent. Reversal requires that senior faculty also possess a human-capital advantage. Sufficiently high substitutability can then shift the allocation towards seniors. A two-period extension shows why the dynamic case for juniors depends on additional primitives such as longer career horizons or steeper AI learning curves. Two appendices establish that neither the two-researcher representation nor quadratic effort costs drives the central invariance result.
10.1007/s11127-026-01446-x.abstract_zh: Tullock（1973: 1256–1257）与Parks（1975: 225–226）之间的一场经典辩论，探讨了大学是否应将研究支持集中于资深教师或青年教师。双方均以非正式方式提出论点。我们将其两种立场形式化，并考察当稀缺投入从秘书协助转变为人工智能算力时，哪些结论依然成立。在互补性投入条件下，总产出最大化倾向于支持青年教师，而最低产出目标则倾向于资深教师。当人工智能被建模为更具替代性的投入时，若教师仅存在职业激励差异，则更高的替代性本身并不会逆转偏向青年教师的资源配置。只有在完全替代的极限情形下，部门才会因无差异而消除青年教师的优势。逆转需要资深教师同时拥有人力资本优势，此时足够高的替代性才能使资源配置向资深教师倾斜。两期扩展模型揭示了为何动态情形下支持青年教师的结论依赖于额外前提条件，例如更长的职业周期或更陡峭的人工智能学习曲线。两个附录证明，无论是双研究者表征还是二次努力成本，均不驱动核心不变性结果。
10.1007/s11127-026-01446-x.title: Allocating faculty compute budgets

10.1007/s11127-026-01447-w.abstract: Several recent constitution-making processes have been celebrated for being participatory, inclusive, and representative. However, many of these processes also failed. We theorize that aspects of these kinds of constitutional drafting processes could reduce the probability of constitutional success. To show why, we construct a “Constitution Drafting game” (CD game) in which representatives from different interest groups must draft a constitution. We consider the case where the probability of constitutional success is single peaked, but the value from successful adoption is increasing in the degree of issue protection chosen. The drafting process then leads to protection choices that are above those which maximize the odds of constitutional success. Moreover, when the CD game is equivalent to a “nice aggregative game”, as in Acemoglu and Jensen (2013), the maximum and minimum equilibrium probabilities of constitutional success are decreasing in the number of representatives. Within a more specific game structure, we show that the symmetric equilibrium degree of protection chosen by each representative is decreasing in the number of interest groups represented, while the total degree of protection is increasing in it, leading to lower probabilities of constitutional success. We explain how optimism can exacerbate the degree of protection chosen by each party.
10.1007/s11127-026-01447-w.abstract_zh: 近期若干制宪过程因参与性、包容性和代表性而备受赞誉。然而，其中许多过程也以失败告终。我们提出理论，认为这类宪法起草过程的某些特征可能降低宪法成功的概率。为阐明原因，我们构建了一个“宪法起草博弈”（CD博弈），其中来自不同利益集团的代表必须起草一部宪法。我们考虑宪法成功概率呈单峰状，但成功采纳的价值随所选议题保护程度递增的情形。起草过程因此导致保护程度的选择高于最大化宪法成功概率的水平。此外，当CD博弈等同于Acemoglu和Jensen（2013）所定义的“良性聚合博弈”时，宪法成功的最大和最小均衡概率随代表人数的增加而递减。在更具体的博弈结构中，我们证明每位代表所选的对称均衡保护程度随所代表利益集团数量的增加而递减，而总保护程度则随其增加而递增，从而导致宪法成功概率降低。我们解释了乐观情绪如何加剧各方所选保护程度。
10.1007/s11127-026-01447-w.title: Constitutional drafting processes and constitutional success
10.1007/s11127-026-01447-w.title_zh: 宪法起草过程与宪法成功

10.1007/s11127-026-01448-9.abstract: Do campaign contributions polarize legislators or induce moderation? Theory allows for both possibilities, with effects likely varying by donor type. Using data on all contributions received by members of the U.S. House of Representatives from 2001 to 2022, this paper examines how Political Action Committee (PAC) and individual donations affect subsequent roll-call voting behavior. The analysis focuses on within-legislator changes in ideological positioning across congressional terms. The results consistently show that increased contributions are associated with greater moderation on the economic dimension of roll-call voting. Republican legislators shift toward the political center following increases in both PAC and individual donations in the previous congress. Democratic legislators are more ideologically stable, exhibiting relatively modest centrist movement in response to higher levels of individual contributions. Dynamic specifications suggest that these associations accumulate over successive electoral cycles, most robustly for Republican PAC receipts. Additional analysis reveals a dimensional asymmetry: the centripetal pattern is specific to economic voting, while on the social dimension higher fundraising is if anything associated with more extreme positioning among Republicans. Overall, the findings suggest that campaign contributions in the contemporary U.S. House are associated with economic moderation rather than polarization.
10.1007/s11127-026-01448-9.abstract_zh: 竞选捐款究竟是使立法者走向极化，还是促使其趋于温和？理论上两种可能性均存在，其效应可能因捐赠者类型而异。本文利用2001年至2022年间美国众议院议员收到的所有捐款数据，考察政治行动委员会（PAC）和个人捐赠对后续唱名表决行为的影响。分析聚焦于议员在国会任期之间意识形态定位的个体内部变化。结果一致表明，捐款增加与唱名表决在经济维度上的更大温和化相关。共和党议员在上一届国会中收到PAC和个人捐赠增加后，会向政治中心靠拢。民主党议员在意识形态上更为稳定，仅在个人捐赠水平较高时表现出相对适度的中间化动向。动态设定表明，这些关联在连续选举周期中累积，其中共和党PAC收入的效果最为稳健。进一步分析揭示了维度上的不对称性：向心模式仅体现在经济投票上，而在社会维度上，筹款增加若有所关联，则与共和党议员更极端的立场相关。总体而言，研究结果表明，当代美国众议院中的竞选捐款与经济温和化相关，而非极化。
10.1007/s11127-026-01448-9.title: Money talks, moderation walks: the centripetal impact of campaign contributions in the U.S. house
10.1007/s11127-026-01448-9.title_zh: 金钱说话，温和走开：竞选捐款对美国众议院的向心影响

10.1007/s11127-026-01450-1.abstract: We consider a committee facing binary decisions on a number of proposals. If members vote sincerely and payoffs are symmetrically distributed, we show analytically that simple majority rule is the best q-majority rule in an aggregate or expected payoff sense. We argue that this (well known) pattern changes systematically if the committee faces multiple decisions and members engage in logrolling deals. In a simulation exercise, we find that unanimity rule outperforms majority rule when the number of proposals considered is large enough. We complement our analysis with a laboratory experiment designed to investigate whether human subjects engage in the logrolling deals assumed in our simulations. We find that deals associated with large negative externalities are less likely to arise than others, as are “complex” deals involving many voters or proposals. These results suggest that the impact of logrolling on the relative performance of the decision rules considered may be mitigated by cognitive constraints and other-regarding preferences.
10.1007/s11127-026-01450-1.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个委员会在多项提案上做出二元决策的情形。若成员真诚投票且收益呈对称分布，我们通过分析证明，简单多数规则在总体或期望收益意义上是最优的q-多数规则。我们论证，若委员会面临多项决策且成员参与互投赞成票（logrolling）交易，这一（众所周知的）模式将系统性改变。在模拟实验中，我们发现，当考虑的提案数量足够多时，一致同意规则优于多数规则。我们通过一项实验室实验补充分析，旨在探究人类被试是否参与我们模拟中所假设的互投赞成票交易。我们发现，涉及巨大负外部性的交易比其他交易更不易出现，涉及众多选民或提案的“复杂”交易同样如此。这些结果表明，互投赞成票对所考虑决策规则相对表现的影响，可能因认知约束及他人导向偏好而有所减弱。
10.1007/s11127-026-01450-1.title: Logrolling affects the relative performance of majority and unanimity rule
10.1007/s11127-026-01450-1.title_zh: 互投赞成票影响多数规则与全体一致规则的相对绩效

10.1007/s11127-026-01451-0.abstract: How does partisan conflict (PC) relate to economic policy uncertainty (EPU)? When does uncertainty feed back into conflict, and how stable is that link? We examine these dynamics using a time-varying Granger causality framework applied to United States monthly data from 1985 to 2025, combining the PC Index with aggregate and disaggregated EPU subindices. PC consistently precedes spikes in fiscal, tax, spending, and health care uncertainty. In contrast, the predictive direction reverses mainly during large shocks, such as trade conflicts or financial regulation crises, and largely disappears during recessions. Generalised forecast error variance decompositions show that PC shocks account for a modest but non trivial share of forecast error variance in fiscal, tax, spending, and health care uncertainty, while policy shocks in trade and regulatory domains explain a much larger share of the variance in partisan conflict itself. These results reveal asymmetric, time-varying predictive linkages between political polarization and policy uncertainty. The findings, which are based on the decomposition of EPU into its components and time-varying Granger causality, contribute to theories of veto players, gridlock, and signaling by identifying the institutional conditions under which political conflict is associated with greater economic volatility and when policy uncertainty appears to reinforce partisan division.
10.1007/s11127-026-01451-0.abstract_zh: 党派冲突（PC）与经济政策不确定性（EPU）之间存在何种关联？不确定性何时会反馈至冲突之中，且这一联系的稳定性如何？我们运用时变格兰杰因果框架，结合美国1985年至2025年的月度数据，将PC指数与总体及分项EPU子指数相结合，对上述动态进行了考察。PC始终先于财政、税收、支出及医疗保健领域不确定性的飙升。相反，预测方向主要在大规模冲击期间发生逆转，如贸易冲突或金融监管危机，并在经济衰退期间基本消失。广义预测误差方差分解显示，PC冲击对财政、税收、支出及医疗保健不确定性预测误差方差的贡献虽适度但不可忽视，而贸易和监管领域的政策冲击则解释了党派冲突自身预测误差方差的更大份额。这些结果揭示了政治极化与政策不确定性之间非对称、时变的预测关联。基于EPU分项分解及时变格兰杰因果的发现，通过识别政治冲突与经济波动加剧相关联的制度条件，以及政策不确定性似乎强化党派分歧的情境，为否决者、僵局及信号传递理论作出了贡献。
10.1007/s11127-026-01451-0.title: Partisan conflict and economic policy uncertainty: insights from a time-varying causality approach
10.1007/s11127-026-01451-0.title_zh: 党派冲突与经济政策不确定性：基于时变因果方法的洞察

10.1007/s11127-026-01452-z.title: Rent-seeking and litigation: some underappreciated virtues of reverse contingency fees
10.1007/s11127-026-01452-z.title_zh: 寻租与诉讼：反向胜诉费制度中被低估的若干优点

10.1007/s11127-026-01453-y.title: Private governance and the limits of state antiquity
10.1007/s11127-026-01453-y.title_zh: 私人治理与国家古代性的限度

10.1007/s11127-026-01454-x.title: Pension’s resource-time trade-off: the role of inequalities in the design of retirement schemes
10.1007/s11127-026-01454-x.title_zh: 养老金资源-时间权衡：退休制度设计中不平等的作用

10.1007/s11127-026-01455-w.title: Dual regulation and the cost of electricity rents to households: evidence from Texas
10.1007/s11127-026-01455-w.title_zh: 双重监管与家庭电力租金成本：来自德克萨斯州的证据

10.1007/s11127-026-01456-9.abstract: Since the pioneering work of Lizzeri and Persico (2001), it has been well known that, in winner-take-all systems, office-motivated politicians may favor targeted redistribution over the provision of public goods. Motivated by the possibility that similar incentives may arise even in small organizations, we examine a policy proposal to revise a journal-ranking system in a medium-sized Economics Department. At the same time, a majority of faculty members signed a petition on an unrelated issue publicly supporting the department’s governance. Using individual publication records, we analyze whether the distributional consequences of the proposed reform were systematically related to such support. We find that faculty members who signed the petition were significantly more likely to benefit from the initial proposal, while this association became considerably weaker after an open departmental discussion and a subsequent revision of the proposal. The observed pattern is consistent with theories emphasizing distributive incentives and the disciplining role of transparency in collective decision-making though alternative readings of the revision cannot be excluded.
10.1007/s11127-026-01456-9.abstract_zh: 自Lizzeri和Persico（2001）的开创性工作以来，众所周知，在赢者通吃的制度下，以职位为导向的政治家可能更倾向于针对性的再分配，而非公共品的提供。鉴于类似激励可能在小规模组织中也出现的可能性，我们考察了一项旨在修订某中等规模经济系期刊排名制度的政策提案。与此同时，该系多数教员签署了一份请愿书，就一项无关事宜公开支持系里的治理。利用个人发表记录，我们分析了拟议改革的分配后果是否与这种支持存在系统性关联。我们发现，签署请愿书的教员在初始提案中显著更可能受益，而在经过系内公开讨论及提案修订后，这一关联显著减弱。观察到的模式与强调分配激励及透明度在集体决策中约束作用的理论相符，尽管对修订过程的其他解读亦无法排除。
10.1007/s11127-026-01456-9.title: Electoral incentives when the stakes are low: a case study from an economics department
10.1007/s11127-026-01456-9.title_zh: 低风险下的选举激励：经济学系的案例研究

10.1007/s11127-026-01458-7.abstract: Populist parties have grown rapidly in popularity in many European countries and have increasingly become common in government coalitions. Because these parties often make expansive promises and derive much of their appeal from their outsider status, entering government may become an electoral liability by the next election. Analyzing populist and mainstream parties in 32 European countries from 1980 to 2023, we estimate the average electoral effect of government participation. We find a post-power penalty of about 4.5–5 percentage points on average. This penalty is remarkably similar for populist and mainstream parties, suggesting that populist parties do not suffer an additional electoral cost from governing. Moreover, the size of the post-power penalty does not vary systematically with growth, inequality, social spending, globalization, or unemployment during the governing term. These findings suggest that bringing populist parties into government does not, by itself, impose a distinctive electoral cost on them relative to other incumbent parties.
10.1007/s11127-026-01458-7.abstract_zh: 民粹主义政党在许多欧洲国家的支持率迅速上升，并日益成为政府联盟中的常见成员。由于这些政党往往做出宏大的承诺，并主要依靠其局外人身份吸引选民，进入政府可能会在下次选举中成为其选举上的不利因素。通过分析1980年至2023年间32个欧洲国家的民粹主义政党与主流政党，我们估计了政府参与的平均选举效应。研究发现，执政后平均存在约4.5至5个百分点的惩罚效应。这一惩罚对民粹主义政党与主流政党而言惊人地相似，表明民粹主义政党并未因执政而承担额外的选举成本。此外，执政期间的增长、不平等、社会支出、全球化或失业率并未系统性地改变执政后惩罚的大小。这些发现表明，将民粹主义政党纳入政府本身，并不会相对于其他执政党对其施加独特的选举成本。
10.1007/s11127-026-01458-7.title: A hangover like any other: the cost of ruling for populist parties
10.1007/s11127-026-01458-7.title_zh: 宿醉如常：民粹主义政党的执政代价

10.1007/s11127-026-01459-6.abstract: Existing theories explain how exit disciplines governments but generally treat citizens’ ability to relocate as an institutional primitive. This paper instead endogenizes exit protection by modeling jurisdictions that first choose whether to preserve or eliminate mobility before competing through extraction. Although preserving exit uniquely maximizes investment and social welfare, it is not self-enforcing because jurisdictions can profit by creating captive populations. Exit protection is therefore institutionally fragile. The paper then evaluates alternative constitutional architectures capable of addressing this incentive problem and develops one formally. The analysis identifies a benchmark constitutional architecture under which decentralized political orders could, in principle, sustain exit without relying on hierarchical enforcement, repeated interaction, or citizen coercive power.
10.1007/s11127-026-01459-6.abstract_zh: 现有理论解释了退出机制如何约束政府，但通常将公民的迁移能力视为制度上的既定前提。本文则将退出保护内生化，通过构建模型，探讨辖区在通过征收进行竞争之前，首先选择是保留还是消除流动性。尽管保留退出机制在最大化投资和社会福利方面具有唯一优势，但它并非自我实施，因为辖区可以通过制造受困人口来获利。因此，退出保护在制度上是脆弱的。本文随后评估了能够应对这一激励问题的替代性宪法架构，并正式发展出一种架构。分析识别出一种基准宪法架构，在此架构下，分散的政治秩序原则上能够在不依赖层级执行、重复互动或公民强制力量的情况下维持退出机制。
10.1007/s11127-026-01459-6.title: The political economy of exit protection
10.1007/s11127-026-01459-6.title_zh: 退出保护的政治经济学

10.1007/s11127-026-01460-z.title: Electoral cycles and consumption in India

10.1007/s11127-026-01461-y.abstract: We consider a framework which brings together losses arising from rent-dissipation and the workhorse model of law enforcement. Governmental actors engage in a contest to share the proceeds from the enforcement of the law through monetary fines, which leads to rent-dissipation. This causes monetary sanctions to be costly, rendering the model used for studying nonmonetary sanctions a better fit for their analysis. The effect of rent-dissipation on optimal sanctions is directly related to the sanction elasticity of offenses measured at the classic optimum (i.e., where the expected sanction equals the direct harm from the offense). When offenses are inelastic, the optimal sanction is smaller than the classic optimum and it is decreasing in the degree of rent-dissipation; and a legislator who does not fully internalize contest costs chooses an overly punitive sanction which is smaller than the classic optimum. The opposite results are obtained when offenses are elastic. We discuss implications and extensions.
10.1007/s11127-026-01461-y.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个框架，将租金耗散带来的损失与法律执行的经典模型相结合。政府行为者通过参与竞争以分享法律执行中货币罚款所产生的收益，这导致了租金耗散。这使得货币制裁变得代价高昂，从而使研究非货币制裁的模型更适用于此类分析。租金耗散对最优制裁的影响，直接与在经典最优状态（即预期制裁等于犯罪直接危害之处）下测得的犯罪制裁弹性相关。当犯罪缺乏弹性时，最优制裁小于经典最优值，并随租金耗散程度的增加而减小；而未能完全内化竞争成本的立法者会选择一种过度惩罚性的制裁，该制裁小于经典最优值。当犯罪具有弹性时，则得到相反的结果。我们讨论了相关含义及扩展方向。
10.1007/s11127-026-01461-y.title: Law enforcement with rent dissipation

10.1007/s11127-026-01462-x.abstract: Academic freedom empowers scholars to influence public discourse and debate, cultivate critical reasoning, discuss ideas that challenge traditional values, and impose a soft check and balance on governments. For those reasons, governments have specific preferences regarding the extent of academic freedom, especially when led by populists, whose ideology, values, and strategic features are frequently at odds with the implications of this freedom. Using a quasi-experimental design, we confirm that academic freedom declines significantly under populist governments, a pattern largely independent of their host ideology. Those negative consequences increase after multiple populist terms, and extend more broadly to the substance of speech and the flow of information. Altogether, these results highlight the incompatibility of populism with democratic guarantees.
10.1007/s11127-026-01462-x.abstract_zh: 学术自由赋予学者影响公共话语与辩论、培养批判性思维、探讨挑战传统价值观的思想，并对政府施加一种软性的制衡机制。正因如此，各国政府，尤其是民粹主义领导下的政府，对学术自由的程度持有特定偏好，因为民粹主义的意识形态、价值观及策略特征往往与此自由的意涵相悖。通过准实验设计，我们证实民粹政府治下学术自由显著下降，且这一模式在很大程度上不受其所属意识形态的影响。这些负面效应在民粹执政多届后加剧，并更广泛地波及言论实质与信息流通。总体而言，这些结果凸显了民粹主义与民主保障之间的不相容性。
10.1007/s11127-026-01462-x.title: Populism and academic freedom

10.1007/s11127-026-01463-w.title: Gubernatorial partisanship and housing outcomes: evidence from close elections
10.1007/s11127-026-01463-w.title_zh: 州长党派属性与住房结果：来自势均力敌选举的证据

10.1007/s11127-026-01464-9.title: Beyond six versus twelve: Kian v. Florida and the design of the criminal jury
10.1007/s11127-026-01464-9.title_zh: 超越六人与十二人之争：基安诉佛罗里达州案与刑事陪审团的设计

10.1007/s11127-026-01465-8.title: Gary D. Libecap, Where’s Coase? The implications of economic property rights or rent-seeking in forming institutions
10.1007/s11127-026-01465-8.title_zh: 加里·D·利贝卡普，《科斯在哪里？经济产权或寻租对制度形成的影响》

10.1007/s11142-026-09971-2.abstract: We propose a framework to assess the decision-usefulness of heterogeneous disclosure practices that managers use to convey information to market participants. We illustrate an application of our framework to non-GAAP earnings, management earnings guidance, and earnings conference calls. We first identify key quality attributes for each disclosure practice and then develop a list of quality metrics that we apply to a small pilot sample. We focus on metrics that are easily measured in real time and discuss the practical challenges of conducting assessments of disclosure quality at the firm-quarter-disclosure level. Our descriptive analysis provides preliminary insights into whether and how voluntary disclosure quality varies across firms and highlights the interconnectedness of these disclosure practices. We discuss future research opportunities to expand and fine-tune the application of the framework to develop a comprehensive disclosure quality assessment.
10.1007/s11142-026-09971-2.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个框架，用以评估管理者向市场参与者传递信息时所采用的不同披露实践的信息决策有用性。我们展示了该框架在非公认会计原则盈利、管理层盈利指引及盈利电话会议中的应用实例。首先，我们识别每种披露实践的关键质量属性，随后制定一套质量指标清单，并将其应用于一个小型试点样本。我们侧重于易于实时衡量的指标，并讨论在企业-季度-披露层面进行披露质量评估所面临的实际挑战。我们的描述性分析初步揭示了自愿性披露质量是否以及如何在企业间存在差异，并强调了这些披露实践之间的相互关联性。我们探讨了未来研究机会，以扩展和微调该框架的应用，旨在开发全面的披露质量评估体系。
10.1007/s11142-026-09971-2.title: Beyond earnings quality: evaluating the quality of corporate disclosure practices
10.1007/s11142-026-09971-2.title_zh: 超越盈余质量：评估公司信息披露实践的质量

10.1007/s11142-026-09975-y.abstract: We consider how images (i.e., photos but not graphs, charts, or infographics) in annual reports provide users with information and use machine-learning algorithms to assess their informativeness. We develop a metric of content reinforcement, defined as the degree to which information investors extract from images complements and reinforces details in textual narratives. We find that firms are more likely to use images when they experience greater asset growth, have greater business complexity, and provide less readable textual disclosures—suggesting images are used more often when information processing costs are high. Our main results indicate that increases in visual prevalence and the extent to which images reinforce text are associated with greater analyst forecast accuracy and lower dispersion, suggesting that images improve users’ information processing. Firms also increase image use after an exogenous decline in analyst coverage. Overall, firms use images when their information environment is poorer, and visual informativeness facilitates information assimilation.
10.1007/s11142-026-09975-y.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了年度报告中图像（即照片，而非图表、图形或信息图）如何向用户提供信息，并运用机器学习算法评估其信息含量。我们构建了一个内容强化指标，定义为投资者从图像中提取的信息与文本叙述中的细节相互补充并强化的程度。研究发现，当企业资产增长较快、业务复杂度较高且文本披露可读性较低时，企业更倾向于使用图像——这表明在信息处理成本较高的情况下，图像的使用更为频繁。我们的主要结果表明，视觉呈现度的提升以及图像对文本强化程度的增加，与分析师的预测准确度提高和预测离散度降低相关，从而说明图像改善了用户的信息处理能力。此外，在分析师覆盖范围出现外生性下降后，企业也会增加图像的使用。总体而言，企业在信息环境较差时更倾向于使用图像，而视觉信息有助于促进信息的吸收与整合。
10.1007/s11142-026-09975-y.title: “Show Me!” The Informativeness of images in firms’ annual reports
10.1007/s11142-026-09975-y.title_zh: 展示给我看！”企业年报中图像的信息含量

10.1007/s11142-026-09982-z.abstract: We study the impact of an online market’s policy (environmental policy) offering entrepreneurs the option to disclose their environmental engagement on entrepreneurship outcomes, using Kickstarter as a laboratory. Following the policy’s implementation, 32.4% of entrepreneurs opted to disclose their environmental commitments. Using the passage of the environmental policy as an instrument, we show that environmental commitment improves funding outcomes, with the funding success rate increasing by 13.2% and the pledged funding ratio by 8.7%. Environmental commitment also attracts more environmentally conscious backers and brings in new backers, which likely contributes to these improved outcomes. However, environmental commitment does not have a material impact on the ultimate project success rate and significantly delays project delivery. Overall, the evidence suggests that Kickstarter’s nudge policy encourages entrepreneurs’ environmental engagement and helps them expand access to environmentally conscious backers by internalizing backers’ environmental preferences.
10.1007/s11142-026-09982-z.abstract_zh: 我们以Kickstarter为实验平台，研究在线市场的一项政策（环境政策）——即允许创业者选择披露其环保参与情况——对创业成果的影响。该政策实施后，32.4%的创业者选择披露其环保承诺。以该环境政策的实施作为工具变量，我们发现环保承诺改善了融资结果，融资成功率提高了13.2%，承诺融资比例提高了8.7%。环保承诺还吸引了更多具有环保意识的资助者，并带来了新的资助者，这很可能促进了上述改善。然而，环保承诺对最终项目成功率并无实质性影响，且显著延迟了项目交付。总体而言，证据表明Kickstarter的助推政策鼓励了创业者的环保参与，并通过内化资助者的环保偏好，帮助其扩大了对环保意识资助者的接触范围。
10.1007/s11142-026-09982-z.title: Role of environmental disclosure policy on access to finance: evidence from crowdfunding
10.1007/s11142-026-09982-z.title_zh: 环境信息披露政策对融资获取的作用：来自众筹的证据

10.1007/s11142-026-09983-y.abstract: We examine the association between permissible non-audit services provided by auditors and the timeliness of earnings announcements. Although earnings announcements are unaudited, audit progress influences management’s ability to release earnings while maintaining confidence in reported results. We posit that non-audit services generate earnings announcement timeliness benefits by improving the efficiency and timing of audits through knowledge transfer. We find that tax non-audit services are associated with timelier earnings announcements while nontax non-audit services are not. These benefits are concentrated in the pre-regulatory period before changes in the mid-2000s. Following these changes, the association persists for firms with weaker information environments, poorer performance, and greater audit-related challenges. Overall, our findings show that auditor-provided tax services are associated with enhanced timeliness of unaudited disclosures and that these benefits vary across firms and over time, highlighting previously undocumented spillovers from non-audit services with implications for academic research and regulation.
10.1007/s11142-026-09983-y.abstract_zh: 我们考察了审计师提供的合规非审计服务与盈余公告及时性之间的关联。尽管盈余公告未经审计，但审计进度影响管理层在保持对报告结果信心的同时发布盈余的能力。我们假设，非审计服务通过知识转移提高审计效率和时机，从而带来盈余公告及时性的益处。我们发现，税务类非审计服务与更及时的盈余公告相关，而非税务类非审计服务则无此关联。这些益处集中在21世纪中期监管变化之前的时期。在这些变化之后，对于信息环境较弱、业绩较差及面临更大审计挑战的公司，这一关联依然存在。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，审计师提供的税务服务与未经审计披露的及时性增强相关，且这些益处因公司和时间而异，揭示了先前未记录的非审计服务溢出效应，对学术研究和监管具有启示意义。
10.1007/s11142-026-09983-y.title: Non-audit services and earnings announcement timeliness
10.1007/s11142-026-09983-y.title_zh: 非审计服务与盈余公告及时性

10.1007/s11142-026-09984-x.abstract: We study whether exogenous improvements in stock liquidity, unrelated to the information environment, affect managers’ disclosure choices. We exploit the 1997 Nasdaq reforms, which exogenously improved stock liquidity by reducing the non-information asymmetry components of the bid-ask spread, and find that Nasdaq firms reduced voluntary disclosure relative to a control group of unaffected firms. This evidence is consistent with managers substituting between components of the bid-ask spread when forming disclosure choices. Specifically, as the non-information asymmetry components decline, managers respond by decreasing disclosure, which in turn raises the information asymmetry component. Despite the reduction in disclosure and corresponding increase in information asymmetry, total stock liquidity nevertheless improves, suggesting that maintaining prior disclosure levels would have yielded minimal marginal benefits.
10.1007/s11142-026-09984-x.abstract_zh: 我们研究股票流动性的外生改善（与信息环境无关）是否会影响管理者的披露选择。我们利用1997年纳斯达克改革，该改革通过降低买卖价差中的非信息不对称成分，外生地提升了股票流动性，并发现相对于未受影响的对照组公司，纳斯达克公司在自愿披露方面有所减少。这一证据与管理者在形成披露选择时在买卖价差各成分之间进行替代的假设相一致。具体而言，随着非信息不对称成分的下降，管理者通过减少披露来应对，这反过来又提高了信息不对称成分。尽管披露减少且信息不对称相应增加，但总体股票流动性仍然改善，这表明维持原有披露水平所带来的边际收益可能微乎其微。
10.1007/s11142-026-09984-x.title: Exogenous stock liquidity improvements and voluntary disclosure
10.1007/s11142-026-09984-x.title_zh: 外生股票流动性改善与自愿性信息披露

10.1007/s11142-026-09985-w.title: Late trade credit payments to meet cash flow forecasts

10.1007/s11142-026-09986-9.abstract: We examine whether negative news media coverage of peer audit firms affects audit quality by mitigating the contagion effect of low-quality audits. We find that when a company issues a restatement, other companies served by the same audit office or within the same city are more likely to subsequently issue a restatement. However, we find that higher negative peer firm news coverage mitigates this contagion effect, particularly when auditors have greater opportunity to improve audit quality (smaller companies) and when media attention amplifies reputational pressures (higher local news intensity). Our findings extend to litigation-related news but not to nonnegative news, suggesting that auditors respond to perceived reputational threats stemming from negative news. Additionally, negative peer news increases auditor attention, consistent with an auditor supply-side effect that improves audit quality. Our findings highlight the media’s role as an informal oversight mechanism.
10.1007/s11142-026-09986-9.abstract_zh: 我们考察了同行审计事务所的负面新闻媒体报道是否通过缓解低质量审计的传染效应来影响审计质量。研究发现，当一家公司发布重述时，由同一审计办公室或同一城市服务的其他公司随后更有可能发布重述。然而，我们发现，同行公司负面新闻报道的增加缓解了这一传染效应，尤其是在审计师有更大机会提升审计质量（规模较小的公司）以及媒体关注放大声誉压力（当地新闻强度较高）的情况下。我们的研究结果扩展到与诉讼相关的新闻，但不适用于非负面新闻，这表明审计师对负面新闻引发的声誉威胁感知作出反应。此外，同行负面新闻增加了审计师的关注度，这与审计师供给侧效应提升审计质量相一致。我们的发现凸显了媒体作为非正式监督机制的作用。
10.1007/s11142-026-09986-9.title: Does news media affect audit quality? Evidence from variation in the “contagion effect”
10.1007/s11142-026-09986-9.title_zh: 新闻媒体会影响审计质量吗？——基于“传染效应”变化的证据

10.1007/s11142-026-09987-8.abstract: We examine how labor market competition affects the quality of workplace information on social media. Using employer reviews on Glassdoor for U.S. publicly listed firms from 2011 to 2022, we find that reviews become less informative about actual workplace practices when firms face more intense competition for labor, consistent with competition inducing workplace information management. The decline in review informativeness is more pronounced when employees have narrower external networks, when firms are less unionized, and when firms have a smaller review base, suggesting that workplace information management is more likely when labor market information asymmetry is greater. Additional analyses show that positive reviews in highly competitive labor markets predict higher short-term labor inflows but greater subsequent employee turnover, indicating a gap between managed expectations and actual workplace conditions. Taken together, our evidence suggests that labor market competition potentially distorts the crowdsourced signals available to job seekers on anonymous review websites.
10.1007/s11142-026-09987-8.abstract_zh: 我们研究了劳动力市场竞争如何影响社交媒体上职场信息的质量。利用2011年至2022年间美国上市公司在Glassdoor上的雇主评价，我们发现当企业面临更激烈的劳动力竞争时，评价对实际工作场所实践的反映程度降低，这与竞争诱发职场信息管理现象相符。评价信息量的下降在员工外部网络较窄、企业工会化程度较低以及企业评价基数较小的情况下更为显著，这表明当劳动力市场信息不对称程度更高时，职场信息管理更易发生。进一步分析显示，在高度竞争的劳动力市场中，正面评价能预测短期劳动力流入的增加，但随后员工离职率也更高，揭示了管理预期与实际工作条件之间的差距。综合来看，我们的证据表明，劳动力市场竞争可能扭曲了匿名评价网站上求职者可获得的众包信号。
10.1007/s11142-026-09987-8.title: How labor market competition shapes workplace information on social media: evidence from Glassdoor reviews
10.1007/s11142-026-09987-8.title_zh: 劳动力市场竞争如何塑造社交媒体上的职场信息：来自Glassdoor点评的证据

10.1007/s11142-026-09988-7.abstract: This study examines whether Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests to the Securities and Exchange Commission convey value-relevant information about publicly traded firms and whether sophisticated investors trade on that information. Our empirical analysis reveals heterogeneous value relevance associated with different types of requests. Specifically, requests submitted by proxy agents to probe for ongoing investigations as well as anonymous requests are negatively correlated with future returns, while requests from institutional investors and intellectual property entities are associated with positive future returns. Our results also support the direct-trading hypothesis, showing institutional investors and short sellers trade on FOIA-obtained information. Our findings add to the information-acquisition literature by highlighting the heterogeneous value signals in FOIA requests, particularly the negative value signals.
10.1007/s11142-026-09988-7.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了向证券交易委员会提交的《信息自由法》（FOIA）请求是否传递了关于上市公司价值相关的信息，以及成熟投资者是否利用这些信息进行交易。我们的实证分析揭示了不同类型请求所关联的价值相关性存在异质性。具体而言，由代理机构提交以探查正在进行的调查的请求以及匿名请求与未来回报呈负相关，而来自机构投资者和知识产权实体的请求则与正向未来回报相关联。我们的结果也支持直接交易假说，表明机构投资者和卖空者基于通过FOIA获取的信息进行交易。我们的发现通过强调FOIA请求中异质性的价值信号，尤其是负面价值信号，为信息获取文献做出了贡献。
10.1007/s11142-026-09988-7.title: The information content of private information acquisition: evidence from FOIA requests to the SEC
10.1007/s11142-026-09988-7.title_zh: 私有信息获取的信息含量：来自向SEC提交FOIA请求的证据

10.1007/s11142-026-09989-6.abstract: This study investigates how audit firm-level spatial licensing requirements affect audit market competition and audit quality, focusing on small (triennially inspected) audit firms, for which licensing frictions are most relevant. Exploiting the staggered state-level adoption of CPA firm mobility provisions that remove spatial licensing barriers, we find that adoption increases competition among small audit firms, as reflected by lower market concentration and greater first-time entry by small out-of-state auditors. Firm mobility adoption also improves audit quality, as indicated by a lower likelihood of client misstatements. These effects are concentrated in less competitive audit markets and among auditors with higher PCAOB deficiency rates. Audit quality improvements extend to both incumbent auditors and new out-of-state entrants, and we find no evidence of audit fee discounting. Overall, our results suggest that removing spatial licensing barriers fosters a more competitive small audit firm market while improving audit outcomes, without increasing audit costs.
10.1007/s11142-026-09989-6.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了审计事务所层面的空间执业许可要求如何影响审计市场竞争与审计质量，重点关注小型（每三年接受检查的）审计事务所，因为许可摩擦对其影响最为显著。利用各州分阶段采纳注册会计师事务所流动性条款（该条款消除了空间执业壁垒）这一自然实验，我们发现，此类条款的采纳增强了小型审计事务所之间的竞争，表现为市场集中度降低以及小型外州审计师首次进入市场的频率增加。事务所流动性条款的采纳还提升了审计质量，表现为客户错报可能性降低。这些效应在竞争程度较低的审计市场以及PCAOB缺陷率较高的审计师中更为突出。审计质量的提升同时惠及现有审计师和新进入的外州审计师，且未发现审计费用折价现象。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，消除空间执业壁垒促进了小型审计事务所市场的竞争性增强，同时改善了审计结果，且未增加审计成本。
10.1007/s11142-026-09989-6.title: The consequences of audit firm mobility for attestation services across states
10.1007/s11142-026-09989-6.title_zh: 审计事务所流动性对各州鉴证服务的影响

10.1007/s11142-026-09991-y.abstract: We examine whether disproportionate insider control, or the divergence between insider voting and cash flow rights at dual-class firms, influences the extent to which stock price reflects information about future firm performance. We find that current returns incorporate less information about future earnings and cash flows as disproportionate insider control increases. However, monitoring by influential institutional investors, strong board oversight, and high-quality disclosure significantly attenuate this effect, such that disproportionate insider control does not result in less informative stock prices. Collectively, our findings reveal that, although the dual-class structure is associated with less informative stock prices, on average, monitoring and disclosure can alleviate investor concerns about disproportionate insider control while allowing firms to take advantage of the benefits of a dual-class ownership structure.
10.1007/s11142-026-09991-y.abstract_zh: 我们考察了双重股权结构公司中不成比例的内部人控制，即内部人投票权与现金流权之间的差异，是否影响股价反映未来公司业绩信息的程度。研究发现，随着不成比例的内部人控制增强，当前收益对未来盈利和现金流信息的包含程度降低。然而，有影响力的机构投资者监督、强有力的董事会监管以及高质量的信息披露显著削弱了这一效应，使得不成比例的内部人控制不会导致股价信息含量降低。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，尽管双重股权结构平均而言与股价信息含量较低相关，但监督和披露能够缓解投资者对不成比例内部人控制的担忧，同时使企业能够利用双重股权结构带来的优势。
10.1007/s11142-026-09991-y.title: The informativeness of stock price at dual-class firms
10.1007/s11142-026-09991-y.title_zh: 双重股权结构公司股票价格的信息含量

10.1007/s11142-026-09993-w.abstract: Anti-recharacterization laws significantly increase the rights of securitization creditors by allowing the buyers of securitized assets to exclusively and immediately seize collateral in bankruptcy. However, strengthening the rights of securitization creditors can limit other creditors’ ability to recover loans. We find that, after a state adopts an anti-recharacterization law, local banks operating in the same state accrue more loan loss provisions, tighten their loan contracts, and incur higher future loan charge-offs. These findings are consistent with the argument that a safe harbor for securitization transactions advantages Wall Street-style structured finance at the expense of Main Street-style lending.
10.1007/s11142-026-09993-w.abstract_zh: 反再定性法律通过允许证券化资产的买方在破产中独占并立即取得抵押品，显著增强了证券化债权人的权利。然而，强化证券化债权人的权利可能会限制其他债权人收回贷款的能力。我们发现，在某一州采纳反再定性法律后，该州运营的本地银行计提了更多的贷款损失准备金，收紧了贷款合同，并面临更高的未来贷款核销。这些发现与以下论点一致：证券化交易的安全港规则有利于华尔街式结构化融资，却以牺牲主街式贷款为代价。

10.1007/s13209-025-00306-z.abstract: We use a simple yet powerful approach to investigate the dynamics of worker flows across sectors in the Spanish economy. The method imposes a minimal amount of structure on the data by assuming sector-specific matching functions, and backs out the direction of workers’ search intensities across sectors using data on realised worker flows and vacancies. We find that aggregate search intensity in Spain has been increasing since the pandemic and has led aggregate labour shortages to be below pre-pandemic levels by 2023. However, this boost of search intensity is directed to industries with low matching efficiencies and job finding rates. As a result, aggregate match formation is near to a 10-years low relative to the number of matches that would result if search intensity was allocated to maximise total matches given the observed vacancy distribution and match efficiencies across sectors.
10.1007/s13209-025-00306-z.abstract_zh: 我们采用一种简洁而有力的方法来研究西班牙经济中跨部门工人流动的动态。该方法通过假设部门特定的匹配函数，对数据施加最小结构，并利用已实现的工人流动和职位空缺数据，反推出工人跨部门的搜寻强度方向。我们发现，自疫情以来，西班牙的总搜寻强度一直在上升，并导致截至2023年总劳动力短缺低于疫情前水平。然而，这种搜寻强度的提升主要流向匹配效率低和就业率低的行业。因此，相对于在观察到的职位空缺分布和各部门匹配效率下，若搜寻强度被分配以最大化总匹配数所能产生的结果，总匹配形成量接近十年来的低点。

10.1016/0022-1996(86)90009-7.abstract: We construct an open economy disequilibrium model to assess the welfare effects of aid in different macroeconomic regimes. Aid is shown to have different effects in different unemployment regimes because it increases the social costs of wage-price rigidities in the classical regime but decreases them in the Keynesian unemployment regime. A link is made with the two-gap model, but we highlight the role of real exchange rate misalignment (failure to clear the NT goods market).
10.1016/0022-1996(86)90009-7.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个开放经济非均衡模型，以评估不同宏观体制下援助的福利效应。研究表明，援助在不同失业体制中具有差异化影响：在古典失业体制下，援助会加剧工资-价格刚性的社会成本；而在凯恩斯失业体制下，援助则降低此类成本。本文将该模型与双缺口模型建立关联，但着重强调实际汇率失调（即非贸易品市场未能出清）所发挥的作用。

10.1016/0022-1996(86)90009-7.title_zh: DP45 对外援助有效性的宏观经济方面：关于双缺口模型、国内商品失衡与实际汇率失调

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102691.abstract: High housing rents and housing costs have played a critical role in residents’ welfare, especially for migrants who are usually low-socioeconomic, and how housing rent shapes migrants’ health has become an important social issue. Using the 2017 China Migrants Dynamic Survey data, this study finds that rising housing rents are negatively correlated with migrants' self-rated health and lead to an increase in the probability of suffering from diseases for them. The negative effect of housing rent is larger for female or low-educated migrants, and short-term migrants are also more sensitive to housing rent change. Besides, housing rents have little significant impact on the health of locals. Three underlying mechanisms are verified. First, rising housing rents lead to the adjustment of family consumption structure, decrease the proportion of non-housing expenditures, and increase their working hours, which negatively affects their health. Second, rising housing rents may decrease their medical care accessibility or reduce their health care utilization level, which is harmful for migrants' health. Third, the decrease in social interaction level may also mediate the negative role of housing rents in migrants' health.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102691.abstract_zh: 高额住房租金与住房成本对居民福利具有关键影响，尤其对于通常处于较低社会经济地位的流动人口而言，住房租金如何影响其健康状况已成为重要的社会议题。基于2017年中国流动人口动态监测调查数据，本研究发现住房租金上涨与流动人口自评健康呈负相关，并增加了其患病概率。住房租金的负面效应在女性或低教育水平流动人口中更为显著，短期流动人口对住房租金变化亦更为敏感。此外，住房租金对本地居民健康的影响不显著。本研究验证了三种潜在机制：首先，住房租金上涨导致家庭消费结构调整，降低非住房支出比例，并增加工作时间，从而对健康产生不利影响；其次，住房租金上涨可能降低其医疗服务可及性或减少医疗保健利用水平，不利于流动人口健康；第三，社会交往水平的下降也可能在住房租金对流动人口健康的负面作用中发挥中介效应。

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102704.abstract: Amidst escalating global green trade barriers, firms in emerging economies face a dual imperative: acquiring advanced green technologies and securing environmental legitimacy. This study investigates how green mergers and acquisitions (M&As) serve as a strategic lever to navigate these challenges and drive the transition to green exports, focusing on China's manufacturing sector. We develop a “Technology-Qualification” framework that highlights the dual channels: enhancing green innovation capability and acquiring environmental market legitimacy. Using a matched dataset linking Chinese A-share listed manufacturers with customs transaction records (2007–2016), we find that green M&As significantly enhance firms' transition to green exports from both the perspectives of export entry and sustained exports. This effect remains robust after a series of tests, including those addressing endogeneity concerns. Mechanism analysis shows that green M&As operate through the dual channels of innovation upgrading and qualification acquisition, and further analysis reveals that these two channels either complement or substitute each other, depending on whether the green qualifications are formal or informal. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the positive impact of green M&As is stronger for firms with higher operational efficiency, weaker initial green foundations, private ownership, and those engaged in processing trade. 10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102704.abstract_zh: 在全球绿色贸易壁垒日益升级的背景下，新兴经济体企业面临双重挑战：既要获取先进绿色技术，又要确保环境合法性。本研究探讨绿色并购如何作为战略杠杆，帮助企业应对这些挑战并推动绿色出口转型，重点关注中国制造业部门。我们构建了一个“技术-资质”框架，强调两条渠道：提升绿色创新能力与获取环境市场合法性。利用匹配数据集，将中国A股上市制造商与海关交易记录（2007-2016年）相结合，研究发现绿色并购显著促进了企业从出口进入和持续出口两个维度向绿色出口的转型。该效应在一系列测试后依然稳健，包括处理内生性问题的测试。机制分析表明，绿色并购通过创新升级和资质获取的双重渠道发挥作用，进一步分析揭示，这两条渠道根据绿色资质是正式还是非正式而相互补充或替代。异质性分析显示，绿色并购的积极影响在运营效率较高、初始绿色基础较弱、民营企业以及从事加工贸易的企业中更为显著。此外，超越单纯促进

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102705.abstract: China's miraculous development has faced major challenges in recent years, partly triggered by the U.S.-China trade war that started in 2018. This paper provides a systematic evaluation of the detrimental consequences of the trade war over the period from 2018:Q1 to 2021:Q1 for China's final demands and industrial outputs as well as for Chinese consumers' and importers' welfare. We construct a Leontief input-output framework with isoelastic demands and complete tariff pass-through, and adopt Harberger's triangle approach to deadweight loss based on partial leakage of tariff revenues. We find that ICT, Furniture, Food, Primary, and Electrical were the most negatively affected sectors in terms of final demand changes, and that the negative impacts on sectoral outputs were largest in ICT and Auto. Our results indicate that Primary, Food, Paper, Petroleum, Chemicals, and ICT incurred the biggest deadweight losses over the entire tariff change, and that Primary, Food, Chemicals, ICT, and Machinery suffer large total losses with 20% tariff leakages. Primary was hurt the most in both measures. China's aggregate total loss amounted to US$1.57 billion, approximately 0.0089% of China's gross output. While the trade war led to a lose-lose outcome, China's aggregate total loss as a percentage of gross output is less than one-fifth of the counterpart in the U.S. Our main findings
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102705.abstract_zh: 中国近年来的奇迹般发展面临重大挑战，部分起因于2018年开始的中美贸易战。本文系统评估了2018年第一季度至2021年第一季度期间贸易战对中国最终需求、产业产出以及中国消费者和进口商福利的不利影响。我们构建了一个具有等弹性需求和完全关税传导的列昂惕夫投入产出框架，并采用哈伯格三角形方法，基于关税收入的部分漏损来计算无谓损失。研究发现，信息通信技术、家具、食品、初级产品及电气行业在最终需求变化方面受负面影响最为严重，而部门产出所受负面影响在信息通信技术和汽车行业最大。我们的结果表明，在整个关税变动期间，初级产品、食品、造纸、石油、化学品和信息通信技术行业遭受了最大的无谓损失，而在20%关税漏损情况下，初级产品、食品、化学品、信息通信技术和机械行业承受了较大的总损失。初级产品行业在这两项指标中受损最为严重。中国的总损失合计达15.7亿美元，约占中国总产出的0.0089%。尽管贸易战导致了双输的结果，但中国总损失占产出的比例不足美国对应比例的五分之一。我们的主要发现

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102728.abstract: In societies with pronounced gender inequality, attractive women are often perceived as less competent leaders or confined to ornamental roles. Drawing on social role theory, institutional theory, and Upper Echelons theory, and integrating insights from research on gender inequality, beauty effects, and corporate philanthropy, we argue that attractive female CEOs strategically engage in philanthropy to counteract gender-based stereotypes, using such actions to signal compassion and social responsibility—qualities consistent with societal expectations of effective leadership. We further propose that the relationship between female CEO attractiveness and corporate philanthropy is moderated by contextual factors. Specifically, weaker gender stereotypes and more competitive markets that reward managerial talent should reduce the need for such compensatory behavior. Using data on Chinese firms, we examine the link between the physical attractiveness of female CEOs and corporate donations. The results show that attractive female CEOs engage more actively in philanthropy, contributing larger donations than their less attractive peers, particularly in regions with stronger gender stereotypes and less market-oriented economies.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102728.abstract_zh: 在性别不平等显著的社会中，有吸引力的女性往往被视为能力较弱的领导者，或被局限于装饰性角色。借鉴社会角色理论、制度理论和高层梯队理论，并结合性别不平等、美貌效应及企业慈善领域的研究洞见，我们认为，有吸引力的女性CEO会策略性地参与慈善活动，以对抗基于性别的刻板印象，通过此类行为传递同情心与社会责任感——这些品质符合社会对有效领导力的期望。我们进一步提出，女性CEO吸引力与企业慈善之间的关系受到情境因素的调节。具体而言，较弱的性别刻板印象和更竞争激烈、奖励管理才能的市场，应会减少此类补偿性行为的必要性。利用中国企业数据，我们考察了女性CEO的外貌吸引力与企业捐赠之间的联系。结果显示，有吸引力的女性CEO更积极地参与慈善活动，其捐赠额高于外貌吸引力较低的同行，尤其是在性别刻板印象较强且市场化程度较低的地区。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102728.title: Female leadership, attractiveness, and corporate philanthropy
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102728.title_zh: 女性领导力、吸引力与企业慈善

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102729.abstract: We use the near-universe of Chinese online job ads (2016–2023; 3.2M postings) to measure job-level skill demand and city-specific skill premia. Combining keyword dictionaries with a Chinese BERT classifier, we construct standardized intensities for skills. Three facts emerge. (i) Skill requirements vary sharply across metropolitan areas (MAs), especially for IT. (ii) Prices do not always track skill intensities: high skill demand does not imply high skill premium. (iii) IT and interpersonal premia polarize across MAs and also polarize within jobs. Results offer policy-relevant descriptive implications for worker location and firm siting.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102729.abstract_zh: 我们利用近乎全量的中国在线招聘广告数据（2016-2023年；320万条帖子）来衡量岗位层面的技能需求及城市特定的技能溢价。结合关键词词典与中文BERT分类器，我们构建了标准化的技能强度指标。研究揭示三个事实：（一）技能需求在都市圈间差异显著，尤其在信息技术领域；（二）价格并不总是与技能强度同步：高技能需求并不意味着高技能溢价；（三）信息技术与人际交往技能溢价在都市圈间呈现极化现象，且在岗位内部也存在极化。研究结果为劳动者选址与企业布局提供了具有政策参考价值的描述性启示。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102729.title: What cities pay for: IT vs. interpersonal skills in China’s urban labor markets
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102729.title_zh: 中国城市劳动力市场中IT技能与人际交往技能的回报差异

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102730.abstract: Conventional wisdom holds that environmental regulation directly spurs innovation within polluting firms, enabling them to comply with standards while boosting competitiveness. Using China's Water Pollution Prevention and Control Action Plan as a quasi-experiment, we ask instead whether regulation primarily induces innovation in regulated firms or in their upstream suppliers. We find no statistically significant increase in water-related green patenting among regulated polluters, but a pronounced rise among their upstream suppliers. This upstream response is stronger in regions with higher wastewater discharge intensity, greater innovation capacity, and stronger intellectual property protection, and is concentrated among competitive, non-state-owned, and larger firms. Innovation mainly targets pollution control rather than preventive technologies. Regulated firms comply chiefly by purchasing external abatement solutions, rather than through knowledge spillovers that enhance their own inventive activity. These findings reveal a demand-driven supply-chain channel through which environmental regulation reshapes the locus and direction of green innovation by creating markets for environmental technologies.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102730.abstract_zh: 传统观点认为，环境规制直接刺激污染企业内部的创新，使其在达标的同时提升竞争力。本文以中国《水污染防治行动计划》为准自然实验，转而探讨规制主要诱发被规制企业还是其上游供应商的创新。研究发现，在被规制的污染企业中，水相关绿色专利并无统计上显著的增加，但其上游供应商的绿色专利则显著上升。这种上游响应在废水排放强度更高、创新能力更强及知识产权保护更完善的地区更为突出，且集中于竞争性强、非国有及规模较大的企业。创新主要聚焦于污染治理技术，而非预防性技术。被规制企业主要通过购买外部治理方案来合规，而非借助知识溢出增强自身的发明活动。这些发现揭示了一条需求驱动的供应链渠道，环境规制通过创造环境技术市场，重塑了绿色创新的发生位置与方向。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102730.title: Environmental regulation and indirect innovation effects along supply chain: Evidence from China's water pollution prevention and control action plan
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102730.title_zh: 环境规制与供应链上的间接创新效应：来自中国水污染防治行动计划的证据

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102731.abstract: This study investigates the impact of corporate collaboration culture on firms' integration into global innovation networks. Using the number of firms' cross-border co-patents to measure global innovation integration, we find that the collaboration culture positively affects it. The positive effects are more pronounced for firms with lower risk-taking and higher information transparency. Moreover, the collaboration culture encourages firms to disclose more innovation-related information. These results reveal that the collaboration culture facilitates integration into global innovation networks by compensating for insufficient risk-taking and enhancing information transparency. Further analyses show that the collaboration culture improves the quality of cross-border co-patents. Strategically, firms prioritize co-patents related to the digital economy and green energy. The cooperation typically follows the pattern of Chinese applicants with foreign inventors. Taken together, these results underscore that corporate unity catalyzes longevity, enabling firms to achieve competitive endurance through integration into global innovation ecosystems.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102731.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了企业协作文化对企业融入全球创新网络的影响。以企业跨境合作专利数量衡量全球创新融入程度，我们发现协作文化对此产生积极影响。对于风险承担能力较低、信息透明度较高的企业，这种正面效应更为显著。此外，协作文化鼓励企业披露更多与创新相关的信息。这些结果表明，协作文化通过弥补风险承担不足和增强信息透明度，促进了企业融入全球创新网络。进一步分析显示，协作文化提升了跨境合作专利的质量。在战略层面，企业优先关注与数字经济及绿色能源相关的合作专利。合作模式通常表现为中国申请人与外国发明人相结合。综上所述，这些结果强调了企业内部的团结是持久发展的催化剂，使企业能够通过融入全球创新生态系统实现竞争耐力。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102731.title: Unity for longevity: Corporate collaboration culture and global innovation network integration
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102731.title_zh: 团结促长青：企业协作文化与全球创新网络整合

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102732.abstract: This paper develops a text-based measure of firms' climate transition risk management by constructing a dedicated dictionary and applying it to annual reports of Chinese listed firms over the period 2011–2021. Using this measure, we examine how corporate digital transformation relates to firms' management of climate transition risk. We find that digital transformation is positively associated with firms' engagement in climate transition risk management, with stronger effects for manufacturing and non-high-tech firms, and in particular for adopters of advanced digital technologies such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing and big data. To address concerns of endogeneity, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences design and propensity score matching. Moreover, our evidence shows that digital transformation is associated with observable transition-related actions, including environmental investment and green patent output. While we do not find consistent evidence that digital transformation improves short-term profitability, stronger climate transition risk management is positively associated with firm value.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102732.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建专用词典并将其应用于2011至2021年间中国上市公司的年度报告，开发了一种基于文本的企业气候转型风险管理度量方法。利用这一度量，我们考察了企业数字化转型与气候转型风险管理之间的关系。研究发现，数字化转型与企业参与气候转型风险管理呈正相关，且这一效应在制造业及非高科技企业中更为显著，尤其是在采用人工智能、云计算和大数据等先进数字技术的企业中。为应对内生性问题，我们采用了交错双重差分设计和倾向得分匹配方法。此外，证据表明，数字化转型与可观察的转型相关行动相关联，包括环境投资和绿色专利产出。尽管我们未发现数字化转型能持续改善短期盈利能力的证据，但更强的气候转型风险管理与企业价值正相关。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102732.title: Digital transformation and climate transition risk management: Evidence from Chinese listed firms
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102732.title_zh: 数字化转型与气候转型风险管理：来自中国上市公司的证据

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102740.abstract: This study uses national survey data from the Chinese Household Income Project for 2002, 2013, and 2023 to examine the influence of task-based factors on the gender wage gap (GWG) in urban China in 2002–2023. We construct multi-period indicators of non-routine task intensity and employ decomposition methods to explore two channels through which tasks influence the GWG. The results indicate that the wage premium for non-routine tasks was higher for women than for men during the period 2002–2023, and several robustness checks support this conclusion. The gender differences in the non-routine task wage premium vary by age and education group, and across the wage distribution. The decomposition results suggest that gender disparities in wage premiums for non-routine tasks (the price effect) contributed to narrowing the GWG in all three sample periods, although the magnitude of this effect declined from 2002 to 2023. By contrast, gender differences in the allocation of non-routine tasks (the endowment effect) widened the GWG in 2002 and 2023, while narrowed it in 2013. Additionally, both the endowment and price effects on the GWG differ across wage distributions in each period.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102740.abstract_zh: 本研究利用中国家庭收入调查2002年、2013年及2023年的全国性数据，考察了基于任务的因素对2002至2023年间中国城镇性别工资差距的影响。我们构建了非例行任务强度的多时期指标，并采用分解方法探索任务影响性别工资差距的两条途径。结果显示，在2002至2023年期间，女性在非例行任务上的工资溢价高于男性，且多项稳健性检验支持这一结论。非例行任务工资溢价的性别差异在不同年龄、教育群体及工资分布上表现各异。分解结果表明，非例行任务工资溢价的性别差异（价格效应）在三个样本期内均有助于缩小性别工资差距，尽管该效应从2002年到2023年有所减弱。相比之下，非例行任务分配上的性别差异（禀赋效应）在2002年和2023年扩大了性别工资差距，而在2013年则缩小了该差距。此外，各时期工资分布上的禀赋效应和价格效应对性别工资差距的影响亦存在差异。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102740.title: Tasks and the gender wage gap in urban China, 2002 –2023
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102740.title_zh: 2002-2023年中国城市工作任务与性别工资差距

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102741.abstract: Studies about climate change effects on service industries in developing countries are limited. Using data from daily flights among 211 Chinese airports (2015–2017), this paper investigates the causal impacts of extreme temperatures on aviation service quality, measured by flight delays. We find that extreme low temperatures significantly increase flight delays, with additional exposure causing longer departure delays, arrival delays, and excessive travel time. Conversely, extreme high temperatures have limited effects or even improve punctuality. This discrepancy arises primarily from differing meteorological disruptions and distinct market-driven airline operational adjustments in response to cold versus hot weather conditions. Low temperatures ( 20 °C) yields average monetary gains equivalent to about 0.04% of local GDP.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102741.abstract_zh: 关于气候变化对发展中国家服务业影响的研究较为有限。本文利用2015至2017年间中国211个机场的每日航班数据，探讨极端温度对航空服务质量（以航班延误衡量）的因果影响。研究发现，极端低温显著增加航班延误，额外暴露于低温会导致离港延误、到港延误及超时旅行时间延长。相反，极端高温的影响有限，甚至可能提升准点率。这一差异主要源于不同的气象干扰以及航空公司针对冷热天气条件采取的不同市场驱动运营调整。低温（20°C）带来的平均货币收益相当于当地GDP的约0.04%。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102741.title: Thermal extremes and airline reliability: Evidence from China's aviation market
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102741.title_zh: 极端高温与航空公司可靠性：来自中国航空市场的证据

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102742.abstract: Drawing on U.S. global trade data from 2015 to 2023, this study empirically examines the impact of the “friend-shoring” policy on semiconductor supply chain dynamics. The analysis reveals that a one-standard-deviation improvement in bilateral political relations is associated with a 0.28 percentage point increase in the U.S. import share of semiconductors from politically aligned countries. Supply chain realignment shows considerable heterogeneity: trade in raw materials and finished components has shifted toward politically aligned partners, whereas manufacturing equipment shows weaker responsiveness due to efficiency considerations and supply-side constraints. The policy has introduced a “security premium” in import prices, especially for manufacturing equipment and imports from upper-middle-income politically aligned partners. Despite U.S. efforts to reduce dependence on China, products with high reliance on Chinese sources show no substantial disruption. Moreover, allied countries have not experienced a significant increase in their export shares to the U.S. market, while China’s semiconductor exports to U.S. allies have continued to expand. These findings indicate that the friend-shoring has led to only limited restructuring within semiconductor supply chains and has not materially altered existing dependency patterns.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102742.abstract_zh: 基于2015至2023年美国全球贸易数据，本研究实证考察了“友岸外包”政策对半导体供应链动态的影响。分析显示，双边政治关系每提升一个标准差，美国从政治盟友国家进口半导体的份额将增加0.28个百分点。供应链重构呈现出显著的异质性：原材料和成品组件的贸易已转向政治盟友伙伴，而制造设备因效率考量及供给侧约束，其响应程度相对较弱。该政策在进口价格中引入了“安全溢价”，尤其体现在制造设备及来自中高收入政治盟友伙伴的进口上。尽管美国致力于减少对中国的依赖，但对华高度依赖的产品并未出现实质性中断。此外，盟友国家在美国市场的出口份额并未显著增长，而中国对美盟友的半导体出口则持续扩大。这些发现表明，友岸外包仅促成半导体供应链的有限重组，并未实质性改变现有的依赖格局。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102742.title: “Friend-shoring” and global supply chains: Empirical evidence from the semiconductor industry
