10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102742.title_zh: 友岸外包”与全球供应链：来自半导体行业的经验证据

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102743.abstract: This paper quantifies the impact of the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) on global value chains (GVCs) and welfare. Using a multi-country, multi-sector general equilibrium model with global input-output linkages, we distinguish between tariffs on intermediate and final goods to capture the granular trade-cost dynamics of RCEP’s implementation. Our results show that RCEP significantly bolsters intra-regional trade and enhances complex GVC participation, although patterns of integration diverge: China and Australia expand primarily through forward linkages, while Japan, South Korea, and ASEAN members integrate more deeply through backward linkages. Welfare decomposition reveals that more than half of the total gains are driven by indirect channels, specifically intermediate-goods trade and sectoral linkages, rather than direct final-goods liberalization. Counterfactual simulations further demonstrate that RCEP serves as a critical strategic buffer against global trade disruptions. While the U.S.-China trade war and the emerging “Trump 2.0” reciprocal tariff regimes pose substantial risks, deeper regional integration and services liberalization can significantly mitigate these adverse welfare shocks. These findings underscore that RCEP functions as a strategic anchor for regional value chains, playing a pivotal role in bolstering supply-chain resilience against the structural shifts and heightened uncertainties of the global trade environment.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102743.abstract_zh: 本文量化了《区域全面经济伙伴关系协定》（RCEP）对全球价值链（GVCs）及福利的影响。通过运用一个包含全球投入产出联系的多国、多部门一般均衡模型，我们区分了中间品与最终品的关税，以捕捉RCEP实施过程中细粒度的贸易成本动态。研究结果显示，RCEP显著促进了区域内贸易，并增强了复杂全球价值链的参与度，尽管一体化模式存在差异：中国和澳大利亚主要通过前向联系扩展，而日本、韩国及东盟成员国则通过后向联系实现更深入的一体化。福利分解表明，总收益中超过一半由间接渠道驱动，具体为中间品贸易和部门间联系，而非直接的最终品自由化。反事实模拟进一步证明，RCEP在应对全球贸易中断时充当关键的战略缓冲。尽管中美贸易战及新兴的“特朗普2.0”互惠关税体制构成重大风险，但更深层次的区域一体化与服务自由化能显著缓解这些不利的福利冲击。这些发现强调，RCEP作为区域价值链的战略锚点，在增强供应链韧性以应对全球贸易环境的结构性转变与不确定性加剧方面发挥着关键作用。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102743.title: The economic and welfare effects of RCEP: A global value chain perspective
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102743.title_zh: RCEP的经济与福利效应：基于全球价值链视角

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102744.abstract: Government procurement is a key demand-side policy tool for state intervention in the economy, as it not only directly influences micro-corporate decision making but also shapes regional industry dynamics. Nevertheless, its industry-level impacts remain underexplored. This study adopts the perspective of firm entry and exits to investigate how government procurement shapes regional industry dynamics. We find that government procurement significantly increases the entry of new firms in regional industries while also promoting firm exit. A series of robustness tests and IV-based causal identification demonstrate the reliability of the result. Mechanism analysis reveals that, on the one hand, by raising the proportion of contracts awarded to local firms, government procurement sends a policy signal of supporting local industry, thereby encouraging both entry and exit. On the other hand, by prefer small and medium-sized enterprises (SME), it enhances market competition and stimulates firm entry and exit. Further analysis shows that: first, government procurement also generates supply-chain spillover effects, extending its influence to upstream and downstream industries; second, the distribution of procurement contracts among firms within an industry moderates the impact of procurement; third, the impact of government procurement on the entry and exit of enterprises ultimately enhances the industry's innovation capability; and finally, the effect of government procurement on firm entry and exit is stronger in regions with a better business environment. This study provides policy insights for optimizing government procurement policies to promote regional industrial development.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102744.abstract_zh: 政府采购是国家干预经济的关键需求侧政策工具，它不仅直接影响微观企业决策，还塑造区域产业动态。然而，其在产业层面的影响尚未得到充分探讨。本研究从企业进入与退出的视角出发，探讨政府采购如何塑造区域产业动态。我们发现，政府采购显著增加了区域产业中新企业的进入，同时也促进了企业的退出。一系列稳健性检验和基于工具变量的因果识别证明了结果的可靠性。机制分析揭示，一方面，通过提高本地企业获得合同的比例，政府采购传递出支持本地产业的政策信号，从而鼓励企业进入与退出；另一方面，通过偏好中小企业，增强了市场竞争，刺激了企业的进入与退出。进一步分析显示：第一，政府采购还产生供应链溢出效应，将其影响延伸至上下游产业；第二，产业内企业间采购合同的分配调节了采购的影响；第三，政府采购对企业进入与退出的影响最终增强了产业的创新能力；最后，在营商环境较好的地区，政府采购对企业进入与退出的影响更为显著。本研究为优化政府采购政策以促进区域产业发展提供了政策启示。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102744.title: Government procurement as a catalyst: Reshaping firm entry-exit dynamics in China
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102744.title_zh: 政府采购作为催化剂：重塑中国企业进入与退出动态

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102745.abstract: Using a randomized controlled trial across 31 rural junior high schools in China, this study examines the spillover effects of providing free eyeglasses to myopic students on the visual health of their non-myopic peers. Within one school year, the intervention significantly reduced visual deterioration among non-myopic students by 0.48 lines and lowered new myopia incidence by 10 percentage points (a 24.3% decline), while also improving eye-use behaviors. These spillovers cannot be explained by conventional interaction-based or shared environmental mechanisms typically emphasized in non-infectious health interventions. Instead, they are more consistent with observational social learning: non-myopic students observe peers being diagnosed with myopia and required to wear eyeglasses, which increases their awareness of vision risks, updates their risk perceptions, and shapes their attitudes toward eyeglasses, thereby prompting protective behavioral changes. This mechanism extends positive spillover effects beyond context-specific interventions (e.g., infectious diseases) to a broader range of health interventions, and offers new insights into the prevention of non-infectious conditions such as myopia.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102745.abstract_zh: 本研究基于中国31所农村初中的随机对照试验，考察了为近视学生免费配镜对其非近视同伴视觉健康产生的溢出效应。在一个学年内，该干预显著减缓了非近视学生视力下降0.48行，并将新发近视率降低了10个百分点（降幅达24.3%），同时改善了用眼行为。这些溢出效应无法用非传染性健康干预中通常强调的基于互动或共享环境的机制来解释。相反，它们更符合观察性社会学习：非近视学生观察到同伴被诊断为近视并需佩戴眼镜，这提高了他们对视力风险的认识，更新了风险感知，并塑造了对眼镜的态度，从而促使保护性行为改变。这一机制将积极溢出效应从特定情境干预（如传染病）扩展到更广泛的健康干预领域，并为近视等非传染性疾病的预防提供了新见解。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102745.title: Reap more than sow: Experimental evidence of spillover effects from free eyeglass distribution among rural students in China
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102745.title_zh: 多收少种：中国农村学生免费眼镜发放溢出效应的实验证据

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102746.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of extreme heat on household consumption using data from the 2013–2019 China Household Finance Survey. We find that extreme heat significantly suppresses total consumption, where each additional day of extreme high temperature leads to a 0.20% decline in total expenditures. This effect is more pronounced among rural, high-dependency-ratio, and credit-constrained households. Mechanism analyses reveal that extreme heat operates through two distinct channels: an income channel, whereby agricultural and labor earnings are reduced, and a risk channel, characterized by heightened risk aversion and increased precautionary savings. Crucially, we document a systematic budget reallocation within the household consumption basket. While subsistence spending remains rigid, defensive expenditures on healthcare and communication significantly increase, forcing households to sharply curtail discretionary and hedonic spending on entertainment, durables, tourism, and luxuries. These findings highlight how climate shocks degrade quality of life by shifting resources from welfare-enhancing to survival-oriented necessities.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102746.abstract_zh: 本文利用2013-2019年中国家庭金融调查数据，考察极端高温对家庭消费的影响。研究发现，极端高温显著抑制了总消费，每增加一个极端高温日，总支出下降0.20%。这一效应在农村、高抚养比及信贷约束家庭中更为明显。机制分析表明，极端高温通过两条不同渠道发挥作用：一是收入渠道，即农业和劳动收入减少；二是风险渠道，表现为风险厌恶程度上升和预防性储蓄增加。尤为重要的是，本文揭示了家庭消费篮子内部的系统性预算再配置。在生存性支出保持刚性的同时，医疗和通信等防御性支出显著增加，迫使家庭大幅削减娱乐、耐用品、旅游和奢侈品等非必需及享乐性支出。这些发现凸显了气候冲击如何通过将资源从增进福利的消费转向生存导向的必需品，从而降低生活质量。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102746.title: Extreme heat and household consumption: Evidence from China
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102746.title_zh: 极端高温与家庭消费：来自中国的证据

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102747.abstract: We examine how tax policy affects firm compliance, drawing on a 2003 tax incentive implementation campaign in Chongqing, China. Local officials promoted a preferential corporate income tax rate treatment (15% versus 33%) under the Western Development Project through door-to-door visits. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that firms became more likely to report positive profits at the extensive margin, leading to higher declared profits and tax payments. For newly compliant firms, the increases came from reported sales and costs rather than real growth in investment or employment. In contrast, consistently compliant firms raised investment and employment, while output did not increase significantly in the short run. Overall, these responses increased local fiscal revenue by about 24%. The findings show that compliance can be improved not only by deterrence but also by credible and favorable tax regimes.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102747.abstract_zh: 我们基于2003年重庆市实施的一项税收激励政策，考察税收政策如何影响企业合规行为。当地官员通过上门走访，在西部大开发项目下推广优惠企业所得税税率（15%对33%）。采用双重差分设计，我们发现企业在广泛边际上更有可能报告正利润，从而导致申报利润和纳税额增加。对于新合规企业，增长主要来自申报的销售额和成本，而非投资或就业的实际增长。相比之下，持续合规的企业增加了投资和就业，但短期内产出并未显著增长。总体而言，这些反应使地方财政收入增加了约24%。研究结果表明，合规性不仅可以通过威慑手段提升，还可以通过可信且优惠的税收制度来改善。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102747.title: Tax incentives and firm compliance: Evidence from China
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102747.title_zh: 税收激励与企业合规：来自中国的证据

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102748.abstract: The social capital embedded in peers' parents can be a hidden but powerful force shaping adolescent development. This study investigates how peers from civil servant families impact adolescents' noncognitive outcomes within the same classroom. Using nationally representative data on middle school students in China and leveraging random classroom assignment, we find that greater exposure to classmates from civil servant families improves students' noncognitive skills, and is associated with higher friendship network quality and stronger teacher-student relationships. These positive effects are especially significant among boys, rural backgrounds, and low-SES households. Our findings contribute novel evidence on the role of peer social capital in influencing children's human capital development.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102748.abstract_zh: 同伴家长所嵌入的社会资本，可能是一种隐蔽却强大的力量，塑造着青少年的发展。本研究探讨了同班同学中来自公务员家庭的学生如何影响青少年的非认知能力结果。利用中国全国代表性的初中生数据，并借助随机分班的自然实验，我们发现，与来自公务员家庭的同学接触越多，学生的非认知技能越高，且与更高的友谊网络质量和更强的师生关系相关联。这些积极效应在男生、农村背景及低社会经济地位家庭中尤为显著。我们的研究为同伴社会资本在影响儿童人力资本发展中的作用提供了新颖的证据。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102748.title: Parental social capital spillovers in children's noncognitive skills formation: Evidence from random classroom assignment in China
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102748.title_zh: 父母社会资本在儿童非认知技能形成中的溢出效应：来自中国随机分班的证据

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102757.abstract: Since the onset of the U.S.–China trade conflict in 2018, the United States has repeatedly imposed import tariffs on Chinese goods, and China has responded with retaliatory measures. Within a deeply interconnected global economy, we examine the role of the third country in shaping the macroeconomic effects of U.S.–China trade conflicts. In particular, when also subject to U.S. import tariffs, how does the third country’s behavior influence the effectiveness of China’s retaliatory measures? Using a three-country DSGE model that includes China, the United States, and the rest of the world (RoW), we find that U.S. tariffs reduce China’s exports to the United States; however, China partially offsets this decline by increasing exports to third-country markets, thereby mitigating the overall adverse effects. Under the U.S. “reciprocal tariff” policy, both China and the third country incur economic losses, and the effectiveness of China’s retaliation depends critically on the third country’s response. If the third country also retaliates, bilateral trade between China and the third country increases significantly, leading to substantial improvements in both economies, while the United States becomes the largest loser due to a deterioration in its global trade position.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102757.abstract_zh: 自2018年中美贸易冲突爆发以来，美国多次对中国商品加征进口关税，中国则采取了相应的反制措施。在深度互联的全球经济背景下，我们考察了第三国在塑造中美贸易冲突宏观经济效应中的作用。特别是，当第三国同样面临美国进口关税时，其行为如何影响中国反制措施的有效性？通过构建一个包含中国、美国及世界其他地区（RoW）的三国DSGE模型，我们发现美国关税减少了中国对美国的出口；然而，中国通过增加对第三国市场的出口部分抵消了这一下降，从而缓解了整体不利影响。在美国“对等关税”政策下，中国和第三国均遭受经济损失，而中国反制措施的有效性关键取决于第三国的反应。若第三国也采取反制措施，中国与第三国之间的双边贸易将显著增加，两国经济均大幅改善，而美国则因全球贸易地位恶化而成为最大输家。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102757.title: U.S.–China trade conflicts and third-country effects
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102757.title_zh: 中美贸易冲突与第三国效应

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102758.abstract: The accelerating pace of population aging has spurred governments worldwide to proactively tap into the potential of the elderly labor market. Policies such as raising the statutory retirement age and advancing the “silver dividend” initiative aim to convert demographic shifts into economic dividends. Meanwhile, artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping the nature of labor market. Existing research has largely focused on the determinants of retirement decisions or the labor market effects of AI, with relatively little attention paid to the delayed retirement behavior of older workers in the era of AI. Against this backdrop, this paper explores the impact of AI exposure on older workers' decisions to delay retirement and the underlying mechanisms. Using micro-level individual data from China, this paper finds that the higher the level of AI exposure in an older worker's occupation, the lower the probability of delaying retirement. Mechanism tests reveal that exposure to AI reduces older workers' probability of delayed retirement by leading to job displacement, a decline in work-related returns, and a loss of confidence in the future. Furthermore, it is found that the negative impact of AI exposure on delayed retirement is more pronounced in groups that are highly educated, male, in poor health, have high family income, have purchased pension insurance, and have children to support them. This paper offers insights and policy recommendations on how to better tap into the potential of the older workforce in the age of AI.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102758.abstract_zh: 人口老龄化进程的加速促使世界各国政府积极挖掘老年劳动力市场的潜力，诸如提高法定退休年龄和推进“银发红利”计划等政策旨在将人口结构变化转化为经济红利。与此同时，人工智能（AI）正迅速重塑劳动力市场的本质。现有研究大多聚焦于退休决策的决定因素或AI对劳动力市场的影响，而对AI时代老年工人延迟退休行为的关注相对较少。在此背景下，本文探讨了AI暴露对老年工人延迟退休决策的影响及其内在机制。利用中国微观个体数据，本文发现，老年工人所在职业的AI暴露水平越高，其延迟退休的概率越低。机制检验揭示，AI暴露通过导致职业替代、工作回报下降以及对未来信心丧失，降低了老年工人延迟退休的概率。进一步研究发现，AI暴露对延迟退休的负面影响在受教育程度高、男性、健康状况差、家庭收入高、已购买养老保险以及有子女赡养的群体中更为显著。本文为如何在AI时代更好地挖掘老年劳动力潜力提供了见解和政策建议。

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102759.abstract: Based on knowledge combination theory, we explore the effect of the U.S. Entity List on firm breakthrough innovation, using a research sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2013 to 2022. Our findings reveal that the U.S. Entity List significantly inhibits these firms' breakthrough innovation. The U.S. Entity List lowers knowledge breadth while enhancing knowledge depth. However, as the impact of knowledge breadth on breakthrough innovation outweighs that of knowledge depth, the U.S. Entity List ultimately inhibits firm breakthrough innovation. Government innovation subsidies and supply chain integration capabilities of firms mitigate the negative effect of the U.S. Entity List on breakthrough innovation. Additionally, we find that the negative effect of the U.S. Entity List on breakthrough innovation is stronger in technology-intensive, regulated, and competitive industries.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102759.abstract_zh: 基于知识组合理论，本文以2013至2022年中国A股上市公司为研究样本，探讨了美国实体清单对企业突破性创新的影响。研究发现，美国实体清单显著抑制了这些企业的突破性创新。该清单降低了知识广度，同时提升了知识深度。然而，由于知识广度对突破性创新的影响大于知识深度，美国实体清单最终抑制了企业的突破性创新。政府创新补贴及企业的供应链整合能力缓解了美国实体清单对突破性创新的负面效应。此外，本文还发现，在技术密集型、受监管及竞争激烈的行业中，美国实体清单对突破性创新的负面效应更为显著。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102759.title: How the U.S. entity list affects firm breakthrough innovation: A perspective on knowledge depth and breadth
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102759.title_zh: 美国实体清单如何影响企业突破性创新：基于知识深度与广度的视角

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102760.abstract: This paper investigates how the “ratchet effect” from the institutional linkage of current expenditures to future budget allocations drives excessive year-end government spending. Applying novel bunching estimation to 1.18 million Chinese procurement contracts (2015–2021), we quantify year-end excess spending, finding approximately 17.81 billion CNY in wasteful year-end spending annually. We show this rush manifests through two detrimental behaviors: regulatory evasion, which increases contract violations, and official discretion, which reduces the quality of suppliers. Exploiting China's Zero-Based Budgeting (ZBB) reform in a difference-in-differences framework, we find that decoupling budgets across years reduces year-end overspending by 15.8%. Critically, the reform works primarily by curbing official discretion, while having limited impact on regulatory evasion. Our findings disentangle the behavioral mechanisms of year-end spending and provide key insights for designing effective budget reforms.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102760.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了当前支出与未来预算分配的制度性关联所产生的“棘轮效应”如何驱动年末政府过度支出。通过将新颖的聚束估计方法应用于2015至2021年间118万份中国采购合同，我们量化了年末超额支出，发现每年约有178.1亿元人民币的浪费性年末支出。我们表明，这种突击花钱表现为两种有害行为：规避监管，导致合同违规增加；以及官员自由裁量权，降低了供应商质量。利用中国零基预算改革，在双重差分框架下，我们发现跨年度预算脱钩使年末超支减少了15.8%。关键在于，该改革主要通过抑制官员自由裁量权发挥作用，而对规避监管的影响有限。我们的研究厘清了年末支出的行为机制，为设计有效的预算改革提供了关键见解。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102760.title: Examining year-end spending surge and ratchet effect: Evidence from bunching estimation and zero-based budget reform in China
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102760.title_zh: 年末支出激增与棘轮效应研究：来自中国聚束估计与零基预算改革的证据

10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102770.abstract: The consequences of retracting democratic rights in authoritarian regimes remain understudied. In 2018, China’s Communist Party implemented the ‘one-head’ policy, replacing dual village governance with a single leader. Using nationally representative survey data and exploiting the exogeneity of village election cycles as an instrument, we analyze short-term effects on voting behavior and political perceptions. Villages adopting the one-head system experienced a sizable decline in election turnout. At the same time, villagers reported lower perceived corruption and greater confidence in local governance. In addition, we find supporting evidence based on changes in objective economic indicators. These results suggest that recentralization reduced electoral participation but did not erode, and may have improved, (perceived) governance quality in the short run.
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102770.abstract_zh: 威权体制下撤回民主权利的后果仍未得到充分研究。2018年，中国共产党实施了“一肩挑”政策，以单一领导取代了村级双重治理。利用全国代表性调查数据，并借助村级选举周期的外生性作为工具变量，我们分析了该政策对投票行为和政治认知的短期影响。实行“一肩挑”制度的村庄，选举投票率显著下降。与此同时，村民报告的腐败感知降低，对地方治理的信心增强。此外，我们基于客观经济指标的变化找到了支持性证据。这些结果表明，权力再集中减少了选举参与，但在短期内并未削弱，甚至可能提升了（感知的）治理质量。
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102770.title: From two heads to one: Electoral and governance consequences of political recentralization
10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102770.title_zh: 从双头到一元：政治再集权的选举与治理后果

10.1016/j.ecolecon.2025.108685.abstract: Acute physical risks are becoming more frequent and severe, with future scenarios projecting further intensification. Such events can cause significant and potentially persistent economic losses, and strain public finances due to increasing disaster response and recovery costs. However, so far, macroeconomic models have struggled to capture the impacts of climate physical risks in the economy and public finance in a consistent way. In particular, tail weather events and key shock transmission channels are often neglected, leading to a partial assessment of disaster losses and of the recovery needs. This information, in turn, is crucial to assess the climate insurance protection gap and to design adequate and financially sound public policy response. To address this gap, we tailor and extend EIRIN, a Stock-Flow Consistent macrofinancial model of an open economy, calibrated at the country level. EIRIN is composed of a limited number of heterogeneous agents and sectors of the real economy and finance, which interact through markets. Importantly, the real and the financial side of the economy are modelled in an integrated way. Agents are represented as a network of interconnected balance sheet items calibrated on real data, and are characterised by bounded rationality. This approach enables us to analyse the conditions for economic disruptions to emerge and become persistent, considering climate tail risk scenarios, and the role of fiscal and credit constraints as amplification mechanisms. We calibrate EIRIN on Italy, a country that is highly exposed to natural disasters, has significant fiscal vulnerabilities and high public debt. We find that extreme weather events leading to 15% of firms’ capital stock loss, coupled with subsequent financial constraints on lending, can trigger large and persistent adverse effects on GDP growth and public debt levels. Negative shocks are amplified in absence of country’s adaptation strategies and tailored financial policies.
10.1016/j.ecolecon.2025.108685.abstract_zh: 急性物理风险正变得愈发频繁和严重，未来情景预测其将进一步加剧。此类事件可能造成重大且可能持续的经济损失，并因灾害应对和恢复成本上升而给公共财政带来压力。然而，迄今为止，宏观经济模型在一致性地捕捉气候物理风险对经济和公共财政的影响方面仍面临困难。特别是，尾部天气事件和关键冲击传导渠道往往被忽视，导致对灾害损失和恢复需求的评估不完整。而这些信息对于评估气候保险保障缺口以及设计充分且财政上稳健的公共政策应对至关重要。为弥补这一缺口，我们对EIRIN模型进行了定制和扩展，该模型是一个以国家层面校准的开放经济体存量-流量一致宏观金融模型。EIRIN由有限数量的异质性主体以及实体经济与金融部门构成，这些主体通过市场相互作用。重要的是，经济的实体面和金融面以一体化方式建模。主体以基于真实数据校准的互联资产负债表项目网络为代表，并具有有限理性特征。这一方法使我们能够分析经济扰动出现并持续的条件，考虑气候尾部风险情景，以及财政和信贷约束作为放大机制的作用。我们将EIRIN校准于意大利，该国高度暴露于自然灾害，具有显著的财政脆弱性和高公共债务。我们发现，极端天气事件导致企业资本存量损失15%，加之随后的金融信贷约束，可能对GDP增长和公共债务水平产生大规模且持续的负面影响。在缺乏国家适应战略和针对性金融政策的情况下，负面冲击会被放大。
10.1016/j.ecolecon.2025.108685.title: Breaking the Economy: How Climate Tail Risk and Financial Conditions can Shape Loss Persistence and Economic Recovery
10.1016/j.ecolecon.2025.108685.title_zh: 打破经济：气候尾部风险与金融状况如何影响损失持续性与经济复苏

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112978.abstract: This paper proposes a dependent wild bootstrap (DWB) procedure for inference on matching estimators in the presence of spatial dependence. The bootstrap algorithm delivers a spatial heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation consistent (HAC) variance estimator that accommodates unknown spatial dependence. By accounting for spatial correlation in the residuals, this approach improves the accuracy of standard error estimation for nonparametric matching estimators. A small Monte Carlo simulation illustrates its performance in a finite sample.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112978.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种相依野生动自助法（DWB）程序，用于在存在空间依赖性的情况下对匹配估计量进行推断。该自助算法提供了一种空间异方差和自相关一致（HAC）的方差估计量，能够适应未知的空间依赖性。通过考虑残差中的空间相关性，该方法提高了非参数匹配估计量标准误估计的准确性。一个小型蒙特卡洛模拟展示了其在有限样本中的表现。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112978.title: Bootstrap inference for matching estimator under spatially correlated effects
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112978.title_zh: 空间相关效应下匹配估计量的Bootstrap推断

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112983.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic political-economy model of trade-policy hysteresis. Tariffs reduce innovation and competitiveness but generate short-run benefits for import-competing sectors, creating incentives for myopic policymakers to adopt protectionism. The interaction between myopic protectionist policy and slow-moving competitiveness generates two stable steady states: a low-tariff, high-competitiveness regime and a high-tariff, low-competitiveness regime. Although free trade is welfare superior, it is politically fragile. Temporary tariff shocks that sufficiently erode competitiveness can permanently shift political incentives toward protectionism, trapping the economy in a low-competitiveness equilibrium with persistently high tariffs and lower welfare.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112983.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于贸易政策滞后性的动态政治经济学模型。关税降低了创新与竞争力，却为进口竞争部门带来短期利益，从而激励短视的政策制定者采取保护主义。短视的保护主义政策与缓慢变动的竞争力之间的相互作用，产生了两个稳定的稳态：一个低关税、高竞争力的体制，以及一个高关税、低竞争力的体制。尽管自由贸易在福利上更优，但在政治上却显得脆弱。暂时性的关税冲击若足以侵蚀竞争力，便能永久性地将政治激励转向保护主义，使经济陷入低竞争力均衡，伴随持续高关税与更低福利。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112983.title: Tipping into protectionism: Tariff shocks and the fragility of free trade
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112983.title_zh: 转向保护主义：关税冲击与自由贸易的脆弱性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112984.abstract: I develop a unified model of resource and risk sharing in which 𝑁 agents pool against a common crisis threshold subject to transaction costs. Three results follow. As transaction costs fall: the welfare-optimal pool expands and individual buffers shrink; average welfare improves strictly; and expected crisis scale — the number of agents simultaneously unable to access the shared resource — grows, even if crisis probability falls. The mechanism is identical across financial risk pooling, supply-chain management, and transportation networks. Large systemic crises are the necessary consequence of welfare-optimal pooling. The correct policy response is a Pigouvian charge on each participant’s marginal contribution to expected crisis scale.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112984.abstract_zh: 我构建了一个统一的资源与风险分担模型，其中N个代理在面临交易成本的情况下，共同应对一个共同的危机阈值。由此得出三个结论。随着交易成本的降低：福利最优的池子规模扩大，个体缓冲减少；平均福利严格改善；以及预期危机规模——即同时无法获取共享资源的代理数量——增大，即使危机概率下降。这一机制在金融风险分担、供应链管理和交通网络中均相同。大规模系统性危机是福利最优分担的必要结果。正确的政策应对是对每个参与者对预期危机规模的边际贡献征收庇古税。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112984.title: Why efficient systems fail spectacularly: A unified theory of systemic risk
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112984.title_zh: 高效系统为何惨败：系统性风险的统一理论

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112992.abstract: Analyzing almost 2.3 million work-related injuries in Italy, we estimate that higher humidity levels significantly increase the number of workplace accidents. Using dew point temperature to capture the moisture content of the atmosphere, our results confirm that a 1 °C increase in the dew point temperature raises the number of accidents by 0.7%. Allowing for non-linear effects of humidity, we uncover a U-shaped relationship highlighting that both low and high humidity levels are associated with a higher number of accidents relative to intermediate conditions.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112992.abstract_zh: 通过分析意大利近230万起工伤事故，我们发现湿度水平升高显著增加了工作场所事故的数量。利用露点温度来捕捉大气中的水分含量，我们的结果证实，露点温度每上升1°C，事故数量增加0.7%。考虑湿度的非线性效应后，我们揭示了一种U型关系，表明相对于中等湿度条件，低湿度和高湿度水平都与更多的事故相关联。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112992.title: Humidity and work-related accidents

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112994.abstract: We study the labor market effects of restricting access to credit information in hiring using a nationwide Chilean policy that temporarily removed recent delinquencies from the credit reports of unemployed workers. The law disproportionately affects low-income workers, who face longer unemployment spells after its implementation, with especially large effects for younger and female workers. These patterns are consistent with reduced screening precision when credit histories are unavailable. Our findings show that such policies can generate cross-subsidization from low-income workers with clean credit histories toward those with recent delinquencies.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112994.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一项限制招聘中信用信息获取的政策对劳动力市场的影响，该政策基于智利全国性规定，暂时将失业工人的近期违约记录从其信用报告中移除。该法律对低收入工人影响尤为显著，他们在政策实施后经历了更长的失业期，其中年轻和女性工人的影响尤为突出。这些现象与信用历史缺失时筛选精度下降的预期相符。我们的研究结果表明，此类政策可能导致从信用记录良好的低收入工人向近期有违约记录的工人进行交叉补贴。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112994.title: Labor market effects of deleting delinquencies
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.112994.title_zh: 删除逾期记录对劳动力市场的影响

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113003.abstract: Using a panel of 157 countries over the period 2000–2022, we estimate time-varying coefficients of government spending cyclicality and examine whether independent fiscal institutions help reduce this cyclicality. Our findings indicate that the design features of independent fiscal institutions play a crucial role. Institutions with stronger mandates, broader responsibilities, greater independence, adequate resources, and effective communication frameworks are associated with more countercyclical fiscal policy.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113003.abstract_zh: 利用2000年至2022年间157个国家的面板数据，我们估计了政府支出周期性的时变系数，并考察独立财政机构是否有助于降低这种周期性。研究结果显示，独立财政机构的设计特征至关重要。拥有更强授权、更广泛职责、更高独立性、充足资源及有效沟通框架的机构，与更具逆周期性的财政政策相关联。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113003.title: Design matters: Independent fiscal institutions and the cyclicality of government spending
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113003.title_zh: 设计至关重要：独立财政机构与政府支出的周期性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113006.abstract: This note studies conditional forecasting under conditions on annual growth rates when variables enter a (possibly structural) vector autoregressive (VAR) model in logarithms or logarithmic first differences. Imposing conditions on the annual growth rate of, for example, quarterly real GDP modeled in logarithms is challenging because annual growth rates are nonlinear functions of the log variables. We derive a linear approximation that makes annual growth-rate conditions compatible with standard conditional forecasting methods and complement it with a damped iterative correction that enforces the nonlinear annual-growth restriction up to numerical tolerance. We provide MATLAB companion code 2 that also accepts other types of conditions: (1) conditions on the path of variables entering the VAR, (2) conditions on the path of structural shocks, and (3) conditions on sums of successive variable observations.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113006.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在变量以对数或对数一阶差分形式进入（可能为结构性的）向量自回归（VAR）模型时，对年度增长率施加条件进行条件预测的问题。例如，当季度实际GDP以对数形式建模时，对其年度增长率施加条件颇具挑战性，因为年度增长率是对数变量的非线性函数。我们推导出一种线性近似方法，使年度增长率条件能与标准条件预测方法兼容，并辅以阻尼迭代修正，以确保非线性年度增长约束在数值容差范围内得到满足。我们提供了MATLAB配套代码，该代码还支持其他类型的条件：（1）对进入VAR的变量路径施加条件，（2）对结构性冲击路径施加条件，以及（3）对连续变量观测值之和施加条件。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113006.title: Forecasting with log-linear (S)VAR models: Incorporating annual growth rate conditions
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113006.title_zh: 使用对数线性(S)VAR模型进行预测：纳入年度增长率条件

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113009.abstract: The maturity premium, a newly proposed anomaly, characterizes higher returns of stocks adopting more long-term debt. Motivated by the stylized facts of declines in the use and dispersion in long-term debt for the U.S. companies, we hypothesize that the maturity premium has attenuated in recent periods. Applying Bai and Perron’s (1998) structural-change test, we detect one structural break at June 2000. The abnormal maturity premium is significant before this date but becomes insignificant afterwards. Our results are robust to different factor models and the concentration of the smallest firms.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113009.abstract_zh: 期限溢价，作为一种新提出的异象，描述了采用更多长期债务的股票获得更高回报的现象。鉴于美国公司长期债务使用减少及其分布分散化的典型事实，我们假设期限溢价在近期已有所减弱。运用Bai和Perron（1998）的结构变化检验，我们检测到2000年6月存在一个结构断点。在此日期之前，异常期限溢价显著，而之后则不再显著。我们的结果在不同因子模型及最小公司集中度下均保持稳健。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113009.title: Has the maturity premium attenuated over time?
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113009.title_zh: 期限溢价是否随时间衰减？

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113010.abstract: We examine whether the late-February 2026 escalation of the Iran conflict revived the safe-haven role of traditional and alternative assets. Using daily Refinitiv data, an event-study design, and interaction regressions with global equity returns, we analyze gold, Bitcoin, oil, and European natural gas (TTF) around the conflict escalation. Gold provides, at best, weak safe-haven properties, with no significant abnormal returns and higher volatility during the event window. Bitcoin offers no robust protection. Oil displays the clearest short-run hedge, but because its payoff is directly exposed to war-related supply risk. The evidence points to war hedges rather than a broad re-emergence of genuinely safe assets.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113010.abstract_zh: 我们考察了2026年2月下旬伊朗冲突升级是否重振了传统及替代资产的避险角色。利用每日Refinitiv数据、事件研究设计以及与全球股票收益的交互回归，我们分析了冲突升级期间黄金、比特币、石油和欧洲天然气（TTF）的表现。黄金最多仅提供微弱的避险属性，事件窗口期内无显著异常收益且波动性较高。比特币未提供稳健的保护。石油展现出最明确的短期对冲效果，但其回报直接暴露于战争相关的供应风险。证据指向战争对冲，而非真正安全资产的广泛重现。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113010.title: Safe havens or war hedges? Asset behavior during the 2026 escalation of the Iran conflict
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113010.title_zh: 安全港还是战争对冲？2026年伊朗冲突升级期间的资产表现

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113017.abstract: Using Shanghai’s 2022 Industrial Internet Chain Leader Program as a quasi-experiment, this study constructs a 2018–2024 firm-level panel to examine the effects of focal firms’ industrial internet platforms on supply chain innovation. We find that the program significantly boosts innovation among upstream suppliers by enhancing collaborative innovation and alleviating liquidity constraints, whereas downstream effects remain negligible. Moreover, the effects are stronger for suppliers with greater technological distance and smaller size, reflecting cross-boundary and size-related spillovers. These findings provide empirical evidence on how focal firms’ industrial internet platforms facilitate supply chain innovation, offering insights for digital transformation and chain-leader policies.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113017.abstract_zh: 本研究以上海市2022年工业互联网链主计划为准自然实验，构建2018—2024年企业层面面板数据，考察核心企业工业互联网平台对供应链创新的影响。研究发现，该计划显著提升了上游供应商的创新水平，其作用机制在于增强协同创新并缓解流动性约束，而对下游企业的影响则不显著。此外，对于技术距离较大、规模较小的供应商，该效应更为明显，体现了跨边界及规模相关的溢出效应。上述发现为核心企业工业互联网平台如何促进供应链创新提供了经验证据，并为数字化转型及链主政策制定提供了启示。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113017.title: Do focal firms’ industrial internet platforms promote innovation along the supply chain?
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113017.title_zh: 焦点企业的工业互联网平台是否促进了供应链上的创新？

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113020.abstract: This note revisits the important question of how fines and imprisonment should be optimally employed. In D’Antoni et al. (2022), a monotone hazard rate condition implies a corner solution for imprisonment in the observable-wealth benchmark when imprisonment disutility is linear. We show that this result is not robust to offenders facing diminishing marginal disutility of imprisonment. The optimal prison term is interior as long as the marginal disutility associated with large imprisonment terms are low and the harms from the offense are large enough to warrant imprisonment. The sentence length thus becomes a genuine policy margin rather than a boundary instrument.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113020.abstract_zh: 本文重访了罚款与监禁如何最优运用这一重要问题。在D'Antoni等人（2022）的研究中，单调风险率条件在监禁负效用为线性时，于可观察财富基准下导致了监禁的角点解。我们证明，当罪犯面临监禁边际负效用递减时，这一结果并不稳健。只要与较长监禁期限相关的边际负效用较低，且犯罪危害足够大以至于需要监禁，最优监禁期限即为内部解。因此，刑期长度成为一个真正的政策边际，而非边界工具。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113020.title: Interior optimal imprisonment under diminishing marginal disutility
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113020.title_zh: 边际负效用递减下的最优监禁刑期

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113022.abstract: We examine the long-run economic consequences of population decline when automation and education respond endogenously to the demographic challenge. We show that, despite negative population growth, positive per capita output growth can be sustained. In equilibrium, output grows in line with physical and human capital accumulation, with household saving behavior playing a central role in sustaining growth. Moreover, the income share of raw labor declines, whereas the share of human capital remains constant.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113022.abstract_zh: 我们考察了当自动化和教育内生地应对人口挑战时，人口下降的长期经济后果。研究表明，尽管人口负增长，人均产出仍能保持正增长。在均衡状态下，产出增长与物质资本和人力资本积累同步，家庭储蓄行为在维持增长中扮演核心角色。此外，原始劳动收入份额下降，而人力资本份额保持不变。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113022.title: Economic growth with human, physical, and automation capital: The role of population decline
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113022.title_zh: 人力、物质与自动化资本驱动的经济增长：人口下降的作用

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113023.title: Corrigendum to “Student beauty and grades under in-person and remote teaching” [Economics Letters 2019 (2022) 110782]
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113023.title_zh: 勘误：“面对面与远程教学下的学生外貌与成绩” [《经济学快报》2019 (2022) 110782]

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113024.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of common ownership on platform competition with price parity clauses (PPCs). We develop a model of two competing platforms and a multi-homing seller. While common ownership typically raises prices and reduces welfare without PPCs, it lowers platform fees and consumer prices under PPCs. As a result, it increases platform and seller profits, consumer surplus, and total welfare, generating a Pareto improvement.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113024.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了共同所有权在价格平价条款（PPCs）下对平台竞争的影响。我们构建了一个包含两个竞争平台和一个多归属卖家的模型。在没有PPCs的情况下，共同所有权通常会提高价格并降低福利；而在PPCs存在时，它则降低了平台费用和消费者价格。因此，共同所有权增加了平台和卖家的利润、消费者剩余及总福利，实现了帕累托改进。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113024.title: Platform competition with common ownership and price parity clauses
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113024.title_zh: 共同所有权与价格平价条款下的平台竞争

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113026.abstract: Using transaction-level data for leading digital assets traded on the largest cryptocurrency exchange, we examine trading activity at the 100-millisecond horizon. A disproportionally high trading activity is found during the first 100 milliseconds of a given second in both spot market and perpetual futures. We consider two competing explanations rooted in exchange-level infrastructure versus participant-driven algorithmic trading. Trades executed during the first 100 milliseconds of a second have a significant contribution to permanent price changes after adjusting for the elevated trading intensity during that interval, which is consistent with the notion of algorithmic trading and its leading role in price discovery in the cryptocurrency markets.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113026.abstract_zh: 利用最大加密货币交易所上主要数字资产的交易级数据，我们考察了100毫秒时间尺度上的交易活动。在现货市场和永续合约市场中，均发现给定秒内前100毫秒的交易活动异常偏高。我们考虑两种竞争性解释，分别基于交易所层面基础设施与参与者驱动的算法交易。在调整该时段内高交易强度后，秒内前100毫秒执行的交易对永久价格变动有显著贡献，这与算法交易的概念及其在加密货币市场价格发现中的主导作用相一致。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113026.title: Price discovery in cryptocurrency markets: sub-second evidence
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113026.title_zh: 加密货币市场的价格发现：亚秒级证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113027.abstract: We assess the impact of cryptocurrencies ultra-high frequency trading on financial stability. Focusing on three well-established cryptocurrencies, namely Bitcoin, Ethereum and Sui, we show that as the trading frequency increases, so do the excess potential losses of the investors, over and above the anticipated losses based on the Value-at-Risk. This is led by the exponential growth of the kurtosis that is exhibited at high-frequency trading. Given that currently the minimum capital requirements do not differentiate between the trading frequency but only between the type of cryptoassets groups, we show that such overlook poses a threat to the financial stability.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113027.abstract_zh: 我们评估了加密货币超高频交易对金融稳定性的影响。聚焦于三种成熟的加密货币，即比特币、以太坊和Sui，我们表明随着交易频率的增加，投资者的超额潜在损失也随之上升，超出了基于风险价值所预期的损失。这一现象由高频交易中呈现的峰度指数级增长所驱动。鉴于当前最低资本要求并未区分交易频率，而仅区分加密资产组类型，我们指出这种忽视对金融稳定性构成了威胁。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113027.title: Cryptokurtosis: Frequent trading fuels higher losses
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113027.title_zh: 加密峰度：频繁交易加剧更高损失

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113034.abstract: We study how rising longevity affects the long-run real interest rate in an overlapping-generations model with mortality risk and accidental bequests to the young. Longer lives increase retirement saving, which tends to lower the interest rate, but they also reduce such bequests and shift asset payoffs from young savers to surviving retirees, weakening aggregate saving. Public debt amplifies this second force. When debt is sufficiently high, further increases in longevity eventually raise the steady-state interest rate. Thus, longevity need not continue to depress interest rates: with large public debt, the relationship between longevity and the interest rate becomes non-monotonic. • We study the longevity–interest rate relationship in an OLG model with accidental bequests. • Longevity raises saving but reduces accidental bequests to the young. • Public debt amplifies the decline in bequests and shifts asset payoffs. • High public debt can make the relationship U-shaped.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113034.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在包含死亡风险和向年轻人意外遗赠的交叠世代模型中，寿命延长如何影响长期实际利率。更长的寿命增加了退休储蓄，这倾向于降低利率，但同时也减少了此类遗赠，并将资产收益从年轻储蓄者转移至存活的退休者，从而削弱了总体储蓄。公共债务放大了这第二种力量。当债务足够高时，寿命的进一步延长最终会提高稳态利率。因此，寿命延长未必持续压低利率：在公共债务庞大的情况下，寿命与利率之间的关系变为非单调的。• 我们在包含意外遗赠的OLG模型中研究了寿命与利率的关系。• 寿命延长提高了储蓄，但减少了对年轻人的意外遗赠。• 公共债务加剧了遗赠的减少并转移了资产收益。• 高公共债务可使该关系呈U形。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113034.title: Fiscal demographic reversal

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113052.abstract: This paper examines gender differences in pension literacy in Italy, distinguishing between knowledge of the public pension pillar and knowledge of supplementary pensions. Using a cross-sectional survey of 2436 working-age adults, we document a substantial raw gender gap in pension literacy. Once observable differences between men and women are taken into account, these characteristics explain roughly half of the gap, while the remaining half persists even after conditioning on observables. Our findings further show that the gender gap is not uniform across pension domains. Women remain significantly less informed about the public pension system, whereas the gap disappears in the case of supplementary pensions. These results suggest that women’s lower pension literacy reflects not only broader differences in financial literacy, but also a specific disadvantage in understanding the public pension system.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113052.abstract_zh: 本文考察了意大利养老金素养中的性别差异，区分了对公共养老金支柱的了解与对补充养老金的了解。利用一项涵盖2436名劳动年龄成年人的横截面调查，我们记录了养老金素养中显著的原始性别差距。在考虑男女性别间的可观测差异后，这些特征解释了约一半的差距，而剩余一半即使在控制可观测变量后依然存在。我们的研究结果进一步表明，性别差距在养老金领域并非均匀分布。女性对公共养老金体系的了解显著较少，而在补充养老金方面，这一差距则消失。这些结果表明，女性较低的养老金素养不仅反映了金融素养方面的广泛差异，也体现了其在理解公共养老金体系上的特定劣势。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113052.title: Gender gap in pension literacy: Evidence from Italy
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113052.title_zh: 意大利养老金素养的性别差距：来自意大利的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113054.abstract: We develop an information design model where mutual fund managers jointly choose portfolio volatility and disclosure policy to maximize fee revenue from risk-averse investors. We demonstrate that persuasion fundamentally drives risk-taking. When high risk-free rates render funds unappealing, managers endogenously inflate asset volatility to manufacture the information asymmetry required to persuade investors. Optimal volatility strictly increases with the risk-free rate and decreases with investor risk aversion. Our framework highlights how high interest rates inadvertently incentivize excessive risk-taking in asset management.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113054.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个信息设计模型，其中共同基金经理联合选择投资组合波动性和披露政策，以最大化来自风险厌恶投资者的费用收入。我们证明，说服机制从根本上驱动了风险承担行为。当高无风险利率使基金缺乏吸引力时，经理人内生地抬高资产波动性，以制造说服投资者所需的信息不对称。最优波动性随无风险利率严格递增，随投资者风险厌恶程度递减。我们的框架揭示了高利率如何无意中激励资产管理中的过度风险承担。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113054.title: Endogenous volatility and strategic disclosure in mutual funds
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113054.title_zh: 共同基金的内生波动性与策略性披露

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113056.abstract: This paper examines how blockchain adoption affects corporate investment efficiency in China. Exploiting the staggered regional rollout of China's blockchain-based electronic invoice system as a quasi-natural experiment, we employ a difference-in-differences design and find that blockchain adoption significantly improves corporate investment efficiency. The results remain robust across a series of endogeneity and robustness tests. Mechanism analysis indicates that the effect operates primarily through improvements in financial reporting quality. Overall, our findings provide novel causal evidence on the real economic consequences of blockchain adoption and highlight the role of government-mandated information technology infrastructure in enhancing firms' resource allocation efficiency.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113056.abstract_zh: 本文考察了区块链采纳如何影响中国企业的投资效率。利用中国基于区块链的电子发票系统分阶段区域推广作为准自然实验，我们采用双重差分设计，发现区块链采纳显著提升了企业投资效率。该结果在一系列内生性与稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析表明，这一效应主要通过提高财务报告质量来实现。总体而言，我们的研究为区块链采纳的真实经济后果提供了新颖的因果证据，并强调了政府主导的信息技术基础设施在提升企业资源配置效率中的作用。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113058.abstract: This paper studies whether the world’s largest workfare scheme reduces targeted violence against marginalized groups. Leveraging the district-wise phased rollout of the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS), we employ a difference-in-differences design to identify the causal impact of MGNREGS implementation on targeted crimes against disadvantaged caste groups. Our findings show a significant increase in reported caste-based crimes following the scheme’s introduction. We discuss and provide suggestive evidence on the mechanisms.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113058.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了全球规模最大的工作福利计划是否减少了针对边缘化群体的定向暴力。利用圣雄甘地国家农村就业保障计划（MGNREGS）在各地区的分阶段推广，我们采用双重差分设计来识别MGNREGS实施对针对弱势种姓群体的定向犯罪的影响。研究结果显示，该计划引入后，报告的基于种姓的犯罪显著增加。我们讨论了相关机制并提供了初步证据。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113058.title: Can public works increase caste-based conflicts? Evidence from India’s National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113058.title_zh: 公共工程会加剧种姓冲突吗？来自印度全国农村就业保障计划的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113060.abstract: A forward-looking agent observes signals of a state that follows a Gaussian AR(1) process. He balances the cost of having imprecise beliefs with the cost of acquiring more precise signals. I characterize his optimal information acquisition policy, and analyze how his steady-state beliefs and costs depend on persistence (the AR(1) parameter) and patience (the agent’s discount factor). Higher persistence has a non-monotone effect on belief precision and raises overall costs. Higher patience makes beliefs more precise and lowers overall costs.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113060.abstract_zh: 前瞻性主体观察遵循高斯AR(1)过程的状态信号。他在信念不精确的成本与获取更精确信号的成本之间进行权衡。我刻画了他的最优信息获取策略，并分析了其稳态信念和成本如何依赖于持续性（AR(1)参数）和耐心（主体的贴现因子）。更高的持续性对信念精度具有非单调效应，并提高总体成本。更高的耐心使信念更精确，并降低总体成本。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113060.title: Persistence, patience and costly information acquisition
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113060.title_zh: 持久性、耐心与昂贵的信息获取

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113063.abstract: This paper proposes a method to account for sample selection (survivor bias) in cross-country comparisons. International assessments such as the Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) observe outcomes only for students enrolled in school at age 15, which can distort comparisons in countries with high dropout rates. I consider a quantile-based selection correction that delivers bounds on countries’ average performance rather than point estimates. Using these bounds, I construct optimistic and pessimistic rankings, with each country’s true rank lying between the two. An application to PISA 2018 shows that correcting for selection bias leads to substantial changes in countries’ average scores and rankings.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113063.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在跨国比较中处理样本选择（幸存者偏差）的方法。诸如国际学生评估项目（PISA）等国际评估仅观测到15岁在校学生的成绩，这可能在辍学率较高的国家导致比较结果失真。我考虑了一种基于分位数的选择校正方法，该方法提供国家平均表现的上界和下界，而非点估计。利用这些界限，我构建了乐观和悲观排名，每个国家的真实排名介于两者之间。对PISA 2018数据的应用表明，校正选择偏差后，各国的平均分数和排名发生了显著变化。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113063.title: Correcting sample selection bias in PISA rankings
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113063.title_zh: 修正PISA排名中的样本选择偏差

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113064.abstract: Probabilistic stated choices allow respondents to express uncertainty about their intended decisions. They are typically paired with random-coefficient models (RCM) that impose Type I extreme value (EV1) resolvable uncertainty. This paper proposes a test of these assumptions based on the restrictions imposed by the EV1 distribution on the population distribution of interquantile ranges of ex ante returns. Our test is rejected in four studies published in leading economics journals. In these applications, EV1-based estimators often perform reasonably well for median willingness-to-pay (WTP), but are less reliable for distributional objects such as the full WTP distribution.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113064.abstract_zh: 概率性陈述选择允许受访者表达对其预期决策的不确定性。这类选择通常与随机系数模型（RCM）配对使用，该模型施加了第一类极值（EV1）可解析的不确定性。本文基于EV1分布对事前收益的群体分位数间距分布所施加的限制，提出了一种检验这些假设的方法。我们的检验在发表于顶级经济学期刊的四项研究中被拒绝。在这些应用中，基于EV1的估计器通常对中位数支付意愿（WTP）表现良好，但在诸如完整WTP分布等分布性对象上则可靠性较低。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113064.title: Is the distribution of resolvable uncertainty Type I extreme value? A test for random coefficient models using choice probabilities
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113064.title_zh: 可解析不确定性的分布是否为第一类极值？基于选择概率的随机系数模型检验

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113065.abstract: We examine whether access to the Federal Reserve's Overnight Reverse Repo Facility (ON RRP) affects money market fund flows during flight-to-safety episodes. We find that funds with ON RRP access serving sophisticated investors experience about a 1 percentage point increase in net daily flows over total assets during the March 2020 flight-to-safety episode relative to similar funds without access. The effect aligns with theoretical predictions and explains more than half of the inflows in those funds. Our results show that access to central bank deposit facilities amplifies flight-to-safety behavior.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113065.abstract_zh: 我们考察了在避险时期，美联储隔夜逆回购工具（ON RRP）的准入是否影响货币市场基金的资金流动。我们发现，在2020年3月的避险事件中，相较于没有准入资格的类似基金，拥有ON RRP准入且服务于成熟投资者的基金，其每日净流入占总资产的比例约增加1个百分点。这一效应与理论预测相符，并解释了这些基金中超过一半的资金流入。我们的结果表明，中央银行存款工具的准入加剧了避险行为。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113065.title: Central bank access and flight to safety

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113066.abstract: Retail gasoline prices often adjust asymmetrically to cost shocks (“rockets and feathers”), but existing studies mostly use price data alone. Using daily station-level price and volume data from Sweden, we test whether asymmetry varies by station size. Nonlinear ARDL and error-correction models show that high-volume stations display more persistent short-run asymmetry, mainly due to slower adjustment after cost decreases. Weighting by station sales implies an annual consumer overcharge of about 1.25 billion SEK. Ignoring station heterogeneity biases aggregate loss estimates: using only low-volume stations understates losses, while using only high-volume stations overstates them.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113066.abstract_zh: 零售汽油价格对成本冲击的调整往往呈现非对称性（“火箭与羽毛”现象），但现有研究大多仅依赖价格数据。利用瑞典每日加油站层面的价格与销量数据，我们检验了非对称性是否随加油站规模而变化。非线性ARDL及误差修正模型显示，高销量加油站的短期非对称性更为持久，主要源于成本下降后调整速度较慢。按加油站销量加权计算，消费者年度多付金额约为12.5亿瑞典克朗。忽视加油站异质性会扭曲总体损失估计：仅使用低销量加油站会低估损失，而仅使用高销量加油站则会高估损失。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113066.title: Asymmetric cost pass-through in gasoline retailing: The role of retailer size for pass-through
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113066.title_zh: 汽油零售中的非对称成本传导：零售商规模对传导的影响

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113067.abstract: The approach by Engelberg et al. (2009) to convert probabilistic survey responses into continuous probability distributions implicitly assumes that the question intervals are equally wide. Almost all recently established surveys have intervals of unequal width. Applying the standard approach to these surveys gives implausible and potentially misleading results. This note shows how the approach of Engelberg et al. (2009) can be adjusted to account for intervals of unequal width.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113067.abstract_zh: Engelberg等人（2009年）将概率调查回答转换为连续概率分布的方法，隐含假设了问题区间宽度相等。然而，几乎所有近期建立的调查都采用了不等宽区间。将标准方法应用于这些调查，会产生不合理且可能具有误导性的结果。本文展示了如何调整Engelberg等人（2009年）的方法，以适应不等宽区间的情况。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113067.title: Extending the procedure of Engelberg et al. (2009) to surveys with unequal interval widths
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113067.title_zh: 将Engelberg等人(2009)的方法扩展到不等区间宽度的调查中

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113068.abstract: We develop a dynamic model of investment timing and liquidity management for a financially constrained all-equity firm whose entrepreneur has time-inconsistent preferences. We provide closed-form solutions for the equity value before and after investment and for the optimal investment threshold. We find that entrepreneur’s time inconsistency delays investment and increases the firm’s cash holdings for investment, which provides a potential theoretical explanation for why firms hold substantial cash. In addition, the investment financing mix violates the pecking order when the degree of time inconsistency is low: firms issue external equity even when internal funds are available. When the degree of time inconsistency is high, investment is financed entirely with internal cash, which aligns with the predictions of the pecking order.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113068.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个动态模型，研究财务受限的全权益企业在企业家具有时间不一致偏好时的投资时机与流动性管理问题。我们提供了投资前后股权价值的闭式解以及最优投资阈值的闭式解。研究发现，企业家的时间不一致性会延迟投资并增加企业为投资持有的现金量，这为解释企业为何持有大量现金提供了潜在的理论依据。此外，当时间不一致程度较低时，投资融资组合违背了啄序理论：即使内部资金充足，企业也会发行外部股权。当时间不一致程度较高时，投资完全由内部现金融资，这与啄序理论的预测一致。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113068.title: Investment timing and cash management with time-inconsistent preferences
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113068.title_zh: 时间不一致偏好下的投资时机与现金管理

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113069.abstract: Using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2007 to 2022, this paper examines how supply chain risk perception affects cross-regional investment. We find that such perception significantly reduces cross-regional investment, while regional FinTech development mitigates this effect. Mechanism tests identify three channels: increased cash holdings, weakened risk-taking willingness, and strategic contraction. The inhibitory effect is more pronounced in firms within highly competitive industries, regions with lower internet development, and firms with severe managerial myopia. Our findings illuminate the spatial spillover effects of supply chain risk and offer evidence for optimizing cross-regional investment decisions.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113069.abstract_zh: 本文利用2007年至2022年中国A股上市公司数据，考察供应链风险感知对跨区域投资的影响。研究发现，供应链风险感知显著减少了企业的跨区域投资，而区域金融科技的发展则缓解了这一效应。机制检验识别出三条路径：现金持有增加、风险承担意愿减弱及战略收缩。抑制作用在竞争激烈行业中的企业、互联网发展水平较低地区以及管理层短视严重的企业中更为显著。本研究揭示了供应链风险的空间溢出效应，并为优化跨区域投资决策提供了证据支持。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113069.title: Supply chain risk perception, FinTech, and cross-regional capital flows: evidence from China
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113069.title_zh: 供应链风险感知、金融科技与跨区域资本流动：来自中国的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113070.abstract: Degrowth is often advocated as a response to the climate crisis, but its consistency with growth theory remains unclear. We develop an endogenous growth model of directed technical change and climate in which the economy relies on both a polluting fossil resource and a clean renewable alternative. We fully characterize the social optimum and show that accounting for climate damages may justify an initial phase of degrowth. Such a phase is more likely when fossil resources are abundant and fossil-oriented research is relatively inefficient. In all cases, long-run optimal growth remains positive.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113070.abstract_zh: 去增长常被倡导作为应对气候危机的方案，但其与增长理论的一致性尚不明确。我们构建了一个定向技术变迁与气候的内生增长模型，在该模型中，经济同时依赖污染性化石资源和清洁可再生能源。我们全面刻画了社会最优状态，并表明考虑气候损害可能为初始阶段的去增长提供合理性。这一阶段在化石资源丰富且化石导向研究相对低效时更可能出现。在所有情形下，长期最优增长仍保持为正。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113070.title: Does the climate challenge justify degrowth?
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113070.title_zh: 气候挑战是否证明了去增长的合理性？

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113071.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between population decline, capital deepening, and productivity growth using cross-country panel data over 1975–2023. Consistent with standard growth theory, slower population growth is associated with faster capital deepening. Conditional on controls, it is also linked to stronger GDP per worker growth, particularly in more technologically advanced economies. The results suggest that demographic headwinds can induce adjustment through capital deepening and labor-saving technologies. While population decline is not inherently beneficial, endogenous investment and technology responses partly offset its adverse effects on growth.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113071.abstract_zh: 本文利用1975年至2023年的跨国面板数据，考察了人口下降、资本深化与生产率增长之间的关系。与标准增长理论一致，人口增长放缓与资本深化加速相关联。在控制相关变量后，这种放缓还与人均GDP增长增强相关，尤其是在技术更为先进的经济体中。研究结果表明，人口逆风可通过资本深化和节约劳动型技术引发调整。尽管人口下降本身并非有益，但内生投资和技术响应部分抵消了其对增长的不利影响。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113071.title: Population decline, capital deepening, and productivity: cross-country evidence
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113071.title_zh: 人口下降、资本深化与生产率：跨国证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113072.abstract: Motivated by empirical evidence from cross-country panel regressions, we develop a heterogeneous-agent model with exponential utility to study how survival risk affects consumption, saving, and the equilibrium real interest rate. Survival risk increases impatience-induced dissaving demand, which raises the equilibrium interest rate through a higher demand for precautionary savings in general equilibrium. Although higher interest rates partially offset this effect by reducing dissaving demand, the overall impact of survival risk on the equilibrium interest rate remains positive. We further show that these results continue to hold under a more general recursive exponential utility specification.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113072.abstract_zh: 受跨国面板回归实证证据的启发，我们构建了一个具有指数效用的异质性主体模型，以研究生存风险如何影响消费、储蓄及均衡实际利率。生存风险加剧了由不耐烦情绪引发的负储蓄需求，从而在一般均衡中通过更高的预防性储蓄需求推高均衡利率。尽管利率上升通过降低负储蓄需求部分抵消了这一效应，但生存风险对均衡利率的总体影响仍为正向。我们进一步证明，在更一般的递归指数效用设定下，这些结论依然成立。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113072.title: Survival risk, the real interest rate, and the permanent income hypothesis in general equilibrium
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113072.title_zh: 一般均衡中的生存风险、实际利率与持久收入假说

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113073.abstract: This paper develops a political economy model in which corruption enhances political control by generating enforceable vulnerability. We conceptualize corruption as a “hostage technology”: by allowing officials to accumulate incriminating evidence, the ruler ensures that elites remain strategically fragmented and vulnerable to selective punishment. We formalize this mechanism through a coordination game of political challenge and derive a risk-dominance threshold for coalition formation. A central theoretical result is the non-monotone effectiveness of enforcement: while moderate enforcement deters political challenges, excessively strong enforcement can paradoxically undermine political control by eliminating the very leverage — incriminating evidence — needed to discipline elites. The model yields sharp comparative statics linking tolerated corruption, enforcement capacity, monitoring technology, and political threat, providing a unified theoretical explanation for the coexistence of systemic corruption and durable political stability.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113073.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个政治经济学模型，其中腐败通过生成可执行的脆弱性来增强政治控制。我们将腐败概念化为一种“人质技术”：通过允许官员积累罪证，统治者确保精英阶层保持战略上的分裂状态，并易受选择性惩罚的影响。我们通过一个政治挑战的协调博弈来形式化这一机制，并推导出联盟形成的风险主导阈值。一个核心理论结果是执法效果的非单调性：适度的执法能威慑政治挑战，而过强的执法却可能适得其反，削弱政治控制——因为它消除了用以约束精英所需的杠杆，即罪证。该模型得出了尖锐的比较静态分析，将容忍的腐败、执法能力、监控技术与政治威胁联系起来，为系统性腐败与持久政治稳定并存提供了统一的理论解释。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113073.title: Corruption as a political control device: Enforceable vulnerability and coalition breakdown
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113073.title_zh: 作为政治控制手段的腐败：可执行的脆弱性与联盟瓦解

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113074.abstract: Bulte et al. (2018), examining the effects of the 2008 earthquake in China, report quasi-experimental evidence of Dutch Disease dynamics in the context of post-disaster aid and recovery. The authors’ conclusion from the synthetic control analysis relies exclusively on visual inspection of the post-earthquake gap between the treated unit and its synthetic control, without implementing the method’s formal inferential procedures. Our reanalysis shows that, while the gap may appear visually large and persistent over time, it is not statistically significant. Within the synthetic control framework, we find no evidence supporting aid-induced Dutch Disease dynamics. This weakens the original study’s conclusion by showing that the reported effect is not robust to alternative methods.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113074.abstract_zh: Bulte等人（2018）在考察2008年中国地震影响时，报告了灾后援助与恢复背景下荷兰病动态的准实验证据。作者基于合成控制分析得出的结论，仅依赖于对处理单元与其合成控制之间地震后差距的视觉检查，而未实施该方法的正式推断程序。我们的再分析表明，尽管这一差距在视觉上可能显得较大且随时间持续存在，但在统计上并不显著。在合成控制框架内，我们未发现支持援助引发的荷兰病动态的证据。这通过表明所报告效应在替代方法下不具稳健性，削弱了原研究的结论。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113074.title: Post-disaster aid and development of the manufacturing sector: Lessons from a natural experiment in China revisited
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113074.title_zh: 灾后援助与制造业发展：基于中国自然实验的再审视

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113075.abstract: This paper reveals that the regression-based trend-cycle decomposition of Hamilton (2018) introduces spurious cyclical dynamics when time series undergo structural breaks. Because the filter relies on an h -step ahead projection, trend adjustment mechanically lags behind regime shifts, inducing large and persistent biases in the cyclical component. We propose a parsimonious modification using a dummy-variable structure that allows the regression intercept and autoregressive components to adjust to identified breaks. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations show that this approach substantially reduces Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) across a wide range of data-generating processes. These gains are robust to variations in break magnitude, timing and number; sample size; and signal-to-noise ratio. Notably, our approach remains superior in pseudo-real-time settings, where the benefits from break-adjustment outweigh the costs of recursive break date estimation and revision. An empirical application to the Swiss franc/euro exchange rate demonstrates that our modification avoids the spurious cyclical spikes generated by standard filters during major policy shifts. Both ex-post and recursive real-time estimates confirm that our proposed framework provides a more reliable decomposition for macroeconomic assessment and inference.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113075.abstract_zh: 本文揭示，当时间序列经历结构性突变时，基于回归的Hamilton（2018）趋势-周期分解会引入虚假的周期动态。由于该滤波器依赖于h步超前预测，趋势调整在机制转换后机械地滞后，导致周期成分出现大而持久的偏差。我们提出了一种简约的修正方法，利用虚拟变量结构，使回归截距和自回归成分能够适应已识别的突变。广泛的蒙特卡洛模拟表明，该方法在多种数据生成过程中显著降低了均方根误差（RMSE）。这些改进对突变幅度、时机和数量的变化，以及样本大小和信噪比均具有稳健性。值得注意的是，在伪实时环境中，我们的方法依然表现优越，因为突变调整带来的收益超过了递归突变日期估计和修正的成本。对瑞士法郎/欧元汇率的实证应用表明，我们的修正避免了标准滤波器在重大政策转变期间产生的虚假周期峰值。事后和递归实时估计均证实，我们提出的框架为宏观经济评估和推断提供了更可靠的分解。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113075.title: Accounting for structural breaks in the Hamilton filter
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113075.title_zh: 汉密尔顿滤波中结构断点的处理

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113076.abstract: This paper examines the effects of taxpayer assistance on corporate tax compliance using administrative data from Brazil’s simplified tax regime (Simples Nacional). Exploiting two large-scale assistance campaigns implemented at different points in time, we adopt a difference-in-differences design, using firms treated later as a control group. We find that assistance generates a large and statistically significant short-run increase in reported tax liabilities: reported amounts rise by 41 percent on average, with peak effects exceeding 270 percent within three months, driven by adjustment tax liabilities. However, these effects are temporary and dissipate within fifteen months. Firms exposed to repeated interventions respond more strongly, suggesting reinforcement effects.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113076.abstract_zh: 本文利用巴西简化税收制度（Simples Nacional）的行政数据，考察纳税人援助对企业税收合规的影响。借助在不同时间点实施的两轮大规模援助活动，我们采用双重差分设计，将后期接受处理的企业作为对照组。研究发现，援助在短期内显著提高了企业申报的税收负债：平均申报金额上升41%，峰值效应在三个月内超过270%，且主要由调整性税收负债驱动。然而，这些效应是暂时的，并在十五个月内逐渐消退。接受多次干预的企业反应更为强烈，表明存在强化效应。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113076.title: Do Taxpayer Assistance Programs Improve Compliance among Small Firms? Evidence from Brazil
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113076.title_zh: 纳税人援助计划是否改善了小型企业的合规性？来自巴西的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113077.abstract: I develop a novel upwind scheme to solve the Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman (HJB) equation with two endogenous state variables. The algorithm chooses the upwind direction that gives the largest Hamiltonian to numerically determine optimal policies over the full state space. The choice of upwind direction in each iteration is intuitive, and can be implemented without splitting asset drifts into multiple components. I compare optimal policy functions on a wealth grid produced by the upwind scheme with those obtained from the splitting scheme used in the literature, and find discrepancies of policy functions at the boundaries.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113077.abstract_zh: 我开发了一种新颖的上风格式，用于求解具有两个内生状态变量的Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman（HJB）方程。该算法选择产生最大Hamiltonian的上风方向，以数值方式确定整个状态空间上的最优策略。每次迭代中上风方向的选择直观易懂，且无需将资产漂移分解为多个分量即可实现。我将上风格式在财富网格上生成的最优策略函数与文献中使用的分裂格式所得结果进行了比较，发现策略函数在边界处存在差异。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113077.title: An upwind scheme for continuous-time optimization with two endogenous state variables
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113077.title_zh: 两个内生状态变量连续时间优化的迎风格式

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113078.abstract: Does climate risk necessarily raise sovereign default risk? While a growing literature documents adverse effects from realized disasters, the implications of long-term (chronic) climate risk remain unclear. Using an endogenous default model with climate shocks, we isolate chronic physical risk from acute disaster realizations. We show that higher climate risk can increase sovereign bond prices by reducing default incentives. Risk-averse governments value continued market access as insurance against future shocks, strengthening repayment motives. While acute disasters still depress prices on impact, chronic risk can operate through a precautionary channel.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113078.abstract_zh: 气候风险是否必然导致主权违约风险上升？尽管越来越多的文献记录了已发生的灾害所带来的不利影响，但长期（慢性）气候风险的影响仍不明确。通过构建包含气候冲击的内生违约模型，我们将慢性物理风险与急性灾害实现区分开来。研究表明，较高的气候风险可能通过降低违约激励来提高主权债券价格。风险厌恶型政府将持续的市场准入视为对未来冲击的保险，从而增强了偿还动机。尽管急性灾害在发生时仍会压低价格，但慢性风险可通过预防性渠道发挥作用。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113078.title: Climate and sovereign default risk

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113079.abstract: In a panel of 4259 ultra-contemporary auction lots (39 artists, 130 houses, 2005Q4–2026Q1), |log(hammer/high estimate)| compresses with within-artist rank only for artists with above-median dispersion in their first five lots (TWFE β = −0.293, wild cluster bootstrap p = 0.015). Of 19 such imprecise-start artists, 18 begin above estimate (Fisher exact p = 0.0008 vs the empirical sample marginal). The compression is not a floor effect: a precise-start subgroup with mean |gap| = 0.456 — well above the imprecise group's terminal level — shows no convergence (β = −0.025, p = 0.883). The compression operates on hammer prices, not on specialist estimate widths.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113079.abstract_zh: 在包含4259件超当代艺术拍卖标的（39位艺术家，130家拍卖行，2005年第四季度至2026年第一季度）的面板数据中，|log(成交价/高估价)|仅对艺术家内部排名呈现压缩效应，且仅限于前五件拍品分散度高于中位数的艺术家（TWFE β = −0.293，野生聚类自助法p = 0.015）。在19位此类起始不精确的艺术家中，有18位起初高于估价（Fisher精确检验p = 0.0008，对比经验样本边际）。该压缩并非地板效应：起始精确的子组平均|差距|为0.456——远高于不精确组的最终水平——却未显示收敛（β = −0.025，p = 0.883）。压缩作用于成交价，而非专家估价宽度。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113079.title: State-dependent within-artist anchor reversal in ultra-contemporary art auctions
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113079.title_zh: 超当代艺术拍卖中艺术家内部锚定反转的状态依赖性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113080.abstract: Using data from the 2024 U.S. National Financial Capability Study, this paper examines the association between financial literacy and buy now, pay later (BNPL) use. A simple framework predicts that greater financial literacy is associated with lower BNPL use, but this link weakens when financial constraints bind. Consistent with this prediction, we find an overall negative association between financial literacy and BNPL use. That pattern, however, is concentrated among non-vulnerable households and becomes weaker, disappears, or reverses under financial vulnerability.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113080.abstract_zh: 利用2024年美国国家金融能力研究数据，本文考察了金融素养与先买后付（BNPL）使用之间的关联。一个简单框架预测，金融素养越高，BNPL使用率越低，但这一联系在财务约束趋紧时会减弱。与这一预测一致，我们发现金融素养与BNPL使用之间存在总体负相关。然而，这一模式集中在非脆弱家庭中，在财务脆弱性下会减弱、消失甚至逆转。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113080.title: Financial literacy, financial vulnerability, and buy now, pay later use
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113080.title_zh: 金融素养、金融脆弱性与先买后付的使用

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113081.abstract: The use of various controlled and illegal substances, especially by young adults, has been a cause of much concern among policymakers, law enforcement officials, educators, and parents. State-level legalization of recreational marijuana in the United States raised concerns about potential adverse impacts on campus drug use and drug law violations. This paper combines data from three sources for 2001–02 to 2023–24, including college campus drug law violations that are collected under the Clery Act of 1990. We find that state legalization of recreational marijuana substantially reduced the arrests and disciplinary incidents for drug law violations.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113081.abstract_zh: 各类受管制及非法物质的使用，尤其是年轻人中的使用，一直是政策制定者、执法官员、教育工作者及家长高度关注的问题。美国各州对娱乐性大麻的合法化引发了关于校园毒品使用及违反毒品法律行为可能产生负面影响的担忧。本文整合了2001-02至2023-24年间三个来源的数据，包括根据1990年《克莱里法案》收集的大学校园毒品法律违规记录。我们发现，州级娱乐性大麻合法化显著减少了因违反毒品法律而导致的逮捕及纪律处分事件。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113081.title: Impact of legalization of recreational marijuana on drug law violations: Evidence from US colleges and universities
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113081.title_zh: 娱乐大麻合法化对毒品违法的影响：来自美国高校的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113089.abstract: We find that gender-neutral financial incentives increased the share of male General Practice (GP) residents by 30% in Catalonia, Spain. Exploiting a salary supplement policy for GP residents and a synthetic difference-in-differences design, we estimate an increase of 8.3 percentage points, with effects concentrated in areas receiving larger wage increases. We also document suggestive evidence of lower GP vacancy rates in treated regions after the policy, although this pattern cannot be interpreted causally. To our knowledge, these results provide the first causal evidence that gender-neutral financial incentives can attract men into a highly feminized occupation.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113089.abstract_zh: 我们发现，性别中立的财政激励措施使西班牙加泰罗尼亚地区男性全科医生（GP）住院医师的比例增加了30%。利用针对全科住院医师的薪资补充政策及合成双重差分设计，我们估计这一比例上升了8.3个百分点，且效应集中在工资增幅较大的地区。我们还记录了政策实施后处理地区全科医生职位空缺率降低的提示性证据，尽管这一模式不能作因果解释。据我们所知，这些结果首次提供了因果证据，表明性别中立的财政激励能够吸引男性进入高度女性化的职业。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113089.title: Paying for parity: Incentivizing men in feminized occupations
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113089.title_zh: 为平等买单：激励女性化职业中的男性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113090.abstract: Economic theory predicts that parents invest more in children when expected returns are higher. We test whether beliefs about societal economic mobility affect these expectations and subsequent investment decisions. In an online experiment, 997 U.S. parents were randomly assigned to view information emphasizing either upward or downward economic mobility. Parents in the upward mobility condition reported higher perceived returns on investment and invested more time and resources: specifically, they allocated 16% more time to a child-focused task and reported 12% higher willingness to pay for educational resources. Results did not vary by parental income or education.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113090.abstract_zh: 经济理论预测，当预期回报更高时，父母会在子女身上投入更多。我们检验了关于社会经济流动性的信念是否会影响这些预期及随后的投资决策。在一项在线实验中，997位美国父母被随机分配查看强调经济流动性向上或向下的信息。处于向上流动性条件下的父母报告了更高的投资感知回报，并投入了更多时间和资源：具体而言，他们将16%更多的时间分配给以儿童为中心的任务，并报告对教育资源有12%更高的支付意愿。结果并未因父母收入或教育水平而异。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113090.title: Economic mobility beliefs and parental investment: Experimental evidence
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113090.title_zh: 经济流动性信念与父母投资：实验证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113091.abstract: We extend the heteroskedasticity IV estimator of Rigobon and Sack (2004) to multiple monetary policy shocks by imposing recursive zero restrictions on the impact matrix. Unlike high-frequency identification, the approach requires neither intraday tick data nor precise announcement timestamps, making it applicable to countries and historical periods where such data are unavailable. Applied to US FOMC announcements, we find causal effects similar to those of high-frequency identification. The heteroskedasticity-based instrument passes weak-instrument tests for the target shock, whereas results are mixed for high-frequency surprises. For the path shock, we obtain strong instruments for the majority of specifications and the underlying shock series is highly correlated with the high-frequency counterpart.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113091.abstract_zh: 我们将Rigobon与Sack（2004）的异方差性IV估计量扩展至多重货币政策冲击，通过对影响矩阵施加递归零约束实现。与高频识别方法不同，该方法既不需要日内逐笔交易数据，也无需精确的公告时间戳，因此适用于缺乏此类数据的国家及历史时期。应用于美国联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告时，我们发现的因果效应与高频识别结果相似。基于异方差性的工具变量在目标冲击的弱工具检验中表现良好，而高频意外冲击的检验结果则参差不齐。对于路径冲击，我们在大多数设定下获得了强工具变量，且其潜在冲击序列与高频对应序列高度相关。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113091.title: Multiple monetary policy shocks from daily data: A heteroskedasticity IV approach
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113091.title_zh: 基于日度数据的多重货币政策冲击：异方差性工具变量方法

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113092.abstract: We develop a macro model with financial frictions where high-productivity farmers must rent land and face ambiguity about production. Ambiguity makes land demand state dependent: it is pro-cyclical when farmers fear low expected returns and counter-cyclical when they anticipate higher future rental costs. Pro-cyclical demand compresses production in downturns and yields competing effects on the net-worth trap. With moderate ambiguity aversion, farmers cut land use, lowering endogenous risk and avoiding the trap. With strong aversion, it slows net-worth rebuilding, leading to sluggish recoveries and economic vulnerability.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113092.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含金融摩擦的宏观模型，其中高生产率农户必须租用土地并面临生产中的模糊性。模糊性使土地需求具有状态依赖性：当农户担忧预期回报较低时，土地需求呈顺周期性；而当他们预期未来租金成本上升时，则呈逆周期性。顺周期需求在经济下行期压缩生产，并对净值陷阱产生竞争性效应。在适度模糊厌恶下，农户减少土地使用，降低内生风险，从而避免陷阱。而在强烈厌恶下，这会减缓净值重建，导致复苏乏力与经济脆弱性。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113092.title: Net worth trap under ambiguity

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113093.abstract: This paper investigates the asymmetric effects of expansionary and contractionary fiscal shocks in the U.S. economy using a state-of-the-art non-linear local projection framework. To identify fiscal shocks, I use a proxy based on revisions to the mean forecast of government spending growth from the Survey of Professional Forecasters, which represent unexpected changes in expectations about government spending. The estimated fiscal multipliers are larger following positive fiscal shocks than following negative ones, indicating asymmetric effects of fiscal policy interventions.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113093.abstract_zh: 本文运用前沿的非线性局部投影框架，研究了美国经济中扩张性与紧缩性财政冲击的非对称效应。为识别财政冲击，我采用基于专业预测者调查中政府支出增长平均预测修正的代理变量，这些修正反映了对政府支出预期的意外变化。估计结果显示，正向财政冲击后的财政乘数大于负向冲击后的乘数，表明财政政策干预存在非对称效应。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113093.title: News on asymmetric fiscal multipliers

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113094.abstract: Can the memory of past inflation shape how people form expectations about prices today? Using regional inflation data from Austria’s 1921–22 hyperinflation linked to quarterly consumer surveys (May 2020–Oct 2024), we document a persistent association between historical inflation exposure and contemporary inflation expectations: individuals from regions more exposed to the historical episode report higher inflation expectations a century later. We further show that regional newspapers in historically high-inflation areas devote greater attention to inflation, suggesting local media environments contribute to the intergenerational transmission of inflation attitudes. The collective memory of major inflation episodes can durably shape expectation formation.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113094.abstract_zh: 过去的通胀记忆能否塑造人们今天对价格预期的形成方式？利用奥地利1921-22年恶性通胀的区域通胀数据，结合季度消费者调查（2020年5月至2024年10月），我们记录了历史通胀暴露与当代通胀预期之间的持久关联：来自历史事件暴露程度更高地区的个体，在一个世纪后报告了更高的通胀预期。我们进一步表明，历史上高通胀地区的区域性报纸对通胀给予了更多关注，这表明地方媒体环境有助于通胀态度的代际传递。重大通胀事件的集体记忆能够持久地影响预期形成。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113094.title: Austria one century apart: Persistent effects of hyperinflation on inflation expectations
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113094.title_zh: 相隔一个世纪的奥地利：恶性通货膨胀对通胀预期的持续影响

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113095.abstract: This paper estimates the elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS) from the aggregate consumption Euler equation using Kroencke’s (2017) unfiltered consumption data. Unlike the published NIPA series used in most studies, unfiltered consumption is designed to recover the latent series obscured by statistical smoothing. Using weak-instrument-robust GMM inference, we show that this measurement choice matters for EIS estimation. With conventional filtered consumption, confidence sets typically include zero and are often uninformative. With unfiltered consumption, confidence sets exclude zero and provide a positive lower bound. The near-zero EIS estimates in the literature may partly reflect a measurement artifact rather than household preferences.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113095.abstract_zh: 本文利用Kroencke（2017）提出的未滤波消费数据，从总体消费欧拉方程中估计跨期替代弹性（EIS）。与多数研究中使用的已发布NIPA序列不同，未滤波消费旨在恢复被统计平滑所掩盖的潜在序列。采用弱工具变量稳健的广义矩估计（GMM）推断，我们证明这一测量选择对EIS估计具有重要影响。使用传统滤波消费数据时，置信集通常包含零且往往信息量不足；而采用未滤波消费数据时，置信集排除零并提供正的下界。文献中接近零的EIS估计可能部分反映的是测量伪象，而非家庭偏好特征。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113095.title: Unfiltered Consumption and the Elasticity of Intertemporal Substitution
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113095.title_zh: 无过滤消费与跨期替代弹性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113096.abstract: We analyze the asymmetric transmission of oil supply news shocks to the inflation distribution in the United States, the Euro Area, and the United Kingdom. Using quantile local projections and high-frequency identification, we document a stark asymmetry across these three large advanced economies: while median responses are transitory, the 90th quantile exhibits significant and persistent increases beyond one year. This upside tail sensitivity, consistent with state-dependent pricing, suggests that supply shocks are structural innovations to the skewness of the inflation distribution. Monetary policy should actively monitor such persistent inflation tail risks to keep expectations anchored.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113096.abstract_zh: 我们分析了石油供给新闻冲击对美国、欧元区和英国通胀分布的不对称传导效应。利用分位数局部投影和高频识别方法，我们记录了这三个大型发达经济体之间显著的不对称性：尽管中位数响应是暂时的，但第90分位数表现出显著且持续超过一年的增长。这种上行尾部敏感性，与状态依赖定价相一致，表明供给冲击是通胀分布偏度的结构性创新。货币政策应积极监测此类持续的通胀尾部风险，以保持预期锚定。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113096.title: Oil supply shocks and inflation tail risks
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113096.title_zh: 石油供给冲击与通胀尾部风险

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113097.abstract: We employ a semiparametric stochastic frontier model with ordinal outcomes to study efficiency in producing overall life satisfaction. Inefficiency is specified as an unknown function of discrete characteristics using a nonparametric Nadaraya–Watson estimator. A Bayesian procedure is developed to estimate latent variables and model parameters, including the bandwidths of the nonparametric component. The empirical analysis examines the role of the Big Five personality traits and individual resilience, showing that individuals who are more extraverted, agreeable, conscientious, and resilient, or less neurotic, tend to be more efficient in converting satisfaction across multiple life domains into overall life satisfaction.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113097.abstract_zh: 本文采用含有序结果的半参数随机前沿模型，研究整体生活满意度的生产效率。通过非参数Nadaraya–Watson估计量，将无效率项设定为离散特征的未知函数。我们开发了贝叶斯程序来估计潜变量和模型参数，包括非参数部分的带宽。实证分析考察了大五人格特质与个体韧性的作用，结果表明：更外向、更随和、更尽责、更具韧性或神经质程度较低的个体，在将多个生活领域的满意度转化为整体生活满意度方面往往更有效率。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113097.title: Efficiency in producing life satisfaction: A stochastic frontier analysis
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113097.title_zh: 生活满意度生产效率：随机前沿分析

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113098.abstract: The super manager model developed in Baranchuk et al. (2011) is revisited in this paper. We show that an important condition required for the firm’s optimization problem was overlooked. Once this condition is imposed, the market equilibrium derived in the original paper may fail to exist for certain parameter values. In particular, the existence of interior hierarchical equilibrium is conditional on managerial productivity exceeding organizational costs, and disappears when demand is sufficiently weak, in the sense that no admissible interior super-manager equilibrium exists We derive the corrected equilibrium system and provide numerical illustrations showing that sufficiently weak demand can eliminate any admissible interior super-manager equilibrium. Our results not only clarify the conditions under which the equilibrium of the super manager model is well defined, but also provide economic interpretations when no admissible interior super-manager equilibrium exists.
