10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113098.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了Baranchuk等人（2011）提出的超级管理者模型。我们发现，该模型在企业优化问题中所需的一个重要条件被忽视了。一旦施加此条件，原论文中推导出的市场均衡在特定参数值下可能不存在。特别是，内部层级均衡的存在性取决于管理生产率是否超过组织成本，并且当需求足够疲弱时，该均衡会消失，即不存在任何可容许的内部超级管理者均衡。我们推导了修正后的均衡体系，并通过数值示例说明，需求不足够强时，任何可容许的内部超级管理者均衡都可能被消除。我们的结果不仅澄清了超级管理者模型均衡定义明确的条件，还为不存在可容许的内部超级管理者均衡时提供了经济学解释。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113098.title: On the existence of equilibrium in the super manager model
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113098.title_zh: 论超级经理模型中均衡的存在性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113099.abstract: We show that non-fundamental price pressure in sovereign bond markets can raise household borrowing costs even when it lowers benchmark yields. Using recommendations of a Chilean advisory firm as an identified shock to government bonds—the mortgage pricing benchmark—buying-pressure events lower yields yet widen spreads by more than the decline, raising mortgage rates on net. Lenders retain the compression as a wider margin, leaving borrowers worse off. Selling pressure raises yields, with mortgage rates partially tracking at longer horizons. Two placebo exercises confirm the results. Price pressure that compresses benchmark yields can leave household borrowing costs higher, not lower.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113099.abstract_zh: 我们证明，主权债券市场中的非基本面价格压力即使降低了基准收益率，也可能提高家庭借贷成本。利用一家智利咨询公司的建议作为对政府债券——即抵押贷款定价基准——的识别冲击，买入压力事件降低了收益率，但利差扩大幅度超过收益率下降，从而净提高了抵押贷款利率。贷款机构将这一压缩保留为更宽的利差，使借款人境况恶化。卖出压力推高收益率，抵押贷款利率在较长时期内部分跟随。两项安慰剂检验证实了这些结果。压缩基准收益率的价格压力可能使家庭借贷成本上升，而非下降。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113099.title: Non-fundamental price pressure and the pass-through to mortgage rates
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113099.title_zh: 非基本面价格压力与抵押贷款利率的传导效应

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113100.abstract: We used a preregistered incentivized online experiment to examine whether unfair treatment increases dishonesty toward uninvolved third parties and whether observers anticipate such effects. Unfairly treated participants were not significantly more likely to lie for personal gain. In contrast, spectators were nearly twice as likely to bet that unfairly treated participants would lie and judged such lying as more morally acceptable following unfair treatment. These patterns provide preliminary evidence of a sizeable belief–behavior gap in expectations about how unfairness influences dishonesty.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113100.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项预先注册的激励性在线实验，考察了不公平对待是否会增加对无关第三方的不诚实行为，以及观察者是否能预见到这种效应。遭受不公平对待的参与者并未显著更倾向于为个人利益而撒谎。相反，旁观者押注遭受不公平对待的参与者会撒谎的可能性几乎翻倍，并认为在不公平对待后此类撒谎行为在道德上更可接受。这些模式初步揭示了关于不公平如何影响不诚实行为的信念与行为之间存在显著差距的证据。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113100.title: Mispredictions about dishonesty after unfair treatment
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113100.title_zh: 不公平对待后对不诚实行为的误判

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113101.abstract: This note analyzes how the moral hazard underlying one loss spills over to another. In a competitive insurance market with two mutually exclusive losses — one is subject to moral hazard while the other is not — we demonstrate that policyholders buy only partial insurance coverage for both losses, even if the second is free of moral hazard. Moreover, the coverage for the second loss is always more generous, and numerical analysis shows that the coverage gap widens with more efficient prevention efforts or lower risk aversion. A mutual assistance mechanism that allows acquainted policyholders to share uninsured risks is introduced to alleviate moral hazard and enhance social welfare.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113101.abstract_zh: 本文分析了某一损失所隐含的道德风险如何外溢至另一损失。在竞争性保险市场中，存在两种互斥损失——一种受道德风险影响，另一种则不受——我们证明，即使第二种损失不存在道德风险，投保人仍会仅为两种损失购买部分保险保障。此外，第二种损失的保障总是更为慷慨，数值分析显示，随着预防措施效率提高或风险厌恶程度降低，保障差距会扩大。本文引入一种互助机制，允许相识的投保人分担未保险风险，以缓解道德风险并增进社会福利。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113101.title: Moral hazard spillovers across losses
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113101.title_zh: 损失间的道德风险溢出效应

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113102.abstract: I study a risk-neutral principal–agent model with moral hazard, limited liability, and renegotiation. With common beliefs, renegotiation is irrelevant under risk neutrality. With heterogeneous beliefs, renegotiation reshapes the contract into a pure “side bet”: after the action is sunk, the principal concentrates all promised compensation on the outcome the agent overweights the most, which can raise compensation costs and even make some actions non-implementable. Under the monotone-likelihood-ratio property and optimism (likelihood-ratio dominance), the disagreement-maximizing outcome coincides with the incentive-efficient outcome, so renegotiation is again innocuous.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113102.abstract_zh: 我研究了一个风险中性的委托-代理模型，该模型包含道德风险、有限责任和再谈判。在共同信念下，风险中性时再谈判无关紧要。在异质信念下，再谈判将合同重塑为纯粹的“对赌”：在行动沉没后，委托人将所有承诺的补偿集中于代理人过度加权最多的结果上，这可能提高补偿成本，甚至使某些行动无法实施。在单调似然比性质和乐观主义（似然比支配）下，分歧最大化的结果与激励有效的结果一致，因此再谈判再次变得无害。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113102.title: Renegotiation and heterogeneous beliefs with risk neutrality
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113102.title_zh: 风险中性下的重新谈判与异质信念

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113103.title: Corrigendum to “Country-level cryptocurrency uncertainty and bank cost of capital” [Economics Letters, 256, October 2025, 112614]
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113103.title_zh: 更正：“国家层面加密货币不确定性与银行资本成本” [《经济学快报》，第256卷，2025年10月，112614]

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113104.abstract: This paper investigates the spatial autoregressive model with convex combination of spatial weights matrices categorized in groups, an empirically relevant specification that has received limited attention in the spatial econometrics literature. We employ the Group Inverse-Gamma Gamma (GIGG) prior introduced by Boss et al. (2024) to distinguish between relevant and irrelevant groups, identify influential spatial weights matrices, and mitigate multicollinearity arising from correlations among matrices within the same group. A computationally efficient Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm is developed for estimation, inference, and hyperparameter tuning. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed prior performs effectively in both parameter estimation and variable selection.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113104.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一类具有分组空间权重矩阵凸组合的空间自回归模型，这是一种在空间计量经济学文献中关注有限但具有实证相关性的设定。我们采用Boss等人（2024）提出的组逆伽马-伽马（GIGG）先验，以区分相关组与不相关组，识别具有影响力的空间权重矩阵，并缓解同一组内矩阵间相关性引起的多重共线性问题。我们开发了一种计算高效的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）算法，用于估计、推断及超参数调优。模拟研究表明，所提出的先验在参数估计和变量选择方面均表现出良好的有效性。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113104.title: Bayesian group shrinkage for spatial autoregressive model with convex combination of spatial weights matrices
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113104.title_zh: 空间权重矩阵凸组合的空间自回归模型的贝叶斯组收缩

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113105.abstract: Mean grocery spending by Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) households peaks at benefit receipt and declines thereafter. Using novel shopping receipt data with observed trip-level tender information across a range of retailers, store formats, and shopping channels, we examine whether households partially smooth grocery spending over the benefit cycle through substitution across payment sources and whether the effects of benefit receipt vary across the grocery spending distribution. We find evidence of smoothing at the extensive margin through modest increases in non-SNAP-funded shopping trips. Distributional analyses reveal more pronounced spending cycles at higher grocery spending quantiles along with suggestive evidence of weaker substitution toward non-SNAP-funded payment sources.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113105.abstract_zh: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）家庭的平均食品杂货支出在福利发放时达到峰值，随后逐渐下降。利用涵盖多种零售商、门店业态及购物渠道的新型购物收据数据（包含单次行程的支付方式信息），我们考察了家庭是否通过跨支付来源的替代行为部分平滑福利周期内的食品杂货支出，以及福利发放效应是否随食品杂货支出分布而变化。研究发现，家庭通过适度增加非SNAP资助的购物行程，在集约边际上实现了支出平滑。分布分析表明，更高食品杂货支出分位点上的支出周期更为显著，同时存在非SNAP资助支付来源替代效应减弱的暗示性证据。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113105.title: The SNAP benefit cycle beyond the mean: Substitution across payment sources and distributional heterogeneity
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113105.title_zh: 均值之外的SNAP福利周期：支付来源的替代与分布异质性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113106.abstract: Partisan theory predicts that left-leaning governments tolerate higher inflation, and UK data appear to confirm it. Before 1997, inflation averaged three percentage points higher under Labour than the Conservatives. I show this gap is not robust. It is the product of a single Labour government (1974–79) that coincided with the OPEC oil shocks; a randomisation test at the level of governments returns p = 0.50 , and omitting any one of nine governments can swing the gap by up to four points. With so few in the sample, the data cannot sustain the partisan effect they appear to show.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113106.abstract_zh: 党派理论预测，左倾政府更能容忍较高的通货膨胀，英国的数据似乎证实了这一点。1997年前，工党执政期间的平均通胀率比保守党高出三个百分点。我证明这一差距并不稳健。它源于一个特定的工党政府（1974-79年），该时期恰逢OPEC石油冲击；在政府层面的随机化检验得出p=0.50，且剔除九个政府中的任何一个，差距可波动高达四个百分点。鉴于样本量如此之少，数据无法支撑其表面所显示的党派效应。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113106.title: The fragility of the partisan inflation gap: Evidence from the United Kingdom
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113106.title_zh: 党派通胀差距的脆弱性：来自英国的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113107.abstract: We study obviously strategy-proof implementation in the framework of social choice over acts introduced by Bahel and Sprumont (2020). We characterize the class of unanimous social choice functions that are implementable via obviously strategy-proof mechanisms. Our main result shows that a unanimous social choice function is obviously strategy-proof implementable if and only if it is dictatorial.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113107.abstract_zh: 我们研究在Bahel和Sprumont（2020）引入的关于行为的社会选择框架中的显然策略证明实施问题。我们刻画了通过显然策略证明机制可实施的一致社会选择函数的类别。我们的主要结果表明，一个一致社会选择函数是显然策略证明可实施的，当且仅当它是独裁的。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113107.title: Obviously strategy-proof choice of social acts
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113107.title_zh: 明显防策略的社会行为选择

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113108.abstract: This paper examines the within-conference relationship between nonverbal features of the Bank of Japan governor and post-answer realized volatility of Japanese Government Bond futures. Using 1,557 question-and-answer segments from 79 post-meeting press conferences during 2016-2026, I regress realized volatility of Japanese Government Bond futures on principal component indices of facial and audio features extracted from conference videos. Facial indicators exhibit a significant positive association with volatility, even after controlling for verbal policy stance, policy surprises, and governor fixed effects. The short-horizon correlation is preserved under a censored-RV robustness check that addresses overlap with subsequent answers, while longer windows attenuate.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113108.abstract_zh: 本文考察了日本央行行长在会议中的非语言特征与答问环节后日本政府债券期货已实现波动率之间的会议内关系。利用2016-2026年间79次会后新闻发布会的1，557个问答片段，我将日本政府债券期货的已实现波动率对从会议视频中提取的面部和音频特征主成分指数进行回归。面部指标与波动率呈现显著正相关，即使在控制言语政策立场、政策意外及行长固定效应后依然如此。在应对后续回答重叠问题的截尾已实现波动率稳健性检验下，短期限相关性得以保持，而较长时间窗口则趋于减弱。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113108.title: Nonverbal Signals and Market Uncertainty: Evidence from Bank of Japan Press Conferences
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113108.title_zh: 非语言信号与市场不确定性：来自日本央行新闻发布会的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113109.abstract: Rare earth elements are critical to national economic security. However, the distributional properties of rare earth returns remain largely underexplored. We fit 81 distributions to 17 rare earth oxide (REO) return series using three goodness-of-fit criteria. Heavy-tailed distributions—Generalised Hyperbolic, Normal Inverse Gaussian, Cauchy, noncentral t, Student’s t and Generalised Error distributions—dominate, consistent with evidence for commodity markets, although some REO series exhibit more extreme tail behaviour. Some series also exhibit asymmetry. These findings have implications for risk assessment, forecasting, volatility and connectedness modelling, and for any future pricing of REO derivatives, where standard frameworks may understate tail risk.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113109.abstract_zh: 稀土元素对国家经济安全至关重要。然而，稀土收益的分布特性在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。我们运用三种拟合优度标准，将81种分布拟合至17个稀土氧化物（REO）收益序列。重尾分布——广义双曲分布、正态逆高斯分布、柯西分布、非中心t分布、学生t分布及广义误差分布——占据主导地位，这与大宗商品市场的证据一致，尽管部分REO序列表现出更极端的尾部行为。部分序列还呈现不对称性。这些发现对风险评估、预测、波动率及关联性建模，以及对未来REO衍生品定价具有重要意义，在这些领域中，标准框架可能低估尾部风险。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113109.title: Never normal: Distributional properties of rare earth returns
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113109.title_zh: 永不正常：稀土收益的分布特征

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113110.abstract: This paper examines family firms’ response to monetary policy tightening. By using a panel of about 130,000 non-listed EMU firms over the period 2011–2021, we show that family firms are more resilient to monetary policy shocks. Compared to non-family firms, they react to interest rate hikes by reducing tangible investments to a lesser extent. Fully family-controlled firms suffer a lower reduction in revenue and reallocate their debt from short to long term liabilities. Our results provide evidence of the existence of a corporate-ownership transmission channel. The presence of family firms appears to be an additional source of heterogeneity in response to monetary policy.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113110.abstract_zh: 本文考察了家族企业对货币政策紧缩的响应。利用2011至2021年间约13万家欧元区非上市企业的面板数据，我们发现家族企业对货币政策冲击更具韧性。与非家族企业相比，家族企业对利率上调的反应表现为有形投资减少幅度较小。完全由家族控制的企业收入下降幅度较低，并将债务从短期负债重新配置至长期负债。我们的研究结果为存在企业所有权传导渠道提供了证据。家族企业的存在似乎是货币政策响应异质性的又一来源。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113110.title: Investment Dynamics and Monetary Policy Shocks: Evidence from EMU Family Firms
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113110.title_zh: 投资动态与货币政策冲击：来自欧洲货币联盟家族企业的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113111.abstract: Corporate climate mitigation targets are increasingly relevant, but ambition measurement remains inconsistent. Linear annual reduction (LAR) and compound annual reduction (CAR) are common measures of climate ambition, but they imply different reduction paths and may reverse ambition rankings when percentage reductions and target horizons differ. I derive the exact pairwise ranking-reversal condition, revealing that LAR favors shorter, shallower targets compared to CAR, and apply this framework to the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) Target Dashboard. The results confirm substantial ranking reversal depending on whether LAR or CAR is used to define ambition.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113111.abstract_zh: 企业气候减缓目标日益重要，但雄心衡量标准仍不一致。线性年度减排（LAR）和复合年度减排（CAR）是衡量气候雄心的常用指标，但它们隐含不同的减排路径，且在百分比减排量和目标期限不同时，可能导致雄心排名发生逆转。我推导出精确的成对排名逆转条件，揭示LAR相较于CAR更偏好较短、较浅的目标，并将此框架应用于科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）目标仪表板。结果证实，根据使用LAR还是CAR来定义雄心，排名逆转现象显著存在。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113111.title: Measuring climate ambition: Annualization and ranking discrepancy
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113111.title_zh: 衡量气候雄心：年度化与排名差异

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113112.abstract: Short-dated options may reveal stock-price information before stock quotes update. I test this using delta-bound violation events: consecutive option trade pairs whose empirical delta exceeds the upper Black–Scholes–Merton bound for calls or falls below the lower bound for puts. Among 77.44 million 2025 trade pairs, these events predict 0.23 basis points of same-direction stock movement over the next second. The result is positive in every month, survives matched controls and WRDS TAQ NBBO reconstruction, and aligns with inferred hedge pressure.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113112.abstract_zh: 短期期权可能在股票报价更新之前揭示股价信息。我通过德尔塔边界违反事件对此进行检验：连续期权交易对中，其实证德尔塔值超过看涨期权的布莱克-舒尔斯-默顿上界或低于看跌期权的下界。在2025年的7744万对交易中，这些事件预测了下一秒内同方向股票变动0.23个基点。该结果在每个月均为正，经匹配对照组和WRDS TAQ NBBO重建后依然稳健，并与推断的对冲压力相一致。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113112.title: Seconds of price discovery: Evidence from short-dated options
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113112.title_zh: 价格发现的秒级证据：来自短期期权的实证

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113113.abstract: Short-term reversal appears to have weakened in international equity markets because standard measures mix firm-specific and industry-wide returns. When evaluated relative to industry peers, the reversal persists. Using data from 64 countries, the conventional strategy delivers negligible returns, whereas an industry-adjusted strategy earns 0.53% per month with a Sharpe ratio of 0.74. The effect reflects the reversal of firm-specific shocks masked by persistent industry components. A regret-based signal captures the same industry-relative variation, adding no incremental return. Reversal did not disappear; it was mismeasured.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113113.abstract_zh: 短期反转效应在国际股票市场中似乎有所减弱，这是因为标准指标混淆了公司特定回报与行业整体回报。当以行业同行作为基准进行评估时，反转效应依然存在。基于64个国家的数据，传统策略带来的回报微乎其微，而经行业调整后的策略每月可获得0.53%的收益，夏普比率为0.74。这一效应反映了被持续性行业成分掩盖的公司特定冲击的反转。基于遗憾的信号捕捉到了相同的行业相对变化，但并未带来额外回报。反转效应并未消失，而是被错误衡量了。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113113.title: Short-Term Reversal Persists Globally—If Properly Measured
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113113.title_zh: 短期反转在全球范围内持续存在——若测量得当

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113114.abstract: Daily Google Trends data exhibit systematic day-of-week patterns that can contaminate spike detection in attention-based event studies. Applying a standard algorithm to raw data for 23 U.S. equities yields substantially more detected spikes than applying the same algorithm after weekday correction, with the excess concentrated on mid-week days. Validation against earnings announcements, SEC filings, and abnormal trading volume shows that weekday-corrected spikes align more closely with attention-relevant benchmarks than raw spikes. Researchers using daily Google Trends in threshold-based event studies should test for day-of-week seasonality and correct it when present.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113114.abstract_zh: 每日谷歌趋势数据呈现出系统性的星期效应模式，这可能污染基于注意力的事件研究中的尖峰检测。将标准算法应用于23只美国股票的原始数据，所检测到的尖峰数量显著多于在星期校正后应用同一算法所得的结果，且多余尖峰集中在一周中间的日子。通过与盈利公告、美国证券交易委员会文件以及异常交易量的验证表明，星期校正后的尖峰比原始尖峰更紧密地与注意力相关基准对齐。使用每日谷歌趋势进行基于阈值的事件研究的研究者，应检验星期季节性，并在存在时予以校正。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113114.title: Weekday bias in daily Google Trends spike detection
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113114.title_zh: 日度谷歌趋势峰值检测中的工作日偏差

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113115.abstract: We consider a single-step approach to estimating the parametric coefficients and bandwidth parameters in a partially linear model. We establish a direct connection between this estimator and the two-step estimator of Robinson (1988). Simulations show that the resulting estimator improves recovery of the nonparametric component and the fitted conditional mean in most designs, while delivering coefficient estimates that are typically comparable to Robinson’s two-step estimator.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113115.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一种单步方法，用于估计部分线性模型中的参数系数和带宽参数。我们建立了该估计器与Robinson（1988）两步估计器之间的直接联系。模拟结果表明，在大多数设计下，由此产生的估计器改善了非参数成分的恢复及拟合条件均值，同时提供的系数估计通常与Robinson的两步估计器相当。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113115.title: Single-step estimation of the partially linear model
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113115.title_zh: 部分线性模型的单步估计

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113116.abstract: I document that self-declared politically Independent households with partisan leanings change economic expectations in ways that resemble weak partisans. Republican leaners align more with weak Republicans, while Democratic leaners are similar to weak Democrats in their macroeconomic beliefs. This insight has important implications for survey design and for how researchers categorize political affiliation in economic analyses. Classifying leaners as neutral Independents can distort estimates of partisan differences.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113116.abstract_zh: 我记录到，自称政治独立但带有党派倾向的家庭，其经济预期的变化方式类似于弱党派支持者。共和党倾向者与弱共和党人的宏观经济信念更为一致，而民主党倾向者则与弱民主党人相似。这一发现对调查设计以及研究人员在经济分析中如何划分政治归属具有重要意义。将倾向者归类为中立的独立派可能会扭曲对党派差异的估计。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113116.title: Partisan Differences Among Independents: Evidence from Household Economic Expectations
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113116.title_zh: 独立选民中的党派差异：来自家庭经济预期的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113117.title: The Curse of Sabotage - Efficiency in an Attacker - Defender framework with Gun & Butter
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113117.title_zh: 破坏的诅咒——枪炮与黄油框架下攻击者-防御者模型的效率分析

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113118.abstract: This paper studies how demand curvature limits first-mover advantage and shapes surplus division in a Stackelberg duopoly facing α -concave demand for α ∈ [ − 1 , ∞ ) . Under constant symmetric marginal costs, I prove that across all possible equilibria, the leader-to-follower profit ratio is at least 1 + 5 + 4 α 2 . Thus, the leader is guaranteed to earn at least 61.8% more than the follower under log-concave demand ( α = 0 ) and at least twice as much under concave demand ( α = 1 ). Under demand with decreasing marginal revenue ( α = − 1 ), the leadership advantage persists. I further derive a lower bound for the leader’s profit alongside an upper bound for deadweight loss. Extremal demand curves D for which D α and ln D are affine attain all bounds for α > − 1 .
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113118.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在面临α-凹需求（α ∈ [ − 1 , ∞ )）的Stackelberg双头垄断中，需求曲率如何限制先发优势并塑造剩余分配。在恒定对称边际成本下，我证明在所有可能的均衡中，领导者与追随者的利润比率至少为1 + 5 + 4 α 2。因此，在对数凹需求（α = 0）下，领导者保证至少比追随者多赚61.8%；在凹需求（α = 1）下，则至少多赚两倍。在边际收益递减的需求（α = − 1）下，领导优势依然存在。我进一步推导了领导者利润的下界以及无谓损失的上界。对于α > − 1，满足D α和ln D为仿射函数的极值需求曲线D能达到所有界限。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113118.title: The limits of leadership advantage in Stackelberg duopoly
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113118.title_zh: 斯塔克尔伯格双寡头中领导优势的局限性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113119.abstract: Setzler (2025) provides an important benchmark for merger analysis when firms exercise linked product-market and labor-market power under oligopoly and oligopsony. This note derives upward pricing pressure (UPP) screens for horizontal mergers under a different labor-market institution: unionization. In an efficient-bargaining model with Stone-Geary union utility, a price change that diverts sales to the merger partner may also affect that partner’s employment, wages, or workers’ outside options. Whereas product-labor links amplify merger harm in Setzler’s oligopsony benchmark, union-mediated effects can make product-side screens too lenient or too aggressive, thereby reversing whether a one-sided screen flags the merger.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113119.abstract_zh: Setzler（2025）为企业在寡头垄断与寡头买方垄断下行使关联的产品市场与劳动力市场势力时的并购分析提供了重要基准。本文在另一种劳动力市场制度——工会化——下推导横向并购的向上定价压力（UPP）筛查指标。在具有Stone-Geary工会效用的有效谈判模型中，将销售转移至并购合作伙伴的价格变化也可能影响该合作伙伴的就业、工资或工人的外部选择。尽管在Setzler的寡头买方垄断基准中，产品与劳动力之间的关联放大了并购损害，但工会中介效应可能使产品侧筛查指标过于宽松或过于激进，从而逆转单边筛查是否标记该并购的结论。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113119.title: Upward pricing pressure in linked product and labor markets: Union bargaining and merger screens
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113119.title_zh: 关联产品与劳动力市场中的向上定价压力：工会谈判与并购审查

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113120.abstract: Teamwork can either cure or create procrastination. When present-biased teammates break a shared plan, the guilt of shirking depends on whether the partner acts too: shared inaction diffuses responsibility, while unilateral inaction betrays an acting partner. A team can therefore act when each member alone would delay, and stall when each alone would act. The harmful case is a coordination trap, arising only when both members are conditional starters who wait for each other. A single self-starter — one who acts whatever the partner does — breaks it, inducing exactly the outcome a committed visible leader would. A self-starter is an endogenous leader: heterogeneity in follow-through substitutes for leadership.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113120.abstract_zh: 团队合作既能治愈拖延，也可能催生拖延。当具有现时偏见的队友违背共同计划时，内疚感取决于伙伴是否同样行动：共同不作为分散了责任，而单方面不作为则辜负了正在行动的伙伴。因此，团队可能在每个成员单独行动都会推迟的情况下采取行动，也可能在每个成员单独行动都会行动的情况下停滞不前。有害的情形是一种协调陷阱，仅当双方都是等待对方的条件启动者时才会出现。一个自我启动者——无论伙伴如何行动都采取行动的人——能够打破这一陷阱，恰好产生一个坚定的可见领导者所能带来的结果。自我启动者即内生领导者：执行力的异质性替代了领导力。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113120.title: Procrastination traps and endogenous leadership in teams
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113120.title_zh: 团队中的拖延陷阱与内生性领导力

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113121.abstract: Researchers often include unit-specific (e.g., state-specific) trends in difference-in-differences (DiD) specifications. Under standard DiD assumptions, these specifications still yield consistent estimates of dynamic treatment effects (i.e., separate effects for each post-treatment time period) but the pooled post-treatment coefficient is not consistent for the average treatment effect. This single coefficient is a weighted average of the dynamic coefficients, but some weights are often negative. This occurs even without a staggered rollout of treatment. Instead of estimating a pooled coefficient, researchers can estimate the average treatment effect as the mean of the dynamic effects. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113121.abstract_zh: 研究者常在双重差分（DiD）设定中纳入单位特定（如州特定）趋势。在标准DiD假设下，这些设定仍能得出动态处理效应（即每个处理后期对应的独立效应）的一致估计，但合并处理后期系数并非平均处理效应的一致估计量。该单一系数是动态系数的加权平均值，但部分权重常为负值——即便在非交错式处理推行情况下亦如此。研究者可通过计算动态效应均值来估计平均处理效应，而非采用合并系数。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113121.title: Difference-in-differences with unit-specific trends: Bias in post-treatment estimates and a simple alternative
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113121.title_zh: 单位特定趋势下的双重差分法：处理后估计的偏差及一个简单替代方案

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113122.abstract: Peer-confirming equilibrium (Lipnowski and Sadler, 2019) weakens Nash equilibrium: given a network, each player correctly anticipates only her neighbors’ actions. We relate the two in anchor games, in which one player—the anchor—is indifferent among her actions, while every other player’s unique best response varies one-to-one with the anchor’s action. We show that peer-confirming equilibrium coincides with Nash equilibrium if and only if the network is connected. Even when a neighbor’s action is payoff-irrelevant, so long as it reveals the action of a payoff-relevant player, that information is transmitted exactly across any distance.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113122.abstract_zh: 同伴确认均衡（Lipnowski和Sadler，2019）弱化了纳什均衡：给定一个网络，每位玩家仅正确预期其邻居的行动。我们在锚定博弈中探讨两者的关系，其中一位玩家——锚定者——对其行动无差异，而其他每位玩家的唯一最优反应随锚定者的行动一一变化。我们证明，同伴确认均衡与纳什均衡一致，当且仅当网络是连通的。即使邻居的行动与收益无关，只要它揭示了收益相关玩家的行动，该信息便能精确地跨越任意距离传递。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113123.abstract: Rainfall fluctuations significantly reduce welfare for poor rural households in low- and middle-income countries dependent on rainfed agriculture for consumption, and the effects of these shocks can be borne disproportionately by vulnerable household members, particularly children and girls. We present new evidence around the effects of rainfall fluctuations on child anthropometric status in Papua New Guinea, an understudied context characterized by some of the highest stunting rates in the world. We show that negative fluctuations in rainfall within the first 12 months of life lead to a reduction in height-for-age and weight-for-age (though not stunting), but this effect is observed only for girls.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113123.abstract_zh: 降雨波动显著降低了依赖雨养农业维持生计的低收入与中等收入国家贫困农村家庭的福利水平，且此类冲击的影响可能不成比例地由弱势家庭成员（尤其是儿童和女童）承担。我们提供了关于巴布亚新几内亚降雨波动对儿童人体测量学指标影响的新证据——该地区是全球发育迟缓率最高的地区之一，但相关研究尚不充分。研究表明，出生后12个月内降雨量的负向波动会导致年龄别身高和年龄别体重下降（但未达到发育迟缓标准），然而这一效应仅出现在女童群体中。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113123.title: The gendered effects of rainfall shocks on stunting: Evidence from Papua New Guinea
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113123.title_zh: 降雨冲击对发育迟缓的性别差异效应：来自巴布亚新几内亚的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113124.abstract: This note studies a pure fertility-timing reform in a three-period OLG model. Holding completed fertility fixed, shifting births from middle age to youth raises the balanced-growth factor if N > 1 , lowers it if N < 1 , and leaves it unchanged if N = 1 . The same positive balanced-growth root λ determines cohort growth, the cohort ratio, and the steady-state PAYG support ratio λ 2 + λ . Thus the long-run support-ratio effect, and under an exogenous wage the pension-benefit effect, are positive in growing populations and negative in shrinking ones.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113124.abstract_zh: 本文在三期OLG模型中研究了一项纯粹的生育时机改革。在保持终身生育率不变的前提下，将生育行为从中年阶段提前至青年阶段，若N>1则会提高平衡增长因子，若N<1则会降低该因子，若N=1则保持不变。相同的正平衡增长根λ决定了队列增长、队列比率以及稳态现收现付制抚养比λ²+λ。因此，长期抚养比效应以及在外生工资条件下的养老金待遇效应，在人口增长型社会中为正，在人口收缩型社会中为负。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113124.title: Birth timing, stable population growth, and pay-as-you-go pensions
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113124.title_zh: 生育时机、稳定人口增长与现收现付养老金

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113125.abstract: Does proximity to the natal family protect women against intimate partner violence (IPV)? Leveraging Uzbekistan as a natural laboratory and an original list experiment among 835 married women, we find that women near their parents show a list-experiment prevalence estimate of 9.4% and no detectable reporting gap, whereas those far from their parents report only 8.5% in direct surveys, against a list-experiment estimate of 36.2%. Standard surveys do not merely undercount these victims — they invert the ranking of risk, making the most vulnerable women appear the safest. A parallel attitude experiment supports neither preference falsification nor cultural selection.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113125.abstract_zh: 靠近原生家庭能否保护女性免受亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）侵害？以乌兹别克斯坦为自然实验场，通过对835名已婚女性开展原始列表实验，我们发现：与父母同住的女性在列表实验中遭受暴力的估计比例为9.4%，且未发现可检测的报告偏差；而远离父母的女性在直接调查中仅报告8.5%的暴力发生率，但列表实验估计值却高达36.2%。传统调查不仅低估了这些受害者的数量——更彻底颠倒了风险排序，使最脆弱的女性反而显得最安全。平行态度实验的结果既不支持偏好伪装假说，也不支持文化选择假说。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113125.title: Under the wing: The effect of parental proximity on intimate partner violence and underreporting
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113125.title_zh: 庇护之下：父母邻近性对亲密伴侣暴力及其低报率的影响

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113126.abstract: Shortages of healthcare professionals, particularly in mental health, remain an ongoing policy dilemma. Licensing requirements may be one potential factor contributing to this shortage. In 2022, Illinois eliminated the exam requirement for master’s level social workers (MSWs). Using data on the number of MSWs from several states, we estimate the effect of this policy change on the number of MSWs in Illinois using the synthetic control method. We find evidence that the elimination of the exam requirement increased the number of active MSW licenses in Illinois by approximately 2,600 licensees– a 50% increase. We also provide evidence that our estimates are both economically and statistically significant.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113126.abstract_zh: 医疗专业人员的短缺，尤其是在心理健康领域，仍然是一个持续的政策难题。执照要求可能是导致这一短缺的潜在因素之一。2022年，伊利诺伊州取消了硕士级社会工作者（MSWs）的考试要求。利用多个州MSW数量的数据，我们采用合成控制法估计了这一政策变化对伊利诺伊州MSW数量的影响。我们发现证据表明，取消考试要求使伊利诺伊州活跃的MSW执照数量增加了约2600名持照人——增幅达50%。我们还提供了证据，证明我们的估计在经济上和统计上均具有显著性。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113126.title: The effect of master’s level social worker licensing reform in Illinois
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113126.title_zh: 伊利诺伊州硕士级社会工作者执照改革的影响

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113127.abstract: We examine the impact of short-term temperature changes on voting behavior in the Brazilian presidential elections from 2010 to 2018, focusing on the candidacy of Marina Silva, a prominent pro-environment politician. Using data on municipality level voting and daily wet bulb temperature, we find that an increase in temperature on election day increases votes for Marina Silva. We argue that this effect is driven by the salience of climate change issues, which influences last-minute voting decisions. Our analysis also shows that temperature variations in the days preceding the election have a limited impact on voting outcomes, highlighting the transient nature of climate salience effects.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113127.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2010年至2018年巴西总统选举期间短期气温变化对投票行为的影响，重点关注著名环保政治家玛丽娜·席尔瓦的竞选活动。利用市级投票数据与每日湿球温度数据，我们发现选举日气温升高会增加玛丽娜·席尔瓦的得票数。我们认为这一效应源于气候变化议题的显著性，这种显著性影响了选民在最后一刻的投票决策。分析还表明，选举前几天的气温变化对投票结果影响有限，凸显了气候显著性效应的短暂性特征。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113127.title: Voting in the heat of the moment: Climate change salience and electoral behavior
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113127.title_zh: 气候变化紧迫性下的投票：气候突显性与选举行为

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113128.abstract: This paper reports the results of an experimental study investigating the role of uncertainty for pro-social behavior. We compare settings in which the decision-maker is solely responsible for the outcome to settings in which his choice is only implemented with some probability while with the complementary probability a “default” is implemented. We find that a sufficiently high probability of the default is necessary to alter decisions. Sufficiently-high-probability defaults lead to less giving by pro-social decision-makers, not only when the default is generous to the receiver but also when it is selfish. This violates monotonicity and is thus not consistent with expected utility theory nor with notions of ex ante fairness.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113128.abstract_zh: 本文报告了一项实验研究的结果，旨在探讨不确定性对亲社会行为的作用。我们比较了决策者独自对结果负责的情境，与决策者的选择仅以一定概率被实施，而互补概率下则执行“默认”选项的情境。研究发现，只有当默认选项的概率足够高时，才能改变决策行为。高概率的默认选项会导致亲社会决策者的给予减少，不仅当默认选项对接收者慷慨时如此，当默认选项为自私时也同样如此。这一现象违反了单调性，因此既不符合预期效用理论，也不符合事前公平的概念。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113128.title: How default risk shapes social choice
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113128.title_zh: 违约风险如何塑造社会选择

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113129.abstract: We study compatibility design in repeated procurement. A winning supplier can make a cost-reducing investment that carries over, while compatibility determines how much of the cost reduction is usable by the alternative supplier. Greater compatibility strengthens the alternative supplier but lowers the future value of winning and can weaken investment incentives. We show that when investment is sustainable, optimal compatibility is the lower of the unconstrained buyer-surplus optimum and the investment-sustaining ceiling. Except when zero compatibility is always optimal, buyer-optimal compatibility first rises and then falls with supplier patience.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113129.abstract_zh: 我们研究重复采购中的兼容性设计。获胜供应商可以进行具有延续性的成本削减投资，而兼容性决定了替代供应商能够利用多少成本削减成果。更高的兼容性会增强替代供应商的实力，但会降低未来获胜的价值，并可能削弱投资激励。研究表明，当投资具有可持续性时，最优兼容性取无约束买方剩余最优值与投资可持续上限两者中的较低值。除非零兼容性始终为最优方案，否则买方最优兼容性会随供应商耐心程度先升后降。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113129.title: Compatibility and investment incentives in dynamic procurement
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113129.title_zh: 动态采购中的兼容性与投资激励

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113130.abstract: This study examines how politically driven trade-threat signals affect global equity markets. Using a Large Language Model (LLM), we construct a measure of trade-threat intensity from U.S. president Donald J. Trump’s posts on Truth Social and identify extreme threat events based on the upper tail of the score distribution. We find that these events are associated with significantly negative abnormal returns in global equity markets, concentrated within a short window around the event date. The effect exhibits substantial regional heterogeneity, with weaker responses in the Americas and stronger reactions in European, Asian, and Pacific markets. Our findings suggest that LLM-based measures of political communication capture economically meaningful signals associated with short-horizon movements in asset prices, highlighting the role of real-time political rhetoric in shaping global financial market dynamics.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113130.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了政治驱动的贸易威胁信号如何影响全球股票市场。通过运用大语言模型（LLM），我们基于美国前总统唐纳德·J·特朗普在Truth Social平台上的帖子构建了贸易威胁强度指标，并根据得分分布的上尾部分识别出极端威胁事件。研究发现，这些事件与全球股票市场显著为负的异常收益率相关，且该效应集中在事件日期前后的短窗口期内。该影响表现出显著的区域异质性：美洲市场反应较弱，而欧洲、亚洲及太平洋市场反应更为强烈。我们的研究结果表明，基于大语言模型的政治沟通指标能够捕捉与资产价格短期波动相关的经济意义信号，凸显了实时政治言论在塑造全球金融市场动态中的作用。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113130.title: Large Language Model, trade threats and stock markets
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113130.title_zh: 大语言模型、贸易威胁与股票市场

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113131.abstract: Empirical evidence shows that environmental, social, and governance (ESG) quality interacts with financial performance at the individual asset level: high-ESG firms outperform during crises and corporate social responsibility lowers systematic beta. Models with separable ESG preferences generate a greenium but no such interaction. We develop a capital asset pricing model (CAPM) with supermodular preferences over each asset’s return and ESG score. The equilibrium features an asset-specific denominator that compresses expected returns for high-ESG assets and generates a negative beta-ESG interaction, implying lower effective market sensitivity for green firms. We show that portfolio-level complementarity cannot produce this interaction, which yields a sharp test distinguishing our mechanism in the data. The model offers one rationalization of the beta-ESG interaction. We illustrate its quantitative content with four empirical studies.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113131.abstract_zh: 实证证据表明，环境、社会和治理（ESG）质量在个体资产层面与财务绩效相互作用：高ESG企业在危机期间表现更优，且企业社会责任降低了系统性贝塔值。具有可分离ESG偏好的模型虽能产生绿色溢价，却无法解释这种相互作用。我们构建了一个资本资产定价模型（CAPM），其中包含对每项资产回报率与ESG评分的超模偏好。均衡状态下，模型呈现资产特定的分母，压缩了高ESG资产的预期回报，并产生负向的贝塔-ESG交互效应，意味着绿色企业的有效市场敏感度较低。我们证明，投资组合层面的互补性无法产生这种交互作用，这为在数据中区分我们的机制提供了一个明确的检验标准。该模型为贝塔-ESG交互效应提供了一种合理化解释。我们通过四项实证研究展示了其定量内容。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113131.title: Doing good and doing well: A CAPM with complementary ESG and financial returns
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113131.title_zh: 行善与盈利：兼具ESG与财务回报互补性的CAPM模型

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113132.abstract: We examine whether investor fear and anti-herding in BRICS currency markets spill over into the US dollar. Using Wavelet Coherence Analysis, we find that BRICS currencies exhibit systemic anti-herding behaviour that intensifies under financial stress. These behaviours transmit to the dollar, amplifying its volatility across short-, medium-, and long-term horizons. Our results challenge the conventional view of one-way risk transmission from advanced to emerging markets, showing instead that behavioural contagion from BRICS destabilises the reserve currency. This suggests that emerging-market investor behaviour may play a role in shaping global financial stability.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113132.abstract_zh: 我们考察了金砖国家货币市场中的投资者恐慌与反羊群行为是否外溢至美元。运用小波相干分析，我们发现金砖国家货币展现出系统性的反羊群行为，该行为在金融压力下加剧。这些行为传导至美元，在短期、中期及长期时间跨度上加剧了其波动性。我们的研究结果挑战了风险从发达市场单向传导至新兴市场的传统观点，反而表明来自金砖国家的行为传染会动摇储备货币的稳定性。这暗示新兴市场投资者的行为可能在塑造全球金融稳定中发挥作用。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113132.title: Investor Fear, Behavioural Contagion, and the Global Dollar Cycle: Evidence From BRICS Currency Markets
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113132.title_zh: 投资者恐惧、行为传染与全球美元周期：来自金砖国家货币市场的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113133.abstract: Consider a non-durable goods monopolist who maximizes the present discounted value of profits. In steady state, which elasticity (short run or long run) should the monopolist use in the classic inverse-elasticity rule? Under some assumptions, the appropriate elasticity is a convex combination of the short-run and long-run elasticities of demand, where the weights depend upon the monopolist’s discount factor and the dynamics inherent in demand.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113133.abstract_zh: 考虑一个追求利润现值最大化的非耐用品垄断者。在稳态下，垄断者在经典的反弹性法则中应使用哪种弹性（短期还是长期）？在某些假设下，适当的弹性是需求短期与长期弹性的凸组合，其中权重取决于垄断者的贴现因子及需求固有的动态特性。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113133.title: Which demand elasticity should a monopoly use?
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113133.title_zh: 垄断应使用哪种需求弹性？

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113140.abstract: Spatial autoregressive stochastic frontier models allow inefficiency to propagate across connected units. However, invertibility of the system matrix alone does not guarantee that exact spillover-corrected efficiency is admissible. If the inverse of the system matrix has negative entries, some non-negative inefficiency realizations imply negative total inefficiency and efficiency scores above one. Under non-negative spatial autoregressive parameters, we characterize the admissible parameter space for general non-negative spatial weighting matrices and extend the analysis to models with multiple weighting matrices. We also provide a practical sufficient condition and, for row-normalized multi-weight models, a simple necessary and sufficient restriction.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113140.abstract_zh: 空间自回归随机前沿模型允许无效率在相连单元间传播。然而，系统矩阵的可逆性本身并不保证经溢出校正的精确效率具有可采纳性。若系统矩阵的逆矩阵含有负元素，则某些非负的无效率实现会导致总无效率为负，效率得分超过1。在非负空间自回归参数下，我们刻画了一般非负空间权重矩阵的可采纳参数空间，并将分析扩展到具有多个权重矩阵的模型。我们还提供了一个实用的充分条件，并针对行归一化的多权重模型，给出了一个简洁的必要且充分约束。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113140.title: Estimating exact efficiency in multi-weight spatial autoregressive stochastic frontier models
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113140.title_zh: 多权重空间自回归随机前沿模型中精确效率的估计

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113141.abstract: We propose a robust bandwidth rule for the classical CUSUM and QS tests for shifts in the mean of a time series: the AR(1) coefficient entering Andrews’ (1991) data-driven HAC bandwidth is truncated at a fixed threshold $\rho {0} < 1$, with $\rho {0}$ selected by a simulation-based procedure that controls empirical size against a user-specified persistence robustness target. The truncated bandwidth is shown to be free from the asymptotic power reversal problem under the diverging-alternatives framework of Juhl and Xiao (2009). Monte Carlo evidence indicates that the CUSUM and QS tests implemented with this bandwidth deliver good size control and monotonic power across a range of break designs and persistence levels.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113141.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种针对时间序列均值突变检测中经典CUSUM和QS检验的稳健带宽规则：将Andrews（1991）数据驱动的HAC带宽中涉及的AR(1)系数截断在固定阈值$\rho {0} < 1$处，其中$\rho {0}$通过基于模拟的程序选择，该程序控制经验大小以针对用户指定的持久性稳健性目标。所提出的截断带宽被证明在Juhl和Xiao（2009）的发散备择框架下避免了渐近功效反转问题。蒙特卡洛证据表明，采用此带宽实施的CUSUM和QS检验在多种断点设计和持久性水平下均能提供良好的大小控制和单调功效。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113141.title: Improved Andrews’ formula for testing changing mean
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113141.title_zh: 改进的Andrews变均值检验公式

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113144.abstract: A representative chooses policy on behalf of a group with heterogeneous preferences. Group members differ in voice (their salience to the representative). The representative maximizes perceived welfare based on a voice-weighted signal. The resulting policy distortion is proportional to the covariance between voice and preferences. When agents choose voice effort endogenously, equilibrium voice is U-shaped (quadratic in distance between preferences and policy). The equilibrium distortion is approximately one-third of a standard deviation times the skewness coefficient. It is non-zero only when the preference distribution is skewed. Combining the voice-weighted signal with a random sample can reduce the expected welfare loss. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113144.abstract_zh: 一位代表代表一个偏好异质性的群体制定政策。群体成员在话语权（即其对代表的重要性）上存在差异。代表基于话语权加权的信号最大化感知福利。由此产生的政策扭曲与话语权和偏好之间的协方差成正比。当代理人内生地选择话语努力时，均衡话语呈U形（即偏好与政策距离的二次函数）。均衡扭曲约为标准差的三分之一乘以偏度系数。只有当偏好分布呈偏态时，该扭曲才非零。将话语权加权信号与随机样本相结合，可以减少预期福利损失。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113144.title: Voice and distortion: When representatives misread the room
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113144.title_zh: 声音与扭曲：当代表们误判局势时

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113145.abstract: Recent literature proposed variants of estimators of conditional error variances that are robust to the presence of many regressors. One of the proposals produces unbiased estimates, which, however, are sensitive to regression parameter values. We propose its modification based on cross-fitting and averaging over random sample splits, which preserves the unbiasedness but eliminates that sensitivity. Then, we extend the cross-fitting machinery to unbiased estimation of pairwise variance products and to testing for many restrictions. We verify properties of associated estimators and tests in a simulation setup with many covariates.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113145.abstract_zh: 近期文献提出了多种条件误差方差的估计量变体，这些估计量对大量回归变量的存在具有稳健性。其中一种方法可产生无偏估计，但其结果对回归参数值较为敏感。我们提出基于交叉拟合与随机样本分割平均的改进方案，该方法在保持无偏性的同时消除了参数敏感性。进一步地，我们将交叉拟合机制扩展至成对方差乘积的无偏估计及多重约束检验。通过包含大量协变量的模拟实验，我们验证了相关估计量与检验方法的性质。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113145.title: Parameter-invariant unbiased estimation of individual variances and their pairwise products
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113145.title_zh: 个体方差及其两两乘积的参数不变无偏估计

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113146.abstract: We show that a one-sided price-adjustment rule, with free price cuts but a fixed daily reset for price increases, raises the reset price even under risk neutrality, mean-zero wholesale cost shocks, and perfect consumer information. The mechanism is option-theoretic: a higher reset price preserves pass-through in adverse cost states, while favorable shocks can still be accommodated by price cuts. In differentiated Bertrand competition, the reset premium scales with cost pass-through and hence with substitutability. The mechanism is distinct from consumer search and strategic price dispersion because it operates even under perfect consumer price information.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113146.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在风险中性、零均值批发成本冲击及消费者完全信息的条件下，单边价格调整规则——即允许自由降价但设定每日固定重置以应对涨价——仍会提高重置价格。其机制具有期权理论特征：较高的重置价格在不利成本状态下保持传导效应，而有利冲击则可通过降价来适应。在差异化伯特兰竞争中，重置溢价随成本传导程度及替代性增强而扩大。该机制不同于消费者搜索和策略性价格离散，因为它即使在消费者完全知晓价格信息的情况下也发挥作用。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113146.title: The reset premium: Option value under asymmetric price commitment
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113146.title_zh: 重置溢价：非对称价格承诺下的期权价值

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113147.abstract: This paper identifies three monthly horizon-specific drivers of gold prices using Iterated Dynamic Model Averaging (IDMA), a new machine-learning method that optimizes DMA by cyclically selecting predictors and updating forgetting factors. IDMA and standard DMA outperform other benchmarks, validating the variable selection mechanism. Predictor selection reveals three main drivers: stock market spillovers over short term, interest rate factors over the medium to long term, and safe-haven effects against geopolitical risk over long term. With the financialization of commodities, spillover effects from equity markets have become more prominent in gold price dynamics, challenging gold’s traditional safe-haven role in financial markets.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113147.abstract_zh: 本文运用迭代动态模型平均法（IDMA）识别了黄金价格的三个月度特定驱动因素，这是一种通过循环选择预测因子并更新遗忘因子来优化DMA的新型机器学习方法。IDMA与标准DMA均优于其他基准模型，验证了变量选择机制的有效性。预测因子选择揭示了三大主要驱动因素：短期内股市溢出效应、中长期利率因素，以及长期内针对地缘政治风险的避险效应。随着商品金融化进程，股票市场的溢出效应在黄金价格动态中愈发显著，对黄金在金融市场中的传统避险角色构成挑战。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113148.abstract: This study examines the effect of managerial responses assisted by generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) on stock price crash risk. Using question–response data from investor-relations platforms operated by Chinese stock exchanges, we employ large language models (LLMs) to measure the degree of GenAI assistance in managerial responses. We find that stronger GenAI-assisted textual features predict higher future stock price crash risk. We further show that greater response–question mismatch and more negative investor sentiment serve as two potential mechanisms, and that the effect is more pronounced among firms with more frequent investor interactions.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113148.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了生成式人工智能（GenAI）辅助的管理层回复对股价崩盘风险的影响。基于中国证券交易所投资者关系平台的问答数据，我们运用大语言模型（LLMs）测度管理层回复中GenAI辅助程度。研究发现，GenAI辅助文本特征越显著，未来股价崩盘风险越高。进一步分析表明，回复与问题匹配度降低及投资者负面情绪加剧是两条潜在作用机制，且该效应在投资者互动更频繁的企业中更为显著。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113148.title: Generative AI-assisted investor communication and stock price crash risk
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113148.title_zh: 生成式AI辅助投资者沟通与股价崩盘风险

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113149.abstract: Extreme weather events generate systematic forecast errors in credit risk models. Using proprietary loan-level data covering approximately 250,000 corporate loans over 2012–2023, we find that exposure to extreme weather significantly predicts realized default rates after conditioning on model-implied probabilities. Effects are stronger for early-year exposures and reflect persistent regional vulnerability rather than transitory fluctuations. These results suggest that omitted climate risk factors contribute to systematic model miscalibration, robust across specifications. More broadly, when relevant weather events are excluded, forecast errors may become systematic rather than idiosyncratic, with implications for model design and the efficient allocation of credit.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113149.abstract_zh: 极端天气事件会导致信用风险模型产生系统性预测误差。基于2012至2023年间约25万笔企业贷款的专有贷款级数据，本研究发现，在控制模型隐含概率后，极端天气暴露度能显著预测实际违约率。该效应在年初暴露中更为显著，且反映的是持续的区域脆弱性而非暂时性波动。这些结果表明，遗漏的气候风险因素会导致模型系统性校准偏差，且该结论在多种设定下保持稳健。更广泛而言，当相关天气事件被排除时，预测误差可能从特质性转为系统性，这对模型设计及信贷资源的有效配置具有重要启示。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113150.abstract: We show that Weitzman (2009)’s dismal theorem resurfaces naturally within a dynamic asset pricing framework with temperature-related disaster risk. If the climate disaster loss distribution is sufficiently fat-tailed, the risk-adjusted expected loss term diverges. Under unit elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS), this causes the social cost of carbon (SCC) to explode and the underlying optimization problem to have no finite solution so that the dynamic general equilibrium analogue of the dismal theorem applies. We show that, if the risk of climate tipping increases with temperature, the fat tail becomes endogenous and the dismal result is more likely to be activated at higher temperatures.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113150.abstract_zh: 我们证明，Weitzman（2009）的“ dismal theorem”在包含温度相关灾难风险的动态资产定价框架中会自然重现。若气候灾难损失分布具有足够厚的尾部，风险调整后的预期损失项将发散。在跨期替代弹性（EIS）为单位值时，这会导致碳的社会成本（SCC）激增，且底层优化问题无有限解，从而使得动态一般均衡版本的“ dismal theorem”成立。我们进一步表明，若气候临界点风险随温度升高而增加，厚尾特征将变为内生性，且该“ dismal”结果更可能在高温条件下被激活。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113150.title: The dismal theorem in a general equilibrium climate-economy model
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113150.title_zh: 一般均衡气候-经济模型中的悲观定理

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113151.abstract: Systemic importance has two dimensions, a bank’s contribution to system-wide tail risk ($\Delta$CoVaR) and its exposure to it (marginal expected shortfall, MES). Using daily $\Delta$CoVaR and MES for 24 publicly traded Global Systemically Important Banks over 2012–2025, we show the two rankings move on different clocks. Contribution rankings reorder at the same rate in calm times, the pandemic, and after. Exposure rankings survive the pandemic but re-anchor sharply at the 2022–2023 interest-rate regime change, as euro-area banks fall and US and Japanese banks rise. Shocks rotate which banks contribute to systemic risk; only regime changes move which are exposed.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113151.abstract_zh: 系统重要性具有两个维度：银行对系统性尾部风险的贡献度（$\Delta$CoVaR）及其风险暴露程度（边际预期损失，MES）。基于2012-2025年间24家上市全球系统重要性银行的日度$\Delta$CoVaR与MES数据，我们发现两种排名遵循不同的时间节奏。贡献度排名在平稳时期、疫情期间及疫情后均以相同速率重新排序；而风险暴露排名虽经受住疫情冲击，却在2022-2023年利率制度转换时发生剧烈锚定调整——欧元区银行排名下降，美日银行排名上升。冲击会改变哪些银行构成系统性风险贡献者，唯有制度变迁才能改变哪些银行面临风险暴露。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113151.title: The two clocks of systemic importance
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113151.title_zh: 系统重要性的两个时钟

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113152.abstract: On Korean cryptocurrency exchanges, dollar-pegged stablecoins trade above their dollar value at the market exchange rate. In the primary USDT/KRW sample used in this paper, the average premium is 1.96%. Because stablecoins are designed to maintain a one-dollar value, their won premium offers a direct market measure of dollar-access pressure under segmented crypto-FX markets. Using 919 daily observations from 7 December 2023 to 12 June 2026, we show that the premium co-moves closely with the Bitcoin kimchi premium and predicts won depreciation over the next one to three days. The relation survives controls for realized USD/KRW volatility, VIX, dollar strength, and domestic equity-market conditions. Coefficients are larger in high-VIX and high-FX-volatility regimes, but the short sample calls for caution. Stablecoin premia may provide a timely gauge of exchange-rate pressure in segmented markets.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113152.abstract_zh: 在韩国加密货币交易所，与美元挂钩的稳定币以高于市场汇率下美元价值的价格进行交易。本文使用的主要USDT/KRW样本中，平均溢价为1.96%。由于稳定币旨在维持一美元的价值，其韩元溢价为在加密与外汇市场分割条件下美元获取压力提供了直接的市场衡量指标。利用2023年12月7日至2026年6月12日期间的919个日度观测值，我们表明该溢价与比特币泡菜溢价紧密联动，并能预测未来一至三天内韩元的贬值趋势。这一关系在控制已实现的USD/KRW波动率、VIX指数、美元强度及国内股市状况后依然成立。在高VIX和高外汇波动率环境下，系数更大，但样本期较短需谨慎解读。稳定币溢价可能为分割市场中的汇率压力提供及时的风向标。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113152.title: The Capital-Access Premium and the Won: Korean Stablecoin Premia as a Leading Indicator of Exchange-Rate Pressure
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113152.title_zh: 资本获取溢价与韩元：韩国稳定币溢价作为汇率压力的先行指标

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113153.abstract: This letter examines the impact of the 2026 Iran conflict and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz on Middle Eastern Stock Markets. The findings reveal heterogeneous effects across the region, with the largest market responses concentrated in Qatar, the UAE, and Egypt. Sectoral analysis further reveals varied gradual adjustment dynamics across industries, with the real estate, healthcare, consumer discretionary, consumer staples and financial sectors exhibiting the largest declines. These results highlight the rapid transmission of geopolitical risk across regional financial markets and underscore the vulnerability of Gulf economies to disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113153.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2026年伊朗冲突及霍尔木兹海峡关闭对中东股市的影响。研究发现，该地区市场反应存在异质性，其中卡塔尔、阿联酋和埃及的市场响应最为显著。行业层面的分析进一步揭示了各行业间不同的渐进调整动态，房地产、医疗保健、非必需消费品、必需消费品及金融板块跌幅最大。这些结果凸显了地缘政治风险在区域金融市场中的快速传导，并强调了海湾经济体对霍尔木兹海峡中断的脆弱性。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113153.title: Geopolitics and the Strait of Hormuz: Evidence from Middle East Stock Markets
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113153.title_zh: 地缘政治与霍尔木兹海峡：来自中东股票市场的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113154.abstract: The “tragedy of the horizon” captures the gap between long-horizon climate damages and the shorter horizons of corporate decision-making. We provide a contracting account of this idea using a deliberately standard CARA-normal moral-hazard model. Under full commitment, the optimal linear contract can condition on long-horizon outcomes; horizon mismatch alone does not generate underinvestment. The tragedy arises when shareholders cannot credibly commit today to compensate a CEO based on outcomes verified after the contracting horizon. Restricting compensation to an interim signal yields a strict effort wedge relative to the full-commitment benchmark. The key comparative static is that the wedge is largest when the long-horizon outcome would have been most informative if contractible; that is, a more informative noncontractible long-horizon outcome does not close the gap. We also quantify the shareholder value of extending the contracting horizon. The implication is that climate-linked CEO pay can address the tragedy of the horizon only when the relevant metrics are both informative and contractible.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113154.abstract_zh: 地平线悲剧”捕捉了长期气候损害与企业决策较短视野之间的差距。我们通过一个标准的CARA正态道德风险模型，对这一理念进行了契约层面的阐释。在完全承诺条件下，最优线性契约能够依据长期结果进行条件设定；仅凭视野错配并不足以导致投资不足。当股东今日无法可信地承诺依据契约期后验证的结果来补偿CEO时，悲剧便应运而生。将补偿限制于中期信号，相对于完全承诺基准，会产生严格的努力程度偏差。关键的比较静态分析显示，当长期结果若可契约化时最具信息量时，这一偏差达到最大；换言之，更具信息量的不可契约化长期结果并不能缩小这一差距。我们还量化了延长契约视野对股东价值的增益。其含义在于，只有当相关指标既具信息性又具可契约性时，与气候挂钩的CEO薪酬才能应对“地平线悲剧”。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113154.title: The tragedy of the horizon: A contracting account
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113154.title_zh: 地平线的悲剧：一份契约解释

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113155.abstract: We document a growing link between university R&D expenditures and patenting activity in surrounding metropolitan statistical areas (MSAs) since 1980: the patents-per-capita gap between MSAs with and without a research university has doubled, and the elasticity of patents with respect to university R&D has tripled. We present several pieces of evidence showing that this trend reflects growing spillovers from universities: it is robust to MSA and university characteristics; local invention tracks the content of nearby university research; and the link is stronger where universities do more basic research. Thus, universities may increasingly shape the geography of innovation.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113155.abstract_zh: 我们记录了自1980年以来，大学研发支出与周边大都市统计区（MSA）专利活动之间日益增强的联系：拥有研究型大学的MSA与没有研究型大学的MSA之间的人均专利差距扩大了一倍，且专利对大学研发的弹性增长了两倍。我们提供了多项证据表明，这一趋势反映了大学溢出效应的增强：该联系对MSA和大学特征具有稳健性；本地发明活动与邻近大学的研究内容相吻合；且在大学从事更多基础研究的地区，这种联系更为显著。因此，大学可能日益塑造着创新的地理格局。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113155.title: The growing importance of universities for patenting and innovation
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113155.title_zh: 大学在专利与创新中日益增长的重要性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113156.abstract: This paper incorporates individual effort constraints into a network formation framework with local public goods. Strict Nash equilibria are characterised, featuring complete multipartite networks as a novel class of stratified structures, where agents are organised into distinct layers based on heterogeneous effort levels, with full inter-layer connectivity and no intra-layer links. We further show that such constraints weaken the law of the few by limiting extreme concentration of effort provision. As a result, equilibrium networks exhibit broader participation in production and layered patterns of effort provision. 10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113156.abstract_zh: 本文将个体努力约束纳入具有地方公共物品的网络形成框架中。严格纳什均衡被刻画，其特征是完全多部网络作为一种新型的分层结构，其中代理人根据异质性努力水平被组织成不同层级，层级间完全连接而层级内无连接。我们进一步表明，此类约束通过限制努力供给的极端集中，削弱了少数定律。因此，均衡网络在生产参与上表现出更广泛的分布，并呈现努力供给的分层模式。图形摘要 下载：下载高分辨率图像（255KB） 下载：下载全尺寸图像
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113156.title: Endogenous networks with constrained public goods
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113156.title_zh: 约束公共品的内生网络

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113157.abstract: This paper investigates the distinct effects of oil-specific and global uncertainty shocks on the stock returns of international oil and gas companies. Using monthly data from May 2007 to August 2025, we employ a Dynamic Factor Model on high-frequency volatility indices to construct separate proxies for global uncertainty and idiosyncratic oil uncertainty shocks. The dynamic effects of these shocks are estimated using Smoothed Local Projections. Global uncertainty shocks generate an immediate and homogeneous decline in stock returns across integrated, upstream, and downstream firms. In contrast, the effects of oil-specific uncertainty depend on a firm’s position within the value chain. Upstream firms exhibit the most pronounced responses, integrated firms display intermediate and mixed effects, while downstream companies appear comparatively insulated from oil-market uncertainty. These findings highlight the importance of distinguishing global from sector-specific uncertainty when assessing the financial consequences of uncertainty shocks in energy markets.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113157.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了石油特定冲击与全球不确定性冲击对国际油气公司股票收益的差异化影响。利用2007年5月至2025年8月的月度数据，我们采用动态因子模型对高频波动率指数进行分析，构建了全球不确定性与特质性石油不确定性冲击的独立代理变量。通过平滑局部投影法估计这些冲击的动态效应。全球不确定性冲击导致综合、上游及下游企业的股票收益立即且同质性地下降。相比之下，石油特定不确定性的影响则取决于企业在价值链中的位置。上游企业表现出最显著的反应，综合企业呈现中间且混合的效果，而下游公司则相对免受石油市场不确定性的影响。这些发现强调了在评估能源市场不确定性冲击的财务后果时，区分全球性与部门特定不确定性的重要性。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113157.title: Effects of oil price uncertainty on the stock returns of oil and gas companies
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113157.title_zh: 油价不确定性对油气公司股票收益的影响

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113158.abstract: Non-financial risks affect asset prices individually, yet they are typically studied in isolation. Using 49 Fama–French industry portfolios over 1990–2026, we show that pairwise compound channels among geopolitical risk, climate policy uncertainty, and financial stress carry significant pricing power beyond individual exposures. Climate policy uncertainty emerges as the nexus variable: its interaction with financial conditions is the most consistent channel, surviving all standard error methods, sub-sample splits, and predetermined (lagged) financial conditions, with an effect roughly four times larger for carbon-intensive industries. A Wald test confirms the joint significance of the interactions while individual risks lack joint significance.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113158.abstract_zh: 非金融风险虽各自影响资产价格，但通常被孤立研究。基于1990-2026年49个Fama-French行业投资组合，我们发现地缘政治风险、气候政策不确定性与金融压力之间的两两复合渠道，其定价能力显著超越单一风险暴露。气候政策不确定性作为枢纽变量：其与金融状况的交互作用是最稳健的渠道，在所有标准误方法、子样本分割及预设（滞后）金融状况下均保持显著，且对碳密集型行业的影响约为其他行业的四倍。Wald检验证实交互项具有联合显著性，而单一风险则缺乏联合显著性。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113159.abstract: We study how high short-term interest rates affect depositor withdrawals and bank fragility. In a global games model, depositors choose between bank deposits and money market funds, while bank holds short-term and long-term assets. Higher rates raise the payoff from withdrawing and reduce long-term asset recovery values. The model delivers a critical interest rate threshold above which runs occur, conditional on bank balance-sheet fundamentals. Lower switching cost, weaker long-term asset returns, larger fire-sale loss, and larger long-term asset share lower the threshold and expand the run region.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113159.abstract_zh: 本文研究短期高利率如何影响储户提款行为及银行脆弱性。在一个全局博弈模型中，储户在银行存款与货币市场基金之间进行选择，而银行持有短期与长期资产。利率上升既提高了提款的收益，又降低了长期资产回收价值。该模型推导出一个关键利率阈值：当利率超过该阈值时，基于银行资产负债表基本面状况，挤兑现象将发生。较低的转换成本、较弱的长期资产回报、较大的折价抛售损失以及较高的长期资产占比，均会降低该阈值并扩大挤兑区域。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113159.title: Interest rates and bank runs

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113160.abstract: We study whether the DeepSeek-R1 shock changed the market value of scarce AI compute. Using U.S. stock returns around January 27, 2025 and compute-supply exposure from pre-event 10-K filings, firms more exposed to supplying AI compute earned significantly lower abnormal returns. In the preferred specification, higher compute-supply exposure predicts a 2.37 percentage-point lower three-day cumulative abnormal return (CAR[-1,+1]). Results survive industry fixed effects, risk and financial controls, alternative benchmarks, placebo dates, and text-validation checks. The evidence suggests DeepSeek was priced as a shock to AI compute scarcity rents, not only a broad technology-sector shock.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113160.abstract_zh: 我们研究了DeepSeek-R1冲击是否改变了稀缺AI算力的市场价值。利用2025年1月27日前后的美国股票回报率以及事件前10-K文件中披露的算力供应敞口，我们发现，更倾向于供应AI算力的公司在异常回报率上显著更低。在首选规格中，更高的算力供应敞口预示着三天累计异常回报率（CAR[-1,+1]）下降2.37个百分点。该结果在行业固定效应、风险与财务控制、替代基准、安慰剂日期以及文本验证检查中均保持稳健。证据表明，DeepSeek被定价为对AI算力稀缺性租金的冲击，而不仅仅是广泛的技术板块冲击。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113160.title: Low-Cost AI and the Value of Compute Scarcity: Evidence from the DeepSeek Shock
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113160.title_zh: 低成本人工智能与算力稀缺性的价值：来自DeepSeek冲击的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113161.abstract: Researchers often have access to multiple instrumental variables for a single treatment, yet empirical practice frequently relies on only one instrument while ignoring the others. We show that this approach generally identifies a noncausal parameter. We characterize the resulting “omitted-instrument bias” and show that it vanishes in special cases, such as when instruments are independent of each other or treatment effects are homogeneous. We propose a simple alternative two-stage least squares specification that identifies a causal estimand.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113161.abstract_zh: 研究者们常常拥有针对单一处理变量的多个工具变量，然而实证操作中往往仅依赖其中一个而忽略其余。我们证明，这种做法通常识别出的并非因果参数。我们刻画了由此产生的“遗漏工具变量偏误”，并指出在特定情形下，如工具变量相互独立或处理效应同质时，该偏误会消失。我们提出一种简单的替代两阶段最小二乘设定，能够识别出因果估计量。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113161.title: Omitted instrument bias

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113162.abstract: We study maximum resale prices across heterogeneous local markets that share a common target retail price. A sufficiently small retailer margin can make the ceiling bind across markets, allowing common terms to implement this price. Two-part tariffs instead require the marginal wholesale price to align the retailer’s unconstrained optimal price exactly with the target. If the ceiling already binds, changes in market structure require no contractual recalibration. Apple’s use of list prices as de facto maximum resale prices, combined with discounts from those prices for independent resellers, illustrates a setting in which the mechanism may be relevant.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113162.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在共享统一目标零售价格的异质性地方市场中，最高转售价格的表现。当零售商利润率足够低时，价格上限可能在各市场间产生约束效应，使得统一条款能够实现该目标价格。相比之下，两部收费制要求边际批发价格精确匹配零售商无约束最优价格与目标价格。若价格上限已产生约束，市场结构变化无需重新调整合同条款。苹果公司将标价作为事实上的最高转售价格，同时为独立经销商提供折扣的做法，揭示了该机制可能适用的场景。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113163.abstract: In the context of school choice, Ergin (2002) shows that Pareto efficiency and group strategy-proofness are equivalent properties for the student-optimal stable mechanism. We show that this equivalence holds at each preference profile and for every stable mechanism, providing a simple test for coalitional manipulability.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113163.abstract_zh: 在学校选择的背景下，Ergin（2002）指出，对于学生最优稳定机制而言，帕累托效率与群体策略防伪性是等价的。我们证明，这种等价性在每个偏好分布下以及对于每一种稳定机制均成立，从而为联盟可操纵性提供了一种简单的检验方法。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113164.abstract: AI coding agents, general purpose assistants that write and execute code, make empirical specification search fast and cheap, but they also widen hidden researcher degrees of freedom. This paper adapts an open-source agent-loop architecture to an empirical economics workflow and adds a post-search holdout evaluation. In a forecast-combination illustration, independent agent searches find methods that improve on benchmarks from the original study. Logged search and holdout evaluation together make adaptive specification search more transparent and help distinguish robust improvements from sample-specific discoveries.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113164.abstract_zh: AI编码代理，即编写并执行代码的通用助手，使得实证规格搜索变得快速且成本低廉，但同时也扩大了研究者隐藏的自由度。本文将开源代理循环架构适配至实证经济学工作流程，并增设搜索后保留样本评估环节。在预测组合的示例中，独立代理搜索发现的方法优于原始研究中的基准方法。结合日志记录的搜索过程与保留样本评估，使自适应规格搜索更加透明，并有助于区分稳健改进与样本特定发现。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113164.title: An auditable AI agent loop for empirical economics: A case study in forecast combination
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113164.title_zh: 可审计的人工智能代理循环在实证经济学中的应用：预测组合的案例研究

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113165.abstract: We examine how corporate earnings announcement shocks influence US stock market bubbles using daily data from January 1990 to June 2025. After identifying positive and negative bubbles, we derive corporate earnings announcement shocks using a heteroskedastic vector autoregression model and estimate their dynamic effects on bubble indicators using local projections, with vector autoregression-based impulse responses reported as a robustness check. Positive earnings shocks boost positive bubbles, particularly at the medium to long-term, while reducing negative bubbles at the short-term. Therefore, favorable earnings news can fuel prolonged speculative episodes by increasing investor optimism, and lead to deep crashes but mild recoveries.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113165.abstract_zh: 我们利用1990年1月至2025年6月的日度数据，考察了企业盈利公告冲击如何影响美国股市泡沫。在识别出正向和负向泡沫后，我们采用异方差向量自回归模型推导企业盈利公告冲击，并通过局部投影法估计其对泡沫指标的动态效应，同时以基于向量自回归的脉冲响应作为稳健性检验。正向盈利冲击会增强正向泡沫，尤其在中期至长期内效果显著，同时短期内会减弱负向泡沫。因此，利好的盈利消息可能通过提升投资者乐观情绪，助长长期投机行为，并导致深度崩盘但温和复苏。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113165.title: Corporate Earnings Announcements and Stock Market Bubbles
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113165.title_zh: 企业盈利公告与股市泡沫

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113166.abstract: We propose target-driven Bayesian stacking for a fixed six-model ensemble of GARCH and stochastic-volatility forecasts with realised- and VIX-based extensions. Two rolling stacking rules target either log predictive density or QLIKE. In S&P 500, the objective changes the preferred information channel: LPD stacking remains centred on GARCH-RV, whereas QLIKE stacking shifts towards GARCH-VIX. Across 56 rolling windows, the QLIKE stack improves certainty-equivalent returns by roughly one to one-and-a-half percentage points per year, depending on the investor’s risk aversion. In the 30 windows where the QLIKE stack assigns material weight to implied volatility models, the gain exceeds two percentage points per year with a 90% win rate. However, LPD stacking delivers tighter 5% Value-at-Risk calibration. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113166.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种目标驱动的贝叶斯堆叠方法，用于一个由GARCH和随机波动率预测构成的固定六模型集成，并加入了基于已实现波动率和VIX的扩展。两种滚动堆叠规则分别以对数预测密度或QLIKE为目标。在标普500指数中，目标函数改变了偏好的信息渠道：LPD堆叠仍以GARCH-RV为中心，而QLIKE堆叠则转向GARCH-VIX。在56个滚动窗口中，根据投资者的风险厌恶程度，QLIKE堆叠每年可将确定性等价收益提高约1至1.5个百分点。在QLIKE堆叠赋予隐含波动率模型显著权重的30个窗口中，年化收益提升超过2个百分点，且胜率达90%。然而，LPD堆叠在5%风险价值校准方面表现更优。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113166.title: Target-driven Bayesian stacking of realized and implied volatility forecasts
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113166.title_zh: 目标驱动的已实现波动率与隐含波动率预测的贝叶斯堆叠

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113167.abstract: The data reported in this paper show that dictator game transfers depend crucially on whether money or effort are to be distributed. In a standard (monetary) version, giving is far more generous (close to equal sharing); behaviour is highly selfish in the effort version. Moreover, women are more altruistic then men when distributing money but are more selfish when distributing effort. The results suggest that the common focus on monetary transfers covers only part of the story.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113167.abstract_zh: 本文报告的数据显示，独裁者博弈中的转移行为关键取决于分配的是金钱还是努力。在标准（金钱）版本中，给予行为远更为慷慨（接近均分）；而在努力版本中，行为则高度自私。此外，在分配金钱时，女性比男性更具利他性，但在分配努力时则更为自私。这些结果表明，对金钱转移的普遍关注仅揭示了问题的一部分。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113168.abstract: This paper studies incomplete information social interaction models with exogenous network structures under rational expectations, where an agent’s outcome is affected by the expected outcomes of other agents through a network. Incomplete information models are suitable for cases where an agent’s outcome is not fully observed or precisely predictable to others. Under an asymptotic framework with many small networks, we derive efficiency bounds for the model. The derivation requires the information matrix to be non-singular. We show that the information matrix is non-singular under an identification condition based on observed network structures.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113168.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在理性预期下，具有外生网络结构的不完全信息社会互动模型，其中个体的结果通过网络受到其他个体预期结果的影响。不完全信息模型适用于个体结果未被他人完全观察或精确预测的情形。在包含许多小网络的渐近框架下，我们推导了该模型的效率界。推导过程要求信息矩阵非奇异。我们证明，在基于观测网络结构的识别条件下，信息矩阵是非奇异的。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113168.title: Efficiency bounds for incomplete information social interaction models with network structures
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113168.title_zh: 网络结构下不完全信息社会互动模型的效率边界

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113169.abstract: Governments use preferential trade agreements (PTAs), the WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement (TFA) and mutual recognition arrangements (MRAs) to reduce bilateral trade costs. Using data for 2010-2022 and a structural gravity framework, we assess the trade impact of a country-pair using all three policy instruments simultaneously. Our analysis considers MRAs for Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) programs that expedite customs clearance for certified actors in the supply chain. These are not product-specific, permitting comparative analysis of the trade impacts of the three types of international agreements. We find significant sectoral heterogeneity across the three instruments. The TFA has large effects on bilateral trade in non-food manufacturing products, while MRAs do more to boost the value of trade in agricultural and food-related products. Overall, international cooperation to reduce the costs of regulatory heterogeneity increases bilateral trade more than PTAs.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113169.abstract_zh: 各国政府通过优惠贸易协定（PTAs）、世界贸易组织《贸易便利化协定》（TFA）以及相互承认安排（MRAs）来降低双边贸易成本。利用2010年至2022年的数据及结构性引力模型框架，我们评估了一对国家同时采用这三种政策工具对贸易的影响。我们的分析聚焦于授权经济经营者（AEO）项目的MRAs，这些项目旨在加速供应链中经认证参与者的海关清关流程。这些措施并非针对特定产品，从而允许对三类国际协定的贸易影响进行比较分析。我们发现，这三种工具在不同行业间存在显著的异质性。TFA对非食品制造业产品的双边贸易影响显著，而MRAs则更有利于提升农产品及食品相关产品的贸易额。总体而言，旨在减少监管差异成本的国际合作对双边贸易的促进作用超过了PTAs。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113169.title: Trade agreements, trade facilitation and mutual recognition arrangements
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113169.title_zh: 贸易协定、贸易便利化与互认安排

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113170.abstract: We study the robustness of Nash equilibria in the preference revelation game induced by the student-optimal stable mechanism when small application fees are introduced. Assuming lexicographic preferences over outcomes, we show that introducing application fees reduces the set of Nash equilibria, to the detriment of student welfare. We provide a sufficient condition on the distribution of application fees that eliminates any Pareto improvement in which a student strictly benefits from being assigned to a given school. When all application fees are strictly positive for all applications, every Nash equilibrium induces a stable assignment.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113170.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在引入小额申请费的情况下，由学生最优稳定机制引发的偏好揭示博弈中纳什均衡的稳健性。假设对结果具有字典序偏好，我们表明引入申请费会减少纳什均衡的集合，从而损害学生福利。我们提供了申请费分布的一个充分条件，该条件消除了任何帕累托改进，其中学生因被分配到特定学校而严格受益。当所有申请费对所有申请均为严格正数时，每个纳什均衡都会产生一个稳定分配。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113170.title: Application fees and the robustness of Nash equilibria in school choice
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113170.title_zh: 申请费与学校选择中纳什均衡的稳健性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113171.abstract: Does central bank independence shape the inflationary impact of geopolitical risk? Using a panel of 29 countries over 1990–2023, we show that geopolitical risk significantly increases inflation, but that this effect depends on the degree of central bank independence. Higher institutional credibility substantially attenuates, and in some case offsets, the inflationary impact of geopolitical shocks. This moderating effect is stronger for geopolitical threats than for realized actions and is considerably more pronounced in advanced than in emerging economies. These findings highlight the importance of credible monetary institutions in enhancing resilience to geopolitical inflation.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113171.abstract_zh: 中央银行独立性是否影响地缘政治风险的通胀效应？基于1990-2023年29个国家的面板数据，我们发现地缘政治风险显著推高通胀水平，但该效应取决于中央银行的独立程度。更高的制度可信度能显著削弱——在某些情况下甚至抵消——地缘政治冲击的通胀影响。相较于已发生的实际行动，这种调节效应对地缘政治威胁更为显著，且在发达经济体中的表现远强于新兴经济体。这些发现凸显了可信货币制度在增强抵御地缘政治通胀韧性方面的重要作用。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113171.title: Geopolitical risk and inflation: Does central bank independence matter?
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113171.title_zh: 地缘政治风险与通货膨胀：央行独立性是否重要？

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113172.abstract: We consider tests for normality, residual autocorrelation, and autoregressive conditional heteroskedasticity for a time series regression, which includes various zero-one dummy variables for individual observations. The sizes of these tests are distorted as the residuals associated with the dummies are equal to zero. We propose a simple solution which amounts to dismissing the observations with these zero-valued residuals, that is, treat these observations as missing. With simulations we show that the resulting tests have the proper size.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113172.abstract_zh: 我们考虑时间序列回归中的正态性检验、残差自相关检验以及自回归条件异方差检验，该回归包含针对个体观测值的各种0-1虚拟变量。由于与虚拟变量相关的残差为零，这些检验的显著性水平存在扭曲。我们提出一个简单解决方案，即剔除这些残差为零的观测值，将其视为缺失值处理。通过模拟研究，我们证明修正后的检验具有恰当的显著性水平。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113172.title: Diagnostic testing a time series regression with zero-one dummies
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113172.title_zh: 零一虚拟变量时间序列回归的诊断检验

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113173.abstract: This paper examines the time-varying effects of monetary policy and global supply-chain disruptions on U.S. inflation and GDP during the COVID-19 pandemic. To this end, we estimate a time-varying parameter Bayesian Vector Autoregressive (TVP-BVAR) model. We find that expansionary monetary policy shocks’ impact differs significantly between pre- and post-pandemic periods. Specifically, inflationary effects of supply-chain disruptions increased substantially after the pandemic, while output effects remained stable. Furthermore, monetary policy pass-through to inflation strengthens as supply-chain pressures intensify. Finally, statistical evidence shows that supply-chain disruptions steepen the Phillips curve, with the effect most pronounced for durable goods inflation.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113173.abstract_zh: 本文考察了新冠疫情期间货币政策与全球供应链中断对美国通胀及GDP的时变影响。为此，我们估计了一个时变参数贝叶斯向量自回归（TVP-BVAR）模型。研究发现，扩张性货币政策冲击的影响在疫情前后时期存在显著差异。具体而言，供应链中断的通胀效应在疫情后大幅增强，而产出效应则保持稳定。此外，随着供应链压力的加剧，货币政策向通胀的传导效应增强。最后，统计证据表明，供应链中断使菲利普斯曲线变得更加陡峭，且这一效应在耐用品通胀中最为显著。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113174.abstract: Reduced-form bequest motives are routinely assumed to exhibit decreasing absolute risk aversion (DARA). I show this is consistent with an underlying altruistic primitive: when descendant risk is unrealised at the bequest choice date, DARA of the warm-glow preference is inherited from the descendant’s continuation value under both multiplicative and additive risk, without parametric restriction. Yet the two canonical specifications differ in what is preserved beyond DARA. Multiplicative risk yields a shifter-weight decomposition and preserves CRRA form; additive income risk—the relevant case for dynastic precautionary savings—preserves DARA but not functional form. • Warm-glow bequest motives inherit DARA from the descendant’s continuation value. • Holds under additive and multiplicative risk without parametric restriction. • Differences across calibrated studies need not reflect altruism strength. • Multiplicative risk preserves CRRA functional form; additive income risk does not. • Under additive risk, functional form is not disciplined by the altruistic primitive.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113174.abstract_zh: 简化形式的遗赠动机通常被假定表现出递减绝对风险厌恶（DARA）。我证明这与潜在的利他主义原始设定相一致：当后代风险在遗赠选择日期尚未实现时，暖光偏好的DARA特性是从后代的延续价值中继承而来的，无论是在乘法风险还是加法风险下，均无需参数限制。然而，两种典型设定在DARA之外所保留的特性上存在差异。乘法风险产生了一种移位权重分解，并保留了CRRA形式；加法收入风险——与王朝预防性储蓄相关的情形——保留了DARA但未保留函数形式。• 暖光遗赠动机从后代的延续价值中继承DARA。• 在加法和乘法风险下均成立，无需参数限制。• 校准研究间的差异未必反映利他主义强度。• 乘法风险保留CRRA函数形式；加法收入风险则不保留。• 在加法风险下，函数形式不受利他主义原始设定的约束。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113174.title: Warm-glow bequests and descendant risk

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113175.abstract: In this paper, we examine whether the relationship between non-bank financial intermediation (NBFI) and economic growth varies across the economic cycle. While existing studies focus on the average effects of broad measures of NBFI, the effects of the narrow measure of NBFI differing during periods of economic stress is less clear. Using a panel of 26 jurisdictions participating in the Financial Stability Board's NBFI exercise between 2006 and 2024, we find that larger narrow NBFI sectors are associated with higher real GDP growth. However, we find limited evidence that this relationship varies systematically between expansionary and recessionary periods.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113175.abstract_zh: 本文考察了非银行金融中介（NBFI）与经济增长之间的关系是否随经济周期变化。现有研究侧重于广义NBFI指标的平均效应，而狭义NBFI指标在经济压力时期的影响尚不明确。利用2006年至2024年间参与金融稳定理事会NBFI监测的26个司法管辖区的面板数据，我们发现，狭义NBFI部门规模越大，实际GDP增长率越高。然而，我们发现的证据有限，表明这种关系在扩张期与衰退期之间存在系统性差异。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113175.title: Narrow Non-Bank Financial Intermediation and Economic Growth: Does the Economic Cycle Matter?
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113175.title_zh: 狭义的影子银行中介与经济增长：经济周期是否重要？

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113177.abstract: This paper asks what can be learned from observed merger pairings when acquirers and targets meet in a two-sided market with transferable utility. A compact assignment-game model implies revealed-preference inequalities: observed matches must generate at least as much total surplus as feasible counterfactual matches in the same local market. I take these inequalities to Refinitiv M&A data for U.S. same-industry transactions during 2010–2024. The final estimation sample contains 1025 completed acquirer-target pairs and 36,881 financially feasible counterfactual pairs constructed within industry-quarter cells. A benchmark linear surplus specification based on differences in profitability, leverage, sales growth, and liquidity has weak identifying content. Across 60 optimization runs, the same maximum score is obtained, but the coefficient vectors attaining it differ substantially in sign and magnitude. The result is not a general impossibility claim about revealed-preference methods. It shows that observed matches and standard financial differences alone provide limited discipline on merger surplus when transfers, outside options, and richer pair-specific synergies are unobserved.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113177.abstract_zh: 本文探讨在具有可转移效用的双边市场中，当收购方与目标方相遇时，从观察到的并购配对中能获得何种信息。一个紧凑的指派博弈模型揭示了显示性偏好不等式：观察到的配对必须至少产生与同一局部市场中可行的反事实配对相等的总剩余。我将这些不等式应用于2010-2024年美国同行业交易的Refinitiv并购数据。最终估计样本包含1025个已完成的收购方-目标方配对，以及在行业-季度单元内构建的36881个财务上可行的反事实配对。基于盈利能力、杠杆率、销售增长率和流动性差异的基准线性剩余设定，其识别能力较弱。在60次优化运行中，虽获得相同的最大得分，但达到该得分的系数向量在符号和大小上存在显著差异。这一结果并非对显示性偏好方法的普遍不可行性论断。它表明，当转移支付、外部选择以及更丰富的配对特定协同效应未被观测到时，仅凭观察到的配对和标准财务差异对并购剩余的约束作用有限。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113177.title: Learning from observed matches in two-sided markets
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113177.title_zh: 从双边市场中的观测匹配中学习

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113178.abstract: This note studies how limited awareness affects cheap talk through message feasibility. A receiver is already aware of a new state, while the sender may be unable to formulate the associated message. We characterize monotone informative equilibria in a three-state game where the sender becomes aware of the new state with an exogenous probability before observing the payoff-relevant state. Prior awareness partially restores the common-awareness mimicking constraint.
