The new-state message may identify the payoff-relevant state, combine state and awareness information, or remain informative by revealing the sender's awareness even when it no longer identifies the state.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113178.abstract_zh: 本文考察了有限意识如何通过信息传递的可行性影响廉价交谈。接收者已意识到新状态的存在，而发送者可能无法构建相应的信息。我们在一个三状态博弈中刻画了单调信息均衡，其中发送者在观察到与收益相关的状态之前，以外部给定的概率意识到新状态。先验意识部分恢复了共同意识下的模仿约束。新状态信息可能识别收益相关状态，结合状态与意识信息，或即便不再识别状态，也能通过揭示发送者的意识而保持信息性。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113178.title: Limited awareness and message feasibility in cheap talk
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113178.title_zh: 廉价谈话中的有限认知与信息可行性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113179.abstract: In the cardinal part of their analysis of spherical preferences, Chambers and Echenique (2020) characterise quadratic-plus-linear utility using two axioms concerning changes from a status quo: Status Quo Independence (SQI) and Eventual Linearity (EL). We show that the two axioms are not independent. Specifically, SQI implies EL and, indeed, forces the additivity condition in EL to hold at every status quo, not merely at some status quo. Consequently, under continuity and normalisation, SQI alone characterises the representation, implying that their cardinal theorem remains valid when EL is dropped. The respective roles of continuity and normalisation are also clarified.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113179.abstract_zh: 在Chambers和Echenique（2020）对球形偏好基数部分的分析中，他们通过两个关于现状变化的公理——现状独立性（SQI）和最终线性（EL）——来刻画二次加线性效用。我们证明这两个公理并非独立。具体而言，SQI蕴含EL，并且实际上迫使EL中的可加性条件在每个现状下都成立，而不仅仅是在某些现状下。因此，在连续性和归一化条件下，仅凭SQI即可刻画该表示，这意味着他们的基数定理在省略EL时依然有效。同时，我们也澄清了连续性和归一化各自的作用。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113179.title: A single-axiom cardinal characterisation of quadratic utility
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113179.title_zh: 二次效用单一公理基数特征刻画

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113180.abstract: We study whether AI innovation changes labor-market polarization by weakening the relative position of high-skilled workers. We develop a CES production framework showing how AI affects the wage-cost ratio between high- and low-skilled workers through wage and employment margins. We test the model’s predictions using European regional labor-market data and find that AI reduces the relative wage-cost ratio by nearly 7 percent on average, with effects broadly split between wage and employment adjustments. These results are primarily driven by regions in countries highly specialized in AI technologies. Overall, our evidence suggests that AI may counteract the polarization effects associated with over two centuries of technological change.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113180.abstract_zh: 我们研究人工智能创新是否通过削弱高技能工人的相对地位来改变劳动力市场的极化现象。我们构建了一个CES生产框架，展示了人工智能如何通过工资和就业两个维度影响高技能与低技能工人之间的工资成本比率。利用欧洲区域劳动力市场数据检验模型预测，我们发现人工智能平均使相对工资成本比率下降近7%，其效应大致在工资调整与就业调整之间平分。这些结果主要由在人工智能技术方面高度专业化的国家中的地区所驱动。总体而言，我们的证据表明，人工智能可能抵消与两个多世纪技术变革相关的极化效应。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113180.title: AI innovation and labor market polarization: Evidence from European regions
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113180.title_zh: 人工智能创新与劳动力市场极化：来自欧洲地区的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113181.abstract: Does the numerical scale used to score an exam affect how hard students try? We test this question with a preregistered natural field experiment in which 1235 university students in India took identical tests framed as scored out of either 20 or 100 points. Exploiting both a high-stakes graded quiz and a zero-stakes additional test, we find no statistically or economically meaningful effects of the point-scale manipulation on test scores or on four effort measures, regardless of stakes, gender, or prior ability. These consistently null results, robust across settings, outcomes, and subgroups, identify a boundary condition for the numerosity heuristic: when scoring units are transparently arbitrary and evaluation ultimately rests on percentages, numerical rescaling does not shift behavior. The findings support the behavioral neutrality of a widely used and easily modified feature of assessment design.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113181.abstract_zh: 考试评分所用的数值量表是否会影响学生的努力程度？我们通过一项预先注册的实地自然实验来检验这一问题，实验中，印度1235名大学生参加了以20分或100分为满分框架的相同测试。利用高风险的计分测验和零风险的附加测试，我们发现，无论风险高低、性别或先前能力如何，分数量表操作对测试成绩或四项努力指标均无统计学或经济意义上的显著影响。这些一致为零的结果，在不同情境、结果和子群体中均稳健，界定了数量启发式的一个边界条件：当评分单位明显随意且评估最终依赖于百分比时，数值重新标定不会改变行为。研究结果支持了评估设计中这一广泛使用且易于修改的特征在行为上的中性。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113182.abstract: Access to space is now a national security priority, yet its cost varies enormously across nations. Using a novel dataset of over 6,740 rocket launches (1960–2025), we estimate country-level launch costs and country-specific experience curves. In 2025, the average costs per kilogram to Low Earth Orbit ranged from $3,225 in the United States to over $13,000 in India, with Europe, Russia, China, and Japan in between. Since 2010, only the US and Europe display statistically significant experience curves, with the US improving far faster. These widening asymmetries reinforce strategic dependencies with economic and security implications.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113182.abstract_zh: 进入太空现已成为国家安全优先事项，然而各国在此方面的成本差异巨大。利用一项涵盖1960至2025年间超过6740次火箭发射的新数据集，我们估算了国家层面的发射成本及各国特有的经验曲线。2025年，将每公斤载荷送入近地轨道的平均成本，从美国的3225美元到印度的超过13000美元不等，欧洲、俄罗斯、中国和日本则介于两者之间。自2010年以来，仅美国和欧洲展现出统计上显著的经验曲线，其中美国的改进速度远快于他国。这些日益扩大的不对称性加剧了战略依赖，并带来经济与安全方面的深远影响。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113182.title: Geopolitics and space access: cost asymmetries and strategic dependence
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113182.title_zh: 地缘政治与太空进入：成本不对称与战略依赖

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113184.abstract: This paper examines whether children’s time preferences independently predict academic achievement using matched incentivized measures for parents and children linked to standardized mathematics performance. Reduced-form regressions replicate prior findings that more patient children perform better academically. However, once parental time preferences are included, children’s patience no longer predicts achievement, while parental patience remains strongly significant across specifications. These results suggest that previously documented links between children’s time preferences and academic performance may reflect intergenerational behavioral transmission or household inputs rather than child-specific traits. The findings highlight the importance of jointly modeling parent and child characteristics when studying non-cognitive skill formation.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113184.abstract_zh: 本文利用匹配的父母与子女激励性时间偏好测量数据，结合标准化数学成绩，考察儿童时间偏好是否独立预测学业成就。简化形式回归重现了先前发现，即更有耐心的儿童学业表现更佳。然而，一旦纳入父母时间偏好，儿童的耐心不再预测学业成就，而父母的耐心在各规格中仍保持高度显著。这些结果表明，先前记录的儿童时间偏好与学业表现之间的关联可能反映代际行为传递或家庭投入，而非儿童特有特质。研究结果强调了在研究非认知技能形成时，联合建模父母与子女特征的重要性。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113185.abstract: This paper examines equity market reactions to the enforcement of the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) on January 1, 2026. Using an event-study approach on a sample of S&P 500 and STOXX Europe 600 firms, we document three main findings. First, CBAM enforcement is associated with positive aggregate abnormal returns, consistent with the resolution of policy uncertainty. Second, both European firms and CBAM-exposed sectors experience lower post-event returns on average, reflecting compliance costs. Third, and most importantly, the interaction between geography and CBAM exposure shows that the impact of exposure is relatively more favorable for European firms compared to their U.S. counterparts. These results suggest that CBAM is perceived by financial markets as both a carbon burden and a competitive mechanism, with effects concentrated in the short run.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113185.abstract_zh: 本文考察了股票市场对2026年1月1日欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）实施的反应。采用事件研究法，以标普500指数和斯托克欧洲600指数成分股为样本，我们得出三项主要发现。第一，CBAM的实施与正向的总体异常收益相关联，这与政策不确定性的消除相一致。第二，欧洲企业和受CBAM影响的行业在事件后平均回报率较低，反映了合规成本。第三，也是最重要的一点，地理位置与CBAM暴露度之间的交互作用表明，相较于美国同行，暴露度对欧洲企业的影响相对更为有利。这些结果表明，金融市场将CBAM视为一种碳负担和竞争机制，其影响主要集中在短期内。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113185.title: Competitive Shield or Carbon Burden? Evidence from Equity Market Reactions to CBAM Enforcement
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113185.title_zh: 竞争盾牌还是碳负担？来自股票市场对CBAM实施反应的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113186.abstract: We develop a real options model with finite-maturity debt to examine how rollover risk shapes the relative effectiveness of tax cuts and investment subsidies. Shorter debt maturity amplifies rollover risk, which strengthens the effectiveness of tax cuts while weakening that of investment subsidies. Under budget neutrality, tax cuts are always optimal. Under a net-subsidy regime, the optimal instrument is maturity-dependent: subsidies are optimal at long maturities, while as maturity shortens, a threshold tax rate emerges above which tax cuts are optimal and below which subsidies remain optimal. When maturity is sufficiently short, tax cuts dominate across all tax rates.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113186.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含有限期限债务的实物期权模型，以考察滚动风险如何影响减税与投资补贴的相对有效性。较短的债务期限会放大滚动风险，从而增强减税的效果，同时削弱投资补贴的作用。在预算中性条件下，减税始终是最优选择。在净补贴机制下，最优工具取决于债务期限：在长期限下，补贴为最优；随着期限缩短，会出现一个税率阈值，高于该阈值时减税为最优，低于该阈值时补贴仍为最优。当期限足够短时，减税在所有税率水平下均占优。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113186.title: Policy incentives, firm investment, and debt rollover risk
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113186.title_zh: 政策激励、企业投资与债务展期风险

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113187.abstract: This paper examines how immigration liberalization affects migrant inflows. We exploit Switzerland’s gradual introduction of free movement for European Union and European Free Trade Association nationals, while third-country nationals remained subject to a selective quota-based regime. Using administrative register data and a staggered difference-in-differences design, we find that free movement substantially increased immigration from affected countries, with the preferred specification implying that immigration more than doubled on average.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113187.abstract_zh: 本文考察了移民自由化如何影响移民流入。我们利用瑞士逐步引入对欧盟及欧洲自由贸易联盟国家国民的自由流动政策，而第三国国民仍受制于基于配额的选择性制度。通过行政登记数据和交错双重差分设计，我们发现自由流动显著增加了来自受影响国家的移民，首选规格表明平均移民数量翻了一倍以上。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113187.title: Free to Move? Immigration Liberalization and International Migration
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113187.title_zh: 自由流动？移民自由化与国际移民

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113188.abstract: Governments increasingly use soft, non-binding trade promotion partnerships alongside, or instead of, binding agreements, but their effects remain unclear. This paper studies the UK’s post-Brexit memoranda of understanding with individual US states. These partnerships promote trade and investment but cannot alter tariffs or establish enforceable market-access commitments. Using a structural gravity model and monthly state level goods trade data, we find no evidence of broad goods trade creation. Aggregate effects are insignificant, and product- and state-level estimates are heterogeneous rather than systematically positive, suggesting MoUs support economic cooperation rather than producing the broad trade effects associated with traditional binding agreements.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113188.abstract_zh: 各国政府日益倾向于在具有约束力的协议之外或取而代之，采用软性的、非约束性的贸易促进伙伴关系，但其效果仍不明确。本文研究了英国脱欧后与美国各州签署的谅解备忘录。这些伙伴关系旨在促进贸易与投资，但无法改变关税或确立可执行的市场准入承诺。利用结构引力模型和月度州级商品贸易数据，我们发现没有证据表明存在广泛的商品贸易创造效应。总体影响不显著，且产品和州层面的估计结果呈现异质性而非系统性正向，这表明谅解备忘录支持经济合作，而非产生与传统约束性协议相关的广泛贸易效应。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113188.title: Do non-binding trade promotion partnerships create trade? Evidence from UK-US state memoranda of understanding
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113188.title_zh: 非约束性贸易促进伙伴关系能否创造贸易？来自英美州级谅解备忘录的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113189.abstract: This paper examines how corporate strategy uniqueness influences stock price crash risk. Using portfolio analyses and panel regressions, we find that firms pursuing more unique strategies exhibit significantly lower crash risk. Channel analyses suggest that strategically unique firms face lower competitive pressure and weaker incentives to withhold bad news, thereby mitigating crash risk. Cross-sectional results further indicate that this negative relationship is stronger among firms with greater information asymmetry and weaker corporate governance. Overall, our findings provide important evidence on the role of corporate strategy in shaping firms’ downside tail risk.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113189.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了企业战略独特性如何影响股价崩盘风险。通过组合分析与面板回归，我们发现采取更为独特战略的企业展现出显著更低的崩盘风险。渠道分析表明，战略独特的企业面临较低的竞争压力及较弱的隐瞒坏消息动机，从而缓解了崩盘风险。截面结果进一步指出，在信息不对称程度较高及公司治理较弱的企业中，这一负向关系更为显著。总体而言，我们的研究为理解企业战略在塑造公司下行尾部风险中的作用提供了重要证据。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113189.title: Strategy uniqueness and stock price crash risk
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113189.title_zh: 策略独特性与股价崩盘风险

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113190.abstract: We investigate suppliers’ incentive to purchase data in a supply chain where multiple competing suppliers face uncertain downstream demand and may choose to acquire noisy demand signals (data) to improve their decisions. We identify a competition-reinforcement effect: data acquisition can trigger more aggressive competition among suppliers, which in turn erodes their incentive to purchase data. We show that this competition reinforcement effect could outweigh the conventional informed-decision benefit of better demand information, especially when input substitutability is low. As a result, intensified competition could reduce suppliers’ willingness to buy data, and may even generate net welfare losses.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113190.abstract_zh: 我们研究了供应链中供应商购买数据的动机，在该供应链中，多个相互竞争的供应商面临不确定的下游需求，并可能选择获取有噪声的需求信号（数据）以改进其决策。我们识别出一种竞争强化效应：数据获取可能引发供应商之间更激烈的竞争，这反过来又削弱了他们购买数据的动机。我们表明，这种竞争强化效应可能超过更好的需求信息所带来的传统知情决策收益，尤其是在投入品替代性较低的情况下。因此，竞争加剧可能降低供应商购买数据的意愿，甚至可能产生净福利损失。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113190.title: Supplier competition and the incentive to purchase data
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113190.title_zh: 供应商竞争与数据购买激励

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113191.abstract: This note revisits the standard derivation of the asymptotic unbiasedness of Akaike information criterion (AIC). The existing literature has shown that AIC is an asymptotically unbiased estimator of the predictive risk. However, there is a technical issue in these justifications. In this note, we bridge the gap and establish the asymptotic unbiasedness of AIC under certain regularity conditions, which are applicable in various scenarios. Our result suggests that AIC should be used with caution if the moment conditions on the parameter estimators may not hold. When model misspecification is allowed, our result can be extended to Takeuchi information criterion (TIC).
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113191.abstract_zh: 本注文重新审视了赤池信息准则（AIC）渐近无偏性的标准推导过程。现有文献已表明，AIC是预测风险的一个渐近无偏估计量。然而，这些论证中存在一个技术性问题。在本注文中，我们弥合了这一差距，并在一定的正则条件下确立了AIC的渐近无偏性，这些条件适用于多种情境。我们的结果表明，若参数估计量的矩条件可能不成立，则应谨慎使用AIC。当允许模型误设时，我们的结果可推广至竹内信息准则（TIC）。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113191.title: A note on the asymptotic unbiasedness of Akaike information criterion
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113191.title_zh: 关于赤池信息准则渐近无偏性的注记

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113192.abstract: When a central bank buys lower inflation with unemployment, does it get fewer price increases or more price cuts? We answer this for the United States by decomposing the Phillips multiplier — the cumulative inflation response to a monetary shock that raises unemployment by one percentage point — into its two directional margins, using 245 disaggregated PCE sub-indices and identified monetary shocks. Before 1990, a one-point rise in the cumulative unemployment gap raises deflationary pressure by 0.4pp: the trade-off runs through price cuts. After 1990, excluding the zero lower bound, weak instruments identify neither the multiplier nor either margin.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113192.abstract_zh: 当中央银行以失业为代价降低通胀时，它获得的是更少的价格上涨还是更多的价格下调？我们通过将菲利普斯乘数——即导致失业率上升一个百分点的货币冲击对通胀的累积反应——分解为其两个方向性边际，利用245个细分的个人消费支出（PCE）子指数及识别出的货币冲击，为美国回答了这一问题。1990年前，累积失业缺口上升一个百分点会使通缩压力增加0.4个百分点：这一权衡通过价格下调实现。1990年后，排除零利率下限情形，弱工具变量既无法识别乘数，也无法识别任一方向性边际。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113192.title: The Phillips multiplier and the two sides of inflation
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113192.title_zh: 菲利普斯乘数与通货膨胀的两面性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113193.abstract: In the classical housing market problem, when all agents have strict preferences, Roth and Postlewaite (1977) show that the top trading cycles (TTC) mechanism yields the unique competitive equilibrium allocation and the unique strong core allocation. We study an extension of the housing market model that incorporates one broker. We propose the concepts of competitive equilibrium and strong core, and show that the outcome yielded by the trading cycles mechanism in Pycia and Ünver (2017) is the unique competitive equilibrium allocation and the unique strong core allocation.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113193.abstract_zh: 在经典住房市场问题中，当所有代理具有严格偏好时，Roth和Postlewaite（1977）证明，顶级交易循环（TTC）机制产生唯一的竞争均衡配置和唯一的强核配置。我们研究了一个包含一个经纪人的住房市场模型的扩展。我们提出了竞争均衡和强核的概念，并证明Pycia和Ünver（2017）中的交易循环机制所产生的结果是唯一的竞争均衡配置和唯一的强核配置。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113193.title: On competitive equilibria and cores in housing market problem with one broker
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113193.title_zh: 带一个中介人的住房市场问题中的竞争均衡与核

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113194.abstract: Paid sick leave mandates aim to improve employee benefits. This paper examines how firms respond to the additional labor costs caused by PSL mandates. Leveraging the staggered implementation of PSL mandates across U.S. states, we use a difference-in-differences design and find that mandatory PSLs greatly accelerate firms’ adoption of automation. This effect is particularly evident among labor-intensive firms, consistent with the view that rising employment costs drive labor-capital substitution. Overall, by revealing an unintended consequence of PSL mandates, this study contributes to the pertinent literature and has important policy implications.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113194.abstract_zh: 带薪病假（PSL）强制规定旨在改善员工福利。本文探讨了企业如何应对由PSL强制规定带来的额外劳动成本。利用美国各州分阶段实施PSL强制规定的自然实验，我们采用双重差分设计，发现强制性PSL显著加速了企业采用自动化技术的进程。这一效应在劳动密集型企业中尤为明显，与就业成本上升驱动劳动-资本替代的观点相符。总体而言，通过揭示PSL强制规定的意外后果，本研究为相关文献做出了贡献，并具有重要的政策启示。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113194.title: Protecting Employees or Replacing Them? Paid Sick Leave Mandates and Firm Automation
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113194.title_zh: 保护员工还是替代员工？带薪病假规定与企业自动化

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113195.abstract: Bounded rationality reshapes monetary-policy trade-offs in response to supply shocks in a New Keynesian model with endogenous growth. A negative supply shock depresses innovation and future productivity, which gives rise to long-run scarring and persistent inflationary pressures. Under rational expectations, tighter monetary policy eases the initial rise in inflation but amplifies the fall in demand, innovation, and productivity. Under bounded rationality, households underreact to future income losses. This weakens the negative wealth effect and mitigates the decline in demand and growth. As a result, tighter monetary policy can contain inflation without generating large scarring effects.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113195.abstract_zh: 有限理性重塑了内生增长的新凯恩斯模型中货币政策对供给冲击的权衡取舍。负向供给冲击抑制创新与未来生产率，导致长期疤痕效应和持续的通胀压力。在理性预期下，紧缩性货币政策缓解了初期通胀上升，但加剧了需求、创新和生产率的下降。在有限理性下，家庭对未来收入损失反应不足，这削弱了负财富效应，并缓解了需求与增长的衰退。因此，紧缩性货币政策能够在不产生显著疤痕效应的情况下遏制通胀。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113195.title: Bounded rationality, monetary policy, and the scars of supply shocks
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113195.title_zh: 有限理性、货币政策与供给冲击的疤痕效应

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113196.abstract: This paper analyzes the macroeconomic consequences of bank market power under corporate earnings-based borrowing constraints. By embedding a Cournot banking structure within a Kiyotaki-Moore framework, we uncover a sharp structural reversal: while credit market power dampens the fire-sale multiplier under traditional asset-backed constraints, it amplifies that multiplier under earnings covenants. The endogenous lending markup directly inflates debt-service obligations, tightening borrowers’ cash-flow constraints, forcing deeper asset misallocations and severe aggregate output contractions. Fostering banking competition and relaxing countercyclical covenants act as structural complements, compressing spreads and maximizing real capital retention during financial distress.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113196.abstract_zh: 本文分析了在企业盈利为基础的借贷约束下，银行市场势力的宏观经济后果。通过将古诺银行业结构嵌入Kiyotaki-Moore框架，我们揭示了一个显著的结构性反转：在传统资产支持约束下，信贷市场势力抑制了火灾销售乘数，而在盈利契约下则放大了这一乘数。内生贷款加成直接推高了偿债义务，收紧借款人的现金流约束，迫使资产错配加深，并导致严重的总产出收缩。促进银行业竞争与放松逆周期契约在结构上互为补充，压缩利差并在金融困境期间最大化实际资本保留。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113196.title: Bank market power and fire-sale amplification under earnings-based constraints
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113196.title_zh: 银行市场势力与基于收益约束下的抛售放大效应

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113197.abstract: This paper examines whether patent-backed financing reforms affect firms’ external technology acquisition strategies. Using the staggered rollout of China’s Patent Pledge Financing Pilot (PPFP) across cities, we employ a difference-in-differences design to study its effect on corporate venture capital (CVC) investment. We find that PPFP significantly increases firms’ CVC activity, with the effect concentrated in high-tech CVC, and weaker for state-owned enterprises. These findings are consistent with the view that increasing the financial value of patent assets strengthens firms’ incentives to engage in technology-oriented CVC for external technology sourcing.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113197.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了专利质押融资改革是否影响企业的外部技术获取策略。利用中国专利质押融资试点（PPFP）在城市层面的分阶段推行，我们采用双重差分设计研究其对企业风险投资（CVC）的影响。研究发现，PPFP显著提升了企业的CVC活动，且该效应集中于高科技CVC，对国有企业的影响较弱。这些发现与提高专利资产金融价值会增强企业通过技术导向型CVC进行外部技术获取的动机这一观点相符。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113197.title: When Patents Become Collateral: Intellectual Property Financialization and Corporate Venture Capital Investment
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113197.title_zh: 当专利成为抵押品：知识产权金融化与企业风险投资

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113198.abstract: Rolling-window methods are widely used to explore time variation in economic relationships. Testing across overlapping windows induces a multiple-testing problem and can inflate the familywise error. Existing corrections are often either overly conservative or computationally intensive. We propose a harmonic mean p -value procedure that provides a global test together with window-level diagnostics. We establish iterated rejection-tail calibration of the global test and weak familywise error control for the associated diagnostic rule under overlap-induced dependence. Simulations using several standard time-series tests show accurate size, higher power, and substantially lower computational cost than bootstrap-based extreme-statistic procedures.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113198.abstract_zh: 滚动窗口方法被广泛用于探索经济关系中的时间变化。跨重叠窗口进行检验会引发多重检验问题，并可能夸大族系误差。现有修正方法往往要么过于保守，要么计算成本高昂。我们提出了一种调和平均p值程序，该程序提供全局检验及窗口级诊断。我们确立了全局检验的迭代拒绝尾部校准，并在重叠诱导依赖下建立了相关诊断规则的弱族系误差控制。使用若干标准时间序列检验的模拟显示，该方法具有准确的检验规模、更高的功效，且计算成本远低于基于自助法的极值统计量程序。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113198.title: Multiple testing in rolling-window analysis via p-value combination
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113198.title_zh: 基于p值组合的滚动窗口分析中的多重检验

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113199.abstract: Professional sports offer rare field tests of game theory with observed choices, sharp incentives, and expert competitors. Ryder Cup Sunday singles is a simultaneous permutation game where captains order twelve players and pairings form slot by slot. Under Hurley (2002)’s benchmark, uniform random ordering is a mixed-strategy equilibrium of the constant-sum game, and therefore also a minimax strategy. Using Sunday singles orders from 1981–2025 and, where available, Data Golf and OWGR ranks before each Cup, I test whether within-team ability is assigned uniformly at random across lineup slots. Permutation tests reject uniform random assignment. The data indicate that stronger players appear earlier than random shuffles within teams predict, with the pattern more pronounced in later Ryder Cups.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113199.abstract_zh: 职业体育为博弈论提供了罕见的实地检验场景，其中包含可观测的选择、明确的激励以及专家级竞争者。莱德杯周日单打赛是一种同时进行的排列博弈，队长们安排十二名球员出场顺序，配对逐位形成。在Hurley（2002）的基准框架下，均匀随机排序是该常和博弈中的混合策略均衡，因此也是极小化极大策略。利用1981年至2025年间的周日单打出场顺序，并在可获得的情况下结合每届杯赛前的Data Golf和OWGR排名，我检验了队内能力是否在各出场位次上被均匀随机分配。排列检验拒绝了均匀随机分配的假设。数据表明，较强球员在队内随机洗牌所预测的位次之前更早出场，且这一模式在后期的莱德杯中更为显著。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113199.title: Do Ryder Cup captains randomize? Evidence from Sunday singles orders
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113199.title_zh: 莱德杯队长是否随机安排？来自周日单打顺序的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113200.abstract: This paper studies a tax on tourism services, collected from foreign visitors upon entry, in a two-sector small open economy with congestible public infrastructure. Lerner symmetry implies that the tax raises manufacturing’s relative price and reverses tourism-driven Dutch disease. Tourism tax revenue lowers resident income taxes, while the contraction in tourism output reduces congestion, generating a double dividend.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113200.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个拥有拥挤性公共基础设施的两部门小型开放经济中，对入境外国游客征收旅游服务税的情况。勒纳对称性表明，该税提高了制造业的相对价格，并逆转了旅游业驱动的荷兰病效应。旅游税收收入降低了居民所得税，而旅游业产出的收缩减轻了拥挤程度，从而产生了双重红利。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113200.title: Tourist taxation, lerner symmetry, and the double dividend
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113200.title_zh: 旅游税、勒纳对称性与双重红利

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113201.abstract: Holding score fixed, unit-price bidders can reallocate line-item prices to hedge quantity risk. Repricing governs how this hedge affects realized payment, while a bid screen limits its size. Their interaction leaves residual exposure: baseline exposure minus effective hedge capacity, truncated at zero. Under constant absolute risk aversion (CARA), residual exposure generates a certainty-equivalent premium in the first-price score equilibrium. With a fixed binding screen, stronger repricing raises expected procurement payments when lost hedge capacity exceeds direct exposure relief. Calibrating the screen to preserve residual exposure preserves allocation, bidder utility, and expected payment under mean-level normalization.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113201.abstract_zh: 在保持评分不变的情况下，按单价投标的竞标者可以重新分配各分项价格以对冲数量风险。重新定价决定了这种对冲如何影响实际支付，而投标筛选则限制了其规模。两者相互作用产生了剩余风险敞口：即基准风险敞口减去有效对冲能力，并以零为下限截断。在常数绝对风险厌恶（CARA）假设下，剩余风险敞口在第一价格评分均衡中产生确定性等价溢价。当固定且具有约束力的筛选存在时，若失去的对冲能力超过直接风险敞口缓解，更强的重新定价会提高预期采购支付。将筛选校准以保持剩余风险敞口不变，在均值水平归一化下，可保持配置、竞标者效用及预期支付不变。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113201.title: Calibrating bid screens under quantity repricing
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113201.title_zh: 数量重定价下投标屏幕的校准

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113202.abstract: We develop a symmetrized smooth test for the equality of two distributions by incorporating information from two probability integral transform representations in a symmetric manner. This construction eliminates the dependence on the assignment of roles to the two samples. We establish the asymptotic Chi-square null distribution of the proposed symmetrized statistic and characterize its behavior under fixed and local alternatives. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed test achieves more stable size control and improved finite-sample performance, particularly when the sample sizes are small or unbalanced.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113202.abstract_zh: 我们通过对称地整合两种概率积分变换表示的信息，开发了一种用于检验两个分布相等性的对称化平滑检验。这一构造消除了对两个样本角色分配依赖的问题。我们确立了所提出的对称化统计量的渐近卡方零分布，并刻画了其在固定备择和局部备择下的行为。模拟研究表明，所提出的检验在样本量较小或不平衡时，实现了更稳定的尺寸控制和改进的有限样本性能。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113202.title: Symmetrized smooth test for the equality of distributions
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113202.title_zh: 对称化平滑检验用于分布相等性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113203.abstract: The source of aging matters for the real-rate redistribution channel of monetary transmission in a three-generation life-cycle model. A given old-age dependency ratio can reflect higher longevity or a lower birth rate. We show that this channel depends on the source of aging and on who bears the fiscal cost, not on the ratio alone. When retirees bear a sufficiently large share of the fiscal cost, the low-birth-rate economy has the larger consumption response to a real interest-rate increase. Otherwise, the high-longevity economy has the larger response.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113203.abstract_zh: 在代际生命周期模型中，老龄化来源对货币传导的实际利率再分配渠道至关重要。给定的老年抚养比可能反映更高的寿命或更低的出生率。我们证明，这一渠道取决于老龄化的来源以及谁承担财政成本，而非仅取决于该比率。当退休人员承担足够大的财政成本份额时，低出生率经济体对实际利率上升的消费反应更大。否则，高寿命经济体的反应更大。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113203.title: Birth rates, longevity, and monetary transmission
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113203.title_zh: 出生率、寿命与货币传导

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113204.abstract: Amidst heightened policy uncertainty, understanding the drivers of global macroeconomic instability becomes increasingly critical. This paper studies the determinants of output volatility synchronization using data for 42 economies worldwide. We construct a bilateral time-varying index of volatility synchronization and infer its drivers using Bayesian Model Averaging, complemented by Weighted Average Least Squares and LASSO. We find that differences in Total Factor Productivity, interest rate, and fiscal policy volatility robustly explain cross-country synchronization, with nuances between developed and developing countries. Overall, the results highlight the role of technological divergence and macroeconomic policy uncertainty in shaping the international co-movement of output volatility.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113204.abstract_zh: 在政策不确定性加剧的背景下，理解全球宏观经济不稳定的驱动因素变得日益关键。本文利用全球42个经济体的数据，研究产出波动同步性的决定因素。我们构建了一个双边时变波动同步性指数，并采用贝叶斯模型平均法，辅以加权平均最小二乘法和LASSO方法，推断其驱动因素。研究发现，全要素生产率、利率及财政政策波动性的差异稳健地解释了跨国同步性，且发达国家与发展中国家之间存在细微差别。总体而言，结果凸显了技术分化与宏观经济政策不确定性在塑造产出波动国际联动中的作用。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113204.title: What ties us together? Explaining synchronized GDP volatility
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113204.title_zh: 什么将我们联系在一起？解释同步的GDP波动

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113205.abstract: This paper compares causal forests with varying-coefficient penalized spline estimators for heterogeneous treatment effects. We conduct simulations with randomized treatment assignment that vary heterogeneity, predictor dimension, and discrete nuisance structure. Performance is measured by out-of-sample mean squared error. Forests perform best in Wager–Athey designs with sharp treatment-effect transitions. Penalized splines tend to dominate when heterogeneity is smooth, when the baseline mean and treatment effect differ in structure, and in mixed designs with continuous, binary, and group-level covariates. As group cardinality rises, forest performance deteriorates, while mgcv random-effect smooths handle group structure effectively and remain easy to implement.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113205.abstract_zh: 本文比较了因果森林与变系数惩罚样条估计器在异质性处理效应中的表现。我们通过随机化处理分配的模拟实验，变化异质性程度、预测变量维度及离散干扰结构。性能以样本外均方误差衡量。在Wager–Athey设计中，处理效应转变陡峭时，森林方法表现最佳。当异质性平滑、基线均值与处理效应结构不同，以及混合设计包含连续、二元和组级协变量时，惩罚样条通常占优。随着组基数增大，森林性能下降，而mgcv随机效应平滑能有效处理组结构，且易于实施。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113205.title: Causal forests versus penalized splines for heterogeneous treatment effects
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113205.title_zh: 异质性处理效应下因果森林与惩罚样条方法的比较

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113206.abstract: Geopolitical tensions and military threats increasingly shape global financial markets. Using geopolitical threat signals associated with President Donald Trump, we distinguish between threats that later escalated into military action and those that did not. We find a clear asymmetry in stock market responses. Threats that do not materialize are associated with positive abnormal returns, whereas threats followed by military escalation generate weaker or negative effects, particularly in Latin American stock markets, while responses in G7 economies remain muted. These findings suggest that markets price not only geopolitical threats themselves, but also their perceived credibility and eventual realization, highlighting the role of credibility in asset pricing.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113206.abstract_zh: 地缘政治紧张局势与军事威胁日益塑造全球金融市场。利用与唐纳德·特朗普总统相关的地缘政治威胁信号，我们区分了后来升级为军事行动的威胁与未升级的威胁。我们发现股市反应存在明显的非对称性。未实现的威胁与正异常收益相关，而随后发生军事升级的威胁则产生较弱或负面的效应，尤其是在拉丁美洲股市中，而七国集团经济体的反应则较为平淡。这些发现表明，市场不仅对地缘政治威胁本身进行定价，还对其感知可信度及最终实现情况进行定价，凸显了可信度在资产定价中的作用。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113206.title: Do stock Markets Price Words or Actions? President Donald Trump´s Geopolitical Signals and Conflict Risk
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113206.title_zh: 股市定价的是言辞还是行动？唐纳德·特朗普总统的地缘政治信号与冲突风险

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113207.abstract: We challenge the narrative of idle monetary transmission in Pakistan. By cleansing conventional policy measures of anticipatory and endogenous motives à la Romer and Romer (2004), and using local projections in long differences (Jordá and Taylor, 2025; Piger and Stockwell, 2025), Piger and Stockwell, 2025], we trace the effects of monetary shocks on macroeconomic and financial outcomes while controlling for the global financial cycle (Miranda-Agrippino and Rey, 2020). A contractionary shock generates a large and persistent output contraction and a significant, non-monotone response of year-on-year inflation, with disinflation on impact and again after eight to nine quarters. The policy rate rises in the short run, while term-spread and credit responses are economically coherent but less precisely estimated. US monetary spillovers are small and statistically imprecise. Monetary policy works in Pakistan; only its measurement was idle.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113207.abstract_zh: 我们挑战了关于巴基斯坦货币政策传导失效的叙事。通过借鉴Romer和Romer（2004）的方法，剔除常规政策度量中的预期性和内生性动机，并采用长期差分中的局部投影法（Jordá和Taylor，2025；Piger和Stockwell，2025），我们在控制全球金融周期（Miranda-Agrippino和Rey，2020）的同时，追踪了货币冲击对宏观经济和金融结果的影响。一个紧缩性冲击会导致产出大幅且持久的收缩，以及同比通胀显著的非单调反应，表现为即时通缩效应及在八至九个季度后再次出现的通缩。政策利率在短期内上升，而期限利差和信贷反应在经济上具有一致性，但估计精度较低。美国货币溢出效应较小且统计上不显著。货币政策在巴基斯坦是有效的；只是其度量方式此前一直处于停滞状态。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113207.title: Idle monetary policy? Evidence from monetary policy shocks for Pakistan
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113207.title_zh: 闲置的货币政策？来自巴基斯坦货币政策冲击的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113208.abstract: Researchers often use fixed-effects and lagged-dependent-variable (LDV) estimates as upper and lower bounds on a treatment effect. This paper studies this comparison in staggered-treatment designs and shows that the conventional ordering of the two estimates is not generally preserved. The direction of the difference depends on cohort- and event-time-specific treatment effects, outcome persistence, and the alignment of treatment timing with unit and time heterogeneity. Thus, either estimator may serve as the lower or upper bound, and the ordering may vary across group-time cells. Monte Carlo simulations further show that the interval formed by the two realized point estimates frequently fails to contain the true group-time average treatment effect in finite samples. The results suggest that fixed-effects and LDV estimates should be viewed as a descriptive comparison rather than as guaranteed bounds.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113208.abstract_zh: 研究者常将固定效应与滞后因变量（LDV）估计值视为处理效应的上界和下界。本文在交错处理设计中考察了这一比较，并表明这两种估计值的传统排序并非普遍成立。差异的方向取决于队列及事件时间特定的处理效应、结果持续性，以及处理时机与单位和时间异质性的对齐情况。因此，任一估计量都可能作为下界或上界，且排序可能因组-时间单元而异。蒙特卡洛模拟进一步显示，由两个实现点估计值构成的区间，在有限样本中经常无法包含真实的组-时间平均处理效应。结果表明，固定效应与LDV估计值应被视为描述性比较，而非有保证的界限。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113208.title: On the bracketing relationship in staggered treatment designs
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113208.title_zh: 关于交错治疗设计中的括号关系

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113209.abstract: When do AI platforms retain too much or too little user data? Users disclose proprietary context to obtain useful generative-AI output, but retention of that context creates exposure and may improve future systems. We formalize this user-side analogue of Arrow’s information paradox. The disclosure cap separates two regimes. Outside the capped region, behavioral adjustment is strong enough for equilibrium harm to fall with retention, so the planner’s optimum is a boundary choice. Within the capped region, the ratio of benefit appropriability to harm internalization governs platform retention: the platform under-retains when the ratio is below one and over-retains when it is above one. When retained inputs also raise AI quality, retention and disclosure become complements once quality feedback is sufficiently strong. Retention regulation corrects the platform’s choice; an interior disclosure choice generally requires an additional disclosure-side instrument to implement the joint first best.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113209.abstract_zh: AI平台何时会保留过多或过少的用户数据？用户披露专有上下文以获取有用的生成式AI输出，但保留这些上下文会带来风险，并可能改进未来系统。我们形式化了这一用户侧的阿罗信息悖论类比。披露上限区分了两种情形。在受限区域之外，行为调整足够强，使得均衡损害随保留量增加而下降，因此规划者的最优选择是边界解。在受限区域之内，收益可占有性与损害内部化之比决定平台的保留行为：当该比率低于1时，平台保留不足；高于1时，则保留过度。当保留的输入同时提升AI质量时，一旦质量反馈足够强，保留与披露便成为互补关系。保留监管纠正了平台的选择；而内部披露选择通常需要额外的披露侧工具才能实现联合最优。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113209.title: The reverse information paradox: When AI platforms retain too much or too little data
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113209.title_zh: 反向信息悖论：当AI平台保留过多或过少数据时

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113210.abstract: This paper studies the behavior of Katz–Bonacich centrality and key-player intercentrality in linear–quadratic network games when spillovers are strong. Understanding this regime is both theoretically important and empirically relevant in environments where interactions are intense. We show that as spillovers become large, Katz–Bonacich centrality converges (up to scale) to the Perron eigenvector, while intercentrality diverges at the same rate for all nodes and becomes dominated by a common leading component. As a result, first-order proportional differences in intercentrality—normalized by the common divergent scale—vanish near the critical threshold. Rankings based on lower-order differences in intercentrality, or on post-removal activity and welfare levels, need not collapse and may remain stable even arbitrarily close to the boundary.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113210.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在溢出效应较强时，线性二次网络博弈中Katz–Bonacich中心性与关键参与者间中心性的行为。理解这一机制在理论上具有重要意义，并且在互动密集的环境中具有实证相关性。我们证明，随着溢出效应增大，Katz–Bonacich中心性（按比例）收敛于Perron特征向量，而间中心性对所有节点以相同速率发散，并受一个共同的领先成分主导。因此，在临界阈值附近，以共同发散尺度归一化后的间中心性的一阶比例差异消失。基于间中心性低阶差异或基于移除后活动与福利水平的排序，则不必崩溃，并且即使在边界任意接近的情况下也可能保持稳定。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113210.title: How to determine key players when spillovers are large
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113210.title_zh: 溢出效应显著时如何识别关键参与者

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113212.abstract: We construct macroeconomic attention indicators (MAIs) using daily search engine data. Across multiple dynamic forecast combination approaches, the MAIs demonstrate significant predictive power for the realized volatility of the Chinese stock market. The predictive gains are primarily driven by attention to safe-haven demand (gold) and monetary policy (interest rates), with substantial heterogeneity across sectors. Moreover, MAIs become particularly informative during the high-uncertainty periods, highlighting the state-dependent transmission of macroeconomic attention to financial markets.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113212.abstract_zh: 我们利用每日搜索引擎数据构建了宏观经济关注度指标（MAIs）。在多种动态预测组合方法下，MAIs对中国股市已实现波动率展现出显著的预测能力。预测增益主要源于对避险需求（黄金）和货币政策（利率）的关注，且各行业间存在显著异质性。此外，在高不确定性时期，MAIs的信息含量尤为突出，凸显了宏观经济关注度向金融市场传导的状态依赖性。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113212.title: Macroeconomic Attention and Stock Market Volatility: Evidence from Dynamic Forecast Combinations
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113212.title_zh: 宏观经济关注与股市波动：来自动态预测组合的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113213.abstract: This paper derives the exact minimum number of impact sign restrictions required to identify shocks in a structural vector autoregression under a natural pairwise separation condition. The answer is . The proof follows from deriving a sharp lower bound using a Kraft-type inequality and then constructing an admissible restriction matrix that attains the bound. Our result reveals a significant sparsity gain: while traditional recursive orderings require restrictions, sign-based separation requires only , providing a transparent benchmark for designing sparse identifying schemes in large SVARs.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113213.abstract_zh: 本文推导了在自然成对分离条件下，结构向量自回归中识别冲击所需的最小精确影响符号约束数量。答案是 。证明过程通过利用Kraft型不等式推导出尖锐下界，随后构造一个达到该下界的可行约束矩阵来完成。我们的结果揭示了显著的稀疏性优势：传统递归排序需要 个约束，而基于符号的分离仅需 个，为大型SVAR中设计稀疏识别方案提供了透明的基准。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113213.title: How many sign restrictions are needed? A sharp lower bound for identifying multiple shocks in SVARs
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113213.title_zh: 需要多少个符号约束？SVAR中识别多重冲击的一个严格下界

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113214.abstract: We investigate the impact of common ownership in a spatial price discrimination model with sequential location choice. In contrast to simultaneous location choice, an increase in common ownership need not reduce locational efficiency. Common ownership by the location leader improves locational efficiency, even restoring the first best.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113214.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在序贯选址的空间价格歧视模型中，共同所有权的影响。与同时选址不同，共同所有权的增加未必会降低选址效率。选址领导者拥有的共同所有权能提升选址效率，甚至恢复最优状态。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113214.title: Common Ownership with a Location Leader
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113214.title_zh: 共同所有权与区位领导者

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113216.abstract: Institutional legacies are associated not only with the scale of finance but also with the organizational forms that emerge. Using prefecture-level data from early twentieth-century China, where indigenous money houses based on relational contracting coexisted with modern banks operating under codified law, we document that prefectures more deeply embedded in the imperial administrative system had more money houses and lower private borrowing costs, consistent with lower information and enforcement costs in relational finance. Treaty-port prefectures instead had more modern banks, with this concentration widening from 1910 to 1935. The analysis is descriptive and does not establish causality.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113216.abstract_zh: 制度遗产不仅与金融规模相关，还与涌现出的组织形式相关联。利用二十世纪初中国府级数据，当时基于关系契约的本土钱庄与依据成文法运营的现代银行并存，我们发现，更深入融入帝国行政体系的府拥有更多钱庄，且私人借贷成本更低，这与关系金融中较低的信息和执行成本相符。相反，通商口岸府则拥有更多现代银行，且这一集中趋势在1910年至1935年间不断扩大。本分析为描述性研究，并未确立因果关系。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113216.title: Different Institutions, Different Finance: Evidence from Early Twentieth-Century China
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113216.title_zh: 不同制度，不同金融：来自二十世纪初中国的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113217.abstract: This paper examines how participation in global value chains (GVCs) shapes inflation in the European Union over 1995–2023. Using local projections, we trace the dynamic response of producer- and consumer-price inflation to total, backward, and forward GVC shocks across core, peripheral, and CEEC economies. The aggregate response at the producer-price level is disinflationary and concentrated in the backward channel, supporting the discipline-on-prices hypothesis. A marked PPI–HICP wedge emerges in peripheral economies, where producer-level gains do not reach consumers, while forward linkages feed demand-pull pressures on consumer prices in both core and CEEC suppliers.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113217.abstract_zh: 本文考察了1995年至2023年间参与全球价值链（GVC）如何影响欧盟的通胀。利用局部投影方法，我们追踪了生产者价格和消费者价格通胀对总体、后向及前向GVC冲击的动态响应，覆盖核心经济体、外围经济体及中东欧国家（CEEC）。生产者价格层面的总体响应呈通缩效应，且集中于后向渠道，支持了价格纪律假说。在外围经济体中，出现了显著的PPI-HICP缺口，生产者层面的收益未能传导至消费者，而前向联系则在核心经济体和CEEC供应商中均对消费者价格产生需求拉动型压力。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113217.title: GVC participation and inflation in the European Union
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113217.title_zh: 欧盟全球价值链参与度与通货膨胀

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113218.abstract: This paper contributes to the recent literature on the FDI–growth nexus by investigating whether fiscal decentralization moderates the growth effects of foreign direct investment (FDI). Using a panel of 69 countries over 1996–2020 with fixed-effects and system-GMM estimations, we show that while FDI generally promotes economic growth, its positive effect is significantly attenuated in countries with higher levels of fiscal decentralization, on both the revenue and expenditure sides. We further identify infrastructure quality as a transmission channel through which expenditure decentralization dampens the FDI–growth nexus, suggesting a reduced capacity to finance national public goods in highly decentralized settings. These findings highlight the importance of intergovernmental coordination in preserving the growth effectiveness of foreign investment, and open new avenues for research on the institutional determinants of the FDI–growth nexus.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113218.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察财政分权是否调节外国直接投资（FDI）的增长效应，为近期关于FDI与增长关系的研究做出贡献。利用1996年至2020年间69个国家的面板数据，并采用固定效应和系统GMM估计方法，我们表明，尽管FDI总体上促进经济增长，但在财政分权水平较高的国家，其积极效应显著减弱，这一现象在收入侧和支出侧均有所体现。我们进一步识别出基础设施质量作为传导渠道，通过该渠道，支出分权削弱了FDI与增长之间的联系，表明在高度分权的环境中，为国家公共产品融资的能力有所下降。这些发现强调了政府间协调在保持外国投资增长有效性方面的重要性，并为研究FDI与增长关系的制度决定因素开辟了新途径。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113218.title: Fiscal decentralization and the FDI–growth nexus
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113218.title_zh: 财政分权与外商直接投资—增长关系

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113220.title: The difficulty of telling signal from noise when noise lingers
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113220.title_zh: 噪声持续时区分信号与噪声的困难

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113221.abstract: The rapid expansion of cryptocurrency markets has intensified interactions between digital assets and traditional financial institutions, raising important questions about the implications of cryptocurrency-related uncertainty for banking activities. This paper investigates how cryptocurrency uncertainty shapes banks' funding, lending, and risk-taking decisions. Using a panel of 8,330 banks across 129 countries over the period 2009–2018, we examine the relationship between cryptocurrency uncertainty and key dimensions of banks' balance-sheet decisions. We find that heightened cryptocurrency uncertainty increases customer deposits while reducing lending activity, non-performing loans, and risk-weighted assets. These findings suggest that banks respond to cryptocurrency uncertainty by adopting more conservative balance-sheet decisions characterized by stronger funding positions, lower credit expansion, and reduced risk exposure. The results remain robust to alternative measures of cryptocurrency uncertainty and lending activity. Our findings highlight that cryptocurrency uncertainty generates significant spillover effects on traditional financial intermediation and should be incorporated into macroprudential surveillance frameworks.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113221.abstract_zh: 加密货币市场的迅速扩张加剧了数字资产与传统金融机构之间的互动，引发了关于加密货币相关不确定性对银行业活动影响的重要问题。本文探讨了加密货币不确定性如何影响银行的融资、贷款及风险承担决策。利用2009年至2018年间覆盖129个国家8，330家银行的面板数据，我们考察了加密货币不确定性与银行资产负债表决策关键维度之间的关系。研究发现，加密货币不确定性的上升增加了客户存款，同时减少了贷款活动、不良贷款及风险加权资产。这些结果表明，银行通过采取更为保守的资产负债表决策来应对加密货币不确定性，其特征为更强的资金状况、更低的信贷扩张及减少的风险敞口。上述结果在采用替代性加密货币不确定性及贷款活动衡量指标后依然稳健。我们的发现强调，加密货币不确定性对传统金融中介产生了显著的溢出效应，应被纳入宏观审慎监管框架之中。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113221.title: Cryptocurrency Uncertainty and Bank Intermediation
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113221.title_zh: 加密货币不确定性与银行中介

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113222.abstract: This paper studies whether local governments use land sales to buffer trade shocks. Combining land transactions for 275 Chinese cities over 2015–2023 with a Bartik measure of US tariff exposure, we find that more exposed cities raise land-sale revenue after the US-China trade war through higher average prices rather than greater aggregate land area. The price increase reflects two channels: a shift toward high-grade land driven primarily by area expansion, and a within-use price increase in commercial-residential land with no corresponding area response. Mechanism analysis shows that tariff shocks weaken local economic activity and intensify fiscal pressure.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113222.abstract_zh: 本文研究地方政府是否利用土地出让来缓冲贸易冲击。结合2015至2023年间中国275个城市的土地交易数据与美国关税暴露的Bartik度量，我们发现，在中美贸易战后，暴露程度更高的城市通过提高平均地价而非扩大土地出让总面积来增加土地出让收入。地价上涨反映了两条渠道：一是主要由面积扩张驱动的高等级土地占比提升，二是商业住宅用地内部价格上升而面积并无相应响应。机制分析表明，关税冲击削弱了地方经济活动并加剧了财政压力。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113222.title: Tariff shocks and land sales: Evidence from China’s cities
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113222.title_zh: 关税冲击与土地出让：来自中国城市的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113223.abstract: We study a bargaining model where a distributor allocates new users between an incumbent supplier, which also serves an installed base, and a rival. We compare separable agreements, whereby installed-base payments continue regardless of the new-user award, with platform-wide agreements, whereby those payments are made only if the incumbent receives the award. When installed-base users are inframarginal and bargaining is frictionless, the contractual linkage does not affect supplier selection or the rival’s equilibrium payment: the distributor’s lost payment is exactly offset by the incumbent’s avoided payment. When contracting frictions are present, platform-wide agreements can exclude a more efficient rival.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113223.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个议价模型，其中分销商将新用户分配给一个既服务现有客户群的在位供应商，或其竞争对手。我们比较了可分离协议与平台范围协议，前者无论新用户归属如何，现有客户群的支付都持续进行；后者仅在位供应商获得新用户分配时才进行这些支付。当现有客户群用户处于边际内且议价无摩擦时，合同关联不影响供应商选择或竞争对手的均衡支付：分销商损失的支付恰好由在位供应商避免的支付所抵消。当存在合同摩擦时，平台范围协议可能排除更高效的竞争对手。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113223.title: Platform-Wide Agreements and Competition for New Users
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113223.title_zh: 平台范围协议与新用户竞争

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113233.abstract: Using transaction data from OpenSea, we examine whether NFT market participants anchor pricing decisions to nominal ETH-denominated transaction histories, rather than their fluctuating dollar values, across sequential stages: price setting (purchase-to-list) and price taking (list-to-sale). Panel regressions on 46,671 repeated NFT sales reveal that sellers anchor listing prices to acquisition prices, generating asymmetric mark-ups during ETH appreciation and mark-downs during ETH depreciation. Buyers exhibit similar anchoring realized prices. Stablecoin-denominated acquisition prices partially mitigate these distortions. These findings extend the denomination and anchoring literature to highly volatile, multi-currency marketplaces.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113233.abstract_zh: 利用OpenSea的交易数据，我们考察了非同质化代币（NFT）市场参与者在定价决策中是否锚定于以ETH计价的标称交易历史，而非其波动的美元价值，这一考察贯穿两个连续阶段：定价阶段（从购买到挂单）与接受价格阶段（从挂单到成交）。基于46,671笔重复NFT销售的回归分析显示，卖方将挂单价格锚定于购买价格，在ETH升值期间产生不对称的加价，在ETH贬值期间则出现减价。买方在成交价格上也表现出类似的锚定行为。以稳定币计价的购买价格在一定程度上缓解了这些扭曲。这些发现将计价单位与锚定效应的研究拓展至高度波动、多货币的市场环境中。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113233.title: Cryptocurrency Denomination and NFT Pricing

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101748.abstract: Travel improved dramatically between 1660 and 1820 in England and Wales. This paper uses nearly 100 travellers’ diaries to study the mode choice, speed of road transport and the quality of the roads used from the mid-1600s to 1820. Using mapping software, we digitise journeys made by various travel modes along more than 348,000 journey miles. We document that travel shifted from the saddlehorse to wheeled vehicles and that speed increased, although to a lesser degree in private or hired carriages compared to stagecoaches. We also report a novel measure of road quality using diarists’ descriptions of the road. The reported quality of many main roads went from ‘poor’ to ‘adequate’ or ‘good’ by the early 19th century. We also show that turnpike trusts, a novel organization for road funding, contributed to significantly better quality and were favoured over other roads by travellers in wheeled vehicles. Our estimates imply that the spread of turnpike trusts can account for most of the road quality change from 1660 to 1820.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101748.abstract_zh: 1660年至1820年间，英格兰和威尔士的旅行条件显著改善。本文利用近100位旅行者的日记，研究了从17世纪中期至1820年间出行方式的选择、道路运输速度及所用道路的质量。借助地图绘制软件，我们将各种出行方式超过348,000英里的旅程进行了数字化处理。研究发现，出行方式从骑马转向了轮式车辆，且速度有所提升，尽管私人或租赁马车的速度提升幅度不及公共马车。我们还通过日记作者对道路的描述，提出了一种新颖的道路质量衡量指标。至19世纪初，许多主要道路的报告质量从“差”提升至“尚可”或“良好”。此外，我们表明，作为道路融资的新型组织，收费信托机构显著改善了道路质量，并受到轮式车辆旅行者的青睐。我们的估算显示，收费信托机构的普及可以解释1660年至1820年间大部分道路质量的改善。

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101754.abstract: Market integration is vital for economic development; its determinants have been extensively documented in the literature. However, relatively little attention has been paid to the role of economic organizations. This paper seeks to fill this gap by investigating the role of futures exchanges in Republican China. Using manually collected primary data, we employ a continuous difference-in-differences approach to analyze the impact of the Chinese Cotton Goods Exchange on long-distance market integration. We find that, following the exchange's establishment in 1921, geographically distant cities experienced a stronger increase in market integration with Shanghai than nearby cities. Regarding the underlying mechanism, we show that the price-discovery function of the futures exchange promoted long-distance market integration by centralizing markets and reducing price uncertainty.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101754.abstract_zh: 市场整合对经济发展至关重要，其决定因素已在文献中得到广泛记载。然而，经济组织的作用相对较少受到关注。本文旨在通过研究民国时期期货交易所的角色来填补这一空白。利用手工收集的一手数据，我们采用连续双重差分法分析中国棉业交易所对长距离市场整合的影响。研究发现，自1921年该交易所成立后，地理上相距较远的城市与上海之间的市场整合程度增强幅度大于邻近城市。关于内在机制，我们表明期货交易所的价格发现功能通过集中市场和降低价格不确定性促进了长距离市场整合。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101754.title: Price discovery and long-distance market integration: Evidence from the Republican Chinese Cotton Goods Exchange
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101754.title_zh: 价格发现与远距离市场整合：来自民国时期中国棉纱交易所的证据

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101756.abstract: We present new annual time-series data on academic human capital across Europe from 1200 to 1793, constructed by aggregating individual-level measures at three geographic scales: cities, present-day countries (as of 2025), and historically informed macro-regions. Individual human capital is derived from a composite index of publication outcomes, based on data from the Repertorium Eruditorum Totius Europae (RETE) database. The macro-regional classifications are designed to reflect historically coherent entities, offering a more relevant perspective than modern national boundaries. This framework allows us to document key patterns, including the Little Divergence in academic human capital between Northern and Southern Europe, the effect of the Black Death and the Thirty Years’ War on academic human capital, the respective contributions of academies and universities, regional inequality across Catholic and Protestant areas of the Holy Roman Empire, and the distinctiveness of the Scottish Enlightenment.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101756.abstract_zh: 我们提供了欧洲1200年至1793年间学术人力资本的新的年度时间序列数据，这些数据通过在城市、现代国家（截至2025年）和历史宏观区域三个地理尺度上汇总个体层面的测量值构建而成。个体人力资本来源于基于《欧洲学者名录》（RETE）数据库的出版成果综合指数。宏观区域分类旨在反映历史上连贯的实体，比现代国家边界提供了更相关的视角。这一框架使我们能够记录关键模式，包括北欧与南欧之间学术人力资本的“小分流”、黑死病和三十年战争对学术人力资本的影响、学院与大学各自的贡献、神圣罗马帝国内天主教与新教地区的区域不平等，以及苏格兰启蒙运动的独特性。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101756.title: Academic human capital in European countries and regions, 1200–1793
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101756.title_zh: 欧洲国家与地区学术人力资本（1200–1793）

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101763.abstract: I construct the first annual-frequency dataset of agricultural output for China’s Yangzi Delta covering the period 1393–1953. Over six centuries, agriculture in the region expanded in total output but exhibited little per capita growth and no significant productivity improvement after the fifteenth century. Using the new data, I estimate representative rural household income and per capita GDP. The results indicate that by the late seventeenth century, both measures in the Yangzi Delta had fallen behind those of leading Western economies, including Britain, the Netherlands, and Italy. The timing of the Great Divergence thus lies between the estimates proposed by traditional Eurocentric scholars and those of the California School.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101763.abstract_zh: 我构建了首个覆盖1393至1953年间中国长三角地区农业产出的年度频率数据集。在这六个世纪里，该地区农业总产出有所增长，但人均产出增长甚微，且自十五世纪后未见显著的生产率提升。利用这一新数据，我估算了代表性农村家庭收入及人均GDP。结果显示，至十七世纪末，长三角地区的这两项指标均已落后于包括英国、荷兰和意大利在内的西方主要经济体。因此，大分流的时点介于传统欧洲中心主义学者与加州学派提出的估计之间。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101763.title: Agricultural growth in the Yangzi Delta: 1393–1953
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101763.title_zh: 长江三角洲的农业增长：1393–1953

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101764.abstract: We introduce a new rule-based linking method for historical Census records. We augment earlier algorithms based on name, age and place of birth (Abramitzky, Boustan, Eriksson, 2012, or “basic ABE”), with five matching characteristics – middle initial, county of residence, and spouse and parents’ names. Relative to basic ABE, ABE-Extra Information (“ABE-EI”) greatly increases match rates, improves accuracy and is similarly representative of the population on most attributes, with geographic mobility being one important exception. Relative to machine learning algorithms, ABE-EI has somewhat lower match rates, greater representativeness, and offers full replicability. We also create the first ABE-based links for women.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101764.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于规则的新方法，用于连接历史人口普查记录。我们在早期基于姓名、年龄和出生地的算法（Abramitzky, Boustan, Eriksson, 2012，或“基础ABE”）基础上，增加了五个匹配特征——中间名首字母、居住县、配偶及父母姓名。与基础ABE相比，ABE-额外信息（“ABE-EI”）显著提高了匹配率，提升了准确性，并且在大多数属性上对人口的代表性相似，但地理流动性是一个重要的例外。与机器学习算法相比，ABE-EI的匹配率略低，代表性更强，并提供了完全的可复制性。我们还首次为女性建立了基于ABE的链接。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101764.title: Finding John Smith: Using Extra Information for Historical Record Linkage
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101764.title_zh: 寻找约翰·史密斯：利用额外信息进行历史记录链接

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101765.abstract: This study examines the relationship between anthropogenic lead pollution recorded in Greenland ice cores and economic dynamics during the Pax Romana (27 BC–180 AD), a period of relative political, institutional and technological stability in the Early Roman Empire. Our findings reveal that approximately one-fourth of the annual variability in lead pollution during this period can be explained by summer temperatures, silver coin output, and warfare – three factors plausibly linked to fluctuations of the Empire’s economy. Using annual time-series analysis, we integrate high-resolution paleoclimatic, paleoenvironmental, and cliometric data to investigate short-run economic dynamics in an ancient society. Specifically, our results suggest that warmer summers, which likely boosted agricultural yields, were positively associated with increased economic activity. In contrast, higher production of silver coins and periods of warfare were associated with lower levels of lead emissions, suggesting that these factors were associated with periods of weaker aggregate economic activity. Our analysis also provides formal statistical support for the hypothesis that historical lead pollution levels contain valuable information about economic activity in ancient Europe, thereby corroborating a highly debated claim in the literature.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101765.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了格陵兰冰芯中记录的人为铅污染与罗马和平时期（公元前27年至公元180年）经济动态之间的关系，这一时期是早期罗马帝国政治、制度和技术相对稳定的阶段。研究发现，该时期铅污染年际变异的约四分之一可由夏季温度、银币产量及战争活动解释，这三者与帝国经济的波动存在合理关联。通过年度时间序列分析，我们整合了高分辨率古气候、古环境及计量历史数据，以探究古代社会的短期经济动态。具体而言，研究结果表明，较为温暖的夏季可能促进农业收成，并与经济活动的增加呈正相关。相反，银币产量的增加及战争时期则与铅排放水平下降相关，暗示这些因素与总体经济活动减弱时期相关联。我们的分析还为历史铅污染水平蕴含古代欧洲经济活动有价值信息这一假说提供了正式的统计支持，从而印证了文献中一个备受争议的观点。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101765.title: Economic dynamics of the Early Roman Empire: Insights from lead pollution, coinage, weather, and war
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101765.title_zh: 早期罗马帝国的经济动态：来自铅污染、铸币、天气与战争的洞见

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101766.abstract: We construct estimates of quarterly GDP (and GNP) for Ireland from 1950, linking to official data from 1995 onward, using a novel factor-augmented Chow-Lin interpolation. Compared to the only alternative series (OECD, 2025), our estimates exploit the variation in a large number of official quarterly economic data and are broadly consistent with contemporary reports. Our series permits a more granular identification of turning points in the Irish economy than was previously possible. The frequency and magnitude of quarterly contractions in the 1950s and 1980s dwarfed those of other decades resulting in lower average growth rates. In contrast, the 1990s are confirmed as a decisive period of higher growth and rapid convergence.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101766.abstract_zh: 我们构建了自1950年起爱尔兰季度GDP（及GNP）的估算序列，并与1995年后的官方数据相衔接，采用了一种新颖的因子增强型Chow-Lin插值方法。与唯一的替代序列（OECD，2025）相比，我们的估算充分利用了大量官方季度经济数据的变动信息，且与当代报告大体一致。该序列使我们能够比以往更细致地识别爱尔兰经济的转折点。1950年代和1980年代的季度收缩频率及幅度远超其他年代，导致平均增长率较低。相比之下，1990年代被确认为增长加快和快速趋同的决定性时期。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101766.title: Quarterly GDP for Ireland since 1950

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101767.abstract: Did Germany’s industrial rise begin with its water mills? This study examines how water mills shaped early industrial development in Prussia using historical county-level census data. I show that water-powered proto-industrialization fostered skilled artisanal human capital by the mid-nineteenth century. Unlike wind or animal-powered mills, water mills supported diverse industries, driving technological spillovers and early industrialization. Counties with more water mills saw faster population growth, though this effect declined with the adoption of coal and steam. These findings underscore water power’s role in Germany’s industrial rise, and suggest that water-driven industrialization was a broader European phenomenon, not unique to Britain.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101767.abstract_zh: 德国的工业崛起是否始于其水力磨坊？本研究利用历史县级人口普查数据，探讨了水力磨坊如何塑造普鲁士早期工业发展。我证明，至十九世纪中叶，以水为动力的原始工业化促进了熟练手工业人力资本的形成。与风力或畜力磨坊不同，水力磨坊支撑了多样化的产业，推动了技术溢出与早期工业化。拥有更多水力磨坊的县经历了更快的人口增长，尽管这一效应随着煤炭和蒸汽的采用而减弱。这些发现强调了水力在德国工业崛起中的作用，并表明水驱动的工业化是更广泛的欧洲现象，并非英国独有。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101767.title: Water mills and human capital accumulation in industrializing Prussia
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101767.title_zh: 水磨与工业化时期普鲁士的人力资本积累

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101768.abstract: How did epidemic mortality affect housing wealth in the pre-industrial period? Using new data on house ownership and variation in street-level mortality in seventeenth-century Leiden, we show that although epidemic mortality targeted poor streets where residents were typically tenants and not owners, these outbreaks still increased the turnover of houses. Ordinarily, turnover was higher in owner-occupied housing sectors, while epidemics created more turnover for low-value houses consolidated in the hands of wealthy investors. In combination with a lack of house price adjustments due to rapid demographic recovery after epidemics, this meant that houses were passed between long-standing owners with similar housing wealth profiles. As a result, epidemics did not affect aggregate housing wealth inequality.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101768.abstract_zh: 流行病死亡率如何影响前工业化时期的住房财富？利用关于房屋所有权的新数据以及十七世纪莱顿街道层面死亡率的变异，我们表明，尽管流行病死亡率主要针对贫困街道，那里的居民通常是租户而非业主，但这些疫情仍然增加了房屋的流转率。通常情况下，业主自住住房部门的流转率较高，而疫情则为集中在富裕投资者手中的低价值房屋带来了更多流转。结合疫情后人口迅速恢复导致房价缺乏调整的情况，这意味着房屋在具有相似住房财富特征的老业主之间传递。因此，疫情并未影响总体住房财富不平等。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101768.title: Epidemic mortality and redistribution of housing wealth in Leiden, 1632–1668
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101768.title_zh: 1632–1668年莱顿流行病死亡率与住房财富再分配

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101769.abstract: This study reassesses Peru’s inflation dynamics during the Pacific War by incorporating alternative exchange rate methodologies that account for the widespread use of paper currency (sol en billete) in domestic transactions. Using archival sources from Lima’s principal newspapers and government documents, combined with price series from Seminario (2016) and Boloña (1993), this analysis reveals that conventional silver-based exchange rate assumptions systematically underestimated wartime inflation. The recalibrated methodology shows inflation peaking at nearly 180 percent during the war’s most intense phase, contrasting dramatically with previous silver-based estimates suggesting price stability. Contemporary currency spread evidence demonstrates the sol en billete depreciating over 1000 percent relative to silver currency between 1879–1880, validating the magnitude of monetary instability captured in our reconstruction. These findings position the Pacific War as one of Peru’s most severe inflationary episodes, averaging over 30 percent annually during the conflict period, rather than the mild deflation suggested by conventional approaches. This historical perspective reveals Peru’s modern era (1997–2025) as its longest period of monetary stability in over three centuries. The corrected estimates align with broader patterns of wartime monetary instability across Latin America while demonstrating how exchange rate methodology choices fundamentally alter historical narratives. This framework offers broader applicability for reassessing historical inflation in dual-currency environments during institutional transitions.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101769.abstract_zh: 本研究通过纳入替代性汇率方法，重新评估了太平洋战争期间秘鲁的通胀动态，这些方法考虑了纸币（索尔纸币）在国内交易中的广泛使用。利用利马主要报纸和政府文件的档案资料，并结合Seminario（2016）和Boloña（1993）的价格序列，本分析揭示，基于白银的传统汇率假设系统性地低估了战时通胀。重新校准的方法显示，在战争最激烈阶段，通胀率峰值接近180%，与先前基于白银的估计所暗示的价格稳定形成鲜明对比。当代货币价差证据表明，1879年至1880年间，索尔纸币相对于白银货币贬值超过1000%，验证了本重建所捕捉的货币不稳定程度的规模。这些发现将太平洋战争定位为秘鲁最严重的通胀事件之一，战争期间年均通胀率超过30%，而非传统方法所暗示的温和通缩。这一历史视角揭示，秘鲁现代时期（1997—2025年）是其三个多世纪以来最长的货币稳定期。修正后的估计与拉丁美洲战时货币不稳定的更广泛模式相一致，同时展示了汇率方法选择如何从根本上改变历史叙事。该框架为在制度转型期间重新评估双货币环境中的历史通胀提供了更广泛的适用性。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101769.title: The price of war: Recalculating inflation in Peru during the Pacific War era
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101769.title_zh: 战争的成本：重新计算太平洋战争时期秘鲁的通货膨胀

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101770.abstract: An ongoing debate among economists concerns the extent to which increasing resource scarcity leads to more clearly defined individual property rights, when there exist significant political pressures that oppose the redistributive aspect of property right redefinition. This paper documents the role of politics in shaping the creation of individual property rights within the context of appropriative water law in early 20th century California, finding evidence of both party ideology and interest group influence in establishing a new system for administering appropriative water rights.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101770.abstract_zh: 经济学家们持续争论的一个议题是，在存在显著政治压力反对产权重新定义再分配方面的情况下，资源稀缺性增加在多大程度上会导致更明确的个人产权界定。本文以20世纪初加利福尼亚州的水资源占用法为背景，记录了政治在塑造个人产权创建过程中的作用，发现政党意识形态和利益集团影响在建立新的占用性水权管理体系方面均有体现。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101770.title: Politics and institutional change: The Water Commission Act of 1913
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101770.title_zh: 政治与制度变迁：1913年《水务委员会法案》

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101771.abstract: Can history explain some of the variation in electric heating usage across American homes today? Assembling a new county panel, we find that areas with more dwellings built before WWII are slower at adopting electric heating in later decades. This is due to old buildings being retrofitted more slowly and new buildings being less likely to have electric heating. We propose two ways to distinguish between persistence and path dependence as mechanisms, and show that our results largely reflect the latter. We document how various factors like natural disasters and government intervention can weaken the hold of history.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101771.abstract_zh: 历史能否解释当今美国家庭电采暖使用差异的部分原因？通过构建新的县级面板数据，我们发现二战前建造的住宅较多的地区，在后续几十年中采用电采暖的速度较慢。这归因于老旧建筑改造进程缓慢，以及新建建筑采用电采暖的可能性较低。我们提出两种方法来区分持续性与路径依赖作为机制，并表明我们的结果在很大程度上反映了后者。我们记录了自然灾害和政府干预等多种因素如何削弱历史的影响。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101771.title: Locked in the past: Old housing and the adoption of electric heating
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101771.title_zh: 困于过去：老旧住房与电采暖的采用

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101772.abstract: In 1900, thousands of people in England were poisoned by arsenic. The source was beer contaminated by tainted sugar. This paper examines how the poisoning affected birth rates in the affected areas, using an event study difference-in-difference design. The results show that the arsenic-in-beer epidemic caused a 10% drop in births in 1901, but the effect was short-lived. After about 28 weeks, birth rates returned to pre-epidemic levels. Evidence from the timing of the effect and a range of alternative mechanisms is most consistent with the epidemic reducing conceptions or early pregnancies, rather than operating through economic disruption or later gestational harm.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101772.abstract_zh: 1900年，英格兰数千人因砷中毒而受害，其源头为被污染糖所掺杂的啤酒。本文采用事件研究双重差分设计，探讨了此次中毒事件对受影响地区出生率的影响。结果显示，1901年啤酒砷中毒疫情导致出生率下降10%，但此效应短暂，约28周后，出生率恢复至疫情前水平。基于效应时间点及一系列替代机制的证据，最符合的解释是疫情减少了受孕或早期妊娠，而非通过经济干扰或妊娠后期伤害发挥作用。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101772.title: Arsenic and fertility: Evidence from the 1900 English beer-poisoning epidemic
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101772.title_zh: 砷与生育力：来自1900年英国啤酒中毒流行病的证据

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101773.abstract: This paper examines how acute pollution exposure in historical London (1892–1919) affected child health. I proxy acute, extreme pollution exposure using daily data on fog events, which reflect meteorological conditions where pollution emitted in the city was not dispersed across space leading to a sharp spike in pollution. I also use rich individual-level data on child health drawn from the Queen Charlotte Hospital, a maternity hospital, and the Foundling Hospital, an orphanage. I find no effect of pollution exposure at birth on birth or growth outcomes or on upper respiratory morbidity. However, exposure on the day of birth had persistent effects on health, increasing mortality risk in childhood and adolescence from respiratory diseases and raising incidence, prevalence and sickness duration of influenza and measles. There was no persistent effect of in utero and postnatal pollution exposures. These mixed results show that extreme pollution at birth had lasting impacts on specific, but also limited, dimensions of child health.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101773.abstract_zh: 本文研究了历史时期伦敦（1892-1919年）急性污染暴露对儿童健康的影响。我利用每日雾天事件数据作为急性极端污染暴露的代理变量——这些雾天反映了城市排放的污染物因无法扩散而导致污染浓度急剧飙升的气象条件。同时，我采用来自夏洛特女王医院（一家妇产医院）和弃婴医院（一家孤儿院）的丰富个体层面儿童健康数据。研究发现，出生时的污染暴露对出生结局、生长发育指标或上呼吸道疾病发病率无显著影响。然而，出生当日的污染暴露对健康产生了持续性影响：它增加了儿童期及青少年期因呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡风险，并提高了流感与麻疹的发病率、患病率及病程持续时间。宫内暴露和产后暴露则未发现持续性影响。这些混合结果表明，出生时的极端污染暴露对儿童健康的特定维度（但范围有限）产生了持久影响。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101773.title: Born in Smog: Immediate and persistent health consequences of acute air pollution exposure in historical London, 1892–1919
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101773.title_zh: 雾霾中诞生：1892-1919年伦敦历史急性空气污染暴露的即时与持续健康后果

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101774.abstract: The Panic of 1825 was a significant crisis in British financial history. We document how this crisis spread from London banks to England’s real economy. England’s correspondent banking network propagated trouble in sovereign debt markets to small banks outside of London and ultimately to non-financial firms. Using exogenous variation in district-level exposure to the crisis, we show that bank failures led to a substantial number of bankruptcies among non-financial firms. We discuss two potential mechanisms by which the financial system affected the real economy: a fall in aggregate demand and a credit supply shock.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101774.abstract_zh: 1825年恐慌是英国金融史上一次重大危机。本文记录了这场危机如何从伦敦银行蔓延至英格兰实体经济。英格兰的代理银行网络将主权债务市场的困境传导至伦敦以外的小型银行，并最终波及非金融企业。利用各地区危机暴露程度的外生差异，我们证明银行倒闭导致非金融企业破产数量大幅增加。本文探讨了金融体系影响实体经济的两种潜在机制：总需求下降与信贷供给冲击。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101774.title: Country banks and the Panic of 1825

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101775.abstract: I examine the effect of a woman-friendly occupation on employment by exploring a unique historical setting -- the postmaster occupation during the early twentieth-century United States. Unlike many occupations that established practices to prevent married women from entering, postmasters were open to married women and offered flexible work arrangements and equal pay. With a novel dataset on postmaster appointments and census linking, I show that postmasters attracted qualified women who were not gainfully employed previously. However, the postmaster occupation offered women few benefits beyond the appointed term. Taking advantage of the fact that postmasters were presidential appointees and were rarely re-appointed after the party of the president changed, I compare the 1940 outcomes of women appointed just before and after the 1933 presidential transition in a regression discontinuity (RD) design. The RD estimates suggest that women experienced a 26.7 percentage points reduction in gainful employment after finishing their postmaster term. The negative employment effect is unique to women and does not apply to men appointed under the same circumstances. In addition, I show that women postmasters were not more likely to be employed than their women neighbors who had never been postmasters, despite their work experience. The lack of benefits for women's future employment is in part explained by state-level discrimination against married women working and the severity of the Great Depression.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101775.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察20世纪初美国邮政局长这一独特的历史职业背景，探究了女性友好型职业对就业的影响。与许多通过制度性规定阻止已婚女性进入的职业不同，邮政局长职位对已婚女性开放，并提供灵活的工作安排与同工同酬。基于邮政局长任命记录与人口普查关联数据构建的新数据集，本研究发现：邮政局长职位吸引了此前未从事有酬工作的合格女性。然而，该职业除任期内的权益外，几乎未为女性提供长期职业发展优势。利用邮政局长由总统任命、且总统所属政党更迭后极少获得连任的制度特征，本文采用断点回归设计（RD），比较了1933年总统权力交接前后被任命的女性在1940年的就业状况。断点回归估计表明，女性在结束邮政局长任期后，有酬就业率下降26.7个百分点。这一负面就业效应仅存在于女性群体，在相同条件下任命的男性并未出现类似现象。此外，研究显示，尽管拥有工作经验，女性邮政局长与其从未担任该职位的女性邻居相比，就业概率并未更高。女性未来就业缺乏职业红利的部分原因，可归因于各州对已婚女性就业的歧视政策以及大萧条时期的严重经济冲击。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101775.title: The effect of a woman-friendly occupation on employment: U.S. postmasters before World War II
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101775.title_zh: 女性友好职业对就业的影响：二战前美国邮政局长

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101776.abstract: How reliable is historical microdata? Understanding historical labor force participation is crucial for assessing long-term trends in economic development and intergenerational mobility. Most existing historical studies are, however, limited to men, and little is known about how reliable quantitative historical sources are when studying labor market outcomes for women. This paper documents that the measurement of women’s economic activity in the 1910 Norwegian population census had a high level of consistency. There is extensive discussion of measurement issues in historical census reports, micro data can reproduce historical census tables with a high degree of accuracy, and other contemporary reports such as industrial censuses and tax statistics confirm the results found in the census. In addition, a double-enumeration feature of the Norwegian census is leveraged to assess consistency between enumerators, finding no indication that precision in the occupational classification of women is any lower than for men. Some potential sources of downward bias are found in the historical census microdata set provided by IPUMS. Based on the results in this paper, historical census data appears well suited to study economic activity using modern econometric methods, for women as well as men. A slight upward revision of the 39% female labor force participation in Norway in 1910 might be in order.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101776.abstract_zh: 历史微观数据的可靠性如何？理解历史劳动力参与率对于评估经济发展和代际流动的长期趋势至关重要。然而，现有的大多数历史研究仅限于男性，关于定量历史资料在研究女性劳动力市场结果时的可靠性知之甚少。本文记录了1910年挪威人口普查中女性经济活动测量的高度一致性。历史普查报告中对测量问题有广泛讨论，微观数据能够高度准确地重现历史普查表格，而其他当代报告如工业普查和税收统计也证实了普查中的结果。此外，利用挪威普查的双重登记特性来评估普查员之间的一致性，未发现女性职业分类的精确度低于男性的迹象。在IPUMS提供的历史普查微观数据集中发现了一些潜在的下行偏差来源。基于本文的结果，历史普查数据似乎非常适合使用现代计量经济学方法研究经济活动，无论是对女性还是男性。对1910年挪威39%的女性劳动力参与率进行轻微上调可能是合适的。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101776.title: Female labor force participation in historical census microdata
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101776.title_zh: 历史人口普查微观数据中的女性劳动力参与

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101784.abstract: We show how probate inventories can be used to measure the seasonal pattern of grain stocks and hence provide direct information on both intra-year and inter-year storage (“carryover”). The correct procedure to quantify total carryover is a ratio-of-means statistic that consistently estimates the appropriate weighted average of individual carryover decisions. Using an existing data base of inventories, we show that the seasonal pattern is plausible, robust to alternative specifications and consistent with an alternative way of estimating carryover. We find that average carryover in the period 1600-1750 was very low in Kent and virtually zero in Cornwall.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101784.abstract_zh: 我们展示了如何利用遗嘱认证清单来衡量谷物库存的季节性模式，从而直接提供年内和跨年储存（“结转”）的信息。量化总结转的正确方法是采用均值比统计量，该统计量能一致地估计个体结转决策的适当加权平均值。利用现有的清单数据库，我们表明季节性模式是合理的，对替代规格具有稳健性，并与估算结转的另一种方法相一致。我们发现，在1600年至1750年间，肯特郡的平均结转量非常低，而康沃尔郡几乎为零。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101784.title: Estimating grain storage with probate inventories: Kent and Cornwall, 1600-1750
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101784.title_zh: 利用遗嘱清单估算粮食储存量：肯特郡与康沃尔郡，1600-1750年

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101785.abstract: The gabelle salt tax system was a cornerstone of the fiscal apparatus of the early modern French state. This article introduces a novel historical geographic information system (GIS) of this institution’s spatial organization as of the seventeenth century, drawing on an original 1665 manuscript map collection: Sanson’s Atlas des gabelles. Beyond presenting the dataset and documenting its construction methodology, we provide a detailed account of the functioning of the gabelle, situate the French case in comparative perspective, and illustrate how the availability of this fine-grained dataset expands the possibilities of empirical research in economic history, historical demography, and historical political economy of early modern France.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101785.abstract_zh: 盐税制度（gabelle）是近代早期法国国家财政架构的基石。本文基于1665年手稿地图集——桑松的《盐税图志》，引入了一套关于该制度在十七世纪空间组织的新历史地理信息系统（GIS）。除展示数据集并记录其构建方法外，我们详细阐述了盐税制度的运作机制，将法国案例置于比较视角中，并说明这一精细数据集的可用性如何拓展了经济史、历史人口学及近代早期法国历史政治经济学领域的实证研究可能性。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101785.title: Mapping the Grandes Gabelles in early modern France
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101785.title_zh: 绘制近代早期法国大盐仓分布图

10.1016/j.ejpoleco.2024.102508.abstract: Firms and policy makers are increasingly looking at friend-shoring to make supply chains less vulnerable to geopolitical tensions. We test whether these considerations are shaping FDI flows, using investment-level data on almost 300,000 instances of greenfield FDI between 2003 and 2022. Estimates from a gravity model, which controls for standard push and pull factors, show an economically significant role for geopolitical alignment in driving the geographical footprint of bilateral investments. This result is robust to the inclusion of standard bilateral drivers of FDI—such as geographic distance and trade flows—and the strength of the effect has increased since 2018, with the resurgence of trade tensions between the U
10.1016/j.ejpoleco.2024.102508.abstract_zh: 企业和政策制定者日益关注“友岸外包”，以降低供应链在地缘政治紧张局势中的脆弱性。我们利用2003年至2022年间近30万例绿地外商直接投资（FDI）的项目层面数据，检验这些考量是否正在影响FDI流动。基于引力模型的估计（该模型控制了标准的推拉因素）表明，地缘政治一致性在驱动双边投资地理布局方面具有显著的经济重要性。这一结果在纳入标准的双边FDI驱动因素（如地理距离和贸易流量）后依然稳健，且自2018年中美贸易紧张局势再度升级以来，该效应的强度有所增强。
10.1016/j.ejpoleco.2024.102508.title: Investing in Friends: The Role of Geopolitical Alignment in FDI Flows
10.1016/j.ejpoleco.2024.102508.title_zh: 投资于朋友：地缘政治联盟在外国直接投资流动中的作用

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2021.103696.abstract: Abstract Short abstractLand is back. The increase in wealth in the second half of 20th century arose from housing and land. It should be taxed. We introduce land and housing structures in Judd’s standard setup: first best optimal taxation is achieved with a property tax on land and requires no tax on capital. With positive taxes on housing rents, a first best is still possible but with subsidies to rental housing investments, and either with differential land tax rates or with a tax on imputed rents. It can be taxed. Even absent land taxes, one can tax it indirectly and reach a Ramsey-second best still with no tax on capital and positive housing rent taxes in the steady-state. This result extends to the dynamics under restrictions on parameters. Longer abstract Land is back. The increase in wealth-to-income ratios in the second half of 20th century has recently received much attention with recommendations of uniform wealth taxation. It however appears that, in many major Western countries analyzed, housing and specifically its land component are responsible for the trends of higher wealth relative to income. It should be taxed. To analyze optimal taxation, we introduce land and housing structures in Judd’s standard setup. We find that the first best is achieved with a positive property tax on land and no tax on capital, in the steady-state and on a path converging to it. Taxing housing rents is not optimal, even with additional taxes on imputed rents. With positive taxes on housing rents, a first best is still possible but with subsidies to rental housing investments and either with differential land tax rates or with a tax on imputed rents. From the two distortions introduced by the tax on rent, the one on land use and the other on the dynamic of structures, the simulation reveals that the latter is much more critical quantitatively. The upshot is that a rent tax supplemented by a structure subsidy does almost as well as a land tax in improving social welfare.
