These results are discussed with respect to the traditional Henry George (1879) tax scheme and we provide a formula for taxing land which accounts for the depreciation of elastic housing structures. It can be taxed. Even absent land taxes, one can tax it indirectly and reach a Ramsey-second best still with no tax on capital and positive housing rent taxes in the steady-state. This result extends to the dynamics under restrictions on parameters. For that, we use the so called implementability condition in Atkeson et al. (1999). Besides, following Straub and Werning (2020) approach of convergence of dynamic multipliers, we show that Judd’s proposition of no second-best capital taxation at the limit steady-state extends, in the presence of land, to a larger range of parameters.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2021.103696.abstract_zh:
短摘要：土地回归了。20世纪下半叶财富的增长源于住房和土地。应对其征税。我们在Judd的标准框架中引入土地和住房结构：最优第一优税收可通过征收土地财产税实现，且无需对资本征税。若对住房租金征税，仍可实现第一优，但需对租赁住房投资给予补贴，并辅以差别化土地税率或对估算租金征税。土地可被征税。即便没有土地税，也可间接对其征税，并在稳态下达到拉姆齐第二优，仍无需对资本征税，但需对住房租金征税。此结果在参数限制下可扩展至动态情形。

长摘要：土地回归了。20世纪下半叶财富收入比的上升近期受到广泛关注，并伴随统一财富税的建议。然而，在许多被分析的主要西方国家中，住房及其土地组成部分是财富相对收入上升趋势的主要原因。应对其征税。为分析最优税收，我们在Judd的标准框架中引入土地和住房结构。我们发现，在稳态及向其收敛的路径上，第一优可通过征收正的土地财产税且不对资本征税来实现。对住房租金征税并非最优，即使附加对估算租金的税收也是如此。若对住房租金征税，仍可实现第一优，但需对租赁住房投资给予补贴，并辅以差别化土地税率或对估算租金征税。租金税引入的两种扭曲——一种涉及土地利用，另一种涉及结构动态——模拟显示后者在数量上更为关键。结论是，租金税辅以结构补贴在改善社会福利方面几乎与土地税效果相当。这些结果与传统的亨利·乔治（1879）税收方案进行了讨论，我们提供了一个考虑弹性住房结构折旧的土地征税公式。土地可被征税。即便没有土地税，也可间接对其征税，并在稳态下达到拉姆齐第二优，仍无需对资本征税，但需对住房租金征税。此结果在参数限制下可扩展至动态情形。为此，我们使用了Atkeson等人（1999）的可实施性条件。此外，遵循Straub和Werning（2020）关于动态乘数收敛的方法，我们表明，在存在土地的情况下，Judd关于极限稳态下无第二优资本税的命题可扩展至更广泛的参数范围。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2021.103696.title: Land is back, it should be taxed, it can be taxed
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2021.103696.title_zh: 土地回归：应当征税，且能够征税

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2025.105256.abstract: Drawing on classical insights from mechanism design, we show that ex post efficient mechanisms induce agents to make efficient ex ante investment choices if and only if they are strategy-proof. For mechanisms that fail to be exactly strategy-proof or efficient, we derive a correspondence between the degree of failure of strategy-proofness or efficiency and the degree of failure to induce efficient investment. Our results extend to settings with uncertainty. Additionally, our results imply both that the worker-optimal stable mechanism incentivizes workers to make efficient human capital investments before entering the labor market, and that uniform-price and double auctions induce approximately efficient investment in large markets.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2025.105256.abstract_zh: 借鉴机制设计的经典洞见，我们证明，事后有效机制能诱导代理人做出事前有效投资选择，当且仅当这些机制是策略-proof的。对于不完全策略-proof或效率不足的机制，我们推导出策略-proof性或效率缺失程度与诱导有效投资缺失程度之间的对应关系。我们的结果扩展至不确定性环境。此外，我们的发现还意味着，工人最优稳定机制激励工人在进入劳动力市场前进行有效的人力资本投资，而统一价格拍卖和双向拍卖在大市场中诱导近似有效的投资。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2025.105256.title: Strategy-proofness, investment efficiency, and marginal returns: An equivalence
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2025.105256.title_zh: 策略证明性、投资效率与边际回报：一个等价关系

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105298.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between energy shocks, monetary policy responses, and inflation inequality, defined as the gap between consumer price inflation faced by households at the bottom and at the top of the expenditure distribution, arising from differences in consumption baskets. We use a VAR-based framework to quantify the impact of energy shocks on inflation inequality and to document their contribution to fluctuations in inflation differentials over time. To interpret the empirical evidence, we develop a two-agent general equilibrium model that sheds light on the underlying mechanisms. We show that the impact of energy shocks on inflation inequality intensifies when monetary policy reacts more forcefully to inflation. By estimating the model for the Italian economy, we assess the joint roles of energy shocks and monetary policy in driving the record level of inflation inequality observed in 2022, thereby providing empirical support for the mechanisms highlighted in the theoretical model.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105298.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了能源冲击、货币政策响应与通胀不平等之间的关系，其中通胀不平等定义为因消费篮子差异而导致的支出分布底层与顶层家庭所面临的消费者价格通胀之间的差距。我们采用基于VAR的框架来量化能源冲击对通胀不平等的影响，并记录其对通胀差异随时间波动的贡献。为解释实证证据，我们构建了一个双主体一般均衡模型，以揭示潜在机制。研究表明，当货币政策对通胀反应更为强烈时，能源冲击对通胀不平等的影响会加剧。通过针对意大利经济估计该模型，我们评估了能源冲击与货币政策在推动2022年观察到的创纪录通胀不平等水平中的共同作用，从而为理论模型所强调的机制提供了实证支持。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105298.title: Inflation is not equal for all: The heterogeneous effects of energy shocks
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105298.title_zh: 通胀并非人人平等：能源冲击的异质性效应

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105332.abstract: A macroeconomic setting characterized by higher inflation represents an opportunity to increase a central bank’s inflation target, which can mitigate the risk of future liquidity traps. We show that the gains generated by this strategy are not one-to-one: Because a higher inflation target leads to a steeper Phillips curve, to effectively get, for instance, 2 percentage points of extra room away from the zero lower bound on the interest rate, policymakers need to raise their inflation target from 2% to 5%. Taking this mechanism into consideration changes the optimal inflation target. When the natural rate is near zero, the optimal inflation target is 1 percentage point higher than the optimal target obtained by conventional, earlier, calculations.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105332.abstract_zh: 以较高通胀为特征的宏观经济环境，为中央银行提高通胀目标提供了契机，这有助于缓解未来流动性陷阱的风险。我们证明，这一策略带来的收益并非一一对应：由于更高的通胀目标导致菲利普斯曲线更为陡峭，要有效获得，例如，利率零下限之外额外2个百分点的空间，政策制定者需将通胀目标从2%上调至5%。考虑这一机制会改变最优通胀目标。当自然利率接近零时，最优通胀目标比传统早期计算所得的最优目标高出1个百分点。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105332.title: Raising the inflation target: What are the effective gains in policy room?
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105332.title_zh: 提高通胀目标：政策空间的有效增益是什么？

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105333.abstract: We explore the effect of information about the pro-sociality of group members on public good contributions. We first provide a theoretical framework, based on psychological game theory, to model the influence of information about pro-sociality on first and second-order beliefs and thereby contributions. We subsequently report the results of three experiments in which we use social value orientation (SVO) as a measure of pro-sociality. We compare: (i) four networks of information: complete, star, pair and empty, and (ii) two information framings: identifying pro-socials versus pro-selfs. Our findings indicate that SVO information significantly boosts contributions, with enhancements ranging from 50% to 70% based on the group’s information structure. Regarding framing effects, we find evidence that emphasizing pro-social traits leads to higher contributions than emphasizing pro-self traits, though this effect emerges primarily after repeated interactions.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105333.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了关于群体成员亲社会性信息对公共品贡献的影响。首先，我们基于心理博弈论构建了一个理论框架，用以模拟亲社会性信息对一阶和二阶信念及其进而对贡献的影响。随后，我们报告了三项实验的结果，其中我们采用社会价值取向（SVO）作为亲社会性的衡量指标。我们比较了：（i）四种信息网络：完全、星形、配对和空网络，以及（ii）两种信息框架：识别亲社会者与识别亲自我者。我们的研究结果表明，SVO信息显著提升了贡献水平，增幅根据群体的信息结构不同而介于50%至70%之间。关于框架效应，我们发现强调亲社会特质比强调亲自我特质更能促进贡献，尽管这一效应主要在重复互动后显现。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105333.title: Are my team members pro-social? Information about social value orientation influences cooperation in public good games
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105333.title_zh: 我的团队成员是亲社会的吗？社会价值取向信息影响公共品博弈中的合作

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105334.abstract: Parents play a pivotal role in shaping opportunities and outcomes for their children. This paper provides unique evidence on parents’ willingness to give their children an advantage. I report from a large-scale lab-in-the-field experiment involving 895 pairs of parents and their adolescent children, which is linked to high quality administrative data. In a situation with equal opportunities, parents are given the opportunity to increase the likelihood of their child winning in a competition. I find that a substantial share of parents prioritizes their own child’s success at the expense of another child’s opportunity to succeed. A considerable share of parents help their child because they expect another to do the same, in which case helping ensures a level playing field. However, I also find evidence suggestive of parents holding self-serving beliefs about the helping decision of other parents. Finally, I provide evidence of the helping decision in the experimental situation being associated with children with below median grades in mathematics doing particularly well at school in situations where parents can directly influence their grade. Taken together, the paper provides the first set of systematic evidence on parents’ willingness to give their own children an advantage, and the findings provide new insights on the role of parents in human capital accumulation.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105334.abstract_zh: 父母在塑造子女的机会与成就方面扮演着关键角色。本文提供了关于父母愿意给予子女优势的独特证据。我报告了一项涉及895对父母及其青少年子女的大规模实地实验室实验结果，该实验与高质量的行政数据相关联。在机会均等的情境下，父母有机会增加其子女在竞争中获胜的可能性。我发现，相当一部分父母优先考虑自己子女的成功，而牺牲其他孩子成功的机会。相当多的父母帮助自己的孩子，是因为他们预期他人也会这样做，在这种情况下，帮助确保了公平的竞争环境。然而，我也发现了暗示父母对其他父母帮助决策持有自利信念的证据。最后，我提供的证据表明，在实验情境中的帮助决策与数学成绩低于中位数的儿童在父母能直接影响其成绩的情况下，在学校表现尤为出色相关联。总体而言，本文提供了关于父母愿意给予自己子女优势的首套系统性证据，这些发现为理解父母在人力资本积累中的作用提供了新的见解。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105334.title: Unleveling the playing field? — Experimental evidence on parents’ willingness to give their children an advantage
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105334.title_zh: 拉平竞技场？——父母给予子女优势意愿的实验证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105339.abstract: We investigate the macroeconomic effects of commodity price uncertainty by explicitly accounting for comovement across commodity markets. Using quarterly realized volatilities of major agricultural, metals, and energy commodity prices, we estimate a hierarchical dynamic factor model that decomposes uncertainty into a global component, common to all commodities, and group-specific components capturing sectoral uncertainty. The estimated uncertainty factors are then embedded into country-specific Structural VAR models to assess the dynamic macroeconomic responses to uncertainty shocks through impulse response functions. We focus in particular on business investment and exports across a panel of advanced and emerging economies. Our results show that a global commodity price uncertainty shock generates sizable and persistent recessionary effects on investment and trade worldwide. Benchmark comparisons indicate that this global commodity uncertainty shock produces larger and more persistent macroeconomic contractions than standard uncertainty measures. Importantly, we show that, once global uncertainty is accounted for, commodity-specific uncertainty shocks exhibit differentiated effects. Increases in agricultural and metals price uncertainty lead to contractionary outcomes, whereas energy-specific uncertainty shocks generate positive short-run responses in investment and exports. These findings provide new empirical evidence that oil price uncertainty can be expansionary when it reflects sector-specific dynamics rather than global demand uncertainty. Overall, our framework offers a novel way to disentangle “bad” and “good” commodity price uncertainty.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105339.abstract_zh: 我们通过明确考虑大宗商品市场间的联动性，研究大宗商品价格不确定性的宏观经济效应。利用主要农产品、金属和能源大宗商品价格的季度已实现波动率，我们估计了一个层级动态因子模型，将不确定性分解为所有大宗商品共有的全球成分，以及捕捉部门性不确定性的组别特定成分。随后，将估计出的不确定性因子嵌入到国家特定的结构向量自回归模型中，通过脉冲响应函数评估不确定性冲击的动态宏观经济反应。我们特别关注一组发达经济体和新兴经济体中企业投资与出口的表现。结果显示，全球大宗商品价格不确定性冲击在全球范围内对投资和贸易产生了显著且持久的衰退效应。基准比较表明，这种全球大宗商品不确定性冲击比标准不确定性度量引发了更大且更持久的宏观经济收缩。重要的是，我们表明，一旦考虑全球不确定性，大宗商品特定不确定性冲击会表现出差异化效应。农产品和金属价格不确定性的上升导致收缩性结果，而能源特定不确定性冲击则在短期内对投资和出口产生正向反应。这些发现提供了新的经验证据，表明当油价不确定性反映的是部门特定动态而非全球需求不确定性时，其可能具有扩张性。总体而言，我们的框架提供了一种新颖的方法来区分“坏”与“好”的大宗商品价格不确定性。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105339.title: Commodity price uncertainty comovement: Does it matter for global economic growth?
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105339.title_zh: 大宗商品价格不确定性的联动性：对全球经济增长重要吗？

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105340.abstract: This paper documents two strategies used to circumvent trade sanctions imposed on Russia following its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. The first involves transshipment through countries that do not participate in the sanctions regime. The second—simple yet largely undocumented—entails goods nominally shipped to neighbouring countries via Russia but failing to reach their declared final destination. Focusing on Armenia, Kazakhstan, and the Kyrgyz Republic, we show that during 2022–23 the two strategies offset roughly one third of the decline in European exports to Russia prompted by product-specific trade sanctions. We further find that sanctions led to only a modest increase in the unit values of products exported to Russia by both sanctioning and non-sanctioning economies.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105340.abstract_zh: 本文记录了两种规避2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后所施加贸易制裁的策略。第一种涉及通过未参与制裁制度的国家进行转运。第二种——简单但鲜有记录——是指货物名义上经由俄罗斯运往邻国，却未能抵达其申报的最终目的地。聚焦于亚美尼亚、哈萨克斯坦和吉尔吉斯共和国，我们表明在2022至2023年间，这两种策略抵消了因产品特定贸易制裁而导致的欧洲对俄出口下降约三分之一。我们进一步发现，制裁仅使制裁国与非制裁经济体对俄出口产品的单位价值出现温和增长。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105340.title: The Eurasian roundabout: Trade flows into Russia through the Caucasus and Central Asia
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105340.title_zh: 欧亚环岛：经由高加索和中亚流入俄罗斯的贸易流

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105348.abstract: This paper studies occupational mobility over the business cycle. We divide occupations into two broad groups, "attractive" and "nonattractive," where we label an occupation attractive if the total net inflow into this occupation through job-to-job transition is positive or its median annual wage is above the median of the population. We measure total net inflows into both occupation groups. We measure these inflows separately for job-to-job (EE) transitions and transitions from unemployment to employment (UE). We find net inflow from nonattractive to attractive occupations through EE transitions slows during recessions. The relative net inflow through UE transitions has a similar cyclicality. This finding suggests a novel cost of recession: during recessions, workers have fewer opportunities to move to a better occupation.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105348.abstract_zh: 本文研究了商业周期中的职业流动性。我们将职业划分为两大类：“吸引力强”与“吸引力弱”，其中，若某职业通过工作间转换实现的总净流入为正，或其年薪中位数高于总体中位数，则将其标记为吸引力强。我们分别衡量了这两类职业群体的总净流入，并针对工作间转换（EE）及从失业到就业（UE）的转换分别测算了这些流入量。研究发现，在经济衰退期间，通过EE转换从吸引力弱职业流向吸引力强职业的净流入减缓。UE转换的相对净流入也呈现出类似的周期性变化。这一发现揭示了衰退的新成本：在经济衰退期间，工人转向更优职业的机会减少。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105348.title: Occupation ladders over the business cycle
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105348.title_zh: 经济周期中的职业阶梯

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105349.abstract: The determination of firm- and industry-level market power is studied in a model with search frictions driven by matching and incomplete information and in which heterogeneous firms compete for sales to ex ante homogeneous buyers. Combining directed search and random meetings sequentially, market tightness and the distributions of prices and productivity across active firms are determined jointly in equilibrium. We relate firm-level variation in prices and markups to variation in the elasticity of demand at the firm level. These distributions respond endogenously to changes in variable costs, utility from consumption, fixed costs of both entry and operation, and the consumer search process. We refer to these responses as pass-through and characterize them for both individual firms and the industry average. We show further that owing to the equilibrium determination of market tightness and the price distribution in directed search, improvements in consumer welfare may be associated with either increases or decreases in average markups.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105349.abstract_zh: 本文在一个由匹配和不完全信息驱动的搜索摩擦模型中，研究了企业层面和行业层面的市场势力决定问题，其中异质性企业竞争向事前同质的买家销售产品。通过将定向搜索与随机相遇顺序结合，市场紧度以及活跃企业间的价格和生产率分布在内生均衡中共同决定。我们将企业层面的价格和加成率变动与企业层面需求弹性的变动联系起来。这些分布会对可变成本、消费效用、进入和运营的固定成本以及消费者搜索过程的变化作出内生反应。我们将这些反应称为传导效应，并分别刻画单个企业和行业平均水平的传导特征。我们进一步表明，由于定向搜索中市场紧度和价格分布的均衡决定，消费者福利的改善可能与平均加成率的上升或下降相关联。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105349.title: Markups, pass-through, and firm heterogeneity with sequentially mixed search
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105349.title_zh: 顺序混合搜索中的加成、传导与企业异质性

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105351.abstract: This paper examines how increased trade in renewable nature-based inputs — such as wild terrestrial and marine biomass, along with tradable forms of clean air, soil, and water — affects economic growth in a world constrained by finite natural capital. Using a standard two-region endogenous growth model, we introduce two novel features: (i) a framework that explicitly models nature-based inputs by accounting for both the stock of natural capital and the flow of ecosystem services it generates, and (ii) ecological tipping points—thresholds beyond which natural capital and the ecosystems that sustain it may undergo irreversible degradation. We find that while global integration benefits all regions in the long run, it slows growth in nature-rich countries during the transition due to over-specialization and increased dependence on foreign technology. However, when tipping points are considered, agents internalize the risk of ecological collapse, reduce resource extraction, and shift toward innovation. Coordinated innovation and conservation policies can support more balanced and sustainable development.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105351.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在受有限自然资本约束的世界中，可交易的可再生自然基础投入品——如野生陆地和海洋生物质，以及可交易形式的清洁空气、土壤和水——贸易增加如何影响经济增长。通过使用标准的双区域内生增长模型，我们引入了两个新特征：（i）一个明确建模自然基础投入品的框架，同时考虑自然资本存量及其产生的生态系统服务流量；（ii）生态临界点——超过这些阈值，自然资本及其维持的生态系统可能遭受不可逆转的退化。我们发现，尽管全球一体化长期内惠及所有区域，但在转型期间，由于过度专业化和对外国技术的依赖增加，它减缓了自然丰富国家的增长。然而，当考虑临界点时，行为主体会内化生态崩溃的风险，减少资源开采，并转向创新。协调一致的创新与保护政策可以支持更加平衡和可持续的发展。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105351.title: Trade, innovation, and natural capital: Growth dynamics near ecological thresholds
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105351.title_zh: 贸易、创新与自然资本：生态阈值附近的增长动态

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105352.abstract: We document a new stylized fact linking uncertainty to the term structure of interest rates: unanticipated increases in uncertainty generate a yield curve that is lower, steeper, and less curved. Using a Yields-Macro Dynamic Nelson–Siegel model applied to U.S. Treasury yields, uncertainty measures, and macroeconomic aggregates, we show that this result is robust across financial, macroeconomic, and policy-related sources of uncertainty. A stylized asset-pricing model provides a structural interpretation, tracing these effects to precautionary motives under investor prudence. Counterfactual analyses show that uncertainty lowers the expected path of short rates while raising term premia, consistent with precautionary and risk-compensation mechanisms. We also develop an efficient Bayesian algorithm for estimating Yields-Macro Dynamic Nelson–Siegel models with constant or time-varying exponential decay parameters.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105352.abstract_zh: 我们记录了一个将不确定性与利率期限结构联系起来的新典型事实：未预期到的不确定性上升会导致收益率曲线更低、更陡峭且弯曲程度更小。通过将Yields-Macro动态Nelson–Siegel模型应用于美国国债收益率、不确定性指标及宏观经济总量，我们表明这一结果在金融、宏观经济和政策相关的不确定性来源中均具有稳健性。一个简约的资产定价模型提供了结构性解释，将这些效应追溯至投资者审慎性下的预防性动机。反事实分析显示，不确定性降低了短期利率的预期路径，同时提高了期限溢价，这与预防性机制和风险补偿机制相一致。我们还开发了一种高效的贝叶斯算法，用于估计具有恒定或时变指数衰减参数的Yields-Macro动态Nelson–Siegel模型。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105352.title: Uncertainty and the term structure of interest rates
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105352.title_zh: 不确定性与利率期限结构

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105353.abstract: This study investigates recruitment bias in the academic job market. We examine the link between statistical significance and placement outcomes for 200 empirical job market papers from 2018-2021. Marginally significant results are associated with higher academic placement likelihoods , suggesting a preference for statistical significance. This bias may incentivize questionable research practices. The COVID-19 pandemic intensified these dynamics, with marginal significance gaining greater weight in hiring decisions during competitive periods. Evidence of publication bias indicates recruiters may use statistical significance to predict future publications, shaping hiring decisions. These findings highlight systemic challenges to research integrity in economics.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105353.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了学术就业市场中的招聘偏见。我们分析了2018至2021年间200篇实证求职论文，考察统计显著性与就业结果之间的关联。边缘显著的结果与更高的学术职位获得可能性相关，表明存在对统计显著性的偏好。这种偏见可能助长可疑的研究实践。COVID-19疫情加剧了这一动态，在竞争激烈时期，边缘显著性在招聘决策中权重增加。出版偏见的证据表明，招聘者可能利用统计显著性预测未来发表情况，从而影响招聘决策。这些发现凸显了经济学研究诚信面临的系统性挑战。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105353.title: Job market stars: Statistical significance and academic hiring in economics
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105353.title_zh: 就业市场明星：经济学中的统计显著性与学术招聘

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105354.abstract: We develop a search-based theory of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) with heterogeneous firms and endogenous search complementarities. We use this model to study how merger incentives, endogenous innovation, and the firm size distribution interact. We derive the law of motion of the firm size distribution, provide closed-form solutions, and solve for firms’ investment in internal innovation and external acquisitions. Strategic complementarities in acquisition incentives can generate multiple equilibria, including an unstable equilibrium with high M&A activity. The model therefore offers a new perspective on merger waves as episodes in which favorable fundamentals and coordination interact to generate temporary bursts of acquisition activity. Competition policy can affect both the level of equilibrium merger activity and the set of equilibria the economy can sustain, with implications for innovation, markups, and welfare.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105354.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个基于搜索的并购理论，其中包含异质性企业和内生搜索互补性。利用该模型，我们探讨了并购激励、内生创新与企业规模分布之间的相互作用。我们推导了企业规模分布的动态规律，提供了闭式解，并求解了企业在内部创新和外部收购方面的投资决策。并购激励中的战略互补性可能产生多重均衡，包括一个高并购活动的不稳定均衡。因此，该模型为并购浪潮提供了新视角，将其视为有利基本面与协调效应相互作用，引发暂时性收购活动激增的时期。竞争政策既能影响均衡并购活动的水平，也能影响经济能够维持的均衡集合，这对创新、加成率和福利具有深远意义。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105354.title: A search-based theory of merger waves
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105354.title_zh: 基于搜索的并购浪潮理论

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105355.abstract: This paper studies the short-run economic impact of unanticipated disruptions to inputs potentially critical for domestic production and the green transition, and prone to geopolitical weaponisation (Foreign Critical Inputs - FCIs). Using firm-level customs and balance-sheet data for Belgium, France, Italy, Slovenia, and Spain, we find that a 50% reduction in FCI imports from China-aligned countries could lead to an average decline in manufacturing value added of 2.7% across the five countries. The impact, however, is highly uneven across firms, sectors, and regions. These findings highlight that supply disruptions in FCIs can impose substantial short-run economic costs.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105355.abstract_zh: 本文研究了意外中断对国内生产和绿色转型可能至关重要、且易受地缘政治武器化影响的关键外国投入品（Foreign Critical Inputs - FCIs）的短期经济影响。利用比利时、法国、意大利、斯洛文尼亚和西班牙的企业层面海关及资产负债表数据，我们发现，从与中国结盟国家进口的FCI减少50%，可能导致五国制造业增加值平均下降2.7%。然而，这一影响在企业、行业和地区之间高度不均。这些发现凸显了FCI供应中断可能带来显著的短期经济成本。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105355.title: Inputs in distress: Geoeconomic fragmentation and firms’ sourcing
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105355.title_zh: 困境中的投入：地缘经济碎片化与企业的采购来源

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105356.abstract: Online instruction holds the promise of expanding access to education for disadvantaged groups, yet it often deepens existing performance gaps. This study examines its impact on high-stakes exam outcomes, focusing on mechanisms driving differential effects for minority students. We leverage rich administrative data on students from five consecutive cohorts in 31 Israeli vocational colleges and the abrupt transition to online instruction during the COVID-19 pandemic. A key advantage of our setting is that exams were held in-person and graded centrally, ensuring comparability to pre-pandemic performance. Using a difference-in-differences design that compares outcomes within students and across cohorts, we find significant declines in both exam attendance and demonstrated knowledge following the switch to online instruction. These effects are not explained by local infection rates or childcare responsibilities, and are especially pronounced among Arabic-speaking minority students, regardless of their socioeconomic status. Drawing on variation in internet infrastructure, residential crowdedness, language of instruction, and prior academic performance, we show that poor internet access is a central mechanism underlying the adverse effects among minority students. For majority-group students, negative effects are concentrated among weaker students, suggesting widening disparities within the majority group. For minority students, the difference by prior achievement is not statistically significant, and if anything, the drop is larger for higher achievers.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105356.abstract_zh: 在线教学有望扩大弱势群体接受教育的机会，然而它往往加剧了现有的成绩差距。本研究考察了在线教学对高风险考试结果的影响，重点关注驱动少数族裔学生差异化效应的机制。我们利用了来自以色列31所职业学院连续五届学生的大量行政数据，以及COVID-19疫情期间向在线教学的突然转变。我们研究设置的一个关键优势在于，考试以线下形式进行并由中央统一评分，确保了与疫情前成绩的可比性。采用双重差分设计，比较学生内部及不同队列之间的结果，我们发现转向在线教学后，考试出勤率和所展示的知识水平均显著下降。这些效应无法由当地感染率或育儿责任解释，并且在阿拉伯语少数族裔学生中尤为突出，无论其社会经济地位如何。利用互联网基础设施、居住拥挤程度、教学语言及先前学业成绩的差异，我们表明互联网接入不畅是少数族裔学生遭受不利影响的核心机制。对于多数群体学生，负面效应集中在学业较弱的学生中，表明多数群体内部差距在扩大。对于少数族裔学生，按先前学业成绩划分的差异在统计上不显著，甚至可以说，高成就者的下降幅度更大。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105356.title: Disconnected: The unequal impact of online learning on minority students
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105356.title_zh: 脱节：在线学习对少数族裔学生的不平等影响

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105357.abstract: Prior literature involving the Gift-Exchange Game (GEG) finds that employee effort is increasing with the magnitude of a fixed wage. We re-examine the relationship between effort and wages in a new paradigm, the Wage Request Game (WRG), in which the worker requests their wage. The main mechanisms thought to deliver the GEG results are not present in the WRG which should lead to a different relationship between wages and effort. Our findings show instead that the relationship between effort and wages is unrelated to the origin of the wage. These findings suggest a new explanation for the commonly observed relationship between wages and effort.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105357.abstract_zh: 先前涉及礼物交换博弈（GEG）的文献发现，员工努力程度随固定工资水平的提高而增加。我们在一种新的范式——工资请求博弈（WRG）中重新审视了努力与工资之间的关系，在该博弈中，工人自行请求其工资。被认为产生GEG结果的主要机制在WRG中并不存在，这应导致工资与努力之间呈现不同的关系。然而，我们的研究结果显示，努力与工资之间的关系与工资的来源无关。这些发现为工资与努力之间普遍观察到的关系提供了一种新的解释。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105357.title: Do you get what you pay for?

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105358.abstract: This study investigates theoretically and experimentally firm-level adoption and market-level diffusion incentives of cost-saving abatement technology in price-collared emissions markets. Our theoretical model shows that the degree of technology diffusion in an industry comprising heterogeneous firms depends on both the position and width of the price collar. The model admits markets without price controls and emissions taxes as special cases, enabling unambiguous rankings of how alternative policies affect technology diffusion. We also implement a laboratory market experiment to provide empirical tests of these rankings. The experimental results strongly support the theoretical predictions regarding differences in technology adoption and diffusion across policy arrangements. Consistent with the theoretical predictions, firms with higher abatement costs adopt the technology more frequently, permit prices increase with positive shocks to abatement costs, and prices decrease in the degree of technology diffusion.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105358.abstract_zh: 本研究从理论和实验两个层面探讨了在价格带约束的排放市场中，企业层面的减排技术采纳与市场层面的扩散激励。我们的理论模型表明，由异质性企业构成的行业技术扩散程度，既取决于价格带的位置，也取决于其宽度。该模型将无价格控制的市场和排放税作为特例纳入，从而能够明确比较不同政策对技术扩散的影响排序。我们还进行了实验室市场实验，为这些排序提供实证检验。实验结果强烈支持关于不同政策安排下技术采纳与扩散差异的理论预测。与理论预测一致，减排成本较高的企业更频繁地采纳技术，配额价格随减排成本的正向冲击而上升，并随技术扩散程度的提高而下降。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105358.title: Technology adoption under emissions taxes and permit markets with price collars
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105358.title_zh: 排放税与价格带许可证市场下的技术采纳

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105359.abstract: This paper explores whether the transmission from monetary policy to income inequality may depend on the adoption of Inflation Targeting (IT) regimes. Using an interacted panel VAR, we find that expansionary monetary policy shocks reduce income inequality in countries that have switched to IT regimes. In contrast, in non-IT regimes the same shock is associated with a short-lived increase in income inequality. A decomposition of transmission channels indicates that the employment channel is the primary equalizing mechanism under IT, as expansionary shocks generate stronger improvements in labor market conditions. The financial channel operates in the opposite direction but is quantitatively smaller. We further show that the inequality-reducing effects of monetary policy are not replicated by other institutional features often associated with credibility, such as central bank transparency or central bank independence. Our findings are robust to alternative identification schemes, broader classifications of IT regimes, controls for self-selection into IT adoption, and to conditioning on different inflation environments.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105359.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了货币政策向收入不平等的传导是否可能取决于通胀目标制（IT）制度的采纳。通过使用交互面板VAR模型，我们发现，在已转向通胀目标制的国家，扩张性货币政策冲击会降低收入不平等。相比之下，在非通胀目标制国家，同样的冲击则与收入不平等的短期加剧相关。对传导渠道的分解表明，就业渠道是通胀目标制下的主要均等化机制，因为扩张性冲击能更显著地改善劳动力市场状况。金融渠道则朝相反方向作用，但其影响在数量上较小。我们进一步证明，货币政策的降低不平等效应并不能被其他常与可信度相关的制度特征所复制，如中央银行透明度或中央银行独立性。我们的研究结果对于替代识别方案、更广泛的通胀目标制分类、对采纳通胀目标制的自选择控制以及不同通胀环境下的条件设定均保持稳健。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105359.title: Inflation targeting, Monetary policy, and Inequality
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105359.title_zh: 通胀目标、货币政策与不平等

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105360.abstract: We study the tension between price and financial stability from a novel perspective: central bank asset purchases for financial stability during monetary policy tightening. We use as context a rare natural experiment, the 2022 UK gilt crisis, and develop a DSGE model featuring Non-Bank Financial Institutions to replicate the crisis and policy response. We find that asset purchases restore market functioning, and their temporary nature is crucial for avoiding a trade-off with monetary policy. Alternative tools such as repo loans and liquidity buffers can achieve the same goal with reduced impact on the central bank balance sheet. Our results show that central banks can ease financial market stress without loosening monetary policy, delivering on both objectives at all times.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105360.abstract_zh: 我们从一个新的视角研究价格稳定与金融稳定之间的张力：在货币政策紧缩期间，中央银行出于金融稳定目的进行的资产购买。我们以2022年英国国债危机这一罕见的自然实验为背景，构建了一个包含非银行金融机构的DSGE模型，以复现该危机及政策应对。我们发现，资产购买能够恢复市场功能，而其临时性对于避免与货币政策产生权衡至关重要。替代工具，如回购贷款和流动性缓冲，可以在减少对中央银行资产负债表影响的同时实现相同目标。我们的结果表明，中央银行可以在不放松货币政策的情况下缓解金融市场压力，从而在任何时候都能同时实现这两个目标。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105360.title: Monetary policy consequences of financial stability interventions: Assessing the UK gilt crisis and the central bank policy response
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105360.title_zh: 金融稳定干预的货币政策后果：评估英国金边债券危机与央行政策应对

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105361.abstract: The value of social and emotional skills is increasing in the labor market, but we have limited knowledge on how education systems can foster these skills at scale. We present evidence from a large-scale field experiment in Norway testing an online curriculum fostering students’ capacity to take on new challenges, solve hard problems and learn new tasks. The Norwegian high school system has a choice architecture particularly conducive to studying challenge-seeking, as students make annual choices about the rigor of math classes and these choices are consequential for future higher educational opportunities. We find that the intervention increases the likelihood that students take a more challenging educational path. The treatment has a positive impact on students’ choices of advanced and more challenging math classes throughout all three years of high school. One concern is that taking more rigorous math courses can be detrimental for marginal students, reducing grade-point averages and even on-time graduation. We find no support for this concern.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105361.abstract_zh: 社会与情感技能在劳动力市场中的价值日益凸显，但我们对教育体系如何大规模培养这些技能的认识仍十分有限。我们基于挪威一项大规模实地实验提供证据，该实验测试了一种在线课程，旨在培养学生迎接新挑战、解决难题及学习新任务的能力。挪威高中体系的选择架构特别有利于研究挑战寻求行为，因为学生每年需就数学课程的难度级别做出选择，而这些选择对未来高等教育机会具有重要影响。我们发现，该干预措施提高了学生选择更具挑战性教育路径的可能性。干预对学生在高中三年期间选择高级及更具挑战性数学课程产生了积极影响。一个担忧是，选择更严格的数学课程可能对边缘学生不利，降低平均绩点甚至影响按时毕业。我们的研究结果并未支持这一担忧。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105361.title: The road not taken: Socioemotional learning and academic rigor
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105361.title_zh: 未选择的路：社会情感学习与学术严谨性

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105362.abstract: Tutoring programs for low-performing students, delivered in-person or online, effectively enhance school performance, yet their medium- and longer-term impacts on labor market outcomes remain less understood. To address this gap, we conduct a randomized controlled trial with 839 secondary school students in Germany to examine the effects of an online tutoring program for low-performing students on academic performance and school-to-work transitions. The online tutoring program had a non-significant intention-to-treat effect of 0.06 standard deviations on math grades six months after program start. However, among students who had not received other tutoring services prior to the intervention, the program significantly improved math grades by 0.14 standard deviations. Moreover, students in non-academic school tracks experienced smoother school-to-work transitions, with vocational training take-up 18 months later being 5 percentage points higher—an effect that was even larger (12 percentage points) among those without prior tutoring. Overall, the results indicate that tutoring can generate lasting benefits for low-performing students that extend beyond school performance.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105362.abstract_zh: 针对低学业表现学生的辅导项目，无论是面对面还是在线形式，均能有效提升学业成绩，但其对劳动力市场结果的中期及长期影响仍知之甚少。为填补这一研究空白，我们在德国对839名中学学生开展了一项随机对照试验，以考察一项针对低学业表现学生的在线辅导项目对学业表现及从学校到工作过渡的影响。该在线辅导项目在项目启动六个月后，对数学成绩的意向治疗效应为0.06个标准差，但未达到统计显著性。然而，在干预前未接受过其他辅导服务的学生中，该项目显著提高了数学成绩，增幅为0.14个标准差。此外，非学术型学校轨道的学生经历了更顺畅的学校到工作过渡，18个月后职业培训参与率高出5个百分点——这一效应在先前未接受辅导的学生中更为显著，达到12个百分点。总体而言，研究结果表明，辅导项目能为低学业表现学生带来超越学业表现的持久益处。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105362.title: Online tutoring, school performance, and school-to-work transitions: Evidence from a randomized controlled trial
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105362.title_zh: 在线辅导、学业表现与从学校到工作的过渡：来自随机对照试验的证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105363.abstract: We study, theoretically and experimentally, the impact of performance thresholds on effort and risk-taking. Our theory predicts that thresholds typically increase effort provision, but that the magnitude of this increase varies non-monotonically with the threshold level. For risk-taking, the effects are positive for high thresholds and negative for low thresholds. We characterize these patterns through the subtle interplay between effort and risk, which transition from complements to substitutes as thresholds become more demanding. Our experiment (N=1092) supports the theoretical predictions, showing that high thresholds raise both effort and risk-taking, whereas more moderate thresholds raise effort but lower risk-taking. Importantly, the experiment sheds light on the crucial role of individual heterogeneity: because individuals have different baseline performances, the same threshold can be perceived as high by some and low by others, producing opposite behavioral responses. The analysis highlights that effective threshold design must understand not only how thresholds shape effort and risk-taking, but also the characteristics of the targeted population.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105363.abstract_zh: 我们从理论和实验两方面研究了绩效门槛对努力和风险承担的影响。我们的理论预测，门槛通常会提高努力水平，但这种提高的幅度随门槛水平呈非单调变化。对于风险承担，高门槛产生正向效应，低门槛则产生负向效应。我们通过努力与风险之间微妙的相互作用来刻画这些模式，随着门槛变得更加严格，两者从互补关系转变为替代关系。我们的实验（N=1092）支持了理论预测，表明高门槛同时提升努力和风险承担，而较为适中的门槛则提升努力但降低风险承担。重要的是，实验揭示了个人异质性的关键作用：由于个体基线绩效不同，同一门槛可能被一些人视为高门槛，而被另一些人视为低门槛，从而产生相反的行为反应。分析强调，有效的门槛设计不仅需要理解门槛如何塑造努力和风险承担，还需了解目标人群的特征。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105363.title: Performance thresholds, effort and risk-taking
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105363.title_zh: 绩效阈值、努力与风险承担

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105365.abstract: During crises, public financial support primarily aims to stabilize firms’ cash flows to sustain their operations. However, beyond this intended objective, such support may produce additional outcomes that remain underexplored. This study examines whether the public loan guarantee schemes introduced in the UK during the economic downturn due to the Covid-19 pandemic helped firms address new investment opportunities. Based on opportunity identification theory and using privileged data from UK public institutions covering the 2020–2023 period, we hypothesize and document that firms receiving public financial support are more likely to identify and pursue new innovation-related investment opportunities.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105365.abstract_zh: 危机期间，公共财政支持的主要目标是稳定企业现金流以维持其运营。然而，除了这一预期目标外，此类支持可能产生尚未充分探索的额外效果。本研究考察了英国在新冠疫情导致的经济衰退期间推出的公共贷款担保计划是否帮助企业把握新的投资机会。基于机会识别理论，并利用覆盖2020至2023年期间的英国公共机构特权数据，我们假设并证实，获得公共财政支持的企业更有可能识别并追求与创新相关的新投资机会。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105365.title: The show must go on: The role of public financial support in promoting firm innovation investments during a crisis
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105365.title_zh: 演出必须继续：公共财政支持在危机中促进企业创新投资的作用

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105372.abstract: I study how schools affect student performance and attainment throughout secondary education. I develop a dynamic structural model of cognitive skill accumulation and educational decisions in which students have imperfect information about their ability and learn about it from academic evaluations. The estimation relies on administrative data covering the universe of students in public middle schools in Barcelona (Spain). I use the estimated model to simulate the educational outcomes that each student would achieve in every school in the sample. The results show that school quality cannot be adequately summarized by any single ranking: students with differing characteristics and ability levels benefit from different school inputs, and the school environment is particularly important for the educational attainment of students from disadvantaged backgrounds or with lower ability. In particular, the schools that would maximize these students’ final test scores are often not those that maximize their probability of graduating or pursuing further education. These findings suggest that evaluating schools using only standardized assessments may fail to identify the schools that best support disadvantaged students. I then evaluate a counterfactual policy requiring students to remain in school through the final grade and take the final assessment rather than only until they turn sixteen. The policy substantially increases graduation rates, especially among disadvantaged students, while having only modest effects on the skill composition of high school entrants.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105372.abstract_zh: 我研究了学校如何影响学生在整个中学阶段的表现与学业成就。我构建了一个认知技能积累与教育决策的动态结构模型，其中学生对其自身能力存在不完全信息，并通过学业评价来了解自身能力。估计所依赖的数据涵盖了西班牙巴塞罗那公立初中全体学生的行政记录。我利用估计出的模型，模拟了样本中每所学校中每位学生本可取得的教育成果。结果显示，学校质量无法通过任何单一排名得到充分概括：具有不同特征和能力水平的学生受益于不同的学校投入，而学校环境对来自弱势背景或能力较低学生的学业成就尤为重要。特别是，能够最大化这些学生最终考试成绩的学校，往往并非那些能最大化其毕业或继续深造概率的学校。这些发现表明，仅使用标准化评估来评价学校，可能无法识别出最能支持弱势学生的学校。随后，我评估了一项反事实政策，即要求学生必须在校学习至最后一年级并参加最终评估，而非仅学习至年满十六岁。该政策显著提高了毕业率，尤其是对弱势学生而言，同时仅对高中入学者的技能构成产生适度影响。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105372.title: School quality beyond test scores: The role of schools in shaping educational outcomes
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105372.title_zh: 超越考试成绩的学校质量：学校在塑造教育成果中的作用

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105374.abstract: We introduce consumer choice into a search-theoretic model of monetary exchange. In contrast to standard search models featuring bilateral meetings, consumers can meet multiple sellers and choose a seller with whom to trade. Market power is endogenized through competitive search and it is influenced by the degree of consumer choice. We consider the effects of greater consumer choice on both market power and the welfare cost of inflation. Surprisingly, we find that greater consumer choice can have a non-monotonic effect on market power. At lower levels of consumer choice, an increase in the degree of consumer choice tends to increase firms’ market power, while the opposite is true at higher levels. When we calibrate the model to U.S. data, we find that despite greater consumer choice having a positive effect on welfare overall, it can also amplify the negative welfare effects of inflation, making it significantly more costly.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105374.abstract_zh: 我们将消费者选择引入货币交换的搜寻理论模型中。与标准搜寻模型中双边会面的设定不同，消费者能够接触多个卖家并选择交易对象。市场势力通过竞争性搜寻内生决定，并受消费者选择程度的影响。我们考察了更大程度的消费者选择对市场势力及通货膨胀福利成本的影响。令人意外的是，我们发现更大程度的消费者选择对市场势力的影响可能呈现非单调性。在消费者选择程度较低时，增加消费者选择程度往往提升企业的市场势力，而在较高水平时则相反。当我们将模型校准至美国数据时，发现尽管更大程度的消费者选择总体上对福利有正面影响，但它也可能放大通货膨胀的负面福利效应，使其代价显著增加。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105374.title: Consumer choice, market power, and inflation
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105374.title_zh: 消费者选择、市场势力与通货膨胀

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105375.abstract: Conventional wisdom suggests that information transparency about prices lowers prices and markups by intensifying seller competition. We show that, when buyer entry is endogenous, this relationship depends on the price measure under consideration. Information transparency may attract additional buyers and intensify demand-side competition, which can raise the price and the markup charged by sellers that compete for informed buyers. Yet, average posted and traded prices may fall because more sellers compete for informed buyers. Thus, information transparency can lower aggregate price indices while raising individual equilibrium prices and markups.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105375.abstract_zh: 传统观点认为，价格信息透明通过加剧卖方竞争会降低价格和加成率。我们证明，当买方进入是内生的时候，这种关系取决于所考虑的价格度量。信息透明可能吸引更多买方并加剧需求侧竞争，这可能会提高争夺知情买方的卖方所收取的价格和加成率。然而，由于更多卖方争夺知情买方，平均标价和成交价可能下降。因此，信息透明可以降低总体价格指数，同时提高个体均衡价格和加成率。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105375.title: Information, prices and buyer entry

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105377.abstract: We propose a factor correlated unobserved components (FCUC) model to analyze the sticky and flexible components of U.S. inflation. The proposed FCUC framework estimates trend inflation and component cycles in a flexible stochastic environment with time-varying volatility, factor loadings, and cross-frequency (trend-cycle) correlations, thus capturing how structural heterogeneity in price adjustment shapes the evolution of aggregate trend inflation over time. Using Bayesian estimation methods, we show that the FCUC model substantially reduces the uncertainty surrounding estimates of trend inflation and improves both point and density forecast accuracy. Our findings reveal that, particularly following the Global Financial Crisis and more markedly since the COVID-19 recession, transitory price shocks originating from flexible inflation have become a major driver of trend inflation, while sticky inflation explains only part of the variation. These results indicate that temporary price movements can have persistent effects, highlighting important policy implications regarding the cyclical dynamics of disaggregated inflation components amid evolving macroeconomic conditions.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105377.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个因子相关不可观测成分（FCUC）模型，用以分析美国通胀中的粘性与弹性成分。所提出的FCUC框架在具有时变波动性、因子载荷及跨频率（趋势-周期）相关性的灵活随机环境中，估计趋势通胀与成分周期，从而捕捉价格调整中的结构性异质性如何随时间塑造总体趋势通胀的演变。利用贝叶斯估计方法，我们表明FCUC模型显著降低了围绕趋势通胀估计的不确定性，并提高了点预测与密度预测的准确性。我们的发现揭示，特别是在全球金融危机之后，以及自新冠疫情衰退以来更为显著，源自弹性通胀的暂时性价格冲击已成为趋势通胀的主要驱动因素，而粘性通胀仅解释了部分变动。这些结果表明，暂时性价格变动可能产生持久影响，突显了在不断演变的宏观经济条件下，关于分类通胀成分周期动态的重要政策含义。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105377.title: Unpacking trend inflation: Evidence from a factor correlated unobserved components model of sticky and flexible prices
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105377.title_zh: 解构趋势通胀：来自粘性价格与弹性价格因子相关不可观测成分模型的证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105378.abstract: This paper articulates and, using newly-assembled data, explores how international taxation affects aggregate tangible cross-border investment. Spillovers from statutory tax rates abroad seem: As sizable as effects from the host’s rate; larger than previous consensus values (attributed to a systematic bias from FDI data); and consistent with ‘implicit’ profit shifting through real investment (rather than ‘paper’ profit shifting). Contrary to much policy discussion, the results also imply that: Host countries’ marginal effective tax rates have at best a weak effect on real investment; those elsewhere have none; and, applied to the prospective global minimum tax, inward tangible investment in most sample countries will increase.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105378.abstract_zh: 本文阐述并利用新汇编的数据，探讨国际税收如何影响总体有形跨境投资。来自国外的法定税率溢出效应似乎：与东道国税率的影响一样大；大于先前共识值（归因于FDI数据的系统性偏差）；并与通过实际投资进行的“隐性”利润转移（而非“纸面”利润转移）相一致。与许多政策讨论相反，结果还表明：东道国的边际有效税率对实际投资的影响至多微弱；其他地方的税率则无影响；并且，应用于拟议的全球最低税时，大多数样本国家的内向有形投资将会增加。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105378.title: International tax spillovers and tangible investment, with implications for a global minimum tax
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105378.title_zh: 国际税收溢出效应与有形投资：对全球最低税率的启示

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105379.abstract: Using a broader online sample from the United Kingdom, we experimentally test for the impact of monetary incentives on lying behavior. Our framework consists of the die-roll paradigm. In line with previous studies using student samples, we find that lying behavior is robust to changes in monetary stakes. Our results suggest that, in our context, the reliability of student-based findings can extend to more diverse populations.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105379.abstract_zh: 我们利用英国更广泛的在线样本，通过实验检验了金钱激励对说谎行为的影响。我们的框架采用掷骰子范式。与先前使用学生样本的研究一致，我们发现说谎行为对金钱激励的变化具有稳健性。我们的结果表明，在我们的情境下，基于学生样本的研究发现的可信度可以推广至更多样化的人群。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105379.title: On the robustness of monetary stakes and lying
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105379.title_zh: 论金钱激励与说谎行为的稳健性

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105380.abstract: We study the dynamic interplay between monetary policy and market power in a decentralized monetary economy. Building on Choi and Rocheteau (2024), our key innovation is to model rent seeking as a process that takes time, allowing market power to evolve gradually. Our model predicts that a gradual reduction in the nominal interest rate causes a simultaneous increase in rent-seeking effort and producers’ market power, consistent with the stylized correlation observed in the US over the last few decades. Free producer entry can however reverse this relation in the short run, and neutralize it in the long run. Indeterminacy and hysteresis emerge when consumers benefit from valuable outside options, with short-run monetary policy shocks potentially locking the economy into high- or low-market-power equilibria in the long run. These dynamics are robust to alternative environments, including dividend-paying real assets, access to banking, and a customer-capital interpretation of rent-seeking, highlighting monetary policy’s persistent and state-dependent effects on market structure through endogenous rent formation.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105380.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个分散化货币经济中货币政策与市场势力之间的动态相互作用。基于Choi和Rocheteau（2024）的研究，我们的关键创新在于将寻租行为建模为一个需要时间的过程，从而使市场势力能够逐步演变。我们的模型预测，名义利率的逐步降低会导致寻租努力和生产者市场势力同时增加，这与美国过去几十年来观察到的典型相关性一致。然而，自由生产者进入在短期内可能逆转这一关系，并在长期内使其中性化。当消费者受益于有价值的外部选择时，会出现不确定性和滞后现象，短期货币政策冲击可能将经济锁定在长期的高或低市场势力均衡中。这些动态在替代环境下依然稳健，包括支付股息的实际资产、银行服务的获取以及寻租的客户资本解释，突显了货币政策通过内生租金形成对市场结构产生的持久且状态依赖的影响。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105380.title: Dynamics of market power in monetary economies
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105380.title_zh: 货币经济中市场势力的动态变化

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105381.abstract: This paper uses unique Finnish firm-level micro data on service imports, employment, and firm characteristics to analyze changes in workforce composition and performance of Finnish service importers during a period of a significant increase in service imports (2002–2012). We utilize country-service specific export supply shocks, which we allocate to firms based on their highly specialized service-origin input structure, as an instrument to identify the impact of sourcing services from abroad. Our analysis indicates that sourcing services internationally offers firms considerable opportunities to enhance productivity and competitiveness. However, the analysis also reveals potential challenges, particularly for workers in low- and medium-skilled occupations, who experienced reduced employment, whereas managers and high-skilled professionals benefited from employment growth. These effects are broad: they involve workers beyond low-skilled occupations and firms across manufacturing and service sectors.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105381.abstract_zh: 本文利用芬兰独特的关于服务进口、就业及企业特征的企业层面微观数据，分析了在服务进口显著增长时期（2002-2012年）芬兰服务进口企业的劳动力构成变化及绩效表现。我们利用国家-服务特定的出口供给冲击，根据企业高度专业化的服务来源投入结构将其分配到各企业，作为识别从国外采购服务影响的工具变量。分析表明，国际服务采购为企业提升生产率和竞争力提供了可观机遇。然而，分析也揭示了潜在挑战，尤其是对低技能和中等技能职业的工人而言，他们经历了就业减少，而管理人员和高技能专业人员则受益于就业增长。这些影响具有广泛性：涉及低技能职业以外的工人，以及制造业和服务业中的各类企业。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105381.title: Service imports, workforce composition, and firm performance: Evidence from Finnish microdata
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105381.title_zh: 服务进口、劳动力结构与企业绩效：来自芬兰微观数据的证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105382.abstract: We introduce a stylized model of an economy with occupational choice, income taxes, and tariffs. The government maximizes a utilitarian welfare function subject to a revenue requirement. In the small open economy (SOE) case, the government implements a free-trade policy, and either imposes a flat tax or a progressive tax on high-income entrepreneurs. In a closed-economy scenario, the government imposes a regressive tax on low-income workers while exempting (or subsidizing) high-income entrepreneurs. A transition from a closed economy to an SOE improves optimal income tax progressivity.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105382.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含职业选择、所得税与关税的简约经济模型。政府需在满足收入需求的前提下最大化功利主义社会福利函数。在小型开放经济体（SOE）情形下，政府实施自由贸易政策，并对高收入企业家征收统一税率或累进税。在封闭经济情境中，政府对低收入工人征收累退税，同时豁免（或补贴）高收入企业家。从封闭经济向小型开放经济体的转型，会提升最优所得税的累进性。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105382.title: Optimal income taxes and tariffs in a small economy
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105382.title_zh: 小型经济体中的最优所得税与关税

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105384.abstract: Using a structural vector autoregression, I document the dominant role of fiscal policy in the recent surge of inflation in the United States. The comovement of output, prices, and primary deficits yields a set of identifying restrictions that allow me to estimate the causal effects of exogenous fiscal shocks. I show that fiscal policy has long been an important driver of inflation, with its unusually large role in the recent inflation surge reflecting the unprecedented scale of fiscal interventions. In the euro area, fiscal policy also contributed to inflation, and the timing of interventions helps explain why the surge lagged behind that in the United States.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105384.abstract_zh: 利用结构向量自回归模型，我记录了财政政策在美国近期通胀飙升中的主导作用。产出、价格与基本赤字之间的联动性提供了一组识别约束，使我能够估计外生财政冲击的因果效应。我表明，财政政策长期以来一直是通胀的重要驱动因素，其在近期通胀飙升中异常显著的作用反映了财政干预的空前规模。在欧元区，财政政策同样对通胀有所贡献，而干预时机的差异有助于解释为何该地区的通胀飙升滞后于美国。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105384.title: Fiscal shocks and the surge of inflation

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105385.abstract: This paper studies the effectiveness of forward guidance when central banks face private agents with heterogeneous expectations allowing for a degree of bounded rationality. Exploiting unique survey-based measures of expected inflation, output growth, and interest rates, we estimate a small-scale New Keynesian model with forward guidance shocks for the United States and the other G7 countries plus Spain. We find that the share of fully-informed rational expectations (FIRE) agents in aggregate expectations is similar for the U.S., the U.K., Germany, and other major advanced economies (albeit far from one); however, Japan’s share is much lower. For each country, the estimate of the share of FIRE agents has declined over time as VAR-based expectations — the heuristic approach assumed under bounded rationality — became more prominent in explaining the more recent data. Forward guidance has correspondingly grown less effective. In a counterfactual analysis, we document that, in the wake of the global financial crisis, inflation would have been significantly higher and the zero lower bound on short-term interest rates much less of a constraint had the public fully incorporated central banks’ forward guidance statements as FIRE agents do. Moreover, in most cases, inflation would have declined more, and somewhat faster, in the wake of the post-COVID-19 inflation surge.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105385.abstract_zh: 本文研究了当中央银行面对具有异质性预期且允许一定程度的有限理性的私人主体时，前瞻指引的有效性。利用独特的基于调查的预期通胀、产出增长和利率度量，我们估计了一个包含前瞻指引冲击的小型新凯恩斯模型，覆盖美国及其他七国集团国家加上西班牙。我们发现，在总体预期中，完全信息理性预期（FIRE）主体的份额在美国、英国、德国及其他主要发达经济体中相似（尽管远未达到一）；然而，日本的份额则低得多。对于每个国家，FIRE主体份额的估计值随时间下降，因为基于VAR的预期——有限理性下假设的启发式方法——在解释近期数据时变得更加突出。相应地，前瞻指引的有效性减弱。在一项反事实分析中，我们记录到，在全球金融危机之后，如果公众像FIRE主体那样完全纳入中央银行的指引声明，通胀本会显著更高，短期利率的零下限约束也会小得多。此外，在大多数情况下，在COVID-19后通胀飙升之后，通胀本会下降更多，且速度稍快。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105385.title: Living Up to Expectations: The Effectiveness of Forward Guidance and Inflation Dynamics Post-Global Financial Crisis
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105385.title_zh: 符合预期：全球金融危机后前瞻性指引的有效性与通胀动态

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105386.abstract: This paper analyzes the discrepancy between partial and general equilibrium approaches to unemployment insurance evaluation using a life-cycle model. We study an OLG economy with learning-by-doing human capital accumulation. Agents can be employed or unemployed. While unemployed, agents costly search for new jobs. We calibrate the model to the U.S. economy and find that the replacement ratio and potential duration are close to the current one. However, in contrast with the previous literature, we find that optimal policies under general and partial equilibrium are almost the same. Through a series of exercises we conclude that the life-cycle model provides two key components, crucial for welfare evaluation: it emphasizes workers’ insurance needs by accurately reproducing the left tail of the wealth distribution, and generates a realistic response of precautionary savings to transfers. As a result, factor prices are largely invariant to UI policy, and the discrepancy between general and partial equilibrium welfare evaluations essentially vanishes.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105386.abstract_zh: 本文利用生命周期模型分析了失业保险评估中局部均衡与一般均衡方法之间的差异。我们研究了一个具有干中学人力资本积累的OLG经济。个体可能处于就业或失业状态。失业期间，个体需付出成本寻找新工作。我们将模型校准至美国经济，发现替代率和潜在持续时间接近当前水平。然而，与以往文献不同，我们发现一般均衡与局部均衡下的最优政策几乎相同。通过一系列实验，我们得出结论：生命周期模型提供了对福利评估至关重要的两个关键要素：它通过精确再现财富分布的左尾，强调了工人的保险需求，并产生了预防性储蓄对转移支付的现实反应。因此，要素价格对失业保险政策基本不变，一般均衡与局部均衡福利评估之间的差异实质上消失了。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105386.title: Unemployment insurance when the wealth distribution matters
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105386.title_zh: 财富分布重要时的失业保险

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105387.abstract: We use a quantitative spatial equilibrium model to evaluate the distributional and welfare impacts of a recent temporary rent control policy in Berlin, Germany. We calibrate the model to key features of Berlin’s housing market, in particular the recent gentrification of inner city locations. As expected, gentrification benefits rich homeowners, while poor renter households lose. Our counterfactual analysis mimicks the rent control policy. We find that this policy reduces welfare for rich and poor households and in fact, the percentage change in welfare is largest for the poorest households. We also study alternative affordable housing policies such as subsidies and re-zoning policies, which are better suited to address the adverse consequences of gentrification.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105387.abstract_zh: 我们运用一个定量空间均衡模型，评估德国柏林近期实施的临时租金管制政策所带来的分配效应与福利影响。我们将模型校准至柏林住房市场的关键特征，特别是内城区位近期的绅士化现象。正如预期，绅士化使富裕房主受益，而贫困租房家庭则遭受损失。我们的反事实分析模拟了租金管制政策，发现该政策降低了富裕与贫困家庭的福利，且实际上，最贫困家庭的福利百分比变化最大。我们还研究了补贴和重新分区政策等替代性可负担住房政策，这些政策更适于应对绅士化带来的不利后果。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105387.title: Gentrification and affordable housing policies
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105387.title_zh: 中产阶级化与可负担住房政策

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105388.abstract: Does technological change affect ethical beliefs? We study the case of synthetic alternatives to meat products using an incentivized survey experiment. One might expect that the possibility of an improved alternative would increase objections to meat production on moral grounds because it reduces the cost of avoiding meat. Instead, we find that informing consumers of a new alternative decreases moral objections to conventional animal farming relative to a control. Participants who are experimentally nudged to view the new alternative relatively more positively do indeed report more moral concern for animal welfare. The findings suggest a backlash effect in which people react to innovation by increasing their support for existing practices, but depending on how positively they view the alternative.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105388.abstract_zh: 技术变革是否会影响道德信念？我们通过一项激励性调查实验，研究了肉类产品的合成替代品案例。人们或许预期，改进替代品的出现会增加基于道德理由对肉类生产的反对，因为它降低了避免食用肉类的成本。然而，我们发现，与对照组相比，告知消费者存在新替代品反而减少了对传统动物养殖的道德反对。被实验性引导更积极看待新替代品的参与者，确实报告了更多对动物福利的道德关切。研究结果表明存在一种反弹效应，即人们通过增加对现有做法的支持来回应创新，但这取决于他们对替代品的积极看法程度。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105388.title: The impact of new products on ethical beliefs
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105388.title_zh: 新产品对伦理信念的影响

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105389.abstract: Voting is a cornerstone of democratic decision-making, but it may also diffuse individual responsibility, potentially encouraging people to support actions they would avoid when deciding alone. Such diffusion of responsibility could lead voters to prioritize relative standing over collective welfare, for example by endorsing policies that reduce others’ advantages even at a cost to overall efficiency. Across two experiments (total N = 1750), including a preregistered replication, we examined whether voting contributes to envy-driven behavior in distributive decisions. Participants made choices in redistribution games under three decision-making rules: individually, through majority voting, or, in Study 2, via a Random Dictator mechanism that involved group decision-making without majority rule. In both studies, voting contributed to a higher rate of envy-driven choices, in which participants sacrificed efficiency to reduce disadvantageous inequality. This effect replicated with nearly identical magnitude in the preregistered study and was strongest when the personal cost of acting enviously was low. Results from the Random Dictator condition indicated that group decision-making alone increased envy-driven behavior, consistent with diffusion of responsibility, while majority rule amplified this effect further. These findings suggest that collective decision-making can shift social preferences by diffusing personal responsibility, thereby fostering competitive motives rather than cooperative ones. This psychological mechanism helps explain why democratic decisions about redistribution may sometimes reflect relative concerns rather than collective welfare.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105389.abstract_zh: 投票是民主决策的基石，但它也可能分散个人责任，从而可能鼓励人们支持那些在独自决策时会避免的行为。这种责任分散可能导致选民优先考虑相对地位而非集体福利，例如支持那些以减少他人优势为代价、即使损害整体效率也在所不惜的政策。通过两项实验（总样本量N=1750），包括一项预注册复制实验，我们考察了投票是否在分配决策中促成嫉妒驱动的行为。参与者在三种决策规则下进行再分配博弈：个人决策、多数投票决策，或在研究2中通过随机独裁者机制进行的不涉及多数规则的群体决策。两项研究均表明，投票提高了嫉妒驱动选择的比例，即参与者牺牲效率以减少不利不平等。这一效应在预注册研究中以几乎相同的幅度得到复制，并且在采取嫉妒行为的个人成本较低时最为显著。随机独裁者条件的结果表明，仅群体决策本身就会增加嫉妒驱动行为，这与责任分散一致，而多数规则进一步放大了这一效应。这些发现表明，集体决策通过分散个人责任可以改变社会偏好，从而促进竞争动机而非合作动机。这一心理机制有助于解释为何关于再分配的民主决策有时可能反映相对关切而非集体福利。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105389.title: Envy in the ballot box: How voting influences distributive preferences
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105389.title_zh: 投票箱中的嫉妒：投票如何影响分配偏好

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105390.abstract: We utilize novel probabilistic expectations data related to contraception, such as the perceived chances of pregnancy or contracting a sexually transmitted disease, to investigate the underlying factors contributing to the differences in contraceptive choices across various demographic groups in the United States. Women from groups with disproportionately higher rates of unintended pregnancies, such as Black women and those with lower income, exhibit relatively accurate perceptions about contraceptive effectiveness. This finding suggests that systematic misperceptions about contraceptive efficacy play a limited role in explaining the variation in contraceptive choice across different groups. We then combine data on contraception choice with the expectations data to make inference on women’s preferences for birth control methods’ attributes. We find heterogeneity in preferences for becoming pregnant: non-Black women with a college degree would be willing to pay $ 260 per month to avoid a pregnancy, while Black women without a degree and low income women exhibit a willingness to pay to avoid pregnancy not statistically different from zero, suggesting an ambivalence toward pregnancy. These results highlight that differences in contraceptive choices and outcomes are primarily driven by varying preferences for pregnancy, with limited disutility among groups experiencing higher rates of unintended pregnancies.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105390.abstract_zh: 我们利用与避孕相关的新型概率预期数据，如感知到的怀孕风险或感染性传播疾病的可能性，来探究导致美国不同人口群体间避孕选择差异的潜在因素。来自意外怀孕率不成比例偏高的群体，如黑人女性和低收入女性，对避孕有效性的认知相对准确。这一发现表明，关于避孕效能的系统性误解在解释不同群体间避孕选择差异方面作用有限。随后，我们将避孕选择数据与预期数据相结合，以推断女性对避孕方法属性的偏好。我们发现，对于怀孕的偏好存在异质性：拥有大学学位的非黑人女性愿意每月支付260美元以避免怀孕，而无学位的黑人女性及低收入女性避免怀孕的支付意愿在统计上与零无显著差异，暗示其对怀孕持有矛盾态度。这些结果强调，避孕选择及结果的差异主要由对怀孕的不同偏好驱动，而在意外怀孕率较高的群体中，避免怀孕的负效用有限。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105390.title: Pregnancy ambivalence: Expectations, preferences and contraceptive choice
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105390.title_zh: 妊娠矛盾心理：期望、偏好与避孕选择

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105391.abstract: We study the relevance of global shocks in determining r-star for a set of typically studied advanced open economies (Australia, Canada, Euro Area, New Zealand, Norway, Sweden, and the United Kingdom). To do so, we apply a multivariate Beveridge–Nelson decomposition using a two-block small open economy Bayesian vector autoregression for each economy with the United States in the foreign block and imposing long-run restrictions to identify the role of global shocks in driving domestic r-star. We document three key findings: (i) U.S. r-star provides a sufficient proxy for global r-star from the perspective of these seven open economies; (ii) local shocks with no impact on U.S. r-star are important for domestic r-stars, leaving open the potential that domestic macroeconomic policies can complement or offset the global forces determining r-star; and (iii) even though local shocks are important, global forces played the dominant role in the long-term decline in r-stars for all seven open economies following the global financial crisis.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105391.abstract_zh: 我们研究了全球冲击在决定一组典型发达开放经济体（澳大利亚、加拿大、欧元区、新西兰、挪威、瑞典和英国）的r-star中的相关性。为此，我们采用多元贝弗里奇-尼尔森分解方法，对每个经济体应用一个以美国为外国区块的两区块小型开放经济贝叶斯向量自回归模型，并施加长期限制以识别全球冲击在驱动国内r-star中的作用。我们记录了三个关键发现：（i）从这七个开放经济体的角度来看，美国的r-star为全球r-star提供了充分的代理指标；（ii）对美国r-star无影响的本地冲击对国内r-star具有重要意义，这为国内宏观经济政策补充或抵消决定r-star的全球力量留下了可能性；（iii）尽管本地冲击重要，但在全球金融危机后，全球力量在七个开放经济体r-star的长期下降中发挥了主导作用。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105391.title: How important is global r-star for open economies?
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105391.title_zh: 全球r-star对开放经济体的重要性如何？

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105392.abstract: We investigate the economic effects of geopolitical risk (GPR) shocks on the US economy, with a focus on non-linear transmission mechanisms. Using a VARX framework, we show that larger positive shocks have a disproportionately greater impact, pointing to the existence of an amplification channel driven by rising uncertainty that leads to sharp declines in private demand and equity prices. In contrast, the prices’ responses are relatively muted, reflecting the offsetting effects of reduced demand and increasing supply-side pressures. Decomposing GPR into Threats and Acts shocks helps explain this result: Threats shocks behave as second-moment uncertainty disturbances that significantly raise oil prices and inflation expectations, exerting upward pressure on domestic prices, while Acts shocks transmit more similarly to first-moment negative demand shocks.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105392.abstract_zh: 我们研究了地缘政治风险（GPR）冲击对美国经济的经济效应，重点关注非线性传导机制。利用VARX框架，我们表明较大的正向冲击具有不成比例的更大影响，指向由不确定性上升驱动的放大渠道的存在，这导致私人需求和股票价格的急剧下降。相比之下，价格的反应相对温和，反映了需求减少与供给侧压力上升的抵消效应。将GPR分解为威胁冲击和行动冲击有助于解释这一结果：威胁冲击表现为二阶矩不确定性扰动，显著推高油价和通胀预期，对国内价格施加上行压力，而行动冲击的传导更类似于一阶矩负向需求冲击。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105392.title: Geopolitical risk shocks: When size matters
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105392.title_zh: 地缘政治风险冲击：当规模至关重要

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105393.abstract: We present a model of frictional lending where entrepreneurs choose their outside options (self-finance or waiting to find other lenders) when bargaining with banks. When the number of banks is sufficiently small, the equilibrium features self-finance as entrepreneurs’ dominant outside option; when the number of banks is sufficiently large, waiting becomes the dominant outside option. The model can rationalize the mixed empirical evidence on the relationship between banking concentration and loan-rate markups. It also uncovers new policy-dependent channels through which the concentration-markup relationship need not be stable or positive. Depending on the equilibrium regime, monetary policy can alter entrepreneurs’ outside options and change how banking concentration affects loan market power. Our main insight extends to cases with endogenous entry of banks or entrepreneurs, prudential regulation, and default risk.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105393.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个摩擦性贷款模型，其中企业家在与银行谈判时选择其外部选项（自我融资或等待寻找其他贷款人）。当银行数量足够少时，均衡特征表现为自我融资成为企业家的主导外部选项；当银行数量足够多时，等待则成为主导外部选项。该模型能够解释关于银行集中度与贷款利率加成之间关系的混合经验证据。它还揭示了新的政策依赖渠道，通过这些渠道，集中度与加成之间的关系可能不稳定或非正相关。根据均衡机制的不同，货币政策可以改变企业家的外部选项，并影响银行集中度如何作用于贷款市场力量。我们的主要见解扩展至银行或企业家的内生进入、审慎监管以及违约风险等情形。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105393.title: Banking concentration and loan-rate markups in a frictional loan market
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105393.title_zh: 摩擦性贷款市场中的银行集中度与贷款利率加成

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105401.abstract: We revisit the question of the role of Hand-to-Mouth (HtM) households in monetary policy transmission across European countries, using the Household Finance and Consumption Survey (HFCS). Using European Central Bank (ECB) monetary shocks and panel local projections, we find that the aggregate output response of countries with higher HtM ratios is less pronounced following monetary policy shocks compared to those with lower HtM ratios. This aligns with the predictions of heterogeneous agent New Keynesian models with both wage and price rigidity. When wages are stickier than prices, real wages for HtM agents may decline despite interest rate cuts, which hinders the demand boost typically expected from the New Keynesian Cross. Consequently, monetary policy is less effective in stimulating aggregate demand in economies with a higher share of HtM households.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105401.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了手到口（HtM）家庭在欧洲各国货币政策传导中的作用，利用家庭金融与消费调查（HFCS）数据。借助欧洲中央银行（ECB）的货币冲击和面板局部投影方法，我们发现，在货币政策冲击后，HtM比率较高的国家，其总体产出反应相较于HtM比率较低的国家更为温和。这一发现与同时包含工资和价格粘性的异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型的预测相符。当工资比价格更具粘性时，尽管利率下调，HtM代理人的实际工资可能下降，这阻碍了新凯恩斯交叉通常预期的需求提振效应。因此，在HtM家庭占比更高的经济体中，货币政策在刺激总需求方面的效果较弱。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105401.title: Hand-to-mouth households in the eurosystem and the transmission of monetary policy
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105401.title_zh: 欧元体系中的手头拮据家庭与货币政策的传导

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105402.abstract: We assess the welfare benefits of government-funded emergency support to the financial sector, considering its effects on the probability of financial crises. In our quantitative general equilibrium model, the financial crisis probability depends on household portfolio choices and on financial intermediaries' balance sheet positions, both influenced by capital adequacy constraints (CAR) and ex-ante known emergency support provisions. The welfare-optimal CAR balances the output costs of equity financing and financial stability gains and ranges from 12.7 to 12.8 \% depending on emergency support. Comprehensive support is welfare improving under the current and optimal CAR, but likely welfare decreasing at lower ratios, or with a significant amount of shadow banking activity undermining the effectiveness of capital adequacy regulation.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105402.abstract_zh: 我们评估了政府资助的金融部门紧急支持措施的福利收益，考虑了其对金融危机概率的影响。在我们的定量一般均衡模型中，金融危机概率取决于家庭投资组合选择及金融中介机构的资产负债表状况，这两者均受资本充足率约束（CAR）和事前已知的紧急支持条款影响。福利最优的CAR在股权融资产出成本与金融稳定收益之间取得平衡，根据紧急支持的不同，其范围在12.7%至12.8%之间。在当前及最优CAR下，全面支持能改善福利，但在较低比率下，或当影子银行活动显著削弱资本充足率监管有效性时，全面支持可能反而降低福利。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105402.title: Are bank bailouts welfare improving?
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105402.title_zh: 银行救助能否改善社会福利？

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105406.abstract: Cooperation is fundamental to the functioning of societies and has been extensively examined across economics, sociology, and biology. Traditional mechanisms for sustaining cooperation, such as punishment and exogenous rewards, often entail significant drawbacks, including resource wastage and dependence on external inputs. In response to these limitations, Yang et al. (2018) introduced an endogenous reward mechanism that maintains cooperation by imposing a tax on participants and allowing them to vote on the allocation of the collected tax revenue, thereby rewarding individuals with higher cooperative tendencies. This study aims to replicate and extend Yang et al. (2018)’s findings by employing a larger sample size and exploring the effects of varying tax rates on the sustainability of cooperation. Our results confirm that the endogenous reward mechanism effectively sustains cooperation, replicating Yang et al. (2018) conclusions at the 20% tax rate. Moreover, we discovered that the maintenance of cooperation follows an inverted U-shaped relationship with the tax rate, peaking at 60%. Higher and lower tax rates were found to be less effective in sustaining cooperative behavior. These findings provide valuable insights into optimizing tax rates for promoting cooperation.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105406.abstract_zh: 合作是社会运作的基础，已在经济学、社会学和生物学领域得到广泛研究。传统的维持合作机制，如惩罚和外部奖励，往往伴随着显著缺陷，包括资源浪费和对外部投入的依赖。针对这些局限，Yang等人（2018）提出了一种内生奖励机制，通过对参与者征税并允许他们就税收收入的分配进行投票，从而奖励合作倾向较高的个体，以此维持合作。本研究旨在通过采用更大的样本量并探索不同税率对合作可持续性的影响，来复制并扩展Yang等人（2018）的研究发现。我们的结果证实，内生奖励机制能有效维持合作，在20%的税率下复制了Yang等人（2018）的结论。此外，我们发现合作的维持与税率呈倒U型关系，在60%时达到峰值。研究发现，较高和较低的税率在维持合作行为方面效果较差。这些发现为优化税率以促进合作提供了宝贵的见解。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105406.title: Optimal tax rates in endogenous reward mechanisms: An inverted U-shaped impact on sustaining cooperation
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105406.title_zh: 内生奖励机制中的最优税率：对维持合作的倒U型影响

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105407.abstract: Repeated interactions can sustain cooperation even when short-run incentives favor defection, but the individual strategies underlying such cooperation remain poorly understood. We study behavior in indefinitely repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma experiments and identify three robust behavioral types: defectors defectors, cautious cooperators, and strong cooperators. Both types of cooperators tend to continue cooperation after mutual cooperation, defect after mutual defection, and randomize after asymmetric outcomes, differing mainly in their initial willingness to cooperate. Variation in the strategic environment primarily changes the population shares of these types rather than their continuation behavior. These findings suggest that cooperation in repeated interactions is sustained by a small number of robust behavioral patterns. At the same time, the continuation behavior of cooperating types is largely insensitive to expected payoffs, contrary to standard game-theoretic predictions.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105407.abstract_zh: 重复互动即使在短期激励倾向于背叛的情况下也能维持合作，但支撑这种合作的个体策略仍鲜为人知。我们研究了无限重复囚徒困境实验中的行为，并识别出三种稳健的行为类型：背叛者、谨慎合作者和强合作者。两类合作者在相互合作后倾向于继续合作，在相互背叛后选择背叛，在不对称结果后随机选择，主要区别在于初始合作意愿。战略环境的变化主要改变这些类型在总体中的占比，而非其后续行为。这些发现表明，重复互动中的合作由少数稳健的行为模式所维持。同时，合作类型的后续行为对预期收益基本不敏感，这与标准博弈论预测相悖。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105407.title: Individual strategy choice in the repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105407.title_zh: 重复囚徒困境中的个体策略选择

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105408.abstract: We study age-income gaps across 32 countries over 2004–2018 using harmonized microdata from the Luxembourg Income Study. We document a striking divergence: the ratio of disposable income of late-career workers (aged 55–64) relative to early-career workers (aged 25–34), which we name the Age Group Income Ratio (AGIR), rose by 18 percentage points in rich countries but fell by 8 percentage points in poor economies. This divergence operates primarily through the employment margin, which accounts for two-thirds of rising AGIR in rich countries and that conventional age-earnings measures miss entirely. To explain these patterns, we develop an overlapping generations model that discriminates among six competing mechanisms. In rich countries, skill congestion – late-career cohorts catching up with early-career workers in educational attainment and crowding them out of skilled labour markets – is the dominant driver of both margins. In poor countries, productivity growth dominates and skill congestion reduces rather than raises income inequality, as the young are expanding their college attainment more rapidly than the old.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105408.abstract_zh: 我们利用卢森堡收入研究的统一微观数据，研究了2004-2018年间32个国家的年龄-收入差距。我们记录了一个显著的差异：晚期职业工人（55-64岁）相对于早期职业工人（25-34岁）的可支配收入比率，我们称之为年龄组收入比率（AGIR），在富裕国家上升了18个百分点，而在贫困经济体则下降了8个百分点。这种差异主要通过就业边际发挥作用，这解释了富裕国家AGIR上升的三分之二，而传统的年龄-收入衡量指标完全忽略了这一点。为了解释这些模式，我们构建了一个代际重叠模型，用以区分六种竞争机制。在富裕国家，技能拥挤——晚期职业群体在教育程度上追赶早期职业工人并将其挤出技能劳动力市场——是这两个边际的主要驱动因素。在贫困国家，生产率增长占主导地位，技能拥挤减少了而非增加了收入不平等，因为年轻人正在比老年人更快地扩大其大学教育程度。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105408.title: Age-income gaps: The role of skill congestion
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105408.title_zh: 年龄-收入差距：技能拥挤的作用

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105409.abstract: The transition toward a circular economy (CE) represents not only an economic shift but also a profound social and institutional transformation that redefines production, consumption, and policy. This study provides the first macro-level empirical assessment of the CE transition across European regions over the last two decades. It then examines how regional regulative, normative, and cultural-cognitive institutions shape regional CE performance, while also accounting for key confounding factors, including EU cohesion funds, regional autonomy, and the EU Circular Economy Action Plan (CEAP). The results reveal strong spatial and temporal heterogeneity, as well as distinct effects across institutional dimensions. Regulative institutions exhibit the most consistent positive association across and within countries. Normative institutions matter most within major regions, while cultural-cognitive institutions provide more modest support for CE efforts. Importantly, the combination of all institutional pillars is associated with the largest gains in circularity. EU cohesion funds significantly support CE progress, while the post-2015 results suggest that the CEAP reshaped the relative importance of institutional pillars. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of coordinated institutional frameworks and targeted policy support in advancing the regional CE transition.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105409.abstract_zh: 向循环经济（CE）的转型不仅代表着经济层面的转变，更是一场深刻的社会与制度变革，重新定义了生产、消费及政策。本研究首次对过去二十年间欧洲各地区的循环经济转型进行了宏观层面的实证评估，并进一步探讨了区域规制性、规范性及文化-认知性制度如何影响区域循环经济绩效，同时控制了包括欧盟凝聚力基金、区域自治权及欧盟循环经济行动计划（CEAP）在内的关键混淆因素。研究结果显示，循环经济转型存在显著的空间与时间异质性，且各制度维度的影响效应各异。规制性制度在国家内部及国家间均展现出最为一致的正向关联；规范性制度在主要区域中作用最为显著；而文化-认知性制度对循环经济努力的支撑作用相对有限。重要的是，所有制度支柱的组合与循环性提升的最大增益相关联。欧盟凝聚力基金显著促进了循环经济进展，而2015年后的结果表明，CEAP重塑了各制度支柱的相对重要性。总体而言，研究结果强调了协调的制度框架与有针对性的政策支持在推进区域循环经济转型中的关键作用。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105409.title: Circular economy transition of European regions: The role of regulative, normative, and cultural–cognitive institutions
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105409.title_zh: 欧洲区域循环经济转型：规制性、规范性与文化认知性制度的作用

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105410.abstract: This paper introduces the Euro Area Communication Event-Study Database (EA-CED), a new dataset tracking intraday financial market movements around 304 ECB Governing Council meetings (ECBGC) and 5100 inter-meeting communication (IMC) events by GC members, primarily in the form of speeches and interviews. We document that IMC events are associated with significant market movements often comparable to, or larger than, those following ECB policy announcements, particularly for longer maturity yields. Importantly, these effects are not limited to communication from the ECB President but also from other Governing Council members. Like ECBGC announcements, IMC events convey multidimensional information: three structurally identified factors explain a large share of the yield curve movements around IMC surprises. Finally, we show that IMC events provide relevant information for identifying the effects of monetary policy shocks on euro area output and inflation in a Bayesian Vector Autoregression model.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105410.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了欧元区沟通事件研究数据库（EA-CED），这是一个新数据集，追踪了304次欧洲央行管理委员会（ECBGC）会议及5100次由理事会成员进行的会议间沟通（IMC）事件（主要为演讲和访谈形式）期间的日内金融市场变动。我们记录到，IMC事件与显著的市场波动相关联，其幅度往往与欧洲央行政策公告后的波动相当或更大，尤其是在较长到期收益率方面。重要的是，这些影响不仅限于欧洲央行行长的沟通，也来自其他管理委员会成员。与ECBGC公告类似，IMC事件传递了多维信息：三个结构性识别因子解释了IMC意外事件中收益率曲线变动的大部分。最后，我们表明，在贝叶斯向量自回归模型中，IMC事件为识别货币政策冲击对欧元区产出和通胀的影响提供了相关信息。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105410.title: ECB communication and its impact on financial markets
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105410.title_zh: 欧央行沟通及其对金融市场的影响

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105411.abstract: We compute a common factor summarising asymmetries in the expected distributions of a large set of survey-based economic data series for the euro area. This expected skewness factor is distinct from lower-moment factors and can help improve forecasts of risks to economic activity and inflation. In addition, within a monthly vector autoregression (VAR), we show that revisions to survey-based expected skewness have macroeconomic and financial implications, even when the average assessment and expected volatility reflected in the surveys remain unchanged. The skewness measure could benefit economic policy institutions by supporting timely quantitative assessments of the balance of risks.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105411.abstract_zh: 我们计算了一个共同因子，用以概括欧元区大量基于调查的经济数据序列预期分布中的不对称性。这一预期偏度因子区别于低阶矩因子，并能有助于改进对经济活动及通胀风险的预测。此外，在月度向量自回归（VAR）框架内，我们表明，即使调查中反映的平均评估和预期波动性保持不变，基于调查的预期偏度修正也会产生宏观经济和金融影响。该偏度指标可通过支持对风险平衡的及时定量评估，惠及经济政策机构。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105411.title: A survey-based measure of asymmetric macroeconomic risk in the euro area
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105411.title_zh: 基于调查的欧元区非对称宏观经济风险测度

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105412.abstract: We measure the Euro Area (EA) output gap and potential output using a non-stationary dynamic factor model estimated on a large dataset of macroeconomic and financial variables. From 2012 to 2023, we estimate that the EA economy was tighter than the European Commission and the International Monetary Fund estimate, suggesting that the slow EA growth is the result of a potential output issue, not a business cycle issue. Moreover, we find that credit indicators are crucial for pinning down the output gap, as excluding them leads to estimating a lower output gap in periods of debt build-up and a higher gap in periods of deleveraging.
