10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105412.abstract_zh: 我们利用一个基于大型宏观经济与金融变量数据集估计的非平稳动态因子模型，来衡量欧元区（EA）产出缺口与潜在产出。从2012年至2023年，我们估算出欧元区经济比欧盟委员会和国际货币基金组织的估计更为紧张，这表明欧元区增长缓慢源于潜在产出问题，而非商业周期问题。此外，我们发现信贷指标对于确定产出缺口至关重要，因为排除这些指标会导致在债务累积时期估计出较低的产出缺口，而在去杠杆时期估计出较高的缺口。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105412.title: Measuring the euro area output gap

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105413.abstract: We study how racial hate crimes influence immigrants’ social identity and sense of belonging to the host country. We focus on the 2008 “San Gennaro massacre”, an attack by a Camorra clan against African immigrants in Southern Italy. Using a difference-in-differences (DiD) approach, we show that the event increased the sense of belonging to Italy among Africans living in the affected area, driven by both a ”fear effect” and a ”solidarity effect”. We further document that this shift in social identification spread to other African immigrant communities, particularly those residing in municipalities characterized by a strong presence of organized crime and by a strong local public reaction of solidarity. Finally, we find that this increase in identification with Italy is persistent over time and is not associated with a weakening of ethnic identity.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105413.abstract_zh: 我们研究了种族仇恨犯罪如何影响移民的社会认同感及对东道国的归属感。我们聚焦于2008年的“圣真纳罗大屠杀”，这是一起卡莫拉犯罪家族对意大利南部非洲移民发动的袭击。采用双重差分法（DiD），我们表明该事件增强了受影响地区非洲裔居民对意大利的归属感，这一效应由“恐惧效应”和“团结效应”共同驱动。我们进一步记录到，这种社会认同的转变扩散到了其他非洲移民社区，尤其是那些居住在组织犯罪活动猖獗且当地公众团结反应强烈的市镇的社区。最后，我们发现这种对意大利认同感的增强随时间持续存在，且并未伴随族裔认同的减弱。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105413.title: Immigrants’ social identity, racial hate crimes, and public backlash: Evidence from the ”San Gennaro massacre”
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105413.title_zh: 移民社会身份、种族仇恨犯罪与公众反弹：来自“圣热纳罗大屠杀”的证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105414.abstract: We study how financial shocks affect the income distribution in the euro area. Using survey-based microdata from 16 countries and a functional pooled panel VAR, we trace impulse responses of the full income distribution. Positive financial shocks increase gross market income inequality: upper-tail incomes rise persistently, whereas lower-tail incomes weaken on impact and recover gradually, even as the mass at zero income declines. Decomposing income into property and labor components reveals two transmission channels. Property income responds quickly, consistent with asset-price revaluation and concentrated financial asset holdings. Labor income responds more gradually and persistently, consistent with broader labor-market adjustment in margins and composition. We also document asymmetries: financial expansions raise inequality, whereas financial contractions initially compress top incomes. The asymmetry is strongest for financial asset income.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105414.abstract_zh: 我们研究了金融冲击如何影响欧元区的收入分配。利用来自16个国家的基于调查的微观数据以及功能性面板VAR模型，我们追踪了完整收入分布的脉冲响应。正向金融冲击加剧了总市场收入不平等：高收入端收入持续上升，而低收入端收入在冲击初期减弱并逐步恢复，即便零收入群体的比例有所下降。将收入分解为财产性收入和劳动收入后，揭示了两种传导渠道。财产性收入反应迅速，与资产价格重估及金融资产持有集中度一致。劳动收入反应则更为渐进且持久，与劳动力市场在边际和构成上的广泛调整相符。我们还记录了不对称性：金融扩张加剧不平等，而金融收缩初期压缩高收入端收入。这种不对称性在金融资产收入中表现最为显著。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105414.title: Disentangling the distributional effects of financial shocks in the euro area
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105414.title_zh: 欧元区金融冲击的分配效应解析

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105415.abstract: Transactions such as kidney sales or surrogacy often evoke repugnance among unaffected observers (spectators). We examine whether individuals directly involved in these transactions (stakeholders) are more accepting. In our lab experiment featuring a transaction with severe consequences and limited agency for the vulnerable party, spectators and vulnerable stakeholders largely deem it repugnant, whereas advantaged stakeholders (who have the right to make offers) are less likely to prohibit it. Spectators and vulnerable stakeholders differentiate between mild and severe outcomes, while advantaged stakeholders are accepting in both cases. All groups are more prohibitive when agency is lacking. Overall, spectators mostly align with the vulnerable, while advantaged stakeholders view the transactions more favorably.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105415.abstract_zh: 诸如肾脏买卖或代孕等交易，往往会在未受影响的旁观者（旁观者）中引发反感。我们考察了直接参与这些交易的个人（利益相关者）是否更为接受。在我们的实验室实验中，涉及后果严重且弱势方代理权有限的交易，旁观者和弱势利益相关者大多认为其令人反感，而优势利益相关者（拥有提出要约权利的一方）则较少倾向于禁止。旁观者和弱势利益相关者会区分轻微与严重后果，而优势利益相关者在两种情况下均持接受态度。当缺乏代理权时，所有群体都更倾向于禁止。总体而言，旁观者主要与弱势方立场一致，而优势利益相关者则对交易持更为积极的态度。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105415.title: Double standards: When stakeholders disagree with spectators in repugnance judgments
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105415.title_zh: 双重标准：当利益相关者与旁观者在厌恶判断上产生分歧时

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105416.abstract: The sociological literature suggests that within diverse communities, individuals create externalities on members of other social groups when they express identity through the consumption of market goods. Positive identity expression externalities lead individuals to increase their exposure to out-group identity expression, while negative externalities lead them to reduce it. At the same time, to the extent that identity expression is tied to market consumption, fiscal policy can influence how much identity is expressed by affecting individuals’ disposable income. We develop a theoretical framework in which identity expression externalities are addressed through these two channels: individuals privately adjust their social contacts to manage exposure, while local governments can use taxation to influence the visibility of identity in shared spaces. We study how these mechanisms interact, and how policy depends on which social group the government prioritizes and whether individuals react favorably or unfavorably to out-group expression. We find that governments amplify the behavioral response to diversity by adjusting the intensity of identity signaling through tax policy. We also show that greater openness to diversity can reduce demand for taxation, leading to more visible identity expression but also more private avoidance. The framework can accommodate a range of political-economy, fiscal, and institutional extensions.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105416.abstract_zh: 社会学文献表明，在多元化的社区中，个体通过消费市场商品来表达身份时，会对其他社会群体的成员产生外部性。积极的身份表达外部性促使个体增加对外群体身份表达的接触，而消极的外部性则促使他们减少这种接触。同时，由于身份表达与市场消费紧密相关，财政政策可以通过影响个体的可支配收入来调节身份表达的程度。我们构建了一个理论框架，其中身份表达外部性通过两条渠道得以解决：个体私下调整其社会交往以管理接触，而地方政府则可以利用税收来影响共享空间中身份的可见性。我们研究了这些机制如何相互作用，以及政策如何取决于政府优先考虑哪个社会群体，以及个体对外群体表达是持积极还是消极反应。我们发现，政府通过税收政策调整身份信号的强度，从而放大对多样性的行为反应。我们还表明，对多样性更大的开放性可能减少对税收的需求，导致身份表达更加可见，但同时也增加了私下的回避行为。该框架能够容纳一系列政治经济学、财政和制度方面的扩展。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105416.title: Diversity taxes: Linking identity expression, social contact, and taxation
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105416.title_zh: 多样性税：身份表达、社会接触与税收的关联

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105417.abstract: An understanding of the growth of surgical robotic technology is not only a contribution to the academic literature on the proliferation of new technology, but also it is a precursor to effective U.S. public policies toward this burgeoning new technology and possibly toward potential future standard-setting dimensions of an emerging ecosystem. Using patent application information from filings with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office, we characterize the growth of this technology in terms of a traditional S-curve model. We also hypothesize a theory of the distribution of surgical robotic technology, and we test our theory empirically.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105417.abstract_zh: 对手术机器人技术增长的理解，不仅是对新技术扩散学术文献的贡献，也是美国针对这一新兴技术制定有效公共政策，乃至可能为未来新兴生态系统标准设定维度奠定基础的前提。利用向美国专利商标局提交的专利申请信息，我们以传统的S曲线模型刻画了该技术的增长特征。我们还提出了一个关于手术机器人技术分布的理论假设，并对其进行了实证检验。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105417.title: The Growth of Surgical Robotic Technology
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105417.title_zh: 手术机器人技术的发展

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105418.abstract: Variations in the low- and high-frequency components of temperature may have distinct impacts on economic outcomes. Parametric and non-parametric estimates from three panels of data all find significant heterogeneity in the relative importance of the two components, but there is clear evidence in each panel of a common, slowly evolving low-frequency factor that is highly correlated with the low-frequency factor of economic activity. In regressions that quantify the output effects of the components, we find that one-way clustered standard errors often lead to size distortions, and that an additive fixed effect specification does not adequately control for common time effects. Using bootstrap inference to assess estimates from our preferred interactive fixed effect specification, we only find a marginally significant effect of the high-frequency component on growth in the U.S. panel. However, the effect of the low-frequency component is significant in the European and International panels, suggesting that the increase in the low-frequency temperature component over the post-1980 period is associated with a reduction in economic growth of approximately 1.3 percentage points. The findings are corroborated by time series estimation using data at the unit and national levels.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105418.abstract_zh: 温度的低频与高频成分变化可能对经济产出产生不同影响。基于三组面板数据的参数与非参数估计均发现，这两种成分的相对重要性存在显著异质性，但每组数据中均清晰显示出一个共同的、缓慢演变低频因子，该因子与经济活动的低频因子高度相关。在量化各成分对产出影响的回归分析中，我们发现单向聚类标准误常导致规模失真，且加性固定效应模型未能充分控制共同时间效应。采用自助法推断评估我们偏好的交互固定效应模型估计结果时，仅在美国面板中发现高频成分对增长的边际显著效应。然而，在欧洲和国际面板中，低频成分的影响显著，表明1980年后低频温度成分的上升与经济增长率约1.3个百分点的下降相关联。这些发现通过使用单位和国家层面数据的时间序列估计得到了进一步证实。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105418.title: The economic impact of low- and high-frequency temperature changes
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105418.title_zh: 低频与高频温度变化的经济影响

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105419.title: Editorial: A Family Perspective on Education, Health, and Gender
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105419.title_zh: 编者按：教育、健康与性别问题的家庭视角

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105420.title: Europe in a Changing World: Resilience, Industrial Policy, and the Political Economy of Fragmentation
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105420.title_zh: 变化世界中的欧洲：韧性、产业政策与碎片化的政治经济学

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105421.abstract: We examine the role of state-dependent distribution frictions in the transmission of monetary policy shocks in a dynamic multi-sector general equilibrium model. Our benchmark model predicts a counter-cyclical distribution margin, which is consistent with micro price evidence. We then estimate an augmented model with price and wage rigidities and attribute the lion’s share of this countercyclicality to service-sector productivity shocks. By allowing for distribution frictions to depend on the state of the economy, which substantially alters monetary transmission, we find that state dependence weakens the real effects of monetary policy by dampening the consumption response to monetary shocks. In stark contrast, such a result cannot be replicated when distribution frictions are time-invariant. Our findings highlight a novel channel through which the interplay between sectoral productivity and distribution frictions jointly influences monetary policy transmission.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105421.abstract_zh: 我们考察了状态依赖型分销摩擦在动态多部门一般均衡模型中对货币政策冲击传导的作用。我们的基准模型预测了一个逆周期的分销利润率，这与微观价格证据相符。随后，我们估计了一个包含价格和工资粘性的扩展模型，并将这种逆周期性的主要部分归因于服务部门的生产率冲击。通过允许分销摩擦依赖于经济状态，这显著改变了货币传导机制，我们发现状态依赖性通过抑制消费对货币冲击的反应，削弱了货币政策的实际效应。与此形成鲜明对比的是，当分销摩擦为时间不变时，无法复制这一结果。我们的发现突显了一个新颖的渠道，通过该渠道，部门生产率与分销摩擦之间的相互作用共同影响货币政策的传导。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105421.title: State-dependent distribution friction and the transmission of monetary policy
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105421.title_zh: 状态依赖型分配摩擦与货币政策的传导

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105422.abstract: In this paper, we investigate whether, and to what extent, UK newspapers exhibited image-based bias in their portrayal of politicians during the 2016 Brexit referendum. We use computer vision and machine learning techniques to first, identify the faces of politicians and assess the emotional content conveyed through their expressions and second, to measure the contextual sentiment of the overall image, including elements such as background, objects, and color. Our findings reveal that tabloid newspapers displayed significant partisan bias. Specifically, pro-leave tabloids were more likely to depict pro-leave politicians with positive facial expressions and in more favorable visual contexts, while pro-remain politicians were portrayed more negatively. This bias was especially pronounced in front-page images and those featuring key political figures, while no comparable patterns were found in broadsheets. However, the visual bias diminished immediately after the referendum vote. Our scalable framework not only provides a systematic way to detect visual bias in political imagery but also underscores the growing need for media accountability and visual literacy as images play an increasingly powerful role in shaping political communication.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105422.abstract_zh: 本文探究了2016年英国脱欧公投期间，英国报纸在描绘政治人物时是否存在以及多大程度上存在基于图像的偏见。我们运用计算机视觉与机器学习技术，首先识别政治人物的面部并评估其表情所传达的情感内容，其次衡量整体图像的语境情感，包括背景、物体和色彩等元素。研究结果显示，小报呈现出显著的党派偏见。具体而言，支持脱欧的小报更倾向于以积极的面部表情和更有利的视觉语境描绘支持脱欧的政治人物，而支持留欧的政治人物则被更负面地呈现。这种偏见在头版图像及关键政治人物特写中尤为突出，而大报中未发现类似模式。然而，视觉偏见在公投投票结束后立即减弱。我们提出的可扩展框架不仅为检测政治图像中的视觉偏见提供了系统性方法，也凸显了随着图像在塑造政治传播中日益增强的作用，媒体问责与视觉素养的需求正不断增长。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105422.title: Visual bias in the Brexit referendum: A quantitative analysis of newspaper images
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105422.title_zh: 英国脱欧公投中的视觉偏见：报纸图像的定量分析

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105423.abstract: Many high-stakes organisational decisions are made by committees, where members exert costly influence to shape a single collective outcome. When committees are gender-imbalanced, the salience of gender identity may affect who mobilises influence and how numerical power translates into effective decision weight. We study how gender-identity salience interacts with numerical power in a controlled laboratory setting using a group-contest design. We vary the numerical balance of power (Female-Majority vs. Male-Majority) and manipulate whether gender composition is revealed. We find larger, advantaged groups invest significantly more and identity salience has asymmetric effects by gender. Among minority men facing female-majority groups, making gender salient increases investment and their initial disadvantage shrinks over time. Among minority women facing male-majority groups, investment does not increase and their relative disadvantage grows over time. These divergent responses are not explained by general social preferences or in-group cohesion. The findings suggest highlighting gender identity may intensify mobilisation by minority men without similarly empowering minority women, with implications for the design of diversity and transparency policies.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105423.abstract_zh: 许多高风险的组织决策由委员会作出，其中成员投入高昂的影响力以塑造单一的集体结果。当委员会性别失衡时，性别身份的显著性可能影响谁动员影响力，以及数字上的权力如何转化为有效的决策权重。我们通过一个群体竞赛设计，在受控实验室环境中研究性别身份显著性与数字权力的相互作用。我们变化权力的数字平衡（女性占多数与男性占多数），并操纵性别构成是否被揭示。我们发现，规模较大且占优势的群体投资显著更多，且身份显著性对性别的影响具有不对称性。在面临女性占多数群体的少数男性中，使性别显著会增加投资，其初始劣势随时间缩小。在面临男性占多数群体的少数女性中，投资并未增加，其相对劣势随时间扩大。这些不同的反应无法由一般社会偏好或群体内聚力解释。研究结果表明，强调性别身份可能加剧少数男性的动员，而不会同样增强少数女性的力量，这对多样性和透明度政策的设计具有启示意义。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105423.title: Gender identity and power imbalance in a group contest
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105423.title_zh: 群体竞赛中的性别认同与权力失衡

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105424.abstract: Facilitated giving, a common yet under-researched form of cause-related marketing (CRM), involves companies collecting donations from customers to support charitable causes. This study examines the impact of facilitated giving on revenue from ticket sales at an opera house through two large-scale field experiments involving over 50,000 customers. The charitable initiative supported a social youth project aimed at enhancing cultural education and social integration for individuals from disadvantaged households. We found that a particularly pervasive donation ask led to a significant short-term reduction in ticket purchases by non-donors. However, this adverse effect was short-lived and we did not find any effect of the program on total revenue from tickets and donations, neither in the short run nor in the long run.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105424.abstract_zh: 便利捐赠，作为一种常见但研究不足的公益关联营销形式，涉及企业收集顾客捐款以支持慈善事业。本研究通过两项涉及超过50,000名顾客的大规模现场实验，考察了便利捐赠对歌剧院门票销售收入的影响。所支持的慈善项目旨在为来自弱势家庭的人群提升文化教育和社会融入。我们发现，一种尤为普遍的捐款请求导致非捐赠者在短期内显著减少了门票购买。然而，这一不利影响是短暂的，且我们未发现该计划对门票及捐款总收入有任何影响，无论是在短期还是长期内。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105424.title: The Double-Edged Sword of Facilitated Giving: Field Evidence on Sales and Donations
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105424.title_zh: 促进捐赠的双刃剑：关于销售与捐赠的实地证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105425.abstract: We model the interaction between shareholder trading and voting on firm policies that create externalities for which investors have heterogenous preferences, and we test the model’s equilibrium predictions in the laboratory. The model suggests, and laboratory results confirm, that low policy costs favor policy adoption while intermediate costs lead to a lower policy adoption rate under dispersed preferences than under polarized preferences. Observed share prices are higher than equilibrium predictions when the policy is adopted and are close to the fundamental value of the firm had the policy not been adopted. We conclude that the adoption of costly policies with externalities may be less burdensome to shareholders than predicted.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105425.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，用以分析股东交易与投票在制定具有外部性的公司政策时的相互作用，其中投资者对这些外部性存在异质性偏好，并通过实验室实验检验了模型的均衡预测。模型表明（且实验结果证实）：低政策成本有利于政策采纳，而在中等成本条件下，分散偏好下的政策采纳率低于极化偏好。当政策被采纳时，观察到的股价高于均衡预测值，且接近未采纳政策时公司的基本面价值。我们得出结论：具有外部性的高成本政策对股东的负担可能低于理论预测。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105425.title: Trade, Voting, and Firm Policies: Theory and Evidence
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105425.title_zh: 贸易、投票与企业政策：理论与证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105426.abstract: We compile a unique dataset linking micro price data underlying the official Swedish producer price index with administrative firm level data and provide new evidence on the inflationary effects of global supply chain shocks. For identification, we interact exogenous shocks to global supply chains, obtained through a VAR model, with firm-specific import shares. Shocks to global supply chains lead to a significant and persistent increase in producer prices with a peak response after two years. Importantly, average responses mask heterogeneous responses across firms. Relatively larger firms, firms with lower labor costs and a higher market share raise prices more strongly.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105426.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个独特的数据集，将瑞典官方生产者价格指数背后的微观价格数据与行政企业层面数据相结合，为全球供应链冲击的通胀效应提供了新证据。为进行识别，我们通过VAR模型获取的全球供应链外生冲击与企业特定的进口份额进行交互作用。全球供应链冲击导致生产者价格显著且持续上升，峰值反应出现在两年后。重要的是，平均反应掩盖了企业间的异质性反应。相对较大的企业、劳动成本较低且市场份额较高的企业，其价格上调幅度更大。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105426.title: The inflationary effects of global supply chain shocks: Evidence from Swedish microdata
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105426.title_zh: 全球供应链冲击的通胀效应：来自瑞典微观数据的证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105427.abstract: New importers increase their conditional survival rate and import share over time. However, a model of multi-input firms with an import entry cost and stochastic import costs cannot replicate these dynamics. I show that an extended model can be reconciled with the data. I calibrate both models and use them to identify the effects of trade shocks. The simulations show that a decrease in import prices with the new importer dynamics generates lower productivity gains, but these gains are more widespread across firms.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105427.abstract_zh: 新进口商的存活率和进口份额随时间推移而提高。然而，一个包含进口进入成本和随机进口成本的多投入企业模型无法复现这些动态特征。本文证明，扩展后的模型能够与数据相吻合。我对两个模型进行了校准，并利用它们识别贸易冲击的影响。模拟结果表明，在新进口商动态特征下，进口价格下降带来的生产率提升幅度较小，但这些提升在企业间的分布更为广泛。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105427.title: New importer dynamics and the effects of trade shocks
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105427.title_zh: 新进口商动态与贸易冲击的影响

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105428.abstract: We present a theory of human capital, with health, skill, and longevity, endogenously determined. Using comparative dynamic analyses and a calibrated version of the theory, we uncover an important economic mechanism driving human-capital formation: whether individuals can influence their longevity. When they can, additional resources are invested in human capital. When they cannot, additional resources are used for consumption and leisure, i.e., “non-productively”. These findings point to the potential importance of endogenous longevity as an economic mechanism driving human-capital formation, and, by extension, human capital-based economic growth.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105428.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种人力资本理论，其中健康、技能和寿命均为内生决定。通过比较动态分析和理论校准版本，我们揭示了驱动人力资本形成的一个重要经济机制：个体能否影响自身寿命。当个体能够影响寿命时，额外资源被投资于人力资本；当不能时，额外资源则用于消费和休闲，即“非生产性”用途。这些发现指出了内生寿命作为驱动人力资本形成，进而推动基于人力资本的经济增长的经济机制，其潜在重要性不容忽视。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105428.title: Human-capital formation: The importance of endogenous longevity
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105428.title_zh: 人力资本形成：内生性寿命的重要性

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105429.abstract: How do culture and institutions jointly shape long-run growth? This paper develops an endogenous growth model in which individualism, property-rights protection, and innovation-driven growth coevolve over time. Parents choose whether to transmit individualist or collectivist values to their children according to the expected future return associated with each trait, while the degree of property-rights protection is determined in political equilibrium. The strategic complementarity between cultural transmission and property-rights protection generates two steady states – an individualistic, innovation-friendly, high-growth regime and a collectivist, expropriating, low-growth regime – and, for intermediate cultural states, an indeterminacy region in which beliefs about future property-rights protection are self-fulfilling. Institutional quality affects growth both directly, by changing the return to innovation, and indirectly, by shaping cultural transmission and the size of the innovative sector. The framework helps explain path dependence, endogenous regime switching, growth miracles, and institutional reversals.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105429.abstract_zh: 文化与制度如何共同塑造长期增长？本文构建了一个内生增长模型，其中个人主义、产权保护与创新驱动的增长随时间共同演化。父母根据每种特质预期的未来回报，选择向子女传递个人主义或集体主义价值观，而产权保护程度则在政治均衡中决定。文化传递与产权保护之间的策略互补性产生了两个稳态——一个个人主义、利于创新、高增长的体制，以及一个集体主义、剥夺性、低增长的体制——并且在中间文化状态下，存在一个不确定性区域，其中对未来产权保护的信念具有自我实现性。制度质量通过两条途径影响增长：直接途径是改变创新的回报，间接途径是塑造文化传递和创新部门的规模。该框架有助于解释路径依赖、内生体制转换、增长奇迹和制度逆转。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105429.title: Culture, institutions and growth

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105430.abstract: Is war good for economic development? Several macrohistorical theories suggest “yes”, yet the supporting evidence relies on war being shocked exogenously. We first examine the raw data from Europe, showing a negative relationship between war and production in both ancient and modern periods. We then create a model to investigate what typical statistical analyses show on data generated with standard conflict mechanisms. We show that typical statistical analyses suggest war positively affects growth in our model economy when it is in fact harmful. We caution against “mostly harmless” regressions that suggest European prosperity comes from its harmful history rather than its peaceful present.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105430.abstract_zh: 战争是否有利于经济发展？若干宏观历史理论倾向于肯定回答，然而其支持证据依赖于战争作为外生冲击的假设。我们首先审视欧洲的原始数据，显示无论在古代还是现代，战争与生产之间均呈负相关关系。随后，我们构建一个模型，探究在标准冲突机制生成的数据上，典型统计分析会呈现何种结果。我们证明，在我们的模型经济中，当战争实际上有害时，典型统计分析却表明战争对增长有积极影响。我们警示，那些看似“基本无害”的回归分析，若暗示欧洲的繁荣源自其苦难历史而非和平现状，则需谨慎对待。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105430.title: The endogenous nature of war and its economic consequences
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105430.title_zh: 战争的内生性及其经济后果

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105431.abstract: Contractions in credit supply can lead firms to reduce their level of employment, yet little is known about how these shocks affect the composition of firms’ employees and outcomes at the worker level. This paper investigates how bank distress affects credit provision and its effects on employment beyond firm-level aggregates. To do so, we use a novel dataset built from administrative and tax records linking all banks, firms, and workers in Denmark. We show that banks that were particularly exposed to the 2008–09 financial crisis cut lending to firms, and firms were unable to fully compensate with financing from alternate sources. The decrease in credit supply led to a drop in firm-level employment, with effects concentrated among firms with low pre-crisis liquidity, and on employment of low-educated and non-managerial workers. At the worker level, we find that increases in the incidence of unemployment were driven by effects on low-educated, non-managerial, short-tenured, and low-earning workers.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105431.abstract_zh: 信贷供给的收缩可能导致企业减少其就业规模，然而，关于这些冲击如何影响企业员工构成及工人层面的结果，我们所知甚少。本文探讨了银行困境如何影响信贷供给，及其对企业总体就业之外的影响。为此，我们利用了一个新颖的数据集，该数据集基于行政和税务记录，关联了丹麦的所有银行、企业和工人。我们研究发现，在2008-09年金融危机中暴露程度较高的银行减少了对企业的贷款，而企业无法通过其他融资渠道完全弥补这一缺口。信贷供给的减少导致企业层面就业下降，其影响主要集中在危机前流动性较低的企业，以及低教育水平和非管理岗位的工人身上。在工人层面，我们发现失业发生率的增加主要由低教育水平、非管理岗位、任期短及低收入工人所受影响驱动。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105431.title: Real effects of credit supply shocks: Evidence from Danish banks, firms, and workers
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105431.title_zh: 信贷供给冲击的真实效应：来自丹麦银行、企业和工人的证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105432.abstract: Fossil fuels have shaped the European economy since the industrial revolution. We use new long-run panel data to analyse the effect of both, coal and oil on economic growth between 1900 and 2015, exploiting variation at the level of European NUTS2 and NUTS3 regions. We show that the reversal of fortune of coal regions resulted from the second energy transition. Specifically, an “oil invasion” in the early 1960s turned regional coal abundance from a blessing into a curse. Human capital accumulation contributed to this reversal of fortune and fully explains the negative effects until today. Moreover, we find substantial heterogeneity between former coal regions that is in line with Glaeser’s “reinvention hypothesis”: regions with a higher skill-level adjusted much better to the decline of coal. In particular, we show that coal regions with a higher urban density before 1800 were much more resilient than others.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105432.abstract_zh: 自工业革命以来，化石燃料深刻塑造了欧洲经济。我们利用新的长期面板数据，以欧洲NUTS2和NUTS3区域为分析单元，考察了1900年至2015年间煤炭与石油对经济增长的影响。研究表明，煤炭产区的命运逆转源于第二次能源转型。具体而言，20世纪60年代初期的"石油入侵"使区域煤炭禀赋从福音转变为诅咒。人力资本积累促成了这一命运逆转，并完全解释了直至今日的负面效应。此外，我们发现前煤炭产区之间存在显著异质性，这与格莱泽的"再造假说"一致：技能水平较高的区域对煤炭产业衰退的适应能力显著更强。特别值得注意的是，1800年前城市密度较高的煤炭产区展现出远超其他地区的经济韧性。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105432.title: Fickle fossils: Economic growth, coal, and the European oil invasion, 1900–2015
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105432.title_zh: 易变化石：经济增长、煤炭与欧洲石油入侵，1900–2015

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105433.abstract: This paper reexamines the consequences of mass layoffs in the French manufacturing sector by linking individual displacement costs to broader local labor-market outcomes. Using matched employer–employee data from 1995 to 2019 and a unified definition of mass layoffs, it provides the first joint assessment of their individual and aggregate effects. Displaced workers experience large and persistent employment and earnings losses. At the local level, unemployment and the number of job seekers rise sharply and remain elevated for several years, with a large local employment multiplier. Two mechanisms connect individual losses to aggregate outcomes: a demand channel, whereby larger wage losses among displaced workers amplify local unemployment, and a housing-related mobility channel linking local housing market conditions to workers’ geographic mobility. Worker reallocations themselves appear inefficient: displaced high-quality workers become less likely to match with high-productivity establishments, while destination firms display lower investment rates and lower value added. We also uncover a critical measurement bias affecting labor productivity assessments. Under standard accounting conventions — where temporary agency workers and their value added are recorded in the service sector rather than in the manufacturing establishments where they actually work — mass layoffs appear to raise productivity. Correcting for this bias fully reverses this apparent productivity gain and instead reveals a substantial productivity decline. Overall, mass layoffs appear individually and socially costly.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105433.abstract_zh: 本文通过将个体置换成本与更广泛的本地劳动力市场结果相联系，重新审视了法国制造业部门大规模裁员的后果。利用1995年至2019年的匹配雇主-雇员数据，并采用统一的大规模裁员定义，本文首次对其个体与总体效应进行了联合评估。被置换的工人经历了巨大且持续的就业和收入损失。在地方层面，失业率和求职者数量急剧上升，并在数年内保持高位，同时存在显著的本地就业乘数效应。两种机制将个体损失与总体结果联系起来：一是需求渠道，即被置换工人更大的工资损失加剧了本地失业；二是与住房相关的流动性渠道，将本地住房市场条件与工人的地理流动性相联系。工人自身的重新配置似乎效率低下：被置换的高质量工人与高生产率企业匹配的可能性降低，而目的地企业则表现出较低的投资率和增加值。我们还揭示了一个影响劳动生产率评估的关键测量偏差。在标准会计惯例下——即临时机构工人及其增加值被记录在服务部门，而非其实际工作的制造业机构中——大规模裁员看似提高了生产率。纠正这一偏差后，这一表面上的生产率提升完全逆转，反而揭示了显著的生产率下降。总体而言，大规模裁员在个体层面和社会层面均代价高昂。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105433.title: Are mass layoffs individually costly but socially beneficial?
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105433.title_zh: 大规模裁员是否对个人代价高昂但对社会有益？

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105434.abstract: Bank leverage constraints can arise from regulatory capital requirements or from central bank collateral requirements in reserve lending. We compare these two policy channels within the so-called “bank money creation” approach. We show that monetary policy via collateral requirements leads to a novel and unique collateral leverage channel. Through this channel, banks facing liquidity constraints can expand loan supply and deposit issuance by raising the collateral value of their loans, which they achieve through tighter loan monitoring. The collateral leverage channel can improve welfare beyond standard bank capital regulation and inform the design of central bank collateral frameworks.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105434.abstract_zh: 银行杠杆约束可能源于监管资本要求，或中央银行在储备贷款中的抵押品要求。我们在所谓的“银行货币创造”框架内比较这两种政策渠道。我们表明，通过抵押品要求实施的货币政策引致了一个新颖且独特的抵押品杠杆渠道。通过这一渠道，面临流动性约束的银行可以通过提高其贷款的抵押品价值来扩大贷款供给和存款发行，而这通过更严格的贷款监控实现。抵押品杠杆渠道能在标准银行资本监管之外增进福利，并为中央银行抵押品框架的设计提供参考。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105434.title: Leverage constraints and bank monitoring: Bank regulation versus monetary policy
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105434.title_zh: 杠杆约束与银行监督：银行监管与货币政策

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105435.abstract: Climate policy uncertainty (CPU) shocks can induce capital reallocation from carbon-intensive sectors to low-emitting sectors. We first show, using a DSGE model with financial frictions and various climate policy tools, that CPU shocks (i) lower the market value of the “dirty” sector relative to the “green” sector and (ii) reduce real investment in the “dirty” sector relative to the “green” sector. The financial channel plays a key role for this reallocation. Second, we document that these results align with firm-level evidence from the US. We find that empirical CPU shocks (i) cause financial markets to revalue firms in carbon-intensive sectors relative to firms in low-emitting sectors, and (ii) lead to substantial investment reallocation, particularly from manufacturing towards services. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105435.abstract_zh: 气候政策不确定性（CPU）冲击可引发资本从碳密集型部门向低排放部门重新配置。我们首先通过构建包含金融摩擦与多种气候政策工具的DSGE模型证明，CPU冲击会（i）降低"高碳"部门相对于"绿色"部门的市值，并（ii）减少"高碳"部门相对于"绿色"部门的实际投资。金融渠道在这一重新配置过程中发挥关键作用。其次，我们证实这些结论与美国企业层面的证据相吻合。实证研究发现，CPU冲击（i）导致金融市场对碳密集型行业企业的估值相对低于低排放行业企业，并（ii）引发显著的投资重新配置，尤其是从制造业向服务业的转移。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105435.title: Capital reallocation under climate policy uncertainty
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105435.title_zh: 气候政策不确定性下的资本再配置

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105436.abstract: Auctions with endogenous rationing have been introduced to stimulate competition. Such (procurement) auctions reduce the volume put out to tender when competition is low. This paper finds a strong negative effect of endogenous rationing on participation when bid-preparation is costly, counteracting the aim to stimulate competition. For multiple auctioneer's objectives mentioned in directives, we derive optimal mechanisms, which differ due to different evaluation of the tradeoff between participation and bid-preparation costs. Thus, the auctioneer needs to decide on an objective. However, reducing bid-preparation costs improves the optimal values of multiple objective functions.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105436.abstract_zh: 内生配给拍卖被引入以刺激竞争。此类（采购）拍卖在竞争不足时会减少招标数量。本文发现，当投标准备成本较高时，内生配给对参与率产生显著的负向效应，这与刺激竞争的目标相悖。针对指令中提及的多种拍卖方目标，我们推导出最优机制，这些机制因对参与率与投标准备成本之间权衡的不同评估而存在差异。因此，拍卖方需要确定一个目标。然而，降低投标准备成本能够改善多个目标函数的最优值。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105436.title: A small volume reduction that melts down the market: Auctions with endogenous rationing
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105436.title_zh: 小规模减量引发市场崩盘：内生配给的拍卖

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105437.abstract: This paper proposes an equilibrium theory of nominal exchange rates, which offers a new perspective on various issues in open economy macroeconomics. The nominal exchange rate and portfolio choices are jointly determined in equilibrium, thus providing a new approach to overcoming the indeterminacy results in Kareken and Wallace (1981). The distinctive features of this theory are that the nominal exchange rate is determined in international financial markets, that the risk premium and UIP deviations are fully endogenous equilibrium objects and that the real exchange rate inherits its properties from the nominal exchange rate. In terms of policy, this novel theory implies that a country with an exchange rate peg and free asset mobility faces a tetralemma and not a trilemma, because it loses not only monetary policy independence but also fiscal policy independence.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105437.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种名义汇率的均衡理论，为开放经济宏观经济学中的诸多问题提供了新视角。名义汇率与资产组合选择在均衡中共同决定，从而为克服卡雷肯与华莱士（1981）中的不确定性结果提供了新途径。该理论的独特之处在于，名义汇率在国际金融市场上确定，风险溢价与未覆盖利率平价偏离均为完全内生的均衡对象，且实际汇率继承了名义汇率的属性。在政策层面，这一新颖理论意味着，实行汇率挂钩且资产自由流动的国家面临的是“四难困境”而非“三难困境”，因为它不仅丧失了货币政策独立性，也丧失了财政政策独立性。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105437.title: An equilibrium theory of nominal exchange rates

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105438.abstract: This paper quantifies the effects of energy price shocks in the euro area and examines the role of ECB monetary policy during the energy crisis. Using a Bayesian VAR identified with sign and narrative restrictions, local projections, and counterfactuals, I show that energy shocks induce persistent and broad-based inflationary pressures while reducing real activity. The pass-through to inflation is state-dependent: it is sizeable and persistent only when inflation is already elevated and when the shock originates from gas and electricity prices. A counterfactual exercise shows that an earlier and more forceful monetary policy tightening would have reduced inflation only at the cost of a sizeable output loss.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105438.abstract_zh: 本文量化了欧元区能源价格冲击的影响，并考察了欧洲央行在能源危机期间的货币政策作用。通过采用基于符号约束与叙事约束识别的贝叶斯向量自回归模型、局部投影法及反事实分析，研究表明能源冲击在抑制实际经济活动的同时，引发了持续且广泛的通胀压力。通胀传导呈现状态依赖性：仅当通胀水平已处于高位且冲击源自天然气与电力价格时，传导效应才显著且持久。反事实模拟显示，若更早实施更强力的货币政策紧缩，虽能降低通胀，但需以显著产出损失为代价。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105438.title: Energy prices, inflation, and the ECB’s monetary policy during the 2021-22 energy crisis
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105438.title_zh: 能源价格、通胀与2021-22年能源危机期间欧洲央行的货币政策

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105439.abstract: We estimate the slope of the Phillips curve in the euro area, allowing for nonlinearities—or kinks—in the relationship between labor market slack and inflation. We exploit cross-country variation in labor market conditions in the period 2001–2024, absorbing aggregate shocks and endogenous monetary policy reactions with time fixed effects. We find that, while the Phillips curve is usually quite flat, it becomes at least three times steeper when the labor market is sufficiently tight. This kink is more pronounced in the euro area than in the United States, potentially due to more rigid labor markets. Our estimates suggest, however, that despite this nonlinearity, most of the post-pandemic inflation surge is attributable to factors other than labor market tightness.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105439.abstract_zh: 我们估计了欧元区菲利普斯曲线的斜率，并允许劳动力市场松弛与通胀之间的关系存在非线性——即拐点。我们利用2001-2024年期间各国劳动力市场状况的跨国差异，通过时间固定效应吸收了总体冲击和内生性货币政策反应。研究发现，尽管菲利普斯曲线通常较为平坦，但当劳动力市场足够紧张时，其斜率至少会陡峭三倍。这一拐点在欧元区比美国更为显著，可能源于欧元区更为僵化的劳动力市场。然而，我们的估计表明，尽管存在这种非线性特征，疫情后通胀飙升的主要原因并非劳动力市场紧张，而是其他因素。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105439.title: Kinky Europe: Evidence from the regional Phillips curve in the euro area
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105439.title_zh: 扭曲的欧洲：来自欧元区区域菲利普斯曲线的证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105446.abstract: This paper studies the role for progressive labor income taxation in the context of social security reform. We propose a novel reform that replaces redistributive pensions with a contribution-based system while simultaneously increasing the progressivity of labor income taxation to preserve social insurance. Using a stylized model, we show that the benefit of such reform is derived from the Frisch elasticity of labor supply. For sufficiently high values, the reform can be fiscally neutral and Pareto-improving. We then evaluate the reform in a full general equilibrium model calibrated to the U.S. economy. Quantitative results on the efficiency-insurance trade-offs are in line with our theoretical predictions. In the steady-state, for plausible values of the Frisch elasticity, the fiscal space generated by increased labor supply is sufficient to compensate through lump-sum transfers the loss of pension-based insurance. These results carry over to transition dynamics: the reform yields a Pareto improvement along the transition path. Our findings highlight the potential for tax-based redistribution to replace pension-based insurance.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105446.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在社会保障改革背景下，累进劳动所得税的作用。我们提出了一项新颖的改革方案，即以缴费制养老金取代再分配型养老金，同时提高劳动所得税的累进性以维持社会保险。通过一个简化模型，我们证明此类改革的收益源于劳动供给的弗里斯弹性。当该弹性足够高时，改革可实现财政中性并达到帕累托改进。随后，我们在一个校准至美国经济的完整一般均衡模型中评估了这一改革。关于效率与保险权衡的量化结果与我们的理论预测一致。在稳态下，对于合理的弗里斯弹性值，由劳动供给增加所产生的财政空间足以通过一次性转移支付补偿因养老金保险减少而带来的损失。这些结论同样适用于转型动态：改革在转型路径上实现了帕累托改进。我们的发现凸显了基于税收的再分配替代基于养老金的保险的潜力。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105446.title: Progressing towards efficiency: The role for labor tax progression in reforming social security
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105446.title_zh: 迈向效率：劳动税累进性在社会保障改革中的作用

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105447.abstract: This paper provides a direct replication of Fehr et al. (2022), who examine whether information about individuals’ position in the global income distribution affects preferences over global inequality. Whereas the original study draws on a representative sample from Germany, we analyze a broadly representative UK sample ( N = 2116 ). UK respondents underestimate their global rank by about 2.4 deciles on average, yet randomly providing accurate rank information has no detectable effect on real-stakes donations to international anti-poverty NGOs or on policy attitudes toward global redistribution, international organizations, globalization, or immigration. The estimated average treatment effects are small, close to zero, and precisely estimated. A data-driven heterogeneity analysis reveals no sizable or systematic differences in subgroup responses. Overall, the results reinforce the evidence that correcting global income misperceptions alone is unlikely to shift preferences over global inequality in the European settings studied so far.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105447.abstract_zh: 本文对Fehr等人（2022）的研究进行了直接复制，该研究探讨了关于个体在全球收入分配中位置的信息是否会影响其对全球不平等的偏好。原研究基于德国代表性样本，而我们则分析了一个广泛代表性的英国样本（N = 2116）。英国受访者平均低估其全球排名约2.4个十分位，但随机提供准确的排名信息对实际捐赠给国际反贫困非政府组织的行为，以及对全球再分配、国际组织、全球化或移民的政策态度，均未产生可检测的影响。估计的平均处理效应较小，接近于零，且估计精确。数据驱动的异质性分析显示，各子群体间不存在显著或系统性的差异。总体而言，研究结果进一步证实，在迄今研究的欧洲情境中，仅纠正全球收入认知偏差不太可能改变对全球不平等的偏好。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105447.title: Relative income and global inequality: Evidence from the United Kingdom
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105447.title_zh: 相对收入与全球不平等：来自英国的证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105451.title: Introduction to the special issue on market power: A search-theoretic approach
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105451.title_zh: 市场势力特刊导论：基于搜寻理论的方法

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105452.abstract: The attention on multi-product firms has focused primarily on firms’ product scope, i.e., how many products firms sell, rather than on which products they co-produce and sell. We address this by developing a stochastic heterogeneous-firm model that allows for correlations in production efficiencies across products and in consumers’ tastes across products and destinations. Our estimation strategy centers on a novel extension of generalized score matching. We use Chinese export data for the leather sector. The estimates reveal a clustered co-exportation structure consistent with correlated efficiency shocks across products sharing similar production processes.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105452.abstract_zh: 关于多产品企业的研究，主要聚焦于企业的产品范围，即企业销售多少种产品，而非它们共同生产和销售哪些产品。我们通过构建一个随机异质性企业模型来解决这一问题，该模型允许不同产品间的生产效率以及不同产品和目的地间的消费者偏好存在相关性。我们的估计策略围绕广义得分匹配的一种新颖扩展展开。我们利用中国皮革行业的出口数据。估计结果显示，存在一种聚类共出口结构，这与共享相似生产流程的产品间效率冲击的相关性相一致。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105452.title: Co-exportation of products by multi-product firms
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105452.title_zh: 多产品企业的产品协同出口

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105453.abstract: Under simple majority voting an absolute majority of voters may choose policies that are harmful to minorities. It is the purpose of sub- and supermajority rules to protect legitimate minority interests. We study how voting rules are chosen under the veil of ignorance and whether there are systematic biases in these choices. In our experiment, individuals choose voting rules for given distributions of gains and losses that can arise from a policy, but before learning their own valuation of the policy. We find that subjects on average adjust the voting rule in line with the skewness of the distribution. As a result, a higher share of the achievable surplus can be extracted with the suggested rules than with exogenously given simple majority voting. While the rule choices are not significantly biased towards under- or overprotection of the minority, towards majority voting or towards status-quo preserving rules, they only imperfectly reflect the distributions of benefits and costs. In expectation this leads to only 63% of the surplus being extracted. The participants are heterogeneous with respect to how well their rule choices adapt to the distribution of valuations, with a large share of the surplus loss caused by a small group of participants.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105453.abstract_zh: 在简单多数投票制下，绝对多数的选民可能选择对少数群体有害的政策。设立少数和绝对多数规则的目的在于保护合法的少数群体利益。我们研究在无知之幕下投票规则如何被选择，以及这些选择中是否存在系统性偏差。在我们的实验中，个体在得知政策可能带来的收益与损失分布后，但在了解自身对政策估值之前，选择投票规则。我们发现，受试者平均会根据分布的偏度调整投票规则。因此，与外部给定的简单多数投票相比，所建议的规则能够提取更高比例的可行剩余。尽管规则选择并未显著偏向于对少数群体的过度或不足保护，也未偏向于多数投票或维持现状的规则，但它们仅不完美地反映了收益与成本的分布。预期而言，这导致仅提取了63%的剩余。参与者在规则选择适应估值分布的程度方面存在异质性，其中大部分剩余损失由一小部分参与者造成。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105453.title: Minority Protection in Voting Mechanisms – Experimental Evidence
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105453.title_zh: 投票机制中的少数群体保护——实验证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105454.abstract: We study the effect of reducing welfare assistance on migrants’ long-term integration in Australia. The reform applied to primary carers of children, delaying welfare benefit eligibility during their first two years in the country. Importantly, the reform was announced after migrants had arrived in Australia. Using a Regression Discontinuity Design and two decades of administrative welfare data, we find that the reform led to a significant and persistent reduction in overall welfare receipt up to 21 years after arrival, with effects that are particularly pronounced among migrants from more disadvantaged backgrounds. Increases in labour income were insufficient to offset the reduction in welfare benefits, and suggestive evidence indicates that migrants face a trade-off between higher-paying jobs and employment stability.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105454.abstract_zh: 我们研究了减少福利援助对澳大利亚移民长期融入的影响。该改革针对儿童的主要照顾者，将他们在该国头两年的福利资格获取时间推迟。重要的是，这项改革是在移民抵达澳大利亚之后才宣布的。利用断点回归设计及二十年的行政福利数据，我们发现该改革导致移民在抵达后长达21年的总体福利领取显著且持续减少，这一效应在来自更弱势背景的移民中尤为明显。劳动收入的增加不足以弥补福利削减带来的损失，且初步证据表明，移民面临高薪工作与就业稳定性之间的权衡。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105454.title: Welfare reform and migrants’ long-term labor market integration
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105454.title_zh: 福利改革与移民的长期劳动力市场融入

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105455.abstract: This paper considers equilibrium trade in a real estate market. When search is directed, buyers have private independent values, and sellers compete on asking prices, stock-flow matching characterises equilibrium outcomes. Consistent with the data, equilibrium not only generates large and variable price spikes for new listing sales; unsuccessful sellers lower their asking prices over time; and there is equilibrium asking price dispersion. Bidding war data demonstrate that the match surplus is substantial: a lower bound equals 3.3% of house price, whereas ballpark examples suggest match surplus is around 10%.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105455.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了房地产市场中的均衡交易。在定向搜索条件下，买方拥有私人独立价值，卖方在要价上竞争，存量-流量匹配刻画了均衡结果。与数据一致，均衡不仅导致新挂牌销售出现大幅且多变的房价飙升；未成功售出的卖方会随时间降低要价；且存在均衡要价离散现象。竞价战数据表明，匹配剩余相当可观：其下限相当于房价的3.3%，而粗略估算示例则显示匹配剩余约为10%。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105455.title: Bidding wars in the housing market: When directed search becomes stock-flow matching
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105455.title_zh: 住房市场中的竞价战：当定向搜索变为存量-流量匹配时

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105456.abstract: Owner-occupied housing is exempt from property taxes in many countries. How does this exemption affect house prices, homeownership, and welfare? And if owner-occupied housing were taxed, should the tax be progressive? To address these questions, I develop a life-cycle model of homeownership with heterogeneous agents in which property taxation affects both the cost of owning and renting through the taxation of real-estate firms. I calibrate the model to match key features of a housing market with an owner-occupied exemption and a regressive effective property tax schedule. I study revenue-neutral reforms that remove the exemption and vary tax progressivity. Eliminating the exemption increases property tax revenues by over 1.2 percentage points of GDP but reduces homeownership substantially. However, moving to a flat or progressive property tax offsets part of this decline while still generating sizable revenue gains. These reforms improve long-run welfare for new generations, particularly for lower-income households, but reduce the welfare of households alive at the time of the reform, highlighting underlying political tensions.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105456.abstract_zh: 在许多国家，自有住房免征房产税。这一免税政策如何影响房价、住房拥有率及社会福利？若对自有住房征税，该税种是否应具有累进性？为解答这些问题，我构建了一个包含异质性代理人的生命周期住房拥有模型，其中房产税通过对房地产企业征税，同时影响购房与租赁成本。我将模型校准至与一个实行自有住房免税及累退性有效房产税税制的住房市场关键特征相匹配。我研究了取消免税并调整税收累进性的收入中性改革方案。取消免税将使房产税收入增加超过GDP的1.2个百分点，但会显著降低住房拥有率。然而，转向统一税率或累进性房产税可在部分抵消这一下降的同时，仍带来可观的收入增长。这些改革提升了新一代人的长期福利，尤其是对低收入家庭，但降低了改革时在世家庭的福利，凸显了潜在的政治张力。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105456.title: Why Not Tax It? The effects of property taxes on house prices and homeownership
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105456.title_zh: 为何不征税？房产税对房价与住房自有率的影响

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105457.abstract: Managing time is an important aspect of student success. In this paper, we identify the impacts of a student’s timetable on their attendance, study habits, and academic achievement. We use detailed administrative and survey data from a public UK university that includes students from a broad range of degree programmes. Our data feature quasi-random assignment of students to their timetables and measure their individual hourly attendance decisions. We consider multiple aspects of timetables including single-class days, back-to-back classes, time-of-day, day-of-instruction and total hours. We find that student attendance is highly dependent on timetable structure. Single-class days reduce attendance and back-to-back classes raise it. Attendance also varies by time-of-day and day-of-week. We document that students compensate for marginal non-attendance at some events with increased attendance at others within the same module and that more conscientious students respond by increasing study time. Net of all behavioural responses, however, these timetable features and attendance choices do not have systematic impacts on academic achievement. Subsample analysis suggests that lab-based modules and compulsory modules are where timetables may play the most meaningful role in impacting marks.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105457.abstract_zh: 时间管理是学生成功的重要方面。本文旨在识别学生课程表对其出勤、学习习惯及学业成绩的影响。我们利用来自英国一所公立大学的详细行政与调查数据，该数据涵盖广泛学位课程的学生。我们的数据特点在于学生课程表的准随机分配，并测量了学生每小时的出勤决策。我们考察了课程表的多个方面，包括单日单课、连续课程、上课时段、教学日及总课时。研究发现，学生出勤高度依赖于课程表结构。单日单课降低了出勤率，而连续课程则提高了出勤率。出勤情况亦随上课时段和星期几而变化。我们记录到，学生会在同一模块内以增加其他活动出勤的方式，来补偿对某些活动的边际缺勤，且更为认真的学生会通过增加学习时间作为回应。然而，在考虑所有行为反应后，这些课程表特征及出勤选择并未对学业成绩产生系统性影响。子样本分析表明，实验室模块和必修模块是课程表可能对成绩产生最显著影响的领域。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105457.title: Timetables, attendance and academic achievement in higher education
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105457.title_zh: 高等教育中的课程表、出勤率与学业成绩

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105458.abstract: We study the product-level effects of Preferential Trade Agreements (PTAs) on the implementation of non-tariff measures (NTMs) using a global database spanning the 2000-2017 period. Employing an instrumental variable strategy, we provide evidence that an increase in the import share of PTA partners leads to a reduction in the application of NTMs. Exploring several mechanisms, we find that these effects are driven by products with higher preferential margins, the gap between MFN and preferential tariff rates. This result is consistent with what we call a “rent preservation effect,” whereby PTA partner countries push to limit the imposition of NTMs in order to preserve their preferential rents. We find that the negative PTA-NTM nexus is stronger for deeper PTAs, technical NTMs, and advanced economies. But there is no evidence that the effects are confined to NTMs that target broader or narrower sets of countries, agricultural products, or products that are subject to more NTMs. Importantly, higher PTA import shares contribute to multilateral liberalization by lowering both the usage of NTMs against PTA members and non-PTA partners.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105458.abstract_zh: 我们利用覆盖2000-2017年期间的全球数据库，研究了特惠贸易协定（PTAs）对非关税措施（NTMs）实施的产品层面影响。采用工具变量策略，我们提供的证据表明，PTA伙伴国进口份额的增加会导致NTMs适用减少。通过探索多种机制，我们发现这些效应由具有较高特惠幅度（即最惠国税率与特惠税率之间的差距）的产品所驱动。这一结果与我们所谓的“租金保全效应”相一致，即PTA伙伴国推动限制NTMs的施加，以维护其特惠租金。我们发现，PTA与NTM之间的负向关联在更深层次的PTA、技术性NTMs以及发达经济体中更为显著。但没有证据表明这些效应仅限于针对更广泛或更狭窄国家群体、农产品或受更多NTMs约束的产品。重要的是，较高的PTA进口份额通过降低对PTA成员国及非PTA伙伴国的NTMs使用，促进了多边自由化。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105458.title: Preferential trade agreements and non-tariff measures
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105458.title_zh: 优惠贸易协定与非关税措施

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105459.abstract: This paper studies how financial development affects business cycles through entrepreneurial composition. Using Argentine microdata, I show that self-employed entrepreneurs are concentrated below the median of the income distribution and have countercyclical population shares, while employer entrepreneurs are concentrated above the median and have procyclical shares. Motivated by these patterns, I develop a dynamic occupational choice model with aggregate risk in which endogenous sorting across occupations shapes macroeconomic fluctuations. In the calibrated model, financial development raises aggregate output volatility by 8 percent because relaxing collateral constraints shifts economic activity toward employer entrepreneurs, who are more sensitive to aggregate shocks. These findings show that while financial development raises long-run output, it may also increase short-run instability.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105459.abstract_zh: 本文研究了金融发展如何通过企业家构成影响经济周期。利用阿根廷微观数据，我展示了自雇型企业家集中于收入分布中位数以下，其人口份额呈逆周期特征，而雇主型企业家则集中于中位数以上，其份额呈顺周期特征。受这些模式启发，我构建了一个包含总体风险的动态职业选择模型，其中跨职业的内生分类塑造了宏观经济波动。在校准模型中，金融发展使总体产出波动性提高了8%，因为放松抵押约束将经济活动转向对总体冲击更为敏感的雇主型企业家。这些发现表明，尽管金融发展提升了长期产出，但也可能加剧短期不稳定性。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105459.title: Entrepreneurial heterogeneity, financial development, and business cycle dynamics
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105459.title_zh: 创业异质性、金融发展与商业周期动态

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105460.abstract: This paper examines a novel channel through which trade agreements affect product quality upgrading. Specifically, we analyze the impact of the US granting Permanent Normal Trade Relations (PNTR) status to China—a policy shift that effectively eliminated trade policy uncertainty (TPU) on imports from China. Using a triple-difference estimation strategy, we find that eliminating TPU encourages Chinese incumbent exporters to improve product quality. This quality-enhancing effect is particularly pronounced among low-productivity firms, firms in industries with high sunk costs, and firms located in regions with favorable market conditions. Quality upgrading by incumbents drives aggregate quality improvement, and ignoring this adjustment would underestimate the benefits for US consumers.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105460.abstract_zh: 本文考察了贸易协定影响产品质量升级的一个新渠道。具体而言，我们分析了美国给予中国永久正常贸易关系（PNTR）地位——这一政策变化实质上消除了对中国进口的贸易政策不确定性（TPU）——所产生的影响。运用三重差分估计策略，我们发现消除贸易政策不确定性会激励中国在位出口商提升产品质量。这一质量提升效应在低生产率企业、高沉没成本行业中的企业以及位于市场条件有利地区的企业中尤为显著。在位企业的质量升级推动了整体质量的提升，而忽视这一调整将低估美国消费者所获得的福利。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105460.title: Sailing in calmer waters: Trade policy uncertainty and product quality
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105460.title_zh: 在平静水域航行：贸易政策不确定性与产品质量

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105461.abstract: What are the long-run economic consequences of short-lived but intense institutional shocks? We study the post–World War II occupation of Austria, where the country was divided into Soviet and Western Allied zones for ten years before reunification. Using a spatial regression discontinuity design combined with a difference-in-differences approach, we show that areas initially occupied by Soviet forces remain significantly less economically developed today. These regions are less populated, host fewer and lower-paying jobs, and exhibit substantially higher rates of out-commuting than comparable areas in the former Western zones. We show that these persistent differences are driven by a large population flight triggered by the onset of the Soviet occupation, which durably shifted the spatial distribution of economic activity. This initial migration shock altered local agglomeration forces, leading to sustained regional divergence despite the restoration of a unified institutional framework. Our findings highlight how even temporary institutional shocks can have long-lasting economic effects.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105461.abstract_zh: 短暂但剧烈的制度冲击会带来怎样的长期经济后果？我们研究了二战后奥地利被占领时期的情况，该国在统一前被划分为苏联和西方盟军占领区长达十年。利用空间断点回归设计与双重差分法相结合的方法，我们发现最初由苏联军队占领的地区至今经济发展水平仍显著较低。这些地区人口较少，就业岗位数量更少且薪资更低，并且相比前西方占领区的可比地区，呈现出明显更高的外出通勤率。我们证明，这些持续差异是由苏联占领开始引发的大规模人口外流所驱动的，这一人口流动持久地改变了经济活动的空间分布。这一初始迁移冲击改变了地方集聚力量，导致尽管恢复了统一的制度框架，区域分化仍持续存在。我们的研究结果凸显了即使是暂时的制度冲击也可能产生长期的经济影响。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105461.title: The long-term effects of military occupations: Evidence from post-world war II Austria
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105461.title_zh: 军事占领的长期效应：来自二战后奥地利的证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105462.abstract: We examine cooperation and defection in populations where individuals use both procedural rationality and imitation to choose their strategies. For a broad class of sampling-based choice procedures that encompasses both procedural rationality and imitation, we characterize the conditions under which universal defection is unstable. The results highlight that for cooperation to emerge and persist, the manner in which agents generate and share information can be as important as the underlying payoff incentives.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105462.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在个体同时运用程序理性与模仿来选择策略的群体中的合作与背叛行为。针对一类广泛的基于抽样的选择程序，该程序涵盖了程序理性与模仿，我们刻画了普遍背叛不稳定的条件。结果表明，要使合作得以涌现并持续，代理人生成和分享信息的方式可能与潜在的收益激励同样重要。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105462.title: Procedural rationality, endogenous sampling, and the instability of defection
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105462.title_zh: 程序理性、内生抽样与背叛的不稳定性

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105463.abstract: This paper explores the role played by comparative advantage in shaping the impact that trade has on a firm’s product quality across industries. We develop a Heckscher-Ohlin model with firm heterogeneity and endogenous quality upgrading. Trade openness increases an exporter’s product quality differently across industries, with a larger effect in a country’s comparative advantage industry. Differences in factor endowments across countries translate into differences in factor prices which affect the firm’s marginal costs of production. The cost-advantage that firms enjoy in a country’s comparative advantage industry increases firm’s prospective market size abroad, increasing the incentives to invest in product quality. Introducing endogenous firm-level comparative advantage based on differences in factor intensity within an industry, reveals that the firm’s response to trade openness in terms of quality choice is shaped by the firm and industry determinants of comparative advantage: Firms that use more intensively the factor in which the country is more abundant will increase quality to a larger extent. Using transaction-level data from Chinese firms, we find empirical support for the model predictions; Chinese exporters produce higher-quality products in those industries in which China reveals a comparative advantage.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105463.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了比较优势在塑造贸易对企业跨行业产品质量影响中所扮演的角色。我们构建了一个包含企业异质性与内生质量升级的赫克歇尔-俄林模型。贸易开放对不同行业出口商产品质量的提升作用存在差异，且在一国具有比较优势的行业中效应更为显著。各国要素禀赋的差异转化为要素价格的差异，进而影响企业的边际生产成本。企业在国家比较优势行业中所享有的成本优势扩大了其海外潜在市场规模，从而增强了投资于产品质量的激励。通过引入基于行业内要素密集度差异的企业层面内生比较优势，我们发现企业对贸易开放的质量选择反应受企业及行业比较优势决定因素的共同影响：更密集使用该国相对充裕要素的企业，其质量提升幅度更大。利用中国企业交易层面的数据，我们为模型预测提供了实证支持；中国出口商在其显示比较优势的行业中生产更高质量的产品。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105463.title: Comparative advantage and the quality choice of heterogeneous firms
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105463.title_zh: 比较优势与异质性企业的质量选择

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105464.abstract: We map the evolution of economics research from 1998 to 2019 to assess progress and identify remaining challenges. Using text mining of 30,675 full-text articles and an in-depth analysis of 578,132 statistical tests from 3746 articles across a broad range of journals, we document changes in research practices over time. We highlight the influence of the credibility revolution and the open science movement. Awareness of reproducibility has increased modestly, largely driven by journal adoption of data and code sharing policies. At the same time, reliance on non-public data has grown, especially among authors at top-five universities, posing new challenges for transparency. Sample sizes have increased substantially, while reported effect sizes have declined, consistent with reduced exaggeration and potentially more policy-relevant estimates. Econometric methods and causal inference practices have become more sophisticated, and articles now report more tables and statistical tests. However, pre-analysis plans, power analyses accompanying null results, and corrections for multiple hypothesis testing remain uncommon. Article length has remained stable or declined slightly, and authors from top-five universities continue to represent a large and stable share of publications in top journals. Our findings provide a baseline for tracking future developments and for guiding efforts to further strengthen the credibility and transparency of economics research.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105464.abstract_zh: 我们描绘了1998年至2019年间经济学研究的演变轨迹，旨在评估进展并识别尚存挑战。通过对30,675篇全文文章进行文本挖掘，并对涵盖广泛期刊的3,746篇文章中的578,132项统计检验进行深入分析，我们记录了研究实践随时间的变化。我们着重强调了可信度革命与开放科学运动的影响。对可复现性的认识有所提升，但幅度温和，这主要得益于期刊采纳数据和代码共享政策。与此同时，对非公开数据的依赖有所增加，尤其是在顶尖五所大学的作者群体中，这为透明度带来了新的挑战。样本量显著增大，而报告的效果量则有所下降，这与夸大效应的减少及估计结果可能更贴近政策相关性相一致。计量经济学方法与因果推断实践日益精进，文章现在报告了更多的表格和统计检验。然而，预分析计划、伴随零结果出现的功效分析以及多重假设检验的校正仍不常见。文章篇幅保持稳定或略有缩短，顶尖五所大学的作者在顶级期刊发表论文中仍占据较大且稳定的份额。我们的发现为追踪未来发展趋势及指导进一步加强经济学研究可信度与透明度的努力提供了基准。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105464.title: How did empirical economic research improve over the last decades: Recent trends and prospects
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105464.title_zh: 近几十年来实证经济研究如何改进：近期趋势与展望

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105465.title: Field Experiments to Reduce Inequality: Introduction to the Special Issue
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105465.title_zh: 减少不平等的实地实验：特刊导言

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105466.abstract: We investigate links between routine-biased technical change, the structure of occupational employment, and cross-country income differences. To implement this, we combine several data sources, including national labour force surveys and the Penn World Tables. In our novel dataset spanning 92 countries, we document a negative relationship between the employment share of routine occupations and GDP per hour worked. We then conduct a development accounting exercise in which we differentiate labour inputs by occupation and allow for occupation-specific technologies. We find a systematic relationship between occupation-specific productivities and development. Labour in routine occupations tends to be much more productive in richer countries, with effective productivity in the top 25 percent being about 14 times higher than in the bottom 25 percent of countries ranked by GDP per hour worked. Cross-country gaps in routine technology alone account for about 17 percent of the 90–10 ratio of GDP per hour worked, whereas differences in abstract labour technology do not contribute to the observed GDP dispersion. Eliminating all occupations’ and capital’s technology differences would compress the GDP distribution by 32 to 40 percent.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105466.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了常规偏向型技术变革、职业就业结构与跨国收入差异之间的联系。为实现这一目标，我们整合了包括国家劳动力调查和宾大世界表在内的多个数据源。在我们覆盖92个国家的新数据集中，我们记录了常规职业就业份额与每小时工作GDP之间的负相关关系。随后，我们进行了一项发展核算分析，按职业区分劳动投入，并允许职业特定技术的存在。我们发现，职业特定生产率与发展水平之间存在系统性关联。在较富裕国家，常规职业中的劳动力往往生产率更高，其中前25%国家的有效生产率约为按每小时工作GDP排名后25%国家的14倍。仅常规技术的跨国差距就解释了每小时工作GDP的90-10比率的约17%，而抽象劳动技术的差异并未对观察到的GDP离散度做出贡献。消除所有职业和资本的技术差异将使GDP分布压缩32%至40%。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105466.title: Routine-biased technical change, structure of employment, and cross-country income differences
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105466.title_zh: 常规偏向型技术变革、就业结构与跨国收入差异

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105467.abstract: This paper examines the structural ties between federally recognized programmatic accreditors and their affiliated professional and trade associations, arguing that these organizational arrangements constitute conflicts of interest that compromise the quality-assurance function accreditation is intended to serve. Drawing on a novel dataset constructed from IRS Form 990 XML filings for 25 accreditor-association pairs over a seven-year panel (2017–2023), we develop and operationalize a three-part typology of capture mechanisms: structural subordination, financial entanglement, and governance overlap. We construct a Regulatory Capture Index (RCI) to measure the intensity of structural capture across the sample. Twenty-two of the 25 pairs are joined by a shared employer identification number, a consolidated filing, or a single legal identity, leaving three structurally separate accreditors; all fourteen licensure-gated health professions pairs score at the maximum RCI of 1.0. Scores are bimodal and static, with no pair occupying an intermediate position and none altering its organizational form across the panel. Because shared legal identity leaves no arm’s-length financial or governance record, separation is observationally indistinguishable from complete entanglement for 88 percent of the sample, suggesting that the arrangements that most compromise independence are precisely those that generate the least evidence of it.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105467.abstract_zh: 本文考察了联邦认可的纲领性认证机构与其附属专业和行业协会之间的结构性联系，认为这些组织安排构成了利益冲突，损害了认证本应发挥的质量保障功能。基于从美国国税局990表格XML申报文件中构建的新数据集，涵盖2017至2023年七年面板中25对认证机构与协会组合，我们开发并操作化了一个由三部分组成的俘获机制类型学：结构性从属、财务纠缠和治理重叠。我们构建了监管俘获指数（RCI）以衡量样本中结构性俘获的强度。25对中有22对通过共享雇主识别号、合并申报或单一法律身份相连，仅剩三个结构上独立的认证机构；所有十四个涉及执照准入的健康职业组合均达到RCI最大值1.0。得分呈双峰分布且保持静态，没有一对处于中间位置，也没有任何一对在面板期间改变其组织形式。由于共享法律身份不留下任何保持距离的财务或治理记录，对于88%的样本而言，分离在观测上与完全纠缠无法区分，这表明最损害独立性的安排恰恰是那些产生最少独立性证据的安排。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105467.title: Captured Gatekeepers: Structural Conflicts of Interest in U.S. Higher Education Accreditation
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105467.title_zh: 被俘获的守门人：美国高等教育认证中的结构性利益冲突

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105469.abstract: Many countries provide public policy support for R&D networks. In publicly funded R&D consortia, firms collaborate with each other and with public scientific institutions to carry out joint innovation projects. The idea behind these policy schemes is that collaborative innovation enables firms to benefit from knowledge spillovers within R&D networks. Surprisingly, however, there is no empirical research showing that spillover effects actually exist in publicly funded R&D consortia. This paper seeks to investigate the extent and sources of knowledge spillovers in R&D networks and to distinguish them from other drivers of additionality generated by collaborative innovation policy programs. Our empirical analysis focuses on Norway and encompasses the entire population of firms supported by R&D policy programs over the period 2002–2022, comprising approximately 15500 collaborative projects. Based on the information on each project, we construct networks of innovators and new R&D spillover pool variables. We use a spatial autoregressive econometric approach and estimate a network regression estimator that endogenizes peer effects related to knowledge spillovers. The econometric results show that the knowledge spillovers arising from publicly funded R&D networks are positive. We also find that the spillover effects resulting from Research Council programs are much stronger than those of tax incentives, and that the spillover effects are much stronger for collaborations between firms operating in different industries than for within-industry collaborations.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105469.abstract_zh: 许多国家为研发网络提供公共政策支持。在公共资助的研发联盟中，企业之间以及企业与公共科研机构之间合作开展联合创新项目。这些政策方案背后的理念是，协作创新使企业能够受益于研发网络内的知识溢出。然而，令人惊讶的是，尚无实证研究表明公共资助研发联盟中确实存在溢出效应。本文旨在探究研发网络中知识溢出的程度和来源，并将其与协作创新政策项目所产生的其他附加性驱动因素区分开来。我们的实证分析聚焦于挪威，涵盖了2002年至2022年间受研发政策项目支持的全部企业群体，共计约15500个合作项目。基于每个项目的信息，我们构建了创新者网络和新的研发溢出池变量。我们采用空间自回归计量方法，并估计了一个将知识溢出相关的同伴效应内生化的网络回归估计量。计量结果表明，公共资助研发网络产生的知识溢出是正向的。我们还发现，研究委员会项目产生的溢出效应远强于税收激励，且不同行业企业间合作的溢出效应远强于行业内合作。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105469.title: Publicly funded R&D networks, knowledge spillovers and innovation performance: Evidence from Norway
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105469.title_zh: 公共资助的研发网络、知识溢出与创新绩效：来自挪威的证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105470.abstract: This paper examines whether teachers’ gender biases stem from discrimination, and focuses on two of its potential drivers: gender preferences and beliefs. In an online experiment, 1840 teachers evaluated fictitious transcripts with randomized gender information. Preferences are measured via dictator games, and beliefs through an Implicit Association Test. While teachers show no gender preferences, they do hold gender beliefs. Analyzing 19,000 transcript evaluations, we find no evidence of gender-based discrimination. Our findings suggest that when only exposed to student gender, even teachers with biased beliefs do not discriminate.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105470.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了教师性别偏见是否源于歧视，并聚焦于其两个潜在驱动因素：性别偏好与性别信念。在一项在线实验中，1840名教师评估了随机化性别信息的虚构成绩单。偏好通过独裁者游戏测量，信念则通过内隐联想测试评估。尽管教师未表现出性别偏好，但他们确实持有性别信念。分析19,000份成绩单评估结果，我们未发现基于性别的歧视证据。研究结果表明，当仅接触学生性别信息时，即使持有偏见信念的教师也不会进行歧视。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105470.title: Determinants of gender discrimination by teachers: Evidence from an online experiment
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105470.title_zh: 教师性别歧视的决定因素：来自在线实验的证据

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105471.abstract: Constitutions as the formal foundation of a country’s legal and political system have important economic and political effects. Yet, we still know little about why constitutions set effective constraints on politicians in some societies, while being largely disregarded in others. Here, we ask if national culture matters for constitutional compliance. We study a cross-section of 115 countries, making use of novel indicators of constitutional compliance. We find that societies with a more individualistic population exhibit higher levels of compliance. These results are robust and extend to instrumental variables estimations. They imply a novel transmission channel from cultural traits to long-term economic development: individualistic national culture increases the credibility of constitutional self-commitments. Our analysis also supports the more general idea that the effects of formal institutions depend on the informal institutional environment in which they are embedded. Regarding religion, our results are consistent with past research that attributes the lack of development in the modern Muslim world to deficient institutional quality.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105471.abstract_zh: 宪法作为国家法律与政治体系的正式基础，具有重要的经济和政治效应。然而，对于为何在某些社会中宪法能有效约束政治家，而在其他社会中却往往被忽视，我们仍知之甚少。在此，我们探讨民族文化是否影响宪法遵从度。我们研究了115个国家的横截面数据，利用新颖的宪法遵从度指标。研究发现，个人主义倾向更强的社会展现出更高的遵从水平。这些结果稳健，并扩展至工具变量估计。它们揭示了从文化特质到长期经济发展的新传导渠道：个人主义民族文化增强了宪法自我承诺的可信度。我们的分析也支持了更普遍的观点，即正式制度的效果取决于其所嵌入的非正式制度环境。关于宗教方面，我们的结果与以往研究一致，这些研究将现代穆斯林世界的发展不足归因于制度质量的欠缺。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105471.title: Culture and constitutional compliance

10.1016/j.foodpol.2025.102854.abstract: • Artefactual field experiment can precisely calibrate and vary ambiguous environment. • Ambiguity is an important factor limiting technology adoption under index insurance. • Technology take-up rates depend on the degree of ambiguity. This paper investigates the effect of ambiguity on technology adoption under index insurance. I conduct an artefactual field experiment with Ghanaian cocoa farmers. Experimental subjects had an option to invest in a package of fertilizer bundled with index insurance. The returns depended both on the subjects’ investment choices and on a stochastic weather realization. The key ingredient of the study was whether the exact probability of bad weather was known or not. This probability was ambiguous in the experimental treatments, and the degree of this ambiguity varied across treatments. A large negative effect on fertilizer investments was found in treatments with either small or large ambiguity. The effect of large ambiguity was also found to be significantly stronger, suggesting that technologies with which farmers are relatively more experienced are more likely to be adopted under index insurance schemes. I provide new evidence that ambiguity may be a significant factor limiting the effectiveness of index insurance in promoting agricultural innovation. The overall findings are complementary to related recent randomized controlled trials, since it is effectively impossible to precisely calibrate and vary the level of ambiguity using the latter methodology.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2025.102854.abstract_zh: 人工实地实验能够精确校准并变化模糊环境。模糊性是限制指数保险下技术采纳的重要因素。技术采纳率取决于模糊程度。本文研究了指数保险下模糊性对技术采纳的影响。我针对加纳可可种植户开展了一项人工实地实验。实验对象可选择投资于化肥与指数保险捆绑的组合。收益既取决于受试者的投资选择，也取决于随机的天气实现情况。研究的关键要素在于坏天气的确切概率是否已知。在实验处理中，该概率是模糊的，且模糊程度在不同处理间有所变化。在模糊程度较小或较大的处理中，均发现对化肥投资有显著的负面影响。同时，较大模糊性的影响显著更强，这表明农民相对更有经验的技术更可能在指数保险计划下被采纳。我提供了新证据，表明模糊性可能是限制指数保险促进农业创新有效性的重要因素。总体发现与近期相关的随机对照试验相辅相成，因为使用后一种方法实际上无法精确校准和变化模糊水平。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2025.102854.title: Ambiguity and technology adoption under index insurance: Experimental evidence
10.1016/j.foodpol.2025.102854.title_zh: 指数保险下的模糊性与技术采纳：实验证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103069.abstract: Food insecurity (FI) in high-income countries (HICs) is increasingly addressed by philanthropic food-aid organizations that operate with limited state oversight. Such is the case in Israel, a high-income country that faces persistent FI and social inequality, but has never conducted a comprehensive mapping of its philanthropic food-aid network. This study is the first national-level analysis of food-aid NGOs in Israel. We evaluated their distribution, purpose, scale, and alignment with need, using administrative data from Guidestar, Israel’s official NGO database, and from the country’s two largest food banks. We analyze the system through the lenses of effectiveness, equity, and efficiency – the three key dimensions used globally to assess food-aid systems. We identified 2289 active food-aid NGOs, with exponential growth over the past two decades. Most organizations operate locally, provide in-kind food rather than vouchers, and serve the general public rather than specific target groups. The majority are affiliated with the Jewish religious sector, while Arab communities, despite significantly higher rates of FI, remain underrepresented. Geographic disparities are evident, with major gaps in low-resource regions, particularly among Bedouin populations in the south. Financial and volunteer investment in the sector is substantial. Little data is available concerning the extent to which the network ensures effectiveness, efficiency, and equity. Thus, our study raises critical questions about the expanding role of private actors and their ability to fulfill public welfare functions in Israel. Moreover, it contributes empirical evidence to an ongoing global debate about whether philanthropic food-aid networks complement or actually displace state responsibilities. We highlight the need for high-income welfare states to assume responsibility for regulation, transparency, and strategic integration of food-aid systems into broader food and social policy frameworks.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103069.abstract_zh: 高收入国家（HICs）中的粮食不安全（FI）问题日益由在有限国家监管下运作的慈善食品援助组织来解决。以色列正是如此，作为一个面临持续粮食不安全和社会不平等的高收入国家，却从未对其慈善食品援助网络进行全面梳理。本研究是首个针对以色列食品援助非政府组织的全国性分析。我们利用以色列官方非政府组织数据库Guidestar以及该国两大食品银行提供的行政数据，评估了这些组织的分布、宗旨、规模及其与需求的一致性。我们通过有效性、公平性和效率这三个全球评估食品援助系统的关键维度来分析该体系。我们识别出2289个活跃的食品援助非政府组织，在过去二十年中呈指数级增长。大多数组织在地方层面运作，提供实物食品而非代金券，并服务于普通公众而非特定目标群体。其中多数隶属于犹太宗教部门，而阿拉伯社区尽管粮食不安全率显著更高，却代表性不足。地理差异明显，在资源匮乏地区存在重大缺口，尤其是南部贝都因人口中。该部门的财政和志愿者投入相当可观。关于该网络在多大程度上确保有效性、效率和公平性的数据却很少。因此，我们的研究对以色列私人行为体角色不断扩展及其履行公共福利职能的能力提出了关键质疑。此外，本研究为关于慈善食品援助网络是补充还是实际上取代国家责任的持续全球辩论提供了实证证据。我们强调，高收入福利国家有必要承担起监管、透明度以及将食品援助系统战略性地融入更广泛的食品和社会政策框架的责任。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103069.title: Philanthropic food assistance in high-income countries: Lessons from Israel’s food-aid network
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103069.title_zh: 高收入国家的慈善食品援助：以色列食品援助网络的经验教训

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103080.abstract: In this paper, we consider the relationship between poultry processing industry concentration and labor costs at the industry level using plant-level data for all poultry processing facilities in the U.S. We find that plant acquisition by an industry leader firm generates an increase in future sales-per-employee at the plant in subsequent periods. Increased ownership concentration at both the national and state-level leads to a reduction in poultry processing worker renumeration, relative to the compensation for comparable jobs in other sectors. Relative to concentration and consolidation levels 25 years ago, these developments have led to between $37 and $710 million in additional revenues per year and between $27 and $218 million savings in the aggregate wage bill for the four largest poultry firms, implying a 2.6–12.0% increase in the gross labor margin for these firms.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103080.abstract_zh: 本文利用美国所有家禽加工设施的工厂层面数据，考察了家禽加工业集中度与行业层面劳动力成本之间的关系。我们发现，行业领军企业对工厂的收购会导致该工厂后续期间人均销售额的增加。在全国及州层面的所有权集中度提高，相对于其他部门类似工作的薪酬，会导致家禽加工工人报酬的减少。与25年前的集中度和整合水平相比，这些发展已使四大禽肉企业每年额外获得3700万至7.1亿美元的收入，并在总工资账单上节省了2700万至2.18亿美元，这意味着这些企业的总劳动利润率提高了2.6%至12.0%。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103080.title: The effects of U.S. poultry industry consolidation on employee productivity and labor costs
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103080.title_zh: 美国禽业整合对员工生产率与劳动力成本的影响

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103085.abstract: Countries are increasingly benchmarking food assistance and labour laws on the cost of nationally recommended diets. Benchmarking is made against national annual estimates, which fail to account for sub-national and intra-annual variation in cost, blunting the impact of policies. Using monthly market price data collected by the Government of Rwanda (April 2019-March 2024), we estimate the cost of the country’s proposed food-based dietary guidelines, using a standardised diet costing methodology. We found rural areas experienced greater inflation in diet cost over the study period than urban areas (41% vs 28%), yet the recommended diet was 12.7% higher in urban locations. Diet costs were approximately 6% lower in districts with international border crossings to Tanzania, but 7% more in those with borders with the Democratic Republic of Congo. Fruits and vegetables (110% and 71%) and starchy staples (86% and 83%) contributed most to cost increases in rural and urban locations respectively. Seasonal diet cost fluctuations were also evident with a seasonal amplitude of 5.6% and 6.9% in rural and urban locations, synchronised to Rwanda’s agricultural calendar. 70% of employed Rwandans would find the recommended diet unaffordable, if spending 52% of wages on food. Diet costs varied 4.2-fold across all districts throughout the study period, meaning that uniform national policies to address costs and affordability would be systematically inadequate in high-cost settings and wasteful in low-cost ones. That such spatial–temporal variation exists in a small, relatively market integrated country like Rwanda suggests variation would be at least equally consequential in other low and lower-middle-income countries. High-frequency and sub-national monitoring of prices, diet costs, and affordability provides essential intelligence for policymakers to enable spatially and seasonally targeted interventions, improving both the adequacy and efficiency of food policy.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103085.abstract_zh: 各国日益以国家推荐膳食的成本为基准，来制定食品援助和劳动法规。然而，这种基准设定基于国家年度估算，未能反映次国家级和年内成本变动，从而削弱了政策效果。利用卢旺达政府收集的月度市场价格数据（2019年4月至2024年3月），我们采用标准化膳食成本计算方法，估算了该国拟议的以食物为基础的膳食指南的成本。研究发现，在研究期间，农村地区的膳食成本通胀率高于城市地区（41%对28%），但城市地区的推荐膳食成本高出12.7%。在与坦桑尼亚接壤的边境地区，膳食成本约低6%，而与刚果民主共和国接壤的地区则高出7%。水果和蔬菜（农村和城市分别上涨110%和71%）以及淀粉类主食（分别上涨86%和83%）是成本上涨的主要贡献因素。季节性膳食成本波动也显而易见，农村和城市地区的季节性振幅分别为5.6%和6.9%，与卢旺达的农业日历同步。如果卢旺达就业人口将工资的52%用于食品支出，70%的人将无法负担推荐膳食。在整个研究期间，各地区间的膳食成本差异高达4.2倍，这意味着统一的国家政策在应对成本和可负担性问题上，在高成本地区将系统性不足，在低成本地区则造成浪费。像卢旺达这样面积小、市场相对一体化的国家尚且存在如此显著的时空差异，这表明在其他低收入和中等偏低收入国家，这种差异至少同样重要。高频次和次国家级的价格、膳食成本及可负担性监测，为政策制定者提供了关键信息，有助于实施空间和季节针对性的干预措施，从而提高食品政策的充分性和效率。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103085.title: Cost and affordability of recommended diets in Rwanda using [near] real-time market data
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103085.title_zh: 使用[近]实时市场数据评估卢旺达推荐膳食的成本与可负担性

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103089.abstract: Many rural households in sub-Saharan Africa rely on rainfed agriculture, meaning that harvests and incomes from farming are highly seasonal. This leads to recurring periods of food insecurity, commonly referred to as lean seasons. Off-farm employment may help mitigate seasonal food insecurity, but evidence on whether it actually does remains scarce. Using panel data from high-frequency phone surveys in Burkina Faso, Malawi, and Uganda, covering the period from 2020–2024, we examine seasonal labor reallocation and implications for food security throughout the year. We find that seasonal labor shifts from farming to off-farm sectors are associated with reduced seasonal food insecurity in most contexts, especially for off-farm wage employment. We also find that in regions where multiple cropping seasons are possible, work in farming is more strongly associated with food security than off-farm wage or self-employment.
