However, seasonal shifts from farming to other income-generating activities are not very large at the aggregate level, possibly due to lack of rural labor opportunities. These findings highlight that — depending on the context — improvements of opportunities for farming and off-farm employment are important to ensure year-round food security in rural sub-Saharan Africa.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103089.abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的许多农村家庭依赖雨养农业，这意味着农业收成和收入具有高度季节性。这导致了周期性粮食不安全时期，通常被称为“淡季”。非农就业可能有助于缓解季节性粮食不安全，但关于其是否确实有效的证据仍然稀缺。利用布基纳法索、马拉维和乌干达2020至2024年间高频电话调查的面板数据，我们考察了季节性劳动力重新配置及其对全年粮食安全的影响。我们发现，在大多数情况下，从农业向非农部门的季节性劳动力转移与季节性粮食不安全减少相关，尤其是非农工资就业。我们还发现，在可能有多季种植的地区，农业工作与粮食安全的关联强于非农工资就业或自营就业。然而，从农业向其他创收活动的季节性转移在总体水平上并不显著，可能原因是农村劳动力机会缺乏。这些发现强调，根据具体情境，改善农业和非农就业机会对于确保撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区全年粮食安全至关重要。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103089.title: Seasonality of employment and food security in rural sub-Saharan Africa
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103089.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区就业的季节性与粮食安全

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103090.abstract: • Literature on EU agri-food policies show limited and often uneven impacts across dimensions. • Policy effectiveness is highly heterogeneous across Member States and regions. • Compliance, governance, and targeting emerge as key recurring policy challenges. • Lack of outcome-based indicators and data limits evaluation of policy impacts. • Stronger governance is needed to align EU agri-food policies with sustainability. The European Union’s agri-food policies aim to balance productivity with environmental, social, and economic sustainability. However, their overall effectiveness remains debated due to fragmented evidence and inconsistent implementation. This study critically reviews the literature on the cumulative impacts of EU policies governing primary agricultural production, focusing on six sectors: the Common Agricultural Policy, genetically modified organisms, pesticide, fertilizers, fisheries, and animal health and welfare. Using a two-step approach, we first mapped EU-level policies, retaining 38 policies that met predefined criteria (binding EU scope, production-related, impact-oriented, and active since 2000). We then conducted a qualitative synthesis of 97 peer-reviewed studies (from 1.359 retrieved), coding the environmental, social, and economic impacts reported in these studies. Results reveal three systemic weaknesses limiting policy effectiveness across sectors: i) compliance gaps, where high implementation costs and limited enforcement create uneven outcomes across actors and Member States; ii) governance tensions, driven by subsidiarity ambiguities and fragmented decision-making; and iii) targeting deficiencies, where vague objectives reduce effectiveness and accountability. Environmentally, region-specific agri-environmental measures show localized benefits but fail to address systemic pressures like persistent nitrate pollution and delays in pesticide reassessments. Socially, advances in food safety and animal welfare coexist with exclusionary effects, notably the marginalization of small-scale fishers. Economically, compliance costs disproportionately burden smaller operators, while larger actors tend to leverage regulatory complexity and loopholes to their advantages. To overcome these structural challenges, the EU must set clearer objectives aligned with long-term sustainability goals, streamline decision-making responsibilities across governance levels, and implement robust outcome-based monitoring to ensure adaptability and accountability.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103090.abstract_zh: 欧盟农食政策相关文献显示，其影响在各维度上有限且往往不均衡。政策有效性在成员国和地区之间高度异质。合规性、治理和目标定位成为反复出现的核心政策挑战。缺乏基于结果的指标和数据限制了政策影响的评估。需要更强有力的治理来使欧盟农食政策与可持续性目标保持一致。欧盟的农食政策旨在平衡生产力与环境、社会和经济可持续性。然而，由于证据碎片化和执行不一致，其整体有效性仍存争议。本研究对关于欧盟初级农业生产政策累积影响的文献进行了批判性综述，聚焦六个领域：共同农业政策、转基因生物、农药、化肥、渔业以及动物健康与福利。采用两步法，我们首先梳理了欧盟层面的政策，保留了38项符合预设标准（具有约束力的欧盟范围、与生产相关、以影响为导向且自2000年起生效）的政策。随后，我们对97篇同行评审研究（从1，359篇检索文献中筛选）进行了定性综合，并对这些研究报告的环境、社会和经济影响进行了编码。结果揭示了跨部门限制政策有效性的三个系统性弱点：i) 合规缺口，高执行成本和有限执法导致不同行为体和成员国之间结果不均衡；ii) 治理张力，源于辅助性原则模糊性和碎片化决策；iii) 目标定位缺陷，模糊目标降低了有效性和问责性。在环境方面，区域特定的农业环境措施显示出局部效益，但未能解决系统性压力，如持续的硝酸盐污染和农药再评估延迟。在社会方面，食品安全和动物福利的进步与排斥效应并存，尤其是小规模渔民被边缘化。在经济方面，合规成本不成比例地加重了小规模经营者的负担，而较大规模行为体则倾向于利用监管复杂性和漏洞获取优势。为克服这些结构性挑战，欧盟必须设定与长期可持续目标相一致的更清晰目标，理顺各治理层面的决策责任，并实施强有力的基于结果的监测，以确保适应性和问责性。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103090.title: A critical review of EU agri-food policy impacts
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103090.title_zh: 欧盟农业食品政策影响的批判性评述

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103097.abstract: • A comparative MSF study of food policy agenda-setting shaped in a policy network. • Framing food environment issues beyond health increased their agenda status. • Food strategies were more likely with consistent views on the role of municipality. • Perceived paternalism fueled political caution in zoning policy agenda-setting. • Being in a policy network helped place and keep food policies on the agenda. Little is known about the processes through which local food environment policies gain a place on municipal policy agendas. This study examines why some municipalities within the Dutch City Deal: Healthy and Sustainable Food Environment succeed in placing food strategies and food environmental zoning policies on the agenda. Guided by Kingdon’s Multiple Streams Framework (MSF) and informed by interviews with 14 policymakers and policy documents from ten municipalities, we conducted a qualitative comparative case study focusing on agenda-setting windows related to food strategies and zoning policies across ten Dutch municipalities. Six municipalities adopted local food strategies, framing obesity, health inequalities, unsustainable food systems, and economic concerns as public policy problems linked to the food environment. Agenda-setting was enabled by committed politicians, alignment with broader health or sustainability agendas, and consistent views on the government’s role. Four municipalities without local food strategies lacked clear framing or leadership and viewed food policy as politically sensitive. Framing fast-food dominance as a threat to health, liveability, and local businesses enabled zoning policy agenda-setting in four municipalities, while legal uncertainty and paternalism concerns constrained it elsewhere. Successful agenda-setting of municipal food policies depended on strategic framing, linking food environments to broader societal goals and local priorities. Institutionalising ambitions in formal visions and structures reduced reliance on individual policy entrepreneurs. Trans-local policy networks such as the City Deal can strengthen local capacity, learning, and political commitment. Limited municipal resources, concerns about paternalism, and limited guidance for zoning policies constrained agenda-setting.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103097.abstract_zh: • 一项基于政策网络的食物政策议程设置的比较MSF研究。 • 将食物环境问题框定超越健康范畴，提升了其议程地位。 • 对市政府角色看法一致时，更可能制定食物战略。 • 感知到的家长式作风加剧了分区政策议程设置中的政治谨慎。 • 身处政策网络有助于将食物政策纳入并保持在议程上。 关于地方食物环境政策如何在市政政策议程上获得一席之地的过程，目前知之甚少。本研究探讨了荷兰“城市协议：健康与可持续食物环境”中，为何一些市政当局能成功将食物战略和食物环境分区政策纳入议程。以金登的多源流框架（MSF）为指导，结合对14位政策制定者的访谈及十个市政当局的政策文件，我们开展了一项定性比较案例研究，聚焦于十个荷兰市政当局中与食物战略和分区政策相关的议程设置窗口。六个市政当局采纳了地方食物战略，将肥胖、健康不平等、不可持续的食物系统及经济关切框定为与食物环境相关的公共政策问题。议程设置得益于有承诺的政治家、与更广泛的健康或可持续议程的契合，以及对政府角色的一致看法。四个未制定地方食物战略的市政当局缺乏明确的框定或领导力，并将食物政策视为政治敏感议题。将快餐主导地位框定为对健康、宜居性和地方商业的威胁，促进了四个市政当局的分区政策议程设置，而在其他地方，法律不确定性和家长式作风的担忧则制约了此进程。市政食物政策的成功议程设置依赖于战略框定，将食物环境与更广泛的社会目标和地方优先事项联系起来。在正式愿景和结构中制度化雄心，减少了对个体政策企业家的依赖。诸如城市协议等跨地方政策网络可以增强地方能力、学习及政治承诺。有限的市政资源、对家长式作风的担忧以及分区政策指导不足，制约了议程设置。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103097.title: Agenda-setting in local food environment policy: A comparative Multiple Streams Analysis of the City Deal network in the Netherlands
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103097.title_zh: 地方食品环境政策中的议程设置：荷兰城市协议网络的比较多源流分析

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103100.abstract: We investigate how exposure to extreme temperature affects smallholder commercialization. We examine a range of outcomes that indicate the degree of commercialization, including market participation, sales quantity, commercialization index, and sales revenue, which serves as an indicator of monetary benefit. Recognizing the non-separability between production and commercialization, we also examine how extreme temperature directly affects agricultural production. To address these questions, we develop a simple and straightforward theoretical framework that links temperature events to production and market dynamics. From this framework, we derive a set of hypotheses which we proceed to test empirically. Our empirical strategy leverages a comprehensive three-wave panel dataset, which we integrate with earth observation data on temperature extremes. We find that extreme temperatures lead to production losses. We also observe significant declines in market participation among smallholder farmers which could be explained by production shortfalls. This reduction is evident at both the extensive margin (likelihood of participating in markets) and the intensive margin (sales quantity). Furthermore, we observe that when farmers face extreme temperatures, the proportion of harvested crops they sell and the resulting revenue from these also decrease. Causal mediation analysis further confirms that production losses due to extreme temperatures explains the reduction in market outcomes. Overall, these findings highlight the broader economic burden that extreme weather events continue to impose on smallholder households.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103100.abstract_zh: 我们研究了极端温度暴露如何影响小农户的商业化程度。我们考察了一系列反映商业化程度的指标，包括市场参与、销售量、商业化指数以及作为货币收益指标的销售收入。鉴于生产与商业化之间的不可分割性，我们还探讨了极端温度如何直接影响农业生产。为解答这些问题，我们构建了一个简洁明了的理论框架，将温度事件与生产和市场动态联系起来。基于此框架，我们推导出一系列假设，并随后进行实证检验。我们的实证策略利用了一个包含三轮调查的面板数据集，并将其与关于极端温度的地球观测数据相结合。我们发现极端温度导致生产损失。同时，我们观察到小农户的市场参与显著下降，这可由生产短缺来解释。这种减少在广度边际（参与市场的可能性）和强度边际（销售量）上均有所体现。此外，我们还发现，当农户面临极端温度时，其收获作物中出售的比例以及由此产生的收入也相应减少。因果中介分析进一步证实，极端温度导致的生产损失解释了市场结果的下降。总体而言，这些发现凸显了极端天气事件对小农户家庭持续施加的更广泛经济负担。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103100.title: Extreme heat and markets: Theoretical and empirical evidence from Nigeria
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103100.title_zh: 极端高温与市场：来自尼日利亚的理论与实证证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103101.abstract: • A representative sample of Italian consumers participated in a Choice Experiment. • Green-Score is more effective than organic at increasing WTP for sustainable food. • The effectiveness of labels varies widely across different food product categories. • Salience nudges increase consumer preference for the Green-Score label. • PDO certification remains the most influential for culturally significant products. The Green-Score label aims to complement established certifications by providing a standardized and easily interpretable assessment of products’ environmental performance. This study examines (i) the relative influence of Green-Score, organic, and Protected Designation of Origin (PDO) certifications on consumers’ willingness to pay (WTP); (ii) how label effectiveness varies across food categories; and (iii) the impact of a salience nudge on consumer choices. A Discrete Choice Experiment was conducted with a nationally representative sample of 1,102 Italian consumers, using a between-subjects design to evaluate the nudge. Results show that PDO labels, leveraging strong institutional credibility and symbolic value, consistently generate the highest marginal WTP (€7.61), especially for culturally and traditionally significant products. Green-Score A+ labels, valued for their diagnosticity and cross-product comparability, achieve an average marginal WTP of €6.25, slightly above organic certification (€4.59), with variation across product categories and treatment conditions. The salience nudge enhances the perceived value of Green-Score, particularly in contexts where environmental performance is salient, and can reduce the marginal contribution of overlapping labels such as organic certification. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of sustainability labels depends on both the balance between credibility and diagnosticity and the product-specific context, offering actionable insights for policymakers and stakeholders seeking to design targeted and effective environmental labelling strategies in food markets.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103101.abstract_zh: • 一项以意大利消费者代表性样本为对象的选择实验。 • 在提升可持续食品支付意愿方面，Green-Score比有机认证更有效。 • 标签的有效性在不同食品产品类别间差异显著。 • 显著性助推增加了消费者对Green-Score标签的偏好。 • 对于具有文化意义的产品，PDO认证仍最具影响力。Green-Score标签旨在通过提供标准化且易于理解的产品环境绩效评估，补充现有认证体系。本研究考察了：(i) Green-Score、有机认证和原产地保护认证（PDO）对消费者支付意愿（WTP）的相对影响；(ii) 标签有效性在不同食品类别间的差异；以及(iii) 显著性助推对消费者选择的影响。研究采用离散选择实验，以1,102名意大利消费者的全国代表性样本为对象，并通过受试者间设计评估助推效果。结果表明，PDO标签凭借强大的制度公信力和象征价值，持续产生最高的边际支付意愿（€7.61），尤其对具有文化和传统意义的产品效果显著。Green-Score A+标签因其诊断性和跨产品可比性而受到重视，平均边际支付意愿为€6.25，略高于有机认证（€4.59），且在不同产品类别和处理条件下存在差异。显著性助推增强了Green-Score的感知价值，尤其在环境绩效显著的情境中，并可能降低有机认证等重叠标签的边际贡献。这些发现表明，可持续标签的有效性既取决于公信力与诊断性之间的平衡，也取决于产品特定情境，为政策制定者和利益相关者设计食品市场中针对性且有效的环境标签策略提供了可操作的见解。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103101.title: Consumer preferences for sustainability labels: A comparative analysis of the green-score and other established labels
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103101.title_zh: 消费者对可持续性标签的偏好：绿色评分与其他成熟标签的比较分析

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103102.abstract: Official food policy-makers are expected both to ensure that they have a well-functioning system of food supply, processing, distribution and consumption while also ensuring that their citizens are protected from unsafe and unhealthy foods. It is evident that the implications of those two responsibilities can and sometimes do conflict; which historically has prompted the question: should those two policy responsibilities be institutionally co-located, or institutionally separated? The UK’s Food Standards Agency (FSA) was created in response to the policy failures revealed by the Mad Cow Disease saga. Previously one UK ministry had been responsible for both agendas, but the tension between them had been so severe that they contributed to turning the saga into a deep crisis. Responsibility for ensuring UK food safety was subsequently separated from the food industries’ sponsoring ministry, and transferred to the FSA. A recent set of proposals from the FSA recommends that the agency should expand its responsibilities by also endeavouring to promote the commercial interests of the food industries. Implementing the proposals risks undermining public confidence in the FSA and the safety of the UK’s food supply. The significance of the proposals goes beyond the UK as it illustrates a pivotal and ubiquitous axis of contestation in food policy-making, it illustrates ways in which food policy governance can be malleable rather than rigid, and explains how a combination of forgetfulness and economic re-prioritisation risks undermining food safety and public trust in policy-making.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103102.abstract_zh: 官方食品政策制定者既被期望确保其拥有一个运作良好的食品供应、加工、分销和消费体系，同时也要确保其公民免受不安全和不健康食品的危害。显然，这两项职责的含义有时可能且确实会发生冲突；这在历史上引发了一个问题：这两项政策职责应在制度上合并还是分离？英国食品标准局（FSA）是为应对疯牛病事件所暴露的政策失败而设立的。此前，英国一个部委同时负责这两项议程，但两者之间的紧张关系如此严重，以至于它们共同促使该事件演变为一场深刻危机。确保英国食品安全的职责随后从食品行业的赞助部委中分离出来，并转移至FSA。FSA最近提出的一系列建议主张，该机构应通过努力促进食品行业的商业利益来扩大其职责范围。实施这些建议可能损害公众对FSA及英国食品供应安全的信任。这些建议的意义超越了英国本身，因为它展示了食品政策制定中一个关键且普遍存在的争议轴心，说明了食品政策治理如何具有可塑性而非僵化性，并解释了遗忘与经济重新优先排序的结合如何可能损害食品安全及公众对政策制定的信任。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103102.title: UK Food standards agency proposals for re-structuring how it regulates food-borne risks: an analysis and critique
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103102.title_zh: 英国食品标准局关于重组食源性风险监管方式的提案：分析与评述

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103103.abstract: As agricultural development increasingly targets high-value crops and markets, food quality and safety have become critical. However, smallholder farmers often face barriers to adopting quality-enhancing practices in the post-production stage because of their limited access to reliable information. Most research on information provision emphasises the need to reduce quantity losses in staple crops, leaving a research gap with respect to quality improvements in high-value crops such as black pepper. This study addresses this gap by evaluating the impact of government training and farmer-to-farmer experience sharing on the adoption of post-harvest quality improvement practices and production behaviour. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 660 black pepper farmers in the Matale District of Sri Lanka. We found that government training significantly improves the adoption of key post-harvest practices such as threshing, fresh berry grading, dry berry grading, and blanching and leads to a shift in production from low quality to high quality. Our findings highlight the importance of structured expertise-led training to improve the quality of high-value crops.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103103.abstract_zh: 随着农业发展日益聚焦于高价值作物与市场，食品质量与安全已成为关键议题。然而，小农户在产后阶段采纳提升品质的做法时，常因获取可靠信息的渠道有限而面临障碍。多数关于信息提供的研究侧重于减少主粮作物的数量损失，对于黑胡椒等高价值作物品质提升的研究则存在空白。本研究旨在填补这一空白，评估政府培训与农户间经验分享对采纳产后品质改进措施及生产行为的影响。我们在斯里兰卡马塔莱区对660名黑胡椒种植户进行了随机对照试验。研究发现，政府培训显著提高了关键产后实践（如脱粒、鲜果分级、干果分级及烫漂）的采纳率，并促使生产从低品质向高品质转变。我们的研究结果强调了结构化、专家主导的培训对于提升高价值作物品质的重要性。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103103.title: The impact of post-harvest training interventions on adoption and production behavior: evidence from black pepper farmers in Sri Lanka
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103103.title_zh: 采后培训干预对采用与生产行为的影响：来自斯里兰卡黑胡椒农户的证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103104.abstract: National nutrition regulations can shape diets in two distinct ways: directly, through domestic policy mechanisms, and indirectly, by mediating trade flows. This study assesses how trans fat (TF) intake is affected by both pathways. When countries act alone – by banning or limiting TF – their rules often differ in timing, stringency, and enforcement. The resulting regulatory heterogeneity can create loopholes that allow unhealthy products to move across borders. This study estimates the causal effects of TF regulations on its intake nationally by constructing a food-item-level panel dataset for 161 countries (2010–2022, validated with established benchmarks), and applying a staggered difference-in-differences approach combined with mediation analysis. The findings show that strict, enforceable regulations, such as those in the United States and European Union, significantly reduce TF intake and imports, acting as effective filters against TF-rich foods. In contrast, countries with weaker regulations experience rising TF imports and, eventually, increased intake, effectively placing them at risk of becoming “dietary risk havens.” Even modest rules work better when backed by strong monitoring. These results are robust to alternative specifications such as controlling for importer-specific foreign regulatory exposure. The causal evidence demonstrates that unilateral action delivers meaningful health gains, but fragmented regulatory approaches create opportunities for “regulatory dumping.” This study underscores the need for global cooperation – through harmonized standards or trade-linked enforcement – to prevent cross-border displacement of dietary risks. Beyond TF, the findings offer timely insights for emerging national and global mandates on other nutrients, such as salt, sugar, and saturated fats.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103104.abstract_zh: 国家营养法规可通过两种不同途径塑造膳食结构：一是直接通过国内政策机制，二是间接通过调节贸易流动。本研究评估反式脂肪（TF）摄入如何受到这两条路径的影响。当各国单独行动——通过禁止或限制反式脂肪时——其法规在时间、严格程度和执行力度上往往存在差异。由此产生的监管异质性可能造成漏洞，使不健康产品得以跨境流动。本研究通过构建涵盖161个国家（2010—2022年，并经既有基准验证）的食品项目层面面板数据集，并采用交错双重差分法结合中介分析，估计反式脂肪法规对其摄入量的因果效应。研究结果表明，严格且可执行的法规（如美国和欧盟的法规）能显著降低反式脂肪摄入量和进口量，有效充当反式脂肪高含量食品的过滤机制。相比之下，法规较弱的国家反式脂肪进口量持续上升，最终摄入量也随之增加，实际上使其面临成为“膳食风险避风港”的风险。即使力度适中的法规，在有强有力监测支撑时也能发挥更好的效果。这些结果在替代设定下依然稳健，例如控制进口国特定的外国监管暴露。因果证据表明，单边行动能带来实质性的健康收益，但碎片化的监管方式为“监管倾销”创造了机会。本研究强调全球合作的必要性——通过统一标准或贸易关联执法——以防止膳食风险的跨境转移。除反式脂肪外，研究结果还为盐、糖和饱和脂肪等其他营养素的新兴国内及全球监管要求提供了及时启示。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103104.title: Regulatory heterogeneity, trade mediation and nutrient intake: The case of Trans fat
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103104.title_zh: 监管异质性、贸易中介与营养素摄入：以反式脂肪为例

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103105.abstract: • Food policies promote plant-based protein; intake remains far below recommendations. • Supermarkets offer a promising setting to increase plant-based protein consumption. • Studies tested interventions in online and physical retail environments. • Legume sales increased with placement and recipe-based in-store interventions. The protein transition is a crucial element of the transition to sustainable food systems, and both EU and national policies aim to foster the consumption of plant-based proteins. Supermarkets as the primary source of food products in many countries represent a promising environment for translating these policy objectives into practice. With three studies from Denmark, including a representative online survey (n = 838 participants) followed by randomised controlled trials in a real online supermarket in two rounds over 6 weeks (n = 9,093 transactions Round 1; n = 8,706 transactions Round 2) and field experiments in physical brick-and-mortar stores (9 test stores, 13 control stores, 21 days of observation), this research investigates the potential of leveraging behavioural interventions to foster legume purchases in online and offline retail settings. The randomised controlled trials in the online supermarket showed that placement interventions in the vegetable section were effective in increasing sales of legumes by 57%, while placement interventions in the meat section were not effective, suggesting that the strategies known to work for highly processed plant-based meat substitutes cannot be translated to legumes. The field experiments in brick-and-mortar supermarkets confirmed that the vegetable section is a promising intervention point. The multi-layered intervention tested (bundling placement combined with a recipe inspiration poster) significantly increased legume purchases to a similar degree as in the other study. This paper concludes that retailers play a pivotal role in the protein transition; however, their commercial interests may impede the implementation of ambitious in-store interventions promoting legumes, highlighting the need for innovative policy approaches.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103105.abstract_zh: • 食品政策倡导植物蛋白，但摄入量仍远低于建议水平。• 超市为增加植物蛋白消费提供了有前景的环境。• 研究测试了在线及实体零售环境中的干预措施。• 通过摆放位置和食谱式店内干预，豆类销售额有所增加。蛋白质转型是向可持续食品体系过渡的关键要素，欧盟及各国政策均旨在促进植物蛋白的消费。作为许多国家食品的主要来源，超市是将这些政策目标付诸实践的有前景环境。本研究基于丹麦的三项研究，包括一项代表性在线调查（n=838名参与者），随后在真实在线超市进行了两轮为期6周的随机对照试验（第一轮n=9,093笔交易；第二轮n=8,706笔交易），并在实体实体店进行了现场实验（9家测试门店，13家对照门店，观察21天），探讨了利用行为干预在线上和线下零售环境中促进豆类购买的潜力。在线超市的随机对照试验显示，蔬菜区的摆放干预有效使豆类销售额增加了57%，而肉类区的摆放干预则无效，这表明适用于高度加工的植物基肉类替代品的策略不能直接应用于豆类。实体超市的现场实验证实，蔬菜区是一个有前景的干预点。测试的多层次干预（捆绑摆放结合食谱灵感海报）显著增加了豆类购买，其效果与其他研究相似。本文得出结论，零售商在蛋白质转型中扮演关键角色；然而，其商业利益可能阻碍实施促进豆类的雄心勃勃的店内干预措施，这凸显了创新政策方法的必要性。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103105.title: Fostering legume purchases with behavioural interventions: evidence from field experiments in online and offline supermarkets
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103105.title_zh: 利用行为干预促进豆类购买：来自线上线下超市实地实验的证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103106.abstract: Shrinkflation, the downsizing of packages without proportional price cuts, raises effective prices in ways that are often difficult for consumers to detect under bounded attention. We exploit a documented episode of product downsizing, combined with preexisting state-level variation in unit price disclosure rules, to identify how information design affects consumer behavior and welfare. Using a matched sample of scanner data and a control function approach, we show that consumers in regulated states are three times more responsive to unit price changes, consistent with disclosure increasing the salience of the relevant price metric. Counterfactual simulations indicate that nationwide disclosure would raise annual consumer surplus by $3.03 million in the short term and $8.33 million in the long term once retailers adjust prices strategically. At present, only 16 states regulate unit price labeling on food items. Our findings demonstrate that such labeling improves consumer decision-making under shrinkflation.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103106.abstract_zh: 缩水式通胀，即包装尺寸缩减而价格未按比例下调，会在有限注意力条件下以消费者往往难以察觉的方式提高实际价格。我们利用一次有记录的產品缩水事件，结合各州在单位价格披露规则上已有的差异，来识别信息设计如何影响消费者行为与福利。通过匹配的扫描数据样本和控制函数方法，我们表明，在受监管的州，消费者对单位价格变化的反应程度是其他州的三倍，这与披露增强了相关价格指标的显著性相一致。反事实模拟显示，若在全国范围内实施披露，短期内消费者剩余将增加303万美元，长期内，在零售商策略性调整价格后，将增加833万美元。目前，仅有16个州对食品的单位价格标签进行监管。我们的研究结果表明，此类标签在缩水式通胀情境下能改善消费者的决策质量。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103106.title: Shrinkflation, unit price disclosure, and consumer welfare: Evidence from canned tuna
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103106.title_zh: 缩水式通胀、单价披露与消费者福利：来自金枪鱼罐头的证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103107.abstract: The 2018 National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS) mandated disclosure of bioengineered (BE) ingredients in regulated foods in the United States, with full compliance required by January 2022. The policy is intended to reduce information asymmetry by enabling consumers to infer BE status through mandatory labeling, alongside existing voluntary claims such as organic and non-GMO labels. This viewpoint paper concludes that the current design and implementation of the NBFDS do not fully support this transparency objective in practice. We show that several regulatory features weaken the inference mechanism linking disclosure to consumer understanding on which the policy relies, including evolving definition and terminology associated with BE foods, electronic and digital disclosure options, detectability-based exclusions for highly refined products, exemptions from mandatory disclosure, and limited ingredient specificity. As a result, under the current design, mandatory BE labeling increases consumer search costs and cognitive burden while creating implementation challenges for industry. These findings underscore the importance of careful policy design in achieving effective transparency. Continued evaluation and evidence-based refinement are needed to improve the effectiveness of the law.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103107.abstract_zh: 2018年美国《国家生物工程食品披露标准》（NBFDS）规定，受监管食品必须披露生物工程（BE）成分，全面合规要求于2022年1月前完成。该政策旨在通过强制性标签，使消费者能够推断BE状态，同时结合现有的自愿性标签（如有机和非转基因标签），以减少信息不对称。本文观点认为，NBFDS当前的设计与实施在实践中并未完全支持这一透明度目标。我们指出，若干监管特征削弱了政策所依赖的、将披露与消费者理解相联系的推断机制，包括BE食品相关定义和术语的不断演变、电子和数字披露选项、针对高度精炼产品的可检测性排除、强制性披露的豁免，以及有限的成分特异性。因此，在当前设计下，强制性BE标签增加了消费者的搜索成本和认知负担，同时给行业带来了实施挑战。这些发现强调了审慎政策设计在实现有效透明度方面的重要性。持续评估和基于证据的改进对于提升该法律的有效性不可或缺。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103107.title: Viewpoint: evaluating transparency and market consequences of the national bioengineered food disclosure standard in the United States
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103107.title_zh: 观点：评估美国国家生物工程食品披露标准的透明度与市场影响

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103108.abstract: Despite growing enthusiasm about the potential of digital innovations to transform agrifood systems, adoption among smallholder farmers in Africa remains low and heterogeneous. While the proliferation of digital tools targeting smallholder farmers is encouraging, the vast majority remain at pilot stages, facing barriers such as limited awareness among farmer, digital illiteracy, usability challenges, and low trust among farmers. This paper evaluates alternative digital literacy interventions designed to address these demand-side barriers and enhance smallholder farmers’ knowledge, utilization, trust, and uptake of two Egyptian mobile apps offering marketing, advisory, and input delivery services. Following a Training of Trainers (TOT) model, we designed and implemented a randomized controlled trial to test three variants of digital literacy training: standard classroom-based digital literacy training (T1), digital training complemented (preceded) by a video-based play (T2), digital training complemented (preceded) by a live community play (T3), and a control group (C). We find that the different variants of digital training led to statistically significant increases in uptake and utilization of digital tools. Specifically, the standard digital training alone increased uptake by 20 percentage points and utilization by 18 percentage points. The interventions also improved farmers’ trust in digital tools by 8–13 percentage points. Surprisingly, for some outcomes, the digital literacy training alone outperformed the combined approaches that incorporated edutainment nudges. We explore possible explanations, including group size effects and social influence dynamics during the plays. We also document heterogeneity in the impact of these interventions across farmers’ gender and age. Our findings offer insights into designing cost-effective, scalable interventions that build digital capabilities and trust among smallholder farmers, while cautioning against assuming edutainment always strengthens adoption outcomes.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103108.abstract_zh: 尽管数字创新在改造农业食品系统方面的潜力日益受到关注，但非洲小农户的采纳率仍然较低且存在异质性。尽管针对小农户的数字工具数量激增令人鼓舞，但绝大多数仍处于试点阶段，面临诸如农民认知有限、数字素养不足、可用性挑战以及农民信任度低等障碍。本文评估了旨在解决这些需求侧障碍并提升小农户对两款埃及移动应用的知识、使用、信任及采纳情况的替代性数字素养干预措施，这两款应用提供营销、咨询和投入品配送服务。遵循培训培训者（TOT）模式，我们设计并实施了一项随机对照试验，测试三种数字素养培训变体：标准课堂式数字素养培训（T1）、辅以（前置）视频剧情的数字培训（T2）、辅以（前置）现场社区剧情的数字培训（T3），以及对照组（C）。我们发现，不同变体的数字培训均显著提高了数字工具的采纳和使用率。具体而言，仅标准数字培训就将采纳率提高了20个百分点，使用率提高了18个百分点。干预措施还将农民对数字工具的信任度提高了8至13个百分点。令人意外的是，在某些结果上，仅数字素养培训的表现优于结合了寓教于乐助推手段的综合方法。我们探讨了可能的解释，包括群体规模效应和剧情表演期间的社会影响动态。我们还记录了这些干预措施在农民性别和年龄上的影响异质性。我们的发现为设计具有成本效益、可扩展的干预措施提供了见解，这些措施能够建立小农户的数字能力和信任，同时提醒人们不要假设寓教于乐总能增强采纳结果。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103108.title: Digital literacy training to promote diffusion of digital agricultural tools to smallholder farmers: evidence from a randomized intervention in Egypt
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103108.title_zh: 数字素养培训促进小农户数字农业工具推广：来自埃及随机干预实验的证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103109.abstract: • First randomized controlled trial of a home garden and nutrition intervention in a refugee camp. • Trial included 1,050 pregnant/lactating women, equally split between control and treatment. • Garden adoption increased 17 percentage points (pp); share of households eating produce from own garden increased 57 pp. • Household food insecurity reduced by 66%; fruit intake increased, but vegetable intake did not. • The study shows the positive impact of garden interventions despite extreme space constraints in refugee camps. Nearly one million Rohingya refugees, displaced by the Myanmar civil war, live in densely populated camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh. While food aid addresses some of their immediate needs, additional solutions are necessary to foster self-reliance, as many have been living in camps for years with little hope of returning home. Gardening is one approach that could enhance diets, food security, and incomes, but evidence for the impact of home garden programs in refugee camps remains limited. The objective of this study is to evaluate the impact of a home garden and nutrition program on the diets and food security of pregnant and lactating women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar. A cluster-randomized controlled trial was conducted, with pre- and post-intervention data collected from 1050 women, evenly split into control and treatment groups. A difference-in-differences estimator was used to measure the intent-to-treat effects. Lack of space was the primary obstacle to gardening, but sack gardens and rooftop gardens offered solutions. Women reported many benefits from gardening beyond food consumption, such as personal joy and making the house look nice. The intervention led to a 17-percentage point increase in garden adoption (p = 0.018) and a 57-percentage point rise in households sourcing fruits and vegetables from their gardens (p < 0.001). It also improved nutrition knowledge by 23 percentage points (p < 0.001) and household food security by 66% (p < 0.05). The intervention led to a significant increase of 1 additional serving of fruit per week, but there was no significant increase in vegetable intake. These findings clearly show the benefits of providing gardening and nutrition training to nutritionally vulnerable women in densely populated refugee camps.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103109.abstract_zh: • 首个在难民营中开展的家庭菜园与营养干预的随机对照试验。• 试验纳入1,050名孕妇及哺乳期妇女，对照组与干预组人数均等。• 菜园采用率提高了17个百分点；自产蔬果的家庭比例上升了57个百分点。• 家庭粮食不安全状况降低了66%；水果摄入量增加，但蔬菜摄入量未见显著变化。• 研究表明，尽管难民营空间极为有限，菜园干预仍能产生积极影响。近百万因缅甸内战流离失所的罗兴亚难民，聚居在孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔人口密集的营地中。虽然食品援助解决了部分即时需求，但许多人已在营地生活多年，返乡希望渺茫，因此需要更多解决方案以促进自力更生。菜园种植是改善饮食、粮食安全和收入的一种途径，但关于难民营中家庭菜园项目效果的证据仍然有限。本研究旨在评估家庭菜园与营养项目对科克斯巴扎尔难民营中孕妇及哺乳期妇女饮食和粮食安全的影响。采用整群随机对照试验设计，在干预前后收集了1,050名妇女的数据，对照组与干预组人数均等。使用双重差分估计量来衡量意向性治疗效果。空间不足是种植的主要障碍，但袋装菜园和屋顶菜园提供了解决方案。妇女们报告了种植带来的诸多非饮食益处，如个人愉悦感和美化居住环境。干预使菜园采用率提高了17个百分点（p = 0.018），自产蔬果的家庭比例上升了57个百分点（p < 0.001）。同时，营养知识水平提高了23个百分点（p < 0.001），家庭粮食安全状况改善了66%（p < 0.05）。干预还使每周水果摄入量显著增加了1份，但蔬菜摄入量未见显著增加。这些发现明确表明，在人口密集的难民营中，为营养脆弱妇女提供菜园种植和营养培训具有显著益处。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103109.title: Impact of gardening and nutrition support provided to women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103109.title_zh: 孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔难民营中为女性提供的园艺与营养支持的影响

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103110.abstract: An adequate diet is essential for children’s cognitive, physical, and educational development, yet children from lower socioeconomic backgrounds are more likely to have poorer dietary quality, reinforcing social inequalities. This study examines whether the offer of school lunch can mitigate the effect of socioeconomic status on children’s total daily dietary quality. Using food frequency data from the second wave of the German KiGGS study (2014–2017), we construct an updated Healthy Nutrition Score for Kids and Youth (HuSKY) to capture overall dietary quality in a single measure. We focus on children between 6 and 13 years and proxy school lunch using attendance at after-school care facilities that typically offer school lunch. To address potential selection bias between children with and without such a lunch offer, we apply propensity score matching. We then estimate a mixed-effects model on the matched sample (n = 2,212) to analyze the effects of socioeconomic status, school lunch offer, and their interaction on total daily dietary quality. Our results corroborate that dietary quality is higher among children with higher socioeconomic status and is also positively associated with receiving a school lunch offer. Beyond supporting prior findings, we find that the positive association between socioeconomic status and dietary quality is substantially weaker among children receiving a school lunch offer. Accordingly, we conclude that school lunch may help reduce socioeconomic disparities in dietary quality. Future research should examine whether these improvements help reduce broader inequalities in health, education, and income. Policymakers should consider these potential benefits in the ongoing debate surrounding (free) school lunch provision.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103110.abstract_zh: 充足的饮食对儿童的认知、身体及教育发展至关重要，然而社会经济背景较低的儿童往往饮食质量较差，这加剧了社会不平等。本研究探讨学校午餐供应是否能缓解社会经济地位对儿童每日总体饮食质量的影响。利用德国KiGGS研究第二波（2014-2017年）的食物频率数据，我们构建了更新版的儿童与青少年健康营养评分（HuSKY），以单一指标衡量整体饮食质量。研究对象为6至13岁的儿童，并以通常提供学校午餐的课后托管机构出勤情况作为学校午餐的代理变量。为处理有无此类午餐供应的儿童之间可能存在的选择偏差，我们采用倾向得分匹配方法。随后，在匹配样本（n=2,212）上估计混合效应模型，分析社会经济地位、学校午餐供应及其交互作用对每日总体饮食质量的影响。结果证实，社会经济地位较高的儿童饮食质量更高，且学校午餐供应与饮食质量呈正相关。在支持先前研究发现的基础上，我们发现，在接受学校午餐供应的儿童中，社会经济地位与饮食质量之间的正相关关系显著减弱。因此，我们得出结论：学校午餐可能有助于缩小饮食质量方面的社会经济差距。未来研究应探讨这些改善是否有助于减少健康、教育及收入方面的更广泛不平等。政策制定者在围绕（免费）学校午餐供应的持续讨论中，应考虑这些潜在益处。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103110.title: Does school lunch equalize? An examination of dietary quality and socioeconomic disparities in Germany
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103110.title_zh: 学校午餐能实现平等吗？——德国膳食质量与社会经济差异的考察

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103111.abstract: This study examines US farmworker participation in social safety net programs, providing the first comprehensive comparison across the National Agricultural Workers Survey, the American Community Survey, and the Current Population Survey. We measure levels, trends, and predictors of farmworker participation rates in six programs: the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC), Medicaid, Unemployment Insurance (UI), the National School Lunch and Breakfast Program (NSLP), and the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC). Across surveys, we find that participation rates among income-eligible farmworker households are consistently highest for Medicaid (71%–79%) and the EITC (75%) and lowest for UI (21%). We evaluate how survey design and data collection methodologies shape these estimates through question wording, farmworker coverage, nonresponse, and measurement error. Comparing across surveys, we identify multiple persistent predictors of participation, including citizenship, gender, age, and educational attainment. These findings inform targeted outreach and policy interventions to enhance participation among US farmworkers and mitigate health and economic disparities.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103111.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了美国农场工人参与社会安全网项目的情况，首次对全国农业工人调查、美国社区调查和当前人口调查进行了全面比较。我们衡量了农场工人在六个项目中参与率的水平、趋势及预测因素：补充营养援助计划（SNAP）、妇女、婴儿和儿童特别补充营养计划（WIC）、医疗补助、失业保险（UI）、全国学校午餐和早餐计划（NSLP）以及劳动所得税抵免（EITC）。跨调查结果显示，在符合收入条件的农场工人家庭中，医疗补助（71%–79%）和劳动所得税抵免（75%）的参与率始终最高，而失业保险（21%）的参与率最低。我们通过问题措辞、农场工人覆盖范围、无应答和测量误差，评估了调查设计和数据收集方法如何影响这些估计值。跨调查比较后，我们识别出多个持续的参与预测因素，包括公民身份、性别、年龄和教育程度。这些发现为有针对性的外展服务和政策干预提供了信息，旨在提高美国农场工人的参与率，并缓解健康和经济差距。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103111.title: Welfare program participation among US farmworkers
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103111.title_zh: 美国农场工人福利计划参与情况

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103112.abstract: Maize varietal turnover is widely promoted across Sub-Saharan Africa to improve crop productivity and increase food security, yet its impact on yields remains poorly understood amid heterogeneous agroecological and socioeconomic conditions. This study quantifies the yield effects of varietal age in Kenya using a three-wave panel survey (2023-2024) of 4,160 smallholder households across Kenya. Using entropy balancing and weighted regression models to isolate the effect of varietal age on maize yield, we find a strong and consistent relationship between varietal age and yield. New varieties yield 147 kg/ha more than old ones in the long rains and 91 kg/ha more in the short rains. Finer age categorization reveals that switching to ultra-new varieties (0-5 years) delivers the highest gains-360 kg/ha over ultra-old varieties (21+ years) in the long rains and 269 kg/ha in the short rains. These findings suggest that slow varietal turnover carries significant opportunity costs in the form of forgone yield gains. While farmers generally perceive new varieties favorably-particularly for yield potential, early maturity and grain quality-concerns around labor intensity and resilience remain, potentially dampening adoption. Providing farmers with clear, locally relevant performance data and opportunities for on-farm experimentation can help shift perceptions and support wider uptake. Policies and programs that expand access to newer, better-performing varieties and strengthen seed quality assurance are essential for translating genetic gains into productivity improvements across Kenya's bimodal maize production systems.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103112.abstract_zh: 玉米品种更替在撒哈拉以南非洲被广泛推广，以提升作物生产力并增强粮食安全，然而在异质性的农业生态和社会经济条件下，其对产量的影响仍知之甚少。本研究利用肯尼亚2023-2024年三轮面板调查数据（涵盖4,160户小农户），量化了品种年龄对产量的影响。通过熵平衡和加权回归模型分离品种年龄对玉米产量的效应，我们发现品种年龄与产量之间存在强烈且一致的关系。在长雨季，新品种较老品种每公顷增产147公斤；在短雨季，每公顷增产91公斤。更精细的年龄分类显示，转向超新品种（0-5年）带来的收益最大——在长雨季，较超老品种（21年以上）每公顷增产360公斤；在短雨季，每公顷增产269公斤。这些发现表明，缓慢的品种更替以牺牲潜在产量收益的形式带来了显著的机会成本。尽管农民普遍对新品种持积极态度——尤其是在产量潜力、早熟性和籽粒品质方面——但对劳动强度及抗逆性的担忧仍然存在，这可能抑制采用率。向农民提供清晰、符合当地实际的性能数据以及田间试验机会，有助于转变观念并促进更广泛的采用。扩大更新、更优品种的可及性并加强种子质量保障的政策和项目，对于将遗传增益转化为肯尼亚双峰玉米生产系统中的生产力提升至关重要。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103112.title: Is newer better? The effect of varietal age on real-world maize yield in Kenya
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103112.title_zh: 更新更好？品种年龄对肯尼亚实际玉米产量的影响

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103113.abstract: Policy coherence is widely recognised as essential for achieving food systems transformation, but attempts to assess food systems policy coherence have been limited to date in terms of their scope of topics and geographies and lack of comparable methods. This paper introduces the Food Systems Policy Coherence (FSPC) Diagnostic Tool and uses it to analyse food systems policy coherence across 10 low- and middle-income countries in Africa and Asia through key informant interviews (n = 189) and review of policy documents (n = 808). The FSPC Diagnostic Tool considers two aspects of policy coherence: (1) the structures and mechanisms that may contribute to achieving stronger policy process coherence and (2) coherence between policies from six sectors and ten common food systems goals. Regarding the former, all countries analysed had strong framework documents for cross-sectoral food policy, backed by high-level political commitment, but they tended to be much weaker when it came to capacity for implementation and especially monitoring and accountability. Policy coherence across sectors was generally strong for the goals of climate change adaptation and social protection but weaker for goals of healthy diets for all, adequate wages for food system workers, and climate change mitigation through food systems. Trade policy was the policy area with the greatest incoherence with a diverse range of food systems goals. The results offer the most comprehensive analysis of food systems policy coherence to date. The tool makes a useful contribution to measuring policy coherence and can serve as both a foundation for future research and enhance accountability for achieving coherent policy outcomes.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103113.abstract_zh: 政策一致性被广泛认为是实现粮食系统转型的关键，但迄今为止，对粮食系统政策一致性的评估在主题和地理范围上均有限，且缺乏可比方法。本文介绍了粮食系统政策一致性（FSPC）诊断工具，并通过关键知情人访谈（n=189）及政策文件审查（n=808），运用该工具对非洲和亚洲10个低收入和中等收入国家的粮食系统政策一致性进行了分析。FSPC诊断工具考量了政策一致性的两个方面：（1）可能有助于实现更强政策过程一致性的结构与机制；（2）六个部门政策与十个常见粮食系统目标之间的一致性。就前者而言，所有被分析国家均拥有强有力的跨部门粮食政策框架文件，并得到高层政治承诺的支持，但在实施能力，尤其是监测与问责方面，往往显得较为薄弱。跨部门政策一致性在气候变化适应和社会保护目标上普遍较强，但在全民健康饮食、粮食系统工作者合理工资以及通过粮食系统减缓气候变化等目标上则较弱。贸易政策是与多种粮食系统目标不一致性最大的政策领域。这些结果提供了迄今为止对粮食系统政策一致性最全面的分析。该工具对衡量政策一致性做出了有益贡献，既可作为未来研究的基础，也能增强实现一致性政策成果的问责性。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103113.title: Food systems policy coherence: A ten-country assessment
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103113.title_zh: 粮食系统政策一致性：十国评估

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103114.abstract: Food policy often struggles to reach diverse population groups, and well-intentioned interventions can sometimes exacerbate inequalities along socio-demographic groups. This systematic data review examines whether default nudges in food choices have consistent effects across different socio-demographic groups, or whether their impact varies depending on factors such as education level, age, and gender. After selecting eligible studies, authors from 12 studies shared their primary data and were subsequently included in the Default Nudge Research & Data Sharing Consortium (Table A2). These primary data enabled us to analyze 40 interaction effects examining whether age, gender, and education moderate the effectiveness of defaults relative to active choice conditions. Results show no consistent and rarely any interaction effects, suggesting defaults influence food decisions similarly across socio-demographic groups. A possible exception is that harmful defaults may be more effective among less educated individuals. These findings highlight default nudges as a broadly equitable behavioral tool in food policy design.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103114.abstract_zh: 食品政策往往难以覆盖多样化的人群，而意图良好的干预措施有时可能会加剧不同社会人口群体之间的不平等。本系统数据综述旨在探讨食品选择中的默认助推是否在不同社会人口群体间具有一致的效果，还是其影响会因教育水平、年龄和性别等因素而异。在筛选出符合条件的研究后，来自12项研究的作者分享了他们的原始数据，并随后被纳入默认助推研究与数据共享联盟（表A2）。这些原始数据使我们能够分析40个交互效应，以检验年龄、性别和教育是否调节默认选项相对于主动选择条件的有效性。结果显示，交互效应并不一致且极少出现，表明默认选项对社会人口群体的食品决策影响相似。一个可能的例外是，有害默认选项可能在教育程度较低的个体中更为有效。这些发现凸显了默认助推作为食品政策设计中一种广泛公平的行为工具。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103114.title: Defaults harmonize our food choices – a systematic data review of default effects across socio-demographic groups
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103114.title_zh: 默认选项协调我们的食物选择——跨社会人口群体的默认效应系统数据综述

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103115.abstract: This study proposes a Macroeconomic Auto-Regressive Random Forest (MARRF) model to complement existing methods for forecasting annual U.S. food price inflation. Leveraging the flexibility of ensemble machine learning and the interpretability of Generalized Time-Varying Parameters (GTVPs), the MARRF model integrates high-dimensional macroeconomic information extracted from the FRED-MD database to produce forecasts that are both accurate and economically informative. Out-of-sample evaluation over 2003–2024 reveals that despite informational inefficiencies, the MARRF and SARIMA exhibit complementary strengths. Forecast encompassing tests confirm that each model captures distinct information, and simple averaging of the two yields both bias reduction and accuracy improvement across the full forecast cycle—outcomes neither model achieves on its own. Furthermore, variable importance metrics and time-varying parameters reveal shifting macroeconomic drivers of food price inflation across time and forecast horizons.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103115.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种宏观经济自回归随机森林（MARRF）模型，以补充现有方法，用于预测美国年度食品价格通胀。该模型结合了集成机器学习的灵活性与广义时变参数（GTVPs）的可解释性，整合了从FRED-MD数据库提取的高维宏观经济信息，从而生成既准确又具有经济信息量的预测。2003年至2024年的样本外评估显示，尽管存在信息效率不足，MARRF与SARIMA模型展现出互补优势。预测包含检验证实，各模型捕捉了不同的信息，而两者的简单平均在整个预测周期内既降低了偏差又提升了准确性——这是任一模型单独无法实现的结果。此外，变量重要性指标和时变参数揭示了食品价格通胀的宏观经济驱动因素在不同时间和预测期限上的动态变化。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103115.title: Food price inflation forecasting: Insights from a Macroeconomic Auto-Regressive Random Forest approach
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103115.title_zh: 食品价格通胀预测：基于宏观经济自回归随机森林方法的洞见

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103116.title: Strait of Hormuz disruption, fertilizer market transmission, and food policy response
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103116.title_zh: 霍尔木兹海峡中断、化肥市场传导与粮食政策应对

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103117.abstract: Climate change threatens the livelihoods of millions of smallholder farmers in sub-Saharan Africa and beyond, yet the adoption of Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) remains low. In this paper, we examine the role of producer organizations (POs) in promoting CSA adoption among their members and non-members through spillover effects. We rely on a three-wave panel dataset of over 1,500 farm households fielded between 2017 and 2019 and estimated the multivariate probit model to capture interdependencies in adopting four key CSA practices: climate-resilient groundnut varieties (CRVs), organic fertilizers, crop rotation, and intercropping. We also examine the association between POs and the adoption intensity of CSA practices, including number of CSA practices used and area under CRVs. Employing the Mundlak–Chamberlain device to address time-invariant unobserved heterogeneity, we find that PO membership is positively associated with the adoption of CSA practices. Beyond the independent use of these CSA practices, we also highlight a positive association between POs and both the adoption intensity and the joint use of these practices which indicates bundling. Importantly, positive spillover effects are observed among non-members, especially for low-cost, easily observable practices such as intercropping and crop rotation, indicating the role of peer learning and informal networks. Conversely, spillovers are less evident for input-intensive practices such as CRVs and organic fertilizers, highlighting the need for targeted support. The results point to two distinct adaptation pathways: a technology-driven strategy reliant on financial and institutional resources, and a diversification-driven strategy based on cost-effective, observable practices. Overall, the study demonstrates the critical role of POs in fostering resilient and sustainable agricultural systems through both direct engagement and community-wide spillovers.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103117.abstract_zh: 气候变化威胁着撒哈拉以南非洲及其他地区数百万小农户的生计，然而气候智能型农业（CSA）的采用率仍然较低。本文考察了生产者组织（POs）在通过溢出效应促进其成员及非成员采用CSA方面的作用。我们利用2017年至2019年间收集的超过1500户农户的三轮面板数据，并估计多元概率比模型以捕捉采用四种关键CSA实践之间的相互依赖性：气候适应性花生品种（CRVs）、有机肥料、作物轮作和间作。我们还考察了生产者组织与CSA实践采用强度之间的关联，包括采用的CSA实践数量及CRVs种植面积。采用Mundlak–Chamberlain方法处理时间不变的非观测异质性，我们发现生产者组织成员身份与CSA实践的采用呈正相关。除了这些CSA实践的独立使用外，我们还强调了生产者组织与采用强度及这些实践联合使用之间的正相关关系，这表明存在捆绑效应。重要的是，在非成员中观察到正向溢出效应，尤其是对于成本低、易于观察的实践，如间作和作物轮作，这表明了同伴学习和非正式网络的作用。相反，对于投入密集型实践，如CRVs和有机肥料，溢出效应不太明显，凸显了定向支持的必要性。研究结果指出了两条不同的适应路径：一条依赖金融和制度资源的技术驱动策略，另一条基于成本效益高、可观察实践的多样化驱动策略。总体而言，该研究证明了生产者组织在通过直接参与和社区范围的溢出效应促进韧性和可持续农业系统方面的关键作用。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103117.title: Do Producer organizations Promote Climate-Smart Agriculture? assessing direct and spillover effects in Nigeria
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103117.title_zh: 生产者组织是否促进了气候智慧型农业？评估尼日利亚的直接效应与溢出效应

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103118.abstract: Interest has grown in how to achieve healthy, sustainable, and affordable human diets. The potential income and employment effects of a transition towards healthier diets have received much less attention. We simulate aggregate and sectoral income and employment for business-as-usual and healthier diets for all geographic regions up to 2050 using scenario-based modelling. These healthier diets can increase food’s share of household expenditure in some regions, for example from 18% to 25% in East and Central Africa in 2050. Our results suggest that a global shift towards healthier diets leads to a reallocation of primary factors of production, especially low-skilled labour and capital, from non-agricultural sectors to crop agriculture in parts of sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. Notably, in 2050, with healthier diets, agriculture’s share of low-skilled labour increases by 3.2 percentage points in East and Central Africa and 1.5 percentage points in South Asia excluding India. Although Gross Domestic Product increases in these regions relative to business-as-usual, this reallocation raises agriculture’s share of Gross Domestic Product, consistent with a slower pace of long-run structural transformation. The reallocation leads to a mild increase in wages for low-skilled workers relative to high-skilled workers in most of these regions, compared to business-as-usual. However, in parts of sub-Saharan Africa, food price increases outweigh wage gains for low-skilled labour, reducing real purchasing power. Policies that encourage healthier diets may also alter income and employment and reduce economic welfare of poor populations in some regions, so care is needed in policy design to avoid adverse unintended consequences.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103118.abstract_zh: 近年来，人们越来越关注如何实现健康、可持续且负担得起的人类饮食。然而，向更健康饮食转变可能带来的潜在收入和就业影响却较少受到关注。我们采用基于情景的建模方法，模拟了到2050年，在一切照旧和更健康饮食两种情境下，所有地理区域的总体及部门收入与就业情况。这些更健康的饮食在某些地区可能会增加食品在家庭支出中的份额，例如，到2050年，在东部和中部非洲，这一比例将从18%上升至25%。我们的研究结果表明，全球向更健康饮食的转变将导致生产要素，尤其是低技能劳动力和资本，从非农业部门向撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚部分地区的作物农业重新配置。值得注意的是，到2050年，在更健康饮食情境下，农业在低技能劳动力中的占比在东部和中部非洲将增加3.2个百分点，在除印度外的南亚地区将增加1.5个百分点。尽管这些地区的国内生产总值相对于一切照旧情境有所增长，但这种重新配置提高了农业在国内生产总值中的份额，这与长期结构转型步伐放缓相一致。与一切照旧情境相比，这种重新配置在大多数这些地区导致低技能工人相对于高技能工人的工资温和上涨。然而，在撒哈拉以南非洲的部分地区，食品价格上涨超过了低技能劳动力的工资增长，从而降低了实际购买力。鼓励更健康饮食的政策也可能改变收入和就业状况，并在某些地区降低贫困人口的经济福利，因此在政策设计时需谨慎，以避免产生不利的意外后果。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103118.title: Healthier diets: a global economic modelling study of income and employment impacts across regions
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103118.title_zh: 更健康的饮食：一项关于各地区收入与就业影响的全球经济学模型研究

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103119.abstract: Per capita consumption of fluid cow’s milk has declined steadily in North America and Europe. In the United States, that well-known decline accelerated in percentage terms in the past two decades as the market for plant-based substitutes surged. This paper documents and explains significant impacts of plant-based products on the retail prices and quantities of fluid cow’s milk products in the United States, using a discrete-choice model of milk product demand with random coefficients. Demand estimates based on household purchase and store scanner data from 2018 to 2020 show that plant-based milk is more substitutable for organic and lactose-free cow’s milk products than for conventional cow’s milk. Based on our demand estimates, if plant-based milk products had not been available in the consumer choice set, the retail quantity of organic cow’s milk would have been 14.5%, lactose-free cow’s milk 10.2% higher, and conventional cow’s milk by 7.7% higher. The absence of plant-based alternatives would increase annual retail purchases of fluid cow’s milk by 1.46 gallons for a representative survey of households. In these data, each gallon of plant-based milk displaced 0.68 gallons of cow’s milk. While plant-based milk continues to affect the demand for fluid cow’s milk products, especially the higher-priced organic and lactose-free products, evidence shows that it has not been the primary driver in the recent accelerated decline in the consumption of fluid cow’s milk.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103119.abstract_zh: 北美和欧洲的人均液态牛奶消费量持续下降。在美国，过去二十年中，随着植物基替代品市场的激增，这一众所周知的下降趋势在百分比上有所加速。本文通过一个带有随机系数的牛奶产品需求离散选择模型，记录并解释了植物基产品对美国液态牛奶产品零售价格和数量的显著影响。基于2018年至2020年家庭购买和商店扫描数据的需求估计显示，植物基牛奶与有机和无乳糖牛奶产品的替代性高于与传统牛奶的替代性。根据我们的需求估计，如果消费者选择集中没有植物基牛奶产品，有机牛奶的零售数量将增加14.5%，无乳糖牛奶增加10.2%，传统牛奶增加7.7%。缺乏植物基替代品将使代表性家庭调查中的年度液态牛奶零售购买量增加1.46加仑。在这些数据中，每加仑植物基牛奶替代了0.68加仑的牛奶。尽管植物基牛奶持续影响液态牛奶产品的需求，尤其是价格较高的有机和无乳糖产品，但证据表明，它并非近期液态牛奶消费加速下降的主要驱动因素。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103119.title: Estimating plant-based milk impacts on U.S. fluid milk prices and quantities
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103119.title_zh: 估算植物基奶对美液态奶价格与数量的影响

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103120.abstract: Fish consumers are often challenged by tradeoffs between nutritional benefits and contaminant risks, which increase due to environmental pollution. Health campaigns and labeling initiatives can guide decision-making by providing information both on contaminant risk and nutritional value of a product, but it is not well understood how consumers react to such complex dual labels. We use data from a stated choice experiment in Kenya’s Lake Victoria region to study how consumers respond to dual labels on fish products, and how their responses to each label interact. We focus on the tradeoff between polyunsaturated fatty acids and contamination with microcystins, a class of toxins produced by harmful algae blooms that can accumulate in fish tissue. Our findings suggest that, faced with a dual information policy, consumers react rationally to dual health attribute labeling, and that nutrient labels and contaminant warnings can function concurrently, indeed even be mutually reinforcing, but pose a risk of inadvertently concentrating unhealthful consumption in less responsive subpopulations.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103120.abstract_zh: 鱼类消费者常常面临营养益处与污染物风险之间的权衡，而环境污染加剧了这一挑战。健康宣传和标签倡议可通过提供产品污染物风险及营养价值的信息来引导决策，但消费者对这类复杂的双重标签如何反应尚不明确。我们利用肯尼亚维多利亚湖地区的一项陈述性选择实验数据，研究消费者如何应对鱼类产品的双重标签，以及他们对各标签的反应如何相互作用。我们聚焦于多不饱和脂肪酸与微囊藻毒素污染之间的权衡，微囊藻毒素是一类由有害藻华产生的毒素，可在鱼类组织中积累。研究结果表明，面对双重信息政策，消费者对双重健康属性标签的反应是理性的，营养标签与污染物警告可以同时发挥作用，甚至相互强化，但存在无意中将不健康消费集中于反应较弱亚群体的风险。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103120.title: Understanding Nutrient - Contaminant Tradeoffs in fish consumer preferences: Evidence from Kenya
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103120.title_zh: 理解鱼类消费者偏好中的营养-污染物权衡：来自肯尼亚的证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103121.abstract: Robust food insecurity indicators are needed for monitoring development targets, emergency responses, and rationally allocating foreign aid. For decades, global food security monitoring relied on the FAO’s prevalence of undernourishment, but this indicator’s fundamental limitations led the FAO to develop the Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES) and adopt the unaffordability of the healthy diet. In parallel, The World Bank monitors monetary poverty, arguably a food insecurity indicator in its own right. In this study we assess whether this larger suite of indicators agrees on: (a) which countries are most food insecure; and (b) whether global food insecurity is really deteriorating. Unfortunately, this new mix of methods produces mixed messages. Longstanding criticisms of the prevalence of undernourishment still apply, while rising undernourishment in the past decade is driven by modelled increases in calorie inequality that are inconsistent with income inequality trends. The FIES fares no better: severe FIES food insecurity is higher in several Latin American and Caribbean countries than in extremely food-insecure African countries such as Niger. The World Bank’s poverty and healthy diet affordability monitoring efforts are significantly constrained by systematically fewer household surveys in poorer and more crisis-affected countries. How can this situation be improved? First, experience-based indicators need to be more rigorously evaluated for cross-cultural comparability, and alternatives need to be considered. Second, international agencies and national governments should pool resources to implement coordinated, high-frequency, multi-purpose surveys – focusing on poor and crisis-affected countries – to jointly monitor food insecurity, poverty and malnutrition, as well as their root causes.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103121.abstract_zh: 可靠的粮食不安全指标对于监测发展目标、应急响应以及合理分配外国援助至关重要。数十年来，全球粮食安全监测依赖于联合国粮农组织的食物不足发生率，但该指标的根本局限性促使粮农组织开发了粮食不安全体验量表（FIES），并采纳了健康膳食负担能力的指标。与此同时，世界银行监测货币贫困，这本身可视为一种粮食不安全指标。本研究评估了这一系列更全面的指标是否在以下方面达成一致：（a）哪些国家的粮食不安全状况最为严重；（b）全球粮食不安全是否确实在恶化。遗憾的是，这种新组合的方法产生了相互矛盾的信息。对食物不足发生率的长期批评依然适用，而过去十年中食物不足率的上升，是由模型估算的卡路里不平等加剧所驱动，这与收入不平等趋势不符。FIES的表现也不尽如人意：拉丁美洲和加勒比地区多个国家的严重FIES粮食不安全程度高于尼日尔等极度粮食不安全的非洲国家。世界银行的贫困和健康膳食负担能力监测工作，因在较贫困和受危机影响较严重的国家中家庭调查系统性地减少而受到显著制约。如何改善这一状况？首先，基于体验的指标需要更严格地评估其跨文化可比性，并考虑替代方案。其次，国际机构和各国政府应集中资源，实施协调一致、高频次、多用途的调查——重点关注贫困和受危机影响的国家——以联合监测粮食不安全、贫困和营养不良及其根本原因。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103121.title: The state of global food insecurity measurement: A mix of methods, and a mix of messages
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103121.title_zh: 全球粮食不安全测量的现状：方法的混合与信息的混杂

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103129.abstract: Urbanization is reshaping agriculture in many low- and middle-income countries, but how this process influences innovation-led agricultural productivity growth remains an open question. This paper studies China’s New-type Urbanization Pilot Program (NTUP), launched in 2014, which combined rural land tenure reforms, hukou system adjustments, and targeted infrastructure investment to promote two-way factor flows between cities and villages. We exploit the program’s staggered rollout across counties and estimate its effects on agricultural total factor productivity (TFP) using a multi-period difference-in-differences design. Drawing on a balanced panel of 1,329 Chinese counties for 2000–2023, we show that the NTUP raises agricultural total factor productivity by about 17–19% in pilot counties, with gains unfolding gradually over time. These gains operate through multiple reinforcing channels, including better integration of factor markets, a shift in farm labor toward mechanized production, and faster technology diffusion. The productivity effects were largest in counties geographically remote from provincial capitals, where market-driven urbanization tends to bypass. Our findings indicate that the returns to urbanization for agriculture are largest when programs explicitly combine institutional reform with geographically inclusive public investment. This design principle offers practical lessons for other developing economies navigating the relationship between rapid urban growth and food security.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103129.abstract_zh: 城市化正在重塑许多中低收入国家的农业格局，但这一过程如何影响以创新为主导的农业生产力增长仍是一个悬而未决的问题。本文研究了中国于2014年启动的新型城镇化试点项目（NTUP），该项目结合了农村土地制度改革、户籍制度调整及定向基础设施投资，旨在促进城乡之间要素的双向流动。我们利用该试点项目在县级层面的分阶段推广，采用多期双重差分设计，评估其对农业全要素生产率（TFP）的影响。基于2000—2023年间1,329个中国县的平衡面板数据，我们发现NTUP使试点县的农业全要素生产率提高了约17%—19%，且这一增益随时间逐步显现。这些增益通过多重相互强化的渠道发挥作用，包括要素市场的更好整合、农业劳动力向机械化生产转移以及技术扩散的加速。生产力效应在距离省会较远、市场化驱动的城市化往往难以覆盖的县份最为显著。我们的研究结果表明，当项目明确将制度性改革与具有地理包容性的公共投资相结合时，城市化对农业的回报最为可观。这一设计原则为其他正在应对快速城市增长与粮食安全关系的发展中经济体提供了切实可行的经验借鉴。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103129.title: Managed urbanization and agricultural productivity: evidence from China’s New-type urbanization pilot program
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103129.title_zh: 管理型城市化与农业生产力：来自中国新型城镇化试点项目的证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103130.abstract: Food systems must be urgently transformed given their disproportionate environmental impacts and contributions to accelerating ecological crises. As public awareness of sustainability grows, companies across consumer goods sectors are increasingly adopting environmental marketing strategies. However, there is growing concern that some of these claims may be “greenwashed” —misleading consumers about actual environmental benefits, undermining consumer trust, and impeding progress towards sustainability transformations. To investigate this issue in the food sector, we developed a novel coding instrument to identify direct and executional environmental marketing and greenwashing on food products. We applied this tool to all food and non-alcoholic beverage products available on two major online grocery platforms, estimating the prevalence of environmental marketing and greenwashing, exploring patterns by store category and claim content, and assessing the processing levels of environmentally marketed and greenwashed products using the NOVA classification system. Environmental marketing appeared on over 10% of products; of these, 65% at the conventional supermarket and 33% at the natural foods store were deemed greenwashed. Greenwashing was most prevalent in the meat and meat alternatives sections and when claims related to food waste and climate mitigation were used. Environmentally marketed and greenwashed products were disproportionately classified as ultra-processed (NOVA 4). Our findings highlight the need for stronger regulation of environmental marketing among food products as one strategy to protect planetary health and provide foundational evidence to inform its development. The replicable coding instrument developed in this study may also support future research and monitoring efforts in this area.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103130.abstract_zh: 食品系统因其对环境的过度影响及对加速生态危机的贡献，亟需进行转型。随着公众对可持续性意识的增强，消费品行业的公司越来越多地采用环境营销策略。然而，人们日益担忧其中一些声明可能是“漂绿”——误导消费者关于实际环境效益，削弱消费者信任，并阻碍向可持续性转型的进程。为调查食品行业的这一问题，我们开发了一种新颖的编码工具，用以识别食品产品上的直接和执行性环境营销及漂绿行为。我们将此工具应用于两大在线杂货平台上所有食品和非酒精饮料产品，估算了环境营销和漂绿的发生率，探讨了按商店类别和声明内容的不同模式，并利用NOVA分类系统评估了环境营销和漂绿产品的加工水平。环境营销出现在超过10%的产品上；其中，传统超市的65%和天然食品店的33%被认定为漂绿。漂绿现象在肉类及肉类替代品区域最为普遍，且当声明涉及食物浪费和气候缓解时尤为突出。环境营销和漂绿产品不成比例地被归类为超加工食品（NOVA 4）。我们的发现强调了加强对食品产品环境营销监管的必要性，作为保护地球健康的一项策略，并为制定相关监管提供了基础证据。本研究中开发的可复制编码工具也可能支持该领域未来的研究和监测工作。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103130.title: Greenwashed groceries: prevalence and patterns of environmental marketing and greenwashing in the retail food sector
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103130.title_zh: 漂绿食品杂货：零售食品行业环境营销与漂绿的普遍性及模式

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103131.abstract: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) is a safety net for 41 million low-income people in the United States. Although 80% of all eligible individuals participate, SNAP eligible agricultural workers likely participate in SNAP at about half that rate. Agricultural workers may be less attached to the safety net because seasonal employment makes administrative burdens more salient and can induce variation in eligibility. In this paper we examine how seasonality affects farmworker attachment to SNAP. We measure households’ attachment to SNAP with churn rates. Churn occurs when a household exits SNAP and subsequently re-enters the program within 3 months. With household-level administrative data from Fresno County as a case study, we provide descriptive evidence that farmworkers are more likely to churn than other SNAP participants. SNAP churn among farmworkers increases significantly when agricultural employment falls after seasonal peaks, particularly for crop production and support activities. We estimate a seasonal pattern in churn for farmworkers that does not exist for non-farmworkers, indicating that the patterns we observe cannot be explained by baseline seasonality alone. Understanding the relationship between churn and the seasonality of agricultural employment has the potential to improve access to the safety net for a vulnerable population, as well as reduce SNAP related costs for both households and the state.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103131.abstract_zh: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）是美国4100万低收入人群的安全网。尽管所有符合条件的个体中有80%参与其中，但符合SNAP资格的农业工人参与率可能仅为该比例的一半左右。农业工人可能因季节性就业而更少依赖安全网，因为季节性工作使行政负担更为突出，并可能导致资格条件的变化。本文考察了季节性如何影响农场工人对SNAP的依附程度。我们通过流失率来衡量家庭对SNAP的依附情况。流失是指家庭退出SNAP后在3个月内重新加入该计划的现象。以弗雷斯诺县的家庭层面行政数据为案例研究，我们提供了描述性证据，表明农场工人比其他SNAP参与者更易发生流失。当农业就业在季节性高峰后下降时，农场工人的SNAP流失率显著增加，尤其是在作物生产及支持活动领域。我们估计出农场工人流失的季节性模式，而非农场工人则不存在此模式，这表明我们观察到的模式不能仅由基线季节性来解释。理解流失与农业就业季节性之间的关系，有望改善这一弱势群体获取安全网的途径，同时降低家庭和州政府与SNAP相关的成本。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103131.title: Agricultural workers’ employment cycles and churn in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: A descriptive analysis
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103131.title_zh: 农业工人就业周期与补充营养援助计划中的流失：一项描述性分析

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103132.abstract: This study examines not only whether paddy procurement channels are associated with price differences in China, but also which farmers are able to capture the gains from the premium channel. Using farm-level panel data, we classify farmers’ paddy sales into four procurement-channel categories: the intermediary channel, the milling channel, the grain depot channel, and multi-channel sales. We estimate net farm-gate paddy price differentials using household fixed-effects models, assess heterogeneity by farm size, rice-income dependence, and adoption of high-quality varieties, and analyze access to the empirically identified premium channel using binary logit and fixed-effects linear probability models. We find that only the milling channel is consistently associated with a price premium. In the baseline specification, selling through the milling channel is associated with net farm-gate paddy prices about 4.5% higher than those received through the intermediary channel. The premium is larger for large-scale farmers, households less reliant on rice income, and growers of high-quality varieties. Medium-scale farmers emerge as the “missing middle”: they are less likely to access the premium channel and least likely to move into it over time. Access to formal market information is robustly associated with premium-channel access, while storage capacity strengthens the price premium associated with the milling channel. Overall, the results suggest that the gains from procurement-channel upgrading are unevenly distributed and depend crucially on who can reach the premium channel and convert that access into realized price gains.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103132.abstract_zh: 本研究不仅考察了稻谷采购渠道是否与中国的价格差异相关，还探讨了哪些农户能够从优质渠道中获益。利用农户层面的面板数据，我们将农户的稻谷销售划分为四类采购渠道：中介渠道、加工渠道、粮库渠道及多渠道销售。通过家庭固定效应模型估计净农户门口稻谷价格差异，并依据农场规模、稻米收入依赖度及优质品种采用情况评估异质性，同时运用二元Logit和固定效应线性概率模型分析进入经验识别出的优质渠道的机会。研究发现，仅加工渠道始终与价格溢价相关联。在基准设定中，通过加工渠道销售与通过中介渠道销售相比，净农户门口稻谷价格高出约4.5%。对于大规模农户、对稻米收入依赖度较低的家庭以及种植优质品种的农户而言，这一溢价更为显著。中等规模农户呈现出“缺失的中间层”特征：他们进入优质渠道的可能性较低，且随时间推移转向该渠道的可能性也最小。获取正规市场信息与进入优质渠道显著相关，而仓储能力则增强了加工渠道带来的价格溢价。总体而言，研究结果表明，采购渠道升级带来的收益分配不均，关键在于谁能触及优质渠道并将这种接触转化为实际的价格收益。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103132.title: Premium procurement channel access and farm-gate prices: evidence from rice farmers in China
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103132.title_zh: 优质采购渠道准入与农场交货价格：来自中国稻农的证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103133.abstract: This paper examines the impact of China’s nationwide Poverty Alleviation Relocation Program (PARP) on cropland abandonment. Utilizing four waves of household panel data across eight provinces, we exploit the staggered timing of relocations among households to identify its consequences on cropland use in origin villages. Our findings show that relocation increases cropland abandonment ratio by 7 percentage points. The observed changes in cropland use reflect relocated households’ rational behavior, driven by increased off-farm employment opportunities and higher farming costs in origin villages. Effects are more pronounced for households with steeper or lower-quality land, those resettled in urban areas, and those from villages not designated as national poor villages. Further analysis indicates that the Grain-for-Green program, along with agricultural industrial development projects and land rental policy, can help mitigate potential pressures on cropland abandonment. We then proposea typology-based framework to optimize land use policies across heterogeneous out-migration regions, aiming to support sustainable rural transformation in post-relocation contexts. Our findings highlight that PARP involves inherent trade-offs between local grain production, poverty alleviation, and ecological restoration.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103133.abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国全国性易地扶贫搬迁项目（PARP）对耕地撂荒的影响。利用覆盖八个省份的四轮农户面板数据，我们利用农户间搬迁时间的交错性来识别其对迁出村耕地利用的因果效应。研究发现，搬迁使耕地撂荒比例提高了7个百分点。观察到的耕地利用变化反映了搬迁农户的理性行为，其驱动因素包括非农就业机会的增加以及迁出村耕作成本的上升。对于拥有坡度较大或质量较差土地的农户、迁入城镇安置的农户以及来自未被认定为国家贫困村的农户，该效应更为显著。进一步分析表明，退耕还林工程、农业产业化发展项目及土地流转政策有助于缓解耕地撂荒的潜在压力。随后，我们提出一个基于类型学的框架，以优化异质性人口迁出地区的土地利用政策，旨在支持搬迁后情境下的可持续农村转型。我们的研究结果强调，PARP在地方粮食生产、扶贫与生态恢复之间内含着固有的权衡取舍。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103133.title: Cropland use consequences of a nationwide poverty alleviation relocation program in China
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103133.title_zh: 中国全国性扶贫搬迁计划对耕地利用的影响

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103134.abstract: The Integrated Phase Classification (IPC) is the global standard for analyzing and classifying food insecurity, including famine. While media attention tends to focus on IPC famine analyses, the IPC conducts most of its analyses in non-famine contexts, providing critical assessments of sub-national food insecurity. These analyses guide considerable humanitarian intervention and investment. We argue that IPC analyses are most valuable and effective when users understand the processes, data, and methodological safeguards that underlie and inform IPC findings. We present and discuss seven essential characteristics to clarify IPC operations and interpretation including its analysis framework, consensus-based processes, reporting output interpretation, and famine classification protocols. These seven characteristics are key to the IPC’s capacity to monitor dynamic, overlapping and chronic circumstances of food insecurity. We discuss the strengths and limitations of these characteristics, and we work through implications for interpreting and applying IPC outputs. While our primary objective is to clarify IPC processes, we conclude with a section that is more normative, discussing the IPC’s role and significance in the current global humanitarian system. At a time of significant strain on the humanitarian system and in the face of a loss of practitioner expertise at all levels, a more complete understanding of the IPC’s processes will enhance its utility in an increasingly constrained humanitarian landscape.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103134.abstract_zh: 综合阶段分类（IPC）是全球分析粮食不安全（包括饥荒）的标准。尽管媒体关注往往聚焦于IPC饥荒分析，但IPC在非饥荒情境下进行了大部分分析，提供了对次国家级粮食不安全状况的关键评估。这些分析指导了大量人道主义干预和投资。我们认为，当用户理解支撑并告知IPC发现的过程、数据和方法论保障时，IPC分析最具价值和有效性。我们提出并讨论了七个关键特征，以阐明IPC的操作和解读，包括其分析框架、基于共识的过程、报告输出的解读以及饥荒分类协议。这七个特征对于IPC监测动态、重叠及慢性粮食不安全状况的能力至关重要。我们讨论了这些特征的优势与局限，并探讨了其对解读和应用IPC输出的启示。虽然我们的主要目标是澄清IPC过程，但我们在结尾部分转向更具规范性的讨论，探讨IPC在当前全球人道主义体系中的角色和意义。在人道主义体系面临重大压力、各级从业者专业知识流失之际，更全面地理解IPC过程将增强其在日益受限的人道主义环境中的实用性。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103134.title: The integrated food security phase classification system: seven defining characteristics
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103134.title_zh: 综合粮食安全阶段分类系统：七个定义性特征

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103135.title: Corrigendum to ”Cost and affordability of recommended diets in Rwanda using [near] real-time market data” [Food Policy 141 (2026) 103085]
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103135.title_zh: 勘误：使用[近]实时市场数据评估卢旺达推荐膳食的成本与可负担性 [Food Policy 141 (2026) 103085]

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103136.abstract: This paper investigates how the agricultural cycle influences protest behavior in Kenya from 2000 to 2019. Using satellite data to identify the crop cycle and local harvest periods at the lowest available administrative level (wards) and geocoded protest records, we find that protest activity does not decline during the harvest period but increases with a temporal lag. A dynamic difference-in-differences specification shows that protest activity gradually rises in the two to three months following harvest, peaking around the onset of the subsequent agricultural cycle. These patterns are consistent with theories of opportunity costs and seasonal scarcity. While the opportunity costs of protest participation are highest during harvest periods, they decline thereafter and coincide with the lean season, when household food stocks become exhausted. These findings are robust across empirical specifications and contribute to a deeper understanding of the temporal dynamics of unrest in agrarian settings. They also highlight the importance of timing in the design of rural development and conflict prevention policies.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103136.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2000年至2019年间农业周期如何影响肯尼亚的抗议行为。利用卫星数据识别最低行政层级（选区）的作物周期与当地收获期，并结合地理编码的抗议记录，我们发现抗议活动在收获期间并未减少，反而在时间滞后效应下有所增加。动态双重差分模型显示，抗议活动在收获后两至三个月内逐渐上升，并在后续农业周期开始时达到峰值。这些模式与机会成本及季节性稀缺理论相吻合：尽管收获期参与抗议的机会成本最高，但此后机会成本下降，恰逢家庭粮食储备耗尽的淡季。上述发现在不同实证设定中均保持稳健，有助于深化对农业社会动荡时间动态的理解，同时凸显了农村发展与冲突预防政策设计中时机选择的重要性。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103136.title: Predictable patterns of protest: The impact of agricultural cycles on social unrest in Kenya
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103136.title_zh: 可预测的抗议模式：农业周期对肯尼亚社会动荡的影响

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103137.abstract: The ways in which governments legitimize and promote plant-rich eating remain underexplored, particularly in contexts where animal-based foods retain strong cultural and political significance. Focusing primarily on nutritional governance, this study examines the institutional mechanisms through which plant foods and plant-rich practices have been framed as objects of public intervention in Portugal since the inception of the National Program for the Promotion of Healthy Eating in 2012. Adopting a qualitative, discourse-oriented, and semiotically informed approach, the study conceptualizes public intervention as a dispositif that actively shapes meanings and norms around food. Findings show that the legitimization of plant-rich eating relies on strategically cautious discourse emphasizing health, sustainability, and heritage, while avoiding explicit advocacy of vegetarianism. The Mediterranean diet emerges as the primary legitimizing model, enabling plant foods without challenging the centrality of meat and fish. Risk prevention and responsibilization further structure these discourses, framing citizens as self-monitoring consumers. Ultimately, plant-rich eating is cautiously legitimized yet continually negotiated, absorbed into broader narratives of health, sustainability, and national identity. As the first European country to legally require the availability of vegetarian meals in public canteens, Portugal offers insights for other national contexts, particularly regarding discursive strategies, risk-based governance, the symbolic status of animal and plant products, and the role of institutional environments in normalizing plant-rich eating. These findings also resonate with developments elsewhere while highlighting context-specific dynamics.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103137.abstract_zh: 政府如何合法化并推广植物性饮食仍是一个研究不足的领域，尤其是在动物性食品仍具有深厚文化及政治意义的背景下。本研究聚焦营养治理，考察自2012年葡萄牙启动《促进健康饮食国家计划》以来，植物性食品及植物性饮食实践被构建为公共干预对象的制度机制。采用定性、话语导向及符号学分析路径，本研究将公共干预概念化为一个积极塑造食品意义与规范的"装置"。研究发现，植物性饮食的合法化依赖于策略性谨慎话语，强调健康、可持续性与传统遗产，同时避免明确倡导素食主义。地中海饮食模式成为主要的合法化模型，既推广植物性食品又不挑战肉类与鱼类的主导地位。风险预防与责任化进一步构建了这些话语，将公民塑造为自我监控的消费者。最终，植物性饮食虽被谨慎合法化，却持续处于协商状态，被吸纳进健康、可持续性与国家认同的宏大叙事中。作为首个通过法律要求公共食堂提供素食的欧洲国家，葡萄牙为其他国家的实践提供了启示，尤其在话语策略、风险治理、动植物产品的象征地位以及制度环境对植物性饮食常态化的作用方面。这些发现亦与其他地区的发展相呼应，同时凸显了特定情境的动态特征。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103137.title: Framing plant-rich eating: an analysis of nutritional public policies in Portugal
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103137.title_zh: 构建植物性饮食框架：葡萄牙营养公共政策分析

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103138.abstract: Technology adoption is an important farm management decision and is frequently made using information that is unavailable to the researcher. Aside from their own experiences, producers often rely on extension services to inform their adoption decisions. Here, we propose a novel instrumental variable (IV) approach to identify the effect that a new technology, genetically modified (GM) corn, has on farm yield using instruments constructed from extension information. The proposed approach allows us to explore the degree to which endogeneity bias is present in the GM adoption effect on farm productivity. Candidate instruments are constructed from variety trial data to resemble information acquired by producers from university extension variety trial reports and are spatially merged with on-farm production data. We find that failure to account for the endogeneity of the adoption decision does indeed result in an upward bias in the estimated productivity gains. After correcting for this bias through our IV approach, GM corn results in large on-farm yield gains of 19.6 bushels per acre. We demonstrate that variety trial data can be used to estimate the on-farm impact of new technology, and this approach is general enough to be applied to additional contexts (i.e., technologies, crops, and/or locations).
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103138.abstract_zh: 技术采纳是农场管理中的一项重要决策，且通常基于研究者无法获取的信息进行。除自身经验外，生产者常依赖推广服务来指导其采纳决策。本文提出一种新的工具变量（IV）方法，利用推广信息构建的工具变量，识别转基因玉米这一新技术对农场产量的影响。该方法使我们能够探究转基因采纳效应中内生性偏差对农场生产率影响的程度。候选工具变量基于品种试验数据构建，以模拟生产者从大学推广品种试验报告中获取的信息，并与农场生产数据进行空间匹配。研究发现，若未考虑采纳决策的内生性，确实会导致估计的生产率提升出现向上偏差。通过IV方法纠正这一偏差后，转基因玉米使农场产量实现每英亩19.6蒲式耳的大幅提升。我们证明，品种试验数据可用于估算新技术对农场的影响，且该方法具有足够普适性，可应用于其他情境（如不同技术、作物或地区）。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103138.title: From field trials to farm adoption: identifying the productivity effect of on-farm technology adoption
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103138.title_zh: 从田间试验到农场采纳：识别农场技术采纳的生产率效应

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103139.abstract: Mitigating antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in veterinary medicine is critical to achieving the UN 2030 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Most countries have adopted tailored antimicrobial reduction policies in animal production, yet rigorous cost-benefit evaluations remain scarce. We leverage China’s large-scale 2021 veterinary antimicrobial use reduction (AUR) policies as a quasi-natural experiment, employing a Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity (FRD) design to estimate its causal effects on farmers’ net income and disentangle the transmission mechanisms using three-wave panel data from hog farmers (2022–2024). The empirical results demonstrate that the AUR policies exhibited a dynamic pattern of initial income suppression followed by income enhancement, with the estimated effect turning positive in the second year of implementation (2023). Based on the baseline FRD estimates, the average effect over the full panel period is an increase of 186.504–198.708 CNY per head, representing 34.09 %–36.32 % of the three-year average net income. This effect is primarily driven by changes in cost-benefit indicators such as slaughter weight, market premiums, biosecurity expenditures, antimicrobial input costs, and antimicrobial alternative costs. We elucidate the underlying mechanisms through which AUR policy interventions operate, specifically via antimicrobial use regulation, compulsory immunization, antimicrobial-reduction compliance certification, and antimicrobial-reduction technical training. During the AUR’s initial rollout (2022), antimicrobial use regulation was the primary income suppressor, whereas market premiums became the dominant income driver in the maturation phase (2023–2024). Moreover, heterogeneity analysis shows that the income-enhancing effect of the AUR policies was more pronounced among farmers who possessed high digital literacy and had organizational support, compared to those without these advantages. Based onChina’s AUR experience, weproposefive policy insightsthat are particularly relevant fordeveloping-country contexts: optimized policy mixes, tiered biosecurity systems, scalable antimicrobial alternatives, targeted market incentives, and inclusive global governance frameworks.
