10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103139.abstract_zh: 减轻兽医学中的抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）对于实现联合国2030年可持续发展目标（SDGs）至关重要。大多数国家已在动物生产中采纳了定制化的抗菌药物减量政策，然而严格的成本效益评估仍然稀缺。我们利用中国2021年大规模兽用抗菌药物使用减量（AUR）政策作为准自然实验，采用模糊断点回归（FRD）设计，估计其对农户净收入的因果效应，并利用2022至2024年三轮生猪养殖户面板数据解析其传导机制。实证结果表明，AUR政策呈现出先抑制收入后提升收入的动态模式，估计效应在实施第二年（2023年）转为正。基于基线FRD估计，整个面板期间的平均效应为每头增加186.504至198.708元人民币，占三年平均净收入的34.09%至36.32%。这一效应主要由屠宰重量、市场溢价、生物安全支出、抗菌药物投入成本及抗菌药物替代成本等成本效益指标的变化驱动。我们阐明了AUR政策干预发挥作用的内在机制，具体通过抗菌药物使用监管、强制免疫、减抗合规认证及减抗技术培训实现。在AUR初期推行阶段（2022年），抗菌药物使用监管是主要的收入抑制因素，而在成熟阶段（2023至2024年），市场溢价成为主导的收入驱动因素。此外，异质性分析显示，AUR政策的收入提升效应在具备较高数字素养且获得组织支持的养殖户中更为显著，相较于不具备这些优势的养殖户。基于中国的AUR经验，我们提出五项对发展中国家情境尤为相关的政策启示：优化政策组合、分级生物安全体系、可推广的抗菌药物替代方案、精准市场激励以及包容性全球治理框架。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103139.title: Assessing the economic effects of veterinary antimicrobial use reduction policies: China’s experience and worldwide implications
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103139.title_zh: 评估兽用抗菌药物减量政策的经济效应：中国经验与全球启示

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103140.abstract: This paper provides new evidence of local protectionism by examining government information disclosure and suggests that public information reporting may serve as a potential channel through which governments favor local firms. Focusing on China’s food safety information disclosure, we compare food safety testing results conducted by local and national administrations for the same product within the same manufacturer and year. Our findings reveal a significantly lower probability of failure in food safety tests conducted by the local prefectural administration, holding across model specifications, accounting for different fixed effects, collusions between manufacturers and independent inspection agencies, technical differences in testing between administrations and the impact of the pandemic. Food manufacturing firms with higher registration capital and those strategic to local economies show lower probability of failure reported by local administrations, particularly in regions with aggressive GDP growth targets. This implies competition among regional governments drives a local bias in public information reporting, undermining the accuracy and transparency of food safety disclosure.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103140.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察政府信息公开提供了地方保护主义的新证据，并指出公共信息报告可能是政府偏袒本地企业的一个潜在渠道。聚焦于中国的食品安全信息公开，我们比较了同一制造商、同一年度内地方与国家行政机构对同一产品进行的食品安全检测结果。研究发现，地方市级行政机构进行的食品安全检测不合格概率显著较低，这一结论在多种模型设定下稳健，包括考虑不同的固定效应、制造商与独立检测机构之间的合谋、行政机构间检测技术差异以及疫情的影响。注册资本较高及对地方经济具有战略意义的食品制造企业，在地方行政机构报告中的不合格概率更低，尤其是在GDP增长目标激进的地区。这表明地方政府间的竞争导致了公共信息报告中的本地偏向，削弱了食品安全信息披露的准确性和透明度。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103140.title: Local protectionism in China’s government disclosure of food safety information
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103140.title_zh: 中国地方政府食品安全信息披露中的地方保护主义

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103141.abstract: Sustainable public procurement (SPP) is increasingly recognized as a policy tool to improve the environmental performance of food systems, yet there is limited empirical evidence on how procurement strategies influence environmental outcomes. This study assesses the environmental implications of municipal food procurement in a rural Swedish region using life cycle assessment (LCA). Procurement data from Östersund Municipality were used to construct baseline and alternative scenarios that reflect policy targets and objectives, including increased sourcing of organic and local foods, substitution of beef with game or legumes, and reductions in plate waste. Environmental impacts were evaluated using the Impact World + method across multiple indicators, including climate change, eutrophication, biodiversity, toxicity, and resource use. The results show that procurement strategies have differing effects across impact categories. Measures targeting food composition and consumption, such as reducing beef consumption and plate waste, lead to consistent reductions across several indicators, whereas strategies focused on sourcing and production methods, such as organic and local, yield more mixed outcomes, with improvements in some categories but increases in others. Substituting minced beef with local game and reducing food waste result in the largest overall reductions, while increasing organic procurement leads to relatively small changes across most indicators. These findings highlight the importance of multi-indicator assessments and show that focusing on a single indicator, or target, risks overlooking trade-offs. The study provides empirical evidence supporting more targeted, evidence-based procurement strategies and highlights the need for improved life cycle inventory data.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103141.abstract_zh: 可持续公共采购（SPP）日益被视为改善食品系统环境绩效的政策工具，然而关于采购策略如何影响环境结果的实证证据仍然有限。本研究采用生命周期评估（LCA）方法，评估瑞典某农村地区市政食品采购的环境影响。基于厄斯特松德市采购数据，构建了反映政策目标与指标的基准情景与替代情景，包括增加有机食品和本地食品采购、以野味或豆类替代牛肉、以及减少餐盘浪费。采用Impact World+方法，从气候变化、富营养化、生物多样性、毒性和资源利用等多个指标评估环境影响。结果表明，不同采购策略在各影响类别中产生差异化效果。针对食品构成与消费的措施（如减少牛肉消费和餐盘浪费）在多个指标上实现持续减排，而聚焦于采购与生产方式（如有机和本地化）的策略则呈现混合结果——部分指标改善，另一些指标恶化。以本地野味替代碎牛肉和减少食物浪费带来最大整体减排，而增加有机采购在多数指标上仅产生较小变化。这些发现凸显了多指标评估的重要性，并表明仅关注单一指标或目标可能忽视权衡取舍。本研究为制定更具针对性和循证性的采购策略提供了实证支持，并强调改进生命周期清单数据的必要性。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103141.title: Assessing the environmental implications of sustainable public procurement of food
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103141.title_zh: 评估可持续公共食品采购的环境影响

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103142.abstract: The concepts of local food and food heritage have attracted increasing attention in academic and policy debates. Yet, both terms remain ambiguous, contested, and open to multiple interpretations. Within the EU, these notions carry particular importance: food has long been central to EU identity and governance, and current strategies for food system transformation and rural development frequently invoke related terms. While prior work has examined some aspects of the EU food policy framing, no systematic text analysis has specifically examined how the two concepts are being constructed and mobilised within the EUThis study aims to fulfil this gap by exploring how local food and food heritage are conceptualised and operationalised in EU policy documents. It adopts a qualitative research design grounded in a constructionist paradigm. Twelve EU policy documents published between 2011 and 2025 were selected from a broader corpus and analysed using Qualitative Document Analysis (QDA). The codebook was derived from the literature and refined through pilot testing. The findings reveal a shift in the treatment of local food: while earlier and less formal documents refer to it explicitly, more recent, strategic, and legally binding texts rely on indirect framings aligned with food producers’ economic priorities. Food heritage is more consistently present, primarily linked to traditional knowledge and cultural identity. The two concepts intersect most clearly in geographical indications system, and in discourses of local branding and rural development. The analysis demonstrates that EU policies frame local food in line with broader economic objectives, and that food heritage is recognised as part of the EU’s cultural identity and worthy of protection as such. We also conclude that a lack of coherent vision of what is the place of both concepts within the EU food governance risks them being primarily determined by producer competitiveness, thereby causing the relational and cultural dimensions that originally justified these concepts to become marginalised in policy.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103142.abstract_zh: 地方食品与食品遗产的概念在学术与政策讨论中日益受到关注。然而，这两个术语仍存在模糊性、争议性，并具有多重解读空间。在欧盟内部，这些概念尤为重要：食品长期以来一直是欧盟身份认同与治理的核心，而当前食品系统转型与农村发展战略也频繁引用相关术语。尽管已有研究考察了欧盟食品政策框架的某些方面，但尚无系统性文本分析专门探讨这两个概念在欧盟内部如何被构建和动员。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探讨地方食品与食品遗产在欧盟政策文件中的概念化与操作化方式。研究采用基于建构主义范式的定性研究设计，从更广泛的语料库中选取了2011年至2025年间发布的12份欧盟政策文件，并运用定性文件分析（QDA）方法进行分析。编码手册源自文献综述，并通过试点测试加以完善。研究发现，地方食品的处理方式发生了转变：早期且非正式的文件明确提及该概念，而近期、战略性及具有法律约束力的文本则依赖与食品生产者经济优先事项相一致的间接框架。食品遗产则更为持续地出现，主要与传统知识和文化认同相关联。这两个概念在地理标志体系以及地方品牌化和农村发展的话语中交汇最为明显。分析表明，欧盟政策将地方食品置于更广泛的经济目标框架内，而食品遗产则被视为欧盟文化认同的一部分，并因此值得保护。我们还得出结论，欧盟食品治理中对这两个概念定位缺乏统一愿景，可能导致其主要由生产者竞争力所决定，从而使最初赋予这些概念的关系性与文化维度在政策中被边缘化。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103142.title: Framing local food and food heritage in European Union food policy
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103142.title_zh: 欧盟食品政策中本地食品与食品遗产的框架构建

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103143.abstract: Integrated staple food markets are essential for food security in sub-Saharan Africa, where national production is often sufficient but spatial disparities limit access for households in deficit regions. This study examines price connectedness in maize and yam markets across ten major regions in Ghana and assesses how transmission patterns respond to domestic and global shocks. Using monthly wholesale prices from January 2006 to December 2024, we employ a dynamic Quantile Vector Autoregression framework to estimate spillovers across the full distribution of price movements. The results show strong integration in maize markets, with total dynamic connectedness averaging 92 %. Major assembly and transit markets, including Kumasi, Techiman and Bolgatanga, consistently transmit price shocks, while coastal consumption markets such as Accra and Takoradi receive them. Yam markets exhibit weaker and more variable integration, with an average connectedness of 87 % and a more dispersed structure of price leadership across regions. For both commodities, connectedness strengthened during the 2008 food price hikes, whereas connectedness during the COVID-19 period was uneven and volatile. In contrast, political regime changes in 2009 and 2017 do not generate substantial shifts in market connectedness, highlighting the dominant role of structural supply chains and trader coordination over short-term political events. The findings identify regional markets where households face greater exposure to price volatility and highlight the importance of spatially targeted investments in transport, storage and market coordination alongside measures to manage shock transmission and reduce vulnerability to price volatility and unequal food access.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103143.abstract_zh: 一体化主食市场对于撒哈拉以南非洲的粮食安全至关重要，该地区国家层面的产量往往充足，但空间差异限制了缺粮区域家庭的获取能力。本研究考察了加纳十个主要地区玉米和山药市场的价格关联性，并评估了传导模式如何响应国内及全球冲击。利用2006年1月至2024年12月的月度批发价格数据，我们采用动态分位数向量自回归框架，估计价格变动全分布上的溢出效应。结果显示，玉米市场整合程度较高，总动态关联度平均为92%。主要集散和转运市场，包括库马西、特奇曼和博尔加坦加，持续传导价格冲击，而阿克拉和塔科拉迪等沿海消费市场则接收这些冲击。山药市场表现出较弱且波动较大的整合特征，平均关联度为87%，且区域间价格领导结构更为分散。就两种商品而言，关联度在2008年食品价格飙升期间有所增强，而在COVID-19期间则呈现不均衡且波动的态势。相比之下，2009年和2017年的政治政权更迭并未引发市场关联度的显著变化，凸显了结构性供应链和交易商协调相对于短期政治事件的支配作用。研究结果识别了家庭面临更大价格波动风险的区域市场，并强调了在交通、仓储和市场协调方面进行空间定向投资的重要性，同时需采取措施管理冲击传导，以降低价格波动脆弱性和粮食获取不平等。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103143.title: Market connectedness and price spillovers in Ghanaian maize and yam markets: Implications for food security
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103143.title_zh: 加纳玉米与山药市场的市场关联性与价格溢出效应：对粮食安全的启示

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103144.title: Corrigendum to “Shrinkflation, unit price disclosure, and consumer welfare: Evidence from canned tuna” [Food Policy 142 (2026) 103106]
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103144.title_zh: 更正：“缩水式通胀、单价披露与消费者福利：来自金枪鱼罐头的证据” [Food Policy 142 (2026) 103106]

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103145.abstract: There is a need to assess the benefits of government policy to improve the welfare of food animals. We present a holistic, animal-centred welfare assessment method using an expert panel of independent animal welfare scientists linked to a survey of food shoppers’ willingness to pay (WTP) to improve welfare levels, using a 0–100 animal welfare scale. We apply this method to six food animal types in the UK and 15 different topical policy scenarios. We find that several current production systems have welfare scores below 50 but that some of the policy initiatives analysed could increase welfare scores substantially if implemented. We provide valuation tables of people’s WTP to increase welfare scores for each of the six animal types. Marginal WTP was found to diminish as welfare scores increased. WTP values are fully transferable across any policies affecting the animals involved and are not tied to specific production practices or contexts. The UK government has been using the method to evaluate a range of policy options to improve welfare. The method can be applied in other countries. The method enables government policy makers to better make the case for policies to improve the welfare of food animals and its application should lead to an increased likelihood of such policies being implemented. The outputs can also be used to inform consumers regarding the animal welfare provenance of the food they purchase. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103145.abstract_zh: 有必要评估政府政策在改善食用动物福利方面的效益。我们提出了一种整体性、以动物为中心的福利评估方法，该方法采用由独立动物福利科学家组成的专家小组，并结合对食品购物者支付意愿的调查，以0-100的动物福利量表衡量福利水平的改善。我们将此方法应用于英国的六类食用动物及15种不同的热点政策情景。研究发现，当前若干生产系统的福利评分低于50分，但若实施所分析的某些政策举措，福利评分可能大幅提升。我们提供了针对六类动物中每一类，人们为提升福利评分而愿意支付的估值表。研究发现，边际支付意愿随福利评分提高而递减。这些支付意愿值可完全转移至任何影响相关动物的政策，且不依赖于特定的生产实践或背景。英国政府已采用该方法评估一系列旨在改善福利的政策选项。该方法也可应用于其他国家。该方法使政府政策制定者能够更有力地论证改善食用动物福利政策的合理性，其应用应能提高此类政策得以实施的可能性。研究结果还可用于告知消费者其所购食品的动物福利来源。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103145.title: Assessment and valuation of government policies to improve food animal welfare
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103145.title_zh: 改善食用动物福利的政府政策评估与价值分析

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103146.abstract: Nutrition insecurity remains a pressing global challenge, and while crop-livestock diversification offers a promising strategy to improve household nutrition, its relationship with micronutrient consumption remains underexplored. Using panel data from the Ethiopian Socio-economic Survey (ESS) from 2018/19 to 2021/22, this study examines the role of crop-livestock diversification in household nutrition security in rural Ethiopia and explores the underlying pathways. Three aspects of farm production diversity are considered: crop-livestock diversification, crop diversification, and livestock diversification. The results indicate that crop-livestock, crop, and livestock diversification are positively associated with total and own-produced nutrient intake but negatively associated with nutrient intake from market-purchased foods. The findings further indicate that the nutritional benefits of diversification are generally stronger among households with better market access, while heterogeneity by shock exposure is more limited and nutrient-specific. The pathway analysis suggests that the relationship between crop-livestock diversification and nutrition outcomes operates through total food consumption, own-produced consumption, market-purchased consumption, farm output, and income channels. Among these channels, total food consumption and own-produced consumption represent the strongest channels, while the income channel appears comparatively weaker. These findings highlight an important nutritional trade-off: diversification is associated with greater nutrient acquisition from household production while reducing nutrient consumption from market-purchased foods. The findings suggest that policies supporting crop-livestock diversification, together with complementary nutrition-sensitive and market-supporting interventions, may contribute to improved household nutrition security while addressing production–market trade-offs.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103146.abstract_zh: 营养不安全仍然是全球面临的紧迫挑战，尽管作物-牲畜多样化被视为改善农户营养状况的一项有前景的策略，但其与微量营养素摄入之间的关系尚未得到充分探讨。本研究利用2018/19至2021/22年埃塞俄比亚社会经济调查（ESS）的面板数据，考察了作物-牲畜多样化在埃塞俄比亚农村家庭营养安全中的作用，并探讨了其潜在的作用路径。研究考虑了农业生产多样性的三个方面：作物-牲畜多样化、作物多样化和牲畜多样化。结果表明，作物-牲畜、作物和牲畜多样化与总营养摄入及自产营养摄入呈正相关，但与从市场购买食品中获得的营养摄入呈负相关。研究进一步发现，多样化的营养益处通常在市场准入条件较好的家庭中更为显著，而受冲击暴露的异质性影响较为有限且具有营养素特异性。路径分析表明，作物-牲畜多样化与营养结果之间的关系通过总食物消费、自产消费、市场购买消费、农业产出和收入渠道发挥作用。在这些渠道中，总食物消费和自产消费是最强的渠道，而收入渠道相对较弱。这些发现揭示了一个重要的营养权衡：多样化与从家庭生产中获取更多营养相关，同时减少了从市场购买食品中获得的营养摄入。研究结果表明，支持作物-牲畜多样化的政策，辅以营养敏感型和市场支持型干预措施，可能有助于改善农户营养安全，同时应对生产与市场之间的权衡。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103146.title: The dual role of crop-livestock diversification in household nutrition security: Evidence from rural Ethiopia
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103146.title_zh: 作物-牲畜多样化在家庭营养安全中的双重作用：来自埃塞俄比亚农村的证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103147.abstract: Demand-side food policies are increasingly recognized as important tools for aligning consumption patterns with climate change mitigation targets, and carbon food labels have attracted growing attention as a potential policy instrument. However, evidence on their effectiveness remains mixed, and causal evaluation results from assessing the effects of carbon food labels in real-world supermarket settings is scarce. This study presents evidence from pre-registered randomized field-embedded survey experiment with behavioral outcomes, combining a representative sample of 2,372 Swiss residents with transaction-level purchasing data covering more than five million daily food purchase decisions made by 1,601 consumers over several years. In collaboration with one of Switzerland’s largest grocery retailers, we evaluate the causal impact of an information treatment designed to increase awareness of one of the world’s first carbon food labels implemented in grocery stores on both stated preferences and revealed purchasing behavior. The results show that the information treatment significantly increases label awareness and leads to small but positive effects on attitudes, perceived behavioral control, and intentions to consider the climate compatibility of food purchases. When tracing these effects into revealed purchasing behavior, the treatment also affects actual food purchases, but effects are modest and heterogeneous across food categories. Rather than inducing broad shifts away from meat consumption, the information treatment primarily leads to a higher overall share of labeled products purchased, increased purchases of labeled convenience products, and a partial reallocation within meat consumption (e.g., lower beef and higher pork purchases). We find no evidence of substantial reductions in overall meat purchases or large cross-category substitutions toward plant-based foods. While heavy meat eaters do not react negatively to the treatment, men and more right-wing individuals show a modest behavioral backlash. Overall, the results suggest that carbon food labels capacity to substantially alter habitual food consumption patterns in stimulus-intensive retail environments is limited and should be thus complemented by additional demand-side measures.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103147.abstract_zh: 需求侧食品政策日益被认为是使消费模式与气候变化减缓目标相一致的重要工具，碳食品标签作为一种潜在的政策手段也引起了越来越多的关注。然而，关于其有效性的证据仍然不一，且在真实超市环境中评估碳食品标签影响的因果评价结果十分稀缺。本研究提供了来自预注册的随机实地嵌入调查实验的证据，并结合行为结果，涵盖了2，372名瑞士居民的代表性样本，以及包含1，601名消费者多年间超过五百万次日常食品购买决策的交易级购买数据。我们与瑞士最大的杂货零售商之一合作，评估了一项旨在提高对杂货店中全球首批碳食品标签之一认知度的信息干预对陈述偏好和揭示性购买行为的因果影响。结果显示，信息干预显著提高了标签认知度，并对态度、感知行为控制以及考虑食品购买气候兼容性的意图产生了虽小但积极的影响。在将这些影响追踪至揭示性购买行为时，干预也影响了实际食品购买，但效果温和且在不同食品类别间存在异质性。信息干预并未引发远离肉类消费的广泛转变，而是主要导致所购标签产品总体份额增加、标签便利产品购买量上升，以及肉类消费内部的部分重新分配（例如，牛肉购买减少而猪肉购买增加）。我们未发现总体肉类购买量大幅减少或向植物基食品大规模跨类别替代的证据。尽管重度肉类消费者对干预未表现出负面反应，但男性和更倾向右翼的个体表现出适度的行为反弹。总体而言，结果表明，在刺激密集的零售环境中，碳食品标签显著改变习惯性食品消费模式的能力有限，因此应辅以额外的需求侧措施。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103147.title: zero pu“Carbon food labels have limited effects on grocery shopping behavior: Evidence from a randomized experiment”
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103147.title_zh: 碳食品标签对杂货购物行为影响有限：来自随机实验的证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103148.abstract: In response to rising consumer demand for food safety, many countries have implemented food traceability systems (FTS) to enhance transparency and accountability along agricultural supply chains. While existing research has largely focused on demand side aspects, evidence on supply side responses remains limited. This study addresses this gap by examining the effects of FTS adoption on farm production practices, specifically the probability of using chemical fertilizers, pesticides, and groundwater, as well as farm revenue and marketing channel selection. We use microdata from Taiwan’s 2020 agriculture census, which provides both plot-level and farm household-level information covering all registered crop farms. Motivated by a farm profit maximization model, we employ an instrumental variable (IV) approach to identify the local average treatment effect of FTS adoption. At the plot level, FTS adoption reduces the probability of using chemical fertilizer, pesticide, and groundwater by 8.2, 15.4, and 40 percentage points, respectively. At the household level, FTS adoption increases farm revenues and expands sales through direct-to-consumer and distributor channels. These findings suggest that while FTS is primarily designed to ensure food safety and market transparency, its adoption may generate unintended environmental co-benefits through reducing the likelihood of using environmentally sensitive inputs in farm production.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103148.abstract_zh: 为应对消费者日益增长的食品安全需求，许多国家实施了食品可追溯系统（FTS），以提升农业供应链的透明度与问责性。尽管现有研究多聚焦于需求侧，供给侧响应的证据仍显不足。本研究通过考察FTS采用对农场生产实践的影响，填补了这一空白，具体涉及化肥、农药及地下水使用的概率，以及农场收入和营销渠道选择。我们利用台湾2020年农业普查的微观数据，该数据涵盖所有注册作物农场的地块层面和农户层面信息。基于农场利润最大化模型，我们采用工具变量（IV）方法识别FTS采用的局部平均处理效应。在地块层面，FTS采用使化肥、农药和地下水使用的概率分别降低8.2、15.4和40个百分点。在农户层面，FTS采用增加了农场收入，并扩大了通过直接面向消费者和分销商渠道的销售。这些发现表明，尽管FTS主要旨在确保食品安全和市场透明度，其采用可能通过降低农场生产中使用环境敏感投入品的可能性，产生非预期的环境协同效益。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103148.title: Food traceability systems and the probability of using chemical fertilizers and pesticides − empirical evidence using plot and farm household data from agriculture census
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103148.title_zh: 食品追溯体系与化肥农药使用概率——基于农业普查地块与农户数据的实证证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103158.abstract: While Brazil and Argentina emerged as major players in the world grain markets following a rapid expansion of corn and soybean production, little is known about their production forecasts. Our study demonstrates that the accuracy of USDA forecasts of Brazil and Argentina’s corn and soybean production varies drastically over the extended forecasting cycle. Specifically, early forecasts are not directionally consistent and offer limited statistical advantage to a naïve alternative. After 8–10 months into the forecasting cycle, these forecasts begin to provide meaningful information to market participants and become more accurate, efficient and reliable for the remainder of the forecasting cycle. These forecasts support export estimates in the US WASDE balance sheets as well as USDA baseline forecasts that have implications for federal budget outlays and may result in misallocation of resources when early projections are used.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103158.abstract_zh: 尽管巴西和阿根廷在全球谷物市场中因玉米和大豆产量的迅速扩张而成为重要参与者，但对其生产预测的了解却十分有限。我们的研究表明，美国农业部对巴西和阿根廷玉米及大豆产量的预测准确性在延长预测周期内波动剧烈。具体而言，早期预测在方向上并不一致，并且相对于一个简单的替代方案，其统计优势有限。在预测周期进入8至10个月后，这些预测开始为市场参与者提供有意义的信息，并在预测周期的剩余时间内变得更加准确、高效和可靠。这些预测支持了美国农业部WASDE平衡表中的出口估算以及基线预测，后者对联邦预算支出有影响，且当使用早期预测时可能导致资源配置不当。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103158.title: The new grain giants: the reliability of USDA’s corn and soybean production forecasts for Brazil and Argentina
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103158.title_zh: 新粮食巨头：美国农业部对巴西和阿根廷玉米及大豆产量预测的可靠性

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103159.abstract: Spatial price differences in agricultural markets, after accounting for transport costs, are often interpreted as evidence of market inefficiency. However, price differences may also reflect product quality variation, especially where formal grading systems are absent. This study uses a novel transaction-level dataset on paddy rice sales from rural Madagascar in 2022–2023, including laboratory-assessed grain quality indicators. By employing hedonic regressions, we construct a composite quality index to quantify the extent to which observed price variation across locations can be explained by quality differences. We find that varietal identity commands substantial price premiums, but measured physical and post-harvest quality attributes beyond variety explain only a small share of the observed price dispersion. Controlling for the quality attributes has little effect on conventional measures of market integration. This result suggests that buyers face difficulties in accurately assessing physical quality at the point of sale. In such contexts, buyers may rely on location-specific reputation as a substitute. Consistent with this, transactions originating from villages with higher average quality are associated with higher prices even after controlling for observable quality attributes. We interpret this as descriptive evidence consistent with reputation or relationship-based sourcing in settings with limited quality observability.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103159.abstract_zh: 农业市场中的空间价格差异，在考虑运输成本后，常被视为市场效率低下的证据。然而，价格差异也可能反映产品质量的差异，尤其是在缺乏正式分级体系的地区。本研究利用2022至2023年间马达加斯加农村稻谷销售的独特交易层面数据集，其中包含实验室评估的谷物质量指标。通过运用特征回归模型，我们构建了一个综合质量指数，用以量化不同地点间观察到的价格差异在多大程度上可由质量差异解释。研究发现，品种身份能带来显著的价格溢价，但除品种外，测得的物理及收获后处理质量属性仅能解释观察到的价格离散度的一小部分。控制质量属性对传统的市场一体化衡量指标影响甚微。这一结果表明，买方在销售点难以准确评估物理质量。在此类情境下，买方可能依赖特定地点的声誉作为替代。与此一致的是，即便在控制可观测质量属性后，来自平均质量较高村庄的交易仍与较高价格相关联。我们将此解读为，在质量可观测性有限的环境中，与声誉或基于关系的采购模式相符的描述性证据。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103159.title: Quality-driven price dispersion: Implications for testing market efficiency
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103159.title_zh: 质量驱动的价格离散：对市场效率检验的启示

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103160.abstract: Increasing attention on “ultra-processed” foods (UPFs) and their health effects has sparked policy debate. News media influences public perceptions yet understanding of UPF framing and industry influence remains limited. This study analysed UPF framing in UK news media and trade press, exploring interests of quoted individuals and organisations. We systematically searched UK media for UPF articles in 2022–23, identifying 188 articles for mixed-methods content analysis. Articles were examined for their position towards classifying food by processing-level (accepted/contested/mixed). Framing Theory guided identification of UPF frames describing problem definitions, causes, and solutions. Actors’ interests were classified using academic journal guidelines. Half the articles (52%) accepted the UPF concept, 19% contested it, and 29% were mixed. Five frames were identified. The ‘Social Justice’, ‘Lifestyle Drift’, and ‘Science Report’ frames accepted the UPF concept, with the ‘Social Justice’ frame positioning UPF consumption as a structural public health problem requiring policy action such as taxes or front-of-package labelling. The ‘UPF Critique’ and ‘Market Justice’ frames contested the scientific basis of the UPF concept, proposing nutrient-based approaches instead. Among 116 named actors, 33% had UPF industry interests, with academics comprising 45% and industry spokespeople 11%. Actors with UPF industry interests were more commonly cited in contesting frames (e.g. ‘Market Justice’: 73%) than accepting frames (e.g. ‘Social Justice’: 10%). These findings highlight that industry influence on UPF media discourse is often obscured behind academic voices. Greater transparency around actor interests is urgently needed to ensure emerging UPF policies are shaped by independent evidence.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103160.abstract_zh: 关于“超加工食品”（UPFs）及其健康影响的关注日益增加，引发了政策辩论。新闻媒体影响公众认知，但对UPF框架构建及行业影响力的理解仍然有限。本研究分析了英国新闻媒体和行业出版物中UPF的框架构建，探讨了被引用的个人和组织的利益关系。我们系统检索了2022-23年间英国媒体中关于UPF的文章，识别出188篇文章进行混合方法内容分析。文章根据其对按加工水平分类食品的立场（接受/质疑/混合）进行审查。框架理论指导了描述问题定义、原因和解决方案的UPF框架识别。行动者的利益根据学术期刊指南进行分类。半数文章（52%）接受UPF概念，19%质疑，29%持混合态度。识别出五种框架。“社会正义”、“生活方式漂移”和“科学报告”框架接受UPF概念，其中“社会正义”框架将UPF消费定位为结构性公共卫生问题，需要税收或前包装标签等政策行动。“UPF批判”和“市场正义”框架质疑UPF概念的科学基础，提出基于营养的方法作为替代。在116名具名行动者中，33%具有UPF行业利益，学者占45%，行业发言人占11%。具有UPF行业利益的行动者更常见于质疑框架（如“市场正义”：73%）而非接受框架（如“社会正义”：10%）。这些发现强调，行业对UPF媒体话语的影响常常隐藏在学术声音背后。迫切需要提高行动者利益的透明度，以确保新兴的UPF政策由独立证据塑造。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103160.title: Framing of ultra-processed foods in UK news media (2022–2023) and associations with quoted actors’ interests: a mixed-methods study
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103160.title_zh: 英国新闻媒体中超加工食品的框架（2022—2023年）及其与引述行动者利益的关联：一项混合方法研究

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103161.abstract: Substantive agri-environmental policy change has not materialized within EU agri-food governance despite emerging scientific consensus on the need for food system transformation. Agri-environmental legislative proposals often face strong resistance, resulting in their weakening or reversal. Although the challenges to adopting agri-environmental legislations are clear, existing analytical tools fall short in explaining why legislative rollbacks occur. This study addresses this gap by drawing on Rational Choice Theory to examine how individual-level motivations linked to the agri-food sector influence members of the European Parliament (MEP) voting behaviour on agri-environmental legislation. Roll-call vote data and a binomial generalized linear mixed model are used to test office-seeking, policy-seeking and vote-seeking motivations. Our analysis shows that MEPs with private financial interests in the agri-food sector were more likely to vote against environmental protection across the studied agri-environmental legislations, while MEPs with stronger environmental ideological affinity were more likely to support such measures. Institutional variables, mainly political group affiliation and COMAGRI leadership of legislative files, are also significant determinants of voting behaviour. These findings suggest that individual-level motivations and institutional structures help explain the lack of consistent legislative support for agri-environmental legislations between February 2022 and July 2024. Our findings raise normative questions about the need for stronger transparency and conflict-of-interest measures in EU agricultural governance.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103161.abstract_zh: 尽管科学界对食品体系转型的必要性已形成共识，欧盟农业食品治理中实质性的农业环境政策变革仍未实现。农业环境立法提案常遭遇强烈抵制，导致其被削弱或逆转。尽管采纳农业环境立法的挑战显而易见，现有分析工具却难以解释立法倒退何以发生。本研究通过借鉴理性选择理论，探讨与农业食品部门相关的个体层面动机如何影响欧洲议会（MEP）议员在农业环境立法上的投票行为，以填补这一研究空白。研究采用唱名表决数据及二项广义线性混合模型，检验了追求职位、追求政策及追求选票三类动机。分析结果显示，在农业食品部门拥有私人财务利益的欧洲议会议员更倾向于在研究的各项农业环境立法中投票反对环境保护，而具有更强环境意识形态倾向的议员则更可能支持此类措施。制度变量，主要是政治团体归属及立法档案的COMAGRI主导权，也是投票行为的重要决定因素。这些发现表明，个体层面动机与制度结构共同解释了2022年2月至2024年7月期间农业环境立法缺乏一贯立法支持的现象。我们的研究结果引发了关于欧盟农业治理中加强透明度与利益冲突管理措施必要性的规范性思考。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103161.title: Voting green, or not: what drives members of the European Parliament opposition to agri-environmental reform?
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103161.title_zh: 投票绿色，还是不投票：什么驱动欧洲议会议员反对农业环境改革？

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103162.abstract: Circular economy solutions within the food system have prioritized prevention. Prevention policies can be formulated as carrots, e.g., waste abatement subsidies, or sticks, e.g., waste disposal taxes, and applied at one or more segments along the food supply chain. We develop a general equilibrium model of the U.S. Midwest that endogenizes food waste decisions and policy responses at key supply chain links. Existing models of circular food systems often fail to endogenize the amount of food waste and seldom apply multiple policies at different food supply chain stages. Our results identify how carrots and sticks differ across targeted supply chain stages. Waste abatement subsidies primarily result in a decrease in waste rates, while a food waste tax leads consumers to adjust both food purchases and waste rates equally. Subsidizing waste abatement can be five times more effective than a food waste tax in reducing food waste, despite both yielding comparable emissions reductions. 88% of emissions reduction caused by a tax derives from reduced food demand (and thus supply). With abatement subsidies, 28% of emissions reduction derives from decreased landfill deposits and 64% from reduced food supply. Our results also suggest that policies aimed at consumers can have four times greater impacts than those applied upstream. Lastly, as their combinations typically generate additive effects, carrots and sticks can complement one another, further informing an optimal policy suite that reduces food waste, while mitigating unintended consequences (e.g., rebound effects or consumption reduction).
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103162.abstract_zh: 食品系统内的循环经济解决方案优先考虑了预防措施。预防政策可设计为激励手段，如废弃物减排补贴，或约束手段，如废弃物处理税，并可在食品供应链的一个或多个环节实施。我们构建了一个美国中西部地区的可计算一般均衡模型，该模型内生了关键供应链环节中的食物浪费决策及政策响应。现有的循环食品系统模型往往未能内生化食物浪费量，且很少在食品供应链的不同阶段同时应用多种政策。我们的研究结果揭示了激励与约束手段在不同目标供应链环节上的差异效应。废弃物减排补贴主要导致浪费率下降，而食物浪费税则促使消费者同时调整食品购买量和浪费率。在减少食物浪费方面，补贴废弃物减排的效果可能是食物浪费税的五倍，尽管两者在减排方面产生的效果相当。税收带来的排放减少中，88%源于食品需求（进而供应）的下降。而在补贴废弃物减排的情况下，排放减少的28%归因于垃圾填埋场沉积物的减少，64%则源于食品供应的缩减。我们的结果还表明，针对消费者的政策其影响可能是针对上游环节政策的四倍。最后，由于政策组合通常产生叠加效应，激励与约束手段可以相辅相成，为优化政策组合提供进一步指导，以在减少食物浪费的同时，缓解意外后果（如反弹效应或消费减少）。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103162.title: Comparing carrots and sticks to create a more circular food system
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103162.title_zh: 比较胡萝卜与大棒政策以构建更循环的食品体系

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103163.abstract: Surface ozone pollution has emerged as a major threat to agricultural productivity, yet evidence on its impacts on high-value cash crops and farmers’ adaptive responses remains limited. Combining a household-level panel from the Chinese National Fixed-Point Survey with high-resolution pollution and weather data from 2003 to 2013, we find that rising ozone concentrations significantly reduced farm income of fruit growers, primarily driven by ozone-induced reductions in fruit yields, total production, and labor productivity. Sugar crops also experienced significant yield losses, while other cash crops exhibited negligible responses. Due to limited adaptive capacity, fruit growers responded by abandoning ozone-damaged plots, reducing input use, and reallocating labor towards off-farm employment, resulting in persistent income losses with little evidence of longer-run adjustment. In contrast, sugar producers offset yield losses by expanding cultivated area and increasing material inputs, maintaining output and income. These findings highlight the critical importance of ozone-control policies and targeted support to strengthen farmers’ adaptive capacity, particularly for fruit growers who are most vulnerable to rising ozone exposure.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103163.abstract_zh: 地表臭氧污染已成为农业生产力的重大威胁，然而其对高价值经济作物及农户适应性应对措施的影响证据仍然有限。结合中国农村固定观察点的农户层面面板数据与2003年至2013年间的高分辨率污染和气象数据，我们发现臭氧浓度上升显著降低了果农的农业收入，主要归因于臭氧引起的果实产量、总产量及劳动生产率下降。糖料作物同样遭受显著产量损失，而其他经济作物的反应则微乎其微。由于适应能力有限，果农通过弃耕受臭氧损害的农田、减少投入品使用以及将劳动力转向非农就业来应对，导致收入持续损失，且几乎没有长期调整的迹象。相比之下，糖料生产者通过扩大种植面积和增加物质投入来弥补产量损失，从而维持了产出和收入。这些发现凸显了臭氧控制政策及针对性支持以增强农户适应能力的关键重要性，尤其是对于最易受臭氧暴露上升影响的果农而言。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103163.title: Ozone pollution, cash crop production, and farmer adaptation: evidence from China
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103163.title_zh: 臭氧污染、经济作物生产与农户适应：来自中国的证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103164.abstract: Ensuring food security under binding land constraints is a central challenge for many developing economies. Using a county-level panel dataset for China from 2000 to 2022, this study examines how agricultural technological innovation affects grain yield under land scarcity. We construct quality-adjusted patent stocks of grain-related technologies based on patent microdata and distinguish between input-oriented innovation and field-management innovation. By integrating patent data, business registration records, and official agricultural statistics, we empirically examine the effects of agricultural technological innovation on grain yield. The results show that agricultural technological innovation significantly increases grain yield: a doubling of the quality-adjusted stock of grain-related patents is associated with an approximately 1.10% increase in grain yield. However, its effects differ sharply by innovation type. Input-oriented innovation exhibits limited or even negative effects, whereas field-management innovation consistently enhances grain yield. Heterogeneity analyses show stronger yield effects in major grain-producing regions, areas with broader technological coverage and greater patent collaboration, and lower-yield counties. Mechanism analyses indicate that production organization and agricultural socialized services are key channels through which innovation translates into yield gains. Overall, the findings suggest that productivity gains in land-scarce agricultural systems depend less on input intensification than on effective production management and supportive institutional arrangements, with broader implications for other land-constrained developing economies.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103164.abstract_zh: 在土地约束下保障粮食安全是许多发展中经济体面临的核心挑战。利用2000年至2022年中国县级面板数据，本研究考察了农业技术创新在土地稀缺条件下如何影响粮食产量。我们基于专利微观数据构建了粮食相关技术的质量调整专利存量，并区分了投入导向型创新与田间管理型创新。通过整合专利数据、企业注册记录和官方农业统计数据，我们实证检验了农业技术创新对粮食产量的影响。结果表明，农业技术创新显著提高了粮食产量：质量调整后的粮食相关专利存量翻一番，与粮食产量约1.10%的增长相关联。然而，其效应因创新类型不同而存在显著差异。投入导向型创新的效应有限甚至为负，而田间管理型创新则持续提升粮食产量。异质性分析显示，在粮食主产区、技术覆盖范围更广且专利合作更多的地区以及低产县，产量效应更为显著。机制分析表明，生产组织方式和农业社会化服务是创新转化为产量增长的关键渠道。总体而言，研究结果表明，在土地稀缺的农业系统中，生产率的提升更多依赖于有效的生产管理和支持性制度安排，而非投入集约化，这对其他土地受限的发展中经济体具有更广泛的启示意义。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103164.title: Feeding a fifth of the world under land constraints: Agricultural innovation and grain yield growth in China
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103164.title_zh: 土地约束下养活全球五分之一人口：中国的农业创新与粮食单产增长

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103165.abstract: The causal impact of information on consumer decision-making has been a prime area of interest for issues including novel food technologies, nutrition, food safety, and food authenticity. Experiments are oftentimes the only way to estimate causal impacts of information, as secondary data lack details on individual-specific information exposure. Response to information is relevant for many policy questions and has been formally integrated into some policy processes, such as those related to provision of nutrition information. However, the standard approach, which exposes participants to information, may provide inaccurate predictions of real-world outcomes. In the real-world, consumers may choose whether to access information, driven by a variety of motives. Forced exposure in experiments may also unintentionally bias results—threatening the internal validity of the design—by signaling the information’s importance to participants. This study investigates how different methods of presenting information impact both the internal and external validity of research designs. Participants were randomized to one of four conditions: information exposure, opt out to bypass information, opt in to access information, and a no-information control. Our findings indicate that the information presentation method has large impacts on external validity, demonstrated by significant differences in results across conditions. Information provision mode also yields significant, though smaller, impacts on internal validity among the subset of participants who accessed the information. In the study, participants are exposed to information about honey fraud, a topic that is both present in general media and of concern for the beekeeping industry globally.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103165.abstract_zh: 信息对消费者决策的因果影响一直是新型食品技术、营养、食品安全及食品真实性等议题中的核心研究领域。由于二手数据缺乏个体特定信息暴露的细节，实验往往成为估计信息因果影响的唯一途径。对信息的反应与众多政策问题相关，并已被正式纳入某些政策流程，例如与营养信息提供相关的政策。然而，标准方法——即让参与者暴露于信息——可能对现实世界结果的预测不够准确。在现实情境中，消费者可能出于多种动机选择是否获取信息。实验中的强制暴露也可能通过向参与者暗示信息的重要性，无意中引入偏差，从而威胁设计的内在有效性。本研究探讨了不同信息呈现方式如何影响研究设计的内在和外在有效性。参与者被随机分配到四种条件之一：信息暴露、选择退出以绕过信息、选择加入以获取信息，以及无信息对照组。我们的研究结果表明，信息呈现方式对外在有效性有显著影响，各条件间结果存在显著差异。信息提供模式对获取信息的参与者子集的内在有效性也产生了显著但较小的影响。在本研究中，参与者接触到的信息涉及蜂蜜欺诈，这一话题既常见于大众媒体，也是全球养蜂业关注的焦点。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103165.title: Implications of information presentation mode for internal and external validity in consumer experiments
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103165.title_zh: 信息呈现方式对消费者实验中内部与外部效度的影响

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103166.abstract: Global food governance is increasingly described as being in crisis, as multilateral cooperation weakens amid rising nationalist and populist politics. However, less attention has been paid to how dominant multilateral modes of governance within the broader field of global governance shape the political conditions in which such tensions emerge. This paper examines how contemporary global food governance is organized primarily around coordination as a governing grammar—a mode of governing oriented toward aligning action across fragmented authority. Drawing on an interpretive analysis of a purposively selected body of authoritative global food governance documents produced between 2012 and 2025, the paper examines how coordination structures action, responsibility, evaluation, and contestation across multilateral institutions. The analysis identifies recurring patterns through which coordination diffuses responsibility, manages failure procedurally, and reframes distributive trade-offs as technical problems, enabling sustained engagement and institutional durability in the absence of centralized authority. These features constrain multilateral institutions’ capacity to assume responsibility, adjudicate conflicts, or respond politically to uneven consequences. Grievances associated with food system transformation often struggle to gain traction within multilateral arenas; this may contribute to their articulation in other political contexts, including national and subnational arenas where responsibility is more readily attributed. Rather than treating such mobilizations as external threats to multilateralism, these dynamics are interpreted as being consistent with the institutional features of coordination-based governance. The paper concludes by outlining implications for global food governance, emphasizing the need to complement coordination with institutional arrangements that clarify responsibility, link measurement to material response, and enable political contestation over distributive trade-offs.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103166.abstract_zh: 全球粮食治理日益被描述为处于危机之中，因为在民族主义和民粹主义政治崛起的背景下，多边合作趋于弱化。然而，对于更广泛的全球治理领域中占主导地位的多边治理模式如何塑造此类紧张关系浮现的政治条件，关注尚显不足。本文考察当代全球粮食治理如何主要围绕“协调”这一治理语法加以组织——这是一种旨在跨碎片化权威对齐行动的治理模式。基于对2012年至2025年间有目的选取的权威全球粮食治理文件进行的解释性分析，本文考察协调如何跨多边机构构建行动、责任、评估与争议。分析识别出反复出现的模式，通过这些模式，协调分散责任、以程序化方式管理失败，并将分配性权衡重新框定为技术性问题，从而在缺乏中央权威的情况下实现持续参与和制度韧性。这些特征制约了多边机构承担责任、裁决冲突或对不均衡后果作出政治回应的能力。与粮食体系转型相关的不满往往难以在多边舞台上获得关注；这可能促使其在其他政治场域中得到表达，包括责任更易被归因的国家和次国家层面。与其将此类动员视为对多边主义的外部威胁，这些动态被解释为与基于协调的治理的制度特征相一致。本文最后概述了对全球粮食治理的启示，强调有必要以明确责任、将测量与实质性回应相挂钩，并允许对分配性权衡进行政治争议的制度安排来补充协调机制。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103166.title: Beyond coordination: responsibility and the crisis of global food governance design
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103166.title_zh: 超越协调：责任与全球粮食治理设计的危机

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103167.abstract: Land degradation poses a critical threat to global food production systems, yet policy responses have focused mainly on agricultural-sector interventions, leaving the cross-sectoral spillovers of industrial environmental regulation on soil quality largely understudied. This paper exploits China’s 2006 shift to hard enforcement of the Two Control Zones (TCZ) policy, an industrial environmental regulation in designated regions, to examine its impacts on land quality and agricultural growth. We find that the policy reduced soil erosion intensity by approximately 1.8%, an effect most pronounced in counties with higher cropland shares, steeper slopes, and higher pre-reform exposure to industrial pollution. This reduction is mainly driven by two mechanisms: direct biophysical restoration through the abatement of acid deposition, and an indirect behavioral adaptation in which farmers reduce chemical input use. Incorporating these estimates into an agricultural production function, we show that this policy-driven improvement in land quality accounts for a 1.4% increase in aggregate agricultural value added. Our findings offer valuable insights for policymakers to ensure food security and advance sustainable development through cross-sectoral environmental regulation.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103167.abstract_zh: 土地退化对全球粮食生产系统构成严重威胁，然而政策应对主要聚焦于农业部门的干预措施，导致工业环境规制对土壤质量的跨部门溢出效应在很大程度上未被充分研究。本文利用中国2006年两控区（TCZ）政策转向严格执法这一契机，考察该针对特定区域的工业环境规制对土地质量和农业增长的影响。研究发现，该政策使土壤侵蚀强度降低了约1.8%，这一效应在耕地占比更高、坡度更陡以及改革前工业污染暴露程度更高的县域中最为显著。这一降低主要源于两种机制：一是通过减少酸沉降实现直接的生物物理修复，二是农民减少化学投入品使用的间接行为适应。将这些估计纳入农业生产函数后，我们表明这一由政策驱动的土地质量改善使农业增加值总量提高了1.4%。我们的研究为政策制定者通过跨部门环境规制保障粮食安全和推进可持续发展提供了有价值的启示。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103167.title: From factories to farms: The impact of industrial environmental regulation on land quality
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103167.title_zh: 从工厂到农田：工业环境规制对土地质量的影响

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103169.abstract: Program officers are faced with difficult modeling choices when monitoring the state of diverse yet related dimensions of household food security. We compare results of single- and multi-output frameworks, applying both econometric and machine learning models, to jointly predict three interrelated outcomes of food security: undernourishment (access), dietary diversity (utilization), and food consumption stability (stability). Using the 2013–2022 Kyrgyz Integrated Household Survey, we evaluate generalized linear models (GLM), a multi-output generalized structural equation model (GSEM), and single- and multi-output artificial neural networks (ANNs) under both cross-sectional and temporal validation settings. The results show that accounting for non-linearity of relationships in our specifications yields greater predictive gains than modeling outcomes jointly. Among the models evaluated, the simplest model (single outcome GLM) often performs as well as others, and even better in some specifications, while also providing interpretable parameter estimates. However, accounting for non-linearity with our single-outcome ANN often achieves superior performance in low-outcome groups, which is especially relevant for policies aimed at targeting vulnerable households. Adding complexity through joint prediction of the related outcomes improves precision in some cases, but reduces recall, increasing exclusion risk. This trade-off makes such approach less desirable from both equity and implementation perspectives. The findings emphasize that complex patterns tie household socio-economic and demographic characteristics with food security dimensions. These results can guide program officers navigating the trade-offs between prediction performance, interpretability, and implementation; showing that linear models can deliver robust predictions, but specific non-linear, data-driven models might allow better targeting of vulnerable households.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103169.abstract_zh: 项目官员在监测家庭粮食安全中多样但相互关联的维度时，面临着困难的建模选择。我们比较了单一输出与多输出框架的结果，应用计量经济学和机器学习模型，共同预测粮食安全的三个相互关联的结果：营养不足（获取）、膳食多样性（利用）和食品消费稳定性（稳定性）。利用2013-2022年吉尔吉斯斯坦综合家庭调查数据，我们在横截面和时间验证设置下评估了广义线性模型（GLM）、多输出广义结构方程模型（GSEM）以及单一和多输出人工神经网络（ANNs）。结果表明，在我们的设定中考虑关系的非线性比联合建模结果能带来更大的预测增益。在评估的模型中，最简单的模型（单一输出GLM）通常表现与其他模型相当，在某些设定中甚至更好，同时提供可解释的参数估计。然而，使用单一输出ANN考虑非线性在低结果组中往往实现更优性能，这对于旨在瞄准脆弱家庭的政策尤为重要。通过联合预测相关结果增加复杂性在某些情况下提高了精确度，但降低了召回率，增加了排除风险。这种权衡使得该方法在公平性和实施性方面都不太可取。研究结果强调，复杂的模式将家庭社会经济和人口特征与粮食安全维度紧密相连。这些结果可以指导项目官员在预测性能、可解释性和实施之间进行权衡；表明线性模型可以提供稳健的预测，但特定的非线性、数据驱动模型可能更好地瞄准脆弱家庭。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103169.title: Simultaneous prediction of multiple dimensions of food security
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103169.title_zh: 粮食安全多维度同步预测

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103170.abstract: Indigenous crops remain visible within the markets and cultivation spaces of many African cities, yet their institutional positioning within urban food systems remains under-examined. While frequently recognised for their nutritional, ecological, and socio-cultural value, little is known about how these crops are currently embedded within urban governance structures. This paper investigates how indigenous crops are integrated into Accra’s urban food system and why they remain structurally marginal within urban food governance frameworks. Drawing on 35 semi-structured interviews with farmers, market actors, agricultural officials, researchers, municipal authorities, and land-use planning actors, we adopt a multi-actor qualitative approach to examine the governance conditions shaping indigenous crop production, circulation and support. The findings show that indigenous crops persist in Accra largely through informal retail networks, direct farmer–buyer relations, and small-scale cultivation in improvised urban spaces. Their presence in markets and cultivation sites does not, however, translate into coordinated institutional support. Farmers grow selected indigenous crops where demand is reliable, while crops perceived as less profitable, harder to prepare, or less compatible with changing urban consumption practices receive weaker market support. Agricultural institutions acknowledge indigenous crops, yet municipal planning and land governance systems rarely incorporate them explicitly into policy frameworks, resulting in institutional diffusion rather than coordinated support. The analysis conceptualises this condition as fragmented urban food governance – a situation in which responsibilities for food production, land-use planning, and market development operate in parallel but without deliberate alignment. Indigenous crops thus persist through informal practices and local initiative, yet remain peripheral within formal governance structures. By showing how indigenous crops are sustained through informality but remain weakly embedded in coordinated policy and planning systems, the paper contributes to debates on policy integration and guides on how to improve the resilience of urban food system transformation in rapidly urbanising African contexts.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103170.abstract_zh: 本土作物在许多非洲城市的市场和种植空间中依然可见，但其在城市食品系统中的制度定位仍未得到充分研究。尽管这些作物因其营养、生态和社会文化价值而常获认可，但关于它们当前如何嵌入城市治理结构的知识却十分有限。本文探讨了本土作物如何融入阿克拉的城市食品系统，以及为何它们在城市食品治理框架中仍处于结构性边缘地位。基于对农民、市场参与者、农业官员、研究人员、市政当局和土地利用规划行动者的35次半结构化访谈，我们采用多行动者定性方法，考察了影响本土作物生产、流通和支持的治理条件。研究结果表明，阿克拉的本土作物主要通过非正规零售网络、农民与买家直接关系以及临时城市空间中的小规模种植得以存续。然而，它们在市场和种植场所的存在并未转化为协调的制度支持。农民在需求可靠的条件下种植选定的本土作物，而被认为利润较低、制备更困难或与不断变化的城市消费习惯兼容性较差的作物则获得较弱的市场支持。农业机构承认本土作物，但市政规划和土地治理系统很少将其明确纳入政策框架，导致制度分散而非协调支持。分析将此状况概念化为碎片化的城市食品治理——即食品生产、土地利用规划和市场发展的责任并行运作，却缺乏有意的协调一致。因此，本土作物通过非正规实践和地方主动性得以存续，但在正式治理结构中仍处于边缘地位。通过展示本土作物如何依赖非正规性得以维持，却未能深度嵌入协调的政策和规划系统，本文为政策整合的讨论作出贡献，并为在快速城市化的非洲背景下提升城市食品系统转型的韧性提供指导。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103170.title: Fragmented urban food governance and impacts on the marginalisation of indigenous crops in Ghana
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103170.title_zh: 碎片化的城市食品治理及其对加纳本土作物边缘化的影响

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103171.abstract: This paper examines how participants from representative surveys in Germany and the United States (N = 2,685) prefer to redistribute a consumer food dollar across supply chain actors, including farmers, how willing they are to support and pay for redistribution, and which attitudes drive each of these preferences. We find widespread support for increasing farmers’ share of food expenditures, primarily driven by the belief that farmers lose from trade and lack alternative trading partners. In contrast, support and willingness to pay for specific interventions are rather shaped by ideological beliefs about markets. These findings demonstrate that folk economic beliefs, such as zero–sum thinking, play a central role in shaping food dollar redistribution. Building on this insight, we develop policy recommendations to help policymakers navigate what we term the Food Dollar Trap: the tension between calls to improve farmers’ incomes and concerns about food affordability.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103171.abstract_zh: 本文考察了来自德国和美国的代表性调查参与者（N = 2,685）如何倾向于在供应链参与者（包括农民）之间重新分配消费者食品支出中的每一美元，他们支持并愿意为这种再分配支付的程度，以及哪些态度驱动了这些偏好。我们发现，广泛支持提高农民在食品支出中的份额，这主要源于一种信念，即农民在贸易中受损且缺乏替代贸易伙伴。相比之下，对具体干预措施的支持和支付意愿则更多地受到关于市场的意识形态信念的影响。这些发现表明，民间经济信念，如零和思维，在塑造食品美元再分配中发挥着核心作用。基于这一见解，我们提出了政策建议，以帮助政策制定者应对我们称之为“食品美元陷阱”的困境：即改善农民收入呼声与对食品可负担性担忧之间的张力。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103171.title: The food dollar trap: attitudes driving public support for redistribution
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103171.title_zh: 食品美元陷阱：态度如何驱动公众对再分配的支持

10.1016/j.geb.2006.10.007.abstract: We characterize the optimal renegotiation-proof contract in a dynamic principal–agent model in which the type of the agent may change stochastically over time. We show that, under general conditions, the optimal contract with commitment is renegotiation proof even when type realizations are serially correlated. When the renegotiation-proofness constraint is binding, it is always optimal to partially screen the types by offering a menu of choices to the agent; and the distortion induced by the renegotiation-proofness constraint is non-decreasing in the persistence of types.
10.1016/j.geb.2006.10.007.abstract_zh: 我们刻画了动态委托-代理模型中最优的可再谈判契约，其中代理人的类型可能随时间随机变化。我们证明，在一般条件下，即使类型实现具有序列相关性，带有承诺的最优契约也是可再谈判的。当可再谈判性约束起约束作用时，通过向代理人提供选择菜单来部分筛选类型总是最优的；且由可再谈判性约束引起的扭曲随类型的持续性非递减。
10.1016/j.geb.2006.10.007.title: Optimality and Renegotiation in Dynamic Contracting
10.1016/j.geb.2006.10.007.title_zh: 动态契约中的最优性与再谈判

10.1016/j.geb.2025.11.005.abstract: This paper analyzes the welfare properties of the mechanism Taiwan uses to match students to high schools. I study the Taiwan mechanism under a theoretical model where students share the same ordinal rankings, and a single lottery determines schools’ preferences. In this setting, all Taiwan mechanisms ex ante weakly Pareto dominate deferred acceptance for strategizing students. Additionally, in my model, there always exists a Taiwan mechanism that provides greater welfare than deferred acceptance to students who do not strategize. Using Cambridge Public School data, I demonstrate that the Taiwan mechanism outperforms deferred acceptance for a range of deduction rules.
10.1016/j.geb.2025.11.005.abstract_zh: 本文分析了台湾地区用于将学生匹配至高中的机制的福利性质。我在一个理论模型下研究台湾机制，该模型假设学生具有相同的序数排名，且单一抽签决定学校的偏好。在此设定下，所有台湾机制在事前弱帕累托优于延迟接受机制，对策略性学生而言。此外，在我的模型中，总存在一种台湾机制，能为不采取策略的学生提供比延迟接受机制更高的福利。利用剑桥公立学校数据，我证明台湾机制在一系列扣分规则下均优于延迟接受机制。
10.1016/j.geb.2025.11.005.title: Welfare properties of the Taiwan mechanism

10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.008.abstract: A social choice function (SCF) is said to be Nash implementable (in pure strategies) if there exists a mechanism in which every pure-strategy Nash equilibrium induces outcomes specified by the SCF. The main objective of this paper is to assess the impact of considering mixed-strategy equilibria in Nash implementation. We define compelling Nash implementation as a case where the implementing mechanism possesses a pure-strategy equilibrium that strictly Pareto dominates any undesired mixed-strategy equilibrium. We show that if the finite environment and the SCF to be implemented jointly satisfy what we call Condition COM, then we can construct a finite mechanism which compellingly implements the SCF. We also identify a class of voting environments that satisfies Condition COM, extend Condition COM to accommodate social choice correspondences, and explore a preliminary stability-based justification for the implementing mechanism. Our mechanism has several desirable features: transfers are completely dispensable; only finite mechanisms are considered; integer games are not invoked; and agents’ attitudes toward risk do not affect implementation.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.008.abstract_zh: 一个社会选择函数（SCF）被称为纳什可实施（在纯策略下），如果存在一种机制，使得该机制中的每一个纯策略纳什均衡都能产生由该SCF指定的结果。本文的主要目标是评估在纳什实施中考虑混合策略均衡的影响。我们将“强制性纳什实施”定义为这样一种情形：实施机制拥有一个纯策略均衡，该均衡严格帕累托优于任何不期望的混合策略均衡。我们证明，如果有限环境与待实施的SCF共同满足我们称之为“COM条件”的条件，那么我们可以构建一个有限机制，该机制能够强制性地实施该SCF。我们还识别了一类满足COM条件的投票环境，将COM条件扩展以适应社会选择对应关系，并探讨了实施机制的一种初步的基于稳定性的合理性论证。我们的机制具有几个理想特征：转移支付完全可省略；仅考虑有限机制；不涉及整数博弈；且代理人对风险的态度不影响实施结果。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.008.title: Compellingness in Nash implementation

10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.009.abstract: We study dynamic mechanism design in non-clairvoyant environments, where sellers cannot forecast future demand and buyers hold private information. Using two laboratory experiments, we evaluate two non-clairvoyant mechanisms: the dynamic maximin-optimal non-clairvoyant mechanism (DM, Mirrokni et al., 2020) and the repeated static optimal mechanism (RS, Myerson, 1981). Experiment 1 compares DM and RS between demand-distribution scenarios and shows that non-clairvoyant mechanisms perform as intended: DM either outperforms or underperforms RS depending on the scenario, consistent with theory. Building on these results, Experiment 2 examines the optimal clairvoyant mechanism (OC) and a different implementation of DM. In surprising contrast to theory, OC using full information performs no better than the non-clairvoyant mechanisms, while DM performs equally well across implementation forms. Our results highlight the practical importance of non-clairvoyant mechanisms as implementable approaches to dynamic auction design in uncertain markets.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.009.abstract_zh: 我们研究了非预见性环境下的动态机制设计，其中卖方无法预测未来需求，买方持有私人信息。通过两项实验室实验，我们评估了两种非预见性机制：动态最大最小最优非预见性机制（DM，Mirrokni等人，2020）和重复静态最优机制（RS，Myerson，1981）。实验1在需求分布情景之间比较了DM和RS，并表明非预见性机制按预期运作：DM的表现优于或劣于RS取决于具体情景，与理论一致。基于这些结果，实验2考察了最优预见性机制（OC）和DM的另一种实施方式。与理论形成惊人对比的是，利用完全信息的OC表现并不优于非预见性机制，而DM在不同实施形式下表现相当。我们的结果强调了非预见性机制作为不确定市场中动态拍卖设计的可行方法，具有实际重要性。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.009.title: Evaluating non-clairvoyant dynamic mechanisms: Theory and experiment
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.009.title_zh: 评估非预见性动态机制：理论与实验

10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.010.abstract: Prior work finds that individuals are often less prosocial when they can exploit uncertainty as an excuse. In contrast to prior work that largely explores the relevance of excuses in the gain domain, this paper investigates the relevance of excuses in both the loss and gain domains. In our laboratory experiment, participants evaluated risky payoffs for themselves and their partners in either the gain or loss domain, with or without interpersonal trade-offs. We found that participants exhibited excuse-driven risk behaviors in both domains. We also documented significant individual heterogeneity in the degree of excuses, influenced by factors such as individuals’ risk preferences, beliefs about others’ risk preferences, and the size of the risk. We present a self-signaling model that incorporates self-image concerns to explain our experimental findings. We show that excuse-driven risk behavior arises because people misattribute their selfish behavior to risk preferences rather than a reduced level of altruism.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.010.abstract_zh: 先前研究发现，个体在能够利用不确定性作为借口时，往往表现出较少的亲社会行为。与主要探讨获益领域中借口相关性的先前工作不同，本文研究了借口在损失和获益两个领域中的相关性。在我们的实验室实验中，参与者在获益或损失领域内，无论是否存在人际间的权衡，都对自己及其伙伴的风险收益进行了评估。我们发现，参与者在两个领域中都表现出由借口驱动的风险行为。我们还记录了借口中显著的个体异质性，这种异质性受到个体风险偏好、对他人风险偏好的信念以及风险大小等因素的影响。我们提出一个包含自我形象关注的自信号模型来解释我们的实验结果。我们表明，借口驱动的风险行为之所以出现，是因为人们将自己的自私行为错误归因于风险偏好，而非利他主义水平的降低。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.010.title: Morality meets risk: What makes a good excuse for selfishness
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.010.title_zh: 道德与风险相遇：什么构成自私的合理借口

10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.011.abstract: Repeated strategic interactions with consistent partners involve both adaptive learning and hierarchical reasoning. Hybrid models that incorporate reasoning into adaptive learning paradigms have been proposed to capture these processes and their interactions at the behavioral level. Here, we employ model-based functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) to investigate the neural computations underlying decisions in repeated strategic interactions between two players using 11–20 money request games. A hybrid model explains medial prefrontal cortex activity more accurately than pure adaptive learning models. Additionally, we find that regions such as the rostral anterior cingulate, dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, right temporoparietal junction, precuneus, and anterior insula correlate with prediction error signals generated by adaptive, simulated adaptive, and sophisticated learning from the hybrid model. Together, our findings provide novel neural-level support for the interplay between adaptive learning and hierarchical reasoning in a repeated game with fixed partners.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.011.abstract_zh: 与固定伙伴的重复策略互动涉及适应性学习与层级推理的双重过程。为捕捉这些过程及其在行为层面的交互，已有研究提出将推理融入适应性学习范式的混合模型。本研究采用基于模型的脑功能磁共振成像技术，通过11-20金钱请求游戏，探究两名玩家在重复策略互动中决策背后的神经计算机制。相较于纯适应性学习模型，混合模型能更精确地解释内侧前额叶皮层的活动。此外，我们发现喙侧前扣带回、背外侧前额叶、右侧颞顶联合区、楔前叶及前脑岛等区域的活动与混合模型产生的适应性、模拟适应性及复杂学习预测误差信号相关。综上，本研究为固定伙伴重复博弈中适应性学习与层级推理的相互作用提供了新的神经层面证据。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.011.title: Neural correlates of interactions between adaptive learning and hierarchical reasoning in repeated strategic games
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.011.title_zh: 重复策略博弈中适应性学习与层级推理交互作用的神经关联

10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.012.abstract: Lobbying transparency regulations are hailed as a potential solution to concerns about the excessive influence of special interest groups (SIGs) over policymaking. I study how these regulations shape strategic interactions between voters, politicians and SIGs. By clarifying the process through which a policy was implemented, lobbying transparency helps voters hold politicians accountable and control the influence of SIGs. Ex-post, conditional on access, SIGs prefer to operate without lobbying transparency. Ex-ante, they may benefit from lobbying transparency because it redirects the voters’ blame towards politicians. However, lobbying transparency standards may ultimately hurt the electoral prospects of politicians and thus risk never being implemented, potentially explaining why voters’ demand for it remains unanswered.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.012.abstract_zh: 游说透明度法规被视为解决特殊利益集团（SIGs）对政策制定过度影响担忧的潜在方案。我研究了这些法规如何塑造选民、政治家和特殊利益集团之间的策略互动。通过明确政策实施的过程，游说透明度有助于选民追究政治家的责任，并控制特殊利益集团的影响力。事后，在获得准入的条件下，特殊利益集团倾向于在没有游说透明度的情况下运作。事前，他们可能因游说透明度而受益，因为它将选民的指责转向政治家。然而，游说透明度标准最终可能损害政治家的选举前景，从而面临永远无法实施的风险，这或许解释了为何选民对此的需求始终未得到回应。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.02.012.title: The case for lobbying transparency

10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.003.abstract: We consider a mixed version of the Shapley window model, where large traders are represented as atoms and small traders are represented by an atomless part. Our main theorem shows that any sequence of Cournot-Nash allocations of the strategic market games associated with the partial replications of the exchange economy has a limit point for each trader and that the assignment determined by these limit points is a Walrasian allocation of the original economy. Instead of relying on restrictive assumptions on the characteristics of atoms, as in Busetto et al. (2017), our limit theorem relies on the characteristics of agents in the atomless part and their endogenously price-taking behavior.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.003.abstract_zh: 我们考虑Shapley窗口模型的一个混合版本，其中大型交易者以原子形式表示，小型交易者则由无原子部分代表。我们的主要定理表明，与交换经济部分复制相关的战略市场博弈中，任何库尔诺-纳什配置序列对每位交易者都存在极限点，且由这些极限点确定的分配是原始经济的瓦尔拉斯配置。与Busetto等人（2017）依赖对原子特征的限制性假设不同，我们的极限定理依赖于无原子部分中代理人的特征及其内生价格接受行为。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.003.title: Noncooperative oligopoly in markets with a continuum of traders and a strongly connected set of commodities: A limit theorem
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.003.title_zh: 连续交易者市场与强连通商品集上的非合作寡头垄断：一个极限定理

10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.004.abstract: We study the relationship between two central concepts in the allocation of divisible goods: competitive equilibrium (CE) and allocations that maximize Nash welfare, i.e., allocations where the weighted geometric mean of the utilities is maximal. When agents have homogeneous concave utility functions, these concepts coincide: the classical Eisenberg–Gale convex program that maximizes Nash welfare over feasible allocations yields a competitive equilibrium. However, they diverge for non–homogeneous utilities. From a computational perspective, maximizing Nash welfare amounts to solving a convex program for any concave utility functions, whereas computing CE becomes PPAD-hard already for separable piecewise linear concave (SPLC) utilities. We introduce the concept of Gale-substitute utility functions, an analogue of the weak gross substitutes (WGS) property for the so-called Gale demand system. For Gale-substitutes utilities, we show that any allocation maximizing Nash welfare provides an approximate-CE with surprisingly strong guarantees, where every agent gets at least half the maximum utility they can get at any CE, and is approximately envy-free. Gale-substitutes include utility functions where computing CE is PPAD hard, such as all separable concave utilities and the previously studied non-separable class of Leontief-free utilities. We introduce a broad new class of utility functions called generalized network utilities based on the generalized flow model. This class includes SPLC and Leontief-free utilities, and we show that all such utilities are Gale-substitutes. Conversely, although some agents may get much higher utility at a Nash welfare maximizing allocation than at a CE, we show a ‘price of anarchy’ type result: for general concave utilities, every CE achieves at least (1/e)1/e > 0.69 fraction of the maximum Nash welfare, and this factor is tight.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.004.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了可分割商品分配中的两个核心概念之间的关系：竞争均衡（CE）与最大化纳什福利的分配，即加权几何平均效用最大的分配。当代理具有齐次凹效用函数时，这两个概念是一致的：经典的Eisenberg-Gale凸规划在可行分配上最大化纳什福利，从而产生竞争均衡。然而，对于非齐次效用，它们则出现分歧。从计算角度看，对于任何凹效用函数，最大化纳什福利等同于求解一个凸规划，而计算CE对于可分分段线性凹（SPLC）效用已经是PPAD难问题。我们引入了Gale替代效用函数的概念，这是弱总替代（WGS）性质在所谓的Gale需求系统中的类比。对于Gale替代效用，我们证明任何最大化纳什福利的分配都能提供一个具有惊人强保证的近似CE，其中每个代理至少获得其在任何CE中能获得的最大效用的一半，并且近似无嫉妒。Gale替代效用包括计算CE为PPAD难问题的效用函数，如所有可分凹效用以及先前研究的非可分Leontief-free效用类别。我们基于广义流模型引入了一类广泛的新效用函数，称为广义网络效用。这一类别包括SPLC和Leontief-free效用，并且我们证明所有这些效用都是Gale替代的。相反，尽管某些代理在纳什福利最大化分配中可能获得比在CE中高得多的效用，我们展示了一个“无政府状态价格”类型的结果：对于一般凹效用，每个CE至少实现最大纳什福利的(1/e)^(1/e) > 0.69比例，且这一因子是紧的。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.004.title: Approximating competitive equilibrium by Nash welfare
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.004.title_zh: 用纳什福利近似竞争均衡

10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.005.abstract: In a system of proportional representation, we study the interaction between a voters turnout decision and her party choice, and how these relate to party polarization. Quantal response equilibria predict such interaction effects. In particular they predict (i) a Polarization Effect: reduced strategic party choice when voting is voluntary makes voters more likely to vote for extreme parties (conditional on voting at all); (ii) an Extremist Effect: voters supporting extreme parties are most likely to vote; (iii) a Turnout Effect: party polarization increases voter turnout. We provide data from a laboratory experiment that support these theoretical predictions. In addition, we provide supporting empirical evidence from real world elections. Hence, the interaction between turnout and strategic voting that has been neglected in most of the previous literature is shown to be important.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.005.abstract_zh: 在比例代表制体系中，我们研究了选民的投票参与决策与其政党选择之间的相互作用，以及这些因素如何与政党极化相关联。量子响应均衡预测了此类交互效应。具体而言，它们预测了（i）极化效应：当投票为自愿时，策略性政党选择减少，使得选民（在决定投票的前提下）更倾向于支持极端政党；（ii）极端主义效应：支持极端政党的选民最有可能参与投票；（iii）投票率效应：政党极化提高了选民投票率。我们提供了来自实验室实验的数据，这些数据支持上述理论预测。此外，我们还提供了来自现实世界选举的实证证据作为佐证。因此，先前多数文献中忽视的投票参与与策略性投票之间的相互作用被证明是重要的。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.005.title: A simultaneous analysis of turnout and voting under proportional representation: Theory and experiments
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.005.title_zh: 比例代表制下投票率与投票行为的同步分析：理论与实验

10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.006.abstract: In a recent paper, Lin and Palfrey (2024) developed a theory of cognitive hierarchies (CH) in sequential games and observed that this solution concept is not reduced-normal-form invariant. In this paper I qualify and explain this observation. I show that the CH model is normal-form invariant, and that the differences arising from the application of the CH model to the reduced normal form depend only on how randomization by level-0 types is modeled. Indeed, while the uniform behavior strategy in the extensive form yields the uniform mixed strategy in the normal form, the latter does not correspond to the uniform randomization in the reduced normal form, because different reduced strategies may correspond to sets of equivalent strategies with different cardinalities. I also comment on (i) the invariance of the CH model to some transformations of the sequential game, and (ii) the independence of conditional beliefs about co-players’ level-types.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.006.abstract_zh: 在近期的一篇论文中，Lin和Palfrey（2024）提出了序贯博弈中的认知层级（CH）理论，并观察到该解概念不具备约简正规型不变性。本文对这一观察进行了限定与解释。我证明CH模型具有正规型不变性，且将CH模型应用于约简正规型时产生的差异仅取决于对0层级类型随机化的建模方式。实际上，尽管扩展型中的均匀行为策略对应于正规型中的均匀混合策略，但后者并不对应于约简正规型中的均匀随机化，因为不同的约简策略可能对应于基数不同的等价策略集合。我还就以下两点进行了评论：（i）CH模型对序贯博弈某些变换的不变性，以及（ii）关于对手层级类型的条件信念的独立性。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.006.title: Reduced strategies and cognitive hierarchies in the extensive and normal form
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.006.title_zh: 简化策略与认知层级在扩展式与标准式博弈中的表现

10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.007.abstract: This study analyzes strategic interactions between cheap talk and lie detection, identifies the receiver-optimal equilibrium under costly lie detection, and evaluates its effectiveness. An informed sender seeks to persuade an uninformed receiver to choose higher actions, while the receiver aims to align the action as closely as possible with the true state. The sender issues a claim about the state, and the receiver then decides whether to incur a cost to inspect the claim’s truthfulness. We show that the receiver-optimal equilibrium partitions the state space into three intervals. Types in the upper interval make precise and truthful claims, which are mimicked by types in the lower interval and are subject to random inspection. Types in the middle interval make a vague claim that is never inspected. We further show that lie detection is more beneficial to the receiver than direct state verification, as it creates incentives for moderate and high types to communicate truthfully.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.007.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了廉价交谈与谎言检测之间的策略互动，识别了在成本性谎言检测下的接收者最优均衡，并评估其有效性。一个信息灵通的发送者试图说服一个信息不足的接收者选择更高的行动，而接收者则力求使行动尽可能接近真实状态。发送者就状态提出声明，随后接收者决定是否承担成本以核查该声明的真实性。我们证明，接收者最优均衡将状态空间划分为三个区间。上区间中的类型做出精确且真实的声明，这些声明被下区间中的类型模仿，并受到随机检查。中区间中的类型则做出模糊声明，且从不被检查。我们进一步表明，与直接状态验证相比，谎言检测对接收者更为有利，因为它激励中等和高类型发送者进行真实沟通。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.007.title: Cheap talk and lie detection

10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.009.abstract: The quasi-prekernel is a novel solution concept for cooperative games. It is a refinement of existing prebargaining set solutions, notably the reactive, semireactive, and Aumann-Davis-Maschler prebargaining sets. It contains the prekernel, and coincides with that solution on simple games except possibly on balanced simple games with all individual worths equal to zero. An axiomatic characterization based on reduced game properties is provided. The steady version, obtained by putting conditions on objecting and counterobjecting coalitions, is considered as well. Finally, by considering objecting and counterobjecting coalitions independent of specific players, the socalled excess prebargaining obtains, which is another novel solution concept.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.009.abstract_zh: 准预核是合作博弈中的一个新颖解概念。它是对现有预谈判集解的细化，特别是针对反应性、半反应性及奥曼-戴维斯-马斯勒预谈判集。它包含预核，并且在简单博弈中与该解一致，除非在个别价值均为零的平衡简单博弈中可能例外。本文提供了基于约简博弈性质的公理化刻画。同时，考虑了对反对联盟和反反对联盟施加条件的稳定版本。最后，通过使反对联盟和反反对联盟独立于特定玩家，得到了所谓的超额预谈判，这是另一个新颖的解概念。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.009.title: The quasi-prekernel for cooperative games

10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.010.abstract: We analyze optimal procurement contracts when suppliers learn about project costs over time and retain an ex-post right to exit. In the first period, the firm observes a private signal on the likelihood of high costs; in the second, it learns the realized cost type and decides whether to continue or exercise its outside option. We show that when exit opportunities are sufficiently attractive, the optimal mechanism pools all first-period signals and reduces to a cost-plus contract, with payments tied only to realized, verifiable costs. Attempts to elicit cost forecasts ex-ante backfire: firms strategically under-report expectations, triggering exit in high-cost states and generating overruns. This provides a mechanism-based interpretation of cost overruns as failures of incentive design. Finally, we demonstrate that more generous outside options can raise procurement costs and lower firm profits, identifying conditions where limiting exit rights is ex-ante Pareto improving. (JEL D82, D86, H57)
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.010.abstract_zh: 我们分析了当供应商随时间了解项目成本并保留事后退出权时的最优采购合同。在第一阶段，企业观察到关于高成本可能性的私人信号；在第二阶段，它了解到实现的成本类型，并决定是继续还是行使外部选择权。我们表明，当退出机会足够有吸引力时，最优机制会汇集所有第一阶段的信号，并简化为成本加成合同，其中支付仅与已实现且可验证的成本挂钩。试图事前获取成本预测会适得其反：企业策略性地低估预期，导致高成本状态下退出并产生超支。这为成本超支作为激励设计失败提供了一种基于机制的解释。最后，我们证明更慷慨的外部选择权可以提高采购成本并降低企业利润，确定了限制退出权在事前帕累托改进的条件。（JEL D82, D86, H57）
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.010.title: The effect of exit rights on cost-based procurement contracts
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.010.title_zh: 退出权对成本型采购合同的影响

10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.011.abstract: International river basins are prone to droughts in some countries and floods in others. Water inflows from upstream neighbors benefit drought-stricken countries but harm flood-stricken countries. As a generalization of two existing river-sharing models (Ambec and Ehlers, 2008; Ambec and Sprumont, 2002), which do not capture the disutility of water inflow, we formulate the river-sharing problem with floods. We provide two characterizations of benefit-function profiles for which the downstream incremental distribution is the unique welfare distribution that satisfies both the upper and lower welfare bounds of river basin countries. We also propose a strategic bargaining process that yields this welfare distribution as a unique subgame-perfect equilibrium.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.011.abstract_zh: 国际河流流域中，部分国家易遭受干旱，而另一些国家则面临洪涝灾害。上游邻国的来水对遭受干旱的国家有益，却对受洪灾影响的国家造成损害。作为对现有两个河流共享模型（Ambec和Ehlers，2008；Ambec和Sprumont，2002）的推广，这些模型未考虑来水带来的负效用，我们构建了包含洪灾情形的河流共享问题。我们给出了效益函数谱系的两种特征刻画，在此条件下，下游增量分配是唯一同时满足流域国家上、下福利界限的福利分配方案。此外，我们提出了一种策略性谈判过程，该过程以唯一子博弈完美均衡的形式实现这一福利分配。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.011.title: River-sharing problem with floods
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.011.title_zh: 洪水条件下的河流共享问题

10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.012.abstract: The ability to punish free-riders has been shown to sustain cooperation in social dilemma games. Those that engage in costly punishment are often those that are angry at observed contributions of their fellow group members. This paper abstracts from the effect of integral (i.e., related to the situation) emotions and explicitly studies the effect of incidental (i.e., unrelated to the situation) emotions. By inducing either positive or negative emotions we can causally investigate the effect of negative emotions on punishment or reward decisions in a one-shot public good game where personal and social interests are at odds. Our findings suggest that neither punishment nor reward per se are a function of induced (incidental) emotions. Induced emotions also do not have an effect on the probability to punish or reward. However, we find that conditionally on punishing, subjects that are induced to be in a negative mood punish group members significantly harsher than subjects who are induced to be in a positive mood. The handing out of rewards is not affected by induced moods.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.012.abstract_zh: 惩罚搭便车者的能力已被证明能在社会困境博弈中维持合作。实施代价高昂的惩罚的人往往是那些对群体成员观察到的贡献感到愤怒的人。本文抽象出整体性（即与情境相关）情绪的影响，并明确研究附带性（即与情境无关）情绪的作用。通过诱导正面或负面情绪，我们可以在个人利益与社会利益相冲突的一次性公共品博弈中，因果性地考察负面情绪对惩罚或奖励决策的影响。我们的研究结果表明，惩罚或奖励本身并非诱导性（附带性）情绪的函数。诱导情绪对惩罚或奖励的概率也没有影响。然而，我们发现，在条件于惩罚的情况下，被诱导处于负面情绪的受试者对其群体成员的惩罚显著严厉于被诱导处于正面情绪的受试者。奖励的发放不受诱导情绪的影响。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.012.title: The effects of induced emotions on punishment and reward
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.012.title_zh: 诱导情绪对惩罚与奖励的影响

10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.013.abstract: We provide an original analysis of historical documents to describe the assignment procedures used to allocate entry-level civil service jobs in China from the tenth to the early twentieth century. The procedures tried to take different objectives into account through trial and error. By constructing a formal model that combines these procedures into a common framework, we compare their effectiveness in minimizing unfilled jobs and prioritizing high-level posts. We show that the problem was inherently complex such that changes made to improve the outcome could have the opposite effect. Based on a small modification of the last procedure used, we provide a new mechanism for producing maximum matchings under constraints in a transparent and public way.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.013.abstract_zh: 我们基于对历史文献的原创性分析，描述了从十世纪至二十世纪初中国用于分配初级公务员职位的程序。这些程序通过试错法试图兼顾不同目标。通过构建一个将这些程序整合进统一框架的形式化模型，我们比较了它们在减少职位空缺和优先安排高级职位方面的有效性。我们证明，该问题本质上具有复杂性，以至于旨在改善结果的调整可能产生相反效果。基于对最后使用程序的小幅修改，我们提出了一种新机制，能在约束条件下以透明且公开的方式生成最大匹配。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.013.title: Designing Heaven’s will: The job assignment in the Chinese imperial civil service
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.013.title_zh: 设计天意：中国帝国文官制度中的职位分配

10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.014.abstract: We propose a global games approach to the standard two-stage entry game. The entry decisions in the first stage are strategic substitutes. The second-stage game of product market competition reflects a fundamental common value “market attractiveness” parameter, about which firms get private noisy signals. The main result establishes the selection of a unique equilibrium in the entry game, as noise vanishes, in cut-off strategies implying efficient entry. This provides a theoretical foundation for the equilibrium selection commonly used in entry models in the empirical literature. In addition, using supermodularity techniques, we provide novel conditions of independent interest on the primitives (demand and cost functions) of market competition to justify our assumptions for Bertrand and Cournot competition. These include results on the effects of entry and demand shifts and highlight the critical relevance of the property of log-supermodularity of demand.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.014.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种全局博弈方法，用于分析标准的两阶段进入博弈。第一阶段中的进入决策表现为策略性替代关系。第二阶段的商品市场竞争博弈反映了一个基本的共同价值参数——“市场吸引力”，企业对此获得私人的噪声信号。主要结果确立了在噪声消失时，进入博弈中唯一均衡的选择，该均衡采用阈值策略，意味着有效率的进入。这为实证文献中常用的进入模型均衡选择提供了理论基础。此外，利用超模性技术，我们提供了关于市场竞争原始要素（需求与成本函数）的新颖条件，这些条件具有独立意义，用以证明伯特兰和古诺竞争假设的合理性。这些条件包括进入和需求变动效应的结果，并强调了需求对数超模性这一性质的关键重要性。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.014.title: Efficient equilibrium in submodular global games of entry
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.014.title_zh: 次模全局进入博弈中的有效均衡

10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.015.abstract: We study the link between strategic equilibria of competing auctions and the “competitive distribution of auctions” (Peters, 1997). With minimal restrictions on each seller’s possible costs and feasible reserve prices, we show that as the number of players increases to infinity while fixing a positive buyer-to-seller ratio, symmetric perfect Bayesian equilibria of finite markets converge to the competitive equilibrium of the large market.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.015.abstract_zh: 我们研究了竞争性拍卖的战略均衡与“拍卖的竞争性分布”（Peters, 1997）之间的联系。在对每个卖家的可能成本及可行保留价格施加最小限制的条件下，我们证明，当玩家数量趋于无穷大且保持固定的正买方与卖方比例时，有限市场的对称完美贝叶斯均衡会收敛至大市场的竞争均衡。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.015.title: Competitive limit of competing auctions
10.1016/j.geb.2026.03.015.title_zh: 竞争性拍卖的竞争极限

10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.001.abstract: We experimentally investigate targeting decisions in a setting where a human player competes for influence in a network against a computerized opponent with opposing views, whose targeting choice is revealed before the player acts. By varying network structure, opponent influence, and nodes opinion heterogeneity, we find that players typically adopt best-response strategies based on relative influence. However, they sometimes deviate – for example, by erroneously targeting central nodes or by avoiding the opponent’s target. Targeting is also affected by affinity and opposition biases, the strength of which depends on the initial opinion distribution. Targeting the center, avoiding the competitor’s target, or selecting nodes based on their initial opinions when these are not best responses generates significant efficiency losses.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.001.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了一个情境下的目标选择决策，其中人类玩家与持有相反观点的计算机化对手在网络中争夺影响力，而对手的目标选择在玩家行动前已被揭示。通过改变网络结构、对手影响力及节点观点异质性，我们发现玩家通常基于相对影响力采取最佳响应策略。然而，他们有时会偏离这一策略——例如，错误地瞄准中心节点或避开对手的目标。目标选择还受到亲和性与对立偏见的影响，其强度取决于初始观点分布。当瞄准中心、避开竞争者目标或依据初始观点选择节点并非最佳响应时，这些行为会导致显著的效率损失。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.001.title: Competing for influence in networks through strategic targeting
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.001.title_zh: 通过战略目标选择在网络中竞争影响力

10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.002.abstract: We develop and extend notions of potentials for normal-form games (Monderer and Shapley, 1996) to present a unified approach for the general class of social environments.
