The different potentials and corresponding social environments can be ordered in terms of their permissiveness. We classify different methods to construct potentials and we characterize potentials for specific examples such as matching problems, vote trading, multilateral trade, TU games, and various pillage games.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.002.abstract_zh: 我们发展并扩展了正规形式博弈中势函数的概念（Monderer和Shapley，1996），以提出一个针对一般社会环境的统一方法。不同的势函数及其对应的社会环境可按其宽松程度进行排序。我们分类了构建势函数的不同方法，并针对特定例子（如匹配问题、投票交易、多边贸易、TU博弈及各种掠夺博弈）刻画了势函数的特征。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.002.title: Potentials in social environments

10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.003.abstract: How does confidence in combination with success affect meritocratic beliefs and preferences for redistribution? In a large-scale real-effort competition (n = 1365), we manipulate both confidence and the outcome of the competition to provide causal evidence. First, we show that increased confidence causes successful participants to perceive outcomes as more meritocratic, while unsuccessful participants perceive outcomes as more determined by luck. Thus, increased confidence polarizes meritocratic beliefs between successful and unsuccessful individuals. Second, we find no statistically significant effect of confidence on preferences for redistribution. However, we do find that winning the competition significantly reduces the willingness to redistribute, regardless of confidence treatment. Our findings suggest that disagreements about the causes of inequality are most likely among individuals who anticipate success in a meritocratic system, and that success and failure can have large polarizing effects on preferences for redistribution.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.003.abstract_zh: 信心与成功如何共同影响人们对精英主义的信念及再分配偏好？在一项大规模真实努力竞赛中（样本量n=1365），我们同时操控信心与竞赛结果，以提供因果证据。首先，我们表明，信心的增强导致成功参与者更倾向于将结果视为精英主义所致，而失败参与者则更倾向于认为结果由运气决定。因此，信心的增强在成功与失败个体之间加剧了精英主义信念的两极分化。其次，我们发现信心对再分配偏好无统计学显著影响。然而，我们确实发现，无论信心处理如何，赢得竞赛显著降低了再分配的意愿。我们的研究结果表明，关于不平等根源的分歧最可能出现在那些预期在精英主义体系中取得成功的人群中，而成功与失败可能对再分配偏好产生巨大的极化效应。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.003.title: Lucky but confident –The effect of confidence on meritocratic beliefs and preferences for redistribution
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.003.title_zh: 幸运但自信——自信对精英信念与再分配偏好的影响

10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.004.abstract: I consider environments where an upwardly-biased expert faces both costs of acquiring information and of “transmitting inaccurate information relative to the realized state” (forecasting error) when advising a decision-maker. While existing models study these costs separately, I show that considering them jointly can substantially alter standard results. Introducing costly information acquisition overturns the partial-communication and language-inflation predictions of models with bounded messages and costly communication: equilibrium communication features truth-telling and full transmission of the acquired information. At the same time, communication costs can reverse the structure of optimal information acquisition, shifting from partitions with decreasing interval lengths to partitions with increasing interval lengths when misreporting is sufficiently more costly than acquisition. Finally, information acquisition costs generate an acquisition–transmission dilemma: the expert never acquires information that cannot be credibly communicated, implying that perfect information acquisition is impossible.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.004.abstract_zh: 我考察了在向上偏误的专家面临信息获取成本及“相对于已实现状态的传递不准确信息”（预测误差）成本时，为决策者提供建议的环境。现有模型分别研究这些成本，但我表明，将它们联合考虑可能显著改变标准结论。引入昂贵的信息获取推翻了有界消息和昂贵沟通模型中的部分沟通与语言膨胀预测：均衡沟通特征为诚实报告及所获信息的完全传递。同时，沟通成本可逆转最优信息获取的结构，当误报成本显著高于获取成本时，从区间长度递减的分区转向区间长度递增的分区。最后，信息获取成本产生获取-传递困境：专家从不获取无法可信沟通的信息，这意味着完美信息获取是不可能的。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.004.title: When information and communication are both costly
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.004.title_zh: 信息与沟通成本高昂时

10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.005.abstract: Gentzkow and Kamenica (2016) show that competition among senders benefits receivers if and only if the information environment is Blackwell-connected. This paper shows that introducing receivers’ limited attention and heterogeneous beliefs can overturn this result. Even in a Blackwell-connected information environment, information revelation may be lower under duopoly than under monopoly. Indeed, limited attention may incentivize receivers to sort into the audiences of like-minded senders. In turn, this adverse sorting can make it optimal for senders to reveal less information.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.005.abstract_zh: Gentzkow和Kamenica（2016）的研究表明，当且仅当信息环境是Blackwell连通的时，发送者之间的竞争对接收者有利。本文证明，引入接收者的有限注意力和异质性信念可以颠覆这一结论。即使在Blackwell连通的信息环境中，双头垄断下的信息揭示程度也可能低于垄断情形。实际上，有限注意力可能激励接收者选择加入与自己观点相似的发送者受众群体。反过来，这种不利的分群可能使发送者最优选择揭示更少的信息。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.005.title: Competition in persuasion in the attention economy
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.005.title_zh: 注意力经济中的说服竞争

10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.006.abstract: This paper studies a preference revelation game induced by the Efficiency-Adjusted Deferred Acceptance (EDA) mechanism in a priority-based allocation problem. The main findings are: (i) we show the existence of a strong Nash equilibrium under EDA through a simple algorithm; (ii) the equilibrium outcome from the algorithm coincides with the outcome of the Top Trading Cycles mechanism; and (iii) the strategy profile found by the algorithm is also a strictly strong Nash equilibrium in the game induced by the Deferred Acceptance mechanism.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.006.abstract_zh: 本文研究在基于优先级的配置问题中，由效率调整的延迟接受（EDA）机制引发的偏好揭示博弈。主要发现如下：（i）我们通过一个简单算法证明了在EDA下强纳什均衡的存在性；（ii）该算法得出的均衡结果与顶级交易循环机制的结果一致；（iii）该算法找到的策略组合在延迟接受机制引发的博弈中同样构成严格强纳什均衡。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.006.title: On the existence of a strong Nash equilibrium under the efficiency-adjusted deferred acceptance mechanism
10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.006.title_zh: 效率调整延迟接受机制下强纳什均衡的存在性

10.1016/j.geb.2026.04.009.title: Persuasion of interacting receivers

10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.001.abstract: We propose a formal framework for measuring the authority of individuals in opinion dynamics. Our framework is based on an axiomatic foundation in the tradition of coalitional game theory. We show that the unique solution concept satisfying our axioms is a generalization of the “authority distribution” notion of Hu and Shapley. Our approach is based on the dynamics of opinion exchange rather than on network topology. However, for any fixed opinion dynamics, our authority concept associates a network centrality measure with any given network topology. Earlier as well as new network centrality measures are obtained in this way.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.001.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个正式框架，用以衡量意见动态中个体的权威性。该框架建立在联盟博弈论传统的公理化基础之上。我们证明，满足我们公理的唯一解概念是胡和沙普利“权威分布”概念的推广。我们的方法基于意见交流的动态过程，而非网络拓扑结构。然而，对于任何固定的意见动态，我们的权威概念都会为任何给定的网络拓扑结构关联一个网络中心性度量。通过这种方式，既得到了早先的网络中心性度量，也获得了新的度量。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.001.title: Authority measure for opinion dynamics

10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.002.abstract: This paper examines the evolution of strategies in repeated 2 x 2 anti-coordination games. Turn-taking is advantageous against strategies that consistently choose the same stage-game action, provided the discount factor is sufficiently high or the payoff asymmetry in coordination is sufficiently low. However, it becomes vulnerable when the set of strategies allowed to invade is expanded. Nonetheless, if the matching process exhibits a high degree of assortativity, turn-taking regains robustness as long as it promotes efficiency.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.002.abstract_zh: 本文考察了重复2×2反协调博弈中策略的演变。当贴现因子足够高或协调中的收益不对称性足够低时，轮流选择策略相对于持续选择相同阶段博弈行动的策略具有优势。然而，当允许入侵的策略集合扩大时，这种优势变得脆弱。尽管如此，如果匹配过程表现出高度的同类相配性，只要轮流选择能促进效率，它便能重新获得稳健性。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.002.title: The evolution of strategies in repeated 2  ×  2 anti-coordination games
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.002.title_zh: 重复2×2反协调博弈中策略的演化

10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.004.abstract: We provide a strategic model of the formation of production networks that subsumes the standard general equilibrium approach. The objective of firms in our setting is to choose their supply relationships so as to maximize their profit at the general equilibrium that unfolds. We show that this objective is equivalent to the maximization by the firms of their eigenvector centrality in the production network. As is common in network formation games based on centrality, there are multiple Nash equilibria in our setting. We have investigated the characteristics and the social efficiency of these equilibria in a stylized version of our model representing international trade networks. We show that the impact of network structure on social welfare is firstly determined by a trade-off between costs of increasing process complexity and positive spillovers on productivity induced by the diversification of the input mix. We further analyze a variant of our model that accounts for the risks of disruption of supply relationships. In this setting, we characterize how social welfare depends on the structure of the production network, the spatial distribution of risks, and the process of shock aggregation in supply chains. We finally show that simple trade policies characterized by sets of links that are either prevented or catalyzed can be a powerful equilibrium selection device.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.004.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个生产网络形成的战略模型，该模型涵盖了标准一般均衡方法。在我们的设定中，企业的目标是选择其供应关系，以在随之展开的一般均衡中最大化其利润。我们证明，这一目标等同于企业在生产网络中最大化其特征向量中心性。正如基于中心性的网络形成博弈中常见的那样，我们的设定中存在多个纳什均衡。我们已在一个代表国际贸易网络的简化模型版本中研究了这些均衡的特征及其社会效率。我们表明，网络结构对社会福利的影响首先由增加流程复杂性的成本与投入组合多样化带来的生产率正向溢出之间的权衡决定。我们进一步分析了我们模型的一个变体，该变体考虑了供应关系中断的风险。在此设定中，我们刻画了社会福利如何依赖于生产网络的结构、风险的空间分布以及供应链中冲击聚合的过程。最后，我们证明，以被阻止或被促进的链接集合为特征的简单贸易政策可以成为强大的均衡选择工具。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.004.title: Strategic formation of production networks

10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.005.abstract: This paper examines effort-maximizing move orders in two-player Tullock contests across varying levels of contest accuracy and player asymmetries. Unlike prior work that favors strong-lead sequential formats in lottery contests, our analysis demonstrates that all three formats—strong-lead, weak-lead, and simultaneous—can be optimal in the general Tullock contests. Strong-lead contests are most effective in noisy environments, but lose their advantage as contest accuracy increases. Weak-lead contests may become optimal when the weaker player successfully preempts. Simultaneous-move contests tend to perform better as the players’ ability differences become less severe. Overall, the optimal contest design jointly depends on the contest accuracy levels and relative strengths of the contestants.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.005.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在两人Tullock竞赛中，随着竞赛精确度与选手不对称性的变化，何种移动顺序能最大化努力程度。与先前偏好于彩票竞赛中强者领先顺序格式的研究不同，我们的分析表明，在一般Tullock竞赛中，三种格式——强者领先、弱者领先及同时进行——均可能成为最优选择。在噪声环境中，强者领先竞赛最为有效，但随着竞赛精确度的提升，其优势逐渐减弱。当较弱选手成功抢占先机时，弱者领先竞赛可能成为最优。而随着选手能力差异减小，同时移动竞赛往往表现更佳。总体而言，最优竞赛设计取决于竞赛精确度水平及参赛者相对实力的共同作用。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.005.title: The effort-maximizing move order in tullock contests
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.005.title_zh: 塔洛克竞赛中努力最大化的行动顺序

10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.006.abstract: This paper introduces the concept of participatory persuasion in autocracies, where regimes use controlled communication to sustain their rule. In an overlapping-generations model of democratization, we show that the regime’s survival can be prolonged when citizens communicate within small circles compared to a setting in which communication is entirely absent. Paradoxically, limited freedom of speech enhances the regime’s persuasion by turning citizens into inadvertent agents of state propaganda. We further extend the analysis to settings with homophily or under state censorship.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.006.abstract_zh: 本文提出了威权政体中“参与式说服”的概念，即政权通过受控沟通来维持其统治。在一个代际交叠的民主化模型中，我们证明，与完全没有沟通的环境相比，当公民在小圈子内交流时，政权的存续时间可以得到延长。矛盾的是，有限的言论自由通过将公民转变为国家宣传的无意代理人，增强了政权的说服力。我们进一步将分析扩展到同质性或国家审查制度下的情境。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.006.title: A model of participatory persuasion

10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.009.abstract: We compare preferences for temporal resolution when uncertainty is resolved over a probability rather than a value. In various theoretical frameworks, preferences over gradual versus one-shot resolution do not depend on whether values or probabilities define the main object of uncertainty. In our experiment, however, we find that preferences for resolution vary with the type of prize: subjects prefer gradual resolution for uncertain value prizes, whereas no such preference emerges for uncertain probability prizes. To explain our findings, we propose an explanation based on what we call “process utility”.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.009.abstract_zh: 我们比较了当不确定性通过概率而非价值来消解时，人们对时间分辨率的偏好。在多种理论框架下，对于渐进式与一次性分辨的偏好并不取决于不确定性主要对象是由价值还是概率定义。然而，在我们的实验中，我们发现对分辨率的偏好随奖品类型而变化：对于不确定的价值奖品，受试者偏好渐进式分辨；而对于不确定的概率奖品，则未出现此类偏好。为解释我们的发现，我们提出了一种基于我们称之为“过程效用”的解释。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.009.title: The resolution of uncertainty in the value and probability domains
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.009.title_zh: 价值域与概率域中不确定性的消解

10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.010.abstract: Digital platforms may manipulate customer reviews to impede other consumers from acquiring accurate information and to increase sales. In a rational inattention setting where consumers acquire information about product quality before making purchasing decisions, we show that the platform has incentives to restrict information acquisition in the presence of consumers with wishful thinking. These biased consumers are unaware of their bias and weigh any good news about the product quality more heavily than a Bayesian consumer. We identify the conditions under which the firm optimally constrains information acquisition, and characterize when competition can alleviate this type of exploitation. Our results extend to a broader class of non-Bayesian rules beyond wishful thinking.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.010.abstract_zh: 数字平台可能操纵客户评论，以阻碍其他消费者获取准确信息并提升销售额。在消费者购买决策前获取产品质量信息的理性疏忽框架下，我们证明，在存在一厢情愿思维的消费者时，平台有动机限制信息获取。这些有偏见的消费者未意识到自身偏见，并且对产品质量的任何好消息给予比贝叶斯消费者更重的权重。我们识别了企业最优限制信息获取的条件，并刻画了竞争何时能缓解此类剥削。我们的结果扩展至一厢情愿思维之外更广泛的非贝叶斯规则类别。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.010.title: Information manipulation of wishful thinkers
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.010.title_zh: 一厢情愿者的信息操纵

10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.011.abstract: We propose an experimental design and data‑analytic method for eliciting and distinguishing the strict‑preference, indifference, and indecisiveness components of individual preferences in general choice environments. The design combines a forced‑choice treatment with a free‑choice treatment. In both treatments, subjects may select multiple alternatives from a menu. In the free‑choice treatment, subjects may also avoid or delay choice at a small expected cost. To analyze such data, we extend a standard non‑parametric goodness‑of‑fit criterion to accommodate multi‑valued choices. We apply it to evaluate the consistency of subjects’ 50 decisions with utility maximization and two models of incomplete‑preference maximization. Around 55% of subjects are well explained by one of these models, with 33% and 22% best explained by utility and incomplete-preference maximization, respectively. Revealed preferences typically feature non-trivial indifferences, and those that are incomplete often exhibit the predicted theoretical distinctions between indifference and indecisiveness, which are documented empirically for the first time.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.011.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种实验设计与数据分析方法，用于在一般选择环境中引出并区分个体偏好的严格偏好、无差异和犹豫不决成分。该设计结合了强制选择处理与自由选择处理。在两种处理中，受试者均可从菜单中选取多个备选项。在自由选择处理中，受试者还可以以较小的预期成本避免或延迟选择。为分析此类数据，我们扩展了标准的非参数拟合优度准则，以适应多值选择。我们将其应用于评估受试者50项决策与效用最大化及两种不完全偏好最大化模型的一致性。约55%的受试者能被这些模型中的一种很好地解释，其中33%和22%分别最佳解释为效用最大化和不完全偏好最大化。揭示出的偏好通常具有非平凡的無差异特征，而那些不完全的偏好往往展现出预测的理论区分，即无差异与犹豫不决之间的区别，这首次在实证中得到记录。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.011.title: Eliciting and distinguishing between weak and incomplete preferences: Theory, experiment and computation
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.011.title_zh: 引出并区分弱偏好与不完全偏好：理论、实验与计算

10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.012.abstract: Why do some investors delegate financial decisions to supposed experts? We report an on-line experiment designed to disentangle four possible motives. About 800 investors drawn from the Prolific subject pool choose whether or not to delegate a real-stakes choice among lotteries to a previous investor (a “designee”) after seeing information on the performance of several available designees. We find that a surprisingly large fraction of investors delegate even trivial choice tasks, suggesting a major role for blame shifting motives. A larger fraction of investors delegate our more complex tasks, suggesting that decision costs play a role for some investors. Some investors who delegate choose a low quality designee with high earnings, suggesting a role for chasing past performance. We find no evidence for a fourth possible motive, that delegation makes risk more acceptable.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.012.abstract_zh: 为何部分投资者会将财务决策委托给所谓的专家？我们通过一项在线实验，旨在厘清四种可能的动机。实验对象为来自Prolific样本库的约800名投资者，他们需在了解若干可选受托人的表现信息后，决定是否将涉及真实赌注的彩票选择任务委托给先前投资者（即“受托人”）。研究发现，令人惊讶的是，相当大比例的投资者即使面对简单选择任务也选择委托，这表明推卸责任的动机扮演了重要角色。更多投资者选择委托更复杂的任务，暗示决策成本对部分投资者有影响。部分选择委托的投资者倾向于选择业绩高但质量低的受托人，这反映出追逐过往业绩的倾向。我们未发现第四种可能动机的证据，即委托使风险更易接受。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.012.title: Motives for delegating financial decisions

10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.013.abstract: A developer seeks to persuade a sequence of two short-tenured officials to award her a contract. Officials maximize social welfare, and the second official follows a bureaucratic norm requiring reliance only on evidence presented directly to him. Thus, Bayesian inference is restricted when the first official defers the decision, because the second does not observe the first official’s evidence. The first official can exploit this restriction to induce more informative experiments. When the static value of persuasion is zero for the bureaucracy but positive for the developer, two outcomes arise: either the first official decides immediately with more information, increasing social welfare, or delay occurs, with delay costs offsetting informational benefits. In both cases, the developer’s expected payoff is lower than under static persuasion. With unrestricted inference, an intuitive PBE replicates the static outcome, so the norm may increase social welfare and never reduces it relative to the static benchmark.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.013.abstract_zh: 一位开发商试图说服两位任期短暂、相继上任的官员授予其合同。官员们追求社会福利最大化，而第二位官员遵循官僚规范，仅依赖直接呈递给他的证据。因此，当第一位官员推迟决策时，贝叶斯推断受到限制，因为第二位官员无法观察到第一位官员的证据。第一位官员可以利用这一限制来诱导更具信息量的实验。当说服的静态价值对官僚机构为零但对开发商为正时，会出现两种结果：要么第一位官员立即决策并掌握更多信息，从而增加社会福利；要么发生延迟，延迟成本抵消信息收益。在两种情况下，开发商的预期收益均低于静态说服下的水平。在无限制推断下，一个直观的完美贝叶斯均衡复制了静态结果，因此该规范可能增加社会福利，且相对于静态基准而言，绝不会降低社会福利。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.013.title: Bureaucratic norms and dynamic Bayesian persuasion
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.013.title_zh: 官僚规范与动态贝叶斯说服

10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.014.abstract: We study dynamic coordination with costly switching, where players are initially uncertain regarding how to coordinate. We model two players searching for compatible platforms in the presence of two kinds of frictions: noisy outcomes and costly switching. The model predicts that players remain on their current platforms whenever their common belief is sufficiently optimistic; otherwise, they randomize their actions, switching with higher probability whenever they are more pessimistic about compatibility, switching is less costly, or success conditional on compatibility is more likely. In an experiment, we vary (i) whether success is Deterministic or Stochastic when players are on compatible platforms and (ii) the cost of switching. We allow subjects to choose explicit mixed strategies to provide a better test of the theory. The data are consistent with most comparative statics predictions, particularly in the Deterministic case, but differ from some of the other theoretical predictions. To explain the disparities between theory and the data, particularly when learning is noisy and switching is costly, we discuss the impacts of several factors, including cognitive ability, inattention, sensitivity to recent failures, and experience.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.014.abstract_zh: 我们研究在存在昂贵转换成本的动态协调问题，其中参与者最初对于如何协调存在不确定性。我们构建了一个模型，涉及两名参与者在两种摩擦条件下寻找兼容平台：结果的不确定性和转换成本的高昂。模型预测，当参与者的共同信念足够乐观时，他们会留在当前平台；否则，他们会随机化行动，且在以下情况下更可能以更高概率转换：对兼容性的悲观程度增加、转换成本降低，或兼容条件下成功的可能性增大。在实验中，我们操纵了两个变量：（i）当参与者处于兼容平台时，成功结果是确定性的还是随机性的；（ii）转换成本的高低。我们允许受试者选择明确的混合策略，以更严格地检验理论。数据与大多数比较静态预测相符，尤其是在确定性情形下，但与其他一些理论预测存在差异。为解释理论与数据之间的偏差，特别是在学习过程伴随噪声且转换成本高昂的情况下，我们探讨了包括认知能力、注意力不集中、对近期失败的敏感度以及经验在内的多种因素的影响。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.014.title: Dynamic coordination with switching costs
10.1016/j.geb.2026.05.014.title_zh: 具有转换成本的动态协调

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.001.abstract: Reinforcement learning algorithms play an increasingly important role in economic situations. These situations are often strategic, and the artificial intelligence may or may not be cooperative. We compare human and algorithmic cooperation rates in the infinitely repeated two-player prisoner’s dilemma and study which strategies they choose to cooperate and punish deviations. Through a sequence of computational Q-learning and human-player experiments, we find that our Q-learning algorithms tend to cooperate less than humans, particularly when cooperation is risky or not incentive-compatible. Algorithms often use different strategies than humans, leading to distinct on- and off-path behavior.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.001.abstract_zh: 强化学习算法在经济情境中扮演着日益重要的角色。这些情境往往具有策略性，而人工智能可能合作也可能不合作。我们比较了人类与算法在无限重复的两玩家囚徒困境中的合作率，并研究了它们选择何种策略进行合作及惩罚偏离行为。通过一系列计算性Q学习算法和人类玩家实验，我们发现我们的Q学习算法倾向于比人类更少合作，尤其是在合作具有风险或不符合激励相容条件时。算法常采用与人类不同的策略，导致路径上及路径外的行为存在显著差异。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.001.title: Algorithmic Cooperation: A Comparison with Human Play in the Infinitely Repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.001.title_zh: 算法合作：与人类在无限重复囚徒困境中的行为比较

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.002.abstract: Networks frequently experience attrition as individual members exit over time. Such departures can significantly impact the behavior of their peers and have cascading effects on overall network activity. We investigate such effects within the framework of the canonical linear-quadratic model of peer influence. We introduce an exogenous shock that removes certain agents from the network, with the key feature that only their immediate neighbors observe these departures. In this setting of incomplete information, we characterize the equilibrium behavior using the Bonacich centrality defined over the belief structures of the agents. We propose the concept of an agent’s expected marginal contribution, quantifying the impact of their presence or absence on aggregate network activity. This metric has direct policy relevance: it enables a planner to identify strategically important agents for targeted intervention: either to preserve their participation and enhance collective effort, or to remove them to reduce activity.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.002.abstract_zh: 网络经常因个别成员随时间退出而经历人员流失。此类退出可能显著影响同伴的行为，并对整体网络活动产生连锁效应。我们在经典的线性二次同伴影响模型框架内研究这些效应。我们引入一个外生冲击，从网络中移除某些主体，其关键特征在于只有他们的直接邻居能观察到这些退出。在这种信息不完全的设定下，我们利用基于主体信念结构的博纳奇中心性来刻画均衡行为。我们提出主体预期边际贡献的概念，用以量化其存在或缺失对总体网络活动的影响。这一指标具有直接的政策相关性：它使规划者能够识别具有战略重要性的主体，以进行有针对性的干预——要么维持其参与以增强集体努力，要么将其移除以减少活动。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.002.title: Network attrition: Theory and policy implications
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.002.title_zh: 网络损耗：理论与政策启示

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.003.abstract: We study the problem of measuring the popularity of artists in music streaming platforms. We uncover the space of popularity indices upon exploring the implications of several axioms capturing principles with normative appeal. As a result, we characterize several families of indices. Our characterizations might help to address the rising concern in the music industry to explore new methods that reward artists (from the revenues platforms raise by charging users) more appropriately. We actually connect our families to the new royalties models, recently launched by Spotify and Deezer.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.003.abstract_zh: 我们研究音乐流媒体平台中艺术家受欢迎程度的度量问题。通过探索若干具有规范吸引力的公理含义，我们揭示了受欢迎度指数的空间。由此，我们刻画了几类指数族。我们的特征化结果可能有助于解决音乐产业中日益增长的关切，即探索更合理地奖励艺术家（基于平台向用户收费所产生的收入）的新方法。我们实际上将所得到的指数族与Spotify和Deezer近期推出的新版税模型联系起来。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.003.title: New methods to compensate artists in music streaming platforms
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.003.title_zh: 音乐流媒体平台中艺术家补偿的新方法

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.004.abstract: A principal wants to rank and reward teams in an organization. Agents perfectly observe the local ranking of their teams, and strictly prefer being on higher-ranking teams. I show there exists an ex-post incentive compatible and efficient team ranking mechanism if (i) there is an agent who belongs to every team (supervisor condition), or (ii) whenever two teams share an agent in common, they share at least two agents in common (connectivity condition). I identify a class of organizations for which these conditions are both necessary and sufficient. In the special case where the principal wants to rank every group of co-workers in the organization, there exists a team ranking mechanism if and only if the organizational network is a star.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.004.abstract_zh: 委托人希望对组织中的团队进行排名并给予奖励。代理人能够完全观察到其所在团队的局部排名，并且严格偏好于排名更高的团队。我证明，若满足以下任一条件，则存在一种事后激励相容且高效的团队排名机制：(i) 存在一位属于所有团队的代理人（监督者条件），或 (ii) 当两个团队共享一名共同代理人时，它们至少共享两名共同代理人（连通性条件）。我识别出一类组织，在这些组织中，上述条件既是必要的也是充分的。在委托人希望对组织中每一组同事进行排名的特殊情形下，存在团队排名机制当且仅当组织网络为星形结构。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.004.title: Ranking teams

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.005.abstract: Many economic situations involve contests for resources, such as winning prizes and earning bonuses. The likelihood of success in such contests is often skewed, favouring some competitors while putting others at a disadvantage. I study the strategic interaction between an advantaged and a disadvantaged competitor in a repeated contest where winning can help overcome the initial disadvantage. Theoretically, the competition for advantage increases effort by both competitors, but that the advantaged competitor increases effort more than the disadvantaged competitor. As a result, the disadvantaged competitor is even less likely to win when they have the potential to overcome their disadvantage, and the initial disadvantage is persistent. Evidence from a laboratory experiment supports these theoretical predictions.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.005.abstract_zh: 许多经济情境涉及对资源的争夺，如赢得奖品和赚取奖金。此类竞赛中成功的可能性往往偏向某些竞争者，而使其他竞争者处于不利地位。我研究了一个重复竞赛中优势方与劣势方之间的策略互动，其中获胜有助于克服初始劣势。理论上，对优势的竞争会增加双方的投入努力，但优势方的努力增加幅度大于劣势方。因此，当劣势方有可能克服其劣势时，他们获胜的可能性反而更低，且初始劣势具有持续性。实验室实验的证据支持了这些理论预测。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.005.title: The Persistence of Disadvantages: Theory and Experiment
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.005.title_zh: 劣势的持续性：理论与实验

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.006.abstract: Each agent in our model occupies a position in a hierarchy (a directed tree) and generates returns through collaborating with his superiors. Thus his superiors can also claim their ownership rights over his returns. Our main axiom for the allocation of these returns is the standard monotonicity with regard to the collective ownership. We establish axiomatic characterizations of monotonic allocation rules. They are represented by hierarchical transfers of the returns at each position to the superiors. When the rate of transfer is symmetric, the rules coincide with the geometric rules (ownership rates constitute a geometric sequence, moving up the hierarchy). Other fair allocation rules are also available, when the rate of transfer is asymmetric; a focal example is the hierarchical equal sharing rule, which is shown to be the unique one with an equal treatment axiom.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.006.abstract_zh: 在我们的模型中，每个代理在层级结构（一个有向树）中占据一个位置，并通过与上级合作产生收益。因此，他的上级也可以对其收益主张所有权。我们分配这些收益的主要公理是关于集体所有权的标准单调性。我们建立了单调分配规则的公理化特征描述。这些规则通过层级中每个位置向上级的收益转移来表示。当转移率对称时，这些规则与几何规则一致（所有权比率构成一个几何序列，沿层级向上移动）。当转移率不对称时，其他公平分配规则也可用；一个典型的例子是层级平等分享规则，该规则被证明是唯一满足平等对待公理的规则。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.006.title: Fair Allocation in Hierarchies

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.007.abstract: We study optimal mechanisms for a data broker selling market segmentation to a producer. The producer engages in discriminatory pricing and is privately informed about a payoff-relevant parameter. We first characterize a class of markets from which the segmentations in optimal mechanisms can be constructed. If the profit-maximizing prices of different producer types are ordered and only downward or only upward incentive constraints bind, this analysis shows that in any created market either all consumer types are served or just a single one. We then characterize optimal mechanisms for a valuation structure that captures differing product quality. In particular, the consumers are segmented into markets in which everyone is served. Lastly, we give a sufficient condition under which optimal mechanisms are efficient regardless of the binding constraints.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.007.abstract_zh: 我们研究数据经纪人向生产者出售市场细分的最优机制。生产者实行歧视性定价，并私下知晓一个影响收益的参数。我们首先刻画了一类市场，从中可以构建最优机制中的细分。若不同生产者类型的利润最大化价格有序排列，且仅向下或仅向上的激励约束起作用，此分析表明，在任何创建的市场中，要么所有消费者类型都被服务，要么仅有一个被服务。随后，我们针对一种体现产品质量差异的估值结构，刻画了最优机制。特别是，消费者被细分为所有个体均被服务的市场。最后，我们给出一个充分条件，在此条件下，无论约束如何绑定，最优机制都是有效的。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.007.title: Optimal Mechanisms for Selling Market Segmentation
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.007.title_zh: 市场细分销售的最优机制

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.008.abstract: We study the object reallocation problem with transfers. We show that if a rule satisfies endowments-swapping-proofness, strategy-proofness, individual rationality, and no subsidy (or non-imposition), then it is equivalent to the top trading cycles rule without transfers (TTC without transfers). Therefore, even when transfers among agents are permitted, no transfer occurs under the class of rules satisfying these four properties, not even in the form of fixed prices.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.008.abstract_zh: 我们研究带转移的对象再分配问题。我们证明，若某一规则满足禀赋交换防操纵性、策略防操纵性、个体理性及无补贴（或非强制）条件，则该规则等同于无转移的顶级交易循环规则（TTC without transfers）。因此，即便允许代理人之间进行转移，在满足这四个性质的规则类别下，也不会发生任何转移，即便是以固定价格的形式也不会出现。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.008.title: Endowments-swapping-proof object reallocation with transfers
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.008.title_zh: 带转移支付的禀赋互换防操纵物品再分配

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.009.abstract: In evolutionary game theory, when a population of players with the same preferences may freely choose a location in which to interact with other players, previous literature has shown that long-run evolutionary forces select in favor of payoff-dominant equilibria. In this paper, I extend this location choice aspect of evolutionary game theory to the case of two different payoff types of players in 2 × 2 games. I show that whether or not payoff-dominant equilibrium selection occurs depends on the precise interaction of types, especially whether they exhibit mutual strategic homophily or a mix of homophily and heterophily. The former case guarantees payoff-dominant equilibria, and the latter case may not, because coordination becomes imperfect and may settle on an inefficient strategy.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.009.abstract_zh: 在演化博弈论中，当具有相同偏好的玩家群体可以自由选择与其他玩家互动的地点时，既有文献表明，长期演化力量倾向于选择收益占优均衡。本文将演化博弈论中的这一地点选择方面扩展至2×2博弈中两类不同收益类型玩家的情形。我证明，收益占优均衡是否出现取决于类型间的精确互动，尤其是它们是否表现出相互的战略同质性，或是同质性与异质性的混合。前者保证收益占优均衡，而后者则未必，因为协调变得不完美，可能最终停留在低效策略上。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.009.title: Long-Run Efficiency with Local Interactions and Heterogeneous Types
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.009.title_zh: 局部互动与异质性类型下的长期效率

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.010.abstract: Strong Nash implementation remains a central challenge in mechanism design, with no direct analogue to Maskin (1977) seminal theorem for Nash implementation under simple and widely applicable conditions. We revisit the structure of Maskin (1979) result and show that strong Nash implementability imposes a coalitional compatibility requirement, formalized by the coalitional intersection property. We then identify the Restricted Coalitional Intersection Property (RCIP) as a weaker implication of this requirement, imposing only limited compatibility across coalitions when comparing equilibrium outcomes under different preference profiles. To guarantee RCIP, we introduce a structural condition on the environment—Agents with Separately Exclusive Alternatives (ASEA)—which ensures RCIP for coalitions separating such agents. ASEA captures situations in which a pair of agents each strictly prefers its own designated alternative to that of the other, while all remaining agents weakly prefer any socially chosen alternative to these designated alternatives. We show that, in societies with at least three agents and containing at least one such pair, every social choice correspondence that is weakly Pareto optimal and satisfies a strengthened form of Maskin monotonicity—called Y-monotonicity—is implementable in strong equilibrium. We illustrate the applicability of our results in a variety of economic environments, including several-to-one matching markets, fair allocation, efficient sharing of commonly owned technologies, and coalitional games.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.010.abstract_zh: 强纳什实施仍是机制设计中的一个核心挑战，在简单且广泛适用的条件下，尚无与Maskin（1977）关于纳什实施的奠基性定理直接对应的结果。我们重新审视了Maskin（1979）结论的结构，并表明强纳什可实施性施加了一种联盟相容性要求，该要求被形式化为联盟交集性质。随后，我们识别出受限联盟交集性质（RCIP）作为这一要求的较弱推论，它仅在不同偏好配置下比较均衡结果时，对联盟间的相容性施加有限限制。为保证RCIP成立，我们引入了一种环境结构条件——具有单独排他替代品的代理人（ASEA）——该条件确保了对分离此类代理人的联盟而言RCIP成立。ASEA刻画了这样一种情形：一对代理人各自严格偏好其指定的替代品而非对方的，而所有其余代理人弱偏好任何社会选择的替代品而非这些指定替代品。我们证明，在至少包含三个代理人且至少包含这样一对代理人的社会中，每一个弱帕累托最优且满足一种强化形式的Maskin单调性——称为Y-单调性——的社会选择对应关系都能在强均衡中实施。我们在一系列经济环境中展示了我们结果的适用性，包括多对一匹配市场、公平分配、共有技术的有效共享以及联盟博弈。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.010.title: Strong Nash Implementation and Economic Applications
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.010.title_zh: 强纳什实施及其经济应用

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.011.abstract: A principal hires an agent to learn about the cost of a project (experimentation) and then to execute it (production). The agent is privately informed about the probability that the cost is low, with the high-type agent more optimistic than the low type. Learning is modeled as a series of experiments, where the agent privately chooses his effort in each experiment. Due to the joint presence of adverse selection and moral hazard, even the low type can misrepresent his type, shirk during experimentation and earn a rent. In the optimal contract, the principal uses the length and outcome of experimentation as well as the timing of payments to induce effort and screen the agent. The principal may find it optimal to reward the low type after failure in experimentation. We provide sufficient conditions for both success and failure to be rewarded. We show that over-experimentation can be optimal as it reduces the asymmetric information after a series of failed experiments. We also consider whether it may be optimal to separate experimentation and production between two different agents. When the same agent works on both tasks, the principal can leverage the adverse selection rent to mitigate moral hazard. Therefore, integrating experimentation and production is optimal when adverse selection is severe.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.011.abstract_zh: 委托人雇佣代理人了解项目成本（实验阶段），随后执行项目（生产阶段）。代理人私下知晓成本为低值的概率，其中高类型代理人比低类型代理人更为乐观。学习过程被建模为一系列实验，代理人在每次实验中私下选择其努力程度。由于逆向选择与道德风险同时存在，即使是低类型代理人也可能虚报其类型，在实验期间偷懒并获取租金。在最优合同中，委托人利用实验的时长与结果以及支付的时间安排来激励努力并筛选代理人。委托人可能发现，在实验失败后奖励低类型代理人是最优的。我们为成功与失败均可能获得奖励提供了充分条件。我们证明，过度实验可能成为最优选择，因为它能减少一系列失败实验后的信息不对称。我们还考虑了将实验与生产分配给两个不同代理人是否可能最优。当同一代理人同时承担两项任务时，委托人可以利用逆向选择租金来缓解道德风险。因此，当逆向选择严重时，整合实验与生产是最优的。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.011.title: Rewarding success and failure: moral hazard and adverse selection in strategic experimentation
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.011.title_zh: 奖励成功与失败：战略实验中的道德风险与逆向选择

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.012.abstract: We show that greater memory overload results in a disproportionately greater underreaction to belief-challenging information compared to belief-confirming information. In an experiment, we keep constant the information subjects receive but vary the difficulty of memorizing the signals. In the treatment condition, the preceding signal disappears as the next signal appears; in the control condition, the preceding signal remains visible. Memory load is therefore greater in the treatment than in the control condition. We find that in the treatment condition, subjects underreact more to belief-challenging information than in the control condition, but updating to belief-confirming information is not significantly affected. Our results caution against information campaigns that ignore the roles of memory load and attention.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.012.abstract_zh: 我们证明，记忆负荷的增大，会导致对挑战信念的信息反应不足的程度，相较于对确认信念的信息，出现不成比例的加剧。在一项实验中，我们保持受试者接收的信息不变，但改变记忆信号的难度。在实验处理条件下，前一个信号随着下一个信号的出现而消失；在控制条件下，前一个信号保持可见。因此，处理条件下的记忆负荷高于控制条件。我们发现，在处理条件下，受试者对挑战信念的信息反应不足程度高于控制条件，但对确认信念的信息更新则未受到显著影响。我们的结果警示，忽视记忆负荷和注意力作用的信息宣传活动可能存在问题。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.012.title: Memory Overload and Asymmetric Underreaction
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.012.title_zh: 记忆过载与非对称性反应不足

10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.013.abstract: We study the problem of fairly allocating indivisible goods and chores under category constraints. There are n agents and m items, partitioned into categories with capacity limits, and an allocation is feasible if every bundle respects these limits. For two agents, Shoshan et al. (2023) gave a polynomial-time algorithm for finding a Pareto-optimal allocation satisfying EF[1,1], a relaxed form of envy-freeness. Extending this beyond two agents was open. We show that for any number n of agents and any number k of categories, there exists a Pareto-optimal allocation such that each agent can be made envy-free by reallocating at most min { k + 1 , n } ( n − 1 ) items. We also give a polynomial-time algorithm for computing such an allocation when n is a constant. Our approach uses a new application of the Knaster-Kuratowski-Mazurkiewicz (KKM) lemma on a simplex of agent weights, which may be of independent interest.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.013.abstract_zh: 我们研究在类别约束下公平分配不可分割物品与杂务的问题。设有n个代理和m个物品，这些物品被划分为具有容量限制的类别，若每个捆绑均遵守这些限制，则该分配是可行的。对于两个代理的情况，Shoshan等人（2023）提出了一种多项式时间算法，用于寻找满足EF[1,1]（一种放宽的无嫉妒形式）的帕累托最优分配。将此结果扩展到两个以上代理的问题此前尚未解决。我们证明，对于任意数量的代理n和任意数量的类别k，存在一种帕累托最优分配，使得每个代理通过重新分配至多min{k+1, n}(n−1)个物品即可实现无嫉妒状态。我们还给出了一种在n为常数时计算此类分配的多项式时间算法。我们的方法采用了Knaster-Kuratowski-Mazurkiewicz（KKM）引理在代理权重单纯形上的新应用，这可能具有独立的研究价值。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.013.title: Fair and efficient allocation of indivisible items under category constraints
10.1016/j.geb.2026.06.013.title_zh: 类别约束下不可分割物品的公平与有效分配

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.001.abstract: Large-scale infrastructure investments are often carried out in settings where their eventual usefulness or importance is difficult to predict. This paper studies optimal incentives for investment when the agent undertaking the investment has superior information on two dimensions: the cost of investment and the likelihood it is useful or beneficial to the principal. Usefulness eventually becomes public, but punishments are limited as the regulator aims at ensuring the agent earns non-negative profits in each period. We characterize the optimal incentive scheme and show it involves either: (i) investments by the agent even though he knows they are useless and rents to only cost-efficient types, or (ii) rents to all types. The possibility that rent is left to all types contrasts with the usual prediction in static (and also dynamic) mechanism design and arises even though the agent’s preferences are stable over time.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.001.abstract_zh: 大规模基础设施投资往往在其实用性或重要性难以预测的环境中进行。本文研究了当承担投资的代理人在两个维度上拥有信息优势时的最优激励问题：投资成本以及投资对委托人而言有用或有益的可能性。实用性最终会公开，但由于监管者旨在确保代理人每期获得非负利润，惩罚措施受到限制。我们刻画了最优激励方案，并表明其涉及以下两种情况之一：（i）代理人即使知道投资无用仍进行投资，且仅向成本效率高的类型支付租金；或（ii）向所有类型支付租金。向所有类型留下租金的可能性与静态（以及动态）机制设计中的通常预测形成对比，并且即使在代理人偏好随时间保持稳定的情况下也会出现。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.001.title: Regulating investments when both costs and need are private
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.001.title_zh: 当成本和需求均为私人信息时的投资监管

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.002.abstract: We develop a dynamic model of autocracy in which repression helps quell acute threats, increasing an autocrat’s survival probability or deterring challenges altogether, but at the expense of policies that reduce popular discontent and future opposition mobilization. Our main contribution is characterizing a unique stationary Markov Perfect equilibrium, which takes one of three forms: deterrence, where the autocrat is never challenged; instability, where challenges occur every period; or a deterrence/contention mixed-strategy equilibrium with periods of deterrence and periods with challenges. The mixed-strategy equilibrium arises because the opposition is easier to deter today when they expect opportunities to challenge in the future. We then examine indirect foreign interference–such as sanctions or withholding aid–aimed at protecting the opposition or promoting democratization. Even under ideal conditions, such interference cannot achieve both goals simultaneously.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.002.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个专制政权的动态模型，其中镇压有助于平息严重威胁，提高独裁者的生存概率或完全阻止挑战，但代价是采取减少民众不满和未来反对派动员的政策。我们的主要贡献在于刻画了一个独特的平稳马尔可夫完美均衡，该均衡呈现三种形式之一：威慑，即独裁者从未受到挑战；不稳定，即每个时期都发生挑战；或威慑/抗争混合策略均衡，其中存在威慑期和挑战期。混合策略均衡之所以出现，是因为当反对派预期未来有机会发起挑战时，他们今天更容易被威慑。随后，我们考察了旨在保护反对派或促进民主化的间接外国干预——如制裁或暂停援助。即使在理想条件下，此类干预也无法同时实现这两个目标。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.002.title: Repression and Autocratic Consolidation

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.003.abstract: We study the diffusion of a true and a false message (misinformation) when agents are biased and able to verify messages. As a recipient of a false message who verifies it becomes informed of the truth, a higher prevalence of misinformation can increase the prevalence of the truth. We uncover conditions such that this happens and discuss policy implications. Specifically, a planner aiming to maximize the prevalence of the truth should allow misinformation to circulate if: non-verified messages may be ignored, transmission of information is relatively low, and the planner's budget to induce verification is neither too low nor too high. Homophily increases the spread of misinformation, but also facilitates diffusion of truth, and leads to similar results on the effect of verification.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.003.abstract_zh: 我们研究了当个体存在偏见且能够验证信息时，真实信息与虚假信息（错误信息）的传播机制。当接收虚假信息的个体通过验证获知真相时，错误信息的更高流行度反而可能提升真相的普及程度。我们揭示了此类现象发生的条件，并探讨其政策启示。具体而言，若规划者旨在最大化真相普及度，则应在以下情形允许错误信息传播：未经验证的信息可能被忽略、信息传播效率相对较低、且规划者用于诱导验证的预算既不过低也不过高。同质性虽会加剧错误信息的扩散，但同时也促进真相的传播，并对验证效果产生类似影响。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.003.title: Optimal Verification of (Mis)Information in Networks
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.003.title_zh: 网络中（错误）信息的最优验证

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.004.abstract: We propose a new dominance notion in strategic games—weak* dominance—that reflects the idea of cautious* rationality, whereby a rational player believes that each opponent’s individual actions are played with positive probabilities. In this paper, we show that an action is weakly* dominated if, and only if, it is not a best response to any marginally full-support conjecture. We characterize Gul’s (1996) notion of perfect τ-rationalizability through an iterative procedure ( S ∞ W * ): removing all weakly* dominated actions in the first round, and then removing only strictly dominated actions in the subsequent rounds. Moreover, we provide epistemic foundations for the iterative procedure in a lexicographic type structure model.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.004.abstract_zh: 我们提出战略博弈中的一种新支配概念——弱*支配，它体现了谨慎*理性的思想，即理性玩家相信每个对手的个体行动以正概率被采取。本文证明，一个行动是弱*支配的，当且仅当它不是对任何边际全支持猜想的的最佳回应。我们通过迭代程序（S∞W*）刻画了Gul（1996）的完美τ-理性化概念：首轮移除所有弱*支配行动，随后各轮仅移除严格支配行动。此外，我们在词典序类型结构模型中为该迭代程序提供了认知基础。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.004.title: Weak* dominance

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.005.abstract: Information in repeated real-world interactions is rarely fixed. Instead, over time, players typically learn more about the game structure, understand more about their own payoff correspondences, and find out what others did and earned in the past. However, how this dynamic information path influences learning and which aggregate outcomes are reached as a result have not been investigated to date. To study this, we conducted a series of laboratory experimental games where we provided more information over time in different orders and along different paths. These games span two strategically distinct classes: a Cournot game with a unique symmetric Nash equilibrium, and step-level public-goods (coordination) games with multiple Nash equilibria of differing Pareto efficiency. Our evidence confirms a natural mapping from information to predominant learning rule: information about own payoffs triggers payoff-based learning, feedback concerning others’ realized payoffs triggers imitation, and structural information about the game triggers best response. In addition, when multiple learning rules are feasible, which one dominates depends on information paths. In particular, feedback about others’ actions and payoffs, especially when supplied marginally, may trigger persistent imitation that locks into Pareto-inferior Nash equilibria, even when more information later becomes available.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.005.abstract_zh: 在重复的真实世界互动中，信息很少是固定不变的。相反，随着时间的推移，参与者通常会更多地了解博弈结构，更深入地理解自身的收益对应关系，并获知他人过去的行动与所得。然而，这种动态信息路径如何影响学习过程，以及最终会达到哪些总体结果，至今尚未得到研究。为探究此问题，我们开展了一系列实验室实验博弈，在不同顺序和不同路径下随时间逐步提供更多信息。这些博弈涵盖两个策略上截然不同的类别：具有唯一对称纳什均衡的古诺博弈，以及具有多个帕累托效率不同的纳什均衡的阶梯式公共品（协调）博弈。我们的证据证实了信息与主导学习规则之间的自然对应关系：关于自身收益的信息触发基于收益的学习，关于他人已实现收益的反馈触发模仿，而关于博弈结构的信息则触发最优反应。此外，当多种学习规则均可行时，哪一种占据主导取决于信息路径。特别是，关于他人行动和收益的反馈，尤其是以边际方式提供时，可能触发持续模仿，从而锁定在帕累托较劣的纳什均衡中，即使后续有更多信息可用也是如此。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.005.title: Information Paths and Learning in Games: Experimental Evidence
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.005.title_zh: 信息路径与博弈中的学习：实验证据

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.006.title: Which Probability Measures are Strict Correlated Equilibria?
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.006.title_zh: 哪些概率测度是严格相关均衡？

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.007.abstract: We extend Kuhn's Theorem to games of the extensive form with unawareness. We prove that if a game of the extensive form with unawareness has perfect recall, then for each mixed strategy there is an equivalent behavior strategy. We show that the converse does not hold under unawareness without restricting the evolution of the player's awareness to constant awareness along paths of play. Both directions of Kuhn's Theorem for games of the extensive form with unawareness require a condition complementary to perfect recall that rules out falsely believing in some events when the player is unaware of the actual past events.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.007.abstract_zh: 我们将库恩定理扩展至具有未知性的扩展式博弈。我们证明，若具有未知性的扩展式博弈满足完美回忆条件，则每个混合策略均存在等价的行为策略。研究表明，在不限制玩家沿博弈路径的认知状态保持恒定的情况下，未知性条件下该定理的逆命题不成立。库恩定理在具有未知性的扩展式博弈中的双向成立，均需在完美回忆条件之外补充一个约束条件：当玩家对实际历史事件缺乏认知时，需排除其对某些事件的错误信念。

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.008.abstract: A sender wants to make a public announcement to three receivers but she cannot. The Byzantine agreement communication protocol (Lamport et al., 1982) prescribes that the sender instead sends the same private message to the receivers who in turn forward to each other the message they have received from the sender. Let the receivers consider the (bitwise) majority of their received messages as a pseudo public message of the sender. We show that this protocol, besides being 1-resilient, substitutes public communication in a very strong sense: every player can consistently believe (Kreps and Wilson, 1982), no matter what messages they have sent or received, that all the receivers hold the same pseudo public message which coincides with the (bitwise) majority of the messages sent by the sender. It follows that the set of sequential equilibrium outcomes of any game (with at least four players) is weakly larger with private communication than with public communication.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.008.abstract_zh: 发送方希望向三位接收者发布公开公告，但无法直接做到。拜占庭协议通信协议（Lamport等，1982）规定，发送方转而向接收者发送相同的私人消息，接收者再将从发送方收到的消息相互转发。让接收者将所收到消息的（按位）多数视为发送方的伪公开消息。我们证明，该协议不仅具有1-弹性，而且在一种很强的意义上替代了公开通信：无论每位玩家发送或接收了何种消息，每位玩家都能一致地相信（Kreps和Wilson，1982），所有接收者持有相同的伪公开消息，该消息与发送方所发送消息的（按位）多数一致。由此可知，在至少包含四位玩家的任何博弈中，私人通信下的序贯均衡结果集合弱大于公开通信下的对应集合。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.008.title: How to Replace Public Communication with Private One
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.008.title_zh: 如何用私人沟通替代公共沟通

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.009.abstract: We examine safety premiums through the lens of financial contagion in interbank networks. In our model with endogenous collateralized lending contracts, safe assets command premiums because they relax funding constraints without amplifying default propagation. Multiple equilibria characterized by distinct lending volumes and safety premiums emerge exclusively in networks containing directed cycles. The safety premium thus serves as a tractable, price-based statistic of systemic fragility. Comparative statics show that conditions weakening contagion—most notably a sufficiently high safe-to-risky-asset ratio—can eliminate equilibrium multiplicity. Pure-strategy high-lending equilibria survive only when collateral quality is sufficiently high. Network structure critically influences these dynamics: increased density introduces competing effects (amplified contagion risk versus enhanced liquidity coinsurance), with their relative dominance determined by loan sizes and collateral quality. Core-periphery networks generate higher safety premiums than complete networks, as peripheral banks respond defensively to the amplified contagion risk circulating within the core. A greater number or larger size of peripheral banks leads to a higher safety premium.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.009.abstract_zh: 我们从银行间网络中的金融传染视角考察安全溢价。在我们的内生抵押贷款合约模型中，安全资产之所以享有溢价，是因为它们在不加剧违约传播的情况下缓解了融资约束。以不同贷款规模和安全溢价为特征的多个均衡，仅在包含有向环的网络中出现。因此，安全溢价可作为衡量系统性脆弱性的一个易于处理的、基于价格的统计指标。比较静态分析表明，削弱传染的条件——尤其是足够高的安全资产与风险资产比率——能够消除均衡的多重性。纯策略高贷款均衡仅在抵押品质量足够高时才能存续。网络结构对这些动态具有关键影响：密度增加引入了竞争效应（传染风险放大与流动性共同保险增强），其相对主导地位取决于贷款规模和抵押品质量。核心-外围网络产生的安全溢价高于完全网络，因为外围银行对核心内部循环放大的传染风险采取防御性反应。外围银行数量更多或规模更大，会导致更高的安全溢价。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.009.title: Contagion-Based Safety Premium in Bank Networks
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.009.title_zh: 银行网络中的传染性安全溢价

10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.001.abstract: This paper explores which correlated equilibrium outcomes are robust to players having the option to publicly and verifiably disclose their private information before playing the game. I focus on outcomes that are disclosure-proof: those that can be induced such that no player is incentivized to disclose their signal. Since signals in this environment do not carry payoff-relevant information, disclosing only limits the ability to coordinate agents off-path. I show that an outcome is disclosure-proof if and only if it satisfies obedience and certain interim participation constraints. Each player must expect to earn more after observing any of their signals than they would in the worst correlated equilibria outcome where they play independently of the other players. For two-player games, this is equivalent to the payoff of their worst Nash outcome. When players can disclose over multiple rounds, all implementable outcomes will be disclosure-proof.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.001.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在博弈前，若玩家可选择公开且可验证地披露其私人信息，哪些相关均衡结果对此具有稳健性。我聚焦于防披露结果：即那些能被诱导实现，使得任何玩家都没有动机披露其信号的结果。由于在此环境中信号不携带与收益相关的信息，披露仅限制了在路径外协调参与者的能力。我证明，一个结果是防披露的，当且仅当它满足服从性及某些中期参与约束。每位玩家在观察到其任一信号后，必须预期获得的收益不低于他们在最差相关均衡结果中独立于其他玩家行动时的收益。对于两人博弈，这等价于他们最差纳什结果的收益。当玩家能在多轮中披露时，所有可实施的结果都将具备防披露性。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.001.title: Disclosure-Proof Correlated EquilibriaTitle

10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.002.abstract: The political economy setting of voting over general nonlinear income taxes with labor disincentives and information asymmetry in consumer/worker/voter types is considered. Agents do not communicate or coordinate with each other. The economy is the realization of a finite draw from a continuous distribution. The revenue required from a draw is determined by Pareto optimal provision of a public good for that draw. Assuming that the government must meet the revenue requirement for any possible draw, in other words the tax is robust, a majority rule equilibrium is shown to exist at the median voter’s preferred tax function out of this robust set. The key restrictions on utility are additive separability, quasi-linearity, and that utility from the public good is multiplicative in type. JEL numbers: D72, D82, H21, H41 Keywords: Voting; Income taxation; Public good; Robustness
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.002.abstract_zh: 本文考虑了在一般非线性所得税上进行投票的政治经济环境，其中包含劳动抑制因素以及消费者/工人/选民类型的信息不对称。各主体之间不进行沟通或协调。经济状态是连续分布中有限次抽取的实现结果。每次抽取所需的财政收入由该抽取下公共物品的帕累托最优供给决定。假设政府必须满足任何可能抽取下的财政收入要求，即税收具有稳健性，则证明在多数规则均衡下，存在中位选民在该稳健集合中最偏好的税收函数。对效用的关键限制包括可加可分性、拟线性，以及公共物品效用与类型呈乘性关系。JEL分类号：D72, D82, H21, H41 关键词：投票；所得税；公共物品；稳健性
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.002.title: On the Political Economy of Nonlinear Income Taxation
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.002.title_zh: 论非线性所得税的政治经济学

10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.003.abstract: We study a mechanism-design-without-money setting in which a designer is interested in selecting items with maximum total value under a budget constraint. The items, however, are controlled by strategic agents who aim to maximize the total value of their selected items. This setting arises naturally when agencies select projects for funding, retailers choose products to stock, or hospitals schedule MRI scans. A mechanism governing the selection is strategyproof if no agent can benefit by hiding items they control from the mechanism. We are interested in mechanisms that are strategyproof and α-approximate, meaning that they always achieve at least an α-fraction of the optimal value for some α ∈ [0, 1]. First, we give a deterministic mechanism that is 1/ϕ 2-approximate, where 1/ϕ 2 ≈ 0.382 is the inverse of the square of the golden ratio. For the special case where all items have unit density, we design a deterministic 1/ϕ-approximate mechanism, where 1/ϕ ≈ 0.618. This result is tight as we show that no deterministic strategyproof mechanism with a better approximation exists. We further give randomized mechanisms with approximation guarantees of 1/2 for the general case and 2/3 for the unit-density case. For both the general and the unit-density settings, no randomized mechanism that is strategyproof in expectation can achieve an approximation guarantee better than 1 / ( 5 ϕ − 7 ) ≈ 0.917 .
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.003.abstract_zh: 我们研究一种无货币的机制设计场景，其中设计者旨在预算约束下选择总价值最大的项目。然而，这些项目由策略性代理人控制，他们旨在最大化其被选中项目的总价值。这一场景自然出现在机构选择资助项目、零售商决定库存商品或医院安排MRI扫描时。管理选择的机制是策略-proof的，如果没有任何代理人能通过向机制隐藏其控制的项目而获益。我们关注的是策略-proof且α-近似的机制，即对于某个α∈[0,1]，它们总能达到最优价值的至少α比例。首先，我们给出一个确定性机制，其近似比为1/φ²，其中1/φ²≈0.382是黄金比例平方的倒数。对于所有项目具有单位密度的特殊情况，我们设计了一个确定性1/φ近似机制，其中1/φ≈0.618。这一结果是紧致的，因为我们证明了不存在具有更好近似比的确定性策略-proof机制。我们进一步给出了随机机制，对于一般情况近似保证为1/2，对于单位密度情况为2/3。对于一般和单位密度设置，没有期望策略-proof的随机机制能实现优于1/(5φ−7)≈0.917的近似保证。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.003.title: On the Strategyproof Allocation of Items Under a Budget Constraint
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.003.title_zh: 预算约束下物品的策略性配置研究

10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.004.abstract: We study a sequential screening model with discrete ex ante types and continuously distributed ex post values. The approach — solving a relaxed problem by pointwise maximization and focusing on deterministic cutoffs — relies on strong regularity conditions and can fail when they are violated. We develop an alternative method that retains local incentive constraints, allowing deterministic and stochastic mechanisms, and derive surplus-to-slack ratio tests that identify each case. We propose the weak alignment condition, a strengthening of first-order stochastic dominance that guarantees stochastic allocations respect global incentive constraints, and the strong alignment condition, under which the gap between deterministic and stochastic conditions closes. We extend the analysis to a continuum of types and solve for optimal mechanisms in the three-type case under additional shape restrictions on the surplus-to-slack ratios. Our results show that randomization can be essential and tractable in optimal dynamic mechanisms when regularity fails.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.004.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个序贯筛选模型，其中事前类型为离散分布，事后价值为连续分布。该方法——通过逐点最大化求解松弛问题并聚焦于确定性截断——依赖于强正则条件，当这些条件被违反时可能失效。我们开发了一种替代方法，保留局部激励约束，允许确定性和随机机制，并推导出盈余-松弛比检验，以识别每种情形。我们提出了弱对齐条件，这是对一阶随机占优的强化，确保随机分配尊重全局激励约束，以及强对齐条件，在该条件下，确定性与随机条件之间的差距得以闭合。我们将分析扩展到连续类型情形，并在对盈余-松弛比施加额外形状限制的情况下，求解了三类型案例中的最优机制。我们的结果表明，当正则性失效时，随机化在最优动态机制中可能是必要且可处理的。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.004.title: Stochastic Sequential Screening

10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.005.abstract: The allocation of decision rights—and the decision hierarchies it creates—shape incentives in organizations and thus individual motivation. We study whether the motivational effects of decision hierarchies go beyond pecuniary incentives and how they relate to the perceived legitimacy of the decision hierarchy. In a laboratory experiment, we exogenously manipulate the payoff structure of an organization in a way that leaves the pecuniary incentives of all involved parties unaffected but shifts subordinates’ perceived legitimacy of the decision hierarchy. Our data show that subordinates’ motivation to provide effort is causally affected by the organizational payoff structure, and significantly associated with the perceived legitimacy of the decision hierarchy.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.005.abstract_zh: 决策权的分配——以及由此产生的决策层级——塑造了组织中的激励机制，进而影响个体的动机。我们研究决策层级的激励效应是否超越金钱激励，以及这些效应如何与决策层级的感知合法性相关联。在一项实验室实验中，我们外生地操纵组织的报酬结构，使得所有相关方的金钱激励保持不变，但改变了下属对决策层级感知合法性的态度。数据显示，下属提供努力的动机受到组织报酬结构的因果影响，并与决策层级的感知合法性显著相关。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.005.title: Legitimate Decision Authority and Motivation in Organizations
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.005.title_zh: 组织中的合法决策权威与动机

10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.006.abstract: Bureaucratic voters are guided both by their preferences over public goods and by their job motivation: they bear costs from policies that downsize the government workforce. Job-motivated voters lead to (i) nonexistence of Condorcet-winning platforms in the short run, and (ii) bureaucratic persistence in the long run: equilibrium outcomes converge to alternations around at most two platforms, in which parties compete over the scale of public investment but keep the size of the bureaucracy fixed. Long-run bureaucracies are never smaller than the ideal bureaucracy of median private sector workers, and parties typically underinvest, so that public goods production is inefficient.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.006.abstract_zh: 官僚选民既受其对公共物品偏好的引导，也受其职业动机的影响：他们承担着因缩减政府工作人员规模的政策而带来的成本。具有职业动机的选民导致（i）短期内不存在孔多塞胜出平台，以及（ii）长期内官僚体制的持续性：均衡结果收敛至至多两个平台之间的交替，在此过程中，政党围绕公共投资规模展开竞争，但保持官僚机构规模不变。长期官僚机构的规模绝不会小于私营部门中位工人理想中的官僚规模，且政党通常投资不足，从而导致公共物品生产效率低下。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.006.title: Elections with Job-Motivated Bureaucrats
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.006.title_zh: 有工作动机官僚的选举

10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.007.abstract: If individuals’ prosocial motivations are complements, this creates an important lever for the provision of social capital. We develop a framework to identify motivation complementarities and apply it in the context of voluntary blood donations—a key example of a purely prosocial behavior. Using quasi-random phone calls to identify causal effects, we find that a 10 percentage point increase in the donation rate for a blood drive raises a focal donor’s turnout by about 5.6 percentage points, creating a policy multiplier of 2.3. We also rule out lower costs from joint traveling as the main driver of the motivation complementarities. Rather, they result, at least partly, from more general mechanisms, such as utility from social approval, peer pressure, or social image concerns.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.007.abstract_zh: 如果个体的亲社会动机具有互补性，这将为社会资本的供给提供一个重要的杠杆。我们构建了一个框架来识别动机互补性，并将其应用于自愿献血情境——这是纯粹亲社会行为的一个关键例子。利用准随机电话呼叫来识别因果效应，我们发现，献血活动中献血率每提高10个百分点，会使焦点捐赠者的参与率上升约5.6个百分点，从而产生2.3的政策乘数效应。我们还排除了共同出行降低成本作为动机互补性主要驱动因素的可能性。相反，这些互补性至少部分源于更普遍的机制，如社会认可带来的效用、同伴压力或社会形象关注。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.007.title: Motivation Complementarities in Prosocial Behavior: Evidence from Social Networks of Blood Donors
10.1016/j.geb.2026.08.007.title_zh: 亲社会行为中的动机互补性：来自献血者社交网络的证据

10.1016/j.geb.2026.104042.abstract: We study tournaments with managerial discretion in hiring. A manager selects a coworker from a pool of candidates and then competes against him in a Lazear–Rosen–style tournament with a prize equal to a share of total output. A profit-maximizing principal sets the prize share together with a head start (or handicap)—an advantage (or disadvantage) in the output comparison—granted to the manager. The head start affects output through three channels: (i) encouraging the manager, (ii) discouraging the new hire, and (iii) inducing the manager to hire a stronger candidate. The hiring effect dominates the discouragement effect until the strongest candidate is hired; beyond that point, any further head start discourages the new hire more than it encourages the manager. The optimal contract therefore grants a head start just large enough to induce the manager to hire the strongest candidate.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.104042.abstract_zh: 我们研究在招聘中具有管理层自由裁量权的锦标赛。管理者从候选人池中挑选一位同事，然后在一个拉齐尔-罗森式锦标赛中与之竞争，奖品为总产出的一个份额。追求利润最大化的委托人设定奖品份额，同时给予管理者一个先发优势（或劣势）——即在产出比较中的优势（或劣势）。先发优势通过三个渠道影响产出：（i）激励管理者，（ii）抑制新员工，（iii）促使管理者招聘更强的候选人。在招聘到最强候选人之前，招聘效应主导抑制效应；超过该点后，任何进一步的先发优势对新员工的抑制程度超过对管理者的激励程度。因此，最优合同给予的先发优势恰好足以促使管理者招聘最强候选人。
10.1016/j.geb.2026.104042.title: Tournaments with Managerial Discretion
10.1016/j.geb.2026.104042.title_zh: 管理层自由裁量权下的锦标赛

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103271.abstract: This study analyzes hospital competition within narrow network health insurance products. We characterize the implications of provider mergers when narrow networks are present. The existence of narrow network insurance plans can lead merger-induced price effects through competitive restraint, leading to merger effects beyond those due to direct, head-to-head competition. We empirically apply these findings to a proposed acquisition that was investigated by the Federal Trade Commission and find evidence suggesting that accounting for narrow networks generates substantially larger price effects.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103271.abstract_zh: 本研究分析窄网络医疗保险产品中的医院竞争。我们刻画了在存在窄网络时提供者合并的影响。窄网络保险计划的存在可通过竞争约束引发合并导致的价格效应，从而产生超出直接面对面竞争之外的合并效应。我们将这些发现实证应用于联邦贸易委员会调查的一起拟议收购案，并发现考虑窄网络因素会带来显著更大的价格效应。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103271.title: You’d be hard to replace: Provider competition in narrow network insurance markets
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103271.title_zh: 难以替代：窄网络保险市场中的医疗服务提供者竞争

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103272.abstract: How would legal institutions affect the rate and direction of innovation in restricted or illicit markets? This paper studies the impact of legalization on innovation in the cannabis market. We construct novel data and measures on cannabis-related innovation in clinical trials and patent applications at the state-year level. We use staggered difference-in-differences models and event studies to analyze the impacts of medical and recreational cannabis legalization (MCL and RCL, respectively) on innovation. We find no evidence that cannabis-related clinical trials respond to MCLs or RCLs. However, there is a marked increase in cannabis-related patenting ( ∼ 4.4 patents) in response to an RCL and more modest impacts from an MCL ( ∼ 1.4 patents). Notably, additional RCL-induced patents are focused primarily on downstream products and methods rather than upstream medical innovation; MCL impacts show a similar pattern. Our further analysis of patent content suggests significant growth in areas that may raise public health, safety, and misuse concerns. These results suggest that legalization increases innovation in the cannabis market, but with relatively weak gains in areas pertinent to health and safe use. We corroborate our findings with multiple new empirical methods in the literature.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103272.abstract_zh: 法律制度如何影响受限或非法市场中的创新速率与方向？本文研究了合法化对大麻市场创新的影响。我们构建了州-年层面关于大麻相关临床试验和专利申请的新颖数据与度量指标。采用交错双重差分模型和事件研究法，分析医用大麻合法化（MCL）和娱乐用大麻合法化（RCL）对创新的影响。研究发现，没有证据表明大麻相关临床试验对MCL或RCL有所响应。然而，RCL显著增加了大麻相关专利申请（约4.4项），而MCL的影响则较为温和（约1.4项）。值得注意的是，RCL额外激发的专利主要集中在下游产品和方法上，而非上游医学创新；MCL的影响也呈现类似模式。对专利内容的进一步分析表明，在可能引发公共健康、安全及滥用担忧的领域出现了显著增长。这些结果表明，合法化促进了大麻市场的创新，但在与健康和安全使用相关的领域增益相对较弱。我们通过文献中的多种新实证方法验证了上述发现。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103272.title: Legalization and innovation in the cannabis market
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103272.title_zh: 大麻市场的合法化与创新

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103281.abstract: The use of pricing algorithms raises concerns about algorithmic collusion. This paper considers a sequential pricing model where marginal cost fluctuates over time. I find that Q-learning algorithms autonomously collude even under cost uncertainty. Collusion is sustained by strategies that involve reward-punishment schemes. It suggests that cost uncertainty is not an obstacle to autonomous algorithmic collusion.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103281.abstract_zh: 定价算法的使用引发了对算法合谋的担忧。本文考虑了一个边际成本随时间波动的序贯定价模型。我发现，即使在成本不确定的情况下，Q学习算法也会自主合谋。合谋通过涉及奖励-惩罚机制的策略得以维持。这表明，成本不确定性并非自主算法合谋的障碍。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103281.title: Algorithmic collusion under sequential pricing and stochastic costs
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103281.title_zh: 序贯定价与随机成本下的算法合谋

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103282.abstract: This paper investigates the optimal information policy of an online platform (or multi-product firm) when ranking products in response to a consumer search query. The informativeness of rankings ranges from full information to full obfuscation, and consumers learn their match values with the products by engaging in costly sequential search. Invoking continuous match value distributions allows us to establish a novel result about consumer search. While consumers buy products with high match values and continue searching when they encounter low match values, they abort search without buying a product for intermediate ones. For a large class of distributions, the optimal strategy of a platform maximizing the probability of the consumer buying a product is to provide either full information or the smallest amount of information subject to the constraint that the consumer starts searching. As a result, platform and consumer welfare are either fully aligned or at odds with each other.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103282.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在线平台（或多产品企业）在回应消费者搜索查询时对产品进行排序的最优信息政策。排序的信息含量范围从完全信息到完全混淆，消费者通过进行有成本的序贯搜索来了解其与产品的匹配值。利用连续匹配值分布，我们得以建立关于消费者搜索的新颖结论。消费者在遇到高匹配值时购买产品，在遇到低匹配值时继续搜索，而在遇到中等匹配值时则中止搜索且不购买任何产品。对于一大类分布而言，平台最大化消费者购买产品概率的最优策略是提供完全信息，或在消费者开始搜索的约束下提供最少量的信息。因此，平台与消费者福利要么完全一致，要么相互对立。

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103283.abstract: This paper examines how the rapid expansion of wind and solar generation in Spain has reshaped wholesale electricity prices, ancillary service (AS) market costs, and market structure. Using an empirical strategy that exploits exogenous variation in renewable potential, we estimate how market outcomes would have differed under lower renewable capacity (and subsequently, renewable output). We find that rising wind and solar output substantially reduced wholesale prices. However, these reductions are partially offset by increases in AS market procurement and the associated operating costs driven by congestion and other operational challenges of variable generation. We show that while renewable growth reduces concentration in the wholesale market, AS markets remain highly concentrated, with limited scope for competition in key market segments. Our results highlight both the substantial net consumer benefits of renewable expansion on final prices (wholesale plus AS markets), while demonstrating the need for AS market reforms to reduce market concentration and cost-effectively manage increasing levels of renewable generation.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103283.abstract_zh: 本文考察了西班牙风电和光伏发电的快速扩张如何重塑了批发电价、辅助服务（AS）市场成本及市场结构。利用一种利用可再生能源潜力外生变化的实证策略，我们估算了在较低可再生能源容量（及随后的可再生能源产出）下市场结果将有何不同。我们发现，风电和光伏产出的增加显著降低了批发价格。然而，这些降幅部分被辅助服务市场采购及其相关运营成本的增加所抵消，这些成本源于拥堵和可变发电的其他运营挑战。我们表明，尽管可再生能源增长降低了批发市场的集中度，但辅助服务市场仍高度集中，关键市场细分领域的竞争空间有限。我们的结果凸显了可再生能源扩张对最终价格（批发加辅助服务市场）带来的显著净消费者利益，同时证明了辅助服务市场改革的必要性，以降低市场集中度并成本有效地管理日益增长的可再生能源发电水平。

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103285.abstract: This paper estimates the causal impact on vehicle prices of an automobile manufacturers’ cartel that operated in Spain from 2006 to 2013. To do so, we construct a novel dataset containing manufacturers’ recommended retail prices for Spain and several unaffected European Union countries over the period 2000–2011. Exploiting variation in the timing of cartel entry across brands, we apply a difference-in-differences approach controlling for sales volume, scrappage schemes, and fixed effects. Our estimates show that the cartel increased prices in Spain by approximately 9.3% on average during the infringement period. Robustness checks confirm the consistency of the findings: the parallel trends assumption holds, results remain stable with alternative control groups, and placebo tests yield no significant effects. These findings contribute to the limited empirical literature on causal estimation of cartel overcharges and provide policy-relevant insights on the transmission of upstream collusion to final consumer prices.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103285.abstract_zh: 本文估计了2006年至2013年间在西班牙运营的一个汽车制造商卡特尔对车辆价格的因果影响。为此，我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，包含2000年至2011年间西班牙及多个未受影响的欧盟国家的制造商建议零售价。利用各品牌加入卡特尔的时间差异，我们采用双重差分法，并控制销量、报废补贴计划及固定效应。估计结果显示，在侵权期间，该卡特尔使西班牙的汽车价格平均上涨约9.3%。稳健性检验证实了研究结果的一致性：平行趋势假设成立，使用替代对照组时结果保持稳定，安慰剂检验未产生显著效应。这些发现为关于卡特尔超额收费因果估计的有限实证文献做出了贡献，并为上游合谋向最终消费者价格传导提供了政策相关的见解。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103285.title: Causal evidence of antitrust damages in the car manufacturers’ cartel in Spain
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103285.title_zh: 西班牙汽车制造商卡特尔反垄断损害赔偿的因果证据

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103286.abstract: Considerable interest has emerged over the past decade in the relationship between macroeconomic outcomes and industry-level market power. The Special Issue on Market Power and the Economy contains seven original contributions offering theoretical and empirical perspectives on these subtle relationships. A brief introduction offers an overview and discussion of avenues for future research by industrial organization economists.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103286.abstract_zh: 过去十年间，宏观经济结果与行业层面市场力量之间的关系引起了广泛关注。《市场力量与经济》特刊收录了七篇原创研究，从理论与实证角度探讨了这些微妙关系。简短引言概述了这些研究，并讨论了产业组织经济学家未来研究的方向。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103286.title: The IJIO special issue on market power and the economy: An introduction

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103287.abstract: This paper examines the effects of ex ante market structure on spectrum auctions and their impact on mobile market outcomes. We review the relevant theory and provide a simple analytic framework suggesting that larger incumbents acquire more spectrum in auctions to disadvantage smaller competitors. Using novel data on European 4G spectrum auctions, we present suggestive evidence of this effect for low-band ( < 1GHz) auctions. Exploiting idiosyncratic differences in auction timing across countries, we show that HHIs, and potentially prices, increase following low-band auctions, particularly in markets where incumbent operators had relatively high pre-auction market shares. These changes are not accompanied by improvements in coverage or increased investment. Operator-level regressions show that these effects are driven by incumbent operator behaviour.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103287.abstract_zh: 本文考察了事前市场结构对频谱拍卖的影响及其对移动市场结果的作用。我们回顾了相关理论，并提供了一个简洁的分析框架，表明规模较大的在位运营商在拍卖中获取更多频谱，以削弱较小竞争对手的地位。利用欧洲4G频谱拍卖的新数据，我们为低频段（<1GHz）拍卖中的这一效应提供了提示性证据。利用各国拍卖时间上的特有差异，我们显示，在低频段拍卖后，赫芬达尔指数（HHIs）以及潜在的价格会上升，尤其是在拍卖前在位运营商市场份额相对较高的市场中。这些变化并未伴随覆盖范围的改善或投资的增加。运营商层面的回归分析表明，这些效应主要由在位运营商的行为驱动。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103287.title: Interaction of spectrum auctions and mobile market competition: Review of theory and evidence from European 4G auctions
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103287.title_zh: 频谱拍卖与移动市场竞争的互动：理论与欧洲4G拍卖证据的综述

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103288.abstract: Pass-through rates are relevant in a variety of contexts, such as estimating antitrust damages. It is often asserted that focal pricing, the practice of charging only special prices, e.g. ending in 9s, reduces the degree of pass-through in an industry. This claim has had serious consequences; for example, it has contributed to the dismissal of high-profile antitrust cases. However, it is not grounded in economic theory or evidence. I prove that, in a simple but general framework, expected pass-through is unchanged by the presence of focal pricing constraints. Therefore, the fact that an industry is characterised by focal pricing constraints does not entail that it will also be characterised by a low pass-through rate.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103288.abstract_zh: 通过率在多种情境下具有重要意义，例如在估算反垄断损害赔偿时。常有观点认为，焦点定价——即仅收取特定价格（如以9结尾的价格）的做法——会降低行业内的通过率。这一论断已产生严重后果；例如，它曾导致备受瞩目的反垄断案件被驳回。然而，这一说法并无经济学理论或实证依据。我证明，在一个简单但普遍的框架下，焦点定价约束的存在并不会改变预期的通过率。因此，一个行业存在焦点定价约束，并不意味着该行业也会表现出较低的通过率。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103288.title: Focal pricing constraints and pass-through of input cost changes
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103288.title_zh: 焦点定价约束与投入成本变化的传导

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103289.abstract: The right to data portability allows consumers to obtain and reuse their personal data across service providers. However, its effect on market competition is not clear-cut, as it impacts the firms’ incentives to collect data. Employing a two-period game-theoretic model in which consumer data collected by one firm in the first period can be transferred to the other firm in the second period, this paper analyzes the implications of data portability on competition and welfare. We find that by eliminating the data “lock-in” effect, data portability mitigates competition during data collection, although intensifying it afterward. Perhaps counterintuitively, the firms collect more data when data is portable. Moreover, they earn higher profits, whereas consumers may well be worse off. We identify the degree of market competition as a critical determinant of the welfare implications of data portability. Specifically, low (high) levels of competition are associated with improved (worsened) overall social welfare.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103289.abstract_zh: 数据可携权允许消费者在不同服务提供商之间获取并重复使用其个人数据。然而，其对市场竞争的影响并非一目了然，因为它会影响企业收集数据的激励。通过构建一个两期博弈论模型，其中一家企业在第一期收集的消费者数据可在第二期转移给另一家企业，本文分析了数据可携权对竞争和福利的影响。我们发现，通过消除数据“锁定”效应，数据可携权缓解了数据收集阶段的竞争，尽管在后续阶段加剧了竞争。或许与直觉相悖的是，当数据可携时，企业会收集更多数据。此外，企业获得更高利润，而消费者可能反而受损。我们识别出市场竞争程度是决定数据可携权福利影响的关键因素。具体而言，低（高）竞争水平与整体社会福利的改善（恶化）相关联。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103289.title: Data portability and the collection of personal data
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103289.title_zh: 数据可携性与个人数据收集

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103290.abstract: I revisit the issue of optimal regulation of credit card interchange fees by considering the incentives arising in the credit market. I model credit cards as offering a base payment instrument and an add-on credit product. By connecting the interchange fee and add-on pricing literature, I show that issuers’ per-transaction fees are lower than when no credit is offered, as issuers aim to induce more demand for the credit feature of the cards. Moreover, total welfare now considers the social costs and benefits of different forms of credit. I discuss how these effects influence optimal interchange fee regulation and examine spillovers between credit market regulations and welfare-maximizing interchange fees.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103290.abstract_zh: 我重新审视信用卡交换费的最优监管问题，通过考虑信贷市场中产生的激励因素。我将信用卡建模为提供基础支付工具和附加信贷产品。通过将交换费与附加定价文献相结合，我证明发卡机构的每笔交易费用低于不提供信贷时的水平，因为发卡机构旨在诱导对信用卡信贷功能的更多需求。此外，总福利现在考虑了不同形式信贷的社会成本与收益。我讨论了这些效应如何影响最优交换费监管，并考察了信贷市场监管与福利最大化交换费之间的溢出效应。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103290.title: Credit card interchange fees revisited: The role of credit and consumer behavior
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103290.title_zh: 信用卡交换费再审视：信贷与消费者行为的作用

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103291.abstract: This paper examines how horizontal mergers affect firms’ incentives to invest in R&D leading to the development of new products. We characterize the impact of a merger to monopoly and a 3-to-2 merger on equilibrium innovation efforts and consumer surplus, absent efficiency gains and spillovers. We show that a 3-to-2 merger directly alters the outsider’s innovation incentives by shifting its best-response function upward, and we analyze how this mechanism affects merger outcomes for innovation and consumer surplus. Finally, we examine how efficiency gains and remedies modify post-merger innovation efforts.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103291.abstract_zh: 本文考察了横向并购如何影响企业投资于研发以开发新产品的激励。我们刻画了并购至垄断及3对2并购对均衡创新努力和消费者剩余的影响，且不考虑效率增益和溢出效应。我们证明，3对2并购通过将外部企业的反应函数上移，直接改变了其创新激励，并分析了这一机制如何影响并购在创新和消费者剩余方面的结果。最后，我们探讨了效率增益和补救措施如何调整并购后的创新努力。

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103292.abstract: A minimum advertised price (MAP) policy is a popular vertical restraint. We study retail pricing under MAP using price data of Seagate hard disk drives on US online retailers. The data suggest that MAP is not a form of minimum resale price maintenance (RPM). First, we find that retail prices are often lower than MAP. Second, retail prices of products subject to MAP have greater dispersions between retailers. Lastly, some retail prices can increase after a MAP decrease. These observations are consistent with the predictions of a search model that interprets MAP as a form of information restraint.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103292.abstract_zh: 最低广告价格（MAP）政策是一种常见的纵向约束。我们利用美国在线零售商希捷硬盘驱动器的价格数据，研究MAP下的零售定价。数据显示，MAP并非最低转售价格维持（RPM）的一种形式。首先，我们发现零售价格往往低于MAP。其次，受MAP约束的产品在零售商之间的零售价格差异更大。最后，某些零售价格可能在MAP下调后上升。这些观察结果与将MAP视为一种信息约束的搜索模型的预测相符。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103292.title: Price discrimination under minimum advertised price restriction
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103292.title_zh: 最低广告价格限制下的价格歧视

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103301.abstract: This paper proposes a framework for designing an emissions trading system (ETS) for the highly concentrated and regulated Chinese electricity forward markets. We present an economic model where a few generation firms maximize profits by choosing output levels under a price set below equilibrium and engage in trading carbon permits under either tradable performance standards (TPS) or cap-and-trade (C&T) systems. The regulated price causes underproduction across all firms. Compared to a scenario with no ETS, both ETS depress permit buyers’ production, and C&T typically decreases sellers’ production unless initial allocations are excessively high. However, TPS encourages permit sellers’ production if a seller cannot drastically shift the permit market equilibrium. From a Guangdong dataset, we uncover model parameters, such as firm-specific cost functions, and use them to evaluate policy scenarios. We find TPS achieves higher welfare with lower emissions than C&T under the regulated price. If the price is jointly selected with the ETS to maximize welfare, both achieve almost identical welfare and emission levels, but TPS has more consumer surplus than C&T. Moreover, TPS under the regulated price approximates this maximized welfare, counteracting the underproduction by reallocating generation to low-emission-intensity firms, whereas C&T requires substantially higher power and permit prices.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103301.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个框架，旨在为高度集中且受监管的中国电力远期市场设计排放交易体系（ETS）。我们构建了一个经济模型，其中少数发电企业在低于均衡水平的价格设定下，通过选择产出水平来实现利润最大化，并在可交易绩效标准（TPS）或总量控制与交易（C&T）体系下进行碳配额交易。受监管的价格导致所有企业生产不足。与无ETS情景相比，两种ETS均抑制了配额买方的生产，而C&T通常减少卖方的生产，除非初始分配过高。然而，若卖方无法大幅改变配额市场均衡，TPS则鼓励配额卖方的生产。基于广东数据集，我们揭示了模型参数，如企业特定成本函数，并利用这些参数评估政策情景。我们发现，在受监管价格下，TPS相比C&T能实现更高福利和更低排放。若价格与ETS共同选择以最大化福利，两者在福利和排放水平上几乎相同，但TPS比C&T带来更多消费者剩余。此外，受监管价格下的TPS接近这种最大化福利，通过将发电重新分配给低排放强度企业来抵消生产不足，而C&T则需要显著更高的电力和配额价格。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103301.title: Designing emissions trading schemes for a price-regulated and concentrated industry: Insights from China’s power sector
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103301.title_zh: 面向价格管制与集中型行业的碳排放交易机制设计：来自中国电力部门的启示

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103302.abstract: We study how corporate debt influences the competitive outcomes of horizontal and conglomerate mergers. In contrast to standard models where debt does not affect pricing, our framework shows that mergers can spread fixed debt obligations across a broader product portfolio, creating an “insurance effect” against adverse demand shocks. This effect interacts with the traditional recapture effect from reduced competition. Using numerical simulations and a case study of a major casino merger, we find that debt can either dampen or amplify post-merger price increases, depending on the merger’s structure and the market environment.
