10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103302.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了企业债务如何影响横向并购与混合并购的竞争结果。与债务不影响定价的标准模型不同，我们的框架表明，并购能将固定债务负担分散至更广泛的产品组合中，从而产生一种针对不利需求冲击的“保险效应”。这一效应与竞争减弱带来的传统“回收效应”相互作用。通过数值模拟及对一家大型赌场并购案例的研究，我们发现，债务可能抑制或放大并购后的价格上涨，具体取决于并购的结构及市场环境。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103302.title: Financial structure and mergers

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103303.abstract: I study the cost pass-through on retail prices in two oligopolistic retail markets defined by specific physical boundaries. Using this setup, I find significant evidence that markets ultimately operate as a single one regarding their level of long-run pass-through and speed of price adjustment, possibly indicating substitution effects. Moreover, pass-through in both markets is not a function of the number of market players, which is in contrast with previous theoretical and empirical studies. Finally, I show that although vertical integration has a positive relationship with the speed of price adjustment, it does not affect long-run pass-through.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103303.abstract_zh: 我研究了两个由特定物理边界界定的寡头零售市场中零售价格的成本传导。利用这一设定，我发现显著证据表明，就长期传导水平和价格调整速度而言，这些市场最终表现为单一市场运作，这可能暗示着替代效应的存在。此外，两个市场的传导并非取决于市场参与者数量，这与先前的理论和实证研究相悖。最后，我表明，尽管纵向一体化与价格调整速度呈正相关，但它并不影响长期传导。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103303.title: Using Pass-Through as an Economic Tool: On Geographical Market Definition, Competition and Number of Market Players, and Vertical Relations
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103303.title_zh: 利用传导效应作为经济工具：论地理市场界定、竞争与市场参与者数量及纵向关系

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103304.abstract: Personalized recommendation systems shape much of user choice online, yet their targeted nature makes separating out the value of recommendation and the underlying goods challenging. We build a discrete-choice model that embeds recommendation-induced utility, low-rank heterogeneity, and flexible state dependence and apply the model to viewership data at Netflix. We identify recommendation-induced engagement from observational variation in algorithmic exposure, treating exposure as conditionally exogenous given observed user, good, and state characteristics. Separately, we estimate model-free diversion ratios from a randomized experiment that perturbs recommendations and use these to assess the validity of the structural model. We use the model to evaluate counterfactuals that quantify the incremental engagement generated by personalized recommendations. First, we show that replacing the current recommender system with a matrix factorization or popularity-based algorithm would lead to a 4% and 12% reduction in engagement, respectively, and decreased consumption diversity. Second, most of the consumption increase from recommendations comes from effective targeting, not mechanical exposure, with the largest gains for mid-popularity goods (as opposed to broadly appealing or very niche goods).
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103304.abstract_zh: 个性化推荐系统在很大程度上塑造了用户的在线选择，但其针对性特征使得分离推荐本身的价值与所推荐商品的价值颇具挑战。我们构建了一个离散选择模型，该模型融合了推荐引致的效用、低秩异质性以及灵活的状态依赖性，并将此模型应用于Netflix的观看数据。我们通过算法曝光中的观测变异来识别推荐引致的参与度，将曝光视为在给定观测到的用户、商品及状态特征条件下的条件外生变量。此外，我们利用一项随机实验来估计无模型依赖的转移比率，该实验对推荐进行扰动，并以此评估结构模型的有效性。我们运用该模型评估反事实情境，量化个性化推荐所产生的增量参与度。首先，我们表明，若将当前推荐系统替换为矩阵分解或基于流行度的算法，参与度将分别下降4%和12%，且消费多样性也会降低。其次，推荐带来的消费增长大部分源于有效的目标定位，而非机械性曝光，其中中等流行度商品（相对于广泛吸引力或极为小众的商品）获益最大。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103304.title: The value of personalized recommendations: Evidence from Netflix
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103304.title_zh: 个性化推荐的价值：来自Netflix的证据

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103305.abstract: Pollution prevention is the EPA’s highest-priority approach to managing toxic chemicals, yet its effects on firm efficiency remain largely unexplored. We address this using a by-production stochastic frontier framework that models desirable output and emissions as linked but distinct production processes, allowing us to separately identify technical and environmental efficiency. The model is estimated across three broad U.S. manufacturing industries (NAICS 31, 32, and 33), using a panel of Compustat, TRI, and EPA P2 data over 1991–2016. Under maintained timing assumptions, we find that a 10% increase in cumulative source reduction improves technical efficiency by 0.09%–0.17% across industries, corresponding to $5.5–$11.2 million in additional real sales at the respective industry means. Source reduction also reduces environmental inefficiency in NAICS 32 and NAICS 33, implying reductions of 4,435–5,802 pounds of toxic releases at the industry means; the effect is not significant in NAICS 31. A disaggregated analysis reveals that different source-reduction activities operate through distinct channels, with material substitution as the most consistent driver of gains in both technical and environmental efficiency.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103305.abstract_zh: 污染防治是美国环保署管理有毒化学品的最优先方法，然而其对厂商效率的影响在很大程度上仍未得到探索。我们通过一个副产品生产随机前沿框架来解决这一问题，该框架将期望产出与排放建模为相互关联但不同的生产过程，从而能够分别识别技术效率和环境效率。该模型基于1991年至2016年间Compustat、TRI和EPA P2数据的面板数据，在美国三大制造业（NAICS 31、32和33）中进行估计。在保持时间假设的前提下，我们发现累计源头削减增加10%可使各行业的技术效率提高0.09%至0.17%，对应各行业均值下额外实际销售额为550万至1120万美元。源头削减还降低了NAICS 32和NAICS 33中的环境无效率，意味着行业均值下有毒排放减少4，435至5，802磅；而在NAICS 31中该效应不显著。一项分解分析显示，不同的源头削减活动通过不同渠道发挥作用，其中材料替代是技术效率和环境效率提升最一致的驱动因素。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103305.title: Does Pollution Prevention Enhance Firm Efficiency? Insights from U.S. Manufacturing Firms
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103305.title_zh: 污染预防能否提升企业效率？来自美国制造业企业的证据

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103306.abstract: Unconditional full-refund policies are widely perceived as consumer-friendly. This paper shows that they can reduce consumer surplus compared to stricter return policies. We develop a model in which a monopolist sells products of uncertain reliability and chooses both the refund amount and the length of the return period. Consumers learn about product reliability during use, and the seller can salvage value from returned defective items. Under an unconditional full-refund policy, the seller can strategically shorten the return period to deter consumers from exploiting the generous return window (i.e., wardrobing). This effect is especially pronounced when consumers derive high utility from the product, as a longer free trial is too costly for the seller to offer. The shorter return period limits the seller’s ability to recover value from genuinely defective products, raising the seller’s effective production cost, which is ultimately transferred to consumers.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103306.abstract_zh: 无条件全额退款政策被广泛视为对消费者友好。本文表明，与更严格的退货政策相比，此类政策可能减少消费者剩余。我们构建了一个模型，其中垄断者销售可靠性不确定的产品，并同时选择退款金额和退货期限的长度。消费者在使用过程中了解产品可靠性，而卖方可以从退回的缺陷产品中回收残值。在无条件全额退款政策下，卖方可以策略性地缩短退货期限，以阻止消费者利用慷慨的退货窗口（即“衣橱购物”行为）。当消费者从产品中获得高效用时，这一效应尤为显著，因为提供更长的免费试用期对卖方而言成本过高。较短的退货期限限制了卖方从真正有缺陷的产品中回收价值的能力，从而提高了卖方的有效生产成本，这一成本最终转嫁给消费者。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103306.title: Do Unconditional Full Refunds Benefit Consumers?
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103306.title_zh: 无条件全额退款对消费者有利吗？

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103307.abstract: In this paper, we consider two platforms that compete for the development of a new product to integrate into their ecosystems. The new product can be developed either in-house by the platforms or by an independent startup active only in the technology market. The technology of the startup can be transferred to the platforms either exclusively (startup acquisition) or non-exclusively (licensing). A platform acquires the startup’s technology either because it failed to develop the technology itself or to prevent a rival from acquiring it (a killer acquisition). The presence of the startup affects the platforms’ R&D efforts through an insurance effect, which reduces the cost of failed innovation, and a competition effect, which diminishes the returns to innovation. The magnitude of these effects depends on the merger policy decided by the competition authorities. We show that allowing acquisitions stimulates platform innovation, but at the cost of a more concentrated market structure.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103307.abstract_zh: 本文考察了两个平台为将新产品整合进其生态系统而展开的竞争。新产品既可由平台内部开发，也可由一家仅在技术市场活跃的独立初创企业开发。初创企业的技术可以排他性（即初创企业被收购）或非排他性（即许可）方式转让给平台。平台收购初创企业技术的原因，要么是自身开发失败，要么是为了阻止竞争对手获得该技术（即“杀手级收购”）。初创企业的存在通过保险效应（降低创新失败的成本）和竞争效应（减少创新的回报）影响平台的研发投入。这些效应的强弱取决于竞争当局制定的并购政策。我们表明，允许收购会刺激平台创新，但代价是市场结构更加集中。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103307.title: Innovation and Startup Acquisition

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103308.abstract: Online auctions have declined in popularity, often due to their high transaction costs. This paper focuses on one such cost: the hassle cost of bidding in often prolonged online auctions. We develop a structural model of ascending auctions with costly bidding that resembles a war of attrition. We show that even in private value settings, bidders strategically lower their bids to avoid hassle. Using data from a large online auto auction platform, we estimate that the average winner incurs hassle costs equivalent to 1.7% of the vehicle’s sale price, while sellers lose 5.0% in revenue due to bid-shading. Counterfactual simulations suggest that higher reserve prices can limit unproductive bidding and partially offset the loss.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103308.abstract_zh: 在线拍卖的受欢迎程度有所下降，这往往归因于其高昂的交易成本。本文聚焦于其中一种成本：在通常漫长的在线拍卖中出价所带来的麻烦成本。我们构建了一个带有昂贵出价的结构性升价拍卖模型，该模型类似于消耗战。我们证明，即使在私有价值情境下，竞标者也会策略性地降低出价以避免麻烦。利用一个大型在线汽车拍卖平台的数据，我们估计平均获胜者承担的麻烦成本相当于车辆售价的1.7%，而卖家因出价缩减损失了5.0%的收入。反事实模拟表明，更高的保留价可以限制非生产性出价，并部分抵消这一损失。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103308.title: Hassle Costs in Online Auctions
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103308.title_zh: 在线拍卖中的麻烦成本

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103309.abstract: In the aftermath of the Russian invasion in Ukraine and rising gas prices, the ’gas price brake’, a subsidy scheme for retail consumers and firms, was implemented in Germany. We employ a difference-in-differences approach and analyze data on offered gas contracts from two countries with comparable gas markets, where one country (Germany) has implemented the gas price brake and the other (Austria) has not. We find that the gas price brake led to an increase in total annual gas costs in Germany. This increase is entirely attributable to incumbents increasing counterfactual gas prices by up to 90%. Non-incumbents do not ’milk‘ the brake.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103309.abstract_zh: 在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰及天然气价格飙升的背景下，德国实施了针对零售消费者和企业的“天然气价格刹车”补贴计划。我们采用双重差分法，分析了来自两个天然气市场可比国家的天然气合同报价数据，其中一国（德国）实施了天然气价格刹车，而另一国（奥地利）未实施。研究发现，天然气价格刹车导致德国年度天然气总成本上升。这一上升完全归因于现有供应商将反事实天然气价格提高了高达90%。非现有供应商并未“利用”该刹车机制。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103309.title: The Gas Price Brake Increases Gas Prices: Empirical Evidence
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103309.title_zh: 气价刹车推高气价：实证证据

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103310.abstract: A firm may decide to make total-surplus-reducing purchase recommendations in response to consumer heterogeneity in an experience good setting with endogenous prices. First, we show under which conditions the firm chooses to make such biased recommendations in a monopoly setting. Second, we propose a duopoly model with differentiated products in which single-product firms compete in uniform prices and recommendation policies. We establish when and why both firms bias their recommendations. This bias can disappear when the market becomes less competitive, one firm exits, or both firms merge.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103310.abstract_zh: 在体验品市场中，面对内生价格与消费者异质性，企业可能选择做出降低总剩余的购买推荐。首先，我们展示了在垄断情境下，企业选择做出此类有偏推荐的条件。其次，我们提出一个差异化产品的双寡头模型，其中单一产品企业在统一定价和推荐策略下竞争。我们确定了双方企业何时以及为何会偏向其推荐。当市场竞争减弱、一家企业退出或两家企业合并时，这种偏差可能消失。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103310.title: Recommendation power and competition

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103311.abstract: In this paper, we summarise the economic literature on the effects of mergers and acquisitions (M&As) on innovation. We primarily focus on empirical studies, but also discuss mechanisms predicted by the theoretical literature. Although the effects of mergers on innovation can be theoretically ambiguous, the vast majority of ex-post evaluations of horizontal M&As find large negative effects on innovation inputs and outputs. In contrast, vertical and other non-horizonal mergers are less likely to generate detrimental effects. We discuss a number of selected merger cases in which the European Commission raised concerns about innovation and derive some ideas and options for merger policy.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103311.abstract_zh: 本文总结了关于并购（M&As）对创新影响的经济学文献。我们主要关注实证研究，同时也探讨了理论文献所预测的机制。尽管并购对创新的影响在理论上可能具有不确定性，但绝大多数对横向并购的事后评估发现，其对创新投入和产出存在显著的负面影响。相比之下，纵向并购及其他非横向并购产生不利影响的可能性较小。我们讨论了欧盟委员会对创新表示担忧的若干精选并购案例，并从中提炼出一些关于并购政策的思路和选项。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103311.title: Mergers, Innovation, and Merger Policy

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103320.abstract: We develop a Hotelling duopoly model of competition on a gatekeeper platform in which firms choose between uniform pricing and personalized pricing. Implementing personalized pricing requires access to a platform-provided pricing technology and entails a per-transaction fee set by the platform. The platform also designs rankings and recommendations that affect the distribution of consumers between loyal and marginal types. We show that the platform may strategically reshape the demand environment to make personalized pricing more attractive to firms and thereby raise the fee it can charge. By reallocating mass from loyal to marginal and more disloyal consumers, the platform intensifies competition under uniform pricing and relaxes firms’ adoption constraint. Excessive centralization, however, erodes the rents that sustain fee extraction, so the platform chooses an interior degree of demand centralization. Relative to a no-manipulation benchmark, this reallocates surplus toward the gatekeeper and away from firms and consumers. When the platform also appropriates a share of seller profits, its incentives may reverse: it may favor loyalty-enhancing designs that soften downstream competition. The analysis highlights how platform monetization and recommendation design jointly determine downstream competition and its welfare consequences.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103320.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个霍特林双寡头竞争模型，研究企业在守门人平台上选择统一定价与个性化定价的竞争行为。实施个性化定价需要获取平台提供的定价技术，并支付平台设定的每笔交易费用。平台还设计排名和推荐机制，影响消费者在忠诚型与边缘型之间的分布。研究表明，平台可能策略性地重塑需求环境，使个性化定价对企业更具吸引力，从而提高其可收取的费用。通过将消费者从忠诚型重新分配至边缘型及更不忠诚的群体，平台加剧了统一定价下的竞争，并放宽了企业的采纳约束。然而，过度集中化会侵蚀支撑费用提取的租金，因此平台会选择适度的需求集中程度。与无操纵基准相比，这种重新分配将剩余向守门人转移，而减少企业和消费者的剩余。当平台同时抽取卖方利润的一部分时，其激励可能发生逆转：平台可能倾向于增强忠诚度的设计，以缓和下游竞争。分析揭示了平台货币化与推荐设计如何共同决定下游竞争及其福利后果。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103320.title: Gatekeepers and the Endogenous Design of Consumer Preferences under Personalized Pricing
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103320.title_zh: 个性化定价下守门人与消费者偏好的内生设计

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103321.abstract: This study examines the relationship between mergers and firm-level financial measures using a sample of 4,482 acquisition targets in the European Union from 2007 to 2021. Findings suggest that horizontal mergers lack statistically significant results, whereas vertical mergers entail changes in markups (-0.7%), market share (+2.5%), Return on Fixed Assets (ROFA) (+2.3%), and capital intensity (-7.2%). The result for vertical mergers increases over time, and is larger when the number of pre-existing subsidiaries is greater. Our results suggest the elimination of double profit margins as a potential explanation.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103321.abstract_zh: 本研究利用2007年至2021年间欧盟4,482个收购目标样本，探讨了并购与企业层面财务指标之间的关系。研究发现，横向并购在统计上不显著，而纵向并购则涉及加成率（-0.7%）、市场份额（+2.5%）、固定资产回报率（ROFA）（+2.3%）和资本密集度（-7.2%）的变化。纵向并购的效果随时间增强，且在既有子公司数量较多时更为显著。我们的结果提示，消除双重利润边际可能是一个潜在的解释机制。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103321.title: Procompetitive effects of vertical mergers? Evidence from the European Union
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103321.title_zh: 纵向合并的促进竞争效应？来自欧盟的证据

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103322.abstract: Advances in artificial intelligence and data analytics have notably expanded employers’ monitoring and surveillance capabilities. While new digital monitoring (DM) technologies facilitate the accurate observability of work effort, their productivity and broader welfare implications remain subject to debate. In this context, many countries confer information, consultation and co-determination rights to employee representation (ER) bodies on matters related to workplace organization and the introduction of new technologies, which could potentially discourage employers from making DM investments. Using a cross-sectional sample of more than 21,000 European establishments, we find instead that establishments with ER are more likely to utilize DM technologies than establishments without ER. We also document a positive effect of ER on DM utilization in the context of a local-randomization regression discontinuity analysis that exploits size-contingent policy rules governing the operation of ER bodies in Europe. We rationalize this unexpected finding through the lens of a theoretical model in which shared governance via ER creates organizational safeguards that mitigate workers’ control-averse responses to monitoring.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103322.abstract_zh: 人工智能与数据分析技术的进步显著扩展了雇主的监控与监督能力。尽管新型数字监控（DM）技术有助于精确观测工作投入，但其生产率及更广泛的福利影响仍存争议。在此背景下，许多国家赋予员工代表（ER）机构在工作场所组织及新技术引入相关事务上的知情权、协商权与共同决策权，这可能抑制雇主进行DM投资。基于对超过21,000家欧洲企业的横截面样本，我们发现，与无ER机构的企业相比，设有ER机构的企业更倾向于采用DM技术。我们还利用欧洲ER机构运作中基于规模的政策规则，通过局部随机化回归断点分析，记录了ER对DM利用的积极影响。我们通过一个理论模型来解释这一意外发现，该模型认为，经由ER实现的共同治理创造了组织保障机制，从而缓解了员工对监控的抵触反应。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103322.title: Contested Transparency: Digital Monitoring Technologies and Worker Voice
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103322.title_zh: 争议中的透明度：数字监控技术与工人话语权

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103323.abstract: We estimate the effects of privatization on zombie versus healthy state-owned enterprises (SOEs) in China, extending our analysis beyond TFP to a broad array of financial and economic indicators. Privatizing zombie SOEs generates persistent favorable effects: it enhances labor productivity and TFP, reduces bank subsidies, lowers leverage and administrative expenses, improves liquidity, boosts profits, and accelerates sales growth, thereby increasing their probability of recovery. Privatization’s effect on reducing government subsidies, however, is generally weaker and appears to be transient. These benefits are more pronounced than for healthy SOEs and display some heterogeneity across regions and industries. Our findings offer policy implications for emerging markets, suggesting that prioritizing the privatization of underperforming, zombie-like entities can be associated with substantial economic gains and efficiency improvements.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103323.abstract_zh: 我们评估了私有化对中国僵尸与健康国有企业（SOEs）的影响，并将分析范围从全要素生产率（TFP）扩展至一系列广泛的金融与经济指标。私有化僵尸国有企业产生了持续积极的效果：它提升了劳动生产率与全要素生产率，减少了银行补贴，降低了杠杆率与行政开支，改善了流动性，增加了利润，并加速了销售增长，从而提高了其复苏的可能性。然而，私有化对减少政府补贴的影响普遍较弱，且似乎具有暂时性。这些益处相较于健康国有企业更为显著，并在不同地区和行业间展现出一定的异质性。我们的研究结果为新兴市场提供了政策启示，表明优先对表现不佳、类似僵尸的实体进行私有化，可带来显著的经济收益与效率提升。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103323.title: Impacts of Privatization on State-Owned Enterprises: A Tale of Zombie versus Healthy Firms
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103323.title_zh: 私有化对国有企业的影响：僵尸企业与健康企业之比较

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103324.abstract: Digital distribution has expanded monetization opportunities for media firms, but it also introduces complex tradeoffs across channels. A central challenge for studios and networks is negotiating fixed-fee licensing deals with bundled subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) platforms like Netflix, whose flat-rate access model may cannibalize à la carte sales on transactional platforms such as iTunes. We exploit the natural experiment of Netflix’s launch in Australia to estimate the causal effect of licensing a film to the service on its digital sales. On average, licensing reduces à la carte downloads by 52.5%, with effects that persist even after titles are removed from Netflix – evidence that temporary bundling can have durable effects on competing transactional channels. Crucially, we show that this treatment effect is heterogeneous: the direction and magnitude of the effect vary systematically with a film’s à la carte price and its latent demand. Lower-priced titles exhibit positive treatment effects following Netflix inclusion while higher-priced titles experience substantial declines, consistent with a framework in which subscriber substitution and cross-segment exposure operate in opposite directions and are differently moderated by the à la carte price. Our findings offer rare revealed-preference evidence on how SVOD bundling interacts with underlying demand, addressing classic questions in industrial organization around bundling and channel conflict.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103324.abstract_zh: 数字发行扩大了媒体公司的变现机会，但也带来了跨渠道的复杂权衡。制片厂和电视网络面临的一个核心挑战是如何与Netflix等捆绑式订阅视频点播（SVOD）平台谈判固定费用许可协议，因为这类平台的包月访问模式可能会蚕食iTunes等交易型平台上的单点销售。我们利用Netflix在澳大利亚上线的自然实验，估计将电影授权给该服务对其数字销售的因果效应。平均而言，授权使单点下载量减少52.5%，且这一效应在影片从Netflix下架后依然持续——这表明临时捆绑可能对竞争性交易渠道产生持久影响。关键在于，我们证明这一处理效应具有异质性：效应的方向和大小随影片的单点价格及其潜在需求系统性变化。价格较低的影片在纳入Netflix后呈现正向处理效应，而价格较高的影片则出现显著下滑，这与一个框架相一致，即订阅者替代和跨细分市场曝光以相反方向发挥作用，并受到单点价格的不同调节。我们的发现提供了罕见的显示性偏好证据，说明SVOD捆绑如何与潜在需求相互作用，回应了产业组织领域关于捆绑和渠道冲突的经典问题。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103324.title: Netflix and Chilling Effect? The Impact of Streaming Video Licenses on Paid Digital Downloads
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103324.title_zh: 奈飞与寒蝉效应？流媒体视频许可对付费数字下载的影响

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103334.abstract: In a platform market where user participation is endogenous and shaped by direct network effects, we compare the competitive and welfare effects of two alternative business models: pure intermediation and ‘encroachment’ — a hybrid model where the platform competes with third-party sellers by selling its own private-label products. There are two groups of sellers: entrants, who must pay a specialization cost to access the marketplace, and incumbents, who have already paid it. With encroachment, the platform has no incentive to entirely foreclose their downstream rivals if there are positive network effects. Surprisingly, although encroachment restricts entry, it increases consumer surplus, total welfare, and the incumbents’ profit when there is a sufficiently large number of incumbents in the marketplace.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103334.abstract_zh: 在用户参与内生且受直接网络效应影响的平台市场中，我们比较了两种替代商业模式——纯中介与“入侵”（一种平台通过销售自有品牌产品与第三方卖家竞争的混合模式）——的竞争与福利效应。市场中有两组卖家：进入者，需支付专业化成本才能进入市场；以及在位者，已支付该成本。在入侵模式下，若存在正网络效应，平台没有动机完全排挤其下游竞争对手。令人意外的是，尽管入侵限制了进入，但当市场中在位者数量足够多时，它反而提高了消费者剩余、总福利以及在位者的利润。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103334.title: The Strategic Value of Platform Encroachment: Seller Entry and Network Effects
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103334.title_zh: 平台入侵的战略价值：卖家进入与网络效应

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103335.abstract: Are state-imposed behavioral remedies effective substitutes for federal antitrust enforcement? We evaluate state regulation of hospital mergers under Certificates of Public Advantage (COPAs). Using hospital data from 1996–2022, we estimate the treatment effect of mergers for both COPA-regulated events and unregulated but similar anticompetitive events, each relative to non-merging controls. The difference between the two treatment effects isolates the impact of state-imposed behavioral remedies: in highly concentrated markets, COPA mergers result in an 11.1 p.p. lower price effect but a 0.5 p.p. greater 30-day mortality effect. We find a negative correlation between price and mortality effects for COPA mergers, consistent with theoretical predictions that binding price caps exacerbate quality deterioration. Our findings suggest that COPA contracts are poor substitutes for traditional antitrust enforcement.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103335.abstract_zh: 国家强制的行为性救济措施能否有效替代联邦反垄断执法？我们评估了在“公共优势证书”（COPAs）下，州级对医院并购的监管情况。利用1996年至2022年的医院数据，我们估计了并购对COPA监管事件及未受监管但类似的反竞争事件的处置效应，均与未并购对照组相比。两种处置效应之差揭示了州级行为性救济措施的影响：在高度集中的市场中，COPA并购导致价格效应降低11.1个百分点，但30天死亡率效应增加0.5个百分点。我们发现COPA并购的价格与死亡率效应之间存在负相关，这与理论预测一致，即约束性价格上限会加剧质量下降。我们的研究结果表明，COPA合同难以成为传统反垄断执法的有效替代品。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103335.title: Evaluating Substitutes for Federal Antitrust: The Case of COPAs
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103335.title_zh: 评估联邦反垄断替代方案：COPA案例研究

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103336.abstract: This study explores how product variety affects alcohol purchasing in the U.S., using store-level and household scanner data. By analyzing households that relocate to areas with different product availability and controlling for destination-specific consumption patterns, I document a positive relationship between increased product variety and higher alcohol purchases. I complement the household-level evidence with an analysis of two state-specific policy changes, the 2012 Washington liquor deregulation and the 2009 Illinois excise tax increase, to document that policies that raise prices, particularly the Washington liquor deregulation, are also associated with expanded product variety, which may partially offset the intended reduction in consumption. The results have important implications for public health: policymakers should be aware that alcohol market reforms can inadvertently increase product assortment and thereby stimulate consumption, particularly among the heaviest purchasers.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103336.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了产品多样性如何影响美国的酒精购买行为，利用店铺层面及家庭层面的扫描数据进行分析。通过考察搬迁至产品供应情况不同地区的家庭，并控制目的地特有的消费模式，我发现产品多样性的增加与酒精购买量的上升之间存在正相关关系。为补充家庭层面的证据，我还分析了两个州级政策变动——2012年华盛顿州酒类销售放松管制及2009年伊利诺伊州消费税上调——结果表明，提高价格的政策，尤其是华盛顿州的酒类销售放松管制，同样伴随着产品多样性的扩大，这可能部分抵消了预期的消费减少效果。这些发现对公共健康具有重要启示：政策制定者应认识到，酒类市场改革可能无意中增加产品种类，进而刺激消费，尤其是在购买量最大的消费群体中。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103336.title: Product Variety, Alcohol Purchases, and the Role of Excise Taxes
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103336.title_zh: 产品多样性、酒精购买行为与消费税的作用

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103337.abstract: This paper develops a model of dynamic pricing with boundedly rational consumer search. Consumers observe one price, can choose to engage in costly search to learn the other prices, and then purchase from the firm with the lowest observed price. Each consumer searches only if the observed price exceeds their dynamically tuned reservation price. Firms optimize given the current distribution of reservation prices. Short run pricing is characterized by Edgeworth cycles. Rather than resetting as a mixed strategy, each cycle resets when the firm with the larger installed base relents by monopolizing its residual demand. Both the lower and upper bounds of the cycles move with consumer search, though not necessarily in the same direction. Whether these cycles persist in the long run or the pricing dynamic converges to the Diamond paradox, the Bertrand paradox, or a kinked-demand equilibrium depends on exogenous conditions that we outline.
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103337.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含有限理性消费者搜寻的动态定价模型。消费者观察到一种价格后，可选择进行成本性搜寻以了解其他价格，随后从提供最低观察价格的厂商处购买。每位消费者仅在观察到的价格超过其动态调整的保留价格时才会进行搜寻。厂商根据当前保留价格的分布进行优化定价。短期定价表现为埃奇沃斯循环特征。并非以混合策略重置，每个循环在拥有较大安装基数的厂商通过垄断其剩余需求而让步时结束。循环的下界与上界均随消费者搜寻行为变动，尽管变动方向未必一致。这些循环在长期内是否持续，或定价动态是否收敛于戴蒙德悖论、伯特兰悖论或弯折需求均衡，取决于我们所概述的外生条件。
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103337.title: Dynamic Price Competition and Evolutionary Behavior with Search
10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103337.title_zh: 搜索条件下的动态价格竞争与演化行为

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101864.abstract: This paper studies how mandatory greenhouse gas disclosure affects new business formation. We find a significant increase in business entry following the implementation of the Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program in affected industries, relative to unaffected controls. We propose two channels. First, through a production channel, disclosure pressures incumbent firms to reduce emissions by scaling back production or reallocating resources toward cleaner technologies, weakening incumbents’ competitive positions and creating space for new entrants. Second, through an information channel, public disclosure of previously proprietary emissions data helps potential entrepreneurs identify viable entry opportunities. We present evidence consistent with both channels. Incumbent firms reduce economic activity and experience declines in profitability, and entry is concentrated in industries facing greater emissions reductions and public scrutiny. Additionally, regulatory and industry commentary highlights concerns over the proprietary nature of disclosed emissions data. Overall, our findings reveal an unintended yet economically meaningful consequence of environmental disclosure mandates.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101864.abstract_zh: 本文研究了强制性温室气体披露对新企业创建的影响。我们发现，在受影响的行业中，温室气体报告计划实施后，企业进入数量显著增加，相较于未受影响的对照组。我们提出两个作用机制。首先，通过生产渠道，披露压力促使现有企业通过缩减生产规模或将资源重新配置至更清洁的技术来减少排放，从而削弱现有企业的竞争地位，为新进入者创造空间。其次，通过信息渠道，公开披露此前属于专有的排放数据，有助于潜在创业者识别可行的进入机会。我们提供了与这两种机制相一致的证据。现有企业减少了经济活动，盈利能力下降，且企业进入集中在面临更大减排压力和公众关注的行业。此外，监管及行业评论强调了披露排放数据专有性质的担忧。总体而言，我们的研究揭示了环境信息披露规定所带来的一个意料之外但具有经济意义的影响。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101864.title: Mandatory carbon disclosure and new business creation
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101864.title_zh: 强制性碳信息披露与新企业创建

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101865.abstract: Audit design invokes a tradeoff between a monitor’s local knowledge and their independence from influence. We study this tradeoff in the context of a pilot program in six Chinese provinces in 2016, in which provincial governments were given control over budgeting and personnel decisions for city audits. Using a difference-in-differences framework we show that, compared to non-pilot provinces, centralization increases detection of suspicious expenditures by over 50%. These improvements occur also in cities with auditors appointed pre-2016, suggesting that stronger incentives and greater resources rather than auditor selection explain the improvements. Consistent with this interpretation, we find that financial (but not human) resources devoted to city audits increase with centralization. Further results show that centralization’s benefits are strongest in provinces that centralized audit office financing as part of the reform – particularly in poorer cities – suggesting a role for resources in improved performance.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101865.abstract_zh: 审计设计涉及监督者的地方知识与他们免受影响之间的权衡。我们在2016年六个中国省份的试点项目中研究了这一权衡，其中省级政府获得了对城市审计预算和人事决策的控制权。利用双重差分框架，我们显示，与非试点省份相比，集中化使得可疑支出的检出率提高了超过50%。这些改进也出现在2016年前任命审计师的城市中，表明是更强的激励和更多的资源，而非审计师的选择，解释了这些改进。与这一解释一致，我们发现，用于城市审计的财务（而非人力）资源随集中化而增加。进一步的结果显示，集中化的益处最显著于那些作为改革一部分而集中了审计办公室融资的省份——尤其是在较贫困的城市——这表明资源在绩效改进中发挥了作用。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101872.abstract: Building on economic theories of cultural transmission, we examine how audit partners’ cultural trust influences audit outcomes. Based on the “presumptive doubt” perspective of professional skepticism, we propose that audit partners from trusting cultures are more likely to rely on management’s assertions, while still exercising a high degree of caution and not naively trusting management. Consistent with our prediction, we find that audit partners from trusting cultures commit fewer Type I errors when issuing going concern opinions, without significantly increasing Type II errors. The reduction in Type I errors is primarily found when audit partners normally tend to be more conservative, and it is attenuated when management is less trustworthy. At the same time, audit partners from trusting cultures are also associated with more within-GAAP earnings management, suggesting that increased trust entails a cost. Collectively, our findings offer new insights into how cultural trust affects the assurance of accounting information.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101872.abstract_zh: 基于文化传播的经济学理论，我们探讨了审计合伙人的文化信任如何影响审计结果。从职业怀疑的“推定怀疑”视角出发，我们提出，来自信任文化的审计合伙人更可能依赖管理层的陈述，同时仍保持高度谨慎，并非天真地信任管理层。与我们的预测一致，我们发现，来自信任文化的审计合伙人在出具持续经营意见时，犯第一类错误的概率较低，而并未显著增加第二类错误。第一类错误的减少主要出现在审计合伙人通常倾向于更为保守的情况下，并且在管理层可信度较低时，这一效应会减弱。同时，来自信任文化的审计合伙人也与更多的GAAP内盈余管理相关联，这表明增加的信任伴随着成本。总体而言，我们的发现为文化信任如何影响会计信息的保证提供了新的见解。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101872.title: Audit partners’ cultural trust and audit outcomes
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101872.title_zh: 审计合伙人的文化信任与审计结果

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101873.abstract: This paper examines whether corporate tax cuts alter product-market competition by differentially affecting firms with high versus low tax burdens. Tax cuts increase after-tax cash flows for profitable firms but provide little immediate benefit to loss-making firms. We study the 1986 Tax Reform Act, which reduced the top corporate tax rate by 12 percentage points, and examine route-level price and quantity data from the U.S. airline industry. We find that in response to the Act, profitable airlines reduce ticket prices by 4.2% relative to their loss-making rivals and gain 3.3 percentage points in market share. These effects are concentrated in routes where loss-making competitors are financially constrained and are accompanied by increased entry by profitable airlines and exit by loss-making airlines. The evidence suggests that taxes can affect competitive outcomes, specifically in our paper by enabling high-tax firms to compete more aggressively with low-tax rivals after tax cuts.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101873.abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业减税是否通过差异化影响高税负与低税负企业，从而改变产品市场竞争格局。减税增加了盈利企业的税后现金流，但对亏损企业几乎没有即时利益。我们以1986年《税收改革法案》为研究对象，该法案将最高企业税率降低了12个百分点，并利用美国航空业的航线层面价格与数量数据进行分析。研究发现，在该法案实施后，盈利航空公司相对于亏损竞争对手将票价降低了4.2%，并获得了3.3个百分点的市场份额增长。这些效应集中在亏损竞争对手面临财务约束的航线上，同时伴随着盈利航空公司的进入增加和亏损航空公司的退出。证据表明，税收可以影响竞争结果，具体而言，在我们的论文中，减税使得高税负企业能够更积极地与低税负竞争对手展开竞争。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101873.title: Taxes and Competition: Evidence from the airline industry
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101873.title_zh: 税收与竞争：来自航空业的证据

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101876.abstract: We study the informational value of trading networks in over-the-counter (OTC) markets. Using detailed transaction-level data from the corporate bond market, we show that investors with larger dealer networks make superior trading decisions before changes in credit fundamentals, resulting in better risk-adjusted performance. We trace these investors’ superior trading decisions to trading connections where dealers are most likely to have access to novel credit-relevant information, supporting the interpretation that these investors obtain private information through their trading networks. Collectively, our evidence highlights the importance of trading relationships for investors’ private information acquisition.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101876.abstract_zh: 我们研究了场外交易（OTC）市场中交易网络的信息价值。利用公司债券市场的详细交易级数据，我们表明，拥有更大交易商网络的投资者在信用基本面变化前能做出更优的交易决策，从而获得更好的风险调整后表现。我们将这些投资者的卓越交易决策追溯到那些交易商最可能获取新颖信用相关信息的交易联系上，支持了这些投资者通过其交易网络获取私人信息的解释。总体而言，我们的证据强调了交易关系对投资者私人信息获取的重要性。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101876.title: Information flows in trading networks

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101883.abstract: This paper investigates how firms manage supplier disclosures to project a greener supply chain. We show that firms selectively reveal relationships with high-ESG suppliers while withholding ties to low-ESG ones. A shift in the supplier’s environmental score from the 10th to the 90th percentile increases disclosure probability by 4.4% relative to the mean disclosure rate. Our analysis suggests this selective disclosure reflects greenwashing rather than genuine communication of supply-chain ESG improvements. In a U.S. subsample, firms are more likely to disclose green suppliers in the 10-K Business section and ESG reports, while low-ESG suppliers appear more frequently in the 10-K Risk Factors section. Strategic disclosure declines as environmental transparency regulations tighten. Finally, firms that strategically disclose green suppliers experience higher short-term stock returns, though these effects diminish over time. Our results highlight the importance of supply chain environmental disclosure and its potential to reduce capital misallocation.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101883.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了企业如何管理供应商披露以塑造更环保的供应链形象。我们发现，企业会选择性地披露与高ESG供应商的关系，同时隐瞒与低ESG供应商的联系。当供应商的环境评分从第10百分位提升至第90百分位时，披露概率相对于平均披露率增加了4.4%。我们的分析表明，这种选择性披露反映的是“漂绿”行为，而非对供应链ESG改进的真实沟通。在美国子样本中，企业更倾向于在10-K业务部分和ESG报告中披露绿色供应商，而低ESG供应商则更频繁出现在10-K风险因素部分。随着环境透明度监管的加强，战略性披露有所减少。最后，战略性披露绿色供应商的企业短期内股票回报更高，但这些效应随时间递减。我们的研究结果凸显了供应链环境披露的重要性及其在减少资本错配方面的潜在作用。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101883.title: Supply chain washing: Strategic disclosure of corporate suppliers
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101883.title_zh: 供应链洗白：企业供应商的战略性披露

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101884.abstract: I examine how antitrust risk affects firms' voluntary disclosure of mergers and acquisitions (M&As). I hypothesize that firms face a trade-off between the benefits of disclosing M&As to capital markets—namely, incorporating product market benefits into stock prices in a timely manner—and the potential antitrust scrutiny such disclosure can invite, which increases the likelihood of agencies challenging the M&A. Using two quasi-exogenous sources of variations in antitrust enforcement that affect the level of antitrust risk, I find a negative relation between antitrust risk and voluntary M&A disclosures in deal press releases, periodic SEC filings, and quarterly earnings conference calls. The effects are concentrated among managers with short-term horizons, where the trade-off is most salient. Further analysis suggests that media coverage is one mechanism through which voluntary M&A disclosure poses antitrust risk. Collectively, my findings establish antitrust risk as a significant determinant of firms’ voluntary disclosure.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101884.abstract_zh: 我考察了反垄断风险如何影响企业对并购（M&As）的自愿披露。我假设企业面临一种权衡：一方面，向资本市场披露并购信息能带来好处，即及时将产品市场效益纳入股价；另一方面，此类披露可能招致反垄断审查，从而增加监管机构质疑该并购的可能性。利用反垄断执法中两种准外生变动来源来影响反垄断风险水平，我发现反垄断风险与交易新闻稿、定期SEC文件和季度财报电话会议中的并购自愿披露之间存在负相关关系。这种效应集中在具有短期视野的管理者中，此时权衡最为显著。进一步分析表明，媒体报道是自愿并购披露构成反垄断风险的一种机制。总体而言，我的研究确立了反垄断风险作为企业自愿披露的重要决定因素。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101884.title: Antitrust risk and voluntary M&A disclosure
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101884.title_zh: 反垄断风险与并购自愿性披露

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101885.abstract: Using website cookie information from U.S. firms’ websites, I measure consumer data collected through cookies and examine how such data affect firms’ accounting information environments. Cookies provide granular and real-time consumer data to firms’ internal information environments and may improve the quality of internal information that managers rely on for external reporting. I find that firms with more cookies issue management sales forecasts more frequently and devote a larger share of disclosures in 10-K filings to customer, marketing, and product topics. The effects are stronger when cookie-collected data are more relevant or larger in volume and when firms have better data analytic technology. However, proprietary costs and data privacy protection mechanisms attenuate these effects. Using the California Consumer Privacy Act as a quasi-natural experiment, I provide causal evidence linking cookie-collected data to voluntary disclosure. Overall, the study highlights the role of firm-collected consumer data in shaping accounting information environments.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101885.abstract_zh: 利用美国企业网站中的Cookie信息，我衡量了通过Cookie收集的消费者数据，并考察了这些数据如何影响企业的会计信息环境。Cookie为企业内部信息环境提供了细粒度且实时的消费者数据，可能提升管理者依赖以进行外部报告的内部信息质量。研究发现，拥有更多Cookie的企业更频繁地发布管理层销售预测，并在10-K文件中将更大比例的披露内容分配给客户、营销和产品相关主题。当Cookie收集的数据更具相关性或规模更大，以及企业拥有更好的数据分析技术时，这些效应更为显著。然而，专有成本和数据隐私保护机制会削弱这些效应。利用《加州消费者隐私法案》作为准自然实验，我提供了将Cookie收集数据与自愿性披露联系起来的因果证据。总体而言，本研究强调了企业收集的消费者数据在塑造会计信息环境中的作用。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101885.title: Website cookies and voluntary disclosure

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101894.abstract: We examine the role of firms’ internal information quality (IIQ) in designing executive incentive contracts. We find that higher IIQ is associated with a greater number of performance metrics and increased dissimilarity from peer firms’ contracts, particularly along non-financial dimensions. These relations hold when we examine changes in IIQ that are likely induced by plausibly exogenous shifts in two financial accounting standards. We further find that incorporating more numerous and more dissimilar non-financial metrics is positively associated with future profitability, but only when IIQ is high. Our results are consistent with the hypothesis that the quality of a firm’s internal information is a friction in performance metric selection.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101894.abstract_zh: 我们考察了企业内部信息质量（IIQ）在高管激励合同设计中的作用。研究发现，较高的IIQ与更多数量的绩效指标及与同行企业合同差异度的增加相关联，尤其是在非财务维度上。当我们考察可能由两项财务会计准则的合理外生变动所引发的IIQ变化时，这些关系依然成立。我们进一步发现，纳入更多且更不相似的非财务指标与未来盈利能力正相关，但仅在IIQ较高时如此。我们的结果与假设一致，即企业内部信息质量是绩效指标选择中的一个摩擦因素。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101894.title: Internal information quality and performance metric selection
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101894.title_zh: 内部信息质量与绩效指标选择

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101895.abstract: OLS estimates of linear regression models become imprecise when distributional assumptions about the regression errors are not strictly met. Such situations frequently arise in applied research due to the heavy-tailed distributions of dependent variables. Using simulated data and replication settings, we show how robust regression estimation can produce more policy-relevant inferences by increasing the precision of estimates, improving test power, and tightening confidence intervals. We provide guidance to researchers on when and how to apply robust estimation as alternative to OLS and how to combine robust regression estimators with fixed effects and clustered standard errors. Given the non-random nature of observations typically downweighted by robust regression estimators, we also illustrate the importance of inspecting the robust regression weights and discuss how these weights can provide useful insights about heterogeneity in treatment effects or relations of interest.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101895.abstract_zh: 当回归误差的分布假设未得到严格满足时，线性回归模型的OLS估计会变得不精确。这种情况在应用研究中经常出现，原因在于因变量具有重尾分布。利用模拟数据和复制设定，我们展示了稳健回归估计如何通过提高估计精度、增强检验功效以及收紧置信区间，从而产生更具政策相关性的推断。我们为研究者提供指导，说明何时以及如何将稳健估计作为OLS的替代方法应用，以及如何将稳健回归估计器与固定效应和聚类标准误相结合。鉴于稳健回归估计器通常降权的观测具有非随机性质，我们还阐述了检查稳健回归权重的重要性，并讨论了这些权重如何为处理效应或感兴趣关系的异质性提供有用见解。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101896.abstract: A large literature documents that many households underinvest in equities, but the beliefs underlying this behavior remain poorly understood. We study Americans' cynicism toward public companies as a belief structure that helps explain limited market participation, examining its prevalence, underlying mechanisms, and strategies to attenuate it. In a nationally representative survey, we find that corporate cynicism is widespread and negatively predicts individuals’ propensity to invest in stocks. Building on these findings, we conduct a series of experiments and provide causal evidence that corporate cynicism reduces stock investments. We further show that perceiving companies as profit-maximizing fuels corporate cynicism, and that cynicism can be reduced by reshaping beliefs about profit maximization or profit itself. Specifically, cynicism declines when companies highlight broader stakeholder responsibilities in narrative disclosures, when people are prompted to take an investor perspective, and when financial media focus on how corporate profits benefit most Americans versus deepen inequality.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101896.abstract_zh: 大量文献记载了许多家庭在股票投资上投入不足，但支撑这一行为的信念仍鲜为人知。我们研究美国人对上市公司的犬儒主义作为一种信念结构，这有助于解释有限的市场参与，考察其普遍性、内在机制及缓解策略。在一项具有全国代表性的调查中，我们发现企业犬儒主义普遍存在，并且负向预测个人投资股票的倾向。基于这些发现，我们进行了一系列实验，提供了企业犬儒主义减少股票投资的因果证据。我们进一步表明，将公司视为追求利润最大化的认知加剧了企业犬儒主义，而通过重塑关于利润最大化或利润本身的信念可以降低犬儒主义。具体而言，当公司在叙述性披露中强调更广泛的利益相关者责任、当人们被引导采取投资者视角，以及当财经媒体聚焦于企业利润如何惠及大多数美国人而非加深不平等时，犬儒主义会有所下降。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101896.title: Profit-fueled corporate cynicism
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101896.title_zh: 逐利驱动的企业犬儒主义

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101897.abstract: We examine whether brokerages cater to investors’ preferences and beliefs when producing analyst reports. We leverage a unique feature of the Chinese market — firms whose shares are dual-listed on a Chinese stock exchange (A-shares) as well as on the Hong Kong stock exchange (H-shares). We rely on the segmented nature of these two markets — with A-shares primarily traded by Chinese investors and H-shares by foreign investors — and the assumption that Chinese and foreign investors have divergent preferences and beliefs. We find that A-share analyst reports discuss more government-related issues, less valuation-related information, and have more positive tone and more optimistic recommendations relative to H-share reports, within the same firm-year-month and holding constant the brokerage firm. We find consistent evidence when examining differences between analyst reports written in Chinese versus English within the same share market. Overall, this paper presents evidence supporting a catering theory for the production of analyst research.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101897.abstract_zh: 我们考察了券商在撰写分析师报告时是否会迎合投资者的偏好与信念。我们利用了中国市场的一个独特特征——公司股票同时在中国证券交易所（A股）和香港证券交易所（H股）双重上市。我们依赖于这两个市场的分割特性——A股主要由中国投资者交易，H股则由外国投资者交易——并假设中国与外国投资者持有不同的偏好和信念。我们发现，在同一公司-年-月内，且控制券商不变的情况下，A股分析师报告相比H股报告，更多讨论政府相关议题，较少涉及估值相关信息，且语气更为积极，推荐评级更为乐观。当我们在同一股票市场内比较中文与英文撰写的分析师报告时，也发现了相一致的结果。总体而言，本文提供了支持分析师研究报告生产中的迎合理论的证据。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101897.title: Do investor preferences affect analyst research? Evidence from Chinese dual-listed shares
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101897.title_zh: 投资者偏好是否影响分析师研究？来自中国双重上市股票的证据

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101898.abstract: This paper examines how consumption taxes—through the taxation of input goods—can affect firms’ product mix decisions. We study India’s staggered transition from a sales tax, where there was the risk that intermediate inputs are taxed multiple times along the supply chain, to a value-added tax (VAT) that offered credits for taxes paid on inputs. Using detailed product-level data for manufacturing firms and a stacked difference-in-differences design, we find that firms respond to the VAT adoption by narrowing their product scope through reducing vertical integration. These changes reflect a shift away from internal production of inputs, which was tax-induced under the sales tax system, toward greater specialization in the most profitable outputs. We also document that this vertical disintegration leads to lower manufacturing costs, greater profitability, improved investment efficiency, and higher firm value. Our findings highlight how consumption tax design can affect resource allocation within firms and that reducing tax burdens on input goods enhances operational efficiency.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101898.abstract_zh: 本文考察了消费税——通过对投入品征税——如何影响企业的产品组合决策。我们研究了印度从销售税（在该税制下，中间投入品沿供应链存在多次被征税的风险）向增值税（VAT）的渐进式过渡，后者对投入品已缴税款提供抵扣。利用制造业企业详细的产品层面数据以及堆叠双重差分设计，我们发现企业通过减少纵向一体化来应对增值税的采纳，从而收窄其产品范围。这些变化反映了从销售税制度下因税收诱因而进行的内部投入品生产，转向对最具盈利能力的产出进行更大程度专业化的转变。我们还记录了这种纵向解体导致制造成本降低、盈利能力增强、投资效率提升以及企业价值提高。我们的研究结果凸显了消费税设计如何影响企业内部资源配置，并表明减轻投入品税收负担能够提升运营效率。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101898.title: Consumption tax and corporate product mix decisions
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101898.title_zh: 消费税与企业产品组合决策

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101899.abstract: This study investigates the importance of top executives for foreign tax planning in multinational corporations. Applying incremental R2 comparisons and Shapley Value decompositions, we find that executives account for meaningful variation in foreign tax planning and the number of foreign (tax haven) subsidiaries, but have limited influence on effective tax rates in nonhaven affiliates. We further provide initial evidence that executive influence declined following the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (TCJA), with the decrease being less pronounced for foreign effective tax rates than for domestic ones. Overall, our findings highlight how managers' influence varies with their firms’ internal structures and external policy changes. Our results contribute to the literature on executive effects, multinational tax planning, and the behavioral implications of tax policy reforms.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101899.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了跨国公司高层管理人员在海外税务筹划中的重要性。通过采用增量R²比较和Shapley值分解方法，我们发现高管对海外税务筹划及海外（避税天堂）子公司数量的变化具有显著影响，但对非避税天堂附属公司的有效税率影响有限。我们进一步提供了初步证据表明，2017年《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）实施后，高管影响力有所下降，且这一下降幅度在海外有效税率上不如国内有效税率显著。总体而言，我们的研究结果凸显了管理者影响力如何随企业内部结构和外部政策变化而调整。我们的研究为高管效应、跨国税务筹划及税收政策改革的行为影响等相关文献做出了贡献。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101899.title: The role of executives in foreign tax planning
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101899.title_zh: 高管在海外税务筹划中的作用

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101900.abstract: A growing literature suggests that accounting standards not only affect public information but also improve the information environment within a firm, leading to operational changes. In this paper, we examine one mechanism for the informational improvements brought by accounting standards. We present a model that demonstrates myopic incentives driven by short-term price pressure can endogenously lead to underinvestment in information. However, imposing an accounting standard that mandates a minimum level of information quality increases acquisition of decision-relevant information for activities the standard targets and untargeted but related activities. The resulting improvements in reporting quality accentuate investors' reliance on the accounting report, which incentivizes the manager to put forth more effort. Collectively, the improvements in information quality and increase in effort improve the firm's subsequent profitability. Using archival data in the context of the revenue recognition standard (ASC 606), we find evidence consistent with the primary conclusions of the modeled environment.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101900.abstract_zh: 越来越多的文献表明，会计准则不仅影响公开信息，还能改善企业内部的信息环境，从而引发运营变革。本文探讨了会计准则带来信息改善的一种机制。我们构建了一个模型，展示由短期股价压力驱动的短视激励可能内生地导致信息投资不足。然而，实施一项强制规定最低信息质量水平的会计准则，会增加对准则所针对活动及其相关但未直接针对活动的决策相关信息的获取。由此带来的报告质量提升增强了投资者对会计报告的依赖，进而激励管理者投入更多努力。总体而言，信息质量的改善与努力的增加共同提升了企业后续的盈利能力。利用收入确认准则（ASC 606）背景下的档案数据，我们发现了与模型环境主要结论相一致的证据。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101901.abstract: We examine whether financial disclosures affect firm sustainability practices. Using mandatory segment reporting in the United States as the setting, we find that disclosing financial information about previously hidden segments in polluting industries reduces toxic emissions from firm plants. This effect is consistent with the notion that segment disclosures enhance monitoring of firm pollution by highlighting the financial materiality of polluting segments and drawing stakeholders’ attention to their environmental impact. The effect is stronger when the newly disclosed segments are more polluting. Disclosing firms achieve this reduction by implementing better pollution prevention practices, reducing waste generation, and increasing green innovation. Overall, our study highlights the role of mandatory financial disclosures in shaping corporate practices beyond the scope of the disclosed information.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101901.abstract_zh: 我们考察财务披露是否影响企业的可持续实践。以美国强制分部报告为背景，我们发现，披露此前隐藏的污染行业分部财务信息，能减少企业工厂的有毒排放。这一效应与分部披露通过凸显污染分部的财务重要性并吸引利益相关者对其环境影响的关注，从而增强对企业污染的监督这一观点相符。当新披露的分部污染更严重时，该效应更强。披露企业通过实施更好的污染预防措施、减少废物产生以及增加绿色创新来实现这一减排。总体而言，我们的研究强调了强制性财务披露在塑造超出披露信息范围的企业实践中的作用。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101902.abstract: This study examines the role of the accounting quality of U.S. federal agencies, measured with audit opinions, in federal budget allocations to those agencies. We find that, when an agency receives a modified audit opinion, the president proposes and Congress enacts a lower budget for the agency, and the budgetary disagreement between them increases. These effects strengthen when the president and Congress have stronger incentives to demonstrate spending accountability to taxpayers. Exploiting the enactment of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Audit Requirement Target Act, which required the DHS to end its longstanding modified audit opinions, we find that following the act's implementation, the president proposed higher budgets for the DHS and the budgetary disagreement over the DHS diminished. These findings suggest that high-quality federal agency accounting influences budgetary decisions by reducing agencies' information asymmetry with politicians (the president and Congress) and taxpayers, facilitating the evaluation of agencies' spending accountability.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101902.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了美国联邦机构会计质量（以审计意见衡量）在其联邦预算分配中的作用。研究发现，当某机构收到保留审计意见时，总统提议的预算及国会通过的预算均较低，且两者间的预算分歧增大。当总统与国会有更强动机向纳税人展示支出问责性时，上述效应更为显著。利用《国土安全部审计要求目标法案》的颁布——该法案要求国土安全部终止其长期存在的保留审计意见——我们发现，在该法案实施后，总统对国土安全部提议的预算有所提高，且围绕该部的预算分歧有所减少。这些发现表明，高质量的联邦机构会计通过降低机构与政治家（总统和国会）及纳税人之间的信息不对称，促进了对机构支出问责性的评估，从而影响预算决策。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101903.abstract: This paper investigates the relation between executive compensation and corporate tax policies, with a focus on the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (TCJA). Using a pay-performance sensitivity framework, we analyze the differing compensation rewards associated with domestic and foreign pre-tax incomes. Our findings reveal that, before the TCJA, executives received significantly higher rewards for foreign income, encouraging them to shift income abroad. The TCJA reduced this disparity, bringing rewards for domestic and foreign income into closer alignment. A cross-sectional analysis shows that firms assessing CEO performance based on after-tax income exhibit greater sensitivity to changes in tax policy, establishing the presence of a tax mechanism. Additional tests eliminate alternative nontax explanations related to protectionist trade policies and changes in foreign market growth opportunities. These results highlight the significant impact of executive incentives on corporate tax behavior and the effectiveness of tax policy reforms.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101903.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了高管薪酬与企业税收政策之间的关系，特别聚焦于2017年的《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）。通过运用薪酬-绩效敏感性框架，我们分析了国内外税前收入所对应的不同薪酬奖励。研究发现，在TCJA实施前，高管因外国收入获得的奖励显著更高，这鼓励他们将收入转移至海外。TCJA缩小了这一差距，使国内外收入的奖励趋于一致。截面分析显示，基于税后收入评估CEO绩效的企业，对税收政策变化更为敏感，从而证实了税收机制的存在。额外的检验排除了与保护主义贸易政策及外国市场增长机会变化相关的非税收替代解释。这些结果凸显了高管激励对企业税收行为的重大影响，以及税收政策改革的有效性。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101904.abstract: We examine how employee fears of automation-driven job displacement influence corporate disclosure of automation plans. Using a novel measure of local automation fear constructed from cable news transcripts, we document a robust negative relation between automation fear and firms’ propensity to provide forward-looking disclosure about automation strategies. This effect strengthens when disclosure conveys incremental information, when automation substitutes for labor, and when firms face greater union exposure or political costs. To strengthen identification, we exploit quasi-natural experiments that induce increases in automation fear, expected union resistance, and political costs, respectively. We also find suggestive evidence that firms increase private communication with investors to compensate for the reduction in public information provision. Overall, our findings shed light on the trade-offs between maintaining transparency and mitigating adverse employee and politician responses in the era of rapid technological advancement.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101904.abstract_zh: 我们研究了员工对自动化导致的工作岗位流失的恐惧如何影响企业披露自动化计划的行为。利用从有线新闻转录中构建的新型地方自动化恐惧指标，我们记录了自动化恐惧与企业提供前瞻性自动化战略披露倾向之间的稳健负相关关系。当披露传递增量信息、自动化替代劳动力以及企业面临更高的工会风险或政治成本时，这一效应会增强。为强化因果识别，我们分别利用引发自动化恐惧上升、预期工会抵制增强及政治成本增加的准自然实验。我们还发现初步证据表明，企业会增加与投资者的私下沟通，以弥补公开信息供给的减少。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了在技术快速进步时代，维持透明度与缓解员工及政治人物不利反应之间的权衡关系。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101905.abstract: This study investigates the practice of re-audits—where an incoming audit firm re-audits the prior year’s financial statements previously examined by a predecessor audit firm. We examine the costs and benefits of such re-audits. We find that re-audits are more likely when the risks of misstatement are high and when incoming auditors can expect to win more clients by identifying material misstatements overlooked by predecessor auditors. Our results show that incoming auditors who perform re-audits are more successful in winning new clients from predecessor auditors. Moreover, re-audits result in significantly more restatements. However, consistent with the resource-intensive nature of re-audits, we also find that they are associated with longer audit delays and higher audit fees. Overall, we conclude that re-audits have important consequences for financial statement users, incoming auditors, and predecessor auditors.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101905.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了重新审计的实践——即新接任的审计事务所对前任审计事务所先前审查过的上一年度财务报表进行再次审计。我们考察了此类重新审计的成本与效益。研究发现，当错报风险较高，且新接任审计师预期通过识别前任审计师遗漏的重大错报而赢得更多客户时，重新审计更可能发生。结果显示，执行重新审计的新接任审计师在从前任审计师处争取新客户方面更为成功。此外，重新审计显著增加了重述的发生。然而，与重新审计的资源密集型特性相一致，我们也发现其与更长的审计延迟和更高的审计费用相关联。总体而言，我们得出结论，重新审计对财务报表使用者、新接任审计师及前任审计师均具有重要影响。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101906.abstract: This paper examines the association between managers' failure to incorporate macroeconomic news and firm performance, focusing on the role of competitors. Measuring this failure using the extent to which management revenue forecast errors reflect U.S. consumer sentiment, we find an asymmetric association. When firms underestimate consumer demand and underproduce, failing to incorporate consumer sentiment news is associated with worse performance, but when they overestimate demand and overproduce, no association exists. These results are consistent with competitors reacting differently to underproduction and overproduction, worsening firm performance in the case of underproduction but not necessarily in overproduction. Cross-sectional analyses reveal that the negative association is mainly present when U.S. consumer sentiment is important and strategic interactions are stronger, such as in markets with higher product similarity. Overall, our findings suggest that the performance consequences of forecast errors due to failure to understand macroeconomic information are nuanced and depend on competitors’ strategic actions.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101906.abstract_zh: 本文考察了管理者未能纳入宏观经济新闻与企业绩效之间的关联，重点关注竞争对手的作用。通过以管理层收入预测误差反映美国消费者情绪的程度来衡量这一失败，我们发现了一种不对称的关联。当企业低估消费者需求并减少生产时，未能纳入消费者情绪新闻与较差的绩效相关；但当企业高估需求并过度生产时，则不存在这种关联。这些结果与竞争对手对生产不足和生产过剩的不同反应一致，即在生产不足情况下会恶化企业绩效，而在生产过剩情况下则未必如此。横截面分析显示，这种负面关联主要出现在美国消费者情绪重要且战略互动更强的市场中，例如产品相似度较高的市场。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，因未能理解宏观经济信息而导致的预测误差对绩效的影响是微妙的，并取决于竞争对手的战略行动。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101907.abstract: This study investigates whether auditors incorporate investor information demand when determining key audit matter (KAM) disclosures. We measure investor information demand using a unique dataset of investor inquiries submitted through investor interactive platforms (IIPs) established by the China Securities Regulatory Commission. At the topic level, we find that auditors are more likely to disclose a given topic as a KAM when investors raise more inquiries on that topic. At the aggregate level, a higher proportion of inquiries devoted to accounting issues is associated with both a greater number of KAMs and longer KAM disclosures. Importantly, following the introduction of KAM reporting, managers’ footnote disclosures become more aligned with heightened investor inquiries, reinforcing our interpretation that the documented effects reflect auditors’ responses to investor inquiries rather than merely mirroring managerial disclosure changes. Overall, our findings suggest that auditors incorporate investor information demand into KAM disclosures.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101907.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨审计师在确定关键审计事项（KAM）披露时，是否纳入投资者信息需求。我们利用中国证券监督管理委员会设立的投资者互动平台（IIPs）上提交的投资者问询独特数据集来衡量投资者信息需求。在主题层面，我们发现当投资者对某一主题提出更多问询时，审计师更有可能将该主题作为关键审计事项进行披露。在总体层面，涉及会计问题的问询比例越高，关键审计事项的数量越多，其披露内容也越长。重要的是，在关键审计事项报告引入后，管理层脚注披露与投资者问询的增加更加一致，这强化了我们的解释，即所记录的影响反映了审计师对投资者问询的回应，而非仅仅是对管理层披露变化的镜像反映。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，审计师将投资者信息需求纳入关键审计事项披露中。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101908.abstract: This paper provides archival and survey evidence on retail investor use of Generative AI (GenAI). Our archival analysis examines over 400,000 investor queries to a major brokerage's GenAI chatbot. Investors most often use GenAI to help interpret and contextualize financial information and market movements, and for additional tasks including stock screening and streamlining complex research. As time with the tool grows, usage shifts from stock screening and high-level company assessments toward detailed monitoring and interpretation of firm news. Our survey of over 2,000 retail investors explores who adopts GenAI and why. Nearly half report using GenAI, primarily to accelerate and simplify information processing. More sophisticated retail investors lead adoption, deploying GenAI for more complex tasks and diverse information sources. Concerns about response quality and data privacy represent the biggest obstacles to further adoption. Heterogeneous adoption highlights the need for research into GenAI's impact on investor behavior and market dynamics.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101908.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于散户投资者使用生成式人工智能（GenAI）的档案与调查证据。我们的档案分析考察了超过40万条投资者向某大型券商GenAI聊天机器人提出的查询。投资者最常使用GenAI来帮助解读和情境化金融信息及市场动态，并执行包括股票筛选和简化复杂研究在内的其他任务。随着使用该工具时间的增长，使用行为从股票筛选和高层次公司评估转向对公司新闻的详细监控与解读。我们对超过2000名散户投资者的调查探讨了谁采用GenAI及其原因。近半数受访者表示使用GenAI，主要目的是加速和简化信息处理过程。更为成熟的散户投资者引领了采用趋势，他们将GenAI应用于更复杂的任务和多样化的信息来源。对回答质量和数据隐私的担忧是进一步采用的最大障碍。采用行为的异质性凸显了研究GenAI对投资者行为和市场动态影响的必要性。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101909.abstract: Investors increasingly turn to social media for information, even though many sites are saturated with ideological opinions. This paper examines whether ideology-driven social media opinions affect stock market responses to polarizing firm news, using boycotts as the empirical setting. On average, polarizing boycotts are associated with a 1% (2.3%) drop in equity value over the seven (60) trading days after gaining social media traction. Consistent with ideology-driven opinions affecting market responses, the immediate price reaction is more negative when users ideologically aligned with boycotters dominate social media, particularly when their opinions are visible and financially relevant. A mediation analysis suggests that this association operates indirectly through overall social media sentiment toward the boycotted firms. Additionally, trading volume and daily return volatility following boycotts are positively associated with user ideological diversity. Together, these results suggest that ideology-driven social media opinions could influence how investors respond to polarizing firm news.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101909.abstract_zh: 投资者日益转向社交媒体获取信息，尽管许多平台充斥着意识形态观点。本文以抵制活动为实证背景，考察意识形态驱动的社交媒体观点是否影响股市对极化企业新闻的反应。平均而言，在获得社交媒体关注后的七（六十）个交易日内，极化抵制事件与股权价值下降1%（2.3%）相关。与意识形态驱动的观点影响市场反应相一致的是，当与抵制者意识形态一致的用户主导社交媒体时，即时价格反应更为负面，尤其是在这些观点可见且具有财务相关性的情况下。中介分析表明，这种关联通过社交媒体对受抵制企业的整体情绪间接发挥作用。此外，抵制事件后的交易量和日回报波动性与用户意识形态多样性呈正相关。综合来看，这些结果表明，意识形态驱动的社交媒体观点可能影响投资者对极化企业新闻的响应方式。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101910.abstract: The municipal bond market has long been criticized for its lack of disclosure, which prior research often attributes to weak regulatory oversight. We offer another explanation: tax clienteles. Most municipal bonds are tax-exempt, and thus primarily attract high-tax retail investors, who may lack the incentive or ability to demand or monitor disclosures. In contrast, taxable bonds attract a broader investor base, including institutional investors who can demand disclosure. We find that issuers provide more continuing disclosures in years with taxable bonds outstanding relative to years without. Issuers also increase disclosures after issuing their first taxable bond and decrease disclosures after calling their last taxable bond. Exploiting a tax law change, we find that disclosures increase following plausibly exogenous increases in taxable bond issuances. Our results suggest that the tax clienteles for municipal bonds affect issuers’ disclosure practices and can inform those concerned with disclosure noncompliance in the municipal bond market.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101910.abstract_zh: 市政债券市场长期以来因信息披露不足而备受批评，先前研究常将此归因于监管薄弱。我们提出另一种解释：税收客户群体。大多数市政债券免税，因此主要吸引高税率零售投资者，他们可能缺乏要求或监督披露的动机或能力。相比之下，应税债券吸引更广泛的投资者基础，包括能够要求披露的机构投资者。我们发现，发行人在有应税债券未偿还的年份相比没有的年份提供更多持续披露。发行人在首次发行应税债券后增加披露，并在赎回最后一笔应税债券后减少披露。利用一项税法变更，我们发现，在看似外生的应税债券发行增加之后，披露也随之增加。我们的结果表明，市政债券的税收客户群体影响发行人的披露实践，并可为关注市政债券市场披露不合规问题的人士提供参考。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101912.abstract: Since 2011, there has been a substantial decline in the number of students graduating from college with accounting majors. We help explain this decline by empirically showing that technological advancement is associated with lower relative demand from employers for accounting majors compared to other business majors, especially finance. Specifically, corporate software investment is associated with lower relative wages and employment for accounting majors. Cross-sectional tests point to these findings resulting from differences in demand for human capital associated with specific college majors. As the wage gap between finance and accounting majors widens, fewer students subsequently choose an accounting major and more choose a finance major, consistent with selection models going back to Roy (1951). Our findings illustrate the utility of incorporating human capital demand factors into analyses of accounting labor markets and their connection to college major choice.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101912.abstract_zh: 自2011年以来，会计专业本科毕业生人数显著下降。我们通过实证研究帮助解释这一现象，表明技术进步与雇主对会计专业相对于其他商科专业（尤其是金融专业）的较低相对需求相关联。具体而言，企业软件投资与会计专业毕业生的相对工资和就业机会下降有关。横截面测试表明，这些发现源于对不同大学专业所对应人力资本需求的差异。随着金融与会计专业间工资差距扩大，选择会计专业的学生随之减少，而选择金融专业的学生增多，这与自Roy（1951）以来的选择模型相符。我们的研究结果凸显了将人力资本需求因素纳入会计劳动力市场分析及其与大学专业选择关联的实用性。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101931.title: Retraction notice to “Lost in standardization: Effects of financial statement database discrepancies on inference” [J. Account. Econ. 76/1 (2023) 101573]
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101931.title_zh: 撤稿通知：“迷失于标准化：财务报表数据库差异对推断的影响” [J. Account. Econ. 76/1 (2023) 101573]

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101933.title: Interpreting the effects of rule 10b5-1 reform

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101934.abstract: Using novel survey data from 1426 firms in Guatemala, Honduras, and El Salvador, we examine the voluntary adoption of accounting systems by microenterprises operating in the informal economy and its association with access to credit and business growth. Despite the absence of regulatory mandates, 44 percent of informal microbusinesses maintain systematic financial records, with roughly three-quarters of those using notebooks and one-quarter using digital records. Accounting quality is closely linked to the owner’s startup motivation, financial stake, and management capabilities. Informal firms that rely on larger suppliers, extend customer installment credit, engage in marketing promotions, or employ more formal organizational structures are also more likely to adopt structured recordkeeping systems, highlighting accounting’s role as a managerial tool rather than as a compliance function or as a precursor to entering the formal economy. Informal firms that maintain notebooks separating business and personal accounts are significantly more likely to apply for and obtain bank loans. Our inferences for access to credit also extend to microenterprises in the Dominican Republic. In addition, accounting quality appears to support lender due diligence even among informal firms, particularly when lenders are more sophisticated. Using a broader measure of credit market status, we find that accounting quality rises monotonically across credit tiers. Finally, we find that entrepreneurs with higher-quality accounting systems are more likely to plan for business expansion. By illuminating the motivations behind accounting choices in low-enforcement settings, this study deepens our understanding of the foundational role accounting plays in early-stage business development in emerging markets.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101934.abstract_zh: 利用来自危地马拉、洪都拉斯和萨尔瓦多1426家企业的全新调查数据，我们考察了非正规经济中微型企业自愿采用会计制度的情况及其与信贷获取和企业增长之间的关联。尽管缺乏监管强制要求，仍有44%的非正规微型企业保持系统性的财务记录，其中约四分之三使用笔记本记录，四分之一使用数字记录。会计质量与企业主的创业动机、财务投入及管理能力密切相关。依赖较大供应商、向客户提供分期付款信贷、开展营销推广活动或采用更正式组织结构的非正规企业，也更有可能采用结构化的记账系统，这凸显了会计作为管理工具而非合规职能或进入正规经济前提的作用。将企业与个人账户分离记账的非正规企业，申请并获得银行贷款的可能性显著更高。我们关于信贷获取的推论同样适用于多米尼加共和国的微型企业。此外，会计质量似乎即使在非正规企业中也能支持贷方的尽职调查，尤其是在贷方更为专业的情况下。使用更广泛的信贷市场地位衡量指标，我们发现会计质量随信贷层级上升而单调递增。最后，我们发现拥有更高质量会计系统的企业家更有可能规划业务扩张。通过揭示低执法环境下会计选择背后的动机，本研究深化了我们对会计在新兴市场早期企业发展中所发挥基础性作用的理解。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101934.title: The role of accounting in the informal economy
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101934.title_zh: 会计在非正规经济中的作用

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101935.abstract: This study examines the causal effect of financial knowledge on stock pricing efficiency. Leveraging a specially designed investor education website, we conduct a field experiment, sharing insights on the pricing of accounting accruals with investors across China and the US on social media. We find that the treatment stocks experience a reduction in accrual mispricing relative to the control stocks. This effect is particularly pronounced when knowledge that enhances the conceptual understanding of accruals is paired with knowledge that aids in the quantitative application of accruals. Furthermore, the treatment effect is strengthened among stocks with investors who engage more deeply with the educational content yet possess lower financial sophistication.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101935.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了金融知识对股票定价效率的因果效应。借助一个专门设计的投资者教育网站，我们开展了一项实地实验，通过社交媒体向中国及美国的投资者分享关于会计应计项目定价的见解。研究发现，相较于对照组股票，处理组股票的应计项目错误定价有所减少。当增强对应计项目概念理解的知识与辅助应计项目量化应用的知识相结合时，这一效应尤为显著。此外，在处理组中，那些更深入参与教育内容但金融素养较低的投资者所持有的股票，其处理效应更为增强。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101935.title: Knowledge is power: A field experiment in the Chinese and US stock markets
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101935.title_zh: 知识即力量：中美股市的实地实验

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101936.abstract: Bhojraj et al. (2026) provide novel evidence that systemically large banks' internal loan loss forecasts systematically overreact to new information and that this overreaction is economically meaningful for loan loss provisioning. Our discussion focuses on whether the evidence identifies representativeness bias, as opposed to a broader set of behavioral, institutional, and economic mechanisms. We argue that the paper more convincingly documents overreaction than it isolates representativeness as the underlying mechanism. We revisit the role of bank information environment, data generating process, COVID-era uncertainty, endogenous bank responses, regulatory influences, and the interpretation of the CECL (Current Expected Credit Losses) results relative to subsidiaries of IFRS 9 adopters. While several additional analyses are supportive of biased expectations, others suggest a more cautious reading of the mechanism. Our overall takeaway is that the paper's central contribution would be strengthened by framing the evidence more directly around overreaction in bank expectations formation and its implications for provisioning, while leaving greater room for multiple coexisting mechanisms and future research on how behavioral forces enter bank forecasting environments.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101936.abstract_zh: Bhojraj等人（2026年）提供了新颖的证据，表明系统重要性银行的内部贷款损失预测系统性地对新增信息过度反应，且这种过度反应对贷款损失拨备具有经济意义上的重要性。我们的讨论聚焦于该证据是否识别出代表性偏差，而非更广泛的行为、制度及经济机制。我们认为，该论文更有说服力地记录了过度反应现象，而非将代表性偏差孤立为潜在机制。我们重新审视了银行信息环境、数据生成过程、新冠疫情时期的不确定性、银行内生反应、监管影响，以及CECL（当前预期信用损失）结果相对于采用IFRS 9的子公司之解释。尽管若干附加分析支持偏差预期的存在，但其他分析则提示应对机制解读持更为审慎的态度。总体而言，我们认为，若将证据更直接地围绕银行预期形成中的过度反应及其对拨备的影响进行框架构建，同时为多种共存机制及未来关于行为因素如何进入银行预测环境的研究留出更大空间，则该论文的核心贡献将得到加强。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101936.title: What drives banks’ overreaction to loan loss information? Discussion of imperfect expectations in loan loss forecasts
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101936.title_zh: 什么驱动银行对贷款损失信息的过度反应？——贷款损失预测中非完美预期的探讨

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101937.abstract: We collect quantitative (true thresholds and realizations) and qualitative (compliance status) covenant information from SEC filings to examine the accuracy of compliance estimates derived using data from commercial databases. Estimated covenant slack frequently overestimates covenant violations, and only rarely understates them, with this asymmetry holding for both qualitative and quantitative disclosers. The non-random structure of this measurement error has implications for research that relies on estimated violations or on precise measurement of covenant realizations near a threshold. Across our two samples of disclosers, we find evidence consistent with the debt covenant hypothesis for debt-to-EBITDA covenants once measurement error is considered. We also show that the lender forbearance rate declines sharply after correcting estimated violations for measurement error, and that true violations, but not estimated violations, are associated with negative stock market reactions and loan renegotiations. Finally, we investigate practical approaches to reduce measurement error.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101937.abstract_zh: 我们从美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的备案文件中收集了定量（真实阈值及实现值）和定性（合规状态）的契约信息，以检验基于商业数据库数据得出的合规估计的准确性。估计的契约缓冲空间往往高估了契约违约情况，而很少低估，这种不对称性在定性披露者和定量披露者中均存在。这种测量误差的非随机结构对依赖估计违约或对阈值附近契约实现值精确测量的研究具有重要影响。在我们的两个披露者样本中，一旦考虑测量误差，我们发现与债务对EBITDA契约相关的债务契约假说证据一致。我们还表明，在纠正估计违约的测量误差后，贷款人容忍率显著下降，且真实违约（而非估计违约）与负面的股市反应及贷款重新谈判相关联。最后，我们探讨了减少测量误差的实用方法。

10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101938.abstract: We study whether misconduct by firms and investment advisers declines around a quasi-natural experiment created by the staggered launch of Twitter accounts by regional offices of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Even though the tweets repackage information available on the SEC’s website, we find a reduction in opportunistic insider trading and financial misreporting for firms, and a reduction in customer complaints against investment advisers. Consistent with the tweets making enforcement actions more salient and widely disseminated, we find the decline in misconduct to be cross-sectionally related to Twitter following and engagement, the fraction of retail clients, tweet content, and investment in compliance. In addition, we find Twitter adoption expands press coverage of the SEC’s work and increases stock market reactions to SEC enforcement actions. Our results suggest that regulators’ use of social media, a relatively low-cost intervention, deters misconduct.
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101938.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在美国证券交易委员会（SEC）各地区办事处陆续开通Twitter账户这一准自然实验背景下，企业及投资顾问的不当行为是否有所减少。尽管这些推文重新包装了SEC网站上已有的信息，我们仍观察到机会主义内幕交易和企业财务错报有所减少，同时针对投资顾问的客户投诉也相应下降。与推文使执法行动更加显著且广泛传播的假设一致，我们发现不当行为的减少与Twitter关注度及互动、零售客户比例、推文内容以及合规投入呈横截面相关。此外，Twitter的采用扩大了媒体对SEC工作的报道范围，并增强了股市对SEC执法行动的反应。我们的研究结果表明，监管机构利用社交媒体这一成本相对较低的干预手段，能够有效遏制不当行为。
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101938.title: Regulating via Social Media: Deterrence Effects of the SEC’s Use of Twitter
10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101938.title_zh: 通过社交媒体进行监管：美国证券交易委员会使用Twitter的威慑效应

10.1016/j.jce.2025.09.001.abstract: Online education is rapidly expanding due to technological advancements and increased demand for quality education. However, its effectiveness and impact on student behavior are not well understood. The COVID-19 pandemic has accelerated online education and offered a unique opportunity to evaluate its effects. Using nationwide longitudinal survey data from China, we find that online education during the pandemic significantly diminished academic performance and worsened mental health outcomes, including increased depressive symptoms and decreased well-being. Our analysis explores four behavioral mechanisms: interpersonal needs and relationships, parent-child interactions, teacher-student dynamics, and time allocation. We demonstrate that online education reduces effective peer interaction, deteriorates self-reported interpersonal and familial relationships, and leads to inefficient time allocation. Students also substantially increased their entertainment internet use, including video watching and gaming. These factors contributed to declines in academic performance and mental health. Our findings underscore the critical role of social networks and time allocation in maximizing the benefits of online education.
10.1016/j.jce.2025.09.001.abstract_zh: 在线教育因技术进步和对优质教育需求的增长而迅速扩张。然而，其有效性及对学生行为的影响尚不明确。新冠疫情加速了在线教育的普及，为评估其效果提供了独特契机。利用中国全国范围的纵向调查数据，我们发现疫情期间的在线教育显著降低了学业表现，并恶化了心理健康结果，包括抑郁症状增加和幸福感下降。我们的分析探讨了四种行为机制：人际需求与关系、亲子互动、师生动态以及时间分配。研究表明，在线教育减少了有效的同伴互动，恶化了自报的人际关系和家庭关系，并导致时间分配效率低下。学生娱乐性互联网使用也大幅增加，包括观看视频和玩游戏。这些因素共同导致了学业表现和心理健康的下降。我们的发现强调了社交网络和时间分配在最大化在线教育效益中的关键作用。

10.1016/j.jce.2025.10.001.abstract: How do gender norms change? This paper provides evidence that exposure to mandatory high school courses on the 1991 Colombian Constitution—which incorporated principles of gender equality—significantly influenced attitudes toward gender roles. Using a difference-in-differences framework, we compare individuals who were exposed to these courses with those who were not. The results show that constitutional education increased support for gender equality, particularly among men. The effect is stronger when a younger woman is present in the household, suggesting a possible motivation to support the empowerment of younger female relatives. We also document important gender differences in how these shifts manifest within households: women exposed to the courses were more likely to reject the idea that men should be the head of the household, whereas men’s views on intra-household roles remained largely unchanged. This contrast points to persistent resistance to gender norm change within the private sphere, even as broader attitudes become more egalitarian. Taken together, the findings underscore the role of institutional and cultural change—through constitutional reform and civic education—in fostering more egalitarian gender norms, while also highlighting the complexity of such transformations.
10.1016/j.jce.2025.10.001.abstract_zh: 性别规范如何变迁？本文提供的证据表明，接触1991年哥伦比亚宪法——其中纳入了性别平等原则——的强制性高中课程，显著影响了人们对性别角色的态度。采用双重差分框架，我们比较了接触过这些课程与未接触过的个体。结果显示，宪法教育增强了对性别平等的支持，尤其是在男性中。当家庭中有较年轻的女性成员时，这一效应更为显著，暗示可能存在支持年轻女性亲属赋权的动机。我们还记录了这些转变在家庭内部表现出的重要性别差异：接触过课程的女性更可能拒绝男性应作为户主的观念，而男性对家庭内部角色的看法则基本未变。这种对比揭示了即使在更广泛态度趋于平等的同时，私人领域内对性别规范变革仍存在持续抵抗。总体而言，研究结果强调了制度与文化变革——通过宪法改革和公民教育——在促进更平等性别规范中的作用，同时也凸显了此类转型的复杂性。

10.1016/j.jce.2025.11.004.abstract: Science knows no borders, but is never detached from politics. We study a lesser-noticed consequence of the US–China tension since 2018: the downturn in STEM educational services trade. Our analysis reveals a pronounced drop, exceeding 40%, in Chinese STEM students pursuing graduate study in the US. Visa restrictions, geopolitical uncertainties and anti-US sentiments reduce the allure of US education, prompting students to seek alternatives in other foreign countries or China. The two reallocation effects are comparable, suggesting similar elasticities of substitution. Further analyses find that females tend to relocate to other foreign countries more than males do.
10.1016/j.jce.2025.11.004.abstract_zh: 科学无国界，但从未脱离政治。我们研究了自2018年以来中美紧张局势中一个较少被注意的后果：STEM教育服务贸易的下滑。我们的分析显示，中国STEM学生赴美攻读研究生的人数显著下降，降幅超过40%。签证限制、地缘政治不确定性和反美情绪降低了美国教育的吸引力，促使学生转向其他国家或中国寻求替代选择。这两种重新分配效应相当，表明替代弹性相似。进一步分析发现，女性比男性更倾向于转移到其他外国国家。
10.1016/j.jce.2025.11.004.title: The US–China tension and global reallocation of Chinese STEM talents
10.1016/j.jce.2025.11.004.title_zh: 中美紧张局势与全球STEM领域中国人才的重新配置

10.1016/j.jce.2025.11.005.abstract: International tax evasion is a major source of discontent for tax authorities. State purchases of bank data on suspected tax evaders from international tax havens constitute one tool to combat such tax evasion. Increasing the risks of detection, such purchases may spur voluntary disclosures for fear of facing charges for tax fraud. Tax authorities in Germany have made repeated use of this tool in recent years, above all in North-Rhine Westphalia, Germany's most populous federal state. Using self-compiled data for North-Rhine Westphalia on the timing and content of data acquisitions and on monthly voluntary disclosures of international tax evasion involving Swiss banks, we study the effects that such acquisitions had on the evolution of voluntary disclosures over time. Our results show that purchases of data on potential tax evaders had a positive and sizeable effect on voluntary disclosures. Various robustness checks and additional explorations corroborate this conclusion.""'
10.1016/j.jce.2025.11.005.abstract_zh: 国际逃税是税务机关不满的主要来源。国家从国际避税天堂购买涉嫌逃税者的银行数据，是打击此类逃税行为的一种工具。增加被发现的風險，此类购买可能促使纳税人因担心面临税务欺诈指控而自愿披露。近年来，德国税务机关反复使用这一工具，尤其是在德国人口最多的联邦州——北莱茵-威斯特法伦州。利用自行编制的北莱茵-威斯特法伦州数据收购时间与内容以及涉及瑞士银行的国际逃税月度自愿披露数据，我们研究了这些收购对自愿披露随时间演变的影响。结果显示，购买潜在逃税者数据对自愿披露产生了积极且显著的影响。多种稳健性检验和额外探索进一步证实了这一结论。
