10.1016/j.jce.2025.11.005.title: International tax evasion, state purchases of confidential bank data and voluntary disclosures
10.1016/j.jce.2025.11.005.title_zh: 国际逃税、国家购买保密银行数据与自愿披露

10.1016/j.jce.2025.12.001.abstract: Do large changes in electorate composition affect institutional quality? In this paper, we causally consider a unique case of a large change in electorate composition that has no ethnic component: German reunification. As East and West Germans were ethnically similar, the main difference between both groups is tied to cultural differences that arose during Communist rule. We test whether reunification lowered economic freedom (our measure of institutional quality) in Germany using synthetic control methods. We find that there was a transitory effect of less than a decade whereby reunification significantly reduced economic freedom and institutional quality.
10.1016/j.jce.2025.12.001.abstract_zh: 选民构成的重大变化是否会影响制度质量？在本文中，我们因果性地考察了一个独特案例，即选民构成发生大规模变化且不涉及种族因素的情况：德国统一。由于东德与西德人在种族上相似，两组之间的主要差异与共产主义统治期间形成的文化差异相关。我们运用合成控制方法检验统一是否降低了德国的经济自由度（我们衡量制度质量的指标）。研究发现，统一对经济自由度和制度质量产生了不到十年的暂时性负面影响。
10.1016/j.jce.2025.12.001.title: The causal effect of German reunification on economic freedom
10.1016/j.jce.2025.12.001.title_zh: 德国统一对经济自由的因果效应

10.1016/j.jce.2025.12.002.abstract: This paper investigates the role of ethnic favoritism in the long run allocation of road infrastructure in Ethiopia. I construct a 5 km 2 grid cell panel by merging road network data from the late 1960s to 2016 with high resolution maps of local ethnic composition. Using a quasi-experimental empirical design, the study finds that cells where the local majority shares the ethnicity with the ruling elite receive 8.7 percent additional road investments and see a 13.8 improvement in road surface quality than otherwise comparable non co-ethnic cells. Exploiting the phased rollout of the Road Sector Development Program between 1997 and 2016, I also document that new roads raise night lights intensity by 0.27 standard deviations in cells benefiting from the program and by 0.51 standard deviations in co-ethnic areas, with larger effects for earlier investments. These findings suggest that ethnic alignment and the availability of large public funds jointly shape the placement of road infrastructure, influencing local economic dynamics. • In Ethiopian roads projects, areas co-ethnic with the government see more investments. • Ethiopian infrastructural investments involve discretionary political allocation. • Ethnic favoritism in Ethiopia peaks in federal roads, where discretion is widest. • In Ethiopia, infrastructure gains bring strong improvements in local development.
10.1016/j.jce.2025.12.002.abstract_zh: 本文考察了民族偏袒在埃塞俄比亚道路基础设施长期配置中的作用。我将20世纪60年代末至2016年的道路网络数据与高分辨率的当地民族构成地图相结合，构建了一个5平方公里网格单元的面板数据集。采用准实验实证设计，研究发现，与统治精英共享民族身份的当地多数群体所在的网格单元，相比其他条件相似的非同族网格单元，获得了8.7%的额外道路投资，且道路表面质量提升了13.8%。利用1997年至2016年间道路部门发展计划的分阶段推进，我还发现，新道路使受益于该计划的网格单元夜间灯光强度提高了0.27个标准差，而在同族地区则提高了0.51个标准差，且早期投资的效果更为显著。这些发现表明，民族对齐和大量公共资金的可得性共同塑造了道路基础设施的布局，进而影响地方经济动态。• 在埃塞俄比亚道路项目中，与政府同族的地区获得更多投资。• 埃塞俄比亚的基础设施投资涉及自由裁量的政治分配。• 埃塞俄比亚的民族偏袒在联邦道路中最为突出，此时自由裁量空间最大。• 在埃塞俄比亚，基础设施收益带来了地方发展的显著改善。
10.1016/j.jce.2025.12.002.title: Road to division: Ethnic favoritism and road infrastructure in Ethiopia
10.1016/j.jce.2025.12.002.title_zh: 分裂之路：埃塞俄比亚的族群偏袒与道路基础设施

10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.001.abstract: In the early 1960s, China launched the “Construction of Third Front” (TF) industrialization campaign for national defense considerations, which significantly spurred manufacturing growth in the underdeveloped hinterland. Exploiting variation in the exposure to the TF across prefectures and cohorts, we find that the TF significantly increased human capital accumulation in the long term. These effects were plausibly driven by improved access to education and healthcare, an income effect, and the dominance of the positive effect of educational returns over the negative impact of the opportunity cost. Further analysis reveals that children with greater exposure to the TF experienced better labor market outcomes, delayed fertility, and smaller family sizes in adulthood.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.001.abstract_zh: 20世纪60年代初，中国出于国防考虑启动了“三线建设”工业化运动，显著促进了欠发达内陆地区的制造业增长。利用不同地区和队列间对三线建设暴露程度的差异，我们发现三线建设长期显著提升了人力资本积累。这些效应可能源于教育和医疗服务可及性的改善、收入效应，以及教育回报的正向影响超过机会成本的负向影响。进一步分析显示，三线建设暴露程度较高的儿童在成年后享有更好的劳动力市场表现、生育年龄推迟及家庭规模缩小。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.001.title: The long-term impact of industrialization campaigns on human capital accumulation: Evidence from the “Construction of Third Front” in China
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.001.title_zh: 工业化运动对人力资本积累的长期影响：来自中国“三线建设”的证据

10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.002.abstract: This paper analyzes the impacts of importing intermediate digital inputs (IDIs) on income inequality between high-skilled and low-skilled workers, using a novel dataset that merges recent EU KLEMS and OECD data for 29 countries and 15 industries for 2008-2020. We find that IDI imports significantly widen income inequality, because such imports are associated with higher technology and capital intensities, which directly increase income inequality by complementing high-skilled labor while substituting for low-skilled labor, and indirectly exacerbate inequality through workforce skill upgrading. Heterogeneity analysis shows that these occur primarily in highly digitalized countries and industries, as well as technology-intensive sectors. We also construct two shift-share instrumental variables, namely the global imported IDI shocks and the global digital export shocks, to address endogeneity.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.002.abstract_zh: 本文利用一项结合近期EU KLEMS与OECD数据的新数据集，涵盖2008-2020年间29个国家及15个行业，分析了进口中间数字投入（IDIs）对高技能与低技能工人之间收入不平等的影响。研究发现，IDI进口显著扩大了收入不平等，原因在于此类进口与更高的技术和资本密集度相关联，这直接通过补充高技能劳动力并替代低技能劳动力加剧了收入不平等，同时通过劳动力技能升级间接加剧了不平等。异质性分析显示，这些效应主要出现在高度数字化国家及行业，以及技术密集型部门。我们还构建了两个转移份额工具变量，即全球进口IDI冲击和全球数字出口冲击，以解决内生性问题。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.002.title: Imported intermediate digital inputs and income inequality
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.002.title_zh: 进口中间数字投入与收入不平等

10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.003.abstract: Drawing on the literature on cultural adaptations to historical disease exposure, we investigate differences in government containment policies during the COVID-19 pandemic. We hypothesize that a higher historical exposure to disease resulted in a stronger government response to recent COVID deaths, particularly during the first year of the pandemic characterized by fundamental uncertainty. Our empirical analysis confirms this hypothesis, both for differences in government responses to disease dynamics between countries and for differences in state-level containment policies within the United States. Our results suggest that the impact of historical health legacies on contemporary policy may be conditional on the character of the public health risk at hand. Deep cultural norms, determined by historical experiences, may play a minor role most of the time but are activated in times of fundamental uncertainty. • High historic pathogen prevalence (HPP) may trigger strong intuitive disease response. • Countries with high HPP had stronger COVID-19 policy responses in 2020. • The same pattern appeared across U.S. states. • Early on, people in high HPP-countries were more anxious and supportive of curfews. • Historical behavioral norms seem to matter more in times of fundamental uncertainty.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.003.abstract_zh: 借鉴关于文化适应历史疾病暴露的文献，我们研究了COVID-19大流行期间政府防控政策的差异。我们假设，历史上较高的疾病暴露程度会导致政府对近期新冠死亡病例采取更强烈的应对措施，尤其是在以根本不确定性为特征的大流行第一年。我们的实证分析证实了这一假设，既体现在各国政府对疾病动态反应的差异上，也体现在美国各州层面防控政策的差异上。我们的结果表明，历史健康遗产对当代政策的影响可能取决于当前公共卫生风险的性质。由历史经历决定的深层文化规范，在大多数时候可能作用有限，但在根本不确定性时期会被激活。• 高历史病原体流行率（HPP）可能触发强烈的直觉性疾病应对反应。• 高HPP国家在2020年采取了更强有力的COVID-19政策应对措施。• 这一模式同样出现在美国各州之间。• 早期，高HPP国家的民众更为焦虑，并更支持宵禁措施。• 历史行为规范似乎在根本不确定性时期更为重要。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.003.title: Conditional persistence? Historical disease exposure and government response to COVID-19
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.003.title_zh: 条件性持续？历史疾病暴露与政府对COVID-19的应对

10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.004.abstract: Foreign direct investment (FDI) is often seen as a means to boost domestic investment and, hence, capital accumulation. Yet, the empirical support for such a positive investment effect of FDI is inconclusive. A possible reason is that FDI is often directed towards the financial sector, where capital investment tends to be low. In this paper, we develop a novel approach to analyse how FDI into the financial sector transmits into domestic investment by non-financial industries. Our approach uses shares of industries’ financial exposure to attribute shifts in financial FDI to individual non-financial industries. Using industry-level FDI and investment data from 12 Central and Eastern European countries between 1997 and 2019, we find that industries with close links to the financial sector increase domestic investment in the presence of financial FDI, particularly manufacturing, trade and real estate. Additionally, we provide suggestive evidence that this relationship operates through a liquidity channel.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.004.abstract_zh: 外国直接投资（FDI）常被视为促进国内投资、进而推动资本积累的一种手段。然而，关于FDI对投资具有积极效应的实证支持并不确定。一个可能的原因是，FDI往往流向金融部门，而该部门的资本投资通常较低。本文开发了一种新颖的方法，用以分析流入金融部门的FDI如何传导至非金融行业的国内投资。我们的方法利用各行业金融敞口的份额，将金融FDI的变动归因于各个非金融行业。利用1997年至2019年间12个中东欧国家的行业层面FDI和投资数据，我们发现，与金融部门联系紧密的行业在金融FDI存在时增加了国内投资，尤其是制造业、贸易和房地产业。此外，我们提供了初步证据表明，这种关系通过流动性渠道发挥作用。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.004.title: How does FDI transmit into domestic investment? Exploring intra-industry and financial channels
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.004.title_zh: 外商直接投资如何传导至国内投资？——行业内部与金融渠道的探索

10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.005.abstract: This paper examines the effect of internal migration on firms’ labor share. We develop a theoretical framework in which rural-to-urban migration increases the labor share of local firms by substituting labor for capital and increasing the skill wage premium. Using a “shift-share” instrumental variable approach, we show that migration inflows increase the labor share of local firms in China. To test the mechanisms predicted by the model, we show that migration inflows reduce capital per worker, raising the relative wages of skilled labor while lowering the skill composition of firm employment. Finally, heterogeneity analysis reveals that the effect is more pronounced among private firms and highly educated migrants, with no significant gender differences.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.005.abstract_zh: 本文考察了内部迁移对企业劳动份额的影响。我们构建了一个理论框架，其中农村向城市的迁移通过以劳动替代资本并提高技能工资溢价，增加了本地企业的劳动份额。采用“转移-份额”工具变量方法，我们表明迁移流入提高了中国本地企业的劳动份额。为检验模型预测的机制，我们发现迁移流入降低了人均资本，提高了技能劳动力的相对工资，同时降低了企业就业的技能构成。最后，异质性分析显示，这一效应在私营企业和高学历迁移者中更为显著，且不存在显著的性别差异。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.005.title: Internal migration and labor share: Theory and evidence
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.005.title_zh: 内部迁移与劳动份额：理论与证据

10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.006.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between local ethnic divisions and conflict in Sub-Saharan Africa. Using census subsamples and large-scale household surveys, we construct a new subnational dataset on ethnic inequality capturing group-level differences in education, asset ownership, and access to basic amenities for several hundred regions in thirty-five countries. To distinguish between deep-rooted and more recent ethnic divisions, we incorporate groups from our sample into Ethnologue’s linguistic tree model and generate alternative measures of both ethnic fractionalization and inequality based on ancestral languages. Our analysis, leveraging within-country variation and accounting for numerous regional characteristics, reveals a robust positive relationship between ethnic fractionalization and conflict, especially when using deeper linguistic cleavages to define distinct groups. In contrast, ethnic inequality shows no systematic association with conflict frequency or severity. These findings suggest the primacy of ethnolinguistic differences per se, rather than socioeconomic disparities between groups, as a driver of local conflict.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.006.abstract_zh: 本文考察了撒哈拉以南非洲地区地方民族分裂与冲突之间的关系。利用人口普查子样本和大规模家庭调查数据，我们构建了一个新的次国家级数据集，用以衡量民族不平等，该数据集涵盖了三十五个国家数百个地区在群体层面上的教育、资产所有权及基本生活设施获取差异。为区分根深蒂固与较新近的民族分裂，我们将样本中的群体纳入Ethnologue语言树模型，并基于祖先语言生成了民族分裂化与不平等的替代度量指标。我们的分析利用国内差异并控制众多区域特征，揭示了民族分裂化与冲突之间存在稳健的正相关关系，尤其是在使用更深层的语言分裂来界定不同群体时。相比之下，民族不平等与冲突频率或严重程度之间并无系统性关联。这些发现表明，民族语言差异本身，而非群体间的社会经济差距，是地方冲突的主要驱动因素。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.006.title: Fragmentation or inequality: Ethnic divisions and conflict in Sub-Saharan Africa
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.006.title_zh: 碎片化还是不平等：撒哈拉以南非洲的族群分裂与冲突

10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.010.abstract: Using manufacturing data for a panel of 86 low- , middle-, and high-income countries over the period 1963–2020, this study investigates the effects of domestic and foreign technological progress on the labour share dynamics in low- and high-tech manufacturing. We find that the increase in domestic and, in particular, foreign technological progress since approximately 1990, has reduced the labour share in high-income countries and contributed to an increase in the labour share in middle- and low-income countries. The positive effects in the low-income countries have been driven by high R&D-intensity firms. Overall, we find that estimates for the US and other high-income countries cannot be used to project the underlying drivers of labour shares in the middle- and low-income countries.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.010.abstract_zh: 本研究利用1963至2020年间86个低收入、中等收入及高收入国家的制造业面板数据，探讨了国内外技术进步对低技术和高技术制造业劳动份额动态的影响。研究发现，自1990年前后起，国内外技术进步（尤其是国外技术进步）的提升，减少了高收入国家的劳动份额，同时促进了中等收入和低收入国家劳动份额的增长。低收入国家的积极效应主要由高研发密集型企业驱动。总体而言，我们的结果表明，美国及其他高收入国家的估计结果不能用于预测中等收入和低收入国家劳动份额的根本驱动因素。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.010.title: Technological progress and the global decline in the manufacturing labour share
10.1016/j.jce.2026.01.010.title_zh: 技术进步与全球制造业劳动份额的下降

10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.001.abstract: This paper quantifies the health benefits of China’s Low-Carbon Pilot (LCP) policy using individual-level mortality records. Exploiting staggered policy adoption and estimating dynamic treatment effects with the Sun and Abraham (2021) approach, we find that LCP implementation reduces pollution-related mortality among older adults by 12.6%, with the largest declines in cardiovascular, ischemic heart, and cerebrovascular deaths. The mechanism evidence points to improved air quality—achieved mainly through stronger fiscal support and tighter regulatory enforcement—and the effects are amplified in places led by younger, career-motivated officials, underscoring sizeable health benefits from climate-oriented environmental regulation.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.001.abstract_zh: 本文利用个体层面的死亡记录，量化了中国低碳试点政策的健康效益。通过利用政策分阶段实施的特点，并采用Sun和Abraham（2021）的方法估计动态处理效应，我们发现低碳试点政策的实施使老年人中与污染相关的死亡率降低了12.6%，其中心血管疾病、缺血性心脏病和脑血管疾病的死亡人数降幅最大。机制证据表明，空气质量改善——主要通过加强财政支持和更严格的监管执法实现——是主要驱动因素，且这一效应在由较年轻、有职业晋升动机的官员领导的地区更为显著，凸显了以气候为导向的环境规制带来的可观健康收益。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.001.title: The impact of low-carbon pilots policy on health
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.001.title_zh: 低碳试点政策对健康的影响

10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.005.abstract: The distinctive traits of early settlers at the initial stages of institutional development may be crucial for cultural formation. In 1973, cultural geographer Wilbur Zelinsky formalized this idea in his doctrine of “First Effective Settlement.” I examine this doctrine and identify its short- and long-run implications for gender norms in the United States. To capture counties at early stages of cultural and institutional development, I focus on county creation events and proxy early settlers’ gender norms using historical female labor force participation rates and women’s financial rights in their places of origin. I document the distinctive characteristics of early settler populations and provide suggestive evidence of the transmission of gender norms across space and time. The results show that women’s labor supply is higher, both in the short and long run, in United States counties that historically hosted larger foreign-born early settler populations from places with high female labor force participation. I provide evidence for four reinforcing mechanisms underlying this persistence: foundational influence during critical junctures, demographic dominance, intergenerational cultural transmission, and political dominance. Together, these findings shed new light on how immigrants’ cultural endowments can have durable effects when introduced during critical junctures of institutional formation in host societies.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.005.abstract_zh: 制度发展初期早期定居者的独特特征可能对文化形成至关重要。1973年，文化地理学家威尔伯·泽林斯基在其“首次有效定居”学说中正式阐述了这一观点。本文考察了这一学说，并识别其对美国性别规范的短期与长期影响。为捕捉处于文化与制度发展早期阶段的县，我聚焦于县的创建事件，并以历史女性劳动力参与率及女性在原籍地的金融权利作为早期定居者性别规范的代理指标。我记录了早期定居者群体的独特特征，并提供了性别规范在空间与时间上传递的提示性证据。结果表明，在历史上接纳了来自高女性劳动力参与率地区的外国出生早期定居者人口较多的美国县，女性劳动力供给在短期和长期内均更高。我为这种持续性提供了四种强化机制的证据：关键节点时期的基础性影响、人口主导性、代际文化传递以及政治主导性。综合来看，这些发现为移民的文化禀赋在宿主社会制度形成的关键节点引入时如何产生持久影响提供了新的见解。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.005.title: Settlers and norms

10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.006.abstract: This paper examines the effects and mechanisms of air pollution on firm exports using Chinese firm–product data (2000–2007) and thermal inversion as an instrumental variable. We find that a 1% increase in PM2.5 reduces export values by 0.65%, with the 28% pollution increase over our sample period reducing overall exports by 18.30%. We identify two channels through which pollution affects exports: Pollution reduces labor productivity (0.83% decrease per 1% increase in PM2.5) and trigger environmental regulations (lowering exports by 20%–25% based on spatial regression discontinuity estimates). The effects are stronger for low-productivity firms and labor-intensive industries. Our results highlight significant economic costs of air pollution as it reduces international trade.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.006.abstract_zh: 本文利用中国企业-产品数据（2000-2007年）及热逆温作为工具变量，考察了空气污染对企业出口的影响及其作用机制。研究发现，PM2.5浓度每上升1%，出口额下降0.65%；样本期内PM2.5浓度上升28%，导致总出口减少18.30%。我们识别出两条污染影响出口的渠道：污染降低劳动生产率（PM2.5每上升1%，劳动生产率下降0.83%），并触发环境规制（基于空间断点回归估计，出口下降20%至25%）。对于低生产率企业和劳动密集型行业，影响更为显著。我们的研究结果凸显了空气污染通过减少国际贸易所带来的显著经济成本。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.006.title: Does pollution affect exports? Evidence from China
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.006.title_zh: 污染是否影响出口？来自中国的证据

10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.007.abstract: • In economics journals, the share of theoretical work declined between 2000 and 2024, while empirical research, especially in development, labor, and public economics, expanded and received substantially higher citation counts. • Network analysis of economics journals reveals persistent concentrations of scholarly influence. • In the economics discipline, a small set of elite U.S. universities occupies central positions in citation and co-authorship networks. • Despite changes in research topics and methods, the structure of scholarly knowledge production in economics remains hierarchical, suggesting that intellectual innovation occurs within a stable institutional core. This paper examines patterns in knowledge production within the top-five economics journals from 2000 to 2024. Drawing on the full set of published articles and associated bibliometric details, citations, co-authorship links, and institutional affiliations, I document notable shifts in the orientation of research. The share of theoretical work has declined, while empirical fields, particularly development, labor, and public economics, have expanded. Network analysis shows that although the substantive questions and analytical approaches in top-five journals are changing, a small group of U.S. universities continues to account for a disproportionate share of highly cited work and occupies central positions in citation networks, a core that at the same time facilitates communication and exchange across fields.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.007.abstract_zh: 在2000年至2024年间，经济学期刊中理论研究的比重有所下降，而实证研究，尤其是发展经济学、劳动经济学和公共经济学领域，则不断扩展并获得了显著更高的引用次数。对经济学期刊的网络分析揭示了学术影响力的持续集中现象。在经济学学科内，少数美国精英大学在引用和合著网络中占据核心位置。尽管研究主题和方法发生了变化，学术知识生产的结构在经济学中仍保持层级性，这表明知识创新发生在一个稳定的制度核心之内。本文考察了2000年至2024年间五大顶级经济学期刊中的知识生产模式。基于全部已发表文章及其相关的文献计量信息、引用、合著关系和机构归属，我记录了研究方向上的显著转变。理论工作的比例有所下降，而实证领域，特别是发展经济学、劳动经济学和公共经济学，则有所扩张。网络分析显示，尽管五大顶级期刊的实质性问题和分析方法正在变化，少数美国大学群体继续占据高被引工作的不成比例份额，并在引用网络中处于中心位置，这一核心同时促进了跨领域的交流与交换。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.007.title: Network analysis of “top-five” economics journals
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.007.title_zh: 五大”经济学期刊的网络分析

10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.008.abstract: • Immigrant settlements in the State of São Paulo led to long-term improvements in public goods provision and property rights. • Brazilian municipalities near historical settlements exhibit stronger legal formalization. • In Brazil, historical settlements increased notarial activity and fiscal capacity. • Brazil's state-led immigration policy shaped regional economic and institutional development. During Brazil’s Age of Mass Migration (1880s-1930s), the state sponsored immigrant settlements in São Paulo. Using a new dataset that combines historical and modern administrative records, this paper explores the institutional impact of these settlements. Municipalities closer to them now enjoy better public goods provision and more well-defined property rights, as reflected in structured contractual arrangements, fewer land invasions, and increased investments in high-stakes agricultural practices. Intermediate data show that settlement municipalities recorded higher notarial activity, more frequent legal transactions, and greater land tax revenues in the years following settlement. These changes supported improvements in local governance, legal certainty, and public investment. Overall, the findings highlight how state-led settlement shaped regional economic and institutional development, showing that the implementation of immigration policy had lasting effects on local growth trajectories.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.008.abstract_zh: • 圣保罗州的移民定居点促进了公共物品供给和财产权的长期改善。• 靠近历史定居点的巴西城市表现出更强的法律正规化。• 在巴西，历史定居点增加了公证活动和财政能力。• 巴西国家主导的移民政策塑造了区域经济和制度发展。在巴西大规模移民时期（1880年代至1930年代），国家在圣保罗赞助了移民定居点。利用结合历史与现代行政记录的新数据集，本文探讨了这些定居点的制度影响。靠近这些定居点的城市如今享有更好的公共物品供给和更明确的财产权，这体现在结构化的契约安排、较少的土地侵占以及对高风险农业实践投资的增加上。中间数据显示，定居点所在城市在定居后的几年中记录了更高的公证活动、更频繁的法律交易以及更大的土地税收收入。这些变化促进了地方治理、法律确定性和公共投资的改善。总体而言，研究结果突显了国家主导的定居如何塑造了区域经济和制度发展，表明移民政策的实施对地方增长轨迹产生了持久影响。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.008.title: Settling prosperity: Historical immigration and its long-term institutional legacies
10.1016/j.jce.2026.02.008.title_zh: 定居繁荣：历史移民及其长期制度遗产

10.1016/j.jce.2026.03.004.abstract: We investigate the willingness of politicians in the German Bundestag to interact with voters, drawing on data capturing direct interchanges between citizens and their elected representatives to measure their responsiveness. In a setting without term limits, we examine whether electoral incentives influence politicians’ engagement with citizens. Our theoretical model predicts, and empirical results confirm, that politicians who are not seeking reelection become less responsive to voters, especially as election day approaches. This decline is attributed to a behavioral response resulting from a decrease in intra-party standing, rather than to a change in motivation or personal ideological convictions. Politicians retiring due to age or health reasons maintain consistent levels of interaction with voters, in contrast to those leaving due to pressure within their party or due to career changes, who exhibit decreased engagement with voters. Our findings offer novel insights into the role of incentives and constraints for political behavior in countries without mandatory term limits.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.03.004.abstract_zh: 我们研究了德国联邦议院议员与选民互动的意愿，利用记录公民与其当选代表直接交流的数据来衡量其回应性。在无任期限制的背景下，我们考察选举激励是否影响政治家与公民的互动。我们的理论模型预测，且实证结果证实，不寻求连任的政治家对选民的回应性降低，尤其是在选举日临近时。这一下降归因于党内地位下降导致的行为反应，而非动机或个人意识形态信念的变化。因年龄或健康原因退休的政治家与选民的互动水平保持稳定，相比之下，因党内压力或职业变动而离任的政治家则表现出与选民互动减少。我们的发现为无强制任期限制国家中政治行为的激励与约束作用提供了新颖见解。

10.1016/j.jce.2026.05.004.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between geopolitical distance and foreign investments over time, countries, and sectors. The analysis uses comprehensive data on foreign direct investments covering greenfield projects, mergers and acquisitions, and stocks of affiliates, as well as data on four alternative measures of geopolitical distance between countries. Our gravity estimations suggest that, first, geopolitical distance has a negative effect on foreign investments and the magnitude has heightened in the post-pandemic period compared to a decade ago, in line with friendshoring forces being at play. Second, it is primarily the companies from advanced Western economies whose foreign investment decisions are increasingly shaped by friendshoring forces. Finally, the paper shows that friendshoring is not only confined to strategic industries, implying that it may not solely reflect national security or resilience considerations.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.05.004.abstract_zh: 本文考察了地缘政治距离与外国投资在不同时间、国家和部门之间的关系。分析采用了涵盖绿地项目、并购及附属公司股票的外国直接投资综合数据，以及国家间四种替代性地缘政治距离衡量指标的数据。我们的引力模型估计表明：首先，地缘政治距离对外国投资有负面影响，且其影响程度在疫情后时期相较于十年前有所加剧，这与友岸外包力量的作用相符。其次，主要是来自西方发达经济体的公司，其对外投资决策日益受到友岸外包力量的影响。最后，本文显示友岸外包不仅局限于战略行业，这意味着它可能不仅仅反映国家安全或韧性考量。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.05.004.title: Geopolitical fragmentation and friendshoring evidence from project-level foreign investments data
10.1016/j.jce.2026.05.004.title_zh: 地缘政治碎片化与友岸外包：基于项目层面外国投资数据的证据

10.1016/j.jce.2026.05.005.abstract: This study examines how political uncertainty affects high-skill labor demand among US public firms. Using close gubernatorial elections as an exogenous shock and job postings data, I find that firms increase skilled hiring, mainly through higher R&D investments. Firms shift labor demand to nearby states with stable policies, creating spillover effects. In counties outside uncertain states, higher exposure to treated firms leads to modest job gains for college-educated workers and a slight unemployment decline, with no wage impact. These findings highlight firms as key channels for transmitting political uncertainty across labor markets.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.05.005.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨政治不确定性如何影响美国上市公司对高技能劳动力的需求。利用州长选举竞争激烈作为外生冲击及职位发布数据，我发现企业增加技能型招聘，主要通过提高研发投资实现。企业将劳动力需求转移至政策稳定的邻近州，产生溢出效应。在非不确定州的县中，对受处理企业的高暴露度导致大学教育程度工人就业小幅增长及失业率轻微下降，且对工资无影响。这些发现凸显了企业作为政治不确定性在劳动力市场间传导的关键渠道。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.05.005.title: The effects of political uncertainty on the demand for high-skill workers
10.1016/j.jce.2026.05.005.title_zh: 政治不确定性对高技能工人需求的影响

10.1016/j.jce.2026.05.006.abstract: This introduction presents the rationale for the special issue “Institutions in flux: The dynamics of formal and informal rules”. It argues that while institutions are central to economic, political and social outcomes, institutional analysis must also explain how rules and norms change, why reforms succeed or fail, and how formal and informal institutions interact. The seven papers in the issue study institutional change across different settings, methods and mechanisms, including reform sequencing, civil society, public-goods provision, censorship, globalization and uncertainty. Together, they show that institutional change is shaped by credibility, coalitions, enforcement, information, culture and power. The special issue therefore contributes to a dynamic understanding of institutions, emphasizing not only their consequences but also their origins, adaptation and unintended effects.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.05.006.abstract_zh: 本导言阐述了特刊“制度变迁：正式与非正式规则的动态”的设立理由。它指出，尽管制度对经济、政治和社会结果至关重要，制度分析还必须解释规则与规范如何变化、改革为何成功或失败，以及正式与非正式制度如何相互作用。本特刊中的七篇论文研究了不同背景、方法和机制下的制度变迁，包括改革顺序、公民社会、公共品供给、审查制度、全球化和不确定性。它们共同表明，制度变迁受到可信度、联盟、执行、信息、文化和权力的塑造。因此，本特刊有助于对制度的动态理解，不仅强调其后果，还强调其起源、适应及非预期效应。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.05.006.title: Introduction to the special issue on “Institutions in flux: The dynamics of formal and informal rules”
10.1016/j.jce.2026.05.006.title_zh: 特刊导言：“变动中的制度：正式与非正式规则的动态

10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.001.abstract: This paper examines the impact of two massive and unexpected inflows of Ukrainian migrants on voting behavior in Poland. In particular, we examine the effects of a conflict-induced labor migration shock and a refugee shock resulting from Russia’s aggression against Ukraine in 2014 and 2022, respectively. Using an instrumental variable approach, we find that greater exposure to labor migrants reduces support for conservative parties in the short run and subsequently shifts voter preferences toward pro-redistribution parties. Exposure to labor migrants as well as to refugees leads to a decrease in far-right voting. This effect emerges only after the salience of Ukrainian migrants increases due to the escalation of Russia’s aggression and the rise of anti-Ukrainian rhetoric from the Polish far-right. The backlash from Polish voters against far-right rhetoric is ten times stronger in areas with stronger exposure to refugees than in areas with greater exposure to labor migrants. Our results are robust to the use of a number of instruments and several sensitivity checks.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.001.abstract_zh: 本文考察了两次大规模且出人意料的乌克兰移民流入对波兰投票行为的影响。具体而言，我们分别研究了2014年因冲突引发的劳动力迁移冲击和2022年因俄罗斯侵略乌克兰导致的难民冲击所产生的影响。采用工具变量方法，我们发现，短期内对劳动力移民的更大暴露会降低对保守党的支持，并随后将选民偏好转向支持再分配的政党。对劳动力移民及难民的暴露均导致极右翼投票减少。这一效应仅在乌克兰移民的显著性因俄罗斯侵略升级及波兰极右翼反乌克兰言论抬头而增强后才显现。波兰选民对极右翼言论的反弹在难民暴露更强的地区比劳动力移民暴露更大的地区强十倍。我们的结果在使用多种工具变量及多项敏感性检验后依然稳健。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.001.title: Migration shocks and voting: Evidence from Ukrainian migration to Poland
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.001.title_zh: 移民冲击与投票：来自乌克兰移民至波兰的证据

10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.003.abstract: We present global microeconometric evidence on the impact of climate advocacy on hydrocarbon production. We construct two panel data sets by first linking climate activist campaigns to several thousand oil fields, which together account for 72% of global production. Second, we use textual analysis of over 140 million words from 1832 annual reports to compute a measure of activism-induced uncertainty for the corporations that control these oil fields. We find robust evidence that climate activism directly reduced not only oil field productivity but also increased company-level uncertainty. By utilising the ownership links between corporations and their oil fields, we also uncover an indirect mechanism in which the initial activism-induced company uncertainty leads to further productivity losses at the field level. Our findings demonstrate the presence of two pathways through which climate advocacy impacts hydrocarbon extraction.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.003.abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于气候倡导对碳氢化合物生产影响的全球微观计量经济学证据。我们首先将气候活动家的运动与数千个油田联系起来，这些油田合计占全球产量的72%，据此构建了两个面板数据集。其次，我们通过对1832份年度报告中超过1.4亿词进行文本分析，计算了控制这些油田的企业所面临的活动引发的确定性指标。我们发现强有力的证据表明，气候倡导不仅直接降低了油田生产率，还增加了企业层面的不确定性。通过利用企业与其油田之间的所有权联系，我们还揭示了一种间接机制，即最初由活动引发的企业不确定性导致油田层面的进一步生产率损失。我们的研究结果表明，气候倡导通过两条途径影响碳氢化合物的开采。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.003.title: Effects of climate activism on firm productivity and uncertainty: Evidence from global oil extraction
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.003.title_zh: 气候行动主义对企业生产率和不确定性的影响：来自全球石油开采的证据

10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.004.abstract: This paper examines the mental health consequences of China’s export slowdown from 2010 to 2016. Using nationally representative individual-level panel data and a shift-share instrument for city-level export exposure, we find that export slowdown significantly increased psychological distress. The effects are most pronounced in export-reliant regions and among middle-aged, less-educated individuals, production and manufacturing workers, and married women. We further show that export slowdowns operate through both level and distributional channels: they deteriorate labor market conditions and widen income inequality. At the household level, export slowdowns increase reliance on short-term borrowing, amplifying forward-looking financial stress, particularly for families with young children. Institutional and technological forces shape these impacts: stronger local social safety nets mitigate mental distress among vulnerable groups, while accelerated workplace automation exacerbates stress for employed workers. A one-standard-deviation decline in export exposure is associated with 44,686 disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) and mental health-related costs equivalent to 0.34% of China’s GDP in 2013. These findings reveal the uneven psychological costs of adverse trade shocks and highlight the importance of distribution-sensitive trade adjustment policies.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.004.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2010至2016年间中国出口放缓对心理健康的影响。利用具有全国代表性的个体层面面板数据及针对城市出口暴露度的转移份额工具变量，我们发现出口放缓显著加剧了心理困扰。这一效应在依赖出口的地区以及中年、受教育程度较低个体、生产与制造业工人及已婚女性中最为突出。我们进一步表明，出口放缓通过水平与分配双重渠道发挥作用：既恶化了劳动力市场状况，又扩大了收入不平等。在家庭层面，出口放缓增加了对短期借贷的依赖，加剧了前瞻性财务压力，尤其对育有幼儿的家庭影响显著。制度与技术力量塑造了这些影响：更强大的地方社会安全网缓解了弱势群体的心理困扰，而工作场所自动化的加速则加剧了在职员工的心理压力。出口暴露度每下降一个标准差，与2013年中国44，686个伤残调整生命年及相当于GDP 0.34%的心理健康相关成本相关联。这些发现揭示了不利贸易冲击带来的不均衡心理成本，并强调了注重分配效应的贸易调整政策的重要性。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.004.title: When exports decelerate: The mental health consequences of China’s export slowdown
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.004.title_zh: 当出口减速：中国出口放缓的心理健康后果

10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.005.abstract: This paper investigates the effect of a major judicial reform—the establishment of interprovincial circuit tribunals (ICTs)—on politically biased court outcomes. Using a unique data set of commercial civil cases involving listed firms in China and based on a difference-in-differences approach, we find that the ICTs effectively curb political favoritism in the judiciary, as evidenced by a significant decline in the win-rate disparity between politically connected and unconnected firms following the reform. The effects are more pronounced for firms connected to higher-ranking officials, those facing higher travel costs to appeal for retrial pre-reform, cases involving larger monetary stakes, and regions characterized by weaker legal environments. Moreover, the mechanism analysis suggests that the reform reshapes local courts’ incentives to yield to political interference through career concerns and the special petition mechanism. Finally, further analysis indicates that this judicial reform improves the quality of court decisions, enhances judicial accessibility, and mitigates local protectionism. Overall, the ICTs have significantly deterred political interference in court proceedings and contributed to a more impartial judicial environment in China.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.005.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了一项重大司法改革——设立跨省巡回法庭（ICTs）——对政治偏颇的法院裁决结果的影响。利用涉及中国上市公司的商业民事案件独特数据集，并基于双重差分法，我们发现巡回法庭有效遏制了司法体系中的政治偏袒，这体现在改革后政治关联企业与非关联企业之间胜诉率差距显著缩小。这一效应在涉及更高级别官员关联的企业、改革前上诉再审旅行成本较高的企业、涉案金额较大的案件以及法治环境较弱的地区中更为显著。此外，机制分析表明，该改革通过职业顾虑和特殊信访机制重塑了地方法院屈服于政治干预的动机。最后，进一步分析显示，此项司法改革提升了法院裁决质量，增强了司法可及性，并缓解了地方保护主义。总体而言，巡回法庭显著遏制了法院程序中的政治干预，为中国更加公正的司法环境做出了贡献。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.005.title: Loosen the ties that bind: interprovincial circuit tribunals, political interference, and judicial independence
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.005.title_zh: 松绑束缚：跨省巡回法庭、政治干预与司法独立

10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.006.abstract: After the collapse of Soviet-style planned economies, the liberalization of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) was considered critical for fostering technology adoption and achieving economic development. On the political side, the naïve expectation was that workers would welcome FDI, whereas the current industrial elite would oppose it. In reality, however, workers and managers often formed a powerful bloc against liberalization. This paper develops a formal model to explain why managers and labor unions may form political coalitions during periods of reform and how information asymmetry between managers and workers influences their policy choices. Since managers possess more information about economic conditions, they can sometimes persuade workers to perceive the managers’ preferred policy as the best option for workers’ welfare. If workers believe that managers’ interests are somewhat aligned with theirs and that managers possess a moderate informational advantage, managers can persuade workers that protectionist policies are in their best interest. In contrast, a misalignment of interests or an excessively large informational disparity might lead to excessive liberalization. The logic of this model can help inform policy debates on how domestic politics affect FDI policies.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.006.abstract_zh: 在苏联式计划经济体制崩溃之后，外国直接投资（FDI）的自由化被视为促进技术采纳和实现经济发展的关键。在政治层面，人们曾天真地预期工人会欢迎FDI，而现有的工业精英则会反对。然而，现实中，工人与管理者往往结成强大的联盟反对自由化。本文构建了一个正式模型，用以解释为何在改革时期管理者和工会可能形成政治联盟，以及管理者与工人之间的信息不对称如何影响他们的政策选择。由于管理者掌握更多关于经济状况的信息，他们有时能说服工人相信管理者偏好的政策是对工人福利最有利的选择。如果工人认为管理者的利益与自身利益存在一定的一致性，且管理者拥有适度的信息优势，那么管理者便能说服工人相信保护主义政策符合他们的最佳利益。相反，利益不一致或信息差距过大则可能导致过度自由化。该模型的逻辑有助于为国内政治如何影响FDI政策的政策辩论提供参考。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.006.title: Information asymmetry and cross-class coalitions in economic liberalization: Theory and evidence from post-communist transition
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.006.title_zh: 经济自由化中的信息不对称与跨阶级联盟：来自后共产主义转型的理论与证据

10.1016/j.jce.2026.08.003.title: Announcing new JCE editors and new journal subtitle, journal of comparative economics: Political economy
10.1016/j.jce.2026.08.003.title_zh: 《比较经济学杂志》新任编辑及新副标题公告：政治经济学

10.1016/j.jce.2026.08.004.abstract: A large portion of the developing world has pursued big-push industrialization to promote growth over the past century. This paper utilizes a quasi-experimental design to investigate the long-term impact of such programs. From 1950 to 1959, the Soviet Union sent thousands of experts, engineers, and machinery to China to aid with the first Five-Year Plan of national development and to help establish a network of state-owned industrial plants across China. This massive program was brought to an abrupt standstill following the Sino-Soviet split in the early 1960s. This paper takes the unforeseen termination of the Soviet projects as an exogenous shock and investigates its impact on local economic development in the long run. Counties with more Soviet projects completed by the 1960s are shown to have larger state sectors today and, surprisingly, also enjoy better developmental outcomes overall and in the private sector in particular. Five mechanisms are examined as potential causes. I find no evidence of innovation spillover or differential infrastructure, but strong support for human capital externality and agglomeration through production networks. Resource allocation also continues to favor these localities: even private businesses in counties with more Soviet projects enjoy better access to the financial market.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.08.004.abstract_zh: 过去一个世纪里，发展中世界的很大一部分地区推行了大推进工业化以促进增长。本文利用准实验设计来考察此类项目的长期影响。1950年至1959年间，苏联派遣了数千名专家、工程师并输送机械设备至中国，协助实施第一个五年国家发展计划，并帮助在中国各地建立国有工业工厂网络。然而，这一大规模项目在20世纪60年代初因中苏分裂而骤然中断。本文将苏联项目的意外终止视为外生冲击，考察其对地方经济的长期影响。研究发现，截至20世纪60年代完成更多苏联项目的县，如今国有部门规模更大，且令人意外的是，这些地区整体发展成果更佳，尤其是私营部门表现更为突出。本文考察了五种可能的机制，未发现创新溢出或基础设施差异的证据，但人力资本外部性和通过生产网络形成的集聚效应得到了有力支持。资源配置也持续偏向这些地区：即便在苏联项目较多的县，私营企业也能获得更好的金融市场准入机会。
10.1016/j.jce.2026.08.004.title: Legacy of Soviet-aided industrialization in China: A quasi-experiment
10.1016/j.jce.2026.08.004.title_zh: 苏联援华工业化的遗产：一项准实验研究

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103038.abstract: China's Communist revolution in the early 20th century left a prosocial cultural heritage in its historical revolutionary bases, consistent with the framework of group-level selection in cultural evolution. We document a robust positive association between local communist revolutionary heritage and corporate donations. This prosocial inclination is distinct from other historical influences, such as Confucian traditions or histories of peasant revolts, though it attenuates with local marketization. We employ propensity score matching, a neighboring-county test, a boundary-based spatial comparison, and an instrumental variable analysis to buttress a causal inference from the prosocial revolutionary heritage to corporate donations. Stakeholder demand and manager intrinsic preference emerge as parallel, mutually reinforcing channels underlining this relationship. Further analyses rule out alternative explanations, such as “grabbing hand” behavior, strategic motives, or political incentives. Collectively, these findings reveal a cultural imprint of Communist revolution history on corporate prosociality in contemporary China.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103038.abstract_zh: 20世纪初的中国共产主义革命在其历史革命根据地留下了亲社会文化遗产，这与文化进化中的群体选择框架相吻合。我们记录了地方共产主义革命遗产与企业捐赠之间稳健的正相关关系。这种亲社会倾向不同于其他历史影响，如儒家传统或农民起义历史，尽管它随地方市场化程度而减弱。我们采用倾向得分匹配、邻近县检验、基于边界的空间比较以及工具变量分析，以支持从亲社会革命遗产到企业捐赠的因果推断。利益相关者需求与管理者内在偏好作为平行且相互强化的渠道，凸显了这一关系。进一步分析排除了“掠夺之手”行为、战略动机或政治激励等替代解释。总体而言，这些发现揭示了共产主义革命历史对当代中国企业亲社会行为的文化印记。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103038.title: Prosocial cultural heritage and corporate philanthropy
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103038.title_zh: 亲社会文化遗产与企业慈善行为

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103041.abstract: We study companies' decisions about holding annual shareholder meetings online during the Covid pandemic and returning to traditional in-person meetings post-pandemic. Among S&P 1500 companies, the frequency of virtual meetings shot up from less than 10% to more than 80% in the first year of the pandemic, with only gradual reversion to in-person meetings since then. In-person meetings are more likely for companies that have Republican majority boards and Republican CEOs, and for companies with headquarters located in jurisdictions that vote Republican. We find little evidence that Republican-led firms have unusually adverse experiences with virtual meetings, and we therefore conclude that their preference for in-person annual meetings aligns with conservative political opposition to other Covid-era regulations that restricted public gatherings and personal contact.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103041.abstract_zh: 我们研究了新冠疫情期间公司决定在线举行年度股东大会，以及疫情后回归传统线下会议的现象。在标普1500指数公司中，虚拟会议的频率在疫情第一年从不足10%飙升至超过80%，此后仅逐步回归线下会议。线下会议更可能出现在董事会中共和党占多数、首席执行官为共和党人，以及总部位于投票支持共和党地区的公司。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明共和党领导的公司因虚拟会议而遭遇异常不利的经历，因此我们得出结论，他们偏好线下年度会议与保守派政治立场反对其他疫情期间限制公众集会和人际接触的规定相一致。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103041.title: Republican boards' and CEOs' preferences for in-person AGMs
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103041.title_zh: 共和党董事会与CEO对线下股东大会的偏好

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103042.abstract: Long-standing tensions exist for firms in developing economies between fulfilling social responsibility mandates and securing sustainable growth. This study leverages China's Targeted Poverty Alleviation (TPA) initiative to demonstrate that corporate participation in poverty reduction serves as a strategic and sustainable investment, simultaneously advancing societal development and providing financing support. Specifically, we find that TPA participation significantly reduces firms' financing costs, an effect that is amplified by greater TPA investment intensity and assistance difficulty. Particularly for firms with limited political connections, TPA financing benefits are boosted through social responsibility credit substituting for traditional political capital. Moreover, balanced equity configurations significantly intensify these cost-reduction effects. Mechanistically, by responding to state-led institutional pressures, firms secure political resources such as fiscal subsidies and tax relief that further ease financing burdens. Meanwhile, TPA reduces information asymmetries and elevates corporate social governance ratings, thereby enhancing creditworthiness and access to credit from banks and suppliers. Motivation analyses confirm that TPA engagement stems from a strategic objective rather than an attempt to conceal corporate misconduct. Overall, our findings illuminate a transformative pathway for emerging markets: converting national institutional pressures into strategic leverage allows firms to achieve both societal objectives and long-term financial resilience.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103042.abstract_zh: 发展中经济体的企业在履行社会责任与确保可持续增长之间长期存在张力。本研究利用中国精准扶贫（TPA）倡议，证明企业参与减贫是一种战略性和可持续的投资，同时推动社会发展并提供融资支持。具体而言，我们发现TPA参与显著降低了企业的融资成本，且这一效应因更高的TPA投资强度和帮扶难度而增强。尤其对于政治关联有限的企业，TPA融资收益通过社会责任信用替代传统政治资本而得到提升。此外，均衡的股权配置显著强化了这些降成本效应。在机制上，通过响应国家主导的制度压力，企业获得财政补贴和税收减免等政治资源，进一步缓解融资负担。同时，TPA降低了信息不对称并提升了企业社会治理论评级，从而增强信用度及从银行和供应商获取信贷的渠道。动机分析证实，TPA参与源于战略目标而非掩盖企业不当行为的企图。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了新兴市场的一条转型路径：将国家制度压力转化为战略杠杆，使企业能够同时实现社会目标与长期财务韧性。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103042.title: Corporate social responsibility as sustainable financial strategy: Evidence from China's targeted poverty alleviation
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103042.title_zh: 企业社会责任作为可持续财务战略：来自中国精准扶贫的证据

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103044.abstract: Financial advice can attenuate underinvestment but is costly, biased, and skewed towards the wealthy. AI-powered co-advisors could help deliver more scalable and affordable advice. To understand how, our vignette-based survey experiment compares the portfolio recommendations made by professional human advisors with GenAI large language models (LLMs) under biased and unbiased prompts. We document human financial advice projection whereby human advisors strongly project their own portfolios onto their clients. AI financial advice projection is prompt and model family dependent: ChatGPT is the least biased, while strong Gemini-Biased projection collapses when removing advisor demographics. LLMs are systematically more conservative than professional human advisors, recommending portfolios with lower Sharpe ratios that deliver up to 18% lower 20-year terminal wealth. However, human advisory fees erode much of this excess gain, with a 20-year breakeven fee of 1.03% p.a. Our results have direct implications for financial regulators, the advice profession, and LLM developers seeking to deploy AI-generated financial advice.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103044.abstract_zh: 财务咨询能够缓解投资不足问题，但成本高昂、存在偏见，且偏向于富裕阶层。人工智能驱动的联合顾问可能有助于提供更具扩展性和可负担性的咨询服务。为理解这一点，我们基于情境设计的调查实验，在带有偏见和无偏见的提示下，比较了专业人类顾问与生成式人工智能大语言模型（LLMs）的投资组合建议。我们记录了人类财务咨询中的投射现象，即人类顾问强烈地将自己的投资组合偏好投射到客户身上。人工智能财务咨询的投射性则取决于提示词和模型家族：ChatGPT偏见最小，而Gemini在移除顾问人口统计信息后，其强烈的偏见性投射现象消失。LLMs系统性地比专业人类顾问更为保守，推荐的投资组合具有较低的夏普比率，导致20年期末财富最多降低18%。然而，人类咨询费用侵蚀了大部分超额收益，20年盈亏平衡费用为每年1.03%。我们的研究结果对金融监管机构、咨询行业以及寻求部署人工智能生成财务建议的LLM开发者具有直接启示。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103044.title: Financial advice behaviour: humans versus AI
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103044.title_zh: 金融咨询行为：人类与人工智能的比较

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103045.abstract: What is the impact of a prior banking relationship on a borrower’s incentives to avoid default? To answer this question, we exploit a unique institutional setting and data on 149,230 mortgage loans tracked for twenty four months. We find that the presence of a relationship diminishes borrower’s default risk by approximately 4%, attributable exclusively to the value of the relationship for the borrower. This effect persists during the notable surge in loan defaults during COVID-19 and is even more pronounced for borrowers affected by a natural disaster, as well as among wealthier and married male borrowers.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103045.abstract_zh: 既有银行关系对借款人避免违约的激励有何影响？为解答此问题，我们利用独特的制度环境及追踪二十四个月的149,230笔抵押贷款数据。研究发现，关系的存在使借款人的违约风险降低约4%，这一效应完全归因于关系对借款人的价值。该效应在COVID-19期间贷款违约显著激增时依然持续，并且对于受自然灾害影响的借款人，以及较富裕和已婚男性借款人中更为显著。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103045.title: Relationship banking: The borrower’s incentives channel
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103045.title_zh: 关系型银行：借款人的激励渠道

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103056.abstract: We examine non-underwritten placements of seasoned equity made by publicly traded firms and contrast non-intermediated and intermediated deals. We posit that agent-assisted, intermediated placements indicate relative weakness, whereas healthier firms place their equity directly with investors. Indeed, the market reaction to announcements of non-intermediated (intermediated) placements of equity is significantly positive (negative). Our findings are robust to selection and simultaneity checks. On average, non-intermediated offerings are placed at a premium and exhibit significantly better long-run stock performance. We also examine the role of the information environment provided by analysts and the coverage by agent-affiliated analysts in private placements.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103056.abstract_zh: 我们研究了上市公司进行的非承销定向增发，并对比了非中介化与中介化交易。我们假设，由代理人协助的中介化定向增发表明企业相对弱势，而更健康的企业则直接向投资者配售股票。确实，市场对非中介化（中介化）股权配售公告的反应显著为正（负）。我们的发现在选择性和同时性检验中依然稳健。平均而言，非中介化发行以溢价配售，并展现出显著更优的长期股票表现。我们还考察了分析师提供的信息环境以及代理人关联分析师在私募配售中的覆盖作用。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103056.title: Non-underwritten placements of equity

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103057.abstract: Horizontal directors, board members who also hold board seats in same-industry peers, are common in U.S. corporations. We posit that horizontal directorships can enhance the efficiency of corporate investment decisions. Horizontal directors enjoy access to current information flows, which help boards fulfill their roles of advising and monitoring – a form of learning from peers. We find that horizontal directorships are negatively related to investment inefficiency, and with over-investment in particular. Exogenous shocks to board composition provide a causal interpretation to our findings. Our paper contributes to a nuanced view of horizontal directors by highlighting their contribution to mitigate excessive investment.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103057.abstract_zh: 横向董事，即同时在同行业其他公司担任董事的董事会成员，在美国企业中普遍存在。我们假设横向董事职位能够提升企业投资决策的效率。横向董事能够获取当前的信息流，这有助于董事会履行其咨询与监督职能——这是一种向同行学习的形式。我们发现横向董事职位与投资无效率呈负相关，尤其是与过度投资的关系更为显著。董事会构成的外生冲击为我们的发现提供了因果解释。本文通过强调横向董事在缓解过度投资方面的贡献，为理解横向董事的作用提供了细致视角。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103057.title: Horizontal directors and investment efficiency

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103058.abstract: Fund managers cast votes that are more critical of firm environmental and social (ES) practices when the firm has operations located close to fund headquarters. This elevated support for shareholder ES proposals is not mirrored in governance proposals, which likely have less impact on the local community. We find similar pro-ES fund voting practices at firms with operations near the fund manager’s college and prior employment locations and in utility companies that provide electric and gas service to the fund’s address. Manager and sub-advisor turnover events provide additional evidence: tracking the same decision-maker’s votes at a fixed set of firms before and after the move, we find that support for ES proposals increases significantly once the manager gains proximity to those firms. The proximity effect is concentrated at high-polluting plants, consistent with managers responding to personal exposure to environmental harm. We conclude that fund managers exhibit a personal bias in ES voting, being more likely to support ES proposals that impact them personally.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103058.abstract_zh: 当企业运营地点邻近基金总部时，基金经理投出的票更倾向于对企业环境与社会（ES）实践持批评态度。这种对股东ES提案支持度的提升并未在治理提案中体现，后者对当地社区的影响可能较小。我们发现，在企业运营地点靠近基金经理的大学及先前工作地点，以及向基金地址提供电力和燃气服务的公用事业公司中，也存在类似的亲ES基金投票行为。经理及副顾问更替事件提供了额外证据：追踪同一决策者在固定企业集合中迁移前后的投票情况，我们发现一旦经理获得与这些企业的邻近性，对ES提案的支持度显著增加。邻近效应集中在高污染工厂，这与经理因个人接触环境损害而作出反应相符。我们得出结论，基金经理在ES投票中表现出个人偏见，更倾向于支持那些对其个人有影响的ES提案。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103058.title: Not in my backyard: Personal bias in mutual fund voting on environmental and social proposals
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103058.title_zh: 不要在我家后院：共同基金对环境与社会提案投票中的个人偏见

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103059.abstract: We examine the effects of time-limited disclosure relief under the Jumpstart Our Business Startups (JOBS) Act of 2012. The Act grants newly public firms up to five years of exemptions, and our results suggest that the fixed duration of this relief, as much as its availability, shapes post-IPO behavior. Using an intention-to-treat design, we compare treated firms with smaller reporting companies whose exemptions are similar but carry no fixed expiry date. Equity issuance by treated firms increases significantly as the deadline nears while debt issuance declines, and cash reserves accumulate over the period. Capital expenditure increases relative to controls in the early post-IPO years, while R&D shows no differential response. As expiry approaches, the differential with the control group in internal investment weakens but cash-financed acquisitions accelerate. This shift in investment composition coincides with deteriorating operating performance and declining market valuations relative to IPO levels. Our post-expiry analysis reveals an abrupt reversal in acquisition activity upon transition to full disclosure while internal investment remains unchanged, supporting the argument that pre-expiry behavior was driven by the regulatory timeline rather than natural firm maturation. We conclude that the duration of regulatory relief is as important as its scope in shaping corporate behavior, and that time-limited exemptions from mandatory disclosure can induce anticipatory firm responses that work against the policy's intended objectives.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103059.abstract_zh: 我们研究了2012年《创业企业扶助法案》（JOBS法案）下限期信息披露豁免的影响。该法案赋予新上市公司最长五年的豁免期，我们的结果表明，这一救济的固定期限与其可用性同样重要，共同塑造了上市后的企业行为。采用意向性治疗设计，我们将受处理公司与作为对照的小型报告公司进行比较，后者的豁免条件相似但无固定到期日。随着截止日期临近，受处理公司的股权发行显著增加，而债务发行减少，现金储备在此期间累积。在上市后初期，资本支出相对于对照组有所增加，而研发支出未表现出差异化反应。随着豁免期临近结束，与对照组相比，内部投资的差异减弱，但现金收购活动加速。这种投资构成的转变与经营业绩恶化和相对于IPO水平的市场估值下降同时发生。我们的豁免期后分析显示，在过渡至全面披露后，收购活动出现急剧逆转，而内部投资保持不变，这支持了豁免期前行为由监管时间表驱动而非企业自然成熟所致的论点。我们得出结论，监管救济的期限在塑造企业行为方面与其范围同等重要，且强制性披露的限期豁免可能引发预期性企业反应，从而违背政策预期目标。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103059.title: How does relief from mandatory disclosure affect firm investment and growth?
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103059.title_zh: 强制性披露豁免如何影响企业投资与增长？

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103060.abstract: We present a large-sample analysis of growth equity (GE) investment using 1512 UK private companies over 2000–2021 and compare the post-investment performance of investee firms to matched companies that do not receive investment. Target companies are younger, smaller, more intangible-asset intensive and more rapidly growing than the general pool of UK private companies. We find that GE target companies differ significantly from venture capital and private equity buyout targets, while the transaction structure also differs. Post-investment, GE target firms dramatically outperform a matched sample of non-GE backed private companies with respect to sales and asset growth, employment, and earnings growth. Much of this extra expansion is financed by significantly faster growth in leverage than for non-GE backed firms.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103060.abstract_zh: 我们基于2000年至2021年间1512家英国私营企业的大样本数据，对成长型股权（GE）投资进行了分析，并将受资企业在投资后的表现与未获投资的匹配企业进行了比较。目标企业相较于英国私营企业整体群体，更为年轻、规模更小、无形资产密集度更高且增长更为迅速。我们发现，GE目标企业与风险投资和私募股权收购目标存在显著差异，同时交易结构亦有所不同。投资后，GE目标企业在销售与资产增长、就业及盈利增长方面，显著优于未获GE支持的匹配私营企业样本。这一额外扩张的大部分资金来源于杠杆增长速度显著快于非GE支持企业。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103060.title: Growth equity investment patterns and performance
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103060.title_zh: 成长型股权投资模式与绩效

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103061.abstract: This paper investigates how peer firms' Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)-related incidents influence the corporate investment efficiency of non-incident firms. Using a sample of U.S. firms from 2007 to 2021, we document a significant increase in investment-Tobin's Q sensitivity following negative peer events, thereby improving investment efficiency. We identify three non-mutually exclusive channels. First, the effect is stronger among firms with higher analyst coverage, greater stock trading volume, and closer product-market proximity to the incident firm, consistent with the notion of heightened external scrutiny. Second, peer incidents serve as informational shocks that enhance managerial learning from external signals, particularly when firms operate in competitive industries, face high product-market uncertainty, or have more informative stock prices. Furthermore, we find that the performance of focal firms deteriorates following peer incidents and that efficiency gains are greater among firms that were previously overinvesting. Taken together, these findings suggest that peer CSR scandals act as disciplining and learning events that improve investment behavior across the industry.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103061.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了同行企业的企业社会责任（CSR）相关事件如何影响非事件企业的投资效率。利用2007年至2021年美国企业样本，我们发现负面同行事件后，投资-托宾Q敏感度显著提升，从而改善了投资效率。我们识别出三个非互斥的传导渠道。首先，在分析师覆盖度更高、股票交易量更大以及与事件企业产品市场距离更近的企业中，该效应更为显著，这与外部监督加强的观点一致。其次，同行事件作为信息冲击，增强了管理层从外部信号中学习的能力，尤其是在竞争激烈行业、面临高产品市场不确定性或股价信息含量更高的企业中表现突出。此外，我们发现，同行事件后焦点企业绩效下滑，且效率提升在先前过度投资的企业中更为显著。综合来看，这些发现表明，同行企业社会责任丑闻起到了纪律约束和学习事件的作用，从而改善了整个行业的投资行为。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103061.title: When peers fail: Spillover effects of CSR incidents on real investment
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103061.title_zh: 当同行失败时：企业社会责任事件对实际投资的溢出效应

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103062.abstract: This study examines how passive institutional investors reshape corporate venture capital (CVC) investment decisions. We find that increases in passive institutional ownership lead firms to cut back CVC investments in non-core, high-risk, and low-quality ventures, with the reduction being more pronounced among firms subject to more severe managerial agency problems. Futhermore, the reduction of CVC investments leads to higher short-term announcement returns and improved long-term operating and innovation performance. The findings suggest that passive institutional investors mitigate managerial agency problems and improve innovation by disciplining CVC investment decisions.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103062.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了被动机构投资者如何重塑企业风险投资（CVC）决策。我们发现，被动机构持股比例的增加促使企业削减对非核心、高风险及低质量项目的CVC投资，且这一削减效应在面临更严重管理层代理问题的企业中更为显著。此外，CVC投资的减少带来了更高的短期公告回报，并改善了长期运营与创新绩效。研究结果表明，被动机构投资者通过约束CVC投资决策，缓解了管理层代理问题并促进了创新。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103062.title: Less is more: Institutional investors and corporate venture capital
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103062.title_zh: 少即是多：机构投资者与企业风险投资

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103063.abstract: We develop a real options model to examine the determinants of patent dispute outcomes between an incumbent firm and an allegedly infringing challenger. By analyzing their dynamic strategic interactions, we find that the gain-to-loss ratio, which reflects the degree of horizontal product differentiation, plays a crucial role in determining settlement feasibility, timing, and royalty terms. A lower gain-to-loss ratio, which indicates less differentiated products and more intense cannibalization, as well as higher market volatility, and a larger divergence in the firms’ financial incentives to continue litigation (ICL) reduce the likelihood of settlement. Our findings illustrate how product market differentiation, market uncertainty, and legal cost-allocation rules collectively determine whether firms accommodate entry through settlement or seek to preserve monopoly structures through litigation.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103063.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个实物期权模型，以考察在位企业与涉嫌侵权的挑战者之间专利争议结果的决定因素。通过分析其动态战略互动，我们发现损益比——反映横向产品差异化程度——在决定和解可行性、时机及许可条款方面起着关键作用。较低的损益比，表明产品差异化程度较小且替代效应更为激烈，加之更高的市场波动性，以及企业继续诉讼财务激励（ICL）差异的扩大，均会降低和解的可能性。我们的研究结果阐明了产品市场差异化、市场不确定性及法律成本分配规则如何共同决定企业是通过和解来适应进入，还是通过诉讼来寻求维持垄断结构。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103063.title: How do firms resolve patent disputes? Insights from competitive dynamics and market uncertainty
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103063.title_zh: 企业如何解决专利纠纷？来自竞争动态与市场不确定性的启示

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103064.abstract: This research examines the relationship between co-opted boards and firms' anti-takeover provisions (ATPs). Analyzing 5585 US firm-year observations for the period 2012–2022, we document a positive relationship between co-opted boards and ATPs. We further illustrate that the positive relationship is stronger in firms that exhibit subpar performance and compensate senior executives and directors more than the industry average. Furthermore, our research finds that good governance, board and executive gender diversity, gender equality, and board cultural diversity moderate the positive relationship between co-opted boards and ATPs. Our results remain robust across a battery of tests. The findings of this research have important implications for corporate boards and managers. The study contributes to the mainstream agency theory by demonstrating that co-opted boards exacerbate firms' agency problems by blocking the potential of external disciplinary mechanisms.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103064.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了共同选择董事会与公司反收购条款（ATPs）之间的关系。通过分析2012至2022年间5585个美国公司年度观测数据，我们发现共同选择董事会与ATPs之间存在正相关关系。进一步研究表明，在业绩不佳且高管及董事薪酬高于行业平均水平的公司中，这种正相关关系更为显著。此外，我们的研究发现，良好的治理结构、董事会及高管性别多样性、性别平等以及董事会文化多样性能够缓和共同选择董事会与ATPs之间的正相关关系。我们的结果在多项测试中保持稳健。本研究的发现对董事会及管理层具有重要启示意义。该研究通过证明共同选择董事会通过阻碍外部纪律机制的潜在作用而加剧公司代理问题，为主流代理理论做出了贡献。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103064.title: Co-opted boards and anti-takeover provisions in US firms: Do better financial outcomes and dynamic governance matter?
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103064.title_zh: 美国公司中的合作董事会与反收购条款：更好的财务结果和动态治理是否重要？

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103065.abstract: We investigate whether short sellers process a specific type of public information: heterogeneity in analysts’ individual EPS forecasts. We find that short-selling activity increases after earnings announcements when firms miss the key analyst forecast beyond missing the analyst consensus forecast. Moreover, higher short-selling activity following key analyst forecast misses predicts lower subsequent returns, consistent with profitable trading. A quasi-experimental design based on exogenous reductions in key analyst coverage further supports our interpretation. Overall, our results highlight a specific channel through which short sellers obtain an informational advantage and improve our understanding of the public signals they process.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103065.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了卖空者是否处理一种特定类型的公开信息：分析师个人每股收益预测的异质性。研究发现，当公司未达到关键分析师预测（而非仅未达到分析师共识预测）时，盈余公告后的卖空活动会增加。此外，关键分析师预测未达标后更高的卖空活动预示着后续较低的回报，这与盈利交易相符。基于关键分析师覆盖外生减少的准实验设计进一步支持了我们的解释。总体而言，我们的结果突显了卖空者获取信息优势的一个具体渠道，并增进了对其所处理公开信号的理解。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103065.title: Are short sellers lured by analyst consensus?
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103065.title_zh: 做空者会被分析师共识吸引吗？

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103066.abstract: Overconfident CEOs overestimate their ability to generate value. We investigate how this affects divestiture activity and whether it moderates a CEO's investment lifecycle. We hypothesize and find that overconfident CEOs are less likely to divest units and their divestment decisions are less sensitive to career lifecycle concerns. In addition, after a divestiture overconfident CEOs spend more on capital expenditures (Capex) and acquisitions than other CEOs. Overall, our results suggest that overconfident CEOs prefer to retain units and divest largely to maintain an investment trajectory. Our results further highlight the important role behavioral traits such as overconfidence play in corporate decision-making.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103066.abstract_zh: 过度自信的首席执行官高估了自己创造价值的能力。我们探讨了这种特质如何影响资产剥离活动，以及它是否调节了CEO的投资生命周期。我们假设并发现，过度自信的CEO不太可能剥离业务单元，且其剥离决策对职业生涯生命周期顾虑的敏感度较低。此外，在资产剥离后，过度自信的CEO在资本支出和收购上的花费高于其他CEO。总体而言，我们的结果表明，过度自信的CEO倾向于保留业务单元，并主要通过剥离来维持投资轨迹。我们的研究进一步强调了过度自信等行为特质在企业决策中的重要作用。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103066.title: Divestitures and CEO overconfidence

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103067.abstract: The Inevitable Disclosure Doctrine (“IDD”) protects trade secrets and intellectual property but restricts labor mobility by limiting a worker's ability to take jobs at competing firms. Prior literature presents evidence of a causal relationship between the adoption of the IDD and earnings manipulation, as executives have less of a need to demonstrate superior performance to attract and retain employees. At the same time, however, the IDD traps executives in their roles, increasing their personal incentive to manage earnings defensively. We present evidence that executive incentives mitigate the desire to reduce earnings management in firms with lower knowledge-worker turnover after adopting the IDD, suggesting a more nuanced understanding of the relation between labor market mobility and accounting disclosure than has previously been documented.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103067.abstract_zh: 不可避免披露原则（“IDD”）保护商业秘密和知识产权，但通过限制员工在竞争对手处任职的能力，制约了劳动力流动性。既有文献提供了IDD采纳与盈余操纵之间存在因果关系的证据，因为高管在吸引和留住员工方面不再需要展示卓越绩效。然而，与此同时，IDD将高管困于其职位之中，增强了他们防御性管理盈余的个人动机。我们提供的证据表明，在采纳IDD后知识型员工流动率较低的企业中，高管激励缓解了减少盈余管理的意愿，这表明劳动力市场流动性与会计披露之间的关系比以往文献所记载的更为微妙复杂。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103067.title: Conflicting incentives: How the inevitable disclosure doctrine disparately influences disclosure
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103067.title_zh: 冲突激励：不可避免披露原则如何差异化影响信息披露

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103068.abstract: We study the effect of skilled foreign labor on corporate investment using two natural experiments involving the H-1B visa program. First, we exploit the randomized lottery for allocating H-1B visas and show that firms with higher lottery success rates increase their post-lottery investments. The effect is stronger for firms hiring higher-wage workers in occupations that are not easily offshorable, consistent with a skilled labor access channel. Second, we exploit the uncertain timing of the H-1B application deadline and show that firms reduce their investments when their visa applications are rendered unexpectedly ineligible due to labor certification processing times.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103068.abstract_zh: 我们利用涉及H-1B签证计划的两个自然实验，研究了技术外国劳动力对企业投资的影响。首先，我们利用H-1B签证分配的随机抽签机制，并表明抽签成功率较高的企业在抽签后增加了投资。这一效应在雇佣高工资、且不易外包岗位的企业中更为显著，这与技术劳动力获取渠道的假设相符。其次，我们利用H-1B申请截止日期的不确定性，并表明当企业的签证申请因劳动认证处理时间而意外失去资格时，企业会减少投资。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103068.title: Skilled foreign labor supply and corporate investment: Evidence from H-1B lotteries and application deadlines
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103068.title_zh: 技术外国劳动力供给与企业投资：来自H-1B抽签和申请截止日期的证据

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103069.abstract: The agency literature generally argues that insider-dominated boards exacerbate agency conflicts and reduce shareholder value. However, other theories suggest that insider control may be efficient for certain firms. Using the staggered implementation of mandatory board independence requirements under the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and related exchange rules, I examine how shifts in board control from insiders to independent directors affect firm value. Among initially insider-dominated firms that remain publicly listed and transition to independent-majority boards, Tobin's Q increases by 7.8% on average. Cross-sectional analyses show that the valuation gains are concentrated among firms where compliance requires substantive changes in board composition and among firms with lower organizational complexity. However, the valuation benefits are significantly weaker when CEOs are highly entrenched. Additional evidence suggests that independent-majority boards may strengthen corporate oversight, as reflected in greater CEO turnover-performance sensitivity. Overall, the findings suggest that the effects of board independence regulations depend systematically on organizational characteristics and internal power structures.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103069.abstract_zh: 代理文献普遍认为，内部人主导的董事会会加剧代理冲突并降低股东价值。然而，其他理论则指出，对某些企业而言，内部人控制可能是有效率的。利用《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》及相关交易所规则下强制董事会独立性要求的逐步实施，我考察了董事会控制权从内部人向独立董事转移如何影响企业价值。在最初由内部人主导、随后保持公开上市并过渡至独立董事占多数的董事会中，托宾Q平均上升了7.8%。横截面分析显示，估值收益集中在那些合规要求实质性改变董事会构成的企业，以及组织复杂性较低的企业中。然而，当首席执行官高度固守其职位时，估值收益显著减弱。额外证据表明，独立董事占多数的董事会可能强化公司监督，这体现在首席执行官更替与业绩敏感性的增强上。总体而言，研究结果表明，董事会独立性监管的效果系统性地依赖于组织特征和内部权力结构。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103069.title: Mandated board independence and shareholder value: Evidence on the role of firm characteristics
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103069.title_zh: 强制董事会独立性与股东价值：基于公司特征作用的证据

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103070.abstract: Existing contingent convertible bonds (CoCos) have several drawbacks for investors and issuers. This paper introduces the CCCR, a hybrid security that improves upon CoCos by adding an automatic share repurchase mechanism, requiring the company to repurchase shares if its financial condition worsens after the conversion of contingent debt securities into equity. We develop a structural model based on Leland’s framework to analyze a firm’s optimal capital structure, which includes equity, CCCR, and a straight debt. The model endogenously determines the CCCR’s features, and we derive pricing formulas for the firm’s liabilities. To ensure applicability, we derive a condition and corresponding minimum conversion ratio ensuring a one-to-one mapping between equity value and firm asset value. Our analysis of credit spreads, asset substitution, and other key financial metrics shows that, compared to alternative financing options, capital structures incorporating CCCR offer significant advantages for investors while imposing minimal additional costs on issuing firms, establishing this new security as a rational and viable form of contingent capital.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103070.abstract_zh: 现有的或有可转换债券（CoCos）对投资者和发行方存在若干缺陷。本文介绍了一种混合证券——CCCR，它通过增加自动股份回购机制改进了CoCos，要求公司在或有债务证券转换为股权后，若财务状况恶化，则需回购股份。我们基于Leland框架构建了一个结构化模型，以分析企业的最优资本结构，该结构包括股权、CCCR和普通债务。模型内生地确定了CCCR的特征，并推导出企业负债的定价公式。为确保适用性，我们推导出一个条件及相应的最低转换比率，以保证股权价值与企业资产价值之间的一一对应关系。我们对信用利差、资产替代及其他关键财务指标的分析表明，与替代融资方案相比，包含CCCR的资本结构为投资者提供了显著优势，同时对发行企业施加的额外成本极小，从而确立了这一新证券作为合理且可行的或有资本形式。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103070.title: Contingent capital with contingent share repurchase clause
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103070.title_zh: 附条件股份回购条款的应急资本

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103071.abstract: We examine how enhanced reporting mandates influence insider trading in the presence of information asymmetry among corporate insiders. We develop an insider trading model in which headquarters executives (HQEXs) are less informed about divisional profitability than divisional managers (DMs) and release public reports subject to external auditing. Our model shows that, when insiders have incentives to report optimistically, enhanced reporting mandates can promote DMs' share purchases based on information not shared with HQEXs. We provide supporting evidence from difference-in-differences analyses using a regulatory shock to segment reporting obligations, namely the adoption of SFAS 131. Our study offers new insights for policymakers.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103071.abstract_zh: 我们考察了在企业内部人之间存在信息不对称的情况下，加强报告要求如何影响内幕交易。我们构建了一个内幕交易模型，其中总部高管（HQEXs）对部门盈利能力的了解程度低于部门经理（DMs），并且发布需经外部审计的公开报告。我们的模型表明，当内部人有动机进行乐观报告时，加强报告要求可以促进部门经理基于未与总部高管共享的信息进行股票购买。我们利用分部报告义务的监管冲击，即SFAS 131的采纳，通过双重差分分析提供了支持性证据。我们的研究为政策制定者提供了新的见解。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103071.title: Internal information asymmetry, external reporting, and insider trading: Theory and evidence
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103071.title_zh: 内部信息不对称、外部报告与内幕交易：理论与证据

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103072.abstract: Despite widespread optimism among regulators and market practitioners about corporate asset-backed securitization (ABS), its relationship with firm performance remains unclear. This study examines the association between corporate ABS and firm performance in China using a novel look-through approach to identify actual originators of ABS transactions. We document an inverted U-shaped relationship between corporate ABS scale and firm performance. Firm performance is positively associated with ABS issuance at low-to-moderate levels, but this association turns negative when issuance becomes excessive. Heterogeneity analyses show that this nonlinear relationship varies across ownership types and firm sizes and is more pronounced among non-state-owned and larger firms. Multiple analyses suggest that corporate ABS issuance in China functions less as pure risk transfer and more as debt-like financing, and the leverage-channel analysis further provides corroborative evidence that leverage helps explain the inverted U-shaped relationship between ABS issuance and firm performance. These findings advance our understanding of the relationship between corporate ABS and firm performance in China and offer practical implications for firms and regulators.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103072.abstract_zh: 尽管监管机构和市场从业者普遍对企业资产支持证券化（ABS）持乐观态度，但其与企业绩效之间的关系仍不明确。本研究采用一种新颖的透视方法识别ABS交易的实际发起人，考察了中国企业ABS与企业绩效之间的关联。我们发现，企业ABS规模与企业绩效之间存在倒U型关系。在低至中等发行水平下，企业绩效与ABS发行正相关，但当发行过度时，这种关联转为负向。异质性分析显示，这种非线性关系因所有权类型和企业规模的不同而有所差异，且在非国有企业和大型企业中更为显著。多项分析表明，中国企业ABS发行更多扮演的是类似债务融资的角色，而非纯粹的风险转移，杠杆渠道分析进一步提供了佐证证据，表明杠杆有助于解释ABS发行与企业绩效之间的倒U型关系。这些发现加深了我们对中国企业ABS与企业绩效关系的理解，并为企业和监管机构提供了实践启示。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103072.title: Corporate asset-backed securitization and firm performance in China: A shadow-leverage perspective
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103072.title_zh: 中国企业资产证券化与企业绩效：基于影子杠杆视角的研究

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103073.abstract: Regulatory fragmentation occurs when multiple agencies promulgate overlapping rules on the same policy topic, requiring firms to coordinate compliance across regulators and reconcile potentially inconsistent requirements. While prior work documents the real economic effects of regulatory fragmentation, this paper examines how regulatory fragmentation is reflected in the disclosures firms produce. Across the numerical and textual content of 10-K and 10-Q filings, I find that regulatory fragmentation is associated with systematic differences in firms' disclosure characteristics. Firms in more fragmented regulatory environments produce less complex numerical disclosures, a pattern concentrated in the notes to the financial statements and in industries whose oversight is persistently fragmented. By contrast, the associations between regulatory fragmentation and narrative disclosure characteristics vary with agency exposure. Among firms exposed to few agencies, regulatory fragmentation is associated with fewer words and sentences, smaller filing size, and more readable text. Among firms exposed to many agencies, it is associated with more words and sentences, while its association with filing size is no longer distinguishable from zero.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103073.abstract_zh: 监管碎片化是指多个机构就同一政策主题颁布重叠规则，要求企业在各监管者之间协调合规，并调和可能不一致的要求。既有研究记录了监管碎片化的实际经济效应，而本文则考察监管碎片化如何反映在企业所生成的披露中。通过对10-K和10-Q文件的数值与文本内容进行分析，我发现监管碎片化与企业披露特征的系统性差异相关联。处于更碎片化监管环境中的企业，其数值披露的复杂性较低，这一模式集中于财务报表附注以及监管持续碎片化的行业。相比之下，监管碎片化与叙述性披露特征之间的关联因机构暴露程度而异。在接触机构较少的企业中，监管碎片化与更少的词数和句数、更小的文件规模以及更易读的文本相关。在接触机构较多的企业中，监管碎片化与更多的词数和句数相关，而其与文件规模的关联则不再显著区别于零。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103073.title: Financial disclosure under regulatory fragmentation
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103073.title_zh: 监管碎片化下的财务信息披露

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103074.abstract: Firms led by older CEOs invest less, but the mechanism behind this age–investment gradient remains unclear. We study how CEO age shapes investment evaluation by eliciting CEOs' ratings of a project's investment attractiveness in a large-scale scenario-based experiment with more than 3700 CEOs from owner-managed Danish firms. Our design provides direct evidence on CEOs' investment evaluations by separating baseline differences in investment attractiveness from sensitivity to risk moments and payout horizon. Each CEO evaluates randomized capital-budgeting scenarios relative to the status quo, allowing us to distinguish a baseline shift in willingness to view projects as compelling from age differences in responsiveness to risk characteristics and payout horizon. We document a pronounced negative association between CEO age and investment attractiveness. Holding expected IRR, variance, skewness, and payout horizon constant, CEOs aged 60 or older rate the same opportunities as less attractive, while age differences in sensitivity to these attributes are weak. Standard stated risk attitudes and a lottery measure show no systematic age pattern. For external validity, we construct a CEO-specific inaction propensity from the experiment—the residual tendency to rate otherwise identical projects as less attractive after accounting for project characteristics—and show that it predicts lower investment in administrative data. Including this measure attenuates the reduced-form age–investment association, suggesting that age-related investment declines are not readily explained by conventional risk preferences or investment horizons alone, but also reflect a broader residual tendency towards lower investment propensity.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103074.abstract_zh: 由年长CEO领导的企业投资较少，但这一年龄-投资梯度背后的机制尚不明确。我们通过一项涉及超过3700位丹麦所有者管理企业CEO的大规模情景实验，研究CEO年龄如何影响投资评估，实验中让CEO对项目的投资吸引力进行评分。我们的设计通过将投资吸引力的基线差异与对风险矩和支付期限的敏感性分离开来，提供了关于CEO投资评估的直接证据。每位CEO相对于现状评估随机化的资本预算情景，使我们能够区分将项目视为有吸引力的意愿的基线变化与年龄在风险特征和支付期限响应性上的差异。我们记录了CEO年龄与投资吸引力之间显著的负相关关系。在保持预期内部收益率、方差、偏度和支付期限不变的情况下，60岁及以上的CEO将相同机会评为吸引力较低，而年龄对这些属性敏感性的差异则较弱。标准陈述的风险态度和彩票测量未显示出系统性年龄模式。为验证外部有效性，我们从实验中构建了一个CEO特定的不作为倾向——在考虑项目特征后，对原本相同的项目评为吸引力较低的残余倾向——并显示它能预测行政数据中较低的投资水平。纳入这一测量削弱了简化形式的年龄-投资关联，表明与年龄相关的投资下降不能仅由传统风险偏好或投资期限轻易解释，还反映了一种更广泛的低投资倾向的残余趋势。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103074.title: CEO aging and investment propensity: Experimental evidence
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103074.title_zh: CEO老龄化与投资倾向：实验证据

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103075.abstract: We survey 153 empirical studies of family firms and document 192 operational definitions representing 25 distinct definition types. These definitions can be decomposed into five recurring, codable dimensions: ownership, management, board representation, embeddedness, and succession. We relate these dimensions to economic mechanisms including agency conflicts, residual control rights, transaction costs, and dynastic control. Alternative definitions select systematically different populations and yield materially different estimates of firm performance and innovation. Definition choice is largely unrelated to the research question, except in succession studies. Ownership thresholds track private enforcement of self-dealing rules, but not statutory shareholder rights or rule of law. We conclude that the family firm is a family of related constructs rather than a single latent construct. Definitions should therefore match the family-firm construct implied by the research question, and results should be reported across alternative classification rules.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103075.abstract_zh: 我们调查了153项关于家族企业的实证研究，记录了192种操作定义，涵盖25种不同的定义类型。这些定义可分解为五个反复出现且可编码的维度：所有权、管理、董事会代表、嵌入性和继承。我们将这些维度与经济机制联系起来，包括代理冲突、剩余控制权、交易成本和王朝控制。不同的定义会系统地选择不同的总体，并对企业绩效和创新的估计产生实质性差异。定义的选择与研究问题基本无关，但在继承研究中除外。所有权阈值与自我交易规则的私人执行相关，但与法定股东权利或法治无关。我们得出结论，家族企业是一个相关构念的家族，而非单一潜在构念。因此，定义应与研究问题所隐含的家族企业构念相匹配，并且结果应跨不同分类规则进行报告。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103075.title: Defining family firms: A survey of empirical criteria
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103075.title_zh: 家族企业的界定：实证标准综述

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103076.abstract: This paper examines the role played by the media in the shareholder proposal process. We find a positive relation between media coverage and the likelihood of being targeted by governance proposals. The effect is mostly observed for proposals submitted by non-institutional shareholders and driven by negative news. We further show that both “first reports” and repeated news contribute to increasing the probability of being targeted by governance proposals. This suggests that the media influence the shareholder proposal process both by conveying information to market participants and increasing firms' visibility. Negative media coverage is also associated with the success of proposals and changes in executive compensation and board turnover. Instrumental variable analysis and tests exploiting local newspaper closures suggest that the relationship between media coverage and shareholder proposals is causal. Our results shed light on a new channel through which the media can play a corporate governance role.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103076.abstract_zh: 本文考察了媒体在股东提案过程中所扮演的角色。我们发现，媒体报道与成为治理提案目标的可能性之间存在正相关关系。这一效应主要体现在非机构股东提交的提案中，且由负面新闻驱动。我们进一步表明，“首次报道”和重复新闻均有助于提高成为治理提案目标的概率。这表明，媒体通过向市场参与者传递信息并提升企业可见度，从而影响股东提案过程。负面媒体报道还与提案的成功、高管薪酬变动及董事会更替相关联。工具变量分析及利用地方报纸停刊的检验表明，媒体报道与股东提案之间的关系具有因果性。我们的研究结果揭示了媒体发挥公司治理作用的新渠道。

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103077.abstract: This paper documents that firms experience a decline in innovation following the staggered adoption of salary history ban legislation (SHBs), which prohibits employers from asking job candidates about salary histories in the hiring process. We develop a theoretical model and hypothesize that SHBs impose higher informational asymmetries in the labor market and thus cause more severe adverse selection when employers attempt to hire inventors.
