Consistent with this hypothesis, we find that after SHBs, firms hire fewer inventors relative to their total workforce and, at the firm-year level, the newly hired inventor pool exhibits lower average innovation performance. Inventor-level tests further show that firms become more selective among the inventors they do hire. We also show that the adverse effect of SHBs on innovation is more pronounced for firms in states with stronger labor market protection. This paper outlines the unintended consequences of labor regulation and information restriction on corporate innovation.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103077.abstract_zh: 本文记录了在逐步实施薪资历史禁令立法（SHBs）后，企业创新活动出现下滑的现象。该立法禁止雇主在招聘过程中询问求职者的薪资历史。我们构建了一个理论模型，并提出假设：SHBs加剧了劳动力市场中的信息不对称，从而在雇主试图招聘发明家时引发更严重的逆向选择问题。与这一假设相符的是，我们发现实施SHBs后，企业相对于其总员工规模招聘的发明家数量减少，并且在企业-年度层面上，新招聘的发明家群体的平均创新绩效较低。发明家层面的测试进一步表明，企业在实际招聘的发明家中变得更加挑剔。我们还发现，SHBs对创新的不利影响在劳动力市场保护更强的州份企业中更为显著。本文揭示了劳动法规与信息限制对企业创新的意外后果。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103077.title: The unintended real effect of salary history bans: The case of innovation
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103077.title_zh: 薪酬历史禁令的意外实际效应：以创新为例

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103078.abstract: This study investigates whether digital supervision technologies enhance the monitoring effectiveness of controlling shareholders in complex investment decisions. We exploit the staggered rollout of the SOEs Online Supervision System (SOSS) by China’s State-Owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC), the controlling shareholder of state-owned enterprises (SOEs), across its central and 31 provincial offices from 2018 to 2021. Following SOSS implementation, SOE transactions exhibit shorter deal duration, fewer regulatory inquiries, lower goodwill impairment, greater withdrawal of low-quality deals, and improved target quality. These improvements in deal review efficiency and screening effectiveness translate into stronger announcement returns and long-run performance. The performance effects are more pronounced for acquirers with stronger technological infrastructure, in transactions characterized by lower transparency and weaker governance, and when SASAC offices face tighter capacity constraints. Overall, digital technologies relaxes information-processing constraints and strengthens shareholder monitoring in complex investment settings.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103078.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨数字监督技术是否能够增强控股股东在复杂投资决策中的监督效能。我们利用中国国有资产监督管理委员会（SASAC）作为国有企业（SOEs）的控股股东，在其中央及31个省级办公室于2018年至2021年间分阶段推行国有企业在线监督系统（SOSS）这一自然实验。SOSS实施后，国有企业交易呈现出交易持续时间缩短、监管问询减少、商誉减值降低、低质量交易撤回增多以及目标质量提升等特征。这些交易审查效率与筛选效果的改善，转化为更强的公告回报和长期绩效表现。绩效效应在技术基础设施更完善的收购方、透明度较低且治理较弱的交易中，以及SASAC办公室面临更紧张的能力约束时更为显著。总体而言，数字技术缓解了信息处理约束，并强化了复杂投资情境下的股东监督。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103078.title: The role of digitalized supervision in mergers and acquisitions: Evidence from the SOEs online supervision system in China
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103078.title_zh: 数字化监管在并购中的作用：来自中国国有企业在线监管系统的证据

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103080.abstract: Firms’ green technology investments are increasingly important for competitive positioning, yet their impact on long-run performance remains unclear. Using electricity capacity data for global utility firms, we construct a unique structural measure of technological greenness based on renewable versus fossil fuel physical infrastructure. We find that adopting sustainable technologies is followed by a long-run improvement in corporate fundamentals that is only partially reflected in stock prices, yielding superior returns over a multi-year horizon. These results partly reflect higher revenue growth in liberalized retail markets rather than investor sentiment, revealing a consumer-based mechanism that likely extends to competitive downstream sectors.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103080.abstract_zh: 企业绿色技术投资对竞争定位日益重要，但其对长期绩效的影响仍不明确。利用全球公用事业企业的电力产能数据，我们构建了一个基于可再生能源与化石燃料物理基础设施的独特结构性技术绿色度指标。研究发现，采纳可持续技术后，企业基本面在长期内得到改善，而这一改善仅部分反映在股价中，从而在多年期内产生超额回报。这些结果部分反映了自由化零售市场中更高的收入增长，而非投资者情绪，揭示了一种基于消费者的机制，该机制可能延伸至竞争性下游行业。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103080.title: Technological greenness and long-run performance: Evidence from the utility industry
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103080.title_zh: 技术绿色度与长期绩效：来自公用事业行业的证据

10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103081.abstract: We examine whether sectoral specialization provides informational advantages to banks, enabling better credit risk assessment of their outstanding corporate loan exposures. Using euro area credit register data, we compare probabilities of default assigned by more and less specialized banks to the same borrowing firm several quarters before the borrower defaults. We find that banks specialized in the borrower’s sector are better at predicting future defaults in their lending portfolios, which is reflected in specialized banks actively raising probabilities of default earlier, suggesting informational advantages over the lifetime of the loans. More specialized banks also increase loan loss provisions to these borrowers more quickly and are more likely to implement forbearance measures. We find no evidence of similar effects towards healthy borrowers, suggesting that our findings are not attributable to general conservatism but to more accurate evaluation of credit risk in the sectors of banks’ specialization. We show that our results are primarily driven by the smallest firms, and that the informational advantages of specialization are stronger when banks do not have long-term relationships with their borrowers and when they are confronted with a sectoral wave of defaults.
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103081.abstract_zh: 我们考察了行业专业化是否能为银行提供信息优势，使其能够更准确地评估未偿还企业贷款敞口的信用风险。利用欧元区信贷登记数据，我们在借款人违约前几个季度，比较了专业化程度较高与较低的银行对同一借款企业所设定的违约概率。我们发现，专注于借款人所在行业的银行更能预测其贷款组合中的未来违约情况，这体现在专业化银行更早地主动上调违约概率，表明其在贷款存续期内具有信息优势。更为专业化的银行还会更快地增加对这些借款人的贷款损失准备金，并且更可能实施宽容措施。我们未发现对健康借款人类似效应的证据，这表明我们的发现并非源于普遍的保守主义，而是源于银行在其专业化行业内对信用风险更准确的评估。我们证明，我们的结果主要由最小型企业驱动，并且当银行与借款人缺乏长期关系以及面临行业性违约浪潮时，专业化的信息优势更为显著。
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103081.title: The expert’s edge? Bank lending specialization and informational advantages for credit risk assessment
10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.103081.title_zh: 专家优势？银行贷款专业化与信用风险评估中的信息优势

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2006.01.008.abstract: this Paper we argue that the political incentives that resource endowments generate are the key to understanding whether or not they are a curse. We show: (1) politicians tend to over-extract natural resources relative to the efficient extraction path because they discount the future too much; (2) resource booms improve the efficiency of the extraction path; (3) resource booms, however, by raising the value of being in power and by providing politicians with more resources which they can use to influence the outcome of elections, increase resource misallocation in the rest of the economy and (4) the overall impact of resource booms on the economy depends critically on institutions, since these determine the extent to which political incentives map into policy outcomes. Countries with good institutions tend to benefit from resource booms since these institutions mitigate the perverse political incentives that such booms create. Countries with bad institutions suffer a resource curse.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2006.01.008.abstract_zh: 本文认为，资源禀赋所产生的政治激励是理解其是否成为“诅咒”的关键。我们论证：（1）政治家倾向于过度开采自然资源，偏离有效开采路径，因为他们对未来过度折现；（2）资源繁荣会改善开采路径的效率；（3）然而，资源繁荣通过提升执政价值，并为政治家提供更多可用于影响选举结果的资源，加剧了经济其他领域的资源错配；（4）资源繁荣对经济的总体影响关键取决于制度，因为制度决定了政治激励转化为政策结果的程度。制度良好的国家往往能从资源繁荣中受益，因为这些制度缓解了繁荣所引发的扭曲性政治激励。制度不良的国家则会遭受资源诅咒。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2006.01.008.title: Political Foundations of the Resource Curse

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2025.103629.abstract: We estimate a Choo and Siow (2006b) model using census data to quantify the relative roles of changes in population structure and changes in marital surplus, i.e., the value of marriage. We find that the increase in the supply of educated people explains half of the decline, partly due to a mismatch between highly-educated women and less-educated men. The deterioration of female-to-male ratio, known as marriage squeeze, explains an additional 13% for men. The decrease in surplus accounts for the remainder.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2025.103629.abstract_zh: 我们利用人口普查数据估计了Choo和Siow（2006b）模型，以量化人口结构变化与婚姻剩余（即婚姻价值）变化的相对作用。研究发现，受教育人口供给的增加解释了婚姻率下降的一半原因，部分源于高学历女性与低学历男性之间的错配。女性与男性比例恶化（即所谓的“婚姻挤压”）对男性婚姻率下降的额外贡献为13%。剩余部分则由婚姻剩余的减少所解释。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103733.abstract: Agricultural extension programs often train a subset of farmers and rely on social networks for knowledge dissemination. We evaluate this approach through a two-stage experiment of an agronomy training program among Rwandan coffee farmers. The first stage randomized trainee concentration at the village level; the second randomly selected participants within villages. The program increased knowledge and self-reported adoption of the taught practices. It also reshaped farmers’ social networks by creating new social ties primarily among co-trainees. At first glance, the intervention appeared modestly effective, with treated farmers exhibiting higher yields than control applicants within the same village, although this difference is not statistically significant. However, knowledge did not diffuse, and control farmers with more treatment friends at baseline reduced audited adoption and input use. Villages with high trainee concentrations showed suggestive evidence of negative spillovers, consistent with reallocation of labor and other shared inputs toward treated farmers, as formalized in a simple model in which social ties shape access to inputs. Relative declines in the yields of control farmers in these villages account for treatment-control differences, raising concerns both about this dissemination strategy and estimates that fail to consider potential negative spillovers.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103733.abstract_zh: 农业推广项目通常培训一部分农民，并依赖社会网络进行知识传播。我们通过一项针对卢旺达咖啡农的农艺培训项目的两阶段实验来评估这一方法。第一阶段在村庄层面随机分配受训者集中度；第二阶段在村庄内随机选择参与者。该项目提高了知识水平及对所教授实践的自报采纳率。同时，它还通过主要在同批受训者之间建立新的社会联系，重塑了农民的社会网络。乍一看，该干预措施似乎效果适中，受训农民在同一村庄内的产量高于对照组申请者，尽管这一差异在统计上并不显著。然而，知识并未扩散，且基线时拥有更多受训朋友的对照组农民减少了经审计的采纳行为和投入品使用。受训者集中度高的村庄显示出负面溢出效应的初步证据，这与劳动力和其它共享投入品向受训农民重新分配的现象一致，正如一个简单模型所形式化的那样，该模型认为社会联系影响投入品的获取。在这些村庄中，对照组农民产量的相对下降解释了处理组与对照组之间的差异，这既对这种传播策略提出了质疑，也对那些未能考虑潜在负面溢出效应的估计提出了担忧。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103733.title: Chat over coffee? Diffusion of agronomic practices and market spillovers in Rwanda
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103733.title_zh: 咖啡闲聊？卢旺达农业技术扩散与市场溢出效应

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103748.abstract: Edutainment is a promising tool for changing behavior at scale, yet little is known about how to maximize impacts. We undertake an experimental evaluation of a popular West African television series, C’est la vie!, delivered through film clubs targeted at adolescent girls and young women in rural Senegal. We examine impacts on violence against women and girls and sexual and reproductive health. Results show C’est la vie! improved knowledge on both domains three months after film clubs ended, as well as violence-related attitudes nine months later, however, had no impact on behaviors. We investigate design components intended to strengthen impacts, generally finding no additional impacts from post-screening discussions, engaging men, and podcasts. Our findings suggest that edutainment is an engaging way to reach viewers on sensitive themes, however more evidence is needed on how to effectively deliver edutainment content for sustained behavior change at scale. • Using a cluster randomized control trial, we evaluate a popular West African TV series. • We examine impacts on violence against women and girls (VAWG) and sexual and reproductive health (SRH). • We find short term knowledge gains in both domains and improved medium term VAWG attitudes. • We find no impact on behaviors. • We find no additional impacts from post-screening discussions, engaging men, and podcasts.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103748.abstract_zh: 寓教于乐是一种有望大规模改变行为的工具，然而关于如何最大化其影响却知之甚少。我们对一部广受欢迎的西非电视连续剧《C'est la vie!》进行了实验评估，该剧通过电影俱乐部形式面向塞内加尔农村的少女和年轻女性。我们考察了其对针对妇女和女孩的暴力以及性与生殖健康的影响。结果显示，《C'est la vie!》在电影俱乐部结束三个月后改善了两个领域的知识，九个月后改善了与暴力相关的态度，但对行为没有影响。我们研究了旨在加强影响的设计要素，总体上发现映后讨论、男性参与和播客并未带来额外影响。我们的研究结果表明，寓教于乐是触及观众敏感主题的一种引人入胜的方式，但关于如何有效传递寓教于乐内容以实现大规模持续行为改变，仍需更多证据。• 通过整群随机对照试验，我们评估了一部广受欢迎的西非电视连续剧。• 我们考察了对针对妇女和女孩的暴力（VAWG）及性与生殖健康（SRH）的影响。• 我们发现两个领域的短期知识提升和中期VAWG态度的改善。• 我们发现对行为没有影响。• 我们发现映后讨论、男性参与和播客未带来额外影响。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103748.title: C'est la vie!: Mixed impacts of an edutainment television series in West Africa
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103748.title_zh: 这就是生活！：西非教育娱乐电视系列剧的混合影响

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103751.abstract: The success of foreign interventions critically depends on cohesion within local communities, which serve as relevant partners in counterinsurgency and reconstruction efforts. Using unique data on military base locations and counterinsurgency aid in Afghanistan, I show that the presence of the International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) negatively affects social cohesion, measured by support within communities, engagement with community institutions, and trust. I leverage a geographic regression discontinuity design to estimate effects of ISAF’s geographic mandate enlargement, complemented by a panel analysis that covers its operational intensification. These findings do not appear to reflect crowding-out of informal institutions by formal provision; rather, they coincide with higher insecurity and reduced confidence in local institutions, offering a plausible explanation for the observed erosion of community cohesion. These findings carry important implications for foreign policy, particularly in settings where communities compensate for gaps in formal institutional provision.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103751.abstract_zh: 外国干预的成功关键取决于当地社区内部的凝聚力，这些社区在反叛乱和重建工作中是重要的合作伙伴。利用关于阿富汗军事基地位置和反叛乱援助的独特数据，我展示了国际安全援助部队（ISAF）的存在对社区凝聚力产生负面影响，这种凝聚力通过社区内部的支持、对社区机构的参与以及信任来衡量。我采用地理断点回归设计来估计ISAF地理任务扩大的效应，并辅以涵盖其行动强化的小组分析。这些发现似乎并未反映出正式供给对非正式机构的挤出效应；相反，它们与更高的不安全感和对地方机构信任度的降低相吻合，为观察到的社区凝聚力侵蚀提供了合理的解释。这些发现对外交政策具有重要意义，尤其是在社区弥补正式机构供给缺口的背景下。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103751.title: Foreign interventions and community cohesion in times of conflict
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103751.title_zh: 冲突时期的外来干预与社区凝聚力

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103757.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of environmental awareness on land transactions. We leverage the exogenous shock caused by the unexpected release of the environmental documentary Under the Dome in early 2015 in China, and use the birthplace of the interviewees in filmmaker's previous signature program as the instrument for exposure. We observe that the cities with more exposure to the documentary exhibit significant reduction in land transaction activities. Mechanism analysis indicates that after the release of documentary, residents awareness of air pollution increases substantially, accompanied by a notable rise in migration intention. This indicates the real impacts of environmental perception on household behavior and land transactions.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103757.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了环境意识对土地交易的影响。我们利用2015年初中国环保纪录片《穹顶之下》意外发布所造成的外生冲击，并以制片人先前标志性节目中受访者的出生地作为曝光度的工具变量。我们观察到，纪录片曝光度较高的城市，其土地交易活动显著减少。机制分析表明，纪录片发布后，居民对空气污染的意识大幅提升，同时迁移意愿显著增强。这揭示了环境感知对家庭行为及土地交易的实际影响。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103757.title: The art of not being chocked: Environmental awareness, residents' responses and land transactions in China
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103757.title_zh: 不被扼住的艺术：环境意识、居民响应与中国土地交易

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103763.abstract: This paper examines the short- and medium-term effects of extending maternity leave on women’s labor market outcomes, exploiting a reform implemented in Chile in 2011 that increased maternity leave from 84 to 168 days. I combine administrative data on leave claims with employer–employee data to estimate the effect of longer leave on women’s employment and wages seven years after childbirth. The results show that, compared to ineligible workers, eligible women extend their maternity leave by 79 days and reduce their use of other sick leave claims. They are more likely to be formally employed for up to three years after giving birth, with no negative effects on earnings. The positive employment effects are driven by women with low labor market attachment prior to giving birth, who experience a reduction in separation rates and an increased likelihood of working under a permanent contract in the medium term. These results suggest that a longer leave incentivizes employment by helping mothers remain in the formal labor market.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103763.abstract_zh: 本文考察了延长产假对女性劳动力市场结果的短期与中期影响，利用智利2011年实施的一项改革，该改革将产假从84天延长至168天。我将行政数据中的产假申请记录与雇主-雇员数据相结合，以估计延长产假对女性分娩后七年内就业和工资的影响。结果显示，与不符合条件的劳动者相比，符合条件的女性产假延长了79天，并减少了其他病假申请的使用。她们在分娩后最多三年内更可能保持正式就业，且对收入无负面影响。积极的就业效应主要由分娩前劳动力市场依附度较低的女性驱动，这些女性的离职率降低，并在中期更可能签订永久合同。这些结果表明，延长产假通过帮助母亲留在正规劳动力市场，激励了就业。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103763.title: Who benefits from a maternity leave extension? Evidence from Chile
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103763.title_zh: 产假延长谁受益？来自智利的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103764.abstract: This paper examines whether military service can promote intergenerational mobility in developing countries. We use survey data from 3037 men exposed to conscription to compare respondents’ socioeconomic and educational outcomes with those of their parents. Exploiting the random assignment of conscription by lottery, we show that serving increases upward mobility for individuals from low-SES backgrounds, with no effects for those from more privileged ones. The positive effects of military service on mobility disappear under non-democratic regimes or wartime, underscoring the importance of stable institutional contexts for the military to enhance mobility.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103764.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在发展中国家，兵役能否促进代际流动性。我们利用3037名受征兵制度影响的男性调查数据，将受访者的社会经济和教育成果与其父母进行比较。借助征兵抽签的随机分配机制，我们发现，对于来自低社会经济地位背景的个体，服役能提升其向上流动性，而对来自更优越背景的个体则无影响。然而，在非民主政权或战争时期，兵役对流动性的积极影响消失，这凸显了稳定的制度环境对于军队促进流动性的重要性。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103764.title: Moving up the ranks: Conscription and intergenerational mobility
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103764.title_zh: 提升排名：征兵与代际流动

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103775.abstract: This paper studies how attacks against journalists affect news media activity. We combine data on content shared by Mexican media outlets on Twitter with records of journalist assassinations between 2010 and 2020, and use difference-in-differences methods that are robust to staggered treatment and heterogeneous effects. Our analysis shows that reporting activity of affiliated outlets declines significantly in the months after journalists are killed, relative to outlets not yet exposed to a killing. Additionally, we observe subtle shifts in the tone of news coverage and a significant increase in grammatical errors. Using census data, we also document that the number of active journalists declines in places where killings occur, and that their demographic characteristics shift: remaining journalists tend to be younger, less educated, less likely to be married, and less likely to have children.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103775.abstract_zh: 本文研究了针对记者的袭击如何影响新闻媒体的活动。我们将墨西哥媒体机构在推特上分享的内容数据与2010年至2020年间记者遇害的记录相结合，并采用对交错处理及异质性效应稳健的双重差分方法进行分析。分析显示，在记者遇害后的数月内，关联媒体的报道活动显著减少，相较于尚未遭遇此类事件的媒体机构。此外，我们观察到新闻报道基调的微妙变化以及语法错误的显著增加。利用人口普查数据，我们还记录了遇害事件发生地活跃记者数量的下降，且其人口特征发生转变：留任记者往往更年轻、受教育程度较低、已婚可能性较小，且生育子女的可能性也较低。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103775.title: Violence against journalists and freedom of the press: Evidence from Mexico
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103775.title_zh: 针对记者的暴力与新闻自由：来自墨西哥的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103776.abstract: We examine the lasting impact of Cold War alignment on African development. To overcome the empirical challenge of ambiguous and interdependent international alliances during the Cold War, we introduce a non-cooperative game of social interactions. Using pre-determined, country-level characteristics to construct payoffs, we identify a unique two-bloc equilibrium partition of the continent. We then assign bloc alignments based on how the partition predicts UN voting patterns. Our empirical results indicate no income differences today between the Western and the Eastern blocs. However, their development paths reflect Cold War ideologies: Western-aligned African countries have greater inequality, financial development, and democracy, but lesser infrastructure, compared to Eastern-aligned ones.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103776.abstract_zh: 我们考察了冷战时期阵营归属对非洲发展的持久影响。为克服冷战期间国际联盟模糊且相互依存的实证挑战，我们引入了一个非合作的社会互动博弈模型。利用预先确定的国别层面特征来构建收益，我们识别出非洲大陆一个独特的双阵营均衡划分。随后，我们根据该划分对联合国投票模式的预测来分配阵营归属。实证结果显示，今日西方阵营与东方阵营之间的收入并无差异。然而，它们的发展路径反映了冷战意识形态：与东方阵营相比，西方阵营的非洲国家不平等程度更高、金融发展更深入、民主程度更高，但基础设施相对薄弱。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103776.title: Did the Cold War produce development clusters in Africa?
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103776.title_zh: 冷战是否在非洲催生了发展集群？

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103782.abstract: We study the labor market and macroeconomic effects of carbon taxation in the energy sector in emerging economies. We build a macro-search model with pollution externalities, endogenous green-energy adoption, salaried-firm entry, and endogenous self-employment. The carbon tax increases green technology adoption in the energy sector and the share of green energy. Under a baseline revenue recycling scheme that transfers the carbon tax revenue to households, the tax raises energy prices, leading to a reduction in salaried firm and job creation, and an increase in self-employment and labor force participation that ultimately generate welfare and GDP losses. Additional model experiments show that the presence of self-employment as a distinct employment category significantly amplifies these losses. However, endogenous green technology adoption can drastically limit the magnitude of these losses. Using the carbon tax revenue to support green energy investment can deliver a decline in energy prices and net welfare and output gains while reducing self-employment.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103782.abstract_zh: 我们研究了新兴经济体能源部门碳税对劳动力市场及宏观经济的影响。我们构建了一个包含污染外部性、内生绿色能源采用、受薪企业进入及内生自雇就业的宏观搜索模型。碳税提高了能源部门的绿色技术采用率及绿色能源占比。在将碳税收入转移给家庭的基准收入循环方案下，税收推高了能源价格，导致受薪企业和就业创造减少，同时自雇就业和劳动力参与率上升，最终造成福利和GDP损失。额外的模型实验表明，自雇就业作为独立就业类别的存在显著放大了这些损失。然而，内生的绿色技术采用能大幅限制这些损失的规模。利用碳税收入支持绿色能源投资，可实现能源价格下降、净福利和产出增长，同时减少自雇就业。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103782.title: Climate policies, labor markets, and macroeconomic outcomes in emerging economies
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103782.title_zh: 新兴经济体的气候政策、劳动力市场与宏观经济结果

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103783.abstract: A major goal of India’s 2016 demonetization was to curb tax evasion by reducing the use of cash in under-reported economic activity. We test whether the policy reduced under-reporting in real estate transactions — a market long suspected of widespread cash use and evasion. We find no change in aggregate under-reporting, but moderate declines among the 30% of transactions between individual buyers and sellers, relative to the 70% where developers are sellers. We also find evidence of under-reporting declines amongst smaller developers and regions where under-reporting was more common pre-demonetization. Our results, from a major Indian city, highlight both the limits of cash-based enforcement and the heterogeneous effects of demonetization style policies.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103783.abstract_zh: 印度2016年废钞令的主要目标之一，是通过减少未报告经济活动中现金的使用来遏制逃税行为。我们检验了该政策是否减少了房地产交易中的低报现象——这一市场长期以来被怀疑存在广泛的现金使用和逃税行为。我们发现总体低报情况没有变化，但在个人买卖双方之间的30%交易中，相对于开发商作为卖方的70%交易，低报现象出现了适度下降。我们还发现，在较小的开发商以及废钞令前低报现象更为普遍的地区，低报情况有所减少。我们的研究结果来自印度一座主要城市，既凸显了基于现金执法手段的局限性，也揭示了废钞令式政策的异质性影响。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103783.title: Demonetization and under-reporting of economic activity: Evidence from real estate
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103783.title_zh: 废钞令与经济活动的低报：来自房地产市场的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103784.abstract: This study examines how controlling misinformation on a social media platform in Pakistan affects users’ exposure to both accurate and false information. It combines an intervention to disseminate official information about the COVID-19 pandemic across the platform with a randomized experiment that measures the impact of fully controlling access to pandemic-related misinformation. The treatments rely on a higher-intensity, ex ante approach to moderating misinformation on the platform relative to the control, which relies on a typical ex post approach to moderation. Fully controlling misinformation, as in the treatments, reduces the number of daily users by 19%, indicating a distaste for moderation. Furthermore, the treatments reduce exposure to official information by 29% more than they reduce exposure to misinformation. A conceptual framework posits that these findings can be explained by the fact that, in this setting, official information is more trusted, and thus is more widely disseminated, relative to misinformation.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103784.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在巴基斯坦的一个社交媒体平台上，控制错误信息如何影响用户接触准确信息与虚假信息的情况。该研究结合了一项干预措施，即在平台上传播关于COVID-19疫情的官方信息，以及一项随机实验，用以衡量完全控制疫情相关错误信息访问的影响。相较于对照组采用的典型事后审核方法，这些处理措施依赖于一种更高强度、事前的方法来审核平台上的错误信息。如处理组所示，完全控制错误信息使每日用户数量减少了19%，表明用户对审核存在反感。此外，处理措施在减少官方信息接触方面的效果比减少错误信息接触高出29%。一个概念框架提出，这些发现可以解释为，在此情境下，官方信息更受信任，因此相较于错误信息，其传播范围更广。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103784.title: The spread of (mis)information: A social media experiment in Pakistan
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103784.title_zh: （错误）信息的传播：巴基斯坦的一项社交媒体实验

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103785.abstract: This paper provides the first evidence that children’s economic preferences vary systematically with parental mental health. Using experimentally elicited measures of economic preferences from more than 4500 children in Bangladesh, we document that children of parents with indications of mental illness are less prosocial but more patient than their peers with mentally healthy parents. Attitudes towards risk remain unchanged. We discuss potential pathways through which parental mental health may influence the formation of children’s preferences, documenting that children of parents with indication of mental illness assume greater responsibilities within the family, experience less parental involvement, and are exposed to a more adverse home environment.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103785.abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了儿童经济偏好随父母心理健康状况系统性变化的证据。利用从孟加拉国超过4500名儿童中通过实验诱导测量的经济偏好数据，我们记录到，与父母心理健康良好的同龄人相比，父母有心理疾病迹象的儿童表现出较少亲社会性但更具耐心。对风险的态度则保持不变。我们探讨了父母心理健康可能影响儿童偏好形成的潜在途径，指出父母有心理疾病迹象的儿童在家庭中承担更多责任，经历较少的父母参与，并暴露于更为不利的家庭环境之中。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103785.title: Parental mental health and the economic preferences of the next generation
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103785.title_zh: 父母心理健康与下一代经济偏好

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103787.abstract: Floods are among the costliest and most recurring natural hazards. Many governments provide disaster preparedness information, but there is limited evidence of its effectiveness. Using a randomized experiment across 300 urban communities in Mozambique, I show that providing information on flood risk increased the implementation of suggested mitigation strategies, measured objectively (using a machine learning-based algorithm to detect solid waste, a major flood hazard, in over 25,000 photos) and through self-reported behaviors. Sending flood preparedness text messages proved to be at least as effective as more resource-intensive interventions that involved household visits and video screenings. Risk perception increased, particularly in lower-risk areas, suggesting that information and past experiences contribute to community preparedness by shaping perceived flood risk. These findings highlight the importance of communication in mobilizing communities for disaster risk management, even in contexts where flood risks are presumably already well-known, and underscore the potential of low-cost, scalable communication tools.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103787.abstract_zh: 洪水是最为昂贵且频发的自然灾害之一。许多政府提供防灾准备信息，但关于其有效性的证据有限。通过在莫桑比克300个城市社区进行的随机实验，我展示了提供洪水风险信息能增加建议缓解策略的实施，这一效果通过客观测量（利用基于机器学习的算法在超过25,000张照片中检测固体废物，这是主要的洪水隐患）及自我报告行为得以证实。发送洪水准备短信被证明至少与涉及家访和视频放映的资源密集型干预措施同样有效。风险感知有所提升，尤其是在低风险区域，这表明信息和过往经历通过塑造感知到的洪水风险，促进了社区的准备工作。这些发现强调了沟通在动员社区参与灾害风险管理中的重要性，即便在洪水风险可能已被广泛认知的情境下，也凸显了低成本、可扩展沟通工具的潜力。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103787.title: It will rain: The effect of information on flood preparedness in urban Mozambique
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103787.title_zh: 降雨将至：信息对莫桑比克城市洪水防范的影响

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103788.title: Retraction notice to “Natural disasters, intra-national FDI spillovers, and economic divergence: Evidence from India” [J. Dev. Econ. 157 (2022) 102872]
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103788.title_zh: 撤回通知：《自然灾害、国内FDI溢出效应与经济分化：来自印度的证据》[J. Dev. Econ. 157 (2022) 102872]

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103789.abstract: This study examines the impact of academic freedom reform on university graduates’ creativity using a large, multi-decade, cross-country sample. We construct a novel creativity index based on occupational task data and analyze how reforms in an individual’s home country affect their creativity after immigrating to the United States. Exploiting variation in reform timing across countries, we find that academic freedom reform significantly enhances graduates’ labor market creativity. Results are robust to multiple DID estimators, alternative specifications, placebo tests, and IV methods, as well as approaches addressing potential biases. Effects are particularly pronounced for developing countries, environments with decentralized governance, and low corruption. Reforms appear to boost creativity by encouraging higher educational attainment, facilitating entry into high-tech and research-oriented fields, and promoting managerial and professional roles. Our findings underscore the economic value of academic freedom and its potential as a policy instrument for nurturing student creativity.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103789.abstract_zh: 本研究利用一个大规模、跨数十年、跨国别的样本，探讨学术自由改革对大学毕业生创造力的影响。我们基于职业任务数据构建了一个新颖的创造力指数，并分析个体母国的改革如何影响其移民美国后的创造力。利用各国改革时点的差异，我们发现学术自由改革显著提升了毕业生在劳动力市场中的创造力。这一结果在多种双重差分估计量、替代规格、安慰剂检验及工具变量方法中均保持稳健，同时亦考虑了可能偏差的处理方法。效应在发展中国家、治理结构分散及腐败程度低的环境中尤为显著。改革似乎通过鼓励更高层次的教育成就、促进进入高科技及研究导向领域，以及推动管理及专业角色的担任来增强创造力。我们的发现强调了学术自由的经济价值及其作为培育学生创造力的政策工具的潜力。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103793.abstract: Developing countries have increased sanitation investment to reduce diarrheal diseases. However, the direct health benefits of latrine construction can be offset by water pollution externalities due to poor treatment of fecal sludge. I estimate these negative externalities of a sanitation policy in India that subsidized the construction of over 100 million latrines. Exploiting geographical variation in soil characteristics and the differential increase in latrine coverage across districts, I find that the policy increases river pollution by 72%. While it reduces diarrheal mortality overall, this positive health effect is two-thirds smaller in areas with lower capacities for treatment of fecal sludge where water pollution externalities are consequently larger.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103793.abstract_zh: 发展中国家已增加卫生设施投资以减少腹泻疾病。然而，厕所建设带来的直接健康效益可能因粪便污泥处理不善所产生的水污染外部性而被抵消。我评估了印度一项补贴超过1亿个厕所建设的卫生政策所带来的这些负面外部性。利用土壤特征的地理差异及各地区厕所覆盖率的不同增长，我发现该政策使河流污染增加了72%。尽管总体上降低了腹泻死亡率，但在粪便污泥处理能力较低、水污染外部性相应较大的地区，这一正面健康效应减少了三分之二。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103793.title: Unintended consequences of sanitation investment: Negative externalities on water quality and health in India
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103793.title_zh: 卫生投资的非预期后果：印度水质与健康的负外部性

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103795.abstract: The poverty–mental health gradient varies substantially across populations, far more than sampling variation alone would predict. We treat this heterogeneity as a primary object of empirical interest. Using data collected four years after the 2005 Great Pakistan Earthquake from 126 villages spanning 0–75 km from the activated fault line, we show that in unaffected populations there is no correlation between consumption poverty and mental health. By contrast, among those nearest the fault, mental health improves by 0.12 standard deviations per log unit of consumption, while the relationship is a precise zero beyond 20 km. This gradient is robust to alternative distance thresholds, sample splits, and binary mental health measures, and is not mediated by acute household trauma. These results suggest that mass adversity can activate the poverty–mental health gradient, helping explain heterogeneity in the broader literature.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103795.abstract_zh: 贫困与心理健康之间的梯度在不同人群中差异显著，远超单纯抽样变异所能解释的范围。我们将这种异质性视为实证研究的主要对象。利用2005年巴基斯坦大地震四年后从距活动断层0至75公里的126个村庄收集的数据，我们发现在未受影响的群体中，消费贫困与心理健康之间不存在相关性。相反，在距断层最近的群体中，每增加一个对数单位的消费，心理健康改善0.12个标准差，而在20公里以外，这一关系精确为零。该梯度对替代距离阈值、样本分割及二元心理健康指标均保持稳健，且不受急性家庭创伤的中介影响。这些结果表明，大规模逆境可能激活贫困与心理健康之间的梯度，有助于解释更广泛文献中的异质性现象。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103795.title: The emergence of the poverty-mental health gradient: Evidence from the great Pakistan earthquake of 2005
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103795.title_zh: 贫困-心理健康梯度的出现：来自2005年巴基斯坦大地震的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103801.abstract: In a tournament-style education system, the high salience of ordinal academic rankings may amplify top performers’ influence as role models. This paper investigates how the gender of the top scorer in the class affects peer students’ outcomes in Chinese junior high schools. Leveraging a regression discontinuity design that exploits minimal score differences between the top-performing female and male students in a class, we find that having a female first-ranked student in a major exam significantly improves subsequent academic performance among girls, while no comparable effects are observed among boys. This gender-specific effect potentially operates through multiple channels: when a female student ranks first in the class, other girls exhibit higher levels of self-confidence, academic aspirations, study effort, and receive more parental support—effects that are not present among boys. Furthermore, the impact of top performer gender is particularly pronounced among academically lower-ranked girls and those from disadvantaged families. In sum, this paper provides the first causal evidence of the gender-differentiated external effect of ordinal ranks in educational settings.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103801.abstract_zh: 在锦标赛式教育体系中，序数排名的显著突出性可能放大顶尖学生作为榜样的影响力。本文探讨了班级中最高分者的性别如何影响中国初中同伴学生的学业成果。利用回归不连续设计，借助班级内表现最优的女生与男生之间微小的分数差异，我们发现，在重要考试中，若女生排名第一，则能显著提升其他女生的后续学业表现，而男生则未观察到类似效应。这种性别特定效应可能通过多种渠道发挥作用：当女生在班级中排名第一时，其他女生展现出更高的自信心、学业抱负、学习努力程度，并获得更多家长支持——这些效应在男生中并不显现。此外，顶尖学生性别的影响在学业排名较低及家庭背景不利的女生中尤为显著。总之，本文首次提供了教育环境中序数排名性别差异化外部效应的因果证据。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103801.title: Number one girl: Female top scorers and peer academic performance in junior high schools
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103801.title_zh: 第一名女孩：初中女学霸与同伴学业表现

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103802.abstract: How are contracts enforced when the state cannot compel compliance? We study contract enforcement in a large illegal gambling market where legal recourse is unavailable and participation is largely anonymous. We observe more than 70 percent of gamblers repay their debts, indicating substantial baseline enforcement even in the absence of formal courts. We interpret this descriptive pattern as consistent with a broader set of informal enforcement forces, including repeated interaction, credit constraints, and reputational considerations. We then provide experimental evidence on one specific channel by experimentally varying reputational stakes and the time available to repay. Increasing reputational sanctions and extending the payment deadline raises repayment by a modest but significant amount, from roughly 70 percent to about 77 percent. These effects imply that reputational incentives can strengthen cooperation to a meaningful degree. Overall, our evidence suggests that impersonal markets can sustain substantial repayment without state enforcement, and that reputational sanctions further increase compliance.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103802.abstract_zh: 当国家无法强制履约时，合同如何得到执行？我们研究了一个大型非法赌博市场中的合同执行情况，在该市场中，法律救济途径不可用，且参与者大多匿名。我们观察到超过70%的赌徒偿还了债务，这表明即使在缺乏正式法院的情况下，也存在显著的基线执行机制。我们将这一描述性模式解释为与更广泛的非正式执行力量相一致，包括重复互动、信贷约束和声誉考量。随后，我们通过实验性地改变声誉风险和还款时间，针对一个具体渠道提供了实验证据。增加声誉制裁并延长还款期限，使还款率从大约70%适度但显著地提升至约77%。这些效应表明，声誉激励能够在有意义的程度上强化合作。总体而言，我们的证据表明，非人格化市场在没有国家执行的情况下也能维持可观的还款率，而声誉制裁进一步提高了合规性。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103802.title: Contract enforcement in a stateless economy
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103802.title_zh: 无国家经济中的合同执行

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103803.abstract: The first of the United Nations 2015 Sustainable Development Goals is: “End poverty in all its forms everywhere.” An implication of this broad goal is the existence of an array of poverty lines, which raises the question of an appropriate lower-bound and an upper-bound to global poverty lines. The ‘dollar-a-day’ poverty line (updated for inflation to P$2.15 in 2017 PPP) is widely accepted as a global lower-bound poverty line (GLBPL). However, while different countries, organizations, and authors use higher poverty lines, there is no consensus on a global upper bound poverty line (GUBPL). We estimate a GUBPL using two conceptually distinct approaches, both grounded in the tension between the focus axiom for poverty measures and standard economic social welfare measures. We set a candidate GUBPL either at: (i) the consumption consistent with the achievement of adequate material well-being or (ii) the consumption level where marginal utility is “near enough” zero. Using either approach, empirical results across an array of measures of well-being demonstrate that ad hoc poverty lines, including the World Bank's highest reported poverty line of P$6.85, are far too low to be plausible candidates for a GUBPL. Using the two approaches across four distinct indicators of well-being all of the empirical results suggest a GUBPL of at least P$21.5, ten times higher than the standard GLPBL of P$2.15. The use of both a lower bound and upper bound global poverty line balances the radically exclusive nature of the ‘dollar-a-day’ standard, which classifies people with very low levels of material well-being and hence very high marginal utility of income as “not poor” with an equally radically inclusive GUBPL which counts only those with globally high material achievement and low (ish) marginal utility of income as “not poor.”
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103803.abstract_zh: 联合国2015年可持续发展目标之首为：“在世界各地消除一切形式的贫困。”这一广泛目标隐含着一系列贫困线的存在，从而引出了全球贫困线适当下限与上限的问题。“每日一美元”贫困线（按2017年购买力平价调整后为P$2.15）被广泛接受为全球贫困线下限（GLPBL）。然而，尽管不同国家、组织及作者采用更高的贫困线，但对于全球贫困线上限（GUBPL）尚无共识。我们采用两种概念上截然不同的方法估算GUBPL，这两种方法均基于贫困测度中的焦点公理与标准经济社会福利度量之间的张力。我们设定候选GUBPL为：（i）与实现充分物质福祉相一致的消费水平，或（ii）边际效用“接近”零的消费水平。采用任一方法，跨多种福祉指标的实证结果表明，临时设定的贫困线，包括世界银行报告的最高贫困线P$6.85，远低于作为GUBPL合理候选的水平。运用这两种方法及四项不同的福祉指标，所有实证结果均表明GUBPL至少为P$21.5，是标准GLPBL（P$2.15）的十倍。同时采用全球贫困线下限与上限，平衡了“每日一美元”标准的极端排他性——该标准将物质福祉极低、因而收入边际效用极高的人群归类为“非贫困”——与同样极端包容性的GUBPL——该上限仅将全球物质成就高且收入边际效用较低（或偏低）的人群视为“非贫困”。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103803.title: Raising the bar: An inclusive global poverty line
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103803.title_zh: 提高标准：一个包容性的全球贫困线

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103804.abstract: We study the procurement patterns of non-listed firms and examine how these often-overlooked, yet pivotal players in global supply chains adjust their sourcing when they anticipate accountability for externalities beyond their organizational boundaries. Using granular customs data and a surprise information release about the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act, product-level regressions reveal that importing firms are 3.5 percentage points less likely to source a product from countries where the relevant production sector exhibits elevated ESG-related risks, suggesting that firms tend to cut ties with higher-risk suppliers. The effects are concentrated among firms with well-diversified supplier networks for a product and higher profitability, suggesting they have the necessary flexibility to respond quickly to anticipated regulatory pressure. Our findings suggest that mandates requiring firms to incorporate broad sustainability considerations into their operational decisions may have limits, particularly for non-listed firms.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103804.abstract_zh: 我们研究了非上市企业的采购模式，并考察了这些在全球供应链中常被忽视却至关重要的参与者，在预期需为其组织边界之外的外部性承担责任时，如何调整其采购来源。利用细粒度海关数据及关于德国《供应链尽职调查法》的意外信息披露，产品层面的回归分析显示，进口企业从相关生产部门存在较高ESG相关风险的国家采购某产品的可能性降低了3.5个百分点，这表明企业倾向于切断与高风险供应商的联系。这一效应集中在拥有产品供应商网络多元化程度较高且盈利能力较强的企业中，暗示这些企业具备必要的灵活性，能够迅速响应预期的监管压力。我们的研究结果表明，要求企业将广泛的可持续性考量纳入运营决策的强制性规定可能存在局限性，尤其对非上市企业而言。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103804.title: The limits of local laws in global supply chains: Cutting ties or “edutrading” procurement partners?
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103804.title_zh: 全球供应链中地方法律的局限性：切断联系还是“教育型交易”采购伙伴？

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103805.abstract: This study examines the long-term legacy of ancestral irrigation for contemporary climate change policies. Using geographic suitability for irrigated agriculture as a plausibly exogenous source of variation in historical irrigation adoption, we find that societies whose ancestors jointly practiced irrigated agriculture during the pre-industrial era tend to adopt less effective climate change policies today. Additional evidence suggests that pro-climate political responses to the growing salience of climate action, driven by exposure to severe natural disasters, are significantly weaker in societies historically dependent on irrigated agriculture. We propose and document empirically that ancestral irrigation, marked by intensive neighborhood-based cooperation and interdependence, contributed to the early formation of tight kinship networks. These networks likely constrained impersonal cooperation across kin boundaries, weakening collective pro-climate action.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103805.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了祖先灌溉对当代气候变化政策的长期影响。利用灌溉农业的地理适宜性作为历史灌溉采用的外生变异来源，我们发现，在前工业化时期，其祖先共同实践灌溉农业的社会，在当今往往采取效果较差的气候变化政策。进一步证据表明，受严重自然灾害暴露驱动的气候行动日益凸显，而在历史上依赖灌溉农业的社会中，亲气候的政治响应显著较弱。我们提出并通过实证证明，祖先灌溉以密集的邻里合作与相互依赖为特征，促进了紧密亲属网络的早期形成。这些网络可能限制了跨越亲属界限的非个人化合作，从而削弱了集体亲气候行动。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103808.abstract: We evaluate the effectiveness of randomized interventions aimed at alleviating behavioral barriers—such as maternal stress and psychological strain, limited future-oriented thinking, and information frictions—for early childhood immunization uptake in a sample of Pakistani mothers with infants. A phone-delivered intervention providing light psychological support as well as visualization and planning techniques increases the total number of vaccines received by young children by 0.3, or 7% of the control mean, one year after baseline. We also find that the intervention improves maternal knowledge, attitudes, and perceived returns to vaccination. However, supplementing this intervention with vaccination-related information from influencers does not yield additional benefits in this context.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103808.abstract_zh: 我们评估了旨在缓解行为障碍（如母亲压力和心理紧张、有限的未来导向思维以及信息摩擦）的随机干预措施，在巴基斯坦有婴儿的母亲样本中对早期儿童免疫接种的有效性。一项通过电话提供的干预，包括轻度心理支持以及可视化和规划技巧，在基线一年后，使幼儿接种疫苗的总次数增加了0.3次，相当于对照组平均值的7%。我们还发现，该干预改善了母亲的知识、态度以及对疫苗接种的感知回报。然而，在此背景下，补充来自影响者的疫苗接种相关信息并未带来额外益处。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103808.title: Improving childhood immunization through maternal support: Evidence from a randomized intervention in Pakistan
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103808.title_zh: 通过母亲支持改善儿童免疫接种：来自巴基斯坦随机干预项目的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103809.abstract: The discourse on human trafficking often depicts migrants as deceived victims, while alternative accounts view trafficking as a constrained migration strategy. We contribute to this debate using original survey data from two cross-sectional waves (2021 and 2023) covering more than 2700 respondents in Edo State, Nigeria. A substantial share of respondents reports a willingness to migrate via traffickers despite awareness of the risks of forced labor. A list experiment provides suggestive evidence of underreporting of trafficking approval, particularly among women, likely reflecting stigma surrounding sex work. We examine the determinants of trafficking approval through an aspirations–capabilities framework. Willingness to migrate via traffickers is highest among individuals with strong migration aspirations but limited capabilities. In contrast, exposure to anti-trafficking campaigns has little effect. Respondents are generally well-informed about the potential risks and returns associated with trafficking and do not exhibit cognitive biases such as motivated reasoning. Overall, our findings suggest that trafficking is not primarily driven by ignorance, but instead reflects a constrained choice shaped by limited legal migration options and structural barriers. • 1 in 4 would consider trafficking for migration despite forced labor risks in a representative survey in Edo State, Nigeria. • List experiment reveals gendered underreporting. • High aspirations and low capabilities predict trafficking approval. • Prospective migrants who would resort to trafficking hold reasonable risk and income expectations, with no evidence of motivated reasoning or selective recall. • Awareness campaigns show limited impact; structural reform is needed.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103809.abstract_zh: 关于人口贩运的讨论常将移民描绘为受骗的受害者，而另一些观点则将贩运视为一种受限的迁移策略。我们利用2021年和2023年两轮横截面调查的原始数据，覆盖尼日利亚埃多州超过2700名受访者，为这一辩论提供实证依据。相当比例的受访者表示，尽管知晓强迫劳动的风险，仍愿意通过贩运者进行迁移。一项列表实验提供了暗示性证据，表明对贩运的认可存在低报现象，尤其在女性中更为显著，这可能反映了围绕性工作的污名化。我们通过愿望-能力框架考察贩运认可的决定因素。在具有强烈迁移愿望但能力有限的个体中，通过贩运者迁移的意愿最高。相比之下，反贩运宣传活动的接触影响甚微。受访者普遍对贩运相关的潜在风险和回报有充分了解，并未表现出动机性推理等认知偏差。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，贩运并非主要由无知驱动，而是反映了在有限合法迁移选择和结构性障碍下形成的受限选择。• 在尼日利亚埃多州的一项代表性调查中，尽管存在强迫劳动风险，仍有四分之一的人会考虑通过贩运进行迁移。• 列表实验揭示了性别差异性的低报现象。• 高愿望和低能力预测贩运认可。• 可能诉诸贩运的潜在移民对风险和收入持有合理预期，没有动机性推理或选择性记忆的证据。• 宣传活动影响有限；需要进行结构性改革。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103809.title: Trafficking as choice? Evidence from Nigeria
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103809.title_zh: 贩卖作为选择？来自尼日利亚的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103811.abstract: Using a natural experiment in Indonesia, we estimate the separate economic effects of natural resource booms and shared resource revenue. Contrary to Dutch disease concerns, oil and gas booms promote manufacturing growth, and shared revenue does not harm local manufacturing firms. Shared revenue significantly raises local non-oil GDP, but resource booms do not. Supply-side factors help explain the results: shared revenue increases local population and firm entry, while resource booms do not. Oil and gas booms thus benefit local economies largely through shared revenue. Where the revenue is spent matters more for local growth than where the resources are extracted.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103811.abstract_zh: 利用印度尼西亚的一项自然实验，我们分别估算了自然资源繁荣与共享资源收入的经济效应。与“荷兰病”担忧相反，油气繁荣促进了制造业增长，而共享收入并未损害当地制造业企业。共享收入显著提升了当地非石油GDP，但资源繁荣本身并无此效果。供给侧因素有助于解释这些结果：共享收入增加了当地人口和企业进入，而资源繁荣则未产生此类影响。因此，油气繁荣主要通过共享收入惠及当地经济。收入的使用地点对当地增长的影响，比资源开采地点更为重要。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103811.title: Resource booms, revenue sharing, and growth
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103811.title_zh: 资源繁荣、收入分享与经济增长

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103814.abstract: Prevailing research suggests that climate change disproportionately burdens emerging markets and developing economies with larger output losses compared to advanced economies, positing that colder regions are less impacted than their warmer counterparts. This study revisits the empirical relationship between temperature fluctuations and real growth, with a novel focus on differentiating between transitory versus permanent temperature shifts, aligning naturally with the definitions of weather and climate change, respectively. Our findings reveal that richer and colder economies appear less affected by weather shocks, whereas this pattern reverses for climate change disturbances, challenging the conclusions of previous studies.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103814.abstract_zh: 现有研究普遍认为，气候变化对新兴市场和发展中经济体的产出损失影响更为严重，相较于发达经济体，寒冷地区所受影响较小。本研究重新审视了温度波动与实际增长之间的实证关系，创新性地聚焦于区分暂时性与永久性温度变化，这自然对应了天气与气候变化的定义。我们的研究结果显示，较富裕且较寒冷的经济体对天气冲击的影响似乎较小，但在气候变化干扰方面，这一模式发生逆转，从而对先前研究的结论提出了挑战。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103814.title: Weather or climate? A new perspective on temperature shocks
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103814.title_zh: 天气还是气候？温度冲击的新视角

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103820.abstract: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are the gold standard in causal inference. However, it is difficult for decision-makers to rely on RCTs when evaluating interventions that affect long-run outcomes. We elicit 25,980 forecasts from 505 participants to test the ability of people to predict the long-run outcomes of RCTs whose results were unknown to participants. Experienced forecasters, academic experts, and laypeople predict the outcomes of seven RCTs, each of which measured long-run outcomes at time horizons of at least five years. Experienced forecasters and academics were more accurate than laypeople, and experienced forecasters outperformed academics, at least in part due to their superior calibration. Aggregated forecasts outperform individual forecasts, showing a clear wisdom-of-the-crowd effect, but neither experienced forecasters nor academics consistently outperform simple benchmarks. We see no evidence of improved forecasting accuracy from randomly providing participants with additional information about good forecasting practices, details about the RCT interventions, or specifics about the local study context.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103820.abstract_zh: 随机对照试验（RCTs）是因果推断的金标准。然而，在评估影响长期结果的干预措施时，决策者难以仅依赖RCTs。我们征集了505名参与者的25,980份预测，以检验人们预测RCTs长期结果的能力，而这些结果对参与者而言是未知的。经验丰富的预测者、学术专家及普通民众对七项RCTs的结果进行了预测，每项试验均测量了至少五年时间跨度的长期结果。结果显示，经验丰富的预测者和学术专家的预测准确性高于普通民众，且经验丰富的预测者优于学术专家，这部分归因于他们更优的校准能力。聚合预测优于个体预测，体现了明显的群体智慧效应，但无论是经验丰富的预测者还是学术专家，均未能持续超越简单基准模型。我们未发现随机向参与者提供关于良好预测实践、RCT干预细节或当地研究背景具体信息能显著提升预测准确性的证据。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103820.title: Forecasting long-run causal effects

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103821.abstract: We exploit a novel opportunity to study the dynamics of wage inequality and labor market competition over the course of economic development. Our context is Lithuania, where two decades of sustained growth and labor market tightening coincided with a substantial decline in wage inequality. We first fit a two-way fixed-effects model with worker and firm heterogeneity and document that the compression of the variance of firm fixed effects has been the main source of the fall in inequality. Guided by a standard dynamic monopsony model, we then estimate firms’ labor supply elasticities and show that labor market competition has increased over the same period. Finally, we construct a shift-share instrument and provide evidence that new job opportunities created by the accession to the European Union in 2004 contributed to the fall in inequality through their impact on labor market competition in Lithuania.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103821.abstract_zh: 我们利用一个新颖的研究机会，探讨经济发展过程中工资不平等与劳动力市场竞争的动态变化。我们的研究背景是立陶宛，该国在经历了二十年的持续增长和劳动力市场紧缩的同时，工资不平等显著下降。我们首先拟合了一个包含工人和企业异质性的双向固定效应模型，并记录到企业固定效应方差的压缩是导致不平等下降的主要因素。在标准动态买方垄断模型的指导下，我们随后估计了企业的劳动力供给弹性，并显示在同一时期内劳动力市场竞争有所增强。最后，我们构建了一个转移份额工具，并提供证据表明，2004年加入欧盟所创造的新就业机会，通过其对立陶宛劳动力市场竞争的影响，促进了不平等的下降。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103821.title: Labor market competition and inequality
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103821.title_zh: 劳动力市场竞争与不平等

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103822.abstract: We examine how reminders for self-set goals influence productivity by analyzing data from 10,187 volunteer agricultural extension workers in Rwanda. We elicited workers’ goals and experimentally varied their salience through text reminders. Due to unforeseen logistical delays, approximately half of the treatment group received reminders after completing their tasks. We find that goal reminders received during the regular working period increased a productivity index by 0.08 standard deviations, while reminders sent late had no effect. Further analysis of heterogeneity by goal ambition quartiles reveals an inverted U-shaped relationship: reminders are effective for goals in the second and third quartiles, but ineffective for low or excessively high goals. These results suggest that workers who set ambitious yet realistic goals are more likely to respond to reminders and increase productivity, consistent with prior evidence on externally set goals.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103822.abstract_zh: 我们通过分析卢旺达10，187名农业推广志愿者的数据，探讨了针对自我设定目标的提醒如何影响生产力。我们引导工人设定目标，并通过短信提醒实验性地改变其显著性。由于不可预见的后勤延误，约半数的治疗组在完成任务后才收到提醒。我们发现，在正常工作期间收到的目标提醒使生产力指数提高了0.08个标准差，而延迟发送的提醒则无效果。进一步按目标雄心四分位数进行的异质性分析揭示了倒U型关系：提醒对第二和第三四分位数的目标有效，但对低目标或过高目标无效。这些结果表明，设定雄心勃勃且现实目标的工人更可能对提醒作出反应并提高生产力，这与先前关于外部设定目标的证据一致。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103822.title: The effect of reminders for self-set goals on productivity
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103822.title_zh: 自我设定目标的提醒对生产率的影响

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103823.abstract: This paper evaluates a multifaceted female empowerment program in urban Liberia that combined intensive psychosocial therapy with vocational skills training over 12 months. The evaluation uses a randomized controlled trial with follow-up surveys at 1 year and 3.5 years post-program (2 and 4.5 years after enrollment). At the first endline, treatment women experienced large reductions in emotional and physical/sexual intimate partner violence (IPV) and in perceived community norms supporting IPV; effects on psychological well-being were null. By 3.5 years, the treatment group’s IPV levels remained close to their first-endline values, but the treatment–control difference had closed because the control group also experienced substantial reductions. Only the gap in perceived community norms persisted. Qualitative evidence points to the psychosocial component as the primary active ingredient, while the economic arm was operationally compromised by the non-delivery of promised capital grants. We interpret the longer-term convergence as durable individual- and interpersonal-level change for treatment women, set against contemporaneous structural interventions in the study region that plausibly affected the control group in particular.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103823.abstract_zh: 本文评估了利比里亚城市地区一项多维度女性赋权项目，该项目在12个月内将强化心理社会治疗与职业技能培训相结合。评估采用随机对照试验设计，并在项目结束后1年及3.5年（即入组后2年及4.5年）进行跟踪调查。在首次终期调查中，接受干预的女性在情感及身体/性亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）方面显著减少，且其对支持IPV的社区规范的感知也有所下降；但心理幸福感方面的效果不显著。至3.5年时，干预组的IPV水平仍接近首次终期调查时的数值，但由于对照组也经历了大幅下降，干预组与对照组之间的差异已消失。仅在对社区规范的感知差距上得以持续。质性证据表明，心理社会干预是主要有效成分，而经济干预因承诺的资本赠款未予发放而在操作上受到损害。我们将长期趋同解释为干预组女性在个体及人际层面发生的持久变化，而同期研究区域内影响对照组的结构性干预措施可能尤为相关。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103823.title: Temporary acceleration or long-term change? Experimental evidence on female empowerment and intimate partner violence in urban Liberia
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103823.title_zh: 暂时加速还是长期变革？利比里亚城市地区女性赋权与亲密伴侣暴力的实验证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103824.abstract: This paper demonstrates how low-cost innovations can improve the implementation of costly government programs. We experimentally evaluate the nationwide roll-out of a new school governance program in Tanzania. As part of the program, school inspectors conduct Whole School Visits (WSVs) producing a set of school-specific ratings and recommendations—targeted at leadership, teachers, and parents—for improving school quality. However, schools faced weak incentives to implement the recommendations, and the local monitors responsible for conducting follow-up visits, who report to a different ministry, lacked direct access to WSV reports. To address this challenge, in a randomly sampled subset of program schools, monitors received text messages informing them of the main recommendations and encouraging them to follow up with schools to ensure compliance. Within the sample of schools that received WSVs, text messages improved student learning by 0.11 standard deviations after two years. Treatment effects are larger for schools that received worse inspection ratings in each domain, consistent with monitors acting on tailored rather than generic recommendations. Observed gains are concentrated in regions exposed to a donor program that provided local bureaucrats with resources to monitor. Our findings show how addressing specific bottlenecks in implementation can significantly enhance the effectiveness of government programs at scale.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103824.abstract_zh: 本文展示了低成本创新如何改善昂贵政府项目的实施效果。我们通过实验评估了坦桑尼亚一项新的学校治理项目在全国范围内的推广情况。作为项目的一部分，学校督学进行全校访问（WSVs），生成一套针对学校领导、教师和家长的具体评级与建议，旨在提升学校质量。然而，学校在落实这些建议方面面临薄弱激励，而负责后续访问的地方监督员（隶属于另一个部门）无法直接获取WSV报告。为应对这一挑战，在随机抽样的部分项目学校中，监督员收到了短信，告知主要建议并鼓励其跟进学校以确保合规。在接受WSV的学校样本中，短信干预在两年后将学生学业成绩提高了0.11个标准差。处理效应在各项评级较差的学校中更为显著，这与监督员依据定制化而非通用建议采取行动相一致。观察到的收益集中在受捐助项目影响的地区，该项目为地方官僚提供了监督资源。我们的研究结果表明，解决实施过程中的特定瓶颈可以显著提升政府项目在大规模推广中的有效性。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103825.abstract: A central mandate of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) is to provide liquidity support to countries facing balance of payment difficulties. Lending programs aim to bridge financing gaps and restore trajectories for growth and stability. The IMF's core programs condition fiscal and other policy measures in return for such support, in hopes that reforms and new financing will catalyze new (especially private) investment into the economy. There is now a deep academic literature assessing the economic and social outcomes of IMF lending programs. This study adds to this literature by evaluating the extent to which IMF programs catalyze gross fixed capital formation (GFCF) in general and private capital formation in particular. An analysis of GFCF provides insight into investment channels of growth and the productivity of IMF-catalyzed capital. We leverage a novel empirical strategy, local projections difference-in-difference. Results indicate that IMF program participation typically has ambiguous or negative impacts on capital formation. These findings add to prior work on growth and investment within IMF programs. Results also support recent calls to rethink the value of fiscal consolidation for balance of payments problems.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103825.abstract_zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）的一项核心职责是为面临国际收支困难的国家提供流动性支持。贷款项目旨在弥合融资缺口，恢复增长与稳定的轨道。IMF的核心项目以财政及其他政策措施为条件，以换取此类支持，期望改革与新增融资能够催化经济中新的（尤其是私人）投资。目前已有大量学术文献评估IMF贷款项目的经济和社会成果。本研究通过评估IMF项目在总体上催化固定资本形成总额（GFCF），特别是私人资本形成的程度，为这一文献领域做出贡献。对GFCF的分析有助于洞察增长的投资渠道及IMF催化资本的生产率。我们采用了一种新颖的实证策略——局部投影双重差分法。结果表明，IMF项目参与通常对资本形成产生模糊或负面影响。这些发现补充了先前关于IMF项目内增长与投资的研究。结果也支持了近期关于重新思考财政整顿对国际收支问题价值的呼吁。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103825.title: Adjustment without accumulation: Evidence on capital formation from IMF programs
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103825.title_zh: 调整而非积累：IMF项目中的资本形成证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103827.abstract: We present the first quantitative evaluation of the overall impact and distributional effects of railroad access on industrial growth in historical China. Using newly digitized data on railroad expansion and distance to hypothetical railroad networks as instruments, we find that railroad access significantly increased the annual entry of local industrial firms from 1858 to 1936 and industrial output in 1933. However, the effect is highly localized, concentrated in counties within 10 km of railroad lines, and stronger in historical population and transportation centers. Using a causal mediation framework to analyze the textile industry, we find that railroads facilitated firm entry primarily by enhancing market access to manufactured yarn and lowering travel costs for workers and technicians. Further evidence shows that access to railroads promoted technology adoption.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103827.abstract_zh: 我们首次对历史中国铁路通达对工业增长的整体影响及其分配效应进行了定量评估。利用新数字化的铁路扩张数据及至假设铁路网络的距离作为工具变量，我们发现铁路通达显著增加了1858年至1936年间地方工业企业的新增进入数量，并提升了1933年的工业产出。然而，这一效应高度局部化，集中于铁路线10公里范围内的县，且在历史人口与交通中心更为显著。通过运用因果中介框架分析纺织业，我们发现铁路主要通过增强对机制纱的市场准入及降低工人和技术人员的旅行成本来促进企业进入。进一步证据表明，铁路通达还促进了技术采纳。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103827.title: On the right track? Railroads, industrial development, and distributional effects in historical China
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103827.title_zh: 正轨之上？历史中国的铁路、工业发展与分配效应

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103828.abstract: We present evidence of a connection between bank concentration and labor markdown in China. Using a large dataset on bank branch distribution and firm performance in China, we document that financial friction in the local market leads to significantly higher firm-level labor markdowns but has little impact on firms’ product markup and profitability. This suggests that firms pass the impact of financial friction to the labor market by exploiting labor when faced with higher financial costs. Such transmission of financial friction is more salient among low-skill-intensity or non-state-owned firms, and greater labor mobility facilitates the transmission. Our findings highlight the distributional effect of financial friction in the economy: labor, especially the low-skilled ones, rather than capital, eventually bears the cost of financial friction.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103828.abstract_zh: 我们提供了中国银行业集中度与劳动力市场买方垄断力之间关联的证据。利用中国银行分支机构分布与企业绩效的大型数据集，我们记录了本地市场金融摩擦导致企业层面劳动力买方垄断力显著提高，但对企业的产品加成率和盈利能力影响甚微。这表明，企业在面临更高财务成本时，通过剥削劳动力将金融摩擦的影响转嫁给劳动力市场。这种金融摩擦的传导在低技能密集度或非国有企业中更为显著，而更大的劳动力流动性促进了这一传导。我们的发现强调了金融摩擦在经济中的分配效应：劳动力，尤其是低技能劳动者，而非资本，最终承担了金融摩擦的成本。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103828.title: Who bears the cost: Financial frictions and labor markdown
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103828.title_zh: 谁承担成本：金融摩擦与劳动力加价

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103831.abstract: We investigate the causal effects of the 1959 Cuban Revolution on income using a synthetic control approach. We employ a novel dataset with revised GDP estimates that do not rely on the regime’s self-reported statistics. We also analyze GDP estimates net of aid coming from the Soviet Union. Our identification strategy allows us to separate the direct effects of the revolution from the diplomatic events that ensued. By overcoming concerns that Cuban GDP statistics are inflated either by the regime’s direct manipulation or by Soviet aid, we identify a large decline in Cuban GDP per capita relative to its counterfactual. The decline is larger when accounting for Soviet aid. The embargo only accounts for a minor share of Cuba’s under-performance relative to the counterfactual. Our results hold after being subjected to multiple robustness checks and lead to the conclusion that the transition to socialism was the main driver of the inferior economic path Cuba has followed since 1959.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103831.abstract_zh: 我们采用合成控制法，探究1959年古巴革命对收入的因果效应。我们使用了一套新颖的数据集，其中包含不依赖政权自报统计的修订后GDP估算。同时，我们还分析了扣除苏联援助后的GDP估算值。我们的识别策略使我们能够将革命的直接影响与随之而来的外交事件区分开来。通过克服古巴GDP统计可能因政权直接操纵或苏联援助而虚高的担忧，我们发现古巴人均GDP相对于其反事实情景出现了大幅下降。在考虑苏联援助后，这一下降幅度更大。禁运仅解释了古巴相对于反事实表现不佳的一小部分原因。我们的结果在经历多重稳健性检验后依然成立，并得出结论：向社会主义的过渡是古巴自1959年以来经济路径落后的主要驱动力。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103831.title: The forsaken road: Reassessing living standards following the Cuban Revolution and the American embargo
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103831.title_zh: 被遗弃之路：重新评估古巴革命与美国禁运后的生活水平

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103832.abstract: Public procurement in developing countries accounts for approximately 13% of GDP, offering a significant market opportunity for domestic firms, especially those facing demand constraints. This paper explores the impact of selling to government entities on firm performance in Uganda, leveraging detailed administrative data and an event study methodology that corrects for firm self-selection and heterogeneity in the timing of the treatment. The results reveal that while firms increase their total sales after entering government contracts, they do not see improvements in productivity (measured by value added per worker). Moreover, sales to non-government customers drop sharply. This reallocation effect is persistent. This effect is not observed when firms start to sell to large private-sector buyers. Drawing on an original survey of firms engaged in public procurement, we highlight potential drivers of these dynamics, including capacity constraints and profitability differences between public and private sector sales.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103832.abstract_zh: 发展中国家的公共采购约占GDP的13%，为国内企业，尤其是面临需求约束的企业，提供了重要的市场机遇。本文利用详细的行政数据及一种修正企业自选择和处理时点异质性的事件研究方法，探讨了乌干达企业向政府实体销售对其绩效的影响。结果显示，尽管企业在获得政府合同后总销售额有所增加，但其生产率（以人均增加值衡量）并未得到提升。此外，对非政府客户的销售额急剧下降，这种重新配置效应持续存在。当企业开始向大型私营部门买家销售时，并未观察到这一效应。基于对参与公共采购企业的原始调查，我们强调了这些动态的潜在驱动因素，包括产能约束以及公共部门与私营部门销售之间的盈利差异。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103832.title: Government demand and firm growth

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103833.title: Texting parents about early child development: Behavioral changes and unintended social effects
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103833.title_zh: 关于早期儿童发展的短信提醒：行为变化与非预期社会效应

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103834.abstract: This paper presents results from a field experiment in Nigeria in which expectant mothers were offered cash payments of N2500, N4000 or N10000 conditioned on using formal medical care. A secondary intervention provided some mothers with an information signal about their pregnancy risk. We find highly non-linear effects of conditional payments—most of the incentive effect occurs on the extensive margin, with rapidly diminishing returns to incentive size. We also uncover new spillover effects: showing that incentives increase healthcare use in childhood by index children and by other children in the household. We find largely null effects of the information signal.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103834.abstract_zh: 本文报告了在尼日利亚进行的一项实地实验的结果，该实验向孕妇提供N2500、N4000或N10000的现金支付，条件是利用正规医疗服务。一项次级干预措施向部分孕妇提供了关于其妊娠风险的信息信号。我们发现，有条件支付的效果呈高度非线性——大部分激励效应发生在广泛边际上，且激励规模带来的回报迅速递减。我们还发现了新的溢出效应：激励措施增加了指数儿童及家庭中其他儿童在童年时期的医疗保健使用。我们发现信息信号的效果基本为零。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103834.title: Right-sizing incentives

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103835.title: Non-normal Empirical Bayes prediction of local welfare
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103835.title_zh: 局部福利的非正态经验贝叶斯预测

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103836.abstract: Large-scale land acquisitions (LSLAs) have expanded rapidly in developing countries and promoted as a pathway to accelerate agricultural transformation. Yet, credible evidence on their developmental and environmental impacts remains limited. This paper provides causal evidence on the effects of LSLAs on agricultural production and forest outcomes by exploiting spatial and temporal variation in the staggered implementation of LSLAs in Gambella, Ethiopia. We combine geo-referenced administrative records on land transactions (2000–2020) with high-resolution remote sensing data on crop production, forest cover, and land use. Using a heterogeneity robust difference-in-difference estimator, we find no evidence that LSLAs increase agricultural production or the share of crop land. In contrast, it leads to significant and persistent declines in tree cover and forest land share. This deforestation-production paradox suggests that, in settings characterized by weak oversight and insufficient infrastructure, poorly regulated large-scale investments can generate substantial environmental burden without delivering the anticipated structural transformation that justifies them.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103836.abstract_zh: 大规模土地收购（LSLAs）在发展中国家迅速扩张，并被推崇为加速农业转型的途径。然而，关于其发展与环境影响的可靠证据仍然有限。本文利用埃塞俄比亚甘贝拉地区大规模土地收购分阶段实施中的时空变异，提供了LSLAs对农业生产和森林结果影响的因果证据。我们将2000至2020年间地理编码的土地交易行政记录与高分辨率遥感数据（涵盖作物生产、森林覆盖和土地利用）相结合。采用异质性稳健的双重差分估计方法，我们发现没有证据表明LSLAs增加了农业生产或耕地占比。相反，它导致了树木覆盖率和林地占比的显著且持续下降。这种毁林-生产悖论表明，在监管薄弱和基础设施不足的环境中，监管不力的大规模投资可能产生巨大的环境负担，而未能实现预期的结构性转型，从而无法证明其合理性。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103836.title: Large-scale land acquisitions in Ethiopia: Impacts on agricultural productivity and deforestation
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103836.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚大规模土地收购：对农业生产率和森林砍伐的影响

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103837.abstract: Mental health conditions are becoming a significant public health concern in the developing world. This paper examines the impact of housing wealth on an individual's mental health through the lens of family relationships. By leveraging the differential effects of China's National Six Policy, which modified down payment ratios and property deed taxes based on house size, we apply a Regression Discontinuity (RD) design to isolate the causal impact of housing wealth shocks on mental health outcomes. The analysis reveals that individuals experiencing positive housing wealth shocks exhibit lower rates of depression, increased life satisfaction, and greater confidence in the future. Additionally, we find that the effects of housing wealth shocks are particularly pronounced for individuals of lower socioeconomic status. The paper further explores the mechanisms through which housing wealth influences mental health, including improved marital satisfaction, stronger parent-child relationships, increased financial investments in children's education, changes in consumption patterns, alterations in employment status, more leisure time, and reduced health risk behaviors. Our findings underscore the substantial impact of housing wealth on enhancing household well-being, particularly in developing countries.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103837.abstract_zh: 心理健康问题正日益成为发展中国家面临的重大公共卫生挑战。本文通过家庭关系的视角，考察了住房财富对个体心理健康的影响。利用中国“国六条”政策根据房屋面积调整首付比例及契税所产生的差异化效应，我们采用断点回归（RD）设计，以隔离住房财富冲击对心理健康结果的因果影响。分析显示，经历正向住房财富冲击的个体表现出较低的抑郁率、更高的生活满意度以及对未来更强的信心。此外，我们发现住房财富冲击对较低社会经济地位个体的影响尤为显著。本文进一步探讨了住房财富影响心理健康的机制，包括婚姻满意度的提升、亲子关系的加强、子女教育金融投资的增加、消费模式的改变、就业状况的变化、闲暇时间的增多以及健康风险行为的减少。我们的研究结果凸显了住房财富在提升家庭福祉方面的重要作用，尤其是在发展中国家。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103837.title: Housing wealth, family relationship and mental health: Evidence from China
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103837.title_zh: 住房财富、家庭关系与心理健康：来自中国的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103839.abstract: We measure benefits to households from Mumbai’s new Metro rail system. We estimate a commute mode choice model to value commute time savings in the short run and a housing choice model to value the improved commuting utility that households experience due to spatial sorting. Aggregate benefits from the Metro rail are over 10 times higher when spatial sorting occurs. In the short run women, college-educated workers, and workers with above median incomes experience higher benefits than their opposites. In the long run, households with lower incomes and assets and less than college education benefit more than their wealthier counterparts.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103839.abstract_zh: 我们衡量了孟买新地铁系统为家庭带来的效益。我们估计了一个通勤方式选择模型，以评估短期内的通勤时间节省价值，以及一个住房选择模型，以评估家庭因空间分选而体验到的通勤效用改善。当发生空间分选时，地铁带来的总效益超过其十倍以上。短期内，女性、受过大学教育的工人以及收入高于中位数的工人所获得的效益高于其对应群体。长期来看，收入较低、资产较少且教育水平低于大学的家庭比更富裕的家庭受益更多。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103839.title: The benefits of public transit to households: Evidence from India
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103839.title_zh: 公共交通对家庭的好处：来自印度的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103840.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of trade liberalization on structural transformation, using quasi-experimental tariff reductions from Brazil's 1990s reforms. Building on recent cross-regional macroeconomic literature, we extend the traditional shift-share framework to estimate both local and spatial spillover effects on sectoral employment shares, providing insights on aggregate outcomes. Regions more exposed to tariff cuts saw declines in manufacturing employment, increases in the primary sector, and reductions in non-tradables. Spillover effects—mediated through migration or proximity—partially offset local deindustrialization in manufacturing but amplified declines in non-tradables. These effects persisted for over twenty years and proved robust to alternative explanations, including competing structural transformation hypotheses and other economic shocks during the period of analysis. Overall, our findings support theories highlighting comparative advantage as a potential driver of trade-induced structural transformation.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103840.abstract_zh: 本文利用巴西1990年代改革中准实验性的关税削减，研究了贸易自由化对结构转型的影响。基于近期跨区域宏观经济文献，我们扩展了传统的转移-份额框架，以估计关税削减对部门就业份额的本地效应和空间溢出效应，从而揭示总体经济结果。关税削减暴露程度更高的地区经历了制造业就业下降、初级部门扩张以及非贸易部门收缩。通过移民或地理邻近性传导的溢出效应，部分抵消了制造业的本地去工业化，但加剧了非贸易部门的收缩。这些效应持续了二十多年，并在替代性解释（包括分析期间的其他经济冲击及竞争性结构转型假说）下依然稳健。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持了强调比较优势作为贸易驱动型结构转型潜在驱动力的理论。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103840.title: Local and spillover effects of trade on structural transformation: Evidence from Brazil
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103840.title_zh: 贸易对结构转型的地方与溢出效应：来自巴西的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103841.title: From rents to results: China’s anti-corruption reforms and the effectiveness of aid to Africa
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103841.title_zh: 从租金到成果：中国反腐败改革与对非援助有效性

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103843.abstract: We estimate the effects of high-speed internet in early childhood development exploiting cross-cohort and geographic differences in the introduction of fiber-optic-to-the-home. Using variation in lifetime cumulative exposure to fiber optic and combining survey and administrative data, we estimate effects on cognitive and non-cognitive outcomes measured by validated screening tests. We show that an increase in 10 percentage points in lifetime exposure to fiber optic decreases development scores between 6% and 17% of a standard deviation in communication, problem solving and social skills. An analysis of heterogeneous effects shows that the negative impact is larger for children with more educated parents.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103843.abstract_zh: 我们利用光纤到户引入过程中的跨队列与地理差异，评估高速互联网对儿童早期发展的影响。通过利用一生中累积光纤暴露的变异，并结合调查与行政数据，我们估计了其对认知及非认知结果的影响，这些结果通过验证过的筛查测试来衡量。研究表明，一生中光纤暴露率每增加10个百分点，沟通、问题解决及社交技能的发展得分将下降6%至17%的标准差。异质性效应分析显示，父母教育程度更高的儿童所受负面影响更为显著。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103843.title: Is high-speed internet detrimental for early childhood development? Evidence from a countrywide program
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103843.title_zh: 高速互联网对幼儿发展有害吗？来自全国性项目的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103844.abstract: We investigate how information frictions affect the efficacy of contraception provision programs. We study a Costa-Rican initiative that combined two pillars: free access to long-acting-reversible contraceptives; and a tailored information campaign to raise awareness and correct for baseline misperceptions. Using administrative data and geographic variation in the initiative, we find a 16% decrease in the teen birth rate. We show information complements access: districts exposed to both pillars experience substantially larger reductions than those with contraception access alone. Using surveys on sexual behavior, we show the initiative shifted the information source from personal networks to healthcare professionals, amending misperceptions on sexual health.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103844.abstract_zh: 我们探讨信息摩擦如何影响避孕提供项目的有效性。我们研究了一项哥斯达黎加倡议，该倡议结合了两大支柱：免费获取长效可逆避孕药具；以及一项量身定制的信息宣传活动，旨在提高认识并纠正基线误解。利用行政数据和该倡议的地理差异，我们发现青少年生育率下降了16%。我们表明信息与获取途径相辅相成：同时接触两大支柱的地区，其生育率下降幅度显著大于仅能获取避孕药具的地区。通过关于性行为的调查，我们显示该倡议将信息来源从个人社交网络转向医疗保健专业人员，从而修正了关于性健康的误解。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103844.title: The complementary role of information and contraceptive access in teen pregnancy
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103844.title_zh: 信息与避孕措施可及性在青少年怀孕中的互补作用

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103851.abstract: This study evaluates the long-term effects of a nationwide immunization program in Burkina Faso, known as the National Vaccination Commando Program, implemented in late 1984. Focusing on the measles vaccination component of the program and using a difference-in-differences approach, we find significant reductions in child mortality and improvements in educational attainment, including increased primary and secondary school completion. We also find significant positive effects on adult employment and agricultural productivity, yielding a substantial return on this early health investment. These findings underscore the lasting benefits of early childhood health interventions in low-income countries.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103851.abstract_zh: 本研究评估了布基纳法索于1984年末实施的全国性免疫计划——“国家疫苗接种突击计划”的长期效应。聚焦于该计划中的麻疹疫苗接种部分，并采用双重差分法，我们发现儿童死亡率显著下降，教育成就有所提升，包括小学和中学完成率的提高。同时，我们还发现该计划对成人就业和农业生产力产生了显著的正面影响，为这一早期健康投资带来了可观的回报。这些发现强调了在低收入国家，儿童早期健康干预措施的持久益处。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103851.title: The lasting effects of early childhood interventions: The National Vaccination Commando Program in Burkina Faso
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103851.title_zh: 早期儿童干预的持久影响：布基纳法索国家疫苗接种突击计划

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103852.abstract: We conduct a randomized controlled trial across Kenyan courts to tackle a major source of court delays: adjournments, i.e., postponements of cases to later dates without reaching a resolution. Partnering with the Kenyan Judiciary, we introduce a simple, cost-effective one-page document that outlines the main reasons for adjournments in each court. We test this intervention in two experimental arms: one where the information is shared with judges, and the other where it is shared with both judges and court user committees. Our intervention successfully prevents approximately 20,000 adjournments nationwide, with each adjournment previously delaying cases by an average of 3 months. The acceleration of court proceedings leads to a notable increase in the demand for and utilization of the legal system, increasing the filing of cases as well as citizen trust in the justice system. Our findings demonstrate that tackling the underlying reasons for court delays can substantially enhance both the perceived and actual performance of judicial systems, fostering greater usage and trust in legal institutions. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103852.abstract_zh: 我们在肯尼亚各级法院开展了一项随机对照试验，旨在解决导致法院案件积压的主要根源——休庭（即案件未达成裁决而延期审理）。通过与肯尼亚司法机构合作，我们引入了一份简单且成本低廉的单页文件，该文件概述了各法院休庭的主要原因。我们在两个实验组中测试了这一干预措施：一组仅向法官提供信息，另一组则同时向法官和法院用户委员会提供信息。我们的干预措施成功在全国范围内避免了约2万次休庭，而此前每次休庭平均导致案件延迟3个月。诉讼程序的加速显著提升了法律系统的需求与利用率，案件立案数量增加，公民对司法系统的信任度也随之提高。研究结果表明，解决法院延迟的根本原因能够显著提升司法系统的实际效能与公众感知，从而促进法律机构的更广泛使用与信任。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103852.title: Making information actionable: Experimental evidence from Kenyan courts
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103852.title_zh: 使信息可操作：来自肯尼亚法院的实验证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103853.abstract: We evaluate a farmer training intervention for smallholder dairy farmers in Uganda, demonstrating that an at-scale version of the “contact farmer” extension model can significantly increase milk production and be cost-effective. In this model, one “farmer trainer” is selected per village and trained to disseminate knowledge to other farmers. Using experimental sub-treatment arms, and a combination of observed and self-reported data, we assess three key components designed to enhance the program’s impact: (i) non-monetary incentives for farmer trainers, (ii) support from professional extension agents, and (iii) a curriculum that combines key principles of animal nutrition and technology choice with a broad set of feeding practices. Results show positive impacts along the hypothesized causal chain, from knowledge acquisition by farmer trainers to knowledge of the farmers they train, and increases in their technology adoption, production, and profits.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103853.abstract_zh: 我们评估了一项针对乌干达小农户奶牛养殖者的农民培训干预措施，证明“联络农民”推广模式的大规模版本能显著提高牛奶产量并具有成本效益。在此模式中，每个村庄选出一名“农民培训师”，接受培训后将知识传播给其他农民。通过实验性子处理组，结合观测数据与自我报告数据，我们评估了旨在增强项目影响力的三个关键组成部分：（i）对农民培训师的非货币激励，（ii）专业推广人员的支持，以及（iii）结合动物营养关键原则、技术选择与广泛饲养实践的课程。结果显示，沿着假设的因果链条产生了积极影响，从农民培训师获取知识，到他们所培训农民的知识增长，再到技术采纳、产量和利润的提升。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103853.title: Social learning in agriculture: A scalable farmer-to-farmer extension approach for dairy farmers
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103853.title_zh: 农业中的社会学习：一种可扩展的奶农间推广方法

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103854.abstract: Mitigating transboundary pollution requires internalizing environmental externalities and coordinating inter-jurisdictional interests. This paper examines the environmental and economic consequences of China's watershed ecological compensation (WEC) policy, a government-led property rights allocation scheme that combines Coasean bargaining with state-contingent contracts. By exploiting the progressive roll-out of inter-provincial WEC schemes and employing a difference-in-difference-in-differences design with a novel county-level dataset containing long-term industrial water pollutant information, we find that upstream counties experience significant reductions in pollution emissions but slower economic growth relative to their adjacent downstream counties after policy implementation. Event study estimates further indicate that environmental governance entailing high economic costs is difficult to sustain over time, reflecting a potential misalignment between costs and benefits in environmental protection. These effects can be attributed to pollution-control-oriented policy measures adopted by upstream local governments and the resulting responses of firms and residents.
