We further show that upstream local governments' prioritization of environmental governance is shaped by both economic and political incentives. Our findings offer insights into institutional design for improving transboundary water quality in countries with decentralized environmental management systems.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103854.abstract_zh: 缓解跨界污染需要将环境外部性内部化并协调跨辖区利益。本文研究了中国流域生态补偿（WEC）政策的环境与经济后果，该政策是一种政府主导的产权分配机制，结合了科斯式谈判与状态依赖契约。利用省际流域生态补偿方案的逐步推广，并采用包含长期工业水污染物信息的新型县级数据集进行三重差分设计，我们发现，与相邻下游县相比，政策实施后上游县的污染排放显著减少，但经济增长速度相对放缓。事件研究估计进一步表明，涉及高经济成本的环境治理难以长期维持，反映出环境保护中成本与收益之间可能存在的错配。这些效应可归因于上游地方政府采取的以污染控制为导向的政策措施以及企业和居民的相应反应。我们进一步表明，上游地方政府对环境治理的优先排序受到经济和政治激励的双重影响。我们的研究为在环境管理分散化国家中改善跨界水质的制度设计提供了启示。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103854.title: Evaluating the environmental and economic implications of curbing transboundary pollution: Evidence from China
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103854.title_zh: 遏制跨界污染的环境与经济影响评估：来自中国的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103859.abstract: Despite decades of reform, early marriage and dowry remain pervasive in rural India. I examine whether women's political representation shifts these practices. I develop a model in which households choose daughters' marriage timing and dowry, facing social penalties for non-marriage. Female leaders, by expanding women's economic opportunities, increase the value of daughters and delay marriage. When social penalties are high, delays raise dowry. I test this using exogenous variation from India's 1992 constitutional amendment, which reserved one-third of village council (pradhan) seats for women. Data from a representative rural survey shows that female pradhans delay marriage by 1.22 years and increase dowry by 68%. A 29% rise in female labor force participation partly explains the delay. Dowry increases are concentrated in patriarchal states, where penalties for non-marriage are most severe. The findings highlight both the potential and the limits of political empowerment in transforming marital norms under binding social constraints.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103859.abstract_zh: 尽管历经数十年改革，童婚与嫁妆在印度农村地区依然普遍存在。本文考察女性政治代表权是否改变了这些习俗。我构建了一个模型，其中家庭在面临未婚的社会惩罚时，会选择女儿的结婚时机与嫁妆。女性领导人通过拓宽女性的经济机会，提升了女儿的价值并推迟了婚龄。当社会惩罚较高时，推迟婚龄会增加嫁妆。我利用印度1992年宪法修正案产生的外生变异进行检验，该修正案将村务委员会（pradhan）席位的三分之一保留给女性。来自代表性农村调查的数据显示，女性pradhan使婚龄推迟了1.22年，并使嫁妆增加了68%。女性劳动力参与率上升29%部分解释了这一推迟现象。嫁妆的增加集中在父权制邦，这些地区对未婚的社会惩罚最为严重。研究结果凸显了在刚性社会约束下，政治赋权在转变婚姻规范方面的潜力与局限。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103859.title: Political empowerment and marital practices

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103860.abstract: Efforts to measure and advance research on intimate partner violence (IPV) often rely on the analysis of data collected from confidential household surveys. Yet, even in confidential settings, women may underreport IPV. I present evidence that, in Sub-Saharan Africa, women with husbands who consume alcohol are 6.4 percentage points less likely to self-report severe physical and/or sexual IPV during evening surveys than during morning surveys. This finding occurs because the expected marginal costs of IPV reporting increase over the day with husbands’ alcohol consumption. My back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that, even if only 10% of interviews conducted by nationally representative IPV survey efforts occur during the evening, time-of-day effects exclude over 314,496 women from estimates of the most severe forms of IPV across Sub-Saharan Africa.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103860.abstract_zh: 衡量和推进亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）研究的工作，往往依赖于对保密性家庭调查所收集数据的分析。然而，即便在保密环境中，女性也可能低报IPV。我提供的证据表明，在撒哈拉以南非洲，丈夫饮酒的女性在晚间调查中自我报告严重身体和/或性IPV的可能性比晨间调查低6.4个百分点。这一发现之所以出现，是因为随着一天中丈夫饮酒量的增加，IPV报告的预期边际成本也随之上升。我的粗略估算显示，即使全国代表性IPV调查工作中仅有10%的访谈在晚间进行，时间效应也会使撒哈拉以南非洲超过314,496名女性被排除在最严重形式IPV的估计之外。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103860.title: Time-of-day effects on disclosure of intimate partner violence
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103860.title_zh: 日内时段对亲密伴侣暴力披露的影响

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103861.abstract: We study the effects of immigration during the Age of Mass Migration (1855–1920) on Brazil’s agricultural development in 1920. Instrumenting for a municipality’s immigrant share using the interaction of aggregate immigrant inflows and the expansion of Brazil’s railway network, we find that a greater share of European immigrants in a municipality led to an increase in farm values. The bulk of the effect was the product of more intense cultivation of land. We also find that it is unlikely that immigration slowed Brazil’s structural transformation. Our results imply that immigration into an emerging agricultural economy can contribute substantially to agricultural development.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103861.abstract_zh: 我们研究了大规模移民时期（1855-1920年）移民对巴西1920年农业发展的影响。利用总移民流入与巴西铁路网络扩张的交互作用作为市政区移民比例的工具变量，我们发现，市政区中欧洲移民比例的增加导致了农场价值的提升。这一效应主要源于土地更密集的耕作。同时，我们也不认为移民减缓了巴西的结构转型。我们的研究结果表明，移民进入一个新兴农业经济体，能显著促进其农业发展。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103861.title: The effects of immigration on agricultural development
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103861.title_zh: 移民对农业发展的影响

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103862.abstract: This paper studies the effects of rural electrification on girls' schooling and later life-course outcomes in rural China. We draw on the Rural Electrification through Small Hydropower (SHP-RE), which was rolled out across counties in three waves during the 1980s and 1990s. Using county-cohort data and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate the effects of exposure to electrification by age 15. SHP-RE increased girls' upper-secondary enrollment by 5.1 percentage points, with no comparable gains for boys. The effects are concentrated among cohorts exposed during later childhood and early adolescence. Exposure also delayed women's age at first marriage and reduced the probability of marrying before age 20. Mechanism evidence is most consistent with reduced domestic labor burden for girls and greater adoption of labor-saving household technology. Counties electrified earlier also later exhibited higher shares of women with upper-secondary education or above and greater enterprise-registration density. Overall, the results show that rural electrification generated large and persistent gains for girls and women at key human-capital and life-course margins.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103862.abstract_zh: 本文研究了农村电气化对中国农村女孩教育及后续人生轨迹的影响。我们利用通过小水电实现农村电气化（SHP-RE）项目，该项目在20世纪80年代和90年代分三波在县域推广。基于县-队列数据并采用双重差分设计，我们估算了15岁前接触电气化的效应。SHP-RE使女孩的高中阶段入学率提高了5.1个百分点，而对男孩则无显著类似增益。这些效应集中在童年后期及青春期早期接触电气化的队列中。接触电气化还推迟了女性的初婚年龄，并降低了20岁前结婚的概率。机制证据最符合女孩家务劳动负担减轻及省力家用技术采纳增加的解释。较早电气化的县后来也表现出女性高中及以上教育比例更高以及企业注册密度更大。总体而言，研究结果表明，农村电气化在关键人力资本和人生轨迹方面为女孩和女性带来了显著且持久的收益。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103862.title: The power of electricity: Small hydropower and girls’ education
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103862.title_zh: 电力的力量：小水电与女童教育

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103863.abstract: While the benefits of cash transfers are well documented, little attention has been given to the negative effects of their cessation, particularly on mental health. We examined this question using South African longitudinal survey data comprising 7899 unique adolescents tracked as they age out of the Child Support Grant , the country’s largest cash transfer. We find that loss of the Child Support Grant leads to a decline in mental health equivalent to 0.42 of a standard deviation in the CES-D score, robust across model specifications and falsification tests. Increased job search activity points to resource mobilisation as a plausible mechanism, consistent with the Conservation of Resources framework. Effects are concentrated among adolescents in urban areas and households with lower and less diversified income. The results point to a neglected aspect of social protection: how and when cash transfers are withdrawn, particularly when this coincides with critical life stages.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103863.abstract_zh: 尽管现金转移支付的好处已有充分记录，但其终止所带来的负面影响，尤其是对心理健康的影响，却鲜少受到关注。我们利用南非纵向调查数据，追踪了7899名青少年在退出该国最大现金转移项目——儿童抚养补助金——过程中的情况，来探讨这一问题。研究发现，失去儿童抚养补助金会导致心理健康状况下降，相当于CES-D评分中0.42个标准差的变化，这一结果在多种模型设定和证伪检验中均保持稳健。求职活动的增加表明资源动员是一个可能的机制，这与资源保护理论框架相符。影响主要集中在城市地区及收入较低且来源单一的青少年家庭中。这些结果揭示了社会保护中被忽视的一个方面：现金转移支付如何及何时被撤回，尤其是当这一过程与关键生命阶段相重叠时。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103863.title: The mental health impact for adolescents ageing out of South Africa’s child support grant
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103863.title_zh: 南非儿童抚养补助金到期对青少年心理健康的影响

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103864.abstract: A lack of longitudinal data has largely prevented the detection of chronic depression among refugees and its intergenerational associations. I link three years of parental depression measures to children’s socio-emotional development and school attendance for Syrian refugees in Jordan. First, chronic depression is common, with over a quarter of adults likely depressed in all three survey rounds. Second, the chronicity of likely parental depression is strongly associated with increasing risk of abnormal child socio-emotional development, and both likely depression and abnormal socio-emotional development are associated with lower school attendance. The results point to caregiver behavior and household tensions as a potential mechanism. Chronic depression among a broadly representative sample of refugees appears to be prevalent and related to urgent child development and human capital needs.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103864.abstract_zh: 纵向数据的缺乏在很大程度上阻碍了对难民慢性抑郁症及其代际关联的检测。我将约旦叙利亚难民父母三年的抑郁测量数据与儿童的社会情感发展及入学情况相联系。首先，慢性抑郁症普遍存在，超过四分之一的成年人在全部三轮调查中可能均处于抑郁状态。其次，父母可能患有慢性抑郁症与儿童异常社会情感发展风险增加密切相关，而可能的抑郁状态及异常社会情感发展均与较低的入学率相关联。研究结果指出，照护者行为及家庭紧张关系可能是潜在的作用机制。在具有广泛代表性的难民样本中，慢性抑郁症似乎普遍存在，并与紧迫的儿童发展及人力资本需求相关。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103864.title: Chronic depression, child development and human capital among the forcibly displaced: Evidence from Syrian refugees
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103864.title_zh: 被迫流离失所者中的慢性抑郁症、儿童发展与人力资本：来自叙利亚难民的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103865.abstract: Does globalization weaken worker’s rights? Data is inconclusive; what evidence there is suggests a developing country tends to strengthen labor rights when its access to global value chains (GVC’s) increases. We present a stylized model of multinational firms choosing host locations for global value chains, in which each host-country government chooses the strength of collective-bargaining rights for its workers. Each government trades the direct benefit of stronger bargaining rights against the effect of chasing multinationals away to rival countries. We find that an increase in globalization in the sense of lower transaction costs has no effect on equilibrium workers’ rights, but lower costs for one country tend to strengthen that country’s labor rights, and adding more countries to the global economy tends, in the limit, to weaken them.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103865.abstract_zh: 全球化是否会削弱工人的权利？现有数据尚无定论；已有的证据表明，当发展中国家融入全球价值链（GVCs）的程度提高时，其往往倾向于加强劳动权利。我们构建了一个模型，描述跨国公司选择全球价值链东道国位置的过程，其中每个东道国政府决定其工人集体谈判权利的强度。每个政府都在加强谈判权利的直接利益与将跨国公司驱赶至竞争对手国家的影响之间进行权衡。我们发现，以降低交易成本为表现的全球化增强，对均衡状态下的工人权利没有影响；但某一国家成本的降低倾向于加强该国的劳动权利，而全球经济中增加更多国家，在极限情况下，则倾向于削弱这些权利。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103865.title: Foreign direct investment, global value chains, and labor rights: No race-to-the-bottom?
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103865.title_zh: 外国直接投资、全球价值链与劳工权利：没有逐底竞争？

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103866.title: More power outages, more CO2 emissions: Evidence from self-generation in China's manufacturing firms
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103866.title_zh: 更多停电，更多二氧化碳排放：来自中国制造业企业自发电的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103867.abstract: We examine how son preference affects women’s mental health across generations using original survey data from extended households in rural India. Leveraging exogenous variation in the sex of the firstborn child, we find that mothers-in-law (MILs) whose co-resident daughter-in-law (DIL) had a firstborn son face a 15 percent lower risk of anxiety or depression. In contrast, firstborn sex has no average effect on DIL mental health, although adverse effects of not having a son emerge among older DILs who face a closing reproductive window. We also find that a DIL’s firstborn son shifts MIL time allocation toward childcare and increases her support for DIL employment when children are young, boosting younger DILs’ labor force participation. These findings reveal an intergenerational pathway linking son preference to women’s mental health, intrahousehold dynamics, and economic outcomes beyond fertility alone.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103867.abstract_zh: 我们利用印度农村扩展家庭的一手调查数据，考察了子女性别偏好如何跨代影响女性心理健康。通过利用头胎子女性别的外生变异，我们发现，与同住的儿媳（DIL）生育头胎为儿子的婆婆（MIL）相比，其焦虑或抑郁风险降低了15%。相反，头胎子女性别对儿媳的心理健康平均无显著影响，但在面临生育窗口即将关闭的年长儿媳中，未生育儿子带来的不利影响则显现出来。我们还发现，儿媳的头胎儿子使得婆婆将更多时间分配于照料孙辈，并在孩子年幼时增加对儿媳就业的支持，从而促进了年轻儿媳的劳动力参与。这些发现揭示了一条跨代路径，将子女性别偏好与女性心理健康、家庭内部动态及超越生育本身的经济结果联系起来。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103867.title: Son preference, intergenerational household dynamics, and women’s mental health in India
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103867.title_zh: 子女性别偏好、代际家庭动态与印度女性心理健康

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103868.abstract: Standard intergenerational measures have been shown to understate the long-run persistence of socioeconomic advantages in developed countries. We study theoretically and empirically whether this pattern extends to less developed settings, using Indonesia as a case study. Using the Indonesian Family Life Survey (IFLS) and Census data, we study multigenerational correlations in education across three generations. Contrary to previous findings, we observe greater multigenerational mobility than parent-child correlations alone would suggest. We develop a theoretical framework to highlight two key factors influencing multigenerational dynamics in developing countries: (1) financial and credit constraints, and (2) cultural norms related to marital sorting. To confirm their relevance, we exploit regional variations in exposure to the 1997-98 Asian financial crisis and in marital customs.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103868.abstract_zh: 标准代际衡量指标已被证明会低估发达国家社会经济优势的长期持续性。我们以印度尼西亚为案例，从理论和实证层面研究这一模式是否同样适用于欠发达地区。通过运用印度尼西亚家庭生活调查（IFLS）及人口普查数据，我们考察了横跨三代人的教育代际相关性。与既有研究发现相反，我们观察到三代人之间的代际流动性高于仅基于亲子两代关联性所呈现的水平。我们构建了一个理论框架，揭示影响发展中国家代际动态的两个关键因素：（1）金融与信贷约束；（2）与婚配选择相关的文化规范。为验证其相关性，我们利用各地区在1997-98年亚洲金融危机中的暴露程度差异以及婚俗差异进行实证分析。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103868.title: Educational mobility across multiple generations in Indonesia
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103868.title_zh: 印度尼西亚多代际教育流动性

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103869.abstract: Accurate estimates of food and nutrient elasticities are important inputs for the design of efficient policies targeting the poor. In this paper we estimate the expenditure elasticity of food and calories using exogenous variation in budget from two unconditional cash transfer programs in rural Kenya, combined with detailed data on food expenditure, nutrition and prices. We find an elasticity of food expenditure of 0.86 and of calories of 0.66. Although these estimates are higher than those reported in many previous studies — plausibly because our study focuses on extremely poor households — they are significantly lower than those obtained using a non-experimental analysis in our context.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103869.abstract_zh: 准确估计食物和营养弹性是设计针对贫困人口的有效政策的重要依据。本文利用肯尼亚农村地区两项无条件现金转移项目带来的预算外生变化，结合详细的食品支出、营养和价格数据，估算了食品和卡路里的支出弹性。研究发现，食品支出弹性为0.86，卡路里弹性为0.66。尽管这些估计值高于许多先前研究报告的结果——可能因为本研究聚焦于极端贫困家庭——但它们显著低于在本研究情境下通过非实验分析所得出的数值。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103869.title: The expenditure elasticity for food and calories: Evidence from unconditional cash transfers in Kenya
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103869.title_zh: 食品与卡路里的支出弹性：来自肯尼亚无条件现金转移支付的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103870.abstract: This paper examines the long-term economic and cultural impacts of the postbellum migration of Southern white individuals to Brazil. Following the U.S. Civil War, thousands of individuals from the former Confederacy settled in a relatively poor region of São Paulo, contributing to its transformation into one of Brazil's wealthiest areas. I show that these migrants, though a small group, played a significant role in regional industrialization, particularly in cotton and textile industries, and in the mechanization of agriculture. Some of the migrants' cultural traits, such as Protestantism and English language use, persisted over time, largely due to the physical infrastructure they established. Unlike similar migrations within the U.S., I find no evidence of persistent legacies in terms of politics or racial inequality, emphasizing the role of local infrastructure in shaping the economic and cultural outcomes of immigration.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103870.abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国内战后南方白人移民巴西的长期经济与文化影响。美国内战结束后，数千名前邦联成员定居于圣保罗一个相对贫困的地区，为该地区转变为巴西最富裕区域之一做出了贡献。我证明，这些移民虽人数不多，却在区域工业化中发挥了重要作用，尤其是在棉花和纺织产业以及农业机械化方面。移民的部分文化特征，如新教信仰和英语使用，随时间持续存在，这主要归功于他们所建立的有形基础设施。与美国境内类似迁移不同，我未发现政治或种族不平等方面的持久遗留影响，这强调了地方基础设施在塑造移民经济与文化成果中的关键作用。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103870.title: Southern roots abroad: The long-run impact of the Confederate migration to Brazil
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103870.title_zh: 海外南方根源：美国邦联移民巴西的长期影响

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103871.abstract: This paper provides evidence that audits can be an effective instrument for improving public services, depending on institutional and sectoral conditions. Leveraging randomized audits of municipal funds in Brazil, I show that audits led to better outcomes for public school students, but were not as effective in improving the provision of other public services. Using a difference-in-differences strategy, I show causal evidence that the audits led to a decrease in dropout rates in municipal elementary and middle schools by 0.41 percentage points (17%), and that this effect persisted for more than eight years. These estimates correspond to approximately one-third of the decrease in dropout rates resulting from the early years of Bolsa Família, a conditional cash transfer program partially designed to minimize student abandonment. The audits were most effective in municipalities where high levels of corruption were uncovered, and whose residents relied heavily on conditional cash transfers.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103871.abstract_zh: 本文提供了证据表明，审计能否成为改善公共服务的有效工具，取决于制度与部门条件。利用巴西市政资金随机审计，我展示了审计改善了公立学校学生的成果，但在提升其他公共服务供给方面效果不彰。采用双重差分策略，我提供了因果证据，表明审计使市政小学和初中的辍学率下降了0.41个百分点（17%），且这一效应持续超过八年。这些估计值相当于早期“家庭补助金”计划（一项部分旨在减少学生辍学的有条件现金转移项目）所带来辍学率下降的三分之一左右。审计在腐败问题严重且居民高度依赖有条件现金转移的市政区域效果最为显著。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103871.title: Monitoring and delivering: Evidence from dropout rates in Brazil
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103871.title_zh: 监控与交付：来自巴西辍学率的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103872.abstract: I use a novel and confidential administrative dataset from a highly rated economics program in Bangladesh to show that female students taught by female instructors gain approximately 9 percent of a standard deviation in grade performance relative to their male counterparts. In addition, I find suggestive evidence that female students benefit more than male students from cumulative exposure to female instructors in longer-term outcomes, such as degree completion time and the likelihood of enrolling in an economics master’s program. The quasi-random allocation of students to mandatory courses, where students cannot select either courses or instructors, alleviates self-selection concerns. I rule out the explanation that the gain is driven by gender preference in teachers’ assessment and find that the gain appears to be driven by instructor gender itself rather than by teacher attributes correlated with gender, as the effect remains large and statistically significant even after controlling for observable teacher characteristics.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103872.abstract_zh: 我利用来自孟加拉国一个高评级经济学项目的全新且保密的行政数据集，表明由女性教师授课的女学生，在成绩表现上相对于男同学大约提高了0.09个标准差。此外，我发现了提示性证据，即在长期成果方面，如学位完成时间和注册经济学硕士项目的可能性，女学生从累积接触女性教师中获益多于男学生。学生被准随机分配到必修课程，且无法选择课程或教师，这缓解了自我选择方面的担忧。我排除了成绩提升是由教师评估中的性别偏好驱动的解释，并发现这种提升似乎是由教师性别本身而非与性别相关的教师特征所驱动，因为在控制可观察的教师特征后，该效应依然显著且统计上显著。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103872.title: The match between ‘She’ and ‘Her’: Performance gains from gender match in higher education
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103872.title_zh: 她”与“她的”匹配：高等教育中性别匹配带来的绩效提升

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103873.abstract: When and how to phase out existing regulations represents a critical policy issue for developing countries. This paper investigates the effects of export inspection deregulation, exploiting the removal of China's compulsory inspection regulation for export commodities as a quasi-experiment. We construct a unique firm-level panel dataset comprising 8700 observations by mapping 10-digit HS product codes to firm identifiers and integrating four distinct micro-databases. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) framework, we find that deregulating export compulsory inspection exerts an overall positive impact on firm exports, without causing a significant decline in export quality as measured by consumer willingness to pay. We also find that inspection deregulation strengthens firms' innovation capacity, which suggests that innovation could be a mechanism that promotes export performance. Furthermore, we find that the effects of export inspection deregulation are stronger in industries characterized by higher levels of competition. Our findings provide empirical evidence for the benefits of periodic regulatory re-evaluation and suggest that well-designed phase-out mechanisms can foster innovation-led growth in emerging economies.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103873.abstract_zh: 何时以及如何逐步取消现有法规，是发展中国家面临的关键政策问题。本文以中国取消出口商品强制检验规定为准自然实验，探究出口检验放松管制的影响。通过将10位HS编码产品映射至企业标识，并整合四个不同的微观数据库，我们构建了一个包含8700个观测值的独特企业层面面板数据集。运用双重差分（DID）框架，我们发现放松出口强制检验对企业出口整体上产生积极影响，且并未导致以消费者支付意愿衡量的出口质量显著下降。同时，检验放松管制增强了企业的创新能力，这表明创新可能是促进出口绩效的一个机制。此外，我们发现出口检验放松管制在竞争程度较高的行业中效果更为显著。我们的研究为定期重新评估法规的益处提供了经验证据，并表明设计良好的退出机制能够促进新兴经济体的创新驱动型增长。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103873.title: The Effectiveness of Entry Deregulation: Quasi-experimental Evidence from China’s Export Compulsory Inspection Deregulation
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103873.title_zh: 准入放松的有效性：来自中国出口强制检验放松的准实验证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103874.abstract: This study investigates the upward intergenerational effects of adult children's high-level human capital accumulation on their older parents' risky behaviors. By exploiting the large-scale higher education expansion in China and applying the Treatment Effects Model, we find that children's higher education leads to a significant reduction in their parents' cigarette smoking. However, such effects cannot be found when it comes to an education increase triggered by the compulsory education popularization. These behavior-modifying effects are more pronounced among fathers and less advantaged families, and sons and firstborns within the family play a more effective role in generating such effects. Further evidence is provided for several underlying mechanisms, including increased security in life, more health knowledge, and rural-to-urban migration for older parents. Our findings indicate an about 8.41% contribution to the declining smoking prevalence since the late 1990s, and also imply narrowing health inequality among the older population in the long run.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103874.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了成年子女高水平人力资本积累对老年父母风险行为的向上代际影响。利用中国大规模高等教育扩张，并应用处理效应模型，我们发现子女接受高等教育显著减少了父母吸烟行为。然而，由义务教育普及引发的教育提升并未产生此类效应。这些行为改变效应在父亲及弱势家庭中更为显著，且家庭中的儿子和长子/长女在产生此类效应中扮演更有效的角色。进一步证据揭示了若干潜在机制，包括生活安全感增强、健康知识增加以及老年父母从农村向城市迁移。我们的研究结果表明，自20世纪90年代末以来，这一效应约占吸烟率下降的8.41%，并长期内意味着老年人口健康不平等状况的缩小。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103874.title: Adult Children’s Human Capital Accumulation and Parents’ Risky Behaviors: Evidence from the Higher Education Expansion in China
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103874.title_zh: 成年子女的人力资本积累与父母的危险行为：来自中国高等教育扩招的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103875.abstract: This paper revisits the political economy of transitions to democracy. We extend a canonical rational choice model of democratization by introducing demographic structure, arguing that it shapes the material incentives for political mobilization. Younger cohorts benefit from democratic change over a longer horizon and face lower costs of participation, as they are less economically and socially integrated. As a result, increases in the youth share–such as during the demographic transition–can create a “window of opportunity” for democratization by strengthening the threat of political unrest faced by autocratic elites. We test this prediction using country-year panel data with detailed information on population age structure. Fixed-effects regressions reveal a robust positive relationship between the youth share and the likelihood of democratic improvement. This effect is strongest for the youngest cohorts, in particular individuals aged 15–19. To address concerns about endogeneity, we implement an instrumental variable strategy based on lagged fertility, including variation from neighboring countries. The IV estimates are consistent with the baseline results and are interpreted with appropriate caution. We also show that the effect of the youth share is amplified during economic downturns, highlighting a complementarity between demographic and macroeconomic forces.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103875.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了民主转型的政治经济学。我们通过引入人口结构，扩展了一个经典的民主化理性选择模型，认为人口结构塑造了政治动员的物质激励。较年轻的群体从民主变革中获益的时间跨度更长，且参与成本较低，因为他们经济和社会融入程度较低。因此，青年人口比例的增加——例如在人口转型期间——可能通过增强专制精英所面临的政治动荡威胁，为民主化创造“机会之窗”。我们利用包含详细人口年龄结构的国家-年度面板数据来检验这一预测。固定效应回归显示，青年人口比例与民主改善的可能性之间存在稳健的正相关关系。这一效应在最为年轻的群体中最为显著，尤其是15至19岁的个体。为解决内生性问题，我们实施了基于滞后生育率的工具变量策略，包括来自邻国的变异。工具变量估计结果与基线结果一致，并需谨慎解读。我们还表明，青年人口比例的影响在经济衰退期间被放大，凸显了人口与宏观经济力量之间的互补性。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103875.title: The youth dividend: Political impacts of demographic transitions
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103875.title_zh: 青年红利：人口转变的政治影响

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103876.abstract: Firms in low- and middle-income countries rarely advertise their vacancies formally and instead use social networks to find employees. We experimentally reduce the cost of formal employee search for small and medium-sized enterprises in Ethiopia to test whether informal search constrains the number and type of positions firms create. We find that treated firms increase formal search and shift their labor demand towards more demanding white-collar positions. However, they struggle to fill these newly created vacancies. We provide suggestive evidence that expectations contribute to this result, especially when firms lack prior experience with formal hiring channels: firms appear overly optimistic about the applicant pools formal search will generate, and job-seekers’ wage expectations exceed firms’ wages.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103876.abstract_zh: 中低收入国家的企业很少正式发布招聘广告，而是利用社交网络寻找员工。我们通过实验降低埃塞俄比亚中小企业正式员工搜索的成本，以检验非正式搜索是否限制了企业创造的职位数量与类型。我们发现，受处理的企业增加了正式搜索，并将其劳动力需求转向要求更高的白领职位。然而，这些企业难以填补新设立的职位空缺。我们提供的初步证据表明，预期因素促成了这一结果，尤其是当企业缺乏正式招聘渠道的先前经验时：企业似乎对正式搜索将产生的应聘者群体过于乐观，而求职者的工资预期超过了企业的工资水平。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103876.title: Formalized employee search and labor demand
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103876.title_zh: 正式化的员工搜寻与劳动力需求

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103877.abstract: This paper studies the effects of the Green Revolution, one of the largest development projects in the late 20th-Century, on individualism. We use a difference-in-differences approach to investigate how rapid technological and organizational changes in traditional agriculture reshaped cultural norms in Indonesia, where Green Revolution rollout was largely driven by centralized government interventions. Regions with greater exposure to Green Revolution policies experienced significant and persistent increases in individualism (as measured by a higher prevalence of infrequent names) decades after the end of the program. Results are not driven by pre-trends and hold across a battery of robustness checks. We further document suggestive, correlational evidence of a persistent fall in community funding for public goods, a key measure of collective action. Our findings suggest that technical change can lead to rapid and persistent changes in culture.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103877.abstract_zh: 本文研究20世纪末最大规模发展项目之一——绿色革命对个人主义的影响。我们采用双重差分法，探究传统农业中快速的技术与组织变革如何重塑印度尼西亚的文化规范。在该国，绿色革命的推广主要由中央政府干预驱动。研究显示，在项目结束数十年后，受绿色革命政策影响较大的地区，其个人主义（以罕见名字出现频率升高为衡量指标）显著且持续增强。该结果不受事前趋势影响，并通过了一系列稳健性检验。我们进一步发现具有提示性的相关证据：作为集体行动关键指标的公共品社区资金投入持续下降。研究结果表明，技术变革能够引发文化快速且持久的变迁。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103877.title: The Green Revolution and individualism: Evidence from Indonesia
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103877.title_zh: 绿色革命与个人主义：来自印度尼西亚的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103878.abstract: This paper examines how natural disasters complicate government efforts to balance energy security with the energy transition in regulated electricity systems. Using random variations in runoff as a natural experiment, we find that droughts lead to a long-term expansion of coal-fired power capacity. This expansion is reflected in extensive-margin adjustments, particularly through the commissioning of new coal-fired power plants. We also show that, under administrative regulation of electricity trading and generation, this investment response is driven primarily by government efforts to strengthen power supply stability rather than by firms’ profit-seeking incentives alone. Our findings highlight how adaptive responses to climate-related supply shocks can generate long-lasting fossil-fuel legacies in developing countries where electricity markets are not yet fully developed.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103878.abstract_zh: 本文考察了在受监管的电力系统中，自然灾害如何使政府在平衡能源安全与能源转型之间的努力复杂化。利用径流量的随机变化作为自然实验，我们发现干旱导致燃煤发电能力的长期扩张。这种扩张体现在集约边际调整上，尤其是通过新建燃煤电厂来实现。我们还表明，在电力交易和发电受到行政监管的情况下，这一投资反应主要源于政府加强电力供应稳定性的努力，而非仅由企业逐利动机驱动。我们的研究结果凸显了，在电力市场尚未完全成熟的发展中国家，对气候相关供应冲击的适应性反应可能产生持久的化石燃料遗留效应。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103879.abstract: When sampled individuals are not found at home, many surveys rely on a proxy respondent: another knowledgeable household member. We study the effect of proxy reporting on the measurement of labor income in Mexico. For identification, we use the panel structure of the Mexican labor force survey and compare workers’ reported earnings when they report them themselves to their reported earnings when another household member does the reporting. We find that male workers’ monthly earnings are 7.2% lower when reported by a proxy, whereas female workers’ earnings are only 1.8% lower. We provide evidence that this gender gap reflects both compositional effects, linked to men’s higher earnings, and household informational asymmetries, partly driven by men’s greater propensity to hide income from other household members. Finally, we study the implications of using proxy respondents and find that it can lead to an underestimation of the gender wage gap by 25%.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103879.abstract_zh: 当抽样个体不在家时，许多调查依赖代理受访者：即另一位了解情况的家庭成员。我们研究了代理报告对墨西哥劳动收入测量的影响。为识别因果效应，我们利用墨西哥劳动力调查的面板结构，比较工人在自我报告收入与由其他家庭成员代理报告时的收入差异。我们发现，男性工人的月收入在代理报告时低7.2%，而女性工人的收入仅低1.8%。我们提供的证据表明，这一性别差异既反映了与男性较高收入相关的构成效应，也反映了家庭信息不对称，部分原因在于男性更倾向于向其他家庭成员隐瞒收入。最后，我们研究了使用代理受访者的影响，发现这可能导致性别工资差距被低估25%。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103879.title: Money and gender: Proxy respondents and the mismeasurement of income in surveys
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103879.title_zh: 金钱与性别：调查中代理受访者与收入的测量偏差

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103880.abstract: We study how the Trans-Regional Jurisdiction reform (TRJ) affects corporate investment. The reform moves administrative lawsuits to courts outside the defendant government's home jurisdiction, which limits local government influence over the courts. We use a stacked difference-in-differences design that draws on the staggered rollout of the reform across cities. We find that the reform raises corporate investment by about 28.7 percent of the sample mean. Complementary evidence shows that the reform improves court outcomes for firms, has stronger effects where pre-reform trust in local institutions is higher, and is associated with lower institutional transaction costs and financing constraints. The effect is larger for firms with more irreversible investment, lower state ownership, and better access to finance. The reform also leads firms to acquire more land and take on more risk, although part of the higher investment appears as overinvestment. These results show how a focused judicial reform can change firm behavior where legal institutions are weak.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103880.abstract_zh: 本文研究跨区域司法管辖改革（TRJ）如何影响企业投资。该改革将行政诉讼案件转移至被告政府所在地之外的法院审理，从而限制了地方政府对法院的影响力。我们采用堆叠双重差分法，利用改革在各城市分阶段推行的特征进行分析。研究发现，改革使企业投资水平较样本均值提升约28.7%。补充证据表明：改革改善了企业面临的司法结果；在改革前对地方制度信任度更高的地区效果更显著；改革降低了制度性交易成本与融资约束。对于投资不可逆性更高、国有持股比例更低、融资渠道更畅通的企业，改革效应更为突出。改革还促使企业增加土地购置并承担更高风险，但部分投资增长表现为过度投资。这些结论揭示了在法律制度薄弱的环境下，聚焦性的司法改革如何改变企业行为。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103880.title: Suing the Leviathan: The Effect of Trans-Regional Jurisdiction Reform on Corporate Investment
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103880.title_zh: 诉诸利维坦：跨区域司法改革对企业投资的影响

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103881.abstract: Natural disasters expose societies to an external environment that requires forward-looking adaptation. This paper argues that societies with greater historical exposure to natural disasters are more likely to develop long-term-oriented norms that emphasize preparation, saving, and future well-being. We test this hypothesis by linking historical exposure to earthquakes, tsunamis, and volcanic eruptions from 4360 BC to 1980 CE to contemporary long-term orientation. Disaster exposure is proxied by a distance-based measure that aggregates proximity to major catastrophic events over long horizons. Long-term orientation is examined using folklore traditions at the ethnic level and survey-based evidence at the individual and country levels. Across all levels of analysis, we find that greater cumulative disaster exposure is associated with significantly stronger long-term orientation. Evidence from folklore and second-generation migrants suggests that these effects operate through cultural adaptation and intergenerational transmission.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103881.abstract_zh: 自然灾害使社会面临需要前瞻性适应的外部环境。本文认为，历史上遭受更多自然灾害的社会更可能形成强调准备、储蓄和未来福祉的长期导向规范。我们通过将公元前4360年至公元1980年间地震、海啸和火山喷发的历史暴露与现代长期导向相联系来检验这一假设。灾害暴露采用基于距离的度量指标，该指标汇总了长期内与重大灾难事件的邻近程度。长期导向则通过族群层面的民间传说传统以及个体和国家层面的调查证据进行考察。在所有分析层面上，我们发现累积灾害暴露程度越高，长期导向显著越强。来自民间传说和第二代移民的证据表明，这些效应通过文化适应和代际传递发挥作用。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103881.title: From catastrophe to culture: The role of historical disasters in shaping long-term orientation
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103881.title_zh: 从灾难到文化：历史灾难在塑造长期导向中的作用

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103882.abstract: Which countries drive global inequality? Which states drive US inequality? We characterize the class of inequality measures that can answer these questions, permitting both an additive decomposition by subgroup and a multiplicative decomposition into within- and between-group components. Its central measure is simply the expected ratio of incomes between two randomly selected individuals. We show that global inequality fell since 1990, driven by declining disparities between countries. Inequality is primarily driven by large middle-income countries (India, China) and poor countries (Democratic Republic of Congo, Ethiopia). In the US, rising inequality is explained by widening gaps within states, while between-state inequality remains limited.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103882.abstract_zh: 哪些国家推动了全球不平等？哪些州推动了美国不平等？我们刻画了能够回答这些问题的不平等度量类别，这类度量既允许按子群进行加性分解，也允许分解为组内和组间成分的乘性结构。其核心度量指标简化为随机选取两个个体收入比值的期望值。研究表明，自1990年以来，全球不平等程度有所下降，这主要源于国家间差距的缩小。不平等的主要驱动因素来自大型中等收入国家（印度、中国）和贫困国家（刚果民主共和国、埃塞俄比亚）。在美国，不平等加剧的原因在于各州内部差距的扩大，而州际不平等程度仍然有限。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103882.title: Who drives inequality?

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103890.abstract: How does drug quality affect self-medication behavior? We address this question in the context of Burkina Faso, where self-medication with antibiotics is widespread. Using chemical quality tests, we find that one in three antibiotics on the market is substandard or falsified, posing significant health risks. While consumers are broadly aware of the prevalence of poor-quality drugs, they struggle to assess quality based on observable cues such as price or packaging. To identify causal effects, we conduct a novel lab-in-the-field experiment that varies the probability of purchasing effective medicine. We find that self-medication increases as drug quality becomes more certain. These results suggest that market-level interventions to improve drug quality may unintentionally increase inappropriate antibiotic use, with implications for health policy and antimicrobial resistance.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103890.abstract_zh: 药物质量如何影响自我药疗行为？我们在布基纳法索的背景下探讨这一问题，该国抗生素自我药疗现象普遍。通过化学质量检测，我们发现市场上三分之一的抗生素为劣质或伪造药品，构成重大健康风险。尽管消费者普遍意识到劣质药物的普遍存在，但他们难以依据价格或包装等可观察线索评估药品质量。为识别因果效应，我们开展了一项新颖的实地实验，该实验改变了购买有效药物的概率。我们发现，随着药物质量确定性提高，自我药疗行为增加。这些结果表明，旨在改善药品质量的市场层面干预措施可能无意中加剧不当抗生素使用，这对卫生政策和抗菌素耐药性具有重要启示。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103890.title: Self-medication under uncertainty: Insights on drug quality and consumer behavior in Burkina Faso
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103890.title_zh: 不确定性下的自我用药：布基纳法索药品质量与消费者行为研究

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103891.abstract: This research demonstrates how securing land property rights can mitigate frictions in rural land rental markets, specifically in the form of landlord-tenant disputes. By combining a comprehensive data set of land rental dispute records, farm-level panel data, and complete agricultural firm registration data, we find that rental disputes decreased following China's land titling reform. We corroborate this finding by distinguishing between property rights-related disputes (e.g., ownership ambiguity, boundary issues, or expropriation) and contractual enforcement disputes (e.g., rent collection). Further analysis reveals that the effect is particularly pronounced in rental agreements between farmers and agricultural firms, especially those involving non-local entities.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103891.abstract_zh: 本研究揭示了保障土地产权如何缓解农村土地租赁市场中的摩擦，具体表现为地主与租户之间的纠纷。通过整合土地租赁纠纷记录的全面数据集、农户层面的面板数据以及完整的农业企业注册数据，我们发现中国的土地确权改革后租赁纠纷有所减少。我们通过区分与产权相关的纠纷（如所有权模糊、边界问题或征收）和合同执行纠纷（如租金收取）来佐证这一发现。进一步分析表明，这一效应在农户与农业企业之间的租赁协议中尤为显著，尤其是涉及非本地实体的协议。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103891.title: Property Rights and Market Frictions: Evidence from the Universe of Land Dispute Files in China
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103891.title_zh: 产权与市场摩擦：来自中国土地纠纷档案全集的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103892.abstract: Improving public service quality is a central challenge in developing countries. A common policy tool is to transfer expertise and protocols to lower-tier institutions, with the expectation that such spillovers improve both current performance and long-term innovative capacity. We study this policy logic using a Chinese reform that mandated knowledge transfer from elite to lower-tier hospitals. Our analysis combines a novel measure of lower-tier hospitals’ alignment with elite hospitals’ clinical practice, developed with a large language model applied to clinical texts and prescription decisions, with measures of physicians’ exploratory activity based on academic publications. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that the policy increased practice alignment at targeted hospitals by 0.29 standard deviations, yielding immediate efficiency gains. At the same time, this gain in exploitation was accompanied by a decline in exploration: physician academic output fell, with publication counts declining by 7% and citation impact by 13%. Our findings highlight that policies promoting existing knowledge can close practice gaps and improve care efficiency, while also creating a potential trade-off with professionals’ incentives to generate new knowledge.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103892.abstract_zh: 提升公共服务质量是发展中国家面临的核心挑战。一个常见的政策工具是将专业知识与操作规程向低层级机构转移，预期此类溢出效应既能改善当前绩效，也能增强长期创新能力。我们利用中国一项要求从精英医院向低层级医院进行知识转移的改革来研究这一政策逻辑。我们的分析结合了一种新颖的低层级医院与精英医院临床实践一致性度量方法——该方法基于大型语言模型对临床文本和处方决策的应用——以及基于学术论文的医生探索性活动度量。采用双重差分设计，我们发现该政策使目标医院的实践一致性提高了0.29个标准差，带来了即时的效率提升。与此同时，这种利用性收益伴随着探索性的下降：医生的学术产出减少，论文发表数量下降7%，引用影响力下降13%。我们的研究结果表明，促进现有知识传播的政策能够缩小实践差距并提高医疗效率，同时也可能与专业人员创造新知识的激励形成潜在权衡。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103892.title: Exploitation vs. Exploration: How knowledge spillovers shape healthcare practices and innovation
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103892.title_zh: 剥削与探索：知识溢出如何塑造医疗实践与创新

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103893.abstract: We show that product and service quality serve as a hidden margin of adjustment to minimum wage hikes in hyper-competitive digital markets. Leveraging granular trans- action data from 2628 Tmall stores in rural China from 2015 to 2020, combined with household surveys and firm-level data, we exploit staggered city-level minimum wage in- creases and find that in the short run, firms neither reduce employment nor significantly raise prices. Instead, they systematically degrade quality, as evidenced by worse product ratings, slower logistics, and poorer customer service, starting within two quarters and per- sisting over time. The reduction in intermediate inputs compromises product quality, while cuts to outsourced IT services undermine service quality by weakening operational effi- ciency. Crucially, this decline is driven by high-quality incumbents, whereas low-quality firms show no change but are more likely to exit the market following the shock. These re- sults reveal a trade-off between labor income and consumer welfare, a cost that is invisible in traditional labor market evaluations but central to a complete welfare assessment.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103893.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在高度竞争的数字市场中，产品和服务质量构成了对最低工资上调的一种隐性调整边际。利用2015年至2020年中国农村2628家天猫店铺的细粒度交易数据，结合家庭调查和企业层面数据，我们利用城市层面最低工资的分阶段上调，发现短期内企业既未减少就业，也未显著提高价格。相反，他们系统性地降低了质量，表现为产品评分下降、物流速度减慢和客户服务变差，这些变化在两个月内开始显现并持续存在。中间投入的减少损害了产品质量，而外包IT服务的削减则通过削弱运营效率损害了服务质量。关键在于，这种下降是由高质量在位企业驱动的，而低质量企业虽无变化，但在冲击后更可能退出市场。这些结果揭示了劳动收入与消费者福利之间的权衡，这一成本在传统劳动力市场评估中不可见，但对于全面的福利评估至关重要。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103893.title: When wages rise, quality falls: Minimum wages and the hidden trade-off in competitive e-commerce markets
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103893.title_zh: 工资上涨，质量下降：最低工资与竞争性电商市场中的隐性权衡

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103894.abstract: The canonical prediction of life-cycle models, that individuals smooth consumption over their lifetime, has mostly been tested in developed countries and found little empirical support. We provide a novel developing-country perspective by analyzing patterns of life-cycle consumption, income, and savings rates in India. In contrast to the U.S., Indian households exhibit little growth in nondurable consumption expenditures after adjusting for family size. Surprisingly, this flat adjusted profile coexists with substantial income growth and a sharp rise in the savings/surplus rate over the life cycle. We show that lumpy non-housing durable accumulation is an important use of this life-cycle surplus, helping reconcile high savings rates with flat measured adult-equivalent nondurable consumption. Quantitatively, non-housing durable stock growth accounts for about one-third of accumulated life-cycle surplus by age 45, and an augmented expenditure profile that adds imputed non-housing durable investment flows to nondurables raises adult-equivalent life-cycle growth from 8.4% to 27.9%.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103894.abstract_zh: 生命周期模型的经典预测——个体在一生中平滑消费——主要在发达国家得到检验，但实证支持甚少。我们通过分析印度的生命周期消费、收入及储蓄率模式，提供了一个新颖的发展中国家视角。与美国的状况相反，印度家庭在调整家庭规模后，非耐用品消费支出几乎没有增长。令人惊讶的是，这种平稳的调整后消费曲线与显著的收入增长及生命周期中储蓄/盈余率的急剧上升并存。我们表明，非住房耐用品的大额积累是这一生命周期盈余的重要用途，有助于调和高储蓄率与平稳的成人等价非耐用品消费之间的矛盾。定量分析显示，到45岁时，非住房耐用品存量增长约占累积生命周期盈余的三分之一，而将估算的非住房耐用品投资流加入非耐用品后，扩展的支出曲线使成人等价生命周期增长率从8.4%提升至27.9%。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103894.title: Household consumption and savings over the life cycle: The roles of demographics and durables
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103894.title_zh: 生命周期中的家庭消费与储蓄：人口结构与耐用消费品的作用

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103895.abstract: Extreme weather events are expected to increase with climate change. Government relief programs are designed to ameliorate the negative consequences, but moral hazard models suggest they also reduce adaptation, such as migrating from disaster-prone areas. Using difference-in-differences, we study the long-term effects of cash relief on migration after the 2010 Pakistan floods. Combining survey and population data, we show that cash transfers have two countervailing effects. As expected, they reduce migration through a moral hazard effect and by facilitating in-situ adaptation. However, they also increase migration by providing liquidity. In practice, these effects cancel each other out in flooded areas.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103895.abstract_zh: 随着气候变化，极端天气事件预计将增多。政府救济项目旨在缓解其负面影响，但道德风险模型表明，这些项目也可能减少适应行为，例如从灾害频发地区迁移。利用双重差分法，我们研究了2010年巴基斯坦洪水后现金救济对迁移的长期影响。结合调查与人口数据，我们发现现金转移具有两种相互抵消的效应。正如预期，它们通过道德风险效应及促进就地适应减少了迁移。然而，它们也通过提供流动性增加了迁移。在实践中，这些效应在受灾地区相互抵消。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103896.abstract: A defining feature of many Community-Driven Development (CDD) interventions in wartorn countries is their pursuit of transformative objectives, seeking to (re)shape local decisionmaking institutions in the process. In recent years, there has been a push to overhaul CDD approaches, with a focus on more realistic objectives aimed at providing infrastructure and building capacity of existing local institutions. We investigate, through a large-scale field experiment involving 400 communities in eastern Congo, the effects of a CDD program that embodied this new focus. Our strategy allows us to identify causal impacts of the CDD intervention, in its basic form consisting of a US$100,000 envelope to finance an infrastructure project with an emphasis on ‘local content’, as well as when augmented with a complementary conflict mitigation component. While the intervention successfully delivered visible infrastructure projects, we find no detectable effects on social cohesion, (violent) conflict, or economic welfare. We conclude discussing policy implications.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103896.abstract_zh: 许多饱受战争蹂躏国家中的社区驱动发展（CDD）干预措施的一个显著特征在于其追求变革性目标，旨在过程中（重新）塑造地方决策机构。近年来，推动了对CDD方法的改革，重点转向更为现实的目标，即提供基础设施并增强现有地方机构的能力。我们通过一项涉及刚果东部400个社区的大规模实地实验，考察了体现这一新重点的CDD项目的影响。我们的研究策略使我们能够识别CDD干预的因果效应，其基本形式包括一笔10万美元的资金用于资助一个强调“本地内容”的基础设施项目，以及当辅以一项补充性冲突缓解组成部分时的效果。尽管干预成功交付了可见的基础设施项目，但我们未发现对社会凝聚力、（暴力）冲突或经济福利有可检测的影响。最后，我们讨论了政策启示。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103896.title: Building infrastructure and cohesion through locally embedded institutions: Evidence from a field experiment in War-torn Eastern Congo
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103896.title_zh: 通过地方嵌入制度构建基础设施与社会凝聚力：来自战乱刚果东部实地实验的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103897.abstract: We study how the announcement of a foreign military intervention, which improves expectations about the state’s future functioning, can raise citizens’ willingness to participate in state-building processes. We analyze the impact of the 2012 United Nations Security Council resolution that authorized intervention in Mali to reunify the country and restore democracy during a profound institutional crisis on individuals’ attitudes toward the state. By exploiting the randomness of the foreign intervention announcement relative to the timeline of the Afrobarometer interviews conducted in South Mali, we document that individuals interviewed in the days after the announcement report more optimistic beliefs about the country’s future level of democracy than individuals interviewed immediately before, with the same characteristics, region, and ethnic group. Consistent with a prospective-beliefs channel, respondents interviewed after the announcement report higher tax morale and more favorable tax-related attitudes across a broad range of outcomes. While optimism about future democracy increases widely, the increase in tax morale appears concentrated in areas with low state capacity, limited ethnic diversity, and individuals who do not perceive discrimination against their ethnic group. Our results indicate that foreign military interventions can enhance perceptions of state-building and the benefits of participation.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103897.abstract_zh: 我们研究了外国军事干预的宣布如何通过改善对国家未来运作的预期，提升公民参与国家建设进程的意愿。我们分析了2012年联合国安理会授权在马里进行干预以在深刻制度危机期间实现国家统一和恢复民主的决议，对个人对国家态度的影响。利用外国干预宣布相对于南马里进行的非洲晴雨表访谈时间线的随机性，我们记录了在宣布后几天接受访谈的个人，相较于在宣布前立即接受访谈、具有相同特征、地区和族群的个体，报告了对国家未来民主水平更为乐观的信念。与前瞻性信念渠道一致，宣布后受访的个体在广泛的结果范围内报告了更高的税收道德和更有利的税收相关态度。尽管对未来民主的乐观情绪普遍上升，但税收道德的提高似乎集中在国家能力较低、族群多样性有限以及不认为自身族群受到歧视的个体所在的地区。我们的结果表明，外国军事干预可以增强对国家建设及参与益处的认知。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103897.title: Expected foreign military intervention and demand for state-building: Evidence from Mali
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103897.title_zh: 预期外国军事干预与国家建设需求：来自马里的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103898.abstract: Students in low-income contexts often lack guidance in their career decisions, which can lead to a misallocation of educational investments. We report on a randomized field experiment conducted with 1715 students in rural Cambodia and show that a half-day career guidance workshop designed to support adolescents in developing occupational aspirations on average increased educational investments. We document substantial heterogeneity in treatment effects by baseline student performance. While the workshop increased schooling efforts of high-performing students, treated low-performing students reduced their educational investments. We develop a simple model that explains this treatment effect heterogeneity by baseline performance.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103898.abstract_zh: 在低收入背景下的学生往往缺乏职业决策指导，这可能导致教育投资配置不当。我们报告了一项在柬埔寨农村对1715名学生进行的随机实地实验，结果显示，一个旨在支持青少年发展职业抱负的半日职业指导工作坊平均增加了教育投资。我们记录了基于基线学生表现的治疗效果显著异质性。尽管工作坊提高了高表现学生的学业努力，但受治疗的低表现学生减少了教育投资。我们构建了一个简单模型，通过基线表现来解释这种治疗效果的异质性。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103898.title: Career guidance and investments in education: Experimental evidence from Cambodia
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103898.title_zh: 职业指导与教育投资：来自柬埔寨的实验证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103899.abstract: China’s rapid growth alongside extensive state ownership challenges theories of state-sector inefficiency. This paper identifies a novel micro-level channel: “dual-track in the family,” whereby one spouse’s stable state job enables the other to pursue private entrepreneurship. Using a triple-difference design that exploits the 1993 market reform, we find that spouses of state employees were 9.8 percentage points more likely to become entrepreneurs after the reform. Mechanism evidence suggests that spousal state employment may promote entrepreneurship by insuring the family against risk. The findings reveal how a gradualist, dual-track transition can succeed partly by leveraging state-sector stability to underpin private-sector dynamism.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103899.abstract_zh: 中国经济的快速增长与大规模国有制并存，对国有部门低效率的传统理论构成挑战。本文识别出一个新颖的微观层面渠道：“家庭双轨制”，即一方稳定的国有部门工作使另一方得以投身私营创业。利用1993年市场化改革作为准自然实验，采用三重差分设计，我们发现改革后，国有部门员工的配偶成为企业家的概率高出9.8个百分点。机制证据表明，配偶的国有部门就业可能通过为家庭提供风险保障来促进创业。研究结果揭示了渐进式双轨转型何以部分成功，其关键在于利用国有部门的稳定性支撑私营部门的活力。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103899.title: Dual-track in the family: How spousal state employment fuels entrepreneurship
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103899.title_zh: 家庭中的双轨制：配偶体制内就业如何助推创业

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103900.abstract: Institutional design can shape the political economy of regional development programmes, ultimately affecting their overall efficacy. We test this hypothesis in the context of the Cassa per il Mezzogiorno, a large-scale place-based policy aimed at fostering industrial development in Southern Italy (1950–1984). In 1971, authority over fund allocation was transferred from a centralised committee to newly established regional governments. Combining unique historical data on local administrators with detailed project-level information, we find that, after devolution, municipalities governed by the same party in power at the regional level (aligned) received more funds compared to unaligned ones. In the long run, aligned municipalities received a greater number of smaller projects, predominantly public works. This pattern intensified in municipalities characterised by higher pre-reform corruption, lower industrial capacity, and larger electorates, consistent with a logic of broad electoral coverage rather than developmental targeting. We also show that the positive association between funding and long-term employment growth weakens substantially after the reform, particularly in aligned municipalities. These findings suggest that, in institutionally fragile contexts, devolution can increase exposure to political distortions and undermine the growth-enhancing potential of place-based policies.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103900.abstract_zh: 制度设计能够塑造区域发展项目的政治经济学特征，并最终影响其整体成效。我们以意大利南部旨在促进工业发展的大规模地方性政策——南方基金（Cassa per il Mezzogiorno，1950—1984年）为背景，对这一假设进行了检验。1971年，资金分配权由中央委员会移交至新成立的大区政府。结合地方行政官员的独特历史数据与详细的项目层面信息，我们发现，权力下放后，由与地区执政党一致的党派（即政治同盟）执政的市镇，相较于非同盟市镇获得了更多资金。长期来看，同盟市镇获得了更多数量但规模较小的项目，且以公共工程为主。这一模式在改革前腐败程度较高、工业能力较弱及选民规模较大的市镇中更为显著，这与广泛选举覆盖而非发展导向的逻辑相符。我们还表明，改革后，资金与长期就业增长之间的正相关关系显著减弱，尤其在同盟市镇中。这些发现表明，在制度脆弱的背景下，权力下放可能增加政治扭曲的风险，并削弱地方性政策促进增长的潜力。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103900.title: The political economy of regional development: Evidence from the Cassa per il Mezzogiorno
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103900.title_zh: 区域发展的政治经济学：来自意大利南部开发署的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103901.abstract: Research and policy debates on population aging typically assume that immigration matters only through immigrants’ own fertility and its impact on total population size, ignoring effects on natives’ fertility. We study this margin in the context of the large inflow of Syrian refugees into Türkiye after 2011. Using an instrumental-variables strategy, we provide evidence that greater local exposure to refugees increases native fertility. Drawing on complete birth histories from the Demographic and Health Surveys, we find that the response operates primarily through earlier entry into motherhood and is concentrated among younger women. The result holds across three independent datasets, including administrative birth registers, and is mirrored in women’s stated ideal number of children. Examining potential mechanisms, we find the evidence most consistent with improved household economic security and find no support for channels operating through housing costs or the use of paid childcare.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103901.abstract_zh: 关于人口老龄化的研究与政策辩论通常假定移民仅通过其自身的生育率及其对总人口规模的影响发挥作用，而忽视了移民对本地人生育率的影响。我们在2011年后大量叙利亚难民涌入土耳其的背景下研究了这一边际效应。利用工具变量策略，我们提供了证据表明，难民在当地更大的暴露程度会增加本地人的生育率。基于人口与健康调查中的完整生育史数据，我们发现这一反应主要通过提前进入母亲身份实现，并集中于较年轻的女性群体。该结果在三个独立数据集中均成立，包括行政出生登记记录，并且与女性自述的理想子女数量相呼应。在考察潜在机制时，我们发现证据最支持家庭经济安全改善的解释，而未发现通过住房成本或使用有偿托儿服务发挥作用的渠道支持。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103901.title: Refugee immigration and natives’ fertility
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103901.title_zh: 难民移民与本地居民的生育率

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103903.abstract: This paper studies the impact of child migration on outcomes of elders who stay behind: consumption, economic participation, health, and mental health. Exploiting variation from the preexisting ties between provinces interacted with the time-varying intensity of regional migration deregulation, we find that increased incentives for internal migration in China resulted in more remittances to rural households, boosting consumption and reducing farm work among the elderly who stay behind. The paper also shows improved healthcare utilization and physical health in these non-migrating elderly populations. However, child migration came with a potential downside: the modest decline in the mental well-being of elderly individuals, possibly due to a lack of informal care and companionship from migrated children. These findings show how internal migration impacts the health and economic wellbeing of elderly individuals in developing countries. (JEL I15, J18, O18, P25, P36, R23)
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103903.abstract_zh: 本文研究了子女迁移对留守老年人结果的影响：消费、经济参与、健康及心理健康。利用省份间既有联系与区域迁移放松政策时间变化强度的交互变异，我们发现中国内部迁移激励的增加导致农村家庭汇款增多，从而提升了留守老年人的消费并减少了其农业劳动。本文还显示，这些未迁移老年人口的医疗利用和身体健康状况得到改善。然而，子女迁移也带来潜在不利影响：老年人心理健康水平适度下降，可能源于迁移子女提供的非正式照料和陪伴缺失。这些发现揭示了内部迁移如何影响发展中国家老年人的健康与经济福祉。（JEL I15, J18, O18, P25, P36, R23）
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103903.title: Migration Incentives and Elderly Health: Evidence from the Hukou Reforms in China
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103903.title_zh: 迁移激励与老年人健康：来自中国户籍改革的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103904.abstract: This paper examines how poor in utero conditions caused by severe typhoons affect psychological well-being later in life. We exploit variation in the timing and location of severe typhoon landfalls. Our design compares individuals with higher expected fetal exposure in landfall counties to those with no such exposure. A one-unit increase in expected in utero exposure raises the likelihood of an adult mental illness diagnosis by 2.2 percentage points, or 11 percent relative to the mean. The incidence of mood disorders such as depression and the use of antidepressants has risen by more than 50 percent. The adverse effects are concentrated among women. In a fully interacted model, we reject equality of the male and female effects for our main outcomes. This gender gap is not driven by differential healthcare-seeking behavior. We discuss several non-mutually exclusive mechanisms that could generate a genuinely female-concentrated effect, including sex-specific fetal programming and mortality selection
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103904.abstract_zh: 本文考察了由严重台风导致的恶劣宫内环境如何影响个体成年后的心理健康状况。我们利用严重台风登陆时间与地点的变异，将预期胎儿期暴露程度较高的登陆县个体与无此类暴露的个体进行比较。预期宫内暴露每增加一个单位，成年期精神疾病诊断的可能性提高2.2个百分点，相对于均值而言增加11%。情绪障碍（如抑郁症）的发病率及抗抑郁药物的使用量上升超过50%。不利影响主要集中在女性群体中。在完全交互模型中，我们拒绝了主要结局指标中男性和女性效应相等的假设。这一性别差异并非由就医行为的差异所驱动。我们讨论了若干非互斥的机制，这些机制可能产生真正集中于女性的效应，包括性别特异性胎儿编程和死亡选择。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103904.title: The long shadow of typhoons: Prenatal exposure and adult mental health
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103904.title_zh: 台风的长影：产前暴露与成年心理健康

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103905.abstract: We propose a new approach to pollution control from the social contract perspective, which highlights the reciprocal obligations between firms and the government, in contrast to the conventional regulatory view. Combining granular data on Chinese industrial firms with a 2007 reform that sharply increased the government’s incentives for pollution control, we show, in a difference-in-differences framework, that firms with prior government support achieved greater emission reductions than those without following the reform, primarily through costly clean technology adoption and output cuts. These effects are consistent across various strategies that account for the potential endogeneity of government support and appear to be driven by reciprocity between firms and the government, as (a) the effects are more pronounced in regions with stronger norms of reciprocity, and (b) the government, in turn, responded with continued support. Alternative explanations—including government leverage, financial constraints, regulatory enforcement, and political connections—cannot explain our findings. We further examine the aggregate implications of firm-government reciprocity at the city level, exploiting quasi-random variation in city-level support induced by plausibly exogenous mayoral rotation and across-mayor variation in support preferences in an instrumental variable design. We find that such reciprocity translated into significant declines in regional pollution concentrations, thereby enhancing the government’s capacity for pollution control.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103905.abstract_zh: 我们从社会契约视角提出一种新的污染控制方法，该方法强调企业与政府之间的互惠义务，与传统的监管观点形成对比。结合中国工业企业层面的精细数据与2007年一项大幅增强政府污染控制激励的改革，我们在双重差分框架下发现，相较于未获得政府支持的企业，那些先前获得政府支持的企业在改革后实现了更大的减排，主要通过采用成本高昂的清洁技术和削减产出实现。这些效应在多种考虑政府支持潜在内生性的策略中保持一致，并似乎由企业与政府之间的互惠关系驱动，具体表现为：(a) 在互惠规范更强的地区，效应更为显著；(b) 政府相应地以持续支持作为回应。其他替代解释——包括政府杠杆、融资约束、监管执行及政治关联——均无法解释我们的发现。我们进一步在城市层面考察企业-政府互惠的总体影响，利用由看似外生的市长轮换及市长间支持偏好差异引起的城市层面支持的准随机变化，采用工具变量设计。我们发现，这种互惠关系转化为区域污染浓度的显著下降，从而增强了政府的污染控制能力。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103905.title: Reciprocity and state capacity: Evidence from a national pollution control reform in China
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103905.title_zh: 互惠与国家能力：来自中国全国性污染治理改革的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103906.abstract: Targeted educational interventions for primary school children in low-income countries have led to substantial improvements in learning, but their impact varies considerably across studies, raising questions about how to sustain their effectiveness in different settings. In this paper, we study a novel primary education program that combines a conventional in-school targeted pedagogical intervention with an out-of-school study group initiative facilitated by the community. To identify the impact of the program and its components, we design a cross-cutting randomized experiment across 200 villages in Assam, India. Our results show that standalone implementation of either component has no significant effect on learning outcomes, but when the components are combined in the full program, they improve children’s test scores in mathematics and language by 0.11 and 0.09 standard deviations, respectively. Our results suggest that integrating in-school targeted instruction with community-based out-of-school activities can enhance program effectiveness by increasing students’ engagement and overall exposure to learning, at relatively low cost.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103906.abstract_zh: 针对低收入国家小学生的定向教育干预措施已显著提升学习成效，但不同研究间效果差异显著，引发关于如何在不同环境中维持其有效性的疑问。本文研究了一项新颖的小学教育项目，该项目将传统的校内定向教学干预与社区推动的校外学习小组活动相结合。为识别该项目及其组成部分的影响，我们在印度阿萨姆邦的200个村庄设计了一项交叉随机实验。结果显示，单独实施任一组成部分对学习成果均无显著影响，但当这些组成部分整合于完整项目中时，分别使儿童数学和语言测试成绩提高了0.11和0.09个标准差。我们的研究结果表明，将校内定向教学与基于社区的校外活动相结合，能通过增加学生参与度和整体学习接触时间，以相对较低的成本提升项目有效性。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103906.title: Supporting learning in and out of school: Experimental evidence from India
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103906.title_zh: 支持校内外的学习：来自印度的实验证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103907.abstract: We examine how drug-related violence influences emigration choices in Central America, a region that has experienced a sharp increase in migration to the United States. Combining multiple data sources, we leverage an instrumental variables strategy that exploits local variation in proximity to drug-trafficking routes and coca production in Colombia. Our results show that rising violence increases intentions, plans, and preparations to emigrate, particularly to the United States. These migration responses are strongest among young and higher-skilled individuals. Mediation analysis suggests that these migration responses operate predominantly through declining economic activity and worsening labor-market conditions in Central America, rather than through a direct response to insecurity.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103907.abstract_zh: 本文考察了毒品相关暴力如何影响中美洲地区的移民选择，该地区向美国的移民数量急剧增加。结合多种数据来源，我们采用工具变量策略，利用靠近毒品贩运路线及哥伦比亚古柯生产的局部差异。研究结果显示，暴力升级增加了移民的意向、计划及准备，尤其是前往美国的移民。这些移民反应在年轻及高技能人群中最为显著。中介分析表明，这些移民反应主要通过中美洲经济活动衰退和劳动力市场状况恶化发挥作用，而非直接源于对不安全感的回应。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103907.title: Is drug-related violence fueling emigration from Central America?
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103907.title_zh: 毒品相关暴力是否加剧了中美洲的移民外流？

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103908.abstract: We examine the intergenerational impact of China’s 1950s adult literacy campaign, one of the largest anti-illiteracy efforts in history, reaching 150 million people. While direct effects on adult literacy remain debated, we document significant long-term benefits for the next generation’s education. Using an original dataset compiled from county gazetteers and the population census, we find a notable increase in educational attainment for children whose parents were more strongly exposed to the campaign. We attribute these results to extensive government propaganda that likely shifted population attitudes toward education. Our findings suggest that education campaigns can be a viable strategy in developing countries for improving human capital.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103908.abstract_zh: 我们考察了中国20世纪50年代成人扫盲运动的代际影响，这是历史上规模最大的扫盲行动之一，惠及1.5亿人。尽管对成人识字率的直接影响仍存争议，但我们记录了该运动对下一代教育产生的显著长期益处。利用从县志和人口普查中汇编的原始数据集，我们发现，父母受该运动影响更深的子女，其教育成就显著提高。我们将这些结果归因于广泛的政府宣传，这可能改变了民众对教育的态度。我们的研究结果表明，在发展中国家，教育运动可作为提升人力资本的可行策略。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103908.title: The Power of Words: Adult Literacy Campaign and Intergenerational Transmission of Human Capital
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103908.title_zh: 语言的力量：成人扫盲运动与人力资本的代际传递

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103909.abstract: Socioemotional skills (SES) programs are widely used to promote economic empowerment, yet their returns may depend on the type of skills targeted and social context. We study this question using a randomized controlled trial (RCT) among 4500 aspiring agribusiness entrepreneurs in Nigeria within a large-scale government program. Participants were randomly assigned to an interpersonal-skills curriculum, a combined interpersonal and intrapersonal-skills curriculum of the same length, or a control group. Both trainings substantially increase women’s business performance, raising average profits by 50%. The two trainings generated broadly similar economic impacts overall. Effects are largest in communities with more liberal gender norms, where women report improvements in interpersonal skills such as empathy and negotiation, and better relational outcomes. Despite large economic gains, we find no corresponding increases in women’s empowerment or intrahousehold decision-making. For men, interpersonal-skills training increases household income, while the combined curriculum raises profits but only in the most gender-liberal environments. The results show that the returns to SES depend not only on which skills are taught, but also on whether prevailing social norms permit individuals to express and deploy those skills. Translating gains into broader empowerment may require complementary programs that relax gender norms.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103909.abstract_zh: 社会情感技能（SES）项目被广泛用于促进经济赋权，然而其回报可能取决于所针对的技能类型及社会背景。我们通过一项随机对照试验（RCT）来研究这一问题，该试验在尼日利亚一个大规模政府项目中，对4500名有志于农业综合企业创业的个体进行了研究。参与者被随机分配至人际技能课程、同等时长的人际与内在技能综合课程，或对照组。两种培训均显著提升了女性的经营绩效，使平均利润增加了50%。总体而言，这两种培训在经济影响上大致相似。在性别规范更为自由化的社区中，效果最为显著，这些地区的女性报告称，其在同理心、谈判等人际技能方面有所提升，且关系性结果更佳。尽管经济收益显著，我们并未观察到女性赋权或家庭内部决策权的相应提升。对于男性而言，人际技能培训增加了家庭收入，而综合课程则提高了利润，但仅限于性别观念最为开放的环境中。研究结果表明，社会情感技能的回报不仅取决于所教授的技能类型，还取决于现行社会规范是否允许个体表达和运用这些技能。将收益转化为更广泛的赋权，可能需要辅以放松性别规范的补充项目。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103909.title: Turning inward and/or outward: Which socioemotional skills pay for agribusiness entrepreneurs in Nigeria?
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103909.title_zh: 向内和/或向外转向：哪些社会情感技能对尼日利亚农业企业创业者有回报？

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103910.abstract: Minimum price floors are a common but understudied instrument for regulating industrial land markets in developing economies. We exploit China’s 2009 adjustment of minimum industrial land prices, which lowered the minimum land price in some counties and raised it in others. Combining parcel-level land transactions with county characteristics in a difference-in-differences design, we find a striking asymmetry: easing counties experienced a 9.15% decline in industrial land prices and a 23.12% expansion in transferred area, whereas tightening counties showed no detectable change. The asymmetry reflects the floor’s initial binding status: it was binding in easing counties, where competition for mobile manufacturing capital pushed prices down and expanded land supply, but non-binding in tightening counties, where the raised floor either stayed below market prices or was offset through rebates and subsidies. Easing counties also gained 15.53% more large-scale industrial enterprises relative to the sample mean and 7.90% in fiscal revenue, yet new land sales concentrated in low- and medium-low-tech, land-intensive sectors, a pattern that persisted through 2022 with no shift toward higher-tech industries. Relaxing a binding industrial land price floor thus brings short-run gains in firm entry and fiscal revenue but leaves these counties specialized in low-tech industries, consistent with race-to-the-bottom competition operating through industrial land pricing.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103910.abstract_zh: 最低价格下限是发展中经济体规范工业用地市场中常见但研究不足的工具。我们利用中国2009年对工业用地最低价格的调整，该调整降低了一些县的最低地价，同时提高了其他县的最低地价。结合地块层面的土地交易与县级特征，采用双重差分设计，我们发现了一个显著的不对称性：放宽限制的县工业用地价格下降了9.15%，转让面积扩大了23.12%，而收紧限制的县则未观察到明显变化。这种不对称性反映了初始最低价格下限的约束状态：在放宽限制的县，最低价格具有约束力，对流动制造业资本的竞争压低了价格并扩大了土地供应；而在收紧限制的县，最低价格不具约束力，提高后的下限要么仍低于市场价格，要么通过回扣和补贴被抵消。放宽限制的县相对于样本均值还新增了15.53%的大型工业企业，财政收入增加了7.90%，但新增土地销售集中在低技术及中低技术、土地密集型行业，这一模式持续至2022年，并未向高技术产业转变。因此，放宽具有约束力的工业用地最低价格下限在短期内带来了企业进入和财政收入的增长，但使这些县长期专注于低技术产业，这与通过工业用地定价进行的逐底竞争现象相符。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103910.title: Race-to-the-bottom dynamics in industrial land pricing: Asymmetric effects of China’s 2009 price floor adjustment policy
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103910.title_zh: 中国工业用地定价中的竞次动态：2009年价格下限调整政策的非对称效应

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103911.abstract: Weather-induced agricultural shocks are geographically selective, as exposure reflects both exogenous atmospheric dynamics and predetermined local geography. We exploit the knowledge of shock determinants to isolate the exogenous component, relying on counterfactual simulations to measure medium-term farmers’ adaptation strategies. Using microdata from Ethiopia and an outbreak of desert locust swarms as source of the shock, we find a shift in agricultural production composition and an increase in household farm labour to smooth consumption. A producer–consumer approach reveals the farmers’ response not to be productivity-neutral in the medium-term, while individual factors’ intensity is used to offset a decrease in partial productivity. Estimating a Cobb–Douglas production function, we find a drop in total factor productivity in treated areas, a decline that exceeds the reduced-form output loss and indicates that available adaptive responses preserve subsistence output while carrying substantial productivity costs.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103911.abstract_zh: 天气引发的农业冲击在地理上具有选择性，因为暴露程度既反映了外生的大气动态，也反映了既定的地方地理特征。我们利用对冲击决定因素的认知来分离外生成分，并依赖反事实模拟来衡量农民的中期适应策略。利用埃塞俄比亚的微观数据以及沙漠蝗虫群爆发作为冲击来源，我们发现农业生产结构发生转变，家庭农业劳动力增加以平滑消费。生产者—消费者方法揭示，农民的反应在中期并非生产力中性的，而个体因素的强度被用来抵消部分生产力的下降。通过估计柯布—道格拉斯生产函数，我们发现处理地区全要素生产率下降，这一降幅超过了简化形式产出损失，表明可用的适应性响应在维持生存产出的同时，承担了显著的生产力成本。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103911.title: Gone with the wind: Productive response to agricultural shock
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103911.title_zh: 随风而逝：农业冲击的生产性应对

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103912.abstract: Road infrastructure is widely recognized as a driver of economic development, but can it also aid in disaster resilience? This study addresses the resilience question in the Indian context by examining the output effects of dual and staggered treatments: national highway construction – the Golden Quadrilateral, and the North-South and East-West highways – and extreme flood exposure. Employing a production-theoretic framework, this study focuses on India’s informal manufacturing, the largest in the world without any formal safety nets. It combines geospatially matched, staggered flood exposure data from the Dartmouth Flood Observatory with phased highway rollout timelines from the National Highways Authority of India and repeated cross-section plant-level survey data (1990–2016). Exploiting quasi-random variation in the timing of flood exposure and road construction, a stacked difference-in-differences design is implemented, matching treated districts to future-treated counterparts. Results show that floods significantly reduce gross output and value added, while access to completed highway segments nearly offsets the average 8 percent flood-related output loss through higher output and reduced input expenditures. These effects are magnified for plants that own transport assets, highlighting a complementarity between internal logistics and external infrastructure. Off-highway plants exhibit similar resilience only when they possess transport assets. Heterogeneity analysis by market orientation reveals that resilience benefits are higher among non-tradable industries through local market stabilization. These findings reveal that roads are not only engines of development but also critical to disaster resilience. Designing infrastructure with dual function—development and resilience—is essential for building a climate-smart and resilient economy.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103912.abstract_zh: 公路基础设施被广泛认为是经济发展的驱动力，但它是否也能有助于灾害韧性？本研究通过考察双重且交错处理的产出效应来探讨印度背景下的韧性议题：国家公路建设——黄金四边形，以及南北和东西高速公路——与极端洪水暴露。采用生产理论框架，本研究聚焦于印度非正规制造业，这是全球最大的缺乏任何正式安全网的部门。研究将达特茅斯洪水观测站的地理空间匹配、交错洪水暴露数据与印度国家公路管理局的分阶段公路铺设时间线以及重复横截面企业层面调查数据（1990-2016年）相结合。利用洪水暴露和公路建设时间上的准随机变异，实施堆叠双重差分设计，将处理地区与未来处理的对照组进行匹配。结果表明，洪水显著降低了总产出和增加值，而通达已建成高速公路路段几乎抵消了平均8%的洪水相关产出损失，其机制是通过提高产出和减少投入支出。这些效应对于拥有运输资产的企业更为显著，凸显了内部物流与外部基础设施之间的互补性。不在公路沿线的企业仅在拥有运输资产时才表现出类似的韧性。按市场导向进行的异质性分析显示，非贸易行业通过本地市场稳定获得的韧性收益更高。这些发现表明，公路不仅是发展的引擎，也是灾害韧性的关键。设计兼具发展与韧性双重功能的基础设施，对于建设气候智慧和韧性经济至关重要。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103912.title: Road to Resilience: Floods, Highways and Indian Informal Manufacturing
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103912.title_zh: 通往韧性之路：洪水、公路与印度非正规制造业

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103913.abstract: Index insurance intended to help low-wealth households manage risk is hampered by downside basis risk, meaning that the insured suffers a loss, but the insurance index fails to signal a loss. Existing index insurance contracts use statisticallyad hoc administrative boundaries to demarcate insurance zones. We develop an algorithm that creates zones that maximize lower tail dependence amongst individual units included in each zone. Breaking boundaries in this way minimizes downside basis risk. Using data from a satellite-based index insurance program in Kenya, we show that replacing administrative with optimized zones can as much as triple the value of insurance using an expected utility-based metric of insurance quality. Robustness tests indicate that this finding is not a result of overfitting the data and we also obtain similar results when applying the same approach to other areas in the Horn of Africa.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103913.abstract_zh: 旨在帮助低收入家庭管理风险的指数保险，受到下行基差风险的制约，即投保人遭受损失，但保险指数未能指示出损失。现有的指数保险合同采用统计上随意的行政边界来划分保险区域。我们开发了一种算法，该算法创建的区域能最大化各区域内个体单位之间的下尾依赖性。通过这种方式打破边界，可最小化下行基差风险。利用肯尼亚一个基于卫星的指数保险项目数据，我们表明，用优化区域替代行政区域，可将保险价值提升至多三倍，这一结论基于期望效用度量的保险质量指标。稳健性检验显示，这一发现并非数据过拟合的结果，且将相同方法应用于非洲之角其他地区时，也获得了类似结果。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103913.title: The economic gains from breaking boundaries: Reformulating index insurance zones to maximize lower tail dependence
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103913.title_zh: 打破边界的经济收益：重构指数保险区域以最大化下尾相依性

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103914.abstract: Survey data can be distorted through mistrust, discomfort, or demand effects on the part of respondents. We test whether familiar enumerators—those with whom a respondent has completed a prior survey—influence data quality in a panel survey with small business owners in Uganda. We randomly assign respondents to a familiar or a new enumerator and cross-cut a second randomization to an in-person or phone-based interview modality. Across a broad set of outcome types, we observe few impacts of either survey method on means, distributions, or attrition. However, respondents are significantly more likely to give norm-congruent answers to new surveyors compared to familiar ones. The effect of familiarity does not interact significantly with a prior experiment conducted with the same sample, suggesting that familiarity influences estimates of levels but not of treatment impacts. These findings suggest that surveys by familiar enumerators can improve the measurement of sensitive beliefs.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103914.abstract_zh: 调查数据可能因受访者的不信任、不适或需求效应而产生扭曲。我们通过一项针对乌干达小企业主的追踪调查，检验了受访者熟悉的调查员——即受访者曾与其完成过先前调查的人员——是否会影响数据质量。我们将受访者随机分配至熟悉或陌生的调查员，并交叉进行第二次随机化，分配至面对面或电话访谈模式。在一系列广泛的结果类型中，我们观察到两种调查方法对均值、分布或流失率的影响甚微。然而，与熟悉调查员相比，受访者向新调查员给出符合规范答案的可能性显著更高。熟悉度效应与先前对同一样本进行的实验并无显著交互作用，表明熟悉度影响的是水平估计而非处理效应估计。这些发现表明，由熟悉调查员进行的调查可改善对敏感信念的测量。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103914.title: Familiar faces, honest answers? The impacts of enumerator familiarity and modality on survey responses
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103914.title_zh: 熟悉的面孔，诚实的回答？访员熟悉度与调查方式对问卷回答的影响

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103916.abstract: This paper evaluates the economic implications of climate change in the Philippines. Data spanning two decades reveal that warmer temperatures increase out-migration, yet locations exposed to intense heat send fewer migrants to historically connected destinations. This pattern raises the question of how climate change affects the spatial allocation of economic activity when mobility is constrained. I employ a quantitative spatial equilibrium model in which rising temperatures and sea-level rise depress local amenities and productivity. Taking climate projections for 2100, I estimate aggregate welfare and output to fall by 15% and 12% respectively, with more prominent losses for high-skilled workers. Large-scale coastal protection can offset damages by up to 3 percentage points, but removing migration barriers attenuates welfare losses by as much as 13 percentage points.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103916.abstract_zh: 本文评估了气候变化对菲律宾的经济影响。跨越二十年的数据显示，气温升高增加了人口外迁，然而遭受酷热地区向历史上联系紧密的目的地输送的移民却较少。这一现象引发了关于在流动性受限时气候变化如何影响经济活动空间布局的问题。我采用了一个定量空间均衡模型，其中气温上升和海平面上升降低了地方宜居性与生产力。依据2100年的气候预测，我估算总体福利和产出将分别下降15%和12%，且高技能工人遭受的损失更为显著。大规模海岸防护措施可抵消高达3个百分点的损害，而消除迁移障碍则能将福利损失减轻多达13个百分点。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103916.title: Economic consequences of climate change: Evidence from the Philippines
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103916.title_zh: 气候变化的经济后果：来自菲律宾的证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103918.abstract: This study examines the impact of payroll-tax enforcement on firm dynamism and its implications for aggregate productivity. We exploit China’s Social Security Collection Agency Reform, which transferred responsibility for collecting social-insurance contributions from local social-insurance agencies to tax authorities, thereby strengthening enforcement. We show that the reform increased firms’ social-insurance contributions, shifted workers toward informal employment without reducing overall nonagricultural employment, and reduced new firm entry while weakening incumbent firms’ profitability and investment. Overall, the reform reduced measured aggregate productivity in China’s registered, above-scale industrial sector by 3.3 percent, with entry into the above-scale industrial sector accounting for about 45 percent of the estimated decline.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103918.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了工资税征管对企业活力及其对总体生产率的影响。我们利用中国社会保险征缴机构改革，该改革将社会保险缴费的征收职责从地方社会保险机构转移至税务部门，从而加强了征管力度。研究表明，该改革增加了企业的社会保险缴费，促使劳动力转向非正规就业而未减少总体非农就业，同时降低了新企业进入率，并削弱了现有企业的盈利能力和投资。总体而言，该改革使中国登记注册的规模以上工业部门的测算总体生产率下降了3.3%，其中进入规模以上工业部门对估计下降的贡献约占45%。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103918.title: Payroll taxes, firm dynamism, and aggregate productivity
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103918.title_zh: 工资税、企业活力与总体生产率

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103919.abstract: A sizable share of marriages in several Asian and African countries are initiated by the man abducting the woman he wishes to wed. In this paper, we use quantitative and qualitative methods to characterize the practice of abduction marriage in Ethiopia. We first present the results from in-depth qualitative interviews with community leaders and abducted women in the Gambella region of Ethiopia to gain a deeper understanding of how the practice functions in these communities. These interviews suggest that abduction is typically used to overcome the refusal of the woman’s family. Second, we use Demographic and Health Survey along with ethnographic data to characterize women and ethnic groups affected by this practice in Ethiopia. Finally, we empirically examine the central hypothesis about the persistence of this practice and find evidence consistent with the hypothesis that men often use abduction to improve bargaining power in marriage negotiations and reduce the size of the bride price payment. Specifically, we demonstrate that droughts—a proxy for income shocks in this setting—increase the probability of abduction marriage only for women from ethnic groups that traditionally exchange a bride price.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103919.abstract_zh: 在多个亚洲和非洲国家，相当比例的婚姻是由男方通过劫持其意中女子来启动的。本文运用定量与定性方法，对埃塞俄比亚的劫婚习俗进行刻画。首先，我们展示了在埃塞俄比亚甘贝拉地区对社区领袖及被劫婚女性的深度定性访谈结果，以深入理解该习俗在这些社区中的运作方式。这些访谈表明，劫婚通常用于克服女方家庭的拒绝。其次，我们利用人口健康调查数据及民族志资料，描绘了埃塞俄比亚受此习俗影响的女性及族群特征。最后，我们实证检验了关于该习俗持续存在的核心假设，并发现证据支持以下假设：男性常利用劫婚来增强婚姻谈判中的议价能力，并减少彩礼支付规模。具体而言，我们证明干旱——在此情境下作为收入冲击的代理变量——仅对传统上交换彩礼的族群中的女性增加了劫婚发生的概率。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103919.title: The economics of abduction marriage: Evidence from Ethiopia
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103919.title_zh: 诱拐婚姻的经济学：来自埃塞俄比亚的证据
