10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103920.abstract: This study examines the industrial preferences of local governments in China through the lens of land allocation. We analyze industrial land transactions from 2007 to 2019, a period marked by both expanding industrial policy and intensifying land market competition. Using a border discontinuity design that compares land transactions near county borders, we separate local government preferences from firm demand. We find systematic industrial favoritism: localities offer deeper price discounts to industries aligned with their existing specialization. This favoritism persists over time, is more pronounced in industries with substantial unrealized agglomeration potential, and is stronger in regions with well-developed market institutions. We further show that local governments comply with upper-level industrial policy only when it aligns with their own specialization. Together, these findings point to a bottom-up process in which local governments use land allocation to attract firms that reinforce local industrial strengths through agglomeration spillovers.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103920.abstract_zh: 本研究从土地配置的视角考察了中国地方政府的产业偏好。我们分析了2007年至2019年间的工业用地交易，这一时期既见证了产业政策的扩张，也伴随着土地市场竞争的加剧。通过采用边界断点设计，对县域边界附近的土地交易进行比较，我们将地方政府的偏好与企业需求分离开来。研究发现存在系统性的产业偏向：地方政府对与其现有专业化方向相符的产业给予更深的土地价格折扣。这种偏向随时间持续存在，在具有显著未实现集聚潜力的产业中更为突出，并且在市场制度发达的地区表现更强。我们进一步表明，地方政府仅在上级产业政策与其自身专业化方向一致时才予以执行。综合来看，这些发现揭示了一个自下而上的过程，即地方政府通过土地配置来吸引能够通过集聚溢出效应强化本地产业优势的企业。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103920.title: Picking Winners: Local Land Allocation and Bottom-Up Industrial Policy in China
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103920.title_zh: 挑选赢家：中国地方土地配置与自下而上的产业政策

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103922.abstract: We explore the use of Revelio data—obtained primarily from LinkedIn profiles—as a source of labor force microdata in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where large-sample, high-frequency, employer-linked alternatives are largely unavailable. To address the selection inherent to LinkedIn usership, we employ ILO labor statistics to construct five sets of country-year-specific weights that alleviate non-representativeness across occupation, industry, occupation × education, industry × education, and industry × firm-size cells. We further validate these weights using national census data where they are available and not used for ILO labor statistics. The weighted dataset provides a balanced monthly panel with coverage across most LMICs. We also discuss remaining limitations of the dataset, including within-cell selection and self-reporting errors, and suggest techniques to alleviate them. Despite imperfect coverage, Revelio offers improved temporal and geographical resolution as well as cross-country comparability and is especially useful for studying the role of firms in economic development.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103922.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了利用Revelio数据——主要源自LinkedIn个人资料——作为低收入和中等收入国家劳动力微观数据来源的可能性，在这些国家，大规模、高频、与雇主关联的替代数据基本不可得。为应对LinkedIn用户群体固有的选择性偏差，我们采用国际劳工组织的劳动统计资料，构建了五组按国家-年份特定的权重，以缓解在职业、行业、职业×教育、行业×教育及行业×企业规模等分类上的非代表性。我们还利用可获取且未用于国际劳工组织统计的国家人口普查数据，对这些权重进行了进一步验证。加权后的数据集提供了一个覆盖大多数低收入和中等收入国家的平衡月度面板。我们还讨论了数据集现存的其他局限，包括单元内选择及自我报告误差，并提出了缓解这些问题的技术方法。尽管覆盖并非完美，Revelio数据在时间与地理分辨率上有所提升，并增强了跨国可比性，尤其适用于研究企业在经济发展中的作用。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103922.title: From LinkedIn to Labor Statistics: Using Revelio Microdata for Labor Market Research in Developing Economies
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103922.title_zh: 从领英到劳动统计：利用Revelio微观数据研究发展中经济体的劳动力市场

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103925.abstract: We estimate productivity spillovers from Japanese cotton-spinning firms in China (known as Zaikabo) to local Chinese cotton-spinning mills based on plant-level data for 1925 to 1938. In order to capture the important role of distance in facilitating such spillovers we geo-localised the plants. Our results provide clear evidence for positive spillovers from Zaikabo to local Chinese mills, which go hand-in-hand with an upgrade in production technology towards greater use of capital. Spillovers are very localised, being strongest within a radius of up to 10 km around the Zaikabo and particularly strong for mills in Shanghai. Exploiting information on the workforce composition of the Japanese affiliates, we find suggestive evidence of a skilled-labour channel: spillovers tend to be larger from Zaikabo employing higher shares of skilled labour. We also find some evidence in line with the idea that these gains are larger for Chinese mills with higher initial productivity, consistent with a role for absorptive capacity. Our paper is the first to document FDI productivity spillovers in a historical context and to characterise the channels through which they operate.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103925.abstract_zh: 我们基于1925年至1938年的工厂层面数据，估算了日本在华棉纺企业（即“在华纺”）对本地中国棉纺厂的生产率溢出效应。为捕捉距离在促进此类溢出中的重要作用，我们对工厂进行了地理定位。研究结果清晰表明，在华纺对本地中国棉纺厂存在正向溢出效应，且这些效应伴随着生产技术向资本更密集使用的升级。溢出效应具有高度本地化特征，在华纺周围10公里半径内最为显著，尤其在上海的棉纺厂中表现突出。利用日本附属企业劳动力构成的信息，我们发现了技能劳动力渠道的提示性证据：雇佣技能劳动力比例较高的在华纺，其溢出效应往往更大。我们还发现一些证据支持这些收益对中国初始生产率较高的棉纺厂更为显著，这与吸收能力的作用相符。本文首次在历史背景下记录了外商直接投资的生产率溢出效应，并刻画了其作用渠道。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103925.title: FDI Spillovers in History: Interwar Japanese “Zaikabo” investment in China’s cotton spinning industry
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103925.title_zh: 历史中的FDI溢出效应：两次世界大战期间日本在华“在华纺”投资与中国棉纺织业

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103927.abstract: This paper analyzes the growth and welfare effects of allocating public resources — both domestic tax revenues and foreign aid — between investment in new public capital and the maintenance of existing public capital in emerging economies. We show that moderate increases in maintenance enhance growth and welfare by improving capital efficiency and longevity, while excessive maintenance crowds out consumption and productive investment and has adverse effects. Foreign aid, by easing domestic fiscal constraints, enables lower distortionary taxation, but its effectiveness depends on both its composition and interaction with domestic fiscal policies. Our study emphasizes the importance of a balanced allocation. Numerical simulations suggest that for a plausible calibration an approximate 80-20 split allocation between new investment and maintenance is desirable, but it is sensitive to the quality of the public capital. For the calibrated benchmark model donor-imposed co-financing requirements have conflicting effects on growth and welfare, although these are highly sensitive to the productivity of public capital, but less so to the allocation.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103927.abstract_zh: 本文分析了新兴经济体在公共资源配置——包括国内税收收入与外国援助——中，将资金用于新增公共资本投资与维护现有公共资本之间的增长与福利效应。研究表明，适度增加维护投入能通过提升资本效率与延长资本寿命来促进增长与福利，而过度的维护则会挤出消费与生产性投资，产生不利影响。外国援助通过缓解国内财政约束，能够降低扭曲性税收，但其效果取决于援助的构成及其与国内财政政策的相互作用。本研究强调了平衡配置的重要性。数值模拟显示，在合理的参数校准下，新增投资与维护之间约80-20的分配比例较为理想，但这一比例对公共资本的质量敏感。在基准模型校准中，捐助方强制的共同融资要求对增长与福利产生相互冲突的影响，尽管这些影响对公共资本的生产率高度敏感，但对分配比例的敏感度较低。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103927.title: Allocation of Foreign Aid in Emerging Economies: Investment in New vs Maintenance of Old Infrastructure
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103927.title_zh: 新兴经济体中的外国援助分配：新基础设施投资与旧基础设施维护

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103928.abstract: Can international anti-corruption monitoring stimulate private investment? We examine staggered reviews across jurisdictions under the United Nations Convention against Corruption (UNCAC), using firm-year observations from 84 economies over 2003–2023. We document that reviews are followed by improvements in economy-level corruption-control indicators. Local-projections difference-in-differences estimates indicate that reviews raise firms’ capital expenditure relative to assets by 1.2126 percentage points, equivalent to 20% of the sample mean. Dynamic estimates show no systematic pre-review adjustment, and the result is robust to influential-economy exclusions, economy-level reweighting, alternative sample restrictions, lagged-outcome controls, and alternative staggered-adoption estimators. Investment responses are stronger in high-corruption economies and developing economies and among firms that are more financially constrained, government dependent, domestically concentrated, or reliant on irreversible capital. These patterns are consistent with international oversight reducing corruption-related institutional risk, financing frictions, and the value of delaying investment. UNCAC reviews are also followed by increases in employment, R&D investment, and leverage. Additional analyses provide no evidence that the increase in investment is accompanied by a systematic decline in investment efficiency. Overall, the findings show that a non-punitive international peer-review mechanism can affect firms’ real activity, particularly where initial institutional frictions are greater.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103928.abstract_zh: 国际反腐败监督能否激发私人投资？我们利用2003年至2023年间84个经济体的企业年度观测数据，考察了《联合国反腐败公约》（UNCAC）下各司法管辖区交错进行的审议。研究发现，审议之后，经济体层面的腐败控制指标有所改善。局部投影双重差分估计表明，审议使企业资本支出相对于资产的比率提高了1.2126个百分点，相当于样本均值的20%。动态估计显示，审议前不存在系统性调整，且该结果在排除具有影响力的经济体、经济体层面重新加权、替代样本限制、滞后结果控制以及替代交错采纳估计量等情形下依然稳健。投资响应在高腐败经济体和发展中经济体中更为显著，且在财务约束更强、更依赖政府、国内业务集中或依赖不可逆资本的企业中表现更为突出。这些模式与国际监督降低腐败相关制度风险、融资摩擦以及延迟投资的价值相一致。UNCAC审议之后，就业、研发投资和杠杆率也有所上升。进一步分析未发现投资增加伴随投资效率系统性下降的证据。总体而言，研究结果表明，非惩罚性的国际同行审议机制能够影响企业的实际活动，尤其是在初始制度摩擦较大的环境中。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103928.title: Corruption and Capital Investment: Worldwide Evidence
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103928.title_zh: 腐败与资本投资：全球证据

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103931.abstract: We estimate the temporal association between high-stakes exam timing and media-reported student suicides in India using geocoded news data. Student suicides are 17.5 percent higher during months in which NEET-UG or JEE-Mains examinations are held, with no comparable pattern around lower-stakes board exams or among adults. The association is concentrated when national entrance exams coincide with board exams, suggesting the salience of cumulative exam burden. These patterns are stronger among girls, in states with higher exam participation, and in urbanised districts. Event-study estimates show suicides increasing immediately before and during exams, while movements around result announcements are weaker and less precisely estimated. We find no evidence that broad shifts in media attention during cyclone or election months account for the pattern, although exam-specific reporting bias cannot be ruled out. In the absence of mental health data, we generate an alternative database to address a policy question and spur future research.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103931.abstract_zh: 我们利用地理编码的新闻数据，估算了印度高风险考试时间与媒体报道的学生自杀事件之间的时间关联。在举行NEET-UG或JEE-Mains考试的月份，学生自杀率高出17.5%，而低风险委员会考试或成年人群体中则未出现类似模式。这一关联在全国性入学考试与委员会考试时间重叠时更为集中，表明累积考试负担的显著性。这些模式在女生群体、考试参与率较高的邦以及城市化程度较高的地区中更为明显。事件研究估计显示，自杀事件在考试前夕及考试期间立即增加，而成绩公布前后的变动则较弱且估计精度较低。我们没有发现气旋或选举月份媒体关注度的广泛转移能解释这一模式的证据，尽管无法排除针对考试特定报道偏差的可能性。在缺乏心理健康数据的情况下，我们构建了一个替代数据库，以回应政策问题并推动未来研究。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103931.title: Under Pressure: High-Stakes Exams and Media-Reported Student Suicides in India1
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103931.title_zh: 压力之下：印度高风险考试与媒体报道的学生自杀事件

10.1016/j.jebo.2021.09.024.abstract: Experiment evidence to date indicates that subjects follow a trigger strategy in finitely repeated games: they punish bad contractual performance by reducing future offers and the threat of punishment disciplines opportunistic breach. This behavior contradicts standard game theory predictions. We conduct a repeated prisoner’s dilemma (PD) game experiment with university students in Ghana and the UK. The experiment is framed as an employment contract. Each period the employer makes a irrevocable wage offer to the worker who then chooses an effort level. UK subjects use a trigger strategy to discipline workers, in line with previous experiments: wage offers reward high effort and punish low effort in the past; this induces workers to choose high effort; and gains from trade are shared between workers and employers. We find no such evidence with Ghana subjects: employers seldom reduce wage offers after low effort and, if they do, workers respond by lowering effort; employer often reduce wages after high effort; and employers earn a zero payoff on average. Introducing competition or reputation does not significantly improve workers’ effort. We conclude that the use of trigger strategies in repeated labor transactions is not a universally shared heuristic. © 2021 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 10.1016/j.jebo.2021.09.024.abstract_zh: 迄今为止的实验证据表明，在有限重复博弈中，受试者遵循触发策略：他们通过减少未来的出价来惩罚不良的合同履行，而惩罚的威胁则约束了机会主义的违约行为。这一行为与标准博弈论的预测相悖。我们在加纳和英国的大学学生中进行了重复囚徒困境（PD）博弈实验。实验被设定为雇佣合同的框架。每个时期，雇主向工人提出不可撤销的工资报价，工人随后选择努力水平。英国受试者使用触发策略来约束工人，这与之前的实验一致：工资报价奖励过去的高努力并惩罚低努力；这促使工人选择高努力；贸易收益在工人和雇主之间共享。然而，我们在加纳受试者中未发现此类证据：雇主在工人低努力后很少降低工资报价，即便降低，工人也会以降低努力作为回应；雇主经常在高努力后降低工资；且雇主平均获得零收益。引入竞争或声誉并未显著改善工人的努力水平。我们得出结论，在重复劳动交易中使用触发策略并非普遍共享的启发式方法。© 2021 Elsevier B.V. 保留所有权利。我们感谢Johannes Abeler、Alan Beggs、Douglas Bernheim、Stefano Caria、Johannes Haushofer、Rocco Macchiavello、Karine Marazyan、Fola Malomo、Muriel Niederle、Simon Quinn、Christopher Roth、Yogita Shamdasani、Hannah Uckat、Marc Witte，以及牛津企业与发展研究小组、斯坦福行为与实验午餐会、CSAE-iiG会议、斯坦福发展研讨会、CSAE研究研讨会、巴黎DIAL会议、世界银行贫困与应用微观研讨会、NEUDC、PacDev和SEEDEC的参与者提供的宝贵意见。非常感谢Václav T ̌ehle和Martin Černý出色的研究协助，以及Andrew Kerr和Denise Gray在本实验试运行期间的帮助。此外，我们感谢Moses Awoonor-Williams在后勤方面的协助，以及我们在当地的实地团队，特别是Eric Agyekum和Bismark Owusu Tetteh Nortey。本研究属于一项更广泛的加纳创业研究的一部分，由英国国际发展部（DFID）资助[资助号GB-1-113580]，作为iiG研究项目的一部分，旨在研究如何改善非洲和南亚有利于穷人的增长的制度。Elwyn Davies感谢经济与社会研究理事会（ESRC）的额外资助[资助号ES/J500112/1]。本研究的IRB批准由牛津大学中央大学研究伦理委员会获得。本文表达的观点、解释和结论完全属于作者本人，不代表DFID、国际复兴开发银行/世界银行及其附属组织的观点，也不代表世界银行执行董事或其代表的政府的观点。∗ 通讯作者。电子邮箱：edavies@worldbank.org (E. 10.1016/j.jebo.2021.09.024.title: When No Bad Deed Goes Punished: Relational Contracting in Ghana and the UK
10.1016/j.jebo.2021.09.024.title_zh: 当恶行未受惩罚时：加纳与英国的关系契约

10.1016/j.jebo.2025.107348.abstract: We investigate the effect of inflation targeting on income inequality across a comprehensive panel of 152 countries spanning over four decades. Using the entropy balancing methodology to address endogeneity issues, we find that inflation targeting significantly increases income inequality. This effect, which is robust across various alternative methods and specifications, is driven by an increase (decrease) in the income share of relatively rich (poor) households. In addition, the impact of inflation targeting is not uniform but varies conditional on redistribution policies, inflation targeting features, the level of economic development, and country-specific characteristics. Our findings contribute to the ongoing discussion on the broad socioeconomic implications of the monetary policy, including measures to mitigate the potential side effects on income distribution.
10.1016/j.jebo.2025.107348.abstract_zh: 我们考察了通货膨胀目标制对收入不平等的影响，基于一个覆盖152个国家、跨越四十多年的全面面板数据。采用熵平衡方法以解决内生性问题，我们发现通货膨胀目标制显著加剧了收入不平等。这一效应在多种替代方法和规格下均保持稳健，其驱动因素在于相对富裕（贫困）家庭收入份额的增加（减少）。此外，通货膨胀目标制的影响并非均匀一致，而是根据再分配政策、通货膨胀目标制的特征、经济发展水平以及国家特定特征而有所差异。我们的发现为关于货币政策广泛社会经济影响的持续讨论做出了贡献，包括采取措施以减轻其对收入分配潜在副作用的策略。
10.1016/j.jebo.2025.107348.title: Inflation targeting and income inequality
10.1016/j.jebo.2025.107348.title_zh: 通胀目标制与收入不平等

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107558.abstract: More than half a century ago, experimental economists came up with a set of rigorous methodological principles that revolutionized the way economists think—and that have defined the field ever since. Pivotal among them are the no-deception norm, the use of abstract instructions, induced-value theory, and the use of incentives in experiments. In this paper I revisit these principles, critically examining their origins and justifications, and explore their stand in current research, given the new challenges posed by online experiments, cross-disciplinary spillovers, and the evolving landscape of behavioral research. I conclude that we have become too rigidly attached to our methodologies and should adopt a more flexible, context-sensitive, and less-dogmatic approach.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107558.abstract_zh: 半个多世纪前，实验经济学家提出了一套严谨的方法论原则，彻底改变了经济学家的思维方式，并自此定义了该领域。其中关键原则包括不欺骗规范、使用抽象指令、诱导价值理论以及在实验中使用激励措施。本文重新审视这些原则，批判性地探讨其起源与合理性，并考察它们在当前研究中的地位，鉴于在线实验、跨学科溢出效应以及行为研究不断演变的格局所带来的新挑战。我得出结论，我们已过于僵化地固守方法论，应当采取更为灵活、情境敏感且较少教条化的方法。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107558.title: Experimental methods: Revisiting the commandments of experimental economics
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107558.title_zh: 实验方法：重访实验经济学准则

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107579.abstract: Attitudes to inequality differ across countries and contexts, and understanding these differences is important for the design of redistributive policies. We here present evidence on fairness preferences in Kenya, based on a series of lab experiments with participants from Nairobi's largest informal settlement and its main university. This innovative sample allows us to compare the attitudes and beliefs of two important groups in society: the poor and the educated. We find that while the participants from the informal settlements are more egalitarian than the university students, they are less egalitarian than what is generally perceived. A second important finding is the sharp distinction made between distribution and redistribution, where participants are far more willing to equalize funds with no clear ownership compared to funds where there is an ex-ante allocation. Finally, many participants view luck as a more deserving source of inequality than performance, an observation that is contrary to what is commonly found in the literature. Our results highlight the complexity of people's fairness views and show the importance of not relying on stereotypes when designing redistributive policies that harmonize with local norms.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107579.abstract_zh: 不同国家与情境下，人们对不平等的态度各异，理解这些差异对于设计再分配政策至关重要。本文基于在内罗毕最大非正规居住区及其主要大学参与者中进行的一系列实验室实验，提供了关于肯尼亚公平偏好的证据。这一创新样本使我们能够比较社会中两个重要群体——贫困群体与受过教育群体——的态度与信念。我们发现，尽管非正规居住区的参与者比大学生更倾向于平等主义，但他们的平等主义程度低于普遍认知。第二个重要发现是，在分配与再分配之间存在显著区分，参与者更愿意均等化无明确所有权的资金，而对于存在事前分配的资金则意愿较低。最后，许多参与者认为运气比表现更应成为不平等的来源，这一观察与文献中常见结论相悖。我们的结果凸显了人们公平观念的复杂性，并表明在设计符合当地规范的再分配政策时，不应依赖刻板印象的重要性。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107579.title: Fair inequality? Lab evidence from Kenya
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107579.title_zh: 公平不平等？来自肯尼亚的实验证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107586.abstract: We study the relative impact of custodial and non-custodial sentences on later crime and labor-market outcomes in Denmark, a country where detention conditions are particularly good. To do so, we take advantage of a large-scale reform of the Danish legislation implemented in 2000, whereby incarceration was replaced by a non-custodial sentence for most drunk-driving crimes, which represented a quarter of all custodial sentences passed in 1999. Our first key finding is that stakeholders anticipated the consequences of the reform and that wealthier offenders managed to postpone their trial until after the reform came into force to avoid prison. To measure the relative impact of incarceration, we therefore use a novel instrumental variable approach exploiting quasi-exogenous variation in the probability of being tried after the reform, and therefore incarcerated, based on offenders’ crime date. We follow sampled individuals over a 15-year period and find that incarcerated offenders commit more crimes and have weaker ties to the labor market after release. Additionally, first-time offenders are more negatively affected than repeat offenders.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107586.abstract_zh: 我们研究了丹麦监禁刑与非监禁刑对后续犯罪及劳动力市场结果的相对影响，该国拘留条件尤为优越。为此，我们利用了2000年实施的一项大规模丹麦立法改革，该改革将大多数酒驾犯罪中的监禁刑替换为非监禁刑，而此类犯罪在1999年占所有监禁刑判决的四分之一。我们的首要关键发现是，利益相关者预见到了改革的后果，较富裕的罪犯设法将审判推迟至改革生效之后，以避免入狱。为衡量监禁的相对影响，我们因此采用了一种新颖的工具变量方法，利用基于罪犯犯罪日期的改革后受审概率的准外生变异，从而推断入狱概率。我们对抽样个体进行了15年的追踪，发现入狱罪犯在释放后犯罪更多，且与劳动力市场的联系更为薄弱。此外，初犯者比惯犯受到更为不利的影响。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107586.title: Custodial versus non-custodial sentences: Long-run evidence from an anticipated reform
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107586.title_zh: 监管刑与非监管刑：基于一项预期改革的长期证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107589.abstract: This paper estimates a “neural autopilot” model of habit formation using individual-level data on posting behavior from a major Chinese social media platform before, during, and after the 2020 pandemic lockdown. The model yields interpretable parameter estimates for autopilot habit formation and demonstrates that, once habits are neuroscientifically formalized, changes in preferences are no longer required to explain observed behavioral changes. Moreover, the model provides a better fit to the data than both traditional state-dependent habit models and alternative reinforcement learning models. Our analysis further reveals that forced experimentation alone does not generate persistent habitual posting after the lockdown ends. Counterfactual experiments indicate that reducing the volatility of posting rewards, in conjunction with forced experimentation, can significantly strengthen habitual posting on social media. This finding highlights the importance of higher moments of the reward process in creating and sustaining habits.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107589.abstract_zh: 本文利用2020年疫情封锁前后及期间中国某大型社交媒体平台上的个体发帖行为数据，估计了一个习惯形成的“神经自动驾驶”模型。该模型为自动驾驶式习惯形成提供了可解释的参数估计，并表明，一旦习惯以神经科学方式形式化，解释观察到的行为变化便不再需要偏好变化。此外，与传统状态依赖习惯模型及替代性强化学习模型相比，该模型对数据的拟合更优。我们的分析进一步揭示，仅靠强制实验本身并不能在封锁结束后产生持续的习惯性发帖行为。反事实实验表明，降低发帖奖励的波动性，并结合强制实验，能显著增强社交媒体上的习惯性发帖。这一发现强调了奖励过程的高阶矩在创造和维持习惯中的重要性。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107589.title: A structural neural autopilot analysis of social media use around the pandemic lockdown
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107589.title_zh: 疫情封锁期间社交媒体使用的结构性神经自动分析

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107590.abstract: We study how variation in social media access (Twitter/X) during a salient political event affects political polarization and stress, and how these exposure effects relate to broader patterns of selection into social media. We conducted a pre-registered laboratory experiment during the 2019 Argentine presidential debate, recruiting both Twitter users and non-users. Twitter users were randomly assigned to one of four conditions: watching the debate with their usual phone access, watching the debate with their phones switched off, watching the debate while interacting with an experimenter-run Twitter account that shared a balanced mix of partisan content, or watching a politically neutral documentary without phones. Non-Twitter participants were randomly assigned to watch the debate or the documentary without phones. Selection comparisons indicate that recruited Twitter users are more polarized than recruited non-users. Causal exposure comparisons within the Twitter-user sample show that two strategies often proposed to reduce political polarization on social media, removing access to the platform and exposing users to counter-attitudinal content, do not reduce polarization and may instead produce mild increases. The latter treatment also significantly increases physiological stress (as measured by salivary cortisol). Further exploratory analyses reveal substantial heterogeneity tied to users’ online political environments. Politically segregated individuals — that is, users embedded in echo chambers — exhibit clear backfire effects when access is removed or cross-ideological interactions are encouraged. In particular, both treatments increase polarization among these users. In addition, when cross-ideological interaction is encouraged, segregated users concentrate a larger share of their Twitter engagement within like-minded networks and show higher cortisol levels. By contrast, non-segregated users show little to no response and closely resemble non-users. Moreover, the selection differences observed between recruited Twitter users and non-users in our sample are concentrated among politically segregated users.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107590.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在重大政治事件期间，社交媒体访问（Twitter/X）的变化如何影响政治极化和压力，以及这些暴露效应如何与社交媒体选择的更广泛模式相关联。我们在2019年阿根廷总统辩论期间进行了一项预先注册的实验室实验，招募了Twitter用户和非用户。Twitter用户被随机分配到四种条件之一：使用手机正常观看辩论、关闭手机观看辩论、观看辩论的同时与实验者运营的Twitter账户互动（该账户分享平衡的党派内容），或无手机观看政治中立纪录片。非Twitter参与者被随机分配为无手机观看辩论或纪录片。选择比较表明，招募的Twitter用户比招募的非用户更加极化。在Twitter用户样本中的因果暴露比较显示，两种常被提议用于减少社交媒体政治极化的策略——移除平台访问权限和让用户接触对立态度内容——并未减少极化，反而可能产生轻微增加。后一种处理还显著增加了生理压力（通过唾液皮质醇测量）。进一步的探索性分析揭示了与用户在线政治环境相关的显著异质性。政治隔离个体——即处于回音室中的用户——在访问被移除或鼓励跨意识形态互动时表现出明显的反弹效应。特别是，两种处理都增加了这些用户的极化。此外，当鼓励跨意识形态互动时，隔离用户将更大比例的Twitter参与集中在同质网络中，并表现出更高的皮质醇水平。相比之下，非隔离用户几乎没有反应，与非用户高度相似。此外，我们样本中招募的Twitter用户与非用户之间观察到的选择差异主要集中在政治隔离用户中。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107590.title: Does social media exacerbate political polarization? Experimental evidence from varying access to Twitter/X during a presidential debate
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107590.title_zh: 社交媒体是否加剧了政治极化？——来自总统辩论期间不同推特/X访问权限的实验证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107591.abstract: We show that social information about competition choices influences individuals’ willingness to compete. In a laboratory experiment, participants perform a real-effort task under piece-rate and tournament incentives, and subsequently participate in two choice rounds. We vary the information provided between the two choice rounds across three treatments. We find that social information on the proportion of participants that choose to compete in the first round affects the willingness to compete in the second round. Salience of payment schemes does not explain this result. Observing a lower willingness to compete by others increases the likelihood of one’s own willingness to compete. This suggests that participants strategically choose to compete based on their treatment induced belief about the average ability of other participants, and this is consistent with predictions from a rational model of Bayesian learning. This effect is particularly strong for women.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107591.abstract_zh: 我们证明，关于竞争选择的社会信息会影响个体的竞争意愿。在一项实验室实验中，参与者在计件薪酬和锦标赛激励下完成一项实际努力任务，随后参与两轮选择。我们在三个处理组中改变两轮选择之间提供的信息。我们发现，第一轮中选择竞争的参与者比例这一社会信息，会影响第二轮中的竞争意愿。支付方案的显著性并不能解释这一结果。观察到他人较低的竞争意愿会增加自身竞争意愿的可能性。这表明，参与者基于处理诱导的关于其他参与者平均能力的信念，策略性地选择是否竞争，这与贝叶斯学习的理性模型预测相一致。这一效应在女性中尤为显著。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107591.title: Effect of social information on competition choice
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107591.title_zh: 社会信息对竞争选择的影响

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107593.abstract: We explore whether experiments involving strategic interactions yield the same conclusions regardless of the environment they take place in. We do so by comparing the behavior of a group of individuals when they play the same two-person zero-sum game in both a soccer stadium (the field) and a video game (the lab). We conduct our experiment with professional soccer players and inexperienced college students to determine if the abilities acquired in the field apply to both environments. Our findings show that while both groups behave consistently with the implications of mixed strategy equilibrium in the field, their behavior rejects the theory in the lab, where both groups seem to follow a reinforcement learning model.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107593.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了涉及策略互动的实验是否在不同环境下得出相同结论。为此，我们比较了同一组个体在足球场（实地）和电子游戏（实验室）中玩相同的两人零和游戏时的行为。我们以职业足球运动员和缺乏经验的大学生为实验对象，以确定在实地获得的能力是否适用于两种环境。研究结果显示，尽管两组在实地中的行为与混合策略均衡的含义一致，但在实验室中，他们的行为却拒绝了该理论，两组似乎都遵循强化学习模型。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107593.title: Déjà Vu? When the Lab Mimics the Field
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107593.title_zh: 既视感？当实验室模拟现实世界时

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107595.abstract: Physical laboratory experiments occupy a key position within experimental economics for a wide range of research questions, offering crucial methodological rigor by ensuring human authenticity, controlling informational conditions, directing interpersonal interactions, ensuring protocol credibility, and reliably administering monetary incentives. These factors contribute to the empirical robustness of experimental findings. The continued advancement of online experimental platforms offers complementary scientific benefits to laboratory experiments, such as lowering costs and increasing sample diversity. We identify and elaborate on specific research questions for which laboratory-based methods offer clear scientific advantages, emphasizing their ability to yield precise, insightful, and replicable data.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107595.abstract_zh: 物理实验室实验在实验经济学中占据关键地位，适用于广泛的研究问题，通过确保人类真实性、控制信息条件、引导人际互动、保证协议可信度以及可靠实施货币激励，提供了至关重要的方法论严谨性。这些因素有助于增强实验发现的经验稳健性。在线实验平台的持续进步为实验室实验提供了互补的科学优势，例如降低成本和提高样本多样性。我们识别并详细阐述了实验室方法具有明显科学优势的具体研究问题，强调其在生成精确、深刻且可复制数据方面的能力。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107595.title: The virtues of lab experiments

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107596.abstract: We develop an information-based intervention against sexual harassment and test it in a randomized control trial across small groups of military recruits in the boot camp of the Norwegian military. The intervention seeks to bridge two knowledge gaps with implications for sexual harassment prevalence. We tell some recruits about their peers’ beliefs that “telling sexualized jokes can be labeled sexual harassment” and about women soldiers’ equal performance on military skill tests. This treatment gives lasting improvements in knowledge about what sexual harassment is and about women’s job performance. The impact on sexual harassment prevalence is directionally negative but statistically insignificant. We discuss measurement error and use survey responses about a harassment scenario to argue that the intervention likely affected behavior. Our study provides the first field experiment to evaluate whether a prevention method against sexual harassment reduces prevalence in a work setting. We use insights from our research process to identify methodological pitfalls and provide guidance for future field experiments in this area.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107596.abstract_zh: 我们设计了一项基于信息的性骚扰干预措施，并在挪威军队新兵训练营的小组随机对照试验中对其进行了测试。该干预旨在弥合两个与性骚扰发生率相关的知识缺口。我们告知部分新兵，其同伴认为“开性玩笑可被视为性骚扰”，以及女兵在军事技能测试中表现与男兵相当。这一干预持久地提升了关于性骚扰定义及女性工作表现的知识。对性骚扰发生率的影响方向为负，但统计上不显著。我们讨论了测量误差，并利用关于骚扰情境的问卷调查回应，论证该干预可能影响了行为。我们的研究提供了首个在职场环境中评估性骚扰预防方法能否降低其发生率的现场实验。我们利用研究过程中的洞察，识别方法论陷阱，并为该领域未来的现场实验提供指导。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107596.title: Targeting attitudes to combat sexual harassment: A randomized intervention in the Norwegian military
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107596.title_zh: 针对态度以打击性骚扰：挪威军队中的随机干预实验

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107598.abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on income tax evasion by the self-employed, using a novel dataset that links a household consumption survey with tax administration records in Italy. We find that the share of unreported income among self-employed households is approximately one-third of total income, a magnitude comparable to that documented in countries with substantially lower aggregate evasion. We show that income tax evasion primarily originates among liberal professionals, who underreport their income by about twice as much as small businesses do. The results suggest that Italy’s high aggregate evasion rate is driven primarily by the composition of economic activity and evasion opportunities, rather than by uniformly higher individual propensities to evade or weaker tax morale. Our distributional analysis reveals that tax evasion substantially distorts vertical and horizontal equity, worsening both forms of equity and increasing inequality in the tax burden across households.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107598.abstract_zh: 本文利用一项将意大利家庭消费调查与税务管理记录相结合的新数据集，为自雇人士的所得税逃税行为提供了新颖证据。我们发现，自雇家庭未申报收入约占总收入的三分之一，这一规模与总体逃税率显著较低的国家所记录的情况相当。研究显示，所得税逃税主要源于自由职业者，其少报收入的程度约为小企业的两倍。结果表明，意大利较高的总体逃税率主要由经济活动构成和逃税机会所驱动，而非个体逃税倾向普遍更高或税收道德较弱所致。我们的分配分析揭示，逃税严重扭曲了纵向和横向公平，加剧了两种形式的公平问题，并增加了家庭间税负的不平等。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107598.title: Self-employment income tax evasion and inequality
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107598.title_zh: 自雇收入逃税与不平等

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107599.abstract: We explore the twin questions of when and how the strategy method creates behavioral distortions in the elicitation of choices in laboratory studies of sequential games. While such distortions have been widely documented, the theoretical forces driving these distortions remain poorly understood. In this paper, we compare behavior in six optimally designed centipede games, implemented under three different choice elicitation methods: the direct response method, the reduced strategy method and the full strategy method. These methods elicit behavioral strategies, reduced strategies, and complete strategies, respectively. We find significant behavioral differences across these elicitation methods—differences that cannot be explained by standard game theory, but are consistent with the predictions of the Dynamic Cognitive Hierarchy solution (Lin and Palfrey, 2024), combined with payoff dependent stochastic choice.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107599.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在序贯博弈实验室研究中，策略方法在何种条件下以及如何引发选择诱导中的行为偏差。尽管此类偏差已被广泛记录，但驱动这些偏差的理论力量仍未被充分理解。本文中，我们比较了六种最优设计的蜈蚣博弈中的行为，这些博弈在三种不同的选择诱导方法下实施：直接反应法、简化策略法和完整策略法。这些方法分别诱导行为策略、简化策略和完整策略。我们发现这些诱导方法之间存在显著的行为差异——这些差异无法用标准博弈论解释，但与动态认知层级解（Lin和Palfrey，2024）结合支付依赖的随机选择的预测一致。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107600.abstract: Little is known about single mothers' labor market outcomes. On the one hand, they might not havethe typical social constraints of married women in traditional patriarchal societies, but on theother hand, they face the same constraints with respect to childcare and childbearing as othermarried mothers. While aggregate data suggests that single mothers’ participationrates are usually higher than those unmarried, we argue that in contrast tomarried women, this realized labor market equilibriummasks potential demand-side discrimination and likely reflects strong supply-side incentives.To uncover potential demand-side discrimination effects, we conduct a correspondencestudy experiment that involves applying to real jobs using fictitious resumes. Weshow that equally qualified single mothers are much less likely to receive interview callbacksthan unmarried women without children, married without children, and married mothers. Forevery interview callback a single mother has to apply to about 30 jobs, whereas an unmarriedwoman receives more than two callbacks for as many job applications.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107600.abstract_zh: 关于单身母亲的劳动力市场结果，我们知之甚少。一方面，她们可能不像传统父权社会中的已婚女性那样受到典型的社会约束；但另一方面，她们在育儿和生育方面面临与其他已婚母亲相同的限制。尽管总体数据显示，单身母亲的劳动参与率通常高于未婚女性，但我们认为，与已婚女性相比，这一已实现的劳动力市场均衡掩盖了潜在的需求侧歧视，并可能反映了强大的供给侧激励。为了揭示潜在的需求侧歧视效应，我们进行了一项通信研究实验，使用虚构简历申请真实职位。结果显示，同等资质的单身母亲获得面试回应的可能性远低于无子女的未婚女性、无子女的已婚女性以及已婚母亲。每获得一次面试回应，单身母亲需申请约30份工作，而未婚女性在相同数量的申请中能收到超过两次回应。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107600.title: Labor market penalty for single mothers
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107600.title_zh: 单亲母亲的劳动力市场惩罚

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107601.abstract: This study examines how informational interventions that aim to correct systematic misperceptions of others’ beliefs (i.e., pluralistic ignorance) affect individuals’ willingness to engage in both private and publicly observable behaviors. We investigate this question in the context of carbon taxation using an online experiment with participants in the United States. Specifically, we test whether providing accurate information about public support for carbon taxation influences climate-related actions. While this informational intervention reduced misperceptions, it marginally lowered private climate action, measured by donations to an organization advocating for climate policies, although this effect was not statistically significant. The intervention did not affect the behavior of individuals who underestimated support for carbon taxation but negatively impacted the donation decisions of those who overestimated support, suggesting a boomerang effect. In contrast, the intervention increased public climate action, measured by the minimum reward participants required to attend climate policy discussions with peers. These findings suggest that correcting misperceived norms can generate heterogeneous behavioral responses, depending on individuals’ prior beliefs and the type of action considered.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107601.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了旨在纠正对他人信念系统性误解（即多元无知）的信息干预如何影响个体参与私人及公开可观察行为的意愿。我们以碳税为背景，通过对美国参与者进行在线实验来考察这一问题。具体而言，我们测试了提供关于碳税公众支持度的准确信息是否会影响气候相关行为。尽管这种信息干预减少了误解，但它略微降低了私人气候行动——以向倡导气候政策的组织捐款为衡量指标，尽管这一效应在统计上并不显著。该干预并未影响低估碳税支持度的个体的行为，但对高估支持度的个体的捐款决策产生了负面影响，表明存在回旋镖效应。相比之下，该干预增加了公开气候行动——以参与者与同伴参加气候政策讨论所需的最低报酬为衡量指标。这些发现表明，纠正被误解的社会规范可能引发异质性行为反应，具体取决于个体先前的信念及所考虑的行为类型。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107601.title: Pluralistic ignorance and climate policies: Information provision experiment
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107601.title_zh: 多元无知与气候政策：信息提供实验

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107602.abstract: Using a triple difference estimation strategy, we compare the labour market outcomes of men and women before and just after the implementation of extended maternity leave policy across age profiles of individuals, in India. We find a negative impact of the maternity leave extension policy on the employment of women in high-fertility age cohorts. To explain this intuitively, we adapt a stylized micro-founded model of life-cycle search and matching friction in a gendered environment where the additional cost burden of maternity leave is borne by the firms, as is the case in India. We argue that if the firm’s cost from longer maternity leave duration outweighs the gain from retaining a worker, then the probability of being employed for fertile-age female workers decreases; via increased reservation productivity and decreased market tightness. Our empirical results and theoretical framework underscore the fact that even a well-intended policy design must be cognizant of underlying labour market dynamics to avoid exacerbating gender differences in labour markets.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107602.abstract_zh: 采用三重差分估计策略，我们比较了印度实施延长产假政策前后，不同年龄段个体的男女劳动力市场结果。我们发现，延长产假政策对高生育年龄段女性的就业产生了负面影响。为直观解释这一现象，我们构建了一个基于生命周期搜索与匹配摩擦的微观基础模型，并置于性别化环境中，其中产假带来的额外成本负担由企业承担，正如印度的情况。我们认为，如果企业因延长产假而承担的成本超过保留员工的收益，那么育龄女性工人的就业概率将下降；这通过提高保留生产率和降低市场紧密度实现。我们的实证结果和理论框架强调，即使是意图良好的政策设计，也必须认识到潜在的劳动力市场动态，以避免加剧劳动力市场中的性别差异。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107602.title: Maternity leave and labour market outcomes
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107602.title_zh: 产假与劳动力市场结果

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107603.abstract: The idea that patience is an important determinant of economic growth is well rooted in the economic literature. This paper investigates the causal relationship going in the opposite direction, i.e., from growth to patience. We propose a simple theoretical framework where patience evolves endogenously over time as a result of parental effort to transmit it to their offspring. Our model links such effort, and thus the overall level of patience in an economy, to economic growth. We corroborate our theoretical mechanism by estimating the impact of growth shocks on proxies of both patience and parental engagement to educate children to patience.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107603.abstract_zh: 耐心是经济增长重要决定因素的观点在经济文献中根深蒂固。本文探讨了相反方向的因果关系，即从经济增长到耐心。我们提出了一个简单的理论框架，其中耐心随时间内生演化，源于父母将其传递给后代的努力。我们的模型将这种努力，以及经济中耐心的总体水平，与经济增长联系起来。我们通过估计增长冲击对耐心代理指标及父母教育孩子耐心参与度的影响，来验证我们的理论机制。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107603.title: The impact of growth on the transmission of patience
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107603.title_zh: 增长对耐心传导的影响

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107604.abstract: This study identifies 44 democratic transitions from 1980–2023 and estimates their effect on pro-market sentiments using a stacked difference-in-differences design. Democratic transitions reduce pro-market sentiments by 0.345 standard deviations on average. Yet the average masks a striking dynamic: a honeymoon spike more than four times the magnitude of the average decline, which reverses within two years. Cases of democratic deepening, where existing democracies further strengthened democratic governance, exhibit similar dynamics. The pattern survives a direct mean reversion test: countries with high and low baseline sentiments both exhibit the honeymoon spike. Falsification tests confirm the effect is specific to market attitudes, not a generic attitudinal shift. Declining beliefs in private ownership drive the negative medium-term effect even as acceptance of personal responsibility rises, suggesting ideological reconfiguration rather than uniform attitude decay. These findings indicate that the ideological foundations of market economies do not automatically consolidate alongside democratic institutions.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107604.abstract_zh: 本研究识别了1980年至2023年间44次民主转型，并采用堆叠双重差分设计估计其对亲市场情绪的影响。民主转型平均使亲市场情绪下降0.345个标准差。然而，这一平均值掩盖了一个显著动态：蜜月期飙升幅度超过平均降幅的四倍，并在两年内逆转。在既有民主国家进一步加强民主治理的民主深化案例中，也呈现出类似动态。该模式通过了直接均值回归检验：基线情绪高和低的国家均表现出蜜月期飙升。证伪检验确认，该效应特定于市场态度，而非普遍的态度转变。对私有产权信念的下降驱动了负面的中期效应，即便个人责任接受度上升，这表明意识形态重构而非态度整体衰退。这些发现表明，市场经济的意识形态基础并不会随民主制度的确立而自动巩固。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107605.abstract: We examine the political and economic effects of sanctions against their stated goals to justify them. We find null or negative effects on every outcome that we test. Given the ubiquity and persistence of economic sanctions as international policy tools, and given the substantial costs of designing, maintaining, and enforcing sanctions, this seems paradoxical. Why would contemporary nation states impose sanctions with no discernibly beneficial effects? We highlight the behavioral complexity inherent to the context of international relations as a viable explanation for sanctions’ lack of measurable efficacy. Designing and enforcing effective sanctions with precision and accuracy is a tangibly more complex challenge beyond conventional punitive deterrence. Using public choice analysis, we explain how sanctions benefit certain special interests and government authorities. The persistent use of these economic tools for statecraft can ultimately be explained by public choice.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107605.abstract_zh: 我们考察了制裁对其宣称目标的政治与经济效应，以论证其合理性。我们发现，在我们测试的每一项结果上，制裁均呈现无效或负面效应。鉴于经济制裁作为国际政策工具的普遍性与持续性，以及设计、维持和执行制裁所付出的巨大成本，这似乎显得矛盾。为何当代民族国家会实施无明显有益效果的制裁？我们强调国际关系语境中固有的行为复杂性，作为制裁缺乏可衡量效力的合理解释。以精准和精确的方式设计和执行有效制裁，是一项远超传统惩罚性威慑的实际复杂挑战。运用公共选择分析，我们解释了制裁如何惠及特定特殊利益集团和政府当局。这些经济工具在外交中的持续使用，最终可由公共选择理论加以解释。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107605.title: Sanctions without sanctimony: Why do states impose sanctions?
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107605.title_zh: 无道义的制裁：国家为何实施制裁？

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107606.abstract: This paper studies how flattening government hierarchy shapes firm creation and aggregate productivity. Exploiting the staggered implementation of China’s government reorganization with comprehensive firm registration data, we find that this delayering of government substantially hindered firm creation and reduced aggregate productivity, with effects especially pronounced among larger enterprises. We discuss two primary channels driving this result: weakened coordination arising from expanded provincial control and intensified vertical political competition between prefecture and county governments. Our findings highlight that flattening government hierarchy can generate unintended economic frictions, potentially offsetting its intended benefits.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107606.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了政府层级扁平化如何影响企业创立与总体生产率。利用中国政府机构改革的错峰实施及全面的企业注册数据，我们发现这一政府层级精简显著阻碍了企业创立并降低了总体生产率，其中对大型企业的影响尤为突出。我们讨论了两条主要作用机制：省级控制范围扩大导致的协调弱化，以及地级市与县级政府间垂直政治竞争的加剧。我们的研究结果表明，政府层级扁平化可能引发非预期的经济摩擦，从而可能抵消其预期收益。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107606.title: Competition versus coordination: The impact of flattening government on firm creation and aggregate productivity
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107606.title_zh: 竞争与协调：政府扁平化对企业创建和全要素生产率的影响

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107607.abstract: By institutionally rethinking the Solow residual in light of how the interplay of policy interventions and market forces affects factor income shares, we attempt to interpret China’s TFP performance from an institutional perspective. To explore the growth–efficiency paradox inherent in the China model of growth, we apply the Jorgensonian APPF–Domar growth accounting framework to the revised and updated CIP/China KLEMS dataset. The framework coherently integrates industry productivity accounts with national accounts to distinguish TFP growth caused by changes in factor utilization within industries from TFP growth caused by changes in factor reallocation between industries. By regrouping 37 Chinese industries according to their distance from state controls (or, conversely, their proximity to final demand) and dividing the entire 1978–2023 period into subperiods to reflect major policy and institutional changes and external shocks, we show that capital reallocation brought about strong TFP gains when both the government and the market happened to address similar structural problems, but policy efforts toward growth inevitably led to efficiency losses and ultimately hindered China’s growth.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107607.abstract_zh: 通过从制度层面重新审视索洛剩余，并考量政策干预与市场力量相互作用如何影响要素收入份额，我们试图从制度视角解读中国的全要素生产率表现。为探究中国增长模式中固有的增长-效率悖论，我们将乔根森式APPF-多马增长核算框架应用于修订并更新的CIP/中国KLEMS数据集。该框架将行业生产率账户与国民账户有机整合，以区分行业内要素利用变化引起的全要素生产率增长与行业间要素重新配置变化引起的全要素生产率增长。通过根据37个中国行业与国家控制距离（或反之，与最终需求接近程度）进行重新分组，并将1978-2023年整个时期划分为子时期以反映重大政策与制度变迁及外部冲击，我们表明，当政府与市场恰好共同应对类似结构性问题时，资本重新配置带来了强劲的全要素生产率收益，但旨在促进增长的政策努力不可避免地导致效率损失，并最终阻碍了中国经济增长。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107607.title: Market versus state in driving growth: An institutional interpretation of TFP changes in China
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107607.title_zh: 市场与政府在增长驱动中的作用：中国全要素生产率变化的制度解读

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107608.abstract: Credence goods markets are prone to fraudulent behavior and market inefficiencies due to informational asymmetries between sellers and customers. We examine experimentally the effects of diagnostic uncertainty and insurance coverage on the information acquisition and provision decisions by sellers and the trading decisions by consumers. Our results reveal that diagnostic uncertainty is a major source of inefficiency that decreases efficient service provision. Insurance coverage has a positive net effect on market efficiency, despite making information acquisition and efficient service provision less likely.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107608.abstract_zh: 信任品市场因卖方与顾客之间的信息不对称，易发生欺诈行为并导致市场效率低下。我们通过实验考察了诊断不确定性和保险覆盖对卖方信息获取与提供决策以及消费者交易决策的影响。结果显示，诊断不确定性是导致效率下降的主要来源，它减少了高效服务的提供。尽管保险覆盖降低了信息获取和高效服务提供的可能性，但其对市场效率具有正向净效应。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107608.title: Diagnostic uncertainty and insurance coverage in credence goods markets: An experiment
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107608.title_zh: 信任品市场中的诊断不确定性与保险覆盖：一项实验研究

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107609.abstract: Location games capture important economic phenomena ranging from preemption to choice of bank leverage. We explore a parametric family of location games with many players, each facing a conflict between maximizing a fundamental payoff component and a relative (or quantile dependent) component. Using simulations and human subject experiments we show that, behaviorally, the stationary Nash equilibria in such games are terrible predictions of behavior and payoffs when players can freely adjust their locations. Instead, large cycles consistently emerge, in which behavior slowly grows bolder over time. This corresponds to progressively earlier timing in pre-emption games or to increasingly later timing in wars of attrition. When locations are maximally bold, namely at the end of the domain of Nash play, behavior quickly reverts to the peak fundamental and a new cycle begins.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107609.abstract_zh: 区位博弈捕捉了从抢占先机到银行杠杆选择等一系列重要经济现象。我们探讨了一个包含众多参与者的参数化区位博弈家族，其中每个参与者都面临在最大化基本面收益成分与相对（或分位数依赖）成分之间的冲突。通过模拟实验和人类受试者实验，我们表明，在行为层面，此类博弈中的静态纳什均衡在参与者能够自由调整其位置时，对行为和收益的预测能力极差。相反，大规模循环持续出现，其中行为随时间逐渐变得更加大胆。这对应于抢占博弈中时机逐渐提前，或消耗战中时机逐渐延后。当位置达到最大胆程度，即处于纳什博弈域的末端时，行为迅速回归至基本面峰值，新一轮循环随即开始。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107609.title: Cyclical behavior in large location games
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107609.title_zh: 大型区位博弈中的周期性行为

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107617.abstract: This paper analyzes the welfare implications of children’s enfranchisement within a political economy framework that emphasizes the trade-offs in public policy when the electorate includes different age groups. We derive the political equilibrium under Markov strategies and compare welfare under standard suffrage and suffrage that includes children, for both PAYG and fully funded social security systems. The franchise that maximizes welfare across demographic groups depends on the fertility rate in the economy. Policies chosen when all demographic groups have voting rights are Pareto-improving compared to those chosen under the standard voting rights system, which excludes children from the electorate, when the fertility rate is low, and Pareto-reducing when the fertility rate is high. This result is driven by the surplus or shortage of funds available to finance pensions, depending on the ratio of workers to retirees in the economy. The model produces a negative association between tax revenues and fertility rates, as well as between public pension spending and the share of parents, consistent with OECD data. The counterfactual analysis based on the model calibrated to match the distribution of the number of children per household in OECD countries indicates that children’s enfranchisement would improve the welfare of all generations in most OECD countries.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107617.abstract_zh: 本文在一个强调不同年龄群体选民构成对公共政策权衡影响的政治经济学框架内，分析了儿童选举权扩展的福利含义。我们在马尔可夫策略下推导出政治均衡，并比较了在现收现付制和完全基金制社会保障体系下，标准选举权与包含儿童选举权两种情形下的福利水平。最大化各人口群体福利的选举权范围取决于经济中的生育率。当所有人口群体均享有投票权时所选政策，相较于将儿童排除在选民之外的现行标准选举权制度下的政策，在生育率较低时具有帕累托改进性质，而在生育率较高时则呈帕累托恶化趋势。这一结果源于经济中劳动者与退休者比例所决定的养老金融资盈余或短缺。模型预测税收收入与生育率之间存在负相关关系，公共养老金支出与父母占比之间亦呈负相关，这与OECD数据一致。基于校准至OECD国家每户儿童数量分布的反事实分析表明，在大多数OECD国家，儿童选举权的扩展将改善所有世代的福利。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107617.title: Fertility and welfare under Demeny voting
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107617.title_zh: 德梅尼投票下的生育率与福利

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107618.abstract: When players make sequential decisions that are unobservable to one another, their behavior can nonetheless be influenced by knowing who moves first. This sequential structure, often referred to as “virtual observability,” suggests that timing alone can shape expectations and choices, even when no information is revealed. The original notion of virtual observability, however, is an equilibrium refinement based on the timing structure and has no bite in games with unique equilibria. To study whether timing may still matter in such environments, we introduce General Virtual Observability (GVO) as a conceptual framework that extends the intuition of virtual observability beyond equilibrium selection. Guided by this framework, we experimentally examine whether the timing of unobserved moves affects behavior in two games with unique Nash equilibria: the Traveler’s Dilemma and the Trust Game. We find that in the sequential Traveler’s Dilemma without observability, first movers behave closer to the Nash equilibrium prediction than in the simultaneous version, whereas timing without observability has no effect on behavior in the Trust Game.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107618.abstract_zh: 当参与者做出彼此不可观察的序贯决策时，其行为仍可能受到知晓谁先行动的影响。这种序贯结构，常被称为“虚拟可观察性”，表明即便没有信息被揭示，仅凭时序本身也能塑造预期与选择。然而，虚拟可观察性的原始概念是基于时序结构的均衡精炼，在具有唯一均衡的博弈中并无约束力。为探究时序在此类环境中是否仍具重要性，我们引入广义虚拟可观察性（GVO）作为概念框架，将虚拟可观察性的直觉拓展至均衡选择之外。在此框架指导下，我们通过实验检验了在两种具有唯一纳什均衡的博弈——旅行者困境与信任博弈中，不可观察行动的时序是否影响行为。我们发现，在无观察性的序贯旅行者困境中，先动者的行为比同时版本更接近纳什均衡预测，而在信任博弈中，无观察性的时序对行为无影响。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107618.title: Virtual observability in sequential play
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107618.title_zh: 序贯博弈中的虚拟可观测性

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107619.abstract: Incumbents’ reputations acquired during their time in office influence voters’ choices. Some studies suggest that, when designing their campaign messages, incumbents might benefit from playing to their strengths and emphasizing fewer issues than challengers. In this paper, I provide causal empirical evidence to support this hypothesis using information from mayoral elections in Brazil and a regression discontinuity design. The findings indicate that incumbency causes campaign manifestos to be more concentrated. Moreover, incumbents who belong to a cohesive and programmatic party tend to emphasize party-specific issues more. This suggests that reputation matters for issue selection. To measure issue emphasis and manifesto concentration, I leverage a unique database of more than 28 thousand documents containing political manifestos and use a Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) algorithm to estimate a vector of topics – or the issues emphasized by each candidate. With this information, I calculate Herfindahl Hirschman Indices (HHI) for each manifesto to assess their relative issue concentration.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107619.abstract_zh: 现任者在任期间积累的声誉会影响选民的选择。一些研究表明，在设计竞选信息时，现任者可能比挑战者更倾向于发挥自身优势，强调较少的议题。本文利用巴西市长选举的信息和断点回归设计，为这一假设提供了因果实证证据。研究结果表明，现任身份导致竞选纲领更加集中。此外，属于团结且纲领性政党的现任者更倾向于强调政党特定议题。这表明声誉对议题选择具有重要影响。为衡量议题强调程度和纲领集中度，我利用了一个包含超过28,000份政治纲领文件的独特数据库，并采用潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）算法来估计每个候选人强调的议题向量。基于这些信息，我为每份纲领计算了赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI），以评估其相对议题集中度。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107619.title: Play to your strengths: Incumbency effect and issue emphasis in Brazilian local elections
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107619.title_zh: 发挥优势：巴西地方选举中的在位效应与议题侧重

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107620.abstract: Subjective expectations about future macroeconomic developments are a core input to people’s consumption and investment decisions. No commonly accepted model of the expectation-formation mechanism for macroeconomic variables has yet emerged. This special issue collects research that advances our understanding of how macroeconomic expectations are formed, how they can be measured, and how they shape economic behavior.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107620.abstract_zh: 关于未来宏观经济走势的主观预期是人们消费与投资决策的核心要素。然而，目前尚未形成被广泛接受的宏观经济变量预期形成机制模型。本特刊汇集了相关研究，旨在深化我们对宏观经济预期如何形成、如何测量以及如何影响经济行为的理解。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107620.title: Macroeconomic expectations: Formation, measurement, and consequences
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107620.title_zh: 宏观经济预期：形成、测度与后果

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107624.abstract: This study investigates the temporal and contextual stability of social risk preferences across health and wealth, focusing on both gains and losses. Using a large representative Dutch panel, we replicated the experimental design of Attema et al. (2023) which elicited social risk preferences through allocation decisions involving two anonymous recipients under risk. The design allows us to distinguish three dimensions of preferences: risk preferences, inequality aversion, and social risk preferences arising from trade-offs between risk and inequality, corresponding to utilitarian, ex-ante, and ex-post perspectives on social welfare. At the aggregate level, the main patterns documented in the original study are largely replicated: inequality aversion is prevalent and risk aversion is weaker in the loss domain than in the gain domain. At the individual level, however, stability is more limited. Test–retest correlations are positive but modest, and the proportion of identical choices across waves varies across domains and framings. Parametric estimations further reveal substantial heterogeneity in social risk preferences. A latent-class analysis identifies utilitarian preferences as the largest group, followed by ex-post and ex-ante perspectives. Overall, the results highlight the coexistence of persistence, contextual effects, and heterogeneity in social risk preferences.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107624.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了社会风险偏好在健康与财富领域中的时间与情境稳定性，重点关注收益与损失两种情形。利用一个具有代表性的荷兰大型面板数据，我们复现了Attema等人（2023）的实验设计，该设计通过涉及两名匿名受助者在风险下的分配决策来引出社会风险偏好。该设计使我们能够区分偏好的三个维度：风险偏好、不平等厌恶，以及由风险与不平等之间权衡产生的社会风险偏好，分别对应社会福利的功利主义、事前和事后视角。在总体层面，原始研究记录的主要模式基本得到复现：不平等厌恶普遍存在，且损失领域的风险厌恶弱于收益领域。然而，在个体层面，稳定性较为有限。重测相关性为正但幅度适中，各波次间相同选择的比例因领域和框架而异。参数估计进一步揭示了社会风险偏好的显著异质性。潜在类别分析识别出功利主义偏好为最大群体，其次是事后和事前视角。总体而言，研究结果凸显了社会风险偏好中持续性、情境效应与异质性的共存。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107624.title: On the stability of social risk preferences for health and wealth
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107624.title_zh: 关于健康与财富社会风险偏好稳定性的研究

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107625.abstract: We examine whether executive pay structures encourage explicit collusion. This is particularly important as the manager determines the firm’s strategy. We link US cartel cases to executive remuneration and firm data for 1994–2017 to exploit variation in the long-term share of compensation using an instrumental variables estimation approach. Our results indicate that a larger share of long-term compensation increases both cartel participation and initiation. This is consistent with a mechanism in which long-term incentives tie managerial wealth to the continuation of profits above the competitive level and reduce gains from deviation. The effects are primarily driven by equity components. In particular, equity-based risk-taking incentives are positively associated with collusion. The results are more pronounced in less competitive industries and among more innovative firms. Our findings imply a governance trade-off: incentive schemes that better align managers with shareholders can raise the incentive to collude. For enforcement purposes, executive pay design is useful for screening and risk assessment.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107625.abstract_zh: 我们考察了高管薪酬结构是否鼓励显性合谋。鉴于管理者决定企业战略，这一点尤为重要。我们将美国卡特尔案件与1994-2017年间的高管薪酬及企业数据相结合，利用工具变量估计方法，探究长期薪酬占比的变化。研究结果表明，长期薪酬占比越高，参与和发起卡特尔的可能性越大。这与一种机制相符：长期激励将管理者财富与高于竞争水平的持续利润挂钩，从而减少了背离合谋的收益。这些效应主要由股权部分驱动。特别是，基于股权的风险承担激励与合谋呈正相关。在竞争程度较低的行业及更具创新性的企业中，这一结果更为显著。我们的发现意味着一种治理权衡：使管理者与股东利益更一致的激励方案，可能提高合谋的动机。就执法而言，高管薪酬设计有助于筛选和风险评估。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107625.title: Do managerial incentives facilitate anti-competitive behavior? Evidence from collusion
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107625.title_zh: 管理层激励是否助长了反竞争行为？来自合谋的证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107626.abstract: We exploit a real-world setting at a German brokerage where some investors are forced to choose between two pricing schemes for trading and holding mutual funds: a flat-rate versus commissions (pay-per-use, via front-end loads and annual fees). Advisors provide a tariff recommendation based on clients’ potential cost savings. Most clients follow this recommendation; still, 41% fail to choose the cost-beneficial scheme, and 83% of them exhibit a pay-per-use bias. Biased choices are partly related to the underestimation of trading costs and expectation-based loss aversion. Our results bear implications for designing pricing schemes in the financial industry.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107626.abstract_zh: 我们利用德国一家券商的实际场景，其中部分投资者被迫在两种共同基金交易与持有定价方案之间做出选择：固定费率与按次付费（通过前端费用和年费实现）。顾问基于客户潜在的成本节省提供费率建议。多数客户遵循此建议；然而，仍有41%的客户未能选择成本效益最优的方案，其中83%表现出按次付费偏好偏差。偏差选择部分与对交易成本的低估及基于预期的损失厌恶有关。我们的研究结果对金融行业定价方案的设计具有启示意义。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107626.title: Can we make trading less hazardous to investors’ wealth? Evidence from a choice between flat rates or commissions for financial services*
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107626.title_zh: 我们能否让交易对投资者财富的危害更小？来自金融服务固定费率与佣金选择的证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107627.abstract: A common practice is to offer optional extras or upgrades during the purchase process. This paper studies endogenous consumer insensitivity to such additional prices: we posit that consumers are more prone to buy these overpriced extras when they represent a smaller share of total expenditure. The presence of such context-sensitive consumers softens competition in the market for the base good, jeopardizing their own surplus but also that of consumers with standard preferences. Exploitation of context effects by firms reduces total welfare.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107627.abstract_zh: 一种常见做法是在购买过程中提供可选的附加服务或升级。本文研究消费者对此类附加价格的内生不敏感性：我们假设，当这些高价附加服务占总支出比例较小时，消费者更倾向于购买。这类对情境敏感的消费者的存在，削弱了基础商品市场的竞争，不仅损害了自身剩余，也损害了具有标准偏好的消费者的剩余。企业利用情境效应会降低总福利。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107627.title: Add-on selling with context effects
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107627.title_zh: 情境效应下的附加销售

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107628.abstract: We document how interactions between App producers affect App security, including both intentional security problems due to immorality and unintentional security problems due to ignorance. Exploiting a quasi-experiment that improves the security of some Apps, we find that a ten-percentage-point increase in the proportion of directly-treated Apps in the same county leads to a 1.6% improvement in App security of other Apps. Such spillover effects are stronger when information dissemination is more efficient, which supports information exchange as an important mechanism. Although spillover effects exist for both types of security problems, the effects are weaker for security problems that are intentional than unintentional ones, especially under high market competition pressure.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107628.abstract_zh: 我们记录了App生产者之间的互动如何影响App安全性，这既包括因道德缺失导致的有意安全问题，也包括因无知造成的无意安全问题。利用一项提升部分App安全性的准实验，我们发现同一县域内直接受处理App比例每增加十个百分点，其他App的安全性将提升1.6%。当信息传播效率更高时，这种溢出效应更为显著，这支持了信息交流作为重要机制的作用。尽管两类安全问题均存在溢出效应，但在市场竞争压力较大的情况下，有意安全问题的溢出效应弱于无意安全问题。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107629.abstract: In this paper, we study how communication influences suspicion. The experiment uses a sender–receiver setup with a low probability of misaligned incentives for senders and receivers. We focus on the impact of open communication on the receivers’ suspicion as measured by the size of the deviation from the senders’ recommendation before and after the communication. Overall, communication substantially reduces suspicion, but some receivers become more suspicious during the communication. We disentangle these effects using machine learning methods to analyze the chat logs.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107629.abstract_zh: 本文研究沟通如何影响猜疑。实验采用发送者-接收者设置，其中发送者与接收者的激励错位概率较低。我们聚焦于开放式沟通对接收者猜疑的影响，以沟通前后偏离发送者建议的程度来衡量。总体而言，沟通显著降低了猜疑，但部分接收者在沟通过程中变得更加猜疑。我们利用机器学习方法分析聊天记录，以厘清这些效应。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107629.title: Suspicion and communication

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107630.abstract: We study the relationship between maternal parenting style and a broad range of children’s skills and outcomes. Using survey and incentivized experimental data from 5644 children aged 6 to 16 and their parents, we find that children whose mothers are classified as practicing a positive parenting style score higher on IQ, are more altruistic, exhibit higher openness, conscientiousness, and agreeableness, and have a higher locus of control, self-control, and self-esteem. They also perform better in scholarly achievement tests, display more prosocial behavior in everyday life, and report higher life satisfaction. Additionally, positive parenting is negatively associated with children’s patience, neuroticism, engagement in risky behaviors, and their emotional and behavioral problems.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107630.abstract_zh: 我们研究了母亲教养方式与儿童广泛技能及成果之间的关系。利用来自5644名6至16岁儿童及其父母的调查和激励性实验数据，我们发现，被归类为采用积极教养方式的母亲所养育的儿童，在智商测试中得分更高，更加利他，展现出更高的开放性、责任心和宜人性，并且拥有更强的内部控制点、自我控制和自尊。他们在学业成就测试中表现更佳，在日常生活中展现出更多亲社会行为，并报告更高的生活满意度。此外，积极教养与儿童的耐心、神经质、参与风险行为及其情绪和行为问题呈负相关。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107630.title: Nurturing the future: How positive parenting is related to children’s skills and well-being
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107630.title_zh: 培育未来：积极养育如何影响儿童技能与福祉

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107631.abstract: We document that labor training requirements for high-skilled occupations increased in the U.S. from 2006 to 2019. These greater training requirements reduce the extent to which workers displaced from shrinking occupations can relocate to expanding (high-skilled) occupations, thus potentially affecting both the equilibrium occupational structure and the unemployment level. We build a quantitative model in which labor is displaced by task-replacing technological change embodied in robots (“tasks shock”) and the extent of occupational switching depends on the destination occupations’ training requirements. We find that: (i) task-displacing technological change increases steady-state unemployment, but it reduces unemployment along the transition; (ii) in contrast, a comparable shock to capital embodied technological change produces larger unemployment rates with respect to the tasks shock, both in the transition and the steady state; and (iii) greater training requirements in high-skilled occupations increase steady-state unemployment and affect the occupational structure along the transition, but the shape of their effect depends on the size of the technological shock
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107631.abstract_zh: 我们记录到，2006年至2019年间，美国高技能职业的劳动力培训要求有所提高。这些更高的培训要求降低了因萎缩职业而失业的工人向扩张（高技能）职业转移的程度，从而可能同时影响均衡职业结构和失业水平。我们构建了一个定量模型，其中劳动力因体现于机器人中的任务替代型技术变革（“任务冲击”）而失业，且职业转换的程度取决于目标职业的培训要求。我们发现：（i）任务替代型技术变革提高了稳态失业率，但在转型过程中降低了失业率；（ii）相比之下，与任务冲击相当规模的资本体现型技术变革冲击，在转型期和稳态下均产生更高的失业率；（iii）高技能职业中更高的培训要求提高了稳态失业率，并影响转型期间的职业结构，但其影响形态取决于技术冲击的规模。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107631.title: Training time, robots and technological unemployment
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107631.title_zh: 培训时间、机器人与技术性失业

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107632.abstract: Stochastic choice (SC)—the tendency to select different options across repeated presentations of the same choice set—is well documented, yet its cognitive mechanisms remain debated. We combine mouse-tracking with the experimental design of Agranov and Ortoleva (2017), comparing distant and sequential repetitions of lottery choices. We show that the Area Under the Curve (AUC) provides a more informative process-level measure of SC than response times (RT). RT decline after the first presentation in both repetition structures, but do not reliably predict trial-level switching. AUC remains stable across distant repetitions while drops sharply after the first sequential choice, suggesting that explicit repetitions allow participants to plan subsequent choices at first and execute them more directly thereafter. AUC also reveals heterogeneity hidden by aggregate choice data: among regular participants, SC does not increase AUC in distant repeats, but produces larger and more curved trajectories in sequential repeats, suggesting a signature of cautiousness under explicit randomization. Among dominance violators, SC is instead accompanied by larger and more erratic trajectories, suggesting error-driven variability. Overall, SC appears to combine a predominantly deliberate component with a smaller boundedly rational component.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107632.abstract_zh: 随机选择（SC）——即在面对相同选择集的重复呈现时倾向于选择不同选项——已被充分记录，但其认知机制仍存在争议。我们将鼠标追踪与Agranov和Ortoleva（2017）的实验设计相结合，比较了彩票选择的远距离重复与顺序重复。我们表明，曲线下面积（AUC）比反应时间（RT）提供了更具信息量的过程层面SC度量。在两种重复结构中，RT在首次呈现后均有所下降，但并不能可靠预测试验层面的切换行为。AUC在远距离重复中保持稳定，而在首次顺序选择后急剧下降，这表明明确的重复使参与者能够在首次时规划后续选择，并在之后更直接地执行。AUC还揭示了聚合选择数据所隐藏的异质性：在常规参与者中，SC在远距离重复中并未增加AUC，但在顺序重复中产生了更大且更弯曲的轨迹，这表明在明确随机化下存在谨慎性的特征。在优势违反者中，SC反而伴随着更大且更不稳定的轨迹，表明存在错误驱动的变异性。总体而言，SC似乎结合了以深思熟虑成分为主与较小程度的有界理性成分。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107632.title: Deliberate stochastic choice: A mouse-tracking experiment
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107632.title_zh: 审慎随机选择：一项鼠标追踪实验

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107633.abstract: This study investigates the causal effect of prenatal air pollution on height in adulthood. We employ a two-stage least squares model, using thermal inversions as an instrumental variable for identification. Leveraging data from a nationally representative sample in China, the results show that an increase of 1 μg/m3 in PM2.5 concentrations during gestation reduces height in adulthood by 0.4 cm and normalized height scores by 0.07 standard deviations. These adverse effects on height are primarily driven by exposure to air pollution during the first and second trimesters of pregnancy. Furthermore, the results show that exposure to air pollution after birth does not significantly impact adult height. The mechanism analysis indicates that income reductions that are associated with air pollution are unlikely to be the main pathway through which prenatal air pollution affects long-term height outcomes. Instead, disruptions to maternal health during pregnancy appear to be the dominant mechanism.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107633.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了产前空气污染对成年期身高的因果效应。我们采用两阶段最小二乘模型，以热逆温作为工具变量进行识别。利用中国全国代表性样本的数据，结果显示，孕期PM2.5浓度每增加1微克/立方米，成年期身高减少0.4厘米，标准化身高评分降低0.07个标准差。这些对身高的不利影响主要源于妊娠期第一和第二个三个月的空气污染暴露。此外，结果表明，出生后空气污染暴露对成年身高无显著影响。机制分析显示，与空气污染相关的收入减少不太可能是产前空气污染影响长期身高结果的主要途径；相反，孕期母体健康受损似乎是主导机制。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107634.abstract: We report findings from a natural field experiment conducted at a university in which staff members order stationery for work-related purposes online, and the university bears the entire cost. We randomize staff members into a treatment and a control group. Only the former observes the cost information in the online ordering interface. We find that displaying the organization’s cost did not change the ordering frequency, nor the quantity of requested items, conditional on the items being ordered (the intensive margin), but did reduce the variety of items ordered (the extensive margin). Overall, the intervention led to a significant reduction in stationery consumption, resulting in a 27% decrease in quantities and substantial cost savings for the university. Thus, individuals at least partially internalize the external effects of their actions when the organization’s cost is made salient.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107634.abstract_zh: 我们报告了一项在大学进行的自然现场实验结果，该实验中，员工出于工作目的在线订购文具，而大学承担全部费用。我们将员工随机分为处理组和对照组，仅前者能在在线订购界面看到成本信息。研究发现，展示组织成本并未改变订购频率，也未改变在订购物品条件下的请求数量（集约边际），但确实减少了订购物品的种类（广延边际）。总体而言，该干预措施显著降低了文具消耗，导致数量减少27%，并为大学节省了大量成本。因此，当组织的成本变得显著时，个体至少部分地内化了其行为的外部效应。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107634.title: Making organization’s cost salient: A natural field experiment
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107634.title_zh: 凸显组织成本：一项自然实地实验

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107635.abstract: The paper evaluates the impact of the reform of the judicial map on the functioning of Italian civil justice. Implemented between 2013 and 2014, the reform abolished all branch offices and merged several small first-instance courts, substantially increasing the size of judicial districts and the scale at which civil justice services are provided. According to our findings, the reform led to a reduction in the demand for justice, plausibly due to higher access costs associated with increased distances to the courts. This decline was particularly pronounced in case types characterized by greater claimant discretion and lower expected stakes. On the supply side, the reform increased the number of cases resolved and reduced their average duration. These improvements were more pronounced in initially less efficient courts and in more complex case types, which benefited the most from the increased scale and specialization.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107635.abstract_zh: 本文评估了司法地图改革对意大利民事司法运行的影响。该改革于2013年至2014年间实施，废除了所有分支机构，并合并了若干小型初审法院，显著扩大了司法辖区的规模及民事司法服务的提供尺度。研究发现，改革导致了对司法需求的减少，这很可能是因为法院距离增加所带来的更高获取成本。这一下降在原告自由裁量权较大且预期标的额较低的案件类型中尤为明显。在供给方面，改革增加了已解决案件的数量，并缩短了其平均审理时长。这些改善在初始效率较低的法院及更为复杂的案件类型中更为显著，后者从规模扩大和专业化中获益最多。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107635.title: The effects of the reform of the judicial map on the functioning of civil justice
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107635.title_zh: 司法地图改革对民事司法运行的影响

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107636.title: Origin country information and immigrant behavior: Evidence from the COVID-19 pandemic in the U.S.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107636.title_zh: 原籍国信息与移民行为：来自美国COVID-19疫情的证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107637.abstract: This paper examines the stability of self-control over time using nationally-representative longitudinal data from Australia. We track the same individuals between 2019 and 2023, a period encompassing one of the most disruptive global crisis in recent history: the COVID-19 pandemic. Despite these extraordinary circumstances, self-control remained remarkably stable: its mean and distribution were unchanged, and individuals largely preserved their relative positions. Within-person changes were small, and unrelated to variations in state-level exposure to both the spread of the virus and the policy responses that ensued. The evidence we report suggests that self-control is a deeply rooted, trait-like characteristic that persists even under extreme societal stress.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107637.abstract_zh: 本文利用澳大利亚具有全国代表性的纵向数据，考察了自我控制随时间推移的稳定性。我们追踪了2019年至2023年间同一批个体，这一时期涵盖了近代史上最具破坏性的全球危机之一：COVID-19疫情。尽管面临这些非同寻常的情况，自我控制仍保持显著稳定：其均值与分布均未发生变化，且个体在很大程度上维持了其相对位置。个体内部的变化幅度较小，且与州级层面病毒传播程度及随之而来的政策应对措施的差异无关。我们报告的证据表明，自我控制是一种根深蒂固、类似特质的特征，即使在极端社会压力下也能持续存在。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107637.title: The stability of self-control in unstable times
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107637.title_zh: 不稳定时期自我控制的稳定性

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107638.abstract: Inequality in bureaucratic employment, favoring individuals from bureaucratic family backgrounds, is widespread. Using China’s recent anti-corruption campaign as a quasi-experiment, we examine how intensified counter-corruption efforts reshape intergenerational occupational transmission within the public sector. Employing a difference-in-differences approach, we compare changes in the likelihood of bureaucratic employment for children of bureaucrats versus non-bureaucrats before and after the campaign implementation across provinces. Prior to the campaign, offspring of bureaucrats were over 13 percentage points more likely to work in the bureaucracy; following the campaign, this advantage diminished by more than 5 percentage points. Further analyses suggest that relatively better outside options for bureaucrats’ children serve as a mechanism, while alternative explanations, such as asymmetric insider information, shifts in risk preferences, or changes in perceptions of bureaucracy, are not supported by the data. Our findings highlight how anti-corruption initiatives can reduce entrenched dynastic privileges and promote greater equality of opportunity within public institutions.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107638.abstract_zh: 官僚就业中的不平等现象普遍存在，倾向于青睐具有官僚家庭背景的个体。利用中国近期反腐败运动作为准自然实验，我们考察了加强的反腐努力如何重塑公共部门内的代际职业传递。采用双重差分方法，我们比较了运动实施前后各省份官僚子女与非官僚子女进入官僚机构就业概率的变化。运动前，官僚子女进入官僚机构工作的可能性高出超过13个百分点；运动后，这一优势缩小了5个多百分点。进一步分析表明，官僚子女相对更优的外部选择机会是一个作用机制，而其他替代性解释，如信息不对称的内部人优势、风险偏好变化或对官僚机构认知的改变，均未得到数据支持。我们的研究结果凸显了反腐败举措如何能够削弱根深蒂固的世袭特权，并促进公共机构内机会平等的提升。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107638.title: The anti-corruption campaign and the intergenerational transmission of bureaucratic employment: Evidence from China
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107638.title_zh: 反腐败运动与官僚就业的代际传递：来自中国的证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107639.abstract: A significant increase in household debt occurred in the United States before the Great Recession. This study examines variations in debt-to-income ratios across local areas at the onset of the recession to understand how exposure to debt affected unincorporated self-employment and its average income during and after the downturn. It shows that the adverse effects of the recession on self-employment outcomes were more pronounced in areas that experienced larger household debt shocks. Furthermore, analysis of the following years indicates that the impact on self-employment persisted for a few more years after the recession ended.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107639.abstract_zh: 在大衰退之前，美国家庭债务显著增加。本研究考察了衰退初期各地区债务收入比的变化，以了解债务暴露如何影响衰退期间及之后的非公司制自雇就业及其平均收入。结果显示，在经历较大家庭债务冲击的地区，衰退对自雇就业结果的不利影响更为显著。此外，对随后几年的分析表明，这种对自雇就业的影响在衰退结束后仍持续了数年。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107639.title: Effects of debt exposure on self-employment: Evidence from US local markets in the Great Recession
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107639.title_zh: 债务暴露对自雇就业的影响：来自美国大衰退时期地方市场的证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107640.abstract: This study experimentally investigates the impact of the lack of arbitrage opportunities across different assets on the realization of the law of one price. Our experiment is based on the framework established by Charness and Neugebauer (2019) where participants, acting as traders, are involved in transactions with two different types of assets. We observe an increase in the magnitude of price discrepancies and fundamental mispricing when traders are unable to engage in arbitrage across assets.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107640.abstract_zh: 本研究通过实验方法探讨了不同资产间套利机会缺失对一价法则实现的影响。实验基于Charness和Neugebauer（2019）建立的框架，参与者作为交易者，涉及两种不同类型资产的交易。我们发现，当交易者无法跨资产进行套利时，价格差异的幅度和基本面错误定价均有所增加。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107640.title: An experimental analysis on cross-asset arbitrage opportunity and the law of one price
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107640.title_zh: 跨资产套利机会与一价定律的实验分析

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107641.abstract: This study investigates whether having daughters impacts political preferences and whether this effect varies across European countries. We estimate effect sizes for 39 countries in the European Social Survey ( n = 156,236) and aggregate estimates using random-effects meta-analysis, following a preregistered analysis plan. We find significant evidence that having daughters increases the preference for gender equality and homosexual rights. However, the meta-analytic effect size estimates are small, with 2.6% (95% CI [1.0%, 4.3%]) and 1.9% (95% CI [0.8%, 3.0%]) of a standard deviation, respectively. The meta-analytic effects of having daughters on left-right political preferences and preferences for reduced income inequality are statistically indistinguishable from zero. The heterogeneity in the effects of having daughters across countries is low, with zero to small heterogeneity for three outcome measures and small to moderate heterogeneity for left-right political preferences, consistent with high generalizability of results across the included countries.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107641.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了拥有女儿是否会影响政治偏好，以及这种影响在欧洲各国间是否存在差异。我们依据预先注册的分析计划，对欧洲社会调查中39个国家（样本量n=156,236）的效应量进行了估计，并采用随机效应元分析方法汇总估计结果。研究发现，拥有女儿显著增强了对性别平等和同性恋权利的支持偏好。然而，元分析效应量估计值较小，分别相当于标准差的2.6%（95%置信区间[1.0%, 4.3%]）和1.9%（95%置信区间[0.8%, 3.0%]）。拥有女儿对左右政治偏好及减少收入不平等偏好的元分析效应在统计上与零无显著差异。各国间拥有女儿效应的异质性较低，其中三项结果指标的异质性为零至小，而左右政治偏好的异质性为小至中等，这与结果在所纳入国家间具有高度普遍性相一致。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107641.title: Does having daughters affect political preferences? Using meta-analytic tools on many surveys
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107641.title_zh: 拥有女儿会影响政治偏好吗？基于多项调查的元分析工具研究

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107642.abstract: We study a committee that decides on multiple issues and determines, for each, both the direction and the extent of reform, assuming that reform intensity is proportional to net support and that agents are ex ante symmetric. Within this environment, we investigate how logrolling shapes policy outcomes. We establish three main results. First, an essentially unique competitive equilibrium always exists. Second, logrolling improves the welfare of every committee member, and actually implements the Nash bargaining solution. Third, when the number of issues is sufficiently large, a single-minded delegate fully determines policy within her domain of interest. That is, the current analysis: (i) identifies a setting in which vote-trading may lead to stable outcomes, (ii) uncovers a link between a familiar political practice and a prominent welfare benchmark, and (iii) pins down one mechanism through which single-issue minorities may acquire disproportionate influence in representative democracies.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107642.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个委员会，该委员会就多个议题进行决策，并为每个议题确定改革的方向与程度，假设改革强度与净支持度成正比，且各代理人事前对称。在此环境下，我们探讨互投赞成票如何塑造政策结果。我们得出三项主要结论。第一，本质上唯一的竞争性均衡始终存在。第二，互投赞成票提升了每位委员会成员的福利，并实际上实现了纳什谈判解。第三，当议题数量足够大时，单一议题代表在其关注领域内完全决定政策。即，当前分析：（i）识别了一种投票交易可能导致稳定结果的场景，（ii）揭示了常见政治实践与显著福利基准之间的联系，以及（iii）确定了单一议题少数派在代议制民主中可能获得不成比例影响力的一种机制。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107642.title: Logrolling and the power of single-mindedness
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107642.title_zh: 单议题偏好与互投赞成票的力量

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107643.abstract: We analyze a sample of nearly 40,000 gender-targeted online job vacancies in Vietnam from February 2019 to July 2020 to estimate wage offer premia for physical attractiveness and how they vary between genders. Specifically, we compare the monthly wages offered in matched vacancies with and without attractiveness requirements for job advertisements targeting men and women separately. Our estimates point to a gender asymmetry in how stated physical attractiveness preferences relate to posted wages: physically attractive women are offered higher salaries, whereas physically attractive men are not. Cross-sectional matching estimates place the premium for women at about five percentage points; specifications with firm fixed effects attenuate this magnitude but preserve the asymmetry. Further analysis reveals that gender differences in the wage offer premia to physical attractiveness are mainly driven by attitudes toward gender roles, employer characteristics, and perceived lack of fit, rather than by the potential productivity-enhancing effects of physical attractiveness in certain occupations.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107643.abstract_zh: 我们分析了2019年2月至2020年7月间越南近4万份针对特定性别的在线招聘广告样本，以估算外貌吸引力带来的工资溢价及其性别差异。具体而言，我们比较了针对男性和女性分别发布的招聘广告中，有外貌要求与无外貌要求的匹配职位之间的月薪差异。估计结果显示，外貌吸引力偏好与公布工资之间的关系存在性别不对称性：外貌有吸引力的女性获得更高薪资，而外貌有吸引力的男性则不然。横截面匹配估计表明，女性的这一溢价约为五个百分点；加入企业固定效应的模型虽削弱了这一幅度，但保留了不对称性。进一步分析揭示，外貌吸引力工资溢价中的性别差异主要受性别角色态度、雇主特征及感知的不匹配影响，而非外貌吸引力在特定职业中可能带来的生产力提升效应。
