10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107643.title: Beauty premia in wage offers: Evidence from Vietnamese online job postings
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107643.title_zh: 工资报价中的美貌溢价：来自越南在线招聘广告的证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107644.abstract: Contemporary business practices are increasingly shifting from top-down job design towards bottom-up job crafting, empowering employees to take an active role in designing their jobs. This new type of delegation has been particularly accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic, however, has not yet been studied from an organizational economics perspective which would allow to shed light on optimal delegation strategies for firms. We develop a multitask agency model featuring private information, moral hazard, and imperfect performance measurement to explore under which conditions the delegation of job design to an informed agent can be beneficial for the firm. Our findings suggest that delegation is preferable to a centralized job design when the performance measure used for contracting purposes is incongruent. Notably, under certain conditions, the principal can attain the same outcome through delegation as if the agent’s private information was observable ex ante.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107644.abstract_zh: 当代商业实践正日益从自上而下的工作设计转向自下而上的工作重塑，赋予员工在自身工作设计中的主动角色。这种新型授权在COVID-19疫情中尤为加速，然而，尚未从组织经济学视角加以研究，而该视角本可揭示企业最优授权策略。我们构建了一个多任务委托代理模型，涵盖私人信息、道德风险和绩效衡量不完善性，以探讨在何种条件下，将工作设计授权给知情代理人可能对企业有利。研究结果表明，当用于契约的绩效衡量指标不一致时，授权优于集中式工作设计。值得注意的是，在特定条件下，委托人通过授权可实现与代理人私人信息事前可观察时相同的结果。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107644.title: Delegation of job design and imperfect performance measures
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107644.title_zh: 工作设计的委托与不完善的绩效衡量

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107652.abstract: This article examines the impact of firms’ quality policies on export performance. Using French administrative data at the employee and firm levels, we assess the level of firms’ commitment to issues related to product reliability and safety through the presence of quality management personnel. We merge these data with French customs data, which provide the value and quantity of exports for each firm by product and destination. We show that firms with quality management employees export higher volumes and have longer trade relationships, especially in non-European markets with stringent standards (higher number of sanitary and phytosanitary or technical measures). Overall, our paper highlights the role of agri-food firms’ ”quality investment” in export performance.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107652.abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业质量政策对出口绩效的影响。利用法国员工与企业层面的行政数据，我们通过质量管理人员的配置情况来评估企业对产品可靠性与安全问题的投入程度。我们将这些数据与法国海关数据相结合，后者提供了各企业按产品和目的地划分的出口价值与数量。研究表明，设有质量管理岗位的企业出口量更大，贸易关系更为持久，尤其是在标准严格（卫生与植物卫生措施或技术性措施数量较多）的非欧洲市场。总体而言，本文强调了农业食品企业“质量投资”在出口绩效中的重要作用。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107652.title: When quality management helps agri-food firms to export
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107652.title_zh: 质量管理如何帮助农产品企业出口

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107653.abstract: Restricting individuals’ access to some opportunities may steer their desire toward their substitutes, a phenomenon known as the forbidden fruit effect. We axiomatize a choice model named restriction-sensitive choice (RSC), which rationalizes the forbidden fruit effect and is compatible with the prominent psychological explanations: reactance theory and commodity theory. The model is identifiable from choice data, specifically from the observation of choice reversals caused by the removal of options. We conduct a normative analysis both in terms of the agent’s freedom and welfare. We apply our model to shed light on two phenomena: the backfire effect of beliefs and the backlash of integration policies targeted toward minorities.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107653.abstract_zh: 限制个体获取某些机会可能会将其欲望引向替代品，这一现象被称为“禁果效应”。我们构建了一个名为“限制敏感选择”（RSC）的选择模型，该模型能够合理化禁果效应，并与主要的心理学解释——抗拒理论与商品理论——相兼容。该模型可从选择数据中识别，特别是通过观察因选项移除而导致的选择反转。我们从个体自由与福利两方面进行了规范性分析。我们将该模型应用于阐明两种现象：信念的反作用效应及针对少数群体的融合政策所引发的反弹效应。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107654.abstract: This paper examines equilibrium strategies in adversarial bargaining, which are negotiations where one party demands concessions under threat of initiating a destructive conflict. We develop a multi-period model incorporating both endogenous conflict decisions and the risk of exogenous conflict, analyzing how outcomes depend on threat credibility and patience levels. Three types of equilibrium emerge: impatient aggressors extract the maximum concession through credible deterministic threats; highly patient scenarios feature probabilistic threats where exogenous risk creates bargaining power; and intermediate patience levels produce mixed-strategy threats. We distinguish between scenarios where conflict benefits the aggressor versus where conflict harms both parties, leading to brinkmanship. Our results reveal a striking non-monotonic relationship between patience and equilibrium demands when conflict benefits the aggressor.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107654.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了对抗性谈判中的均衡策略，此类谈判是指一方在威胁发动破坏性冲突的条件下要求对方让步的协商过程。我们构建了一个多期模型，同时纳入内生冲突决策与外生冲突风险，分析结果如何取决于威胁的可信度及耐心程度。均衡呈现三种类型：缺乏耐心的侵略者通过可信的确定性威胁获取最大让步；高度耐心的情境则涉及概率性威胁，其中外生风险赋予谈判筹码；而中等耐心水平则产生混合策略威胁。我们区分了冲突对侵略者有利与冲突对双方均有害的两种情形，后者导致边缘政策。研究结果显示，当冲突对侵略者有利时，耐心程度与均衡要求之间存在显著的非单调关系。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107654.title: Adversarial bargaining with exogenous shocks
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107654.title_zh: 外生冲击下的对抗性谈判

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107658.abstract: Financial–macroeconomic agent-based models offer a promising avenue for understanding complex economic interactions, but their empirical estimation is challenging, particularly when the relevant data are observed at different frequencies. We address this gap by developing a mixed-frequency adaptation of the simulated method of moments that evaluates macroeconomic and financial moment conditions at their native quarterly and daily frequencies within a single objective function. Applying it to a stylized integrated agent-based model on U.S. data from 1954 to 2025, we quantify three key interaction channels between the financial and real sectors. The stock market influences the real economy through the wealth effect on consumption and the cost effect on firms’ financing. Conversely, the real economy influences the stock market through a price-misperception effect that shapes fundamental valuations. Our results provide the first model-based empirical evidence that all three channels are statistically significant, offering novel insights into macro-financial dynamics.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107658.abstract_zh: 金融-宏观经济主体基模型为理解复杂的经济互动提供了有前景的途径，但其经验估计颇具挑战性，尤其是在相关数据以不同频率观测时。我们通过开发一种混合频率的模拟矩方法适配来填补这一空白，该方法在单一目标函数内，以各自的季度和日度频率评估宏观经济与金融矩条件。将其应用于一个风格化的整合主体基模型，基于1954年至2025年的美国数据，我们量化了金融部门与实体经济之间的三个关键互动渠道。股票市场通过财富效应影响消费及成本效应影响企业融资，进而影响实体经济。反之，实体经济通过价格误判效应塑造基本面估值，从而影响股票市场。我们的结果首次提供了基于模型的经验证据，表明这三个渠道均具有统计显著性，为宏观金融动态提供了新颖见解。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107658.title: Wealth, cost, and misperception: Empirical estimation of three interaction channels in a financial–macroeconomic agent-based model
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107658.title_zh: 财富、成本与认知偏差：金融-宏观经济主体模型中三种交互渠道的实证估计

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107659.abstract: Many incentive plans are inherently ambiguous, lacking an explicit mapping between performance and compensation. We study the effect of ambiguous incentive plans on willingness to accept contracts to do a real-effort task, what types of individuals (low vs. high ability) accept the contract, the probability of completing the task, and performance on the task. The effect of ambiguous incentives is negative on multiple dimensions. Piece rate contracts significantly improve performance relative to fixed wages, primarily due to selection. This positive effect is not present with ambiguous incentives because high ability individuals are no more likely than low ability individuals to accept a contract with ambiguity. Modest levels of ambiguity about the relationship between performance and compensation are sufficient to reduce the probability that subjects choose and complete the task. Information about individual ability at the task reduces the probability that subjects choose and complete the task, but this is primarily due to decreased overconfidence rather than a reduction of uncertainty.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107659.abstract_zh: 许多激励计划本质上具有模糊性，缺乏绩效与报酬之间的明确对应关系。我们研究了模糊激励计划对接受真实努力任务合同的意愿、何种类型个体（低能力与高能力）接受合同、完成任务的可能性以及任务表现的影响。模糊激励在多个维度上产生负面影响。计件工资合同相对于固定工资显著提升了绩效，这主要归因于选择效应。然而，在模糊激励下，这一正面效应并不存在，因为高能力个体并不比低能力个体更倾向于接受带有模糊性的合同。绩效与报酬之间关系的适度模糊足以降低受试者选择并完成任务的概率。关于个体在任务中能力的信息降低了受试者选择并完成任务的概率，但这主要归因于过度自信的减少，而非不确定性的降低。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107659.title: Ambiguity in performance pay: A real effort experiment
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107659.title_zh: 绩效薪酬中的模糊性：一项真实努力实验

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107660.abstract: We study spatial variation in the responses of single mothers to a welfare reform in Australia which reduced the generosity of parenting support payments and increased the taper rates. We estimate the reform’s effect on earned income, using a large administrative dataset and applying regression discontinuity models separately to 87 distinct local labour markets. We can link the local reform effects to local unemployment rates and local wages. In sharp contrast to its objectives, the reform reduced labour earnings for single mothers; the effects were most pronounced in disadvantaged areas with weak labour market conditions. We also find that the reform did not induce migration, despite these costs of staying in place. Welfare reform imposed an extra cost on those living in more disadvantaged areas, and single mothers who cannot relocate bear a disproportionate burden.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107660.abstract_zh: 我们研究了澳大利亚一项福利改革对单亲母亲反应的地区差异，该改革降低了育儿支持金的慷慨程度并提高了边际扣减率。我们利用大型行政数据集，分别对87个不同的地方劳动力市场应用断点回归模型，估计了该改革对劳动收入的影响。我们能够将地方改革效应与地方失业率及地方工资水平联系起来。与改革目标截然相反，该改革减少了单亲母亲的劳动收入；其影响在劳动力市场条件疲弱的弱势地区最为显著。我们还发现，尽管留在原地存在这些代价，改革并未促使人口迁移。福利改革对居住在更弱势地区的人群施加了额外成本，而无法迁移的单亲母亲承担了不成比例的负担。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107660.title: Spatial heterogeneity in welfare reform success – local labour markets and single mothers’ earnings
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107660.title_zh: 福利改革成效的空间异质性——地方劳动力市场与单身母亲收入

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107661.abstract: In the spring of 2020, as the COVID-19 pandemic swept across the globe, governments implemented drastic containment measures, including widespread school closures that deprived millions of children of their primary social environment—the classroom. To understand how classroom peer relationships differed between the pre-pandemic and pandemic cohorts, we leverage social network data from 3rd and 4th-grade students in Turkish primary schools, comparing pre-pandemic and pandemic cohorts across three relationship types: friendship, academic support, and emotional support. We document opposing changes across network types: friendship isolation increased by 22%, while academic support nominations rose by 20%. These improvements in academic support were driven entirely by native students; refugee students faced deterioration in both friendship and academic support networks. Our findings show that large-scale disruptions can reshape peer relationships in complex ways, underscoring the vital role of the classroom in building social capital.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107661.abstract_zh: 2020年春季，随着COVID-19疫情席卷全球，各国政府实施了严格的防控措施，包括大规模关闭学校，使数百万儿童失去了他们主要的社会环境——教室。为了了解疫情前后学生群体中课堂同伴关系的差异，我们利用土耳其小学三年级和四年级学生的社交网络数据，比较了疫情前后群体在三种关系类型中的差异：友谊、学业支持和情感支持。我们发现不同网络类型呈现出相反的变化：友谊孤立现象增加了22%，而学业支持提名则上升了20%。学业支持的改善完全由本地学生驱动；难民学生在友谊和学业支持网络方面均面临恶化。我们的研究结果表明，大规模干扰可以以复杂的方式重塑同伴关系，凸显了课堂在构建社会资本中的关键作用。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107661.title: COVID-19 and peer relationships: Insights from classroom social networks
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107661.title_zh: COVID-19与同伴关系：来自课堂社交网络的启示

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107662.abstract: Standard human-capital theory predicts that firms invest in training early in a worker’s tenure to maximize the duration of returns. Yet in practice, training is often deferred to later stages of employment. This paper develops a unifying framework for understanding deferred training. We begin by establishing a benchmark result: in standard dynamic environments, firm-sponsored training is front-loaded. We then extend the framework to identify three conceptually distinct forces that can generate deferral: (1) productive efficiency, where training is delayed because later investment yields higher returns; (2) turnover management, where firms postpone training to mitigate mobility risk; and (3) poaching deterrence, where firms suppress early training to conceal information about worker ability. While the first mechanism is efficiency enhancing, the latter two reflect timing distortions. For each mechanism, we characterize the underlying logic, derive testable predictions, and draw implications for firm practice and public policy that promote timely skill development.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107662.abstract_zh: 标准人力资本理论预测，企业会在员工任职初期进行培训投资，以最大化回报期限。然而，实践中培训往往被推迟到雇佣关系的后期阶段。本文构建了一个统一框架来理解延迟培训现象。我们首先确立一个基准结果：在标准动态环境中，企业资助的培训倾向于前置。随后，我们扩展该框架，识别出三种概念上不同的力量可能产生延迟：（1）生产效率，即培训因后期投资带来更高回报而被推迟；（2）流动管理，即企业通过推迟培训来降低流动性风险；（3）挖角威慑，即企业抑制早期培训以隐藏关于员工能力的信息。第一种机制提升效率，而后两种则反映了时间上的扭曲。针对每种机制，我们刻画其内在逻辑，推导可检验的预测，并为促进及时技能发展的企业实践与公共政策提出启示。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107662.title: Deferred training

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107663.abstract: How do consumers decide between quality and quantity, and what drives heterogeneity in quality choice? This paper introduces a tractable model of consumer choice in which quality sorting emerges endogenously from wage heterogeneity in the presence of time opportunity costs of consumption. Consumers must allocate more time to consume larger quantities, while quality allows consumers to increase utility without affecting their time budget constraints. The model predicts that higher-wage consumers choose higher quality while higher-wealth consumers choose higher quantity. This leads consumers to view quality and quantity as distinct concepts and offers a tractable alternative to discrete choice models, explicitly incorporating both dimensions.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107663.abstract_zh: 消费者如何在质量与数量之间做出选择，以及什么因素驱动质量选择的异质性？本文引入了一个易于处理的消费者选择模型，其中质量排序在存在消费时间机会成本的情况下，由工资异质性内生地产生。消费者必须分配更多时间来消费更大数量，而质量则允许消费者在不影响其时间预算约束的情况下增加效用。模型预测，高工资消费者选择更高质量，而高财富消费者选择更大数量。这导致消费者将质量与数量视为不同概念，并为离散选择模型提供了一种易于处理的替代方案，明确纳入这两个维度。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107663.title: Quality vs. quantity when time is scarce
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107663.title_zh: 时间稀缺下的质量与数量权衡

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107664.abstract: We study the early-life determinants of children’s perseverance and its predictive power for educational attainment and labour market outcomes across the life course. Using teacher-assessed perseverance from the 1970 British Cohort Study we document that cognitive skills, gender, early health, and parental influences (particularly maternal biological factors and paternal education) are the strongest predictors of perseverance at age 10. Perseverance and cognitive skills exhibit distinct yet complementary effects on later outcomes. Perseverance shows strong associations with academic self-perception, internal locus of control, and interpersonal workplace skills such as teamwork, while cognitive skills dominate in technical and numerical domains. We assess the credibility of these associations, by combining Augmented Inverse Propensity Weighting with the framework of Cinelli and Hazlett (2020), quantifying how strong unobserved confounding would need to be to overturn our findings. This analysis reveals that perseverance’s associations with contemporaneous academic performance and locus of control beliefs show strong to moderate robustness. In contrast, associations with educational attainment and labour market outcomes are more fragile. Subgroup analysis reveals that perseverance functions as a compensatory mechanism in the face of childhood adversity, and it reinforces effort beliefs and labour market outcomes for males. Our findings would imply that policies promoting perseverance yield credible benefits for academic engagement and psychological well-being, but long-term economic gains requires interventions addressing educational access, financial barriers and labour market inequality.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107664.abstract_zh: 我们研究了儿童早期坚持性的决定因素及其在生命历程中对教育成就和劳动力市场结果的预测力。利用1970年英国队列研究中教师评估的坚持性，我们记录了认知技能、性别、早期健康以及父母影响（尤其是母亲生物学因素和父亲教育程度）是10岁时坚持性的最强预测因子。坚持性与认知技能在后续结果上表现出独特且互补的效应。坚持性与学术自我认知、内在控制点以及人际工作场所技能（如团队合作）密切相关，而认知技能在技术和数值领域占主导地位。我们通过将增强逆概率加权与Cinelli和Hazlett（2020）的框架相结合，评估了这些关联的可信度，量化了未观测混杂因素需要多强才能推翻我们的发现。分析显示，坚持性与同期学业表现和控制点信念的关联表现出强至中等的稳健性。相比之下，与教育成就和劳动力市场结果的关联则较为脆弱。亚组分析揭示，坚持性在面对童年逆境时起到补偿机制的作用，并强化了男性的努力信念和劳动力市场结果。我们的发现意味着，促进坚持性的政策对学术参与和心理健康产生可信的益处，但长期经济收益需要干预措施来解决教育机会、财务障碍和劳动力市场不平等问题。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107664.title: Perseverance, cognitive skills and life outcomes
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107664.title_zh: 毅力、认知技能与人生结果

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107665.abstract: How can development programs reach geographically, politically, culturally, and economically isolated communities? We present experimental evidence on the impact of a role model intervention to inspire enterprise activity among ethnic minorities in Vietnam. We distinguish between relatable ethnic minority role models and ethnic majority role models to examine how increasing the social distance of a role model from the target population affects outcomes, while holding the information content constant. The intervention temporarily increased the locus of control of participants in the ethnic minority treatment, however, these effects were transient and faded over time. While behavioral responses were limited, we find some evidence that the social relatability of the role models was a slightly more important trigger for behavioral change than the information content. Ultimately, however, the limited effects of the treatments on enterprise activities did not translate into higher incomes for households at end-line. Overall, our findings provide a cautionary tale for the use of role models as a standalone intervention to generate sustained behavioral change.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107665.abstract_zh: 发展项目如何触达地理、政治、文化及经济上孤立的社区？我们提供了关于榜样干预措施对越南少数民族创业活动影响的实验证据。我们区分了可亲近的少数民族榜样与多数民族榜样，以考察在保持信息内容不变的情况下，增加榜样与目标人群之间的社会距离如何影响结果。该干预措施暂时提升了少数民族受试者的控制点，但这些效应是短暂的，随时间逐渐消退。尽管行为反应有限，我们发现一些证据表明，榜样的社会亲近性在触发行为改变方面比信息内容略为重要。然而，最终，处理组对创业活动的有限影响并未在终期调查中转化为家庭收入的提高。总体而言，我们的发现为将榜样作为独立干预手段以产生持续行为改变提供了一个警示性案例。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107665.title: Using role models to inspire marginalized groups: A cautionary tale
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107665.title_zh: 利用榜样激励边缘群体：一则警示故事

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107666.abstract: Registered potential donors in stem cell transplantation may refuse to donate when matched with patients, causing supply shortages. To reduce such donor dropout, we developed behavioral interventions comprising messages added into the letters sent when donors are matched with patients in Japan, and conducted a field experiment to evaluate the effect of our intervention. The results demonstrate that the inclusion of our messages can reduce donor dropout and increase donor availability for transplantation. Specifically, the message emphasizing the limited number of compatible donors per patient increased the probability of donors completing the confirmatory typing stage by 7.3%. Since physicians can choose the best donor for proceeding to donation from those who complete confirmatory typing, this message increases donor availability for transplantation.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107666.abstract_zh: 在干细胞移植中，已登记的潜在捐赠者在与患者匹配后可能拒绝捐赠，导致供应短缺。为减少此类捐赠者流失，我们开发了行为干预措施，即在日本捐赠者与患者匹配时发送的信件中加入信息，并开展了一项实地实验以评估干预效果。结果表明，加入我们的信息能减少捐赠者流失，提高移植可用的捐赠者数量。具体而言，强调每位患者匹配捐赠者数量有限的信息，使捐赠者完成确认分型阶段的可能性提高了7.3%。由于医生可以从完成确认分型的捐赠者中选择最佳捐赠者进行移植，这一信息增加了移植可用的捐赠者数量。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107666.title: Exploring information provision to promote stem cell donation: Evidence from a field experiment of the Japan Marrow Donor Program
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107666.title_zh: 促进干细胞捐赠的信息提供探索：来自日本骨髓捐赠计划实地实验的证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107667.abstract: This paper examines whether granting property inheritance rights to women improves their participation in politics as election candidates in India. Leveraging state-level changes in inheritance laws and large-scale election data, we find that improved property rights increase female candidacy and their chances of winning elections. The reforms particularly encourage regional parties to nominate more women, with a notable rise in new female candidates. We show that these results are not confounded by pre-existing trends and are robust to treatment effect heterogeneity. We provide suggestive evidence that the rise in political participation stems from gains in women’s financial autonomy and shifts in restrictive gender norms due to the reforms. Our findings underscore the potential for legal and institutional reforms that expand women’s economic agency to generate meaningful political empowerment and reduce gender gaps in political representation.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107667.abstract_zh: 本文考察了赋予女性财产继承权是否能够提升她们作为选举候选人的政治参与度。利用各邦继承法的变动及大规模选举数据，我们发现财产权的改善增加了女性候选人的数量及其当选的概率。改革尤其鼓励地区政党提名更多女性，新女性候选人显著增多。我们证明这些结果不受既有趋势的干扰，并对处理效应异质性具有稳健性。我们提供的初步证据表明，政治参与度的提升源于改革带来的女性财务自主权增强及限制性性别规范的转变。我们的研究结果强调了扩大女性经济自主权的法律与制度改革的潜力，能够产生实质性的政治赋权效果，并缩小政治代表中的性别差距。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107667.title: The political returns to women’s inheritance rights in India
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107667.title_zh: 印度女性继承权的政治回报

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107668.title: Corrigendum to “The Effects of Digitalization on the Functioning of the Public Sector: Evidence from E-Procurement” [Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 246, June 2026, 107587]
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107668.title_zh: 更正：“数字化对公共部门运作的影响：来自电子采购的证据” [《经济行为与组织杂志》，第246卷，2026年6月，107587]

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107669.abstract: To what extent are market participants’ predictions driven by intuition and subjective judgment? A lot more than we thought, according to the data. We propose a simple heuristic to explain how forecasters form predictions and find strong support in the Survey of Professional Forecasters (SPF). At the heart of the heuristic is base-rate neglect—a well-documented psychological tendency to underweight prior beliefs in favor of salient new information. Our result suggests that this overreaction to new information affects not only point forecasts but also how forecasters perceive uncertainty. As evidence, the estimated subjective uncertainty aligns closely with the cross-sectional disagreement among forecasters, a measure of macroeconomic uncertainty.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107669.abstract_zh: 市场参与者的预测在多大程度上受到直觉和主观判断的驱动？根据数据，其影响远超我们的想象。我们提出一个简单的启发式规则来解释预测者如何形成预测，并在专业预测者调查（SPF）中找到了强有力的支持。该启发式规则的核心是基础率忽视——一种有充分文献记载的心理倾向，即低估先验信念而偏向显著的新信息。我们的结果表明，这种对新信息的过度反应不仅影响点预测，还影响预测者对不确定性的感知。作为证据，估计的主观不确定性与预测者之间的横截面分歧紧密吻合，后者是衡量宏观经济不确定性的一个指标。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107669.title: Heuristic macroeconomic expectations

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107670.abstract: Recent empirical evidence suggesting the malleability of identity raises the critical question of whether an updated identity, adapted to new environments, endures and under what conditions. To address this question, I analyze the 2009 parliamentary election in Malawi, during which the results deviated from historical voting patterns along ethno-regional lines. Specifically, the southern-based Democratic Progressive Party unexpectedly gained overwhelming support across the country, reducing the salience of local ethnic groups and signaling a drive for unity among historically divided societies. By comparing constituencies where this party barely won or lost, I find that the victory significantly reduced citizens’ sense of ethnic instead of national identity—particularly in rural areas historically aligned with opposition parties. This effect persisted for several years, coinciding with improvements in certain public goods and services, but dissipated within seven years. Furthermore, there is no evidence that selective migration across ethnic homelands, strategic downplaying of ethnic attachments, or post-election disillusionment with the party explains the identity shift, though these alternatives cannot be conclusively dismissed. These findings suggest that while identity can swiftly respond to socioeconomic shocks that alter group salience, it may revert to its original state unless further shocks or policies reinforce the altered identity.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107670.abstract_zh: 近期实证证据表明身份认同具有可塑性，这引发了一个关键问题：适应新环境而更新的身份认同是否能够持久，以及在何种条件下得以持久。为解答此问题，我分析了2009年马拉维议会选举，此次选举结果偏离了历史上沿族群-地域界限的投票模式。具体而言，以南地区为根据地的民主进步党意外在全国范围内获得压倒性支持，削弱了地方族群的重要性，并标志着历史上分裂社会走向团结的驱动力。通过比较该党以微弱优势获胜或落败的选区，我发现该党的胜利显著降低了公民的族群认同感，而非国家认同感——尤其是在历史上与反对党结盟的农村地区。这一效应持续了数年，与某些公共产品和服务改善的时间相吻合，但在七年内逐渐消退。此外，没有证据表明选择性迁往族群故土、策略性淡化族群依附或选后对该党的失望情绪能解释这一身份转变，尽管这些替代解释无法被完全排除。这些发现表明，尽管身份认同能够迅速响应改变群体显著性的社会经济冲击，但除非有进一步的冲击或政策强化已改变的身份认同，否则它可能回归原初状态。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107670.title: On the persistence of fluid identity: Insights from the decline of ethnic voting in Malawi
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107670.title_zh: 论流动身份的持续性：来自马拉维族群投票衰落的启示

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107671.abstract: The metaphor of "pain of paying" has shaped behavioral economics for decades, yet direct evidence that spending money elicits literal pain remains elusive. Building on Camerer et al.'s (2005) neuroeconomic framework, we present converging evidence from two studies demonstrating that payment decisions activate affective pain-processing circuits. In a correlational pilot study, we use fMRI during incentive-compatible purchase decisions to show that activity in the anterior insula—a key region in affective pain processing—correlates parametrically with price magnitude. Critically, we find that paying with money activates affective but not somatosensory pain networks in the brain, whereas paying with electric shocks activates both. In the main study, we establish causality through a novel reverse-placebo paradigm in which participants believed they had taken pain-modulating drugs. Only affective pain enhancing placebos influenced valuation: participants given affective pain “enhancers” exhibited higher willingness to pay than those given affective “relievers,” though neither condition differed significantly from the untreated control. These findings provide the first causal evidence that the pain of paying constitutes a genuine affective experience that shapes economic valuation. We discuss implications for models of consumer choice, mental accounting, and behavioral policy interventions aimed at improving financial decision-making.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107671.abstract_zh: 支付的痛苦”这一隐喻塑造了行为经济学数十年，然而，关于花钱会引发真实疼痛的直接证据仍然难以捉摸。基于Camerer等人（2005年）的神经经济学框架，我们通过两项研究提供了汇聚的证据，表明支付决策会激活情感性疼痛处理回路。在一项相关性预实验中，我们使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）在激励相容的购买决策中显示，前脑岛——情感性疼痛处理的关键区域——的活动与价格幅度呈参数性相关。关键的是，我们发现用金钱支付激活的是大脑中的情感性而非躯体感觉性疼痛网络，而用电击支付则同时激活两者。在主要研究中，我们通过一种新颖的反向安慰剂范式确立了因果关系，在该范式中，参与者相信他们服用了调节疼痛的药物。只有情感性疼痛增强安慰剂影响了估值：接受情感性疼痛“增强剂”的参与者比接受情感性“缓解剂”的参与者表现出更高的支付意愿，尽管这两种情况与未治疗对照组相比均无显著差异。这些发现首次提供了因果证据，表明支付的痛苦构成了一种真实的情感体验，能够塑造经济估值。我们讨论了这些发现对消费者选择模型、心理账户以及旨在改善财务决策的行为政策干预的启示。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107671.title: The affective cost of spending: neuroeconomic and experimental evidence on the pain of paying
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107671.title_zh: 消费的情感成本：关于支付痛苦的神经经济学与实验证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107672.abstract: Despite increasingly stringent regulations, there has been a concerning stagnation in reducing workplace fatalities. Can place-based policy targeting help? By coupling machine learning techniques with comprehensive data from Italy, we develop a place-based approach to workplace fatalities. Harnessing accurate machine forecasts, we construct a granular risk map and compare it to the allocation of on-site work inspections and public subsidies for occupational safety, uncovering limited overlap. Counterfactual estimates reveal that current public policies are effective only in areas flagged as high-risk by ex-ante machine predictions. A back-of-the-envelope exercise based on these estimates suggests that machine-learning-based targeting could prevent approximately 70 workplace fatalities per year, equivalent to around 6% of annual deaths, generating substantial social benefits. AI-powered territorial targeting can reduce the incidence and economic burden of this chronic issue while lowering the costs of policy implementation.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107672.abstract_zh: 尽管监管日益严格，工作场所死亡率的降低却出现了令人担忧的停滞。基于地方的政策定向能否有所帮助？通过将机器学习技术与意大利的全面数据相结合，我们开发了一种针对工作场所死亡的地方性方法。利用准确的机器预测，我们构建了一个精细的风险地图，并将其与现场工作检查及职业安全公共补贴的分配进行比较，发现两者重叠有限。反事实估计显示，当前公共政策仅在前瞻性机器预测标记为高风险的区域有效。基于这些估计的粗略计算表明，机器学习驱动的定向策略每年可预防约70起工作场所死亡，约占年死亡人数的6%，产生显著的社会效益。人工智能驱动的地域定向能够减少这一长期问题的发生率与经济负担，同时降低政策实施成本。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107672.title: ‘Dead man working’: A Place-based approach to occupational safety and health
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107672.title_zh: 亡者工作”：基于场所的职业安全与健康研究

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107673.abstract: Promoting green (usually more costly) product consumption is one essential element in building a sustainable society. In times of high inflation, not only budget constraints but also the fear that prices will continue to rise might limit the effectiveness of exerted efforts to promote sustainable behaviors. To test this suggestion, we conducted a Germany-wide survey with almost 1200 respondents, followed by a framed field experiment to confirm causality. Our proxy for green consumption is organic food purchases. Survey respondents’ stated organic purchasing behavior is positively correlated with concerns about climate change but negatively correlated with concerns about inflation. The latter result is driven by individuals with a below-median environmental attitude. In the framed field experiment, we use the priming method to manipulate the saliency of inflation concerns. Whereas sizably relaxing the budget constraint has no impact on the share of organic products in participants’ baskets, the priming significantly decreases the share of organic products for individuals with below-median environmental attitude. Using the same inflation priming in a subsequent survey experiment with around 1800 respondents, we find that high inflationary environments affect both the perception of organic being luxury products and the social norm of buying organic. Both effects are more pronounced for individuals with below-median environmental attitude and, hence, they are the likely mechanisms driving the negative effects on organic product consumption.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107673.abstract_zh: 推广绿色（通常成本更高）产品消费是构建可持续社会的基本要素之一。在高通胀时期，不仅预算约束，而且对价格持续上涨的担忧，都可能限制促进可持续行为所付出努力的有效性。为验证这一观点，我们在德国开展了一项覆盖近1200名受访者的全国性调查，并随后进行了一项框架性实地实验以确认因果关系。我们以有机食品购买作为绿色消费的代理指标。调查受访者所报告的有机购买行为与对气候变化的担忧呈正相关，但与对通胀的担忧呈负相关。后者结果主要由环境态度低于中位数的个体驱动。在框架性实地实验中，我们采用启动方法操纵通胀担忧的显著性。尽管大幅放宽预算约束对参与者购物篮中有机产品的比例没有影响，但启动显著降低了环境态度低于中位数个体中有机产品的比例。在随后一项涉及约1800名受访者的调查实验中，使用相同的通胀启动，我们发现高通胀环境既影响有机产品被视为奢侈品的认知，也影响购买有机产品的社会规范。这两种效应在环境态度低于中位数的个体中更为显著，因此，它们可能是驱动有机产品消费负面效应的潜在机制。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107673.title: Inflation concerns and green product consumption: Evidence from a nationwide survey and a framed field experiment
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107673.title_zh: 通胀担忧与绿色产品消费：基于全国性调查和框架田野实验的证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107674.abstract: To investigate the heterogeneous impacts of test-optional policies, I construct a network of private colleges based on their self-reported peer institutions and detect communities within it using a network science algorithm. I then estimate treatment effects by comparing adopters and non-adopters within the same community. I show how restricting to within-community comparisons drastically attenuates the severe pre-trends that arise when all untreated units serve as controls, suggesting that, within community, a parallel counterfactual trends assumption is satisfied. Overall, adoption substantially increases reported SAT scores, making adopting schools appear more selective, but decreases the share of bachelor’s degree completions in STEM, suggesting that marginally enrolled students are much less likely to complete a STEM degree than those they have displaced. Effects vary by community; at the most selective liberal arts colleges, policy adoption causes an 8 (26) percent decline in the share of all (under-represented minority) bachelor’s completions with a STEM major.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107674.abstract_zh: 为探究选择性考试政策（test-optional）的异质性影响，我基于私立学院自我报告的同行院校构建了一个网络，并运用网络科学算法识别其中的社群。随后，我通过比较同一社群内的采纳者与非采纳者来估计处理效应。我展示了将比较限制在社群内部如何大幅减弱当所有未处理单位作为对照组时出现的严重预趋势，这表明在社群内部，平行反事实趋势假设得以满足。总体而言，政策采纳显著提高了报告的SAT分数，使采纳学校显得更具选择性，但降低了STEM领域学士学位完成比例，这表明边际入学学生完成STEM学位的可能性远低于他们所取代的学生。效应因社群而异；在最具选择性的文理学院中，政策采纳导致STEM专业学士学位完成比例总体下降8%，少数族裔群体下降26%。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107674.title: Peer institution networks, test-optional admission policies, and STEM major completions
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107674.title_zh: 同行院校网络、可选考试录取政策与STEM专业完成率

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107675.abstract: This paper provides evidence of costly perseverance in the field. In a setting where consultants select and pursue projects autonomously, I show that perseverance, conditional on consistency of interest, is associated with fewer successfully completed projects as well as lower sales and commissions. Using rich firm data on individual job activity, I shed light on the task-specific behavioral mechanisms. Overall, perseverant consultants start fewer projects. In fast markets, the lower number of projects started is the main channel of costly perseverance; in slower markets, costs primarily arise from pursuing projects in a more isolated and uninformed way, as shown by an inefficient allocation of effort between stakeholders. The survey questions driving costly perseverance point to the consultants’ failure to incorporate negative signals and opportunity costs into their effort allocation. Using heterogeneity within and between consultants’ task assignment, I show that perseverance is more costly in exploration tasks as opposed to well-defined tasks characterized by mere exploitation.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107675.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于“昂贵坚持”在实地环境中的证据。在一个顾问自主选择并追求项目的环境中，我表明，在兴趣一致性条件下，坚持与成功完成项目数量减少以及销售额和佣金降低相关。利用关于个体工作活动的丰富企业数据，我揭示了任务特定行为机制。总体而言，坚持的顾问启动的项目较少。在快速市场中，启动项目数量减少是昂贵坚持的主要渠道；在较慢市场中，成本主要源于以更孤立且信息不足的方式追求项目，这体现在利益相关者之间努力分配的低效上。驱动昂贵坚持的调查问题指向顾问未能将负面信号和机会成本纳入其努力分配中。利用顾问任务分配内部及之间的异质性，我表明，坚持在探索性任务中比在仅需利用的明确任务中成本更高。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107675.title: Running against windmills: Costly perseverance in long- and short-term goal pursuit
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107675.title_zh: 逆风而行：长期与短期目标追求中的高成本坚持

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107676.abstract: This study examines the causal effect of P M 2.5 air pollution exposure on premature mortality in Southern European cities from 2010 to 2018. We leverage local variations in precipitation and wind speed as a source of random variation in P M 2.5 exposure. Using the Two-Sample Two-Stage Least Squares (TS2SLS) estimator to reconcile monitoring station-level and city-level data, our findings reveal a statistically significant increase in premature mortality caused by P M 2.5 . According to our preferred specification, a 1% increase in P M 2.5 causes a 0.82% rise in the under-65 mortality rate and a 0.93% rise in the infant mortality rate. The results are robust to alternative specifications. The most affected populations are those residing in urban areas (relative to suburban areas) and those living in cities located in richer regions (as opposed to poorer ones). We also examine the role of additional pollutants, finding further evidence for the importance of particulate matter.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107676.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了2010年至2018年南欧城市PM2.5空气污染暴露对过早死亡率的因果效应。我们利用降水和风速的局部变化作为PM2.5暴露的随机变异来源。通过采用两样本两阶段最小二乘估计量（TS2SLS）协调监测站点级与城市级数据，研究结果表明PM2.5暴露显著增加了过早死亡率。根据我们的首选模型设定，PM2.5浓度每增加1%，会导致65岁以下死亡率上升0.82%，婴儿死亡率上升0.93%。该结果在替代模型设定下依然稳健。受影响最严重的人群包括城市地区（相对于郊区）居民，以及位于较富裕地区（相对于较贫困地区）城市的居民。我们还考察了其他污染物的作用，进一步证实了颗粒物的重要性。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107676.title: Poisoned air, shortened lives: PM2.5 exposure and premature mortality in Southern European cities
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107676.title_zh: 毒化空气，缩短寿命：PM2.5暴露与南欧城市过早死亡

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107677.abstract: We study whether competition between groups that yields no material rewards fosters within-group cooperation. In a laboratory experiment, pairs of subjects played an indefinitely repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma either in isolation or in a tournament against another pair, where winning conferred no monetary payoff. The competitive environment increased cooperation, and the effect strengthened over time as subjects gained experience. Exploiting the binary action space of the repeated game, we estimate participants’ strategies and find that the tournament reallocates play away from strategies that start with defection toward strategies that start with cooperation. This reallocation results in a shift from Always Defect to the least risky cooperative strategy, Grim. We complement the experiment with a simple tournament-based model that shows how non-monetary competition can shift equilibrium selection toward cooperative strategies.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107677.abstract_zh: 我们研究的是，不产生物质回报的群体间竞争是否能够促进群体内部的合作。在一项实验室实验中，成对的参与者要么在隔离环境中，要么在与另一对进行锦标赛式对抗中，参与无限重复的囚徒困境游戏，其中获胜并不带来金钱收益。竞争环境增强了合作，且随着参与者积累经验，这一效应随时间增强。利用重复博弈的二元行动空间，我们估计了参与者的策略，并发现锦标赛将游戏行为从以背叛开始的策略重新分配至以合作开始的策略。这种重新分配导致从“始终背叛”转向风险最低的合作策略——“冷酷策略”。我们通过一个简单的基于锦标赛的模型补充实验，该模型展示了非金钱竞争如何将均衡选择转向合作策略。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107677.title: Unity through rivalry: How competition mitigates social dilemmas
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107677.title_zh: 竞争中的团结：竞争如何缓解社会困境

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107678.abstract: We study how localized gasoline price shocks affect household consumption by linking high-frequency bank transaction data with station-level fuel prices. A 1% increase in local gasoline prices reduces monthly household spending by approximately 0.13%, even after controlling for national fuel price movements. We identify two mechanisms. First, spending declines are larger among fuel-dependent, low-liquidity households, consistent with a budget-constraint channel. Second, highly visible local price spikes reduce spending even among non-car households, consistent with a price-salience channel. We further show that localized gasoline price shocks amplify consumption inequality: low-income households with high fuel exposure experience the largest reductions, particularly in discretionary spending. Our findings show that localized energy price fluctuations shape household consumption through both financial constraints and behavioral responses to salient price signals.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107678.abstract_zh: 我们通过将高频银行交易数据与加油站级别的燃油价格相关联，研究局部汽油价格冲击如何影响家庭消费。即使控制了全国燃油价格变动，当地汽油价格每上涨1%，每月家庭支出约减少0.13%。我们识别出两种机制。首先，在依赖燃油且流动性低的家庭中，支出下降幅度更大，这与预算约束渠道一致。其次，高度可见的局部价格飙升甚至减少了无车家庭的支出，这与价格显著性渠道相符。我们进一步表明，局部汽油价格冲击加剧了消费不平等：燃油暴露度高的低收入家庭经历最大幅度的支出削减，尤其是在可自由支配支出方面。我们的研究结果显示，局部能源价格波动通过财务约束和对显著价格信号的行为反应，共同塑造家庭消费。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107678.title: Fueling the mind: How local gasoline prices shape household consumption
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107678.title_zh: 燃油心智：地方汽油价格如何影响家庭消费

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107679.abstract: We examine whether preventive health care uptake varies with cultural background related to patience and risk-taking. We combine individual-level survey data on preventive care use from 27 European countries with country-level preference measures from the Global Preferences Survey. To reduce confounding from institutional and economic correlates of culture, we focus on second-generation immigrants, who were born and currently reside in the same country – and thus face the same health care system and broad economic environment – but differ in inherited cultural background through their parents’ countries of origin. We find that respondents from more patient cultural backgrounds are more likely to use preventive services, while those from more risk-tolerant backgrounds are less likely to do so. These patterns appear across multiple preventive care outcomes.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107679.abstract_zh: 本文考察预防性医疗服务的利用是否因与耐心和风险偏好相关的文化背景而异。我们将来自27个欧洲国家的个体层面预防性护理使用调查数据，与全球偏好调查中的国家层面偏好指标相结合。为减少文化与制度、经济因素之间的混杂效应，我们聚焦于第二代移民——他们出生并居住在同一国家，因此面临相同的医疗体系与宏观经济环境，但通过父母的原籍国继承了不同的文化背景。研究发现，来自更具耐心文化背景的受访者更倾向于使用预防性服务，而来自更具风险容忍背景的受访者则较少使用。这一模式在多种预防性护理结果中均得到体现。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107679.title: Cultural origins of preventive health care utilization
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107679.title_zh: 预防性医疗保健利用的文化起源

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107680.title: Commitment and threats in adversarial bargaining: Insights from a plea bargaining experiment
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107680.title_zh: 对抗性谈判中的承诺与威胁：来自辩诉交易实验的启示

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107681.abstract: This paper studies how a government’s disclosure of information based on short-term reputation concerns can distort agents’ investment decisions and welfare. Agents receive public information before deciding whether to invest, and their actions are strategic complements. There are efficient and inefficient governments, and the high productivity state is more likely under the efficient type. Governments know the state and make public reports with the goal of being perceived as efficient. This motivation leads the inefficient type to be optimistic in equilibrium, sending false reports of the high productivity state with positive probability, thus distorting agents’ beliefs. When productivity is actually high, this distortion reduces investment and welfare compared to a truthful disclosure policy. However, I show that the inefficient type can improve welfare in the low productivity state by sending false reports (there is a small economic boom), as long as the trust in the report is not too high. As the trust in the false report rises, the bias in the agents’ beliefs becomes so large that welfare starts to decrease (the boom might turn into a crisis).
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107681.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了政府基于短期声誉考量进行信息披露，如何扭曲代理人的投资决策及社会福利。代理人在决定是否投资前接收公共信息，其行为具有战略互补性。存在高效与低效两类政府，且高效类型下高生产率状态更可能出现。政府知晓真实状态，并出于被视为高效的动机发布公开报告。这一动机导致低效类型在均衡中倾向于乐观，以正概率发送高生产率状态的虚假报告，从而扭曲代理人的信念。当生产率实际较高时，与真实披露政策相比，这种扭曲减少了投资和社会福利。然而，本文表明，只要对虚假报告的信任度不过高，低效类型在低生产率状态下发送虚假报告（引发小幅经济繁荣）可提升福利。随着对虚假报告信任度的上升，代理人信念的偏差变得过大，福利开始下降（繁荣可能转为危机）。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107681.title: Optimism, complementarity and welfare
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107681.title_zh: 乐观主义、互补性与福利

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107682.abstract: Discouraged workers are those who have given up searching for work because of the (perceived) low chances of obtaining it. In this paper we develop a stochastic structural econometric framework for analyzing discouraged worker behavior based on the theory of job search and the notion of probabilistic rationality and risky choice. Subsequently, we conduct an empirical analysis of immigrant women from non-Western countries and women born in Norway, using microdata on labor force participation and unemployment. We find that the discouraged worker effect is particularly high among immigrant women with low wage rates and many children.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107682.abstract_zh: 沮丧劳动者是指那些因（感知到的）获得工作机会渺茫而放弃求职的人群。本文基于工作搜寻理论以及概率理性与风险选择的概念，构建了一个随机结构计量经济学框架，用以分析沮丧劳动者行为。随后，我们利用劳动力参与和失业的微观数据，对来自非西方国家的移民女性及挪威本土出生的女性进行了实证分析。研究发现，沮丧劳动者效应在工资率低且子女众多的移民女性群体中尤为显著。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107683.abstract: Why has internal migration remained low, even as advances in communication technologies have reduced information frictions in relocation decisions? This paper develops and estimates a spatial model of mobility that incorporates status quo bias in locational preferences, multilateral search frictions, and comoving regional unemployment. Using historical proxies for search frictions, we identify and recover county-level estimates of status quo bias across the United States. Status quo bias is spatially heterogeneous and highest in states containing large urban job centers. Translating these estimates into expected-utility, geographic-distance, and state-border equivalents indicates that variation in status quo bias generates migration frictions comparable to large geographic and institutional barriers. Status quo bias also exhibits strong persistence over time, a robust relationship to migration dynamics, and associations with a range of non-wage individual- and community-level correlates of locational preferences (e.g., housing, climate, and religious and political orientations). These patterns suggest that status quo bias partly reflects place-based preferences shaped by individuals’ residential histories.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107683.abstract_zh: 为何在通信技术发展降低了搬迁决策中的信息摩擦的情况下，内部迁移率仍然保持低位？本文开发并估计了一个空间迁移模型，该模型融入了区位偏好中的现状偏见、多边搜索摩擦以及区域失业率的共同变动。利用历史代理变量来衡量搜索摩擦，我们识别并恢复了美国县级层面的现状偏见估计值。现状偏见在空间上呈现异质性，且在包含大型城市就业中心的州中最为显著。将这些估计值转换为期望效用、地理距离和州界等效值表明，现状偏见的差异所产生的迁移摩擦可与大型地理和制度障碍相媲美。现状偏见还表现出强烈的时间持续性，与迁移动态存在稳健关联，并与一系列非工资性的个体及社区层面的区位偏好相关因素（如住房、气候、宗教和政治倾向）相关联。这些模式表明，现状偏见部分反映了由个体居住历史塑造的基于地方的偏好。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107683.title: On migration gravity with status quo bias and job search frictions
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107683.title_zh: 带有现状偏好和工作搜寻摩擦的移民引力模型

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107684.abstract: We examine how within-group inequality, by influencing the group bias of state institutions, affects the cost-benefit calculus of individuals engaging in identity-assertive behaviour, that results in police complaints regarding hate crimes. We develop a two-stage contest model of between-group conflict, where the relative influence of a group over institutions, determined by an initial contest, affects subsequent hierarchy-establishing interaction between individuals belonging to opposing groups. Applying this model to caste conflict in India, we find that greater inequality among non-Scheduled Caste and non-Scheduled Tribe (non-SC/ST) Hindus reduces the registered rate of crimes against SCs by non-SC/ST Hindus, and the rate at which such registered crimes lead to conviction. Using state-level annual crime and household consumption data over 2005–2021, we find empirical support for these hypotheses. Our analysis suggests that greater equality within dominant groups might reduce institution-capture by them and thereby improve both reporting and punishment of aggression against marginalized groups.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107684.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了群体内不平等如何通过影响国家机构的群体偏向，进而影响个体参与身份彰显行为的成本收益计算，此类行为最终导致针对仇恨犯罪的警方投诉。我们构建了一个两阶段群体间冲突的竞争模型，其中群体对机构相对影响力由初始竞争决定，并影响后续对立群体个体间确立等级关系的互动。将此模型应用于印度的种姓冲突，我们发现，非在册种姓与非在册部落（非SC/ST）印度教徒内部更大的不平等，降低了非SC/ST印度教徒对SC群体犯罪登记率，以及此类登记犯罪导致定罪的比率。利用2005年至2021年邦级年度犯罪和家庭消费数据，我们为这些假设找到了实证支持。我们的分析表明，主导群体内部更大的平等可能减少他们对机构的俘获，从而改善对边缘群体遭受侵犯行为的举报与惩罚。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107685.abstract: We study the effect of communication on beliefs, behavior, and efficiency in the context of trust games with a punishment option, which have the structure of hold-up problems. We apply a novel behavioral motivation, frustration-dependent anger, that links unmet payoff expectations with the willingness to forgo material payoffs to punish others, and we conjecture that communication works through this mechanism to raise expectations about the likelihood of belief-dependent costly punishment and to increase trust, cooperation, and efficiency. Promises drive the effect of communication on beliefs and broken promises lead to costly punishment. In an experiment we allow communication in the form of a single pre-play message. We measure beliefs and our design permits the observation of promises and deception. The results are consistent with the theory.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107685.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在具有惩罚选项的信任博弈中，沟通对信念、行为及效率的影响，这类博弈具有敲竹杠问题的结构。我们引入了一种新颖的行为动机——基于挫败感的愤怒，该动机将未实现的收益预期与牺牲物质收益惩罚他人的意愿联系起来，并推测沟通通过这一机制发挥作用，提升对信念依赖性高成本惩罚可能性的预期，从而增强信任、合作与效率。承诺驱动了沟通对信念的影响，而违背承诺则导致高成本惩罚。在实验中，我们允许以单一事前信息的形式进行沟通，测量了信念，并通过实验设计观察了承诺与欺骗行为。实验结果与理论预测一致。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107685.title: Promises and Punishment

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107686.abstract: We model and experimentally test the relationship between a firm’s reputation and its governance when firms can repair reputation damage through reform. Our model shows that conditions for establishing a reputation depend on whether control of firm operations is delegated to professional managers. Moreover, although the option to reform always dilutes firms’ incentive to commit to reputable behavior, delegation ameliorates the dilution. We assess the robustness of our model to behavioral deviations from optimal behavior through a laboratory experiment. The results of this experiment are directionally consistent with the model’s predictions.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107686.abstract_zh: 我们构建模型并通过实验检验了企业声誉与其治理之间的关系，前提是企业能够通过改革修复声誉损害。模型显示，建立声誉的条件取决于企业运营控制权是否委托给职业经理人。此外，尽管改革选项始终削弱企业承诺声誉行为的激励，但委托管理能缓解这种削弱效应。我们通过实验室实验评估了模型对偏离最优行为的行为偏差的稳健性。实验结果在方向上与模型预测一致。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107686.title: Governance, reputation, crises and recovery: An experiment
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107686.title_zh: 治理、声誉、危机与复苏：一项实验研究

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107687.abstract: We analyze the effects of income interdependence between two players on risk sharing without commitment in an infinitely repeated game. In theory, the likelihood that an informal risk-sharing agreement is self-enforcing decreases with income correlation due to a higher probability of both players being in the same income state in future periods. We test this prediction in a laboratory setting, using treatments with negative, zero, and positive income correlation. Contrary to expectations, we find the least engagement in risk-sharing activities in the zero-correlation treatment. This surprising result suggests that when incomes are positively correlated, experiencing similar financial outcomes fosters a social bond that enhances the success of informal risk-sharing mechanisms.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107687.abstract_zh: 我们分析了无限重复博弈中，两位参与者之间的收入相互依赖对无承诺风险分担的影响。理论上，由于未来时期两位参与者处于相同收入状态的概率更高，非正式风险分担协议自我执行的可能性会随着收入相关性的增加而降低。我们在实验室环境中检验了这一预测，采用了负相关、零相关和正相关三种收入相关性处理。与预期相反，我们发现零相关处理中风险分担活动的参与度最低。这一令人惊讶的结果表明，当收入呈正相关时，经历相似的财务结果会促进社会纽带，从而增强非正式风险分担机制的成功率。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107687.title: Income interdependence and informal risk sharing under the shadow of the future
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107687.title_zh: 未来阴影下的收入相互依赖与非正式风险分担

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107688.abstract: We propose a novel game, the Dictatorial Public Goods Game , to study the interplay between collective resource generation and centralized provision of public goods. After making choices in a standard Voluntary Contribution Mechanism (VCM), one player is selected from the group to administrate the contributions: either provide the public good or expropriate the collected resources for personal gain. We find that adding this centralized mechanism reduces efficiency compared to the standard VCM. Although higher contributions increase the material incentive to expropriate, they lead to more provision. Thus, pro-social choices in the contribution and in the provision stages act as complements, reflecting the generation of social capital in the group. Administrators tend to provide more when the statutory default is expropriation rather than provision. This counter status-quo effect is in line with the standard provision-maintenance gap in the literature, but is not explained by the theoretical arguments typically invoked to explain such framing effects.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107688.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的博弈——独裁性公共品博弈，用以研究集体资源生成与公共品集中供给之间的相互作用。在标准自愿贡献机制（VCM）中做出选择后，从群体中选出一名玩家来管理贡献：要么提供公共品，要么将收集的资源据为己有。我们发现，与标准VCM相比，加入这一集中机制会降低效率。尽管更高的贡献增加了侵占的物质激励，但它们反而导致了更多的供给。因此，贡献阶段和供给阶段的亲社会行为互为补充，反映了群体中社会资本的生成。当法定默认设置为侵占而非供给时，管理者倾向于提供更多。这种反现状效应与文献中标准的供给-维护缺口一致，但无法用通常用于解释此类框架效应的理论论点来解释。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107688.title: The dictatorial public goods game

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107690.abstract: Markets are often used to allocate decision-making, from selecting voting rights of shareholders to hiring workers in the gig economy. We study how market selection can influence the composition of strategic thinking types in strategic interactions. Using auctions as the selection mechanism, we demonstrate that after-market decisions in the 𝑝 -Beauty Contest Game can result in either higher or lower numbers, depending on the incentives. Furthermore, we pinpoint the cause of differences to the market selection of strategic thinking types, rather than the decision-maker altering behaviour due to beliefs about the selection of other players. This highlights the role of institutional factors in determining “who plays the game”.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107690.abstract_zh: 市场常被用于分配决策权，从股东投票权的选择到零工经济中工人的雇佣。我们研究市场选择如何影响战略互动中战略思维类型的构成。以拍卖作为选择机制，我们证明在p-美容竞赛游戏中的售后决策，根据激励的不同，可能导致数字更高或更低。此外，我们将差异的原因精确指向市场对战略思维类型的选择，而非决策者因对其他参与者被选情况的信念而改变行为。这凸显了制度因素在决定“谁参与游戏”中的作用。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107690.title: Market selection of strategic thinking types
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107690.title_zh: 战略思维类型的市场选择

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107691.abstract: Some researchers argue that preferences for wealth accumulation contribute to the long-run stagnation of the Japanese economy. One theoretical implication of such preferences, particularly the assumption that the marginal utility of accumulated wealth has a strictly positive lower bound while that of consumption does not, is a widening of wealth inequality. We experimentally test this theoretical prediction by inducing preferences for wealth accumulation in the laboratory. We find partial support for the prediction: wealth inequality widens when initial inequality is large, but not when it is small. This occurs because high-wealth participants tend to overconsume more than low-wealth participants, partly offsetting the effect of induced preferences for wealth accumulation on inequality dynamics. Providing relative wealth-ranking information has only a limited impact on the widening of wealth inequality.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107691.abstract_zh: 一些研究者认为，对财富积累的偏好是导致日本经济长期停滞的原因之一。此类偏好的一个理论含义——特别是假设累积财富的边际效用存在严格正下限而消费的边际效用不存在这一假设——会导致财富不平等扩大。我们通过实验室实验诱导被试产生财富积累偏好，对该理论预测进行检验。结果发现该预测得到部分支持：当初始不平等程度较高时，财富不平等会扩大；但当初始不平等程度较低时则不会。这是因为高财富参与者比低财富参与者更倾向于过度消费，这在一定程度上抵消了诱导的财富积累偏好对不平等动态的影响。提供相对财富排名信息对财富不平等扩大的影响有限。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107691.title: Preferences for wealth accumulation and wealth inequality: Experimental evidence
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107691.title_zh: 财富积累偏好与财富不平等：实验证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107692.abstract: This paper examines how attitudes among supervisors, co-workers, and customers are related to discrimination against sexual minority individuals in the workplace. Participants from a large, nationally representative online sample in Chile took part in double list experiments  which reduce social desirability bias when eliciting views on sensitive topics  followed by direct questions on attitudes toward sexual minority individuals. The findings reveal a discrepancy between reported and actual levels of comfort with gay individuals in the labor market. The respondents underreported their discomfort by 15-23 percentage points, with the largest bias and lowest comfort levels observed when they were asked about supervising gay employees. These attitudinal patterns were mirrored in incentivized donation behavior: individuals who chose not to donate any amount from a lottery to a local LGBTQ-related nonprofit reported lower comfort levels and exhibited greater misreporting. Finally, the respondents consistently underestimated the broader societal support for gay employees and co-workers.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107692.abstract_zh: 本文考察了主管、同事及顾客的态度如何与工作场所中对性少数个体的歧视相关联。来自智利一个大型、具有全国代表性的在线样本的参与者参与了双重列表实验——该实验在探讨敏感话题时能减少社会期望偏差——随后直接回答了关于对性少数个体态度的问题。研究结果揭示了在劳动力市场中对同性恋个体所报告的实际舒适度与真实舒适度之间存在差异。受访者将其不适感低估了15至23个百分点，其中在询问关于监督同性恋员工时，偏差最大且舒适度最低。这些态度模式在激励性捐赠行为中得到了体现：选择不从彩票中捐赠任何金额给当地LGBTQ相关非营利组织的个体，报告了较低的舒适度，并表现出更大的误报倾向。最后，受访者普遍低估了社会对同性恋员工及同事的更广泛支持。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107693.abstract: Using longitudinal data from the UK, we study the role of industrial segregation for sexual identity-based pay disparities, while controlling for fixed unobserved heterogeneity. We show that industries that have a greater proportion of sexual minorities pay their male employees less. This is of an order of magnitude of a 0.6% marginal reduction in earnings as industrial representation of sexual minorities increases by 1 percent. This compares to an equivalent marginal figure for occupational segregation of approximately 0.9%. In contrast, there is a protective element present for females in the public sector who benefit from a within industry premium to locating in industries with greater LGB representation. However, such effects do not remove the substantial wage penalty faced by gay men, and by lesbian women in the private sector.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107693.abstract_zh: 利用英国纵向数据，我们研究了行业隔离对基于性取向的薪酬差异的作用，同时控制了固定的不可观测异质性。我们表明，性少数群体占比更高的行业支付给男性员工的薪酬较低。当行业中的性少数群体代表性增加1%时，男性员工收入边际减少约0.6%。这与职业隔离的相应边际数值约0.9%相比。相反，在公共部门，女性存在一种保护性因素，她们因进入LGB代表性更高的行业而享有行业内溢价。然而，这些效应并未消除男同性恋者以及私营部门女同性恋者所面临的显著工资惩罚。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107694.abstract: We conduct an artefactual field experiment in real-existing trade networks to analyze how individual network degree affects bargaining demands and outcomes. We combine data from a bilateral bargaining experiment with data of trade networks in 24 villages in Uganda. To identify the effect of individual degree in the village trade network we experimentally vary the disclosure of participants’ identities in a bargaining pair. We derive hypotheses on how degree should affect behavior and find partial support for them. Specifically, we observe that individual degree affects bargaining demands in the predicted direction when one of the bargainers is informed about the network positions but not when both sides are informed. Moreover, network degree affects the likelihood of agreements and earnings, irrespective of the knowledge of the network positions of bargaining partners.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107694.abstract_zh: 我们在真实存在的贸易网络中开展了一项人工实地实验，以分析个体网络度如何影响议价要求与结果。我们将双边议价实验的数据与乌干达24个村庄的贸易网络数据相结合。为了识别村庄贸易网络中个体度的影响，我们通过实验操作议价对中参与者身份的披露情况。我们提出了关于度应如何影响行为的假设，并发现这些假设得到了部分支持。具体而言，我们观察到，当议价双方中只有一方知晓网络位置信息时，个体度对议价要求的影响方向符合预测；但当双方都知晓时，这一影响则不显著。此外，无论议价对手的网络位置是否被知晓，网络度都会影响达成协议的可能性及收益。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107695.abstract: Using monthly rainfall data, we study the demographic consequences of extreme rainfall variability, focusing on extreme dry and wet events in rural China. We find that both types of extreme rainfall events increase fertility, with a stronger response for male births, between 1990 and 1999. More than a decade later, children who were exposed to extreme rainfall events in utero, especially extreme wet events, attain fewer years of schooling than unexposed cohorts. The second trimester of pregnancy emerges as the critical exposure window, with shocks during this period generating the largest negative effects on adult educational outcomes. Examining potential mechanisms, we show that extreme rainfall events reduce household income and increase child mortality. These results highlight the persistent demographic impacts of extreme weather shocks.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107695.abstract_zh: 利用月度降雨数据，我们研究了极端降雨变率的人口后果，重点关注中国农村地区的极端干旱和湿润事件。我们发现，在1990年至1999年间，这两类极端降雨事件均提高了生育率，其中对男性婴儿出生的影响更为显著。十多年后，那些在子宫内暴露于极端降雨事件（尤其是极端湿润事件）的儿童，其受教育年限少于未暴露的同龄群体。孕中期成为关键暴露窗口，此期间的冲击对成年后教育成果产生最大的负面影响。在探究潜在机制时，我们表明极端降雨事件减少了家庭收入并增加了儿童死亡率。这些结果凸显了极端天气冲击对人口结构的持久影响。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107696.abstract: This paper proposes a model of tax compliance and fiscal capacity grounded in universalization reasoning. Citizens partially internalize the consequences of concealment by imagining a world in which everyone acted similarly, linking their compliance decisions to the perceived effectiveness of public spending. A selfish elite chooses between public goods and private rents, taking compliance as given. In equilibrium, citizens' moral internalization expands the feasible tax base and induces elites to allocate resources toward provision rather than appropriation. When the value of public spending is uncertain, morality enables credible reform: high-value elites can signal their type through provision, prompting citizens to increase compliance and raising fiscal capacity within the same period. The analysis thus identifies a moral channel through which states may escape low-capacity traps even under weak institutions.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107696.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个基于普遍化推理的税收遵从与财政能力模型。公民通过想象一个所有人行为相似的世界，部分内化隐瞒行为的后果，从而将自身的税收遵从决策与公共支出的感知有效性联系起来。自私的精英阶层在给定税收遵从水平的情况下，在公共品与私人租金之间进行选择。在均衡状态下，公民的道德内化扩大了可行的税基，并促使精英阶层将资源分配给公共品供给而非私人侵占。当公共支出的价值不确定时，道德因素能够促成可信的改革：高价值精英可以通过提供公共品来传递自身类型信号，促使公民提高税收遵从度，并在同一时期内提升财政能力。因此，本文分析揭示了一条道德渠道——即便在制度薄弱的情况下，国家也可能通过该渠道摆脱低财政能力陷阱。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107696.title: Universalization and the origins of fiscal capacity
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107696.title_zh: 财政能力的普遍化与起源

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107697.abstract: We document that China’s 2018 domestic regulations, which suppressed the future growth potential of its game app market, unintentionally triggered an immediate and significant export expansion in this sector. This expansion was largely accounted for by apps already established in foreign markets, and was significantly stronger among high-quality firms. To rationalize these patterns, we develop and calibrate a dynamic model featuring customer accumulation under capacity constraints. In response to the regulatory shocks, firms proactively reallocate resources toward foreign markets, with higher-quality firms exhibiting a stronger reallocation response. This proactive behavior further amplifies the welfare losses borne by domestic consumers.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107697.abstract_zh: 我们记录到，中国2018年的国内监管措施抑制了其游戏应用市场未来的增长潜力，却意外地引发了该行业即时的显著出口扩张。这一扩张主要由已在海外市场立足的应用所贡献，并且在高质量企业中表现尤为突出。为解释这些现象，我们构建并校准了一个在产能约束下具有客户积累特征的动态模型。面对监管冲击，企业主动将资源重新配置至海外市场，其中高质量企业展现出更强的重新配置反应。这种主动行为进一步加剧了国内消费者所承受的福利损失。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107698.abstract: The paper presents a novel strategic analysis of narcoterrorism where a weak developing country’s terrorist group extorts home drug farmers to finance terror attacks. A developed country’s counterterror actions are motivated by the harm its residents endure from those attacks. The developed country’s counterterrorism involves efforts to destroy the drug crop abroad. The analysis begins with the drug price being exogenously fixed, followed by a “large-country case’’ with a market-determined drug price. The extension introduces a fourth participant, consisting of the developed country’s consumers whose purchases determine the drug demand. A subsequent extension allows for two drug-exporting countries along with their resident terrorist groups. Now, the drug price depends on terrorists’ extortion rates and the developed country’s counterterrorism associated with the two drug-exporting countries. With the last extension, novel drug-based counterterror transfers of terrorism occur between the drug-producing countries. For alternative scenarios, we show the key influence of the elasticity of the farmers’ counterterror resilience on the extortion rate and terrorism level.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107698.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种关于毒品恐怖主义的新战略分析，其中，一个弱小发展中国家的恐怖组织通过勒索本国毒品农民来资助恐怖袭击。发达国家的反恐行动源于其居民因这些袭击所遭受的伤害。该发达国家的反恐措施包括努力在海外摧毁毒品作物。分析首先假设毒品价格外生固定，随后探讨“大国情形”，即毒品价格由市场决定。扩展部分引入第四方参与者，即发达国家的消费者，其购买行为决定毒品需求。进一步的扩展允许存在两个毒品出口国及其各自的恐怖组织。此时，毒品价格取决于恐怖分子的勒索率以及发达国家针对这两个毒品出口国的反恐行动。通过最后的扩展，毒品生产国之间出现了基于毒品的新型反恐恐怖转移。针对不同情景，我们展示了农民反恐韧性弹性对勒索率和恐怖主义水平的关键影响。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107699.abstract: This paper asks whether authors’ ability to manipulate AI referees necessarily undermines peer review, or whether it can sometimes improve it. We model a journal in which authors privately know quality, referees choose between costly manual review and cheap AI delegation, and editors may investigate suspicious recommendations. Hidden prompts can force AI to recommend acceptance, but prompt detection is imperfect. With the baseline referee incentives and sequentially rational, non-committed investigation, manual-only review is unsustainable once AI is available, and there is no robust pure-strategy AI-only equilibrium with manipulation. Most notably, under the welfare criterion studied here, prompt injection can be welfare improving on an open set of primitives: in certain monitoring equilibria, manipulation makes positive AI reports more suspicious or more exposed to audit, induces editor investigation, and helps sustain manual review where prompt-free standard inspection would fail. Stronger prompt detection is, therefore, not unconditionally better; within the focal equilibrium menu, it can eliminate a monitoring regime without replacing it with a higher-welfare one. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107699.abstract_zh: 本文探讨作者操纵AI审稿人的能力是否必然损害同行评审，抑或有时能改进评审机制。我们构建了一个期刊模型：作者私下知晓论文质量，审稿人可在高成本人工评审与低成本AI委托之间选择，编辑则可能对可疑推荐展开调查。隐藏提示可强制AI推荐接收，但提示检测并不完美。在基准审稿人激励与序贯理性、非承诺调查条件下，一旦AI可用，纯人工评审便不可持续，且不存在稳健的纯策略AI均衡（含操纵行为）。尤为值得注意的是，在所研究的福利标准下，提示注入可在开集参数上改善福利：在某些监控均衡中，操纵行为使正面AI报告更可疑或更易受审计，促使编辑展开调查，并在无提示的标准审查失效时维持人工评审。因此，更强的提示检测并非无条件更优；在焦点均衡集合内，它可能消除一种监控机制，却未代之以更高福利的机制。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107699.title: Can author manipulation of AI referees be welfare improving?
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107699.title_zh: 作者操纵AI审稿人能否提升福利？

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107711.abstract: Herd behavior is a well-documented phenomenon in economics, yet little is known about whether people follow the general crowd or those who are most similar to them. This paper asks a simple but critical question: who do individuals really follow in a time of crisis? Using data from the European Social Survey combined with vaccination records across 15 countries, we examine how COVID-19 vaccination decisions were shaped by peers. We find that individuals’ willingness to vaccinate is driven far more strongly by their age-group peers than by the broader population, with the effect holding across most age groups. Moreover, our results reveal a U-shaped relationship between the share of vaccinated peers and individual vaccination intentions, suggesting that social norms reinforce peer effects once vaccination reaches a critical mass. These results highlight the perception that herd behavior is not just about the size of the herd; similarity is central to social learning and decision-making under uncertainty, with important implications for public health strategies and beyond. Regarding vaccination operations, these results indicate that mobilizing age-specific leaders, influencers, or social networks can help establish a herd within high-risk groups. More generally, as social learning appears to be most effective among individuals with shared characteristics, interventions designed to increase compliance may be more successful when targeted to specific peer groups rather than the general public.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107711.abstract_zh: 羊群行为是经济学中一个已被充分记录的现象，然而关于人们是跟随大众还是跟随与自己最相似的人群，我们所知甚少。本文提出了一个简单但关键的问题：在危机时刻，个体究竟会跟随谁？利用欧洲社会调查数据结合15个国家的疫苗接种记录，我们考察了同伴如何影响COVID-19疫苗接种决策。研究发现，个体接种意愿受同龄群体影响远大于受更广泛人群的影响，且这一效应在大多数年龄组中均成立。此外，我们的结果揭示了已接种同伴比例与个体接种意愿之间存在U型关系，表明一旦疫苗接种达到临界规模，社会规范会强化同伴效应。这些结果凸显了一个认知：羊群行为不仅仅关乎群体的规模；相似性是社会学习和不确定性下决策的核心，对公共卫生策略及其他领域具有重要启示。就疫苗接种操作而言，这些结果表明，动员特定年龄的领导者、影响者或社交网络有助于在高风险群体中建立群体免疫。更广泛地说，由于社会学习在具有共同特征的个体之间最为有效，旨在提高遵从度的干预措施在针对特定同伴群体而非普通公众时可能更为成功。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107714.abstract: Carbon taxation is one of the most effective tools for reducing emissions, but it often faces public resistance due to concerns about fairness, distributional impacts, and the use of revenue. Experimental evidence on how these factors shape tax acceptance remains limited, particularly outside North America and Western Europe. This study examines how information emphasizing the progressive features of a fuel tax—a proxy for carbon taxation—affects perceptions of fairness and tax acceptance. It also investigates, for the first time, how allocating tax revenue to national defense, at a time when this issue is highly salient, influences tax acceptance. Drawing on Lithuania’s 2025 fuel tax increase, which was partially earmarked for defense spending, we conducted an online survey experiment (N = 2553). Respondents were assigned to one of three conditions: (1) information on the tax’s distributional effects, emphasizing its progressiveness; (2) the same information plus a reminder about revenue allocation to defense; or (3) no information. Providing distributional information, both on its own and in combination with a reminder that revenues would be allocated to defense spending, increased perceived fairness and self-reported support for the tax. Moreover, the combined treatment reduced opposition to the tax. The defense-earmarking reminder also made an independent contribution to reducing opposition. Overall, the results suggest that both distributional considerations and the intended use of revenues shape public acceptance of the policy.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107714.abstract_zh: 碳税是减少排放最有效的工具之一，但因其公平性、分配影响及收入用途方面的担忧，常常面临公众阻力。关于这些因素如何影响税收接受度的实验证据仍然有限，尤其是在北美和西欧以外的地区。本研究考察了强调燃油税（作为碳税的代理指标）累进特征的信息如何影响公平感及税收接受度。同时，本研究首次探讨了在国防问题高度突出的时期，将税收收入分配给国防如何影响税收接受度。基于立陶宛2025年燃油税上调（部分指定用于国防支出），我们开展了一项在线调查实验（N = 2553）。受访者被分配到三种条件之一：（1）关于税收分配效应的信息，强调其累进性；（2）相同信息加上税收收入用于国防的提醒；（3）无信息。提供分配信息，无论是单独提供还是与收入将用于国防支出的提醒相结合，均提高了感知公平性和对税收的自我报告支持度。此外，联合处理减少了对税收的反对。国防指定用途的提醒也对减少反对做出了独立贡献。总体而言，结果表明，分配考量与收入的预期用途共同塑造了公众对该政策的接受度。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107715.abstract: In the context of an epidemic where the risk of death post-infection depends on demography and social behaviour, this paper characterises how the degree of congestibility of the social environment and the public/private nature of the available information about health states jointly affect the strategic social distancing of demographically heterogeneous agents. Key result is that the joint presence of congestibility and private information is necessary and sufficient for social-distancing decisions to be strategic complements. Strategic substitutability ensues in every other case. Within the limits of the proposed model, the analysis provides a sound theoretical rationale for the heterogeneity in the results provided by the extant literature on the issue. Implications ensue for optimal information design. First: limiting private information (e.g. by forbidding self-tests) is always socially optimal. Second: if private information cannot be limited, the second-best policy crucially depends on environmental congestibility: with high congestibility, providing the maximum extent of public information (e.g. via mass screening campaigns) is desirable, whereas the converse is true with low congestibility.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107715.abstract_zh: 在感染后死亡风险取决于人口结构和社会行为的流行病背景下，本文刻画了社会环境拥挤程度以及健康状态信息的公共/私人属性如何共同影响人口异质性主体的策略性社交距离行为。关键结论是，拥挤性与私人信息的共同存在是社交距离决策成为战略互补品的充分必要条件。在其他所有情形下，则表现为战略替代性。在模型设定范围内，分析为现有文献中关于该问题结果异质性提供了坚实的理论依据。这对最优信息设计具有启示意义。第一：限制私人信息（例如禁止自我检测）始终是社会最优的。第二：若私人信息无法限制，次优政策则关键取决于环境拥挤程度：在高拥挤性下，提供最大程度的公共信息（例如通过大规模筛查活动）是可取的；而在低拥挤性下，情况则相反。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107716.abstract: This paper investigates how the COVID-19 pandemic affected Italian firms’ expectations regarding future growth and prices, and the link between firm-level uncertainty and forecast errors. Using firm-level panel data from the Bank of Italy’s INVIND survey, we document that growth-expectation formation is stable across nearly three decades, including the COVID-19 pandemic, and that growth forecasts retain predictive content for realized outcomes in every year of the sample. Firms’ self-reported uncertainty about growth is informative about forecast accuracy in crisis years but not during 2020–2021, when uncertainty was driven by a common aggregate shock. At the aggregate level, cross-sectional disagreement among firms predicts the dispersion of subsequent realized outcomes, with predictability running only from expectations to outcomes. Workforce shortages are the dominant channel through which the pandemic disrupted firm expectations, more relevant than demand, supply, or financial channels. The price domain differs from real growth, with the response of expected prices to realized prices weakening during the late 1990s, the 2008–2009 financial crisis, and the 2022 inflation surge, while subjective price uncertainty remains a stable predictor of forecast errors.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107716.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了COVID-19疫情如何影响意大利企业对未来增长和价格的预期，以及企业层面不确定性与预测误差之间的联系。利用意大利央行INVIND调查的企业层面面板数据，我们记录了增长预期形成机制在近三十年间保持稳定，包括COVID-19疫情期间，且增长预测在样本中的每一年都对实际结果具有预测内容。企业自我报告的增长不确定性在危机年份对预测准确性具有信息价值，但在2020-2021年期间则不然，彼时不确定性由共同的总体冲击驱动。在总体层面，企业间的横截面分歧能够预测后续实际结果的离散程度，且预测性仅从预期传导至结果。劳动力短缺是疫情扰乱企业预期的主要渠道，其重要性超过需求、供给或金融渠道。价格领域与实际增长有所不同，预期价格对实际价格的响应在1990年代末、2008-2009年金融危机及2022年通胀飙升期间有所减弱，而主观价格不确定性始终是预测误差的稳定预测因子。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107717.abstract: News shocks are often characterized as a form of external uncertainty, which could drive consumer behavior by shaping cognitive processes. However, news coverage often coincides with real-world events, making it difficult to identify whether observed effects are driven by the news itself or by the underlying events. Based on the announcement of the planned release of ALPS-treated water from Fukushima, news concerning future events, this paper identifies the economic consequences of news shocks and incorporates salience theory into international trade. Applying a difference-in-difference method, we find that Pacific Rim countries and regions near Japan experienced a significantly greater decrease in seafood exports than those further away in the post-news period. The negative effects could be attributed to demand-side factors, including consumer sensitivity to news, heightened fear of unknown risks, and a shift toward substitute products.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107717.abstract_zh: 新闻冲击常被视为一种外部不确定性形式，其通过塑造认知过程来影响消费者行为。然而，新闻报道往往与现实世界事件同步发生，这使得难以区分观察到的效应究竟源于新闻本身还是其背后的实际事件。基于福岛核处理水计划排放公告这一涉及未来事件的新闻，本文识别了新闻冲击的经济后果，并将显著性理论引入国际贸易领域。运用双重差分方法，我们发现，在新闻发布后时期，靠近日本的环太平洋国家和地区相较于距离更远的地区，其海产品出口出现了显著更大幅度的下降。负面效应可归因于需求侧因素，包括消费者对新闻的敏感性、对未知风险的恐惧加剧，以及向替代产品的转移。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107718.abstract: We investigate prosocial preferences in contexts where giving involves small amounts. Focusing on the lower bound of generosity, we propose an asymmetry: givers may prefer to give nothing rather than a small amount, whereas receivers prefer receiving a small amount to receiving nothing. Evidence from two survey experiments (N = 1,658), an incentivized laboratory experiment (N = 296), and a field study involving 77 fundraising sessions supports the existence of a reluctance to give small amounts. Our findings further suggest that this reluctance is misaligned with receivers’ preferences and that informing givers that small amounts are acceptable significantly increases the likelihood of giving.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107718.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在捐赠涉及小额款项情境下的亲社会偏好。聚焦于慷慨的下限，我们提出了一种不对称性：给予者可能宁愿什么都不给，也不愿给予小额，而接受者则更倾向于收到小额而非一无所获。来自两项调查实验（N=1,658）、一项激励性实验室实验（N=296）以及涉及77次筹款活动的实地研究证据，支持了不愿给予小额款项这一现象的存在。我们的研究进一步表明，这种不愿与小额接受者的偏好并不一致，并且告知给予者小额款项是可接受的，能显著提高给予的可能性。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107719.abstract: The effect of demographic diversity on teamwork remains theoretically ambiguous. More diverse teams may benefit from more creativity and knowledge sharing, but they also face higher communication and coordination costs. This paper tests these competing mechanisms in the context of higher education. We exploit an experimental setting in a large undergraduate class, where students are randomly assigned to small homework groups, with varying levels of diversity in terms of race, gender, and place of birth. We find that the relationship between diversity and performance depends systematically on the task environment: more diverse groups outperform less diverse groups in open-ended, generative tasks, but underperform in more structured analytical tasks. We then address the effect of team diversity on coordination and communication, building an index of teamwork quality based on collaboration between members, the balance of member contributions, and the absence of conflicts. We find that diversity has a U-shaped effect on teamwork quality, regardless of the type of task performed. This result suggests that faultlines – dividing lines that split a group into subgroups based on demographic characteristics – can cause inter-subgroup cohesion to break down, while very homogeneous or very heterogeneous groups collaborate better. The results help provide a framework to understand optimal team composition for institutions and organizations.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107719.abstract_zh: 人口多样性的影响在理论上对团队合作仍存在不确定性。更多样化的团队可能因创造力和知识共享的增加而受益，但也面临更高的沟通与协调成本。本文在高等教育背景下检验了这些相互竞争的机制。我们利用一个大班本科课程中的实验设置，学生被随机分配到小型作业小组，这些小组在种族、性别和出生地方面具有不同程度的多样性。我们发现，多样性与绩效之间的关系系统地依赖于任务环境：在开放式、生成性任务中，更多样化的群体表现优于较少多样化的群体，但在结构化的分析性任务中则表现不佳。接着，我们探讨了团队多样性对协调与沟通的影响，基于成员间的合作、成员贡献的均衡性以及冲突的缺失构建了一个团队合作质量指数。我们发现，无论执行何种类型的任务，多样性对团队合作质量的影响呈U形。这一结果表明，断层线——根据人口特征将群体划分为子群体的分界线——可能导致子群体间凝聚力瓦解，而高度同质或高度异质的群体则合作得更好。这些结果有助于为机构和组织理解最优团队构成提供一个框架。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107720.abstract: Do gender differences matter for politicians' budgetary behaviour when confronted with institutional change? Following Spain's 2013 municipal reform, municipalities with more than 20,000 inhabitants lost responsibility for social services provision. Using a difference-in-differences design on municipalities in the Madrid region from 2010 to 2019, we find no effect of female representation on social services spending in the absence of the reform. Once the reform is taken into account, however, social services spending falls significantly in treated municipalities, and the decline is smaller where the share of female politicians is higher: governments with a female share of about 30% cut spending by an amount equivalent to more than 50% of average social services spending, whereas those with a 45% female share reduce spending by less than 20%. These findings suggest that female politicians are more likely to protect social services spending at the municipal level as responsibilities shift to the regional level.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107720.abstract_zh: 性别差异在面临制度变革时是否会影响政治家的预算行为？以西班牙2013年市政改革为背景，超过两万居民的市镇失去了社会服务供给的职责。通过对马德里地区2010至2019年间市镇数据的双重差分分析，我们发现，在改革未实施的情况下，女性代表比例对社会服务支出并无影响。然而，一旦考虑改革因素，受改革影响的市镇社会服务支出显著下降，且女性政治家比例越高，支出减少幅度越小：女性占比约30%的政府削减的支出相当于平均社会服务支出的50%以上，而女性占比45%的政府削减幅度则不足20%。这些发现表明，随着职责向地区层面转移，女性政治家更倾向于在市镇层面保护社会服务支出。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107722.abstract: We evaluate the First-Generation Graduate Scholarship scheme implemented in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu, which waives tuition fees for first-generation college students in technical education. The scheme represents a large-scale non-identity-based affirmative action policy in higher education, using first-generation status as the basis for eligibility. Using household survey data in difference-in-differences (DiD) and synthetic DiD frameworks, we find substantial improvements in enrollment, stream choice, and graduation in technical courses, with downstream effects on regular employment, occupational choices, and household welfare. Male students gained more than female students. The scheme also increased reliance on education loans to cover residual costs. The findings suggest that policies based on first-generation status can promote intergenerational mobility by expanding higher education access and improving labour market outcomes.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107722.abstract_zh: 我们评估了印度泰米尔纳德邦实施的第一代研究生奖学金计划，该计划免除了技术教育中第一代大学生的学费。该计划代表了一项大规模的非身份认同为基础的平权行动政策，在高等教育中，以第一代身份作为资格依据。利用家庭调查数据，在双重差分（DiD）和合成双重差分框架下，我们发现技术课程的入学率、专业选择和毕业情况有了显著改善，并对正规就业、职业选择和家庭福利产生了下游影响。男性学生比女性学生获益更多。该计划还增加了对教育贷款的依赖，以覆盖剩余成本。研究结果表明，基于第一代身份的政策可以通过扩大高等教育入学机会和改善劳动力市场结果来促进代际流动性。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107723.abstract: We report the results from a large field experiment that tests if happiness spreads within an organizational setting, as predicted by the emotional contagion hypothesis. Although some studies have supported this hypothesis, no well-powered randomized controlled trial has ever tested it in the field. In collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces, we randomly assign over 1500 recruits to rooms during eight-week boot camps. Some recruits live with relatively happier peers while others live with relatively unhappier ones. We find no evidence of happiness convergence at the room level and reject even small contagion effects. We show that the null result is not explained by excessive stability in happiness, and prior studies in the same setting show that peer effects emerge for some non-emotional attitudes. These results call for a reconsideration of the presumed ubiquity of happiness spillovers, with subsequent implications for well-being models and policies.
