10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107723.abstract_zh: 我们报告了一项大规模实地实验的结果，该实验检验了情绪传染假说所预测的幸福感是否能在组织环境中传播。尽管已有一些研究支持这一假说，但尚无一项具有充分统计功效的随机对照试验在实地环境中对其进行验证。我们与挪威武装部队合作，在为期八周的新兵训练营中，将超过1500名新兵随机分配到不同房间。部分新兵与相对更快乐的同伴同住，而另一些则与相对不那么快乐的同伴同住。我们发现，在房间层面没有证据表明幸福感趋于一致，甚至拒绝了微小的传染效应。我们证明，这一零结果并非由幸福感的过度稳定性所解释，且在同一环境下的先前研究表明，同伴效应确实会对某些非情绪态度产生影响。这些结果呼吁重新审视幸福感溢出效应被假定为普遍存在的观点，并对幸福感模型及政策制定具有后续启示。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107724.abstract: This paper examines the impact of net overseas migration (NOM) on residential property marketsusing annual, neighborhood-level data for Australia. We leverage an instrumental variableapproach based on historical immigrant settlement patterns to isolate plausibly exogenousvariation in migration flows. We find that a 1% increase in NOM, as a share of the local population,raises unit rents and prices by 5.0% and 1.3%, respectively, and increases house rents by3.6%. These effects are more pronounced in areas with low rates of dwelling approvals, suggestingthat housing supply constraints amplify the response of prices and rents to migration.In contrast, house prices decline by 1.3%, a pattern concentrated in older neighborhoods andconsistent with displacement dynamics, for which we present supporting evidence.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107724.abstract_zh: 本文利用澳大利亚年度社区层面数据，考察了净海外移民（NOM）对住宅房地产市场的影响。我们采用基于历史移民定居模式的工具变量方法，以隔离移民流动中可能外生的变化。研究发现，NOM占当地人口比例每增加1%，单元房租金和价格分别上涨5.0%和1.3%，独栋房屋租金上涨3.6%。这些效应在住房审批率较低的地区更为显著，表明住房供应约束放大了价格和租金对移民的响应。相比之下，独栋房屋价格下降1.3%，这一模式集中在较老社区，与置换动态一致，我们为此提供了支持性证据。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107725.abstract: This paper studies the public expression of opinions on polarized topics (race and gender). In a series of pre-registered online experiments conducted in the United States in 2021 and 2023, we elicited participants’ views on these topics and their willingness to publish their views online. We find an asymmetric U-shaped relationship between ideological stance and willingness to share views publicly: moderates were least willing to speak up, willingness rose toward both ideological extremes and was highest among respondents with progressive views. Participants also perceived publicly expressed opinions as more left-leaning than underlying private opinions. A priming treatment highlighting the risk of negative social media backlash had modest and statistically insignificant effects. A social-information treatment informing respondents that many others were willing to speak up significantly reduced self-censorship.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107725.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在极化议题（种族与性别）上公众意见的表达。通过2021年和2023年在美国进行的一系列预注册在线实验，我们收集了参与者对这些议题的看法及其在线公开发表意见的意愿。我们发现，意识形态立场与公开发表意见意愿之间存在不对称的U型关系：温和派最不愿发声，意愿向意识形态两端递增，且在持进步观点的受访者中最高。参与者还认为，公开表达的意见比私下意见更偏左。一项强调社交媒体负面反弹风险的启动处理效应较小且统计上不显著。一项告知受访者许多其他人愿意发声的社会信息处理显著减少了自我审查。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107727.abstract: We study the extent of a one-size-fits-all approach in the design of public procurement (PP) tenders using comprehensive data from Finland. We show that crucial PP design features related to auction and contract rules tend to have significant lack of variation across different tenders for different industries within a contracting authority. We show that this organizational rigidness is due to both organizational level culture and individual employee level work habit formation with the latter being more important. We find that both greater organizational rigidity and deviating from the national industry norms are associated with lower number of bids and higher probability of zero-bid tenders, pointing to a potential efficiency loss from organizational rigidness in PP, and offering a solution that buyers could mimic how other organizations typically buy similar products rather than how they themselves buy very different products.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107727.abstract_zh: 我们利用芬兰的全面数据，研究了公共采购（PP）招标设计中“一刀切”方法的普遍程度。我们表明，与拍卖和合同规则相关的关键PP设计特征，在同一采购机构针对不同行业的不同招标中，往往缺乏显著变化。我们证明，这种组织僵化既源于组织层面的文化，也源于个体员工层面的工作习惯形成，其中后者更为重要。我们发现，更大的组织僵化以及偏离国家行业规范，均与投标数量减少和零投标招标概率增加相关，这暗示了公共采购中组织僵化可能导致的效率损失，并提出了一个解决方案：买家可以模仿其他组织通常如何采购类似产品，而非依据自身采购截然不同产品的习惯。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107728.abstract: We estimate the impact of temperatures on emergency department visits using daily data from the universe of public hospitals in Mexico from 2008 to 2021. We find that cold temperatures decrease visits by up to 9.1 percent on the same day, and warm temperatures increase visits by as much as 3.7 percent. Using distributed lag models, we then show that cold temperatures can reduce visits for the next 30 days by up to 16 percent. For warm temperatures, contemporaneous and cumulative effects are similar (limited harvesting). These findings suggest that, unlike mortality, temperatures affect the demand for emergency services linearly. Leveraging the granularity of our dataset, we also document significant heterogeneities (e.g., higher sensitivity for children and teenagers) and provide suggestive evidence about mechanisms, such as ecosystem dynamics and behavioral changes. Finally, we project that — absent adaptation — temperature-driven annual emergency department visits might increase by 0.35 percent by midcentury, resulting in an estimated increase of 8.5 million USD in annual medical expenditures in Mexico.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107728.abstract_zh: 我们利用2008年至2021年墨西哥公立医院全样本的每日数据，评估了气温对急诊就诊人次的影响。研究发现，寒冷天气会使当日就诊人次减少高达9.1%，而炎热天气则会使就诊人次增加多达3.7%。通过使用分布滞后模型，我们进一步揭示，寒冷天气可在未来30天内将就诊人次减少最多16%。对于炎热天气，同期效应与累积效应相似（即有限的“收获效应”）。这些结果表明，与死亡率不同，气温对急诊服务需求的影响呈线性关系。借助数据集的细粒度特性，我们还记录了显著的异质性（例如，儿童和青少年对气温变化更为敏感），并提供了关于机制（如生态系统动态和行为变化）的提示性证据。最后，我们预测——在缺乏适应措施的情况下——到本世纪中叶，由气温驱动的年度急诊就诊人次可能增加0.35%，这将导致墨西哥年度医疗支出预计增加850万美元。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107728.title: Emergency department visits and temperature: Evidence from Mexico
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107728.title_zh: 急诊就诊与气温：来自墨西哥的证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107729.abstract: Understanding an individual’s human network assessment is fundamental for successful policy design when dealing with infection risk. Yet, how individuals cognitively compensate for their inability to process complex network models, remains poorly understood. Using an online best-worst ranking experiment, we investigate individuals’ perception of the risk of connecting to carefully constructed COVID-19-infected networks of 697 Dutch participants. Specifically, we consider three network characteristics that individuals can either directly access or implicitly estimate in real-life social network assessment. We show that the perceived infection risk in social networks is not solely based on the objective probability of this risk: easily assessable physical characteristics have stronger predictive power on the perceived risk than the objective probability. Heterogeneity assessment suggests that demographic differences such as the level of education interact with the order and strength of the network characteristics. The often-complex mental calculation underlying objective risk in networks is substituted by a heuristics-driven approach. Our findings facilitate more tailored, effective, and generalizable policy and economically optimal infection-mitigating campaign design.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107729.abstract_zh: 理解个体的人际网络评估对于制定应对感染风险的有效政策至关重要。然而，个体如何在认知上弥补其处理复杂网络模型能力的不足，仍鲜为人知。通过一项在线最优-最差排序实验，我们调查了697名荷兰参与者对连接精心构建的COVID-19感染网络风险的感知。具体而言，我们考虑了三种个体在现实社交网络评估中可直接获取或隐含估计的网络特征。我们表明，社交网络中的感知感染风险并非仅基于该风险的客观概率：易于评估的物理特征对感知风险的预测力强于客观概率。异质性评估表明，教育水平等人口统计学差异与网络特征的作用顺序和强度相互作用。网络客观风险背后通常复杂的心理计算被一种基于启发式的方法所取代。我们的发现有助于设计更具针对性、有效且可推广的政策，以及经济上最优的感染缓解宣传活动。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107729.title: Human accuracy in social network analysis: The role of network characteristics in infection risk assessment
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107729.title_zh: 社会网络分析中的人类准确性：网络特征在感染风险评估中的作用

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107730.abstract: In simple choice, slower decisions tend to indicate proximity to indifference and thus less predictable choice. In complex situations, some studies have argued that slower decisions indicate more reasoning and thus more optimal decisions. However, those studies rely on games where the optimal responses are debatable – they depend on agents’ beliefs or social preferences. Thus, it is unclear whether being slow is a good or bad sign. Here, we examine whether fast decisions are more or less optimal in high and low complexity, zero-sum games with dominant strategies and limited social-preference concerns. We study repeated 2-person p-beauty contests, where halfway through the experiment we switch the multiplier, changing the dominant strategy. Only 33% of subjects correctly adjusted after the switch, an indication of understanding the dominant strategy. Those who continued to play the dominant strategy showed a decrease in response time (RT) upon playing the dominant strategy, while those who later switched away from the dominant strategy did not. Contrary to the predictions for complex games, subjects exhibited negative correlations between RT and optimal choice, both in the early rounds and after the switch. Thus, we find no support for the notion that slower decisions result in better choices.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107730.abstract_zh: 在简单选择中，较慢的决策往往表明接近无差异状态，从而预测性较低。在复杂情境下，一些研究认为较慢的决策意味着更多的推理，因此更可能产生最优决策。然而，这些研究依赖于最优反应存在争议的博弈——它们取决于参与者的信念或社会偏好。因此，尚不清楚决策缓慢是积极信号还是消极信号。在此，我们考察在具有主导策略且社会偏好关注有限的高、低复杂度零和博弈中，快速决策是否更优或更劣。我们研究了重复进行的两人p-美容竞赛，在实验中途切换乘数，从而改变主导策略。仅有33%的受试者在切换后正确调整，这表明他们理解了主导策略。那些继续采用主导策略的受试者在执行主导策略时反应时间（RT）有所下降，而那些后来偏离主导策略的受试者则没有表现出这种下降。与复杂博弈的预测相反，受试者在早期轮次及切换后均表现出反应时间与最优选择之间的负相关。因此，我们没有发现支持“较慢决策导致更好选择”这一观点的证据。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107731.abstract: Behavioral nudges in the form of peer-comparison information have, in many cases, proven effective in promoting pro-social behavior. The most prominent example is the use of home energy reports in electricity markets. While there is evidence that peer comparisons can induce reductions in externality-generating consumption, it is not clear through which channels the nudges operate. One possible channel is pecuniary: peer comparisons may make consumption choices more salient and prompt discovery of opportunities for financial savings. The other is non-pecuniary: peer comparisons may trigger moral motives such as guilt, social conformism, or social competitiveness. This study uses a controlled posted-price market experiment with externalities. We eliminate the “discovery” channel present in field settings by making financial incentives fixed and known. The experiment thus controls the pecuniary channel, leaving only the non-pecuniary, “moral” channel. We find that the nudge still enhances pro-social behavior, pointing to the moral channel’s importance. Two additional findings are that the nudge is equally effective across the treatments with low and high market prices (indicating that nudges and financial incentives neither complement nor crowd each other out) and that the nudge is more effective for participants with relatively cooperative worldviews.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107731.abstract_zh: 以同伴比较信息为形式的行为助推，在许多情况下已被证明能有效促进亲社会行为。最显著的例子是电力市场中家庭能源报告的使用。尽管有证据表明同伴比较能诱导减少产生外部性的消费，但助推发挥作用的具体渠道尚不明确。一种可能的渠道是金钱性的：同伴比较可能使消费选择更加突出，并促使人们发现节省财务开支的机会。另一种是非金钱性的：同伴比较可能触发道德动机，如内疚感、社会从众心理或社会竞争意识。本研究采用带有外部性的受控标价市场实验。我们通过使财务激励固定且已知，消除了实地环境中存在的“发现”渠道。因此，该实验控制了金钱性渠道，仅保留非金钱性的“道德”渠道。我们发现，助推仍然增强了亲社会行为，这表明道德渠道的重要性。另外两项发现是：助推在低市场价格和高市场价格处理中效果相同（表明助推与财务激励既不相辅相成，也不相互排斥），且助推对世界观相对合作的参与者更为有效。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107731.title: Peer comparisons and the cost of pro-social behavior: Evidence from the lab
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107731.title_zh: 同伴比较与亲社会行为的成本：来自实验室的证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107733.abstract: Do cultural mindsets shape cooperation? Individualists, who view people as independent, and collectivists, who see them as interconnected, make different decisions that impact governance and economic outcomes. This study tests individualism and collectivism (I/C) in indefinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemmas (IRPD) among in- and out-group members. We hypothesized that collectivists would cooperate more with in-group members, while individualists would treat all groups similarly. To explore causality, participants completed a group-identity task before the I/C measure in Strong-Identity treatment, but not in Weak-Identity treatment. Results show largely null I/C effects; only higher defection payoffs consistently reduced cooperation. Some evidence supports the Strong-Identity treatment leading to lower defection in groups exhibiting greater cohesion in the group-identity task.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107733.abstract_zh: 文化心态是否塑造合作行为？个人主义者视个体为独立存在，而集体主义者则视其为相互关联，这两种不同的观念会导致影响治理和经济结果的决策差异。本研究在无限重复囚徒困境（IRPD）中，针对群体内与群体外成员，测试了个人主义与集体主义（I/C）的影响。我们假设集体主义者会更多与群体内成员合作，而个人主义者则对所有群体一视同仁。为探究因果关系，在强身份处理组中，参与者在完成I/C测量前先执行群体身份任务；而在弱身份处理组中则无此任务。结果显示，I/C效应大体上不显著；唯有更高的背叛收益持续降低了合作率。部分证据支持强身份处理组在群体身份任务中表现出更高凝聚力的群体中，导致背叛率下降。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107733.title: Do individualists and collectivists cooperate differently?
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107733.title_zh: 个人主义者与集体主义者的合作方式是否不同？

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107735.abstract: Many economic decisions affect other stakeholders, yet information about these consequences is often not directly available at the moment of choice and must instead be recalled from memory. Here, three studies examine how memory processes shape social behavior and whether their behavioral effects are better explained by motivated memory or rational accounts of memory allocation. In Study 1, participants made binary dictator-game decisions in which the consequences for themselves and another player were represented by pictures whose monetary outcomes had to be learned and later recalled from memory. Compared with the control condition in which all outcome information was available on the decision screen, participants chose less prosocially when decisions relied on memory. Studies 2 and 3 showed that prosocial choice in memory-based dictator games did not reliably increase either when strategic encoding of outcomes was made impossible or when accurate recall was monetarily incentivized. A structural model with a social utility function indicates that memory-based decisions reduce the weight placed on the other player’s outcome in unequal allocations that are advantageous to the dictator. Across choices, recall patterns, structural modeling, and individual differences, the results are most consistent with motivated forgetting during decision making: participants appear to selectively fail to retrieve information about social consequences when this information would make selfish choices harder to justify. These findings suggest that making consequences for other stakeholders salient at the moment of choice can promote socially beneficial behavior.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107735.abstract_zh: 许多经济决策会影响到其他利益相关者，然而在决策时刻，关于这些后果的信息往往无法直接获取，必须依赖记忆进行回忆。本研究通过三项实验探讨记忆过程如何塑造社会行为，并检验其行为效应是否更符合动机性记忆或理性记忆分配的解释。在研究1中，参与者进行二元独裁者博弈决策，其中对自身及另一玩家的后果以图片形式呈现，图片所对应的货币结果需先学习后回忆。与决策屏幕上所有结果信息均可见的控制条件相比，当决策依赖记忆时，参与者的亲社会选择减少。研究2和研究3表明，在基于记忆的独裁者博弈中，无论是使结果策略性编码变得不可能，还是对准确回忆给予金钱激励，亲社会选择均未可靠增加。一个包含社会效用函数的结构模型显示，基于记忆的决策降低了对独裁者有利的不平等分配中另一玩家结果的权重。综合选择行为、回忆模式、结构建模及个体差异的分析，结果最符合决策过程中的动机性遗忘：当关于社会后果的信息会使自私选择更难合理化时，参与者似乎选择性地未能检索这些信息。这些发现表明，在决策时刻凸显对其他利益相关者的后果，可以促进有益于社会的行为。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107735.title: Do you remember? Prosocial behavior declines in memory-based decisions
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107735.title_zh: 你记得吗？基于记忆的决策中亲社会行为会减少

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107736.abstract: We study a (rent-seeking) contest in which some players form syndicates and compete collectively, while others compete individually, to win a prize (or rent). A syndicate competes, as a single entity, with the other contestants to win the prize. The organizer of a syndicate chooses the syndicate’s effort level. The members of a syndicate share both the cost of effort and the prize (if it wins), according to the syndicate’s sharing rule. We first examine the profitability of being a syndicate member, assuming that the sizes of the syndicates are exogenously given. Then we consider the endogenous formation of syndicates and its effect on prize (or rent) dissipation. We show that, for any given number of players, there is a unique equilibrium size for the syndicate when only one syndicate is formed, and unique equilibrium sizes of the syndicates when two syndicates are formed. We also show that the endogenous formation of syndicates is beneficial both to the syndicate members and to the singletons, and the endogenous formation of syndicates reduces prize dissipation, compared with the individual (rent-seeking) contest.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107736.abstract_zh: 我们研究一种（寻租）竞赛，其中部分参与者组成辛迪加并集体竞争，而其他参与者则单独竞争，以赢得奖品（或租金）。一个辛迪加作为一个整体与其他参赛者竞争以赢得奖品。辛迪加的组织者选择该辛迪加的努力水平。辛迪加成员根据其分配规则，共同分担努力成本和奖品（若获胜）。我们首先考察成为辛迪加成员的盈利性，假设辛迪加的规模是外生给定的。随后，我们考虑辛迪加的内生形成及其对奖品（或租金）耗散的影响。我们证明，对于任意给定的参与者数量，当仅形成一个辛迪加时，存在唯一的均衡规模；当形成两个辛迪加时，存在唯一的均衡规模。我们还表明，辛迪加的内生形成对辛迪加成员和独立参与者均有益，并且与个人（寻租）竞赛相比，辛迪加的内生形成减少了奖品耗散。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107736.title: Endogenous syndicate formation in (rent-seeking) contests
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107736.title_zh: （寻租）竞赛中的内生辛迪加形成

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107747.abstract: The traditional deadweight-loss (DWL) formula rests on a usually unstated, strong assumption: that all other markets are undistorted. We extend the partial-equilibrium DWL formula to cases where the surplus in other markets is non-zero. It involves an additional term of the same order of magnitude as the DWL; this term does not go to zero even when the directly affected market is small relative to the rest of the economy. In examples, we show that the DWL may get the sign of the surplus change wrong when a substantial share of the economy is monopolized or subject to commodity taxes.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107747.abstract_zh: 传统的无谓损失（DWL）公式基于一个通常未明说的强假设：所有其他市场均无扭曲。我们将局部均衡的DWL公式扩展到其他市场剩余非零的情形。该扩展涉及一个与DWL同数量级的额外项；即使直接受影响的市场相对于经济整体规模很小，这一项也不会趋于零。通过实例，我们表明当经济中相当大比例被垄断或受商品税影响时，DWL可能错误地判断剩余变化的符号。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107747.title: A new partial-equilibrium approach to approximating the welfare effects of market power and taxes
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107747.title_zh: 市场势力与税收福利效应近似的一种新局部均衡方法

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107751.abstract: The two-step norm elicitation procedure (opinion-matching) is widely used to measure personal normative beliefs and incentivized normative expectations, yet little is known about how sensitive it is to common design variations. This study tests the robustness of the procedure by examining whether personal normative beliefs, normative expectations, and behaviour change when elements of the elicitation procedure are varied. Using an online dictator game with a four-point scale, the baseline treatment asks participants to evaluate the appropriateness of a fair allocation. Two treatments manipulate (i) the timing of elicitation (before vs. after the decision) and (ii) incentives for normative expectations, while (iii) a third treatment varies the scope by asking participants to evaluate two action subsets (fair and low-share allocations). Timing does not significantly affect behaviour, personal normative beliefs, or normative expectations, whereas incentivizing normative expectations improves the accuracy with which participants correctly identify the modal personal normative belief. Evaluating two action subsets does not significantly alter aggregate beliefs and expectations but reveals additional variation in how participants differentiate normative appropriateness across action subsets. Overall, the findings provide evidence of robustness to changes in elicitation timing and scope in environments with clear focal norms, while incentivization improves the accuracy of elicited normative expectations.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107751.abstract_zh: 两步规范引出程序（意见匹配法）被广泛用于测量个人规范信念和激励性规范预期，然而关于其对常见设计变异的敏感性知之甚少。本研究通过考察当引出程序的要素发生变化时，个人规范信念、规范预期和行为是否随之改变，来检验该程序的稳健性。采用带有四点量表的在线独裁者博弈，基线处理要求参与者评估公平分配的适当性。两项处理分别操纵（i）引出时机（决策前与决策后）和（ii）规范预期的激励措施，而（iii）第三项处理通过要求参与者评估两个行动子集（公平分配和低份额分配）来改变范围。时机对行为、个人规范信念或规范预期没有显著影响，而对规范预期进行激励则提高了参与者正确识别众数个人规范信念的准确性。评估两个行动子集并未显著改变总体信念和预期，但揭示了参与者在不同行动子集间区分规范适当性方面的额外变异。总体而言，研究结果提供了在具有明确焦点规范的环境中，引出时机和范围变化下程序稳健性的证据，而激励措施则提高了所引出规范预期的准确性。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107751.title: Variations in the two-step norm elicitation procedure: timing, incentives, and scope
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107751.title_zh: 两步规范引出程序中的变化：时机、激励与范围

10.1016/j.jeconom.2023.105558.abstract: Models defined by moment inequalities have become a standard modeling framework for empirical economists, spreading over a wide range of fields within economics. From the point of view of an empirical researcher, the literature on inference in moment inequality models is large and complex, including multiple survey papers that document the non-standard features these models possess, the main novel concepts behind inference in these models, and the most recent developments that bring advances in accuracy and computational tractability. In this paper we present a guide to empirical practice intended to help applied researchers navigate all the decisions required to frame a model as a moment inequality model and then to construct confidence intervals for the parameters of interest. We divide our template into four main steps: (a) a behavioral decision model, (b) moving from the decision model to a moment inequality model, (c) choosing a test statistic and critical value, and (d) accounting for computational challenges. We split each of these steps into a discussion of the “how” and the “why”, and then illustrate how to take these steps to practice in an empirical application that studies identification of expected sunk costs of offering a product in a market.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2023.105558.abstract_zh: 由矩不等式定义的模型已成为实证经济学家的标准建模框架，广泛覆盖经济学内的多个领域。从实证研究者的角度来看，关于矩不等式模型推断的文献庞大且复杂，包括多篇综述文章，这些文章记录了这些模型所具有的非标准特征、这些模型推断背后的主要新颖概念，以及带来准确性和计算可行性进步的最新发展。本文提供了一份实证实践指南，旨在帮助应用研究者应对将模型构建为矩不等式模型并随后为感兴趣参数构建置信区间所需的所有决策。我们将模板分为四个主要步骤：（a）行为决策模型，（b）从决策模型过渡到矩不等式模型，（c）选择检验统计量和临界值，以及（d）考虑计算挑战。我们将每个步骤分解为“如何做”和“为何这样做”的讨论，然后通过一个实证应用来展示如何将这些步骤付诸实践，该应用研究识别在市场中提供产品的预期沉没成本。

10.1016/j.jeconom.2024.105917.abstract: We employ a novel semiparametric Bayesian ordinal probit model to re-examine the relationships between age and life satisfaction (“happiness”) across countries and gender. Within our ordinal choice framework we introduce a new scheme for cutpoint simulation and develop a locally adaptive method for smoothing an otherwise erratic collection of age dummy variable coefficients. We find strong evidence that employment status is deeply intertwined with the reported happiness of men, that employment status is relatively more important for men than it is for women, and that the common use of quadratic models to report ages when happiness is minimized can produce inference that is inaccurate and misleadingly precise. We also find evidence that refines the “U”-shaped pattern between age and happiness that has been reported and/or debated in this literature: For men in most of the European countries we consider, happiness is found to rise sharply before traditional retirement age and then into the beginning of retirement, followed by a flattening or decline in the right-tail of the age distribution. Often-used models that are quadratic in age fail to reproduce this pattern and are frequently at odds with the data.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2024.105917.abstract_zh: 我们采用一种新颖的半参数贝叶斯有序概率模型，重新审视了不同国家和性别间年龄与生活满意度（“幸福感”）之间的关系。在我们的有序选择框架内，引入了一种新的切点模拟方案，并开发了一种局部自适应方法来平滑原本不稳定的年龄虚拟变量系数序列。我们发现强有力的证据表明，就业状态与男性报告的幸福感紧密相关，且就业状态对男性的重要性相对高于女性；同时，常用二次模型来报告幸福感最低点年龄的做法，可能导致推断不准确且误导性地精确。我们还发现了细化该文献中已报道或争论的年龄与幸福感之间“U”形模式的证据：在我们考察的大多数欧洲国家中，男性的幸福感在传统退休年龄前急剧上升，并延续至退休初期，随后在年龄分布的右尾部分趋于平缓或下降。常用的年龄二次模型无法重现这一模式，且常常与数据不符。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2024.105917.title: Semiparametric Bayesian estimation in an ordinal probit model with application to life satisfaction across countries, age and gender
10.1016/j.jeconom.2024.105917.title_zh: 基于有序Probit模型的半参数贝叶斯估计及其在国家、年龄和性别间生活满意度中的应用

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105949.abstract: In this paper we consider the simulation-based Bayesian analysis of stochastic volatility in mean (SVM) models. Extending the highly efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo mixture sampler for the SV model proposed in Kim et al. (1998) and Omori et al. (2007), we develop an accurate approximation of the logarithm of the non-central chi-squared distribution as a mixture of thirty normal distributions . Under this mixture representation, we sample the parameters and latent volatilities in one block. We also detail a correction of the small approximation error by using additional Metropolis–Hastings steps. The proposed method is extended to the SVM model with leverage. The methodology and models are applied to excess holding yields and S&P500 returns in empirical studies, and the SVM models are shown to outperform other volatility models based on marginal likelihoods.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105949.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了基于模拟的贝叶斯分析在随机波动率均值（SVM）模型中的应用。通过扩展Kim等人（1998）及Omori等人（2007）提出的针对SV模型的高效马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛混合抽样方法，我们开发了一种精确近似非中心卡方分布对数的方法，将其表示为三十个正态分布的混合形式。在此混合表示下，我们实现了参数与潜在波动率的联合分块抽样。同时，我们详细阐述了通过附加Metropolis-Hastings步骤来修正微小近似误差的方法，并将所提方法扩展至包含杠杆效应的SVM模型。在实证研究中，我们将该方法与模型应用于超额持有收益率及标普500指数收益率，结果表明基于边际似然比较，SVM模型优于其他波动率模型。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105949.title: Stochastic volatility in mean: Efficient analysis by a generalized mixture sampler
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105949.title_zh: 均值随机波动率：基于广义混合抽样器的高效分析

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105955.abstract: High-dimensional matrix-valued time-series are increasingly common in economics and finance. Prominent examples include large cross-region panels and dynamic economic networks. As the dimensions of the matrix grow, conventional approaches based on vector autoregressions—implemented by vectoring the matrix-valued data—become computationally infeasible. We introduce a class of large Bayesian matrix autoregressions (BMARs) that can accommodate time-varying volatility, non-Gaussian errors and COVID-19 outliers. To tackle parameter proliferation, we propose Minnesota-type shrinkage priors on the MAR coefficients. We develop a unified approach for estimating this class of models, which scales well to high dimensions. The empirical relevance of these new BMARs is illustrated using a US state-level dataset that contains 6 macroeconomic times-series for each of the 50 states, with a total of 300 times-series.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105955.abstract_zh: 高维矩阵值时间序列在经济学和金融领域日益普遍。典型例子包括大规模跨区域面板数据和动态经济网络。随着矩阵维度的增长，基于向量自回归的传统方法——通过将矩阵值数据向量化实现——在计算上变得不可行。我们引入了一类大规模贝叶斯矩阵自回归模型（BMARs），该模型能够适应时变波动性、非高斯误差以及COVID-19异常值。为应对参数激增问题，我们提出了针对MAR系数的明尼苏达型收缩先验。我们开发了一种统一的方法来估计这类模型，该方法能良好地扩展到高维情形。通过一个包含美国各州层面数据集的实证研究，我们展示了这些新型BMARs的实际应用价值，该数据集涵盖50个州各6个宏观经济时间序列，总计300个时间序列。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105955.title: Large Bayesian matrix autoregressions
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105955.title_zh: 大型贝叶斯矩阵自回归

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105978.abstract: This paper provides a theoretical justification for the Deviance Information Criterion (DIC) as a Bayesian model selection tool using MCMC output. Unlike Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) and Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC), which balance model adequacy against complexity without considering prior information, DIC incorporates priors into this trade-off. The contributions of this paper are two-fold. First, it demonstrates that when a plug-in predictive distribution — obtained by substituting parameter values with their optimal estimates to yield the plug-in estimated sampling distribution — is used under a set of regularity conditions, the DIC serves as an asymptotically unbiased estimator of the expected Kullback–Leibler divergence between the data-generating process and the plug-in predictive distribution. Second, it develops higher-order expansions for DIC and the effective number of parameters, highlighting the effect of the priors. We employ DIC to compare discrete-choice models, stochastic frontier models, and copula models in three empirical applications; the results align with theoretical expectations, showing the utility of DIC as a versatile tool outperforming the traditional model selection criteria. It is found that the logit model is better than the probit model for investigating the marginal effects of parents’ education on children’s completion of high school. Additionally, the stochastic frontier model with an exponential distribution better fits electricity utility data than the normal distribution. Finally, the chosen copula models for S&P index returns exhibit heavy tails and strong tail dependence. By modelling the effect of priors through higher order expansions, we also find the above empirical models outperforming their benchmark counterparts in terms of predictive accuracy.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105978.abstract_zh: 本文为偏差信息准则（DIC）作为基于MCMC输出的贝叶斯模型选择工具提供了理论依据。与赤池信息准则（AIC）和贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）不同，后者在平衡模型拟合度与复杂度时未考虑先验信息，而DIC则将先验纳入这一权衡之中。本文的贡献有两方面。首先，它证明了在一定的正则条件下，当使用插件预测分布——即通过将参数值替换为其最优估计以得到插件估计的抽样分布——时，DIC可作为数据生成过程与插件预测分布之间期望Kullback–Leibler散度的渐近无偏估计量。其次，本文发展了DIC和有效参数数目的高阶展开式，突显了先验的影响。我们在三个实证应用中采用DIC比较离散选择模型、随机前沿模型和copula模型；结果与理论预期一致，展示了DIC作为一种多功能工具优于传统模型选择准则的实用性。研究发现，在考察父母教育对子女完成高中教育的边际效应时，logit模型优于probit模型。此外，具有指数分布的随机前沿模型比正态分布更好地拟合了电力公用事业数据。最后，针对S&P指数收益所选的copula模型表现出重尾和强尾部依赖性。通过高阶展开对先验效应进行建模，我们还发现上述实证模型在预测准确性方面优于其基准对应模型。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105978.title: Deviance Information Criterion for Bayesian model selection: Theoretical justification and applications
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105978.title_zh: 贝叶斯模型选择的偏差信息准则：理论依据与应用

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106050.abstract: This paper introduces a Bayesian framework designed to address two critical econometric challenges in empirical growth studies: variable selection and cross-sectional dependence. We first propose a growth regression model that incorporates cross-sectional dependence through a multi-factor structure and accounts for variable selection with sparse coefficients. We then introduce a new Bayesian Adaptive LASSO estimator specifically designed for this model, capable of performing variable selection while simultaneously addressing cross-sectional dependence. To validate this framework, we conduct a Monte Carlo study, demonstrating that our Adaptive Bayesian LASSO growth regression model with a factor structure consistently outperforms three benchmark models across all evaluation metrics. Furthermore, we apply our model to a dataset encompassing 55 candidate variables across 71 countries from 1961 to 2019. Our empirical comparison confirms the superiority of our model over the benchmark models. Additionally, our model identifies five global factors and 16 key growth determinants, with robustness checks using Principal Component Analysis and instrumental variables confirming the reliability of our findings.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106050.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯框架，旨在解决实证增长研究中两个关键计量经济学挑战：变量选择与横截面依赖性。我们首先构建了一个增长回归模型，该模型通过多因子结构纳入横截面依赖性，并利用稀疏系数处理变量选择问题。随后，我们引入了一种专为此模型设计的新型贝叶斯自适应LASSO估计器，该估计器能够在处理横截面依赖性的同时执行变量选择。为验证此框架，我们进行了蒙特卡洛研究，结果表明，带有因子结构的自适应贝叶斯LASSO增长回归模型在所有评估指标上均持续优于三个基准模型。此外，我们将该模型应用于涵盖1961年至2019年间71个国家55个候选变量的数据集。实证比较进一步证实了我们的模型相对于基准模型的优越性。同时，我们的模型识别出五个全球因子和16个关键增长决定因素，并通过主成分分析和工具变量的稳健性检验确认了研究结果的可靠性。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106050.title: A Bayesian approach to modeling economic growth: Variable selection and cross-sectional dependence
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106050.title_zh: 贝叶斯方法在经济建模中的应用：变量选择与截面依赖

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106066.abstract: We develop a transparent Bayesian framework to measure uncertainty in asset pricing models. By assigning a modified class of g -priors to the risk prices of asset pricing factors, our method quantifies the trade-off between mean–variance efficiency and parsimony for asset pricing models to achieve high posterior probabilities. Model uncertainty is defined as the entropy of these model probabilities. We prove the model selection consistency property of our procedure, which is missing from the classic g -priors. Acknowledging the possibility of omitting true asset pricing factors in real applications, we also characterize the maximum degree of contamination that the omitted factors can introduce to our model uncertainty measure. Empirically, we find that model uncertainty escalates during major market events and carries a significantly negative risk premium of approximately half the magnitude of the market. Positive shocks to model uncertainty predict persistent outflows from US equity funds and inflows to Treasury funds.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106066.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个透明的贝叶斯框架，用以度量资产定价模型中的不确定性。通过为资产定价因子的风险价格分配一类修正的g-先验，我们的方法量化了资产定价模型在均值-方差效率与简约性之间的权衡，以实现较高的后验概率。模型不确定性被定义为这些模型概率的熵。我们证明了该过程的模型选择一致性性质，而这一性质在经典g-先验中是缺失的。考虑到实际应用中可能遗漏真实资产定价因子，我们还刻画了遗漏因子可能对我们的模型不确定性度量引入的最大污染程度。实证上，我们发现模型不确定性在重大市场事件期间显著上升，并带有约为市场风险溢价一半幅度的显著负风险溢价。模型不确定性的正向冲击预示着美国股票基金出现持续性资金流出，以及国债基金的资金流入。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106066.title: Model uncertainty in the cross-section of stock returns
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106066.title_zh: 股票收益率截面中的模型不确定性

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106067.abstract: This paper addresses the non-standard problem of detecting multiple structural breaks when the data-generating model in each regime is uncertain, with an application to factor selection in empirical asset pricing. Detection is based on the marginal likelihood of break points, obtained by a novel integration over all possible pairings of models across regimes, from all possible models within regimes. The optimal break points maximize this marginal likelihood. Applying this method to the six Fama–French factors on monthly data from 1963–2023, the analysis identifies three breaks – 1982, 1998, and 2009 – and a shift toward more parsimonious models after 1998. Before 1998, five or six factors are selected, but two afterward. Thus, with breaks, there is a move to parsimony, which has implications for the factor zoo literature. Moreover, within each regime, all omitted factors are spanned by the ones selected. Incorporating breaks also leads to substantially different weight allocations in the maximum Sharpe ratio risk factor portfolio.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106067.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了当每个制度下的数据生成模型不确定时，检测多重结构断点的非标准问题，并将其应用于实证资产定价中的因子选择。检测基于断点的边际似然，通过一种新颖的积分方法，对所有可能的跨制度模型配对及制度内所有可能的模型进行整合。最优断点最大化这一边际似然。将该方法应用于1963年至2023年月度数据中的六个Fama-French因子，分析识别出三个断点——1982年、1998年和2009年——并观察到1998年后模型趋向更简洁。1998年前，选择五或六个因子，但之后仅选两个。因此，随着断点的出现，模型转向简约，这对因子动物园文献具有启示意义。此外，在每个制度内，所有被省略的因子均被所选因子所涵盖。纳入断点还导致最大夏普比率风险因子组合中的权重分配发生显著变化。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106067.title: Structural breaks, model uncertainty and factor selection
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106067.title_zh: 结构突变、模型不确定性与因子选择

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106072.abstract: There is an increasing interest in applying variational Bayes techniques to estimating large Bayesian vector autoregressions (VARs) with stochastic volatility. However, less attention has been paid to the development of appropriate tools for comparing these high-dimensional models, especially among those designed to address COVID-19 outliers. This paper develops a marginal likelihood estimator that combines importance sampling and variational approximation for comparing large VARs with different time-varying volatility specifications and outlier adjustments. Through a Monte Carlo study, we show that the proposed approach is fast and able to identify the correct models. The effectiveness of the proposed method is further illustrated through an empirical application of comparing a variety of 180-variable VARs.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106072.abstract_zh: 将变分贝叶斯技术应用于估计具有随机波动性的大规模贝叶斯向量自回归（VAR）模型，正引起越来越多的关注。然而，对于开发适当的工具来比较这些高维模型，尤其是那些旨在处理COVID-19异常值的模型，关注相对较少。本文提出了一种边际似然估计器，结合重要性抽样与变分近似，用于比较具有不同时变波动性设定和异常值调整的大规模VAR模型。通过蒙特卡洛研究，我们展示了所提方法快速且能够识别正确模型。所提方法的有效性进一步通过一个包含180个变量的多种VAR模型比较的实证应用得到验证。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106072.title: Bayesian model comparison for large Bayesian VARs after the COVID-19 pandemic
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106072.title_zh: COVID-19疫情后大型贝叶斯向量自回归模型的贝叶斯模型比较

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106075.abstract: Quantifying the economic impacts of weather variables has been a key empirical topic in understanding the impacts of climate change. While panel methods, which utilize cross-sectional differences in within-unit over-time changes in weather variables, have been widely used to credibly identify the average effect of interest, there has been a growing interest in understanding the distribution of potentially heterogeneous weather effects. The heterogeneity of the effects across space and time, which can shed light on the differences in the local capacity of adaptation across regions or its evolution over time, provides important insights into developing climate policies. In this paper, we propose a novel Bayesian hierarchical modeling approach to estimate heterogeneous effects of weather variables using panel data. Our proposed approach models space–time varying coefficients via Gaussian process priors. Using the data of the corn yield from the US corn belt, we show that our proposed model outperforms several alternatives. Our findings are consistent with the literature and also provide additional insights into the localized nuances of climate change adaptation.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106075.abstract_zh: 量化天气变量的经济影响一直是理解气候变化影响的关键实证课题。尽管利用截面差异中单位内随时间变化的天气变量的面板方法已被广泛用于可信地识别感兴趣的平均效应，但近年来，对于理解潜在异质性天气效应的分布，兴趣日益增长。这些效应在空间和时间上的异质性，能够揭示各地区适应能力的差异或其随时间的演变，为制定气候政策提供了重要见解。本文提出了一种新颖的贝叶斯层次建模方法，利用面板数据估计天气变量的异质性效应。我们提出的方法通过高斯过程先验对时空变化系数进行建模。利用美国玉米带玉米产量的数据，我们展示了所提模型优于几种替代方法。我们的发现与现有文献一致，并为气候变化适应的局部细微差别提供了额外见解。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106075.title: Bayesian space–time varying coefficient modeling for climate econometrics: A spatial–temporal Gaussian process approach
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106075.title_zh: 气候计量经济学中的贝叶斯时空变系数建模：一种时空高斯过程方法

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106081.abstract: We propose kernel estimators for the densities of persistent and transient inefficiencies in a generalized panel data stochastic frontier model. This approach relaxes the conventional distributional assumptions imposed on the inefficiencies, thereby increasing robustness. A Bayesian sampling algorithm is developed to estimate all model parameters and unobserved entities, as well as the bandwidths needed to construct the densities of persistent and transient inefficiencies. The advantages of our estimator and sampling algorithm are demonstrated through numerical studies based on pseudo-samples. We find that our estimation approach outperforms conventional Bayesian estimation, providing more accurate estimates of firm-level inefficiencies. We also apply the approach to analyze the cost frontier and related characteristics for a panel of large US commercial banks, and discuss differences relative to the traditional Bayesian framework. Our estimator reveals that the high-density region of transient inefficiency varies over time, whereas the conventional approach does not possess such a feature. Moreover, the contribution of persistent inefficiency to the total inefficiency revealed by our approach is slightly more than half of that suggested by the conventional framework.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106081.abstract_zh: 我们针对广义面板数据随机前沿模型中的持久性与暂时性无效率密度，提出了核估计方法。该方法放宽了对无效率项的传统分布假设，从而增强了稳健性。我们开发了一种贝叶斯采样算法，用以估计所有模型参数、未观测实体以及构建持久性和暂时性无效率密度所需的带宽。通过基于伪样本的数值研究，我们展示了所提估计器及采样算法的优势。研究发现，我们的估计方法优于传统贝叶斯估计，能更精确地估计企业层面的无效率。我们还应用该方法分析了一组大型美国商业银行的成本前沿及相关特征，并讨论了与传统贝叶斯框架的差异。我们的估计器揭示，暂时性无效率的高密度区域随时间变化，而传统方法不具备此特性。此外，我们方法揭示的持久性无效率对总无效率的贡献，略高于传统框架所建议的一半。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106081.title: Bayesian estimation of a semiparametric stochastic frontier model with persistent and transient inefficiencies
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106081.title_zh: 具有持久性和暂时性低效率的半参数随机前沿模型的贝叶斯估计

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106085.abstract: We propose a semiparametric Bayesian estimator for copula density, formulated as a generalized exponential family that combines a parametric baseline copula with a flexible adjustment modeled by a Gaussian Process (GP). The baseline captures the main features of dependence and accommodates possibly unbounded densities, while the GP component introduces nonparametric refinement. To modulate the influence of the baseline, we further introduce a tuning parameter that adjusts its weight in the final estimate. Both the GP hyperparameters and this tuning parameter are inferred jointly within a Bayesian framework. We also present a posterior sampler based on importance sampling, with the baseline copula serving as a natural approximating distribution. Simulations demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed estimator and the efficiency of the sampler. The method is further illustrated with an application to commodity futures markets.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106085.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于连接函数密度的半参数贝叶斯估计器，其形式化为广义指数族，结合了参数基线连接函数与由高斯过程（GP）建模的灵活调整项。基线部分捕捉依赖关系的主要特征，并能适应可能无界的密度，而GP成分则引入非参数细化。为了调节基线的影响，我们进一步引入一个调谐参数，以调整其在最终估计中的权重。GP超参数与该调谐参数均在贝叶斯框架内联合推断。我们还提出了一种基于重要性抽样的后验采样器，以基线连接函数作为自然的近似分布。模拟实验证明了所提估计器的有效性及采样器的效率。该方法进一步应用于商品期货市场的实例中加以说明。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106085.title: A semiparametric Bayesian estimator of copula density
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106085.title_zh: copula密度的半参数贝叶斯估计量

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106098.abstract: This paper studies mutual fund performance evaluation, where non-random missing data is an important issue. Ignoring sample selection issues can lead to biased parameter estimates and invalid performance evaluation. Therefore, we propose a novel Beta selection model to characterize this non-random missingness mechanism. We can significantly reduce the bias in alpha estimates, by introducing our Beta selection mechanism into the Noise-Reduced Alpha (NRA) model of Harvey and Liu (2018). A computationally attractive Bayesian estimation procedure is also provided. Simulation results show that our proposed method achieves superior finite-sample performance compared to classical fund-by-fund ordinary least squares (OLS) and the baseline NRA model. Finally, we apply our method to Chinese mutual fund data, and find that: (i) our out-of-sample alpha forecasts exhibit greater predictive accuracy across all tested missingness rates; (ii) approximately 18% of funds exhibit statistically significant positive alphas, suggesting market-beating skill; and (iii) portfolios constructed using our method deliver significantly higher returns than those using alternative approaches.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106098.abstract_zh: 本文研究共同基金业绩评估问题，其中非随机缺失数据是一个重要议题。忽视样本选择问题可能导致参数估计偏差及业绩评估失效。为此，我们提出一种新颖的Beta选择模型来刻画这一非随机缺失机制。通过将我们的Beta选择机制引入Harvey和Liu（2018）的噪声削减Alpha（NRA）模型，我们能够显著降低Alpha估计的偏差。同时，我们提供了一种计算上具有吸引力的贝叶斯估计方法。模拟结果表明，与传统的逐基金普通最小二乘法（OLS）及基线NRA模型相比，我们提出的方法在有限样本下表现出更优的性能。最后，我们将该方法应用于中国共同基金数据，发现：（i）在所有测试的缺失率下，我们的样本外Alpha预测具有更高的预测准确性；（ii）约18%的基金展现出统计上显著的正Alpha，表明存在超越市场的技能；（iii）使用我们方法构建的投资组合相比其他方法能获得显著更高的回报。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106098.title: Bayesian evaluation of mutual fund performance with non-random missing data: Application to the Chinese market
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106098.title_zh: 非随机缺失数据下共同基金绩效的贝叶斯评估：中国市场应用

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106107.abstract: We consider structural vector autoregressions that are identified through stochastic volatility under Bayesian estimation. Three contributions emerge from our exercise. First, we show that a non-centred parameterization of stochastic volatility yields a marginal prior for the conditional variances of structural shocks that is centred on homoskedasticity, with strong shrinkage and heavy tails—unlike the common centred parameterization. This feature makes it well suited for assessing partial identification of any shock of interest. Second, Monte Carlo experiments on small and large systems indicate that the non-centred setup estimates structural parameters more precisely and normalizes conditional variances efficiently. Third, revisiting prominent fiscal structural vector autoregressions, we show how the non-centred approach identifies tax shocks that are consistent with estimates reported in the literature.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106107.abstract_zh: 我们考虑在贝叶斯估计下通过随机波动率识别的结构向量自回归模型。我们的研究贡献有三点。首先，我们展示了随机波动率的非中心参数化能为结构冲击的条件方差产生一个以同方差性为中心的先验边际分布，该分布具有强收缩和重尾特性——这与常见的中心参数化不同。这一特性使其非常适合评估任何感兴趣冲击的部分识别。其次，针对小型和大型系统的蒙特卡洛实验表明，非中心设定能更精确地估计结构参数，并有效规范化条件方差。第三，重新审视著名的财政结构向量自回归模型，我们展示了非中心方法如何识别出与文献中报告估计一致的税收冲击。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106107.title: Partial identification of structural vector autoregressions with non-centred stochastic volatility
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106107.title_zh: 非中心随机波动下结构向量自回归的部分识别

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106109.abstract: This paper introduces a novel econometric framework for identifying and modeling bank business models (BBMs), which dynamically evolve in response to changing financial and economic conditions. Building on the stochastic frontier literature, we extend the traditional cost-efficiency models by decomposing inefficiency into persistent and transient components. We propose a Bayesian nonparametric approach that adapts to the data through an infinite mixture model with predictor-dependent clustering, enabling a flexible classification of banks into distinct business models. Our method, based on the Logit Stick-Breaking Process (LSBP), provides a data-driven way to capture the heterogeneity in bank strategies, allowing for dynamic transitions between business models over time. This model offers a significant advancement over existing parametric and kernel-based approaches by combining the scalability of nonparametric methods with efficient computational routines. We apply the model to a dataset of European banks and identify four distinct business model clusters, providing novel insights into the evolution of bank performance and efficiency. Our findings contribute to the growing literature on the identification and measurement of bank business models, offering valuable implications for policy and regulatory frameworks.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106109.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的计量经济学框架，用于识别和建模银行商业模式（BBMs），这些模式随着金融和经济条件的变化而动态演变。基于随机前沿文献，我们通过将无效率分解为持久性和暂时性成分，扩展了传统的成本效率模型。我们提出了一种贝叶斯非参数方法，该方法通过具有预测变量依赖聚类的无限混合模型适应数据，从而能够灵活地将银行分类为不同的商业模式。我们的方法基于Logit Stick-Breaking过程（LSBP），提供了一种数据驱动的方式来捕捉银行策略的异质性，允许商业模式随时间动态转换。该模型通过结合非参数方法的可扩展性与高效的计算程序，相较于现有的参数化和核基方法实现了显著进步。我们将该模型应用于一组欧洲银行的数据集，识别出四个不同的商业模式集群，为银行绩效和效率的演变提供了新颖见解。我们的发现为日益增长的银行商业模式识别与测量文献做出了贡献，并为政策和监管框架提供了有价值的启示。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106109.title: Bayesian nonparametric inference in bank business models with transient and persistent cost inefficiency
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106109.title_zh: 银行经营模型中具有暂时性和持续性成本无效率的贝叶斯非参数推断

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106146.abstract: The Heterogeneous AutoRegressive model for the logs of Realised Volatility (HARL) has established itself as the benchmark specification for modelling and forecasting return volatility, owing to its parsimony and ability to capture the strong persistence typically observed in RV. To address potential concerns such as measurement errors, nonlinearities, and non-spherical residuals, numerous variants of the baseline HARL model have been developed in the literature. This paper contributes to this body of work by proposing a new class of dynamic state-space models with time-varying parameters. The parameter dynamics are assumed to follow an autoregressive process, with or without stochastic volatility, giving rise to two specifications: SHARP and SHARP-SV. Both models are designed to capture the evolving nature of return volatility and are estimated via Bayesian inference using Particle Gibbs sampling. Empirical applications to high-frequency data on SPY, sector ETFs, representative NYSE stocks, and the VIX index demonstrate that our proposed models on average outperform alternative HARL-based specifications in forecasting volatility, particularly at medium- and long-term horizons. An extensive Monte Carlo analysis further illustrates the advantages of our approach in terms of both estimation accuracy and predictive performance.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106146.abstract_zh: 基于已实现波动率（RV）对数的异质自回归模型（HARL）因其简洁性及捕捉RV中通常观察到的强持续性的能力，已成为建模和预测收益波动率的基准规范。为解决测量误差、非线性及非球形残差等潜在问题，文献中已发展出多种基线HARL模型的变体。本文通过提出一类具有时变参数的新动态状态空间模型，为该领域研究做出贡献。参数动态被假定遵循自回归过程，可包含或不包含随机波动性，由此产生两种规格：SHARP和SHARP-SV。两种模型均旨在捕捉收益波动率的演变特性，并通过使用粒子吉布斯抽样的贝叶斯推断进行估计。对SPY、行业ETF、代表性纽交所股票及VIX指数的高频数据实证应用表明，我们提出的模型在预测波动率方面平均优于其他基于HARL的规格，尤其是在中期和长期预测区间。广泛的蒙特卡洛分析进一步展示了我们方法在估计精度和预测性能方面的优势。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106146.title: A dynamic state-space HAR model

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106163.abstract: Economic analysis based on text data has expanded rapidly, yet the ultra-high dimensionality of text data presents substantial challenges for term selection and estimation. We propose the Information-Adaptive Lasso and Information-Adaptive Spike-and-Slab Lasso as novel frequentist and Bayesian approaches to address these challenges. A key theoretical contribution of this study is the establishment of the rate of convergence in term-selection consistency, which we show to be faster than those achieved in the existing Lasso literature. Applying our methods to Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) statements, we identify and estimate high-impact terms driving fluctuations in monetary policy uncertainty.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106163.abstract_zh: 基于文本数据的经济分析发展迅速，然而文本数据的超高维度给术语选择和估计带来了巨大挑战。我们提出了信息自适应Lasso和信息自适应尖峰- slab Lasso，作为应对这些挑战的新型频率学派和贝叶斯方法。本研究的一个关键理论贡献是确立了术语选择一致性的收敛速率，我们证明该速率快于现有Lasso文献中所达到的速率。将我们的方法应用于联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）声明，我们识别并估计了驱动货币政策不确定性波动的高影响力术语。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106163.title: Text-term selection and analysis: Frequentist and Bayesian strategies and interpretations
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106163.title_zh: 文本项选择与分析：频率学派与贝叶斯策略及解释

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106190.abstract: In this article, we examine the foundations of a rich and diverse literature in economics and derive the likelihood function of simultaneous equation models for discrete data as the invariant distribution of a suitably specified Markov process. This formulation offers a well-defined reduced form of the model and dispenses with the need for controversial recursivity requirements and ad hoc indeterminacy rules. The derivation resolves puzzling paradoxes highlighted in earlier work and shows that the likelihood is unique, proper, coherent, complete, and theoretically grounded in conditional distribution modeling – a framework that has yet to be popularized in economics. We note possible extensions and relevant links with other models, comment on computational issues, and implement the methodology in three empirical applications involving female labor force participation, the interactions between health and wealth, and the interplay between banks’ lending practices and their reliance on assistance from the lender of last resort during the Great Depression.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106190.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们探讨了经济学中一个丰富且多元文献的基础，并推导了离散数据联立方程模型的似然函数，将其视为一个适当设定的马尔可夫过程的不变分布。这一表述为模型提供了一个明确的简化形式，并免除了对有争议的递归性要求和临时性不确定性规则的需求。该推导解决了早期研究中突出的令人困惑的悖论，并表明似然函数是唯一的、恰当的、连贯的、完整的，并且在理论上基于条件分布建模——这一框架在经济学中尚未普及。我们指出了可能的扩展方向及与其他模型的相关联系，讨论了计算问题，并在三个实证应用中实施了该方法，涉及女性劳动力参与、健康与财富之间的相互作用，以及大萧条期间银行贷款行为与对最后贷款人援助依赖之间的互动。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106190.title: Likelihood specification in simultaneous equation models for discrete data
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106190.title_zh: 离散数据联立方程模型中的似然设定

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106216.abstract: Variable correlations pose significant challenges for various LASSO-type shrinkage methods in big-data modeling. This paper presents a comprehensive framework for a correlation-robust shrinkage estimator, enhancing both the theoretical and practical aspects of high-dimensional estimation. We break down the penalty term into a “shrinkage” term and a “grouping” term, illustrating its distinctive properties in clustering highly correlated variables. We establish the (non-)asymptotic properties of this estimator under relaxed assumptions regarding mixing conditions and heavier-tailed distributions. Furthermore, we demonstrate the consistency of model selection under mild conditions. Additionally, we propose a debiased version of the estimator, proving its asymptotic normality. Simulated data indicate that the debiased estimator surpasses traditional benchmarks. In an empirical application, we use this debiased estimator to identify key Economic Policy Uncertainty (EPU) factors that account for inflation levels. Our findings imply that news-based EPU factors are essential in explaining CPI dynamics.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106216.abstract_zh: 变量相关性在大数据建模中对各类LASSO型收缩方法构成了显著挑战。本文提出了一个针对相关性稳健收缩估计量的综合框架，增强了高维估计的理论与实践层面。我们将惩罚项分解为“收缩”项与“分组”项，展示了其在聚类高度相关变量方面的独特性质。在关于混合条件及重尾分布的宽松假设下，我们确立了该估计量的（非）渐近性质。此外，我们证明了在温和条件下模型选择的一致性。同时，我们提出了一种去偏版本的估计量，并证明了其渐近正态性。模拟数据表明，该去偏估计量优于传统基准。在实证应用中，我们利用此去偏估计量识别了影响通胀水平的关键经济政策不确定性（EPU）因素。我们的研究结果表明，基于新闻的EPU因素在解释CPI动态中至关重要。

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106218.abstract: Observation-driven models for time series have a long history in statistics and econometrics, but are typically studied under the assumption of correct dynamic specification. We develop an in-fill asymptotic framework to study the limiting behavior of the estimated (i.e., filtered) time-varying parameter paths obtained with such models in (severely) mis-specified settings. We show that despite such mis-specification, the filtered paths, particularly those from the class of score-driven models of Creal et al. (2011, 2013) and Harvey (2013), still converge in probability to the Kullback-Leibler optimal time-varying parameter paths, even in severely mis-specified settings. We obtain distributional convergence results for the filtering errors and formulate the observation-driven filter that minimizes the asymptotic filter error variance. Such an optimal filter again has score-driven features. The results substantially generalize earlier findings, which we demonstrate by applying the new theory to time-varying tail shape models, dynamic copulas, and time-varying regression models. We further highlight the practical relevance of the asymptotic results by using them to construct pointwise intervals that quantify the uncertainty of filtered parameter paths based on observation-driven filters and apply these to the volatility path of intraday Pfizer log-returns.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106218.abstract_zh: 时间序列的观测驱动模型在统计学和计量经济学中有着悠久的历史，但通常是在正确动态设定的假设下进行研究。我们发展了一个填充渐近框架，以研究在（严重）误设定情形下，此类模型所估计（即滤波）的时变参数路径的极限行为。我们表明，尽管存在这种误设定，滤波路径——尤其是来自Creal等人（2011, 2013）和Harvey（2013）的得分驱动模型类——即使在严重误设定情形下，仍以概率收敛于Kullback-Leibler最优时变参数路径。我们获得了滤波误差的分布收敛结果，并构建了最小化渐近滤波误差方差的观测驱动滤波器。这种最优滤波器同样具有得分驱动的特征。这些结果大幅推广了早期发现，我们通过将新理论应用于时变尾部形状模型、动态copula和时变回归模型来加以证明。我们进一步通过利用这些渐近结果构建点态区间来突出其实践相关性，这些区间量化了基于观测驱动滤波器的滤波参数路径的不确定性，并将其应用于辉瑞公司日内对数收益的波动率路径。

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106221.abstract: We use long-run annual cross-country data for 10 macroeconomic variables to evaluate the long-horizon forecast distributions of six forecasting models. The variables we use range from ones having little serial correlation to ones having persistence consistent with unit roots. Our forecasting models include simple time series models and frequency domain models developed in Müller and Watson (2016). For plausibly stationary variables, an AR(1) model and a frequency domain model that does not require the user to take a stand on the order of integration appear reasonably well calibrated for forecast horizons of 10 and 25 years. For plausibly non-stationary variables, a random walk model appears reasonably well calibrated for forecast horizons of 10 and 25 years.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106221.abstract_zh: 我们利用10个宏观经济变量的长期年度跨国数据，评估了六种预测模型在长预测期下的分布预测表现。所采用的变量范围从序列相关性极低到具有单位根一致性的持续性不等。我们的预测模型包括简单时间序列模型以及Müller和Watson（2016）提出的频域模型。对于可能平稳的变量，AR(1)模型和一种无需用户对积分阶数做出明确假设的频域模型，在10年和25年的预测期下，校准效果表现合理。对于可能非平稳的变量，随机游走模型在10年和25年的预测期下，校准效果同样表现合理。

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106230.abstract: Macro-prudential policymakers face a risk-management problem: they must assess medium-term downside risks to the real economy stemming from financial imbalances and the associated threat of future financial crises, while accounting for the cost of policy interventions in terms of foregone upside potential. This trade-off between limiting downside risks and preserving upside growth is inherently asymmetric and depends on the distribution of future macroeconomic outcomes. We formalize this decision problem by defining novel measures of downside risk and upside potential and by stipulating an explicit loss function for macro-prudential policy. To evaluate policy in this setting, we develop and apply a novel Bayesian structural quantile vector autoregressive model that delivers flexible and potentially asymmetric predictive distributions. Using quantile impulse responses, we assess the scope for macro-prudential policy to reduce growth volatility and negative skewness, infer the macro-prudential policy stance, and characterize the circumstances under which macro-prudential interventions are likely to be beneficial.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106230.abstract_zh: 宏观审慎政策制定者面临一个风险管理问题：他们必须评估由金融失衡及其引发的未来金融危机威胁所导致的实体经济中期下行风险，同时考虑政策干预在放弃上行潜力方面的成本。这种在限制下行风险与保留上行增长之间的权衡本质上是不对称的，并取决于未来宏观经济结果的分布。我们通过定义新的下行风险与上行潜力度量指标，并规定宏观审慎政策的显式损失函数，将这一决策问题形式化。为在此背景下评估政策，我们开发并应用了一种新颖的贝叶斯结构分位数向量自回归模型，该模型能够提供灵活且可能不对称的预测分布。利用分位数脉冲响应，我们评估了宏观审慎政策在降低增长波动性和负偏度方面的空间，推断宏观审慎政策立场，并刻画了宏观审慎干预可能有益的情形。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106230.title: Macro-prudential policy under asymmetric risks: A Bayesian structural quantile VAR approach
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106230.title_zh: 非对称风险下的宏观审慎政策：基于贝叶斯结构分位数VAR方法

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106231.abstract: This paper studies the limiting behavior of the test for instrument exogeneity in linear models when there is uncertainty about the strength of the identification signal. We consider the test for conditional moment restrictions with an expanding set of constructed instruments. We establish the uniform validity of the standard normal asymptotic approximation, under the null, of this specification test over all possible degrees of model identification. As a result, this allows the researcher to use standard inference for testing instrument exogeneity without the need of any prior knowledge if the instruments are strong, semi-strong, weak or completely irrelevant. Furthermore, we show that the test is consistent regardless of the instrument strength; i.e., even in cases (weak and completely irrelevant instruments) where the standard tests fail to exhibit asymptotic power. To obtain these results, we characterize the rate of the estimator under a drifting sequence for the identification signal. We illustrate the appealing properties of the test in simulations and an empirical application.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106231.abstract_zh: 本文研究了当识别信号强度存在不确定性时，线性模型中工具变量外生性检验的极限行为。我们考虑在构造工具变量集不断扩大的情况下，对条件矩约束进行检验。我们确立了在原假设下，该设定检验的标准正态渐近近似在所有可能的模型识别程度上均具有统一有效性。因此，这使得研究者无需事先了解工具变量是强、半强、弱还是完全不相关，即可使用标准推断来检验工具外生性。此外，我们证明无论工具强度如何，该检验都是一致的；即，即使在标准检验无法展现渐近功效的情况下（如弱工具和完全不相关工具），该检验依然有效。为获得这些结果，我们刻画了在识别信号漂移序列下估计量的速率。我们通过模拟和实证应用展示了该检验的优良性质。

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106238.abstract: We develop a Bayesian Wald-type test for detecting temporal differences in connectedness from variance decompositions, and establish the asymptotic normality of impulse response functions and variance decomposition matrices at fixed local time points. The resulting test statistic is asymptotically χ 2 distributed under the null hypothesis and performs well in Monte Carlo simulations. Applying our methodology to high-frequency options data on sectoral exchange-traded funds (ETFs) from January 2013 to June 2023, we identify and quantify monetary policy surprises following Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) announcements. Our empirical results indicate that total connectedness among sectoral ETF implied volatilities increases significantly following FOMC announcements, with these elevated connectedness levels persisting for approximately one hour on days with monetary policy surprises. Our findings indicate more than one-fifth of FOMC announcements surprise financial markets.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106238.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一种贝叶斯Wald型检验，用于检测方差分解中关联性的时间差异，并确立了在固定局部时间点上脉冲响应函数和方差分解矩阵的渐近正态性。所提出的检验统计量在原假设下渐近服从χ²分布，并在蒙特卡洛模拟中表现良好。将我们的方法应用于2013年1月至2023年6月期间行业交易所交易基金（ETFs）的高频期权数据，我们识别并量化了联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告后的货币政策意外。实证结果表明，在FOMC公告后，行业ETF隐含波动率之间的总体关联性显著增强，且这种增强的关联性水平在存在货币政策意外的日子里持续约一小时。我们的发现表明，超过五分之一的FOMC公告令金融市场感到意外。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106238.title: Testing for differences in high-frequency network connectedness from variance decompositions
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106238.title_zh: 基于方差分解的高频网络连通性差异检验

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106239.abstract: We propose a weak-instrument-robust subvector Lagrange multiplier test for instrumental variables regression. We show that it is asymptotically size-correct under a technical condition. This is the first weak-instrument-robust subvector test for instrumental variables regression to recover the degrees of freedom of the commonly used non-weak-instrument-robust Wald test. Additionally, we provide a closed-form solution for subvector confidence sets obtained by inverting the subvector Anderson-Rubin test. We show that they are centered around a k-class estimator. Also, we show that the subvector confidence sets for single coefficients of the causal parameter are jointly bounded if and only if Anderson's likelihood-ratio test rejects the hypothesis that the first-stage regression parameter is of reduced rank, that is, that the causal parameter is not identified. Finally, we show that if a confidence set obtained by inverting the Anderson-Rubin test is bounded and nonempty, it is equal to a Wald-based confidence set with a data-dependent confidence level. We explicitly compute this Wald-based confidence test.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106239.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种针对工具变量回归的弱工具变量稳健子向量拉格朗日乘数检验。我们证明，在技术性条件下，该检验渐近地具有正确的规模。这是首个能够恢复常用非弱工具变量稳健Wald检验自由度的弱工具变量稳健子向量检验。此外，我们提供了通过反转子向量Anderson-Rubin检验所得子向量置信集的闭式解。我们证明这些置信集以k类估计量为中心。同时，我们表明，对于因果参数的单个系数的子向量置信集，当且仅当Anderson似然比检验拒绝了第一阶段回归参数为降秩（即因果参数未被识别）的假设时，这些置信集才是联合有界的。最后，我们证明，如果通过反转Anderson-Rubin检验获得的置信集是有界且非空的，则它等于一个具有数据依赖置信水平的基于Wald的置信集。我们明确计算了这一基于Wald的置信检验。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106239.title: Weak-instrument-robust subvector inference in instrumental variables regression: A subvector Lagrange multiplier test and properties of subvector Anderson-Rubin confidence sets
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106239.title_zh: 工具变量回归中弱工具变量稳健的子向量推断：子向量拉格朗日乘子检验与子向量安德森-鲁宾置信集的性质

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106242.abstract: This paper develops a set of empirically tractable and flexible sieve estimators for semi-nonparametric multidimensional matching models with transferable utility, focusing on worker-job matching. We generalize the parametric quadratic-Gaussian framework employed by Bojilov and Galichon (2016) and Lindenlaub (2017), which relies on joint normality of observed characteristics. We allow unrestricted distributions of characteristics and show identification of the production technology and the equilibrium wage and matching functions using optimal transport theory. Given identification, we propose efficient, consistent, and asymptotically normal sieve estimators. We revisit Lindenlaub’s empirical application and show that, between 1990 and 2010, the U.S. economy experienced much larger technological progress favoring cognitive abilities than the original findings suggest. Furthermore, our flexible model specifications provide a significantly better fit for patterns in the evolution of wage inequality.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106242.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一套经验上易于处理且灵活的筛子估计量，用于具有可转移效用的半非参数多维匹配模型，重点关注工人-职位匹配。我们推广了Bojilov和Galichon（2016）及Lindenlaub（2017）所采用的参数二次高斯框架，该框架依赖于观测特征的联合正态性。我们允许特征分布不受限制，并利用最优传输理论证明了生产技术以及均衡工资和匹配函数的可识别性。在识别的基础上，我们提出了高效、一致且渐近正态的筛子估计量。我们重新审视了Lindenlaub的实证应用，并表明在1990年至2010年间，美国经济经历了比原始发现所暗示的更为显著的技术进步，偏向于认知能力。此外，我们灵活的模型设定为工资不平等演变模式提供了显著更好的拟合。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106242.title: Semi-nonparametric models of multidimensional matching: An optimal transport approach
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106242.title_zh: 多维匹配的半非参数模型：一种最优传输方法

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106252.abstract: This paper studies a concentrated Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) estimation method that offers significant computational advantages while delivering valid inference for parameters of interest. By reducing the dimension of parameters to be sampled, this method substantially decreases computational time and memory usage relative to both traditional and some state-of-the-art Bayesian algorithms. Its applicability extends to correctly specified or misspecified likelihood functions, as well as generalized method of moments objective functions. Monte Carlo studies demonstrate that the biases and root mean squared errors of the concentrated MCMC estimators are typically smaller than or comparable to those of conventional Bayesian estimators. Furthermore, this method exhibits reliable model selection performance. We establish the large sample properties of the concentrated MCMC estimator. An empirical application analyzing the network spillover effect of stock returns in the Chinese A-share market further illustrates the advantages of this method.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106252.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种集中马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）估计方法，该方法在提供有效推断的同时，具有显著的计算优势。通过降低待采样参数的维度，与传统及部分前沿贝叶斯算法相比，该方法大幅减少了计算时间和内存使用。其适用性涵盖正确设定或错误设定的似然函数，以及广义矩方法目标函数。蒙特卡洛研究表明，集中MCMC估计器的偏差和均方根误差通常小于或相当于传统贝叶斯估计器。此外，该方法展现出可靠的模型选择性能。我们确立了集中MCMC估计器的大样本性质。一项针对中国A股市场股票收益网络溢出效应的实证应用进一步展示了该方法的优势。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106252.title: Concentrated MCMC estimation

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106253.abstract: Multivalued treatments are commonplace in applications. We explore the use of discrete-valued instruments to control for selection bias in this setting. Our discussion revolves around the concept of targeting: which instruments target which treatments. It allows us to establish conditions under which counterfactual averages and treatment effects are point- or partially-identified for composite complier groups. We explore the additional identifying power of a positive selection assumption. We illustrate its usefulness by revisiting the findings of Kline and Walters (2016) on the Head Start Impact Study. We derive informative bounds that suggest less beneficial effects of Head Start expansions than their parametric estimates.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106253.abstract_zh: 多值处理在应用中十分常见。我们探讨在此背景下使用离散值工具变量来控制选择偏差的问题。我们的讨论围绕“靶向”概念展开：即哪些工具变量针对哪些处理。这使我们能够建立条件，在这些条件下，反事实平均值和处理效应对于复合依从者群体可以是点识别或部分识别的。我们进一步探讨了正向选择假设的额外识别力。通过重新审视Kline和Walters（2016）关于“启智计划影响研究”的发现，我们展示了其有用性。我们推导出信息丰富的边界，这些边界表明启智计划扩展的有益效果低于其参数估计所显示的水平。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106253.title: Treatment effects with targeting instruments
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106253.title_zh: 使用目标工具的处理效应

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106254.abstract: We provide novel bounds on average treatment effects (on the treated) that are valid under an unconfoundedness assumption. Our bounds are designed to be robust in challenging situations, for example, when the conditioning variables take on a large number of different values in the observed sample, or when the overlap condition is violated. This robustness is achieved by only using limited "pooling" of information across observations. Namely, the bounds are constructed as sample averages over functions of the observed outcomes such that the contribution of each outcome only depends on the treatment status of a limited number of observations. No information pooling across observations leads to so-called "Manski bounds", while unlimited information pooling leads to standard inverse propensity score weighting. We explore the intermediate range between these two extremes and provide corresponding inference methods. We show in Monte Carlo experiments and through two empirical application that our bounds are indeed robust and informative in practice.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106254.abstract_zh: 我们提供了在无混杂假设下有效的平均处理效应（对受处理者）的新界限。这些界限旨在应对挑战性情境，例如当条件变量在观测样本中取大量不同值时，或当重叠条件被违反时，仍保持稳健性。这种稳健性通过仅利用观测间有限的“信息汇集”实现。具体而言，界限构建为观测结果函数的样本平均值，使得每个结果的贡献仅依赖于有限数量观测的处理状态。无信息汇集导致所谓的“曼斯基界限”，而无限制信息汇集则导致标准的逆倾向得分加权。我们探索了这两个极端之间的中间范围，并提供了相应的推断方法。通过蒙特卡洛实验和两个实证应用，我们展示了这些界限在实践中确实稳健且具有信息量。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106254.title: Bounding treatment effects by pooling limited information across observations
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106254.title_zh: 通过跨观测值汇集有限信息来界定处理效应

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106255.abstract: This paper develops methods for the empirical analysis of singular processes, particularly in macroeconomics. A strong rationale, a well-developed theoretical framework and, as we show, empirical support exist for multivariate time series with a singular spectral density. A singular spectral density is consistent with economic theory underlying, for example, DSGE models in which the number of variables is greater than the number of structural shocks. This assumption guarantees the existence of a finite order VAR representation but there does not exist a unique probability density function with respect to the Lebesgue measure. We therefore define a density on a compact linear submanifold with respect to the Hausdorff measure and, in a Bayesian framework, develop an HMC algorithm that jointly samples coefficients, lag length, and the number of shocks. We use the proposed framework to carry out structural analysis on the US macroeconomy with fewer shocks than variables.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106255.abstract_zh: 本文开发了针对奇异过程实证分析的方法，尤其在宏观经济学领域。我们展示了，对于具有奇异谱密度的多元时间序列，存在强有力的理论依据、完善的理论框架以及实证支持。奇异谱密度与经济理论相一致，例如，在DSGE模型中，变量数量大于结构冲击数量时即如此。这一假设保证了有限阶VAR表示的存在，但相对于勒贝格测度，并不存在唯一的概率密度函数。因此，我们在紧致线性子流形上，相对于豪斯多夫测度定义密度，并在贝叶斯框架下，开发了一种HMC算法，该算法联合采样系数、滞后长度和冲击数量。我们利用所提出的框架，在冲击数量少于变量的情况下，对美国宏观经济进行结构分析。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106255.title: Singular vector autoregressions

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106256.abstract: This paper considers the case of non-conjugate prior distributions for Bayesian model averaging (BMA). Although the natural conjugate setting is the default choice for BMA, mainly for reasons of analytical tractability, it has come under considerable criticism due to its unrealistic assumptions about prior information, among others. In this study, we extend the literature by considering two special cases of the multivariate Student-t distribution. We obtain closed-form solutions using Laplace approximations and apply our techniques to a controlled numerical experiment and cross-country growth regressions. Our results show that, under fine tuning of the hyperparameters, the proposed approach has similar performance to the conjugate alternatives on synthetic datasets, whereas in real data it favors, on average, more parsimonious models than the conjugate alternatives and also exhibits superior predictive performance.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106256.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）中非共轭先验分布的情形。尽管自然共轭设置因解析便利性而成为BMA的默认选择，但其关于先验信息的不切实际假设已受到广泛批评。在本研究中，我们通过考虑多元学生t分布的两种特殊情况来扩展现有文献。我们利用拉普拉斯近似获得了闭式解，并将我们的技术应用于受控数值实验和跨国增长回归中。结果表明，在超参数精细调整下，所提方法在合成数据集上的表现与共轭替代方法相似，而在实际数据中，它平均倾向于比共轭替代方法更简约的模型，并展现出更优的预测性能。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106256.title: Bayesian model averaging with non-conjugate priors
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106256.title_zh: 非共轭先验下的贝叶斯模型平均

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106264.abstract: We propose a new estimator for nonparametric binary choice models that does not impose a parametric structure on either the systematic function of covariates or the distribution of the error term. A key advantage of our approach is its computational scalability in the number of covariates. For instance, even when assuming a normal error distribution as in probit models, commonly used sieves for approximating an unknown function of covariates can lead to a large-dimensional optimization problem when the number of covariates is moderate. Our approach, motivated by kernel methods in machine learning, views certain reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces as special sieve spaces, coupled with spectral cut-off regularization for dimension reduction. We establish the consistency of the proposed estimator and asymptotic normality of the plug-in estimator for weighted average partial derivatives. Simulation studies show that, compared to parametric estimation methods, the proposed method effectively improves finite sample performance in cases of misspecification, and has a rather mild efficiency loss if the model is correctly specified. Using administrative data on the grant decisions of US asylum applications to immigration courts, along with nine case-day variables on weather and pollution, we re-examine the effect of outdoor temperature on court judges' ``mood'', and thus, their grant decisions.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106264.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的非参数二元选择模型估计方法，该方法无需对协变量的系统函数或误差项的分布施加参数结构。我们方法的一个关键优势在于其计算可扩展性，能够处理协变量数量较多的情况。例如，即使在如probit模型中假设正态误差分布时，常用的筛法（sieves）在协变量数量适中时，也可能导致高维优化问题。我们的方法受机器学习中的核方法启发，将特定的再生核希尔伯特空间视为特殊筛空间，并结合谱截断正则化进行降维。我们证明了所提估计量的一致性，以及加权平均偏导数插件估计量的渐近正态性。模拟研究表明，与参数估计方法相比，所提方法在模型误设情况下能有效改善有限样本性能，而在模型正确设定时，其效率损失相对较小。利用美国移民法院庇护申请裁决的行政数据，以及九个关于天气和污染的案例日变量，我们重新审视了室外温度对法官“情绪”及其裁决决定的影响。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106264.title: A kernelization-based approach to nonparametric binary choice models
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106264.title_zh: 基于核化的非参数二元选择模型方法

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106265.abstract: This paper considers time domain estimation of possibly non-fundamental (that is, non-causal and/or non-invertible) non-Gaussian linear ARMA models with martingale difference innovations that may display conditional heteroskedasticity of unknown form. Instead of explicitly parametrizing the underlying volatility process (the higher order dependence) and employing maximum likelihood procedures, we propose a time domain minimum distance objective function based on innovations predictability using second and third powers of past innovations. Using the proposed efficient GMM estimator, which is consistent and asymptotically normal, we estimate possibly non-fundamental ARMA models to inflation data from 29 OECD countries and find widespread evidence on non-fundamentalness.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106265.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在可能非基础（即非因果和/或非可逆）的非高斯线性ARMA模型中进行时域估计的问题，这些模型具有鞅差创新，可能表现出未知形式的条件异方差性。我们并未明确参数化潜在的波动率过程（高阶依赖性）并采用最大似然方法，而是提出了一种基于过去创新二次和三次幂的可预测性的时域最小距离目标函数。利用所提出的有效GMM估计量，该估计量具有一致性和渐近正态性，我们对29个OECD国家的通胀数据估计了可能非基础的ARMA模型，并发现了非基础性的广泛证据。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106265.title: Time domain estimation of non-fundamental ARMA models in the presence of heteroskedasticity of unknown form
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106265.title_zh: 异方差形式未知时非基础ARMA模型的时域估计

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106266.abstract: Boundary discontinuity designs are used to learn about causal treatment effects along a continuous assignment boundary that splits units into control and treatment groups according to a bivariate location score. We analyze location-based local polynomial treatment effect estimators that directly employ the bivariate score of each unit. We develop pointwise and uniform estimation and inference methods for the \textit{Boundary Average Treatment Effect Curve} (BATEC), as well as for two aggregated causal parameters: the \textit{Weighted Boundary Average Treatment Effect} (WBATE) and the \textit{Largest Boundary Average Treatment Effect} (LBATE). Our results cover both sharp and fuzzy (imperfect compliance) designs. We illustrate the methods with an empirical application, and provide companion general-purpose software. The supplemental appendix includes additional substantive theoretical results, methodological details, and simulation evidence.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106266.abstract_zh: 边界不连续设计用于沿连续分配边界学习因果处理效应，该边界根据二元位置得分将单位划分为对照组和处理组。我们分析了直接利用每个单位的二元得分的基于位置局部多项式处理效应估计量。我们为《边界平均处理效应曲线》（BATEC）以及两个聚合因果参数：《加权边界平均处理效应》（WBATE）和《最大边界平均处理效应》（LBATE）开发了点态和一致估计及推断方法。我们的结果涵盖锐利和模糊（不完全依从）设计。我们通过一个实证应用展示了这些方法，并提供了配套的通用软件。补充附录包含额外的实质性理论结果、方法论细节和模拟证据。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106266.title: Estimation and inference in boundary discontinuity designs: Distance-based methods
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106266.title_zh: 边界断点设计中的估计与推断：基于距离的方法

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106267.abstract: This paper studies the estimation of characteristics-based quantile factor models where the factor loadings are unknown functions of observed individual characteristics, and the idiosyncratic error terms are subject to conditional quantile restrictions. We propose a three-stage estimation procedure that is easy to implement and has nice properties. The convergence rates, the limiting distributions of the estimated factors and loading functions, plus a consistent selection criterion for the number of factors at each quantile are derived under general conditions. Our proposed estimators are shown to work satisfactorily when: (i) the idiosyncratic errors have heavy tails, (ii) the time dimension of the panel dataset is not large, and (iii) the number of factors differs from the number of characteristics. Further, a consistent estimation method based on quantile factor analysis and sieve regression is proposed when the factor loadings depend on additional unobserved characteristics. Monte Carlo simulations and an empirical application aimed at estimating the loading functions of the daily returns of a large panel of S&P 500 index securities help illustrate these properties.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106267.abstract_zh: 本文研究了基于特征的分位数因子模型的估计问题，其中因子载荷是观测个体特征的未知函数，且 idiosyncratic 误差项受条件分位数约束。我们提出了一种易于实现且具有良好性质的三阶段估计程序。在一般条件下，我们推导了估计因子和载荷函数的收敛速率、极限分布，以及各分位数下因子数量的一致选择准则。我们提出的估计器在以下情况下表现良好：（i）idiosyncratic 误差具有重尾分布，（ii）面板数据集的时间维度不大，（iii）因子数量与特征数量不同。此外，当因子载荷依赖于额外的未观测特征时，我们提出了一种基于分位数因子分析和筛回归的一致估计方法。蒙特卡洛模拟以及旨在估计标普500指数证券大面板日收益载荷函数的实证应用，有助于说明这些性质。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106267.title: Estimation of characteristics-based quantile factor models
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106267.title_zh: 基于特征的分位数因子模型的估计

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106268.abstract: This paper considers identification and estimation of distributional effect parameters that depend on the joint distribution of an outcome and another variable of interest (“treatment”) in a setting with “two-sided” measurement error—that is, where both variables are possibly measured with error. Examples of these parameters in the context of intergenerational income mobility include transition matrices, rank-rank correlations, and the poverty rate of children as a function of their parents’ income, among others. Building on recent work on quantile regression (QR) with measurement error in the outcome (particularly, Hausman et al. (2021)), we show that, given (i) two linear QR models separately for the outcome and treatment conditional on other observed covariates and (ii) assumptions about the measurement error for each variable, one can recover the joint distribution of the outcome and the treatment. Besides these conditions, our approach does not require an instrument, repeated measurements, or distributional assumptions about the measurement error. Using recent data from the 1997 National Longitudinal Study of Youth, we find that accounting for measurement error notably reduces several estimates of intergenerational mobility parameters.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106268.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在“双向”测量误差背景下——即结果变量与另一感兴趣变量（“处理变量”）均可能存在测量误差时，依赖于结果与处理变量联合分布效应的识别与估计问题。在代际收入流动的语境中，此类参数实例包括转移矩阵、秩-秩相关性以及儿童贫困率作为其父母收入函数等。基于近期关于结果变量含测量误差的分位数回归（QR）研究（特别是Hausman等人（2021）），我们证明，在给定（i）分别针对结果变量和处理变量关于其他观测协变量的两个线性QR模型，以及（ii）关于每个变量测量误差的假设条件下，可以恢复结果变量与处理变量的联合分布。除这些条件外，我们的方法无需工具变量、重复测量或对测量误差的分布假设。利用1997年全国青年纵向调查的最新数据，我们发现考虑测量误差显著降低了若干代际流动性参数的估计值。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106268.title: Distributional effects with two-sided measurement error: An application to intergenerational income mobility
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106268.title_zh: 双边测量误差的分布效应：代际收入流动性的应用

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106269.abstract: This special issue brings together 21 papers that reflect the expanding scope and methodological evolution of Bayesian econometrics. We introduce a new organizing taxonomy that distinguishes between Traditional Bayesian Approaches - rooted in conjugate priors, standard likelihood-based estimation, and established Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) techniques - and Contemporary Bayesian Frontiers, characterized by nonparametric methods, variational inference, high-dimensional shrinkage, and integration with machine learning. We further classify contributions across two broad domains covering applications in Economics (focusing on macroeconomics, microeconomics, and climate econometrics) and Finance (focusing on asset pricing, volatility, and bank business models). Across these fields, four cross-cutting themes emerge: (1) high-dimensionality, volatility, and time-varying dynamics; (2) structural identification and model uncertainty; (3) semiparametric and nonparametric flexibility; and (4) data quality, granularity, and novel data structures.
