This survey synthesizes the methodological and empirical contributions of the special issue, proposes a unifying framework for organizing recent advances in Bayesian econometrics, and identifies unresolved challenges and promising directions for future research.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106269.abstract_zh: 本期特刊汇集了21篇论文，反映了贝叶斯计量经济学不断扩展的范围与方法论的演进。我们引入了一种新的组织分类法，区分了传统贝叶斯方法——根植于共轭先验、标准似然估计及成熟的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）技术——与当代贝叶斯前沿，后者以非参数方法、变分推断、高维收缩及与机器学习的融合为特征。我们进一步将贡献划分为两大广泛领域，涵盖经济学应用（聚焦于宏观经济学、微观经济学及气候计量经济学）与金融学应用（聚焦于资产定价、波动性及银行商业模式）。在这些领域中，涌现出四个跨领域主题：（1）高维性、波动性及时变动态；（2）结构识别与模型不确定性；（3）半参数与非参数灵活性；（4）数据质量、粒度及新颖数据结构。本综述综合了特刊的方法论与实证贡献，提出了一个统一框架以组织贝叶斯计量经济学的最新进展，并指出了未解决的挑战及未来研究的有前景方向。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106269.title: Bayesian methods in economics and finance: A unified survey and taxonomy
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106269.title_zh: 经济学与金融学中的贝叶斯方法：统一综述与分类

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106270.abstract: The original and corrected Akaike information criteria (AIC) have been routinely used for model selection for ages. The penalty terms in these criteria are tied to the classical normal linear regression, characterized by conditional homoskedasticity and a small number of regressors relative to the sample size. We derive, from the same principles, a general version that takes account of conditional heteroskedasticity and regressor numerosity. The new AICm penalty takes a form of a ratio of certain weighted average error variances. The classical results on asymptotic prediction optimality of AIC are extended to AICm in heteroskedastic possibly misspecified models. Further, the infeasible AICm penalty can be operationalized via unbiased estimation of individual variances. Under suitable conditions, the feasible AICm criterion differs from the infeasible counterpart up to an asymptotically negligible term, and also possesses the property of asymptotic optimality. In simulations, the feasible AICm tends to select models that deliver systematically better out-of-sample predictions than the classical criteria. In the empirical application to an impact of legalized abortion on crime reduction, AICm tends to select a more parsimonious model than non-heteroskedasticity-robust versions of AIC.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106270.abstract_zh: 原始和修正的赤池信息准则（AIC）长期以来一直被常规用于模型选择。这些准则中的惩罚项与经典正态线性回归相关联，其特征是条件同方差性以及相对于样本量而言较少的回归元数量。我们从相同的原理出发，推导出一个通用版本，该版本考虑了条件异方差性和回归元数量众多的情况。新的AICm惩罚项采取某种加权平均误差方差之比的形式。关于AIC渐近预测最优性的经典结果被扩展到异方差且可能设定错误的模型中的AICm。此外，不可行的AICm惩罚项可以通过对个体方差的无偏估计来实现操作化。在适当条件下，可行的AICm准则与不可行的对应准则之间的差异在渐近意义下可忽略不计，并且同样具有渐近最优性。在模拟中，可行的AICm倾向于选择比经典准则系统性地产生更好样本外预测的模型。在关于合法堕胎对减少犯罪影响的经验应用中，AICm倾向于选择比非异方差稳健版本的AIC更简约的模型。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106270.title: AIC for many-regressor heteroskedastic regressions
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106270.title_zh: 多回归元异方差回归的AIC

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106271.abstract: We introduce general estimation and inference methods for threshold spatial panel regression with two-way fixed effects in a diminishing-threshold-effects framework. A valid objective function is obtained through a simple adjustment on the concentrated quasi loglikelihood with fixed effects being concentrated out, which leads to a consistent estimation of all common parameters. We show that the estimation of threshold parameter has a negligible effect on the asymptotic distribution of the main parameter estimators and thereby regular inference methods apply, though a bias correction may be necessary. The limiting distribution of the threshold parameter estimator is shown to be non-regular and infeasible, and for inference, a likelihood ratio test procedure is proposed. The test for the non-existence of threshold effects faces an identification issue at the null. To overcome this difficulty, we propose a sup-Wald test and a bootstrap method for its critical values. Monte Carlo results show that the proposed methods perform well in finite samples. An empirical application is presented on age-of-leader effects on political competitions across Chinese cities.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106271.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在阈值效应递减框架下，针对具有双向固定效应的阈值空间面板回归的通用估计与推断方法。通过简单调整集中拟对数似然函数，并消去固定效应，我们获得了一个有效的目标函数，从而实现对所有共同参数的一致估计。研究表明，阈值参数的估计对主要参数估计量的渐近分布影响可忽略不计，因此常规推断方法适用，尽管可能需要进行偏差校正。阈值参数估计量的极限分布被证明是非正则且不可行的，为此，我们提出了一种似然比检验程序进行推断。对于阈值效应不存在性的检验，在零假设下存在识别问题。为克服这一困难，我们提出了一个sup-Wald检验及其临界值的自助法。蒙特卡洛结果表明，所提方法在有限样本中表现良好。我们还提供了一个实证应用，研究中国各城市政治竞争中领导人年龄效应的影响。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106271.title: Threshold spatial panel regression with fixed effects
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106271.title_zh: 固定效应阈值空间面板回归

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106272.abstract: This paper proposes a correlated random coefficient linear panel data model, where regressors can be correlated with time-varying and individual-specific random coefficients through both a fixed effect and a time-varying random shock. I develop a new panel data-based method to identify the average partial effect and the local average response function. The identification strategy employs a sufficient statistic to control for the fixed effect and a control variable for the random shock. Conditional on these two controls, the residual variation in the regressors is driven solely by the exogenous instrumental variables, and thus can be exploited to identify the parameters of interest. The constructive identification analysis leads to three-step series estimators, for which I establish rates of convergence and asymptotic normality. To illustrate the method, I estimate a heterogeneous Cobb-Douglas production function for manufacturing firms in China, finding substantial variations in output elasticities across firms that can be related to various firm characteristics.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106272.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种相关随机系数线性面板数据模型，其中回归元可通过固定效应和时变随机冲击与个体特定的时变随机系数相关。我开发了一种基于面板数据的新方法，以识别平均部分效应和局部平均响应函数。识别策略利用一个充分统计量来控制固定效应，并采用一个控制变量来处理随机冲击。在这两个控制条件下，回归元中的剩余变异仅由外生工具变量驱动，因此可用于识别感兴趣参数。构造性识别分析导出了三步级数估计量，我为其建立了收敛速率和渐近正态性。为说明该方法，我估计了中国制造业企业的异质性柯布-道格拉斯生产函数，发现企业间产出弹性存在显著差异，且这些差异可与企业特征相关联。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106272.title: Identification and estimation in a time-varying endogenous random coefficient panel data model
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106272.title_zh: 时变内生随机系数面板数据模型的识别与估计

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106273.abstract: This paper considers the estimation of a censored partial linear quantile regression model with endogeneity. Our method extends those for partial linear quantile regression (Lee, 2003, Qu et al. 2024), nonparametric quantile regression (Qu and Yoon, 2015, Belloni et al., 2019), and censored linear quantile regression with endogeneity (Chen, 2018). Our estimation method involves a tractable sequential-multiple-step procedure. We establish the uniform consistency, the uniform representation and the asymptotic normality for the proposed estimators. We further extend our analysis to allow for sample selection. A set of Monte Carlo experiments show that our estimators have a good finite sample performance and an empirical application is given to show the usefulness of our estimators.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106273.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了带内生性的截断部分线性分位数回归模型的估计问题。我们的方法扩展了部分线性分位数回归（Lee, 2003; Qu等，2024）、非参数分位数回归（Qu和Yoon, 2015; Belloni等，2019）以及带内生性的截断线性分位数回归（Chen, 2018）的相关研究。我们的估计方法采用了一种易于处理的序贯多步骤程序。我们为所提出的估计量建立了均匀一致性、均匀表示及渐近正态性。我们进一步将分析扩展至允许样本选择的情形。一系列蒙特卡洛实验表明，我们的估计量具有良好的有限样本性能，并通过一个实证应用展示了其有用性。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106273.title: Censored partial linear quantile regression with endogeneity
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106273.title_zh: 内生性下的删失部分线性分位数回归

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106274.abstract: The modal factor model represents a novel statistical framework for dimension reduction in high dimensional panel data analysis. It is specifically designed to capture modal factors which exert a significant influence on the conditional mode of the distribution of the observables. Statistical inference for this model is developed based on a newly proposed modal component analysis, where modal factors and their corresponding loadings are estimated through maximizing a kernel-type objective function. Two computationally efficient and easy-to-implement algorithms—minorization-maximization and alternating maximization—are devised for the numerical computation of these estimators. Furthermore, two model selection criteria are proposed to determine the optimal number of modal factors. Under mild regularity conditions that accommodate both cross-sectional and time-series dependence, the asymptotic properties of the proposed estimators are established. Additionally, the limiting distributions of parameter estimators and forecasts derived from factor-augmented regressions incorporating estimated modal factors are rigorously derived. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed estimators exhibit favorable finite-sample performance, even in the presence of heavy-tailed, skewed, multimodal, and heteroskedastic error distributions. Finally, an application to inflation and industrial production index forecasting validates the practical merits and superior predictive power of modal factors in real-world macroeconomic scenarios.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106274.abstract_zh: 模态因子模型代表了一种新颖的统计框架，用于高维面板数据分析中的降维处理。它专门设计用于捕捉对观测变量分布条件众数具有显著影响的模态因子。基于新提出的模态成分分析，该模型的统计推断得以发展，其中模态因子及其相应的载荷通过最大化核型目标函数来估计。为了这些估计量的数值计算，设计了两种计算高效且易于实现的算法——最小化-最大化算法和交替最大化算法。此外，提出了两种模型选择准则以确定最优模态因子数量。在适应横截面和时间序列依赖性的温和正则条件下，建立了所提估计量的渐近性质。同时，严格推导了包含估计模态因子的因子增强回归中参数估计量及预测的极限分布。模拟研究表明，即使在存在重尾、偏斜、多峰及异方差误差分布的情况下，所提估计量也展现出良好的有限样本性能。最后，应用于通货膨胀和工业生产指数预测的实例验证了模态因子在现实宏观经济情景中的实用价值及优越的预测能力。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106274.title: MCA: High-dimensional modal component analysis towards the mode
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106274.title_zh: MCA：面向模态的高维模态成分分析

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106275.abstract: We propose an approach to estimate how individuals’ expectations influence their responses to a counterfactual change. The approach relies on average partial effects, which recover counterfactual impacts under conditions that we specify. We propose a three-step estimation method that relies on panel data on subjective expectations. We illustrate our approach in a model of consumption and saving, focusing on the impact of an income tax that not only changes current income but also affects beliefs about future income. Applying our approach to Italian survey data, we find that individuals’ beliefs matter for evaluating the impact of tax policies on consumption decisions.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106275.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法来估计个体的预期如何影响其对反事实变化的反应。该方法依赖于平均部分效应，在我们指定的条件下，这些效应能够恢复反事实影响。我们提出一种三步估计方法，该方法依赖于主观预期的面板数据。我们在一个消费与储蓄模型中展示我们的方法，重点关注所得税的影响，该税种不仅改变当前收入，还影响对未来收入的信念。将我们的方法应用于意大利调查数据，我们发现个体的信念对于评估税收政策对消费决策的影响至关重要。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106275.title: Estimating individual responses when tomorrow matters
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106275.title_zh: 当明天至关重要时：个体反应的估计

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106276.abstract: The stochastic block model (SBM) has been widely used to analyze network data. Various goodness-of-fit tests have been proposed to assess the adequacy of model structures. To the best of our knowledge, however, none of the existing approaches are applicable for sparse networks in which the connection probability of any two communities is of order log(n)/n, and the number of communities is divergent. To fill this gap, we propose a novel goodness-of-fit test for the stochastic block model. The key idea is to construct statistics by sampling the maximum entry-deviations of the adjacency matrix that the negative impacts of network sparsity are alleviated by the sampling process. We demonstrate theoretically that the proposed test statistic converges to the Type-I extreme value distribution under the null hypothesis regardless of the network structure. Accordingly, it can be applied to both dense and sparse networks. In addition, we obtain the asymptotic power against alternatives. Moreover, we introduce a bootstrap-corrected test statistic to improve the finite sample performance, recommend an augmented test statistic to increase the power, and extend the proposed test to the degree-corrected SBM. Simulation studies and two empirical examples with both dense and sparse networks indicate that the proposed method performs well.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106276.abstract_zh: 随机块模型（SBM）已被广泛用于分析网络数据。为评估模型结构的充分性，已有多种拟合优度检验方法被提出。然而，据我们所知，现有方法均不适用于连接概率为log(n)/n量级且社区数量发散的稀疏网络。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种针对随机块模型的新型拟合优度检验方法。其核心思想是通过采样邻接矩阵的最大条目偏差来构造统计量，从而通过采样过程减轻网络稀疏性的负面影响。我们从理论上证明，在原假设下，所提出的检验统计量收敛于第一类极值分布，且与网络结构无关。因此，该方法可同时适用于稠密和稀疏网络。此外，我们获得了备择假设下的渐近功效。进一步地，我们引入了一种基于自助法的修正统计量以提升有限样本性能，推荐了一种增强统计量以增加检验功效，并将所提检验扩展至度修正的SBM。模拟研究及两个涵盖稠密与稀疏网络的实证案例表明，所提方法表现良好。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106276.title: A goodness-of-fit test for sparse networks
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106276.title_zh: 稀疏网络拟合优度检验

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106297.abstract: This paper studies the introduction of causal conditional heteroskedasticity in noncausal autoregressive (AR) models. We demonstrate that, in this framework, large shocks to the innovation process driving the GARCH error term of a noncausal AR model result in heightened volatility immediately before and after a bubble crash. The non-coincidence of the σ -fields generated by past observations and past values of the GARCH process makes statistical inference nonstandard. In particular, the full quasi-maximum likelihood estimator (QMLE) is generally inconsistent. We investigate the asymptotic properties of three-step weighted least squares estimators of the AR coefficient and the QMLE of the volatility parameters. Our findings are illustrated by Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application to financial data.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106297.abstract_zh: 本文研究在非因果自回归（AR）模型中引入因果条件异方差性的方法。我们证明，在该框架下，驱动非因果AR模型GARCH误差项的创新过程中的大幅冲击，会导致泡沫崩溃前后波动性显著加剧。由于过去观测值生成的σ域与GARCH过程过去值生成的σ域不重合，统计推断变得非标准。具体而言，完全拟极大似然估计量（QMLE）通常不一致。我们研究了AR系数的三步加权最小二乘估计量以及波动率参数的QMLE的渐近性质。通过蒙特卡洛实验和对金融数据的实证应用，本文验证了上述发现。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106297.title: Noncausal AR processes driven by causal GARCH volatility
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106297.title_zh: 因果GARCH波动驱动的非因果AR过程

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106298.abstract: Empirical regression discontinuity (RD) studies often include covariates in their specifications to increase the precision of their estimates. In this paper, we propose a novel class of estimators that use such covariate information more efficiently than existing methods and can accommodate many covariates. Our estimators are simple to implement and involve running a standard RD analysis after subtracting a function of the covariates from the original outcome variable. We characterize the function of the covariates that minimizes the asymptotic variance of these estimators. We also show that the conventional RD framework gives rise to a special robustness property which implies that the optimal adjustment function can be estimated flexibly via modern machine learning techniques without affecting the first-order properties of the final RD estimator. We demonstrate our methods' scope for efficiency improvements by reanalyzing data from a large number of recently published empirical studies.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106298.abstract_zh: 实证回归不连续性（RD）研究中通常会在设定中包含协变量，以提高估计的精确度。本文提出了一类新型估计量，相较于现有方法能更高效地利用协变量信息，并可容纳大量协变量。我们的估计量易于实施，只需在从原始结果变量中减去协变量的函数后，进行标准RD分析即可。我们刻画了能使这些估计量渐近方差最小化的协变量函数。同时证明，传统RD框架具有特殊的稳健性特征，这意味着最优调整函数可通过现代机器学习技术灵活估计，而不会影响最终RD估计量的一阶性质。通过重新分析近期大量已发表实证研究的数据，我们展示了该方法在效率提升方面的潜力。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106298.title: Flexible covariate adjustments in regression discontinuity designs
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106298.title_zh: 断点回归设计中的灵活协变量调整

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106299.abstract: Parameter instability has been widely documented to lead to poor predictive accuracy for economic forecasting models. Adaptive schemes for data weighting such as rolling-window estimation only involve a single tuning parameter (akin to a bandwidth) and are often used to address this issue. The importance of the shape of the weighting scheme (kernel) has received far less attention in the forecasting literature. In this paper we show that in practice there can be a large discrepancy between the theoretically optimal bias-variance tradeoff, based on the optimal bandwidth, and the actual bias-variance trade-off in practice, which depends jointly on the kernel shape as well as the (typically non-optimal) bandwidth. Simplifying this joint optimization problem by focusing only on one dimension, we show that optimizing over the kernel shape rather than the bandwidth often constitutes a better performing and more practical choice. We establish that a class of affine kernel shapes indexed by a single parameter, s, is optimal under squared forecast error loss, show that the shape parameter can be restricted to the interval [0, 2], where s = 0 corresponds to a uniform kernel (rolling-window) and s = 2 corresponds to a triangular kernel, and develop a robust three-point grid search method for choosing this shape parameter. An empirical analysis of U.S. inflation forecasting demonstrates the advantage of optimizing for the kernel shape parameter, particularly in unstable environments characterized by a time-varying bias-variance trade-off.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106299.abstract_zh: 参数不稳定性已被广泛证实会导致经济预测模型的预测精度下降。诸如滚动窗口估计之类的自适应数据加权方案仅涉及单一调优参数（类似于带宽），常用于解决此问题。然而，在预测文献中，加权方案（核函数）形状的重要性受到的关注较少。本文表明，在实践中，基于最优带宽的理论最优偏差-方差权衡与实际中的偏差-方差权衡之间可能存在显著差异，后者同时依赖于核函数形状以及（通常非最优的）带宽。通过简化这一联合优化问题，仅聚焦于一个维度，我们证明，优化核函数形状而非带宽往往构成更优性能且更实用的选择。我们确立了一类由单一参数s索引的仿射核函数形状在平方预测误差损失下是最优的，表明形状参数可限制在区间[0, 2]内，其中s = 0对应均匀核（滚动窗口），s = 2对应三角核，并开发了一种稳健的三点网格搜索方法来选择此形状参数。对美国通胀预测的实证分析展示了优化核函数形状参数的优势，尤其是在以时变偏差-方差权衡为特征的不稳定环境中。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106299.title: Shaping forecast models for arbitrary choice of bandwidth
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106299.title_zh: 为任意带宽选择构建预测模型

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106300.abstract: Mutual fund managers’ skills, measured by risk-adjusted alphas, are predictable using fund characteristics identified by machine learning (e.g., Kaniel et al., 2023, JFE; DeMiguel et al., 2023, JFE). However, alpha’s predictive power varies across funds and periods, with most funds exhibiting negligible alphas. To model this heterogeneous predictability, this paper introduces Sparse Clustering GMM, a nonparametric approach for identifying latent fund groups. SCGMM clusters funds using estimated alphas and identifies group-specific parameters tied to market predictors. The method accounts for heterogeneity in cross-sectional grouping and time-varying mechanisms across predictors, without requiring prior cluster information or time-varying specifications. We establish consistency for group recovery and time-varying parameter estimation. Empirically, using monthly U.S. mutual fund data, we find that predictable alpha is concentrated in a small subset of funds, with the majority of funds exhibiting near-zero, weakly predictable alphas. The skilled clusters also exhibit lower benchmark R 2, moderate expense ratios, and longer manager tenure.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106300.abstract_zh: 共同基金经理的技能，以风险调整后的阿尔法衡量，可通过机器学习识别的基金特征进行预测（例如，Kaniel等，2023，JFE；DeMiguel等，2023，JFE）。然而，阿尔法的预测能力在不同基金和时期之间存在差异，大多数基金的阿尔法接近于零。为建模这种异质性预测，本文引入了稀疏聚类GMM，一种用于识别潜在基金组的非参数方法。SCGMM利用估计的阿尔法对基金进行聚类，并识别与市场预测因子相关的组特定参数。该方法考虑了横截面分组中的异质性以及预测因子间随时间变化的机制，无需先验聚类信息或时变设定。我们建立了组恢复和时变参数估计的一致性。实证上，利用美国月度共同基金数据，我们发现可预测的阿尔法集中于一小部分基金，而大多数基金表现出接近零、弱可预测的阿尔法。技能较高的聚类还表现出较低的基准R²、适中的费用比率和更长的经理任期。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106300.title: Heterogeneous predictability on mutual fund alphas: A sparse clustering GMM approach
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106300.title_zh: 共同基金阿尔法的异质性可预测性：一种稀疏聚类GMM方法

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106301.abstract: Measuring systemic risk has been an important topic in recent research on risk management. Adrian and Brunnermeier (2016) pioneered the CoVaR measure for systemic risk, which is defined as the conditional quantile of system loss given some state predictors and one stress event of an individual loss at a certain risk level. They proposed to estimate CoVaR by a two-quantile-regression approach, which is simple and easy to implement in practice, but without stating or developing the necessary asymptotic theory. In this paper, we develop tests to reveal that using the classical regularity condition in quantile regressions for the two-quantile-regression model may be unrealistic by revisiting the datasets in Adrian and Brunnermeier (2016). Under the proposed weaker conditions, we further develop the asymptotic theory of the CoVaR inference and introduce a random weighted bootstrap method to quantify the inference uncertainty. We examine the finite sample performance of the proposed tests in terms of size and power, as well as the coverage probabilities of confidence intervals for CoVaR. Finally, we demonstrate the CoVaR inference across financial institutions and time.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106301.abstract_zh: 衡量系统性风险一直是风险管理近期研究中的重要课题。Adrian和Brunnermeier（2016）开创性地提出了用于系统性风险的CoVaR度量，该度量定义为在给定某些状态预测因子和单个损失在特定风险水平下的压力事件条件下，系统损失的條件分位数。他们提出通过双分位数回归方法估计CoVaR，该方法在实践中简单易行，但未阐述或发展必要的渐近理论。本文通过重新审视Adrian和Brunnermeier（2016）的数据集，开发了检验方法，以揭示在双分位数回归模型中使用经典分位数回归正则条件可能不切实际。在提出的较弱条件下，我们进一步发展了CoVaR推断的渐近理论，并引入随机加权自助法来量化推断不确定性。我们检验了所提检验在规模和功效方面的有限样本性能，以及CoVaR置信区间的覆盖概率。最后，我们展示了跨金融机构和时间的CoVaR推断。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106301.title: Asymptotics of CoVaR inference in two-quantile-regression
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106301.title_zh: 两分位数回归中CoVaR推断的渐近性质

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106302.abstract: This paper presents an inference method for the local average treatment effect (LATE) in the presence of high-dimensional covariates, regardless of the strength of identification. We propose an orthogonalized Anderson-Rubin test statistic that maintains uniformly valid asymptotic size. We provide an easy-to-implement algorithm for inferring the high-dimensional LATE by inverting our test statistic and employing the double/debiased machine learning method. Simulation results show that our test achieves better size control under both weak identification and high dimensionality, outperforming conventional alternatives. Applying the proposed method to railroad and population data to study the effect of railroad access on urban population growth, we observe wider confidence intervals than those obtained using conventional methods.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106302.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在高维协变量存在下，无论识别强度如何，对局部平均处理效应（LATE）进行推断的方法。我们构建了一个正交化的安德森-鲁宾检验统计量，该统计量能保持均匀有效的渐近规模。通过反转该检验统计量并采用双重/去偏机器学习方法，我们提供了一种易于实现的算法来推断高维LATE。模拟结果表明，在弱识别和高维性条件下，我们的检验在规模控制方面优于传统替代方法。将所提方法应用于铁路与人口数据以研究铁路通达对城市人口增长的影响时，我们观察到比传统方法更宽的置信区间。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106302.title: Identification-robust inference for the LATE with high-dimensional covariates
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106302.title_zh: 高维协变量下局部平均处理效应的识别稳健推断

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106303.abstract: In semi-logarithmic regressions, treatment coefficients are often interpreted as approximations of an average treatment effect (ATE) in percentage points. This paper highlights the overlooked bias of this approximation under treatment effect heterogeneity, arising from Jensen’s inequality. The issue is particularly relevant for difference-in-differences designs with log-transformed outcomes and staggered treatment adoption, where treatment effects may vary across groups and periods. This paper proposes new estimation and inference methods for an estimand that accounts for heterogeneity across observable subgroups and can improve upon conventional measures. The estimand provides a lower bound on the ATE in percentage points for the relevant target (sub)population, and coincides with it in the absence of within-group heterogeneity. I establish the methods’ large-sample properties and study their finite-sample performance through Monte Carlo experiments, which reveal substantial discrepancies between conventional and proposed measures when systematic heterogeneity is large. Two empirical applications further underscore the practical importance of these methods.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106303.abstract_zh: 在半对数回归中，处理效应系数常被解释为平均处理效应（ATE）在百分点上的近似值。本文揭示了在处理效应异质性下，这一近似因詹森不等式而产生的被忽视的偏差。该问题对于采用对数转换结果变量及交错处理采纳的双重差分设计尤为相关，因为处理效应可能随群体和时期的不同而变化。本文提出了一种新的估计与推断方法，针对一个考虑可观测子群体异质性且能优于传统测度的估计目标。该估计目标为相关目标（子）总体在百分点上的平均处理效应提供了一个下界，并在不存在组内异质性时与之相等。我确立了这些方法的大样本性质，并通过蒙特卡洛实验研究了其有限样本表现，实验结果显示，当系统性异质性较大时，传统测度与所提测度之间存在显著差异。两个实证应用进一步强调了这些方法的实际重要性。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106303.title: Estimation and inference on average treatment effect in percentage points under heterogeneity
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106303.title_zh: 异质性下百分比点平均处理效应的估计与推断

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106304.abstract: In many scenarios, such as the evaluation of place-based policies, potential outcomes are not only dependent upon the unit's own treatment but also its neighbors' treatment. Despite this,"difference-in-differences"(DID) type estimators typically ignore such interference among neighbors. I show in this paper that the canonical DID estimators generally fail to identify interesting causal effects in the presence of neighborhood interference. To incorporate interference structure into DID estimation, I propose doubly robust estimators for the direct average treatment effect on the treated as well as the average spillover effects under a modified parallel trends assumption. I later relax common restrictions in the literature, such as immediate neighborhood interference and correctly specified spillover functions. Moreover, robust inference is discussed based on the asymptotic distribution of the proposed estimators.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106304.abstract_zh: 在许多场景中，例如基于地点的政策评估，潜在结果不仅取决于个体自身的处理状态，还取决于其邻居的处理状态。然而，典型的“双重差分”（DID）类估计量通常忽略了这种邻居间的相互干扰。本文表明，在存在邻居干扰的情况下，经典DID估计量通常无法识别有意义的因果效应。为了将干扰结构纳入DID估计，本文在修正的平行趋势假设下，提出了针对处理组的直接平均处理效应以及平均溢出效应的双重稳健估计量。随后，本文放宽了文献中的常见限制条件，例如直接邻居干扰和正确设定的溢出函数。此外，基于所提估计量的渐近分布，本文讨论了稳健推断方法。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106304.title: Difference-in-differences with interference
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106304.title_zh: 存在干扰的双重差分法

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106305.abstract: Instrumental variable models with repeated endogenous treatments are popular in empirical research using pooled cross-sectional or short panel datasets. This paper proposes a novel semi-parametric approach that explicitly considers 1) path dependency in the contemporaneous treatment effect and 2) a direct carryover effect from past treatments. We demonstrate that when either of these new features is present, the standard two-stage least squares estimator is generally invalid. We apply the proposed semi-parametric estimation and inference approach to revisit the seminal work of Acemoglu et al. (2016). Using industry-level data, we find that the magnitude of contemporaneous impacts of increased Chinese import competition on US manufacturing employment depends on an industry’s past import exposure. In particular, industries with larger trade shocks in the 1990s tend to experience stronger impacts from contemporaneous trade shocks in the 2000s.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106305.abstract_zh: 含有重复内生处理变量的工具变量模型在利用混合截面数据或短面板数据的实证研究中颇为流行。本文提出了一种新颖的半参数方法，明确考虑了1)同期处理效应中的路径依赖性，以及2)过去处理带来的直接延续效应。我们证明，当这两种新特征中的任意一种存在时，标准的两阶段最小二乘估计量通常无效。我们将所提出的半参数估计与推断方法应用于重新审视Acemoglu等人(2016)的开创性工作。利用行业层面数据，我们发现中国进口竞争加剧对美国制造业就业的同期影响幅度取决于该行业过去的进口暴露程度。特别是，在1990年代经历较大贸易冲击的行业，往往在2000年代对同期贸易冲击的反应更为强烈。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106305.title: Instrumental variable regression with varying-intensity repeated treatments
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106305.title_zh: 变强度重复处理的工具变量回归

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106306.abstract: Accurately estimating the Phillips curve remains a significant methodological challenge. Recent panel data approaches reveal substantial cross-sectional heterogeneity, raising doubts about pooled estimates. This paper develops a novel group-based approach that systematically accounts for unobserved heterogeneity in the regional Phillips curve. We identify two distinct groups of U.S. states: one with a steep, significant Phillips curve, and another with a flat, insignificant relationship. Our results show that regional heterogeneity persists across regimes, with parameter nonlinearity emerging during recessions. Much of the flattening of the Phillips curve is region-specific, indicating the importance of both heterogeneity and nonlinearity in Phillips curve dynamics.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106306.abstract_zh: 准确估计菲利普斯曲线仍是一项重大的方法论挑战。近期面板数据方法揭示了显著的横截面异质性，引发了对合并估计的质疑。本文开发了一种新颖的基于分组的方法，系统性地考虑了区域菲利普斯曲线中的未观测异质性。我们识别出两组不同的美国州：一组具有陡峭且显著的菲利普斯曲线，另一组则呈现平坦且不显著的关系。我们的结果显示，区域异质性在不同制度下持续存在，参数非线性在经济衰退期间显现。菲利普斯曲线的大部分平坦化现象具有区域特定性，表明异质性和非线性在菲利普斯曲线动态中的重要性。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106306.title: Dissecting the Phillips curve: Evidence from cross-sectional heterogeneity and regime-dependent nonlinearity
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106306.title_zh: 剖析菲利普斯曲线：来自横截面异质性与体制依赖非线性的证据

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106307.abstract: This paper investigates estimation and inference for average treatment effects in completely randomized experiments when researchers observe potentially many covariates. Within Neyman's (1923) design-based framework, allowing the number of covariates to grow more slowly than the sample size, we demonstrate that a cross-fitted regression adjustment estimator--adapted from Aronow and Middleton (2013)--exhibits more favorable asymptotic properties than existing alternatives, such as Lin's (2013) regression adjustment estimator and the bias-corrected estimator of Lei and Ding (2021). For inference, we derive the first- and second-order terms in the stochastic expansions of regression-adjusted estimators, analyze the higher-order behavior of existing inference procedures, and introduce a modified version of the HC3 standard error. The proposed methods extend naturally to stratified experiments with large strata. Simulation studies show that the cross-fitted estimator, in combination with the modified HC3, provides accurate point estimates and reliable size control across a wide range of data-generating processes.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106307.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在完全随机化实验中，当研究者观察到可能众多协变量时，平均处理效应的估计与推断问题。在Neyman（1923）的设计框架内，允许协变量数量以慢于样本量的速度增长，我们证明了一种交叉拟合回归调整估计量——改编自Aronow和Middleton（2013）——相较于现有替代方法，如Lin（2013）的回归调整估计量和Lei与Ding（2021）的偏差校正估计量，展现出更优的渐近性质。在推断方面，我们推导了回归调整估计量随机展开中的一阶和二阶项，分析了现有推断程序的高阶行为，并引入了修正版HC3标准误。所提方法自然扩展至具有大层数的分层实验。模拟研究表明，交叉拟合估计量结合修正HC3，在广泛的数据生成过程中提供了精确的点估计和可靠的规模控制。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106307.title: Regression adjustment in completely randomized experiments with many covariates
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106307.title_zh: 完全随机实验中多协变量的回归调整

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106308.abstract: This paper proposes a novel time-varying model averaging (TVMA) approach to enhancing forecast accuracy for multivariate time series subject to structural changes. The TVMA method averages predictions from a set of time-varying vector autoregressive models using optimal time-varying combination weights selected by minimizing a penalized local criterion. This allows the relative importance of different models to adaptively evolve over time in response to structural shifts. We establish an asymptotic optimality for the proposed TVMA approach in achieving the lowest possible quadratic forecast errors. The convergence rate of the selected time-varying weights to the optimal weights minimizing expected quadratic errors is derived. Moreover, we show that when one or more correctly specified models exist, our method consistently assigns full weight to them, and an asymptotic normality for the TVMA estimators under some regularity conditions can be established. Furthermore, the proposed approach encompasses special cases including time-varying VAR models with exogenous predictors, as well as time-varying factor augmented VAR (FAVAR) models. Simulations and empirical applications illustrate the proposed TVMA method outperforms some commonly used model averaging and selection methods in the presence of structural changes.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106308.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的时变模型平均（TVMA）方法，旨在提升面临结构变化的多变量时间序列预测准确性。TVMA方法通过最小化惩罚局部准则选取最优时变组合权重，对一组时变向量自回归模型的预测结果进行平均。这使得不同模型的相对重要性能够随时间自适应调整，以应对结构转变。我们为所提出的TVMA方法建立了渐近最优性，确保其达到最低可能的二次预测误差。同时，推导了所选时变权重向最小化期望二次误差的最优权重收敛的速度。此外，我们证明，在存在一个或多个正确设定模型的情况下，该方法能一致地将全部权重赋予这些模型，并在一定正则条件下，可建立TVMA估计量的渐近正态性。进一步地，所提方法涵盖了特殊情形，包括含外生预测变量的时变VAR模型，以及时变因子增强VAR（FAVAR）模型。模拟与实证应用表明，在结构变化存在时，所提出的TVMA方法优于一些常用的模型平均与选择方法。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106308.title: Model averaging for time–varying vector autoregressions
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106308.title_zh: 时变向量自回归的模型平均

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106309.abstract: This paper develops a test for coefficient variability in spatial regressions. The test is designed to have good power for a wide range of persistent patterns of coefficient variation, be applicable in a wide range of spatial designs, and accommodate spatial correlation in regressors and regression errors. The test approximates the locally best invariant test for coefficient stability in a Gaussian regression model with martingale-like coefficient variation under the alternative, and is thus a spatial generalization of the Nyblom (1989) test of coefficient stability in time series regressions.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106309.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种针对空间回归中系数变异性的检验方法。该检验旨在对广泛的持续性系数变化模式具有良好的检验功效，适用于多种空间设计，并能容纳回归因子及回归误差中的空间相关性。此检验近似于高斯回归模型中系数稳定性检验的局部最优不变检验，其中备择假设下系数变化具有类鞅性质，因此它是Nyblom（1989）时间序列回归系数稳定性检验的空间推广。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106309.title: Testing coefficient stability in spatial regression
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106309.title_zh: 检验空间回归中的系数稳定性

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106310.abstract: When observing spatial data, what standard errors should we report? Within a finite population framework, we identify three channels of possible spatial correlation: sampling scheme, assignment design, and model specification. The Eicker-Huber-White standard error, cluster-robust standard error, and spatial-correlation robust inference are compared under different combinations of the three channels. We prove a finite population central limit theorem for weakly dependent random fields that bridges the gap between superpopulation and finite population inference in our unified framework. These limit theorems are then applied to derive the asymptotic distribution of M-estimators and functions of M-estimators. Based on the decomposition of the finite population variance-covariance matrix of M-estimators, standard errors should be adjusted for spatial correlation when effective assignment variables are spatially correlated and/or spillover effects are specified in the model. In the special case where the sampling probabilities approach zero in the limit, the Eicker-Huber-White and cluster-robust standard errors would be close to the spatial-correlation robust standard errors regardless of the spatial correlation among assignment variables.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106310.abstract_zh: 在观测空间数据时，我们应报告何种标准误？在有限总体框架内，我们识别了可能产生空间相关性的三个渠道：抽样方案、分配设计和模型设定。我们比较了在不同组合下的Eicker-Huber-White标准误、聚类稳健标准误和空间相关稳健推断。我们证明了弱依赖随机场的有限总体中心极限定理，该定理在我们的统一框架中弥合了超总体与有限总体推断之间的差距。这些极限定理随后被应用于推导M估计量及其函数的渐近分布。基于M估计量有限总体方差-协方差矩阵的分解，当有效分配变量存在空间相关性且/或模型中设定了溢出效应时，标准误应针对空间相关性进行调整。在抽样概率极限趋近于零的特殊情况下，无论分配变量间的空间相关性如何，Eicker-Huber-White和聚类稳健标准误将接近空间相关稳健标准误。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106310.title: A design-based approach to spatial correlation
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106310.title_zh: 基于设计的方法处理空间相关性

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106311.abstract: This paper develops inference tools for the number of common latent factors across two large cross-sectional panels observed over a short time span (large n, small T). Our approach builds on a general test for determining the dimension of the intersection of two matrix column spaces, where each matrix is estimated with noise. The proposed test statistics are based on canonical correlations, and their asymptotic distributions are derived via perturbation methods. An empirical application to large cross-sections of monthly US stock returns and corporate bond returns finds that, on average, five latent factors influence both asset classes over an 18-month period. Our results suggest that a plausible candidate for a common factor is a stock portfolio with weights sorted on book leverage. Overall, the common factors between the two asset classes behave more like stock characteristic portfolios than bond characteristic portfolios, both in terms of pricing performance and time series dynamics.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106311.abstract_zh: 本文开发了针对两个大型横截面面板在短时间跨度内（大n，小T）共同潜在因子数量的推断工具。我们的方法基于一个通用检验，用于确定两个矩阵列空间交集的维度，其中每个矩阵均含噪声估计。所提出的检验统计量基于典型相关，其渐近分布通过扰动方法推导得出。一项对月度美国股票回报和企业债券回报的大型横截面的实证应用发现，平均而言，在18个月期间内有五个潜在因子影响这两类资产。我们的结果表明，一个可能的共同因子候选是依据账面杠杆排序权重的股票组合。总体而言，这两类资产之间的共同因子在定价表现和时间序列动态方面，更类似于股票特征组合而非债券特征组合。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106311.title: Testing for common latent factors across two short panels
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106311.title_zh: 检验两个短面板中的共同潜在因子

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106312.abstract: How many experimental studies would have come to different conclusions had they been run on larger samples? I show how to estimate the expected number of statistically significant results that a set of experiments would have reported had their sample sizes all been counterfactually increased. The proposed deconvolution estimator is asymptotically normal and adjusts for publication bias. Unlike related methods, this approach requires no assumptions about the distribution of true intervention treatment effects and allows for point masses. Simulations find good coverage even when the t-score is only approximately normal. An application to randomized trials (RCTs) published in economics journals finds that doubling every sample would increase the power of t-tests by 7.2 percentage points on average. This effect is smaller than for non-RCTs and comparable to systematic replications in laboratory psychology where previous studies enabled more accurate power calculations. This suggests that RCTs are on average relatively insensitive to sample size increases. Research funders who wish to raise power should generally consider sponsoring better-measured and higher-quality experiments—rather than only larger ones.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106312.abstract_zh: 如果有更多实验研究在更大样本量下进行，它们会得出多少不同的结论？我展示了如何估计一组实验在样本量均被反事实增加的情况下，原本会报告出的统计显著结果数量的期望值。所提出的反卷积估计量渐近正态，并对发表偏倚进行了调整。与相关方法不同，此方法无需对真实干预处理效应的分布做出假设，并允许存在点质量。模拟结果显示，即使t分数仅近似正态，覆盖率也表现良好。应用于经济学期刊上发表的随机对照试验（RCTs）发现，将每个样本量加倍会使t检验的平均功效提高7.2个百分点。这一效应小于非随机对照试验，并与实验室心理学中的系统性重复研究相当，后者先前的研究使得功效计算更为精确。这表明随机对照试验平均而言对样本量增加的敏感性相对较低。希望提高功效的研究资助者通常应考虑资助测量更精确、质量更高的实验——而不仅仅是规模更大的实验。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106312.title: Testing for underpowered literatures

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106313.abstract: This article proposes a graph-based maximum pairwise difference (MPD) test to compare K-sample distributions. This test can be utilized to identify the most informative variables contributing to the heterogeneity of multiple multivariate distributions. To construct the test, we first pool observations from multiple samples to create a similarity graph based on the distances between any two observations. For each observation, we next evaluate its connection probability to each sample. Then, we doubly maximize the squared differences of these connection probabilities via the within and between samples. Accordingly, the MPD test is a max-of-squares test and can effectively detect sparse alternatives. In addition, we show the asymptotic null distribution of the test statistic and establish its consistency under alternatives. To illustrate the finite sample performance of the proposed test, we conduct extensive simulation studies. The results indicate that the MPD test outperforms some commonly used multisample tests. Finally, we employ it to select relevant features related to corporate credit ratings.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106313.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于图的最大成对差异（MPD）检验，用于比较K个样本的分布。该检验可用于识别对多个多元分布异质性贡献最大的信息变量。为构建此检验，我们首先将多个样本的观测值合并，基于任意两个观测值之间的距离构建相似图。随后，对每个观测值，评估其与各样本的连接概率。接着，通过样本内与样本间的双重最大化，对这些连接概率的平方差进行最大化处理。因此，MPD检验是一种平方最大值检验，能有效检测稀疏备择假设。此外，我们展示了检验统计量的渐近零分布，并确立了其在备择假设下的一致性。为说明所提检验的有限样本性能，我们进行了广泛的模拟研究。结果表明，MPD检验优于一些常用的多样本检验。最后，我们将其应用于与企业信用评级相关的特征选择。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106313.title: Graph-based multisample comparison with application to feature selection for multi-category responses
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106313.title_zh: 基于图的多样本比较及其在多类别响应特征选择中的应用

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106315.abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of forecasting corporate distress, a problem marked by three key statistical hurdles: (i) right censoring, (ii) high-dimensional predictors, and (iii) mixed-frequency data. To overcome these complexities, we introduce a novel high-dimensional censored MIDAS (Mixed Data Sampling) logistic regression. Our approach handles censoring through inverse probability weighting and achieves accurate estimation with numerous mixed-frequency predictors by employing a sparse-group penalty. We establish finite-sample bounds for the estimation error, accounting for censoring, MIDAS approximation error, and heavy tails. For statistical inference, we develop a de-sparsified version of the proposed penalized estimator and establish its asymptotic theory, which enables valid statistical inference in high-dimensional settings with censoring. We show that censoring induces a nonstandard variance structure for the de-sparsified estimator, a feature that, to the best of our knowledge, has not been studied in the existing literature. The superior performance of the method is demonstrated through Monte Carlo simulations. Finally, we present an extensive application of our methodology to predict the financial distress of Chinese-listed firms and to identify covariates that are statistically significant for predicting distress. Our novel procedure is implemented in the R package Survivalml.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106315.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了企业困境预测这一挑战，该问题面临三个关键统计障碍：（i）右删失，（ii）高维预测变量，以及（iii）混合频率数据。为克服这些复杂性，我们引入了一种新颖的高维删失MIDAS（混合数据采样）逻辑回归模型。我们的方法通过逆概率加权处理删失问题，并利用稀疏组惩罚在众多混合频率预测变量下实现精确估计。我们建立了估计误差的有限样本界，同时考虑了删失、MIDAS近似误差和重尾分布。在统计推断方面，我们开发了所提惩罚估计量的去稀疏化版本，并建立了其渐近理论，从而在高维删失情境下实现有效的统计推断。我们证明，删失会诱导去稀疏化估计量产生非标准方差结构，据我们所知，这一特征在现有文献中尚未被研究。通过蒙特卡洛模拟展示了该方法优越的性能。最后，我们对该方法进行了广泛的应用，以预测中国上市公司的财务困境，并识别对预测困境具有统计显著性的协变量。我们的新程序已在R包Survivalml中实现。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106315.title: High-dimensional censored MIDAS logistic regression for corporate survival forecasting
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106315.title_zh: 高维删失MIDAS逻辑回归在企业生存预测中的应用

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106317.abstract: This paper develops a procedure for uncovering the common cyclical factors that drive a mix of stationary and nonstationary variables. The method does not require knowing which variables are nonstationary or the nature of the nonstationarity. An application to the FRED-MD macroeconomic dataset demonstrates that the approach offers similar benefits to those oftraditional principal component analysis with some added advantages.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106317.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，用于揭示驱动平稳与非平稳变量混合体的共同周期因子。该方法无需预先知晓哪些变量是非平稳的，也无需了解非平稳性的具体性质。将此法应用于FRED-MD宏观经济数据集，结果显示，该方法在提供与传统主成分分析相似益处的同时，还具备一些额外优势。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106317.title: Principal component analysis for a mix of stationary and nonstationary variables
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106317.title_zh: 平稳与非平稳变量混合的主成分分析

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106318.abstract: Consensus professional stock return forecasts are three times more volatile than those of non-professionals and econometricians. We show that this difference reflects professionals’ strong countercyclical responses to macro shocks, which explain 20–40% of forecast variation and are consistent with rational asset pricing models in which discount rates rise in bad times. We use macro shocks to identify the discount-rate component of professional forecasts and find that it closely matches realized returns. We conclude that professionals’ assessment of the discount-rate impact of macro shocks distinguishes them from other forecasts, challenging existing models of expectation formation.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106318.abstract_zh: 共识性专业股票收益预测的波动性是非专业人士和计量经济学家的三倍。我们表明，这一差异反映了专业人士对宏观冲击的强烈逆周期反应，这些反应解释了预测变异的20%-40%，并与理性资产定价模型一致，即折现率在经济不景气时上升。我们利用宏观冲击来识别专业预测中的折现率成分，并发现其与实际回报紧密匹配。我们得出结论，专业人士对宏观冲击折现率影响的评估使其区别于其他预测，这对现有的预期形成模型提出了挑战。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106318.title: What drives the volatility of professional stock return forecasts? Causal evidence from macro shocks
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106318.title_zh: 宏观经济冲击对专业股票收益预测波动性的因果影响

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106319.abstract: Motivated by predicting intraday trading volume curves, we consider two spatio-temporal autoregressive models for matrix time series, in which each column may represent daily trading volume curve of one asset, and each row captures synchronized 5-minute volume intervals across multiple assets. While traditional matrix time series focus mainly on temporal evolution, our approach incorporates both spatial and temporal dynamics, enabling simultaneous analysis of interactions across multiple dimensions. The inherent endogeneity in spatio-temporal autoregressive models renders ordinary least squares estimation inconsistent. To overcome this difficulty while simultaneously estimating two distinct weight matrices with banded structure, we develop an iterated generalized Yule-Walker estimator by adapting a generalized method of moments framework based on Yule-Walker equations. Moreover, unlike conventional models that employ a single bandwidth parameter, the dual-bandwidth specification in our framework requires a new two-step, ratio-based sequential estimation procedure.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106319.abstract_zh: 受日内交易量曲线预测的启发，我们针对矩阵时间序列考虑了两种时空自回归模型，其中每一列可代表某一资产的日交易量曲线，每一行则捕捉多个资产间同步的5分钟交易量区间。传统矩阵时间序列主要关注时间演化，而我们的方法融合了空间与时间动态，能够同时分析多个维度间的交互作用。时空自回归模型中固有的内生性使得普通最小二乘估计不一致。为克服这一难题，同时估计两个具有带状结构的独特权重矩阵，我们通过基于Yule-Walker方程的广义矩方法框架，开发了一种迭代广义Yule-Walker估计量。此外，不同于采用单一带宽参数的传统模型，我们框架中的双带宽设定要求一种新的基于比率的两步顺序估计程序。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106319.title: Spatio-temporal autoregressions for high dimensional matrix-valued time series
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106319.title_zh: 高维矩阵值时间序列的时空自回归模型

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106320.abstract: Predictive regression models are often used to evaluate the predictive capability of economic fundamentals on bond and equity returns. Inferential procedures in these regressions typically employ parameter constancy or piecewise constancy in slope coefficients. Such formulations are prone to misspecification, more especially during periods of disturbance or evolution in prevailing economic and financial conditions, which can lead to size distortion and spurious evidence of predictability. To address these issues the present work proposes a semiparametric predictive regression model with mixed-root regressors and time-varying coefficients that allow for smooth evolution in the generating mechanism over time. For estimation and inference a novel variant of the self-generated instrument approach called sieve-IVX is introduced, giving a robust approach to inference concerning time-varying predictability that is applicable irrespective of the degrees of persistence. Asymptotic theory of the Sieve-IVX approach is based on a new infinite dimensional invariance principle that delivers limit theory for sieve-IVX estimation, validating pointwise and uniform inference procedures for testing predictability and model specification. Simulations show excellent performance characteristics of the resulting tests in finite samples. An empirical exercise is conducted examining excess S&P 500 returns, applying Sieve-IVX regression with pointwise and uniform tests to reveal evidence of time-varying patterns in the predictive capability of commonly used fundamental variables.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106320.abstract_zh: 预测性回归模型常被用于评估经济基本面因素对债券和股票收益的预测能力。在这些回归中，推断程序通常假设斜率系数恒定或分段恒定。这种设定容易产生模型误设，尤其是在经济金融状况动荡或演变的时期，可能导致检验规模失真及虚假的预测性证据。为解决这些问题，本研究提出了一种半参数预测性回归模型，该模型包含混合根回归因子及随时间平滑演变的时变系数。在估计与推断方面，引入了一种新颖的自生成工具变量变体，称为sieve-IVX，为时变预测性的推断提供了稳健方法，且适用于各种持久性程度。Sieve-IVX方法的渐近理论基于一个新的无限维不变原理，该原理为sieve-IVX估计提供了极限理论，验证了点态与均匀推断程序在检验预测性和模型设定方面的有效性。模拟结果显示，所提出的检验在有限样本中具有优异的性能特征。本文还进行了实证分析，考察了标准普尔500指数的超额收益，应用Sieve-IVX回归及点态与均匀检验，揭示了常用基本面变量预测能力中的时变模式证据。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106320.title: Robust inference for time varying predictability: A Sieve-IVX approach
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106320.title_zh: 时变可预测性的稳健推断：一种Sieve-IVX方法

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106321.abstract: We show how clustering standard errors in one or more dimensions can be justified in M-estimation when there is sampling or assignment uncertainty. Since existing procedures for variance estimation are either conservative or invalid, we propose a variance estimator that refines a conservative procedure and remains valid. We then interpret environments where clustering is frequently employed in empirical work from our design-based perspective and provide insights on their estimands and inference procedures.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106321.abstract_zh: 我们展示了在M估计中，当存在抽样或分配不确定性时，如何在一个或多个维度上对标准误进行聚类是合理的。鉴于现有的方差估计程序要么保守要么无效，我们提出了一种方差估计器，它改进了保守程序并保持有效性。随后，我们从基于设计的视角解读了实证工作中频繁采用聚类的环境，并对其估计目标及推断程序提供了见解。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106321.title: Clustering with potential multidimensionality: Inference and practice
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106321.title_zh: 多维潜聚类：推断与实践

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106322.abstract: This paper provides statistical inference for marginal expected shortfall (MES) and delta conditional value-at-risk (ΔCoVaR) measures, which are semiparametrically estimated by a two-step procedure in a multivariate GARCH-type framework. We establish the asymptotic properties of corresponding estimators and illustrate how the estimation uncertainty can be decomposed into dynamic univariate marginal and time-varying dependence components. Our methodology reveals good finite sample performance for estimation and prediction of risk. Moreover, we propose tests for differences in systemic risk in order to construct confidence sets for companies’ ranks in systemic risk rankings. In an empirical application based on 50 large US financial institutions, our framework provides novel evidence on the informativeness of such rankings. Moreover, our findings highlight the importance of accounting for time-varying return dependence in systemic risk estimators.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106322.abstract_zh: 本文针对边际预期缺口（MES）与德尔塔条件风险价值（ΔCoVaR）指标提供了统计推断方法，这些指标在多元GARCH型框架下通过两步程序进行半参数估计。我们确立了相应估计量的渐近性质，并阐述了估计不确定性如何分解为动态单变量边际成分与时变依赖结构成分。我们的方法在风险估计与预测方面展现出良好的有限样本性能。此外，我们提出了系统性风险差异的检验方法，以构建公司系统性风险排名中的置信集。在基于50家美国大型金融机构的实证应用中，我们的框架为这些排名的信息含量提供了新颖证据。同时，我们的发现强调了在系统性风险估计中考虑时变收益依赖性的重要性。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106322.title: Multivariate inference for dynamic systemic risk measures
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106322.title_zh: 动态系统性风险测度的多元推断

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106323.abstract: We introduce a new time-varying parameter spatial matrix autoregressive model that integrates matrix-valued time series, heterogeneous spillover effects, outlier robustness, and time-varying parameters in one unified framework. The model allows for separate dynamic spatial spillover effects across both the row and column dimensions of the matrix-valued observations. Robustness can be introduced via a matrix Student’s t distribution. The model can still be estimated straightforwardly by standard maximum likelihood methods, and we establish stationarity and invertibility of the model, as well as consistency and asymptotic normality of its maximum likelihood estimator. Simulations reveal that the two-way spatial spillover dynamics can be successfully recovered even if the model is misspecified. Using a 12 × 12 trade network application, we show that the time-varying, robust matrix features of the new model better fit the empirical data than alternative specifications.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106323.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的时变参数空间矩阵自回归模型，该模型将矩阵值时间序列、异质性溢出效应、异常值稳健性以及时变参数整合在一个统一框架内。该模型允许在矩阵值观测的行和列两个维度上分别存在动态空间溢出效应。通过引入矩阵学生t分布，可以实现稳健性。该模型仍可通过标准最大似然方法简便估计，我们确立了模型的平稳性和可逆性，以及其最大似然估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。模拟结果表明，即使模型设定存在错误，双向空间溢出动态也能被成功恢复。通过一个12×12的贸易网络应用案例，我们展示了新模型的时变、稳健矩阵特征相比其他备选设定能更好地拟合实证数据。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106323.title: Matrix-valued spatial autoregressions with dynamic heterogeneous spillovers
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106323.title_zh: 矩阵值空间自回归模型中的动态异质性溢出效应

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106325.abstract: We establish normal approximation in the Wasserstein metric for both non-degenerate and degenerate second-order U-statistics under cross-sectional dependence using Stein’s method. For the non-degenerate case, our results extend recent studies on the asymptotic properties of sums of cross-sectionally dependent random variables. The degenerate case is more challenging due to the additional dependence induced by the nonlinearity of the U-statistic kernel. Through a specific implementation of Stein’s method, we derive convergence rates under conditions on the mixing rate, the sparsity of the cross-sectional dependence structure, and the moments of the U-statistic kernel. Finally, we demonstrate the application of our theoretical results with a nonparametric specification test for data with cross-sectional dependence.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106325.abstract_zh: 我们利用Stein方法，在横截面依赖条件下，针对非退化和退化二阶U统计量，建立了Wasserstein度量下的正态近似。对于非退化情形，我们的结果扩展了近期关于横截面依赖随机变量和渐近性质的研究。退化情形因U统计量核的非线性引入额外依赖性而更具挑战性。通过Stein方法的一种特定实现，我们在混合速率、横截面依赖结构的稀疏性以及U统计量核的矩条件下，推导出收敛速率。最后，我们通过一个针对横截面依赖数据的非参数设定检验，展示了我们理论结果的应用。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106325.title: Normal approximation for U-statistics with cross-sectional dependence
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106325.title_zh: 横截面依赖下U统计量的正态逼近

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106332.title: Identification of non-additive fixed effects models: Is the return to teacher quality homogeneous?
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106332.title_zh: 非加性固定效应模型的识别：教师质量的回报是同质的吗？

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106333.abstract: We propose a discrete Fourier transform (DFT)-based test for detecting structural changes in panel data models with interactive fixed effects (IFE). When structural changes are present but ignored, the conventional asymptotic distribution of the least squares (LS) estimator of Bai (2009) may no longer provide reliable inference, and the resulting residuals contain signals of parameter instability. Our test exploits this feature by comparing the DFT of weighted residuals to the flat (zero) spectrum implied under the null hypothesis of no structural change. We establish the theoretical properties of the test, including its asymptotic null distribution and its local and global power, and propose a bootstrap procedure for valid inference in finite samples. Notably, the proposed test can detect a class of local alternatives converging to the null at the rate of N − 1 / 2 T − 1 / 2 , matching the convergence rate of the slope estimators, where N and T are the cross-sectional and time dimensions, respectively. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the excellent performance of the proposed test across various types of structural changes in both factor loadings and slope coefficients. We further illustrate the empirical relevance of our method by applying it to the environmental Kuznets curve and the relationship between health expenditure and income. Our findings highlight the importance of accounting for structural changes in panel data models with IFE.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106333.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于离散傅里叶变换（DFT）的检验方法，用于检测具有交互固定效应（IFE）的面板数据模型中的结构变化。当存在结构变化但被忽略时，Bai（2009）的最小二乘（LS）估计量的传统渐近分布可能不再提供可靠的推断，由此产生的残差中包含了参数不稳定性的信号。我们的检验利用这一特性，将加权残差的DFT与无结构变化原假设下隐含的平坦（零）谱进行比较。我们确立了该检验的理论性质，包括其渐近零分布以及局部和全局功效，并提出了一种自助法程序，以在有限样本中进行有效推断。值得注意的是，所提出的检验能够检测一类以N−1/2T−1/2速率收敛于零假设的局部备择假设，这与斜率估计量的收敛速率相匹配，其中N和T分别代表截面维度和时间维度。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的检验在因子载荷和斜率系数的各种结构变化类型下均表现出优异的性能。我们进一步通过将其应用于环境库兹涅茨曲线以及健康支出与收入之间的关系，展示了我们方法的实证相关性。我们的发现强调了在具有IFE的面板数据模型中考虑结构变化的重要性。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106333.title: Testing for structural changes in panel data models with interactive fixed effects via discrete Fourier transform
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106333.title_zh: 基于离散傅里叶变换的面板数据交互固定效应模型结构变化检验

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106334.abstract: This article introduces an iterative distributed computing (IDC) estimator for the multinomial logistic regression model with large choice sets. The IDC estimator reformulates the estimation problem as a sequence of structured, low-dimensional subproblems that can be solved efficiently and in parallel. We establish that, when initialized with a consistent estimator, the IDC estimator is asymptotically equivalent to the maximum likelihood estimator and achieves asymptotic efficiency under a weak dominance condition. We further develop a parametric bootstrap procedure for inference based on the IDC estimator and prove its consistency. Extensive simulation studies validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods and highlight the computational efficiency of the IDC estimator.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106334.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于大选择集多项逻辑回归模型的迭代分布式计算（IDC）估计量。IDC估计量将估计问题重构为一系列结构化、低维的子问题，这些子问题可高效并行求解。我们证明，在初始化为一致估计量的条件下，IDC估计量与最大似然估计量渐近等价，并在弱支配条件下实现渐近有效性。我们进一步开发了一种基于IDC估计量的参数自助法推断程序，并证明了其一致性。广泛的模拟研究验证了所提方法的有效性，并凸显了IDC估计量的计算效率。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106334.title: Iterative distributed multinomial regression
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106334.title_zh: 迭代式分布式多项回归

10.1016/j.jedc.2020.103885.abstract: We develop a model with incomplete asset markets and household heterogeneity in market and home technologies and preferences to account for these labor market trends and assess their welfare consequences. Using micro data on expenditures and time use, we identify the sources of heterogeneity across households, document how these sources have changed over time, and perform counterfactual analyses. Given the observed increase in leisure expenditures relative to leisure time and the complementarity of these inputs in leisure technology, we infer a significant increase in the average productivity of time spent on leisure. The increasing productivity of leisure time generates significant welfare gains for the average household and moderates negative welfare effects from the rising dispersion of expenditures and time allocation across households.
10.1016/j.jedc.2020.103885.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含不完全资产市场以及家庭在市场、家庭技术和偏好方面异质性的模型，以解释这些劳动力市场趋势并评估其福利后果。利用支出和时间使用的微观数据，我们识别了家庭间异质性的来源，记录了这些来源随时间的变化，并进行了反事实分析。鉴于休闲支出相对于休闲时间的增加，以及这些投入在休闲技术中的互补性，我们推断出休闲时间平均生产率显著提升。休闲时间生产率的提高为平均家庭带来了显著的福利收益，并缓和了因支出和家庭间时间分配离散度上升而产生的负面福利效应。

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105313.abstract: Are standard production network properties similar across all available datasets, and if not, why? We provide benchmark results from two administrative datasets (Ecuador and Hungary), which are exceptional in that they have no reporting threshold. We compare these networks with a leading commercial dataset (FactSet) and published results on national firm-level production networks. Administrative datasets with no reporting thresholds have remarkably similar quantitative properties, while a number of important properties are biased in datasets with missing data.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105313.abstract_zh: 标准生产网络属性在所有可用数据集中是否相似？若否，原因何在？我们提供了来自两个行政数据集（厄瓜多尔和匈牙利）的基准结果，这些数据集因其无报告门槛而尤为特殊。我们将这些网络与领先的商业数据集（FactSet）及已发表的关于国家企业级生产网络的结果进行比较。无报告门槛的行政数据集在定量属性上表现出显著相似性，而含缺失数据的数据集中若干重要属性则存在偏差。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105313.title: Firm-level production networks: What do we (really) know?
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105313.title_zh: 企业层面的生产网络：我们（真正）了解什么？

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105315.abstract: The skewed Kalman filter (SKF) extends the classical Gaussian Kalman filter by accommodating asymmetric error distributions in linear state-space models. We introduce a computationally efficient method to mitigate the curse of increasing skewness dimensions inherent in the SKF. By analyzing skewness propagation in state-space systems, we develop the pruned skewed Kalman filter (PSKF), which eliminates elements in cumulative distribution functions that do not significantly impact asymmetry beyond a specified threshold. Extensive simulations on univariate and multivariate state-space models validate the PSKF’s accuracy and efficiency. Additionally, we derive the skewed Kalman smoother and its pruned variant, applying them to estimate a New Keynesian DSGE model using US data via standard maximum likelihood and Bayesian MCMC methods. Results strongly favor skewed distributions, particularly for productivity and monetary policy shocks.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105315.abstract_zh: 偏斜卡尔曼滤波器（SKF）通过适应线性状态空间模型中的非对称误差分布，扩展了经典高斯卡尔曼滤波器。我们引入了一种计算高效的方法，以缓解SKF中偏斜维度增加所带来的维数灾难。通过分析状态空间系统中的偏斜传播机制，我们开发了剪枝偏斜卡尔曼滤波器（PSKF），该滤波器在累积分布函数中剔除那些在指定阈值以上对非对称性影响不显著的元素。对单变量和多变量状态空间模型的大量模拟验证了PSKF的准确性和效率。此外，我们推导了偏斜卡尔曼平滑器及其剪枝变体，并将其应用于使用美国数据通过标准最大似然和贝叶斯MCMC方法估计新凯恩斯DSGE模型。结果强烈支持偏斜分布，尤其是对生产率和货币政策冲击而言。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105315.title: Pruned skewed Kalman filter and smoother with application to DSGE models
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105315.title_zh: 剪枝偏斜卡尔曼滤波与平滑器及其在DSGE模型中的应用

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105317.abstract: This paper constructs an overlapping generation model that integrates endogenous marital formation and parental human capital investment decisions to characterize the joint determination of the distributions of family structure and college attainment. We use the model to examine the effects of public policies that reallocate college enrollment opportunities based on students’ social and economic status. We find that such policies may equalize college enrollment rates but lower college completion rates, marriage rates, and overall welfare. These outcomes arise from distorted parental investment incentives and a shift in family composition toward single and non-college-educated households, which invest less in children’s human capital relative to households with college-educated parents. These findings highlight disparities in the family structures in which children grow up as a fundamental source of inequality in college education.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105317.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个融合内生婚姻形成与父母人力资本投资决策的世代交叠模型，用以刻画家庭结构与大学教育成就分布的联合决定机制。我们利用该模型考察了基于学生社会经济地位重新分配大学入学机会的公共政策效应。研究发现，此类政策虽可能使大学入学率趋于均等，但会降低大学毕业率、结婚率及整体福利水平。这些结果源于父母投资激励的扭曲，以及家庭构成向单亲及非大学教育背景家庭转变，这类家庭相对于拥有大学教育背景父母的家庭，对子女人力资本的投资较少。这些发现凸显了儿童成长所面临的家庭结构差异，是大学教育不平等的一个根本性来源。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105317.title: A tale of two families: marital formation, parental human capital investment and college attainment
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105317.title_zh: 两个家庭的故事：婚姻形成、父母人力资本投资与大学教育获得

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105319.abstract: We examine innovation in an n -player market-entry timing game with complete information and observable actions. In our novel multi-player setup, we allow for heterogeneous payoffs between players and leader payoff functions to be multi-peaked and non-monotonic, only requiring that followers’ payoffs are non-increasing with the time of the leader’s entry. We outline the conditions under which an n -player asymmetric game leads to standard second-mover advantage and preemption equilibria. In the context of a two-player game, we provide a comprehensive characterization of the pure-strategy equilibria for a general case. This includes the potential for the emergence of a new type of preemption equilibrium, as well as scenarios where no equilibria in pure strategies exist. Finally, we connect our findings to various applications, offering a new explanation for entry clustering among heterogeneous players
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105319.abstract_zh: 我们考察了一个在完全信息且行动可观察的n人市场进入时机博弈中的创新问题。在我们新颖的多参与者设定中，我们允许参与者之间的收益异质性，且领导者收益函数可为多峰且非单调的，仅要求追随者的收益随领导者进入时间的推移而非递增。我们概述了n人非对称博弈导致标准后发优势与抢占均衡的条件。在两人博弈的背景下，我们对一般情形下的纯策略均衡进行了全面刻画。这包括新型抢占均衡可能出现的可能性，以及纯策略下不存在均衡的情景。最后，我们将我们的发现与多种应用联系起来，为异质性参与者之间的进入聚集现象提供了新的解释。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105319.title: General timing games with multiple players
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105319.title_zh: 多参与者的广义时机博弈

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105320.abstract: Measures of stock market volatility, such as the cross-sectional dispersion of firm-level stock returns and the time-series volatility of market returns, fluctuate countercyclically. While this phenomenon is often used as evidence that exogenous rises in uncertainty lead to economic recessions, we show that first-moment productivity shocks can cause countercyclical fluctuations in stock market volatility. We study a dynamic model with costly state verification, allowing for ex-ante monitoring that can credibly compel borrowers to reveal true investment outcomes to lenders, thereby reducing information asymmetry. Interpreting these financial contracts as external equities, we show that the calibrated model, with only first-moment shocks, can generate cyclical fluctuations in equity return volatility and financial conditions, with correlation coefficients between pairs of these measures quantitatively in line with the data.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105320.abstract_zh: 股票市场波动性的度量指标，如公司层面股票收益的横截面离散度和市场收益的时间序列波动性，呈现出逆周期波动。尽管这一现象常被用作外生不确定性上升导致经济衰退的证据，但我们表明，一阶矩生产率冲击能够引发股票市场波动性的逆周期波动。我们研究了一个带有昂贵状态验证的动态模型，允许事前监督，这种监督能够可信地迫使借款人向贷款人揭示真实投资结果，从而减少信息不对称。将这些金融合约解释为外部股权，我们表明，仅含一阶矩冲击的校准模型能够生成股权收益波动性和金融状况的周期性波动，且这些度量指标之间的相关系数在数量上与数据相符。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105320.title: Endogenous dispersion and volatility in stock returns
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105320.title_zh: 股票收益的内生离散度与波动性

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105321.abstract: This paper examines the drivers of income inequality during the expansion of secondary education. We build a general equilibrium model with endogenous demand and supply of high school graduates and show that skill-biased technological change alone cannot explain the rise in educational attainment alongside the decline in the skill premium during the American high school movement. Instead, increased public spending on secondary education is key. Calibrating the model to U.S. data from 1830 to 1980, we assess the joint effects of technological change and education policy on long-run inequality. Through counterfactual historical analysis, we demonstrate that the expansion of public secondary education played a pivotal role in reducing income disparities during the 20th century. Panel regression for the 49 states give further evidence for the public spending channel.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105321.abstract_zh: 本文考察了中等教育扩张期间收入不平等的影响因素。我们构建了一个包含高中毕业生内生供需的一般均衡模型，并证明仅凭技能偏向型技术进步无法解释美国高中运动期间教育普及率上升与技能溢价下降并存的现象。相反，公共教育支出的增加是关键因素。通过将模型校准至1830年至1980年的美国数据，我们评估了技术进步与教育政策对长期不平等的联合效应。通过反事实历史分析，我们证明公共中等教育的扩展在20世纪减少收入差距方面发挥了关键作用。针对49个州的面板回归进一步为公共支出渠道提供了证据。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105321.title: Public high school expansion and income inequality: Revisiting the race between education and technology
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105321.title_zh: 公立高中扩张与收入不平等：重访教育与技术的赛跑

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105322.abstract: We introduce a novel method to quantify perceived global risk and ambiguity in media attention using content analysis. First, we apply structural topic modeling to risk-related news articles to identify distinct sources of uncertainty. We define ambiguity in attention as the variability in the distribution of topic probabilities across articles—that is, the extent to which media coverage diverges in its focus on different topics. In contrast, perceived risk is measured as the share of articles that assign a particular topic as their primary focus. We then examine whether these measures of perceived global risk and ambiguity in attention can explain changes in credit default swap (CDS) spreads. Our results show that greater ambiguity in news media attention is associated with a decrease in CDS spreads by up to 5.9%, while higher perceived risk corresponds to an increase of up to 4.9%. These findings highlight the role of media-driven uncertainty in shaping investor behavior and market risk perceptions.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105322.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法，通过内容分析来量化媒体关注中的感知全球风险与模糊性。首先，我们将结构主题模型应用于风险相关新闻文章，以识别不确定性的不同来源。我们将注意力中的模糊性定义为文章间主题概率分布的变异性——即媒体覆盖在不同主题上的关注分散程度。相比之下，感知风险则通过将特定主题作为主要焦点的文章占比来衡量。随后，我们考察了这些感知全球风险与注意力模糊性的度量是否能解释信用违约互换（CDS）利差的变化。结果显示，新闻媒体注意力中更高的模糊性与CDS利差下降高达5.9%相关联，而更高的感知风险则对应利差上升高达4.9%。这些发现凸显了媒体驱动的确定性在塑造投资者行为和市场风险感知中的作用。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105322.title: Decoding news: How media risk and ambiguity shape CDS spreads
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105322.title_zh: 解读新闻：媒体风险与模糊性如何影响信用违约互换利差

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105330.abstract: We leverage microdata to identify macro shocks in time series settings. We exploit firm-level forecast errors on prices and production along with information on production impediments to construct a shock series capturing input material constraints. The resulting shock series is not related to other common macro economic shocks, but is correlated with major events that likely triggered input material constraints. We find that tightening shocks have a persistent effect on prices, while the negative impact on production is short-lived. However, industrial production remains subdued for an extended period. Decomposing the instrument into its individual components allows to contrast the response to input material shocks with that to any other generic supply shock. Additionally, we demonstrate that the construction of the shock series is robust to variations in the underlying identification assumptions at the micro-level.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105330.abstract_zh: 我们利用微观数据来识别时间序列设定中的宏观冲击。通过结合企业在价格和生产方面的预测误差以及生产障碍的相关信息，我们构建了一个捕捉投入材料约束的冲击序列。该冲击序列与其他常见宏观经济冲击无关，但与可能引发投入材料约束的重大事件相关联。研究发现，紧缩性冲击对价格具有持续性影响，而对生产的负面效应则是短暂的。然而，工业产出在较长时期内仍保持低迷。将工具变量分解为其各个组成部分，可以对比投入材料冲击与任何其他一般性供给冲击的响应差异。此外，我们证明该冲击序列的构建对微观层面潜在识别假设的变化具有稳健性。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105330.title: Identifying macroeconomic shocks using firm-level data: Material shortages in the German manufacturing sector
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105330.title_zh: 利用企业层面数据识别宏观经济冲击：德国制造业的原材料短缺

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105331.abstract: The nonlinear nexus between financial conditions indicators and the conditional distribution of GDP growth has recently been challenged. We show how one can use textual economic news and word embeddings to construct an alternative indicator which by design associates growth-at-risk to news about financial conditions. We then document that the proposed indicator is particularly informative about the lower left tail of the GDP distribution and delivers significantly better out-of-sample density forecasts than commonly used alternatives. Speaking to theories on endogenous information choice and credit-market sentiment we further document that the news-based index likely carries information about beliefs rather than fundamentals.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105331.abstract_zh: 金融状况指标与GDP增长条件分布之间的非线性关联近期受到质疑。我们展示了如何利用文本经济新闻和词嵌入构建一个替代指标，该指标在设计上就将增长风险与金融状况新闻相关联。随后，我们证明所提出的指标对GDP分布左下尾尤为信息丰富，并在样本外密度预测方面显著优于常用替代指标。结合内生信息选择与信贷市场情绪的理论，我们进一步记录到，基于新闻的指数可能承载的是关于信念而非基本面的信息。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105331.title: Risky news and credit market sentiment
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105331.title_zh: 风险新闻与信贷市场情绪

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105332.abstract: To identify shocks in VARs using short-run sign or exclusion restrictions, the highest-frequency data possible is usually preferred. For income inequality, there is tension be-tween high frequency and high quality. Annual datasets that survey large numbers of people provide high-quality estimates of income. Higher frequency surveys generally provide a sparser sampling of individual income. Some previous studies have used the higher frequency data, presumably to match the frequency necessary to identify the shock. Using data obtained from the higher frequency, lower respondent surveys might result in misleading conclusions. We combine the two surveys and construct a set of quarterly-frequency income quantiles that are scaled to the annual data but (cid:135)uctuate according to the high-frequency survey. We show that using these data yields di⁄erent economic conclusions than simply using the raw high-frequency income series. In particular, we show in two simple applications to technology shocks and house price shocks that one obtains di⁄erent conclusions about the permanence and/or the direction of the responses of income inequality
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105332.abstract_zh: 为了利用短期符号或排除限制来识别VAR中的冲击，通常倾向于使用尽可能高频的数据。然而，对于收入不平等而言，高频与高质量之间存在张力。每年调查大量人群的数据集能提供高质量的估计收入，而更高频率的调查通常对个人收入的抽样更为稀疏。一些先前的研究使用了较高频率的数据，推测是为了匹配识别冲击所需的频率。使用来自高频但受访者较少的数据可能导致误导性结论。我们结合两种调查，构建了一组季度频率的收入分位数，这些分位数按年度数据缩放，但根据高频调查波动。我们表明，使用这些数据得出的经济结论与直接使用原始高频收入序列不同。特别是，在两个简单应用中——技术冲击和房价冲击——我们发现关于收入不平等响应的持久性和/或方向会得出不同结论。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105332.title: Measuring the effect of shocks on inequality: It’s all about the data
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105332.title_zh: 衡量冲击对不平等的影响：关键在于数据

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105333.abstract: Supply chain disruptions constitute a widely neglected risk for financial stability. As in financial networks, systemic risk in supply chain networks (SCNs) arises when the local failure of a single or a small group of firms impacts the production of others and might trigger cascading drops in production that affect significant parts of the economy. Here, we study how systemic risk in SCNs translates into financial systemic risk through a mechanism where supply chain contagion leads to correlated bank-firm loan defaults. We propose a financial stress-testing framework for macro-prudential applications that features a national firm level SCN in combination with bank-firm loans and the interbank network. The model is calibrated with a unique data set including about 1 million firm-level supply links, practically all bank-firm loans, and all interbank loans in Hungary. As a showcase we implement a real COVID-19 shock scenario based on firm-level labour data. This model allows us to study how the disruption dynamics in the real economy can lead to and amplify interbank solvency contagion dynamics. We estimate to what extent SCN contagion amplifies financial systemic risk, discuss the relative importance of these contagion channels, and find an increase of interbank contagion of 70% when SCN contagion is present. A key finding is that the interaction of SCN contagion and financial network contagion amplifies financial systemic risks and leads to heavier tails of banks’ loss distributions. We then examine the financial systemic risk of individual firm failures and find that interbank contagion can amplify bank equity losses from supply-chain-contagion-induced defaults by up to 28%. This framework is the first financial systemic risk model that takes real economy shocks mediated by supply chain contagion into account at the agent-level. This opens a path for a direct and event-driven understanding of the dynamical interaction between the real economy and financial systems.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105333.abstract_zh: 供应链中断构成了金融稳定性中一个被广泛忽视的风险。与金融网络相似，在供应链网络中，当单个或少数企业的局部失败影响到其他企业的生产，并可能引发波及经济重要部分的生产连锁下降时，系统性风险便随之产生。在此，我们研究供应链网络中的系统性风险如何通过一种机制转化为金融系统性风险，该机制中供应链传染导致银行与企业贷款违约的相关性增加。我们提出一个适用于宏观审慎应用的金融压力测试框架，该框架结合了国家级企业层面的供应链网络、银行-企业贷款以及银行间网络。模型利用一个独特的数据集进行校准，该数据集包含约100万条企业层面的供应链接、几乎所有的银行-企业贷款以及匈牙利所有的银行间贷款。作为示例，我们基于企业层面的劳动力数据实施了一个真实的COVID-19冲击情景。该模型使我们能够研究实体经济中的中断动态如何导致并放大银行间偿付能力传染动态。我们估计了供应链网络传染在多大程度上放大金融系统性风险，讨论了这些传染渠道的相对重要性，并发现当存在供应链网络传染时，银行间传染增加了70%。一个关键发现是，供应链网络传染与金融网络传染的相互作用放大了金融系统性风险，并导致银行损失分布的尾部更重。随后，我们考察了单个企业失败的金融系统性风险，发现银行间传染可以将由供应链传染引发的违约导致的银行股本损失放大至多28%。该框架是首个在代理层面考虑由供应链传染介导的实体经济冲击的金融系统性风险模型。这为直接且事件驱动地理解实体经济与金融系统之间的动态相互作用开辟了道路。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105333.title: A data-driven econo-financial stress-testing framework to estimate the effect of supply chain networks on financial systemic risk
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105333.title_zh: 基于数据的经济金融压力测试框架：评估供应链网络对金融系统性风险的影响

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105334.abstract: This preliminary paper extends the dynamics of a basic stylized limit order book model introduced in Chiarella & Iori (2002). The original model is capable of generating some key market microstructure features, but it cannot recreate longer range persistence in volatility. We explore a very simple and intuitive addition to the stylized, near zero intelligence behavior of traders that is capable of delivering persistent volatility. We also show that this strategy depends critically on certain key features in the dynamics of supply and demand for liquidity and depth in the limit order book. We believe this is fundamental to understanding both the dynamics of volatility in financial time series, along with variations in liquidity in financial markets. We contribute a parsimonious agent-based model to the literature that may be used as a test bed or sandbox for developing agents with more complex behavior.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105334.abstract_zh: 这篇初步论文扩展了Chiarella与Iori（2002）提出的基础简化限价订单簿模型的动态特性。原始模型能够生成一些关键的市场微观结构特征，但无法重现波动率中的长期持续性。我们探索了一种对交易者简化、近乎零智能行为的简单直观补充，该补充能够产生持续性的波动率。我们还表明，这一策略关键依赖于限价订单簿中流动性与深度供需动态的某些核心特征。我们认为，这对于理解金融时间序列中波动率的动态以及金融市场流动性的变化至关重要。我们为文献贡献了一个简约的基于代理的模型，可作为开发具有更复杂行为代理的测试平台或沙盒。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105334.title: Dynamic order dispersion and volatility persistence in a simple limit order book model
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105334.title_zh: 简单限价订单簿模型中的动态订单分散与波动持续性

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105335.abstract: This paper employs a sequential learning framework to extend the static industrial organisation literature regarding optimal capacity choice and timing for incumbents and potential entrants to a dynamic environment with heterogeneous products in which uncertainty over future demand changes over time. The incumbent is uncertain about the quality of the entrant’s product and receives imperfect information signals at random points in time. Based on these signals, the incumbent updates his belief about the entrant’s product in a Bayesian fashion. Once adequately convinced about its true quality, he stops learning and makes a capacity choice according to his conviction. Existing models on capacity choice and timing in an incumbent-entrant context have not accounted for incomplete information and sequential learning in their analyses. As such, there are several novel implications that arise from the modeling framework, as well as new rationales for incumbent inertia and what this suggests in terms of over- and under-investment in capacity relative to the welfare-maximising socially optimal level.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105335.abstract_zh: 本文采用序贯学习框架，将关于在位者与潜在进入者最优产能选择及时机的静态产业组织文献，扩展至一个产品具有异质性且未来需求不确定性随时间变化的动态环境中。在位者对于进入者产品的质量存在不确定性，并在随机时间点接收到不完美的信息信号。基于这些信号，在位者以贝叶斯方式更新其对进入者产品的信念。一旦充分确信其真实质量，他便停止学习，并根据其信念做出产能选择。现有关于在位者-进入者情境下产能选择与时机选择的模型，在分析中未考虑不完全信息与序贯学习。因此，该建模框架产生了若干新颖的推论，并为在位者惰性提供了新的解释，同时揭示了相对于福利最大化的社会最优水平，产能过度投资与投资不足的潜在原因。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105335.title: A dynamic model of capital investment with uncertain demand and Bayesian learning
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105335.title_zh: 需求不确定与贝叶斯学习下的资本投资动态模型

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105336.abstract: The presence of an occasionally binding constraint from the effective lower bound (ELB) in New Keynesian models often leads to multiple or no equilibria. The problem stems from a strong feedback loop between expectations (of inflation and output) and current outcomes at the ELB. With non-existence, the economy cannot settle into a consistent, stable outcome; whilst with multiplicity, non-fundamental shifts in beliefs might trigger belief-driven recessions. To prevent such outcomes, a policymaker needs to ensure their actions will produce a unique minimum state variable solution. We show that simple fiscal policy rules can introduce additional stabilising forces that dampen the feedback loop, thereby ensuring the existence and uniqueness of an equilibrium.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105336.abstract_zh: 新凯恩斯模型中有效下界（ELB）偶尔具有约束力的存在往往导致多重均衡或无均衡。问题源于预期（通胀和产出）与ELB处当前结果之间的强反馈循环。在无均衡情况下，经济无法稳定于一致、稳定的结果；而在多重均衡情况下，非基本面信念转变可能引发信念驱动的衰退。为防止此类结果，政策制定者需确保其行动能产生唯一的最小状态变量解。我们证明，简单的财政政策规则可以引入额外的稳定力量，削弱反馈循环，从而确保均衡的存在性和唯一性。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105336.title: Restoring existence and uniqueness at the effective lower bound with simple fiscal policy
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105336.title_zh: 通过简单财政政策恢复有效下限的存在性与唯一性

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105337.abstract: This paper develops a continuous-time OLG model, incorporating rare disasters and agents who learn more from their own experiences. Disasters such as the Great Depression make investors distrustful of the market. Generations that experience disasters save in the form of safer portfolios, even if similar disasters are not likely to occur again during their lifetimes. “Fearing to attempt” therefore inhibits wealth accumulation by these “depression babies” relative to other generations. This effect is amplified in the general equilibrium since the expected excess return is relatively high following a disaster. When calibrated to US data, the model can explain around half of the old-to-young wealth ratio decrease between the Great Depression and the 1980s, and around 7% of the subsequent increase.
