The model can also explain about a quarter of the increase of top 1% wealth shares and is consistent with observations of life cycle portfolio choices, and changes in asset returns following disasters.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105337.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个连续时间OLG模型，纳入罕见灾难因素，并假设代理人更多地从自身经历中学习。诸如大萧条之类的灾难会使投资者对市场产生不信任。经历过灾难的世代即使在其有生之年类似灾难不太可能再次发生，也会选择以更安全的投资组合形式进行储蓄。因此，“畏惧尝试”抑制了这些“大萧条婴儿”相对于其他世代的财富积累。在一般均衡中，这一效应被放大，因为灾难后预期超额回报相对较高。以美国数据进行校准后，该模型能够解释大萧条至1980年代间老年与青年财富比率下降的大约一半，以及其后上升的约7%。模型还能解释顶层1%财富份额增加的四分之一左右，并与生命周期投资组合选择及灾难后资产回报变化的观察结果相符。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105337.title: How do stock market experiences shape wealth inequality?
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105337.title_zh: 股市经历如何塑造财富不平等？

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105338.abstract: We develop a regime-switching banking model that incorporates deposit insurance and dual bankruptcy thresholds—one endogenously determined by shareholders and the other exogenously imposed by regulators. Quantitative results indicate that rigid capital regulation tends to amplify risk during economic downturns, while countercyclical adjustments contribute to greater financial stability. Capital regulation should be state-dependent; otherwise, excessively stringent regulation may induce higher leverage, whereas insufficient oversight may undermine regulatory effectiveness. The findings also highlight a trade-off between capital requirements and financial stability. These insights offer guidance for designing countercyclical capital frameworks that help stabilize bank behavior throughout the business cycle.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105338.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含存款保险与双重破产阈值的制度转换银行模型，其中一重阈值由股东内生决定，另一重由监管机构外生设定。量化结果表明，刚性资本监管在经济下行期倾向于放大风险，而逆周期调整则有助于增强金融稳定性。资本监管应具有状态依赖性；否则，过度严格的监管可能诱发更高杠杆，而监管不足则可能削弱监管效力。研究结果还揭示了资本要求与金融稳定性之间的权衡关系。这些见解为设计有助于在整个商业周期内稳定银行行为的逆周期资本框架提供了指导。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105338.title: Bank liability structure under capital requirements in a regime-switching framework
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105338.title_zh: 资本要求下银行负债结构的体制转换框架研究

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105346.abstract: This paper proposes a two-sector production model augmented with the endogenous preference evolution mechanism. The preference evolution reflects the popularity of two sectors among investors and captures the idea that preferences for the two goods move endogenously over time. The interaction of preference evolution and market-clearing mechanism generates endogenous movements in Tobin’s Q, risk premia and wealth shares different to the standard production economy of Eberly and Wang (2011). The model also implies that wealth fluctuates across sectors due to the shifts in preferences and subsequently because of expected returns and Sharpe ratios. In the empirical tests, I calibrate the baseline model to the US data sample over 1975–2019 and verify that model predictions are supported in the data.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105346.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个包含内生偏好演化机制的两部门生产模型。偏好演化反映了投资者对两个部门的偏好程度，并捕捉了两种商品偏好随时间内生变动的思想。偏好演化与市场出清机制的相互作用，产生了托宾Q、风险溢价和财富份额的内生变动，这与Eberly和Wang（2011）的标准生产经济有所不同。模型还表明，由于偏好变化，以及随后预期收益和夏普比率的变动，财富在各部门间发生波动。在实证检验中，我将基准模型校准至1975年至2019年的美国数据样本，并验证了模型预测在数据中得到支持。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105346.title: Production and endogenous preferences

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105347.abstract: This paper contributes to the price–quality relationship literature by examining the role of consumer heterogeneity. While theoretical research predominantly supports a positive price–quality relationship, empirical findings reveal a more complex picture. This complexity highlights a theoretical gap in understanding the mixed empirical evidence on the price–quality relationship. To address this gap, we introduce consumer heterogeneity and distinguish between objective and subjective quality. We propose an optimal control framework that unifies these dimensions, capturing both positive and negative price–quality relationships. Our main contribution is to show that heterogeneity in consumer type alone is sufficient for positive and negative price–quality relationships to coexist within the same market.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105347.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察消费者异质性的作用，为价格-质量关系文献做出贡献。尽管理论研究主要支持正面的价格-质量关系，实证发现却揭示了更为复杂的图景。这种复杂性凸显了在理解价格-质量关系混合实证证据方面的理论空白。为填补这一空白，我们引入消费者异质性，并区分客观质量与主观质量。我们提出一个最优控制框架，统一这些维度，捕捉正面与负面的价格-质量关系。我们的主要贡献在于表明，仅消费者类型的异质性就足以使正面与负面的价格-质量关系在同一市场中共存。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105347.title: Consumer heterogeneity and the price-quality relationship
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105347.title_zh: 消费者异质性与价格-质量关系

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105348.abstract: We show that the cyclical component of market-based short-term interest rate uncertainty (SRU) is a robust predictor of aggregate stock market returns, whereas the slow-moving trend component obscures this predictability. In real-time out-of-sample forecasting, the cyclical component of SRU achieves an R 2 of up to 14.22%, significantly outperforming the historical average and a broad set of standard financial and macroeconomic predictors. This predictive performance translates into substantial economic value for mean-variance investors. Mechanistically, the cyclical component captures transient uncertainty shocks that are strongly linked to interest rates, real economic activity, and investor sentiment. A present-value decomposition reveals that the predictive power of cyclical component operates primarily through the cash-flow channel rather than the discount-rate channel.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105348.abstract_zh: 我们证明，基于市场的短期利率不确定性（SRU）的周期成分是股票市场总体回报的稳健预测因子，而其缓慢变动的趋势成分则掩盖了这一可预测性。在实时样本外预测中，SRU的周期成分实现了高达14.22%的R²，显著优于历史平均值及一系列标准金融和宏观经济预测指标。这种预测能力转化为均值-方差投资者可观的经济价值。从机制上看，周期成分捕捉了与利率、实际经济活动及投资者情绪紧密相关的暂时性不确定性冲击。现值分解显示，周期成分的预测力主要通过现金流渠道而非贴现率渠道发挥作用。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105348.title: Market-based short-rate uncertainty and time-varying expected returns
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105348.title_zh: 基于市场的短期利率不确定性与时变预期收益

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105349.abstract: This paper embeds an artificial intelligence (AI) agent, implemented using a deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm, in a dynamic monetary general equilibrium environment to study adaptive expectation formation. Agents make intertemporal decisions through exploration-driven learning rather than model-consistent beliefs. A permanent increase in money growth serves as a regime-shift experiment to examine equilibrium adjustment. Simulations show that agents revise their policy functions toward, but not fully to, the rational expectations benchmark. The speed and stability of adjustment vary with the degree of exploration: higher exploration is associated with faster policy revision and inflation outcomes closer to the policy-implied rate, while lower exploration generates more persistent deviations and distinct wealth dynamics. The results highlight how expectation flexibility shapes macroeconomic adjustment following structural change.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105349.abstract_zh: 本文将基于深度强化学习算法实现的人工智能（AI）主体嵌入动态货币一般均衡环境中，以研究适应性预期形成机制。主体通过探索驱动的学习而非模型一致性信念做出跨期决策。以货币增长率永久性上升作为制度变迁实验，考察均衡调整过程。模拟结果显示，主体会将其政策函数向理性预期基准调整，但并未完全达到该基准。调整的速度与稳定性随探索程度的不同而变化：较高的探索程度与更快的政策修正及更接近政策隐含通胀率的结果相关联，而较低的探索程度则导致更持久的偏离及显著的财富动态差异。研究结果凸显了预期灵活性如何塑造结构性变化后的宏观经济调整路径。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105349.title: Can an AI agent hit a moving target?
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105349.title_zh: AI智能体能否击中移动目标？

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105350.abstract: We estimate a large-scale open-economy DSGE model to assess the role of energy commodity prices in euro area inflation and short-run output dynamics. The model features rich pass-through from energy import prices to consumer and producer prices, distinguishing between the role of crude oil and natural gas in the imported energy bundle allocated between production and consumption. Transmission is quantified through direct effects on household energy consumption, indirect effects via energy as an intermediate input, and second-round general-equilibrium effects through, for example, wages and markups. Bayesian estimation suggests that in 2022, shocks to energy import prices alone added about 2 percentage points (pps) to inflation. Integrating broader energy measures in a reduced-form extension increases this contribution to over half of the 2021–22 surge (to around 3 pps). Backward-looking indexation, often associated with wage-price spirals, is estimated to be limited. The post-2020 surge leaves substitution elasticities broadly unchanged but points to a steeper Phillips curve and slightly lower real wage rigidity.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105350.abstract_zh: 我们估算了一个大规模开放经济DSGE模型，以评估能源大宗商品价格在欧元区通胀及短期产出动态中的作用。该模型详细刻画了能源进口价格向消费者价格和生产者价格的传导机制，区分了原油与天然气在进口能源组合中用于生产和消费的不同角色。传导效应通过家庭能源消费的直接作用、能源作为中间投入的间接作用，以及经由工资和加成率等渠道产生的第二轮一般均衡效应进行量化。贝叶斯估计表明，2022年，仅能源进口价格冲击就使通胀上升了约2个百分点。在简化形式的扩展分析中，纳入更广泛的能源指标后，这一贡献增至2021-22年通胀飙升的一半以上（约3个百分点）。与工资-价格螺旋常相关联的后顾式指数化估计作用有限。2020年后的通胀飙升使替代弹性总体保持不变，但指向更陡峭的菲利普斯曲线和略低的实际工资刚性。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105350.title: Energy commodity price shocks in the euro area: Evidence from a large-scale structural model
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105350.title_zh: 欧元区能源商品价格冲击：基于大规模结构模型的证据

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105351.abstract: This paper introduces a hierarchical Large Language Model (LLM) framework for the automated identification of narrative fiscal shocks. We develop a multi-stage architecture to extract austerity episodes from IMF Article IV reports (2004–2020) for 17 OECD countries. Relative to manual coding, our approach improves replicability and auditability by generating a documented sequence of classification steps. Benchmarking against Adler et al. (2024), we find that the LLM-based classification aligns closely with the narrative benchmark, while differing on a small subset of episodes. Local projection estimates indicate that LLM-identified shocks are associated with smaller estimated multipliers than the narrative benchmark, with the difference linked in large part to differences in shock persistence and endogeneity.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105351.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种分层大型语言模型（LLM）框架，用于自动识别叙事性财政冲击。我们构建了一个多阶段架构，从17个OECD国家2004至2020年间的IMF第四条磋商报告中提取紧缩时期。相较于人工编码，我们的方法通过生成一系列有记录的分类步骤，提高了可复制性和可审计性。与Adler等人（2024）的基准相比，我们发现基于LLM的分类与叙事基准高度一致，但在少数事件上存在差异。局部投影估计表明，LLM识别的冲击所对应的乘数估计值小于叙事基准，这一差异在很大程度上与冲击的持续性和内生性差异有关。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105351.title: Identifying episodes of fiscal austerity: An LLM-based approach
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105351.title_zh: 识别财政紧缩时期：基于大语言模型的方法

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105352.abstract: We show that the secular decline in real interest rates in the United States, which began in the early 1980s and persisted for nearly four decades, reduced the labor’s share of output and the unemployment rate, and increased earnings inequality. We establish this link using a model of frictional labor markets, estimated from household-level data, in which unemployment risk is only partially insurable. Rising debt resulting from lower interest rates reduces the value of unemployment, leading to lower equilibrium wages relative to productivity and a lower unemployment rate. Wage dispersion also rises. The model is consistent with panel-data reduced-form evidence linking unemployment duration, assets, debt, and post-unemployment wages. In the model, a decline in the real interest rate of the magnitude observed in the data generates a decline in the labor’s share of 6 percentage points and in the unemployment rate of 0.3 percentage points. The variance of log earnings rises from 0.66 to 0.75.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105352.abstract_zh: 我们证明，美国实际利率自20世纪80年代初开始的长期下降趋势，持续近四十年，降低了劳动收入份额和失业率，并加剧了收入不平等。我们通过一个基于摩擦性劳动力市场的模型建立了这一联系，该模型利用家庭层面数据估计，其中失业风险仅能部分保险。由较低利率导致的债务增加降低了失业的价值，从而相对于生产率降低了均衡工资，并降低了失业率。工资离散度也随之上升。该模型与面板数据简化形式证据一致，这些证据将失业持续时间、资产、债务及失业后工资联系起来。在模型中，实际利率下降幅度与数据中观察到的相当，导致劳动收入份额下降6个百分点，失业率下降0.3个百分点。对数收入方差从0.66上升至0.75。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105352.title: Household debt, the labor share, and earnings inequality
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105352.title_zh: 家庭债务、劳动收入份额与收入不平等

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105354.abstract: Empirical parameter estimation of large scale agent-based models has long been recognised as computationally challenging. Their bottom-up nature imposes the use of non-parametric or indirect inference methods, which in turn typically requires a significant amount simulated data. However, their high computational requirements makes the application of these estimation methodologies unfeasible in practice. This hurdle can limit the applicability of agent based models for quantitative policy advice, for example in scenario analysis, in cases where the parameter calibration cannot be checked against empirical data. We show how this problem can be overcome by estimating the Dosi et al. (2015) agent-based model. This extends the original ‘Keynes meets Schumpeter’ model of Dosi et al. (2010) allowing for the interaction of fiscal and monetary policy. 18 free parameters of the model are estimated on 10 standard macroeconomic US variables, using annual and quarterly data, and the estimates obtained are shown to improve the fit of the baseline model on the data. A model-selection exercise is carried out, investigating impact of changing the expectation-formation mechanism. Finally, the original policy experiments are replicated using the new empirical estimates, showing that pushing the model into a low-growth regime leads to several key differences relative to the original conclusions. Overall, the exercise establishes the feasibility and relevance of macro-economic empirical parameter estimation and mechanism selection to ABM designers for improving the fit of scenario analyses.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105354.abstract_zh: 大规模基于主体的模型的经验参数估计长期以来被认为是计算上的挑战。其自下而上的特性要求使用非参数或间接推断方法，这通常需要大量的模拟数据。然而，这些方法的高计算需求使得在实际中应用这些估计方法变得不可行。这一障碍可能限制基于主体的模型在定量政策建议中的应用，例如在情景分析中，当参数校准无法与经验数据对照时。我们展示了如何通过估计Dosi等人（2015）的基于主体模型来克服这一问题。该模型扩展了Dosi等人（2010）原始的“凯恩斯遇见熊彼特”模型，允许财政与货币政策之间的相互作用。模型的18个自由参数基于10个标准美国宏观经济变量，使用年度和季度数据进行估计，所得估计结果被证明能改善基线模型对数据的拟合度。我们进行了模型选择练习，考察了改变预期形成机制的影响。最后，使用新的经验估计重复了原始政策实验，结果显示将模型推入低增长状态会导致与原始结论相比的几个关键差异。总体而言，这项工作确立了宏观经济经验参数估计和机制选择对ABM设计者而言的可行性和相关性，以改善情景分析的拟合度。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105354.title: Bayesian estimation of a large-scale macroeconomic policy agent-based model
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105354.title_zh: 大规模宏观经济政策基于主体的模型的贝叶斯估计

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105355.abstract: This paper applies distributional deep reinforcement learning to solve dynamic quantile models with uncertainty. We focus on agents who evaluate outcomes based on specific quantiles of the utility distribution, capturing intratemporal risk attitudes via a quantile level τ ∈ (0, 1). We formulate a recursive quantile value function associated with time-consistent dynamic quantile preferences in a Markov decision process, where at each period the agent maximizes the quantile of a distribution composed of instantaneous utility combined with the discounted future value, conditioned on the current state. We adapt the Actor-Critic framework to learn the τ-quantile of the distribution and the policy maximizing the τ-quantile. We demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of the proposed algorithm using an intertemporal consumption model with known analytical solutions, benchmarking against value function iteration. The results show that the algorithm provides accurate approximations of theoretical value and policy functions. Compared to value function iteration, the neural network approximation produces smoother estimates and avoids discretization errors inherent in grid-based methods. As model dimensionality increases, the algorithm scales well to higher dimensions and provides faster solutions with smaller computational requirements compared to value function iteration. The algorithm is robust to various network architectures and weight initializations.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105355.abstract_zh: 本文运用分布深度强化学习求解具有不确定性的动态分位数模型。我们关注基于效用分布特定分位数评估结果的决策者，通过分位数水平τ∈(0,1)捕捉期内风险态度。我们在马尔可夫决策过程中构建了与时间一致动态分位数偏好相关的递归分位数价值函数，其中在每个时期，决策者最大化由瞬时效用与折现未来价值组合而成的分布的分位数，该分布以当前状态为条件。我们调整Actor-Critic框架以学习分布的τ分位数及最大化τ分位数的策略。我们利用具有已知解析解的跨期消费模型，通过与价值函数迭代进行基准比较，验证了所提算法的准确性和稳健性。结果表明，该算法能精确逼近理论价值函数和策略函数。与价值函数迭代相比，神经网络逼近方法产生更平滑的估计，并避免了基于网格方法固有的离散化误差。随着模型维度的增加，该算法能良好扩展至更高维度，并在计算需求更小的情况下提供更快的求解，优于价值函数迭代。该算法对多种网络架构和权重初始化具有稳健性。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105355.title: Gradient-based reinforcement learning for dynamic quantile models
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105355.title_zh: 基于梯度的动态分位数模型强化学习

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105356.abstract: This paper examines how pandemic and physical climate risks can co-evolve endogenously and jointly shape macroeconomic, financial, and environmental outcomes. It introduces CliMaPan Lab, an agent-based framework that incorporates epidemiological dynamics and a channel linking emissions, atmospheric concentrations, and temperature within a macroeconomic-financial environment featuring heterogeneous households and firms, as well as adaptive behavior. The framework is designed to capture non-linear propagation and state dependence under alternative public-health interventions. Simulation results show that stronger contact suppression is associated with faster infection control, but also with larger contemporaneous contractions in GDP and consumption, alongside weaker credit activity. Vaccination-centered regimes, and to a lesser extent social distancing, are associated with fewer severe outcomes and comparatively smoother macroeconomic and credit trajectories when protection accumulates sufficiently early. When physical climate risk is activated, cumulative damages weaken economic performance and increase persistence, with larger disruptions under compound scenarios where pandemic-related labor-market frictions interact with climate-related production losses. Emissions decline during pandemic disruptions but rebound as activity normalizes. Under compound risk, more persistent emissions reductions primarily reflect prolonged economic weakness rather than an endogenous decarbonization transition. Overall, the findings indicate that compound risks can generate non-additive, path-dependent dynamics that are not captured by single-risk analyses.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105356.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了疫情风险与物理气候风险如何内生地共同演化，并联合影响宏观经济、金融及环境结果。研究引入了CliMaPan Lab框架，这是一个基于主体的模型体系，整合了流行病学动态以及排放、大气浓度与温度之间的关联渠道，置于包含异质性家庭与企业及适应性行为的宏观经济-金融环境中。该框架旨在捕捉不同公共卫生干预措施下的非线性传导与状态依赖性。模拟结果显示，更强的接触抑制措施虽能加速感染控制，但同时也伴随当期GDP与消费的更大收缩，以及信贷活动的减弱。以疫苗接种为核心的机制，以及程度较轻的社交距离措施，在保护措施足够早积累的情况下，与较少的严重结果及相对更平稳的宏观经济和信贷轨迹相关联。当物理气候风险被激活时，累积损害削弱经济表现并增强持续性，在疫情相关劳动力市场摩擦与气候相关生产损失相互作用的复合情景下，干扰更为显著。疫情期间排放量下降，但随着经济活动正常化而反弹。在复合风险下，更持久的排放减少主要反映的是长期经济疲软，而非内生脱碳转型。总体而言，研究结果表明，复合风险能产生非加总、路径依赖的动态效应，这些效应是单一风险分析无法捕捉的。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105356.title: When pandemics meet climate risk: An agent-based model of non-linear macroeconomic dynamics under compound stress
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105356.title_zh: 当流行病遇上气候风险：复合压力下非线性宏观经济动态的基于主体模型

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105357.abstract: I study how public sector employment affects aggregate output and employment. Although accounting for approximately 25% of the labour force in modern economies, the macroeconomic effects of public sector employment remain largely underexplored. I build a Heterogeneous Agent New Keynesian (HANK) model with unemployment risk, endogenous job destruction, sluggish vacancy creation, and public sector employment. This is the first HANK model to study this fiscal tool, allowing me to capture key labour dynamics and assess their joint role with unemployment risk in shaping the effectiveness of policy shocks. Calibrated to France, the model shows that public sector employment lowers unemployment and increases aggregate output with multipliers above unity, driven by (i) stronger demand, (ii) labour frictions limiting crowding out, and (iii) reduced unemployment risk –effects that decline in the absence of labour and nominal frictions, and disappear in a representative agent setup. Finally, compared to an increase in benefits, public sector employment is more effective in stimulating economic activity and welfare.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105357.abstract_zh: 我研究了公共部门就业如何影响总产出与就业。尽管在现代经济中公共部门就业约占劳动力的25%，但其宏观经济效应在很大程度上仍未得到充分探讨。我构建了一个包含失业风险、内生性岗位破坏、缓慢的空缺创造以及公共部门就业的异质性代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）模型。这是首个研究这一财政工具的HANK模型，使我能够捕捉关键的劳动力动态，并评估其与失业风险在塑造政策冲击有效性方面的联合作用。以法国为校准对象，模型显示公共部门就业降低了失业率并提高了总产出，乘数大于1，这得益于（i）更强的需求，（ii）限制挤出效应的劳动力摩擦，以及（iii）降低的失业风险——这些效应在缺乏劳动力和名义摩擦时减弱，并在代表性代理人设定中消失。最后，与增加福利相比，公共部门就业在刺激经济活动和福利方面更为有效。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105357.title: A heterogeneous agent new Keynesian model of search frictions and public sector employment
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105357.title_zh: 搜索摩擦与公共部门就业的异质性主体新凯恩斯模型

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105358.title: Corrigendum to “Market-based short-rate uncertainty and time-varying expected returns” [Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control 188 (2026) 105348]
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105358.title_zh: 对《基于市场的短期利率不确定性与时变预期收益》的更正 [Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control 188 (2026) 105348]

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105359.abstract: This paper studies the joint roles of inheritance and entrepreneurship in shaping wealth inequality using a heterogeneous agent, general equilibrium overlapping generations model. The analysis is disciplined by new empirical evidence from the Survey of Consumer Finances on how inheritances relate to observed wealth among very wealthy households. In the data, among households in the richest 1% of the wealth distribution, only about 6% have received inheritances that account for at least half of their net worth, and more than half report receiving no inheritance at all. When disciplined by these facts, the calibrated model implies that inheritances play only a limited role in generating extreme wealth, even when accounting for their interaction with entrepreneurship. Using the calibrated model, the paper evaluates estate tax reforms and finds that their effects on wealth concentration are smaller than commonly believed.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105359.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个包含异质性主体、一般均衡重叠世代模型，研究了继承与创业在塑造财富不平等中的联合作用。分析受到消费者金融调查中关于继承与极富裕家庭观测财富关系的新经验证据的约束。数据显示，在财富分布最富有的1%家庭中，仅有约6%的家庭所获继承至少占其净资产的一半，而超过一半的家庭报告未收到任何继承。在这些事实约束下，校准模型表明，即使考虑到继承与创业的相互作用，继承在产生极端财富方面的作用也有限。利用校准模型，本文评估了遗产税改革，发现其对财富集中度的影响小于普遍认知。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105359.title: Inheritance, entrepreneurship, and estate taxation

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105360.abstract: A central bank’s accumulation of foreign reserves can reallocate domestic credit and influence investments among firms. Exploiting institutional features in Korea and connecting firms with their lending banks from 2004 to 2019, we examine how reserve accumulation and sterilization affect credit allocation and firm investment. We track the issuance of sterilization bonds by the central bank to finance reserve purchases and identify heterogeneous exposure across banks. Banks more responsive to sterilization absorb larger quantities of these bonds and adjust their loans accordingly. We find that firms–particularly those with higher liabilities to such banks–reduce investment during periods of reserve accumulation. The impact of reserve-induced credit reallocation on firm investment is centered primarily on non-listed firms, non-exporters, and firms with low productivity.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105360.abstract_zh: 中央银行积累外汇储备能够重新配置国内信贷，并影响企业间的投资。利用韩国的制度特征，并将2004年至2019年间企业与贷款银行相匹配，我们考察了储备积累及冲销操作如何影响信贷配置与企业投资。我们追踪了中央银行为融资储备购买而发行的冲销债券，并识别了不同银行间暴露程度的异质性。对冲销操作反应更积极的银行吸收了更大数量的这些债券，并相应调整了其贷款。我们发现，在储备积累期间，企业——尤其是对那些银行负债较高的企业——减少了投资。储备引致的信贷重新配置对企业投资的影响主要集中在非上市企业、非出口企业以及生产率较低的企业。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105360.title: International reserves and firm investment: Identification through bank credit reallocation
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105360.title_zh: 国际储备与企业投资：基于银行信贷再配置的识别

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105367.abstract: Most models on the life-cycle utilization of health care consider the expected development of an individual’s health. However, health shocks with significant impact (e.g. the onset of a chronic disease or life-threatening accidents) should not be averaged, as they can put the life-course onto a different trajectory. This paper presents an optimal-control framework incorporating a stochastic health shock with individuals allocating their resources to consumption and various types of health care over their life-cycle. We distinguish between general health care and shock-specific prevention, acute, and chronic care. We investigate the optimal decisions (on consumption, saving, and health care) made in anticipation and the optimal reaction to the shock depending on the timing of its arrival. Furthermore, we extend the value of life concept to the multidimensionality of health and the scope for a shock and illustrate our findings by calibrating the model to an individual facing a potential cancer diagnosis in the US. In so doing we also investigate the role of possible bias in the subjective expectation of a health shock.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105367.abstract_zh: 大多数关于生命周期内医疗保健利用的模型考虑的是个体健康状况的预期发展。然而，具有重大影响的健康冲击（如慢性疾病的发生或危及生命的事故）不应被平均化处理，因为它们可能将生命历程引向不同的轨迹。本文提出一个最优控制框架，纳入随机健康冲击，个体在其生命周期内将资源分配于消费及各类医疗保健。我们区分了一般医疗保健与针对冲击的预防、急性及慢性护理。我们研究了在预期冲击情况下做出的最优决策（涉及消费、储蓄及医疗保健），以及根据冲击发生时间而采取的最优应对措施。此外，我们将生命价值概念扩展至健康的多维性及冲击的影响范围，并通过将模型校准至美国面临潜在癌症诊断的个体来阐述我们的发现。在此过程中，我们还探讨了主观预期健康冲击中可能存在的偏差所起的作用。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105367.title: Integrating large health shocks into life-cycle models - modelling impacts of a cancer diagnosis
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105367.title_zh: 将重大健康冲击纳入生命周期模型——癌症诊断影响的建模

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105368.abstract: This paper measures the value of information mortgage brokers provide to UK households using an application of a structural model of search. Aided by administrative loans data, we document the existence of a substantial degree of unexplained price dispersion, and observe that while mortgages obtained from brokers are cheaper, borrowers who use intermediaries pay more once commissions are factored in. However, our results also show that broker presence exerts negative pressure on lenders’ market power. Compared to a world where broker advice is unavailable, brokers reduce average monthly mortgage costs by 21% and eliminate a part of welfare losses arising from costly search. In other words, eliminating brokers from the market would lead to even higher borrowing costs from the group of borrowers who need it most: those with the highest search costs. We also find that regulation in support of market centralization halves lenders’ markups and lowers monthly costs of an average mortgage by 4.4%.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105368.abstract_zh: 本文通过应用搜索的结构模型，衡量了抵押贷款经纪人为英国家庭提供的信息价值。借助行政贷款数据，我们记录了存在显著程度的未解释价格离散现象，并观察到虽然通过经纪人获得的抵押贷款更便宜，但使用中介的借款人在计入佣金后支付更多。然而，我们的结果也表明，经纪人的存在对贷款人的市场势力施加了负面压力。与没有经纪人建议的世界相比，经纪人将平均月度抵押贷款成本降低了21%，并消除了因昂贵搜索而产生的部分福利损失。换言之，将经纪人从市场中剔除将导致最需要帮助的借款人群体——即搜索成本最高者——面临更高的借款成本。我们还发现，支持市场集中化的监管措施使贷款人的加价减半，并将平均抵押贷款的月度成本降低了4.4%。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105368.title: Estimating the value of information in the UK mortgage market
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105368.title_zh: 评估英国抵押贷款市场中信息的价值

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105369.abstract: This paper considers a class of asset-based preferences characterized by intertemporal, multiplicative utility functions over consumption and asset holdings. The optimal investment strategy under such preferences is inherently time-dependent and can be characterized by a sequence of first-order ordinary differential equations (ODEs). Conversely, any time-dependent investment strategy can be rationalized as optimal for some asset-based preference, whereas no time-dependent strategy can be optimal under time-separable preferences. Furthermore, the revealed asset-based preference can be derived as the solution to a recursive system of first-order ODEs. Our analysis establishes a unique correspondence between asset-based preferences and time-dependent investment strategies, demonstrating that the former naturally generate time-dependent investment strategies.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105369.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了一类基于资产偏好的特性，这类偏好通过跨期、乘性效用函数对消费和资产持有进行刻画。在此类偏好下，最优投资策略固有地依赖于时间，并可通过一系列一阶常微分方程（ODEs）序列来表征。反之，任何依赖于时间的投资策略都能被合理化，视为某种基于资产偏好的最优选择，而在时间可分离偏好下，则不存在时间依赖策略的最优性。此外，揭示出的基于资产偏好可通过递归一阶常微分方程组求解得出。我们的分析确立了基于资产偏好与时间依赖投资策略之间的唯一对应关系，表明前者自然衍生出时间依赖的投资策略。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105369.title: Preference revelation when investment is time-dependent
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105369.title_zh: 投资时间依赖时的偏好揭示

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105370.abstract: This paper develops a framework to estimate U.S. housing market slack—the deviation of inventory from equilibrium levels needed for stability. We estimate a housing Phillips curve linking slack to house price growth, where slack is identified as the common cyclical component shared by existing and new home inventories. Results show a statistically significant inverse relationship between slack and price growth, with persistent negative slack since 2010 and extreme tightness during the pandemic. A shock to the estimated housing market slack generates substantial, lasting effects on house prices and rents, with rental impacts peaking 24 months after initial shocks.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105370.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个评估美国住房市场松弛度的框架，即库存偏离维持稳定所需均衡水平的程度。我们估计了一条住房菲利普斯曲线，将松弛度与房价增长联系起来，其中松弛度被识别为现有住房和新房库存共有的周期性成分。结果显示，松弛度与房价增长之间存在统计上显著的负相关关系，自2010年以来持续存在负松弛，并在疫情期间出现极度紧张状态。对估计的住房市场松弛度施加冲击，会对房价和租金产生显著且持久的影响，其中租金影响在初始冲击后24个月达到峰值。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105370.title: Measuring housing market slack
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105370.title_zh: 衡量住房市场疲软程度

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105372.abstract: This paper studies optimal monetary policy in a two-country Schumpeterian growth model incorporating the spirit of capitalism (SOC). We analyze how the strength of SOC in each country shapes the incentives for and outcomes of international monetary policy cooperation. In our framework, monetary policy affects domestic productivity growth via cash-in-advance constraints on both consumption and R&D investment. We show analytically that stronger SOC in either country lowers the optimal cooperative nominal interest rate by increasing R&D-driven growth and cross-border spillovers. Calibrating the model to the U.S. and the Euro Area, we find that the optimal cooperative interest rates satisfy the Friedman rule, while the Nash-equilibrium interest rates are positive in both economies. Moreover, while policy cooperation yields welfare gains for both parties when SOC levels are similar, it generates welfare losses for the country with the weaker SOC when asymmetries are large. Our results highlight a novel mechanism: the feasibility and desirability of international monetary policy cooperation depend critically on the relative strengths of the SOC across countries.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105372.abstract_zh: 本文在纳入资本主义精神（SOC）的两国熊彼特增长模型中研究最优货币政策。我们分析了各国SOC强度如何影响国际货币政策合作的激励与结果。在我们的框架中，货币政策通过消费和研发投资的现金预付约束影响国内生产率增长。我们分析表明，任一国家更强的SOC通过提升研发驱动增长和跨境溢出效应，降低了最优合作名义利率。将模型校准至美国和欧元区，我们发现最优合作利率满足弗里德曼规则，而纳什均衡利率在两国均为正。此外，当SOC水平相似时，政策合作为双方带来福利收益；但当不对称性较大时，合作对SOC较弱的国家产生福利损失。我们的结果突显了一个新颖机制：国际货币政策合作的可行性与可取性关键取决于各国SOC的相对强度。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105372.title: Monetary Policy and Growth in an Open Economy with the Spirit of Capitalism
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105372.title_zh: 资本主义精神下开放经济中的货币政策与增长

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105373.abstract: We investigate the sources of heterogeneity in producer and consumer price inflation rates at both industry and aggregate levels. To this end, we develop a dynamic general equilibrium model with a production network, which enables us to disentangle the effects of producer price stickiness and consumer price stickiness in the transmission of sectoral shocks—a distinction often overlooked in theoretical models. We demonstrate that sectoral cost-push shocks and network connectivity are key determinants of the relative volatility between producer and consumer price inflation in the U.S. Furthermore, we quantify how these shocks propagate through cascading adjustments in producer prices, ultimately influencing the aggregate consumer price.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105373.abstract_zh: 我们探究了行业及总体层面上生产者与消费者价格通胀率异质性的来源。为此，我们构建了一个包含生产网络的动态一般均衡模型，该模型使我们能够区分生产者价格粘性与消费者价格粘性在部门冲击传导中的作用——这一区别在理论模型中常被忽视。我们证明，部门成本推动冲击和网络连通性是决定美国生产者与消费者价格通胀相对波动性的关键因素。此外，我们量化了这些冲击如何通过生产者价格的级联调整进行传播，最终影响总体消费者价格。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105373.title: Heterogeneous Inflation Volatility in Production Networks: Producer vs. Consumer Prices
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105373.title_zh: 生产网络中的异质性通胀波动：生产者价格与消费者价格

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105382.abstract: We investigate the influence of trading institutions on emotional arousal and bidding behavior through a series of behavioral and physiological experiments involving an investment task. In line with the competitive arousal hypothesis, we show that market institutions exacerbate the emotional arousal associated with winning bids, especially when buying an asset leads to substantial earnings. The market treatment exhibits stronger overbidding and bubble dynamics than baselines that use a Becker-DeGroot-Marschak mechanism. Treatment differences disappear for investors who exhibit no base rate emotional arousal. Our study shows that emotions are an important mechanism for understanding market outcomes and suggests designing new trading institutions to mitigate competitive arousal and subsequent overbidding in markets.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105382.abstract_zh: 我们通过一系列涉及投资任务的行为与生理实验，探究了交易制度对情绪唤醒及竞价行为的影响。与竞争性唤醒假说一致，我们发现市场制度加剧了与中标相关的情绪唤醒，尤其是在购买资产能带来可观收益的情况下。相较于采用贝克尔-德格鲁特-马沙克机制的基线情境，市场处理表现出更强烈的过度竞价和泡沫动态。对于未表现出基础情绪唤醒的投资者，处理组间的差异消失。本研究显示，情绪是理解市场结果的重要机制，并建议设计新的交易制度以缓解市场中的竞争性唤醒及随之而来的过度竞价现象。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105382.title: Trading Institutions, Emotional Arousal, and Overbidding
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105382.title_zh: 交易制度、情绪唤醒与过度出价

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105383.abstract: Quantum computation, a paradigm shift in computer science, has the potential to profoundly affect research in economics and finance. This special issue brings together a subset of papers that were presented at the conference. Quantum advantage has been demonstrated for payment systems and the first three papers cover such applications. The next set of papers cover asset pricing applications. The final one covers quantum data auction models.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105383.abstract_zh: 量子计算，作为计算机科学领域的一次范式转变，有望深刻影响经济学与金融学的研究。本期特刊汇集了会议上展示的部分论文。量子优势已在支付系统中得到验证，前三篇论文即涵盖此类应用。接下来的论文涉及资产定价应用。最后一篇则探讨量子数据拍卖模型。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105383.title: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control Special Issue on Quantum Computing Applications in Economics and Finance
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105383.title_zh: 《经济动力学与控制杂志》量子计算在经济学与金融中应用专刊

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105384.abstract: We describe a quantum variational algorithm for securities transactions settlement optimization, based on a novel mathematical formalization of the problem that includes the most relevant constraints considered in the pan-European securities settlement platform TARGET2-Securities. The proposed algorithm is designed for Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum devices, specifically targeting IBM's superconducting qubit machines. We adopt non-linear activation functions to encode inequality constraints in the objective function of the problem, and design customized noise mitigation techniques to alleviate the effect of readout errors. We consider batches of up to 40 trades obtained from real transactional data to benchmark our algorithm on quantum hardware against classical and quantum-inspired solvers.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105384.abstract_zh: 我们描述了一种用于证券交易结算优化的量子变分算法，该算法基于问题的一种新颖数学形式化，包含了泛欧证券结算平台TARGET2-Securities中考虑的最相关约束条件。所提出的算法专为噪声中等规模量子设备设计，特别针对IBM的超导量子比特机器。我们采用非线性激活函数将不等式约束编码到问题的目标函数中，并设计定制化的噪声缓解技术以减轻读出误差的影响。我们利用从真实交易数据中获取的至多40笔交易的批次，在量子硬件上对我们的算法与经典及量子启发式求解器进行了基准测试。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105384.title: Securities transaction settlement optimization on superconducting quantum devices
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105384.title_zh: 超导量子设备上的证券交易结算优化

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105385.abstract: In McMahon et al. (2024) the authors demonstrated the effectiveness of a hybrid quantum solver in improving the liquidity efficiency of Canada’s high-value payments system (HVPS), altering the payment queue in order to minimize liquidity requirements. In this work, we apply a similar technique to the Italian segment of TARGET2, the Eurosystem’s HVPS, using the Constrained Quadratic Model (CQM) solver provided by D-Wave. This application achieves improvements in optimizing payment batches of size 70 and 140, showing daily average liquidity savings of respectively EUR 23 million and EUR 38 million over a 35 days sample. In addition we clarify the causes and possible extent of the liquidity savings realized. Introducing a machine learning framework to identify batch features that enhance liquidity savings, we find that batch optimizability increases with the number of participants acting as both senders and receivers, as well as the number of unique receivers within the batch. Finally we benchmark the CQM solver results against those obtained using a simulated annealing algorithm (SAA) under the same time constraints, finding comparable liquidity savings for batch sizes of 70 and 140 payments. The SAA is extended to handle batch sizes of up to 700 payments, a scale that is challenging for current quantum hardware, demonstrating a more than tenfold increase in liquidity savings.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105385.abstract_zh: 在McMahon等人（2024）的研究中，作者展示了一种混合量子求解器在提升加拿大高价值支付系统（HVPS）流动性效率方面的有效性，通过调整支付队列以最小化流动性需求。本研究将类似技术应用于欧元系统HVPS的意大利部分——TARGET2，采用D-Wave提供的约束二次模型（CQM）求解器。该应用在优化规模为70和140的支付批次方面取得了改进，在35天的样本期内，日均流动性节省分别达到2300万欧元和3800万欧元。此外，我们阐明了所实现流动性节省的原因及可能范围。通过引入机器学习框架来识别增强流动性节省的批次特征，我们发现批次的优化潜力随着同时作为发送方和接收方的参与者数量以及批次内独特接收方数量的增加而增强。最后，我们将CQM求解器的结果与在相同时间约束下使用模拟退火算法（SAA）获得的结果进行基准比较，发现在70和140笔支付的批次规模下，两者实现了相当的流动性节省。SAA被扩展以处理高达700笔支付的批次规模，这一规模对当前量子硬件而言颇具挑战，展示了流动性节省超过十倍的提升。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105385.title: Liquidity Optimization in Gross Settlement Systems with Quantum Reordering: Application to TARGET2
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105385.title_zh: 量子重排序下大额结算系统的流动性优化：在TARGET2中的应用

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105386.abstract: We build a network formation game of firms with trade flows to study the adoption and usage of a new digital currency. In pairwise stable equilibria, we document endogenous heterogeneity and inefficiency in adoption, and explain how changing properties of the currency may increase usage but decrease adoption. We frame the model as a quadratic binary optimization problem and apply it to data. This approach resolves the long-standing complexity issue of network formation games and makes them empirically feasible, as demonstrated with a quantum computer.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105386.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含企业间贸易流量的网络形成博弈模型，以研究新型数字货币的采纳与使用情况。在成对稳定均衡中，我们记录了采纳行为的内生异质性与低效率现象，并解释了货币属性变化如何可能提升使用率却降低采纳度。我们将该模型表述为二次二元优化问题，并将其应用于实际数据。这一方法解决了网络形成博弈中长期存在的复杂性难题，使其在实证上可行，并通过量子计算机得到了验证。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105386.title: Digital payments in network formation games: Theory of adoption and quantum algorithm
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105386.title_zh: 网络形成博弈中的数字支付：采纳理论与量子算法

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105387.abstract: Accurately estimating tail risk in financial markets is crucial yet difficult, especially when data are scarce. This paper investigates the use of Quantum Boltzmann Machines (QBMs), a class of quantum generative models capable of capturing complex, high-dimensional, and heavy-tailed distributions through quantum superposition and entanglement. Compared to classical Restricted Boltzmann Machines, QBMs offer greater expressive power and sampling efficiency. We apply this framework to assess risk for newly listed firms with limited historical data and find that QBM-augmented estimates significantly improve the prediction of long-term risk measures, including Value-at-Risk and expected shortfall, making QBMs a promising tool for financial modeling.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105387.abstract_zh: 准确评估金融市场的尾部风险至关重要，但尤其在数据稀缺时颇具挑战。本文探讨了量子玻尔兹曼机（QBMs）的应用，这是一类能够通过量子叠加和纠缠捕捉复杂、高维及重尾分布的量子生成模型。与经典受限玻尔兹曼机相比，QBMs展现出更强的表达能力和采样效率。我们将此框架应用于评估历史数据有限的新上市公司的风险，并发现QBM增强的估计显著提升了对长期风险度量（包括风险价值与预期短缺）的预测能力，使QBMs成为金融建模中颇具前景的工具。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105387.title: Simulating Heavy-Tailed Economic Data with Quantum Boltzmann Machines: Applications to Downside Risk in Firms with Limited Histories
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105387.title_zh: 使用量子玻尔兹曼机模拟重尾经济数据：在有限历史企业下行风险中的应用

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105388.abstract: Classical data can be copied and re-used for computation, with adverse consequences economically and in terms of data privacy. Motivated by this, we formulate problems in one-way communication complexity where Alice holds some data x and Bob holds m inputs 𝑦 1 , … , 𝑦 𝑚 . They want to compute m instances of a bipartite relation 𝑅 ( · , · ) on every pair ( 𝑥 , 𝑦 1 ) , … , ( 𝑥 , 𝑦 𝑚 ) . We call this the asymmetric direct sum question for one-way communication. We give examples where the quantum communication complexity of such problems scales polynomially with m, while the classical communication complexity depends at most logarithmically on m. Thus, for such problems, data behaves like a consumable resource that is effectively destroyed upon use when the owner stores and transmits it as quantum states, but not when transmitted classically. We show an application to a strategic data-selling game, and discuss other potential economic implications.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105388.abstract_zh: 经典数据可以被复制并重新用于计算，这在经济层面和数据隐私方面带来了不利后果。基于此，我们构建了单向通信复杂度中的问题，其中Alice持有数据x，Bob持有m个输入y₁,…,yₘ。他们希望计算一个二分关系R(·,·)在每一对(x,y₁),…,(x,yₘ)上的m个实例。我们称之为单向通信的非对称直接求和问题。我们给出了示例，其中此类问题的量子通信复杂度随m呈多项式增长，而经典通信复杂度对m的依赖至多为对数级别。因此，对于此类问题，当数据所有者以量子态存储和传输数据时，数据表现得像一种消耗性资源，在使用时被有效销毁；而经典传输则不会如此。我们展示了这一发现在一个战略性数据销售游戏中的应用，并讨论了其他潜在的经济影响。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105388.title: Consumable Data via Quantum Communication
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105388.title_zh: 通过量子通信实现的可消费数据

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105389.abstract: In physics the famous von Neumann measurement model assumes that - apart from measurement noise - the data is aligned with the model. In economics and finance, models are prone to specification errors. Decision theory has offered insights into statistical inference given uncertainty in the data generating process. Quantum behavioral models have resolved longstanding paradoxes facing decision theory by allowing candidate decisions to behave like quantum mechanical states in superposition. We introduce quantum decision-theoretic foundations of ambiguity and model/parameter uncertainty to deal with model selection and specification errors. We provide an illustrative example involving asset pricing models.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105389.abstract_zh: 在物理学中，著名的冯·诺依曼测量模型假设数据与模型对齐，除测量噪声外。而在经济学与金融领域，模型易受设定误差影响。决策理论已为数据生成过程不确定性下的统计推断提供了洞见。量子行为模型通过允许候选决策像量子力学态一样处于叠加状态，解决了决策理论面临的长期悖论。我们引入量子决策理论基础，以处理模糊性及模型/参数不确定性，应对模型选择与设定误差问题。我们提供了一个涉及资产定价模型的示例说明。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105389.title: On Statistical Decision-Theoretical Foundations of Quantum Measurement with an Application to Asset Pricing Models
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105389.title_zh: 量子测量统计决策理论基础及其在资产定价模型中的应用

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105390.abstract: This paper proposes the first methodology for assessing local determinacy in incomplete-markets models. My simple determinacy criterion yields theoretical results and can be verified numerically. It merely requires calculating aggregate marginal propensities to consume (MPC) and aggregate elasticities of asset demand. I find that the policy rules ensuring determinacy can be quite different in incomplete as opposed to complete-markets models. My methodology can thus avoid the current (flawed) practice of referring to complete markets results to assess determinacy in incomplete markets models. The main findings are: If bonds are nominal, the economy is always determinate for a constant nominal interest rate or for price level targeting if prices are sufficiently rigid. The model is indeterminate if fiscal policy is too expansionary, requiring a monetary policy response to reestablish determinacy. If bonds are real, whether or not the Taylor principle induces determinacy depends non-linearly on MPCs, the degree of price rigidities and whether interest rates respond to output. I also find the determinacy properties of active and passive fiscal rules (Leeper, 1991) to be different in incomplete and complete markets models. I explain the shortcomings in Kaplan et al. (2023), which are the reason for their different and thus invalid findings.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105390.abstract_zh: 本文提出了在不完全市场模型中评估局部确定性的首个方法论。这一简洁的确定性准则既能推导出理论结果，也可通过数值方法验证，仅需计算总边际消费倾向（MPC）与总资产需求弹性。研究发现，相较于完全市场模型，不完全市场模型中确保确定性的政策规则可能存在显著差异。因此，本方法论可避免当前（存在缺陷的）将完全市场结论套用于不完全市场模型确定性评估的实践。主要发现如下：若债券为名义债券，在名义利率恒定或价格水平目标制下（当价格具有充分刚性时），经济始终具有确定性；若财政政策过度扩张，模型将出现不确定性，此时需通过货币政策响应重建确定性。若债券为实际债券，泰勒原理能否引发确定性取决于MPC、价格刚性程度及利率是否对产出做出反应的非线性关系。此外，本文发现主动与被动财政规则（Leeper, 1991）在完全市场与不完全市场模型中的确定性特征存在差异，并阐释了Kaplan等（2023）研究中的缺陷——正是这些缺陷导致其结论存在差异且无效。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105390.title: Local Determinacy in Incomplete-Markets Models
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105390.title_zh: 不完全市场模型中的局部确定性

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105391.abstract: A large body of research has established the empirical and quantitative importance of international remittances as an insurance mechanism against income shocks in developing countries. However, households have additional self-insurance mechanisms, including precautionary savings, labor supply adjustments, and multiple earners. This paper develops a model with heterogeneous two-member households and endogenous international remittances to study the relationship between remittances from overseas workers and other self-insurance mechanisms. I calibrate the model with data from the Dominican Republic, and then use the model to decompose the relative importance of the self-insurance mechanisms used by non-migrant households and households with overseas workers. I find that the response of household behavior (remittances, labor supply, and savings) differs greatly depending on whether the household has an overseas worker or is a non-migrant household and on whether the shock hits the overseas worker (usually male) or the left-behind family member (usually female). Allowing for correlated wage shocks within non-migrant households further highlights the insurance benefits of migration by reducing joint exposure to local shocks and altering the composition of self-insurance mechanisms.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105391.abstract_zh: 大量研究已确立国际汇款作为发展中国家收入冲击保险机制的经验与定量重要性。然而，家庭还拥有其他自我保险机制，包括预防性储蓄、劳动供给调整以及多收入来源。本文构建了一个包含异质性双成员家庭和内生国际汇款的模型，以研究海外工人汇款与其他自我保险机制之间的关系。我利用多米尼加共和国的数据对模型进行校准，然后使用该模型分解非移民家庭和拥有海外工人的家庭所采用的自我保险机制的相对重要性。研究发现，家庭行为（汇款、劳动供给和储蓄）的反应差异显著，取决于家庭是否拥有海外工人或为非移民家庭，以及冲击是作用于海外工人（通常为男性）还是留守家庭成员（通常为女性）。允许非移民家庭内部工资冲击相关，进一步凸显了移民通过减少对本地冲击的共同暴露和改变自我保险机制构成所带来的保险收益。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105391.title: International Remittances and Intra-Household Risk-Sharing
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105391.title_zh: 国际汇款与家庭内部风险分担

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105392.abstract: We present a behavioural heterogeneous agents model of the foreign exchange (FX) market designed from the perspective of a developing economy that cannot trade in its national currency. The model distinguishes between speculative and non-speculative FX sectors. We show that, as long as non-speculative demand responds to domestic economic activity, a market-clearing output growth rate exists that, in the steady state, equals the ratio of FX supply growth to the income elasticity of demand for foreign assets, i.e., a generalised dynamic trade multiplier. The model is compatible with endogenous persistent and bounded fluctuations, and the analysis of the basins of attraction reveals coexistence of fixed points and chaotic attractors. Numerical simulations reproduce key stylised facts of exchange rate dynamics, including non-Gaussian distributions, consistent with evidence from Latin American economies. Time-varying parameter estimation confirms that the dynamic trade multiplier closely tracks observed growth rates in the region.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105392.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个行为异质性主体模型，用以分析外汇市场，该模型从无法以本国货币进行交易的发展中经济体的视角出发。模型区分了投机性与非投机性外汇部门。研究表明，只要非投机性需求对国内经济活动有所响应，就存在一个市场出清时的产出增长率，在稳态下，该增长率等于外汇供给增长率与外国资产需求收入弹性之比，即广义动态贸易乘数。该模型兼容内生性的持续且有界波动，吸引域分析揭示了不动点与混沌吸引子的共存。数值模拟再现了汇率动态的关键典型事实，包括非高斯分布，这与拉丁美洲经济体的证据相符。时变参数估计确认，动态贸易乘数紧密追踪该地区观察到的增长率。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105392.title: FX-constrained growth: Fundamentalists, contrarians, trend-extrapolators and the dynamic trade-multiplier
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105392.title_zh: FX约束下的增长：基本面交易者、反向交易者、趋势外推者与动态贸易乘数

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105393.abstract: In this paper, we assess how the stability of financial networks is affected by interconnectedness considering its tiniest variation: the edge. We compute the impact of edges as the percentage difference in the systemic risk (SR) of the whole network caused by the inclusion of that edge. We apply this framework to a thorough Brazilian dataset to compute the impact of bank-firm edges. After observing that (i) edges are heterogeneous regarding their impact on the SR, and (ii) the fraction of edges whose impact on the SR is non-positive increases with the level of the initial shock, we use machine learning techniques to try to predict two variables: the criticality of the edges (defining as critical an edge whose impact on SR is significantly greater than that of the others) and the sign of the edge impact. The level of accuracy obtained in these prediction exercises was very high. These results have important implications for the development macroprudential policies aimed at financial stability. Our framework allows to identify, based on features related to the origin and destination nodes of the edge (i.e., the lending bank and the borrowing firm), whether an additional loan will have a significant and positive impact on the SR.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105393.abstract_zh: 本文评估了金融网络稳定性如何受互联性影响，重点关注其最细微的变化：边。我们通过计算某条边加入后对整个网络系统性风险（SR）造成的百分比差异，来衡量该边的影响。我们将这一框架应用于详尽的巴西数据集，以计算银行-企业边的影响。在观察到以下两点后：（i）各边对系统性风险的影响具有异质性；（ii）对系统性风险影响为非正值的边所占比例随初始冲击水平上升而增加，我们运用机器学习技术尝试预测两个变量：边的关键性（将系统性风险影响显著高于其他边的边定义为关键边）以及边影响的符号。这些预测练习的准确度非常高。上述结果对旨在维护金融稳定的宏观审慎政策制定具有重要启示。我们的框架能够基于边起点与终点节点（即贷款银行与借款企业）的相关特征，识别新增贷款是否会对系统性风险产生显著正向影响。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105393.title: The systemic impact of edges in financial networks
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105393.title_zh: 金融网络中边缘的系统性影响

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105394.abstract: This paper presents an analytical heterogeneous agent model (HAM) to explore micro-level concentration dynamics and their effects on macro-level distribution and growth. It contributes to recent work on macroeconomic agent-based models (ABMs) by comparing a small-scale ABM with bilateral firm-customer matching to a simplified HAM without direct agent interactions. The HAM replicates key ABM results while allowing for analytical solutions. In the model, larger firms benefit from lower unit costs due to economies of scale, gain larger market shares, and set higher markups. More profitable firms temporarily grow faster, leading to endogenous changes in the firm size distribution. The resulting right-skewed distributions create a divergence between the average profit share across firms and the aggregate profit share, which is driven by the largest firms. The decline in the labour share reduces aggregate consumption and slows growth. Despite its simplicity, the model captures key empirical patterns related to superstar firms and declining labour shares.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105394.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析性异质主体模型（HAM），旨在探究微观层面的集中动态及其对宏观分配与增长的影响。该研究通过将一个小规模、具有双边企业-客户匹配的基于主体的模型（ABM）与一个简化、无直接主体互动的HAM进行对比，为近期宏观经济基于主体模型的研究做出了贡献。HAM在允许解析解的同时，复现了ABM的关键结果。在该模型中，规模较大的企业因规模经济而享有较低的单位成本，获得更大的市场份额，并设定更高的加成率。盈利能力更强的企业暂时增长更快，导致企业规模分布发生内生变化。由此产生的右偏分布造成了企业间平均利润份额与总体利润份额之间的差异，后者由最大型企业主导。劳动份额的下降减少了总消费并减缓了增长。尽管模型简洁，它仍捕捉到了与超级明星企业和劳动份额下降相关的主要经验模式。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105394.title: An analytical heterogeneous agent macro model of concentration, markups, and falling labour shares
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105394.title_zh: 集中度、加成率与劳动份额下降的分析性异质主体宏观模型

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105395.abstract: The US government has historically expanded unemployment insurance (UI) during economic downturns along three policy dimensions: benefit amount, duration, and eligibility. We study how these elements affect the labor market, focusing in particular on the interaction among them. Specifically, we quantify the impact of the Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security (CARES) Act UI package, which combined all three during the COVID-19 pandemic. The package raised average unemployment rate by 1.05 percentage points during April–December 2020. Two-thirds of this effect resulted from amplification by economic shutdown policies and COVID-19 infection risk. Decomposing the CARES Act UI package reveals that interactions between the three policy dimensions accounted for one-fourth of the total effect, highlighting that policy components do not operate in isolation.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105395.abstract_zh: 美国政府历史上在经济衰退期间沿三个政策维度扩展失业保险（UI）：福利金额、期限和资格条件。我们研究这些要素如何影响劳动力市场，尤其关注它们之间的相互作用。具体而言，我们量化了《冠状病毒援助、救济和经济安全（CARES）法案》中的失业保险方案的影响，该方案在COVID-19疫情期间综合了这三个维度。该方案使2020年4月至12月的平均失业率上升了1.05个百分点。这一影响的三分之二源于经济封锁政策和COVID-19感染风险的放大效应。对CARES法案失业保险方案的分解显示，三个政策维度之间的相互作用占总效应的四分之一，凸显了政策组成部分并非孤立运作。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105395.title: A Quantitative Analysis of Multidimensional Changes in Unemployment Insurance Policies
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105395.title_zh: 失业保险政策多维变化的定量分析

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105396.abstract: Recent work suggests that nominal GDP targeting may raise social welfare, but fiscal considerations have largely been ignored. We study an overlapping generations model with government debt and distortionary taxes. Nominal GDP targeting has two opposing effects on the tax burden: mean taxes increase, but tax volatility is reduced. Differently to previous works, we find that nominal GDP targeting lowers social welfare relative to inflation targeting. A key mechanism is that nominal GDP targeting makes inflation countercyclical, thereby raising long run inflation risk and consumption risk of retirees while increasing the inflation risk premium paid on government debt.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105396.abstract_zh: 近期研究指出，名义GDP目标化可能提升社会福利，但财政方面的考量在很大程度上被忽视了。我们研究了一个包含政府债务和扭曲性税收的代际重叠模型。名义GDP目标化对税收负担产生两种相反的影响：平均税收增加，但税收波动性降低。与以往研究不同，我们发现名义GDP目标化相对于通胀目标化降低了社会福利。一个关键机制在于，名义GDP目标化使通胀呈现逆周期特性，从而增加了长期通胀风险及退休人员的消费风险，同时提高了政府债务所支付的通胀风险溢价。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105396.title: Nominal GDP targeting and the tax burden

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105397.abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model of firm dynamics with multiple labour skills to analyse the productivity implications of skill shortages. Firms employ cognitive, interpersonal, and manual skills in both operational and overhead tasks, with sectoral variation in skill intensities, and within sector firm size heterogeneity due to idiosyncratic technology draws. Calibrated to UK data, the model reveals that cognitive skills are a binding constraint on productivity. A reduction in the supply of cognitive skills lowers labour productivity at all levels – firms, sectors, and in the aggregate. About half of the sectoral effects are due to changes in the within-sector distribution, whereby larger firms grow in relative size but become less productive. Sectoral heterogeneity in skill intensities amplifies these effects.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105397.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含多种劳动技能的企业动态一般均衡模型，以分析技能短缺对生产率的影响。企业将认知、人际交往和手工技能用于运营及管理任务，各行业在技能密集度上存在差异，且行业内企业规模因特有技术冲击而呈现异质性。基于英国数据的校准结果显示，认知技能是生产率的约束性瓶颈。认知技能供给的减少会降低企业、行业及总体层面的劳动生产率。约一半的行业效应源于行业内分布的变化，即大型企业相对规模扩大但生产率下降。行业间技能密集度的异质性加剧了这些影响。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105397.title: Worker Skills, Firm Dynamics, and Productivity
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105397.title_zh: 工人技能、企业动态与生产率

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105398.abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of sustainable investment in which emission-based government regulation simultaneously stimulates green investment and creates policy-induced transition risk. A novel market failure emerges: policy uncertainty generates both financial value and pro-social values for emission mitigation, but firms internalize only the financial benefits and therefore underinvest in mitigation, triggering the emission rebound effect. Investor activism can alleviate this distortion and incentivize green investment. Hence, activism reduces the need for aggressive policy intervention. This substitution effect is weakened by advisory costs but strengthened by green innovation.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105398.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于可持续投资的动态理论，其中基于排放的政府监管同时刺激绿色投资并产生政策引发的转型风险。一种新颖的市场失灵现象浮现：政策不确定性既为减排带来财务价值，也带来亲社会价值，但企业仅内化财务收益，因此对减排投资不足，引发排放反弹效应。投资者积极主义能够缓解这一扭曲并激励绿色投资。因此，积极主义降低了对激进政策干预的需求。这种替代效应因咨询成本而减弱，但会因绿色创新而增强。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105398.title: Uncertain Climate Policy and Activist Investing
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105398.title_zh: 不确定的气候政策与积极投资者投资

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105399.abstract: We study the optimal and strategic extraction of a renewable resource that is spatially distributed over a network, migrates across nodes (with no loss of biomass during transit), and evolves according to a nonlinear (concave) aggregate growth function. A subset of nodes hosts extractors, while the remaining ones serve as reserves. We analyze a centralized planner’s problem and a non-cooperative game with stationary Markov strategies. For three canonical growth families (logistic, power, and log-type saturating laws) paired with corresponding utilities, we derive closed-form value functions and feedback rules for the planner, and we construct a symmetric Markov equilibrium for the game on strongly connected networks.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105399.abstract_zh: 我们研究一种可再生资源的最优与策略性开采问题，该资源在网络上空间分布，可在节点间迁移（迁移过程中生物量无损失），并依据非线性（凹形）总量增长函数演化。部分节点设有开采者，其余节点则作为保护区。我们分析了集中规划者的问题以及采用平稳马尔可夫策略的非合作博弈。针对三种典型增长族（逻辑斯蒂、幂函数和对数型饱和规律）及其对应的效用函数，我们为规划者推导出闭式价值函数和反馈规则，并在强连通网络上构建了博弈的对称马尔可夫均衡。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105399.title: Centralized and competitive extraction of distributed renewable resources on networks with nonlinear aggregate growth
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105399.title_zh: 网络非线性总量增长下分布式可再生资源的集中与竞争性开采

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105400.abstract: This paper quantifies the role of bank lending in shaping the short-run effects of climate policy on the economy. Using carbon price surprises from the EU Emissions Trading System we document that higher carbon prices, while successfully reducing emissions, lead to lower economic activity, lower bank capital and higher credit spreads. We further show that banks with greater exposure to emission-intensive industries reduce credit supply more strongly in response to an increase in carbon price. We interpret these empirical facts through the lens of a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model with polluting and non-polluting sectors, nominal price rigidities, and a bank credit channel. The model matches well the empirical impulse responses of key aggregates to a carbon policy shock. Counterfactual simulations suggest that the bank credit channel plays a quantitatively meaningful role in the transmission of carbon policy shocks. Finally, implications for the design of macroprudential and monetary policies are explored.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105400.abstract_zh: 本文量化了银行信贷在塑造气候政策对经济短期影响中的作用。利用欧盟排放交易体系的碳价意外变动，我们记录到，碳价上升虽成功减少了排放，却导致经济活动下降、银行资本减少及信用利差扩大。进一步研究表明，对高排放行业敞口较大的银行，在碳价上升时信贷供给缩减更为显著。我们通过一个包含污染与非污染部门、名义价格刚性及银行信贷渠道的动态随机一般均衡模型来解释这些实证事实。该模型很好地匹配了碳政策冲击下关键总量指标的实证脉冲响应。反事实模拟表明，银行信贷渠道在碳政策冲击传导中发挥着数量上显著的作用。最后，本文探讨了其对宏观审慎及货币政策设计的启示。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105400.title: Macroeconomic Effects of Carbon Pricing: The Role of Bank Credit
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105400.title_zh: 碳定价的宏观经济效应：银行信贷的作用

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105401.abstract: In the African Financial Community (CFA) franc zones, a credible euro peg coexists with external debt denominated largely in U.S. dollars: euro–dollar fluctuations, exogenous to these small economies, directly raise the domestic-currency burden of debt. Panel regressions show that such depreciations raise sovereign default intensity by roughly 9%. In these same high-default years, consumption does not fall—evidence against the insurance motive of standard default models. I explain both facts by extending the partial default framework of Arellano et al. (2023) with foreign-currency debt, exogenous exchange rate shocks, and government heterogeneity. Exogeneity changes the nature of default: governments default not for insurance but opportunistically, exploiting the valuation gap between the higher debt burden and the higher revenue from new borrowing, generating a short-run rise in consumption. A policy counterfactual finds leaving for a self-managed dollar peg welfare-neutral on the financial side: opportunistic default insures the mismatch so effectively that a country profits from devaluations whatever their source, so the arrangement’s value lies not in shielding the debt but in the exogenous-devaluation environment that makes default opportunistic.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105401.abstract_zh: 在非洲金融共同体（CFA）法郎区，可信的欧元盯住汇率制度与主要以美元计价的外部债务并存：欧元兑美元汇率的波动，对这些小型经济体而言是外生的，直接加重了国内货币计价的债务负担。面板回归显示，此类贬值会使主权违约强度上升约9%。而在这些高违约年份中，消费并未下降——这与标准违约模型中的保险动机相悖。我通过扩展Arellano等人（2023）的部分违约框架，引入外币债务、外生汇率冲击及政府异质性，来解释这两个事实。外生性改变了违约的本质：政府违约并非出于保险目的，而是机会主义行为，利用更高债务负担与新增借款更高收入之间的估值缺口，从而在短期内推高消费。一项政策反事实分析发现，转向自我管理的美元盯住汇率制度在金融层面福利中性：机会主义违约如此有效地对冲了货币错配，以至于无论贬值源于何种因素，国家都能从中获利，因此该安排的价值不在于保护债务本身，而在于外生贬值环境使违约具有机会主义性质。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105401.title: Opportunistic Sovereign Default under a Credible Peg
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105401.title_zh: 可信盯住汇率制下的机会主义主权违约

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105408.abstract: This paper investigates market outcomes and trading behavior in experimental over-the-counter (OTC) asset markets. By reducing market size from 9 to 4 participants, the experiment induces changes in trading frictions and selling pressure that produce distinct effects at both the market and individual levels. The results show the emergence of positive price bubbles in both treatments, even though the fundamental value remains constant. The findings further demonstrate that the lower traded prices and narrower bid–ask spreads observed in smaller OTC markets are largely attributable to the decrease in ask prices. This pattern can be interpreted as a consequence of the increased difficulty sellers face in executing trades within a smaller OTC market, where fewer potential buyers heighten overall trading frictions and amplify selling pressure. Consequently, sellers lower their ask prices to complete transactions.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105408.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了实验性场外交易（OTC）资产市场中的市场结果与交易行为。通过将市场规模从9名参与者缩减至4名，实验引发了交易摩擦与卖出压力的变化，这些变化在市场和个体层面均产生了不同效应。结果显示，尽管基础价值保持不变，两种处理方式下均出现了正向价格泡沫。进一步研究发现，较小OTC市场中观察到的较低成交价格和更窄的买卖价差，主要归因于要价（ask prices）的下降。这一模式可解释为，在较小的OTC市场中，卖方执行交易面临更大难度，潜在买家数量减少加剧了整体交易摩擦并放大了卖出压力，因此，卖方降低要价以促成交易完成。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105408.title: Market Size, Trading Frictions, and Selling Pressure in Experimental Over-The-Counter Asset Markets
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105408.title_zh: 市场规模、交易摩擦与场外资产市场实验中的抛售压力

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105409.abstract: How does population aging affect the political decision-making regarding the inflation target? Using an overlapping generations New Keynesian model, we analyze how demographic factors affect the inflation target rates preferred by young and old households, respectively. Given a demographic structure, the earnings redistribution channel leads young and old households to have different preferences over the inflation target: the optimal target rate for the average old household is negative, whereas that for the average young household is close to zero. Hence, the composition effect of population aging on the population-weighted average of these optimal rates is negative. However, the overall effect is either positive or only marginally negative, depending on whether the transition to a new steady state is taken into account, and there is no strong negative association between the population-weighted average of the optimal inflation rates and population aging. The analysis reveals that greater longevity and lower birth rates make the preferences of young and old households more similar, either directly through utility functions or indirectly through a lower real interest rate.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105409.abstract_zh: 人口老龄化如何影响关于通胀目标的政治决策？通过运用世代交叠的新凯恩斯模型，我们分析了人口因素如何分别影响年轻与老年家庭所偏好的通胀目标率。在给定的人口结构下，收入再分配渠道导致年轻与老年家庭对通胀目标持有不同偏好：平均老年家庭的最优目标率为负，而平均年轻家庭的最优目标率接近于零。因此，人口老龄化对人口加权平均最优目标率的构成效应为负。然而，总体效应要么为正，要么仅为轻微负值，这取决于是否考虑向新稳态的过渡，且人口加权平均最优通胀率与人口老龄化之间并无强烈的负相关关系。分析揭示，寿命延长和出生率降低使得年轻与老年家庭的偏好趋于一致，这种趋同或直接通过效用函数实现，或间接通过较低的实际利率实现。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105409.title: Generational War on Inflation? Optimal Inflation Rates for the Young and the Old
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105409.title_zh: 代际通胀之争？年轻人与老年人的最优通胀率

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105410.abstract: As illustrated by the Great Recession, the COVID-19 pandemic and the global decline in GDP growth since the mid-2000s, economists need to account for sudden and deep recessions, shifts in macroeconomic volatility, and longer-term fluctuations in GDP growth. This paper puts forward a Mean-Variance Markov-Switching Dynamic Factor Model (MV-MS-DFM) that accounts for these stylised facts by allowing the mean and the volatility of macroeconomic variables to switch abruptly, and trend GDP growth to vary smoothly over time. We show that allowing for different volatility regimes improves the detection of turning points in the US business cycle, that the Great Recession and the COVID-19 pandemic only led to temporary increases in volatility, and that US trend GDP growth has declined by around 1 percentage point since the early 2000s. Information criteria and marginal likelihood comparisons support our model specification. The model also provides a unified framework connecting the literature on turning-point detection to the more recent literature on Growth-at-Risk in macroeconomic forecasting. While tightening financial conditions are shown to increase the probability of falling into recession, the model can generate left-skewed density forecasts without including any financial variable in the information set. The paper finally discusses how to deal with the COVID-19 period when estimating the model.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105410.abstract_zh: 正如大衰退、新冠疫情以及自2000年代中期以来全球GDP增长的放缓所展示的，经济学家需要解释突然而深度的衰退、宏观经济波动性的变化以及GDP增长的长期波动。本文提出了一种均值-方差马尔可夫转换动态因子模型（MV-MS-DFM），该模型通过允许宏观经济变量的均值和波动性发生突变，以及趋势GDP增长随时间平滑变化，来适应这些典型事实。我们证明，允许不同的波动性制度存在，能提高对美国商业周期转折点的识别能力；大衰退和新冠疫情仅导致了波动性的暂时上升；而自2000年代初以来，美国趋势GDP增长已下降了约1个百分点。信息准则和边际似然比较支持我们的模型设定。该模型还提供了一个统一框架，将转折点检测的文献与宏观经济预测中较新的增长风险文献联系起来。虽然金融状况收紧被证明会增加陷入衰退的概率，但该模型无需在信息集中包含任何金融变量，就能生成左偏的密度预测。最后，本文讨论了在估计模型时如何处理新冠疫情时期。
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105410.title: Switching Macroeconomic Growth and Volatility: Evidence from a Mean-Variance Markov-Switching Dynamic Factor Model
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105410.title_zh: 宏观经济增速与波动的区制转换：基于均值-方差马尔可夫区制转换动态因子模型的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103310.abstract: Mounting causal evidence shows particulate matter pollution reduces real-time cognitive function and increases aggressive behavior by reducing neural connectivity through oxidative stress and neuro-inflammation. We investigate a setting in which reduced cognition can generate significant private and external costs: driving. Using exogenous variation in wind direction, we show that a one-unit increase in PM 2.5 exposure results in just under a one-percent increase in fatal car crashes and fatalities. Further, these effects are limited to same-day pollution exposure, highlighting the immediate negative effects of high-pollution days. An across-the-board one standard deviation reduction in fine particulate matter pollution would have averted nearly 2000 motor vehicle fatalities in 2019.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103310.abstract_zh: 越来越多的因果证据表明，颗粒物污染通过氧化应激和神经炎症降低神经连接性，从而削弱实时认知功能并增加攻击性行为。我们研究了一个认知能力下降可能产生显著私人及外部成本的场景：驾驶。利用风向的外生变化，我们发现PM 2.5暴露每增加一个单位，会导致致命车祸及死亡人数增加近百分之一。此外，这些影响仅限于当日污染暴露，凸显了高污染日的即时负面效应。若全面降低细颗粒物污染一个标准差，2019年本可避免近2000起机动车死亡事故。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103310.title: Negative externalities of temporary reductions in cognition: Evidence from particulate matter pollution and fatal car crashes
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103310.title_zh: 认知暂时下降的负外部性：来自颗粒物污染与致命车祸的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103312.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of solar panel program announcements on household utility consumption. Using anonymized monthly block level electricity and water consumption data for each flat type from January 2011 to December 2020 in Singapore and a staggered difference-in-differences approach, we find that public housing buildings affected by the solar panel program tender announcements experience a 2.1% increase in monthly electricity consumption and a 2.3% increase in water consumption. We attribute this pattern to a financial misperception whereby households mistakenly believe that collective solar adoption will reduce their electricity costs, after ruling out alternative explanations such as changes in energy prices, wealth effects, and moral licensing. Our findings highlight the importance of effective information dissemination for the successful implementation of solar energy initiatives.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103312.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了太阳能板项目公告对家庭公用事业消费的影响。利用2011年1月至2020年12月新加坡各户型每月匿名区块级电力与用水数据，并采用交错双重差分法，我们发现受太阳能板项目招标公告影响的公共住房建筑，其月度电力消费增加了2.1%，用水消费增加了2.3%。我们将这一现象归因于一种财务误解，即家庭错误地认为集体采用太阳能将降低其电费支出，在排除了能源价格变动、财富效应及道德许可等替代解释后，这一结论依然成立。我们的研究结果强调了有效信息传播对于太阳能倡议成功实施的重要性。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103312.title: The illusion of free electricity: Household responses to solar panel program in Singapore
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103312.title_zh: 免费电力的幻觉：新加坡家庭对太阳能板项目的反应

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103313.abstract: Climate disasters can inflict significant property damage and depress housing markets, yet their effects on property tax administration remain poorly understood. Homeowners with or without property damage may face tax burdens that do not match changes in their property values after disasters. This study examines the impact of Hurricane Sandy on property values and tax assessments in New York City. Using a difference-in-differences approach and comprehensive property-level data, we find that (1) inundated properties faced greater tax burdens due to taxable values falling less than corresponding market values after the storm; (2) unaffected properties in flood zones saw even larger tax burden increases as market values fell while taxable values remained unchanged; and (3) higher-valued homes bore larger tax burden hikes. These uneven consequences largely reflect the interplay between market reactions to Hurricane Sandy and City’s tax relief measures and existing assessment policies, highlighting how property tax administration is intertwined with disaster responses in the era of climate change.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103313.abstract_zh: 气候灾害可能造成重大财产损失并抑制住房市场，然而其对房产税管理的影响仍鲜为人知。无论房屋是否受损，业主都可能面临与灾后房产价值变化不匹配的税负。本研究考察了飓风桑迪对纽约市房产价值及税收评估的影响。采用双重差分法并利用全面的房产层面数据，我们发现：（1）受灾淹没的房产因应税价值下降幅度小于灾后相应市场价值，而承担了更高的税负；（2）洪泛区内未受影响的房产，因市场价值下降而应税价值保持不变，其税负增幅更大；（3）价值较高的房屋承受了更大的税负增加。这些不均衡的后果主要反映了市场对飓风桑迪的反应与城市税收减免措施及现有评估政策之间的相互作用，凸显了在气候变化时代，房产税管理与灾害应对如何紧密交织。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103313.title: Rising waters, falling taxes: The impact of Hurricane Sandy on property tax assessments in New York City
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103313.title_zh: 涨水与减税：飓风桑迪对纽约市房产税评估的影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103314.abstract: In this paper, we study the effects of gasoline content regulations on consumers’ product choices in China. Our empirical design leverages a unique market structure and policy-induced changes in gasoline standards. Using detailed station-level data, we compare sales volumes of gas stations located near city borders before and after one side’s government implements stricter gasoline standards, which raise both the price and quality of gasoline. We find that the relative market share of stations located on the side implementing stricter standards increases, and we recover consumers’ underlying preference for higher fuel quality. Based on the estimated demand, the marginal willingness to pay (MWTP) for the upgrade from China III to China IV gasoline standards is approximately 5.2% of the retail price. Our simulation shows that government subsidies for the upgraded gasoline product create unintended behavioral distortions, which diminish the overall environmental benefits and welfare gains.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103314.abstract_zh: 本文研究了汽油含量监管对中国消费者产品选择的影响。我们的实证设计利用了独特的市场结构和政策引发的汽油标准变化。利用详细的加油站层面数据，我们比较了城市边界两侧加油站在一侧政府实施更严格汽油标准前后的销售量，该标准同时提高了汽油的价格和质量。我们发现，实施更严格标准一侧的加油站的相对市场份额有所增加，并据此恢复了消费者对更高燃油质量的潜在偏好。基于估计的需求，从中国III到中国IV汽油标准升级的边际支付意愿（MWTP）约为零售价格的5.2%。我们的模拟显示，政府对升级汽油产品的补贴造成了非预期的行为扭曲，削弱了整体环境效益和福利收益。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103314.title: Consumer response to environmental standards: Evidence from gasoline regulation in China
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103314.title_zh: 消费者对环境标准的反应：来自中国汽油管制的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103315.abstract: Obtaining valid answers from respondents has been a central concern of stated preference (SP) studies. In contrast, sample representativeness is the main focus of current public polling accuracy debates, largely due to declining survey response rates. We introduce the multi-level regression and post-stratification (MRP) modelling approach to welfare estimation using discrete choice models. Through Monte Carlo simulations and two water resource valuation surveys, we demonstrate how MRP can help researchers to (i) generate population-relevant welfare measures from non-representative samples, (ii) estimate preference heterogeneity and distributional impacts across people, and (iii) evaluate the impacts of removing potentially invalid responses using a consistent target population frame. We propose MRP as a complementary modelling approach for non-market valuation data and discuss its opportunities and limitations.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103315.abstract_zh: 从受访者处获取有效答案一直是陈述偏好（SP）研究的核心关注点。相比之下，样本代表性则是当前民意调查准确性争论的主要焦点，这主要归因于调查回复率的下降。我们引入多级回归与事后分层（MRP）建模方法，用于基于离散选择模型的福利估计。通过蒙特卡洛模拟及两项水资源价值评估调查，我们展示了MRP如何帮助研究者：（i）从非代表性样本中生成与总体相关的福利度量；（ii）估计人群间的偏好异质性与分配影响；（iii）在一致的目标总体框架下，评估剔除潜在无效回答的影响。我们提出将MRP作为非市场价值评估数据的补充建模方法，并讨论其机遇与局限性。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103315.title: Multi-level regression and post-stratification for discrete choice modelling and stated preference research
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103315.title_zh: 离散选择建模与陈述偏好研究中的多层次回归与事后分层

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103324.abstract: I analyse how global value chain (GVC) position and exposure to foreign environmental regulation shape firms’ CO 2 emissions in a large emerging economy. Combining detailed energy-use records for Indian manufacturing firms with firm-specific GVC position indicators and exposure to foreign environmental policy stringency (EPS), I show three main results. A one-unit increase in upstreamness–moving further from final consumption roughly being equivalent to the average GVC position of textile firms to that of basic metals firms–raises direct CO 2 emissions by 28 % and CO 2 per unit of value added by 35 %. Second, the higher CO 2 intensity of upstream firms becomes statistically insignificant for firms that operate in industries that are highly exposed to stringent environmental regulations: the interaction term between upstreamness and EPS is negative significant and fully offsets the baseline effect. Third, exporting per se does not moderate the upstreamness-CO 2 relationship, indicating that over-proportional technology upgrading in upstream positions is driven by exposure to destination-specific factors. Overall, the evidence suggests that foreign stakeholder pressure is transmitted through GVCs and can help decarbonise energy-intensive upstream producers. • Firm-level evidence links GVC upstreamness to higher direct CO 2 intensity. • Within industries, upstream firms emit 28 % more CO 2 and 35 % more per value added. • Exposure to stringent foreign environmental regulation diminishes the higher upstreamness CO 2 intensity. • Exporting itself does not alter the upstreamness-CO 2 intensity relationship. • Cutting emissions in upstream sectors is essential for global CO 2 targets.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103324.abstract_zh: 我分析了全球价值链（GVC）位置及对外国环境法规的暴露程度如何影响大型新兴经济体中企业的二氧化碳排放。通过将印度制造业企业的详细能源使用记录与企业特定的GVC位置指标及对外国环境政策严格性（EPS）的暴露程度相结合，我展示了三个主要结果。上游度每增加一个单位——即进一步远离最终消费，大致相当于从纺织企业的平均GVC位置转向基础金属企业的位置——直接二氧化碳排放量增加28%，单位增加值二氧化碳排放量增加35%。其次，对于处于高度暴露于严格环境法规行业的企业而言，上游企业较高的二氧化碳强度在统计上变得不显著：上游度与EPS之间的交互项为负且显著，完全抵消了基准效应。第三，出口本身并不调节上游度与二氧化碳之间的关系，这表明上游位置中不成比例的技术升级是由目的地特定因素的暴露所驱动的。总体而言，证据表明外国利益相关者的压力通过GVC传导，有助于高能耗上游生产者的脱碳。• 企业层面的证据将GVC上游度与更高的直接二氧化碳强度联系起来。• 在行业内，上游企业每单位增加值排放的二氧化碳多28%，每单位增加值排放多35%。• 暴露于严格的外国环境法规会削弱上游度带来的更高二氧化碳强度。• 出口本身并不改变上游度与二氧化碳强度之间的关系。• 削减上游部门的排放对于实现全球二氧化碳目标至关重要。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103324.title: Upstreamness, foreign environmental regulation and CO2 emissions in Indian manufacturing firms
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103324.title_zh: 上游度、外国环境规制与印度制造业企业的二氧化碳排放

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103325.abstract: This paper analyzes the causal effect of exposure to uncensored environmental reporting on individuals’ environmental preferences and pro-environmental behavior. We exploit a natural experiment occurring in the German Democratic Republic, where geographic characteristics determined access to Western TV. Western media provided information on environmental pollution, a topic censored in East German state media. Using individual-level data from the German Socio-Economic Panel, we find a positive and persistent effect of Western TV exposure on environmental concerns and participation in environmental organizations. Complementing these findings, the analysis of county-level data reveals additional changes in pro-environmental behavior. Specifically, we show that Western TV induced GDR citizens to submit complaint letters on environmental issues to local authorities. Furthermore, regions with Western TV access exhibited stronger electoral support for the Green Party in the first two federal elections of reunified Germany. These results highlight the influential role of mass media in shaping both environmental preferences and corresponding behavior.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103325.abstract_zh: 本文分析了接触未经审查的环境报道对个人环境偏好及亲环境行为的因果效应。我们利用德意志民主共和国发生的一项自然实验，其中地理特征决定了西德电视的接入情况。西方媒体提供了关于环境污染的信息，而这一话题在东德国家媒体中受到审查。利用德国社会经济面板数据的个体层面数据，我们发现西德电视接触对环境关注及参与环保组织具有积极且持久的影响。为补充这些发现，县级数据的分析揭示了亲环境行为的额外变化。具体而言，我们表明西德电视促使东德公民向地方当局提交关于环境问题的投诉信。此外，在统一后德国的前两次联邦选举中，能够接入西德电视的地区表现出对绿党更强的选举支持。这些结果凸显了大众媒体在塑造环境偏好及相应行为方面的关键作用。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103325.title: Fog or smog? The impact of uncensored reporting on pollution on individuals’ environmental preferences
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103325.title_zh: 雾还是霾？无审查污染报道对个人环境偏好的影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103330.abstract: Since ignorance can serve as an excuse for selfish behavior, people sometimes avoid learning about possible negative externalities of their actions. In social situations, however, others might provide the information anyway. How do potential informers affect willful ignorance and the resulting social outcomes? We introduce a third-party potential informer into the moral wiggle-room game. Almost half of the dictators avoided information only to have it imposed upon them by the informer. Most of these unwillingly-informed dictators revised their behavior to benefit the recipient, even at a cost to themselves. While knowledge of the informer’s presence did not change dictators’ propensity to seek information, a subtle change in the experimental choice interface did: The share of dictators choosing ignorance was more than halved when the dictator’s ignorance and allocation choices were made in two separate decision screens rather than a single one.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103330.abstract_zh: 由于无知有时能为自私行为提供借口，人们有时会避免了解自身行为可能带来的负面外部效应。然而，在社交情境中，他人仍可能提供这些信息。潜在的信息提供者如何影响故意无知及其导致的社会结果？我们在道德模糊空间游戏中引入了第三方潜在信息提供者。近半数的独裁者选择回避信息，却不得不接受信息提供者强加的信息。这些非自愿获知信息的独裁者中，大多数调整了行为以惠及接收者，即便这需要他们自身承担成本。尽管知晓信息提供者的存在并未改变独裁者寻求信息的倾向，但实验选择界面的细微调整却产生了显著影响：当独裁者的无知与分配选择被置于两个独立的决策屏幕而非单一屏幕时，选择无知的独裁者比例减少了一半以上。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103330.title: Unwillingly informed: the prosocial impact of third-party informers
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103330.title_zh: 非自愿知情：第三方告知者的亲社会影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103331.abstract: International trade in natural resource commodities has been tied to declining socio-environmental conditions in production locations. Increasingly, governing bodies have turned to unilateral traceability programs to harmonize environmental and social standards at the production local with those of the importer. The United States’ Seafood Import Monitoring Program (SIMP) is one such program that covers the largest seafood import market by value and aims to reduce imports of seafood products from Illegal, Unreported, and Unregulated fishing or that are fraudulently labeled.
