We evaluate the impact of the SIMP on import prices as an indicator of program costs and supply chain changes. Comparing observed import prices to forecasts of counterfactual prices in a causal impact framework, we find an average 13.55% increase in import price, or a lower bound $411 million increase in import value, in the first year of implementation. Examining potential heterogeneity, we find variation in the timing of impact across processed and unprocessed products. Impact also differs across species groups. Observed significant price increases for some tunas and crustaceans likely reflect cost pass-through and changes to sourcing decisions aligned with program goals. Our findings suggest that unilateral traceability programs can be costly but support socio-environmental sustainability.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103331.abstract_zh: 自然资源类商品的国际贸易与生产地的社会经济环境恶化密切相关。为协调生产地与进口国之间的环境和社会标准，越来越多的管理机构转向实施单边可追溯性计划。美国的《海产品进口监控计划》（SIMP）便是其中之一，该计划覆盖了按价值计最大的海产品进口市场，旨在减少来自非法、未报告和无管制（IUU）捕捞或标签欺诈的海产品进口。我们评估了SIMP对进口价格的影响，以此作为项目成本和供应链变化的指标。在因果影响框架下，将观察到的进口价格与反事实价格预测进行比较，我们发现实施第一年进口价格平均上涨13.55%，即进口价值至少增加4.11亿美元。在考察潜在异质性时，我们发现加工和未加工产品在影响时间上存在差异，不同物种组之间的影响也有所不同。部分金枪鱼和甲壳类动物观察到的显著价格上涨，可能反映了成本转嫁以及与项目目标一致的采购决策变化。我们的研究结果表明，单边可追溯性计划虽可能带来成本，但有助于支持社会经济环境的可持续性。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103331.title: Impacts of natural resource traceability programs: evidence from the United States’ seafood import monitoring program
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103331.title_zh: 自然资源可追溯计划的影响：来自美国海产品进口监测项目的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103333.abstract: This paper examines the impact of upstream deforestation on water coverage and burned area in wetlands. Using a panel dataset of satellite-derived land cover for multiple hydrographic basins, we analyze this relationship in the Brazilian Pantanal from 1985 to 2023. We find that a 1% increase in upstream deforestation reduces water coverage by 0.51% and increases burned area by 0.55% per year. The effect of upstream deforestation on downstream burned area generates an emissions multiplier, as carbon released through deforestation is compounded by emissions from downstream burned area. On average, for each ton of carbon emitted due to deforestation, an additional 0.14 tons are released through downstream fire.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103333.abstract_zh: 本文考察了上游森林砍伐对湿地水域覆盖面积及过火面积的影响。利用涵盖多个水文流域的卫星遥感土地覆盖面板数据，我们分析了1985年至2023年间巴西潘塔纳尔地区这一关系。研究发现，上游森林砍伐每增加1%，每年水域覆盖面积减少0.51%，过火面积增加0.55%。上游森林砍伐对下游过火面积的影响产生了排放乘数效应，因为森林砍伐释放的碳与下游过火产生的排放相互叠加。平均而言，每因森林砍伐排放一吨碳，下游火灾会额外释放0.14吨碳。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103333.title: Drying the wetland: Water scarcity in the Brazilian pantanal
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103333.title_zh: 湿地干涸：巴西潘塔纳尔的水资源短缺

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103334.abstract: Public consultations are widely used in regulatory processes, allowing stake-holders to present their viewpoints despite their inherent biases. Some stake-holders, such as firms, are known to be pro-business, while others, such as environmental NGOs, are pro-environment. We develop a framework to analyze how a regulator should process information provided by biased stakeholders. We distinguish between stakeholders whose biases are high and known and those whose biases are small but unknown, such as national authorities. We show that the regulator should follow the advice that runs counter to a stakeholder’s typical bias, i
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103334.abstract_zh: 公众咨询在监管过程中被广泛采用，允许利益相关者表达其观点，尽管这些观点带有固有偏见。某些利益相关者，如企业，已知倾向于商业利益，而其他如环境非政府组织则倾向于环境保护。我们构建了一个框架，分析监管者应如何处理来自有偏见利益相关者的信息。我们区分了偏见程度高且已知的利益相关者与偏见程度小但未知的利益相关者，例如国家当局。研究表明，监管者应采纳与利益相关者通常偏见相悖的建议。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103334.title: Environmental regulation informed by biased stakeholders
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103334.title_zh: 受偏见利益相关者影响的环境规制

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103335.abstract: We examine how political dynamics shape environmental outcomes in Colombia, focusing on the role of Regional Environmental Protection Agencies (REPAs). To identify causal effects, we implement a regression discontinuity design based on close mayoral elections. Our results show that when governors—who sit on REPA boards—are politically aligned with local mayors, annual deforestation increases by 0.044 percentage points, or about 40 percent relative to the mean. The problem is most pronounced in agencies where political actors dominate decision-making. Crucially, additional deforestation does not translate into local economic gains, suggesting that forests are being lost without broader social benefit. These findings highlight how decentralized institutional design can leave environmental governance vulnerable to political capture, underscoring the need for safeguards in the governance structure of environmental authorities to protect natural resources from short-term political interests.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103335.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了政治动态如何影响哥伦比亚的环境结果，重点关注区域环境保护署（REPAs）的作用。为识别因果效应，我们基于市长选举的激烈竞争实施了一项断点回归设计。结果显示，当省长——作为REPA董事会成员——与地方市长政治立场一致时，年森林砍伐率增加0.044个百分点，相对于平均值约增长40%。这一问题在政治人物主导决策的机构中最为突出。关键的是，额外的森林砍伐并未转化为地方经济收益，表明森林损失并未带来更广泛的社会利益。这些发现凸显了分权制度设计如何使环境治理易受政治俘获的影响，强调了在环境管理机构的治理结构中设置保障措施的必要性，以保护自然资源免受短期政治利益的侵害。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103335.title: Power plays in the jungle: Political alignment and environmental degradation in Colombia
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103335.title_zh: 丛林中的权力博弈：哥伦比亚的政治联盟与环境退化

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103336.abstract: This study extends the Ricardian framework to forestry by accounting for tree growth and harvest dynamics. Indeed, whereas standard Ricardian applications in agriculture assume that farmland prices reflect a perpetual flow of annual profits from the most climate-adapted crops, forestland prices additionally capitalize the age-dependent value of standing timber accumulated over decades. Coupling the Ricardian and Faustmann approaches, we theoretically show that this age dependence is systematically tied to species (and therefore to climate), so that stand age becomes a confounding factor in standard pooled Ricardian regressions. Our theory implies a correction – the age-structured Ricardian approach – that regresses the climate-value relationship across stand-age classes, with the coefficients obtained for the youngest class providing the closest approximation to the true Ricardian effects in the context of forestry. Using geolocated plot-level data from all forestland transactions in France between 2014 and 2023 (over 100,000 plots) matched to forest age at sale (1–219 years), we empirically confirm that standard pooled Ricardian estimates are biased, typically understating the benefits of warmer climates to forestry – in our case, by nearly a factor of two. Consistent with our theory, age-structured coefficients exhibit an inverted U-shape with stand age: capitalization of climate productive effects into forestland prices first strengthens as stands mature and then weakens as slow-growing species increasingly dominate older age classes. Our findings hold under multiple sensitivity analyses and extensions, making clear that ignoring age-related dynamics systematically biases climate estimates in Ricardian applications to forestry.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103336.abstract_zh: 本研究将李嘉图框架拓展至林业领域，通过纳入树木生长与采伐动态来实现。确实，在农业的标准李嘉图应用中，假定农田价格反映的是最适应气候作物所带来的永续年利润流，而林地价格则额外资本化了数十年间累积的立木年龄依赖价值。结合李嘉图与福斯特曼方法，我们从理论上证明，这种年龄依赖性系统地与树种（进而与气候）相关联，使得林分年龄成为标准混合李嘉图回归中的混淆因素。我们的理论提出了一种修正方法——年龄分层李嘉图方法——该方法在不同林分年龄等级间回归气候-价值关系，其中以最幼龄等级获得的系数最接近林业背景下真实李嘉图效应的近似值。利用2014年至2023年间法国所有林地交易的地理定位地块级数据（超过10万块地块），并将其与销售时的林龄（1至219年）相匹配，我们实证确认，标准混合李嘉图估计存在偏差，通常低估了较暖气候对林业的益处——在本案例中，低估幅度接近两倍。与我们的理论一致，年龄分层系数随林分年龄呈倒U型形态：气候生产效应向林地价格的资本化首先随林分成熟而增强，随后因生长缓慢的树种在较老龄等级中日益占优而减弱。我们的发现在多项敏感性分析和扩展检验中保持稳健，明确表明忽视年龄相关动态会系统性地使林业李嘉图应用中的气候估计产生偏差。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103336.title: The impacts of global warming on forestry: an age-structured Ricardian approach
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103336.title_zh: 全球变暖对林业的影响：基于年龄结构的李嘉图方法

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103338.abstract: This paper studies the effects of extreme temperatures on labor supply and performance in the heavy-duty trucking industry, a pivotal sector with broad productivity spillovers and significant road safety externalities. Using rich and high-frequency data on individual truck drivers in China, we find that exposure to extreme heat significantly reduces labor supply and increases the incidence of risky driving. Evidence further suggests that extreme temperatures disrupt off-duty rest and increase on-duty fatigue among drivers. We also document behavioral adaptation: drivers respond to heat by adjusting work schedules and reallocating labor to adjacent days. Furthermore, the estimated temperature effects on labor supply and risky driving are smaller among drivers employed by firms that offer heat subsidies.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103338.abstract_zh: 本文研究了极端温度对重型卡车运输行业劳动力供给与工作表现的影响，该行业具有广泛的生产率溢出效应和显著的道路安全外部性。利用中国个体卡车司机丰富的高频数据，我们发现暴露于极端高温显著降低了劳动力供给，并增加了危险驾驶行为的发生率。进一步证据表明，极端温度扰乱了司机的下班休息，并加剧了上班期间的疲劳。我们还记录了行为适应现象：司机通过调整工作安排并将劳动重新分配至邻近日期来应对高温。此外，在提供高温补贴的企业所雇用的司机中，温度对劳动力供给和危险驾驶的估计影响较小。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103338.title: Too hot to haul? the impact of temperature on labor supply and performance of truck drivers
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103338.title_zh: 酷热难行？温度对卡车司机劳动力供给与工作绩效的影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103339.abstract: Despite the proliferation of behavioral nudges across pro-environmental domains, it remains unclear whether and how these interventions interact. We study nudge interactions through a two-year natural field experiment, in which two Home Report-type social-comparison interventions—targeting household waste sorting (HWSR) and water conservation (HWR), respectively—were implemented either independently or jointly. The HWSR improved waste sorting regardless of whether the HWR was also applied. However, while the HWR reduced water consumption when implemented alone, it became ineffective when combined with the HWSR. This crowding-out effect eliminates the welfare gains from the HWR under pre-existing water tariffs that weakly internalize the environmental costs of water use. Additional evidence suggests that crowding out was most pronounced in communities with high social capital and without monetary rewards for waste sorting, and that the HWSR strengthened recipients’ moral-normative beliefs in these communities. We discuss potential crowding-out mechanisms related to attention and preferences.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103339.abstract_zh: 尽管行为助推在环保领域日益普及，但这些干预措施之间是否以及如何相互作用仍不明确。我们通过一项为期两年的自然实地实验研究助推互动，其中两类基于家庭报告型的社会比较干预——分别针对家庭垃圾分类（HWSR）和节水（HWR）——被独立或联合实施。HWSR在无论是否同时实施HWR的情况下均改善了垃圾分类。然而，HWR在单独实施时减少了用水量，但与HWSR联合实施时则失效。这种挤出效应消除了在现有水价弱化水资源使用环境成本的情况下HWR带来的福利收益。额外证据表明，挤出效应在社会资本高且无垃圾分类货币奖励的社区中最为显著，且HWSR在这些社区中强化了接受者的道德规范性信念。我们讨论了与注意力和偏好相关的潜在挤出机制。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103339.title: Interactions of behavioral interventions across pro-environmental domains: A natural field experiment
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103339.title_zh: 跨环保行为领域的行为干预互动：一项自然田野实验

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103340.abstract: This paper studies the optimal design of corrective subsidies when eligibility and subsidy levels can be differentiated across observable recipient categories, such as geographic location or housing type. Although such categorical targeting is common in practice, there is limited normative guidance on how to design it when externality correction, cost-effectiveness, and redistribution must be balanced under a budget constraint. We develop a framework that decomposes the optimal subsidy for each category into three components reflecting these objectives. We show how the optimal design depends systematically on category-specific primitives—positive externalities, subsidy responsiveness, and the average social welfare weight of subsidy recipients—and on the program budget. We apply the framework to residential solar PV installation subsidy programs in Japan, some of which differentiate support between new and existing homes. We provide causal evidence that existing homes are 2 to 3.5 times more responsive to subsidies than new homes. Our simulations show that, in most scenarios, this large difference makes it optimal to assign higher subsidies to existing homes, generating sizable welfare gains relative to a uniform design (15% in the benchmark case). More generally, our theoretical and empirical results highlight the importance of systematically incorporating these factors into the design of categorically targeted corrective subsidies.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103340.abstract_zh: 本文研究了当资格条件和补贴水平可根据可观察的受助类别（如地理位置或住房类型）进行差异化设定时，矫正性补贴的最优设计问题。尽管此类分类定向在实践中较为常见，但在预算约束下需兼顾外部性矫正、成本效益与再分配目标时，关于如何设计此类补贴的规范性指导却相对有限。我们构建了一个分析框架，将每一类别的最优补贴分解为反映上述三个目标的组成部分。我们展示了最优设计如何系统性地依赖于类别特定的基础要素——正外部性、补贴响应度以及补贴受助者的平均社会福利权重——以及项目预算。我们将该框架应用于日本住宅太阳能光伏安装补贴项目，其中部分项目对新旧住宅的扶持力度有所区分。我们提供了因果证据，表明现有住宅对补贴的响应度是新住宅的2至3.5倍。模拟结果显示，在大多数情境下，这一显著差异使得向现有住宅提供更高补贴成为最优选择，相较于统一设计可产生可观的福利收益（基准情形下为15%）。更广泛而言，我们的理论与实证结果强调了在分类定向矫正性补贴设计中系统纳入这些因素的重要性。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103340.title: Cost-effective and equitable targeting of corrective subsidies: Differentiated green subsidies for new and existing homes
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103340.title_zh: 成本有效且公平的矫正性补贴目标：针对新建与现有住宅的差异化绿色补贴

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103341.abstract: Unexpected shocks to the electricity supply can influence people’s decision to invest in renewable energy, particularly when these technologies serve as substitutes for backup power. This study investigates the impact of a large-scale power outage on subsequent photovoltaic (PV) installations and examines how households and firms evaluate the expected benefits of PV systems as an emergency power source. Using a doubly-robust difference-in-differences design, we exploit the 2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi Earthquake in Japan as a natural experiment to estimate the effect of the subsequent blackout on municipality-level PV installations. Our results show that the blackout significantly increased commercial PV installations but had no effect on residential installations. In particular, commercial PV capacity rose by 4.243 kW per 1000 people per half-year following the blackout. Additional analysis suggests that the intermittent nature of solar power may limit the reliability of residential PV systems during emergencies, especially under adverse weather conditions. These findings highlight the need to address intermittency to enhance the role of PV systems as resilient infrastructure.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103341.abstract_zh: 电力供应的意外冲击可能影响人们投资可再生能源的决策，尤其是当这些技术作为备用电源的替代品时。本研究探讨了大规模停电对后续光伏安装的影响，并考察了家庭和企业如何评估光伏系统作为应急电源的预期效益。采用双重稳健差分中的差分设计，我们利用2018年日本北海道胆振东部地震作为自然实验，估计了随后停电对市级光伏安装的影响。结果显示，停电显著增加了商业光伏安装，但对住宅安装无影响。具体而言，停电后每半年每千人商业光伏容量增加了4.243千瓦。进一步分析表明，太阳能发电的间歇性可能限制住宅光伏系统在紧急情况下的可靠性，尤其是在不利天气条件下。这些发现强调了解决间歇性问题以增强光伏系统作为韧性基础设施的作用的必要性。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103341.title: Light after the darkness: Estimating the impact of power outages on subsequent solar installations
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103341.title_zh: 黑暗之后的光明：评估停电对后续太阳能安装的影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103343.abstract: Soil tests provide information that can help farmers optimize their inputs. This can reduce costs, increase yields and profits, and contribute to sustainable soil health. Yet soil tests are rarely used by small-scale farmers and are typically not offered by extension workers. Instead, high hopes are pinned on a market-based dissemination. In this study, we elicit small-scale farmers’ willingness-to-pay (WTP) for rapid, low-cost soil tests using incentive-compatible auctions. Additionally, we test whether randomized participation in a sustainable soil management training can increase farmers’ WTP. Furthermore, we elicit WTP in an alternative setting by measuring the willingness to contribute to the costs of a soil test kit when entire farmer groups are offered kits containing 50 tests. The average WTP for soil tests amounts to 39% of the market price and is not statistically different if soil tests are offered to groups where free riding is possible. Participants who were exposed to prior training do not exhibit a higher WTP per test. Data collected five months after the WTP experiment indicate an association between soil testing and reduced use of inorganic fertilizers—particularly nitrogen—as well as more sustainable input management in the context characterized by prevalent overuse. Our results can guide the integration of subsidized soil tests into extension programs.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103343.abstract_zh: 土壤测试能提供有助于农户优化投入品的信息，从而降低成本、提高产量和利润，并促进土壤健康的可持续发展。然而，小农户很少使用土壤测试，推广人员通常也不提供此项服务。相反，人们寄厚望于基于市场的推广方式。本研究通过激励相容的拍卖方式，测度小农户对快速、低成本土壤测试的支付意愿（WTP）。此外，我们检验了随机参与可持续土壤管理培训是否能提高农户的支付意愿。进一步地，我们在另一种情境下测度支付意愿，即当整个农户群体获得包含50次测试的土壤测试套件时，衡量其为该套件成本分担的意愿。结果显示，土壤测试的平均支付意愿为市场价格的39%，且在允许搭便车行为的群体情境下，支付意愿在统计上无显著差异。接受过先前培训的参与者并未表现出更高的单次测试支付意愿。在支付意愿实验五个月后收集的数据表明，土壤测试与无机肥料（尤其是氮肥）使用减少之间存在关联，并在普遍存在过度使用的背景下，促进了更可持续的投入品管理。我们的研究结果可为将补贴性土壤测试纳入推广计划提供指导。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103343.title: Smallholders’ willingness to pay for information: A comparison of individual purchase decisions with contributions to a club good. Evidence from Indonesian rice farmers
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103343.title_zh: 小农户对信息的支付意愿：个体购买决策与俱乐部物品贡献的比较——来自印度尼西亚稻农的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103344.abstract: This paper investigates the optimal subsidy path when emerging low-emission technologies, such as electric vehicles (EVs), compete with established high-emission incumbents, such as internal combustion engines (ICEs). I develop a dynamic model that accounts for market competition, the channel of sales leading to technology improvements, and the externality of carbon emissions. This paper compares dynamic purchase and investment subsidies with currently fixed subsidies in the US and no policy baseline. To calibrate and run the model, I utilize collocation methods and use coefficients from the estimation of aggregated real market data: 531 vehicle models sold in the US from 2008 to 2019, as well as SEC filing reports. I find that the optimal policy path is heavily front-loaded, beginning with high subsidy values that phase out as EV firms accumulate capital and reach technological maturity. Both dynamic purchase and investment subsidies significantly increase the total social net benefit compared to constant subsidies. The results suggest that constant subsidies, which are not responsive to changes in market information, fail to account for the dynamic gains from induced investment and technological learning, which are essential for achieving an efficient market transition.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103344.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了当新兴低碳技术（如电动汽车）与既有高排放技术（如内燃机）竞争时，最优补贴路径的问题。我构建了一个动态模型，该模型考虑了市场竞争、销售渠道带来的技术进步以及碳排放的外部性。本文比较了动态购买补贴和投资补贴与美国当前固定补贴及无政策基准的情况。为校准并运行模型，我采用了配置方法，并利用从聚合真实市场数据估计得到的系数：2008年至2019年间美国销售的531款车型，以及美国证券交易委员会备案报告。研究发现，最优政策路径呈现明显的前置特征，即初期补贴较高，随着电动汽车企业积累资本并达到技术成熟阶段而逐步退出。与固定补贴相比，动态购买补贴和投资补贴均显著提高了社会总净收益。结果表明，固定补贴未能对市场信息变化作出响应，未能考虑诱导投资和技术学习带来的动态收益，而这些对于实现高效的市场转型至关重要。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103344.title: Incentivizing capital investments in electric vehicle attributes to stimulate demand
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103344.title_zh: 激励电动汽车属性资本投资以刺激需求

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103345.abstract: Market-based instruments are widely promoted for their efficiency in achieving environmental goals, but their effectiveness depends on enforcement and compliance, which are often imperfect. We develop a theoretical model in which agents face both technological standards and quota regulations, with the possibility of non-compliance with both at the risk of fines. Within this model, we investigate how intrinsic motivation to comply with different regulations affects investment behavior in quota markets. We find that a greater willingness to invest in quotas can result from either a strong intrinsic motivation to comply with quota regulations or a weak motivation to comply with technological standards. To test these predictions, we use survey data and incentivized economic experiments with Norwegian fishers. The empirical results confirm the theory predictions: Fishers who find technological violations less acceptable tend to invest less in quotas, while those who disapprove of quota violations tend to buy more quotas. These findings highlight the critical role of compliance attitudes for quota market behavior and offer insights for designing more efficient environmental regulations.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103345.abstract_zh: 基于市场的工具因其在实现环境目标方面的效率而被广泛推广，但其有效性依赖于执行与合规，而这些往往并不完善。我们构建了一个理论模型，其中行为主体面临技术标准与配额规定，且两者均存在违规风险并可能遭受罚款。在此模型框架内，我们探讨了遵守不同规定的内在动机如何影响配额市场中的投资行为。研究发现，对配额投资的更大意愿可能源于对配额规定强烈的内在遵守动机，或是对技术标准遵守动机的薄弱。为验证这些预测，我们利用调查数据及与挪威渔民进行的激励性经济实验。实证结果证实了理论预测：认为技术违规较不可接受的渔民倾向于减少配额投资，而不赞同配额违规的渔民则倾向于购买更多配额。这些发现凸显了合规态度对配额市场行为的关键作用，并为设计更高效的环境规制提供了洞见。

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103348.abstract: The literature on the relationship between extreme heat and mental health in low- and middle-income countries has primarily focused on long-term and indirect channels, such as harvest failures and their impacts on mental health. In contrast, this study assesses the direct, short-term effects of heat stress on mental health and explores potential underlying physiological mechanisms. Moreover, by using a heat stress measure that accounts for non-linear interactions between heat and relative humidity (wet bulb temperature) and comparing it with conventional temperature measures (dry bulb temperature), I show that neglecting this interaction may underestimate the true effect. I combine data on self-reported depression and anxiety symptoms from four waves of the Indian WHO-SAGE survey with high-resolution climate data, exploiting quasi-random variation in heat exposure driven by the timing and location of survey implementation. The results show that exposure to extreme heat stress (wet bulb temperature) increases the reporting of depressive symptoms, but not of anxiety symptoms. The effects are consistently smaller and insignificant when dry bulb temperature is used together with humidity as linear control variable. The evidence points to heat stress exposure during agricultural work, increased cognitive difficulties, and sleeping disturbances as pathways linking heat stress and mental health among rural populations, while urban populations are not affected. Finally, the study shows that access to the District Mental Health Program plays a protective role, mitigating the negative impact of heat stress on mental health. These results underscore the need to integrate mental health into climate impact assessments and adaptation policies.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103348.abstract_zh: 关于极端高温与中低收入国家心理健康之间关系的文献，主要聚焦于长期和间接渠道，如农作物歉收及其对心理健康的影响。相比之下，本研究评估了热应激对心理健康的直接短期效应，并探讨了潜在的生理机制。此外，通过采用考虑热与相对湿度非线性相互作用的热应激指标（湿球温度），并将其与传统温度指标（干球温度）进行比较，我表明忽视这种相互作用可能会低估真实效应。我将印度WHO-SAGE调查四轮中自我报告的抑郁和焦虑症状数据与高分辨率气候数据相结合，利用调查实施时间和地点所驱动的热暴露的准随机变化。结果显示，暴露于极端热应激（湿球温度）会增加抑郁症状的报告，但对焦虑症状无显著影响。当使用干球温度并同时将湿度作为线性控制变量时，效应始终较小且不显著。证据表明，农业劳动中的热应激暴露、认知困难增加以及睡眠障碍是连接热应激与农村人口心理健康之间的途径，而城市人口则未受影响。最后，研究表明，获得地区心理健康项目具有保护作用，能够减轻热应激对心理健康的负面影响。这些结果强调了将心理健康纳入气候影响评估和适应政策的必要性。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103348.title: The mental health toll of heat stress in India
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103348.title_zh: 印度热应激对心理健康的损害

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103350.abstract: Climate change poses increasing risks to population well-being through heightened water scarcity. This threat is particularly pronounced in low-income and climate-vulnerable regions, where traditional water infrastructure may not be feasible in the near term. This study evaluates the effectiveness of a decentralized water policy as a climate adaptation strategy, focusing on Brazil's Cisterns Program, a large-scale rainwater harvesting initiative designed to build climate resilience in remote, underserved communities. The analysis shows that access to rainwater harvesting reduces severe cases of waterborne diseases by approximately 34%. Beyond these average health gains, the study assesses climate resilience by examining how the program moderates the impacts of drought shocks. Using multiple definitions of drought, the analysis shows that these events substantially increase disease burden. However, these adverse effects are significantly mitigated or fully offset by the program, indicating a sharp reduction in vulnerability to climate-related stress. Evidence on mechanisms suggests that effectiveness depends not only on water availability but also on beneficiaries' capacity to manage water safely and on program implementation. Impacts are significantly larger in more educated communities and where local civil-society organizations play a central role in implementation. These findings highlight the potential of low-cost, decentralized interventions as viable climate adaptation strategies, particularly in settings where large-scale infrastructure projects are impractical, and offer a scalable model for resilience-building development policies in the Global South.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103350.abstract_zh: 气候变化通过加剧水资源短缺，对人口福祉构成日益严重的风险。这一威胁在低收入和气候脆弱地区尤为突出，这些地区传统的水利基础设施短期内可能难以实现。本研究评估了分散式水政策作为气候适应策略的有效性，重点关注巴西的“蓄水池计划”——一项旨在为偏远、服务不足社区建立气候韧性的大规模雨水收集倡议。分析显示，获得雨水收集设施可使严重水传播疾病病例减少约34%。除这些平均健康收益外，本研究还通过考察该计划如何调节干旱冲击的影响来评估气候韧性。利用多种干旱定义，分析表明这些事件显著增加了疾病负担。然而，这些不利影响被该计划显著缓解或完全抵消，表明对气候相关压力的脆弱性大幅降低。关于作用机制的证据表明，有效性不仅取决于水资源可用性，还取决于受益者安全用水的能力及项目实施情况。在受教育程度较高的社区以及当地公民社会组织在实施中发挥核心作用的地区，影响显著更大。这些发现凸显了低成本、分散式干预措施作为可行气候适应策略的潜力，尤其是在大型基础设施项目不切实际的环境中，并为全球南方韧性建设发展政策提供了可扩展的模式。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103350.title: Building resilience in the Global South: Evidence from a decentralized water policy in Brazil
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103350.title_zh: 增强全球南方韧性：来自巴西分散式水政策的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103351.abstract: Bitcoin contributes to global carbon emissions on a scale comparable to entire countries in order to secure its decentralized network. This exposes Bitcoin to climate policies aimed at reducing emissions. This paper develops a general equilibrium framework to examine how the stringency of climate policy affects Bitcoin’s valuation and its relationship with the equity market. Our theoretical analysis delivers a key insight: a transition from a lenient to a stringent climate policy increases the conditional correlation between Bitcoin and equity returns, thereby compromising Bitcoin’s appeal as a hedge or diversifier against equity market volatility. Empirical evidence supports this theoretical prediction.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103351.abstract_zh: 比特币为维护其去中心化网络所产生的全球碳排放量，其规模堪比整个国家，这使其面临旨在减少排放的气候政策的影响。本文构建了一个一般均衡框架，用以考察气候政策的严格程度如何影响比特币的估值及其与股票市场的关系。我们的理论分析得出一个关键见解：从宽松气候政策向严格气候政策的转变，会提高比特币与股票收益之间的条件相关性，从而削弱比特币作为对冲或分散股票市场波动工具的吸引力。实证证据支持了这一理论预测。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103351.title: Bitcoin growth amid climate change: Policy and investment implications
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103351.title_zh: 气候变化背景下的比特币增长：政策与投资启示

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103353.abstract: Existing studies find that reducing income inequality increases greenhouse gas emissions. However, these analyses usually rely on household surveys that underrepresent top-income groups or on corrections that assume a constant relationship between income and emissions, both of which can distort the results. This study develops a new approach that combines tax microdata to correct the income distribution with machine-learning-based predictions of consumption to better estimate emissions among high-income households. Applied to Ecuador, a highly unequal country with institutional commitments to environmental protection, the approach identifies substantially higher emissions at the top of the income distribution and a non-monotonic pattern of emissions intensity per US$ of income that conventional methods fail to detect. Simulations show that full redistribution raises emissions by 26% under the new approach, compared with 6% in uncorrected surveys. These results underline the importance of better data and methods for evaluating inequality-emission trade-offs and designing redistribution policies.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103353.abstract_zh: 现有研究发现，减少收入不平等会增加温室气体排放。然而，这些分析通常依赖于对高收入群体代表性不足的家庭调查，或依赖于假设收入与排放之间关系恒定的修正方法，这两者都可能扭曲结果。本研究开发了一种新方法，结合税收微观数据以修正收入分布，并利用基于机器学习的消费预测，更准确地估算高收入家庭的排放量。将该方法应用于厄瓜多尔——一个高度不平等且对环境保护有制度承诺的国家——研究发现，收入分布顶端的排放量显著更高，且每美元收入的排放强度呈现非单调模式，而传统方法未能检测到这一现象。模拟显示，在新方法下，完全再分配使排放增加26%，而在未修正的调查中仅为6%。这些结果强调了更优的数据和方法对于评估不平等与排放之间的权衡以及设计再分配政策的重要性。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103353.title: Amplified challenges for the joint reduction of emissions and inequality, considering the missing-rich
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103353.title_zh: 考虑缺失富裕群体时，协同减排与减贫面临的加剧挑战

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103354.abstract: The rapid adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) is essential for reducing CO₂ emissions, but it puts growing pressure on electricity grids by driving up peak demand. Grid tariffs can help mitigate this impact by encouraging more efficient use of grid capacity. We conduct a randomized controlled trial among more than 600 households with home EV charging to evaluate their response to a capacity-based tariff that imposes an exceedance charge on electricity consumption above a predefined capacity threshold. We test two variants: a static exceedance tariff, which charges for exceedances at all times and encourages households to reduce overall capacity use; and a Time-of-Use (TOU) exceedance tariff, which only charges for exceedances during peak hours (5 PM to 2 AM), incentivizing demand shifts to off-peak periods. We find that the static exceedance tariff reduces individual peak demand and exceedances above the threshold by approximately 5 to 10 percent, while not shifting charging to off-peak hours. In contrast, households exposed to the TOU exceedance tariff shift charging to off-peak hours after 2 AM, but without reducing individual peak demand or exceedances. Although TOU tariffs are designed to reduce peak demand, they may unintentionally create new peaks by concentrating EV charging in the same off-peak hours, revealing a clear drawback. Our findings suggest that static exceedance tariffs may be more effective in reducing peak demand.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103354.abstract_zh: 电动汽车（EV）的快速普及对于减少二氧化碳排放至关重要，但同时也通过推高峰值需求给电网带来了日益增长的压力。电网电价可通过鼓励更高效地利用电网容量来缓解这一影响。我们针对超过600户拥有家用电动汽车充电设施的家庭开展了一项随机对照试验，以评估他们对基于容量的电价方案的反应，该方案对超过预设容量阈值的电力消耗征收超额费用。我们测试了两种变体：静态超额电价，对所有时段的超额用电收费，鼓励家庭减少整体容量使用；以及分时（TOU）超额电价，仅对高峰时段（下午5点至凌晨2点）的超额用电收费，激励需求转移至非高峰时段。我们发现，静态超额电价使个体峰值需求和超过阈值的超额用电量减少了约5%至10%，但并未将充电行为转移至非高峰时段。相比之下，接触分时超额电价的家庭将充电行为转移至凌晨2点后的非高峰时段，但并未减少个体峰值需求或超额用电量。尽管分时电价旨在降低峰值需求，却可能因将电动汽车充电集中在相同的非高峰时段而无意中制造新的峰值，这揭示了一个明显的弊端。我们的研究结果表明，静态超额电价在降低峰值需求方面可能更为有效。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103354.title: Reducing peak load from electric vehicles through grid tariffs: Evidence from a randomized field experiment
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103354.title_zh: 通过电网电价降低电动汽车峰值负荷：来自随机现场实验的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103355.abstract: Food waste from restaurants contributes to greenhouse gas emissions and puts pressure on urban waste systems, especially in low and middle-income countries. We conducted a randomized controlled trial to assess whether food waste management training reduces kitchen-level organic waste in micro-sized and small restaurants in the hospitality industry in Cusco, Peru, a major global tourist destination. We find that the intervention reduces food waste generation by 10 percent in the trained restaurants. We also find that it improved the staff’s knowledge and awareness of food waste management practices. A simple cost-benefit analysis suggests that skills-building interventions can improve the pro-environmental performance of micro and small firms and can be implemented with a positive net benefit to society.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103355.abstract_zh: 餐厅产生的食物浪费加剧了温室气体排放，并对城市废弃物系统造成压力，尤其是在中低收入国家。我们在秘鲁库斯科——一个全球重要的旅游目的地——开展了一项随机对照试验，以评估食物浪费管理培训是否能减少酒店业中微型和小型餐厅的厨房有机废弃物。我们发现，该干预措施使受训餐厅的食物浪费产生量减少了10%。同时，干预还提升了员工对食物浪费管理实践的知识和意识。一项简单的成本效益分析表明，技能建设干预能够改善微型和小型企业的环境友好表现，并可为社会带来正净效益。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103355.title: Trained to reduce food waste: Evidence from an RCT with micro-sized and small enterprises in Cusco's hospitality industry
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103355.title_zh: 减少食物浪费培训：库斯科酒店业微型和小型企业随机对照试验的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103356.abstract: While mobile-source emission standards have been widely implemented for decades, their effectiveness remains underexplored. This paper evaluates the impact of California’s Low Emission Vehicle (LEV) program on ambient air pollution by exploiting its staggered adoption across states. Using a large panel of monitor-day observations from 1985–2014 matched with daily weather data, I employ a modern staggered difference-in-differences framework to compare air-pollution trends in LEV and never-LEV states. The event-study results show no evidence of pre-trends and reveal a gradual build-up of treatment effects over roughly a decade after adoption. On average over the sample period, the LEV program reduces daily maximum ozone concentrations by 4.78%. The program’s impact is more pronounced during summer months and in urban and suburban regions, and these patterns are robust to restricting the sample to long-running monitors, excluding border monitors, and reweighting the data using a synthetic-control difference-in-differences procedure. These findings provide empirical evidence on the effectiveness of vehicle-emission standards and contribute to the broader literature on environmental regulation and mobile-source pollution control.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103356.abstract_zh: 尽管移动源排放标准已实施数十年，但其有效性仍未得到充分探讨。本文通过利用各州分阶段采纳加州低排放车辆（LEV）计划的情况，评估该计划对空气质量的影响。利用1985年至2014年间与每日天气数据匹配的大规模监测站日观测面板数据，我采用现代交错双重差分框架，比较了采纳LEV计划州与从未采纳州之间的空气污染趋势。事件研究结果显示，不存在预趋势证据，并揭示了采纳后约十年内处理效应的逐步累积。在样本期间平均而言，LEV计划使每日最大臭氧浓度降低了4.78%。该计划的影响在夏季月份及城市和郊区更为显著，且这些模式在限制样本为长期运行监测站、排除边境监测站以及使用合成控制双重差分程序重新加权数据后依然稳健。这些发现为车辆排放标准的有效性提供了实证证据，并对环境规制与移动源污染控制的更广泛文献有所贡献。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103356.title: Evaluating the effectiveness of mobile emission standards: Evidence from California’s LEV program
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103356.title_zh: 评估移动排放标准有效性：来自加州低排放车辆项目的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103357.abstract: Using the initial impoundment of the world’s largest hydroelectric dam as a natural experiment, we assess how farming households adapt to dam-induced seasonal water scarcity. We find that the impoundment of the TGD for power generation has altered the Yangtze River’s water cycle, seasonally reducing downstream water supply and causing rice yields to fall. In response to a persistent 12% decline in yields, subsistence households primarily expanded their farming area to maintain total output. While some households reallocated labor to non-agricultural sectors, this adaptation was significantly constrained by wealth endowment.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103357.abstract_zh: 以全球最大水电站初期蓄水作为自然实验，我们评估了农户如何适应大坝引发的季节性水资源短缺。研究发现，三峡大坝为发电而蓄水改变了长江的水循环，季节性减少了下游供水，导致水稻产量下降。面对持续12%的产量下滑，自给型农户主要通过扩大耕作面积来维持总产出。尽管部分农户将劳动力重新配置到非农部门，但这种适应方式受到财富禀赋的显著制约。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103357.title: How do smallholder farmers adapt to water scarcity? Evidence from the three Gorges Dam
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103357.title_zh: 小农户如何适应水资源短缺？来自三峡大坝的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103358.abstract: While conservation goals have long been pursued through traditional species-augmenting actions, a broader set of episodic ecosystem modification (EEM) actions, such as hydropower dam releases, prescribed fire, and beach nourishment, is garnering attention. EEM actions face several implementation challenges stemming from high opportunity costs, delayed effect mechanisms, reliance on monitoring for deployment timing, and outcome uncertainty due to infrequent use. In this paper, we study the use of EEM actions in the form of designer flows—ecologically-motivated releases of water into regulated river segments—to maintain a viable population of a threatened native fish species in the Colorado River. We demonstrate how the cost-effectiveness of EEM actions can be hampered by the complex and delayed effects on species viability, but enhanced through targeted monitoring for timing deployment and experimentation for reducing uncertainty about effectiveness.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103358.abstract_zh: 长期以来，保护目标一直通过传统的物种增殖行动来实现，然而，一系列更广泛的间歇性生态系统改造（EEM）行动，如水力发电大坝泄流、计划烧除和海滩养护，正日益受到关注。EEM行动面临若干实施挑战，这些挑战源于高昂的机会成本、延迟的效应机制、依赖监测来确定部署时机，以及因使用频率低而导致的结果不确定性。本文研究了以设计流量形式——即出于生态动机向受管制河段放水——实施的EEM行动，用以维持科罗拉多河中一种受威胁本土鱼类种群的生存能力。我们展示了EEM行动的成本效益如何因对物种生存能力的复杂且延迟的影响而受到制约，但通过有针对性的监测以确定部署时机和通过实验减少效果不确定性，其成本效益可以得到提升。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103358.title: Timing, uncertainty, and opportunity cost: Lessons for ecosystem modification on the Colorado River
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103358.title_zh: 时机、不确定性与机会成本：科罗拉多河生态系统改造的启示

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103359.abstract: This paper examines the enduring effects of early-life exposure to heatwaves on the climate governance of local political leaders. We compile detailed biographical information on city mayors and party secretaries in China and combine it with comprehensive data on carbon emissions, economic outcomes, and policies for over 2800 counties from 2000 to 2017. We find that counties governed by officials who experienced heatwaves in their early life exhibit about a 1% reduction in carbon emissions relative to those governed by officials without such exposure. The effect is driven primarily by mayors, officials with more intense or repeated heatwave exposure, and cities with less industrialized economic structures. Further analysis provides suggestive evidence that these officials are more likely to implement carbon pricing and emission abatement policies, as well as policies with clear targets, enforcement, and mandatory language. Their governance reshapes local economic structures by constraining the activity and entry of emission-intensive manufacturing firms, a pattern further supported by firm-level evidence of lower carbon emissions.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103359.abstract_zh: 本文考察了早期生活中经历热浪对地方政治领导人气候治理的持久影响。我们汇编了中国城市市长及市委书记的详细传记信息，并将其与2000年至2017年间超过2800个县的碳排放、经济成果及政策综合数据相结合。研究发现，由早期生活中经历过热浪的官员治理的县，其碳排放量相较于未经历此类暴露的官员所治理的县，约减少1%。这一效应主要由市长、经历更强烈或更频繁热浪暴露的官员，以及工业化程度较低的经济结构的城市所驱动。进一步分析提供了提示性证据，表明这些官员更可能实施碳定价和减排政策，以及具有明确目标、执行机制和强制性语言的政策。他们的治理通过限制排放密集型制造业企业的活动和进入，重塑了地方经济结构，这一模式也得到了企业层面碳排放降低的证据支持。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103359.title: The enduring impacts of early life exposure to heatwaves on climate governance
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103359.title_zh: 早期热浪暴露对气候治理的持久影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103360.abstract: India consistently ranks among the countries with the highest levels of ambient air pollution worldwide. At the same time, it faces significant challenges in neonatal health, with newborns having low birth weights which has been shown to have long-term impacts on health and labor market outcomes. Using data from the Indian Demographic and Health Survey (DHS), we examine the impact of in-utero exposure to particulate matter ( ) on birth outcomes. We exploit quasi-random variation in wind direction as an instrument for in-utero particulate matter exposure for each child. We find that reducing in-utero exposure by one standard deviation would lead to a 1.1% increase in average birth weight and reduce the incidence of low birth weight (LBW) and very low birth weight (VLBW) births by 2.9 and 0.7 percentage points, respectively. We extend our analysis to examine potential nonlinear effects of pollution exposure on birth outcomes. While we find no evidence of heterogeneous effects across different pollution thresholds, our results indicate that pollution disproportionately affects individuals in the lower tail of the birth weight distribution, with no impact at the upper tail.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103360.abstract_zh: 印度在全球环境空气污染最严重的国家之列，同时，该国在新生儿健康方面面临重大挑战，新生儿出生体重偏低，而研究表明这对其长期健康及劳动力市场结果具有深远影响。利用印度人口与健康调查（DHS）的数据，我们考察了子宫内暴露于颗粒物（PM）对出生结局的影响。我们利用风向的准随机变化作为每个儿童子宫内颗粒物暴露的工具变量。研究发现，将子宫内暴露减少一个标准差，可使平均出生体重提高1.1%，并使低出生体重（LBW）和极低出生体重（VLBW）的发生率分别降低2.9和0.7个百分点。我们进一步扩展分析，探讨污染暴露对出生结局可能存在的非线性效应。尽管未发现不同污染阈值下存在异质性效应的证据，但结果表明，污染对出生体重分布下尾端个体影响尤为显著，而对上尾端则无影响。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103360.title: Impact of air pollution on birth outcomes: Causal evidence from India
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103360.title_zh: 空气污染对出生结果的影响：来自印度的因果证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103361.abstract: Empirical research suggests that occupational heterogeneity is crucial to explaining labor market outcomes. However, most computable general equilibrium models used to assess energy and environmental policies assume a single labor type that can easily shift from one occupation to another. We evaluate the social cost and incidence implications of labor market heterogeneity via limits it imposes on labor mobility and substitution in the supply and demand of occupations within a computable general equilibrium model. We find that occupational heterogeneity has limited implications for aggregate social costs but plays a key role in how those costs are distributed across households.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103361.abstract_zh: 实证研究表明，职业异质性对于解释劳动力市场结果至关重要。然而，用于评估能源与环境政策的大多数可计算一般均衡模型假设单一劳动类型，能够轻易在不同职业间转换。我们通过在一个可计算一般均衡模型中，对劳动力流动性及职业供需替代性施加限制，评估了劳动力市场异质性对社会成本及其分布的影响。我们发现，职业异质性对总体社会成本的影响有限，但在这些成本如何在不同家庭间分配方面扮演关键角色。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103361.title: Occupational affiliation and the incidence of environmental regulation
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103361.title_zh: 职业归属与环境规制的发生率

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103362.abstract: Overextraction and excess capacity are longstanding challenges in natural resource industries. Capacity-reduction programs are increasingly common policy responses designed to reduce capacity, reallocate access rights, and improve environmental and economic outcomes. Yet little is known about how such programs distribute benefits and costs among participants who remain in the industry. This paper estimates the benefits accruing from the U.S. Pacific Coast Groundfish Buyback Program, which retired over one-third of its vessel capacity through a voluntary $46 million reverse auction. Exploiting spatial variation in capacity reductions across ports within a difference-in-differences design, we find that active vessels operating in ports with larger relative reductions realized substantial revenue gains, while those elsewhere saw small or negligible gains. Conservative estimates suggest the program generated approximately $23.9 million in additional revenues net of variable costs and program fees over the first seven years, yielding approximately $4.66 in private net benefits per dollar of fees paid during this period. However, returns varied widely depending on the degree of local capacity reduction. These findings demonstrate that while capacity reduction programs can yield significant economic gains for remaining industry participants, their uneven impacts raise important questions about program design and the balance between efficiency and equity.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103362.abstract_zh: 过度捕捞与产能过剩是自然资源行业长期面临的挑战。产能削减计划作为一种日益普遍的政策应对措施，旨在减少产能、重新分配准入权，并改善环境与经济成效。然而，关于此类计划如何在继续留在行业内的参与者之间分配收益与成本，目前知之甚少。本文估算了美国太平洋沿岸底栖鱼类回购计划所带来的收益，该计划通过一场自愿性的4600万美元反向拍卖，淘汰了超过三分之一的渔船产能。利用双重差分设计中各港口产能削减的空间差异，我们发现，在产能相对削减幅度较大的港口运营的活跃渔船获得了显著的收入增长，而其他港口的渔船则仅获得微小或可忽略不计的收益。保守估计显示，该计划在头七年内产生了约2390万美元的额外收入（扣除可变成本与计划费用后），在此期间每支付1美元费用约带来4.66美元的私人净收益。然而，收益因当地产能削减程度的不同而差异显著。这些研究结果表明，尽管产能削减计划能为剩余行业参与者带来可观的经济收益，但其不均衡的影响引发了关于计划设计以及效率与公平之间平衡的重要问题。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103362.title: Who benefits from capacity reduction programs? Insights from the U.S. Pacific Coast groundfish fishery
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103362.title_zh: 谁从产能削减计划中受益？来自美国太平洋沿岸底层鱼类渔业的启示

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103363.abstract: The global energy transition is accelerating the phase-out of fossil fuel combustion, yet its indirect environmental benefits through reduced fossil fuel extraction remain underexplored. This paper examines whether coal mining-induced deforestation and air pollution emissions are smaller in regions with greater renewable energy deployment in China. Leveraging high-resolution geographical data on permitted coal mining areas, along with satellite data on forest cover and PM2.5 emissions in the past two decades, we find that while coal mining reduces forest cover by 3.3%, integrating an additional 1% of local renewable energy into the electricity grid is associated with about 0.3% lower deforestation. As PM2.5 is transported downwind, ambient pollution and benefits of renewables have spillover to counties within 30 km of coal mines. Monetizing these benefits of avoided deforestation and air pollution, we estimate that the total value can exceed one billion US dollars. Our findings offer policy insights to promote energy transition with ecological preservation and environmental protection.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103363.abstract_zh: 全球能源转型正加速化石燃料燃烧的淘汰进程，然而，通过减少化石燃料开采所带来的间接环境效益仍未得到充分探讨。本文考察了中国可再生能源部署较多的地区，其煤炭开采引发的森林砍伐和空气污染排放是否相对较少。利用过去二十年中关于许可煤矿区的高分辨率地理数据，以及卫星获取的森林覆盖和PM2.5排放数据，我们发现，尽管煤炭开采使森林覆盖率减少了3.3%，但当地电网中每增加1%的可再生能源，与约0.3%的森林砍伐减少相关联。由于PM2.5随风向下风向传输，环境中的污染及可再生能源的效益会溢出至煤矿周边30公里内的县区。将这些避免的森林砍伐和空气污染所带来的效益货币化后，我们估计其总价值可超过十亿美元。我们的研究为促进能源转型与生态保护及环境保护协同推进提供了政策启示。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103363.title: Environmental benefits of renewable energy: Evidence from coal mining-induced deforestation and air pollution emissions
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103363.title_zh: 可再生能源的环境效益：来自煤矿开采导致的森林砍伐与空气污染排放的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103364.abstract: Climate-related disasters can affect housing markets by making previously underappreciated risks more salient. This paper studies how a rare and catastrophic quick-clay landslide in Eastern Norway affects housing market outcomes. The event constituted a double information shock for the housing market: extensive national media coverage sharply increased public attention to quick-clay risk, while the same coverage widely disseminated interactive hazard maps and encouraged people to assess whether their own properties were located in at-risk zones. Using detailed property transaction data from Eastern Norway, we combine a two-way fixed effects difference-in-differences design with boundary-based comparisons of properties located near mapped hazard zones. Properties exposed to quick-clay risk experience statistically significant price declines of 1–1.5 percent relative to non-exposed properties, with effects extending beyond the directly affected municipality. Event-study estimates show that the response is temporary, reflecting a short-lived adjustment in risk perceptions. Applying these event-study estimates to exposed properties sold in Eastern Norway during the two-year response period implies a capitalization loss of approximately USD 23 million. We find little indication of effects on transaction volumes, but new residential development in quick-clay risk zones appears to fall by roughly 12 percent. Overall, the findings show that even a highly visible fatal disaster generates a detectable but limited and short-lived housing market response.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103364.abstract_zh: 气候相关灾害可能通过使先前未被充分认识的风险变得更加显著而影响住房市场。本文研究挪威东部一次罕见且灾难性的快黏土滑坡如何影响住房市场结果。该事件对住房市场构成了双重信息冲击：全国性媒体的广泛报道急剧提升了公众对快黏土风险的关注，同时这些报道广泛传播了交互式灾害地图，并鼓励人们评估自己的房产是否位于风险区域内。利用挪威东部的详细房产交易数据，我们将双向固定效应双重差分设计与基于边界的地块比较相结合，比较位于已绘制灾害区域附近的地块。暴露于快黏土风险的房产相对于未暴露房产，价格出现统计上显著的1%至1.5%的下降，且影响延伸至直接受灾市镇之外。事件研究估计显示，这一反应是暂时的，反映了风险认知中的短期调整。将这些事件研究估计应用于挪威东部两年响应期内出售的暴露房产，意味着资本化损失约为2300万美元。我们发现对交易量影响的迹象甚微，但快黏土风险区域内的新建住宅开发似乎下降了约12%。总体而言，研究结果表明，即使是一场高度可见的致命灾害，也只会引发可检测但有限且短暂的住房市场反应。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103364.title: When climate risks become evident: A natural experiment on risk perceptions in the housing market
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103364.title_zh: 当气候风险变得明显：住房市场中风险感知的自然实验

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103365.abstract: Global warming is having increasingly negative health effects, particularly in relatively poor and hot countries such as India. These impacts are partly due to the direct effect of high temperatures on the human body, and partly due to vector-borne diseases and reduced food availability. While numerous harmful health effects of high temperatures have been established, there is very little research into their possible impact on anemia, a medical condition affecting 25% of the global population and 43 % of people in India. Using health, nutrition and climate data, we analyze the relationship between heat exposure and anemia in India over the past decade. We match blood hemoglobin measurements from nearly 265,000 children, 914,000 women and 140,000 men to two different measurements of exposure to heat, based on air temperature and wet-bulb globe temperature respectively. We find that heat exposure in the 30 days preceding blood measurement is associated with anemia in these three population groups. Moreover, the mechanisms responsible do not seem to be related to nutritional deficiencies, while direct effects and malaria could explain part of the relationship between temperature and anemia. Finally, we estimate the number of extra anemia cases induced by a + 2 ∘ C increase in air temperature, which has an associated cost of around 4.2 billion US dollars, i.e., 0.11 % of Indian GDP.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103365.abstract_zh: 全球变暖正对健康产生日益严重的负面影响，尤其是在印度这样相对贫困且炎热的国家。这些影响部分源于高温对人体的直接作用，部分则归因于媒介传播疾病和粮食供应减少。尽管高温的诸多有害健康效应已被证实，但关于其对贫血——一种影响全球25%人口及印度43%人口的医学状况——可能产生的影响，研究却寥寥无几。利用健康、营养和气候数据，我们分析了过去十年间印度热暴露与贫血之间的关系。我们将近265,000名儿童、914,000名女性和140,000名男性的血液血红蛋白测量数据，分别与基于气温和湿球黑球温度的两种不同热暴露测量指标进行匹配。研究发现，在血液测量前30天内的热暴露与这三个人群中的贫血状况相关联。此外，其作用机制似乎与营养缺乏无关，而直接影响和疟疾可能部分解释了温度与贫血之间的关联。最后，我们估算了气温升高+2°C所导致的额外贫血病例数量，其相关成本约为42亿美元，相当于印度GDP的0.11%。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103365.title: A hidden health impact of heat: exacerbated anemia in India
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103365.title_zh: 热浪的隐性健康影响：印度贫血症的加剧

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103366.abstract: The world is witnessing a surge in green industrial policies, with prominent examples such as the U.S. Inflation Reduction Act incorporating significant protectionist elements. We argue that such green protectionism can play a strategic role in fostering international coordination on climate action. In a simple model combining a standard abatement game with a beggar-thy-neighbor game, we show that protectionist policies improve welfare when expected distortions are low, as they facilitate coordination on climate mitigation at minimal costs. When expected distortions are high, protectionist measures are not adopted and are effectively welfare-neutral. However, when expected distortions are of intermediate size, unregulated protectionist climate policies lead countries to rely excessively on distortive instruments, reducing global welfare. Our findings suggest that regulators like the WTO can enhance welfare by restricting but not entirely banning green protectionist measures. When countries are asymmetric, the case for differentiated regulation depends on whether asymmetries primarily affect countries’ incentives to coordinate on abatement or the social cost of using protectionist instruments to sustain that coordination. We further find that efforts to reduce uncertainty about the size of distortions might backfire, inadvertently encouraging coordination on costly protectionist measures.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103366.abstract_zh: 全球正经历绿色产业政策的激增，其中美国《通胀削减法案》等突出案例包含了显著的贸易保护主义元素。我们认为，此类绿色保护主义在促进国际气候行动协调方面可发挥战略性作用。在一个将标准减排博弈与以邻为壑博弈相结合的简单模型中，我们证明，当预期扭曲程度较低时，保护主义政策能够增进福利，因其以最小成本促进气候减缓方面的协调。当预期扭曲程度较高时，保护主义措施不会被采纳，且实际上对福利无影响。然而，当预期扭曲程度处于中间水平时，不受监管的保护主义气候政策会导致各国过度依赖扭曲性工具，从而降低全球福利。我们的研究结果表明，世界贸易组织等监管机构可通过限制而非完全禁止绿色保护主义措施来增进福利。当各国不对称时，差异化监管的合理性取决于不对称性主要影响各国协调减排的激励，还是影响用以维持该协调的保护主义工具的社会成本。我们进一步发现，减少扭曲规模不确定性的努力可能适得其反，无意中鼓励各国在代价高昂的保护主义措施上达成协调。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103366.title: Greener thy neighbor? On the welfare effects of protectionist climate policies
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103366.title_zh: 更绿色的邻居？论保护主义气候政策的福利效应

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103374.abstract: This paper estimates the impact of air pollution on consumers’ offline consumption behavior using high-frequency, bankcard transaction-level payment data from China in 2015 and 2016. Employing a panel regression approach with thermal inversion as the instrumental variable for daily local air pollution exposure, we find a statistically and economically significant, negative relationship between pollution exposure and consumer spending. On average, a 100 μg/m3 increase in daily PM2.5 concentration leads to a 14% reduction in daily offline consumer expenditures paid via bankcards. The adverse impacts are particularly pronounced for spending on deferrable goods, groceries, and daily life services; and consumers significantly reduce outdoor shopping activities—including travel distance to intra-city shopping venues—during periods of elevated pollution, consistent with avoidance behavior. Older individuals, high-spending consumers, and holiday shoppers exhibit stronger response to pollution. Our findings underscore the potential economic co-benefits, in terms of consumption, achievable through policies improving air quality.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103374.abstract_zh: 本文利用中国2015年至2016年高频银行卡交易层面的支付数据，估计了空气污染对消费者线下消费行为的影响。采用面板回归方法，并以热逆温作为每日局部空气污染暴露的工具变量，我们发现污染暴露与消费者支出之间存在统计显著且经济意义显著的负相关关系。平均而言，每日PM2.5浓度每增加100微克/立方米，会导致通过银行卡支付的线下日常消费支出减少14%。这一不利影响在可延迟商品、食品杂货及日常生活服务类支出中尤为突出；同时，在污染加剧期间，消费者显著减少户外购物活动——包括前往市内购物场所的出行距离，这与规避行为相一致。老年人、高消费群体及节假日购物者对污染的反应更为强烈。我们的研究结果强调了通过改善空气质量的政策在消费方面可能实现的潜在经济协同效益。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103374.title: Air pollution and consumers’ avoidance behavior: Evidence from high-frequency payment data in China
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103374.title_zh: 空气污染与消费者规避行为：来自中国高频支付数据的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103375.abstract: Large-scale experiments and surveys have become powerful tools for economists, measuring individual economic preferences that help explain economic behavior. However, willingness-to-pay (WTP) for public goods, derived from best-practice stated preference methods, typically relies on response variations to estimate population average preferences. We develop a new WTP elicitation method based on information theory and Bayesian updating that dynamically optimizes bids for a series of binary choices and independently elicits each participant’s WTP while collecting responses. We conduct an online survey experiment with over 1400 adults aged 20 to 79 in Japan to explore the relationship between age and the value of a statistical life (VSL) in a pandemic context at the individual level. First, Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that our adaptive method can provide accurate individual-level estimates of WTP with fewer questions than traditional non-adaptive methods. These estimates are highly correlated with “true” values, even at the extremes of WTP. Second, the VSL estimate among adults does not decrease with age, as sometimes seen in the literature; instead, it hits its lowest point in their 30s and 40s, then increases with age, even after controlling for a comprehensive set of covariates. Third, economic preferences are strongly associated with VSL. Participants who are loss tolerant, present biased, and prosocial tend to have a higher VSL on the intensive margin. Risk-averse, impatient, and selfish participants are more likely to have zero WTP on the extensive margin.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103375.abstract_zh: 大规模实验和调查已成为经济学家的有力工具，用以衡量个体经济偏好，从而有助于解释经济行为。然而，基于最佳实践陈述偏好方法得出的公共物品支付意愿（WTP），通常依赖于响应变化来估计总体平均偏好。我们开发了一种基于信息论和贝叶斯更新的新型WTP诱导方法，该方法能动态优化一系列二元选择的出价，并在收集响应的同时独立诱导每位参与者的WTP。我们在日本对超过1400名20至79岁的成年人进行了在线调查实验，以个体层面探讨年龄与统计生命价值（VSL）在疫情背景下的关系。首先，蒙特卡洛模拟表明，我们的自适应方法能以比传统非自适应方法更少的问题提供准确的个体层面WTP估计。这些估计与“真实”值高度相关，即使在WTP的极端值处也是如此。其次，成年人的VSL估计并不随年龄增长而下降，这与文献中有时所见不同；相反，它在30多岁和40多岁时达到最低点，随后随年龄增长而上升，即使在控制了一组全面的协变量后也是如此。第三，经济偏好与VSL密切相关。损失容忍、现时偏向和亲社会的参与者在集约边际上倾向于有更高的VSL。风险厌恶、缺乏耐心和自私的参与者更可能在广延边际上有零WTP。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103375.title: Dynamically optimized sequential WTP elicitation: Application to the age and VSL relationship
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103375.title_zh: 动态优化的序贯支付意愿诱导：年龄与统计生命价值关系的应用

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103376.abstract: Brazil’s recent tax reform replaces several indirect taxes with a unified Value-Added Tax (VAT), introduces additional rates on goods harmful to health or the environment, exempts several food products, and provides cashback transfers to low-income households. We evaluate the environmental and distributional effects of this reform by combining detailed household expenditure data with product- and state-level carbon footprint estimates that incorporate all emissions sources, including land-use change. The reform, as designed, is projected to increase consumption-based greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by 1.7% (or 49 kilograms per capita), primarily because high-emission food products become tax-exempt. At the same time, lower-income households experience welfare gains through lower food prices and cashback transfers, revealing a trade-off between distributional and environmental objectives. We then evaluate counterfactual scenarios in which additional tax rates are extended to carbon-intensive goods and revenues are recycled through targeted transfers and subsidies. These scenarios reverse the increase in emissions and achieve reductions with relatively limited welfare losses, particularly when revenues subsidize lower-emission food consumption. Our findings show that targeted environmental taxation combined with compensatory transfers can better align tax policy with climate goals without sacrificing distributional objectives.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103376.abstract_zh: 巴西近期的税制改革以统一增值税（VAT）取代多项间接税，对危害健康或环境的商品征收附加税率，豁免多种食品，并向低收入家庭提供现金返还转移。我们通过将详细家庭支出数据与涵盖所有排放源（包括土地利用变化）的产品及州级碳足迹估算相结合，评估了该改革的环境与分配效应。按设计，该改革预计将使基于消费的温室气体（GHG）排放增加1.7%（即人均49千克），主要原因是高排放食品获得免税。与此同时，低收入家庭通过食品价格下降和现金返还转移获得福利改善，这揭示了分配目标与环境目标之间的权衡。随后，我们评估了反事实情景，其中将附加税率扩展至碳密集型商品，并将收入通过定向转移和补贴进行循环利用。这些情景逆转了排放增长，并在福利损失相对有限的情况下实现减排，尤其是当收入用于补贴低碳食品消费时。我们的研究结果表明，针对性的环境税收与补偿性转移相结合，能够在不牺牲分配目标的前提下，更好地使税收政策与气候目标保持一致。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103376.title: Environmental implications of Brazil’s tax reform on household consumption
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103376.title_zh: 巴西税制改革对家庭消费的环境影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103377.abstract: Distance-based road pricing can internalize driving externalities and provide fiscally sustainable infrastructure financing as vehicle electrification erodes fuel tax revenues. Yet, political resistance may pose a barrier to implementation. We provide the first comprehensive analysis of preferences for universal road pricing using a stated choice experiment with nearly 4000 Norwegian respondents. Policy alternatives vary systematically across urban peak prices, off-peak prices, non-urban prices, electric vehicle prices, and revenue allocation. We document robust majority support (70% to 80%) for most universal road pricing schemes, substantially exceeding typical support for local congestion charges. Support varies by design: public transport earmarking outperforms general budget allocation by eight percentage points, while moderate pricing dominates high pricing by six points. Support varies substantially with car use, urban versus rural residence, availability of transport alternatives, and institutional trust, but shows little sensitivity to income, toll exposure, or the likelihood of benefiting financially from road pricing. Latent class analysis identifies unconditional supporters (57%), systematic opponents (22%), and a persuadable middle (21%). Randomized information treatments generate modest effects, with factual information increasing support by 6 percentage points. Political barriers to road pricing may be lower than assumed with low to moderate pricing and credible infrastructure earmarking.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103377.abstract_zh: 基于距离的公路收费能够将驾驶外部性内部化，并在车辆电动化侵蚀燃油税收入的情况下，为财政可持续的基础设施融资提供支持。然而，政治阻力可能成为实施中的障碍。我们利用一项包含近4000名挪威受访者的陈述性选择实验，首次对普遍公路收费的偏好进行了全面分析。政策备选方案在城区高峰价格、非高峰价格、非城区价格、电动汽车价格及收入分配方面系统性地有所不同。我们记录了大多数普遍公路收费方案获得了稳健的多数支持（70%至80%），显著高于地方拥堵费的典型支持水平。支持程度因设计而异：公共交通专项拨款比一般预算分配高出八个百分点，而适度定价比高定价高出六个百分点。支持程度随汽车使用情况、城市与农村居住地、交通替代方案的可得性以及制度信任程度而显著变化，但对收入、收费暴露程度或从公路收费中获益的可能性则不太敏感。潜在类别分析识别出无条件支持者（57%）、系统性反对者（22%）以及可被说服的中间群体（21%）。随机信息处理产生了适度效应，其中事实信息使支持率提高了六个百分点。在低至中等定价和可信的基础设施专项拨款条件下，公路收费面临的政治障碍可能低于预期。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103377.title: Public support for universal road pricing
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103377.title_zh: 全民道路收费的公众支持度

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103378.abstract: Although the environmental impact of trade has been a long-standing concern, there is still scant evidence on the channels through which international market access affects pollution. We exploit the unique episode of China’s world market integration in the early 2000s to provide direct empirical evidence on three such mechanisms, corresponding to each pollution scope: direct pollution at firms’ locations (scope-1), indirect pollution from energy generation (scope-2), and indirect pollution from the supply chain (scope-3). We combine granular satellite data on air pollution with detailed information on manufacturing firms and coal power plants, and leverage exogenous foreign demand shocks for identification. Three main findings emerge: exporting firms reduce local pollution; pollution levels around coal power plants rise due to regional export shocks; and upstream suppliers reduce pollution in the face of export demand shocks to downstream firms. Our findings point to China’s reliance on coal power plants to fuel its export-driven growth as one of the main drivers of the rise in pollution.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103378.abstract_zh: 尽管贸易对环境的影响一直是长期关注的焦点，但关于国际市场准入如何影响污染的渠道证据仍然匮乏。我们利用21世纪初中国融入世界市场的独特时期，为三种机制提供了直接的经验证据，这些机制分别对应不同的污染范围：企业所在地的直接污染（范围1）、能源生产的间接污染（范围2）以及供应链的间接污染（范围3）。我们将高分辨率的卫星空气污染数据与制造业企业和燃煤电厂的详细信息相结合，并利用外生外国需求冲击进行识别。主要发现有三点：出口企业减少了当地污染；区域出口冲击导致燃煤电厂周边污染水平上升；面对下游企业的出口需求冲击，上游供应商减少了污染。我们的研究结果表明，中国依赖燃煤电厂来支撑其出口导向型增长，是污染加剧的主要驱动因素之一。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103378.title: Trade and the scopes of pollution: Evidence from China’s world market integration
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103378.title_zh: 贸易与污染范围：来自中国融入世界市场的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103379.abstract: Land use alterations and climate change are shifting natural fire regimes, leading to prolonged and intensified fire seasons accompanied by widespread air pollution, with potentially important consequences for local wildlife. Combining data from the North American Breeding Bird Survey with high-resolution satellite imagery, we estimate the impact of wildfire-specific smoke pollution (PM2.5) on avian biodiversity in the contiguous United States (US) from 2008 to 2022. The panel fixed effects instrumental variable estimation results indicate a short-term adverse effect of PM2.5 on taxonomic and phylogenetic diversity metrics. More specifically, a standard deviation (sd) increase in wildfire-specific PM2.5 pollution reduces species richness, abundance, and phylogenetic diversity by about 0.1 sd. For the most polluted transects the effect is up to 2–3 standard deviations. The adverse impacts on biodiversity vary across ecosystems, with particularly pronounced effects in the North American Deserts and Eastern Temperate Forests. These findings underscore that fire management and conservation strategies should consider biodiversity impacts among the many factors guiding resource allocation, particularly as wildfire intensity and smoke exposure are projected to increase in many regions worldwide.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103379.abstract_zh: 土地利用变化与气候变化正在改变自然火情格局，导致火灾季节延长且强度加剧，伴随大范围空气污染，对当地野生动物可能产生重要影响。结合北美繁殖鸟类调查数据与高分辨率卫星影像，我们估算了2008年至2022年间美国本土野火特定烟雾污染（PM2.5）对鸟类生物多样性的影响。面板固定效应工具变量估计结果表明，PM2.5对分类学及系统发育多样性指标存在短期不利影响。具体而言，野火特定PM2.5污染每增加一个标准差（sd），物种丰富度、丰度及系统发育多样性约降低0.1个标准差。对于污染最严重的样带，其影响可达2至3个标准差。生物多样性的不利影响因生态系统而异，在北美沙漠和东部温带森林中尤为显著。这些发现强调，火灾管理与保护策略在指导资源分配的众多因素中应考虑生物多样性影响，尤其是在全球许多地区野火强度及烟雾暴露预计将增加的背景下。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103379.title: The impact of wildfire smoke on local avian biodiversity
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103379.title_zh: 野火烟雾对当地鸟类生物多样性的影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103380.abstract: Agricultural production is a major contributor to water pollution in China and increasingly subject to regulation. However, the effectiveness of such regulation—particularly for non-point source pollution—remains underexplored. This paper estimates the causal effects of environmental enforcement on agricultural outcomes using a spatial regression discontinuity design based on China's surface water quality monitoring network. Monitoring stations only register pollution from upstream sources, creating sharp spatial variation in regulatory pressure. After water quality performance was linked to political promotions in 2003, upstream counties experienced a significant decline in agricultural value added—about 58% lower than downstream neighbors. No such gap existed before the reform. The effect is robust to placebo tests, bandwidth changes, a difference-in-discontinuities design, and an instrumental variables strategy using hydrological station placement. To explore the channels through which regulation affects agricultural outcomes, we combine administrative data, household survey microdata, remote sensing, and emissions inventories. We find that upstream counties hired fewer agricultural workers, cultivated less land, and applied less fertilizer. Rural households in upstream counties are also more likely to migrate across counties, consistent with declining local agricultural viability. Remote sensing data confirm broad reductions in crop planting areas. N2O emission inventory data show accompanying reductions in N2O from both agricultural soils and manure. These results show that China water quality regulation can alter input use, land allocation, and emissions in agriculture. However, enforcement may also displace rural labor and reshape household decisions, highlighting important trade-offs in implementing environmental policy in developing country contexts.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103380.abstract_zh: 农业生产是中国水污染的主要来源之一，并日益受到法规的约束。然而，此类法规的有效性——尤其是针对非点源污染的法规——仍未得到充分探讨。本文利用基于中国地表水质监测网络的空间断点回归设计，估计了环境执法对农业产出的因果效应。监测站仅记录上游来源的污染，从而在监管压力上形成了显著的空间差异。自2003年水质绩效与官员政治晋升挂钩后，上游县农业增加值显著下降，比下游邻县低约58%。而改革前并无此差距。该效应在安慰剂检验、带宽调整、断点差异设计以及利用水文站点布局作为工具变量的策略中均保持稳健。为探究法规影响农业产出的渠道，我们结合了行政数据、住户调查微观数据、遥感影像及排放清单。研究发现，上游县雇佣的农业劳动力减少，耕地面积缩减，化肥施用量下降。上游县农村家庭也更倾向于跨县迁移，这与当地农业生存能力下降相符。遥感数据证实了作物种植面积的大幅减少。N2O排放清单数据显示，农业土壤和粪便中的N2O排放相应减少。这些结果表明，中国的水质法规能够改变农业中的投入品使用、土地配置及排放。然而，执法也可能导致农村劳动力转移并重塑家庭决策，凸显了在发展中国家实施环境政策时需权衡的重要取舍。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103380.title: Impact of water quality regulation on the agricultural economy in China
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103380.title_zh: 水质监管对中国农业经济的影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103381.abstract: Afforestation, which involves converting cropland to forestland, can provide multiple ecosystem services. Consequently, public incentive programs such as those administered by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), and, increasingly, private incentive programs, provide funding to farmers to convert their land to forest. However, the degree to which afforestation incentives provide greater ecosystem services depends on the degree to which afforestation is additional, both in the short- and long-term. Incentives are additional if they lead to forest growth that would not have occurred without payments. In this study, we assess the additionality of incentives for afforestation of cropland in USDA's Conservation Reserve Program over a two-decade time span. We estimate impacts using a regression discontinuity design that leverages the Conservation Reserve Program's General Signup auction mechanism. We use remote-sensing data to compare the extent of trees on land that had rejected and accepted offers to enroll in the program. We find that 32 to 65 percent of land enrolled is additional; and that impacts of incentives on tree cover remain steady from nine to twenty years after initial offers are made.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103381.abstract_zh: 造林，即将农田转变为林地，能够提供多种生态系统服务。因此，公共激励计划，如美国农业部（USDA）管理的项目，以及日益增多的私人激励计划，向农民提供资金以将其土地转为林地。然而，造林激励措施所能带来的生态系统服务增量，取决于造林在短期和长期内的额外性程度。如果激励措施促进了在没有补贴情况下不会发生的森林增长，则这些激励具有额外性。在本研究中，我们评估了美国农业部保护储备计划中农田造林激励措施在二十年时间跨度内的额外性。我们利用回归不连续设计，借助保护储备计划的一般签约拍卖机制来估计影响。我们使用遥感数据，比较了被拒绝和接受加入该计划提议的土地上的树木覆盖程度。我们发现，32%至65%的已注册土地具有额外性；且激励措施对树木覆盖的影响在初始提议提出后的九至二十年间保持稳定。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103381.title: Additionality of Afforestation Incentives: Evidence from the Conservation Reserve Program
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103381.title_zh: 造林激励的额外性：来自保护储备计划的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103382.abstract: We analyze the distributional effects of climate policy by examining heterogeneity in households’ carbon intensity of consumption. We construct a novel dataset that includes information on the carbon intensity of 1.7 million individual households from 88 countries. First, we show that horizontal differences are generally larger than vertical differences. Then, we use supervised machine learning to analyze the non-linear contribution of household characteristics to the prediction of carbon intensity of consumption. Household income, proxied by total household expenditures, is usually an insufficient predictor for the additional costs of climate policy. Including household-level information beyond household income increases the accuracy of prediction. We identify ten clusters of countries that differ in the distribution of climate policy costs and their predictors. Our results highlight that, depending on the context, some compensation policies may be more effective in reducing overall heterogeneity than others.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103382.abstract_zh: 我们通过考察家庭消费碳强度的异质性，分析了气候政策的分配效应。我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，包含来自88个国家170万个家庭消费碳强度的信息。首先，我们表明水平差异通常大于垂直差异。随后，我们运用监督式机器学习分析家庭特征对消费碳强度预测的非线性贡献。以家庭总支出作为收入代理指标，通常不足以预测气候政策的额外成本。在家庭收入之外纳入家庭层面的信息，能提高预测的准确性。我们识别出十个国家集群，它们在气候政策成本的分布及其预测因素上存在差异。我们的结果强调，根据具体情境，某些补偿政策在减少整体异质性方面可能比其他政策更为有效。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103382.title: The heterogeneous effects of climate policy on households: Evidence from 88 countries
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103382.title_zh: 气候政策对家庭异质性影响的证据：来自88个国家的分析

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103383.abstract: Aligning electric vehicle (EV) charging with periods of abundant clean energy is essential for decarbonizing transportation. In solar-dominated grids, this requires shifting charging to midday hours – when vehicles are typically parked at workplaces. Yet workplace charging networks operate under institutional constraints such as shared infrastructure, bundled parking and charging services, and limited willingness to require drivers to move vehicles, making time-of-day pricing and active management difficult to implement. In a natural field experiment (n = 629 drivers) across a large workplace charging network, we randomize time-invariant price discounts and environmental nudges that emphasize the environmental benefits of daytime charging. Price discounts modestly increase workplace charging but shift charging toward off-solar periods when charger occupancy is lower, while environmental nudges re-time charging toward solar hours without increasing total demand. A follow-up experiment shows that these timing responses are driven by perceived charger scarcity and congestion under price discounts. Finally, we quantify the abatement costs per ton of of these shifts.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103383.abstract_zh: 将电动汽车（EV）充电与丰富的清洁能源时段对齐，对于交通脱碳至关重要。在以太阳能为主的电网中，这要求将充电转移至正午时段——此时车辆通常停放在工作场所。然而，工作场所充电网络受制于制度性约束，如共享基础设施、停车与充电服务捆绑，以及要求驾驶员移动车辆的意愿有限，这使得分时定价和主动管理难以实施。在一项覆盖大型工作场所充电网络的自然实地实验中（n = 629名驾驶员），我们随机分配了时间不变的折扣价格和强调日间充电环境效益的环境助推信息。价格折扣适度增加了工作场所充电量，但将充电转移至充电器占用率较低的太阳能低谷时段，而环境助推信息则将充电重新安排至太阳能高峰时段，且未增加总需求。后续实验表明，这些时间响应是由价格折扣下感知到的充电器稀缺性和拥堵所驱动的。最后，我们量化了这些转移每吨的减排成本。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103383.title: Electric vehicle charging at the workplace: Experimental evidence on incentives and environmental nudges
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103383.title_zh: 工作场所电动汽车充电：激励与环境助推的实验证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103384.abstract: In the UK, aggregate emissions intensity has declined by about a factor of two over the last three decades. Prior research attributes most of this decline to reductions within industries rather than shifts in the composition of economic activity. This paper investigates whether such within-industry progress primarily reflects industry-specific factors or common forces operating across industries. Using a newly constructed panel of UK industry-level GHG emissions and gross value added for 1990–2022, we estimate a block-level dynamic factor model that decomposes changes in emissions intensity into global, block-level, and idiosyncratic components. We find that industry-specific factors account for the majority of variation in emissions intensity changes, though common shocks, either global or at the level of groups of industries, play a smaller but non-negligible role. We further show how patterns of co-movement partly reflect the way that emissions are recorded at the activity level and allocated to industries, a feature with implications for interpreting industry-level decarbonization dynamics.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103384.abstract_zh: 在英国，过去三十年间，总体排放强度大约下降了一半。先前的研究将这一下降主要归因于行业内部的减排，而非经济活动构成的转变。本文旨在探究这种行业内部的进步究竟主要反映了行业特有的因素，还是跨行业运作的共同力量。利用我们新构建的1990年至2022年英国行业级温室气体排放及总增加值面板数据，我们估计了一个区块级动态因子模型，将排放强度的变化分解为全球性、区块级及特质性成分。研究发现，行业特有因素解释了排放强度变化中的大部分变异，尽管全球性或行业群体层面的共同冲击作用较小，但也不容忽视。我们进一步展示了共同变动模式如何部分反映排放按活动层面记录并分配到行业的方式，这一特征对解读行业级脱碳动态具有重要意义。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103384.title: Do common shocks drive changes in aggregate emissions intensity?
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103384.title_zh: 共同冲击是否推动了总排放强度的变化？

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103385.abstract: Institutions are crucial for allocating natural resources. Surface water allocation in the western U.S. follows the prior appropriation doctrine, which distributes water based on the date when water was first appropriated for beneficial use. During scarcity, water is allocated by seniority, with holders of more junior rights losing access first. Curtailments of water access influence the profitability of irrigated production, especially in the arid West where most croplands depend on irrigation. The Ricardian theory of rent suggests a premium for senior water rights, as the net present value of long-term returns is higher due to more secure access. We estimate this premium using a hedonic pricing model and agricultural land transactions as proxies for water-rights values. Our dataset links roughly 25,000 sales across 37 Colorado counties with geocoded information on associated water rights. Results show that surface-water access increases land values by about $6,300 per acre, or 64 % relative to similar non-irrigated parcels. Furthermore, we estimate the premium for properties that are one year more senior in water rights to be about $49 per acre. Our results also indicate that properties with access to storage and supplementary groundwater rights sell, on average, for 16% and 14% more, respectively, compared to irrigated properties with only surface water access. These findings highlight the importance of water security in shaping agricultural land markets and offer insights into how policy measures, such as expanding water markets or investing in storage reservoirs, can potentially improve allocation and reduce vulnerability of irrigated agriculture.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103385.abstract_zh: 制度在自然资源分配中至关重要。美国西部的地表水分配遵循先占原则，即根据水首次被用于有益用途的日期来分配水资源。在缺水时期，水按资历分配，持有较新水权者首先失去使用权。水的获取限制影响着灌溉生产的盈利能力，尤其是在干旱的西部，大多数农田依赖灌溉。李嘉图地租理论表明，由于更稳定的获取权，长期收益的净现值更高，因此资深水权存在溢价。我们利用特征价格模型和农业土地交易作为水权价值的代理，来估算这一溢价。我们的数据集将科罗拉多州37个县约25,000笔销售与相关水权的地理编码信息相连接。结果显示，地表水的获取使土地价值每英亩增加约6,300美元，相对于类似的非灌溉地块高出64%。此外，我们估算，水权资历每多一年的物业溢价约为每英亩49美元。我们的结果还表明，拥有蓄水设施和补充地下水权的物业，其售价平均分别比仅拥有地表水权的灌溉物业高出16%和14%。这些发现凸显了水安全在塑造农业土地市场中的重要性，并为政策制定提供了见解，如扩大水市场或投资于蓄水水库，这些措施有望改善水资源分配并降低灌溉农业的脆弱性。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103385.title: The value of water access security in agriculture
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103385.title_zh: 农业用水安全保障的价值

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103386.abstract: Wind power expansion is a central environmental policy objective, yet it may entail aesthetic disamenities for nearby residents. Turbine visibility often transcends administrative borders, whereas political and economic processes remain more localized. We exploit this spatial asymmetry to identify the impact of cross-jurisdictional visual exposure on support for climate mitigation policies, proxied by pro-renewable voting in Germany between 1998 and 2021. We find no electoral backlash in earlier periods, but significant declines in support in more recent elections. These dynamics are consistent with shifts in debates over wind energy expansion and the growing salience of landscape concerns, with stronger effects in rural areas and in places with organized resistance, while localized economic benefits may partly offset adverse attitudes.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103386.abstract_zh: 风电扩张是一项核心的环境政策目标，然而它可能对邻近居民造成美学上的不便。风机可见性往往超越行政边界，而政治和经济过程则更为地方化。我们利用这种空间不对称性，来识别跨辖区视觉暴露对气候减缓政策支持度的影响，以1998年至2021年间德国支持可再生能源的投票作为代理指标。我们发现早期阶段并未出现选举反弹，但在近期的选举中支持度显著下降。这些动态与关于风电扩张辩论的转变及景观关注日益凸显的趋势相吻合，且在乡村地区及存在有组织抵抗的地方影响更为强烈，而地方经济利益可能部分抵消不利态度。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103386.title: Headwind in sight? Wind turbine visibility spillovers and support for renewable energy policy
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103386.title_zh: 眼前逆风？风力涡轮机可见性溢出效应对可再生能源政策支持的影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103387.abstract: Food production and consumption account for a third of global greenhouse gas emissions (Crippa et al., 2021) and, therefore, offer a large mitigation potential. Policies such as carbon taxation and carbon labelling can contribute to correcting such externalities by encouraging consumers to substitute away from carbon intensive food products. We employ data from a survey-based, randomized experiment simulating an online supermarket, administered to a representative sample of the UK population. Using a structural demand system based on the Exact Affine Stone Index model with censoring, we estimate the greenhouse gas emission reductions and welfare effects associated with a range of demand-side policy scenarios, combining carbon labelling and carbon taxation. Our results show that the application of carbon labels leads to a 5.60% decrease in the carbon content of the average food basket. A £60 tax per tonne of CO 2 e on the most carbon intensive products would yield a 9.89% reduction in the carbon footprint, while also decreasing consumer welfare by £78.71 per person per year. Respectively, these policies would yield a decrease in emissions corresponding to about 2.7% and 4.7% of the GHG emissions of the UK. Combining carbon taxation and carbon labelling allows to reach the same CO 2 e emissions reduction as the carbon tax, with only a £27.86 tax rate per tonne of CO 2 e, thereby reducing welfare losses to £33.52 per person per year. These findings imply that carbon taxation and carbon labelling can be complementary policies to abate greenhouse gas emissions, while limiting the negative impacts on welfare.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103387.abstract_zh: 食品生产与消费占全球温室气体排放的三分之一（Crippa等，2021），因此具有巨大的减排潜力。碳税和碳标签等政策可通过鼓励消费者减少对碳密集型食品的替代，有助于纠正此类外部性。我们利用一项基于调查的随机实验数据，模拟在线超市，并对英国人口代表性样本进行调查。基于精确仿射斯通指数模型并考虑审查机制的结构性需求系统，我们估算了结合碳标签与碳税的一系列需求侧政策情景下的温室气体减排量及福利效应。结果显示，应用碳标签可使平均食品篮的碳含量降低5.60%。对碳密集型产品征收每吨二氧化碳当量60英镑的税收，将使碳足迹减少9.89%，同时消费者福利每年每人下降78.71英镑。相应地，这些政策将分别使排放量减少约英国温室气体排放的2.7%和4.7%。将碳税与碳标签相结合，可在仅征收每吨二氧化碳当量27.86英镑税率的情况下实现与单独碳税相同的二氧化碳当量减排效果，从而将福利损失降至每年每人33.52英镑。这些发现表明，碳税与碳标签可作为互补政策，在减少温室气体排放的同时，限制对福利的负面影响。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103387.title: The welfare impacts of carbon taxes and labels on food demand
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103387.title_zh: 碳税与食品标签对食品需求福利影响的评估

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103388.abstract: The increasing use of monitoring technologies raises important questions about their impact on regulatory strategies and enforcement outcomes. This paper studies the adoption of the Continuous Emission Monitoring System (CEMS), a real-time pollution tracking technology in China. Using firm-level data, we find that CEMS adoption reduces corporate sulfur dioxide (SO2) and nitrogen oxides (NOx) emissions by 16.8% and 15.8%, respectively. Mechanism analyses indicate that CEMS-generated exceedance signals increase the observability of violations and success rate of inspections. We find no evidence that CEMS adoption crowds out enforcement or increases emissions among nearby non-CEMS firms. These findings suggest that monitoring technologies can enhance regulatory precision, which is important for the extension of new monitoring technologies.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103388.abstract_zh: 监测技术的日益普及引发了关于其对监管策略和执法效果影响的重要问题。本文研究了中国实时污染追踪技术——连续排放监测系统（CEMS）的采用情况。利用企业层面数据，我们发现CEMS的采用使企业二氧化硫（SO2）和氮氧化物（NOx）排放分别减少了16.8%和15.8%。机制分析表明，CEMS生成的超标信号提高了违规行为的可观测性和检查成功率。我们未发现CEMS采用会挤出执法或增加邻近非CEMS企业排放的证据。这些发现表明，监测技术能够增强监管精准性，这对于新监测技术的推广具有重要意义。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103388.title: Technology, Enforcement Resources Allocation, and Environmental Performance
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103388.title_zh: 技术、执法资源配置与环境绩效

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103389.abstract: Policymakers frequently implement environmental policies that are less ambitious than what voters would prefer.
