We document this gap using findings from previous research as well as evidence from climate policy in Austria's transport sector. To account for this pattern, we develop a model in which political parties compete with electoral platforms that involve multiple policy dimensions. When voters place greater weight on a primary issue -such as fiscal policy - than on environmental policy, we show that parties may refrain from proposing environmental reforms, even when these reforms enjoy broad public support. This dynamic arises once the primary issue becomes sufficiently salient to voters. We then examine potential ways to overcome this policy inertia, including the use of direct democratic instruments (e.g., referendums) and the delegation of environmental policy decisions from national to regional governments.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103389.abstract_zh: 政策制定者经常实施的环境政策力度低于选民期望的水平。我们利用既有研究成果以及奥地利交通部门气候政策的实证证据，揭示了这一差距。为解释这一现象，我们构建了一个模型，其中政党在涉及多个政策维度的选举纲领中展开竞争。当选民对财政政策等首要议题的重视程度超过环境政策时，研究表明即使环境改革获得广泛公众支持，政党也可能放弃提出相关改革方案。这种动态机制在首要议题对选民具有足够显著重要性时便会显现。随后我们探讨了克服这种政策惯性的潜在路径，包括运用直接民主工具（如公投）以及将环境政策决策权从国家政府下放至地区政府。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103389.title: Voter preferences, party politics and environmental policy reform
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103389.title_zh: 选民偏好、政党政治与环境政策改革

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103390.abstract: This paper examines the implications of different forms of corruption, i.e., grand corruption, petty corruption, and cut-money culture, on the formulation and enforcement of regulatory policies. Focusing on quota regulation in the context of natural resource extraction, it demonstrates the following. In the absence of cut-money culture, petty corruption never occurs in equilibrium, irrespective of whether the policymaker is honest or corrupt. However, when the policymaker is corrupt, the threat of petty corruption leaves no room for grand corruption unless net environmental damage due to extraction is sufficiently discounted, in which case grand corruption occurs. In contrast, the presence of cut-money culture induces corruption, either petty or both grand and petty, in equilibrium. Cut-money culture may reduce the equilibrium quota from the ‘no petty corruption enforcing quota’; however, whenever this occurs, total extraction and environmental damage rise, and welfare declines. Our results have important implications for designing corruption control mechanisms and governing natural resource extraction.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103390.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了不同形式的腐败——即重大腐败、轻微腐败及“截留资金”文化——对监管政策制定与执行的影响。聚焦于自然资源开采背景下的配额监管，本文论证如下：在缺乏“截留资金”文化的情况下，无论政策制定者是否廉洁，均衡状态下均不会出现轻微腐败。然而，当政策制定者腐败时，除非开采造成的净环境损害被充分折现，否则轻微腐败的威胁使得重大腐败无隙可乘；在此折现条件下，重大腐败则会发生。相反，“截留资金”文化的存在会在均衡中诱发腐败，无论是轻微腐败还是重大与轻微腐败并存。这种文化可能将均衡配额降至“无轻微腐败执行配额”之下；然而，每当这种情况发生时，总开采量与环境损害上升，社会福利下降。我们的研究结果对设计反腐败控制机制及管理自然资源开采具有重要意义。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103390.title: Quota regulation under corruption – Grand, petty and the cut-money culture
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103390.title_zh: 腐败下的配额管制——大额、小额腐败与“抽成”文化

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103391.abstract: Residential land prices are highly sensitive to new information, particularly when pollution disclosures highlight potential health risks. Following the 2020 disclosure of nationwide government survey results, extensive contamination from per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, or PFAS, commonly known as “forever chemicals,” was revealed, leading to intensified media coverage and heightened public awareness. This study applies a staggered difference-in-differences approach to quantify the impact of PFAS pollution disclosures on Japanese residential land prices. Using property-level panel data from the Land Market Value Publication, we compare treated properties to control properties within varying distance radii. In the 5 km radius analysis, statistically significant average post-treatment declines range from approximately 1.3% when Tokyo is excluded to 2.4% when Osaka and Okinawa, which had received PFAS-related disclosures earlier, are also excluded. Across the distance-buffer specifications, dynamic event-study effects reach approximately 4.4–6.4% by the fourth year after disclosure. Notably, significant price declines emerged only after media coverage intensified around 2023, highlighting the critical role of information salience in translating environmental disclosures into market responses. A heterogeneity analysis suggests that high-value properties tend to exhibit larger and earlier price responses, consistent with buyers in higher-value market segments being more sensitive to environmental risk information. These findings indicate that pollution disclosures can reduce residential asset values, underscoring the economic costs of environmental information disclosure and the need for complementary policy measures to mitigate capitalized losses borne by affected property owners.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103391.abstract_zh: 住宅用地价格对新信息高度敏感，尤其是当污染披露揭示潜在健康风险时。2020年全国政府调查结果公布后，全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS，俗称“永久化学品”）的广泛污染被曝光，导致媒体报道加剧和公众意识提升。本研究采用交错双重差分法，量化PFAS污染披露对日本住宅用地价格的影响。利用《地价公示》中的物业层面面板数据，我们在不同距离半径内将受处理物业与对照物业进行比较。在5公里半径分析中，统计上显著的平均处理后降幅约为1.3%（排除东京时）至2.4%（进一步排除此前已收到PFAS相关披露的大阪和冲绳时）。在不同距离缓冲区的设定下，动态事件研究效应在披露后第四年达到约4.4%至6.4%。值得注意的是，显著的价格下降仅在2023年左右媒体报道加剧后才出现，凸显了信息显著性在将环境披露转化为市场反应中的关键作用。异质性分析表明，高价值物业往往表现出更大且更早的价格反应，这与高价值市场细分中的买家对环境风险信息更为敏感一致。这些发现表明，污染披露可能降低住宅资产价值，凸显了环境信息披露的经济成本，以及需要采取补充政策措施来减轻受影响物业所有者承担的资本化损失。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103391.title: PFAS contamination disclosures and declining residential land prices in polluted areas of Japan
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103391.title_zh: PFAS污染披露与日本污染地区住宅用地价格下跌

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103392.abstract: We study the interplay between individuals’ voluntary contributions to environmental protection and public environmental policy in a dynamic general-equilibrium model. To capture the observed discrepancy between the willingness of individuals to contribute privately versus publicly to environmental protection, we treat the quality of the environment as a public good and assume that voluntary contributions are motivated by a ‘warm glow’ of giving. We show that in the laissez-faire scenario without government intervention, the strength of warm glow negatively affects aggregate output and positively affects environmental quality in the long run. However, when the government intervenes and decides on environmental policy in the interests of individuals, the warm-glow strength has a negative long-run effect on both variables. Thus, our results suggest that advocating for private actions to ensure a better environment in the future may be counterproductive in the presence of public environmental policies.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103392.abstract_zh: 本文在一个动态一般均衡模型中研究个体对环境保护的自愿贡献与公共环境政策之间的相互作用。为捕捉个体在私下与公开场合对环境保护贡献意愿的差异，我们将环境质量视为公共品，并假设自愿贡献源于“温暖光辉”的利他动机。研究表明：在无政府干预的自由放任情景下，长期中温暖光辉强度会抑制总产出但提升环境质量；然而当政府以个体利益为出发点制定环境政策时，温暖光辉强度对这两个变量均产生长期负面影响。因此，我们的结论表明，在存在公共环境政策的情况下，倡导通过私人行动确保未来环境改善可能适得其反。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103392.title: Protecting the environment: On the interplay between voluntary contributions and public policy
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103392.title_zh: 保护环境：论自愿贡献与公共政策的相互作用

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103393.abstract: This paper provides novel firm-level estimates of the economic damages caused by temperature shocks to European firms. I rely on a panel data analysis to show wide heterogeneities in the impact of temperature shocks, which depend on firm characteristics. This paper reveals the importance of micro-level data for quantifying climate damages estimates, as the average relationship between temperature and economic outcomes masks firms’ different susceptibilities to weather shocks. These create both winners and losers, harming less productive firms, particularly those in warmer regions, while benefiting more productive ones. Compared with the pooled marginal effect, the least-productive firms experience negative effects roughly ten times as large, while the most-productive firms experience positive effects roughly three times as large. I highlight the distributional effects of climate change, and offer insights for adaptation policies.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103393.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于温度冲击对欧洲企业造成经济损失的新型企业层面估计。我采用面板数据分析，揭示了温度冲击影响的广泛异质性，这种异质性取决于企业特征。本文揭示了微观数据在量化气候损害估计中的重要性，因为温度与经济结果之间的平均关系掩盖了企业对天气冲击的不同敏感性。这既创造了赢家也创造了输家，损害了生产率较低的企业（尤其是位于较暖地区的企业），同时使生产率较高的企业受益。与合并边际效应相比，生产率最低的企业受到的负面效应大约是其十倍，而生产率最高的企业获得的正面效应大约是其三倍。我强调了气候变化的分配效应，并为适应政策提供了见解。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103393.title: Heterogeneous effects of weather shocks on firm economic performance
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103393.title_zh: 天气冲击对企业经济绩效的异质性影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103394.title: Corrigendum to “Power plays in the jungle: Political alignment and environmental degradation in Colombia” [J. Environ. Econ. Manag. 138 (2026) 103335]
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103394.title_zh: 更正：“丛林中的权力游戏：哥伦比亚的政治联盟与环境退化” [J. Environ. Econ. Manag. 138 (2026) 103335]

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103395.title: Corrigendum to “A helping hand for the regulator: The role of industry associations in firm water pollution abatement in China” [J. Environ. Econ. Manag. 137 (2026) 103306]
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103395.title_zh: 对《监管者的帮手：行业协会在中国企业水污染治理中的作用》的更正 [J. Environ. Econ. Manag. 137 (2026) 103306]

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103396.title: Do economic principles explain orbital use in space?
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103396.title_zh: 经济原理能否解释太空轨道利用？

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103397.abstract: Whereas hydrogen is currently a marginal energy carrier, the aim of the EU is to trigger low-carbon hydrogen production that covers around 10 percent of EU’s energy needs by 2050. If this comes true, it will be an energy revolution. We study competition between green and blue hydrogen using an extended Salop model that encompasses the value chains for hydrogen and CCS. For blue hydrogen, we distinguish between exports of blue hydrogen—natural gas is converted into hydrogen close to the extraction site of natural gas and hydrogen is then transported over a long distance to the hydrogen consumers—and local production of blue hydrogen—natural gas is exported over a long distance and then converted into hydrogen near the hydrogen consumers. We find that mark-ups are highest in the case of exports of blue hydrogen production, which implies that total production of hydrogen, supply of blue hydrogen, and share of plants investing in carbon capture facilities are lower in the case of exports of blue hydrogen than in the case of local production of blue hydrogen. We provide numerical simulations of the alternative market outcomes and the corresponding first-best outcomes and identify policy instruments that should be used to sustain the first-best social outcomes in the cases of exports of blue hydrogen and local production of blue hydrogen.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103397.abstract_zh: 尽管氢能目前仍是一种边缘能源载体，欧盟的目标是到2050年推动低碳氢能生产，使其覆盖欧盟约10%的能源需求。若这一目标实现，将引发一场能源革命。我们通过扩展萨洛普模型（Salop model）研究绿色氢能与蓝色氢能之间的竞争，该模型涵盖了氢能与碳捕集与封存（CCS）的价值链。针对蓝色氢能，我们区分了两种模式：蓝色氢能出口（在天然气开采地附近将天然气转化为氢能，再通过长距离运输至氢能消费端）与蓝色氢能本地生产（将天然气长距离出口至氢能消费端附近，再转化为氢能）。研究发现，蓝色氢能出口模式下的加价幅度最高，这意味着相较于蓝色氢能本地生产模式，出口模式下的氢能总产量、蓝色氢能供应量以及投资碳捕集设施的工厂占比均更低。我们通过数值模拟对比了不同市场结果与对应的最优社会结果，并识别出在蓝色氢能出口与本地生产两种模式下，用于维持最优社会结果的政策工具。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103397.title: Competition between green and blue hydrogen and indirect network effects1
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103397.title_zh: 绿色氢能与蓝色氢能的竞争及间接网络效应

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103398.abstract: There are tipping points in the climate system that could lock the world into a higher-temperature regime. Many tipping points are characterised by Knightian uncertainty, that is, it is difficult to assign prior probabilities to their occurrence. This paper quantifies the economic cost of this uncertainty using a min-max regret robust policy in an integrated assessment model with temperature feedback effects. By not imposing prior probabilities over critical thresholds, the framework provides policy guidance when threshold forecasting and learning are limited. I compute the implied social cost of carbon under the robust policy and compare it to the complete information benchmark. The uncertainty premium is modest at the start of the transition, between 1% and 2.2% in 2020, but rises to approximately 20% by the end of the century as robust and complete information policy paths diverge. These results imply that tipping-point ambiguity is not a first-order driver of carbon pricing in the short run, but becomes significant over policy-relevant horizons, strengthening the case for precautionary abatement.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103398.abstract_zh: 气候系统中存在临界点，一旦越过，可能将世界锁定在更高温度的状态。许多临界点具有奈特不确定性特征，即难以为其发生赋予先验概率。本文通过一个包含温度反馈效应的综合评估模型，采用最小最大遗憾稳健政策来量化这种不确定性的经济成本。通过不对临界阈值施加先验概率，该框架在阈值预测和学习受限时提供了政策指导。我计算了稳健政策下隐含的碳社会成本，并将其与完全信息基准进行比较。不确定性溢价在转型初期较为温和，2020年为1%至2.2%，但到本世纪末，随着稳健政策路径与完全信息政策路径的分化，该溢价上升至约20%。这些结果表明，临界点模糊性在短期内并非碳定价的一阶驱动因素，但在政策相关的时间范围内变得显著，从而强化了预防性减排的理由。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103398.title: The uncertainty premium of climate tipping points
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103398.title_zh: 气候临界点的不确定性溢价

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103399.abstract: Over the past three decades, the number of U.S. landfills has fallen by 41%, while average capacity has risen by 130%. This paper studies the distributional consequences of this consolidation. We show these changes coincide with waste disposal shifting toward locations with lower population density and higher shares of low-income, Black, and Hispanic residents. Event studies of landfill openings rule out large effects on migration, though new landfills are sited in places with fast-changing demographics. Using a novel measure of regulation built from large-language-model classifications of state statutes, we show evidence that increased state regulations may contribute to increasing disparities.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103399.abstract_zh: 过去三十年间，美国垃圾填埋场数量减少了41%，而平均容量却增加了130%。本文研究了这一整合过程带来的分配性后果。我们表明，这些变化与废物处理向人口密度较低、低收入、黑人和西班牙裔居民比例较高的地区转移的趋势相吻合。对垃圾填埋场开放的事件研究排除了其对迁移产生重大影响的可能性，尽管新填埋场选址于人口结构快速变化的地区。利用基于大型语言模型对州法规分类构建的新型监管度量，我们提供的证据表明，州级监管的加强可能加剧了这些不平等现象。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103399.title: The environmental justice implications of industry consolidation: Evidence from U.S. landfills
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103399.title_zh: 产业整合的环境正义影响：来自美国垃圾填埋场的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103400.abstract: We analyze the potential for electricity storage to substitute for transmission capacity. We develop a spatial-dynamic model of the grid where a utility manager dispatches generators and batteries to serve load at the lowest possible cost. The addition of storage requires the manager to optimize charging and discharging across the day, making the problem dynamic. We identify general conditions under which transmission and storage can serve as substitutes. When transmission is constrained and the battery is being charged or discharged, storage and transmission are substitutes at that instant. The investment-relevant capacity value depends on the aggregation of these instantaneous scarcity values across all hours of the day: storage substitutes for transmission investment when additional storage capacity reduces the time-averaged shadow value of the transmission constraint. This suggests storage can serve as transmission in markets where transmission is frequently constrained and the battery rarely sits idle. We calibrate our model to the electric grid in Texas and show that transmission and storage are substitutes even when wind generation is curtailed. The ability to substitute storage for transmission enables utilities to forgo costly and contentious grid expansion projects.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103400.abstract_zh: 我们分析了电力存储替代输电能力的潜力。我们构建了一个电网的空间动态模型，其中公用事业管理者以最低成本调度发电机和电池以满足负荷。存储的加入要求管理者优化一天内的充放电操作，使问题具有动态性。我们识别了输电与存储能够作为替代品的一般条件。当输电受限且电池正在充电或放电时，存储与输电在该瞬间可视为替代品。与投资相关的容量价值取决于这些瞬时稀缺价值在一天内所有小时的聚合：当额外存储容量降低输电约束的时间平均影子价值时，存储替代输电投资。这表明，在输电频繁受限且电池很少闲置的市场中，存储可以充当输电的作用。我们将模型校准至德克萨斯州的电网，并显示即使风力发电被削减，输电与存储仍是替代品。存储替代输电的能力使公用事业能够避免昂贵且争议不断的电网扩建项目。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103400.title: Substituting Storage for Transmission: Implications for Renewable Energy
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103400.title_zh: 以储能替代输电：对可再生能源的影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103401.abstract: This paper studies whether behavioral interventions designed to promote resource conservation in one domain generate spillovers in another. Using a natural field experiment involving over 2,000 residents, we identify the direct and spillover effects of real-time feedback and social comparisons on water and energy consumption. We implement three interventions: two targeting shower use and one targeting air-conditioning use. We find significant reductions in shower use from both water-saving interventions, but no direct effect of the energy-saving intervention on air-conditioning use. For spillovers, we estimate precise null effects of water-saving interventions on air-conditioning use, and of the energy-saving intervention on shower use.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103401.abstract_zh: 本文研究旨在促进某一领域资源节约的行为干预措施是否会在另一领域产生溢出效应。通过一项涉及2000多名居民的自然实地实验，我们识别了实时反馈与社会比较对水和能源消耗的直接效应及溢出效应。我们实施了三种干预措施：两种针对淋浴用水，一种针对空调用电。研究发现，两种节水干预措施均显著减少了淋浴用水，但节能干预措施对空调用电无直接效应。在溢出效应方面，我们估计出节水干预措施对空调用电以及节能干预措施对淋浴用水的精确零效应。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103401.title: Testing for spillovers in resource conservation: Evidence from a natural field experiment
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103401.title_zh: 资源保护中的溢出效应检验：来自自然田野实验的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103409.abstract: Weather extremes shape short-run economic activity through both market and nonmarket channels, yet evidence on local consumer-side activity remains limited. Using a municipality-level panel of Portuguese data (2010–2021), we estimate panel VAR and local-projection responses to weather shocks of point-of-sale purchases (a measure of merchant-location transaction activity, not resident household consumption), together with unemployment and house prices. Our central methodological finding is that hourly rather than daily measurement of rainfall variability raises the estimated semi-elasticities by an order of magnitude, suggesting that the existing climate-economy literature systematically understates the importance of high-intensity rainfall. Substantively, the local-projection responses indicate that hourly rainfall volatility raises purchases on impact and reverses the following quarter, consistent with intertemporal reallocation; temperature variability generates a sharp positive impact effect followed by a contraction; and high fire-danger days raise contemporaneous purchases. Unemployment and house prices follow the same patterns more weakly. Regional heterogeneity is substantial, the Lisbon Metropolitan Area and the Algarve sometimes display effects opposite in sign to those in the North.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103409.abstract_zh: 极端天气通过市场与非市场渠道影响短期经济活动，但关于本地消费者侧活动的证据仍然有限。基于葡萄牙市级面板数据（2010-2021年），我们采用面板VAR和局部投影法估计了天气冲击对销售点购买行为（衡量商户所在地交易活动，而非居民家庭消费）、失业率和房价的影响。核心方法论发现是：以小时而非日度频率测量降雨变异性，会使估计的半弹性系数提升一个数量级，表明现有气候经济学文献系统性低估了高强度降雨的重要性。从实质结果看，局部投影响应显示：小时降雨波动性在当期推高购买量，随后一个季度出现反转，符合跨期重新配置特征；温度波动性产生先急剧正向冲击后收缩的效应；高火灾风险日则提升同期购买量。失业率和房价呈现相同但更弱的模式。区域异质性显著，里斯本大都市区和阿尔加维地区有时呈现与北部地区符号相反的效应。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103409.title: The regional economic impact of weather shocks: Evidence from Portugal
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103409.title_zh: 天气冲击的区域经济影响：来自葡萄牙的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103410.abstract: This study investigates convergent validity between elicitation formats within contingent valuation methodology, focusing on theory-driven formats designed to align with incentive compatibility. While earlier literature endorsed the single binary choice (SBC) format as the only incentive-compatible option, recent studies outline theoretical conditions under which payment card (PC) and open-ended (OE) formats may also encourage truthful preference revelation. We contribute to this debate by directly comparing these three theory-driven formats and assessing their robustness against bid-vector effects and other biases such as anchoring, yea-saying, and strategic misrepresentation. We conduct a large-scale, multi-country survey with 12,343 respondents across Poland, Sweden, Hungary, Spain, Germany, and the Netherlands, examining consumers’ willingness to pay (WTP) for an EU-wide biodiversity-enhancing program. The results indicate limited convergent validity across formats, with substantial discrepancies in WTP estimates. However, analysis of choice frequencies suggests that convergent validity holds for lower bid levels, whereas higher bids introduce differences. We argue that these differences stem from both behavioral biases and methodological factors, including bid vector design and econometric assumptions. Our results underscore the critical influence of bid structure on WTP estimates and highlight the need for further research to refine elicitation formats and econometric methods used in contingent valuation studies.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103410.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了条件价值评估方法中不同诱导格式之间的收敛效度，重点关注旨在与激励相容性对齐的理论驱动型格式。尽管早期文献将单一二元选择（SBC）格式视为唯一具有激励相容性的选项，但近期研究提出了支付卡（PC）和开放式（OE）格式在特定理论条件下也可能促进真实偏好揭示的条件。我们通过直接比较这三种理论驱动型格式，并评估它们对投标向量效应及其他偏差（如锚定效应、附和倾向和策略性误报）的稳健性，为这一争论做出贡献。我们开展了一项大规模跨国调查，覆盖波兰、瑞典、匈牙利、西班牙、德国和荷兰的12,343名受访者，考察消费者对欧盟范围内生物多样性增强计划的支付意愿（WTP）。结果表明，各格式之间的收敛效度有限，WTP估计值存在显著差异。然而，选择频率分析显示，在较低投标水平下收敛效度成立，而较高投标水平则引入差异。我们认为，这些差异源于行为偏差和方法论因素，包括投标向量设计和计量经济学假设。我们的结果强调了投标结构对WTP估计的关键影响，并凸显了进一步研究以完善条件价值评估研究中诱导格式和计量经济学方法的必要性。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103410.title: Convergent Validity in Incentive-Compatible Contingent Valuation: Bid-vector and elicitation format effects
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103410.title_zh: 激励相容条件价值评估中的收敛效度：投标向量与诱导格式效应

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103411.abstract: This paper uses high-frequency public data to provide an ex-post evaluation of two floods that hit the Italian region of Emilia-Romagna in May 2023, just a few weeks after they occurred. Using nightlight data to measure output growth and considering a difference-in-differences empirical framework, we find a decline in nightlight growth in flooded municipalities in the three weeks surrounding the two floods, a rebound effect in the following three weeks, but no effect thereafter. In the most pessimistic scenario, the reduction in GDP growth in flooded municipalities in 2023 is between 0.3% and 0.8%, excluding the agricultural sector. The duration of the impact of the floods is broadly confirmed by the other two proxies for economic activity available at the daily frequence and municipal level, i.e. hiring and road traffic data. We also find temporary effects on the housing market demand, but no effects on the house prices asked by the sellers and the number of posted advertisements for house sales, suggesting that the housing market in flooded municipalities already discounts the risk of such natural events.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103411.abstract_zh: 本文利用高频公共数据，对2023年5月袭击意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅大区的两次洪水进行了事后评估，评估时间距灾害发生仅数周。通过使用夜间灯光数据衡量产出增长，并采用双重差分实证框架，我们发现，在两次洪水发生后的三周内，受灾市镇的夜间灯光增长出现下降，随后三周出现反弹效应，但此后无显著影响。在最悲观情景下，2023年受灾市镇的GDP增长率下降幅度在0.3%至0.8%之间，不包括农业部门。洪水影响的持续时间大致得到了另外两个日频且市级层面的经济活动代理变量的证实，即招聘和道路交通数据。我们还发现住房市场需求受到暂时性影响，但对卖方挂牌房价及房屋销售广告数量无显著影响，这表明受灾市镇的住房市场已提前将此类自然灾害风险纳入考量。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103411.title: How to rapidly assess the economic consequences of floods with public data sources? evidence from northern Italy
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103411.title_zh: 如何利用公共数据源快速评估洪水的经济后果？来自意大利北部的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103412.abstract: Energy performance disclosure is increasingly paired with minimum energy performance standards to accelerate the capitalization of energy inefficiency into housing prices and strengthen homeowners’ incentives to renovate inefficient dwellings. We study the 2021 French policy implementing a progressive rental ban on the least energy-efficient dwellings (“energy sieves”) and examine whether it has affected house prices. Using more than 900,000 housing transactions over 2014–2024, we document that energy sieves sell at an additional discount of about 5 percent following the policy announcement. Consistent with expected renovation costs driving the post-ban-announcement discount, the discount is much larger for houses that are costlier to renovate. The increase in the supply of G-rated houses on the sales market is also concentrated among those properties. While the post-ban-announcement discount reduces the gap between expected renovation costs to achieve compliance and expected sale loss due to non-compliance, we find limited evidence of a renovation response.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103412.abstract_zh: 能源绩效披露正日益与最低能源绩效标准相结合，以加速能源低效在房价中的资本化，并增强业主翻新低效住宅的激励。我们研究了2021年法国实施的一项政策，该政策逐步禁止出租能效最低的住宅（“能源筛子”），并考察其是否影响了房价。利用2014年至2024年间超过90万笔住房交易数据，我们记录到，在政策宣布后，能源筛子类房产的售价出现了约5%的额外折价。与预期翻新成本驱动禁令宣布后折价这一现象一致，翻新成本较高的房屋折价幅度更大。销售市场上G级评级房屋供应的增加也主要集中在这些房产中。尽管禁令宣布后的折价缩小了实现合规所需的预期翻新成本与因不合规导致的预期销售损失之间的差距，但我们发现翻新反应的证据有限。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103412.title: Minimum Energy Performance Standards and House Price Capitalization: Evidence from France’s Rental Ban on “Energy Sieves”
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103412.title_zh: 最低能源性能标准与房价资本化：来自法国“能源筛”租赁禁令的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103413.abstract: We study the impact of dust-driven pollution on social conflict in West Africa, exploiting exogenous variation in PM2.5 concentrations caused by Saharan dust transported by Harmattan winds. Using a monthly panel covering 16 West African countries from 2003 to 2017, we combine satellite-derived PM2.5 data with geo-referenced conflict events. We instrument PM2.5 using dust emissions from the Bodélé Depression interacted with northeasterly Harmattan winds. We find that a one standard deviation increase in PM2.5 reduces the likelihood of conflict by 0.13 percentage points. The effects are concentrated in riots, one-sided violence, ethnic and religious conflict, and conflicts involving non-local actors. Similarly, we find that resource-related conflicts increase. The findings suggest that severe dust episodes constrain mobility, visibility, and social interaction, thereby reducing opportunities for violent confrontation, even as they intensify competition over scarce resources.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103413.abstract_zh: 我们研究了沙尘驱动的污染对西非社会冲突的影响，利用由哈马丹风输送的撒哈拉沙尘引起的PM2.5浓度外生变化。通过覆盖2003年至2017年16个西非国家的月度面板数据，我们将卫星获取的PM2.5数据与地理参照的冲突事件相结合。我们使用博德莱洼地的沙尘排放与东北哈马丹风的交互作用作为PM2.5的工具变量。研究发现，PM2.5每增加一个标准差，冲突发生的可能性降低0.13个百分点。这一效应主要集中在骚乱、单方面暴力、民族和宗教冲突以及涉及非本地行为者的冲突中。同样，我们发现资源相关冲突有所增加。研究结果表明，严重的沙尘事件限制了流动性、能见度和社交互动，从而减少了暴力对抗的机会，即便它们加剧了对稀缺资源的竞争。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103413.title: Air pollution and conflict in West Africa: The effects of the harmattan dust
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103413.title_zh: 西非空气污染与冲突：哈马丹沙尘的影响

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103414.abstract: Local policies like high-occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane exemptions play an important role in encouraging electric vehicle (EV) adoption, a key component of climate programs. Using tract-level vehicle registrations and detailed data on HOV lane openings from 2012 to 2024, we study the causal effect of HOV policies on EV adoption in California. We find that HOV exemptions significantly increased EV uptake, with effects that were stronger in later years as EV technology and markets advanced. The impact is also greater in more congested areas with longer commutes and concentrated in higher-income tracts, highlighting both the effectiveness and distributional implications of HOV incentives.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103414.abstract_zh: 地方性政策如高占用率车辆（HOV）车道豁免在鼓励电动汽车（EV）采用方面发挥着重要作用，这是气候项目的关键组成部分。利用2012年至2024年间的人口普查区级车辆注册数据及HOV车道开放的详细资料，我们研究了HOV政策对加利福尼亚州电动汽车采用的因果效应。研究发现，HOV豁免显著促进了电动汽车的普及，且随着电动汽车技术和市场的进步，这一效应在后期年份更为显著。此外，该影响在交通拥堵更严重、通勤时间更长的地区更为突出，并集中于高收入区域，这既凸显了HOV激励措施的有效性，也揭示了其分配效应。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103414.title: Beyond the early era of EVs: Evidence from the staggered rollout of the HOV lane network in California
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103414.title_zh: 超越电动汽车早期时代：来自加州HOV车道网络分阶段推出的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103415.abstract: We study how short-term political incentives affect firms’ compliance with environmental regulation. In China, city mayors face a sharp drop in promotion probability after age 57, creating a transitory enforcement window. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find that firms governed by promotion-eligible mayors reduce sulfur dioxide ( S O 2 ) emissions substantially more than under the same mayors after the threshold. These reductions are concentrated among firms without end-of-pipe abatement equipment and are driven by temporary cuts in operating hours and output rather than technological upgrades. We further document that government subsidies increase during the promotion window and are disproportionately directed to unequipped firms that curtail production, consistent with coordinated short-run compliance. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that these transitory incentives account for 5.2% of the national S O 2 decline during the Eleventh Five-Year Plan, but at a cost of 0.9% of total industrial output. We develop a dynamic model of firm compliance showing that such short-lived incentives induce inefficient output-based responses. Our findings highlight the limits of episodic regulatory pressure.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103415.abstract_zh: 我们研究了短期政治激励如何影响企业遵守环境法规的情况。在中国，城市市长在57岁之后晋升概率急剧下降，这形成了一个短暂的执法窗口期。利用断点回归设计，我们发现，由具备晋升资格的市长管辖的企业，其二氧化硫排放量的减少幅度显著大于同一市长在超过年龄门槛后的时期。这些减排效果主要集中在没有末端治理设备的企业中，并且是通过临时减少运营时间和产量实现的，而非技术升级。我们进一步记录到，在晋升窗口期内政府补贴有所增加，并且不成比例地流向那些削减生产的无设备企业，这与协调一致的短期合规行为相符。粗略估算表明，这些暂时性激励措施在“十一五”规划期间贡献了全国二氧化硫减排量的5.2%，但代价是工业总产出减少了0.9%。我们构建了一个企业合规的动态模型，显示此类短期激励会导致低效的基于产出的应对行为。我们的研究结果凸显了阶段性监管压力的局限性。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103415.title: Window-dressing in environmental regulation: Short-term incentives and temporary abatement
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103415.title_zh: 环境规制中的粉饰行为：短期激励与临时减排

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103416.abstract: We examine the effect of local public charging infrastructure on electric vehicle (EV) adoption using microdata from Norway between 2010 and 2023. We use million new car registrations, geocoded to buyers’ residences and matched to nearby charging stations, along with individual- and neighbourhood-level controls and fixed effects, to estimate the causal impact of local charger availability. We find statistically significant, but economically negligible effects: doubling charger density in 2023 increases the probability of EV adoption by less than 1 percentage point. Of the (74 percentage-point) increase in the EV share in new registrations from 2016 to 2023, less than one percentage point is explained by new publicly available chargers. Effects are heterogeneous, and largely driven by car buyers living in multi-dwelling housing, and those residing in large urban areas.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103416.abstract_zh: 我们利用2010年至2023年间挪威的微观数据，考察了本地公共充电基础设施对电动汽车（EV）普及的影响。我们使用了百万条新车注册记录，这些记录按购买者居住地进行地理编码，并与附近的充电站相匹配，同时结合个人及社区层面的控制变量和固定效应，来估计本地充电设施可用性的因果效应。我们发现，虽然统计上显著，但经济效应微乎其微：到2023年，充电桩密度翻倍仅使电动汽车普及概率增加不到1个百分点。在2016年至2023年间新车注册中电动汽车份额（上升74个百分点）的增长中，不到1个百分点可归因于新增的公共充电设施。效应存在异质性，且主要由居住在多户住宅及大城市地区的购车者驱动。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103416.title: Local charger availability and electric vehicle adoption: Evidence from Norway
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103416.title_zh: 本地充电桩可用性与电动汽车普及：来自挪威的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103417.abstract: As countries phase out coal, natural gas is often promoted as a transitional fuel, but incomplete policies and price distortions can cause emissions leakage, undermining coal reduction efforts. This paper examines China’s 2017 coal-to-gas transition policy, which banned coal in central heating across 28 northern cities, triggering a 70% increase in natural gas prices while coal prices remained stable due to price distortions. Using a comprehensive dataset of hourly pollution measures from 1563 monitors and firm-level data covering around 50% coal consumption in China, we find that instead of reducing coal consumption, the policy led to substantial leakage. Baseline industry composition, the stringency of environmental regulations, and uneven enforcement across polluting firms all contribute to leakage. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that for every ton of coal reduced in the heating sector, coal use increased by 0.19 tons in targeted cities, 2.18 tons in northern non-targeted cities, and 2.32 tons in southern cities. We estimate that 42.9% of the coal consumption rebound could have been prevented if coal prices had been liberalized to fluctuate with natural gas prices, as in European markets. Alternatively, a carbon price of 16.61 RMB (approximately 2.4 USD) per ton of CO2 would achieve an equivalent reduction in coal use while preventing leakage. These findings highlight the importance of addressing market distortions to enhance the effectiveness of coal phase-out policies.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103417.abstract_zh: 随着各国逐步淘汰煤炭，天然气常被作为过渡燃料推广，但不完善的政策和价格扭曲可能导致排放泄漏，削弱煤炭削减成效。本文研究了中国2017年的煤改气过渡政策，该政策在北方28个城市禁止集中供暖使用煤炭，导致天然气价格飙升70%，而煤炭价格因价格扭曲保持稳定。利用涵盖1563个监测点的每小时污染数据及覆盖中国约50%煤炭消费的企业层面数据，我们发现该政策非但未减少煤炭消费，反而引发了显著的泄漏效应。基准产业结构、环境规制严格程度及污染企业间执法不均衡均促成泄漏。粗略估算显示，供暖部门每减少一吨煤炭，目标城市煤炭使用增加0.19吨，北方非目标城市增加2.18吨，南方城市增加2.32吨。我们估计，若煤炭价格像欧洲市场那样放开并与天然气价格联动，42.9%的煤炭消费反弹本可避免。或者，设定每吨二氧化碳16.61元人民币（约2.4美元）的碳价，也能在实现同等煤炭削减的同时防止泄漏。这些发现凸显了解决市场扭曲以增强煤炭退出政策有效性的重要性。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103417.title: Coal phase-out in a second-best setting: Evidence from China’s coal-to-gas transition
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103417.title_zh: 次优情境下的煤炭退出：来自中国煤改气转型的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103425.abstract: A common theme in the vast literature on climate change is the estimation of models using historical data to make predictions many decades into the future. Although there is a large and growing number of these types of studies, researchers rarely return later to check the accuracy of their predictions. In this paper, we perform such an exercise. In Davis and Gertler (2015), we used household-level microdata from Mexico to predict future air conditioning adoption as a function of income and temperature. Revisiting these predictions with 12 years of additional data, we find that air conditioning in Mexico has accelerated, significantly exceeding our predictions. This large prediction gap is not explained by income growth, rising temperatures, migration patterns, or an overly restrictive model. Instead, the evidence points to decreased electricity prices and technological change in air conditioning as potential explanations.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103425.abstract_zh: 关于气候变化的大量文献中，一个共同的主题是利用历史数据估计模型，以预测未来数十年后的情况。尽管这类研究数量庞大且日益增多，但研究者们很少在事后回头检验其预测的准确性。本文即开展这样一项检验工作。在Davis和Gertler（2015）的研究中，我们利用墨西哥的家庭层面微观数据，预测了未来空调普及率作为收入和温度的函数。借助额外12年的数据重新审视这些预测，我们发现墨西哥的空调普及速度已加快，显著超出了我们的预测。这一巨大的预测差距并不能由收入增长、气温上升、人口迁移模式或模型设定过于严格来解释。相反，证据指向电价下降和空调技术进步作为可能的解释因素。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103425.title: Why did air conditioning adoption accelerate faster than predicted? Evidence from Mexico
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103425.title_zh: 为什么空调普及速度超出预期？来自墨西哥的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103426.abstract: This paper investigates how informal political patronage subverts environmental regulation and local economic performance in China. We demonstrate that patronage provides local officials with political insurance, enabling them to safely shield polluting firms from top-down enforcement. Contrary to the promotion tournament hypothesis, this forbearance does not drive GDP growth. Instead, it is sustained through localized rent extraction. Utilizing firm-level data and shocks induced by provincial party secretary turnover, we find that connected officials extract a political tax, measured via perk expenditures, from both polluting and non-polluting enterprises. This systemic extortion generates broad negative spillovers: while shielding incumbent polluters, patronage crowds out productive investment and deters clean market entrants, ultimately degrading both environmental outcomes and the regional business environment.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103426.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了非正式政治庇护如何在中国颠覆环境规制及地方经济表现。我们证明，庇护为地方官员提供了政治保险，使其能够安全地庇护污染企业免受自上而下的执法。与晋升锦标赛假说相反，这种纵容并未推动GDP增长。相反，它通过地方化的租金抽取得以维持。利用企业层面数据及省委书记更替引发的冲击，我们发现，关联官员通过额外津贴支出衡量的政治税收，从污染与非污染企业中抽取。这种系统性勒索产生了广泛的负面溢出效应：在庇护现有污染者的同时，庇护行为挤出了生产性投资，阻碍了清洁市场进入者，最终同时恶化了环境成果与区域商业环境。
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103426.title: Political Patronage, Rent-Extraction, and Social Costs: Evidence from China’s Environmental Cleanup
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103426.title_zh: 政治庇护、寻租与社会成本：来自中国环境治理的证据

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103427.title: Incentivizing environmental public goods: Evidence from urban greening in China
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103427.title_zh: 激励环境公共品供给：来自中国城市绿化的证据

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106179.abstract: I study a model of information acquisition and transmission in which the sender’s ability to misreport her findings is limited. The sender learns covertly, so a key observation is that in equilibrium she must be deterred from undetectably worsening the meaning of the messages she sends. This force substantially disciplines equilibrium beliefs and behavior: the receiver is maximally skeptical of what the sender claims and learns all discovered information. I exploit these equilibrium properties to characterize the sense in which the sender benefits from her claims being more verifiable , showing that this is akin to increasing her commitment power. Finally, I identify sender- and receiver-optimal falsification environments.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106179.abstract_zh: 我研究了一个信息获取与传递模型，其中发送者虚报其发现的能力受到限制。发送者秘密地获取信息，因此一个关键观察是，在均衡状态下，必须阻止她以不可察觉的方式恶化所发送信息的含义。这一力量显著约束了均衡信念与行为：接收者对发送者的声称持最大程度的怀疑，并获知所有被发现的信息。我利用这些均衡性质来刻画发送者从其声称更具可验证性中获益的意义，表明这类似于增强其承诺力。最后，我识别了发送者最优和接收者最优的伪造环境。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106179.title: Covert learning and disclosure

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106182.abstract: We study a persuasion problem in which the receiver has the ability to probabilistically verify the state at a cost. The sender wants to convince the receiver to accept a project, but the receiver is only willing to accept the project when its quality is above a threshold. The optimal disclosure policy strikes a balance between influencing the receiver’s decisions to accept and to verify the quality. It is deterministic and involves at most three messages, each consisting of an acceptance recommendation and a verification recommendation. Under the optimal disclosure policy, the acceptance recommendation exhibits a cutoff structure, while the verification recommendation exhibits a negative assortative structure. Specifically, the optimal disclosure policy recommends acceptance when the quality exceeds a certain threshold. When the quality falls below this threshold, rejection without verification is recommended. For qualities above the threshold, verification is not recommended if the quality lies within the middle range of the interval. Using the characterization of the optimal disclosure policy, we conduct comparative statics and show that verification is recommended when the probability of successful verification is moderate.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106182.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个说服问题，其中接收方有能力以一定成本对状态进行概率性验证。发送方希望说服接收方接受一个项目，但接收方仅在项目质量高于某一阈值时才愿意接受。最优披露策略在影响接收方接受决策与验证质量决策之间取得平衡。该策略是确定性的，并涉及至多三条信息，每条信息包含一个接受建议和一个验证建议。在最优披露策略下，接受建议呈现截断结构，而验证建议呈现负匹配结构。具体而言，最优披露策略在质量超过某一阈值时建议接受。当质量低于此阈值时，建议不验证即拒绝。对于高于阈值的质量，若质量位于区间中间范围，则不建议验证。利用最优披露策略的特征化，我们进行了比较静态分析，并表明当验证成功的概率适中时，会建议进行验证。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106182.title: Information design with endogenous state verification
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106182.title_zh: 内生状态验证下的信息设计

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106183.abstract: Perfect equilibrium and its refinements are widely studied and typically rely on full-support perturbations. We introduce a δ-localized notion of perfection for games with a continuum of players. It confines perturbations within a δ-neighborhood of the underlying action distribution and eliminates undesirable equilibria from a local perspective. We establish the existence of a pure strategy δ-localized perfect equilibrium and show that it is equivalent to δ-admissible Nash equilibrium. We also study limit versions of δ-localized perfection. Illustrative applications to large routing games and crowd saturation games are presented.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106183.abstract_zh: 完美均衡及其精炼已被广泛研究，通常依赖于全支撑扰动。我们针对具有连续统参与者的博弈引入了一种δ-局部化的完美概念。它将扰动限制在基础行动分布的δ-邻域内，并从局部视角消除不良均衡。我们证明了纯策略δ-局部化完美均衡的存在性，并表明其等价于δ-可容许纳什均衡。我们还研究了δ-局部化完美的极限版本。文中给出了在大规模路由博弈和人群饱和博弈中的示例性应用。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106183.title: Localized perfection

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106186.abstract: We study optimal auctions with expectation-based loss-averse bidders. We first consider when bidders are ex-ante identical. Although symmetric designs are optimal for bidders with expected-utility preferences, if the degree of loss aversion is sufficiently large relative to the variation in valuations, expected revenues are higher in the optimal design with one buyer than in any symmetric mechanism with multiple bidders. Further, we provide a sufficient condition under which optimal mechanisms are necessarily asymmetric. When bidders are ex-ante heterogeneous, the optimal degree of favoritism must be modified from the level in Myerson (1981) to reduce the uncertainty in auction outcomes. Not only the degree of the required modification but also the direction of the modification may not be monotone in the degree of loss aversion.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106186.abstract_zh: 我们研究在期望损失厌恶竞拍者情况下的最优拍卖设计。首先考虑竞拍者事前相同的情形。尽管对称设计对于具有期望效用偏好的竞拍者是最优的，但如果损失厌恶程度相对于估值差异足够大，那么在一个买家情况下的最优设计所获得的期望收益将高于任何包含多个竞拍者的对称机制。此外，我们提供了一个充分条件，在该条件下最优机制必然是非对称的。当竞拍者事前异质时，最优的偏袒程度需从Myerson（1981）中的水平进行调整，以减少拍卖结果的不确定性。不仅所需调整的程度，而且调整的方向也可能不随损失厌恶程度单调变化。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106186.title: Asymmetric optimal auction design with loss-averse bidders
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106186.title_zh: 损失厌恶投标者下的非对称最优拍卖设计

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106187.abstract: We study mechanism design when agents may have hidden secondary goals which will play a role when the primary utility of the outcomes is the same. We show that in such cases, a mechanism is immune to strategic manipulation if and only if it is incentive compatible with regard to primary utility -- a property we term "primary incentive compatibility" -- and nonbossy -- a well-studied property in the context of matching and allocation mechanisms. We give complete characterizations of primarily incentive-compatible and nonbossy mechanisms in various settings, including auctions with single-parameter agents and public decision settings where all agents share a common outcome. In particular, we show that in the single-item setting, a mechanism is primarily incentive compatible, individually rational, and nonbossy if and only if it is a sequential posted-price mechanism.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106187.abstract_zh: 我们研究当代理人可能拥有隐藏的次要目标时，这些目标在主要效用结果相同的情况下会发挥作用时的机制设计问题。我们证明，在这种情况下，一个机制对策略操纵具有免疫性，当且仅当它相对于主要效用是激励相容的——我们称之为“主要激励相容”性质——并且是非专断的——这是在匹配和分配机制背景下被广泛研究的性质。我们给出了在多种情境下主要激励相容且非专断机制的完整刻画，包括单参数代理人的拍卖以及所有代理人共享共同结果的公共决策情境。特别地，我们证明在单物品情境下，一个机制是主要激励相容、个体理性且非专断的，当且仅当它是一个序贯标价机制。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106187.title: Nonbossy mechanisms: Mechanism design robust to secondary goals
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106187.title_zh: 非强制性机制：对次要目标稳健的机制设计

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106188.abstract: We revisit the welfare properties of competitive credit markets with endogenousdebt limits that arise from limited commitment. We introduce a novel concept ofconstrained efficiency to encompass economies where market interest rates influencedefault values and participation constraints. We explore this concept through a baselineeconomy featuring heterogeneous agents with cyclical endowments. The analysis showsthat the efficiency of market equilibria and welfare outcomes are sensitive to the natureof default punishments. It suggests that laissez-faire debt limits, while supportiveof risk-sharing, might not always optimize welfare. The study illustrates how creditrationing—tightening future debt limits—can enhance current risk-sharing and overallwelfare. This occurs because such interventions influence market interest rates andthe default option’s value, thereby affecting agents’ present consumption and savingchoices, and enabling a more efficient allocation of resources.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106188.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了在有限承诺条件下，内生债务限额的竞争性信贷市场的福利特性。我们引入了一个新的约束效率概念，以涵盖市场利率影响违约价值和参与约束的经济体。通过一个具有周期性禀赋的异质性主体基准经济模型，我们探讨了这一概念。分析表明，市场均衡的效率及福利结果对违约惩罚的性质高度敏感。研究指出，尽管自由放任的债务限额有助于风险分担，但未必总能优化福利。研究进一步阐明，信贷配给——即收紧未来债务限额——能够增强当前的风险分担并提升整体福利。这是因为此类干预措施会影响市场利率及违约选择的价值，进而影响主体的当前消费与储蓄决策，实现资源更有效的配置。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106188.title: Credit rationing in unsecured debt markets
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106188.title_zh: 无担保债务市场中的信贷配给

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106189.abstract: In this paper, we characterize a forecasting model where forecasters cannot perfectly distinguish between the two persistent components (trends and cycles) in a dynamic setting. In this model, forecasters jointly update their beliefs about the two components: noisy information about one component is used to update beliefs about the other component. We present diagnostic empirical facts on forecasting behaviors and show that these facts are consistent with our model’s predictions while contradicting those of existing models in the expectation formation literature. To validate our model, we exploit the Federal Reserve’s 2012 adoption of explicit inflation targeting as a policy shock. Structural estimation reveals that this policy change altered the underlying data-generation process, and the corresponding changes in forecasting behavior indeed align with our model’s predictions. Finally, we characterize how this rational confusion mechanism interacts with behavioral biases such as overconfidence and show that this interaction can address the well-known persistent forecast error puzzle in the literature.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106189.abstract_zh: 本文刻画了一个预测模型，在该模型中，预测者无法在动态环境中完美区分两个持久性成分（趋势与周期）。在此模型中，预测者联合更新关于这两个成分的信念：关于一个成分的噪声信息被用于更新关于另一个成分的信念。我们提出了关于预测行为的诊断性经验事实，并表明这些事实与我们的模型预测一致，同时与预期形成文献中现有模型的预测相矛盾。为验证我们的模型，我们利用美联储2012年采用明确通胀目标制作为政策冲击。结构估计揭示，这一政策变化改变了潜在的数据生成过程，且相应的预测行为变化确实与我们的模型预测相符。最后，我们刻画了这一理性混淆机制如何与过度自信等行为偏差相互作用，并表明这种相互作用能够解决文献中著名的持续预测误差之谜。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106189.title: Expectation and confusion: Evidence and theory
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106189.title_zh: 期望与困惑：证据与理论

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106190.abstract: In the standard dynamic screening problem between an uninformed seller and a privately informed buyer, theory suggests that the presence (absence) of the buyer’s outside option leads to a substantial surplus for the seller (buyer). This outcome arises from contrasting unraveling processes that theory predicts: negative selection occurs in the absence of an outside option, while positive selection occurs in the presence of it. We examine the validity of these contrasting unraveling processes and report laboratory data that qualitatively deviate from theoretical predictions. We found that the seller’s profit ranking was reversed between the two environments. In particular, in the presence of an outside option, the buyer frequently rejected current-round offers, leading to pervasive delays; and the seller’s reported beliefs about the buyer’s type were qualitatively more consistent with the negative selection than with the theoretically predicted positive selection.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106190.abstract_zh: 在标准动态筛选问题中，不知情的卖方与拥有私人信息的买方之间，理论表明买方外部选择权的存在（缺失）会导致卖方（买方）获得显著剩余。这一结果源于理论预测的两种相反的去遮蔽过程：在缺乏外部选择权时发生负向选择，而在存在外部选择权时则发生正向选择。我们检验了这些相反去遮蔽过程的有效性，并报告了与理论预测定性偏离的实验室数据。我们发现，卖方利润排名在两种环境之间发生了反转。特别是，在存在外部选择权的情况下，买方频繁拒绝当轮报价，导致普遍延误；且卖方关于买方类型的报告信念在定性上更符合负向选择，而非理论预测的正向选择。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106190.title: Positive and negative selection in bargaining
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106190.title_zh: 议价中的正向与负向选择

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106191.abstract: Given a model of preferences, what choice data or experiment is sufficient to definitively test whether a subject is consistent with the model or to classify them into some “type” within the model? We characterize all experiments that test or classify a given model using a novel graph-theoretic construction: the labeled permutohedron. We show how these results can be used to identify the smallest experiments that achieve a particular goal.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106191.abstract_zh: 给定偏好模型，何种选择数据或实验足以明确检验受试者是否与模型一致，或将其归类为模型内的某种“类型”？我们通过一种新颖的图论构造——标记置换多面体——刻画了所有检验或分类给定模型的实验。我们展示了这些结果如何用于识别实现特定目标的最小实验。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106191.title: Which experiments test a model?
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106191.title_zh: 哪些实验检验了一个模型？

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106192.abstract: The Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) mechanism is one of the most compelling constructs in mechanism design, but the presence of complementary goods creates the possibility of non-core and even zero-revenue outcomes. In this article, we show that joint feasibility constraints on allocations offer a second pathway to ill-behaved outcomes in the VCG mechanism, even when all bidders have substitutes preferences for the goods. We then develop a theory of complementarities specifically tailored to assignment stages of spectrum auctions. Assignment stages typically guarantee contiguous spectrum to each winner—this proves to be an especially severe joint feasibility constraint. We propose a definition of bidder complementarities and further dichotomize them as direct or indirect. When opponents bid on distinct parts of a bidder’s preferred assignment, they set up a direct bidder complementarity. However, if an assignment is denied through the contiguity restriction, that is called an indirect complementarity. As a result, non-core outcomes, together with all of the accompanying anomalies, can be expected in VCG assignment stages. We then examine a conspicuous recent spectrum auction, the FCC’s Broadcast Incentive Auction, and we provide the first documentation of zero-revenue outcomes in the field. Of 207 assignment stage auctions with at least three bidders, 17.9% produced non-core outcomes relative to the bids and, of these, 3 generated zero revenues. After rescaling bidder values, we find that the majority of assignment stage auctions had the potential for exploitable bidder complementarities and that the vast majority of bidder complementarities—both potential and realized—were indirect.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106192.abstract_zh: 维克里-克拉克-格罗夫斯（VCG）机制是机制设计中最引人注目的构造之一，但互补品的存在可能导致非核心结果，甚至出现零收入的情况。本文表明，即使所有竞标者对商品均具有替代偏好，分配上的联合可行性约束也为VCG机制中的不良结果提供了第二条路径。随后，我们发展了一套专门针对频谱拍卖分配阶段互补性的理论。分配阶段通常保证每个获胜者获得连续频谱——这被证明是一种尤为严重的联合可行性约束。我们提出了竞标者互补性的定义，并将其进一步分为直接互补性和间接互补性。当对手在竞标者偏好分配的不同部分出价时，便形成了直接竞标者互补性。然而，如果某项分配因连续性限制而被拒绝，则称为间接互补性。因此，非核心结果及其伴随的所有异常现象，在VCG分配阶段是可以预期的。接着，我们考察了一个近期引人注目的频谱拍卖——联邦通信委员会的广播激励拍卖，并首次记录了实地中的零收入结果。在至少有三名竞标者的207场分配阶段拍卖中，17.9%产生了相对于出价的非核心结果，其中3场产生了零收入。在重新调整竞标者价值后，我们发现大多数分配阶段拍卖存在可利用的竞标者互补性潜力，且绝大多数竞标者互补性——无论是潜在的还是已实现的——都是间接的。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106192.title: The VCG mechanism, the core, and assignment stages in auctions
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106192.title_zh: VCG机制、核心与拍卖中的分配阶段

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106202.abstract: We study pseudonymity—an information regime where agents’ histories are perfectly observable, but linked only to pseudonyms rather than to true identities. A key feature is that agents may open and use multiple pseudonyms simultaneously. In a tractable environment with limited commitment, we characterize the set of stationary credit equilibria under pseudonymity, showing that it forms a strict non-empty subset of equilibria attainable under a no anonymity regime, where histories are publicly linked to true identities. Moreover, money is always essential under pseudonymity, yet cannot co-exist with credit. Finally, imposing optimal fees on pseudonym creation generally raises welfare, whereas making pseudonyms tradable never does.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106202.abstract_zh: 我们研究化名制度——一种信息体制，其中个体的历史完全可观察，但仅与化名而非真实身份相关联。其关键特征在于，个体可同时开设并使用多个化名。在有限承诺的可处理环境中，我们刻画了化名制度下平稳信贷均衡的集合，表明该集合构成无匿名制度（即历史与真实身份公开关联）下可实现均衡的严格非空子集。此外，在化名制度下，货币始终是必要的，却无法与信贷共存。最后，对化名设立征收最优费用通常能提升福利，而允许化名交易则从未如此。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106202.title: Credit, money and (pseudo-)anonymity

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106203.abstract: We compare how well agents aggregate information in two repeated social learning environments. In the first setting agents have access to a public data set. In the second they have access to the same data, and also to the past actions of others. Despite the fact that actions contain no additional payoff-relevant information, and despite potential herd behavior, free riding and information overload issues, observing and imitating the actions of others leads agents to take the optimal action more often in the second setting. We also investigate the effect of group size, as well as a setting in which agents observe private data and others’ actions.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106203.abstract_zh: 我们比较了两种重复社会学习环境中主体聚合信息的能力。在第一种环境中，主体可访问公共数据集。在第二种环境中，他们可访问相同的数据，以及他人过去的行为。尽管行为不包含额外的与收益相关的信息，且存在潜在的羊群行为、搭便车和信息过载问题，观察并模仿他人的行为使得主体在第二种环境中更频繁地采取最优行动。我们还研究了群体规模的影响，以及一种主体观察私人数据与他人行为的环境。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106203.title: Learning through imitation: An experiment
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106203.title_zh: 通过模仿学习：一项实验

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106204.abstract: A Hard Problem is a collective choice problem in which the only feasible alternatives to the status quo consist of a welfare gain to some people (the Winners) and a welfare loss to others (the Losers). These problems are typical in a number of settings, such as climate action, anti-trust regulation, and tax design. We study how to make collective choices when faced with Hard Problems. We find that a relatively weak fairness requirement, which we call Expansion Solidarity, necessarily leads to a dictatorship of the Losers, no matter how small their number. Even one single Loser must be given the power to veto any departure from the status quo, regardless of the number of Winners, how large the gains, how small the loss, or how extreme the welfare inequalities.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106204.abstract_zh: 硬问题”是一种集体选择问题，其中唯一可行的替代现状方案包括对某些人（赢家）的福利增益和对其他人（输家）的福利损失。这类问题在多种情境中普遍存在，如气候行动、反垄断监管和税收设计。我们研究在面对硬问题时如何做出集体选择。我们发现，一个相对较弱的公平性要求，我们称之为“扩展团结”，必然导致输家的独裁，无论其数量多么微小。即便只有一个输家，也必须被赋予否决任何偏离现状的权力，不论赢家数量多少、增益多大、损失多小，或福利不平等程度多么极端。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106204.title: The Hard Problem and the Tyranny of the Losers
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106204.title_zh: 硬问题与失败者的暴政

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106205.abstract: The paper studies the canonical hold-up problem with one-sided investment by the buyer and full bargaining power by the seller. The buyer can covertly choose any distribution of valuations at a cost and privately observes her valuation. I show that, unlike in the well-understood case with linear costs, if investment costs are strictly convex, the buyer’s equilibrium utility is strictly positive and total welfare is strictly higher than when valuations are public information, thus alleviating the severity of the hold-up problem. In fact, when costs are mean-based or display decreasing risk, the equilibrium outcome might be efficient.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106205.abstract_zh: 本文研究了买方单方面投资且卖方拥有完全议价能力的经典敲竹杠问题。买方可以秘密地以一定成本选择任意估值分布，并私下观察其估值。我证明，与线性成本下已充分理解的情形不同，若投资成本严格凸，则买方的均衡效用严格为正，且总福利严格高于估值公开信息时的情形，从而缓解了敲竹杠问题的严重性。实际上，当成本基于均值或表现出递减风险时，均衡结果可能是有效的。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106205.title: The hold-up problem with flexible unobservable investments
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106205.title_zh: 灵活不可观测投资下的敲竹杠问题

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106206.abstract: I study the stationary wealth distribution in a dynamic model of financial markets in which investors differ in their levels of investment sophistication. Some investors form beliefs rationally but have access to different information, while others hold incorrect beliefs. For all investor types, the stationary wealth distribution exhibits a thick upper tail, whose thickness depends on the higher moments of portfolio returns relative to the aggregate market. The upper tail of the overall stationary wealth distribution is populated by the group with the thickest tail. I show that this group is either a rational group with an undominated information set or the group with incorrect beliefs, despite the latter earning the lowest expected return. To explain the observed degrees of wealth concentration, it is sufficient that some investor groups earn an expected excess return of 0.89% per annum relative to the aggregate economy – consistent with the risk-adjusted returns generated by hedge funds and private equity funds and their portfolio shares among the ultra-wealthy in the United States. A calibration of the model matches the distribution of average returns for Norwegian households documented by Fagereng et al. (2020).
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106206.abstract_zh: 我研究了一个动态金融市场模型中的稳态财富分布，其中投资者的投资 sophistication 水平各异。部分投资者理性形成信念但获取的信息不同，而其他投资者则持有错误信念。对于所有投资者类型，稳态财富分布均呈现厚尾特征，其厚度取决于投资组合收益相对于整体市场的更高阶矩。整体稳态财富分布的上尾部分由尾部最厚的群体占据。我证明，这一群体要么是拥有无支配信息集的理性群体，要么是持有错误信念的群体，尽管后者获得的预期收益最低。为解释观察到的财富集中程度，只需某些投资者群体相对于整体经济每年获得0.89%的预期超额收益即可——这与对冲基金和私募股权基金产生的风险调整后收益及其在美国超级富豪中的投资组合份额相符。模型校准结果与Fagereng等人（2020）记录的挪威家庭平均收益分布相匹配。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106206.title: Investment Sophistication and Wealth Inequality
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106206.title_zh: 投资成熟度与财富不平等

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106207.abstract: I derive a model of choice bracketing from two behavioral axioms in an expected utility framework. The first behavioral axiom establishes a link between narrow bracketing and correlation neglect. The second behavioral axiom identifies the reference point as the connector between broad and narrow preferences. The narrow bracketer is characterized by an inability to process changes from the reference point in different dimensions simultaneously. As a result, her tradeoffs between dimensions are distorted. She evaluates dimensions in isolation, implying a disregard for how they affect one another. When evaluating a dimension, she remains anchored to the reference point in the respective other dimension. This implies that she mistakenly perceives preference interactions in relation to the reference point. I present applications to portfolio choice, consumption bundle choice, and an exchange economy.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106207.abstract_zh: 我在期望效用框架下，从两个行为公理推导出一个选择分框模型。第一个行为公理建立了窄分框与相关性忽视之间的联系。第二个行为公理将参考点识别为宽偏好与窄偏好之间的连接器。窄分框者的特征在于无法同时处理来自参考点在不同维度上的变化。因此，她在各维度之间的权衡被扭曲了。她孤立地评估各个维度，意味着忽视了它们之间的相互影响。在评估某一维度时，她仍锚定于另一相应维度上的参考点。这导致她错误地感知了与参考点相关的偏好交互作用。我将此模型应用于投资组合选择、消费束选择以及交换经济中。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106207.title: Reference-dependent choice bracketing

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106208.abstract: Despite addressing similar underlying questions, the literatures on network formation and matching have evolved more or less independently. This paper offers a common framework, studying a general model of network formation without externalities—equivalently, a one-sided many-to-many matching model. I give conditions for the existence and uniqueness of stable graphs, I prove a rural hospital theorem, and I highlight a link-by-link conflict of interest across different stable graphs. Special cases contain and extend classic results for the roommate problem and two-sided matching markets. An iterated deletion algorithm adapted from Gutin et al. (2023) furnishes a crucial tool, reducing network formation games to a normal form with helpful properties.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106208.abstract_zh: 尽管网络形成与匹配的相关文献探讨了相似的根本性问题，但它们的发展路径大致上相互独立。本文提出一个统一框架，研究无外部性的网络形成一般模型——等价于单边多对多匹配模型。我给出了稳定图存在性与唯一性的条件，证明了乡村医院定理，并揭示了不同稳定图之间逐链接的利益冲突。特例涵盖并扩展了室友问题和双边匹配市场的经典结果。借鉴自Gutin等人（2023）的迭代删除算法提供了一个关键工具，将网络形成博弈简化为具有有益性质的规范形式。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106208.title: Classical Matching via Network Formation
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106208.title_zh: 基于网络形成的经典匹配

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106209.abstract: The hold-up problem has given rise to a large and influential literature. We consider a bilateral hold-up problem where bargaining power is asymmetrically distributed among the agents, in particular investing at the efficient level is not “individually rational” for one of the agents. We demonstrate that in the presence of a rich natural setup – that allows for dynamics in transfers, investments and negotiations – there exist subgame perfect equilibria that achieve asymptotic efficiency. This is true both when investments by the two agents are substitutes, as well as when these are complements. Moreover, implementation requires gradualism, with sequential investments and transfers over several periods.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106209.abstract_zh: 敲竹杠问题催生了一大批具有影响力的文献。我们考虑一个双边敲竹杠问题，其中议价能力在代理人之间不对称分布，特别是，对于其中一方代理人而言，以有效水平进行投资并非“个体理性”的。我们证明，在一个丰富的自然设定下——该设定允许转移支付、投资和谈判具有动态性——存在能够实现渐近效率的子博弈完美均衡。这一结论在双方投资为替代品时成立，在投资为互补品时同样成立。此外，实施过程需要渐进性，即投资和转移支付需在多个时期内顺序进行。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106209.title: Hold-up in the Absence of Individual Rationality: Asymptotic Efficiency and Gradualism
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106209.title_zh: 缺乏个体理性下的敲竹杠问题：渐近效率与渐进主义

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106216.abstract: We study an assignment market where multiple heterogenous objects are sold to unit demand agents who have general preferences that accommodate income effects and market frictions. The minimum price equilibrium (MPE) is one of the most important equilibrium concepts in such settings. Nevertheless, none of the well-known mechanisms that find the MPE in the quasi-linear settings can identify or even approximate MPEs for general preferences. We establish novel structural properties of MPEs and use them as bases to design a "Serial Vickrey (SV) mechanism." The SV mechanism finds an MPE for general preferences in a finite number of steps and only requires agents to reveal finite-dimensional information regarding their preferences in finitely many times. Besides, the SV mechanism also has nice incentive properties.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106216.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个分配市场，其中多种异质物品被出售给具有单位需求的代理，这些代理拥有能够容纳收入效应和市场摩擦的一般偏好。在此类环境中，最低价格均衡（MPE）是最重要的均衡概念之一。然而，在拟线性设定中，所有已知的能够找到MPE的著名机制都无法识别甚至近似一般偏好下的MPE。我们建立了MPE的新结构性属性，并以此为基础设计了一种“序列维克里（SV）机制”。该SV机制能在有限步骤内找到一般偏好下的MPE，并且仅要求代理在有限次数内揭示其偏好的有限维信息。此外，SV机制还具有良好的激励特性。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106216.title: Minimum price equilibrium in the assignment market: Structural properties and the Serial Vickrey mechanism
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106216.title_zh: 指派市场中的最低价格均衡：结构性质与序列维克里机制

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106217.abstract: We propose a mean-field game (MFG) approach to study the dynamics of spatial agglomeration in a continuous space-time framework where trade across locations may follow a broad class of static gravity models. Forward-looking intertemporal utility-maximizing agents work and migrate in a two-dimensional geography and face idiosyncratic shocks. Equilibrium wages and prices depend on their common distribution and adjust statically according to the underlying trade model. We first prove existence and uniqueness of the static trade equilibrium. We then prove existence of dynamic equilibria. In the case of a circular economy, we obtain closed-form solutions for small perturbations around the steady state, and we identify the sets of parameters that lead to agglomeration or dispersion. We exploit the MFG structure of the model to explicitly quantify how uncertainty and forward-looking expectations contribute to agglomeration and dispersion. In particular, we show that, regardless of the static trade model, forward-looking expectations always promote agglomeration, but cannot reverse the dominant pattern that would arise under myopic behavior.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106217.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种平均场博弈（MFG）方法，用以研究连续时空框架下空间集聚的动态过程，其中跨地区贸易可能遵循一类广泛的静态引力模型。具有前瞻性跨期效用最大化的个体在二维地理空间中工作与迁移，并面临异质性冲击。均衡工资与价格取决于他们的共同分布，并根据底层贸易模型静态调整。我们首先证明静态贸易均衡的存在性与唯一性。随后证明动态均衡的存在性。在环形经济情形下，我们获得了稳态附近小扰动的闭式解，并识别出导致集聚或分散的参数集合。我们利用模型的MFG结构，明确量化不确定性与前瞻性预期对集聚和分散的贡献。特别地，我们表明，无论静态贸易模型如何，前瞻性预期总是促进集聚，但无法逆转在短视行为下将占主导地位的格局。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106217.title: When Lasry-Lions meet Krugman: A mean-field game theory of spatial dynamics
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106217.title_zh: 当Lasry-Lions遇见Krugman：空间动力学的平均场博弈理论

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106218.abstract: We enrich standard models of imperfect competition by allowing consumer demand for market goods to depend non-separably on off-market time. Consumers value final consumption experiences that require both market purchases and time, which reshapes demand elasticities through two opposing forces. First, because time is an input, changes in market prices translate only partially into changes in the cost of an experience and second, households can substitute time for market purchases in response to price variation. We show how these forces alter the mapping from markups to welfare by distinguishing between markups and a holistic counterpart that accounts for the time cost of consumption. In a monopolistically competitive environment with CES preferences over experiences, firm selection and entry is governed solely by the elasticity of substitution between time use and market purchases, and markup dispersion can be consistent with efficiency when time and market purchases are perfect complements. Extending the analysis to oligopolistic competition, we show that forces that raise markups, like greater market concentration and less competitive conduct, also amplify the gap between the usual and holistic markups.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106218.abstract_zh: 我们通过允许市场商品的需求非可分地依赖于非市场时间，来丰富不完全竞争的标准模型。消费者重视需要市场购买和时间投入的最终消费体验，这通过两种相反的力量重塑了需求弹性。首先，由于时间是一种投入，市场价格的变化仅部分转化为体验成本的变化；其次，家庭可以通过时间替代市场购买来应对价格变动。我们展示了这些力量如何通过区分通常的加成率与考虑消费时间成本的全面对应指标，改变加成率向福利的映射关系。在具有CES偏好于体验的垄断竞争环境中，企业选择和市场进入仅由时间使用与市场购买之间的替代弹性决定，并且当时间与市场购买为完全互补时，加成率离散可以与效率一致。将分析扩展到寡头竞争，我们表明提高加成率的力量，如更大的市场集中度和较弱的竞争行为，也会扩大通常加成率与全面加成率之间的差距。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106218.title: Time Use and Heterogeneous Markups
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106218.title_zh: 时间使用与异质性加成

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106219.abstract: We examine optimal strategy-proof voting mechanisms in environments where the designer lacks precise information about the probability distribution of individual utility profiles. This uncertainty over the true distribution is represented by a set of multiple distributions, and the designer evaluates mechanisms using either the worst-case utility sum or worst-case regret. Departing from the existing literature, we do not assume that utility functions are single-peaked or that the set of possible utility functions is maximally rich. In this setting, we show that the median voter rule is the unique optimal mechanism under both criteria. Our result provides a new justification for this well-known mechanism from a welfare perspective.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106219.abstract_zh: 我们考察在设计师对个体效用分布概率缺乏精确信息的环境中的最优策略性投票机制。这种对真实分布的不确定性通过一组多重分布来表示，设计师依据最坏情况下的效用总和或最坏情况下的遗憾来评估机制。与现有文献不同，我们不假设效用函数是单峰的，也不假设可能的效用函数集合是最大丰富的。在此设定下，我们证明中位选民规则是这两种标准下的唯一最优机制。我们的结果为这一知名机制从福利角度提供了新的合理性依据。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106219.title: Robustly Optimal Voting Rule

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106220.abstract: The Taylor principle, a more than one-for-one reaction of the nominal interest rate to inflation, is a central tenet of monetary policy to rule out self-fulfilling equilibria. The standard sticky-price model only holds this principle as a sufficient determinacy bound, with substitutes such as output-gap targeting available. We show that if the long-run Phillips curve is vertical, the Taylor principle is necessary and no amount of output-gap, output-growth, or forecast targeting can substitute for the vigorous response to inflation it prescribes. Sticky price models report determinacy bounds as generically model-dependent, nonlinear functions of model parameters. We find that models with vertical long-run Phillips curves share the same determinacy bounds despite differing short-run tradeoffs. These bounds are more conservative, placing tighter restrictions on monetary policy, and more robust, being independent of model-specific parameters and depending solely on monetary policy’s reaction to current inflation.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106220.abstract_zh: 泰勒原理，即名义利率对通胀的响应超过一比一，是货币政策排除自我实现均衡的核心原则。标准粘性价格模型仅将此原则视为充分确定性边界，并提供了如产出缺口目标等替代方案。我们证明，若长期菲利普斯曲线垂直，则泰勒原理为必要条件，且任何产出缺口、产出增长或预测目标均无法替代其规定的对通胀的强力响应。粘性价格模型将确定性边界报告为通常依赖模型、随模型参数变化的非线性函数。我们发现，具有垂直长期菲利普斯曲线的模型，尽管短期权衡不同，却共享相同的确定性边界。这些边界更为保守，对货币政策施加更严格的限制，且更为稳健，不依赖于模型特定参数，仅取决于货币政策对当前通胀的反应。

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106221.abstract: Financial arrangements involving illiquid assets financed by liquid liabilities are often viewed as inherently runnable. Diamond and Dybvig (1983) show that this is true when risk-sharing arrangements are not optimally designed. Peck and Shell (2003) and Ennis and Keister (2009, 2016), however, demonstrate that runnable banking arrangements can be constrained-efficient when liquidity demand is uncertain and withdrawals must be processed on a first-come, first-served basis. We show that this insight extends to environments in which redemptions are not subject to a sequential service constraint. Instead, increasing returns to scale in banking-consistent with empirical evidence-can generate regions of the parameter space in which the constrained-efficient allocation is runnable. Runnable banking arrangements can be constrained-efficient when the minimum scale required to realize economies of scale is difficult to attain during large redemption events, when the penalty for failing to achieve scale is small, and when the likelihood of a coordinated run is low 1 1 The authors are grateful to Todd Keister, Manuel Amador, and two anonymous referees for very helpful comments and criticisms. The views expressed here are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect those of the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta or the Federal Reserve System. .
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106221.abstract_zh: 涉及以流动性负债融资的流动性不足资产的金融安排，常被视为本质上具有可挤兑性。Diamond和Dybvig（1983）指出，当风险分担安排未得到最优设计时，这一情况确实成立。然而，Peck和Shell（2003）以及Ennis和Keister（2009, 2016）证明，在流动性需求不确定且取款必须按先到先得原则处理的情况下，可挤兑的银行安排可能是约束有效的。我们证明这一见解同样适用于赎回不受顺序服务约束的环境。相反，银行业中与实证证据一致的规模报酬递增，可以产生参数空间中的某些区域，在这些区域中，约束有效的配置是可挤兑的。当实现规模经济所需的最小规模在大规模赎回事件中难以达到、未能达到规模的惩罚较小，以及协调挤兑的可能性较低时，可挤兑的银行安排可能是约束有效的。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106221.title: On the Efficiency of Runnable Banking Arrangements
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106221.title_zh: 论可运行银行安排的效率

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106222.abstract: We study a sender-receiver game in which the receiver can commit to a decision rule before the sender determines the information policy. We ask how the receiver should commit, in advance, to a rule that maps the information of the sender into decisions-when the receiver knows neither the sender’s true preferences nor the full range of information the sender could supply. To handle this dual uncertainty, we adopt a unified robust framework that nests max-min utility, min-max regret, and min-max competitive ratio as special cases. Across all criteria, the same answer emerges: the optimal rule is always a quota rule.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106222.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个发送者-接收者博弈，其中接收者在发送者确定信息政策之前可以承诺一个决策规则。我们探讨接收者应如何事先承诺一个将发送者信息映射为决策的规则——当接收者既不知道发送者的真实偏好，也不了解发送者可能提供的全部信息范围时。为应对这种双重不确定性，我们采用一个统一的稳健框架，该框架将最大最小效用、最小最大遗憾和最小最大竞争比作为特例包含在内。在所有准则下，得出的答案一致：最优规则始终是配额规则。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106222.title: Managing Persuasion Robustly: The Optimality of Quota Rules
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106222.title_zh: 稳健地管理说服：配额规则的最优性

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106223.abstract: We show in a model of RFQ trading that customers may admit only a few dealers, even when more are available, to induce maximum liquidity supply—“less can be more.” The number of admitted dealers is pinned down by a competition elasticity, shaped by dealers’ cost to respond to RFQs. For example, higher search (operating) costs increase (reduce) admitted dealers. A social planner would mandate even fewer dealers than the market outcome, because customers induce excessive dealer competition. The model predicts endogenous market power, yields implications for regulation and design of electronic platforms, and speaks to customer-dealer interactions under market stress.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106223.abstract_zh: 我们在一个询价（RFQ）交易模型中表明，即使有更多交易商可用，客户也可能仅接纳少数几家，以诱导最大化的流动性供给——“少即是多”。接纳的交易商数量由竞争弹性决定，这一弹性受交易商响应询价的成本影响。例如，较高的搜寻（运营）成本会增加（减少）接纳的交易商数量。社会规划者会规定比市场结果更少的交易商数量，因为客户会引发过度的交易商竞争。该模型预测了内生市场力量，为电子平台的监管与设计提供了启示，并探讨了市场压力下的客户与交易商互动。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106223.title: When Can Less Be More? Inducing Dealer Responses in RFQ Platforms
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106223.title_zh: 何时少即是多？在RFQ平台中诱导交易商反应

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106224.abstract: Monotonicity and recursivity are central assumptions in intertemporal consumption problems under ambiguity. We show that monotone recursive preferences admit both a recursive and an ex-ante representation, and that the certainty equivalent functionals associated with these representations are translation invariant. Translation invariance implies that the decision maker’s ambiguity attitudes are constant, in the sense that they do not vary with the level of welfare or utility. Finally, we establish an equation linking the two certainty equivalent functionals that extends the notion of rectangularity for recursive multiple priors, which we call generalized rectangularity. This equation yields a simple, testable condition for dynamic consistency.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106224.abstract_zh: 单调性和递归性是模糊环境下跨期消费问题的核心假设。我们证明，单调递归偏好既允许递归表示，也允许事前表示，并且与这些表示相关的确定性等价函数具有平移不变性。平移不变性意味着决策者的模糊态度是恒定的，即它们不随福利或效用水平的变化而变化。最后，我们建立了一个连接这两个确定性等价函数的方程，该方程扩展了递归多先验的矩形性概念，我们称之为广义矩形性。此方程提供了一个简单且可检验的动态一致性条件。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106224.title: Recursive Preferences and Ambiguity Attitudes

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106225.abstract: Complexity aversion in choice under risk is well documented. One of its main behavioral effects is the event-splitting effect. It captures how the value of a lottery changes when one prize is split into two prizes, each with half the original probability. We weaken independence and continuity to accommodate the event-splitting effect. The resulting preferences admit either an expected utility representation with an additive entropy cost of complexity or a power-weighted expected utility representation in which probabilities are weighted by a power function. The model also provides behavioral foundations for logit choice.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106225.abstract_zh: 风险选择中的复杂性厌恶已有充分文献记载。其主要行为效应之一是事件分割效应，该效应刻画了当一项奖金被拆分为两项各具原概率一半的奖金时，彩票价值如何变化。我们弱化独立性和连续性公理，以容纳事件分割效应。由此产生的偏好允许两种表示形式：一种是带有加性熵复杂性成本的期望效用表示，另一种是概率由幂函数加权的幂加权期望效用表示。该模型还为Logit选择提供了行为基础。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106225.title: On Preference for Simplicity and Probability Weighting
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106225.title_zh: 关于简单偏好与概率加权

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106226.abstract: We analyze how public asset purchases affect liquidity, risk sharing and intertemporal smoothing in imperfectly competitive financial markets. Even “neutral” policies, such as budget-balanced trades of risk-free debt, affect liquidity and trading efficiency. Public debt purchases worsen liquidity and risk sharing by increasing price impact, while debt sales improve risk sharing but distort intertemporal trade. “Expansionary” quantitative easing policies can thus reduce trading efficiency. We also derive quantity-based trading rules for optimal public portfolio management. These call for policy to equalize weighted measures of public and private price impact.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106226.abstract_zh: 我们分析了在非完全竞争金融市场中，公共资产购买如何影响流动性、风险分担及跨期平滑。即便是“中性”政策，如预算平衡的无风险债务交易，也会影响流动性和交易效率。公共债务购买通过增加价格冲击效应而恶化流动性和风险分担，而债务出售虽能改善风险分担，却扭曲了跨期交易。因此，“扩张性”量化宽松政策可能降低交易效率。我们还推导了基于数量的最优公共投资组合管理交易规则，这些规则要求政策应使公共与私人价格冲击的加权度量相等。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106226.title: Government Trading and Efficiency in Imperfectly Competitive Financial Markets
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106226.title_zh: 不完全竞争金融市场中的政府交易与效率

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106227.abstract: We adapt the methods from Abreu, Pearce and Stacchetti (1990) to finitely repeated games with imperfect public monitoring. Under a combination of (a slight strengthening of) the assumptions of Benôıt and Krishna (1985) and those of Fudenberg, Levine and Maskin (1994), a folk theorem follows.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106227.abstract_zh: 我们将Abreu、Pearce和Stacchetti（1990）的方法应用于具有不完全公共监督的有限重复博弈。在Benôıt和Krishna（1985）的假设（经轻微强化）与Fudenberg、Levine和Maskin（1994）的假设相结合的条件下，可得一个民间定理。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106227.title: A folk theorem for finitely repeated games with public monitoring
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106227.title_zh: 公共监督下有限重复博弈的民间定理

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106228.abstract: A literature debates the explanations for the cyclical properties of emerging markets using either trend shocks Aguiar and Gopinath (2007) or financial frictions Garcia-Cicco et al. (2010); Neumeyer and Perri (2004). We state a formal proposition that makes explicit the parametric assumptions needed for consumption to behave (exactly) as in a random-walk, permanent income model. The result is general and applies to economies with endogenous investment and production. The proposition offers a fresh perspective on the debate regarding the sources of emerging market fluctuations, and reconciles diverging findings in the literature. Moreover, we quantitatively explore the business cycle properties of the RBC model when one moves away from the parametric assumptions suggested by the proposition.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106228.abstract_zh: 关于新兴市场周期属性的解释，文献中存在两种观点：一种强调趋势冲击（Aguiar和Gopinath，2007），另一种则侧重于金融摩擦（Garcia-Cicco等，2010；Neumeyer和Perri，2004）。我们提出一个正式命题，明确阐述了使消费行为（精确地）符合随机游走、永久收入模型所需的参数假设。该结果具有普遍性，适用于包含内生投资和生产的经济体。这一命题为关于新兴市场波动来源的辩论提供了新视角，并调和了文献中的分歧发现。此外，我们定量探讨了当偏离命题所建议的参数假设时，RBC模型的商业周期特性。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106228.title: When Is the Trend the Cycle?

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106229.abstract: We provide an axiomatic characterization of the segregation order represented by the Isolation index, which is increasingly used by economists to measure segregation and related concepts. We extend this result to a broad family of segregation orders that includes the Atkinson and Entropy orders.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106229.abstract_zh: 我们给出了由隔离指数所代表的隔离顺序的公理化特征，该指数日益被经济学家用于衡量隔离及相关概念。我们将此结果推广至一个广泛的隔离顺序家族，其中包括阿特金森顺序和熵顺序。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106229.title: The Isolation index and variations on relative exposure
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106229.title_zh: 隔离指数及其相对暴露度的变体

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106230.abstract: The student-optimal stable mechanism (DA), the most popular mechanism in school choice, is the only one that is stable and strategy-proof. However, when DA is implemented, a student can change the schools of others without changing her own. We show that this drawback is limited: a student cannot change her schoolmates while remaining at the same school. We refer to this new property as local non-bossiness and use it to provide a new characterization of DA that does not rely on stability. Furthermore, we show that local non-bossiness plays a crucial role in providing incentives to be truthful when students have preferences over their colleagues. As long as students have school-lexicographic preferences over colleagues—meaning that they first consider the school to which they are assigned and then their schoolmates—DA induces the only stable and strategy-proof mechanism. There is limited room to expand this preference domain without compromising the existence of a stable and strategy-proof mechanism.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106230.abstract_zh: 学生最优稳定机制（DA）是学校选择中最常用的机制，也是唯一既稳定又防策略的机制。然而，在实施DA时，学生可以在不改变自身分配的情况下改变他人的学校分配。我们证明这一缺陷是有限的：学生无法在留在同一所学校的同时改变其同学。我们将这一新性质称为局部非专断性，并利用它提供了DA的一个不依赖稳定性的新特征刻画。此外，我们表明，当学生对同事有偏好时，局部非专断性在提供真实报告激励方面起着关键作用。只要学生对同事具有学校字典序偏好——即他们首先考虑被分配的学校，然后考虑同学——DA就能诱导出唯一稳定且防策略的机制。在不牺牲稳定且防策略机制存在性的前提下，扩展这一偏好域的空间十分有限。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106230.title: local non-bossiness

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106231.abstract: In finite problems comprising objects, cases, and an object- and case-contingent payoff function, we study the comparative statics of the set of undominated objects, meaning those for which there exists no mixture over objects that is superior in every case. We consider both weak and strict dominance (corresponding to different degrees of ‘strictness’ in the definition of superiority). Our main theorem characterises those payoff transformations which robustly expand the not-weakly-dominated and not-strictly-dominated sets: the necessary and sufficient condition is that payoffs be transformed separately across cases, in either a monotone–concave or a constant manner. We apply our results to Pareto frontiers and games.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106231.abstract_zh: 在由对象、情形及依赖于对象与情形的收益函数构成的有限问题中，我们研究了无支配对象集合的比较静态性质，即那些不存在任何在每种情形下均更优的对象混合的对象。我们同时考虑了弱支配与严格支配（对应于“更优”定义中不同程度的“严格性”）。我们的主要定理刻画了那些能够稳健地扩展非弱支配集合与非严格支配集合的收益变换：其必要且充分条件是，收益需按情形分别进行变换，且变换方式要么是单调凹的，要么是恒定的。我们将结果应用于帕累托前沿与博弈中。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106231.title: The comparative statics of dominance
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106231.title_zh: 支配地位的比较静态分析

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106232.abstract: This study extends Blackwell (1953) comparison of information to a sequential social learning model in which agents make decisions sequentially based on both private signals and observed actions of others.
