In this context, we introduce a binary relation over information structures: an information structure is more socially valuable than another if it yields higher expected payoffs for all agents, regardless of their preferences and equilibrium realizations. First, we establish that this binary relation is strictly stronger than the Blackwell order. Next, we provide a necessary and sufficient condition for our binary relation and propose a simpler sufficient condition that is easier to verify. We further explore comparisons of information structures in terms of long-run payoffs, limit welfare, and canonical binary environments.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106232.abstract_zh: 本研究将Blackwell（1953）的信息比较扩展至序贯社会学习模型，在该模型中，代理人基于私人信号及观察到的他人行为依次做出决策。在此背景下，我们引入了一种关于信息结构的二元关系：若一种信息结构对所有代理人而言，无论其偏好及均衡实现如何，均能产生更高的预期收益，则称其比另一种更具社会价值。首先，我们确立该二元关系严格强于Blackwell序。其次，我们给出该二元关系的充要条件，并提出一个更易验证的简化充分条件。我们进一步探讨了信息结构在长期收益、极限福利及典型二元环境中的比较。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106232.title: Value of Information in Social Learning
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106232.title_zh: 社会学习中信息的价值

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106233.abstract: This paper studies a multi-trait cultural transmission model with social interactions. The resulting cultural dynamic is equivalent to an evolutionary dynamic on a population game that combines social payoffs and cultural biases. This transformation allows us to apply tools from evolutionary game theory to examine cultural homogeneity and heterogeneity. We show that when social interactions have a coordination nature, cultural biases can push the cultural dynamic toward selecting a culturally homogeneous equilibrium that is efficient for those interactions. In contrast, when interactions have an anti-coordination nature, cultural biases usually drive the dynamic toward a culturally heterogeneous state that differs from the efficient equilibrium.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106233.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个包含社会互动的多特征文化传播模型。由此产生的文化动态等价于一个结合了社会收益与文化偏好的种群博弈上的演化动态。这一转换使我们能够运用演化博弈论的工具来考察文化的同质性与异质性。我们表明，当社会互动具有协调性质时，文化偏好能推动文化动态趋向于选择对这些互动而言高效的文化同质均衡。相反，当互动具有反协调性质时，文化偏好通常驱使动态走向一个不同于高效均衡的文化异质状态。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106233.title: Intergenerational Cultural Transmission with Social Interactions as An Evolutionary Game
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106233.title_zh: 代际文化传递与社会互动的演化博弈分析

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106234.abstract: Consider a population of agents who repeatedly compete for awards, as in the case of researchers annually applying for grants. Noise in the selection process may encourage entry of low-quality proposals, forcing the principal to commit large resources to reviewing applications and further increasing award misallocation. A temporary exclusion policy prohibits an agent from applying in the current period if they received a low evaluation in the previous. We study the steady-state equilibria under various policies of this type. With exclusion, agents that have low-quality applications self-select to stay out, which reduces the volume of submissions and mitigates award misallocation. At the same time, the volume of high-quality applications is also reduced due to the ineligibility of banned agents. We also show that exclusion has a distributional effect, where higher-ability agents exhibit more self-selection.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106234.abstract_zh: 考虑一群代理人反复竞争奖项的情形，例如研究人员每年申请资助的情况。评选过程中的噪音可能鼓励低质量提案的进入，迫使委托方投入大量资源审查申请，并进一步加剧奖项分配不当。一项临时排除政策规定，若代理人在上一期获得低评价，则禁止其在本期申请。我们研究了此类政策下各种情形的稳态均衡。在排除政策下，拥有低质量申请的代理人会选择自行退出，从而减少提交量并缓解奖项分配不当。同时，由于被禁止代理人的资格受限，高质量申请的数量也会减少。我们还表明，排除政策具有分配效应，其中能力较高的代理人表现出更多的自我选择行为。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106234.title: Temporary exclusion in repeated contests
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106234.title_zh: 重复竞赛中的临时排除

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106244.abstract: We develop a verification theorem for infinite-horizon optimal stopping under G-Brownian motion and apply it to several stopping problems of economic interest. The theorem gives sufficient conditions under which a candidate solution to a system of variational inequalities is the value function under volatility, covariance, or joint drift–volatility ambiguity. In the canonical irreversible investment problem, volatility ambiguity advances investment because the worst-case scenario selects the lowest feasible volatility for a convex continuation value. Ambiguity about volatility therefore acts in the opposite direction from volatility itself, which postpones investment. In other environments, worst-case volatility can vary with the state, alter project relevance, create bilateral valuation wedges, shorten search, and change two-dimensional investment payoffs through covariance and correlation ambiguity. A common convexity-based mechanism drives these results: volatility ambiguity changes the perceived dispersion of future outcomes, whereas drift ambiguity acts through monotonicity.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106244.abstract_zh: 我们针对G-布朗运动下的无限期最优停止问题建立了一个验证定理，并将其应用于若干具有经济意义的最优停止问题。该定理给出了充分条件，在这些条件下，变分不等式系统的候选解在波动率、协方差或联合漂移-波动率模糊性下即为价值函数。在经典不可逆投资问题中，波动率模糊性会提前投资，因为最坏情形选择对于凸的延续价值而言对应最低可行波动率。因此，关于波动率的模糊性其作用方向与波动率本身相反——后者会推迟投资。在其他环境中，最坏情形波动率可能随状态变化，改变项目的相关性，产生双边估值楔子，缩短搜寻时间，并通过协方差和相关性模糊性改变二维投资回报。一个基于凸性的共同机制驱动了这些结果：波动率模糊性改变了未来结果的感知离散度，而漂移模糊性则通过单调性发挥作用。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106244.title: Optimal Stopping under Volatility Ambiguity
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106244.title_zh: 波动率模糊下的最优停止

10.1016/j.jet.2026.106250.abstract: This paper studies the large market implications of impersonal wage competition. There are finitely many categories of firms and workers, and firms compete for workers by offering uniform wages. We first characterize the unique mixed strategy Nash equilibrium of large replica economies with supermodular preferences. Competition is local: firms only compete with others like themselves, either within the same category or one category above. As the market size grows, the equilibrium converges rapidly to the firm-optimal competitive equilibrium. For general preferences, Nash equilibria converge to competitive equilibria as the market becomes arbitrarily large. We identify a condition on preferences which ensures that the limiting equilibria differ from the firm-optimal competitive equilibrium. Our analysis highlights how the interaction between preference structure and pricing flexibility governs whether uniform wage posting leads to suppressed or inflated wages in large markets.
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106250.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非人格化工资竞争在大市场中的含义。存在有限类别的企业和工人，企业通过提供统一工资来竞争工人。我们首先刻画了具有超模偏好的大型复制经济中唯一的混合策略纳什均衡。竞争是局部性的：企业仅与同类企业竞争，要么在同一类别内，要么在上一类别中。随着市场规模的增长，均衡迅速收敛至企业最优竞争均衡。对于一般偏好，当市场变得任意大时，纳什均衡收敛至竞争均衡。我们识别了一个关于偏好的条件，该条件确保极限均衡不同于企业最优竞争均衡。我们的分析强调了偏好结构与定价灵活性之间的相互作用如何决定统一工资报价在大市场中导致工资被抑制还是膨胀。
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106250.title: Matching and Price Competition in Large Markets
10.1016/j.jet.2026.106250.title_zh: 大规模市场中的匹配与价格竞争

10.1016/j.jfi.2026.101232.abstract: In many countries, small businesses rely on loans backed by personal guarantees from company managers, making managers personally liable for loan repayment if the business fails. Such guarantees may discourage managerial risk-taking by increasing the personal costs of failure. Exploiting a Japanese policy reform aimed at reducing the use of personal guarantees by encouraging monitoring-based loans, this paper examines which firms opt out of personal guarantees and choose monitoring-based loans, and how these loan arrangements are associated with firm risk-taking and performance. We find that: (1) monitoring-based loans carry higher interest rates; (2) firms with stronger credit ratings and lower managerial ownership are more likely to choose monitoring-based loans; and (3) after accounting for positive borrower selection, firms using monitoring-based loans exhibit greater risk-taking, reflected in a higher likelihood of default but stronger growth conditional on survival. Without controlling for selection through managerial ownership and credit ratings, firms borrowing through monitoring-based loans exhibit both lower default probabilities and even higher growth, indicating substantial positive self-selection into opting out of personal guarantees. Overall, the results suggest that allowing borrowers to choose between loans with and without personal guarantees facilitates positive selection into monitoring-based lending and may promote performance-enhancing risk-taking among SMEs.
10.1016/j.jfi.2026.101232.abstract_zh: 在许多国家，小企业依赖由公司经理个人担保支持的贷款，若企业失败，经理需对贷款偿还承担个人责任。此类担保可能因增加失败的个人成本而抑制经理的风险承担行为。本文利用日本旨在通过鼓励基于监控的贷款以减少个人担保使用的政策改革，考察哪些企业选择退出个人担保并选用监控型贷款，以及这些贷款安排如何与企业风险承担和绩效相关联。研究发现：（1）监控型贷款利率较高；（2）信用评级较强且管理层持股比例较低的企业更倾向于选择监控型贷款；（3）在考虑借款人正向选择效应后，使用监控型贷款的企业展现出更大的风险承担，表现为违约可能性更高，但在存活条件下增长更为强劲。若未通过管理层持股和信用评级控制选择效应，通过监控型贷款借款的企业则表现出较低的违约概率及更高的增长，表明在退出个人担保方面存在显著的正向自我选择。总体而言，研究结果表明，允许借款人在有无个人担保的贷款之间进行选择，有助于促进监控型贷款中的正向选择，并可能推动中小企业中提升绩效的风险承担行为。
10.1016/j.jfi.2026.101232.title: Who opts out of personal guarantees? Borrower selection and performance in small business lending
10.1016/j.jfi.2026.101232.title_zh: 谁选择退出个人担保？小企业贷款中的借款人选择与绩效

10.1016/j.jfi.2026.101233.abstract: We investigate the theoretical mechanisms through which labor turnover adversely affects bank risk and performance. Using monthly matched employer-employee data from Brazil during 2003-2019, we find banks with higher labor turnover show lower risk buffers, greater loan losses, higher loan growth, and lower profitability. These adverse effects align with the firm-specific human capital theory. Consistent with our identifying assumptions, the effects are stronger when turnover reduces experience and expertise, among loan officers, as well as across cities and banks. Placebo tests and further analyses confirm our results. The evidence suggests that high labor turnover impairs bank information production, increasing risk and lowering performance.
10.1016/j.jfi.2026.101233.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了劳动力流动对银行风险与绩效产生不利影响的理论机制。利用2003-2019年间巴西月度匹配的雇主-雇员数据，我们发现劳动力流动率较高的银行表现出较低的风险缓冲、更大的贷款损失、更高的贷款增长以及较低的盈利能力。这些不利影响与公司特定人力资本理论相符。与我们的识别假设一致，当流动减少经验与专业知识时，在信贷员群体中，以及跨城市和银行间，这些效应更为显著。安慰剂检验及进一步分析证实了我们的结果。证据表明，高劳动力流动损害了银行的信息生产能力，从而增加了风险并降低了绩效。

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104241.abstract: ETF market makers can satisfy excess demand in secondary markets by selling shares that are not yet created. While this ability to “operationally short” is not unique to ETFs, it plays a central role in ETF liquidity provision. We propose and validate a novel “operational shorting” measure. In addition to constituting a majority of ETF short interest, it is associated with higher retail trading activity and short-term return reversals, consistent with liquidity-supplying motives. Accounting for operational shorting is important in examining ETF returns, mispricing, and the asset-pricing implications of ETF trading on underlying securities.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104241.abstract_zh: ETF做市商可以通过出售尚未创建的份额来满足二级市场的超额需求。尽管这种“操作性做空”的能力并非ETF独有，但它在ETF流动性提供中扮演着核心角色。我们提出并验证了一种新颖的“操作性做空”度量指标。除了构成ETF空头持仓的大部分外，该指标还与更高的散户交易活动和短期收益反转相关，这与流动性供给动机一致。在考察ETF收益、错误定价以及ETF交易对标的证券的资产定价影响时，考虑操作性做空至关重要。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104241.title: Operational shorting and ETF liquidity provision
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104241.title_zh: 运营做空与ETF流动性提供

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104255.abstract: We surveyed all Chinese public firms in 2019 and 2022 to examine the real effects of financial markets. Over 90% of firms say they actively monitor the stock market, and the most common reasons they provide are that they learn new information from the price and that they depend on the price for financing. Focusing on the learning channel, we examine how the responses relate to firm characteristics and actions. Firms that indicate learning have characteristics that suggest greater benefit from market information. They also exhibit higher investment-to-price sensitivity. We provide results on what dimensions of information firms learn about.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104255.abstract_zh: 我们于2019年和2022年调查了所有中国上市公司，以考察金融市场的实际效应。超过90%的企业表示积极关注股票市场，其最常提及的原因是，它们从价格中获取新信息，并依赖价格进行融资。聚焦于学习渠道，我们考察了这些回应如何与企业特征及行为相关联。表明存在学习行为的企业，其特征显示出从市场信息中获益更大。它们还表现出更高的投资-价格敏感性。我们提供了关于企业学习信息维度的结果。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104255.title: Market feedback: Evidence from the horse’s mouth
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104255.title_zh: 市场反馈：来自马嘴的证据

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104273.abstract: This paper examines how sustainable investing affects the governance role of financial markets. We show that stronger concerns about externalities among informed investors can reduce price informativeness about managerial effort to improve financial performance, increasing the cost of incentive provision. This mechanism creates an inherent link between firms’ environmental and social (ES) and governance quality. We show that the agency costs of sustainable investing can have real effects on ES outcomes when firms can change their externalities.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104273.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了可持续投资如何影响金融市场的治理作用。我们证明，知情投资者对外部性问题的更强关注可能会降低关于管理层提升财务绩效努力的股价信息含量，从而增加激励提供的成本。这一机制在企业环境与社会（ES）表现与治理质量之间建立了内在联系。我们进一步表明，当企业能够调整其外部性时，可持续投资的代理成本可能对ES结果产生实质性影响。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104273.title: Sustainable investing and market governance
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104273.title_zh: 可持续投资与市场治理

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104274.abstract: This paper introduces a Peer Index (PI) constructed from economically motivated peer networks that summarizes (i) the strength of a firm’s peers and (ii) the firm’s position within its peer group. PI predicts stock returns and earnings surprises over short and long horizons. Machine-learning models based solely on firm-level characteristics do not subsume PI’s predictive power, supporting the interpretation that it captures genuine cross-stock information. Lag-augmented local projections show that positive PI innovations are followed by higher next-month returns that gradually decay without reversal, consistent with slow diffusion of peer information into prices.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104274.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个基于经济动机驱动的同行网络“同行指数”（Peer Index, PI），该指数综合反映了（i）企业同行的实力强度及（ii）企业在同行群体中的地位。PI能够预测股票回报及盈利惊喜，在短期和长期时间跨度内均有效。仅基于企业层面特征的机器学习模型无法涵盖PI的预测能力，这支持了其捕捉真实跨股票信息的解释。通过滞后增强的局部投影分析显示，正向的PI创新会带来下月回报的提升，随后逐渐衰减且无逆转现象，这与同行信息缓慢融入价格的过程相一致。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104274.title: Dual peer effects and cross-stock predictability
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104274.title_zh: 双重同伴效应与跨股票可预测性

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104275.abstract: Pandemic fraud is geographically concentrated and stimulated local purchases, with effects on prices. Recipients of fraudulent Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) funds significantly increased their home purchasing rate compared to recipients of non-fraudulent PPP funds, and house prices in high-fraud ZIP codes increased 5.8 percentage points more than in low-fraud ZIP codes within the same county. In a horse race, pandemic fraud is one of the largest and most robust factors explaining house price appreciation during COVID. ZIP codes with fraud also experienced heightened vehicle purchases and other consumer spending in 2020-21, with a return to normal in 2022.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104275.abstract_zh: 疫情欺诈在地理上呈现集中分布，并刺激了当地购买行为，进而对价格产生影响。与获得非欺诈性薪资保护计划（PPP）资金的受助者相比，欺诈性PPP资金的受助者购房率显著提高，且在同一县内，欺诈高发邮政编码区的房价涨幅比低发区高出5.8个百分点。在竞争性检验中，疫情欺诈是解释新冠期间房价上涨的最大且最稳健的因素之一。欺诈高发邮政编码区在2020-21年间还经历了车辆购买及其他消费支出的增加，而到2022年则回归常态。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104275.title: Did pandemic relief fraud inflate house prices?
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104275.title_zh: 疫情救济欺诈是否推高了房价？

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104276.abstract: This paper studies the interaction between process and product innovations and their distinct role in firm growth dynamics. We differentiate empirically and theoretically two types of process innovations: foundational processes that advance production technology and cost-reducing processes that enhance existing production efficiency. We develop an innovation model of product varieties with quality heterogeneity to illustrate how these innovations impact firm growth differently and highlight how process innovation induces product innovation. By analyzing millions of patent texts from 1900 to 2020, we classify innovations into product, cost-reducing process, and foundational process innovations. We find that foundational processes lead to sustained firm growth, especially through their effect on subsequent product creation. R&D-intensive firms focused on “deep-tech” innovations have an advantage in creating foundational processes, resulting in superior product quality. Using patents linked to FDA-approved drugs, we show that firms with a comparative advantage in creating foundational processes, due to greater knowledge and technological stock, tend to produce higher-value products.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104276.abstract_zh: 本文研究了过程创新与产品创新之间的相互作用及其在企业成长动态中的不同作用。我们在实证和理论上区分了两种类型的过程创新：推进生产技术的奠基性过程创新和提升现有生产效率的成本降低型过程创新。我们构建了一个具有质量异质性的产品种类创新模型，以阐明这些创新如何对企业成长产生不同影响，并突出过程创新如何诱发产品创新。通过分析1900年至2020年间数百万份专利文本，我们将创新分类为产品创新、成本降低型过程创新和奠基性过程创新。我们发现，奠基性过程创新能够带来持续的企业成长，尤其是通过其对后续产品创造的影响。专注于“深科技”创新的研发密集型企业，在创造奠基性过程创新方面具有优势，从而带来更优的产品质量。利用与FDA批准药物相关联的专利，我们表明，由于拥有更丰富的知识和技术储备，在创造奠基性过程创新方面具有比较优势的企业，往往能生产出更高价值的产品。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104276.title: Foundational processes and growth

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104277.abstract: This paper investigates how cashless payment affects credit access for underserved populations using data from Alipay, a leading Chinese BigTech platform with over 1 billion users that offers a wide range of financial services. By exploiting the staggered rollout of Alipay-bundled shared bikes across cities as a natural experiment and analyzing a representative Alipay user sample, I find that cashless payment adoption increases credit access by 56.3% and that a 1% rise in payment flow increases credit lines by 0.41%. These effects are stronger for less educated and older individuals, who have traditionally faced greater barriers to accessing financial services.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104277.abstract_zh: 本文利用中国领先的BigTech平台——支付宝（拥有超过10亿用户，提供广泛金融服务）的数据，探讨无现金支付如何影响弱势群体的信贷获取。通过将支付宝捆绑共享单车在各城市的逐步推广作为自然实验，并分析具有代表性的支付宝用户样本，我发现无现金支付的采纳使信贷获取增加了56.3%，且支付流量每增加1%，信贷额度相应提高0.41%。这些效应在受教育程度较低及年龄较大的个体中更为显著，而这一群体历来在获取金融服务方面面临更大障碍。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104277.title: Cashless payment and financial inclusion
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104277.title_zh: 无现金支付与金融包容性

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104278.abstract: Confounding events can cause false positives when testing the relationship between short-term returns around a quasi-experimental event and firm characteristics. We show that this risk is severe in practice — return-characteristic relationships are often statistically significant at the 1% level on over 30% of all trading days. Benchmarking a relationship against the distribution of the same relationship on pre-event days is effective at addressing the problem. We introduce a novel GLS variation of this approach that achieves large gains in statistical power relative to OLS and provide Stata and Python modules that implement both procedures.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104278.abstract_zh: 混淆事件在检验准实验事件前后短期收益与企业特征之间的关系时，可能导致假阳性结果。我们表明，这一风险在实践中十分严重——在超过30%的所有交易日中，收益与特征之间的关系通常在1%显著性水平上具有统计显著性。将某一关系与事件前日期的同一关系分布进行基准比较，能有效解决此问题。我们引入了一种新颖的GLS变体方法，相较于OLS，在统计功效上实现了大幅提升，并提供Stata和Python模块以实施这两种程序。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104278.title: Past is prologue: Inference from the cross section of returns around an event
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104278.title_zh: 过去即是序幕：事件前后横截面收益的推断

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104279.abstract: This study examines the effect of Department of Justice lawsuits in the 2010s against large lenders for alleged fraud in the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) mortgage insurance program. The suits led to over $5 billion in settlements and caused targeted banks and their peers to precipitously exit the FHA market. Difference-in-differences and triple-differences tests exploiting geographic variation in exposure to exiting banks show an 18% reduction in FHA lending in heavily exposed areas. This reduction was not associated with improved underwriting standards or lower default rates. Large banks’ FHA exit has significantly reduced low-income households’ overall access to mortgage credit.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104279.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了2010年代美国司法部针对大型贷款机构在联邦住房管理局（FHA）抵押贷款保险项目中涉嫌欺诈提起的诉讼所产生的影响。这些诉讼导致了超过50亿美元的和解金，并促使目标银行及其同行迅速退出FHA市场。利用暴露于退出银行的地理差异进行的双重差分和三重差分检验显示，在高度暴露地区，FHA贷款减少了18%。这一减少并未与承保标准的改善或违约率的下降相关联。大型银行退出FHA市场显著降低了低收入家庭整体获得抵押贷款信贷的机会。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104279.title: Government litigation risk and the decline in low-income mortgage lending
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104279.title_zh: 政府诉讼风险与低收入群体抵押贷款发放的减少

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104280.abstract: This paper examines the causal role of face-to-face (F2F) interactions in generating local informational advantages for mutual fund managers. Using COVID-19 lockdowns as an exogenous shock, I show that fund managers’ performance on local stocks declined relative to distant stocks when in-person meetings were curtailed, driven by impaired investment timing rather than changes in firm fundamentals. I investigate two distinct benefits of F2F interactions arising from interpersonal cues: trust-building, which enhances the transmission of soft information, and impression management, which facilitates the transmission of favorable information. The results cannot be fully explained by changes in internal information flows or the use of public information, and are more pronounced for stocks in less transparent information environments and in regions with stronger social traits.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104280.abstract_zh: 本文考察了面对面（F2F）互动在共同基金经理获取本地信息优势中的因果作用。利用COVID-19封锁作为外生冲击，我发现当面对面会议受限时，基金经理在本地股票上的表现相对于远程股票有所下降，这一现象源于投资时机判断受损，而非公司基本面变化。我探究了面对面互动中人际线索带来的两个不同益处：信任构建，它增强了软信息的传递；以及印象管理，它促进了有利信息的传递。这些结果无法完全由内部信息流变化或公共信息使用来解释，并且在信息环境透明度较低及社会特征较强的地区更为显著。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104280.title: Face-to-face social interactions and local informational advantage
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104280.title_zh: 面对面社交互动与本地信息优势

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104281.abstract: When a technology becomes the new standard, the firms that are leaders in producing this technology gain a competitive advantage. Matching the semantic content of patents to standard documents, we show that firms closer to the new technology standard increase their market share and sales. In addition, if they operate in a competitive market, these firms also increase their R&D expenditure. Yet, these effects are temporary since standardization creates a common technological basis for everyone, which allows followers to catch up and the economy to grow.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104281.abstract_zh: 当一项技术成为新标准时，生产该技术的领先企业将获得竞争优势。通过将专利的语义内容与标准文件相匹配，我们发现更接近新技术标准的企业市场份额和销售额有所增加。此外，若这些企业处于竞争性市场中，它们还会增加研发支出。然而，这些效应是暂时的，因为标准化为所有参与者建立了共同的技术基础，使追随者得以追赶，并推动经济增长。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104281.title: Patents that match your standards: Firm-level evidence on competition, innovation and growth
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104281.title_zh: 符合标准的专利：关于竞争、创新与增长的企业层面证据

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104282.abstract: To enforce insider trading laws, financial regulators require top executives to make their own-company trades public. One implication of this regulatory focus is that executives below the top fly under the radar. We use administrative register data from Norway to examine whether executives below the top in listed companies earn abnormal returns on purchases in own-company stock. We find evidence of abnormal returns on such trades, about 50 to 100 basis points at the 1-month horizon. The abnormal returns on purchases in other stocks are negative, making high investor ability an unlikely explanation.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104282.abstract_zh: 为执行内幕交易法规，金融监管机构要求高层管理人员公开其对本公司股票的交易。这一监管重点的一个隐含结果是，高层以下的管理人员得以规避监管。我们利用挪威的行政登记数据，考察上市公司中非高层管理人员在购买本公司股票时是否获得异常回报。研究发现，此类交易存在异常回报的证据，在1个月的时间跨度内约为50至100个基点。而购买其他股票的异常回报为负，这使得高投资者能力成为不太可能的解释。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104282.title: Flying below the radar: Insider trading by executives below the top
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104282.title_zh: 低空飞行：高管以下层级的内幕交易

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104283.abstract: We study the rationale behind firms’ investment in risky financial assets by formulating and estimating a dynamic model in which firms allocate their precautionary savings to both safe and risky securities. In equilibrium, risky financial asset holdings are positively related to the sensitivity of a firm’s financing deficit to the risky asset returns—the “financing deficit beta”. Using a comprehensive sample of US corporate financial asset holdings, we find evidence of a positive correlation between risky financial asset holdings and financing deficit betas that capture firms’ incentives to hedge interest-rate risk. Precautionary motives are stronger in small, high-volatility, and R&D-intensive firms.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104283.abstract_zh: 我们通过构建并估计一个动态模型来探讨企业投资于风险金融资产的动因，在该模型中，企业将预防性储蓄配置于安全与风险证券。均衡状态下，风险金融资产持有量与企业的融资缺口对风险资产收益的敏感性——即“融资缺口贝塔”——呈正相关。基于美国企业金融资产持有的全面样本，我们发现风险金融资产持有量与反映企业对冲利率风险激励的融资缺口贝塔之间存在正相关关系。预防性动机在小规模、高波动性及研发密集型企业中更为显著。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104283.title: Bonding with risk: Corporate investment and savings in risky financial assets
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104283.title_zh: 风险共担：企业风险金融资产投资与储蓄

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104290.abstract: Self-imposed risk limits effectively limit dealers' appetite for risks and their capacity to intermediate in Treasury markets in times of market stress. Using granular and high frequency regulatory data on US dealers' Treasury securities trading desk positions and desk-level Value-at-Risk limits, we show that dealers are more inclined to reduce their positions as they get closer to their internal risk limit, consistent with such limit being meaningful and costly for traders to breach. Dealers actively manage their inventories away from their limits by selling longer-term securities and requiring higher compensation to take on additional risks. During the height of the Covid-crisis in 2020, dealer desks that were closer to their VaR limits sold more Treasury securities to the Fed and accepted lower prices in the emergency open market operations. Our findings complement studies that link post-GFC bank regulations to market liquidity by showing that self-imposed risk limits can explain the risk-averse behavior by dealers, and provide a micro-foundation for the link between market volatility and market liquidity in dealer-intermediated OTC markets. In times of crisis, policy prescriptions such as deregulation alone may not be sufficient to induce risk-taking by dealer intermediaries. Moreover, to address market functioning issues, policy actions that address the funding costs of intermediaries would not be as effective as policies that remove risks from intermediary balance sheets directly.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104290.abstract_zh: 自我设定的风险限额在市场压力时期有效限制了交易商的风险偏好及其在国债市场中的中介能力。利用美国交易商国债证券交易台头寸及台级风险价值限额的细粒度、高频监管数据，我们表明交易商在接近其内部风险限额时更倾向于减少头寸，这与该限额具有实质性意义且对交易商而言违反成本高昂相一致。交易商通过出售较长期限证券并要求更高的补偿来承担额外风险，积极管理其库存远离限额。在2020年新冠疫情危机高峰期，更接近其风险价值限额的交易台在紧急公开市场操作中向美联储出售了更多国债，并接受了较低的价格。我们的发现补充了将后全球金融危机银行监管与市场流动性联系起来的研究，表明自我设定的风险限额可以解释交易商的风险规避行为，并为交易商中介的场外市场中市场波动性与市场流动性之间的联系提供了微观基础。在危机时期，仅靠放松监管等政策处方可能不足以诱导交易商中介承担风险。此外，为解决市场功能问题，针对中介融资成本的政策行动不如直接从中介资产负债表上移除风险的政策有效。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104290.title: Risk-averse dealers in a risk-free market—The role of trading desk risk limits
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104290.title_zh: 风险中性市场中的风险规避交易商——交易台风险限额的作用

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104291.abstract: We test whether forecast bias affects household stock trading by combining measures of bias elicited in laboratory experiments with administrative trade-level data. On average, subjects exhibit positive forecast bias (i.e., extrapolators), while a large minority exhibit negative forecast bias (i.e., contrarians). Forecast bias is positively associated with past excess returns of stocks that are purchased: Extrapolators (contrarians) purchase past winners (losers). Forecast bias is negatively associated with the capital gains of stocks that are sold. Furthermore, forecast bias explains investor heterogeneity in the relation between market returns and net flows to stocks. Overall, our study provides evidence of a common mechanism – forecast bias – that links past returns to trading decisions for purchases, sales, and net flows.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104291.abstract_zh: 我们通过将实验室实验中引发的偏差度量与行政级别的交易数据相结合，检验预测偏差是否影响家庭股票交易。平均而言，受试者表现出正向预测偏差（即外推者），而相当一部分少数群体表现出负向预测偏差（即反向投资者）。预测偏差与所购股票过去的超额收益正相关：外推者（反向投资者）购买过去的赢家（输家）。预测偏差与所售股票的资本利得负相关。此外，预测偏差解释了投资者在市场回报与股票净流入之间关系上的异质性。总体而言，我们的研究提供了证据表明存在一种共同机制——预测偏差——它将过去的回报与购买、出售及净流入的交易决策联系起来。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104291.title: Extrapolators and contrarians: Forecast bias and individual investor stock trading
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104291.title_zh: 外推者与反向投资者：预测偏差与个人投资者股票交易

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104292.abstract: This study investigates how financial literacy shapes the propensity of individuals to commit financial crime. Using state-level administrative data on criminal charges linked to comprehensive public records , we exploit a policy-based discontinuity in grade level assignment based on individual birth dates that exogenously requires certain high school cohorts to attend a financial literacy course. Our estimates suggest that exposure to the course reduces the propensity to commit financial crime by 37%. The reduction is driven by declines in embezzlement and is stronger for low-income individuals. Additional evidence suggests that the reductions are primarily explained by improvements in household balance sheets.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104292.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了金融素养如何影响个体实施金融犯罪的倾向。利用与全面公共记录相关联的州级刑事指控行政数据，我们基于个体出生日期所导致的年级分配政策不连续性，外生地要求某些高中群体参加金融素养课程。估计结果显示，接触该课程使实施金融犯罪的倾向降低了37%。这一减少主要由贪污行为的下降驱动，且对低收入个体影响更为显著。进一步证据表明，这些减少主要归因于家庭资产负债表的改善。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104292.title: Financial literacy and financial crime: A regression discontinuity approach
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104292.title_zh: 金融素养与金融犯罪：基于断点回归方法的研究

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104293.abstract: Can governments use real bonds such as Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) to tame inflation? We propose a novel framework of optimal debt management with sticky prices and a government issuing nominal and real state-uncontingent bonds. A government debt portfolio with both nominal and real bonds helps completing markets unless the monetary policy stance renders them perfect substitutes. Under Full Commitment, the government borrows with nominal debt and accumulates real assets, to be able to use inflation to smooth taxes. With No Commitment, the government portfolio favors real bonds to strategically prevent future governments from monetizing debt ex-post. Quantitatively, our model with No Commitment is consistent with the small and persistent TIPS share in U.S. data. A higher TIPS share mitigates the commitment friction, and effectively curbs inflation.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104293.abstract_zh: 政府能否利用实际债券（如通货膨胀保值国债，TIPS）来抑制通胀？我们提出一个新颖的最优债务管理框架，其中包含价格粘性，且政府发行名义和实际的无状态或有债券。包含名义与实际债券的政府债务组合有助于完善市场，除非货币政策立场使它们成为完全替代品。在完全承诺下，政府通过名义债务借款并积累实际资产，以便利用通胀来平滑税收。在无承诺情况下，政府组合倾向于实际债券，以策略性地防止未来政府事后将债务货币化。定量分析显示，我们的无承诺模型与美国数据中小而持久的TIPS份额相符。更高的TIPS份额缓解了承诺摩擦，并有效遏制了通胀。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104293.title: Government debt management and inflation with real and nominal bonds
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104293.title_zh: 实际与名义债券下的政府债务管理与通货膨胀

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104294.abstract: Machine learning methods in asset pricing are often criticized for their black box nature. We study this issue by predicting corporate bond returns using interpretable machine learning on a high-dimensional bond characteristics data set. We achieve state-of-the-art performance while maintaining an interpretable model structure, overcoming the accuracy–interpretability trade-off. The estimation uncovers nonlinear relationships and economically meaningful interactions in bond pricing, notably related to term structure and macroeconomic uncertainty. Subsample analysis reveals stronger sensitivities to these effects for small firms and long-maturity bonds. Finally, we demonstrate how interpretable models enhance transparency in portfolio construction by providing ex ante insights into portfolio composition.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104294.abstract_zh: 资产定价中的机器学习方法常因其“黑箱”特性而受到批评。我们通过在高维债券特征数据集上运用可解释机器学习预测公司债券回报来研究这一问题。我们在保持模型结构可解释的同时达到了最先进的性能，克服了准确性与可解释性之间的权衡。估计过程揭示了债券定价中的非线性关系及具有经济意义的交互作用，尤其涉及期限结构和宏观经济不确定性。子样本分析显示，小型企业和长期债券对这些效应的敏感性更强。最后，我们展示了可解释模型如何通过提供投资组合构成的事前洞察，增强投资组合构建的透明度。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104294.title: Glass box machine learning and corporate bond returns
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104294.title_zh: 玻璃箱机器学习与企业债券回报

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104295.abstract: We analyze 18 quadrillion models for the joint pricing of corporate bond and stock returns. Strikingly, we find that equity and nontradable factors alone suffice to explain corporate bond risk premia once their Treasury term structure risk is accounted for, rendering the extensive bond factor literature largely redundant for this purpose. While only a handful of factors, behavioral and nontradable, are likely robust sources of priced risk, the true latent stochastic discount factor is dense in the space of observable factors. Consequently, a Bayesian Model Averaging Stochastic Discount Factor explains risk premia better than all low-dimensional models, in- and out-of-sample, by optimally aggregating dozens of factors that serve as noisy proxies for common underlying risks, yielding an out-of-sample Sharpe ratio of 1.5 to 1.8. This SDF, as well as its conditional mean and volatility, are persistent, track the business cycle and times of heightened economic uncertainty, and predict future asset returns.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104295.abstract_zh: 我们分析了18万亿个模型，用于公司债券和股票回报的联合定价。引人注目的是，我们发现，一旦考虑了国债期限结构风险，仅凭股权和不可交易因素就足以解释公司债券的风险溢价，这使得广泛的债券因子文献在此目的上显得大为多余。尽管只有少数几个因子，包括行为性和不可交易性的，可能是定价风险的稳健来源，但真实的潜在随机贴现因子在可观测因子空间中是密集的。因此，贝叶斯模型平均随机贴现因子通过最优地聚合数十个作为共同潜在风险噪声代理的因子，在样本内和样本外均优于所有低维模型，解释了风险溢价，实现了1.5至1.8的样本外夏普比率。该SDF及其条件均值和波动性具有持续性，追踪商业周期和经济不确定性加剧时期，并能预测未来资产回报。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104295.title: The co-pricing factor zoo

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104305.abstract: We show that US monetary policy is transmitted internationally through the factor structure of exchange rates. Following an easing of monetary policy, investment funds sell safe and buy risky currencies. Global US banks, similarly, tilt their distribution of foreign loan origination toward currencies with greater systematic currency risk. The effects of monetary policy on currency flows and loans persist for several months and feed into the leverage and real investment decisions of firms and, in particular, those that operate using a high-risk currency. We conclude that the risk factor exposure of currencies is a significant channel through which we can understand the international transmission of US monetary policy.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104305.abstract_zh: 我们证明，美国货币政策通过汇率的因子结构在国际间传导。在货币政策宽松之后，投资基金卖出安全货币并买入风险货币。同样，全球美国银行将其外国贷款发放的分布倾向于具有更高系统性货币风险的货币。货币政策对货币流动和贷款的影响持续数月，并渗透到企业的杠杆和实际投资决策中，尤其是那些使用高风险货币运营的企业。我们得出结论，货币的风险因子暴露是理解美国货币政策国际传导的重要渠道。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104305.title: Monetary policy transmission through the exchange rate factor structure
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104305.title_zh: 汇率因子结构下的货币政策传导

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104306.abstract: We examine the impact of lost intellectual property protection on innovation, competition, firm performance, and valuation. We consider firms whose ability to protect intellectual property (IP) using patents is weakened following a major Supreme Court decision. We use large language models (LLM) to identify firms’ patent portfolios’ exposure to this decision and find an unequal impact. Large firms gain and small firms lose. Large impacted firms benefit as their sales growth increases and their exposure to lawsuits decreases. Small impacted firms lose as they face increased competition, product-market encroachment, and lower profits and valuations. They increase R&D and nondisclosure agreements.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104306.abstract_zh: 我们研究了知识产权保护丧失对创新、竞争、企业绩效及估值的影响。我们关注那些因最高法院一项重大裁决而专利保护能力被削弱的企业。利用大型语言模型（LLM）识别企业专利组合受该裁决影响的程度，我们发现影响并不均衡：大企业受益，小企业受损。受影响的大企业因销售增长加快和诉讼风险降低而获益；受影响的小企业则因竞争加剧、产品市场被侵占以及利润和估值下降而受损，它们增加了研发投入并加强了保密协议的使用。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104306.title: Intellectual property protection lost and competition: An examination using large language models
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104306.title_zh: 知识产权保护缺失与竞争：基于大语言模型的考察

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104307.abstract: Utilizing leading machine learning techniques to analyze the textual content and quality of patents, we demonstrate that patents with female lead inventors are under-cited relative to what would be expected had the lead inventor been male. Male inventors are the greatest contributors to the undercitation of patents with female inventors, followed by female inventors and male examiners, while female patent examiners appear to be even-handed. Using market reactions to patents suggests no average difference in market value by the inventor’s gender. The results have potential implications for research conclusions that rely on citation-based assessments of patent quality.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104307.abstract_zh: 利用前沿机器学习技术分析专利的文本内容与质量，我们证明，若主要发明人为女性，其专利被引用的频率低于预期——即相较于主要发明人为男性时的情况。男性发明人是导致女性发明人专利被低估引用的最大贡献者，其次是女性发明人和男性审查员，而女性专利审查员则显得较为公正。基于市场对专利的反应，发明人性别在平均市场价值上并无差异。这些发现对依赖基于引用的专利质量评估的研究结论具有潜在影响。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104307.title: Are patents with female inventors under-cited? Evidence from text estimation
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104307.title_zh: 女性发明人的专利是否被低估引用？基于文本估计的证据

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104308.abstract: We document a global reallocation of pollutive assets as a response to investor pressure: large firms facing increased investor pressure divest foreign-located pollutive assets to firms that are less in the limelight. There is no evidence of increased engagement in any other emission reduction activities. We estimate that 369 million metric tons (mt) of CO2e are reallocated via divestments in the post-Paris Agreement period. Our results indicate that investor pressure to decarbonize reshapes the global conglomerate structure of large firms.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104308.abstract_zh: 我们记录了投资者压力引发的全球污染性资产重新配置：面临更大投资者压力的大型企业，将位于国外的污染性资产剥离给那些较少受到关注的企业。没有证据表明这些企业增加了其他任何减排活动的参与。我们估计，在《巴黎协定》签署后的时期内，通过资产剥离重新配置了3.69亿公吨二氧化碳当量。我们的结果表明，投资者要求脱碳的压力重塑了大型企业的全球集团结构。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104308.title: Out of sight, out of mind: Divestments and the global reallocation of pollutive assets
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104308.title_zh: 眼不见，心不烦：资产剥离与污染性资产的全球重新配置

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104309.abstract: We study whether access to local pollution information causes investors to make greener portfolio allocations, exploiting the rollout of air quality monitoring stations in India. Using a triple-differences framework on the trading records of 19 million investors, we show that retail investors’ holdings in “brown” stocks become more negatively related to local pollution after a nearby station appears. This effect is more pronounced on “alert” dates when air quality is reported to be harmful. The effect is strongest among tech-savvy investors likely “treated” by real-time pollution data, and younger investors, who may be more sensitive to environmental concerns.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104309.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了获取本地污染信息是否促使投资者做出更环保的投资组合配置，利用印度空气质量监测站的推广作为自然实验。基于1900万投资者的交易记录，采用三重差分框架，我们发现，在附近监测站设立后，零售投资者对“棕色”股票的持有与本地污染之间的负相关性增强。这一效应在报告空气质量为有害的“警报”日期更为显著。在可能受实时污染数据“影响”的技术娴熟投资者及可能对环境问题更为敏感的年轻投资者中，该效应最为突出。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104309.title: Dirty air and green investments: The impact of pollution information on portfolio allocations
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104309.title_zh: 脏空气与绿色投资：污染信息对资产配置的影响

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104310.abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model in which firms issue nearly redundant securities to investor clienteles with participation constraints, with prices and demand determined endogenously in primary and secondary markets. The model characterizes how issuance costs, market frictions, and investor composition shape firms’ funding choices, equilibrium prices, and asset allocations. We test the model’s predictions using data from the Malaysian corporate bond market following the introduction of Islamic bonds. Consistent with the model, issuance decisions reflect trade-offs between collateral and liquidity benefits, Islamic and conventional bonds coexist without crowding out, and the expanded investor base increases access to debt financing.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104310.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中企业向面临参与约束的投资者客户群发行近乎冗余的证券，价格和需求在一级市场和二级市场中内生决定。该模型刻画了发行成本、市场摩擦及投资者构成如何塑造企业的融资选择、均衡价格和资产配置。我们利用马来西亚企业债券市场在引入伊斯兰债券后的数据检验了模型的预测。与模型一致，发行决策反映了抵押品与流动性收益之间的权衡，伊斯兰债券与常规债券共存而不相互挤出，且扩大的投资者基础增加了债务融资的可及性。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104310.title: The impact of introducing a (nearly) redundant security: Evidence from Malaysian corporate bonds
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104310.title_zh: 引入（近乎）冗余证券的影响：来自马来西亚公司债券的证据

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104311.abstract: We study how U.S. dollar fluctuations transmit through domestic supply chains in emerging markets. Large firms borrow in foreign currency and extend trade credit to domestic partners, exposing the supply chain to exchange rate risk. We develop a model where financially constrained suppliers pass through shocks to buyers, while unconstrained firms absorb them. Using quarterly firm-level data from 19 emerging markets, we provide empirical evidence consistent with the model’s predictions. We find that even highly exposed firms reduce trade credit only modestly following a depreciation, while accepting large profit losses, suggesting that firm-to-firm credit relationships partially shield downstream firms from financial shocks.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104311.abstract_zh: 我们研究了美元波动如何通过新兴市场的国内供应链传导。大型企业借入外币并向国内合作伙伴提供贸易信贷，使供应链面临汇率风险。我们构建了一个模型，其中受财务约束的供应商将冲击传递给买家，而财务不受约束的企业则吸收这些冲击。利用19个新兴市场的季度企业层面数据，我们提供了与模型预测相符的经验证据。我们发现，即使在贬值后，高度暴露的企业也仅适度减少贸易信贷，同时承受较大的利润损失，这表明企业间的信贷关系在一定程度上保护了下游企业免受金融冲击的影响。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104311.title: Firm-to-firm financial linkages and dollar risk transmission
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104311.title_zh: 企业间金融联系与美元风险传导

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104319.abstract: Using a new equilibrium representation, I characterize dynamic, nonstationary risk sharing in a complete-information setting among strategic traders submitting demand schedules and heterogeneous in risk aversion. In equilibrium, more risk-averse (smaller) traders diversify more aggressively due to endogenously lower price impact. This creates term structure effects, where smaller traders dynamically hedge the persistent order flow of larger, slower traders and become the marginal pricers at short horizons. When pre-announced security issuances (e.g., bond reopenings) or predictable trades take place, the model generates the gradual, V-shaped price response observed around these events and delivers new predictions about institutional trading.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104319.abstract_zh: 利用一种新的均衡表示方法，我刻画了在完全信息环境中，风险规避程度异质的策略性交易者提交需求曲线时的动态、非平稳风险分担特征。在均衡状态下，风险规避程度更高（规模更小）的交易者因内生性较低的价格冲击效应而更为积极地分散风险。这产生了期限结构效应，其中较小规模的交易者动态对冲较大且行动较慢交易者的持续性订单流，并在短期视野内成为边际定价者。当预先公告的证券发行（例如债券重新开放）或可预测交易发生时，模型生成了围绕这些事件观察到的渐进式V形价格反应，并为机构交易提供了新的预测。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104319.title: Asymmetric thin markets

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104320.abstract: Exploiting transaction-level international trade data, this paper documents that long-term firm-to-firm relationships facilitate the use of trade credit, with the strength of this effect varying with firm size, firms’ payment delays, and multinational affiliate status. Effects also depend on the strength of contract enforcement across countries and the complexity of products traded. Because trade credit can reduce the overall need to borrow from the financial sector, long-term relationships may reduce firms’ credit demand. The destruction of trade relationships, for example, through trade conflicts, may hence increase firms’ leverage.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104320.abstract_zh: 利用交易层面的国际贸易数据，本文记录了长期企业间关系如何促进贸易信贷的使用，且这一效应的强度随企业规模、企业付款延迟及跨国子公司身份的不同而变化。该效应还受各国合同执行力度及交易产品复杂性的影响。由于贸易信贷能减少对金融部门整体借贷的需求，长期关系可能降低企业的信贷需求。因此，贸易关系的破坏，例如因贸易冲突所致，可能增加企业的杠杆率。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104320.title: Trade credit and relationships

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104321.abstract: Blended finance—the use of public and philanthropic funding to crowd in private capital—has emerged as a potential tool for financing sustainable development. Yet little is known about the design of blended finance contracts. We develop a conceptual framework in which development finance institutions (DFIs) allocate concessional capital across projects to maximize societal impact while crowding in private investors. Our framework highlights a trade-off between sustainability impact and the amount of concessionality required to make projects commercially viable and characterizes how DFIs optimally combine different instruments, including concessional debt, junior equity tranches, and risk management facilities. We then provide empirical evidence on blended finance using deal-level data from a major DFI. Consistent with our conceptual framework, projects with higher anticipated sustainability impact receive greater concessionality. Moreover, concessionality is higher in countries with greater political risk and information asymmetries, and these projects are more likely to include risk management provisions. Our findings provide new evidence on how DFIs deploy catalytic capital to mobilize private investment in sustainable development.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104321.abstract_zh: 混合融资——利用公共和慈善资金撬动私人资本——已成为资助可持续发展的一种潜在工具。然而，关于混合融资合约的设计知之甚少。我们构建了一个概念框架，在此框架中，开发金融机构（DFIs）在项目间分配优惠资本，以最大化社会影响，同时吸引私人投资者。我们的框架揭示了可持续影响与使项目商业可行所需优惠程度之间的权衡，并刻画了DFIs如何最优地组合不同工具，包括优惠债务、次级股权层级和风险管理设施。随后，我们利用一家主要DFI的交易级数据，提供了关于混合融资的实证证据。与我们的概念框架一致，预期可持续影响更高的项目获得了更大的优惠性。此外，在政治风险和信息不对称程度较高的国家，优惠性更高，且这些项目更可能包含风险管理条款。我们的发现为DFIs如何部署催化资本以动员私人投资于可持续发展提供了新的证据。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104321.title: Blended finance

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104322.abstract: As the economy has become increasingly knowledge-based, firms’ capability to benefit from external knowledge has grown in importance. We construct a measure of this capability – absorption intensity – from information in firms’ patents. To validate the measure, we exploit the American Inventors Protection Act (AIPA), which exogenously increased patent information availability. A triple-difference design shows that firms with higher absorption intensity experience greater innovation growth when more exposed to the reform. Beyond AIPA, absorption intensity predicts stronger innovation outcomes and firm growth. Our measure offers a tool to study how differences in absorption capability shape returns to external knowledge.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104322.abstract_zh: 随着经济日益向知识密集型转型，企业从外部知识中获益的能力愈发重要。我们基于企业专利信息构建了一项衡量该能力的指标——吸收强度。为验证这一指标的有效性，我们利用了《美国发明人保护法案》（AIPA），该法案外生地增加了专利信息的可获得性。三重差分设计显示，在改革影响更显著的条件下，吸收强度较高的企业实现了更大的创新增长。除AIPA情境外，吸收强度还能预测更优的创新成果和企业成长。我们的指标为研究吸收能力差异如何影响外部知识回报提供了工具。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104322.title: Measuring firms’ capability to absorb external knowledge
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104322.title_zh: 企业吸收外部知识能力的测度

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104323.abstract: This paper examines the effects of a shock to angel finance on entrepreneurial activity. Using U.S. Census data, we estimate the state-level fraction of households that lost accreditation status from Dodd–Frank’s elimination of housing wealth in determining accreditation. A larger reduction in the pool of potential investors reduces angel investment, firm entry, and employment at small entrants. Employment increases at small and young incumbents, suggesting competitive effects. Though we document partial substitution, angel finance appears to complement other capital sources in the entrepreneurial ecosystem. Our paper offers insight on the impact of angel finance and where it matters most.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104323.abstract_zh: 本文考察了天使融资冲击对创业活动的影响。利用美国人口普查数据，我们估算了因多德-弗兰克法案取消住房财富在认定合格投资者资格中的作用，而导致各州失去合格投资者身份的家庭比例。潜在投资者池的更大缩减减少了天使投资、企业进入以及小型新进入企业的就业。小型和年轻在位企业的就业增加，表明存在竞争效应。尽管我们记录了部分替代效应，但天使融资似乎与创业生态系统中的其他资本来源形成互补。本文为理解天使融资的影响及其最关键的作用领域提供了洞见。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104323.title: Angels, entrepreneurship, and employment dynamics: Evidence from investor accreditation rules
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104323.title_zh: 天使投资、创业与就业动态：来自投资者认证规则的证据

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104324.abstract: We show that institutional portfolio rebalancing across asset classes plays a key role in transmitting monetary shocks to the stock market. Around FOMC announcements, ceteris paribus, a stock with 10-percentage-point higher ownership by rebalancing institutions experiences an additional 3.7-basis-point loss following a 10-basis-point surprise rate hike. We corroborate our mechanism by exploiting within-firm variations for dual shares, showing stronger price reactions at quarter- and month-ends when rebalancing is more imminent, and presenting placebo tests contrasting rebalancing institutions with other institutions. A concluding calibration suggests rebalancing could contribute roughly one-third to two-thirds of the aggregate stock market excess return response to monetary shocks.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104324.abstract_zh: 我们证明，机构投资者在资产类别间的组合再平衡在货币政策冲击向股市传导中扮演关键角色。在联邦公开市场委员会公告前后，在其他条件相同的情况下，若某只股票由进行再平衡的机构持有的比例高出10个百分点，则在利率意外上调10个基点时，该股票将额外损失3.7个基点。我们通过利用双重股份的公司内部差异来验证这一机制，显示在季度末和月末再平衡更为临近时，价格反应更为强烈，并通过对比再平衡机构与其他机构的安慰剂测试加以佐证。最终的校准分析表明，再平衡可能贡献了股票市场总体超额收益对货币政策冲击响应的约三分之一至三分之二。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104324.title: Monetary transmission and portfolio rebalancing: A cross-sectional approach
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104324.title_zh: 货币传导与投资组合再平衡：一种横截面方法

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104325.abstract: Whether proprietary traders provide or take liquidity, and how their behavior evolves over the business cycle and across stocks, remains at the center of an ongoing debate. Using a unique dataset from the NYSE, we document that proprietary traders act as net liquidity providers, buying after price declines in a contrarian pattern. Proprietary trader liquidity provision is concentrated in large, liquid, low-volatility stocks and diminishes significantly when intermediary balance sheets are weak. Liquidity provision is stronger when price movements are plausibly not driven by information. Our findings highlight both the role and the limits of proprietary traders in supporting market liquidity across time and market segments.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104325.abstract_zh: 专有交易者究竟是提供流动性还是吸收流动性，以及其行为如何随商业周期和股票种类演变，始终是持续争论的核心议题。利用纽约证券交易所的独特数据集，我们记录到专有交易者作为净流动性提供者，以逆向模式在价格下跌后买入。专有交易者的流动性提供集中于大盘、流动性强、波动性低的股票，并在中介机构资产负债表疲弱时显著减少。当价格变动可能并非由信息驱动时，流动性提供更为强劲。我们的发现凸显了专有交易者在不同时期和市场细分中支持市场流动性的作用及其局限性。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104325.title: Do proprietary traders provide liquidity?
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104325.title_zh: 自营交易者是否提供流动性？

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104326.abstract: We examine the effects of mandatory board gender quotas on unregulated firms that are connected to regulated ones via interlocking directorates. After the introduction of quotas, connected firms significantly increase their share of female directors relative to similar unconnected firms. The spillover effects are substantial — at least as large as the direct effects on regulated firms, challenging previous claims that quotas have no broader impact on women in business. Our results suggest that quotas indirectly broaden the supply of candidates for connected firms, along dimensions that include, but are not limited to, gender.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104326.abstract_zh: 我们研究了强制性董事会性别配额对通过连锁董事网络与受监管企业相关联的未受监管企业的影响。配额引入后，关联企业女性董事比例相较于类似的无关联企业显著提升。这种溢出效应显著——至少与对受监管企业的直接影响相当，这挑战了先前关于配额对商界女性无更广泛影响的观点。我们的结果表明，配额间接拓宽了关联企业候选人的供给范围，其维度包括但不限于性别。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104326.title: Changing the board game: Horizontal spillovers of gender quotas
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104326.title_zh: 改变游戏规则：性别配额的横向溢出效应

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104327.abstract: I show that the overreaction of the long-term yield forecasts to yield news, evidenced in recent studies, results directly from the overreaction of long-horizon inflation forecasts to inflation news. Motivated by this finding, I study how agents form inflation expectations across forecast horizons. Short-horizon survey forecasts underreact, while long-horizon forecasts overreact to inflation news. To reconcile this behavior, I implement a long-run bias, building on the widely shared intuition that agents conflate transitory with permanent shocks, within a realistic trend-gap inflation model. I embed this bias within a yield curve model. The long-horizon inflation expectations overreaction translates into a long-term yields’ overreaction, generating excess yield sensitivity to news. The model implies a long-term bond risk premium substantially less volatile and cyclical than that implied by predictive regressions or estimates imposing full-information rational expectations.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104327.abstract_zh: 我证明，近期研究中发现的长期收益率预测对收益率消息的过度反应，直接源于长期通胀预测对通胀消息的过度反应。基于这一发现，我研究了经济主体在不同预测期限上如何形成通胀预期。短期调查预测对通胀消息反应不足，而长期预测则反应过度。为调和这一行为，我在一个现实的趋势-缺口通胀模型中引入长期偏差，基于广泛认同的直觉，即经济主体将暂时性冲击与永久性冲击混淆。我将这一偏差嵌入收益率曲线模型。长期通胀预期的过度反应转化为长期收益率的过度反应，产生收益率对消息的过度敏感性。该模型意味着长期债券风险溢价的波动性和周期性显著低于预测回归或强加完全信息理性预期估计所隐含的水平。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104327.title: Forecast bias across horizons: Inflation expectations and the Treasury yields
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104327.title_zh: 跨期限预测偏差：通胀预期与国债收益率

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104328.abstract: We study the effects of carbon price uncertainty on firms’ decisions to decarbonize their operations. We first use information on the pricing of options on emission allowances in the European Emissions Trading System to create the Carbon VIX, a market-based high-frequency measure of carbon price uncertainty. Carbon price uncertainty is high, varies substantially over time, and experiences persistent shocks around major climate policy events. To explore the effects of carbon price uncertainty on expected aggregate decarbonization investments, we analyze its effect on the stock returns of firms that help other businesses decarbonize. To identify these “carbon solution providers”, we extract common types of decarbonization investments from a large survey of firms, and then identify companies that offer the associated goods and services. We find that the stock returns of these carbon solution providers vary positively with carbon prices, but negatively with carbon price uncertainty. The effect of increases in carbon price uncertainty on our proxy for expected decarbonization investments is economically large and of similar magnitude as the effect of declines in carbon prices. These findings support predictions from real options theory that firms may delay investments in decarbonization when faced with uncertainty about the future costs of emissions.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104328.abstract_zh: 我们研究了碳价不确定性对企业脱碳运营决策的影响。首先，利用欧洲排放交易体系中排放配额期权定价的信息，构建了碳VIX指数，这是一种基于市场的高频碳价不确定性度量指标。碳价不确定性水平较高，随时间显著波动，并在重大气候政策事件期间经历持续性冲击。为探究碳价不确定性对预期总体脱碳投资的影响，我们分析了其对帮助其他企业实现脱碳的公司股票回报的影响。为识别这些“碳解决方案提供商”，我们从一项大规模企业调查中提取常见的脱碳投资类型，进而确定提供相关商品和服务的公司。研究发现，这些碳解决方案提供商的股票回报与碳价正相关，但与碳价不确定性负相关。碳价不确定性上升对我们预期脱碳投资代理指标的影响在经济规模上显著，且与碳价下降的影响程度相当。这些发现支持实物期权理论的预测，即当面临未来排放成本的不确定性时，企业可能会推迟脱碳投资。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104328.title: Carbon VIX: Carbon price uncertainty and decarbonization investments
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104328.title_zh: 碳VIX：碳价格不确定性与脱碳投资

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104329.abstract: I document robust U.S. and international evidence that aggregate corporate cash savings negatively forecast future excess market returns, with economic uncertainty an important driver of this relation. In a calibrated neoclassical dynamic model featuring precautionary savings, I show that fixed financing costs, firm exit, and an uncertainty-driven time-varying price of risk are crucial to replicating this return predictability. The model further implies that the well-known positive return predictive power of aggregate accruals is largely attributable to aggregate cash savings, and the data support this implication.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104329.abstract_zh: 我记录了美国及国际上的有力证据，表明总体企业现金储蓄对未来超额市场回报具有负向预测作用，其中经济不确定性是这一关系的重要驱动因素。在一个包含预防性储蓄的校准新古典动态模型中，我展示了固定融资成本、企业退出以及由不确定性驱动的时变风险价格，对于复现这种回报可预测性至关重要。该模型进一步暗示，总体应计项目众所周知的正面回报预测能力在很大程度上归因于总体现金储蓄，而数据支持了这一推论。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104329.title: Aggregate corporate savings, economic uncertainty, and future stock returns
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104329.title_zh: 企业总储蓄、经济不确定性与未来股票收益

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104330.abstract: We estimate the causal effect of online sports betting on households’ investment, spending, and debt management decisions using household transaction data and a staggered difference-in-differences framework. Following legalization, sports betting spreads quickly, with both the number of participants and frequency of bets increasing over time. This increase does not displace other gambling or consumption but significantly reduces savings, as risky bets crowd out positive expected value investments. These effects concentrate among frequent bettors and low-savings households. Our findings highlight the potential adverse effects of online sports betting on vulnerable households.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104330.abstract_zh: 我们利用家庭交易数据和交错双重差分框架，估计了在线体育博彩对家庭投资、支出及债务管理决策的因果效应。合法化后，体育博彩迅速普及，参与人数和投注频率均随时间增加。这一增长并未挤占其他赌博或消费活动，但显著减少了储蓄，因为高风险投注排挤了具有正期望值的投资。这些影响集中在频繁投注者和低储蓄家庭中。我们的研究结果凸显了在线体育博彩对弱势家庭可能产生的不利影响。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104330.title: Gambling away stability: Sports betting’s impact on vulnerable households
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104330.title_zh: 赌博侵蚀稳定：体育博彩对脆弱家庭的影响

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104331.abstract: Institutional and individual investors evaluate private market opportunities systematically differently, even facing identical choices. In a survey experiment, 593 institutional and 445 individual investors assess venture capital fund profiles with independently randomized GP characteristics. Institutions heavily weight past fund performance, consistent with risk-averse investor demand calibrated to VC markets. Individuals largely ignore performance, favoring educational credentials instead. A follow-up experiment identifies two independent mechanisms: individuals lack awareness that VC performance persists and discount quality signals for funds they perceive as inaccessible. Performance-based selection alone reduces individuals’ expected returns by approximately 7%, accounting for 20% of the return gap with professionals.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104331.abstract_zh: 机构投资者与个人投资者在面对相同的私募市场机会时，其评估方式存在系统性差异。在一项调查实验中，593名机构投资者与445名个人投资者对风险投资基金概况进行了评估，其中普通合伙人特征被独立随机化。机构投资者高度重视过往基金业绩，这与风险投资市场中风险规避型投资者需求相吻合。相比之下，个人投资者则基本忽视业绩表现，转而偏好教育背景资质。后续实验揭示了两个独立机制：个人投资者既缺乏对风险投资业绩持续性的认知，又对自认为难以触及的基金质量信号持折扣态度。仅基于业绩的选择机制便使个人投资者的预期收益降低约7%，这解释了其与专业人士之间约20%的收益差距。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104331.title: Investor expertise and private investment selection
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104331.title_zh: 投资者专长与私人投资选择

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104332.abstract: A firm’s gross margin increases by 0.8 p.p.after forming a new direct board connection to a product market peer. Gross margin also rises by 0.4 p.p.after a connection is formed to a peer indirectly through a third intermediate firm. Further, using barcode-level data of 2.7 million products, we show that new board connections are related to higher consumer good prices, a greater tendency for market allocation, and slower new product introductions. The effects are stronger when the newly connected peers share corporate customers or have similar business descriptions and hold when controlling for other inter-firm relationships.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104332.abstract_zh: 企业毛利率在与其产品市场同行建立新的直接董事会联系后上升0.8个百分点。通过第三方中间企业间接建立联系后，毛利率亦上升0.4个百分点。进一步，利用270万种产品的条形码级数据，我们发现新的董事会联系与更高的消费品价格、更强的市场分配倾向以及更慢的新产品推出速度相关。当新建立联系的同行共享企业客户或具有相似业务描述时，这些效应更为显著，并且在控制其他企业间关系后依然成立。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104332.title: Board connections, firm profitability, and product market actions
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104332.title_zh: 董事会关联、公司盈利能力与产品市场行为

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104333.abstract: Using close elections as an empirical setting, this paper examines the drivers and consequences of politically motivated lending by U.S. banks, with a special focus on resulting benefits. We first show that firms with ties to members of Congress receive more favorable loan terms, despite no observable improvements in performance or default risk. The effect is especially pronounced among banks facing regulatory challenges — such as FDIC enforcement actions, corporate misconduct investigations, or low Community Reinvestment Act ratings — which also lend more frequently to connected firms, suggesting that these institutions have a heightened demand for political influence. Crucially, we find that politically motivated lending produces tangible future benefits for banks, including reduced misconduct penalties and easier approval for mergers and acquisitions. These findings provide evidence of a quid pro quo dynamic: banks extend preferential credit to firms with political connections and, in turn, receive regulatory advantages.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104333.abstract_zh: 以竞争激烈的选举为实证背景，本文探讨了美国银行政治动机贷款的驱动因素及其后果，特别关注由此产生的利益。我们首先发现，与国会议员有联系的企业能获得更优惠的贷款条件，尽管其业绩或违约风险并无显著改善。这一效应在面临监管挑战的银行中尤为明显——如遭遇FDIC执法行动、企业不当行为调查或社区再投资法案评级较低——这些银行也更频繁地向关联企业放贷，表明此类机构对政治影响力的需求更为强烈。关键的是，我们发现政治动机贷款为银行带来了切实的未来利益，包括减少不当行为处罚和更易获得并购批准。这些发现揭示了互惠交换的动态机制：银行向具有政治关联的企业提供优惠信贷，并因此获得监管上的优势。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104333.title: Reaching for influence: Do banks use loans to establish political connections?
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104333.title_zh: 寻求影响力：银行是否利用贷款建立政治关联？

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104334.abstract: We demonstrate the passthrough of Treasury supply to bank deposits through bank market power. We show that a larger Treasury supply crowds out deposits with disproportionate effects in more competitive deposit markets. A larger Treasury supply further curtails bank lending and affects bank funding structure. The explanatory power of Treasury supply is not driven by other shocks to deposit demand and supply. In comparison, monetary policy rate hikes have a larger impact on deposit funding in more concentrated markets, consistent with the deposits channel of monetary policy. Our empirical findings are rationalized in a model of imperfect deposit competition.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104334.abstract_zh: 我们证明了国债供给通过银行市场势力向银行存款的传导效应。研究表明，国债供给增加会挤出存款，且在竞争更激烈的存款市场中影响尤为显著。国债供给增加进一步抑制了银行贷款，并影响银行的融资结构。国债供给的解释力并非由存款需求与供给的其他冲击所驱动。相比之下，货币政策加息在更集中的市场中对存款融资影响更大，这与货币政策的存款渠道相符。我们的实证发现在一个不完全存款竞争模型中得到合理化解释。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104334.title: The passthrough of treasury supply to bank deposit funding
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104334.title_zh: 国债供给对银行存款融资的传导效应

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104335.abstract: We document the capability of large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT to predict stock market reactions from news headlines without direct financial training. Using post-knowledge-cutoff headlines, GPT-4 captures initial market responses, achieving approximately 90% portfolio-day hit rates for the non-tradable initial reaction. GPT-4 scores also significantly predict the subsequent drift, especially for small stocks and negative news. Forecasting ability generally increases with model size, suggesting that financial reasoning is an emerging capacity of complex LLMs. Strategy returns decline as LLM adoption rises, consistent with improved price efficiency. To rationalize these findings, we develop a theoretical model that incorporates LLM technology, information-processing capacity constraints, underreaction, and limits to arbitrage.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104335.abstract_zh: 我们记录了大型语言模型（LLMs）如ChatGPT在无需直接金融训练的情况下，从新闻标题预测股市反应的能力。利用知识截止日期后的标题，GPT-4捕捉到了市场的初始反应，对于不可交易的初始反应实现了约90%的投资组合日命中率。GPT-4的评分还能显著预测随后的漂移，尤其是对于小盘股和负面新闻。预测能力通常随模型规模增大而增强，这表明金融推理是复杂LLMs的一种新兴能力。随着LLM采用的增加，策略回报下降，这与价格效率提升相一致。为合理化这些发现，我们构建了一个理论模型，该模型整合了LLM技术、信息处理能力限制、反应不足以及套利限制。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104335.title: Can ChatGPT forecast stock price movements? Return predictability and large language models
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104335.title_zh: ChatGPT能否预测股价变动？收益可预测性与大型语言模型

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104336.abstract: We evaluate private equity (PE) performance using investor-specific stochastic discount factors, and examine whether investors could benefit from changing their allocation to PE.Plans invest in PE funds with higher average risk-adjusted performance.This is mainly due to access to successful PE managers, not superior selection skill.Decomposing returns into risk-compensation and "alpha", we find that some plans obtain higher PE returns by taking more risk without earning higher, and in some cases earning lower, risk-adjusted returns, broadly consistent with agency problems within plans.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104336.abstract_zh: 我们采用投资者特定的随机贴现因子评估私募股权（PE）业绩，并考察投资者是否能够通过调整PE配置获益。投资计划倾向于选择平均风险调整后业绩更高的PE基金，这主要得益于接触成功的PE管理人，而非卓越的筛选能力。通过将收益分解为风险补偿和“阿尔法”，我们发现部分投资计划通过承担更高风险获取更高PE收益，但并未获得更高（某些情况下甚至更低）的风险调整后收益，这与投资计划内部的代理问题基本一致。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104336.title: Private equity for pension plans? Evaluating private equity performance from an investor’s perspective
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104336.title_zh: 养老金计划的私募股权投资？从投资者视角评估私募股权绩效

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104337.abstract: This paper quantifies how investors’ portfolio demand responds to price changes at long horizons versus short horizons. Using investor trades – changes in portfolios – at different horizons, I first present reduced-form evidence that elasticities increase significantly over time. I then propose a dynamic demand system via a parsimonious partial-adjustment model that recovers the full term structure of elasticities while mitigating long-horizon identification challenges. The estimates imply that price impacts are three times larger at quarterly horizons than in the long-run equilibrium. The model produces a novel, stock-level measure of long-term reversal that avoids the noise of long-horizon return regressions.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104337.abstract_zh: 本文量化了投资者投资组合需求对价格变动在长期与短期不同期限下的响应程度。利用不同期限下的投资者交易——即投资组合变动——我首先呈现了简化形式的证据，表明弹性随时间显著增加。随后，我通过一个简约的部分调整模型提出了一个动态需求系统，该系统能够恢复弹性的完整期限结构，同时缓解长期识别挑战。估计结果显示，价格影响在季度期限上比长期均衡状态下大三倍。该模型产生了一种新颖的、基于个股层面的长期反转度量，避免了长期回报回归中的噪声问题。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104337.title: Short versus long-run demand elasticities in asset pricing
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104337.title_zh: 资产定价中的短期与长期需求弹性

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104338.abstract: How do bank networks facilitate information flows that shape market outcomes? Using international banks’ advisory activities in corporate takeovers as their source of private information, we show in supervisory data that banks with closer ties to the target, but not the acquirer, advisor trade profitably in the target’s stock prior to the deal announcement. This trading behavior is associated with a higher premium paid without compromising deal success. As connected banks’ incentives are aligned only with target shareholders’ interests, which are represented by the target advisor, our evidence suggests that economic incentives determine which banks share information and with whom.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104338.abstract_zh: 银行网络如何促进信息流动并影响市场结果？利用国际银行在企业并购中的顾问活动作为其私有信息来源，我们在监管数据中发现，与目标公司（而非收购方）关系更密切的银行顾问会在交易公告前通过目标公司股票交易获利。这种交易行为与支付更高溢价相关，且不影响交易成功率。由于关联银行的激励仅与目标股东利益一致（由目标顾问代表），我们的证据表明，经济激励决定了哪些银行共享信息以及与谁共享。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104338.title: Strategic communication among banks

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104347.abstract: Using an instrument for U.S. Treasury supply, we show that convenience yields on medium- and long-term Treasurys are much more sensitive to supply than those on short-term Treasurys, which respond little. Over the past two decades, fiscal expansion has substantially reduced medium- and long-term convenience yields, at times pushing them below zero, while short-term convenience yields have declined toward zero. Quantitatively, we estimate that increased Treasury supply explains a large share of the secular decline in medium- and long-term convenience yields, lowering the total seigniorage revenue from Treasury issuance by about one-third.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104347.abstract_zh: 利用美国国债供给的工具变量，我们证明中长期国债的便利收益率对供给的敏感度远高于短期国债，后者反应甚微。过去二十年中，财政扩张显著降低了中长期便利收益率，有时甚至将其推至负值，而短期便利收益率则逐步向零趋近。定量分析显示，国债供给增加解释了中长期便利收益率长期下降的很大一部分，使国债发行的总铸币税收入减少了约三分之一。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104347.title: Convenience lost

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104348.abstract: Deviations from covered interest rate parity (CIP) are often linked to limits to arbitrage, yet trading volumes surge during periods of apparent no-arbitrage violations. We show that these distortions stem from constraints on non-U.S. agents’ access to wholesale U.S. dollar markets and reflect a premium for unencumbered synthetic dollar funding: non-U.S. banks substitute secured USD borrowing with FX swaps to meet regulatory requirements. A shadow cost-augmented CIP condition holds, implying no riskless arbitrage. U.S. dealers extract rents on dollar provision while non-U.S. customers bear $10.4 billion in additional annual hedging costs. Our results illustrate how intermediary constraints segment global dollar funding.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104348.abstract_zh: 抵补利率平价（CIP）的偏离常与套利限制相关联，然而在表面无套利机会的时期，交易量却激增。我们证明，这些扭曲源于非美国主体进入美国批发美元市场的限制，并反映了无负担合成美元融资的溢价：非美国银行以外汇互换替代有担保的美元借款，以满足监管要求。一个包含影子成本的增强型CIP条件成立，意味着不存在无风险套利。美国交易商在提供美元时获取租金，而非美国客户则承担每年104亿美元的额外对冲成本。我们的研究结果揭示了中介机构约束如何分割全球美元融资市场。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104348.title: Segmented Dollar Funding

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104349.abstract: Institutions facilitate short-selling by lending from their holdings, but what they hold is endogenous. This paper examines how institutional demand, driven by investment mandates (benchmarking), affects short-selling. In a model where benchmarked managers lend from their holdings, both lending supply and equilibrium price are higher for the benchmark asset, and so is shorting demand (due to inflated price). A quasi-experiment using Russell index reconstitution shows that stocks with more benchmarked capital have greater lending supply and demand. Ultimately, such stocks are costlier to short. In theory and data, results are driven by incomplete pass-through from benchmarked capital to lending supply.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104349.abstract_zh: 机构通过出借其持有的证券来促进卖空，但其持有量是内生的。本文考察了由投资授权（基准化）驱动的机构需求如何影响卖空行为。在一个基准化管理者出借其持有资产的模型中，基准资产的借贷供给和均衡价格均更高，卖空需求也随之增加（因价格被抬高）。利用罗素指数重构进行的准实验表明，基准化资本占比更高的股票具有更大的借贷供给和需求。最终，这类股票的卖空成本更高。在理论和数据中，这些结果均由基准化资本向借贷供给的不完全传导所驱动。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104349.title: Institutional investor mandates, securities lending, and short-selling constraints
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104349.title_zh: 机构投资者委托、证券借贷与卖空约束

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104351.abstract: A simple production economy with nominal price rigidities explains several key asset pricing facts, including the average slopes and cyclicality of equity and interest rate term structures. Nominal rigidities amplify the procyclicality of dividends after negative productivity shocks and generate countercyclical inflation, as sluggish price adjustment leads to a gradual dividend recovery. Consequently, short-duration equities (bonds) have more (less) procyclical payoffs than their long-duration counterparts. Slow-moving consumption habits produce large, countercyclical risk prices, yielding realistic asset valuations. Extending Campbell–Cochrane preferences with both market- and home-consumption habits allows them to operate in production economies while preserving realistic macroeconomic dynamics.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104351.abstract_zh: 一个具有名义价格刚性的简单生产经济模型，能够解释若干关键资产定价事实，包括股票和利率期限结构的平均斜率及其周期性。名义刚性放大了负向生产率冲击后股息的前瞻性周期性，并产生反周期的通货膨胀，因为价格调整迟缓导致股息逐步恢复。因此，短久期股票（债券）的支付比长久期对应物更具（更不）前瞻性周期性。缓慢变动的消费习惯产生大规模、反周期的风险价格，从而得出符合现实的资产估值。将Campbell–Cochrane偏好扩展至同时包含市场消费习惯和家庭消费习惯，使其能在生产经济中运作，同时保持现实宏观经济动态。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104351.title: A New Keynesian model of the term structures of equity and bond returns
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104351.title_zh: 股票与债券收益率期限结构的新凯恩斯模型

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104352.abstract: Are banks safer when they hold more safe assets? This paper builds a model in which banks supply liquidity services through uninsured deposits. Define a safe asset as an asset with both low payoff risk and high pledgeability. Banks consider equity costly and because of safe assets’ low payoff risk prefer to fund them largely with deposits. High pledgeability makes this feasible. The rise in banks’ deposit supply increases deposit rates and forces banks to deviate from socially desirable levels of capital to meet return-on-equity targets. Regulatory leverage ratios can be tightened to increase welfare.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104352.abstract_zh: 银行持有更多安全资产时是否更安全？本文构建了一个模型，其中银行通过未保险存款提供流动性服务。将安全资产定义为既具有低支付风险又具有高可质押性的资产。银行视股权成本高昂，并因安全资产的低支付风险而倾向于大量以存款为其融资。高可质押性使这一做法成为可能。银行存款供给的增加推高了存款利率，迫使银行偏离社会合意的资本水平以满足股本回报率目标。监管杠杆比率可被收紧以提升社会福利。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104352.title: Macroprudential regulation and banks’ supply of liquidity services
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104352.title_zh: 宏观审慎监管与银行流动性服务供给

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104353.abstract: Hidden fees can distort consumer decision-making. In response, regulators historically have (a) improved disclosure to make fees more salient or (b) standardized products to restrict what fees can be charged. We use Chilean administrative data and a multi-stage natural experiment to separately identify the effects of disclosure and standardization on repayment. We find that disclosure reduces delinquencies by 13.7 percentage points (40%) and default by 1.68 percentage points (98%), whereas standardization has no effect. We find no effect on initial loan terms, suggesting that disclosure’s effects are specific to repayment behavior: specifically, disclosure improves borrowers’ understanding of their credit obligations.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104353.abstract_zh: 隐藏费用可能扭曲消费者的决策。为此，监管机构历来采取两种措施：（a）改进信息披露，使费用更加显眼；或（b）标准化产品，限制可收取的费用类型。我们利用智利的行政数据及一个多阶段自然实验，分别识别信息披露与标准化对还款行为的影响。研究发现，信息披露能将逾期率降低13.7个百分点（降幅40%），并将违约率降低1.68个百分点（降幅98%），而标准化则无显著效果。我们未发现对初始贷款条款的影响，这表明信息披露的效果特定于还款行为：具体而言，信息披露增强了借款人对自身信贷义务的理解。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104353.title: Removing the fine print: Disclosure, standardized products, and consumer outcomes
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104353.title_zh: 去除细则：信息披露、标准化产品与消费者结果

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104355.abstract: Firms often expose themselves to currency risk by borrowing in foreign currencies, even when the local currency actually provides a better hedge in downturns. Motivated by this novel fact, we develop an international corporate finance model in which firms facing adverse selection choose the foreign currency share of their debt. In the unique separating equilibrium, good firms optimally expose themselves to currency risk to signal their type. Crucially, the nature of this equilibrium depends on the co-movement between cash flows and the exchange rate. We provide evidence consistent with the predictions of the model using a granular dataset including more than 4800 firms in 19 emerging markets and 5700 firms in 22 advanced economies between 2005 and 2021. The signaling mechanism is most salient for firms in emerging markets and also those subject to greater information asymmetries in advanced economies. These findings are important for assessing and managing risks from currency mismatches on corporate balance sheets.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104355.abstract_zh: 企业常常通过借入外币来暴露自身于汇率风险之中，即便本币在经济下行期实际上能提供更好的对冲效果。受这一新颖事实启发，我们构建了一个国际企业金融模型，在该模型中，面临逆向选择的企业会选择其债务中外币所占的比例。在唯一的分离均衡中，优质企业会最优地选择暴露于汇率风险以传递其类型信号。关键在于，这一均衡的性质取决于现金流与汇率之间的联动关系。我们利用一个包含2005年至2021年间19个新兴市场超过4800家企业及22个发达经济体5700家企业的精细数据集，提供了与模型预测相一致的证据。信号机制在新兴市场的企业中最为显著，同时也在发达经济体中面临更大信息不对称的企业中表现突出。这些发现对于评估和管理企业资产负债表上货币错配风险具有重要意义。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104355.title: Signaling with debt currency choice
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104355.title_zh: 债务货币选择中的信号传递

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104356.abstract: Tax loss carryforwards (TLCF) — accumulated losses that reduce taxable income — are an important and risky corporate asset. We show theoretically how TLCF affect equity risk: If TLCF are low and used with certainty, equity risk decreases in TLCF because TLCF represent a safe cash flow; if TLCF are high, equity risk increases in TLCF because TLCF increase after-tax cash flows in good times but may expire unused or be deferred in bad times. In a calibrated model the latter effect dominates and risk increases in TLCF on average. Empirically, TLCF positively forecast firms’ volatility, beta, and return.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104356.abstract_zh: 税收亏损结转（TLCF）——即减少应税收入的累计亏损——是一项重要且具有风险的企业资产。我们从理论上展示了TLCF如何影响股权风险：若TLCF较低且确定会被使用，则因其代表安全的现金流，股权风险随TLCF增加而降低；若TLCF较高，则因TLCF在景气时期增加税后现金流，但在不景气时期可能未使用而到期或递延，股权风险随TLCF增加而上升。在标定模型中，后一种效应占主导，平均而言风险随TLCF增加而上升。实证上，TLCF正向预测企业的波动率、贝塔系数及回报率。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104356.title: Tax loss carryforwards and firms’ risk
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104356.title_zh: 税收亏损结转与企业风险

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104358.abstract: We create a new measure of the value of an important, but previously understudied, intangible asset —trademarks. We quantify the stock market reaction to the publication of individual trademarks manually matched to U.S. publicly traded firms. We find that trademarks are used ubiquitously and possess substantial value: the median trademark is worth $20 million. Firms that obtain new trademarks subsequently launch new products, increase sales, invest more in physical capital, hire more employees, increase production output, become more profitable, and increase their market share considerably. For identification, we exploit the quasi-random assignment of USPTO examining attorneys to trademarks.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104358.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一种衡量重要但此前研究不足的无形资产——商标价值的新方法。通过将美国上市公司与个别商标的公开信息进行手工匹配，我们量化了商标公布时的股市反应。研究发现，商标被广泛使用且具有显著价值：中位数商标价值达2000万美元。获得新商标的企业随后会推出新产品、增加销售额、加大实物资本投资、扩充员工队伍、提升生产产出、增强盈利能力，并显著扩大市场份额。为识别因果关系，我们利用了美国专利商标局审查律师对商标的准随机分配机制。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104358.title: The value of trademarks

10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104359.abstract: We examine the dramatic collapse of the Terra blockchain in May 2022. Using granular blockchain data, we show that the run resulted from the interaction of three economic forces: subsidized money creation, real-time observability of transactions, and investor concentration. The early success of Terra’s algorithmic stablecoin, UST, was fueled by highly subsidized deposit rates, which attracted many investors but failed to engage them meaningfully with other services. Blockchain transparency allowed investors to observe Terra’s worsening fundamentals and monitor each other’s exits in real time. Larger and sophisticated investors reacted faster to adverse signals and served as catalysts for the run. These findings challenge the idea that blockchain transparency levels the playing field and highlight how greater observability and concentration can amplify financial fragility. Our results contribute to the understanding of the limits of private money creation and the dynamics of runs in fully digital financial systems.
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104359.abstract_zh: 我们审视了2022年5月Terra区块链的戏剧性崩溃。利用细粒度区块链数据，我们表明，此次挤兑源于三种经济力量的相互作用：补贴性货币创造、交易的实时可观测性以及投资者集中度。Terra算法稳定币UST的早期成功，得益于高补贴的存款利率，这吸引了众多投资者，但未能使他们有意义地参与其他服务。区块链的透明度使投资者能够观察到Terra日益恶化的基本面，并实时监控彼此的退出行为。规模较大且经验丰富的投资者对不利信号反应更快，成为挤兑的催化剂。这些发现挑战了区块链透明度能拉平竞争环境的观点，并强调了更高的可观测性和集中度如何放大金融脆弱性。我们的研究结果有助于理解私人货币创造的局限性以及全数字金融系统中挤兑的动态机制。
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104359.title: Anatomy of a run: The Terra Luna crash
10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104359.title_zh: 运行机制剖析：Terra Luna崩溃事件

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103164.abstract: Social health insurance expansions can affect not only new beneficiaries but also those who remain outside the program. This paper studies these spillovers in the context of Medicare Part D. Increases in insured demand can raise or lower price depending on market conditions: they may increase price when pharmaceutical firms face less elastic demand, but reduce price when demand concentration strengthens bargaining and pass-through in competitive markets. I find that Part D lowered the out-of-pocket unit price paid by Americans under age 65 without prescription drug insurance. Price declines are larger in therapeutic classes more exposed to Part D and in classes with stronger within-class competition, consistent with a demand-concentration channel. Demand increases mainly for generic drugs and among existing users.
