The implied consumer-surplus gain is roughly $76 per person per year, comprising about $65 from lower price on inframarginal consumption and $11 from additional consumption. Demand responses appear strongest among lower-income, younger, and healthier uninsured individuals, consistent with greater pre-existing non-adherence. Although price fall across several drug classes, demand does not increase significantly for medications associated with greater overuse in the United States, suggesting potentially positive net health spillovers.
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103164.abstract_zh: 社会医疗保险的扩展不仅会影响新增受益者，还可能影响那些仍处于计划之外的人群。本文以联邦医疗保险D部分为背景，研究这些溢出效应。受保需求的增加可能根据市场条件提高或降低价格：当制药企业面临较低的需求弹性时，价格可能上升；但当需求集中度增强议价能力并在竞争性市场中促进传导时，价格则可能下降。我发现，D部分降低了65岁以下无处方药保险的美国人所支付的自付单位价格。价格下降在受D部分影响更大的治疗类别以及同类内部竞争更强的类别中更为显著，这与需求集中渠道一致。需求增长主要集中于仿制药和现有使用者群体。由此产生的消费者剩余收益约为每人每年76美元，其中约65美元来自边际内消费的价格下降，11美元来自额外消费。需求响应在低收入、较年轻和较健康的未参保个体中表现最为明显，这与既有较高的不依从性一致。尽管多种药物类别的价格均有所下降，但与美国过度使用相关的药物的需求并未显著增加，这表明可能存在正向的净健康溢出效应。
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103164.title: The effect of health insurance expansion on price and demand for medications among the uninsured
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103164.title_zh: 医疗保险扩展对无保险人群药品价格与需求的影响

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103166.abstract: We estimate the short-term cognitive effects of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) exposure using novel exposure data collected during cognitive testing in Kenya. Unlike most existing studies that rely on satellite-based or fixed monitoring station data, we measure highly localized ambient pollution using portable monitors deployed at cognitive testing sites and link these readings directly to Harmonized Cognitive Assessment Protocol (HCAP) scores. Higher PM2.5 exposure during testing is associated with lower cognitive performance, particularly in executive function, memory, and visuospatial tasks. Binned exposure models suggest a monotonic pattern, with more negative estimates at higher exposure levels. Notably, effects are significantly larger among more educated individuals, possibly due to greater task demands or lower chronic exposure that limits physiological adaptation. Given that cognitive impairment is evident even at PM2.5 levels below Kenya’s mean annual regulatory threshold of 35 μ g /m 3 , the findings suggest that short-term exposure may impose underappreciated human capital costs that current regulatory standards fail to mitigate. The results highlight the potential cognitive and economic returns to interventions that reduce air pollution exposures in low-resource settings.
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103166.abstract_zh: 我们利用在肯尼亚认知测试期间收集的新型暴露数据，估算了细颗粒物（PM2.5）暴露对认知能力的短期影响。与多数依赖卫星或固定监测站数据的现有研究不同，我们在认知测试现场部署便携式监测器，测量高度局地化的环境污染物浓度，并将这些读数直接与协调认知评估协议（HCAP）得分相关联。测试期间较高的PM2.5暴露与较低的认知表现相关，尤其在执行功能、记忆和视觉空间任务中表现显著。分段暴露模型显示单调模式，在较高暴露水平下估计值更为负面。值得注意的是，教育程度较高个体的效应显著更大，这可能归因于更高的任务需求或较低的慢性暴露限制了生理适应。鉴于即使在PM2.5水平低于肯尼亚年均监管阈值35微克/立方米时，认知损伤依然明显，研究结果表明短期暴露可能带来当前监管标准未能缓解的、被低估的人力资本成本。这些结果凸显了在资源匮乏环境中减少空气污染暴露的干预措施可能带来的认知和经济回报。
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103166.title: Impacts of contemporaneous air pollution exposure on cognitive performance in Kenya
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103166.title_zh: 肯尼亚同期空气污染暴露对认知表现的影响

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103173.abstract: We examine the financial consequences of the 2007 California Fair Pricing Law, which places a price ceiling on hospital bills for financially vulnerable individuals. Using cross-sectional variation in exposure to the law, proxied by county-level uninsured rates, we estimate its impact on individual financial outcomes. We find that the law reduces the likelihood of incurring non-medical debt in collections and the number of non-medical accounts in collections. In addition, we find evidence that credit scores increased and suggestive evidence that the number of delinquent accounts decreased for individuals in more exposed counties. Our results suggest hospital billing regulations can improve targeted individuals’ financial outcomes.
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103173.abstract_zh: 我们研究了2007年加州公平定价法对财务脆弱人群医院账单设置价格上限所产生的财务后果。利用法律暴露程度的横截面差异，以县级未保险率作为代理指标，我们评估了该法律对个人财务结果的影响。研究发现，该法律降低了产生非医疗债务催收的可能性及非医疗催收账户的数量。此外，证据显示，在暴露程度更高的县，个人信用评分有所提升，且拖欠账户数量减少的迹象也较为明显。我们的结果表明，医院账单规定能够改善目标人群的财务状况。
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103173.title: Hospital Billing Regulations and Financial Well-being: Evidence from California’s Fair Pricing Law
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103173.title_zh: 医院计费法规与财务福祉：来自加州公平定价法的证据

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103174.abstract: This paper studies the health consequences of administrative centralization in healthcare, focusing on the consolidation of Local Health Authorities (LHAs) within the Italian National Health Service. This type of reform fits within a broader set of cost-containment efforts aimed at reducing administrative expenditures and exploiting economies of scale. In the Italian case, the reform centralized governance and expanded the scale of health administration, creating authorities with substantially larger catchment areas and shifting decision-making to more heterogeneous jurisdictions. Such changes may affect the responsiveness of healthcare provision to local needs, the coordination of service delivery, and access to care. Using an event-study Difference-in-Differences design, we estimate the policy's impact on municipal mortality rates, accounting for heterogeneous treatment effects and co-occurring fiscal adjustment policies. We find a significant increase in mortality starting four years after implementation, with an average treatment effect on the treated of 2.1%. The effects are concentrated in municipalities belonging to absorbed LHAs and in those exposed to mergers involving relatively large pre-reform LHAs and substantial post-merger expansions in catchment areas; they are also unevenly distributed, creating new vulnerable areas. Welfare estimates based on life-years lost indicate that the monetary costs of increased mortality exceed plausible administrative savings by roughly an order of magnitude.
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103174.abstract_zh: 本文研究了医疗行政集权对健康结果的影响，重点关注意大利国家卫生服务体系中地方卫生机构（LHAs）的合并。此类改革属于旨在削减行政开支并利用规模经济的一系列成本控制措施的一部分。在意大利案例中，改革集中了治理权并扩大了卫生行政的规模，形成了覆盖区域显著扩大且决策权转向更具异质性辖区的机构。这些变化可能影响医疗服务对地方需求的响应性、服务提供的协调性以及医疗服务的可及性。利用事件研究双重差分设计，我们评估了该政策对市级死亡率的影响，并考虑了处理效应的异质性及同时实施的财政调整政策。我们发现，政策实施四年后死亡率显著上升，处理组的平均处理效应为2.1%。这一效应集中于被吸收合并的地方卫生机构所在市镇，以及涉及合并前规模相对较大且合并后覆盖区域大幅扩张的地方卫生机构的市镇；同时，该效应分布不均，催生了新的脆弱区域。基于生命年损失的福利估算表明，死亡率上升带来的货币成本大约超过合理的行政节省一个数量级。
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103174.title: Consolidation of Local Health Authorities and mortality in the Italian NHS
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103174.title_zh: 意大利国家卫生服务体系中地方卫生当局的整合与死亡率

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103175.abstract: We study how individuals' migration decisions during a pandemic interact with the spatial allocation of hospital resources, characterizing both the laissez-faire equilibrium and the planner's allocation in closed form. Susceptible individuals leave high-infection cities while infected individuals move toward better-resourced ones, but these private decisions diverge from the planner's along two dimensions. First, the migration of infected agents toward susceptible-rich destinations raises transmission risk, a contagion externality the planner internalizes by restricting such flows. Second, the migration of infected agents toward better-resourced cities relieves hospital congestion at the epicenter, a congestion externality the planner internalizes by encouraging such flows. The two externalities work in opposite directions, and our comparative statics show when each dominates. The framework explains a cross-country pattern that standard misallocation theory cannot: during COVID-19, countries with greater regional dispersion in mortality tended to have lower aggregate mortality. This pattern arises naturally once contagion and endogenous mobility are added to a standard misallocation framework. More broadly, the analysis identifies a setting in which spatial dispersion can raise rather than reduce welfare, reversing the sign of the standard misallocation prescription.
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103175.abstract_zh: 我们研究了疫情期间个体迁移决策如何与医院资源的空间配置相互作用，并以闭式解形式刻画了自由放任均衡与规划者配置。易感个体离开高感染城市，而感染者则向资源更优的城市移动，但这些私人决策在两个方面与规划者的选择产生分歧。首先，感染者向易感人群密集目的地的迁移增加了传播风险，这是一种传染外部性，规划者通过限制此类流动将其内部化。其次，感染者向资源更优城市的迁移缓解了疫情中心的医院拥挤状况，这是一种拥挤外部性，规划者通过鼓励此类流动将其内部化。这两种外部性作用方向相反，我们的比较静态分析揭示了各自占优的条件。该框架解释了一种标准错配理论无法解释的跨国模式：在COVID-19期间，区域死亡率离散度较大的国家往往具有较低的总体死亡率。一旦将传染性和内生流动性纳入标准错配框架，这一模式便自然显现。更广泛而言，分析识别了一种情境，其中空间分散能够提高而非降低福利，从而逆转了标准错配处方的符号。
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103175.title: Contagion, migration, and misallocation in a pandemic
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103175.title_zh: 疫情中的传染、迁移与资源错配

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103176.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between union membership and deaths of despair. Using state-level variation in the timing of the adoption of right-to-work laws as a natural experiment, I show that right-to-work laws are associated with a decline in union membership and an increase in deaths of despair. Two-way fixed-effects (TWFE) difference-in-differences (DiD) estimates suggest that the adoption of a right-to-work law is associated with a 2.6 percentage point reduction in union membership and an increase in deaths of despair mortality of 13 additional persons per 100,000, implying there are approximately 7.5 additional deaths of despair for every 1000 workers who lose union membership. An analysis of mechanisms suggests the increase in mortality is largely driven by increased opioid usage and a concomitant increase in overdose deaths. I support the TWFE results with estimates from two alternative estimators robust to concerns about treatment effect heterogeneity and variation in treatment timing. Estimates from the Callaway and Sant’Anna (2021) estimator and the Borusyak et al. (2024) estimator support the TWFE findings: right-to-work laws reduce union membership and increase deaths of despair.
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103176.abstract_zh: 本文考察了工会会员身份与绝望死亡之间的关系。利用各州采纳工作权法时间上的差异作为自然实验，我表明工作权法与工会会员身份的下降及绝望死亡的增加相关联。双向固定效应（TWFE）双重差分（DiD）估计显示，采纳工作权法与工会会员身份降低2.6个百分点及绝望死亡死亡率每10万人增加13人相关，这意味着每1000名失去工会会员身份的工人中，大约有7.5例额外的绝望死亡。机制分析表明，死亡率的增加主要由阿片类药物使用增加及随之而来的过量死亡增加所驱动。我通过两种对处理效应异质性和处理时间变化具有稳健性的替代估计器来支持TWFE结果。来自Callaway和Sant’Anna（2021）估计器及Borusyak等人（2024）估计器的估计支持TWFE发现：工作权法减少了工会会员身份并增加了绝望死亡。
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103176.title: Labor unions and deaths of despair: Evidence from right-to-work laws
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103176.title_zh: 工会与绝望之死：来自工作权法的证据

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103177.abstract: Determining the value of different post-acute care settings for clinically similar patients is important for providers and payers. This study examines the causal effect of post-acute care (PAC) setting on Medicare spending and short-term patient outcomes among beneficiaries discharged from hospitals following treatment for stroke or congestive heart failure (CHF). Using 2013–2017 Medicare claims data, we implement an instrumental variable strategy that exploits daily variation in skilled nursing facility (SNF) bed occupancy at the hospital service area level to estimate the local average treatment effect of SNF versus home health agency (HHA) care. Our findings reveal no significant differences, on average, in 30-day mortality or rehospitalization rates between SNF and HHA care among stroke and CHF patients. However, the 95% confidence intervals do not exclude clinically meaningful reductions in 30-day mortality. Meanwhile, SNF care is associated with approximately $4,700 more in Medicare spending per PAC episode. The spending gap is larger in markets with more constrained SNF capacity, particularly in states with Certificate of Need regulations, rural areas, and low-income neighborhoods. However, we do not detect statistically significant differences in short-term health outcomes across these markets on average, suggesting that supply constraints may amplify the spending implications of SNF use while the relationship between PAC setting and short-term clinical outcomes remains uncertain. These findings highlight the importance of aligning PAC discharge decisions with both clinical needs and local capacity considerations, particularly under value-based payment models.
10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103177.abstract_zh: 确定临床相似患者在不同急性后期护理环境中的价值，对医疗服务提供者和支付方而言至关重要。本研究考察了急性后期护理（PAC）环境对中风或充血性心力衰竭（CHF）治疗后出院受益人的医疗保险支出及短期患者结局的因果效应。利用2013-2017年医疗保险索赔数据，我们实施了一种工具变量策略，利用医院服务区域层面熟练护理机构（SNF）床位占用率的日常变化，来估计SNF相对于家庭健康机构（HHA）护理的局部平均处理效应。研究结果显示，在中风和CHF患者中，SNF与HHA护理在30天死亡率或再入院率方面平均无显著差异。然而，95%置信区间并未排除30天死亡率在临床上显著降低的可能性。与此同时，SNF护理与每个PAC疗程约4，700美元的额外医疗保险支出相关。在SNF容量受限更严重的市场中，这一支出差距更大，尤其是在实施需求证明法规的州、农村地区及低收入社区。然而，我们未在这些市场中检测到短期健康结局的统计学显著差异，这表明供给约束可能放大SNF使用的支出影响，而PAC环境与短期临床结局之间的关系仍不确定。这些发现强调了在基于价值的支付模式下，将PAC出院决策与临床需求及当地容量考量相结合的重要性。

10.1016/j.jinteco.2025.104174.abstract: Stock markets of countries that actively engage in international trade may move together more or less depending on their international trade linkages. This paper demonstrates that the stock markets of two countries are less likely to move together if these countries compete intensely in their export product markets. This is in contrast to the higher stock co-movement of countries that share similar exposures to common demand shocks. The empirical patterns imply that stronger cross-border trade linkages may not result in higher cross-market return correlations.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2025.104174.abstract_zh: 积极参与国际贸易的国家的股票市场，其联动程度可能因国际贸易联系的不同而有所增减。本文证明，若两国在其出口产品市场上竞争激烈，则其股票市场更不易同步波动。这与那些面临共同需求冲击且暴露程度相似的国家间股票市场联动性较高的现象形成对比。实证模式表明，更强的跨境贸易联系未必导致更高的跨市场回报相关性。

10.1016/j.jinteco.2025.104203.abstract: We develop a model that shows how foreign reserve management decisions can adversely affect U.S. money market liquidity. Consistent with the March 2020 dash-for-cash, our model suggests that as export-price volatility increases, a foreign central bank that pegs its exchange rate shifts reserves from relatively illiquid Treasuries to the Fed’s reverse repo facility. Over the relevant horizon, this precautionary behavior drains liquidity from U.S. money markets and raises repo spreads. These predictions provide a credible channel to identify the effect of foreign central bank demand for dollar liquidity on repo spreads, exploiting the characteristics of commodity exporters with pegged exchange rates. Empirical evidence supports the model’s predictions: precautionary sales by these central banks lead to a statistically and economically significant widening of repo spreads, accompanied by a drawdown in Treasury balances. These results underscore how the Fed’s foreign-repo facilities mitigate global dollar-funding stress and protect U.S. short-term funding markets.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2025.104203.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，展示外汇储备管理决策如何对美元货币市场流动性产生不利影响。与2020年3月的“现金争夺”现象一致，我们的模型表明，随着出口价格波动性增加，实行汇率盯住制度的外国央行会将其储备从相对缺乏流动性的美国国债转向美联储的逆回购工具。在相关时间范围内，这种预防性行为会抽干美国货币市场的流动性，并推高回购利差。这些预测提供了一个可信的渠道，用以识别外国央行对美元流动性需求对回购利差的影响，利用的是实行盯住汇率制的商品出口国的特征。实证证据支持模型的预测：这些央行的预防性抛售导致回购利差在统计和经济意义上显著扩大，同时伴随美国国债余额的减少。这些结果强调了美联储的外国回购便利如何缓解全球美元融资压力，并保护美国短期融资市场。

10.1016/j.jinteco.2025.104204.abstract: We adopt a data-driven approach to measure trade decoupling over 2015-2023. Countries are classified into three groups according to changes in their data-inferred trade costs with the US and China: those shifting toward the US bloc, those shifting toward the China bloc, and those with no change in alignment. We document that while cross-bloc trade costs rose, they were accompanied by falling within-bloc trade costs, with average trade costs falling marginally in line with global trade resilience. We use a quantitative model to compute the real income effects of this reconfiguration of trade costs. Model simulations suggest that real income in the median country in the world, and the median country within each bloc, rose by 0.4-0.6%. Finally, we find a modest amount of bloc misalignment: the median country would be better off switching blocs. These results suggest that trade decoupling may not follow trade-driven economic interests.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2025.104204.abstract_zh: 我们采用数据驱动的方法来衡量2015年至2023年间的贸易脱钩现象。根据各国与美国和中国之间数据推断贸易成本的变化，将国家分为三组：转向美国阵营的、转向中国阵营的，以及联盟关系未发生变化的。我们记录到，虽然跨阵营贸易成本上升，但伴随而来的是阵营内贸易成本下降，平均贸易成本略有下降，这与全球贸易韧性相符。我们运用定量模型来计算这种贸易成本重构对实际收入的影响。模型模拟结果显示，世界中等国家以及各阵营内中等国家的实际收入增长了0.4%至0.6%。最后，我们发现存在适度的阵营错位：中等国家若转换阵营将获益更多。这些结果表明，贸易脱钩可能并不符合贸易驱动的经济利益。

10.1016/j.jinteco.2025.104207.abstract: We study the global impacts of sanctions on central bank assets. We build a database on freezes and seizures of central bank assets spanning 1914–2024. We show that the scale of the freeze on today’s Central Bank of Russia’s assets is rarely seen in history and that non-belligerent countries have never seized central bank assets to finance reconstruction in a third country in an ongoing war. We propose a three-country DSGE model to understand the global impacts of sanctions on central bank assets and tease out the macroeconomic mechanisms. One insight of the model is that seizing central bank assets can result in adverse effects on the sanctioning country in general equilibrium. Calibrated model simulations suggest that seizing Russia’s immobilized sovereign assets could result in higher interest rates on sanctioning countries’ government bonds. The increase in interest rate payments could surpass the assets’ amount seized after about three years.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2025.104207.abstract_zh: 我们研究了制裁对中央银行资产的全球影响。我们构建了一个覆盖1914年至2024年中央银行资产冻结与没收事件的数据库。研究表明，当今俄罗斯中央银行资产被冻结的规模在历史上极为罕见，且非交战国从未在持续冲突中没收中央银行资产以资助第三国的重建。我们提出了一个三国DSGE模型，以理解制裁对中央银行资产的全球影响，并揭示宏观经济机制。模型的一个洞见是，没收中央银行资产在一般均衡中可能对制裁国产生不利影响。校准模型模拟显示，没收俄罗斯被冻结的主权资产可能导致制裁国政府债券利率上升。约三年后，增加的利息支付可能超过被没收资产的金额。

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104219.abstract: How does trade fragmentation affect inflationary pressures? What is the response of monetary policy needed to sustain inflation at target? To address these questions, we develop a two-sector, small open-economy model that features imperfect international risk-sharing and household heterogeneity, capturing both the supply-side and demand-side effects of fragmentation. In the model, fragmentation takes the form of import-price increases or a decline in tradable-sector productivity. The sign and magnitude of its impact on inflationary pressures, and the appropriate policy response, depend not only on the direct effect of higher import prices or lower productivity on supply but also, crucially, on how aggregate demand adjusts to lower real incomes. In turn, this depends on the pace of fragmentation (gradual versus front-loaded) and other key structural factors highlighted by the model. We compare outcomes under Taylor-type monetary policy rules to a constrained-efficient allocation.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104219.abstract_zh: 贸易碎片化如何影响通胀压力？为维持通胀目标，货币政策需要作出何种反应？为解答这些问题，我们构建了一个包含不完全国际风险分担和家庭异质性的两部门小型开放经济体模型，以捕捉碎片化对供给侧和需求侧的双重影响。在该模型中，碎片化表现为进口价格上升或可贸易部门生产率下降。其对通胀压力的影响方向与程度，以及相应的政策应对，不仅取决于进口价格上升或生产率下降对供给的直接效应，还关键地取决于总需求如何适应实际收入下降。而这一适应过程又取决于碎片化的速度（渐进式与前置式）以及模型所强调的其他关键结构性因素。我们将泰勒型货币政策规则下的结果与约束有效配置进行了比较。

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104225.abstract: We present new empirical evidence on the role of granularity in the current account (CA), using a unique and comprehensive firm-level dataset for Switzerland. We show that idiosyncratic shocks to large firms account for almost two thirds of the fluctuations in the headline CA and are the primary source of CA volatility. The granular effect is present across goods, services, and income components and persists over both short- and medium-term horizons. In addition to their direct impact, idiosyncratic shocks propagate through inter-firm linkages via input–output relationships and cross-product connections associated with multinational enterprise activity. Our findings complement standard macroeconomic models by providing a micro-founded perspective and demonstrating the importance of granularity in explaining fluctuations in external balances.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104225.abstract_zh: 我们利用瑞士独特且全面的企业层面数据集，提供了关于颗粒度在经常账户（CA）中作用的新实证证据。我们表明，大型企业的特质性冲击几乎解释了头条CA波动的三分之二，并且是CA波动性的主要来源。这种颗粒效应存在于商品、服务和收入组成部分中，并在短期和中期时间跨度内持续存在。除了直接影响外，特质性冲击还通过企业间联系，经由投入产出关系及与跨国企业活动相关的跨产品连接进行传播。我们的发现通过提供微观基础视角并展示颗粒度在解释外部平衡波动中的重要性，补充了标准宏观经济模型。

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104230.abstract: Chinese portfolio equity outflows grew significantly over time due to capital account liberalization. Using matched stock-fund holding data under the Qualified Domestic Institutional Investor (QDII) program, we identify a nascent financial channel of international transmission of Chinese monetary policy to world stock markets. Event studies around monetary policy announcement days uncover a cross-sectional differential impact: returns on MSCI indexes and U.S. stocks with QDII exposure are more responsive than those of non-exposed ones. The effects are driven by smaller, less liquid, and lower-turnover stocks, but not by China-concept stocks, or those exposed to mainland macroeconomic shocks. We also provide evidence consistent with a retail-driven portfolio-rebalancing mechanism: tightening periods are associated with outflows from QDII funds with high equity portfolio shares that fund managers do not fully offset. Retail flows also seem more closely associated with monetary policy changes than institutional flows.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104230.abstract_zh: 由于资本账户自由化，中国组合证券投资流出随时间显著增加。利用合格境内机构投资者（QDII）计划下的匹配股票-基金持仓数据，我们识别出中国货币政策向全球股市传导的一个新兴金融渠道。围绕货币政策公告日的事件研究发现横截面差异影响：具有QDII敞口的MSCI指数和美国股票的回报率比未暴露的股票更为敏感。这些效应由规模较小、流动性较低及换手率较低的股票驱动，而非中国概念股或受中国大陆宏观经济冲击影响的股票。我们还提供了与散户驱动的投资组合再平衡机制相一致的证据：紧缩时期与股票组合占比较高的QDII基金资金流出相关，而基金经理并未完全抵消这些流出。散户资金流动似乎也比机构资金流动与货币政策变化更为紧密相关。

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104231.abstract: We study the behavior of Covered Interest Parity (CIP) deviations – aka the CIP basis – in Emerging Markets (EM). A major challenge in computing the CIP basis in EM’s lies in measuring local currency interest rates which are free of local credit risk and market segmentation. To do so, we construct a ‘purified’ CIP basis for eight major EM currencies using supranational bonds issued in EM local currencies and US dollar going back twenty years. We show that this ‘purified’ CIP basis aligns well with theory-implied predictions. In the cross-section and the time-series, the basis correlates with fundamental forces driving supply and demand for dollar forwards. Shocks to global dollar funding costs, global intermediary’s balance sheet capacity, and the demand for dollar safe assets interact with currency-specific dollar hedging and funding needs in moving the CIP basis in EM’s.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104231.abstract_zh: 我们研究了新兴市场中覆盖利率平价（CIP）偏离——即CIP基差——的行为。在新兴市场计算CIP基差的一个主要挑战在于衡量不受当地信用风险和市场分割影响的本币利率。为此，我们利用以新兴市场本币和美元发行的超国家债券，构建了八种主要新兴市场货币的“净化”CIP基差，时间跨度达二十年。我们表明，这一“净化”CIP基差与理论预测高度吻合。在横截面和时间序列上，该基差与驱动美元远期供需的基本力量相关联。全球美元融资成本冲击、全球中介机构资产负债表容量以及美元安全资产需求的变化，与货币特定的美元对冲和融资需求相互作用，共同影响新兴市场CIP基差的变动。

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104256.abstract: Using household- and firm-level data, we show that reductions in soybean tariffs lowered agricultural labor input and output, and improved agricultural efficiency. The shock induced a large reallocation of low-skilled labor into manufacturing, expanding firms’ employment but reducing firm-level productivity, while intensifying competition in urban low-skilled labor markets. Our quantitative analysis implies a small aggregate welfare loss, with substantial heterogeneity across sectors, regions, and skill groups. Importantly, lowering migration costs can substantially mitigate this welfare loss, highlighting the need to coordinate trade liberalization with domestic labor-market reforms. Comparing forces behind structural transformation, we find that agricultural import liberalization (“push”) was an important driver for labor reallocation, whereas manufacturing export expansion (“pull”) was the sole source of welfare gains.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104256.abstract_zh: 利用家庭与企业层面的数据，我们展示了降低大豆关税减少了农业劳动投入和产出，同时提升了农业效率。这一冲击引发了低技能劳动力向制造业的大规模重新配置，扩大了企业就业规模但降低了企业层面的生产率，同时加剧了城市低技能劳动力市场的竞争。我们的定量分析表明，总体福利损失较小，但各部门、地区和技能群体之间存在显著异质性。重要的是，降低迁移成本能大幅缓解这一福利损失，凸显了将贸易自由化与国内劳动力市场改革相协调的必要性。通过比较结构转型背后的驱动力，我们发现农业进口自由化（“推力”）是劳动力重新配置的重要推动因素，而制造业出口扩张（“拉力”）则是福利收益的唯一来源。

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104265.abstract: We study how supply chain disruptions shape consumer prices. We develop a simple model showing how disruptions that cause delivery delays affect pricing through product availability, beyond standard cost pass-through, and extend it to include strategic interactions across firms. Empirically, we construct a novel micro-level dataset linking shipment-level U.S. import records from Bills of Lading to granular consumer prices from the Numerator panel. Using delivery shortfalls, port congestion, and import costs in a shift-share identification strategy, we estimate the pass-through of supply chain shocks to retail prices. We find sizable but incomplete pass-through: both imported-input cost shocks and delivery delays raise prices, with stronger responses when disruptions persist. Firms also raise prices when competitors face disruptions—including those that do not import directly—indicating strategic pricing spillovers. Combining these estimates with back-of-the-envelope calculations, we show such interactions substantially amplify aggregate price effects, particularly through product availability, during the pandemic.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104265.abstract_zh: 我们研究了供应链中断如何影响消费者价格。我们构建了一个简洁模型，展示导致交货延迟的中断如何通过产品可得性影响定价，这超越了标准的成本传导机制，并将模型扩展至包含企业间的策略性互动。在实证方面，我们构建了一个新颖的微观层面数据集，将提单层面的美国进口记录与Numerator面板中的细粒度消费者价格相链接。利用交货短缺、港口拥堵及进口成本，并采用份额转移识别策略，我们估算了供应链冲击对零售价格的传导效应。研究发现传导效应显著但不完全：进口投入成本冲击与交货延迟均推高价格，且当中断持续时反应更为强烈。当竞争对手面临中断时——包括那些不直接进口的企业——企业也会提价，这表明存在策略性定价溢出效应。结合这些估计与粗略计算，我们表明此类互动显著放大了总体价格效应，尤其是在疫情期间，通过产品可得性渠道尤为突出。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104265.title: The price of delay: Supply chain disruptions and pricing dynamics
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104265.title_zh: 延迟的代价：供应链中断与定价动态

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104266.abstract: We study tariffs in a general equilibrium dynamic model with search frictions between heterogeneous exporting producers and importing retailers. We show the model has a unique equilibrium and analytically characterize home unilateral import tariffs that maximize welfare given a passive foreign country. Search frictions add two terms to the standard optimal tariff expression: One lowers tariffs when contact rates are low; another when private export costs exceed social opportunity costs. Search frictions also introduce new incentives to subsidize imports due to market thickness effects. We calibrate our baseline to U.S. and Chinese 2016 data. We compare this baseline to a counterfactual with international search costs reduced to domestic levels but with all other parameters fixed. We find that higher baseline search costs reduce optimal U.S. unilateral and Nash tariffs and attenuate welfare responses to tariff changes.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104266.abstract_zh: 我们在一个包含异质性出口生产商与进口零售商之间搜索摩擦的一般均衡动态模型中研究关税问题。我们证明该模型存在唯一均衡，并在外国被动的情况下，解析刻画了最大化本国福利的单边进口关税。搜索摩擦在标准最优关税表达式中增加了两项：一项在联系率较低时降低关税；另一项在私人出口成本超过社会机会成本时降低关税。搜索摩擦还因市场厚度效应引入了新的补贴进口激励。我们将基准模型校准至2016年美国和中国的数据，并将此基准与一个国际搜索成本降至国内水平但其他所有参数固定的反事实情形进行比较。我们发现，较高的基准搜索成本会降低美国最优单边关税和纳什关税，并减弱福利对关税变化的响应。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104266.title: Tariffs and goods-market search frictions
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104266.title_zh: 关税与商品市场搜寻摩擦

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104267.abstract: We investigate the impact of expectations about future climate policy on investment decisions of fossil fuel firms. Our empirical analysis reveals that within the fossil fuel industry, firms with high exposure to climate policy significantly increased their investment in response to the Paris Agreement relative to firms with low exposure. Importantly, the result is driven by traditional investment in fossil fuel exploration and extraction with no indications that firms invested in a transition towards renewable energy production, nor in reducing the carbon-intensity of fossil fuel production. Our findings contribute to the ongoing discussion about the potential adverse effects of delaying the implementation of planned climate regulation.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104267.abstract_zh: 我们研究了关于未来气候政策预期对化石燃料企业投资决策的影响。实证分析显示，在化石燃料行业内，相较于气候政策暴露度较低的企业，暴露度高的企业在《巴黎协定》后显著增加了投资。重要的是，这一结果主要由对化石燃料勘探与开采的传统投资驱动，并未发现企业投资转向可再生能源生产或降低化石燃料生产碳强度的迹象。我们的发现为当前关于推迟实施既定气候监管可能带来的不利影响的讨论提供了参考。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104267.title: Burn now or never? Climate policy exposure and investment of fossil fuel firms
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104267.title_zh: 现在还是永不燃烧？气候政策风险与化石燃料企业的投资

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104268.abstract: We consider five models of international trade that belong to the class of models in which the trade elasticity and domestic trade share are sufficient statistics for the welfare cost of autarky. Three are fixed-variety models featuring increasing micro-level margins of adjustment: versions of the Armington model, the Ricardian model, and its variable-markup counterpart. Two are endogenous-variety models featuring monopolistic competition: versions of the Krugman model and the Melitz model. For the three fixed-variety models, we show theoretically that, although they imply the same mapping from the trade elasticity to welfare, they imply different mappings from the trade elasticity to observed order statistics of price gaps of identical goods across countries. This result implies that choosing the parameter that governs the elasticity of trade to match the same order statistics in the data differentially impacts each model’s measured welfare cost of autarky. We quantify these differences for all five models.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104268.abstract_zh: 我们考察了五类国际贸易模型，这些模型均属于贸易弹性与国内贸易份额足以衡量自给自足福利成本的模型类别。其中三个为固定品种模型，体现了微观层面调整边际的递增：包括阿明顿模型、李嘉图模型及其可变加成变体。另外两个为内生品种模型，采用垄断竞争框架：即克鲁格曼模型和梅利茨模型。对于三个固定品种模型，我们从理论上证明，尽管它们从贸易弹性到福利的映射相同，但从贸易弹性到跨国同质商品价格差距观测顺序统计量的映射却各不相同。这一结果表明，为使贸易弹性参数与数据中的相同顺序统计量相匹配而进行的参数选择，会差异化地影响各模型测得的自给自足福利成本。我们对所有五个模型的这些差异进行了量化分析。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104268.title: Trade models, trade elasticities, and the gains from trade
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104268.title_zh: 贸易模型、贸易弹性与贸易收益

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104269.abstract: We provide the first systematic evidence on the short-run labor market consequences of the 25% decline in Canadian visits to the United States in 2025. We combine smartphone foot-traffic data measuring Canadian visitor presence at the ZIP code × industry level with real-time establishment-level employment records. Exploiting the high heterogeneity in exposure to Canadian visits, we find that small establishments in the top 1% exposed local-industry markets experienced employment declines of about 6% compared to less exposed ones. Our estimates imply between 13,900 and 42,100 jobs lost, concentrated in a small number of localities.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104269.abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于2025年加拿大赴美访问量下降25%对短期劳动力市场影响的首个系统性证据。我们将衡量加拿大游客在邮政编码×行业层面存在的智能手机人流数据，与实时企业层面的就业记录相结合。利用加拿大访问暴露度的高度异质性，我们发现，在暴露度最高的1%本地行业市场中，小型企业的就业相比暴露度较低的企业下降了约6%。我们的估计表明，约有13,900至42,100个工作岗位流失，且集中在少数地区。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104269.title: When neighbors stop knocking: The impact of Canada’s 2025 tourism decline on U.S. local labor markets
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104269.title_zh: 当邻居不再敲门：加拿大2025年旅游业下滑对美国地方劳动力市场的影响

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104270.abstract: This paper investigates the role of international air connectivity in shaping regional industrial specialization through its impact on manufacturing firm entry. Leveraging granular data on international airlines originated from China during the 2010s, we construct county-specific foreign market air access measure. To address endogeneity, we employ a shift–share IV strategy that isolates exogenous variations in global air service from local factors. Our findings reveal that counties experiencing greater expansions in foreign air access exhibit higher entry rates in industries where China's exports hold stronger revealed comparative advantages. Mechanism analysis indicates that improved air connectivity boosts export activity and profitability, disproportionately expand exports among young exporters, and foster trade in new product and destination markets. We also provide evidence that air connectivity mitigates contracting frictions by facilitating face-to-face interactions. Overall, our results highlight international air connectivity as an important driver of endogenous spatial sorting and export-biased industrial growth.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104270.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了国际航空连通性如何通过影响制造业企业进入，进而塑造区域产业专业化。利用2010年代源自中国的国际航空公司细粒度数据，我们构建了县级层面的外国市场航空通达度指标。为应对内生性问题，我们采用偏移-份额工具变量策略，从本地因素中分离出全球航空服务的外生变动。研究发现，外国航空通达度扩张更大的县，在中国出口具有较强显性比较优势的行业中，企业进入率更高。机制分析表明，改善的航空连通性促进了出口活动和盈利能力，不成比例地扩大了年轻出口企业的出口规模，并推动了新产品和目的地市场的贸易。我们还提供了证据，表明航空连通性通过促进面对面互动缓解了契约摩擦。总体而言，我们的研究结果凸显了国际航空连通性作为内生空间分选和出口偏向型产业增长的重要驱动因素。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104270.title: Air access to foreign markets and export-biased growth: Evidence from business entries
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104270.title_zh: 国外市场航空通达性与出口偏向型增长：基于企业进入的证据

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104278.abstract: This paper explores the impact of international experience on worker mobility, with a focus on Swedish companies acquired by foreign multinationals. We posit that international experience, by imparting knowledge about foreign operations, enhances an employee’s appeal to multinational enterprises (MNEs). By matching acquired firms with comparable control firms and using a stacked difference-in-differences methodology, we observe a significant impact of foreign acquisitions on job mobility. Our results indicate that foreign acquisitions raise the likelihood of switching to another MNE by 3.6 percentage points, while reducing moves to local firms by approximately 4 percentage points. Furthermore, workers who transition to another MNE post-acquisition have significantly higher wage growth compared to those who stay. Additional analyses reveal that the positive effect on mobility to MNEs is linked to learning opportunities stemming from increased trade linkages within multinational production networks and the implementation of advanced technologies after an acquisition.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104278.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了国际经验对劳动力流动性的影响，重点关注被外国跨国公司收购的瑞典企业。我们假设，国际经验通过传授关于外国运营的知识，增强了员工对跨国企业（MNEs）的吸引力。通过将收购企业与可比对照组企业进行匹配，并采用堆叠双重差分法，我们观察到外国收购对职业流动性有显著影响。结果显示，外国收购使员工转向另一家跨国企业的可能性提高了3.6个百分点，而转向本地企业的概率则降低了约4个百分点。此外，收购后转至其他跨国企业的员工，其工资增长显著高于留在原企业的员工。进一步分析表明，对跨国企业流动性的积极影响与学习机会相关，这些机会源于跨国生产网络内贸易联系的增强以及收购后先进技术的实施。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104278.title: From local to global: How foreign acquisitions reshape job mobility
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104278.title_zh: 从地方到全球：外资并购如何重塑职业流动性

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104281.abstract: We investigate the relationship between fiscal policy and inflation dynamics in the Euro Area, with a focus on the post-pandemic inflation surge. Using a structural vector autoregression identified via sign restrictions, we disentangle the effects of various demand- and supply-side shocks, including fiscal policy, on inflation. First, while both positive demand and adverse supply shocks contributed to the inflation surge, demand shocks were relatively more important. Second, fiscal stimulus played a substantial and progressively increasing role, particularly in influencing domestic-based measures of inflation. Finally, despite cross-country heterogeneity in the inflationary effects of fiscal stimulus, fiscal shocks were largely synchronized across the Euro Area.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104281.abstract_zh: 我们研究了欧元区财政政策与通胀动态之间的关系，特别关注疫情后的通胀飙升。通过使用符号限制识别的结构向量自回归模型，我们区分了包括财政政策在内的各种需求侧和供给侧冲击对通胀的影响。首先，尽管正向需求冲击和不利的供给冲击都促成了通胀飙升，但需求冲击相对更为重要。其次，财政刺激发挥了显著且逐步增强的作用，尤其是在影响基于国内的通胀指标方面。最后，尽管财政刺激的通胀效应存在跨国异质性，但欧元区内的财政冲击大体上是同步的。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104281.title: Fiscal policy and inflation in the Euro Area
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104281.title_zh: 欧元区财政政策与通货膨胀

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104282.abstract: Emerging economy central banks often hold large FX reserves while residents carry substantial local-currency-linked external liabilities. With financial frictions creating interest parity gaps, such opposing positions imply a carry cost. In a small open economy with intermediation frictions and inherited local-currency debt, we study optimal reserve and exchange rate policies, explaining why debtor economies may retain reserves rather than netting out costly gross positions. While policy can eliminate costly intermediation by deploying reserves and appreciating the real exchange rate, doing so creates a general equilibrium revaluation effect which raises the real burden of local-currency obligations. Optimal policy retains reserves, accepting some intermediation to avoid a larger revaluation loss. This policy is time-inconsistent: a discretionary central bank prefers stronger ex-post appreciation; a time-consistent equilibrium features more reserve retention and larger interest parity gaps. Revaluation costs restrain reserve deployment; when large, optimal policy retains more reserves during disruptions than in normal times.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104282.abstract_zh: 新兴经济体央行通常持有大量外汇储备，而居民则承担着大量与本币挂钩的外部负债。在金融摩擦导致利率平价缺口存在的情况下，这种对立头寸意味着一种持有成本。在一个存在中介摩擦和继承性本币债务的小型开放经济体中，我们研究最优储备与汇率政策，解释为何债务经济体可能保留储备而非抵消高成本的总额头寸。尽管政策可以通过动用储备并促使实际汇率升值来消除昂贵的中介活动，但这样做会产生一般均衡重估效应，从而提高本币债务的实际负担。最优政策保留储备，接受一定程度的中介活动，以避免更大的重估损失。该政策存在时间不一致性：一个具有自由裁量权的中央银行更倾向于事后更强的升值；而时间一致均衡则表现为更多储备保留和更大的利率平价缺口。重估成本制约储备的动用；当重估成本较大时，最优政策在危机期间保留的储备多于正常时期。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104282.title: Financial frictions, FX reserves, and exchange rate management with local-currency debt
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104282.title_zh: 金融摩擦、外汇储备与本地货币债务下的汇率管理

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104283.abstract: We study optimal bailout policies amidst banking and sovereign crises. Our model features sovereign borrowing with limited commitment, where domestic banks hold government debt and extend credit to the private sector. Bank capital shocks can trigger banking crises, prompting the government to consider extending guarantees over bank assets. This poses a trade-off: Larger bailouts relax financial frictions and increase output, but increase fiscal needs and default risk (creating a ‘diabolic loop’). Optimal bailouts exhibit clear properties. The fraction of banking losses the bailouts cover is (i) decreasing in government debt; (ii) increasing in aggregate productivity; and (iii) increasing in the severity of banking crises. Even though bailouts mitigate the adverse effects of banking crises, the economy is ex ante better off without bailouts: Having access to bailouts lowers the cost of defaults, which in turn increases the default frequency, and reduces the levels of debt, output, and consumption.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104283.abstract_zh: 我们研究了银行危机与主权危机并存时的最优救助政策。模型设定中，主权借款面临有限承诺约束，国内银行持有政府债务并向私营部门发放信贷。银行资本冲击可能引发银行危机，促使政府考虑对银行资产提供担保。这构成了权衡：更大规模的救助虽能缓解金融摩擦并提升产出，但会增加财政需求及违约风险（形成“恶魔循环”）。最优救助政策具有明确特征：救助覆盖银行损失的比例（i）随政府债务增加而下降；（ii）随总生产率提高而上升；（iii）随银行危机严重程度加剧而上升。尽管救助缓解了银行危机的不利影响，但事前而言，无救助的经济状况更优：救助的可获得性降低了违约成本，进而提高了违约频率，并减少了债务、产出和消费水平。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104283.title: Optimal bailouts in banking and sovereign crises
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104283.title_zh: 银行与主权危机中的最优救助

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104284.abstract: The invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 led to large and unprecedented sanctions against Russia. In parallel, many multinational firms voluntarily decided to suspend their activities in Russia. Using Spanish firm-level data, this paper quantifies the impact of trade sanctions and firms’ voluntary decisions to suspend activities on exports and imports with Russia. We find that firms’ voluntary decisions to suspend activities in Russia contributed to the reduction in exports and imports by 20% and 24%, respectively, while sanctions contributed by 10% and 34%, respectively. The results show that the combination of sanctions and firms’ voluntary suspension of activities caused a much greater reduction in trade with Russia than sanctions alone would have achieved.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104284.abstract_zh: 2022年2月对乌克兰的入侵导致了对俄罗斯大规模且前所未有的制裁。与此同时，许多跨国公司自愿决定暂停在俄罗斯的业务。利用西班牙企业层面的数据，本文量化了贸易制裁及企业自愿暂停业务的决定对与俄罗斯进出口的影响。我们发现，企业自愿暂停在俄罗斯业务的决定分别导致出口和进口减少了20%和24%，而制裁则分别贡献了10%和34%的减少。结果表明，制裁与企业自愿暂停业务的结合，对与俄罗斯贸易的削减效果远大于仅靠制裁所能达到的程度。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104284.title: Reducing trade with Russia: Sanctions vs. firms’ voluntary suspension of activities
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104284.title_zh: 减少与俄罗斯的贸易：制裁与企业自愿暂停活动

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104285.abstract: Using one million procurement contracts awarded in France and Spain, we quantify the importance of home bias in explaining governments’ purchases. First, we exploit that “home” has a different meaning for subnational and national governments and identify their relative home bias by comparing how local and non-local establishments sell to national and subnational agencies within a region. Second, we exploit a reorganization of French regions, to estimate how “new local” establishments sell to governments after the reform. Using a quantitative trade model, we find that governments’ home bias increases local expenditures shares by 29% and reduces governments’ output by 8%.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104285.abstract_zh: 利用法国和西班牙授予的一百万份采购合同，我们量化了本土偏好对政府购买行为的重要性。首先，我们利用“本土”对次国家级和国家级政府的不同含义，通过比较区域内本地与非本地企业向国家和次国家级机构销售的情况，识别出它们的相对本土偏好。其次，我们利用法国地区的重组，估计了改革后“新本地”企业如何向政府销售。借助定量贸易模型，我们发现政府的本土偏好使本地支出份额增加了29%，同时使政府产出减少了8%。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104285.title: Governments’ home bias and efficiency losses: Evidence from national and subnational governments
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104285.title_zh: 政府本土偏好与效率损失：来自国家及次国家级政府的证据

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104286.abstract: We study how relationship-specific learning affects the joint dynamics of exports and trade finance. Using micro-level Chilean data, we document that new exporters initially rely on cash-in-advance payments and gradually transition to providing trade credit as relationships mature, with faster transitions in riskier destinations and for less experienced firms. Motivated by this, we develop a general equilibrium trade model that integrates learning about foreign demand and counterparty risk together with firms’ endogenous export and trade finance choices. We use the model to investigate the role of learning and risks in shaping export adjustments and quantify the impact of shocks to the cost of trade finance on aggregate exports. We find that the response to these shocks depends on the riskiness of the destination and is amplified by the disruption of long-term trading relationships.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104286.abstract_zh: 我们研究了关系特定性学习如何影响出口与贸易融资的联合动态。利用智利微观层面数据，我们记录了新出口商最初依赖预付现金支付，并随着关系成熟逐步转向提供贸易信贷，且在风险更高的目的地和缺乏经验的企业中，这一转变速度更快。受此启发，我们构建了一个一般均衡贸易模型，该模型整合了对外国需求和交易对手风险的学习，以及企业内生性的出口和贸易融资选择。我们利用该模型探讨学习与风险在塑造出口调整中的作用，并量化贸易融资成本冲击对总体出口的影响。我们发现，对这些冲击的响应取决于目的地的风险程度，并因长期贸易关系的破裂而被放大。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104286.title: International trade finance and learning dynamics
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104286.title_zh: 国际贸易融资与学习动态

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104287.abstract: We study the uneven effects of a commodity cycle, documenting its impact across workers based on their skill level and the region where they live. To this end, we develop a dynamic quantitative model of a multi-region economy featuring spatial linkages (interregional trade and migration) and downward wage rigidity. Empirically, we focus on Brazil’s experience during the commodity boom of the 2000s and subsequent bust of the 2010s. The skill premium falls during the boom, while the extent of downward wage rigidity determines whether it reverts or maintains its decline during the bust. In addition, there is substantial heterogeneity across Brazilian states in the gains from the commodity cycle. Finally, we build counterfactuals to show that both spatial linkages (interregional migration and interregional trade) and downward wage rigidity jointly shape the impact of the commodity cycle on the skill premium, real wages, unemployment, and spatial disparities.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104287.abstract_zh: 我们研究了大宗商品周期的不均衡影响，记录了其对不同技能水平和居住地区工人的作用。为此，我们构建了一个包含空间联系（区域间贸易与迁移）和工资下行刚性的多区域经济动态量化模型。实证上，我们聚焦于巴西在2000年代大宗商品繁荣及2010年代随之而来的衰退期间的经历。技能溢价在繁荣期下降，而工资下行刚性的程度决定了其在衰退期是回升还是维持下降。此外，巴西各州在大宗商品周期中的收益存在显著异质性。最后，我们通过反事实分析表明，空间联系（区域间迁移与区域间贸易）和工资下行刚性共同塑造了大宗商品周期对技能溢价、实际工资、失业率及空间差异的影响。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104287.title: Spatial linkages and the uneven effects of a commodity boom
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104287.title_zh: 空间关联与大宗商品繁荣的非均衡效应

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104288.abstract: How do U.S. monetary tightening shocks affect emerging market economies, and how does the impact depend on these economies’ own macroeconomic vulnerabilities? We examine this question in a model that combines financial frictions with imperfect anchoring of inflation expectations, a key vulnerability in emerging markets. The degree of anchoring is disciplined using evidence that inflation expectations in emerging markets respond significantly to inflation surprises. Imperfect anchoring amplifies the contractionary effects of U.S. monetary shocks on emerging markets but also generates increases in inflation and nominal interest rates, patterns that we show are consistent with the empirical evidence but are not well explained by existing models. Our analysis also distinguishes between the drivers of U.S. policy tightenings. U.S. interest rate hikes resulting from stronger demand, rather than exogenous policy shocks, lead to modestly positive spillovers for emerging markets with well-anchored inflation expectations, but to substantial slowdowns in those with less-well-anchored expectations.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104288.abstract_zh: 美国的货币紧缩冲击如何影响新兴市场经济体，这种影响又如何取决于这些经济体自身的宏观脆弱性？我们在一个结合金融摩擦与通胀预期不完全锚定的模型中探讨此问题，后者是新兴市场的一个关键脆弱性。锚定程度通过新兴市场通胀预期对通胀意外显著反应的证据加以约束。不完全锚定放大了美国货币冲击对新兴市场的紧缩效应，但也导致通胀和名义利率上升，我们展示这些模式与实证证据一致，而现有模型未能充分解释。我们的分析还区分了美国政策收紧的驱动因素。源于需求增强而非外生政策冲击的美国利率上调，对通胀预期锚定良好的新兴市场产生适度正向外溢效应，但对锚定较差的经济体则导致显著放缓。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104288.title: U.S. monetary spillovers to emerging markets: Both policy drivers and vulnerabilities matter
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104288.title_zh: 美国货币政策对新兴市场的溢出效应：政策驱动因素与脆弱性均至关重要

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104289.abstract: We use regulatory data on the foreign claims and liabilities of global banks with U.S. operations to study how multinational lenders respond to large natural disasters abroad. Our difference-in-difference estimates show that, on average, international banks do not increase their lending to countries after destructive disasters that should increase the demand for funds. Consistent with information frictions, our results show that post-disaster lending is higher among banks with foreign affiliate offices and stronger pre-disaster lending relationships in affected countries. Our estimates predict substantial heterogeneity across countries in post-disaster international lending, with poorer countries seeing substantial declines and increases among richer countries.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104289.abstract_zh: 我们利用全球银行在美国运营的外国债权与负债监管数据，研究跨国银行如何应对海外重大自然灾害。我们的双重差分估计显示，平均而言，在破坏性灾害发生后，国际银行并未增加对受灾国的贷款，尽管这些灾害理应提升资金需求。与信息摩擦一致，我们的结果表明，在受灾国设有外国分支机构且灾前贷款关系较强的银行，其灾后贷款水平更高。我们的估计预测，各国在灾后国际贷款方面存在显著异质性，较贫穷国家贷款大幅下降，而较富裕国家则有所增加。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104289.title: Global banks and natural disasters

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104290.abstract: We study the internationalization of the Chinese renminbi (RMB) leveraging a unique policy experiment. In 2023, amid a dollar shortage, Argentina expanded a currency swap line with China. The share of imports from China invoiced in RMB surged rapidly, displacing the dollar, which had previously accounted for virtually all invoicing. Following the presidential election of late 2023, as the dollar shortage eased, invoicing in RMB declined. We explore the mechanisms behind this pattern, using firm-level data on imports, bank-firm loan relationships, and bank balance sheets. We find that banks played a key role. Firms with pre-existing relationships to banks with limited US dollar loans were more likely to switch to RMB. In addition, firms borrowing from a Chinese state-owned bank were more likely to use RMB. We also document firm-level spillovers, with RMB use for imports from China increasing RMB use for imports from other countries. Finally, firms switching to RMB saw increased total imports.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104290.abstract_zh: 我们利用一项独特的政策实验来研究人民币的国际使用。2023年，在美元短缺的背景下，阿根廷扩大了与中国的货币互换额度。从中国进口的商品以人民币计价的比例迅速上升，取代了此前几乎占据全部计价份额的美元。随着2023年末总统大选后美元短缺状况缓解，人民币计价比例有所下降。我们利用企业层面的进口数据、银行与企业间的贷款关系以及银行资产负债表，探讨了这一现象背后的机制。研究发现，银行在其中发挥了关键作用。与美元贷款有限的银行有既有关系的企业更倾向于转向使用人民币。此外，从中国国有银行借款的企业也更可能使用人民币。我们还记录了企业层面的溢出效应，即从中国进口时使用人民币会增加从其他国家进口时使用人民币的可能性。最后，转向使用人民币的企业总进口额有所增加。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104290.title: How to grow an invoicing currency: Micro evidence from Argentina
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104290.title_zh: 如何培育一种发票货币：来自阿根廷的微观证据

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104292.abstract: This study provides the first empirical analysis of how access to equity financing affects firm exports, leveraging China’s stringent approval system for initial public offerings (IPOs). Our empirical strategy compares the export performance of successful IPO applicants with that of “near misses” — applicants rejected at the final review meetings. To sharpen identification, we utilize meeting records to exclude rejections citing concerns about future revenue growth or profitability risks, as these may entail unobserved shocks to export performance. Our cohort-based difference-in-differences analysis reveals that IPO approval leads to a significant annualized increase of more than 6% in firm exports over the subsequent six years. In contrast to previous findings on debt financing, IPO approval primarily affects the extensive margin, enabling firms to expand into more destination-product markets. Mechanism tests suggest that IPOs enhance exports by financing intangible investments and fostering risk-taking activities.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104292.abstract_zh: 本研究首次实证分析了股权融资获取对企业出口的影响，利用中国首次公开募股（IPO）的严格审批制度作为研究背景。我们的实证策略比较了成功通过IPO申请的企业与“擦肩而过”的申请者——即在最终审核会议上被否决的申请者的出口表现。为加强识别，我们利用会议记录排除了因未来收入增长或盈利能力风险担忧而被否决的情况，因为这些担忧可能涉及影响出口表现的未观测冲击。基于队列的双重差分分析显示，IPO批准导致企业出口在随后六年内年均增长超过6%。与以往关于债务融资的研究发现不同，IPO批准主要影响扩展边际，使企业能够拓展至更多的目的地-产品市场。机制检验表明，IPO通过资助无形资产投资和促进风险承担活动来增强企业出口。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104292.title: Equity financing and exports: Evidence from IPO approvals in China
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104292.title_zh: 股权融资与出口：来自中国IPO审批的证据

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104293.abstract: This paper shows that diaspora networks played a pivotal role in directing early foreign investment to Chinese locations with weaker institutions and in catalyzing long-run industrial development. Using an administrative dataset of all foreign firms in China, we document that the post-1979 surge in foreign entry was led by diaspora firms whose legal representatives were overseas Chinese; large non-diaspora inflows arrived mainly in the late 1990s. Leveraging the staggered rolling-out of opening-up policies across prefectures during 1981-96 and employing the variation in the geographic distribution of surnames as an identification strategy, we find that diaspora firms preferentially entered prefectures likely to be their legal representatives’ ancestral origins. This pattern is stronger in contract-intensive industries and disappears around China’s WTO accession. Early diaspora entry had sizable long-run multiplier effects, attracting later non-diaspora FDI and fostering the development of industrial clusters and parks.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104293.abstract_zh: 本文表明，侨民网络在引导早期外资流向制度环境较弱的中国地区以及促进长期工业发展方面发挥了关键作用。利用涵盖中国所有外资企业的行政数据集，我们记录了1979年后外资进入的激增主要由法定代表人系海外华人的侨民企业引领；大规模非侨民外资流入则主要出现在1990年代末。借助1981年至1996年间各城市对外开放政策分阶段推行的自然实验，并利用姓氏地理分布差异作为识别策略，我们发现侨民企业倾向于进入其法定代表人可能祖籍所在的地区。这一模式在契约密集型行业中更为显著，并在中国加入世贸组织后消失。早期侨民企业的进入产生了显著的长期乘数效应，吸引了后续非侨民直接投资，并促进了产业集群和园区的形成发展。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104293.title: Familiar strangers: The role of diaspora networks in foreign investment and long-run development
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104293.title_zh: 熟悉的陌生人：侨民网络在外资与长期发展中的作用

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104294.abstract: We explore the negative balance sheet effect of foreign currency borrowing on the exchange rate pass-through to domestic prices. Exploiting a large, unexpected depreciation episode in Korea in 1997, we show that firms with higher foreign currency debt experience balance sheet deterioration and face lower growth rates of net worth, sales, and markups. We then empirically document that sectors populated by firms with higher foreign currency debt exposure prior to the depreciation exhibit larger price increases. Building a heterogeneous-firm model with financial constraints, we quantify the role of foreign currency debt in explaining the exchange rate pass-through to prices and find that 10% to 44% of sectoral price changes during the depreciation episode can be explained by the balance sheet effect of foreign currency debt alone. We emphasize the role of strategic complementarity in amplifying sectoral price increases.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104294.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了外币借款的负面资产负债表效应对汇率传导至国内价格的影响。利用1997年韩国一次大规模、意外的贬值事件，我们表明，外币债务较高的企业经历了资产负债表恶化，净资产、销售额和加价率的增长率均较低。随后，我们通过实证记录，贬值前外币债务敞口较高的企业所在行业表现出更大的价格上涨。通过构建一个包含金融约束的异质性企业模型，我们量化了外币债务在解释汇率传导至价格中的作用，并发现贬值期间10%至44%的行业价格变动可仅由外币债务的资产负债表效应解释。我们强调战略互补性在放大行业价格上涨中的作用。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104294.title: Liability dollarization and exchange rate pass-through to domestic prices
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104294.title_zh: 负债美元化与汇率传递对国内价格的影响

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104295.title: Introduction: NBER International Seminar on Macroeconomics
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104295.title_zh: NBER国际宏观经济学研讨会导论

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104296.abstract: This paper examines the international dimension of the post-pandemic inflation surge. We estimate an extended structural vector autoregressive (SVAR) model for Norway, Sweden, the United Kingdom, and the United States to disentangle domestic and foreign drivers of inflation. Foreign supply and demand shocks are identified through novel restrictions on import prices and trading-partner output, consistent with a simple New Keynesian model featuring firm-to-firm trade in intermediate inputs. Our results show that international demand shocks played a major role across countries. Foreign supply shocks absorb some explanatory power from domestic supply shocks, but demand factors remain the prevalent source of inflation.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104296.abstract_zh: 本文考察了疫情后通胀飙升的国际维度。我们为挪威、瑞典、英国和美国估计了一个扩展的结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型，以区分国内和国外通胀驱动因素。通过针对进口价格和贸易伙伴产出的新颖约束条件，我们识别了外国供给和需求冲击，这与一个包含企业间中间投入贸易的简单新凯恩斯模型相一致。结果表明，国际需求冲击在各国中发挥了重要作用。外国供给冲击从国内供给冲击中吸收了一些解释力，但需求因素仍是通胀的主要来源。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104296.title: Demand shocks during the post-pandemic inflation surge: An international perspective
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104296.title_zh: 后疫情通胀飙升期间的需求冲击：国际视角

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104297.abstract: Central bank policy decisions shape the economy both by influencing market conditions and by affecting expectations. These expectations can be driven by two simultaneous shocks: monetary and information shocks. Identifying the information shock as one with a non-negative effect on expectations, this paper shows that such shocks are highly relevant in emerging markets. In particular, inflation and output forecasts tend to increase in the short run following an unexpected rise in the policy rate. This pattern can be reconciled with baseline New Keynesian models only if the policy rate gives information about shocks that generate a positive co-movement between the interest rate, inflation, and output. The findings suggest that information shocks are an important part of monetary policy surprises.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104297.abstract_zh: 央行政策决策通过影响市场条件和预期来塑造经济。这些预期可能受到两种同时发生的冲击驱动：货币冲击和信息冲击。本文将信息冲击识别为对预期具有非负效应的冲击，并表明此类冲击在新兴市场中尤为重要。具体而言，在政策利率意外上升后，通胀和产出预测往往在短期内上升。这一模式只有在政策利率提供关于产生利率、通胀和产出正协同运动的冲击的信息时，才能与基准新凯恩斯模型相吻合。研究结果表明，信息冲击是货币政策意外的重要组成部分。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104297.title: Is the information channel of monetary policy alive in emerging markets?
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104297.title_zh: 新兴市场货币政策的信息渠道是否有效？

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104298.abstract: We analyze infectious diseases in a general equilibrium model with endogenous mobility, where forward-looking agents weigh disease risks against economic opportunities in cross-regional mobility decisions. This generates “self-containment” and “self-healing” mobility responses to regional differences in healthcare and prevalence. Applied to US COVID-19 data, our model reveals that cross-state mobility restrictions curbed infections by reducing cross-regional contacts but increased deaths and output losses by hindering mobility toward regions with better recovery outcomes. Relative to a model with exogenous mobility, our framework predicts fewer infections, lower mortality, and higher economic output following the unanticipated pandemic shock.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104298.abstract_zh: 我们在一个具有内生流动性的一般均衡模型中分析传染病，其中前瞻性主体在跨区域流动决策中权衡疾病风险与经济机会。这产生了对区域医疗保健和患病率差异的“自我隔离”和“自我修复”流动性响应。应用于美国COVID-19数据，我们的模型揭示，跨州流动性限制通过减少跨区域接触遏制了感染，但通过阻碍向恢复结果更好区域的流动增加了死亡和产出损失。相对于具有外生流动性的模型，我们的框架在未预期疫情冲击后预测出更少的感染、更低的死亡率和更高的经济产出。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104298.title: Endogenous mobility in pandemics: Theory and evidence from the United States
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104298.title_zh: 大流行中的内生流动性：来自美国的理论与证据

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104299.abstract: We identify the liquidity channel through which Federal Reserve quantitative easing (QE) and quantitative tightening (QT) affect capital flows to emerging markets. Using weekly data on the Fed’s purchases and sales of long-term U.S. Treasury securities, we find that large purchases lead to a significant increase in capital flows to emerging markets, and that sales have the reverse effect. We then show that QE lowers, and QT raises, the convenience yield on U.S. Treasuries, measured by covered interest parity deviations, and that the induced changes in the convenience yield drive the capital flow responses. Our model based on liquidity rationalizes these findings: QE shifts publicly held government debt toward more liquid assets, providing investors a greater buffer against the risk of low consumption. Better insured through liquid asset holdings, investors are willing to increase illiquid investments, including lending to emerging markets.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104299.abstract_zh: 我们识别了美联储量化宽松（QE）与量化紧缩（QT）影响新兴市场资本流动的流动性渠道。利用美联储购买和出售长期美国国债的周度数据，我们发现大规模购买显著增加了流向新兴市场的资本，而出售则产生相反效应。随后，我们证明QE降低了美国国债的便利收益率，而QT则提高了该收益率，这一指标通过覆盖利率平价偏差来衡量，且由此引发的便利收益率变化驱动了资本流动的反应。我们基于流动性的模型合理化了这些发现：QE将公众持有的政府债务转向更具流动性的资产，为投资者提供了应对低消费风险的更大缓冲。通过持有流动性资产获得更好的保障后，投资者更愿意增加非流动性投资，包括向新兴市场放贷。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104299.title: U.S. liquid government liabilities and emerging market capital flows
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104299.title_zh: 美国流动性政府负债与新兴市场资本流动

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104300.abstract: The slowdown in globalization has been analyzed primarily from the viewpoint of trade and aggregate investment. Based on a rich micro-level dataset of worldwide affiliate networks of European MNEs, we define an episode approach to (i) analyze the extent and direction of foreign network restructuring between 2010 and 2019, and (ii) estimate its effects on home-country activity. We find evidence of a strong rise in contraction episodes and a substantial fall in expansion episodes in the second half of this decade. Both contraction and expansion episodes have increasingly gone hand in hand with a reorientation towards geopolitically aligned countries (friendshoring) and a reduced geographic scope (nearshoring). We do not find any systematic increase in home-country activity for networks that contract abroad, neither along the extensive nor the intensive network margin. By contrast, foreign expansion episodes are associated with increased parent activity and a rise in the number of domestic affiliates.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104300.abstract_zh: 全球化的放缓主要从贸易和总体投资的角度进行了分析。基于欧洲跨国公司全球关联网络的丰富微观数据集，我们定义了一种事件研究方法，旨在（i）分析2010年至2019年间外国网络重组的程度与方向，以及（ii）评估其对母国活动的影响。我们发现，在这十年的后半段，收缩事件显著增加，而扩张事件大幅减少。收缩与扩张事件均日益与向地缘政治联盟国家（友岸外包）的重新定向及地理范围缩小（近岸外包）相伴发生。我们未发现任何系统性的证据表明，在海外收缩的网络会提升母国活动，无论是在网络广度还是深度方面。相反，外国扩张事件与母公司活动的增加及国内关联企业数量的上升相关联。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104300.title: Multinational network restructuring, geopolitical exposure, and home country effects – Evidence for European MNEs
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104300.title_zh: 跨国网络重构、地缘政治暴露与母国效应——基于欧洲跨国企业的证据

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104307.abstract: This paper examines how trust among ultimate owners and their affiliates shapes business group structure and correlates with firm productivity. We first confirm that greater business group verticality is associated with higher firm productivity. We then develop a theoretical model explaining how bilateral trust influences group verticality. To test these predictions, we construct a novel dataset by developing an algorithm that extends Amadeus ownership links into ownership chains, allowing us to measure verticality for a large European sample. We find that groups with higher average trust among members are more vertically structured. Firm-level estimates indicate that more trustworthy affiliates are positioned in a layer closer to the ultimate owner and exhibit higher productivity. Results are robust to using somatic distance as an instrument for bilateral trust.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104307.abstract_zh: 本文考察了最终所有者与其关联方之间的信任如何塑造企业集团结构，并探究其与企业生产率的相关性。我们首先证实，企业集团垂直化程度越高，企业生产率也越高。随后构建理论模型，阐释双边信任如何影响集团垂直化程度。为验证上述预测，我们开发了一种算法，将Amadeus数据库中的所有权链接扩展为所有权链条，据此构建了覆盖欧洲大型样本的新数据集。研究发现，成员间平均信任度更高的集团呈现更显著的垂直结构。企业层面估计表明，可信度更高的关联方更接近最终所有者层级，且表现出更高的生产率。采用体细胞距离作为双边信任的工具变量后，结果依然稳健。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104307.title: Trust, business group verticality, and firm productivity
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104307.title_zh: 信任、企业集团垂直性与企业生产率

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104308.abstract: Deviations from covered interest rate parity (CIP) have persisted since the global financial crisis, reflecting a segmentation between onshore (US) and offshore dollar markets. This segmentation can give rise to dollar shortages in offshore markets during periods of financial stress. We propose a model with limited CIP and UIP arbitrage where the CIP deviation and exchange rate are jointly determined by equilibrium in the swap and spot FX markets. We consider offshore dollar funding shocks, where either the supply of dollar funding by the US to offshore markets declines or the demand for dollar funding in offshore markets rises. We show that this gives rise to dollar shortages, with a rise in the CIP deviation and appreciation of the dollar. In contrast to other models of exchange rate determination, the dollar appreciation is entirely due to imperfect CIP arbitrage.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104308.abstract_zh: 自全球金融危机以来，对利率平价（CIP）的偏离持续存在，反映了在岸（美国）与离岸美元市场之间的分割。这种分割在金融压力时期可能导致离岸市场出现美元短缺。我们提出了一个具有有限CIP和UIP套利的模型，其中CIP偏差和汇率由掉期市场和即期外汇市场的均衡共同决定。我们考虑了离岸美元融资冲击，即美国向离岸市场的美元融资供应减少或离岸市场对美元融资需求上升的情况。我们表明，这会导致美元短缺，伴随CIP偏差上升和美元升值。与其他汇率决定模型不同，这里的美元升值完全归因于不完全的CIP套利。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104308.title: Offshore dollar funding shocks and the dollar exchange rate
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104308.title_zh: 离岸美元融资冲击与美元汇率

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104309.abstract: Policies aimed at promoting currency internationalization often target frictions in both capital and current account transactions. We study this two-pronged approach using a dynamic general equilibrium model in which an international currency serves as both a store of value and a medium of exchange. Due to the complementarity between different functions of an international currency, a two-pronged approach is more effective than policies with a single focus. We analytically characterize this policy complementarity and apply the model to China’s renminbi internationalization reforms during 2010-2021. We find that: (1) These reforms reduced the return wedge on foreign held renminbi bonds by 4.1 percentage points (p.p.) and lowered the cost of renminbi-settled international trade by 0.9 p.p. in trade-revenue equivalent. (2) Policy complementarity accounted for half of the overall policy effect. (3) A single-focused policy — targeting only capital (current) account frictions — would have raised fiscal costs by a factor of 2.1 (1.8).
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104309.abstract_zh: 旨在促进货币国际化的政策往往针对资本与经常账户交易中的摩擦。我们通过一个动态一般均衡模型来研究这种双管齐下的策略，在该模型中，国际货币既充当价值储存手段，又充当交换媒介。鉴于国际货币不同功能之间的互补性，双管齐下的方法比单一聚焦的政策更为有效。我们从理论上刻画了这种政策互补性，并将模型应用于2010-2021年间中国人民币国际化的改革实践。研究发现：（1）这些改革使境外持有的人民币债券的回报率差距缩小了4.1个百分点，并以贸易收入等价计算，将人民币结算的国际贸易成本降低了0.9个百分点。（2）政策互补性贡献了总体政策效果的一半。（3）若仅针对资本（或经常）账户摩擦采取单一聚焦政策，财政成本将分别增加至原来的2.1倍（或1.8倍）。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104309.title: A two-pronged approach to currency internationalization
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104309.title_zh: 货币国际化的双管齐下策略

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104310.abstract: This paper examines the impact of roads on structural transformation and business composition both empirically and theoretically. Empirically, we find that major highway programs in India and China led to declines in the number of businesses where structural transformation is weak, and increases where it is strong. We develop a two-sector model of regional trade with endogenous firm entry that highlights two opposing forces. Ceteris paribus , lower trade costs in non-agriculture lead to fewer firms, but cheaper agricultural imports release labor from local agricultural production, leading to more firms. We show that the model-simulated outcomes reasonably replicate the empirical results, and that more rapid agricultural productivity growth in China differentiates the two countries.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104310.abstract_zh: 本文从实证与理论两个层面探讨了道路建设对结构转型及企业构成的影响。实证研究发现，印度与中国的重大高速公路项目导致结构转型薄弱地区的企业数量减少，而结构转型强劲地区的企业数量增加。我们构建了一个包含内生企业进入的两部门区域贸易模型，揭示了两种相反的作用力：在其他条件不变的情况下，非农业贸易成本的降低会导致企业数量减少，但更廉价的农产品进口会释放本地农业劳动力，从而促使企业数量增加。研究表明，模型模拟结果能够合理复现实证结论，且中国更快的农业生产力增长是两国差异的关键因素。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104310.title: Melitz meets Lewis: The impacts of roads on structural transformation and businesses
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104310.title_zh: 梅利茨遇见刘易斯：道路对结构转型与企业的影响

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104311.abstract: Two facts distinctively separate exporter dynamics from firm dynamics. One is the strikingly low survival rate of new entrants into export markets. The second is that new entrants survive less than re-entrants. We argue that these two facts are particularly useful to discipline exporter dynamics models because many sources of firm heterogeneity (e.g. fixed costs) do not affect survival rates when firms time their entry decision optimally. We extend a standard exporter dynamics model by positing that firms experiment to resolve an uncertain component in foreign-market profitability. We estimate the model using customs data from Peru. Despite its parsimony, having only four relevant parameters, the model matches the survival profile of new entrants and re-entrants. It is also sufficiently rich to deliver predictions about many exporter dynamics facts highlighted in the literature. Finally, we exploit variation across products and markets to provide additional evidence supporting the model’s experimentation mechanism.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104311.abstract_zh: 两个显著事实将出口商动态与企业动态区分开来。其一，新进入出口市场的企业存活率极低。其二，新进入者的存活率低于重新进入者。我们认为，这两个事实对于约束出口商动态模型尤为有用，因为当企业最优地选择进入时机时，许多企业异质性来源（如固定成本）并不影响存活率。我们通过假设企业进行试验以解决国外市场盈利能力中的不确定成分，扩展了标准出口商动态模型。我们利用秘鲁的海关数据估计该模型。尽管模型极为简约，仅包含四个相关参数，却能匹配新进入者和重新进入者的存活率曲线。同时，该模型也足够丰富，能够对文献中强调的众多出口商动态事实提供预测。最后，我们利用产品和市场间的差异，为模型的试验机制提供了额外支持证据。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104311.title: Exporter survival with uncertainty and experimentation
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104311.title_zh: 不确定性与实验下的出口商生存

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104312.abstract: Domestic policies regulating the horizontal dimensions of product differentiation can impede international trade and have become a major concern in contemporary trade negotiations. We estimate trade frictions associated with incompatible designs of electric plugs, a well-known example of a horizontal regulatory barrier. Our findings indicate that fewer electronic devices are exported to destinations with incompatible electric plugs, and this effect operates through both the extensive margin and the intensive margin of exports. These results are further corroborated by an online survey of Chinese electronics exporters. Moreover, incompatible plugs are associated with lower average quality of exported electronic devices, suggesting that horizontal regulatory barriers are linked to variation in the vertical dimension of product differentiation.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104312.abstract_zh: 国内政策对产品差异化横向维度的规制可能阻碍国际贸易，并已成为当代贸易谈判中的主要关切。我们估算了与电源插头不兼容设计相关的贸易摩擦，这是横向监管壁垒的一个著名例子。研究结果表明，出口至电源插头不兼容目的地的电子设备数量减少，且这一效应通过出口的扩展边际和集约边际同时发挥作用。这些结果进一步得到对中国电子产品出口商的在线调查的佐证。此外，不兼容的插头与出口电子设备的平均质量较低相关联，这表明横向监管壁垒与产品差异化的纵向维度变化存在联系。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104312.title: Horizontal regulatory barriers in international trade: Evidence from electric plugs
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104312.title_zh: 国际贸易中的横向监管壁垒：来自电源插头的证据

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104313.abstract: Since the launch of the euro, the Euro Area has combined weak growth with persistent trade surpluses, a rising trade share, and the absence of a real exchange rate trend. In academic and policy debates, the Euro Area's trade surplus is often viewed as reflecting weak domestic aggregate demand. This paper argues that a purely demand-based view of the trade balance is incomplete. Using an estimated two-region framework, we find that slower productivity growth in the Euro Area has been a major driver of the trade surplus since 1999, while demand shocks play an important role in the rising trade balance following the global financial crisis. We further show that real exchange rate dynamics cannot be understood from productivity growth differentials and aggregate demand shocks alone, but also reflect longer-run shifts in trade patterns.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104313.abstract_zh: 自欧元启动以来，欧元区在经济增长疲软的同时，持续出现贸易顺差、贸易份额上升以及实际汇率无趋势的现象。在学术与政策讨论中，欧元区的贸易顺差常被视为国内总需求疲软的反映。本文认为，纯粹基于需求的贸易余额观点并不完整。通过使用一个估计的两区域框架，我们发现，自1999年以来，欧元区生产率增长放缓是贸易顺差的主要驱动因素，而需求冲击在全球金融危机后贸易余额上升中扮演了重要角色。我们进一步表明，实际汇率动态无法仅从生产率增长差异和总需求冲击来理解，还反映了贸易模式的长期转变。

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104314.abstract: In the past two decades, several banks have joined global initiatives aimed at enhancing the disclosure of their assets and climate commitments. We study whether banks that joined such initiatives have altered the emissions exposure of their syndicated loans. We rely on loan-level data with global coverage combined with country-industry data on emissions. We find that on average, banks have reduced the emissions exposure of their syndicated loans portfolio. However, we do not find statistically significant or robust differences between banks that did and those that did not subscribe to climate commitments. In the few instances where we found a statistically significant change after becoming a signatory to a climate initiative, the effect was temporary or did not survive our robustness testing. We conclude that, on average, while banks reduced their relative lending to high-emission sectors, voluntary climate commitments did not contribute to syndicated loan reallocation away from those sectors.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104314.abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，多家银行加入了旨在提升资产与气候承诺披露水平的全球性倡议。我们研究了加入此类倡议的银行是否改变了其银团贷款的排放暴露。我们利用覆盖全球的贷款层面数据，结合国家-行业层面的排放数据进行分析。研究发现，平均而言，银行已降低了其银团贷款组合的排放暴露。然而，在签署与未签署气候承诺的银行之间，我们未发现统计上显著或稳健的差异。在少数情况下，我们发现成为气候倡议签署方后出现了统计显著的变化，但该效应或是暂时性的，或是未能通过我们的稳健性检验。我们得出结论：平均来看，尽管银行减少了对高排放行业的相对贷款，但自愿性气候承诺并未促使银团贷款从这些行业进行重新配置。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104314.title: Industrial composition of syndicated loans and banks’ climate commitments
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104314.title_zh: 银团贷款的行业构成与银行的气候承诺

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104315.abstract: How do global production networks and market structure interact to shape the gains from trade and competition policy? We develop a quantifiable model with two-sided firm heterogeneity, matching frictions, and imperfect competition. More productive buyers match with more suppliers, which spurs tougher competition, lowers input costs, and raises profits. Reduced-form evidence confirms that larger French and Chilean firms import higher quantities at lower prices as more Chinese suppliers enter, and that suppliers charge diversified buyers lower markups. We estimate the model by extending recent methods for combinatorial discrete-choice problems. Counterfactuals reveal that entry upstream benefits primarily high-productivity buyers, while lower trade or matching costs favor mid-productivity firms. Moreover, the interaction between endogenous networks and markups significantly amplifies the welfare gains from entry upstream, as well as from packaging trade liberalization with reductions in matching or entry costs.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104315.abstract_zh: 全球生产网络与市场结构如何相互作用，以塑造贸易收益与竞争政策？我们构建了一个可量化的模型，包含双边企业异质性、匹配摩擦和不完全竞争。生产率更高的买家与更多供应商匹配，这促进了更激烈的竞争，降低了投入成本，并提高了利润。简化形式的证据证实，随着更多中国供应商进入，较大的法国和智利企业以更低价格进口更多数量，且供应商对多元化买家收取较低的加成。我们通过扩展组合离散选择问题的最新方法对模型进行估计。反事实分析显示，上游进入主要惠及高生产率买家，而降低贸易或匹配成本则有利于中等生产率企业。此外，内生网络与加成之间的相互作用显著放大了上游进入带来的福利收益，以及将贸易自由化与匹配或进入成本降低相结合所带来的福利收益。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104315.title: Global production networks and imperfect competition
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104315.title_zh: 全球生产网络与不完全竞争

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104316.abstract: Interest rate spreads vary widely across time and countries and are a central driver of business cycles in emerging market economies (EMEs). Since 2008, advanced market economies (AMEs) have exhibited persistently higher and more volatile spreads, alongside increased macroeconomic volatility and stronger co-movement with EMEs. We document six facts showing that AMEs have become more similar to EMEs along key dimensions. We interpret these patterns through a small open economy model and uncover a stark dichotomy: higher spreads reflect greater indebtedness and lower debt tolerance, whereas greater macroeconomic volatility and co-movement are driven by stronger global shocks.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104316.abstract_zh: 利率利差在不同时期和国家间差异显著，是新兴市场经济体（EMEs）商业周期的主要驱动力。自2008年以来，发达市场经济体（AMEs）表现出持续更高且更波动的利差，同时伴随宏观经济波动性增强以及与EMEs的联动性加强。我们记录了六项事实，表明AMEs在关键维度上已与EMEs更加相似。我们通过一个小型开放经济模型解释这些模式，并揭示了一个鲜明的二分法：更高的利差反映了更高的债务水平和较低的债务容忍度，而更大的宏观经济波动性和联动性则是由更强的全球冲击所驱动。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104316.title: Different no more: Country spreads in advanced and emerging economies
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104316.title_zh: 不再不同：发达与新兴经济体的国家利差

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104317.abstract: What inflation rate should central banks target? Using two global surveys, we provide evidence on inflation preferences among economic experts—the group whose models and judgments inform monetary policy. We document that, although experts’ preferred inflation rates are centered on central-bank targets, roughly half of them deviate (symmetrically) from the target. Cross-expert heterogeneity in preferences is driven by (i) beliefs about the costs of disinflation, (ii) normative views on the relative importance of different central bank objectives, and (iii) inflation narratives. Finally, we show that experts’ preferences influence their evaluations of monetary policy decisions, suggesting that experts’ preferences are likely to matter for policymaking.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104317.abstract_zh: 中央银行应设定何种通胀目标？借助两项全球性调查，我们提供了经济专家——这一群体的模型与判断指导货币政策——对通胀偏好的证据。我们发现，尽管专家们偏好的通胀率围绕中央银行目标为中心，但大约半数专家的偏好（对称地）偏离该目标。专家间偏好的异质性受以下因素驱动：（一）对通胀减速成本的信念，（二）关于不同央行目标相对重要性的规范性观点，以及（三）通胀叙事。最后，我们表明专家的偏好影响其对货币政策决策的评价，暗示专家的偏好很可能对政策制定产生影响。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104317.title: Expert inflation preferences and the evaluation of monetary policy
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104317.title_zh: 专家通胀偏好与货币政策评估

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104325.abstract: We investigate how transportation networks influence agricultural technology adoption and structural transformation. Our empirical results show that improved transport networks lower non-labor input prices relative to wages and promote the adoption of more productive labor-saving technologies. These changes increase agricultural labor productivity and facilitate structural transformation. In our calibrated model, transportation improvements alone account for a 2.2–2.5 percentage-point decline in India’s agricultural employment share, representing approximately 16–18 percent of the total decline observed in the data. A counterfactual exercise in which farmers cannot choose their technology results in a smaller structural transformation, highlighting the role of farmers’ adoption decision in the process of structural transformation.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104325.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了交通网络如何影响农业技术采纳与结构转型。实证结果显示，改善的交通网络降低了非劳动力投入品价格相对于工资的水平，并促进了更具生产力的节省劳动力技术的采纳。这些变化提升了农业劳动生产率，并推动了结构转型。在我们的校准模型中，仅交通改善一项就解释了印度农业就业份额下降2.2至2.5个百分点，约占数据中观察到的总下降幅度的16%至18%。一项反事实模拟中，若农民无法选择技术，则结构转型幅度较小，这凸显了农民采纳决策在结构转型过程中的作用。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104325.title: Transportation networks, technology adoption, and structural transformation
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104325.title_zh: 交通网络、技术采纳与结构转型

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104326.abstract: This paper examines trade-induced restructuring at the extensive margin, using a novel measure of new work—jobs employing new knowledge, skills, and technologies—based on the emergence of new job titles over time. I find that import competition significantly increases the adoption of new work in US manufacturing industries. I further show that offshoring is central to this restructuring process and is accompanied by compositional shifts toward non-production activities. Finally, evidence from local labor market analysis indicates that these adjustments extend beyond within-industry responses and that new work is a critical channel through which trade shocks increase local wage inequality.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104326.abstract_zh: 本文考察了贸易引致的广泛边际重组，采用一种基于新职业头衔随时间涌现的新颖度量——新工作（即运用新知识、技能和技术的岗位）。我发现进口竞争显著增加了美国制造业行业中新工作的采纳。我进一步表明，离岸外包在这一重组过程中至关重要，并伴随着向非生产活动的构成性转变。最后，来自地方劳动力市场分析的证据表明，这些调整超越了行业内反应，且新工作是贸易冲击加剧地方工资不平等的一个关键渠道。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104326.title: The extensive margin of restructuring: Adoption of new work in a global economy
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104326.title_zh: 重组的广延边际：全球经济中新工作的采用

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104327.abstract: This paper examines how the US-China trade war reshaped supply chains across the Asia-Pacific region. Using newly constructed product-level input–output linkages from Chinese customs transactions, we trace how US tariffs on downstream Chinese exports propagated across borders and production stages. We document that US tariffs significantly reduced Chinese exports to the US and, through upstream linkages, caused a 6.8% decline in China’s imports from Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan. Furthermore, both China and the US reoriented parts of their supply chains toward alternative economies, especially ASEAN, but also Mexico and India. A quantitative Armington model shows that these adjustments generated heterogeneous welfare effects across countries: downstream economies such as ASEAN, Mexico, and India gained, whereas upstream suppliers such as Taiwan and South Korea incurred losses. We further show that, under a broader 2025 tariff escalation with retaliation, world trade contracts and welfare declines in all countries.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104327.abstract_zh: 本文考察了中美贸易战如何重塑亚太地区的供应链格局。利用中国海关交易数据构建的全新产品层面投入产出关联，我们追溯了美国对中国下游出口商品加征关税如何跨越国界与生产阶段进行传导。研究发现，美国关税显著减少了中国对美出口，并通过上游关联效应，导致中国从日本、韩国及台湾地区的进口下降了6.8%。此外，中国与美国均将部分供应链转向其他经济体，尤其是东盟国家，同时也包括墨西哥和印度。一个量化的阿明顿模型显示，这些调整在不同国家间产生了异质性的福利效应：下游经济体如东盟、墨西哥和印度获益，而上游供应方如台湾和韩国则遭受损失。我们进一步表明，在2025年更广泛的关税升级及报复措施情境下，全球贸易收缩，所有国家的福利均出现下降。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104327.title: Reshaping factory Asia: How did the US-China trade war affect the Asian-Pacific supply chain?
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104327.title_zh: 重塑工厂亚洲：中美贸易战如何影响亚太供应链？

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104328.abstract: International trade in digital services, including mobile app trade (e.g., Facebook in Frankfurt, Instagram in Istanbul), is large and rapidly growing. Analyzing 2015–2020 data on 28,000 mobile apps, we find that AI increases an app’s user base threefold, a massive effect. AI’s handmaiden is data, including cross-border flows of personal data.
