Concerned with privacy and national security, policymakers have responded with thousands of conflicting data regulations, ranging from guaranteeing free trade in data (USMCA) to data export bans. We are the first to show that these regulations matter: AI’s massive effect is halved in countries with strict data flow restrictions.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104328.abstract_zh: 包括移动应用贸易（如法兰克福的Facebook、伊斯坦布尔的Instagram）在内的数字服务国际贸易规模庞大且增长迅速。基于2015至2020年间28,000款移动应用的数据分析，我们发现人工智能使应用的用户基础扩大了三倍，这一效应极为显著。人工智能的辅助因素是数据，包括个人数据的跨境流动。出于隐私和国家安全的考量，政策制定者已出台数千项相互冲突的数据法规，从保障数据自由贸易（如USMCA）到禁止数据出口不等。我们率先证明这些法规具有实质影响：在数据流动限制严格的国家，人工智能的巨大效应减半。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104328.title: The impact of AI and cross-border data regulation on international trade in digital services
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104328.title_zh: 人工智能与跨境数据监管对数字服务国际贸易的影响

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104329.abstract: The recent decades have witnessed a remarkable surge in machinery imports from China to African economies. Our study examines the causes and local implications of these imports. Notably, we find that China’s efforts to decommission excess capacity have been a driving force behind this trend. Chinese city industries that face urgent capacity elimination requirements imposed by the government tend to export machinery equipment to emerging markets, particularly African countries with weaker environmental regulations and abundant resources. By using instrumental variables based on China’s annual lists of eliminated capacity, we find mixed effects of machinery imports on African economies. They increase output and value added in recipient industries that use the imported machinery, but have limited effects on employment and intersectoral linkages. Nevertheless, labor markets in affected regions reallocate away from agriculture toward both high-skilled and low-skilled occupations. These regions also experience higher pollution levels and increased nighttime light intensity.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104329.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，非洲经济体从中国进口机械设备的数量显著激增。本研究探讨了这些进口的成因及其对当地的影响。值得注意的是，我们发现中国淘汰过剩产能的努力是推动这一趋势的关键因素。面临政府紧迫产能淘汰要求的中国城市产业，倾向于向新兴市场出口机械设备，尤其是那些环境规制较弱且资源丰富的非洲国家。通过利用基于中国年度淘汰产能清单的工具变量，我们发现机械设备进口对非洲经济体的影响喜忧参半。这些进口提升了使用进口机械的接收行业的产出和附加值，但对就业和跨部门关联的影响有限。尽管如此，受影响地区的劳动力市场从农业向高技能和低技能职业重新配置。这些地区还经历了更高的污染水平和夜间灯光强度的增加。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104329.title: Tapping into excess capacity: Chinese machinery exports and African industrialization
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104329.title_zh: 释放过剩产能：中国机械出口与非洲工业化

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104330.abstract: We show that the optimal monetary and exchange rate frameworks depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions depend on the commodity cycle. Stabilizing domestic prices is optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But when economies import commodities as production inputs, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ their direct and indirect effects on domestic prices. In emerging economies, where financial conditions are closely related to commodity cycles, trade-offs are starker and limited credibility may make implementing optimal policy challenging.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104330.abstract_zh: 我们证明，最优的货币与汇率框架在很大程度上取决于经济体的商品敞口。我们构建了一个灵活但易于处理的经济模型，包含商品出口与进口，其中国际金融状况随商品周期而变化。对于商品出口国而言，稳定国内价格是最优选择，这与标准开放经济政策建议相符。但当经济体将商品作为生产投入品进口时，最优政策在很大程度上“透视”其对国内价格的直接与间接影响。在新兴经济体中，金融状况与商品周期紧密相关，权衡更为严峻，而有限的信誉可能使实施最优政策面临挑战。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104330.title: Optimal monetary and exchange rate frameworks for commodity-exposed economies
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104330.title_zh: 大宗商品暴露经济体的最优货币与汇率框架

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104331.abstract: This paper assesses the role of climate policies as a catalyst for the deployment of low carbon technologies through foreign direct investment (FDI). Leveraging detailed cross-border project-level information, it identifies “green” FDI and finds that a larger number of active climate policies is associated with higher green FDI inflows. Importantly, climate policies are not linked to lower non-green FDI inflows. The paper also finds heterogeneity across sectors and policy instruments. The association between climate policies and green projects is stronger in energy and manufacturing, and when the recipient’s climate portfolio is tilted towards binding policies (taxes and regulation) and expenditure measures. Finally, results point to policy spillovers, whereby larger climate policy portfolios in the source country are linked to higher green FDI outflows. Moreover, larger climate policy portfolios in the source country can amplify the role of climate policies in the destination country as a catalyst for green FDI.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104331.abstract_zh: 本文评估了气候政策作为催化剂，通过外国直接投资（FDI）促进低碳技术部署的作用。利用详细的跨境项目级信息，识别出“绿色”FDI，并发现活跃气候政策数量越多，绿色FDI流入量越高。重要的是，气候政策与非绿色FDI流入的减少并无关联。本文还发现不同部门和政策工具之间存在异质性。气候政策与绿色项目之间的关联在能源和制造业领域更为显著，且当接收国的气候政策组合偏向于约束性政策（税收和法规）及支出措施时，这种关联更强。最后，结果揭示了政策溢出效应，即来源国更庞大的气候政策组合与更高的绿色FDI流出相关联。此外，来源国更庞大的气候政策组合能放大目的地国气候政策作为绿色FDI催化剂的角色。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104331.title: Climate policies as a catalyst for green FDI
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104331.title_zh: 气候政策作为绿色外商直接投资的催化剂

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104332.abstract: Unemployment rates are substantially higher and more volatile in the euro area relative to the United States. We ask to what extent the lack of cross-country labor mobility can account for unemployment dynamics in Europe. Our analytical model incorporates downward nominal wage rigidity and an endogenous migration decision. Firms are unable to freely adjust wages during economic contractions, generating an asymmetric distribution of unemployment over the business cycle. The model is calibrated to the dynamics of unemployment and net migration in a typical euro area country. An increase in labor mobility to that observed in the United States and holding all other parameters fixed would reduce the volatility of euro area unemployment by 28% and return over 1,000,000 unemployed to the workforce. The welfare cost to a typical euro area country of the currency union is 4.1 percent of permanent consumption; increasing labor mobility reduces this cost to about 3.55 percent.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104332.abstract_zh: 欧元区的失业率相对于美国显著更高且波动性更大。我们探讨了跨国劳动力流动性不足在多大程度上可以解释欧洲的失业动态。我们的分析模型纳入了名义工资刚性下行和内生迁移决策。在经济收缩期间，企业无法自由调整工资，导致失业在商业周期中呈现不对称分布。该模型根据典型欧元区国家的失业和净迁移动态进行了校准。若将劳动力流动性提升至美国水平，并保持所有其他参数不变，欧元区失业率的波动性将降低28%，并使超过100万名失业者重返劳动力市场。货币联盟对典型欧元区国家的福利成本相当于永久消费的4.1%；提高劳动力流动性可将这一成本降至约3.55%。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104332.title: Labor mobility and the level of unemployment in a currency union
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104332.title_zh: 货币联盟中的劳动力流动性与失业水平

10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104334.abstract: This paper examines the medium- and long-run effects of Brazil’s 1990s trade liberalization on child labor, schooling, and human capital accumulation. Drawing on Census and administrative data spanning nearly three decades, we exploit cross-regional variation in two components of the trade shock that differentially affected labor market opportunities for adults and children. We find that regions more exposed to child-specific tariff reductions experienced larger declines in child labor and greater increases in school attendance; those more exposed to adult-specific tariff reductions experienced the opposite. The impacts of the shocks are persistent and always larger in the long run. Specifically, we show that cohorts whose formative years coincided with the reform accumulated less human capital where adult-specific shocks were greater, and more where child-specific shocks were larger. Overall, our results highlight the role of human capital in amplifying the effects of economic shocks.
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104334.abstract_zh: 本文考察了巴西20世纪90年代贸易自由化对童工、教育及人力资本积累的中长期影响。利用跨越近三十年的普查与行政数据，我们利用贸易冲击中两个组成部分的区域间差异，这些差异对成人与儿童的劳动力市场机会产生了不同影响。我们发现，在儿童特定关税削减暴露程度更高的地区，童工现象减少幅度更大，学校出勤率提升更多；而在成人特定关税削减暴露程度更高的地区，则出现相反情况。这些冲击的影响具有持续性，且长期内总是更为显著。具体而言，我们表明，在改革期间处于成长关键期的群体，在成人特定冲击较大的地区积累了较少的人力资本，而在儿童特定冲击较大的地区则积累了更多。总体而言，我们的结果强调了人力资本在放大经济冲击效应中的作用。
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104334.title: Trade shocks and human capital: Evidence from Brazil’s trade liberalization
10.1016/j.jinteco.2026.104334.title_zh: 贸易冲击与人力资本：来自巴西贸易自由化的证据

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103225.abstract: It is known that no public goods mechanism can be Pareto efficient in Nash equilibrium, individually rational (IR), simple (using a one-dimensional message space), and dynamically stable. The Walker mechanism satisfies all but stability, while the Groves–Ledyard mechanism satisfies all but IR. Here we show that a hybrid between these two mechanisms maintains all of the properties of the Groves–Ledyard mechanism, but with fewer IR failures in expectation.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103225.abstract_zh: 众所周知，没有任何公共品机制能在纳什均衡中同时实现帕累托效率、个体理性（IR）、简单性（使用一维信息空间）以及动态稳定性。Walker机制满足除稳定性外的所有条件，而Groves–Ledyard机制则满足除个体理性外的所有条件。在此，我们展示这两种机制的混合体保留了Groves–Ledyard机制的所有性质，但在预期中减少了个体理性失效的情况。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103225.title: The Walker–Groves–Ledyard mechanism: Improving individual rationality without sacrificing simplicity or stability
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103225.title_zh: Walker–Groves–Ledyard机制：在不牺牲简洁性或稳定性的前提下提升个体理性

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103228.abstract: When negotiators fail to reach agreements, arbitration is used to resolve disputes. This study examines final-offer arbitration (FOA), in which an arbitrator selects one of the negotiators’ offers as the binding outcome. FOA encourages pre-arbitration settlements by increasing the risks associated with arbitral uncertainty. Nevertheless, negotiators often proceed to arbitration in practice. To address this, we characterize the conditions under which negotiators either reach an agreement or escalate to FOA. Our model incorporates reference-dependent preferences and the uncertainty over arbitral decisions. Negotiators incur costs of losing in FOA that depend on their offers, and an arbitrator is drawn from a probability distribution. We reveal a necessary and sufficient condition for agreements under a general class of distributions. FOA facilitates settlements only when negotiators’ costs are sufficiently high relative to the odds of “gambling” in arbitration. We demonstrate that the condition becomes distribution-independent under linear utilities.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103228.abstract_zh: 当谈判者未能达成协议时，仲裁被用于解决争端。本研究考察最终报价仲裁（FOA），即仲裁员从谈判者的报价中选择其一作为具有约束力的结果。FOA通过增加仲裁不确定性相关的风险来促进仲裁前和解。然而，实践中谈判者往往仍会诉诸仲裁。为解决此问题，我们刻画了谈判者达成协议或升级至FOA的条件。我们的模型纳入了参考依赖偏好及仲裁裁决的不确定性。谈判者在FOA中承担失败成本，该成本取决于其报价，且仲裁员从某一概率分布中抽取。我们揭示了一般分布类别下达成协议的必要且充分条件。仅当谈判者的成本相对于仲裁中“博弈”的几率足够高时，FOA才能促进和解。我们证明，在线性效用下，该条件与分布无关。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103228.title: Final-offer arbitration with reference-dependent preferences
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103228.title_zh: 参考依赖偏好的最终报价仲裁

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103237.abstract: This paper revisits the debate between Harsanyi and Rawls on collective decision-making with impartiality (Veil of Ignorance), focusing on how different levels of uncertainty influence the resulting social welfare functions. By incorporating ambiguity into the Impartial Observer framework, the paper constructs a continuum of compromise positions between Harsanyi’s utilitarian approach and Rawls’s maximin rule. In the proposed model, the independence between the uncertainty faced by the Impartial Observer over the distributions of identities and the uncertainty faced by each individual over the distributions of outcomes allows us to introduce ambiguity on both identity acts and/or outcome acts to explore various configurations where the Impartial Observer’s preference representation changes based on the type and level of uncertainty considered. The results offer a more nuanced understanding of impartiality in social choice contexts and help clarify the philosophical foundations of the Harsanyi–Rawls debate.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103237.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了哈萨尼与罗尔斯关于公正集体决策（无知之幕）的辩论，聚焦于不同程度的不确定性如何影响由此产生的社会福利函数。通过将模糊性纳入公正观察者框架，本文构建了介于哈萨尼功利主义方法与罗尔斯最大最小规则之间的连续折中立场。在所提出的模型中，公正观察者面临的身份分布不确定性与每个个体面临的结果分布不确定性之间的独立性，使我们得以在身份行为及/或结果行为上引入模糊性，以探索各种配置，其中公正观察者的偏好表示随所考虑的不确定性的类型和水平而变化。研究结果增进了对社会选择情境中公正性的细致理解，并有助于澄清哈萨尼-罗尔斯辩论的哲学基础。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103237.title: Impartial observer theorem with ambiguity
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103237.title_zh: 含模糊性的公正观察者定理

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103238.abstract: We consider cooperative TU-games with unpaid players, which are described by a TU-game and two categories of players, paid and unpaid. Unpaid players participate in the cooperative game but are not rewarded for their participation, for instance for legal reasons. The objective is then to determine how the contributions of unpaid players are redistributed among the paid players. To meet this goal, we introduce and characterize axiomatically three values that are inspired by the Shapley value but differ in the way they redistribute the contributions of unpaid players. These values are unified as instances of a more general two-step allocation procedure.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103238.abstract_zh: 我们考虑具有未支付参与者的合作TU博弈，此类博弈由TU博弈及两类参与者（支付与未支付）描述。未支付参与者参与合作博弈，但因其参与而不获报酬，例如出于法律原因。目标在于确定未支付参与者的贡献如何在支付参与者之间重新分配。为实现此目标，我们引入并公理化刻画了三种值，它们受Shapley值启发，但在重新分配未支付参与者贡献的方式上有所不同。这些值统一为更一般的两步分配程序的实例。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103238.title: Cooperative games with unpaid players
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103238.title_zh: 无报酬参与者的合作博弈

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103239.abstract: We study spatial competition between firms when consumer choices are not only influenced by their individual preferences but also by the popularity of firms. We fully characterize the subgame perfect equilibria, and show that the preference for popular goods enlarges the classical prediction: while minimal differentiation can still occur, the set of equilibria includes differentiated and asymmetric outcomes. We also show that the welfare impact of popularity is subtle: although the socially optimal outcome is a subgame perfect equilibrium when the popularity effect is strong, the price of anarchy, which measures the worst-case outcome, varies non-monotonically with the intensity of the popularity effect.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103239.abstract_zh: 我们研究当消费者选择不仅受个人偏好影响，还受企业流行度影响时的企业间空间竞争。我们全面刻画了子博弈完美均衡，并表明对流行商品的偏好扩展了经典预测：虽然最小差异化仍可能发生，但均衡集合包含了差异化及不对称结果。我们还表明，流行度的福利影响是微妙的：尽管当流行效应较强时，社会最优结果是子博弈完美均衡，但衡量最坏情况结果的“无政府状态代价”随流行效应强度呈非单调变化。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103239.title: Popularity in location games
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103239.title_zh: 选址博弈中的受欢迎程度

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103240.abstract: This paper develops an information-theoretic framework that integrates the principle of minimum relative entropy with Bellman’s principle of optimality to formally characterize how purposeful individual behavior gives rise to spontaneous order in market economies. Under standard assumptions from dynamic programming theory, I prove that a probabilistic formulation of Bellman’s equation, subject to an upper bound on relative entropy, admits a unique solution in the form of a dynamic logit function. This function generates a Markov transition with a unique invariant probability distribution, which characterizes economic equilibria as emergent outcomes arising from the purposeful behavior of private agents. I apply these results to neoclassical models of consumption and investment, illustrating that the theory can effectively account for key cross-sectional and time-series properties of economic systems.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103240.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个信息论框架，将最小相对熵原理与贝尔曼最优性原则相结合，以正式刻画有目的性的个体行为如何在市场经济中催生自发秩序。在动态规划理论的标准假设下，我证明了在相对熵上界约束下的贝尔曼方程的概率形式化表述，具有唯一解，该解表现为动态逻辑函数形式。此函数生成一个具有唯一不变概率分布的马尔可夫转移，从而将经济均衡刻画为私人主体有目的性行为涌现出的结果。我将这些结果应用于新古典消费与投资模型，说明该理论能有效解释经济系统中的关键横截面与时间序列特征。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103240.title: A theory of probabilistic economic equilibria

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103241.abstract: The seller seeks to sell two different items by bundling participation. Membership allows only members to buy either item or both. A membership mechanism thus specifies a member set and a fee as well as allocation and payment rules. We first establish the revenue-maximizing mechanism given a modified valuation distribution incorporating the member set, which also resolves the existence problem. The optimal membership mechanism enables us to compare between bundling participation and separate participation, suggesting conditions under which membership dominates selling two goods separately: interplay between the number of bidders and the degree of the stochastic dominance of valuation distributions. This mechanism also provides a rationale for secret reserve prices, a long-standing puzzle in theory.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103241.abstract_zh: 卖方试图通过捆绑参与来销售两种不同的物品。会员资格仅允许会员购买其中任一物品或两者兼有。因此，会员机制规定了会员集合、费用以及分配和支付规则。我们首先在考虑会员集合的修正估值分布下，确立了收益最大化的机制，这也解决了存在性问题。最优会员机制使我们能够比较捆绑参与与单独参与，提出了会员制优于分别销售两种商品的条件：竞标者数量与估值分布随机优势程度之间的相互作用。该机制还为秘密保留价这一理论中长期存在的谜题提供了合理解释。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103241.title: Membership mechanism

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103242.abstract: In cooperative games with communication networks, it is typically assumed that two players can communicate whenever there is a connecting path between them, regardless of its length. We relax this assumption by introducing a new concept, k -boundedness, which sets an upper bound on the length of admissible communication paths. Building on this idea, we define a restriction operator for feasible coalitions in communication games, which leads to a new solution concept extending the Myerson value. Our first main contribution is an axiomatic characterization of this solution within the class of games with communication networks. The characterization combines the classical Fairness axiom with new axioms capturing the effect of k -boundedness constraints on cooperative possibilities. We then investigate the feasible coalition structures that arise under arbitrary k -boundedness constraints, which we term feasible communication structures. Within this alternative framework, we provide another axiomatic characterization of our solution concept.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103242.abstract_zh: 在具有通信网络的合作博弈中，通常假设只要两个玩家之间存在连接路径，无论其长度如何，他们就能进行通信。我们通过引入一个新概念——k-有界性，放宽了这一假设，该概念为可允许的通信路径长度设定了上限。基于此思想，我们为通信博弈中的可行联盟定义了一个限制算子，从而引出一个扩展了Myerson值的新解概念。我们的第一个主要贡献是在具有通信网络的博弈类别中，对该解进行了公理化刻画。该刻画将经典的公平性公理与捕捉k-有界性约束对合作可能性影响的新公理相结合。随后，我们研究了在任意k-有界性约束下产生的可行联盟结构，称之为可行通信结构。在此替代框架内，我们为我们的解概念提供了另一种公理化刻画。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103242.title: k-boundedness, feasible communication structures, and the Myerson value
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103242.title_zh: k-有界性、可行沟通结构与Myerson值

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103243.abstract: This paper considers voting systems in which abstention is possible, and in which the power of coalitions may depend on the issues under consideration. A class of issue-based Banzhaf power indices is axiomatically characterized for such systems. As a by-product, this approach also yields several new characterizations of (nonnegative multiples of) the Banzhaf power index. Examples are included to show how the indices behave.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103243.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了允许弃权的投票系统，其中联盟的权力可能取决于所审议的议题。针对此类系统，我们公理化地刻画了一类基于议题的Banzhaf权力指数。作为副产品，该方法还产生了Banzhaf权力指数（非负倍数）的若干新特征化。文中包含示例以展示这些指数的行为表现。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103243.title: Abstention, multiple issues, and the Banzhaf power index
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103243.title_zh: 弃权、多重议题与班扎夫权力指数

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103244.abstract: Does waiting to observe others’ actions delay profitable choices? If so, for how long? We study a social learning environment in which players decide whether and when to undertake an irreversible risky investment. The timing is asymmetric: some players face an investment opportunity earlier than others. We prove the existence of equilibria with arbitrarily long delays, where, with positive probability, the first investment occurs after several periods without investment. In these equilibria, the better-informed player need not invest first, delays may persist even when signals are highly precise, and their duration is independent of the number of players. We illustrate how this framework can help explain observed investment dynamics in the venture capital industry.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103244.abstract_zh: 等待观察他人行动是否会延迟有利可图的选择？如果是，会延迟多久？我们研究了一个社会学习环境，其中玩家决定是否以及何时进行一项不可逆的风险投资。时间安排不对称：一些玩家比其他人更早面临投资机会。我们证明了存在任意长延迟的均衡，在这些均衡中，有正概率首次投资发生在几个无投资时期之后。在这些均衡中，信息更充分的玩家不一定首先投资，即使信号高度精确，延迟也可能持续存在，并且其持续时间与玩家数量无关。我们展示了这一框架如何有助于解释风险投资行业中观察到的投资动态。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103244.title: Waiting for others: Long delays in social learning
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103244.title_zh: 等待他人：社会学习中的长时间延迟

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103245.abstract: This study establishes the existence of Walrasian equilibrium for large production economies with infinitely many commodities and interdependent preferences. The interdependence is formulated so that each agent’s preference depends on the average demand among agents. Preferences are allowed to be price-dependent and need not be represented by a utility function. This result generalizes previous existence results for large economies with infinitely many commodities. We employ a saturated measure space of agents to apply the infinite dimensional Fatou’s lemma, Lyapunov convexity theorem and regularity properties (convexity, norm/weak compactness, and preservation of norm/weak upper hemicontinuity) of the Bochner integration of correspondences. We use a subsequence formulation of the infinite dimensional Fatou’s lemma in the limiting argument.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103245.abstract_zh: 本研究确立了在具有无限多种商品和相互依赖偏好的大型生产经济中瓦尔拉斯均衡的存在性。这种相互依赖性被设定为每个代理人的偏好依赖于代理人间平均需求。偏好允许依赖于价格，且无需通过效用函数来表示。这一结果推广了先前关于无限多种商品大型经济中均衡存在性的结论。我们采用饱和测度空间中的代理人集合，以应用无限维法图引理、李雅普诺夫凸性定理以及对应关系的博赫纳积分的正则性质（凸性、范数/弱紧致性，以及范数/弱上半连续性的保持）。在极限论证中，我们使用了无限维法图引理的子序列表述形式。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103245.title: Equilibria of large production economies with interdependent preferences: A role for the infinite dimensional Fatou’s lemma
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103245.title_zh: 具有相互依赖偏好的大型生产经济的均衡：无限维Fatou引理的作用

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103246.abstract: This study considers standard equity auctions in the presence of winner’s post-auction effort as bidder moral hazard. The valuation of the auctioned object is endogenously determined by the winner’s effort and private type. We characterize the equilibria of the first-price equity auction (FPEA) and the second-price equity auction (SPEA) under various environments with bidder moral hazard. Regarding performance comparison, we identify the conditions under which the FPEA features, in equilibrium, a lower equity share payment, higher total surplus, equal bidder payoffs, and a higher seller payoff in expectation. Consequently, the FPEA Pareto dominates the SPEA in terms of expected bidder and seller payoffs. We further identify the conditions under which bidder payoff equivalence does not hold while the FPEA maintains an advantage in the expected total surplus and the expected seller payoff. Lastly, we compare equity auctions with fixed-royalty auctions under bidder moral hazard and investigate equity auctions under double moral hazard.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103246.abstract_zh: 本研究在竞标者道德风险背景下，考察了存在中标者事后努力的标准股权拍卖。拍卖标的物的价值由中标者的努力及其私人类型内生决定。我们刻画了在竞标者道德风险的各种环境下，第一价格股权拍卖（FPEA）与第二价格股权拍卖（SPEA）的均衡特征。在绩效比较方面，我们识别了FPEA在均衡状态下呈现较低股权份额支付、较高总剩余、竞标者收益相等以及预期卖方收益更高的条件。因此，在预期竞标者与卖方收益方面，FPEA帕累托优于SPEA。我们进一步识别了竞标者收益等价性不成立而FPEA在预期总剩余和预期卖方收益上仍保持优势的条件。最后，我们将股权拍卖与固定特许权使用费拍卖在竞标者道德风险下进行比较，并探讨了双重道德风险下的股权拍卖。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103246.title: Equity auctions with bidder moral hazard
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103246.title_zh: 具有竞标者道德风险的股权拍卖

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103247.abstract: We examine the welfare effects of integrating two-sided unbalanced matching markets with randomly heterogeneous preferences. It is well known that integrating balanced matching markets is profitable for both sides when we focus on stable matching outcomes. However, this result can change as soon as markets become slightly unbalanced. Integration results in a welfare gain for those who end up on the short side of the integrated market on average, at the expense of those on the long side. The magnitude of the loss for one side can be as significant as the welfare gain for the other side, making the aggregate welfare effect of the integration infinitesimal relative to each side’s welfare effect.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103247.abstract_zh: 我们考察了整合具有随机异质性偏好的双边不平衡匹配市场的福利效应。众所周知，在关注稳定匹配结果时，整合平衡匹配市场对双方均有利。然而，一旦市场变得略微不平衡，这一结论可能发生改变。整合导致最终处于整合市场短边的一方平均获得福利增益，而长边一方则承受损失。一方的损失幅度可能等同于另一方的福利增益，使得整合的总福利效应相对于各方的福利效应而言微乎其微。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103247.title: Welfare effects of integrating unbalanced matching markets
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103247.title_zh: 整合非均衡匹配市场的福利效应

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103248.abstract: We consider a pure exchange economy with consumption externalities in preferences. We study competitive equilibria with “small” taxes and lump-sum transfers that make everyone strictly better off. We extend the result of Geanakoplos and Polemarchakis (2008), on the generic existence of Pareto improving policies with uniform taxes and uniform transfers when there are fewer consumer types than commodities, to the case of general preferences that need not be separable between own consumption and externalities. We also prove the generic existence of Pareto improving policies with uniform taxes and personalized transfers, or vice-versa, when there are at least as many types as commodities. Finally, we study the existence of Pareto improving policies for Bergson-Samuelson utilities and two-type economies, without perturbing utilities.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103248.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个在偏好中存在消费外部性的纯交换经济。我们研究通过“小额”税收和一次性转移支付实现的竞争均衡，这些措施能使每个人的境况严格变好。我们将Geanakoplos和Polemarkakis（2008）关于在消费者类型少于商品数量时，统一税收和统一转移支付下帕累托改进政策普遍存在的结论，推广至一般偏好情形，即自身消费与外部性之间不必可分离。我们还证明了当类型数量不少于商品数量时，在统一税收与个性化转移支付，或反之的情况下，帕累托改进政策普遍存在。最后，我们研究了在不扰动效用的情况下，针对Bergson-Samuelson效用和两类经济体的帕累托改进政策的存在性。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103248.title: Pareto improving taxes with non-separable externalities: A differentiable approach
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103248.title_zh: 不可分离外部性下的帕累托改进税收：一种可微方法

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103249.abstract: A subset of economic agents in a society is aware of the existence of an economic opportunity, and compete to exploit it. We study incentives to communicate about the existence of this economic opportunity when its exploitation by the winner generates externalities to other agents. We characterize the equilibria of the communication game, identify conditions under which stronger externalities generate more communication, and highlight the tension between equilibrium and efficient communication.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103249.abstract_zh: 社会中一部分经济主体知晓某一经济机会的存在，并竞相利用该机会。我们研究了当机会被赢家利用时对其他主体产生外部性的情况下，关于该经济机会存在信息的沟通激励。我们刻画了沟通博弈的均衡特征，识别了更强外部性促进更多沟通的条件，并强调了均衡沟通与有效沟通之间的张力。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103249.title: Sharing opportunities under externalities

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103250.abstract: This paper investigates the strategic implications of the uniform rank-minimizing mechanism (URM), an assignment rule that selects uniformly from the set of deterministic assignments minimizing the sum of agents'reported ranks. We focus on settings in which agents may refuse their assignment and instead receive an outside option. Without the refusal option, we show that truth-telling is not strictly dominated under any fair rank-minimizing mechanism; that is, one satisfying equal treatment of equals. However, introducing the refusal option significantly changes strategic incentives: specific manipulations, called outside option demotion strategies, dominate truth-telling under the URM. Moreover, such manipulations can lead to inefficient outcomes, as desirable objects may be refused by misreporting agents and consequently remain unassigned. To address this issue, we propose a modification of the URM that restores undominated truth-telling, although it introduces incentives to underreport acceptable objects. Our results highlight a fundamental trade-off in the design of fair rank-minimizing mechanisms when agents can refuse their assignments.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103250.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了统一秩最小化机制（URM）的战略含义，该机制是一种从使代理人报告秩总和最小的确定性分配集合中均匀选择的分配规则。我们聚焦于代理人可能拒绝其分配结果并转而接受外部选项的情境。在没有拒绝选项的情况下，我们证明在任何公平的秩最小化机制下，即满足同等对待同等者的机制中，真实报告并非严格劣势策略。然而，引入拒绝选项显著改变了战略激励：在URM下，特定操纵策略，即所谓的外部选项降级策略，优于真实报告。此外，此类操纵可能导致无效率的结果，因为虚报代理人可能拒绝理想物品，从而导致这些物品最终未被分配。为解决此问题，我们提出对URM进行修改，以恢复非劣势的真实报告，尽管这引入了低报可接受物品的激励。我们的结果凸显了在代理人可拒绝其分配时，设计公平秩最小化机制中的基本权衡。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103250.title: Strategic analysis of fair rank-minimizing mechanisms with agent refusal option
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103250.title_zh: 具有代理人拒绝选项的公平排名最小化机制的战略分析

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103251.abstract: We establish a mean-field stochastic framework for analyzing institutional lock-in driven by asymmetric belief updating. A continuum of agents update confidence levels s_tthrough success/failure experiences, with update functions F_S,F_Fexhibiting negativity bias: failures impact beliefs more strongly than successes of equal magnitude. Aggregate confidence I_tinfluences the success probability \pi(I_t), creating feedback between individual psychology and collective outcomes. We prove existence of stationary equilibria via Schauder’s fixed-point theorem on the space of probability measures \mathcal{P}\left(\left[0,1\right]\right), establishing compactness through Prokhorov’s theorem. Stability is characterized via spectral analysis of Fréchet derivatives in the bounded-Lipschitz metric, with operator decomposition into push-forward L_{\mu^\ast} and rank-one feedback R_{\mu^\ast} components. Under negativity bias and positive feedback, we establish multiplicity: generically three equilibria (low, middle, high) with stable-unstable-stable pattern. For escape dynamics from stable equilibria, we establish a large deviation principle on Skorokhod space D\left([0,\infty\right),\mathcal{P}\left(\left[0,1\right]\right)) with rate function determined by a quasi-potential computed via action functional minimization. Expected escape times scale as exp\left(N\cdot V\right) where N is population size and V is the quasi-potential, confirming exponential rarity: for calibrated parameters with N={10}^6 agents, escape times exceed {10}^{63,900} periods. We derive comparative statics for reform policy through optimal control: value function concavity implies optimal sequencing places high-success-probability reforms first. Material investments M and psychological interventions P exhibit strategic complementarity (\partial^2I^\ast/\partial M\partial P>0), verified through implicit function theorem analysis. Numerical verification with {10}^6 Monte Carlo simulations confirms all theoretical predictions, with robustness checks across alternative functional specifications. The framework provides a rigorous foundation for understanding institutional persistence as emerging from collective psychological dynamics rather than material coordination failures, with implications for development economics, political economy, and organizational change.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103251.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个平均场随机框架，用以分析由不对称信念更新所驱动的制度锁定现象。在此框架中，一个连续统的代理人通过成功/失败经历更新其信心水平s_t，更新函数F_S,F_F展现出负面偏差：同等强度的失败对信念的影响大于成功。总体信心I_t影响成功概率\pi(I_t)，从而在个体心理与集体结果之间形成反馈机制。我们通过Schauder不动点定理在概率测度空间\mathcal{P}\left(\left[0,1\right]\right)上证明了平稳均衡的存在性，并利用Prokhorov定理确立了紧致性。稳定性通过有界-Lipschitz度量下Fréchet导数的谱分析来刻画，其中算子分解为前推L_{\mu^\ast}与秩一反馈R_{\mu^\ast}两部分。在负面偏差与正反馈条件下，我们确立了多重性：一般存在三个均衡（低、中、高），呈现稳定-不稳定-稳定的模式。对于从稳定均衡的逃逸动态，我们在Skorokhod空间D\left([0,\infty\right),\mathcal{P}\left(\left[0,1\right]\right))上建立了大偏差原理，其速率函数由通过作用泛函最小化计算的准势决定。预期逃逸时间按exp\left(N\cdot V\right)缩放，其中N为总体规模，V为准势，从而确认了指数量级的稀有性：对于校准参数，当N={10}^6个代理人时，逃逸时间超过{10}^{63,900}个时期。我们通过最优控制推导了改革政策的比较静态分析：价值函数的凹性意味着最优排序应将高成功概率的改革置于首位。物质投资M与心理干预P表现出策略互补性（\partial^2I^\ast/\partial M\partial P>0），这一结论通过隐函数定理分析得到验证。基于{10}^6次蒙特卡洛模拟的数值验证确认了所有理论预测，并在不同函数设定下进行了稳健性检验。该框架为理解制度持续性源于集体心理动态而非物质协调失败提供了严谨基础，对发展经济学、政治经济学与组织变革具有启示意义。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103251.title: Psychological lock-in and institutional persistence: A mean-field model of confidence dynamics
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103251.title_zh: 心理锁定与制度持续性：信心动力学的平均场模型

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103252.abstract: We study the problem of allocating indivisible commodities, or “objects”, when some of them are privately owned and some are collectively owned. We search for well-behaved rules that are implementable in “obviously dominant equilibrium”, namely, obviously strategy-proof rules (Li, 2017). We start from the you request my house–I get your turn rules (Abdulkadiroǧlu and Sönmez, 1999), the “AS rules”. We ask whether and when they are obviously strategy-proof. When preferences are strict but otherwise unrestricted, and with at least three agents, the AS rules are obviously strategy-proof if and only if there is at most one owner. This disappointing result raises the question whether things would work out better on some restricted preference domains. On the single-peaked domain, we propose a new family of rules and show that not only are these “priority-augmented crawlers” obviously strategy-proof, but also that they satisfy efficiency, the individual endowments lower bounds, group strategy-proofness, weak neutrality, and separability. On the single-dipped domain, we establish a contrasting result: on this subdomain, unlike on the single-peaked domain, the AS rules are obviously strategy-proof.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103252.abstract_zh: 我们研究在部分商品为私人所有、部分为集体所有的情况下，如何分配不可分割商品或“物品”的问题。我们寻找那些能在“显然占优均衡”中实施的良好行为规则，即显然策略-proof规则（Li, 2017）。我们从“你求我房—我取你轮”规则（Abdulkadiroǧlu和Sönmez, 1999），即“AS规则”出发，探讨它们是否以及何时是显然策略-proof的。当偏好严格但不受其他限制，且至少有三个代理人时，AS规则是显然策略-proof的当且仅当最多只有一个所有者。这一令人失望的结果引发了一个问题：在某些受限偏好域上，情况是否会更好。在单峰偏好域上，我们提出了一族新规则，并证明这些“优先级增强爬行规则”不仅是显然策略-proof的，而且满足效率、个人禀赋下限、群体策略-proof性、弱中立性和可分离性。在单谷偏好域上，我们得出了一个对比性结果：在此子域上，与单峰偏好域不同，AS规则是显然策略-proof的。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103252.title: Obviously strategy-proof implementation for mixed-ownership object-allocation problems
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103252.title_zh: 混合所有制物品分配问题的显然策略防实施

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103253.abstract: The standard model of choice in economics is the maximization of a complete and transitive preference relation over a fixed set of alternatives. While completeness of preferences is usually regarded as a strong assumption, weakening it requires care to ensure that the resulting model still has enough structure to yield interesting results. This paper takes a step in this direction by studying the class of "connected preferences", that is, preferences that may fail to be complete but have connected maximal domains of comparability. We offer four new results. Theorem 1 identifies a basic necessary condition for a continuous preference to be connected in the sense above, while Theorem 2 provides sufficient conditions. Building on the latter, Theorem 3 characterizes the maximal domains of comparability. Finally, Theorem 4 presents conditions that ensure that maximal domains are arc-connected.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103253.abstract_zh: 经济学中的标准选择模型是在固定备选集合上最大化一个完备且传递的偏好关系。尽管偏好的完备性通常被视为一个强假设，但弱化这一假设需要谨慎，以确保所得模型仍具备足够结构以产生有意义的结果。本文朝此方向迈出一步，研究“连通偏好”这一类偏好，即可能不完备但具有连通的最大可比域的偏好。我们提供了四项新结果。定理1识别了连续偏好按上述意义连通的一个基本必要条件，而定理2给出了充分条件。在此基础上，定理3刻画了最大可比域的特征。最后，定理4提出了确保最大可比域为弧连通的条件。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103253.title: Connected incomplete preferences

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103254.abstract: There are many situations where policymakers are primarily concerned with the availability and accessibility of goods or services. Examples include electricity, food, housing, medical supplies, et cetera. In such cases, the social goal may be to maximize the number of transactions, which we refer to as a maximal matching. This paper presents a mechanism that implements this objective for markets characterized by bilateral transactions. The mechanism is incentive compatible, but, like the VCG-mechanism that yields the total-utility-maximizing outcome, it requires external funding.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103254.abstract_zh: 在许多情况下，政策制定者主要关注商品或服务的可获得性和可及性。例如电力、食品、住房、医疗用品等。在这些情况下，社会目标可能是最大化交易数量，我们称之为最大匹配。本文提出了一种机制，用于实现以双边交易为特征的市场中的这一目标。该机制具有激励相容性，但与产生总效用最大化结果的VCG机制一样，它需要外部资金支持。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103254.title: Maximal matchings

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103255.abstract: A well-known feature of overlapping generations economies is that the First Welfare Theorem fails and equilibrium may be inefficient. The Cass (1972) criterion furnishes a necessary and sufficient condition for efficiency, but it does not address the existence of efficient equilibria, and Cass, Okuno, and Zilcha (1979) provide nonexistence examples. A closely related question (known as the Hahn (1965) problem) deals with the existence of monetary equilibria. In this paper, I provide sufficient conditions for the existence of optimal monetary equilibria on consumption-loan, non-stationary overlapping generations economies without durable, dividend-paying assets, cash-in-advance constraints, wealth-transfer mechanisms, or transaction costs. Essentially, the economy must be prone to savings. Furthermore, I develop an algorithm to find these optimal monetary equilibria as the limit of nested compact sets. These compact sets are the result of a backward calculation through equilibrium equations departing from the set of optimal monetary equilibria of well-behaved tail economies.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103255.abstract_zh: 重叠世代经济的一个众所周知特征是，第一福利定理失效，均衡可能无效率。Cass（1972）准则提供了效率的充分必要条件，但并未涉及有效均衡的存在性，而Cass、Okuno和Zilcha（1979）给出了不存在性的例子。一个密切相关的问题（即Hahn（1965）问题）涉及货币均衡的存在性。在本文中，我为消费贷款型、非平稳重叠世代经济中最优货币均衡的存在性提供了充分条件，这些经济不包含耐用品、分红资产、现金预付约束、财富转移机制或交易成本。本质上，经济必须倾向于储蓄。此外，我开发了一种算法，通过嵌套紧集极限来寻找这些最优货币均衡。这些紧集是通过从表现良好的尾部经济的最优货币均衡集合出发，沿均衡方程进行反向计算得出的结果。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103255.title: Existence and calculation of optimal monetary equilibria on overlapping generations economies
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103255.title_zh: 重叠世代经济中最优货币均衡的存在性与计算

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103256.abstract: We give weak conditions for a continuous time optimal control problem with one-dimensional state space to have monotone optimal trajectories. These conditions include a concavity condition on the Lagrange function. If that condition is changed to strict concavity, then all optimal trajectories are monotone.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103256.abstract_zh: 我们给出了在一维状态空间中，连续时间最优控制问题具有单调最优轨迹的弱条件。这些条件包括对拉格朗日函数的凹性要求。若将该条件加强为严格凹性，则所有最优轨迹均为单调的。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103256.title: Monotone optimal trajectories in continuous-time infinite horizon optimal control problems
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103256.title_zh: 连续时间无限时域最优控制问题中的单调最优轨迹

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103257.abstract: Gul and Pesendorfer (2015) introduce subjective sources in Hurwicz expected utility: event domains on which binary bets are ranked as if by a prior and this “as if” behavior varies continuously with the event. Motivated by the certainty effect, I relax continuity only at the extremes, allowing discontinuities at impossible and certain events while maintaining continuity for non-degenerate bets. I characterize these non-extreme-outcome (neo)-continuous sources by a conditional power-series link between source probability and inner probability on an ideal core event. On acts measurable with respect to a neo-continuous source, the Hurwicz functional admits a rank-dependent representation on non-extreme ranks together with an extreme-outcome term.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103257.abstract_zh: Gul和Pesendorfer（2015）在Hurwicz期望效用中引入了主观来源：在事件域上，二元赌注的排序如同依据先验概率进行，且这种“如同”行为随事件连续变化。受确定性效应启发，我仅在极端情形下放宽连续性，允许在不可能事件和必然事件处出现不连续，同时保持非退化赌注的连续性。我通过一个条件幂级数联系，将来源概率与理想核心事件上的内概率相关联，从而刻画了这些非极端结果（新）连续来源。对于相对于新连续来源可测的行为，Hurwicz泛函在非极端秩上允许秩依赖表示，并附带一个极端结果项。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103257.title: The certainty effect and neo-continuous subjective sources in Hurwicz expected utility
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103257.title_zh: 确定性效应与Hurwicz期望效用中的新连续主观来源

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103264.abstract: By embedding uncertainty into time, we obtain a conjoint axiomatic characterization of both Exponential Discounting and Subjective Expected Utility that accommodates arbitrary state and outcome spaces. In doing so, we provide a novel and simple time-interpretation of subjective probability. The subjective probability of an event is calibrated using time discounting.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103264.abstract_zh: 通过将不确定性嵌入时间之中，我们获得了指数贴现与主观期望效用的一种联合公理化刻画，该刻画适用于任意状态空间和结果空间。在此过程中，我们为主观概率提供了一种新颖且简洁的时间解释。事件的主观概率通过时间贴现进行校准。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103264.title: Discounted Subjective Expected Utility in continuous time
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103264.title_zh: 连续时间下的折现主观期望效用

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103267.abstract: This paper establishes a precise link between the tail behavior of a distribution and the structure of its Virtual Value. We show that the only continuously differentiable distributions whose Virtual Value is linear on an interval coincide, on that interval, with a Generalized Pareto distribution. This equivalence yields explicit expressions for optimal cutoffs and implies that, within this class, comparative statics of allocation and pricing rules are governed by a single primitive, the tail index. Thin tails lead to the familiar monotone adjustment of prices, whereas heavy tails reverse the sign of the response and produce countercyclical pricing. The analysis also demonstrates that widely used textbook distributions acquire an approximately affine Virtual Value in their upper tails whenever their expectations are finite. Under standard regularity conditions from Extreme Value Theory, the tail Virtual Value converges to an affine form, with slope equal to the underlying tail index. These results provide a unified framework for studying allocation, mechanism design and monopoly pricing in environments where high valuations play a central role.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103267.abstract_zh: 本文在分布的尾部行为与其虚拟价值结构之间建立了精确联系。我们证明，唯一在某一区间上具有线性虚拟价值的连续可微分布，在该区间上与广义帕累托分布一致。这一等价关系为最优截断值提供了显式表达式，并意味着在此类分布中，配置与定价规则的比较静态分析由单一原始参数——尾部指数——所支配。薄尾分布导致熟悉的单调价格调整，而厚尾分布则使响应符号反转，产生逆周期定价。分析还表明，当期望有限时，广泛使用的教科书分布在其上尾部分近似具有仿射虚拟价值。在极值理论的标准正则条件下，尾部虚拟价值收敛于仿射形式，其斜率等于潜在尾部指数。这些结果为研究高估值起核心作用的环境中的配置、机制设计与垄断定价提供了统一框架。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103267.title: Affine Virtual Values and the Generalized Pareto distribution
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103267.title_zh: 仿射虚拟值与广义帕累托分布

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103268.abstract: This paper develops a data-driven approach to Bayesian persuasion. The receiver is privately informed about the prior distribution of the state of the world, the sender knows the receiver’s preferences but does not know the distribution of the state variable, and the sender’s payoffs depend on the receiver’s action but not on the state. Prior to interacting with the receiver, the sender observes the distribution of actions taken by a population of decision makers who share the receiver’s preferences in best response to an unobserved distribution of messages generated by an unknown and potentially heterogeneous family of signals. The sender views any prior that rationalizes these data as plausible and seeks a signal that maximizes her worst-case payoff against the set of all such distributions. We show that the two-state two-action problem has a saddle point, identify a monotonicity condition on the sender’s preferences under which strong duality holds in the two-state many-action problem, and identify structural restrictions on the sender’s belief set under which strong duality holds in the two-action many-state problem. In all such cases, we identify adversarial priors and characterize robustly optimal signals.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103268.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的贝叶斯说服方法。接收者私下知晓世界状态的先验分布，发送者了解接收者的偏好但不知晓状态变量的分布，且发送者的收益取决于接收者的行动而非状态。在与接收者互动之前，发送者观察到一个决策者群体所采取行动的分布，这些决策者与接收者具有相同偏好，并对一个由未知且可能异质的信号族生成的未观测消息分布作出最优反应。发送者将任何能使这些数据合理化的先验视为可能，并寻求一种信号，以最大化其针对所有此类分布集合的最坏情况收益。我们证明，在双状态双行动问题中存在鞍点，识别出发送者偏好的单调性条件，在该条件下强对偶性在双状态多行动问题中成立，并识别出发送者信念集的结构性限制，在该限制下强对偶性在双行动多状态问题中成立。在所有这些情形中，我们识别出对抗性先验，并刻画了稳健最优信号的特征。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103268.title: Data-driven persuasion

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103269.abstract: This paper analyzes a decentralized matching environment in which agents privately observe their ability but must choose between two mutually exclusive sectors before learning their relative rank. The sectors differ in their payoff distributions, and positions within each are assigned via positive assortative matching. Thus, outcomes depend both on ability and on the endogenous congestion created by agents’ sectoral choices. I characterize the unique symmetric Bayesian Nash equilibrium, which exhibits a cutoff structure: high-ability agents select the high-payoff sector with certainty, while low-ability agents mix to trade off match quality against the risk of being crowded out. The equilibrium choice probability is continuous within groups but displays a discontinuous jump at the sorting threshold. A key welfare finding is that rank uncertainty can raise the expected utility of some low-ability agents relative to a complete information benchmark. The analysis shows how private information induces endogenous discontinuities in strategies and heterogeneous welfare effects across types.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103269.abstract_zh: 本文分析了一个分散匹配环境，其中代理人私下观察自身能力，但在了解相对排名之前，必须在两个互斥部门之间做出选择。这两个部门的收益分配不同，且每个部门内的职位通过正向分类匹配进行分配。因此，结果既取决于能力，也取决于代理人部门选择所产生的内生拥挤效应。我刻画了唯一对称贝叶斯纳什均衡，该均衡呈现截断结构：高能力代理人确定性地选择高收益部门，而低能力代理人则进行混合策略，以在匹配质量与被挤出风险之间权衡。均衡选择概率在群体内是连续的，但在分类阈值处表现出不连续的跳跃。一个关键的福利发现是，排名不确定性可以提高某些低能力代理人相对于完全信息基准的预期效用。分析表明，私人信息如何引发策略中的内生不连续性以及不同类型间异质的福利效应。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103269.title: Sorting and matching under rank uncertainty
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103269.title_zh: 排名不确定下的分类与匹配

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103270.abstract: We study efficient, linear, and symmetric (ELS) values, a central family of allocation rules for cooperative games with transferable-utility (TU-games) that includes the Shapley value, the CIS value, and the ENSC value. We first show that every ELS value can be written as the Shapley value of a suitably transformed TU-game. We then introduce three types of invariance axioms for fixed player populations. The first type consists of composition axioms, and the second type is active-player consistency. Each of these two types yields a characterization of a subclass of the ELS values that contains the family of least-square values. Finally, the third type is nullified-game consistency: we define three such axioms, and each axiom yields a characterization of one of the Shapley, CIS, and ENSC values.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103270.abstract_zh: 我们研究高效、线性且对称（ELS）值，这是可转移效用合作博弈（TU博弈）中一类核心的分配规则，包括Shapley值、CIS值和ENSC值。我们首先证明，每个ELS值都可以表示为适当变换后的TU博弈的Shapley值。接着，我们针对固定玩家群体引入三类不变性公理。第一类由组合公理组成，第二类是活跃玩家一致性。这两类中的每一类都刻画了ELS值的一个子类，该子类包含最小二乘值族。最后，第三类是无效化博弈一致性：我们定义了三个此类公理，每个公理分别刻画了Shapley值、CIS值和ENSC值中的一个。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103270.title: Characterizing the ELS values with fixed-population invariance axioms
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103270.title_zh: 固定人口不变性公理下的ELS值特征刻画

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103271.abstract: The smooth ambiguity model (Klibanoff et al., 2005) or second-order subjective expected utility (SOSEU) model (Nau, 2006; Seo, 2009; Giraud, 2014) has two characteristics that contribute to its success: it is an iterated expected utility and, under certain conditions, it is smooth. These characteristics allow for the use of standard analytical techniques from expected utility theory, including optimization calculus. In this paper, we utilize the continuous differentiability ( C 1 ) of the SOSEU functional to offer an axiomatic characterization of this model. First, we define C 1 preferences and provide a representation for them. Then, assuming that preferences are C 1 , the primary axiom that delivers the iterated expected utility form essentially states that if decision makers are more sensitive to perturbations of one portfolio of assets than another one when the probability distribution is known, then they are still more sensitive when it is not.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103271.abstract_zh: 平滑模糊模型（Klibanoff等，2005）或二阶主观期望效用（SOSEU）模型（Nau，2006；Seo，2009；Giraud，2014）具有两个促使其成功的特征：它是一个迭代期望效用，并且在特定条件下是平滑的。这些特征使得能够运用期望效用理论中的标准分析技术，包括优化微积分。本文利用SOSEU泛函的连续可微性（C¹），为该模型提供了一种公理化刻画。首先，我们定义了C¹偏好并为其提供了表示。然后，假设偏好是C¹的，实现迭代期望效用形式的主要公理实质上表明：如果在概率分布已知的情况下，决策者对某一资产组合的扰动比另一资产组合更为敏感，那么在概率分布未知时，他们依然会更为敏感。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103271.title: An axiomatization of the smooth ambiguity model using differentiability
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103271.title_zh: 使用可微性对平滑模糊模型进行公理化

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103272.abstract: We introduce a new family of power indices for nodes in graphs with classes. We provide an axiomatic characterization of this family and prove the independence of the axioms. Furthermore, we show that these indices coincide with the Shapley values of a family of subadditive transferable-utility games defined on such graphs. These normative results yield a general framework for quantifying structural influence in complex networks. In particular, we identify the normative conditions under which power in technological sharing networks can be represented by our family of indices. Importantly, the proposed axiomatic framework also applies to influence flows that generate negative effects.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103272.abstract_zh: 我们针对带有类别属性的图节点引入了一类新的权力指数族，给出了该指数族的公理化刻画，并证明了各公理之间的独立性。进一步地，我们证明这些指数与定义在此类图上的次可加可转移效用博弈族中的沙普利值一致。这些规范性结论为量化复杂网络中的结构性影响提供了通用框架。特别地，我们识别出技术共享网络中权力可由本指数族表征的规范性条件。重要的是，所提出的公理化框架同样适用于产生负效应的影响力流动。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103272.title: Power in graphs with classes
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103272.title_zh: 具有类别的图中的权力

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103273.abstract: When exactly does a preference ordering on acts have an additive state-dependent utility representation per indifference curve? Following the analogy of a sliding balance, a perfect reflection of the well-known betweenness models for lotteries, we find three answers for monetary acts on a finite state space. In the first two, we exploit the axiom of weak decomposability, identified by Grant, Kajii, and Polak (2000) as the key axiom to extend betweenness to acts, but leaving the continuity and monotonicity of state utility in setpoints an open issue. Our first theorem confirms the necessity of continuity, while the second shows that monotonicty in setpoints requires the additional axiom of ratio monotonicity . It formalises the idea that sliding a setpoint towards a gain decreases its momentum compared to losses. This observation, in turn, suggests to extend the primitive of a preference ordering with a benchmark for discerning gains from losses within an act. Thus we arrive at the Additive Sliding Balance Utility model for orderings anchored to such a benchmark. In the third theorem, we characterise this class with an even more straightforward betweenness axiom: the balance point of an act should be in between those of its parts.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103273.abstract_zh: 在何种精确条件下，行动上的偏好序能够为每条无差异曲线提供加性状态依赖效用表示？遵循滑动平衡的类比——这一概念完美反映了彩票理论中著名的中间性模型——我们针对有限状态空间上的货币行动给出了三种解答。前两种解答中，我们运用了格兰特、梶井与波拉克（2000）所识别的弱可分解性公理，该公理被视为将中间性扩展至行动的关键，但状态效用关于设定点的连续性与单调性仍为开放问题。第一定理证实了连续性的必要性，而第二定理表明设定点单调性需要额外引入比率单调性公理。该公理形式化了如下思想：将设定点向收益方向滑动会降低其相对于损失的动量。这一观察进而提示，应在偏好序的原始概念中引入一个基准，用以区分行动内部的收益与损失。由此，我们提出了针对锚定此类基准的序关系的加性滑动平衡效用模型。在第三定理中，我们通过一个更为直接的中间性公理刻画了该模型类别：行动的平衡点应介于其各组成部分的平衡点之间。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103273.title: Balancing Acts

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103274.abstract: The complexity of climate change and environmental dynamics requires us to account for the possibility of singularities in the occurrence of future events. Abrupt and disruptive phenomena, often associated with extreme or catastrophic processes, provide clear examples of why singularities may be relevant for policymaking when designing appropriate control measures. However, the classical theory of differential equations and thus of dynamic optimization does not apply when environmental complexity implies that the source of the temporal variation in a state variable is singular with respect to the Lebesgue measure. In this paper we thus develop a theory of dynamic optimization capable to handling singularities (i) by defining a suitable differential equation (based on a new concept of derivative with respect to an abstract measure) describing singular dynamics, and (ii) by following the calculus of variations approach to establish first-order type necessary conditions for an optimization problem in which the dynamic constraint is characterized by singularity properties. We present an economic application in the context of climate change in which the social planner aims at minimizing the social cost of adaptation over a finite time-horizon in the case in which the cumulative damages are highly irregular and concentrated. We show how our theory can effectively be used to determine the optimal policy response in such a complex framework and thus how it can support policymakers to effectively account for the presence of eventual singularities in environmental dynamics.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103274.abstract_zh: 气候变化与环境动态的复杂性要求我们在考虑未来事件发生时，必须考虑到奇点存在的可能性。突发的、破坏性的现象，往往与极端或灾难性过程相关联，为奇点为何可能对政策制定在设计适当控制措施时具有重要意义提供了明确例证。然而，当环境复杂性意味着状态变量时间变化的来源相对于勒贝格测度是奇异的时，经典的微分方程理论及随之而来的动态优化理论便不再适用。因此，本文发展了一种能够处理奇点的动态优化理论，具体做法包括：（i）通过定义一个合适的微分方程（基于一种关于抽象测度的新导数概念）来描述奇异动态；（ii）遵循变分法的方法，为动态约束具有奇点特性的优化问题建立一阶必要条件的类型。我们在气候变化的背景下提出了一个经济应用，其中社会规划者旨在有限时间范围内最小化适应成本的社会成本，且累积损害高度不规则且集中。我们展示了我们的理论如何有效地用于确定在这种复杂框架下的最优政策响应，从而支持政策制定者有效考虑环境动态中可能存在的奇点。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103274.title: Climate change and complexity: Accounting for singularities in environmental dynamics
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103274.title_zh: 气候变化与复杂性：环境动态中奇异性的考量

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103275.abstract: We consider a number of deterministic models of economic growth in which all agents act rationally and the unique perfect foresight equilibrium features a stock price bubble. The key assumptions are that the production technology exhibits decreasing returns to scale (so that firms earn positive profits) and that wage income and dividend income have different growth rates. We relate the latter property to the violation of the Inada conditions for labor. The unique equilibrium fails to satisfy the property of balanced growth.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103275.abstract_zh: 我们考察了一系列确定性经济增长模型，其中所有行为者均理性行动，且唯一的完美预见均衡具有股价泡沫特征。关键假设在于生产技术呈现规模报酬递减（因此企业获得正利润），且工资收入与股息收入的增长率不同。我们将后一特性与劳动投入的Inada条件违反联系起来。该唯一均衡未能满足平衡增长的性质。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103275.title: Inevitability of stock price bubbles in simple growth models
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103275.title_zh: 股票价格泡沫在简单增长模型中的必然性

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103282.abstract: Progressive social ranking rules assign greater weight to shifts in voters' preferences occurring lower in their ranking, potentially enhancing egalitarianism between individuals with more and with less favored alternatives, compared to non-progressive rules. Weakly robust ranking rules are not overly sensitive to the smallest admissible change in an individual’s preferences. We axiomatically characterize four classes of progressive and weakly robust ranking rules: the comprehensive class, the negative quadratic (NQ) class, the constant absolute inequality aversion (CAIA) class and, in a continuous setting, the constant relative inequality aversion (CRIA) class. We also identify the subclass satisfying a stronger robustness requirement that limits excessive sensitivity to bottom-rank changes. The rules within the CAIA class are parameterized by a variable β ∈ ( 1 , ∞ ) , representing progressivity levels. The Borda and inverse plurality rules are obtained as special cases at the lower and upper bounds of β . Selecting the appropriate rule within this class requires deciding upon the desired level of progressivity and we illustrate how one can opt for a context-dependent choice of β by employing the median voter theorem. Finally, we provide a complete taxonomy of our four classes and the Borda rule, which leads to the axiomatization of the negative squared Borda rule, demonstrating its unique position within the intersection of the NQ and CRIA classes.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103282.abstract_zh: 渐进式社会排序规则赋予选民偏好中排名较低位置的变化以更大的权重，与非渐进式规则相比，这可能在拥有更受青睐和较少受青睐备选方案的个体之间增强平等主义。弱稳健排序规则对个体偏好中最小的可允许变化不过度敏感。我们公理化地刻画了四类渐进且弱稳健的排序规则：综合类、负二次（NQ）类、常数绝对不平等厌恶（CAIA）类，以及在连续设定下的常数相对不平等厌恶（CRIA）类。我们还识别出一个满足更强稳健性要求的子类，该要求限制了对底部排名变化的过度敏感性。CAIA类中的规则由参数β∈(1,∞)参数化，代表渐进性水平。博尔达规则和逆多数规则分别在β的下界和上界处作为特例获得。在此类中选择合适的规则需要决定所需的渐进性水平，我们通过运用中位选民定理说明如何根据情境选择β。最后，我们提供了我们四类规则与博尔达规则的完整分类体系，这引出了负平方博尔达规则的公理化，展示了其在NQ和CRIA类交集内的独特地位。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103282.title: Progressive and Robust Scoring Rules: Axiomatic Taxonomy
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103282.title_zh: 渐进且稳健的评分规则：公理分类

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103283.abstract: In close-knit communities, relationships are often formed and severed through the consent of community members. Inspired by this fact, I consider network formation when individuals need the consent of at least a fraction 𝑝 of the population to form or sever links. First, I show that a small consent requirement ( 𝑝 = 1 / ( 𝑛 − 1 ) ) is sufficient to stabilize efficient networks in the classical connections model. Second, I establish that altering only one feature of the connections model — type of externalities (positive vs negative) or path-dependence (single vs multiple paths) — has little impact, whereas modifying both features simultaneously produces significant changes in outcomes. My analysis highlights the importance of understanding complementarities between different features of externalities in network formation.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103283.abstract_zh: 在紧密联系的社群中，人际关系的建立与解除往往需经社群成员的共识。受此启发，我探讨了当个体需获得至少人口比例p的同意才能建立或解除联系时的网络形成问题。首先，我证明了一个较小的同意要求（p = 1 / ( n - 1 )）足以在经典连接模型中稳定高效网络。其次，我确认仅改变连接模型的一个特征——外部性类型（正或负）或路径依赖性（单路径或多路径）——影响甚微，而同时修改这两个特征则会导致结果显著变化。我的分析强调了理解网络形成中不同外部性特征间互补性的重要性。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103283.title: Link by consensus: Formation of community networks
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103283.title_zh: 共识联结：社区网络的形成

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103284.abstract: This paper uncovers some of the epistemic implications of stability in the presence of one-sided incomplete information. If it is not common knowledge that an allocation is not stable under complete information, the allocation must be stable under incomplete information, in the sense of Liu et al. (2014), regardless of the agents’ information and preferences. The converse does not necessarily hold, so that there can be common knowledge that an incomplete-information stable allocation is not complete-information stable, but is recovered within familiar information and preference domains. The characterization implies that incomplete-information stability is testable and observationally equivalent to its complete-information counterpart, and carries over to other well-known stability notions proposed in the literature.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103284.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了在单边不完全信息背景下，稳定性所蕴含的某些认知意义。若在完全信息下，一项配置的不稳定性并非共同知识，则该配置在不完全信息下必定是稳定的，此处的稳定性遵循Liu等人（2014）的定义，且不受代理人信息与偏好的影响。反之则未必成立，即可能存在共同知识表明，一项不完全信息下的稳定配置并非完全信息下的稳定配置，但在熟悉的信息与偏好域内可被重新识别。这一特征化结果表明，不完全信息下的稳定性是可检验的，并与完全信息下的稳定性在观测上等价，同时该结论也适用于文献中提出的其他著名稳定性概念。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103284.title: Epistemic implications of stable allocations
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103284.title_zh: 稳定配置的认识论含义

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103285.abstract: We extend the classical syndicate model to a setting with ambiguous beliefs, where agents face both risk and ambiguity and have heterogeneous smooth ambiguity preferences. Our main theorem generalizes Borch’s seminal result by providing necessary and sufficient conditions for Pareto optimality in this environment: an uncertainty-sharing contract is Pareto-optimal if and only if agents’ marginal utilities, weighted by ambiguity-adjusted belief densities, are proportional across states. The ambiguity-adjusted densities reflect how ambiguity aversion tilts evaluation toward adverse probabilistic models, with weights proportional to the marginal ambiguity attitude. The welfare interpretation is standard: Pareto-optimal contracts coincide with maximizers of a weighted social-welfare functional, and the proportionality constants equal the associated Pareto weights. The characterization nests Borch’s rule, reducing to proportional marginal utilities when beliefs are unambiguous or agents are ambiguity neutral.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103285.abstract_zh: 我们将经典辛迪加模型扩展至信念模糊的环境，其中代理人同时面临风险与模糊，并具有异质平滑模糊偏好。我们的主要定理推广了博尔奇的开创性成果，在此环境中提供了帕累托最优性的必要且充分条件：当且仅当代理人的边际效用，经模糊调整后的信念密度加权，在各状态间成比例时，不确定性分担契约才是帕累托最优的。模糊调整后的密度反映了模糊厌恶如何将评估偏向于不利的概率模型，其权重与边际模糊态度成比例。福利解释是标准的：帕累托最优契约与加权社会福利泛函的最大化者一致，且比例常数等于相应的帕累托权重。该特征化嵌套了博尔奇规则，当信念明确或代理人模糊中性时，简化为边际效用成比例。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103285.title: Pareto optimal uncertainty sharing under smooth ambiguity
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103285.title_zh: 平滑模糊下的帕累托最优不确定性分担

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103286.abstract: This paper studies a new axiom of choice functions, equal treatment of individuals in an indifference class (ETI), in the context of matching problems. We show that when a choice function satisfies ETI, substitutability, and size monotonicity, any individual for whom equal treatment applies must be either always accepted whenever available or never accepted. The set of admissible choice functions expands substantially when any one of these three axioms is dropped. ETI is also incompatible with 𝑞 -acceptance. We characterize the minimum degree of 𝑞 -acceptance violation under ETI, substitutability, and either size monotonicity or consistency. Under size monotonicity, the minimum is characterized by a partition of indifference classes into two groups. By contrast, under consistency, it is characterized by the size of a particular indifference class.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103286.abstract_zh: 本文研究了选择函数的一个新公理——无差异类中个体平等待遇（ETI），并将其置于匹配问题的背景下。我们证明，当选择函数满足ETI、可替代性和规模单调性时，任何适用平等待遇的个体，要么在可用时总被接受，要么永不被接受。若这三条公理中任意一条被舍弃，可容许选择函数的集合将大幅扩展。ETI还与𝑞-接受性不相容。我们刻画了在ETI、可替代性以及规模单调性或一致性条件下，𝑞-接受性违反的最小程度。在规模单调性下，最小值由无差异类划分为两组来表征；相比之下，在一致性下，则通过特定无差异类的大小来表征。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103286.title: Equal treatment and its market design implications
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103286.title_zh: 平等待遇及其市场设计含义

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103287.abstract: We study development traps generated by payoff-mediated coordination between an institutional layer and a private-sector layer. The leading interpretation is the transition from informality to formal-sector participation: institutional effort raises the return to formalisation, while formal participation raises the fiscal, compliance, and legitimacy returns to institutional effort. The paper develops this mechanism through nested continuous-time replicator models. The one-population benchmark gives the familiar critical-mass and hysteresis result. The two-role follower model shows how a scalar threshold becomes a stable saddle branch. The main contribution is a leader–follower phase-plane analysis: we derive local stability conditions for joint poverty, joint prosperity, and decoupled regimes; give sufficient global conditions under which the stable manifold of an interior saddle is the basin boundary; and prove a comparison result showing that payoff-improving reforms weakly expand the basin of joint prosperity. A multi-role extension records local rare-deviation stability and monotone nullcline shifts, without claiming a complete global classification in four dimensions. The analysis implies that unilateral policy interventions do not fail by definition; they fail when the induced state remains in the basin of the low-activity equilibrium.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103287.abstract_zh: 我们研究由制度层与私营部门层之间通过收益中介的协调所产生的“发展陷阱”。主导性解释是从非正规经济向正规部门参与的转型：制度努力提高了正规化的回报，而正规参与则提升了制度努力在财政、合规及合法性方面的回报。本文通过嵌套的连续时间复制者模型来阐述这一机制。单群体基准模型给出了熟悉的临界规模与滞后效应结果。双角色追随者模型展示了标量阈值如何演变为稳定的鞍分支。主要贡献在于领导者-追随者相平面分析：我们推导了共同贫困、共同繁荣及分离状态下的局部稳定性条件；给出了内部鞍点的稳定流形作为盆地边界的充分全局条件；并证明了一个比较结果，即收益改善型改革会弱扩展共同繁荣的盆地。多角色扩展记录了局部稀有偏差稳定性及单调零斜线移动，但未声称在四维空间中提供完整的全局分类。分析表明，单边政策干预并非必然失败；它们仅在所诱导的状态仍停留在低活动均衡的盆地内时才会失败。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103287.title: On the dynamics of coordinated hierarchies: Economic growth versus poverty traps
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103287.title_zh: 协调层级动态研究：经济增长与贫困陷阱

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103288.abstract: We study the strong core of housing markets when agents’ preferences over houses are expressed as partial orders. We provide a structural characterization of the strong core, and propose an efficient algorithm that finds an allocation in the strong core or decides that it is empty, even in the presence of forced and forbidden arcs. The algorithm satisfies the property of weak group-strategyproofness. Additionally, we show that certain results known for the strong core in the case where agents’ preferences are weak orders can be extended to the setting with partial order preferences; among others, we show that the strong core in such housing markets satisfies the property of respecting improvements.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103288.abstract_zh: 我们研究当代理人对房屋的偏好以偏序形式表达时住房市场的强核。我们提供了强核的结构性特征，并提出了一种高效算法，该算法能在存在强制弧和禁止弧的情况下找到强核中的分配或判定其为空。该算法满足弱群体策略证明性。此外，我们证明，在代理人偏好为弱序的情况下已知的关于强核的某些结果可以扩展到偏序偏好设置中；其中，我们证明此类住房市场中的强核满足尊重改进的性质。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103288.title: The strong core of housing markets with partial order preferences
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103288.title_zh: 具有偏序偏好的住房市场的强核

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103289.abstract: When can a leader allocate scarce resources without triggering conflict from excluded groups? We study this question in a centralized assignment problem in which a conflict-averse leader allocates indivisible resources under an influence structure that determines which coalitions can block outcomes. We characterize when stable assignments exist, identify the minimum resource level required to guarantee stability, and determine how resources are allocated when stability is feasible. Our main result is that the relationship between resource availability and stability is non-monotonic: stable allocations may arise under extreme scarcity and abundance, yet fail at intermediate levels. The exact thresholds governing these regimes depend entirely on the underlying influence structure. The model provides a framework for studying conflict avoidance in environments such as political appointments, land allocation, public procurement, and aid distribution.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103289.abstract_zh: 领导者何时能够在不引发被排除群体冲突的情况下分配稀缺资源？我们在一个集中式分配问题中研究此问题，其中一位厌恶冲突的领导者在一个决定哪些联盟能够阻止结果的影响力结构下分配不可分割的资源。我们刻画了稳定分配何时存在，确定了保证稳定性所需的最低资源水平，并探讨了在稳定性可行时资源如何分配。我们的主要发现是，资源可用性与稳定性之间的关系是非单调的：在极端稀缺和充裕条件下可能出现稳定分配，而在中间水平下则可能失败。控制这些机制的确切阈值完全取决于底层影响力结构。该模型为研究政治任命、土地分配、公共采购和援助分配等环境中的冲突规避提供了框架。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103289.title: Rationing to avoid conflict: A centralized assignment problem
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103289.title_zh: 配额分配以避免冲突：一个集中指派问题

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103291.abstract: We examine how the shapes of utility functions, particularly risk attitudes, influence Nash bargaining outcomes, thereby challenging the conventional assumption of risk neutrality. Our comparative static analysis reveals several key insights. (1) Changes in Pie Size: Increasing Absolute Risk Aversion (IARA) introduces an “equality bias,” which elucidates the fair distributions observed in unstructured bargaining experiments by emphasizing the role of participants’ risk attitudes. (2) Changes in Disagreement Point: IARA also results in low sensitivity, referred to as “insensitivity bias,” which contests the interpretation proposed by Anbarci and Feltovich (2013) by showing that concave IARA utility functions can adequately explain this insensitivity. These equality bias and insensitivity bias are closely interconnected phenomena. We propose a novel theoretical framework that elucidates the diverse outcomes of experimental bargaining through the lens of fundamental risk attitudes.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103291.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了效用函数形状，特别是风险态度，如何影响纳什谈判结果，从而挑战了风险中性的传统假设。我们的比较静态分析揭示了几个关键见解。(1) 馅饼大小的变化：递增绝对风险厌恶（IARA）引入了“平等偏见”，这通过强调参与者风险态度的作用，阐明了非结构化谈判实验中观察到的公平分配。(2) 分歧点的变化：IARA还导致低敏感性，称为“不敏感偏见”，这通过展示凹形IARA效用函数能够充分解释这种不敏感性，对Anbarci和Feltovich（2013）提出的解释提出了质疑。这些平等偏见和不敏感偏见是紧密相连的现象。我们提出了一种新颖的理论框架，通过基本风险态度的视角阐明了实验性谈判的多样化结果。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103291.title: Comparative statics of Nash bargaining solution: Equality and insensitivity biases
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103291.title_zh: 纳什谈判解的比较静态分析：平等与不敏感偏差

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103292.abstract: We study value allocation in two-sided markets (such as payment cards, streaming platforms, online travel booking sites, ride-sharing apps, and search engines). We characterize two focal classes of allocation rules (premium-augmented Shapley solutions and premium-augmented equal-division solutions) with strong normative underpinnings. A common feature of these classes is that they permit favorable treatment to only one side of the market. Our characterized rules provide rationale for familiar practices of platforms in real life, which charge one side (say, sellers) of the market while subsidizing the other side (buyers) in various ways (e.g., coupons and discounts).
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103292.abstract_zh: 我们研究双边市场（如支付卡、流媒体平台、在线旅行预订网站、拼车应用和搜索引擎）中的价值分配问题。我们刻画了两类具有坚实规范基础的分配规则（溢价增强的沙普利解和溢价增强的均分解）。这两类规则的共同特点是允许仅对市场一方给予优惠待遇。我们所刻画的规则为现实中平台常见的做法提供了理论依据，即向市场一方（如卖家）收费，同时以各种方式（如优惠券和折扣）补贴另一方（买家）。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103292.title: Value allocation in two-sided markets
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103292.title_zh: 双边市场中的价值分配

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103293.abstract: Consider the problem of designing a revenue-optimal auction mechanism when two heterogeneous items are sold to a single buyer having independent valuations over the items. The distributions of the buyer’s valuation for the items are assumed to have densities that are positive, nondecreasing, and continuously differentiable on their support sets [ c i , c i + b i ] in the positive axis. I prove that the optimal mechanism is deterministic if at least one of the minimum valuations (i.e., either c 1 or c 2 ) is sufficiently high. I provide a method to calculate the threshold of ( c 1 , c 2 ) beyond which the optimal mechanism is deterministic. I also provide a sufficient condition on the distributions of buyer’s valuations for which the individual sale mechanism is optimal. I show that when c 1 is low and c 2 is high, it is optimal for the seller to sell item 2 at the minimum valuation c 2 , thus effectively reducing the problem to finding the optimal mechanism in the one-dimensional setting only for item 1. I conjecture with promising preliminary results that this result can be extended to the three-item setting. Specifically, I conjecture that when c 1 and c 2 are low but c 3 is high, it is optimal for the seller to sell item 3 at the minimum valuation c 3 , thus effectively reducing the problem to finding the optimal mechanism in the two-dimensional setting for items 1 and 2.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103293.abstract_zh: 考虑在将两种异质商品出售给对商品具有独立估值的单一买家时，设计收益最优拍卖机制的问题。假设买家对商品的估值分布具有正密度、非递减且在支撑集[ci, ci + bi]（位于正半轴）上连续可微。我证明，如果至少一个最低估值（即c1或c2）足够高，则最优机制是确定性的。我提供了一种方法来计算(c1, c2)的阈值，超过该阈值后最优机制即为确定性的。我还给出了买家估值分布的一个充分条件，在该条件下，单独销售机制是最优的。我表明，当c1较低而c2较高时，卖家以最低估值c2出售商品2是最优的，从而有效地将问题简化为仅针对商品1的一维设置中的最优机制求解。我推测，基于有前景的初步结果，这一结论可以扩展到三商品设置。具体而言，我推测当c1和c2较低但c3较高时，卖家以最低估值c3出售商品3是最优的，从而有效地将问题简化为针对商品1和2的二维设置中的最优机制求解。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103293.title: On deterministic optimal mechanisms in a two-item setting for distributions with nondecreasing density
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103293.title_zh: 确定性最优机制：两物品情形下非递减密度分布的研究

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103294.abstract: We characterize the optimal contract within the class of fixed-terms mechanisms in a repeated buyer-seller relationship with persistent adverse selection and one-sided limited enforcement. The seller reports his type once, and the corresponding transfer and output are then repeated in every period. After receiving the current transfer, the seller may breach, pay an enforceable penalty, and terminate the relationship. In this benchmark, the enforcement problem collapses to a bound on the transfer targeted to the most efficient type. This yields a three-regime characterization. With strong enforcement, the repeated static second-best contract is feasible. With weak (intermediate) enforcement, the top transfer is capped, inducing bunching among efficient types and additional downward distortions. With very weak enforcement, sustaining compliance through public penalties alone would require excessive quantity distortions, and the optimal contract instead leaves strictly positive continuation rents, including for the least efficient type. We interpret the associated distortion as a virtual enforcement cost.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103294.abstract_zh: 我们在重复买卖双方关系中，针对固定期限机制类别，刻画了最优契约，该关系具有持久性逆向选择与单边有限执行的特点。卖方仅报告一次其类型，相应的转移支付与产出随后在每一期重复。在收到当期转移支付后，卖方可能违约，支付可执行的罚金，并终止关系。在此基准情形下，执行问题简化为对最有效率类型所对应转移支付的上限约束。这产生了三区域特征描述。在强执行下，重复的静态次优契约是可行的。在弱（中等）执行下，最高转移支付受到上限限制，导致有效率类型之间的聚集以及额外的向下扭曲。在极弱执行下，仅通过公共罚金维持合规将要求过度的数量扭曲，而最优契约则转而留下严格正的持续租金，包括对最无效率类型也是如此。我们将相关扭曲解释为一种虚拟执行成本。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103294.title: Optimal fixed-terms contracts under one-sided enforcement and persistent adverse selection
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103294.title_zh: 单向执行与持续逆向选择下的最优固定期限合同

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103295.abstract: This paper studies social choice rules over sets of feasible utility vectors à la Nash’s (1950) bargaining problem. First, we identify necessary and sufficient conditions for choice rules to be rationalized by welfare orderings or functions over 0–1 normalized utility vectors. These general results are useful for providing an axiomatic foundation for a novel class of choice rules with normalization. Furthermore, we show that at the axiomatic level, this class of choice rules is closely related to the classical bargaining solution introduced by Kalai and Smorodinsky (1975).
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103295.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一类社会选择规则，其对象为可行效用向量集合，遵循纳什（1950）讨价还价问题的框架。首先，我们识别了选择规则能够被0-1标准化效用向量上的福利排序或函数合理化的必要且充分条件。这些一般性结果有助于为带有标准化处理的新型选择规则类别提供公理化基础。此外，我们表明，在公理层面，这类选择规则与卡拉伊和斯莫罗丁斯基（1975）提出的经典讨价还价解密切相关。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103295.title: Social choice rules when individuals are responsible for their skills
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103295.title_zh: 当个体对其技能负责时的社会选择规则

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103296.abstract: We consider voting rules in settings where voters’ identities are difficult to verify. Voters can manipulate the process by casting multiple votes under different identities or abstaining from voting. Immunities to such manipulations are called false-name-proofness and participation, respectively. For the universal domain of (strict) preferences, these properties together imply anonymity and are incompatible with neutrality. For the domain of preferences defined over all subsets of a given set of objects, both false-name-proofness and participation cannot be met by rules that are also onto, object neutral, and tops-only. However, when preferences over subsets of objects are restricted to be separable, all these properties can be satisfied. Furthermore, the domain of separable preferences is maximal for these properties.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103296.abstract_zh: 我们考察在选民身份难以验证的环境下的投票规则。选民可能通过以不同身份投多票或弃权来操纵过程。对此类操纵的免疫性分别称为虚假身份证明性和参与性。在（严格）偏好的全域上，这些性质共同蕴含匿名性，并与中立性不相容。在定义于给定对象集所有子集上的偏好域中，虚假身份证明性和参与性无法由同时满足满射性、对象中立性和仅依赖顶点的规则实现。然而，当对对象子集的偏好被限制为可分离时，所有这些性质均可满足。此外，可分离偏好域对于这些性质而言是最大的。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103296.title: On voting rules satisfying false-name-proofness and participation
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103296.title_zh: 关于满足假名防伪性与参与性的投票规则

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103297.abstract: In an agency model, we compare the use of an insider versus an outsider agent when the principal can restrict their choice sets. The insider is familiar with the old project but not with the new project, whereas the outsider is unfamiliar with both. The principal chooses between the insider and the outsider, and the selected agent manages the project—deciding between the old and the new project, as well as choosing the project’s attribute. Gathering information about a project is costly to an agent. We show the following. Restricting the selected agent’s choice set allows the principal to induce information gathering more effectively. Under sequential learning, the principal (weakly) prefers the insider. Under simultaneous learning, however, the outsider may be preferred. Moreover, restricting the agent’s choice set enlarges the parameter range where the outsider is preferred. Sequential learning is dominated by simultaneous learning from the principal’s perspective.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103297.abstract_zh: 在代理模型中，我们比较了当委托人能限制其选择集时，使用内部代理人还是外部代理人的情况。内部代理人熟悉旧项目但不熟悉新项目，而外部代理人对两者都不熟悉。委托人需在内部与外部代理人之间做出选择，被选中的代理人负责管理项目——决定采用旧项目还是新项目，并选择项目的属性。对代理人而言，收集项目信息是有成本的。我们的研究结果显示：限制所选代理人的选择集能使委托人更有效地促使信息收集。在序贯学习下，委托人（弱）偏好内部代理人。然而，在同时学习下，外部代理人可能更受青睐。此外，限制代理人的选择集扩大了偏好外部代理人的参数范围。从委托人的角度看，序贯学习不如同时学习。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103297.title: Restrictions and agent selection

10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103298.abstract: This paper studies equilibria in games in which agents report utility functions or preferences over continuously divisible goods and allocation is determined by maximizing the egalitarian social welfare function. About the game of reporting utility functions, we make an even trivial but practically overlooked point that everybody tries to be seen as unhappier, and hence only ordinal information can be conveyed. We then characterize equilibria of the preference reporting game in which we adopt a wide class of individual welfare measures.
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103298.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在博弈中，当参与者报告对连续可分商品的效用函数或偏好，且分配通过最大化平等主义社会福利函数来确定时的均衡状态。关于效用函数报告的博弈，我们提出了一个虽微不足道但在实践中常被忽视的观点：每个人都试图表现得更加不快乐，因此只能传递序数信息。随后，我们刻画了采用广泛个体福利度量类别的偏好报告博弈中的均衡特征。
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103298.title: Equilibrium consequence of welfare egalitarianism
10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103298.title_zh: 福利平等主义的均衡结果

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2023.04.003.abstract: We study the effects of supply disruptions - for instance due to energy price shocks or the emergence of a pandemic - in an economy with Keynesian unemployment and endogenous productivity growth. By temporarily disrupting investment, negative supply shocks generate permanent output losses - or scarring effects. By inducing a negative wealth effect, scarring effects depress aggregate demand, which may even fall below the exogenous fall in supply. However, that scarring effects depress aggregate demand does not necessarily translate into low rates of inflation. On the contrary, scarring effects may reinforce and prolong the inflationary impact of supply disruptions. A contractionary monetary policy response may end up deepening scarring effects and increasing inflation in the medium run. A successful disinflation may require a policy mix of monetary tightening and fiscal interventions aiming at supporting business investment and the economy’s productive capacity.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2023.04.003.abstract_zh: 我们研究在存在凯恩斯式失业与内生生产率增长的经济体中，供应中断（例如能源价格冲击或疫情爆发）所产生的影响。通过暂时扰乱投资，负向供应冲击会导致持久产出损失，即疤痕效应。疤痕效应通过引发负财富效应，抑制总需求，其下降幅度甚至可能超过外生供应减少。然而，疤痕效应抑制总需求并不必然转化为低通胀率。相反，疤痕效应可能加剧并延长供应中断的通胀影响。紧缩性货币政策回应最终可能加深疤痕效应，并在中期推高通胀。成功的通胀回落可能需要结合货币紧缩与旨在支持企业投资及经济生产能力的财政干预措施的政策组合。

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2025.103780.abstract: We analyze the effects of policy transition risk on asset pricing and the green transition using a global two-sector, macro-finance model of climate and the economy. Policy transition risk results from probabilistic changes between three policy states: no, modest, and ambitious carbon pricing. We show that policy transition risk leads to carbon premiums (i.e. higher expected returns on brown than on green assets), especially if the economy is still quite carbon-intensive and close to the temperature cap, and thus accelerate the green transition. Increased transition risk leads to more precautionary saving and falls in the risk-free rate.
