We offer extensions to deal with physical risks (temperature-related risk of climate disasters and climate tipping), technology transition risk, and more realistic policy tipping with endogenous transition probabilities. • Policy transition risk leads to carbon premiums and a faster green transition. • Risks of climate-related disasters and climate tipping push up the carbon price. • Climate policy shocks have a significant impact on asset prices and returns. • Price impacts are more pronounced if carbon-intensive capital is more prevalent.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2025.103780.abstract_zh: 我们利用一个全球两部门、宏观金融的气候与经济模型，分析了政策转型风险对资产定价和绿色转型的影响。政策转型风险源于三种政策状态之间的概率性变化：无碳定价、适度碳定价和雄心勃勃的碳定价。研究表明，政策转型风险会导致碳溢价（即棕色资产预期回报高于绿色资产），尤其是在经济仍高度碳密集且接近温度上限时，从而加速绿色转型。转型风险的增加会引发更多预防性储蓄，并导致无风险利率下降。我们提供了扩展分析，以处理物理风险（与温度相关的气候灾害风险和气候临界点风险）、技术转型风险，以及具有内生转型概率的更现实的政策临界点情形。• 政策转型风险导致碳溢价并加速绿色转型。• 气候相关灾害和气候临界点风险推高碳价格。• 气候政策冲击对资产价格和回报有显著影响。• 当碳密集型资本更为普遍时，价格影响更为显著。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2025.103780.title: Policy Transition Risk, Carbon Premiums, and Asset Prices
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2025.103780.title_zh: 政策转型风险、碳溢价与资产价格

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103926.title: Comment on: Is it AI or data that drives market power?
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103926.title_zh: 评论：驱动市场力量的是人工智能还是数据？

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103934.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic led to unprecedented disruptions in global supply chains (GSC), coupled with large fiscal stimulus. This paper employs a proxy structural VAR model to examine GSC shocks, the Federal Reserve’s response, and their propagation under two counterfactual policy rules. Large fiscal stimulus amplifies inflation while cushioning the downturn from GSC shocks. Historically, the Fed has looked through price surges and adopted a loose stance. The first counterfactual, which stabilises inflation, entails less accommodation and yields a more favourable inflation-output trade-off, reflecting greater price flexibility and limited output losses. The second, which minimises a dual-mandate loss function under inflation targeting (IT) or average inflation targeting (AIT), calls for greater initial easing. Relative to IT, AIT implies a looser policy that generates more persistent inflation and ultimately requires a contractionary response, worsening the trade-off.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103934.abstract_zh: 新冠疫情导致了全球供应链（GSC）前所未有的中断，同时伴随着大规模的财政刺激。本文采用代理结构向量自回归模型，考察了全球供应链冲击、美联储的应对措施，以及在两种反事实政策规则下的传导效应。大规模的财政刺激在缓解全球供应链冲击引发的经济衰退的同时，加剧了通货膨胀。从历史角度看，美联储一直忽视价格飙升并采取宽松的政策立场。第一种反事实情景旨在稳定通胀，其政策宽松程度较低，却带来了更优的通胀-产出权衡，反映出更高的价格灵活性和有限的产出损失。第二种反事实情景在通胀目标制（IT）或平均通胀目标制（AIT）下最小化双重使命损失函数，则要求更大幅度的初始宽松。与IT相比，AIT意味着更宽松的政策，导致通胀更具持续性，并最终需要紧缩性应对，从而恶化了权衡关系。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103934.title: Monetary policy trade-offs amid global supply chain disruptions
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103934.title_zh: 全球供应链中断中的货币政策权衡

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103935.abstract: This paper studies how rising returns to scale contributed to declining business dynamism and increasing markups and expenditures devoted to customer acquisition in the U.S. economy. It introduces a firm dynamics model with heterogeneous markups and customer accumulation based on directed search, in which larger firms gain a competitive edge from higher returns to scale. This makes markets less contestable for new firms and leads to the rise of superstar firms. The model quantitatively accounts for a substantial share of these trends, and the underlying micro-level mechanisms align with empirical evidence. • Superstar firms contribute to secular trends: declining business dynamism, increasing markups, and higher spending on customer acquisition. • Rising returns to scale amplify differences among firms, driving the growth of superstar firms. • Novel directed-search model quantitatively explains a substantial fraction of these secular changes via rising returns to scale. • The model also aligns with several micro-level phenomena associated with these secular trends.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103935.abstract_zh: 本文研究了规模报酬递增如何促进美国经济中商业活力下降、加成率上升以及客户获取支出增加的现象。文章引入了一个包含异质性加成率和基于定向搜索的客户积累的企业动态模型，在该模型中，规模较大的企业因更高的规模报酬而获得竞争优势。这使得新企业面临的市场可竞争性降低，从而催生了超级明星企业的崛起。该模型在数量上解释了这些趋势的相当大一部分，其微观层面的机制与实证证据相符。• 超级明星企业推动了长期趋势：商业活力下降、加成率上升以及客户获取支出增加。• 规模报酬递增加剧了企业间的差异，推动了超级明星企业的成长。• 新颖的定向搜索模型通过规模报酬递增在数量上解释了这些长期变化的相当大一部分。• 该模型还与这些长期趋势相关的若干微观层面现象相吻合。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103935.title: Customer accumulation, returns to scale, and secular trends
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103935.title_zh: 客户积累、规模报酬与长期趋势

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103942.abstract: This paper documents how racial differences in labor income may simultaneously explain both crime and wealth disparities between Black and White individuals. Using an overlapping generations model that endogenously determines crime rates alongside consumption and savings decisions, we find that equalizing labor incomes results in a significant decline in both the Black crime rate and the proportion of Black individuals in the lowest wealth quintile. Higher crime and incarceration rates of Black individuals, on the other hand, do not significantly contribute to their low wealth. This is primarily because most crimes are committed by already poor and young individuals who are not saving in any case.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103942.abstract_zh: 本文档记录了劳动收入中的种族差异如何可能同时解释黑人与白人个体之间的犯罪率和财富差距。通过使用一个内生决定犯罪率以及消费和储蓄决策的重叠世代模型，我们发现，使劳动收入均等化会导致黑人犯罪率和处于最低财富五分位的黑人比例显著下降。另一方面，黑人个体较高的犯罪率和监禁率并未显著促成其低财富水平。这主要是因为大多数犯罪由本已贫困且年轻、无论如何都不储蓄的个体实施。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103942.title: Racial disparities in crime and wealth
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103942.title_zh: 犯罪与财富中的种族差异

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103943.title: Discussion of: “Automated credit limit increases and consumer welfare”
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103943.title_zh: 讨论：“自动信用额度提升与消费者福利

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103944.abstract: Nowadays, many producing firms do not hire workers, but rent them from “staffing agencies”, whose main activity is to find, employ, and rent out workers to producing firms. That way, producing firms do not bear the direct costs of search and instead rent workers in a competitive market. We employ standard search-and-matching theory to analyze this phenomenon, with producing firms that have decreasing returns to scale. We find that the mere presence of staffing agencies has an important impact on the bargaining between the firms and their hired, “in-house” workers: firms can strategically use rented workers to weaken the bargaining position of in-house workers, tilting bargaining in their own favor. This has first-order effects on wages and employment. If rented and in-house workers are identical in production and in search markets, the unique equilibrium is one where producing firms only use rented workers. If renting workers involve additional costs, the equilibrium features an interior solution where each firm procures workers from two sources.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103944.abstract_zh: 如今，许多生产企业不再直接雇佣工人，而是从“劳务派遣机构”租用工人，这些机构的主要活动是寻找、雇佣并将工人出租给生产企业。这样一来，生产企业无需承担直接的搜寻成本，而是在竞争性市场中租用工人。我们运用标准的搜寻与匹配理论来分析这一现象，假设生产企业具有规模报酬递减的特征。研究发现，劳务派遣机构的存在本身就对生产企业与其雇佣的“内部”工人之间的谈判产生重要影响：企业可以策略性地利用租用工人来削弱内部工人的谈判地位，使谈判向有利于自身的方向倾斜。这对工资和就业产生了一阶效应。如果租用工人与内部工人在生产和搜寻市场上完全相同，那么唯一均衡是企业仅使用租用工人。如果租用工人涉及额外成本，则均衡呈现内部解特征，即每个企业从两个来源获取工人。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103944.title: Staffing agencies and in-house bargaining
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103944.title_zh: 人事代理机构与内部谈判

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103945.abstract: The protracted fall in the real interest rate of the 1991–2020 period indicates that global demand for financial assets grew much faster than supply. We propose a two-region model of private capital flows to show that two drivers of global prosperity played a key role in this phenomenon: faster growth in emerging economies (EMEs) and financial development in advanced (AEs) and emerging economies. The model also predicts that asset portfolios became riskier and made countries more vulnerable to financial crises, increasing output volatility worldwide. The faster growth of EMEs accounts for 18% and 13% of the rise in volatility in EMEs and AEs, respectively, and it also produced large welfare gains for EMEs. Changes in the financial structure of both regions also contributed to increase output volatility, producing gains for entrepreneurs and losses for households.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103945.abstract_zh: 1991年至2020年间实际利率的持续下降表明，全球对金融资产的需求增长远快于供给。我们提出一个两区域私人资本流动模型，以证明全球繁荣的两大驱动力在这一现象中发挥了关键作用：新兴经济体的更快增长以及发达经济体和新兴经济体的金融发展。该模型还预测，资产组合变得更加风险化，使各国更易遭受金融危机，从而加剧了全球产出波动。新兴经济体的更快增长分别解释了新兴经济体和发达经济体波动性上升的18%和13%，同时也为新兴经济体带来了巨大的福利收益。两个地区金融结构的变化也促进了产出波动的增加，为企业家带来收益，却使家庭遭受损失。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103945.title: Unstable prosperity: How globalization made the world economy more volatile
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103945.title_zh: 不稳定的繁荣：全球化如何加剧世界经济波动

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103946.abstract: U.S. product markets have become more concentrated since the late 1990s, with higher markups, weaker entry, and slower productivity growth. This paper studies whether consolidation in the U.S. banking sector has contributed to these trends. Empirically, I show that higher bank concentration is associated with rising product market markups, lower entry, and a reallocation of market power toward large incumbents. I interpret these patterns in a quantitative endogenous growth model with imperfect bank competition and heterogeneous firms. The key mechanism is a widening loan-deposit spread: even as interest rate levels decline, greater bank market power increases the wedge between the borrowing costs faced by small bank-dependent firms and the opportunity cost of funds faced by large internally financed firms, shifting competition toward large incumbents and weakening innovation incentives. In calibrated counterfactuals, the rise in bank concentration explains about 14% of the increase in product market concentration and 5% of the slowdown in productivity growth over the post-2000 period.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103946.abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代末以来，美国产品市场集中度上升，伴随更高的加成率、更弱的市场进入以及生产率增长放缓。本文研究美国银行业整合是否对这些趋势有所贡献。实证上，我表明更高的银行集中度与产品市场加成率上升、进入减少以及市场力量向大型在位企业重新分配相关联。我在一个包含不完全银行竞争和异质性企业的定量内生增长模型中解释这些模式。关键机制在于贷款-存款利差的扩大：即使利率水平下降，更大的银行市场力量增加了小型依赖银行的企业所面临的借款成本与大型内部融资企业所面临的资金机会成本之间的差距，从而将竞争转向大型在位企业并削弱创新激励。在校准的反事实分析中，银行集中度的上升解释了2000年后产品市场集中度增加的大约14%以及生产率增长放缓的5%。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103946.title: Bank concentration, product market competition and productivity growth
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103946.title_zh: 银行集中度、产品市场竞争与生产率增长

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103947.title: Comment on “The impact of AI on global knowledge work” by Enrique Ide and Eduard Talamàs
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103947.title_zh: 评论：Enrique Ide与Eduard Talamàs的《人工智能对全球知识工作的影响》

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103955.abstract: We develop a framework for decision-making under model uncertainty, grounded in Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization. In contrast to standard Kullback–Leibler approaches constrained by absolute continuity, Wasserstein ambiguity sets constructed via optimal transport permit the adversary to physically relocate probability mass to new states, capturing economically relevant support-shifting distortions—structural breaks, regime shifts, and catastrophic tail events—that the reference model excludes entirely. We integrate these state-shift distortions into both static and recursive dynamic decision problems, where agents optimize against the worst-case distribution within a transport budget. A data-driven bootstrap calibration procedure disciplines the degree of robustness by linking the ambiguity radius to statistical confidence sets. Applying the framework to asset pricing, we show that endogenous belief distortions amplify perceived variance, inducing precautionary savings that lower the risk-free rate and widen the equity premium. The geometric uncertainty propagates through persistent state dynamics, generating endogenous stochastic volatility akin to long-run risk. The resulting pricing kernel aligns with empirical Hansen–Jagannathan bounds without requiring implausibly high risk aversion or non-standard preferences.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103955.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个在模型不确定性下进行决策的框架，其基础是Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化。与受绝对连续性约束的标准Kullback–Leibler方法不同，通过最优传输构建的Wasserstein模糊集允许对抗者将概率质量物理性地移动到新状态，从而捕捉参考模型完全排除的、具有经济相关性的支持转移扭曲——结构性断裂、制度变迁和灾难性尾部事件。我们将这些状态转移扭曲整合到静态和递归动态决策问题中，其中代理在传输预算内针对最坏情况分布进行优化。一种数据驱动的自助法校准程序通过将模糊半径与统计置信集联系起来，对鲁棒性程度加以约束。将该框架应用于资产定价，我们表明内生信念扭曲会放大感知方差，引发预防性储蓄，从而降低无风险利率并扩大股权溢价。几何不确定性通过持久的状态动态传播，产生类似于长期风险的内生随机波动性。由此产生的定价核与经验上的Hansen–Jagannathan边界一致，而无需假设过高的风险厌恶或非标准偏好。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103955.title: Wasserstein worst-case scenarios and asset pricing

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103956.abstract: Foreign monetary policy shocks increasingly influence U.S. yields, particularly since the Global Financial Crisis. We show that this heightened sensitivity reflects both the adoption of unconventional monetary policy tools and a decline in the convenience of Treasuries. Using high frequency identification, we find that when Treasuries command a low convenience premium—behaving more like other assets—they respond more to ECB monetary policy, consistent with increased sensitivity to portfolio rebalancing. A two-country preferred-habitat model with time-varying covariance of yields rationalizes these results: when Treasuries are less convenient, they become closer substitutes for foreign equivalents, amplifying cross-border transmission of policy shocks.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103956.abstract_zh: 外国货币政策冲击对美国收益率的影响日益增强，尤其是在全球金融危机之后。我们证明，这种敏感性的提升既反映了非常规货币政策工具的采用，也反映了美国国债便利性的下降。利用高频识别方法，我们发现，当美国国债的便利溢价较低——其行为更类似于其他资产时，它们对欧洲央行货币政策的反应更为显著，这与投资组合再平衡敏感性的增强相一致。一个具有时变收益率协方差的两国偏好栖息地模型为这些结果提供了理论解释：当美国国债便利性降低时，它们与外国同类资产的替代性增强，从而放大了政策冲击的跨境传导效应。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103956.title: Unconventional monetary policy spillovers and the (in)convenience of Treasuries
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103956.title_zh: 非常规货币政策溢出效应与国债的（不）便利性

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103957.abstract: This paper develops a general equilibrium framework to examine the welfare implications of aggregate-demand information derived from payment data. The disclosure of such information tends to improve aggregate welfare when interest rates are low but may reduce welfare when rates are high. If a central bank controls information disclosure, it can craft noisy messages that encourage investment and benefit welfare through a form of Bayesian persuasion. If the information is instead produced by private banks and traded in a competitive market, excessive information production may happen. Finally, privacy concerns may dissuade some consumers from using digital payments, thereby decreasing the precision of aggregate-demand information, but it need not reduce welfare.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103957.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个一般均衡框架，用以考察源自支付数据的总体需求信息对福利的影响。当利率较低时，此类信息的披露往往能提升总体福利，但在利率较高时则可能降低福利。若中央银行掌控信息披露，它能通过一种贝叶斯说服的形式，设计出带有噪声的信息，以鼓励投资并增进福利。相反，若信息由私人银行生产并在竞争性市场中交易，则可能出现信息过度生产的情况。最后，隐私担忧可能促使部分消费者放弃使用数字支付，从而降低总体需求信息的精确度，但这并不必然导致福利减少。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103957.title: Payment data, information disclosure, and privacy
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103957.title_zh: 支付数据、信息披露与隐私

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103958.abstract: Unemployment insurance (UI) acts both as a disincentive for labor supply and as a demand stimulus which may explain why empirical studies often find limited effects of UI on employment. This paper provides independent estimates of the disincentive effects arising from the largest expansion of UI in U.S. history, the pandemic unemployment benefits. Using high-frequency data on small restaurants and retailers from Homebase, we control for local demand effects by comparing neighboring businesses that largely share the positive impact of UI stimulus. We find that employment in low-wage businesses recovered more slowly than employment in high-wage businesses in labor markets with larger differences in the relative generosity of pandemic UI benefits. According to a labor search model that replicates the estimated employment differences between low-and high-wage businesses, the disincentive effects from the pandemic UI programs held back the aggregate employment recovery by 4.7 percentage points between April and December 2020.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103958.abstract_zh: 失业保险（UI）既作为劳动供给的抑制因素，也作为需求刺激手段，这可能解释了为何实证研究常发现UI对就业影响有限。本文针对美国历史上最大规模的失业保险扩展——疫情失业补助，提供了其抑制效应的独立估计。利用来自Homebase的高频数据，涵盖小型餐馆和零售商，我们通过比较邻近企业来控制地方需求效应，这些企业大体上共享UI刺激的正面影响。我们发现，在疫情UI福利相对慷慨程度差异较大的劳动力市场中，低工资企业的就业恢复速度慢于高工资企业。根据一个能够复现低工资与高工资企业间估计就业差异的劳动搜寻模型，疫情UI项目的抑制效应在2020年4月至12月期间，使总体就业恢复率降低了4.7个百分点。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103958.title: Disincentive effects of unemployment insurance benefits
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103958.title_zh: 失业保险金的抑制效应

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103959.abstract: Using a novel database of media-reported anonymous leaks about monetary policy in the euro area, we conduct the first systematic empirical analysis of these confidential information disclosures originating from central banks. Our database reveals that Eurosystem leaks are frequent — in particular relative to leaks from other major central banks. We provide evidence that many Eurosystem leaks are likely not accidents, but placed strategically by insiders. Exploiting high-frequency financial market reactions to leaks, we find that they have large effects on markets relative to standard monetary surprises, often exceeding the impact of attributed statements by policy-makers. Yet, mainly reflecting minority opinions, leaks do not usually lock in decision-making. Post-meeting leaks regularly reveal information about dissent on the committee, changing market perceptions about the strength of the policy signal. Post-meeting leaks thereby reverse some of the initial market effect of official policy announcements.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103959.abstract_zh: 利用一个关于欧元区货币政策媒体匿名泄密的新颖数据库，我们对源自中央银行内部的这些机密信息披露进行了首次系统性实证分析。我们的数据库显示，欧洲体系内的泄密事件频繁发生——尤其是相对于其他主要中央银行而言。我们提供的证据表明，许多欧洲体系的泄密事件可能并非偶然，而是内部人士策略性安排的。利用高频金融市场对泄密事件的反应，我们发现相对于标准的货币政策意外，这些泄密对市场产生了显著影响，往往超过政策制定者公开声明的效应。然而，主要反映少数派意见的泄密通常不会锁定决策结果。会后泄密经常揭示委员会内部的分歧信息，改变市场对政策信号强度的认知。因此，会后泄密部分逆转了官方政策公告的初始市场效应。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103959.title: Central bank communication by ??? The economics of monetary policy leaks
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103959.title_zh: 央行沟通的谜题？货币政策泄露的经济学

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103960.abstract: This paper studies the effects of replacing the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) with a Universal Basic Income (UBI) in an environment where EITC take-up is incomplete. In contrast, UBI ensures full participation by design, extending benefits to households who do not take up the EITC, at the cost of higher fiscal expenditures. I study this trade-off between expanded coverage and fiscal cost using a life-cycle model with an endogenous EITC participation decision that replicates the observed eligibility and take-up patterns. The results show that a generous UBI ($12,000 annually) reduces welfare due to the substantial fiscal burden it entails, whereas a modest UBI ($3500 per year) improves welfare by reaching previously uncovered households at only a moderate fiscal cost. These findings highlight the importance of the program participation margin in evaluating policy reforms.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103960.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在劳动所得税抵免（EITC）参与不完全的环境下，以全民基本收入（UBI）替代劳动所得税抵免的影响。相比之下，UBI通过设计确保全面参与，将福利延伸至未参与EITC的家庭，但代价是更高的财政支出。我通过一个包含内生EITC参与决策的生命周期模型来研究扩大覆盖范围与财政成本之间的权衡，该模型能够复现观察到的资格与参与模式。结果表明，慷慨的UBI（每年12，000美元）因伴随的巨额财政负担而降低福利，而适度的UBI（每年3，500美元）则通过以适度的财政成本惠及此前未被覆盖的家庭来改善福利。这些发现凸显了项目参与边际在评估政策改革中的重要性。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103960.title: From means-tested programs to Universal Basic Income - The role of endogenous participation in transfer programs
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103960.title_zh: 从经济状况调查项目到全民基本收入——转移支付项目中内生参与的作用

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103961.abstract: Asymmetries play an important role in many macroeconomic models. We show that assumptions on household and firm expectations play a key role in determining the effects of these asymmetries on macroeconomic outcomes. If households and firms have perfect foresight and hence do not account for the possibility of future shocks, then the implied longer-run averages and distributions can differ significantly from their rational expectations counterparts. We first derive this result analytically in a standard New Keynesian environment under either an asymmetric monetary policy rule or a nonlinear Phillips curve before numerically examining some of the key nonlinearities featured in the recent literature.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103961.abstract_zh: 不对称性在许多宏观经济模型中扮演着重要角色。我们证明，家庭和企业预期的假设在决定这些不对称性对宏观经济结果的影响方面起着关键作用。如果家庭和企业拥有完美预见能力，因此不考虑未来冲击的可能性，那么由此隐含的长期平均值和分布可能与理性预期下的对应值存在显著差异。我们首先在标准新凯恩斯主义环境中，在非对称货币政策规则或非线性菲利普斯曲线下，从分析上推导出这一结果，随后数值考察了近期文献中强调的一些关键非线性特征。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103961.title: Evaluating macroeconomic outcomes under asymmetries: Expectations matter
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103961.title_zh: 评估非对称性下的宏观经济结果：预期至关重要

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103962.abstract: The distributive effects of carbon taxation are critical for its political acceptability and depend on both income and geographic factors. Using French administrative data, household surveys, and matched employer–employee records, we document that rural households spend 2.8 times more on fossil fuels than urban households and work in firms that emit 2.7 times more greenhouse gases. We incorporate these facts into a spatial heterogeneous-agent model with migration, housing and wealth accumulation, bridging spatial and macroeconomic approaches. Carbon taxes generate 56% larger welfare losses for rural households than for urban households, as the former may be trapped due to mobility frictions and homeownership. While uniform or income-based rebates reduce inequality along the income dimension, they leave large spatial disparities that must be offset through location-based transfers. These results suggest that carbon policies should account for spatial differences to improve political feasibility.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103962.abstract_zh: 碳税政策的分配效应对其政治可接受性至关重要，且这种效应同时受收入与地理因素影响。基于法国行政数据、家庭调查及匹配的雇主-雇员记录，我们发现农村家庭在化石燃料上的支出是城市家庭的2.8倍，且其就业企业的温室气体排放量是城市企业的2.7倍。我们将这些事实纳入一个包含迁移、住房与财富积累的空间异质性主体模型中，从而融合空间经济学与宏观经济学的研究方法。碳税对农村家庭造成的福利损失比城市家庭高出56%，原因在于前者可能因流动性摩擦和房屋所有权而陷入困境。尽管统一退税或基于收入的退税能够缩小收入维度的不平等，但由此产生的巨大空间差异仍需通过基于地理位置的转移支付来弥补。这些结果表明，碳政策应考虑空间差异以提升其政治可行性。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103962.title: Geography versus income: The heterogeneous effects of carbon taxation
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103962.title_zh: 地理与收入：碳税政策的异质性效应

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103963.abstract: This paper revisits the question of what core inflation is meant to represent and assesses the competing measures of core inflation that are available, including some new ones. I take the primary perspective that core inflation is a simple predictor of future headline inflation. There is evidence for ex food and energy, and other core measures, being superior predictors than headline inflation itself. Within choices of core inflation, simple averaging of different measures and different horizons seems to work best. I also consider some other concepts of core inflation: closeness to a common trend component and measurement of demand-driven inflation. The averaging estimator fares well by all of these metrics.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103963.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了核心通胀旨在代表什么的问题，并评估了可用的竞争性核心通胀衡量指标，包括一些新指标。我主要从核心通胀作为未来总体通胀的简单预测指标这一视角出发。有证据表明，剔除食品和能源后的核心通胀及其他核心指标，在预测能力上优于总体通胀本身。在核心通胀的选择中，对不同指标和不同时间跨度进行简单平均似乎效果最佳。我还考虑了核心通胀的其他概念：与共同趋势成分的接近程度以及需求驱动型通胀的衡量。平均估计量在所有这些指标上均表现良好。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103963.title: What is core inflation?

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103964.abstract: How do import tariffs affect retail prices? We combine daily product-level posted prices from seven major Canadian retailers with product-level tariff exposure to estimate tariff effects in a difference-in-differences framework. Prices of tariffed goods rose gradually, peaking at 6% after three months, implying pass-through of roughly one quarter of the 25% tariff. We find little spillover to untariffed substitutes and a rapid reversal of price effects after tariff removal. Adjustment occurred mainly through the frequency of price changes. Pass-through shifted with trade-policy news and was larger for products labeled “Tariffed”, showing that tariff-induced inflation depends on policy expectations and tariff salience.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103964.abstract_zh: 进口关税如何影响零售价格？我们整合了加拿大七家主要零售商的每日产品层面标价数据与产品层面的关税暴露程度，在双重差分框架下估算关税效应。受关税影响商品的价格逐步上升，三个月后达到6%的峰值，这意味着约四分之一的25%关税被传导至价格。我们未发现对未征税替代品产生显著溢出效应，且关税取消后价格效应迅速逆转。价格调整主要通过调价频率实现。传导效应随贸易政策新闻动态变化，且对标注"征税"标签的产品更为显著，这表明关税引发的通胀取决于政策预期与关税显著性。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103964.title: The price impact of Canadian retaliatory tariffs
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103964.title_zh: 加拿大报复性关税的价格影响

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103965.abstract: In this paper, we study optimal monetary policy in an economy where firms’ price-setting decisions are distorted by a signal-extraction problem: they cannot perfectly distinguish aggregate from idiosyncratic shocks based on noisy local information. This systematic misattribution of aggregate shocks to firm-specific factors generates an additional price response, implying that strict price stability is no longer optimal. Instead, the optimal policy fully stabilizes the output gap, which necessarily requires accommodating fluctuations in the price level. The cyclicality of the optimal price level depends on the source of firms’ incomplete information: learning from local demand signals implies a procyclical price level, whereas learning from local productivity signals yields a countercyclical one.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103965.abstract_zh: 本文研究企业在价格设定决策中因信号提取问题而扭曲的经济环境下的最优货币政策：企业无法基于含噪的局部信息完美区分总体冲击与异质性冲击。这种将总体冲击系统性误归因于企业特定因素的现象，会引发额外的价格反应，意味着严格的价格稳定不再是最优选择。相反，最优政策应完全稳定产出缺口，这必然要求容忍价格水平的波动。最优价格水平的周期性取决于企业不完全信息的来源：从局部需求信号中学习会导致价格水平呈顺周期性，而从局部生产率信号中学习则会产生逆周期性。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103965.title: Optimal monetary policy with confounding information
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103965.title_zh: 混淆信息下的最优货币政策

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103966.abstract: This paper documents five empirical facts about the role of strategic complementarities in firms’ price-setting behavior, using administrative data on Chilean firms. (1) Strategic complementarities play a dominant role in price setting, exerting a stronger influence than changes in marginal costs. (2) While the strength of strategic complementarities varies across sectors, it consistently outweighs the role of cost changes. (3) In high-inflation environments, firms become more responsive to changes in their competitors’ prices. (4) Firms respond more strongly to competitors’ price increases than to price decreases, mirroring the ‘rockets and feathers’ phenomenon of costs. (5) Strategic complementarities are stronger among firms with fewer competitors, larger market shares, and broader customer bases. These findings suggest that strategic complementarities — a source of real rigidities — are quantitatively important, state-dependent, asymmetric, and shaped by market structure.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103966.abstract_zh: 本文利用智利企业的行政数据，记录了关于战略性互补在企业定价行为中作用的五项实证事实。（1）战略性互补在定价中占据主导地位，其影响力超过边际成本变化。（2）尽管战略性互补的强度在不同行业间存在差异，但其作用始终超过成本变化的影响。（3）在高通胀环境下，企业对竞争对手价格变动的反应更为敏感。（4）企业对竞争对手提价的反应强于对降价的反应，这反映了成本变动的“火箭与羽毛”现象。（5）在竞争对手较少、市场份额较大且客户基础更广的企业中，战略性互补更为显著。这些发现表明，战略性互补——作为实际刚性的来源——在数量上具有重要意义，具有状态依赖性、非对称性，并受市场结构影响。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103966.title: Beyond costs: The dominant role of strategic complementarities in pricing
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103966.title_zh: 超越成本：战略互补性在定价中的主导作用

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103973.abstract: Within a New Keynesian model with heterogeneous households and credit frictions, we show that idiosyncratic uncertainty gives rise to an additional transmission channel that amplifies the effects of balance-sheet policies through consumption risk, making them a key tool for anchoring private-sector expectations. We further show that the optimal monetary policy features a clear division of labor between conventional and unconventional tools: balance-sheet policy should target cross-sectional welfare objectives, absorbing fluctuations in variables with distributional relevance such as private debt, whereas conventional interest-rate policy stabilizes aggregate targets and responds to aggregate shocks, as in the representative-agent benchmark. Thus, the optimal response to a debt-deleveraging crisis is unconventional: it entails a shorter, rather than longer, duration of zero-interest-rate policies relative to conventional inflation targeting, and does not require front-loaded inflation at the effective lower bound.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103973.abstract_zh: 在包含异质性家庭与信贷摩擦的新凯恩斯模型中，我们证明特质性不确定性通过消费风险催生了一个额外的传导渠道，该渠道放大了资产负债表政策的效应，使其成为锚定私人部门预期的关键工具。我们进一步证明，最优货币政策在传统工具与非传统工具之间呈现出明确的分工：资产负债表政策应瞄准横截面福利目标，吸收具有分配相关性的变量（如私人债务）的波动，而传统利率政策则稳定总量目标并对总量冲击作出反应，这与代表性代理人基准情形一致。因此，对债务去杠杆危机的最优应对是非传统的：相对于传统通胀目标制，它意味着更短而非更长的零利率政策持续时间，并且不需要在有效下限处进行前置通胀。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103973.title: Unconventional policy and idiosyncratic risk
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103973.title_zh: 非常规政策与特质风险

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103974.abstract: We analyze the fiscal and welfare implications of the size of public debt in stochastic OLG models with distortionary taxation. The government borrowing rate is realistically sensitive to debt issuance and lower than the growth rate. The risky rate is much higher due to convenience benefits of public debt, idiosyncratic return risk, and aggregate risk. Although free-lunch deficits can reduce tax distortions, welfare-maximizing debt (WMD) is considerably lower than deficit-maximizing debt (DMD) in our baseline model calibrated to the US economy. A detailed decomposition of ex ante welfare reveals the forces shaping WMD, the strongest being the positive risk-sharing effect and the negative crowding-out effect. We identify key drivers, such as pension policy or risk premia, and quantify their differential impact on WMD and DMD. Extending the model to account for market power substantially reduces WMD. When wealth inequality is included in the model, the rich favor much higher debt than the middle class.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103974.abstract_zh: 我们分析了在具有扭曲性税收的随机OLG模型中，公共债务规模对财政和福利的影响。政府借款利率现实地对债务发行敏感，且低于增长率。由于公共债务的便利收益、特质性回报风险及总体风险，风险利率远高于此。尽管免费午餐式赤字能减少税收扭曲，但在以美国经济为基准校准的模型中，福利最大化债务（WMD）显著低于赤字最大化债务（DMD）。对事前福利的详细分解揭示了塑造WMD的力量，其中最强的是正向风险分担效应和负向挤出效应。我们识别了关键驱动因素，如养老金政策或风险溢价，并量化了它们对WMD和DMD的不同影响。将模型扩展至考虑市场势力后，WMD大幅降低。当模型中纳入财富不平等时，富人比中产阶级更偏好更高的债务水平。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103974.title: Public debt in calibrated OLG models: Fiscal arithmetic versus welfare analysis
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103974.title_zh: 校准OLG模型中的公共债务：财政算术与福利分析

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103975.abstract: Do firms adjust prices to realized costs, expected costs, or both? We address this question using a new survey of U.S. businesses that separately measures realized cost changes since the last price adjustment and expected cost changes over the subsequent year, including portions attributable to 2025 trade policies. Using perceived tariff exposure as an instrument, we identify the causal effects of realized and expected costs on prices. Reset prices incorporate almost 70 percent of current costs and nearly 45 percent of expected costs over the next year. The importance of these channels varies significantly across firms. Frequent price adjusters respond mainly to current costs, while sticky-price firms weight expectations more heavily. Goods producers adjust contemporaneously, whereas service firms are more forward looking, as are firms with a high labor share or facing high trade uncertainty. This evidence favors endogenous pricing frameworks in which uncertainty reshapes the reset-price kernel across horizons or imperfect-information models in which uncertainty amplifies the role of expectations over standard time-dependent models.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103975.abstract_zh: 企业是否根据已实现成本、预期成本，还是两者兼而有之来调整价格？我们利用一项针对美国企业的新调查来回答这一问题，该调查分别衡量了自上次价格调整以来已实现的成本变化以及随后一年内的预期成本变化，包括可归因于2025年贸易政策的部分。利用感知关税暴露度作为工具变量，我们识别了已实现成本和预期成本对价格的因果效应。重置价格吸收了当前成本的近70%以及未来一年预期成本的近45%。这些渠道的重要性在企业间存在显著差异。频繁调价的企业主要对当前成本作出反应，而价格粘性企业则更重视预期。商品生产商同步调整价格，而服务企业更具前瞻性，高劳动份额或面临高贸易不确定性的企业也是如此。这一证据支持内生定价框架，其中不确定性重塑了跨期限的重置价格核，或支持不完美信息模型，其中不确定性放大了预期的作用，而非标准的时间依赖模型。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103975.title: The future in today’s prices: Evidence from a survey of U.S. firms
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103975.title_zh: 今日价格中的未来：来自美国企业调查的证据

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103976.abstract: An increasing share of corporate loans, a critical source of firm credit, is sold off banks’ balance sheets and actively traded in a secondary over-the-counter market. We develop a microfounded equilibrium search-theoretic model with labor, credit, and financial markets to study the impact of this secondary loan market on the real economy. Our analysis highlights a policy-relevant trade-off: the market reduces the steady state level of unemployment by 0.21pp, but it also amplifies unemployment’s response to a 1% productivity drop by 0.07pp. Trading delays in the secondary market matter significantly: if trade were instantaneous, steady state unemployment and its volatility would decline by 1.49pp and by 0.24pp, respectively.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103976.abstract_zh: 企业贷款作为企业信贷的关键来源，其日益增长的份额正从银行资产负债表中剥离，并在二级场外市场中活跃交易。我们构建了一个包含劳动力市场、信贷市场和金融市场的微观基础均衡搜索理论模型，以研究这一二级贷款市场对实体经济的影响。我们的分析揭示了一个具有政策相关性的权衡：该市场将稳态失业率降低了0.21个百分点，但同时将失业率对1%生产率下降的响应放大了0.07个百分点。二级市场中的交易延迟影响显著：若交易即时完成，稳态失业率及其波动性将分别下降1.49个百分点和0.24个百分点。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103976.title: The effects of the secondary market for corporate loans on the real economy
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103976.title_zh: 公司贷款二级市场对实体经济的影响

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103977.abstract: Between 2021 and 2024, the United States experienced one of the most severe inflation episodes in decades, coinciding with renewed debate over the role of economic conditions for electoral outcomes. This paper studies the political economy of inflation and real wages using U.S. county-level data on family budget costs, nominal income, and electoral results for President and Congress during this period. Exploiting within-state, cross-county variation in changes in local prices over time, it examines how inflation, real wage growth, and purchasing power relate to changes in vote shares of incumbents, vote margins, and turnout. Real wage decline, rather than higher inflation itself, is predictive of Republican electoral gains, in line with an economic voting rationale. Inflation, however, retains an association with presidential vote shares beyond pure economic voting.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103977.abstract_zh: 2021年至2024年间，美国经历了数十年来最严重的通胀事件之一，与此同时，关于经济状况对选举结果作用的讨论再度兴起。本文利用美国县级家庭预算成本、名义收入以及总统和国会选举结果的数据，研究通胀与实际工资的政治经济学。通过利用州内、县际间地方价格变动的差异，本文考察了通胀、实际工资增长及购买力如何与在位者得票份额变化、得票差距及投票率相关联。实际工资下降，而非通胀本身，预示着共和党选举收益的增加，这与经济投票逻辑相符。然而，通胀对总统得票份额的影响超越了纯粹的经济投票因素。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103977.title: Do voters punish inflation or pay cuts? Inflation and real wages in U.S. elections
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103977.title_zh: 选民惩罚通胀还是减薪？美国选举中的通胀与实际工资

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103978.abstract: We study how monetary policy shapes macroeconomic outcomes in a two-sector small open economy hit by export shocks —due, e.g., to export tariffs, geopolitical tensions, or a recession in destination countries— allowing the shock to have both aggregate and distributional effects. Imperfect worker mobility across sectors, coupled with incomplete markets against aggregate and idiosyncratic shocks, implies that export contractions (i) spill over across sectors due to households’ precautionary response and (ii) affect income and consumption inequalities within and across sectors —in addition to their usual asymmetric effects on sectoral outputs and wages. In this context, exchange-rate flexibility provides insurance against inefficient fluctuations in consumption inequality, which increases the social value of floating-rate regimes. Relative to a nominal exchange-rate peg, flexible inflation targeting helps mitigate the rise in consumption inequality after an export contraction, especially among tradable-sector workers. However, even flexible inflation targeting does not in general provide sufficient exchange-rate flexibility relative to the optimal monetary policy.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103978.abstract_zh: 我们研究货币政策如何在遭受出口冲击（例如，因出口关税、地缘政治紧张局势或目的地国经济衰退所致）的二元部门小型开放经济中塑造宏观经济结果，并允许该冲击同时具有总量效应和分配效应。部门间工人流动性不完善，加之针对总量冲击和异质性冲击的市场不完全性，意味着出口收缩（i）因家庭预防性反应而跨部门溢出，且（ii）除对部门产出和工资产生通常的非对称影响外，还影响部门内及部门间的收入与消费不平等。在此背景下，汇率灵活性为消费不平等的低效波动提供了保险，从而提升了浮动汇率制度的社会价值。相对于名义汇率钉住制度，灵活的通胀目标制有助于缓解出口收缩后消费不平等的加剧，尤其是在可贸易部门工人中。然而，即便采用灵活的通胀目标制，相对于最优货币政策而言，通常也无法提供足够的汇率灵活性。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103978.title: Monetary stabilization of export shocks, revisited
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103978.title_zh: 出口冲击的货币稳定化：再探讨

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103979.abstract: Empirical evidence commonly cited as indicating that inflation expectations have become better anchored includes the declining sensitivity of expectations to inflation surprises over time, particularly around the adoption of inflation targeting. These patterns are typically attributed to the influence of explicit or implicit inflation targets on inflation expectations. We show that this evidence is consistent with a model of experience-based learning in which individuals learn solely from their life-time history of realized inflation, without anchoring their expectations to an announced inflation target. In this model, the prolonged experience of low short-run inflation persistence in the pre-COVID decades renders long-run expectations insensitive to inflation surprises, matching the patterns observed in empirical anchoring tests. A unique prediction of the experience-based learning model is also borne out in the data: the decline in surprise sensitivity since the 1980s is strongest among younger individuals. The memory of low inflation persistence experiences further explains why long-run inflation expectations remained stable in the face of the post-COVID inflation surge. At the same time, simulations indicate that the sensitivity of long-run expectations to inflation surprises would rise sharply if individuals were to experience another sustained episode of highly persistent inflation. Overall, long-run inflation expectations may be less firmly anchored than commonly believed.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103979.abstract_zh: 通常被引用的实证证据表明，通胀预期已更好地锚定，包括预期对通胀意外事件的敏感性随时间下降，特别是在采纳通胀目标制前后。这些模式通常被归因于明确或隐含的通胀目标对通胀预期的影响。我们证明，这一证据与一种基于经验的学习模型相符，在该模型中，个体仅从自身一生经历的实际通胀历史中学习，而不将其预期锚定于公布的通胀目标。在此模型中，新冠疫情前几十年间长期存在的低短期通胀持续性经验，使得长期预期对通胀意外事件不敏感，与实证锚定测试中观察到的模式相匹配。基于经验的学习模型的一个独特预测也在数据中得到验证：自1980年代以来，意外事件敏感性的下降在年轻个体中最为显著。对低通胀持续性经验的记忆进一步解释了为何长期通胀预期在新冠疫情后通胀飙升面前保持稳定。同时，模拟表明，如果个体再次经历持续的高通胀时期，长期预期对通胀意外事件的敏感性将急剧上升。总体而言，长期通胀预期的锚定程度可能比普遍认为的要弱。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103979.title: Seemingly anchored inflation expectations

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103986.abstract: We examine how policymakers’ speeches and monetary policy announcements at official policy meetings transmit to financial markets and the real economy in the euro area. Using high-frequency intraday data across a broad cross-section of financial assets, we introduce the Euro Area Extended Monetary Policy Event-Study Database (EA-EMPD). We refine the identification of monetary policy surprises by exploiting granular, quote-level data on individual market participants’ bid and ask quotes. This novel dataset expands the set of identifiable policy events by an order of magnitude relative to databases restricted to rate-setting meetings. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, central bank speeches move asset prices across all maturities by magnitudes comparable to those of official policy announcements. Second, the relative importance of surprises associated with policy decisions and speeches differs markedly between euro area and U.S. financial markets. Third, speech-induced short-rate shocks transmit to the real economy similarly to official policy shocks, and combining the two sources of policy shocks materially improves the precision of inference. Importantly, even under this much broader definition and measurement of monetary policy impulses, monetary policy shocks account for only a negligible share of fluctuations in real economic activity.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103986.abstract_zh: 我们考察了政策制定者的演讲及官方政策会议上的货币政策公告如何传导至欧元区的金融市场与实体经济。利用涵盖广泛金融资产的高频日内数据，我们构建了欧元区扩展货币政策事件研究数据库（EA-EMPD）。通过利用个体市场参与者买卖报价的细粒度报价级数据，我们优化了货币政策冲击的识别方法。这一新颖数据集将可识别的政策事件集合相对于仅限于利率设定会议的数据库扩大了一个数量级。我们的分析得出三项主要发现。首先，央行演讲对各期限资产价格的影响幅度与官方政策公告相当。其次，与政策决策及演讲相关的冲击在欧元区与美国金融市场中的相对重要性存在显著差异。第三，演讲引发的短期利率冲击向实体经济的传导方式与官方政策冲击类似，且将两类政策冲击结合使用能显著提高推断的精确度。重要的是，即使在这种更为宽泛的货币政策冲击定义与测度下，货币政策冲击对实际经济活动波动的解释份额仍然微乎其微。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103986.title: Monetary transmission with frequent policy events
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103986.title_zh: 频繁政策事件下的货币传导

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103987.abstract: This paper provides empirical evidence that shocks to aggregate Research and Development (R&D) exert persistent effects on macroeconomic dynamics and represent a significant source of risk for investors, consistent with ‘long-run risk’ models. The analysis focuses on ‘effective R&D’, the unique scaling of R&D that, across a broad class of models, maintains a linear relationship with productivity growth. This measure theoretically captures the entire contribution of R&D to productivity, flexibly accounting for knowledge spillovers and product proliferation. Importantly, its deviations from equilibrium are empirically identifiable via the error correction term in the cointegration relationship among R&D, total factor productivity, and the labor force. Using U.S. data, structural R&D shocks, based on effective R&D, are shown to affect productivity and consumption growth rates beyond business cycle horizons, and to be associated with a significant risk premium (around 12% annually) in a cross section of stock and bond portfolios, with cash-flow risk a key determinant.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103987.abstract_zh: 本文提供了实证证据，表明总体研发（R&D）冲击对宏观经济动态产生持久影响，并构成投资者面临的重要风险来源，这与“长期风险”模型相符。分析聚焦于“有效研发”，即在广泛模型类别中，与生产率增长保持线性关系的独特研发度量方式。该指标理论上捕捉了研发对生产率的全部贡献，灵活考虑了知识溢出和产品多样化效应。重要的是，其偏离均衡状态可通过研发、全要素生产率与劳动力之间的协整关系中的误差修正项进行实证识别。利用美国数据，基于有效研发的结构性研发冲击被证明会影响超越商业周期视野的生产率与消费增长率，并与股票和债券组合横截面中的显著风险溢价（年化约12%）相关联，其中现金流风险是关键决定因素。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103987.title: The innovation long-run risk component

10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103988.abstract: We examine how wage flexibility affects the transmission of economic shocks within a monetary union using a two-agent New Keynesian small open economy model. We show that, in the presence of financially constrained households, greater wage flexibility can amplify shocks rather than mitigate them. This amplification arises through an income channel that dominates the standard expenditure-switching mechanism when price flexibility is limited. The critical threshold of price flexibility required to offset this effect depends on the economy’s trade openness and the share of constrained households, but not on wage flexibility itself. These findings challenge the conventional view that wage flexibility inherently enhances macroeconomic stability within a monetary union.
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103988.abstract_zh: 我们利用一个双主体新凯恩斯小型开放经济模型，考察了货币联盟内工资灵活性如何影响经济冲击的传导。研究表明，在存在金融约束家庭的情况下，更高的工资灵活性可能放大而非缓解冲击。这种放大效应通过收入渠道产生，当价格灵活性有限时，该渠道主导了标准的支出转换机制。抵消这一效应所需的价格灵活性临界阈值取决于经济体的贸易开放度和受约束家庭的比例，而与工资灵活性本身无关。这些发现挑战了传统观点，即工资灵活性在货币联盟内固有地增强宏观经济稳定性。
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103988.title: Recessionary wage flexibility in a monetary union
10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103988.title_zh: 货币联盟中的衰退期工资灵活性

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105591.abstract: Childhood disability significantly impacts family members. Limited by data, prior research has faced challenges in measurement and identification and focused primar- ily on maternal labor outcomes. Utilizing 20-year-long administrative records from Taiwan’s National Health Insurance Research Database, we study cerebral palsy (CP), one of the most prevalent causes of childhood disability. We leverage its unexpected nature and our comprehensive data to investigate a broad spectrum of impacts on family members. Adopting an event study approach, we examine various outcomes, including parental labor supply, mental health, marital status, and fertility. Our find- ings reveal that having a child with CP decreases the mother’s likelihood of employ- ment by 6.2 percentage points (pp), increases the likelihood of divorce by 2.3 pp, and amplifies the risk of depression by 28%. Additionally, there’s a notable decrease in long-term fertility. These effects are more pronounced for parents in poorer socioeco- nomic conditions and for families with daughters who have CP.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105591.abstract_zh: 儿童期残疾对家庭成员产生显著影响。受数据限制，以往研究在测量与识别方面面临挑战，且主要聚焦于母亲的劳动成果。利用台湾国民健康保险研究数据库长达20年的行政记录，我们研究了脑性瘫痪（CP），这是儿童期残疾最常见的病因之一。我们利用其突发性质及全面数据，探讨了对家庭成员的广泛影响。采用事件研究方法，我们考察了多种结果，包括父母的劳动供给、心理健康、婚姻状况及生育情况。研究发现，有脑性瘫痪儿童的家庭中，母亲就业可能性下降6.2个百分点，离婚可能性增加2.3个百分点，抑郁风险增加28%。此外，长期生育率显著下降。这些效应在社会经济条件较差的父母及有脑性瘫痪女儿的家庭中更为明显。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105591.title: Impacts of childhood disability on family: Labor, marriage, fertility, and depression
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105591.title_zh: 儿童残疾对家庭的影响：劳动、婚姻、生育与抑郁

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105593.title: Climate Coalitions with Sophisticated Policy Makers
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105593.title_zh: 精明政策制定者下的气候联盟

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105614.abstract: We investigate data manipulation in the principal-agent relationship using administrative microdata from the police in Pakistan. We find that police are less likely to register citizens’ crime reports in areas where political accountability pressure is higher because the governing party holds a particular constituency. We report a series of tests to rule out the possibility that this result is explained by increased crime prevention. The results are consistent with officials deciding not to register some reports, under pressure to keep crime statistics low. As a new crime reports tracking database is rolled out, improving observability, the number of registered crimes increases.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105614.abstract_zh: 我们利用巴基斯坦警方的行政微观数据，探讨了委托-代理关系中的数据操纵现象。研究发现，在政治问责压力较大的地区，即执政党持有特定选区时，警方登记公民犯罪报告的意愿较低。我们进行了一系列测试，以排除这一结果可由犯罪预防增强来解释的可能性。结果与官员在压力下为保持犯罪统计数据较低而决定不登记部分报告的行为相符。随着新的犯罪报告追踪数据库的推出，提高了可观测性，登记犯罪的数量随之增加。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105614.title: The unintended consequences of accountability: Quasi-experimental evidence from policing in Pakistan
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105614.title_zh: 问责制的意外后果：来自巴基斯坦警务准实验的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105633.abstract: We study how access to credit markets affects the value of insurance. Loans allow consumers to smooth financial shocks over time, reducing the incremental benefits provided by insurance. We derive tractable formulas for the value of insurance that can be taken to data and show how that value varies with loan features. We then apply our framework to health insurance. Access to a five-year loan decreases the values of community- and experience-rated health insurance for the average two-person household by $232–$366 (58–61%). Even for the sickest decile, loan access reduces the value of community-rated insurance by $1099 (17%). Our results suggest that greater credit availability can serve as a substitute for health insurance.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105633.abstract_zh: 我们研究了信贷市场准入如何影响保险的价值。贷款使消费者能够跨期平滑金融冲击，从而减少了保险提供的边际收益。我们推导出可用于数据的保险价值可处理公式，并展示了该价值如何随贷款特征而变化。随后，我们将此框架应用于健康保险。对于平均两人家庭而言，获得五年期贷款使社区评级和经验评级健康保险的价值分别降低了232至366美元（58%至61%）。即使对于最病重的十分位人群，贷款准入也使社区评级保险的价值减少了1099美元（17%）。我们的结果表明，更大的信贷可得性可以作为健康保险的替代品。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105633.title: Access to credit reduces the value of insurance
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105633.title_zh: 信贷获取降低了保险的价值

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105640.abstract: How does the tax treatment of entrepreneurial activity affect the decision to start a business? We study this question in the context of a major tax reform in Poland that introduced a flat tax for business owners, leaving the taxation of employees unchanged. Using a difference-in-differences approach and data on the universe of Polish taxpayers, we find that a 1 percentage point increase in the tax differential at the top of the income distribution leads to a 0.9% increase in the share of self-employed five years after the reform. The increase is primarily driven by transitions from employment to self-employment, in particular, solo self-employment (self-employment without dependent workers). Moreover, the transitions occur in industries with a high human-capital component. Altogether, we find that high-income taxpayers respond strongly to the increased attractiveness of self-employment by starting a business, that such behavior shows considerable persistence, that it accumulates over time, and much of it is likely to reflect income reclassification rather than genuine entrepreneurial activity.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105640.abstract_zh: 创业活动的税收待遇如何影响创业决策？我们以波兰一项重大税制改革为背景研究此问题，该改革对企业主引入了统一税率，而雇员税收保持不变。利用双重差分方法及波兰全体纳税人数据，我们发现，在收入分布顶端，税收差异每增加1个百分点，改革五年后自雇比例上升0.9%。这一增长主要由从就业转向自雇，尤其是独自自雇（无受雇工人的自雇）所驱动。此外，这种转变发生在人力资本密集的行业中。总体而言，我们发现高收入纳税人对自雇吸引力的增强反应强烈，选择创业，此类行为表现出显著的持续性，随时间累积，且其中很大部分可能反映的是收入重新分类，而非真正的创业活动。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105640.title: Taxation and business entry: Evidence from the Polish self-employment “Flat” tax
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105640.title_zh: 税收与商业进入：来自波兰自雇“统一”税的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105641.abstract: This paper examines how the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) supported employment during the COVID-19 period by distinguishing between its short-term liquidity and broader funding effects. Using county-level data, we show that delays in loan disbursement had prolonged negative impacts only on the smallest urban businesses. To identify the causal impact of funding itself, we develop an instrument based on the pre-pandemic payroll share in small establishments. Instrumental-variable and firm-level analyses reveal that PPP funding improved business survival and employment recovery substantially and broadly, with an estimated cost of roughly $89,000 per job-year, consistent with other large-scale fiscal interventions.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105641.abstract_zh: 本文通过区分薪资保护计划（PPP）的短期流动性与更广泛的资金效应，考察了其在COVID-19期间对就业的支持作用。利用县级数据，我们显示贷款发放延迟仅对最小的城市企业产生了持续的负面影响。为识别资金本身的因果影响，我们基于疫情前小型企业中的工资份额构建了一个工具变量。工具变量与企业层面的分析揭示，PPP资金显著且广泛地促进了企业生存与就业恢复，估计每工作年成本约为89,000美元，与其他大规模财政干预措施相符。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105641.title: Better late than never? Quantifying funding and liquidity effects of the PPP on pandemic-era employment recovery
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105641.title_zh: 迟做总比不做好？量化PPP对疫情时期就业复苏的资金与流动性效应

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105642.abstract: I explore how non-linear health insurance contracts allow consumers to substitute healthcare in one period for healthcare in another period by increasing consumption in the year the annual deductible was met and decreasing future consumption. I exploit variation in the timing of an injury that generates significant healthcare expenses to identify the causal effect of meeting the deductible on healthcare consumption in the following year. Estimates indicate that there is intertemporal substitution across years in healthcare consumption and that consumers are able to strategically respond to non-linear pricing schemes to undermine the potential savings from deductible plans.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105642.abstract_zh: 我探讨了非线性健康保险合同如何允许消费者通过增加在满足年度免赔额当年的医疗消费并减少未来消费，在不同时期之间替代医疗服务。我利用伤害发生时间的变化（该伤害产生显著医疗费用）来识别满足免赔额对次年医疗消费的因果效应。估计结果表明，医疗消费在年度间存在跨期替代，且消费者能够策略性地应对非线性定价方案，从而削弱免赔额计划可能带来的节省。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105642.title: Intertemporal substitution in response to non-linear health insurance contracts
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105642.title_zh: 非线性健康保险合同中的跨期替代

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105643.abstract: This paper studies tax policy interaction among local governments for both mobile and immobile tax bases. We exploit exogenous changes in the local tax setting of German municipalities due to participation in state debt reduction programs to learn about the size, scope and nature of strategic interaction among local governments. Our results suggest strong and significant tax policy responses both in corporate as well as in property tax rates. Based on these results, the tax response function gradients are in the range of 0.30 to 0.69, depending on the tax instrument and state. Spatial, political, demographic, and administrative municipality characteristics all influence the size of the tax response.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105643.abstract_zh: 本文研究了地方政府在流动与非流动税基上的税收政策互动。我们利用德国市政当局因参与州债务削减计划而导致的本地税收设置外生变化，来探究地方政府间战略互动的规模、范围及性质。研究结果显示，企业所得税率和财产税率均存在显著且强烈的税收政策反应。基于这些结果，税收反应函数的斜率介于0.30至0.69之间，具体取决于税收工具及所在州。空间、政治、人口及行政市政特征均对税收反应的大小产生影响。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105643.title: Identifying tax-setting responses from local fiscal policy programs
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105643.title_zh: 识别地方财政政策项目中的税收设定反应

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105650.abstract: Congressional candidates simultaneously seek votes from local residents and money from partisan potential donors who live across the United States. Ad targeting allows political candidates an inexpensive way not only to reach this dispersed partisan audience but also to deliver messages tailored to donors, whose preferences are more extreme than voters’. Using data on geographically-targeted Facebook ads, I find that the national ads of Democratic and Republican candidates have less issue overlap — and are more extreme — than their local, voter-targeted ads. Candidates’ ability to direct tailored, extreme communication to receptive audiences via targeted ads facilitates divergent political speech.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105650.abstract_zh: 国会议员候选人在争取本地居民选票的同时，也寻求来自全美各地党派潜在捐赠者的资金支持。广告定向投放为政治候选人提供了一种低成本的方式，不仅能够触达分散的党派受众，还能向偏好比选民更为极端的捐赠者传递定制化信息。利用地理定向的Facebook广告数据，我发现民主党和共和党候选人的全国性广告在议题重叠度上低于其面向本地选民的广告，且内容更为极端。候选人通过定向广告向接受度高的受众传达定制化、极端化的政治言论，这一能力促进了政治话语的分化。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105650.title: Two-faced on facebook: Ad tailoring in U.S. house campaigns
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105650.title_zh: 脸谱网上的两面性：美国众议院竞选中的广告定制

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105651.abstract: This paper studies the effects of public childcare expansion for children under age three in Germany on mothers’ child penalties. Exploiting county-level variation in the expansion, we find that a 20-percentage-point increase in childcare coverage rate reduces earnings penalties by 4.5 percentage points. This accounts for about 56% of the total 8-percentage-point decline in earnings penalties over the reform period. Early childcare increases employment and days worked, especially in full-time and non-marginal positions. It also raises daily wages and increases the likelihood that mothers work in higher-paying firms and occupations. These effects persist beyond the early childcare eligibility period. We further identify two key contextual factors explaining the positive effects of early childcare: the initial level of child penalties and reliance on informal care. In settings with high child penalties and limited alternatives, early public childcare can yield substantial lasting benefits for mothers’ careers. • Germany substantially expanded public childcare for children under age three. • This expansion persistently reduced mothers’ child penalties. • Mothers work more, earn higher wages, and sort into full-time and better-paying jobs. • Effects are larger where child penalties are high and informal care is scarce.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105651.abstract_zh: 本文研究了德国三岁以下儿童公共托育服务的扩展对母亲育儿惩罚的影响。利用县级扩展差异，我们发现儿童托育覆盖率每提高20个百分点，收入惩罚降低4.5个百分点。这占改革期间收入惩罚总下降8个百分点中的约56%。早期托育增加了就业和工作天数，尤其是在全职和非边缘岗位中。同时，它提高了日工资，并增加了母亲在薪酬更高企业和职业中工作的可能性。这些效应在早期托育资格期结束后依然持续。我们进一步识别出两个关键背景因素，用以解释早期托育的积极效应：初始育儿惩罚水平和对照料非正式照料的依赖。在育儿惩罚高且替代选择有限的背景下，早期公共托育能为母亲的职业生涯带来显著且持久的益处。• 德国大幅扩展了三岁以下儿童的公共托育服务。• 这一扩展持续降低了母亲的育儿惩罚。• 母亲工作更多，工资更高，并转向全职和薪酬更优的工作。• 在育儿惩罚高且非正式照料稀缺的地区，效应更为显著。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105651.title: Can early public childcare reduce child penalties? Evidence from Germany
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105651.title_zh: 早期公共托育能否减少育儿惩罚？来自德国的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105652.abstract: We study the consequences of a large-scale reassessment of the health and working capacity of disability insurance beneficiaries in Hungary. Leveraging birthday and health cutoffs in the reassessment, we estimate employment responses to the threat of disability benefit loss and the actual termination or reduction of benefits. We show that due to the threat of benefit removal, many beneficiaries stopped working after the reassessment was announced but before it took place. Another group of beneficiaries lost their benefits and increased their labor supply significantly. Overall, the reassessment had a negative short-term and neutral medium-term impact on employment and earnings. Our results suggest that unintended responses to the threat of benefit loss operate as a substitution effect that can reduce labor supply even without binding formal earnings limits, and thus should be considered in the design of reassessments.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105652.abstract_zh: 我们研究了匈牙利对残疾保险受益人健康及工作能力的大规模重新评估所带来的后果。利用重新评估中的生日和健康临界点，我们估计了就业对残疾福利丧失威胁及实际终止或减少福利的反应。结果显示，由于福利取消的威胁，许多受益人在重新评估宣布后但实施前便停止了工作。另一部分受益人则失去了福利，并显著增加了劳动供给。总体而言，重新评估对就业和收入产生了短期负面及中期中性的影响。我们的研究结果表明，对福利丧失威胁的非预期反应作为一种替代效应，即便在没有正式收入限制的情况下也能减少劳动供给，因此在设计重新评估时应予以考虑。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105652.title: The employment effects of disability benefit reassessment
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105652.title_zh: 残疾津贴重新评估的就业效应

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105653.abstract: This paper studies the effects of the 2017 multilateral automatic exchange of information (AEoI) on tax compliance in Switzerland. Using detailed administrative tax data and difference-indifferences designs, I find significant positive compliance effects. The AEoI prompted 107k taxpayers (2% of all) to participate in the amnesty, disclosing CHF 42.3 billion—over 6% of GDP. At the micro level, once evaders participate in the amnesty, their reported wealth increases by approximately 50% on average, with compliance effects persisting in the medium run. Furthermore, I document that tax evasion in Switzerland is widespread and significantly more evenly distributed than in other countries.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105653.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2017年多边自动信息交换（AEoI）对瑞士税收遵从的影响。利用详细的行政税收数据和双重差分设计，我发现显著的正面遵从效应。AEoI促使10.7万名纳税人（占总数的2%）参与特赦，披露了423亿瑞士法郎——超过GDP的6%。在微观层面，一旦逃税者参与特赦，其申报财富平均增加约50%，且遵从效应在中期持续存在。此外，我记录了瑞士的逃税现象普遍存在，且其分布比其他国家的更为均匀。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105653.title: The compliance effects of the automatic exchange of information: Evidence from the Swiss tax amnesty
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105653.title_zh: 自动信息交换的合规效应：来自瑞士税收赦免的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105654.abstract: Utility companies recover their capital costs through regulator-approved rates of return. Using a comprehensive database of utility rate cases, we find a significant premium for regulated returns on equity relative to several capital cost benchmarks. We show that firms decide strategically when to initiate new rate cases, such that regulated returns respond more quickly to increases in underlying capital cost benchmarks than to decreases. Higher regulated returns incentivize utilities to own more capital: a one percentage point rise in return on equity increases capital assets by 3-4%. Overall we find excess costs to US consumers averaging $7 billion per year.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105654.abstract_zh: 公用事业公司通过监管机构批准的回报率来回收其资本成本。利用一个全面的公用事业费率案例数据库，我们发现，相对于多个资本成本基准，受监管的股本回报存在显著溢价。我们表明，企业会策略性地决定何时启动新的费率案例，使得受监管回报对资本成本基准上升的反应快于对下降的反应。更高的受监管回报激励公用事业公司持有更多资本：股本回报率每上升一个百分点，资本资产增加3-4%。总体而言，我们发现美国消费者每年平均承担70亿美元的额外成本。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105654.title: Rate of return regulation revisited

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105655.abstract: During June–August 2022, Germany temporarily reduced the fare of unlimited local and regional public transport nationwide to €9 per month. We study changes in mobility behavior and rail congestion effects induced by this 9-Euro Ticket. We employ difference-in-differences and event-study designs to analyze data from mobile-network devices, administrative traffic counts from road monitoring stations, and train arrival data. We find a strong increase in rail travel with modest substitution away from cars. Train trips rise by around 35%, while car traffic falls by 1–5%, with the smallest traffic reductions during commuting times and the largest increases in rail travel for leisure purposes on weekends and to touristic destinations. Moreover, the train demand surge materially worsens service quality via elevated train delays, which even spill over to long-distance trains. A welfare analysis suggests that the policy mostly acted as a cost-of-living transfer with limited emissions benefits, implying high implicit CO2 government abatement costs. Overall, our findings indicate that deeply discounted, nationwide “go-anywhere” tickets can substantially increase railway travel, yet generate limited car-to-rail substitution and strain service reliability when implemented without accompanying capacity extensions.During June–August 2022, Germany temporarily reduced the fare of unlimited local and regional public transport nationwide to €9 per month. We study changes in mobility behavior and rail congestion effects induced by this 9-Euro Ticket. We employ difference-in-differences and event-study designs to travel data from mobile-network devices, administrative traffic counts from road monitoring stations, and train arrival data. We find a strong increase in rail travel with modest substitution away from cars. Train trips rise by around 35%, while car traffic falls by 1–5%, with the smallest traffic reductions during commuting times and the largest increases in rail travel for leisure purposes on weekends and to touristic destinations. Moreover, the train demand surge materially worsens service quality via elevated train delays, which even spill over to long-distance trains. A welfare analysis suggests that the policy mostly acted as a cost-of-living transfer with limited emissions benefits, implying high implicit CO2 government abatement costs. Overall, our findings indicate that deeply discounted, nationwide “go-anywhere” tickets can substantially increase railway travel, yet generate limited car-to-rail substitution and strain service reliability when implemented without accompanying capacity extensions.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105655.abstract_zh: 2022年6月至8月期间，德国暂时将全国范围内无限制的地方及区域公共交通票价降至每月9欧元。我们研究了这一“9欧元车票”政策引发的出行行为变化及铁路拥堵效应。采用双重差分法和事件研究设计，分析了来自移动网络设备的数据、道路监测站的行政交通流量统计以及列车到达数据。研究发现，铁路出行显著增加，而汽车出行仅出现适度替代。列车出行次数上升约35%，汽车交通量下降1%至5%，其中通勤时段交通减少幅度最小，而周末及前往旅游目的地的休闲铁路出行增幅最大。此外，列车需求激增通过加剧列车延误实质性地恶化了服务质量，甚至波及长途列车。福利分析表明，该政策主要充当了生活成本转移的作用，减排效益有限，这意味着政府隐含的二氧化碳减排成本较高。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，深度折扣的全国性“任意出行”车票能大幅增加铁路旅行，但在未配套运力扩展的情况下实施，其对汽车向铁路转移的替代作用有限，并会损害服务可靠性。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105655.title: Almost fare free: Impact of a cheap public transport ticket on mobility patterns and train delays
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105655.title_zh: 近乎免费：廉价公共交通票对出行模式与列车延误的影响

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105656.abstract: Quantifying the welfare effects of rural electrification is often hindered by non-price barriers that depress demand at the adoption margin. I study demand for pay-as-you-go (PAYGo) solar using a randomized experiment with 800 existing PAYGo customers in Kenya and Rwanda post-adoption. The experiment randomly assigns incentives that lower the effective price of usage for consumers who meet monthly purchase thresholds. Although average demand is unchanged, consumers with the highest pre-experimental demand increase their purchases by 6–7% in response to the incentive. I use these responses to estimate a lower bound on consumer surplus from PAYGo solar. I find large gains for high-demand consumers, but benefits deteriorate substantially for low-demand consumers. Combining my estimates with evidence from the literature on the environmental externalities of solar home systems, I calculate that the marginal value of public funds for PAYGo solar subsidies is at most 1.7 in Kenya and 2 in Rwanda.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105656.abstract_zh: 量化农村电气化的福利效应，常常因非价格壁垒在采用边际上抑制需求而受阻。我通过一项随机实验，研究了肯尼亚和卢旺达800名现有按需付费（PAYGo）太阳能客户在采用后的需求情况。该实验随机分配激励措施，为达到月度购买门槛的消费者降低有效使用价格。尽管平均需求未变，但实验前需求最高的消费者对激励的反应是购买量增加6-7%。我利用这些反应估算了PAYGo太阳能消费者剩余的较低界限。我发现高需求消费者获得巨大收益，但低需求消费者的福利显著恶化。结合我的估计与文献中关于太阳能家庭系统环境外部性的证据，我计算出PAYGo太阳能补贴的公共资金边际价值在肯尼亚至多为1.7，在卢旺达至多为2。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105656.title: Using price incentives to bound welfare from pay as you go solar electricity
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105656.title_zh: 利用价格激励约束即付即用太阳能电力的福利

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105657.abstract: I examine how election fraud affects the type of government corruption and red tape that inhibit economic growth, as measured by building permit approvals in the Philippines, which are often delayed due to requests for bribes. To identify effects, I exploit a switch to automated elections in 2010 that made committing fraud more difficult. Estimates from a research design comparing changes over time in previously high-fraud and low-fraud towns indicate that automated elections significantly reduced election fraud, and that this led to a sharp and sustained 15 percent increase in the number of building permits approved annually. Local budget outcomes and priorities do not appear to be affected.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105657.abstract_zh: 我研究了选举舞弊如何影响阻碍经济增长的政府腐败类型及官僚程序，以菲律宾建筑许可审批为衡量指标，这些审批常因索贿而延误。为识别因果效应，我利用了2010年转向自动化选举这一变化，该举措使舞弊行为更加困难。通过比较此前舞弊高发与低发城镇随时间变化的估计结果显示，自动化选举显著减少了选举舞弊，并由此导致每年获批建筑许可数量大幅且持续地增加了15%。地方预算结果和优先事项似乎未受影响。

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105658.abstract: We re-assess the consequences of a NIT for two-parent families in the Income Maintenance Experiments. The Gary and Seattle experiments fail balancing tests. We reject the contentious finding that the NIT increased marital separations in Seattle-Denver, which is driven solely by the contaminated Seattle experiment. Moreover, using newly collected data from archival records, we estimate substantial increases in happiness, marital satisfaction, household production, and social activities in Winnipeg. Finally, in New Jersey, Denver and Winnipeg we estimate far greater labor supply responses than previous estimates, with remarkable consistency in point estimates and statistical significance across experiments and countries.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105658.abstract_zh: 我们重新评估了收入维持实验中负所得税（NIT）对双亲家庭的影响。加里和西雅图实验未能通过平衡性检验。我们否定了关于NIT在西雅图-丹佛实验中增加婚姻解体的争议性发现，该结果完全由受污染的西雅图实验驱动。此外，利用从档案记录中新收集的数据，我们估计温尼伯实验中幸福感、婚姻满意度、家庭生产和社会活动均有显著增加。最后，在新泽西、丹佛和温尼伯实验中，我们估计的劳动力供给反应远大于先前估计，且各实验和国家的点估计及统计显著性表现出高度一致性。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105658.title: What did we learn from the North American Income Maintenance Experiments? New data and evidence on two-parent families
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105658.title_zh: 北美收入维持实验的启示：双亲家庭的新数据与证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105659.abstract: We examine the labor supply effects of short-term income transfers for families experiencing a housing crisis. We link callers to an emergency assistance homelessness prevention hotline to their federal tax records and measure their earnings in the years surrounding their calls. Our methodology exploits quasi-random variation in the availability of assistance to compare similar families receiving and not receiving funds. Looking up to four years post-assistance, we find evidence, especially for the lowest earners, of earnings gains, and overall we find no evidence that assistance lowers earnings. Our results indicate that any income effect of temporary transfers for those in crisis is minimal and that these targeted transfers may convey labor market benefits for the poorest of the poor.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105659.abstract_zh: 我们考察了面临住房危机的家庭获得短期收入转移对劳动力供给的影响。我们将拨打紧急援助无家可归预防热线的来电者与其联邦税务记录相链接，并衡量他们在来电前后几年的收入情况。我们的方法利用援助可用性的准随机变化，比较接受与未接受资金的家庭。在援助后长达四年的观察期内，我们发现，尤其是对于最低收入群体，存在收入增长的证据，且总体而言，我们没有发现援助会降低收入的证据。我们的结果表明，对于处于危机中的家庭，临时转移支付的任何收入效应都微乎其微，而这些有针对性的转移支付可能为最贫困群体带来劳动力市场收益。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105659.title: The effect of emergency financial assistance on employment and earnings
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105659.title_zh: 紧急财政援助对就业和收入的影响

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105660.abstract: In an instrumental variable framework, we define supercompliers as the subpopulation whose treatment take-up positively responds to eligibility and whose outcome positively responds to take-up. Supercompliers are the only subpopulation to benefit from treatment eligibility and, hence, are important for policy evaluation. We propose conditions for characterizing supercompliers, and show how estimation and inference can be conducted with instrumental variable regression. In two job training experiments, we demonstrate our machinery’s utility, particularly in incorporating social welfare weights into marginal value of public funds analyses.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105660.abstract_zh: 在工具变量框架下，我们将“超级依从者”定义为治疗接受度对资格条件呈正向响应、且结果对治疗接受度呈正向响应的子群体。超级依从者是唯一从治疗资格中获益的子群体，因此对政策评估具有重要意义。我们提出了刻画超级依从者的条件，并展示了如何利用工具变量回归进行估计与推断。在两个职业培训实验中，我们展示了该方法的实用性，特别是在将社会福利权重纳入公共资金边际价值分析中的应用。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105660.title: Supercompliers

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105661.abstract: Legal representatives play a prominent role in the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) adjudication process, earning fees totaling $1.2 billion in 2019. Long ubiquitous in appellate hearings, legal representation has begun appearing more frequently at the beginning of cases, during the initial review. Using novel administrative data, we provide the first causal estimates of the impact of legal representation on SSDI case outcomes when representatives are engaged from the initial stage. To address selection into representation, we instrument for initial representation using geographic and temporal variation in the lagged share of appellate cases handled by private law firms (as opposed to public interest organizations or family). Among applicants on the margin, initial representation increases the probability of an initial award by 24 percentage points and reduces time to final decision by nearly a year. The increased awards are for applicants with the most severe, automatically qualifying conditions, indicating that representatives bring needed technical expertise to the initial filing. However, representation at the initial level reduces the probability that the case is ever appealed by 38 points, with two-thirds of this reduction coming from increases in initial allowances and one-third from fewer appeals following initial denials. We show that the benefits of initial representation are concentrated among people with mental diagnoses, while those with musculoskeletal diagnoses do not benefit. Our results suggest that representation leads to a reduction in application burdens and may improve target efficiency.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105661.abstract_zh: 法定代表人在社会保障残疾保险（SSDI）裁决过程中扮演着重要角色，2019年其收取的费用总计达12亿美元。长期以来，法定代表在申诉听证中普遍存在，如今在案件初始审查阶段也开始更为频繁地出现。利用新颖的行政数据，我们首次对从初始阶段即聘请法定代表对SSDI案件结果的影响进行了因果估计。为应对代表选择问题，我们利用私营律师事务所（相对于公益组织或家庭成员）处理的申诉案件滞后份额的地理和时间变异，作为初始代表的工具变量。在边际申请者中，初始代表使初始获赔概率提高了24个百分点，并将最终裁决时间缩短了近一年。获赔增加主要集中于患有最严重、自动符合条件病情的申请者，这表明代表为初始申请带来了必要的技术专长。然而，初始层面的代表使案件被申诉的概率降低了38个百分点，其中三分之二的减少源于初始获赔的增加，三分之一源于初始被拒后申诉次数的减少。我们表明，初始代表的益处主要集中在精神疾病诊断者中，而肌肉骨骼疾病诊断者并未受益。我们的结果表明，代表有助于减轻申请负担，并可能提高目标瞄准效率。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105661.title: Legal representation in disability claims
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105661.title_zh: 残疾索赔中的法律代理

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105662.abstract: We document a prominent yet underappreciated feature of the post-2000 Chinese economy: a vertical structure in which key upstream industries are dominated by state-owned enterprises (SOEs), while downstream industries are largely open to private competition. We develop a general-equilibrium model to analyze how this vertical structure—interacting with industrialization, globalization, and labor abundance—has shaped the Chinese economy. The framework offers new insights into SOE profitability, structural change, resource misallocation, and economic reform. First, upstream SOEs become more profitable as downstream private firms raise their productivity and face greater external demand during industrialization and globalization, helping explain the unprecedented prosperity of SOEs between 2002 and 2007. Second, reducing upstream market power would facilitate labor reallocation from agriculture to non-agricultural sectors, raising GDP and aggregate welfare. Third, preferential credit subsidies to SOEs can improve welfare by alleviating upstream under-supply; consequently, removing these subsidies without dismantling SOE monopoly power could reduce welfare. Quantitative analyses using firm-level data support the theoretical findings. We further show that this vertical structure can arise endogenously as an equilibrium outcome.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105662.abstract_zh: 我们记录了中国2000年后经济中一个显著但未得到充分认识的特征：一种纵向结构，其中关键上游行业由国有企业主导，而下游行业则基本向私营竞争开放。我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，分析这种纵向结构——与工业化、全球化和劳动力充裕相互作用——如何塑造了中国经济。该框架为国有企业盈利能力、结构变迁、资源错配和经济改革提供了新的见解。首先，随着下游私营企业提高生产率并在工业化和全球化过程中面临更大的外部需求，上游国有企业变得更加盈利，这有助于解释2002年至2007年间国有企业前所未有的繁荣。其次，减少上游市场势力将促进劳动力从农业向非农业部门重新配置，从而提高GDP和总体福利。第三，对国有企业的优惠信贷补贴可以通过缓解上游供给不足来改善福利；因此，在不瓦解国有企业垄断势力的情况下取消这些补贴可能会降低福利。基于企业层面数据的定量分析支持了理论发现。我们进一步表明，这种纵向结构可以作为均衡结果内生地出现。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105662.title: A model of China’s economic vertical structure
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105662.title_zh: 中国经济垂直结构模型

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105664.abstract: This paper investigates how local bureaucrats in China respond to minimum targets for air pollution control, which are part of a hybrid incentive contract that simultaneously specifies high-powered incentives for economic growth. Using a novel prefecture-day level dataset on air quality and applying a Regression Discontinuity Design, we find strong evidence that air quality tends to improve when the air quality target is doomed to fail, but deteriorates significantly once early fulfillment of the target is secured. We develop a theoretical model to rationalize these findings and highlight the role of uncertainty faced by local bureaucrats in shaping their responses. Further analyses explore how local economic pressure, the punishment loss for failing to meet the target, regional differences, and political turnovers affect bureaucratic strategic behavior after the target completion status becomes known. This study sheds light on how hybrid incentive contracts function in a multitasking context.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105664.abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国地方官员如何应对空气质量控制的底线目标，这些目标属于一种混合激励合同的一部分，该合同同时设定了对经济增长的高能激励。利用新颖的地级市日度空气质量数据集，并采用断点回归设计，我们发现强有力的证据表明：当空气质量目标注定无法达成时，空气质量趋于改善；而一旦目标提前实现得到保障，空气质量则显著恶化。我们构建了一个理论模型来解释这些发现，并强调地方官员面临的不确定性在塑造其应对行为中的作用。进一步分析探讨了地方经济压力、未达标惩罚损失、区域差异以及政治更替如何影响目标完成状态明朗后官员的策略性行为。本研究揭示了混合激励合同在多任务情境下的运作机制。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105664.title: How do bureaucrats respond to hybrid incentive contract? Evidence from China’s air pollution controls
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105664.title_zh: 官僚如何回应混合激励合同？来自中国空气污染控制的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105665.abstract: This paper examines the levels and dynamics of wealth inequality in Chile between 2007 and 2021, in a context where the private pension system is mandatory and government housing policies are centered on private ownership. We focus on two major macroeconomic events: the sharp increase in housing prices following the introduction of a value-added tax on new dwellings in 2016 and the large-scale liquidation of pension assets through early withdrawals during the recent pandemic. To do so, we construct a micro–macro consistent wealth distribution by extending existing methodologies to integrate administrative pension fund balances into household wealth surveys using machine learning techniques. Our results reveal pronounced wealth concentration: the top 1% hold roughly one-third of total private wealth—levels comparable to those observed in the United States—driven by their disproportionate ownership of financial assets. By contrast, the bottom 50% hold 7–9%, primarily through housing and pension assets, shares that exceed those reported in most European countries. We also document a modest decline in wealth inequality over the period, particularly after 2016. A counterfactual analysis suggests that this decline reflects the interaction of two opposing forces: housing appreciation, which predominantly benefited the bottom 90% of households, and pension withdrawals, which reduced wealth across the distribution while relatively increasing inequality. Our findings on levels, trends, and counterfactuals are robust across alternative methodological specifications.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105665.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2007年至2021年间智利财富不平等的水平与动态变化，其背景是私人养老金制度为强制性，且政府住房政策以私人所有权为核心。我们重点关注两大宏观经济事件：2016年对新住宅征收增值税后房价的急剧上涨，以及近期疫情期间通过提前提取养老金资产进行的大规模清算。为此，我们通过扩展现有方法，利用机器学习技术将行政养老金账户余额整合至家庭财富调查中，构建了一个微观与宏观一致的财富分布。研究结果显示，财富集中程度显著：前1%的家庭持有约三分之一的私人总财富，这一水平与美国相当，主要得益于其对金融资产的不成比例持有。相比之下，底层50%的家庭持有7%至9%的财富，主要来源于住房和养老金资产，这一比例高于大多数欧洲国家的报告值。我们还记录了该时期内财富不平等的温和下降，尤其是在2016年之后。反事实分析表明，这一下降反映了两种相反力量的相互作用：住房升值主要惠及底层90%的家庭，而养老金提取则减少了各阶层的财富，同时相对加剧了不平等。我们的研究结果在水平、趋势及反事实分析方面，均在不同方法论设定下保持稳健。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105665.title: From housing gains to pension losses: Micro-macro integration to reveal wealth inequality dynamics in Chile
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105665.title_zh: 从住房收益到养老金损失：微观-宏观整合揭示智利财富不平等动态

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105666.abstract: Does political polarisation influence actual economic behaviours? Using British nationally representative surveys and administrative data, we document how the Brexit referendum triggered stark divergences in individual micro and macro expectations between Leave and Remain supporters. Compared to existing research, we show how these polarising effects were driven by a specific policy issue and mostly unrelated to traditional partisan identities. We also demonstrate howthese diverging beliefs influenced major real financial decisions. Leavers became more likely to purchase durable goods and engage in housing transactions, and areas with higher proportions of Leave voters experienced increased housing transaction volumes and rising prices.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105666.abstract_zh: 政治极化是否会影响实际经济行为？利用英国全国代表性调查与行政数据，我们记录了脱欧公投如何引发脱欧派与留欧派在个人微观及宏观预期上的显著分歧。与现有研究相比，我们揭示了这些极化效应是由特定政策议题驱动，且与传统党派身份关联不大。我们还证明了这些分歧信念如何影响重大实际财务决策。脱欧派更倾向于购买耐用消费品并参与住房交易，而脱欧选民比例较高的地区则经历了住房交易量增加和价格上涨。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105666.title: Ballots, budgets and bricks: Brexit and the polarisation of individual economic behaviours
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105666.title_zh: 选票、预算与砖块：英国脱欧与个体经济行为的极化

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105667.abstract: We study whether term limits can accelerate women’s access to top political positions by analyzing two reforms in Italian local elections that extended mayoral term limits from two to three five-year terms. In a period marked by rapid growth in women’s political participation, the first reform affected municipalities with fewer than 3000 inhabitants in 2014, and the second those below 5000 in 2022. Using a difference-in-discontinuities design, we find that longer term limits restrict opportunities for early-career politicians, with substantial effects on female representation: the share of female mayors would be 8 percentage points higher without the term limit extensions. The impact is larger in municipalities with more women in lower political positions and where gender quotas for council members are present, suggesting that entry-level quotas can be more effective when paired with policies promoting turnover in top positions. • Italy extended mayoral term limits below population thresholds in 2014 and 2022. • We use a difference-in-discontinuities design at the 3000 and 5000 cutoffs. • Without the reforms, the share of female mayors would be 8 p.p. higher. • The effect operates through incumbent retention, not gender preferences for tenure. • Term limits complement entry-level gender quotas in promoting female representation.
