10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105667.abstract_zh: 我们通过分析意大利地方选举中的两项改革来研究任期限制能否加速女性获得最高政治职位的机会，这两项改革将市长任期限制从两届延长至三届五年任期。在一个女性政治参与迅速增长的时代，第一项改革于2014年影响了居民少于3000人的市镇，第二项改革于2022年影响了居民少于5000人的市镇。利用断点回归中的差异设计，我们发现更长的任期限制限制了早期职业政治家的机会，对女性代表产生了显著影响：如果没有延长任期限制，女性市长的比例将高出8个百分点。这种影响在女性在较低政治职位中占比较多以及存在市议会成员性别配额的市镇中更为显著，这表明入门级配额在配合促进高层职位轮换的政策时可能更为有效。• 意大利在2014年和2022年按人口阈值延长了市长任期限制。• 我们使用3000和5000人口截断点的差异断点回归设计。• 如果没有改革，女性市长的比例将高出8个百分点。• 这种效应通过现任者留任发挥作用，而非性别对任期的偏好。• 任期限制与入门级性别配额相辅相成，共同促进女性代表。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105667.title: Gender equality through turnover: Quasi-experimental evidence from term limit reforms in Italy
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105667.title_zh: 通过人员更替实现性别平等：来自意大利任期限制改革的准实验证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105668.abstract: We examine the impact of public versus private television content on political engagement and accountability during the initial rollout of Canada’s television network in the early 1950s. A policy prohibiting market competition restricted districts to receiving either public or private programming, but never both. While both station types aired the public broadcaster’s national service, private stations bundled this content with local news. We find that exposure to the public broadcaster reduced voter turnout by 2.1 percentage points relative to districts without television, while engagement in private television districts remained indistinguishable from pre-television levels. This lack of engagement weakened re-election incentives and increased the incumbency advantage. Consequently, incumbents in public districts spoke less about their constituencies in parliament and demonstrated greater party loyalty in roll-call votes—results consistent with a significant reduction in political accountability.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105668.abstract_zh: 我们考察了20世纪50年代初加拿大电视网络初步推广期间，公共与私营电视内容对政治参与和问责制的影响。一项禁止市场竞争的政策限制各地区只能接收公共或私营节目，但从未同时接收两者。尽管两种类型的电视台都播出了公共广播公司的全国性服务，但私营电视台将这一内容与本地新闻捆绑在一起。我们发现，与没有电视的地区相比，接触公共广播公司使选民投票率降低了2.1个百分点，而私营电视地区的参与度则与电视出现前水平无显著差异。这种参与度的缺失削弱了连任激励，并增加了在位优势。因此，公共电视地区的在位者在议会中较少谈论其选区事务，并在唱名表决中表现出更强的党派忠诚度——这些结果与政治问责制显著减弱相一致。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105668.title: National content and local political consequences: Evidence from public and private television
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105668.title_zh: 国家内容与地方政治后果：来自公共与私营电视的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105675.abstract: This paper proposes a new framework to study the distribution of current taxes and the effects of tax reforms. For current taxes, labor taxes are assigned to the corresponding workers, capital taxes to the corresponding asset owners, and consumption taxes to the corresponding consumers. Current taxes capture the wedges between pre-tax prices (relevant for production) and after-tax prices (relevant for the work, saving, and consumption decisions of households) as well as the direct equity effects of taxes while being silent about efficiency. Our method does not require structural assumptions, is internally consistent, and maximizes the comparability of tax progressivity and inequality over time and across countries. Applying this methodology to the United States, we find that the effective tax rate of the top 1% has declined from about 50% in the early 1950s to 32% in 2021. It is through the corporate tax that a high degree of tax progressivity was achieved in the middle of the 20 th century. To analyze the distributional effects of tax reforms, mechanical changes in tax liability by income groups and aggregate revenue effects due to household (but not firms’) behavioral responses are sufficient statistics in the neoclassical optimal tax model of Diamond and Mirrlees (1971). The effects of taxes on pre-tax prices at the heart of classical tax incidence analysis are normatively irrelevant.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105675.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新框架，用以研究现行税收的分配状况及税制改革的影响。对于现行税收，劳动税归于相应劳动者，资本税归于相应资产所有者，消费税归于相应消费者。现行税收捕捉了税前价格（与生产相关）与税后价格（与家庭的工作、储蓄及消费决策相关）之间的楔子，以及税收的直接公平效应，而未涉及效率问题。我们的方法无需结构性假设，内部一致，并最大化税收累进性与不平等性在时间及跨国间的可比性。将此方法应用于美国，我们发现顶层1%的有效税率已从20世纪50年代初的约50%下降至2021年的32%。正是通过公司税，20世纪中叶实现了高度的税收累进性。为分析税制改革的分配效应，按收入群体划分的税收负担机械变化及因家庭（而非企业）行为反应导致的总体收入效应，在Diamond和Mirrlees（1971）的新古典最优税收模型中构成充分统计量。古典税收归宿分析中关于税收对税前价格影响的核心内容，在规范意义上并不相关。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105675.title: Distributional tax analysis in theory and practice: Harberger meets Diamond-Mirrlees
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105675.title_zh: 理论与实践中的分配性税收分析：哈伯格与戴蒙德-米尔利斯

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105676.abstract: This paper shows that infrastructure investments enhance local tax outcomes. Drawing on a novel dataset combining information on the location and timing of all road upgrades in Rwanda with 12 years of administrative tax and census records, we estimate large and significant increases in tax revenues in municipalities near upgraded roads. These effects are driven by firm entry as well as land value appreciation, captured through taxes on rental income at the local level. Finally, we show that while the additional revenues do not fully recover the central government’s initial investment, local municipalities’ revenues more than double within five years following the upgrades.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105676.abstract_zh: 本文表明，基础设施投资能够提升地方税收成果。利用一项结合了卢旺达所有道路升级的位置与时间信息的新数据集，以及12年的行政税收和人口普查记录，我们估计出靠近升级道路的市政区域税收收入出现了大幅且显著的增加。这些效应主要由企业进入以及土地价值增值所驱动，并通过地方层面的租金收入税得以体现。最后，我们指出，尽管额外收入未能完全回收中央政府的初始投资，但在升级后的五年内，地方市政的收入翻了一倍以上。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105676.title: The (fiscal) dividend of infrastructure: Roads and revenues in Rwanda
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105676.title_zh: 基础设施的（财政）红利：卢旺达的道路与收入

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105677.abstract: We study the effects of reducing formalization costs by exploiting the introduction of a simplified tax regime for microentrepreneurs in Brazil. Using novel administrative data and industry-level eligibility criteria, we show that a large reduction in entry and compliance costs significantly increased formal firm creation. Despite the increase in formalization, newly formal firms exhibit no growth or earnings gains. We then evaluate the new tax system’s fiscal consequences, showing that the expansion in social security coverage generated costs that exceed the additional tax revenue collected by 2.56 times. These costs arise as microentrepreneurs gain access to subsidized contributory benefits after registering through the system, highlighting the broader social value of bringing microentrepreneurs into the formal sector even in the absence of positive government net revenue or improvements in firm performance.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105677.abstract_zh: 我们通过利用巴西为微型企业家引入简化税收制度的机会，研究了降低正规化成本的影响。借助新颖的行政数据和行业层面的资格标准，我们表明，大幅降低进入和合规成本显著增加了正规企业的创立。尽管正规化有所增加，新正规化的企业在增长或收益方面并未展现出改善。随后，我们评估了新税收制度的财政后果，显示社会保障覆盖范围的扩大所产生的成本，是额外征收税收收入的2.56倍。这些成本源于微型企业家在通过该系统注册后获得补贴性缴费福利，这凸显了即使在没有政府净收入为正或企业绩效改善的情况下，将微型企业家纳入正规部门也具有更广泛的社会价值。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105677.title: Formalizing microentrepreneurs through targeted tax systems: Evidence from Brazil
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105677.title_zh: 通过目标税制正规化微型企业家：来自巴西的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105678.abstract: We estimate the fiscal externalities of a property transfer tax, the Los Angeles “Mansion Tax”, on the revenues from property taxes when assessed values are closely tied to transactions. In California, as in over half of U.S. states, growth in tax assessments between transactions lags market values, so any reduction in transaction frequency reduces the growth of property tax revenue. Assuming that Measure ULA did not directly change transaction rates outside of Los Angeles, we estimate a sizable fiscal externality: in our benchmark calibration, the resulting property-tax revenue loss offsets about four-fifths of the revenue generated by the transfer tax, and under alternative parameter values the offset can range from 30 percent to over 100 percent. The net revenue loss is larger for high-value and commercial properties.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105678.abstract_zh: 我们估算了房产转让税（洛杉矶“豪宅税”）对房产税收入产生的财政外部性，前提是评估价值与交易紧密相关。在加利福尼亚州，如同美国超过一半的州一样，交易间隔期间的税收评估增长滞后于市场价值，因此任何交易频率的减少都会降低房产税收入的增长。假设ULA法案并未直接改变洛杉矶以外的交易率，我们估算出一个显著的财政外部性：在我们的基准校准中，由此产生的房产税收入损失抵消了转让税收入的约五分之四，而在其他参数值下，这一抵消比例可从30%到超过100%不等。对于高价值及商业房产，净收入损失更大。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105678.title: Fiscal externalities of transaction taxes: Evidence from the Los Angeles mansion tax
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105678.title_zh: 交易税的财政外部性：来自洛杉矶豪宅税的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105679.abstract: We provide quasi-experimental evidence on the labor market returns to industry-recognized credentials connected to community college noncredit workforce training programs. Using novel individual-level administrative data on noncredit workforce training program enrollees in the Virginia Community College System and individual fixed effects models, we estimate the returns to industry credentials by comparing the labor market trajectories of credential earners and individuals who complete the same training but do not obtain a credential. Our results indicate that earning an industry credential increases quarterly earnings by approximately $818, which is partially attributable to a higher likelihood of transitioning into a higher-paying industry. We estimate these earnings gains would exceed program costs in just over half a year.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105679.abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于与社区学院非学分劳动力培训项目相关联的行业认可证书在劳动力市场回报方面的准实验证据。利用弗吉尼亚社区学院系统中非学分劳动力培训项目参与者的新颖个体层面行政数据，并采用个体固定效应模型，我们通过比较获得证书者与完成相同培训但未获得证书者的劳动力市场轨迹，来估计行业证书的回报。我们的结果表明，获得行业证书可使季度收入增加约818美元，这部分归因于转向更高薪酬行业的可能性增大。我们估计，这些收入增长将在半年多一点的时间内超过项目成本。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105679.title: Noncredit workforce training, industry credentials, and labor market outcomes
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105679.title_zh: 非信贷劳动力培训、行业证书与劳动力市场结果

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105680.abstract: The long, physically demanding hours that physicians, particularly surgeons, work during their training could impact physician mothers’ birth outcomes. Using Texas birth data from 2007 to 2014, we compare birth outcomes between physicians and lawyers and between surgeons and non-surgeon physicians. We then examine whether the 2011 duty hour reform, which lowered trainee work hours, impacted those birth outcomes. We find that physicians have an increased incidence of having low birth weight and small for gestational age infants, with the results driven by surgeons. In addition, we find that the duty hour reform is associated with a reduction in the incidence of small for gestational age infants for younger physicians.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105680.abstract_zh: 医生，尤其是外科医生，在培训期间长时间、高强度的体力工作，可能影响医生母亲的生育结果。利用2007年至2014年得克萨斯州的出生数据，我们比较了医生与律师、外科医生与非外科医生之间的生育结果。随后，我们考察了2011年值班时间改革（该改革降低了实习医生的工作时长）是否对这些生育结果产生影响。我们发现，医生生育低出生体重儿和小于胎龄儿的概率增加，这一结果主要由外科医生驱动。此外，我们还发现，值班时间改革与年轻医生生育小于胎龄儿概率的降低相关。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105680.title: Occupational Hazard? An analysis of birth outcomes among physician mothers
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105680.title_zh: 职业危害？医生母亲生育结果分析

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105681.abstract: Personal autonomy has been argued to be fundamental to well-being and is often discussed as an important driver of economic and political behavior. However, preferences for autonomy remain poorly understood. We propose a novel elicitation method for an individual’s intrinsic preference for choice autonomy that fully controls for instrumental value benefits of choice. We show that, while a majority of subjects in our experiment display a preference for choice autonomy, a significant minority is averse to their own choice.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105681.abstract_zh: 个人自主性被认为是福祉的基础，并常被讨论为经济和政治行为的重要驱动力。然而，对自主性的偏好仍知之甚少。我们提出了一种新颖的诱导方法，用于评估个体对选择自主性的内在偏好，该方法完全控制了选择工具性价值的好处。我们表明，在我们的实验中，虽然大多数受试者表现出对选择自主性的偏好，但相当一部分少数群体却对自己的选择感到厌恶。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105681.title: Choosing (not) to choose: Uncovering intrinsic preferences for choice autonomy
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105681.title_zh: 选择（不）选择：揭示对选择自主权的内在偏好

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105682.abstract: We study a model of popular demand for anti-elite populist reforms that drain the swamp: replace experienced public servants with novices that will only acquire experience with time. Voters benefit from experienced public servants because they are more effective at delivering public goods and more competent at detecting emergency threats. However, public servants’ policy preferences do not always align with those of voters. This tradeoff produces two key forces in our model: public servants’ incompetence spurs disagreement between them and voters, and their effectiveness grants them more power to dictate policy. Both of these effects fuel mistrust between voters and public servants, sometimes inducing voters to drain the swamp in cycles of anti-elite populism. We study which factors can sustain a responsive democracy or induce a technocracy. When instead populism arises, we discuss which reforms may reduce the frequency of populist cycles.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105682.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个关于反精英民粹主义改革的大众需求模型，该改革旨在“排干沼泽”：用仅随时间积累经验的新手替换经验丰富的公务员。选民受益于经验丰富的公务员，因为他们在提供公共物品方面更有效，在识别紧急威胁方面更有能力。然而，公务员的政策偏好并不总是与选民一致。这种权衡在我们的模型中产生了两个关键力量：公务员的无能加剧了他们与选民之间的分歧，而他们的有效性则赋予他们更多制定政策的权力。这两种效应都加剧了选民与公务员之间的不信任，有时会诱导选民以反精英民粹主义的周期方式“排干沼泽”。我们研究了哪些因素能够维持一个响应性民主或催生技术官僚体制。当民粹主义出现时，我们讨论了哪些改革可能减少民粹主义周期的频率。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105682.title: Drain the swamp: A theory of anti-elite populism
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105682.title_zh: 排干沼泽：反精英民粹主义的一种理论

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105683.abstract: Understanding the spatial economic impacts of large-scale transport infrastructure projects is vital for promoting ecient resource allocation in modern economies. However, the current practice of economic evaluation in transport policy is largely conned to partial equilibrium models, which focus solely on transport markets in isolation, ignoring the transformative impact of large-scale interventions. In this paper, we build upon the methodological principles of quantitative spatial economics, an emerging eld within the spatial economics literature, to design an appraisal method that captures the interactions between transport supply and the labour, production and real estate markets. Our model features travel time valuations that are micro-founded through an explicit leisure-labour trade-o, making them unique to each residence-workplace pair. The model is invertible and suitable for the theoretically and geographically coherent causal estimation of the dispersion of idiosyncratic location choice preferences and the strength and distance decay of agglomeration forces.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105683.abstract_zh: 理解大型交通基础设施项目的空间经济影响，对于促进现代经济中资源的高效配置至关重要。然而，当前交通政策中的经济评估实践大多局限于局部均衡模型，这些模型仅孤立地关注交通市场，忽视了大规模干预措施的变革性影响。本文基于定量空间经济学的方法论原则——这一空间经济学文献中的新兴领域，设计了一种评估方法，用以捕捉交通供给与劳动力、生产及房地产市场之间的相互作用。我们的模型通过明确的休闲-劳动权衡，为出行时间价值提供了微观基础，使其对每个居住-工作地点组合具有独特性。该模型可逆，适用于对个体区位选择偏好离散度的异质性以及集聚力的强度与距离衰减效应进行理论上和地理上连贯的因果估计。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105683.title: A quantitative urban model for transport appraisal
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105683.title_zh: 交通评估的定量城市模型

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105684.abstract: Why do employers offer pensions? We empirically investigate two rationales, namely that they improve worker effort and selectively retain good workers. We test these hypotheses using rich administrative data on effort and output for public school teachers around the pension-eligibility threshold. When teachers cross the threshold, their effective compensation falls by over 50 percent of salary due to sharply reduced pension accruals. Standard economic models predict that this effective pay cut reduces teacher effort and output, but we observe no such decline. This suggests that yearly pension accruals do not meaningfully increase effort. Similarly, if pensions selectively retain better teachers, we would expect average teacher quality to decline when the retentive incentive disappears at the threshold. Instead, we find no change in workforce composition, suggesting pensions do not selectively retain higher-performing teachers around the threshold.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105684.abstract_zh: 为什么雇主会提供养老金？我们通过实证研究探讨了两个理由，即养老金能提升员工努力程度并有选择性地留住优秀员工。我们利用围绕养老金资格门槛的公立学校教师的丰富行政数据，对努力程度和产出进行了测试。当教师跨越这一门槛时，由于养老金累积急剧减少，其有效薪酬下降超过工资的50%。标准经济模型预测，这种有效减薪会降低教师的努力程度和产出，但我们并未观察到此类下降。这表明年度养老金累积并未显著提升努力程度。同样，如果养老金能有选择性地留住更优秀的教师，我们预期当门槛处的保留激励消失时，平均教师质量会下降。然而，我们发现劳动力构成并无变化，这表明在门槛附近，养老金并未有选择性地留住表现更佳的教师。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105684.title: Do pensions enhance effort and selective retention?: Evidence from public schools
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105684.title_zh: 养老金能否提升工作努力与选择性留任？——来自公立学校的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105685.abstract: We use population-wide data from Finland to provide evidence on the impact of earnings disregard policies on part-time work during unemployment spells. The share of part-time workers among benefit recipients increased sharply from about 10% to nearly 18% over a few years after the implementation of earnings disregards in unemployment benefits and housing allowances, which allowed individuals to earn up to 300 euros per month without reductions in their benefits. Using variation in the impact of the reforms on incentives between individuals eligible for different types of benefits, we estimate that the share of individuals working part-time during unemployment increased by 4.1–4.5 percentage points (23–32%) due to the implementation of earnings disregards, corresponding to a part-time work participation elasticity with respect to the participation tax rate of approximately 1. We find no evidence that earnings disregards crowd out full-time employment, but instead find moderate positive longer-run employment effects.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105685.abstract_zh: 我们利用芬兰全国范围内的数据，为收入忽略政策对失业期间兼职工作的影响提供证据。在失业救济金和住房补贴中实施收入忽略政策后，允许个人每月赚取高达300欧元而不减少其福利，受益人中兼职工作者的比例在几年内从约10%急剧上升至近18%。利用改革对不同类型福利资格个体激励影响的差异，我们估计，由于收入忽略政策的实施，失业期间从事兼职工作的个体比例增加了4.1至4.5个百分点（23%至32%），这相当于兼职工作参与率对参与税率的弹性约为1。我们没有发现收入忽略政策挤出全职就业的证据，反而观察到适度的正向长期就业效应。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105685.title: Combining part-time work and social benefits: Empirical evidence from Finland
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105685.title_zh: 兼职工作与社会福利的结合：来自芬兰的经验证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105686.abstract: We ask what direct consumption data can reveal about the consumption-smoothing component of the insurance value of the Affordable Care Act Medicaid expansions. Medicaid expansion may reduce consumption risk by limiting exposure to out-of-pocket medical spending, but this channel may be muted when much uninsured care is financed through charity care, bad debt, or other forms of uncompensated care. We combine household expenditure data from the Consumer Expenditure Survey with the staggered timing of state Medicaid expansions to estimate effects on average consumption and on the within-education-group consumption distribution. We then map these estimated distributional effects into a static expected-utility framework. The exercise highlights both what this approach can reveal and where it is limited. Point estimates are largest for individuals without a high school degree and close to zero for higher-education groups, but the estimates are imprecise, including for average consumption. The resulting insurance-value calculations require additional assumptions and are also statistically imprecise. We therefore interpret the results as showing that existing consumption data can be used to bound the consumption-smoothing channel, but are not adequate to precisely estimate this component of the insurance value of Medicaid expansion. The findings clarify what can and cannot be learned from consumption data about this component of Medicaid’s value.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105686.abstract_zh: 我们探讨直接消费数据能揭示《平价医疗法案》医疗补助扩展保险价值中的消费平滑成分。医疗补助扩展可能通过限制自付医疗支出来降低消费风险，但当大量未保险医疗通过慈善医疗、坏账或其他形式的无偿医疗来融资时，这一渠道可能被削弱。我们将消费者支出调查的家庭支出数据与各州医疗补助扩展的时间错开相结合，估计其对平均消费及教育组内消费分布的影响。随后，我们将这些估计的分布效应映射到一个静态期望效用框架中。这一实践既凸显了该方法能揭示的内容，也指出了其局限性。点估计显示，对未完成高中学历的个体影响最大，而对高等教育群体则接近零，但估计不精确，包括平均消费的估计也是如此。由此得出的保险价值计算需要额外假设，且在统计上也不精确。因此，我们将结果解读为：现有消费数据可用于界定消费平滑渠道的范围，但不足以精确估计医疗补助扩展保险价值的这一组成部分。这些发现阐明了消费数据在理解医疗补助价值这一方面能及不能提供的信息。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105686.title: Estimating the consumption-smoothing value of Medicaid expansion: Evidence and limits
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105686.title_zh: 估算医疗补助扩展的消费平滑价值：证据与局限

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105687.abstract: This paper provides causal evidence that the sex composition of dating markets affects maternal and neonatal health. Using a novel instrument that leverages randomness in sex at birth to vary the availability of male partners, I find that a more favorable dating market for women decreases non-marital but increases marital fertility, lowers rates of chlamydia and hypertension among mothers, and decreases the incidence of low APGAR scores and a composite index of adverse birth outcomes. These effects appear to operate primarily through changes in relationship dynamics and selection into motherhood. Connecting this to inequalities, racial disparities in partner availability can explain 5–10% of the Black–White pregnancy health gap.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105687.abstract_zh: 本文提供了因果证据，表明约会市场的性别构成影响母婴健康。利用一种新颖的工具变量，该工具利用出生性别的随机性来变化男性伴侣的可获得性，我发现对女性更有利的约会市场降低了非婚生育率但提高了婚内生育率，降低了母亲中衣原体感染和高血压的比率，并减少了低APGAR评分及不良出生结局综合指数的发生率。这些效应似乎主要通过关系动态变化和进入母亲身份的选择机制发挥作用。将此与不平等联系起来，伴侣可获得性的种族差异可以解释黑人-白人妊娠健康差距的5%至10%。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105687.title: The effect of dating markets on maternal and neonatal health
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105687.title_zh: 婚恋市场对孕产妇及新生儿健康的影响

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105688.abstract: We examine how social observability affects the willingness of low-income individuals to apply for financial support. After completing tasks to earn income in the lab, participants are given the opportunity to apply for a transfer from a social fund earmarked for the lowest earners. We experimentally vary whether the application is public or private and whether the funds come from the experimenters or other participants. We find that making the application public reduces take-up by 31 percentage points. Adding peer funding leads to a further 10 percentage point drop. These effects are strongest when income is earned through effort instead of a lottery, and when both public visibility and peer funding are present. The findings are not driven by altruistic or redistributive preferences, but perspective taking makes participants more sensitive to the public application treatment. Our findings suggest that ensuring privacy in the application process helps increase access to income support programs.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105688.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了社会可见性如何影响低收入个体申请经济支持的意愿。在实验室中完成赚取收入的任务后，参与者有机会申请从一项专为最低收入者设立的社会基金中获得转移支付。我们通过实验变化申请是公开还是私密，以及资金来源是实验者还是其他参与者。我们发现，将申请公开化会使参与率下降31个百分点。增加同伴资助则导致进一步下降10个百分点。这些效应在收入通过努力而非抽签获得时最为显著，并且当公开可见性与同伴资助同时存在时效果最强。这些发现并非由利他或再分配偏好驱动，但换位思考使参与者对公开申请处理更为敏感。我们的结果表明，确保申请过程中的隐私有助于增加收入支持项目的可及性。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105688.title: Social observability and demand for transfers: Experimental evidence from a low income population
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105688.title_zh: 社会可观察性与转移支付需求：来自低收入人群的实验证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105695.abstract: Benefit overpayments are a common byproduct of benefit programs and often lead to substantial debts among individuals. Although effective repayment and debt-relief policies are a key policy concern, empirical evidence on their impact is still scarce. In this study, we investigate the impact of welfare debt relief on labor market and mental health outcomes among financially vulnerable individuals. We exploit an eligibility cutoff applied by a Dutch welfare office to identify causal effects, using an instrumented difference-in-difference and fuzzy regression discontinuity design. Using linked administrative data, our findings suggest that debt relief reduces the use of mental health medication by about 1.1 percentage points (13.9%), consistent with lower financial stress. We find no significant effects on employment, earnings, and welfare receipt for the full sample. However, employment increases among debtors with ex-ante severe debt positions. This indicates the initial presence of debt overhang problems with larger debts.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105695.abstract_zh: 福利金超额支付是福利项目中常见的副产品，往往导致个人背负大量债务。尽管有效的还款和债务减免政策是政策关注的重点，但关于其影响的实证证据仍然稀缺。在本研究中，我们考察了福利债务减免对财务脆弱个体的劳动力市场及心理健康结果的影响。我们利用荷兰一家福利办公室适用的资格截止点来识别因果效应，采用工具变量双重差分法和模糊断点回归设计。基于关联的行政数据，我们的研究结果表明，债务减免使心理健康药物的使用减少了约1.1个百分点（13.9%），这与财务压力降低相一致。对于全样本，我们未发现对就业、收入和福利领取有显著影响。然而，在事前债务状况严重的债务人中，就业有所增加。这表明，在债务规模较大时，最初存在债务悬置问题。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105695.title: Welfare debt relief: Impact on employment, benefit receipt, and mental health
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105695.title_zh: 福利债务减免：对就业、福利领取及心理健康的影响

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105696.abstract: Electric vehicles are key to decarbonizing transportation, but, as batteries-on-wheels, they present novel challenges and opportunities for grids simultaneously transitioning to renewable energy. In a field experiment tracking 390 electric vehicles minute-by-minute, we show that time-based charging incentives dramatically shift not only when vehicles are charged, but also where. Incentives to increase charging during solar energy generation hours lead to a 34% rise in charging—mostly outside the home. Incentives to reduce peak time charging result in 17%—27% lower charging—mostly at home. Participants demonstrate multiple responses to incentives, including shifting time and location of charging, reducing charging by driving less, and lowering their battery state-of-charge. We find stronger midday charging responses for commuters and those with fast home chargers, and suggestive evidence that commuters increase use of workplace charging. Tariffs and charging infrastructure, therefore, need to be designed in tandem to manage the critical time and location imbalances brought about by the net-zero transition.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105696.abstract_zh: 电动汽车是实现交通脱碳的关键，但作为“轮子上的电池”，它们同时为正在向可再生能源转型的电网带来了新的挑战与机遇。在一项对390辆电动汽车进行分钟级追踪的实地实验中，我们展示了基于时间的充电激励不仅显著改变了车辆的充电时间，还改变了充电地点。激励措施鼓励在太阳能发电高峰时段增加充电，导致充电量上升34%——其中大部分发生在家庭之外。而旨在减少高峰时段充电的激励措施则使充电量下降17%至27%——其中大部分发生在家庭内部。参与者对激励措施表现出多种响应，包括调整充电时间和地点、通过减少驾驶来降低充电需求，以及降低电池荷电状态。我们发现，通勤者及拥有快速家用充电桩的参与者对午间充电的响应更为强烈，并有初步证据表明通勤者增加了工作场所充电的使用。因此，电价机制与充电基础设施需要协同设计，以应对净零转型所带来的关键时间与地点上的不平衡。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105696.title: Can electric vehicles aid the renewable transition? Evidence from a field experiment incentivizing midday charging
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105696.title_zh: 电动汽车能否助力可再生能源转型？来自激励午间充电实地实验的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105697.abstract: The rise of platform gig work in recent years has meant more workers have self-employment earnings, which are not subject to tax withholding but generally covered by information reporting on 1099 returns. In 2017, many gig workers suddenly and unexpectedly stopped receiving a 1099 for their work activity, providing an opportunity to study the impact of third-party reporting on tax compliance for gig workers. We first exploit exogenous variation in receiving a 1099 information return using a border-county design in two states where all workers continued to receive a 1099. We find no impact of receiving a 1099 on whether one files a tax return, but find that each dollar reported on a 1099-K increases self-reported profits by 17 cents. We then use the state-level filings to impute the size of the national online platform workforce in 2017 and 2018. We estimate that 770,000 gig workers did not receive information returns due to the change in third-party reporting practices by online platforms and that $560 million in profits went unreported on income tax filings as a result.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105697.abstract_zh: 近年来，平台零工经济的兴起意味着更多工人拥有自雇收入，这些收入虽不适用预扣税，但通常需通过1099表格进行信息申报。2017年，许多零工工人突然且意外地不再收到其工作活动的1099表格，这为研究第三方报告对零工工人税收遵从度的影响提供了契机。我们首先利用边境县设计，在两个所有工人均继续收到1099表格的州中，利用收到1099信息回报的外生变异。我们发现，收到1099表格对是否提交纳税申报表没有影响，但每收到1099-K表格上报告的1美元，自报利润增加17美分。随后，我们利用州级申报数据估算2017年和2018年全国在线平台劳动力的规模。我们估计，由于在线平台第三方报告实践的变更，有77万名零工工人未收到信息回报，导致5.6亿美元的利润未在所得税申报中报告。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105697.title: The impact of third-party reporting on tax compliance: Evidence from gig workers
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105697.title_zh: 第三方报告对税收遵从的影响：来自零工工人的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105700.abstract: Elites disproportionately influence policymaking, yet little is known about their fairness and efficiency preferences—key determinants of support for redistributive policies. We investigate these preferences in an incentivized lab experiment with future elites: Ivy League MBA students. We find that MBA students implement substantially more unequal earnings distributions than the average American, regardless of whether inequality stems from luck or merit. Their redistributive choices are also far more responsive to efficiency costs than the near-zero response found in representative U.S. samples. These patterns partly reflect distinct fairness ideals: a large share of MBA students falls outside standard classifications, instead displaying “weak meritocratic” tendencies that tolerate inequality even when it stems from luck. These findings identify a channel through which elite preferences may sustain U.S. inequality.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105700.abstract_zh: 精英阶层对政策制定的影响不成比例地巨大，然而关于他们的公平与效率偏好——这些是支持再分配政策的关键决定因素——我们知之甚少。我们通过一项带有激励机制的实验室实验，以未来精英——常春藤联盟MBA学生为对象，探究了这些偏好。研究发现，MBA学生实施的收入分配不平等程度显著高于普通美国人，无论这种不平等源于运气还是能力。他们的再分配选择对效率成本的响应也远高于美国代表性样本中近乎为零的响应。这些模式部分反映了不同的公平理念：相当大比例的MBA学生不属于标准分类，而是表现出“弱精英主义”倾向，即使不平等源于运气也予以容忍。这些发现揭示了精英偏好可能维持美国不平等的一个渠道。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105700.title: Are elites meritocratic and efficiency-seeking? Evidence from MBA students
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105700.title_zh: 精英是否追求贤能治理与效率？来自MBA学生的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105701.abstract: This paper constructs monthly distributions of national income for the United States. We develop a methodology to disaggregate annual distributions and project monthly changes in a timely manner by combining high-frequency public data sources. This allows us to estimate growth by social groups as soon as quarterly macroeconomic growth numbers are released, and to track the distributional impacts of government policies during and in the aftermath of recessions in real time. We test and validate our methodology by implementing it retrospectively back to 1976. Estimates are available at https://realtimeinequality.org.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105701.abstract_zh: 本文构建了美国国民收入的月度分布。我们开发了一种方法，通过结合高频公共数据源，对年度分布进行分解，并及时预测月度变化。这使得我们能够在季度宏观经济增长数据发布后立即估算各社会群体的增长情况，并实时追踪经济衰退期间及之后政府政策的分配影响。我们通过回溯至1976年的实施来测试和验证我们的方法。估算数据可在https://realtimeinequality.org获取。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105701.title: Real-time inequality

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105702.abstract: In 1965–1966, Chile built and staffed thousands of new primary classrooms in supply-constrained communities. Using a quasi-experimental design and large census samples, we show that childhood exposure to school construction improved the schooling and labor market outcomes of adults and closed a persistent female disadvantage in school attainment. Women’s exposure to the policy had large intergenerational spillovers on their children’s on-time grade progression and completed schooling. The marginal value of public funds is 13, including direct effects on adults and intergenerational spillovers.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105702.abstract_zh: 1965年至1966年间，智利在供给受限的社区新建并配备了数千间小学教室。利用准实验设计和大规模人口普查样本，我们发现，童年时期接触学校建设改善了成年人的教育程度和劳动力市场表现，并缩小了女性在教育成就上长期存在的不利差距。女性受该政策影响对其子女的按时升学进度及最终受教育年限产生了显著的代际溢出效应。公共资金的边际价值为13，其中包括对成年人的直接影响及代际溢出效应。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105702.title: Building opportunity: the intergenerational effects of Chilean school construction
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105702.title_zh: 创造机会：智利学校建设的代际效应

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105703.abstract: This paper examines the impact of additional income provided to low-income families immediately after childbirth on criminal justice involvement. Using a regression discontinuity design, I exploit a policy that allows children born before year-end to be claimed as dependents for that tax year, thereby providing additional cash during the first year of parenthood. Using linked administrative data, I find that this extra income immediately reduces the likelihood of criminal charges and incarceration among first-time fathers, particularly for income-related offenses. In the long run, it also reduces juvenile justice involvement among their children.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105703.abstract_zh: 本文考察了低收入家庭在生育后立即获得额外收入对刑事司法介入的影响。利用断点回归设计，我利用一项允许年终前出生的儿童在该纳税年度被申报为被抚养人的政策，从而在育儿第一年提供额外现金。通过关联行政数据，我发现这笔额外收入立即降低了初为人父者面临刑事指控和监禁的可能性，尤其是与收入相关的犯罪。从长期来看，这也减少了其子女的青少年司法介入。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105703.title: Cash transfer at birth reduces criminal activity of fathers and children
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105703.title_zh: 出生时现金转移减少父亲和子女的犯罪活动

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105704.abstract: There is no consensus on how to measure social welfare and inequality when households have different needs. As we show, a dilemma emerges between holding households responsible for their needs or compensating them. This dilemma is of first-order importance for social welfare, but generally plays a minor role in the measurement of inequality. To address this impasse, we introduce partial compensation. Our axiomatic characterizations reveal novel families of welfare criteria and, with the extension to multidimensional commodity spaces, provide ready-to-use criteria for the analysis of redistributive policies.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105704.abstract_zh: 在家庭需求各异的情况下，如何衡量社会福利与不平等尚无共识。正如我们所展示的，在让家庭对其需求负责与对其进行补偿之间，出现了一种两难困境。这一困境对社会福利具有首要重要性，但在不平等衡量中通常作用甚微。为化解此僵局，我们引入了部分补偿机制。我们的公理化特征刻画揭示了新颖的福利准则家族，并通过对多维商品空间的扩展，为再分配政策分析提供了即用型准则。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105704.title: Equity and efficiency when needs differ
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105704.title_zh: 需求差异下的公平与效率

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105705.abstract: Using China's expansion of the high-speed rail system (HSR) as a quasi-natural experiment, we analyze the comprehensive vehicle registration data from 2010 to 2023 to estimate the causal impact of HSR connectivity on the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs).Implementing several identification strategies, including staggered difference-in-differences (DID), Callaway and Sant'Anna (CS) DID, and two instrumental-variable approaches, we consistently find that, by alleviating range anxiety, the expansion of HSR can account for up to one third of the increase in EV market share and EV sales in China during our sample period, with effects particularly pronounced in cities served by faster HSR lines.The results remain robust when controlling for local industrial policies, charging infrastructure growth, supply-side factors, and economic development.We also find that HSR connectivity amplifies the effectiveness of charging infrastructure and consumer purchase subsidies in promoting EV adoption.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105705.abstract_zh: 以中国高铁系统扩张作为准自然实验，我们分析了2010年至2023年的综合车辆登记数据，以估计高铁连通性对电动汽车采用率的因果影响。通过实施多种识别策略，包括交错双重差分法（DID）、Callaway和Sant'Anna（CS）DID以及两种工具变量方法，我们一致发现，通过缓解里程焦虑，高铁扩张可解释样本期内中国电动汽车市场份额及销量增长的三分之一，且这一效应在高铁线路速度更快的城市尤为显著。在控制地方产业政策、充电基础设施增长、供给侧因素及经济发展水平后，结果依然稳健。我们还发现，高铁连通性增强了充电基础设施和消费者购车补贴在促进电动汽车采用方面的有效性。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105705.title: High-speed rail and China’s electric vehicle adoption miracle
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105705.title_zh: 高铁与中国电动汽车普及奇迹

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105706.abstract: Limited post-secondary education infrastructure and opportunities partly explain low higher education attainment in developing countries. This paper estimates the effect of a program that expanded higher education by constructing numerous university campuses across Uruguay. Exploiting temporal and geographic variation in the program’s rollout, we use a dynamic two-way fixed-effects design and comprehensive administrative records to estimate the program’s causal impact. By reducing the distance to the nearest campus, the program increased university enrollment by 34 percent relative to baseline, with especially large gains among less-privileged, first-generation students. Spillovers extend up to 30 kilometers from new campuses, with effects concentrated among students from less-educated families, thereby reducing spatial inequality. We also find that university expansion increased secondary-school enrollment and completion, a relevant result given that low secondary school completion rates remain one of the main barriers to higher education. These improvements occurred without lowering tertiary completion rates. A cost-effectiveness analysis reveals substantial private and social returns, with costs comparable to those of a scholarship program, while reducing spatial inequalities. Overall, the findings suggest that place-based expansion of higher education can reduce spatial inequalities and foster intergenerational mobility in developing countries cost-effectively.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105706.abstract_zh: 有限的后中等教育基础设施和机会部分解释了发展中国家高等教育入学率低下的原因。本文评估了一项通过在乌拉圭各地建设众多大学校园来扩大高等教育的项目所产生的效应。利用该项目推广过程中的时间和地理差异，我们采用动态双向固定效应设计及全面的行政记录来估计该项目的因果影响。通过缩短至最近校园的距离，该项目使大学入学率相对于基线提高了34%，其中在弱势家庭背景的首代大学生中收益尤为显著。溢出效应延伸至新校园周边30公里范围内，且影响集中于来自教育程度较低家庭的学生，从而缩小了空间不平等。我们还发现，大学扩张提高了中学入学率和完成率，鉴于中学完成率低下仍是高等教育的主要障碍之一，这一结果具有重要意义。这些改善并未以降低高等教育完成率为代价。成本效益分析揭示了可观的私人和社会回报，其成本与奖学金项目相当，同时减少了空间不平等。总体而言，研究结果表明，以地方为基础的高等教育扩张能够以成本有效的方式减少发展中国家的空间不平等并促进代际流动性。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105706.title: Human capital consequences of expanding the supply of higher education institutions in a developing country
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105706.title_zh: 发展中国家扩大高等教育机构供给的人力资本后果

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105707.abstract: The combination of ongoing pandemic-related supply chain issues and the commencement of the Ukraine-Russia war triggered a sharp increase in gasoline prices in 2022, occurring alongside a forty-year high in general inflation. In response, five state governments temporarily stopped collecting excise taxes on gasoline in order to provide ‘inflation relief’ to their constituents. In this work, we examine the incidence of this tax relief and assess whether or not the full amount was passed-through to consumers using multiple methodologies in a natural experiment setting. In aggregate, we find that excise tax pass-through was not complete with about 82% of the excise tax relief passed down to consumers, though state-level event-studies show pass-through was likely complete in two states. Our results imply an unintended subsidy to gasoline retailers of approximately $390 million dollars in exchange for only about $10–15 in savings for each driver. The results highlight the need for alternative policy measures.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105707.abstract_zh: 疫情相关的供应链问题持续存在，加之乌克兰-俄罗斯冲突的爆发，导致2022年汽油价格急剧上涨，同时伴随着四十年来的高通胀水平。为应对此情况，五个州政府暂时停止征收汽油消费税，旨在为民众提供“通胀救济”。本研究通过多种方法，在自然实验背景下，考察了这一税收减免的归宿，并评估其是否全额传导至消费者。总体而言，我们发现消费税减免并未完全传导，约有82%的税收减免惠及消费者，尽管州级事件研究显示，其中两个州的传导可能已完全实现。我们的结果暗示，汽油零售商意外获得了约3.9亿美元的补贴，而每位驾驶者仅节省约10至15美元。这些发现凸显了采取替代政策措施的紧迫性。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105707.title: Is inflation relief passed-through? Evidence from excise taxes
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105707.title_zh: 通胀减免是否传导？来自消费税的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105708.abstract: International trade depends on the expectation that courts will protect commercial interests when disputes arise. With the growing number of international conflicts, it is crucial to know whether this expectation is met in practice. We examine the effect of the 2014 annexation of Crimea on the enforcement rate of foreign decisions by Russian and Ukrainian judges. We assemble novel data on the entire universe of Russian and Ukrainian court decisions concerning the enforcement of foreign decisions resolving cross-border commercial disputes. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that the enforcement rate of Ukrainian (Russian) decisions in Russia (Ukraine) fell by 26% (33%) after the annexation. We show that courts increasingly justified refusals through discretionary legal grounds and undue-notification claims. Our findings provide the first causal evidence that international conflict affects both judicial decision-making and compliance with commercial treaties.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105708.abstract_zh: 国际贸易依赖于一种预期，即当纠纷发生时，法院会保护商业利益。随着国际冲突日益增多，了解这一预期在实践中是否得到满足至关重要。我们研究了2014年克里米亚被吞并事件对俄罗斯和乌克兰法官执行外国判决率的影响。我们收集了关于俄罗斯和乌克兰法院处理跨境商业纠纷中外国判决执行问题的全部判决的新数据。采用双重差分法，我们发现吞并事件后，乌克兰（俄罗斯）判决在俄罗斯（乌克兰）的执行率下降了26%（33%）。研究表明，法院越来越多地通过自由裁量的法律理由和不当通知主张来拒绝执行。我们的研究首次提供了因果证据，证明国际冲突会影响司法决策以及商业条约的遵守情况。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105708.title: The impact of international conflict on cross-border commercial dispute resolution
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105708.title_zh: 国际冲突对跨境商事争议解决的影响

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105709.abstract: We study consumption stimulus using digital coupons, which provide time-limited subsidies contingent on minimum spending. Analyzing a large-scale program in China, we find that the program generates large and heterogeneous short-term effects. Consumption responses vary across both consumers and locations, reflecting both demand-side and supply-side factors. This heterogeneity shapes the incidence of the program: high-response consumers tend to patronize larger businesses, leading to a regressive allocation of stimulus benefits. Through counterfactual analysis, we show that targeting rules can reshape both the size and distribution of stimulus effects. Targeting the most responsive consumers can more than double the aggregate stimulus, while a hybrid design that combines targeted distribution with direct support to small businesses improves both efficiency and equity.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105709.abstract_zh: 我们利用数字优惠券研究消费刺激，这些优惠券提供基于最低消费额限定的限时补贴。通过分析中国一项大规模项目，我们发现该项目产生了显著且异质性的短期效应。消费反应在消费者和地区间均存在差异，这反映了需求侧与供给侧的双重因素。这种异质性塑造了项目的受益分布：高反应消费者倾向于光顾规模较大的商家，导致刺激福利的分配呈累退性。通过反事实分析，我们表明定向规则能够重塑刺激效应的规模与分布。针对最具响应性的消费者进行定向，可使总体刺激效果翻倍以上，而结合定向发放与对小企业直接支持的混合设计，则能同时提升效率与公平性。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105709.title: Consumption stimulus with digital coupons: Heterogeneity and policy design
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105709.title_zh: 数字消费券的消费刺激效应：异质性与政策设计

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105710.abstract: This paper examines the effects of minimum wage increases on household consumption, focusing on Spain’s 2019 reform, which raised the wage floor by an unprecedented 22.3 percent in a low-inflation environment. Using high-frequency confidential card-based transaction data, we exploit geographic variation in exposure to the reform. We find that municipalities more exposed to the reform increased consumption by 4.5 percent relative to less-exposed municipalities, with the largest gains concentrated in categories such as electronics, leisure, and spending at restaurants and hotels. We complement this analysis with household-level evidence from the Spanish Household Budget Survey. Consistent with the transaction data, affected households increased their consumption substantially—by 10.2 percent—and exhibited a marginal propensity to consume of 0.8, with spending gains also concentrated in discretionary categories. Combining evidence from both sources, our findings are suggestive of sizable local demand spillovers. Firm-level sectoral evidence further suggests that the costs of the reform were primarily absorbed through the exit of less productive firms rather than through broad employment or price adjustments.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105710.abstract_zh: 本文考察了最低工资上调对家庭消费的影响，重点关注西班牙2019年的改革，该改革在低通胀环境下将最低工资标准前所未有地提高了22.3%。利用高频机密银行卡交易数据，我们利用各地区对改革暴露程度的地理差异进行分析。研究发现，相对于暴露程度较低的地区，暴露程度较高的城市消费增长了4.5%，其中增长最为显著的类别集中在电子产品、休闲以及餐饮和酒店消费。我们通过西班牙家庭预算调查中的家庭层面证据对这一分析进行了补充。与交易数据一致，受影响家庭的消费显著增加了10.2%，边际消费倾向为0.8，且支出增长同样集中在非必需品类。结合两个来源的证据，我们的研究结果表明存在显著的本地需求溢出效应。企业层面的行业证据进一步表明，改革的成本主要通过低生产率企业的退出而非广泛的就业或价格调整来吸收。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105710.title: Consumption responses to a major minimum wage increase: Evidence from Spain
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105710.title_zh: 最低工资大幅上调的消费反应：来自西班牙的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105711.abstract: Quantitative evidence on the extent of paternalism within families is scant. We provide a novel measure to study whether and how parents interfere paternalistically in their children’s intertemporal decision-making. In an experiment with over 2000 members from 610 families in Bangladesh, we find that more than half of all parents are willing to pay money to override their children’s choices in order to mitigate the (correctly anticipated) level of children’s present bias. The extent of parental paternalism is strongly related to parenting styles and we discuss how it interacts with the intergenerational transmission of patience.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105711.abstract_zh: 关于家庭内部家长主义程度的定量证据十分匮乏。我们提出了一种新颖的衡量方法，用以研究父母是否以及如何以家长主义方式干预子女的跨期决策。通过对孟加拉国610个家庭中2000多名成员进行的实验，我们发现超过半数的父母愿意支付金钱来推翻子女的选择，以减轻子女（被正确预期的）现时偏向程度。父母家长主义的程度与教养方式密切相关，我们进一步探讨了其如何与耐心的代际传递相互作用。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105711.title: Parental paternalism and patience

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105712.abstract: Can modes of collective action, including protests, demonstrations, and marches influence court decisions, even without affecting the law or formal institutions? Here, I assess the influence of protests on the results of removal proceedings in U.S. immigration courts. Using a difference-in-differences design and administrative immigration court data, I compare removal proceedings outcomes around the time of the 2006 immigration reform protests. I find some evidence of a small and temporary influence on removal decisions. The probability of removals appears to decrease by approximately 2 percentage points for up to 3 weeks following the protests’ onset. There is little evidence that the overall effect of mobilization has medium or long term influence on outcomes. The effect varies across case, location and judge characteristics.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105712.abstract_zh: 集体行动模式，包括抗议、示威和游行，能否在不影响法律或正式制度的情况下影响法院判决？在此，我评估了抗议对美国移民法院遣返程序结果的影响。采用双重差分设计并利用行政移民法院数据，我比较了2006年移民改革抗议前后遣返程序的结果。我发现有证据表明，抗议对遣返决定产生了微小且暂时的影响。在抗议开始后的三周内，遣返概率似乎下降了约2个百分点。几乎没有证据显示动员的总体效应在中期或长期内对结果有影响。这种效应因案件、地点和法官特征的不同而有所差异。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105712.title: Do social movements influence decision makers? Evidence from U.S. immigration courts
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105712.title_zh: 社会运动是否影响决策者？来自美国移民法庭的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105713.abstract: People with mental illness are frequently discriminated against and stigmatized. We introduce a new measure of perceived depression stigma and examine the causal effect of perceived stigma on help-seeking in a sample of 1844 Americans suffering from depression. We document that a large majority of our participants overestimate the extent of stigma associated with depression. An informational intervention aimed at reducing perceived social stigma decreases the demand for psychotherapy. Merely prompting individuals to think about stigma has a similar effect. A mechanism experiment reveals that our interventions increase both participants’ optimism about future mental health and their readiness to rely on friends and family, thereby reducing the perceived need for therapy.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105713.abstract_zh: 精神疾病患者常遭受歧视与污名化。我们引入了一种新的感知抑郁污名测量方法，并在1844名患有抑郁症的美国样本中，考察了感知污名对求助行为的因果效应。研究发现，绝大多数参与者高估了与抑郁症相关的污名程度。一项旨在降低感知社会污名的信息干预措施，减少了对心理治疗的需求。仅提示个体思考污名问题，也产生了类似效果。机制实验表明，我们的干预措施既提升了参与者对未来心理健康的乐观程度，也增强了他们依赖亲友的意愿，从而降低了对治疗必要性的感知。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105713.title: Depression stigma

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105714.abstract: Using Measure 114’s narrow passage in Oregon as a natural experiment, we study how new gun regulations affect firearm demand. Background checks, a proxy for demand, rose 13.9% in anticipation of the referendum and surged 157% immediately following the election. After judicial intervention halted the law’s enactment, demand returned near pre-election levels. Temporal displacement/harvesting does not explain the demand spike: after eighteen months, we still observe a substantial cumulative increase of 63,000 excess firearm-related background checks. Administrative data reveal significant within-state heterogeneity. This evidence underscores the paradoxical effect of gun-control policies, offering a cautionary lesson to policymakers.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105714.abstract_zh: 以俄勒冈州第114号法案的微弱通过作为自然实验，我们研究了新枪支管制法规如何影响枪支需求。作为需求代理指标的背景调查，在公投预期阶段上升了13.9%，选举结束后立即激增157%。司法干预暂停该法律实施后，需求回落至接近选举前水平。时间转移/收割效应无法解释需求激增现象：十八个月后，我们仍观察到累计增加6.3万次超额枪支相关背景调查的显著效应。行政数据揭示了显著的州内异质性。这些证据凸显了枪支管制政策的悖论效应，为政策制定者提供了警示性启示。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105714.title: Gun policy and the steel paradox

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105715.abstract: Departmentalized instruction, in which teachers specialize in one or more core subjects and instruct multiple groups of students in a day, has become increasingly prominent in elementary schools. Departmentalization involves a potential trade-off: specialized assignments exploit teacher comparative advantage across subjects but introduce coordination costs across teams of teachers instructing common students. Using 8 years of data from Massachusetts and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate the effects of departmentalization on student achievement. Overall, we find that departmentalization has positive effects in English language arts (ELA) and science and either null or positive effects in math. Consistent with prior findings on teacher specialization, teachers are less effective when specializing in math and no more effective in ELA than when teaching self-contained classrooms. Rather, the improvements are driven by departmentalized schools assigning teachers to their stronger subjects.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105715.abstract_zh: 分科教学（即教师专攻一门或多门核心学科，并在一天内教授多个学生群体）在小学中日益普遍。这种教学方式涉及一种潜在的权衡：专业化分工能够发挥教师在不同学科上的比较优势，但也会在教授同一批学生的教师团队之间产生协调成本。利用马萨诸塞州八年的数据及双重差分法，我们估算了分科教学对学生学业成绩的影响。总体而言，我们发现分科教学对英语语言艺术和科学学科具有积极影响，而对数学学科则呈现无影响或积极影响。与先前关于教师专业化的研究结论一致，教师在专攻数学时教学效率较低，而在英语语言艺术学科上的教学效果并不优于包班制教学。相反，学业成绩的提升主要源于分科学校将教师分配至其更擅长的学科。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105715.title: Departmentalized instruction and elementary school effectiveness
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105715.title_zh: 分科教学与小学教育效能

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105718.abstract: This paper asks whether, and under which circumstances, rent subsidies to low-income households increase rents. We study a reform of the Finnish housing allowance system that caused large quasi-random variation in housing allowances. Using register data spanning five years before and after the reform, we find that large increases in allowances for affected housing units had little or no effect on their rents relative to other units. The effect of a one-euro increase in housing allowance on rent is roughly 0.036 euros with a standard error of 0.028. We provide novel evidence on the underlying demand- and supply-side responses that drive the rent effects. The reform led to only small changes in recipients’ housing choices, and at most modest changes in rental supply. Our interpretation is that rent subsidies can be effective in helping recipient households even in supply-constrained contexts, if recipients’ housing choices are unresponsive to the subsidy. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105718.abstract_zh: 本文探讨租金补贴在何种情况下会提高低收入家庭的租金水平。我们以芬兰住房补贴制度改革为研究对象，该改革导致住房补贴出现准随机大幅波动。基于改革前后五年的登记数据，我们发现受改革影响的住房单元在获得大幅补贴增加后，其租金相对于其他单元几乎没有变化。每增加1欧元住房补贴对租金的影响约为0.036欧元，标准误差为0.028。我们提供了关于驱动租金效应的需求侧与供给侧反应的新证据。改革仅导致受助者住房选择发生微小变化，租赁供给的调整幅度也极为有限。我们的解释是：若受助者的住房选择对补贴不敏感，即使面临供给约束，租金补贴仍能有效帮助受助家庭。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105718.title: The incidence of rent subsidies: Evidence on rents, housing choices and supply
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105718.title_zh: 租金补贴的影响：租金、住房选择与供给的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105719.abstract: In this paper, we study the effects of the Women’s Labor Subsidy (WLS), introduced in 2012, on women’s labor outcomes. We use detailed administrative records for more than 2.5 million women that allow us to analyze employment and income trajectories before, during, and after the implementation of the subsidy. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits the fact that eligibility is contingent upon falling below a specified vulnerability score cutoff, we analyze how eligibility and being a program beneficiary affect labor outcomes. Our results indicate no significant effects of WLS eligibility on women’s employment, months worked, or income. We also find null effects on labor outcomes for program beneficiaries. The null effect is relatively consistent across different subgroups of eligible women.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105719.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2012年实施的女性劳动补贴（WLS）对女性劳动结果的影响。我们利用超过250万女性的详细行政记录，分析了补贴实施前、实施期间及实施后的就业与收入轨迹。通过采用断点回归设计，利用资格取决于是否低于特定脆弱性评分阈值的特征，我们分析了资格认定及成为项目受益人对劳动结果的影响。研究结果表明，WLS资格对女性就业、工作月数或收入均无显著影响。同时，项目受益人的劳动结果也未发现显著效应。这一零效应在不同合格女性子群体中相对一致。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105719.title: Women’s labor subsidy: Evidence from Chile
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105719.title_zh: 女性劳动补贴：来自智利的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105720.abstract: I examine behavioral responses to inheritance and gift taxes in a setting where individuals knew the tax would increase three months before the new tax code took effect. Using tax microdata from Brazil, I employ bunching and difference-in-differences (DD) methods and find that individuals significantly retime their wealth transfers to avoid taxes. Retimed gifts resulted in smaller inheritances for nearly three years. Moreover, I find that responses are sensitive to changes in top gift marginal tax rates and tax design (flat rates vs progressive brackets). Finally, evasion increased in the medium run in reform states, particularly among small inheritances.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105720.abstract_zh: 本文考察了在个人知晓遗产税与赠与税将在三个月后上调的背景下，其行为反应。利用巴西的税收微观数据，采用聚束分析与双重差分法，发现个人显著调整财富转移时间以规避税负。调整后的赠与行为导致近三年内遗产规模缩小。此外，研究显示，行为反应对最高赠与边际税率变动及税制设计（统一税率与累进税率）具有敏感性。最后，改革州的中期逃税行为有所增加，尤以小额遗产为甚。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105720.title: Behavioral responses to inheritance taxes: Evidence from Brazil
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105720.title_zh: 遗产税的行为反应：来自巴西的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105721.abstract: This paper studies how tax expenditures shape the distribution of firm-level effective tax rates and their implications for domestic minimum taxes under the global minimum tax (GMT). Using administrative corporate tax returns from 16 countries, we document that tax expenditures are large and that effective tax rates tend to follow a hump-shaped pattern across the firm-size distribution, with particularly low rates among the largest firms. As a result, more than one quarter of the largest firms have effective tax rates below the 15-percent GMT rate, despite substantially higher statutory rates. However, firm-level simulations from five countries with data on subsidiaries of multinationals suggest that GMT-consistent domestic minimum taxes would likely generate modest revenue gains—a few percentage points of baseline CIT revenue—reflecting the small number of firms in scope and extensive deductions.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105721.abstract_zh: 本文研究了税收支出如何塑造企业层面有效税率的分布，及其在全球最低税（GMT）下对国内最低税的影响。利用来自16个国家的行政企业纳税申报数据，我们记录了税收支出规模庞大，且有效税率在企业规模分布上呈现驼峰形模式，其中最大型企业的税率尤其偏低。因此，超过四分之一的最大型企业有效税率低于15%的GMT税率，尽管其法定税率显著更高。然而，基于五个拥有跨国子公司数据国家的企业层面模拟表明，与GMT一致的国内最低税可能仅带来适度的收入增长——约占基准企业所得税收入的几个百分点——这反映了适用企业数量有限及广泛的扣除项。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105721.title: Effective tax rates, firm size and the global minimum tax
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105721.title_zh: 有效税率、企业规模与全球最低税

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105722.abstract: This paper examines causal peer effects in pro-environmental behavior using geocoded panel data on 260,000 Swiss households from 2008 to 2019 and instrumental variables methods. We find that peer behavior has a simultaneous impact on a broad range of energy-related practices. In particular, we find that peer solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption increases household electricity conservation efforts, with each additional solar PV installation at 100 meters’ distance to a household reducing a household’s annual electricity consumption by 0.2%. We also document peer effects both within and across markets for pro-environmental durable goods, with increased uptake of solar PV and electric vehicles following new solar PV installations nearby. We find suggestive evidence that peer influence manifests itself in different ways contingent upon households’ constraints. Our findings have important implications for renewable energy subsidy evaluation. To illustrate this we calculate the marginal value of public funds (MVPF) of the existing solar PV subsidy scheme. In this setting, accounting for peer effects increases the estimated MVPF by approximately 17%. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105722.abstract_zh: 本文利用2008年至2019年间26万户瑞士家庭的地理编码面板数据及工具变量方法，考察了亲环境行为中的同伴因果效应。研究发现，同伴行为对一系列与能源相关的实践具有即时影响。具体而言，同伴太阳能光伏（PV）的采用增加了家庭节电努力，每增加一个距离家庭100米范围内的太阳能光伏安装，可使该家庭年用电量减少0.2%。我们还记录了亲环境耐用品市场内及跨市场的同伴效应，即附近新增太阳能光伏安装后，太阳能光伏和电动汽车的采用率随之上升。我们发现了提示性证据，表明同伴影响根据家庭约束条件的不同而以不同方式显现。我们的发现对可再生能源补贴评估具有重要意义。为说明这一点，我们计算了现有太阳能光伏补贴方案的公共资金边际价值（MVPF）。在此情境下，考虑同伴效应会使估算的MVPF增加约17%。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105722.title: Green spills: Peer effects in pro-environmental behaviors
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105722.title_zh: 绿色溢出：亲环境行为中的同伴效应

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105723.abstract: Over the past three decades, China has experienced substantial reductions in social security benefits due to pension reforms and undergone profound demographic changes. By combining empirical studies and quantitative analyses in a general equilibrium setting, this paper examines the effects of China’s pension reforms and rapid population aging on household saving and labor supply behaviors. Calibrating the model to the Chinese economy, we find that the pension reforms alone account for approximately 25 percent of the increase in the household saving rate between 1995 and 2009, and 49 percent of the sharp rise in labor supply over the same period. These effects are significantly amplified by rapid aging. Our study demonstrates that both household saving and labor supply serve as quantitatively important self-insurance channels in response to changes in pension generosity and longevity risk.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105723.abstract_zh: 过去三十年间，中国因养老金改革经历了社会保障福利的大幅缩减，并发生了深刻的人口结构变化。通过结合实证研究与一般均衡框架下的定量分析，本文考察了中国养老金改革及快速人口老龄化对家庭储蓄和劳动供给行为的影响。将模型校准至中国经济数据后，我们发现，仅养老金改革一项，就解释了1995年至2009年间家庭储蓄率上升的约25%，以及同期劳动供给急剧增长的49%。这些效应因快速老龄化而显著放大。本研究证明，家庭储蓄与劳动供给均为应对养老金慷慨度变化及长寿风险的重要数量级自我保险渠道。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105723.title: The impact of pension reforms and rapid aging on savings and labor supply: The case of China
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105723.title_zh: 养老金改革与快速老龄化对储蓄和劳动供给的影响：以中国为例

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105733.abstract: We assess whether layering an ultra-poor graduation program on Ethiopia’s Productive Safety Net Programme (PSNP) protects women and their households from localized weather shocks. Using panel data from a large cluster-randomized trial matched with detailed weather records, we identify community-level exposure to dryness shocks. Women who are exposed to dryness shocks experience deteriorating nutritional status (in conjunction with declining household food security and assets) and a significant increase in the risk of intimate partner violence. However, access to the graduation program fully buffers women from any increase in intimate partner violence, and partially buffers women and their households against other adverse effects. Further analysis suggests that improved household savings likely drives the program’s protective impact.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105733.abstract_zh: 本文评估了在埃塞俄比亚生产性安全网计划（PSNP）基础上叠加极端贫困毕业计划，是否能够保护女性及其家庭免受局部天气冲击的影响。利用大规模整群随机试验的面板数据，结合详细的天气记录，我们识别了社区层面的干旱冲击暴露程度。遭受干旱冲击的女性营养状况恶化（同时伴随家庭粮食安全与资产下降），且亲密伴侣暴力风险显著上升。然而，参与毕业计划完全缓冲了女性亲密伴侣暴力的增加，并部分缓解了女性及其家庭面临的其他不利影响。进一步分析表明，家庭储蓄改善很可能是该计划保护效应的驱动因素。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105733.title: Do ultra-poor graduation programs build women’s resilience to weather shocks? Evidence from rural Ethiopia
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105733.title_zh: 极端贫困脱贫项目能否增强女性应对气候冲击的韧性？来自埃塞俄比亚农村的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105734.abstract: Simple theoretical models of job search can imply that a higher minimum wage increases the number of job seekers for affected jobs. Researchers often appeal to these models in defending or explaining non-negative estimated employment effects of minimum wages. We use novel data on job search in U.S. states to examine the effect of minimum wage increases on the number of job seekers for low-skilled positions. We find little if any evidence that higher minimum wages increase job search for low-skilled jobs, and more evidence that higher minimum wages decrease the number of workers seeking employment in these jobs.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105734.abstract_zh: 简单的求职理论模型可能暗示，最低工资提高会增加受影响职位的求职者数量。研究者常引用这些模型来为最低工资的非负就业效应估计进行辩护或解释。我们利用美国各州关于求职的新数据，考察最低工资上调对低技能岗位求职者数量的影响。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明更高的最低工资会增加低技能工作的求职活动，反而有更多证据显示，更高的最低工资会减少寻求这些岗位就业的工人数量。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105734.title: Minimum wage laws and job search
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105734.title_zh: 最低工资法与求职行为

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105735.abstract: Land taxes are widely viewed as an efficient source of public revenue, yet explicit land taxation is rarely implemented. We study a closely related but largely overlooked object: implicit land taxes that arise within standard property tax systems when tax assessments place different relative weights on land and structures than market valuations do. Using parcel-level data on assessed values and transaction prices from U.S. counties, we estimate these implicit land taxes by comparing assessor and market hedonic valuations. We find substantial dispersion in implicit land taxes across and within metropolitan areas. Counties with higher implicit land taxes experience faster growth in population density, business establishments, earnings, and demographic diversity. These patterns are consistent with theoretical predictions that taxing land more heavily than structures encourages denser and more productive development.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105735.abstract_zh: 土地税被广泛视为一种高效的公共收入来源，但明确征收土地税的做法却鲜有实施。我们研究了一个密切相关但长期被忽视的对象：当房产税评估体系对土地和建筑物的相对权重与市场估值存在差异时，标准财产税制度中产生的隐性土地税。利用美国各县的地块级评估价值与交易价格数据，我们通过比较评估师与市场的特征价格估值来估算这些隐性土地税。研究发现，大都市区内部及之间均存在显著的隐性土地税差异。隐性土地税较高的县，其人口密度、商业机构数量、收入水平及人口多样性均呈现更快增长。这些现象与理论预测一致：对土地课以重于建筑物的税负，将促进更密集、更高效率的开发模式。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105735.title: Implicit land taxes and their effect on the real economy
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105735.title_zh: 隐性土地税及其对实体经济的影响

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105736.abstract: We leverage a sharp 2012 parking fine increase for failing to purchase vehicle registration to examine disparate ticketing patterns across enforcement agencies in Chicago. Using an event-study framework, we find that Chicago police increased their enforcement of car registration non-compliance in Black relative to non-Black neighborhoods, with no observed disparate response from non-police enforcement agencies. This disparity is unexplained by compliance and is instead driven by departmental revenue incentives and multitasking-driven lower marginal search costs in Black neighborhoods. Disparate enforcement also exacerbated existing gaps in financial instability, generating increased rates of ticket non-payment and bankruptcy filings in Black neighborhoods.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105736.abstract_zh: 我们利用2012年芝加哥对未购买车辆注册的停车罚款大幅上调这一事件，考察不同执法机构间开罚单模式的差异。通过事件研究框架，我们发现芝加哥警方在黑人相对非黑人社区加强了对车辆注册违规的执法力度，而非警方执法机构则未表现出类似的差异化反应。这种差异无法用合规性解释，而是源于部门收入激励及多任务处理导致的在黑人社区较低的边际搜索成本。差异化执法还加剧了既有的财务不稳定差距，导致黑人社区罚单未支付率和破产申请率上升。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105736.title: Agency incentives and disparate revenue collection: Evidence from Chicago parking tickets
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105736.title_zh: 代理激励与差异化税收征管：来自芝加哥停车罚单的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105738.abstract: I study redistribution between inactive, unemployed, and employed agents who are heterogeneous in their preferences and their productive skills in the labor market and at home. The government considers that redistribution across skills is desirable, but redistribution across preferences is not: if everyone has the same preferences, equality is optimal, but if everyone has the same skills, laissez-faire is optimal. In turn, this leads to a simple sufficient statistic to assess any reform: any extra dollar of transfer should go to the agent whose consumption is the furthest below what she would have consumed if everyone had average skills. In high-income countries, the gap between the lowest consumption and the average production is empirically much larger in the labor market than among inactives. Hence, introducing an inactivity benefit, or basic income, would neither be welfare-improving nor optimal for that social welfare function, regardless of labor supply elasticities.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105738.abstract_zh: 我研究的是在劳动力市场与家庭中，偏好和生产技能均存在异质性的非活跃、失业及就业个体之间的再分配问题。政府认为，跨技能再分配是可取的，但跨偏好再分配则不然：若所有人偏好相同，则平等为最优；若所有人技能相同，则自由放任为最优。由此，这引出了一个简单的充分统计量来评估任何改革：每一额外转移支付的美元应流向消费水平最低于其若拥有平均技能时所应消费水平的个体。在高收入国家中，最低消费与平均产出之间的差距在劳动力市场中实证上远大于非活跃群体。因此，引入非活跃津贴或基本收入，无论劳动供给弹性如何，既不会改善福利，也不符合该社会福利函数下的最优状态。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105738.title: Basic income versus fairness: redistribution with inactive agents
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105738.title_zh: 基本收入与公平：非活跃主体下的再分配

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105739.abstract: The current opioid epidemic is the worst drug epidemic the U.S. has ever faced. We examine the role of social connections in its spatial spread. Having many friendship links to counties with high opioid exposure positively correlates with overdose death rates. To address identification concerns, we exploit two quasi-natural experiments that led users to substitute illicit opioids for prescription drugs. Having more friends exposed to counties affected by these shocks leads to more overdose deaths. We also provide suggestive evidence that spillovers affect different stages of addiction, are influenced by both supply- and demand-side conditions, and are attenuated in counties with more cohesive local friendship networks. Our results show how social connections contribute to the spread of the opioid epidemic.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105739.abstract_zh: 当前阿片类药物危机是美国历史上最严重的药物流行病。我们考察了社会联系在其空间传播中的作用。与阿片类药物暴露水平较高的县拥有众多友谊链接，与过量死亡率的上升呈正相关。为解决识别问题，我们利用了两个准自然实验，这些实验导致使用者从处方药转向非法阿片类药物。更多朋友暴露于受这些冲击影响的县，会导致更多过量死亡。我们还提供了初步证据表明，溢出效应影响成瘾的不同阶段，受供需双方条件的影响，并在地方友谊网络更为紧密的县中有所减弱。我们的研究结果表明，社会联系如何促进阿片类药物流行病的传播。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105739.title: Friends with drugs: The role of social networks in the opioid epidemic
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105739.title_zh: 毒品之友：社交网络在阿片类药物流行中的作用

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105740.abstract: Were COVID-19 and the associated restrictions used by authoritarian governments to tighten their grip on power? Using data from 83 Russian regions, we show that yes, they were – during the pandemic, it was the quality of institutions and the strength of civil society that limited the government’s information manipulation and repression, two main tools of authoritarian regimes. Arrest waves that followed the poisoning of Alexey Navalny, the opposition leader, in August 2020 and his jailing in January 2021 were more pronounced in those regions that manipulated the COVID-19 statistics more. The increase in the usage of authoritarian tools came at a price: misinformation reduced compliance with pandemic restrictions. In addition to two-way fixed effects, we use sensitivity analysis to account for possible omitted variables. Our findings are consistent with the theoretical complementarity between propaganda and repression. Regions that had more political repression also exhibited greater information manipulation, conditional on pandemic intensity and institutional characteristics.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105740.abstract_zh: 新冠疫情及相关限制措施是否被威权政府用来加强其权力控制？基于俄罗斯83个地区的数据，我们证实了这一点——疫情期间，正是制度质量和公民社会的力量限制了政府在信息操纵和镇压这两大威权统治工具上的运用。2020年8月反对派领袖阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼中毒及2021年1月其入狱后引发的逮捕浪潮，在那些对新冠疫情统计数据操纵更为严重的地区表现得更为突出。威权工具使用的增加付出了代价：错误信息降低了民众对防疫限制措施的遵从度。除了双向固定效应模型外，我们还采用了敏感性分析以应对潜在的遗漏变量问题。我们的研究结果与宣传与镇压之间的理论互补性相吻合。在疫情严重程度和制度特征既定的条件下，政治镇压更为严重的地区也表现出更显著的信息操纵行为。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105740.title: Information manipulation and repression: Theory and evidence from the COVID-19 response in Russia
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105740.title_zh: 信息操纵与压制：来自俄罗斯COVID-19应对措施的理论与证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105741.abstract: Federal judges—who enjoy lifetime tenure and constitutionally protected salaries—represent an especially hard test case for incentive-based bureaucratic reform. I study the “six-month list,” a reform requiring U.S. federal courts to publicly identify judges with overdue matters. Using a regression discontinuity design and other methods, I find that matters most exposed are resolved approximately 14% faster than those least exposed, with larger effects among younger, non-white, and female judges. The speed gains come with trade-offs: upfront time savings are partially offset by downstream delays, and more-exposed matters are more likely to be reversed on appeal. A bunching analysis estimates aggregate time savings of approximately 4%, demonstrating that non-monetary levers can shift behavior even among highly insulated elite professionals.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105741.abstract_zh: 联邦法官——享有终身任期及宪法保障的薪酬——构成了基于激励的官僚改革中尤为严峻的考验案例。我研究了“六个月清单”这一改革，该改革要求美国联邦法院公开识别存在逾期未决案件的法官。利用断点回归设计及其他方法，我发现，暴露程度最高的案件比暴露程度最低的案件解决速度快约14%，且在较年轻、非白人及女性法官中效果更为显著。速度提升伴随权衡：前期时间节省部分被后续延误所抵消，且暴露程度更高的案件更有可能在上诉中被推翻。通过聚束分析估计，总体时间节省约为4%，这表明即使在高度隔离的精英专业人士中，非货币杠杆也能改变行为。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105741.title: Non-monetary incentives and bureaucratic performance: Evidence from U.S. courts
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105741.title_zh: 非货币激励与官僚绩效：来自美国法院的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105742.abstract: Does the distribution of government transfers affect elections? We analyze a natural experiment in the 2019 wave of the US Department of Agriculture's Market Facilitation Program (MFP). The 2019 MFP allocated $14.5 billion via a formula combining historical production data and commodity-specific trade damages. We show how a methodological quirk resulted in arbitrary variation in these damages that propagated through the formula into excessive county-level compensation rates. We estimate the effects of this payment shock using a novel, design-based, randomization inference approach to account for complex dependencies across US counties. We find that counties receiving greater compensation rates, on average, have higher two-party Republican presidential vote shares in the 2020 election. Instrumenting for actual 2019 MFP disbursements, we find an additional $1 million in payments to a county increased that county's 2020 two-party Trump vote share by about .18 percentage points on average. Had the 2019 MFP maintained the spending levels of the 2018 wave, we estimate that Candidate Trump's two-party vote share would have been .117 percentage points lower nationally, with particularly pronounced effects in swing states like Arizona (.41 percentage points) and Georgia (.159 percentage points).
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105742.abstract_zh: 政府转移支付分配是否影响选举？我们以美国农业部2019年市场便利化计划（MFP）中的一项自然实验为分析对象。该计划通过结合历史生产数据与特定商品贸易损失的计算公式，拨款145亿美元。我们揭示了一个方法论缺陷如何导致这些贸易损失产生任意性波动，并通过公式传导至县级补偿率，形成过度差异。我们采用一种新颖的、基于设计的随机化推断方法，以处理美国各县之间的复杂依赖关系，从而估计这一支付冲击的影响。研究发现，平均而言，获得更高补偿率的县在2020年大选中两党制共和党总统得票率更高。以实际2019年MFP支付额为工具变量，我们发现，某县每额外获得100万美元支付，其2020年两党制特朗普得票率平均增加约0.18个百分点。若2019年MFP维持2018年的支出水平，我们估计候选人特朗普在全国范围内的两党制得票率将降低0.117个百分点，其中在亚利桑那州（0.41个百分点）和佐治亚州（0.159个百分点）等摇摆州的影响尤为显著。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105742.title: The political benefits of the monoculture: Estimating the electoral effect of the market facilitation program
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105742.title_zh: 单一栽培的政治收益：估算市场促进计划的选举效应

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105743.title: The costs of environmental land use regulation
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105743.title_zh: 环境土地利用管制的成本

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105744.abstract: We study how institutional wage reforms in one sector spill over to other sectors by focusing on the public sector. We leverage the Japanese policy reform that cut public-sector wages only in certain municipalities and the institutional setting in which only young workers are eligible for public-sector jobs. We find that a 1% public-sector wage cut reduces the private-sector wages of young workers by 0.3%. This spillover elasticity is greater when public-sector jobs are more important as workers’ outside options. We also find evidence that private-sector firms’ employment and profits expand in response to the public-sector wage cut. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105744.abstract_zh: 我们通过聚焦公共部门，研究了某一部门的制度性工资改革如何溢出至其他部门。我们利用日本仅针对特定市町村削减公共部门工资的政策改革，以及仅年轻工人有资格从事公共部门工作的制度安排。研究发现，公共部门工资每削减1%，年轻工人的私营部门工资将下降0.3%。当公共部门工作作为工人外部选择的重要性更高时，这一溢出弹性更大。我们还发现证据表明，私营企业就业和利润会因公共部门工资削减而扩张。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105744.title: Wage spillovers across sectors: Evidence from a localized public-sector wage cut
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105744.title_zh: 部门间工资溢出效应：基于局部公共部门减薪的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105745.abstract: Contrary to a long-standing concern, we present evidence that classical benefit-based labor income taxation in the tradition of Smith (1776) is consistent with income redistribution through transfers and negative average tax rates both theoretically and—in plausibly-specified simulations—quantitatively, at levels which reflect U.S. policy over the past several decades. As redistribution is widespread in practice, our results remove an obstacle to the benefit principle’s plausibility as a prevailing normative foundation of tax policy.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105745.abstract_zh: 与长期以来的担忧相反，我们提供的证据表明，遵循斯密（1776）传统的基于福利的古典劳动所得税制，在理论上与通过转移支付和负平均税率实现的收入再分配相一致，并且在合理设定的模拟中，其量化水平也反映了美国过去几十年的政策实践。鉴于再分配在实践中普遍存在，我们的研究结果消除了福利原则作为税收政策主流规范基础所面临的一个障碍。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105745.title: Benefit-based taxation can include substantial redistribution
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105745.title_zh: 基于受益的税收可包含显著的再分配效应

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105752.abstract: To address rising income inequality, governments typically rely on two levers: predistribution policies that implement inequality reduction before incomes are earned—e.g., minimum-wage laws—and redistribution policies that implement inequality reduction after incomes are earned—e.g., taxes and transfers. We explore whether support for reducing inequality depends on the choice of policy lever. Using incentivized experiments with the general population of the US and Sweden ( N = 2510 ), we study inequality reduction under predistribution and redistribution, focusing on whether inequality reduction is implemented before or after income is earned. We find that timing matters: subjects in both countries reduce inequality more under predistribution than redistribution. Furthermore, subjects in the predistribution treatment more often invoke equal effort to justify reducing inequality, while those in the redistribution treatment more often invoke adherence to the initial agreement to justify preserving it. Overall, our results imply that the choice between predistribution and redistribution can influence public support for reducing inequality.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105752.abstract_zh: 为应对日益加剧的收入不平等，政府通常依赖两种手段：一是事前分配政策，即在收入产生之前实施不平等削减，如最低工资法；二是再分配政策，即在收入产生之后实施不平等削减，如税收和转移支付。我们探讨了减少不平等的支持度是否取决于政策手段的选择。通过对美国和瑞典普通人群的激励性实验（样本量N=2510），我们研究了事前分配与再分配下的不平等削减，重点关注不平等削减是在收入赚取之前还是之后实施。我们发现时机至关重要：两国受试者在事前分配下比在再分配下更倾向于减少不平等。此外，事前分配处理中的受试者更常援引平等努力来为减少不平等辩护，而再分配处理中的受试者则更常援引对初始协议的遵守来为维持不平等辩护。总体而言，我们的结果表明，事前分配与再分配之间的选择可能影响公众对减少不平等的支持度。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105752.title: Fairness perceptions of redistribution and predistribution
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105752.title_zh: 再分配与预分配中的公平感知

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105753.abstract: This paper studies the optimal combination of government grants that provide direct public funding to nonprofits and tax incentives that reduce the cost of charitable giving. When nonprofits face high fundraising costs to attract donors, tax incentives cannot fully replace grants, which remain part of the optimal funding policy. When fundraising costs are sufficiently low, a government that can tailor tax incentives across causes can finance some causes entirely through donations. However, when cause-specific tax differentiation is unavailable, grants remain necessary to accommodate differences in funding needs across causes. In a calibrated example, imposing a uniform tax treatment of donations across charitable causes raises the optimal share of nonprofit funding covered by grants from 0 to 60%.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105753.abstract_zh: 本文研究了向非营利组织提供直接公共资金的政府拨款与降低慈善捐赠成本的税收激励之间的最优组合。当非营利组织在吸引捐赠者方面面临高昂的筹款成本时，税收激励无法完全替代拨款，拨款仍是最优资助政策的一部分。当筹款成本足够低时，能够针对不同事业定制税收激励的政府，可以完全通过捐赠来资助某些事业。然而，当无法按事业差异化税收待遇时，拨款仍是必要的，以适应各事业间资金需求的差异。在一个校准示例中，对各类慈善事业的捐赠实施统一税收待遇，会将拨款覆盖的非营利组织资金最优份额从0%提升至60%。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105753.title: How to fund nonprofits?
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105753.title_zh: 如何为非营利组织提供资金？

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105754.abstract: Racial disparities in criminal justice outcomes are well documented. However, there is little evidence on whether the pairing of prosecutors and defendants contributes to these disparities. This paper tests for race-pairing effects in convictions by prosecutors. I leverage conditionally as-good-as-random assignment of misdemeanor cases using administrative data from New York County’s Early Case Assessment Bureau. I find little evidence of race-pairing effects overall or for drug, person, and other offenses. In contrast, I find a robust 5 percentage point (8 percent) race-pairing effect for property crimes. The underlying pattern is driven by differences in outcomes for Black defendants, while conviction rates for White defendants are nearly identical across prosecutor race. Results appear driven by reduced use of adjournments in contemplation of dismissal, a discretionary form of prosecutorial leniency.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105754.abstract_zh: 刑事司法结果中的种族差异已有充分记录。然而，关于检察官与被告的配对是否促成这些差异的证据却寥寥无几。本文利用纽约县早期案件评估局的行政数据，检验了轻罪案件中检察官与被告种族配对效应。总体而言，或在毒品、人身及其他犯罪类别中，我未发现明显的种族配对效应。相反，对于财产犯罪，我发现了稳健的5个百分点（8%）的种族配对效应。这一潜在模式主要由黑人被告结果的差异驱动，而白人被告的定罪率在不同种族的检察官之间几乎相同。结果似乎源于对“延期驳回”使用的减少，这是一种检察官自由裁量权的宽大处理形式。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105754.title: Do prosecutor and defendant race pairings matter? Evidence from random assignment
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105754.title_zh: 检察官与被告的种族配对是否重要？来自随机分配的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105755.abstract: We study the impact of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) adoption on female employment outcomes in Vietnam using rich firm- and individual-level data. Our identification exploits exogenous variation in ICT access driven by geographic connectivity conditions and a nationwide network upgrade in 2007. We find that ICT adoption increases the female share of employment within firms, primarily through within-firm reallocation in the formal sector. We further provide evidence consistent with a task-reallocation channel: ICT is associated with a shift in labor demand away from routine and manual tasks toward social, customer-based, and service-oriented activities, where women are more likely to have a comparative advantage.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105755.abstract_zh: 我们利用丰富的企业和个人层面数据，研究了信息与通信技术（ICT）采纳对越南女性就业结果的影响。我们的识别策略利用了由地理连接条件和2007年全国网络升级所驱动的ICT接入的外生变化。研究发现，ICT采纳提高了企业内女性就业份额，主要通过正规部门内的企业内部重新配置实现。我们进一步提供了与任务重新配置渠道相一致的证据：ICT与劳动力需求从常规性和体力任务向社交、客户导向及服务型活动的转变相关联，而女性在这些领域更可能具有比较优势。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105755.title: Do information and communication technologies empower female workers? Evidence from Vietnam
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105755.title_zh: 信息和通信技术是否赋能女性劳动者？来自越南的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105756.abstract: This paper provides direct evidence that shared incarceration can facilitate the formation of post-release criminal partnerships. Using Norwegian administrative data linking prison spells to police case identifiers, we measure network ties through subsequent co-offending. We exploit time-based variation in exposure within facilities by comparing inmate pairs in the same facility who differ only in whether their spells overlapped. Overlap is associated with a 37% increase in five-year co-offending relative to comparable non-overlapping pairs, robust to extensive controls and timing-based restrictions. Effects are stronger in environments and for pairs where interaction is plausibly more intense, highlighting network formation as a plausible mechanism.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105756.abstract_zh: 本文提供了直接证据，表明共同监禁经历可能促进释放后犯罪伙伴关系的形成。利用挪威行政数据，将监狱服刑期与警方案件标识符相链接，我们通过后续共同犯罪来衡量网络联系。我们利用设施内接触时间上的变化，比较同一设施中仅在服刑期是否重叠上有所不同的囚犯配对。与可比的非重叠配对相比，重叠配对五年内共同犯罪率增加了37%，这一结果在广泛的控制变量和基于时间的限制条件下依然稳健。在互动强度可能更高的环境及配对中，效应更为显著，凸显了网络形成作为一种合理解释机制。
