10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105756.title: From prison peers to co-offenders

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105757.abstract: Multinational firms can use internal debt to shift taxable income across jurisdictions. To limit such profit shifting and protect the corporate tax base, many countries use thin capitalization rules that restrict interest deductibility. These rules often include escape clauses that exempt firms below specified thresholds, but such thresholds may create incentives for avoidance within corporate groups. This paper evaluates Norway’s 2014 thin capitalization rule using difference-in-differences, bunching, and regression discontinuity designs. We find that exposed firms sharply reduce leverage after the reform, driven by lower intra-group borrowing and interest costs, with no detectable effects on firm performance. At the corporate-group level, leverage remains unchanged, indicating that firm-level responses primarily reflect intra-group debt reallocation. We document substantial bunching below the rule’s exemption thresholds, especially among newly created subsidiaries, and show that internal debt is disproportionately shifted to these bunching firms. Although firms eliminate most of their initial exposure to the rule itself, this happens largely through reduced internal lending, and we find suggestive evidence of higher taxable income in the medium run. Because we observe only the Norwegian parts of multinational groups, we cannot provide conclusive evidence on cross-border profit shifting. Overall, the findings show that firm-level escape clauses generate strategic avoidance responses within corporate groups, while also suggesting that the reform may have protected the Norwegian tax base.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105757.abstract_zh: 跨国公司可利用内部债务在不同司法管辖区之间转移应税收入。为限制此类利润转移并保护企业所得税税基，许多国家采用资本弱化规则以限制利息扣除。这些规则通常包含豁免条款，对低于特定门槛的企业予以豁免，但此类门槛可能在企业集团内部诱发规避动机。本文利用双重差分法、聚束分析和断点回归设计评估挪威2014年资本弱化规则的效果。研究发现，受影响的公司在改革后显著降低杠杆率，这一变化主要由集团内部借款及利息支出的减少所驱动，且未对公司绩效产生可检测的影响。在企业集团层面，杠杆率保持不变，表明公司层面的反应主要反映集团内部债务的重新配置。我们记录了规则豁免门槛下方显著的聚束现象，尤其是在新设立的子公司中，并证明内部债务不成比例地转移至这些聚束企业。尽管企业基本消除了其对规则本身的初始敞口，但这主要通过减少内部借贷实现，且我们发现有提示性证据表明中期应税收入有所增加。由于我们仅能观察到跨国集团在挪威境内的部分，无法就跨境利润转移提供结论性证据。总体而言，研究结果表明，公司层面的豁免条款在企业集团内部引发策略性规避行为，同时亦提示该改革可能对挪威税基起到了保护作用。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105757.title: The role of escape clauses: Firm response to thin capitalization rules
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105757.title_zh: 逃逸条款的作用：企业应对资本弱化规则的反应

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105758.abstract: This paper studies how reducing the cost differential between permanent and temporary contracts affects firms’ use of each contract type. We analyze a 1997 Spanish reform that lowered non-wage labor costs for new open-ended (OE) contracts for workers under 30 and over 45, while leaving short-term (ST) contracts unaffected. Exploiting sectoral exposure and age-based discontinuities, we show that firms substitute strongly from ST to OE contracts for young workers but respond little for older workers. We find partial wage incidence of the subsidy on directly affected permanent jobs. The implied elasticity of substitution between ST and OE contracts is 6.5 for workers below age 30 and close to zero for workers above age 45. We also document that young workers’ wages rise in unsubsidized ST jobs consistent with the expansion of OE employment strengthening their outside options. Overall, the results reveal sharp age asymmetries in contract substitution. They suggest that monetary incentives can facilitate transitions from temporary to permanent employment for young workers, but are less effective for workers above age 45.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105758.abstract_zh: 本文研究了降低永久合同与临时合同之间的成本差异如何影响企业对各类合同的使用。我们分析了1997年西班牙的一项改革，该改革降低了30岁以下及45岁以上新签无固定期限（OE）合同的非工资劳动力成本，而短期（ST）合同则未受影响。利用行业暴露程度和基于年龄的断点，我们表明，对于年轻工人，企业会显著从ST合同转向OE合同，但对年长工人的反应则较小。我们发现补贴对直接受影响的永久性工作岗位存在部分工资传导效应。对于30岁以下的工人，ST与OE合同之间的替代弹性估计为6.5，而对于45岁以上的工人，该弹性接近于零。我们还记录了年轻工人在未获补贴的ST岗位中工资上升的现象，这与OE就业扩张增强了他们的外部选择权相一致。总体而言，研究结果揭示了合同替代中显著的年龄不对称性。这表明，货币激励可以促进年轻工人从临时就业转向永久就业，但对于45岁以上的工人效果则较为有限。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105758.title: Escaping temporary traps? Evidence from age-based incentives to permanent employment
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105758.title_zh: 摆脱临时陷阱？基于年龄的永久就业激励证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105759.abstract: Can digital technologies improve the efficiency of social safety net programs? This paper examines the impact of digitizing payments in the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) on participant outcomes. We hand-collect the rollout schedule of payment digitization and link it to WIC participation and birth outcomes across multiple datasets. We find that WIC participation increases and birth outcomes improve among mothers exposed to digitization. Suggestive evidence indicates that payment digitization raises WIC participation by increasing awareness of the program and reducing stigma at the point of purchase, and that higher participation may, in turn, improve birth outcomes by increasing health insurance enrollment. Our back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that payment digitization is fiscally appealing, with a marginal value of public funds of 0.94. These findings can inform evaluations of further digitization in safety net programs, such as online redemption.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105759.abstract_zh: 数字技术能否提升社会安全网项目的效率？本文考察了妇女、婴儿及儿童特别补充营养计划（WIC）中支付数字化的影响及其对参与者结果的作用。我们手工收集了支付数字化的推广时间表，并将其与多个数据集中的WIC参与情况及出生结果相关联。研究发现，接触数字化的母亲中，WIC参与率上升，出生结果得到改善。初步证据表明，支付数字化通过提高项目认知度和减少购买时的污名效应来增加WIC参与，而更高的参与率可能进而通过增加健康保险注册来改善出生结果。我们的粗略估算显示，支付数字化在财政上具有吸引力，公共资金的边际价值为0.94。这些发现可为评估安全网项目中进一步数字化（如在线兑换）提供参考。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105759.title: Safety net payment digitization and participant outcomes: Evidence from the WIC EBT transition
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105759.title_zh: 安全网支付数字化与参与者结果：来自WIC EBT转型的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105761.abstract: Can electoral outcomes shape voters’ perceptions of the past? Election results can provide informational cues that prompt voters to reinterpret prior conditions, shifting the benchmarks on which accountability rests. We examine this through perceptions of crime, a valence issue relevant to any candidate. We compare respondents interviewed just before and after local elections in Chile, across municipalities where a right-wing mayor narrowly won versus lost. Individuals surveyed shortly after a narrow right-wing victory are more likely to report that crime has increased, even though self-reported victimization remains unchanged. Our findings suggest that accountability itself becomes endogenous to electoral results.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105761.abstract_zh: 选举结果能否塑造选民对过去的认知？选举结果可以提供信息线索，促使选民重新解读先前状况，从而改变问责所依赖的基准。我们通过犯罪感知这一与任何候选人都相关的价值议题来考察此问题。我们比较了智利地方选举前后受访者的回答，涵盖右翼市长以微弱优势获胜与落败的市镇。在右翼以微弱优势获胜后不久接受调查的个体，更倾向于报告犯罪率上升，尽管自我报告的受害经历并未改变。我们的发现表明，问责本身对选举结果具有内生性。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105761.title: Electoral results affect beliefs about the past: Evidence from Chile
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105761.title_zh: 选举结果影响对过去的认知：来自智利的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105762.abstract: Over the past decade, India’s BJP-led national government has undertaken various reforms to welfare programs, aiming to reduce the scope for local officials to manipulate beneficiary selection or divert funds. Nevertheless state and local governments retained considerable discretion over beneficiary selection and the local delivery of central government funded welfare benefits, and have maintained exclusive control over state-funded programs. We use longitudinal household survey data from the state of West Bengal to evaluate the effects of these reforms on pro-poor targeting of welfare programs, and political competition between the BJP and the TMC, the incumbent political party in the state. We find that welfare programs were better targeted toward poorer and socially disadvantaged households in the period 2014–2018 than in 2010–2013. However the welfare reforms do not explain why the BJP’s vote share increased, as its electoral gains from the new nationwide programs were outweighed by their losses, stemming from the increased support for the TMC from recipients of new state and pre-existing benefits.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105762.abstract_zh: 过去十年间，印度人民党领导的全国政府推行了多项福利项目改革，旨在减少地方官员操纵受益人筛选或挪用资金的空间。尽管如此，邦及地方政府在受益人筛选和中央政府资助福利项目的地方执行方面仍保留了大量自主权，并继续独家掌控邦资助项目。我们利用西孟加拉邦的纵向家庭调查数据，评估这些改革对福利项目扶贫定向效果及印度人民党与现任邦执政党草根国大党之间政治竞争的影响。研究发现，2014至2018年间，福利项目相较于2010至2013年更精准地覆盖了贫困和社会弱势家庭。然而，福利改革并未解释印度人民党得票率上升的原因，因为其从新全国性项目中获得的选举收益被因新邦级及既有福利项目受益者增加对草根国大党的支持而造成的损失所抵消。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105762.title: Impacts of a partial welfare reform on targeting and political competition
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105762.title_zh: 部分福利改革对目标定位与政治竞争的影响

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105763.abstract: Education and corruption are negatively correlated at the cross-national level, but little is known about the causal relationship between the two. We combine newly-collected data on timing and locations of Vietnam’s national expansion of universities with detailed survey data on experiences of corruption from over 170,000 respondents in 320 districts across 12 years. Using staggered difference-in-differences, we show that cohorts exposed to the university expansion are 87% more likely to have a university education. However, this increase neither translates into fewer individuals being affected by corruption nor increases the propensity to denounce corrupt officials. Instead, we find that education increases the incidence of bribe requests and perceptions of corruption. The mechanism most consistent with our data is that higher education raises household income, and that the associated rise in the opportunity cost of time and in exposure to bribe-prone situations increases exposure to corruption.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105763.abstract_zh: 教育与腐败在国家层面呈负相关，但关于二者之间的因果关系知之甚少。我们将新收集的越南全国大学扩张时间与地点数据，与涵盖12年间320个地区超过17万名受访者的详细腐败经历调查数据相结合。采用交错双重差分法，我们发现暴露于大学扩张的队列获得大学教育的可能性高出87%。然而，这一增长既未转化为受腐败影响的个体减少，也未提高举报腐败官员的倾向。相反，我们发现教育增加了贿赂索求的发生率和腐败感知。与我们的数据最一致的机制是，高等教育提高了家庭收入，而随之而来的时间机会成本上升及暴露于易受贿赂情境的增加，加剧了腐败暴露风险。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105763.title: The effects of education on corruption: Evidence from Vietnam’s university expansion
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105763.title_zh: 教育对腐败的影响：来自越南大学扩招的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105764.abstract: We study the accuracy of wage expectations among unemployed workers by comparing subjective beliefs to benchmark and realized wages using linked survey-administrative data. On average, jobseekers overestimate their reemployment wages, with optimism concentrated among those with low earnings potential. Beliefs are anchored to past wages, and inaccuracies persist over the course of unemployment and in response to stronger search incentives. Moreover, there is an asymmetry in belief formation: individuals who are likely to experience wage losses relative to their previous job are particularly rigid in adjusting their expectations. Finally, wage optimism predicts higher reservation wages, greater search intensity, and delayed reemployment.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105764.abstract_zh: 我们利用关联的调查-行政数据，通过将主观信念与基准工资及实际实现工资进行比较，研究了失业工人对工资预期的准确性。平均而言，求职者高估了其再就业工资，这种乐观情绪主要集中在潜在收入较低的人群中。信念锚定于过去的工资水平，且这种不准确性在失业期间及面对更强的求职激励时持续存在。此外，信念形成存在不对称性：那些可能相对于先前工作经历工资下降的个体，在调整其预期时尤为僵化。最后，工资乐观情绪预示着更高的保留工资、更强的求职强度以及延迟的再就业。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105764.title: The accuracy of jobseekers’ wage expectations
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105764.title_zh: 求职者工资预期的准确性

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105765.abstract: Governments have long imposed a common language of schooling on linguistic minorities in the hope of forging a shared national identity, yet whether such mandates integrate minorities or provoke backlash remains contested. We study Quebec’s 1977 Charter of the French Language, which required younger cohorts of immigrant children to enroll in French instead of English schools. Using a difference-in-differences estimation strategy we compare cohorts required to be schooled in French with those exempted from the requirement. We find that two to four decades later, children who were required to attend French schools were more likely to adopt French as a home language and less likely to adopt English, with part of the shift away from English going to heritage languages rather than to French. These shifts in language carry over to changes in identity and political attitudes: treated cohorts are more likely to identify as Québécois or French-Canadian, less attached to Canada, and more supportive of Quebec independence. We find no robust evidence of effects on education or income, and no evidence of cultural or political backlash among those who remained in Quebec. The clearest resistance took the form of exit, as treated families were twice as likely to leave the province.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105765.abstract_zh: 政府长期以来对语言少数群体实施统一的学校教育语言，以期塑造共同的民族认同，然而，此类强制措施究竟是促进少数群体融合还是引发反弹，仍存争议。我们研究了魁北克1977年《法语宪章》，该宪章要求较年轻的移民子女群体注册法语学校而非英语学校。采用双重差分估计策略，我们将被要求接受法语教育的群体与豁免此要求的群体进行比较。研究发现，在二至四十年后，被要求就读法语学校的儿童更可能将法语作为家庭语言，而较少采用英语，其中部分从英语转向的并非法语，而是传承语言。这些语言转变进一步影响了身份认同与政治态度：受政策影响的群体更可能认同为魁北克人或法裔加拿大人，对加拿大的归属感减弱，并更支持魁北克独立。我们未发现对教育或收入有稳健影响的证据，也未发现留在魁北克的群体中出现文化或政治反弹的迹象。最明显的抵抗形式是退出，受政策影响的家庭离开该省的可能性是其他家庭的两倍。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105765.title: Language and identity: Evidence from a schooling reform
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105765.title_zh: 语言与身份认同：来自一项教育改革的证据

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105766.abstract: Should public policies address inequality due to heterogeneous life expectancy? Intuitively, taking a short life as a disadvantage, such policies should favor those with high mortality. Yet, pension systems implicitly redistribute from low-life-expectancy to high-life-expectancy people. Moreover, this direction of redistribution is optimal from the perspective of the standard utilitarian welfare criterion. We study mortality-related redistribution in a more flexible setting. We start by establishing a formal framework for the analysis by clearly distinguishing between redistribution along the mortality and income dimensions. We then characterize the conditions under which it is optimal to redistribute toward high-mortality people. One such condition is that the welfare criterion must feature an aversion to lifetime inequality that exceeds the aversion to consumption inequality.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105766.abstract_zh: 公共政策是否应解决因预期寿命异质性导致的不平等问题？直觉上，将短命视为一种劣势，此类政策应倾向于高死亡率群体。然而，养老金体系却隐性地将资源从低预期寿命者向高预期寿命者再分配。此外，从标准功利主义福利准则的角度看，这种再分配方向是最优的。我们在一个更灵活的框架下研究死亡率相关的再分配问题。首先，通过明确区分沿死亡率维度和收入维度的再分配，建立正式的分析框架。随后，我们刻画了向高死亡率群体再分配为最优的条件。其中一个条件是，福利准则必须体现出对终身不平等的厌恶程度超过对消费不平等的厌恶程度。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105766.title: Mortality regressivity and pension design
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105766.title_zh: 死亡率累退性与养老金设计

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105767.abstract: This paper studies how immigration enforcement shapes participation in safety net programs within mixed-status households. I examine the program participation responses of Hispanic citizens living with individuals facing deportation risk following the enactment of E-Verify mandates, an employment-based immigration enforcement policy targeting undocumented immigrants. Using a difference-in-differences framework, I find that E-Verify mandates reduced household income. Participation responses differ across programs—Medicaid, the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), and Supplemental Security Income (SSI). While SSI participation temporarily increased and SNAP participation remained stable, Medicaid participation declined sharply. The decline in Medicaid participation is more pronounced among groups whose household members face higher deportation risk, consistent with chilling effects limiting program take-up.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105767.abstract_zh: 本文研究了移民执法如何影响混合身份家庭中安全网项目的参与情况。我考察了在实施E-Verify强制令（一项针对无证移民的基于就业的移民执法政策）后，与面临遣返风险的个人同住的西班牙裔公民的项目参与反应。利用双重差分框架，我发现E-Verify强制令降低了家庭收入。不同项目的参与反应各异——医疗补助、补充营养援助计划（SNAP）和补充保障收入（SSI）。虽然SSI参与暂时增加且SNAP参与保持稳定，但医疗补助参与急剧下降。医疗补助参与的下降在家庭成员面临更高遣返风险的群体中更为显著，这与寒蝉效应限制项目参与的现象一致。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105767.title: Immigration enforcement and safety net participation in mixed-status households
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105767.title_zh: 移民执法与混合身份家庭中的安全网参与

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105768.abstract: We study technology investment and public good provision in a setting where two parties with differing valuations of the public good alternate in power. In each period, the incumbent chooses public good provision and invests in technology that lowers the cost of future public good provision. We characterize Markov perfect equilibria and show how polarization and irreversibility of investment jointly shape long-run outcomes. When polarization is low, power turnover may increase expected technology investment and public good provision, and steady-state outcomes are unaffected by the degree of reversibility. When polarization is high, however, irreversibility becomes important: the party favoring the public good invests more aggressively, and irreversible investment induces higher public good provision by both parties. As polarization rises, expected technology stock and public good provision initially decline but jump upward once the irreversibility constraint binds.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105768.abstract_zh: 我们研究在一个两方对公共产品估值不同的环境中，技术投资与公共产品供给的问题。每一时期，执政方选择公共产品供给，并投资于能降低未来公共产品供给成本的技术。我们刻画了马尔可夫完美均衡，并展示了极化程度与投资不可逆性如何共同塑造长期结果。当极化程度较低时，权力更迭可能增加预期的技术投资和公共产品供给，且稳态结果不受可逆性程度的影响。然而，当极化程度较高时，不可逆性变得重要：偏好公共产品的一方会更积极地进行投资，且不可逆投资促使双方提高公共产品供给。随着极化程度上升，预期的技术存量与公共产品供给起初下降，但一旦不可逆性约束生效，则会向上跳跃。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105768.title: Irreversible investment in divided times: Complementarity and public good provision
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105768.title_zh: 分裂时期的不可逆投资：互补性与公共品供给

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105770.abstract: I study how economic expectation shocks induced by elections contribute to democratic discontent in polarized societies, focusing on the 2022 Brazilian presidential election. Using newly collected survey data, I investigate how respondents’ expectations and attitudes toward democracy evolved after the opposition candidate’s narrow victory. By resurveying respondents post-election, I show that losing polarized voters who overestimate their candidate’s chances of winning experience a large negative economic expectation shock, as well as an increase in their anti-democratic sentiment. In an additional survey experiment, I provide causal evidence that this shock is a driver of democratic discontent, by showing that positively updating respondents’ economic expectations reduces their anti-democratic sentiment.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105770.abstract_zh: 我研究了选举引发的经济预期冲击如何在极化社会中加剧民主不满，并以2022年巴西总统选举为焦点。利用新收集的调查数据，我探讨了在反对派候选人以微弱优势获胜后，受访者的经济预期及对民主的态度如何演变。通过对受访者进行选举后再次调查，我发现，那些高估其候选人获胜概率的落败方极化选民，经历了显著负面的经济预期冲击，同时其反民主情绪也有所上升。在一项额外的调查实验中，我提供了因果证据，表明这种冲击是民主不满的一个驱动因素，具体表现为，正向更新受访者的经济预期可降低其反民主情绪。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105770.title: Election results and democratic discontent: Expectations, extremism, and democratic values in post-election Brazil
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105770.title_zh: 选举结果与民主不满：巴西大选后的期望、极端主义与民主价值观

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105772.abstract: As shortages of essential resources become more frequent, high prices alone may fail to curb demand. We study power limits for residential electricity, which restrict household consumption rather than setting it to zero as in rolling blackouts. We show theoretically and empirically that power limits can deliver electricity savings equivalent to sizable blackouts while affecting fewer households. The mechanism works through selection of high users, creating distributional trade-offs that depend on whether limits are uniform or proportional to contracted power. This highlights the potential of smart meters to improve shortage management while preserving access to essential electricity services.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105772.abstract_zh: 随着关键资源短缺日益频繁，仅靠高价格可能无法有效抑制需求。我们研究了居民用电的功率限制，这种限制约束家庭消费，而非像轮流停电那样将消费降至零。我们从理论和实证两方面证明，功率限制能够实现相当于大规模停电的节电效果，同时影响到的家庭数量更少。其机制在于对高用电量用户的选择性作用，这产生了分配上的权衡，取决于限制是统一设定还是按合同功率比例设定。这凸显了智能电表在改善短缺管理的同时，保障基本电力服务可及性的潜力。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105772.title: Smart power limits: Designing shortage mechanisms for extreme events
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105772.title_zh: 智能电力限制：极端事件下的短缺机制设计

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105773.abstract: Couples can face higher taxes when filing as married rather than unmarried. These marriage penalties may motivate newlyweds to delay reporting their marriage on U.S. tax returns. Linking Minnesota marriage records to federal tax returns, we show that marriage penalties are correlated with delayed marriage reporting. Over 2 % of newlyweds misreport their marital status. Misreporting rates increase to 14 % when marriage penalties reach $8000. Misreporting and large marriage penalties are more prevalent among similar-earning couples and EITC claimants. Misreporting couples’ behavior appears responsive to incentive changes, often correcting their filing status when marriage penalties become bonuses.
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105773.abstract_zh: 夫妻在已婚而非未婚状态下申报纳税时，可能面临更高的税负。这种婚姻惩罚可能促使新婚夫妇推迟在美国纳税申报中报告其婚姻状况。通过将明尼苏达州的婚姻记录与联邦纳税申报表相关联，我们发现婚姻惩罚与延迟报告婚姻状况之间存在相关性。超过2%的新婚夫妇虚报其婚姻状态。当婚姻惩罚达到8000美元时，虚报率上升至14%。虚报行为及高额婚姻惩罚在收入相近的夫妇和劳动所得税抵免（EITC）申领者中更为普遍。虚报夫妇的行为似乎对激励变化反应敏感，当婚姻惩罚转为婚姻奖励时，他们往往纠正其申报状态。
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105773.title: Do marriage tax penalties cause delayed marriage reporting?
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105773.title_zh: 婚姻税收惩罚是否导致延迟婚姻申报？

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105776.title: Corrigendum to “The effects of education on corruption: Evidence from Vietnam’s university expansion” [J. Public Econ. 262 (2026) 105763]
10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105776.title_zh: 更正启事：“教育对腐败的影响：来自越南大学扩招的证据” [J. Public Econ. 262 (2026) 105763]

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103860.abstract: This paper investigates how Asian immigrants affect U.S. housing prices and identifies the mechanisms underlying these effects. Using annual county-level data from 2009 to 2018 and a dual instrumental variable approach, we decompose the overall impact of Asian immigrants into education-related and non-education channels. We find that roughly 30%–40% of the housing price increase associated with Asian immigration is driven by the capitalization of improved educational amenities, while the remaining 60%–70% reflects non-education forces, such as home-biased foreign capital inflows and other neighborhood changes. The education-related capitalization effects are greater in counties with a higher share of Asian school-aged children, underscoring the key insight that immigrant composition — specifically, who arrives — matters for how immigration shapes local housing markets.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103860.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了亚洲移民如何影响美国房价，并识别了其背后的作用机制。利用2009年至2018年的县级年度数据及双重工具变量方法，我们将亚洲移民的整体影响分解为与教育相关及非教育渠道。研究发现，亚洲移民带来的房价上涨中，约30%至40%归因于教育设施改善的资本化效应，而其余60%至70%则反映了非教育因素，如本土偏好的外国资本流入及其他社区变化。教育相关的资本化效应在亚洲学龄儿童占比更高的县更为显著，这凸显了一个关键见解：移民构成——具体而言，即谁到来——对移民如何塑造地方住房市场至关重要。

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103866.abstract: We study the evolution of housing rents in the proximity of Swiss asylum seeker hosting centers whose populations differ by ethnic composition. Rental prices within 0.7km of an active center are found on average to be 3.8% lower than in the control group. The price response is significantly more pronounced when centers host a higher share of asylum seekers from sub-Saharan Africa. In contrast, neither religious affiliation nor inferred crime propensity of the center populations are found to affect local rental prices significantly. Our findings are consistent with phenotype-based racial animus as a significant driver of observed market outcomes.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103866.abstract_zh: 我们研究了瑞士寻求庇护者收容中心附近住房租金的演变，这些中心的人口构成因族裔而异。在活跃中心0.7公里范围内的租金价格，平均比对照组低3.8%。当中心接纳的撒哈拉以南非洲寻求庇护者比例较高时，价格反应显著更为明显。相比之下，中心人口的宗教信仰或推断的犯罪倾向均未对当地租金价格产生显著影响。我们的研究结果与基于表型的种族敌意作为观察到的市场结果的重要驱动因素相一致。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103866.title: Price and prejudice: Housing rents reveal racial animus
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103866.title_zh: 价格与偏见：住房租金揭示种族敌意

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103867.abstract: We investigate the impacts of industrial parks on economic growth, living standards, and women’s empowerment in Ethiopia. Exploiting the staggered openings of parks across districts and combining satellite imagery with detailed survey data, we document several key findings. First, the establishment of an industrial park leads to sizable gains in local economic activity and urbanization. However, these effects remain spatially concentrated, with little evidence of spillovers into nearby districts. Second, parks situated in areas with stronger market access, larger labor pools, and better transport connectivity generate substantially larger impacts, underscoring the importance of location fundamentals. Third, the arrival of a park improves local living standards and raises employment rates — particularly among women — reflecting the parks’ predominant focus on female-labor-intensive industries. This shift enhances women’s decision-making power and reduces their acceptance of domestic violence, suggesting meaningful progress toward female empowerment.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103867.abstract_zh: 我们研究了工业园区对埃塞俄比亚经济增长、生活水平及女性赋权的影响。利用各区工业园区分阶段设立的情况，结合卫星影像与详细调查数据，我们记录了若干关键发现。首先，工业园区的建立显著促进了当地经济活动与城市化进程。然而，这些效应在空间上高度集中，几乎没有证据表明存在向邻近地区的溢出效应。其次，位于市场准入更佳、劳动力规模更大及交通连接更优区域的工业园区，其影响显著更大，凸显了区位基础条件的重要性。第三，工业园区的到来改善了当地生活水平并提高了就业率——尤其是女性就业率——这反映了园区主要集中于女性劳动密集型产业的特点。这一转变增强了女性的决策权，并减少了她们对家庭暴力的接受度，表明在女性赋权方面取得了实质性进展。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103867.title: The socioeconomic impacts of industrial parks in Ethiopia
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103867.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚工业园区的社会经济影响

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103868.abstract: We assess how minimum wage effects on restaurant employment in the U.S. vary with market size and monopsony power. Using city-level data, we construct monopsony proxies based on labor flows and concentration. Minimum wages bind less in larger cities, consistent with the urban wage premium, and omitting this relationship overstates how labor market power reduces adverse employment effects of minimum wages. Nonetheless, accounting for size, lower labor market fluidity is linked to weaker employment effects, consistent with search models. By contrast, concentration-based proxies are less informative in this setting: employer-density measures move opposite to theory, while HHI exhibits insufficient variation.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103868.abstract_zh: 我们评估了美国最低工资对餐饮业就业的影响如何随市场规模和买方垄断力量而变化。利用城市层面的数据，我们基于劳动力流动和集中度构建了买方垄断代理指标。最低工资在大城市中的约束力较弱，这与城市工资溢价一致，而忽略这一关系会高估劳动力市场力量对最低工资不利就业效应的缓解作用。尽管如此，在考虑规模因素后，较低的劳动力市场流动性仍与较弱的就业效应相关联，这与搜寻模型相符。相比之下，基于集中度的代理指标在此情境中信息量有限：雇主密度指标的变化方向与理论相反，而赫芬达尔指数则表现出不足的变异性。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103868.title: JUE insight: City size, monopsony, and the employment effects of minimum wages
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103868.title_zh: JUE洞察：城市规模、买方垄断与最低工资的就业效应

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103869.abstract: We study whether restaurants in more visible urban locations receive different customer ratings, consistent with consumer-search models in which prominence interacts with search frictions. Using 1.5 million Yelp reviews of 61,000 restaurants in 18 cities across eight countries, we relate ratings to three location-based proxies for prominence: proximity to tourist landmarks, street corners, and public squares. Across specifications with rich controls and user-city fixed effects, restaurants in more prominent locations receive lower ratings. The results are robust to comparing nearby establishments and to checks addressing selection, crowding, and measurement, and we interpret them as consistent with a worse price–quality mix in prominent locations when continued search is costly.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103869.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了位于更显眼城市地段的餐厅是否获得不同的顾客评分，这与消费者搜索模型中显眼性与搜索摩擦相互作用的理论相符。基于八个国家18个城市中61,000家餐厅的150万条Yelp评论，我们将评分与三个基于位置的显眼性代理指标相关联：靠近旅游地标、街角和公共广场。在包含丰富控制变量和用户-城市固定效应的多种规格中，位于更显眼位置的餐厅评分较低。这些结果在比较邻近场所及处理选择、拥挤和测量问题的检验中依然稳健，我们将其解释为与显眼位置在持续搜索成本高昂时提供较差价格-质量组合的现象一致。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103869.title: Disappointment looms around the corner: Visibility and businesses’ local market power
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103869.title_zh: 失望近在咫尺：可见性与企业的本地市场势力

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103870.abstract: The fracking revolution has exposed more than 15 million American residents to drilling within 3 miles, a tripling from conventional extraction methods. While the economic benefits are distributed across nearby counties, the environmental and neighborhood costs are concentrated within miles of a well. Using granular data on exposure and outcomes, I show that nearby fracking activity shrinks neighborhood population by 5%. The spatial decay, temporal pattern, and mechanisms of this treatment effect operate to debunk the stylized argument that fracking creates local boom towns.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103870.abstract_zh: 水力压裂革命已使超过1500万美国居民暴露于3英里范围内的钻井活动，这一数字是传统开采方法的三倍。尽管经济效益分布于邻近各县，环境和社区成本却集中在油井数英里之内。利用关于暴露程度和结果的精细数据，我表明附近的压裂活动使社区人口缩减了5%。这一处理效应的空间衰减、时间模式及其作用机制，共同驳斥了压裂创造地方繁荣城镇的典型论点。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103870.title: Fracking ghost towns: How neighborhood exposure drives population decline
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103870.title_zh: 压裂幽灵城镇：社区暴露如何驱动人口下降

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103871.abstract: We use high-resolution spatial data to build a novel global annual gridded GDP dataset at 1°, 0.5°, and 0.25°resolutions from 2012 onwards. Our random forest model trained on local and national GDP achieves an R 2 above 0.94 for GDP levels and above 0.73 for annual changes in regions left out of the training sample. By incorporating diverse indicators beyond population and nighttime lights, our estimates offer more precise subnational GDP measurements for analyzing economic shocks, local policies, and regional disparities. We evaluate the precision of using a case study of COVID-19’s impact on local GDP in China.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103871.abstract_zh: 我们利用高分辨率空间数据，构建了一套自2012年起覆盖全球、分辨率分别为1°、0.5°和0.25°的新型年度网格化GDP数据集。我们的随机森林模型在本地及国家GDP训练下，对GDP水平的R²超过0.94，对训练样本外区域的年度变化R²超过0.73。通过纳入除人口和夜间灯光之外的多样化指标，我们的估算提供了更精确的次国家级GDP测量，适用于分析经济冲击、地方政策及区域差异。我们以COVID-19对中国地方GDP影响为例，评估了该数据的精确性。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103871.title: Local GDP estimates around the world

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103872.abstract: We estimate the effect of local regulatory approval times on housing production. The analysis derives from a novel dataset of development timelines for all multifamily housing projects permitted by the City of Los Angeles between 2010 and 2022. Results indicate that a 25 percent reduction in approval times would have increased the rate of housing production in Los Angeles between 2010 and 2022 by 12.7 percent, simply by pulling forward in time the completion of projects already begun. The production gains are even larger upon accounting for the role of approval times in incentivizing new development. Discretionary approvals are shown to be especially salient to development timelines. The estimated impacts on development are also shown to be heterogeneous across project type and space, and correlated with neighborhood socioeconomic status. Results underscore the importance of municipal regulatory reform to the achievement of housing production goals.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103872.abstract_zh: 我们估算了地方审批时间对住房建设的影响。分析基于一项新颖的数据集，涵盖了2010年至2022年间洛杉矶市批准的所有多户住宅项目的发展时间线。结果表明，审批时间缩短25%，仅通过提前完成已启动项目的时间，就能使洛杉矶在2010年至2022年间的住房建设率提高12.7%。在考虑审批时间对激励新开发项目的作用后，生产收益更为显著。自由裁量审批对发展时间线的影响尤为突出。估计对开发的影响在项目类型和空间上表现出异质性，并与社区社会经济状况相关。研究结果强调了市政监管改革对于实现住房建设目标的重要性。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103872.title: Development approval times and new housing supply: Evidence from Los Angeles
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103872.title_zh: 开发审批时间与新房供给：来自洛杉矶的证据

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103882.abstract: We estimate the causal effect of ride-hailing entry on transport-related air pollution, disentangling its mediating effect through changes in commuting modes in U.S. cities. To do so, we combine two sets of empirical approaches. First, for our main outcome regression, we leverage granular satellite-based NO2 concentration data and a newly constructed Google Trends-based measure of ride-hailing presence, with the staggered difference-in-differences design. Second, to explore its mediating mechanism, we use household-level commuting mode data to run two auxiliary regressions: commuting modes on ride-hailing entry and ambient NO2 concentration on commuting modes. For identification on the latter, we construct our instruments by combining geography-based instruments with leave-one-out regional average exposure to Uber’s official entry. We find robust evidence that (i) ride-hailing improves air quality in highly dense cities, but has no significant impact in cities with low to medium density and (ii) this air quality improvement is indeed mediated by the associated changes in commuting mode choices. Our findings provide strong empirical support for the hypothesis that the environmental impact of ride-hailing depends on its complementarity with public transit.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103882.abstract_zh: 我们估算了网约车进入对交通相关空气污染的因果效应，并分解了其通过美国城市通勤方式变化产生的中介效应。为此，我们结合了两套实证方法。首先，对于主要结果回归，我们利用基于卫星的高分辨率二氧化氮浓度数据和新构建的基于谷歌趋势的网约车存在度指标，采用交错双重差分设计。其次，为探究其中介机制，我们使用家庭层面的通勤方式数据进行了两项辅助回归：通勤方式对网约车进入的回归，以及环境二氧化氮浓度对通勤方式的回归。为识别后者，我们通过结合基于地理的工具变量与留一法区域平均优步官方进入暴露度来构建工具变量。我们发现了稳健的证据表明：（i）网约车改善了高密度城市的空气质量，但对低至中等密度城市无显著影响；（ii）这种空气质量改善确实由相关的通勤方式选择变化所中介。我们的发现为以下假设提供了强有力的实证支持：网约车的环境影响取决于其与公共交通的互补性。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103882.title: Is ride-sharing good for environment? Evidence from combining satellite and survey data on U.S. cities
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103882.title_zh: 拼车对环境有益吗？基于美国城市卫星与调查数据的证据

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103883.abstract: This paper investigates the agglomeration spillovers from the beet sugar industry, which was supported by the U.S. government as an industrial policy to encourage rural development during the early twentieth century. To estimate the effects of plant openings, I identify suitable locations for beet sugar plants from a historical trade journal and find that these plant openings had large and long-lasting effects on population and manufacturing activities over one hundred years. The local jobs multiplier was significantly larger in less populated areas, suggesting that low congestion in sparsely settled regions enabled a sizeable impact. The agglomeration spillovers benefited industries not only directly linked through input–output linkages but also extended to broader, less related industries outside the production chain of agricultural processing.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103883.abstract_zh: 本文考察了甜菜制糖业的集聚溢出效应，该产业在二十世纪初作为美国政府鼓励农村发展的产业政策而受到支持。为估计工厂设立的影响，我从历史贸易期刊中识别出适合建立甜菜制糖厂的地点，并发现这些工厂的设立对人口和制造业活动产生了持续逾百年的显著且长久的影响。在人口较少的地区，本地就业乘数明显更大，这表明稀疏定居地区的低拥挤程度使得影响得以显著扩大。集聚溢出不仅惠及通过投入产出关联直接相连的产业，还延伸至农业生产链之外更广泛、关联度较低的产业。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103883.title: Industrial spillovers from agricultural processing: Evidence from the beet sugar industry
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103883.title_zh: 农业加工产业的工业溢出效应：来自甜菜制糖业的证据

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103884.abstract: How do changing shopping habits shape cities? We investigate this question in the context of major shop closures. Leveraging geocoded crime and economic data at the level of small areas covering England and Wales, we examine the effects of these closures on criminal activity and urban dynamics. Our findings reveal that closures lead to significant increases in crime. These effects survive a battery of robustness checks and are highly localised. We also find evidence for wider changes to urban areas triggered by the closures. Our results highlight broader implications for declining inner-city areas and the “death of the high street”.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103884.abstract_zh: 不断变化的购物习惯如何塑造城市？我们以大型商店关闭为背景探讨这一问题。利用覆盖英格兰和威尔士的小区域地理编码犯罪与经济数据，我们考察了这些关闭对犯罪活动和城市动态的影响。研究发现，商店关闭导致犯罪显著增加。这些效应在多项稳健性检验中依然存在，且具有高度局部性。我们还发现了关闭引发城市区域更广泛变化的证据。我们的结果凸显了内城区衰退及“高街之死”的更广泛影响。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103884.title: The death of the “High Street”? Main street closures, social disorder and urban change
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103884.title_zh: 高街”之死？主街关闭、社会失序与城市变迁

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103885.abstract: Flattening government hierarchies not only reduces organizational layers but also restructures fiscal capacity, reshaping both local growth incentives and regional redistribution. This paper identifies a fundamental trade-off: while flattening promotes equalization across regions, it simultaneously undermines economic efficiency at the local level. We develop a multi-tier government model showing that reallocating fiscal authority upward enlarges common revenue pools, which enhance redistribution but dilute local governments’ incentives to foster growth. Empirically, we exploit China’s staggered Province-Managing-County (PMC) reform as a quasi-natural experiment and apply a stacked difference-in-differences strategy to county-level panel data from 2000 to 2007. We find that the PMC reform significantly reduced intra-provincial inequality—measured by Gini, Theil, and related indices—but concurrently lowered county GDP per capita. Reductions in physical investment and firm-level productivity, rather than shifts in labor input, drove the efficiency loss. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that provinces with stronger fiscal pooling (higher VAT-sharing ratios) and broader administrative spans experienced a more severe equalization–efficiency trade-off. Our findings extend fiscal federalism and organizational structure theories by showing how hierarchy flattening and fiscal pooling jointly shape the balance between redistribution and local economic performance.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103885.abstract_zh: 扁平化政府层级不仅减少了组织层级，还重构了财政能力，从而重塑了地方增长激励与区域再分配格局。本文揭示了一个根本性的权衡：扁平化在促进区域间均等化的同时，也削弱了地方层面的经济效率。我们构建了一个多层政府模型，表明将财政权力向上重新配置会扩大共同收入池，这增强了再分配效应，但稀释了地方政府促进增长的激励。在实证方面，我们利用中国分阶段推行的“省直管县”（PMC）改革作为准自然实验，并采用堆叠双重差分策略分析2000至2007年的县级面板数据。研究发现，PMC改革显著降低了省内不平等——以基尼系数、泰尔指数及相关指标衡量——但同时降低了县级人均GDP。效率损失主要源于物质投资和企业层面生产率的下降，而非劳动力投入的变化。异质性分析表明，财政统筹程度更强（增值税分享比例更高）和行政管辖范围更广的省份，其均等化—效率权衡更为严峻。我们的研究拓展了财政联邦主义和组织结构理论，揭示了层级扁平化与财政统筹如何共同塑造再分配与地方经济绩效之间的平衡。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103885.title: Flattening governments, flattening growth: Equalization–efficiency trade-off in jurisdictional reform
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103885.title_zh: 扁平化政府，扁平化增长：辖区改革中的均等化与效率权衡

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103886.abstract: We revisit the evolution of the relationship between mortgage debt and income, adding to the growing literature that extends beyond the 2000s housing boom. Our analysis reveals a permanent decline in the correlation between purchase mortgage amounts and borrower incomes that occurred in the 1990s and was largely complete before the 2000s housing boom. We attribute the decline in the debt–income correlation to a transition in underwriting practices, as lenders moved from human judgment to data-driven statistical models of mortgage default that better identified risky borrowers and enabled broader access to mortgage credit. Using a simple model, we show that patterns observed in the 1990s, including slow price growth and large increases in homeownership, are consistent with a substantial expansion of credit to lower-income households.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103886.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了抵押贷款债务与收入之间关系的演变，为超越2000年代房地产繁荣的日益增长的研究文献增添了新内容。我们的分析揭示，购房贷款金额与借款人收入之间的相关性在1990年代出现了永久性下降，且这一下降在2000年代房地产繁荣之前已基本完成。我们将债务-收入相关性的下降归因于承保实践的转变，即贷款机构从人工判断转向基于数据的统计模型来预测抵押贷款违约，这些模型能更准确地识别高风险借款人，并促进了更广泛的抵押贷款信贷获取。通过一个简单模型，我们展示了1990年代观察到的模式，包括价格增长缓慢和住房拥有率大幅上升，与向低收入家庭大幅扩大信贷的情况相一致。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103886.title: JUE Insight: Technological innovation in mortgage underwriting and the growth in credit: 1985–2015
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103886.title_zh: JUE洞察：抵押贷款承销中的技术创新与信贷增长：1985–2015

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103887.abstract: Since 2015, French municipalities facing high housing market pressures have been allowed to levy a surcharge on the housing tax applied to second homes. Using a synthetic difference-in-differences design, we find a substantial decline in the declared number of second homes and a significant increase in housing tax revenues in treated municipalities, but no evidence of a decrease in housing prices. Drawing on dwelling-level transition microdata, we show that most of the apparent reduction in second homes is driven by strategic reclassification for tax purposes rather than genuine changes in occupancy.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103887.abstract_zh: 自2015年起，面对高住房市场压力的法国市镇被允许对第二套住房征收住房税附加费。采用合成双重差分设计，我们发现受处理市镇中申报的第二套住房数量显著下降，住房税收收入显著增加，但未发现房价下降的证据。基于住宅层面的转换微观数据，我们表明第二套住房表面上的减少大部分源于出于税收目的的策略性重新分类，而非实际居住状况的改变。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103887.title: Quantity, price, and compliance effects of a second-home taxation reform in France
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103887.title_zh: 法国第二住宅税收改革的数量、价格与合规效应

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103888.abstract: Using data on millions of individual for-sale home listings, we estimate that new seller entrants cause an immediate reduction in their competitors’ probability of selling, suggesting significant search congestion externalities. Competitor prices, however, are much less responsive. Our estimates imply that shocks to the for-sale supply — such as the recent sharp decline in new listings due to mortgage lock-in — play a limited role in explaining short-run house price fluctuations. We also show evidence of buyers directing their search by time on market, as new listings compete for buyers more intensively with each other than with older listings.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103888.abstract_zh: 利用数百万条个人待售房源挂牌数据，我们估计新卖家进入市场会立即降低其竞争对手的售出概率，这表明存在显著的搜索拥挤外部性。然而，竞争对手的价格反应则相对较弱。我们的估计表明，待售供给冲击——例如近期因抵押贷款锁定效应导致的新挂牌房源急剧减少——在解释短期房价波动方面作用有限。我们还提供了证据，显示买家会根据房源在市场上的时间长短来引导其搜索，新挂牌房源彼此之间的竞争比与较旧房源的竞争更为激烈。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103888.title: Housing market congestion: The effects of new for-sale supply on home prices and sale hazards
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103888.title_zh: 住房市场拥堵：新增待售房源对房价与销售风险的影响

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103889.abstract: Rapid Re-Housing (RRH) programs provide short-term rental subsidies to help people experiencing homelessness secure market-rate housing. Using linked administrative data from Los Angeles County, we examine the causal effects of RRH on subsequent homelessness, as well as health, crime, public assistance, and labor market outcomes. We compare the outcomes of individuals and families who enrolled in an RRH program and received the subsidy (that is, leased up) to otherwise similar people who enrolled in the same RRH program in the same month but did not lease up. Participants who leased up received an average subsidy of $1500 per month for seven months, with families receiving more generous subsidies than individuals. Leasing up reduced homeless service use over four years by 30% for individuals and 25% for families, including reductions after the end of the subsidy period for both groups. Effects persisted for families, but faded out for individuals after three years. Likewise, leasing up improved health and criminal justice outcomes and increased income from public assistance programs for families, but not individuals. We find no evidence that leasing up reduced employment or earnings for either group based on statewide administrative data. The results indicate that short-term rental subsidies can meaningfully reduce homelessness, especially for families.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103889.abstract_zh: 快速重新安置（RRH）项目提供短期租金补贴，以帮助无家可归者获得市场价住房。利用洛杉矶县的关联行政数据，我们考察了RRH对后续无家可归状况以及健康、犯罪、公共援助和劳动力市场结果的因果效应。我们将参与RRH项目并领取补贴（即成功租赁）的个人和家庭，与在同一月份参与同一RRH项目但未成功租赁的相似人群进行了比较。成功租赁的参与者平均每月获得1500美元的补贴，持续七个月，其中家庭获得的补贴比个人更为慷慨。成功租赁使四年内无家可归服务使用率在个人中降低30%，在家庭中降低25%，且两组在补贴期结束后仍呈现下降趋势。对家庭而言，效应持续存在，但对个人而言，三年后效应逐渐消退。同样，成功租赁改善了家庭的健康与刑事司法结果，并增加了来自公共援助计划的收入，但对个人无此影响。基于全州行政数据，我们未发现成功租赁对任一组的就业或收入产生负面影响的证据。结果表明，短期租金补贴能够显著减少无家可归现象，尤其是对家庭而言。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103889.title: Does Rapid Re-Housing reduce homelessness?
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103889.title_zh: 快速安置住房能否减少无家可归现象？

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103890.abstract: Academic collaboration is a key driver of innovation. Using international journal publication data, this study examines how transfers of university presidents among 111 prestigious public universities in China affect inter-university academic collaboration. Based on PPML estimates, we find that appointing a president to a university who has previously studied or worked at another university leads to an approximately 10% increase in the quantity of collaboration between the two institutions during the president’s period in office at the receiving university. In contrast, comparable transfers of university party secretaries do not generate such effects. The impact of presidential transfers is stronger for collaboration within the president’s own field of study, for university pairs that are geographically more distant, and for presidents who face stronger promotion incentives. In addition, presidential transfers stimulate collaboration regardless of whether the president’s current university or the connected university is listed as the first affiliation on a publication.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103890.abstract_zh: 学术合作是创新的关键驱动力。本研究利用国际期刊发表数据，考察了中国111所重点公立大学校长流动对校际学术合作的影响。基于PPML估计，我们发现，任命一位曾在其他大学学习或工作的校长，在其任职期间，两校间的合作数量大约增加10%。相比之下，类似的大学党委书记调动并未产生此类效应。校长流动的影响在校长自身研究领域内的合作中更为显著，对于地理距离更远的大学配对以及面临更强晋升激励的校长而言，效果更为突出。此外，无论校长当前所在大学还是关联大学是否被列为论文的第一署名单位，校长流动均能促进合作。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103890.title: Greasing the wheels of collaboration: Evidence from transfers of university presidents in China
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103890.title_zh: 润滑协作之轮：来自中国大学校长调任的证据

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103891.abstract: Many communities in the U.S. have programs that make financial assistance available to families with low incomes who are struggling to pay rent. In this paper, we examine the average and distributional impacts of reducing wait times for emergency housing assistance on evictions. Taking advantage of administrative data from Franklin County, Ohio and exploiting exogenous changes in application processing times in two complementary empirical approaches, we find that each additional week of delay in receiving assistance increases the probability of an eviction filing within 12 months by 19–29%. A substantial share of the additional filings result in judgments against tenants. Our results have important implications for the design and implementation of emergency rental assistance programs. More broadly, our findings speak to the downstream impacts of passive compliance costs in social safety net programs.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103891.abstract_zh: 美国许多社区设有项目，为难以支付租金的低收入家庭提供经济援助。本文研究了缩短紧急住房援助等待时间对驱逐事件的平均影响及分布效应。利用俄亥俄州富兰克林县的行政数据，并借助两种互补实证方法中申请处理时间的外生变化，我们发现：援助每延迟一周，12个月内收到驱逐申请的概率将增加19%至29%。这些额外申请中有相当比例最终导致对租户不利的判决。我们的研究结果对紧急租金援助项目的设计与实施具有重要启示。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了社会安全网项目中被动合规成本的后续影响。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103891.title: Can rapid rental assistance avert evictions? Evidence from administrative delays
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103891.title_zh: 快速租金援助能否避免驱逐？来自行政延迟的证据

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103892.abstract: Does gentrification spread along intercity transport connections? We study the 2017 French high-speed rail (HSR) extensions from Paris to Bordeaux and Rennes. We build a model where HSR reduces the cost of accessing a primary city from a secondary one, enabling skilled workers to enjoy the primary city’s labor market while living in the more affordable secondary city. This induces migration from the primary to the secondary city, raising housing prices there. Empirically, the HSR connection raised housing prices in Bordeaux and Rennes by 12%, central-neighborhood median income by 2%, and within-neighborhood inequality by 2%. Near Montparnasse, the connecting Paris terminal, prices fell 4% relative to the rest of Paris.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103892.abstract_zh: 绅士化是否会沿着城际交通连接扩散？我们研究了2017年法国高速铁路（HSR）从巴黎延伸至波尔多和雷恩的案例。我们构建了一个模型，其中高速铁路降低了从次级城市进入主要城市的成本，使得技能型工人能够在享受主要城市劳动力市场的同时，居住在更为负担得起的次级城市。这引发了从主要城市向次级城市的迁移，从而推高了次级城市的住房价格。实证结果显示，高速铁路连接使波尔多和雷恩的住房价格上涨了12%，中心街区收入中位数上升了2%，街区内不平等程度增加了2%。在巴黎连接终点站蒙帕纳斯附近，房价相对于巴黎其他地区下降了4%。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103892.title: Second-hand gentrification: Theory and evidence from high-speed rail extensions
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103892.title_zh: 二手绅士化：高铁延伸的理论与实证

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103901.abstract: The holdout problem presents a pervasive challenge in situations that require the assembly of independently controlled assets, where due to complementarity the combined whole is worth more than the sum of its parts. One avenue for addressing holdout problems involves contingent contracts, where agreements are conditional upon reaching a predetermined threshold. This paper reports an experiment to investigate a new refund bonus contingent mechanism, in which asset owners who agree to participate (e.g., sell their asset) receive a bonus payment if the required threshold for project success is not met. The refund bonus eliminates failure equilibria and improves the frequency of successfully reaching the threshold in the symmetric mixed strategy equilibrium. In the experiment, individual asset holders choose each round whether to accept an offer to sell. Multiple owners must accept for the (contingent) sale to materialize, and holdout owners who do not sell can earn more, so the game has the strategic incentives of a volunteer’s dilemma. The data show that the bonus mechanism increases agreements to sell, the frequency of successful projects, and efficiency. By the second half of the experimental sessions, the total number of sales is 35 percent higher and the threshold is met nearly twice as often with the bonus than without.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103901.abstract_zh: 搁置问题在需要整合独立控制资产的场景中普遍存在，由于互补性，整体价值超过各部分之和。解决搁置问题的一个途径是采用条件合同，即协议以达成预定门槛为条件。本文通过实验研究了一种新的退款奖金条件机制，在该机制中，同意参与（如出售其资产）的资产所有者，若项目成功所需门槛未达成，将获得一笔奖金支付。退款奖金消除了失败均衡，并在对称混合策略均衡中提高了成功达到门槛的频率。实验中，个体资产持有者每轮选择是否接受出售要约。多个所有者必须接受才能使（条件）销售实现，而未出售的搁置所有者能获得更多收益，因此该博弈具有志愿者困境的战略激励。数据显示，奖金机制增加了出售协议的数量、成功项目的频率及效率。在实验后半段，有奖金时的总销售数量比无奖金时高出35%，达到门槛的频率几乎是后者的两倍。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103901.title: JUE Insight: Breaking ground: Can refund bonuses solve the holdout problem?
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103901.title_zh: 洞察专栏：破土动工：退款奖金能否解决“钉子户”问题？

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103902.abstract: The idea that people want to go to where the jobs are is intuitive, yet is absent from the standard quantitative spatial modelling approach in which location choices are guided by prices, without reference to quantities (the number of jobs in a place). The purpose of this paper is to fill this gap by making jobs, as well as places, the objects of household choice. This involves minor change to the modelling approach used in the literature and provides a simple description of labour market matching. Similar modification of the modelling of firms’ location choices captures the idea that these are shaped by both wage costs and the availability of workers with appropriate skill. These modifications yield powerful agglomeration forces, as workers’ location choices become positively influenced by the number of jobs in a place, and firms’ decision are shaped by the number of workers with appropriate skills. Results are established analytically and in a regional model in which the equilibrium distributions of workers and sectors are demonstrated.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103902.abstract_zh: 人们渴望前往就业机会所在地的想法直观易懂，但在标准的定量空间建模方法中却未得到体现，该方法中，位置选择由价格引导，而不考虑数量（即某地的就业岗位数量）。本文旨在填补这一空白，将工作岗位与地点一同作为家庭选择的客体。这需要对文献中使用的建模方法进行微调，并为劳动力市场匹配提供简洁描述。类似地，对企业选址建模的调整捕捉到了这一观念：企业选址既受工资成本影响，也受具备适当技能的劳动力可得性影响。这些调整产生了强大的集聚效应，因为工人的位置选择受到某地就业岗位数量的正向影响，而企业的决策则受具备适当技能工人数量的影响。研究结果通过解析方法及一个区域模型得以确立，在该模型中展示了工人与部门的均衡分布。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103902.title: Location choice when the number of jobs matters: matching in spatial equilibrium
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103902.title_zh: 当工作数量重要时的区位选择：空间均衡中的匹配

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103903.abstract: Low-emission zones (LEZs) increase commuting costs by car but decrease negative traffic externalities in affected locations. High-income workers are more likely to sort into central locations where the benefits of the policy are expected to be the strongest, but are also more likely to commute by car. Thus, they should be more exposed to both the costs and benefits of driving restrictions. Using a quantitative urban model with rich worker heterogeneity and non-homothetic preferences, I argue that the redistributive effects of urban policies are indeed shaped by these differences in exposure and budget shares. After showing that the model is able to reproduce the patterns of sorting across space and transport modes observed in the Greater Paris region, I use it to compute the prospective effects of the Parisian LEZ. Results indicate that the policy would most likely increase welfare only at the top of the income distribution, while the rest of the population would suffer net losses.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103903.abstract_zh: 低排放区（LEZs）提高了驾车通勤成本，但减少了受影响地区的负面交通外部性。高收入工人更可能选择居住在城市中心区域，那里预期政策收益最大，但他们也更倾向于驾车通勤。因此，他们应同时面临驾驶限制带来的成本与收益。利用一个包含丰富工人异质性和非齐次偏好的定量城市模型，我认为城市政策的再分配效应确实受到这些暴露程度和预算份额差异的影响。在证明该模型能够再现大巴黎地区观察到的空间与交通方式选择模式后，我运用它来预测巴黎低排放区的潜在影响。结果表明，该政策最可能仅提高收入分配顶端群体的福利，而其余人口将遭受净损失。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103903.title: The redistributive effects of transport policies
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103903.title_zh: 交通政策的再分配效应

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103904.abstract: Cross-border housing markets have become more prevalent in Europe since the establishment of the European Union. Using data from the functional urban area of Luxembourg, we document significant floorspace price discontinuities at the borders of Luxembourg with Belgium, France, and Germany. Employing a quantitative spatial urban model and spatial regression discontinuity techniques, we show that differences in tax rates and tax importing account for 8% and 13% of the observed price jump, respectively. The remaining price discrepancy is explained by differences in productivity and amenities.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103904.abstract_zh: 自欧盟成立以来，跨境住房市场在欧洲日益普遍。利用卢森堡功能性城市区域的数据，我们记录了卢森堡与比利时、法国和德国边界处显著的楼面面积价格不连续性。通过运用定量空间城市模型和空间回归断点技术，我们表明，税率差异和税收输入分别解释了观察到的价格跳升的8%和13%。剩余的价格差异则由生产率和便利设施的差异来解释。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103904.title: Floorspace price discontinuities and taxation in cross-border commuting areas
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103904.title_zh: 跨境通勤区域楼面价格不连续性与税收问题

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103905.abstract: This paper studies how improvements in local accessibility influence cities’ distributions of nontradable amenities, housing costs and welfare. I build a model of local demand for these amenities, which depends on travel times and costs. Ridesharing’s entry shocks these times and costs. Three years after entry, amenities grow faster in areas which are driving-accessible and transit-inaccessible. In these locations, house prices and rents rise by 7% and 2% after three years, respectively. Taken together, the improvements in amenities and access outpace the rising housing costs. All residents benefit from ridesharing; yet, owners gain 24% more than renters on average, as they capture equity gains from rising house prices while renters face higher housing costs.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103905.abstract_zh: 本文研究了本地可达性的改善如何影响城市的非贸易性便利设施分布、住房成本与福利。我构建了一个对这些便利设施的本地需求模型，该需求取决于出行时间与成本。拼车服务的进入冲击了这些时间与成本。进入三年后，在驾车可达且公共交通不可达的区域，便利设施增长更快。在这些地点，三年后房价与租金分别上涨了7%和2%。综合来看，便利设施与可达性的改善超过了住房成本的上升。所有居民均从拼车服务中受益；然而，业主平均比租户多获益24%，因为他们从房价上涨中获得了资产增值收益，而租户则面临更高的住房成本。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103905.title: Ridesharing and the redistribution of economic activity
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103905.title_zh: 共享出行与经济活动的再分配

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103906.abstract: Cycling as a mode of commuting has gained popularity in cities worldwide. This study examines the impact of cycling on the urban spatial structure and welfare through the development of a quantitative spatial equilibrium model that incorporates mode choice and car congestion. We apply this model to the Netherlands, which is known for its extensive cycling infrastructure. Eliminating cycling increases commuting times and distances by 15% and 30%, exacerbates car congestion, and results in a significant reduction in worker welfare. We also show that removing dedicated cycleways leads to similar, although less pronounced, changes in the spatial economy.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103906.abstract_zh: 骑行作为一种通勤方式在全球城市中日益普及。本研究通过构建一个纳入出行方式选择与汽车拥堵的量化空间均衡模型，探讨骑行对城市空间结构与福利的影响。我们将该模型应用于以广泛骑行基础设施著称的荷兰。消除骑行会使通勤时间与距离分别增加15%和30%，加剧汽车拥堵，并导致劳动者福利显著下降。我们还表明，移除专用自行车道会引发类似但程度较轻的空间经济变化。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103906.title: Cycling cities: Mode choice, car congestion, and urban structure
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103906.title_zh: 骑行城市：出行方式选择、汽车拥堵与城市结构

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103907.abstract: How does transport cost affect the spatial organization of economic activities? This study develops a theoretical framework that distinguishes between two types of dispersion forces in spatial models: “local” dispersion forces acting within cities, and “global” dispersion forces acting across them. The distinction leads to a systematic classification of spatial models into a few fundamental types, each with distinct endogenous spatial patterns and comparative statics in response to changes in transport costs. The framework reconciles empirical findings and clarifies how transport-induced reorganization of economic activities can depend on the spatial scale of dominant dispersion forces.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103907.abstract_zh: 运输成本如何影响经济活动的空间组织？本研究构建了一个理论框架，区分了空间模型中的两类分散力：“本地”分散力作用于城市内部，而“全球”分散力则作用于城市之间。这一区分使得空间模型得以系统性地归类为几种基本类型，每种类型具有不同的内生空间格局及对运输成本变化的比较静态响应。该框架调和了实证发现，并阐明了运输引发的经济活动重组如何取决于主导分散力的空间尺度。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103907.title: Spatial scale of agglomeration and dispersion: Number, spacing, and the spatial extent of cities
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103907.title_zh: 集聚与分散的空间尺度：城市数量、间距及空间范围

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103908.abstract: This paper studies the distortionary effects of land-use regulations that preserve farmland from urban sprawl. I exploit a major policy restricting farm-to-urban land conversion in China — the Farmland Red Line Policy — to provide causal evidence on the negative impact of land-use regulation on local development, measured by GDP and population growth. To understand the aggregate impact of the policy, I develop a quantitative spatial equilibrium model that features endogenous land-use decisions. The calibrated model reveals a 7% loss in workers’ welfare due to the policy. Furthermore, a cap-and-trade platform that allows local regions to exchange farmland preservation requirements can eliminate 60% of workers’ welfare costs. The results highlight the substantial welfare costs that can arise from suboptimal land-use policies, underscoring the need for careful design in fast-growing economies.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103908.abstract_zh: 本文研究了旨在保护农田免受城市扩张影响的土地使用法规所产生的扭曲效应。我利用中国一项限制农地转用的重大政策——农田红线政策——作为自然实验，提供了土地使用法规对地方发展（以GDP和人口增长衡量）产生负面影响的因果证据。为理解该政策的总体影响，我构建了一个包含内生土地使用决策的定量空间均衡模型。校准模型显示，该政策导致工人福利损失7%。此外，一个允许各地区交易农田保护义务的总量控制与交易平台，能够消除60%的工人福利成本。研究结果凸显了次优土地使用政策可能带来的巨大福利代价，强调了在快速增长经济体中政策设计需谨慎的重要性。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103908.title: The local and aggregate effects of land-use regulation on farmland protection
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103908.title_zh: 土地利用规制对农田保护的局部与总体效应

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103909.abstract: Why are populations more spatially concentrated in some countries than in others? And why does that concentration change over time? I study how international trade integration affects the within-country spatial allocation of population and the welfare implications of these reallocations. A one-sector quantitative spatial model isolates a key mechanism: lower international trade costs disproportionately benefit regions with high foreign import dependence, which tend to be less populated regions within their countries. For greater realism, I then estimate a two-sector extension with non-homothetic preferences, allowing sectoral composition to adjust endogenously while retaining regional differences in trade access and local fundamentals. Counterfactuals imply that external integration reduces spatial concentration on average, raises aggregate welfare, and modestly tilts within-country welfare gains toward peripheral regions. In a decomposition of 1990–2005 concentration changes, trade-cost and productivity changes account for a modest share of cross-country variation, while inferred amenity changes capture most of the remainder.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103909.abstract_zh: 为什么有些国家的人口在空间上比其他国家更为集中？为什么这种集中程度会随时间变化？我研究国际贸易一体化如何影响国家内部人口的空间分布，以及这些重新配置对福利的影响。一个单部门定量空间模型揭示了关键机制：较低的国际贸易成本不成比例地惠及那些对外国进口依赖度高的地区，而这些地区往往是其国内人口较少的区域。为增强现实性，我随后估计了一个具有非齐次偏好的两部门扩展模型，允许部门结构内生调整，同时保留区域间贸易准入和地方基本条件的差异。反事实分析表明，外部一体化平均降低了空间集中度，提高了总体福利，并适度地将国内福利收益向边缘地区倾斜。在对1990年至2005年集中度变化的分解中，贸易成本和生产率的变动解释了跨国差异的适度份额，而推断的便利性变化则解释了其余大部分差异。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103909.title: De-concentrating integration? Spatial concentration, trade access, local fundamentals, and welfare
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103909.title_zh: 去集中化整合？空间集中、贸易通道、地方基础与福利

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103910.abstract: I investigate how local commodity booms impact regional manufacturing in Colombia. I build a multisectoral economic geography model with industry linkages where states trade domestically and internationally. I quantify the spatial spillovers to manufacturing under several local resource boom scenarios, finding three key results. First, states that have both high domestic and international market access tend to see an increase in their manufacturing activity under booms, while less-connected states see a decline. Second, domestic trade and industry linkages can amplify or reduce these manufacturing spillovers. Third, international trade is the main determinant of the spatial spillovers to manufacturing. I also find that local commodity booms produce four patterns: (i) they crowd out manufacturing activity in the state where the boom occurs, (ii) their spatial spillovers to manufacturing change when I eliminate labor mobility frictions, (iii) they increase production costs in manufacturing sectors, and (iv) they induce worker reallocation across sectors. My findings show that geography, trade, and industry linkages crucially determine how commodity booms shape regional industrialization in developing nations.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103910.abstract_zh: 我研究了地方大宗商品繁荣如何影响哥伦比亚的区域制造业。我构建了一个包含产业关联的多部门经济地理模型，其中各州在国内和国际上进行贸易。我量化了几种地方资源繁荣情景下对制造业的空间溢出效应，发现了三个关键结果。首先，在国内和国际市场准入方面均较高的州，在繁荣时期往往会出现制造业活动的增长，而连通性较差的州则会出现下降。其次，国内贸易和产业关联可以放大或缩小这些制造业溢出效应。第三，国际贸易是决定制造业空间溢出效应的主要因素。我还发现，地方大宗商品繁荣产生了四种模式：（i）它们挤出了繁荣发生州的制造业活动，（ii）当我消除劳动力流动摩擦时，其对制造业的空间溢出效应发生变化，（iii）它们提高了制造业部门的生产成本，以及（iv）它们引发了工人跨部门的重新配置。我的研究结果表明，地理、贸易和产业关联在决定大宗商品繁荣如何塑造发展中国家区域工业化方面至关重要。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103910.title: The geography of commodity booms
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103910.title_zh: 大宗商品繁荣的地理分布

10.1016/j.jue.2026.103912.abstract: We estimate the impact of inward immigration on city-level inflation in the United States. We find that doubling the rate of immigration reduces inflation by about 0.1 to 0.2 percentage points. The disinflationary effect is concentrated in goods prices. Effects are larger for working-age immigrants, with suggestive but less precise evidence of stronger disinflationary effects from less-educated immigrants, especially in services. Housing markets respond differently: immigration increases local housing prices, with the largest effects for higher-education immigrants. Our results are jointly rationalized by a simple general equilibrium model where substitutability of capital and labor varies across industries but capital is fixed in the short run.
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103912.abstract_zh: 我们估算了美国境内移民流入对城市层面通货膨胀的影响。研究发现，移民率翻倍会使通货膨胀率下降约0.1至0.2个百分点。这一通缩效应主要集中在商品价格上。对于处于劳动年龄的移民，其影响更为显著；尽管证据尚不精确，但提示性结果表明，教育程度较低的移民，尤其是在服务业领域，可能带来更强的通缩效应。住房市场的反应则有所不同：移民推高了当地房价，其中对高学历移民的影响最为显著。我们的研究结果通过一个简单的通用均衡模型得到了统一解释，该模型假设资本与劳动的替代性在不同行业间存在差异，但短期内资本固定不变。
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103912.title: Immigration and local inflation: Evidence from US cities
10.1016/j.jue.2026.103912.title_zh: 移民与地方通胀：来自美国城市的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108077.abstract: Farm afforestation is central to climate and biodiversity goals in Ireland, yet farmer uptake remains persistently low despite decades of generous government incentives. This paper investigates the drivers of reluctance through the lens of Real Options Theory, which emphasises the value of waiting under conditions of irreversibility and uncertainty. Drawing on 24 in-depth interviews with Irish farmers, the study uses thematic analysis to inductively identify how farmers frame afforestation and then deductively interprets these themes through the three pillars of the ROT: irreversibility, uncertainty and flexibility. The study demonstrates that hesitation is not a failure of rationality but its expression. Farmers consistently described afforestation as uniquely risky compared to alternative land uses, citing profound irreversibility (legal, financial, and socio-cultural), multidimensional uncertainties (policy, market, biological, and social), and the attractiveness of more flexible alternatives. Together, these conditions elevate the option value of delay, rationalising inaction despite the financial incentives on offer. Theoretically, the paper extends Real Options Theory beyond its traditional focus on price volatility to encompass institutional and socio-cultural dimensions of irreversibility and uncertainty. Methodologically, it demonstrates the value of qualitative inquiry to capture how farmers perceive and assign option value. This study contributes to land-use policy debates by integrating behavioural insights with investment-under-u
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108077.abstract_zh: 农场造林对于爱尔兰的气候和生物多样性目标至关重要，然而尽管政府提供了数十年的慷慨激励，农民的参与度却持续低迷。本文通过实物期权理论的视角探讨了农民犹豫不决的驱动因素，该理论强调在不可逆性和不确定性条件下等待的价值。基于对爱尔兰农民的24次深度访谈，本研究采用主题分析，先归纳性地识别农民如何构建造林议题，再通过实物期权理论的三大支柱——不可逆性、不确定性和灵活性——对这些主题进行演绎性解读。研究表明，犹豫并非理性的失败，而是理性的体现。农民一致认为，与其他土地利用方式相比，造林具有独特的风险性，他们提到了深层次的不可逆性（法律、财务和社会文化层面）、多维度的不确定性（政策、市场、生物和社会层面）以及更具吸引力的灵活替代方案。这些条件共同提升了延迟的期权价值，使得即使有经济激励，不作为也显得合理。在理论上，本文将实物期权理论从传统的价格波动关注扩展到制度和社

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108086.abstract: Limiting global warming to 1.5°C will require significant land-use change. Various post-Paris Agreement strategies are rooted in land-based CO2 removal. However, these strategies introduce potential mismatches with biodiversity conservation policies. Given this, our study evaluates the compatibility between the UN Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework’s “30-by-30” target—protecting 30% of land and oceans by 2030—and two climate change scenarios: “Current Trends” (CT), which extrapolates present climate policies through the century, and “Accelerated Actions” (AA) which seeks to stabilize average temperatures at 1.5°C. We apply a multi-sector computable general equilibrium model (MIT Economic Projection and Policy Analysis), where the 30-by-30 target is implemented by protecting biodiversity-rich natural forest and grasslands while prioritizing subsidy-based transition to these land types. Under CT and AA, India and the Middle East will experience the largest GDP losses, up to tens of billions of dollars, as a result of combining the 30-by-30 target. Meanwhile, Brazil and Australia and New Zealand will experience billion-dollar magnitude growth. Outputs further magnify the distributional effects of the 30-by-30 target, where the Middle East and India will experience substantial food price increases ranging from 5% to 600% in certain agricultural products. These results highlight disparities for regions with deficient natural forest and grassland cover, but also the potential comparative advantage for strong agri-livestock regions that would benefit from increased food exports. Overall, our outputs provide a socioeconomic insight into the effects of a dual biodiversity-climate interventi
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108086.abstract_zh: 将全球变暖限制在1.5°C以内将需要显著的土地利用变化。各种后巴黎协定战略均以基于土地的二氧化碳清除为核心。然而，这些战略与生物多样性保护政策之间可能存在不匹配。鉴于这一背景，本研究评估了联合国《昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架》的“30×30”目标——即到2030年保护30%的陆地和海洋——与两种气候变化情景之间的兼容性：“当前趋势”（CT）情景，即延续本世纪现有气候政策；以及“加速行动”（AA）情景，旨在将平均气温稳定在1.5°C。我们应用了一个多部门可计算一般均衡模型（MIT经济预测与政策分析模型），其中30×30目标通过保护生物多样性丰富的天然森林和草原来实现，同时优先考虑基于补贴的向这些土地类型的转型。在CT和AA情景下，印度和中东地区将因结合30×30目标而遭受最大的GDP损失，高达数百亿美元。与此同时，巴西、澳大利亚和新西兰将经历数十亿美元级别的增长。产出进一步放大了30×30目标的分配效应，其中中东和印度将经历显著的食物价格上涨，某些农产品涨幅在5%至600%之间。这些结果凸显了天然森林和草原覆盖不足地区的差异，同时也揭示了强大的农牧业地区可能从食品出口增加中获益的潜在比较优势。总体而言，我们的产出为双重生物多样性-气候干预措施的影响提供了社会经济层面的洞察。

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108101.abstract: Scotland aims to achieve net-zero emissions by 2045, with afforestation and native woodland restoration as key strategies, targeting 25% woodland cover by 2050, or roughly 10,000 ha of new woodland annually. Much of this expansion depends on private landowners often supported by public subsidies. Yet landowners are often resistant to native woodland expansion on account of their prioritization of traditional land uses and perceived economic risks. Understanding the factors that influence landowner uptake is therefore crucial for designing effective policies. This raises the question: how does interaction between policymakers and landowners affect policy adoption? To provide insights on this, we developed a custom strategy game as an interactive socio-ecological model in which local stakeholders develop land and resource use strategies as estate owners, farmers, or policymakers. In the game setting, ‘landowners’ made decisions on land-related economic activities, while ‘policymakers’ enacted policies with potential impact on the ‘landowners’ activities. In-game landscape indicators tracked land use changes. Discussions among players were recorded with a microphone for later analysis. We showed that interactions during policy drafting between land managers and policymakers within the frame of the game modeling process are associated with higher adoption rates of proposed policies. This suggests that, under simplified experimental conditions, integrating stakeholder perspectives early in real-life policy formulation could enhance the effectiveness of reforestation strategies in Scotland by addressing both ecological and social barriers to successful implementation. More broadly, in regions where policy adoption is limited by low stakeholder engagement or misaligned incentives, accessible and engaging participatory approaches as represented by strategy games may foster more effective and widely supported environmental governance.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108101.abstract_zh: 苏格兰旨在2045年前实现净零排放，将植树造林和原生林地恢复作为关键策略，目标是在2050年前实现25%的林地覆盖率，即每年新增约1万公顷林地。这一扩张在很大程度上依赖于通常获得公共补贴支持的私人土地所有者。然而，由于土地所有者优先考虑传统土地利用方式并感知到经济风险，他们往往对原生林地扩张持抵触态度。因此，理解影响土地所有者采纳行为的因素对于设计有效政策至关重要。这引出了一个问题：政策制定者与土地所有者之间的互动如何影响政策采纳？为深入探究此问题，我们开发了一款定制策略游戏，作为一种交互式社会生态模型，让当地利益相关者以庄园主、农民或政策制定者的身份制定土地和资源利用策略。在游戏设定中，“土地所有者”就土地相关经济活动做出决策，而“政策制定者”则颁布可能影响“土地所有者”活动的政策。游戏中的景观指标追踪了土地利用变化。玩家间的讨论通过麦克风记录以供后续分析。我们研究表明，在游戏建模过程的框架内，土地管理者与政策制定者在政策起草期间的互动与所提议政策的更高采纳率相关联。这表明，在简化的实验条件下，将利益相关者的观点早期融入现实政策制定中，可通过同时应对生态和社会障碍来增强苏格兰再造林策略的有效性。更广泛而言，在政策采纳受限于利益相关者参与度低或激励措施不匹配的地区，以策略游戏为代表的可及且参与性强的方法可能促进更有效且获得广泛支持的环境治理。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108101.title: Beyond top-down policymaking: Policymaker–landowner interaction promotes reforestation in a strategy game
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108101.title_zh: 超越自上而下的政策制定：策略游戏中政策制定者与土地所有者的互动促进再造林

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108103.abstract: Forest-based solutions, such as forest landscape restoration (FLR), are increasingly emphasized in response to the interrelated crises of deforestation, biodiversity loss, and climate change. However, there is notable lack of attention to the relationship between forest governance approaches and forest transitions. In many African countries, little is known about how various forest governance models affect changes in vegetation cover over time. Leveraging remote sensing techniques and time-series analysis, we examine the changing patterns of vegetation cover from 2003 to 2021 across Malawi, where distinct governance approaches have been implemented within and across protected areas and communal lands. The analysis revealed varying patterns and magnitudes of greening (vegetation gain) and browning (vegetation loss) across different periods, seasons, locations, and scales. Our findings indicate a significant increase in greenness during 2003–2009 in districts where community-based forest management (CBFM) programs were implemented. Conversely, the extent of vegetation greening was mixed during 2005–2014 in areas where combined CBFM and forest co-management (FCoM) were the primary participatory forest governance models implemented. The FCoM governance model implemented solely during 2014–2019 was associated with very little vegetation greening. Our study offers insights into vegetation cover changes over specific timeframes, with a deeper understanding of how different participatory forest governance models have influenced these transitions. Specifically, our evidence demonstrates a positive association of CBFM with improvements in vegetation cover. This underscores the importance of strongly centering local communities in the implementation and monitoring processes of forest-based solutions, with increased power devolution, empowered self-governance authority, and stronger resource ownership rights. Consequently, an effective implementation of Malawi's FLR strategy should prioritize institutional models that fully devolve power to local community with adequate means for self-governance while granting secure resource rights. However, additional factors that would sustain observed greening outcomes require further investigation using modeling approaches.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108103.abstract_zh: 基于森林的解决方案，如森林景观恢复（FLR），正日益受到重视，以应对森林砍伐、生物多样性丧失和气候变化这三重相互关联的危机。然而，森林治理方法与森林转型之间的关系却明显缺乏关注。在许多非洲国家，不同森林治理模式如何影响植被覆盖随时间的变化，人们知之甚少。利用遥感技术和时间序列分析，我们考察了2003年至2021年间马拉维植被覆盖的变化模式，该国在保护区和社区土地内外实施了不同的治理方法。分析揭示了不同时期、季节、地点和尺度上绿化（植被增加）和褐化（植被减少）的不同模式和程度。我们的研究结果表明，在实施社区森林管理（CBFM）项目的地区，2003年至2009年间绿度显著增加。相反，在2005年至2014年间，以CBFM和森林共同管理（FCoM）为主要参与式森林治理模式的地区，植被绿化的程度参差不齐。仅在2014年至2019年间实施的FCoM治理模式与极少的植被绿化相关。我们的研究提供了特定时间框架内植被覆盖变化的见解，并深入理解了不同参与式森林治理模式如何影响这些转型。具体而言，我们的证据表明CBFM与植被覆盖改善之间存在正相关关系。这强调了在森林解决方案的实施和监测过程中，以地方社区为核心的重要性，包括增加权力下放、增强自治权以及强化资源所有权。因此，有效实施马拉维的FLR战略应优先考虑将权力完全下放给地方社区、提供充分自治手段并保障资源权利的体制模式。然而，维持所观察到的绿化成果的其他因素仍需通过建模方法进一步研究。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108103.title: Spatio-temporal analysis of vegetation cover transitions and underlying governance approaches in Malawi, Southern Africa
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108103.title_zh: 马拉维（南部非洲）植被覆盖变化时空分析及其背后的治理方法

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108105.abstract: Afforestation is the most significant land-based strategy for enhancing carbon sequestration and mitigating climate change globally. However, in many countries, including Ireland, planting targets remain unmet despite the availability of financial incentives. The latest Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) reform introduced Small-Scale Afforestation Measures (SSAMs) to encourage tree planting on Irish farms, but barriers and motivations for adoption remain poorly understood. Accordingly, this study examines both external factors (e.g. financial incentives) and intrinsic motives (e.g., beliefs, values, attitudes, and social norms) influencing the adoption of SSAMs, which is crucial for designing more effective and targeted afforestation policies. Using data from a nationally representative survey of 563 Irish farms, the extended Theory of Planned Behaviour was applied to distinguish the influence of different beliefs, subjective norm, and barriers. A Generalised Linear Model with Ordinal Regression was used to analyse farmers’ adoption intentions. Results showed over half of farmers were either ‘neutral’ or ‘unwilling’ to adopt SSAMs, while 38.9%, 32.0%, and 45.1% were ‘willing’ to adopt tree planting of ‘Any-kind’, under CAP Pillar I ‘Eco-scheme’, and CAP Pillar II ‘Agri-Environment-Climate Measures (AECMs)’, respectively. Most background factors were not significant to adoption, and while socio-psychological factors emerged as particularly significant. Economic beliefs shaped farmers’ attitudes toward AECM adoption, while environmental beliefs were key drivers for Eco-Scheme participation. Findings suggest that adoption can be improved by combining financial incentives with participatory training to engage influential peer groups. Addressing both economic concerns and environmental values is essential for enhancing the effectiveness of afforestation policies and increasing uptake.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108105.abstract_zh: 植树造林是全球范围内增强碳汇和减缓气候变化的最重要的陆地策略。然而，在许多国家，包括爱尔兰，尽管有财政激励措施，植树目标仍未实现。最新的共同农业政策（CAP）改革引入了小规模造林措施（SSAMs），以鼓励爱尔兰农场植树，但采纳的障碍和动机仍鲜为人知。因此，本研究考察了影响SSAMs采纳的外部因素（如财政激励）和内在动机（如信念、价值观、态度和社会规范），这对于设计更有效和有针对性的造林政策至关重要。利用对563个爱尔兰农场的全国代表性调查数据，应用扩展的计划行为理论来区分不同信念、主观规范和障碍的影响。采用带有序数回归的广义线性模型分析农民的采纳意愿。结果显示，超过一半的农民对采纳SSAMs持“中立”或“不愿意”态度，而分别有38.9%、32.0%和45.1%的农民“愿意”采纳“任意类型”的植树、CAP第一支柱下的“生态计划”和CAP第二支柱下的“农业环境气候措施（AECMs）”。大多数背景因素对采纳不显著，而社会心理因素尤为显著。经济信念塑造了农民对AECM采纳的态度，而环境信念是参与生态计划的关键驱动力。研究结果表明，将财政激励与参与式培训相结合，以吸引有影响力的同行群体，可以改善采纳情况。解决经济关切和环境价值观对于提高造林政策的有效性和增加采纳率至关重要。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108105.title: What motivates Irish farmers to participate in new afforestation schemes: Financial or environmental drivers?
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108105.title_zh: 什么激励爱尔兰农民参与新的造林计划：经济驱动还是环境驱动？

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108106.abstract: Accurate understanding and modelling of complex nature land dynamics is essential for effective nature conservation and land-use planning, particularly in and around metropolitan areas where diverse land-use demands compete for limited space. However, existing modelling frameworks often overlook stakeholder interactions by relying solely on spatial drivers such as land suitability, and tend to oversimplify land-use dynamics by focusing on a single land-use type, ignoring the competing pressures from other land uses. To address this gap, this study proposes a stakeholder-integrated land-use competition (SI-LUC) model that integrates stakeholder interactions, defined by decision-making and negotiation processes, into a multi-type land-use competition framework. The model was applied to simulate nature land dynamics in the Randstad metropolitan area from 2012 to 2023. Results show that SI-LUC improves simulation performance compared to a widely used conventional model, achieving around 5% increase in the global Figure of Merit (FoM). Moreover, the sensitivity analysis confirms the effectiveness of stakeholder-related parameters in SI-LUC, such as negotiation costs and thresholds to agree, in regulating the intensity of stakeholder interactions and shaping nature land changes. Additionally, the scenario analysis highlights the model’s potential as a virtual laboratory for testing governance strategies on nature conservation, enabling decision-makers assess the long-term effects of different nature governance approaches and facilitating a more informed, context-sensitive land-use planning in complex urban contexts.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108106.abstract_zh: 准确理解与模拟复杂的自然土地动态对于有效的自然保护和土地利用规划至关重要，尤其是在大都市区及其周边地区，那里多样化的土地利用需求在有限空间内相互竞争。然而，现有的建模框架往往仅依赖土地适宜性等空间驱动因素，忽视了利益相关者之间的互动，并且倾向于通过聚焦单一土地利用类型来过度简化土地利用动态，忽略了其他土地利用带来的竞争压力。为弥补这一不足，本研究提出了一种利益相关者整合的土地利用竞争（SI-LUC）模型，该模型将利益相关者互动（由决策和谈判过程定义）整合到多类型土地利用竞争框架中。该模型被应用于模拟2012年至2023年间兰斯塔德大都市区的自然土地动态。结果表明，与广泛使用的传统模型相比，SI-LUC提高了模拟性能，全球品质因数（FoM）提升了约5%。此外，敏感性分析证实了SI-LUC中利益相关者相关参数的有效性，如谈判成本和达成一致的阈值，这些参数在调节利益相关者互动强度和塑造自然土地变化方面发挥作用。另外，情景分析凸显了该模型作为虚拟实验室的潜力，可用于测试自然保护治理策略，使决策者能够评估不同自然治理方法的长期影响，并促进在复杂城市背景下进行更明智、更具情境敏感性的土地利用规划。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108106.title: A stakeholder-integrated land-use model for nature conservation in metropolitan areas: The case of the Randstad, Netherlands
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108106.title_zh: 面向大都市区自然保护的整合利益相关者土地利用模型：以荷兰兰斯塔德为例

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108107.abstract: Based on the System of National Accounts (SNA) and the European System of Accounts (ESA), land is classified as a natural resource and a non-produced non-financial asset. Due to its significant share in an economy’s assets, evaluating the value of land is crucial for preparing the national balance sheet and national wealth. This requires classifying land types according to their use and pricing them accordingly. The main types of land include land underlying dwellings, land underlying other buildings and structures, agricultural, and forestry lands. This study estimates the value of land as an economic asset in Iran, providing the first comprehensive evaluation of various land types in the country. Lands underlying dwellings are valued using residual (benchmark approach), net present value (NPV), and land-to-structure ratio (LSR) methods.
