Lands underlying other buildings and structures are valued using the LSR method, while agricultural and forestry lands are valued based on the NPV of expected future incomes. The results of this study show that the total estimated value of land in Iran ranges from IRR 32,862 trillion to IRR 918,986 trillion during 2015–2023. Lands underlying dwellings constitute the largest share of this value at 45.59%, with the household sector being the largest owner. Agricultural lands have the second-largest share, followed by land underlying buildings other than dwellings (on average, approximately 32.66% and 21.56%, respectively), while forest lands have the smallest share of the total land value (on average 0.19%).
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108107.abstract_zh: 根据国民账户体系（SNA）与欧洲账户体系（ESA），土地被归类为自然资源及非生产性非金融资产。鉴于土地在经济体资产中占据重要份额，评估土地价值对于编制国家资产负债表和国家财富至关重要。这要求根据土地用途对其类型进行分类，并据此定价。主要土地类型包括住宅用地、其他建筑物和构筑物用地、农业用地及林业用地。本研究估算了伊朗作为经济资产的土地价值，首次对该国各类土地进行了全面评估。住宅用地采用剩余法（基准法）、净现值法（NPV）及土地与建筑物比率法（LSR）进行估值；其他建筑物和构筑物用地采用LSR法估值；农业和林业用地则基于预期未来收入的净现值进行估值。研究结果显示，2015年至2023年间，伊朗土地总价值估计介于32,862万亿伊朗里亚尔至918,986万亿伊朗里亚尔之间。其中，住宅用地占总价值的最大份额，为45.59%，住户部门是最大的所有者。农业用地占比次之，其后依次为除住宅外的建筑物用地（平均分别约为32.66%和21.56%），而林业用地在土地总价值中占比最小（平均为0.19%）。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108107.title: Estimating the value of land in Iran’s economy
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108107.title_zh: 估算伊朗经济中土地的价值

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108109.abstract: Zimbabwe’s land reform was initiated at independence in 1980 to redress deeply unequal colonial land ownership patterns and advance socio-economic justice. However, its outcomes remain contested and unevenly understood across a fragmented body of scholarship. This study therefore undertakes a systematic review of peer-reviewed research from 1980 to 2026, examining the evolution of scholarly engagement, the policy trajectory across reform phases, and the multidimensional impacts of land reform. The review shows that while redistribution expanded access to land and reconfigured agrarian structures, its outcomes have been differentiated and conditional. Social and livelihood patterns reveal the emergence of “middle farmers” alongside the continued marginalisation of vulnerable groups, including women and youth. Environmental evidence points to both adaptive land use and persistent ecological pressures. Across phases, the effectiveness of reform has depended less on redistribution itself and more on institutional capacity, policy coherence, and post-settlement support. By integrating dispersed scholarship within a coherent analytical framework, the study demonstrates that land reform functions as a foundational but insufficient condition for agrarian transformation, with outcomes shaped by the interaction between access to land and broader governance systems.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108109.abstract_zh: 津巴布韦的土地改革始于1980年独立之际，旨在纠正殖民时期极度不平等的土地所有权格局，并推动社会经济正义。然而，其成果在零散的研究文献中仍存争议，且理解程度参差不齐。为此，本研究对1980年至2026年间经同行评审的研究进行了系统性回顾，考察了学术参与的演变、各改革阶段的政策轨迹以及土地改革的多维影响。综述显示，尽管再分配扩大了土地获取机会并重构了农业结构，但其成果呈现出差异化和条件性特征。社会与生计模式揭示了“中等农民”群体的兴起，同时妇女和青年等弱势群体持续被边缘化。环境证据表明，既存在适应性的土地利用方式，也面临持续的生态压力。在各阶段中，改革的有效性更多取决于制度能力、政策连贯性和安置后支持，而非再分配本身。通过将分散的学术成果整合于一个连贯的分析框架内，本研究证明，土地改革是农业转型的基础性条件，但并非充分条件，其成果受土地获取机会与更广泛治理体系之间相互作用的影响。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108109.title: An assessment of Zimbabwe's post-independence land reforms
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108109.title_zh: 津巴布韦独立后土地改革评估

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108110.abstract: Land-use scenario simulations support policy decisions that seek to balance economic development with environmental conservation. In Uruguay’s Río de la Plata temperate grasslands, agribusiness expansion has driven land-use intensification, threatening biodiversity, ecosystem services, and rural livelihoods. This study integrates land-use data from 2000 to 2015 with explanatory variables in a multi-layer perceptron Markov model to predict vulnerability to change and land-use patterns for 2030 under three scenarios: business-as-usual, multifunctional land use, and grassland conservation. Under continued intensification, native grasslands are predicted to decline by 9% to a land cover of 51% by 2030, with cropland expansion accounting for 80% of the loss. Reducing cropland expansion and maintaining timber plantations at 2015 levels could preserve grassland cover at 57%, corresponding to more than 10,000 km² compared to the business-as-usual scenario. Except for a northern area with comparatively low conflict potential, approximately two-thirds of Uruguay remain highly susceptible to agricultural conversion. Applying 90 m and 180 m conservation buffers around sensitive areas may reduce agricultural spillover and enhance ecosystem service provision. Implementing 90 m protection buffers substantially curtails cropland expansion within designated areas, resulting in a 139% relative difference in net cropland change compared to the business as usual scenario. By providing high-resolution vulnerability assessments and policy-relevant insights, this study supports evidence-based land-use planning and highlights how targeted conservation measures can help navigate trade-offs between agricultural development and ecological resilience at national and local scales.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108110.abstract_zh: 土地利用情景模拟为寻求平衡经济发展与环境保护的政策决策提供支持。在乌拉圭拉普拉塔河流域的温带草原地区，农业综合企业的扩张推动了土地利用集约化，威胁到生物多样性、生态系统服务和农村生计。本研究整合2000年至2015年的土地利用数据与解释变量，采用多层感知器马尔可夫模型，预测三种情景下（常规发展、多功能土地利用和草原保护）2030年的变化脆弱性及土地利用格局。在持续集约化情景下，预计原生草原面积将减少9%，至2030年土地覆盖率降至51%，其中耕地扩张占损失的80%。减少耕地扩张并将人工林维持在2015年水平，可将草原覆盖率保持在57%，与常规发展情景相比，相当于保留超过10,000平方公里的草原面积。除北部一个冲突潜力相对较低的区域外，乌拉圭约三分之二的国土仍高度易受农业转化影响。在敏感区域周围设置90米和180米的保护缓冲带，可减少农业溢出效应并增强生态系统服务供给。实施90米保护缓冲带可大幅遏制指定区域内的耕地扩张，与常规发展情景相比，耕地净变化相对差异达139%。通过提供高分辨率脆弱性评估和政策相关洞见，本研究为基于证据的土地利用规划提供支持，并凸显了有针对性的保护措施如何在国家和地方尺度上协调农业发展与环境韧性之间的权衡。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108110.title: Balancing growth and conservation: Land-use policy scenarios for Uruguay’s grasslands
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108110.title_zh: 平衡增长与保护：乌拉圭草原土地利用政策情景

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108111.abstract: This study examines how changes in forest cover in rural Poland are related to socioeconomic development and the degree of deagrarianization of local economies. Understanding these relationships is essential for the design of effective land-use and afforestation policies in structurally diverse rural regions. The analysis was conducted at the level of local administrative units (LAU), covering all rural municipalities in Poland during 2004–2013, a period of intensive forest expansion supported by the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP). During the study period, Poland’s forest area increased from 28.7% to 29.3%. Private forests accounted for 80.5% of this increase, indicating that agricultural land-to-forest transitions were the dominant source of new forest area. Using generalized additive models, we identified distinct non-linear relationships between afforestation intensity and key socioeconomic indicators. Forest cover growth was strongest in municipalities with low levels of socioeconomic development and a dominant agricultural function. The effect of deagrarianization was threshold-based: afforestation intensity increased with the deagrarianization index up to approximately 0.3, beyond which no further increase was observed. 10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108111.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了波兰农村森林覆盖变化与当地社会经济发展及经济去农业化程度之间的关系。理解这些关系对于在结构多样化的农村地区制定有效的土地利用和造林政策至关重要。分析在地方行政单位（LAU）层面进行，覆盖了2004—2013年间波兰所有农村市镇，这一时期在共同农业政策（CAP）支持下森林面积快速扩张。研究期间，波兰森林面积从28.7%增加到29.3%。私有林占这一增量的80.5%，表明农地转林地是新增森林面积的主要来源。利用广义加性模型，我们识别出造林强度与关键社会经济指标之间显著的非线性关系。森林覆盖增长在社会经济发展水平较低且以农业功能为主的市镇中最为强劲。去农业化的影响具有阈值效应：造林强度随去农业化指数上升而增加，直至约0.3，此后不再进一步增加。在空间上，森林扩张集中于边缘市镇，尤其是那些远离区域中心且以相对单一功能为特征的地区。

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108112.abstract: While land tenure security is recognised as a cornerstone of sustainable land use, understanding of its influence on the adoption of agroecological practices is still limited, particularly in tenure-insecure contexts. This study examines how land tenure security, institutional support, and behavioural factors shape smallholders’ willingness to adopt agroecological innovations. Institutional and behavioural perspectives are integrated within a discrete choice modelling framework to analyse data from a choice experiment conducted with 400 smallholder farmers in Huambo Province, Angola. Willingness-to-accept (WTA) estimates were derived for key attributes, including land tenure security, technical assistance, and financial compensation. A conditional logit model was first employed to establish baseline preferences, followed by a mixed logit specification that relaxes the independence of irrelevant alternatives assumption and captures unobserved preference heterogeneity. The results revealed trade-offs among incentives, with required compensation increasing from 27,250 kwanzas for biopesticide use to 81,749 kwanzas for combined agroecological practices. Secure land tenure emerged as the most influential determinant, reducing WTA by 344%, while behavioural factors, including pro-environmental attitudes and livelihood security perception, moderate farmers’ responses to policy incentives. Overall, the findings indicate that institutional support, particularly tenure security combined with targeted technical assistance, increases adoption and reduces reliance on monetary compensation. These results provide empirical evidence that land governance reforms embedded in supportive institutional frameworks can enhance the cost-effectiveness and scalability of agri-environmental and payments for ecosystem services (PES) programmes. The study offers policy-relevant insights for land-use and agricultural policy design in Sub-Saharan Africa and other regions facing comparable institutional constraints.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108112.abstract_zh: 尽管土地保有权保障被视为可持续土地利用的基石，但其对农业生态实践采纳的影响仍认识有限，尤其是在保有权不稳定的情境下。本研究考察了土地保有权保障、制度支持和行为因素如何塑造小农户采纳农业生态创新的意愿。在离散选择建模框架内整合制度与行为视角，分析在安哥拉万博省对400名小农户进行的选型实验数据。针对关键属性（包括土地保有权保障、技术援助和经济补偿）推导出接受意愿（WTA）估计值。首先采用条件Logit模型建立基准偏好，随后采用混合Logit模型放宽无关选择独立性假设并捕捉未观测到的偏好异质性。结果显示激励之间存在权衡，所需补偿从生物农药使用的27，250宽扎增至综合农业生态实践的81，749宽扎。土地保有权保障成为最具影响力的决定因素，使WTA降低344%，而行为因素（包括亲环境态度和生计安全感知）则调节了农户对政策激励的响应。总体而言，研究结果表明，制度支持，尤其是保有权保障与针对性技术援助相结合，能够提高采纳率并减少对货币补偿的依赖。这些结果提供了实证证据，表明嵌入支持性制度框架中的土地治理改革能够增强农业环境及生态系统服务付费（PES）项目的成本效益和可扩展性。本研究为撒哈拉以南非洲及其他面临类似制度约束地区的土地利用和农业政策设计提供了具有政策相关性的见解。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108112.title: Land tenure security and agroecological transitions: Evidence from a discrete choice experiment in Angola
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108112.title_zh: 土地权属保障与农业生态转型：来自安哥拉离散选择实验的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108114.abstract: Farming systems in many developing countries face persistent sustainability challenges, partly due to weak incentives for the adoption of ecologically sound practices. Existing policy instruments often reinforce this imbalance by favoring input-intensive approaches, such as chemical fertilizers, while neglecting sustainable soil management practices for which farmers often possess strong indigenous knowledge. Promoting sustainable agriculture in dryland farming systems therefore requires a better understanding of farmers’ preferences as well as the policy incentives that shape adoption decisions. This study examines how alternative policy incentives influence farmers’ choices regarding ecologically sustainable land management practices. Using a choice experiment with a between-subjects design, we elicited farmers’ trade-offs among different soil fertility and moisture-conserving practices under varying policy incentive schemes. For exploring preferences and estimating willingness to accept, we used mixed logit model. Results show negative preferences for chemical-based fertilization and positive preferences for moisture-conserving practices such as tie-ridges and trenches, which are well suited to dryland conditions. Preferences for zero tillage, although heterogeneous, are on average positive despite the widespread use of repeated tillage in current farming systems. Policy treatments reveal that cash transfers provide the strongest incentives for adopting sustainable practices, followed by input subsidies, whereas insurance mechanisms have weaker effects. These findings suggest that liquidity constraints constitute a major barrier to the uptake of sustainable land management. Policy interventions should thus prioritize flexible financial support instruments that allow farmers to allocate resources according to their specific production constraints, while complementing these with targeted incentives for practices that generate long-term environmental benefits. Adaptive policy designs that combine cash-based support, selective subsidies, and locally appropriate extension services are more likely to facilitate transitions toward sustainable agricultural systems.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108114.abstract_zh: 许多发展中国家的农业系统面临持续性的可持续性挑战，部分原因在于采用生态友好型实践的激励不足。现有政策工具往往通过偏向于化肥等投入密集型方法，而忽视农民通常拥有丰富本土知识的可持续土壤管理实践，从而加剧了这一不平衡。因此，促进旱作农业系统中的可持续农业，需要更好地理解农民的偏好以及影响采纳决策的政策激励。本研究探讨了不同的政策激励如何影响农民对生态可持续土地管理实践的选择。采用受试者间设计的选择实验，我们获取了农民在不同政策激励方案下对多种土壤肥力及保水实践之间的权衡。为探究偏好并估算接受意愿，我们使用了混合Logit模型。结果显示，农民对化学基施肥表现出负面偏好，而对适应当地旱地条件的保水实践如垄沟和沟渠则表现出正面偏好。尽管存在异质性，但平均而言，农民对免耕的偏好为正，尽管当前农业系统中普遍采用重复耕作。政策处理显示，现金转移为采纳可持续实践提供了最强激励，其次是投入补贴，而保险机制的效果较弱。这些发现表明，流动性约束是采纳可持续土地管理的主要障碍。因此，政策干预应优先考虑灵活的财政支持工具，使农民能够根据其具体生产约束分配资源，并辅以针对产生长期环境效益的实践的有针对性激励。结合现金支持、选择性补贴和本地适宜的推广服务的适应性政策设计，更有可能促进向可持续农业系统的转型。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108114.title: Policy incentives for sustainable land use practices: Evidence from farmers’ choice behavior in dryland farming systems
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108114.title_zh: 可持续土地利用实践的政策激励：来自旱作农业系统农户选择行为的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108115.abstract: Sustainable land management (SLM) is widely recognised as central to addressing land degradation, strengthening agricultural productivity, and enhancing ecosystem resilience across Africa. However, implementation remains uneven and is constrained by interacting socioeconomic, environmental, and institutional factors. A systematic review of peer-reviewed literature published between 2010 and 2023 was conducted using the Scopus and Google Scholar databases, resulting in 45 eligible studies, which were analysed using inductive thematic analysis. The results revealed three dominant categories of constraints: environmental, economic, and social, with environmental degradation, particularly soil erosion, deforestation, and climate variability, being the most frequently reported. However, the review demonstrates that underlying governance challenges, including insecure land tenure, land fragmentation, limited access to resources, weak land-use planning, and administrative inefficiency, largely drive these environmental pressures. Co-occurrence patterns further highlight a key research gap: most studies examine constraints in isolation, despite their systemic interdependence. Geographically, research is heavily concentrated in East Africa, especially Ethiopia, while Central Africa and parts of North Africa remain under-represented. This study’s novelty lies in integrating fragmented evidence into a unified analytical perspective and proposing an Integrated Sustainable Land Management (ISLM) framework that links institutional capacity, tenure security, economic incentives, and ecological restoration. The findings provide actionable insights for policymakers and researchers by supporting coordinated, cross-sectoral SLM strategies tailored to the diverse African land governance contexts.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108115.abstract_zh: 可持续土地管理（SLM）被广泛认为是应对非洲土地退化、增强农业生产力和提升生态系统韧性的核心举措。然而，其实施仍不均衡，并受到社会经济、环境和制度因素相互作用的制约。本研究利用Scopus和Google Scholar数据库，对2010年至2023年间发表的同行评审文献进行了系统综述，筛选出45项符合条件的研究，并采用归纳性主题分析进行分析。结果显示，制约因素主要分为三类：环境、经济和社会因素，其中环境退化，尤其是土壤侵蚀、森林砍伐和气候变率，是最常被报告的制约因素。然而，综述表明，潜在的治理挑战，包括土地权属不稳定、土地碎片化、资源获取受限、土地利用规划薄弱以及行政效率低下，在很大程度上驱动了这些环境压力。共现模式进一步凸显了一个关键研究空白：大多数研究孤立地考察制约因素，尽管它们在系统层面相互依存。在地理分布上，研究高度集中于东非，尤其是埃塞俄比亚，而中非和北非部分地区则代表性不足。本研究的创新之处在于将分散的证据整合为统一的分析视角，并提出一个综合可持续土地管理（ISLM）框架，将制度能力、权属保障、经济激励和生态恢复联系起来。研究结果为政策制定者和研究人员提供了可操作的见解，有助于制定适应非洲多样化土地治理背景的协调、跨部门SLM战略。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108115.title: Socioeconomic and environmental challenges affecting sustainable land management in Africa: A systematic review towards integrated framework proposal
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108115.title_zh: 影响非洲可持续土地管理的社会经济和环境挑战：面向综合框架提案的系统综述

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108116.abstract: Forests play a crucial role in maintaining environmental balance by providing a wide range of valuable ecosystem services. Monitoring their change dynamics is increasingly important for planning, decision-making, and especially for evaluating conservation policies. Due to the significance of this issue, the number of studies examining global forests in terms of change trends is not uniform. The Hyrcanian forests, recognized as one of the most important temperate forests in the world and listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site since 2019, serve as a notable example. The study of their change trends, particularly in light of recent conservation policies, has gained increasing importance. This study aims to analyze the spatial-temporal change trends of the Hyrcanian forests from 2000 to 2022 using remote sensing products. To assess the intensity and direction of changes, Sen’s slope and Mann-Kendall tests were employed. The results indicate 78,609.51 ha of degradation and 85,579.15 ha of deforestation during the study period in this region. Meanwhile, the forest restoration effort has only covered 45,525.90 ha, emphasizing the imbalance between deforestation and restoration. Deforestation is primarily driven by the expansion of agricultural lands, accounting for 79.45% of the total changes. Impervious surfaces and shrublands follow with 7.66% and 5.67%, respectively. In contrast, forest restoration has mostly occurred through the conversion of agricultural land into forests, with agricultural land contributing 74.26% to this process. Grasslands and shrublands follow with 8.14% and 7.65%, respectively. The economic analysis also revealed that deforestation has led to a loss of $1.033 billion in ecosystem service value from the Hyrcanian forests. Among the major policies, the implementation of the forest rest plan in 2016 and the inclusion of the Hyrcanian forests in the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2019 have played a significant role in mitigating forest degradation. Prior to these policies, forest degradation in some years reached approximately 4000 ha, but following their implementation, it was reduced to around 1500 ha. Additionally projections for 2030, 2040, and 2046 show that, without continued protective policies, the forest area could decrease by up to 64,340 ha by 2046, while with the continuation of policies, the forest area could increase by up to 28,554 ha. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of conservation policies and emphasize the necessity for their continuation and strengthening, along with revising land management practices, planning for ecosystem restoration, and ensuring the sustainable use of natural resources.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108116.abstract_zh: 森林在维持环境平衡中发挥着至关重要的作用，提供了多种宝贵的生态系统服务。监测其变化动态对于规划、决策以及特别是评估保护政策日益重要。鉴于这一问题的重要性，关于全球森林变化趋势的研究数量并不均衡。希尔卡尼森林被公认为世界上最重要的温带森林之一，并自2019年起被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录，是一个显著的例子。对其变化趋势的研究，尤其是在近期保护政策背景下，日益受到重视。本研究旨在利用遥感产品分析2000年至2022年间希尔卡尼森林的时空变化趋势。为评估变化的强度和方向，采用了Sen斜率和Mann-Kendall检验。结果表明，研究期间该区域发生了78，609.51公顷的退化和85，579.15公顷的毁林。与此同时，森林恢复工作仅覆盖了45，525.90公顷，凸显了毁林与恢复之间的不平衡。毁林主要由农业用地扩张驱动，占总变化的79.45%。不透水面和灌木地紧随其后，分别占7.66%和5.67%。相比之下，森林恢复主要通过农业用地向森林的转化实现，农业用地对这一过程的贡献率为74.26%。草地和灌木地紧随其后，分别占8.14%和7.65%。经济分析还揭示，毁林已导致希尔卡尼森林生态系统服务价值损失10.33亿美元。在主要政策中，2016年实施的森林休养计划和2019年希尔卡尼森林被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录，在减缓森林退化方面发挥了重要作用。在这些政策实施之前，某些年份的森林退化面积约为4000公顷，而政策实施后减少至约1500公顷。此外，对2030年、2040年和2046年的预测显示，若无持续的保护政策，到2046年森林面积可能减少多达64，340公顷；而若政策得以延续，森林面积可能增加多达28，554公顷。这些发现证明了保护政策的有效性，并强调了继续和加强这些政策的必要性，同时还需修订土地管理实践、规划生态系统恢复，并确保自然资源的可持续利用。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108116.title: Exploring land cover change patterns in Hyrcanian forests through spatiotemporal trend analysis (2000–2022)
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108116.title_zh: 基于时空趋势分析（2000–2022年）的希尔卡尼森林土地覆盖变化模式研究

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108117.abstract: Urban green infrastructure is a nature-based remedy for urban environmental, social and economic problems. This study mapped and quantified urban green infrastructure (UGI) dynamics in Dire Dawa city and projected future changes for 2055. Landsat and Sentinel-2 data, obtained from the USGS and ESA, respectively, were accessed via the Google Earth Engine platform. A random forest model was employed to classify the images, achieving kappa coefficients of 97%, 88%, 89%, and 90% for the years 1995, 2005, 2016, and 2025, respectively. To quantify and predict UGI dynamics, this study utilized the CA-Markov model and the multi-layer perceptron-artificial neural network (MLP-ANN) method. The results revealed a significant decline in UGI area: reductions of 454.96 ha (1995–2005), 884.22 ha (2005–2016), 269.40 ha (2016–2025), and a total loss of 1608.58 ha (1995–2025). Over the 30-year period (1995–2025), Dire Dawa’s UGI decreased by 23%, while built-up areas increased by 31.9%, and bare land decreased by 8.4%. Spatially, UGI fragmentation was most pronounced in the northern, southern, and central parts of the city. The findings suggest that existing urban planning, management, and land-use policies in Dire Dawa have failed to mitigate UGI loss. Therefore, analyzing UGI dynamics is crucial for informing future urban planning, management strategies, and policymaking to address fragmentation and promote sustainable urban development.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108117.abstract_zh: 城市绿色基础设施是应对城市环境、社会和经济问题的基于自然的解决方案。本研究对德雷达瓦市城市绿色基础设施（UGI）动态进行了制图与量化，并预测了2055年的未来变化。研究使用了分别从美国地质调查局（USGS）和欧洲空间局（ESA）获取的Landsat和Sentinel-2数据，并通过谷歌地球引擎平台进行访问。采用随机森林模型对影像进行分类，1995年、2005年、2016年和2025年的Kappa系数分别达到97%、88%、89%和90%。为量化和预测UGI动态，本研究采用了CA-Markov模型和多层感知器-人工神经网络（MLP-ANN）方法。结果表明，UGI面积显著下降：1995–2005年减少454.96公顷，2005–2016年减少884.22公顷，2016–2025年减少269.40公顷，1995–2025年总损失达1608.58公顷。在30年期间（1995–2025年），德雷达瓦的UGI减少了23%，而建成区面积增加了31.9%，裸地减少了8.4%。在空间上，UGI破碎化在城市北部、南部和中部最为显著。研究结果表明，德雷达瓦现有的城市规划、管理和土地利用政策未能有效遏制UGI的流失。因此，分析UGI动态对于指导未来城市规划、管理策略和政策制定，以应对破碎化问题并促进可持续城市发展至关重要。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108117.title: Mapping, quantifying and predicting future urban green infrastructure dynamics: The case study of Dire Dawa, Ethiopia
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108117.title_zh: 绘制、量化与预测未来城市绿色基础设施动态：以埃塞俄比亚德雷达瓦为例

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108118.abstract: In this study, we develop quantitative models to identify land use changes to individual parcels in Miami, FL. We focus on indicators for changes in population and economic activity. In our analysis, we identify the factors that promote this activity by examining how residential and commercial parcels are changing over time. While significant efforts have been conducted in earlier literature, there is limited work on understanding how parcels of a particular land use type change over time. The main aim of the proposed research effort is to contribute to land use evolution models that are customized by land use type. These frameworks can allow for quantitative exploration mechanisms for policy makers to proactively encourage sustainable adaptation due to emerging challenges associated with global climate change. The frameworks were developed using high-resolution parcel level data from the Florida Department of Revenue for the time period 2011–2020. The framework has two components: (1) a binary logit model to analyze what factors affect a change from the current land use designation and (2) for parcels selected for a change, a multinomial logit model, to examine the factors contributing to the new land use type. We built a joint model system that allows for a simultaneous estimation of the two decision processes. The joint model was estimated using a comprehensive set of independent variables including socio-demographic variables, economic development variables, and transportation infrastructure variables. The models developed were validated using hold-out sample data to show the value of the proposed model system
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108118.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们开发了定量模型，以识别佛罗里达州迈阿密市个别地块的土地利用变化。我们重点关注人口和经济活动变化的指标。在分析中，我们通过考察住宅和商业地块随时间的变化，识别促进这种活动的因素。尽管早期文献中已有大量研究，但针对特定土地利用类型地块随时间变化的理解工作仍然有限。本研究的主要目标是贡献于按土地利用类型定制的土地利用演化模型。这些框架能够为政策制定者提供定量探索机制，以主动鼓励因全球气候变化带来的新兴挑战而进行的可持续适应。这些框架是利用佛罗里达州税务局2011年至2020年间的高分辨率地块级数据开发的。该框架包含两个组成部分：（1）一个二元Logit模型，用于分析哪些因素影响当前土地利用指定状态的变化；（2）对于被选中发生变化的土地地块，一个多项Logit模型，用于考察促成新土地利用类型的因素。我们构建了一个联合模型系统，允许对两个决策过程进行同时估计。该联合模型使用了一组全面的自变量进行估计，包括社会人口变量、经济发展变量和交通基础设施变量。所开发的模型通过保留样本数据进行了验证，以展示所提出的模型系统的价值。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108118.title: Understanding land use evolution for vacant residential and vacant commercial parcels in Miami, Florida
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108118.title_zh: 理解佛罗里达州迈阿密市闲置住宅与闲置商业地块的土地利用演变

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108119.abstract: Climate-induced extremities deplete agricultural yield and reshape investment incentives. Mitigating the adverse effects of climate change on food systems requires increasing commitments to climate-smart investments (CSIs). Property Rights (PRs) create incentives to utilize resources optimally. However, unless such rights are enforceable, CSIs may remain low. In this study, we specifically interrogated the role of institutions in strengthening or undermining the resilience of food systems by assessing how different land-use rights (formal, semi-formal and informal) impact farming households’ incentives to embrace climate-smart adaptation measures. Data for this study were obtained from the fifth wave of the General Household Survey (GHS) Panel for Nigeria. Data from 1199 farming households were analyzed using the Endogenous Switching Regression (ESR) model. Our results show that holding formal PRs have higher positive correlates with investments in climate-smart adaptation measures than in the counterfactual scenario, and, farming households without such rights exhibit higher positive correlates with investments in climate-smart adaptation measures than in the counterfactual scenario. By contrast, residence in communities that allocate non-formal (semi-formal and informal) PRs significantly improves the CSIs of farming households than in the counterfactual scenario. However, the positive impact on CSIs is significantly lower for farming households in communities that do not allot non-formal PRs than in the counterfactual scenario. Therefore, extending the frontier of non-formal PRs such that communities that hitherto do not wield such rights become empowered to allot them is a core pathway through which institutions in Nigeria can foster extensive commitments to climate-smart adaptation measures among farming households.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108119.abstract_zh: 气候引发的极端事件降低了农业产量，并重塑了投资激励。缓解气候变化对粮食系统的不利影响，需要加大对气候智能型投资（CSIs）的承诺。产权（PRs）为优化资源利用创造了激励。然而，除非这些权利具有可执行性，否则气候智能型投资可能仍然较低。在本研究中，我们通过评估不同土地使用权（正式、半正式和非正式）如何影响农户采纳气候智能型适应措施的激励，专门探讨了制度在增强或削弱粮食系统韧性中的作用。本研究数据来源于尼日利亚第五轮综合住户调查（GHS）面板数据。采用内生转换回归（ESR）模型对1199个农户的数据进行了分析。结果表明，与反事实情景相比，持有正式产权的农户在气候智能型适应措施投资方面表现出更高的正向相关性；而没有此类权利的农户在气候智能型适应措施投资方面也表现出比反事实情景更高的正向相关性。相比之下，居住在以非正式（半正式和非正式）产权分配土地的社区中，农户的气候智能型投资显著高于反事实情景。然而，对于居住在未分配非正式产权的社区中的农户，其对气候智能型投资的积极影响显著低于反事实情景。因此，扩展非正式产权的边界，使迄今未拥有此类权利的社区能够获得分配权，是尼日利亚制度促进农户广泛参与气候智能型适应措施的核心途径。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108119.title: Heterogenous impacts of property rights on the climate-smart investments of farming households: Empirical evidence from Nigeria
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108119.title_zh: 产权对农户气候智慧型投资的异质性影响：来自尼日利亚的经验证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108120.abstract: To meet the growing global demands for food and biofuels, Brazilian soybean and sugarcane production must expand. Consequently, a comprehensive understanding of how climate-induced shifts will drive competition for agricultural land in critical regions is essential for sustainable development. Here, we investigate this potential conflict in the Paranapanema River Basin (PRB), focusing on the competition between soybean and sugarcane planted areas and analyzing how temperature and rainfall seasonality influence land-use decisions. Using predictive modeling, we simulate agricultural land-use changes for 2030, 2040, and 2050 under three climate scenarios (Baseline, SSP 2–4.5, and SSP 5–8.5). Our findings reveal that climate change will significantly reshape agricultural land-use dynamics in the PRB. Rising temperatures generally favor the conversion of pasture, soybean, and mosaic areas to sugarcane, but constrain soybean cultivation. Sugarcane thrives under moderate rainfall seasonality, while soybean expansion is suppressed under moderate (SSP 2–4.5) and high emissions (SSP 5–8.5) scenarios, while sugarcane area expands and pastureland consistently declines. Those trends reflect land-use policy constraints and favor carbon mitigation due to increase biofuel production. The mosaic area remains stable under the Baseline but decreases under the SSP scenarios. The shift from soybean to sugarcane, coupled with the decline in pastureland, underscores the dual pressures of economic demands and climate adaptation. These dynamics could have broader implications for Brazil’s agricultural exports, highlighting the need for diversification and climate-resilient practices. Policymakers must prioritize integrated strategies that balance agricultural productivity with environmental sustainability, while also promoting diversification to reduce reliance on a small number of commodities.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108120.abstract_zh: 为满足全球日益增长的粮食和生物燃料需求，巴西的大豆和甘蔗生产必须扩大。因此，全面理解气候引发的转变将如何驱动关键地区农业用地竞争，对于可持续发展至关重要。本研究聚焦于帕拉纳帕内马河流域（PRB），探讨大豆与甘蔗种植面积之间的潜在冲突，并分析温度和降雨季节性如何影响土地利用决策。通过预测建模，我们在三种气候情景（基线、SSP 2–4.5和SSP 5–8.5）下模拟了2030年、2040年和2050年的农业土地利用变化。研究结果显示，气候变化将显著重塑PRB的农业土地利用动态。气温升高总体上有利于牧场、大豆和镶嵌区域向甘蔗转化，但制约大豆种植。甘蔗在中等降雨季节性条件下生长良好，而大豆扩张在中等排放（SSP 2–4.5）和高排放（SSP 5–8.5）情景下受到抑制，同时甘蔗面积扩大，牧场面积持续减少。这些趋势反映了土地利用政策约束，并因生物燃料产量增加而有利于碳减排。镶嵌区域在基线情景下保持稳定，但在SSP情景下有所减少。从大豆向甘蔗的转变，加之牧场面积的减少，凸显了经济需求与气候适应的双重压力。这些动态可能对巴西的农业出口产生更广泛的影响，凸显了多样化和气候韧性实践的必要性。政策制定者必须优先考虑综合战略，平衡农业生产效率与环境可持续性，同时促进多样化以减少对少数大宗商品的依赖。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108120.title: Climate change drives agricultural land use competition in the Paranapanema River Basin, Southeastern Brazil
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108120.title_zh: 气候变化驱动巴西东南部巴拉那帕内马河流域农业用地竞争

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108121.abstract: The cultivation of economic resilience in poverty-stricken areas is often constrained by capital shortage and development path locking. While existing studies primarily examine resilience through industrial composition and upgrading, the role of industrial land use structure as a spatially embedded and institutionally mediated dimension of economic organization remains underexplored. Based on data from 756 Chinese poverty-stricken counties (2010–2020), this study employs the shift-share model and XGBoost-SHAP method to examine the nonlinear and heterogeneous relationships between structural adjustment of industrial land use and economic resilience. The adopted methodological framework further uncovers threshold effects and nonlinear patterns that are difficult to detect using linear approaches. The results exhibit pronounced heterogeneity across land use types: a high concentration of resource-intensive industrial land is associated with lower economic resilience, reflecting potential technology lock-in; adjustments in capital-intensive industrial land exhibit an inverted U-shaped relationship with resilience; and higher shares of labor- and technology-intensive industrial land are consistently associated with stronger resilience, likely through employment expansion and knowledge spillovers. These findings demonstrate that industrial land use structure provides a complementary analytical lens by linking land allocation, factor mobility, and development path dependence. By highlighting the differentiated and policy-conditioned associations between industrial land use structure and economic resilience, this study offers insights into resilience-building strategies for poverty-stricken regions.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108121.abstract_zh: 贫困地区经济韧性的培育往往受制于资本短缺与发展路径锁定。现有研究主要从产业构成与升级视角考察经济韧性，而工业用地结构作为经济组织在空间嵌入与制度中介维度上的重要体现，其作用尚未得到充分探讨。基于2010—2020年中国756个贫困县的数据，本研究采用偏离-份额模型与XGBoost-SHAP方法，考察工业用地结构调整与经济韧性之间的非线性及异质性关系。所采用的方法框架进一步揭示了线性方法难以识别的门槛效应与非线性模式。研究结果在用地类型间呈现出显著异质性：资源密集型工业用地的高集中度与较低的经济韧性相关联，反映出潜在的技术锁定效应；资本密集型工业用地的调整与经济韧性呈倒U型关系；劳动密集型与技术密集型工业用地占比的上升则始终与更强的经济韧性相关，其作用机制可能源于就业扩张与知识溢出。上述发现表明，工业用地结构通过联结土地配置、要素流动与发展路径依赖，为经济韧性研究提供了互补性的分析视角。通过揭示工业用地结构与经济韧性之间差异化且受政策条件调节的关联，本研究为贫困地区韧性建设策略提供了启示。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108121.title: Structural adjustment of industrial land use and economic resilience: Evidence from China's poverty-stricken counties
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108121.title_zh: 工业用地结构调整与经济韧性：来自中国贫困县的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108122.abstract: Rapid urbanization is transforming the structure of agriculture across Africa; however, its impact on crop diversification remains debated. Using georeferenced data from the Tanzania LSMS-ISA survey and a double-hurdle econometric model, this study examines the motivators of diversification in peri-urban environments. We compare mainland with the extreme land scarcity and real-estate pressures of Zanzibar; we find important structural paradoxes. First, a negative relationship exists between formal land tenure and the degree of diversification. This finding suggests that property rights in hyper-specified markets provide incentives to the commodification of land and monoculture instead of complex farming systems. Second, the study dismisses the linear scale-diversification hypothesis by showing a strong u-shaped pattern in the mainland peri-urban zones. Micro-holders diversify mainly for survival (distress push) while large commercial farms diversify for profit (accumulation push) and leave medium-scale operations to specialize. Moreover, biophysical factors, especially heavy clay soils, significantly restrict diversification options regardless of economic incentives. These results raise questions about the validity of uniform policy frameworks and suggest that conventional land titling programs, highly speculative real-estate markets could potentially harm agro-biodiversity in rapidly growing island economies unless they are accompanied by agricultural conservation programs.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108122.abstract_zh: 快速城市化正在改变非洲的农业结构，然而其对作物多样化的影响仍存争议。本研究利用坦桑尼亚LSMS-ISA调查的地理参照数据，并采用双重门槛计量经济模型，探讨了城郊环境中多样化的驱动因素。我们将大陆与土地极度稀缺且面临房地产压力的桑给巴尔进行比较，发现了重要的结构性悖论。首先，正式土地权属与多样化程度之间存在负相关关系。这一发现表明，在高度特定化的市场中，产权激励了土地商品化和单一作物种植，而非复杂的农业系统。其次，本研究否定了线性规模-多样化假说，揭示了大陆城郊区域呈现强烈的U型模式。微型农户主要出于生存需求（困境推动）而多样化，大型商业农场则为了利润（积累推动）而多样化，而中等规模经营则趋于专业化。此外，生物物理因素，尤其是重黏土土壤，显著限制了多样化选择，无论经济激励如何。这些结果对统一政策框架的有效性提出质疑，并表明，除非伴随农业保护计划，否则常规的土地确权项目和高度投机的房地产市场可能对快速发展的岛屿经济中的农业生物多样性造成潜在损害。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108122.title: The speculation trap and the distress push: Divergent pathways of peri-urban agriculture in Tanzania
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108122.title_zh: 投机陷阱与困境推动：坦桑尼亚城郊农业的分化路径

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108125.abstract: China’s agricultural sector is a key contributor to global carbon emissions, making improvements in Agricultural Carbon Emission Efficiency (ACEE) crucial for achieving climate and food security goals. Departing from traditional studies that often assume a singular nationwide evolutionary path, this research investigates the divergent convergence dynamics of ACEE through the lens of land-use modes to map its long-term evolution. By applying a club convergence methodology to provincial panel data from 2004 to 2020, we reject the hypothesis of a unique steady state and identify instead five distinct convergence clubs with heterogeneous equilibrium pathways, alongside a small group of non-converging provinces. The results reveal that agricultural land-use modes act as a fundamental sorting mechanism: while diversified systems generally facilitate higher efficiency equilibria, specialized production bases often face efficiency bottlenecks despite their scale advantages. Furthermore, the economic drivers of efficiency differ markedly across clusters, showing that imbalanced fixed-asset investment constrains further gains in high-efficiency regions, whereas narrowing urban-rural income gaps consistently supports efficiency across most clubs. These findings underscore the necessity of club-specific, locally adapted strategies that align production systems, land-use modes, and factor inputs with regional realities to foster sustainable agricultural development and enhance China's contribution to global carbon reduction.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108125.abstract_zh: 中国农业部门是全球碳排放的重要贡献者，因此提升农业碳排放效率（ACEE）对于实现气候与粮食安全目标至关重要。不同于传统研究往往假设全国存在单一演化路径，本研究从土地利用模式的视角探讨ACEE的差异化收敛动态，以描绘其长期演变趋势。通过将俱乐部收敛方法应用于2004年至2020年的省级面板数据，我们拒绝了单一稳态的假设，识别出五个具有异质性均衡路径的收敛俱乐部，以及一小部分不收敛的省份。研究结果显示，农业土地利用模式作为基本的分类机制发挥作用：多元化系统通常促进更高效率的均衡状态，而专业化生产基地尽管具有规模优势，却常面临效率瓶颈。此外，各俱乐部间的经济驱动因素差异显著，表明固定资本投资失衡限制了高效率地区的进一步增益，而缩小城乡收入差距在大多数俱乐部中持续支持效率提升。这些发现强调了针对俱乐部特定、因地制宜策略的必要性，使生产系统、土地利用模式和要素投入与区域实际相匹配，以促进农业可持续发展，并增强中国对全球碳减排的贡献。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108125.title: Agricultural carbon emission efficiency and its regional convergence in China: Role of land use modes and economic factors
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108125.title_zh: 中国农业碳排放效率及其区域收敛性：土地利用模式与经济因素的作用

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108127.abstract: Forestland transfer has been promoted as a key policy instrument to address severe parcelization and improve management efficiency. However, in China, despite long-standing policy support, actual transfer rates remain persistently low. While existing research attributes this to institutional and economic barriers, little is known about how smallholders’ subjective perceptions of forest values influence their market participation. This study examines how forest value orientations (FVOs), defined as smallholders’ perceived importance of different forest functions, shape their willingness, price expectations, and actual behaviors regarding forestland transfers. Using household-level data collected from timber-forest farmers across several provinces in southern China, exploratory factor analysis identifies three distinct value dimensions: ecological, economic, and emotional-symbolic. Binary Logit, Heckman two-step, and Cragg double-hurdle models are applied to estimate their effects on willingness-to-transfer, willingness-to-pay (WTP), willingness-to-accept (WTA), and realized transactions. Results show that ecological values significantly inhibit both transfer willingness and participation, likely reflecting the public-good nature and management burdens of ecologically valuable forests. In contrast, economic values promote active market engagement and narrow the WTA–WTP gap by aligning expectations with market benchmarks. Emotional-symbolic values, though less influential overall, positively affect transfer intentions, reflecting their role as private, exchangeable benefits under China’s temporary transfer arrangements. The findings highlight that subjective forest value perceptions critically shape market participation and price formation. Recognizing these heterogeneous value orientations can help policymakers design more nuanced, value-sensitive interventions to foster efficient and culturally appropriate forestland markets.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108127.abstract_zh: 林地流转已被作为应对严重细碎化问题、提升管理效率的关键政策工具加以推广。然而，在中国，尽管政策支持由来已久，实际流转率仍持续偏低。现有研究多将此归因于制度性与经济性障碍，但关于小农户对森林价值的主观认知如何影响其市场参与，学界知之甚少。本研究考察森林价值取向（FVOs）——即小农户对不同森林功能重要性的主观感知——如何塑造其林地流转意愿、价格预期及实际行为。利用来自中国南方多个省份用材林农户的家庭层面数据，探索性因子分析识别出三个不同的价值维度：生态价值、经济价值和情感—象征价值。本研究采用二元Logit模型、Heckman两步法和Cragg双重门槛模型，估计这些价值维度对流转意愿、支付意愿（WTP）、受偿意愿（WTA）及实际交易的影响。结果表明，生态价值显著抑制流转意愿和参与行为，这可能反映了生态价值较高林地的公共物品属性及管理负担。相比之下，经济价值促进积极的市场参与，并通过使预期与市场基准趋同而缩小WTA–WTP差距。情感—象征价值虽总体影响较弱，但对流转意向产生正向作用，反映出其在中国临时性流转安排下作为私人性、可交换收益的角色。研究结果凸显，主观森林价值感知对市场参与和价格形成具有关键塑造作用。识别这些异质性价值取向，有助于政策制定者设计更具针对性和价值敏感性的干预措施，以促进高效且符合文化情境的林地市场发展。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108127.title: Cognition behind land transactions: How diverse forest value orientations shape willingness, price expectations, and forestland transfer behavior in rural China
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108127.title_zh: 土地交易背后的认知：多元森林价值取向如何影响中国农村的意愿、价格预期与林地流转行为

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108135.abstract: Land use mix (LUM) metrics provide actionable evidence to monitor planning goals and prioritize interventions, including transit-oriented development, zoning revisions, and urban retrofits. Yet common measures suffer from two main limitations that often render them difficult to translate into decisions. First, all measures summarize how mixed a place is without indicating the direction of the mix, i.e. whether a homogeneous area is predominantly residential or non-residential. Second, most metrics attain their maximum LUM value at a 50/50 split, even when the citywide composition is highly asymmetric. Here we introduce the Bidirectional Global-centered Balance Index (BGBI), a bounded signed index for land use composition that preserves directionality and centers interpretation on the observed citywide reference share. We compute BGBI alongside four widely used benchmarks and empirically validate all indices against job accessibility metrics by testing whether each measure’s implied balance target coincides with accessibility optima. The analysis uses point address data to measure LUM in terms of residential and non-residential shares aggregated in H3 hexagonal grids for three Brazilian cities. The full workflow can be executed using an open-source R package, which supports reproducible computation of all indices across multiple H3 resolutions and facilitates straightforward replication and sensitivity checks. Our results indicate that the highest-accessibility locations occur near baseline-centered balance (BGBI ≅ 0), rather than near the 50/50 reference implicit in many conventional metrics. These results show that interpretability properties can change diagnostic conclusions and suggest that baseline-centered directionality provides a practical target for planning and policy monitoring.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108135.abstract_zh: 土地利用混合（LUM）指标为监测规划目标及优先干预措施（如公交导向开发、分区修订和城市更新）提供了可操作的证据。然而，常用度量方法存在两大局限，往往难以转化为决策依据。首先，所有度量均仅概括某地的混合程度，而未指明混合方向，即同质区域是以住宅为主还是非住宅为主。其次，多数指标在50/50比例时达到最大LUM值，即便城市整体构成高度不对称。本文引入双向全局中心平衡指数（BGBI），这是一种有界的有符号土地利用构成指数，既保留方向性，又以观测到的城市整体参考份额为中心进行解释。我们将BGBI与四种广泛使用的基准指标一并计算，并通过检验各指标隐含的平衡目标是否与可达性最优值一致，对所有指标进行实证验证，以对照就业可达性指标。分析采用点地址数据，以住宅与非住宅份额衡量LUM，并在三个巴西城市的H3六边形网格中聚合。完整工作流程可通过开源R包执行，支持在多种H3分辨率下对所有指标进行可复现计算，便于直接复制和敏感性检验。结果表明，最高可达性位置出现在接近基线中心平衡（BGBI ≅ 0）处，而非许多传统指标隐含的50/50参考点附近。这些结果说明，可解释性特征可能改变诊断结论，并提示以基线为中心的方向性可为规划与政策监测提供实用目标。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108135.title: BGBI: A citywide-referenced and bidirectional land use mix index for planning and policy evaluation
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108135.title_zh: BGBI：面向规划与政策评估的全域参考双向土地利用混合指数

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108137.abstract: Cropland non-agriculturalization, encompassing permanent loss and transitions to non-grain uses, drives global food insecurity. However, accurately mapping these diverse pathways across large spatiotemporal scales remains methodologically elusive. To address this, we developed a novel approach integrating multi-index temporal-spectral segmentation (LandTrendr) with Random Forest (RF) classification to map three primary cropland conversion types in China (1991–2020): conversion to non-grain uses, waterbody, and built-up land. Crucially, to explicitly overcome phenological confounding effects, we innovatively utilized the Coefficient of Variation (CV) of vegetation indices to suppress seasonal noise and extract robust inter-annual cultivation features. By employing the LandTrendr algorithm to segment these CV metrics and other multi-spectral indices, we detected the features of distinct disturbances, which subsequently served as predictors within an RF framework to map the different cropland non-agriculturalization types. This methodology yielded an 87.5 ± 1.0% overall accuracy. China's non-agriculturalized cropland reached 426,388 km2, comprising conversions to non-grain (312,771 km2), built-up (92,462 km2), and waterbody (21,155 km2). Spatially, non-grain conversions concentrated in the Northeast China Plain and northern arid/semi-arid regions. Waterbody transitions aggregated in the Middle and Lower Yangtze Plain, while built-up land expansion dominated major coastal and urban agglomerations (Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze/Pearl River Deltas). Temporally, non-grain transitions exhibited early fluctuating upward trajectories, whereas waterbody and built-up conversions peaked in 2001 and 2013, respectively. Ultimately, this research establishes a robust multi-index framework capable of untangling concurrent cropland non-agriculturalization types over vast extents. By accurately attributing spatially explicit transitions, our methodology offers a reliable mechanism for continuous monitoring and a strong empirical basis for global sustainable agricultural policies.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108137.abstract_zh: 耕地非农化，涵盖永久性丧失及向非粮用途的转变，威胁着全球粮食安全。然而，在广阔时空尺度上精确绘制这些多样化的转变路径，在方法论上仍具挑战性。为此，我们开发了一种新方法，整合多指数时间-光谱分割（LandTrendr）与随机森林（RF）分类，以绘制中国1991-2020年间三种主要耕地转化类型：非粮化、水域化和建设用地化。关键创新在于，为明确克服物候混淆效应，我们创新性地利用植被指数变异系数（CV）抑制季节性噪声，提取稳健的年内耕作特征。通过应用LandTrendr算法分割这些CV指标及其他多光谱指数，我们检测了不同干扰的特征，这些特征随后作为RF框架内的预测因子，用于绘制不同耕地非农化类型图。该方法总体精度达到87.5±1.0%。中国非农化耕地面积达426,388平方公里，包括非粮化（312,771平方公里）、建设用地化（92,462平方公里）和水域化（21,155平方公里）。空间上，非粮化转变集中于东北平原及北方干旱/半干旱地区。水域化转变聚集于长江中下游平原，而建设用地扩张主导了主要沿海及城市群（京津冀、长三角、珠三角）。时间上，非粮化转变呈现早期波动上升趋势，而水域化和建设用地化转变分别于2001年和2013年达到峰值。最终，本研究建立了一个稳健的多指数框架，能够在大范围内解析并存的耕地非农化类型。通过精确归因空间显式转变，我们的方法为持续监测提供了可靠机制，并为全球可持续农业政策提供了坚实的实证基础。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108137.title: Unpacking spatially explicit cropland non-agriculturalization in China based on satellite remote sensing data: A 30-year analysis of spatial patterns and conversion types
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108137.title_zh: 基于卫星遥感数据的中国耕地非农化空间显式解析：30年空间格局与转换类型分析

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108138.abstract: Reducing farmland abandonment is essential for protecting farmland resources and ensuring national food security. The driving mechanisms of farmland abandonment in China at the 1-km grid scale remain insufficiently understood. In this study, a composite theoretical framework integrating natural factors, socioeconomic factors, and cultivation conditions was developed to explain farmland abandonment at the grid scale. Fifteen driving variables, together with a 1-km gridded dataset of farmland abandonment ratio (the proportion of abandoned farmland relative to the total farmland area), were modelled using random forest models. The SHAPley additive explanations algorithm was applied to quantify both the individual effects and interaction effects. The results revealed that in 2019, the overall farmland abandonment ratio in China was 4.49%, with higher rates observed in mountainous areas (6.26%) than in the plains (2.22%). Stable hotspots of farmland abandonment emerged in the agro‑pastoral transition zone between the northern arid and semiarid regions and the Loess Plateau, in the southeastern coastal region, in the southwestern mountainous region, and around the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei urban agglomeration. Distinct driving mechanisms of farmland abandonment were observed between plains and mountainous areas. Increased farmland density mitigated abandonment risk across both terrains by strengthening large‑scale farming and organizational structure. In plains, farmland abandonment was governed mainly by labour, location, and organizational structure. Engineering improvements and institutional support weakened the effects of climatic and topographic factors. The influence of ageing was both stage-specific and bidirectional. In mountainous areas, farmland abandonment was driven mainly by strong coupling among climatic conditions, topography, and service accessibility. The effects of climatic conditions were amplified by their interactions with slope and altitude, resulting in the formation of a chain that extends from natural stress to mechanization constraints and ultimately to cost accumulation. The dominant driving factors of farmland abandonment varied regionally. Natural factors dominated in western high‑altitude, cold, and arid areas. Socioeconomic factors dominated in the plains and rapidly urbanizing regions. Cultivation conditions were dominant in hilly regions and areas characterized by fragmented farmland. This study enhances the understanding of farmland abandonment from a grid-scale perspective and provides guidance for regionalized governance strategies.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108138.abstract_zh: 减少农田撂荒对于保护耕地资源和保障国家粮食安全至关重要。然而，在中国1公里网格尺度上，农田撂荒的驱动机制仍未得到充分理解。本研究构建了一个整合自然因素、社会经济因素和耕作条件的综合理论框架，以解释网格尺度下的农田撂荒现象。利用随机森林模型，对十五个驱动变量及一套1公里网格化的农田撂荒率（撂荒农田占农田总面积的比例）数据集进行了建模。采用SHAPley加性解释算法量化了各变量的独立效应及其交互效应。研究结果显示，2019年中国整体农田撂荒率为4.49%，山区（6.26%）显著高于平原地区（2.22%）。农田撂荒的稳定热点区域出现在北方干旱半干旱区与黄土高原之间的农牧交错带、东南沿海地区、西南山区以及京津冀城市群周边。平原与山区的农田撂荒驱动机制存在显著差异。农田密度的增加通过强化规模化经营和组织结构，在两种地形条件下均降低了撂荒风险。在平原地区，农田撂荒主要受劳动力、区位和组织结构因素支配。工程改善和制度支持削弱了气候和地形因素的影响。老龄化的影响具有阶段性和双向性特征。在山区，农田撂荒主要由气候条件、地形和服务可及性之间的强耦合作用驱动。气候条件的影响通过与坡度和海拔的交互作用被放大，形成了从自然胁迫到机械化约束、最终到成本累积的连锁链条。农田撂荒的主导驱动因素存在区域差异。自然因素在西部高海拔、寒冷和干旱地区占主导地位。社会经济因素在平原和快速城市化地区占主导地位。耕作条件在丘陵地区和农田破碎化区域占主导地位。本研究从网格尺度深化了对农田撂荒的理解，并为分区治理策略提供了指导。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108138.title: Composite driving mechanisms of farmland abandonment in plains and mountainous areas of China from a 1-km grid perspective
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108138.title_zh: 1公里网格视角下中国平原与山区耕地撂荒的复合驱动机制

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108139.abstract: This paper examines the effects of clarifying overlapping land rights on Mailo land in Central Uganda, contributing to broader debates on property rights and rural development. The study leverages a quasi-experimental design implemented across three districts, where interventions included systematic demarcation of parcel boundaries and land inventories, dissemination of legal knowledge, conflict mediation services, and facilitation of tenant–landlord agreements. Drawing on a panel of Mailo tenants, a large-N tenant survey, and a survey of landlords, we assess how land rights awareness raising shaped institutional clarity (improved documentation and legal awareness), tenure security (reduced conflict and strengthened perceptions of security), and economic behavior (evidence of land market activity). The findings highlight the central role of annual Busuulu (ground rent) payments—functioning simultaneously as a rent obligation and as formal evidence of tenant rights—as a mechanism linking institutional reforms to greater tenure security and market participation. We further identify heterogeneous effects, with distinct patterns for female-headed households and for tenants with kinship ties to landlords on all three outcomes. Taken together, the results provide new evidence on the mechanisms through which property rights interventions shape security and economic activity in rural Africa.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108139.abstract_zh: 本文考察了澄清乌干达中部梅洛土地重叠权属对制度明晰度、产权安全及经济行为的影响，为产权与农村发展的更广泛讨论提供了新证据。研究采用准实验设计，在三个地区实施干预措施，包括地块边界的系统划定与土地清册编制、法律知识传播、冲突调解服务以及促进租户与地主间协议达成。基于梅洛租户面板数据、大规模租户调查及地主调查，我们评估了土地权利意识提升如何塑造制度明晰度（改善文件记录与法律认知）、产权安全（减少冲突并强化安全感知）及经济行为（土地市场活动的证据）。研究结果凸显了年度布苏鲁（地租）支付的核心作用——其同时作为租金义务和租户权利的正式凭证——成为连接制度改革与增强产权安全及市场参与的关键机制。我们进一步识别出异质性效应，在女性户主家庭及与地主存在亲属关系的租户中，三项结果均呈现不同模式。总体而言，本研究为产权干预如何影响非洲农村安全与经济活动提供了机制层面的新证据。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108139.title: Clarifying overlapping land rights in semi-formal systems: The case of Mailo tenant lands in Uganda
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108139.title_zh: 厘清半正式体系中的重叠土地权利：乌干达Mailo租户土地案例

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108140.abstract: Advanced producer services (APS)—as key indicators of global city functions—reinforce the hub and control capacities of central cities within the global economy. However, their spatial benefits are unevenly distributed, often bypassing surrounding small- and medium-sized cities. This study investigates how the development of APS in 35 Chinese cities at or above the "sufficiency" level of global integration contributes to regional spatial inequality. We emphasize the role of de-localization processes, whereby economic functions and flows are increasingly detached from local-regional contexts. Our findings reveal three key insights:(1) The growth of APS intensifies center–periphery inequality, reinforcing the dominance and polarization of core global cities; (2) Cross-regional economic linkages—accounting for approximately 15% of spatial disparity—exacerbate inequality beyond conventional siphoning effects, highlighting the structural impact of interurban externalities; (3) Transportation infrastructure, particularly increased cross-city traffic flows, compounds disparities by facilitating the agglomeration of APS in core cities. This integrative approach sheds light on the spatial mechanisms through which global city development reshapes regional economic balance. Our findings offer policy insights for mitigating urban polarization and promoting more equitable spatial development in rapidly globalizing economies.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108140.abstract_zh: 高级生产性服务业（APS）作为全球城市功能的关键指标，强化了中心城市在全球经济中的枢纽与控制能力。然而，其空间效益分布不均，往往绕过周边中小城市。本研究探讨了中国35个达到或超过“充分”全球化整合水平的城市中，APS的发展如何加剧区域空间不平等。我们强调去本地化过程的作用，即经济功能与流动日益脱离地方—区域背景。研究发现三大要点：（1）APS的增长加剧了中心—边缘不平等，强化了核心全球城市的主导地位与极化效应；（2）跨区域经济联系——约占空间差异的15%——在传统虹吸效应之外进一步加剧不平等，凸显了城市间外部性的结构性影响；（3）交通基础设施，尤其是城际交通流量的增加，通过促进APS在核心城市的集聚而加剧了差异。这一综合视角揭示了全球城市发展重塑区域经济平衡的空间机制。我们的研究为缓解城市极化、促进快速全球化经济体中更为公平的空间发展提供了政策启示。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108140.title: De-localization of global cities: How advanced producer services exacerbate regional spatial inequality?
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108140.title_zh: 全球城市的去地方化：高级生产者服务业如何加剧区域空间不平等？

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108141.abstract: Land multifunctionality requires integrated strategies to reconcile diverse human needs within finite resources. Conventional land sparing and sharing (LSS) frameworks, primarily applied to agricultural trade-offs between food production and biodiversity, inadequately address the non-agricultural production and living functions associated with construction land development. This study extends the LSS framework to holistically assess production, living, and ecological functions under construction land intensification. Focusing on China's karst region, we employed the Development Intensity Index (DII) as a quantitative strategy indicator. Using sub-basins in the Southwest China karst belt as analytical units over 2010–2019, we integrated land function measurements with the DII, nonparametric tests, Locally Weighted Scatterplot Smoothing (LOWESS), and Bayesian Change Point (BCP) analysis to precisely delineate spatial strategy differentiation and nonlinear functional responses. Significant nonlinear relationships and critical threshold effects were revealed between land use strategies and functions. As DII increased, production function exhibited an inverted U-shaped trend, peaking at a DII of 6.2 then declining significantly. Living function maintained a continuous positive correlation, with its growth rate accelerating slightly beyond an intensity of 10.5. Ecology function remained negatively correlated, declining sharply at a DII of 0.65 followed by a slower decrease rate. The comprehensive land function index reaches an inflection point at a DII of 6.35, beyond which its growth rate diminishes until eventually turning negative. The research quantifies key functional response thresholds, broadens the LSS framework's applicability to multifunctional land systems encompassing construction land. This finding facilitates the scientific selection of land-use strategies and promotes the transition of territorial spatial development toward coordination and sustainability.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108141.abstract_zh: 土地多功能性要求采取综合策略，在有限资源内协调多样化的人类需求。传统的土地节约与共享（LSS）框架主要应用于农业生产与生物多样性之间的权衡，未能充分涵盖与建设用地开发相关的非农业生产及生活功能。本研究将LSS框架拓展至建设用地集约化背景下生产、生活与生态功能的综合评估。以中国喀斯特地区为研究对象，采用发展强度指数（DII）作为定量化策略指标。以2010—2019年西南喀斯特带子流域为分析单元，将土地功能测度与DII、非参数检验、局部加权散点平滑（LOWESS）及贝叶斯变点（BCP）分析相结合，精确刻画空间策略分异及非线性功能响应。研究揭示了土地利用策略与功能之间显著的非线性关系及关键阈值效应。随着DII增加，生产功能呈倒U型趋势，在DII为6.2时达到峰值后显著下降；生活功能保持持续正相关，其增长率在强度超过10.5后略有加速；生态功能始终呈负相关，在DII为0.65时急剧下降，随后降速趋缓。综合土地功能指数在DII为6.35处达到拐点，此后其增长率逐渐减弱直至最终转为负值。本研究量化了关键功能响应阈值，拓展了LSS框架在涵盖建设用地的多功能土地系统中的适用性，有助于科学选择土地利用策略，推动国土空间开发向协调与可持续方向转型。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108141.title: Land sparing and sharing: Understanding the relationship between different construction land strategies and land functions in karst areas
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108141.title_zh: 土地节约与共享：理解喀斯特地区不同建设用地策略与土地功能之间的关系

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108142.abstract: Urban informality in Southern Europe remains an underexplored yet significant phenomenon, challenging dominant frameworks that primarily address informality in the Global South. This study examines the Centro Espansione Periferica (CEP) neighborhood in Palermo, Italy, to develop a taxonomy of informal settlement indicators suited to Southern European cities' specific governance, socio-economic, and spatial characteristics. Using a qualitative methodology grounded in Grounded Theory, this research integrates semi-structured interviews, document analysis, and field observations to capture the complexities of informality in a regulated urban environment. Findings reveal that informality in CEP emerges from economic hardship and governance failures, ambiguous tenure arrangements, and spatial adaptations within public housing initiatives. The study highlights key informality indicators, including weak institutional oversight, socio-spatial transformations, and informal negotiations between residents and public authorities. This taxonomy challenges binary classifications of informality and calls for a more nuanced, context-sensitive approach to land-use policies in European urban contexts. This research provides valuable perspectives for urban management and sustainable development approaches in cities facing comparable issues by emphasizing staged formalization, inclusive planning, and tailored policy measures.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108142.abstract_zh: 南欧的城市非正规性仍是一个尚未充分探索却意义重大的现象，它对主要关注全球南方非正规性的主流分析框架构成了挑战。本研究以意大利巴勒莫的Centro Espansione Periferica（CEP）社区为案例，旨在构建一套适用于南欧城市特定治理、社会经济及空间特征的非正规聚落指标分类体系。研究采用基于扎根理论的定性方法，整合半结构化访谈、文献分析和实地观察，以捕捉受规制城市环境中非正规性的复杂性。研究发现，CEP的非正规性源于经济困境与治理失灵、模糊的产权安排以及公共住房项目中的空间适应性调整。研究揭示了关键的非正规性指标，包括制度监管薄弱、社会空间转型以及居民与公共当局之间的非正式协商。该分类体系挑战了非正规性的二元划分，并呼吁在欧洲城市语境下采取更具情境敏感性的土地政策路径。通过强调分阶段正规化、包容性规划及针对性政策措施，本研究为面临类似问题的城市提供了城市管理与可持续发展方面的重要参考视角。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108142.title: Defining informality in a Southern European City indicators of informality in the CEP neighborhood, Palermo
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108142.title_zh: 定义南欧城市非正规性：巴勒莫CEP社区的非正规性指标

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108143.abstract: Global food security is increasingly challenged by issues such as population growth, cropland decline, and rapid urbanization, among which construction land expansion and its occupation of high-quality cropland have become key drivers affecting food production potential. However, existing studies have largely focused on changes in cropland quantity, with little attention to the selective occupation of high-quality cropland as well as its implications for food security. To mitigate this gap, this study develops an Indicator of the Tendency toward Preferential Occupation of high-quality cropland by construction land expansion (ITPO) based on the China Land Cover Dataset (CLCD) and farmland production potential data, which enables a quantitative assessment of the selective effects of urban expansion on cropland quality structure, hoping to provide new insights into the “land-use + food security” nexus. According to the results, several facts have been identified: (1) cropland occupied by construction land expansion exhibits a clear spatial pattern from eastern coastal regions toward inland areas. From 1985–2020, 85.93% of newly expanded construction land originated from cropland, of which 55.8% was high-quality cropland. Such occupation is primarily concentrated in major urban agglomerations, including the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Chengdu–Chongqing regions; (2) preferential occupation shows significant spatial and temporal heterogeneities, with persistent high-intensity clusters in eastern, northeastern, and central China, while western China maintains a relatively high proportion of statistically significant counties, approaching 60% in most periods (approximately 55% during 1991–2000); (3) the spatial center of both Construction Land Occupation of Cropland (CLOC) and ITPO shift westward in the study period, with a more significant displacement observed for ITPO, indicating an increasing westward redistribution of pressure on high-quality cropland; and (4) cumulative losses in food production potential caused by construction land expansion during 1985–2020 are estimated at 4.59 × 10 ¹ ⁰ kg (0.15% of total cropland potential), of which 2.69 × 10 ¹ ⁰ kg (0.09%) was high-quality cropland. Overall, although the relative intensity of preferential occupation of high-quality cropland has declined over time, its absolute loss remains substantial due to higher unit productivity and spatial concentration. By incorporating the cropland quality structure into the analysis, this study advances the understanding of the relationship between construction land expansion and food security, providing quantitative evidence to support differentiated cropland protection and territorial spatial governance strategies.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108143.abstract_zh: 全球粮食安全日益受到人口增长、耕地减少和快速城市化等问题的挑战，其中建设用地扩张及其对优质耕地的占用已成为影响粮食生产潜力的关键因素。然而，现有研究多聚焦于耕地数量的变化，较少关注对优质耕地的选择性占用及其对粮食安全的影响。为弥补这一不足，本研究基于中国土地覆盖数据集（CLCD）和农田生产潜力数据，构建了建设用地扩张对优质耕地偏好占用倾向指标（ITPO），从而能够定量评估城市扩张对耕地质量结构的选择性效应，以期为“土地利用+粮食安全”关联提供新的见解。研究结果显示：（1）建设用地扩张所占用的耕地呈现从东部沿海地区向内陆地区转移的明显空间格局。1985—2020年间，新增建设用地中85.93%来源于耕地，其中55.8%为优质耕地。此类占用主要集中在京津冀、长三角、珠三角和成渝等主要城市群；（2）偏好占用表现出显著的时空异质性，东部、东北和中部地区存在持续的高强度集聚区，而西部地区统计显著县份比例相对较高，多数时期接近60%（1991—2000年间约为55%）；（3）研究期内，建设用地占用耕地（CLOC）和ITPO的空间重心均向西移动，其中ITPO的位移更为显著，表明优质耕地面临的压力日益向西部再分配；（4）1985—2020年间，建设用地扩张导致的粮食生产潜力累计损失估计为4.59×10¹⁰千克（占耕地总潜力的0.15%），其中优质耕地损失为2.69×10¹⁰千克（占0.09%）。总体而言，尽管优质耕地偏好占用的相对强度随时间有所下降，但由于其较高的单位生产力和空间集中性，绝对损失仍然可观。通过将耕地质量结构纳入分析，本研究深化了对建设用地扩张与粮食安全关系的理解，为差异化耕地保护和国土空间治理策略提供了定量证据支持。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108143.title: Spatiotemporal dynamics of preferential occupation of high-quality cropland by construction land expansion in china and its implications for food production potential
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108143.title_zh: 中国建设用地扩张优先占用优质耕地的时空动态及其对粮食生产潜力的影响

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108144.abstract: Despite extensive research on solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption, limited attention has been given to the role of disaster experiences in accelerating the shift toward sustainable energy. This study investigates how earthquake events influence household solar adoption in Japan, leveraging a comprehensive panel dataset of Japanese regions. Employing a quasi-experimental design, we find that, following the disaster, household solar panel installations increase significantly more in affected areas than in unaffected regions. Our results underscore the behavioral response to disasters as a pivotal yet underexamined driver of renewable energy adoption. Additionally, we estimate the potential reductions in carbon emissions associated with this increased solar adoption. These findings offer actionable insights for policymakers aiming to design post-disaster policies that foster renewable energy adoption and enhance energy resilience.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108144.abstract_zh: 尽管关于太阳能光伏（PV）采用的研究已相当广泛，但关于灾害经历在加速向可持续能源转型中的作用却鲜有关注。本研究利用日本各地区的综合面板数据集，探讨地震事件如何影响家庭太阳能采用情况。通过采用准实验设计，我们发现，在灾害发生后，受灾地区的家庭太阳能板安装量显著高于未受灾地区。我们的研究结果强调了灾害后的行为反应作为可再生能源采用的一个关键但尚未充分研究的驱动因素。此外，我们还估算了与这种增加的太阳能采用相关的潜在碳排放减少量。这些发现为政策制定者设计灾后政策以促进可再生能源采用并增强能源韧性提供了可行的见解。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108144.title: Disaster exposure and residential solar adoption: Urban evidence from Japan
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108144.title_zh: 灾害暴露与住宅太阳能采用：来自日本城市的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108146.abstract: Brazil’s Rural Environmental Registry (CAR), established in 2012 under the Forest Code, is a mandatory environmental cadastral system based on self-declaration of property boundaries that plays a central role in environmental enforcement, rural credit allocation, and land-use monitoring. This study develops and applies a hierarchical conflict-resolution framework to systematically identify which portions of the CAR are procedurally reliable and analytically usable for deforestation attribution and regulatory enforcement. We analyzed 310,657 CAR registrations recorded in 2025 in Piauí, Brazil, integrating them with official tenure datasets through a sequence of hierarchical rules for the Cerrado-Caatinga transition, one of the most active agribusiness frontiers. The reconstructed tenure map, derived from the hierarchical framework representing the accumulated state of all property registrations and boundary rectifications, was applied to attribute deforestation recorded between 2013 and 2023. The primary findings indicate that intra-CAR spatial overlaps were detected nearly one-third of the registered area, with boundary conflicts concentrated among larger properties along the Cerrado agribusiness frontier. In terms of deforestation, 94.20% of vegetation loss (1236,100 ha) can be attributable to identifiable actors, of which 86.60% is associated with private properties registered in CAR and official tenure datasets. The top 1% of properties ranked by cumulative deforestation account for 71.50% of total vegetation loss between 2013 and 2023, indicating a pronounced concentration of clearing among a numerically small set of landowners. Of the deforestation associated with private properties, 73.40% is classified as illegal under the Forest Code mandates applied in this analysis, with Legal Forest Reserve deficit violations representing the dominant source of non-compliance. Although over 13 million ha of native vegetation remains on private lands, Legal Reserve deficits are concentrated among large properties in the Cerrado biome, while small properties show the largest number of individual deficit records. These results demonstrate that a hierarchical analytical framework can extract procedurally reliable information from a self-declared registry, providing a scalable basis for spatially targeted enforcement, deforestation attribution, and Forest Code compliance monitoring at the subnational level.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108146.abstract_zh: 巴西农村环境登记系统（CAR）依据《森林法》于2012年设立，是一项基于产权边界自我声明的强制性环境地籍制度，在环境执法、农村信贷分配和土地利用监测中发挥着核心作用。本研究开发并应用了一个层级化冲突解决框架，以系统识别CAR中哪些部分在程序上可靠且可用于森林砍伐归因和监管执法分析。我们分析了2025年在巴西皮奥伊州登记的310，657份CAR注册记录，通过一系列层级规则将其与官方土地权属数据集整合，研究区域覆盖塞拉多-卡廷加过渡带——这是最活跃的农业边疆之一。基于该层级框架重建的土地权属地图，反映了所有产权登记和边界修正的累积状态，被用于归因2013年至2023年间记录的森林砍伐。主要研究结果表明，CAR内部空间重叠在近三分之一的登记面积中被检测到，边界冲突集中在沿塞拉多农业边疆分布的大型地产中。在森林砍伐方面，94.20%的植被损失（1，236，100公顷）可归因于可识别的行为主体，其中86.60%与在CAR和官方土地权属数据集中注册的私人地产相关。按累计森林砍伐量排名前1%的地产占2013年至2023年总植被损失的71.50%，表明森林清除在数量上较少的地主群体中呈现显著集中。在与私人地产相关的森林砍伐中，73.40%根据本分析所适用的《森林法》规定被归类为非法，其中法定森林保护区赤字违规是主要的合规性问题来源。尽管私人土地上仍有超过1300万公顷的原生植被，但法定保护区赤字集中在塞拉多生物群落的大型地产中，而小型地产则显示出最多的个体赤字记录。这些结果表明，层级化分析框架能够从自我声明登记系统中提取程序上可靠的信息，为地方层面的空间定向执法、森林砍伐归因和《森林法》合规监测提供了可扩展的基础。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108146.title: Land use transformations and tenure conflicts in the Cerrado-Caatinga frontier: Evidence from Piauí, Brazil
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108146.title_zh: 塞拉多-卡廷加交界地带的土地利用转型与权属冲突：来自巴西皮奥伊州的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108147.abstract: As the concept of soil health gains prominence, it becomes increasingly important to examine how states design and implement soil health policies. Does soil health offer a novel pathway to enact and legitimize institutional changes toward more sustainable farming systems, or does it risk becoming another neologism that preserves status quo, productivist agriculture? We explore these questions through an analysis of one of the most ambitious state-led initiatives organized around soil health: India’s Soil Health Card (SHC) scheme. The SHC scheme seeks to provide every farmer in the country with bi-annual soil test reports, based on the assumption that improved information will encourage more judicious use of fertilizers and pesticides. The assumption reflects a broader emphasis within the agricultural sciences on the importance of quantifying soil health. Drawing on government documents and farmer perception studies (n = 38), we find that although farmers view the cards positively, they make few substantive changes to their farming practices. As an illustrative case, India’s grand SHC scheme shows that quantification alone is insufficient and could even dampen momentum for transformative policy reforms. Effective and durable change lies in pairing efforts to quantify soil health with (a) plural epistemic approaches to knowledge pr
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108147.abstract_zh: 随着土壤健康概念的日益凸显，审视各州如何设计与实施土壤健康政策变得愈发重要。土壤健康是否为朝向更可持续农业系统的制度变革提供了一条新颖路径，抑或它有可能沦为又一个维护现状、维持生产主义农业的新术语？我们通过分析印度最雄心勃勃的以土壤健康为核心的国家主导计划之一——土壤健康卡（SHC）计划，来探讨这些问题。该计划旨在为全国每位农民提供每两年一次的土壤检测报告，其前提假设是，改善信息将鼓励更明智地使用化肥和农药。这一假设反映了农业科学界对量化土壤健康重要性的广泛强调。基于政府文件和农民感知研究（样本数=38），我们发现，尽管农民对这些卡片持积极态度，但他们在耕作实践中几乎没有做出实质性改变。作为典型案例，印度宏大的土壤健康卡计划表明，仅靠量化并不足够，甚至可能削弱对变革性政策改革的推动力。有效且持久的变革在于将量化土壤健康的努力与（a）多元知识论方法相结合，以促进知识生产与传播。

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108148.abstract: We empirically examined the impact of gender equality on forest protection using data for 151 countries from 2000 to 2023 via panel estimation. The results supported that gender equality usually associates with more forest protection, which is reliable while we conducted regression by changing estimations, employing measurements of forest protection and gender equality. In addition, this positive impact is weakened by industrial structure, income inequality, governmental spending, while it is stronger among OECD countries. Moreover, the positive impact of gender equality on forest protection is weaker among right-wing governments and countries with political corruption, while it is strengthened by governmental effectiveness, political stability and regulatory quality. Finally, growing disasters such as epidemics and wet mass movement would reduce gender equality’s positive impact on forest protection, while renewable energy consumption would benefit for it. Our conclusions offered several policy implications for governments to promote forest protection.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108148.abstract_zh: 我们利用2000年至2023年间151个国家的面板数据，实证考察了性别平等对森林保护的影响。研究结果支持性别平等通常与更有效的森林保护相关联，这一结论在通过变换估计方法、采用不同的森林保护与性别平等衡量指标进行回归后依然稳健。此外，这种积极影响会受到产业结构、收入不平等及政府支出的削弱，而在OECD国家中则更为显著。进一步地，性别平等对森林保护的正面作用在右翼政府及政治腐败严重的国家中较弱，而政府效能、政治稳定性及监管质量的提升则会强化这一效应。最后，诸如流行病和湿物质运动等日益增多的灾害会减弱性别平等对森林保护的积极影响，而可再生能源消费则对此有所助益。我们的研究结论为政府促进森林保护提供了多项政策启示。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108148.title: Impact of gender equality on forest protection: Role of economic, social, political and energy factors
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108148.title_zh: 性别平等对森林保护的影响：经济、社会、政治与能源因素的作用

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108149.abstract: Digital twin technologies are increasingly promoted to move land administration from static, two-dimensional information systems toward dynamic platforms that support real-time governance. Yet most existing studies focus on single-country pilots or narrow technical design, offering limited insight into how digital twins are embedded in legal, institutional and participatory frameworks. This paper develops and applies an eight-dimension comparative framework to examine Digital Twin–enabled Land Administration Systems (DT-LAS) in eight jurisdictions (South Korea, Singapore, China, the Netherlands, Finland, the United Kingdom, Australia and Canada), with Turkey analysed as an emerging adopter. Methodologically, the study combines structured document analysis of national strategies, international standards and peer-reviewed research with an evidence-informed maturity scoring system, synthesised in a cross-country matrix and a two-mode country–dimension network visualisation. The analysis shows that data interoperability and sustainability function as central structural hubs within the global DT-LAS landscape, whereas citizen participation consistently emerges as the weakest dimension. High DT-LAS maturity is associated not only with advanced three-dimensional (3D) and four-dimensional (4D) cadastre, Internet of Things (IoT) and Building Information Modelling (BIM) integration, but also with investment in standards-based spatial data infrastructures, cross-agency coordination and evolving cultures of citizen engagement. Turkey demonstrates strong cadastral digitisation capacity through the Land Registry and Cadastre Information System (TAKBIS) and the Spatial Property System (MEGSIS) but remains constrained by fragmented institutional arrangements and limited participatory mechanisms. The paper proposes a context-sensitive implementation roadmap for Turkey, linking technical capacity with legal, institutional and participatory reforms.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108149.abstract_zh: 数字孪生技术日益被推广，旨在将土地管理从静态的二维信息系统转向支持实时治理的动态平台。然而，现有研究大多聚焦于单一国家的试点或狭隘的技术设计，对数字孪生如何嵌入法律、制度及参与式框架的洞察有限。本文开发并应用了一个八维度比较框架，考察八个司法管辖区（韩国、新加坡、中国、荷兰、芬兰、英国、澳大利亚和加拿大）中的数字孪生赋能土地管理系统（DT-LAS），并将土耳其作为新兴采纳者进行分析。方法上，本研究将国家战略、国际标准和同行评审研究的结构化文献分析与基于证据的成熟度评分系统相结合，通过跨国矩阵和双模式国家-维度网络可视化进行综合。分析表明，数据互操作性和可持续性在全球DT-LAS格局中充当核心结构枢纽，而公民参与始终是最薄弱的维度。高DT-LAS成熟度不仅与先进的三维（3D）和四维（4D）地籍、物联网（IoT）及建筑信息模型（BIM）集成相关，还与对基于标准的地理空间数据基础设施的投资、跨机构协调以及不断发展的公民参与文化相关。土耳其通过土地登记和地籍信息系统（TAKBIS）及空间财产系统（MEGSIS）展现出强大的地籍数字化能力，但仍受制于碎片化的制度安排和有限的参与机制。本文为土耳其提出了一条情境敏感的实施方案路线图，将技术能力与法律、制度及参与式改革相衔接。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108149.title: Digital twin enabled land administration systems: A multi-dimensional comparative assessment and policy pathways for Turkey
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108149.title_zh: 数字孪生赋能的地籍管理系统：土耳其的多维比较评估与政策路径

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108150.abstract: Biodiversity loss, driven by human activities such as land-use change, climate change, and pollution, is a critical global challenge. Effective sustainability performance assessments, especially at the national level, require tools that account for biophysical characteristics alongside economic and social factors. Current methods often overlook the ecological constraints and opportunities shaped by biomes—large-scale regions defined by climatic and ecological attributes that influence ecosystem services. This study introduces Econobiome classifications, a novel country categorization system based on terrestrial ecosystem composition and the spatial distribution of economic activities, including agriculture, forestry, and night light data. Using partitioning clustering techniques, we classify countries into four distinct groupings: cropland (11 clusters), forestry (5 clusters), night light (7 clusters), and all activities (7 clusters). The classifications highlight how dominant biomes and economic activity locations shape ecological conditions and sustainability constraints. We apply the Econobiome framework to benchmark the environmental efficiency of national agricultural systems (NAS) using data envelopment analysis (DEA). Results reveal significant variation in eco-efficiency across clusters, underscoring the importance of context-sensitive comparisons in sustainability diagnostics. While the Econobiome framework improves ecological comparability across countries, it relies on national-scale data and does not capture subnational ecological and socio-economic variation. Yet, the Econobiome classification provides policymakers and researchers with a robust tool to align environmental assessments with ecological realities, improving the accuracy of sustainability benchmarks and supporting evidence-based decision-making in the face of the biodiversity crisis.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108150.abstract_zh: 生物多样性丧失，由土地利用变化、气候变化和污染等人类活动驱动，是全球面临的严峻挑战。有效的可持续性绩效评估，尤其是在国家层面，需要能够兼顾生物物理特征与经济和社会因素的工具。当前方法往往忽视了由生物群落——即由影响生态系统服务的气候和生态属性定义的大规模区域——所塑造的生态约束与机遇。本研究引入了Econobiome分类法，这是一种基于陆地生态系统组成及经济活动空间分布（包括农业、林业和夜间灯光数据）的新型国家分类体系。利用分区聚类技术，我们将国家划分为四个不同的组别：农田（11个聚类）、林业（5个聚类）、夜间灯光（7个聚类）及所有活动（7个聚类）。这些分类突显了主导生物群落和经济活动位置如何塑造生态条件和可持续性约束。我们应用Econobiome框架，通过数据包络分析（DEA）对国家农业系统（NAS）的环境效率进行基准评估。结果显示各聚类间生态效率存在显著差异，强调了在可持续性诊断中考虑情境敏感性比较的重要性。尽管Econobiome框架提高了国家间的生态可比性，但它依赖于国家尺度数据，未能捕捉次国家层面的生态和社会经济变异。然而，Econobiome分类为政策制定者和研究人员提供了一个强有力的工具，使环境评估与生态现实相契合，提高了可持续性基准的准确性，并在生物多样性危机面前支持基于证据的决策。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108150.title: Econobiomes: A terrestrial-based country classification for international sustainability comparison
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108150.title_zh: 生态经济区：基于陆地的国家分类用于国际可持续性比较

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108152.abstract: Large-scale land use changes can lead to a fundamental reorganisation of the land and corresponding socioecological regime. These regime shifts are notably hard to detect, predict or model, often arising from unprecedented changes in technology, markets or policies. In a remote rural region in Portugal, we tracked the land use history in three parishes between 1899 and 2018, capturing multiple disruptive socioeconomic and political circumstances, to assess whether a regime shift was triggered. We used a causal historical approach that included the spatio-temporal mapping of LULC changes and a socioecological event timeline to track policy changes and other important events or circumstances. We used these, and other available (historic) literature, to contextualise local information provided in oral history interviews (OHI) that revealed land managers’ decision-making during the last 70 years. We found that during the Estado Novo dictatorship, productivism-based policies had a strong influence on the observed land use intensification, yet OHI revealed that the high level of self-sufficiency agriculture made alternative trajectories unlikely if not impossible. After the 1974 revolution, recalibration took place in the form of a rural exodus and associated land reorganisation, including tenure and production systems. Overall, semi-natural areas, which usually depend on grazing or pastoralism, strongly diminished, while natural and plantation forests expanded. Arable land areas remained relatively stable across the entire study period. Our study shows that land systems that have undergone disruptive changes in the past may continue to evolve discontinuously afterwards, without causing a socioecological regime shift or breaking path dependence.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108152.abstract_zh: 大规模土地利用变化可能导致土地及其相应的社会生态体系发生根本性重组。这些体系转变往往难以察觉、预测或建模，通常源于技术、市场或政策的空前变化。在葡萄牙一个偏远的乡村地区，我们追踪了1899年至2018年间三个教区的土地利用历史，捕捉了多次破坏性的社会经济和政治环境，以评估是否触发了体系转变。我们采用了一种因果历史方法，包括土地利用/土地覆盖变化的时空制图和社会生态事件时间线，以追踪政策变化及其他重要事件或情况。我们利用这些资料及其他可用的（历史）文献，对口头历史访谈中提供的本地信息进行背景化处理，这些访谈揭示了土地管理者在过去70年间的决策过程。我们发现，在“新国家”独裁时期，基于生产主义的政策对观察到的土地利用集约化产生了强烈影响，但口头历史访谈显示，高度自给自足的农业使得替代路径即使不是不可能，也是极不可能实现的。1974年革命后，以农村人口外流及相应的土地重组（包括土地所有权和生产体系）形式进行了重新调整。总体而言，通常依赖放牧或畜牧业的半自然区域大幅减少，而自然林和人工林则有所扩展。在整个研究期间，耕地面积保持相对稳定。我们的研究表明，过去经历过破坏性变化的土地系统可能在此后继续以不连续的方式演变，而不会引发社会生态体系转变或打破路径依赖。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108152.title: Similar patterns, different processes: Persistence and change in path-dependent land systems
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108152.title_zh: 相似模式，不同过程：路径依赖土地系统中的持续与变迁

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108153.abstract: Colonial-era and systematically inaccurate mapping of Indigenous ancestral territories creates failures in land use planning and environmental governance, undermining legally mandated Tribal consultation processes in California. Through qualitative interviews with 83 participants (33 Tribal representatives, 39 agency officials, 11 other), this study reveals critical shortcomings in territorial mapping protocols that serve to exclude Tribes from consultation and misrepresent traditional territories.
