10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108251.title_zh: 不同社区参与程度的城市绿色廊道生态系统服务供给

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108256.abstract: Amid the acceleration of global warming and urbanization, summer heat has become a critical climate hazard that constrains outdoor recreation in megacities. By leveraging high-resolution spatiotemporal mobility data alongside meteorological station observations, we estimate linear mixed effects and quantile regression models to quantify the influences of multiple high-temperature metrics on visits to 234 parks of diverse typologies within the Beijing Sixth Ring Road. High temperatures are shown to decrease park visits by 11–19%. However, once the air temperature exceeds 35 °C, the marginal deterrent effect of heat duration attenuates, indicating a phenomenon of desensitization. Historical and ecological parks, together with weekday visitation, exhibit pronounced rigidity and display limited sensitivity, whereas community, comprehensive and specialized parks and weekend park visits are markedly heat responsive. These findings highlight the scope for urban planning interventions to strengthen thermal resilience. Fostering increased clustering and edge complexity for green space while tempering its connectivity, expanding the proportion of blue space, implementing time-of-day operational zoning in heat-sensitive parks, and providing seamless linkages between parks, shopping malls and metro stations can collectively mitigate heat-induced declines in park use.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108256.abstract_zh: 在全球变暖和城市化进程加速的背景下，夏季高温已成为制约特大城市户外休闲活动的关键气候风险因素。通过利用高分辨率时空移动数据与气象站观测数据相结合，我们估计了线性混合效应模型和分位数回归模型，以量化多种高温指标对北京六环内234个不同类型公园访问量的影响。研究表明，高温使公园访问量减少11%至19%。然而，当气温超过35°C时，高温持续时间的边际威慑效应减弱，呈现出一种脱敏现象。历史名园和生态公园以及工作日访问表现出明显的刚性，敏感性有限，而社区公园、综合公园、专类公园及周末公园访问则对高温反应显著。这些发现凸显了城市规划干预措施在增强热韧性方面的潜力。通过促进绿地聚集度和边缘复杂性的提升，同时适度控制其连通性，扩大蓝色空间占比，在热敏感公园实施分时段运营管理，以及构建公园、购物中心与地铁站之间的无缝衔接，均可共同缓解高温导致的公园使用下降。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108256.title: Enhancing climate adaptation through urban park planning: Modelling high-temperature visitation patterns via big data in Beijing
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108256.title_zh: 通过城市公园规划增强气候适应：基于北京大数据的高温访问模式建模

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108257.abstract: Rural industrial transfer has increasingly reshaped land-use patterns and environmental burdens in China’s countryside, yet its implications for agricultural productivity remain insufficiently understood. Guided by an extended agricultural household framework, this study examines whether the presence of highly polluting industries near rural villages is associated with changes in agricultural total factor productivity (TFP). Using panel data from the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS), we employ a difference-in-differences framework based on the reported presence of highly polluting industries within 5 km of villages. The results indicate that the emergence of nearby highly polluting industries is associated with an approximately 23% decline in agricultural household TFP. A series of robustness checks, matching analyses, and placebo exercises suggest that the negative association remains relatively stable across alternative empirical specifications. Additional analyses provide supplementary evidence broadly consistent with pollution-related channels, partly through reduced labor quality, although the available data do not allow direct observation of pollutant exposure or definitive identification of specific mechanisms. We further find substantial heterogeneity across locations and village structures: the negative association is stronger in villages located farther from provincial or county capitals and weaker in villages with higher concentrations of large surnames. These findings highlight the potentially uneven environmental costs of rural industrialization and underscore the importance of land-use governance, industrial siting regulation, and rural environmental protection for sustainable agricultural development.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108257.abstract_zh: 农村产业转移日益重塑了中国农村的土地利用格局和环境负担，但其对农业生产率的影响仍未得到充分理解。在扩展的农户家庭框架指导下，本研究考察了农村村庄附近高污染产业的存在是否与农业全要素生产率（TFP）的变化相关联。利用中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）的面板数据，我们采用基于村庄5公里范围内报告的高污染产业存在的双重差分框架。结果表明，附近高污染产业的出现与农业家庭全要素生产率约23%的下降相关联。一系列稳健性检验、匹配分析和安慰剂测试表明，这种负向关联在不同实证设定下保持相对稳定。进一步分析提供了与污染相关渠道大体一致的补充证据，部分通过降低劳动力质量实现，尽管现有数据不允许直接观察污染物暴露或明确识别具体机制。我们还发现不同地点和村庄结构之间存在显著异质性：距离省或县首府较远的村庄中负向关联更强，而大姓集中度较高的村庄中负向关联较弱。这些发现凸显了农村工业化可能带来的环境成本不均，并强调了土地利用治理、产业选址监管和农村环境保护对农业可持续发展的重要性。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108257.title: Grey fields in rural China: Industrial pollution and agricultural productivity losses
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108257.title_zh: 中国农村的灰色地带：工业污染与农业生产力损失

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108258.abstract: Achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) requires mechanisms that translate global objectives into context-sensitive local policies. Land consolidation connects land governance, spatial planning, and sustainable development, yet systematic frameworks for evaluating its alignment with the SDGs remain limited. Guided by Fit-for-Purpose (FFP) principles, this study develops an SDG-oriented framework based on the Policy Modeling Consistency (PMC) index. It first applies content analysis to extract land-consolidation measures from a national policy. It then establishes a multidimensional mapping between policy measures and SDG targets through expert consultation, constructing an indicator system covering social, economic, ecological, spatial, and managerial dimensions. Differentiated weights based on provincial development orientations and indicators of local policy innovation are incorporated to reflect the FFP principles of purpose-driven, fit-to-context, inclusiveness, and flexibility. Using 26 provincial-level administrative units in mainland China as empirical cases, the results reveal significant interprovincial variation in SDG alignment. Spatial and managerial dimensions performed strongly, while the social dimension showed a relatively high mean but considerable variation. Economic alignment was weaker, and the ecological dimension recorded the lowest mean and greatest variation. Cluster analysis identifies three policy types, including institution-led, spatial and social response-dominant, and multi-dimensional synergistic advancement. This study extends FFP from project suitability assessment to SDG-oriented policy text analysis and proposes a transferable evaluation paradigm for land governance and broader spatial planning research.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108258.abstract_zh: 实现可持续发展目标（SDGs）需要将全球目标转化为符合地方情境的政策机制。土地整治连接了土地治理、空间规划与可持续发展，然而系统评估其与SDGs契合度的框架仍然有限。本研究以“适用性”（Fit-for-Purpose, FFP）原则为指导，基于政策建模一致性（PMC）指数构建了一个面向SDGs的评估框架。首先，运用内容分析法从国家政策中提取土地整治措施；其次，通过专家咨询建立政策措施与SDG目标之间的多维映射关系，构建涵盖社会、经济、生态、空间和管理五个维度的指标体系。为体现FFP原则中目标导向、情境适配、包容性和灵活性的要求，本研究纳入基于省级发展导向的差异化权重及地方政策创新指标。以中国大陆26个省级行政单元为实证案例，结果显示各省份在SDG契合度上存在显著差异。空间和管理维度表现较强，社会维度均值较高但变异较大，经济维度契合度相对较弱，生态维度均值最低且变异最大。聚类分析识别出三种政策类型，包括制度主导型、空间与社会响应主导型以及多维协同推进型。本研究将FFP从项目适宜性评估拓展至面向SDGs的政策文本分析，并为土地治理及更广泛的空间规划研究提出了一种可迁移的评估范式。

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108259.abstract: Understanding the spatial distribution of air pollutants is essential for supporting air-quality management and land-use planning. This study developed an exploratory XGBoost–GAN framework to reconstruct annual PM2.5 and NO2 surfaces and to examine model-indicated pollutant-pattern differences under land-use scenarios in the Sichuan Basin, China. Annual observations from 113 monitoring stations during 2014–2024 were combined with multi-source auxiliary rasters, including aerosol optical depth, meteorological variables, land-use/land-cover data, nighttime light, elevation, and population density. Random Forest, Long Short-Term Memory, and XGBoost models were trained using 2014–2023 data and independently evaluated using 2024 station observations. XGBoost achieved the best overall performance, with R² values of 0.71 and 0.81 for PM2.5 and NO2, respectively, and was therefore used to generate 1-km baseline pollutant surfaces for 2024. Two Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) models were then trained to translate land-use images into XGBoost-estimated pollutant maps, enabling scenario experiments involving plant, built-up land, and water-body configurations. Under the condition of exploratory mode response rather than causal analysis, the scenario analysis results indicate that multiple land use layouts are related to the local decrease in pollutant concentrations estimated by the model. This study provides a data-driven approach for joint pollutant mapping and preliminary screening of land-use planning scenarios, while highlighting the need for validation with observed land-use transitions in future work.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108259.abstract_zh: 理解空气污染物的空间分布对于支持空气质量管理和土地利用规划至关重要。本研究开发了一种探索性的XGBoost–GAN框架，用于重建中国四川盆地年度PM2.5和NO2浓度表面，并检验在土地利用情景下模型指示的污染物格局差异。研究结合了2014—2024年间113个监测站的年度观测数据与多源辅助栅格数据，包括气溶胶光学厚度、气象变量、土地利用/覆盖数据、夜间灯光、高程和人口密度。利用2014—2023年数据训练了随机森林、长短期记忆网络和XGBoost模型，并使用2024年站点观测数据进行独立评估。XGBoost取得了最佳整体性能，PM2.5和NO2的R²值分别为0.71和0.81，因此被用于生成2024年1公里分辨率的基线污染物浓度表面。随后训练了两个生成对抗网络（GAN）模型，将土地利用图像转换为XGBoost估算的污染物地图，从而支持涉及植被、建设用地和水体配置的情景实验。在探索性模式响应而非因果分析的前提下，情景分析结果表明，多种土地利用布局与模型估算的局部污染物浓度下降相关。本研究提供了一种数据驱动的方法，用于联合污染物制图和土地利用规划情景的初步筛选，同时强调未来工作中需利用观测到的土地利用变化进行验证。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108259.title: An XGBoost-GAN framework for mapping PM2.5 and NO2 and exploring land-use scenarios in the Sichuan Basin
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108259.title_zh: 基于XGBoost-GAN框架的四川盆地PM2.5与NO2制图及土地利用情景探索

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108260.abstract: Coastal cities face significant challenges in urban growth planning due to rapid urbanization, exposure to natural hazards, and heightened vulnerability to climate change. These challenges are particularly acute in developing countries, which host nearly 90% of at-risk coastal populations. However, effective planning in these contexts is often constrained by the scarcity of reliable spatial data. To address this issue, this study integrates ubiquitous big data sources and SDG-based parameters to develop a Sustainable Urban Growth Scenario (SUGS) and a Normal Urban Growth Scenario (NUGS). A hybrid cellular automata approach combining Fuzzy-CA and CA-Markov was applied to project land-use change in Chabahar and Konarak on Iran’s Makran coast. Results indicate that under NUGS, the cities may expand by over 1.9 million hectares by 2050, leading to extensive development within environmentally sensitive zones. In contrast, SUGS promotes a leapfrog development pattern. This study contributes an SDG-guided, ubiquitous big data-driven framework for guiding urban growth in coastal cities facing environmental challenges. The findings offer useful insights for policymakers and regional planners seeking to support resilient coastal urban management and disaster risk reduction, particularly in least developed countries.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108260.abstract_zh: 沿海城市在快速城市化、自然灾害暴露以及气候变化脆弱性加剧的背景下，面临着城市增长规划的重大挑战。这些挑战在发展中国家尤为严峻，这些国家集中了全球近90%的沿海高风险人口。然而，在这些地区进行有效规划往往受限于可靠空间数据的稀缺。为解决这一问题，本研究整合了泛在性大数据源和基于可持续发展目标（SDG）的参数，开发了可持续城市增长情景（SUGS）和常态城市增长情景（NUGS）。采用结合模糊元胞自动机（Fuzzy-CA）和CA-Markov的混合元胞自动机方法，对伊朗马克兰海岸的恰巴哈尔和科纳拉克的土地利用变化进行了预测。结果表明，在NUGS情景下，到2050年这些城市可能扩张超过190万公顷，导致环境敏感区内的大规模开发。相比之下，SUGS情景则促进了跳跃式发展模式。本研究提供了一个以SDG为导向、泛在性大数据驱动的框架，用于指导面临环境挑战的沿海城市的城市增长。研究结果为政策制定者和区域规划者提供了有益见解，以支持韧性沿海城市管理和灾害风险降低，特别是在最不发达国家。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108260.title: Sustainable urban growth scenario for climate-vulnerable coastal cities: An analysis based on ubiquitous big data and a hybrid fuzzy-cellular automata
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108260.title_zh: 气候脆弱沿海城市的可持续城市增长情景：基于泛在大数据与混合模糊元胞自动机的分析

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108261.abstract: Rapid urbanization is reshaping landscapes worldwide, concentrating populations and economic activities while intensifying environmental challenges. Understanding the long-term impacts of three-dimensional (3-D) urban expansion on the thermal environment is essential for advancing the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals and mitigating climate change. While the urban heat island (UHI) effect has been extensively studied, most research has overlooked how regional-scale long-term thermal dynamics evolve under sustained 3-D urban expansion. Previous studies have largely focused on single or several cities in short time periods, leaving the long-term regional consequences of 3-D expansion poorly understood. Here, we examined the Yangtze River Delta (YRD) region from 2000 to 2020 to assess how long-term 3-D (horizontal and vertical) urban expansion shapes land surface temperature (LST) and surface urban heat island intensity (SUHII). During this period, impervious surface area (ISA) increased from 16493.90 km² to 51738.24 km², while mean building height (BH) showed a slight overall increase, indicating the coexistence of rapid horizontal expansion and moderate vertical urban growth. Both annual mean LST and SUHII show a fluctuating but overall upward trend during daytime and nighttime. In a 3-D context, LST and SUHII were positively correlated with impervious surface coverage (ISC) and BH. Notably, when the horizontal urban intensity gradient was in the range of 0–0.4, the value of LST was relatively low. The increase in SUHII along the horizontal urban intensity gradient at nighttime was smaller than at daytime, and there was an obvious inflection point (ISC = 0.8). In addition, when the vertical urban intensity gradient ranged from 20 to 30 m, it had the most unfavorable impact on the thermal environment of the YRD region. These findings provide novel insights into the long-term thermal impacts of 3-D urban expansion. They highlight critical thresholds of urban form that exacerbate heat stress, offering valuable implications for formulating effective urban heat adaptation policies in rapidly urbanizing regions.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108261.abstract_zh: 快速城市化正在重塑全球景观，集中人口和经济活动，同时加剧环境挑战。理解三维（3-D）城市扩张对热环境的长期影响，对于推进联合国可持续发展目标和减缓气候变化至关重要。尽管城市热岛（UHI）效应已被广泛研究，但大多数研究忽视了在持续的三维城市扩张下，区域尺度的长期热动态如何演变。以往研究多聚焦于单个或少数城市在短时间内的变化，导致对三维扩张的长期区域后果认识不足。本研究以2000年至2020年的长江三角洲（YRD）地区为例，评估长期三维（水平和垂直）城市扩张如何塑造地表温度（LST）和地表城市热岛强度（SUHII）。在此期间，不透水表面面积（ISA）从16493.90平方公里增加到51738.24平方公里，而平均建筑高度（BH）总体略有上升，表明快速水平扩张与适度垂直城市增长并存。年际平均LST和SUHII在白天和夜间均呈现波动但总体上升的趋势。在三维背景下，LST和SUHII与不透水表面覆盖率（ISC）和BH呈正相关。值得注意的是，当水平城市强度梯度在0–0.4范围内时，LST值相对较低。夜间沿水平城市强度梯度的SUHII增幅小于白天，并存在明显的拐点（ISC = 0.8）。此外，当垂直城市强度梯度在20至30米范围内时，对长三角地区热环境的不利影响最为显著。这些发现为三维城市扩张的长期热影响提供了新颖见解，揭示了加剧热应激的城市形态关键阈值，为快速城市化地区制定有效的城市热适应政策提供了宝贵启示。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108261.title: Long-term impact of 3-D urban expansion on the thermal environment in the Yangtze River Delta region, China
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108261.title_zh: 长三角地区三维城市扩张对热环境的长期影响

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108262.abstract: Agri-food products with geographical indications (GI products) are territorially embedded agricultural systems whose production and value depend on legally defined protection boundaries, rendering them biophysically vulnerable to climate change. Despite extensive examination of terroir-associated climate risks, the heterogeneous climate-driven potential land-use risks across product categories and protection boundaries remain insufficiently understood. Based on 7260 planting occurrence records, this study employs the MaxEnt model to conduct an exploratory simulation of shifts in the suitable areas for 185 Chinese GI products across seven categories under the China-EU GI Agreement. Consequently, it identifies high-risk GI products/categories, assesses their potential sensitivity and pressures from intra- and extra-zone exposure disparities under future climate scenarios. This study addresses three core questions: (i) identifying key environmental variables; (ii) assessing the potential climate sensitivity of specific categories; and (iii) quantifying potential intra- and extra-zone exposure pressures. Results demonstrate that (1) climatic factors constitute the primary biophysical drivers of GI product suitability, followed by topographic and soil factors; (2) Tea & Coffee products exhibit the highest potential climate sensitivity among all categories, while 35 identified high-sensitivity GI products face significant suitable area change or displacement risks; and (3) under future climate scenarios, the potential legal exposure induced by suitability expansion outside designated GI zones is projected to be approximately twice that of the potential moral hazard to product quality arising from environmental mismatches inside, underscoring a profound spatial mismatch between shifting ecological niches and static institutional boundaries. These findings highlight emerging land-use and institutional governance challenges for GI systems under climate change, offering policy insights for empowering entrepreneurial resilience, implementing category-specific interventions, and dynamically adjusting GI protection boundaries.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108262.abstract_zh: 具有地理标志的农产品（GI产品）是根植于特定地域的农业系统，其生产和价值依赖于法律界定的保护边界，因此在生物物理层面易受气候变化影响。尽管关于风土相关气候风险的研究已较为广泛，但不同产品类别及保护边界内由气候驱动的潜在土地利用风险的异质性仍未得到充分理解。基于7260条种植发生记录，本研究采用MaxEnt模型，对中国-欧盟GI协定下七大类185种中国GI产品适宜区变化进行了探索性模拟。据此，识别出高风险GI产品/类别，并评估其在未来气候情景下因区内与区外暴露差异而产生的潜在敏感性与压力。本研究回应三个核心问题：（i）识别关键环境变量；（ii）评估特定类别的潜在气候敏感性；（iii）量化区内与区外潜在暴露压力。结果表明：（1）气候因素是GI产品适宜性的首要生物物理驱动因子，其次为地形和土壤因素；（2）茶与咖啡类产品在所有类别中表现出最高的潜在气候敏感性，而识别出的35种高敏感性GI产品面临显著的适宜区变化或位移风险；（3）在未来气候情景下，因适宜区扩展至指定GI区域之外而引发的潜在法律暴露预计约为因区内环境错配导致产品质量潜在道德风险的2倍，凸显了生态位迁移与静态制度边界之间的深刻空间错配。这些发现揭示了气候变化下GI系统面临的新兴土地利用与制度治理挑战，为增强创业韧性、实施类别差异化干预及动态调整GI保护边界提供了政策启示。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108262.title: Heterogeneous climate risks for China's GI products under the China-EU Agreement: Disentangling effects across product categories and protection boundaries?
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108262.title_zh: 《中欧协定下中国地理标志产品的异质性气候风险：产品类别与保护边界的效应分解》

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108263.abstract: How do forest owners and managers – as policy addressees - intend to respond to EU policy – such as biodiversity and climate policy objectives - across different national contexts? Addressing this question, the study builds on social science behavioral theories to derive forest owner and manager types (FOTs) based on distinct decision-making logics. Using survey data from 1573 respondents in five European countries (Germany, Poland, Slovenia, Spain, and Sweden) and applying hierarchical cluster analysis, the study quantitatively identifies and validates these behavioral types across diverse institutional and ecological settings. The results show that multifunctionalists consistently support EU biodiversity and climate objectives, while optimizers tend to prioritize economic outcomes and often oppose regulatory interventions. Environmentalists display generally positive but context-dependent responses, whereas traditionalists show more limited support, particularly for stricter conservation measures. Across countries, the presence of similar behavioral types but varying response patterns highlights the importance of national context in shaping policy support and resistance. By linking behavioral typologies to EU policy objectives, the study advances forest policy and Europeanization research by introducing an actor-centered explanation of differentiated policy implementation outcomes. The findings provide insights for more targeted and context-sensitive policy design, while acknowledging the limits of survey-based measures of behavioral responses.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108263.abstract_zh: 森林所有者和管理者作为政策对象，在不同国家背景下如何回应欧盟政策——例如生物多样性和气候政策目标？针对这一问题，本研究基于社会科学行为理论，依据不同的决策逻辑推导出森林所有者和管理者类型（FOTs）。利用来自五个欧洲国家（德国、波兰、斯洛文尼亚、西班牙和瑞典）1573名受访者的调查数据，并应用层次聚类分析，研究在多样化的制度和生态情境中定量识别并验证了这些行为类型。结果表明，多功能主义者始终支持欧盟的生物多样性和气候目标，而优化者倾向于优先考虑经济结果，并常常反对监管干预。环保主义者表现出总体积极但依情境而异的回应，而传统主义者则显示出较为有限的支持，尤其是在更严格的保护措施方面。跨国比较显示，相似行为类型的存在但回应模式各异，凸显了国家背景在塑造政策支持与抵制中的重要性。通过将行为类型学与欧盟政策目标相联系，本研究引入了一种以行动者为中心的解释，推进了森林政策和欧洲化研究，阐明了政策实施结果的差异性。研究结果为更具针对性和情境敏感性的政策设计提供了见解，同时也承认基于调查的行为回应测量存在局限性。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108263.title: How policy addressees intend to respond to EU policy change? A cross-country survey analysis of forest owner behavioral types and responses to EU biodiversity and climate objectives
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108263.title_zh: 政策对象如何应对欧盟政策变化？森林所有者行为类型及其对欧盟生物多样性与气候目标响应的跨国调查分析

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108264.abstract: Land degradation and climate change remain pressing challenges to agricultural development in Ethiopia, where rural farm households rely heavily on rainfed agriculture amid mounting ecological stress and climate risks. Although Sustainable Land Management (SLM) practices are central to mitigating these risks, intervention outcomes are mixed, and most empirical studies rarely consider the recursive and endogenous nature of farmers’ adaptation decisions, failing to distinguish between independent and conditionally interdependent adaptation decisions, leaving a missing link in our understanding of their combined effects. While the standard multivariate probit model accounts for interdependence through correlated error terms, it still overlooks the structural and directional connections among SLM adaptation choices. Recursive specifications explicitly capture how upstream adaptation conditioned the feasibility and effectiveness of downstream adaptation, incorporating both correlation and causal ordering across SLM domains. Using this framework, the study investigates the determinants and interdependencies among structural, agronomic, and ecosystem-based SLM adaptation strategies, employing nationally representative data and a recursive multivariate probit (RMVP) model. Using 15,839 pooled observations from two waves of the Ethiopian Living Standards Measurement Survey (2018/19 and 2021/22), we modeled the recursive relationships among the three adaptation domains. Results demonstrate that the uptake of structural and agronomic measures significantly enhances ecosystem-based adaptation. In contrast, agronomic adaptation is positively influenced by structural adaptation, revealing strong complementarities among SLM technologies. Other exogenous covariates, such as education level, annual expenditure, food security, landholding, and participation in watershed programs, significantly increase the likelihood of adaptation, whereas market distance and plot remoteness constrain adaptation decisions. Viewing decision-making as a recursive process offers a more realistic depiction of how smallholders integrate multiple adaptation pathways amid complex socioeconomic and ecological constraints. Policies that promote integrated SLM practices are more likely to yield resilient, sustainable, and climate-smart land-use outcomes in Ethiopia.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108264.abstract_zh: 土地退化与气候变化仍是埃塞俄比亚农业发展面临的紧迫挑战，该国农村农户在生态压力与气候风险日益加剧的背景下，高度依赖雨养农业。尽管可持续土地管理（SLM）实践是缓解这些风险的核心手段，但干预效果参差不齐，且多数实证研究很少考虑农户适应决策的递归性与内生性特征，未能区分独立适应决策与条件性相互依赖的适应决策，导致对其综合效应的理解存在缺失环节。标准多元概率比模型虽通过误差项相关性考虑了相互依赖关系，但仍忽视了SLM适应选择之间的结构性与方向性联系。递归设定明确刻画了上游适应如何制约下游适应的可行性与有效性，将SLM各领域间的相关性与因果顺序同时纳入分析。基于这一框架，本研究利用具有全国代表性的数据，采用递归多元概率比（RMVP）模型，考察结构性、农艺性和基于生态系统的SLM适应策略的决定因素及其相互依赖关系。利用埃塞俄比亚生活水平测量调查两轮数据（2018/19和2021/22年度）汇总的15，839个观测值，本研究对三类适应领域之间的递归关系进行了建模。结果表明，结构性措施和农艺措施的采纳显著促进了基于生态系统的适应；而农艺适应受到结构性适应的正向影响，揭示了SLM技术之间存在较强的互补性。其他外生协变量，如教育水平、年支出、粮食安全、土地持有量及参与流域治理项目，均显著提高适应概率，而市场距离和地块偏远程度则制约适应决策。将决策过程视为递归过程，能够更真实地刻画小农户在复杂社会经济与生态约束下如何整合多种适应路径。促进SLM综合实践的政策更有可能在埃塞俄比亚实现具有韧性、可持续和气候智慧型的土地利用结果。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108264.title: Exploring the determinants and recursive influences of land degradation and climate change adaptation technologies in Ethiopia: Evidence from a recursive multivariate probit model
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108264.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚土地退化与气候变化适应技术的决定因素及递归影响探究：来自递归多元概率模型的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108265.abstract: Communal Reserves were established as a co-management compromise between the Peruvian state and Amazonian indigenous peoples to promote biodiversity conservation and indigenous territorial rights. However, these areas face escalating land grabbing, environmental degradation and violence. This study utilizes archival, spatial, and ethnographic data to analyze the magnitude, drivers, and mechanisms of Land Use and Land Cover Change (LULCC) in El Sira Communal Reserve and its buffer zone. We find that current pressures stem from a longstanding legacy of state-led colonization and agricultural development preceding the reserve’s creation. Our spatial analysis shows that El Sira’s deforestation and agricultural expansion rates are the highest among all Peruvian Communal Reserves and their buffer zones. Finally, our ethnographic action research highlights the role of subnational governments in facilitating LULCC through state-backed dispossession of indigenous lands. Our discussion exposes the limitations of co-managed conservation in the Central Peruvian Amazon, where growth coalitions and a legacy of settler colonization provide the administrative infrastructure necessary to transform protected forests into private assets.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108265.abstract_zh: 社区保护区（Communal Reserves）是秘鲁国家与亚马逊原住民之间为促进生物多样性保护和原住民土地权利而建立的共同管理折中方案。然而，这些区域正面临日益严重的土地侵占、环境退化和暴力问题。本研究利用档案、空间和民族志数据，分析埃尔西拉社区保护区及其缓冲区内土地利用与土地覆盖变化（LULCC）的规模、驱动因素和机制。我们发现，当前的压力源于保护区建立之前长期存在的国家主导的殖民化和农业发展遗留问题。空间分析显示，埃尔西拉地区的森林砍伐和农业扩张率在秘鲁所有社区保护区及其缓冲区中最高。最后，我们的民族志行动研究揭示了地方政府在通过国家支持的原住民土地剥夺促进LULCC中所扮演的角色。我们的讨论揭示了秘鲁中部亚马逊地区共同管理保护的局限性，在那里，增长联盟和定居者殖民化的遗留问题提供了将受保护森林转变为私人资产所需的行政基础设施。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108265.title: When co-managed conservation fails: Environmental degradation and state-backed dispossession of indigenous lands in communal reserves in the Peruvian Amazon
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108265.title_zh: 共同管理保护失败之时：秘鲁亚马逊社区保护区中的环境退化与国家支持的原住民土地剥夺

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108266.abstract: Africa is urbanizing rapidly. In many cases, cities are expanding into areas where land is held under customary tenure, which differ in important ways from the ‘transparent, secure, and alienable’ private rights that underpin most models of cities in urban economic theory. This paper therefore asks: how does customary tenure shape the development, use, and value of land in urbanizing areas? Drawing on a unique data set of 1400 households in eThekwini Municipality, Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition analysis is used to examine observable differences in characteristics and values of housing located in legally recognized customary areas with those that are not. The results provide a rare empirical snapshot on urban development patterns in this context, revealing variation in housing values across these two areas that is largely attributed to differences in public services rather than factors that are widely linked to individual investment decisions and tenure security, such as housing size and quality of building materials. We also find tentative evidence of a price discount for housing on customary land in densely urbanized areas and a price premium in more rural locations, raising questions for further research on the interaction between property rights and spatial transformation.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108266.abstract_zh: 非洲正在快速城市化。在许多情况下，城市扩张进入了以习惯法土地权属持有的区域，这些区域与支撑城市经济理论中大多数城市模型的“透明、安全且可转让”的私人权利存在重要差异。因此，本文探讨的问题是：习惯法土地权属如何影响城市化地区的土地开发、使用及价值？基于eThekwini市1400户家庭的独特数据集，采用Blinder-Oaxaca分解分析，考察位于法律认可的习惯法区域与非此类区域住房特征和价值的可观测差异。结果提供了关于这一背景下城市发展模式的罕见实证快照，揭示出这两类区域住房价值的差异主要归因于公共服务差异，而非广泛与个人投资决策和土地权属保障相关的因素，如住房面积和建筑材料质量。我们还发现了在高度城市化区域习惯法土地上住房存在价格折价，而在更偏远地区则存在价格溢价的初步证据，这为关于产权与空间转型之间互动的进一步研究提出了问题。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108266.title: Customary property rights and urban property values: Insights from Ingonyama Trust lands in Durban, South Africa
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108266.title_zh: 习俗产权与城市房产价值：来自南非德班Ingonyama信托土地的启示

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108267.abstract: Market-based instruments and land-use management are key mechanisms for emission reduction, directly influencing regional carbon storage and constituting critical considerations for achieving the “dual-carbon” goals. Previous studies have primarily assessed the response of regional carbon storage to land-use management, while largely overlooking the role of market-based instruments. As an integration of market mechanisms and land-use management, whether Transfer of Development Rights (TDR) can effectively improve regional carbon storage remains unclear. Therefore, it is necessary to explore the impact of TDR on regional carbon storage. This study employs the PLUS model to simulate four land-use scenarios in Guangxi for 2030: Baseline Scenario (BS), Development Scenario (DS), Protection Scenario (PS), and TDR scenarios (TDR). On this basis, the InVEST model is used to quantify carbon storage under each scenario. Through scenario comparison, the impact of TDR on regional carbon storage is identified. The results indicate that TDR improves regional carbon storage by optimizing land-use structure and reallocating development rights across zones. With a total carbon storage of 3269,444.5 × 10⁴t, the TDR represents an optimal solution that balances regional development and ecological protection, aligning with China’s territorial spatial governance and green low-carbon development policies. Therefore, this study provides an effective pathway for promoting low-carbon land use.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108267.abstract_zh: 市场型工具与土地利用管理是实现减排的关键机制，直接影响区域碳储量，构成实现“双碳”目标的重要考量。以往研究主要评估土地利用管理对区域碳储量的响应，而很大程度上忽视了市场型工具的作用。作为市场机制与土地利用管理的整合，发展权转移（TDR）能否有效提升区域碳储量尚不明确。因此，有必要探讨TDR对区域碳储量的影响。本研究采用PLUS模型模拟广西2030年四种土地利用情景：基准情景（BS）、发展情景（DS）、保护情景（PS）及发展权转移情景（TDR）。在此基础上，运用InVEST模型量化各情景下的碳储量。通过情景对比，识别TDR对区域碳储量的影响。结果表明，TDR通过优化土地利用结构和跨区域重新配置发展权，提升了区域碳储量。总碳储量为3269,444.5×10⁴吨，TDR代表了平衡区域发展与生态保护的最优解，契合中国国土空间治理及绿色低碳发展政策。因此，本研究为促进低碳土地利用提供了有效路径。

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108268.abstract: Climate change affects agriculture directly through crop yield losses and indirectly through changes in crop prices. Farmers need to adapt their land-use decisions to these changing conditions. These decisions are made in advance and under considerable uncertainty. The extent to which farmers adapt their crop area allocations to changing yields and prices remains unclear, particularly at the national scale. We present an approach for measuring the adaptedness of observed crop area allocations to changing yields and prices in terms of the number of hectares differing from an economically optimal cropping pattern. We demonstrate the approach in a case study in Germany (1999–2020). To identify economically optimal crop area allocations under changing yields and prices, we employ an econometric mathematical programming (EMP) approach within a multi-agent system modeling framework. Over the 20 years, we find persistent changes in crop area allocations averaging 36% ±4% of each district’s agricultural area. Of these changes, 43% improved the adaptedness to today’s yields and prices. We observe a trend of increasing adaptedness over time, though significantly lower in districts facing drought conditions. Adaptation, however, prevails both under drought and non-drought conditions. Our results suggest that the economic impacts of changing yields and prices play a significant role in shaping observed land-use patterns, with important implications for land-use dynamics under climate change. Our approach opens promising avenues for further research seeking to disentangle the drivers of land-use adaptation over time and to inform future policies aimed at supporting agricultural adaptation to increasing weather extremes and changing climatic conditions.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108268.abstract_zh: 气候变化通过作物产量损失直接影响农业，并通过作物价格变化间接影响农业。农民需要根据这些变化条件调整其土地利用决策，而这些决策需提前做出，且面临相当大的不确定性。农民在多大程度上根据产量和价格的变化调整其作物面积分配，目前尚不清楚，尤其是在国家尺度上。我们提出了一种方法，用以衡量观测到的作物面积分配对产量和价格变化的适应程度，具体以偏离经济最优种植模式的公顷数来表示。我们在德国的一项案例研究（1999-2020年）中展示了该方法。为识别在产量和价格变化下的经济最优作物面积分配，我们在多智能体系统建模框架内采用了计量经济数学规划（EMP）方法。在这20年间，我们发现作物面积分配发生了持续变化，平均占每个地区农业面积的36%±4%。其中，43%的变化改善了对当前产量和价格的适应程度。我们观察到适应程度随时间呈上升趋势，但在面临干旱条件的地区，这一趋势显著较低。然而，无论在干旱还是非干旱条件下，适应现象均普遍存在。我们的结果表明，产量和价格变化的经济影响在塑造观测到的土地利用模式中发挥着重要作用，这对气候变化下的土地利用动态具有重要意义。我们的方法为进一步研究土地利用适应随时间变化的驱动因素，以及为制定支持农业适应日益加剧的极端天气和变化气候条件的未来政策，开辟了有前景的途径。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108268.title: Measuring adaptation in action: Uncovering agricultural land-use responses to changing yields and prices
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108268.title_zh: 衡量适应行动：揭示农业土地利用对产量与价格变化的响应

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108269.abstract: The European objective of achieving “No Net Land Take” (NNLT) by 2050 represents an ambitious paradigm shift in the fields of urban planning and architecture. However, the primary obstacles to its implementation are not technical in nature, but rather stem from our society’s inability to reform itself in order to attain this fundamental goal. This viewpoint paper reviews the political, economic, and sociocultural barriers that must be overcome to effectively halt the loss of agricultural and natural land.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108269.abstract_zh: 欧洲到2050年实现“零净土地占用”（NNLT）的目标，标志着城市规划和建筑领域的一次雄心勃勃的范式转变。然而，其实施的主要障碍并非技术层面，而是源于我们社会在实现这一根本目标上的自我改革能力不足。本文从观点角度审视了必须克服的政治、经济和社会文化障碍，以有效遏制农业和自然土地的流失。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108269.title: The European No Net Land Take objective: A meta-challenge
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108269.title_zh: 欧洲净零土地占用目标：一项元挑战

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108270.abstract: Multiple land rights holders and layered land rights structures create fundamental challenges for implementing land-based financing methods such as land value capture (LVC). In a decentralized governance system, overlapping land rights and fragmented planning complicate coordination and limit the effectiveness of LVC for financing transport infrastructure development. This study examines how different rights holders contribute to implementing land value capture within a layered land rights and multi-level governance system in Indonesia, using the Jakarta Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) project as a case study. In Indonesia’s decentralized system, multiple levels of government apply different planning tools to regulate land use and development, complicating coordination between planning, land rights, and LVC mechanisms. Qualitative data from semi-structured interviews and policy analysis show that overlapping land rights and fragmented regulations create legal and administrative uncertainty. This uncertainty acts as a barrier to cross-governmental coordination and private stakeholder engagement, both of which are necessary for a workable LVC framework. Although a formal LVC framework exists, unclear rules on which rights holders should contribute, combined with complex administrative procedures, limit its practical use. This study contributes to the LVC literature by linking instruments to specific land rights holders and by extending the bundle-of-rights perspective. It explains why LVC remains underutilized in contexts with layered land rights and decentralized governance. The findings highlight the need for policy reforms to clarify contribution obligations, improve coordination across governance levels, and simplify the administrative process.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108270.abstract_zh: 多重土地权利主体与分层土地权利结构，为实施土地价值捕获（LVC）等土地融资方式带来了根本性挑战。在分散化治理体系下，土地权利重叠与规划碎片化使协调工作复杂化，并限制了LVC在交通基础设施发展融资中的有效性。本研究以雅加达大众快速交通（MRT）项目为案例，考察在印度尼西亚分层土地权利与多层治理体系中，不同权利主体如何参与土地价值捕获的实施。在印度尼西亚的分散化体制下，多级政府运用不同的规划工具来规范土地利用与开发，这使得规划、土地权利与LVC机制之间的协调更加复杂。基于半结构化访谈与政策分析的定性数据表明，土地权利重叠与法规碎片化造成了法律和行政层面的不确定性。这种不确定性成为跨政府协调与私营利益相关方参与的障碍，而这两者均为可行的LVC框架所必需。尽管存在正式的LVC框架，但关于哪些权利主体应承担贡献义务的规则不明确，加之复杂的行政程序，限制了其实际应用。本研究通过将工具与特定土地权利主体相联系，并拓展权利束视角，为LVC文献作出贡献。研究解释了为何在分层土地权利与分散化治理背景下，LVC仍未被充分利用。研究结果凸显了政策改革的必要性，以明确贡献义务、改善跨治理层级的协调，并简化行政程序。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108270.title: Layered land rights under government-led decentralization: Implications for land value capture implementation in Jakarta, Indonesia
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108270.title_zh: 政府主导分权下的分层土地权利：对印度尼西亚雅加达土地价值捕获实施的影响

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108271.abstract: Informality remains one of the most persistent challenges for land governance, particularly where large-scale legalization policies seek to reconcile existing development with formal planning and regulatory systems. Although zoning amnesties often generate comprehensive administrative records of informal development, they rarely establish institutional mechanisms capable of transforming legitimization into sustainable legalization. This study examines the implementation outcomes of Türkiye's 2018 Zoning Amnesty and evaluates how they provide the foundation for a governance model for structured legalization. An integrated analytical framework combining spatial assessment, institutional analysis, and policy evaluation was applied using national administrative statistics, orthophoto-based spatial analysis, municipal inventories, zoning-amnesty datasets, and evidence from the environmentally sensitive Uzungöl case study. The findings demonstrate that the Building Registration Certificate functioned primarily as an instrument of institutional legitimization rather than complete legalization, creating a nationwide administrative inventory while leaving critical planning, technical, environmental, and legal issues unresolved. Building on these findings, the study proposes a governance model that transforms administrative legitimization into structured legalization through a sequential institutional pathway integrating legal verification, spatial assessment, technical and environmental assessment, and administrative integration. The proposed model offers a transferable approach for more transparent, adaptive, and risk-informed land governance in countries facing similar challenges of large-scale informality.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108271.abstract_zh: 非正规性仍然是土地治理中最持久的挑战之一，尤其是在大规模合法化政策试图将现有发展与正式规划和监管体系相协调的情况下。尽管分区特赦常常产生非正规发展的全面行政记录，但它们很少建立能够将合法化转化为可持续法律化的制度机制。本研究考察了土耳其2018年分区特赦的实施结果，并评估了它们如何为结构化合法化的治理模式奠定基础。采用结合空间评估、制度分析和政策评估的综合分析框架，利用国家行政统计、基于正射影像的空间分析、市政清单、分区特赦数据集以及环境敏感的乌宗格尔案例研究证据。研究结果表明，建筑登记证书主要作为制度合法化的工具而非完全法律化，在全国范围内建立了行政清单，同时留下了关键的规划、技术、环境和法律问题未解决。基于这些发现，研究提出了一种治理模式，通过整合法律验证、空间评估、技术和环境评估以及行政整合的序列化制度路径，将行政合法化转化为结构化法律化。所提出的模式为面临类似大规模非正规性挑战的国家提供了一种可转移的方法，以实现更透明、适应性强和风险知情的土地治理。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108271.title: From legitimization to structured legalization: A governance framework from Türkiye’s 2018 zoning amnesty
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108271.title_zh: 从合法化到结构化法治：土耳其2018年区划特赦的治理框架

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108272.abstract: PV (photovoltaic) farms are rapidly expanding across China, affecting its land use patterns and terrestrial ecosystems. While previous studies have shown that the effects of PV farms on vegetation are diverse, regulated by land cover, climate, and technology type, the role of human interventions, especially water management, in influencing vegetation dynamics remain insufficiently examined, leaving a critical knowledge gap. To bridge this gap, we assessed the vegetation dynamics of China’s PV farms using the normalized difference vegetation index, estimated human-induced evapotranspiration change ( ET h ) as a measure of water management intensity, and used machine learning models to assess its impact on vegetation dynamics. Our results showed that water management plays a critical role in driving vegetation recovery, with optimal ET h forming a climate-dependent ‘ridge pattern’ that increased from 92 mm/year in humid regions to 200 mm/year in arid zones. Optimized water management can increase the improvement in vegetation greenness to 2.3 times that under observed scenario, while reducing total water consumption by 21.5%. Importantly, our findings provide evidence-based guidance for region-specific water management policies aiming to promote ecological restoration in PV farms while also supporting sustainable land use practices.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108272.abstract_zh: 光伏（PV）电站正在中国迅速扩张，深刻影响其土地利用格局与陆地生态系统。尽管已有研究表明，光伏电站对植被的影响因土地覆盖、气候和技术类型而异，呈现多样性，但人为干预，尤其是水资源管理，在影响植被动态中的作用仍未得到充分探讨，留下了关键的知识空白。为填补这一空白，我们利用归一化差异植被指数评估了中国光伏电站的植被动态，估算人为引起的蒸散发变化（ET h ）作为水资源管理强度的度量，并采用机器学习模型评估其对植被动态的影响。结果表明，水资源管理在驱动植被恢复中发挥关键作用，最优ET h 形成一种依赖气候的“脊状模式”，从湿润地区的92毫米/年递增至干旱区的200毫米/年。优化水资源管理可将植被绿度改善程度提升至观测情景下的2.3倍，同时减少总用水量21.5%。重要的是，我们的发现为旨在促进光伏电站生态恢复并支持可持续土地利用实践的区域特定水资源管理政策提供了基于证据的指导。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108272.title: Water management regulates vegetation recovery in photovoltaic farms across China
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108272.title_zh: 中国光伏电站水资源管理调控植被恢复研究

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108273.abstract: Land consolidation (LC) is commonly regarded as a sustainability-oriented strategy designed to enhance agricultural productivity and promote rural development. LC can occur through de jure mechanism (formal, state-led programs, public-private partnerships) or de facto processes that evolve informally. However, there remains a significant gap in understanding the negative implications of de facto LC, particularly within commodity booms in the Global South. This study addresses that gap by examining an ongoing LC process driven by the expansion of Hass avocado plantations in Salamina, Colombia. Grounded in the Theory of Access, the analysis argues that de facto LC fosters exclusionary dynamics within traditional agricultural landscapes. These dynamics manifest through both direct and indirect mechanisms, generating a range of adverse consequences for peasant communities living adjacent to expanding plantations.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108273.abstract_zh: 土地整理（LC）通常被视为一种以可持续性为导向的策略，旨在提升农业生产效率并促进农村发展。土地整理可通过法律机制（正式的、国家主导的项目，公私合作伙伴关系）或非正式演变的事实过程实现。然而，关于事实土地整理的负面影响，尤其是在全球南方大宗商品繁荣背景下的影响，仍存在显著的研究空白。本研究通过考察哥伦比亚萨拉米纳地区由哈斯鳄梨种植园扩张驱动的持续土地整理过程，填补了这一空白。基于“获取理论”框架，分析认为事实土地整理在传统农业景观中催生了排斥性动态。这些动态通过直接和间接机制显现，对毗邻扩张种植园的农民社区产生了一系列不利后果。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108273.title: De facto land consolidation leads to exclusion: The role of commodity expansion in Salamina, Colombia
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108273.title_zh: 事实上的土地整合导致排斥：商品扩张在哥伦比亚萨拉米纳的作用

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108274.abstract: Land-use policy increasingly operates under conditions of shock and uncertainty, yet the mechanisms through which emergency measures produce persistent land take remain underexplored. In this paper, land take refers to land development involving the conversion of natural, semi-natural or agricultural land to artificial uses, often associated with impervious soil cover. The paper examines how post-earthquake road-access restrictions, safety cordons, and infrastructure-and-amenity siting choices interacted with road-network centrality and land-use change in L’Aquila, Italy. Using a configurational approach, namely Space Syntax, on reconstructed pre-earthquake and post-earthquake road networks, we compute segment-based Integration (NAIN) and Choice (NACH) at multiple radii and relate centrality deciles to a 2014 post-event census of commercial and public amenities through nearest-segment association and buffer-based sensitivity tests. Results show a strong spatial alignment between road closures in and around the historic centre, the emergence of high-centrality road corridors, notably Viale della Croce Rossa and the SS17, and the concentration of post-disaster amenities along those corridors and their immediate surroundings. Two peripheral district centres, Torrione and Torretta, also consolidated as locally autonomous service nuclei, reinforcing a more polycentric pattern that only partly aligned with statutory planning objectives. Rather than proposing a formal predictive model, the paper uses single-case evidence to show how road-network diagnostics can help identify corridors where temporary land uses and emergency-related land take are most likely to persist; support decisions on the reopening of strategic road links; and inform time-bound rules for de-commissioning, reuse, regularisation, and development caps on floor area and intensity. The workflow is low-cost, open-data based and transferable to other hazards and city sizes, providing actionable evidence for planners and governments seeking to align post-disaster responses with land-take control objectives.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108274.abstract_zh: 土地政策日益在冲击与不确定性条件下运作，然而紧急措施如何导致持续性土地占用（land take）的机制仍未得到充分探讨。本文中，土地占用指涉及将自然、半自然或农业用地转化为人工用途的土地开发，通常与不透水地表覆盖相关。本文考察了意大利拉奎拉地震后道路通行限制、安全警戒线以及基础设施与便利设施选址如何与道路网络中心性和土地利用变化相互作用。采用构形方法，即空间句法（Space Syntax），对重建的地震前与地震后道路网络进行分析，我们计算了多半径下的分段整合度（NAIN）和选择度（NACH），并通过最近路段关联和缓冲区敏感性检验，将中心性十分位数与2014年震后商业及公共便利设施普查数据进行关联。结果显示，历史中心及其周边的道路封闭、高中心性道路走廊（尤其是红十字大道和SS17公路）的出现，以及灾后便利设施沿这些走廊及其邻近区域的集中，之间存在显著的空间对应关系。两个外围区域中心——托里奥内和托雷塔——也巩固为地方自治的服务节点，强化了一种仅与法定规划目标部分吻合的多中心格局。本文并未提出正式预测模型，而是利用单案例证据展示道路网络诊断如何有助于识别临时性土地利用和紧急相关土地占用最可能持续存在的走廊；支持战略道路连接重新开放的决策；并为退役、再利用、规范化以及建筑面积和强度开发上限提供有时限的规则依据。该工作流程成本低廉、基于开放数据，并可推广至其他灾害类型和城市规模，为规划者和政府提供可操作证据，以将灾后响应与土地占用控制目标相协调。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108274.title: Emergency land take, road-network centrality and post-disaster land-use policy: Evidence from the post-earthquake reconstruction of L’Aquila, Italy
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108274.title_zh: 紧急土地征收、路网中心性与灾后土地利用政策：来自意大利拉奎拉震后重建的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108275.abstract: Multipurpose cadastre implementation is increasingly promoted as a key instrument for improving land administration, urban planning, taxation, service delivery, and land governance. However, local capacity to operationalise such systems remains uneven, particularly in peri-urban contexts where land pressure, institutional fragmentation, and weak cadastral documentation coexist. This study develops and tests a governance-readiness framework for assessing local capacity to support multipurpose cadastre implementation. Drawing on a purposive benchmarking sample of sixteen localities selected from a preliminary longlist of candidate cases across Africa, Europe, Asia, and North America, the study combines normalised governance indicators with partial least squares structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM). Governance readiness is modelled as a second-order formative construct, while Performance of Land Governance (PLG) is specified as a reflective outcome construct. The results show a strong positive relationship between governance readiness and PLG, with a standardised path coefficient of β = 0.849 and an explained variance of R² = 0.721. Robustness checks using Spearman rank correlation and ordinary least squares regression confirm the stability of this relationship, with ρ = 0.954 and OLS R² = 0.965. Agoè-Nyivé 2, located in the rapidly urbanising Greater Lomé metropolitan area in Togo, records particularly low readiness and PLG scores, highlighting the gap between cadastral needs and local governance capacity. The findings suggest that multipurpose cadastre implementation should be approached as a policy-readiness process requiring transparency, accountability, institutional coordination, technical capacity, and reliable land information systems.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108275.abstract_zh: 多用途地籍的实施日益被推崇为改善土地管理、城市规划、税收、服务提供及土地治理的关键工具。然而，地方在运作此类系统方面的能力仍不均衡，尤其是在土地压力、制度碎片化及地籍文件薄弱并存的城郊地区。本研究开发并测试了一个治理就绪度框架，用以评估地方支持多用途地籍实施的能力。研究选取了来自非洲、欧洲、亚洲和北美洲的初步候选案例长名单中的十六个地方作为目的性基准样本，结合标准化治理指标与偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行分析。治理就绪度被建模为二阶形成性构念，而土地治理绩效（PLG）则被设定为反映性结果构念。结果显示，治理就绪度与PLG之间存在强正相关关系，标准化路径系数为β = 0.849，解释方差为R² = 0.721。采用斯皮尔曼秩相关和普通最小二乘回归进行的稳健性检验确认了该关系的稳定性，ρ = 0.954，OLS R² = 0.965。位于多哥大洛美都市区快速城市化地区的Agoè-Nyivé 2，其就绪度和PLG得分均特别低，凸显了地籍需求与地方治理能力之间的差距。研究结果表明，多用途地籍的实施应被视为一个政策就绪过程，需要透明度、问责制、机构协调、技术能力及可靠的土地信息系统。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108275.title: From global benchmarking to local policy readiness: Assessing governance capacity for multipurpose cadastre implementation
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108275.title_zh: 从全球对标到地方政策准备：多用途地籍实施的治理能力评估

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108276.abstract: Land tenure security plays a vital role in promoting sustainable land management, but its impact on soil health remains poorly understood within Uganda's complex tenure systems. This study examines how formal land certification and tenure systems influence soil health outcomes using data from the Uganda National Panel Survey (2020/2021) and robust econometric methods, including ordinary least squares, instrumental variables, and propensity score matching. We constructed the soil health index by combining five key variables, namely organic matter, biodiversity, erosion control, fertilizer use, and fallow practices, with each factor weighted based on its importance. To reduce endogeneity, we used instrumental variables like historical land reform and distance to land registry offices. The results indicate that formal land certification enhances soil health, with leasehold and freehold land systems demonstrating the most substantial positive effects. Nonetheless, the impacts of land certification differ by tenure system. Certification of land combined with customary tenure has a significant impact on soil health, whereas certification within customary systems proves ineffective, underscoring the need for supplementary interventions. Conversely, inherited land and households led by widows are associated with negative outcomes for soil health, which may reflect issues of land fragmentation and resource limitations. Analysis of heterogeneity of the impact of land certification reveals that Mailo and Leasehold land tenure systems benefit from land certification. In contrast, Freehold systems exhibit negative returns, potentially due to existing security arrangements. We recommend including scaling up Uganda's Certificates of Customary Ownership while integrating gender-sensitive support, education, and credit access to maximize the benefits of soil health.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108276.abstract_zh: 土地权属保障在促进可持续土地管理中发挥着至关重要的作用，但其对土壤健康的影响在乌干达复杂的土地制度体系中仍未得到充分理解。本研究利用乌干达全国面板调查（2020/2021）数据，并采用稳健的计量经济学方法，包括普通最小二乘法、工具变量法和倾向得分匹配法，考察正式土地确权证书和土地制度对土壤健康结果的影响。我们通过综合五个关键变量构建了土壤健康指数，即有机质、生物多样性、侵蚀控制、化肥使用和休耕实践，并根据各因素的重要性赋予权重。为减少内生性问题，我们使用了历史土地改革和距土地登记处距离等工具变量。结果表明，正式土地确权证书能够改善土壤健康，其中租赁权和自由保有土地制度展现出最为显著的正向效应。然而，土地确权的影响因土地制度而异。土地确权与习惯保有制度相结合对土壤健康具有显著影响，而习惯制度内部的土地确权则效果有限，凸显了补充干预措施的必要性。相反，继承土地和寡妇户主家庭与土壤健康负面结果相关，这可能反映了土地碎片化和资源限制的问题。对土地确权影响的异质性分析显示，Mailo和租赁权土地制度受益于土地确权。相比之下，自由保有制度表现出负向回报，可能归因于现有的安全保障安排。我们建议扩大乌干达习惯保有所有权证书的推广范围，同时纳入性别敏感支持、教育和信贷获取渠道，以最大化土壤健康的收益。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108276.title: Land tenure security and soil health: Evidence from Uganda
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108276.title_zh: 土地权属安全与土壤健康：来自乌干达的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108277.abstract: Urbanization, population growth and agricultural commodity demand increasingly shift land-use pressure toward distant rural frontiers, intensifying cropland expansion into tropical forests and creating substantial trade-offs between agricultural production and carbon-sink capacity. Yet where regional climate-policy land-demand pathways translate into forest-conversion risk, and how these risks overlap with agricultural-value and carbon-sink outcomes at fine spatial resolution, remains insufficiently quantified. We couple the Global Change Assessment Model (GCAM) with the Future Land Use Simulation (FLUS) model to assess cropland-expansion-driven deforestation in South America from 1992 to 2050, with the Amazon basin as the focal analytical region, under reference and 1.5 °C -consistent (1p5) pathways. We estimate agricultural value using a data-driven approach and quantify carbon impacts as changes in vegetation carbon-sink capacity. From 1992–2020, Amazon cropland increased by 2.12 × 105 km2 while forests declined by 3.51 × 105 km2, accounting for more than 60% of South America forest loss. Under the reference pathway, forest loss reaches 8.23 × 105 km2, including 1.10 × 105 km2 converted to cropland, causing an annual loss of 1.04 × 1010 kg of forest carbon sequestration while generating 4.79 × 108 GK$ in agricultural revenue. Under the 1p5 pathway, Amazon forest-to-cropland conversion declines to 7.00 × 103 km2, a 93.6% reduction relative to the reference pathway, and the net land-conversion effect shifts toward a carbon-sink gain. These results indicate an asymmetric agriculture-carbon trade-off, in which cropland expansion produces relatively limited agricultural-value gains while imposing large carbon-sink costs. The GCAM-FLUS framework identifies where such trade-offs are spatially concentrated and where mitigation-consistent land-demand pathways may reduce conversion risk. These policy implications should be interpreted together with local governance, tenure and supply-chain conditions, which are not directly simulated in the present modelling framework.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108277.abstract_zh: 城市化、人口增长和农业商品需求日益将土地利用压力转向偏远的农村前沿地区，加剧了热带森林地区的耕地扩张，并在农业生产与碳汇能力之间产生了显著的权衡关系。然而，区域气候政策下的土地需求路径在何处转化为森林转换风险，以及这些风险如何在精细空间分辨率上与农业价值和碳汇结果重叠，仍未得到充分量化。我们将全球变化评估模型（GCAM）与未来土地利用模拟（FLUS）模型相结合，评估1992年至2050年间南美洲由耕地扩张驱动的森林砍伐，以亚马逊流域为焦点分析区域，并分别考虑参考路径和与1.5°C目标一致（1p5）的路径。我们采用数据驱动方法估算农业价值，并将碳影响量化为植被碳汇能力的变化。1992年至2020年间，亚马逊地区耕地增加了2.12×10⁵平方公里，而森林减少了3.51×10⁵平方公里，占南美洲森林损失的60%以上。在参考路径下，森林损失达到8.23×10⁵平方公里，其中1.10×10⁵平方公里转为耕地，导致森林碳汇年损失1.04×10¹⁰千克，同时产生4.79×10⁸ GK$的农业收入。在1p5路径下，亚马逊地区森林转耕地面积降至7.00×10³平方公里，较参考路径减少93.6%，净土地转换效应转向碳汇增益。这些结果表明存在不对称的农业-碳权衡关系，即耕地扩张带来的农业价值增益相对有限，却造成巨大的碳汇成本。GCAM-FLUS框架识别了此类权衡在空间上的集中区域，以及符合减缓目标的地需求路径可能在何处降低转换风险。这些政策启示应与地方治理、土地权属和供应链条件结合解读，而这些因素未在本建模框架中直接模拟。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108277.title: Climate-policy pathways reshape cropland-expansion-driven deforestation and agricultural-carbon trade-off imbalance in the Amazon
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108277.title_zh: 气候政策路径重塑亚马逊地区农田扩张驱动的森林砍伐与农业碳权衡失衡

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108278.abstract: Urban development frequently requires land assembly, cross-parcel coordination, and allocation of costs and benefits created by zoning plans. In Norway, property-formation tasks typically rely on cadastral procedures that depend on voluntary agreement and may involve multiple fragmented, sequential, and time-consuming approvals. This article examines whether organizational instruments under the Land Consolidation Act – rules on joint use, orders for joint measures, and governance arrangements – can function as a less invasive and more efficient complement to physical reallotment in urban land readjustment. Using a structured review of Norwegian zoning plans and Land Consolidation Court decisions, supplemented with targeted literature, we identify (i) coordination problems these instruments can address, (ii) their legal effects and constraints, and (iii) practical conditions for implementation, including loss-prevention rules and transition to later physical property formation. We conclude that organizational instruments are best suited for early-phase cooperation and shared functions (e.g., access, infrastructure, common areas), reducing transaction costs and holdout risks when physical reallotment is premature. We discuss implications for ‘fit-for-purpose’ land readjustment and outline how comparable rule-based joint-use solutions may be adapted to resource-constrained contexts, provided that legal clarity and registration mechanisms are addressed. In Norwegian land consolidation law traditional physical readjustment includes measures such as land exchange and the reduction of fragmentation of holdings. Organizational instruments, by contrast, operate closer to the actual coordination problems faced in urban development. As such, they represent a more fit-for-purpose response to the challenges of fragmented ownership and cross-boundary planning in transformation areas.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108278.abstract_zh: 城市发展常常需要土地整合、跨地块协调以及分区规划所产生成本与收益的分配。在挪威，土地形成任务通常依赖于地籍程序，这些程序以自愿协议为基础，并可能涉及多个分散、连续且耗时的审批环节。本文考察《土地整理法》下的组织性工具——关于共同使用的规则、共同措施的命令以及治理安排——是否能够在城市土地调整中，作为物理性重新分配的一种侵入性更小、效率更高的补充手段。通过对挪威分区规划和土地整理法院裁决的结构化审查，辅以针对性文献，我们识别出（i）这些工具能够解决的协调问题，（ii）其法律效力与限制，以及（iii）实施的实际条件，包括损失预防规则和向后续物理性土地形成的过渡。我们得出结论：组织性工具最适合于早期阶段的合作和共享功能（如通道、基础设施、公共区域），在物理性重新分配尚不成熟时，能够降低交易成本和持有风险。我们讨论了其对“因地制宜”土地调整的启示，并概述了在资源受限情境下，如何调整类似的基于规则的共同使用解决方案，前提是法律明确性和登记机制得到解决。在挪威土地整理法中，传统的物理性调整包括土地交换和减少地块碎片化等措施。相比之下，组织性工具更贴近城市发展中所面临的实际协调问题。因此，它们代表了对转型区域中碎片化所有权和跨边界规划挑战的一种更符合实际需求的回应。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108278.title: Rethinking land readjustment: Fit-for-purpose rules for joint use in real estate development
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108278.title_zh: 重新思考土地整理：面向房地产开发联合使用的适用性规则

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108279.abstract: In Turkey, mining companies are required to pay various types of forest fees to the forestry administration, as well as environmental compliance fees, state rights, and operating license fees to the relevant mining and environmental authorities. Rehabilitation and waste management costs, in contrast, are not fees calculated and collected directly by public authorities; rather, they are expenditures incurred by mining companies to fulfill their regulatory obligations. In recent years, legislative changes in Turkey concerning the calculation methods for land use fees and mining royalties required for mining operations have adversely affected the mining sector and reduced the attractiveness of mining investments. Therefore, assessing the economic feasibility of mining requires an integrated approach that considers the total financial burden imposed on mining companies rather than evaluating individual fees separately. To address this issue, data on various land use fees, operating costs, and other relevant parameters were collected from mining companies through the SurveyMonkey program. This analysis was motivated by the limited publicly available information on the actual magnitude of land use costs incurred by mining companies and the possibility that mining and environmental authorities may assess individual fees separately without considering their cumulative financial burden. Accordingly, this study evaluates land use fees and mining royalties in Turkey both individually and collectively, calculating their values per tonne of mineral production, per hectare of land, and on an annual basis. The ratios of these costs to mining operating costs were subsequently determined. The results indicate that the average land use cost is €1.65 ton⁻¹ year⁻¹ of mineral production and €3440.7 ha⁻¹ year⁻¹ of land used, while the combined land use fees included in the analysis account for 29.15% of total operating costs. Forest fees constitute the largest individual component, accounting for 8.39% of operating costs. In particular, revising the calculation methodology for forest fees and reducing the resulting financial burden could improve the economic feasibility and competitiveness of mining operations in Turkey.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108279.abstract_zh: 在土耳其，矿业公司需向林业管理部门缴纳多种类型的林地使用费，同时还需向相关矿业及环保主管部门支付环境合规费、国家权益金及经营许可证费用。相比之下，恢复治理和废弃物管理成本并非由公共机构直接计算并征收的费用，而是矿业公司为履行监管义务而产生的支出。近年来，土耳其有关矿业用地使用费及采矿权益金计算方法的立法变动，对采矿业造成了不利影响，降低了矿业投资的吸引力。因此，评估采矿经济可行性需要采用综合方法，考虑矿业公司承担的总体财务负担，而非单独评估各项费用。为解决这一问题，通过SurveyMonkey程序向矿业公司收集了各类用地使用费、运营成本及其他相关参数的数据。此项分析的动因在于，关于矿业公司实际承担的用地成本规模，公开信息有限，且矿业与环保主管部门可能单独评估各项费用，而未考虑其累积财务负担。据此，本研究分别从单项和整体角度评估土耳其的用地使用费及采矿权益金，计算其每吨矿产产量、每公顷用地及年度基础上的数值，并进一步确定这些成本占矿业运营成本的比例。结果表明，平均用地成本为每吨矿产产量每年1.65欧元，每公顷用地每年3440.7欧元，而纳入分析的各项用地使用费合计占运营总成本的29.15%。林地使用费是最大的单项组成部分，占运营成本的8.39%。特别是，修订林地使用费的计算方法并降低由此产生的财务负担，有望提升土耳其矿业运营的经济可行性和竞争力。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108279.title: The impact of high land use costs and mining royalties on mining operating costs in Turkey
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108279.title_zh: 高土地使用成本与采矿权使用费对土耳其矿业运营成本的影响

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108280.abstract: Urban form is undergoing rapid transformation amid global politico-economic transitions, yet the mechanisms shaping these changes in non-Western contexts remain under-theorized. Taking China’s transition as an example, we reconceptualize the transition by adding regionalization into the traditional framework of decentralization, marketization, and globalization, highlighting the role of regional cooperation. We delineate the evolution of urban form through morphological analysis in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area (GBA) from 2010 to 2019, and employ regression methods to validate the pathways through which this extended transitional framework influences form outcomes. Empirical results demonstrate that urban form is co-shaped by local governments’ fiscal expenditure, land market prices, foreign direct investment, and the intensity of inter-city cooperation. A compound growth model integrating industrial land, transport networks, and real estate is emerging as a significant mechanism forging urban spatial structure. Overall, our study reaffirms the pivotal impact of local government play among the various actors shaping urban development and spatial configuration in China. While regionalization has shown tangible effects in enhancing inter-city collaboration and reducing regional disparities, it has yet to fundamentally transform the entrenched governance logic through which local governments leverage land markets to drive urban growth.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108280.abstract_zh: 在全球政治经济转型的背景下，城市形态正经历快速变革，然而在非西方情境下塑造这些变化的机制仍未得到充分理论化。以中国的转型为例，我们通过将区域化纳入传统的分权化、市场化与全球化分析框架中，重新概念化这一转型过程，并强调区域合作的作用。我们运用形态分析方法，描绘了2010年至2019年间粤港澳大湾区城市形态的演变，并采用回归方法验证了这一扩展转型框架影响形态结果的路径。实证结果表明，城市形态受到地方政府财政支出、土地市场价格、外商直接投资及城际合作强度的共同塑造。一个整合工业用地、交通网络与房地产的复合增长模式，正成为塑造城市空间结构的重要机制。总体而言，本研究重申了地方政府在中国城市发展与空间格局塑造的多元主体中所发挥的关键作用。尽管区域化在增强城际协作与缩小区域差距方面已显现出切实成效，但其尚未从根本上改变地方政府借助土地市场驱动城市增长的固有治理逻辑。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108280.title: Urban form under China’s politico-economic transition: The role of decentralization, marketization, globalization, and regionalization in the Greater Bay Area
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108280.title_zh: 中国政治经济转型下的城市形态：粤港澳大湾区中分权、市场化、全球化与区域化的作用

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108281.abstract: Forests play a vital role in maintaining ecosystem services and sustaining human livelihoods. However, under globalization, trade has increasingly exerted pressure on forest resources. Existing studies on deforestation footprints and forest-related incomes often overlook spatial heterogeneity and consistency, making it difficult to provide detailed information for precise land-use management policies. To address this gap, we develop an enhanced spatial input-output models by incorporating export-priority zones to construct 1 km-resolution deforestation footprint maps, which are then used to estimate forest-related incomes. Our findings reveal noticeable spatial heterogeneity in deforestation footprints within countries, with inland areas typically show lower deforestation footprints than coastal regions. Conventional country-level analyses overlook these details, often overestimating forest product incomes in inland regions (e.g., approximately 10% in the USA), while underestimating incomes in developed coastal regions (e.g., approximately 15% in China). Within 300 km of the coastlines, forest incomes are consistently underestimated, while more remote areas show the opposite bias. The pixel-level analyses in this study reveal statistically significant differences in forest product incomes within countries (p < 0.05), with inequality amplified by uneven locational advantages and different levels of economic development. These findings demonstrate that trade intensifies spatial inequalities in forest-based livelihoods. Policymakers should prioritize investments in infrastructure and market accessibility to reduce these disparities and promote more equitable and sustainable forest management.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108281.abstract_zh: 森林在维持生态系统服务和保障人类生计方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，在全球化背景下，贸易对森林资源的压力日益增大。现有关于毁林足迹和森林相关收入的研究往往忽视了空间异质性与一致性，难以为精准的土地利用管理政策提供详细信息。为弥补这一不足，我们通过引入出口优先区，构建了增强型空间投入产出模型，生成了1公里分辨率的毁林足迹图，并据此估算森林相关收入。研究结果显示，各国国内的毁林足迹存在显著的空间异质性，内陆地区的毁林足迹通常低于沿海地区。传统的国家层面分析忽视了这些细节，往往高估内陆地区的森林产品收入（例如，美国约为10%），而低估发达沿海地区的收入（例如，中国约为15%）。在海岸线300公里范围内，森林收入始终被低估，而更偏远地区则呈现相反的偏差。本研究的像元级分析揭示了国内森林产品收入存在统计学上显著的差异（p < 0.05），且这种不平等因区位优势不均和经济发展水平差异而进一步加剧。这些发现表明，贸易加剧了森林生计的空间不平等。政策制定者应优先投资于基础设施建设和市场可达性，以缩小这些差距，促进更加公平和可持续的森林管理。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108281.title: High-resolution mapping of global deforestation footprints and livelihood inequalities: Toward equitable forest governance
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108281.title_zh: 全球毁林足迹与生计不平等的高分辨率制图：迈向公平的森林治理

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108282.abstract: The accelerated development of solar photovoltaic (PV) is crucial for achieving global climate goals, yet it poses significant ecological challenges due to the extensive land occupation. The “PV + ” land use model could be a countermeasure. By quantifying the ecological cost of multiple PV expansion scenarios in China and the potential ecological compensation capacity of “PV + ” model, we present an optimized energy expansion pathway. From the perspective of ecosystem services, we found that historical PV expansion caused an ecological loss of $2.15 billion (0.78 USD/m2). Without energy pathway optimization, the accelerated expansion required to meet 2050 targets would lead to ecological losses of $18.56 to $37.11 billion. However, pathway optimization can reduce those losses by 58–81%. Our analysis based on field investigations revealed that the "PV + " system holds significant potential for ecological compensation. Agriculture–PV has the highest capacity (0.63 USD/m2), even exceeding the pre-construction value of cropland, while Grassland–PV and Gobi and Desert-PV also achieve ecological restoration. Prioritizing the development of suitable land or barren land is the optimal expansion path to achieve a triple-win situation in energy, economics, and ecology. The power generation capacity of these pathways could reach 7.21–19.75 PWh annually by 2050, while reducing ecological costs to 0.09–0.19 USD/m2. This study provides guidance for ecologically considerate PV expansion planning and supports the sustainable management of PV power plants, offering a replicable solution for optimizing global renewable energy expansion.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108282.abstract_zh: 太阳能光伏（PV）的加速发展对于实现全球气候目标至关重要，然而由于大量土地占用，它也带来了显著的生态挑战。“光伏+”土地利用模式或可成为应对之策。通过量化中国多种光伏扩张情景下的生态成本及“光伏+”模式的潜在生态补偿能力，我们提出了一条优化的能源扩张路径。从生态系统服务的角度来看，我们发现历史光伏扩张已造成21.5亿美元（0.78美元/平方米）的生态损失。若不对能源路径进行优化，为满足2050年目标所需的加速扩张将导致185.6亿至371.1亿美元的生态损失。然而，路径优化可将这些损失减少58%至81%。基于实地调查的分析表明，“光伏+”系统具有显著的生态补偿潜力。农业-光伏模式的补偿能力最高（0.63美元/平方米），甚至超过了农田建设前的价值，而草地-光伏和戈壁沙漠-光伏模式同样实现了生态修复。优先开发适宜土地或荒芜土地是实现能源、经济和生态三方共赢的最优扩张路径。到2050年，这些路径的发电能力可达每年7.21至19.75拍瓦时，同时将生态成本降至0.09至0.19美元/平方米。本研究为兼顾生态考量的光伏扩张规划提供了指导，并支持光伏电站的可持续管理，为优化全球可再生能源扩张提供了可复制的解决方案。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108282.title: Ecological impacts and countermeasures for future solar photovoltaic expansion: Based on the assessment and planning of ecosystem services
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108282.title_zh: 未来太阳能光伏扩张的生态影响与应对措施：基于生态系统服务的评估与规划

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108283.abstract: Rural-urban income inequality (RUIE) remains a persistent challenge across many rapidly developing regions, undermining socio-economic welfare and hindering sustainable development. The ecological transition of cropland use (ETCU), a management paradigm rooted in the principles of sustainable intensification, is widely advocated to enhance agricultural sustainability. While localized case studies suggest that such practices can bolster rural incomes through improved resource efficiency or product diversification, robust empirical evidence on whether large‑scale ETCU adoption mitigates regional RUIE remains scarce, and the underlying systemic mechanisms are poorly understood. This study develops a multi-scale "cropland-agriculture-rural" framework to analyze how ETCU influences RUIE in China's intensively cultivated Huang-Huai-Hai Region. By integrating plot-scale biogeochemical modeling (PEST-DNDC), county-level panel data (2000–2020), and Structural Equation Modeling, we systematically quantify the spatiotemporal patterns and causal pathways of this transition. The results demonstrate that: (1) ETCU and RUIE exhibit spatially heterogeneous co-evolution; improvements in ETCU are not consistently associated with reduced inequality, and in some coastal counties, they even coincide with widening gaps. (2) ETCU affects RUIE primarily by restructuring agricultural multifunctionality, which serves as the core mediator. (3) The effects are highly dimension-specific. Enhancing resource-use efficiency exerts a modest yet significant direct mitigating effect on RUIE. Conversely, improvements in productivity and environmental performance exhibit no direct effect; instead, they indirectly exacerbate inequality by weakening the agricultural product supply function—which our model identifies as a strong and direct suppressor of RUIE. The economic value-added and ecological conservation functions do not exhibit significant direct equalizing effects. These findings indicate that the equity outcomes of ETCU are not automatic but depend critically on how it reshapes the multifunctional structure of agriculture. Policy interventions must therefore adopt an integrated approach that strategically guides the agricultural transition toward balanced multifunctionality, safeguards diversified production, and ensures that efficiency gains translate into broadly shared benefits for both rural and urban households.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108283.abstract_zh: 城乡收入不平等（RUIE）在许多快速发展的地区依然是一个持续存在的挑战，削弱了社会经济福祉并阻碍了可持续发展。耕地利用生态转型（ETCU）作为一种根植于可持续集约化原则的管理范式，被广泛倡导以提升农业可持续性。尽管局部案例研究表明，此类实践可通过提高资源效率或产品多样化来增加农村收入，但关于大规模ETCU采纳是否缓解区域RUIE的稳健实证证据仍然稀缺，其潜在的系统性机制也尚不明确。本研究构建了一个多尺度“耕地—农业—农村”框架，以分析ETCU如何影响中国集约化耕作的黄淮海地区的RUIE。通过整合地块尺度生物地球化学模型（PEST-DNDC）、县级面板数据（2000—2020年）以及结构方程模型，我们系统量化了这一转型的时空格局与因果路径。结果表明：（1）ETCU与RUIE呈现出空间异质的协同演化；ETCU的改善并非始终与不平等缩小相关联，在某些沿海县甚至伴随着差距扩大。（2）ETCU主要通过重构农业多功能性来影响RUIE，后者构成核心中介变量。（3）其效应具有高度维度特异性。资源利用效率的提升对RUIE产生适度但显著的直接缓解作用。相反，生产力与环境绩效的改善并无直接效应；而是通过削弱农产品供给功能间接加剧不平等——我们的模型识别出该功能是RUIE的强直接抑制因素。经济附加值功能与生态保育功能未表现出显著的直接均等化效应。这些发现表明，ETCU的公平结果并非自动实现，而是关键取决于其如何重塑农业的多功能结构。因此，政策干预必须采取综合路径，战略性地引导农业转型走向均衡的多功能性，保障多样化生产，并确保效率提升转化为城乡家庭广泛共享的福祉。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108283.title: Can the ecological transition of cropland use narrow rural-urban income inequality? Evidence from China’s Huang-Huai-Hai Region
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108283.title_zh: 耕地利用生态转型能否缩小城乡收入差距？——来自中国黄淮海地区的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108284.abstract: Despite rapid expansion of farmland transfer in rural China, the quality of contractual governance often fails to keep pace, raising the question of whether spatial consolidation arrangements can promote more complete contract terms. This study examines how coordinated land transfer promotes the standardization of farmland rental contracts within China’s three-rights separation framework. Drawing on primary household survey data from 1101 farming households across four counties in Guizhou Province, this study documents a robust positive relationship between the degree of spatial contiguity in transfer arrangements and the level of contract standardization. Mediation analysis applying the KHB decomposition method reveals that this effect is transmitted primarily through two operational channels: economies of scale and technology adaptation through mechanization adoption. Heterogeneity analysis further reveals that the standardization effect concentrates among operators with greater financial capacity, in regions with stronger market connectivity and irrigation infrastructure, and in villages where collective governance is comparatively weak.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108284.abstract_zh: 尽管中国农村土地流转规模迅速扩张，契约治理质量却往往未能同步提升，由此引发一个问题：空间整合安排能否促进更完整的契约条款？本研究考察在“三权分置”框架下，协调性土地流转如何推动农地租赁契约的标准化。基于贵州省四个县1101户农户的入户调查数据，研究发现流转安排的空间连片程度与契约标准化水平之间存在稳健的正向关系。采用KHB分解法的中介分析表明，这一效应主要通过两条运行渠道传导：规模经济与机械化采纳所引致的技术适应。异质性分析进一步揭示，标准化效应集中于资金能力较强的经营主体、市场连通性和灌溉基础设施较好的地区，以及集体治理相对薄弱的村庄。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108284.title: How does coordinated land transfer promote the standardization of contracts?
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108284.title_zh: 协调土地流转如何促进合同标准化？

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108285.abstract: We systematically review collective agri-environmental schemes that support landscape stewardship in agriculture. We analyze 96 case studies across OECD countries based on 73 peer-reviewed articles. To guide this review, we develop a framework based on policy dimensions, the policy cycle, and micro-level implementation dimensions. This framework provides a basis for defining evaluation criteria and for assessing how these schemes are designed. The review combines the analytical power of artificial intelligence with expert domain knowledge. The synthesis of both enables a comprehensive examination of policy and implementation dimensions, resulting in critical insights into the schemes’ designs and functioning, and their broader applicability. Our results describe patterns of design and implementation in the reviewed literature, without establishing a causal link between the design and implementation of schemes and ecological outcomes. We find considerable heterogeneity among schemes indicating flexibility for decision-makers to adapt schemes to specific environmental targets at local scale, but that there is still significant room to enhance the role of farmers as key players in collective agri-environmental schemes. By integrating human expertise with the capabilities of large language models, our approach exemplifies how to balance and mitigate the limitations of each, increasing the transparency of the review process.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108285.abstract_zh: 我们系统性地回顾了支持农业景观管理的集体农业环境计划。基于73篇同行评审文章，我们分析了OECD国家中的96个案例研究。为引导本综述，我们构建了一个基于政策维度、政策周期及微观实施维度的分析框架。该框架为定义评估标准和评估这些计划的设计方式提供了基础。本综述结合了人工智能的分析能力与专家领域知识，两者的综合运用使得对政策与实施维度进行全面审视成为可能，从而对计划的设计、运作及其更广泛的适用性提出关键见解。我们的结果描述了所回顾文献中的设计与实施模式，但并未建立计划设计与实施同生态结果之间的因果联系。我们发现各计划间存在显著异质性，表明决策者可根据地方尺度的具体环境目标灵活调整计划，但在增强农民作为集体农业环境计划关键参与者的作用方面仍有显著提升空间。通过将人类专业知识与大型语言模型的能力相结合，我们的方法展示了如何平衡并减轻各自的局限性，从而提高综述过程的透明度。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108285.title: A review of collective agri-environmental schemes using a human–AI framework
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108285.title_zh: 基于人机协同框架的集体农业环境计划述评

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108287.abstract: Uncontrolled urban expansion places increasing pressure on natural resources and poses a significant threat to agricultural production. The loss of agricultural land negatively affects food security and ecosystem services, while rising carbon emissions further exacerbate environmental challenges. In this context, the protection of fertile agricultural lands surrounding cities is critical for sustainable food production. Urban agriculture has emerged as an alternative approach that supports local food production, economic viability, and environmental sustainability. This study examines the suitability of agricultural lands located on the urban fringe of Erzurum for urban agriculture as a response to urban sprawl. The study area, covering selected neighbourhoods in the western part of Erzurum, was divided into 1 × 1 km grid cells. Spatial analyses were conducted for each grid cell based on seven main parameters and twenty-three sub-criteria. An agricultural suitability synthesis map was generated according to the cumulative impact scores derived from these parameters. Rather than limiting the analysis to suitability identification, the spatial results were translated into eight planning-oriented urban agriculture typologies targeting different user groups by integrating suitability outcomes with existing land-use and functional characteristics. The findings indicate that 848 ha of land in Erzurum’s urban periphery exhibit very high suitability for urban agriculture, while 1385 ha demonstrate high suitability. Overall, the study demonstrates that urban agriculture can function as a strategic land-use policy instrument by linking spatial suitability assessment with typology-based planning approaches, thereby supporting peri-urban land protection and guiding statutory planning decisions in secondary cities such as Erzurum.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108287.abstract_zh: 不受控制的城市扩张对自然资源施加了日益增长的压力，并对农业生产构成了重大威胁。农地流失对粮食安全和生态系统服务产生负面影响，而碳排放的上升进一步加剧了环境挑战。在此背景下，保护城市周边肥沃农田对于可持续粮食生产至关重要。城市农业已成为一种支持本地粮食生产、经济可行性和环境可持续性的替代途径。本研究考察了埃尔祖鲁姆城市边缘区农地作为应对城市蔓延的城市农业适宜性。研究区域覆盖埃尔祖鲁姆西部选定的社区，被划分为1×1公里的网格单元。基于七项主要参数和二十三项子标准，对每个网格单元进行了空间分析。根据这些参数得出的累积影响得分，生成了农业适宜性综合图。分析并未局限于适宜性识别，而是通过将适宜性结果与现有土地利用和功能特征相结合，将空间结果转化为面向不同用户群体的八种规划导向型城市农业类型。研究结果表明，埃尔祖鲁姆城市边缘区有848公顷土地对城市农业表现出极高的适宜性，另有1385公顷土地表现出高适宜性。总体而言，本研究证明，通过将空间适宜性评估与基于类型的规划方法相结合，城市农业可以作为一种战略性的土地利用政策工具，从而支持城郊土地保护，并指导埃尔祖鲁姆等次级城市的法定规划决策。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108287.title: Urban agriculture as a land-use policy instrument for protecting peri-urban agricultural land: A grid-based analysis from Erzurum, Türkiye
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108287.title_zh: 城市农业作为保护城郊农业用地的土地利用政策工具：来自土耳其埃尔祖鲁姆的基于网格的分析

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108288.title: Joint production, externalities, and terrace conservation strategies
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108288.title_zh: 联合生产、外部性与梯田保护策略

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108289.abstract: Protected areas play a central role in territorial governance and the provision of environmental public goods, yet their performance is typically evaluated through effectiveness-based frameworks rather than through efficiency analysis. This study provides a multidimensional assessment of 27 Italian National Parks, conceptualized as multi-mission public organizations operating within complex territorial and institutional contexts. Four mission-specific domains - ecological performance, tourism valorization, managerial administration, and governance capacity - are evaluated using Data Envelopment Analysis within a non-radial framework that captures asymmetric inefficiencies across functions. The analysis explicitly examines the role of institutional scale, distinguishing between pure technical inefficiency and structural scale effects. Results reveal differentiated performance regimes: ecological outcomes are largely anchored in territorial endowment, whereas tourism and managerial domains exhibit both slack-driven and scale-related inefficiencies. Governance performance appears strongly conditioned by the configuration of institutional scales. These findings highlight the importance of scale alignment and mission-specific benchmarking for improving the design and coordination of protected-area governance systems.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108289.abstract_zh: 保护区在领土治理和环境公共产品供给中发挥着核心作用，然而其绩效通常通过基于有效性的框架而非效率分析来评估。本研究对27个意大利国家公园进行了多维度评估，将其概念化为在复杂领土和制度背景下运作的多使命公共组织。四个特定使命领域——生态绩效、旅游增值、管理行政和治理能力——采用数据包络分析在非径向框架内进行评估，该框架能够捕捉各功能间的非对称低效率。分析明确考察了制度规模的作用，区分了纯技术低效率与结构性规模效应。结果显示差异化的绩效模式：生态成果主要锚定于领土禀赋，而旅游和管理领域则表现出由松弛驱动和规模相关的双重低效率。治理绩效似乎受到制度规模配置的强烈制约。这些发现凸显了规模匹配和使命特定基准对于改善保护区治理体系设计与协调的重要性。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108289.title: Multidimensional efficiency and institutional scale heterogeneity in protected areas: Evidence from Italy
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108289.title_zh: 保护区多维效率与制度规模异质性：来自意大利的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108290.abstract: Land use planning, as a scientific discipline, is a nexus among philosophy of science, planning theories and methodological frameworks. It is built primarily upon two distinct schools of thought, landscape ecology and land ecology, each supported by different ontological roots and epistemic commitments. The methodologies in this domain have been extensively developed and refined at a technical level; however, the underlying philosophies and ethical implications remain largely implicit. Consequently, spatial planning practices can potentially be stuck in a path-dependent cycle, where ethical blind spots and methodological numbness can arise. The current study analyzes how such foundations are embedded within the theories and methodologies of influential schools of thought in land use planning, a situation which currently constitutes a research gap. We address this gap by examining the epistemological and ethical underpinnings, and their methodological and planning implications, of both schools of thought. More specifically, our examination compares the way these planning approaches conceptualize, componentize and synthesize the land for planning and how they treat integration of socioeconomic and ecological data and delineate land units. Our analysis also shows how they rely on inductive and deductive reasoning, or causal and correlational analysis and how methodological choices can affect the level of holism/reductionism and non-anthropocentrism/anthropocentrism in the methodologies. This philosophical and analytical study contributes to advancing discussion and methodological innovations in land use science.
