10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108290.abstract_zh: 土地利用规划作为一门科学学科，是科学哲学、规划理论与方法论框架的交汇点。它主要建立在两种不同的思想流派之上，即景观生态学与土地生态学，各自依托不同的本体论根源和认识论承诺。该领域的方法论在技术层面已得到广泛发展与完善；然而，其背后的哲学基础与伦理意涵在很大程度上仍处于隐含状态。因此，空间规划实践可能陷入路径依赖的循环之中，从而产生伦理盲区与方法论麻木。本研究分析了这些基础如何嵌入土地利用规划中有影响力的思想流派的理论与方法之中，而这一现状目前构成了研究空白。我们通过考察这两种思想流派的认识论与伦理基础及其方法论和规划意涵来填补这一空白。更具体而言，我们的比较分析审视了这些规划方法在概念化、要素化及综合化土地以供规划之用的方式，以及它们如何处理社会经济与生态数据的整合并划定土地单元。我们的分析还揭示了它们如何依赖归纳与演绎推理，或因果与相关分析，以及方法论选择如何影响方法论中的整体主义/还原主义和非人类中心主义/人类中心主义水平。这项哲学与分析性研究有助于推动土地利用科学领域的讨论深化与方法论创新。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108290.title: Understanding land use philosophy through ontology and epistemology
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108290.title_zh: 从本体论与认识论视角理解土地利用哲学

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108291.abstract: Livestock browsing is a significant driver of forest degradation, with major ecological consequences. In Chile, high livestock stocking densities (LSD) negatively impact on forests, yet their social determinants remain poorly understood. Based on 100 farms that are part of the National Forest Inventory Dataset (farm-level socioeconomic and biophysical data measured in both 2016 and 2022), semi-structured interviews and forest plots (species, sizes, health, and regeneration plots) were performed to evaluate the impact of livestock on forests, understand its socioeconomic drivers, and propose policies to better regulate this activity. We observed that livestock production was stable between 2016 and 2022, despite the huge impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on productive systems. LSD decreased when the importance of off-farm incomes increased. Forest cover was also relevant, as LSD increased in larger and more deforested farms. It means deforestation exacerbates animal load and its negative impacts on the remnant forest fragments. A high LSD decreases seedling and sapling abundance, and increases damage on them, even in farms with supplementary fodder supply. We also observed a significant correlation between damage on tree regeneration and low-quality adult-trees (shape, health and diversity), which exposes past impacts of livestock on forests. As livestock is stable along time, this correlation shows how livestock has been degrading previous tree-cohorts and modifying forest dynamic in a silent process, which exposes how important regulating animal load is for the future of Chilean forests. Finally, we develop several policy proposals to better regulate livestock and its negative impacts.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108291.abstract_zh: 牲畜啃食是森林退化的重要驱动因素，具有重大生态后果。在智利，高牲畜放养密度（LSD）对森林产生负面影响，但其社会决定因素仍知之甚少。基于100个属于国家森林清查数据集（2016年和2022年两次测量的农场层面社会经济和生物物理数据）的农场，进行了半结构化访谈和森林样地（物种、大小、健康状况和更新样地）调查，以评估牲畜对森林的影响，理解其社会经济驱动因素，并提出政策以更好地规范这一活动。我们观察到，尽管COVID-19大流行对生产系统产生了巨大影响，2016年至2022年间畜牧业生产保持稳定。当非农收入的重要性增加时，LSD下降。森林覆盖率也具有相关性，因为在更大且更退化的农场中LSD增加。这意味着森林砍伐加剧了动物负荷及其对残余森林斑块的负面影响。高LSD降低了幼苗和幼树丰度，并增加了对其的损害，即使在提供补充饲料的农场中也是如此。我们还观察到树木更新损害与低质量成年树（形状、健康和多样性）之间存在显著相关性，这揭示了牲畜过去对森林的影响。由于畜牧业随时间保持稳定，这一相关性表明牲畜如何以无声过程持续退化先前的树木群体并改变森林动态，这凸显了调节动物负荷对智利森林未来的重要性。最后，我们提出了若干政策建议，以更好地规范畜牧业及其负面影响。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108291.title: Socioeconomic drivers of livestock browsing, and its impact on Chilean forests
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108291.title_zh: 智利森林中牲畜啃食的社会经济驱动因素及其影响

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108292.abstract: Brownfield regeneration is increasingly central to sustainable land-use policy in Europe, as it supports soil protection, compact urban development, urban restructuring, and reduced pressure on greenfield land. Yet redevelopment remains difficult because contaminated land is shaped not only by market conditions, but also by the institutional design of planning, remediation, financing, and intergovernmental coordination. This article compares Spain and the Netherlands to examine how different land-use policy architectures condition brownfield regeneration. Using a qualitative comparative approach that combines doctrinal legal analysis with institutional interpretation, it analyzes four dimensions: risk allocation, planning–environment integration, value-capture mechanisms, and governance modes. The findings identify two contrasting models. Spain operates through a codified and redistributive framework in which liability and value capture are largely predefined by statute, while remediation and planning remain institutionally differentiated. The Netherlands exhibits a more integrated and adaptive model in which environmental regulation is more closely embedded within spatial planning and redevelopment relies more heavily on negotiated coordination and local administrative capacity. The comparison shows that legislative integration alone does not ensure effective regeneration. What matters more is the alignment between liability rules, financial design, and governance capacity. The article concludes that brownfield redevelopment should be understood as a land-use policy problem of institutional coordination, not merely as a technical question of remediation or a market question of land valorization.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108292.abstract_zh: 棕地再开发正日益成为欧洲可持续土地利用政策的核心议题，因为它有助于土壤保护、紧凑型城市发展、城市更新以及减轻对绿地的开发压力。然而，由于受污染土地不仅受市场条件影响，还受规划、修复、融资和政府间协调的制度设计制约，再开发仍然面临困难。本文通过比较西班牙与荷兰，考察不同的土地利用政策架构如何影响棕地再开发。采用结合法律条文分析与制度解释的定性比较方法，本文从四个维度展开分析：风险分配、规划与环境整合、价值捕获机制以及治理模式。研究发现存在两种截然不同的模式。西班牙运行于一个法典化且具有再分配性质的框架之中，其中责任归属和价值捕获在很大程度上由法律预先设定，而修复与规划在制度上保持分离。荷兰则展现出一种更为整合且适应性更强的模式，其环境规制更紧密地嵌入空间规划之中，再开发更依赖于协商协调和地方行政能力。比较结果表明，仅靠立法整合并不能确保有效的再开发。更为关键的是责任规则、财务设计与治理能力之间的匹配。本文得出结论：棕地再开发应被理解为一项涉及制度协调的土地利用政策问题，而不仅仅是修复的技术问题或土地增值的市场问题。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108292.title: Land-use policy architectures for brownfield regeneration: A comparative analysis of Spain and the Netherlands
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108292.title_zh: 棕地再开发的土地利用政策架构：西班牙与荷兰的比较分析

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108293.abstract: Historic landscapes are frequently capitalized into accommodation prices, yet existing valuation frameworks still rely heavily on planar proximity or coarse visibility proxies that fail to capture room-level three-dimensional exposure in dense urban settings. This study develops an automated multi scalar analytical framework that integrates room level three dimensional viewshed modelling, street-view image perception, semantic segmentation, and explainable machine learning to estimate how multidimensional visual exposure translates into hotel room premiums in Beijing’s historic core. The analysis yields four main findings. First, three-dimensional exposure variables, especially maximum visual depth, provide substantially greater explanatory power than conventional visible-area measures, showing that being spatially close is not equivalent to seeing deeply. Second, room premiums respond to visual environments through nonlinear thresholds rather than smooth linear increments: moderate vertical observation conditions and moderate visual complexity are associated with stronger capitalization, whereas excessive visual competition from surrounding buildings rapidly erodes marginal returns. Third, landmark visual connectivity corresponds to discrete rent surges once critical visibility levels are reached, indicating that iconic heritage nodes reflect threshold like spillover effects on nearby accommodation prices. Fourth, both the magnitude and internal structure of visual premiums vary sharply across districts, demonstrating that capitalization is spatially differentiated rather than spatially uniform within the historic core. By shifting valuation from planar proximity to room-level depth, this study advances three-dimensional visibility assessment and provides an operational framework for view-corridor protection, height control, and differentiated heritage-area management in high-density historic environments. 10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108293.abstract_zh: 历史景观常被资本化入住宿价格之中，然而现有的估值框架仍主要依赖平面邻近性或粗略的可见性代理指标，未能捕捉高密度城市环境中房间级别的三维暴露情况。本研究开发了一种自动化的多尺度分析框架，整合了房间级别的三维视域建模、街景图像感知、语义分割及可解释机器学习，以估算多维视觉暴露如何转化为北京历史核心区酒店房间的溢价。分析得出四项主要发现。第一，三维暴露变量，尤其是最大视觉深度，相比传统可见面积指标提供了显著更强的解释力，表明空间上的接近并不等同于视觉上的深入。第二，房间溢价对视觉环境的响应呈现非线性阈值特征，而非平滑线性递增：适度的垂直观察条件和适度的视觉复杂度与更强的资本化效应相关联，而周边建筑过度的视觉竞争则迅速侵蚀边际回报。第三，地标视觉连通性在达到关键可见度水平后对应离散的租金激增，表明标志性遗产节点对周边住宿价格产生类似阈值的溢出效应。第四，视觉溢价的幅度及内部结构在各区域间差异显著，证明在历史核心区内，资本化效应在空间上呈现差异化而非均匀分布。通过将估值从平面邻近性转向房间级别的深度，本研究推进了三维可见性评估，并为高密度历史环境中的视廊保护、高度控制及差异化遗产区管理提供了操作框架。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108293.title: From planar proximity to room-level depth: Nonlinear capitalization of historic landscape visibility in dense urban districts
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108293.title_zh: 从平面邻近到街区尺度深度：密集城区历史景观可见性的非线性资本化

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108294.abstract: African agricultural systems are at a critical juncture, grappling with the interconnected challenges of soil degradation, climate change vulnerability, and rising food insecurity. While innovative, context-appropriate technologies are urgently needed, a significant chasm often separates promising pilot-scale demonstrations from their widespread adoption within national agricultural frameworks. This perspective paper explores biochar, a carbon-dense substance generated from the pyrolysis of organic waste, as a significant case study of this pilot-to-policy divide. Building upon recent discussions that have highlighted its potential, this analysis moves beyond advocacy to provide a critical examination of the socio-technical and economic barriers impeding its integration into African farming systems. We synthesize evidence from ongoing initiatives across the continent to argue that biochar's agronomic and climate benefits, while well-documented in experimental settings, remain unrealized at scale due to policy misalignment, limited farmer awareness, and underdeveloped value chains. We advocate for a unified approach to integrating biochar, underscoring the necessity for its official incorporation in national climate commitments, the tactical realignment of agricultural incentives, the establishment of continent-wide quality benchmarks, and its expedited assimilation into carbon market frameworks. We conclude that without such systemic and policy-oriented support, biochar and other similarly promising agricultural innovations risk remaining perpetually in a pilot phase, thereby delaying crucial progress toward a more resilient and food-secure future for the continent.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108294.abstract_zh: 非洲农业系统正处于关键转折点，面临土壤退化、气候变化脆弱性和日益加剧的粮食不安全等多重相互关联的挑战。尽管迫切需要创新且符合当地实际情况的技术，但前景广阔的试点规模示范与其在国家农业框架内的广泛采用之间，往往存在显著鸿沟。本文以视角论文的形式，探讨生物炭——一种通过有机废弃物热解产生的富碳物质——作为这一从试点到政策鸿沟的重要案例研究。在近期讨论凸显其潜力的基础上，本分析超越单纯倡导，对阻碍其融入非洲农业系统的社会技术及经济障碍进行批判性审视。我们综合非洲大陆正在进行的相关举措的证据，论证生物炭在农艺和气候方面的效益虽在实验环境中得到充分记录，但由于政策错位、农民认知有限以及价值链发展不足，其在大规模应用中仍未得到实现。我们倡导采用统一方法整合生物炭，强调将其正式纳入国家气候承诺、对农业激励措施进行战略性调整、建立全大陆质量标准，以及加速其融入碳市场框架的必要性。我们得出结论，若无此类系统性和政策导向的支持，生物炭及其他同样前景广阔的农业创新可能永远停留在试点阶段，从而延误非洲大陆迈向更具韧性和粮食安全未来的关键进展。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108294.title: From waste to resilience: A circular biochar framework for climate-smart agriculture in Africa
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108294.title_zh: 从废弃物到韧性：非洲气候智慧农业的循环生物炭框架

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108295.abstract: Forest carbon gross emissions from deforestation and degradation arise from interconnected socio-economic and ecological processes, including demographic pressure, urban expansion, and land-use transformation. In Ethiopia, these drivers exhibit strong spatial interdependence and temporal persistence, generating heterogeneous emission patterns that conventional econometric approaches may not sufficiently capture, especially the dynamic spatial characteristics of forest carbon emissions. This study examines the drivers of forest carbon gross emissions (FCGE) across time, space, and emission intensities using an integrated spatiotemporal framework that combines dynamic panel GMM estimation with spatial econometric models and the dynamic spatial Durbin model (DSDM)—alongside quantile regression analysis. Dynamic panel results show that population growth significantly increases FCGE, while the significant lagged FCGE term indicates strong persistence in forest carbon emissions over time. DSDM estimates indicate significant temporal persistence and spatial spillover effects, confirming that FCGE are driven by processes that are simultaneously dynamic and spatial, with stronger influences arising from boundary adjacency than from road network connectivity and distance decay. A 10% relative increase in urbanization is associated with an approximate 32% rise in emissions. Quantile regression results indicate strong asymmetries, with demographic, market, and land-use pressures exerting larger effects in high-emission regions. Overall, the findings underscore the need for coordinated, region-specific policies to mitigate FCGE, including early interventions to prevent persistent forest disturbances, targeted protection of vulnerable forest frontiers, stronger regulation of urban expansion, and locally tailored forest restoration strategies. The study provides robust, systems-based evidence to enhance REDD + implementation and climate-resilient environmental governance in Ethiopia and beyond.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108295.abstract_zh: 毁林和森林退化导致的森林碳总排放量，源于社会经济与生态过程的相互交织，包括人口压力、城市扩张和土地利用转型。在埃塞俄比亚，这些驱动因素表现出强烈的空间相互依赖性和时间持续性，产生了异质性的排放模式，而传统计量经济学方法可能无法充分捕捉这些特征，尤其是森林碳排放的动态空间特性。本研究采用一个整合的时空框架，结合动态面板GMM估计、空间计量模型、动态空间杜宾模型（DSDM）以及分位数回归分析，考察森林碳总排放量（FCGE）在时间、空间和排放强度上的驱动因素。动态面板结果显示，人口增长显著增加FCGE，而显著的滞后FCGE项表明森林碳排放随时间具有强烈的持续性。DSDM估计显示显著的时间持续性和空间溢出效应，证实FCGE由同时具有动态性和空间性的过程驱动，且边界邻近性比道路网络连通性和距离衰减产生更强的影响。城市化相对增长10%与排放量约32%的上升相关。分位数回归结果显示显著的不对称性，人口、市场和土地利用压力在高排放地区产生更大的影响。总体而言，研究结果强调了需要协调一致、针对特定区域的政策来减缓FCGE，包括早期干预以防止持续的森林干扰、对脆弱森林前沿进行有针对性的保护、加强对城市扩张的监管，以及因地制宜的森林恢复策略。本研究提供了基于系统的稳健证据，以增强埃塞俄比亚及其他地区的REDD+实施和气候适应性环境治理。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108295.title: Spatial spillovers and inequality in forest carbon emissions: Implications for land-use policy in Ethiopia
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108295.title_zh: 森林碳排放的空间溢出与不平等：对埃塞俄比亚土地利用政策的启示

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108296.abstract: Conservation covenants are an innovative legal mechanism that modify private property rights to promote biodiversity benefits. Their use is increasing as governments encourage private land conservation to help meet national and global biodiversity goals, such as the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. However, existing use of covenants from a variety of countries, including Australia, New Zealand and the United States, highlights some limitations. There is limited explicit accommodation of changing circumstances such as climate impacts; insufficient support to landowners and a need for increased environmental monitoring and compliance oversight. Several actions could be taken to ameliorate these and other law-related impediments, including improved reciprocity between parties to covenants, designing covenants with greater flexibility, and improving integrity mechanisms.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108296.abstract_zh: 保护契约是一种创新的法律机制，通过调整私人财产权以促进生物多样性效益。随着政府鼓励私人土地保护以助力实现国家和全球生物多样性目标，如昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架，其应用日益增多。然而，来自澳大利亚、新西兰和美国等多个国家的现有契约使用情况揭示了若干局限性。这些包括对气候变化影响等变化情况的明确适应不足；对土地所有者的支持不够，以及需要加强环境监测和合规监督。为缓解这些及其他法律相关障碍，可采取多项措施，包括增强契约双方间的互惠性，设计更具灵活性的契约，以及完善诚信机制。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108296.title: Private land, public benefits: Conservation covenants and easements aiding global biodiversity targets
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108296.title_zh: 私有土地，公共福祉：保护契约与地役权助力全球生物多样性目标

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108297.abstract: This study uses propensity score matching (PSM) to quantitatively evaluate the impact of Japan's Location Optimization Plan (LOP) on residential land prices. Despite the growing attention given to compact city development policies, rigorous empirical evaluations of the effectiveness of the LOP using causal inference methods remain limited. Stable land prices are crucial for sustainable urban development. Stable land prices ensure fair property valuations and promote investment confidence. Land price stability also affects infrastructure planning. The analysis uses data from Hachioji City, where the LOP has been implemented for over a decade, and compares it with data from other densely populated areas within Tokyo Prefecture. By applying nearest neighbor and kernel matching techniques, the study isolates the effects of the policy from confounding variables. The results demonstrate that land prices in Hachioji City decreased by approximately 6701.32 JPY/m2 compared to other areas in Tokyo. The results suggest that LOP implementation is associated with more moderate land price changes in Hachioji than in comparable areas. The findings contribute to our understanding of how spatial planning policies influence land markets in the context of demographic decline. The findings also offer methodological foundations for future policy assessments in similar contexts.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108297.abstract_zh: 本研究采用倾向得分匹配法（PSM）定量评估日本立地適正化計画（LOP）对住宅用地价格的影响。尽管紧凑型城市发展政策日益受到关注，但运用因果推断方法对LOP有效性进行严谨的实证评估仍较为有限。稳定的地价对城市可持续发展至关重要，它既能确保财产估值的公平性，又能增强投资信心，同时地价稳定还会影响基础设施规划。分析以已实施LOP超过十年的八王子市为对象，并将其数据与东京都内其他人口密集区域进行对比。通过采用最近邻匹配和核匹配技术，本研究将政策效应从混杂变量中分离出来。结果表明，与东京其他区域相比，八王子市的地价下降了约6701.32日元/平方米。研究结果显示，LOP的实施与八王子市相较于可比区域更为温和的地价变动相关联。这些发现增进了我们对人口减少背景下空间规划政策如何影响土地市场的理解，同时也为类似情境下的未来政策评估提供了方法论基础。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108297.title: Land price stabilization under Japan's LocatIon Optimization Plan: A propensity score matching analysis of Hachioji City
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108297.title_zh: 日本区位优化计划下的地价稳定：基于八王子市的倾向得分匹配分析

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108298.abstract: Urban development boundaries (UDBs) have been introduced in China’s territorial spatial planning system as a key tool to regulate urban expansion. However, existing research has paid limited attention to how land development rights are negotiated and exercised among multiple stakeholders under UDBs, from delineation to implementation. We develop a two-stage game model to explain the UDB policy, using the Pearl River Delta (PRD) urban agglomeration as a simulation case. In the first stage, a principal–agent model is applied to examine how land development rights are allocated through negotiations between superior and subordinate governments. In the second stage, an evolutionary game model is used to analyze the strategic interactions among governments and developers regarding land development rights under UDBs. Simulation results indicate that during delineation, higher land values and stronger bargaining capacity improve efforts to obtain quotas, whereas greater external volatility and heavier protection tasks reduce these efforts. During implementation, stakeholders’ strategies are linked with land quota scarcity in the first stage. In a quota-abundant scenario, the system converges to the optimal evolutionarily stable strategy (ESS) of strict supervision, prohibition, and compliance. In a quota-scarce scenario, achieving the optimal ESS becomes more difficult, requiring an effective penalty and strict accountability for subordinate governments. Overall, the proposed two-stage game framework provides a numerical illustration that captures the behavioral dynamics of multiple stakeholders and provides practical insights to strengthen the enforcement of UDBs.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108298.abstract_zh: 城市开发边界（UDBs）已被引入中国国土空间规划体系，作为调控城市扩张的关键工具。然而，现有研究对UDBs下从划定到实施过程中，多元利益主体之间土地发展权的协商与行使关注有限。我们构建了一个两阶段博弈模型来解释UDB政策，并以珠江三角洲（PRD）城市群作为模拟案例。第一阶段，运用委托—代理模型考察上级与下级政府之间通过协商分配土地发展权的过程。第二阶段，采用演化博弈模型分析UDBs下政府与开发商之间围绕土地发展权的策略互动。模拟结果表明，在划定阶段，较高的土地价值和更强的谈判能力会提升获取配额的积极性，而更大的外部波动性和更重的保护任务则会降低这种积极性。在实施阶段，各利益主体的策略与第一阶段的土地配额稀缺性相关联。在配额充裕的情景下，系统收敛于严格监管、禁止和合规的最优演化稳定策略（ESS）。在配额稀缺的情景下，实现最优ESS变得更加困难，需要有效的惩罚措施和对下级政府的严格问责。总体而言，所提出的两阶段博弈框架提供了一个数值示例，捕捉了多元利益主体的行为动态，并为加强UDBs的执行提供了实践启示。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108298.title: From delineation to implementation of urban development boundaries: A two-stage game of land development rights
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108298.title_zh: 城市开发边界的划定与实施：土地开发权的两阶段博弈

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108299.abstract: Extreme heat events significantly threaten public health and urban sustainability. Traditional urban green space (UGS) optimization often relies on static census data, failing to capture spatio-temporal variations in human activity and associated thermal risks. This study proposes a spatially explicit multi-objective optimization model to mitigate heat exposure in Xuzhou’s central urban area. Integrating hourly cellular signaling data from three representative time points (08:00, 14:00, and 20:00), the optimization framework utilizes a heuristic search strategy to simultaneously optimize four critical objectives: reducing heat exposure, minimizing conversion cost, enhancing spatial equity, and improving morphological compactness. Three policy-oriented scenarios—balanced development (BD), cost-effective (CE), and social equity (SE)—were simulated to explore the trade-offs between fiscal constraints and climate benefits. The main findings are as follows: (1) The proposed framework effectively captures the spatiotemporal heterogeneity of population heat exposure and generates differentiated UGS layouts under varying policy priorities. (2) The CE scenario achieves the lowest conversion cost, whereas the SE scenario yields higher cooling effectiveness and lower Gini coefficients through dispersed micro-scale green interventions in densely populated areas; the BD scenario provides a balanced compromise among the four objectives. (3) Spatial overlay analysis further identifies no-regret intervention zones that remain stable across scenarios and time periods, which are mainly concentrated on public service land, warehousing land, rural homesteads, and vacant land. This study advances UGS optimization from static, land-oriented planning toward multi-temporal, people-centered climate adaptation, providing practical support for heat mitigation and resilient urban planning in high-density cities.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108299.abstract_zh: 极端高温事件严重威胁公共健康和城市可持续性。传统的城市绿地（UGS）优化往往依赖静态普查数据，难以捕捉人类活动的时空变化及其相关的热风险。本研究提出了一种空间显式的多目标优化模型，以缓解徐州市中心城区的热暴露问题。该优化框架整合了三个代表性时间点（08:00、14:00和20:00）的小时级蜂窝信令数据，采用启发式搜索策略，同时优化四个关键目标：降低热暴露、最小化改造成本、增强空间公平性以及改善形态紧凑度。研究模拟了三种政策导向情景——均衡发展（BD）、成本效益（CE）和社会公平（SE），以探索财政约束与气候效益之间的权衡关系。主要研究发现如下：（1）所提出的框架能够有效捕捉人口热暴露的时空异质性，并在不同政策优先级下生成差异化的绿地布局。（2）CE情景实现了最低的改造成本，而SE情景通过在人口密集区域实施分散的小尺度绿色干预措施，获得了更高的降温效果和更低的基尼系数；BD情景则在四个目标之间提供了均衡的折中方案。（3）空间叠加分析进一步识别出在不同情景和时间段内保持稳定的无遗憾干预区，这些区域主要集中在公共服务用地、仓储用地、农村宅基地和空闲地。本研究将城市绿地优化从静态的、以土地为导向的规划推进到多时相的、以人为本的气候适应策略，为高密度城市的降温减灾和韧性城市规划提供了实践支持。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108299.title: Alleviating urban heat exposure through green space optimization: A multi-objective framework using cellular signaling data
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108299.title_zh: 通过绿色空间优化缓解城市热暴露：基于蜂窝信令数据的多目标框架

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108300.abstract: This article examines unequal access to coastal land in Mahajanga, Madagascar, under legal pluralism and growing tourism pressure. It analyses the gap between state land law, customary tenure practices and effective control over coastal space. The study uses a mixed-methods single-case design. Primary data come from 300 participants: 180 completed structured questionnaires and 120 took part in semi-structured interviews. Additional primary evidence includes observations across 16 sites, georeferenced records, field photographs and 100 locally collected taratasy, or informal land deeds. Secondary data include 47 land registration files, legal texts, cadastral records, census data and satellite imagery. Formal tenure security rarely matches widespread customary occupation. Among the 200 local household and resident participants, 72.0% relied mainly on customary arrangements, while only 15.0% held a registered land title. Coastal sectors with greater tourism development also show higher land values, a stronger concentration of formal transactions near the shoreline and more conflicts over access, enclosure and territorial control. Formal registration remains easier for actors with greater financial resources and stronger administrative networks. Within the Amborovy coastal sector, particularly in Marohala, Petite Plage and Grand Pavois, fences and tourism facilities restrict public access to the shore and reduce spaces used by fishing households. Existing land management tools therefore give limited protection to long-established occupants during rapid market change. The findings support closer coordination between land administration, local land uses and public coastal access. The case extends debates on legal pluralism and tourism-led land restructuring to secondary coastal cities in the Global South.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108300.abstract_zh: 本文考察了马达加斯加马哈赞加在法律多元主义和旅游业日益增长的压力下，沿海土地获取的不平等现象。文章分析了国家土地法、习惯保有制度与沿海空间实际控制之间的差距。研究采用混合方法的单案例设计。一手数据来自300名参与者：180人完成了结构化问卷，120人参与了半结构化访谈。其他一手证据包括16个地点的观察记录、地理参照数据、实地照片以及100份当地收集的非正式土地契约（taratasy）。二手数据包括47份土地登记档案、法律文本、地籍记录、人口普查数据和卫星影像。正式保有权的保障程度很少能与普遍的习惯占有相匹配。在200名当地家庭和居民参与者中，72.0%主要依赖习惯安排，而仅有15.0%持有注册土地所有权。旅游业发展程度较高的沿海区域也显示出更高的土地价值、更集中的近岸正式交易，以及更多关于通行权、圈占和领土控制的冲突。正式登记对于拥有更多财政资源和更强行政网络的行动者而言更为容易。在安博罗维沿海区域，特别是在马罗哈拉、小海滩和大帕瓦瓦，围栏和旅游设施限制了公众进入海岸的通道，并减少了渔业家庭使用的空间。因此，现有的土地管理工具在市场快速变化时期对长期定居者的保护十分有限。研究结果支持土地管理、地方土地利用和公共沿海通行权之间更紧密的协调。该案例将法律多元主义和旅游导向的土地重组的讨论扩展至全球南方的次级沿海城市。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108300.title: Legal pluralism and coastal land access: Inequalities, governance, and tourism pressure in Mahajanga
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108300.title_zh: 法律多元主义与沿海土地获取：马哈赞加的不平等、治理与旅游压力

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108301.abstract: Salinity intrusion is an emerging threat in low‑lying regions as climate‑driven fluvial/tidal flooding intensifies. Yet its impacts remain poorly characterised due to focus on biophysical processes and limited understanding of how it affects agricultural productivity, profitability, and risk exposure. The study sought to quantify the impact of flood‑induced salinisation on crop productivity and profitability, assess how it alters risk-return relationships, and evaluate how this affects crop competitiveness and optimal land‑use portfolios. The study focused on Greater Lincolnshire, United Kingdom as a case, and used spatially explicit crop, land‑grade, and flood‑risk datasets integrated with enterprise‑level gross‑margin modelling, Monte‑Carlo simulation, and cross‑crop competitiveness analysis. Without flood-induced salinisation, profitability varies across crops, with margins from £ 1114/ha for beet and £ 825/ha for winter wheat to £ 255/ha for potatoes. Under the salinity scenario, all crops incur substantial losses from simulated yield declines. Potatoes show the greatest drop (–£1382/ha), followed by beet (–£442/ha) and cereals such as winter wheat (–£339/ha), spring wheat (–£273/ha), and spring barley (–£304/ha). Risk-return analysis reveals that salinity systematically collapses the profitability hierarchy across crops, compressing them into a uniformly low‑return, moderate‑risk zone and thereby eliminating the high‑value production opportunities that currently underpin regional agricultural competitiveness. Competitiveness shifts markedly, with potatoes most disadvantaged and barley relatively resilient, while portfolio optimisation indicates strong reallocation toward winter wheat. Overall, the scenario suggests that flood‑induced salinisation could become a transformative constraint without flood defences, underscoring the need for proactive mitigation policies, adaptive planning, and investment in salt‑tolerant crop options.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108301.abstract_zh: 盐分入侵是低洼地区因气候驱动的河流/潮汐洪水加剧而出现的新威胁。然而，由于其影响主要聚焦于生物物理过程，且对农业生产力、盈利能力和风险暴露的影响理解有限，这些影响仍未得到充分刻画。本研究旨在量化洪水引发的盐渍化对作物生产力和盈利能力的影响，评估其如何改变风险-回报关系，并考察这对作物竞争力和最优土地利用组合的影响。研究以英国大林肯郡为案例，利用空间显式的作物、土地等级和洪水风险数据集，结合企业层面的毛利润建模、蒙特卡洛模拟和跨作物竞争力分析。在没有洪水引发的盐渍化情况下，不同作物的盈利能力各异，利润从甜菜的1114英镑/公顷和冬小麦的825英镑/公顷到马铃薯的255英镑/公顷不等。在盐渍化情景下，所有作物因模拟的产量下降而遭受重大损失。马铃薯降幅最大（–1382英镑/公顷），其次是甜菜（–442英镑/公顷）和谷物类作物如冬小麦（–339英镑/公顷）、春小麦（–273英镑/公顷）和春大麦（–304英镑/公顷）。风险-回报分析显示，盐渍化系统性地压缩了作物间的盈利层级，将其统一压缩至低回报、中等风险区域，从而消除了当前支撑区域农业竞争力的高价值生产机会。竞争力发生显著变化，马铃薯最受不利影响，而大麦相对具有韧性，同时组合优化表明向冬小麦的强烈重新配置。总体而言，该情景表明，在没有防洪设施的情况下，洪水引发的盐渍化可能成为变革性制约因素，凸显了采取主动缓解政策、适应性规划以及投资耐盐作物选项的必要性。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108301.title: Salinity fundamentally reshapes crop competitiveness and optimal land‑use portfolios in a high-value agricultural landscape
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108301.title_zh: 盐度从根本上重塑高价值农业景观中的作物竞争力和最优土地利用组合

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108302.abstract: Urban expansion is strongly determined by changes in urban population and the density in which new residents settle. Consequently, assessments of future changes in urban area depend on population and density projections. While the former are well-established, the latter have received much less research attention. To fill this void, we set up a time series representing most countries around the globe describing urban population density and several explanatory variables. Using a panel regression approach with country-fixed effects we explain the variation in density levels over time. The results indicate that urban density increases with growing total urban population and decreases with increasing levels of urbanisation. The latter effect diminishes, however, when the urban population fraction increases even further. These results indicate a sequence of increasing, decreasing and stabilising urban densities with increasing urban population shares. This succession can be linked to subsequent development stages of urbanisation, suburbanisation and eventually reurbanisation. The latter stage remains rare in our time series, however, as only a few countries reach the corresponding high urbanisation rates. Furthermore, we find that urban densities decrease with growing national income per capita. This may indicate that higher incomes enable suburbanisation to more dispersed urban areas with larger residences but can also be associated with the advent of smaller households and the growth of non-residential sectors such as industry and commerce. Conversely, urban density increases with higher agricultural land values that we proxy with a novel primary production intensity variable. We use our explanatory results to determine country-specific future urban areas following a commonly applied socio-economic scenario (SSP2) and suggest the total global urban area may triple from 2015 to 2100.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108302.abstract_zh: 城市扩张在很大程度上取决于城市人口的变化以及新居民定居的密度。因此，对未来城市面积变化的评估依赖于人口和密度预测。前者已较为成熟，而后者则较少受到研究关注。为填补这一空白，我们构建了一个涵盖全球大多数国家的时间序列，描述城市人口密度及若干解释变量。采用带有国家固定效应的面板回归方法，我们解释了密度水平随时间的变化。结果表明，城市密度随总城市人口增长而增加，随城市化水平提高而降低。然而，当城市人口比例进一步增加时，后者的效应会减弱。这些结果表明，随着城市人口份额的增加，城市密度经历先增、后减、再稳定的序列变化。这一序列可与城市化、郊区化及最终再城市化的后续发展阶段相联系。然而，在我们的时间序列中，再城市化阶段仍较为罕见，因为只有少数国家达到相应的高城市化率。此外，我们发现城市密度随人均国民收入增加而降低。这可能表明，更高的收入促使郊区化向更分散的城市区域发展，居住空间更大，但也可能与家庭规模缩小及工业、商业等非住宅部门的增长相关。相反，城市密度随农业土地价值增加而上升，我们采用一种新颖的初级生产强度变量作为其代理指标。我们利用这些解释性结果，依据一种常用社会经济情景（SSP2）确定各国未来的城市面积，并预计全球城市总面积在2015年至2100年间可能增长三倍。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108302.title: Explaining urban density trends; a global assessment of the factors that steer changes in urban population density
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108302.title_zh: 解释城市密度趋势：影响城市人口密度变化的全球因素评估

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108303.abstract: This editorial introduces the Special Issue, Sustainability Dialogue: Land Management Practices and Climate Change Resilience Efforts, developed from a Summer School and journal call involving scholars and practitioners across the global sustainability community. Its articles provide multidisciplinary teaching and reference material linking land governance, ecological processes, climate risk, technology, and human behaviour across rural, urban, forest, agricultural, and river-basin settings. Governance studies show that resilience requires coordinated institutions, secure land access, and incentives for long-term stewardship. At the same time, social research explains how local knowledge, livelihoods, adoption, public services, and environmental justice shape intervention outcomes. Ecological studies examine biodiversity, wetlands, forests, soils, ecosystem services, carbon storage, and fragmentation, identifying practical pathways such as agroforestry, conservation agriculture, green infrastructure, nature-based solutions, urban forestry, and restoration, alongside trade-offs involving production, urbanisation, energy, property values, and carbon sequestration. Remote sensing, GIS, modelling, artificial intelligence, and scenario tools support hazard mapping, attribution, forecasting, and intervention planning. Evidence from Africa, Asia, Europe, and the Americas links diagnosis, prediction, governance, finance, and implementation, advancing place-based, socially accountable, climate-resilient land management.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108303.abstract_zh: 本社论介绍了特刊《可持续性对话：土地管理实践与气候变化韧性努力》，该特刊源于一次暑期学校及期刊征稿活动，汇聚了全球可持续性社群的学者与实践者。其文章提供了多学科的教学与参考材料，将土地治理、生态过程、气候风险、技术及人类行为联系起来，覆盖农村、城市、森林、农业及流域等多种环境。治理研究表明，韧性需要协调的制度、有保障的土地获取权以及促进长期管护的激励机制。同时，社会研究解释了地方知识、生计、采纳行为、公共服务及环境正义如何影响干预成果。生态研究考察了生物多样性、湿地、森林、土壤、生态系统服务、碳储存及破碎化，识别出农林业、保护性农业、绿色基础设施、基于自然的解决方案、城市林业及生态恢复等实践路径，并探讨了涉及生产、城市化、能源、房产价值及碳封存之间的权衡取舍。遥感、地理信息系统、建模、人工智能及情景工具支持灾害绘图、归因分析、预测及干预规划。来自非洲、亚洲、欧洲及美洲的证据将诊断、预测、治理、融资与实施相连接，推进了基于地方、对社会负责且具有气候韧性的土地管理。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108303.title: Knowledge base on sustainability of land management practices and climate change resilience efforts
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108303.title_zh: 土地管理实践可持续性与气候变化韧性努力的知识基础

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108310.abstract: Understanding the potential synergies or trade-offs among the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) is crucial for achieving the 2030 Agenda. This study systematically investigates SDG synergies and trade-offs at the local scale by quantitatively describing the monotonicity and linear characteristics of SDG interactions in Chinese counties from 2000 to 2020 and compares the findings with those of other multiscale studies. The key findings include the following: (1) China's local-scale sustainable development trends show overall improvement, although the SDG2, SDG3, and SDG17 indices exhibit declining trajectories. (2) The majority of SDGs do not have significant interactions. Among the classified interactions, synergies are clearly more common than trade-offs are, and linear interactions are more common than nonlinear interactions are. (3) Spatial location and land development intensity shape SDG trade-offs. Synergies are largely consistent across locations, while adjacent counties show stronger economic–ecological tensions. Counties with higher shares of construction land exhibit more active SDG interactions and intensified trade-offs between economic development and ecological conservation. (4) SDG1, SDG8, SDG9, and SDG17 serve as core goals within the local-scale SDG network, functioning as leverage goals to maximize synergies and advance sustainable development. Additionally, the network relationships among the SDGs tend towards simplification over a 20-year period. (5) The synergies and trade-offs among the SDGs exhibit significant spatial variation across the different scales. Compared with global-scale and regional-scale SDG interactions, local-scale SDG relationships demonstrate stronger spatial heterogeneity and structural stability. Macroscale studies (national, provincial) often reveal overarching trends dominated by structural constraints, whereas microscale synergies or trade-offs are more influenced by local resource endowments, industrial structures, and social foundations.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108310.abstract_zh: 理解可持续发展目标（SDGs）之间的潜在协同效应或权衡关系对于实现2030年议程至关重要。本研究通过定量描述2000年至2020年中国县域SDG相互作用的单调性和线性特征，系统探讨了地方尺度上的SDG协同与权衡，并将研究结果与其他多尺度研究进行了比较。主要发现如下：（1）中国地方尺度的可持续发展趋势总体改善，尽管SDG2、SDG3和SDG17指数呈现下降轨迹。（2）大多数SDG之间不存在显著的相互作用。在已分类的相互作用中，协同效应明显多于权衡效应，线性相互作用多于非线性相互作用。（3）空间位置和土地开发强度塑造了SDG权衡关系。协同效应在不同区位间基本一致，而相邻县域表现出更强的经济-生态张力。建设用地占比较高的县域表现出更活跃的SDG相互作用，以及经济发展与生态保护之间加剧的权衡。（4）SDG1、SDG8、SDG9和SDG17是地方尺度SDG网络中的核心目标，作为杠杆目标以最大化协同效应并推进可持续发展。此外，SDG之间的网络关系在20年间趋于简化。（5）SDG之间的协同与权衡在不同尺度上表现出显著的空间差异。与全球尺度和区域尺度的SDG相互作用相比，地方尺度的SDG关系表现出更强的空间异质性和结构稳定性。宏观尺度研究（国家、省级）往往揭示以结构性约束为主导的总体趋势，而微观尺度的协同或权衡则更多受到地方资源禀赋、产业结构和社会基础的影响。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108310.title: Analysis of synergies and trade-offs in sustainable development goals at the local scale: A case study of 2,063 counties in China
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108310.title_zh: 地方尺度可持续发展目标协同与权衡分析：基于中国2063个县的案例研究

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108311.abstract: Indigenous Peoples' Lands (IPLs) play a key role in biodiversity conservation, yet IPLs are vulnerable to land grabbing for agricultural development. To understand the potential habitat exposure and main commodities overlapping with land grabs on IPLs, we combined the spatial distribution of land grabs intended for agricultural crops, plantations, and logging on IPLs with biodiversity metrics for mammal and bird species. Globally, 9.4 Mha of land grabs were on IPLs, with Russia (4.5 Mha), Myanmar (0.7 Mha), and Indonesia (0.7 Mha) having the highest areas. Land grabs were mainly for logging in Russia, biofuels in Myanmar, and a mixture of non-food, food, and biofuel crops in Indonesia. Oil palm (39 kha) and rice (37 kha) were the food crops and oil palm (42 kha) the biofuel crop associated with the highest deforestation areas on grabbed IPLs, while it was rubber (6 kha) for non-food crops. Deforestation on grabbed IPLs overlapped with 3213 species ranges with the highest potential habitat exposure in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Vietnam, on land grabs intended for oil palm, rubber crops, and timber plantations. Our results show that there are substantial land grabs on IPLs with a considerable potential habitat exposure, hence more effort is needed to protect IPL rights, ensuring indigenous stewardship of their land and biodiversity conservation.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108311.abstract_zh: 原住民土地（IPLs）在生物多样性保护中扮演着关键角色，然而这些土地却易受农业开发导致的土地掠夺影响。为探究IPLs上土地掠夺的潜在栖息地暴露及其主要商品重叠情况，我们结合了针对农业作物、种植园和伐木活动的土地掠夺空间分布，以及哺乳动物和鸟类物种的生物多样性指标。全球范围内，IPLs上共有940万公顷的土地被掠夺，其中俄罗斯（450万公顷）、缅甸（70万公顷）和印度尼西亚（70万公顷）面积最大。土地掠夺主要用于俄罗斯的伐木、缅甸的生物燃料，以及印度尼西亚的非粮食作物、粮食作物和生物燃料作物的混合用途。油棕（3.9万公顷）和水稻（3.7万公顷）是与被掠夺IPLs上森林砍伐面积最大的粮食作物，而油棕（4.2万公顷）则是与森林砍伐面积最大的生物燃料作物，橡胶（0.6万公顷）为非粮食作物。被掠夺IPLs上的森林砍伐与3213个物种的分布范围重叠，其中印度尼西亚、马来西亚和越南的潜在栖息地暴露程度最高，主要涉及油棕、橡胶作物和木材种植园的土地掠夺。我们的研究结果表明，IPLs上存在大量土地掠夺，且具有显著的潜在栖息地暴露，因此需要加大力度保护原住民土地权利，确保原住民对其土地的管理权及生物多样性保护。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108311.title: The biodiversity impacts of forestry and agricultural land grabs on Indigenous Peoples’ Lands
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108311.title_zh: 林业与农业土地掠夺对原住民土地生物多样性的影响

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108314.abstract: Housing inequalities have long been a pressing global issue, particularly in the context of rapidly transforming urban housing markets. However, intra-urban spatiotemporal disparities in housing price dynamics remain insufficiently understood. By developing an infrastructural approach operationalized through interpretable machine-learning methods that explicitly incorporate spatiotemporal heterogeneity, this study examines the complex capitalization of key infrastructures into housing prices, drawing on 288,570 second-hand housing transactions and multi-source geographic data from 2010 to 2023 in Shenzhen, one of the largest and most dynamic urban housing markets in China. The results reveal increasingly intensified housing price disparities, which are particularly pronounced within school catchment areas and 15-minute infrastructure-accessible neighborhoods. Compared with physical infrastructures, as well as structural and locational attributes, social infrastructures—especially public schools—are more decisively and consistently associated with housing prices. Their spatiotemporally heterogenous capitalization and increasingly salient threshold effects highlight the agency of social infrastructures in leveraging urban development and (re)shaping social inequalities, thereby advancing the understanding of housing price disparities. Finally, this study provides dynamic, fine-grained evidence to support locally calibrated and stage-sensitive urban planning and housing policies.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108314.abstract_zh: 住房不平等长期以来一直是全球性的紧迫问题，尤其是在城市住房市场快速转型的背景下。然而，城市内部住房价格动态的时空差异仍未得到充分理解。通过构建一种基础设施分析方法，并借助可解释的机器学习方法明确纳入时空异质性，本研究考察了关键基础设施对住房价格的复杂资本化效应，基于2010年至2023年间深圳288,570笔二手房交易及多源地理数据进行分析。深圳是中国规模最大、最具活力的城市住房市场之一。研究结果显示，住房价格差异日益加剧，尤其是在学区范围内和15分钟基础设施可达的邻里区域表现尤为突出。与实体基础设施以及结构和区位属性相比，社会基础设施——尤其是公立学校——与住房价格的关系更为决定性和一致性。其时空异质性的资本化效应及日益显著的阈值效应，凸显了社会基础设施在推动城市发展和（重新）塑造社会不平等中的能动作用，从而深化了对住房价格差异的理解。最后，本研究提供了动态、精细化的证据，以支持因地制宜、分阶段响应的城市规划和住房政策。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108314.title: Unravelling intra-urban spatiotemporal disparities in housing price dynamics: An infrastructural approach using interpretable machine-learning methods in Shenzhen, China
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108314.title_zh: 揭示城市内部房价动态的时空差异：基于可解释机器学习方法的深圳基础设施视角分析

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108315.abstract: With booming global trade and deepened connectivity, China, a central player in global oilseed trade networks, has not only eased domestic supply shortages but also fundamentally reshaped global resource allocation. However, the specific impacts of this trade on the quantity and quality of cultivated land protection remain under-explored. Using complex network analysis under the metacoupling framework, this study examines the evolution of major oilseed trade patterns from 2010 to 2023 and their metacoupling impacts. During 2010–2023, the global oilseed trade network exhibited escalating structural tightness and localized clustering, evidenced by a 27.2% and 24.6% increase in network density for the S1 and S2 networks, respectively, alongside a notable transition from regional fragmentation to transcontinental integration. Crucially, China’s oilseed imports activate a "Dual-track Land Sparing Mechanism": quantitatively expanding global land savings from 116.4 to 193.1 M ha, while qualitatively buffering the domestic agricultural system by trade-driven shifts in cultivation patterns, thereby stabilizing China’s domestic cultivated land pressure index at a low safety margin (0.13–0.16). This study highlights the pivotal role of trade in balancing national food security with global sustainable land management. Future policies should focus on diversifying import sources to sustain these quantity-quality benefits against supply concentration risks.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108315.abstract_zh: 随着全球贸易蓬勃发展和互联互通不断深化，中国作为全球油籽贸易网络的核心参与者，不仅缓解了国内供应短缺问题，也从根本上重塑了全球资源配置格局。然而，这一贸易对耕地保护数量与质量的具体影响仍未得到充分探讨。本研究在元耦合框架下运用复杂网络分析，考察了2010年至2023年主要油籽贸易格局的演变及其元耦合效应。2010—2023年间，全球油籽贸易网络呈现出结构紧密度上升和局部集聚增强的特征，S1和S2网络的网络密度分别增长了27.2%和24.6%，同时呈现出从区域碎片化向跨大陆一体化转变的显著趋势。至关重要的是，中国油籽进口激活了“双轨土地节约机制”：在数量层面，全球土地节约规模从1.164亿公顷扩大至1.931亿公顷；在质量层面，通过贸易驱动的种植模式转变，对国内农业系统形成缓冲，从而将中国国内耕地压力指数稳定在较低安全区间（0.13—0.16）。本研究凸显了贸易在平衡国家粮食安全与全球可持续土地管理中的关键作用。未来政策应聚焦于进口来源多元化，以在供应集中风险下维持上述数量—质量双重效益。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108315.title: Linking global oilseed trade networks to China's cultivated land conservation: A metacoupling perspective
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108315.title_zh: 链接全球油籽贸易网络与中国耕地保护：基于meta耦合的视角

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108316.abstract: Urban greening has become a widely adopted policy strategy for improving environmental quality and urban livability. However, the effectiveness of large-scale government-led greening programs and their ecological outcomes remain insufficiently evaluated, particularly in rapidly urbanizing countries. China’s National Garden City Program (NGCP), implemented nationwide for more than three decades, represents one of the world’s most extensive urban greening policy initiatives. Yet its actual impacts and underlying mechanisms across different regions and city types remain unclear. Using panel data from 293 prefecture-level cities between 2000 and 2022, this study applies a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) model to estimate the causal effects of the NGCP on urban greening. Results show that the NGCP significantly increases urban green coverage rates, but does not produce significant improvements in NDVI. Policy impacts vary spatially, with significant improvements in northern and southern cities and sub-provincial cities, while remaining insignificant in northwestern and Qinghai–Tibet regions. Mediation analysis indicates that industrial structure adjustment contributes to improvements in built-up-area NDVI, whereas fiscal investment is not a significant pathway. These findings demonstrate that government-led greening policies can effectively expand urban greenspace quantity but may not necessarily improve greenspace quality. The study highlights the importance of multidimensional evaluation frameworks and context-sensitive governance strategies for enhancing the ecological effectiveness of urban greening programs. The findings also provide evidence to support policymakers in refining the implementation and evaluation of urban greening policies, thereby improving the ecological effectiveness of future greening initiatives.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108316.abstract_zh: 城市绿化已成为改善环境质量和提升城市宜居性的广泛采纳的政策策略。然而，大规模政府主导的绿化项目及其生态成效尚未得到充分评估，尤其是在快速城市化国家。中国国家园林城市项目（NGCP）在全国范围内实施已超过三十年，是全球最广泛的城市绿化政策举措之一，但其在不同地区和城市类型的实际影响及内在机制仍不明确。本研究利用2000年至2022年间293个地级市的面板数据，采用交错双重差分（DID）模型估计NGCP对城市绿化的因果效应。结果显示，NGCP显著提高了城市绿化覆盖率，但并未显著改善NDVI。政策影响存在空间异质性，北方和南方城市以及副省级城市有显著改善，而西北地区和青藏高原地区则不显著。中介分析表明，产业结构调整有助于提升建成区NDVI，而财政投入并非显著路径。这些发现表明，政府主导的绿化政策能有效扩大城市绿地数量，但未必能提升绿地质量。研究强调了多维评估框架和情境敏感治理策略对提升城市绿化项目生态有效性的重要性。研究结果也为政策制定者优化城市绿化政策的实施与评估提供了证据支持，从而提升未来绿化举措的生态成效。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108316.title: The impact of urban greening policies: Evidence from China’s National Garden City Program
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108316.title_zh: 城市绿化政策的影响：来自中国国家园林城市项目的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108317.abstract: Dynamic urbanisation processes in Poland, including land development pressure and oversupply of buildable land, pose increasing challenges in ensuring equal access to soft infrastructure for local populations. These problems are addressed in the 2023 amendment to the Act on spatial planning and development. It allows for defining municipal standards for soft infrastructure accessibility in master plans. The study diagnoses the spatial accessibility of the infrastructure in Kraków and evaluates the compliance of the existing soft infrastructure with the new statutory standards. Its novelty lies in being the first attempt at operationalising the new regulations in an empirical analysis that uses network-based GIS methodology. The analyses were performed with the QNEAT3 plugin for QGIS using the statutory distance limits. The results show that 77% and 93% of parcels in Kraków conform to school and public green spaces accessibility criteria, respectively. However, only 56% of the city area has access to both types of soft infrastructure simultaneously; eastern and peripheral parts of the city are clearly disadvantaged. Overall, Kraków is relatively well prepared to implement soft infrastructure accessibility standards, but the findings revealed an integration gap across housing, transport, and environmental policies. The evidence can serve as a reference for other municipalities in Poland and internationally, including in Eastern European countries, following the sociopolitical transformation for implementing new spatial planning tools.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108317.abstract_zh: 波兰动态城市化进程，包括土地开发压力及可建设用地供应过剩，对确保当地居民平等享有软性基础设施带来了日益严峻的挑战。这些问题在2023年《空间规划与发展法》修正案中得到回应，该修正案允许在总体规划中定义软性基础设施可达性的市政标准。本研究诊断了克拉科夫基础设施的空间可达性，并评估了现有软性基础设施与新法定标准的符合情况。其创新之处在于首次尝试将新规应用于实证分析，采用基于网络的GIS方法。分析利用QGIS的QNEAT3插件，依据法定距离限制进行。结果显示，克拉科夫77%和93%的地块分别符合学校和公共绿地可达性标准。然而，仅有56%的城市区域能同时获得两类软性基础设施；城市东部和边缘地区明显处于劣势。总体而言，克拉科夫在实施软性基础设施可达性标准方面准备相对充分，但研究结果揭示了住房、交通和环境政策之间的整合缺口。该证据可为波兰及其他国际地区，包括经历社会政治转型后的东欧国家，在实施新空间规划工具时提供参考。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108317.title: Implementing municipal standards for soft infrastructure accessibility: A spatial diagnosis of Kraków in the context of urban planning reforms
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108317.title_zh: 实施软性基础设施可达性的市政标准：城市规划改革背景下克拉科夫的空间诊断

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108318.abstract: The spatiotemporal patterns of land consolidation in China have undergone profound reshaping, exerting significant impacts on socioeconomic development. Based on land use data from 2000 to 2024, this study analyzes the multi-scale spatiotemporal evolution and multidimensional effects of Chin’s land consolidation from the two dimensions of quantity and quality, specifically through cultivated land conversion area and cultivated land fragmentation. Significant spatial heterogeneity is identified. Four governance modes emerge: a "high-quantity-high-quality" synergistic improvement in the Northeast Plain; a coexistence of "high-quantity-low-quality" in the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau; a "low-quantity-high-quality" optimization in the Huang-Huai-Hai Plain; and a "low-quantity-low-quality" lag in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. Markov-chain forecasts indicate that cultivated land conversion is mobile under policy intervention and spatial spillovers, whereas cultivated land fragmentation remains rigid and stable due to natural constraints and spatial lock-in. Using the High-Standard Farmland Construction Policy as a quasi-natural experiment, land consolidation is found to have significantly increased grain production capacity and agricultural net carbon sequestration, while its effects on land transfer exhibit marked regional heterogeneity. Stronger policy responses in yield improvement and carbon-sink gains are observed in central western regions and major grain-producing areas, whereas land-transfer markets in eastern China are more sensitive to policy shocks. The study provides systematic empirical evidence for improving territorial-spatial governance and offers China’s experience to global sustainable land management.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108318.abstract_zh: 中国土地整治的时空格局经历了深刻重塑，对社会经济发展产生了显著影响。基于2000—2024年土地利用数据，本研究从数量与质量两个维度，即通过耕地转换面积与耕地破碎度，分析了中国土地整治的多尺度时空演变及其多维效应。研究发现显著的空间异质性。四种治理模式浮现：东北平原的“高数量—高质量”协同提升；云贵高原的“高数量—低质量”并存；黄淮海平原的“低数量—高质量”优化；以及青藏高原的“低数量—低质量”滞后。马尔可夫链预测表明，在政策干预与空间溢出作用下，耕地转换具有流动性，而耕地破碎度因自然约束与空间锁定效应而保持刚性与稳定。以高标准农田建设政策为准自然实验，研究发现土地整治显著提升了粮食生产能力与农业净碳汇，而其土地流转效应则呈现显著的区域异质性。中西部地区及粮食主产区在增产与碳汇增益方面表现出更强的政策响应，而东部地区土地流转市场对政策冲击更为敏感。本研究为完善国土空间治理提供了系统性经验证据，并为全球可持续土地管理贡献了中国经验。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108318.title: Deconstructing and evaluating China’s land consolidation from the dual perspective of quantity and quality
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108318.title_zh: 数量与质量双重视角下中国土地整治的解构与评价

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108319.abstract: Deforestation in Brazil’s Legal Amazon increased sharply after 2018, renewing concerns about environmental governance and frontier expansion. Yet it remains unclear whether this surge reflected only higher forest loss or a deeper reconfiguration of land-use drivers. The study examines whether the relationships linking municipal deforestation to governance, climate, and agricultural expansion changed after 2018. Using a municipality-year panel covering 634 municipalities for 2010–2021, the study combines satellite-based deforestation data, municipal economic accounts, gridded climate indicators, and environmental enforcement records in panel interaction and event-study models, complemented by an aggregate break-date assessment and spatial comparisons between the arc of deforestation and the interior Amazon. The results are consistent with a post-2018 reconfiguration of deforestation dynamics rather than only an increase in forest-loss levels. After 2018, the already positive enforcement–deforestation association strengthened substantially, indicating a change in magnitude rather than a sign reversal. This pattern is consistent with enforcement actions becoming increasingly concentrated in municipalities under greater deforestation pressure. Baseline estimates suggest that precipitation becomes more positively associated with deforestation while temperature loses explanatory relevance. These climatic shifts are sensitive to specifications that absorb time-varying spatial shocks, while the agricultural channel strengthens mainly outside the consolidated frontier. The baseline estimates are also spatially uneven: precipitation is positively associated with deforestation in the arc but negatively associated in the interior. These findings point to a qualitative restructuring of land-use pressures and support policy responses that combine restored enforcement with spatially differentiated governance strategies.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108319.abstract_zh: 巴西亚马逊合法地区的森林砍伐在2018年后急剧增加，重新引发了关于环境治理和边疆扩张的担忧。然而，尚不清楚这一激增是否仅反映了更高的森林损失，还是土地利用驱动因素发生了更深层次的重组。本研究考察了将市级森林砍伐与治理、气候和农业扩张联系起来的关联在2018年后是否发生了变化。利用覆盖2010—2021年634个市镇的市镇—年度面板数据，本研究将基于卫星的森林砍伐数据、市级经济账户、网格化气候指标和环境执法记录相结合，应用于面板交互和事件研究模型中，并辅以总体断点日期评估以及砍伐弧区与亚马逊内陆之间的空间比较。结果与2018年后森林砍伐动态的重组相一致，而非仅仅是森林损失水平的上升。2018年后，原本已为正的执法—森林砍伐关联显著增强，表明变化体现在幅度而非符号反转上。这一模式与执法行动日益集中于面临更大砍伐压力的市镇相一致。基线估计表明，降水与森林砍伐的正向关联增强，而温度的解释相关性减弱。这些气候效应在吸收时变空间冲击的设定下较为敏感，而农业渠道主要在已整合边疆之外得到强化。基线估计在空间上也不均衡：在砍伐弧区，降水与森林砍伐呈正相关，而在内陆地区则呈负相关。这些发现指向土地利用压力的质性重构，并支持将恢复执法与空间差异化治理策略相结合的政策应对。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108319.title: Reconfiguring deforestation drivers in Brazil’s Legal Amazon after 2018: Climate, agricultural production, and environmental governance
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108319.title_zh: 2018年后巴西亚马逊合法区毁林驱动因素的重构：气候、农业生产与环境治理

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108320.abstract: Urban sprawl is a major spatial transformation process characterized by the unplanned expansion of urban areas into surrounding rural and natural landscapes. As a result, rural areas at the urban fringe are increasingly exposed to pressures driven by population growth, housing demand, and expanding transportation infrastructure, giving rise to hybrid “rurban” landscapes. Managing these areas requires not only monitoring land use change but also identifying zones at risk of transformation before irreversible change occurs.Since the 1980s, Antalya has experienced rapid population growth, tourism-driven economic expansion, and largely uncoordinated development, leading to significant changes in surrounding agricultural and rural landscapes. This study develops a Geographic Information System (GIS) and remote sensing–based spatial analysis framework to systematically identify rural areas under urban sprawl pressure. The approach integrates the direction and intensity of urban expansion with existing rural land use patterns to examine their spatial interactions.Using multi-temporal satellite imagery within a GIS environment, the spatio-temporal dynamics of urban growth were analyzed and rural areas with high susceptibility to urban encroachment were delineated. The results show that the impacts of urban sprawl extend beyond existing built-up areas and are increasingly concentrated in transitional rural zones that remain unurbanized yet are critical for planning.The identified spatial patterns provide a basis for an early warning framework to support the protection of agricultural land and the development of preventive land use policies. Although tested in Antalya, the proposed framework is transferable to regions experiencing similar urbanization dynamics.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108320.abstract_zh: 城市蔓延是一种主要的空间转型过程，其特征是城市区域无计划地向周边乡村和自然景观扩张。因此，城市边缘的乡村地区日益面临由人口增长、住房需求和交通基础设施扩展所驱动的压力，催生了城乡融合的“半城市化”景观。管理这些区域不仅需要监测土地利用变化，还需在不可逆变化发生前识别面临转型风险的区域。自20世纪80年代以来，安塔利亚经历了快速的人口增长、旅游业驱动的经济扩张以及大体上缺乏协调的开发活动，导致周边农业和乡村景观发生显著变化。本研究开发了一个基于地理信息系统（GIS）和遥感的空间分析框架，以系统性地识别处于城市蔓延压力下的乡村地区。该方法将城市扩张的方向和强度与现有乡村土地利用模式相结合，考察其空间相互作用。利用GIS环境中的多时相卫星影像，分析了城市增长的空间-时间动态，并划定了对城市侵占高度敏感的乡村区域。结果表明，城市蔓延的影响已超出既有建成区，日益集中于尚未城市化但对规划至关重要的过渡性乡村地带。所识别的空间格局为早期预警框架提供了基础，以支持农业用地保护和预防性土地利用政策的制定。尽管在安塔利亚进行了测试，该框架可推广至经历类似城市化动态的其他地区。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108320.title: Spatial identification of rural areas under urban sprawl pressure: Preventive land-use policy framework for Antalya (Turkey)
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108320.title_zh: 城市蔓延压力下乡村地区的空间识别：安塔利亚（土耳其）预防性土地利用政策框架

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108323.abstract: Urban green spaces (UGSs) in rapidly urbanizing African cities are increasingly threatened by weak governance systems and institutional inefficiencies. This study investigates how formal and informal institutional arrangements shape governance responsibilities, interagency coordination, and UGS management in the Greater Tamale Metropolitan Area, Ghana. Using an institutional theory framework, the research adopted a qualitative case study approach, involving 54 semi-structured interviews, document analysis, and field observations across selected communities: Sagnarigu, Nyohini, Gumbeheni, Taha, and Kukuo. The findings reveal that UGS governance in Tamale operates through a hybrid institutional system in which statutory planning frameworks coexist with customary land tenure systems. Traditional authorities, particularly chiefs, play a significant role in land allocation and initiating planning processes, while state institutions primarily provide regulatory oversight. Although this arrangement creates opportunities for legitimacy and local participation, it also generates ambiguities in authority, weak accountability, and poor coordination among stakeholders. Collaboration tends to be stronger within institutional groupings than between local actors and formal spatial planning institutions. The study further identifies critical institutional constraints, including overlapping mandates, limited public participation, and severe staffing shortages in planning and environmental agencies. Specifically, only one of the required five physical planning officers and one of the four required development control officers were available during the study period. These institutional weaknesses, compounded by rapid urbanization and increasing land-use pressures, contribute significantly to the decline of UGS. The study concludes that strengthening coordination, accountability, participation, and institutional capacity is essential for sustainable and inclusive UGS governance.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108323.abstract_zh: 非洲快速城市化城市中的城市绿地（UGS）日益受到治理体系薄弱和制度效率低下的威胁。本研究探讨正式与非正式制度安排如何塑造加纳大塔马利都市区的治理责任、机构间协调及城市绿地管理。基于制度理论框架，研究采用定性案例研究方法，在选定的社区——萨格纳里古、尼奥希尼、贡贝赫尼、塔哈和库库奥——开展了54次半结构化访谈、文件分析和实地观察。研究发现，塔马利的城市绿地治理运行于一种混合制度体系中，法定规划框架与习惯土地保有制度并存。传统权威，尤其是酋长，在土地分配和启动规划进程中发挥重要作用，而国家机构主要提供监管监督。尽管这一安排为合法性和地方参与创造了机会，但也导致了权威模糊、问责薄弱以及利益相关者之间协调不力。协作在制度群体内部往往强于地方行动者与正式空间规划机构之间。研究进一步识别了关键制度制约因素，包括职责重叠、公众参与有限以及规划与环境机构严重的人员短缺。具体而言，在研究期间，所需五名实体规划官员中仅有一名到位，所需四名开发控制官员中也仅有一名在岗。这些制度弱点，加之快速城市化和日益增长的土地利用压力，显著加剧了城市绿地的退化。研究得出结论，加强协调、问责、参与和制度能力对于可持续和包容性的城市绿地治理至关重要。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108323.title: Institutional relationships in urban green space governance in Greater Tamale, Ghana: Roles, interactions and policy implications for sustainable management
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108323.title_zh: 加纳大塔马利城市绿地治理中的制度关系：角色、互动及可持续管理的政策启示

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108324.abstract: Customary land governance is widely studied in Northern Ghana for its failures, yet its contributions to social cohesion, community development, and resource management are underexplored. This study bridges that gap using a qualitative case of the Bole Traditional Area in the Savannah Region of Ghana, where customary land governance remains active and legitimate despite pressures from land commercialisation, small-scale mining and urbanisation. Drawing on twenty key informant interviews (KII) with land custodians (tindanas), chiefs, and community members, with eight focus group discussions, two each across the four communities (Kalba, Gbeniyiri, Soma, and Datompilayiri). The study employed thematic data analysis to examine how traditional values shape land governance, conflict resolution, environmental stewardship, and access equity. This study builds on Ostrom’s Common Pool Resource Theory, expanding it by showing how spiritual legitimacy is central and not periphery to effective customary governance, a dimension historically neglected by the framework. The study reveals that, land spiritual framing makes conflict resolution a moral process that sustains compliance beyond coercion, it also revealed that, indigenous conservation practices function as adaptive resource management strategies underrecognised by statutory frameworks, also gendered and generational hierarchies persistently constrain women and youth land access, with reforms failing to dismantle underlying inequalities. The study suggests a hybrid governance framework that honours indigenous strategies while addressing exclusion.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108324.abstract_zh: 加纳北部习惯土地治理因其失败而被广泛研究，但其对社会凝聚力、社区发展和资源管理的贡献却未得到充分探讨。本研究通过加纳萨凡纳地区博莱传统区域的定性案例弥合了这一空白，在该区域，尽管面临土地商业化、小规模采矿和城市化的压力，习惯土地治理仍然活跃且具有合法性。研究基于对土地监护人（tindanas）、酋长和社区成员进行的二十次关键知情人访谈（KII），以及四次社区（Kalba、Gbeniyiri、Soma和Datompilayiri）各两场共八场焦点小组讨论。研究采用主题数据分析方法，考察传统价值观如何塑造土地治理、冲突解决、环境管理和获取公平性。本研究以奥斯特罗姆的公共池资源理论为基础，通过展示精神合法性如何处于有效习惯治理的核心而非边缘地位来扩展该理论，这一维度历来被该框架所忽视。研究发现，土地的精神框架使冲突解决成为一种道德过程，维持了超越强制力的遵从；研究还揭示，本土保护实践作为适应性资源管理策略，未被法定框架充分认可；此外，性别和代际等级制度持续限制妇女和青年的土地获取，而改革未能消除潜在的不平等。研究提出了一种混合治理框架，既尊重本土策略，又解决排斥问题。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108324.title: Beyond the tragedy of the commons: Spiritual legitimacy, customary land governance, and community development in Northern Ghana
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108324.title_zh: 超越公地悲剧：精神合法性、习惯土地治理与加纳北部的社区发展

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108326.abstract: Land degradation and native vegetation loss in Brazil have persisted despite a comprehensive land use regulatory framework. This study examines how Brazilian federal land use policies changed between 2000 and 2025 and how these changes relate to institutional government change. Drawing on historical institutionalism, qualitative policy analysis, and process tracing, the research analyzes 239 laws and decrees across eight environmental and agricultural policies over eight administrations. The findings show that policy goals persisted across governments, while rules, instruments, budgets, and institutional capacities shifted. Two critical junctures, Dilma Rousseff’s impeachment in 2015 and the start of Bolsonaro’s presidency in 2019, coincided with environmental policy replacement, institutional dismantling, and weakened enforcement. However, prior layering and conversion of environmental policies created resilience, enabling institutional recovery under Lula’s third administration beginning in 2023. Agricultural policies exhibited greater stability, reflecting entrenched economic and political coalitions. Linking policy change processes to vegetation loss data shows that periods of weakened implementation were associated with increased vegetation loss, whereas restored institutional coordination was associated with reduced deforestation. Targeted strategies, especially the Action Plans for the Prevention and Control of Deforestation, were highly effective when supported by institutional capacity. This study calls for greater integration between agricultural and environmental policies, using cross-compliant financial and technical instruments to combat land use change driving vegetation loss, matched with continued whole-territory monitoring and targeted actions across biomes. The findings underscore the critical role of stable interministerial coordination and long-term institutional foundations in sustaining conservation policy amid political volatility.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108326.abstract_zh: 巴西的土地退化与原生植被丧失问题，尽管已有全面的土地利用监管框架，却依然持续存在。本研究考察了2000年至2025年间巴西联邦土地利用政策的变化及其与政府制度更迭的关联。基于历史制度主义、定性政策分析与过程追踪方法，本研究分析了八个行政任期内的八项环境与农业政策所涉及的239项法律和法令。研究发现，政策目标在各届政府间得以延续，而规则、工具、预算及制度能力则发生了变动。两个关键节点——2015年迪尔玛·罗塞夫遭弹劾和2019年博索纳罗总统任期开始——恰逢环境政策被替代、制度被瓦解及执法力度被削弱。然而，先前环境政策的层层叠加与转化形成了制度韧性，使2023年开始的卢拉第三届政府得以实现制度恢复。农业政策则表现出更强的稳定性，反映了根深蒂固的经济与政治联盟。将政策变迁过程与植被丧失数据相关联后发现，执行弱化时期与植被丧失加剧相关，而制度协调恢复则与森林砍伐减少相关。针对性策略，尤其是《预防与控制毁林行动计划》，在制度能力支撑下成效显著。本研究呼吁加强农业政策与环境政策之间的整合，利用交叉合规的金融与技术工具来应对驱动植被丧失的土地利用变化，并辅之以持续的全国范围监测及各生物群落的针对性行动。研究结果凸显了稳定的部际协调和长期制度基础在政治动荡中维持保护政策的关键作用。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108326.title: When governments shift, do policies follow?Tracing policy change in Brazil’s land use regulatory framework
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108326.title_zh: 政府更迭，政策是否随之改变？——追踪巴西土地利用监管框架的政策变迁

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108327.abstract: Global climate change and extreme precipitation events pose increasing threats to agricultural systems worldwide. However, existing studies often fail to integrate the synergistic effects of precipitation, neglect the role of transportation infrastructure, and rely on data with coarse spatial resolution. To address these gaps, this study develops a “climate–cropland–transportation” framework. By integrating high-resolution hourly precipitation data (0.1˚) and 30 m cropland distribution data, we quantified the thresholds, frequency, and intensity of extreme precipitation to construct a Cropland Extreme Precipitation Exposure (CEPE) index using the entropy weighting method. Four transportation accessibility scenarios—considering the presence or absence of expressways connecting prefecture- and county-level cities—were simulated to examine their spatial coupling with the CEPE. The results reveal pronounced spatial heterogeneity in CEPE across the study area. Rural population density and industrial structure exert nonlinear regulatory effects on cropland exposure to extreme precipitation. Extreme precipitation intensity peaks at moderate population levels, while areas where the primary industry accounts for 30–40% of the economy constitute a critical buffering zone. Geographically, croplands in southwest China remain highly threatened by extreme precipitation, whereas the exposure fluctuates considerably across the Huang–Huai–Hai Plain and the Northeast China Plain. Uneven transportation accessibility further amplifies these exposures, creating vulnerability traps in regions with high exposure but low accessibility, such as the Northeast China Plain. These findings offer valuable insights for developing targeted agricultural and infrastructure strategies to strengthen agricultural resilience under climate extremes.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108327.abstract_zh: 全球气候变化与极端降水事件对全球农业系统构成日益严重的威胁。然而，现有研究往往未能整合降水的协同效应，忽视了交通基础设施的作用，且依赖空间分辨率较粗的数据。为弥补上述不足，本研究构建了“气候—农田—交通”分析框架。通过整合高分辨率逐时降水数据（0.1˚）与30米农田分布数据，量化了极端降水的阈值、频率和强度，并采用熵权法构建了农田极端降水暴露度（CEPE）指数。本研究模拟了四种交通可达性情景——考虑地级市与县级市之间高速公路的有无——以考察其与CEPE的空间耦合关系。结果表明，研究区域内CEPE呈现显著的空间异质性。农村人口密度与产业结构对农田极端降水暴露度产生非线性调节效应。极端降水强度在中等人口水平下达到峰值，而第一产业占经济比重30%—40%的地区构成关键缓冲地带。从地理分布看，中国西南地区农田仍面临极端降水的高度威胁，而黄淮海平原和东北平原的暴露度则波动较大。交通可达性的不均衡进一步加剧了上述暴露风险，在高暴露但低可达性的地区（如东北平原）形成了脆弱性陷阱。上述发现为制定针对性的农业与基础设施策略、增强气候极端事件下的农业韧性提供了有价值的参考。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108327.title: Compound exposure of cropland to extreme precipitation and transportation disadvantage in China
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108327.title_zh: 中国农田极端降水与交通不便的复合暴露研究

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108330.abstract: The wildland–urban interface (WUI) refers to zones where buildings intersect with undeveloped wildland vegetation, and identifying its ecological effects is crucial for understanding human–environment conflicts in relation to landscapes. Current WUI assessments have focused primarily on areas with high-density human activity in developed countries, with limited evidence of vegetation degradation in ecologically vulnerable regions with rapid increases in human activity, e.g., the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau (QTP). We mapped the WUI at a 100-m resolution from 2000 to 2020 on the QTP and quantified vegetation greenness degradation within WUI expansion areas based on the normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI), leaf area index (LAI) and solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF), using propensity score matching (PSM) to control for environmental covariate bias and a difference-in-differences (DiD) approach to eliminate background temporal trends, thereby quantifying the net suppressive effect of WUI expansion on vegetation.The results revealed that the WUI area expanded by 48% over the 20-year period, and the expansion was concentrated mainly at the western, southern, southeastern, and eastern margins of the QTP. Urban expansion had a mean total contribution of 89.6% to WUI expansion, approximately 9 times that of wildland. LAI degradation was 11.57%, NDVI degradation was 2.48%, and SIF degradation was 2.06%; all three indicators exhibited consistent degradation directions, confirming that the impact of WUI expansion on vegetation is dominated by leaf area loss and canopy structural simplification. Direct land conversion is the primary driver of LAI degradation, which proceeds through multiple pathways including direct clearing, landscape reorganisation with fragmentation amplification, and the concentration of grazing pressure.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108330.abstract_zh: 城乡交错带（WUI）指建筑物与未开发野生植被相交的区域，识别其生态效应对于理解人类与环境的景观冲突至关重要。当前WUI评估主要聚焦于发达国家高密度人类活动区域，而对生态脆弱且人类活动快速增加地区（如青藏高原）的植被退化证据有限。本研究以100米分辨率绘制了2000至2020年青藏高原WUI分布图，并基于归一化植被指数（NDVI）、叶面积指数（LAI）和太阳诱导叶绿素荧光（SIF）量化了WUI扩张区域内的植被绿度退化，采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）控制环境协变量偏差，并运用双重差分（DiD）方法消除背景时间趋势，从而量化WUI扩张对植被的净抑制作用。结果表明，20年间WUI面积扩张了48%，扩张主要集中在青藏高原西部、南部、东南部和东部边缘。城市扩张对WUI扩张的平均总贡献率为89.6%，约为野生植被扩张贡献的9倍。LAI退化率为11.57%，NDVI退化率为2.48%，SIF退化率为2.06%；三项指标均呈现一致的退化方向，证实WUI扩张对植被的影响以叶面积损失和冠层结构简化为主要特征。直接土地转换是LAI退化的主要驱动因素，其作用通过多种途径实现，包括直接清除、伴随破碎化放大的景观重组以及放牧压力的集中化。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108330.title: Declining greenness under the rapid expansion of the wildland–urban interface on the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108330.title_zh: 青藏高原城乡交错带快速扩张下的绿地衰退现象

10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102526.abstract: Admission into public high schools in Türkiye was exam-based before 2018. The new policy is that the top 10% of students will continue to be placed in the best schools based on exam scores, while the remaining students will be assigned to other schools based on residential addresses. The reform raised concerns about educational inequality since the average public school quality and average income are positively correlated across municipalities. We use a general equilibrium political economy model of education to quantitatively analyze the reform. A computational experiment imply that mean achievement, variance of achievement, and aggregate household welfare decrease following the reform.
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102526.abstract_zh: 2018年之前，土耳其公立高中的入学基于考试。新政策规定，成绩排名前10%的学生将继续根据考试成绩被分配到最好的学校，而其余学生则根据居住地址被分配到其他学校。这项改革引发了关于教育不平等的担忧，因为各市镇的平均公立学校质量与平均收入呈正相关。我们运用教育的一般均衡政治经济学模型对改革进行定量分析。计算实验表明，改革后平均学业成就、学业成就方差以及家庭总福利均有所下降。

10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102531.abstract: This paper analyzes axiomatically what is known as “Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP),” focusing on depreciation. It is widely accepted that a depreciation method should be rational and systematic. There are many possible depreciation methods; however, only a few are used in practice, such as the straight-line method, the declining-balance method, the sum-of-the-years’ digits method, and the fair value measurement. We investigate through the axiomatic approach in what sense these depreciation methods can be considered rational and systematic. We provide a practical interpretation for each axiom examined in this paper and relate the axioms to accounting principles. Interestingly, it turns out that the straight-line method satisfies all but one of the axioms considered in the paper. Since the players are not humans in the model studied in the paper, it is not so clear whether the axiom of core selection is desirable or not in this context. Our analysis provides a positive answer to this question. Specifically, we show that core selection is a direct consequence of three compelling axioms: population monotonicity, the final year reasonableness, and conservatism.
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102531.abstract_zh: 本文以公理化方法分析了所谓的“公认会计原则”（GAAP），重点关注折旧问题。普遍认为，折旧方法应当合理且系统化。存在多种可能的折旧方法；然而，实践中仅使用少数几种，如直线法、余额递减法、年数总和法以及公允价值计量。我们通过公理化方法探究这些折旧方法在何种意义上可被视为合理且系统化。本文为所考察的每项公理提供了实际解释，并将这些公理与会计原则相联系。有趣的是，结果表明直线法满足本文考虑的所有公理，仅有一项除外。由于所研究模型中的参与者并非人类，核心选择公理在此情境下是否可取尚不明确。我们的分析对此问题给出了肯定答案。具体而言，我们证明核心选择是三个有力公理的直接结果：总体单调性、末年合理性以及稳健性。

10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102532.abstract: In random assignment, fairness is often captured by stochastic-dominance envy-freeness (SD-EF). We observe that assignments satisfying SD-EF may admit decompositions that result in each agent envying another agent with high probability. To address this, we introduce decomposition envy-freeness (Dec-EF), which is a property of a decomposition rather than of an assignment matrix. We show that an SD-EF assignment matrix always admits a Dec-EF decomposition when there are at most three agents or the agents have at most two distinct preferences.
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102532.abstract_zh: 在随机分配中，公平性常通过随机占优无嫉妒（SD-EF）来体现。我们观察到，满足SD-EF的分配可能允许某些分解，使得每个代理以高概率嫉妒另一个代理。为解决此问题，我们引入分解无嫉妒（Dec-EF），这是关于分解而非分配矩阵的性质。我们证明，当代理数量至多为三或代理至多有两种不同偏好时，SD-EF分配矩阵总是允许一个Dec-EF分解。

10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102543.abstract: We consider a class of cost allocation problems where a public facility is shared by a group of agents with “needs” for it, and these needs possess a “nested” character. A facility accommodating an agent can also accommodate any other agent with a lower need at no extra cost. The facility has to be provided to accommodate all agents. The question is how to allocate its cost among them. An example is airlines sharing an airstrip. These problems are therefore known as “airport problems”. We identify desirable rules through the axiomatic approach. We propose three main axioms: (i) order preservation in contribution rates, which requires the order of agents’ contribution rates to match the order of their needs; (ii) minimizing the range of contribution rates, which requires that the difference between the highest and lowest contribution rates among agents be minimized; and (iii) single-constraint consistency, which is an expression of the well-known “consistency” principle. Drawing inspiration from the literature on economic design, we adapt the proportionality principle to guarantee that no group of agents subsidizes the complementary group. We call this resulting rule the “constrained proportional rule”. Our main result is that this rule is the only rule satisfying these three axioms. We also provide new characterizations of two other well-known rules. The “constrained equal contributions rule” is the only rule minimizing the variance of contributions. The “constrained equal benefits rule” is the only rule minimizing the range (or variance) of benefits.
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102543.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一类成本分配问题，其中一项公共设施由一群对其有“需求”的代理人共享，且这些需求具有“嵌套”特征。容纳某一代理人的设施，也能以零额外成本容纳任何需求更低的代理人。该设施必须提供以容纳所有代理人。问题在于如何在代理人之间分配其成本。一个例子是航空公司共享一条跑道，因此这些问题被称为“机场问题”。我们通过公理化方法识别理想的规则。我们提出三个主要公理：（i）贡献率的顺序保持，要求代理人贡献率的顺序与其需求顺序一致；（ii）贡献率范围最小化，要求代理人中最高与最低贡献率之间的差异最小化；（iii）单约束一致性，这是著名的“一致性”原则的一种表达。借鉴经济设计文献中的思想，我们调整比例原则，以确保没有任何代理人群体补贴互补群体。我们将由此得到的规则称为“约束比例规则”。我们的主要结果是，该规则是唯一满足这三个公理的规则。我们还提供了另外两个著名规则的新特征化。“约束等贡献规则”是唯一使贡献方差最小化的规则。“约束等收益规则”是唯一使收益范围（或方差）最小化的规则。
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102543.title: Three rules for airport problems: Characterizations via order preservation, dispersion minimization, and consistency
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102543.title_zh: 机场问题的三条规则：基于顺序保持、分散最小化与一致性的刻画

10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102544.abstract: This paper study the effects of investment delay on the dynamics of economic growth. We consider the modified Mankiw–Romer-Weil model in the form of a two-dimensional dynamical system with a time delay both in the production and depreciation. To analyse the solutions of the model we use one of the special functions, the Lambert W function. The analytical and numerical methods are used to study the local stability of steady solution. We find that the MRW model with production and depreciation delays exhibit cyclic behaviour. The curves of stability change are determined with respect to model parameters.
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102544.abstract_zh: 本文研究了投资延迟对经济增长动态的影响。我们考虑修正的曼昆-罗默-韦尔模型，该模型以二维动力系统形式呈现，并在生产与折旧过程中均引入时间延迟。为分析模型解，我们运用了特殊函数之一——朗伯W函数。通过解析与数值方法，我们考察了稳态解的局部稳定性。研究发现，包含生产与折旧延迟的MRW模型展现出周期性行为。我们确定了稳定性变化曲线相对于模型参数的分布。
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102544.title: Mankiw–Romer–Weil model with a delay
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102544.title_zh: 含时滞的曼昆-罗默-韦尔模型

10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102545.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model which incorporates intra-organizational structures and bounded rationality into models of tax compliance and strategic firm behavior within a duopolistic setting where two firms with different technologies produce a homogeneous good. A linear product tax is imposed, and firms may choose partial compliance to reduce costs, at the risk of losing profits if tax evasion is detected. Each firm is functionally organized into a Manufacturing department and a Finance department. Manufacturing departments choose quantities through best-reply behavior, whereas Finance departments follow a bounded-rational gradient adjustment rule to update compliance. The interaction across departments and firms is represented by a four-dimensional piecewise smooth map. The unique Cournot–Nash equilibrium may be located either on the interior or at the boundaries of the feasible regions. According to the model predictions, the firm facing higher production costs tends to comply less; furthermore, lower tax rates promote higher compliance. As the system is analytically intractable, due to nonlinearities, boundary effects, and high dimensionality, the analysis focuses on numerical simulation. Tax rate, production inertia, compliance adjustment speed, and technological asymmetries lead to complex dynamics. The results indicate that tax evasion can compensate for cost disadvantages, affect production levels, and generate complex dynamics under the considered organizational arrangements.
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102545.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个动态模型，将组织内部结构与有限理性融入税收遵从及双头垄断市场中的企业策略行为分析，其中两家技术不同的企业生产同质产品。政府征收线性产品税，企业可选择部分遵从以降低成本，但若逃税行为被查处，则面临利润损失的风险。每家企业按职能划分为制造部门和财务部门：制造部门通过最优反应行为决定产量，而财务部门则遵循有限理性的梯度调整规则来更新遵从水平。跨部门及跨企业的相互作用由四维分段光滑映射表示。唯一的古诺-纳什均衡可能位于可行区域的内部或边界上。模型预测显示，生产成本较高的企业倾向于更低程度的遵从；此外，较低的税率有助于提高遵从水平。由于系统存在非线性、边界效应及高维性，解析处理难以实现，因此分析侧重于数值模拟。税率、生产惯性、遵从调整速度及技术不对称性共同引发复杂动态。结果表明，逃税可弥补成本劣势，影响生产水平，并在所考虑的组织安排下产生复杂动态行为。
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102545.title: Tax compliance and strategic interactions in a dynamic duopoly model with product tax
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102545.title_zh: 产品税动态双寡头模型中的税收遵从与策略互动

10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102546.abstract: We study how interpersonal information projection bias influences a researcher’s decision to implement a current idea or to continue drawing new ones. Consistent misbeliefs, such as overconfidence or underconfidence, distort beliefs in a fixed manner. In contrast, information projection creates state-dependent beliefs: before an idea arises, the researcher is optimistic about its uniqueness, and once the idea is in hand, the researcher becomes pessimistic. This fluctuation makes implementation less attractive and makes repeated searches more appealing. Our analysis yields two key findings. First, compared to any consistent-misbelief researcher whose fixed belief falls between the optimistic and pessimistic assessments of the information projection researcher, the information projection researcher is more selective: implementing less, drawing more ideas, and quitting less frequently. Second, at sufficiently high performance thresholds, researchers who end up passing the threshold are disproportionately information projection researchers. Consequently, information projection systematically biases both individual search dynamics and the composition of such researchers.
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102546.abstract_zh: 我们研究人际信息投射偏差如何影响研究者决定实施当前想法还是继续构思新想法。一致的错误信念，如过度自信或信心不足，会以固定方式扭曲信念。相比之下，信息投射产生依赖于状态的信念：在想法出现之前，研究者对其独特性持乐观态度；而一旦想法在手，研究者则变得悲观。这种波动使得实施想法的吸引力降低，而重复搜索则更具吸引力。我们的分析得出两个关键发现。首先，与任何固定信念介于信息投射研究者乐观与悲观评估之间的一致错误信念研究者相比，信息投射研究者更具选择性：实施更少、构思更多、放弃频率更低。其次，在足够高的绩效门槛下，最终通过门槛的研究者中，信息投射研究者占比不成比例地高。因此，信息投射系统性地偏差了个体搜索动态以及此类研究者的构成。
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102546.title: Information projection and selective search: Implement now or draw again
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102546.title_zh: 信息投射与选择性搜索：立即实施还是重新抽取
