10.1057/be.2016.5.abstract_zh: 本文展示了出生人数的历史波动如何影响教育体系、劳动力市场中的相对收入与失业率、家庭数量与构成、住房消费模式、医疗服务及个人社会服务的压力，以及国家退休养老金体系的缴费率。同时，本文揭示了大规模世代成员可能在教育机会、终身收入前景乃至所获养老金方面遭受的不利影响。
10.1057/be.2016.5.title: DP44 Economic Implications of Demographic Change
10.1057/be.2016.5.title_zh: DP44 人口变化的经济影响

10.1080/00036846.2025.2532888.abstract: This paper examines the nonlinear impact of environmental regulations in export destinations on the export quality of Chinese manufacturing goods using the CEPII-BACI database (2001–2021). This study reveals that environmental regulations in destination countries have an inverted U-shaped effect on the quality of Chinese manufacturing exports through the combined effects of the innovation effects, crowding-out effects, and constraint effects. In addition, the scale of imported intermediate products and foreign direct investments into China have a moderating role on the inverted U-shaped relationship, shifting the inflection point of the curve to the left and flattening it. This study deepens the understanding of the spillover effects of cross-border environmental policies and their effects on export quality.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2532888.abstract_zh: 本文利用CEPII-BACI数据库（2001-2021年），考察了出口目的地环境规制对中国制造业出口质量的非线性影响。研究发现，目的地国家的环境规制通过创新效应、挤出效应和约束效应的共同作用，对中国制造业出口质量产生倒U型影响。此外，进口中间品规模与外商对华直接投资对上述倒U型关系具有调节作用，使曲线拐点左移且曲线趋于平缓。本研究深化了对跨境环境政策溢出效应及其对出口质量影响的理解。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2532888.title: Does environmental regulation of export destinations affect export quality? Evidence from an emerging economy
10.1080/00036846.2025.2532888.title_zh: 出口目的地的环境规制是否影响出口质量？来自新兴经济体的证据

10.1080/00036846.2025.2532889.abstract: As most studies on the employment effects of the minimum wage rely on static employment frameworks, dynamic factors, such as labour mobility, have not been sufficiently explored. To address this gap in the literature, this study examines the employment effects of minimum wage hikes and the dynamic impact on job mobility (local position shifts) and geographical mobility (cross-regional labour relocation). We use data from the Urban Household Surveys in China from 2010 to 2014 and the China Household Finance Surveys from 2017 to 2019. The analysis reveals that minimum wage hikes negatively affect employment; however, the unemployment effect is nonlinear, with a less pronounced unemployment effect at the 60th percentile. From a dynamic perspective, the minimum wage hikes are associated with an increased likelihood of job transition among urban workers. Additionally, these transitions are often accompanied by a wage decline, especially in the low-friction service industry. Further, the hikes are associated with a higher incidence of return migrants and no significant increase in the aggregate unemployment rate. This study provides new evidence on the effects of minimum wage increases on dynamic job-mobility patterns and geographical reallocation, offering important new insights for minimum wage policies.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2532889.abstract_zh: 由于大多数关于最低工资就业效应的研究依赖于静态就业框架，诸如劳动力流动性等动态因素尚未得到充分探讨。为弥补这一文献空白，本研究考察了最低工资上调的就业效应及其对职业流动性（本地职位变动）和地理流动性（跨区域劳动力迁移）的动态影响。我们使用了2010年至2014年中国城镇住户调查数据以及2017年至2019年中国家庭金融调查数据。分析结果显示，最低工资上调对就业产生负面影响；然而，失业效应呈非线性特征，在第60百分位处失业效应相对较弱。从动态视角看，最低工资上调与城市工人职业转换概率增加相关联。此外，这些职业转换往往伴随着工资下降，尤其是在摩擦成本较低的服务业中。进一步地，最低工资上调与返乡迁移人口比例上升相关，但并未导致总体失业率显著增加。本研究为最低工资上调对动态职业流动模式和地理再配置的影响提供了新证据，为最低工资政策提供了重要的新见解。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2532890.abstract: This study examines the impact of fiscal transparency on the spatial layout of enterprises. After collecting data on 36,285 off-site subsidiaries established by 3725 listed companies in China’s A-share market from 2014 to 2021 and using the conditional logit model for empirical analysis, it is found that listed companies have a higher probability of establishing subsidiaries in cities with higher fiscal transparency. The above effect is more pronounced in the site selection process of subsidiaries that are affiliated with privately owned parent companies or not directly held by their parent companies, as well as micro, small, and medium-sized subsidiaries and subsidiaries whose main business is in the financial or real estate industry. To better attract capital inflows, local governments should enhance their information disclosure systems to improve fiscal transparency, strengthen communication with enterprises, and implement differentiated policies tailored to various types of enterprises.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2532890.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨财政透明度对企业空间布局的影响。通过收集2014年至2021年间中国A股市场3725家上市公司设立的36285家异地子公司数据，并运用条件Logit模型进行实证分析，发现上市公司更倾向于在财政透明度较高的城市设立子公司。上述效应在私营母公司下属或非直接控股的子公司选址过程中更为显著，同时，在微型、小型及中型子公司以及主营业务涉及金融或房地产行业的子公司中表现尤为突出。为更好地吸引资本流入，地方政府应完善信息披露制度以提升财政透明度，加强与企业的沟通，并针对不同类型企业实施差异化政策。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2532891.abstract: We construct a comprehensive financial stress index (FSI) by leveraging all available time-series data for the Iranian economy, which has long contended with extensive financial and non-financial sanctions. To this end, we measure the dynamic response of this devised FSI to different exogenous shocks including expected and unexpected changes in oil price and production, well as Middle-East geopolitical crisis over Nov. 1997 to Dec. 2023 considering quantile and time frequency connected approaches. We find that the Iranian financial market is relatively more sensitive to changes in oil price than oil production shocks. Besides, the Iranian financial market is exposed with the hike of geopolitical events concerning Turkey and Israel, while it is less responsive to those events concerning Egypt and Saudi Arabia. Besides, Iranian financial market demonstrates resilience to oil price shocks before 2008. We also find that outbreak of COVID-19 or the escalation of the conflict between Russia and Ukraine did not cause financial stress in the Iranian financial market.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2532891.abstract_zh: 我们利用伊朗经济所有可用的时间序列数据，构建了一个全面的金融压力指数（FSI），该经济体长期面临广泛的金融和非金融制裁。为此，我们测量了这一设计的FSI对不同外生冲击的动态响应，包括油价和产量的预期及非预期变化，以及1997年11月至2023年12月期间中东地缘政治危机，采用分位数和时间频率关联方法。我们发现，伊朗金融市场对油价变化的敏感度相对高于石油产量冲击。此外，伊朗金融市场对涉及土耳其和以色列的地缘政治事件升级表现出暴露性，而对涉及埃及和沙特阿拉伯的事件反应较弱。同时，伊朗金融市场在2008年前对油价冲击表现出韧性。我们还发现，COVID-19的爆发或俄罗斯与乌克兰冲突的升级并未导致伊朗金融市场出现金融压力。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2534731.abstract: Using data from Chinese listed companies, this study examines the overall impact of the smart city policy (SCP) on corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance, focusing on the distinct effects across the E, S, and G dimensions. Using a multiperiod difference-in-differences (DID) approach, we analyse 24647 firm-year observations from 2009 to 2021, leveraging the three-stage SCP rollout as a quasi-natural experiment. The results indicate that the SCP improves corporate ESG scores by approximately 0.04, with significant enhancements in governance performance. Mechanism analysis also reveals that the SCP fosters ESG improvements through increased R&D investments and market attention, while executive environmental awareness has limited effects. Policy impacts also vary by ownership and industry, with state-owned enterprises, industrial firms, and companies in low-pollution and high-technology sectors obtaining the greatest benefits. Robustness checks, including alternative models and PSM-DID estimations, confirm these findings. Moreover, interaction analysis indicates that the SCP and other sustainability-focused policies (e.g. green credit and resource city policies) act as substitutes rather than complements due to policy priority and resource constraints for companies. Our findings underscore the importance of a coordinated policy design to maximize the collective effectiveness of policies in promoting sustainable corporate practices.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534731.abstract_zh: 基于中国上市公司数据，本研究考察了智慧城市政策（SCP）对企业环境、社会和治理（ESG）绩效的整体影响，重点关注其在E、S、G三个维度上的差异化效应。采用多期双重差分（DID）方法，我们分析了2009年至2021年间24647个公司-年度观测值，将三阶段SCP推广作为准自然实验。结果表明，SCP使企业ESG得分提升约0.04，其中治理绩效的改善尤为显著。机制分析进一步揭示，SCP通过增加研发投入和市场关注度促进ESG改善，而高管环境意识的影响有限。政策效应因所有权性质和行业类型而异，国有企业、工业企业以及低污染和高科技行业的企业获益最大。包括替代模型和倾向得分匹配双重差分（PSM-DID）估计在内的稳健性检验证实了上述发现。此外，交互效应分析表明，由于政策优先级和企业资源约束，SCP与其他可持续发展导向政策（如绿色信贷政策和资源型城市政策）呈现替代而非互补关系。本研究结果强调了协调政策设计对于最大化政策组合在促进企业可持续实践方面整体效能的重要性。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534731.title: Better city, better life: smart city policy and corporate ESG performance
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534731.title_zh: 智慧城市，美好生活：智慧城市政策与企业ESG表现

10.1080/00036846.2025.2534732.abstract: This article is concerned with a green production optimization problem of enterprises and obtains the optimal production strategy. A stochastic green production model is established by introducing stochastic differential equations. The carbon quota is incorporated as a control variable. We transform the problem to one kind of optimal control problems. In virtue of the convex variational technique and Ekeland variational principle, the maximum principle is established. Finally, we use this result to solve the original enterprise’s production optimization problem in the specified context. Our model and our results can have many policy implications. They can also be used by governments to price externalities and side effects, as the principle is to tax companies that issue more carbon and pollution.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534732.abstract_zh: 本文关注企业的绿色生产优化问题，并获得了最优生产策略。通过引入随机微分方程，建立了一个随机绿色生产模型。将碳配额作为控制变量纳入考量。我们将该问题转化为一类最优控制问题。借助凸变分技术和Ekeland变分原理，建立了最大值原理。最后，我们利用这一结果在特定情境下解决了企业原始的生产优化问题。我们的模型和结果具有多项政策启示，也可供政府用于对外部性和副作用定价，其原则是对排放更多碳和污染的企业征税。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2534733.abstract: This study examines the effectiveness of Digital Financial Inclusion (DFI) in alleviating the vulnerability of expected poverty (VEP) among rural households in China by utilizing data from the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS) from 2012 to 2020. The results demonstrate a mechanism that DFI significantly reduces VEP among rural households by stimulating entrepreneurial activities. However, this mechanism exhibits a distinct ‘digital divide’ where households below the poverty line of $1.90 per day fail to utilize DFI to mitigate their VEP status, due to insufficient digital literacy, lower risk tolerance, and higher risk aversion. By analysing the marginal effects of control variables such as the head of household’s occupation, family size, and healthcare, this study provides valuable conclusions and additional empirical evidence to eliminate rural vulnerability. This study carries significant implications for extending the benefits of deepened DFI reforms to greater numbers of impoverished households.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534733.abstract_zh: 本研究利用2012年至2020年中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）数据，探讨了数字普惠金融（DFI）在缓解中国农村家庭预期贫困脆弱性（VEP）方面的有效性。研究结果显示，DFI通过激发创业活动显著降低了农村家庭的VEP，但这一机制呈现出明显的“数字鸿沟”现象：日均收入低于1.90美元贫困线的家庭，因数字素养不足、风险承受能力较低及风险规避倾向较高，未能利用DFI来缓解其VEP状况。通过分析户主职业、家庭规模及医疗保障等控制变量的边际效应，本研究为消除农村脆弱性提供了有价值的结论及额外的实证证据。本研究对于将深化DFI改革的红利惠及更多贫困家庭具有重要启示意义。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2534734.abstract: This paper examines how support from entrepreneurs’ insiders affects financial constraints for entrepreneurs using a survey of 2,644 new firms in Japan. The major findings of this paper are as follows. First, bank referrals from their insiders alleviate entrepreneurs’ financial constraints, whereas there is no evidence that the provision of initial funds from such insiders alleviates the constraints. Second, the effect of such referrals can be more pronounced for financially constrained entrepreneurs. Third, the referrals are effective in alleviating entrepreneurs’ financial constraints even if they do not receive initial funds from their insiders.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534734.abstract_zh: 本文利用日本2644家新创企业的调查数据，考察企业家内部人支持如何影响其融资约束。主要发现如下：第一，内部人提供的银行推荐能够缓解企业家的融资约束，但尚无证据表明内部人提供的初始资金能缓解此类约束；第二，对于面临融资约束的企业家而言，此类推荐的效果更为显著；第三，即便企业家未从内部人处获得初始资金，内部人推荐仍能有效缓解其融资约束。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534734.title: How do insiders affect start-up financing?
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534734.title_zh: 内部人士如何影响初创企业融资？

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535542.abstract: While improving agricultural technical efficiency and alleviating energy poverty are vital components of sustainable development, existing research on the relationship between the two remains limited. This study aims to elucidate the effects and mechanisms of energy poverty on agricultural technical efficiency. The sample comprises small-scale farmers from the China Family Panel Studies, spanning from 2012 to 2018. Utilizing the two-stage least squares method to correct for the endogenous bias of energy poverty, our findings indicate that energy poverty reduces agricultural productivity by 11.7% to 47.8%, depending on the measurement method used. With a structural equation modelling approach, we find that the relationship between energy poverty and agricultural productivity is partially mediated by non-agricultural employment and land transfer, which contribute 3.72% to 30.86% to the total impact of energy poverty. Non-agricultural employment and land transfer hinder the improvement of agricultural technical efficiency in the process of alleviating energy poverty. The results and findings of this study yield significant policy implications for energy poverty alleviation and the enhancement of agricultural technical efficiency, which can be generalized to other developing countries.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535542.abstract_zh: 提升农业技术效率与缓解能源贫困是可持续发展的重要组成部分，然而现有关于二者关系的研究仍较为有限。本研究旨在阐明能源贫困对农业技术效率的影响及其作用机制。研究样本来自中国家庭追踪调查（2012-2018年）中的小规模农户。通过采用两阶段最小二乘法校正能源贫困的内生性偏误，研究发现：根据测量方法的不同，能源贫困使农业生产率降低11.7%至47.8%。基于结构方程模型的分析表明，非农就业与土地流转在能源贫困与农业生产率的关系中发挥部分中介作用，二者对能源贫困总效应的贡献度介于3.72%至30.86%之间。在缓解能源贫困的过程中，非农就业与土地流转反而抑制了农业技术效率的提升。本研究的结论对发展中国家制定能源贫困缓解与农业技术效率提升政策具有重要启示意义。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535542.title: Does energy poverty affect agricultural technical efficiency? Evidence from small-scale farmers in China
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535542.title_zh: 能源贫困是否影响农业技术效率？来自中国小规模农户的证据

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535543.abstract: There is a prevailing claim, particularly among proponents of modern monetary theory (MMT), which sovereign defaults on public debt denominated in a sovereign currency can be avoided through monetization. Despite considerable opposition to this assertion, to the best of the authors‘ knowledge, no rigorous empirical analysis has been conducted to test this proposition. This study aims to fill this gap by statistically analysing the validity of the proposition using traditional logistic regression and a machine-learning technique known as random forest. The findings suggest that, although the share of public debt denominated in a sovereign currency indeed reduces the probability of sovereign default, other factors, such as the public debt-to-gross domestic product ratio and the economic growth rate, do significantly influence the probability of sovereign default. These results indicate that the data do not support the MMT’s assertion.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535543.abstract_zh: 有一种普遍观点，尤其在现代货币理论（MMT）的支持者中流传，认为以主权货币计价的公共债务可以通过货币化来避免主权违约。尽管这一论断面临相当大的反对意见，但据作者所知，尚无严谨的实证分析对此命题进行检验。本研究旨在填补这一空白，通过使用传统逻辑回归和一种称为随机森林的机器学习技术，对命题的有效性进行统计分析。研究结果表明，尽管以主权货币计价的公共债务比例确实降低了主权违约的概率，但其他因素，如公共债务与国内生产总值之比以及经济增长率，确实显著影响主权违约的概率。这些结果说明，数据并不支持MMT的论断。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535544.abstract: Leveraging China’s corporate annuity system, a state-guaranteed and employee-friendly practice, we examine its impact on executive pay-performance sensitivity. Our study results show a significant increase in executive pay-performance sensitivity when firms establish an annuity system. Mechanism tests indicate that the optimization of firms’ human capital structure results in increased executive pay-performance sensitivity following the establishment of the annuity system. In cross-sectional analysis, the effect of the annuity system on executive pay-performance sensitivity is more pronounced among high-tech firms and companies with lower financing constraints. We contribute to the research on employee-related corporate governance reforms by elucidating the role of employees in executive compensation contracts, thereby aiding global firms in deepening their positive perceptions of employee-friendly practices.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535544.abstract_zh: 利用中国具有国家保障且对员工友好的企业年金制度，我们考察了其对高管薪酬业绩敏感性的影响。研究结果显示，当企业建立年金制度后，高管薪酬业绩敏感性显著提升。机制检验表明，企业人力资本结构的优化是年金制度设立后高管薪酬业绩敏感性增强的原因。在横截面分析中，年金制度对高管薪酬业绩敏感性的影响在高科技企业和融资约束较低的公司中更为显著。我们通过阐明员工在高管薪酬契约中的作用，为员工相关的公司治理改革研究做出贡献，从而帮助全球企业深化对员工友好实践的积极认识。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535545.abstract: This study examines the debt service ratio (DSR) as a predictor of household financial distress in South Korea, with a particular focus on identifying the threshold at which delinquency risk rises sharply. Leveraging household-level microdata and a multilevel Bayesian threshold regression model, we estimate the tipping point in the DSR – default relationship while accounting for household heterogeneity. Our findings indicate that the critical DSR threshold falls below current regulatory benchmarks, suggesting that many households may experience financial strain at lower debt levels than anticipated by policymakers. Notably, we find substantial variation by employment type: temporary and self-employed workers exhibit significantly higher vulnerability, even at moderate DSRs. These results highlight the limitations of uniform regulatory caps and support the need for differentiated, evidence-based lending standards. By offering the first data-driven estimate of DSR thresholds in Korea, this study advances the academic understanding of household credit risk and informs ongoing macroprudential policy development. KEYWORDS: Debt service ratio Delinquency financial stability multilevel bayesian model JEL CLASSIFICATION: G51 C11 D14 G21
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535545.abstract_zh: 本研究以韩国为对象，考察偿债比率（DSR）作为家庭财务困境预测指标的有效性，重点识别违约风险急剧上升的阈值。通过运用家庭层面微观数据与多层贝叶斯阈值回归模型，我们在考虑家庭异质性的基础上，估算了DSR与违约关系中的临界点。研究结果表明，关键DSR阈值低于现行监管基准，这意味着许多家庭在债务水平低于政策制定者预期时便可能面临财务压力。值得注意的是，不同就业类型之间存在显著差异：临时工与自雇劳动者即使在中等DSR水平下也表现出明显更高的脆弱性。这些结果揭示了统一监管上限的局限性，并支持制定差异化、基于证据的贷款标准。通过首次提供韩国DSR阈值的数据驱动估计，本研究深化了对家庭信用风险的学术理解，并为当前宏观审慎政策的发展提供参考。关键词：偿债比率；违约；金融稳定；多层贝叶斯模型 JEL分类：G51；C11；D14；G21
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535545.title: DSR and Household debt delinquency: evidence from South Korea
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535545.title_zh: DSR与家庭债务违约：来自韩国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535546.abstract: BRICS nations – Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa – stand at a critical crossroads. These countries, while achieving impressive economic growth and urbanization over the past few decades, now face escalating environmental challenges. This study dives deep into the interplay between educational development, digital transformation, and environmental sustainability in BRICS nations from 1990 to 2022. The analysis employs dynamic panel data techniques, including Two-Step System Generalized Method of Moments (GMM), AMG, CCEMG, Fixed Effects models, and also Granger causality to capture the relationships between educational components and environmental outcomes effectively. The GMM outcomes reveal a double-edged sword: economic growth (EG) drives environmental degradation, whereas digital transformation (DT) emerges as a powerful counterforce, significantly mitigating emissions. The first model highlights primary education’s (SEP) vital role in fostering sustainable practices, showing a significant positive effect on reducing carbon emissions (CE). The second model underscores the impact of secondary education (SES), with increased investment proving pivotal in advancing environmental sustainability. The third model brings tertiary education (SET) into the spotlight, emphasizing its crucial contribution to enhancing environmental outcomes. The robustness of these findings is reinforced through rigorous-fixed effects panel regression analysis, consistently affirming the interconnectedness of education, digital transformation, and urbanization in tackling environmental challenges.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535546.abstract_zh: 金砖国家——巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非——正站在关键的十字路口。这些国家在过去几十年实现了令人瞩目的经济增长和城市化进程，但如今面临着日益严峻的环境挑战。本研究深入探讨了1990年至2022年间金砖国家教育发展、数字化转型与环境可持续性之间的相互作用。分析采用动态面板数据技术，包括两步系统广义矩估计法（GMM）、AMG、CCEMG、固定效应模型，以及格兰杰因果检验，以有效捕捉教育要素与环境结果之间的关系。GMM结果显示了一柄双刃剑：经济增长（EG）加剧了环境退化，而数字化转型（DT）则成为强大的反制力量，显著减少了排放。第一个模型凸显了初等教育（SEP）在促进可持续实践中的关键作用，表明其对减少碳排放（CE）具有显著的积极影响。第二个模型强调了中等教育（SES）的影响，增加投入被证明是推进环境可持续性的关键。第三个模型将高等教育（SET）置于聚光灯下，强调其在改善环境结果方面的重要贡献。通过严格的固定效应面板回归分析，这些发现得到了进一步强化，一致证实了教育、数字化转型和城市化在应对环境挑战中的相互关联性。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535547.abstract: This study examines how industrial agglomeration interacts with global value chains (GVCs) integration to affect total factor productivity (TFP) in China. Using panel data from 30 provinces between 2011 and 2020, we find that agglomeration alone is associated with lower TFP, likely due to congestion and resource misallocation. However, when embedded in GVCs, agglomeration exerts a positive and significant impact on productivity. Mechanism analysis reveals that innovation capacity and industrial competitiveness enhance this effect, especially in regions with high GVC value-added. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that GVC participation amplifies agglomeration’s productivity benefits in high-agglomeration regions, but not in low-agglomeration ones. These findings highlight the need for region-specific policies that promote GVC upgrading, foster innovation and strengthen industrial linkages to support high-quality development.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535547.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了产业集聚与全球价值链（GVCs）整合如何相互作用，进而影响中国的全要素生产率（TFP）。基于2011年至2020年间30个省份的面板数据，我们发现，集聚本身与较低的全要素生产率相关，这可能是由于拥挤效应和资源配置不当所致。然而，当嵌入全球价值链时，集聚对生产率产生了积极且显著的影响。机制分析揭示，创新能力与产业竞争力增强了这一效应，尤其是在全球价值链附加值较高的地区。异质性分析进一步表明，全球价值链参与在高集聚地区放大了集聚的生产率收益，但在低集聚地区则不然。这些发现强调了制定区域特定政策的必要性，以促进全球价值链升级、激发创新并强化产业联系，从而支持高质量发展。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535548.abstract: This study constructs an R&D technology model that considers cross-ownership (CO) in a duopoly, analyses the boundaries of R&D decisions, and examines the impacts of CO on R&D efforts and social welfare. Our findings reveal that an increase in CO level negatively affects social welfare, while both independent and collaborative R&D can enhance social welfare. In independent R&D, it is crucial to control CO levels, as excessive CO can result in a monopoly, leading to a significant loss of social welfare. The impact of CO on R&D effort is dual, with the outcome hinging on the contrast between the ‘prospect-improving effect’ of R&D and the ‘competition-softening effect’ induced by CO. The extended analysis finds that reverse shareholding, in which a non-R&D firm holds equity in an R&D firm, exacerbates the asymmetry in the cost-benefit distribution structure, hindering collaborative R&D and reducing R&D efforts. In the context of CO, allocating decision-making power based on equity shares is a more effective strategy for enhancing social welfare and improving R&D performance.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535548.abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个考虑交叉持股（CO）的双寡头研发技术模型，分析了研发决策的边界，并考察了交叉持股对研发努力和社会福利的影响。研究发现，交叉持股水平的提升对社会福利产生负面影响，而独立研发与合作研发均能增进社会福利。在独立研发情形下，控制交叉持股水平至关重要，因为过高的交叉持股可能导致垄断，从而造成社会福利的重大损失。交叉持股对研发努力的影响具有双重性，其结果取决于研发的“前景改善效应”与交叉持股引发的“竞争缓和效应”之间的对比。扩展分析发现，反向持股——即非研发企业对研发企业持有股权——加剧了成本收益分配结构的不对称性，阻碍了合作研发并降低了研发努力。在交叉持股背景下，基于股权份额分配决策权是提升社会福利和改善研发绩效的更有效策略。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535548.title: Cross-ownership, R&D decision, and social welfare in a duopoly
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535548.title_zh: 双寡头市场中的交叉持股、研发决策与社会福利

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535549.abstract: Upgrading household consumption is essential for China’s high-quality economic development. This study develops a framework for asset allocation and consumption decision-making that includes wealth accumulation and social security, clarifying the theoretical mechanisms through which social security influences household consumption upgrading. Using a mixed cross-sectional dataset from the Chinese Social Survey (CSS), this study empirically evaluates the impact of social security on household consumption upgrading. The results show that (1) social security significantly and positively affects household consumption upgrading; this result is robust after accounting for endogeneity problems and conducting multiple robustness checks. (2) The impact of social security on household consumption upgrading varies across cultural practices, pandemic shocks, and employment characteristics, showing heterogeneity. (3) Social security can promote household consumption upgrading by enhancing future household expectations. The role of expectations is significant in how social security influences household consumption upgrading.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535549.abstract_zh: 居民消费升级对于中国经济高质量发展至关重要。本研究构建了一个包含财富积累与社会保障的资产配置与消费决策框架，明确了社会保障影响居民消费升级的理论机制。利用中国社会状况综合调查（CSS）的混合截面数据，本研究实证评估了社会保障对居民消费升级的影响。结果显示：（1）社会保障显著正向影响居民消费升级；在考虑内生性问题并进行多项稳健性检验后，这一结果依然稳健。（2）社会保障对居民消费升级的影响因文化习俗、疫情冲击及就业特征的不同而呈现异质性。（3）社会保障能够通过增强居民未来预期来促进消费升级。预期在社会保障影响居民消费升级的过程中发挥着重要作用。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535550.abstract: Despite the growing importance of digital transformation (DT) in reshaping organizational innovation, its role in fostering cross-boundary innovation remains underexplored. Using an approach that is grounded in resource dependence theory (RDT), this study examines the impact of DT on cross-boundary innovation by analysing a sample of 2,582 Chinese A-share listed companies from 2012 to 2022. The findings indicate that DT significantly enhances enterprises’ cross-boundary innovation and promotes incremental and breakthrough innovation. Furthermore, mechanism analyses reveal that DT facilitates cross-boundary innovation by expanding innovation networks and reducing external transaction costs. Additionally, heterogeneity analysis reveals that high-tech enterprises and those with strong absorptive capacity are more likely to benefit from DT in fostering cross-boundary innovation. This research contributes to the literature by providing empirical evidence on the mechanisms by which DT enhances cross-boundary innovation, thus deepening the understanding of such mechanisms through the lens of RDT. Practically, this study offers guidance for enterprises to leverage DT in optimizing networks and reducing transaction costs, thereby achieving breakthroughs and incremental innovations across boundaries.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535550.abstract_zh: 尽管数字化转型（DT）在重塑组织创新中的重要性日益凸显，但其在促进跨界创新方面的作用仍未得到充分探索。本研究基于资源依赖理论（RDT），通过分析2012年至2022年间2,582家中国A股上市公司的样本，考察了DT对跨界创新的影响。研究发现，DT显著增强了企业的跨界创新，并促进了渐进式创新与突破式创新。此外，机制分析表明，DT通过扩大创新网络和降低外部交易成本来促进跨界创新。进一步地，异质性分析揭示，高科技企业和具有较强吸收能力的企业更有可能从DT中受益，以促进跨界创新。本研究通过提供DT增强跨界创新机制的实证证据，为相关文献做出贡献，从而通过RDT视角加深对这些机制的理解。实践上，本研究为企业利用DT优化网络、降低交易成本，从而实现跨界突破与渐进创新提供了指导。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535550.title: How does digital transformation affect cross-boundary innovation? Evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535550.title_zh: 数字化转型如何影响跨界创新？——来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535551.abstract: This study aims to examine the relationship between the digital economy and the environmental development gap between the eastern and western regions of China. Using urban panel data from 2003 to 2021, we apply the entropy method to measure the development levels of the digital economy and environmental performance across cities. The study systematically analyzes the impact and mechanisms of the digital economy in narrowing the environmental development gap. Furthermore, it examines the effects of its linkage on promoting regional convergence and common prosperity. The findings show that: First, the development of the digital economy significantly reduces the environmental development gap between the eastern and western regions. Second, mechanism analysis reveals that the digital economy promotes green technological innovation, improving carbon productivity and energy efficiency, thereby helping to narrow the gap. Third, the digital economy fosters environmental development in neighbouring cities, exhibiting significant spatial spillover effects. Fourth, digital economy exhibits significant linkage effects in promoting environmental equity and supporting the realization of common prosperity, with micro-level mechanisms indicating that the digital economy can increase the incomes of rural residents. Overall, the development of the digital economy not only narrows regional environmental disparities but also promotes broader economic and social objectives.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535551.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨数字经济与中国东西部地区环境发展差距之间的关系。利用2003年至2021年的城市面板数据，我们采用熵值法衡量各城市数字经济发展水平和环境绩效。研究系统分析了数字经济在缩小环境发展差距方面的影响及其作用机制，并进一步考察了其联动效应在促进区域趋同与共同富裕中的作用。研究发现：第一，数字经济的发展显著缩小了东西部地区之间的环境发展差距。第二，机制分析表明，数字经济促进绿色技术创新，提升碳生产率和能源效率，从而有助于缩小差距。第三，数字经济对邻近城市的环境发展具有促进作用，表现出显著的空间溢出效应。第四，数字经济在促进环境公平和支持实现共同富裕方面展现出显著的联动效应，微观层面的机制表明，数字经济能够增加农村居民收入。总体而言，数字经济的发展不仅缩小了区域环境差异，还推动了更广泛的经济和社会目标的实现。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535551.title: Bridging the East-West environmental development gap in China: the role and mechanisms of the digital economy in promoting common prosperity
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535551.title_zh: 弥合中国东西部环境发展差距：数字经济促进共同富裕的作用与机制

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535552.abstract: Amidst a rapidly evolving energy landscape, understanding how ESG-driven sustainability risks reshape oil, heating oil, and natural gas prices is crucial for investors and policymakers charting a resilient path forward. Therefore, this study utilizes the recently developed ESG-based sustainability uncertainty index (ESGUI), which provides a crucial tool for assessing how ESG (environmental, social, governance) uncertainties are integrated into investment decisions. This research examines the impact of ESGUI on fossil fuel energy price volatility, using data from 2002:M11 to 2024:M9. Additionally, the study introduces wavelet cross-quantile regression to capture this relationship. The results show that ESGUI has a predominantly negative short-term impact on oil, heating oil, and natural gas prices, especially under bearish or moderately active market conditions. However, in the long term, ESG uncertainty tends to increase prices across all three fuels – reflecting market adjustments to regulatory risks, supply concerns, and hedging strategies. Based on these findings, the study formulates relevant policy recommendations.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535552.abstract_zh: 在快速演变的能源格局中，理解ESG驱动的可持续性风险如何重塑石油、取暖油和天然气价格，对于投资者和政策制定者规划韧性发展路径至关重要。因此，本研究利用近期开发的基于ESG的可持续性不确定性指数（ESGUI），该指数为评估ESG（环境、社会、治理）不确定性如何融入投资决策提供了关键工具。本研究考察了ESGUI对化石燃料能源价格波动的影响，使用了2002年11月至2024年9月的数据。此外，研究引入了小波分位数回归来捕捉这一关系。结果显示，ESGUI对石油、取暖油和天然气价格主要产生短期负面影响，尤其是在市场看跌或适度活跃的条件下。然而，长期来看，ESG不确定性倾向于推高所有三种燃料的价格——反映了市场对监管风险、供应担忧及对冲策略的调整。基于这些发现，研究提出了相关政策建议。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535553.abstract: Taking the Yangtze River Delta region of China as a case study, this study empirically demonstrates the long-run heterogeneous effects of the late Qing dynasty open port and trade policy on urban green economic efficiency using the asymptotic spatial DID methodology based on data from 2011 to 2022. The study confirms that the policy of opening ports for trade and commerce at the end of the Qing Dynasty objectively increased the long-term green total factor productivity (GTFP) and green technical efficiency (EC) of the cities, but had no significant effect on green technological progress (TC). The above effects vary according to the timing of the city’s opening, political status and heterogeneity of the power of the Great Powers. Under the combined effects of financial stability, technological progress and policy mechanisms, openness policymaking should fully consider the potential roles of political systems, legal traditions and path dependence, and innovate policies with lower implementation costs, such as green technology transfer and foreign education. This study reveals the dynamic impact of the history of economic openness on the efficiency of the green economy from both the historical and spatial dimensions, providing important insights into the path of green economic development.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535553.abstract_zh: 以中国长三角地区为案例，本研究基于2011年至2022年的数据，采用渐近空间双重差分法，实证揭示了晚清开埠通商政策对城市绿色经济效率的长期异质性影响。研究确认，清末开埠通商政策客观上提升了城市的长期绿色全要素生产率（GTFP）及绿色技术效率（EC），但对绿色技术进步（TC）未产生显著影响。上述效应因城市开埠时间、政治地位及列强势力的异质性而有所不同。在金融稳定、技术进步与政策机制的综合作用下，开放政策的制定应充分考虑政治体制、法律传统及路径依赖的潜在作用，并创新实施成本较低的政策，如绿色技术转移与海外教育。本研究从历史与空间维度揭示了经济开放历史对绿色经济效率的动态影响，为绿色经济发展路径提供了重要启示。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536239.abstract: This study examines the impact of China’s Information Consumption Pilot (ICP) policy on enterprises’ digital transformation (DT) using firm-level panel data of Chinese listed companies from 2009 to 2023. Employing a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) approach, we find that the ICP significantly promotes firms’ DT, particularly in foundational digital technology adoption. The effect is more pronounced in high-consumption regions, among non-politically connected enterprises, larger firms and those operating in high-tech industries. The mechanism analysis reveals that, on the demand side, the ICP increases media digital attention, which indirectly accelerates DT by shaping consumer expectations and digital awareness. On the supply side, the ICP enhances digital infrastructure, provides digital subsidies, and promotes the aggregation of digital talent, jointly strengthening firms’ capacity for DT. Furthermore, we find that the ICP significantly enhances firms’ total factor productivity (TFP), indicating broader economic benefits beyond DT. Our findings offer new insights into digital policy design and enterprise transformation strategies in emerging economies.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536239.abstract_zh: 本研究利用2009至2023年中国上市公司企业层面的面板数据，考察了信息消费试点政策对企业数字化转型的影响。采用多期双重差分法，我们发现信息消费试点显著促进了企业的数字化转型，尤其是在基础数字技术采纳方面。这一效应在消费水平较高的地区、非政治关联企业、规模较大的企业以及高科技行业的企业中更为显著。机制分析揭示，在需求侧，信息消费试点增加了媒体数字关注度，通过塑造消费者预期和数字意识间接加速了数字化转型；在供给侧，信息消费试点强化了数字基础设施，提供了数字补贴，并促进了数字人才的集聚，共同增强了企业数字化转型的能力。此外，我们还发现信息消费试点显著提升了企业的全要素生产率，表明其带来的经济效益超越了数字化转型本身。我们的研究为新兴经济体的数字政策设计与企业转型策略提供了新的洞见。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536239.title: Information consumption and enterprise digital transformation: evidence from China’s pilot policy
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536239.title_zh: 信息消费与企业数字化转型：来自中国试点政策的证据

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536733.abstract: This study explores the relationship between negative online word-of-mouth (NeWOM) on social media and corporate cash holdings. Utilizing data from Fortune 500 firms spanning the years 2010 to 2017, our analysis reveals a positive association between negative online word-of-mouth and the cash-holding policies of these firms. By analysing the moderating factors, we find that high litigation risk and greater diversification weaken the positive relation between NeWOM and cash holding. Conversely, a higher level of insider shareholding enhances the relation between NeWOM and cash holding. Our findings remain robust across econometric specifications, controlling for endogeneity and alternative measures of proxies. Overall, this study contributes by introducing a previously unexplored determinant of cash holdings and providing valuable insights into the ongoing global discourse on the opportunities and implications of social media for corporations.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536733.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了社交媒体上的负面在线口碑（NeWOM）与企业现金持有之间的关系。利用2010年至2017年间《财富》500强企业的数据，我们的分析揭示了负面在线口碑与这些企业现金持有政策之间存在正相关关系。通过分析调节因素，我们发现高诉讼风险和更大的多元化程度会削弱NeWOM与现金持有之间的正相关关系。相反，内部人持股比例较高则会增强NeWOM与现金持有之间的关系。我们的研究结果在各种计量经济学设定下均保持稳健，包括控制内生性和替代代理变量的情况。总体而言，本研究通过引入一个先前未被探索的现金持有决定因素，并为当前关于社交媒体为企业带来的机遇与影响的全球讨论提供了有价值的见解。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536734.abstract: Value-based insurance design (VBID) can shape health systems to be centred on value by promoting high-value and disincentivizing low-value care use. However, in choice-based insurance systems, concerns arise that individuals might oppose the implementation of VBID. This paper aims to elicit consumers’ preferences for VBID in Switzerland. We fielded a discrete choice experiment and applied mixed logit modelling to estimate individuals’ willingness-to-pay (WTP) for selected VBID elements. The results suggest a status quo bias in health insurance decision-making and resistance to higher cost-sharing or restrictions on low-value care. Posterior WTP distributions reveal substantial preference heterogeneity, which we characterize along the countries’ three language regions and individuals’ background characteristics. Based on the results, tailored communication strategies could be developed to help shape future health policy and support the integration of VBID in basic insurance.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536734.abstract_zh: 基于价值的保险设计（VBID）能够通过促进高价值医疗服务的使用并抑制低价值医疗服务的利用，将医疗体系塑造为以价值为中心。然而，在选择型保险体系中，存在一种担忧，即个体可能会反对VBID的实施。本文旨在探究瑞士消费者对VBID的偏好。我们开展了一项离散选择实验，并运用混合Logit模型来估算个体对特定VBID要素的支付意愿（WTP）。结果表明，在健康保险决策中存在现状偏差，且个体对提高费用分摊或限制低价值医疗服务持有抵触情绪。后验WTP分布揭示了显著的偏好异质性，我们根据该国三个语言区域及个体背景特征对其进行了刻画。基于这些结果，可以制定针对性的沟通策略，以帮助塑造未来的卫生政策，并支持将VBID整合入基本保险之中。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536734.title: Less is more: consumers’ preferences for value-based insurance design – evidence from a discrete choice experiment
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536734.title_zh: 少即是多：消费者对基于价值的保险设计的偏好——来自离散选择实验的证据

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536735.abstract: This study investigates how digital transformation affects financial reporting clarity in the Chinese capital market, focusing explicitly on economic and social implications. Utilizing data from A-share listed companies in China and employing a fixed effects panel regression analysis, the study demonstrates a significant positive relationship between digital transformation and annual report readability. This positive correlation is particularly pronounced in high-tech and non-state-owned enterprises. State-owned enterprises also experience readability improvements, though less markedly due to inherent resource advantages and limited competitive pressures. Nonetheless, the correlation is consistently present across various firm types, highlighting broad applicability. The findings reveal that digital transformation enhances financial reporting clarity by improving both the information environment and corporate performance, thus fostering greater corporate transparency. Economically, this clarity facilitates more informed investor decisions and efficient capital allocation, while socially, it promotes stakeholder trust and reduces information asymmetry. This study underscores the critical role of digital transformation in economic development and social transparency, offering valuable insights into leveraging technology for enhanced corporate communication.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536735.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了数字化转型如何影响中国资本市场中的财务报告清晰度，特别关注其经济与社会影响。利用中国A股上市公司的数据，并采用固定效应面板回归分析，研究表明数字化转型与年度报告可读性之间存在显著的正相关关系。这一正相关性在科技密集型及非国有企业中尤为突出。国有企业虽也能体验到可读性的提升，但由于其固有的资源优势及有限的竞争压力，改善程度相对较小。尽管如此，这一相关性在不同类型的企业中均保持一致，凸显了其广泛的适用性。研究发现，数字化转型通过优化信息环境和企业绩效，增强了财务报告的清晰度，进而促进了企业透明度的提升。从经济角度看，这种清晰度有助于投资者做出更明智的决策和资本的有效配置；从社会角度看，它增进了利益相关者的信任并减少了信息不对称。本研究强调了数字化转型在经济发展和社会透明度中的关键作用，为利用技术加强企业沟通提供了宝贵的见解。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536736.abstract: We examined the efficiency of the health system in improving maternal health outcomes, i.e. increasing institutional delivery (desirable output) and reducing the maternal mortality ratio (undesirable output). We used a nonradial, nonoriented Slack-based measure data envelopment analysis model to assess the efficiency of the health system across 19 states of India between 2016 and 2020. The overall average efficiency score suggested potential for a 30% improvement in the health system efficiency in India, with only six states emerging as efficient. Interestingly, few states that were endowed with more than adequate health resources were inefficient. We find that resource constraint states such as Bihar and Jharkhand have emerged as efficient. To substantiate the use of undesirable adjusted model instead of the transformed model, we used the Wilcoxon ranked-signed test to estimate the statistical significance. We conclude that incorporating undesirable outputs while measuring efficiency is imperative. Our findings suggest that states that are inefficient with excess capacity should prioritize the efficient utilization of resources. Additionally, adequate resources should be allocated to resource constraints and efficient states such that they achieve better health outcomes. Furthermore, the diversification of health resources across levels of care could be a suggestive measure for some states.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536736.abstract_zh: 我们评估了卫生系统在改善孕产妇健康结果方面的效率，即提高机构分娩率（期望产出）并降低孕产妇死亡率（非期望产出）。我们采用非径向、非导向的松弛变量测度数据包络分析模型，对2016年至2020年间印度19个邦的卫生系统效率进行了评估。总体平均效率得分表明，印度卫生系统效率存在30%的提升空间，仅有六个邦表现出高效。有趣的是，少数拥有充足以上卫生资源的邦却效率低下。我们发现，如比哈尔邦和贾坎德邦等资源受限的邦反而表现出高效。为验证采用非期望调整模型而非转换模型的合理性，我们运用了威尔科克森符号秩检验来评估统计显著性。我们得出结论，在衡量效率时纳入非期望产出至关重要。我们的研究结果表明，产能过剩且效率低下的邦应优先考虑资源的有效利用。此外，应向资源受限且高效的邦分配充足资源，以便其实现更好的健康结果。同时，对于某些邦而言，卫生资源在不同护理层级间的多元化配置可能是一项建议性措施。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536737.abstract: The enhancement of urban economic resilience is essential for achieving sustainable development. However, existing research has paid limited attention to the role of science and technology (sci-tech) finance, and its causal impact, underlying mechanisms, and spatial spillover effects remain underexplored. Drawing on panel data from 282 Chinese cities between 2004 and 2021, this paper takes the implementation of the sci-tech finance pilot policy as a quasi-natural experiment to evaluate its impact on urban economic resilience. The empirical results show that the policy significantly enhances economic resilience, and the findings remain robust across a series of robustness checks. Mechanism analysis reveals that the policy promotes economic resilience primarily through four channels: improving financial development efficiency, facilitating industrial upgrading, and strengthening innovation capacity and entrepreneurial activity. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the policy has a more pronounced effect in eastern and central regions, non-resource-based cities, and cities with higher levels of human capital. Moreover, the spatial spillover analysis demonstrates that the policy not only benefits pilot cities but also contributes to resilience improvements in neighbouring cities. This study provides empirical evidence and policy insights for China and other countries seeking to enhance urban economic resilience through sci-tech finance.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536737.abstract_zh: 城市经济韧性的增强是实现可持续发展的关键。然而，现有研究对科技金融的作用关注不足，其因果效应、内在机制及空间溢出效应尚未得到充分探讨。基于2004年至2021年间中国282个城市的面板数据，本文以科技金融试点政策的实施作为准自然实验，评估其对城市经济韧性的影响。实证结果显示，该政策显著增强了经济韧性，且这一结论在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析表明，该政策主要通过四条途径促进经济韧性：提升金融发展效率、推动产业升级、增强创新能力及激发创业活力。异质性分析显示，政策效应在东部和中部地区、非资源型城市以及人力资本水平较高的城市中更为显著。此外，空间溢出分析表明，该政策不仅惠及试点城市，还促进了邻近城市韧性的提升。本研究为中国及其他国家通过科技金融增强城市经济韧性提供了实证依据和政策启示。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536738.abstract: Using the horizontal ecological compensation policy (HECP) as a quasi-natural experiment and data from Chinese A-share listed companies from 2008–2019, we examine the impact of HECP on the labour share of income within enterprises. Compared with the control group, HECP increases the labour share of income in the treated group by 1.03% points. Notably, this policy does not result in a pass-through effect between employee wages and benefits. Mechanism analysis indicates that HECP not only suppresses capital deepening within enterprises but also increases the input of labour factors and improves the structure of human capital, thus fostering an innovation substitution effect and ultimately increasing the labour share of income within enterprises. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that HECP is particularly effective for low-tax-burden enterprises, enterprises in regions with abundant labour resources, and enterprises facing less fiscal pressure. Furthermore, a series of robustness tests confirm the validity of our findings. This study offers a new explanation for understanding the dynamics of China’s labour share of income and provides policy insights for improving horizontal ecological compensation to optimize the labour capital distribution.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536738.abstract_zh: 以横向生态补偿政策（HECP）作为准自然实验，利用2008-2019年中国A股上市公司数据，我们考察了HECP对企业劳动收入份额的影响。与对照组相比，HECP使处理组的劳动收入份额提高了1.03个百分点。值得注意的是，该政策并未在员工工资与福利之间产生传导效应。机制分析表明，HECP不仅抑制了企业内部的资本深化，还增加了劳动要素投入并改善了人力资本结构，从而促进了创新替代效应，最终提高了企业内部的劳动收入份额。异质性分析显示，HECP对低税负企业、劳动力资源丰富地区的企业以及财政压力较小的企业尤为有效。此外，一系列稳健性检验证实了我们研究结果的有效性。本研究为理解中国劳动收入份额的动态变化提供了新的解释，并为完善横向生态补偿以优化劳动资本分配提供了政策启示。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536738.title: Horizontal ecological compensation and Labour share of income within enterprises: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536738.title_zh: 横向生态补偿与企业劳动收入份额：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536739.abstract: Amid rising interest in how industry-university-research (IUR) collaboration drives regional development, this study investigates the spatial economic effects of IUR collaboration across 30 Chinese provinces from 2009 to 2019. A coupling coordination index is developed to quantify IUR performance and integrated into a Spatial Durbin Model under three spatial structures: geographic contiguity, physical distance, and economic similarity. Results show that economic similarity generates stronger spatial interdependence than geographic proximity. Nationally, IUR collaboration does not uniformly promote growth and instead produces negative spillovers across neighbouring and structurally similar regions. Subregional analysis reveals clear heterogeneity: eastern provinces benefit from positive spillovers, while central and western provinces exhibit localized impacts, reflecting absorptive constraints and structural gaps. These findings propose a scalable spatial framework for assessing IUR collaboration and offer policy insights for developing countries with uneven innovation capacities.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536739.abstract_zh: 随着产学研合作对区域发展驱动作用日益受到关注，本研究考察了2009年至2019年间中国30个省份产学研合作的空间经济效应。构建耦合协调指数以量化产学研绩效，并将其纳入三种空间结构下的空间杜宾模型：地理邻接、物理距离和经济相似性。结果表明，经济相似性产生的空间相互依赖性强于地理邻近性。在全国层面，产学研合作并未一致促进增长，反而对邻近及结构相似地区产生负向溢出效应。分区域分析揭示了明显的异质性：东部省份受益于正向溢出，而中部和西部省份则表现出局部影响，反映了吸收能力约束和结构性差距。这些发现提出了一个可扩展的产学研合作空间评估框架，并为创新能力不均衡的发展中国家提供了政策启示。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536740.abstract: The paper examines how economic policy uncertainty (EPU) would impact the clique behaviour of institutional investors. By probing the link between EPU and the shareholdings of institutional investors, we find that EPU prompts institutional investors to clique, especially in enterprises with sound social performance, experienced executives, high analyst coverage, state property, and large scale. EPU may facilitate institutional investor cliques through channels of exacerbating agency problems, enterprise cash flows, enterprise risk and enterprise-investor information asymmetry. Namely, EPU motivates institutional investors to clique to tackle EPU-induced challenges. Evidence further demonstrates that institutional investor cliques aggravate the negative impact of EPU on macroeconomy but mitigate that on business performance. The findings suggest that EPU fuels institutional investor cliques and both impede macroeconomy.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536740.abstract_zh: 本文考察了经济政策不确定性（EPU）如何影响机构投资者的“抱团”行为。通过探究EPU与机构投资者持股之间的联系，我们发现EPU促使机构投资者形成抱团，尤其是在社会绩效良好、高管经验丰富、分析师覆盖度高、国有性质及规模较大的企业中尤为显著。EPU可能通过加剧代理问题、企业现金流问题、企业风险以及企业与投资者之间的信息不对称等渠道，促进机构投资者的抱团行为。换言之，EPU激励机构投资者抱团以应对由EPU引发的挑战。进一步证据表明，机构投资者抱团加剧了EPU对宏观经济的负面影响，但缓解了其对经营业绩的不利影响。研究结果表明，EPU助长了机构投资者的抱团现象，且两者均对宏观经济构成阻碍。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536741.abstract: Urban green development is not just a modern urban planning necessity, it’s also a vital strategy for achieving sustainable growth, enhancing city competitiveness, and improving residents’ quality of life. In 2012, China introduced the ambient air quality standards policy to propel the nation’s green development. Using a sample of 268 prefecture-level cities in China from 2006 to 2020, this paper investigates the impact of centralized vertical regulation on urban green development using DID model. The results demonstrate that centralized vertical regulation greatly enhances urban green development. The mechanism tests suggest that centralized vertical regulation encourages green development by increasing government investments in environmental protection, optimizing financial and technological capabilities, and raising public awareness of environmental issues. Next, the research highlights that centralized vertical regulation more significantly influences urban green development in central and western cities, those with limited innovation capacity cities, and cities less dependent on protection of property rights. Finally, the economic analysis concludes that centralized vertical regulation not only benefits green environmental outcomes but also drives high-quality economic growth in China.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536741.abstract_zh: 城市绿色发展不仅是现代城市规划的必然要求，也是实现可持续增长、提升城市竞争力及改善居民生活质量的关键策略。2012年，中国实施了环境空气质量标准政策，旨在推动国家绿色发展。本文利用2006年至2020年间中国268个地级市的数据，采用双重差分模型探讨了中央垂直监管对城市绿色发展的影响。研究结果显示，中央垂直监管显著促进了城市绿色发展。机制检验表明，中央垂直监管通过增加政府环保投入、优化财政与科技能力以及提升公众环保意识来推动绿色发展。进一步研究发现，中央垂直监管对中部和西部城市、创新能力有限的城市以及产权保护依赖度较低的城市，其绿色发展影响更为显著。最后，经济分析指出，中央垂直监管不仅有利于绿色环境成果，还促进了中国高质量的经济增长。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536743.abstract: The study investigates the effects of higher education (HE) expansion policy initiated in China in 1999 on individuals’ engagement with risky financial assets. Utilizing a regression discontinuity (RD) design, the analysis reveals a consistent and statistically significant positive relationship between the HE expansion and the likelihood of investing in risky financial assets. The results indicate that the HE expansion policy increases the propensity to invest in such assets by 2.6% points, representing a 37.1% increase relative to the control group’s mean. The study also conducts robustness tests, including bandwidth sensitivity and placebo tests, to reinforce the reliability of these findings. Mechanism analysis identifies increased income, enhanced cognitive ability, and improved access to financial information as key pathways through which higher education fosters greater participation in risky asset markets. This research contributes to the literature by providing new insights into how educational policies can influence financial behaviours in emerging economies.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536743.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了1999年中国实施的高等教育扩招政策对个体参与风险性金融资产投资的影响。利用断点回归设计，分析揭示出高等教育扩招与投资风险性金融资产可能性之间存在一致且统计显著的正向关系。结果显示，高等教育扩招政策使投资此类资产的倾向增加了2.6个百分点，相对于对照组均值而言，增幅达37.1%。研究还进行了包括带宽敏感性和安慰剂检验在内的稳健性测试，以增强这些发现的可靠性。机制分析识别出收入增加、认知能力提升及金融信息获取渠道改善，是高等教育促进风险资产市场参与的关键路径。本研究通过提供关于教育政策如何影响新兴经济体金融行为的新见解，为现有文献做出了贡献。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536744.abstract: Employing panel data from Chinese-listed enterprises from 2002 to 2022 within a quasi-natural experiment framework of digital social credit platforms, this study examines big data’s impact on corporate financing through public credit information. Findings indicate that these platforms alleviate financing constraints, expand funding scale and enhance efficiency. Mechanisms include the mitigation of adverse selection, reduction of default risk and optimization of resource allocation through credit structure and cost adjustments. Public credit information is shown to improve financial environments, thereby strengthening financing capacity. Heterogeneity analyses reveal differential impacts: benefits are amplified for firms with established credit records; manufacturing entities and those in low-competition markets experience constraint alleviation; significant scale and efficiency gains are observed in eastern regions, demonstrating pronounced geographical variation. This research elucidates digital platforms’ role in modern finance and supports deeper digital-real economy integration.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536744.abstract_zh: 本研究利用2002至2022年中国上市企业面板数据，在数字社会信用平台的准自然实验框架下，探讨大数据通过公共信用信息对企业融资的影响。研究发现，这些平台缓解了融资约束，扩大了融资规模并提升了效率。其机制包括缓解逆向选择、降低违约风险以及通过信用结构和成本调整优化资源配置。公共信用信息被证明能改善金融环境，从而增强融资能力。异质性分析揭示了差异化影响：对于信用记录完善的企业，益处更为显著；制造业实体及低竞争市场中的企业经历了约束缓解；东部地区在规模与效率上取得显著提升，显示出明显的地域差异。本研究阐明了数字平台在现代金融中的作用，并支持数字经济与实体经济更深层次的融合。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536747.abstract: This study empirically examines the use of capital flows as a tool of economic statecraft by the Gulf Arab states in Egypt, with a particular focus on Qatar’s investments from 2005 to 2023, encompassing phases of support, the suspension of diplomatic relations, and renewed diplomacy. While empirical research on the Gulf states’ use of economic statecraft is growing, significant gaps remain. This study tests the hypothesis that Qatar/Gulf investments have been used as instruments of economic statecraft. It provides a seminal exploration of the impact of political frictions between Egypt and Qatar on FDI inflows from Qatar to Egypt. Using panel data on FDI flows to Egypt, the study employs a gravity model covering the period from 2005 to 2023. The analysis evaluates the effects of several political shocks, such as the Qatar blockade and the Al Ula Agreement, on capital flows. The findings reveal that Qatar’s investment flows into Egypt, as well as those from other Gulf countries, hinge on the state of bilateral relations and the presence of like-minded administrations. This confirms that capital flows are part of the Gulf’s economic statecraft.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536747.abstract_zh: 本研究实证考察了海湾阿拉伯国家在埃及将资本流动用作经济治国工具的情况，特别关注卡塔尔2005年至2023年间的投资，涵盖支持阶段、外交关系中断及外交重启阶段。尽管关于海湾国家运用经济治国手段的实证研究日益增多，但仍存在显著空白。本研究检验了卡塔尔/海湾投资被用作经济治国工具的假设，首次深入探讨了埃及与卡塔尔之间的政治摩擦对卡塔尔对埃及外国直接投资流入的影响。利用埃及外国直接投资流入的面板数据，本研究采用覆盖2005年至2023年期间的引力模型进行分析。分析评估了若干政治冲击（如卡塔尔封锁和《欧拉协议》）对资本流动的影响。研究结果显示，卡塔尔对埃及的投资流入以及其他海湾国家的投资流入，取决于双边关系的状态及是否存在志同道合的政府。这证实了资本流动是海湾国家经济治国手段的一部分。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536748.abstract: This article explores the intricate relationship between climate change, credit risk and liquidity risk in Indian commercial banks from 2000 to 2020. Utilizing an unbalanced panel dataset of 63 banks, the study reveals significant findings regarding the impact of climate change on liquidity and credit risks. It highlights that liquidity risk escalates due to climate change, particularly when temperature and precipitation anomalies occur simultaneously, leading to a reduction in banks’ high-quality liquid assets. Furthermore, climate change exacerbates credit risk by increasing non-performing loans, with nationalized banks being more vulnerable than private banks. The interaction between credit risk and climate change further intensifies liquidity risk, especially during erratic monsoon seasons when both temperature and precipitation anomalies are present. Given India’s position as a major economic player with a bank-centric financial system, the findings underscore the necessity for financial regulators to incorporate climate change considerations into macroprudential regulatory frameworks to safeguard the banking sector. This research contributes to understanding the multifaceted challenges posed by climate change on financial institutions in emerging economies.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536748.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了2000年至2020年间印度商业银行中气候变化、信用风险与流动性风险之间错综复杂的关系。利用包含63家银行的不平衡面板数据集，研究揭示了气候变化对流动性和信用风险影响的显著发现。研究表明，气候变化导致流动性风险上升，尤其是在温度和降水异常同时发生时，这会减少银行的高质量流动资产。此外，气候变化通过增加不良贷款加剧了信用风险，其中国有银行比私人银行更为脆弱。信用风险与气候变化之间的相互作用进一步加剧了流动性风险，特别是在季风季节异常，温度和降水异常并存的情况下。鉴于印度作为主要经济体的地位及其以银行为中心的金融体系，这些发现强调了金融监管机构有必要将气候变化因素纳入宏观审慎监管框架，以保障银行业的安全。本研究有助于理解气候变化对新兴经济体金融机构构成的多方面挑战。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536749.abstract: This note discusses the empirical findings of Bahmani-Oskooee and Wang (2008), thereafter BOW. In their analysis, BOW suggest that the J-curve phenomenon holds in 22 US industries with China as a trading partner. However, it turns out that there is a misinterpretation of their findings. We show that the J-curve hypothesis is extremely questionable in at least 10 cases out of those 22 industries, claimed by BOW that the J-curve holds.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536749.abstract_zh: 本注释讨论了Bahmani-Oskooee和Wang（2008）的实证发现，以下简称BOW。在他们的分析中，BOW提出，在22个美国行业中，以中国为贸易伙伴时，J曲线现象成立。然而，事实证明，他们的发现存在误解。我们表明，在BOW声称J曲线成立的这22个行业中，至少有10个案例中，J曲线假说极为可疑。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536750.abstract: This study aims to model inflation dynamics by presenting the evidence supporting instability of the Phillips curve for the period covering the explicit inflation targeting (IT) adoption in Turkey as a small open economy. To this end, Bai and Perron approach is applied to capture possible breaks or instability associated with the structural changes in the hybrid New Keynesian Phillips curve (NKPC) estimation, using quarterly data from 2006:q1 to 2023:q4. The empirical findings reveal that the hybrid model of the NKPC with the control variables gives unstable parameter estimations with significant structural breaks which can be related to some structural changes the Turkish economy experienced for post IT periods. The results also put forward that the inflation-output gap relationship produces larger amount of parameter in high inflation period implying that the Phillips curve steepens with changing price setting behaviour and the effects of reel exchange rate and oil prices on domestic inflation rate. Based on these findings, the weaker anchored expectations may increase the output cost because of the changing trade-off between inflation and output gap. The Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey (CBRT) should take its unstable structure into account in the inflation targeting process.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536750.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过呈现支持土耳其这一小型开放经济体在明确采纳通胀目标制（IT）期间菲利普斯曲线不稳定性的证据，来对通胀动态进行建模。为此，采用Bai和Perron方法，以捕捉混合新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线（NKPC）估计中与结构性变化相关的可能断点或不稳定性，使用2006年第一季度至2023年第四季度的季度数据。实证结果表明，包含控制变量的NKPC混合模型给出了不稳定的参数估计，并伴有显著的结构性断点，这些断点可能与土耳其在后通胀目标制时期经历的一些结构性变化有关。结果还指出，在高通胀时期，通胀-产出缺口关系产生的参数值更大，这意味着菲利普斯曲线随着价格设定行为的变化而变得更加陡峭，同时实际汇率和石油价格对国内通胀率也有影响。基于这些发现，较弱的锚定预期可能因通胀与产出缺口之间权衡关系的改变而增加产出成本。土耳其共和国中央银行（CBRT）在通胀目标制过程中应考虑其不稳定的结构。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536751.abstract: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) aims to measure inflation. The CPI, published monthly by the US and measured by the price index of ‘All items’, is the sum of the products of component price indices and their relative weights. We analysed the CPI and its component price indices between 2012 and 2023. Based on the correlations between the CPI and its 358 component price indices, the CPI well represented the trends of most component price indices throughout the period. The time series regression coefficients of component indices did not necessarily match the relative weights. If measuring volatility with rolling standard deviations of raw values with 19 or more months time windows, the CPI was less volatile than the core CPI. The CPI is a good measure of relative price changes in most of the goods or services. However, some goods and services have prices fluctuating in patterns very different from that of the CPI. Policy implications include initiatives that focus on the management of macroeconomic risks, early policy responses using the leading indicators of inflation, policies to manage inflation propagation over time or across price indices, and strategies to refine inflation-linked payments.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536751.abstract_zh: 消费者价格指数（CPI）旨在衡量通货膨胀。美国每月发布的CPI以“所有项目”价格指数衡量，是各成分价格指数与其相对权重乘积的总和。我们分析了2012年至2023年间的CPI及其成分价格指数。基于CPI与其358个成分价格指数之间的相关性，CPI在整个时期内较好地代表了大多数成分价格指数的趋势。成分指数的时间序列回归系数未必与其相对权重匹配。若采用19个月及以上时间窗口的原始值滚动标准差衡量波动性，CPI的波动性低于核心CPI。CPI是衡量大多数商品或服务相对价格变化的良好指标。然而，部分商品和服务的价格波动模式与CPI存在显著差异。政策启示包括：聚焦宏观经济风险管理的举措、利用通胀领先指标进行早期政策响应、管理通胀随时间或跨价格指数传导的政策，以及优化通胀挂钩支付策略。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536753.abstract: This study provides descriptive evidence on how the COVID-19 pandemic influenced secondary school students’ application patterns to higher education in France, offering insights into the reallocation of preferences across academic fields and degree types. Using detailed administrative data, we document significant shifts in application shares during 2021, with increased interest in competitive tracks and concurrent declines in applications to bachelor’s and vocational programs. These findings suggest that students responded to the pandemic by favouring structured and selective pathways with clear labour market prospects, moving away from generalist degrees. Students’ share of applications to STEM degrees increased, while applications to health and business programs remained stable. We then analyse the probability of applying to at least one program in a given field or degree and find a decline in application diversification: students narrowed their choices to fewer fields, reflecting a more risk-averse and selective approach in response to the pandemic. Our analysis highlights substantial heterogeneity in these effects across demographic groups.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536753.abstract_zh: 本研究提供了关于COVID-19疫情如何影响法国中学生高等教育申请模式的描述性证据，揭示了学术领域与学位类型间偏好重新配置的见解。利用详细的行政数据，我们记录了2021年申请份额的显著变化，表现为对竞争性轨道的兴趣增加，同时学士学位及职业项目的申请量下降。这些发现表明，学生应对疫情时倾向于选择结构明确、选拔性强且具有清晰就业前景的路径，而远离通用型学位。学生申请STEM领域的份额有所上升，而健康与商业项目的申请则保持稳定。随后，我们分析了申请至少一个特定领域或学位项目的概率，并发现申请多样化程度下降：学生将选择范围缩小至更少的领域，反映出疫情下更为风险规避和审慎的应对策略。我们的分析强调了这些效应在不同人口群体间存在显著异质性。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536872.abstract: This study aims to investigate the complex relationship between market concentration and financial stability in the microfinance sector, with a particular emphasis on the influence of diverse funding models. Via the use of advanced one-step GMM panel estimation and GMM panel quantile regression, this study effectively addresses endogeneity concerns, thereby examining data from 3,114 MFIs across 123 developing nations from 1999 to 2019. The application of quantile regression provides a nuanced understanding of how the relationship between market concentration and financial stability varies across different levels of insolvency risk, revealing heterogeneous effects often neglected in traditional analyses. Our findings substantiate the concentration‒stability hypothesis, indicating that MFIs in more concentrated markets generally demonstrate enhanced stability. Additionally, the role of funding sources is critical, with savings exerting a greater positive effect on financial stability compared with borrowings. Furthermore, the type of deposits collected is key to understanding the market concentration‒financial stability nexus. MFIs attracting significant volumes of small deposits exhibit a robust positive correlation between market power and stability. Conversely, heightened competition for savings and borrowings may inadvertently amplify insolvency risk, challenging institutional resilience.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536872.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨小额信贷行业中市场集中度与金融稳定性之间的复杂关系，特别关注不同融资模式的影响。通过采用先进的一步系统GMM面板估计和GMM面板分位数回归方法，本研究有效解决了内生性问题，并据此分析了1999年至2019年间来自123个发展中国家的3，114家小额信贷机构的数据。分位数回归的应用提供了对市场集中度与金融稳定性之间关系在不同破产风险水平下如何变化的细致理解，揭示了传统分析中常被忽视的异质性效应。我们的研究结果支持了“集中度-稳定性”假说，表明在更为集中的市场中，小额信贷机构通常展现出更强的稳定性。此外，融资来源的作用至关重要，储蓄相较于借款对金融稳定性具有更大的积极影响。进一步而言，所吸收存款的类型是理解市场集中度与金融稳定性关联的关键。吸引大量小额存款的小额信贷机构在市场力量与稳定性之间表现出显著的正相关关系。相反，对储蓄和借款的激烈竞争可能无意中加剧破产风险，对机构的韧性构成挑战。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536873.abstract: This paper assesses the impact of debt-for-nature swaps on sustainable development in developing countries, using entropy balancing on a large sample of 127 countries from 1990 to 2020. The findings indicate that debt-for-nature swaps have a positive and statistically significant effect on sustainable development, operating through several key channels: public debt reduction, increased public investment, lower CO2 emissions, and improved human development. The additional results found in this paper show that if treated countries had not benefited from debt-for-nature swaps, their sustainable development index would have decreased by 11%. At the same time, if untreated countries had benefited from debt-for-nature swaps, their sustainable development index would have increased by around 2%. The analysis also reveals a non-linear relationship between the size of debt-for-nature swaps and the sustainable development index, with an optimal threshold estimated at 42% of the public debt level, beyond which diminishing returns are observed. These results suggest that debt-for-nature swaps can serve as an effective financing tool for sustainable development, provided that they are appropriately designed. From a policy perspective, expanding debt-for-nature swap programs requires broadening eligibility criteria, strengthening transparency and governance of environmental funds, and more systematically integrating climate objectives into multilateral debt relief mechanisms. Enhanced coordination between public and private creditors, as well as environmental organizations, is also crucial to ensure that debt-for-nature swaps support the ecological transition effectively in the most vulnerable countries.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536873.abstract_zh: 本文评估了债务换自然互换对发展中国家可持续发展的影响，采用熵平衡方法，基于1990年至2020年间127个国家的广泛样本进行分析。研究发现，债务换自然互换对可持续发展具有正向且统计显著的影响，其作用机制主要通过几个关键渠道实现：公共债务减少、公共投资增加、二氧化碳排放降低以及人类发展水平提升。本文的额外结果显示，若受处理国家未受益于债务换自然互换，其可持续发展指数将下降11%；同时，若未受处理国家受益于债务换自然互换，其可持续发展指数将上升约2%。分析还揭示了债务换自然互换规模与可持续发展指数之间的非线性关系，估计最优阈值为公共债务水平的42%，超过此阈值则观察到边际收益递减。这些结果表明，债务换自然互换可作为可持续发展的有效融资工具，前提是其设计得当。从政策角度看，扩大债务换自然互换项目需要拓宽资格标准、加强环境基金的透明度与治理，并更系统地将气候目标纳入多边债务减免机制。加强公共与私人债权人以及环境组织之间的协调，对于确保债务换自然互换在最脆弱国家有效支持生态转型也至关重要。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536875.abstract: The environmental court is an institutional innovation for a country to strengthen environmental governance, which is facing critical challenges posed by heavy polluters. Therefore, it is worthwhile to examine how environmental courts can address the problem by influencing polluting businesses’ behaviors. Given the important function of ESG (environmental, social, and corporate governance), this study explores the impact of the establishment of environmental courts on the ESG performance of heavily polluting businesses. Using tripartite game and difference-in-differences (DID) methods, this study analyzes the behavior of individual business listed in China’s heavily polluting industries from 2010 to 2022. Our findings indicate that the establishment of environmental courts significantly contributed to improved ESG performance of heavily polluting businesses, and that the level of environmental information disclosure and the intensity of environmental regulation are important mechanisms of this contribution. These findings offer valuable policy implications for government to promote regulatory framework.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536875.abstract_zh: 环保法庭是国家加强环境治理的一项制度创新，正面临着重污染企业所带来的严峻挑战。因此，探讨环保法庭如何通过影响污染企业的行为来解决这一问题具有重要意义。鉴于ESG（环境、社会和公司治理）的重要功能，本研究探讨了环保法庭的设立对重污染企业ESG表现的影响。采用三方博弈和双重差分法（DID），本研究分析了2010年至2022年间中国重污染行业上市企业的个体行为。研究发现，环保法庭的设立显著促进了重污染企业ESG表现的提升，且环境信息披露水平和环境规制强度是这一促进作用的重要机制。这些发现为政府完善监管框架提供了有价值的政策启示。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536876.abstract: This paper examines the systemic importance of shadow banks in the Indian financial system. Systemic risk measures of four sectors- banks, shadow banks, real estate, investment banks- are computed with a network model emphasizing the interconnectedness for the period July 2002 to October 2023. Spillovers among these sectors are explored through conditional and aggregate spillover indices estimated with time-varying vector autoregressions. Results reveal that systemic risk was high during crisis periods, such as the global financial crisis and the COVID. Also, the systemic risk measures exhibit significant variations among different sectors. Sector-specific measures capture the build-up of systemic risk in shadow banks before the 2017–18 non-bank financial crisis in India. Lower systemic risk found in banks suggests effective financial oversight in the Indian banking system. Further, the spillover analysis shows shadow banks are major emitters of systemic risk to other sectors. While banks emit the least systemic risk, they are net receivers. The findings highlight the importance of better regulatory measures for shadow banks. Monitoring systemic risk that captures network effects may help in the effective implementation of macroprudential policy.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536876.abstract_zh: 本文考察了印度金融体系中影子银行的系统性重要性。通过一个强调互联性的网络模型，计算了四个部门——银行、影子银行、房地产、投资银行——在2002年7月至2023年10月期间的系统性风险度量。利用时变向量自回归模型估计的条件和总体溢出指数，探讨了这些部门之间的溢出效应。结果显示，在全球金融危机和新冠疫情等危机时期，系统性风险较高。此外，系统性风险度量在不同部门间表现出显著差异。部门特定度量捕捉到了2017-18年印度非银行金融危机前影子银行系统性风险的累积。银行中发现的较低系统性风险表明印度银行体系具有有效的金融监管。进一步，溢出分析显示影子银行是向其他部门传导系统性风险的主要来源。而银行传导的系统性风险最少，且为净接收方。研究结果强调了加强对影子银行监管措施的重要性。监测能够捕捉网络效应的系统性风险，可能有助于宏观审慎政策的有效实施。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536877.abstract: This research explores the impact of severe physical climate risks on corporate investment decisions and outcomes, focusing on the role of cultural differences in shaping this relationship among emerging economies. Using a sample of 308,451 firm-year observations across 51 countries covering 2007 to 2019, we find that physical climate risks significantly reduce investment efficiency. Our analyses of cultural differences show that firms in hierarchical cultures adopt more conservative investment approaches, limiting adaptability to climate challenges, while firms in risk-averse cultures proactively integrate climate risks, leading to better investment efficiency. A difference-in-differences analysis further shows that the Paris Agreement led to modest short-term improvements in climate-related investment responses, though longer-term challenges remain. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating cultural context into policy and corporate governance strategies to enhance climate resilience. For robustness, we use System-GMM estimation, helping to account for potential endogeneity and dynamic firm-level factors.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536877.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了严重物理气候风险对企业投资决策及结果的影响，并聚焦于文化差异在塑造新兴经济体这一关系中的作用。基于2007年至2019年间覆盖51个国家的308,451个公司-年度观测样本，我们发现物理气候风险显著降低了投资效率。对文化差异的分析表明，在层级文化中的企业采取更为保守的投资策略，限制了对气候挑战的适应能力，而在风险规避文化中的企业则主动整合气候风险，从而实现更高的投资效率。一项双重差分分析进一步显示，《巴黎协定》在短期内带来了气候相关投资反应的适度改善，但长期挑战依然存在。这些发现强调了将文化背景纳入政策和公司治理策略以增强气候韧性的重要性。为稳健性考虑，我们采用系统GMM估计方法，以帮助应对潜在的内生性和动态企业层面因素。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536879.abstract: This study examines how mergers and research and development (R&D) investments affect earnings quality and corporate governance among Chinese exchange-listed manufacturing firms. We find that managers respond to the high costs and uncertainty associated with mergers and R&D by adopting more aggressive operating strategies, which in turn deteriorate earnings quality. However, competitive market environments mitigate this negative effect, particularly for firms with high R&D intensity. Notably, CEO duality – typically viewed as a governance weakness – can improve earnings quality for state-owned enterprises (SOEs) investing in R&D within competitive markets, where political incentives and risk aversion guide more prudent managerial behaviour. By decomposing the role of market competitiveness, our analysis highlights its moderating effect on managerial decision-making and governance outcomes. These findings offer important insights for policymakers aiming to foster innovation and managerial accountability in emerging markets.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536879.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了并购与研发投资如何影响中国交易所上市制造企业的盈余质量与公司治理。我们发现，管理者面对并购和研发相关的高成本与不确定性，会采取更为激进的经营策略，进而导致盈余质量下降。然而，竞争性市场环境能够缓解这一负面效应，尤其是对于研发强度较高的企业而言。值得注意的是，CEO二元性——通常被视为治理弱点——在竞争性市场中，对于进行研发投资的国有企业而言，能够提升盈余质量，因为政治激励和风险规避促使管理者采取更为审慎的行为。通过分解市场竞争力的作用，我们的分析强调了其对管理者决策和治理结果的调节效应。这些发现为旨在促进新兴市场创新和管理问责的政策制定者提供了重要启示。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536881.abstract: With the comprehensive integration of finance and technology, banks accelerate their fintech development through independent research or cooperation with fintech companies, which also impacted banks’ micro-risk-taking. This study constructs a database covering the cooperation data of 129 banks from 2012 to 2022 and empirically examines the influence of strategic cooperation between banks and fintech companies on banks’ active and passive risk-taking. The following conclusions emerge: (1) On the whole, cooperation with fintech companies will increase the risk-taking of banks. (2) In terms of active risk-taking of banks, cooperation will change the credit structure of banks and increase the share of loans to small and micro companies, thus increasing the willingness of banks to take risks. In terms of passive risk-taking, cooperation will increase the liquidity risk of banks, and thus improve the level of passive risk-taking of banks. (3) Further heterogeneity analysis shows that cooperation has a greater positive impact on the risk-taking of listed banks and has a positive impact on the passive risk-taking of banks with high capital adequacy ratios. This article expands the academic understanding of the economic consequences of bank fintech and also provides a new perspective for optimizing financial regulation.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536881.abstract_zh: 随着金融与科技的全面融合，银行通过自主研发或与金融科技公司合作加速其金融科技发展，这一进程亦对银行的微观风险承担产生了影响。本研究构建了一个涵盖2012年至2022年间129家银行合作数据的数据库，实证考察了银行与金融科技公司战略合作对银行主动及被动风险承担的影响。研究结论如下：（1）总体而言，与金融科技公司的合作会增加银行的风险承担。（2）在银行主动风险承担方面，合作将改变银行的信贷结构，增加对小微企业的贷款份额，从而提升银行的风险承担意愿。在被动风险承担方面，合作将增加银行的流动性风险，进而提高银行的被动风险承担水平。（3）进一步的异质性分析显示，合作对上市银行的风险承担具有更大的正向影响，并对高资本充足率银行的被动风险承担产生积极影响。本文拓展了学术界对银行金融科技经济后果的理解，也为优化金融监管提供了新的视角。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536882.abstract: With the rise of algorithmic commerce, data-driven product recommendations have become central to online retail. This study investigates whether such recommendations enhance product performance and consumer satisfaction, and how their effects vary by consumption timing (immediate vs. non-immediate) and product characteristics (price and type). Using real-time ‘Gold List’ rankings from JD.com, we analyse over 28,000 product records and consumer reviews. Satisfaction is quantified using a supervised Word2vec-SVM model, and effects are estimated using a double machine learning (DML) framework. Results show that recommendations significantly improve product performance, especially for non-immediate consumption and experience goods, but have limited or even negative effects on satisfaction. Topic modelling (LDA) of negative reviews reveals dissatisfaction drivers such as weak after-sales support and quality concerns. Robustness checks confirm the consistency of findings. This study contributes to understanding when and why algorithmic recommendations succeed or fail, offering insights for personalized retail strategies in AI-driven digital marketplaces.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536882.abstract_zh: 随着算法商务的兴起，数据驱动的产品推荐已成为在线零售的核心。本研究探讨了此类推荐是否能够提升产品绩效与消费者满意度，并考察其效果如何因消费时机（即时与非即时）及产品特征（价格与类型）而异。基于京东实时“金榜”排名数据，我们分析了超过28,000条产品记录及消费者评论。满意度通过有监督的Word2vec-SVM模型进行量化，效果则采用双重机器学习（DML）框架进行估计。结果表明，推荐显著提升了产品绩效，尤其对非即时消费和体验型商品效果更为明显，但对满意度的提升作用有限甚至产生负面影响。对负面评论的主题建模（LDA）揭示了不满驱动因素，如售后支持薄弱和质量问题。稳健性检验确认了研究结果的一致性。本研究有助于理解算法推荐在何种情境下及为何会成功或失败，为人工智能驱动的数字市场中的个性化零售策略提供了洞见。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2537458.abstract: This study explores the hierarchical and dynamic mechanisms of risk transmission among China’s systemically important banks. Given China’s hybrid financial system – characterized by state intervention, rapid market reforms and increasing global integration – systemic risk propagation remains underexplored and critically important. This article fills this research gap by employing a multilayer dynamic network model based on stock price return data from 19 systemically important banks from January 2020 to July 2024. The model integrates both linear and nonlinear interbank relationships through Pearson and Spearman correlations and captures directional causal relationships using Granger causality tests. The Planar Maximal Filter Graph (PMFG) method optimizes the network structure, effectively identifying critical transmission pathways and pivotal banks acting as risk propagators or receivers. Our empirical findings highlight distinct interdependencies and evolving risk propagation paths, revealing that certain banks consistently function as central nodes in systemic risk transmission, with their roles dynamically shifting in response to economic fluctuations. These results underline the importance of adopting multilayer dynamic approaches for accurate systemic risk assessment. Furthermore, the study provides practical implications for financial regulators by offering a framework to detect, monitor and mitigate systemic risks in real-time, thus enhancing financial system stability.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2537458.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了中国系统重要性银行间风险传递的层级性与动态机制。鉴于中国混合金融体系的特点——政府干预、快速市场改革及日益增强的全球一体化——系统性风险的传播机制尚未得到充分研究，且具有至关重要的意义。本文通过构建基于2020年1月至2024年7月19家系统重要性银行股价收益率数据的多层动态网络模型，填补了这一研究空白。该模型通过Pearson和Spearman相关系数整合了银行间线性与非线性关联，并利用Granger因果检验捕捉方向性因果关系。平面最大过滤图（PMFG）方法优化了网络结构，有效识别了关键传递路径及作为风险传播者或接收者的核心银行。实证研究结果揭示了显著的相互依赖性和不断演变的风险传播路径，表明某些银行在系统性风险传递中始终充当中心节点，其角色随经济波动而动态变化。这些结果强调了采用多层动态方法进行准确系统性风险评估的重要性。此外，本研究为金融监管机构提供了实用启示，构建了一个实时检测、监测和缓解系统性风险的框架，从而增强金融体系的稳定性。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2537460.abstract: This paper employs county-level panel data from 2012 to 2020 and a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) approach to examine the impact of China’s National New-Type Urbanization Plan (NNUP) on firm entry. The findings indicate that the NNUP significantly discourages firm entry through two main channels: first, by increasing enterprise costs due to enhanced worker welfare policies; and second, by intensifying fiscal pressure on local governments because of increased investments in public services. This negative effect exhibits regional heterogeneity depending on strategic orientations and administrative levels. However, the NNUP also fosters positive structural changes by promoting the growth of public service sectors such as education, healthcare, and transportation. The study further reveals that although the NNUP enhances social welfare and sustainability, achieving inclusive economic growth requires striking a balance between urbanization objectives and a business-friendly environment. Specifically, local governments should adopt fiscal diversification strategies and formulate adaptive policies tailored to regional characteristics to ensure sustainable development during the process of urbanization reform and resident welfare enhancement. This research contributes to a deeper understanding of the microeconomic impacts of urbanization, providing valuable insights into urban policy design in developing economies.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2537460.abstract_zh: 本文利用2012至2020年县级面板数据及交错双重差分法，考察了中国新型城镇化规划（NNUP）对企业进入的影响。研究发现，NNUP显著抑制了企业进入，主要通过两个渠道实现：一是通过增强劳动者福利政策提高企业成本；二是因公共服务投资增加加剧了地方政府的财政压力。这一负面效应根据战略导向和行政层级的不同呈现出区域异质性。然而，NNUP也通过促进教育、医疗和交通等公共服务部门的发展，推动了积极的结构性变化。研究进一步揭示，尽管NNUP提升了社会福利和可持续性，实现包容性经济增长仍需在城镇化目标与营商友好环境之间寻求平衡。具体而言，地方政府应采取财政多元化策略，并制定适应区域特点的针对性政策，以确保城镇化改革和居民福利提升过程中的可持续发展。本研究有助于深入理解城镇化的微观经济影响，为发展中经济体的城市政策设计提供了有价值的参考。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2538814.abstract: This study investigates the Chinese government’s subsidy allocations to domestic public companies, focusing on the economic versus political motives behind these decisions. Using two-way fixed effects regression models with firm-level annual subsidy data from 2008 to 2023, we find distinct subsidy allocation patterns based on Tobin’s Q values. Firms with Q values above 1 receive subsidies driven by economic motives, with the government favouring those with higher market value efficiency. In contrast, firms with Q values below 1 are more likely to receive subsidies motivated by political considerations, particularly supporting weaker performers. Robustness checks confirm our findings, including two-stage least squares, difference-in-differences regressions with policy shocks, and cross-sectional analyses. Additionally, subsidies allocated to firms with higher Tobin’s Q values enhance their investment efficiency, particularly benefiting non-state-owned enterprises and those operating in market-oriented regions. A regression discontinuity design reveals that subsidies to underperforming state-owned enterprises are politically motivated. This study reconciles inconsistencies in prior research regarding the relationship between investment efficiency and subsidy allocation, providing new insights into government subsidy strategies.
