10.1080/00036846.2025.2538814.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国政府对国内上市公司的补贴分配，聚焦于这些决策背后的经济动机与政治动机。利用2008年至2023年企业层面的年度补贴数据，采用双向固定效应回归模型，我们发现基于托宾Q值的不同补贴分配模式。托宾Q值高于1的企业所获补贴受经济动机驱动，政府倾向于支持市场价值效率较高的企业。相反，托宾Q值低于1的企业更可能因政治考量而获得补贴，尤其是对表现较弱者的支持。稳健性检验证实了我们的发现，包括两阶段最小二乘法、基于政策冲击的双重差分回归以及横截面分析。此外，分配给托宾Q值较高企业的补贴提升了其投资效率，尤其惠及非国有企业及位于市场化程度较高地区的企业。断点回归设计揭示，对表现不佳的国有企业的补贴具有政治动机。本研究调和了以往关于投资效率与补贴分配关系研究中的不一致之处，为政府补贴策略提供了新的见解。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2538817.abstract: In this study, we investigate the optimal investment-consumption-insurance decisions faced by a wage earner operating within an inflationary environment, utilizing a continuous finite time framework. We posit that the wage earner’s preference is described by the Cobb-Douglas utility function, which incorporates a parameter that reflects the elasticity of substitution between consumption and leisure. Additionally, we assume that the financial market comprises three distinct financial assets: a risk-free bond, an index bond and a stock. To obtain closed-form solutions for optimal strategies and value function, we utilize the martingale method in conjunction with duality theory. Finally, the impact of several model parameters on optimal strategies is explored through numerical simulation utilizing predefined parameters.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2538817.abstract_zh: 本研究在连续有限时间框架下，探讨通胀环境中工薪阶层面临的最优投资-消费-保险决策问题。假设工薪阶层的偏好由柯布-道格拉斯效用函数描述，该函数包含反映消费与闲暇替代弹性的参数。同时，假定金融市场包含三种不同金融资产：无风险债券、指数债券和股票。为获得最优策略与价值函数的闭式解，我们采用鞅方法与对偶理论相结合的分析框架。最后，通过预设参数的数值模拟，探讨了若干模型参数对最优策略的影响。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2538819.abstract: This study tackles the challenge of constructing long-term, consistent input-output tables (IOTs) for nations experiencing significant geopolitical shifts. This study proposes a methodological framework that integrates the Bidimensional Location Quotient (2DLQ) for estimating intra-regional flows and a Double-Constrained Gravity Model (DCGM) for inter-regional trade. We apply this 2DLQ-DCGM framework to the regional disaggregation of the Soviet Union’s IOTs in 1987. Using the actual IOTs of the Soviet republics in 1987 as a benchmark, this study first compares and analyzes the performance implications of different parameterization approaches in the 2DLQ, thereby validating the importance of incorporating regional structural data and the feasibility of the cross-entropy method in data-scarce scenarios. In the estimation of trade flows, this study investigates how different model specifications affect estimation accuracy. Furthermore, it extends the DCGM by incorporating factors of industrial specialization and spatial correlation. These findings contribute to the development of long-term, consistent global input-output databases and offer valuable guidance for future regionalization studies in complex geopolitical contexts.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2538819.abstract_zh: 本研究针对经历重大地缘政治变迁的国家在构建长期一致投入产出表（IOTs）方面所面临的挑战，提出了一种方法论框架，该框架整合了用于估算区域内流量的二维区位商（2DLQ）与用于区域间贸易的双约束引力模型（DCGM）。我们将此2DLQ-DCGM框架应用于1987年苏联投入产出表的区域分解。以1987年各苏维埃共和国的实际投入产出表为基准，本研究首先比较并分析了2DLQ中不同参数化方法的性能影响，从而验证了纳入区域结构数据的重要性及交叉熵方法在数据稀缺情境下的可行性。在贸易流量估算中，本研究探讨了不同模型设定如何影响估算精度。此外，通过纳入产业专业化与空间相关性因素，本研究对DCGM进行了扩展。这些发现有助于发展长期一致的全球投入产出数据库，并为未来复杂地缘政治背景下的区域化研究提供了宝贵指导。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2538819.title: Bridging historical discontinuities: a framework for regionalization of input-output tables
10.1080/00036846.2025.2538819.title_zh: 弥合历史断裂：投入产出表区域化框架

10.1080/00036846.2025.2538820.abstract: Information asymmetries between parents and children, as well as poor school-parent communication, hinder parental participation in education. This paper examines two key questions: (1) How does reducing information asymmetries affect student performance? (2) What drives changes in parental and student behaviour? Using data from a Shenzhen school, nearly 250 parents received both positive and negative information on their children’s school performance. The experiment, conducted over two semesters starting in spring 2019, was terminated in spring 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Contrary to expectations and existing literature, increased parental information was correlated with lower test scores. The explanation lies in ‘upward belief bias’, where parents overestimate their children’s behaviour. Although school information corrected these beliefs, negatively surprised parents responded with increased involvement, such as punishments or rewards for money and playtime, which proved counterproductive. The findings suggest that excessive parental intervention, particularly in response to negative information, exerts undue pressure on children, harming their academic performance. Over-incentivization may not be beneficial for elementary students in China, highlighting the need for balanced parental involvement.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2538820.abstract_zh: 家长与子女之间的信息不对称，以及学校与家长之间沟通不畅，阻碍了家长参与教育。本文探讨两个关键问题：（1）减少信息不对称如何影响学生表现？（2）是什么驱动了家长和学生行为的改变？利用深圳一所学校的数据，近250名家长收到了关于其子女在校表现的正面和负面信息。该实验自2019年春季开始，持续两个学期，因COVID-19疫情于2020年春季终止。与预期及现有文献相反，家长获得更多信息与考试成绩下降相关。其原因在于“向上信念偏差”，即家长高估子女的行为表现。尽管学校信息纠正了这些信念，但受到负面惊讶的家长以增加参与度作为回应，如采取惩罚或对金钱和游戏时间进行奖惩，结果适得其反。研究结果表明，过度的家长干预，尤其是针对负面信息的干预，给孩子施加了不当压力，损害了其学业表现。过度激励可能对中国小学生并无益处，凸显了平衡家长参与的必要性。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2538820.title: Why providing more information to parents may not always improve child educational outcomes: lessons from a study in China
10.1080/00036846.2025.2538820.title_zh: 为何向家长提供更多信息未必总能改善子女教育成果：来自中国研究的启示

10.1080/00036846.2025.2538822.abstract: By shifting the focus from traditional firm-level outcomes, this study reveals that dual-class share structures significantly exacerbate managerial self-interest. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that this effect is stronger in registered countries with higher corruption levels. The agency effect of dual-class share structures is insignificant for companies in the growth phase, but becomes more pronounced for those in the mature and decline phases. Moderating channel analysis indicates that audit monitoring, stock incentives, sunset clauses, and institutional shareholding can effectively mitigate the managerial self-interest behaviours in dual-class share structures. These findings can be useful references for optimizing dual-class share practice by alleviating its potential agency problems in the field of corporate governance.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2538822.abstract_zh: 本研究通过将焦点从传统的企业层面结果转移，揭示出双重股权结构显著加剧了管理层自利行为。异质性分析表明，在腐败程度较高的注册国家，这一效应更为显著。对于处于成长阶段的企业，双重股权结构的代理效应不显著，但在成熟期和衰退期企业中则更为突出。调节渠道分析指出，审计监督、股票激励、日落条款及机构持股能有效缓解双重股权结构下的管理层自利行为。这些发现为优化双重股权实践、减轻其在公司治理领域潜在的代理问题提供了有益参考。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2539529.abstract: Aggregate trading by Chinese institutional investors, trading for mutual funds and private funds are positively associated with stock volatility. In contrast, the dealers trading exhibits a negative association with stock volatility. These results highlight heterogeneity in the impact of institutional trading on stock volatility. The relationship between Chinese institutional investor trading and stock volatility is time-varying, differing significantly between bull and bear market periods. We find no evidence that the unexpected components of mutual funds and private funds trading convey more information than their expected components. Our findings suggest that Chinese institutional investors do not possess an informational advantage and are unable to stabilize the market.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539529.abstract_zh: 中国机构投资者的总体交易行为，包括共同基金和私募基金的操作，与股票波动性呈正相关。相反，券商交易则与股票波动性呈负相关。这些结果凸显了机构交易对股票波动性影响的异质性。中国机构投资者交易与股票波动性之间的关系随时间变化，牛市与熊市期间存在显著差异。我们未发现证据表明共同基金和私募基金交易的意外成分比其预期成分传递了更多信息。我们的研究结果表明，中国机构投资者并不具备信息优势，且无法稳定市场。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539529.title: Is daily Chinese institutional trading and stock price volatility positively correlated?
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539529.title_zh: 中国机构每日交易与股价波动是否正相关？

10.1080/00036846.2025.2539530.abstract: This study explores rural–urban (RU) disparities in the body mass index (BMI) among women of childbearing age in Bangladesh using data from five rounds of the Bangladesh Demographic and Health Surveys (2004–2018). Employing Oaxaca-Blinder and quantile regression-based counterfactual decomposition methods, we quantify the contributions of socio-economic factors, healthcare access, fertility behaviours, and infrastructure to the BMI gap between rural and urban areas. Our findings indicate that socio-economic factors, particularly education and wealth, significantly explain the disparities, with infrastructure differences further aggravating these gaps. Results reveal that the gap widens at higher BMI quantiles, suggesting that targeted interventions in rural areas are crucial for addressing educational and infrastructural deficits. While women’s differential returns to education and wealth status substantially contribute to the RU gap, differences in the impacts of health behaviours on BMI serve to shrink the gap. These findings emphasize the importance of tailored policy strategies to reduce health inequalities in developing countries.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539530.abstract_zh: 本研究利用孟加拉国人口与健康调查五轮数据（2004-2018年），探讨了孟加拉国育龄妇女体重指数（BMI）的城乡差异。采用Oaxaca-Blinder及基于分位数回归的反事实分解方法，我们量化了社会经济因素、医疗保健可及性、生育行为及基础设施对城乡BMI差距的贡献。研究发现，社会经济因素，尤其是教育和财富，显著解释了这些差异，而基础设施差异进一步加剧了这些差距。结果显示，在较高的BMI分位数上，差距扩大，表明针对农村地区的定向干预对于解决教育和基础设施不足至关重要。尽管女性在教育和财富状况上的不同回报显著贡献于城乡差距，但健康行为对BMI影响的差异则有助于缩小这一差距。这些发现强调了制定针对性政策策略以减少发展中国家健康不平等的重要性。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539530.title: Rural–urban disparities in body mass index of women: evidence from counterfactual decomposition methods
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539530.title_zh: 农村与城市女性体质指数差异：基于反事实分解方法的证据

10.1080/00036846.2025.2539531.abstract: This paper examines how ambiguity in the production process and exogenous shocks affect contractual outcomes by incorporating these factors into a principal-agent model. The principal adopts distinct strategies in response to each type of ambiguity. When ambiguity in production process increases, the principal reduces investment, shares ambiguity exposure with the agent, and delays payment to strengthen bargaining power position. In contrast, when facing exogenous shocks beyond the agent’s control, the principal mitigates firm internal risk and enhances stability by reducing capital investment in the risky production process, providing advance payments, and avoiding payoff reductions to preserve the agent’s incentives during shocks. These strategies emerge from the interaction between ambiguity and incentive design within the contracting framework. Notably, both types of ambiguity lose relevance under liquidation pressure, and production process ambiguity becomes insignificant when output is sufficiently high.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539531.abstract_zh: 本文通过将生产过程中的模糊性与外生冲击纳入委托-代理模型，探讨了这两类因素如何影响契约结果。委托人针对每种模糊性采取不同的应对策略。当生产过程模糊性增加时，委托人减少投资，与代理人分担模糊性风险，并延迟支付以增强议价地位。相反，当面临超出代理人控制的外生冲击时，委托人通过减少对高风险生产过程的资本投入、提供预付款以及避免削减报酬来维持代理人在冲击期间的激励，从而降低企业内部风险并增强稳定性。这些策略源于契约框架内模糊性与激励设计之间的相互作用。值得注意的是，在清算压力下，两类模糊性均失去相关性；而当产出足够高时，生产过程模糊性变得不再显著。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2539532.abstract: The persistence of infant mortality in middle-income countries, such as Brazil, is a critical health challenge in the twenty-first century. Healthcare policymakers increasingly use statistical methods such as survival analysis to identify factors associated with mortality rates. Using 2.9 million observations from the Brazilian Unique Health System (SUS) 2017, we estimated a set of different machine learning models (Survival Support Vector Machines, Random Survival Forest and Extreme Gradient Boosting) to predict which infants have the highest risk of not surviving the first year of life. The SHAP framework of interpretable machine learning was used to identify factors affecting infant mortality rates in Brazil. Factors such as caesarean sections and gestational weeks affect mortality nonlinearly and mean variable effects, found in standard survival regression models, can be misleading. Finally, we argue that interpretable machine learning models can support policymakers in designing health policies and screening frameworks that address the challenge of infant mortality in middle-income countries.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539532.abstract_zh: 中等收入国家（如巴西）婴儿死亡率的持续存在是二十一世纪面临的一项关键健康挑战。医疗政策制定者越来越多地运用生存分析等统计方法来识别与死亡率相关的因素。利用巴西统一卫生系统（SUS）2017年的290万条观测数据，我们估计了一系列不同的机器学习模型（生存支持向量机、随机生存森林和极限梯度提升），以预测哪些婴儿在生命第一年内无法存活的风险最高。采用可解释机器学习的SHAP框架来识别影响巴西婴儿死亡率的因素。剖宫产和孕周等因素对死亡率的影响呈非线性，而标准生存回归模型中发现的平均变量效应可能具有误导性。最后，我们认为，可解释的机器学习模型能够支持政策制定者设计应对中等收入国家婴儿死亡率挑战的健康政策和筛查框架。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2539533.abstract: This article analyzes the role of municipal public procurement in shaping the productivity of local firms. Combining firm-level data on Italian limited liability companies with administrative records of public procurement contracts from 2010 to 2018, we find that higher per capita municipal procurement spending is associated with higher productivity among firms located in the same municipality. This positive relationship is significantly weakened for firms with dynastic top management (i.e. managed by a member of the owner’s family), and stronger in larger municipalities outside specialized industrial districts, where more diversified local economies, procurement of services, and higher worker mobility enhance productivity.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539533.abstract_zh: 本文分析了市政公共采购在塑造当地企业生产率中的作用。结合意大利有限责任公司层面的数据与2010年至2018年公共采购合同的行政记录，我们发现，人均市政采购支出越高，同一市政区域内企业的生产率也越高。这种正相关关系对于由家族成员管理的世袭高层管理企业显著减弱，而在专业化工业区之外的大型市政区域中则更为强劲，这些地区更多元化的地方经济、服务采购以及更高的劳动力流动性促进了生产率的提升。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539533.title: Municipal procurement, productivity and dynastic management: evidence from Italian firms
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539533.title_zh: 市政采购、生产率与世袭管理：来自意大利企业的证据

10.1080/00036846.2025.2539534.abstract: The integration of the digital economy and the real economy (IDR) plays a pivotal role in achieving sustainable economic development. Using panel data from Chinese A-share listed companies from 2011 to 2022, this study empirically explores the influence of IDR on corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) practices. Results indicate that higher IDR levels significantly enhance ESG practices. The mechanism analysis demonstrates that IDR strengthens firms’ absorptive, adaptive, and innovative capabilities, which in turn improves ESG practices. Under the ‘Technology-Organization-Environment’ (TOE) framework, executives’ information technology backgrounds, strong customer relationships, and advanced digital finance amplify IDR’s positive impact on ESG. This study contributes to understanding the micro-level implications of IDR and offers practical insights for advancing sustainable corporate transformation.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539534.abstract_zh: 数字经济与实体经济的融合（IDR）在实现可持续经济发展中扮演着关键角色。利用2011年至2022年中国A股上市公司的面板数据，本研究实证探讨了IDR对企业环境、社会和治理（ESG）实践的影响。结果表明，较高的IDR水平显著增强了企业的ESG实践。机制分析显示，IDR通过强化企业的吸收能力、适应能力和创新能力，进而改善ESG实践。在“技术-组织-环境”（TOE）框架下，高管的信息技术背景、稳固的客户关系以及先进的数字金融均能放大IDR对ESG的积极影响。本研究有助于理解IDR的微观层面含义，并为推进企业可持续转型提供了实践见解。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539534.title: Does digital-real integration contribute to corporate ESG practices? The mediating role of dynamic capabilities
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539534.title_zh: 数字实体融合是否促进企业ESG实践？动态能力的中介作用

10.1080/00036846.2025.2539535.abstract: Promoting green development along the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) is an important initiative for global environmental governance and an inevitable choice for leading the economic and social development in a green, low-carbon and recycling-oriented manner. This article analyzes the impact of the BRI on the green innovation development along the routes and neighbouring regions by using the Super-SBM model, the dynamic-spatial difference-in-difference (DS-DID) model and the GMM estimation method. It is found that: (1) The level of green innovation development in different regions varies greatly, but the overall positive spatial correlation is stable. (2) The BRI can effectively improve the green innovation development in the regions along the routes, and has the ‘spatial and temporal spillover effect’ of ‘taking neighbours as partners and making progress together’. (3) The BRI can promote the green innovation development of the regions along the routes and neighbouring areas through industrial development and scientific and technological progress. This article puts forward suggestions for reference from the aspects of balancing regional competition with overall objectives, coordinating pilot projects and joint development, taking into account both domestic and international ‘double-cycling’, and focusing on the precise implementation of the powers and responsibilities of local governments.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539535.abstract_zh: 推动共建“一带一路”绿色发展，是全球环境治理的重要举措，也是引领经济社会发展绿色低碳转型的必然选择。本文运用Super-SBM模型、动态空间双重差分模型（DS-DID）及GMM估计方法，分析了“一带一路”倡议对沿线及邻近地区绿色创新发展的影响。研究发现：（1）各地区绿色创新发展水平差异显著，但整体呈现稳定的正向空间相关性。（2）“一带一路”倡议能有效提升沿线地区的绿色创新发展水平，并具有“以邻为伴、共同进步”的“时空溢出效应”。（3）“一带一路”倡议可通过产业发展和科技进步促进沿线及邻近地区的绿色创新发展。本文从平衡区域竞争与整体目标、协调试点与联动发展、兼顾国内外“双循环”以及注重地方政府权责精准落实等方面提出参考建议。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2539536.abstract: This study examines the impact of the expanding power of institutional shareholders on corporate tax avoidance. We measure shareholder power using the geographic concentration of institutional shareholders that affects tax aggressiveness. Our findings suggest that shareholder power is negatively associated with tax avoidance, as it constrains managerial opportunistic behaviours. The effect is more pronounced for firms in weaker external monitoring environments, with lower CEO shareholdings, more management with a financial background, and more long-term and foreign institutional shareholdings. In addition, shareholder power facilitates higher tax revenue collection. This study contributes to the nascent stream of research on the impact of institutional collective governance effectiveness, which is essential for monitoring managerial opportunism related to tax avoidance.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2539536.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了机构股东权力扩张对企业避税行为的影响。我们利用机构股东地理集中度来衡量股东权力，这一因素影响税收激进程度。研究结果表明，股东权力与避税行为呈负相关，因为它约束了管理层的机会主义行为。在外部监督环境较弱、CEO持股比例较低、管理层中具有金融背景的人员较多以及长期和外国机构持股比例较高的公司中，这一效应更为显著。此外，股东权力促进了税收收入的增加。本研究为关于机构集体治理有效性影响的新兴研究领域做出了贡献，这对于监督与避税相关的管理层机会主义行为至关重要。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2540093.abstract: Environmental regulations are reshaping industrial land markets, yet their effects on firm behaviour and land demand remain underexplored. This study investigates how China’s clean air policies impact industrial land prices, emphasizing firm-level adaptation strategies. Using a difference-in-differences approach on 229 cities, we find that these policies significantly increase land prices, with larger cities experiencing the strongest gains, while manufacturing-heavy and pollution-intensive cities see weaker growth. Firms respond by adopting green initiatives and clustering in high-tech hubs, fuelling land demand, whereas polluting firms reduce land acquisitions. The relationship between regulatory stringency and land prices follows a weak U-shaped curve, indicating that moderate regulation fosters growth, but excessive stringency may dampen market activity. These findings highlight a fundamental shift in local land allocation strategies, where environmental priorities increasingly shape urban-industrial development. This research offers critical insights for policymakers navigating the trade-offs between sustainability and economic competitiveness.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540093.abstract_zh: 环境规制正在重塑工业用地市场，但其对企业行为及土地需求的影响仍未得到充分探讨。本研究考察中国清洁空气政策如何影响工业用地价格，重点关注企业层面的适应策略。基于对229个城市采用双重差分法，我们发现这些政策显著推高了土地价格，其中大城市涨幅最为明显，而制造业密集及污染密集型城市的增长则相对较弱。企业通过采取绿色举措并集聚于高科技中心作为应对，从而推升了土地需求，而污染型企业则减少了土地购置。规制强度与土地价格之间的关系呈现弱U型曲线，表明适度规制促进增长，但过度严格可能抑制市场活力。这些发现揭示了地方土地配置策略的根本性转变，环境优先事项日益塑造城市工业发展格局。本研究为政策制定者在可持续性与经济竞争力之间权衡取舍提供了重要洞见。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2540600.abstract: This article evaluates the out-of-sample exchange rate predictability of exchange rate models using real-time and revised data for 10 countries from 1973 to 2024 across short and long forecast horizons. Employing directional change tests and economic evaluation, we find that real-time data significantly enhances the performance of the most successful specifications at the shortest forecast horizon. However, this advantage is more elusive at longer horizons, as data revisions correct initial errors. We examine the models based on monetary, purchasing power parity, and Taylor rule fundamentals, as well as the uncovered interest rate parity model augmented with inflation. Using real-time data, models with Taylor-rule fundamentals exhibit superior predictive accuracy at the shortest horizon and offer the highest economic gains at all forecast horizons, while the UIRP model augmented with either U.S. and foreign inflation or U.S. inflation demonstrates superior predictive ability over longer horizons. Notably, the UIRP model with inflation shows stronger directional accuracy with real-time data at all horizons than with revised data. Additionally, we introduce geopolitical risk into the model with Taylor rule fundamentals to capture uncertainty from wars, terrorism, and political tensions. This model yields the highest economic gains and superior out-of-sample performance at the 1-quarter horizon.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540600.abstract_zh: 本文评估了汇率模型在样本外汇率可预测性方面的表现，利用1973年至2024年间10个国家的实时与修订数据，覆盖短期和长期预测区间。通过方向变化检验和经济评估，我们发现实时数据显著提升了最成功模型在最短预测区间内的表现。然而，在较长区间内这一优势较难维持，因为数据修订修正了初始误差。我们考察了基于货币、购买力平价和泰勒规则基本面的模型，以及加入通胀因素的无抛补利率平价模型。使用实时数据时，泰勒规则基本面模型在最短区间内展现出卓越的预测准确性，并在所有预测区间内提供最高的经济收益，而加入美国及外国通胀或仅美国通胀的UIRP模型在较长区间内表现出更强的预测能力。值得注意的是，加入通胀的UIRP模型在所有区间内使用实时数据时，方向准确性均优于修订数据。此外，我们将地缘政治风险引入泰勒规则基本面模型，以捕捉战争、恐怖主义和政治紧张局势带来的不确定性。该模型在1季度区间内实现了最高的经济收益和优越的样本外表现。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540600.title: Out-of-sample exchange rate predictability with real-time and revised data
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540600.title_zh: 实时数据与修订数据下的样本外汇率可预测性

10.1080/00036846.2025.2540601.abstract: Digital technology is wider penetration, as reflected in its ability to directly or indirectly embed the improvement of productivity efficiency into other industries. Utilizing the China’s Industrial Productivity (CIP) database and industry classification, we employ the growth accounting method to measure Total Factor Productivity (TFP) for various industries and the digital economy. And we further construct the TFP input-output model, dismantling the factor input and final demand, to explore China ‘s production efficiency linkage and transmission path across digital economy and various industries. Our empirical results show that TFP input and final demand have increased after multiple transmitting by digital economy, but these TFP transmission effect is mainly within the digital economy itself, its pervasiveness effect to other industries is still weak. Moreover, from industrial perspective, high-tech-dependent industries show higher sensitivity and influence than non-technology-dependent industries when considering TFP input, and the feed-back effect to digital economy of TFP technology spillover from producer services is higher than that of advanced manufacture. This study provides new perspectives and critical empirical evidence on how TFP can penetrate and transmit to other industries through digital economy, offering significant policy implications for enhancing the spillover effects of the digital economy and optimizing industrial policy.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540601.abstract_zh: 数字技术的渗透性日益增强，体现在其能够直接或间接地将生产效率的提升嵌入其他产业之中。借助中国工业生产率（CIP）数据库及行业分类，我们采用增长核算方法测算了各行业及数字经济的全要素生产率（TFP）。进一步地，我们构建了TFP投入产出模型，分解要素投入与最终需求，以探究中国数字经济与各行业间的生产效率联动及其传导路径。实证结果显示，经过数字经济的多次传导，TFP投入与最终需求均有所增长，但这些TFP传导效应主要局限于数字经济内部，其对其他行业的渗透效应仍显薄弱。此外，从产业视角看，高技术依赖行业在TFP投入方面展现出比非技术依赖行业更高的敏感性与影响力，而生产者服务业对数字经济的TFP技术溢出反馈效应高于先进制造业。本研究为理解TFP如何通过数字经济渗透并传导至其他行业提供了新视角与关键实证依据，对增强数字经济溢出效应及优化产业政策具有重要政策启示。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2540602.abstract: This paper explores the influence of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) factors on Chinese companies’ cross-border mergers and acquisitions (M&A). It finds that acquirers prefer targets with equal or superior ESG ratings, reflecting a strategic emphasis on sustainability. While initial post-acquisition performance may face challenges, acquiring firms ultimately experience improvements in ESG performance, particularly through green innovation. This research highlights ESG’s growing importance in strategic decision-making, contributing to the literature on cross-border M&A and sustainability by offering insights into how ESG ratings shape acquisition outcomes and long-term corporate sustainability.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540602.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了环境、社会与治理（ESG）因素对中国企业跨境并购（M&A）的影响。研究发现，收购方倾向于选择ESG评级相当或更高的目标企业，这反映了对可持续性的战略重视。尽管并购初期业绩可能面临挑战，但收购企业最终在ESG表现上有所提升，尤其是通过绿色创新实现改善。本研究凸显了ESG在战略决策中日益增长的重要性，通过揭示ESG评级如何影响并购成果及企业长期可持续性，为跨境并购与可持续性领域的文献贡献了见解。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2540604.abstract: We investigate the impact of China’s supply chain digitalization policy on firm-level carbon risk, utilizing a quasi-experimental framework from 2013 to 2021. We substantiate the policy’s significant role in reducing carbon-related risks, with the extent of mitigation influenced by factors such as firm characteristics, pollution levels, financial constraints, and ESG performance. We further investigate the mechanisms linking supply chain digitalization to carbon risk, focusing on CEO-related factors. The results indicate that political ties exacerbate carbon risk, though their interaction with digitalization policies yields a risk-reducing effect. Instead, CEO turnover and narcissism positively influence this relationship. Further investigation reveals that the policy enhances firms’ participation in global innovation networks, substantially alleviating corporate carbon risk exposure. Our study provides timely insights into how digitalization policies can be a strategic tool for firms to align with global sustainability goals while managing carbon-related uncertainties.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540604.abstract_zh: 我们利用2013至2021年间的准实验框架，考察了中国供应链数字化政策对企业层面碳风险的影响。我们证实了该政策在降低碳相关风险方面的重要作用，其缓解程度受企业特征、污染水平、财务约束及ESG表现等因素的影响。我们进一步探究了供应链数字化与碳风险之间的关联机制，重点关注首席执行官相关因素。结果表明，政治关联加剧了碳风险，尽管其与数字化政策的交互作用产生了风险降低效应。相反，CEO更替和自恋特质对此关系产生正向影响。进一步研究发现，该政策增强了企业参与全球创新网络的程度，显著减轻了企业碳风险敞口。我们的研究为数字化政策如何成为企业对接全球可持续发展目标、同时管理碳相关不确定性的战略工具提供了及时见解。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2540605.abstract: The effect of environmental regulations on corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance and greenwashing behaviour has become the focus of academic attention. This research empirically analyzes the influence of public environmental concern on the ESG performance and greenwashing behaviour of listed companies from the perspective of informal regulations based on the panel data of A-share listed companies from 2007 to 2022. Results show that public environmental concern significantly improves corporate ESG performance, and the conclusion still holds after robustness tests of one period lag, systematic generalized method of moments, and two-stage least squares regression. Heterogeneity analysis shows that public environmental concern has a significantly positive effect on the ESG performance of state-owned enterprises, non-heavily polluting enterprises, and technology-intensive enterprises but a significantly negative effect on the ESG performance of labour-intensive enterprises. Further moderating effect results indicate that government governance and market constraints strengthen the positive effect of public environmental concern on firms’ ESG performance. Finally, this study confirms that public environmental concern has a significant inhibitory effect on corporate greenwashing behaviour. The findings of the study are of great practical significance for enterprises to improve the quality of their environmental information disclosure.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540605.abstract_zh: 环境规制对企业环境、社会与治理（ESG）表现及漂绿行为的影响已成为学术界关注的焦点。本研究基于2007年至2022年A股上市公司的面板数据，从非正式规制视角出发，实证分析了公众环境关注对上市公司ESG表现及漂绿行为的影响。结果表明，公众环境关注显著提升了企业ESG表现，且在滞后一期、系统广义矩估计及两阶段最小二乘回归等稳健性检验后，该结论依然成立。异质性分析显示，公众环境关注对国有企业、非重污染企业及技术密集型企业的ESG表现具有显著正向影响，而对劳动密集型企业的ESG表现则产生显著负向影响。进一步的调节效应结果表明，政府治理与市场约束强化了公众环境关注对企业ESG表现的正向作用。最后，本研究证实公众环境关注对企业漂绿行为具有显著抑制作用。研究结论对于企业提升环境信息披露质量具有重要的实践意义。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2540607.abstract: With the advancement of the digital economy, digital literacy has become a crucial component of human capital, necessitating in-depth research into its impact on labour productivity and the underlying mechanisms. Utilizing data from the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS), this research examines the effects of digital literacy on individual labour productivity and analyzes the moderating role of educational level. The findings indicate that digital literacy significantly enhances individual labour productivity, but this effect is significantly moderated by education levels. As education levels increase, the impact of digital literacy on labour productivity becomes more significant. Mechanism analyses reveal that digital literacy enhances labour productivity through three main pathways: facilitating transitions into digital occupations, reducing skill mismatches, and improving employment probabilities. These pathways are also moderated by education levels. Further analysis of different types of digital literacy reveals that, in comparison to productive digital literacy, the impact of living digital literacy on labour productivity is more dependent on individual education. Heterogeneity analysis indicates significant variations in the effects of digital literacy on labour productivity across regions with varying levels of digital technology development and between urban and rural areas.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540607.abstract_zh: 随着数字经济的发展，数字素养已成为人力资本的重要组成部分，深入研究其对劳动生产率的影响及内在机制显得尤为必要。本研究利用中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）数据，考察了数字素养对个人劳动生产率的影响，并分析了教育水平的调节作用。研究发现，数字素养显著提升个人劳动生产率，但这一效应受到教育水平的显著调节。随着教育水平的提高，数字素养对劳动生产率的影响愈发显著。机制分析表明，数字素养通过三条主要途径增强劳动生产率：促进向数字职业的转变、减少技能错配以及提高就业概率。这些途径同样受到教育水平的调节。对不同类型数字素养的进一步分析显示，相较于生产性数字素养，生活性数字素养对劳动生产率的影响更依赖于个人教育水平。异质性分析表明，在数字技术发展水平不同的地区以及城乡之间，数字素养对劳动生产率的影响存在显著差异。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2540609.abstract: As digital innovation becomes a key driver of competitive advantage, enhancing organizational digital innovation has gained increasing attention. This study examines how Open Government Data (OGD) policies drive corporate digital innovation through a quasi-natural experiment based on China’s multi-phase OGD implementation. Using panel data from 2008 to 2022, we confirm OGD’s significant positive impact on corporate digital innovation. Mechanism analysis identifies three key pathways: strengthening digital infrastructure, fostering high-tech talent, and enhancing corporate digital awareness. Heterogeneity analysis shows stronger effects for non-state-owned enterprises, firms outside the Yangtze River Economic Belt, and those with higher financing constraints. The study provides theoretical and empirical insights for optimizing data governance and highlights the need for tailored policies to address firm-level disparities. Our results underscore the pivotal role of public data in digital economic growth and offer valuable guidance for maximizing OGD’s impact on corporate digital innovation.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540609.abstract_zh: 随着数字创新成为竞争优势的关键驱动力，提升组织数字创新能力日益受到关注。本研究以中国多阶段开放政府数据（OGD）实施为自然实验，探讨OGD政策如何驱动企业数字创新。基于2008年至2022年的面板数据，我们证实了OGD对企业数字创新的显著正向影响。机制分析识别出三条关键路径：加强数字基础设施、培养高科技人才以及提升企业数字意识。异质性分析显示，非国有企业、长江经济带以外企业以及融资约束较高的企业，其影响更为显著。本研究为优化数据治理提供了理论与实证见解，并强调了针对企业层面差异制定定制化政策的必要性。我们的研究结果凸显了公共数据在数字经济增长中的关键作用，并为最大化OGD对企业数字创新的影响提供了宝贵指导。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2540610.abstract: This study investigates whether hedge fund managers can benefit from oil market volatility through active management. Using a range of oil market volatility measures, including Oil ETF Volatility Index (OVX), Brent volatility (BRTVOL) and WTI volatility (WTIVOL), we performed univariate portfolio analysis and cross-sectional Fama-MacBeth regressions to assess the relationship between hedge fund returns and exposure to oil volatility. The results showed that hedge funds with better hedging behaviour generate higher future returns, with top hedgers consistently outperforming bottom hedgers across various holding periods. The results are consistent after considering downside volatility risk measures and style level analysis. Additionally, hedge fund managers exhibit a significant oil market volatility timing ability. The results are robust to the use of stock market volatility timing, manager luck and crisis periods. Our findings provide empirical evidence for volatility-managed portfolio theory in the oil market, which contradicts the traditional risk-return trade-off. These findings provide valuable insights for global investors that hedge fund managers are sophisticated in trading oil market volatility.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540610.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨对冲基金经理能否通过主动管理从石油市场波动中获益。利用一系列石油市场波动率指标，包括石油ETF波动率指数（OVX）、布伦特原油波动率（BRTVOL）和西德克萨斯中质原油波动率（WTIVOL），我们进行了单变量投资组合分析和横截面Fama-MacBeth回归，以评估对冲基金收益与石油波动率敞口之间的关系。结果显示，具有更优对冲行为的对冲基金能产生更高的未来收益，顶级对冲者在不同持有期内始终优于底部对冲者。在考虑下行波动风险指标和风格层面分析后，结果保持一致。此外，对冲基金经理展现出显著的石油市场波动择时能力。该结果在使用股市波动择时、经理运气及危机时期等控制条件下依然稳健。我们的发现为石油市场中的波动率管理投资组合理论提供了实证证据，这与传统的风险-收益权衡相悖。这些发现为全球投资者提供了宝贵见解，表明对冲基金经理在交易石油市场波动方面具有高超技巧。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2540611.abstract: Digital monetary transactions are revolutionizing the way economies operate by enabling faster, more efficient, and cost-effective methods of value exchange. These developments carry significant macroeconomic implications, notably for the velocity of money (VoM). Despite the growing literature on digital payments and macroeconomic variables, the interaction between digital transactions, monetary aggregates, and structural shifts such as the COVID-19 pandemic remains underexplored, especially for developing economies. This study investigates the impact of digital transactions and the COVID-19 pandemic on VoM in Turkey while accounting for a comprehensive set of macroeconomic variables. Employing an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model with bounds-testing, we find a stable and positive long-run relationship: a 1% increase in digital payments raises VoM by 0.3%. The COVID-19 pandemic has amplified this effect, as lockdowns and social distancing measures have accelerated the adoption of contactless transactions. Among digital banking activities, digital payments emerge as the primary drivers of increased VoM, surpassing money transfers and online credit card use. Moreover, digital banking influences the circulation of currency more than broader monetary aggregates, mainly by displacing physical cash. These results confirm that rising VoM driven by digitalization may require more dynamic and forward-looking liquidity management and closer monitoring of payment systems.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540611.abstract_zh: 数字货币交易正通过提供更快、更高效且成本更低的价值交换方式，彻底改变经济运作模式。这些发展具有显著的宏观经济影响，尤其是对货币流通速度（VoM）而言。尽管关于数字支付与宏观经济变量的文献日益增多，但数字交易、货币总量与诸如新冠疫情等结构性冲击之间的相互作用仍未得到充分探讨，尤其是在发展中经济体背景下。本研究考察了数字交易及新冠疫情对土耳其货币流通速度的影响，同时纳入了全面的宏观经济变量集。采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型并进行边界检验，我们发现存在稳定且正向的长期关系：数字支付每增加1%，货币流通速度将提升0.3%。新冠疫情放大了这一效应，因为封锁和社交距离措施加速了非接触式交易的普及。在数字银行活动中，数字支付成为提升货币流通速度的主要驱动力，其作用超过了转账和在线信用卡使用。此外，数字银行对通货流通的影响大于对更广泛货币总量的影响，这主要通过替代实物现金实现。这些结果证实，由数字化驱动的货币流通速度上升，可能需要更具动态性和前瞻性的流动性管理，以及对支付系统的更密切监测。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2540612.abstract: This study investigates the underexplored spillover effects of equity market liberalization on the efficiency of non-pilot enterprises by employing robust quasi-experimental methods to generate insights relevant to policy and investment strategies. Using the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect and Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect as natural experiments, the analysis focuses on their influence on the total factor productivity (TFP) of listed companies. The findings indicate that equity market liberalization significantly enhances TFP among non-pilot enterprises through mechanisms such as attracting institutional investors, accelerating digital transformation, and improving investment efficiency. From a resource allocation perspective, liberalization reduces ownership discrimination, providing disproportionate advantages to private enterprises over state-owned enterprises, while simultaneously intensifying scale discrimination as larger firms gain preferential access to resources. These results offer important implications for policymakers and practitioners, highlighting the necessity of targeted reforms to promote equitable resource distribution and address disparities arising from market liberalization. The study contributes to the broader discourse on economic efficiency, equity, and market integration by providing empirical evidence applicable to policy development and strategic decision-making.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540612.abstract_zh: 本研究采用稳健的准实验方法，探讨股票市场开放对非试点企业效率的溢出效应，这一领域此前研究不足，旨在为政策制定与投资策略提供洞见。以上海—香港股票市场交易互联互通机制和深圳—香港股票市场交易互联互通机制作为自然实验，分析其对上市公司全要素生产率的影响。研究发现，股票市场开放通过吸引机构投资者、加速数字化转型及提升投资效率等机制，显著提高了非试点企业的全要素生产率。从资源配置视角看，开放降低了所有权歧视，使民营企业相较于国有企业获得不成比例的益处，同时加剧了规模歧视，大型企业因优先获取资源而受益更多。这些结果对政策制定者和实践者具有重要启示，凸显了推进定向改革以促进资源公平分配、应对市场开放所引发差异的必要性。本研究通过提供适用于政策制定与战略决策的经验证据，为经济效率、公平及市场一体化等更广泛议题的讨论作出贡献。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2540613.abstract: Poor rural human settlement environments (HSEs) are a persistent challenge in developing countries. While the development of the rural collective economy (RCE) is considered a potential solution in China, rigorous quantitative analysis has been lacking. This study uses a large-scale Chinese farmer survey and Mvprobit/Ivprobit models to analyse the impact and mechanisms of RCE development on farmers’ governance of HSEs. Results show that stronger RCEs significantly increase the likelihood of improved sanitation, specifically, scientific sewage treatment and sanitary toilet adoption – a finding robust to endogeneity concerns and after controlling for rural tourism, poverty status, and suburban location. RCE growth boosts rural public spending and farmers’ disposable income, offsetting inadequate government funding, and enhances farmer satisfaction with village cadres, fostering collective action. Village cadre human capital and the farmer dependency ratio significantly moderate these effects. Promoting RCE development, and engaging migrant workers are key strategies for improving rural sanitation.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2540613.abstract_zh: 农村人居环境恶劣是发展中国家面临的持续挑战。尽管在中国，发展农村集体经济被视为一种潜在解决方案，但缺乏严谨的定量分析。本研究利用大规模中国农民调查数据及Mvprobit/Ivprobit模型，分析农村集体经济发展对农民治理人居环境的影响及其作用机制。结果表明，较强的农村集体经济显著提升了卫生条件改善的可能性，具体表现为科学污水处理和卫生厕所的采用——这一发现在控制内生性问题及排除乡村旅游、贫困状态和郊区区位等因素后依然稳健。农村集体经济增长促进了农村公共支出和农民可支配收入的增加，弥补了政府资金不足，并增强了农民对村干部的满意度，从而推动集体行动。村干部人力资本和农民抚养比显著调节了这些效应。促进农村集体经济发展及吸纳农民工参与，是改善农村卫生状况的关键策略。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2541937.abstract: This study examines residents’ willingness to pay (WTP) to preserve the Cultural Landscape of the Old Tea Forests of Jingmai Mountain in China by combining the contingent valuation method (CVM) with fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis (FsQCA). CVM results reveal that tea-drinking habits, sustainable intelligence, cultural worldview, nature-centric views, and income positively influence WTP. Mean annual truncated WTP is estimated to be 204 CNY (US$28.18) per resident, yielding an aggregate preservation value of 490.39 million CNY (US$67.73 million). This value is comprised of bequest (58.8%), existence (23.6%), and option value (17.6%). FsQCA identifies two core pathways towards willingness to pay for preservation: (1) nature-centric views combined with high income, and (2) tea-drinking habits, regardless of income level associated with respondents. FsQCA results suggest that cultural factors can partially override income constraints in preservation valuation decisions. Overall results provide a basis for identifying preservation funding targets and reveal that policymakers can enhance WTP through economic development and cultural reinforcement strategies.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2541937.abstract_zh: 本研究通过结合条件价值评估法（CVM）与模糊集定性比较分析（FsQCA），探讨了居民对保护中国景迈山古茶林文化景观的支付意愿（WTP）。CVM结果显示，饮茶习惯、可持续智能、文化世界观、自然中心观及收入对支付意愿有正向影响。年均截断支付意愿估计为每位居民204元人民币（约28.18美元），合计保护价值达4.9039亿元人民币（约6773万美元）。该价值由遗赠价值（58.8%）、存在价值（23.6%）和选择价值（17.6%）构成。FsQCA识别出两条通往保护支付意愿的核心路径：（1）自然中心观与高收入相结合；（2）饮茶习惯，不论受访者收入水平如何。FsQCA结果表明，在保护价值评估决策中，文化因素可在一定程度上超越收入限制。总体结果为实现保护资金目标提供了依据，并揭示政策制定者可通过经济发展与文化强化策略提升支付意愿。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2541938.abstract: This study aims to explore how the market-oriented development of data elements can drive an innovative ‘1+N’ configuration of production factors, enhance synergistic innovation, boost total factor productivity, and support the connotative growth of new-quality productivity. This study, based on data from 274 prefecture-level cities in China from 2012 to 2023, treats the establishment of data trading platforms as a quasi-natural experiment and constructs a progressive difference-in-differences (DID) model to analyse the impact of the marketization of data elements on new quality productivity and its underlying mechanisms. Results indicate that data element marketization, exemplified by data trading platforms, significantly enhances new-quality productivity. This effect exhibits spatial spillover, promoting local development while driving neighbouring cities to cultivate new-quality productivity. Mechanism analysis reveals that data element marketization boosts new-quality productivity by encouraging disruptive technological innovation and fostering deep integration of digital economy and real economy. Heterogeneity analysis indicates stronger effects in large-scale, innovative, and high-market-potential cities. The research findings reveal the technological and economic paradigm innovation effect of data element reallocation, providing policy insights for the government to further promote its innovation-driven strategy and theoretical basis and empirical evidence for cultivating new-quality productivity under the new development pattern.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2541938.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨数据要素市场化发展如何驱动创新性“1+N”生产要素配置，增强协同创新，提升全要素生产率，并支撑新质生产力的内涵式增长。基于2012年至2023年中国274个地级市的数据，本研究将数据交易平台的设立视为准自然实验，构建渐进式双重差分（DID）模型，分析数据要素市场化对新质生产力的影响及其内在机制。结果表明，以数据交易平台为代表的数据要素市场化显著提升了新质生产力。该效应具有空间溢出性，在促进本地发展的同时，也带动邻近城市培育新质生产力。机制分析显示，数据要素市场化通过鼓励颠覆性技术创新和促进数字经济与实体经济深度融合来提升新质生产力。异质性分析表明，在规模较大、创新活跃及市场潜力高的城市中，该效应更为显著。研究结果揭示了数据要素重新配置的技术与经济范式创新效应，为政府进一步推进创新驱动战略提供了政策启示，也为新发展格局下培育新质生产力提供了理论基础与实证依据。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2542571.abstract: Transparency of government information plays an important role in impacting firms’ operations. Higher transparency can reduce political and economic uncertainty and improve the overall information environment, thereby reducing the negative impact on firms’ investment decisions. Using municipal level fiscal transparency, we find a significant positive relationship between local government fiscal transparency and enterprise digital transformation. Specifically, an increase of one standard deviation in fiscal transparency leads to a 2.04% improvement in the level of enterprise digital transformation. This effect remains significant in a series of robustness checks. Further analysis suggests that fiscal transparency significantly reduces the cost of debt, decreases uncertainty as estimated from analysts’ textual reports, and promotes more efficient resource allocation, thereby supporting the view that higher fiscal transparency facilitates digital transformation. Overall, this paper highlights the critical role of government behaviour at the micro level.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2542571.abstract_zh: 政府信息透明度在影响企业运营方面发挥着重要作用。更高的透明度能够降低政治与经济不确定性，改善整体信息环境，从而减轻对企业投资决策的负面影响。利用市级财政透明度数据，我们发现地方政府财政透明度与企业数字化转型之间存在显著的正相关关系。具体而言，财政透明度每增加一个标准差，企业数字化转型水平将提升2.04%。这一效应在一系列稳健性检验中依然显著。进一步分析表明，财政透明度显著降低了债务成本，减少了基于分析师文本报告所估计的不确定性，并促进了更高效的资源配置，从而支持了更高透明度有利于数字化转型的观点。总体而言，本文强调了政府行为在微观层面的关键作用。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2543905.abstract: This study investigates how climate policy uncertainty (CPU) influences corporate debt default risk, using firm-level data from 4,610 A-share listed companies in China from 2009 to 2023. Leveraging a novel province-level CPU index, we find that heightened CPU significantly reduces firms’ distance to default, particularly among large firms, high-carbon emitters, and those with low ESG performance. Mechanism analysis shows that CPU increases default risk by raising financing costs and asset impairment losses. We further identify environmental investment and green innovation as effective mitigation channels, especially for carbon-intensive firms. By introducing a high-resolution policy uncertainty data, our findings provide new evidence on how local climate policy ambiguity affects financial fragility and offer practical implications for promoting green resilience and policy transparency in the transition to a low-carbon economy.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2543905.abstract_zh: 本研究利用2009年至2023年中国4610家A股上市公司的企业层面数据，探讨了气候政策不确定性（CPU）如何影响企业债务违约风险。借助省级层面的新型CPU指数，我们发现气候政策不确定性的加剧显著缩短了企业的违约距离，尤其是在大型企业、高碳排放企业以及ESG表现不佳的企业中更为明显。机制分析表明，气候政策不确定性通过提高融资成本和增加资产减值损失来加剧违约风险。进一步研究发现，环境投资和绿色创新是有效的缓解渠道，尤其对碳密集型企业而言。通过引入高分辨率的政策不确定性数据，我们的研究为地方气候政策模糊性如何影响金融脆弱性提供了新证据，并为在低碳经济转型中促进绿色韧性和政策透明度提供了实践启示。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2545013.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between firms’ dividend payments and their designation as financially insolvent. We aim to identify a forward-looking indicator that can help predict potential insolvency. Using data from firms listed on the Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) and the Korea Securities Dealers Automated Quotations (KOSDAQ) markets between 2005 and 2023, we find that dividend payments are negatively associated with financial insolvency designations. This suggests that firms at risk of insolvency tend to conserve liquidity by postponing or withholding dividend payments prior to being officially designated as insolvent. These findings offer practical insights for investors seeking to protect capital and enhance their understanding of financial sustainability. Moreover, this study underscores the potential of dividend policy as a proactive indicator of financial distress, providing valuable implications for market participants and regulators seeking to promote financial stability.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2545013.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了企业股利支付与其被认定为财务破产之间的关系，旨在识别有助于预测潜在破产的前瞻性指标。基于2005年至2023年间韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）和韩国证券交易商自动报价系统（KOSDAQ）市场上市公司的数据，我们发现股利支付与财务破产认定呈负相关。这表明，面临破产风险的企业倾向于在正式被认定为破产前，通过推迟或暂停股利支付来保留流动性。这些发现为寻求保护资本并增强对财务可持续性理解的投资者提供了实践启示。此外，本研究强调了股利政策作为财务困境前瞻性指标的潜力，为致力于促进金融稳定的市场参与者和监管机构提供了重要参考。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2545016.abstract: The structural change process in Sub-Saharan Africa involves a shift of labour out of agriculture and into the nonagricultural sector, with the traditional service sector absorbing the bulk of labour leaving agriculture. Several hypotheses concerning this process will be examined using data from eighteen Sub-Saharan countries from 1990 to 2018. The results indicate that agricultural productivity increases are associated with the shift of labour into the nonagricultural sector. This shift is positively associated with development measured broadly, with the most important relationship being the expansion of the traditional service sector employment share. The employment expansion in this sector is mainly driven by increases in agricultural productivity. Finally, as traditional service sector employment increases, productivity in this sector increases. Policy implications include increased investment to raise agricultural productivity as well as programmes aimed at supporting productivity growth in traditional services. The results are important because the data seem to indicate that the traditional process of structural change (agriculture to manufacturing) does not seem to be relevant for much of Sub-Saharan Africa.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2545016.abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的结构变迁过程涉及劳动力从农业向非农业部门的转移，其中传统服务业部门吸纳了大部分离开农业的劳动力。本文将利用1990年至2018年间十八个撒哈拉以南国家的数据，检验关于这一过程的若干假设。结果表明，农业生产力提升与劳动力向非农业部门的转移相关联。这种转移与广义上的发展呈正相关，其中最重要的关联在于传统服务业部门就业份额的扩大。该部门就业的增长主要由农业生产力提升所驱动。最后，随着传统服务业就业的增加，该部门的生产力也随之提高。政策含义包括增加投资以提高农业生产力，以及旨在支持传统服务业生产力增长的计划。这些结果具有重要意义，因为数据似乎表明，传统的结构变迁路径（从农业到制造业）对撒哈拉以南非洲的大部分地区并不适用。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2545018.abstract: This paper investigates the risk spillover effects among nine biofuel-related assets across three countries. Both dependence structure and tail causal relations are studied with the stationary vine (S-vine) copula model and the quantile Granger causality test. The modified conditional value-at-risk (CoVaR) is proposed to measure the intertemporal risk spillover effects. It extends the traditional CoVaR to account for intertemporal dynamics. Comparatively, the traditional CoVaR may overestimate the risk spillover effects. The empirical results exhibit geographical clusters and potential paths of risk spillovers among biofuel-related assets. The spillover path runs from American markets to Chinese markets via the Malaysian market. American soybean oil is the risk transmitter, while Chinese palm oil is the primary risk recipient. Moreover, the spillover effects of downside risks have increased since the COVID-19. This research provides significant implications for risk management and investment in the biofuel-related markets.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2545018.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了三个国家九种生物燃料相关资产之间的风险溢出效应。利用平稳藤（S-vine）copula模型和分位数格兰杰因果检验，研究了依赖结构和尾部因果关系。提出了修正的条件风险价值（CoVaR）来衡量跨期风险溢出效应，该指标扩展了传统CoVaR以考虑跨期动态。相比之下，传统CoVaR可能高估风险溢出效应。实证结果显示了生物燃料相关资产间的地理集群和潜在风险溢出路径。溢出路径从美国市场经由马来西亚市场传导至中国市场。美国豆油是风险传递者，而中国棕榈油是主要风险接收者。此外，自COVID-19以来，下行风险溢出效应有所增强。本研究为生物燃料相关市场的风险管理和投资提供了重要启示。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2545019.abstract: This paper examines the symmetric and asymmetric effects of oil-price shocks and geopolitical risk (GPR) on the stock-market performance of six Middle Eastern and African economies during the period 2002–2023, utilizing the nonlinear autoregressive distributed lag (NARDL) framework. Our findings underscore the necessity of accounting for country-specific characteristics, as each market demonstrates distinct sensitivities and dynamic responses to these factors. Stock markets in Egypt, Tunisia, and Turkey are significantly influenced by both oil prices and GPR, exhibiting asymmetric long-run effects. The stock markets in Saudi Arabia and Israel respond positively to oil-price changes and display resilience to GPR, while South Africa’s market demonstrates resilience and adaptability to both factors, in the long and short run. We highlight the implications of identifying the distinct sensitivities to major external shocks (geopolitical and oil-price shocks) as a prerequisite for designing financial policies at the country level. These findings offer practical guidance for policymakers to implement country-specific risk management frameworks, enhance market resilience, and tailor regulatory responses to external shocks.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2545019.abstract_zh: 本文利用非线性自回归分布滞后（NARDL）框架，考察了2002年至2023年间石油价格冲击与地缘政治风险（GPR）对六个中东和非洲经济体股市表现的影响，包括对称与非对称效应。研究发现，必须考虑各国特有的特征，因为每个市场对这些因素表现出不同的敏感性和动态响应。埃及、突尼斯和土耳其的股市显著受到石油价格和地缘政治风险的影响，并展现出长期非对称效应。沙特阿拉伯和以色列的股市对石油价格变化呈正向反应，并对地缘政治风险表现出韧性，而南非的股市在长期和短期内均展现出对这两类因素的韧性和适应性。我们强调识别对重大外部冲击（地缘政治和石油价格冲击）的独特敏感性，是制定国家层面金融政策的前提条件。这些发现为政策制定者提供了实践指导，以实施针对国别的风险管理框架，增强市场韧性，并针对外部冲击调整监管应对措施。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2546115.abstract: Amid the growing push for sustainable development, corporate leaders are increasingly called upon to adopt a long-term perspective to mitigate potential external risks. However, whether centralized leadership power benefits a firm’s long-term growth and enhances its ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) performance remains an open question. Drawing on a sample of Shanghai and Shenzhen-listed companies from 2009 to 2022, this study empirically examines the relationship between CEO power and corporate ESG performance. The findings suggest that CEO power significantly promotes ESG performance. Building on a dual-value (firm and individual) and reputational framework, the mechanism analysis indicates that formal power exerts a regulatory effect and informal power provides a guiding effect. Both of them are crucial in explaining how CEO power, by driving digital transformation and stabilizing operations, enhances ESG outcomes. Further analysis indicates that CEO power exerts the strongest influence on the social dimension of ESG, followed by governance and then environment. These core findings also exhibit heterogeneity across different industries. Enhanced information transparency is found to be an effective way for firms to leverage their internal drivers, whereas higher levels of internal control and external audit constraints may conflict with CEO power, thereby weakening its positive impact on ESG performance.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2546115.abstract_zh: 在可持续发展日益受到重视的背景下，企业领导者被寄予厚望，需采取长远视角以规避潜在外部风险。然而，集权式领导力是否有利于企业长期成长并提升其ESG（环境、社会与治理）表现，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。本研究以2009年至2022年沪深上市公司为样本，实证考察了CEO权力与企业ESG表现之间的关系。研究发现，CEO权力显著促进了企业ESG表现。基于双重价值（企业层面与个体层面）及声誉框架的机制分析表明，正式权力发挥调节作用，非正式权力则提供引导作用，两者在解释CEO权力如何通过推动数字化转型和稳定运营来提升ESG成效方面均至关重要。进一步分析显示，CEO权力对ESG中社会维度的促进作用最为显著，其次为治理维度，最后为环境维度。这些核心发现在不同行业间亦表现出异质性。研究还发现，增强信息透明度是企业有效利用内部驱动力的途径，而较高的内部控制水平和外部审计约束则可能与CEO权力产生冲突，从而削弱其对ESG表现的积极影响。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2546119.abstract: This study examines the impact of state ownership reduction on firms’ Environmental, Social, and Governance performance and investigates how regional development influences this relationship. Using panel data from Chinese publicly traded firms between 2012 and 2024, we employ a fixed-effect design combined with robust econometric techniques, including propensity score matching (PSM), Heckman two-stage estimation, and the generalized method of moments (GMM), to address endogeneity concerns. Our empirical results show that reductions in state ownership are significantly associated with a decline in firms’ ESG performance; however, the effect size appears relatively modest, and the findings should be interpreted as robust correlations rather than definitive causal effects. The analysis also suggests that higher levels of regional development help mitigate this negative association by enhancing local institutional conditions. This study contributes important insights for policymakers by highlighting how privatization and subnational development can jointly influence corporate sustainability practices in emerging markets.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2546119.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了国有股权减持对企业环境、社会与治理绩效的影响，并考察了区域发展水平如何调节这一关系。基于2012至2024年中国上市公司的面板数据，我们采用固定效应模型，并结合倾向得分匹配、赫克曼两阶段估计及广义矩估计等稳健计量方法以处理内生性问题。实证结果表明，国有股权减持与企业ESG绩效下降显著相关，但效应规模相对有限，研究结论应被解读为稳健的相关关系而非确凿的因果效应。进一步分析显示，较高的区域发展水平通过改善地方制度环境有助于缓解这种负向关联。本研究为政策制定者提供了重要启示，揭示了私有化进程与地方发展如何共同影响新兴市场企业的可持续发展实践。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547103.abstract: In the context of the rapid growth in earnings and internet penetration in China, this study investigates the impact of internet use on earnings. Using a panel data from China Family Panel Study 2010, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022，this study finds that internet use promotes earnings growth in China. The benefits of internet use are more pronounced for those born after 1970, the high-educated, and the rural residents. Further investigations reveal three underlying mechanisms, including promoting non-agricultural employment, facilitating multiple jobholding and improving social capital.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547103.abstract_zh: 在中国收入与互联网普及率快速增长的背景下，本研究探讨了互联网使用对收入的影响。基于中国家庭追踪调查2010、2014、2016、2018、2020、2022年的面板数据，本研究发现互联网使用促进了中国居民的收入增长。对于1970年后出生群体、高学历人群及农村居民而言，互联网使用的收益更为显著。进一步研究揭示了三种潜在机制：促进非农就业、推动多重职业参与以及提升社会资本。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547105.abstract: This study contributes to understanding the link between the housing market and airport location proximity, whilst examining the entirety of the house price distribution. The research investigates this association across four key urban areas within New Zealand proximal to an international airport – Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, and Queenstown. Applying hedonic and quantile regression, the analysis reveals that proximity to airports on house prices has a heterogeneous pricing effect. Results show that distance comprises a positive pricing effect within Auckland and Christchurch, whereas in Wellington and Queenstown the pricing effect is negative. The quantile regression findings further revealed differences between lower and higher priced properties value, given distance and proximity to airports within each city region. The Christchurch region reveals contrasting findings, showing there to be a higher positive pricing effect for higher-priced housing, which gradually decreases when moving down the quantiles. It is argued that this higher positive pricing for higher priced properties is due to particularities in the housing market close to Christchurch Airport.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547105.abstract_zh: 本研究有助于理解住房市场与机场区位邻近性之间的关系，同时考察了房价分布的完整区间。研究调查了新西兰四个靠近国际机场的主要城市区域——奥克兰、惠灵顿、基督城和皇后镇——中这一关联性。通过应用特征价格模型和分位数回归，分析揭示了机场邻近性对房价存在异质性的定价效应。结果显示，在奥克兰和基督城，距离对房价具有正向定价效应，而在惠灵顿和皇后镇，定价效应则为负向。分位数回归结果进一步揭示了各城市区域内，低价值与高价值房产在距离和机场邻近性方面的差异。基督城地区呈现出对比性发现：高价位住房的正向定价效应更强，且随着分位数下移而逐渐减弱。本文认为，高价位房产更强的正向定价效应源于基督城机场附近住房市场的特殊性。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547107.abstract: This article investigates the impacts of monetary policy, macro- and micro-prudential supervision, and their coordination on mitigating systemic risk in China at both macro and micro levels. At the macro level, we employ the TVP-SV-SVAR model to capture the time-varying impacts of these policies on financial-real sector risk spillover. The results show that expansionary monetary policy and micro-prudential supervision increase the risk spillover, while macro-prudential supervision has the opposite effect. At the micro level, we use bank-level panel data to evaluate the individual and interactive effects of these policies on banks’ systemic risk-taking. The findings reveal that expansionary monetary policy increases banks’ systemic risk through the risk-taking channel, whereas both macro- and micro-prudential supervision reduce banks’ risk-taking. Most notably, the results highlight the significance of policy coordination. Macro-prudential supervision can mitigate the negative effects of expansionary monetary policy, while micro-prudential tools require strategic integration with macro-prudential supervision to reduce macro-level risk spillover.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547107.abstract_zh: 本文从宏观与微观两个层面，考察了货币政策、宏观审慎监管、微观审慎监管及其协调配合对中国系统性风险的缓释效应。在宏观层面，我们采用TVP-SV-SVAR模型捕捉上述政策对金融-实体经济风险溢出的时变影响。结果表明，扩张性货币政策与微观审慎监管加剧了风险溢出，而宏观审慎监管则产生相反效果。在微观层面，我们利用银行层面面板数据评估了这些政策对银行系统性风险承担行为的独立效应与交互效应。研究发现，扩张性货币政策通过风险承担渠道增加了银行的系统性风险，而宏观与微观审慎监管均降低了银行的风险承担。尤为重要的是，研究结果凸显了政策协调的重要性：宏观审慎监管能够缓解扩张性货币政策的负面效应，而微观审慎工具需与宏观审慎监管进行战略整合，方能降低宏观层面的风险溢出。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547109.abstract: Previous climate risk assessments using models such as DICE or IAMs often exhibit instability, which poses challenges for accurate calculations. This paper refines these methodologies to assess the climate risk exposure of Chinese banks, taking into account both physical and transition risks. We empirically examine the impact of climate risk on bank performance and find that most Chinese listed banks are exposed to significant climate risks, with some banks’ exposures surpassing their market value. By comparing banks located in the upper and lower reaches of the Yangtze River, we observe that climate risk exposures typically show distinct geographic patterns. Using a time and individual fixed effects model, we demonstrate that higher climate risk negatively affects bank performance by degrading credit quality and increasing market risk-weighted assets. This impact is especially pronounced for commercial banks with small assets, low equity ratios, low ESG performance or low share capital. Our findings provide valuable insights for improving business strategies in response to climate change.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547109.abstract_zh: 以往使用DICE或IAMs等模型进行的气候风险评估往往表现出不稳定性，这给精确计算带来了挑战。本文改进了这些方法，综合考虑物理风险和转型风险，评估了中国银行的气候风险敞口。我们通过实证检验气候风险对银行绩效的影响，发现大多数中国上市银行面临显著的气候风险，部分银行的风险敞口甚至超过其市值。通过比较长江上下游地区银行的差异，我们观察到气候风险敞口通常呈现明显的地理分布特征。采用时间和个体固定效应模型，我们证明较高的气候风险会通过降低信贷质量和增加市场风险加权资产，对银行绩效产生负面影响。这种影响在资产规模小、权益比率低、ESG表现差或股本规模小的商业银行中尤为显著。我们的研究结果为应对气候变化而改进商业策略提供了有价值的见解。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547110.abstract: Traditional passive fund performance evaluation relies on tracking error metrics, which have a short-term orientation. As such, these metrics may not appropriately quantify the long-term performance of passive funds, which is of particular interest to buy-and-hold investors. This study considers the potential shortcomings of current passive investment evaluation practices by comparing the performance of a sample of United States equity exchange traded funds (ETFs) based on short-run (tracking error) and long-run (cointegration-based) tracking metrics over the period 1 January 2013 to 25 September 2024. The cointegration approach employed accommodates structural breaks. Our findings reveal significant disparities in rankings, highlighting the importance of aligning performance evaluation with investment horizons. We also introduce a novel metric, ‘Overall Tracking Performance’, which integrates both short- and long-run measures. Finally, we demonstrate that top-performing funds maintain consistent tracking performance over successive periods, irrespective of the measure of tracking performance. These results offer meaningful insights for both investors and fund managers seeking a more comprehensive approach to passive fund performance evaluation.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547110.abstract_zh: 传统被动型基金绩效评估依赖跟踪误差指标，这类指标具有短期导向性。对于长期持有型投资者尤为关注的被动型基金长期绩效，这些指标可能无法进行恰当量化。本研究通过对比2013年1月1日至2024年9月25日期间美国股票交易所交易基金（ETF）样本基于短期（跟踪误差）与长期（协整）跟踪指标的绩效表现，探讨当前被动投资评估实践存在的潜在缺陷。所采用的协整方法能够适应结构性突变。研究结果揭示排名存在显著差异，凸显了绩效评估与投资期限相匹配的重要性。我们同时引入"综合跟踪绩效"这一新型指标，该指标整合了短期与长期度量维度。最后证明，无论采用何种跟踪绩效度量方式，表现最优的基金均能在连续期间保持稳定的跟踪绩效。这些发现为寻求更全面被动型基金绩效评估方法的投资者与基金管理人提供了重要启示。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547110.title: Evaluating passive fund performance: short-term versus long-term metrics
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547110.title_zh: 被动基金绩效评估：短期与长期指标的比较

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547111.abstract: We study how the rapid adoption of FinTech payment technology, Zelle, affects crime in the United States. We collect a novel dataset of Zelle’s banking partners using an internet archive tool-the Wayback Machine. Our baseline OLS model shows a higher Zelle penetration is associated with a lower robbery rate and motor vehicle theft rate at the county level. To address the reverse causality issue, we exploit the fact that Zelle was launched by the seven largest U.S. banks in 2017. The difference-in-difference analysis shows that counties with large exposure to the seven largest U.S. banks before 2017 experienced a large decline in the robbery rate and motor vehicle theft rate. The negative effect on the robbery rate was more pronounced in counties with lower education levels and fewer law employees. Our findings shed light on the evolution of the social impact of FinTech adoption.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547111.abstract_zh: 本文研究了金融科技支付技术Zelle的快速普及对美国犯罪率的影响。我们利用互联网存档工具Wayback Machine收集了Zelle银行合作伙伴的新数据集。基准OLS模型显示，Zelle渗透率较高的县，其抢劫率和机动车盗窃率较低。为解决反向因果问题，我们利用Zelle于2017年由美国七大银行联合推出这一事实。双重差分分析表明，在2017年前对七大银行敞口较大的县，抢劫率和机动车盗窃率显著下降。抢劫率的下降效应在教育水平较低及执法人员较少的县更为明显。本研究揭示了金融科技应用社会影响的演变规律。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547113.abstract: Building upon the static analysis conducted via structural equation modelling (SEM), this study employs Belousov-Zhabotinskii reaction model in complex system theory to construct three-dimensional Logistic dynamic equation, simulates the collaborative support pathways between formal finance and informal finance for enterprise innovation under policy incentives. 519 science and technology-based SMEs listed on Growth Enterprise Market in China are taken as samples. The results of simulation reveal that the level of formal financial support and enterprise innovation performance improve with enhancing of policy incentive. The scale and growth rate of formal finance significantly surpass those of informal finance. Formal and informal finance consistently exhibit an incomplete substitution relationship which becomes more pronounced as policy incentives intensify. The regional disparities in the effects of policy stimulation are notable: Eastern and central regions benefit from substantial policy support, where a marked positive relationship exists between corporate innovation and formal financial support. The external policy environment in the western and northeastern regions needs to be optimized, where enterprises innovation remains sluggish. The marginal contribution of this study lies in simulating the nonlinear dynamic evolutionary pathways of financial support for enterprise innovation under different policy incentive intensities, from the perspective of complex system theory. KEYWORDS: Science and technology-based small and medium-sized enterprises financial synergistic support policy incentive complex system theory Belousov-Zhabotinskii reaction model JEL CLASSIFICATION: C15 G30 O17 O38
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547113.abstract_zh: 在结构方程模型（SEM）静态分析的基础上，本研究运用复杂系统理论中的别洛乌索夫-扎博京斯基反应模型，构建三维Logistic动态方程，模拟政策激励下正规金融与非正规金融对企业创新的协同支持路径。以中国创业板上市的519家科技型中小企业为样本。模拟结果显示：正规金融支持水平与企业创新绩效随政策激励增强而提升；正规金融的规模与增长速度显著优于非正规金融；正规金融与非正规金融始终呈现不完全替代关系，且该关系随政策激励强化而更加显著。政策激励效果存在显著区域差异：东部和中部地区受益于强有力的政策支持，企业创新与正规金融支持之间存在显著正向关系；西部和东北地区的外部政策环境有待优化，企业创新仍显滞后。本研究的边际贡献在于：从复杂系统理论视角，模拟不同政策激励强度下金融支持企业创新的非线性动态演化路径。关键词：科技型中小企业；金融协同支持；政策激励；复杂系统理论；别洛乌索夫-扎博京斯基反应模型 JEL分类号：C15 G30 O17 O38

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547115.abstract: This paper investigates the safe haven properties of China’s green stocks under geopolitical risks and oil market volatility. Leveraging an integrated analytical framework – including the Transformer-DCC-GARCH, SVAR, and TVP-VAR models – we examine the dynamic relationships among green stocks, geopolitical risks, and oil prices. The results show that green stocks exhibit a significant negative correlation with oil prices during periods of heightened geopolitical risks, such as the global oil price collapse, COVID-19 pandemic, and Russia-Ukraine conflict, indicating their short-term dynamic safe haven properties. Moreover, green stocks help stabilize oil price fluctuations by promoting energy transition, thereby indirectly mitigating the adverse impact of geopolitical risks and exhibiting long-term structural safe haven properties. These safe haven properties are time-varying and more pronounced during periods of heightened global risk. Further analysis demonstrates that incorporating green stocks into energy investment portfolios through a geopolitical risk-based strategy improves both return and risk-adjusted performance, confirming their practical hedging value. Overall, the findings suggest that while green stocks play a vital role in stabilizing energy markets, their hedging effectiveness is contingent on evolving risk environments. Strengthening regulatory support and expanding green financial instruments are essential to fully realize their safe haven properties.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547115.abstract_zh: 本文探究中国绿色股票在地缘政治风险与石油市场波动下的避险属性。通过整合Transformer-DCC-GARCH、SVAR与TVP-VAR模型构建分析框架，我们考察了绿色股票、地缘政治风险与石油价格之间的动态关系。研究结果表明：在全球油价暴跌、新冠疫情及俄乌冲突等地缘政治风险加剧时期，绿色股票与石油价格呈现显著负相关，表明其具有短期动态避险属性。此外，绿色股票通过推动能源转型有助于稳定油价波动，从而间接缓解地缘政治风险的不利影响，展现出长期结构性避险属性。这些避险属性具有时变性，在全球风险加剧时期更为显著。进一步分析表明，基于地缘政治风险策略将绿色股票纳入能源投资组合，能够同时提升收益与风险调整后绩效，证实了其实际对冲价值。总体而言，研究结果表明绿色股票在稳定能源市场方面发挥重要作用，但其对冲效果取决于风险环境的演变。为充分实现其避险属性，需加强监管支持并拓展绿色金融工具。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547116.abstract: To preserve a competitive edge and protect proprietary information, companies may strategically design their ESG disclosures in line with product market competition (PMC). This study aims to examine how the moderating role of PMC influences the relationship between sustainable practices and ‘firm financial performance’ (FFP). Using regression techniques on a sample of 2801 firms from G-20 countries over a study period covering from 2011 to 2023, findings show that firms’ sustainable practices positively impact FFP. PMC effectively acts as a disciplinary mechanism for firm’s performance and aligns with the deterrence hypothesis. Due to competitive pressure, sustainable practices increase firm performance. Although in all cases, PMC does not portray moderating effect to establish relationship between sustainable practices and firm value, the individual parameters, such as environmental and social practices, are enhancing FFP under high PMC levels. While in low competition, environmental practices detriment FFP due to competitive disadvantages. Further, in developed countries, PMC is ineffective, whereas it effectively works for developing countries. Using alternative competition measures, sensitivity analysis, and propensity score matching, the present study provides robust empirical evidence to validate the moderating role of PMC in shaping ESG-FFP dynamics. Managers may leverage PMC strategically; investors and policymakers ought to keep on surveillance for greenwashing.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547116.abstract_zh: 为保持竞争优势并保护专有信息，企业可能根据产品市场竞争（PMC）策略性地设计其ESG披露。本研究旨在探讨PMC的调节作用如何影响可持续实践与企业财务绩效（FFP）之间的关系。基于2011至2023年间G20国家2801家企业的样本数据，采用回归分析发现：企业可持续实践对FFP具有正向影响。PMC有效发挥企业绩效的惩戒机制作用，与威慑假说一致。在竞争压力下，可持续实践提升了企业绩效。尽管在所有情形中PMC均未表现出调节可持续实践与企业价值关系的效应，但在高PMC水平下，环境与社会实践等单项指标均能提升FFP；而在低竞争环境下，环境实践因竞争劣势反而损害FFP。此外，PMC在发达国家中调节效应不显著，但在发展中国家表现有效。通过采用替代竞争指标、敏感性分析和倾向得分匹配，本研究为PMC在ESG-FFP动态关系中的调节作用提供了稳健的实证证据。管理者可策略性运用PMC；投资者与政策制定者需持续警惕漂绿行为。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547117.abstract: This study explores the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) adoption on the quality of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) disclosures, emphasizing the moderating roles of internal (corporate governance quality) and external (regional institutional development) factors in Chinese firms listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchanges. Drawing on data from the Wind, Bloomberg, and CSMAR databases, as well as firms’ annual reports, the analysis spans 14,945 firm-year observations from 2015 to 2023. Methodologically, the study employs principal component analysis (PCA), fixed effects modelling, one-year lagged regression, and three-stage least squares (3SLS) estimation to ensure robust findings. The results reveal that both governance quality and regional institutional strength significantly enhance the positive effect of AI adoption on ESG disclosure. Firms situated in regions with stronger institutional frameworks and higher governance standards report more transparent and detailed ESG information. Among the sample, companies listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange demonstrate the most substantial improvements. The findings suggest that policymakers should strengthen institutional support and promote AI integration, while corporate leaders should enhance governance practices to maximize AI’s potential in ESG reporting. This research offers new insights into the role of digital transformation in advancing ESG transparency within emerging markets like China. KEYWORDS: Artificial intelligence (AI) ESG disclosure institutional quality corporate governance (CG) regional development China JEL CLASSIFICATION: M14 M41 M40 M15
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547117.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人工智能（AI）应用对环境、社会和治理（ESG）信息披露质量的影响，重点分析了内部因素（公司治理质量）与外部因素（区域制度发展）在中国沪深两市上市公司中的调节作用。基于Wind、彭博、CSMAR数据库及企业年报数据，研究涵盖2015年至2023年间14,945个公司-年度观测值。在方法上，本研究采用主成分分析（PCA）、固定效应模型、滞后一期回归及三阶段最小二乘法（3SLS）估计，以确保结果的稳健性。结果表明，治理质量与区域制度强度均显著增强了AI应用对ESG信息披露的正向效应。位于制度框架更完善、治理标准更高地区的企业，其ESG信息披露更为透明且详尽。在样本中，深圳证券交易所上市公司的改善最为显著。研究建议，政策制定者应强化制度支持并推动AI整合，而企业领导者则应优化治理实践，以最大化AI在ESG报告中的潜力。本研究为理解数字化转型在新兴市场（如中国）中推动ESG透明度提升的作用提供了新见解。关键词：人工智能（AI） ESG信息披露 制度质量 公司治理（CG） 区域发展 中国 JEL分类：M14 M41 M40 M15

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547118.abstract: This study examines the impact of the ‘integration of informatization and industrialization’ (III) pilot policy on corporate ESG (environmental, social, and governance) performance. Utilizing unbalanced panel data from Chinese listed companies spanning 2010–2022, we construct a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) model for empirical analysis. The results demonstrate that the III pilot policy significantly enhances corporate ESG performance, with findings remaining robust across a series of rigorous tests. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the policy’s positive effects are more pronounced in eastern and central China compared with western regions. The policy also consistently improves ESG performance across corporate life cycles – growth, maturity, and decline stages – although the magnitude varies. Notably, heavily polluting and technology-intensive industries exhibit stronger ESG improvements under the policy. Additional mechanism analyses indicate that green technology innovation capabilities, labour productivity levels, and government support collectively form a positive feedback loop in mediating the policy’s impact on ESG outcomes. Our research provides novel policy-level evidence for advancing corporate ESG practices.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547118.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了“两化融合”（III）试点政策对企业ESG（环境、社会和治理）绩效的影响。基于2010—2022年中国上市公司非平衡面板数据，构建多期双重差分（DID）模型进行实证分析。结果表明，III试点政策显著提升了企业ESG绩效，该结论在一系列严格检验中保持稳健。异质性分析显示，相较于西部地区，该政策在东部和中部地区的积极效应更为显著。政策在企业生命周期各阶段（成长期、成熟期和衰退期）均能持续改善ESG绩效，但影响幅度存在差异。值得注意的是，重污染行业和技术密集型行业在政策作用下表现出更强的ESG改善效果。进一步机制分析表明，绿色技术创新能力、劳动生产率水平和政府支持共同构成正向反馈循环，中介了政策对ESG结果的影响。本研究为推进企业ESG实践提供了新的政策层面证据。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2548037.abstract: This study uses a multilevel analysis to examine how banking system stability influences the relationship between bank concentration and borrower discouragement. The analysis uses 26 rounds of the Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises for 11 Eurozone countries between 2010 and 2022. We find that banking system stability reduces or even reverses the negative effect of bank concentration on borrower discouragement for small and medium-sized enterprises. Specifically, increased bank concentration reduces borrower discouragement when banking system stability, measured using the Z-score, is above certain thresholds: 20.6 for term loans and 21.97 for credit lines. These thresholds correspond to the 90th–95th percentiles of banking system stability in the data, meaning that only about 5–10% of firms operate in banking systems sufficiently stable for concentration to reduce discouragement. Micro firms benefit the most from bank concentration in stable banking systems but suffer the most in unstable ones. Additionally, increased bank concentration discourages credit line borrowers more than term loan borrowers in unstable systems, with the opposite effect in stable systems. Overall, maintaining banking system stability is essential for realizing the potential benefits of bank concentration, especially for small firms.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2548037.abstract_zh: 本研究采用多层次分析，探讨银行体系稳定性如何影响银行集中度与借款者受挫感之间的关系。分析基于2010年至2022年间欧元区11国企业融资调查的26轮数据。研究发现，银行体系稳定性能够削弱甚至逆转银行集中度对中小企业借款者受挫感的负面效应。具体而言，当以Z-score衡量的银行体系稳定性超过特定阈值时（定期贷款为20.6，信用额度为21.97），银行集中度的提高会降低借款者受挫感。这些阈值对应数据中银行体系稳定性的第90至第95百分位，意味着仅有约5%至10%的企业处于稳定性足以使集中度缓解受挫感的银行体系中。微型企业在稳定银行体系中从集中度获益最大，但在不稳定体系中受损也最严重。此外，在不稳定体系中，银行集中度提高对信用额度借款者的抑制作用强于定期贷款借款者，而在稳定体系中则呈现相反效应。总体而言，维持银行体系稳定性对于实现银行集中度的潜在效益至关重要，尤其对小型企业而言。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2548409.abstract: Pilot free trade zones (FTZs) constitute crucial reform measures for deepening institutional opening up. However, their microeconomic effects remain debated, and their influence on total factor productivity (TFP) needs further exploration. Using Chinese A-share listed companies as a sample, this study employs a difference-in-differences (DID) model to evaluate the productivity effects of FTZs and to identify the underlying mechanisms. The results indicate that pilot FTZs have a negative effect on enterprise productivity, which is seen primarily in eastern China, private enterprises, and high-tech industries. However, pilot FTZs in first-tier cities can mitigate this negative impact. Regarding the mechanisms, FTZs exacerbate market monopoly power, encourage enterprises to increase their investment scale, and exert a crowding-out effect on innovation. Hence, the mass implementation of institutional opening up via pilot FTZs should not be rushed. Instead, pilot reforms should prioritize developed first-tier cities, and they should balance high levels of openness with innovation-driven growth strategies. These findings offer a foundation for refining FTZ policies and advancing high-quality enterprise development.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2548409.abstract_zh: 自由贸易试验区（FTZs）是深化制度型开放的关键改革举措，但其微观经济效应仍存争议，对全要素生产率（TFP）的影响有待深入探究。本研究以中国A股上市公司为样本，采用双重差分（DID）模型评估自贸试验区的生产率效应，并识别其作用机制。结果表明，自贸试验区对企业生产率存在负向影响，这一效应主要集中于东部地区、民营企业和高科技行业。然而，一线城市的自贸试验区能够缓解这种负面冲击。从机制来看，自贸试验区加剧了市场垄断势力，促使企业扩大投资规模，并对创新产生挤出效应。因此，不宜急于通过自贸试验区大规模推行制度型开放，而应优先在发达的一线城市开展试点改革，并平衡高水平开放与创新驱动增长战略。这些发现为完善自贸试验区政策、推动企业高质量发展提供了依据。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2548413.abstract: Workers Pension Insurance accounts for more than 90% of China’s basic social pension income and expenditure. This scheme is a partially funded design that is pronounced sensitivity to demographic shifts. Persistently low fertility and accelerated population ageing jeopardize the system’s long-term solvency, rendering an actuarial evaluation imperative. Drawing on data from the United Nations’ World Population Prospects 2024 and official Chinese statistical sources, we calibrate an actuarial model to project the system’s sustainability. Our simulations indicate that, absent of a delayed-retirement reform, the pension system is projected to record its first annual cash-flow shortfall in 2033 and to exhaust its cumulative reserves by 2042. Under a phased retirement-age increase, the first cash-flow deficit and reserve depletion are deferred to 2049 and 2058, respectively. By 2100, the system is still expected to accumulate an unfunded deficit of approximately CNY 1715 trillion. Consequently, while the delayed retirement policy may provide temporary relief for pension payment pressures, it fails to resolve the underlying long-term viability of the pension system.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2548413.abstract_zh: 职工养老保险占中国基本社会养老保险收支的90%以上。该制度采用部分积累制设计，对人口结构变化高度敏感。持续的低生育率和加速的人口老龄化正危及该体系的长期偿付能力，因此进行精算评估势在必行。基于联合国《世界人口展望2024》及中国官方统计数据，我们校准了一个精算模型以预测该体系的可持续性。模拟结果显示，若不实施延迟退休改革，养老金体系预计将在2033年首次出现年度现金流缺口，并于2042年耗尽累计储备。若采取渐进式延迟退休年龄方案，首次现金流赤字和储备耗尽将分别推迟至2049年和2058年。到2100年，该体系预计仍将积累约1715万亿元人民币的无资金准备赤字。因此，延迟退休政策虽能暂时缓解养老金支付压力，但无法从根本上解决养老金体系的长期可持续性问题。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2548415.abstract: The corporate labour share reflects the proportion of labour income in the primary distribution of national income. Against the backdrop of a global decline in labour shares, growing attention has been drawn to the impact of social insurance system reforms on labour share in China. Leveraging a quasi-natural experiment from the reform of social insurance contribution collection, this paper employs a difference-in-differences model. It uses panel data on listed firms from 2015 to 2022. The findings indicate that the reform improved the corporate labour share by enhancing compliance and solidifying the contribution base. The effects are more pronounced in firms with weak external oversight, strong internal oversight, small size, and private ownership. Similar patterns are observed in regions with high labour mobility or less generous pension systems. The analysis also reveals evidence of labour substitution among low-skilled workers, particularly in low-end manufacturing. This paper provides valuable policy insights into strengthening the income distribution function and promoting the sustainable development of the social insurance system.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2548415.abstract_zh: 企业劳动收入份额反映了劳动报酬在国民收入初次分配中的占比。在全球劳动收入份额下降的背景下，中国社会保险制度改革对劳动收入份额的影响日益受到关注。本文利用社会保险缴费征收改革的准自然实验，采用双重差分模型，基于2015至2022年上市公司面板数据，研究发现该改革通过提高缴费遵从度和夯实缴费基数，提升了企业劳动收入份额。这一效应在外部监督较弱、内部监督较强、规模较小及民营企业中更为显著；在劳动力流动性高或养老金制度保障水平较低的地区，也呈现出类似模式。分析还揭示了低技能劳动力，尤其是低端制造业中的劳动替代现象。本文为强化收入分配功能、促进社会保险制度可持续发展提供了有价值的政策启示。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2548415.title: The impact of social insurance contribution collection system reform on labour share: evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in China
