The results show that countries with more diverse and unique products (i.e. higher economic complexity) tend to experience higher asset-price stability. This relationship is driven by emerging market economies. Additional tests show that the benefit of lower volatility kicks in after economic complexity breaches a certain threshold, below which the gains are either lower or insignificant. The results are robust in response to concerns about endogeneity and to alternative measures of volatility. Further analysis reveals that trade complexity has a greater influence on stock market stability than technology and research complexities. Finally, with the COVID-19 stock market shock as a backdrop, the analysis shows that emerging markets with higher economic complexity had smaller stock price drops.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2563917.abstract_zh: 本研究利用61个国家的面板数据，检验经济复杂性是否影响股市波动性。结果显示，产品更为多样且独特的国家（即经济复杂性较高）往往经历更高的资产价格稳定性。这一关系主要由新兴市场经济体驱动。进一步测试表明，经济复杂性突破某一阈值后，降低波动性的益处才开始显现，低于该阈值时，收益要么较小，要么不显著。结果在应对内生性问题和波动性替代度量方面保持稳健。深入分析揭示，贸易复杂性对股市稳定性的影响大于技术复杂性和研究复杂性。最后，以COVID-19股市冲击为背景，分析显示经济复杂性较高的新兴市场股市跌幅较小。

10.1080/00036846.2026.2669656.abstract: Using a database comprising US bank balance sheet variables and the list of failed banks as provided by the FDIC, we run various models to compute banks’ default probability in order to assess the impact of capital and liquidity on it. A companion website is available to execute the associated code on a https://github.com/Durand-LeQuang-Vialfont/banksdefaultGithub repository. We provide evidence that 1) capital is a stronger predictor of default than liquidity, 2) Basel III capital requirements should be set at a higher level. Having a look at the impact of the interaction between capital and liquidity on the probability of default, we indeed show that the influence of the former completely outweighs that of the latter. Concerning the impact of capital ratios on the probability of default, we provide evidence that increasing the former allows reducing the latter up to a certain point. More precisely, it seems that when the risk-weighted ratio is around 15% and the simple leverage ratio around 10%, the probability of default reaches it lowest value. These results therefore call for strengthening capital requirements while at the same time releasing the regulatory pressure put on liquidity, especially for small banks.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2669656.abstract_zh: 利用包含美国银行资产负债表变量及FDIC提供的倒闭银行名单的数据库，我们运行多种模型计算银行的违约概率，以评估资本和流动性对其的影响。配套网站可在https://github.com/Durand-LeQuang-Vialfont/banksdefaultGithub 仓库中执行相关代码。我们提供的证据表明：1）资本比流动性更能预测违约，2）巴塞尔III的资本要求应设定在更高水平。通过考察资本与流动性交互作用对违约概率的影响，我们确实发现前者的影响完全超过了后者。关于资本比率对违约概率的影响，我们提供的证据显示，提高前者可以在一定程度上降低后者。更具体地说，当风险加权比率约为15%且简单杠杆比率约为10%时，违约概率达到最低值。因此，这些结果呼吁加强资本要求，同时减轻对流动性的监管压力，尤其是对小型银行而言。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2669656.title: To fail or not to fail? Disentangling capital and liquidity effects on US banks default
10.1080/00036846.2026.2669656.title_zh: 失败还是不失败？资本与流动性对美国银行违约影响的解构

10.1080/00036846.2026.2673230.abstract: While extensive literature has explored the implications of artificial intelligence (AI) and government procurement in driving technological evolution and economic growth, the relationship between AI intensity and government procurement remains underexamined. This paper shifts focus to digital government procurement (DGP) and empirically examines its impact on corporate AI intensity using a sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2015 to 2022 with a two-way fixed effects model. The results demonstrate a significantly positive association between DGP and AI intensity, which holds robust across a series of robustness tests. Further analysis suggests that DGP promotes AI intensity by easing financing constraints, improving managerial capability, and enhancing human capital. The promotion effect of DGP on AI intensity is stronger for private firms, regions with higher institutional quality, and for procurement conducted by non-university government entities. This study broadens the theoretical boundary of the economic outcomes of government procurement and determinants of AI adoption, offering valuable practical implications for designing procurement strategies that effectively foster corporate AI advancement.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2673230.abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量文献探讨了人工智能（AI）与政府采购在推动技术演进和经济增长方面的作用，但AI强度与政府采购之间的关系仍未得到充分研究。本文将焦点转向数字政府采购（DGP），并利用2015年至2022年中国A股上市公司的样本，通过双向固定效应模型实证检验其对企业的AI强度的影响。结果显示，DGP与AI强度之间存在显著的正相关关系，这一结论在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。进一步分析表明，DGP通过缓解融资约束、提升管理能力和增强人力资本来促进AI强度。对于民营企业、制度质量较高的地区以及非大学政府实体进行的采购，DGP对AI强度的促进作用更为显著。本研究拓宽了政府采购经济后果及AI采纳决定因素的理论边界，为设计有效促进企业AI发展的采购策略提供了宝贵的实践启示。

10.1080/00036846.2026.2675507.abstract: This study verifies the role of environmental governance in promoting high-quality economic development (HQED) and establishes a systematic evaluation framework for assessing both urban environmental governance and economic performance. The empirical results demonstrate that stricter environmental regulation significantly enhances the quality of urban economic growth, lending support to Porter’s hypothesis. Effective environmental supervision stimulates the adoption of green production technologies, boosts total factor productivity, and strengthens cities’ capacity to attract skilled human capital, thereby fostering a more sustainable and innovation-driven growth model. Heterogeneity analysis further indicates that this positive effect is broadly consistent across different regions, confirming the feasibility and effectiveness of government-led environmental regulation as a tool for advancing high-quality development. Nonetheless, the marginal impact of such regulation weakens in the later phases of governance, suggesting that once a certain threshold of regulatory intensity is reached, additional tightening yields diminishing returns to economic upgrading.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2675507.abstract_zh: 本研究验证了环境治理在促进经济高质量发展（HQED）中的作用，并构建了一个系统评估框架，用以衡量城市环境治理与经济绩效。实证结果表明，更严格的环境规制显著提升了城市经济增长的质量，支持了波特假说。有效的环境监管激励了绿色生产技术的采纳，提高了全要素生产率，并增强了城市吸引技能型人力资本的能力，从而促进了更具可持续性和创新驱动型的增长模式。异质性分析进一步表明，这一积极效应在不同地区间大体一致，证实了政府主导的环境规制作为推进高质量发展工具的可行性与有效性。然而，此类规制的边际影响在治理后期有所减弱，表明一旦规制强度达到某一阈值，进一步收紧对经济升级的回报将递减。

10.1080/00036846.2026.2679654.abstract: This paper exploits China’s Environmental Protection Tax Reform (CEPTR) as a quasi-natural experiment to examine whether market-based environmental regulation can simultaneously enhance productivity and reduce pollution. Using panel data on A-share listed firms over the period 2012–2024 and a difference-in-differences (DID) framework, we evaluate the reform’s impact on firms’ total factor productivity (TFP) and pollutant emissions. The results reveal a clear ‘double dividend’ effect: CEPTR significantly increases TFP while simultaneously reducing emissions. Mechanism analyses indicate that these effects are primarily driven by three channels: the promotion of green innovation, increased R&D investment and the alleviation of financing constraints. Heterogeneity analysis shows that firms in moderately polluting industries experience the most pronounced improvements in both productivity and emission reduction, suggesting that the reform is particularly effective where regulatory pressure is neither too weak nor excessively stringent. Overall, the findings provide firm-level evidence supporting the Porter Hypothesis in the context of a major developing economy and highlight the role of environmental taxation as an effective policy instrument for achieving coordinated economic and environmental gains.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2679654.abstract_zh: 本文利用中国环境保护税改革（CEPTR）作为准自然实验，考察基于市场的环境规制能否同时提升生产率并减少污染。基于2012—2024年A股上市公司面板数据及双重差分（DID）框架，我们评估了该改革对企业全要素生产率（TFP）和污染物排放的影响。研究结果揭示了明显的“双重红利”效应：CEPTR显著提高了TFP，同时减少了排放。机制分析表明，这些效应主要通过三条渠道实现：促进绿色创新、增加研发投入以及缓解融资约束。异质性分析显示，中度污染行业的企业在生产率提升和减排方面均表现出最显著的改善，这表明改革在监管压力既不过弱也不过强的情境下尤为有效。总体而言，本文的研究发现为波特假说在大型发展中经济体的适用性提供了企业层面的证据，并凸显了环境税作为实现经济与环境协同增效的有效政策工具的作用。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2679654.title: Achieving win–win outcomes in productivity and pollution abatement through environmental tax reform: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2679654.title_zh: 通过环境税改革实现生产率与污染减排的双赢：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2679659.abstract: The Government Green Fund (GGF) has emerged as an important policy instrument for promoting green and low-carbon development and advancing the broader green transformation of the economy and society. Using a sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2010 to 2022, this study manually collects firm-level GGF data and employs a difference-in-differences (DID) approach to evaluate the impact of GGF on enterprise green transformation (EGT). The results indicate that GGF significantly promotes EGT. Further channel analyses suggest that the effect of GGF is consistent with two potential channels: green signalling and the alleviation of financing constraints. Heterogeneity analysis further reveals that the effect of GGF on EGT is more pronounced among firms in non-heavily polluting industries, non-state-owned enterprises, and non-growth-stage firms. Furthermore, GGF has a significantly stronger effect in regions with greater government fundraising capacity, and its positive effect on EGT is statistically more significant in regions with lower government environmental attention. In addition, GGF has a stronger effect in non-key support industries. Accordingly, efforts should be made to improve the incentive compatibility mechanism of GGF investment and to implement differentiated investment strategies to enhance the efficiency of capital allocation.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2679659.abstract_zh: 政府绿色基金（GGF）已成为推动绿色低碳发展、促进经济社会全面绿色转型的重要政策工具。本文以2010—2022年中国A股上市公司为样本，手工收集企业层面GGF数据，采用双重差分法（DID）评估GGF对企业绿色转型（EGT）的影响。结果表明，GGF显著促进了企业绿色转型。进一步渠道分析表明，GGF的作用与绿色信号传递和融资约束缓解两个潜在渠道一致。异质性分析进一步揭示，GGF对非重污染行业企业、非国有企业及非成长期企业的绿色转型效应更为显著。此外，在政府筹资能力更强的地区，GGF的促进作用更为突出；而在政府环境关注度较低的地区，GGF对EGT的正向效应在统计上更为显著。同时，GGF在非重点支持行业中的效应更强。据此，应完善GGF投资的激励相容机制，并实施差异化投资策略以提升资本配置效率。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2679659.title: Government-led green finance and enterprise green transformation: an empirical study of China’s government green fund policy
10.1080/00036846.2026.2679659.title_zh: 政府引导的绿色金融与企业绿色转型：基于中国政府绿色基金政策的实证研究

10.1080/00036846.2026.2682549.abstract: Understanding how financial reporting shapes firms’ innovation strategies is central to research at the intersection of accounting and strategic management. While prior studies examine the informational role of financial reporting, the impact of financial statement comparability (FSC) on innovation choices remains underexplored. Drawing on data from Chinese A-share listed firms, this study explores how FSC shapes firms’ choices between specialization-oriented and diversification-oriented innovation strategies. We find that higher FSC is significantly associated with greater related variety but has no significant effect on specialization or unrelated variety. Heterogeneity analyses show that the effect is stronger in high-tech industries and that FSC facilitates unrelated diversification among state-owned enterprises and firms in the decline stage of the firm life cycle. In the green innovation domain, FSC primarily promotes specialization rather than diversification. Additional tests reveal important boundary conditions: financing constraints weaken, whereas lower market competition strengthens, the positive association between FSC and related variety. Managerial and organizational factors also matter. CEO functional diversity reduces the marginal effect of FSC, whereas dynamic capabilities strengthen it up to a certain threshold. Our study provides new evidence on the role of financial disclosure in shaping firms’ innovation strategies and offers useful insights for practitioners.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2682549.abstract_zh: 理解财务报告如何塑造企业创新战略，是会计与战略管理交叉领域研究的核心。尽管已有研究探讨了财务报告的信息角色，但财务报表可比性（FSC）对创新选择的影响仍未得到充分探索。基于中国A股上市公司的数据，本研究探讨了FSC如何影响企业在专业化导向与多元化导向创新战略之间的选择。我们发现，较高的FSC与更大的相关多样性显著相关，但对专业化或非相关多样性无显著影响。异质性分析显示，这一效应在高科技行业中更为显著，且FSC促进了国有企业及处于企业生命周期衰退期企业的非相关多元化。在绿色创新领域，FSC主要促进专业化而非多元化。附加测试揭示了重要的边界条件：融资约束削弱了FSC与相关多样性之间的正相关关系，而较低的市场竞争则强化了这一关系。管理及组织因素同样重要。CEO职能多样性降低了FSC的边际效应，而动态能力在达到一定阈值前则增强该效应。本研究为财务披露在塑造企业创新战略中的作用提供了新证据，并为实践者提供了有益见解。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2682549.title: Specialization or diversification? The role of financial statement comparability in shaping firm innovation strategy
10.1080/00036846.2026.2682549.title_zh: 专业化还是多元化？财务报表可比性在企业创新战略形成中的作用

10.1080/00036846.2026.2682551.abstract: Smart Manufacturing (SM) has injected new impetus into enterprises’ innovation and is a key measure to enable the manufacturing industry to take the lead in the current industrial transformation. However, the evidence regarding whether SM can promote enterprise innovation remains unclear. Using China’s official SM certification launched by the China National Standardization Administration in 2014 as an exogenous policy shock, this paper adopts a difference-in-differences design to explore the impact of SM on firm innovation based on manufacturing panel data. Results show firms adopting SM achieve remarkably higher innovation performance, lifting patent-based innovation by approximately 6.48% to 11.10%. This impact persisted for several years after the certification, indicating a sustained innovation effect. Subsequent robustness tests also verified these results. Mechanism analysis indicates that SM promotes innovation by reducing operational costs, alleviating financial pressure, and enhancing market competition for firms with sound internal controls, a strong information technology foundation, and high-tech industry status. The effect is also stronger for firms located in regions with more developed digital infrastructure and higher levels of marketization. Overall, our findings provide robust evidence that the government-led SM policy can effectively promote firm innovation and economic development.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2682551.abstract_zh: 智能制造（SM）为企业创新注入了新动力，是当前产业变革中助力制造业抢占先机的重要举措。然而，关于智能制造能否促进企业创新的证据尚不明确。本文以2014年中国国家标准化管理委员会启动的官方智能制造认证作为外生政策冲击，基于制造业面板数据，采用双重差分设计探讨智能制造对企业创新的影响。结果显示，采用智能制造的企业创新绩效显著提升，专利类创新增长约6.48%至11.10%。这一影响在认证后持续数年，表明存在持续的创新效应。后续稳健性检验也验证了这些结果。机制分析表明，智能制造通过降低运营成本、缓解财务压力以及增强市场竞争来促进创新，且这一效应在内部控制健全、信息技术基础雄厚及高科技行业的企业中更为显著。此外，位于数字基础设施更发达、市场化程度更高地区的企业，其效应也更强。总体而言，我们的研究提供了有力证据，表明政府主导的智能制造政策能有效促进企业创新与经济发展。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2682551.title: Smart manufacturing and firm innovation: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2682551.title_zh: 智能制造与企业创新：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2682553.abstract: As the core engine of the new round of technological revolution, the digital economy has made data factors a key driver of high-quality corporate development. This paper takes the establishment of data trading platforms as a quasi-natural experiment, uses data from A-share listed companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen from 2012 to 2022, and adopts a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) model to examine the impact of data trading platform establishment on corporate investment efficiency and its internal mechanism. The research results show that the establishment of data trading platforms significantly reduces corporate investment inefficiency. Mechanism analysis indicates that data factor marketization mitigates corporate investment inefficiency by reducing information asymmetry, optimizing resource allocation efficiency, and promoting corporate digital technology innovation. Heterogeneity tests reveal that the above positive effects are more significant in mature and declining enterprises as well as non-state-owned enterprises, and mainly reduce investment inefficiency by curbing over-investment. From the perspective of investment efficiency, this paper reveals the positive impact of data factor marketization at the micro-enterprise level, providing empirical evidence for improving the construction of data factor marketization.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2682553.abstract_zh: 作为新一轮科技革命的核心引擎，数字经济使数据要素成为企业高质量发展的关键驱动力。本文以数据交易平台的设立作为准自然实验，利用2012—2022年沪深A股上市公司数据，采用多期双重差分（DID）模型，考察数据交易平台设立对企业投资效率的影响及其内在机制。研究结果表明，数据交易平台的设立显著降低了企业投资无效率。机制分析显示，数据要素市场化通过降低信息不对称、优化资源配置效率以及促进企业数字技术创新，进而缓解企业投资无效率。异质性检验发现，上述积极效应在成熟期和衰退期企业以及非国有企业中更为显著，且主要通过抑制过度投资来降低投资无效率。本文从投资效率视角揭示了数据要素市场化在企业微观层面的积极影响，为完善数据要素市场化建设提供了经验证据。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2682553.title: Data factor marketization and corporate investment efficiency—A Quasi-Natural Experiment based on the establishment of data trading platforms
10.1080/00036846.2026.2682553.title_zh: 数据要素市场化与企业投资效率——基于数据交易平台设立的准自然实验

10.1080/00036846.2026.2683052.abstract: Sugar taxes are increasingly debated as a tool to improve public health. Using a discrete choice experiment, we examine how consumer preferences and willingness to pay (WTP) for sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs) respond to three tax presentation formats: a simple price increase, an implicit tax message without the tax amount, and an explicit message that clearly displays the tax. We also assess their implications for health inequality. SSB taxes significantly reduce preferences and WTP, with the strongest effect observed under explicit disclosure. In contrast, non-salient formats have substantially weaker effects on overweight and high-frequency SSB consumers, thereby potentially widening health inequality. An explicit tax display strengthens the policy’s impact on these target consumers and may mitigate the behavioural disparities that could otherwise exacerbate health inequality. These findings provide experimental evidence to inform the design of SSB taxes aimed at reducing sugar intake and narrowing health inequalities.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2683052.abstract_zh: 糖税作为改善公共健康的工具日益受到讨论。通过一项离散选择实验，我们考察了消费者对含糖饮料（SSBs）的偏好及支付意愿（WTP）如何响应三种税收呈现形式：单纯的价格上涨、不含税额的隐性税收信息，以及明确显示税额的显性信息。我们还评估了这些形式对健康不平等的影响。含糖饮料税显著降低了消费者偏好和支付意愿，其中显性披露下的效果最为强烈。相比之下，非显著性形式对超重及高频含糖饮料消费者的影响明显较弱，从而可能加剧健康不平等。显性税收展示增强了政策对这些目标消费者的影响，并可能缓解那些否则会加剧健康不平等的行为差异。这些发现为旨在减少糖摄入和缩小健康不平等的含糖饮料税设计提供了实验证据。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2683052.title: Reducing unhealthy consumption while balancing health inequality: the dual effects of explicit sugar taxes
10.1080/00036846.2026.2683052.title_zh: 降低不健康消费同时平衡健康不平等：显性糖税的双重效应

10.1080/00036846.2026.2683054.abstract: This paper investigates how the interaction between financial structure and market strategy influences the survival and growth trajectories of young firms. We develop a theoretical model grounded in industrial organization showing that debt, through the limited liability mechanism, induces more aggressive market strategies and also increases the risk of failure. The model’s predictions are then tested using longitudinal data from the French SINE survey. While debt alone increases the risk of exit, a non-monotonic relationship exists regarding strategy: the highest proportion of aggressive firms is found among those with medium debt intensity. In this group, entrepreneurial behaviour (proactiveness and competitive aggressiveness) has a positive and significant effect on firm survival and, among surviving firms, increases the probability of belonging to the high-growth category. Entrepreneurial behaviour benefits only materialize when firms operate with a balanced financial structure combining debt and equity. High leverage increases the risk of failure, which cancels out the benefits of an aggressive market strategy. One possible explanation is that firms benefiting from a diversified range of financing sources (debt and equity) face fewer constraints in securing inputs. Improved bargaining power vis-à-vis suppliers may also enable them to better manage uncertainty in production costs.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2683054.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了金融结构与市场策略之间的相互作用如何影响年轻企业的生存与成长轨迹。我们构建了一个基于产业组织理论的理论模型，表明债务通过有限责任机制，促使企业采取更具攻击性的市场策略，同时也增加了失败的风险。随后，我们利用法国SINE调查的纵向数据对模型的预测进行了检验。尽管债务单独增加了退出风险，但在策略方面存在非单调关系：中等债务强度的企业中，采取攻击性策略的比例最高。在这一群体中，企业家行为（主动性和竞争攻击性）对企业生存具有正向且显著的影响，并且在存活企业中，增加了进入高成长类别的概率。企业家行为的益处仅在企业在结合债务与股权的平衡财务结构下运营时才能实现。高杠杆增加了失败风险，这抵消了攻击性市场策略的益处。一个可能的解释是，受益于多样化融资来源（债务与股权）的企业在获取投入品方面面临更少的约束。与供应商相比，更强的议价能力也可能使它们更好地管理生产成本的不确定性。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2683054.title: When finance meets entrepreneurial behaviour: explaining young firms’ survival and growth
10.1080/00036846.2026.2683054.title_zh: 金融与创业行为的交汇：解释年轻企业的生存与增长

10.1080/00036846.2026.2683698.abstract: Competitive balance in Formula One racing has different aspects. The existing literature measures uncertainty of outcome: concentration of wins, podium finishes, and season points among a few drivers or teams. The drama during the race, captured by measures of overtaking, has received attention recently. We propose another measure to capture the closeness of racing: lap-time dispersion, using detailed, lap-level data on each driver. To illustrate this measure, we compare lap-time dispersion in 16 races on the same tracks, under similar weather conditions, in the 2021 and 2022 seasons. Formula One made important rule changes prior to the 2022 season to improve competitive balance, focused on encouraging closer racing. Using quantile regression methods, we show that 2022 lap times decreased for the slowest drivers and increased for faster drivers, thus reducing lap-time dispersion, with the standard deviation of lap times and the Gini coefficient falling by 14.5% and 11.7%, respectively. The Lorenz curve for lap times also shifted significantly upward, indicating closer racing after the rule changes. Other aspects of competitive balance point in the same direction – lower concentration ratios for laps led and podium finishes – but the concentration ratio for wins rose substantially in 2022.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2683698.abstract_zh: 一级方程式赛车中的竞争平衡具有多个方面。现有文献衡量结果的不确定性：少数车手或车队对胜利、领奖台位置及赛季积分的集中程度。比赛中通过超车次数衡量的戏剧性近期受到关注。我们提出另一项衡量赛车接近程度的指标：圈速离散度，利用每位车手的详细单圈数据。为说明此指标，我们比较了2021和2022赛季中，在相同赛道、相似天气条件下16场比赛的圈速离散度。一级方程式赛车在2022赛季前进行了重要规则变更，旨在提升竞争平衡，重点鼓励更接近的赛车。通过分位数回归方法，我们显示2022年最慢车手的圈速下降，而较快车手的圈速上升，从而减少了圈速离散度，圈速标准差和基尼系数分别下降了14.5%和11.7%。圈速的洛伦兹曲线也显著上移，表明规则变更后赛车更加接近。竞争平衡的其他方面也指向同一方向——领先圈数和领奖台位置的集中度降低——但2022年胜利的集中度大幅上升。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2683698.title: Lap-time dispersion as an aspect of within-race competitive balance in Formula One
10.1080/00036846.2026.2683698.title_zh: 单圈时间离散度作为一级方程式赛车内部竞争平衡的一个方面

10.1080/00036846.2026.2684702.abstract: This study investigates how deeply rooted collectivist culture, stemming from historical rice farming practices, shapes individuals’ willingness to pay (WTP) for environmental protection in China. Using data from the China General Social Survey (CGSS), we examine the relationship between the proportion of rice farming in a province – a proxy for collectivism – and stated environmental WTP. Our findings reveal that regions with a higher prevalence of rice farming exhibit a significantly greater environmental WTP, consistent with the hypothesis that collectivism fosters stronger pro-environmental preferences. The effect is strongest among individuals with low intrinsic public spirit, revealing a ‘cultural compensation’ mechanism whereby external norms of shared responsibility substitute for weak internal altruism. It is further amplified in regions facing more severe pollution pressures but weakens in areas with a higher share of migrants from low-collectivism regions, underscoring both the persistence of historical cultural influences. These findings extend the ‘rice theory’ to contemporary environmental behaviour and highlight the enduring role of culture in shaping environmental preferences. For policymakers, this suggests that while collectivist cultural values should be recognized as important contextual factors in environmental policy design, formal environmental policies also play a crucial role in complementing or even substituting the influence of collectivist culture.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2684702.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了源自历史水稻种植实践的根深蒂固的集体主义文化如何塑造中国个体对环境保护的支付意愿（WTP）。利用中国综合社会调查（CGSS）数据，我们考察了省份水稻种植比例——作为集体主义的代理指标——与陈述性环境支付意愿之间的关系。研究发现，水稻种植比例较高的地区表现出显著更高的环境支付意愿，这与集体主义促进更强亲环境偏好的假设相一致。这一效应在内在公共精神较低的个体中最为显著，揭示了一种“文化补偿”机制，即外部共享责任规范替代了薄弱的内在利他主义。该效应在面临更严重污染压力的地区进一步增强，但在来自低集体主义地区移民比例较高的地区则有所减弱，凸显了历史文化影响的持续性。这些发现将“水稻理论”拓展至当代环境行为，并强调了文化在塑造环境偏好中的持久作用。对政策制定者而言，这表明在环境政策设计中，集体主义文化价值观应被视为重要的背景因素，同时正式的环境政策在补充甚至替代集体主义文化影响方面也发挥着关键作用。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2684702.title: From rice to responsibility: collectivism and environmental willingness to pay in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2684702.title_zh: 从大米到责任：中国的集体主义与环境支付意愿

10.1080/00036846.2026.2684775.abstract: Whether artificial intelligence (AI) can enable firms to break free from supply chain path dependence and achieve diversification remains a critical question for reconciling efficiency and security. Using data from Chinese listed firms (2012–2024) and a staggered difference-in-differences model, we find that the AI pilot policy significantly promotes supply chain diversification. Drawing on Transaction Cost Economics and Agency Theory, we show that AI disrupts supply chain lock-in by mitigating internal agency costs, reducing external switching costs, and intensifying market competition. This effect is more pronounced in firms with fewer non-local subsidiaries, a robust internal digital foundation, and those in highly marketized regions. Furthermore, we demonstrate that AI-driven diversification fosters ‘strategic resilience’, it simultaneously boosts total factor productivity and alleviates perceived disruption risks. Our findings offer novel evidence of how digital governance empowers the real economy, underscoring AI’s role in harmonizing supply chain resilience and efficiency.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2684775.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）能否助力企业突破供应链路径依赖、实现多元化，是协调效率与安全的关键问题。基于2012—2024年中国上市公司数据，并采用交错双重差分模型，我们发现AI试点政策显著促进了供应链多元化。借鉴交易成本经济学与代理理论，我们表明AI通过降低内部代理成本、减少外部转换成本以及加剧市场竞争，打破了供应链锁定效应。这一效应在非本地子公司较少、内部数字化基础扎实以及位于高市场化地区的企业中更为显著。此外，我们证明AI驱动的多元化培育了“战略韧性”——它同时提升了全要素生产率并缓解了感知到的中断风险。我们的发现为数字治理赋能实体经济提供了新证据，凸显了AI在协调供应链韧性与效率方面的作用。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2684775.title: Artificial intelligence development and corporate supply chain restructuring: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2684775.title_zh: 人工智能发展与企业供应链重构：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2685219.abstract: This study examines the relationship between institution-level intercollegiate athletic success and the academic quality of incoming freshmen classes at U.S. universities. While much of the economics literature emphasizes single-sport success, we measure athletic performance using Learfield Directors’ Cup points, which capture success across all sports. Econometric specifications are tested in which freshman quality is proxied by SAT scores, ACT scores, and high school GPAs. The empirical results consistently indicate that marginal increases in Learfield Directors’ Cup points are linked to higher standardized test scores and higher high school GPAs.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685219.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了美国大学校级校际体育成就与新生班级学术质量之间的关系。尽管经济学文献多聚焦于单一运动项目的成功，我们则采用Learfield总监杯积分来衡量体育表现，该积分涵盖了所有运动项目的成就。我们测试了多种计量经济学模型，其中新生质量以SAT成绩、ACT成绩及高中GPA作为代理指标。实证结果一致表明，Learfield总监杯积分的边际增加与标准化测试成绩及高中GPA的提高相关联。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685219.title: Everything schools: university athletic performance and the quality of incoming freshmen
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685219.title_zh: 一切皆学校：大学体育表现与新生质量

10.1080/00036846.2026.2685224.abstract: Fiscal transparency is widely regarded as an important component of government governance, yet its implications for firms’ financing conditions remain underexplored, particularly at the micro level. Using a panel of 22,715 firm-year observations of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2013 to 2022, this study examines the effect of local government fiscal transparency on corporate debt financing costs. We employ a two-way fixed effects panel regression framework, combining firm-level financial data from CSMAR and CNRDS with city-level fiscal transparency measures compiled by Tsinghua University. The results show that greater fiscal transparency significantly reduces firms’ cost of debt. Economically, a one – standard deviation increase in fiscal transparency is associated with a decline in borrowing costs of approximately 0.22% points, equivalent to about 3.8% of the sample mean. Mechanism analyses indicate that this effect operates through improvements in both external and internal information environments. The financing cost reduction is more pronounced for firms receiving higher levels of government subsidies or tax incentives. Overall, this study provides novel firm-level evidence that fiscal information disclosure serves as an important macro-institutional determinant of corporate financing outcomes.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685224.abstract_zh: 财政透明度被广泛视为政府治理的重要组成部分，然而其对微观企业融资条件的影响尚未得到充分探讨。本研究利用2013至2022年间中国A股上市公司22,715个公司-年度观测值的面板数据，考察了地方政府财政透明度对企业债务融资成本的影响。我们采用双向固定效应面板回归框架，将来自CSMAR和CNRDS的公司层面财务数据与清华大学编制的城市层面财政透明度指标相结合。研究结果显示，财政透明度的提高显著降低了企业的债务成本。在经济意义上，财政透明度每增加一个标准差，借款成本约下降0.22个百分点，相当于样本均值的3.8%。机制分析表明，这一效应通过改善外部和内部信息环境得以实现。对于获得较高政府补贴或税收优惠的企业，融资成本的降低效应更为显著。总体而言，本研究提供了新颖的企业层面证据，表明财政信息披露是影响企业融资结果的重要宏观制度性因素。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685224.title: The impact of local government fiscal transparency on corporate financing costs: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685224.title_zh: 地方政府财政透明度对企业融资成本的影响：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2685228.abstract: The rise of the gig economy has reshaped workforce structures and challenged traditional Human Resource Management (HRM) models, making it crucial to understand managers’ perspectives on integrating freelancers – an area still underexplored, especially in emerging economies. This study addresses this gap by examining Romanian managers’ perceptions of hiring freelancers, using unique survey data. Drawing on the theoretical foundations of Person-Organization Fit theory and Human Capital theory, following rigorous econometrical analysis, this research shows that managers’ desire to engage freelancers is influenced not only by technical expertise but also by cultural fit, value alignment, knowledge, and willingness to share knowledge within organizational teams. Furthermore, demographic (age, gender) and industry-level differences significantly shape managerial attitudes. These insights contribute to HRM scholarship by advancing theory on managerial decision-making in relation to non-standard work arrangements, with direct practical implications.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685228.abstract_zh: 零工经济的崛起重塑了劳动力结构，并对传统人力资源管理（HRM）模式构成挑战，这使得理解管理者对整合自由职业者的看法变得至关重要——这一领域在新兴经济体中仍探索不足。本研究利用独特的调查数据，通过考察罗马尼亚管理者对雇佣自由职业者的认知来填补这一空白。基于人-组织匹配理论与人力资本理论的理论基础，经过严谨的计量经济学分析，本研究表明，管理者聘用自由职业者的意愿不仅受技术专长影响，还受文化契合度、价值观一致性、知识水平及在组织团队内分享知识的意愿所驱动。此外，人口统计学特征（年龄、性别）及行业层面的差异显著塑造了管理者的态度。这些见解通过推进关于非标准工作安排中管理者决策的理论，为人力资源管理学术研究作出贡献，并具有直接的实际应用意义。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685228.title: Integrating freelance talent in organizations: insights from managers
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685228.title_zh: 整合组织中的自由职业人才：来自管理者的洞见

10.1080/00036846.2026.2685229.abstract: We use the monthly data of geopolitical risk (GPR) and financial markets, including stock, bond, and exchange rate markets in 23 countries between January 2013 and June 2023, and employ a multilayer nonlinear network to accurately capture and analyse the complex, interrelated dynamics between geopolitical risks and financial markets. The results indicate that geopolitical risk events alter the pattern of financial risk connectedness. During periods of geopolitical stress, GPR becomes the primary risk transmitter, displacing the stock market as the dominant source of risk spillovers. Although GPR is normally more closely associated with the stock market, during major geopolitical events its influence shifts towards the bond market with a noticeable lag. Major economies and geopolitical focal countries serve as key risk spillovers, while other emerging economies primarily act as risk recipients.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685229.abstract_zh: 我们利用2013年1月至2023年6月间23个国家的月度地缘政治风险（GPR）与金融市场数据，涵盖股票、债券及汇率市场，并采用多层非线性网络，以精确捕捉并分析地缘政治风险与金融市场之间复杂且相互关联的动态关系。研究结果显示，地缘政治风险事件改变了金融风险关联模式。在地缘政治紧张时期，GPR成为主要风险传递者，取代股票市场成为风险溢出的主导来源。尽管GPR通常与股票市场联系更为紧密，但在重大地缘政治事件期间，其影响转向债券市场，并伴有明显的滞后效应。主要经济体和地缘政治焦点国家作为关键的风险溢出源，而其他新兴经济体则主要扮演风险接收者的角色。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685229.title: Impact of geopolitical risk on global financial market connectedness: evidence from dynamic analysis based on multilayer nonlinear network
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685229.title_zh: 地缘政治风险对全球金融市场关联性的影响：基于多层非线性网络动态分析的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2685877.abstract: This study investigates how science, technology, and finance (STF) policies improve urban green transformation and competitiveness. Utilizing a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) model, we analyse panel data from 285 Chinese cities spanning the period 2006–2022 to assess the effect and underlying mechanisms of STF policies on urban green competitiveness. Results show that the implementation of STF policies significantly enhances urban green competitiveness, with an average improvement ranging from 8.12% to 9.18%. Our analysis of the underlying mechanisms reveals that this improvement is driven by three key factors: increased financial incentives for research and development, a rise in green patent awards, and improved total factor productivity. These findings demonstrate that STF policies enhance urban green competitiveness both directly and indirectly through innovation and productivity gains. In addition, we highlight the heterogeneity of STF policy effects across regions, city sizes, resource endowments, and city clusters. Our study provides new empirical evidence and policy insights to guide regions in harnessing the combined power of science, technology, and finance to achieve green and sustainable urban development.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685877.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了科技金融（STF）政策如何促进城市绿色转型与竞争力提升。利用多期双重差分（DID）模型，我们分析了2006年至2022年间中国285个城市的面板数据，以评估STF政策对城市绿色竞争力的影响及其内在机制。结果显示，STF政策的实施显著增强了城市绿色竞争力，平均提升幅度介于8.12%至9.18%之间。机制分析表明，这一提升主要由三个关键因素驱动：研发财政激励的增加、绿色专利授权的增长以及全要素生产率的提高。这些发现证明，STF政策通过创新与生产率提升，直接及间接地增强了城市绿色竞争力。此外，我们强调了STF政策效应在区域、城市规模、资源禀赋及城市群间的异质性。本研究提供了新的实证证据与政策启示，以指导各地区利用科技、金融的协同力量，实现绿色可持续的城市发展。

10.1080/00036846.2026.2685878.title: Politeness as an economic signal in C2C markets: evidence from Korea and Japan
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685878.title_zh: C2C市场中礼貌作为经济信号：来自韩国和日本的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2685879.abstract: Addressing household energy poverty is essential for improving quality of life and achieving sustainable development, yet limited evidence exists on the role of FinTech in alleviating it at the household level. This study examines the impact of FinTech adoption on household energy poverty using data from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS) and the China Digital Inclusion Financial Index. We find that FinTech adoption significantly reduces energy poverty, with stronger effects observed among households with middle-aged heads, smaller sizes, and higher financial literacy, as well as those located in eastern regions or digitally advanced cities. Mechanism analysis reveals that FinTech alleviates energy poverty by enhancing employment, increasing pension income, optimizing regional industrial structures, enhancing energy efficiency, and narrowing income inequality. These findings provide a new perspective on mitigating household energy poverty through the promotion and effective utilization of FinTech.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685879.abstract_zh: 解决家庭能源贫困对于提升生活质量、实现可持续发展至关重要，然而关于金融科技在家庭层面缓解能源贫困作用的实证证据尚显不足。本研究利用中国健康与养老追踪调查（CHARLS）及中国数字普惠金融指数数据，考察了金融科技采纳对家庭能源贫困的影响。研究发现，金融科技采纳显著降低了能源贫困，且这一效应在户主为中年人、家庭规模较小、金融素养较高以及位于东部地区或数字化程度较高城市的家庭中更为显著。机制分析表明，金融科技通过促进就业、增加养老金收入、优化区域产业结构、提升能源效率及缩小收入差距等途径缓解能源贫困。这些发现为通过推广并有效利用金融科技来缓解家庭能源贫困提供了新的视角。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685879.title: Can FinTech adoption alleviate energy poverty? Evidence from Chinese households*
10.1080/00036846.2026.2685879.title_zh: 金融科技采纳能否缓解能源贫困？基于中国家庭的经验证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2686346.title: The Spritz effect: impact of informal, cultural channels on sparkling wine trade
10.1080/00036846.2026.2686346.title_zh: 斯普利茨效应：非正式文化渠道对起泡酒贸易的影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2686349.abstract: This article investigates how firm-level financial positions shape corporate investment responses to policy-related monetary shocks in China. Guided by a heterogeneous firm framework in which net worth governs financing constraints, we link an event-based monetary shock measure to panel data on Chinese listed firms. We document three main findings. First, monetary transmission varies systematically with within-firm leverage states: following expansionary shocks, firms with leverage above their own historical average experience larger reductions in effective financing costs and stronger increases in investment. This pattern is consistent with an important role for the balance-sheet channel in a bank-dominated financial system. Second, this heterogeneity is asymmetric: it is pronounced during monetary easing but statistically insignificant during tightening episodes. Third, ownership structure matters. The leverage-driven amplification is substantial among non-state-owned firms but muted among state-owned enterprises. Overall, our findings show that balance-sheet conditions and institutional frictions jointly shape the investment transmission of monetary policy in China, with implications for the design of stabilization policy and structural reform.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2686349.abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业层面的财务状况如何塑造中国企业对政策性货币冲击的投资反应。在净财富决定融资约束的异质性企业框架指导下，我们将基于事件的货币冲击度量与我国上市公司面板数据相结合。我们记录了三个主要发现。首先，货币传导随企业内杠杆状态的系统性变化：在扩张性冲击之后，杠杆高于自身历史平均水平的企业，其有效融资成本降幅更大，投资增长更为强劲。这一模式与银行主导金融体系中资产负债表渠道的重要作用相一致。其次，这种异质性具有不对称性：在货币宽松时期显著，而在紧缩阶段统计上不显著。第三，所有权结构具有影响。杠杆驱动的放大效应在非国有企业中显著，而在国有企业中则较为微弱。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，资产负债表状况和制度性摩擦共同塑造了中国货币政策对投资传导的影响，这对稳定政策的设计和结构性改革具有启示意义。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2686349.title: Heterogeneous firms and the investment transmission mechanism of monetary policy
10.1080/00036846.2026.2686349.title_zh: 异质性企业与货币政策的投资传导机制

10.1080/00036846.2026.2686352.abstract: This article examines foreign direct investment (FDI) flows from global investor economies to Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) recipient economies during 2010–2021 against the backdrop of rising global uncertainty, with a particular focus on the role of sovereign credit ratings as financial information intermediaries. The results show that upgrades in both investor-economy and recipient-economy sovereign credit ratings are significantly associated with higher bilateral FDI flows into BRI economies. The heterogeneity analysis reveals that the positive effect of recipient-economy rating improvements on FDI inflows is more pronounced when the investor economy is a BRI economy, a developing economy, or a global tax haven. In contrast, the promoting effect of investor-economy rating improvements on FDI outflows is more evident when the investor economy is a non-BRI economy, a developed economy, or a non-tax-haven economy. Mechanism results provide suggestive evidence that rating upgrades in recipient economies may strengthen FDI ‘pull’ effects by signalling improvements in the investment environment, whereas rating improvements in investor economies may support FDI ‘push’ effects by reflecting stronger outward investment capacity. Overall, the findings underscore the critical role of sovereign credit ratings as financial information intermediaries in cross-border capital allocation.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2686352.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2010—2021年间，在全球不确定性上升的背景下，全球投资者经济体对“一带一路”倡议（BRI）受援经济体的外国直接投资（FDI）流动情况，特别关注主权信用评级作为金融信息中介的作用。研究结果表明，投资者经济体与受援经济体的主权信用评级上调均与流入BRI经济体的双边FDI显著增加相关。异质性分析显示，当投资者经济体为BRI经济体、发展中经济体或全球避税天堂时，受援经济体评级改善对FDI流入的正向效应更为显著。相反，当投资者经济体为非BRI经济体、发达经济体或非避税天堂经济体时，投资者经济体评级改善对FDI流出的促进作用更为明显。机制结果提供了提示性证据，表明受援经济体评级上调可能通过传递投资环境改善的信号来强化FDI的“拉力”效应，而投资者经济体评级改善则可能通过反映更强的对外投资能力来支持FDI的“推力”效应。总体而言，研究结果强调了主权信用评级作为金融信息中介在跨境资本配置中的关键作用。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2686352.title: How does sovereign credit rating affect foreign direct investment? Evidence from Belt and Road economies
10.1080/00036846.2026.2686352.title_zh: 主权信用评级如何影响外国直接投资？来自“一带一路”经济体的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687728.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of blockchain technology on firms’ vertical merger and acquisition (M&A) behaviour, and finds that the probability of firms making vertical M&A decisions increases steadily with the development of blockchain technology application. This impact is achieved by reducing transaction costs, information asymmetry and improving the integration of industrial resources. Furthermore, the establishment of alliance network relationships can provide more industrial information and other resources, complementing the advantages of blockchain technology to facilitate smooth and efficient vertical M&A activities. Specifically, although strategic alliance networks, supply chain networks, and managerial alliance networks all exert distinct effects, the establishment of supply chain networks and managerial alliance networks has a more prominent impact on the relationship between blockchain technology and firms’ vertical M&A decisions. This paper expands the research scope of blockchain applications in the field of capital market behaviour and also provides a basis and practical reference for identifying the influencing factors of firms’ vertical M&A decisions.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687728.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了区块链技术对企业纵向并购行为的影响，发现随着区块链技术应用的发展，企业做出纵向并购决策的概率稳步上升。这一影响通过降低交易成本、减少信息不对称以及提升产业资源整合得以实现。此外，联盟网络关系的建立能够提供更多产业信息及其他资源，与区块链技术的优势互补，促进纵向并购活动的顺畅高效进行。具体而言，尽管战略联盟网络、供应链网络和管理层联盟网络均发挥不同作用，但供应链网络和管理层联盟网络的建立对区块链技术与企业纵向并购决策之间关系的影响更为显著。本文拓展了区块链应用在资本市场行为领域的研究范围，也为识别企业纵向并购决策的影响因素提供了依据和实践参考。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687728.title: Blockchain technology, alliance networks, and corporate vertical M&A: empirical evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687728.title_zh: 区块链技术、联盟网络与企业纵向并购：来自中国的经验证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687731.abstract: This paper investigates the intra-industry spillover effects of new delisting regulations in China, with special attention to the unique role of shell value. We find that the new delisting regulation has an intra-industry spillover effect, which indicates it is effective. After the implementation of new delisting regulations, common institutional investors invest based on firm value rather than shell value. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that these spillovers are most pronounced in the real estate and industrial sectors. Among delisting indicators, ‘net profit after excluding non-recurring gains and losses and revenue’ exhibits the strongest spill-in effect, while ‘closing price’ shows the strongest spill-out effect. These findings provide evidence for the efficacy of delisting regulation in emerging countries and offer insights into the peer effect under delisting pressure.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687731.abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国退市新规的行业内溢出效应，特别关注壳价值的独特作用。研究发现，退市新规具有行业内溢出效应，这表明其是有效的。在退市新规实施后，普通机构投资者基于企业价值而非壳价值进行投资。异质性分析显示，这些溢出效应在房地产和工业部门最为显著。在退市指标中，“扣除非经常性损益后的净利润与营业收入”表现出最强的溢出流入效应，而“收盘价”则显示出最强的溢出流出效应。这些发现为新兴市场国家退市监管的有效性提供了证据，并为退市压力下的同伴效应提供了见解。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687731.title: Delisting regulation and intra-industry spillover effect: from the perspective of common institutional ownership
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687731.title_zh: 退市监管与行业内溢出效应：基于共同机构所有权的视角

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687732.abstract: Strengthening the management of local government debt is crucial for safeguarding national economic and financial security. As a central instrument for regulating government borrowing and preventing local debt risks, whether hardening budget constraints generates spillover effects on firms’ digital transformation remains an open question. From the perspective of China’s ongoing efforts to reinforce fiscal discipline, this study examines the impact and mechanisms of local government budget constraint hardening on corporate digital transformation, using matched data on listed firms and regional debt conditions. Our baseline evidence indicates that tighter budget constraints significantly accelerate firms’ digital upgrading. Mechanism analyses show that the effect operates primarily through the reallocation of financial resources and the improvement of internal corporate governance. Heterogeneity results further demonstrate that the promoting role of fiscal discipline is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises, firms operating in competitive industries, and capital-intensive producers. By uncovering how macro-level fiscal reforms shape micro-level strategic transformation, this paper enriches the literature on the real effects of local government budget constraint hardening and provides new empirical evidence on the institutional foundations of corporate upgrading.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687732.abstract_zh: 加强地方政府债务管理对于维护国家经济和金融安全至关重要。作为规范政府借贷、防范地方债务风险的核心工具，硬化预算约束是否会对企业数字化转型产生溢出效应，仍是一个待解的问题。本文基于中国持续推进财政纪律强化的背景，利用上市公司与区域债务状况的匹配数据，考察了地方政府预算约束硬化对企业数字化转型的影响及其作用机制。基准结果表明，预算约束的收紧显著加速了企业的数字化升级。机制分析显示，这一效应主要通过金融资源的重新配置和内部公司治理的改善发挥作用。异质性结果进一步表明，财政纪律的促进作用在非国有企业、竞争性行业企业以及资本密集型生产者中更为显著。通过揭示宏观财政改革如何塑造微观战略转型，本文丰富了关于地方政府预算约束硬化实际效应的文献，并为企业升级的制度基础提供了新的经验证据。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687732.title: The impact of hardening local government budget constraints on corporate digital transformation: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687732.title_zh: 硬化地方政府预算约束对企业数字化转型的影响：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687733.abstract: According to endogenous growth theory, temporary changes in R&D spending affect the flow of new technologies only temporarily, but their cumulative effect permanently alters the stock of knowledge and thus the level of aggregate productivity. Because R&D is pro-cyclical, business cycles and long-run growth may be connected. If shocks and responses are symmetric, the effects cancel out; if they are asymmetric, business cycle volatility and long-term growth become interdependent. We test for such asymmetries in U.S. aggregate R&D using standard empirical techniques. The main findings are that: (i) R&D spending expansions are 40% longer than contractions, but differences in their rapidity are not statistically significant; (ii) the pro-cyclicality of R&D is stronger when unemployment is particularly low; (iii) the pro-cyclicality of R&D is stronger when financing opportunities are more abundant. Therefore, the results underscore the importance of economic booms for understanding R&D’s pro-cyclicality, especially in periods of tight labor markets and easy credit. Moreover, we point to promising avenues for theory to explain these findings.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687733.abstract_zh: 根据内生增长理论，研发支出的临时变动仅暂时影响新技术流，但其累积效应却永久性地改变知识存量，进而影响总体生产率水平。由于研发活动具有顺周期性，商业周期与长期增长之间可能存在联系。若冲击与响应呈对称性，则效应相互抵消；若呈非对称性，则商业周期波动与长期增长相互依存。我们运用标准实证技术，对美国总体研发活动中的此类非对称性进行了检验。主要发现如下：（i）研发支出扩张期比收缩期长约40%，但两者速度差异在统计上并不显著；（ii）当失业率特别低时，研发的顺周期性更为显著；（iii）当融资机会更为充裕时，研发的顺周期性亦更为突出。因此，研究结果强调了经济繁荣期对于理解研发顺周期性的重要性，尤其是在劳动力市场紧张和信贷条件宽松的时期。此外，我们指出了理论解释这些发现有前景的方向。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687733.title: Business cycles, R&D, and hysteresis: searching for asymmetries
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687733.title_zh: 商业周期、研发与滞后效应：非对称性探究

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687734.abstract: This study investigates whether the gender of the board secretary, the legally mandated disclosure officer in Chinese listed firms, affects stock price informativeness (SPI). Drawing on Upper Echelons Theory, we posit that female board secretaries serve as superior information translators whose distinct communication styles and risk preferences reduce transmission friction between firms and capital markets. Using a comprehensive sample of Chinese A-share firms from 2010 to 2022, we find that firms with female board secretaries exhibit significantly higher SPI. To establish causality, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences design that accounts for heterogeneous treatment timing across firms. The dynamic treatment effects confirm clean pre-treatment trends and a significant positive impact peaking in the first year following male-to-female transitions. A reverse female-to-male transition yields no significant effect, supporting a causal interpretation. We document two channels: female secretaries enhance the quality of analyst communication and strengthen the credibility of internal governance. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the effect is most pronounced when the secretary possesses financial expertise, serves in environments characterized by opacity, intense investor attention, or weak institutional infrastructure, and works in high-tech industries where information complexity and the demands on the disclosure role are greatest.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687734.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨董事会秘书——中国上市公司法定信息披露负责人——的性别是否影响股价信息含量。基于高层梯队理论，我们提出女性董事会秘书作为更优的信息传递者，其独特的沟通风格和风险偏好降低了企业与资本市场之间的信息传递摩擦。利用2010年至2022年中国A股上市公司综合样本，我们发现女性董事会秘书所在公司的股价信息含量显著更高。为确立因果关系，我们采用交错双重差分设计，以处理不同公司间处理时点的异质性。动态处理效应证实了处理前趋势干净，且男性转女性过渡后第一年正向影响最为显著。反向的女性转男性过渡则无显著效应，支持因果解释。我们识别出两条作用渠道：女性秘书提升了分析师沟通质量，并增强了内部治理的可信度。异质性分析表明，当秘书具备财务专长、所处环境信息不透明、投资者关注度高或制度基础设施薄弱，以及在高科技行业——信息复杂性及信息披露角色要求最高——时，该效应最为显著。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687734.title: Female board secretaries and stock price informativeness: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687734.title_zh: 女性董事会秘书与股价信息含量：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687735.abstract: This study investigates how asset-light operation affects corporate innovation performance using data on Chinese listed firms from 2012 to 2023. Employing two-way fixed effects models, we find that asset-light operation significantly enhances innovation performance. Mechanism analysis shows that innovation investment, innovation output, innovation efficiency, and supply chain digitalization (particularly planning, production, sales, and logistics) serve as mediating channels. New digital infrastructure positively moderates this relationship. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the promoting effect is more pronounced in eastern regions, firms with effective internal control, state‑owned enterprises, and high‑tech sectors. The study extends the literature by shifting the focus from cost‑saving financial strategies to agility and resource orchestration, and by incorporating supply chain digitalization and new digital infrastructure as key mechanisms.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687735.abstract_zh: 本研究利用2012至2023年中国上市公司数据，探讨了轻资产运营如何影响企业创新绩效。通过采用双向固定效应模型，我们发现轻资产运营显著提升了创新绩效。机制分析表明，创新投入、创新产出、创新效率及供应链数字化（尤其是规划、生产、销售与物流环节）构成了中介渠道。新型数字基础设施对此关系起到正向调节作用。异质性分析显示，在东部地区、内部控制有效的企业、国有企业及高科技行业中，这种促进作用更为显著。本研究通过将关注点从节约成本的财务策略转向灵活性与资源编排，并将供应链数字化及新型数字基础设施纳入关键机制，拓展了相关文献。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687735.title: A study on asset-light operation and enterprise innovation performance——empirical evidence from listed Chinese enterprises
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687735.title_zh: 轻资产运营与企业创新绩效研究——来自中国上市企业的经验证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687737.title: Energy transition policy and green innovation in manufacturing firms: the dual forces of incentives and constraints
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687737.title_zh: 能源转型政策与制造企业绿色创新：激励与约束的双重力量

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687742.abstract: Climate risk represents a systemic threat to global economic stability, forcing firms to fundamentally adapt. Drawing on risk-management and resource dependence theories, this study investigates how climate risk exposure (CRE) reshapes corporate green transformation (GT) using a panel of Chinese A-share non-financial firms (2016–2024). Our results indicate that elevated CRE acts as a disciplining force, significantly accelerating corporate GT. Mechanism analyses reveal that firms respond to this exposure strategically by advancing green technological innovation and improving environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance. Furthermore, this positive effect is amplified under specific boundary conditions: robust internal digital capabilities, accessible supply chain finance, and active monitoring by institutional investors. Heterogeneity analyses demonstrate that this proactive transition is more pronounced among state-owned enterprises, large corporations, and firms in regions with high public environmental awareness. By quantifying this behavioural response, this study suggests that external climate pressure catalyzes internal sustainable power, providing micro-level evidence for differentiated policy interventions.Footnote11 Abbreviations: green transformation (GT); climate risk exposure (CRE); World Meteorological Organization (WMO); Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC); Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD); Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS); Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG); China Research Data Services Platform (CNRDS); China Stock Market & Accounting Research (CSMAR); Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A); propensity score matching (PSM); two-stage least squares (2SLS); two-stage instrumental variables generalized method of moments (2SIV-GMM); difference-in-differences (DID); state-owned enterprises (SOEs); small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687742.abstract_zh: 气候风险对全球经济稳定构成系统性威胁，迫使企业进行根本性调整。本研究基于风险管理和资源依赖理论，利用2016至2024年中国A股非金融企业面板数据，探讨气候风险暴露（CRE）如何重塑企业绿色转型（GT）。研究结果表明，气候风险暴露的升高作为一种约束力量，显著加速了企业的绿色转型。机制分析显示，企业通过推进绿色技术创新和改善环境、社会及治理（ESG）表现来战略性地应对这种暴露。此外，这一积极效应在特定边界条件下得到增强：强大的内部数字化能力、可获得的供应链金融以及机构投资者的积极监督。异质性分析表明，这种主动转型在国有企业、大型企业以及公众环保意识较高地区的企业中更为显著。通过量化这一行为反应，本研究提出外部气候压力能够催化内部可持续发展动力，为差异化政策干预提供了微观层面的证据。脚注1 缩写：绿色转型（GT）；气候风险暴露（CRE）；世界气象组织（WMO）；政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）；气候相关财务信息披露工作组（TCFD）；央行与监管机构绿色金融网络（NGFS）；环境、社会与治理（ESG）；中国研究数据服务平台（CNRDS）；中国股票市场与会计研究数据库（CSMAR）；管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）；倾向得分匹配（PSM）；两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）；两阶段工具变量广义矩估计（2SIV-GMM）；双重差分法（DID）；国有企业（SOEs）；中小企业（SMEs）。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687742.title: Turning pressure into power: climate risk exposure and corporate green transformation
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687742.title_zh: 化压力为动力：气候风险暴露与企业绿色转型

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687743.abstract: This study uses hand-collected data to investigate the impact of state-level political uncertainty and corruption on corporate investment in India. We use a panel of 1,666 firms with 16,869 firm-year observations from 2001 to 2022. We find that the interaction between political uncertainty and corruption negatively affects firm-level investments, and that firms close to political power face greater political uncertainty. These findings are consistent across multiple robustness checks. We further validate the results by employing a Difference-in-Differences (DID) framework and using the 2018 Prevention of Corruption (Amendment) Act as a quasi-natural experiment to check investment patterns. The strong anti-corruption measures helped alleviate the negative impact of political uncertainty and corruption. Overall, the study highlights the adverse effect of state-level political uncertainty and corruption on firm-level investments.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687743.abstract_zh: 本研究利用手工收集的数据，考察了印度邦级政治不确定性与腐败对企业投资的影响。我们采用了一个包含2001年至2022年间1,666家企业、共16,869个企业-年度观测值的面板数据。研究发现，政治不确定性与腐败之间的交互作用对企业层面投资产生负面影响，且靠近政治权力的企业面临更高的政治不确定性。这些发现在多项稳健性检验中保持一致。我们进一步通过采用双重差分（DID）框架，并利用2018年《反腐败（修正）法案》作为准自然实验来验证投资模式，从而确认了上述结果。强有力的反腐败措施有助于缓解政治不确定性和腐败的负面影响。总体而言，本研究强调了邦级政治不确定性与腐败对企业层面投资的不利影响。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687743.title: Political uncertainty, corruption, and corporate investment: evidence from India
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687743.title_zh: 政治不确定性、腐败与企业投资：来自印度的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687744.abstract: This study employs a time-varying parameter vector autoregressive (TVP-VAR) model to extend the joint connectivity model and investigate the correlation between artificial intelligence (AI) tokens and the energy market. The analysis covers the period from 1 November 2019, to 20 May 2024, and includes eight mainstream AI tokens (such as Cortex, Fetch.ai, and SingularityNET) as well as energy assets including oil, natural gas, and biofuels. The findings reveal a significant correlation between AI tokens and energy assets, with the strength of this correlation exhibiting asymmetric characteristics. This study provides key insights for investors and policymakers to gain a deeper understanding of the evolving interplay between AI-driven digital assets and the energy sector.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687744.abstract_zh: 本研究采用时变参数向量自回归（TVP-VAR）模型，扩展联合连通性模型，以探讨人工智能（AI）代币与能源市场之间的关联性。分析覆盖自2019年11月1日至2024年5月20日期间，纳入八种主流AI代币（如Cortex、Fetch.ai和SingularityNET）以及包括石油、天然气和生物燃料在内的能源资产。研究结果显示，AI代币与能源资产之间存在显著相关性，且这种相关性的强度表现出非对称特征。本研究为投资者和政策制定者提供了关键见解，以更深入地理解AI驱动的数字资产与能源部门之间不断演变的相互作用。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687744.title: How artificial intelligence tokens interact with the energy sector: a novel perspective
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687744.title_zh: 人工智能代币与能源行业的互动：一个新视角

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687745.abstract: This paper empirically studies the impact of digital transformation on manufacturing profitability based on the panel data of Chinese A-share listed manufacturing enterprises from 2015 to 2024. The results show that the digital transformation can significantly improve the comprehensive profitability of the manufacturing enterprises. The main transmission channels are through revenue enhancement and cost reduction. In the expansion test, the effect of the improvement of profitability brought about by digital transformation is more obvious in non-state-owned enterprises and non-high-pollution industries, and the effect remains robust after solving the endogeneity problem. The conclusions fill the void of multidimensional measurement of profitability in existing research, and also provide experience for enterprises to optimize digital transformation strategies, and for policymakers to formulate targeted industrial policies.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687745.abstract_zh: 本文基于2015至2024年中国A股制造业上市企业的面板数据，实证研究了数字化转型对制造业盈利能力的影响。结果表明，数字化转型能显著提升制造业企业的综合盈利能力，其主要传导渠道在于增收与降本。在扩展性检验中，数字化转型带来的盈利能力提升效应在非国有企业及非高污染行业中更为明显，且在解决内生性问题后，该效应依然稳健。本文的结论填补了现有研究中对盈利能力多维测量的空白，同时也为企业优化数字化转型策略、政策制定者制定针对性产业政策提供了经验参考。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687745.title: Digital transformation and the profitability of manufacturing: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687745.title_zh: 数字化转型与制造业盈利能力：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687747.abstract: Previous studies have shown that aggregate shocks shape households’ financial conditions and influence their investment behaviour. However, literature provides mixed evidence on the persistence of household investment behaviour in the aftermath of such shocks. This study utilizes a large panel household dataset from India to analyse the investment choices of households in the aftermath of a nationwide pandemic. Our findings indicate that households that experienced adverse impacts on their financial conditions during the crisis have a 2.2% points higher likelihood of investing in relatively safe assets compared to other households. Importantly, a similar preference for safer assets persists in the post-crisis period for such households. This persistence is primarily driven by households whose financial conditions did not improve in the post-crisis period. We also find that financially-strained households’ preference for safer assets is lower in regions that are better banked. Our baseline results are robust to alternate definitions of safe and risky assets, crisis intensity, financially-strained households, potential selection bias, and placebo tests. Our findings suggest that alleviating financial strain and enhancing access to banking services can mitigate risk-averse behaviour both during a crisis and in the subsequent period.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687747.abstract_zh: 已有研究表明，总体冲击会塑造家庭的财务状况并影响其投资行为。然而，关于此类冲击后家庭投资行为持续性的文献证据并不一致。本研究利用印度大规模家庭面板数据，分析全国性疫情后家庭的投资选择。研究结果显示，在危机期间财务状况受到不利影响的家庭，相较于其他家庭，投资相对安全资产的可能性高出2.2个百分点。重要的是，此类家庭在危机后时期仍持续表现出对安全资产的类似偏好。这种持续性主要由危机后财务状况未改善的家庭驱动。我们还发现，在银行服务更完善的地区，财务紧张家庭对安全资产的偏好较低。我们的基准结果在安全与风险资产的不同定义、危机强度、财务紧张家庭界定、潜在选择偏差及安慰剂检验中均保持稳健。研究结论表明，缓解财务压力并增强银行服务可及性，有助于在危机期间及后续时期降低风险规避行为。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687747.title: Financial asset choices in the aftermath of a crisis: evidence from India
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687747.title_zh: 危机后的金融资产选择：来自印度的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687748.abstract: In the context of the burgeoning digital economy, data assets have emerged as a vital determinant of strategic advantage, offering substantial potential to fortify supply chain resilience (SCR). Utilizing a dataset comprising Chinese listed companies spanning the period from 2007 through 2024, this study empirically investigates the relationship between data assets and SCR. The findings provide robust evidence that the data assets exert a statistically significant positive influence on SCR. Mechanism analysis indicates that this ameliorative effect is principally channelled through three distinct pathways: information transparency, corporate reputation, and production efficiency. Furthermore, market power has amplified the beneficial impact of data assets on SCR. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the observed positive effects are notably more potent within non-SOEs, firms with high digitalization levels, and firms facing low financing constraints. Analysis of spillover effects reveals that focal firms’ data assets significantly improve SCR among upstream suppliers but have no significant impact on downstream customers.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687748.abstract_zh: 在数字经济蓬勃发展的背景下，数据资产已成为决定战略优势的关键因素，为增强供应链韧性（SCR）提供了巨大潜力。本研究利用2007年至2024年间中国上市公司的数据集，实证考察了数据资产与供应链韧性之间的关系。研究结果提供了有力证据，表明数据资产对供应链韧性具有统计上显著的正向影响。机制分析显示，这一改善效应主要通过三条不同路径实现：信息透明度、企业声誉和生产效率。此外，市场力量放大了数据资产对供应链韧性的有益影响。异质性分析揭示，上述正向效应在非国有企业、数字化水平较高的企业以及融资约束较低的企业中尤为显著。溢出效应分析表明，焦点企业的数据资产显著提升了上游供应商的供应链韧性，但对下游客户未产生显著影响。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687748.title: The digital shock absorber: can data assets influence supply chain resilience?
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687748.title_zh: 数字减震器：数据资产能否影响供应链韧性？

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687749.abstract: Marketing channel choice plays a crucial role in shaping small-scale grain farmers’ production decisions and sales outcomes, yet empirical evidence remains limited. This study categorizes grain farmers’ marketing channel choices into farmgate (door-to-door), non-farmgate informal, and non-farmgate formal channels. We examine the effects of marketing channel choice on fertilizer expenditure, pesticide expenditure, production costs, and sales frequency. Using a multivalued treatment effects (MVTE) framework with the inverse probability weighted regression adjustment (IPWRA) estimator, we address selection bias and estimate open-access data from the 2020 China Rural Revitalization Survey. Results show that, compared with selling through the farmgate channel, selling through the non-farmgate informal channel is associated with higher sales frequency. Compared with both farmgate and non-farmgate informal channels, selling through the non-farmgate formal channel is associated with lower fertilizer and pesticide expenditures, production costs, and sale frequency. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that these associations are more pronounced among small farms and vary with distance to town. This study offers practical implications for designing market-oriented interventions to strengthen smallholder farmers’ access to formal, organized marketing channels.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687749.abstract_zh: 营销渠道选择在塑造小规模粮农的生产决策与销售成果中扮演关键角色，然而相关实证证据仍显不足。本研究将粮农的营销渠道选择划分为田间地头（上门收购）、非田间地头非正式渠道及非田间地头正式渠道三类。我们考察了营销渠道选择对化肥支出、农药支出、生产成本及销售频率的影响。采用多值处理效应（MVTE）框架，结合逆概率加权回归调整（IPWRA）估计量，我们处理了选择偏差，并基于2020年中国乡村振兴调查的公开数据进行了估算。结果显示，与通过田间地头渠道销售相比，通过非田间地头非正式渠道销售与更高的销售频率相关联。与田间地头及非田间地头非正式渠道相比，通过非田间地头正式渠道销售则与较低的化肥和农药支出、生产成本及销售频率相关联。异质性分析进一步表明，这些关联在小规模农场中更为显著，并随距城镇距离的变化而有所不同。本研究为设计以市场为导向的干预措施，以增强小农户获取正式、有组织营销渠道的能力提供了实践启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687749.title: Grain farmers’ marketing channel choice and its economic implications: evidence on chemical input use, production costs, and sales behaviour
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687749.title_zh: 谷物农户的市场渠道选择及其经济影响：基于化学投入品使用、生产成本与销售行为的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687750.abstract: Rural commercial banks (RCBs) are key financial service providers in rural China, and enhancing their financial resilience is critical for overall financial stability. Using 2013–2023 panel data, this paper constructs a financial resilience measure for RCBs and employs a fixed-effects model to examine the impact of digital transformation on their resilience. Results show that digital transformation significantly improves RCBs’ financial resilience, especially in economically developed regions, areas with unstable climate policies, and those with weaker financial competition. Mechanism analysis reveals that digital transformation strengthens resilience by improving deposit stability, while unstable monetary policies, stringent regulation, and high loan concentration weaken it. Therefore, future efforts should promote RCBs’ digital transformation, foster a stable macroeconomic policy environment, implement differentiated regulation aligned with digitalization, and integrate digital technologies into risk management. Optimizing asset structures will solidify RCBs’ financial resilience and support sustainable agricultural development.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687750.abstract_zh: 农村商业银行（RCBs）是中国农村地区关键的金融服务提供者，增强其金融韧性对于整体金融稳定至关重要。利用2013至2023年的面板数据，本文构建了农村商业银行的金融韧性度量指标，并采用固定效应模型考察数字化转型对其韧性的影响。结果显示，数字化转型显著提升了农村商业银行的金融韧性，尤其是在经济发达地区、气候政策不稳定区域以及金融竞争较弱的地区。机制分析揭示，数字化转型通过提高存款稳定性来增强韧性，而不稳定的货币政策、严格的监管以及高贷款集中度则会削弱这一效应。因此，未来应推动农村商业银行的数字化转型，营造稳定的宏观经济政策环境，实施与数字化相适应的差异化监管，并将数字技术融入风险管理之中。优化资产结构将巩固农村商业银行的金融韧性，支持农业可持续发展。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687750.title: Digital transformation and financial resilience of rural commercial banks: an empirical analysis based on panel data from 2013 to 2023
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687750.title_zh: 数字化转型与农村商业银行财务韧性：基于2013-2023年面板数据的实证分析

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687751.abstract: This study examines how the expansion of public childcare is associated with the exit dynamics of existing childcare facilities in South Korea. Using comprehensive facility-level data covering all operating and closed childcare centres, we estimate fixed-effects models with lagged entry variables. Newly established public childcare centres are associated with a significant increase in exits among non-public facilities, whereas public facilities are largely unaffected by new public entry. We interpret this pattern as evidence that public expansion restructures local childcare markets. This market adjustment is not necessarily welfare-reducing: public expansion may improve affordability, accessibility, and service quality even as it changes the provider mix. Our findings therefore suggest that evaluations of public childcare expansion should consider both the benefits of public provision and the ownership-specific adjustment pressures that arise in local childcare markets.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687751.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了韩国公共托育服务的扩展与现有托育设施退出动态之间的关联。利用涵盖所有运营中及已关闭托育中心的全面设施层面数据，我们估计了包含滞后进入变量的固定效应模型。新设立的公共托育中心与非公共设施退出率显著增加相关，而公共设施则基本不受新公共进入的影响。我们将这一模式解读为公共扩展重塑了地方托育市场的证据。这种市场调整未必会降低福利：公共扩展可能改善可负担性、可及性和服务质量，即便它改变了提供者结构。因此，我们的研究结果表明，对公共托育扩展的评估应同时考虑公共供给的益处以及地方托育市场中因所有权特定调整压力而产生的影响。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687751.title: The unintended exit: public childcare expansion and the crowding-out of non-public facilities in South Korea
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687751.title_zh: 非预期退出：韩国公共托育扩张对非公立设施的挤出效应

10.1080/00036846.2026.2687754.abstract: This study evaluates the causal effect of public data openness on urban total factor productivity (TFP) and explores its mechanisms through government governance and transaction costs. Using panel data of Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2000 to 2023, we treat the launch of government data open platforms as a quasi-natural experiment and employ a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) approach. TFP is measured via the two-step Solow residual method, with robustness verified by instrumental variable estimation, PSM-DID, placebo tests, and green TFP. Baseline regressions show that public data openness significantly enhances urban TFP. Mechanism analysis reveals that improved government governance and reduced transaction costs are the primary drivers. Heterogeneity analysis indicates stronger policy effects in non-Yangtze River Economic Belt regions and areas with lower financial development, exhibiting a ‘timely assistance’ characteristic. This study provides city-level causal evidence, identifies concrete transmission channels, expands research on data factor economic value, and offers empirical support for differentiated data openness policies and inclusive growth.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687754.abstract_zh: 本研究评估了公共数据开放对城市全要素生产率（TFP）的因果效应，并探讨其通过政府治理与交易成本的作用机制。利用2000至2023年中国地级市面板数据，我们将政府数据开放平台的上线视为准自然实验，采用多期双重差分（DID）方法进行分析。TFP通过两步索洛残差法测算，并通过工具变量估计、PSM-DID、安慰剂检验及绿色TFP进行稳健性验证。基准回归结果显示，公共数据开放显著提升了城市全要素生产率。机制分析表明，政府治理改善与交易成本降低是主要驱动因素。异质性分析显示，在非长江经济带区域及金融发展水平较低地区，政策效应更为显著，呈现出“雪中送炭”的特征。本研究提供了城市层面的因果证据，识别了具体传导渠道，拓展了数据要素经济价值的研究，并为差异化数据开放政策及包容性增长提供了实证支持。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687754.title: How does public data openness enhance urban total factor productivity? A perspective from government governance and transaction costs
10.1080/00036846.2026.2687754.title_zh: 公共数据开放如何提升城市全要素生产率？——基于政府治理与交易成本的视角

10.1080/00036846.2026.2688437.title: Predicting sovereign bonds credit ratings: new evidence from new strategies in machine learning models
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688437.title_zh: 主权债券信用评级预测：机器学习模型新策略的新证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2688438.abstract: This article investigates how climate shocks affect firms’ environmental disclosure decisions. Using a large panel of A-share listed firms, we combine firm-level disclosure data with regional measures of climate shocks. We estimate the effects using a two-way fixed-effects framework, complemented by a quasi-natural experiment based on the 2021 Henan extreme rainfall event. We find that climate shocks lead firms to significantly increase the level of environmental disclosure, and this result is robust to a range of alternative checks. Mechanism analyses suggest that climate shocks intensify external stakeholder pressure and enhance firms’ internal environmental awareness, thereby encouraging greater disclosure. The disclosure response is more pronounced among manufacturing firms, heavily polluting firms, high-carbon emitters, and non-state-owned enterprises, and is concentrated in dimensions subject to heightened regulatory attention. We further show that increases in environmental disclosure are associated with improvements in firms’ green governance performance and positive spillover effects on upstream suppliers. This study provides new evidence on firm responses to exogenous shocks through information disclosure under increasing climate uncertainty.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688438.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了气候冲击如何影响企业的环境信息披露决策。利用A股上市公司的庞大面板数据，我们将企业层面的披露数据与区域气候冲击指标相结合，采用双向固定效应模型进行估计，并辅以基于2021年河南极端降雨事件的准自然实验。研究发现，气候冲击促使企业显著提升环境信息披露水平，且该结果在一系列稳健性检验中保持一致。机制分析表明，气候冲击增强了外部利益相关者的压力，并提升了企业内部的环境意识，从而推动更充分的信息披露。这一披露响应在制造业企业、重污染企业、高碳排放企业及非国有企业中更为显著，并集中于受监管关注度较高的维度。我们进一步证明，环境信息披露的增加与企业绿色治理绩效的改善相关，并对上游供应商产生正向溢出效应。本研究为日益加剧的气候不确定性下企业通过信息披露应对外生冲击提供了新的证据。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688438.title: Climate shocks and environmental disclosure by firms: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688438.title_zh: 气候冲击与企业环境信息披露：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2688439.abstract: Despite growing concerns about technological unemployment, existing evidence remains fragmented, country-specific, and largely silent on whether productivity growth driven by artificial intelligence (AI) can decouple from human labour globally. This paper provides new global evidence on AI-labour substitution using an unbalanced panel of 65 countries over 2013–2023. Building on a task-based theoretical framework, we conceptualize AI as a potentially labour-replacing technology that reallocates economic tasks from humans to machines. We test this framework empirically using AI development, combined with cross-country data on labour force participation, productivity, human capital, and institutional characteristics. The results reveal three main findings. First, AI development is associated with a statistically significant decrease in labour force participation, indicating the presence of labour displacement effects. Second, AI simultaneously raises productivity, pointing to productivity-labour decoupling, whereby output growth becomes less dependent on human labour. Third, human capital and governance quality play crucial moderating roles in weakening labour-displacing effects of AI. Remarkably, dynamic panel estimates suggest that AI induces short-run labour displacement, while long-run outcomes depend on countries’ capacity to adapt through education and institutional quality.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688439.abstract_zh: 尽管对技术性失业的担忧日益加剧，现有证据仍显零散、局限于特定国家，且在很大程度上未能阐明由人工智能（AI）驱动的生产率增长能否在全球范围内与人类劳动脱钩。本文利用2013至2023年间65个国家的非平衡面板数据，为AI与劳动替代提供了新的全球证据。基于任务型理论框架，我们将AI概念化为一种可能替代劳动力的技术，它将经济任务从人类重新分配至机器。我们通过AI发展指标，结合各国劳动力参与率、生产率、人力资本及制度特征等跨国数据，对该框架进行了实证检验。结果揭示了三个主要发现。首先，AI发展与劳动力参与率的统计显著下降相关联，表明存在劳动替代效应。其次，AI同时提升了生产率，指向生产率与劳动的脱钩，即产出增长对人类劳动的依赖减弱。第三，人力资本和治理质量在削弱AI的劳动替代效应中发挥着关键调节作用。值得注意的是，动态面板估计表明，AI在短期内引发劳动替代，而长期结果则取决于各国通过教育和制度质量进行适应的能力。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688439.title: Can artificial intelligence replace human labour? Global evidence from 65 countries
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688439.title_zh: 人工智能能否取代人类劳动？来自65个国家的全球证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2688890.abstract: This article examines how nationality-based employment quotas affect wages using player-level data from the Canadian Football League (CFL), where teams are required to field a minimum number of Canadian players. Using salary data from 2021 to 2025, I find that Canadian players earn approximately 9–11% more than comparable American players on average. Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition shows that although American players possess stronger observable performance characteristics, Canadian players receive higher returns to these characteristics. I further validate these findings by showing that Canadian all-stars receive a premium relative to their American counterparts, especially in positions with a lower supply of domestic labour. These findings contribute to the literature on labour market regulation by illustrating how binding employment quotas shape wage determination in highly specialized and skilled labour markets. The results inform policy debates about employment protections, visa restrictions and local hiring requirements.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688890.abstract_zh: 本文利用加拿大橄榄球联盟（CFL）的球员层面数据，考察基于国籍的就业配额如何影响工资水平，该联盟要求各队必须安排最低数量的加拿大球员上场。基于2021年至2025年的薪资数据，我发现加拿大球员平均比可比美国球员多赚约9%至11%。Oaxaca–Blinder分解显示，尽管美国球员在可观测的表现特征上更为突出，但加拿大球员在这些特征上获得了更高的回报。我进一步验证了这些发现，表明加拿大全明星球员相对于其美国同行享有溢价，尤其是在本土劳动力供给较低的职位上。这些发现为劳动力市场规制文献做出了贡献，阐明了具有约束力的就业配额如何在高度专业化和技能密集型的劳动力市场中塑造工资决定机制。研究结果对关于就业保护、签证限制及本地雇佣要求的政策辩论具有参考意义。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688890.title: Nationality quotas and wages in professional sports: evidence from the Canadian Football League
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688890.title_zh: 国籍配额与职业体育薪资：来自加拿大橄榄球联盟的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2688895.abstract: The low-altitude economy, as an emerging economic form integrating aviation technology, digital technologies, and traditional industries, has in recent years been recognized as a new engine driving economic transformation and upgrading. Drawing on endogenous growth theory and the analytical framework of emerging productivity, this study examines the impact of the low-altitude economy (LAE) city pilot policy on enterprise total factor productivity (TFP). Utilizing panel data from Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share listed companies between 2016 and 2023, we examine the underlying mechanisms using a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) approach. The results demonstrate that low-altitude economy city pilot policy significantly enhances enterprise TFP. The low-altitude economy city pilot policy can optimize capital allocation, enhance supply chain collaboration, and advance technological progress, and thereby contribute to improving enterprise TFP. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the TFP-enhancing is more pronounced for technology-intensive and manufacturing enterprises, as well as for firms located in regions characterized by stronger intellectual property protection. This study provides empirical evidence on the micro-level mechanisms of new-type productivity from the perspective of the low-altitude economy and offers policy insights for developing economies.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688895.abstract_zh: 低空经济作为融合航空技术、数字技术与传统产业的新兴经济形态，近年来被视为推动经济转型升级的新引擎。本研究基于内生增长理论与新质生产力的分析框架，探讨低空经济城市试点政策对企业全要素生产率的影响。利用2016至2023年间上海和深圳A股上市公司的面板数据，我们采用交错双重差分法考察其内在机制。结果表明，低空经济城市试点政策显著提升了企业全要素生产率。低空经济城市试点政策能够优化资本配置、增强供应链协同并促进技术进步，从而有助于提高企业全要素生产率。异质性分析显示，对于技术密集型企业和制造业企业，以及位于知识产权保护较强地区的企业，全要素生产率的提升效应更为显著。本研究从低空经济视角提供了新质生产力微观机制的经验证据，并为发展中经济体提供了政策启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688895.title: The impact of low-altitude economy city pilot policy on enterprise total factor productivity: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688895.title_zh: 低空经济城市试点政策对企业全要素生产率的影响：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2688896.abstract: This study investigates the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) applications on the overseas investment efficiency of Chinese multinational enterprises using firm-level data from 2008 to 2023. The results show that AI can significantly improve investment efficiency. Mechanism analysis indicates that AI plays roles by mitigating managerial myopia and enhancing dynamic capabilities. Heterogeneity analyses indicate that the positive effects of AI are more pronounced in host countries characterized by high economic policy uncertainty and greater institutional distance. Concurrently, the enabling effects of AI vary depending on firms’ organizational learning capabilities and political connectedness. These findings underscore the transformative potential of AI in refining multinational enterprises’ investment strategies, strengthening global competitiveness, and facilitating adaptation to diverse institutional and economic contexts, thereby providing actionable insights for improving international investment performance.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688896.abstract_zh: 本研究利用2008年至2023年的企业层面数据，探讨了人工智能应用对中国跨国企业海外投资效率的影响。结果显示，人工智能能显著提升投资效率。机制分析表明，人工智能通过缓解管理者短视和增强动态能力发挥作用。异质性分析显示，在经济政策不确定性高和制度距离大的东道国，人工智能的积极效应更为显著。同时，人工智能的赋能效果因企业的组织学习能力和政治关联度而异。这些发现强调了人工智能在优化跨国企业投资策略、增强全球竞争力以及适应不同制度和经济环境方面的变革潜力，从而为提升国际投资绩效提供了可行的见解。

10.1080/00036846.2026.2688897.abstract: We examine inference in a two-group, three-period staggered difference-in-differences setting where conventional pre-trends testing is infeasible. By imposing structured assumptions on treatment effect heterogeneity and dynamics, we develop a novel framework that enables reliable inference on the direction of treatment effects while relaxing the parallel-trends assumption. We apply this framework to assess the effects of minimum wages in China, a context in which the validity of existing DiD-based findings may be compromised by the inability to validate pre-trends. The results indicate that minimum wages substantially increase the wages of low-skilled rural migrant workers, with no detectable effects for high-skilled workers. We find no evidence of employment reductions; conversely, the findings suggest a positive employment effect for low-skilled workers.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688897.abstract_zh: 我们考察了一个两组、三期交错双重差分设定中的推断问题，在该设定下，传统的预趋势检验不可行。通过对处理效应异质性和动态性施加结构化假设，我们开发了一个新框架，该框架能够在放宽平行趋势假设的同时，实现对处理效应方向的可靠推断。我们将此框架应用于评估中国最低工资的影响，在这一背景下，现有基于双重差分的研究发现的有效性可能因无法验证预趋势而受到损害。结果表明，最低工资显著提高了低技能农村流动工人的工资，而对高技能工人则未检测到显著效应。我们未发现就业减少的证据；相反，研究结果提示最低工资对低技能工人存在正向就业效应。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688897.title: Two-group, three-period staggered difference-in-differences design and evaluation of labour market effects of minimum wages in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688897.title_zh: 两组三阶段交错双重差分设计与中国最低工资劳动力市场效应评估

10.1080/00036846.2026.2688898.title: Hard connectivity and soft standardization: how logistics policy coordination shapes supply chain resilience
10.1080/00036846.2026.2688898.title_zh: 硬连接与软标准化：物流政策协调如何塑造供应链韧性

10.1080/00036846.2026.2688900.abstract: China’s renewable energy sector sits at the heart of a deepening contest between techno-nationalist rivals. Whether R&D investment shields firms from the resulting disruption or heightens their vulnerability remains an open question.
