10.1080/00036846.2026.2707339.abstract_zh: 在全球生态文明建设背景下，理解环境政策对企业绿色创新的影响具有重要意义。基于构建的理论模型，本研究采用双机器学习（DML）模型，以2008至2024年中国资源型上市企业为样本，检验新《环境保护法》对资源型企业绿色技术创新的影响。研究发现：（1）新《环境保护法》对资源型企业绿色技术创新具有正向影响，该结论在包括内生性处理在内的多项检验后依然稳健。（2）地方政府环境关注度与企业环境信息披露构成新《环境保护法》影响资源型企业绿色技术创新的作用机制。（3）当企业董事长或高管具有中共党员身份或数字专业背景，或企业位于环保重点城市或经济发达的东部地区时，新《环境保护法》对资源型企业绿色技术创新的正向影响更为显著。关键词：新《环境保护法》；绿色技术创新；地方政府环境关注度；企业环境信息披露 JEL分类：O32 O38 K23 致谢：作者对文中所有观点和见解承担全部责任。黄钊：数据整理、形式分析、方法论、初稿撰写。李柯南：方法论、形式分析、概念构思、审阅修订。唐凌霄：形式分析、项目管理。所有作者：共同参与论文撰写并批准最终投稿版本。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707339.title: The impact of the new Environmental Protection Law on green technology innovation in resource-based enterprises: a double machine learning approach
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707339.title_zh: 新《环境保护法》对资源型企业绿色技术创新的影响：基于双机器学习方法

10.1080/00036846.2026.2707340.abstract: The study investigates the heterogeneity of the effect of COVID-19 pandemic-related restrictions on economic well-being in Russia based on labour market size, socio-demographic groups and income distribution. We examine the effect by composing a group of private-sector workers affected by pandemic-related restrictions in the labour market. We use public-sector workers as a counterfactual. Difference‑in‑differences, as the main approach, is combined with propensity score matching and applied to evaluate the average and quantile treatment effects. The results based on microdata from the RLMS-HSE reveal that the restrictions led to a loss of individual income of approximately 13%. However, the income decline was lower at the household level. In contrast to other crises, the pandemic led to significant income losses among working-age individuals, male workers and workers with secondary education. We note a negative effect on income in the top quantiles of the income distribution for the entire sample and in the median and lower quantiles for single-parent households and households with members who have severe health problems. The article contributes to the literature by identifying the heterogeneous effects of the pandemic restrictions in Russia and ruling out confounding factors. KEYWORDS: COVID-19 difference-in-differences quantile difference-in-differences equivalised income public–private sectoral gap JEL CLASSIFICATION: C21 D31 E24 Acknowledgements We express our gratitude to the two anonymous reviewers for their constructive comments.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707340.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了新冠疫情相关限制措施对俄罗斯经济福祉影响的异质性，基于劳动力市场规模、社会人口群体及收入分配维度进行分析。我们通过构建受疫情相关劳动力市场限制影响的私营部门工作者群体来考察该效应，并以公共部门工作者作为反事实参照。采用双重差分法作为主要分析方法，结合倾向得分匹配，评估平均处理效应与分位数处理效应。基于RLMS-HSE微观数据的实证结果显示，限制措施导致个人收入损失约13%，但家庭层面的收入下降幅度较小。与其他危机不同，疫情导致劳动年龄个体、男性工作者及中等教育水平工作者的收入显著损失。我们注意到，在全样本收入分布的高分位数处存在负向收入效应，而在单亲家庭及有严重健康问题成员的家庭中，中位数及低分位数处也呈现负向影响。本文通过识别俄罗斯疫情限制措施的异质性效应并排除混杂因素，为现有文献作出贡献。关键词：COVID-19；双重差分法；分位数双重差分法；等值收入；公共-私营部门差距 JEL分类：C21 D31 E24 致谢：我们感谢两位匿名审稿人的建设性意见。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707340.title: The heterogeneous impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on income: evidence from Russia
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707340.title_zh: COVID-19疫情对收入的不均衡影响：来自俄罗斯的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2707343.abstract: This study investigates whether luxury watches offer diversification benefits as alternative investment assets. Using the stochastic dominance method, we aim to provide robust statistical evidence of the safe-haven properties of Rolex watches. Our analysis shows that for risk-averse investors, the Rolex index stochastically dominates traditional alternatives, including gold, Bitcoin, and equities. This dominance is primarily driven by superior price stability, extreme positive skewness, and limited downside risk, rather than simply the mean return. We identify an optimal portfolio allocation consisting of 65–70% Rolex watches and the remainder in gold. This diversified strategy yields a superior risk-return profile, lies on the efficient frontier, and achieves first-order stochastic dominance over a pure Rolex position. This research contributes to the literature by extending the stochastic dominance framework to physical luxury collectables for the first time and highlighting the critical role of distributional properties, such as low tail risk and positive skewness, in determining asset dominance.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707343.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨奢侈品手表作为另类投资资产是否具备分散化投资优势。通过随机占优方法，我们旨在为劳力士手表的避险属性提供稳健的统计证据。分析表明，对于风险厌恶型投资者而言，劳力士指数在随机占优意义上优于黄金、比特币及股票等传统替代资产。这种优势主要源于其卓越的价格稳定性、极端正偏态分布特征以及有限的下行风险，而非单纯的平均收益率差异。我们识别出由65%-70%劳力士手表与剩余黄金构成的最优投资组合配置。该分散化策略呈现出更优的风险收益特征，位于有效前沿曲线上，并实现对纯劳力士头寸的一阶随机占优。本研究首次将随机占优框架拓展至实体奢侈品收藏品领域，揭示了低尾部风险与正偏态等分布特征在决定资产占优性中的关键作用，为相关文献作出贡献。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707343.title: Beyond gold and Bitcoin: stochastic dominance evidence for Rolex watches as an elite safe-haven asset
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707343.title_zh: 超越黄金与比特币：劳力士手表作为精英避险资产的随机占优证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2707344.abstract: This article examines the impact of high temperatures on the downstream enterprises. By constructing ‘supplier-customer’ pairs during 2001–2022, this article explores exogenous variation in temperature and finds that high temperatures in suppliers’ regions significantly reduce customers’ performance. The effects are more pronounced for non-state-owned, smaller, less digitalized, more supply-chain-concentrated and less monopolistic enterprises. The possible channel is that suppliers pass on the increased costs due to high temperatures to customers, leading to adverse impacts on their performance. The study enriches the research on extreme weather and provides insights about how to respond to supply chain risks in a warming world. KEYWORDS: Extreme high temperatures supply chain risks enterprise performance JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q54 L25 G30
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707344.abstract_zh: 本文考察了高温对下游企业的影响。通过构建2001—2022年间的“供应商—客户”配对，本文利用温度的外生变化发现，供应商所在地区的高温显著降低了客户的绩效。这一效应在非国有企业、规模较小、数字化程度较低、供应链集中度较高以及垄断程度较低的企业中更为明显。可能的传导渠道是，供应商将高温导致的成本增加转嫁给客户，从而对其绩效产生不利影响。本研究丰富了极端天气相关研究，并为在变暖世界中如何应对供应链风险提供了启示。关键词：极端高温 供应链风险 企业绩效 JEL分类：Q54 L25 G30
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707344.title: Extreme heat, supply chain risks and enterprise performance
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707344.title_zh: 极端高温、供应链风险与企业绩效

10.1080/00036846.2026.2707345.abstract: This study employs a TVP-VAR method and wavelet analysis to investigate the risk linkages and volatility spillovers between energy and stock markets. The key findings are as follows. First, significant risk spillovers exist between the international energy market and the Chinese stock market, with volatility predominantly driven by long-term components. Moreover, these dynamic spillovers tend to intensify during extreme events. Second, energy price fluctuations serve as a leading indicator for stock market risk dynamics. Third, frequency heterogeneity exists between energy and stock markets. From a policy perspective, regulatory authorities should improve the macro-regulatory system – by building strategic energy reserves and advancing early warning systems – to bolster financial stability.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707345.abstract_zh: 本研究采用TVP-VAR方法与小波分析，探讨能源市场与股票市场之间的风险关联及波动溢出效应。主要发现如下：第一，国际能源市场与中国股票市场之间存在显著的风险溢出，波动主要由长期成分驱动。此外，此类动态溢出在极端事件期间趋于加剧。第二，能源价格波动可作为股票市场风险动态的先行指标。第三，能源市场与股票市场之间存在频率异质性。从政策视角看，监管机构应完善宏观调节体系——通过构建战略能源储备与推进预警系统建设——以增强金融稳定性。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707345.title: Risk linkages between international energy prices and the Chinese stock market: insights from TVP-VAR and wavelet analysis
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707345.title_zh: 国际能源价格与中国股市的风险关联：基于TVP-VAR与小波分析的洞见

10.1080/00036846.2026.2708161.abstract: The rapid expansion of digital technologies has transformed how individuals access information and interact with institutions, yet older adults often remain excluded from these opportunities. This study examines the role of information access in fostering rights awareness among older adults in Vietnam, a country undergoing both demographic ageing and rapid digital transformation. Using data from the 2011 Vietnam National Ageing Survey, we construct a composite index of information access incorporating television, radio, newspapers, internet, community loudspeakers, and computer ownership. Rights awareness is measured across four domains: health, social protection, legal and policy, and civic participation. To address potential endogeneity, we employ a coefficient stability bounds approach, complemented by propensity score matching, inverse probability weighting, entropy balancing, coarsened exact matching, and double/debiased machine learning. Across all specifications, information access is consistently associated with greater rights awareness, even under conservative assumptions regarding omitted variable bias. Mediation analysis further reveals that information access promotes awareness both directly and indirectly, through enhanced civic participation and stronger intergenerational support. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the effects are stronger and more robust in the Northern and Southern regions, among more educated individuals, within the Kinh majority group, and among women. KEYWORDS: Information access right awareness ageing Vietnam JEL CLASSIFICATION: I39 O10
10.1080/00036846.2026.2708161.abstract_zh: 数字技术的迅速扩张改变了个人获取信息和与机构互动的方式，然而老年人往往仍被排除在这些机会之外。本研究考察了信息获取在促进越南老年人权利意识方面的作用，越南正处于人口老龄化和快速数字化转型并行的阶段。利用2011年越南国家老龄化调查数据，我们构建了一个包含电视、广播、报纸、互联网、社区扩音器和计算机拥有情况在内的信息获取综合指数。权利意识从四个维度进行衡量：健康、社会保障、法律与政策以及公民参与。为应对潜在的内生性问题，我们采用系数稳定性边界方法，并辅以倾向得分匹配、逆概率加权、熵平衡、粗化精确匹配以及双重/去偏机器学习。在所有设定下，即使在关于遗漏变量偏差的保守假设下，信息获取始终与更高的权利意识相关联。中介分析进一步表明，信息获取既通过增强公民参与和强化代际支持间接地，也直接地促进权利意识。异质性分析显示，在北部和南部地区、受教育程度较高的群体、京族多数群体以及女性中，该效应更强且更为稳健。关键词：信息获取 权利意识 老龄化 越南 JEL分类：I39 O10
10.1080/00036846.2026.2708161.title: Empowering the elderly: the role of information access in promoting rights awareness in Vietnam
10.1080/00036846.2026.2708161.title_zh: 赋权老年人：信息获取在促进越南权利意识中的作用

10.1080/00036846.2026.2708162.abstract: Strengthening the ecological rule of law represents an important form of institutional innovation through which China seeks to achieve its carbon-reduction goals. Using a panel of 285 Chinese cities over the period 2006–2021, this study employs a supervised double machine learning framework to examine both the theoretical mechanisms and the policy effects of establishing environmental tribunals on urban pollution reduction and carbon mitigation. We find that the establishment of environmental tribunals significantly promotes coordinated reductions in pollution and carbon emissions at the city level. Mechanism analyses indicate that this effect operates primarily through the substitution and upgrading of clean industries, technological progress in energy conservation and emissions reduction, and the optimization of industrial land-use structure. Further heterogeneity analyses show that the mitigating effects are stronger in cities with more advanced judicial development, greater public awareness of legal rights protection, and more developed green finance systems. These findings suggest that the gradual expansion of environmental tribunals, together with continued improvements in industrial, technological, and land-use structures and the adoption of more targeted ecological rule-of-law policies tailored to local resource endowments, can enhance the synergistic effectiveness of pollution and carbon reduction.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2708162.abstract_zh: 加强生态法治建设是中国实现碳减排目标的重要制度创新形式。本研究基于2006—2021年中国285个城市的面板数据，采用有监督的双重机器学习框架，考察设立环境法庭对城市减污降碳的理论机制与政策效应。研究发现，设立环境法庭显著促进了城市层面污染物与碳排放的协同减排。机制分析表明，该效应主要通过清洁产业替代升级、节能降碳技术进步以及工业用地结构优化三条路径实现。进一步异质性分析显示，在司法发展水平较高、公众法律维权意识较强以及绿色金融体系较完善的城市，其减排效应更为显著。研究结论表明，逐步扩大环境法庭的设立范围，持续优化产业、技术与用地结构，并因地制宜实施更具针对性的生态法治政策，能够有效提升减污降碳的协同效能。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2708162.title: The impact of environmental courts on urban pollution reduction and carbon mitigation: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2708162.title_zh: 环境法庭对城市污染减排与碳减排的影响：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2708166.abstract: This paper proposes a Hierarchical Archimedean Copula Risk Parity (HAC-RP) framework that extends the conventional Hierarchical Risk Parity (HRP) approach by incorporating nonlinear and asymmetric dependence through hierarchical Archimedean copulas. Three copula specifications – Gumbel, Clayton, and a multi-generator HAC – are considered within the HRP allocation framework. The proposed method is evaluated using monthly U.S. sector ETF data and compared with conventional HRP, a Ledoit – Wolf global minimum-variance portfolio, and an equal-weight benchmark. Empirical results show that the proposed HAC portfolios provide competitive risk-adjusted performance while maintaining favourable diversification and turnover characteristics. Among the proposed specifications, the multi-generator HAC exhibits the strongest overall performance. These findings suggest that hierarchical copulas provide a practical extension of the conventional HRP framework for portfolio construction. KEYWORDS: Risk parity stock volatility Archimedean copula portfolio selection portfolio performance JEL CLASSIFICATION: G11 C46 C58 Acknowledgements This article develops and substantially extends research originally presented in Minju Kim’s master’s thesis, “A Hierarchical Asset Allocation Capturing the Smile Phenomenon of Cross-Sectional Market Volatility Using an Archimedean Copula,” submitted to Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) in 2023.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2708166.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种分层阿基米德Copula风险平价（HAC-RP）框架，通过引入分层阿基米德Copula来捕捉非线性及非对称依赖性，从而扩展了传统的分层风险平价（HRP）方法。在HRP配置框架内，考虑了三种Copula设定——Gumbel、Clayton以及多生成元HAC。所提方法利用美国行业ETF月度数据进行评估，并与传统HRP、Ledoit-Wolf全局最小方差组合及等权重基准进行比较。实证结果表明，所提出的HAC组合在保持良好分散化和换手率特性的同时，提供了具有竞争力的风险调整后表现。在所提设定中，多生成元HAC展现出最强的整体表现。这些发现表明，分层Copula为传统HRP框架在组合构建中提供了一种实用的扩展。关键词：风险平价 股票波动率 阿基米德Copula 组合选择 组合表现 JEL分类：G11 C46 C58 致谢 本文发展并大幅扩展了最初发表于金敏珠（Minju Kim）硕士论文中的研究，该论文题为“利用阿基米德Copula捕捉横截面市场波动微笑现象的分层资产配置”，于2023年提交至浦项科技大学（POSTECH）。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2708166.title: Copula-based hierarchical risk parity: modelling nonlinear dependence structures for portfolio allocation
10.1080/00036846.2026.2708166.title_zh: 基于Copula的分层风险平价：为投资组合配置建模非线性相依结构

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709058.abstract: Investors and policymakers are increasingly relying on Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) metrics to inform capital allocation and regulatory decisions. However, prior research on the link between ESG and financial performance (FP) has yielded mixed results, ranging from positive to neutral and negative associations. These inconsistencies stem from a lack of sector-specific analysis and insufficient treatment of endogeneity. This study addresses these gaps by adopting a sector-based approach and employing the Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) panel regression to control for endogeneity, ensuring more robust and unbiased estimates. Using 15,886 U.S. firm-year observations from 2017 to 2023, the study evaluates market-based (excess return), accounting-based (ROA and ROE), and financial stability indicators (Altman Z-score and Kaplan-Zingales KZ Index). It also compares results across periods that include and exclude the COVID-19 pandemic. The findings reveal that ESG performance has a significant influence on financial outcomes, but the effects vary across sectors and performance measures. ESG is positively associated with financial flexibility (KZ Index) in most sectors, while its impact on ROA and ROE is more inconsistent. Sectors such as Energy, Utilities, and Consumer Staples benefit the most from ESG engagement, whereas Healthcare and Communication Services may face ESG-related trade-offs.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709058.abstract_zh: 投资者和政策制定者日益依赖环境、社会和治理（ESG）指标来指导资本配置和监管决策。然而，先前关于ESG与财务绩效（FP）之间关系的研究得出了不一致的结论，包括正向、中性和负向关联。这些不一致源于缺乏行业特定分析以及对内生性问题的处理不足。本研究通过采用基于行业的方法，并运用广义矩估计（GMM）面板回归来控制内生性，从而弥补上述不足，确保估计结果更加稳健且无偏。基于2017年至2023年间15,886个美国公司-年度观测值，本研究评估了市场导向指标（超额收益）、会计导向指标（ROA和ROE）以及财务稳定性指标（Altman Z值和Kaplan-Zingales KZ指数），并比较了包含与排除COVID-19疫情时期的结果。研究发现，ESG绩效对财务结果具有显著影响，但其效应因行业和绩效衡量指标而异。在大多数行业中，ESG与财务灵活性（KZ指数）呈正相关，而对ROA和ROE的影响则更不一致。能源、公用事业和必需消费品行业从ESG参与中获益最多，而医疗保健和通信服务行业可能面临与ESG相关的权衡。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709058.title: ESG Value in US firms: sectoral dynamics with a COVID-19 perspective
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709058.title_zh: 美国企业ESG价值：基于新冠疫情视角的行业动态分析

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709059.abstract: Motivated by recent calls for new investment to enhance EU competitiveness, this paper compares intangible capital accumulation in France and Germany, documenting large cross-country differences in investment levels, particularly in software and organizational capital. Yet, both countries have experienced similar labor productivity growth (LPG) from 1995 to 2021, raising questions about investment efficiency and potential measurement issues, especially in light of contrasting evidence from firm-level surveys. To shed further light on this puzzle, we conduct an econometric cross-country sectoral growth accounting analysis based on capital services growth rates. The results show that intangible capital contributed more to LPG in Germany than in France, despite the lower investment levels in the former. We interpret this finding primarily as reinforcing concerns about cross-country measurement inconsistencies and highlight the need for harmonizing intangible capital statistics to support more robust policy comparisons at the EU level.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709059.abstract_zh: 受近期关于提升欧盟竞争力的新投资呼吁的启发，本文比较了法国和德国的无形资本积累情况，记录了在投资水平上的显著跨国差异，尤其是在软件和组织资本方面。然而，两国在1995年至2021年间经历了相似的全员劳动生产率增长，这引发了关于投资效率和潜在测量问题的疑问，尤其是考虑到企业层面调查中呈现的对比性证据。为深入探究这一谜团，我们基于资本服务增长率进行了跨国部门层面的增长核算计量分析。结果显示，尽管德国的投资水平较低，但其无形资本对全员劳动生产率增长的贡献大于法国。我们将这一发现主要解读为加剧了对跨国测量不一致性的担忧，并强调需要统一无形资本统计，以支持欧盟层面更为稳健的政策比较。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709059.title: Is the EU ready for the next generation of investment? A cross-country sectoral growth accounting analysis of intangible capital in France and Germany
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709059.title_zh: 欧盟准备好迎接下一代投资了吗？法国与德国无形资产跨国部门增长核算分析

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709062.abstract: Using loan-level matched data between banks and firms from 2014 to 2022, we examine the association between banks’ adoption of artificial intelligence and shadow banking activities among non-financial firms. We find that bank-level AI adoption is associated with a significant and robust reduction in firms’ engagement in shadow banking. This mitigating effect operates through two channels. First, AI adoption enhances banks’ ex-ante screening capacity, improves borrower identification, expands credit access for high-quality firms, and alleviates financing constraints. Second, by strengthening post-lending monitoring, AI adoption is associated with a lower incidence of corporate financial misconduct and limits firms’ ability to divert loan proceeds into shadow banking activities. The governance effect is more pronounced among firms with greater information asymmetry and in regions with weaker financial regulation, and it is strongest for entrusted loans, a major form of corporate shadow banking in China. Further evidence shows that bank AI adoption is associated with reduced firms’ reliance on short-term borrowing and significantly higher investment in core business activities, suggesting that AI curbs financial arbitrage incentives and facilitates the reallocation of credit towards the real economy. This study provides novel bank–firm-level evidence on how digital financial intermediation reshapes corporate shadow banking behaviour.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709062.abstract_zh: 本文利用2014至2022年间银行与企业层面的贷款匹配数据，考察银行采用人工智能与非金融企业影子银行活动之间的关联。研究发现，银行层面的人工智能应用与企业参与影子银行活动显著且稳健地减少相关。这一抑制作用通过两条渠道实现：其一，人工智能应用增强了银行的事前筛选能力，改善了借款人识别机制，扩大了优质企业的信贷获取渠道，缓解了融资约束；其二，通过强化贷后监控，人工智能应用与企业财务违规行为发生率降低相关联，并限制了企业将贷款资金转移至影子银行活动的能力。这种治理效应在信息不对称程度较高的企业以及金融监管较弱的地区更为显著，且对委托贷款（中国影子银行的主要形式）的抑制效果最强。进一步证据表明，银行人工智能应用与企业短期借款依赖度降低及核心业务投资显著增加相关，说明人工智能抑制了金融套利动机，促进了信贷资源向实体经济的再配置。本研究为数字金融中介如何重塑企业影子银行行为提供了新颖的银企层面证据。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709062.title: Technological empowerment: the governance effect of bank artificial intelligence adoption on corporate shadow banking
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709062.title_zh: 技术赋能：银行人工智能应用对企业影子银行的治理效应

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709063.abstract: Alabama is a high-poverty state with permissive small-dollar credit regulation and one of the largest licenced alternative financial service provider (AFSP) markets in the United States. Using Alabama State Banking Department licencing data for 2011, 2014, 2015, 2016, and 2020, we estimate Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood (PPML) models with high-dimensional fixed effects to examine conditional spatial associations between traditional financial institutions (TFIs), socioeconomic and demographic characteristics, and counts of deferred-presentment providers (payday lenders), small-loan providers, and pawnshops. Models are estimated at census-tract, ZIP-code, and county levels, and two-part hurdle models separate AFSP presence from conditional intensity. The results are more consistent with co-location than with a spatial-void account. Lagged credit-union intensity shows the most consistent positive association with AFSP counts across specifications, especially at the ZIP-code level, while lagged bank intensity is positive in most specifications, with significance concentrated on the ZIP-code intensity and tract-level entry margins. Population size and an inverted-U income gradient are the strongest predictors. Demographic associations are strongest at the tract level, especially Hispanic share, share aged 65 and over, and lower educational attainment, while Black share is not significant in the main PPML models. The findings underscore the importance of spatial scale for interpreting AFSP location. KEYWORDS: Alternative financial service providers traditional financial institutions payday spatial scale credit-market segmentation JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 G23 Acknowledgements We sincerely appreciate the valuable feedback from peers in American Council on Consumer Interests (ACCI)’s Early-Career Professional Development Mentorship Program.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709063.abstract_zh: 阿拉巴马州是一个高贫困州，其小额信贷监管较为宽松，并拥有美国规模最大的持牌替代性金融服务提供商（AFSP）市场之一。利用阿拉巴马州银行部2011年、2014年、2015年、2016年和2020年的许可数据，我们估计了具有高维固定效应的泊松伪最大似然（PPML）模型，以考察传统金融机构（TFIs）、社会经济与人口特征，以及延期付款提供商（发薪日贷款机构）、小额贷款机构和当铺数量之间的条件空间关联。模型在人口普查区、邮政编码区和县三个层面进行估计，两部分的障碍模型将AFSP的存在与条件强度区分开来。结果更支持共选址而非空间空白假说。滞后信用合作社强度与AFSP数量在各规格中呈现最一致的正向关联，尤其在邮政编码区层面；而滞后银行强度在大多数规格中为正，显著性集中于邮政编码区强度及人口普查区进入边际。人口规模和倒U型收入梯度是最强的预测因子。人口特征关联在人口普查区层面最强，尤其是西班牙裔占比、65岁及以上人口占比以及较低的教育程度，而黑人占比在主要PPML模型中不显著。研究结果强调了空间尺度对解释AFSP选址的重要性。关键词：替代性金融服务提供商；传统金融机构；发薪日贷款；空间尺度；信贷市场分割 JEL分类：G21 G23 致谢：我们衷心感谢美国消费者利益委员会（ACCI）早期职业专业发展导师计划中同行们的宝贵反馈。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709063.title: The spatial distribution of alternative financial service providers in Alabama: a multi-scale analysis
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709063.title_zh: 阿拉巴马州替代性金融服务提供者的空间分布：多尺度分析

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709064.abstract: Using Chinese listed firms outside heavily polluting industries from 2009 to 2020, we show that higher local air pollution raises measured labour investment efficiency. We identify this effect using city-level thermal inversions and atmospheric ventilation coefficients as instruments for pollution. We explain the pattern through government pressure reallocation. Local governments face simultaneous targets for growth, employment stability, and environmental improvement. When pollution increases environmental scrutiny on high-polluting industries, firms outside those industries, especially local state-owned enterprises and politically connected firms, become key carriers of growth and employment objectives. Consistent with this mechanism, pollution increases a local multi-objective pressure index, and the estimated effect is strongest where multi-objective pressure is high. Firm-level evidence shows that the adjustment is accompanied by higher employee welfare spending. The apparent improvement is not followed by higher productivity, profitability, or market value, and it sometimes predicts weaker performance. These findings show that pollution reallocates policy pressure and induces labour expansion by firms with capacity to absorb social and employment responsibilities. Our study reveals a hidden organizational cost of air pollution.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709064.abstract_zh: 基于2009至2020年中国非重污染行业上市公司数据，研究发现本地空气污染加剧显著提升了企业劳动投资效率。本文利用城市级逆温现象与大气通风系数作为污染的工具变量识别该因果效应，并通过政府压力再分配机制解释这一现象。地方政府同时面临经济增长、就业稳定与环境改善的多重目标。当污染加剧导致重污染行业面临更严格的环境监管时，非重污染行业企业——尤其是地方国有企业和具有政治关联的企业——成为承载增长与就业目标的关键主体。机制检验表明：污染加剧会提升地方多目标压力指数，且该效应在多目标压力较高地区更为显著。企业层面证据显示，劳动投资效率提升伴随员工福利支出增加，但并未带来生产率、盈利能力或市场价值的同步提升，甚至在某些情况下预示着更差的经营表现。这些发现表明，污染通过重新分配政策压力，促使具备社会就业吸纳能力的企业进行劳动力扩张。本研究揭示了空气污染隐藏的组织成本。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709064.title: When pollution improves efficiency: air quality and labour investment in firms
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709064.title_zh: 当污染提升效率：空气质量与企业劳动投资

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709065.abstract: This study examines the relationship between unemployment, income inequality, and Africans’ expectations about future economic prospects, highlighting how structural exclusion and labour market inefficiencies shape perceived opportunities, optimism, and confidence. Using Afrobarometer individual-level survey data combined with country-level macroeconomic indicators, ordinary least squares estimates reveal that Africans’ expectations regarding their countries’ future economic prospects are more strongly and negatively associated with unemployment than with the level of income inequality prevailing in their countries. Specifically, a one-percentage-point increase in unemployment is associated with a 0.026-point decrease in respondents’ optimism expectations regarding economic outlook. In addition, there is limited evidence that inequality substantially moderates the relationship between unemployment and expectations. Robustness checks using ordered logit models, a leave-one-country-out exercise, and logit models, confirm the consistency of the findings. However, robustness checks based on aggregating individuals’ perceptions at country-year level data suggest that the relationship between unemployment, inequality, and economic expectations is primarily driven by individual-level variation, underscoring the importance of micro-level heterogeneity in studying perceptions of future economic conditions. The findings suggest that African policymakers should prioritize addressing unemployment challenges to restore optimism, even where inequality remains unresolved. KEYWORDS: Inequality unemployment expectations Africa JEL CLASSIFICATION: E24 D63 D84 O55 Acknowledgements This paper was presented at the 65th Annual Congress of the Canadian Society of Economic Science (SCSE) and at the 93rd Congress of French-Canadian Association for the Advancement of Science (ACFAS). The authors are grateful to participants and discussants for their valuable comments and suggestions, which helped improve the quality of this study.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709065.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了失业、收入不平等与非洲人对未来经济前景预期之间的关系，揭示了结构性排斥和劳动力市场低效如何塑造感知机会、乐观情绪和信心。利用非洲晴雨表个人层面调查数据，结合国家层面宏观经济指标，普通最小二乘估计显示，非洲人对本国未来经济前景的预期与失业率的负向关联强于与本国收入不平等水平的关联。具体而言，失业率每上升一个百分点，受访者对经济前景的乐观预期下降0.026个点。此外，仅有有限证据表明不平等显著调节失业与预期之间的关系。采用有序Logit模型、逐一剔除国家检验及Logit模型的稳健性检验证实了研究结果的一致性。然而，基于将个人感知聚合至国家-年份层面的稳健性检验表明，失业、不平等与经济预期之间的关系主要由个人层面变异驱动，凸显了微观层面异质性在研究未来经济条件感知中的重要性。研究结果表明，非洲政策制定者应优先解决失业挑战以恢复乐观情绪，即使不平等问题尚未解决。关键词：不平等；失业；预期；非洲 JEL分类：E24 D63 D84 O55 致谢 本文曾在加拿大经济科学学会（SCSE）第65届年会及法裔加拿大科学促进协会（ACFAS）第93届大会上报告。作者感谢与会者和评论人的宝贵意见与建议，这些帮助提升了本研究的质量。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709065.title: Unemployment, inequality, and Africans’ expectations about future economic prospects
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709065.title_zh: 失业、不平等与非洲人对未来经济前景的预期

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709066.abstract: Concentrated animal feeding operations (CAFOs) provide low-cost products but often face local opposition due to environmental externalities. Based on a two-time panel discrete choice experiment (DCE) of rural residents living near CAFOs in China, this study quantifies how water quality information disclosure and various means of compensation affect residents’ acceptance of local CAFO development. The findings reveal that: (1) Compensation programmes incorporating quasi-public goods and environmental offsets can improve residents’ acceptance of CAFOs, with environmental offsets yielding the highest utility to respondents. (2) Water quality information disclosure heightens legitimate risk awareness, increasing the likelihood of opting out and rejecting CAFO construction. When the contribution of crop production to water pollution is clarified, residents receiving favourable water quality testing results show a higher willingness to accept CAFO development than those receiving unfavourable testing results. These results suggest that policymakers should prioritize environmental offsets, strengthen environmental regulation to ensure compliance, and provide the public with objective interpretations of risks. This study offers valuable insights for promoting sustainable CAFO development in China and economies with similar institutional contexts. KEYWORDS: Concentrated animal feeding operations information disclosure means of compensation willingness to accept JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q51 Q53 Q56 Q13
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709066.abstract_zh: 集约化畜禽养殖场（CAFOs）提供低成本产品，但常因环境外部性而面临当地居民的反对。基于对中国CAFOs周边农村居民开展的两期面板离散选择实验（DCE），本研究量化了水质信息披露及不同补偿方式对居民接受当地CAFOs开发意愿的影响。研究发现：（1）纳入准公共物品与环境补偿的补偿方案能够提升居民对CAFOs的接受度，其中环境补偿为受访者带来最高效用。（2）水质信息披露增强了居民的合法风险意识，提高了选择退出并拒绝CAFOs建设的可能性。当明确作物生产对水污染的贡献时，获得有利水质检测结果的居民比获得不利检测结果的居民表现出更高的CAFOs开发接受意愿。上述结果表明，政策制定者应优先考虑环境补偿，加强环境监管以确保合规，并向公众提供客观的风险解读。本研究为促进中国及具有相似制度背景的经济体中CAFOs的可持续发展提供了有价值的参考。关键词：集约化畜禽养殖场；信息披露；补偿方式；接受意愿 JEL分类：Q51 Q53 Q56 Q13
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709066.title: Willingness to accept local CAFO development: actual water quality information and rural residents’ preferences for means of compensation
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709066.title_zh: 接受本地集中式动物饲养场开发的意愿：实际水质信息与农村居民补偿方式偏好

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709067.abstract: Artificial intelligence is becoming a key input in corporate transformation, yet its effects on workforce skill structure remain underexplored. Drawing on skill-biased technological change theory, this study examines AI investment’s effect on the share of highly educated labour and the mediating role of administrative expense ratio. Using panel data of Chinese A-share listed firms (2015–2024), this research finds that a 1% increase in AI investment raises the proportion of employees with a master’s degree or above by about 0.0009% points – significant but modest, reflecting high-skilled talent supply lag. The direct positive effect is partially offset by an indirect negative effect via reduced administrative expense ratio. The effect is strongest in services, weaker in industry, and insignificant in agriculture; it is also significant in non-state-owned enterprises but not in state-owned ones. These findings suggest AI affects skill structure through both production and organizational channels, with implications for firm strategy and policy.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709067.abstract_zh: 人工智能正成为企业转型的关键投入，但其对劳动力技能结构的影响仍待深入探究。基于技能偏向型技术变革理论，本研究考察了人工智能投资对高学历劳动力占比的影响，以及管理费用率的中介作用。利用2015-2024年中国A股上市公司面板数据，研究发现：人工智能投资每增加1%，硕士及以上学历员工占比约提升0.0009个百分点——该效应虽显著但幅度有限，反映出高技能人才供给滞后。直接正向效应部分被管理费用率下降带来的间接负向效应所抵消。该效应在服务业中最强，工业次之，农业不显著；在非国有企业中显著，在国有企业中不显著。这些发现表明，人工智能通过生产渠道和组织渠道双重路径影响技能结构，对企业战略与政策制定具有启示意义。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709067.title: How does artificial intelligence investment optimize the skill structure of enterprise labour force? Evidence from Chinese listed companies
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709067.title_zh: 人工智能投资如何优化企业劳动力技能结构？来自中国上市公司的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709068.abstract: This study investigates the impact of public data openness (PD) on venture capital investments. Our research design provides new evidence on how public data, as digital public goods, can serve as a policy instrument in public governance to promote venture capital investments by boosting regional trust and improving the business credit environment, both theoretically and empirically. We use data from 291 prefecture-level cities from 2009 to 2021 to examine the adoption of online public data platforms by local public sectors in China’s pilot cities. Using staggered Difference-in-Differences (DID) analyses, we find that public data platforms significantly increase the number of city-level venture capital investments. Our findings are also robust to a series of tests and checks for endogeneity, including dynamic DID, synthetic DID, matching, poisson pseudo-maximum-likelihood estimation, alternative measures of VC, exclusion of other policies’ impacts, Bacon-Decomposition and Callaway and Sant’Anna estimator, and machine learning techniques. In additional analysis, we also verify that public data openness helps mitigate regional investment imbalances in venture capital. Our empirical findings indicate that public sectors should promote the openness of public data resources to generate greater positive externalities in regional development.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709068.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了公共数据开放（PD）对风险投资的影响。我们的研究设计从理论与实证层面提供了新证据，揭示公共数据作为数字公共品，如何通过提升区域信任度、改善商业信用环境，成为公共治理中促进风险投资的政策工具。我们采用2009至2021年中国291个地级市的数据，考察试点城市地方公共部门对在线公共数据平台的采纳情况。基于交错双重差分（DID）分析发现，公共数据平台显著增加了城市层面的风险投资数量。该结论在一系列稳健性检验与内生性处理中依然成立，包括动态DID、合成DID、匹配法、泊松伪极大似然估计、风险投资的替代测度、排除其他政策影响、Bacon分解、Callaway与Sant'Anna估计量以及机器学习技术。进一步分析还证实，公共数据开放有助于缓解区域间风险投资的不平衡。实证结果表明，公共部门应推动公共数据资源的开放，以在区域发展中产生更大的正外部性。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709068.title: Public data openness and venture capital investments
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709068.title_zh: 公共数据开放与风险投资

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709069.abstract: E-commerce platforms increasingly introduce private-label products that compete with green manufacturers’ products, while choosing among platform in-house production, outsourcing to green manufacturers, and outsourcing to OEM manufacturers. This study develops a game-theoretic model to examine how selling modes and production strategies affect green technology investment, platform–manufacturer cooperation, and private-label production choices, considering private-label market size, competition intensity, and consumer green preferences. Results show that when private-label market size exceeds a critical threshold, platform in-house production becomes optimal under both reselling and agency selling, with a lower threshold under reselling. As competition intensifies, green manufacturers reduce green technology investment. The platform adjusts its production strategy according to the cost difference between in-house production and outsourcing. From a supply chain perspective, agency selling achieves Pareto improvement over reselling within intermediate commission-rate ranges when no private label is introduced, production is in-house, or production is outsourced to green manufacturers. However, under outsourcing to OEM manufacturers, reselling achieves a win–win outcome over agency selling within an intermediate commission-rate range. KEYWORDS: Platform sales mode private-label production mode green manufacturer JEL CLASSIFICATION: L81 L13 Q56
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709069.abstract_zh: 电商平台日益引入自有品牌产品，与绿色制造商的产品形成竞争，同时需在平台自产、外包给绿色制造商及外包给OEM制造商之间做出选择。本研究构建博弈论模型，考察销售模式与生产策略如何影响绿色技术投资、平台与制造商合作及自有品牌生产选择，并考虑自有品牌市场规模、竞争强度及消费者绿色偏好等因素。研究结果表明，当自有品牌市场规模超过临界阈值时，平台自产在转售模式和代理销售模式下均为最优选择，且转售模式下的阈值更低。随着竞争加剧，绿色制造商减少绿色技术投资。平台根据自产与外包之间的成本差异调整其生产策略。从供应链视角看，在不引入自有品牌、采用自产或外包给绿色制造商的情况下，代理销售在中等佣金率区间内相对于转售模式实现帕累托改进。然而，在外包给OEM制造商的情形下，转售模式在中等佣金率区间内相对于代理销售实现双赢结果。关键词：平台销售模式；自有品牌生产模式；绿色制造商 JEL分类：L81 L13 Q56
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709069.title: Platform private-label production modes and manufacturer sales strategy choices under green product competition
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709069.title_zh: 绿色产品竞争下平台自有品牌生产模式与制造商销售策略选择

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709070.abstract: China hosts the world’s largest and fastest-growing ocean economy, yet it now confronts heightening external trade risks driven by global growing instability. To understand its potential risk from external shocks, this study evaluates the dependence of China’s ocean economy from both forward and backward perspectives and assesses the potential impacts of a U.S.A.–China decoupling based on a provincial ocean economy input–output table. The findings indicate that: 1) the forward external dependence (0.12) is higher than its backward external dependence (0.08), revealing that China’s ocean economy is more sensitive to fluctuations in external market demand than to disruptions in the external supply. 2) The external dependence exhibits significant regional and sectoral heterogeneity. While Guangdong and Shanghai show high external dependence, incorporating HHI concentration reveals that Jiangsu, Liaoning, and Shandong possess greater structural vulnerability. Industries such as marine shipbuilding (forward) and marine chemical (backward) are the most externally exposed industries. 3) The U.S.A.–China decoupling would significantly reduce total output of China’s ocean economy, particularly in marine transport and chemicals; however, scenario simulations confirm that global trade substitution can effectively mitigate a substantial portion of these losses. These findings provide policy insights for managing external risks and strengthening industrial resilience. KEYWORDS: China’s ocean industries external dependence ocean economy input-output table U.S.A–China decoupling JEL CLASSIFICATION: D57 R15
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709070.abstract_zh: 中国拥有全球规模最大、增长最快的海洋经济，但当前全球不稳定加剧使其面临日益严峻的外部贸易风险。为理解外部冲击的潜在风险，本研究基于省级海洋经济投入产出表，从前向与后向两个维度评估中国海洋经济的外部依赖度，并测算中美脱钩的潜在影响。研究发现：1）前向外部依赖度（0.12）高于后向外部依赖度（0.08），表明中国海洋经济对外部市场需求波动的敏感度高于外部供给中断。2）外部依赖度呈现显著的区域与行业异质性。广东和上海的外部依赖度较高，但引入赫芬达尔指数（HHI）集中度分析后，江苏、辽宁和山东的结构脆弱性更为突出。海洋船舶制造（前向）与海洋化工（后向）是外部暴露程度最高的行业。3）中美脱钩将显著降低中国海洋经济总产出，尤其对海洋运输和化工行业冲击最大；但情景模拟证实，全球贸易替代可有效弥补大部分损失。上述结论为应对外部风险、增强产业韧性提供了政策启示。关键词：中国海洋产业；外部依赖度；海洋经济；投入产出表；中美脱钩 JEL分类：D57；R15
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709070.title: External dependence of China’s ocean Industries
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709070.title_zh: 中国海洋产业的外部依赖性

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709167.abstract: This paper examines the interactions between shocks to oil prices (demand, supply, and risks) and the federal funds rate and the MSCI World Climate Change Index (CLMT), a market-based measure of transition risk and green asset valuations, utilizing a cross-spectral coherency and a novel Quantile VAR extended joint connectedness, the research uncovers a noteworthy impact of oil price shocks on interdependence and volatility spillovers. Notably, the coherency outcomes indicate an inverse relationship between oil price shocks (demand, supply and risks) and Federal fund rates during oil price recession (OPR) and COVID-19 crisis period. Quantile connectedness analysis shows that spillover intensities vary across different quantiles and frequencies. Total connectedness surge during OPR and COVID-19 crisis period, highlighting the heightened market connectedness during crisis periods. The dynamic connectedness analysis signifies that volatility spillovers intensify during extreme quantiles, indicating rapid volatility propagation in highly volatile market conditions. These findings have significant implications for diverse stakeholders.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709167.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了油价冲击（需求、供给及风险）与联邦基金利率及MSCI世界气候变化指数（CLMT）——一种基于市场的转型风险与绿色资产估值指标——之间的相互作用，运用交叉谱相干性和一种新颖的分位数VAR扩展联合连通性方法，研究发现油价冲击对相互依赖性和波动溢出效应具有显著影响。值得注意的是，相干性结果表明，在油价衰退期（OPR）和COVID-19危机期间，油价冲击（需求、供给及风险）与联邦基金利率呈反向关系。分位数连通性分析显示，溢出强度在不同分位数和频率间存在差异。总连通性在OPR和COVID-19危机期间激增，凸显了危机时期市场连通性的增强。动态连通性分析表明，波动溢出在极端分位数下加剧，表明在高波动市场条件下波动传播迅速。这些发现对各类利益相关者具有重要启示意义。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709167.title: Dynamics of oil price shocks and federal interest rates: a quantile based analysis during crisis period
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709167.title_zh: 石油价格冲击与联邦利率的动态关系：危机时期的分位数分析

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709171.abstract: Agricultural production systems around the globe are experiencing significant climate-driven pressures. As climate change effects intensify, agricultural adaptation must align with climate sustainability policy and consumers who are attentive to production that reduce supply-chain emissions. This study provides case-study evidence from New Zealand, where warming climatic conditions are driving exploration of alternative horticultural land uses such as bananas, and where consumer demand may influence whether such diversification pathways are commercially viable. We examine how preferences for cleaner production attributes shape banana demand using a discrete choice experiment of banana consumers designed to assess the effects of organic and spray-free production, carbon-zero claims, and local origin on consumer choices. A Latent Class Analysis identified preference heterogeneity finding 38% of consumers state willingness to pay for low environmental impact attributes: organic (+76%), spray-free (+33%) and carbon-zero (+23%), indicating potential demand for environmentally produced bananas aligned with a changing climate. The findings suggest that a differentiated domestic banana product could support sustainable production and climate-adaptive diversification but should be interpreted as case study stated-preference demand-side evidence rather than as an assessment of industry feasibility. Further evidence on production costs, supply-chain logistics, and revealed demand is needed before drawing stronger conclusions about commercial potential.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709171.abstract_zh: 全球农业生产系统正面临显著的气候变化压力。随着气候变化影响加剧，农业适应措施必须与气候可持续政策及关注供应链减排的消费者需求相协调。本研究以新西兰为案例，该国气候变暖正推动香蕉等替代性园艺土地利用方式的探索，而消费者需求可能影响此类多元化路径的商业可行性。我们通过香蕉消费者离散选择实验，考察清洁生产属性偏好如何塑造香蕉需求，旨在评估有机生产、无农药生产、碳中和声明及本地来源对消费者选择的影响。潜在类别分析揭示了偏好异质性，发现38%的消费者愿意为低环境影响的属性支付溢价：有机（+76%）、无农药（+33%）和碳中和（+23%），这表明对适应气候变化的环境友好型香蕉存在潜在需求。研究结果表明，差异化本土香蕉产品可支持可持续生产与气候适应性多元化，但应将其解读为案例研究中的陈述偏好需求侧证据，而非行业可行性评估。在得出关于商业潜力的更可靠结论前，仍需进一步获取生产成本、供应链物流及显示性需求方面的证据。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709171.title: Sustainable adaptation in agriculture: exploring consumer support for low-carbon climate resilient crops
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709171.title_zh: 农业可持续适应：消费者对低碳气候韧性作物的支持研究

10.1080/00036846.2026.2709816.abstract: We study income-related differences in tax-reported out-of-pocket healthcare expenditure using a unique database of more than 6 million tax records over five years. Individuals in the lowest income tax bracket report about €1,212 lower annual healthcare expenditure, excluding NHS tickets and disability expenditure, than those in the highest bracket after controlling for observable factors. Individual fixed-effects estimates show a positive within-taxpayer association between income and tax-reported healthcare expenditure, although these estimates should be interpreted as descriptive evidence rather than as causal estimates of unmet need. The income gradient is stronger among older taxpayers, and healthcare-expenditure income elasticities are up to three times higher in the lowest than in the highest income bracket. These patterns are consistent with the possibility that poorer taxpayers face tighter financial constraints in accessing private healthcare services. Higher-income individuals also report higher average costs for medical procedures and drugs, suggesting income-related differences in the composition and value of reported healthcare consumption. Since tax records measure declared, deductible and unreimbursed expenditure rather than actual healthcare needs or total healthcare consumption, the results should be read as evidence consistent with, but not definitive proof of, implicit healthcare expenditure rationing. KEYWORDS: Healthcare rationing out of pocket expenditure income-related inequality out-of-pocketout-of-pocket health expenditure JEL CLASSIFICATION: I14 I11 I12 I18 H24 Acknowledgements The authors gratefully acknowledge ACLI and CAF ACLI for providing access to the anonymized administrative tax-return data used in this study. We are especially grateful for their support in making available a unique dataset on tax-reported healthcare expenditure and taxpayer characteristics, which made it possible to analyse income-related differences in out-of-pocket healthcare expenditure in Italy. The data were used exclusively for research purposes and were processed in compliance with the applicable confidentiality and data-protection requirements. The authors remain solely responsible for the analysis, interpretation of the results, and any remaining errors.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709816.abstract_zh: 我们利用一个包含五年间超过600万条税务记录的独特数据库，研究了与收入相关的税收申报自付医疗支出差异。在控制可观测因素后，最低所得税档位的个人年均医疗支出比最高档位低约1，212欧元，此差异不包括国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的票务费用和残疾相关支出。个体固定效应估计显示，在纳税人内部，收入与税收申报医疗支出之间存在正相关关系，尽管这些估计应被视为描述性证据，而非未满足需求的因果估计。收入梯度在年长纳税人中更为显著，且最低收入档位的医疗支出收入弹性最高可达最高档位的三倍。这些模式与较贫困纳税人在获取私人医疗服务时面临更紧的财务约束的可能性一致。高收入个体还报告了更高的医疗程序和药品平均成本，表明报告医疗消费的构成和价值存在收入相关差异。由于税务记录衡量的是申报的、可扣除且未报销的支出，而非实际医疗需求或总医疗消费，因此结果应被视为与隐性医疗支出配给一致的证据，而非最终证明。关键词：医疗配给 自付支出 收入相关不平等 自付医疗支出 JEL分类：I14 I11 I12 I18 H24 致谢：作者衷心感谢ACLI和CAF ACLI提供本研究所用的匿名行政税务申报数据。我们特别感谢他们支持提供关于税收申报医疗支出和纳税人特征的独特数据集，这使得分析意大利自付医疗支出的收入相关差异成为可能。数据仅用于研究目的，并按照适用的保密和数据保护要求进行处理。作者对分析、结果解释及任何遗留错误负全责。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709816.title: Healthcare expenditure rationing: evidence from tax records
10.1080/00036846.2026.2709816.title_zh: 医疗支出配给：来自税收记录的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2710405.abstract: Supply chain disruption is a critical operational risk, yet how ESG misconduct affects supply chain stability remains underexplored. Using a BERT-based measure of supply chain disruption risk constructed from MD&A disclosures of Chinese listed firms, we find that ESG incidents significantly elevate supply chain disruption risk. This effect operates primarily through the customer channel, while supplier relationships remain largely unaffected. This asymmetry is consistent with customers facing lower switching costs and being more sensitive to supplier reputation. Quantile regressions reveal that the effect is more pronounced among firms already facing elevated supply chain risk. Cross-sectionally, the effect is stronger for smaller firms, non-state-owned enterprises, heavy-pollution industries, and periods of economic downturns. Community-oriented, diversity-related, and product-oriented CSR activities buffer ESG-induced supply chain risk, whereas environmental management and employee relations efforts do not, indicating that externally visible CSR carries insurance value. The effect persists approximately one to two years and ultimately impairs operating performance. Our findings identify ESG incidents as an important yet manageable driver of supply chain instability and highlight the strategic value of proactive ESG management and targeted CSR investment in sustaining supply chain resilience.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710405.abstract_zh: 供应链中断是一种关键运营风险，但ESG不当行为如何影响供应链稳定性仍未被充分探讨。利用基于BERT模型从中国上市公司MD&A披露中构建的供应链中断风险度量指标，我们发现ESG事件显著提升了供应链中断风险。这一效应主要通过客户渠道发挥作用，而供应商关系基本不受影响。这种不对称性与客户面临较低转换成本且对供应商声誉更为敏感的特征一致。分位数回归显示，在已面临较高供应链风险的企业中，该效应更为显著。横截面分析表明，该效应在规模较小企业、非国有企业、重污染行业以及经济下行时期更为突出。社区导向、多元化相关及产品导向的企业社会责任活动能够缓冲ESG引发的供应链风险，而环境管理与员工关系方面的努力则无此效果，这表明外部可见的企业社会责任具有保险价值。该效应持续约一至两年，并最终损害经营绩效。我们的研究揭示了ESG事件是供应链不稳定性的重要但可控驱动因素，并强调了主动ESG管理与针对性企业社会责任投资在维持供应链韧性方面的战略价值。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710405.title: The ripple effect of misconduct: ESG incidents and supply chain disruption risk
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710405.title_zh: 不当行为的涟漪效应：ESG事件与供应链中断风险

10.1080/00036846.2026.2710407.abstract: This paper empirically investigates the impact of the digital economy on firms’ low-carbon transition, using data on listed firms in the Chinese A-share market from 2013 to 2022. Our findings reveal that the digital economy notably drives their low-carbon transition, and this conclusion remains robust to stability tests and controls for endogeneity. The mediating effect test outcomes indicate that the digital economy can facilitate firms’ transition to low-carbon operations through industrial structure upgrading. The moderating effect analysis exhibits that the intensity of market competition strengthens this facilitating effect on firms’ low-carbon transition. The heterogeneity analysis demonstrates that this facilitating effect is more pronounced among state-owned enterprises, declining firms, digital economy firms, and technology-intensive enterprises. Furthermore, the spillover effect test results indicate significant spillover effects of the digital economy among peer firms, categorized by industry and city. Our study elaborates on the underlying mediating pathways through which the digital economy indirectly drives this transition via industrial structure upgrading, alongside the moderating role of market competition intensity. This work broadens the theoretical research framework on transformation dynamics and provides decision-making references for formulating industrial upgrading guidance policies and optimizing the market competition landscape. KEYWORDS: Digital economy firms’ low-carbon transition industrial structure upgrading market competition intensity JEL CLASSIFICATION: F63 F61 L23 Q50 Acknowledgements Thank you for the funding of the Western Project of the National Social Science Fund of China [24XGL001], Gansu Provincial University Teacher Innovation fund Project No. [2024B-092], and Gansu Provincial University Teacher Innovation Fund Project No. [2025A-076].
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710407.abstract_zh: 本文利用2013—2022年中国A股市场上市公司数据，实证考察了数字经济对企业低碳转型的影响。研究发现，数字经济显著推动了企业低碳转型，该结论在稳定性检验和内生性控制后依然稳健。中介效应检验结果表明，数字经济能够通过产业结构升级促进企业低碳转型。调节效应分析显示，市场竞争强度强化了这一促进效应。异质性分析表明，该促进效应在国有企业、衰退型企业、数字经济企业及技术密集型企业中更为显著。此外，溢出效应检验结果显示，数字经济在同行业、同城市的企业间存在显著的空间溢出效应。本研究揭示了数字经济通过产业结构升级间接驱动企业低碳转型的中介路径，以及市场竞争强度的调节作用，拓展了转型动因的理论研究框架，并为制定产业升级引导政策、优化市场竞争格局提供了决策参考。关键词：数字经济；企业低碳转型；产业结构升级；市场竞争强度 JEL分类号：F63 F61 L23 Q50 致谢：感谢国家社会科学基金西部项目[24XGL001]、甘肃省高等学校教师创新基金项目[2024B-092]及甘肃省高等学校教师创新基金项目[2025A-076]的资助。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710407.title: Driving green growth: the asymmetric impact of the digital economy on firms’ low-carbon transition in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710407.title_zh: 驱动绿色增长：数字经济对中国企业低碳转型的非对称影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2710409.abstract: Using data from 29 regional housing markets in China, this study examines the long-run relationships between housing prices and key macroeconomic variables. Conventional cointegration methods can be misleading, as estimated coefficients often contradict standard demand–supply theory even when statistical tests indicate cointegration. Among the variables, only real income consistently explains regional housing price dynamics, whereas real interest rates and building costs fail to do so consistently across markets. Region-specific models reveal substantial heterogeneity and are both statistically robust and economically meaningful. Panel cointegration tests that account for cross-sectional dependence fail to detect cointegration when such heterogeneity is ignored. These findings highlight the limitations of uniform national approaches and underscore the need for tailored, region-specific housing policies. KEYWORDS: Housing market cointegration dynamic ordinary least squares panel cointegration test with CSD disaggregated regional data JEL CLASSIFICATION: R30 E00 C51
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710409.abstract_zh: 本研究利用中国29个区域住房市场的数据，探讨了房价与关键宏观经济变量之间的长期关系。传统的协整方法可能产生误导，因为即便统计检验表明存在协整，估计系数也常常与标准供需理论相悖。在各类变量中，仅实际收入能一致地解释区域房价动态，而实际利率和建筑成本则无法在各市场间保持一致的解释力。区域特定模型揭示了显著的异质性，既在统计上稳健，又在经济上具有意义。当忽略这种异质性时，考虑横截面依赖性的面板协整检验未能检测到协整关系。这些发现凸显了统一全国性方法的局限性，并强调了制定针对性的区域住房政策的必要性。关键词：住房市场协整 动态普通最小二乘法 考虑横截面依赖性的面板协整检验 分类区域数据 JEL分类：R30 E00 C51
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710409.title: When cointegration misleads: regional evidence on the determinants of housing prices in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710409.title_zh: 当协整误导：中国房价决定因素的区域证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2710410.abstract: A better understanding of the effectiveness of grassroots coping measures against existing shocks is essential in case similar events arise in the future. This study examines how rural villages coped with off-farm employment shocks during the COVID-19 pandemic, using a panel dataset of 800 households in 100 villages across 25 counties in five provinces. Our data show that between the COVID-19 outbreak and April 2020, up to 81% of villages adopted at least one measure to support off-farm employment, such as providing job information, job offers and transportation subsidies or services. Regression results from both Propensity Score Matching and Instrumental Variable approaches consistently show that providing job information with job offers significantly reduced the probability of exiting off-farm employment and reducing working hours. Providing job information alone also reduced the probability of working fewer hours, but with little heterogeneous effects by gender, education or the village’s economic status. These findings provide valuable insights for other developing countries and can help inform policymakers about the effectiveness of grassroots responses to off-farm employment shocks. KEYWORDS: Off-farm employment grassroots coping measures extensive and intensive margin responses COVID-19 Instrumental Variable JEL CLASSIFICATION: J21 J48 Acknowledgements We acknowledge the financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant Numbers 72373140 and 71903185).
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710410.abstract_zh: 更深入地理解基层应对现有冲击措施的有效性，对于未来类似事件的发生至关重要。本研究利用覆盖五省25县100个村庄800户家庭的面板数据集，考察了农村村庄在COVID-19疫情期间如何应对非农就业冲击。数据显示，从疫情爆发至2020年4月，高达81%的村庄至少采取了一项支持非农就业的措施，如提供就业信息、工作机会及交通补贴或服务。基于倾向得分匹配和工具变量方法的回归结果一致表明，提供就业信息并附带工作机会显著降低了退出非农就业和减少工作时间的概率。仅提供就业信息也降低了工作时间减少的概率，但在性别、教育程度或村庄经济状况方面几乎没有异质性效应。这些发现为其他发展中国家提供了宝贵见解，并有助于政策制定者了解基层应对非农就业冲击的有效性。关键词：非农就业；基层应对措施；广延边际与集约边际响应；COVID-19；工具变量JEL分类：J21 J48致谢：我们感谢国家自然科学基金（项目编号72373140和71903185）的资助。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710410.title: Coping with off-farm employment shocks at the grassroots level in rural areas: evidence from the COVID-19 pandemic in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710410.title_zh: 农村基层应对非农就业冲击：来自中国新冠疫情的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2710897.abstract: With the rapid development of China’s FinTech, this study considers China as an example to explore the impact of FinTech on vertical integration in developing countries. The research results reveal the following. First, the development of FinTech has significantly increased vertical integration, indicating that FinTech can enhance the security of industrial and supply chains. Second, such development has reduced the information asymmetry between banks and enterprises and alleviated the financing constraints of enterprises. Third, it has also improved the digital management level of enterprises and enhanced their internal governance ability. Fourth, FinTech is more conducive to increasing vertical integration in private enterprises, smaller enterprises, start-up and growth-stage enterprises, high-tech industry enterprises, and export enterprises.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710897.abstract_zh: 随着中国金融科技的快速发展，本研究以中国为例，探讨金融科技对发展中国家垂直整合的影响。研究结果揭示：第一，金融科技的发展显著提升了垂直整合水平，表明金融科技能够增强产业链与供应链的安全性；第二，这种发展降低了银行与企业间的信息不对称，缓解了企业的融资约束；第三，金融科技还提高了企业的数字化管理水平，增强了其内部治理能力；第四，金融科技更有利于提升民营企业、小型企业、初创及成长期企业、高技术产业企业以及出口企业的垂直整合程度。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710897.title: FinTech and vertical integration in emerging economies: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710897.title_zh: 金融科技与新兴经济体的垂直整合：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2710898.abstract: China launched a pilot value-added tax reform in 2004 that allowed eligible firms to deduct input VAT on purchases of fixed assets, thereby lowering the user cost of capital. Using firm-level panel data from 2001 to 2008 and a difference-in-differences design, we find that the reform increased treated firms’ carbon productivity by approximately 28%. The effect emerged gradually and peaked in 2006. Mechanism eviden.ce suggests that the improvement was more closely associated with higher R&D investment and gains in total factor productivity than with simple input expansion. The results suggest that general-purpose investment policies can deliver climate co-benefits by promoting innovation and resource efficiency, even without explicit environmental objectives.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710898.abstract_zh: 中国于2004年启动了增值税改革试点，允许符合条件的企业在购置固定资产时抵扣进项增值税，从而降低了资本使用成本。利用2001年至2008年的企业层面面板数据及双重差分设计，我们发现该改革使受处理企业的碳生产率提高了约28%。这一效应逐步显现，并于2006年达到峰值。机制证据表明，这一改善与研发投入增加及全要素生产率提升的关联更为紧密，而非简单的投入扩张。研究结果表明，即使没有明确的环境目标，通用型投资政策也能通过促进创新和资源效率，带来气候协同效益。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710898.title: How do capital tax incentives affect carbon productivity? Evidence from China’s VAT reform
10.1080/00036846.2026.2710898.title_zh: 资本税收激励如何影响碳生产率？来自中国增值税改革的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2711828.abstract: Enhancing supply chain transparency through corporate social responsibility (CSR) disclosure has become a key instrument of sustainability governance. Yet whether such mandates alter cross-border supply chain configurations remains theoretically debated and empirically unresolved. Using Chinese listed firms from 2010 to 2022, this study examines the impact of the EU Non-Financial Reporting Directive (NFRD) on supply chain relationships between Chinese suppliers and EU customers. We document a significant decoupling effect: after the NFRD, Chinese firms experience a substantial reduction in EU customer ties, especially when they had low pre-treatment CSR performance. Cross-sectional analysis reveals that the impact of the NFRD on the customer relationships of Chinese firms is more pronounced when supply chain CSR risk visibility is higher and the transmission of regulatory pressure from customers is greater. By identifying the cross-border spillover effects of a unilateral disclosure policy on firms in a non-implementing country, this study provides evidence on the real effects of mandatory CSR disclosure on global supply chain restructuring. KEYWORDS: Social responsibility mandatory disclosure supply chain disruption emerging market JEL CLASSIFICATION: M14 G38 L14
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711828.abstract_zh: 通过企业社会责任（CSR）披露提升供应链透明度已成为可持续治理的关键工具。然而，此类强制要求是否会改变跨境供应链配置，在理论上仍存争议，且缺乏实证证据。本研究以2010至2022年中国上市公司为样本，考察欧盟《非财务报告指令》（NFRD）对中国供应商与欧盟客户之间供应链关系的影响。我们发现了显著的脱钩效应：NFRD实施后，中国企业拥有的欧盟客户关系大幅减少，尤其当这些企业在指令实施前CSR表现较差时更为明显。横截面分析表明，当供应链CSR风险可见度更高、客户传递的监管压力更大时，NFRD对中国企业客户关系的影响更为突出。通过识别单边披露政策对非实施国企业的跨境溢出效应，本研究为强制性CSR披露对全球供应链重构的真实影响提供了证据。关键词：社会责任 强制披露 供应链中断 新兴市场 JEL分类：M14 G38 L14
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711828.title: Mandatory social responsibility disclosure and supply chain disruptions: evidence from emerging markets
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711828.title_zh: 强制性社会责任披露与供应链中断：来自新兴市场的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2711831.abstract: Strengthening manufacturing industry chain resilience has become a strategic priority for China amid global supply-chain restructuring. This article investigates whether and how digital finance enhances manufacturing industry chain resilience, with particular attention to threshold-dependent nonlinearities shaped by labour market conditions. Using panel data on 30 Chinese provinces from 2011 to 2022, we employ two-way fixed-effects regressions, instrumental variable (IV) estimation and panel threshold models. The results show that digital finance significantly enhances manufacturing industry chain resilience. This effect is nonlinear: it intensifies in a stepwise manner as digital finance develops. Human capital amplifies the effect once average schooling exceeds a critical threshold, whereas labour market segmentation weakens it beyond a corresponding threshold. The benefits are also more pronounced in provinces with well-developed digital infrastructure and larger manufacturing scale. This study is the first to identify labour market segmentation as a threshold variable in the digital finance–resilience nexus. Theoretically, it shows that the resilience dividend of digital finance is conditional on both its own maturity and labour market institutions; practically, it offers guidance for sequencing digital finance and labour market reforms across regions. KEYWORDS: Digital finance industry chain resilience threshold effect human capital labour market segmentation JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 L60 J24 R12
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711831.abstract_zh: 在全球供应链重构背景下，增强制造业产业链韧性已成为中国的战略优先事项。本文考察数字金融是否以及如何提升制造业产业链韧性，特别关注劳动力市场条件所塑造的门限依赖型非线性特征。基于2011至2022年中国30个省份的面板数据，本文采用双向固定效应回归、工具变量（IV）估计和面板门限模型。研究结果表明，数字金融显著增强制造业产业链韧性。该效应具有非线性特征：随着数字金融的发展，其效应呈阶梯式增强。当平均受教育年限超过临界阈值时，人力资本会放大该效应；而当劳动力市场分割超过相应阈值时，则会削弱该效应。此外，在数字基础设施完善和制造业规模较大的省份，该效应更为显著。本研究首次将劳动力市场分割识别为数字金融—韧性关联中的门限变量。在理论上，本文揭示了数字金融的韧性红利取决于其自身成熟度与劳动力市场制度的双重条件；在实践上，为各地区数字金融与劳动力市场改革的时序安排提供了政策参考。关键词：数字金融；产业链韧性；门限效应；人力资本；劳动力市场分割 JEL分类号：G21 L60 J24 R12
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711831.title: The impact of digital finance on manufacturing industry chain resilience: a labour market perspective
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711831.title_zh: 数字金融对制造业产业链韧性的影响：基于劳动力市场的视角

10.1080/00036846.2026.2711832.abstract: Digital finance is reshaping financial institutions, but its relationship with efficiency remains unclear. This study examines whether regional digital insurance development is associated with the efficiency of Chinese insurers. Using an unbalanced panel from 2016 to 2023, efficiency is estimated by data envelopment analysis (DEA) efficiency scores, while regional digital insurance exposure is constructed from provincial digital insurance development and insurers’ geographic premium distribution. The results show no significant contemporaneous or nonlinear association, whereas one-year-lagged exposure is positively associated with efficiency. The clearest channel-consistent evidence appears on the asset side, where lagged exposure is positively related to investment returns, which are associated with efficiency. Liability-side indicators provide limited support, and the lagged coefficient does not differ significantly across insurer types. The findings are robust to an alternative efficiency measure, Tobit estimators, a longer lag and a lead placebo. Overall, regional digital insurance development appears to be an enabling condition whose efficiency implications emerge over time. KEYWORDS: Digital finance digital insurance exposure operating efficiency insurance firms data envelopment analysis JEL CLASSIFICATION: G22 O33 C14
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711832.abstract_zh: 数字金融正在重塑金融机构，但其与效率之间的关系仍不明确。本研究考察区域数字保险发展是否与中国保险公司的效率相关。利用2016年至2023年的非平衡面板数据，通过数据包络分析（DEA）效率得分估算效率，同时基于省级数字保险发展及保险公司地理保费分布构建区域数字保险暴露指标。结果显示，当期暴露与效率之间不存在显著的同期或非线性关联，而滞后一年的暴露与效率呈正相关。最清晰的渠道一致性证据出现在资产端，滞后暴露与投资回报正相关，而投资回报又与效率相关。负债端指标提供的支持有限，且滞后系数在不同类型保险公司之间无显著差异。上述发现在替代效率度量、Tobit估计、更长滞后期及前置安慰剂检验下均保持稳健。总体而言，区域数字保险发展似乎是一种赋能条件，其对效率的影响随时间逐步显现。关键词：数字金融；数字保险暴露；经营效率；保险公司；数据包络分析 JEL分类：G22 O33 C14
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711832.title: Digital insurance development and firm operating efficiency: evidence from Chinese insurers
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711832.title_zh: 数字保险发展与企业经营效率：来自中国保险公司的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2711834.abstract: Tax incentive policies are widely used to foster green innovation, but their supply-chain spillovers remain underexamined. This paper explores the impact of upstream and downstream firms’ tax incentives on midstream enterprises’ green innovation using China’s National Enterprise Tax Survey Data and listed firm data spanning 2008–2016. Baseline estimates indicate that downstream tax-incentive exposure is positively and statistically significantly associated with midstream green innovation, whereas no robust statistically significant association is found for upstream exposure. Innovation-composition tests further show that downstream exposure is associated with more green patent applications, a higher green share, fewer non-green patent applications, and no statistically significant change in total patent applications, indicating a green-oriented reallocation rather than a general expansion of innovation. On this basis, this paper further takes China’s 2014 Accelerated Depreciation Policy for Fixed Assets as a quasi-natural experiment and applies the Double Machine Learning (DML) method to provide policy-based identification evidence on tax incentives and supply-chain green innovation spillovers. Mechanism analysis provides evidence consistent with liquidity, corporate-vitality, and ESG-related channels. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the downstream coefficient is larger and statistically significant among midstream enterprises facing stricter environmental regulation, employing executives with environmental backgrounds, or receiving greater media attention. KEYWORDS: Tax reduction incentives supply chain spillovers green innovation double machine learning JEL CLASSIFICATION: H23 Q55 O38
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711834.abstract_zh: 税收激励政策被广泛用于促进绿色创新，但其供应链溢出效应尚未得到充分研究。本文利用2008-2016年中国全国企业税收调查数据和上市公司数据，探讨上下游企业税收激励对中游企业绿色创新的影响。基准估计表明，下游税收激励暴露与中游绿色创新呈正向且统计显著的相关关系，而上游暴露则未发现稳健的统计显著关联。创新构成检验进一步显示，下游暴露与更多绿色专利申请、更高绿色占比、更少非绿色专利申请相关，而专利申请总量无统计显著变化，表明这是一种绿色导向的重新配置而非创新的普遍扩张。在此基础上，本文进一步以中国2014年固定资产加速折旧政策为准自然实验，采用双机器学习方法，为税收激励与供应链绿色创新溢出提供基于政策的识别证据。机制分析提供了与流动性、企业活力及ESG相关渠道一致的证据。异质性分析表明，在面临更严格环境规制、拥有环境背景高管或受到更多媒体关注的中游企业中，下游系数更大且统计显著。关键词：减税激励 供应链溢出 绿色创新 双机器学习 JEL分类：H23 Q55 O38
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711834.title: The external effects of tax reduction incentive policies on green innovation – from the perspective of supply chain spillovers
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711834.title_zh: 减税激励政策对绿色创新的外部效应——基于供应链溢出视角

10.1080/00036846.2026.2711836.abstract: This study examines how corporate green innovation is influenced by ultimate controlling shareholders, which we categorize into three institutional types: central government, local government, and private entities. Using 29,926 firm-year observations of A-share listed firms from 2009 to 2023 and panel fixed-effects models with industry-year and province-year joint fixed effects, we find that central state-owned enterprises (SOEs) significantly outperform others in green innovation willingness, quantity, and quality, while local SOEs and private enterprises show no significant difference. Mechanism tests reveal that central state-owned enterprises’ green innovation advantage is driven by greater social responsibility, whereas local state-owned enterprises’ regulatory bargaining power dampens their green innovation. Further analysis shows that central SOEs and local SOEs exhibit a stronger emphasis on non-R&D environmental transformation activities than private enterprises, suggesting differentiated compliance strategies across ownership types. These findings extend the ownership-innovation literature by demonstrating that the ownership hierarchy established for general innovation does not necessarily hold in the context of corporate green innovation, and provide new insights into the mechanisms through which state capitalism shapes firms’ green innovation. KEYWORDS: Green innovation state capitalism ultimate controlling shareholders responsible investment bargaining power JEL CLASSIFICATION: G32 G34 M14 Acknowledgements The authors express their gratitude to Dr. Jing Zhang of Xiamen University of Technology for her insightful comments. Any remaining errors are solely our responsibility.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711836.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了终极控制股东如何影响企业绿色创新，我们将终极控制股东划分为三种制度类型：中央政府、地方政府和私人实体。基于2009年至2023年间A股上市公司29,926个公司-年度观测值，并采用行业-年份和省份-年份联合固定效应的面板固定效应模型，我们发现中央国有企业（SOEs）在绿色创新意愿、数量和质量上显著优于其他类型企业，而地方国有企业和私营企业之间则无显著差异。机制检验揭示，中央国有企业的绿色创新优势源于更强的社会责任承担，而地方国有企业的监管议价能力则抑制了其绿色创新。进一步分析表明，中央国有企业和地方国有企业在非研发环境转型活动上的重视程度高于私营企业，这表明不同所有权类型的企业采取了差异化的合规策略。这些发现拓展了所有权-创新文献，证明了为一般创新建立的所有权层级在绿色创新背景下并不必然成立，并为国家资本主义如何塑造企业绿色创新的机制提供了新的见解。关键词：绿色创新；国家资本主义；终极控制股东；责任投资；议价能力JEL分类：G32 G34 M14致谢：作者感谢厦门理工学院张静博士的 insightful 评论。文中任何错误均由我们自行承担。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711836.title: Does state capitalism always lead corporate green technology innovation? Evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2711836.title_zh: 国家资本主义是否总能促进企业绿色技术创新？来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2712576.abstract: This study examines the impact of clean production on export product quality by focusing on a key whole-process environmental regulation policy in China. Using a difference-in-differences approach and firm-level microdata, we find that the policy significantly improves export product quality and can explain 3.3% of the one standard deviation change in the export product quality of firms covered by the policy. Mechanism analysis shows that the policy functions through three interconnected channels: factor reallocation in source prevention, innovation compensation in production processes, and product transformation in end-of-pipe treatment. Additional analysis reveals stronger positive impacts on non-state-owned firms, large firms, and firms located in regions with high environmental regulation intensity. This study highlights the significant environmental and economic benefits of shifting from end-of-pipe pollution control to process control in production. KEYWORDS: Clean production environmental regulation product quality end-of-pipe treatment JEL CLASSIFICATION: F10 F12 F18 Acknowledgements We would like to thank Editage (www.editage.cn) for English language editing. All the authors have made important contributions to the study. Material preparation, data collection and analysis were performed by Tao Lin and Xiaoqing Ming. The first draft of the manuscript was written by Xiaoqing Ming, Tao Lin and Beili Liu, and all authors commented on previous versions of the manuscript.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2712576.abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于中国一项关键的全过程环境规制政策，探讨清洁生产对出口产品质量的影响。采用双重差分法与企业层面微观数据，我们发现该政策显著提升了出口产品质量，并能解释受政策覆盖企业出口产品质量一个标准差变动的3.3%。机制分析表明，该政策通过三个相互关联的渠道发挥作用：源头预防中的要素重新配置、生产过程中的创新补偿以及末端治理中的产品转型。进一步分析显示，该政策对非国有企业、大型企业以及位于环境规制强度较高地区的企业具有更强的正向影响。本研究凸显了从末端污染控制转向生产过程控制所带来的显著环境与经济效益。关键词：清洁生产；环境规制；产品质量；末端治理；JEL分类：F10 F12 F18 致谢：我们感谢意得辑（www.editage.cn）提供的英文语言编辑服务。所有作者均对本研究做出了重要贡献。材料准备、数据收集与分析由陶林和明晓清完成。论文初稿由明晓清、陶林和刘贝利撰写，所有作者对先前版本的手稿提出了意见。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2712576.title: Beyond end-of-pipe treatment: how whole-process clean production shapes export product quality
10.1080/00036846.2026.2712576.title_zh: 超越末端治理：全过程清洁生产如何影响出口产品质量

10.1080/00036846.2026.2712580.abstract: This study investigates the social, economic, cultural, and infrastructural factors associated with circular economy (CE) practices across 22 districts of Tehran from 2019 to 2023. Using recorded dry waste generation as an imperfect proxy for certain dimensions of circular economy behaviour, the analysis employs conventional and spatial panel data models to capture inter-district interactions and spillover effects. The results show that municipal revenues, urban infrastructure quality, demographic characteristics, and socioeconomic conditions significantly shape dry waste generation patterns and outcomes consistent with elements of circular economy behaviour. Higher municipal revenues and improved infrastructure (measured through both incident reports and the availability of public green spaces) are associated with lower per capita dry waste, with notable positive spillover effects on neighbouring districts. Demographic factors, particularly family size, also influence waste outcomes linked to circularity, while traditional lifestyles and poverty exhibit intertwined and mixed effects. The COVID-19 pandemic further contributed to temporary reductions in dry waste generation, with spatially diffused impacts across districts. Spatial panel results highlight strong inter-district dependencies, underscoring the importance of regional coordination in CE policy design. Overall, the study demonstrates that effective CE strategies in urban areas require integrated economic, infrastructural, and social interventions, alongside collaborative governance across districts.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2712580.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了2019至2023年间德黑兰22个区循环经济实践相关的社会、经济、文化和基础设施因素。以记录的干垃圾产生量作为循环经济行为某些维度的不完全代理指标，分析采用常规及空间面板数据模型，以捕捉区域间互动与溢出效应。结果显示，市政收入、城市基础设施质量、人口特征和社会经济条件显著影响干垃圾产生模式及与循环经济行为要素相符的结果。较高的市政收入和改善的基础设施（通过事件报告和公共绿地可用性衡量）与人均干垃圾减少相关，并对邻近区域产生显著的正向溢出效应。人口因素，尤其是家庭规模，也影响与循环性相关的垃圾结果，而传统生活方式和贫困则表现出交织且混合的影响。新冠疫情进一步导致干垃圾产生量暂时减少，其影响在区域间呈空间扩散。空间面板结果凸显了区域间强烈的相互依赖性，强调了循环经济政策设计中区域协调的重要性。总体而言，研究表明，城市有效的循环经济策略需要经济、基础设施和社会干预的综合措施，以及跨区域的协作治理。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2712580.title: Patterns associated with circular economy practices: socioeconomic and infrastructural insights from Tehran
10.1080/00036846.2026.2712580.title_zh: 循环经济实践相关模式：德黑兰的社会经济与基础设施洞察

10.1080/00036846.2026.2714937.abstract: This paper exploits a quasi-natural experiment provided by China’s Province-Managing-County (PMC) fiscal reform to examine the impact of fiscal decentralization on under-five mortality. Using a county-level panel dataset from 1999 to 2012 matched with county-level under-five mortality data, we employ a staggered DID design to identify the health effect of fiscal decentralization. The results show that the PMC fiscal reform significantly increased county-level under-five mortality, an increase of approximately 1.02–1.51 deaths per 1,000 live births. The reduction in the provision of public healthcare services and increases in air pollution are two potential channels through which the reform adversely affects under-five mortality. The adverse effect can be strengthened by fiscal pressures,legal transparency and political promotion incentives of local officials. KEYWORDS: Fiscal decentralization healthcare under-five mortality JEL CLASSIFICATION: H75 H77 I18
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714937.abstract_zh: 本文利用中国省直管县财政改革所提供的准自然实验，考察了财政分权对五岁以下儿童死亡率的影响。基于1999年至2012年的县级面板数据，并匹配县级五岁以下儿童死亡率数据，我们采用交错双重差分设计来识别财政分权的健康效应。研究结果显示，省直管县财政改革显著提高了县级五岁以下儿童死亡率，每千例活产婴儿中死亡人数增加约1.02至1.51人。公共卫生服务供给的减少以及空气污染的加剧，是改革对五岁以下儿童死亡率产生不利影响的两条潜在渠道。财政压力、法律透明度以及地方官员的政治晋升激励会强化这一不利影响。关键词：财政分权；医疗卫生；五岁以下儿童死亡率 JEL分类号：H75 H77 I18

10.1080/00036846.2026.2714938.abstract: This paper examines the underexplored role of China’s policy bank loans as a countercyclical tool for stabilizing economic fluctuations, complementing conventional fiscal and monetary policies. Utilizing panel data on Chinese listed companies from 2005 to 2023, we demonstrate that policy bank loans effectively mitigate the adverse impacts of economic downturns, and ensure corporate value stability during periods of contraction. The research further identifies that the countercyclical effect of these loans is influenced by both internal factors, including political and economic stability and tax revenue growth, as well as external factors such as global financial uncertainty. Additionally, the study highlights the complementary role of policy bank loans alongside conventional stabilization measures, strengthening the combined capacity to enhance macroeconomic stability. KEYWORDS: Policy banks countercyclical listed firms economic stability JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 G32
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714938.abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国政策性银行贷款作为稳定经济波动的逆周期工具这一尚未充分研究的角色，其与常规财政和货币政策形成互补。利用2005年至2023年中国上市公司的面板数据，我们证明政策性银行贷款能够有效缓解经济下行带来的不利影响，并在经济收缩期间保障企业价值稳定。研究进一步识别出，这些贷款的逆周期效应受到内部因素（包括政治与经济稳定性及税收增长）和外部因素（如全球金融不确定性）的共同影响。此外，研究强调了政策性银行贷款与常规稳定措施之间的互补作用，增强了共同提升宏观经济稳定的能力。关键词：政策性银行 逆周期 上市公司 经济稳定 JEL分类：G21 G32

10.1080/00036846.2026.2714938.title_zh: 逆周期政策性银行贷款与经济稳定：来自中国上市公司的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2714939.abstract: This article examines meat consumption behaviour across four meat categories (pork, beef, poultry and lamb) in urban and rural China through a dynamic demand system that accounts for habit formation and pre-committed effects. Based on provincial‑level data spanning the period 2015 to 2022, estimation results show that all categories are habitual, with beef being the most habitual and rural consumers displaying stronger habit formation. A higher level of pre-committed consumption is observed for pork relative to other categories, indicating that pork retains its position as a dietary staple among Chinese consumers, while pre-committed consumption for poultry is negative, reflecting its flexible and price-responsive role in household meat budgets. Demographic variables, including population growth and family size, are shown to significantly shape meat demand in urban areas, while ageing plays an important role in all four meat categories among rural consumers. Long-term elasticity prediction suggests that beef and poultry are likely to take a larger portion of future meat expenditure. Our findings provide empirical support for policymakers and industry stakeholders regarding future meat consumption, showing poultry can serve as a cost-effective substitute for pork and other red meats, while emphasizing the need to improve the supply chain resilience of beef production in China. 10.1080/00036846.2026.2714939.abstract_zh: 本文通过一个考虑习惯形成和预先承诺效应的动态需求系统，考察了中国城镇和农村地区四类肉类（猪肉、牛肉、禽肉和羊肉）的消费行为。基于2015年至2022年的省级面板数据，估计结果显示所有肉类类别均具有习惯形成特征，其中牛肉的习惯形成最为显著，且农村消费者的习惯形成更强。与其它肉类类别相比，猪肉的预先承诺消费水平较高，表明猪肉在中国消费者饮食结构中仍保持主食地位，而禽肉的预先承诺消费为负值，反映出其在家庭肉类预算中具有灵活且价格敏感的作用。人口统计变量，包括人口增长和家庭规模，显著影响城镇地区的肉类需求，而老龄化对农村消费者所有四类肉类的需求均具有重要作用。长期弹性预测表明，牛肉和禽肉在未来肉类消费支出中所占比重可能更大。我们的研究结果为政策制定者和行业相关方提供了关于未来肉类消费的实证支持，表明禽肉可作为猪肉及其它红肉的经济有效替代品，同时强调提升中国牛肉生产供应链韧性的必要性。关键词：肉类消费 习惯形成 预先承诺效应 消费者行为 动态AIDS方法 JEL分类：Q11 Q18 D11 D12 Q10 致谢：感谢堪萨斯州立大学的Allen Featherstone、Edward Perry、Glynn Tonsor、Yangming Chang，亚利桑那州立大学的Justin Bina，肯塔基大学的Yuqing Zheng，佐治亚大学的Chen Zhen，以及密歇根州立大学的Jaime Luke提供的宝贵反馈和指导。

10.1080/00036846.2026.2714940.abstract: Using A-share listed firms from the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges between 2007 and 2021 as the research sample, this article examines the impact of merchant guild culture on the speed at which firms adjust towards their target level of tax avoidance. The baseline results show that merchant guild culture significantly accelerates the adjustment speed. Mechanism analyses show that merchant guild culture enhances adjustment speed by improving internal coordination efficiency and reducing agency costs. Further research reveals that the enhancing effect of merchant guild culture on the adjustment speed is more pronounced when the actual level of tax avoidance is below the target. The promoting effect of merchant guild culture on tax adjustment speed is more evident in firms where the chairman’s place of origin or birthplace matches the registered location of the listed firm, those facing stronger product market competition, and those located in regions with weaker tax enforcement. This article not only identifies a new factor influencing tax avoidance adjustments, addressing a gap in the existing literature, but also examines the economic consequences of merchant guild culture from the perspective of tax management, providing insights into how merchant guild culture shapes corporate behaviour. KEYWORDS: Merchant guild culture target level of tax avoidance adjustment speed corporate governance JEL CLASSIFICATION: H26 M14
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714940.abstract_zh: 以2007—2021年沪深A股上市公司为研究样本，本文考察了商帮文化对企业向目标避税水平调整速度的影响。基准结果表明，商帮文化显著加快了企业避税调整速度。机制分析显示，商帮文化通过提升内部协调效率和降低代理成本来加快调整速度。进一步研究发现，当实际避税水平低于目标水平时，商帮文化对调整速度的促进作用更为显著。商帮文化对避税调整速度的促进效应在董事长籍贯或出生地与上市公司注册地一致的企业、面临更强产品市场竞争的企业以及位于税收征管较弱地区的企业中更为明显。本文不仅识别了影响避税调整的新因素，弥补了现有文献的空白，还从税收管理视角考察了商帮文化的经济后果，为理解商帮文化如何塑造企业行为提供了启示。关键词：商帮文化；目标避税水平；调整速度；公司治理 JEL分类：H26；M14
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714940.title: Merchant guild culture and dynamic adjustment of corporate tax avoidance: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714940.title_zh: 商帮文化与企业避税的动态调整——来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2714942.abstract: Skill shortages are a type of skill mismatch whereby employers are unable to fill existing vacancies due to a lack of suitably qualified or skilled candidates. Despite representing a significant concern for policymakers, the literature on skill shortages is highly underdeveloped, as a result of a lack of clarity and consistency on how skill shortages are defined and measured. In this study, using data from the 2021 European Skills and Jobs Survey combined with Lightcast job advertisement data, we attempt to bridge the methodological gap by developing a measure of potential skill shortages that can be readily replicated across countries over time. Benchmarking an objective measurement approach to a dataset reflecting the current distribution of skills and competencies being utilized within the labour market constitutes, in our view, a novelty within the skill shortages measurement literature.
