We estimate that approximately two per cent of vacancies in the EU are likely to experience skill shortages. We find substantial variation in estimates across occupations and countries. Moreover, potential skill shortages tend to be in occupations within which the skill content is changing more rapidly over time. Acknowledgements We would like to express our gratitude to the participants of the Cedefop research conference ‘ Using data from the web to shape next-generation labour market and skills analysis’ , hosted by the European Economic and Social Committee (Brussels, April 2025) for their invaluable feedback and constructive suggestions.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714942.abstract_zh: 技能短缺是一种技能错配类型，即雇主因缺乏具备适当资格或技能的候选人而无法填补现有职位空缺。尽管这已成为政策制定者关注的重要问题，但由于对技能短缺的定义和测量缺乏清晰性和一致性，相关文献仍极为不完善。本研究利用2021年欧洲技能与就业调查数据，结合Lightcast招聘广告数据，试图通过开发一种可随时跨国家、跨时间复制的潜在技能短缺测量方法来弥合方法论上的差距。我们认为，将客观测量方法对标于反映劳动力市场中当前技能与能力分布状况的数据集，是技能短缺测量文献中的一项创新。我们估计，欧盟约2%的职位空缺可能面临技能短缺。研究发现，不同职业和国家之间的估计值存在显著差异。此外，潜在技能短缺往往集中在技能内容随时间变化更快的职业中。致谢：我们谨向欧洲经济社会委员会主办的Cedefop研究会议“利用网络数据塑造下一代劳动力市场与技能分析”（布鲁塞尔，2025年4月）的与会者表示诚挚感谢，感谢他们宝贵的反馈和建设性建议。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714942.title: Developing a new European indicator of potential skill shortages
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714942.title_zh: 构建欧洲潜在技能短缺新指标

10.1080/00036846.2026.2714944.abstract: Agricultural machinery operators constitute a crucial skilled workforce for mechanization service provision, but population ageing and rural labour outmigration are threatening the continuity of this workforce and the transmission of its operational skills. Using survey data from 2,458 agricultural machinery operators across five provinces in China, this study examines whether cooperative membership promotes apprenticeship-based skill transmission. The baseline results show that cooperative membership is significantly and positively associated with skill transmission. The results are robust to IV Poisson estimation, propensity score matching, and a negative binomial specification. Mechanism analysis suggests that cooperative membership may promote skill transmission by enhancing operators’ occupational identity and expanding their business volume. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that this positive association is stronger among multi-skilled operators and non-cross-regional operators. Additional analysis of operators who have not yet trained apprentices indicates that cooperative membership also increases their willingness and plans for future skill transmission. These findings suggest that cooperatives not only organize mechanization services and facilitate technology diffusion, but also serve as important platforms for agricultural human capital formation. KEYWORDS: Skill transmission apprenticeship training cooperative membership agricultural mechanization agricultural machinery operators JEL CLASSIFICATION: J24 J43 O15
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714944.abstract_zh: 农业机械操作人员是机械化服务供给的关键技能型劳动力，但人口老龄化和农村劳动力外流正威胁着这一劳动力队伍的延续及其操作技能的传承。利用中国五省2458名农业机械操作人员的调查数据，本研究考察了合作社成员身份是否促进基于学徒制的技能传承。基准结果表明，合作社成员身份与技能传承呈显著正相关。该结果在工具变量泊松估计、倾向得分匹配和负二项回归设定下均保持稳健。机制分析表明，合作社成员身份可能通过增强操作人员的职业认同感和扩大其业务规模来促进技能传承。异质性分析进一步显示，这一正向关联在多项技能操作人员和跨区域作业操作人员中更为显著。对尚未培养学徒的操作人员的补充分析表明，合作社成员身份也提高了他们未来进行技能传承的意愿和计划。这些研究发现表明，合作社不仅组织机械化服务并促进技术扩散，还充当农业人力资本形成的重要平台。关键词：技能传承 学徒培训 合作社成员身份 农业机械化 农业机械操作人员 JEL分类：J24 J43 O15
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714944.title: Cooperative membership and skill transmission: evidence from apprenticeship among agricultural machinery operators in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714944.title_zh: 合作社成员资格与技能传播：来自中国农业机械操作员学徒制的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2714945.abstract: Extreme weather increasingly threatens agricultural production, underscoring the need to enhance farmers’ adaptive capacity and strengthen disaster risk management. Using panel data from China’s National Fixed Observation Points (NFOP) matched with ERA5 data for 2009–2019, this study employs fixed-effects models to examine the effects of extreme weather on farmers’ agricultural insurance participation and insurance expenditure, and further analyzes the moderating role of insurance claims. We further examine how variation in the severity of extreme weather affects farmers’ crop insurance participation and coverage levels. The results show that drought exposure increases farmers’ likelihood of purchasing agricultural insurance, particularly under prolonged drought conditions. However, the effect on insurance payment levels is mixed: short-term drought shocks are associated with increased insurance investment, while moderate-duration drought shows a negative association, and intermediate horizons yield insignificant results. This heterogeneity suggests that farmers‘ coverage adjustment responses are contingent on the duration and timing of drought exposure. The association between drought exposure and insurance uptake is more pronounced among households with prior claim experience. KEYWORDS: Agricultural disasters crop insurance drought severity insurance demand JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q14 Q13 Q54
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714945.abstract_zh: 极端天气日益威胁农业生产，凸显了增强农户适应能力与强化灾害风险管理的必要性。本研究利用中国国家固定观测点（NFOP）2009—2019年的面板数据，匹配ERA5气象数据，采用固定效应模型考察极端天气对农户农业保险参与及保费支出的影响，并进一步分析保险理赔的调节作用。同时，本文还探讨了极端天气严重程度的变化如何影响农户种植业保险参与及保障水平。结果表明，干旱暴露提高了农户购买农业保险的可能性，尤其是在持续干旱条件下。然而，干旱对保险支付水平的影响呈现混合效应：短期干旱冲击与保险投入增加相关，中等时长干旱则呈负向关联，而中间时段的影响不显著。这一异质性表明，农户保障水平的调整反应取决于干旱暴露的持续时间和发生时机。干旱暴露与保险参与之间的正向关联在具有既往理赔经历的农户中更为显著。关键词：农业灾害；种植业保险；干旱严重程度；保险需求 JEL分类：Q14 Q13 Q54
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714945.title: Drought exposure and crop insurance demand: evidence from Rural China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2714945.title_zh: 干旱暴露与农作物保险需求：来自中国农村的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2715722.abstract: Regulatory tightening aims to curb opportunistic insider trading by reducing informational advantages. However, the effectiveness of such reforms, particularly in emerging markets with historically weak enforcement, remains debated. This study investigates the effect of regulatory tightening on the information content of insider trades in India, an emerging market. We focus on the implementation of the Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations 2015, which introduced stricter disclosure requirements, higher penalties, and a reversal of the burden of proof. Using a comprehensive sample of insider trades from 2008 to 2024, we employ difference-in-differences and propensity score matching to assess changes in the predictive power of insider trades for future stock returns. Our findings indicate that the regulatory reforms did not diminish the overall informativeness of insider trades. Notably, while insider purchases retained their positive predictive value, insider sales, previously uninformative, gained significant negative information content post-regulation. These results suggest that enhanced enforcement may amplify rather than suppress the market’s ability to incorporate insider information, underscoring the role of rigorous implementation in emerging markets. We recommend that regulators prioritize enforcement mechanisms to balance investor protection with market efficiency.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2715722.abstract_zh: 监管收紧旨在通过减少信息优势来遏制机会主义的内幕交易。然而，此类改革的有效性，尤其是在历史上执法薄弱的新兴市场中，仍存在争议。本研究探讨了监管收紧对印度这一新兴市场中内幕交易信息含量的影响。我们聚焦于2015年《内幕交易禁止条例》的实施，该条例引入了更严格的披露要求、更高的罚款以及举证责任的倒置。利用2008年至2024年间全面的内幕交易样本，我们采用双重差分法和倾向得分匹配来评估内幕交易对未来股票收益预测能力的变化。研究发现，监管改革并未削弱内幕交易的整体信息含量。值得注意的是，尽管内幕买入保持了其正向预测价值，而此前无信息含量的内幕卖出在监管后获得了显著的负向信息含量。这些结果表明，加强执法可能放大而非抑制市场吸收内幕信息的能力，凸显了在新兴市场中严格实施的重要性。我们建议监管机构优先考虑执法机制，以平衡投资者保护与市场效率。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2715722.title: The effect of regulatory tightening on the information content of insider trades
10.1080/00036846.2026.2715722.title_zh: 监管收紧对内部人交易信息含量的影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2715727.abstract: Research indicates that a city’s total factor productivity (TFP) correlates with its size, with larger cities exhibiting higher TFP. However, some smaller cities can achieve high TFP by borrowing their size from surrounding cities, achieving the size necessary to support the benefits of agglomeration. This study uses data from industrial firms in 13 mature city clusters in China to explore how borrowed size influences TFP. The findings reveal that borrowed size significantly enhances firms’ TFP, acting as a substitute for city size. Heterogeneity analysis shows that technology-intensive and downstream industries in the industrial chain are more dependent on borrowed size, whereas state-owned firms face challenges due to intergovernmental competition, making it difficult for them to benefit from borrowed size. The positive effects of borrowed size rely on inter-city connections: lower administrative barriers, a more flattened spatial structure of city clusters, and a denser transportation network amplify its benefits. Mechanism analysis indicates that large cities can borrow size from surrounding smaller cities to develop productive services beyond their capacity, while smaller cities can share the productive service functions of large cities and specialize in manufacturing. This clear functional division helps improve firms’ TFP. KEYWORDS: Borrowed size total factor productivity city clusters city functional division firms JEL CLASSIFICATION: O25 R12 R58 Acknowledgements The authors appreciate the insightful and constructive comments of the anonymous reviewers.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2715727.abstract_zh: 研究表明，城市全要素生产率与其规模相关，大城市展现出更高的全要素生产率。然而，一些较小的城市可以通过向周边城市“借用规模”来实现高全要素生产率，从而获得支撑集聚效应所需的规模。本研究利用中国13个成熟城市群中的工业企业数据，探讨借用规模如何影响全要素生产率。研究发现，借用规模显著提升了企业的全要素生产率，起到了城市规模的替代作用。异质性分析显示，技术密集型产业和产业链下游行业对借用规模的依赖度更高，而国有企业因受政府间竞争的影响，难以从借用规模中获益。借用规模的积极效应依赖于城市间的联系：较低的行政壁垒、更为扁平的城市群空间结构以及更密集的交通网络能够放大其益处。机制分析表明，大城市可以借用周边小城市的规模，发展超出自身承载能力的生产性服务业，而小城市则可以共享大城市的生产性服务功能，专注于制造业。这种明确的功能分工有助于提升企业的全要素生产率。关键词：借用规模；全要素生产率；城市群；城市功能分工；企业 JEL分类号：O25 R12 R58 致谢：作者感谢匿名审稿人的深刻见解和建设性意见。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2715727.title: Borrowed size, city functional division, and total factor productivity of firms: a study based on city clusters in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2715727.title_zh: 借用规模、城市功能分工与企业全要素生产率——基于中国城市群的研究

10.1080/00036846.2026.2715728.abstract: Based on panel data from 2011 to 2022 covering all Chinese provinces except Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and Tibet, this study constructs a multi-weighted, multi-scenario spatial Durbin model to examine the structural stability of the relationship between agricultural industrial agglomeration and rural labour outflow. The results indicate that the local effect of agricultural industrial agglomeration on labour outflow is not a structurally stable relationship, but rather an average effect dependent on specific contextual conditions. Spatial spillover effects are generally limited and lack robustness, thereby refuting the implicit assumption in existing research that ‘agglomeration effects possess cross-spatial stability’. These spillover effects exhibit directional consistency only under specific spatial linkages and institutional conditions, suggesting that they are closer to a context-triggered latent mechanism. The moderating role of contextual variables indicates that this effect is not universally present but is embedded within specific spatial structures, thereby revealing that it is essentially a conditional process dependent on spatial structure. Based on these findings, this paper defines the scope of agricultural agglomeration effects from the perspective of spatial structure and institutional conditions, revealing that these effects hold only under specific forms of connectivity and contextual conditions. KEYWORDS: Agricultural industrial agglomeration rural labour outflow spatial Durbin model spatial spillover JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q18 O15
10.1080/00036846.2026.2715728.abstract_zh: 基于2011至2022年间中国除香港、澳门、台湾及西藏外所有省份的面板数据，本研究构建了一个多权重、多情景的空间杜宾模型，旨在考察农业产业集聚与农村劳动力外流之间关系的结构稳定性。研究结果显示，农业产业集聚对劳动力外流的本地效应并非一种结构稳定的关系，而是一种依赖于特定情境条件的平均效应。空间溢出效应总体有限且缺乏稳健性，从而反驳了现有研究中隐含的“集聚效应具有跨空间稳定性”的假设。这些溢出效应仅在特定的空间联系和制度条件下表现出方向一致性，表明它们更接近于一种由情境触发的潜在机制。情境变量的调节作用表明，这一效应并非普遍存在，而是嵌入于特定的空间结构之中，从而揭示其本质上是一个依赖于空间结构的条件过程。基于上述发现，本文从空间结构与制度条件的视角界定了农业集聚效应的适用范围，揭示这些效应仅在特定的连接形式与情境条件下成立。关键词：农业产业集聚；农村劳动力外流；空间杜宾模型；空间溢出；JEL分类：Q18；O15
10.1080/00036846.2026.2715728.title: Research on the mechanism of agricultural industrial agglomeration’s Impact on rural labour outflow: an empirical analysis based on China’s inter-provincial panel data
10.1080/00036846.2026.2715728.title_zh: 农业产业集聚对农村劳动力外流的影响机制研究——基于中国省际面板数据的实证分析

10.1080/00036846.2026.2715731.title: Understanding residents’ waste separation behaviour in a rural aging society: the effects of reward-penalty policies
10.1080/00036846.2026.2715731.title_zh: 理解农村老龄化社会中居民垃圾分类行为：奖惩政策的影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2716383.abstract: This article examines the effects of persistent negative terms-of-trade (ToT) shocks on economic performance in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) using a local projections difference-in-differences (LP-DiD) approach. This methodology allows for flexible estimation of dynamic treatment effects while controlling for GDP dynamics and contemporaneous shocks. The results show that persistent negative ToT shocks generate delayed but economically meaningful reductions in GDP per capita, with effects accumulating gradually and lasting up to 9 years. The estimated contractions are significantly larger in SSA than in the rest of the world. This heightened vulnerability reflects the region’s structural characteristics – high commodity dependence, low economic diversification, limited financial development, and weaker institutional quality. Heterogeneity analyses further reveal that countries with deeper financial systems and stronger institutions experience smaller and less persistent losses. Overall, the findings underscore the importance of financial development, institutional strengthening, and export diversification in enhancing resilience to persistent adverse ToT shocks in SSA.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2716383.abstract_zh: 本文采用局部投影双重差分（LP-DiD）方法，考察了持续负向贸易条件（ToT）冲击对撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）经济表现的影响。该方法能够在控制GDP动态和同期冲击的同时，灵活估计动态处理效应。结果表明，持续负向贸易条件冲击会引发延迟但具有经济意义的GDP人均水平下降，其影响逐步累积并持续长达9年。与全球其他地区相比，SSA地区的估计收缩幅度显著更大。这种更高的脆弱性反映了该地区的结构性特征——高度依赖大宗商品、经济多元化程度低、金融发展有限以及制度质量较弱。异质性分析进一步揭示，金融体系更深化、制度更健全的国家所遭受的损失更小且持续性更弱。总体而言，研究结果强调了金融发展、制度强化和出口多元化在增强SSA地区抵御持续不利贸易条件冲击能力方面的重要性。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2716383.title: On the effects of persistent negative terms-of-trade shocks on growth: new evidence from Sub-Saharan Africa
10.1080/00036846.2026.2716383.title_zh: 持续性贸易条件负面冲击对增长的影响：来自撒哈拉以南非洲的新证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2716766.abstract: Superstitious beliefs, as culturally embedded cognitive biases, can influence managerial decision-making. This study examines the impact of CEOs’ zodiac-year superstition on corporate environmental investment. Using panel data on Chinese listed firms from 2008 to 2023, we find that CEOs become more risk-averse during their zodiac years, which leads firms to reduce environmental investment. This negative effect is weaker among younger or long-tenured CEOs and CEOs with academic or overseas backgrounds. It is also attenuated in state-owned firms, firms with low ownership concentration, and firms operating in polluting or capital-intensive industries. Specifically, the negative effect is concentrated in pollution control investments rather than pollution prevention investments. The findings highlight how culturally embedded managerial beliefs shape corporate environmental investment decisions by influencing CEOs’ risk preferences. KEYWORDS: Superstition CEOs zodiac year environmental strategy JEL CLASSIFICATION: M21 M12 Q56
10.1080/00036846.2026.2716766.abstract_zh: 迷信信念作为一种文化嵌入的认知偏差，能够影响管理者的决策。本研究考察了CEO本命年迷信对企业环境投资的影响。利用2008年至2023年中国上市公司的面板数据，我们发现CEO在本命年期间变得更加风险规避，从而导致企业减少环境投资。这一负面效应在年轻或任期较长的CEO以及具有学术或海外背景的CEO中较弱。此外，在国有企业、股权集中度较低的企业以及污染密集型或资本密集型行业中，该效应也有所减弱。具体而言，负面效应集中于污染治理投资而非污染预防投资。研究结果凸显了文化嵌入的管理者信念如何通过影响CEO的风险偏好来塑造企业环境投资决策。关键词：迷信；CEO；本命年；环境战略；JEL分类：M21 M12 Q56
10.1080/00036846.2026.2716766.title: Risk aversion or hedging? CEO superstition beliefs and corporate environmental investment
10.1080/00036846.2026.2716766.title_zh: 风险厌恶还是对冲？CEO迷信信念与企业环境投资

10.1080/00036846.2026.2716900.abstract: The increasing integration of agricultural commodity markets and growing external uncertainty have made risk transmission along China’s hog–feed supply chain an important issue for agricultural risk management. This study investigates the tail-risk spillovers between China’s live hog futures and five major feed futures (No. 1 soybean, No. 2 soybean, soybean meal, soybean oil, and corn) using daily data from January 2021 to July 2025. The quantile Granger causality test, the Multivariate Multiple-Quantile Conditional Autoregressive Value at Risk (MVMQ-CAViaR) model, and quantile impulse response analysis are employed to examine cross-market dependence under extreme market conditions. The results show that significant tail dependence exists between live hog and feed futures, with spillover patterns varying across commodities and quantiles. The MVMQ-CAViaR estimates reveal heterogeneous and state-dependent cross-market interactions. Subsample analysis indicates that the Russia–Ukraine conflict altered the pattern of tail-risk transmission rather than uniformly strengthening spillovers across markets. Quantile impulse responses further show that feed-market shocks generate short-run responses that gradually converge to equilibrium. These findings provide new evidence on tail-risk transmission within China’s hog–feed futures system and offer implications for agricultural risk management and futures market regulation. KEYWORDS: Live hog futures feed commodity futures hog industry chain extreme risk spillovers JEL CLASSIFICATION: G13 Q11
10.1080/00036846.2026.2716900.abstract_zh: 农业商品市场一体化程度的提高和外部不确定性的加剧，使得中国生猪—饲料供应链中的风险传导成为农业风险管理的重要议题。本研究利用2021年1月至2025年7月的日度数据，考察中国生猪活体期货与五种主要饲料期货（一号大豆、二号大豆、豆粕、豆油和玉米）之间的尾部风险溢出效应。采用分位数格兰杰因果检验、多元多分位数条件自回归风险价值（MVMQ-CAViaR）模型以及分位数脉冲响应分析，研究极端市场条件下的跨市场依赖性。结果表明，生猪活体期货与饲料期货之间存在显著的尾部依赖关系，且溢出模式因商品和分位数的不同而存在差异。MVMQ-CAViaR估计揭示了异质性和状态依赖性的跨市场交互作用。子样本分析表明，俄乌冲突改变了尾部风险传导的模式，而非在各市场间一致性地增强溢出效应。分位数脉冲响应进一步显示，饲料市场冲击产生的短期响应会逐渐收敛至均衡状态。这些发现为中国生猪—饲料期货体系内的尾部风险传导提供了新的证据，并对农业风险管理和期货市场监管具有启示意义。关键词：生猪活体期货 饲料商品期货 生猪产业链 极端风险溢出 JEL分类号：G13 Q11
10.1080/00036846.2026.2716900.title: Extreme risk spillovers between live hog and feed ingredient futures in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2716900.title_zh: 中国生猪与饲料原料期货间的极端风险溢出效应

10.1080/00036846.2026.2717385.abstract: This article re-examines the relationship between weather and investor behaviour. Much of the earlier literature treats weather mainly as a source of sentiment, but the evidence remains mixed and the mechanism remains unclear. We argue that weather may be more closely related to investors’ willingness to trade and take risks than to their directional beliefs. Using more than 300,000 trades placed by over 14,000 UK retail spread traders, matched with hourly local weather conditions, we test whether weather is associated with buy-sell direction or with several margins of trading activity and risk-taking. We find little evidence of a consistent effect on the propensity to buy rather than sell. By contrast, weather is more clearly related to trading participation, trading frequency, and investment size.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717385.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了天气与投资者行为之间的关系。早期文献多将天气主要视为情绪来源，但证据尚不一致，机制亦不明确。我们认为，天气可能与投资者的交易意愿及风险承担更为紧密相关，而非其方向性信念。利用超过14,000名英国零售点差交易者进行的逾300,000笔交易，并结合每小时当地天气状况，我们检验了天气是否与买卖方向或交易活动及风险承担的多个维度相关。我们发现，天气对买入而非卖出倾向的影响缺乏一致性证据。相比之下，天气与交易参与度、交易频率及投资规模的关系更为显著。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717385.title: Weather and retail investor behaviour: directional trading decisions or risk-taking?
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717385.title_zh: 天气与散户投资者行为：方向性交易决策还是风险承担？

10.1080/00036846.2026.2717388.abstract: Despite a long-standing literature documenting wage differentials between public and private sector workers in the US, the factors underlying these differences remain only partially understood. Existing studies examining human capital explanations for public-private wage differentials have largely focused on general labour market experience and firm tenure, with limited attention to industry and occupation-specific human capital. This study examines the extent to which different forms of human capital: general, firm-specific, industry-specific, and occupation-specific, which contribute to public-private wage differentials using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 (NLSY79) from 2008 to 2018. Employing Oaxaca decomposition, ordinary least squares, and random-effects models, the results show that human capital explains a substantial share of the observed public-sector wage premium. Firm-specific human capital is the largest contributor, followed by industry-specific human capital, while general human capital has a smaller but statistically significant effect. In contrast, occupation-specific human capital does not explain the wage differential once unobserved individual heterogeneity is taken into account. The findings are robust to propensity score matching and alternative sample restrictions. Overall, differences in the accumulation of specific human capital, particularly within firms and industries, help explain the persistence of public-private wage differentials in the US. KEYWORDS: Firm-specific human capital industry-specific human capital Occupational Human Capital sectoral wage differentials JEL CLASSIFICATION: J24 J31 J45 J62 Acknowledgements The authors acknowledge the use of Generative AI and AI-assisted technologies during the manuscript preparation process to improve the quality of the language and intelligibility.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717388.abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量文献记录了美国公共部门与私营部门劳动者之间的工资差异，但造成这些差异的因素至今仍未得到充分理解。现有研究在考察人力资本对公私部门工资差异的解释时，主要聚焦于一般劳动力市场经验和企业任期，而对行业和职业特定人力资本的关注有限。本研究利用1979年全国青年纵向调查（NLSY79）2008年至2018年的数据，考察不同类型的人力资本——一般性、企业特定、行业特定和职业特定——在多大程度上解释了公私部门工资差异。通过采用Oaxaca分解、普通最小二乘法和随机效应模型，结果显示人力资本解释了所观察到的公共部门工资溢价中的相当大份额。企业特定人力资本是最大的贡献因素，其次是行业特定人力资本，而一般性人力资本的影响较小但具有统计显著性。相比之下，在考虑未观测到的个体异质性后，职业特定人力资本并不能解释工资差异。研究结果在倾向得分匹配和替代样本限制下依然稳健。总体而言，特定人力资本积累的差异，尤其是企业和行业层面的人力资本积累差异，有助于解释美国公私部门工资差异的持续存在。关键词：企业特定人力资本；行业特定人力资本；职业人力资本；部门工资差异 JEL分类：J24 J31 J45 J62 致谢 作者感谢在稿件准备过程中使用生成式人工智能和AI辅助技术以提升语言质量和可读性。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717388.title: Human capital and public-private wage differentials in the US: evidence from the NLSY79 (2008–2018)
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717388.title_zh: 美国人力资本与公私部门工资差异：来自NLSY79（2008—2018）的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2717389.abstract: This study examines the effect of central bank digital currency (CBDC) on corporate risk-taking. Using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2017 to 2023, we exploit the pilot rollout of China’s CBDC(e-CNY) as a quasi-natural experiment and implement a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) design. The results show that CBDC significantly increases corporate risk-taking, and this finding remains robust to a range of tests. Heterogeneity analyses indicate that the effect is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises (non-SOEs) and firms with higher institutional ownership. Mechanism analyses suggest that CBDC operates by alleviating agency problems and financing constraints, which enhances firms’ risk-taking propensity and capacity. The study further documents that the increased corporate risk-taking associated with CBDC is associated with higher firm value and total factor productivity ( TFP ). These findings extend the literature on the economic consequences of CBDC and the determinants of corporate risk-taking, while offering useful implications for its broader promotion and application.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717389.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了中央银行数字货币（CBDC）对企业风险承担的影响。利用2017至2023年中国A股上市公司数据，我们将中国CBDC（数字人民币）的试点推广视为准自然实验，并采用多期双重差分（DID）设计。结果显示，CBDC显著提升了企业风险承担水平，且这一发现在一系列检验中保持稳健。异质性分析表明，该效应在非国有企业（non-SOEs）及机构持股比例较高的企业中更为显著。机制分析揭示，CBDC通过缓解代理问题和融资约束发挥作用，从而增强企业的风险承担意愿与能力。研究进一步指出，与CBDC相关的企业风险承担增加与企业价值及全要素生产率（TFP）的提升相关联。这些发现拓展了关于CBDC经济后果及企业风险承担决定因素的文献，同时为其更广泛的推广与应用提供了有益启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717389.title: Central bank digital currency and corporate risk-taking: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717389.title_zh: 央行数字货币与企业风险承担：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2717395.abstract: This paper examines whether Chinese foreign aid strengthens state capacity in recipient countries. We construct a country-year panel covering 214 countries over 2000–2021 by combining AidData’s Global Chinese Development Finance Dataset with a latent-variable measure of state capacity. To address aid allocation endogeneity, we instrument Chinese official development assistance (ODA) using the interaction between China’s steel production and each recipient’s historical propensity to receive Chinese aid. The results show that one additional Chinese ODA project increases the state-capacity index by 0.032 points, equivalent to 9.22% of the sample mean. This finding remains robust to controlling for additional recipient characteristics, other aid sources, policy factors, and spatial spillovers. The effect is stronger in countries that are institutionally or politically closer to China and for aid directed towards production and infrastructure sectors, with infrastructure provision and bilateral economic engagement serving as the primary channels. The estimates for official finance (OF) and other official financing (OOF) remain positive but are smaller and less precisely estimated, highlighting the distinctive role of concessional ODA in state capacity building. From a policy perspective, this finding suggests that concessional aid can strengthen recipient governments’ capacity to implement policies and pursue self-reliant development. KEYWORDS: Chinese aid ODA state capacity infrastructure projects JEL CLASSIFICATION: F35: Foreign Aid O19: International Linkages to Development Role of International Organizations P45: International Trade, Finance, Investment, and Aid O43: Institutions and Growth H11: Structure, Scope, and Performance of Government
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717395.abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国对外援助是否增强了受援国的国家能力。通过结合AidData的全球中国发展融资数据集与国家能力的潜变量测度，我们构建了一个覆盖2000年至2021年214个国家的国家-年份面板数据。为处理援助分配的内生性问题，我们利用中国钢铁产量与各受援国历史上接受中国援助的倾向之间的交互项，作为中国官方发展援助（ODA）的工具变量。结果显示，每增加一个中国ODA项目，国家能力指数提升0.032点，相当于样本均值的9.22%。在控制额外受援国特征、其他援助来源、政策因素及空间溢出效应后，这一发现依然稳健。该效应在制度或政治上与中国更接近的国家中更为显著，且对投向生产与基础设施部门的援助效果更强，其中基础设施供给与双边经济交往是主要作用渠道。官方融资（OF）及其他官方融资（OOF）的估计系数虽为正，但数值较小且显著性较弱，凸显了优惠性ODA在国家能力建设中的独特作用。从政策角度看，这一发现表明，优惠性援助能够增强受援国政府实施政策及追求自主发展的能力。关键词：中国援助 ODA 国家能力 基础设施项目 JEL分类：F35：对外援助 O19：国际组织在发展中的国际联系作用 P45：国际贸易、金融、投资与援助 O43：制度与增长 H11：政府的结构、范围与绩效
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717395.title: Does Chinese foreign aid enhance state capacity in recipient countries?
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717395.title_zh: 中国对外援助是否增强了受援国的国家能力？

10.1080/00036846.2026.2717402.abstract: The increasing frequency of extreme natural risks, coupled with volatility in the international financial environment, has exerted dual pressures on national monetary policy regulation and the global trade landscape. Based on a global panel dataset covering 62 countries from 2005 to 2023, this study employs three-stage least squares (3SLS), fixed-effects panel models, and an endogenous Kernel Regularized Quantile Regression (KRQR) to systematically examine the independent and interactive effects of natural risk shocks and policy-rate changes on international trade. The baseline findings highlight the significant synergistic disruptive effects in emerging markets (EMs). Post-disaster forced monetary tightening significantly exacerbated the export contraction, while imports exhibited post-disaster rigidity, showing minimal sensitivity to this dual shock. Crucially, the non-linear KRQR estimates reveal a profound distributional asymmetry. While advanced economies (AEs) demonstrate the macro-financial capacity for post-shock trade recovery, EMs suffer from a complete absence of upside resilience, falling into a liquidity-induced trade stagnation under the compound shock. This paper explores the macroeconomic consequences of natural risks from a unique perspective focusing on the monetary-trade transmission mechanism. It emphasizes the crucial role of central banks in balancing inflation targets and trade stability in vulnerable economies amid escalating natural risks.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717402.abstract_zh: 极端自然风险频发叠加国际金融环境波动，对各国货币政策调控与全球贸易格局形成双重压力。基于2005至2023年覆盖62个国家的全球面板数据集，本研究运用三阶段最小二乘法（3SLS）、固定效应面板模型及内生核正则化分位数回归（KRQR），系统考察自然风险冲击与政策利率变动对国际贸易的独立效应及交互效应。基准结果凸显了新兴市场（EMs）中显著的协同破坏效应：灾后被迫性货币紧缩显著加剧出口收缩，而进口则呈现灾后刚性，对此双重冲击的敏感度极低。关键在于，非线性KRQR估计揭示了深刻的分布不对称性：尽管发达经济体（AEs）展现出冲击后贸易复苏的宏观金融能力，新兴市场却完全缺乏上行韧性，在复合冲击下陷入流动性引致的贸易停滞。本文从聚焦货币—贸易传导机制的独特视角，探讨自然风险的宏观经济后果，强调在自然风险不断升级背景下，中央银行在脆弱经济体中平衡通胀目标与贸易稳定方面的关键作用。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717402.title: Natural risk disclosure, monetary policy, and international trade: empirical evidence from global data
10.1080/00036846.2026.2717402.title_zh: 自然风险披露、货币政策与国际贸易：来自全球数据的经验证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2718434.abstract: This study examines the relationship between classroom diversity in family occupational backgrounds and student academic performance using a randomized classroom assignment framework. We find that students achieve higher test scores when their classmates come from more diverse backgrounds, as measured by their fathers’ occupations. We also provide suggestive evidence consistent with a role for parental involvement. In more diverse classrooms, parents have higher expectations and stricter discipline at home. These patterns are stronger when students live at home and when parent meeting attendance rates are high. Overall, the results suggest that classroom peer diversity may influence student outcomes partly through parental responses. KEYWORDS: Diversity student achievement Peer Effects parental involvement JEL CLASSIFICATION: I21 I24 J13
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718434.abstract_zh: 本研究利用随机分班框架，探讨了家庭职业背景的课堂多样性与学生学业表现之间的关系。研究发现，当同学的家庭背景更加多元（以父亲职业为衡量标准）时，学生的考试成绩更高。我们还提供了与家长参与作用相一致的初步证据。在更加多元的课堂中，家长对孩子抱有更高的期望，并在家中实施更严格的纪律。这些效应在学生住校以及家长会出席率较高的情况下更为显著。总体而言，研究结果表明，课堂同伴多样性可能部分通过家长的反应影响学生学业成果。关键词：多样性 学生成就 同伴效应 家长参与 JEL分类：I21 I24 J13
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718434.title: Beyond student peer effects: class diversity, test scores, and the role of parents
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718434.title_zh: 超越学生同伴效应：班级多样性、考试成绩与家长的作用

10.1080/00036846.2026.2718436.abstract: Understanding the role of international trade in sustainable manufacturing development is a critical area of industrial research. This study investigates the impact of imports on manufacturing development within a sustainable framework encompassing economic, environmental, and social dimensions. Using city-level panel data from Guangdong Province, China, we find that imports have a positive impact on sustainable manufacturing development. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that this positive effect is more pronounced for labour-intensive and technology-intensive imports, midstream imports along the supply chain, and in cities with greater sectoral complexity within the manufacturing sector. Further analysis indicates that increased imports enhance key aspects of sustainable manufacturing development, including innovation capability, structural optimization, inclusive development, and public support, while negatively affecting green production.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718436.abstract_zh: 理解国际贸易在可持续制造业发展中的作用是工业研究的一个关键领域。本研究在涵盖经济、环境和社会维度的可持续框架内，探讨了进口对制造业发展的影响。利用中国广东省的城市级面板数据，我们发现进口对可持续制造业发展具有积极影响。异质性分析显示，这一积极效应在劳动密集型和技术密集型进口、供应链中游进口以及制造业部门内行业复杂度较高的城市中更为显著。进一步分析表明，进口增加提升了可持续制造业发展的关键方面，包括创新能力、结构优化、包容性发展和公共支持，而对绿色生产产生了负面影响。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718436.title: Imports and sustainable manufacturing development: evidence from Guangdong, China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718436.title_zh: 进口与制造业可持续发展：来自中国广东的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2718437.abstract: Leveraging China’s signing of the Paris Agreement as a quasi-natural experiment, this paper examines how climate transition risk shapes the capital share of income at the firm level. Using a panel of Chinese A-share listed firms over the period 2007–2023, we document that exposure to climate transition risk leads to a statistically significant increase in firms’ capital income share. This finding remains robust to a battery of endogeneity and sensitivity checks. Mechanism analyses indicate that climate transition risk operates through multiple channels: it reduces operating costs, induces capital deepening, accelerates technological progress, and reshapes labour–capital relations, jointly contributing to a higher capital share of income. Heterogeneity tests further show that the effect is more pronounced in regions with lower energy consumption and higher levels of public environmental awareness. Overall, the results offer a novel perspective from the lens of green transition for understanding shifts in the functional distribution of income. KEYWORDS: Climate transition risk capital income share capital deepening technological progress labour–capital relations JEL CLASSIFICATION: G32 O12
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718437.abstract_zh: 本文以中国签署《巴黎协定》作为准自然实验，考察气候转型风险如何影响企业层面的收入资本份额。利用2007—2023年中国A股上市公司面板数据，我们发现气候转型风险暴露显著提高了企业的资本收入份额。该结论在一系列内生性与敏感性检验中保持稳健。机制分析表明，气候转型风险通过多重渠道发挥作用：降低经营成本、促进资本深化、加速技术进步以及重塑劳资关系，共同推动资本收入份额上升。异质性检验进一步显示，在能源消费较低、公众环保意识较高的地区，该效应更为显著。总体而言，本文从绿色转型视角为理解功能性收入分配变化提供了新的视角。关键词：气候转型风险；资本收入份额；资本深化；技术进步；劳资关系 JEL分类：G32；O12
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718437.title: Impact of climate transition risk on capital income share: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718437.title_zh: 气候转型风险对资本收入份额的影响：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2718442.abstract: The position of enterprises within supply chain networks, as a core element of enterprise social networks, has an important impact on supply chain resilience. Using panel data on non-financial firms listed in China’s A-share market from 2014 to 2023, this study empirically examines how supply chain network centrality affects supply chain resilience, as well as the mediating role of dynamic capabilities and the moderating role of ESG performance. The results show that supply chain network centrality can significantly influence enterprise supply chain resilience. Enterprises located at the core of the network can better withstand diverse risk shocks by exploiting their positional advantages in information acquisition and resource integration. Further analysis indicates that dynamic capabilities constitute an important mediating channel between supply chain network centrality and resilience, and ESG performance positively moderates it. The heterogeneity analysis reveals that manufacturing firms, state-owned enterprises, and high-tech firms are more reliant on network centrality to enhance supply chain resilience. This paper proposes that firms should prioritize the strategic synergy among network centrality, dynamic capability cultivation, and ESG performance. Meanwhile, policymakers should endeavour to promote the construction of supply chain collaborative networks, refine ESG incentive mechanisms, and implement differentiated industry support policies. KEYWORDS: Network centrality supply chain resilience dynamic capabilities ESG performance supply chain network JEL CLASSIFICATION: G34 L22 O47
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718442.abstract_zh: 企业在供应链网络中的位置作为企业社会网络的核心要素，对供应链韧性具有重要影响。本研究利用2014年至2023年中国A股市场非金融类上市公司的面板数据，实证检验了供应链网络中心度对供应链韧性的影响，以及动态能力的中介作用和ESG绩效的调节作用。研究结果表明，供应链网络中心度能够显著影响企业供应链韧性。位于网络核心位置的企业能够利用其在信息获取和资源整合方面的位置优势，更好地抵御各类风险冲击。进一步分析表明，动态能力是供应链网络中心度与供应链韧性之间的重要中介渠道，且ESG绩效对此具有正向调节作用。异质性分析显示，制造业企业、国有企业和科技型企业更加依赖网络中心度来提升供应链韧性。本文提出，企业应重视网络中心度、动态能力培育与ESG绩效之间的战略协同。同时，政策制定者应努力推动供应链协同网络建设，完善ESG激励机制，并实施差异化的产业支持政策。关键词：网络中心度 供应链韧性 动态能力 ESG绩效 供应链网络 JEL分类：G34 L22 O47
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718442.title: How does supply chain network centrality affect supply chain resilience: an empirical study of Chinese listed firms
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718442.title_zh: 供应链网络中心性如何影响供应链韧性：来自中国上市公司的实证研究

10.1080/00036846.2026.2718443.abstract: Mitigating local government debt risks is essential for safeguarding economic and financial stability. As a key instrument of structural deleveraging, the local government debt replacement programme may generate important spillover effects on firms, yet its microeconomic consequences and transmission mechanisms remain underexplored. Using China’s first-round LGDR programme during 2015–2018 as a quasi-natural experiment and a sample covering 248 prefecture-level cities, this study employs an intensity-based difference-in-differences approach to examine the impact of local government debt replacement on corporate investment efficiency and its underlying mechanisms. The results show that local government debt replacement significantly improves corporate investment efficiency. Mechanism analyses provide evidence consistent with two potential channels: improvements in firms’ external financing conditions and internal managerial efficiency. Heterogeneity analyses further reveal that the positive effect is stronger for non-state-owned firms, technology-intensive firms, and firms operating in competitive industries. This study enriches the literature on the microeconomic effects of local debt governance policies and provides new evidence on how debt-risk mitigation policies improve resource allocation and investment efficiency at the firm level. KEYWORDS: Local government debt replacement corporate investment efficiency intensity DID quantile regression JEL CLASSIFICATION: G38 E65
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718443.abstract_zh: 化解地方政府债务风险对于维护经济金融稳定至关重要。作为结构性去杠杆的关键工具，地方政府债务置换计划可能对企业产生重要的溢出效应，但其微观经济后果及传导机制尚未得到充分探讨。本文以2015—2018年中国首轮地方政府债务置换计划作为准自然实验，利用覆盖248个地级市层面的样本，采用基于强度的双重差分方法，考察地方政府债务置换对企业投资效率的影响及其内在机制。研究结果表明，地方政府债务置换显著提升了企业投资效率。机制分析提供了与两条潜在渠道相一致的证据：企业外部融资条件的改善和内部管理效率的提升。异质性分析进一步揭示，对于非国有企业、技术密集型企业以及处于竞争性行业的企业而言，这一积极效应更为显著。本研究丰富了关于地方债务治理政策微观经济效应的文献，并为债务风险化解政策如何改善企业层面的资源配置与投资效率提供了新的证据。关键词：地方政府债务置换；企业投资效率；强度DID；分位数回归 JEL分类：G38；E65
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718443.title: Does local government debt replacement affect corporate investment efficiency? Evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718443.title_zh: 地方政府债务置换是否影响企业投资效率？来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2718445.abstract: Selecting the right CEO is critical to firm success, yet boards must evaluate candidates before observing future performance. This paper examines whether machine learning can improve the hard‑information component of CEO selection by using appointment‑time public information to predict early CEO turnover. Using CEO appointments in Chinese listed firms from 2004 to 2022, we apply XGBoost to predict performance-induced turnover and forced turnover within 2 years of appointment. XGBoost yields stronger out-of-sample predictions than AIC-selected OLS and logit models, and its prediction gains map into decision-relevant screening outcomes. Candidate-pool analyses show that XGBoost rankings remain informative against internal and external benchmarks. SHAP-based interpretation reveals that the model identifies both conventional and unconventional predictors, along with important interactions. Further, the model performs better in non-state-owned firms, suggesting algorithmic screening is most useful where CEO evaluation is market-driven. Overall, our findings suggest machine learning can provide a complementary, auditable screening benchmark for CEO selection. KEYWORDS: CEO selection machine learning XGBoost CEO turnover model interpretation JEL CLASSIFICATION: C10 G30 M12 M51 Acknowledgements The authors thank Jianjun Jia, Guangwei Li, Lei Wang and Su Wang for their helpful comments and suggestions, as well as seminar participants at ShanghaiTech University, the 2023 Pacific-Basin Finance Journal Special Issue Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Corporate Finance, and the internal conference at Shanghai University of International Business and Economics for helpful discussions.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718445.abstract_zh: 选择合适的CEO对企业成功至关重要，然而董事会必须在观察未来业绩之前评估候选人。本文探讨了机器学习能否通过利用任命时的公开信息预测CEO早期更替，从而改善CEO选拔中的硬信息组成部分。利用2004年至2022年中国上市公司的CEO任命数据，我们应用XGBoost预测任命后两年内因业绩导致的更替和强制更替。XGBoost在样本外预测方面优于基于AIC选择的OLS和Logit模型，其预测增益转化为决策相关的筛选结果。候选人池分析显示，XGBoost排名在内部和外部基准下仍具有信息量。基于SHAP的解释揭示，该模型识别了传统和非传统的预测因子，以及重要的交互作用。此外，该模型在非国有企业中表现更佳，表明算法筛选在CEO评估以市场为导向时最为有用。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，机器学习可以为CEO选拔提供一种互补且可审计的筛选基准。关键词：CEO选拔；机器学习；XGBoost；CEO更替；模型解释 JEL分类：C10 G30 M12 M51 致谢：作者感谢Jianjun Jia、Guangwei Li、Lei Wang和Su Wang的有益评论与建议，以及上海科技大学、2023年《太平洋盆地金融杂志》关于公司金融中人工智能与机器学习的特刊会议和上海对外经贸大学内部会议的与会者们的有益讨论。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718445.title: Can machine learning improve CEO selection?
10.1080/00036846.2026.2718445.title_zh: 机器学习能否改善CEO选拔？

10.1080/00036846.2026.2719625.abstract: As a central bank-backed digital financial infrastructure innovation, central bank digital currency (CBDC) may reshape the information and transaction environment of corporate financing in the digital economy. Using A-share firms listed on China’s SME Board from 2011 to 2024 as the research sample, this study employs a multi-period difference-in-differences model to examine the impact of China’s digital yuan pilot programme on the financing constraints of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and its underlying mechanisms. The results show that the digital yuan pilot programme significantly alleviates financing constraints among SMEs. Mechanism analyses indicate that the digital yuan reduces financing constraints by improving corporate information disclosure quality and lowering financing transaction costs. Further analyses reveal that digital inclusive finance and corporate digital transformation strengthen the alleviating effect of the digital yuan. Heterogeneity tests show that the effect is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises and high-tech firms. Moreover, the alleviation of financing constraints contributes to improvements in corporate innovation efficiency and total factor productivity. This study extends the literature on the economic consequences of CBDCs by providing micro-level evidence from corporate financing and offers policy implications for enhancing SME financing environments and promoting the development of digital currency infrastructure. KEYWORDS: Digital yuan financing constraints information disclosure quality financing transaction costs digital inclusive finance corporate digital transformation JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 G28 O16
10.1080/00036846.2026.2719625.abstract_zh: 作为央行背书的数字金融基础设施创新，央行数字货币（CBDC）可能重塑数字经济中企业融资的信息与交易环境。本研究以2011至2024年中国中小板A股上市公司为研究样本，采用多期双重差分模型，考察中国数字人民币试点项目对中小企业融资约束的影响及其内在机制。研究结果表明，数字人民币试点项目显著缓解了中小企业的融资约束。机制分析显示，数字人民币通过提升企业信息披露质量和降低融资交易成本来缓解融资约束。进一步分析发现，数字普惠金融和企业数字化转型强化了数字人民币的缓解效应。异质性检验表明，该效应在非国有企业和科技型企业中更为显著。此外，融资约束的缓解有助于提升企业创新效率和全要素生产率。本研究拓展了关于CBDC经济后果的文献，提供了来自企业融资层面的微观证据，并为改善中小企业融资环境、推动数字货币基础设施建设提供了政策启示。关键词：数字人民币；融资约束；信息披露质量；融资交易成本；数字普惠金融；企业数字化转型 JEL分类号：G21 G28 O16
10.1080/00036846.2026.2719625.title: Central bank digital currency and financing constraints of small and medium-sized enterprises: evidence from China’s digital yuan pilot programme
10.1080/00036846.2026.2719625.title_zh: 央行数字货币与中小企业融资约束：来自中国数字人民币试点项目的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2719637.abstract: This study examines how strategic alliance formation influences corporate outward foreign direct investment (OFDI) decisions based on a sample of Chinese share listed companies, and finds that strategic alliances significantly promote OFDI activities by dual channels of digital transformation and R&D investment, and the promoting effect is more pronounced for firms located within the ‘Top Ten Commercial Group Cultures’ circle, those with high ESG performance, and those with lower agency costs. Analysis of market soft information shows that strategic alliances provide additional impetus for OFDI by analyst coverage and investor optimism.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2719637.abstract_zh: 本研究基于中国A股上市公司样本，探讨了战略联盟形成如何影响企业对外直接投资决策，并发现战略联盟通过数字化转型与研发投入的双重渠道显著促进了对外直接投资活动，且这一促进效应在位于“十大商业集团文化”圈内的企业、具有高ESG表现的企业以及代理成本较低的企业中更为显著。市场软信息分析显示，战略联盟通过分析师关注与投资者乐观情绪为对外直接投资提供了额外动力。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2719637.title: Strategic alliances and outward foreign direct investment decisions
10.1080/00036846.2026.2719637.title_zh: 战略联盟与对外直接投资决策

10.1080/00036846.2026.2720559.abstract: This study explores whether alternative data provide incremental predictive information for crude oil return forecasting in emerging markets, focusing on China’s Shanghai International Energy Exchange (INE) crude oil futures market. We construct a comprehensive forecasting framework that integrates traditional econometric benchmarks, mixed-frequency specifications, and deep learning models, and evaluate predictive performance through return forecasting, interval prediction for uncertainty quantification, a mean-variance framework for economic value assessment, and interpretable machine learning for information contribution analysis. The results show that deep learning models generally achieve better out-of-sample forecast accuracy and directional predictability than conventional linear benchmarks. Incorporating alternative data provides incremental predictive information beyond traditional predictors and improves the economic performance of forecasting-based portfolios. Furthermore, feature ablation and interpretability analyses reveal that different categories of alternative data provide heterogeneous incremental predictive signals, with their relative importance varying across market conditions. These findings enhance the understanding of how alternative information contributes to return predictability and information processing in the INE market, and offer practical implications for forecasting, risk assessment, and information infrastructure development in this market. KEYWORDS: Alternative data crude oil futures return forecasting emerging markets machine learning JEL CLASSIFICATION: C45 C53 G17 Q41
10.1080/00036846.2026.2720559.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了替代数据是否为新兴市场原油期货收益预测提供了增量预测信息，重点关注中国上海国际能源交易中心（INE）原油期货市场。我们构建了一个综合预测框架，整合了传统计量经济学基准模型、混频规格和深度学习模型，并通过收益预测、用于不确定性量化的区间预测、用于经济价值评估的均值-方差框架以及用于信息贡献分析的可解释机器学习来评估预测性能。结果表明，深度学习模型通常比传统线性基准模型实现更好的样本外预测准确性和方向可预测性。纳入替代数据提供了超越传统预测因子的增量预测信息，并改善了基于预测的投资组合的经济表现。此外，特征消融和可解释性分析揭示，不同类别的替代数据提供了异质性的增量预测信号，其相对重要性随市场条件而变化。这些发现增进了对替代信息如何促进INE市场收益可预测性和信息处理的理解，并为该市场的预测、风险评估和信息基础设施建设提供了实践启示。关键词：替代数据 原油期货 收益预测 新兴市场 机器学习 JEL分类号：C45 C53 G17 Q41
10.1080/00036846.2026.2720559.title: Incremental information value of alternative data and return forecasting in an emerging crude oil futures market: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2720559.title_zh: 新兴原油期货市场中另类数据的增量信息价值与收益预测：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2720561.abstract: Drawing on an unbalanced firm-year panel linking Chinese A-share listed firms to prefecture-level cities from 2012 to 2024, this study employs a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) framework to systematically estimate the effect of green data centre policy on corporate energy efficiency and to clarify the underlying mechanisms. The results show that the policy significantly enhances firms’ energy efficiency. Mechanism analyses suggest that the effect operates primarily through two channels: improved ESG performance and policy-induced increases in firms’ green investment. Heterogeneity analyses indicate that the policy impact is stronger in resource-based cities, in more competitive industries, and among mature-stage firms. Moderating analyses further show that executives’ digital cognition tends to weaken the policy effect when considered alone; however, when executives simultaneously exhibit high levels of both green and digital cognition, their synergistic alignment yields a positive moderating effect. In addition, as successive pilot batches expand, the policy’s diffusion effect exhibits a nonlinear trajectory, increasing initially and then declining thereafter. KEYWORDS: Green data centre policy corporate energy efficiency executives’ green cognition executives’ digital cognition JEL CLASSIFICATION: O21 O25
10.1080/00036846.2026.2720561.abstract_zh: 本研究基于2012至2024年间中国A股上市公司与地级市相匹配的不平衡企业-年度面板数据，采用交错双重差分（DID）框架，系统评估了绿色数据中心政策对企业能源效率的影响，并厘清了其内在作用机制。结果表明，该政策显著提升了企业能源效率。机制分析显示，这一效应主要通过两条渠道发挥作用：ESG表现的改善以及政策引致的企业绿色投资增加。异质性分析表明，政策效应在资源型城市、竞争更激烈的行业以及成熟期企业中更为显著。调节分析进一步显示，高管数字认知单独存在时倾向于削弱政策效应；然而，当高管同时具备高水平的绿色认知与数字认知时，二者的协同匹配产生了正向调节作用。此外，随着试点批次逐步扩展，政策的扩散效应呈现非线性轨迹，先上升后下降。关键词：绿色数据中心政策；企业能源效率；高管绿色认知；高管数字认知 JEL分类：O21 O25
10.1080/00036846.2026.2720561.title: Green data centre policy, executives’ cognition, and corporate energy efficiency
10.1080/00036846.2026.2720561.title_zh: 绿色数据中心政策、高管认知与企业能源效率

10.1080/00036846.2026.2720565.abstract: This article investigates the role of health perception biases for healthcare utilization and related expenditure in China, an underexplored context characterized by rapid population ageing and fragmented healthcare coverage. Using panel data on over 17,000 adults from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS), we measure health perception biases as the difference between objective health outcomes from physical examinations and self-reported health. We find that health underestimation is associated with more doctor visits, while health overestimation is correlated with less doctor services. The positive association between underestimation and hospital stays is present in random-effects and correlated random-effects Poisson estimates but is not supported by the FE Poisson estimates. Health perception biases are also strongly associated with total and out-of-pocket expenditures for both outpatient and inpatient care. Importantly, family support – especially the presence of co-resident sons – moderates the association between health underestimation and doctor visits, highlighting the role of family dynamics in healthcare decisions. KEYWORDS: Health perception bias overconfidence underconfidence healthcare utilization China JEL CLASSIFICATION: I12 I18 P46
10.1080/00036846.2026.2720565.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了健康认知偏差在中国医疗保健利用及相关支出中的作用，这一背景尚未得到充分研究，其特点是人口快速老龄化和医疗保障覆盖碎片化。利用中国健康与养老追踪调查（CHARLS）中超过17，000名成年人的面板数据，我们将健康认知偏差量化为体检得出的客观健康结果与自报健康之间的差异。研究发现，健康低估与更多的就诊次数相关，而健康高估则与较少的医疗服务使用相关。低估与住院之间的正相关关系在随机效应和相关随机效应泊松估计中显著，但固定效应泊松估计未支持这一结果。健康认知偏差还与门诊和住院护理的总支出及自付支出密切相关。重要的是，家庭支持——尤其是与儿子同住——调节了健康低估与就诊次数之间的关联，凸显了家庭动态在医疗保健决策中的作用。关键词：健康认知偏差；过度自信；信心不足；医疗保健利用；中国 JEL分类：I12 I18 P46
10.1080/00036846.2026.2720565.title: Health perception biases and healthcare utilization in China: a longitudinal approach
10.1080/00036846.2026.2720565.title_zh: 中国健康认知偏差与医疗服务利用：一项纵向研究

10.1080/00036846.2026.2721540.abstract: Corporate financialization has emerged as a pivotal force reshaping the finance–trade nexus and profoundly altering firms’ export trajectories. Using a panel of Chinese A-share non-financial listed firms from 2008 to 2024, this paper empirically examines the effect of corporate financialization on export scale and its underlying mechanisms. We find that financial asset accumulation significantly increases export volumes, and this result remains robust across a battery of sensitivity checks. Channel analyses reveal that the effect operates mainly through alleviating financing constraints and reducing information-acquisition costs. In addition, heterogeneity tests show that export performance is much stronger among firms located in regions with superior innovation environments, firms in industries with low competition, and firms with low technological intensity. The study provides micro-level evidence on the interlinkage between financial asset allocation and real economic activity, offering new insights into the finance-trade-growth chain. KEYWORDS: Corporate financialization firm-level exports financial asset allocation real economy activity
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721540.abstract_zh: 企业金融化已成为重塑金融—贸易关系并深刻改变企业出口轨迹的关键力量。利用2008年至2024年中国A股非金融类上市公司的面板数据，本文实证考察了企业金融化对出口规模的影响及其内在机制。研究发现，金融资产积累显著提升了出口规模，且这一结果在一系列敏感性检验中保持稳健。渠道分析表明，该效应主要通过缓解融资约束和降低信息获取成本发挥作用。此外，异质性检验显示，在创新环境优越地区的企业、低竞争行业中的企业以及技术密集度较低的企业中，出口表现更为突出。本研究为金融资产配置与实体经济活动之间的关联提供了微观层面的证据，为金融—贸易—增长链条提供了新的见解。关键词：企业金融化；企业层面出口；金融资产配置；实体经济活动
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721540.title: Does corporate financialization promote exports?
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721540.title_zh: 企业金融化是否促进了出口？

10.1080/00036846.2026.2721541.abstract: This article examines the short-run equity market impact of the February 2026 US–Israeli occupation coordinated strikes on Iran using a dual-benchmark event study applied to 491 S&P 500 constituents. Relative to the S&P 500 index (internal benchmark), the aggregate cumulative average abnormal return (CAAR) over the six-trading-day post-event window [0, +5] is −1.76%, indicating that constituents underperformed the cap-weighted index on average. Relative to the EFA international benchmark (iShares MSCI EAFE ETF, excludes US), the same constituents earned a CAAR of +3.00%***, consistent with a flight-to-US-quality effect. Sector heterogeneity is pronounced: Energy firms earn +2.65%** under the internal benchmark, while Consumer Staples (−5.07%), Materials (−4.94%), Health Care (−3.59%*), Industrials (−3.21%), and Consumer Discretionary (−3.23%***) record the largest negative relative returns. Cross-sectional regressions with HC3 standard errors confirm that sector fixed effects explain 15.4% of firm-level CAR variation (joint F-test p < 0.001), compared with only 3.3% for seven firm-level characteristics. Results are robust across estimation window lengths and a six-statistic test battery.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721541.abstract_zh: 本文采用双基准事件研究法，对2026年2月美以联合对伊朗协调打击后的短期股票市场影响进行了考察，研究对象涵盖标普500指数中的491只成分股。相对于标普500指数（内部基准），在事件后六个交易日窗口[0, +5]内，累计平均异常收益率（CAAR）为−1.76%，表明成分股平均表现逊于市值加权指数。相对于EFA国际基准（iShares MSCI EAFE ETF，不含美国），同一批成分股的CAAR为+3.00%***，与资金流向美国优质资产的效应一致。行业异质性显著：能源企业在内部基准下获得+2.65%**的正收益，而必需消费品（−5.07%）、材料（−4.94%）、医疗保健（−3.59%*）、工业（−3.21%）和非必需消费品（−3.23%***）则录得最大的负相对收益。采用HC3标准误的横截面回归证实，行业固定效应解释了企业层面CAR变异的15.4%（联合F检验p < 0.001），而七项企业层面特征仅解释了3.3%。结果在估计窗口长度变化及六项统计检验组合下均保持稳健。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721541.title: Shock and reprice: sectoral heterogeneity in S&P 500 constituent abnormal returns around the 2026 Iran strikes
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721541.title_zh: 冲击与重新定价：2026年伊朗打击事件前后标普500成分股异常收益的行业异质性

10.1080/00036846.2026.2721542.abstract: Fund managers may adjust portfolio styles to pursue short-term private benefits, with implications for investor welfare and market stability. Using a sample of 3,243 Chinese equity-oriented mutual funds from 2012 to 2022, this paper examines the determinants and performance consequences of style drift by separating two behaviours: self-drift, defined as intertemporal variation in a fund’s style relative to its own history, and benchmark-drift, defined as deviation from the prospectus-stated style. This paper shows that self-drift is associated with two distinct motives—hot-chasing by underperforming funds and value-seeking by top performers—while benchmark-drift is predominantly driven by hot-chasing among underperformers. Consistent with these channels, the link between self-drift and future performance hinges on past performance, whereas benchmark-drift is followed by markedly lower future returns. Further evidence indicates that compensation incentives, rather than career concerns, are the primary driver of style drift. Although investors can distinguish the two forms, they disproportionately allocate capital to self-drift funds, suggesting limited recognition of their heterogeneous underlying motives. KEYWORDS: Self-drift benchmark-drift hot-chasing value-seeking fund performance JEL CLASSIFICATION: G11 G23 G41
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721542.abstract_zh: 基金经理可能为了追求短期私人利益而调整投资组合风格，这对投资者福利和市场稳定性具有重要影响。本文以2012年至2022年间3，243只中国股票型共同基金为样本，通过区分两种行为——自我漂移（定义为基金风格相对于自身历史的时间变化）和基准漂移（定义为偏离招募说明书所述风格）——考察了风格漂移的决定因素及其业绩后果。研究发现，自我漂移与两种不同的动机相关——业绩不佳基金的追逐热点行为和顶尖基金的寻求价值行为——而基准漂移则主要由业绩不佳者的追逐热点行为驱动。与这些渠道一致，自我漂移与未来业绩之间的关系取决于过往业绩，而基准漂移之后则伴随着显著较低的未来回报。进一步证据表明，薪酬激励而非职业担忧是风格漂移的主要驱动因素。尽管投资者能够区分这两种形式，但他们将资本不成比例地配置给自我漂移基金，这表明投资者对其异质性潜在动机的认知有限。关键词：自我漂移 基准漂移 追逐热点 寻求价值 基金业绩 JEL分类：G11 G23 G41
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721542.title: Style drift in China’s capital market: hot-chasing or value-seeking?
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721542.title_zh: 中国资本市场风格漂移：追热还是寻值？

10.1080/00036846.2026.2721543.abstract: This study examines the impact of efficient data transactions on firm innovation. We develop a theoretical framework showing that transaction frictions in processed data markets impede the circulation of data bundles and that efficient transaction mechanisms introduced by Data Trading Centres (DTCs) promote firm innovation by reducing data acquisition costs and strengthening learning from external knowledge. Exploiting the staggered establishment of DTCs in China as a quasi-natural experiment and employing a stacked difference-in-differences estimator, we find that DTCs significantly increase firms’ innovation output. Mechanism analyses show that these effects are stronger for firms with greater dependence on externally sourced processed data and for those with greater opportunities for knowledge spillovers, providing direct evidence for the production cost-saving and learning channels predicted by the theoretical model. Beyond increasing innovation quantity, DTCs also enhance the quality and novelty of firms’ innovations by increasing patent citations, broadening patent knowledge breadth, and raising the adjusted citation-based disruptiveness (ACD) index, suggesting that DTCs encourage more original technological exploration. KEYWORDS: Data trading centres firm innovation data transactions cost savings learning effects JEL CLASSIFICATION: O31 O33 D22 Acknowledgements We appreciate the valuable feedback provided by the reviewers during the revision process. Additionally, we extend our gratitude to colleagues and professors who took the time to read the manuscript and provide their valuable suggestions for improvement.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721543.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨高效数据交易对企业创新的影响。我们构建了一个理论框架，表明加工数据市场中的交易摩擦阻碍了数据包的流通，而数据交易中心（DTCs）引入的高效交易机制通过降低数据获取成本并强化外部知识学习，促进了企业创新。利用中国数据交易中心分阶段设立作为准自然实验，并采用堆叠双重差分估计方法，我们发现数据交易中心显著提升了企业的创新产出。机制分析显示，这些效应对于更依赖外部来源加工数据的企业以及知识溢出机会更大的企业更为显著，为理论模型预测的生产成本节约和学习渠道提供了直接证据。除了增加创新数量外，数据交易中心还通过增加专利引用、拓宽专利知识广度以及提高基于引用的调整后颠覆性指数（ACD），提升了企业创新的质量和新颖性，表明数据交易中心鼓励了更具原创性的技术探索。关键词：数据交易中心；企业创新；数据交易；成本节约；学习效应 JEL分类：O31 O33 D22 致谢 我们感谢审稿人在修订过程中提供的宝贵反馈。此外，我们向在百忙之中阅读稿件并提供宝贵改进建议的同事和教授们致以诚挚的谢意。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721543.title: How do data trading centers affect firm innovation: quasi-experimental evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721543.title_zh: 数据交易中心如何影响企业创新：来自中国的准实验证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2721544.abstract: Green innovation is crucial for sustainable corporate development; however, existing literature provides limited insight into how energy-derivatives market development (EDMD) affects corporate green innovation behaviour. Using the official launch of the Shanghai crude oil futures contract as an exogenous shock, this study investigates whether EDMD enhances Chinese corporate green innovation. Using a panel of A-share listed firms from 2013 to 2023 (comprising 22,179 firm-year observations) and a continuous difference-in-differences (DID) design, this study has found that the introduction of crude oil futures in China significantly elevates corporate green innovation levels. This result was robust to a battery of checks. The mechanism analysis revealed that EDMD promoted green innovation by alleviating financial constraints. Managerial myopia and heightened information asymmetry attenuate this positive relationship. Heterogeneity analyses have indicated that the promoting effect is more pronounced among state-owned enterprises, highly polluting firms, and firms in which the roles of the CEO and board chairs are separated. Overall, this study provides micro-level empirical evidence of the nexus between EDMD and corporate green innovation and offers relevant insights into the design of energy policies. KEYWORDS: Energy-derivatives market development corporate green innovation crude oil futures financial constraints JEL CLASSIFICATION: G18 G30 O31
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721544.abstract_zh: 绿色创新对企业可持续发展至关重要；然而，现有文献对能源衍生品市场发展如何影响企业绿色创新行为的探讨十分有限。本研究以中国上海原油期货合约的正式上市作为外生冲击，考察能源衍生品市场发展是否促进了中国企业的绿色创新。基于2013至2023年间A股上市公司的面板数据（包含22，179个公司-年度观测值），并采用连续型双重差分模型，研究发现中国原油期货的推出显著提升了企业绿色创新水平，且该结论在一系列稳健性检验后依然成立。机制分析表明，能源衍生品市场发展通过缓解企业融资约束促进了绿色创新，而管理层短视与信息不对称程度的加剧则会削弱这一正向效应。异质性分析显示，在国有企业、高污染企业以及董事长与总经理两职分离的企业中，该促进效应更为显著。总体而言，本研究为能源衍生品市场发展与企业绿色创新之间的关联提供了微观层面的经验证据，并为能源政策设计提供了相关启示。关键词：能源衍生品市场发展；企业绿色创新；原油期货；融资约束 JEL分类号：G18 G30 O31
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721544.title: Energy-derivatives market development and corporate green innovation: evidence from the launch of Shanghai crude oil futures
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721544.title_zh: 能源衍生品市场发展与企业绿色创新——来自上海原油期货上市的实证证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2721545.abstract: This study examines the spatial treatment effects of Low-carbon City pilot policy on PM 2.5 concentrations across 277 cities in China from 2005 to 2023. Based on spatial causal inference, this study finds that this policy significantly decreases PM 2.5 concentrations in regions with greater policy intensity, while the direct effects of this policy are not significant in regions with lower policy intensity. Furthermore, the implementation of this policy reduces PM 2.5 concentrations in the neighbouring cities from the perspective of spatial effects while its direct effects are weaker. The implementation of Low-carbon City pilot policy diminishes PM 2.5 concentrations through increasing environmental technological innovation capacity and average green asset ratio of regional firms. This study further examines the spatial attenuation effects and heterogeneous impacts arising from differentiated policy regulation intensity, indicating the transformation of the spatial pattern from mutual collaboration to a beggar-thy-neighbour situation as distance increases. KEYWORDS: Environmental pilot policy spatial causal inference spillover effects spatial attenuation effects JEL CLASSIFICATION: C31 Q55 Q56 Acknowledgements The authors gratefully thank editors and three anonymous referees for their insightful feedback.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721545.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了低碳城市试点政策对2005年至2023年间中国277个城市PM 2.5浓度的空间处理效应。基于空间因果推断，本研究发现该政策在政策强度较高的地区显著降低了PM 2.5浓度，而在政策强度较低的地区，其直接效应并不显著。此外，从空间效应的角度来看，该政策的实施降低了邻近城市的PM 2.5浓度，而其直接效应则相对较弱。低碳城市试点政策的实施通过提升区域企业的环境技术创新能力和平均绿色资产比率来降低PM 2.5浓度。本研究进一步探讨了差异化政策调控强度所带来的空间衰减效应和异质性影响，表明随着距离的增加，空间格局从相互协作转变为以邻为壑的状态。关键词：环境试点政策 空间因果推断 溢出效应 空间衰减效应 JEL分类：C31 Q55 Q56 致谢 作者衷心感谢编辑及三位匿名审稿人的 insightful 反馈意见。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721545.title: Low-carbon policy regulation and spatial effects: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721545.title_zh: 低碳政策规制与空间效应：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2721547.abstract: The choice of a major in higher education is closely associated with the sector of activity of future employment. As a labour price signal, the industry salary level is transmitted to candidates through the labour market and affects their choice of major. Drawing on panel data matching college entrance examination admission scores of majors with industry salary levels from 147 Chinese ‘Double First-Class’ universities during 2019–2023, this study employs fixed-effects panel regression models to explore the mechanism underlying the effect of industry salary levels on college entrance examination admission scores for corresponding majors. The findings indicate that rising industry salary levels significantly increase the college entrance examination admission scores of relevant majors, and that the rising popularity of majors and the improvement in teaching quality are important factors contributing to these higher admission scores. More importantly, the increasing salary levels of upstream industries also contribute to higher college entrance examination admission scores for majors related to the target industry. From the perspective of salary signals, this article provides empirical evidence regarding the major choices of college entrance examination candidates, the structure of university majors, and the improvement of the talent supply–demand matching mechanism. KEYWORDS: Industry salary level price signal college entrance examination score for majors Double First-Class universities JEL CLASSIFICATION: J31 J24 I21
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721547.abstract_zh: 高等教育专业选择与未来就业的行业领域密切相关。作为劳动力价格信号，行业薪酬水平通过劳动力市场传递给考生，并影响其专业选择。本研究利用2019—2023年间147所中国“双一流”高校的专业高考录取分数与行业薪酬水平相匹配的面板数据，采用固定效应面板回归模型，探讨行业薪酬水平对相应专业高考录取分数的影响机制。研究结果表明，行业薪酬水平的上升显著提高了相关专业的高考录取分数，而专业热度的上升及教学质量的提升是推动录取分数提高的重要因素。更为重要的是，上游行业薪酬水平的提升同样有助于提高目标行业相关专业的高考录取分数。本文从薪酬信号视角，为高考考生的专业选择、高校专业结构设置及人才供需匹配机制的完善提供了经验证据。关键词：行业薪酬水平；价格信号；专业高考录取分数；双一流高校 JEL分类：J31 J24 I21
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721547.title: Industry salary signals and adjustments in college entrance examination admission scores for majors: evidence from China’s Double First-Class universities
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721547.title_zh: 行业薪酬信号与高考专业录取分数线的调整：来自中国“双一流”大学的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2721551.abstract: We examine the impact of climate risk exposure on corporate resilience using data on Chinese A-share listed firms. The results show that higher climate-related disclosure intensity is significantly negatively associated with corporate resilience, with a stronger association among firms whose executives lack environmental backgrounds, as well as firms in high-carbon and heavily polluting industries. Further analysis indicates that greenwashing exacerbates this negative effect, whereas green investment effectively mitigates the adverse impact of climate risk on corporate resilience. Mechanism tests show that climate risk mainly undermines firms’ adaptive capacity by intensifying external monitoring and suppressing risk-taking. Overall, this article provides new disclosure-based evidence on the relationship between climate risk and corporate resilience. KEYWORDS: Climate risk corporate resilience external monitoring risk aversion textual analysis JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q54 L25 G32 D22
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721551.abstract_zh: 我们利用中国A股上市公司的数据，考察了气候风险暴露对企业韧性的影响。结果显示，气候相关披露强度越高，企业韧性显著越低，且这一关联在管理层缺乏环境背景的企业以及高碳、重污染行业的企业中更为明显。进一步分析表明，绿色洗白行为加剧了这一负面效应，而绿色投资则能有效缓解气候风险对企业韧性的不利影响。机制检验显示，气候风险主要通过加强外部监督和抑制风险承担来削弱企业的适应能力。总体而言，本文为气候风险与企业韧性之间的关系提供了基于披露的新证据。关键词：气候风险；企业韧性；外部监督；风险规避；文本分析 JEL分类：Q54 L25 G32 D22
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721551.title: Climate risk and corporate resilience: text-based evidence from Chinese listed firms
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721551.title_zh: 气候风险与企业韧性：来自中国上市公司的文本证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2721553.abstract: As data evolve into a core factor of production in the digital economy, their assetization poses unprecedented challenges to financial reporting and auditing practices. Based on a sample of Chinese A-share listed firms in Shanghai and Shenzhen from 2013 to 2024, this study empirically examines the impact of corporate data assetization on audit pricing and its underlying mechanisms. The results show that data assetization significantly increases audit fees, a finding robust to a series of tests. Mechanism analysis reveals three distinct channels: higher audit resource input, greater difficulty in measuring excess goodwill, and elevated operational risk. Further analysis shows that the upward pressure on audit fees is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises, technology-intensive firms, and firms with aggressive earnings management, poor ESG performance, or negative textual tone in annual reports. Additional evidence confirms that data assetization increases auditors’ propensity to issue modified audit opinions. This study extends audit pricing research to data assets by demonstrating how their unique attributes reshape audit risk and resource allocation. It also offers practical implications for corporate governance, auditor expertise, and regulatory standard-setting. KEYWORDS: Data assetization audit fees audit risk audit opinions JEL CLASSIFICATION: M42 O33 G32 G41
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721553.abstract_zh: 随着数据演变为数字经济中的核心生产要素，其资产化对财务报告与审计实务构成了前所未有的挑战。本研究以2013年至2024年中国沪深A股上市公司为样本，实证考察了企业数据资产化对审计定价的影响及其内在机制。结果表明，数据资产化显著提高了审计费用，该发现在一系列检验中保持稳健。机制分析揭示了三条不同的传导渠道：审计资源投入增加、超额商誉计量难度加大以及经营风险上升。进一步分析显示，审计费用的上行压力在非国有企业、技术密集型企业以及具有激进盈余管理、ESG表现不佳或年报文本语调负面的企业中更为显著。额外证据证实，数据资产化提高了审计师出具非标准审计意见的倾向。本研究将审计定价研究拓展至数据资产领域，展示了其独特属性如何重塑审计风险与资源配置，同时为企业治理、审计师专业能力及监管标准制定提供了实践启示。关键词：数据资产化；审计费用；审计风险；审计意见 JEL分类：M42 O33 G32 G41
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721553.title: Data assetization and audit pricing: evidence from China’s digital economy
10.1080/00036846.2026.2721553.title_zh: 数据资产化与审计定价：来自中国数字经济的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2722303.abstract: This study investigates how an unprecedented systemic shock, the COVID-19 pandemic, reshaped bank productivity and intermediation efficiency in Vietnam, one of the fastest-growing emerging economies. We develop a novel risk-adjusted total factor productivity (TFP) measure based on the by-production Luenberger–Hicks–Moorsteen (LHM) indicator, which incorporates non-performing loans as undesirable outputs to better capture credit-risk dynamics. Using a balanced panel covering both the pre-pandemic and pandemic periods (2016–2022), our results show that Vietnamese banks experienced a general decline in productivity before and during COVID-19, driven largely by reductions in technical and scale efficiency. However, foreign and state-owned banks recorded stronger technological progress during the pandemic, reflecting accelerated digital transformation and operational adjustment. Regression results reveal a positive relationship between the COVID-19 period and productivity, suggesting that crisis-driven innovation and policy intervention helped offset negative shocks. Conversely, credit growth, loan-loss provisioning, bank size, and deposit dependence are all negatively associated with productivity, underscoring the importance of prudent risk management, optimal scale, and funding diversification for sustaining performance under stress.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722303.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了前所未有的系统性冲击——新冠疫情，如何重塑越南（增长最快的新兴经济体之一）的银行生产率和中介效率。我们基于副产品卢恩伯格-希克斯-穆尔斯滕（LHM）指标，开发了一种新颖的风险调整后全要素生产率（TFP）衡量方法，该方法将不良贷款作为非期望产出纳入考量，以更准确地捕捉信用风险动态。利用涵盖疫情前和疫情期间（2016-2022年）的平衡面板数据，我们的结果显示，越南银行在疫情前及疫情期间普遍经历生产率下降，这主要归因于技术效率和规模效率的降低。然而，外资银行和国有银行在疫情期间录得了更强的技术进步，反映出数字化转型加速和运营调整。回归结果显示，疫情期间与生产率之间存在正相关关系，表明危机驱动的创新和政策干预有助于抵消负面冲击。相反，信贷增长、贷款损失拨备、银行规模和存款依赖度均与生产率负相关，这强调了审慎风险管理、最优规模和资金来源多元化对于在压力下维持绩效的重要性。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722303.title: Crisis, credit risk, and productivity: lessons from the Vietnamese banking sector during COVID-19
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722303.title_zh: 危机、信用风险与生产率：COVID-19期间越南银行业的经验教训

10.1080/00036846.2026.2722305.abstract: As economic globalization and the specialization of labour deepen, competition among firms has increasingly shifted towards supply-chain-based competition. Accordingly, the continued enhancement of supply chain resilience has become a key issue in corporate strategic management. Using data on Chinese A-share listed firms from 2008 to 2024, this study examines the effect of shareholder chain relationship networks on corporate supply chain resilience and further explores the underlying mechanisms. The results indicate a significant positive association between shareholder chain relationship networks and corporate supply chain resilience, and the findings remain robust across a series of robustness checks. Mechanism tests demonstrate that operating risk diversification and resource allocation efficiency are important channels through which shareholder chain relationship networks enhance corporate supply chain resilience. Heterogeneity tests show that shareholder chain relationship networks have a more pronounced effect on enhancing supply chain resilience among firms with greater managerial myopia and higher internal control quality. KEYWORDS: Shareholder chain relationship network corporate supply chain resilience operating risk resource allocation JEL CLASSIFICATION: D22 G32 G41
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722305.abstract_zh: 随着经济全球化与劳动分工的深化，企业间的竞争日益转向供应链层面的竞争，持续增强供应链韧性由此成为企业战略管理的关键议题。本文利用2008—2024年中国A股上市公司数据，考察了股东链关系网络对企业供应链韧性的影响，并进一步探讨了其作用机制。研究结果表明，股东链关系网络与企业供应链韧性之间存在显著的正向关联，且该结论在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。机制检验显示，经营风险分散与资源配置效率是股东链关系网络提升企业供应链韧性的重要渠道。异质性检验表明，在管理者短视程度较高及内部控制质量较高的企业中，股东链关系网络对供应链韧性的提升作用更为显著。关键词：股东链关系网络；企业供应链韧性；经营风险；资源配置 JEL分类：D22 G32 G41
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722305.title: Can shareholder chain relationship network enhance corporate supply chain resilience? Evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722305.title_zh: 股东链关系网络能否增强企业供应链韧性？来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2722306.abstract: Mitigating local government debt risk poses a significant challenge for debt governance in developing countries. However, the causal link between environmental regulation and local government debt risk remains underexplored. This study examines the causal impact of environmental regulation on local government debt risk. We leverage China’s Blue Sky Defence War as a quasi-exogenous shock to environmental regulation. In a difference-in-differences framework with unbalanced panel data from 2,491 counties between 2015 and 2023, we find that environmental regulation significantly reduces local government debt risk. We then provide evidence suggesting that environmental regulation lowers local government debt risk by enhancing repayment capacity and optimizing the debt structure. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the effect is more pronounced in regions with more implicit government debt structure, superior government credit, advanced factor markets, and lower resource dependency. Further results reveal that environmental regulation effectively promotes high-quality economic development. Overall, our findings confirm the importance of environmental regulation in managing local government debt risk and enhancing its economic benefits.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722306.abstract_zh: 缓解地方政府债务风险是发展中国家债务治理面临的重大挑战。然而，环境规制与地方政府债务风险之间的因果关系尚未得到充分探讨。本研究考察了环境规制对地方政府债务风险的影响。我们利用中国的蓝天保卫战作为环境规制的准外生冲击。在基于2015年至2023年间2491个县的非平衡面板数据的双重差分框架中，我们发现环境规制显著降低了地方政府债务风险。随后，我们提供的证据表明，环境规制通过增强偿债能力和优化债务结构来降低地方政府债务风险。异质性分析显示，在隐性政府债务结构更突出、政府信用更优、要素市场更发达以及资源依赖度较低的地区，这一效应更为显著。进一步的结果揭示，环境规制有效促进了高质量经济发展。总体而言，我们的研究结果证实了环境规制在管理地方政府债务风险及提升其经济效益方面的重要性。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722306.title: Environmental regulation and local government debt risk
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722306.title_zh: 环境规制与地方政府债务风险

10.1080/00036846.2026.2722308.abstract: Against the backdrop of economic globalization, relationships among countries established through regional services trade agreements (services RTAs) have become increasingly complex. Assessing a country’s global value chain (GVC) position requires considering its place within the network of services RTAs formed with other economies. Using data from 60 countries for the period 2007–2021, this study estimates the impact of the services RTA network, with network linkages weighted by agreement depth, on countries’ GVC positions. The results indicate that the expansion and deepening of the services RTA network significantly promote the upgrading of countries’ GVC positions, and the conclusion is robust. This positive effect operates primarily through three channels: reductions in services trade costs, technology spillovers, and adjustments to production length. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the positive effect of the services RTA network on GVC upgrading is more pronounced in North-North and North-South cooperation as well as in multilateral agreements, and that this effect varies across sectors. This study contributes to understanding how the services RTA network affects the development of global value chains and provides insights for countries seeking to improve their services trade policies. KEYWORDS: Regional services trade agreements GVC upgrading complex network analysis deep RTAs intensive margin JEL CLASSIFICATION: F13 F14 F60
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722308.abstract_zh: 在经济全球化的背景下，各国通过区域服务贸易协定（服务RTA）建立的国家间关系日益复杂。评估一个国家的全球价值链（GVC）地位，需要考虑其与其他经济体形成的服务RTA网络中的位置。本研究利用2007年至2021年间60个国家的数据，估计了以协定深度加权的服务RTA网络联系对国家GVC地位的影响。结果表明，服务RTA网络的扩展与深化显著促进了国家GVC地位的提升，且该结论具有稳健性。这一积极效应主要通过三个渠道发挥作用：服务贸易成本的降低、技术溢出以及生产长度的调整。异质性分析揭示，服务RTA网络对GVC升级的积极效应在南北合作和北北合作以及多边协定中更为显著，且该效应在不同部门间存在差异。本研究有助于理解服务RTA网络如何影响全球价值链的发展，并为各国改善服务贸易政策提供了启示。关键词：区域服务贸易协定；GVC升级；复杂网络分析；深度RTA；集约边际 JEL分类：F13 F14 F60
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722308.title: Regional services trade agreements and upgrading in global value chains: an analysis from the network perspective
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722308.title_zh: 区域服务贸易协定与全球价值链升级：基于网络视角的分析

10.1080/00036846.2026.2722309.abstract: This study contributes to the literature on inequality of educational opportunity (IEOp) by advancing both the measurement and the empirical analysis of how social background shapes educational attainment in the United States over time. The study makes several key contributions. First, whereas existing studies typically rely on a limited set of circumstance variables, this study incorporates a more comprehensive and multidimensional set of background characteristics. Second, the paper introduces a novel composite measure – the Social Advantage Factor (SAF) – which summarizes multiple dimensions of social and economic background into a single index and overcomes the existing trade-off between capturing heterogeneity and maintaining statistical precision. Third, motivated by recent developments, this study employs machine-learning techniques to reduce reliance on ad hoc model selection, flexibly capture nonlinearities and interactions among circumstance variables, address multicollinearity, and enhance the robustness of opportunity estimates. In addition, this study provides a long-term perspective on inequality of educational opportunity by examining trends since 1920 across four distinct educational stages. The findings show that, over time, inequality of educational opportunity has decreased for ‘high school’ and ‘some college attainment’ levels. Evidence of persistent inequality remains at the college graduation level, while estimates for post-college attainment should be interpreted more cautiously due to weak model performance at this educational stage. KEYWORDS: Inequality educational opportunity Social Advantage Factor machine-learning JEL CLASSIFICATION: I24 I20 J18
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722309.abstract_zh: 本研究在推进教育机会不平等（IEOp）相关文献方面做出了贡献，既改进了测量方法，也深化了对美国社会背景如何随时间影响教育成就的实证分析。本研究具有多项关键贡献。首先，现有研究通常依赖有限的环境变量集，而本研究纳入了更为全面且多维的背景特征。其次，本文引入了一种新颖的复合测量指标——社会优势因子（SAF）——将社会与经济背景的多个维度汇总为单一指数，从而克服了在捕捉异质性与维持统计精度之间的现有权衡。第三，受近期研究进展启发，本研究采用机器学习技术，以减少对临时模型选择的依赖，灵活捕捉环境变量间的非线性关系与交互效应，处理多重共线性问题，并增强机会估计的稳健性。此外，本研究通过考察自1920年以来四个不同教育阶段的趋势，提供了教育机会不平等的长期视角。研究结果显示，随着时间的推移，“高中”和“部分大学教育”阶段的教育机会不平等有所下降。大学本科毕业阶段仍存在持续不平等的证据，而研究生及以上教育阶段的估计结果应更为谨慎地解读，因为该教育阶段的模型表现较弱。关键词：教育机会不平等 社会优势因子 机器学习 JEL分类：I24 I20 J18
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722309.title: The evolution of inequality of educational opportunity in USA: a machine-learning approach
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722309.title_zh: 美国教育机会不平等演变：一种机器学习方法

10.1080/00036846.2026.2722310.abstract: Recent NCAA policy changes reduced barriers to player mobility and allowed athletes to be compensated for their Name, Image, and Likeness, making the labour market for athletes more competitive. We investigate how these changes affect the distribution of elite quarterback talent within NCAA football. After controlling for the supply of elite quarterbacks, which increases during the NIL period, and team-specific factors, we find no aggregate effect on the likelihood of teams having an elite quarterback on their roster. However, Power conference schools do have significantly more elite quarterbacks on their rosters after the policy change, and this is primarily driven by elite talent moving to schools without a returning starting quarterback. This suggests that these policy changes allow market forces to direct resources where they have an opportunity to be more productive. These findings suggest that market forces are directing elite quarterbacks towards Power programmes where there is a chance to start, and QB talent generally is moving to where it has a clearer path towards playing time. KEYWORDS: NIL football labour mobility sports economics JEL CLASSIFICATION: J08 Z28 J62
