10.1080/00036846.2026.2722310.abstract_zh: 近期NCAA政策调整降低了球员流动壁垒，并允许运动员就其姓名、形象和肖像权获得补偿，这使得运动员劳动力市场更具竞争性。我们研究了这些变化如何影响NCAA橄榄球中精英四分卫人才的分布。在控制了精英四分卫供给（在NIL时期有所增加）以及球队特定因素后，我们发现这些变化对球队阵容中拥有精英四分卫的可能性没有总体效应。然而，政策变化后，权力联盟学校阵容中的精英四分卫数量显著增加，这主要源于精英人才流向那些没有回归首发四分卫的学校。这表明，这些政策调整使市场力量能够将资源引导至其可能更具生产力的地方。这些发现表明，市场力量正将精英四分卫引向有机会首发的权力联盟项目，而四分卫人才总体上正流向那些上场时间路径更清晰的学校。关键词：NIL 橄榄球 劳动力流动性 体育经济学 JEL分类：J08 Z28 J62
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722310.title: NIL, the transfer portal, and quarterback talent in NCAA football
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722310.title_zh: NCAA橄榄球中的NIL、转会门户与四分卫人才

10.1080/00036846.2026.2722313.abstract: The rising incidence of conflict has raised concerns regarding the socioeconomic outcomes of affected populations. This study investigates how violent conflict shapes food insecurity coping strategies among households in Nigeria. Using a spatially merged dataset that links a longitudinal High Frequency Phone Survey (HFPS) with geocoded conflict data from the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data (ACLED), we employ an instrumental variable (IV) approach to address potential endogeneity between conflict exposure and food insecurity. We instrument conflict with proximity to an international border and proximity to the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja. Our study shows that violent conflict significantly worsens household food insecurity and increases reliance on adverse food coping strategies. We further find that conflict significantly increases the likelihood of severe food insecurity among households. Urban residence, age of the household head, household employment, temperature, and precipitation are also significantly associated with food insecurity outcomes, highlighting the importance of socioeconomic, spatial, and environmental factors in shaping household vulnerability. Findings are robust across different measures of food insecurity and various sensitivity tests. Given the strong adverse effect of conflict on household food security and coping behaviour, addressing conflict-driven vulnerabilities is crucial for improving food security in affected regions.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722313.abstract_zh: 冲突事件的日益增多引发了对受影响人口社会经济状况的担忧。本研究探讨了暴力冲突如何影响尼日利亚家庭应对粮食不安全的策略。通过整合一个将纵向高频电话调查（HFPS）与武装冲突地点与事件数据（ACLED）中的地理编码冲突数据相链接的空间合并数据集，我们采用工具变量（IV）方法来应对冲突暴露与粮食不安全之间可能存在的内生性问题。我们以与国际边界的距离以及与联邦首都区阿布贾的距离作为冲突的工具变量。研究表明，暴力冲突显著加剧了家庭粮食不安全状况，并增加了对不利粮食应对策略的依赖。进一步发现，冲突显著提高了家庭面临严重粮食不安全的风险。城市居住地、户主年龄、家庭就业状况、气温和降水量也与粮食不安全结果显著相关，凸显了社会经济、空间及环境因素在塑造家庭脆弱性中的重要性。研究结果在不同粮食不安全衡量指标及多种敏感性测试中均保持稳健。鉴于冲突对家庭粮食安全及应对行为的强烈负面影响，解决冲突驱动的脆弱性对于改善受影响地区的粮食安全至关重要。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722313.title: Violent conflicts and food insecurity coping strategies: evidence from Nigeria
10.1080/00036846.2026.2722313.title_zh: 暴力冲突与粮食不安全应对策略：来自尼日利亚的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2723556.title: Climate policy uncertainty, geopolitical risk, and oil volatility in global energy markets: reinforcement or substitution?
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723556.title_zh: 气候政策不确定性、地缘政治风险与全球能源市场中的石油波动：强化还是替代？

10.1080/00036846.2026.2723557.abstract: Green poverty reduction, which integrates green development and poverty reduction, has become a vital foundation for long-term regional development. Given China’s role as the world’s largest emitter and its ongoing transition, the carbon emissions trading policy has a significant impact on regional environmental improvement and economic development. However, its effects on green poverty reduction in China remain underexplored. This study calculates the green poverty reduction index and investigates the influence of the carbon emissions trading policy on green poverty reduction by applying the difference-in-differences model using provincial data of China from 2006 to 2022. The results demonstrate that: (1) the carbon emissions trading policy significantly promotes regional green poverty reduction; (2) the heterogeneity analysis shows that this positive effect varies across allocation of carbon emission quotas modes, geographical locations and the degree of carbon trading market effectiveness; (3) the mechanism analysis identifies that improving green innovation efficiency and reducing fiscal decentralization are two critical channels through which carbon emissions trading policy to affects green poverty reduction. These findings provide empirical evidence for optimizing carbon market mechanisms to promote green poverty reduction more effectively, and offering practical insights for improving policy design and regional sustainable development strategies. KEYWORDS: Carbon emissions trading policy green poverty reduction difference-in-differences model green innovation efficiency fiscal decentralization JEL CLASSIFICATION: O44 O13 R11 Q48
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723557.abstract_zh: 绿色减贫融合了绿色发展理念与减贫目标，已成为区域长期发展的重要基石。鉴于中国作为全球最大碳排放国的地位及其正在进行的转型，碳排放交易政策对区域环境改善和经济发展具有重要影响。然而，其对我国绿色减贫的影响尚未得到充分探讨。本研究计算了绿色减贫指数，并运用双重差分模型，基于2006年至2022年中国省级面板数据，考察了碳排放交易政策对绿色减贫的影响。研究结果表明：（1）碳排放交易政策显著促进了区域绿色减贫；（2）异质性分析显示，这一积极效应因碳排放配额分配方式、地理位置及碳交易市场有效程度的不同而存在差异；（3）机制分析表明，提升绿色创新效率和降低财政分权程度是碳排放交易政策影响绿色减贫的两条重要渠道。这些发现为优化碳市场机制以更有效地促进绿色减贫提供了经验证据，并为完善政策设计和区域可持续发展战略提供了实践启示。关键词：碳排放交易政策；绿色减贫；双重差分模型；绿色创新效率；财政分权 JEL分类：O44 O13 R11 Q48
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723557.title: How Does carbon emissions trading policy affect green poverty reduction? Evidence from China’s pilot quasi-natural experiment
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723557.title_zh: 碳排放权交易政策如何影响绿色减贫？来自中国试点准自然实验的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2723559.abstract: This article investigates the relationship between bank capitalization and credit risk in the West African Economic and Monetary Union (WAEMU) using a panel of 130 banks over 2018–2022, a period that coincides with the implementation of Basel II and Basel III prudential standards by the Central Bank of West African States (BCEAO). The empirical strategy combines fixed-effects estimations with Driscoll-Kraay standard errors, panel-corrected standard errors, cluster-robust fixed-effects models and instrumental-variable checks. Across specifications, better-capitalized banks tend to record lower loan-loss provisions. The analysis also reveals that the capitalization-risk relationship varies across innovation and institutional environments. Stronger innovation ecosystems reinforce the risk-reducing association between capitalization and credit risk, highlighting complementarity between capital buffers and ex ante screening and monitoring mechanisms. Institutional quality further conditions this nexus, with capitalization being more strongly associated with lower credit risk in environments characterized by stronger governance and regulatory enforcement. Overall, the findings support a context-sensitive prudential approach that combines adequate capitalization with improved institutional quality and innovative credit-risk management tools in WAEMU.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723559.abstract_zh: 本文利用2018至2022年间西非经济货币联盟（WAEMU）130家银行的面板数据，考察了银行资本充足率与信用风险之间的关系，该时期恰逢西非国家中央银行（BCEAO）实施《巴塞尔协议II》和《巴塞尔协议III》审慎监管标准。实证策略结合了固定效应估计与Driscoll-Kraay标准误、面板校正标准误、聚类稳健固定效应模型及工具变量检验。在各种设定下，资本充足率较高的银行往往录得较低的贷款损失准备金。分析还揭示，资本化与风险之间的关系因创新和制度环境的不同而有所差异。更强的创新生态系统强化了资本充足率与信用风险之间的风险降低关联，凸显了资本缓冲与事前筛选及监控机制之间的互补性。制度质量进一步调节了这一关系，在治理和监管执行力度更强的环境中，资本充足率与较低信用风险的关联更为显著。总体而言，研究结果支持一种情境敏感的审慎监管方法，该方法在WAEMU中将充足的资本化与改善的制度质量及创新的信用风险管理工具相结合。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723559.title: Bank capitalization and credit risk: the conditional role of innovation and institutional quality
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723559.title_zh: 银行资本化与信用风险：创新与制度质量的条件作用

10.1080/00036846.2026.2723560.abstract: Firm-level data sets suffer from panel attrition, and it can also be a problem with dynamic panel estimates. In this paper, we explore the question of whether the leverage estimates of a firm are meaningfully impacted by a predictable exit event, after adjusting for firm and time characteristics. We use a cross-fitted machine-learning model to estimate survival probabilities for an unbalanced panel of firms from 1999 to 2024, using lagged financial characteristics. Predictions show almost perfect separation between the groups of firms that survive and the group of firms that exit, suggesting little common support. We build stabilized inverse probability weights and re-estimate dynamic leverage models with firm and year fixed-effects. The weighted estimates suggest there is less leverage persistence and more speed of adjustment to the target leverage than conventional fixed-effects estimates, and the core qualitative relationships are largely unchanged. Therefore, the direction of estimated leverage dynamics is not really affected by predictable attrition, as it is the magnitude that is affected. The weighted estimates are only interpreted as sensitivity evidence due to limited overlap; there are no globally identified causal effects. KEYWORDS: Attrition bias corporate leverage machine learning panel data selection adjustment JEL CLASSIFICATION: C23 C55 G32 Acknowledgements We would like to express our sincere appreciation to Professor Mark Taylor, the Editor, for his guidance and constructive feedback throughout the review process. We are also grateful to the two anonymous reviewers for their careful evaluation and insightful and constructive comments, which have substantially improved the quality, clarity, and rigour of our manuscript.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723560.abstract_zh: 企业层面的数据集常面临面板 attrition（样本流失）问题，这一问题同样可能影响动态面板估计。本文探讨在调整企业与时间特征后，企业杠杆估计是否受到可预测退出事件的显著影响。我们采用交叉拟合机器学习模型，基于滞后财务特征，对1999年至2024年间非平衡面板企业样本的生存概率进行估计。预测结果显示，存活企业与退出企业群体之间几乎完全分离，表明共同支持域极为有限。我们构建了稳定化逆概率权重，并重新估计了包含企业与年份固定效应的动态杠杆模型。加权估计结果表明，相较于传统固定效应估计，杠杆持续性有所降低，而向目标杠杆调整的速度则加快，核心定性关系基本保持不变。因此，可预测 attrition 对估计的杠杆动态方向影响不大，主要影响的是其幅度。由于共同支持域有限，加权估计仅作为敏感性证据解读，不存在全局识别的因果效应。关键词：Attrition 偏差；企业杠杆；机器学习；面板数据；选择调整 JEL分类号：C23 C55 G32 致谢：我们衷心感谢编辑 Mark Taylor 教授在审稿过程中给予的指导与建设性反馈。同时，我们也感谢两位匿名审稿人的细致评估及深刻且富有建设性的意见，这些意见显著提升了我们稿件的质量、清晰度与严谨性。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723560.title: When attrition is predictable: machine learning and the estimation of corporate leverage dynamics
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723560.title_zh: 当损耗可预测时：机器学习与企业杠杆动态的估计

10.1080/00036846.2026.2723561.abstract: This study investigates how supervisor–subordinate communication in a fully remote work setting affects employee salaries. We use panel data from a company where all employees work entirely remotely and exploit the company’s routine supervisor rotations as a quasi-natural experiment (in a difference-in-differences-in-differences design) to identify causal effects. Our findings show that Slack-based text communication or Zoom video meetings with one’s supervisor have little overall impact on subordinates’ salaries. However, the impact varies by supervisor ability: having frequent meetings with a supervisor significantly boosts an employee’s salary only when that supervisor is among the top 25% in performance evaluations. In contrast, text-based communication volume shows no effect. Moreover, meeting length matters – the positive impact is largest when monthly meeting time ranges between 4 and 8 hours, yielding roughly a 9.1% higher monthly salary and 21.0% greater salary increase for those subordinates compared to meeting less than 4 hours per month.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723561.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在完全远程工作环境下，上下级沟通如何影响员工薪资。我们利用一家全员远程办公公司的面板数据，并借助公司常规性的主管轮换作为准自然实验（采用三重差分设计），以识别因果效应。研究发现，通过Slack文本沟通或Zoom视频会议与主管的交流，对下属薪资整体影响甚微。然而，影响因主管能力而异：只有当主管绩效评估位列前25%时，频繁与其会面才显著提升员工薪资。相比之下，文本沟通量则无此效应。此外，会议时长亦具关键作用——当月度会议时间介于4至8小时之间时，正面影响最为显著，与月度会议不足4小时的下属相比，这些下属的月薪约高出9.1%，薪资增幅则高出21.0%。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723561.title: Excellent boss affects subordinates’ evaluations : evidence from working full remotely
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723561.title_zh: 优秀上司影响下属评价：来自完全远程办公的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2723563.abstract: This study uses matched data from Taiwan’s 1979–2024 Manpower Utilization Survey to compare current, entry, and tenure-minimum unemployment rates. The wage-level estimates show a persistent negative association between the tenure-minimum unemployment rate and wages. However, this association becomes substantially smaller after first differencing and changes sign when contemporaneous unemployment changes are included jointly. By contrast, changes in current unemployment remain negatively and significantly associated with within-person wage changes. Therefore, wage-level associations may partially reflect persistent worker heterogeneity, sorting across jobs or firms, job selection, or firm-specific wage-setting practices. Within-person evidence is more compatible with short-term wage adjustments, although it does not definitively identify a pure spot-market mechanism. These findings suggest that wage levels and within-person wage changes capture different dimensions of wage determination, and the implicit-contract interpretation should be viewed as one possible explanation rather than as a uniquely identified mechanism. Exploratory period-specific estimates suggest that the wage-level association with tenure-minimum unemployment is stronger in earlier periods. However, the small post-COVID subsample does not permit inference regarding a structural break.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723563.abstract_zh: 本研究利用台湾1979年至2024年人力运用调查的匹配数据，比较了当前、入职及任期最低失业率。工资水平估计显示，任期最低失业率与工资之间存在持续的负相关关系。然而，在一阶差分后，这种关联显著减小，并在同时纳入当期失业率变化时符号发生逆转。相比之下，当前失业率的变化与个人内部工资变动之间仍保持显著负相关。因此，工资水平层面的关联可能部分反映了工人异质性的持续性、工作或企业间的分类选择、职位选择或企业特定的工资设定实践。个人内部证据更符合短期工资调整机制，尽管其并未明确识别出纯粹的现货市场机制。这些发现表明，工资水平与个人内部工资变动捕捉了工资决定的不同维度，隐含契约解释应被视为一种可能的解释，而非唯一确定的机制。探索性的分时期估计显示，工资水平与任期最低失业率的关联在早期阶段更为显著。然而，新冠疫情后的小样本子集不足以推断是否存在结构性断裂。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723563.title: Labour market conditions, implicit contracts, and wage determination: evidence from a matched panel dataset for Taiwan
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723563.title_zh: 劳动力市场状况、隐性契约与工资决定：基于台湾匹配面板数据的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2723564.abstract: Audit pricing remains a black box due to the opaque fee negotiations and the credence nature of audit services. Focusing on auditors’ elite educational backgrounds as a salient human capital signal, this study investigates the economic returns to educational prestige in China’s audit market. The results show that auditors with elite university degrees are associated with higher audit fees. The association attenuates substantially after controlling client fixed effects, indicating that part of the baseline premium reflects auditor-client matching. The association is amplified in less concentrated markets and among non-Big 4 firms. This premium is stronger in state-owned enterprises and intensifies following the 2013 special general partnership reform. This study extends signalling theory by delineating the organizational, market, and institutional boundaries that govern the human capital valuation in emerging audit market. KEYWORDS: Signing auditors elite education audit pricing audit firm JEL CLASSIFICATION: M40 M42
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723564.abstract_zh: 审计定价因费用谈判的不透明性及审计服务的信任品特性，始终是一个“黑箱”。本研究聚焦于签字审计师的名校教育背景作为显著的人力资本信号，探讨在中国审计市场中教育声望的经济回报。研究发现，拥有精英大学学位的审计师与更高的审计费用相关联。在控制客户固定效应后，这一关联显著减弱，表明基线溢价部分反映了审计师与客户之间的匹配效应。该关联在竞争程度较低的市场及非“四大”事务所中更为显著。此外，这一溢价在国有企业中表现更强，并在2013年特殊普通合伙制改革后有所加剧。本研究通过界定新兴审计市场中影响人力资本估值的组织、市场及制度边界，拓展了信号传递理论。关键词：签字审计师；精英教育；审计定价；审计事务所 JEL分类：M40；M42
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723564.title: Elite auditor and audit pricing
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723564.title_zh: 精英审计师与审计定价

10.1080/00036846.2026.2723566.abstract: Providing decent jobs, eradicating poverty and reducing inequality fall under the 17 Sustainable Development Goals of the United Nations. We investigate the impact of Directors’ and Officers’ liability insurance (D&O liability insurance) on internal wage disparity among Chinese listed firms from 2007 to 2022. Our findings reveal that D&O liability insurance is positively correlated with the wage disparity between executives and ordinary employees. This association remains significant after the robustness and endogeneity tests. Furthermore, executive quality, agency issues, subsidy-bolstered performance, reduced scrutiny, and constraint and compensation committees appear to be plausible underlying mechanisms. Finally, our results indicate that the positive association between D&O liability insurance and internal wage disparity is more pronounced in non-state-owned enterprises, firms facing higher market competition, and labour-intensive enterprises. This study sheds new light on the real effects of D&O liability insurance.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723566.abstract_zh: 提供体面工作、消除贫困和减少不平等属于联合国17项可持续发展目标之列。我们考察了2007年至2022年间中国上市公司董事及高级职员责任保险（D&O责任保险）对内部薪酬差距的影响。研究发现，D&O责任保险与高管与普通员工之间的薪酬差距呈正相关。在稳健性和内生性检验后，这一关联依然显著。此外，高管素质、代理问题、补贴支撑的业绩、监督减弱以及约束与薪酬委员会似乎是合理的潜在作用机制。最后，我们的结果表明，D&O责任保险与内部薪酬差距之间的正相关关系在非国有企业、面临更高市场竞争的企业以及劳动密集型企业中更为显著。本研究为D&O责任保险的实际效应提供了新的见解。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723566.title: Does directors’ & officers’ liability insurance impact on internal wage disparity?
10.1080/00036846.2026.2723566.title_zh: 董事及高级职员责任保险是否影响内部薪酬差距？

10.1080/00036846.2026.2724149.abstract: The low efficiency and high costs of logistics depress the return on real-sector investment, leading many firms to reallocate capital towards financial assets. Using the national logistics service standardization (LSS) pilot as a quasi-natural experiment, we find that the LSS pilot significantly inhibits corporate excessive financialization. Mechanism analysis indicates that LSS pilot mitigates corporate excessive financialization by reducing internal management costs and external transaction costs, as well as enhancing production and sales efficiency. Cross-sectional tests further reveal that this effect is more pronounced for firms with higher levels of corporate digitalization, as well as for those located in regions with well-established transportation infrastructure, and greater marketization level. Overall, we highlight the positive impact of LSS pilot and provide a potential solution for promoting the development of the real economy. KEYWORDS: Logistics service standardization corporate excessive financialization development of the real economy cost reduction efficiency improvement JEL CLASSIFICATION: D21 G31 M29
10.1080/00036846.2026.2724149.abstract_zh: 物流的低效率和高成本压低了实体部门投资的回报率，导致许多企业将资本重新配置到金融资产上。以全国物流服务标准化试点作为准自然实验，我们发现该试点显著抑制了企业的过度金融化。机制分析表明，物流服务标准化试点通过降低内部管理成本和外部交易成本，以及提升生产和销售效率，缓解了企业的过度金融化。横截面测试进一步揭示，这一效应在企业数字化水平较高、所在地区交通基础设施完善以及市场化程度较高的企业中更为显著。总体而言，我们强调了物流服务标准化试点的积极影响，并为促进实体经济发展提供了潜在解决方案。关键词：物流服务标准化；企业过度金融化；实体经济发展；成本降低；效率提升 JEL分类：D21 G31 M29
10.1080/00036846.2026.2724149.title: Does logistics service standardization matter for corporate excessive financialization? Evidence from a natural experiment in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2724149.title_zh: 物流服务标准化是否影响企业过度金融化？来自中国自然实验的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2724150.title: The dividend of social Insurance: how long-term care insurance reshapes household asset allocation
10.1080/00036846.2026.2724150.title_zh: 社会保险的红利：长期护理保险如何重塑家庭资产配置

10.1080/00036846.2026.2724151.abstract: The study examines the structural dynamics between AI dependence and anchoring bias on mobile recharge platforms in India. It integrates a layered behavioural economic theoretical framework. It examines how AI dependence amidst a complex choice environment, perceived cognitive load, easy digital access and higher search costs influence anchoring bias in the choice of mobile recharge plans. Data is collected from the four telecom categories in India among 301 consumers who purchase prepaid mobile recharge plans via digital platforms. The PLS-SEM analysis finds that the complexity of choice and resultant higher search costs are the primary drivers of AI dependence. It implies that AI recommendation systems, which are aimed to reduce search effort, rather limit consumers’ independent evaluation of plans by creating anchoring bias. Further, the study employs complementary robustness checks using Gaussian Copula for instrument-free endogeneity correction, a quadratic effect for testing non-linearity and FIMIX PLS to confirm the absence of unobserved heterogeneity. The results reveal a significant inverted U-shaped relationship between AI dependence and anchoring bias, indicating a cognitive saturation point at which the bias plateaus at extreme levels of AI dependence. The study calls for policy interventions like targeted nudges for consumers and appropriate AI inclusive competition policies.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2724151.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了印度移动充值平台上AI依赖与锚定偏差之间的结构性动态关系，并整合了一个分层行为经济学理论框架。研究考察了在复杂选择环境中，AI依赖如何通过感知认知负荷、便捷的数字访问和更高的搜索成本影响消费者在移动充值套餐选择中的锚定偏差。数据收集自印度四大电信类别中301名通过数字平台购买预付费移动充值套餐的消费者。PLS-SEM分析发现，选择复杂性及其导致的更高搜索成本是AI依赖的主要驱动因素。这意味着，旨在减少搜索努力的AI推荐系统，反而通过制造锚定偏差限制了消费者对套餐的独立评估。此外，研究采用互补稳健性检验，包括使用高斯Copula进行无工具变量的内生性校正、二次效应检验非线性以及FIMIX PLS确认不存在未观测异质性。结果显示，AI依赖与锚定偏差之间存在显著的倒U型关系，表明在AI依赖达到极端水平时，存在一个认知饱和点，偏差在此趋于平稳。研究呼吁采取政策干预措施，如针对消费者的定向助推以及适当的AI包容性竞争政策。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2724151.title: AI-driven anchoring bias in mobile recharge platforms: a PLS-SEM analysis
10.1080/00036846.2026.2724151.title_zh: 移动充值平台中AI驱动的锚定效应：基于PLS-SEM的分析

10.1080/00036846.2026.2725151.abstract: Green finance is an important policy tool for advancing green development in China, while new green-firm entry is an integral part of this transition. Using data from 278 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2015 to 2023, this study measures the level of green finance development and examines its relationship with green entrepreneurial entry intensity. The empirical results show that green finance is significantly associated with higher green entrepreneurial entry intensity, and this finding remains robust across a series of robustness checks. The mechanism analysis suggests that green technological innovation and the external financing environment are two important channels linking green finance to green entrepreneurial entry. The heterogeneity analysis shows that this positive relationship is stronger in old industrial-base cities and in cities with stronger science and education endowments. The positive relationship also remains robust after accounting for spatial dependence across cities. This study provides empirical evidence on the role of green finance in new green-firm entry and offers useful implications for local governments seeking to develop more targeted green finance and entrepreneurship policies. KEYWORDS: Green finance green entrepreneurial entry intensity green technological innovation industrial legacy science and education endowments JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 Q56 L26
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725151.abstract_zh: 绿色金融是推动中国绿色发展的重要政策工具，而新绿色企业的进入则是这一转型过程中不可或缺的组成部分。本研究利用2015年至2023年中国278个地级市的数据，测度了绿色金融发展水平，并考察了其与绿色创业进入强度之间的关系。实证结果表明，绿色金融与更高的绿色创业进入强度显著相关，且这一发现在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析表明，绿色技术创新和外部融资环境是连接绿色金融与绿色创业进入的两个重要渠道。异质性分析显示，这一正向关系在旧工业基地城市以及科教资源较为丰富的城市中更为显著。在考虑城市间空间依赖性后，这一正向关系依然稳健。本研究为绿色金融在促进新绿色企业进入方面的作用提供了经验证据，并为地方政府制定更具针对性的绿色金融与创业政策提供了有益启示。关键词：绿色金融；绿色创业进入强度；绿色技术创新；工业遗产；科教资源；JEL分类：G21 Q56 L26
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725151.title: Green finance and green entrepreneurial entry intensity in China: the role of industrial legacy and science and education endowments
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725151.title_zh: 中国绿色金融与绿色创业进入强度：产业遗产与科教禀赋的作用

10.1080/00036846.2026.2725152.abstract: Enterprise digital transformation has become an imperative strategic pathway for enhancing corporate competitiveness in the digital era. Yet, empirical evidence on how industrial cluster policies facilitate such transformation remains scarce. This study leverages China’s innovative industrial clusters pilot policy as a quasi-natural experiment and employs a multi-period DID design using data on Chinese listed firms. We find robust evidence that innovative cluster policy significantly accelerates enterprise digital transformation. The underlying mechanisms operate through three complementary channels: knowledge spillovers, agglomeration of digital-enabling factors, and inter-firm competitive pressure. Heterogeneity analyses further reveal that the policy effect is significantly stronger for small-scale enterprises, high-tech firms, non-state-owned enterprises, and firms located in China’s eastern region. Moreover, fintech development not only directly fosters enterprise digital transformation but also amplifies the effectiveness of the innovative cluster policy, acting as a catalytic enabler. These findings offer actionable insights for policymakers seeking to design place-based, synergistic interventions that accelerate broad-based digital upgrading.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725152.abstract_zh: 企业数字化转型已成为数字时代提升企业竞争力的战略必由之路。然而，关于产业集聚政策如何促进企业数字化转型的经验证据仍较为匮乏。本研究以中国创新型产业集群试点政策作为准自然实验，利用中国上市公司数据，采用多期双重差分设计。研究发现，创新型产业集群政策显著加速了企业数字化转型，该结论具有稳健性。其作用机制通过三条互补渠道实现：知识溢出、数字赋能要素集聚以及企业间竞争压力。异质性分析进一步表明，该政策效应在小型企业、高技术企业、非国有企业以及位于中国东部地区的企业中更为显著。此外，金融科技发展不仅直接促进企业数字化转型，还通过发挥催化赋能作用，增强了创新型产业集群政策的实施效果。上述发现为政策制定者设计基于区位、协同联动且能加速广泛数字化升级的干预措施提供了可操作的政策启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725152.title: Innovative industrial cluster policies and enterprise digital transformation: does FinTech matter
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725152.title_zh: 创新性产业集群政策与企业数字化转型：金融科技是否重要？

10.1080/00036846.2026.2725153.abstract: This study examines exit from active professional boat racing as a form of exit from performance-based self-employment. Boat racers operate in an individual prize-based labour market in which income opportunities, reputation, and career continuity depend on current performance and periodic institutional evaluation. Drawing on lifecycle models of self-employment and retirement, this study estimates pooled probit models using racer-period panel data from Japan’s professional boat racing industry. Next-period exit is modelled as a function of current performance, accumulated career success, individual characteristics, racing class, and period effects. Current performance is measured by the first-place finish rate in individual races, while accumulated career success is measured by cumulative victories in multi-day race series. The results show that current performance is negatively associated with exit probability, but this exit-deterring association becomes smaller and statistically insignificant among racers with greater accumulated career success. The findings suggest that exit from performance-contingent work depends not only on weaker current performance, but also on how current returns are evaluated relative to accumulated career capital. KEYWORDS: Self-employment exit athlete retirement performance-based self-employment professional labour markets occupational exit JEL CLASSIFICATION: J24 J26 J44 L83 Acknowledgements The author is grateful to the editor and the anonymous referees for their constructive comments.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725153.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了退出职业赛艇竞技作为一种退出基于绩效的自雇就业形式的现象。赛艇选手在个人奖金制的劳动力市场中运作，其收入机会、声誉及职业连续性取决于当前表现及定期的机构评估。借鉴自雇与退休的生命周期模型，本研究利用日本职业赛艇行业的选手-时期面板数据，估计了合并概率模型。下一期的退出行为被建模为当前表现、累积职业成就、个人特征、赛艇级别及时期效应的函数。当前表现以个人赛事中的第一名完成率衡量，而累积职业成就则以多日系列赛事中的累计胜利次数衡量。结果显示，当前表现与退出概率呈负相关，但这种退出抑制效应在累积职业成就较高的选手中减弱且统计上不显著。研究结果表明，从绩效依赖型工作中退出不仅取决于当前表现的减弱，还取决于当前回报相对于累积职业资本的评估方式。关键词：自雇退出 运动员退休 基于绩效的自雇 专业劳动力市场 职业退出 JEL分类：J24 J26 J44 L83 致谢 作者感谢编辑及匿名审稿人的建设性意见。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725153.title: Exit from performance-based self-employment: evidence from professional boat racers
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725153.title_zh: 退出绩效型自雇：来自职业赛艇选手的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2725155.abstract: Based on a sample of 4,396 Chinese A-share listed companies from 2009 to 2024, this study explores the impact of digital washing as a selective disclosure strategy on corporate total factor productivity (TFP). The empirical findings are as follows. First, digital washing significantly improves corporate TFP. Second, mechanism tests reveal that digital washing promotes TFP by facilitating cooperative innovation, enhancing independent innovation capabilities and alleviating financing constraints. Third, dynamic effect analysis confirms a significant time-lag characteristic in the productivity-enhancing impact of digital washing. Fourth, the marginal effect of digital washing on total factor productivity follows an inverted U-shaped trend, which first increases and then decreases with the rise in digital washing intensity. For the vast majority of firms engaged in digital washing behaviours, their digital washing intensity falls within the reasonable range before the turning point. Market competition strengthens the promotional effect of digital washing on TFP, and only firms with a low level of actual digital transformation can effectively improve TFP through digital washing. The above findings indicate that digital washing is not merely a purely opportunistic behaviour. Firms should view it rationally, formulating differentiated disclosure strategies based on their resource endowments rather than blindly endorsing or avoiding it.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725155.abstract_zh: 基于2009至2024年间4396家中国A股上市公司的样本，本研究探讨了选择性披露策略——数字漂洗——对企业全要素生产率的影响。实证结果显示：第一，数字漂洗显著提升了企业全要素生产率。第二，机制检验表明，数字漂洗通过促进合作创新、增强自主创新能力及缓解融资约束来推动全要素生产率的增长。第三，动态效应分析确认了数字漂洗对生产率提升作用存在显著的时滞特征。第四，数字漂洗对全要素生产率的边际效应呈倒U型趋势，即随着数字漂洗强度的增加，其效应先升后降。对于绝大多数实施数字漂洗行为的企业而言，其漂洗强度处于拐点之前的合理区间内。市场竞争强化了数字漂洗对全要素生产率的促进作用，且仅实际数字化转型程度较低的企业能通过数字漂洗有效提升全要素生产率。上述发现表明，数字漂洗并非纯粹的机会主义行为。企业应理性看待，依据自身资源禀赋制定差异化的披露策略，而非盲目推崇或回避。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725155.title: Digital washing and corporate total factor productivity
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725155.title_zh: 数字化洗白与企业全要素生产率

10.1080/00036846.2026.2725879.abstract: In China, urban agglomeration planning has become an important institutional arrangement for promoting coordinated regional development and enhancing urban innovation capabilities. This study utilizes panel data from Chinese prefecture-level cities spanning 2003 to 2018, constructs a quasi-natural experimental framework based on batch-issued national urban agglomeration planning policies, and employs a Difference-in-Differences(DID) model to empirically identify the causal effects and mechanisms through which urban agglomeration planning influences urban innovation output. The results show that: First, urban agglomeration planning significantly increases the number of granted invention patents in cities included in the planning, and this promoting effect is persistent and dynamically enhanced. Second, urban agglomeration planning mainly enhances urban innovation capabilities through facilitating the agglomeration of high skilled talent, optimizing the specialization among cities, and strengthening the agglomeration effect of venture capital. Third, heterogeneity analysis indicates that non-core cities benefit more significantly from industrial absorption and manufacturing function transfer compared to core cities. This paper further controls for other institutional shocks such as the national innovative city pilot policy and conducts robustness tests using event study methodology, placebo tests, and changes in the control group; the conclusions remain stable. KEYWORDS: National planning urban agglomeration innovation specialization JEL CLASSIFICATION: O21 O31 O38
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725879.abstract_zh: 在中国，城市群规划已成为促进区域协调发展、提升城市创新能力的重要制度安排。本研究利用2003年至2018年中国地级市面板数据，基于分批发布的国家级城市群规划政策构建准自然实验框架，采用双重差分（DID）模型实证识别城市群规划影响城市创新产出的因果效应及其作用机制。研究结果显示：第一，城市群规划显著增加了被纳入规划城市的发明专利授权数量，且这一促进效应具有持续性和动态增强特征。第二，城市群规划主要通过促进高技能人才集聚、优化城市间专业化分工以及强化风险投资集聚效应等途径提升城市创新能力。第三，异质性分析表明，非核心城市相较于核心城市在产业承接和制造业功能转移中获益更为显著。本文进一步控制了国家创新型城市试点政策等其他制度冲击，并采用事件研究法、安慰剂检验及更换对照组等方式进行稳健性检验，结论依然稳健。关键词：国家级规划 城市群 创新 专业化 JEL分类号：O21 O31 O38
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725879.title: Planning for prosperity: how urban agglomerations influence city innovation in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2725879.title_zh: 规划繁荣：城市群如何影响中国城市创新

10.1080/00036846.2026.2726525.abstract: This study examines the dynamics of return spillovers in the Lumber, Grain and Soft commodity markets, by adopting the DY 2012 Spillover Framework on the daily frequency data from January 2010 to December 2023. The findings confirm the interconnectedness and spillover effects among various agricultural commodities, quantified by a spillover index value of 20.90%, indicating a notable degree of market interconnectedness. The net spillover analysis shows that Corn Futures emerge as major return spillover transmitters, however, while Oats and Coffee Futures are identified as the primary recipients. Furthermore, the GJR-GARCH model result revealed that Lumber Futures exhibit the highest level of volatility persistence, followed by Sugar Futures, highlighting the presence of asymmetric volatility behaviours. However, Oats and coffee show a negative leverage effect in the market. The DCC-GJR-GARCH model further reveals time-varying correlations among commodity pairs, with persistently high co-movement observed across the sample period. Our research findings contribute to the in-depth understanding of the complex dynamics of the agricultural commodity market and provide significant insights to financial investors and policymakers. KEYWORDS: Commodity market return spillover volatility GJR-GARCH DCC-GJR-GARCH JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q14 Q50
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726525.abstract_zh: 本研究采用DY 2012溢出框架，基于2010年1月至2023年12月的日度频率数据，考察了木材、谷物及软性大宗商品市场的收益溢出动态。研究结果证实了各类农产品之间的相互关联性及溢出效应，通过溢出指数值20.90%予以量化，表明市场具有显著的互联程度。净溢出分析显示，玉米期货成为主要的收益溢出传递者，而燕麦和咖啡期货则被识别为主要接收者。此外，GJR-GARCH模型结果表明，木材期货表现出最高水平的波动持续性，其次为糖期货，凸显了非对称波动行为的存在。然而，燕麦和咖啡在市场呈现负杠杆效应。DCC-GJR-GARCH模型进一步揭示了商品对之间时变的相关性，在整个样本期内观察到持续较高的协同运动。本研究结果有助于深入理解农产品市场的复杂动态，并为金融投资者和政策制定者提供重要见解。关键词：商品市场 收益溢出 波动性 GJR-GARCH DCC-GJR-GARCH JEL分类：Q14 Q50
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726525.title: Spillover effects and volatility persistence in agricultural commodities: an empirical study of Lumber, Grain and Soft markets
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726525.title_zh: 农产品溢出效应与波动持续性：木材、谷物及软性商品市场的实证研究

10.1080/00036846.2026.2726529.abstract: This study investigates the proficiency of three leading GPTs, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Gemini, in answering final-exam questions for an undergraduate course in Financial Markets and Intermediaries, a specialized finance education context characterized by heterogeneous cognitive and assessment demands. Drawing on Bloom’s revised taxonomy and Cognitive Load Theory (CLT), this study examines whether GPT performance varies across assessment formats requiring different levels of cognitive processing and reasoning. The results revealed significant divergences: Gemini achieved the highest scores, demonstrating strong comprehension and reasoning skills, whereas ChatGPT showed moderate proficiency and DeepSeek underperformed. All models performed better on multiple-choice questions than on open-ended questions, suggesting that GPTs currently perform more effectively in tasks associated with lower-order cognitive processes. Computational questions posed the greatest challenges across all models, supporting theoretical expectations from CLT. The findings contribute to literature on generative AI in higher education showing that GPT proficiency is not uniform across cognitive assessment levels and by proposing a framework linking AI performance to educational assessment theories. Highly proficient GPTs can serve as valuable supplementary tools for students and educators; however, limitations in complex reasoning, computational accuracy, and regulatory interpretation require critical use. Findings should be interpreted with caution given the single-course single-institution setting.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726529.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了三种主流GPT模型——ChatGPT、DeepSeek与Gemini——在回答金融学本科课程《金融市场与中介》期末考试题目时的表现水平。该课程属于专业金融教育情境，其特点在于评估要求具有异质性的认知层次与考核类型。基于布鲁姆修订分类学与认知负荷理论（CLT），本研究考察了GPT在不同认知加工与推理要求下的评估形式中是否表现出性能差异。结果显示存在显著分化：Gemini得分最高，展现出较强的理解与推理能力；ChatGPT表现中等；DeepSeek则相对逊色。所有模型在选择题上的表现均优于开放式题目，表明当前GPT在涉及低阶认知过程的任务中表现更为有效。计算类题目对所有模型构成最大挑战，这与认知负荷理论的理论预期相符。本研究为高等教育中生成式人工智能的相关文献作出贡献，揭示了GPT能力在不同认知评估层次上并非均匀分布，并提出一个将人工智能表现与教育评估理论相联系的框架。高水平的GPT可作为学生与教师的有益辅助工具；然而，其在复杂推理、计算准确性及监管解释方面的局限性要求批判性使用。鉴于本研究基于单一课程、单一院校的设定，对研究结果的解读应保持审慎。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726529.title: AI in the classroom: assessing GPTs’ capability in undergraduate finance tests
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726529.title_zh: 人工智能走进课堂：评估GPT模型在本科金融测试中的能力

10.1080/00036846.2026.2726530.abstract: Stock price delay serves as a key metric of information efficiency in stock markets, and identifying its determinants is essential for promoting market information efficiency. This study examines the effect of open public data (OPD) on stock price delay. Using the staggered adoption of city-level OPD portals in China as a quasi-natural experiment, our difference-in-differences analysis finds that OPD significantly reduces stock price delay, with an economic magnitude representing approximately 7.9% of its standard deviation. Cross-sectional analyses demonstrate that this effect is more pronounced when (1) public data on OPD portals are of higher quality, (2) public data are more relevant to firm operations, (3) public data are less substitutable, (4) investors have greater information processing capacity, and (5) firms’ information disclosure quality is lower. Additional tests show that OPD implementation is associated with improved liquidity, reduced return volatility, and diminished information content of earnings announcements. This study makes a valuable contribution to the literature on the determinants of stock price delay and the economic consequences of OPD, while offering insights for policymakers seeking to enhance market information efficiency and assess the effectiveness of OPD initiatives. 1 Under the Chinese institutional setting, a firm’s registered city generally coincides with the location of its headquarters rather than merely serving as a legal place of incorporation. According to the Company Law of the People’s Republic of China and the Regulations on the Administration of Market Entities Registration , a company’s registered domicile must correspond to the location of its principal administrative office, and firms relocating their principal office are required to update their registration accordingly (Chen, Hung, and Wang Citation 2018). Consequently, firms’ registered cities generally represent the locations of their headquarters. Because local governments in China play an active role in firms’ operations and are responsible for taxation, administrative approvals, industrial policy implementation, regulatory oversight, and other aspects of the local business environment (Xu Citation 2011), firms’ registered cities also represent the local institutional and information environments surrounding their headquarters. 3 GF Securities has developed an enterprise financial intelligent early-warning platform based on large-scale pre-trained models, which leverages public data and artificial intelligence to identify corporate financial risks at earlier stages and with greater accuracy. Similarly, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange’s blockchain-based industry risk data sharing project enhances the secure sharing of risk information across market participants, enabling investors to better assess industry-level risks. The Shanghai Equity Exchange has introduced a blockchain-based equity registration, custody, and transfer service platform that integrates multi-source data and provides more objective valuation benchmarks for investors in equity markets. (Citation 2018) decomposition model. $\mathit{GDPGrowth} = \mathit{\alpha} + \beta {1} \Delta \mathit{Electricity} + \beta {2} \Delta \mathit{Freight} + \beta {3} \Delta \mathit{Loan} + \mathit{\epsilon}$. where GDPGrowth denotes the annual growth of GDP. ∆Electricity , ∆Freight , and ∆Loan represent the year-on-year changes in electricity consumption, road freight volume, and financial institution loans, respectively, each scaled by GDP in the previous year. The buy and sell volumes are estimated as. $V {\tau}^{B} = \sum {\mathit{i} = \mathit{t} \left(\mathit{\tau} - 1\right) + 1}^{\mathit{t} \left(\right. \mathit{\tau} \left.\right)} V {i} \times \mathit{Z} \left(\frac{P {i} - P {\mathit{i} - 1}}{\sigma {ΔP}}\right)$. $V {\tau}^{S} = \sum {\mathit{i} = \mathit{t} \left(\mathit{\tau} - 1\right) + 1}^{\mathit{t} \left(\right. \mathit{\tau} \left.\right)} V {i} \times \mathit{Z} \left[1 - \mathit{Z} \left(\frac{P {i} - P {\mathit{i} - 1}}{\sigma {\Delta \mathit{P}}}\right)\right] = \mathit{V} - V {\tau}^{B}$. Where t ( τ )denotes the last one-minute interval contained in bucket τ ; V i is the trading volume during minute i ; P i is the transaction price at minute i ; σ Δ P is the standard deviation of one-minute price changes; and Z (⋅) denotes the cumulative distribution function of the standard normal distribution; n denotes the number of equal-volume buckets, we choose n = 50; and V denotes the volume contained in each bucket. 10.1080/00036846.2026.2726530.abstract_zh: 股票价格延迟是衡量股票市场信息效率的关键指标，识别其决定因素对于促进市场信息效率至关重要。本研究考察了开放公共数据（OPD）对股票价格延迟的影响。利用中国城市级OPD门户网站的分阶段采纳作为准自然实验，我们的双重差分分析发现，OPD显著降低了股票价格延迟，其经济幅度约占其标准差7.9%。横截面分析表明，当（1）OPD门户网站上的公共数据质量更高，（2）公共数据与企业运营更相关，（3）公共数据的可替代性较低，（4）投资者的信息处理能力更强，以及（5）企业的信息披露质量较低时，这一效应更为显著。附加测试显示，OPD的实施与流动性改善、回报波动性降低以及盈余公告信息含量减少相关联。本研究为股票价格延迟决定因素及OPD经济后果的文献做出了有价值的贡献，同时为旨在提升市场信息效率和评估OPD举措有效性的政策制定者提供了见解。¹ 在中国制度背景下，企业的注册城市通常与其总部所在地一致，而非仅仅作为法定注册地。根据《中华人民共和国公司法》和《市场主体登记管理条例》，公司的注册住所必须与其主要办事机构所在地相符，企业迁移主要办事机构时需相应更新注册信息（Chen, Hung, and Wang Citation 2018）。因此，企业的注册城市通常代表其总部所在地。由于中国地方政府在企业运营中发挥积极作用，并负责税收、行政审批、产业政策实施、监管监督以及地方商业环境其他方面的事务（Xu Citation 2011），企业的注册城市也代表了其总部周边的本地制度和信息环境。³ 广发证券基于大规模预训练模型开发了企业财务智能预警平台，该平台利用公共数据和人工智能，以更早阶段和更高准确性识别企业财务风险。类似地，深圳证券交易所基于区块链的行业风险数据共享项目增强了市场参与者之间风险信息的安全共享，使投资者能够更好地评估行业层面风险。上海股权交易所推出了基于区块链的股权登记、托管和转让服务平台，该平台整合多源数据，为股权市场投资者提供更客观的估值基准。更多详情，请参见 https://www.csrc.gov.cn/shanxi/c106408/c7568249/content.shtml、https://jrj.sh.gov.cn/SC212/20241023/7f10aa43b0424212b06e0385adaece26.html 和 https://finance.stockstar.com/IG2024102200029365.shtml。⁴ 在本研究中，由于样本仅限于中国A股市场，企业-日观测值等同于证券-日观测值。方程Eq. (1) (1) $\mathit{Re} t {\mathit{i} , \mathit{d}} \textrm{ } = \textrm{ }\textrm{ } a {i} \textrm{ } + \textrm{ }\textrm{ } b {i} \mathit{R} M {d} \textrm{ } + \textrm{ } \sum {\mathit{n} \textrm{ } = \textrm{ }\textrm{ } 1}^{5} c {\mathit{i} , n} \mathit{R} M {\mathit{d} - \mathit{n}} \textrm{ } + \textrm{ }\textrm{ } \epsilon {\mathit{i} , \mathit{d}} ,$(1) 中使用的个股回报和市场回报均仅基于A股证券。尽管部分企业也在H股或B股市场上市，但这些上市并未纳入我们的分析。⁵ 我们将GDPManage计算为Lyu等人（Citation 2018）分解模型残差的负绝对值。$\mathit{GDPGrowth} = \mathit{\alpha} + \beta {1} \Delta \mathit{Electricity} + \beta {2} \Delta \mathit{Freight} + \beta {3} \Delta \mathit{Loan} + \mathit{\epsilon}$。其中GDPGrowth表示GDP的年增长率。∆Electricity、∆Freight和∆Loan分别表示电力消费、公路货运量和金融机构贷款的同比变化，各自按上一年GDP进行缩放。因此，GDPManage计算为–| ε |。GDPManage值越大，表明GDP管理水平越低，对应更高的公共数据质量。⁶ 我们还根据外国销售额占总销售额的比例对企业进行分组。未列表结果显示，OPD对股票价格延迟的影响在外销比例较低的企业中显著更强，这与基于Distribution的结果相似。⁷ 遵循Easley、López de Prado和O’Hara（Citation 2012）的方法，我们首先使用以下方程构建每日VPIN指标。$\mathit{VPIN} = \frac{\sum {\tau = 1}^{n} \left|V {\tau}^{B} - V {\tau}^{S}\right|}{\mathit{nV}}$。买入和卖出量估计为。$V {\tau}^{B} = \sum {\mathit{i} = \mathit{t} \left(\mathit{\tau} - 1\right) + 1}^{\mathit{t} \left(\right. \mathit{\tau} \left.\right)} V {i} \times \mathit{Z} \left(\frac{P {i} - P {\mathit{i} - 1}}{\sigma {ΔP}}\right)$。$V {\tau}^{S} = \sum {\mathit{i} = \mathit{t} \left(\mathit{\tau} - 1\right) + 1}^{\mathit{t} \left(\right. \mathit{\tau} \left.\right)} V {i} \times \mathit{Z} \left[1 - \mathit{Z} \left(\frac{P {i} - P {\mathit{i} - 1}}{\sigma {\Delta \mathit{P}}}\right)\right] = \mathit{V} - V {\tau}^{B}$。其中t ( τ )表示桶τ中包含的最后一个一分钟区间；V i 是第i分钟的交易量；P i 是第i分钟的交易价格；σ Δ P 是一分钟价格变化的标准差；Z (⋅)表示标准正态分布的累积分布函数；n表示等量桶的数量，我们选择n = 50；V表示每个桶中包含的量。最后，我们将企业年度VPIN计算为每个财政年度内所有每日VPIN值的平均值。⁸ Amihud（Citation 2002）非流动性比率计算为每日绝对回报率（以百分比计）与每日交易量（以亿元人民币计）之比的年度平均值。尽管买卖价差是股票流动性的常用代理指标，但我们未使用该指标，因为中国股票市场中大多数买卖价差等于1分钱（Xu, Xuan, and Zheng Citation 2021）。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726530.title: Open public data and stock price delay: evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726530.title_zh: 开放公共数据与股价延迟：来自中国准自然实验的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2726531.abstract: Previous studies on inflation expectations suggest that agents often overreact to public signals, motivating extensions of standard macroeconomic models beyond full-information rational expectations and pointing to a role for behavioural explanations. Using Japanese survey data from 2008 to 2024 that include a variety of questions related to behavioural economics, we examine how individuals’ behavioural attributes are associated with responses to public signals. Allowing for a shift in mean forecast errors during Japan’s high-inflation period, we find evidence broadly consistent with overreaction in inflation expectations. However, this overreaction is not fully explained by the behavioural attributes examined in this paper. Our findings suggest that overreaction is not concentrated among individuals classified as behaviourally biased on the basis of the four self-reported attributes in our data: differences in the response to public signals across these attributes are not large enough to make expectations consistent with full-information rational expectations. KEYWORDS: Inflation forecasts over-extrapolation behavioural agents behavioural bias JEL CLASSIFICATION: D84 D91 E31 E70 Acknowledgements We thank M. Eguchi for helpful comments and E. Kurimune for excellent research assistance. The authors used a generative AI tool, ChatGPT (OpenAI, 5.4), to improve English expression. The authors reviewed and revised the output as necessary and take full responsibility for the final manuscript.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726531.abstract_zh: 以往关于通胀预期的研究表明，经济主体往往对公共信号反应过度，这促使标准宏观经济模型在完全信息理性预期之外进行扩展，并指出了行为解释的作用。利用2008年至2024年间包含多种行为经济学相关问题的日本调查数据，我们考察了个体的行为属性如何与对公共信号的反应相关联。在考虑日本高通胀期间平均预测误差的变动后，我们发现了与通胀预期过度反应大致相符的证据。然而，这种过度反应并未被本文所考察的行为属性完全解释。我们的研究结果表明，过度反应并非集中于那些基于我们数据中四项自我报告属性而被归类为具有行为偏差的个体：这些属性之间对公共信号反应的差异不足以使预期与完全信息理性预期保持一致。关键词：通胀预测 过度外推 行为主体 行为偏差 JEL分类：D84 D91 E31 E70 致谢：我们感谢M. Eguchi的有益评论和E. Kurimune出色的研究协助。作者使用生成式AI工具ChatGPT（OpenAI，5.4）来改进英文表达。作者对输出内容进行了必要的审查和修改，并对最终稿件承担全部责任。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726531.title: Overreaction in inflation expectations: do behavioural attributes of individuals matter?
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726531.title_zh: 通胀预期中的过度反应：个体行为特征是否重要？

10.1080/00036846.2026.2726532.abstract: Inter-regional investment plays a critical role in enabling capital flows and fostering coordinated regional development. Drawing on the micro-level behaviour of establishing inter-regional subsidiaries, this study examines the impact of enterprise digital transformation on inter-regional investment using data on Chinese A-share listed companies from 2011 to 2023. Results show that enterprise digital transformation significantly facilitates inter-regional investment. The primary mechanisms involve increasing the level of specialized division of labour, enhancing information transparency, and improving operational performance. The facilitative impact is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises, industries with high competition, and regions with well-developed factor markets. Further analysis reveals an inverted U-shaped distance pattern in this effect. Digital transformation encourages investment towards peripheral and border cities, although core and non-border destinations benefit more. Moreover, inter-regional expansion under digital transformation contributes to a smaller inter-city economic development gap. Through micro-level empirical evidence, this study highlights the digital dividends of enterprise digital transformation across regional boundaries, offering strategic insights for enterprises navigating digital transformation and optimizing investment decisions, while informing government efforts to promote coordinated and sustainable development. KEYWORDS: Digital transformation inter-regional investment specialized division of labor information transparency operational performance JEL CLASSIFICATION: O33 G34 R11
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726532.abstract_zh: 跨区域投资在促进资本流动和推动区域协调发展方面发挥着关键作用。本研究基于设立跨区域子公司的微观行为视角，利用2011年至2023年中国A股上市公司的数据，考察了企业数字化转型对跨区域投资的影响。结果表明，企业数字化转型显著促进了跨区域投资。其主要机制在于提升专业化分工水平、增强信息透明度以及改善经营绩效。这一促进作用在非国有企业、竞争激烈的行业以及要素市场发达的地区中更为显著。进一步分析显示，该效应呈现倒U型的距离模式。数字化转型推动投资向边缘城市和边境城市延伸，但核心城市和非边境目的地受益更多。此外，数字化转型下的跨区域扩张有助于缩小城市间的经济发展差距。本研究通过微观层面的实证证据，揭示了企业数字化转型跨越区域边界的数字红利，为企业推进数字化转型和优化投资决策提供了战略参考，同时为政府促进协调可持续发展提供了政策启示。关键词：数字化转型；跨区域投资；专业化分工；信息透明度；经营绩效 JEL分类：O33 G34 R11
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726532.title: Digital dividends across boundaries: inter-regional investment under enterprise digital transformation
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726532.title_zh: 跨边界数字红利：企业数字化转型下的区域间投资

10.1080/00036846.2026.2726533.abstract: Geographical indications (GIs) are increasingly promoted as rural development instrument, yet how they reshape farm-level economic activity remains poorly understood at population scale. This study examines the farm-level economic effects of GI wine designation, asking whether it shifts farms towards value-added production, reallocates labour, and stimulates diversification into downstream activities. Using the Spanish Agricultural Census 2020, we examine farms holding wine GI designations, employing multivariate regression, propensity score matching, and a descriptive mediation decomposition. Since GI status is not randomly assigned and the data are cross-sectional, we interpret the estimates as conditional associations rather than causal effects. The analysis yields three main results. Wine GI designation is associated with substantially higher production value relative to comparable non-GI farms, consistent with a shift towards quality-differentiated production. GI farms also diversify more into downstream activities; an effect concentrated in agricultural processing rather than tourism and indicative of vertical integration. Total employment differences, however, are statistically indistinguishable from zero once production scale is held constant. Rather than creating jobs, GI designation reallocates labour towards family workers and away from hired labour, operating almost entirely through production-scale expansion. These patterns suggest that Spanish wine GIs function primarily to raise value-added production and reorganize labour.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726533.abstract_zh: 地理标志（GIs）日益被推广作为农村发展工具，然而其在人口规模上如何重塑农场层面的经济活动仍知之甚少。本研究考察了葡萄酒地理标志认定对农场层面的经济效应，探讨其是否促使农场转向增值生产、重新配置劳动力，并刺激向下游活动的多元化发展。利用2020年西班牙农业普查数据，我们研究了持有葡萄酒地理标志认定的农场，采用多元回归、倾向得分匹配及描述性中介分解方法。由于地理标志状态并非随机分配且数据为横截面数据，我们将估计结果解释为条件关联而非因果效应。分析得出三项主要结果。葡萄酒地理标志认定与可比非地理标志农场相比，显著关联于更高的生产价值，这与向质量差异化生产的转变相一致。地理标志农场在下游活动中的多元化程度也更高；这一效应集中于农业加工而非旅游业，表明存在纵向一体化趋势。然而，在控制生产规模后，总就业差异在统计上与零无显著区别。地理标志认定并未创造就业，而是将劳动力从雇佣劳动重新配置至家庭劳动力，且这一效应几乎完全通过生产规模扩张实现。这些模式表明，西班牙葡萄酒地理标志主要功能在于提升增值生产并重组劳动力。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726533.title: Geographical indications and farm economic performance: evidence from wine farms in Spain
10.1080/00036846.2026.2726533.title_zh: 地理标志与农场经济绩效：来自西班牙葡萄酒农场的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2727138.abstract: This study examines the cointegration between WTI and Brent crude oil prices across spot and futures markets over 1993–2022. We analyse four price pairs to assess market integration and price discovery, while developing a cointegration parity consistency framework linking the estimated bivariate cointegration structures across interconnected markets. We find strong evidence of a stable long-run equilibrium in spot markets, confirming tight global integration. In contrast, futures relationships are less stable and vary across sub-sample periods. Three structural shifts drive these dynamics: (i) post-2003 divergence of futures from spot relationships amid increased market participation, (ii) a 2015 shift in price discovery from Brent to WTI following U.S. export liberalization, and (iii) a marked weakening of spot–futures linkages since 2019 during heightened global uncertainty. Finally, the tests reveal no statistically detectable cross-system inconsistency among the estimated cointegrating relationships, illustrating the role of the proposed parity consistency framework as a system-level diagnostic. These findings highlight how institutional changes and global shocks shape price linkages and market integration in crude oil markets. KEYWORDS: Cointegration parity consistency vector error correction method West Texas Intermediate brent regime shifts in long-run relationship JEL CLASSIFICATION: G14 C19 Q43
10.1080/00036846.2026.2727138.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了1993年至2022年间WTI与布伦特原油价格在现货与期货市场上的协整关系。我们分析了四组价格配对，以评估市场一体化与价格发现机制，同时构建了一个协整套利一致性框架，将跨关联市场的估计双变量协整结构联系起来。研究发现，现货市场存在稳定的长期均衡关系的有力证据，确认了全球市场的紧密一体化。相比之下，期货市场的关系稳定性较弱，且在不同子样本期间有所变化。三个结构性转变驱动了这些动态变化：（i）2003年后，随着市场参与度提升，期货与现货关系出现分化；（ii）2015年，在美国出口自由化后，价格发现主导权从布伦特转向WTI；（iii）自2019年以来，在全球不确定性加剧的背景下，现货与期货之间的联动关系显著减弱。最后，检验结果显示，所估计的协整关系之间不存在统计上可检测的跨系统不一致性，这体现了所提出的协整套利一致性框架作为系统层面诊断工具的作用。这些发现凸显了制度变迁与全球冲击如何塑造原油市场的价格联动与市场一体化。关键词：协整套利一致性 向量误差修正方法 西德克萨斯中质原油 布伦特 长期关系中的制度转变 JEL分类：G14 C19 Q43
10.1080/00036846.2026.2727138.title: Market integration and regime shifts in WTI and Brent crude oil Markets
10.1080/00036846.2026.2727138.title_zh: WTI与布伦特原油市场的市场整合与制度变迁

10.1080/00036846.2026.2727140.abstract: This paper examines how leverage regulation affects firms’ innovation incentives and systematic risk exposure. Exploiting China’s 2018 leverage regulation reform that introduced industry-specific leverage thresholds for state-owned enterprises, we employ a regression discontinuity design to identify causal effects. We find that stronger leverage regulation significantly reduces firms’ patenting activities, particularly invention patents, without evidence of changes in patent quality. Additional analyses suggest that this decline reflects a contraction in internal innovation activities rather than substitution towards external technology acquisition. Importantly, we show that leverage regulation increases firms’ systematic risk, consistent with the view that reduced innovation weakens growth opportunities and changes the composition of firm value. In contrast, we find limited short-run effects on operating performance and valuation, consistent with the long-horizon nature of innovation outcomes. Overall, our findings highlight how leverage regulation can influence firms’ innovation incentives and risk exposure through a regulatory discipline channel.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2727140.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了杠杆监管如何影响企业的创新激励与系统性风险暴露。利用中国2018年针对国有企业实施的行业特定杠杆阈值改革，我们采用断点回归设计来识别因果效应。研究发现，更强的杠杆监管显著减少了企业的专利申请活动，尤其是发明专利，但未发现专利质量变化的证据。进一步分析表明，这一下降反映了内部创新活动的收缩，而非转向外部技术获取。重要的是，我们证明杠杆监管增加了企业的系统性风险，这与创新减少削弱增长机会并改变企业价值构成的看法一致。相比之下，我们发现对经营绩效和估值的短期影响有限，这与创新成果的长期性质相符。总体而言，我们的研究结果突显了杠杆监管如何通过监管约束渠道影响企业的创新激励与风险暴露。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2727140.title: Leverage regulation, innovation, and systematic risk
10.1080/00036846.2026.2727140.title_zh: 杠杆监管、创新与系统性风险

10.1080/00036846.2026.2729566.abstract: This study examines the within-firm association between foreign blockholder ownership and corporate tax avoidance using 36,717 firm-year observations for Chinese A-share firms from 2007 to 2024. Greater foreign blockholder ownership is associated with lower statutory–effective tax-rate gaps and discretionary book–tax differences. A 10-percentage-point increase in ownership is associated with reductions equivalent to approximately 19.7% of the sample mean for the statutory–effective tax-rate gap and 20.5% for discretionary book–tax differences. The estimates remain negative and statistically significant under alternative ownership measures, additional controls, richer fixed effects, long-run cash effective tax rates, permutation tests, and matched-firm panel specifications. MSCI-based instrumental-variable estimates provide complementary evidence in the same direction. We then examine media, analyst, and regulatory responses to tax avoidance. Negative media coverage and recorded tax-related violations become more responsive to tax avoidance as foreign blockholder ownership rises, whereas analyst following moves in the opposite direction. The negative ownership association is stronger in regions with higher marketization and among firms receiving greater public attention, but weaker in state-owned enterprises. These findings identify foreign blockholding as a distinct governance arrangement whose relationship with corporate tax avoidance depends on whether domestic institutions and public information support outside shareholder oversight. KEYWORDS: Foreign blockholders corporate tax avoidance corporate governance cross-border ownership external monitoring JEL CLASSIFICATION: F21 G34 H26
10.1080/00036846.2026.2729566.abstract_zh: 本研究利用2007年至2024年间中国A股上市公司36，717个公司-年度观测值，考察了外资大股东持股与公司避税行为之间的企业内关联。外资大股东持股比例越高，法定税率与实际税率之差及 discretionary book–tax differences（可自由支配的账面-税务差异）越小。持股比例每增加10个百分点，法定税率与实际税率之差约降低样本均值的19.7%，可自由支配的账面-税务差异约降低20.5%。在采用替代持股度量、增加控制变量、引入更丰富的固定效应、使用长期现金有效税率、进行置换检验及匹配样本面板设定后，估计结果仍为负且统计显著。基于MSCI的工具变量估计提供了方向一致的补充证据。随后，本文考察了媒体、分析师及监管机构对避税行为的反应。随着外资大股东持股比例上升，负面媒体报道及记录的税务相关违规行为对避税行为的反应更为敏感，而分析师关注度则呈现相反趋势。持股比例的负向关联在市场化和公众关注度较高的地区更为显著，但在国有企业中较弱。上述发现表明，外资大股东持股是一种独特的治理安排，其与公司避税行为的关系取决于国内制度及公共信息是否支持外部股东监督。关键词：外资大股东；公司避税；公司治理；跨境持股；外部监督 JEL分类：F21 G34 H26

10.1080/00036846.2026.2729571.abstract: This paper examines whether industrial robot adoption affects marriage formation in China. Using micro-level data from the China Family Panel Studies for 2010–2020 matched with a city-level measure of robot exposure, we find that greater robot exposure significantly reduces the probability of marriage formation. Further analysis shows that industrial robots asymmetrically reshape the labour-market positions of men and women, thereby altering relative economic position and marriage incentives. The effect operates through three channels: stronger incentives for human-capital investment, gender-differentiated labour-market adjustment, and occupational reallocation. The negative effect is more pronounced among high-income individuals, younger cohorts, migrants, and residents of cities with weaker manufacturing bases, indicating that the marriage consequences of automation extend beyond direct low-skilled manufacturing displacement. More flexible employment arrangements, stronger social protection, and more egalitarian gender norms mitigate the adverse effect. Overall, the findings show that industrial robots affect marriage formation through broader labour-market restructuring.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2729571.abstract_zh: 本文考察了工业机器人应用是否影响中国的婚姻形成。利用2010—2020年中国家庭追踪调查的微观数据，并结合城市层面的机器人暴露度指标，我们发现机器人暴露度越高，婚姻形成的概率显著降低。进一步分析表明，工业机器人不对称地重塑了男性和女性在劳动力市场中的地位，从而改变了相对经济地位和婚姻激励。其影响通过三个渠道发挥作用：人力资本投资激励增强、性别差异化的劳动力市场调整以及职业再配置。负面效应在高收入群体、年轻队列、流动人口以及制造业基础较弱城市的居民中更为显著，这表明自动化的婚姻后果不仅限于直接的低技能制造业岗位替代。更灵活的就业安排、更强的社会保障以及更平等的性别规范能够缓解这一不利影响。总体而言，研究结果表明，工业机器人通过更广泛的劳动力市场重构影响婚姻形成。

10.1080/00036846.2026.2730529.abstract: Patent examination speed is critical for firms in rapidly evolving AI technology. Drawing on knowledge recombination perspectives, this study examines how knowledge diversity and technology cycles influence patent examination duration and how firm size moderates these relationships. Using patents in the natural language processing (NLP) sector, we employed Cox proportional hazards models with time-dependent coefficients. The results show that knowledge diversity follows an inverted U-shaped relationship with patent examination duration, with moderate levels of knowledge diversity associated with longer examination durations and higher levels associated with shorter durations. A longer technology cycle is associated with a shorter patent examination duration. Furthermore, firm size strengthens the beneficial effects of knowledge diversity and mature technological knowledge on the efficiency of examinations. This study contributes to the innovation economics literature by highlighting the nonlinear effects of knowledge characteristics and the role of firm heterogeneity in explaining variations in patent examination efficiency. KEYWORDS: Patent examination duration knowledge diversity across firms technology cycle firm size Natural Language Processing JEL CLASSIFICATION: D81 D23 C41
10.1080/00036846.2026.2730529.abstract_zh: 专利审查速度对于快速发展的AI技术领域中的企业至关重要。基于知识重组视角，本研究探讨了知识多样性与技术周期如何影响专利审查时长，以及企业规模如何调节这些关系。利用自然语言处理（NLP）领域的专利数据，我们采用了含时变系数的Cox比例风险模型。结果表明，知识多样性与专利审查时长呈倒U型关系，中等程度的知识多样性对应较长的审查时长，而较高程度的知识多样性则对应较短的审查时长。较长的技术周期与较短的专利审查时长相关联。此外，企业规模增强了知识多样性和成熟技术知识对审查效率的积极影响。本研究通过强调知识特征的非线性效应以及企业异质性在解释专利审查效率差异中的作用，为创新经济学文献做出了贡献。关键词：专利审查时长 跨企业知识多样性 技术周期 企业规模 自然语言处理 JEL分类：D81 D23 C41
