10.1080/00036846.2026.2731163.abstract: This study compares Elastic Net logistic regression with three tree-based ensemble models for one-year-ahead financial distress prediction using 295,416 firm-year observations from Korean SMEs. Financial distress is defined using a forward-looking cash-flow-based criterion requiring both negative operating cash flow relative to total debt and a negative net cash position. Models are developed on 2009–2023 observations using Bayesian optimization and five-fold stratified cross-validation and evaluated on an independent 2024 out-of-time sample. All three tree-based ensemble models achieve stronger threshold-free discrimination than the Elastic Net benchmark. XGBoost achieves the best overall predictive performance, with the highest ROC-AUC (0.8096), PR-AUC (0.5318), and F1-score (0.5445), although its advantage over Random Forest and LightGBM is quantitatively modest. DeLong tests confirm that these ROC-AUC differences are statistically significant despite their small magnitudes. SHAP analysis identifies Debt Dependence, the Interest Coverage Ratio, and operating cash flow relative to sales as the three most influential predictors and reveals nonlinear predictive relationships. Overall, the findings highlight the value of combining a forward-looking distress measure with interpretable nonlinear ensemble models for SME credit risk assessment and early warning. KEYWORDS: Financial distress prediction Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) Cash-flow-based financial distress interpretable machine learning SHAP JEL CLASSIFICATION: C53 G33 C55
10.1080/00036846.2026.2731163.abstract_zh: 本研究比较了弹性网络逻辑回归与三种基于树的集成模型在韩国中小企业一年期财务困境预测中的表现，使用了295,416个企业-年度观测值。财务困境采用基于前瞻性现金流的标准进行定义，要求同时满足经营现金流相对于总债务为负以及净现金头寸为负两个条件。模型基于2009年至2023年的观测数据，通过贝叶斯优化和五折分层交叉验证进行开发，并在独立的2024年样本外数据上进行了评估。所有三种基于树的集成模型在无阈值判别能力方面均优于弹性网络基准模型。XGBoost取得了整体最佳的预测性能，其ROC-AUC（0.8096）、PR-AUC（0.5318）和F1分数（0.5445）均为最高，尽管其相对于随机森林和LightGBM的优势在数量上较为有限。DeLong检验确认，尽管这些ROC-AUC差异幅度较小，但在统计上具有显著性。SHAP分析识别出债务依赖度、利息覆盖倍数以及经营现金流与销售额之比为三个最具影响力的预测因子，并揭示了非线性预测关系。总体而言，研究结果凸显了将前瞻性困境度量与可解释的非线性集成模型相结合，对中小企业信用风险评估和早期预警的价值。关键词：财务困境预测；中小企业；基于现金流的财务困境；可解释机器学习；SHAP JEL分类：C53 G33 C55
10.1080/00036846.2026.2731163.title: Predicting financial distress in Korean SMEs: a comparison of Elastic Net and tree-based ensemble models
10.1080/00036846.2026.2731163.title_zh: 预测韩国中小企业财务困境：弹性网络与基于树的集成模型的比较

10.1080/07350015.2025.2551246.abstract: We develop a dynamic framework to detect the occurrence of permanent and transitory breaks in the illiquidity process. We propose various tests that can be applied separately to individual events and can be aggregated across different events over time for a given firm or across different firms. We use this methodology to study the impact of forward and reverse stock splits on the illiquidity dynamics of the S&P 500, S&P 400 and S&P 600 index stock constituents. Our empirical results show that stock splits have a positive and significant effect on the permanent component of the illiquidity process while a majority of the stocks engaging in reverse splits experience an improvement in liquidity conditions.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2551246.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个动态框架，用以识别非流动性过程中永久性与暂时性断裂的发生。我们提出了多种检验方法，既可单独应用于特定事件，也可跨时间对同一企业或跨不同企业进行汇总分析。运用此方法论，我们研究了正向与反向股票拆分对标准普尔500、标准普尔400及标准普尔600指数成分股非流动性动态的影响。实证结果显示，股票拆分对非流动性过程的永久性成分具有正向且显著的影响，而大多数进行反向拆分的股票则经历了流动性状况的改善。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2551246.title: The Permanent and Temporary Effects of Stock Splits on Liquidity in a Dynamic Semiparametric Model
10.1080/07350015.2025.2551246.title_zh: 股票拆分对流动性的永久与暂时效应：基于动态半参数模型的分析

10.1080/07350015.2025.2551249.abstract: Quantile vector autoregression (QVAR) models offer enhanced capabilities over vector autoregression (VAR) models in analyzing asymmetric interactions within multiple time series and are widely used in many areas, including finance and economics. However, in scenarios involving high-dimensional data where the number of time series N exceeds the length of the time series T, both parameter estimation and the theoretical establishment present significant challenges. Notably, existing research has not yet explored these challenges with the framework of QVAR models. To handle this problem, we propose a novel high-dimensional QVAR model that incorporates influencers and communities, which assumes that variables within distinct communities have shared dependency structures and are influenced by the same set of variables, called influencers. We develop an estimation procedure based on the alternating minimization algorithm and the convolution-smoothed approach. The local consistency results for the estimated parameters are established in high-dimensional settings with sub-Weibull innovations. Numerical studies illustrate that the proposed model performs well in finite samples. The proposed model is applied to identify the most influential macroeconomic variables in the United States across business cycles and construct a dynamic quantile network with influencers and communities for volatility spillover effects of global stock markets.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2551249.abstract_zh: 分位数向量自回归（QVAR）模型相较于向量自回归（VAR）模型，在分析多元时间序列中的非对称交互作用方面具有更强的能力，并广泛应用于金融和经济学等多个领域。然而，在高维数据场景下，当时间序列数量N超过时间序列长度T时，参数估计和理论构建均面临显著挑战。值得注意的是，现有研究尚未在QVAR模型框架内探讨这些挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的高维QVAR模型，该模型纳入影响者与社群结构，假设不同社群内的变量具有共享的依赖结构，并受同一组变量（称为影响者）的影响。我们开发了一种基于交替最小化算法和卷积平滑方法的估计程序。在高维设置下，针对次Weibull创新项，我们建立了估计参数的局部一致性结果。数值研究表明，所提出的模型在有限样本中表现良好。该模型被应用于识别美国商业周期中最具影响力的宏观经济变量，并构建一个包含影响者与社群的动态分位数网络，以分析全球股票市场的波动溢出效应。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2551249.title: High-Dimensional Quantile Vector Autoregression with Influencers and Communities
10.1080/07350015.2025.2551249.title_zh: 高维分位数向量自回归：影响者与社区结构

10.1080/07350015.2025.2554669.abstract: We consider the problem of time-varying high quantile estimation for a general class of nonstationary tail dependent time series. Unlike the conventional quantile analysis in which the quantile level is typically assumed to be fixed, the current high quantile setting requires the quantile level to grow with the sample size to capture the tail phenomenon. In addition, for nonstationary time series data, the underlying data generating mechanism is expected to change over time, and as a result the associated time-varying high quantile can no longer be treated as a constant parameter making existing results not directly applicable. In this article, we model the underlying time-varying high quantile as a nonparametric function of time to avoid any parametric misspecification, and we establish the consistency and central limit theorem of nonparametric high quantile estimators for a general class of nonstationary tail dependent time series. It can be seen from our limit theorems that the asymptotic behavior of nonparametric high quantile estimators can be affected by both the double asymptotic scheme caused by the growing quantile level and the serial tail dependence in time series data. Numerical results are provided to illustrate the developed results, and an extension to time-varying high quantile regression models is also discussed.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2554669.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了一类广泛非平稳尾部相依时间序列中时变高分为点估计的问题。与通常假设分位水平固定的传统分位分析不同，当前高分为设定要求分位水平随样本量增长以捕捉尾部现象。此外，对于非平稳时间序列数据，其背后的数据生成机制预期随时间变化，因此相关的时变高分为点不能再被视为常数参数，这使得现有结果无法直接适用。在本文中，我们将潜在的时变高分为点建模为时间的非参数函数，以避免任何参数误设，并针对一类广泛的非平稳尾部相依时间序列，建立了非参数高分为点估计量的一致性及中心极限定理。从我们的极限定理可以看出，非参数高分为点估计量的渐近行为可能同时受到由增长的分位水平引起的双重渐近方案以及时间序列数据中序列尾部相依性的影响。文中提供了数值结果以说明所发展的理论，并进一步讨论了向时变高分为回归模型的扩展。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2554669.title: Time-Varying High Quantile Estimation for Nonstationary Tail Dependent Time Series
10.1080/07350015.2025.2554669.title_zh: 非平稳尾部相依时间序列的时变高分位数估计

10.1080/07350015.2025.2560369.abstract: Bayesian inference in Vector Autoregressions (VARs) involves manipulating large matrices which appear in the posterior (or conditional posterior) of the VAR coefficients. For large VARs, the computational burden of these manipulations can render empirical work impractical. In response to this, many researchers transform their VARs so as to allow for Bayesian estimation to proceed one equation at a time. This leads to a massive reduction in the computational burden. This transformation involves taking the Cholesky decomposition for the error covariance matrix. However, this strategy implies that posterior inference depends on the order the variables enter the VAR. In this paper we develop an alternative transformation, based on the eigendecomposition, which does not lead to order dependence. Beginning with an inverse-Wishart prior on the error covariance matrix, we derive and discuss the properties of the prior it implies on the eigenmatrix and eigenvalues. We then show how an extension of the prior on the eigenmatrix can allow for greater flexibility while maintaining many of the benefits of conjugacy. We leverage this flexibility to extend the prior on the eigenvalues to allow for stochastic volatility. The properties of the eigendecomposition approach are investigated in a macroeconomic forecasting exercise involving VARs with 20 variables.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2560369.abstract_zh: 向量自回归（VARs）中的贝叶斯推断涉及对出现在VAR系数后验（或条件后验）中的大型矩阵进行操作。对于大规模VAR，这些操作的计算负担可能使实证工作变得不切实际。为此，许多研究者对其VAR进行变换，以便贝叶斯估计能够逐方程进行。这大幅降低了计算负担。该变换涉及对误差协方差矩阵进行Cholesky分解。然而，这一策略意味着后验推断依赖于变量进入VAR的顺序。在本文中，我们开发了一种基于特征分解的替代变换，该变换不会导致顺序依赖性。从误差协方差矩阵的逆Wishart先验出发，我们推导并讨论了该先验对特征矩阵和特征值所隐含的性质。随后，我们展示了如何扩展特征矩阵上的先验，以在保持共轭性诸多优点的同时，提供更大的灵活性。我们利用这种灵活性来扩展特征值上的先验，以允许随机波动性。特征分解方法的性质在一个涉及20个变量的VAR宏观经济预测练习中进行了研究。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2560369.title: Fast, Order-Invariant Bayesian Inference in VARs Using the Eigendecomposition of the Error Covariance Matrix
10.1080/07350015.2025.2560369.title_zh: 利用误差协方差矩阵特征分解实现VAR中快速、顺序不变的贝叶斯推断

10.1080/07350015.2025.2561147.abstract: We propose a novel methodology for discovering the presence of relationships realized as binary time series between variables in high dimension. To make it visually intuitive, we regard the existence of a relationship as an edge connection, and call a collection of such edges a network. Our objective is thus rephrased as uncovering the network by selecting relevant edges, referred to as the network exploration. Our methodology is based on multiple testing for the presence or absence of each edge, designed to ensure statistical reproducibility via controlling the false discovery rate (FDR). In particular, we carefully construct p-variables, and apply the Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure. We show that the BH with our p-variables controls the FDR under arbitrary dependence structure with any sample size and dimension, and has asymptotic power one under mild conditions. The validity is also confirmed by simulations and a real data example.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2561147.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法论，用于在高维变量间发现以二元时间序列形式实现的关系存在性。为使视觉直观，我们将关系的存在视为边连接，并将此类边的集合称为网络。因此，我们的目标被重新表述为通过选择相关边来揭示网络，即网络探索。我们的方法论基于对每条边存在与否的多重检验，旨在通过控制错误发现率（FDR）确保统计可重复性。特别地，我们精心构造p变量，并应用Benjamini-Hochberg（BH）程序。我们证明，在任意依赖结构下，无论样本量和维度如何，我们的p变量配合BH程序都能控制FDR，并在温和条件下具有渐近功效为1。其有效性也通过模拟实验和实际数据示例得到验证。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2561147.title: Robust Reproducible Network Exploration
10.1080/07350015.2025.2561147.title_zh: 稳健可复现的网络探索

10.1080/07350015.2025.2561409.abstract: Using a novel macro-finance model, we infer jointly the equilibrium real interest rate rt∗, trend inflation, interest rate expectations, and bond risk premia for the United States. In the model rt∗ plays a dual macro-finance role: as the benchmark real interest rate that closes the output gap and as the time-varying long-run real interest rate that determines the level of the yield curve. Our estimated rt∗ declines over the last decade, with estimation uncertainty being relatively contained. We show that both macro and financial information is important to infer rt∗. Accounting for the secular decline in interest rates renders term premia more stable than those based on stationary yield curve models.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2561409.abstract_zh: 我们采用一种新颖的宏观金融模型，联合推断美国的均衡实际利率rt∗、趋势通胀、利率预期及债券风险溢价。在该模型中，rt∗扮演着双重宏观金融角色：既是缩小产出缺口的基准实际利率，又是决定收益率曲线水平的时间变化长期实际利率。我们的估计显示，过去十年rt∗有所下降，且估计不确定性相对可控。我们证明，宏观与金融信息对于推断rt∗均至关重要。考虑利率的长期下降趋势，使得期限溢价相较于基于平稳收益率曲线模型所得结果更为稳定。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2561409.title: Estimating the Natural Rate of Interest in a Macro-Finance Yield Curve Model
10.1080/07350015.2025.2561409.title_zh: 宏观金融收益率曲线模型中自然利率的估计

10.1080/07350015.2025.2561747.abstract: It is well-known that the detection of change-points in heavy-tailed time series is an open problem since the traditional tests may not have a power. This article introduces a winsorized cumulative sum (CUSUM) approach to solve this problem. We begin by investigating the winsorized CUSUM process and then use it to construct the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) test and the Self-normalized (SN) test. Under the null hypothesis, it is shown that each weakly converges to the maximum of a function related to the standard Brownian bridge. Under the alternative, we first study the behavior of tests after applying the winsorization technique, and then show that our tests have a power approaching to 1 as the sample size n→∞. Furthermore, we extend the winsorizing technique to test for multiple change-points without prior knowledge of the number of change points. Our framework is general and its assumptions are mild, so that our tests can be applied to a wide range of linear and nonlinear time series. The empirical results illustrate the effectiveness of our proposed procedures for change-point detection.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2561747.abstract_zh: 众所周知，重尾时间序列中的变点检测是一个开放性问题，因为传统检验可能缺乏功效。本文引入了一种截尾累积和（CUSUM）方法来解决这一问题。我们首先研究截尾CUSUM过程，并利用其构建Kolmogorov-Smirnov（KS）检验和自归一化（SN）检验。在原假设下，我们证明每个检验均弱收敛于与标准布朗桥相关的函数的最大值。在备择假设下，我们首先研究应用截尾技术后检验的行为，然后证明随着样本量n→∞，我们的检验功效趋近于1。此外，我们将截尾技术扩展至无需预先知道变点数量的多重变点检验。我们的框架具有一般性，且假设条件宽松，因此我们的检验可广泛应用于线性和非线性时间序列。实证结果展示了我们提出的变点检测程序的有效性。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2561747.title: Testing for Change-Points in Heavy-Tailed Time Series—A Winsorized CUSUM Approach
10.1080/07350015.2025.2561747.title_zh: 重尾时间序列变点检测——一种Winsorized CUSUM方法

10.1080/07350015.2025.2561749.abstract: This paper develops a simple and new approach for testing linear hypotheses about autocorrelations for time series with general stationary serial correlation structures. A practically important special case is the computation of robust confidence intervals for individual autocorrelations that do not require resampling methods. Inference is heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation robust (HAR) and allows innovations to be uncorrelated but not necessarily independent and identically distributed (iid). It is well known that the classic Bartlett (1946) formula can provide invalid inference when innovations are not (iid). Romano and Thombs (1996) derive the asymptotic distribution of sample autocorrelations under weak assumptions but avoid estimation of the variances of sample autocorrelations and suggest resampling schemes to obtain confidence intervals. As an alternative we provide an easy to implement regression approach for estimating autocorrelations and their variance matrices. The asymptotic variance takes a sandwich form which can be estimated using well known HAR variance estimators. Resulting test statistics can be implemented with fixed-smoothing critical values which reduce finite sample size distortions. Monte Carlo simulations show our approach is robust to innovations that are not iid and works reasonably well across various serial correlation structures. An empirical illustration using robust confidence intervals for autocorrelations of S&P 500 index returns shows that conclusions about market efficiency and volatility clustering during pre and post-Covid periods using our approach contrast with conclusions using traditional (and often incorrectly used) methods. We provide a Python implementation for practitioners that implements our approach: https://eastlansing.github.io/Robust_CI_Acf/
10.1080/07350015.2025.2561749.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种简单新颖的方法，用于检验具有一般平稳序列相关结构的时间序列自相关的线性假设。一个实际重要的特例是计算单个自相关的稳健置信区间，无需重采样方法。推断具有异方差性和自相关稳健性（HAR），允许创新项不相关但不一定独立同分布（iid）。众所周知，当创新项非iid时，经典的Bartlett（1946）公式可能导致无效推断。Romano和Thombs（1996）在弱假设下推导了样本自相关的渐近分布，但避免估计样本自相关的方差，并建议采用重采样方案以获得置信区间。作为替代，我们提供了一种易于实现的回归方法来估计自相关及其方差矩阵。渐近方差采用三明治形式，可利用众所周知的HAR方差估计器进行估计。所得检验统计量可采用固定平滑临界值实施，以减少有限样本尺寸失真。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，我们的方法对非iid创新项具有稳健性，并在各种序列相关结构下表现良好。一项实证示例使用S&P 500指数收益自相关的稳健置信区间显示，采用我们的方法得出的关于疫情前后市场效率和波动聚集性的结论，与传统（且常被误用）方法得出的结论形成对比。我们为实践者提供了实现该方法的Python代码：https://eastlansing.github.io/Robust_CI_Acf/
10.1080/07350015.2025.2561749.title: Robust Confidence Intervals for Autocorrelations of Stationary Time Series
10.1080/07350015.2025.2561749.title_zh: 平稳时间序列自相关的稳健置信区间

10.1080/07350015.2025.2562954.abstract: We introduce a novel simulation-based method for signal extraction in a general class of state space models. It can be used to estimate time-varying conditional means, modes, and quantiles, and to predict latent variables or forecast observations. The method consists of generating artificial datasets from the model and estimating the quantities of interest via extremum estimation. The approach is broadly applicable and its implementation is straightforward. The method is suited for signal extraction in cases of long time series, missing data, or high-dimensionality. Furthermore, we demonstrate its use in real-time filtering, where most of the computations can be performed in advance, and in fixed-interval smoothing. Conditions for the stability and convergence of the filtering method are discussed, and its key properties are illustrated by various applications, including nonlinear and high-dimensional models.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2562954.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的基于模拟的信号提取方法，适用于一般类别的状态空间模型。该方法可用于估计时变条件均值、众数和分位数，并预测潜在变量或预报观测值。其过程包括从模型中生成人工数据集，并通过极值估计来估算感兴趣的量。此方法适用范围广泛，实现简便，特别适合处理长时间序列、数据缺失或高维情况下的信号提取。此外，我们展示了其在实时滤波中的应用，其中大部分计算可预先完成，以及固定区间平滑中的应用。文中讨论了滤波方法稳定性与收敛性的条件，并通过包括非线性及高维模型在内的多种应用，阐明了其关键特性。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2562954.title: Extremum Monte Carlo Filters: Signal Extraction via Simulation and Regression
10.1080/07350015.2025.2562954.title_zh: 极值蒙特卡洛滤波器：基于模拟与回归的信号提取

10.1080/07350015.2025.2562964.abstract: The use of machine learning methods for predictive purposes has exponentially increased over the past two decades, but uncertainty quantification for predictive comparisons remains challenging and underdeveloped. This article addresses this gap by extending the classic inference theory for predictive ability in time series to modern machine learners, such as Lasso or Deep Learning. We investigate under which conditions such extensions are possible. For standard out-of-sample asymptotic inference to be valid with machine learning, two key properties must hold: (i) a zero-mean condition for the score of the prediction loss function and (ii) a “fast rate” of convergence for the machine learner. Absent any of these conditions, the estimation risk may be unbounded, and inferences invalid and very sensitive to sample splitting. For accurate inferences, we recommend an 80%–20% training-test splitting rule. We illustrate the wide applicability of our results with three applications: high-dimensional time series regressions with Lasso, Deep learning for binary outcomes, and a new out-of-sample test for the Martingale Difference Hypothesis (MDH). The theoretical results are supported by extensive Monte Carlo simulations and an empirical application evaluating the MDH of some major exchange rates.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2562964.abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，机器学习方法在预测领域的应用呈指数级增长，然而，针对预测比较的不确定性量化仍具挑战性且发展不足。本文通过将时间序列预测能力的经典推断理论扩展至现代机器学习方法，如Lasso或深度学习，来填补这一空白。我们探讨了此类扩展在何种条件下可行。要使标准的样本外渐近推断在机器学习背景下有效，需满足两个关键性质：（i）预测损失函数得分的零均值条件，及（ii）机器学习器达到“快速收敛率”。若任一条件缺失，估计风险可能无界，推断结果将失效且对样本分割极为敏感。为获得准确推断，我们建议采用80%-20%的训练-测试分割比例。我们通过三个应用实例展示了研究结果的广泛适用性：高维时间序列回归中的Lasso方法、二分类结果的深度学习，以及针对鞅差假设（MDH）的新型样本外检验。理论结果得到了广泛蒙特卡洛模拟及一项评估主要汇率MDH的实证应用的支持。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2562964.title: Extending the Scope of Inference About Predictive Ability to Machine Learning Methods
10.1080/07350015.2025.2562964.title_zh: 扩展预测能力推断范围至机器学习方法

10.1080/07350015.2025.2565281.abstract: We consider general models of linear interactions in binary outcomes. We first characterize the conditions under which these models are coherent and complete. Next, we show that models of linear interactions admit sound microfoundations under assumptions of incomplete information and independence. To help guide practitioners, we discuss key modeling choices and testable restrictions. We then consider a specification that is linear in parameters, and propose a simple Two-Stage Least Squares estimator. We revisit the empirical analysis of teenage smoking and peer effects of Lee, Li, and Lin. Our reanalysis highlights the main advantages of the linear framework, including minimal computational and data requirements and ability to handle fixed effects. Supplementary materials for this article are available online.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2565281.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了二元结果中线性交互作用的一般模型。首先，我们刻画了这些模型具有连贯性和完备性的条件。接着，我们证明在信息不完全和独立性的假设下，线性交互模型能够支持合理的基础微观机制。为便于实践者应用，我们讨论了关键的建模选择及可检验的约束条件。随后，我们考虑了一种参数线性的设定，并提出了一种简单的两阶段最小二乘估计方法。我们重新审视了Lee、Li和Lin关于青少年吸烟与同伴效应的实证分析。我们的再分析凸显了线性框架的主要优势，包括极低的计算与数据需求以及处理固定效应的能力。本文的补充材料可在网上获取。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2565281.title: Binary Outcomes and Linear Interactions

10.1080/07350015.2025.2565285.abstract: The Common Correlated Effects (CCE) approach enjoys considerable popularity for estimating factor-augmented panel data models. A key benefit is that by orthogonalizing the data on the available cross-section averages, the unobserved components are eliminated from the data, regardless of their order(s) of integration. This obviates the need for such knowledge, and makes CCE particularly attractive for macroeconomic applications, where the set of unobservables might contain both stationary and non-stationary variables. Despite of these benefits, it is often neglected that the pooled CCE (CCEP) estimator suffers from an asymptotic bias in TN−1→τ>0 panels, which too is common in macroeconomic research. This bias is highly disruptive for inference but cannot generally be remedied with analytical corrections. As such, we establish in this paper the validity of the cross-section bootstrap under general unknown factors for TN−1→τ<∞ as (N,T)→∞. We show that the scheme replicates the distribution of the CCE estimators, leading to a straightforward bias-correction, and confidence intervals that enable asymptotically valid inference for τ<∞. This significantly broadens the applicability of the CCEP method. We in addition explore the case where idiosyncratics serve as another source of non-stationarity. Simulation experiments show that our theoretical predictions translate well to finite samples, and that the methodology outperforms alternative bias-corrections and estimators. The method is finally demonstrated with a gravity trade application based on the dataset of Serlenga and Shin (2007).
10.1080/07350015.2025.2565285.abstract_zh: 公共相关效应（CCE）方法在估计因子增强面板数据模型时广受欢迎。其关键优势在于，通过利用可获得的截面平均值对数据进行正交化处理，未观测成分得以从数据中消除，无论其积分阶数如何。这免除了对此类知识的依赖，使得CCE特别适用于宏观经济应用，其中不可观测变量集合可能同时包含平稳与非平稳变量。尽管有这些优点，但常常被忽视的是，在TN−1→τ>0的面板中，合并CCE（CCEP）估计量存在渐近偏差，而这种情况在宏观经济研究中同样普遍。该偏差对推断造成严重干扰，且通常无法通过解析修正加以解决。因此，本文在一般未知因子条件下，针对TN−1→τ<∞且(N,T)→∞的情形，确立了截面自助法的有效性。我们证明该方法能够复制CCE估计量的分布，从而提供直接的偏差修正及置信区间，使得在τ<∞时能够进行渐近有效的推断。这显著拓宽了CCEP方法的适用范围。此外，我们还探讨了个体特异项作为非平稳性另一来源的情形。模拟实验表明，我们的理论预测在有限样本中表现良好，且该方法优于其他偏差修正方法和估计量。最后，我们基于Serlenga和Shin（2007）的数据集，通过引力贸易应用对方法进行了实证演示。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2565285.title: Cross-Section Bootstrap for CCE Regressions with General Unknown Factors
10.1080/07350015.2025.2565285.title_zh: 一般未知因子下CCE回归的横截面自助法

10.1080/07350015.2025.2566352.abstract: This article develops a new estimator for an average partial effect in nonlinear panel models, where outcomes are time-varying monotonic transformations of latent variables that include fixed effects and endogenous regressors. The partial effect can be time-varying and the counterfactual shift is scale invariant—key advantages over the linear model. We exploit a conditional moment restriction and address the ill-posed nature of recovering the transformation functions using nonparametric instrumental variable techniques. Our estimator for the partial effect satisfies root-n asymptotic normality. We apply our method to data from the Trends in International Mathematics and Science Study, and find evidence that traditional instruction is strongly associated with improved achievement in both mathematics and science.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2566352.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的估计量，用于非线性面板模型中的平均偏效应，其中结果变量是随时间变化的潜在变量的单调变换，这些潜在变量包含固定效应和内生的解释变量。该偏效应可以随时间变化，且反事实变动具有尺度不变性——这是相对于线性模型的关键优势。我们利用条件矩约束，并采用非参数工具变量技术来解决恢复变换函数时的不适定问题。我们的偏效应估计量满足根n渐近正态性。我们将此方法应用于国际数学与科学趋势研究的数据，发现传统教学与数学和科学成绩的提升密切相关。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2566352.title: Partial Effects in Time-Varying Linear Transformation Panel Models with Endogeneity
10.1080/07350015.2025.2566352.title_zh: 时变线性变换面板模型中带内生性的偏效应

10.1080/07350015.2025.2569479.abstract: This paper examines the joint-hypothesis-testing problem that arises when comparing two competing forecast methods across multiple horizons. We focus on the concept of uniform Superior Predictive Ability (uSPA) and investigate the asymptotic properties of the corresponding test statistic. Under standard regularity conditions, the asymptotic distribution under the null hypothesis is derived, ensuring that the test maintains the correct size and exhibits consistency. Monte Carlo simulations are used to assess the test’s finite-sample performance. An empirical application replicates and extends earlier studies, providing inference for multi-horizon comparisons between direct and iterative forecasting approaches.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2569479.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在多个预测期限上比较两种竞争性预测方法时所出现的联合假设检验问题。我们聚焦于一致优越预测能力（uSPA）这一概念，并研究相应检验统计量的渐近性质。在标准正则条件下，推导了原假设下的渐近分布，确保检验具有正确的显著性水平并表现出一致性。蒙特卡洛模拟用于评估检验的有限样本表现。一项实证应用复现并扩展了早期研究，为直接预测与迭代预测方法之间的多期限比较提供了推断依据。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2569479.title: Multi-Horizon Uniform Superior Predictive Ability Revisited
10.1080/07350015.2025.2569479.title_zh: 多水平一致优越预测能力再探

10.1080/07350015.2025.2569483.abstract: In recent years, orthogonal statistical learning has been widely recognized for its ability to reduce sensitivity with respect to nuisance parameters to estimate the target parameter, making it an important tool in causal inference, particularly in the estimation of the conditional average treatment effect (CATE). However, its application on conditional quantile treatment effect (CQTE), which offers a more comprehensive perspective on treatment effects than CATE, has not yet been explored comprehensively. In this article, we propose a novel method for learning CQTE. This method shares Neyman-orthogonal property, which produces CQTE estimators that are insensitive to small perturbations of nuisance functions. We first model the CQTE nonparametrically and use deep learning to estimate it. We establish the convergence rate of the neural network estimator, demonstrating that it achieves the minimax optimal rate of convergence (up to a polylogarithmic factor). This highlights deep learning’s ability to identify low-dimensional structures in high-dimensional data. Additionally, we then model CQTE linearly to facilitate interpretation and statistical inference. We prove that the corresponding coefficient and CQTE estimators achieve root-n consistency and asymptotic normality, even if the estimators of the nuisance parameters converge at a slower rate. Through empirical evaluation for numerical studies, we demonstrate the superiority of our method compared to competing methods.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2569483.abstract_zh: 近年来，正交统计学习因其能够降低对干扰参数的敏感性以估计目标参数而广受认可，成为因果推断中的重要工具，尤其是在条件平均处理效应（CATE）的估计中。然而，其在条件分位数处理效应（CQTE）上的应用——这一效应相比CATE提供了对处理效应更全面的视角——尚未得到深入探索。在本文中，我们提出了一种学习CQTE的新方法。该方法具有Neyman-正交性质，使得所得到的CQTE估计量对干扰函数的微小扰动不敏感。我们首先对CQTE进行非参数建模，并利用深度学习进行估计。我们建立了神经网络估计器的收敛速率，证明其达到了极小极大最优收敛速率（至多相差一个多项式对数因子）。这凸显了深度学习在高维数据中识别低维结构的能力。此外，我们随后对CQTE进行线性建模，以促进解释和统计推断。我们证明，即使干扰参数的估计量以较慢速率收敛，相应的系数和CQTE估计量也能实现根号n一致性和渐近正态性。通过数值研究的实证评估，我们展示了我们方法相较于竞争方法的优越性。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2569483.title: Deep Orthogonal Learner for Conditional Quantile Treatment Effect Estimation
10.1080/07350015.2025.2569483.title_zh: 面向条件分位数处理效应估计的深度正交学习器

10.1080/07350015.2025.2569730.abstract: Outliers are commonly encountered in financial and economic data, and pose significant challenges to the study of the conventional factor models. This article focuses on factor analysis for high-dimensional data in the presence of random outliers. We first propose a new class of factor model which incorporates a sparse outlier matrix. We then develop a class of robust methods to estimate the factor matrix and the number of factors. Under mild conditions, consistency of the proposed estimators is established. Judging from the numerical examples, we observe that the proposed estimation methods outperform existing approaches. Our methods significantly enhance the performance of the high-dimensional factor analysis when the data are contaminated by outliers.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2569730.abstract_zh: 金融与经济数据中常出现异常值，这对传统因子模型的研究构成了重大挑战。本文聚焦于存在随机异常值的高维数据因子分析。我们首先提出了一类新的因子模型，该模型纳入了一个稀疏异常值矩阵。随后，我们开发了一类稳健方法来估计因子矩阵及因子数量。在温和条件下，我们确立了所提估计量的一致性。从数值实例来看，我们观察到所提出的估计方法优于现有方法。当数据受到异常值污染时，我们的方法显著提升了高维因子分析的性能。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2569730.title: Robust Factor Analysis for High-Dimensional Data with Outliers
10.1080/07350015.2025.2569730.title_zh: 高维数据中带异常值的稳健因子分析

10.1080/07350015.2025.2571185.abstract: This paper provides a framework for joint shrinkage estimation and identification of latent group structures in panel data models with interactive fixed effects and large number of explanatory variables. The latent structure of the model allows individuals to be classified into a number of groups where the number of groups and/or each individual’s group identity are unknown. A doubly penalized principal component estimation procedure using a pairwise fusion penalty and an adaptive LASSO (least absolute shrinkage and selection operator) penalty is introduced to detect the latent group structure and select the relevant regressors. To implement the proposed approach, an alternating direction method of multipliers algorithm has been developed. The proposed method is further illustrated by simulation studies and an empirical application of economic growth across various countries which demonstrate the good performance of the method.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2571185.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个联合收缩估计与潜在群组结构识别的框架，适用于具有交互固定效应及大量解释变量的面板数据模型。该模型的潜在结构允许个体被划分为若干群组，其中群组数量和/或每个个体的群组归属未知。我们引入了一种双重惩罚主成分估计方法，结合成对融合惩罚与自适应LASSO（最小绝对收缩和选择算子）惩罚，以检测潜在群组结构并筛选相关回归变量。为实施所提方法，开发了交替方向乘子法算法。通过模拟研究及跨国经济增长的实证应用，进一步展示了所提方法的良好性能。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2571185.title: Shrinkage Estimation and Identification of Latent Group Structures in Panel Data with Interactive Fixed Effects
10.1080/07350015.2025.2571185.title_zh: 面板数据交互固定效应下潜在群组结构的收缩估计与识别

10.1080/07350015.2025.2572768.abstract: We analyze a varying-coefficient spatial autoregressive model with spatial fixed effects. One salient feature of the model is the incorporation of multiple spatial weight matrices through their linear combinations with varying coefficients, which help solve the problem of choosing the most “correct” one for applied econometricians who often face the availability of multiple expert spatial weight matrices. We estimate and make inferences on the model coefficients and coefficients in basis expansions of the varying coefficients through penalized estimations, establishing the oracle properties of the estimators and the consistency of the overall estimated spatial weight matrix, which can be time-dependent. We further consider two applications of our model in change point detections in spatial autoregressive models, providing theoretical justifications in consistent change point locations estimation and practical implementations. Simulation experiments demonstrate the performance of our proposed methodology, and real data analyses are also carried out.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2572768.abstract_zh: 我们分析了一个带有空间固定效应的变系数空间自回归模型。该模型的一个显著特点是，通过变系数的线性组合整合了多个空间权重矩阵，这有助于解决应用计量经济学家常面临的选择最“合适”空间权重矩阵的问题，因为他们往往面对多个专家提供的空间权重矩阵。我们通过惩罚估计对模型系数及变系数基展开中的系数进行估计与推断，确立了估计量的预言性质以及整体估计空间权重矩阵（可能随时间变化）的一致性。我们进一步考虑了该模型在空间自回归模型变点检测中的两个应用，为一致变点位置估计提供了理论依据及实际实施方案。模拟实验展示了我们提出方法的性能，并进行了实际数据分析。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2572768.title: Inference on Dynamic Spatial Autoregressive Models with Change Point Detection
10.1080/07350015.2025.2572768.title_zh: 动态空间自回归模型的推断与变点检测

10.1080/07350015.2025.2572770.abstract: Businesses frequently run online controlled experiments (i.e., A/B tests) to learn about the effect of an intervention on multiple business metrics. To account for multiple hypothesis testing, multiple metrics are commonly aggregated into a single composite measure, losing valuable information, or strict family-wise error rate adjustments are imposed, leading to reduced power. In this paper, we propose an economical framework to design Bayesian A/B tests while controlling both power and the false discovery rate (FDR). Selecting optimal decision thresholds to control power and the FDR typically relies on intensive simulation at each sample size considered. Our framework efficiently recommends optimal sample sizes and decision thresholds for Bayesian A/B tests that satisfy criteria for the FDR and average power. Our approach is efficient because we leverage new theoretical results to obtain these recommendations using simulations conducted at only two sample sizes. Our methodology is illustrated using an example based on a real A/B test involving several metrics.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2572770.abstract_zh: 企业经常开展在线受控实验（即A/B测试），以了解干预措施对多个业务指标的影响。为应对多重假设检验问题，通常将多个指标汇总为单一综合度量，但这会丢失有价值的信息，或施加严格的族系错误率调整，从而降低检验效能。本文提出了一种经济高效的框架，用于设计贝叶斯A/B测试，同时控制检验效能和错误发现率（FDR）。在考虑每个样本量时，选择最优决策阈值以控制检验效能和FDR通常依赖于密集的模拟计算。我们的框架能够高效地推荐满足FDR和平均检验效能标准的贝叶斯A/B测试的最优样本量和决策阈值。该方法的高效性源于我们利用新的理论结果，仅需在两个样本量下进行模拟即可获得这些推荐。我们通过一个涉及多个指标的真实A/B测试案例来展示所提方法的实用性。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2572770.title: Design of Bayesian A/B Tests Controlling False Discovery Rates and Power
10.1080/07350015.2025.2572770.title_zh: 控制错误发现率与功效的贝叶斯A/B测试设计

10.1080/07350015.2025.2573151.abstract: This article captures the underlying regime switching mechanism in the prediction of stock returns via a predictive quantile regression with multiple thresholds. The predictability of each predictor is allowed to switch from one regime to another according to the value of a threshold variable and could vary across quantiles, and the predictors could possess heterogeneous degrees of persistence. Statistical learning techniques, including a sequential estimation procedure, an adaptive group Lasso refinement and a backward elimination algorithm, are adopted to estimate the unknown multiple thresholds. The adaptive Lasso is then applied to identify the important predictors in each regime to improve prediction accuracy at each quantile. Asymptotic properties of the proposed estimators are established, which are further corroborated with their nice finite sample performance revealed in simulations. The empirical analysis for the U.S. stock returns shows that the return predictability of several predictors changes with the economic states across the quantiles, demonstrating the regime-specific return predictability in quantiles.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2573151.abstract_zh: 本文通过带有多个阈值的预测分位数回归，捕捉了股票收益预测中的潜在机制转换效应。每个预测因子的预测能力可根据阈值变量的取值在不同机制间切换，并可能随分位数变化，同时预测因子可能具有异质性的持久程度。采用统计学习技术，包括序贯估计程序、自适应组套索精炼和向后消除算法，来估计未知的多重阈值。随后应用自适应套索识别各机制中的重要预测因子，以提高各分位数上的预测精度。所提估计量的渐近性质得以确立，并通过模拟研究进一步验证了其在有限样本中的优良表现。对美国股票收益的实证分析表明，若干预测因子的收益预测能力随经济状态跨分位数变化，展示了分位数上的机制特定收益可预测性。
10.1080/07350015.2025.2573151.title: Regime-Specific Return Predictability in Quantiles
10.1080/07350015.2025.2573151.title_zh: 分位数下的制度特定收益可预测性

10.1080/07350015.2025.2581341.abstract: Modeling interference effects in high-dimensional settings presents significant challenges due to the complexity of underlying dependence structures. Existing approaches often rely on explicit and homogeneous assumptions, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we introduce a novel low-rank and sparse treatment effect model that leverages high-dimensional techniques to identify interference structures without restrictive parametric assumptions. We propose an efficient profiling algorithm for estimating model coefficients and develop statistical methodologies for both global testing of interference existence and local detection of interference-affected units. Theoretical guarantees are established, including non-asymptotic error bounds for estimation and accuracy guarantees for detection based on the Jaccard index. Through numerical experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in high-dimensional settings, highlighting its advantages in capturing complex interference patterns.
10.1080/07350015.2025.2581341.abstract_zh: 在高维环境中建模干扰效应，因底层依赖结构的复杂性而面临重大挑战。现有方法往往依赖于明确且同质的假设，限制了其在现实场景中的适用性。本文提出了一种新颖的低秩稀疏处理效应模型，利用高维技术识别干扰结构，无需严格的参数假设。我们设计了一种高效的轮廓算法来估计模型系数，并开发了针对干扰存在性的全局检验及受干扰影响单元的局部检测的统计方法。理论保证得以确立，包括估计的非渐近误差界及基于Jaccard指数的检测准确性保证。通过数值实验，我们展示了该方法在高维环境中的有效性，并强调了其在捕捉复杂干扰模式方面的优势。
