10.1080/07350015.2026.2658865.abstract: To detect the global community structure of multi-layer networks, individual layers might not provide sufficient information. It is of vital importance to effectively complement the information from the network data. In this paper, under the framework of multi-layer stochastic block model, a Spectral method with Moments integration and Bias Adjustment (SpecMBA) is proposed for community detection. The key distinguishing feature of SpecMBA is the adaptive integration of both the first and second moments of adjacency matrices with a hyperparameter α∈[−1,∞), which overcomes the limitations of fixed-form aggregation. Furthermore, SpecMBA adjusts for the bias caused by noise heteroskedasticity to mitigate signal distortion. In addition, a data-driven likelihood-based approach is proposed to select the optimal α. This adaptive aggregation ensures robust and competitive performance across diverse scenarios, which has been confirmed in the numerical studies. Under mild conditions, the community detection consistency for SpecMBA is established. The application on the international food trading network reveals interesting findings.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2658865.abstract_zh: 为检测多层网络的全局社区结构，单一层可能无法提供足够的信息。有效补充网络数据中的信息至关重要。本文在多层随机块模型框架下，提出了一种结合矩积分与偏差调整的谱方法（SpecMBA），用于社区检测。SpecMBA的关键特征在于，通过超参数α∈[−1,∞)自适应整合邻接矩阵的一阶和二阶矩，克服了固定形式聚合的局限性。此外，SpecMBA调整了由噪声异方差性引起的偏差，以减轻信号失真。同时，提出了一种基于似然的数据驱动方法，用于选择最优α。这种自适应聚合确保了在不同场景下的稳健且具有竞争力的性能，这一点已在数值研究中得到证实。在温和条件下，建立了SpecMBA的社区检测一致性。在国际食品贸易网络上的应用揭示了有趣的发现。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2658865.title: Moment-Integrated Bias-Adjusted Spectral Method for Community Detection in Multi-Layer Networks
10.1080/07350015.2026.2658865.title_zh: 多层网络中社区检测的矩积分偏差校正谱方法

10.1080/07350015.2026.2661980.abstract: A continuing puzzle in constructing a point forecast by combining individual forecasts is that simple averaging often leads to a smaller out-of-sample mean square error compared to estimating optimal weights (the forecast combination puzzle). Most researchers have suggested that the puzzle is explained by estimation error in computing the weights, typically by estimation of a restricted least squares regression. For this explanation, gains from optimal weights must be small. This paper focuses on this complementary part of the argument and asks how large the gains from optimal combination can be in empirically and theoretically reasonable situations. Under these restrictions we show that gains can indeed be small, and that for gains to be large the best approach to forecast combination is to discard some of the forecasts and average over the remaining ones. We introduce a new weight estimation procedure implied by the theoretical results.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2661980.abstract_zh: 在通过组合个体预测构建点预测时，一个持续存在的谜团是，简单平均往往比估计最优权重产生更小的样本外均方误差（即预测组合之谜）。多数研究者认为，这一谜团可通过计算权重时的估计误差来解释，通常涉及受限最小二乘回归的估计。对于这一解释，最优权重带来的增益必须较小。本文聚焦于该论证的补充部分，探讨在经验上和理论上合理的情境下，最优组合的增益可能有多大。在这些限制条件下，我们证明增益确实可能很小，且要使增益显著，最佳预测组合策略是舍弃部分预测并对剩余预测取平均。我们根据理论结果提出了一种新的权重估计程序。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2661980.title: Combining Forecasts – On Why Averaging Beats Optimal Linear Weights
10.1080/07350015.2026.2661980.title_zh: 组合预测——论为何平均优于最优线性权重

10.1080/07350015.2026.2667765.abstract: Stochastic frontier models have attracted considerable attention due to the incorporation of an inefficiency term in addition to the conventional error term. In this paper, we propose a general estimation framework for panel stochastic frontier models that accommodates potential heterogeneity through latent group structures. The framework is tailored to the distinctive features of stochastic frontier models and is paired with a practical hybrid estimation procedure that combines individual-level and joint panel estimation. We illustrate the estimation framework using a panel stochastic frontier model that treats the inefficiency term as a random effect, and show that it can be readily extended to a range of fixed effects specifications common in the literature. Simulation studies indicate strong finite-sample performance, and we further demonstrate the practicality of the approach in an empirical application to the cost efficiency of the U.S. commercial banking sector.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2667765.abstract_zh: 随机前沿模型因在传统误差项之外引入无效率项而受到广泛关注。本文提出了一种适用于面板随机前沿模型的通用估计框架，该框架通过潜在群组结构来容纳异质性。此框架针对随机前沿模型的独特特征量身定制，并配以结合个体层面与联合面板估计的实用混合估计程序。我们以一个将无效率项视为随机效应的面板随机前沿模型为例说明该估计框架，并展示其可便捷地扩展至文献中常见的多种固定效应设定。模拟研究表明该方法具有较强的小样本表现，且我们进一步通过一项针对美国商业银行部门成本效率的实证应用，展示了该方法的实用性。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2667765.title: Panel Stochastic Frontier Models with Latent Group Structures
10.1080/07350015.2026.2667765.title_zh: 具有潜在分组结构的面板随机前沿模型

10.1080/07350015.2026.2668046.abstract: Heterogeneity and endogeneity become increasingly common in statistical modeling and econometric practice. Threshold regression provides a simple yet flexible modeling strategy to account for heterogeneity. This paper studies estimation and inference for multi-threshold regression with endogenous regressors. We exploit a novel two-stage estimation procedure based on instrumental variables, which first identifies a set of possible threshold locations using the group LASSO estimation, and then refines the candidate set by a predetermined selection criterion. Given that the performance of the conventional information criteria is sensitive to the choice of the penalization factor, we develop a data-adaptive threshold-based cross-validation criterion incorporating an order-preserved sample-splitting strategy to determine the number of thresholds. Regarding inference, we develop test statistics to test for the presence of threshold effects and the existence of endogeneity, respectively. Numerical simulations and an application analyzing the threshold effects of 401(k) plans on wealth demonstrate the excellent finite sample performance of our methods. Finally, we develop a user-friendly R package MultiThreshold to implement the methodologies.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2668046.abstract_zh: 异质性和内生性在统计建模与计量经济学实践中日益普遍。阈值回归提供了一种简单而灵活的建模策略来处理异质性。本文研究了具有内生回归变量的多阈值回归的估计与推断问题。我们利用一种基于工具变量的新颖两阶段估计程序，该程序首先通过组LASSO估计识别一组可能的阈值位置，然后通过预定的选择准则对候选集进行精炼。鉴于传统信息准则的性能对惩罚因子的选择较为敏感，我们开发了一种数据自适应的基于阈值的交叉验证准则，结合保序样本分割策略来确定阈值数量。在推断方面，我们分别构建了检验统计量，用于检验阈值效应的存在性以及内生性的存在性。数值模拟和一项分析401(k)计划对财富阈值效应的应用展示了我们方法在有限样本下的优异表现。最后，我们开发了一个用户友好的R包MultiThreshold来实现这些方法。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2668046.title: Estimation and Inference for Multi-Threshold Regression with Endogeneity
10.1080/07350015.2026.2668046.title_zh: 内生性多阈值回归的估计与推断

10.1080/07350015.2026.2669269.abstract: We propose a novel generalized method of moments (GMM) estimator for linear threshold regression models with a mismeasured regressor and an exogenous threshold variable. The estimator addresses a key challenge in empirical applications: identifying model parameters in the absence of valid external instruments for the mismeasured regressor. We establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the proposed estimator and develop test statistics for detecting threshold effects. Monte Carlo simulations show strong finite-sample performance, and an empirical application to firm investment equations highlights the practical relevance of the method.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2669269.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的广义矩估计（GMM）方法，用于处理带有测量误差回归变量和外生阈值变量的线性阈值回归模型。该估计器解决了实证应用中的一个关键挑战：在缺乏针对测量误差回归变量的有效外部工具时，如何识别模型参数。我们确立了所提估计量的一致性和渐近正态性，并开发了用于检测阈值效应的检验统计量。蒙特卡洛模拟显示了良好的有限样本性能，而对企业投资方程式的实证应用则凸显了该方法的实际相关性。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2669269.title: Threshold Regression with Errors-in-Variables
10.1080/07350015.2026.2669269.title_zh: 带测量误差的门槛回归

10.1080/07350015.2026.2671238.abstract: This paper introduces a regularized factor-augmented vector autoregressive (RFAVAR) model which incorporates sparsity in the factor loadings. Within this framework, the factors can load on a subset of variables, thereby enabling factor identification and enhancing their economic interpretation. The proposed RFAVAR model allows to investigate the effects of structural shocks on economically interpretable factors and on all observed time series included in the model. We prove consistency for the estimators of the factor loadings, the covariance matrix of the idiosyncratic component, the factors, and the autoregressive parameters in the dynamic model. In an empirical application, we examine the effects of a monetary policy shock on a broad range of economically relevant variables. The identification of this shock is accomplished through a joint identification of the factor model and the structural innovations in the VAR model. The obtained impulse response functions align with the established economic rationale.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2671238.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种正则化因子增强向量自回归（RFAVAR）模型，该模型在因子载荷中引入了稀疏性。在此框架下，因子可以加载于变量的子集上，从而促进因子识别并增强其经济解释性。所提出的RFAVAR模型允许研究结构性冲击对具有经济可解释性的因子以及模型中包含的所有观测时间序列的影响。我们证明了因子载荷、特质成分协方差矩阵、因子以及动态模型中的自回归参数估计量的一致性。在实证应用中，我们考察了货币政策冲击对广泛经济相关变量的影响。该冲击的识别通过因子模型与VAR模型中结构性创新的联合识别来实现。所得的脉冲响应函数与既定经济逻辑相符。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2671238.title: Sparsity-Induced Identification of Factor-Augmented VAR Models
10.1080/07350015.2026.2671238.title_zh: 稀疏性诱导的因子增强VAR模型识别

10.1080/07350015.2026.2671240.abstract: When factors are weak, covariance-based factor analysis methods tend to exhibit poor performance. To address this issue in the case of non-Gaussian data, we propose a new method called Higher-order multi-cumulant Factor Analysis (HFA). HFA estimates factors and factor loadings via the eigenvalue decomposition of the product of a higher-order multi-cumulant matrix and its transpose. We derive the asymptotic properties of HFA under a weak factor model where non-Gaussianity originates solely from the latent factors, while idiosyncratic errors remain Gaussian. Simulation studies demonstrate that HFA significantly improves both factor selection and estimation when factors are weak and non-Gaussian, compared with traditional methods. Applied to the FRED-MD dataset, HFA identifies factors that improve out-of-sample forecasting performance for the S&P 500 monthly equity premium.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2671240.abstract_zh: 当因子较弱时，基于协方差分析的因子分析方法往往表现不佳。针对非高斯数据中的这一问题，我们提出了一种新方法，称为高阶多累积量因子分析（HFA）。HFA通过高阶多累积量矩阵及其转置的特征值分解来估计因子和因子载荷。我们在弱因子模型下推导了HFA的渐近性质，其中非高斯性仅源自潜在因子，而特质误差保持高斯分布。模拟研究表明，与传统方法相比，HFA在因子较弱且非高斯的情况下显著提升了因子选择与估计的效果。应用于FRED-MD数据集时，HFA识别出的因子改善了标普500月度股权溢价的样本外预测性能。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2671240.title: Estimation of Factors Using Higher-Order Multi-Cumulants in Weak Factor Models
10.1080/07350015.2026.2671240.title_zh: 弱因子模型中基于高阶多重累积量的因子估计

10.1080/07350015.2026.2671452.abstract: This paper proposes a covariate-driven matrix factor model in which the row and column loading matrices evolve as nonparametric functions of an observable time-varying covariate sequence. This flexible specification accommodates dynamic factor loadings driven by the temporal characteristics of the covariate. We develop a nonparametric estimation procedure that combines kernel smoothing with principal component analysis (PCA). Under high-dimensional asymptotics, we establish convergence rates for the estimators of the latent factor, dynamic loading matrices, and common component. Furthermore, we propose a formal bootstrap-based hypothesis test for the null hypothesis of constant loadings and a post-estimation smoothing procedure to resolve rotational ambiguity. Monte Carlo simulations and empirical applications to international trade flows and portfolio returns demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed method relative to conventional constant-loading matrix factor models, particularly in settings with complex, covariate-driven structural variation.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2671452.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种协变量驱动的矩阵因子模型，其中行和列的载荷矩阵作为可观测时变协变量序列的非参数函数而演化。这种灵活的设定能够适应由协变量的时间特征驱动的动态因子载荷。我们开发了一种结合核平滑与主成分分析（PCA）的非参数估计方法。在高维渐近框架下，我们建立了潜在因子、动态载荷矩阵及共同成分估计量的收敛速率。此外，我们提出了一种基于自助法的正式假设检验，用于检验载荷恒定的原假设，并引入了一种估计后平滑程序以解决旋转模糊性问题。蒙特卡洛模拟以及对国际贸易流量和投资组合收益的实证应用表明，相较于传统恒定载荷矩阵因子模型，所提方法在具有复杂、协变量驱动的结构变化情境中表现出更优的性能。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2671452.title: Dynamic Matrix Factor Models: A Covariate-Driven Approach to Varying Factor Loadings
10.1080/07350015.2026.2671452.title_zh: 动态矩阵因子模型：协变量驱动的时变因子载荷方法

10.1080/07350015.2026.2674157.abstract: Factor-augmented vector autoregressive (FAVAR) models serve as a powerful tool for forecasting economic and financial variables, particularly in environments with a large number of predictors. In this study, we propose a time-varying model-averaging method for FAVAR (TVMA-FAVAR) that accommodates smooth structural changes. To estimate the optimal time-varying combination weights, we develop a local leave-one-out cross-validation (LLOCV) criterion that is asymptotically unbiased for the local mean squared error (LMSE), as it excludes a term irrelevant to the weight vector. We establish the asymptotic optimality of the TVMA-FAVAR method by demonstrating that its LMSE attains an infeasible lower bound. In addition, we derive the convergence rates of the selected weights and the TVMA-FAVAR estimator. Monte Carlo simulations show that the proposed method outperforms existing popular model averaging and selection approaches. An empirical application to forecasting U.S. macroeconomic variables further illustrates the superior predictive performance of the TVMA-FAVAR method.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2674157.abstract_zh: 因子增强向量自回归（FAVAR）模型在预测经济和金融变量方面是一种强有力的工具，尤其是在预测变量众多的情况下。在本研究中，我们提出了一种适用于FAVAR的时变模型平均方法（TVMA-FAVAR），该方法能够适应平滑的结构变化。为了估计最优的时变组合权重，我们开发了一种局部留一交叉验证（LLOCV）准则，该准则对于局部均方误差（LMSE）是渐近无偏的，因为它排除了与权重向量无关的一项。我们通过证明TVMA-FAVAR方法的LMSE达到一个不可行的下界，确立了其渐近最优性。此外，我们推导了所选权重和TVMA-FAVAR估计量的收敛速率。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的方法优于现有的流行模型平均和选择方法。一项针对美国宏观经济变量预测的实证应用进一步展示了TVMA-FAVAR方法的优越预测性能。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2674157.title: Time-Varying Model Averaging for FAVAR Models with Smooth Structural Changes
10.1080/07350015.2026.2674157.title_zh: FAVAR模型中含平滑结构变化的时变模型平均

10.1080/07350015.2026.2674742.abstract: We propose methods to improve the forecasts from generalized autoregressive score (GAS) models (Creal, et al., 2013; Harvey, 2013) by localizing their parameters using decision trees and random forests. These methods avoid the curse of dimensionality faced by kernel-based approaches, and allow one to draw on information from multiple state variables simultaneously. We apply the new models to four distinct empirical analyses, and in all applications the proposed new methods significantly outperform the baseline GAS model. In our applications to stock return volatility and density prediction, the optimal GAS tree model reveals a leverage effect and a variance risk premium effect. Our study of stock-bond dependence finds evidence of a flight-to-quality effect in the optimal GAS forest forecasts, while our analysis of high-frequency trade durations uncovers a volume-volatility effect.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2674742.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一些方法，通过决策树和随机森林对广义自回归得分（GAS）模型（Creal等，2013；Harvey，2013）的参数进行局部化处理，以改进其预测。这些方法避免了基于核方法所面临的维度灾难问题，并允许同时利用多个状态变量的信息。我们将新模型应用于四项不同的实证分析中，在所有应用中，所提出的新方法均显著优于基准GAS模型。在股票收益波动率和密度预测的应用中，最优GAS树模型揭示了杠杆效应和方差风险溢价效应。我们对股票-债券依赖性的研究发现，最优GAS森林预测中存在避险效应，而对高频交易持续时间的分析则揭示了成交量-波动率效应。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2674742.title: Generalized Autoregressive Score Trees and Forests
10.1080/07350015.2026.2674742.title_zh: 广义自回归得分树与森林

10.1080/07350015.2026.2675481.abstract: By treating intervals as inseparable sets, this paper proposes sparse machine learning regressions for high-dimensional interval-valued time series. With LASSO or adaptive LASSO techniques, we develop a penalized minimum distance estimation method, which covers point-based estimators are special cases. We establish the consistency and oracle properties of the proposed penalized estimator, regardless of whether the number of predictors grows slower or faster than the sample size. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the favorable finite sample properties of the proposed estimator. Empirical applications to interval-valued crude oil price forecasting and sparse index-tracking portfolio construction illustrate the robustness and effectiveness of our method against competing approaches, including random forests and multilayer perceptrons for interval-valued data. Our findings highlight the potential of regularized techniques in interval-valued time series analysis, offering new insights for financial forecasting and portfolio management.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2675481.abstract_zh: 本文将区间视为不可分割的集合，针对高维区间值时间序列提出了稀疏机器学习回归方法。利用LASSO或自适应LASSO技术，我们开发了一种惩罚最小距离估计方法，该方法将基于点的估计器作为特例涵盖其中。我们建立了所提惩罚估计量的一致性和oracle性质，无论预测变量数量相对于样本量增长较慢还是较快。蒙特卡洛模拟展示了所提估计量良好的有限样本性质。对区间值原油价格预测和稀疏指数追踪投资组合构建的实证应用，说明了我们的方法相对于竞争方法（包括针对区间值数据的随机森林和多层感知器）的稳健性和有效性。我们的研究结果凸显了正则化技术在区间值时间序列分析中的潜力，为金融预测和投资组合管理提供了新的见解。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2675481.title: Regularized Interval-Valued Time Series Modeling
10.1080/07350015.2026.2675481.title_zh: 正则化区间值时间序列建模

10.1080/07350015.2026.2676673.abstract: The Gini index is a widely reported measure of income inequality. Because the underlying microdata are often confidential, releasing the Gini index may leak information. We present an approach for bounding this information leakage by releasing a differentially private version of the Gini index. In doing so, we analyze how adding, deleting, or altering a single observation in any specific dataset can affect the computation of the Gini index; this is known as the local sensitivity. We then derive a smooth upper bound on the local sensitivity. Using this bound, we define a mechanism that adds noise to the Gini index, thereby satisfying differential privacy. Using simulated and genuine income data, we show that the mechanism can reduce the errors from noise injection substantially relative to differentially private algorithms that rely on the global sensitivity, that is, the maximum of the local sensitivities over all possible datasets. We characterize settings where using smooth sensitivity can provide highly accurate estimates, as well as settings where the noise variance is simply too large to provide reliably useful results. We also present a post-processing step that provides interval estimates about the value of the Gini index computed with the confidential data.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2676673.abstract_zh: 基尼指数是衡量收入不平等的一个广泛报道的指标。由于底层微观数据往往具有保密性，发布基尼指数可能会泄露信息。我们提出了一种方法，通过发布基尼指数的差分隐私版本来限制这种信息泄露。在此过程中，我们分析了在任意特定数据集中添加、删除或修改单个观测值如何影响基尼指数的计算；这被称为局部敏感性。随后，我们推导出局部敏感性的平滑上界。利用这一上界，我们定义了一种向基尼指数添加噪声的机制，从而满足差分隐私要求。通过模拟数据和真实收入数据，我们展示了该机制相对于依赖全局敏感性（即所有可能数据集上局部敏感性的最大值）的差分隐私算法，能够显著减少噪声注入带来的误差。我们刻画了使用平滑敏感性能够提供高精度估计的场景，以及噪声方差过大以至于无法提供可靠有用结果的场景。我们还提出了一种后处理步骤，用于提供关于基于保密数据计算的基尼指数值的区间估计。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2676673.title: Differentially Private Computation of the Gini Index for Income Inequality
10.1080/07350015.2026.2676673.title_zh: 收入不平等的基尼系数的差分隐私计算

10.1080/07350015.2026.2680059.abstract: A common practice in evidence-based decision-making uses estimates of conditional probabilities P(y|x) obtained from research studies to predict outcomes y based on observed covariates x. Given this information, decisions are then based on the predicted outcomes. Researchers commonly assume that the predictors used in the generation of the evidence are the same as those used in applying the evidence: i.e., the meaning of x in the two circumstances is the same. This may not be the case in real-world settings. Across a wide range of settings, ranging from clinical practice to education policy, demographic attributes (e.g., age, race, ethnicity) are often classified differently in research studies than in decision settings. This paper studies identification in such settings. We propose a formal framework for prediction with what we term differential covariate classification (DCC). Using this framework, we analyze partial identification of probabilistic predictions and assess how various assumptions influence the identification regions. We apply the findings to a range of settings, focusing mainly on differential classification of individuals' race and ethnicity in clinical medicine. We find that bounds on P(y|x) can be wide, and the information needed to narrow them is available only in special cases. These findings highlight an important problem in using evidence in decision making, a problem that has not yet been fully appreciated in debates on classification in public policy and medicine.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2680059.abstract_zh: 循证决策中的常见做法是利用研究获得的条件概率估计值P(y|x)，基于观测到的协变量x来预测结果y。基于这些信息，决策随后依据预测结果制定。研究者通常假设用于生成证据的预测变量与应用证据时所用的预测变量相同：即，两种情境下x的含义一致。然而，在现实环境中情况未必如此。在从临床实践到教育政策的广泛情境中，人口统计学属性（如年龄、种族、民族）在研究中的分类方式往往与决策环境中的分类方式不同。本文研究此类情境下的识别问题。我们提出了一个形式化框架，用于处理我们称之为差异协变量分类（DCC）的预测问题。利用该框架，我们分析了概率预测的部分识别，并评估了各种假设如何影响识别区域。我们将研究结果应用于多种情境，主要聚焦于临床医学中个体种族和民族的差异分类。我们发现，P(y|x)的界限可能很宽，而缩小这些界限所需的信息仅在特殊情况下可得。这些发现凸显了在决策中运用证据时的一个重要问题，这一问题在公共政策和医学分类的讨论中尚未得到充分认识。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2680059.title: Prediction with Differential Covariate Classification: Illustrated by Covariate Classification in Medical Risk Assessment
10.1080/07350015.2026.2680059.title_zh: 基于差分协变量分类的预测：以医学风险评估中的协变量分类为例

10.1080/07350015.2026.2681740.abstract: High-dimensional time series are very common in reality. Analyzing each series separately may not be a good strategy, as it may miss some important information and result in a less optimal outcome. Even worse, in some cases, it may not even provide an answer to the question of interest. Reduced-rank model is an important tool for joint analysis of high-dimensional multiple-response time series. In this paper, we develop a new and powerful method for estimating the coefficient matrix of a multiple-response reduced-rank time series model based on factor models. With the help of the estimated factors, we also propose two statistics for testing the dependence of high-dimensional time series. Asymptotic results for the proposed estimators and tests are established. Intensive simulation studies show that the proposed procedure is more powerful than its alternatives. We also apply the proposed method to a real dataset to illustrate its usefulness in solving real-life problems.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2681740.abstract_zh: 高维时间序列在现实中非常普遍。单独分析每个序列可能并非良策，因为这可能会遗漏一些重要信息，导致结果不够优化。更糟的是，在某些情况下，甚至可能无法回答所关注的问题。降秩模型是对高维多响应时间序列进行联合分析的重要工具。本文基于因子模型，开发了一种新的且有效的方法来估计多响应降秩时间序列模型的系数矩阵。借助估计出的因子，我们还提出了两种统计量，用于检验高维时间序列的依赖性。针对所提出的估计量和检验，我们建立了渐近结果。大量模拟研究表明，所提出的方法比其替代方法更具效力。我们还将所提方法应用于一个真实数据集，以展示其在解决实际问题中的实用性。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2681740.title: Factor Model Based Estimation for High Dimensional Reduced-Rank Time Series
10.1080/07350015.2026.2681740.title_zh: 基于因子模型的高维降秩时间序列估计

10.1080/07350015.2026.2682538.abstract: We develop new econometric methods for the comparison of nonparametric time trends. In many applications, practitioners are interested in examining the trending behaviour of multiple time series. Among other things, they would like to know which time series have different trends and in which time intervals the differences occur. We design a multiscale test to formally approach these questions. Specifically, we develop a test which allows to make rigorous confidence statements about which time trends are different and where (i.e., in which time intervals) they differ. Based on our multiscale test, we further develop a clustering algorithm which allows to cluster the observed time series into groups with the same trending behaviour. We derive asymptotic theory for our test and clustering methods. The theory is complemented by a simulation study and two applications to house pricing and GDP growth data.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2682538.abstract_zh: 我们开发了新的计量经济学方法，用于比较非参数时间趋势。在许多应用中，实践者关注于检验多个时间序列的趋势行为。除其他事项外，他们希望了解哪些时间序列具有不同的趋势，以及差异发生在哪些时间区间。我们设计了一个多尺度检验来正式处理这些问题。具体而言，我们开发了一种检验方法，能够对哪些时间趋势不同以及它们在何处（即哪些时间区间）存在差异做出严格的置信陈述。基于我们的多尺度检验，我们进一步开发了一种聚类算法，该算法能够将观测到的时间序列聚类为具有相同趋势行为的组。我们为我们的检验和聚类方法推导了渐近理论。该理论辅以模拟研究以及两个应用案例，分别涉及房价和GDP增长数据。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2682538.title: Multiscale Comparison of Nonparametric Trend Curves
10.1080/07350015.2026.2682538.title_zh: 非参数趋势曲线的多尺度比较

10.1080/07350015.2026.2682541.abstract: Matrix-valued time-series data have become increasingly prevalent across diverse fields, including economics, finance, computer science, engineering, and signal processing. However, mixed matrix-vector structures in real-world data present challenges for existing methods. To fill in this gap, we propose a multi-matrix autoregressive (MMAR) model designed to jointly model matrix time series with varying structures. The key idea is to treat matrices as elements and to model their contemporaneous and intertemporal relationships within a simultaneous equation system. In particular, the matrix-valued autoregressive model and the three-order tensor autoregressive model are special cases of the proposed model. We present three distinct estimation methods for the MMAR model, investigate their statistical properties, and provide numerical simulations to corroborate them. Furthermore, we integrate the MMAR model with connectedness network analysis, proposing a multi-modal connectedness framework to estimate the interconnectedness between the rows and columns of matrices. Finally, we provide an empirical application to concurrently model the macroeconomic matrix time series of China’s 31 provinces and a vector time series comprising the economic policy uncertainty, trade policy uncertainty, and geopolitical risk. The findings of the empirical study provide valuable insights for further research and policymaking in the relevant domains.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2682541.abstract_zh: 矩阵值时间序列数据在经济学、金融学、计算机科学、工程学及信号处理等多个领域日益普遍。然而，现实世界数据中混合矩阵-向量结构对现有方法提出了挑战。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种多矩阵自回归（MMAR）模型，旨在联合建模具有不同结构的矩阵时间序列。其核心思想是将矩阵视为元素，并在联立方程系统中建模其同期及跨期关系。特别地，矩阵值自回归模型和三阶张量自回归模型是所提模型的特例。我们为MMAR模型提出了三种不同的估计方法，研究了它们的统计性质，并通过数值模拟加以验证。此外，我们将MMAR模型与连通性网络分析相结合，提出了一种多模态连通性框架，用于估计矩阵行与列之间的相互关联性。最后，我们提供了一个实证应用，同时建模中国31个省份的宏观经济矩阵时间序列以及包含经济政策不确定性、贸易政策不确定性和地缘政治风险的向量时间序列。实证研究结果为相关领域的进一步研究和政策制定提供了有价值的见解。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2682541.title: Multi-Matrix Autoregressive Models with an Application to Multi-Modal Network
10.1080/07350015.2026.2682541.title_zh: 多矩阵自回归模型及其在多模态网络中的应用

10.1080/07350015.2026.2683047.abstract: In the case of panel data with staggered interventions, we propose a simple time-series transformation that can be combined with various treatment effect estimators. The transformation is at the unit level, and simply requires computing the average outcome prior to an intervention, subtracting it from a post-treatment outcome, and then carefully selecting the control units in each time period. We show that under no anticipation and parallel trends assumptions, the cohort treatment indicators satisfy the key unconfoundedness assumption with respect to the transformed potential outcome. Given identification, any number of treatment effect estimators, including matching estimators, can be applied for each treated cohort and calendar time pair where the average treatment effects on the treated are identified. The doubly robust method of combining inverse probability weighting with linear regression adjustment works particularly well in terms of bias and efficiency. Importantly, our transformation is easily modified to account for unit-specific trends, allowing relaxation of the parallel trends assumption even after conditioning on covariates.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2683047.abstract_zh: 在交错干预的面板数据情形下，我们提出了一种简单的时间序列变换，可与多种处理效应估计量结合使用。该变换在单位层面进行，仅需计算干预前的平均结果，从干预后的结果中减去该平均值，并在每个时间段仔细选择对照组单位。我们证明，在无预期效应和平行趋势假设下，队列处理指标相对于变换后的潜在结果满足关键的无混淆性假设。在识别成立的前提下，任何数量的处理效应估计量，包括匹配估计量，均可应用于每个处理队列与日历时间配对，其中处理组的平均处理效应可被识别。将逆概率加权与线性回归调整相结合的双稳健方法在偏差和效率方面表现尤为出色。重要的是，我们的变换易于调整以考虑单位特定趋势，从而即使在协变量条件下也能放宽平行趋势假设。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2683047.title: A Simple Transformation Approach to Difference-in-Differences Estimation for Panel Data
10.1080/07350015.2026.2683047.title_zh: 面板数据双重差分估计的一种简单变换方法

10.1080/07350015.2026.2683048.abstract: This paper proposes a geometric model averaging (GMA) method in the framework of general likelihood estimation. Instead of using the classical weighted arithmetic mean, we consider a weighted geometric mean of the conditional probability density functions estimated from different candidate models, allowing both parameter uncertainty and model misspecification. The optimal weight is the minimizer of the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of the true density to the weighted density. The geometric form of the weighted density makes it possible to find an approximately unbiased estimator of the KL divergence, and hence the optimal weight can be estimated consequently. Also, the geometric mean is naturally more applicable to density tail estimation than arithmetic mean due to its special form. The proposed GMA method provides a unified framework for a wide range of problems and is connected to many existing model averaging methods. When all the candidate models are misspecified, the weight of GMA is asymptotically optimal in the sense of achieving the lowest possible KL divergence. When correct candidate models are included, estimation consistency is established. Results of a comprehensive simulation study and two real data analyses show favorable performance of GMA relative to alternative model selection and model averaging methods.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2683048.abstract_zh: 本文在一般似然估计框架下提出了一种几何模型平均（GMA）方法。与传统的加权算术平均不同，我们考虑对不同候选模型估计的条件概率密度函数进行加权几何平均，从而同时纳入参数不确定性和模型误设。最优权重是使真实密度与加权密度之间的Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度最小化的权重。加权密度的几何形式使得能够找到KL散度的近似无偏估计量，进而可估计最优权重。此外，由于其特殊形式，几何平均在密度尾部估计方面天然比算术平均更具适用性。所提出的GMA方法为广泛的问题提供了统一框架，并与许多现有的模型平均方法相关联。当所有候选模型均被误设时，GMA的权重在实现尽可能低的KL散度意义上渐近最优。当包含正确候选模型时，则建立了估计一致性。综合模拟研究和两项实际数据分析的结果表明，GMA相对于替代的模型选择与模型平均方法具有优越性能。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2683048.title: Geometric Model Averaging

10.1080/07350015.2026.2691740.abstract: This paper develops a data-driven inference procedure for extreme analysis of data with near epoch dependence (NED), a condition less restrictive than traditional dependence structures like α-mixing, making it particularly useful for analyzing heavy-tailed time series data. To capture nonlinear data structures, we propose a new framework that combines local linear quantile regression with extreme value theory. We first study the asymptotic properties of the local-linear intermediate conditional quantile (IQR) estimators under NED by establishing the Bahadur representation. While we show the IQR estimator exhibits the desired asymptotic normality for NED data, it is unstable and inaccurate for estimation at extreme quantile levels. Therefore, we develop an enhanced Hill method to estimate the nonlinear extreme value index (EVI) and, consequently, the extreme conditional quantiles (ECQ) based on the tail properties and extrapolation. We show that the proposed EVI and ECQ estimators have the same asymptotic bias. We further develop a bias correction approach to refine these estimators. We thoroughly study the properties of the proposed EVI and ECQ estimators under NED, and their bias-corrected counterparts. Simulation studies and real data analyses demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed methods.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2691740.abstract_zh: 本文开发了一种数据驱动的推断程序，用于分析具有近邻依赖（NED）数据的极端值，这一条件比传统依赖结构如α-混合更为宽松，特别适用于分析重尾时间序列数据。为捕捉非线性数据结构，我们提出了一种结合局部线性分位数回归与极值理论的新框架。我们首先通过建立Bahadur表示，研究了在NED条件下局部线性中间条件分位数（IQR）估计量的渐近性质。虽然我们证明了IQR估计量在NED数据下展现出理想的渐近正态性，但在极端分位数水平下其估计不稳定且不准确。因此，我们开发了一种增强的Hill方法来估计非线性极值指数（EVI），并进而基于尾部性质和 extrapolation 估计极端条件分位数（ECQ）。我们证明了所提出的EVI和ECQ估计量具有相同的渐近偏差。我们进一步开发了一种偏差校正方法来优化这些估计量。我们深入研究了在NED条件下所提出的EVI和ECQ估计量及其偏差校正版本的性质。模拟研究和实际数据分析证明了所提出方法的有效性和适用性。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2691740.title: Extremal Local Linear Quantile Regression for Heavy-Tailed Time Series with near Epoch Dependence
10.1080/07350015.2026.2691740.title_zh: 重尾时间序列近端依赖下极值局部线性分位数回归

10.1080/07350015.2026.2695448.abstract: This paper introduces the Subseries-based Cauchy Combination Test (SCT), a novel procedure for testing encompassing relationships or model validity using identification conditions formulated as multiple moment restrictions. SCT applies to weakly or short-range-dependent data and eliminates the need to estimate high-dimensional covariance matrices. Unlike Wald- or J-type tests, it remains reliable in both low- and high-dimensional settings. The test is asymptotically unbiased and near-minimax-rate optimal, with asymptotic power no less than that of an oracle max-type test under alternatives in which the selected model fails to encompass the valid model. SCT accommodates redundancy, progression, and nonlinearity testing in rank-deficient systems. As an empirical illustration, we apply SCT to the U.S. factor zoo and show how a handful of factors effectively span the country-level factors over the period 1964–2022.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2695448.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的子序列柯西组合检验（SCT），该程序用于检验包含关系或模型有效性，其识别条件以多重矩约束形式设定。SCT适用于弱依赖或短程依赖数据，并无需估计高维协方差矩阵。与Wald型或J型检验不同，SCT在低维和高维设置下均保持可靠性。该检验渐近无偏且接近极小极大速率最优，在所选模型未能包含有效模型的备择假设下，其渐近功效不低于预言机最大型检验。SCT支持秩亏系统中的冗余性、递进性和非线性检验。作为实证示例，我们将SCT应用于美国因子动物园，并展示了在1964年至2022年间，少数几个因子如何有效覆盖国家层面因子。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2695448.title: Encompassing and Progression Testing in High-Dimensions
10.1080/07350015.2026.2695448.title_zh: 高维中的涵盖性与渐进性检验

10.1080/07350015.2026.2695989.abstract: In this paper, we study the asymptotic bias of the factor-augmented regression estimator and its reduction, which is augmented by the $r$ factors extracted from a large number of $N$ variables with $T$ observations. In particular, we consider general weak latent factor models with $r$ signal eigenvalues that may diverge at different rates, $N^{\alpha _{k}}$, $0<\alpha _{k}\leq 1$, $k=1,\dots,r$. In the existing literature, the bias has been derived using an approximation for the estimated factors with a specific data-dependent rotation matrix $\hat{H}$ for the model with $\alpha_{k}=1$ for all $k$, whereas we derive the bias for weak factor models. In addition, we derive the bias using the approximation with a different rotation matrix $\hat{H}_q$, which generally has a smaller bias than with $\hat{H}$. We also derive the bias using our preferred approximation with a purely signal-dependent rotation $H$, which is unique and can be regarded as the population version of $\hat{H}$ and $\hat{H}_q$. Since this bias is parametrically inestimable, we propose a split-panel jackknife bias correction, and theory shows that it successfully reduces the bias. The extensive finite-sample experiments suggest that the proposed bias correction works very well, and the empirical application illustrates its usefulness in practice.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2695989.abstract_zh: 本文研究了因子增强回归估计量的渐近偏差及其缩减方法，该估计量通过从包含T个观测值的N个变量中提取的r个因子进行增强。特别地，我们考虑了具有r个信号特征值的通用弱潜在因子模型，这些特征值可能以不同速率发散，即$N^{\alpha _{k}}$，其中$0<\alpha _{k}\leq 1$，$k=1,\dots,r$。在现有文献中，偏差是通过使用特定数据依赖的旋转矩阵$\hat{H}$对估计因子进行近似推导得出的，该模型假设所有$k$的$\alpha_{k}=1$，而我们则针对弱因子模型推导了偏差。此外，我们使用不同的旋转矩阵$\hat{H}_q$进行近似来推导偏差，该矩阵通常比$\hat{H}$产生的偏差更小。我们还使用我们偏好的近似方法，即纯信号依赖的旋转$H$来推导偏差，该旋转是唯一的，可视为$\hat{H}$和$\hat{H}_q$的总体版本。由于该偏差在参数上不可估计，我们提出了一种分割面板刀切法偏差校正方法，理论表明该方法能有效减少偏差。广泛的有限样本实验表明，所提出的偏差校正方法效果良好，实证应用也展示了其在实际中的有用性。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2695989.title: Bias Correction in Factor-Augmented Regression Models with Weak Factors
10.1080/07350015.2026.2695989.title_zh: 弱因子情形下因子增强回归模型的偏差修正

10.1080/07350015.2026.2696490.title: Modeling and Forecasting Realized Volatility with Multivariate Fractional Brownian Motion
10.1080/07350015.2026.2696490.title_zh: 基于多元分数布朗运动的已实现波动率建模与预测

10.1080/07350015.2026.2696492.title: Self-Normalized Tests for Skewness, Kurtosis, and Normality for Time Series Data
10.1080/07350015.2026.2696492.title_zh: 时间序列数据偏度、峰度及正态性的自标准化检验

10.1080/07350015.2026.2703238.abstract: This paper proposes a vector autoregression augmented with nonlinear factors that are modeled nonparametrically using regression trees. There are four main advantages of our model. First, modeling potential nonlinearities nonparametrically lessens the risk of misspecification. Second, the use of factor methods ensures that departures from linearity are modeled parsimoniously. In particular, they exhibit functional pooling where a small number of nonlinear factors are used to model common nonlinearities across variables. Third, Bayesian computation using MCMC is straightforward even in very high-dimensional models, allowing for efficient, equation-by-equation estimation, thus avoiding computational bottlenecks that arise in popular alternatives such as the time-varying parameter VAR. Fourth, existing methods for identifying structural economic shocks in linear factor models can be adapted for the nonlinear case in a straightforward fashion using our model. Exercises involving artificial and macroeconomic data illustrate the properties of our model and its usefulness for forecasting and structural economic analysis.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2703238.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种向量自回归模型，该模型通过回归树非参数化地引入了非线性因子。我们的模型有四大优势。第一，非参数化地建模潜在的非线性关系降低了模型设定错误的风险。第二，采用因子方法确保了非线性偏离被简约地建模。特别是，它们展现出功能汇集特性，即用少量非线性因子来刻画变量间共有的非线性特征。第三，即使在极高维模型中，利用MCMC的贝叶斯计算方法也直接可行，允许逐方程高效估计，从而避免了如时变参数VAR等流行替代方法中出现的计算瓶颈。第四，现有的线性因子模型中识别结构性经济冲击的方法，可以借助我们的模型直接适用于非线性情形。基于人工数据与宏观经济数据的实证分析展示了我们模型的性质及其在预测和结构性经济分析中的实用性。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2703238.title: A Flexible Approach to Augmenting a Bayesian VAR with Nonlinear Factors *
10.1080/07350015.2026.2703238.title_zh: 一种增强贝叶斯向量自回归模型非线性因子的灵活方法

10.1080/07350015.2026.2703863.abstract: In this paper, we propose a model-free feature screening framework tailored for high-dimensional and heterogeneous datasets, based on a novel distributionally robust dependence measure termed Copula Divergence. The proposed screening method, named CD-Screen, addresses critical limitations of existing feature screening methods, such as restrictive modeling assumptions and sensitivity to heterogeneous feature distributions. CD-Screen ranks features according to their Copula Divergence without relying on a specific regression model or distributional assumptions. Additionally, we introduce CD-FDR, a data-driven procedure to control false discoveries, ensuring accurate and efficient feature selection. Theoretical analyses establish the sure screening and rank consistency properties of CD-Screen, along with asymptotic control of the false discovery rate by CD-FDR. Extensive simulation studies demonstrate the superior performance of our methods compared to traditional screening approaches across diverse scenarios. Furthermore, a real data analysis of the relationship between stock returns and inflation in the United States illustrates the practical use of our method and provides descriptive evidence on sector-specific responses to economic changes.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2703863.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种针对高维异质性数据集的无模型特征筛选框架，基于一种新颖的分布鲁棒性依赖度量——Copula散度。所提出的筛选方法名为CD-Screen，解决了现有特征筛选方法的关键局限性，如限制性建模假设和对异质性特征分布的敏感性。CD-Screen根据特征的Copula散度进行排序，无需依赖特定的回归模型或分布假设。此外，我们引入了CD-FDR，一种数据驱动的程序，用于控制错误发现率，确保特征选择的准确性和高效性。理论分析确立了CD-Screen的确定筛选和秩一致性性质，以及CD-FDR对错误发现率的渐近控制。广泛的模拟研究表明，在各种场景下，我们的方法相比传统筛选方法具有优越性能。此外，对美国股票收益与通货膨胀关系的实际数据分析展示了我们方法的实际应用，并提供了关于经济变化对部门特定响应的描述性证据。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2703863.title: Model-free and Distributionally Robust Feature Screening with False Discovery Control for High-Dimensional Heterogeneous Data
10.1080/07350015.2026.2703863.title_zh: 高维异质性数据的无模型与分布鲁棒特征筛选及错误发现控制

10.1080/07350015.2026.2704969.title: Post-Lasso Inference for Multiple Threshold Regressions with an Application to Return Predictability
10.1080/07350015.2026.2704969.title_zh: 多阈值回归的Post-Lasso推断及其在收益可预测性中的应用

10.1080/07350015.2026.2705382.abstract: This paper investigates the estimation of the double autoregressive (DAR) model in the presence of skewed and heavy-tailed innovations. We propose a novel Normal Mixture Quasi-Maximum Likelihood Estimation (NM-QMLE) method to address the limitations of conventional quasi-maximum likelihood estimation (QMLE) under non-Gaussian conditions. By incorporating a normal mixture distribution into the quasi-likelihood framework, NM-QMLE effectively captures both heavy-tailed behavior and skewness. A critical contribution of this paper is addressing the often-overlooked challenge of selecting the appropriate number of mixture components, $K$, a key parameter that significantly impacts model performance. We systematically evaluate the effectiveness of different model selection criteria. Under regularity conditions, we establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the NM-QMLE estimator for DAR($p$) models. Numerical simulations demonstrate that NM-QMLE outperforms commonly adopted QMLE methods in terms of estimation accuracy, particularly when the innovation distribution deviates from normality. Our results also show that while criteria like BIC and ICL improve parameter estimation of $K$, fixing a small order of components provides comparable accuracy. To further validate its practical applicability, we apply NM-QMLE to empirical data from the S\&P 500 index and assess its performance through Value at Risk (VaR) estimation. The empirical findings highlight the effectiveness of NM-QMLE in modeling real-world financial data and improving risk assessment. By providing a robust and flexible estimation approach, NM-QMLE enhances the analysis of time series models with complex innovation structures, making it a valuable tool in econometrics and financial modeling.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2705382.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在存在偏态和重尾创新情形下双自回归（DAR）模型的估计问题。我们提出了一种新颖的正态混合拟极大似然估计（NM-QMLE）方法，以解决传统拟极大似然估计（QMLE）在非高斯条件下的局限性。通过将正态混合分布纳入拟似然框架，NM-QMLE有效捕捉了重尾行为和偏态特性。本文的一个关键贡献在于处理了常被忽视的混合成分数量\(K\)的选择难题，这一关键参数对模型性能有显著影响。我们系统评估了不同模型选择标准的有效性。在正则条件下，我们确立了NM-QMLE估计量对于DAR(\(p\))模型的一致性和渐近正态性。数值模拟表明，当创新分布偏离正态时，NM-QMLE在估计精度上优于常用的QMLE方法。我们的结果还显示，尽管BIC和ICL等准则能改善参数\(K\)的估计，但固定较小阶数的成分也能提供相当的精度。为进一步验证其实用性，我们将NM-QMLE应用于标普500指数的实证数据，并通过风险价值（VaR）估计评估其性能。实证结果凸显了NM-QMLE在建模真实金融数据和改进风险评估方面的有效性。通过提供一种稳健且灵活的估计方法，NM-QMLE增强了对具有复杂创新结构的时间序列模型的分析，使其成为计量经济学和金融建模中的宝贵工具。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2705382.title: Robust Estimation of Double Autoregressive Models via Normal Mixture QMLE*
10.1080/07350015.2026.2705382.title_zh: 基于正态混合QMLE的双自回归模型稳健估计

10.1080/07350015.2026.2707220.abstract: The Mixed Data Sampling (MIDAS) approach provides a flexible framework for incorporating mixed-frequency data into econometric models. In this paper, we introduce the MIDAS framework into a panel data model and derive the asymptotic properties of the NLS estimator under a joint asymptotic framework where both N and T tend to infinity, allowing for heteroskedasticity and arbitrary correlation within each individual. To facilitate valid inference, we construct robust heteroskedasticity- and autocorrelation-consistent (HAC) covariance estimators. We also analyze the asymptotic bias and variance of the LS estimator based on pre-specified aggregation weights. In addition, we propose a Wald test for the null hypothesis of equal weights and a supremum-type Wald test to address the unidentified nuisance parameter problem. The theoretical results are evaluated via an extensive Monte Carlo simulation study and an empirical application.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2707220.abstract_zh: 混合数据抽样（MIDAS）方法为将混合频率数据纳入计量经济模型提供了一个灵活的框架。本文将该MIDAS框架引入面板数据模型，并在联合渐近框架下（其中N和T均趋于无穷大）推导了非线性最小二乘（NLS）估计量的渐近性质，该框架允许异方差性及个体内部的任意相关性。为便于有效推断，我们构建了稳健的异方差性和自相关一致性（HAC）协方差估计量。我们还分析了基于预设聚合权重的LS估计量的渐近偏差和方差。此外，我们提出了一个用于检验等权重原假设的Wald检验，以及一个上确界型Wald检验，以解决未识别冗余参数问题。理论结果通过广泛的蒙特卡洛模拟研究和实证应用进行了评估。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2707220.title: Asymptotic Distributions of Nonlinear Least Squares Estimators for Panel-MIDAS Models
10.1080/07350015.2026.2707220.title_zh: 面板-MIDAS模型非线性最小二乘估计量的渐近分布

10.1080/07350015.2026.2709681.abstract: We show that, for a certain class of scaling matrices including the inverse square-root of the conditional Fisher information, score-driven factor models are identifiable up to a multiplicative scalar constant under very mild restrictions. This result has no analogue in parameter-driven models, as it exploits the different structure of the score-driven factor dynamics. Consequently, score-driven factor models overcome the issue of rotational invariance that typically affects dynamic factor models, thereby enhancing the economic and financial interpretability of the estimated factors. Our restrictions are order-invariant and can be generalized to score-driven factor models with dynamic loadings and nonlinear factor models. We test extensively the identification strategy using simulated and real data. The empirical analysis on financial and macroeconomic data reveals a substantial increase of log-likelihood ratios and significantly improved out-of-sample forecast performance when switching from the classical restrictions adopted in the literature to our more flexible specifications.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2709681.abstract_zh: 我们证明，对于包括条件Fisher信息逆平方根在内的某类缩放矩阵，得分驱动因子模型在非常宽松的限制下可识别至多一个乘性标量常数。这一结果在参数驱动模型中并无对应，因为它利用了得分驱动因子动态的不同结构。因此，得分驱动因子模型克服了通常影响动态因子模型的旋转不变性问题，从而增强了估计因子的经济与金融可解释性。我们的限制具有顺序不变性，并可推广至具有动态载荷的得分驱动因子模型及非线性因子模型。我们通过模拟和真实数据广泛检验了识别策略。对金融和宏观经济数据的实证分析显示，当从文献中采用的经典限制转向我们更灵活的规格时，对数似然比显著增加，且样本外预测性能大幅提升。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2709681.title: From rotational to scalar invariance: Enhancing identifiability in score-driven factor models
10.1080/07350015.2026.2709681.title_zh: 从旋转不变性到标量不变性：提升得分驱动因子模型的可识别性

10.1080/07350015.2026.2710360.abstract: We consider a semiparametric multinomial choice model that allows for an arbitrary joint distribution of choice specific unobservables that are independent of explanatory variables. This model permits relatively flexible substitution patterns between choices. To minimize computational difficulties, we restrict attention on estimators of the model that can be expressed in closed form. We combine and extend various results from the existing literature to enforce economic restrictions implied by the model and to attain “as efficient estimators as we can” - given the closed form requirement. Some aspects of our estimators achieve the semiparametric efficiency bound, while others do not. In Monte-Carlo experiments, we study how various strategies increase efficiency, and compare the efficiency of our best estimators to computationally more challenging, non-closed form, estimators that are efficient.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2710360.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个半参数多项选择模型，该模型允许选择特定不可观测因素具有任意联合分布，且这些因素与解释变量相互独立。此模型能够容纳选择之间相对灵活的替代模式。为减少计算难度，我们仅关注能以闭式形式表达的模型估计量。我们结合并扩展现有文献中的多种结果，以施加模型隐含的经济约束，并在闭式要求下尽可能实现“高效估计”。我们提出的估计量在某些方面达到了半参数效率界，而在其他方面则未达到。通过蒙特卡洛实验，我们研究了不同策略如何提升效率，并将我们最优估计量的效率与计算上更具挑战性、非闭式但高效的估计量进行了比较。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2710360.title: Closed Form Estimators for a Class of Semiparametric Multinomial Choice Models
10.1080/07350015.2026.2710360.title_zh: 一类半参数多项选择模型的闭式估计量

10.1080/07350015.2026.2714065.abstract: Value-at-Risk (VaR) remains one of the most widely used risk measures in finance due to its simplicity, interpretability, and regulatory prominence, particularly within the Basel framework. However, VaR is not a coherent risk measure, as it generally fails to satisfy the subadditivity property. This paper demonstrates that, although finite weighted combinations of VaR-type functionals do not necessarily yield coherent risk measures, appropriately constructed infinite weighted averages of quantiles can generate coherent risk measures. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a two-parameter weight function that jointly depends on the quantile level and a position parameter, and propose a novel coherent risk measurement framework termed generalized quantile regression (GQR). In particular, we establish explicit and verifiable conditions on the weight function under which the resulting risk functional satisfies coherence, reversibility, monotonicity, and comparability across quantile levels. The proposed framework is flexible, interpretable, and unifying: it encompasses a broad class of existing coherent risk measures as special cases while also generating several new and economically meaningful risk measures. These results provide a characterization that is not explicitly available in conventional distortion or spectral risk measure frameworks. We further develop corresponding nonparametric estimators, including in multi-dimensional settings, and investigate their asymptotic properties. Empirical studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed GQR framework in both risk assessment and portfolio optimization.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2714065.abstract_zh: 风险价值（VaR）因其简洁性、可解释性及在监管框架（尤其是巴塞尔协议）中的突出地位，至今仍是金融领域应用最广泛的风险度量之一。然而，VaR并非一致性风险度量，因为它通常不满足次可加性。本文证明，尽管有限加权组合的VaR型泛函未必能产生一致性风险度量，但适当构造的分位数无限加权平均却能生成一致性风险度量。受此观察启发，我们引入一个同时依赖于分位数水平和位置参数的双参数权重函数，并提出一种新颖的一致性风险度量框架，称为广义分位数回归（GQR）。特别地，我们建立了关于权重函数的显式且可验证的条件，在这些条件下，所得风险泛函满足一致性、可逆性、单调性以及跨分位数水平的可比性。该框架灵活、可解释且具有统一性：它将现有广泛类别的一致性风险度量作为特例涵盖其中，同时也能生成若干新的且具有经济意义的风险度量。这些结果提供了一种在传统扭曲或谱风险度量框架中并未明确给出的刻画。我们进一步开发了相应的非参数估计量，包括多维情形下的估计量，并研究了其渐近性质。实证研究证明了所提出的GQR框架在风险评估和投资组合优化中的有效性。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2714065.title: A family of coherent risk measures: an infinite weighted average of Value-at-Risk
10.1080/07350015.2026.2714065.title_zh: 一类一致风险度量：风险价值（VaR）的无限加权平均
