10.1080/07350015.2026.2715055.title: Nonparametric Inference in Dynamic Network Formation: Comments on “Homophily and Transitivity in Dynamic Network Formation”
10.1080/07350015.2026.2715055.title_zh: 动态网络形成中的非参数推断：对“动态网络形成中的同质性与传递性”一文的评论

10.1080/07350015.2026.2719893.abstract: This paper introduces a matrix quantile factor model for matrix-valued data with low-rank structure. We estimate the row and column factor spaces via minimizing the empirical check loss function with orthogonal rotation constraints. We show that the estimates converge at rate (min{p1p2,p2T,p1T})−1/2 in the average Frobenius norm, where p1, p2 and T are the row dimensionality, column dimensionality and length of the matrix sequence, respectively. This rate is faster than that of the quantile estimates via “flattening" the matrix model into a large vector model. To establish the central limit theorem, we introduce a tricky augmented Lagrangian function, which is equivalent to the original constrained empirical check loss minimization problem. Via the equivalence, we prove that the Hessian matrix of the augmented Lagrangian function is locally positive definite, resulting in a locally convex penalized loss function around the true factors and their loadings. This easily leads to a feasible second-order expansion of the score function and readily established central limit theorems of the smoothed estimates of the loadings. We provide three consistent criteria to determine the pair of row and column factor numbers. Extensive simulation studies and an empirical study justify our theory.
10.1080/07350015.2026.2719893.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于具有低秩结构的矩阵值数据的矩阵分位数因子模型。我们通过最小化带有正交旋转约束的经验检查损失函数来估计行与列因子空间。研究表明，在平均Frobenius范数下，估计值的收敛速度为(min{p1p2,p2T,p1T})−1/2，其中p1、p2和T分别代表矩阵序列的行维度、列维度和长度。这一速度优于将矩阵模型“扁平化”为大型向量模型后的分位数估计速度。为建立中心极限定理，我们引入了一个巧妙的增广拉格朗日函数，该函数与原始带约束的经验检查损失最小化问题等价。通过这种等价性，我们证明了增广拉格朗日函数的Hessian矩阵在局部是正定的，从而在真实因子及其载荷周围产生一个局部凸的惩罚损失函数。这便于得到得分函数的可行二阶展开，并顺利建立载荷平滑估计的中心极限定理。我们提供了三种一致准则来确定行与列因子数的配对。广泛的模拟研究和一项实证研究验证了我们的理论。
10.1080/07350015.2026.2719893.title: Matrix Quantile Factor Model

10.1080/07350015.2026.2729095.title: Specification LASSO and a Flexible Characteristics-Based Asset Pricing Model
10.1080/07350015.2026.2729095.title_zh: 规范LASSO与基于特征的灵活资产定价模型

10.1086/719686.abstract: This paper studies learning within organizations when incentives change. We use a simple principal-agent model to show how, in the presence of imperfect information over the shape of the production function, workers' effort choice changes over time as information is disclosed and processed. We also show that changing incentives can trigger this learning process. We test this prediction using personnel data from an egg production plant in Peru. Exploiting a sudden change in the contract parameters, we find that workers learn from each other over the shape of the production function. This adjustment process is costly for the firm.
10.1086/719686.abstract_zh: 本文研究了当激励发生变化时组织内部的学习行为。我们运用一个简单的委托-代理模型，展示了在生产函数形态信息不完全的情况下，随着信息的披露与处理，工人的努力选择如何随时间演变。同时，我们也证明了激励的变化能够触发这一学习过程。我们利用秘鲁一家蛋品生产厂的员工数据对这一预测进行了检验。通过利用合同参数的突然变动，我们发现工人之间会就生产函数的形态相互学习。这一调整过程对企业而言成本高昂。

10.1086/733049.abstract: Many workers are evaluated on their ability to engage with customers. We measure the impact of gender-based customer discrimination on the productivity of online sales agents in sub-Saharan Africa. Using a novel framework that randomly varies the gender of names presented to customers without changing worker behavior, we find the assignment of a female-sounding name leads to 50 percent fewer purchases. Customers also lag in responding, are less expressive, and avoid discussing purchases. We show similar results for customers around the world and across workers. Removing customer bias, we find women would be more productive than their male coworkers.
10.1086/733049.abstract_zh: 许多工人的工作表现取决于其与客户互动的能力。本研究衡量了基于性别的客户歧视对撒哈拉以南非洲地区在线销售代理生产率的影响。通过采用一种新颖的实验框架——在不改变工人实际行为的前提下，随机向客户展示不同性别的姓名——我们发现，使用女性化姓名会导致购买量减少50%。客户不仅回复延迟、表达更不积极，还会回避讨论购买事宜。全球范围内的客户及不同工人群体均呈现类似结果。若消除客户偏见，女性工人的生产率将高于其男性同事。
10.1086/733049.title: Customer Discrimination in the Workplace: Evidence from Online Sales
10.1086/733049.title_zh: 职场中的顾客歧视：来自在线销售的证据

10.1086/733051.abstract: This paper characterizes the joint evolution of income and consumption inequality across generations. We estimate a model featuring intergenerational persistence and family-independent idiosyncratic heterogeneity. We find that inequality in income and consumption is predominantly driven by idiosyncratic factors rather than intergenerational linkages. We show evidence of consumption insurance against idiosyncratic lifetime income risk, particularly for the bottom and top quartiles of income. Parental income is a significant source of this insurance only for the richest quartile.
10.1086/733051.abstract_zh: 本文刻画了代际间收入与消费不平等的联合演变过程。我们构建了一个包含代际持续性及家庭独立异质性特征的模型。研究发现，收入与消费不平等主要源于异质性因素而非代际关联。实证结果表明，消费对终身收入异质性风险具有保险功能，尤其体现在收入最低和最高四分位群体中。仅对收入最高四分位群体而言，父母收入构成此类保险的重要来源。
10.1086/733051.title: Consumption and Income Inequality across Generations
10.1086/733051.title_zh: 代际消费与收入不平等

10.1086/733225.title: Instrumental Variables with Unordered Treatments: Theory and Evidence from          Returns to Fields of Study
10.1086/733225.title_zh: 无序处理工具变量：理论及基于专业回报的实证证据

10.1086/733226.abstract: We analyze trends in labor-market returns to psychological traits using data from half a million Finnish men from 2001 to 2015. Cognitive skills' value declined, while noncognitive skills' value increased. Our novel findings show that extraversion drives this rise, while conscientiousness remains stable. Extraversion's rising returns are most pronounced for lower earners and those on the employment margin. These traits predict different labor market paths: extraversion predicts lower education and more work experience, while cognitive ability and conscientiousness lead to higher education and high-paying jobs.
10.1086/733226.abstract_zh: 我们利用2001年至2015年50万芬兰男性的数据，分析了劳动力市场对心理特质的回报趋势。认知技能的价值下降，而非认知技能的价值上升。我们的新发现表明，外向性推动了这一上升趋势，而尽责性则保持稳定。外向性回报率的上升在低收入者和就业边缘人群中最为显著。这些特质预测了不同的劳动力市场路径：外向性预示着较低的教育水平和更多的工作经验，而认知能力和尽责性则导向更高的教育水平和高薪工作。
10.1086/733226.title: Beyond IQ: The Rising Value of Extraversion
10.1086/733226.title_zh: 超越智商：外向性的价值上升

10.1086/733490.abstract: Using Danish registry data linked to the Labor Force Survey, we provide the first rigorous evidence with external validity on the hours-career nexus (positive association between hours and career success). Guided by three theories (human capital; rat race; tournament), we unpack the hours-career nexus through examining: the differential effect of hours in the present firm and elsewhere; hours relative to peers’ hours; standard vs. evening/night/weekend hours; and the importance of sustaining long hours. Supplemented by the time use survey, we show the gender gap in hours and career success is due mostly to gendered division of labor in household production.
10.1086/733490.abstract_zh: 利用丹麦登记数据与劳动力调查的关联，我们首次提供了关于工时与职业发展关联（即工时与职业成功之间的正相关关系）且具有外部效度的严谨证据。基于三种理论（人力资本理论、竞争性工作理论、锦标赛理论），我们通过以下维度解析工时与职业发展的关联：当前企业内工时与其他企业工时的差异化效应；工时相对于同行的相对水平；标准工时与晚间/夜间/周末工时的差异；以及持续超长工时的重要性。结合时间使用调查数据，我们揭示工时与职业成功中的性别差异主要源于家庭生产中的性别分工。
10.1086/733490.title: Working Hours, Top Management Appointments, and Gender: Evidence from Linked Employer-Employee Data
10.1086/733490.title_zh: 工作时间、高管任命与性别：基于雇主-雇员匹配数据的证据

10.1086/733493.abstract: Using full count US census data, we study the impact of early twentieth-century state-industry-specific minimum wage laws that primarily targeted female employees. Our triple-difference estimates suggest a null impact of the minimum wage laws, potentially reflecting disemployment effects and the positive selection bias of the workers remaining in the labor force. When comparing county-industry trends between counties straddling state borders, female employment is lower by around 3.1% in affected county-industry cells. We further investigate the implications for own-wage elasticity of labor demand as a function of cross-industry concentration, the channels of substitution between men and women, and heterogeneity by marital status.
10.1086/733493.abstract_zh: 利用美国人口普查全量数据，本文研究了20世纪初主要针对女性雇员的州-行业特定最低工资法的影响。三重差分估计结果表明，最低工资法的影响为零，这可能反映了就业抑制效应以及留在劳动力队伍中的工人存在的正向选择偏差。通过比较州界两侧县-行业层面的趋势，受影响县-行业单元的女性就业率下降约3.1%。我们进一步探讨了劳动力需求的自工资弹性如何随跨行业集中度变化、男女替代渠道以及婚姻状况异质性。
10.1086/733493.title: The Economics of Gender-Specific Minimum Wage Legislation
10.1086/733493.title_zh: 性别特定最低工资立法的经济学分析

10.1086/733494.abstract: In theory, monitoring can improve employee motivation and effort, particularly in settings lacking measurable outputs, but research assessing monitoring as a motivator is limited to laboratory settings. To address this gap, I leverage exogenous variation in the presence and intensity of teacher monitoring, in the form of unannounced in-class observations as part of DC public schools’ IMPACT program. As monitoring intensifies, teachers use more individualized teaching and emphasize higher-level learning. When teachers are unmonitored, their students have lower test scores and increased suspensions. This evidence validates monitoring as a potential tool for enhancing teacher pedagogy and employee performance more broadly.
10.1086/733494.abstract_zh: 理论上，监督能够提升员工的积极性和努力程度，尤其在缺乏可量化产出的环境中，但关于监督作为激励因素的研究目前仅限于实验室环境。为填补这一空白，我利用华盛顿特区公立学校IMPACT项目中未事先通知的课堂观察作为教师监督存在及强度的外生变异。随着监督加强，教师更倾向于采用个性化教学并强调更高层次的学习。当教师不受监督时，其学生的考试成绩下降，停学事件增多。这一证据证实了监督作为提升教师教学方法及更广泛员工绩效的潜在工具的有效性。
10.1086/733494.title: Does Monitoring Change Teacher Pedagogy and Student Outcomes?
10.1086/733494.title_zh: 监督是否改变了教师教学法和学生成果？

10.1086/734087.abstract: Firstborns, on average, complete more education than laterborns. We study whether individuals’ endowments measured by genetic information amplify this effect. Our familyfixed effects approach allows exploiting exogenous variation in birth order and genetic endowments among 14,850 siblings in the UK Biobank. We find that those with higher genetic endowments benefit disproportionately more from being firstborn compared to those with lower endowments, providing a clean example of how nature and nurture interact in producing human capital. Since parental investments are a dominant channel driving birth order effects, our results are consistent with complementarity between endowments and investments in human capital formation.
10.1086/734087.abstract_zh: 平均而言，头胎子女比后生子女完成更多教育。我们研究以遗传信息衡量的个体禀赋是否会放大这一效应。通过采用家庭固定效应方法，我们利用英国生物银行中14,850名兄弟姐妹在出生顺序和遗传禀赋上的外生变异进行分析。研究发现，与低遗传禀赋者相比，高遗传禀赋者从作为头胎子女中获得的收益显著更大——这为先天禀赋与后天培养如何相互作用以形成人力资本提供了清晰例证。由于父母投资是驱动出生顺序效应的主导渠道，我们的结果与禀赋与人力资本形成投资之间的互补性假说一致。
10.1086/734087.title: Gene-Environment Complementarity in Educational Attainment
10.1086/734087.title_zh: 教育成就中的基因-环境互补性

10.1086/734527.title: Prior Work Experience and Entrepreneurship: The Careers of Young Entrepreneurs
10.1086/734527.title_zh: 先前工作经验与创业：年轻创业者的职业路径

10.1086/734845.title: Gender Difference in Innovation Recognition: A Textual Analysis Approach
10.1086/734845.title_zh: 创新认可中的性别差异：基于文本分析的方法

10.1086/734846.abstract: Firms are starting to replace humans with algorithms in important screening decisions, but there are potential spillovers of human biases contained in datasets to subsequent algorithmic predictions. When these biases are motivated by human prejudices, there are risks of algorithms perpetuating discrimination. I prove that when datasets are generated by a sufficiently discriminatory human, firms are more profitable when training discriminatory algorithms. If instead enough affirmative action is instituted in favor of a disadvantaged group, firms are more profitable when training algorithms that inflate scores for this group, but this effect diminishes with excess affirmative action.
10.1086/734846.abstract_zh: 企业开始在重要的筛选决策中用算法取代人类，但数据集中蕴含的人类偏见可能会溢出至后续的算法预测中。当这些偏见源于人类歧视时，算法存在延续歧视的风险。我证明，当数据集由具有足够歧视性的人类生成时，企业训练歧视性算法更为有利可图。相反，若对弱势群体实施充分的平权措施，企业训练为该群体抬高评分的算法将更有利可图，但这一效应会随着过度平权而减弱。
10.1086/734846.title: Profits of Prejudiced Algorithms

10.1086/734862.abstract: We use a vignette-based survey experiment to elicit respondents’ assessments of the fairness of race-based hiring decisions and compare these assessments with the predictions of four preregistered ethical frameworks. While conservative respondents are much more accepting of discriminatory actions than others, respondents of all political leanings rate the relative fairness of different actions in a very similar way. A two-group framework in which one group (mostly self-described conservatives) values employers’ decision rights, the other has utilitarian concerns, and both groups use the same race-blind rules to assign relative fairness levels to actions explains our data well.
10.1086/734862.abstract_zh: 我们采用基于情境描述的调查实验，来获取受访者对基于种族的雇佣决策公平性的评估，并将这些评估与四个预注册伦理框架的预测进行比较。尽管保守派受访者比其他人更接受歧视性行为，但所有政治倾向的受访者对不同行为的相对公平性评价方式非常相似。一个双群体框架——其中一组（主要是自称保守派的人）重视雇主的决策权，另一组具有功利主义关切，且两组都使用相同的种族中立规则来为行为分配相对公平等级——很好地解释了我们的数据。
10.1086/734862.title: When Is Discrimination Unfair?

10.1086/735551.title: Minimum Wage Effects and Monopsony Explanations
10.1086/735551.title_zh: 最低工资效应与买方垄断解释

10.1086/736551.title: Gender Gaps in Access to Medical Intern Positions: The Role of Competition
10.1086/736551.title_zh: 医学实习岗位获取中的性别差距：竞争的作用

10.1086/736552.title: Heterogeneous Effects of Large and Small Minimum Wage Changes: Evidence Using a Partially Precommitted Analysis Plan
10.1086/736552.title_zh: 大小最低工资变动的异质性效应：基于部分预先承诺分析计划的证据

10.1086/736801.abstract: Contract theorists routinely assume that opportunities for efficient breach are exogeneous. This prompts the conventional approach to contract remedies, according to which expectation damages are preferred to the disgorgement rule: when ex-post renegotiations are unfeasible, the former regime facilitates efficient breach while the latter deters it. In this paper, I offer a simple model in which two parties to a contract can exert search efforts to locate better contractual alternatives. The endogeneity of efficient-breach opportunities gives rise to a novel outlook on the choice of remedies for a breach of contract. Specifically, this paper opts out of the expectation damages versus disgorgement distinction to offer two new remedies: conditional disgorgement, which ignores each party's breaching or non-breaching status and grants the breach surplus to the party who has located a better contractual alternative; and partial disgorgement, which divides the breach surplus by bestowing a fixed, predetermined share upon each party. I show that these remedies are generally superior to extant regimes in terms of inducing optimal search efforts. The underlying intuition is that under the proposed rules, each party is better off with being either the breaching or the non-breaching party, and therefore, is incentivized to carry out both selfish and cooperative search. This paper likewise makes the inner comparison between conditional and partial disgorgement, deriving conditions for the optimality of each rule. Finally, it discusses the results in light of existing contract doctrine and commercial practice.
10.1086/736801.abstract_zh: 合同理论家通常假设有效违约的机会是外生的。这促使了合同救济的传统方法，即预期损害赔偿优于返还规则：当事后重新谈判不可行时，前者促进有效违约，而后者则阻碍之。本文提出一个简单模型，其中合同双方可以付出搜寻努力以寻找更好的合同替代方案。有效违约机会的内生性为违约救济的选择提供了新的视角。具体而言，本文超越了预期损害赔偿与返还规则的传统区分，提出了两种新的救济方式：条件性返还，它忽略各方的违约或非违约状态，将违约盈余授予找到更好合同替代方案的一方；以及部分返还，通过向各方分配固定的预定份额来分割违约盈余。我证明，在诱导最优搜寻努力方面，这些救济方式通常优于现有制度。其基本直觉是，在提议的规则下，无论是作为违约方还是非违约方，各方都能获益，因此有动力进行既利己又合作的搜寻。本文同样对条件性返还与部分返还进行了内部比较，推导出每种规则最优性的条件。最后，结合现有合同理论与商业实践对结果进行了讨论。
10.1086/736801.title: Contract Remedies and Search Efforts

10.1086/737768.abstract: We examine whether the US Securities Exchange Act of 1934 significantly stabilized the market by introducing mandatory disclosure of information. We argue that mandatory information disclosure can curb stock manipulation by enhancing transparency, thereby reducing excess stock volatility. After a comprehensive assessment of the voluntary disclosure practices of companies listed on the New York Stock Exchange before 1934, we find that those with poor disclosure practices experienced a significantly greater reduction in volatility after the implementation of the act compared with those with good disclosure practices. Further analysis reveals that the liquidity of these companies with poor disclosure practices also improved significantly more than that of companies with better disclosure, and the improvement in liquidity was linked to the decrease in their volatility. Given that one key purpose of the act’s legislators was to reduce excess market volatility, our findings provide empirical support for considering this legislative aim successful.
10.1086/737768.abstract_zh: 本文考察了1934年美国《证券交易法》是否通过引入强制性信息披露显著稳定了市场。我们认为，强制性信息披露能够通过提升透明度抑制股票操纵行为，从而降低股票过度波动。在对1934年前纽约证券交易所上市公司自愿披露实践进行全面评估后，我们发现：相较于披露实践良好的公司，披露实践较差的公司在该法案实施后波动性下降幅度显著更大。进一步分析表明，这些披露实践较差公司的流动性改善程度也显著优于披露较好的公司，且流动性改善与其波动性下降存在关联。鉴于该法案立法者的核心目标之一是减少市场过度波动，我们的研究结果为认定该立法目标已成功实现提供了实证支持。
10.1086/737768.title: Does Securities Regulation Matter? Mandatory Disclosure, Excess Stock Volatility, and the US Securities Exchange Act of 1934
10.1086/737768.title_zh: 证券监管重要吗？强制披露、股票过度波动与1934年美国证券交易法

10.1086/737770.abstract: The Dodd-Frank Act in 2010 increased ex ante downgrade threats without changing credit-rated firms’ underlying credit quality. We show that the act had negative impacts on credit-rated firms’ acquisition activities, especially among speculative-grade firms as they face greater downgrade-induced costs. The more selective acquisition strategies led to higher announcement returns and greater postacquisition upgrade probabilities. Consistent with firms refraining from taking on overall acquisition risk rather than financial risk, we show significant reductions in both cash-and stock-settled dealmaking after the Dodd-Frank Act. In sum, our study highlights that increased legal stringency on credit rating agencies has important spillover effects on firms’ mergers and acquisitions activities.
10.1086/737770.abstract_zh: 2010年的《多德-弗兰克法案》在不改变信用评级公司基础信用质量的情况下，增加了事前降级威胁。我们证明该法案对信用评级公司的收购活动产生了负面影响，尤其是在投机级公司中，因为它们面临更大的降级引发的成本。更为审慎的收购策略导致了更高的公告回报和更大的收购后升级概率。与公司避免承担整体收购风险而非财务风险的行为一致，我们发现在《多德-弗兰克法案》之后，现金结算和股票结算的交易活动均显著减少。总之，我们的研究强调，对信用评级机构加强法律约束对企业的并购活动具有重要的溢出效应。
10.1086/737770.title: The Impact of the Dodd-Frank Act on Acquisition Activity
10.1086/737770.title_zh: 多德-弗兰克法案对收购活动的影响

10.1086/737771.abstract: Migrant domestic workers (MDWs) are highly vulnerable to labor abuse. Usinga survey and randomized controlled trial conducted in Hong Kong, this studyinvestigates MDWs’ labor experiences and the potential of rights awarenesscampaigns to mitigate labor abuse. The campaigns increased public knowledgeof MDWs’ rights and reduced the social acceptability of MDWs’ mistreatment.To the extent that improving knowledge about MDWs’ rights and decreasingacceptance of mistreatment affect the behaviors of employers and others whocan support MDWs, rights awareness campaigns can help reduce labor abuse.However, the campaigns had limited impact on MDWs, who demonstrated highawareness of their rights but often experienced concerning levels of abuse andregarded mistreatment as an unavoidable aspect of their employment. These differences highlight the constrained agency of MDWs to independently improvetheir labor conditions and emphasize the value of rights awareness initiativestargeting employers of MDWs and the general public.
10.1086/737771.abstract_zh: 外籍家庭佣工（MDWs）在劳动权益方面高度脆弱。本研究基于在香港开展的问卷调查与随机对照试验，考察了外籍家庭佣工的劳动经历，以及权利意识宣传活动在减少劳动虐待方面的潜力。这些宣传活动提升了公众对外籍家庭佣工权利的认知，并降低了社会对虐待外籍家庭佣工行为的接受度。在改善外籍家庭佣工权利认知与降低虐待行为接受度能够影响雇主及其他支持者行为的前提下，权利意识宣传活动有助于减少劳动虐待。然而，此类活动对外籍家庭佣工自身的影响有限——他们虽对自身权利有较高认知，却常遭遇令人担忧的虐待程度，并将虐待视为其就业中不可避免的组成部分。这些差异凸显了外籍家庭佣工在独立改善劳动条件方面受到的能力限制，并强调了针对外籍家庭佣工雇主及普通公众开展权利意识倡议的价值。
10.1086/737771.title: Growing Awareness to Reduce Labor Abuse: An Experimental Test of a Migrant Domestic Workers’ Rights Awareness Campaign
10.1086/737771.title_zh: 减少劳工虐待意识的提升：一项针对移民家政工人权利意识运动的实验检验

10.1086/737772.title: Why Life Gets Better after Age 50, for Some: Mental Well-Being and the Social Norm of Work
10.1086/737772.title_zh: 为何50岁后生活对某些人而言变得更美好：心理健康与工作社会规范

10.1086/737992.title: Exam Reward Structure, Gender Performance Gaps, and Labor Market Outcomes
10.1086/737992.title_zh: 考试奖励结构、性别绩效差距与劳动力市场结果

10.1086/738358.abstract: Proponents of recreational marijuana laws (RMLs) argue that expanding legal access to marijuana may serve an important social justice objective by reducing racial disparities in arrest rates. Using data from the Uniform Crime Reports and a generalized difference-in-differences approach, we find support for this claim: RML adoption is associated with a reduction of 498–561 marijuana arrests per 100,000 persons (over 90 percent) among Black adults and a reduction of 128–145 arrests (78–88 percent) among White adults. However, we find no evidence that RML adoption reduces racial disparities in nonmarijuana drug arrests or arrests for property and violent crimes, and post-RML reallocation of policing resources to fight nonmarijuana drug crime and violent crime may, in some circumstances, widen these racial disparities. Finally, RMLs reduce opioid-related mortality among non-Hispanic Whites relative to Blacks and Hispanics, consistent with the hypothesis that those hardest hit at the outset of the US opioid epidemic disproportionately gain from recreational marijuana legalization.
10.1086/738358.abstract_zh: 娱乐性大麻合法化（RML）的支持者认为，扩大大麻合法获取渠道可通过减少逮捕率中的种族差异，实现重要的社会公正目标。基于《统一犯罪报告》数据并采用广义双重差分法，我们验证了这一主张：RML实施后，黑人成年人每10万人中大麻相关逮捕人数减少498-561人（降幅超90%），白人成年人减少128-145人（降幅78%-88%）。然而，未发现RML实施能缩小非大麻类毒品逮捕、财产犯罪及暴力犯罪逮捕中的种族差异；在特定情境下，RML实施后警务资源向非大麻毒品犯罪与暴力犯罪的重新配置，反而可能加剧这些领域的种族差异。此外，相较于黑人与西班牙裔群体，RML显著降低了非西班牙裔白人的阿片类药物相关死亡率，这与"美国阿片类药物危机初期受影响最严重群体从娱乐性大麻合法化中获益更多"的假说一致。
10.1086/738358.title: Recreational Marijuana Laws and Racial Disparities: New Evidence on Arrests and Deaths of Despair
10.1086/738358.title_zh: 娱乐性大麻法案与种族差异：逮捕与绝望死亡的新证据

10.1086/738360.abstract: Insufficient trust in journalists creates space for disinformation. We ask whether institutions can safeguard trust in journalists. Our main finding is that the rule of law is positively and robustly associated with trust in journalists. The rule of law arguably promotes trustworthy behavior by punishing deceit and dishonesty, thereby fostering trust. Robustness checks support this result. Moderation analysis indicates that the relationship between the rule of law and trust in journalists is weaker in low-income countries; this difference vanishes once gross domestic product per capita, a variable strongly correlated with the rule of lawyer negatively associated with trust in journalists, is taken into account. A heterogeneous treatment analysis using the COVID-19 pandemic as an exogenous shock to trust levels offers suggestive evidence against reverse causality. Though exploratory, our findings point to the importance of high-quality legal institutions in combatting distrust in journalists.
10.1086/738360.abstract_zh: 对记者的信任不足为虚假信息提供了空间。我们探究制度能否维护对记者的信任。主要发现是，法治水平与对记者的信任呈稳健的正相关关系。法治通过惩罚欺骗与不诚实行为，促进可信赖行为，从而培育信任。稳健性检验支持这一结果。调节效应分析表明，在低收入国家，法治与记者信任之间的关联较弱；一旦考虑人均国内生产总值（这一与法治高度相关且与记者信任呈负相关的变量），该差异便消失。利用新冠疫情作为信任水平的外生冲击进行的异质性处理分析，提供了反向因果关系的提示性证据。尽管本研究属于探索性分析，但研究结果凸显了高质量法律制度在对抗对记者不信任中的重要性。
10.1086/738360.title: The Rule of Law Predicts Trust in Journalists
10.1086/738360.title_zh: 法治预测对记者的信任

10.1086/738415.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between crises and the intrahousehold allocation of resources. Using data from Mexico, I estimate a structural collective model to identify the distribution of household resources among its members. Then, I construct a proxy for women’s bargaining power on the basis of their control of resources and document how it evolves over periods of economic stability and contraction. The results indicate that during the COVID-19 crisis, women’s control over household resources declined by approximately 4–5 percentage points compared with non-recession periods and by 6–8 percentage points relative to the financial crisis, with a more pronounced effect for households with children. I further analyze how this resource reallocation affects individual poverty. The findings highlight the heterogeneous behavior of intrahousehold inequality over the business cycle. They also suggest that the hypothesis that the financial crisis was a “man-cession” and the COVID-19 crisis was a “she-cession” holds in terms of intrahousehold resource allocation.
10.1086/738415.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了危机与家庭内部资源配置之间的关系。利用墨西哥的数据，我估计了一个结构性集体模型，以识别家庭成员间资源的分配情况。随后，我基于女性对资源的控制构建了一个衡量其议价能力的代理指标，并记录了该指标在经济稳定期与收缩期的演变过程。结果表明，在COVID-19危机期间，女性对家庭资源的控制相比非衰退时期下降了约4至5个百分点，相比金融危机时期下降了6至8个百分点，且对有子女的家庭影响更为显著。我进一步分析了这种资源重新配置对个体贫困的影响。研究结果凸显了家庭内部不平等在经济周期中的异质性表现，同时也表明，关于金融危机为“男性衰退”和COVID-19危机为“女性衰退”的假设，在家庭内部资源配置方面得到了证实。
10.1086/738415.title: COVID-19, Crises, and Women’s Control of Resources: Evidence from Mexico
10.1086/738415.title_zh: COVID-19、危机与女性资源控制：来自墨西哥的证据

10.1086/738470.title: Spatial Clustering of Natural Disasters, Selection in Migration, and Economic Outcomes
10.1086/738470.title_zh: 自然灾害的空间集聚、迁移中的选择效应与经济结果

10.1086/738579.abstract: This study evaluates the effect of the Read Liberia intervention that provided teacher training, coaching, and teaching and learning materials, reaching 57,600 grades 1 and 2 students across 640 schools. Exploiting the randomized assignment of schools to the program, we find that Read Liberia improved students’ ability to read a paragraph, doubling oral reading fluency in intervention schools relative to control schools (an effect size of 0.60 standard deviations), and increased their ability to comprehend that paragraph (oral reading comprehension) by 12–13 percentage points, corresponding to an effect size of 0.47 standard deviations. On the basis of the analysis of the program implementation data, teachers’ and students’ surveys, and in-depth classroom observations, we argue that the improvements in reading performance are driven by the availability and utilization of Read Liberia reading materials and not by improved teaching practices in schools. Good-quality reading materials combined with improved instructional practices have the potential to generate even higher effects.
10.1086/738579.abstract_zh: 本研究评估了“利比里亚阅读”干预项目的效果，该项目提供教师培训、辅导及教学与学习材料，覆盖640所学校的57,600名一、二年级学生。利用学校随机分配至项目的机制，我们发现“利比里亚阅读”项目提升了学生朗读段落的能力，使干预学校的口语阅读流利度相对于对照学校翻倍（效应量为0.60个标准差），并提高了他们理解该段落的能力（口语阅读理解），增幅为12至13个百分点，对应效应量为0.47个标准差。基于对项目实施数据的分析、教师与学生调查以及深入的课堂观察，我们认为阅读表现的提升是由“利比里亚阅读”阅读材料的可用性和使用所驱动，而非学校教学实践的改进。高质量的阅读材料结合改进的教学实践，有可能产生更高的效果。
10.1086/738579.title: Understanding Improvements in Reading Performance in Liberia: Investigating the Centrality of Text
10.1086/738579.title_zh: 利比里亚阅读表现提升的理解：探究文本的核心作用

10.1086/738610.abstract: Social norms discouraging women from working, and particularly from working with men, are prevalent in many settings with low female employment. I implement a field experiment and survey experiment with educated women via a job-matching platform in Pakistan, one such setting, to elucidate the role of information about supervisor or employee gender on women’s job search. At the job-application stage, among women who are reminded about job-search discussions with their families, information about a male supervisor significantly decreases the job-application rate by nearly 60%. However, at the stage of accepting an offer that includes sufficiently high salary, women are willing to accept a male supervisor but exhibit a strong preference to work in an environment with mostly female coworkers.
10.1086/738610.abstract_zh: 在许多女性就业率较低的环境中，普遍存在阻碍女性工作、尤其是与男性共事的社会规范。我在巴基斯坦这样一个背景下，通过一个求职匹配平台对受过教育的女性实施了一项实地实验和调查实验，以阐明关于主管或员工性别信息对女性求职行为的影响。在求职申请阶段，当女性被提醒与家人讨论求职事宜时，关于男性主管的信息显著降低了近60%的申请率。然而，在接受包含足够高薪水的职位阶段，女性愿意接受男性主管，但表现出强烈偏好于在大多数同事为女性的环境中工作。
10.1086/738610.title: Workplace Attributes and Women’s Labor Supply Decisions: Evidence from a          Randomized Experiment
10.1086/738610.title_zh: 工作场所属性与女性劳动供给决策：来自随机实验的证据

10.1086/739049.abstract: This paper investigates the marriage market returns to female education by examining the resources transferred from the groom to the bride and her family at the time of marriage, known as the bride price, as well as the husband’s imputed permanent income as an additional source of returns. The study exploits a school reform in Egypt that reduced the number of years required to complete primary education from six to five, creating exogenous variations in the timing of treatment across schools due to its staggered roll-out. To address identification issues, an instrumental variable estimator combined with a Two-Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) model at the birth year and primary school levels is employed. The findings reveal that the estimated return on a bride’s compulsory education is over three times higher in bride price and 20% higher in the husband’s imputed permanent income compared to those without compulsory education. These substantial marriage market returns outweigh labor market returns at the extensive margin of employment. Further empirical evidence suggests that higher female education potentially signals positive outcomes in terms of home production and child-rearing in Egypt, while educational assortative mating also appears to be an important mechanism.
10.1086/739049.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察婚礼上新郎向新娘及其家庭转移的资源（即彩礼），以及丈夫的估算永久收入作为额外回报来源，探究女性教育的婚姻市场回报。研究利用埃及一项将小学教育年限从六年缩短至五年的学校改革，该改革因分阶段推行而在不同学校间产生了外生的处理时间差异。为解决识别问题，本研究采用工具变量估计法，并结合出生年份和小学层面的双向固定效应模型。结果显示，与未接受义务教育的女性相比，接受义务教育的女性在彩礼方面的估计回报高出三倍以上，在丈夫估算永久收入方面的回报高出20%。这些显著的婚姻市场回报在就业的广延边际上超过了劳动力市场回报。进一步的实证证据表明，在埃及，更高的女性教育水平可能在家务劳动和育儿方面传递积极信号，同时教育同型婚配也是一个重要机制。
10.1086/739049.title: Returns to Education in the Marriage Market: Bride Price and School Reform in Egypt
10.1086/739049.title_zh: 婚姻市场中教育回报：埃及的彩礼与教育改革

10.1086/739099.abstract: This paper examines how son preference and reproductive health-care conditions interact to influence maternal morbidity and mortality. Using data on 2.5 million women across 44 developing countries between 1990 and 2018, we exploit cross-country variation in son preference intensity and health-care conditions to document distinct patterns in maternal health. We show that in societies with strong son preference, women with first-born girls face higher incidence of moderate to severe anemia, a risk factor for maternal mortality. Moreover, these women exhibit lower survival into older ages where strong son preference coexists with poor maternal care. These patterns persist over time.
10.1086/739099.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了子女性别偏好与生殖健康保健条件如何相互作用，进而影响孕产妇的发病率与死亡率。利用1990年至2018年间44个发展中国家的250万名女性数据，我们借助各国在子女性别偏好强度及医疗保健条件上的差异，揭示了孕产妇健康方面的独特模式。研究表明，在子女性别偏好强烈的社会中，首胎为女孩的女性面临中重度贫血（孕产妇死亡的一个风险因素）的更高发生率。此外，在强烈的子女性别偏好与较差的孕产妇护理并存的情况下，这些女性在老年阶段的存活率较低。这些模式随时间持续存在。
10.1086/739099.title: Son Preference and Maternal Health: A Cross-Cultural and Temporal Analysis
10.1086/739099.title_zh: 子代性别偏好与孕产妇健康：一项跨文化与时间维度的分析

10.1086/739149.abstract: Noncommunicable diseases impede development, yet evidence on screening in low-resource settings is scarce. We evaluate hypertension screening in rural South Africa using a multidimensional regression discontinuity: a survey measures blood pressure (BP) and refers individuals exceeding either of two thresholds. Overall, referral modestly raises treatment uptake but shows no average BP effect after 4 years. We use BP variation with time of day and temperature to identify screens that are less likely to produce false positives. For these, referrals lower systolic BP by 5 mm Hg and uncontrolled BP by 22 percentage points. Limiting false positives may increase referral impact and program cost-effectiveness.
10.1086/739149.abstract_zh: 非传染性疾病阻碍发展，然而在资源匮乏环境中关于筛查的证据却十分稀缺。我们利用多维回归不连续性评估南非农村地区的高血压筛查：一项调查测量血压（BP），并将超过任一阈值的个体转诊。总体而言，转诊适度提高了治疗接受率，但在4年后未显示出平均血压效应。我们利用血压随时间与温度的变化来识别更不可能产生假阳性的筛查。对于这些筛查，转诊使收缩压降低5毫米汞柱，未控制血压的比例降低22个百分点。限制假阳性可能增强转诊效果及项目的成本效益。
10.1086/739149.title: Is Hypertension Screening Effective in a Low-Resource Setting? A Multidimensional Regression Discontinuity Design
10.1086/739149.title_zh: 低资源环境下高血压筛查是否有效？基于多维断点回归设计

10.1086/739150.abstract: We conducted a randomized experiment to study the impacts of a summer learning camp and the language of instruction on education outcomes. The program, covering social studies and mathematics, provided additional high-quality learning time for 4th and 5th graders in Malawi. The program significantly increased test scores in social studies and mathematics (0.24–0.36 standard deviations). We find suggestive evidence that the impact on test scores in social studies was greater for students instructed in Chichewa, the local language, than for those instructed in English. However, we find no such evidence of differential impacts on test scores in mathematics by the language of instruction.
10.1086/739150.abstract_zh: 我们开展了一项随机实验，研究暑期学习营及教学语言对教育成果的影响。该项目涵盖社会研究和数学课程，为马拉维四、五年级学生提供了额外的高质量学习时间。实验结果显示，该项目显著提升了学生在社会研究和数学方面的测试成绩（效应量为0.24–0.36个标准差）。我们初步发现，以当地语言奇契瓦语授课的学生在社会研究测试成绩上的提升幅度大于以英语授课的学生。然而，在数学测试成绩方面，未发现教学语言导致差异化影响的证据。
10.1086/739150.title: Learning Camp, Language of Instruction, and Education Outcomes: Evidence from a Field Experiment in Malawi
10.1086/739150.title_zh: 学习营、教学语言与教育成果：来自马拉维田野实验的证据

10.1086/739319.abstract: This paper examines the long-term effects of British colonialism on women’s empowerment in India. Exploiting district-level variation in colonial rule and using a specific feature of the annexation policy as an instrument for selective annexation, we find that in the early twenty-first century, women in districts directly ruled by the British exhibit higher empowerment across multiple dimensions than those elsewhere. We provide suggestive evidence that British legal reforms advancing women’s rights and social reform movements influenced by Western ideas may explain the observed relationship. Our findings underscore the lasting role of historical and institutional contexts in shaping gender inequality.
10.1086/739319.abstract_zh: 本文考察了英国殖民主义对印度女性赋权的长期影响。利用殖民统治在地区层面的差异，并以吞并政策的一个特定特征作为选择性吞并的工具变量，我们发现，在二十一世纪初，由英国直接统治的地区，女性在多个维度上的赋权程度高于其他地区。我们提供的初步证据表明，推动女性权利进步的英国法律改革及受西方思想影响的社会改革运动，可能解释了所观察到的关联。我们的研究结果强调了历史与制度背景在塑造性别不平等中的持久作用。
10.1086/739319.title: British Colonialism and Women’s Empowerment in India
10.1086/739319.title_zh: 英国殖民主义与印度女性赋权

10.1086/739584.title: Cooperation in Polygynous Households: Experimental Evidence from Northern Benin
10.1086/739584.title_zh: 多妻制家庭中的合作：来自贝宁北部的实验证据

10.1086/739610.abstract: Balanced experimental designs, in which the number of treatment and control units are the same, do not maximize power subject to a cost constraint when treatment units are more expensive than control ones. Despite this, such balanced designs are the norm in economics. This paper describes methods to optimally choose the number of treatment and control clusters, and the number of units within treatment and control clusters, allowing for full flexibility. We use three archetypal examples from the development literature to illustrate the magnitude of the power gains, which lie between 7.9 and 19.0 percentage points.
10.1086/739610.abstract_zh: 当处理组单位成本高于对照组时，平衡实验设计（即处理组与对照组单位数量相等）在成本约束下无法实现统计功效最大化。然而，此类平衡设计仍是经济学研究的常态。本文提出在完全灵活条件下，最优选择处理组与对照组集群数量及其内部单位数量的方法。我们采用发展经济学文献中的三个典型案例，展示统计功效的提升幅度介于7.9至19.0个百分点之间。
10.1086/739610.title: More Powerful Cluster Randomized Controlled Trials
10.1086/739610.title_zh: 更强大的整群随机对照试验

10.1086/739821.abstract: We test Le Play's (1875) hypothesis that the French Revolution contributed to France's early fertility decline by imposing equal partition of inheritance among all children, including women. We combine new data on local inheritance rules before the Revolution and individual-level demographic data from historical sources and crowdsourced genealogies. Difference-in-differences and regression-discontinuity estimates show that the inheritance reforms enacted during the Revolution reduced completed fertility by 0.5 children. A key mechanism was the desire to avoid land fragmentation across generations. These reforms closed the fertility gap between regions with different historical inheritance rules and crucially contributed to France's demographic transition.
10.1086/739821.abstract_zh: 我们检验了勒普莱（1875年）的假说，即法国大革命通过强制实行所有子女（包括女性）平等继承遗产的规定，促进了法国早期生育率的下降。我们将大革命前地方继承规则的新数据与来自历史资料和众包家谱的个人层面人口统计数据相结合。双重差分法和断点回归估计显示，大革命期间实施的继承改革使完成生育率降低了0.5个孩子。一个关键机制是避免土地在代际间分割的愿望。这些改革缩小了历史上不同继承规则地区之间的生育率差距，并对法国的 demographic transition 起到了关键作用。
10.1086/739821.title: Revolutionary Transition: Inheritance Change and Fertility Decline
10.1086/739821.title_zh: 革命性转型：继承制度变迁与生育率下降

10.1086/739823.abstract: This paper examines the nature of entrepreneurship using a novel panel dataset based on US Internal Revenue Service data. We analyze income growth trajectories and the determinants of entrepreneurial choice for business owners. Compared with prior household survey–based studies, we find that self-employed individuals have significantly higher average incomes and steeper income growth than their wage-earning matched peers. Contrary to survey evidence, we find a limited role for nonpecuniary motives, uninsurable risk, and liquidity constraints driving entrepreneurial choice. Prior work experience predicts entrepreneurial entry. Entry and exit rates into self-employment remain stable over time, including during the Great Recession.
10.1086/739823.abstract_zh: 本文利用基于美国国税局数据的新颖面板数据集，探讨了创业的本质。我们分析了企业主的收入增长轨迹及创业选择的决定因素。与以往基于家庭调查的研究相比，我们发现自雇人士的平均收入显著更高，且收入增长曲线比与之匹配的工薪阶层更为陡峭。与调查证据相反，我们发现非金钱动机、不可保险风险及流动性约束在驱动创业选择方面的作用有限。先前的工作经验预示着创业进入。自雇的进入率和退出率随时间保持稳定，包括在大衰退期间也是如此。
10.1086/739823.title: On the Nature of Entrepreneurship

10.1086/739829.abstract: The Allais critique of expected utility theory (EUT) has led to the development of theories of choice under risk that relax the independence axiom but adhere to the fundamental/conventional axioms of ordering (completeness and transitivity) and monotonicity (with respect to first-order stochastic dominance). Unlike experimental work designed to test independence, our experiment is comprehensive, testing the entire set of axioms on which EUT is based. Our econometric analysis is also nonparametric and performed at the level of each individual subject. For the vast majority of subjects, departures from independence are small relative to departures from ordering and/or monotonicity.
10.1086/739829.abstract_zh: 阿莱斯对期望效用理论（EUT）的批评促使了风险条件下选择理论的发展，这些理论放宽了独立性公理，但坚持排序（完备性和传递性）及单调性（相对于一阶随机占优）的基本/传统公理。与旨在检验独立性的实验研究不同，我们的实验更为全面，测试了EUT所依据的整套公理。我们的计量分析也是非参数的，并在每个个体受试者层面进行。对于绝大多数受试者而言，偏离独立性的程度相对于偏离排序和/或单调性的程度较小。
10.1086/739829.title: Ever since Allais

10.1086/739830.abstract: Glass Walls: Experimental Evidence on Constraints Faced by Women in Accessing Valuable Skilling Opportunities
10.1086/739830.abstract_zh: 玻璃墙：女性获取高价值技能机会所面临约束的实验证据
10.1086/739830.title: Glass Walls: Experimental Evidence on Constraints Faced by Women in Accessing Valuable Skilling Opportunities
10.1086/739830.title_zh: 玻璃墙：女性获取高价值技能机会所面临限制的实验证据

10.1086/739831.abstract: We develop a life-cycle model of labor supply and human capital formation that incorporates health shocks, health insurance, and medical treatment decisions. We use the model to study effects of health shocks on health, labor supply, earnings, and earnings inequality. We also simulate provision of public insurance to agents who lack employer-sponsored insurance. While this increases medical spending substantially, it creates positive labor supply incentives for low-skill workers while reducing costs of social insurance, Medicaid, and free care. The net program cost is modest, and all model agents are ex ante better off in a balanced budget simulation.
10.1086/739831.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含健康冲击、健康保险及医疗治疗决策的劳动供给与人力资本形成的生命周期模型。利用该模型，我们研究了健康冲击对健康、劳动供给、收入及收入不平等的影响。同时，我们模拟了向缺乏雇主提供保险的个体提供公共保险的情形。尽管这显著增加了医疗支出，但它为低技能工人创造了积极的劳动供给激励，同时降低了社会保险、医疗补助及免费医疗的成本。净项目成本适中，且在平衡预算模拟中，所有模型个体的事前福利均有所改善。
10.1086/739831.title: Health Shocks, Health Insurance, Human Capital, and the Dynamics of Earnings and Health
10.1086/739831.title_zh: 健康冲击、医疗保险、人力资本与收入及健康的动态关系

10.1086/739832.abstract: The goal of this paper is to link attitude toward risk over personal consumption with attitude toward risk over social consumptions. Because many everyday choices involve risk, these attitudes enter virtually every realm of individual decision-making. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for deducing preferences over risky social choices (which have consequences both for the Decision Maker and for others) from risky personal choices (which have consequences only for the Decision Maker) and riskless social choices, and we offer an experimental test of the theory. The experiments generate a rich dataset that enables completely non-parametric revealed preference tests of the theory at the level of the individual subject. Many subjects behave as predicted by the theory but a substantial fraction do not. JEL Classification Numbers: C91, D63, D81.
10.1086/739832.abstract_zh: 本文旨在将个人消费风险态度与社会消费风险态度联系起来。由于众多日常选择涉及风险，这些态度几乎渗透到个体决策的各个领域。我们提供了必要且充分的条件，用以从个人风险选择（仅对决策者自身产生影响）及无风险社会选择中，推导出对风险性社会选择（对决策者及他人均产生影响）的偏好，并对该理论进行了实验检验。实验产生了丰富的数据集，使得能够在个体受试者层面进行完全非参数化的显示性偏好检验。许多受试者的行为符合理论预测，但相当一部分并非如此。JEL分类号：C91, D63, D81。
10.1086/739832.title: Linking Social and Personal Preferences: Theory and Experiment
10.1086/739832.title_zh: 连接社会偏好与个人偏好：理论与实验

10.1086/739973.abstract: This paper investigates the effect of land property rights on rural household welfare and resilience outcomes by using large panel data on the rollout of China’s large-scale land certification program. While the program increases households’ consumption, income, assets, and resilience scores, we find no effects on health outcome (proxied by household expenditure on health and self-reported physical health of the household head). Our heterogeneity analysis suggests that the program increases household consumption and resilience across both male- and female-headed households as well as poor and nonpoor households. We identify agricultural investments, access to credit, land rental market participation, and labor allocation as potential mechanisms through which the land certification program affects household welfare and resilience outcomes. Our findings suggest that land property rights reform could be another effective strategy to alleviate poverty in line with the poverty trap hypothesis.
10.1086/739973.abstract_zh: 本文利用中国大规模土地确权项目推行的面板数据，研究了土地产权对农村家庭福利和韧性结果的影响。尽管该项目增加了家庭的消费、收入、资产和韧性评分，但我们发现其对健康结果（以家庭医疗支出和户主自报身体健康状况为代理指标）没有影响。异质性分析表明，该项目提高了男性和女性户主家庭以及贫困和非贫困家庭的消费和韧性。我们识别出农业投资、信贷获取、土地租赁市场参与和劳动力配置是土地确权项目影响家庭福利和韧性结果的潜在机制。我们的研究结果表明，土地产权改革可能是另一种符合贫困陷阱假说的有效减贫策略。
10.1086/739973.title: Land Property Rights and Household Welfare: Evidence from Rural China
10.1086/739973.title_zh: 土地产权与家庭福利：来自中国农村的证据

10.1086/740156.abstract: Violent conflict has enduring effects on child health, but the speed at which these effects manifest is not fully understood. By use of data from a decade before to shortly after the Nigerian Boko Haram insurgency extended across the border to Cameroon, this study investigates the immediate effects of a deteriorating security environment caused by foreign-born insurgent terrorism on children’s health. Boko Haram attacks decrease weight-for-height for children under 5 years—an indicator of short-term health and nutrition—within an average of 2.6 months after the attacks. This effect is likely driven by a reduction in health-care service utilization, which can exacerbate the prevalence and the severity of conditions such as fever and diarrhea. However, the attacks do not affect dietary diversity or child mortality. The results underscore the importance of maintaining accessibility to health-care service after the start of terrorist violence to prevent irreversible effects, a concern that is increasingly relevant for countries combating the infiltration of foreign terrorists.
10.1086/740156.abstract_zh: 暴力冲突对儿童健康具有持久影响，但这些影响显现的速度尚未完全明了。本研究利用尼日利亚博科圣地叛乱跨越边境蔓延至喀麦隆前后十年的数据，探讨了由外国出生的叛乱恐怖主义导致的安全环境恶化对儿童健康的即时影响。博科圣地袭击在平均2.6个月内降低了5岁以下儿童的体重-身高比——这是衡量短期健康和营养状况的指标。这一效应很可能源于医疗服务利用的减少，这可能会加剧发烧和腹泻等疾病的患病率及严重程度。然而，袭击并未影响饮食多样性或儿童死亡率。研究结果强调了在恐怖暴力开始后保持医疗服务可及性的重要性，以防止不可逆的影响，这对于正在应对外国恐怖分子渗透的国家而言日益相关。
10.1086/740156.title: Unpacking the Links between Conflict and Child Health: Evidence from a Foreign Insurgency
10.1086/740156.title_zh: 冲突与儿童健康关联解析：来自外国叛乱的证据

10.1086/740172.abstract: We analyze a fundamental dilemma and time-inconsistency problem facing climate-concerned producers of natural gas. In the short term, it is tempting to produce more to outcompete coal. When this policy is anticipated, however, investments in renewables fall and emissions may ultimately increase. When the gas producers cannot precommit, their policies can be counterproductive. A simulated version applied to Europe verifies that the gas trap is quantitatively important. We discuss the robustness of this result and possible solutions, ranging from direct investments in renewables to taxes on the search and exploration of gas.
10.1086/740172.abstract_zh: 我们分析了关注气候的天然气生产商面临的一个根本性困境及时间不一致性问题。短期内，增加产量以超越煤炭颇具吸引力。然而，当这一政策被预期到时，可再生能源投资将减少，最终排放量可能上升。当天然气生产商无法预先承诺时，其政策可能适得其反。应用于欧洲的模拟版本验证了“天然气陷阱”在数量上的重要性。我们讨论了这一结果的稳健性及可能的解决方案，范围从对可再生能源的直接投资到对天然气勘探与开采征税。
10.1086/740172.title: The Gas Trap: Outcompeting Coal versus Renewables
10.1086/740172.title_zh: 天然气陷阱：与煤炭和可再生能源的竞争

10.1086/740185.abstract: This study extends the monocentric city model to incorporate endogenous household automobile fuel choice and dwelling energy consumption. Electric vehicle (EV) tax credits lower direct energy consumption and emissions via commuting but also cause important urban general equilibrium effects, including sprawl. This creates a substantial emissions rebound effect via larger homes, longer commutes, and greater consumption of the numeraire good. Nevertheless, EV tax credits are welfare enhancing unless electricity production is heavily tilted toward coal, with total household energy consumption and carbon emissions falling substantially.
10.1086/740185.abstract_zh: 本研究将单中心城市模型扩展至包含内生家庭汽车燃料选择和住宅能源消耗。电动汽车税收抵免通过通勤降低了直接能源消耗和排放，但也引发了重要的城市一般均衡效应，包括城市蔓延。这通过更大的住房、更长的通勤距离以及对计价商品消费的增加，产生了显著的排放反弹效应。尽管如此，除非电力生产严重偏向煤炭，电动汽车税收抵免仍能提升福利，且家庭总能源消耗和碳排放显著下降。
10.1086/740185.title: The Urban Equilibrium Effects of Electric Vehicle Tax Credits
10.1086/740185.title_zh: 电动汽车税收抵免的城市均衡效应

10.1086/740219.abstract: This paper examines how training affects productivity across hierarchical layers within organizations. After a randomized training program for frontline employees at a government agency, trained workers’ output increased while their requests for managerial assistance fell. This freed managers to focus on strategic tasks—particularly managers with the strongest connections to trained employees. A structural model of organizational hierarchy shows that spillovers to managers account for approximately 45% of the program’s total benefits, indicating that evaluations focused solely on individual trainees may substantially understate the full value of training investments.
10.1086/740219.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了培训如何影响组织内各层级员工的生产力。在一项针对政府机构一线员工的随机培训项目中，受训工人的产出增加，同时他们向管理层寻求帮助的次数减少。这使管理者得以专注于战略任务——尤其是那些与受训员工联系最紧密的管理者。一个组织结构层级模型显示，对管理者的溢出效应约占项目总收益的45%，这表明仅关注个体受训者的评估可能会大幅低估培训投资的整体价值。
10.1086/740219.title: Training, Communications Patterns, and Spillovers inside Organizations
10.1086/740219.title_zh: 组织内部培训、沟通模式与溢出效应

10.1086/740220.abstract: We use equity returns to construct a time-varying measure of the zero-beta interest rate: the expected return of a stock portfolio orthogonal to the stochastic discount factor. In contrast to safe rates, the zero-beta rate fits the aggregate consumption Euler equation remarkably well both unconditionally and conditional on monetary policy shocks and is high, volatile, and persistent enough to explain the average return and most of the volatility of the market portfolio. The puzzle is why safe rates are so low, stable, and disconnected from both consumption and the zero-beta rate.
10.1086/740220.abstract_zh: 我们利用股票收益率构建了一个随时间变化的零贝塔利率度量：即与随机贴现因子正交的股票投资组合的预期收益率。与安全利率相比，零贝塔利率在无条件情况下及货币政策冲击条件下均能极好地拟合总体消费欧拉方程，并且其水平高、波动大且持久性强，足以解释市场组合的平均回报及其大部分波动性。谜团在于，为何安全利率如此之低、稳定，且与消费及零贝塔利率均脱节。
10.1086/740220.title: The Zero-Beta Interest Rate

10.1086/740221.abstract: In a field experiment among US university students, incentives for sleep increase both sleep and academic performance. Our primary intervention pairs bedtime reminders with morning feedback and immediate rewards for sleeping at least 7 hours on weeknights. The intervention raises the share of weeknights with 7+ hours of sleep by 26% and average sleep by 19 minutes during a 4-week treatment period, with posttreatment effects of 8 minutes. Immediate incentives outperform both delayed incentives and reminders/feedback alone during treatment but have no distinguishable impacts posttreatment. The primary intervention improves average semester course performance by 0.075–0.089 grade points, a 0.10–0.11 standard deviation increase. Our results demonstrate that incentives targeting sleep can be a cost-effective approach to improve educational outcomes.
10.1086/740221.abstract_zh: 在一项针对美国大学生的实地实验中，睡眠激励措施同时提升了睡眠时长和学业表现。我们的主要干预措施结合了睡前提醒、晨间反馈以及针对工作日夜间至少睡眠7小时的即时奖励。该干预措施在为期4周的治疗期内，将工作日夜间达到7小时以上睡眠的比例提高了26%，平均睡眠时间增加了19分钟，治疗后的效果为8分钟。即时激励在治疗期间优于延迟激励及仅提供提醒/反馈的方式，但在治疗后的影响上无显著差异。主要干预措施使学期平均课程成绩提高了0.075至0.089个绩点，相当于0.10至0.11个标准差的提升。我们的结果表明，针对睡眠的激励措施可以成为改善教育成果的一种成本效益高的方法。
10.1086/740221.title: Sleep: Educational Impact and Habit Formation
10.1086/740221.title_zh: 睡眠：教育影响与习惯养成

10.1086/740222.title: Do Mergers and Acquisitions Improve Efficiency? Evidence from Power Plants
10.1086/740222.title_zh: 并购是否提升了效率？来自发电厂的证据

10.1086/740223.abstract: We state a sufficient condition under which choice data alone suffices to identify consumer preferences when choices are not fully informed. Suppose that: (i) the data generating process is a search model in which the attribute hidden to consumers is observed by the econometrician; (ii) if a consumer searches good j, she also searches goods which are better than j in terms of the non-hidden component of utility; and (iii) consumers choose the good that maximizes overall utility among searched goods. Canonical models will be biased: the value of the hidden attribute will be understated because consumers will be unresponsive to variation in the attribute for goods that they do not search. Under the conditions above and additional mild restrictions, an alternative method of recovering preferences using cross derivatives of choice probabilities succeeds regardless of the search protocol and is thus robust to whether consumers are informed. The approach nests several standard models, including full information. Our methods suggest natural tests for full information and can be used to forecast how consumers will respond to additional information. We verify in a lab experiment that our approach succeeds in recovering preferences when consumers engage in costly search.
10.1086/740223.abstract_zh: 我们给出一个充分条件，在此条件下，当消费者选择并非完全知情时，仅凭选择数据即可识别消费者偏好。假设：（i）数据生成过程是一个搜索模型，其中消费者未观察到的属性被计量经济学家观察到；（ii）若消费者搜索商品j，则她也会搜索在效用的非隐藏成分方面优于j的商品；（iii）消费者在已搜索商品中选择总效用最大化的商品。经典模型将存在偏误：隐藏属性的价值会被低估，因为消费者对未搜索商品的属性变化无反应。在上述条件及额外温和限制下，一种利用选择概率的交叉导数来恢复偏好的替代方法，无论搜索协议如何均能成功，因此对消费者是否知情具有稳健性。该方法涵盖包括完全信息在内的若干标准模型。我们的方法为完全信息提供了自然检验，并可预测消费者如何响应额外信息。我们通过实验室实验验证，当消费者进行有成本搜索时，该方法能成功恢复其偏好。
10.1086/740223.title: A Method to Estimate Discrete Choice Models That Is Robust to Consumer Search
10.1086/740223.title_zh: 一种对消费者搜索行为稳健的离散选择模型估计方法

10.1086/740224.abstract: To study long-run large-scale early childhood policies, this paper incorporates early childhood investments into a general equilibrium heterogeneous agent overlapping generations model calibrated using US data. A randomized controlled trial evaluation of a short-run small-scale early childhood program in the model predicts effects on children’s education and income that are similar to the empirical evidence. A long-run large-scale program, however, yields over twice as large welfare gains as those of a short-run small-scale program even after considering general equilibrium and taxation effects. Key to this difference is that investing in a child not only improves her skills but also creates better ancestors for future generations.
10.1086/740224.abstract_zh: 为研究长期大规模早期儿童政策，本文将早期儿童投资纳入一个以美国数据校准的通用均衡异质性主体世代交叠模型中。模型中对短期小规模早期儿童项目的随机对照试验评估预测，对儿童教育及收入的影响与实证证据相似。然而，即便考虑了一般均衡与税收效应，长期大规模项目带来的福利收益是短期小规模项目的两倍以上。这一差异的关键在于，对儿童的投资不仅提升了其个人技能，还为未来世代创造了更优秀的祖先。
10.1086/740224.title: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Early Childhood Development Policies
10.1086/740224.title_zh: 早期儿童发展政策的宏观经济后果

10.1086/740225.abstract: Mayshar, Moav, and Pascali apply an instrumental variables identification strategy to data from nearly 1,000 societies included in the Ethnographic Atlas to claim that cultivation of cereals (appropriable by elites), rather than increased land productivity following the adoption of agriculture, led to the development of the state. We show two things. (1) Evidence for the appropriability theory holds when moving from a tribe-chiefdom to a state and not more broadly. (2) Conclusions are driven by a handful of outliers with statistical significance at the 10% level lost with winsorization at 2.1% (or trimming at 1.2%) of locations by cereal advantage.
10.1086/740225.abstract_zh: Mayshar、Moav和Pascali运用工具变量识别策略，对《民族志图谱》中近1000个社会的数据进行分析，主张是谷物种植（易被精英侵占）而非农业采用后土地生产力的提高，导致了国家的形成。我们证明了两点：（1）侵占性理论在从部落-酋邦向国家过渡时得到证据支持，但并非更广泛适用；（2）结论由少数异常值驱动，当按谷物优势对地点进行2.1%的缩尾处理（或1.2%的截尾处理）时，10%水平上的统计显著性消失。
10.1086/740225.title: The Origin of the State: Land Productivity or Appropriability? Comment
10.1086/740225.title_zh: 国家的起源：土地生产力还是可占有性？评论

10.1086/740226.title: Financial Aid and Upward Mobility: Evidence from Colombia’s Ser Pilo            Paga
10.1086/740226.title_zh: 财政援助与向上流动：来自哥伦比亚“Ser Pilo Paga”项目的证据

10.1086/740411.abstract: Can a substance abuse intervention lead to sustained social ties between vulnerable women? This study analyzes the results on peer relationship outcomes of a substance abuse intervention, which included group workshops and individual and spousal counseling sessions. Using dyadic estimations, we find evidence that the intervention strengthened relationships between female peers both assigned to the treatment sixteen months post-intervention. Results were especially pronounced between pairs of treatment women in which the first had a husband with highly regressive views (generally supports wife beating) and the second woman's husband did not. Among these dyadic peer links, we find that a woman is significantly more likely to receive money from her peer, speak daily with her peer, and attend a community organization with her peer relative to those in the control. The study contributes to our understanding of methods to improve support among those who have vulnerability to IPV through building links with those less vulnerable.
10.1086/740411.abstract_zh: 物质滥用干预能否促成弱势女性之间持续的社会联系？本研究分析了一项物质滥用干预措施对同伴关系结果的影响，该干预包括小组工作坊及个人和配偶咨询会议。通过二元估计方法，我们发现有证据表明，在干预后十六个月，该干预加强了被分配至治疗组的女性同伴之间的关系。这一效果在特定配对中尤为显著：即第一方女性其丈夫持有高度倒退观点（普遍支持殴打妻子），而第二方女性的丈夫则无此观点的治疗组女性之间。在这些二元同伴联系中，我们发现，相较于对照组，一位女性显著更有可能从她的同伴那里获得金钱、每日与同伴交谈，并与同伴一同参加社区组织活动。本研究增进了我们对如何通过建立与较少受暴力风险女性的联系，来改善易受亲密伴侣暴力侵害者支持方法的理解。
10.1086/740411.title: Women Talking: Intimate Partner Violence, Group Discussions, and Their Effects on Social and Economic Ties
10.1086/740411.title_zh: 女性之声：亲密伴侣暴力、小组讨论及其对社会与经济联系的影响

10.1086/740567.abstract: This study examines the effects of droughts on economic activity, proxied by nighttime lights. Using two different indices of drought severity, one remotely sensed and one from ground-sensed meteorological data, we provide some of the first global estimates of the economic effects of drought, as opposed to temperature and precipitation. Economic impacts depend on drought severity, with moderate-or-worse droughts reducing luminosity by about 2%. Water storage in the form of accessible groundwater mitigates drought impacts. Dams moderate the effects of all but the most extreme droughts. For moderate or worse droughts, negative effects are fully offset by the presence of dams, unless some dams are hydroelectric. Upstream dams do not appear to create harmful spillovers for drought resilience downstream. Results are robust to allowing separate mediating impacts from irrigation and suggest that the resilience benefits of dams and groundwater extend beyond agriculture.
10.1086/740567.abstract_zh: 本研究以夜间灯光作为经济活动代理变量，考察干旱对经济活动的影响。利用两种干旱严重程度指数——一种基于遥感数据，另一种基于地面气象观测数据——我们提供了全球范围内干旱（而非温度和降水）经济影响的首批估计之一。经济影响取决于干旱严重程度，中度及以上干旱会使夜间灯光亮度降低约2%。以可获取地下水形式存在的水储量能够缓解干旱影响。水坝可减轻除极端干旱外所有干旱的影响。对于中度及以上干旱，除非部分水坝用于水力发电，否则其负面影响可被水坝完全抵消。上游水坝似乎不会对下游抗旱韧性产生有害溢出效应。在允许灌溉产生独立中介效应的条件下，结果依然稳健，并表明水坝和地下水的韧性效益不仅限于农业领域。
10.1086/740567.title: Droughts and Economic Activity: Do Dams and Groundwater Mediate the Impact?
10.1086/740567.title_zh: 干旱与经济活动：水坝与地下水能否缓解其影响？

10.1086/740568.abstract: Researchers deploying stated preference surveys to value public goods commonly use techniques designed to reduce bias in hypothetical choice settings. This practice is at odds with evidence that most survey respondents perceive that their decisions are not hypothetical but instead have economic consequences. We examine three bias reduction procedures in both hypothetical and incentive-compatible, real payment settings: cheap talk, solemn oath, and certainty adjustment. We confirm that adjusting hypothetical choices based on response certainty or using a solemn oath can reduce hypothetical bias. In the incentive-compatible decision setting, the oath increases willingness to pay (WTP), and certainty adjustment can lead to serious distortions in demand estimates. Cheap talk does not alter mean WTP but leads to a stark difference in WTP across sexes. To minimize unintended consequences, our results suggest that survey researchers should deploy screening questions to better target these hypothetical bias reduction techniques.
10.1086/740568.abstract_zh: 研究人员在评估公共物品价值时，常采用陈述偏好调查，并运用旨在减少假设性选择情境中偏差的技术。然而，这一做法与多数调查受访者认为其决策并非假设性而是具有经济后果的证据相悖。我们在假设性及激励兼容的真实支付情境中，考察了三种偏差减少程序：廉价谈话、庄严宣誓及确定性调整。我们确认，基于响应确定性调整假设性选择或采用庄严宣誓可减少假设性偏差。在激励兼容的决策情境下，宣誓增加了支付意愿（WTP），而确定性调整可能导致需求估计的严重扭曲。廉价谈话虽不改变平均WTP，但导致不同性别间WTP的显著差异。为最小化非预期后果，我们的研究结果表明，调查研究者应部署筛选问题，以更精准地应用这些假设性偏差减少技术。
10.1086/740568.title: Are We Doing More Harm than Good? Using Hypothetical Bias Reduction Techniques in Consequential Decision Settings
10.1086/740568.title_zh: 我们是否弊大于利？在后果性决策情境中使用假设性偏差减少技术

10.1086/740616.abstract: We test for cheap talk between husbands and wives in farm households. In a lab-in-the-field experiment, husbands allocate inputs between their own plots and their wives’ higher-return plots. We vary how returns on the wife’s plot are communicated. Across all treatments, husbands underinvest in their wives’ land. We model this with limited enforcement of marital agreements and derive additional predictions. Allocative inefficiencies are greater when women hold private information, especially in households with low resource sharing under full information. Communication only partly offsets inefficiencies, and only when information is verifiable ex post.
10.1086/740616.abstract_zh: 我们检验了农户家庭中丈夫与妻子之间的廉价交谈现象。在一项实地实验室实验中，丈夫在自有地块与妻子较高回报的地块之间分配投入。我们改变了妻子地块回报的传达方式。在所有处理组中，丈夫对妻子土地的投入均不足。我们通过婚姻协议有限执行模型对此进行建模，并推导出额外预测。当女性掌握私人信息时，配置效率损失更大，尤其是在完全信息下资源共享程度较低的家庭中。沟通仅能部分抵消效率损失，且仅在信息事后可验证时有效。
10.1086/740616.title: Communication and Production in the Family Farm: Theory and Evidence from Rural Togo
10.1086/740616.title_zh: 家庭农场中的沟通与生产：来自多哥农村的理论与证据

10.1086/740617.title: Tasks and Gender Wage Gap: Evidence from China
10.1086/740617.title_zh: 工作任务与性别工资差距：来自中国的证据

10.1086/740831.abstract: Financial stress is correlated with behavioral biases thought to negatively affect quality of economic decision-making. To investigate whether this hypothesis holds for short-term (acute) financial stress, I conducted a lab-in-the-field experiment with vendors in neighborhood markets in Addis Ababa. Half of the vendors in the study were visited by a mystery shopper who made a single sizable purchase at their stalls, tripling vendors’ average daily earnings on that day but leaving their poverty status unchanged. Vendors who received this unanticipated earnings shock reported higher than expected earnings and an improvement in psychological well-being. However, the unanticipated increase in earnings did not translate into improved cognition or decision-making. Descriptive evidence shows that monthly shortfalls in earnings are more predictive of better-quality decision-making (as proxied by income-seeking behavior) than day-to-day variation in earnings.
10.1086/740831.abstract_zh: 财务压力与被认为会对经济决策质量产生负面影响的行为偏差相关联。为探究这一假设是否适用于短期（急性）财务压力情境，我在亚的斯亚贝巴社区市场对摊贩开展了一项实地实验。研究中，半数摊贩遭遇了一位神秘顾客，在其摊位进行了一次大额购买，使这些摊贩当日平均收入增至三倍，但并未改变其贫困状态。收到这一意外收入冲击的摊贩报告称，其收入高于预期，且心理健康状况有所改善。然而，这一意外收入增加并未转化为认知能力或决策质量的提升。描述性证据表明，月度收入短缺比日常收入波动更能预测更高质量的决策（以寻求收入行为作为代理指标）。
10.1086/740831.title: Short-Term Financial Stress and Decision-Making: Evidence from Market Vendors in Addis Ababa
10.1086/740831.title_zh: 短期财务压力与决策：来自亚的斯亚贝巴市场摊贩的证据

10.1086/740839.abstract: Utilities have invested billions of dollars in advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) but proceeded slowly to deploy AMI-enabled programs that benefit consumers. High bill alert (HBA) programs, which inform consumers of unusually high usage patterns, offer an avenue for tapping AMI-enabled benefits. We evaluate an HBA program and find that the program reduced mean electricity and natural gas consumption by about 0.5%. The effects were largest at the top of the usage distribution, especially when normalized by preprogram usage, indicating that households experienced fewer expenditure shocks. Estimates of the program’s benefits and costs illustrate the importance of considering the forgone value of conserved energy when evaluating demand-side management programs in the energy sector.
10.1086/740839.abstract_zh: 公用事业公司在先进计量基础设施（AMI）上投入了数十亿美元，但在部署惠及消费者的AMI相关项目方面进展缓慢。高用量提醒（HBA）项目通过告知消费者异常高的用电模式，为挖掘AMI带来的益处提供了途径。我们评估了一个HBA项目，发现该项目使平均电力和天然气消耗降低了约0.5%。影响在使用量分布的高端最为显著，尤其是在按项目前使用量进行标准化后，这表明家庭经历的支出冲击有所减少。对该项目收益与成本的估算显示，在评估能源领域的需求侧管理项目时，考虑节约能源的放弃价值至关重要。
10.1086/740839.title: Shock Avoidance: High Bill Alert Programs and Energy Consumption
10.1086/740839.title_zh: 避免冲击：高额账单预警项目与能源消费

10.1086/740877.title: Crime-Differential Responses to an Environmental Shock: Evidence from Blackouts
10.1086/740877.title_zh: 犯罪对环境冲击的差异化反应：来自停电的证据

10.1086/740879.abstract: College education, homeownership, and automobiles are all examples of purchases where consumers sink a large up-front investment expecting to enjoy a stream of future net benefits. Often those benefits are uncertain at the time of purchase. We consider how uncertainty in future operating costs impacts the choice of vehicle fuel economy. Using measures of future gasoline price uncertainty from real options theory and comprehensive data on sales of automobiles in the United States, we find that future gasoline price uncertainty has economically meaningful impacts on vehicle demand, with a one standard deviation increase in the variance of the future price distribution increasing willingness to pay for fuel economy by 6.7%, slightly improving mean fuel economy but substantially reducing short-run vehicle sales. This new finding has implications for transportation policies that may introduce new uncertainties in future vehicle operating costs.
10.1086/740879.abstract_zh: 大学教育、购房和汽车均是消费者投入大量前期资金以期获得未来净收益流的购买行为。然而，这些收益在购买时往往存在不确定性。我们探讨了未来运营成本的不确定性如何影响车辆燃油经济性的选择。借助实物期权理论中的未来汽油价格不确定性度量指标，以及美国汽车销售的全面数据，我们发现未来汽油价格的不确定性对车辆需求具有经济意义上的显著影响：未来价格分布方差每增加一个标准差，消费者对燃油经济性的支付意愿将提高6.7%，平均燃油经济性略有改善，但短期内汽车销量显著下降。这一新发现对可能引入未来车辆运营成本新不确定性的交通政策具有启示意义。
10.1086/740879.title: A Hedge Fund in Your Garage: Automobile Purchases Under Gasoline Price            Uncertainty
10.1086/740879.title_zh: 车库里的对冲基金：汽油价格不确定性下的汽车购买行为

10.1086/740953.abstract: This study examines a Pennsylvania policy reform that increased bonded liability for coal mines with reclamation obligations. A 2001 change for surface mines was largely priced into existing reclamation insurance mechanisms, which exist to prevent mines from shirking their liabilities. We find that the changes increased mine-level insured liability and idling (≈15% for median mines), led to declines in production, and did not change environmental performance directly for treated mines. However, we do find that these effects were driven largely by higher polluting mines. Major results are robust to both comparing bituminous and anthracite mines within Pennsylvania as well as bituminous mines between Pennsylvania and Virginia.
10.1086/740953.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了宾夕法尼亚州一项政策改革，该改革提高了负有复垦义务的煤矿的有担保负债。2001年针对露天矿的一项变更，在很大程度上已被纳入现有的复垦保险机制中，该机制旨在防止煤矿逃避其责任。我们发现，这些变化增加了矿井层面的保险负债和闲置率（中位数矿井约15%），导致产量下降，且未直接改变受处理矿井的环境绩效。然而，我们确实发现这些效应主要由污染较高的矿井驱动。主要结果在比较宾夕法尼亚州内部的烟煤和无烟煤矿井，以及宾夕法尼亚州与弗吉尼亚州之间的烟煤矿井时均保持稳健。
10.1086/740953.title: Environmental Liability, Insurance, and Market Structure in Coal Mining
10.1086/740953.title_zh: 煤矿开采中的环境责任、保险与市场结构

10.1086/741020.title: Foreign Direct Investment and Gender Education Gap
10.1086/741020.title_zh: 外国直接投资与性别教育差距

10.1086/741141.abstract: As the largest user of global water, irrigated agriculture accounts for 20% of global cropland and 40% of food production. Irrigation is also a potential adaptive response to drought and extreme temperatures. This paper examines the extent to which the current global irrigation footprint reflects climate change over the last 50 years. Utilizing exogenous variation in geological structure, I find evidence that farmers adapt by increasing groundwater irrigation in places that became dryer and hotter. The results hold globally and in the US. Observed recent warming is responsible for 9% of global irrigation growth. GRACE satellite data shows that climate-driven irrigation contributes to aquifer stress, as well as increased soil salinity, thus representing large negative externalities of adaptation to climate change and a potential threat to future food security. ∗I would like to thank Wolfram Schlenker, Frances Moore, Douglas Almond, Jaime Mullins, Geoffrey Heal, Pierre Gentine, Thomas Braun, and Jeffrey Shrader for their comments, as well as participants at the AERE@EEA conference, WEAI conference, and Climate Economics Workshop at UC Berkeley. †School of International and Public Affairs and The Earth Institute, Columbia University. cat2180@columbia.edu
10.1086/741141.abstract_zh: 作为全球最大的水资源使用者，灌溉农业占据了全球耕地的20%和粮食产量的40%。灌溉也是对干旱和极端温度的一种潜在适应性响应。本文考察了当前全球灌溉足迹在多大程度上反映了过去50年的气候变化。利用地质构造的外生变异，我发现了农民通过在地势更干燥、温度更高的地区增加地下水灌溉来适应气候变化的证据。这一结果在全球范围内以及美国均成立。观测到的近期变暖现象导致了全球灌溉增长的9%。GRACE卫星数据显示，气候驱动的灌溉加剧了含水层压力，并增加了土壤盐碱度，从而代表了适应气候变化带来的巨大负面外部性，以及对未来粮食安全的潜在威胁。
10.1086/741141.title: Irrigation and Climate Change: Long-Run Adaptation and Its Externalities
10.1086/741141.title_zh: 灌溉与气候变化：长期适应及其外部性

10.1086/741162.title: Environmental Regulation, Labor Income Share, and Implications for Inequality
10.1086/741162.title_zh: 环境规制、劳动收入份额及其对不平等的影响

10.1086/741272.abstract: An updating rule specifies how an agent reacts to information. An updating rule is Blackwell monotone if more information is always better for an agent in a decision problem and strictly Blackwell monotone if, in addition, there is always a decision problem in which more information is strictly better for an agent. Bayes'law is strictly Blackwell monotone, and I show that within a broad class of updating rules--those that distort the Bayesian posteriors in a signal-independent manner--it is the only strictly Blackwell-monotone updating rule. If an agent's decisions are evaluated non-paternalistically (according to her beliefs), the Blackwell-monotone updating rules are affine distortions of the Bayesian posteriors.
10.1086/741272.abstract_zh: 更新规则规定了代理人如何对信息做出反应。若在决策问题中，更多信息对代理人总是更有利，则该更新规则是布莱克威尔单调的；若此外还存在某个决策问题，使得更多信息对代理人严格更有利，则该规则是严格布莱克威尔单调的。贝叶斯法则具有严格布莱克威尔单调性，本文证明：在一大类更新规则（即以信号无关方式扭曲贝叶斯后验概率的规则）中，贝叶斯法则是唯一满足严格布莱克威尔单调性的更新规则。若代理人的决策依据其自身信念进行非家长式评估，则布莱克威尔单调的更新规则是贝叶斯后验概率的仿射扭曲形式。
10.1086/741272.title: Blackwell-Monotone Updating Rules
10.1086/741272.title_zh: 布莱克韦尔-单调更新规则

10.1086/741274.abstract: I propose a general theory of strategic network formation based on increasing marginal linking costs and vertical heterogeneity among the players. In the spirit of revealed preference, I describe the entire set of graphs that can be stable, without making any parametric assumptions about players’ preferences. Stable graphs feature assortativity and clustering, and I highlight conditions that lead to hierarchies and cliquish behavior. Extensions shed light on which findings are robust and which are more fragile. Collectively, these results map interpretable properties of preferences to particular network structures and furnish new tools to study strategic network formation.
10.1086/741274.abstract_zh: 我提出一个基于递增边际连接成本和参与者间垂直异质性的战略网络形成一般理论。遵循显示偏好的精神，我描述了所有可能稳定的图集，而不对参与者的偏好做任何参数假设。稳定图表现出同配性和聚类性，并强调了导致层级结构和派系行为的条件。扩展部分揭示了哪些发现是稳健的，哪些更为脆弱。总体而言，这些结果将偏好的可解释属性映射到特定网络结构，并为研究战略网络形成提供了新工具。
10.1086/741274.title: Making a Swap: Network Formation with Increasing Marginal Costs
10.1086/741274.title_zh: 进行交换：边际成本递增下的网络形成

10.1086/741288.title_zh: 农业中的劳动力短缺与技术采用：来自COVID-19疫情期间印度农村的证据
