10.1086/741342.title_zh: 减少教育机会对劳动力市场结果的影响：来自女性大学限制的证据

10.1086/741353.title: In the Name of Love: Policy Imitation, Political Incentives, and Local Economic Growth
10.1086/741353.title_zh: 以爱之名：政策模仿、政治激励与地方经济增长

10.1086/741450.title: Tackling Women’s Unemployment: Evidence from an Online Jobs Experiment in Bangladesh
10.1086/741450.title_zh: 解决女性失业问题：来自孟加拉国在线就业实验的证据

10.1086/741509.abstract: Emerging datasets capture rich temporal variation in recreation behavior, but recreation demand analyses have traditionally used variation across sites, rather than across time, to value environmental amenities. We introduce a model and estimation procedure designed to exploit panel variation in recreation demand analyses by embedding panel data causal inference techniques within a travel cost random utility model. To demonstrate the method, we use “structural synthetic controls” to value the welfare losses caused by water-quality-induced beach closures in southeast Michigan. Losses tend to be larger on weekends and hotter days, and our results suggest that a stigma effect reduces visitation even after the beach reopens. Our method is particularly useful for valuing the recreational impacts of resource shocks, like harmful algal blooms or wildfires, and it can be applied broadly given the increasing availability of high-frequency recreation data.
10.1086/741509.abstract_zh: 新兴数据集捕捉了休闲行为中丰富的时间变化，但传统的休闲需求分析通常利用地点间的差异，而非时间上的差异，来评估环境设施的价值。我们提出了一种模型和估计程序，旨在通过将面板数据因果推断技术嵌入旅行成本随机效用模型中，利用休闲需求分析中的面板变化。为演示该方法，我们采用“结构合成控制法”来评估密歇根州东南部因水质引起的海滩关闭所造成的福利损失。损失在周末和炎热天气下往往更大，我们的结果表明，即使在海滩重新开放后，污名效应仍会减少游客访问量。我们的方法特别适用于评估资源冲击（如有害藻华或野火）对休闲活动的影响，并且随着高频休闲数据的日益可得，该方法可广泛应用。
10.1086/741509.title: Causal Inference, High-Frequency Data, and the Recreational Value of Water Quality
10.1086/741509.title_zh: 因果推断、高频数据与水质休闲价值

10.1086/741528.title: Automation Trends and Labor Markets
10.1086/741528.title_zh: 自动化趋势与劳动力市场

10.1086/741557.abstract: Do citizens value the electrification of public transport? Cleaner and quieter services should increase consumer welfare. Yet this response has not been tested, despite the vast investment planned by governments worldwide. We provide a three-pronged empirical analysis of the demand response to bus electrification. First, commuters alighting from electric buses report higher satisfaction regarding noise, fumes, and smell compared with a diesel bus control. Second, residents of a neighborhood exposed to electric buses for over one year are willing to pay US$0.085 for an electric relative to a diesel bus ride, which amounts to US$20 per resident per year. Consumer welfare gains are US$250,000 per electric bus procured—a neglected demand-side cobenefit in public transit’s energy transition that is similar in size to the carbon savings. Third, ridership is higher on electrified bus lines. This effect increases with the timing, duration, and intensity of a bus line’s electrification.
10.1086/741557.abstract_zh: 公民是否重视公共交通的电气化？更清洁、更安静的服务应能提升消费者福利。然而，尽管全球各国政府规划了巨额投资，这一反应尚未得到验证。我们针对公交电气化的需求响应进行了三管齐下的实证分析。首先，与柴油公交车对照组相比，从电动公交车下车的通勤者对噪音、废气和气味的满意度更高。其次，暴露于电动公交车超过一年的社区居民，愿意为乘坐电动公交车而非柴油公交车支付0.085美元，相当于每位居民每年20美元。消费者福利收益为每辆采购的电动公交车25万美元——这是公共交通能源转型中被忽视的需求侧协同效益，其规模与碳节约相当。第三，电气化公交线路的客流量更高。这一效应随着公交线路电气化的时间、持续时间和强度而增强。
10.1086/741557.title: Satisfaction, Willingness to Pay, and Ridership When Buses Are            Electrified
10.1086/741557.title_zh: 公交车电动化后的满意度、支付意愿与乘客量

10.1086/741559.abstract: While deforestation may yield short-term economic gains, it has lasting impacts on climate change, biodiversity, and water systems. The age of political leaders is a key determinant of how these trade-offs are managed. We study closely contested elections in Brazil and show that when a young politician is in power there is less deforestation (p-value .000), lower greenhouse gas emissions (p-value .061), but higher local income (p-value .023). Results are partly explained by young mayors turning over the bureaucracy with younger public servants (p-value .043).
10.1086/741559.abstract_zh: 尽管森林砍伐可能带来短期经济收益，但它对气候变化、生物多样性和水系统产生持久影响。政治领导人的年龄是管理这些权衡的关键决定因素。我们研究了巴西竞争激烈的选举，并表明当年轻政治家执政时，森林砍伐减少（p值.000），温室气体排放降低（p值.061），但地方收入提高（p值.023）。结果部分归因于年轻市长通过更年轻的公务员实现官僚机构更替（p值.043）。
10.1086/741559.title: Young Local Politicians and Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon
10.1086/741559.title_zh: 年轻地方政治家与巴西亚马逊地区的森林砍伐

10.1086/741590.abstract: Has automakers’ use of artificial intelligence (AI) in advanced driver-assistance systems (ADASs) improved automobile safety? We address this question with a first-of-its-kind trim-level dataset of the universe of registered automobiles and accidents in Texas over a 9-year period. We find that ADASs reduce the risk of a motorist getting in any type of accident by 11 to 14 percent and reduce the risk of a motorist getting in a single-vehicle fatal accident by roughly one-third. Our finding that ADASs have improved automobile safety is especially important because it provides early evidence of the benefits of vehicle automation in actual travel environments. Hopefully, it will spur greater interest in the development and widespread adoption of fully autonomous vehicles and in the potential benefits of other transportation technologies using AI.
10.1086/741590.abstract_zh: 汽车制造商在高级驾驶辅助系统（ADASs）中应用人工智能（AI）是否提升了汽车安全性？我们利用覆盖得克萨斯州9年间所有注册车辆及事故的首个车型级别数据集，对此问题展开研究。研究发现，ADASs使驾驶员发生任何类型事故的风险降低11%至14%，并将单车致命事故的风险降低约三分之一。这一结论尤为重要，因为它首次提供了车辆自动化在实际出行环境中带来益处的早期证据。我们期待该发现能激发对全自动驾驶汽车研发与普及的更大兴趣，并推动对运用AI的其他交通技术潜在效益的深入探索。
10.1086/741590.title: AI at the Wheel: The Effectiveness of Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems
10.1086/741590.title_zh: AI驾驶：高级驾驶辅助系统的有效性

10.1086/741602.abstract: Policy makers frequently champion information provision about carbon impact on the premise that consumers are willing to mitigate their emissions but are poorly informed about how to do so. We empirically test this argument and reject it. We collect an extensive new dataset and find both large misperceptions of the carbon impact of different consumption behaviors and clear preferences for mitigation. Yet, in two separate experiments, we show that correcting beliefs has no effect on consumption in large representative samples. Our null results are well-powered and informative, as we target information for maximal impact. These results call into question the potential of correcting carbon footprint misperceptions as a tool to fight climate change.
10.1086/741602.abstract_zh: 政策制定者常以消费者愿意减少碳排放但缺乏相关知识为前提，主张提供碳影响信息。我们通过实证检验了这一论点并予以否定。通过收集大量新数据集，我们发现消费者对不同消费行为的碳影响存在严重认知偏差，同时具有明确的减排偏好。然而，在两项独立实验中，我们证明纠正认知偏差对大规模代表性样本的消费行为并无影响。我们的零结果具有充分统计效力且富有信息量，因为所提供的信息针对的是最大影响目标。这些结果对将纠正碳足迹认知偏差作为应对气候变化工具的有效性提出了质疑。
10.1086/741602.title:
Correcting Consumer Misperceptions about CO
                    <sub>2</sub>
                    Emissions
10.1086/741602.title_zh: 纠正消费者对二氧化碳排放的误解

10.1086/741623.abstract: We consider estimation and inference for a regression coefficient in panels with interactive fixed effects (i.e., with a factor structure). We demonstrate that existing estimators and confidence intervals (CIs) can be heavily biased and size-distorted when some of the factors are weak. We propose estimators with improved rates of convergence and bias-aware CIs that remain valid uniformly, regardless of factor strength. Our approach applies the theory of minimax linear estimation to form a debiased estimate, using a nuclear norm bound on the error of an initial estimate of the interactive fixed effects. Our resulting bias-aware CIs take into account the remaining bias caused by weak factors. Monte Carlo experiments show substantial improvements over conventional methods when factors are weak, with minimal costs to estimation accuracy when factors are strong.
10.1086/741623.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了具有交互固定效应（即因子结构）的面板数据中回归系数的估计与推断问题。我们证明，当部分因子较弱时，现有估计量和置信区间可能存在严重偏误和尺寸扭曲。为此，我们提出具有更优收敛速度的估计量，以及无论因子强度如何均能保持均匀有效性的偏误感知置信区间。该方法运用极小化极大线性估计理论，通过对交互固定效应初始估计误差的核范数约束构建去偏估计量。由此得到的偏误感知置信区间能够充分考虑弱因子导致的剩余偏误。蒙特卡洛实验表明，在因子较弱时，该方法较传统方法有显著改进，而在因子较强时对估计精度的影响极小。
10.1086/741623.title: Robust Estimation and Inference in Panels with Interactive Fixed Effects
10.1086/741623.title_zh: 交互固定效应面板数据的稳健估计与推断

10.1086/741624.abstract: We develop an asset demand system to analyze the equilibrium relation between international portfolio holdings and flows, exchange rates, and asset prices across all countries. We introduce a nested logit model of asset demand, for which we develop a new identification strategy by instrumental variables. Averaged across years and issuer countries, the demand elasticities are 27.9 for short-term debt, 3.2 for long-term debt, and 1.2 for equity. These demand elasticities are empirical targets for international macro models that feature inelastic demand to resolve long-standing puzzles in international finance. We use the estimated demand system to decompose the variation in exchange rates and asset prices into portfolio flows and shifts in asset demand to interpret economic events such as the European sovereign debt crisis and to estimate the convenience yields on US assets. In units of annual expected returns, the convenience yield is 1.41% on the US dollar, 2.71% on US long-term debt, and 0.50% on US equity.
10.1086/741624.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个资产需求系统，用以分析全球各国国际投资组合持有量、资金流动、汇率及资产价格之间的均衡关系。我们引入了一个嵌套逻辑模型来描述资产需求，并为此开发了一种新的工具变量识别策略。按年份和发行国平均计算，需求弹性分别为：短期债务27.9，长期债务3.2，以及股票1.2。这些需求弹性为国际宏观模型中应对需求缺乏弹性的情况提供了实证基准，有助于解决国际金融领域长期存在的难题。我们利用估计出的需求系统，将汇率和资产价格的变动分解为投资组合流动和资产需求变化，以解读欧洲主权债务危机等经济事件，并估算美国资产的便利收益。以年化预期收益为单位，美元的便利收益为1.41%，美国长期债务为2.71%，美国股票为0.50%。
10.1086/741624.title: Exchange Rates and Asset Prices in a Global Demand System
10.1086/741624.title_zh: 全球需求体系中的汇率与资产价格

10.1086/741641.abstract: We study changes in markups across 70 product markets from 2006 to 2018. A growing literature has documented rising markups using a production function approach. We instead estimate demand and invert firms’ first-order pricing conditions to infer markups. To make the method scalable, we propose estimating nested logit demand models using household panel data to automate the assignment of products to nests. We find an overall upward trend in markups, with considerable heterogeneity across and within product markets. These increases are primarily driven by changes in firms’ marginal costs and households’ price sensitivity instead of changes in firm ownership.
10.1086/741641.abstract_zh: 我们研究了2006年至2018年间70个产品市场的加成率变化。现有文献多采用生产函数方法记录加成率的上升趋势。我们则转而估计需求，并通过反转企业的一阶定价条件来推断加成率。为使该方法具有可扩展性，我们提出利用家庭面板数据估计嵌套Logit需求模型，以自动化产品归巢分配。研究发现，加成率总体呈上升趋势，但各产品市场间及市场内部存在显著异质性。这些增长主要由企业边际成本变化和家庭价格敏感度变化驱动，而非企业所有权变动所致。
10.1086/741641.title: Scalable Demand and Markups
10.1086/741641.title_zh: 可扩展需求与加成定价

10.1086/741689.abstract: There is renewed interest in valuing the natural assets that sustain human welfare and economic prosperity. The science associated with many renewable natural asset stocks often highlights risk, uncertainty, and tipping points (nonconvexities). However, there is little guidance in the literature concerning how to incorporate risk or tipping points within capital dynamics into the valuation of nonmarket assets. We extend and demonstrate the theory of natural capital valuation for smooth stochasticity (diffusions) with convex and nonconvex drift terms and for “stochastic nonconvexities,” whereby a stock is subject to endogenous risk of collapse. We highlight pathways for risk to influence capital valuations, demonstrating conditions where diffusions with convex dynamics have negligible effects on shadow prices. However, we find that risk has large stock-dependent effects in the context of nonconvexities. Our findings suggest that efforts to incorporate risk into natural capital valuation should prioritize settings where nonconvex capital dynamics are likely.
10.1086/741689.abstract_zh: 近年来，人们重新关注对支撑人类福祉和经济繁荣的自然资产的估值问题。与许多可再生自然资产存量相关的科学往往强调风险、不确定性和临界点（非凸性）。然而，文献中关于如何将资本动态中的风险或临界点纳入非市场资产估值的指导甚少。我们扩展并展示了自然资本估值理论，涵盖具有凸和非凸漂移项的平滑随机性（扩散过程），以及“随机非凸性”，即存量面临内生性崩溃风险的情形。我们强调了风险影响资本估值的途径，证明了在凸动态扩散条件下风险对影子价格的影响可忽略不计的条件。然而，我们发现，在非凸性背景下，风险具有显著的存量依赖效应。我们的研究结果表明，将风险纳入自然资本估值的努力应优先考虑非凸资本动态可能出现的场景。
10.1086/741689.title: Risky (Natural) Assets: Stochasticity, Nonconvexity, and the Value of Natural Capital
10.1086/741689.title_zh: 风险性（自然）资产：随机性、非凸性与自然资本价值

10.1086/741704.abstract: Benefit transfer (BT) has evolved as the dominant valuation method for environmental benefit-cost analyses, including those required of US federal agencies. Yet even best-practice approaches for BT based on meta-regression models (MRMs) typically exhibit poor predictive fit and out-of-sample precision. This article introduces random forests (RFs) for nonparametric estimation of MRMs and construction of BT predictions. We compare the performance of different RF models to current best-practice approaches for BT. We find that forest-based models substantially improve the out-of-sample accuracy of welfare predictions and tighten confidence intervals of predicted benefits for stipulated policy scenarios. The best performers reside within the family of local linear forests (LLFs), a hybrid approach that combines elements of RFs and locally weighted regression. Results suggest that this new approach has the potential to substantially improve BT accuracy for environmental policymaking without sacrificing theoretical properties, while simultaneously reducing econometric and computational difficulties relative to leading alternatives.
10.1086/741704.abstract_zh: 效益转移（BT）已成为环境效益-成本分析中的主导估值方法，包括美国联邦机构所需的分析。然而，即便是基于元回归模型（MRMs）的最佳实践BT方法，通常也表现出较差的预测拟合度和样本外精度。本文引入随机森林（RFs）用于MRMs的非参数估计及BT预测的构建。我们将不同RF模型的性能与当前BT最佳实践方法进行比较。研究发现，基于森林的模型显著提高了福利预测的样本外准确性，并收紧了规定政策情景下预测效益的置信区间。表现最佳的模型属于局部线性森林（LLFs）家族，这是一种结合了RFs和局部加权回归元素的混合方法。结果表明，这一新方法有潜力在不牺牲理论性质的前提下，显著提升环境政策制定中BT的准确性，同时相对于领先的替代方法，减少了计量经济学和计算上的困难。
10.1086/741704.title: Random Forests for Benefit Transfer
10.1086/741704.title_zh: 随机森林在效益转移中的应用

10.1086/741829.abstract: Conservation on working agricultural lands provides many ecosystem services, and public funding for conservation programs has increased substantially over the past two decades. This study estimates the public economic benefits of agricultural conservation through its capitalization in US housing markets. We spatially link USDA Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP) data with individual property transactions to estimate residents’ valuation of environmental amenities provided by conservation practices. Using a repeat-sales model, we find that agricultural conservation increases local housing prices, with benefits capitalized up to 20 miles. In addition, we show that conservation payments made two years ago have larger impacts than those made in the previous year, suggesting the importance of accounting for the temporal dynamics of conservation impacts. We also examine the heterogeneous impacts across practices targeting different resource concerns or with different design lifespans. Our results highlight the positive impact of agricultural conservation on nearby communities.
10.1086/741829.abstract_zh: 在耕作农业用地上实施保护措施提供了多种生态系统服务，过去二十年间，针对保护项目的公共资金投入显著增加。本研究通过农业保护在美国住房市场中的资本化效应，评估其公共经济效益。我们将美国农业部环境质量激励计划（EQIP）数据与个体房产交易记录进行空间关联，以估算居民对保护实践所提供的环境便利设施的估值。采用重复销售模型，我们发现农业保护提升了当地房价，其效益可资本化至20英里范围内。此外，研究显示，两年前实施的保护支付对房价的影响大于前一年实施的，这表明在考虑保护影响时需重视其时间动态性。我们还考察了针对不同资源问题或具有不同设计寿命的保护措施所产生的异质性影响。我们的研究结果凸显了农业保护对邻近社区的积极影响。
10.1086/741829.title: Public Economic Benefits of Agricultural Conservation: Evidence from Housing Markets
10.1086/741829.title_zh: 农业保护对公共经济利益的贡献：来自住房市场的证据

10.1086/741830.abstract: We estimate the effect of competition on incumbent firm pricing by using high frequency price data and the precise geographic location for all gas stations in California. Using an event study design, we find that the entry of a new station is associated with a 2.5 cent decrease in prices at incumbent stores, which equates to a 7% reduction in estimated retail markups. The effects are immediate, persistent, and show no sign of deterrence or limit pricing behavior. In contrast, nearby exit results in precisely estimated null effects on prices with no evidence of predatory pricing in the lead up to the station departure. The results are consistent across all fuel blends and dissipate with station distance. Finally, we explore the asymmetric effects, showing that the difference cannot be attributed to difference in branding, proximity to highway, or data quality idiosyncrasies, although we find suggestive evidence that exit tends to happen in more competitive markets and amongst less heavily trafficked stations.
10.1086/741830.abstract_zh: 我们利用高频价格数据和加利福尼亚州所有加油站的精确地理位置，估算了竞争对现有企业定价的影响。通过事件研究设计，我们发现新加油站的进入导致现有门店价格下降2.5美分，相当于零售加价幅度减少7%。这种影响是即时且持久的，没有表现出任何威慑或限制性定价行为的迹象。相比之下，附近加油站的退出对价格产生了精确估计的零效应，且在退出前未发现掠夺性定价的证据。所有燃料混合物的结果均一致，并随距离增加而减弱。最后，我们探讨了非对称效应，表明这种差异不能归因于品牌差异、高速公路邻近性或数据质量特性，尽管我们发现了暗示性证据，即退出往往发生在竞争更激烈的市场以及交通流量较少的加油站中。
10.1086/741830.title: The Effects of Competition in the Retail Gasoline Industry
10.1086/741830.title_zh: 零售汽油行业竞争的影响

10.1086/742108.abstract: The prospect for electric vehicles (EVs) as a climate change solution hinges on their widespread adoption across political lines. This study uses county-level data to show that from 2012 to 2023 about half of all new EV registrations in the United States went to the 10% most Democratic counties, and about one-third went to the top 5%. This correlation is largely stable over time and remains after controlling for household income, gasoline prices, and other observables. EV trucks are a small share of the EV market but show a lower correlation than other EV types. We also conducted a survey, finding little difference in the ability of Democrats and Republicans to answer questions about EVs.
10.1086/742108.abstract_zh: 电动汽车（EV）作为气候变化解决方案的前景，取决于其在各政治派别中的广泛普及。本研究利用县级数据表明，从2012年至2023年，美国新增电动汽车注册量中约有一半流向了最倾向民主党的10%县，约三分之一流向了前5%的县。这一相关性在时间上基本保持稳定，并且在控制家庭收入、汽油价格及其他可观测因素后依然存在。电动卡车在电动汽车市场中所占份额较小，但其相关性低于其他类型的电动汽车。我们还进行了一项调查，发现民主党人和共和党人在回答有关电动汽车问题上的能力几乎没有差异。
10.1086/742108.title: Political Ideology and U.S. Electric Vehicle Adoption

10.1086/742163.abstract: The European Union (EU) is implementing a Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) at its borders, which will require exporters of basic materials to surrender emission permits when exporting to the EU market. Since it makes foreign producers compete under a carbon price, the EU CBAM may motivate some trade partners to implement their own carbon pricing mechanisms, thereby encouraging the creation of a coalition of countries with ambitious carbon pricing policies protected by a joint CBAM. Such geostrategic potential of the EU CBAM has been identified in previous literature, but the conditions under which it could be realised remain largely unknown. Here, we present a modelling framework to simulate the potential of CBAMs to motivate the creation of climate coalitions. We use a fully interlinked New Quantitative Trade model to evaluate the pay-offs of a dynamic club negotiation model. Compared to previous research, our approach allows for a more granular definition of climate policies and requires relatively little input data and numerical power. This allows us to explore the formation and stability of climate coalitions under a broader range of CBAM implementation options. Our results highlight that the potential of a CBAM-based climate coalition strongly depends on the exact CBAM design. In its current version, the EU CBAM would only trigger the formation of a modest coalition. Future extensions of the EU CBAM could motivate the adoption of carbon pricing in all countries except China, India and Russia. Meanwhile, export rebates shrink its coalition-building potential.
10.1086/742163.abstract_zh: 欧盟正在其边境实施碳边境调节机制（CBAM），要求基本材料出口商在向欧盟市场出口时交出排放许可证。由于该机制使外国生产者在碳价格下竞争，欧盟CBAM可能促使一些贸易伙伴实施自己的碳定价机制，从而鼓励形成一个由联合CBAM保护、拥有雄心勃勃碳定价政策的国家联盟。欧盟CBAM的这种地缘战略潜力已在先前文献中被识别，但其实现条件在很大程度上仍属未知。在此，我们提出一个建模框架，以模拟CBAM激励气候联盟形成的潜力。我们使用一个完全互联的新量化贸易模型来评估动态俱乐部谈判模型的收益。与先前研究相比，我们的方法允许对气候政策进行更细粒度的定义，并且所需输入数据和数值计算能力相对较少。这使我们能够在更广泛的CBAM实施选项下探索气候联盟的形成与稳定性。我们的结果强调，基于CBAM的气候联盟潜力强烈依赖于CBAM的具体设计。在其当前版本下，欧盟CBAM仅能触发一个适度联盟的形成。未来欧盟CBAM的扩展可能激励除中国、印度和俄罗斯以外的所有国家采纳碳定价。同时，出口退税削弱了其构建联盟的潜力。
10.1086/742163.title: The potential of Carbon Border Adjustments to foster climate cooperation

10.1086/742258.abstract: Carbon dioxide removal (CDR) is considered essential for climate change mitigation, yet its optimal role in climate policy remains unclear in the presence of non-permanent storage, energy constraints, and fossil fuel scarcity. We integrate CDR into an analytic integrated assessment model to derive general conditions for socially optimal CDR deployment. Within a linear carbon cycle model, we consider diﬀerent CDR pathways, including direct air carbon capture, ocean alkalinity enhancement, and ocean iron fertilization. Introducing CDR does not significantly alter the optimal carbon price and the incentive to reduce emissions. The impact of CDR on gross emissions mainly stems from the energy required to operate it. This impact, as well as the optimal deployment of CDR, depends on fossil fuel scarcity and the pace of renewable energy deployment. In high-damage scenarios, the optimal deployment of CDR occurs before and around the year 2100, consistent with temperature overshoot pathways.
10.1086/742258.abstract_zh: 二氧化碳移除（CDR）被视为减缓气候变化的关键手段，然而在存在非永久性封存、能源约束及化石燃料稀缺性的情况下，其在气候政策中的最优角色仍不明确。我们将CDR整合进一个分析性综合评估模型中，以推导社会最优CDR部署的一般条件。在线性碳循环模型框架内，我们考虑了不同的CDR路径，包括直接空气碳捕集、海洋碱度增强及海洋铁施肥。引入CDR并未显著改变最优碳价格及减排激励。CDR对总排放的影响主要源于其运行所需的能源。这一影响以及CDR的最优部署，取决于化石燃料的稀缺性和可再生能源部署的速度。在高损害情景下，CDR的最优部署发生在2100年前后，与温度过冲路径相一致。
10.1086/742258.title: From Gross to Net: Carbon Dioxide Removal in an Analytic Climate Economy

10.1086/742354.abstract: How important are social norms, information gaps and family constraints in explaining the low rates of female labor force participation (FLFP) in conservative societies? To answer this question, we conducted a field experiment embedded in a survey of female university students at a large public university in Saudi Arabia. We randomly provided one subset of individuals with information on the labor market and aspirations of their female peers (T1), while another subset was provided with this information along with a prime that made their parents more salient (T2). We find that expectations of working among those in the Control group are quite high, yet students underestimate the expected labor force attachment of their female peers. We show that social information matters: relative to the Control group, expectations about own labor force participation are significantly higher in the T1 group, which is driven primarily by receiving information about their peers' aspirations. We show that T2, as intended, causes students to report a higher importance of parents' approval of their choices. However, we do not find that the impact of information is counteracted by evoking parental expectations: impacts for the T2 group on labor market expectations are not smaller than those for T1 group. However, T2 does lead to higher expectations of working in Education and the Public sectors -sectors that are more socially acceptable for women, suggesting that parental expectations their daughters' labor market aspirations but partly shape them.
10.1086/742354.abstract_zh: 社会规范、信息差距和家庭约束在解释保守社会中女性劳动力参与率（FLFP）偏低方面有多重要？为回答这一问题，我们在沙特阿拉伯一所大型公立大学对女大学生进行了一项嵌入调查的实地实验。我们随机向一组受试者提供了关于其女性同龄人在劳动力市场和 aspirations 方面的信息（T1），而另一组则在此基础上额外获得了一种提示，使她们父母的重要性更加凸显（T2）。我们发现，对照组中对工作的期望相当高，但学生们低估了其女性同龄人的预期劳动力参与度。我们证明，社会信息具有重要性：与对照组相比，T1组中对自身劳动力参与度的期望显著更高，这主要源于接收到关于同龄人 aspirations 的信息。我们表明，T2 按预期导致学生报告父母对其选择认可的重要性更高。然而，我们并未发现信息的影响因唤起父母期望而被抵消：T2组对劳动力市场期望的影响并不小于T1组。但T2确实导致了对教育和公共部门工作期望的更高值——这些部门对女性而言更具社会接受度，这表明父母的期望并未削弱女儿的劳动力市场 aspirations，但在一定程度上塑造了它们。

10.1086/742418.abstract: Recent years have seen tremendous advances in the theory and application of sequential experiments. While these experiments are not always designed with hypothesis testing in mind, researchers may still be interested in performing tests after the experiment is completed. The purpose of this paper is to aid in the development of optimal tests for sequential experiments by analyzing their asymptotic properties. Our key finding is that the asymptotic power function of any test can be matched by a test in a limit experiment where a Gaussian process is observed for each treatment, and inference is made for the drifts of these processes. This result has important implications, including a powerful sufficiency result: any candidate test only needs to rely on a fixed set of statistics, regardless of the type of sequential experiment. These statistics are the number of times each treatment has been sampled by the end of the experiment, along with final value of the score (for parametric models) or efficient influence function (for non-parametric models) process for each treatment. We then characterize asymptotically optimal tests under various restrictions such as unbiasedness, α-spending constraints etc. Finally, we apply our our results to three key classes of sequential experiments: costly sampling, group sequential trials, and bandit experiments, and show how optimal inference can be conducted in these scenarios.
10.1086/742418.abstract_zh: 近年来，序贯实验的理论与应用取得了巨大进展。尽管这些实验并非总是以假设检验为设计初衷，但研究者仍可能在实验结束后有兴趣进行检验。本文旨在通过分析序贯实验的渐近性质，助力开发最优检验方法。我们的核心发现是，任何检验的渐近功效函数都可以通过一个极限实验中的检验来匹配，在该极限实验中，每种处理观测到一个高斯过程，并针对这些过程的漂移进行推断。这一结果具有重要含义，包括一个强有力的充分性结论：任何候选检验仅需依赖一组固定的统计量，无论序贯实验的类型如何。这些统计量包括实验结束时每种处理被采样的次数，以及每种处理得分（对于参数模型）或有效影响函数（对于非参数模型）过程的最终值。随后，我们在无偏性、α支出约束等各种限制条件下刻画了渐近最优检验。最后，我们将结果应用于三类关键的序贯实验：成本采样、组序贯试验和老虎机实验，并展示了在这些情境下如何进行最优推断。
10.1086/742418.title: Optimal Tests Following Sequential Experiments
10.1086/742418.title_zh: 序贯实验后的最优检验

10.1086/742420.abstract: I derive a formula for the equilibrium distribution of markups in the search-theoretic model of imperfect competition of Butters (1977), Varian (1980), and Burdett andJudd (1983).The level of markups and the sign of the relationship between a seller's markup and its size depends on the extent of search frictions, as well as on other deep parameters.Markups are efficient.Markups are positive even though the varieties produced by sellers are perfect substitutes.Markups are heterogeneous even when all sellers operate the same production technology.Markups depend on size, even though the substitutability between a variety and the others does not depend on how much of that variety is consumed.Interpreting these markups through the lens of the monopolistic competition model of Dixit and Stiglitz (1977) would lead one to recover incorrect and unstable buyers' preferences.Interpreting these markups through the lens of the Dixit-Stiglitz model would also leads to incorrect policy recommendations.These results are a cautionary note on recent work in macroeconomics.
10.1086/742420.abstract_zh: 我推导出了在Butters（1977）、Varian（1980）以及Burdett和Judd（1983）的不完全竞争搜索理论模型中，加成率均衡分布的公式。加成率的水平及其与卖方规模之间关系的符号，取决于搜索摩擦的程度以及其他深层参数。加成率是有效率的。尽管卖方生产的品种是完全替代品，加成率仍为正。即使所有卖方采用相同的生产技术，加成率也是异质的。加成率依赖于规模，尽管某一品种与其他品种之间的替代性并不取决于该品种的消费量。若通过Dixit和Stiglitz（1977）的垄断竞争模型来解读这些加成率，将会导致恢复出不正确且不稳定的买方偏好。同样，通过Dixit-Stiglitz模型解读这些加成率，也会得出错误的政策建议。这些结果对宏观经济学领域近期的研究提出了警示。
10.1086/742420.title: Markups: A Search-Theoretic Perspective

10.1086/742434.abstract: An informed seller designs a dynamic mechanism to sell an experience good. The seller has partial information about the product match, which affects the buyer's private consumption experience. We characterize equilibrium mechanisms of this dynamic informed principal problem. The belief gap between the informed seller and the uninformed buyer, coupled with the buyer's learning, gives rise to mechanisms that provide the skeptical buyer with limited access to the product and an option to upgrade if the buyer is swayed by a good experience. Depending on the seller's screening technology, this takes the form of free/discounted trials or tiered pricing, which are prevalent in digital markets. In contrast to static environments, having consumer data can reduce sellers' revenue in equilibrium, as they fine-tune the dynamic design with their data forecasting the buyer's learning process.
10.1086/742434.abstract_zh: 一位知情卖方设计了一个动态机制来销售体验型商品。卖方对产品匹配度拥有部分信息，这影响买方私人的消费体验。我们刻画了这一动态知情委托人问题中的均衡机制。知情卖方与不知情买方之间的信念差距，加之买方的学习过程，催生了这样的机制：为持怀疑态度的买方提供有限的产品接触机会，并在买方因良好体验而动摇时给予升级选项。根据卖方的筛选技术，这表现为免费或折扣试用，或分级定价，这些在数字市场中普遍存在。与静态环境相比，拥有消费者数据可能降低卖方在均衡中的收入，因为他们利用数据预测买方的学习过程，从而微调动态设计。
10.1086/742434.title: From Doubt to Devotion: Trials and Learning-Based Pricing
10.1086/742434.title_zh: 从怀疑到忠诚：基于试验与学习的定价策略

10.1086/742435.abstract: We study the macroeconomic implications of asymmetric information in capital markets.We build a quantitative capital-accumulation model in which capital is traded in illiquid markets, with sellers having more information about capital quality than buyers.Asymmetric information distorts the terms of trade for sellers of high-quality capital, who list higher prices and are willing to accept lower trading probabilities to signal their type.Led by the model's predictions, we measure the distortions from asymmetric information by studying the relationship between listed prices and trading probabilities in a unique dataset of individual capital units listed for trade.By combining the empirical measurement with the model, we show that information asymmetries can play a quantitatively large role during economic crises when the degree of asymmetric information deteriorates.
10.1086/742435.abstract_zh: 我们研究资本市场中信息不对称对宏观经济的影响。我们构建了一个定量资本积累模型，其中资本在非流动性市场上交易，卖方对资本质量的了解程度高于买方。信息不对称扭曲了高质量资本卖方的交易条件，他们设定更高的价格，并愿意接受较低的交易概率以传递其类型信号。受模型预测的引导，我们通过研究一个独特的个体资本单位交易挂牌数据集中挂牌价格与交易概率之间的关系，来衡量信息不对称造成的扭曲。将实证测量与模型相结合，我们表明，在经济危机期间，当信息不对称程度恶化时，信息不对称可能发挥数量上显著的作用。

10.1086/742585.abstract: Zero-interest green loan programs (ZIGL) are gaining traction to address the tremendous financing needs implied by net-zero emission targets. We provide the first evaluation of such a program, the \emph{Éco-Prêt à Taux Zéro}, introduced in France in 2009 to encourage home energy retrofits. Using an event-study design applied to a panel survey of 10,000 households, we find evidence that the program had a substantial, yet short-lived, effect. Eligibility to the program increased investment by 20-22\% on the extensive margin and 2-3\% on the intensive one, thereby generating 3\% electricity savings. The effects are however limited to the first two years, after which they turn non-significant. They are primarily driven by low-income homeowners, suggesting the program effectively alleviates credit constraints. These results are robust to a range of robustness checks, including placebo regressions and propensity score weighting. They lead to leverage estimates in the 1.3-1.7 range in the `successful' period and below 1 thereafter. Using additional banking data to investigate the post-2011 failure, we find suggestive evidence that banks exploited prospective borrowers’ incomplete information to sell them their own loan products in lieu of a ZIGL.
10.1086/742585.abstract_zh: 零利率绿色贷款项目（ZIGL）正日益受到关注，以应对净零排放目标所隐含的巨大融资需求。我们首次对此类项目进行了评估，即法国于2009年推出的“零利率生态贷款”（Éco-Prêt à Taux Zéro），旨在鼓励家庭能源改造。通过将事件研究设计应用于一项涵盖10,000户家庭的面板调查，我们发现证据表明该项目产生了显著但短暂的效果。符合资格条件使投资在广泛边际上增加了20-22%，在集约边际上增加了2-3%，从而实现了3%的电力节约。然而，这些效应仅限于前两年，之后变得不再显著。这些效应主要由低收入房主驱动，表明该项目有效缓解了信贷约束。这些结果在一系列稳健性检验中保持稳健，包括安慰剂回归和倾向得分加权。在“成功”期间，杠杆估计值在1.3-1.7范围内，此后降至1以下。利用额外的银行数据调查2011年后的失效现象，我们发现了暗示性证据，表明银行利用潜在借款人的信息不完全，向其推销自有贷款产品以替代ZIGL。

10.1086/742595.abstract: Remotely sensed measurements and other machine learning predictions are increasingly used in place of direct observations in empirical analyses. Errors in such measures may bias parameter estimation, but it remains unclear how large such biases are or how to correct for them. We leverage a new benchmark dataset providing co-located ground truth observations and remotely sensed measurements for multiple variables across the contiguous U.S. to show that the common practice of using remotely sensed measurements without correction leads to biased parameter point estimates and standard errors across a diversity of empirical settings. More than three-quarters of the 95% confidence intervals we estimate using remotely sensed measurements do not contain the true coefficient of interest. These biases result from both classical measurement error and more structured measurement error, which we find is common in machine learning based remotely sensed measurements. We show that multiple imputation, a standard statistical imputation technique so far untested in this setting, effectively reduces bias and improves statistical coverage with only minor reductions in power in both simple linear regression and panel fixed effects frameworks. Our results demonstrate that multiple imputation is a generalizable and easily implementable method for correcting parameter estimates relying on remotely sensed variables.
10.1086/742595.abstract_zh: 遥感测量及其他机器学习预测在实证分析中日益取代直接观测数据。此类测量中的误差可能导致参数估计偏误，但此类偏误的严重程度及修正方法尚不明确。我们利用一项新的基准数据集，该数据集提供了美国本土多个变量的共址地面实况观测与遥感测量数据，以证明在多种实证情境下，未经修正直接使用遥感测量的常见做法会导致参数点估计及标准误出现偏误。我们使用遥感测量数据估计的95%置信区间中，超过四分之三未包含真实的关注系数。这些偏误既源于经典测量误差，也源于更具结构性的测量误差，而后者在基于机器学习的遥感测量中普遍存在。我们证明，多重插补——一种在此情境下尚未得到检验的标准统计插补技术——能有效减少偏误并提升统计覆盖率，且在简单线性回归及面板固定效应框架中仅带来轻微的功效损失。我们的研究结果表明，多重插补是一种可推广且易于实施的方法，适用于修正依赖遥感变量的参数估计。

10.1086/742710.abstract: We study the frictions in dealer-intermediation in residential real estate through the lens of "iBuyers," technology entrants, who purchase and sell residential real estate through online platforms. iBuyers supply liquidity to households by allowing them to avoid a lengthy sale process. They sell houses quickly and earn a 5% spread. Their prices are well explained by a simple hedonic model, consistent with their use of algorithmic pricing. iBuyers choose to intermediate in markets that are liquid, and in which automated valuation models have low pricing error. These facts suggest that iBuyers' speedy offers may come at the cost of information loss concerning house attributes that are difficult to capture in an algorithm, resulting in adverse selection. We calibrate a dynamic structural search model with adverse selection to understand and quantify the economic forces underlying the tradeoffs of dealer intermediation in this market.
10.1086/742710.abstract_zh: 我们通过“iBuyers”（技术新进入者）的视角，研究住宅房地产中经销商中介的摩擦，这些iBuyers通过在线平台购买和销售住宅房地产。iBuyers通过允许家庭避免冗长的销售过程来提供流动性。他们快速出售房屋并赚取5%的价差。其价格能很好地由一个简单的特征价格模型解释，这与他们使用算法定价的做法一致。iBuyers选择在流动性强且自动估值模型定价误差低的市场中进行中介。这些事实表明，iBuyers的快速报价可能以损失难以在算法中捕捉的房屋属性信息为代价，从而导致逆向选择。我们校准了一个包含逆向选择的动态结构搜索模型，以理解和量化该市场中经销商中介权衡背后的经济力量。

10.1086/742710.title_zh: 为什么房屋中介如此困难？来自iBuyers的证据

10.1086/742712.abstract: In this paper we provide new estimates of the impact of unions on nonunion wage setting. We allow the presence of unions to affect nonunion wages both through the typically discussed channel of nonunion firms emulating union wages in order to fend off the threat of unionisation and through a bargaining channel in which nonunion workers use the presence of union jobs as part of their outside option. We specify these channels in a search and bargaining model that includes union formation and, in our most complete model, the possibility of nonunion firm responses to the threat of unionisation. Our results indicate an important role played by union wage spillovers in lowering wages over the 1980-2010 period. We find de-unionisation can account for 38% of the decline in the mean hourly wage between 1980 and 2010, with two-thirds of that effect being due to spillovers. Both the traditional threat and bargaining channels are operational, with the bargaining channel being more important.
10.1086/742712.abstract_zh: 本文提供了工会对非工会工资设定影响的新估计。我们允许工会的存在通过两种途径影响非工会工资：一是通常讨论的非工会企业为抵御工会化威胁而模仿工会工资的渠道；二是通过谈判渠道，非工会工人将工会工作的存在作为其外部选择的一部分。我们在一个包含工会形成的搜索与谈判模型中具体化了这些渠道，并在我们最完整的模型中，考虑了非工会企业对工会化威胁可能作出的反应。我们的结果表明，在1980年至2010年期间，工会工资溢出效应在降低工资方面发挥了重要作用。我们发现，去工会化可以解释1980年至2010年间平均小时工资下降的38%，其中三分之二的影响归因于溢出效应。传统的威胁渠道和谈判渠道均发挥作用，且谈判渠道更为重要。

10.1086/742713.abstract: The U.S. shale boom has profoundly increased crude oil movements by both pipelines-the traditional mode of transportation-and railroads. This paper develops a model of how pipeline investment and railroad use are determined in equilibrium, emphasizing how railroads' flexibility allows them to compete with pipelines. We show that policies that address crude-by-rail's environmental externalities by increasing its costs should lead to large increases in pipeline investment and substitution of oil flows from rail to pipe. Similarly, we find that policies enjoining pipeline construction would cause 80-90% of the displaced oil to flow by rail instead.
10.1086/742713.abstract_zh: 美国页岩气繁荣深刻改变了原油运输方式，既包括传统管道运输，也涉及铁路运输。本文构建了一个模型，探讨管道投资与铁路使用如何在均衡中决定，强调铁路的灵活性使其能够与管道竞争。我们表明，通过提高原油铁路运输成本来解决其环境外部性的政策，应导致管道投资大幅增加，并将石油流量从铁路转向管道。同样，我们发现，禁止管道建设的政策将导致80-90%的转移石油改由铁路运输。

10.1086/742939.abstract: This paper utilizes wealth shocks from winning lottery prizes to examine the causal effect of financial resources on fertility. We employ extensive panels of administrative data encompassing over 0.4 million lottery winners in Taiwan and implement a triple-differences design. Our analyses reveal that a substantial lottery win can significantly increase fertility, the implied wealth elasticity of which is around 0.06. Moreover, the primary channel through which fertility increases is by prompting first births among previously childless individuals. Finally, our analysis reveals that approximately 25% of the total fertility effect stems from increased marriage rates following a lottery win.
10.1086/742939.abstract_zh: 本文利用中奖彩票带来的财富冲击，考察金融资源对生育率的因果效应。我们采用涵盖台湾地区超过40万彩票中奖者的广泛行政数据面板，并实施三重差分设计。分析表明，大额彩票中奖能显著提高生育率，其隐含的财富弹性约为0.06。此外，生育率提升的主要渠道是促使此前无子女的个体生育头胎。最后，我们的分析揭示，约25%的总生育效应源于中奖后结婚率的上升。

10.1086/742941.abstract: Using multiple administrative data sources from Norway, we examine how firm performance changes after entrepreneurs become parents.Female-owned businesses experience a substantial decline in profits, steadily decreasing to 30% below baseline ten years post-childbirth.In contrast, male-owned businesses show no decline, often growing in revenues and costs after childbirth.The profit decline for female-owned firms is most pronounced among highly capable entrepreneurs, women who are majority owners, and those with working spouses.Entrepreneurial effort is key to performance, and our findings suggest that time demands from childbirth and childcare are a significant determinant of the decline in firm profits.
10.1086/742941.abstract_zh: 利用挪威的多项行政数据来源，我们考察了企业家成为父母后企业绩效的变化。女性拥有的企业在利润上出现显著下降，产后十年内利润持续下滑至基准水平的30%。相比之下，男性拥有的企业未出现下降，且在产后收入和成本往往有所增长。女性企业利润下降在能力较强的企业家、女性占多数股权的所有者以及配偶有工作的群体中最为明显。创业努力是绩效的关键因素，我们的研究结果表明，生育和育儿的时间需求是导致企业利润下降的重要决定因素。

10.1086/743072.abstract: This paper examines the impact of immigration on natives' social trust in the context of China's mass internal migration. Combining individual-level information on social trust and county-level information on immigration rate, we employ the instrumental variable strategy and find that immigration has a significant negative impact on trust among native residents. The impact of immigration on trust is more salient for trust in weak ties than trust in strong ties, and from a compositional perspective, the impact of low-skilled immigrants is more salient than that of high-skilled immigrants. Additional analyses suggest that better public services can buffer the impact of immigration on trust, implying a key role in public policy.
10.1086/743072.abstract_zh: 本文以中国大规模内部人口迁移为背景，考察移民对本地居民社会信任的影响。通过结合个体层面的社会信任数据与县级层面的移民率信息，采用工具变量策略发现：移民对本地居民的社会信任具有显著的负向影响。从信任类型来看，移民对弱关系信任的冲击强于强关系信任；从移民结构来看，低技能移民的影响比高技能移民更为显著。进一步分析表明，更优质的公共服务能够缓冲移民对信任的冲击，这揭示了公共政策在此过程中的关键作用。

10.1086/743334.abstract: This paper examines the resilience of city structure to a large shock and its underlying economic mechanisms. We analyze the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, which was an exogenous shock that leveled the city center but not its periphery, by combining newly digitized data with a dynamic quantitative urban model. We first construct spatially granular data within Hiroshima and document the resilience: the city center recovered just about five years after being destroyed. Importantly, we also show that the recovery of the city center is not necessarily explained by its fundamental locational characteristics. We then develop a novel dynamic urban economics model that allows us to disentangle the mechanisms underlying the recovery. Our calibrated model finds that strong agglomeration forces, together with individuals’ expectations of the recovery, created a strong incentive to rebuild the city center quickly despite the catastrophic shock.
10.1086/743334.abstract_zh: 本文考察了城市结构在面对重大冲击时的韧性及其背后的经济机制。我们以广岛原子弹爆炸为例，这一外生冲击夷平了城市中心但未波及周边区域，通过结合新数字化数据与动态定量城市模型进行分析。我们首先构建了广岛内部空间粒度数据，并记录了其韧性表现：城市中心在被摧毁后仅约五年便得以恢复。重要的是，我们还表明，城市中心的恢复并不必然由其基础区位特征所解释。随后，我们开发了一个新颖的动态城市经济学模型，以厘清恢复背后的机制。校准模型发现，强大的集聚力量，加之个体对恢复的预期，共同构成了在灾难性冲击后迅速重建城市中心的强烈激励。

10.1086/743387.abstract: Changes in transport costs can affect mobility in ways that differ across the population, affecting the impacts of transport policies. We randomly assign large price reductions on Uber in Egypt over a 3-month period and collect comprehensive data on participant mobility using Google Timeline. A 50% price reduction quadruples Uber usage and induces a 42% increase in total travel. Effects and welfare gains are larger for women, who are less mobile at baseline and perceive public transit as unsafe. The price elasticity of private vehicle kilometers traveled (-1.28) implies that mobility and external costs increase substantially when ride-hailing prices fall.
10.1086/743387.abstract_zh: 运输成本的变化可能以不同方式影响不同人群的流动性，从而影响交通政策的效应。我们在埃及对Uber实施为期三个月的大幅降价随机分配，并利用Google Timeline收集参与者流动性的全面数据。降价50%使Uber使用量翻两番，并导致总出行量增加42%。对于基线流动性较低且认为公共交通不安全的女性，其影响和福利收益更为显著。私人车辆行驶公里数的价格弹性（-1.28）表明，当网约车价格下降时，流动性和外部成本会大幅增加。

10.1086/743389.abstract: Boys are less likely than girls to enter college, a gap that is often attributed to a lack of non-cognitive skills such as motivation and self-discipline.We study how being classified as gifted -determined by having an IQ score of 116 or higher -affects college entry rates of disadvantaged children in a large urban school district.For boys with IQ's around the cutoff, gifted identification raises the college entry rate by 25-30 percentage points -enough to catch up with girls in the same IQ range.In contrast, we find small effects for girls.Looking at course-taking and grade outcomes in middle and high school, we find large effects of gifted status for boys that close most of the gaps with girls, but no detectable effects on standardized tests scores of either gender.Overall, we interpret the evidence as demonstrating that gifted services raise the non-cognitive skills of boys conditional on their cognitive skills, leading to gains in educational attainment.
10.1086/743389.abstract_zh: 男孩进入大学的比例低于女孩，这一差距常被归因于缺乏动机和自律等非认知技能。我们研究在一个大型城市学区中，被认定为资优——依据智商分数达到116或以上——如何影响弱势儿童的大学入学率。对于智商接近临界值的男孩，资优认定将大学入学率提高了25至30个百分点——足以赶上同智商范围内的女孩。相比之下，我们发现对女孩的影响较小。通过考察初中和高中的课程选择及成绩结果，我们发现资优身份对男孩有显著影响，缩小了与女孩之间的大部分差距，但对两性的标准化测试成绩均无可检测的影响。总体而言，我们将证据解读为表明，资优服务在认知技能不变的情况下提升了男孩的非认知技能，从而带来了教育成就上的收益。

10.1086/743452.abstract: Religious holidays are associated with changes to usual routines and special religious practices that can worsen air pollution. Using the Hakka Tomb Sweeping Day in Taiwan as an illustration, we find that religious activities lower overall air quality by 10.8% and increase levels of specific pollutants by 9.8% - 18.6%. In contrast to previous studies suggesting elevated air pollution is due to the burning of incense, joss paper and fireworks, we identify greater motor vehicle use and a decrease in travel speed as primary mechanisms. Changes in traffic also lead to a 16% increase in injuries from motor vehicle accidents. In Hakka areas serviced by rail lines we find no increase in air pollution or injuries during Tomb Sweeping Day, highlighting the benefits of public transportation to accommodate holiday travel.
10.1086/743452.abstract_zh: 宗教节日往往伴随着日常作息的变化及特定的宗教习俗，这些因素可能加剧空气污染。以台湾地区的客家清明节为例，我们发现宗教活动使整体空气质量下降10.8%，特定污染物浓度上升9.8%至18.6%。与先前研究将空气污染加剧归因于焚烧香烛、纸钱及燃放鞭炮不同，我们识别出机动车使用增加及行驶速度降低为主要机制。交通变化还导致机动车事故伤害增加16%。在设有铁路线路的客家地区，清明节期间未观察到空气污染或伤害事件的增加，这凸显了公共交通在应对节日出行需求方面的益处。

10.1086/743610.abstract: We measure the impact of two main signals of tertiary-level human capital accumulation, college quality and certification, on hiring in India. Using a correspondence experiment, we send 16,944 resumes to 1,412 job postings for recent engineering graduates at small and medium firms. We do not find evidence that either of the two signals that we consider have effects on callbacks separately. Specifically, the impact of having graduated from a mid-tier college ranked in the top 300 relative to an unranked college outside of the top 1000 is close to zero and precisely estimated, despite significant government investment in ranking colleges in India. There is also a precisely estimated null effect of scoring in the highest as opposed to the lowest quartile of a post-tertiary certification test that has been taken by millions of graduating students. Resumes with female names modestly benefit in this first stage of the hiring process.
10.1086/743610.abstract_zh: 我们衡量了高等教育人力资本积累的两个主要信号——大学质量和认证——对印度招聘的影响。通过一项通信实验，我们向1,412个针对近期工程毕业生的小型和中型企业职位发布发送了16,944份简历。我们没有发现我们所考虑的这两个信号对回电有任何单独影响的证据。具体而言，毕业于排名前300的中等层次大学相对于未进入前1000名排名的大学，其影响接近于零且估计精确，尽管印度政府在大学排名方面投入了大量资金。此外，在数百万毕业生参加的毕业后认证测试中，得分最高四分位数相对于最低四分位数的效应也被精确估计为零。带有女性名字的简历在招聘流程的这一初始阶段略有优势。

10.1086/743899.abstract: I show democratizations have a large, negative impact on asset valuations driven by a rise in redistribution risk. Across 90 countries over 200 years, risk premia are substantially elevated in democratizations, similar in magnitude to financial crises. Using a shift in Catholic church doctrine in support of democracy, I provide causal evidence that democratizations increase risk premia. Successful democratizations lead to substantial redistribution: the size of the public sector grows, income inequality falls, and the labor share of income rises. A model of asset prices and political regimes in which wealthy asset market participants face redistribution risk in democratizations can quantitatively explain these effects. The model also explains the negligible asset pricing response to autocratizations. Neither an increase in macroeconomic risk nor generic political risk can explain the results.
10.1086/743899.abstract_zh: 我证明民主化对资产估值具有显著的负面影响，这一影响源于再分配风险的上升。在跨越200年、涵盖90个国家的研究中，民主化期间的风险溢价显著升高，其幅度与金融危机相当。利用天主教会教义转向支持民主这一变化，我提供了因果证据表明民主化提升了风险溢价。成功的民主化导致实质性再分配：公共部门规模扩大，收入不平等程度下降，劳动收入份额上升。一个将资产价格与政治体制相结合的模型，其中富裕的资产市场参与者面临民主化中的再分配风险，能够定量解释这些效应。该模型同样解释了为何威权化对资产定价的影响微乎其微。宏观经济风险的增加或一般性政治风险均无法解释这些结果。
10.1086/743899.title: Who Values Democracy?

10.1086/743900.abstract: This paper studies whether common leadership, defined as two firms sharing executives or board directors, contributes to collusion. Using an explicit measure of labor market collusion from unsealed court evidence, we find that the probability of collusion between two firms increases by 11 percentage points after the onset of common leadership, a ninefold increase over the baseline rate. These results are not driven by closeness of product or labor market competition. Our findings are consistent with the increasing attention toward common leadership under Clayton Act Section 8. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
10.1086/743900.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了共同领导——即两家企业共享高管或董事会成员——是否助长了合谋行为。利用来自公开法庭证据的劳动力市场合谋明确度量指标，我们发现，在共同领导关系建立后，两家企业之间发生合谋的概率上升了11个百分点，相较于基准率增长了九倍。这些结果并非由产品或劳动力市场竞争的紧密程度所驱动。我们的发现与《克莱顿法案》第8条下对共同领导日益增长的关注相吻合。订阅NBER工作论文系列的机构及发展中国家的居民可免费从www.nber.org下载本文。

10.1086/743914.abstract: We study social learning using experiments where two people independently learn relevant information and can share it to make accurate private decisions. Across three experiments, people are substantially less sensitive to information others discover than to equally-relevant information they discovered themselves. This holds when they must learn information from others through discussion; when the experimenter perfectly communicates the information; and even when participants observe others’ information with their own eyes. Our results therefore stem not from a failure to elicit information from others but a systematic tendency to underweight it relative to one’s own information. Our findings illustrate a powerful barrier to social learning that might underlie many documented cases of failure to learn from others.
10.1086/743914.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究社会学习，其中两人独立获取相关信息，并可分享这些信息以做出准确的私人决策。在三个实验中，人们对他人发现的信息的敏感度远低于对自身发现的同等相关信息。这一现象在以下情况下均成立：当人们必须通过讨论从他人处学习信息时；当实验者完美传达信息时；甚至当参与者亲眼目睹他人的信息时。因此，我们的结果并非源于未能从他人处获取信息，而是源于一种系统性的倾向，即相对于自身信息，人们会低估他人信息。我们的发现揭示了社会学习中的一个强大障碍，这可能解释了诸多记录在案的学习他人失败的案例。

10.1086/743961.abstract: Standard occupational classifications obscure identifying which jobs directly con tribute to decarbonization. Using U.S. online job vacancy data, we develop a trans parent, skill-based approach that identifies low-carbon jobs within occupations, by combining advanced natural language processing with text linked to established green classifications. We show that low-carbon job creation is more prevalent in low-skilled occupations, yet low-carbon jobs systematically require more complex skill sets than comparable generic jobs in the same occupations. These higher skill requirements are associated with a modest wage premium that declines over time and is largely driven by firm fixed effects. Reskilling patterns and low-carbon wage premia vary substantially across occupations, and the latter are markedly smaller than the high-carbon wage premia, especially in STEM occupations. Finally, low carbon jobs are more spatially correlated with high-carbon employment than just renewable energy jobs, but are also more prevalent in wealthier areas.
10.1086/743961.abstract_zh: 标准职业分类难以明确识别哪些工作直接促进脱碳。利用美国在线职位空缺数据，我们开发了一种透明、基于技能的方法，通过结合先进自然语言处理与既定绿色分类相关文本，识别职业内部的低碳工作。研究表明，低碳岗位创造更多集中于低技能职业，然而低碳工作系统性地要求比同一职业中类似普通岗位更复杂的技能组合。这些更高的技能要求与适度的工资溢价相关，该溢价随时间递减，且主要由企业固定效应驱动。技能重塑模式与低碳工资溢价在不同职业间差异显著，且后者明显小于高碳工资溢价，尤其在STEM职业中。最后，低碳工作与高碳就业的空间相关性高于仅可再生能源岗位，但低碳工作在更富裕地区也更为普遍。
10.1086/743961.title: Emerging skills and wage gaps in the low-carbon transition: evidence from online job vacancy data
10.1086/743961.title_zh: 低碳转型中的新兴技能与工资差距：来自在线招聘数据的证据

10.1093/acprof:oso/9780199204175.003.000.abstract: This chapter explains an essential feature of power properties: directedness, which provides a direction to a particular manifestation. The chapter contends that the connection between power and manifestation is a difficult but necessary task for the theory of powers. It evaluates the strengths and faults of the Brentano thesis, and analyses the topic of intentionality, which includes the parallels between psychological intentionality and physical intentionality. The chapter also provides accounts of the objections to physical intentionality, including impossible intentional objects, the threat of panpsychism, unique intentional objects, and the deluge of necessities. Lastly, the chapter proposes to treat physical intentionality as an undefined primitive of the theory of properties.
10.1093/acprof:oso/9780199204175.003.000.abstract_zh: 本章阐释了能力属性的一个基本特征：方向性，它为特定表现提供了指向。本章主张，能力与表现之间的联系是能力理论中一项艰巨但必要的任务。本章评估了布伦塔诺论点的优势与不足，并分析了意向性主题，包括心理意向性与物理意向性之间的相似之处。本章还阐述了针对物理意向性的反对意见，包括不可能意向对象、泛心论的威胁、独特意向对象以及必然性的泛滥。最后，本章提议将物理意向性视为属性理论中一个未定义的原始概念。
10.1093/acprof:oso/9780199204175.003.000.title: Directedness in Search

10.1093/ej/ueag054.abstract: This paper investigates whether tax evasion opportunities can increase tax revenue. Past theoretical discussions have presented mixed outcomes as to whether allowing taxpayers to opt into uncertainty could indeed enhance overall tax revenues. In this study, we conducted a series of original real-effort experiments in an online setting with almost 6,000 participants to test this hypothesis empirically. Our findings show significant positive labour supply responses to the opportunity to evade (increased labour supply by 30%). More importantly, the expected tax revenue significantly and substantially increased by up to 40%. Strikingly, this effect persists when comparing effective tax rates: Lowering effective tax rates through probabilistic enforcement (the opportunity to evade) is more efficient than simply lowering statutory tax rates. Our findings suggest that the opportunity for tax evasion can increase tax revenues beyond what a corresponding decrease in nominal rates would achieve.
10.1093/ej/ueag054.abstract_zh: 本文探讨逃税机会能否增加税收收入。以往的理论讨论对于允许纳税人选择不确定性是否确实能提高整体税收收入，得出了相互矛盾的结果。在本研究中，我们通过在线环境开展了一系列原创的真实努力实验，涉及近6000名参与者，以实证检验这一假设。研究结果显示，逃税机会显著激发了劳动供给的正向反应（劳动供给增加30%）。更重要的是，预期税收收入显著且大幅增长，增幅高达40%。引人注目的是，在比较有效税率时，这一效应依然存在：通过概率性执法（即逃税机会）降低有效税率，比单纯降低法定税率更为高效。我们的发现表明，逃税机会带来的税收收入增长，可能超过相应名义税率下调所能实现的效果。
10.1093/ej/ueag054.title: The Bright Side of Tax Evasion

10.1093/ej/ueag055.abstract: Partisan vitriol has become a defining feature of American politics, evident in survey responses and social media discourse. Conventional wisdom holds that these expressions reflect deeply rooted hostility. Yet they may also function as social signals, reinforcing loyalty and conformity within partisan groups. In this view, animosity is less about entrenched ideological divisions and more about fostering cohesion among co-partisans. We test this proposition in two settings. First, using the 2012 American National Election Studies, which recorded interviewer partisanship, we exploit within-interviewer variation to examine whether respondents adjusted their reported hostility depending on the partisan identity of their interviewer. Respondents expressed significantly more animosity when interviewed by a co-partisan and less when facing an opposing-partisan interviewer. Second, in an online experiment with 1,510 participants, we find that revealing a partner’s partisan alignment—when it matched the participant’s—encouraged more frequent out-group attacks and in-group promotion. These behaviours were strongly shaped by social norms: participants were substantially more likely to attack when their partner had done so in the previous round. Together, these findings suggest that partisan hostility is contingent on immediate social context, not solely on deeply held animus.
10.1093/ej/ueag055.abstract_zh: 党派恶语相向已成为美国政治的一个显著特征，在调查反馈和社交媒体讨论中随处可见。传统观点认为，这些言论反映了根深蒂固的敌意。然而，它们也可能发挥社会信号的作用，强化党派内部的忠诚与从众心理。按照这种观点，敌意更多源于促进同党成员间的凝聚力，而非固化的意识形态分歧。我们在两个场景中检验了这一命题。首先，利用记录了访谈者党派归属的2012年美国全国选举研究数据，我们通过分析同一访谈者面对不同受访者时的差异，考察受访者是否会根据访谈者的党派身份调整其表达的敌意程度。结果显示，当受访者面对同党访谈者时，其表达的敌意显著增强；而面对对立党派访谈者时，敌意则明显减弱。其次，在一项包含1510名参与者的在线实验中，我们发现：当参与者得知搭档的党派立场与自己一致时，他们会更频繁地攻击外群体并推崇内群体。这些行为深受社会规范的影响——若搭档在前一轮中发起攻击，参与者发动攻击的可能性会显著提高。综合来看，这些发现表明，党派敌意取决于即时的社会情境，而非仅仅源于根深蒂固的敌视情绪。
10.1093/ej/ueag055.title: Animosity is for the Audience: How Social Context Shapes Expressions of Political Hostility
10.1093/ej/ueag055.title_zh: 敌意是给观众看的：社会情境如何塑造政治敌意的表达

10.1093/ej/ueag057.abstract: Exploiting a 1960s government trial in Copenhagen, we study the long-run effects of preventive health care for toddlers. We combine administrative data with handwritten nurse records to document universal treatment take-up. Treated children enjoy a five percent of a standard deviation increase in a good adult health index. While initial trial cohorts experience positive health and labour market impacts, those are absent for the final cohorts. Impacts are largest for children with initial health disadvantage and females, and we identify childhood health improvements as a core mechanism. The heterogeneity of trial effects across individuals’ initial health status and cohorts documents that universal toddler care can alleviate health inequalities at low costs, and that the counterfactual policy environment matters.
10.1093/ej/ueag057.abstract_zh: 利用20世纪60年代在哥本哈根开展的一项政府试验，我们研究了幼儿预防性医疗保健的长期影响。我们将行政数据与手写护士记录相结合，记录了普遍的治疗接受情况。接受治疗的儿童在成年健康综合指数上提高了0.05个标准差。尽管最初的试验队列在健康和劳动力市场方面产生了积极影响，但最终队列并未观察到这些影响。对于初始健康状况较差的儿童和女性，影响最为显著，并且我们确定儿童期健康状况改善是核心机制。试验效果因个体初始健康状况和队列而异，这表明普遍的幼儿保健能够以低成本缓解健康不平等，且反事实政策环境至关重要。
10.1093/ej/ueag057.title: Universal Investments in Toddler Health. Learning from a Large Government Trial
10.1093/ej/ueag057.title_zh: 幼儿健康的普遍投资：来自一项大型政府试验的启示

10.1093/ej/ueag059.abstract: Dominant platforms like Booking.com have often imposed Price Parity Clauses to prevent lower prices on alternative sales channels. We provide quasi-experimental evidence on the removal of these price restrictions in France in 2015 for three major global hotel groups. Our analysis reveals limited and non-significant price effects for rooms sold through consumer-visible channels, such as hotels’ websites or online travel agencies. However, we document a significant price reduction on sales channels not visible to consumers, such as direct offline bookings. Additionally, we identify a significant shift in the share of bookings from online travel agencies to the hotels’ direct offline channels.
10.1093/ej/ueag059.abstract_zh: 像Booking.com这样的主导平台经常实施价格一致性条款，以防止替代销售渠道出现更低价格。我们针对2015年法国三大全球酒店集团取消这些价格限制的情况，提供了准实验证据。分析显示，对于通过消费者可见渠道（如酒店官网或在线旅行社）销售的客房，价格影响有限且不显著。然而，我们发现，在消费者不可见的销售渠道（如直接线下预订）上，价格显著下降。此外，我们还发现预订份额从在线旅行社显著转向酒店的直接线下渠道。
10.1093/ej/ueag059.title: The Price Effects of Prohibiting Price Parity Clauses: Evidence from Global Hotel Chains
10.1093/ej/ueag059.title_zh: 禁止价格平价条款的价格效应：来自全球连锁酒店的证据

10.1093/ej/ueag061.abstract: Direct public funding of R&D investment to stimulate technological innovation has a strong theoretical case and has gained renewed attention in recent times as a way to address the long-term challenges of modern society, such as economic growth, climate change, energy independence, and national security. We estimate the dynamic macroeconomic effects of government R&D investment and we find that it is very effective in fostering the national innovation effort by crowding in private R&D investment and raising aggregate output in the long run, but also that it stimulates a strong expansion from the outset, in particular through anticipation effects.
10.1093/ej/ueag061.abstract_zh: 直接公共资助研发投资以刺激技术创新具有坚实的理论依据，近年来作为应对现代社会长期挑战（如经济增长、气候变化、能源独立和国家安全）的手段重新受到关注。我们估算了政府研发投资的动态宏观经济效应，发现其通过挤入私人研发投资并在长期内提高总产出，对促进国家创新努力非常有效，同时从初期就激发了强劲的经济扩张，尤其是通过预期效应发挥作用。
10.1093/ej/ueag061.title: Macroeconomic Effects of Public R&D
10.1093/ej/ueag061.title_zh: 公共研发的宏观经济效应

10.1093/ej/ueag062.abstract: How does polarisation — as measured by mistreatment of political rivals — spread? In an online experiment, participants choose between splitting financial resources equally or discriminating against a supporter of the opposing political party. We vary the information subjects receive about others’ choices and justifications for discrimination. Exposure to extreme justifications for discrimination increases discrimination — particularly in a polarized environment, when many others are already discriminating — and it leads participants to adopt more extreme justifications themselves. Our findings suggest a self-reinforcing dynamic that may fuel polarisation: Exposure to extreme statements increases polarisation and the prevalence of extreme reasoning.
10.1093/ej/ueag062.abstract_zh: 极化——以政治对手遭受不公对待为衡量标准——是如何扩散的？在一项在线实验中，参与者在平均分配财务资源与歧视对立政党支持者之间做出选择。我们调整了受试者接收到的关于他人选择及歧视理由的信息。接触极端的歧视理由会增加歧视行为——尤其是在极化环境中，当许多人已经实施歧视时——并且会导致参与者自身采用更极端的理由。我们的研究结果表明，一种可能加剧极化的自我强化动态：接触极端言论会加剧极化，并增加极端推理的普遍性。
10.1093/ej/ueag062.title: Extreme justifications fuel polarisation

10.1093/ej/ueag063.abstract: We study the intergenerational impact of birth-control policies on fertility and examine whether and how these policies reduce fertility, even after their abolition. We develop a model that integrates the endogenous evolution of fertility norms. Birth-control policies, through the reduction of mothers’ fertility, establish new norms that shape the fertility decisions of subsequent generations. Consequently, daughters’ fertility is lower due to these new norms, even when the policies are no longer in force. To test the model’s implications, we leverage a quasi-experimental setting provided by China’s One-Child Policy, which was implemented in a staggered manner starting in 1979 and gradually phased out beginning in 2014. Based on the recently released 2020 population census, our results reveal that the policy has an impact on reducing fertility and affects generations no longer subject to its regulations. This study is the first to provide causal evidence of birth-control policies from an intergenerational perspective and highlights the role of norms in shaping fertility outcomes.
10.1093/ej/ueag063.abstract_zh: 本文研究生育控制政策对生育率的代际影响，并探讨这些政策在废除后是否以及如何持续降低生育率。我们构建了一个融合生育规范内生演化的模型。生育控制政策通过降低母亲的生育率，建立了影响后代生育决策的新规范。因此，即使政策不再实施，女儿这一代的生育率也会因这些新规范而降低。为检验模型推论，我们利用中国独生子女政策提供的准实验环境——该政策自1979年起分阶段实施，并于2014年开始逐步退出。基于最新公布的2020年人口普查数据，研究结果表明，该政策不仅降低了生育率，还影响了不再受其约束的世代。本研究首次从代际视角为生育控制政策提供了因果证据，并揭示了规范在塑造生育结果中的关键作用。
10.1093/ej/ueag063.title: The Intergenerational Impact of Birth-Control Policies on Fertility: The Role of Norms
10.1093/ej/ueag063.title_zh: 生育控制政策的代际影响：规范的作用

10.1093/ej/ueag064.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Reducing gender-specific commuting barriers in developing countries can have heterogeneous effects on women’s labor outcomes. We study a program that offers free bus rides for women in several Indian states (the Pink Slip program) using a synthetic difference-in-differences approach to examine impacts on transportation expenditures, time use, and labor supply. We find that the program substantially reduces bus-related expenditures. However, when considering all women together, we find no significant changes in travel time, household production, or labor supply. Beneath these aggregate effects, responses vary sharply by employment, marital status, and education. Unmarried women employed prior to the policy increase labor supply, while married women with low and medium levels of education reallocate time away from paid work toward household chores. Overall employment rates remain unchanged in the short run, highlighting that reducing commuting costs does not uniformly improve women’s labor market outcomes.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag064.abstract_zh: 摘要：在发展中国家，减少性别特定的通勤障碍可能对女性劳动结果产生异质性影响。我们利用合成双重差分法，研究了一项为印度多个邦女性提供免费公交乘车服务的项目（“粉红车票”计划），评估其对交通支出、时间利用和劳动供给的影响。研究发现，该项目显著降低了公交相关支出。然而，当将所有女性作为一个整体考虑时，我们未发现出行时间、家庭生产或劳动供给发生显著变化。在这些总体效应之下，不同就业状况、婚姻状况和教育水平的女性反应差异显著。政策实施前已有工作的未婚女性增加了劳动供给，而低学历和中等学历的已婚女性则将时间从有偿工作重新分配至家务劳动。短期内总体就业率保持不变，这表明降低通勤成本并不能一致地改善女性的劳动力市场结果。
10.1093/ej/ueag064.title:
Gender-Specific Transportation Costs and Female Time Use: Evidence from India’s
                    Pink Slip
                    Program
10.1093/ej/ueag064.title_zh: 性别特定交通成本与女性时间利用：来自印度“粉色车票”项目的证据

10.1093/ej/ueag065.abstract: Can participation in safety net programs have long-lasting negative effects across multiple generations? We take advantage of a 1993 Dutch disability insurance reform which tightened requirements and lowered benefits for participants. We study the third generation 25 years after the reform, finding that grandchildren of individuals whose DI eligibility and benefits were reduced are less likely to be born premature, have low birthweight, or experience complicated deliveries. They also have better health and schooling outcomes during early childhood. These early-life improvements are consequential, as they have been linked to better health, education, and labor market outcomes in adulthood.
10.1093/ej/ueag065.abstract_zh: 参与安全网项目是否会对多代人产生长期负面影响？我们利用1993年荷兰伤残保险改革这一契机，该改革收紧了参保条件并降低了福利水平。我们研究了改革25年后的第三代群体，发现其伤残保险资格和福利被削减的个体的孙辈，早产、低出生体重或出现分娩并发症的概率更低。他们在幼儿期的健康和教育成果也更为优异。这些早期生命阶段的改善具有深远影响，因为已有研究表明其与成年后更佳的健康、教育及劳动力市场表现相关联。
10.1093/ej/ueag065.title: Persistent Effects of Social Program Participation on the Third Generation
10.1093/ej/ueag065.title_zh: 社会项目参与对第三代的持续影响

10.1093/ej/ueag066.abstract: We study gender differences in the response to losing competitions using an online experiment (N=2,086). We find that both genders reduce tournament entry rates in response to losses that are unequivocally meritocratic. However, when the winner is not necessarily determined by merit—a setting perceived as less fair than the meritocratic tournament—female losers are relatively more discouraged. These results suggest that women are more negatively affected by competitions perceived as unfair than men. Exploratory machine learning analysis indicates that risk preferences, age and sports participation in adolescence are associated with a reduced impact of losing competitions.
10.1093/ej/ueag066.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项在线实验（N=2,086）研究性别在应对竞争失败时的差异。研究发现，在明确基于能力的竞争中，男女两性均会因失败而降低参赛率。然而，当获胜者并非必然由能力决定——这种情境被认为不如能力型竞争公平——女性失败者相对更受挫。这些结果表明，相较于男性，女性对被认为不公平的竞争会产生更消极的反应。探索性机器学习分析显示，风险偏好、年龄及青少年时期参与体育运动与竞争失败影响的减弱相关。
10.1093/ej/ueag066.title: Does Unfairness Hurt Women? The Effects of Losing Unfair Competitions
10.1093/ej/ueag066.title_zh: 不公平会伤害女性吗？输掉不公平竞争的影响

10.1093/ej/ueag067.abstract: Much economic analysis derives policy recommendations based on social welfare criteria intended to model policymakers’ preferences. Yet, little is known about policymakers’ normative views suitable for this use. Our behavioural experiment elicits German legislators’ welfare criteria. When resolving preference conflicts across individuals, they place substantially more importance on least-favoured alternatives than on most-favoured alternatives, contrasting with common aggregation mechanisms and the equal weighting inherent in utilitarianism. When resolving preference conflicts within individuals, politicians choose inconsistently with behavioural economists’ most common approach to welfare analysis with time-inconsistent preferences. In distribution, politicians largely support the same welfare criteria as the public.
10.1093/ej/ueag067.abstract_zh: 许多经济分析基于社会福利标准推导政策建议，旨在模拟政策制定者的偏好。然而，关于适合此用途的政策制定者规范观点，我们知之甚少。我们的行为实验揭示了德国立法者的福利标准。在解决个体间的偏好冲突时，他们赋予最不利选项的重要性远高于最有利选项，这与常见的聚合机制及功利主义中固有的平等加权形成对比。在解决个体内部的偏好冲突时，政治家的选择与行为经济学家在时间不一致偏好福利分析中最常用的方法不一致。在分配问题上，政治家与公众所支持的福利标准基本一致。
10.1093/ej/ueag067.title: Politicians’ Social Welfare Criteria An Experiment With German Legislators
10.1093/ej/ueag067.title_zh: 德国立法者政治家的社会福利标准实验

10.1093/ej/ueag068.abstract: We conduct a meta-analysis of distributional preferences, examining 297 estimates of sensitivity to inequality from 41 articles that structurally estimate the Fehr and Schmidt (1999) model. Our analysis indicates that individuals are inequality averse: mean sensitivity to disadvantageous and advantageous inequality are, respectively, 0.533 and 0.326. We also uncover systematic heterogeneity: aversion to advantageous (disadvantageous) inequality is smaller (larger) in strategic environments. Finally, we examine 98 estimates of altruism and attitude towards equity versus efficiency from 17 studies structurally estimating the Andreoni and Miller (2002) model. The representative individual displays Cobb–Douglas preferences with roughly 1/3 weight on others’ earnings.
10.1093/ej/ueag068.abstract_zh: 我们对分配偏好进行了一项元分析，考察了来自41篇文献的297个不平等敏感度估计值，这些文献均采用结构估计方法对Fehr和Schmidt（1999）模型进行估计。分析表明，个体具有不平等厌恶倾向：对不利不平等和有利不平等的平均敏感度分别为0.533和0.326。我们还发现了系统性异质性：在策略性环境中，对有利（不利）不平等的厌恶程度较小（较大）。最后，我们考察了来自17项研究的98个利他主义及公平与效率态度的估计值，这些研究均采用结构估计方法对Andreoni和Miller（2002）模型进行估计。代表性个体表现出柯布-道格拉斯偏好，其中他人收益的权重约为1/3。
10.1093/ej/ueag068.title: Meta-Analysis of Distributional Preferences

10.1093/ej/ueag069.abstract: Chamley and Judd argued that optimal taxation dictates zero long-run taxes on capital income, but Straub and Werning found that these taxes may be positive in the steady state. These models feature a ‘period-zero problem’ because the Ramsey formulation omits past commitments but includes future ones. Chari, Nicolini, and Teles (2020) add commitments to the representative household’s wealth in utility units. Then a nonzero capital levy may apply in period 1, future tax rates on asset income equal zero, and tax rates on consumption are constant. Time-consistency fails if future policymakers are unconstrained but holds if wealth commitments in each period are strict enough to motivate each policymaker to choose zero capital levies. Then a timeless perspective applies where period 1 is not special, tax rates on asset income are always zero, and tax rates on consumption are constant. In the neoclassical growth model with utility depending on the log of consumption, the level of the wealth commitment is constant in the steady state. Extensions allow for uncertainty and heterogeneity and for a form of partial commitment.
10.1093/ej/ueag069.abstract_zh: Chamley与Judd认为最优税收理论要求资本收入长期税率为零，但Straub与Werning发现稳态下此类税收可能为正。这些模型存在"第零期问题"，因为拉姆齐框架忽略了历史承诺却包含未来承诺。Chari、Nicolini与Teles（2020）将代表性家庭以效用单位衡量的财富承诺纳入模型。此时第一期可能征收非零资本税，后续各期资产收入税率均为零，消费税率保持恒定。若未来政策制定者不受约束则时间一致性失效，但若每期财富承诺严格到足以激励每位政策制定者选择零资本税，则时间一致性成立。此时适用无时间视角：第一期不再特殊，资产收入税率始终为零，消费税率保持恒定。在消费对数效用的新古典增长模型中，稳态财富承诺水平保持恒定。该框架可扩展至包含不确定性、异质性及部分承诺形式。
10.1093/ej/ueag069.title: Taxation of Capital–Capital Levies and Commitment
10.1093/ej/ueag069.title_zh: 资本课税——资本征收与承诺

10.1093/ej/ueag070.abstract: This Special Issue of The Economic Journal brings together papers at the frontier of dynamic, spatial and heterogeneous-agent structural modelling for the study of climate change and climate policy. These models are designed to be consistent with the fundamentals of climate science and to be calibrated and/or taken to the data. In this respect, Eftekhari, Folini, Friedl, Kubler, Scheidegger and Schenk contribute a methodological paper to the Issue, developing efficient climate emulators that can be embedded within economic models of climate change. Centring on the link between climate change and inequality, the papers in the Issue span different, and often complementary, dimensions of heterogeneity in the effects of climate change and various mitigation policies, most notably carbon taxes. Taken together, they show that the distributional consequences of climate action depend crucially on where a policy is implemented, how markets transmit shocks across regions and countries, and which households or regions are most exposed through income, wealth, consumption baskets, production structures or demographic characteristics.
10.1093/ej/ueag070.abstract_zh: 《经济学期刊》本期特刊汇集了运用动态、空间及异质性主体结构模型研究气候变化与气候政策的前沿论文。这些模型旨在与气候科学基本原理保持一致，并经过校准和/或实证数据验证。基于此，Eftekhari、Folini、Friedl、Kubler、Scheidegger与Schenk为本期特刊贡献了一篇方法论论文，开发了可嵌入气候变化经济模型的高效气候模拟器。围绕气候变化与不平等之间的关联，本期论文涵盖了气候变化及各类减缓政策（尤其是碳税）影响中不同且常具互补性的异质性维度。综合来看，这些研究表明：气候行动分配效应的关键取决于政策实施地点、市场如何跨区域和国家传导冲击，以及哪些家庭或地区通过收入、财富、消费篮子、生产结构或人口特征面临最大风险。
10.1093/ej/ueag070.title: Special Issue: Climate Change and Inequality
10.1093/ej/ueag070.title_zh: 特刊：气候变化与不平等

10.1093/ej/ueag071.abstract: Savings behavior is governed by innate predispositions (nature) and environmental conditions (nurture); yet prior research largely examines these forces in isolation. Leveraging China’s send-down movement—a policy shock that exposed urban youths to adversity—and a twins design exploiting genetic differences between monozygotic and dizygotic pairs, we identify nature-nurture interplay. Applying extended twin-based variance components models to representative data, we find that adversity more than triples genetic influence on savings, increasing its variance share from 15.2 percent among the unexposed to 53.4 percent among the exposed. Results challenge conventional fixed-effects models which assume time-invariant unobserved traits (e.g., genetic endowments) exert linearly additive effects, and demonstrate policy effectiveness hinges on interactions with such traits.
10.1093/ej/ueag071.abstract_zh: 储蓄行为受先天禀赋（天性）与后天环境（教养）共同支配，然而既有研究多将二者割裂分析。本研究借助中国"上山下乡"运动——一项使城市青年暴露于逆境的政策冲击——结合双胞胎设计（利用同卵与异卵双胞胎的遗传差异），识别天性-教养的交互作用。通过将扩展的双胞胎方差成分模型应用于代表性数据，我们发现逆境使储蓄行为的遗传影响提升逾两倍，其方差占比从未经历逆境群体的15.2%跃升至经历逆境群体的53.4%。该结果挑战了传统固定效应模型（该模型假设未观测特质如遗传禀赋呈线性可加效应），并证明政策有效性取决于其与这类特质的交互作用。
10.1093/ej/ueag071.title: How Nurture Activates Nature in Determining Savings Behavior: Evidence from China’s Send-Down Movement and Twins Data
10.1093/ej/ueag071.title_zh: 后天如何激发先天以决定储蓄行为：来自中国上山下乡运动与双胞胎数据的证据

10.1093/ej/ueag072.abstract: This study examines the willingness to engage with others who hold opposing views, a key and understudied step for reducing polarization. A sample of 2,507 Americans is offered the opportunity to listen to opposing views on immigration, abortion and gun ownership. We find that, at baseline, a large fraction of participants are willing to listen, even without incentives and with an easy way out. Emphasizing common ground increases the willingness to engage and reconsider views on abortion and immigration. We discuss possible mechanisms that can explain increased engagement. We propose that emphasizing common ground increases the value of communication as a means to reason through an issue. These findings point to promising directions for interventions aimed at fostering dialogue across ideological divides.
10.1093/ej/ueag072.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人们与持对立观点者进行交流的意愿，这是减少极化过程中一个关键但尚未充分研究的环节。通过对2507名美国民众进行抽样调查，我们提供了倾听关于移民、堕胎和枪支管制等议题对立观点的机会。研究发现，在基线条件下，即使没有激励措施且存在便捷的退出途径，仍有相当比例的参与者愿意倾听。强调共同立场能够提升参与者就堕胎和移民议题进行交流并重新审视自身观点的意愿。我们探讨了可能解释这种参与度提升的潜在机制，并提出强调共同立场能够增强沟通作为理性探讨议题工具的价值。这些发现为旨在促进跨意识形态对话的干预措施指明了有前景的方向。
10.1093/ej/ueag072.title: Breaking Echo Chambers: An Experimental Study on the Willingness to Listen to Opposite Views
10.1093/ej/ueag072.title_zh: 打破回音室：倾听对立观点意愿的实验研究

10.1093/ej/ueag073.abstract: I investigate the macroeconomic impact of money-financed fiscal stimuli when they are financed by interest-paying central bank reserves. I do so in New Keynesian models where government bonds and reserves are imperfect substitutes. Despite reducing funding costs for the consolidated government, I analytically show for several models that there is zero impact from money-financed fiscal stimuli on inflation and the real economy (relative to debt-financed stimuli). Afterwards, I relax the conditions behind this ‘irrelevance result’, and show that money-financed fiscal stimuli barely increase inflation and output.
10.1093/ej/ueag073.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在由付息央行储备融资的情况下，货币融资型财政刺激对宏观经济的影响。我在新凯恩斯模型中展开分析，其中政府债券与储备为不完全替代品。尽管降低了合并政府的融资成本，我通过多个模型的分析表明，货币融资型财政刺激对通胀和实体经济的影响（相对于债务融资型刺激）为零。随后，我放宽了这一“无关性结论”背后的条件，并证明货币融资型财政刺激几乎不会推高通胀和产出。
10.1093/ej/ueag073.title: Monetary financing produces neither high inflation nor miraculous fiscal multipliers
10.1093/ej/ueag073.title_zh: 货币融资既不会导致高通胀，也不会产生奇迹般的财政乘数

10.1093/ej/ueag074.abstract: We experimentally implement security-bid auctions, which are used around the world to sell projects that generate large, stochastic future cash flows. Buyers make bids with debt and equity, linking payments to the project’s ex-post revenue. Contrary to the theoretical predictions, we find that debt auctions generate more revenue than equity auctions. This is explained by overbidding in debt auctions. Furthermore, we find that second-price equity auctions generate slightly more surplus than other treatments. We also implement informal auctions and find that buyers use equity more often than theory predicts, and that sellers successfully choose dominant bids.
10.1093/ej/ueag074.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验实施了担保竞价拍卖，这类拍卖在全球范围内被用于出售产生大规模、随机未来现金流的项目。买家以债务和股权形式出价，将支付与项目的事后收入挂钩。与理论预测相反，我们发现债务拍卖比股权拍卖产生更高的收入。这一现象可通过债务拍卖中的过度出价来解释。此外，我们发现第二价格股权拍卖产生的剩余略高于其他处理方式。我们还实施了非正式拍卖，发现买家使用股权的频率高于理论预测，且卖家成功选择了占优出价。
10.1093/ej/ueag074.title: Experimental Auctions with Securities

10.1093/ej/ueag075.abstract: Following Sargent and Wallace’s ‘Some Unpleasant Monetarist Arithmetic,’ we study different ways to implement monetary and fiscal policy. In one case, monetary policy pegs the path of the money supply, while fiscal policy adjusts endogenously to balance the budget. In another, fiscal policy pegs the deficit path, while money adjusts to balance the budget. We ask which is more prone to instability – i.e., more likely to have multiple equilibria, endogenous dynamics, or volatile responses to news? The answer depends on whether inflation (equivalently, the deficit) is positive or negative in the long run. This is consistent with cross-country data.
10.1093/ej/ueag075.abstract_zh: 遵循萨金特和华莱士的《令人不快的货币主义算术》，我们研究了货币与财政政策的不同实施方式。一种情形下，货币政策锚定货币供给路径，财政政策内生调整以实现预算平衡；另一种情形下，财政政策锚定赤字路径，货币供给则通过调整实现预算平衡。我们探究哪种政策组合更易引发不稳定性——即更可能产生多重均衡、内生动态或对新闻的剧烈反应？答案取决于长期通胀（等价于赤字）为正还是为负。这一结论与跨国数据相吻合。
10.1093/ej/ueag075.title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Some New Monetarist Arithmetic
10.1093/ej/ueag075.title_zh: 货币与财政政策：新货币主义算术

10.1093/ej/ueag076.abstract: Robo-advisors are tools in financial markets that provide investors with low-cost financial advice, typically based on individual characteristics such as risk attitudes. We study the benefits of robo-advice in a ten-week portfolio choice experiment. Depending on treatment, investors either receive robo-advice, have a robo-advisor implement recommendations by default, or invest on their own. While we observe no effect of robo-advice on initial market participation, we find positive effects on continued participation. Robo-advisors also help investors avoid mistakes, increase rebalancing, and yield portfolios closer to the utility-maximising benchmark. Default implementation of recommendations performs significantly better than advice alone.
10.1093/ej/ueag076.abstract_zh: 机器人投顾是金融市场中为投资者提供低成本财务建议的工具，通常基于风险态度等个人特征。我们通过一项为期十周的投资组合选择实验，研究了机器人投顾的益处。根据实验处理方式的不同，投资者或接受机器人投顾建议，或由机器人投顾默认执行推荐方案，或自行投资。虽然我们未观察到机器人投顾对初始市场参与的影响，但发现其对持续参与具有积极效应。机器人投顾还能帮助投资者避免错误、增加再平衡操作，并使投资组合更接近效用最大化的基准水平。相较于仅提供建议，默认执行推荐方案的效果显著更优。
10.1093/ej/ueag076.title: On the Benefits of Robo-Advice in Financial Markets
10.1093/ej/ueag076.title_zh: 论机器人投顾在金融市场中的益处

10.1093/ej/ueag077.abstract: Populism has been on the rise, posing a threat to liberal democracy. Existing evidence suggests that globalization, economic shocks, and concerns over cultural change increase support for populist agendas. Yet less is known about interventions that can empower individuals to critically evaluate populist messaging. We argue that tailored exposure to financial markets can reduce support for populist policies because it can encourage learning about the gains of economic complementarity and the costs of nativism and isolationism. We test this argument with an RCT implemented in the run-up to the Brexit referendum. We randomly assigned British citizens to hold and trade complementary financial assets from the UK, EU and the US for six weeks. We show that this intervention increased citizens’ willingness to vote to remain in the European Union during the Brexit Referendum, and particularly so when exposed to companies that exemplify EU-UK economic complementarity. Countering populist narratives, treated participants instead came to associate the EU with economic prosperity, rather than a threat to their cultural identity or a waste of money. Overall, the effects are stronger among swing participants and those originally more open to a European cultural identity.
10.1093/ej/ueag077.abstract_zh: 民粹主义持续抬头，对自由民主制度构成威胁。现有证据表明，全球化、经济冲击以及对文化变迁的担忧会增强民众对民粹主义议程的支持。然而，关于哪些干预措施能够帮助个人批判性评估民粹主义信息的研究仍显不足。本文认为，有针对性的金融市场参与能够降低民众对民粹主义政策的支持，因为这种参与可以促使人们认识到经济互补性的收益以及本土主义与孤立主义的代价。我们通过在英国脱欧公投前夕实施的一项随机对照试验验证了这一论点。我们随机分配英国公民在六周内持有并交易来自英国、欧盟和美国的互补性金融资产。研究表明，这一干预措施提高了民众在脱欧公投中投票支持留欧的意愿，尤其是当参与者接触体现欧盟-英国经济互补性的企业时效果更为显著。与民粹主义叙事相反，受试者转而将欧盟与经济繁荣相联系，而非视其为文化认同的威胁或资金浪费。总体而言，这种效应在摇摆参与者及原本对欧洲文化认同持更开放态度的人群中更为显著。
10.1093/ej/ueag077.title: Resisting Populism through Financial Market Exposure: Experimental Evidence from Brexit
10.1093/ej/ueag077.title_zh: 通过金融市场暴露抵制民粹主义：来自英国脱欧的实验证据

10.1093/ej/ueag078.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
