                  <jats:p>Rising polarisation heightens concerns about politicising regulatory agencies, prompting reassessment of the accountability–independence trade-off. We study whether perceived out-group oversight affects trust in regulation and market behaviour. Using US television transcripts, we show that media link agencies with presidents. We then conduct a field experiment (N=5,566) using a case where the EPA endorsed antibiotic spraying on citrus crops during both Trump’s and Biden’s presidencies. Holding science constant, out-group oversight reduces support for spraying by 26%, lowers trust in EPA’s evaluation, and increases donations to an opposing NGO by 15%. In an obfuscated follow-up, citrus demand is unchanged, but effects differ by consumption habits.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag078.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>日益加剧的两极分化加剧了人们对监管机构政治化的担忧，促使学界重新审视问责与独立之间的权衡。本文研究感知到的外群体监督是否会影响对监管的信任及市场行为。利用美国电视转录文本，我们发现媒体将机构与总统关联。随后，我们以美国环保署（EPA）在特朗普和拜登总统任期内均批准对柑橘作物喷洒抗生素的案例开展实地实验（N=5,566）。在保持科学依据不变的情况下，外群体监督使喷洒支持率降低26%，对EPA评估的信任度下降，并向对立非政府组织的捐款增加15%。在后续模糊化实验中，柑橘需求未发生变化，但影响因消费习惯而异。</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag078.title: Politics of Food: An Experiment on Trust in Expert Regulation and Economic Costs of Political Polarisation
10.1093/ej/ueag078.title_zh: 食品政治：专家监管信任与政治极化经济成本的实验研究

10.1093/ej/ueag079.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The well-known cashless-limiting result in Woodford (1998) has become the theoretical foundation for a large body of work that treats the costs and benefits of holding money as irrelevant for monetary transmission. I reexamine this result and find that it relies on a peculiar credit-market structure consisting of perfectly competitive, zero-interest deferred payment arrangements. I show that the result breaks down when the microstructure is generalized to allow for an endogenous interest rate and market power in credit intermediation. The tenuousness of this influential result should give pause to the widespread practice of basing monetary policy advice on models without money.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag079.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>Woodford（1998）中著名的无现金限制结果已成为大量研究的理论基础，这些研究将持有货币的成本与收益视为与货币政策传导无关。本文重新审视了这一结果，发现其依赖于一种特殊的信贷市场结构，即完全竞争、零利率的延期支付安排。研究表明，当微观结构被推广至允许内生利率和信贷中介市场势力时，该结果不再成立。这一具有影响力的结果存在脆弱性，应促使学界对基于无货币模型提供货币政策建议的普遍做法进行反思。</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag079.title:
onetary Economics
                    at 30: A Reexamination of the Relevance of Money in Cashless Limiting Monetary Economies
10.1093/ej/ueag079.title_zh: 货币经济学30年：无现金极限货币经济中货币相关性的再审视

10.1093/ej/ueag080.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Consider the transition out of a stagnant Malthusian system spearheaded by high-human-capital people. Individuals with a stronger preference for offspring quality may be the first to escape the Malthusian regime and adopt modern fertility behaviours (Galor and Moav 2002). To test this hypothesis, we examine the relationship between family size and human capital among academics in Northern Europe in the two centuries before the Industrial Revolution. We measure the human capital of academics using a novel approach based on their publications. We find that scholars with a higher number of publications than the median shifted from having more siblings to having fewer siblings in the first half of the 18th century. Estimating the parameters of an evolutionary growth model by indirect inference, we show how Malthusian constraints initially led the high human capital families to reproduce more, before being endogenously replaced by Beckerian constraints with a tradeoff between child quality and quantity. Our results support an extension of Galor and Moav’s (2002) approach, in which the decline of Malthusian constraints is linked to the accumulation of human capital during the 18th century.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag080.abstract_zh: 考虑由高人力资本个体引领的马尔萨斯停滞体系转型。对后代质量偏好更强的个体可能率先摆脱马尔萨斯体制，并采纳现代生育行为（Galor and Moav 2002）。为检验这一假说，我们考察了工业革命前两个世纪北欧学者家庭规模与人力资本的关系。我们采用基于学术发表的新方法衡量学者的人力资本。研究发现，在18世纪上半叶，发表数量高于中位数的学者从拥有更多兄弟姐妹转变为拥有更少兄弟姐妹。通过间接推断法估计演化增长模型参数，我们揭示了马尔萨斯约束最初如何导致高人力资本家庭生育更多后代，随后被内生的贝克尔约束（子女质量与数量权衡）所取代。研究结果支持对Galor and Moav（2002）理论的拓展，即马尔萨斯约束的衰退与18世纪人力资本积累密切相关。
10.1093/ej/ueag080.title: The Emergence of the Child Quantity-Quality Tradeoff - insights from early modern academics
10.1093/ej/ueag080.title_zh: 儿童数量与质量权衡的出现——来自近代早期学术界的洞见

10.1093/ej/ueag081.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Ten years of idiosyncratic variation in school closure dates for all secondary schools in England are combined with administrative records of educational and criminal trajectories linked at the individual level to study the impact of the school schedule on the dynamics of youth crime. When school is not in session, students commit more property offences, more serious violent offences and fewer minor violent offences. Increased thefts, robberies and violent assaults drive these effects. This is novel evidence of strong multiple crime effects that arise from the protective factor of schooling and which affect not only the incidence of violence, but also its severity and its targets.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag081.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文利用英格兰所有中学十年间因特殊原因导致的停课日期变化，结合个体层面关联的教育与犯罪轨迹行政记录，研究学校作息安排对青少年犯罪动态的影响。当学校停课时，学生实施的财产犯罪、严重暴力犯罪增加，而轻微暴力犯罪减少。盗窃、抢劫和暴力袭击的增加是导致这些效应的主要原因。本研究首次提供了强有力的多重犯罪效应证据，这些效应源于学校教育的保护性因素，不仅影响暴力犯罪的发生率，还影响其严重程度及目标对象。
10.1093/ej/ueag081.title: Youth Crime and Delinquency In And Out Of School
10.1093/ej/ueag081.title_zh: 青少年犯罪与逃学及在校行为

10.1093/ej/ueag082.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>I combine newly digitized data on confidence votes, party switches, and tax returns of Italian MPs from 2001 to 2022 to study how tenure-dependent benefits influence politicians’ behaviour and government stability. Using a difference-in-discontinuities design, I find that a tenure requirement for parliamentary pensions introduced in 2008 increased confidence votes for the government, switches to majority parties, and legislative effort. Consistent with agency model predictions, the policy discouraged internal party defiance that could jeopardize reelection chances and pension eligibility for a second term. Tenure requirements increase government stability but also strengthen party control, with ambiguous effects on voters’ welfare.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag082.abstract_zh: 我整合了2001年至2022年意大利议员的信任投票、政党转换及纳税申报单的新数字化数据，研究任期相关福利如何影响政治人物行为及政府稳定性。通过断点回归设计，我发现2008年引入的议会养老金任期要求增加了对政府的信任投票、向多数党的转换以及立法努力。与委托代理模型预测一致，该政策抑制了可能危及连任机会及第二任期养老金资格的内部政党反抗。任期要求提升了政府稳定性，但也强化了政党控制，对选民福利产生模糊影响。
10.1093/ej/ueag082.title: The Impact of Tenure-Dependent Benefits on Government Stability
10.1093/ej/ueag082.title_zh: 任期相关福利对政府稳定性的影响

10.1093/ej/ueag083.abstract: Mental health disorders account for a significant share of the overall global disease burden. The economic losses from such disorders are staggeringly large, particularly in low-income countries, where people are faced with several unexpected shocks. We test whether improved communication can mitigate such mental health disorders. Partnering with a major telecommunications company, we implement low-cost communication interventions that provide mobile calling credits to a nationally representative set of low-income adults in Ghana during the COVID-19 pandemic. Individuals’ inability to make unexpected calls, need to borrow SOS airtime, and to seek digital loans decreased significantly relative to a control group. As a result, the programs led to a significant decrease in mental distress (-9.7%), the likelihood of severe mental distress by -2.3 percentage points (a quarter of the mean prevalence), and domestic violence, with null impact on overall consumption expenditure. The effects are stronger for monthly mobile credits than a lump-sum. We present evidence that improvements in both business-related services and social inclusion and/or protection are relevant explanations. Simple cost-benefit analysis shows that providing communication credit to low-income adults is a cost-effective policy for improving mental health. Communication – the ability to stay connected – meaningfully improves mental well-being and interventions about communication are particularly valuable when implemented as many installments.
10.1093/ej/ueag083.abstract_zh: 心理健康障碍在全球疾病总负担中占据显著比例。此类障碍造成的经济损失极为巨大，尤其在低收入国家，民众常面临多重突发冲击。本研究检验了改善通信条件能否缓解此类心理健康障碍。我们与一家大型电信公司合作，在新冠疫情期间向加纳具有全国代表性的低收入成年人群体实施低成本通信干预措施，即提供手机通话信用额度。相较于对照组，干预对象在无法进行紧急通话、需要借用应急通话时长以及寻求数字贷款等方面的状况显著减少。由此，这些干预措施显著降低了心理困扰程度（-9.7%），使严重心理困扰的发生概率下降2.3个百分点（相当于平均患病率的四分之一），并减少了家庭暴力现象，但对总体消费支出无显著影响。按月发放手机信用额度的效果优于一次性发放。我们提供的证据表明，商业相关服务的改善以及社会包容和/或保护机制的增强是合理的解释路径。简单的成本效益分析显示，向低收入成年人提供通信信用额度是一项具有成本效益的心理健康改善政策。通信——即保持联系的能力——能显著提升心理健康水平，而分多次实施的通信干预措施尤为有价值。
10.1093/ej/ueag083.title: The Value of Communication for Mental Health
10.1093/ej/ueag083.title_zh: 沟通对心理健康的价值

10.1093/ej/ueag084.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We examine child mental health treatment surrounding three school milestones in Taiwan: Middle school entry, high stakes testing for high school entrance, and college entrance exams. Using age cutoffs for school entry, we compare August-born to September-born children since the August-born reach each milestone one year earlier. Comparing adjacent cohorts of children born in the same month yields similar estimates. We find that entry into middle school increases mental health prescribing of antidepressant, anti-anxiety, and antipsychotic medications. Use of psychiatric medications falls sharply following high-stakes tests. Effects are stronger in counties where parents and children have higher educational aspirations.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag084.abstract_zh: 我们考察了台湾地区三个学校关键节点前后的儿童心理健康治疗情况：初中入学、高中入学高利害考试以及大学入学考试。利用入学年龄截止日期，我们比较了八月出生与九月出生的儿童，因为八月出生的儿童在每个关键节点上比九月出生的儿童早一年。对同月出生的相邻队列进行比较，得出了相似的估计结果。我们发现，进入初中增加了抗抑郁药、抗焦虑药和抗精神病药等精神药物的处方量。高利害考试后，精神药物的使用量急剧下降。在父母和子女教育期望更高的县市，这种效应更为显著。
10.1093/ej/ueag084.title: School milestones impact child mental health in Taiwan
10.1093/ej/ueag084.title_zh: 台湾学龄里程碑对儿童心理健康的影响

10.1093/ej/ueag085.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper develops a framework for monetary policy normalization in which liquidity conditions shape aggregate demand through a liquidity channel. The model implies that central bank balance sheet operations can stabilize demand even away from the zero lower bound, making reserves an independent policy instrument alongside interest rates. Optimal balance sheet size therefore depends not only on private reserve demand, but also on fiscal interactions and liquidity management. Following shocks that generate a liquidity trap, optimal policy expands reserves at the lower bound, initiates quantitative tightening before rate liftoff, and normalizes rates and reserves together, clarifying balance sheets’ stabilization role.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag085.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个货币政策正常化框架，其中流动性状况通过流动性渠道影响总需求。模型表明，即使远离零利率下限，央行资产负债表操作也能稳定需求，使准备金与利率并列为独立政策工具。因此，最优资产负债表规模不仅取决于私人准备金需求，还受财政互动与流动性管理的影响。在引发流动性陷阱的冲击发生后，最优政策在零利率下限扩大准备金，在加息启动前实施量化紧缩，并同步推进利率与准备金正常化，从而阐明资产负债表的稳定作用。
10.1093/ej/ueag085.title: Managing Monetary Policy Normalization

10.1093/ej/ueag086.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the relationship between interpersonal trust and political stability in democratic countries. Using an annual country-level panel dataset covering six decades, we find that recessions are more likely to cause political turnover in countries with lower levels of generalised interpersonal trust. The effect is present in democracies and not autocracies, for turnovers occurring through regular procedures and not coups, and during regularly scheduled election years. We find an analogous connection between trust and leader turnover during recessions when looking across sub-national regions in Europe, across counties in the United States, and across individuals in U.S. counties. Our results highlight the crucial role of generalised trust in ensuring political stability during times of economic turmoil.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag086.abstract_zh: 我们研究了民主国家中人际信任与政治稳定性之间的关系。利用涵盖六十年间的年度国家层面面板数据，我们发现，在普遍人际信任水平较低的国家，经济衰退更易引发政治更迭。这一效应存在于民主国家而非专制国家，体现在通过常规程序而非政变实现的更迭中，且发生在定期选举年份。在考察欧洲次国家区域、美国各县以及美国各县个体层面时，我们发现了经济衰退期间信任与领导人更迭之间的类似关联。我们的研究结果凸显了普遍信任在经济动荡时期确保政治稳定性的关键作用。
10.1093/ej/ueag086.title: Trust and Democracy: Political Stability in Times of Economic Crisis
10.1093/ej/ueag086.title_zh: 信任与民主：经济危机时期的政治稳定

10.1093/ej/ueag087.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Dispute resolution in low-income countries is typically done by either a costly and slow formal court or an informal institution without state-sanctioned enforcement powers. Can access to justice be increased by combining the best aspects of formal and informal institutions? We evaluate the effects of “Village Courts” (VCs) in rural Bangladesh using a large-scale field experiment. The introduction of VCs more than doubles the share of disputes resolved in state-sanctioned courts, but an informal institution called shalish remains dominant. There is some substitution from shalish to VCs, but congestion in higher-level courts, village social dynamics, and economic activity remain unaffected.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag087.abstract_zh: 低收入国家的纠纷解决通常依赖成本高昂且效率低下的正式法院，或缺乏国家强制执行力保障的非正式机构。能否通过融合正式与非正式机构的最佳特性来提升司法可及性？我们通过一项大规模实地实验，评估了孟加拉国农村地区"村级法院"（VCs）的实施效果。村级法院的引入使国家认可法院解决的纠纷比例提升了一倍以上，但名为"沙利什"的非正式机构仍占据主导地位。虽然存在从沙利什向村级法院的部分替代效应，但上级法院的案件积压、村庄社会动态及经济活动均未受到显著影响。
10.1093/ej/ueag087.title: Formalizing Dispute Resolution: Effects of Village Courts in Bangladesh
10.1093/ej/ueag087.title_zh: 正式化争端解决：孟加拉国村级法庭的影响

10.1093/ej/ueag088.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Restrictive immigration policies can force organisations to alter their workforce composition, with unclear effects on organisational performance. We study the effects of the 2016 Brexit referendum, which reduced the share of EU-nationality nurses in English hospitals. Using administrative patient-level data and a continuous difference-in-differences design, exploiting hospitals’ pre-referendum exposure, we estimate the causal impact of a negative labour supply shock on care quality. Hospitals with higher pre-referendum EU nurse shares experienced higher post-referendum emergency patient mortality, equivalent to 1,238 additional deaths annually in the three years after the referendum. Consistent with theoretical predictions, hospitals responded to labour shortages by relaxing hiring standards: foreign nurses recruited after the referendum were appointed to lower salary grades, suggesting lower skills and experience.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag088.abstract_zh: 限制性移民政策可能迫使组织改变其劳动力构成，但对组织绩效的影响尚不明确。我们研究了2016年英国脱欧公投的影响，该公投减少了英国医院中欧盟籍护士的比例。利用行政层面的患者数据以及连续双重差分设计，通过分析医院在公投前的暴露程度，我们估算了负面劳动力供给冲击对护理质量的因果影响。公投前欧盟护士比例较高的医院，在公投后急诊患者死亡率更高，相当于公投后三年内每年额外增加1238例死亡。与理论预测一致，医院通过放宽招聘标准来应对劳动力短缺：公投后招聘的外籍护士被分配到较低的薪资等级，这表明其技能和经验较低。
10.1093/ej/ueag088.title: Immigration, Workforce Composition, and Organisational Performance: The Effect of Brexit on NHS Hospital Quality
10.1093/ej/ueag088.title_zh: 移民、劳动力构成与组织绩效：英国脱欧对NHS医院质量的影响

10.1093/ej/ueag089.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We construct a continuous-time, monetary model with frictional goods and labour markets to revisit the long-run relationship between inflation and unemployment. By endogenising the value of consumers’ outside options and market power in accordance with standard consumer search theory, we generate novel predictions for the slope of the long-run Phillips curve, optimal monetary policy, and outcomes at the frictionless limit. The relationship between inflation and unemployment is non-monotone and, at low inflation rates, an increase in inflation reduces unemployment. The Friedman rule is suboptimal when firms’ average bargaining power across markets is low. Markups and markdowns vanish as frictions disappear.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag089.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含商品市场与劳动力市场摩擦的连续时间货币模型，重新审视通胀与失业之间的长期关系。通过依据标准消费者搜寻理论内生化消费者外部选择价值与市场势力，我们为长期菲利普斯曲线的斜率、最优货币政策以及无摩擦极限下的均衡结果提出了新的理论预测。通胀与失业之间的关系呈现非单调特征：在低通胀水平下，通胀上升会降低失业率。当企业在各市场的平均议价能力较低时，弗里德曼规则并非最优。随着摩擦消失，加成率与折价率趋于零。
10.1093/ej/ueag089.title: Inflation and Unemployment in the Long Run Revisited
10.1093/ej/ueag089.title_zh: 长期视角下通货膨胀与失业关系的再探讨

10.1093/ej/ueag090.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study how an agent evaluates an action when she observes a sample of its outcomes rather than its outcome-generating distribution. We propose a model where the agent’s estimated value for the action is a convex combination of her average utility over the sample outcomes and an ex ante utility reflecting her prior information. The weight put on the average utility increases with sample size, reflecting the inferential advantages of larger samples. The model nests certain forms of Bayesian behaviour and, more generally, identifies parameters quantifying departures from Bayesian updating, such as conservatism and the Law of Small Numbers.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag090.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>本文研究当代理人观察到某行动的结果样本而非其结果生成分布时，如何评估该行动。我们提出一个模型，其中代理人对该行动的估计价值是样本结果平均效用与反映其先验信息的事前效用的凸组合。平均效用的权重随样本量增加而增加，这反映了更大样本的推断优势。该模型涵盖了某些形式的贝叶斯行为，并更一般地识别出量化偏离贝叶斯更新的参数，例如保守主义和小数定律。</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag090.title: Learning by Convex Combination,

10.1093/ej/ueag091.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Social norms that are costly for individuals are held in place because of social pressure to conform. Historical examples include duelling in Europe and footbinding in China; contemporary examples include female genital cutting and wasteful consumption. Such norms exhibit varied dynamics. Some collapse after staying unchanged for centuries, while others erode gradually. Still others escalate gradually before collapsing. This paper develops a theoretical framework that explains these patterns in terms of different forces of social influence and lends itself to empirical estimation. The analysis can guide the design of policies aimed at mitigating or eliminating costly norms, and shows that some interventions can be counterproductive.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag091.abstract_zh: 摘要：对个体而言代价高昂的社会规范之所以得以维系，是因为存在要求遵从的社会压力。历史上的例子包括欧洲的决斗和中国的缠足；当代的例子则包括女性割礼和浪费性消费。此类规范呈现出不同的演变动态：有些在历经数百年不变后突然瓦解，有些则逐渐消解，还有些在崩溃前会逐步升级。本文构建了一个理论框架，通过不同的社会影响力机制解释这些模式，并适用于实证估计。该分析可为旨在减轻或消除代价高昂规范的政策设计提供指导，同时表明某些干预措施可能适得其反。
10.1093/ej/ueag091.title: The dynamics of costly norms

10.1093/ej/ueag092.abstract: We investigate the impact of information disclosure, via a statistical instrument, on consumer welfare in competitive insurance markets with limited screening. We demonstrate that, under natural constraints on information disclosure, no statistical instrument is “safe” to implement. There always exists a nonnegligible set of prior beliefs about the risk types of consumers, compatible with an observed market situation, under which additional information disclosure strictly worsens welfare.
10.1093/ej/ueag092.abstract_zh: 我们研究在有限筛选的竞争性保险市场中，通过统计工具进行信息披露对消费者福利的影响。我们证明，在信息披露的自然约束条件下，没有任何统计工具是“安全”可实施的。总存在一组不可忽略的、与观察到的市场状况相容的关于消费者风险类型的先验信念，在这些信念下，额外的信息披露会严格降低福利。
10.1093/ej/ueag092.title: Disclosure in Insurance Markets with Limited Screening
10.1093/ej/ueag092.title_zh: 有限筛选下保险市场的信息披露

10.1093/ej/ueag093.abstract: We examine how automation affects intergenerational income mobility. Using Swedish register data for parents and children from 1985–2019, we study how parental exposure to robots during the 1990s shaped children’s outcomes up to thirty years later. Combining occupational exposure measures with industry- and firm-level robot adoption, we find that automation reduced children’s income and upward mobility and worsened long-run labour market and educational outcomes. These effects are concentrated among low-income families and appear driven primarily by adverse parental labour market shocks and financial strain. Our findings suggest that technological change can reduce intergenerational mobility and increase long-run inequality.
10.1093/ej/ueag093.abstract_zh: 本文考察自动化如何影响代际收入流动性。利用1985-2019年瑞典父母与子女的登记数据，我们研究了1990年代父母接触机器人如何影响子女长达三十年后的发展结果。通过将职业暴露指标与行业及企业层面的机器人应用相结合，我们发现自动化降低了子女收入与向上流动性，并恶化了其长期劳动力市场表现与教育成果。这些影响集中于低收入家庭，且主要源于父母劳动力市场负面冲击与财务压力。研究结果表明，技术变革可能削弱代际流动性并加剧长期不平等。
10.1093/ej/ueag093.title: Long-run effects of technological change: the impact of automation on intergenerational mobility
10.1093/ej/ueag093.title_zh: 技术变革的长期效应：自动化对代际流动性的影响

10.1093/ej/ueag094.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Climate change is predicted to have large and heterogeneous impacts on agricultural yields. I use a model of production, consumption, and trade of 24 crops between 271 regions across sub-Saharan Africa to simulate the effects of climate change and explore how trade mediates these effects. I estimate a continent-wide welfare loss equivalent to 2.4% of GDP using median yield changes across 5 climate models, with country-level losses up to 60% of GDP in the worst model. The continent-wide welfare loss is 19% smaller with lower trade costs and over 7 times larger if trade flows are capped at current levels.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag094.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>气候变化预计将对农业产量产生巨大且异质性的影响。本文利用一个涵盖撒哈拉以南非洲271个地区、24种作物生产、消费与贸易的模型，模拟气候变化的影响，并探讨贸易如何调节这些效应。基于5个气候模型的中位产量变化，我估算出全大陆福利损失相当于GDP的2.4%，而在最差模型下，国家层面的损失高达GDP的60%。当贸易成本较低时，全大陆福利损失减少19%；若贸易流量被限制在当前水平，损失则扩大7倍以上。</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag094.title: Agricultural trade and adaptation to climate change in sub-Saharan Africa
10.1093/ej/ueag094.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的农业贸易与气候变化适应

10.1093/ej/ueag095.abstract: This paper studies gender differences in educational attainment and labor market outcomes. Across 21 OECD countries, though men are paid more than women, the college attainment rates and college premia are (mostly) higher for women. This paper explains these patterns through the quantitative analysis of a dynamic choice model of education and labor market outcomes. Using the estimated model, we decompose the observed gender gaps through a series of counterfactual exercises. One finding is that these gaps are driven mainly by gender differences in the average compensation at non-college jobs. The estimated lower compensation for non-college women generates for them larger college premia and higher incentives to attend college relative to men. A second finding, through the lens of the estimated model, is that observed gender wage gaps for college workers are largely driven by differences in the gender specific distributions across signals of ability rather than wage differences across genders given a signal.
10.1093/ej/ueag095.abstract_zh: 本文研究了教育成就与劳动力市场结果中的性别差异。在21个OECD国家中，尽管男性薪酬高于女性，但女性的大学入学率及大学教育溢价（大多）更高。本文通过构建教育与劳动力市场结果的动态选择模型并进行量化分析，解释了上述模式。基于估计模型，我们通过一系列反事实模拟分解了观察到的性别差距。研究发现之一：这些差距主要由非大学职业中男女平均薪酬差异驱动。非大学职业女性薪酬较低，导致其大学教育溢价更高，且相较于男性更倾向于接受高等教育。研究发现之二：通过估计模型的视角，大学劳动者的性别工资差距主要源于不同能力信号在性别分布上的差异，而非给定信号下性别间的工资差异。
10.1093/ej/ueag095.title: Determining Gender Differences in Education and Labor Market Outcomes
10.1093/ej/ueag095.title_zh: 确定教育与劳动力市场结果中的性别差异

10.1093/ej/ueag096.abstract: Why do some buyers contract directly with producers, while others contract via an intermediary that coordinates assignments and monitors performance? We develop a repeated-game model in which intermediaries aggregate fluctuating demand, lengthening productive relationships and making cooperation easier to sustain. This benefit comes at the cost of double marginalization: an added layer of rents is needed to motivate the intermediary. The trade-off determines which buyers rely on an intermediary and which contract directly. In equilibrium, producers working through intermediaries earn lower, less variable pay but greater job security. Intermediaries expand trade, yet shift its gains from producers to buyers. Managerial coordination also promotes specialization. The framework sheds new light on professional service firms, global sourcing intermediaries, and digital matching platforms.
10.1093/ej/ueag096.abstract_zh: 为何部分买方直接与生产者签约，而另一些买方则通过协调任务分配并监督履约的中介机构进行签约？我们构建了一个重复博弈模型，其中中介机构通过整合波动的需求，延长生产关系的存续期，使合作更易维持。这一优势的代价是双重边际化：需要额外层级的租金来激励中介机构。这种权衡决定了哪些买方依赖中介机构、哪些买方直接签约。在均衡状态下，通过中介机构工作的生产者收入更低、波动性更小，但工作保障更高。中介机构扩大了贸易规模，却将贸易收益从生产者转移至买方。管理协调还促进了专业化分工。该框架为专业服务公司、全球采购中介及数字匹配平台提供了新的理论视角。
10.1093/ej/ueag096.title: Managerial Coordination in Decentralized Markets
10.1093/ej/ueag096.title_zh: 分散市场中的管理协调

10.1093/ej/ueag097.abstract: We study cost pass-through in a model of price dispersion where consumers differ in the number of firms they consider. By analysing how cost changes affect each quantile of the price distribution, we demonstrate how the effects on price dispersion and consumers’ expected purchase prices depend upon whether demand is log-concave or log-convex. We further show that consumers who consider fewer firms tend to experience a relatively smaller change to their surplus. This provides new insights into the distributional consequences of cost changes. Additionally, we examine the relation to demand shocks and the roles of competition and endogenous consideration sets. D43; L13; D83
10.1093/ej/ueag097.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个价格离散模型中的成本传导机制，其中消费者因考虑的企业数量不同而存在差异。通过分析成本变化如何影响价格分布的每个分位数，我们揭示了其对价格离散程度及消费者预期购买价格的影响如何取决于需求的对数凹性或对数凸性。进一步研究表明，考虑较少企业的消费者往往面临相对较小的剩余变化，这为成本变化的分配效应提供了新见解。此外，我们还探讨了其与需求冲击的关系，以及竞争和内生性考虑集的作用。D43; L13; D83
10.1093/ej/ueag097.title: Understanding Cost Pass-Through when Prices are Dispersed
10.1093/ej/ueag097.title_zh: 价格分散时的成本传导理解

10.1093/ej/ueag099.abstract: Burdensome entry regulations can hinder productivity growth, particularly in services where competitive pressures are weaker. We construct a novel measure of entry regulation, varying across narrowly defined sectors, and combine it with firm-level data for the universe of Italian firms. Exploiting reforms that generate variation across sectors and over time, we find that deregulation (reductions in red tape) raises productivity. The effect is driven by incumbent firms, with a smaller role for reallocation and selection. Effects are larger in the lower-middle of the productivity distribution and in sectors with higher entry rates and tighter initial regulation.
10.1093/ej/ueag099.abstract_zh: 繁重的准入规制可能阻碍生产率增长，尤其是在竞争压力较弱的服务业中。我们构建了一种新的准入规制衡量指标，该指标在细分行业间存在差异，并将其与意大利全部企业的企业层面数据相结合。利用跨行业及随时间变化的改革所带来的差异，我们发现放松规制（减少行政手续）能提升生产率。这一效应主要由在位企业驱动，而重新配置与选择机制的作用较小。在生产率分布的中低端以及进入率较高、初始规制较严格的行业中，效应更为显著。
10.1093/ej/ueag099.title: Productivity and Entry Regulation in the Service Sector: Evidence from the Universe of Firms in Italy
10.1093/ej/ueag099.title_zh: 服务业生产率与准入规制：来自意大利全量企业的证据

10.1093/ej/ueag100.abstract: This paper examines how the transition to iron metallurgy lowered the cost of organised violence and drove political fragmentation across the Eastern Mediterranean after 1200 BCE. Bronze required scarce inputs, concentrating coercive capacity among elites. Iron was widely abundant, redistributing access to weapons beyond the elite class and undermining centralised control. Using novel geospatial data of ancient polities, I exploit staggered iron adoption across 200 km × 200 km grid-cells in a Two-Way Fixed Effects framework. Iron adoption increases polities per cell by 1.356 to 1.521 units. The results are robust to a variety of alternative specifications and competing explanations.
10.1093/ej/ueag100.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了铁冶金技术的转型如何降低了有组织暴力的成本，并在公元前1200年之后推动了东地中海地区的政治分裂。青铜需要稀缺的原料，将强制力集中在精英阶层手中。而铁资源广泛丰富，使得武器获取途径重新分配，超越了精英阶层，削弱了中央集权控制。利用古代政体的新型地理空间数据，我在200公里×200公里的网格单元中，采用双向固定效应模型，利用铁器采用的阶段性差异进行分析。铁器的采用使每个网格单元中的政体数量增加了1.356至1.521个。这一结果在多种替代规格和竞争性解释下依然稳健。
10.1093/ej/ueag100.title: Blood and Iron: Political Fragmentation in the Ancient Eastern Mediterranean
10.1093/ej/ueag100.title_zh: 血与铁：古代东地中海的政治分裂

10.1093/ej/ueag101.abstract: We revisit the heterogeneous tax pass-through analysis in Borrella-Mas (2022a) (B&B). We find that B&B’s estimating equation is misspecified, as it excludes a necessary lower-order interaction between vertical integration and the post-treatment period. Including this term reveals a significant structural price trend for vertically integrated firms in the post-reform period, whose origin is uncertain. A spatial placebo test confirms that this structural shift is present even in never-treated provinces, indicating that it is not a local, province-level pass-through of the regional tax. Without this control, the original specification may conflate this shift with the tax effect. Once the interaction is included, the differential pass-through estimate becomes null for diesel, while for gasoline a significant effect persists—albeit at a reduced magnitude—supporting B&B’s central claim that market structure matters for tax pass-through. These findings highlight the importance of explicitly modelling group-specific time trends when estimating heterogeneous treatment effects in difference-in-differences designs.
10.1093/ej/ueag101.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了Borrella-Mas (2022a)（简称B&B）中的异质性税收转嫁分析。我们发现B&B的估计方程设定有误，因为它遗漏了垂直整合与处理后时期之间必要的低阶交互项。纳入这一项后，揭示了改革后时期垂直整合企业显著的结构性价格趋势，其来源尚不确定。空间安慰剂检验证实，即使在从未受处理的省份也存在这种结构性转变，表明这并非地方性的省级税收转嫁效应。若无此控制，原始设定可能将这一转变与税收效应混淆。一旦加入交互项，柴油的差异化转嫁估计变为零，而汽油则仍存在显著效应——尽管幅度有所减小——这支持了B&B的核心主张，即市场结构对税收转嫁具有重要影响。这些发现强调了在双重差分设计中估计异质性处理效应时，明确建模组别特定时间趋势的重要性。
10.1093/ej/ueag101.title: A Comment on “The Heterogeneous Tax Pass-Through Under Different Vertical Relationships” by Bajo-Buenestado and Borrella-Mas
10.1093/ej/ueag101.title_zh: 对巴霍-布埃内斯塔多与博雷利亚-马斯《不同纵向关系下的异质性税收转嫁》一文的评论

10.1093/ej/ueag102.abstract: We analyse the contribution of rising longevity to the increase in wealth inequality in the U.S. over the past seventy years. To do so, we construct an overlapping generations (OLG) model with multiple sources of inequality, carefully calibrated to the data. Our key finding is that improvements in old-age longevity have a substantial impact on wealth inequality, accounting for approximately half the effect of income inequality, which has been the focus of much of the existing literature. In contrast, the impact of tax changes is relatively minor. The contribution of rising longevity is expected to continue driving wealth inequality upward in the coming decades.
10.1093/ej/ueag102.abstract_zh: 我们分析了过去七十年间美国寿命延长对财富不平等加剧的贡献。为此，我们构建了一个包含多种不平等来源的代际重叠（OLG）模型，并仔细校准至数据。我们的核心发现是，老年寿命的改善对财富不平等有显著影响，其效应约为收入不平等影响的一半，而后者一直是现有文献关注的焦点。相比之下，税收变化的影响相对较小。预期寿命延长将在未来几十年内继续推动财富不平等上升。
10.1093/ej/ueag102.title: Demographic transition and the rise of wealth inequality
10.1093/ej/ueag102.title_zh: 人口转型与财富不平等加剧

10.1093/ej/ueag104.abstract: Political polarization can undermine democratic governance by weakening electoral accountability through biases in voter information consumption and processing. A growing literature, primarily from high-income countries, has identified promising interventions to reduce negative affect toward out-partisans, though evidence regarding their downstream effects remains mixed. We evaluate whether these depolarizing interventions and an open-mindedness nudge that increases awareness of information-processing biases stemming from emotions or partisanship promote counter-attitudinal information consumption and internalization in a survey of nearly 2,500 participants from a nationally representative panel in Mexico, a heavily polarized context. Videos designed to correct misperceptions about out-partisans improved trust in opposition media, while those designed to foster empathy or emphasize shared identities reduced partisan polarization. Although none of the videos affected immediate counter-attitudinal news consumption, exposure to either the corrective video or the open-mindedness nudge led to greater partisan attitudinal updating when participants were exposed to a counter-attitudinal news article. This effect is due to reduced partisan perceptions of the article rather than increased factual retention of its information. These findings provide insights into the potential and limitations of scalable interventions to improve citizens’ ability to consume and process politically relevant information across partisan lines.
10.1093/ej/ueag104.abstract_zh: 政治极化可能通过选民信息消费与处理过程中的偏见削弱选举问责制，从而损害民主治理。现有文献主要基于高收入国家，已识别出若干有前景的干预措施以减少对外群体成员的负面情绪，但关于其下游效应的证据仍不一致。我们在墨西哥——一个高度极化的情境中，基于全国代表性面板的近2500名参与者开展调查，评估这些去极化干预措施以及一种增强对情绪或党派性所致信息处理偏见认知的开放性思维助推是否促进反态度信息消费与内化。旨在纠正对外群体误解的视频提升了对对立媒体的信任，而旨在培养同理心或强调共同身份的视频则降低了党派极化。尽管所有视频均未影响即时的反态度新闻消费，但当参与者接触到反态度新闻文章时，接触纠正性视频或开放性思维助推均导致更大的党派态度更新。这一效应归因于参与者对文章党派性感知的降低，而非对文章信息事实性记忆的增强。这些发现为可扩展干预措施在提升公民跨党派消费和处理政治相关信息能力方面的潜力与局限性提供了洞见。
10.1093/ej/ueag104.title: Political Polarization and Counter-attitudinal Information Consumption and Internalization
10.1093/ej/ueag104.title_zh: 政治极化与反态度信息消费及内化

10.1093/ej/ueag105.abstract: To evaluate the impact of group identity on belief formation, we conducted online experiments before and after the 2020 US presidential election. We elicit participants’ beliefs about future unemployment statistics and health system rankings and provide relevant news summaries. We find that people pay money to avoid information from political outgroups and attribute lower weight to this information when updating beliefs. An intervention which unlabels information sources decreases outgroup information avoidance by 50%, with a significant impact on only groupish participants. A debiasing intervention equalizing instrumental values of information sources reduces only universalists’ WTP for a private signal. The interventions have little effect on information processing. The evidence is consistent with a source-utility channel contributing to polarization.
10.1093/ej/ueag105.abstract_zh: 为评估群体身份对信念形成的影响，我们在2020年美国总统选举前后进行了在线实验。我们引导参与者表达对未来失业统计和医疗体系排名的信念，并提供相关新闻摘要。研究发现，人们愿意支付金钱以避免来自政治外群体的信息，并在更新信念时赋予此类信息较低权重。一项去除信息来源标签的干预措施将外群体信息回避行为减少了50%，且仅对具有强烈群体倾向的参与者产生显著影响。一项旨在平衡信息来源工具价值的去偏干预仅降低了普遍主义者的私人信号支付意愿。这些干预措施对信息处理过程影响甚微。证据与来源效用渠道促进两极化的观点一致。
10.1093/ej/ueag105.title: Group Identity and Belief Formation: A Microfoundation of Political Polarization
10.1093/ej/ueag105.title_zh: 群体身份与信念形成：政治极化的微观基础

10.1093/ej/ueag106.abstract: Remote work policies remain controversial partly because of productivity concerns, which are potentially exacerbated in team settings. Using experiments, we isolate how location-based beliefs of teammate effort affect the own-effort choices of participants assigned to work with remote and office-based teammates. Participants perform a real effort task and can contribute this effort to an individual account, paying a piece rate wage, or to a team account using a minimum-effort payment scheme. We find that remote workers do not complete fewer tasks than their office-based counterparts. Yet, teams suffer from lower effort due to workers responding to beliefs that remote teammates contribute less effort to the team. In a follow-up treatment, we demonstrate that these location-based beliefs remain salient even under a revenue-sharing team payment scheme where beliefs of free-riding may have dominated. Finally, we provide unique evidence that the COVID-19 pandemic may have shifted beliefs to be more pessimistic about the effort of remote workers but did not alter the actual effort.
10.1093/ej/ueag106.abstract_zh: 远程工作政策仍具争议，部分原因在于对生产力的担忧，而这种担忧在团队环境中可能被进一步放大。通过实验，我们分离出关于团队成员努力程度的地点性信念如何影响被分配与远程及办公室同事合作的参与者的自身努力选择。参与者执行一项实际努力任务，并可将该努力贡献至个人账户（按计件工资支付）或团队账户（采用最低努力支付方案）。我们发现，远程工作者完成的任务数量并不少于办公室同事。然而，团队因工人对远程同事贡献较少努力的信念而遭受努力水平下降。在后续处理中，我们证明即使在可能以搭便车信念为主导的收入共享团队支付方案下，这些基于地点的信念仍然显著。最后，我们提供独特证据表明，COVID-19大流行可能使人们对远程工作者努力的信念变得更加悲观，但并未改变实际努力水平。
10.1093/ej/ueag106.title: Remote work and effort provision in teams
10.1093/ej/ueag106.title_zh: 远程工作与团队中的努力供给

10.1093/ej/ueag107.abstract: The linear-in-means model is the standard empirical model of peer effects and asks that an agent’s choice or outcome is a combination of their ideal point and the mean outcome of their group. Using choice data and exogenous group variation, we develop a revealed preference style test for the linear-in-means model. This test is formulated as a linear program and can be interpreted as a condition about differentiating the behaviour of each agent in a consistent manner. We then study the identification properties of the linear-in-means model. A key takeaway from our analysis is the close relationship between the dimension of the outcome variable and identification. When the outcome variable is one-dimensional, failures of identification are generic. When the outcome variable is multidimensional, we provide natural conditions under which identification is generic.
10.1093/ej/ueag107.abstract_zh: 线性均值模型是同伴效应的标准实证模型，它假设个体的选择或结果由其理想点与所在群体平均结果的组合构成。利用选择数据和外生群体变动，我们为线性均值模型开发了一种基于显示偏好的检验方法。该检验以线性规划形式表述，可被解释为对每个个体行为进行一致性区分的一种条件。随后，我们研究了线性均值模型的识别性质。我们分析的一个关键结论是结果变量维度与识别之间的紧密联系。当结果变量为一维时，识别失败是普遍存在的。当结果变量为多维时，我们提供了在自然条件下识别具有普遍性的充分条件。
10.1093/ej/ueag107.title: Revealed Social Networks

10.1093/ej/ueag108.abstract: Helping as an important form of social support is an integral part of a firm’s workplace culture. Using matched employer-employee panel data that are representative of larger, private-sector firms in Germany, we document significant between-firm variation in helping in the workplace. Helping is positively correlated with better organizational outcomes for both employees and firms. Differences in a firm’s quality of leadership together with employees’ level of general trust play a key role in explaining firm-level differences in helping. Our results corroborate the importance of both leadership and workforce characteristics for the manifestation of supportive workplace cultures.
10.1093/ej/ueag108.abstract_zh: 帮助作为一种重要的社会支持形式，是企业职场文化不可或缺的组成部分。利用代表德国较大规模私营企业的匹配雇主-雇员面板数据，我们记录了职场中帮助行为的显著企业间差异。帮助行为与员工及企业的更优组织结果呈正相关。企业领导质量差异及员工普遍信任水平，在解释企业间帮助行为差异中发挥关键作用。我们的研究结果证实了领导力与劳动力特征对于形成支持性职场文化的重要性。
10.1093/ej/ueag108.title: Helping in the Workplace: The Role of Leadership Relative to Employee Personality and Preferences
10.1093/ej/ueag108.title_zh: 工作场所中的帮助行为：领导力相对于员工个性与偏好的作用

10.1093/ej/ueag109.abstract: There appears to be a tension between trade proponents and environmental activists. This paper shows, however, how Contingent Trade Agreements (CTAs) can motivate conservation. I first analyse a standard trade model where trade-specific investments (e.g., deforestation) cause environmental damage and traditional trade agreements, including free trade, increase deforestation. Next, I define and analyse CTAs, where default tariffs vary with production capacity (e.g., forest cover). In equilibrium, countries conserve to maintain favourable terms of trade. The quantitative model shows that trade liberalisation can dramatically expand Brazil’s agricultural area, but this expansion is avoidable if the EU or US offers a CTA.
10.1093/ej/ueag109.abstract_zh: 贸易支持者与环保活动人士之间似乎存在紧张关系。然而，本文表明，或有贸易协定（CTAs）如何能够激励环境保护。我首先分析了一个标准贸易模型，其中贸易特定投资（如森林砍伐）导致环境损害，而传统贸易协定，包括自由贸易，加剧了森林砍伐。接着，我定义并分析了CTAs，其中默认关税随生产能力（如森林覆盖率）变化。在均衡状态下，各国为维持有利的贸易条件而进行保护。定量模型显示，贸易自由化可能大幅扩张巴西的农业面积，但若欧盟或美国提供CTA，这一扩张则可避免。
10.1093/ej/ueag109.title: Contingent Trade Agreements: Linking Free Trade and Environmental Conservation
10.1093/ej/ueag109.title_zh: 临时贸易协定：联结自由贸易与环境保护

10.1093/ej/ueag112.title: Teacher Effects on Students’ Socio-Emotional Skills and Young Adult Outcomes
10.1093/ej/ueag112.title_zh: 教师对学生社会情感技能及青年期结果的影响

10.1093/ej/ueag114.title: Incomplete Information and Self-fulfilling Inflation Dynamics —Lucas meets Keynes
10.1093/ej/ueag114.title_zh: 不完全信息与自我实现的通胀动态——卢卡斯遇见凯恩斯

10.1093/epolic/eiac008.abstract: SUMMARY G. Montalvo and Marta Reynal-Querol?>Official statistics on economic inequality are only available at low frequency and with considerable delay. This makes it challenging to assess the impact on inequality of fast-unfolding crises like the COVID-19 pandemic, and to rapidly evaluate and tailor policy responses. We propose a new methodology to track income inequality at high frequency using anonymized data from bank records for over three million account holders in Spain. Using this approach, we analyse how inequality evolved between February and November 2020 (compared to the same months of 2019). We first show that the wage distribution in our data matches very closely that from official labour surveys. We then document that, in the absence of government intervention, inequality would have increased dramatically, mainly due to job losses and wage cuts experienced by low-wage workers. The increase in pre-transfer inequality was especially pronounced among the young and the foreign-born, and in regions more dependent on services. Public transfers and unemployment insurance schemes were effective at providing a safety net to the most affected segments of the population and at offsetting most of the increase in inequality. Increased inequality is primarily driven by differential changes in employment rate. Indeed, using individual-level regressions, we find that, over the course of the pandemic, the probability of being employed decreased drastically for workers in the lower part of the pre-COVID wage distribution, young cohorts and foreign-born.
10.1093/epolic/eiac008.abstract_zh:
G. Montalvo和Marta Reynal-Querol的摘要：

官方关于经济不平等性的统计数据仅以较低频率获取，且存在显著延迟。这使得评估像COVID-19疫情这样快速演变的危机对不平等性的影响，以及迅速评估和调整政策应对措施变得具有挑战性。我们提出了一种新方法，利用西班牙超过三百万账户持有人的银行记录匿名数据，以高频率追踪收入不平等性。采用这一方法，我们分析了2020年2月至11月期间（与2019年同期相比）不平等性的演变情况。我们首先表明，我们数据中的工资分布与官方劳动力调查结果高度吻合。随后，我们记录到，在缺乏政府干预的情况下，不平等性将急剧上升，主要原因是低工资工人遭受的失业和工资削减。转移前不平等性的增加在年轻人、外国出生者以及更依赖服务业的地区尤为显著。公共转移支付和失业保险计划在为主要受影响群体提供安全网以及抵消大部分不平等性增加方面发挥了有效作用。不平等性的加剧主要由就业率的差异性变化驱动。实际上，利用个体层面回归分析，我们发现，在疫情期间，对于疫情前工资分布较低端的工人、年轻群体和外国出生者，就业概率大幅下降。

10.1093/epolic/eiad027.abstract: We propose a data-based approximation of the effects of trade sanctions. We validate the approximation by comparing it with exact responses simulated from a canonical multi-country multi-sector model. The approximation is palatable for a broad range of elasticities of substitution, except for extremely low ones. It is based on a decomposition of high order trade according to destination or inputs markets and can readily be computed on the basis of international input-output data. As such it provides a practical shortcut to evaluating the consequences of trade sanctions without having to make difficult calibration choices. We implement our approximation to evaluate the consequences of trade sanctions between Europe and Russia. Our approximated effects are within the range of existing estimates, but they mask vast asymmetries. First, the effects of sanctions are about fifteen times larger on Russia than on Europe. Second, the effects within Europe are enormously asymmetric, with much larger consequences on ex-“satellite” countries of the Soviet Union than on large Western European economies. We then adapt our approach to show that the most affected European countries do not typically have access to substitute markets and are in fact highly dependent on Russia. We show that this extreme dependence on Russia is at least partly explained by the existence of specific energy transporting infrastructure (pipelines) that appear to constrain tightly the production of electricity in those heavily affected East European economies. These findings illustrate the practical potentiality of our approximation in a variety of different contexts.
10.1093/epolic/eiad027.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于数据的贸易制裁效应近似方法。通过将其与经典多国多部门模型模拟的精确响应进行比较，验证了该近似的有效性。该近似适用于除极低替代弹性外的大多数弹性范围。其原理基于按目的地或投入市场划分的高阶贸易分解，可直接利用国际投入产出数据计算。因此，它为评估贸易制裁后果提供了一种实用捷径，无需进行复杂的校准选择。我们运用该近似方法评估了欧洲与俄罗斯之间贸易制裁的后果。近似结果与现有估计范围一致，但揭示了巨大的不对称性：首先，制裁对俄罗斯的影响约为对欧洲影响的十五倍；其次，欧洲内部的影响极不对称，对前苏联"卫星国"的影响远大于西欧主要经济体。我们进一步调整方法，发现受影响最严重的欧洲国家通常无法获得替代市场，实际上高度依赖俄罗斯。研究表明，这种对俄罗斯的极端依赖至少部分源于特定能源运输基础设施（管道）的存在——这些设施严重制约了受冲击严重的东欧经济体的电力生产。这些发现展示了该近似方法在不同情境下的实用潜力。
10.1093/epolic/eiad027.title: An Empirical Approximation of the Effects of Trade Sanctions with an Application to Russia
10.1093/epolic/eiad027.title_zh: 贸易制裁效果的实证近似：以俄罗斯为例

10.1093/epolic/eiad043.abstract: We build on Baqaee and Farhi (2019, 2021) and derive a theoretically grounded criterion that allows targeting bans on exports to a sanctioned country at the level of ∼5,000 six-digit HS products. The criterion implies that the costs to the sanctioned country are highly convex in the market share of the sanctioning parties. Hence, there are large benefits from coordinating export bans among a broad coalition of countries. Applying our results to Russia reveals that sanctions imposed by the European Union and the United States in response to Russia’s invasion of Ukraine are not systematically related to our arguments once we condition on Russia’s total imports of a product from participating countries. We discuss drivers of these differences and then provide a quantitative evaluation of the export bans to show that (i) they are very effective with the welfare loss typically ∼100 times larger for Russia than for the sanctioners; (ii) improved coordination of the sanctions and targeting sanctions based on our criterion allows to increase the costs to Russia by about 80% with little to no extra cost to the sanctioners; and (iii) there is scope for increasing the cost to Russia further by expanding the set of sanctioned products.
10.1093/epolic/eiad043.abstract_zh: 我们基于Baqaee和Farhi（2019, 2021）的研究，推导出一个具有理论基础的准则，用于在约5000种六位HS编码产品层面，对受制裁国家的出口禁令进行精准定向。该准则表明，受制裁国家所承受的成本与制裁方的市场份额呈高度凸性关系。因此，在广泛的国家联盟中协调出口禁令能带来显著收益。将我们的结果应用于俄罗斯后发现，在控制俄罗斯从参与国进口某产品的总量后，欧盟和美国因俄罗斯入侵乌克兰而实施的制裁与我们的理论依据并无系统性关联。我们探讨了这些差异的驱动因素，随后对出口禁令进行定量评估，结果表明：（i）制裁效果显著，俄罗斯的福利损失通常约为制裁方的100倍；（ii）基于我们的准则改进制裁协调与定向，可在几乎不增加制裁方成本的情况下，使俄罗斯承担的成本增加约80%；（iii）通过扩大受制裁产品范围，仍有进一步提升俄罗斯成本的潜力。
10.1093/epolic/eiad043.title: On the Design of Effective Sanctions: The Case of Bans on Exports to Russia
10.1093/epolic/eiad043.title_zh: 有效制裁的设计：对俄出口禁令案例研究

10.1093/epolic/eiae039.abstract: Summary Advanced-economy central banks are currently experiencing losses. To examine how rate-tightening cycles affect central bank finances, we study the financial statements of ten advanced-economy central banks during the 1970s and 1980s, the most notable and comparable policy environment to the present. We find that central bank profits actually increased in response to the anti-inflationary measures of the 1980s. We thus discuss how central bank profits depend on their policy instruments as well as their balance-sheet position when rate tightening begins, rather than on the tightening per se. Unlike today, central banks in the 1980s avoided losses because they did not remunerate bank reserves and their balance sheets did not carry the legacy of a decade of large asset purchases at low interest rates and long maturity. Our counterfactuals show that only a combination of these factors could have triggered losses in the 1980s: none of them is sufficient on its own. When losses emerged in the late 1970s, before the Volcker shock, they were due to foreign exchange reserves depreciating. In these instances, when central banks carried them forward and did not rely on transfers from the government, there was no loss of central bank independence or their ability to fight inflation.
10.1093/epolic/eiae039.abstract_zh: 发达经济体中央银行目前正面临亏损。为考察利率紧缩周期如何影响央行财务，我们研究了1970年代和1980年代十个发达经济体央行的财务报表，这一时期是与当前最具可比性的政策环境。我们发现，央行利润实际上因1980年代的反通胀措施而增加。因此，我们探讨了央行利润如何取决于其政策工具以及利率紧缩开始时的资产负债表状况，而非紧缩本身。与今日不同，1980年代的央行避免了亏损，原因在于它们不对银行准备金支付利息，且其资产负债表并未承载过去十年以低利率和长期限大规模购买资产所遗留的负担。我们的反事实分析表明，只有这些因素的组合才可能在1980年代引发亏损：单独任何一项都不足以导致亏损。当1970年代末期亏损出现时，早于沃尔克冲击，其原因是外汇储备贬值。在这些情况下，当央行将亏损结转且不依赖政府转移支付时，并未丧失央行独立性或其抗击通胀的能力。
10.1093/epolic/eiae039.title: Do Disinflation Policies Ravage Central Bank Finances?
10.1093/epolic/eiae039.title_zh: 反通胀政策是否损害中央银行财政？

10.1093/epolic/eiw014.abstract: In the global recession of 2009, exports declined precipitously in many countries. We illustrate with firm-level data for Belgium and Peru that the decline was very sudden and almost entirely due to lower export sales by existing exporters. After the recession, exports rebounded almost equally quickly and we evaluate whether export promotion programs were an effective tool aiding this recovery. We show that firms taking advantage of this type of support did better during the crisis, controlling flexibly for systematic differences between supported and control firms. The primary mechanism we identify is that supported firms are generally more likely to survive on the export market and, in particular, are more likely to continue exporting to countries hit by the financial crisis. In terms of absolute magnitudes, the mid-point of the range of estimates suggest a 6% to 11%, respectively for Belgium and Peru, higher probability of survival on the export market for supported firms and approximately 20% to 10% higher exports for surviving exporters.
10.1093/epolic/eiw014.abstract_zh: 在2009年的全球衰退中，许多国家的出口急剧下降。我们利用比利时和秘鲁的企业层面数据说明，这一下降非常突然，且几乎完全归因于现有出口企业的出口销售减少。衰退过后，出口几乎同样迅速地反弹，我们评估了出口促进计划是否成为助力这一复苏的有效工具。我们表明，在灵活控制支持企业与对照企业之间的系统性差异后，利用此类支持的企业在危机期间表现更佳。我们识别出的主要机制是，受支持企业通常更有可能在出口市场上存活，尤其是更有可能继续向受金融危机影响的国家出口。就绝对规模而言，估计范围的中点显示，受支持企业在出口市场上的存活概率分别高出6%至11%（比利时和秘鲁），而存活出口企业的出口额则分别高出约20%至10%。
10.1093/epolic/eiw014.title: Did export promotion help firms weather the crisis?
10.1093/epolic/eiw014.title_zh: 出口促进是否帮助企业度过了危机？

10.1093/erae/jbag004.abstract: We examine the economic impact of regulating new genomic techniques on investment decisions in the EU. Using a real options model, we compare five major regulatory options (nine including sub-options) with the status quo and analyse their effects on plant breeders’ investments. Using the current authorization process for genetically modified organisms for NGTs presents a high investment barrier for companies. The findings indicate that all alternative five options offer opportunities to reduce investment hurdles, depending on the design of the authorization process. Our model and its calibration serve as an example for further advancing the application of real options for regulatory policy analysis.
10.1093/erae/jbag004.abstract_zh: 我们研究了欧盟对新基因组技术进行监管对投资决策的经济影响。通过使用实物期权模型，我们比较了五种主要监管方案（含子方案共九种）与现状的差异，并分析了它们对植物育种者投资的影响。将当前转基因生物授权流程应用于新基因组技术，对企业构成了较高的投资门槛。研究结果表明，所有五种替代方案均提供了降低投资障碍的机会，具体效果取决于授权流程的设计。我们的模型及其校准为推进实物期权在监管政策分析中的应用提供了范例。
10.1093/erae/jbag004.title: Comparing the effects of regulating new genomic techniques on investment decisions in the European Union
10.1093/erae/jbag004.title_zh: 比较欧盟监管新基因组技术对投资决策的影响

10.1093/erae/jbag005.abstract: Market integration is critical for food security in developing economies facing socio-political instability. Using weekly price data from ninety-seven Nigerian markets, this study investigates how violent conflict influences price dynamics between market pairs. Results reveal that frequent violent events have limited short-term effects on price transmission, and changes in conflict intensity do not significantly disrupt price adjustments. Markets with stronger trade connections demonstrate greater resilience by leveraging alternative trade routes. These findings highlight the role of market connectivity in maintaining trade efficiency, suggesting that policies that enhance market networks can strengthen resilience and improve food security.
10.1093/erae/jbag005.abstract_zh: 市场整合对于面临社会政治动荡的发展中经济体的粮食安全至关重要。本研究利用尼日利亚97个市场的周度价格数据，考察暴力冲突如何影响市场对之间的价格动态。结果显示，频繁的暴力事件对价格传导的短期影响有限，冲突强度的变化并未显著干扰价格调整。贸易联系较强的市场通过利用替代贸易路线展现出更强的韧性。这些发现凸显了市场连通性在维持贸易效率中的作用，表明增强市场网络的政策能够强化韧性并改善粮食安全。
10.1093/erae/jbag005.title: Market integration and the impact of violence on trade networks: Evidence from Nigeria
10.1093/erae/jbag005.title_zh: 市场整合与暴力对贸易网络的影响：来自尼日利亚的证据

10.1093/erae/jbag006.abstract: Agent-based models are valuable tools for agricultural policy evaluation. They can represent the heterogeneity of farmers and farmer interactions and are especially useful when behavioural and social factors are integrated to represent farmers’ decision-making. We assess the potential of agent-based models by conducting a review of forty-eight agent-based models developed for European agriculture and a survey with twenty-six modellers and twenty-four policy stakeholders. We find that while agent-based models provide nuanced representations of farmers’ decision-making processes, there is a gap between what is currently implemented in models, what modellers consider important and what policymakers expect.
10.1093/erae/jbag006.abstract_zh: 基于智能体的模型是农业政策评估的重要工具。这类模型能够刻画农户的异质性及其互动关系，尤其在整合行为与社会因素以表征农户决策过程时具有独特价值。我们通过梳理48个针对欧洲农业开发的智能体模型，并对26位建模者及24位政策利益相关方开展问卷调查，评估了此类模型的潜力。研究发现：尽管智能体模型能细致呈现农户决策过程，但当前模型的实际应用、建模者认为重要的要素与政策制定者的预期之间仍存在显著差距。
10.1093/erae/jbag006.title: Behavioural and social factors in farm-level agent-based models for European agricultural policy evaluations
10.1093/erae/jbag006.title_zh: 欧洲农业政策评估中农场层面基于主体模型的行为与社会因素

10.1093/erae/jbag007.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Agriculture accounts for 11 per cent of EU greenhouse gas emissions, yet sectoral emissions have stagnated over the past two decades. This paper evaluates carbon pricing in EU agriculture by integrating stochastic yield variability into the CAPRI model. We assess how different carbon price levels affect emissions and outcome uncertainty. Results show that carbon pricing reduces emissions, and higher price levels are associated with lower uncertainty in policy outcomes. While expected results remain similar to deterministic simulations, stochastic modeling reveals greater regional and sectoral heterogeneity. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for production risk when designing agricultural climate policies.</jats:p>
10.1093/erae/jbag007.abstract_zh: 农业占欧盟温室气体排放的11%，但过去二十年间该行业排放量停滞不前。本文通过将随机产量波动纳入CAPRI模型，评估了欧盟农业碳定价政策。我们分析了不同碳价水平对排放量及结果不确定性的影响。研究表明，碳定价能够减少排放，且更高的碳价水平与更低的政策结果不确定性相关。尽管预期结果与确定性模拟相似，但随机模型揭示了更大的区域和行业异质性。这些发现凸显了在制定农业气候政策时考虑生产风险的重要性。
10.1093/erae/jbag007.title: Beyond determinism: Accounting for weather variability in the carbon pricing debate for EU agriculture
10.1093/erae/jbag007.title_zh: 超越决定论：欧盟农业碳定价辩论中天气变率的考量

10.1093/erae/jbag008.abstract: The European Union Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) seeks to reduce deforestation by restricting market access to deforestation-embodied soy products in the EU market. The main concern is that such restrictions could shift the soy trade to unregulated non-EU markets. To shed light on this issue, we employ a gravity model, treating the EUDR compliance costs as additional trade costs for exports to the EU. We find that stricter compliance costs reallocate soy exports from South America toward non-EU markets, mainly China, divert the EU imports toward North America, and increase the prices of soy faced by EU soy users. Under the counterfactual scenario in which South America does not comply with the regulation, EU consumers face even larger price increases, while South American countries experience minimal terms-of-trade losses. Our analysis suggests that trade reallocation to an unregulated market could potentially dilute the impact of the EUDR, making it less effective in directly reducing deforestation linked to soy production.
10.1093/erae/jbag008.abstract_zh: 欧盟毁林法规（EUDR）旨在通过限制含有毁林成分的大豆产品进入欧盟市场来减少森林砍伐。主要担忧在于此类限制可能导致大豆贸易转向不受监管的非欧盟市场。为阐明这一问题，我们采用引力模型，将EUDR合规成本视为对欧盟出口的额外贸易成本。研究发现：更严格的合规成本促使南美大豆出口向非欧盟市场（主要是中国）转移，导致欧盟进口转向北美市场，并推高欧盟大豆用户面临的价格。在反事实情景中，若南美不遵守该法规，欧盟消费者将面临更大的价格上涨，而南美国家仅遭受微小的贸易条件损失。我们的分析表明，贸易向未受监管市场的重新配置可能削弱EUDR的效果，使其在直接减少与大豆生产相关的毁林方面效力降低。
10.1093/erae/jbag008.title: Costly regulation, minimal results: The EU’s deforestation regulation effect on global soy trade
10.1093/erae/jbag008.title_zh: 高成本监管，低效成果：欧盟毁林法规对全球大豆贸易的影响

10.1093/erae/jbag010.abstract: We examine how pesticide expenditure relates to the probability distribution of yield and revenue per hectare in apple production in northern Italy. Using a flexible moment-based approach, we find that pesticide expenditure is negatively associated with downside risk in yield and revenue, whereas late frosts are positively associated with downside risk in yield. Sensitivity analyses show that mean-equation estimates are robust to unobserved confounders, while negative semi-variance models are less robust overall. Only the pesticide–expected outcome relationship appears plausibly causal. Therefore, conclusions about pesticides as risk-increasing or risk-decreasing inputs should be made with caution.
10.1093/erae/jbag010.abstract_zh: 本文考察了意大利北部苹果生产中农药支出与每公顷产量及收益概率分布之间的关系。采用灵活的基于矩的方法，我们发现农药支出与产量和收益的下行风险呈负相关，而晚霜则与产量的下行风险呈正相关。敏感性分析表明，均值方程估计对未观测到的混杂因素具有稳健性，而负半方差模型整体稳健性较弱。只有农药与预期结果之间的关系似乎具有合理的因果性。因此，关于农药作为风险增加或风险减少投入的结论应谨慎得出。
10.1093/erae/jbag010.title: The relationship between pesticides and risk in apple production
10.1093/erae/jbag010.title_zh: 农药与苹果生产风险的关系

10.1093/erae/jbag011.abstract: Using matched employer–employee data, we examine how workforce knowledge characteristics relate to firm productivity in the equine sector. Using panel data on Swedish equine firms from 2010 to 2022, we construct measures of workforce composition, including occupation-specific education, accumulated work experience and knowledge diversity. The results show that access to occupation-specific human capital is positively associated with productivity, with substantial heterogeneity across firms. Knowledge effects are stronger among firms specializing in horse racing than in breeding, highlighting differences in the role of human capital across production orientations. The findings have implications for policy and firms’ investment decisions.
10.1093/erae/jbag011.abstract_zh: 利用匹配的雇主-雇员数据，我们研究了马业部门劳动力知识特征与企业生产率之间的关系。基于2010年至2022年瑞典马业企业的面板数据，我们构建了劳动力构成指标，包括职业特定教育、累积工作经验及知识多样性。结果表明，职业特定人力资本的获取与生产率呈正相关，且企业间存在显著异质性。相较于育种企业，赛马专营企业的知识效应更为显著，凸显了人力资本在不同生产导向中的差异化作用。该发现对政策制定及企业投资决策具有启示意义。
10.1093/erae/jbag011.title: The role of specialized knowledge and ‘know-how’ for firm productivity: Evidence from the equine sector
10.1093/erae/jbag011.title_zh: 专业化知识与“诀窍”对企业生产率的作用：来自马业部门的证据

10.1093/erae/jbag012.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We analyze alternative agricultural carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM) designs across three dimensions (participating countries, emission intensity, and carbon price). We find that an agricultural CBAM by the European Union (or an expanded climate club consisting of the EU and other countries) has minor global agricultural GHG emission implications but protects the most emission intensive domestic production. Nevertheless, having a larger climate club imposing CBAM tariffs and applying exporters’ emission intensities are more effective in lowering global emissions. Compared to national carbon prices, harmonized carbon prices at climate club level can reduce trade disruptions while attaining similar emission reduction outcomes.</jats:p>
10.1093/erae/jbag012.abstract_zh: 摘要：我们从三个维度（参与国、排放强度与碳价格）分析了农业碳边境调节机制（CBAM）的替代设计方案。研究发现，欧盟（或由欧盟及其他国家组成的扩大版气候俱乐部）实施的农业CBAM对全球农业温室气体排放影响较小，但能有效保护国内排放强度最高的生产活动。然而，由更大规模的气候俱乐部征收CBAM关税并采用出口国排放强度的方案，在降低全球排放方面更为有效。相较于各国自主设定的碳价格，在气候俱乐部层面统一碳价格既能减少贸易扭曲，又能实现相近的减排效果。
10.1093/erae/jbag012.title: Alternative Agricultural Carbon Border Adjustment and Climate Club Designs : a Quantitative Assessment
10.1093/erae/jbag012.title_zh: 替代性农业碳边境调节与气候俱乐部设计：一项量化评估

10.1093/erae/jbag013.abstract: Adoption of organic certification across the EU remains lower than anticipated, with financial risks during and after conversion often cited as barriers. We examine whether farms with stronger financial health (FH) are associated with a higher likelihood of adopting organic certification. Using Farm Accountancy Data Network panel data from 2014 to 2018 covering 24,797 EU farms, we classify farms by FH and apply matching and logit regression to analyse the relationship between preconversion FH and organic certification adoption. Results show no clear association between FH and adoption, while preconversion land-use intensity consistently correlates with organic certification uptake, suggesting relevance for EU policy design efforts.
10.1093/erae/jbag013.abstract_zh: 欧盟范围内有机认证的采用率仍低于预期，转型期间及之后的财务风险常被视为障碍。本文探究财务健康状况更佳的农场是否更有可能采用有机认证。基于2014至2018年覆盖24,797个欧盟农场的农场会计数据网络面板数据，我们对农场进行财务健康分类，并运用匹配法和逻辑回归分析转型前财务健康与有机认证采用之间的关系。结果显示，财务健康与有机认证采用之间无显著关联，而转型前土地利用强度始终与有机认证采用呈正相关，这一发现对欧盟政策设计具有参考价值。
10.1093/erae/jbag013.title: Deep pockets needed? Financial health and organic certification adoption in the European Union
10.1093/erae/jbag013.title_zh: 资金充裕是必需的吗？欧盟有机认证采纳中的财务状况研究

10.1093/erae/jbag014.abstract: We analyse how agricultural extension services affect farm resilience using the Post-Russian Invasion Survey of Smallholder Farmers in Ukraine for 2022–3. Farm household resilience is measured using the Resilience Capacity Index (RCI), constructed from Adaptive Capacity (AC), Assets (AST), Social Safety Nets (SSN), and Sensitivity (S). To address the heterogeneity problem, Latent Profile Analysis (LPA) defines homogenous resilience profiles. The manuscript also examines a causal relationship by incorporating treatment effects into latent analysis. The results reveal that extension service receivers experience higher levels of AST and SSN. The extension service has a positive effect on RCI levels.
10.1093/erae/jbag014.abstract_zh: 我们利用2022-2023年乌克兰小农户战后入侵调查数据，分析农业推广服务如何影响农场韧性。农场家庭韧性通过韧性能力指数（RCI）衡量，该指数由适应能力（AC）、资产（AST）、社会安全网（SSN）和敏感性（S）构成。为应对异质性问题，采用潜在剖面分析（LPA）定义同质韧性剖面。本文还通过将处理效应纳入潜在分析，考察因果关系。结果显示，接受推广服务的农户在AST和SSN方面水平更高。推广服务对RCI水平具有正向影响。
10.1093/erae/jbag014.title: Agricultural extension services for farm resilience in Russian–Ukrainian Conflict
10.1093/erae/jbag014.title_zh: 俄乌冲突背景下农业推广服务对农场韧性的作用

10.1093/erae/jbag015.abstract: Increasing attention is being paid to the design of economic incentives for conservation on private land to encourage spatial coordination. We investigate the effects of using incorrect information on the ecological benefits of spatial coordination in the design of a conservation auction, using a framed field experiment with real farmers as participants. We find that auction performance can be substantially weakened if the parameters adopted are ‘wrong enough’ to change which farms are prioritized for enrolment in a conservation contract. Parameters that under-estimate the true coordination benefits are less damaging to policy performance than those which over-estimate these benefits.
10.1093/erae/jbag015.abstract_zh: 私人土地保护的经济激励设计正日益受到关注，以促进空间协调。我们通过一项以真实农民为参与者的框架实地实验，研究了在保护拍卖设计中采用关于空间协调生态效益的错误信息所产生的影响。研究发现，如果采用的参数“错误程度足够大”，以至于改变了保护合同优先纳入的农场排序，拍卖绩效可能会显著削弱。低估真实协调效益的参数对政策绩效的损害小于高估这些效益的参数。
10.1093/erae/jbag015.title: Spatially coordinated conservation auctions under imperfect information about ecological spillovers
10.1093/erae/jbag015.title_zh: 不完全信息下考虑生态溢出效应的空间协调保护拍卖

10.1093/erae/jbag016.abstract: This study examines the impact of smartphone adoption on livestock trading in pastoral China. We develop a bargaining and search model with two mechanisms: information discovery, which reduces herders’ search costs, and information posting, which expands market access. Using household survey data, we find that smartphone adoption increases selling prices. Mechanism analysis shows that traditional phone functions improve information access, while smartphone-specific features, especially information posting, enhance bargaining power by expanding selling channels and trader access. These findings demonstrate that digital technologies affect market outcomes not only through improved information access but also by reshaping bargaining structures and market participation.
10.1093/erae/jbag016.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了智能手机采用对中国牧区牲畜交易的影响。我们构建了一个包含两种机制的议价与搜索模型：信息发现机制，降低了牧民的搜索成本；信息发布机制，扩大了市场准入。利用家户调查数据，我们发现智能手机的采用提高了销售价格。机制分析表明，传统电话功能改善了信息获取，而智能手机特有功能，尤其是信息发布，通过拓宽销售渠道和增加交易商接触，增强了议价能力。这些发现表明，数字技术不仅通过改善信息获取，还通过重塑议价结构和市场参与，影响市场结果。
10.1093/erae/jbag016.title: Smartphones, information, and bargaining power: Evidence from pastoral areas in China
10.1093/erae/jbag016.title_zh: 智能手机、信息与议价能力：来自中国牧区的证据

10.1093/erae/jbag017.abstract: There are optimistic targets for phosphorus recycling from waste streams to solve environmental and supply issues simultaneously. The recycling process requires high energy inputs, thus the joint distribution of (input) energy and (output) fertilizer commodity prices is a crucial determinant of the profitability of investing. We propose a methodology to model the investment risk and price dependencies using quantile vector autoregression and copulas. Moreover, we show that standard approaches overestimate the variance of investment returns. Finally, we find that phosphorus recycling investments are only profitable with substantial subsidies or savings on disposal expenditures.
10.1093/erae/jbag017.abstract_zh: 针对从废物流中回收磷以同时解决环境与供应问题的乐观目标，回收过程需要高能量投入，因此（投入）能源与（产出）肥料商品价格的联合分布是投资盈利性的关键决定因素。我们提出了一种方法，利用分位数向量自回归和连接函数来建模投资风险与价格依赖性。此外，我们表明标准方法高估了投资回报的方差。最后，我们发现磷回收投资仅在获得大量补贴或节省处置支出时才具有盈利性。
10.1093/erae/jbag017.title: Commodity price risk in phosphorus recycling investments
10.1093/erae/jbag017.title_zh: 磷回收投资中的商品价格风险

10.1093/jeea/jvag021.title: Correction to: Taxing Capital in the Presence of Trickle-Down Effects
10.1093/jeea/jvag021.title_zh: 更正：涓滴效应下的资本课税

10.1093/jeea/jvag023.abstract: States sometimes back rebellions abroad to signal resolve. We study this reputation-building logic in international relations, focusing on co-ethnic links between countries as an objective source of variation in a state‚s incentives to demonstrate resolve. We formally derive two interconnected predictions from the mechanism: (a) a state is more likely to endorse the uprising of a foreign group when facing a larger audience, resulting in (b) greater political inclusion for the group. We build a comprehensive panel dataset of co-ethnic rebellion sponsorship, and find evidence consistent with both predictions.
10.1093/jeea/jvag023.abstract_zh: 国家有时会支持国外的叛乱以展示其决心。我们研究国际关系中的这种声誉构建逻辑，重点关注国家间基于同族裔联系这一客观因素，如何影响国家展示决心的动机。我们通过形式化推导得出两个相互关联的预测：（a）当面对更广泛的受众时，国家更可能支持外国群体的起义，从而（b）该群体获得更大的政治包容性。我们构建了关于同族裔叛乱赞助的全面面板数据集，并发现了与这两个预测一致的证据。
10.1093/jeea/jvag023.title: Building Reputation: State-Sponsored Rebellions and Transnational Identities,
10.1093/jeea/jvag023.title_zh: 构建声誉：国家支持的叛乱与跨国身份

10.1093/jeea/jvag025.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic equilibrium model of crime with heterogeneous agents and human capital accumulation. Agents decide whether to commit crimes by comparing potential gains with the expected punishment. Public security policies are defined as pairs of a size of the police force and an average sentence length. We propose a micro-founded public security technology linking expenditures on police to the probability of apprehension of a criminal. We illustrate the relevance of this theoretical framework by using an estimated version of the model using US data to (i) characterize the socially optimal public security policy; (ii) explore potential complementarities across public security and educational policies; and (iii) show that comparative statics exercises often lead, under reasonable parameter values, to recommendations that differ from those obtained in a global optimality analysis. These results highlight the relevance of equilibrium considerations in the economic analysis of crime. The paper gives a methodological first step towards building a manageable model of crime that can bring together different pieces of evidence—and equilibrium considerations—when evaluating the trade-offs across policy alternatives.
10.1093/jeea/jvag025.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含异质性主体与人力资本积累的动态均衡犯罪模型。行为人通过比较潜在收益与预期惩罚来决定是否实施犯罪。公共安全政策被定义为警力规模与平均刑期长度的组合。我们提出了一种基于微观基础的公共安全技术，将警务支出与罪犯被捕概率相关联。通过使用美国数据对模型进行参数估计，我们阐明了该理论框架的适用性，具体用于：（i）刻画社会最优公共安全政策；（ii）探索公共安全政策与教育政策之间的潜在互补性；（iii）证明在合理参数取值下，比较静态分析得出的政策建议往往与全局最优性分析结果存在差异。这些结论凸显了均衡考量在犯罪经济学分析中的重要性。本文为构建一个可操作的犯罪模型提供了方法论基础，该模型能够在评估不同政策方案的权衡时，整合多元实证证据与均衡分析视角。
10.1093/jeea/jvag025.title: Socially Optimal Crime and Punishment
10.1093/jeea/jvag025.title_zh: 社会最优的犯罪与惩罚

10.1093/jeea/jvag026.abstract: Health matters for marital outcomes, but health information may remain concealed until marriage. Our matching model, which incorporates socioeconomic status (SES) and health, predicts that the removal of health information should shift sorting toward SES, potentially reducing child health and welfare, particularly for those with low SES. We empirically examine this in the context of rural China, following the repeal of compulsory premarital health examinations (PHE). Our difference-in-differences estimation, which compares provinces with varying levels of exposure based on pre-policy PHE rates, confirms a larger shift in sorting patterns in provinces with higher treatment intensity. The decrease in health-based assortative matching negatively affects child health outcomes, which is followed by a decline in postmarital subjective well-being. Women and low-SES individuals experience larger losses than their counterparts within the same highly affected provinces, highlighting persistent gender and socioeconomic disparities.
10.1093/jeea/jvag026.abstract_zh: 健康对婚姻结果至关重要，但健康信息可能在婚前仍处于隐匿状态。我们的匹配模型纳入了社会经济地位（SES）与健康因素，预测健康信息的消除将促使婚配模式转向以SES为基础，这可能降低儿童健康与福利水平，尤其对低SES群体影响显著。我们以中国农村地区为背景，在强制婚前健康检查（PHE）制度取消后展开实证研究。基于政策实施前各省PHE覆盖率差异，采用双重差分法比较不同暴露程度的省份，证实治疗强度较高的省份婚配模式转变幅度更大。基于健康指标的选型匹配减少对儿童健康结果产生负面影响，进而导致婚后主观幸福感下降。在同一高影响省份内，女性和低SES群体相比其他群体遭受更大损失，凸显了持续存在的性别与社会经济不平等。
10.1093/jeea/jvag026.title: Ignorance is Whose Bliss: The Repeal of Compulsory Premarital Health Examinations and Marital Outcomes in Rural China
10.1093/jeea/jvag026.title_zh: 无知是谁的福气：中国农村强制婚前体检的废除与婚姻结果

10.1093/jeea/jvag027.abstract: At the aggregate level, the observation that deviations from purchasing power parity (PPP) are too persistent to be accounted for solely by nominal rigidities has long been a puzzle (Rogoff 1996). In addition, microeconomic evidence suggests that deviations from the law of one price (LOP) are less persistent than PPP deviations. To reconcile these two empirical anomalies, we incorporate the behavioral inattention approach of Gabaix (2014) into a two-country sticky-price model. Our model shows that firms’ behavioral inattention to the aggregate component of real marginal costs generates an endogenous dependence of LOP deviations on PPP deviations. We find strong supporting evidence for this particular formulation of behavioral inattention. Calibrating our model with the estimated degree of attention, we show that our model can fully account for the two empirical anomalies. PPP deviations are more than twice as persistent as those implied by nominal rigidities alone, while the persistence of LOP deviations is about two-thirds that of PPP deviations.
10.1093/jeea/jvag027.abstract_zh: 在总体层面，购买力平价偏离的持续性远超名义刚性所能解释的范围，这一现象长期以来被视为一个谜题（Rogoff 1996）。此外，微观经济证据表明，一价定律偏离的持续性低于购买力平价偏离。为调和这两个实证异常，我们将Gabaix（2014）的行为疏忽方法引入两国粘性价格模型。模型表明，企业对实际边际成本中总体成分的行为疏忽，会内生地导致一价定律偏离对购买力平价偏离的依赖。我们找到了支持这一特定行为疏忽公式的有力证据。通过使用估计的注意力程度校准模型，我们证明该模型能够完全解释这两个实证异常：购买力平价偏离的持续性比仅由名义刚性所隐含的持续性高出两倍以上，而一价定律偏离的持续性约为购买力平价偏离的三分之二。
10.1093/jeea/jvag027.title: A Behavioral Explanation for the Puzzling Persistence of the Aggregate Real Exchange Rate
10.1093/jeea/jvag027.title_zh: 实际汇率持续之谜的行为解释

10.1093/jeea/jvag028.abstract: This paper studies electoral competition over redistributive taxation between a safe incumbent and a risky opponent. With reference-dependent preferences, economically disappointed voters become risk lovers, and hence are attracted by the more risky candidate. We show that the equilibrium can display policy divergence: the intrinsically more risky candidate proposes lower taxes and is supported by a coalition of very rich and very disappointed voters, while the safe candidate proposes higher taxes. This can explain why right-wing populist parties are often supported by economically dissatisfied voters and yet they run on policy platforms of low redistribution.
10.1093/jeea/jvag028.abstract_zh: 本文研究安全在任者与风险挑战者之间围绕再分配税收的选举竞争。在参照依赖偏好下，经济上失望的选民会变成风险偏好者，因而更倾向于支持风险较高的候选人。我们证明，均衡状态可能呈现政策分化：内在风险较高的候选人提出较低税率，并得到由极富裕和极失望选民组成的联盟支持，而安全候选人则提出较高税率。这可以解释为何右翼民粹主义政党常获得经济不满选民的支持，却推行低再分配的政策纲领。
10.1093/jeea/jvag028.title: The Political Implications of Reference-Dependent Preferences,
10.1093/jeea/jvag028.title_zh: 参考依赖偏好的政治含义

10.1093/jeea/jvag029.abstract: We examine the rise of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) in wartime China. Using a spatial regression discontinuity design and several measures as proxies for the rise of the Party during the Sino-Japanese War (middle- to upper-rank party cadres, grassroots party organization, and guerrilla bases), we find that it grew significantly more in counties occupied by the Japanese Army. However, despite its popularity before the war, the same markers were not statistically significant at that time. We identify two primary channels behind the political ascendancy of the CCP. First, the communists took advantage of the militarily weaker “puppet troops” in charge of administering the loosely held occupied areas. Second, support for the CCP was fueled by a strong anti-Japanese sentiment spurred by war suffering, using civilian casualties and rape cases as proxies for the harm inflicted. Finally, the CCP’s wartime influence persisted after the war: former Japanese Occupied Areas exhibited a significantly higher density of party membership between 1950 and 1980.
10.1093/jeea/jvag029.abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国共产党在战时中国的崛起。利用空间断点回归设计，并以多项指标（中高级党员干部、基层党组织及游击根据地）作为党在抗日战争期间崛起的代理变量，我们发现党在日军占领的县域中发展显著更快。然而，尽管战前该党已具声望，但同一指标在战前并不具有统计显著性。我们识别出中共政治崛起的两个主要渠道：首先，共产党利用了负责管理松散占领区的军事上较弱的“伪军”；其次，以平民伤亡和强奸案件作为战争伤害的代理变量，由战争苦难激发的强烈抗日情绪推动了民众对中共的支持。最后，中共的战时影响力在战后持续存在：1950年至1980年间，原日军占领区的党员密度显著更高。
10.1093/jeea/jvag029.title: The Rise of the Chinese Communist Party,

10.1093/jeea/jvag030.abstract: We study the interaction between monetary policy and labor supply decisions at the household level. We uncover evidence of heterogeneous responses and a strong countercyclicality of hours worked in the left tail of the income distribution following a monetary policy shock in the US. Specifically, while aggregate hours and labor earnings decline after a monetary tightening, individuals at the bottom of the income distribution increase their hours worked. Moreover, this positive labor supply response is quantitatively significant, substantially dampening the decline in aggregate hours worked. We show that the empirical patterns are consistent with a standard one-asset HANK model featuring endogenous labor supply. The model reveals that strong income effects at the bottom of the distribution can account for the observed countercyclical labor responses, highlighting how labor supply adjustments act as an additional margin through which households smooth consumption. Comparing this specification to a model with a homogeneous labor supply, we find that labor supply heterogeneity reduces the aggregate MPC and attenuates the transmission of monetary policy through aggregate demand. As a result, the output cost of disinflation is lower in economies where poorer households can flexibly adjust their labor effort, easing the trade-off faced by the central bank.
10.1093/jeea/jvag030.abstract_zh: 本文研究了货币政策与家庭层面劳动供给决策之间的相互作用。我们发现了美国货币政策冲击后劳动供给的异质性反应证据，以及收入分布左尾工作时长的强逆周期性特征。具体而言，当货币紧缩导致总工时和劳动收入下降时，收入分布底层的个体反而增加了工作时长。此外，这种正向劳动供给反应在数量上具有显著性，显著缓解了总工时的下降幅度。我们证明，这些实证特征与包含内生劳动供给的标准单资产HANK模型一致。模型揭示，收入分布底层的强收入效应可以解释所观察到的逆周期劳动反应，凸显了劳动供给调整作为家庭平滑消费的额外渠道。将该设定与同质劳动供给模型对比发现，劳动供给异质性降低了总边际消费倾向，并削弱了货币政策通过总需求的传导效应。因此，在贫困家庭能灵活调整劳动投入的经济体中，通胀抑制的产出成本更低，从而缓解了央行面临的权衡取舍。
10.1093/jeea/jvag030.title: A Tail of Labor Supply and a Tale of Monetary Policy
10.1093/jeea/jvag030.title_zh: 劳动供给的尾部与货币政策的故事

10.1093/jeea/jvag031.abstract: We study the feasibility of opening new mines in ethnically diverse countries without escalating the risk of conflict. We propose a theoretical model in which ethnic groups can organize themselves to fight at the national or the local level. Our model yields two key insights. First, peace cannot be guaranteed in the presence of ethnic segregation and spatial resource inequality. Second, once the peace-maximizing policies are implemented, local conflict risks depend on local resource rents and local ethnic groups as well as the country’s entire ethnic and mining geography. We validate key concepts from our model using granular spatial data from Sierra Leone and the rest of sub-Saharan Africa and employing a shift-share identification strategy. We then apply these concepts to simulate the potential impact of planned mining projects in Sierra Leone and confirm that projects in the right locations can promote peace. We offer policy recommendations for making the mining industry a facilitator of peace and prosperity.
10.1093/jeea/jvag031.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在多民族国家中开设新矿而不加剧冲突风险的可行性。我们构建了一个理论模型，其中各民族群体可在国家或地方层面组织起来进行斗争。该模型得出两个关键结论：第一，在存在民族隔离与空间资源不平等的情况下，无法保障和平；第二，一旦实施最大化和平的政策，地方冲突风险不仅取决于地方资源租金和地方民族群体，还取决于整个国家的民族与矿业地理格局。我们利用塞拉利昂及撒哈拉以南非洲其他地区的精细空间数据，并采用份额转移识别策略，验证了模型中的核心概念。随后，我们运用这些概念模拟了塞拉利昂计划中采矿项目的潜在影响，证实选址得当的项目能够促进和平。最后，我们提出政策建议，旨在使采矿业成为和平与繁荣的推动者。
10.1093/jeea/jvag031.title: Mining for Peace,

10.1093/jeea/jvag032.abstract: Most comparative analyses explaining the 1970s and 1990s/2000s inflation performance, focusing on good/bad policy versus good/bad luck, assume that price and wage-setting institutions remained constant. While studies acknowledge institutional changes, they typically overlook sources of intrinsic persistence of wage and price inflation. This paper contributes to this ongoing debate by revisiting the U.S. business cycle. We account for time variations in pricing and wage-setting behavior due to institutional changes and for switches in inflation-intrinsic persistence, which we formally represent as changes in the shape of the hazard function. By analyzing how policy and shocks interact within different institutional settings in our model economy, we trace the existing contrasting evidence back to an identification problem that biases regime estimates and leads to misleading interpretations. Once we account for persistence switches, the empirical outcomes strongly support, but refine, the luck interpretation over the policy interpretation. The 1970s were characterized not only by larger shocks but also by more pronounced transmission mechanisms of supply shocks, driven by the price- and wage-setting institutions of the time. Additionally, the data suggest to reinterpret the monetary regimes more in line with the central bankers’ view and show that structural changes in price and wage adjustments play essential and opposite roles in the Great Inflation. Finally, our analysis yields two important general findings. First, it emphasizes the critical role that changes in price and wage-setting institutions play in influencing the propagation of shocks. Second, it validates the use of a generalized time-dependent rule to represent nominal rigidities.
10.1093/jeea/jvag032.abstract_zh: 大多数比较分析在解释1970年代与1990年代/2000年代的通胀表现时，聚焦于政策优劣与运气好坏之争，均假设价格与工资设定制度保持不变。尽管部分研究承认制度变迁的存在，但通常忽略了工资与价格通胀内在持续性的根源。本文通过重新审视美国商业周期，为这一持续争论做出贡献。我们考虑了因制度变迁导致的定价与工资设定行为的时间变化，以及通胀内在持续性的转变——这种转变在形式上表现为风险函数形态的变化。通过分析政策与冲击在我们模型经济中不同制度环境下的交互作用，我们将现有相互矛盾的证据追溯至一个识别问题：该问题导致对制度区间的估计产生偏差，并引发误导性解读。一旦我们纳入持续性转变因素，实证结果便强烈支持（但修正了）运气解释优于政策解释的结论。1970年代不仅面临更大的冲击，更因当时的价格与工资设定制度，导致供给冲击的传导机制更为显著。此外，数据表明应重新解读货币制度，使其更符合央行官员的视角，并揭示价格与工资调整的结构性变化在大通胀中扮演了关键且对立的作用。最后，我们的分析得出两项重要的一般性结论：第一，强调价格与工资设定制度变迁在影响冲击传导中的关键作用；第二，验证了使用广义时间依赖规则来表征名义刚性的有效性。
10.1093/jeea/jvag032.title: The U.S. Economic Dynamics and Inflation Persistence: A Regime-Switching Perspective
10.1093/jeea/jvag032.title_zh: 美国经济动态与通胀持续性：基于体制转换视角

10.1093/jeea/jvag033.abstract: We introduce a Generalized Nested Logit model of demand for bundles that can be estimated sequentially, eliminating the challenge of dimensionality due to large choice sets. We use it to investigate quantity discounts for carbonated soft drinks by simulating a counterfactual with linear pricing.
