The prices of small-volume UPCs (<2L) decrease by −29.2% while those of large-volume UPCs (≥2L) increase by +16.8%. Purchased quantities decrease by −19.5% and industry profit by −6.3%. Consumer surplus however reduces only moderately, suggesting that a ban on quantity discounts on sugary drinks may be a simple and effective policy to limit added sugar intake. Our calculations confirm that such a ban would be as effective as a sugar tax of 1.5/oz of added sugar and reduce added sugar intake by −17.4%. A nested logit model that mistakenly ignores joint purchases of UPCs within shopping trips would instead simulate a reduction in added sugar intake of only −3.9%.
10.1093/jeea/jvag033.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种广义嵌套Logit需求模型，用于估计捆绑商品的需求，该模型可通过序贯估计方法解决因选择集过大带来的维度问题。我们利用该模型研究碳酸饮料的数量折扣问题，通过模拟线性定价的反事实情景发现：小容量UPC（<2升）价格下降29.2%，而大容量UPC（≥2升）价格上涨16.8%。购买量减少19.5%，行业利润下降6.3%，但消费者剩余仅温和下降，这表明禁止含糖饮料的数量折扣可能是限制添加糖摄入的简单有效政策。我们的计算证实，该禁令的效果相当于对每盎司添加糖征收1.5美分的糖税，可使添加糖摄入量减少17.4%。若错误采用忽略购物行程中UPC联合购买的嵌套Logit模型，则模拟得出的添加糖摄入量降幅仅为3.9%。
10.1093/jeea/jvag033.title: An Empirical Model of Quantity Discounts with Large Choice Sets
10.1093/jeea/jvag033.title_zh: 大选择集下数量折扣的实证模型

10.1093/jeea/jvag034.abstract: We study how job mobility, firms, and firm-ladder climbing can shape immigrants’ labor market success. Our context is the mass migration of former Soviet Union Jews to Israel during the 1990s. Once in Israel, these immigrants faced none of the legal barriers that are typically posed by migration regulations around the world, offering a unique backdrop to study undistorted immigrants’ job mobility and resulting unconstrained assimilation. Rich administrative data allows us to follow immigrants for up to three decades after arrival. Immigrants experienced large initial wage gaps relative to natives—57% for men and 47% for women—and 12%–20% of these gaps are explained by differential sorting across firms and differential pay-setting within firms. The wage gap closes only after 27–29 years, and much of this convergence is driven by immigrants’ differential climbing of the firm ladder: immigrants are more mobile and experience faster upward moves, even in the long term. As such, firm-to-firm mobility is a key driver of these immigrants’ long-run prosperity. Lastly, we quantify a previously undocumented job utility gap when accounting for non-wage amenities. Upon arrival, immigrants’ non-pay amenities were lower by 0.38 (men) and 0.94 (women) native standard deviations. As such, amenities exacerbate immigrant-native disparities based on pay alone.
10.1093/jeea/jvag034.abstract_zh: 本文研究职业流动性、企业以及企业阶梯攀升如何影响移民在劳动力市场中的成功。我们的研究背景是20世纪90年代前苏联犹太人向以色列的大规模移民。抵达以色列后，这些移民未面临全球移民法规通常设置的法律障碍，这为研究不受扭曲的移民职业流动性及其导致的无约束同化提供了独特背景。丰富的行政数据使我们能够追踪移民抵达后长达三十年的情况。移民最初面临相对于本地人的巨大工资差距——男性为57%，女性为47%——其中12%至20%的差距可由企业在不同群体间的差异化配置以及企业内部差异化薪酬设定解释。工资差距需27至29年才能弥合，而这一趋同过程很大程度上源于移民在企业阶梯上的差异化攀升：移民流动性更强，且即使在长期内也能实现更快的向上流动。因此，企业间流动性是这些移民长期经济繁荣的关键驱动力。最后，我们在考虑非工资福利后，量化了此前未被记录的职位效用差距。抵达时，移民的非薪酬福利比本地人低0.38（男性）和0.94（女性）个标准差。因此，福利因素加剧了仅基于薪酬的移民与本地人之间的差距。
10.1093/jeea/jvag034.title: The Role of Firms and Job Mobility in the Assimilation of Immigrants: Former Soviet Union Jews in Israel 1990–2019,
10.1093/jeea/jvag034.title_zh: 企业与工作流动性在移民融入中的作用：1990–2019年以色列的前苏联犹太人

10.1093/jeea/jvag035.abstract: How will future climate change affect Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) in terms of migration and welfare? Can policymakers help SSA adapt to this process? I answer these questions with a quantitative framework that, coupled with rich spatial data and forecasts for the future climate, projects millions of climate migrants and unequal welfare losses across SSA. Investigating migration and trade liberalization as policy tools, I find persistent inequality in welfare losses if only migration barriers in SSA are reduced. Relaxing trade barriers addresses these distributional concerns, as do both policies combined. Yet, the policy mix is less effective in reducing aggregate losses due to inefficiencies arising from congestion externalities.
10.1093/jeea/jvag035.abstract_zh: 未来气候变化将如何影响撒哈拉以南非洲地区的移民与福利？政策制定者能否帮助该地区适应这一过程？本文通过构建一个量化分析框架，结合丰富的空间数据与未来气候预测，揭示了撒哈拉以南非洲地区将出现数百万气候移民及不均衡的福利损失。在将移民与贸易自由化作为政策工具进行研究时发现，若仅降低撒哈拉以南非洲地区的移民壁垒，福利损失的不平等现象将持续存在。放松贸易壁垒能够解决这些分配问题，而两项政策组合实施亦能达到同样效果。然而，由于拥挤外部性导致的效率损失，政策组合在减少总体损失方面的有效性有所降低。
10.1093/jeea/jvag035.title: Climate Change and Migration: The Case of Africa,
10.1093/jeea/jvag035.title_zh: 气候变化与移民：以非洲为例

10.1093/jeea/jvag036.abstract: This paper examines how monetary policy committee announcements and inflation surprises affect Turkish firms’ inflation expectations and FX management decisions during the 2015-2024 period–a time characterized by both relatively stable and highly volatile inflation. Using survey data, we define monetary policy (inflation) surprises as the unexpected component of interest rate (inflation) forecasts measured within a narrow window around policy announcements. First, we show that firms’ aggregate inflation expectations change significantly in response to monetary policy shocks, but their response is highly state-dependent: In relatively stable inflation environments, firms react in line with standard theory, anticipating a decline in prices while becoming pessimistic about the economic outlook. By contrast, in volatile settings, firms adopt a supply-side interpretation, revising their expectations upward amid pessimism. Second, inflation surprises increase inflation expectations and heighten pessimism regardless of the state, providing additional evidence for the supply-side view. Third, a positive inflation surprise induces an increase in FX holdings-reflecting concerns about potential currency depreciation-whereas an unexpected policy rate hike prompts firms to reduce FX positions in anticipation of currency appreciation. Our findings demonstrate that in a high-inflation environment, firms are especially attentive to macroeconomic developments, revising their inflation expectations and adjusting their financial strategies accordingly. These results underscore the importance of monetary policy communication and inflation news in shaping firm-level decisions, particularly when inflation is elevated and volatile.
10.1093/jeea/jvag036.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2015-2024年间货币政策委员会公告与通胀意外如何影响土耳其企业的通胀预期及外汇管理决策——这一时期既包含相对稳定的通胀阶段，也涵盖高度波动的通胀时期。基于调查数据，我们将货币政策（通胀）意外定义为政策公告前后短时间窗口内利率（通胀）预测中未预期的成分。首先，我们发现企业总体通胀预期会因货币政策冲击而发生显著变化，但其反应具有高度状态依赖性：在相对稳定的通胀环境下，企业的反应符合标准理论，预期价格下降的同时对经济前景持悲观态度；相反，在波动环境下，企业采取供给侧解读，在悲观情绪中上调通胀预期。其次，无论处于何种状态，通胀意外均会推高通胀预期并加剧悲观情绪，这为供给侧观点提供了额外证据。第三，正向通胀意外导致企业增加外汇持有量——反映出对潜在货币贬值的担忧——而意外的政策利率上调则促使企业因预期货币升值而减少外汇头寸。我们的研究结果表明，在高通胀环境下，企业尤其关注宏观经济动态，并据此调整通胀预期与财务策略。这些结果凸显了货币政策沟通与通胀新闻在塑造企业层面决策中的重要性，尤其是在通胀高企且波动剧烈的时期。
10.1093/jeea/jvag036.title: How Do Monetary Policy and Inflation Announcements Affect Firm Expectations in High Inflation?
10.1093/jeea/jvag036.title_zh: 货币政策和通胀公告如何影响高通胀环境下的企业预期？

10.1093/jeea/jvag037.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper develops a novel method to estimate inequality within a country based on what the country imports. If preferences are non-homothetic, rich and poor individuals of a country have different consumption profiles. Imports can thus inform about the income distribution in a country. The global availability of trade data allows us to estimate inequality using a single transparent and comparable method for a large sample of countries over time. Compared to conventional data, we feature an especially good coverage of developing countries. We provide a number of robustness checks and cross-validation exercises that show the good performance of our method.</jats:p>
10.1093/jeea/jvag037.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于国家进口数据估算国内不平等程度的新方法。若偏好具有非位似性，一国富人与穷人的消费结构将存在差异，因此进口数据可反映该国的收入分配状况。利用全球可获取的贸易数据，我们能够通过单一透明且可比的方法，对大量国家在时间序列上的不平等程度进行估算。与传统数据相比，本方法尤其能覆盖更多发展中国家。我们通过多项稳健性检验和交叉验证，证实了该方法具有良好的表现。
10.1093/jeea/jvag037.title: Recovering Within-Country Inequality From Trade Data,
10.1093/jeea/jvag037.title_zh: 从贸易数据中恢复国内不平等程度

10.1093/jeea/jvag038.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper empirically examines the idea that the increasing return to college is reducing intergenerational mobility by differentially impacting the investments in children by parents across education groups. A larger return to college will create stronger incentives to invest in children by parents with more education, if educated parents have a comparative advantage in producing human capital in children. Given the importance of a two-parent household on childhood development, marital status is a critical investment decision that parents consider. Relative to less-educated mothers, the analysis shows that educated mothers in states with a larger increase in the return to education are more likely to be married, less likely to divorce, have a more educated spouse, and own more valuable houses. Their children also have relatively higher test scores in 8th grade and rates of college completion. These results are consistent with the increasing return to college differentially affecting the incentives for parental investments in children, which in turn, creates greater disparities in childhood conditions and reduces intergenerational mobility in education.</jats:p>
10.1093/jeea/jvag038.abstract_zh: 本文实证检验了如下观点：大学教育回报率的上升正通过不同教育背景父母对子女投资行为的差异化影响，降低代际流动性。若受教育程度较高的父母在子女人力资本培育方面具有比较优势，则更高的大学教育回报将激励其增加对子女的投资。鉴于双亲家庭对儿童发展的重要性，婚姻状况是父母考虑的关键投资决策。分析表明，相较于低学历母亲，在受教育回报率增幅较大的州，高学历母亲更可能处于已婚状态、离婚概率更低、配偶受教育程度更高、且拥有更高价值的房产。其子女在八年级的学业测试成绩及大学完成率也相对更高。这些结果印证了大学教育回报率上升会差异化影响父母对子女的投资激励，进而加剧儿童成长环境的不平等，并削弱教育代际流动性。
10.1093/jeea/jvag038.title: The Return to College, Marriage, and Intergenerational Mobility
10.1093/jeea/jvag038.title_zh: 大学教育、婚姻与代际流动的回报

10.1093/jeea/jvag039.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Political polarization is a growing concern in many countries. Are mass protests merely a sign of increasing cleavages, or do they polarize societies? In this paper, we estimate the impact of Nazi marches in 1932 Hamburg, using granular data from 622 voting precincts during 6 elections. We show propaganda can persuade – but it does by raising the share of areas with high levels of Nazi support. Importantly, marches can also backfire, repelling voters. Thus, protest marches lead to polarization. These effects diffused through social networks, measured as contagion patterns across neighborhoods from the 1918 Spanish flu outbreak. The electoral effects of social spillovers are of similar importance as direct exposure, and grow over time.</jats:p>
10.1093/jeea/jvag039.abstract_zh: 政治极化是许多国家日益严峻的问题。大规模抗议仅仅是社会裂痕加剧的表现，还是会导致社会极化？本文利用1932年汉堡622个投票区在6次选举中的微观数据，估算了纳粹游行的影响。研究表明，宣传具有说服力——但这是通过提高纳粹支持率较高地区的占比来实现的。重要的是，游行也可能适得其反，使选民产生排斥。因此，抗议游行导致了极化。这些效应通过社会网络扩散，以1918年西班牙流感爆发期间社区间的传染模式为衡量标准。社会溢出效应对选举的影响与直接接触同等重要，且随时间推移而增强。
10.1093/jeea/jvag039.title: Going Viral: Protests and Polarization in 1932 Hamburg,
10.1093/jeea/jvag039.title_zh: 病毒式传播：1932年汉堡的抗议与极化

10.1093/jeea/jvag040.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Can markets discipline socially costly misbehavior abroad? We explore the market penalty associated with major human rights violations—specifically, the assassination of mining activists, a context where formal legal recourse is rare and events often do not involve counterparties. We show that firms featured in media coverage of these incidents experience significant, negative abnormal stock returns. Whereas reactions to related forms of corporate misconduct may be transitory or muted, we find that the market responses are both substantial and persistent, with a median 10-day loss exceeding USD 100 million. Since formal legal sanction is exceedingly rare, we consider the role of market penalties. We highlight three mechanisms that are consistent with reputational costs: (1) Media attention magnifies the market response. (2) Information-sensitive institutional investors systematically divest following assassination events. (3) Events reduce future trade, leading to a 19% decline in new contracts with counterparties. Despite these costs, events persist. We find that assassinations increase with dependence on mining royalties, suggesting that local rents sustain conflict despite market pressure. Thus, reputational sanctions may be significant—even in weakly institutionalized settings—yet may not fully deter misbehavior when local and global incentives diverge.</jats:p>
10.1093/jeea/jvag040.abstract_zh: 市场能否约束企业在海外的高成本不当行为？我们探讨了与重大人权侵犯相关的市场惩罚——具体而言，即针对采矿活动人士的暗杀事件。在此类情境下，正式法律救济极为罕见，且事件往往不涉及交易对手。研究表明，媒体报道中提及这些事件的企业会经历显著且负面的异常股票回报。尽管针对相关形式的企业不当行为的市场反应可能是短暂或微弱的，但我们发现市场反应既显著又持久，其中位10天损失超过1亿美元。由于正式法律制裁极为罕见，我们考察了市场惩罚的作用。我们强调了与声誉成本一致的三种机制：（1）媒体关注放大了市场反应；（2）信息敏感的机构投资者在暗杀事件后系统性地撤资；（3）事件减少了未来交易，导致与新交易对手的合同数量下降19%。尽管存在这些成本，事件仍持续发生。我们发现，暗杀事件随对采矿特许权使用费的依赖程度增加而增加，这表明尽管存在市场压力，地方租金仍维持冲突。因此，声誉制裁可能意义重大——即使在制度薄弱的环境中——但当地方与全球激励不一致时，可能无法完全遏制不当行为。
10.1093/jeea/jvag040.title: The Value of Names: Civil Society, Information, and Governing Multinationals,
10.1093/jeea/jvag040.title_zh: 名称的价值：公民社会、信息与跨国公司的治理

10.1093/jeea/jvag041.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study how political parties engage in political targeting of resources by coordinating politicians across multiple levels of government. We combine thousands of election outcomes from the Indian state of West Bengal with 300 million payments from a welfare scheme jointly controlled by state and local governments. We show that the state government gives disproportionate funding to co-partisan local councils, which target payments to raise votes for national candidates. Welfare payments are diverted to reward local councilors who successfully deliver votes, and to recruit opposition councilors. The ruling party recruits candidates only where it lacks a majority, systematically expanding its control.</jats:p>
10.1093/jeea/jvag041.abstract_zh: 我们研究了政党如何通过协调多级政府中的政治家来实施政治资源定向。我们将印度西孟加拉邦数千个选举结果与一项由邦政府和地方政府共同控制的福利计划中3亿笔支付记录相结合。研究显示，邦政府向同党地方议会提供不成比例的资金，这些资金被用于定向支付以提升国家层面候选人的得票率。福利支付被挪用，用于奖励成功拉票的地方议员，并招募反对党议员。执政党仅在未获得多数席位的地方招募候选人，从而系统性地扩大其控制范围。
10.1093/jeea/jvag041.title: Party Organizations and Complementary Political Control,
10.1093/jeea/jvag041.title_zh: 党组织与互补性政治控制

10.1093/jeea/jvag042.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper studies how large firms’ synchronized lumpy investments endogenously shape an economy’s fragility to negative TFP shocks. I develop a heterogeneous-firm real business cycle model that matches the empirical interest rate elasticities of investment for both large and small firms. In the model, large firms’ lumpy investments become persistently synchronized due to their low sensitivity to general equilibrium effects, generating investment surges. Following these surges, TFP-induced recessions are particularly severe, and the semi-elasticity of aggregate investment drops significantly, consistent with the data.</jats:p>
10.1093/jeea/jvag042.abstract_zh: 本文研究大型企业同步化的大额投资如何内生地塑造经济对负向全要素生产率冲击的脆弱性。我构建了一个异质性企业真实商业周期模型，该模型与大型和小型企业投资的经验利率弹性相匹配。在该模型中，大型企业的大额投资由于对一般均衡效应的敏感性较低而持续同步化，从而产生投资激增。在这些激增之后，全要素生产率引发的衰退尤为严重，且总投资的半弹性显著下降，这与数据一致。
10.1093/jeea/jvag042.title: Striking While the Iron Is Cold: Fragility after a Surge of Lumpy Investments,
10.1093/jeea/jvag042.title_zh: 趁热打铁：大宗投资激增后的脆弱性

10.1093/jeea/jvag043.abstract: Taxes on capital gains are deferred until realization whereas dividends are taxed upon accrual. This often makes dividends tax disadvantaged relative to share repurchases, which leads to the payout puzzle: why do firms pay dividends? This paper demonstrates that tax deferment can also provide a solution to this puzzle: if shareholders with an accrued capital gain and a non-zero investment horizon demand a premium to sell equity—as compensation for accelerated realizations (and taxation)—then dividends can become tax efficient. This mechanism is appealing because it can explain dividend payments without appealing to asymmetric information, incomplete contracting, repurchase constraints, and/or irrationality.
10.1093/jeea/jvag043.abstract_zh: 资本利得税在实现时递延缴纳，而股息则在应计时征税。这通常使股息相对于股票回购处于税收劣势，从而引发"股利之谜"：企业为何仍要支付股息？本文证明，税收递延机制同样能为这一谜题提供解释：若持有已实现资本利得且投资期限非零的股东要求溢价出售股权——作为加速实现（及纳税）的补偿——则股息可能具有税收效率。该机制的优势在于，无需借助信息不对称、不完全契约、回购限制或非理性行为等假设，即可解释股息支付现象。
10.1093/jeea/jvag043.title: The Lock-In Effect and the Corporate Payout Puzzle,
10.1093/jeea/jvag043.title_zh: 锁定效应与企业分红之谜

10.1093/jeea/jvag044.abstract: This study examines the potential impact of introducing a transfer system, similar to that used in professional soccer, into the standard labor market. We develop a toy model highlighting the theoretical properties of transfer fees. We show that, unlike non-compete clauses—which generate a trade-off between training and mobility—transfer fees encourage investment in training while preserving efficient mobility toward more productive firms. As a result, such a system brings the economy closer to the social optimum than laissez-faire. We then construct a life-cycle model featuring endogenous job creation and destruction, on-the-job search, and training. Using data from the French Labor Force Survey, we estimate the model’s parameters and conduct counterfactual experiments. Our simulations suggest that a time-limited compensation mechanism would significantly increase employment, training access, and welfare.
10.1093/jeea/jvag044.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了将职业足球中采用的转会制度引入标准劳动力市场可能产生的影响。我们构建了一个简化模型，以阐明转会费的理论特性。研究表明，与在培训与流动性之间产生权衡的非竞争条款不同，转会费在鼓励培训投资的同时，保持了向更具生产力企业流动的高效性。因此，此类制度使经济比自由放任状态更接近社会最优水平。随后，我们构建了一个包含内生就业创造与毁灭、在职搜索及培训的生命周期模型。利用法国劳动力调查数据，我们估计了模型参数并进行了反事实实验。模拟结果显示，一种限时补偿机制将显著提升就业率、培训机会及社会福利。
10.1093/jeea/jvag044.title: Training and Job-to-Job Mobility with Transfer Fees,
10.1093/jeea/jvag044.title_zh: 培训与工作间流动中的转移费用

10.1093/jeea/jvag045.abstract: Social media has created new, highly competitive markets for attention. But to what extent does attention on social media generate tangible economic returns and how are these returns characterized? Using a daily dataset of Twitter activity and campaign contributions for US Members of Congress (2019-2020), we show that attention on Twitter, as measured by likes, increases small donations. However, the effect is highly skewed: only a few members benefit substantially, consistent with a winner-takes-all market. These results are confirmed using a geography-based causal design tracking donation patterns across counties, showing that the increase in donations from attention on Twitter comes disproportionately from high Twitter usage areas.
10.1093/jeea/jvag045.abstract_zh: 社交媒体催生了新的、竞争激烈的注意力市场。然而，社交媒体上的注意力在多大程度上能转化为切实的经济回报，这些回报又具有怎样的特征？利用美国国会议员（2019-2020年）的推特活动与竞选捐款的日度数据集，我们表明，推特上的注意力（以点赞量衡量）会增加小额捐款。然而，这种效应高度偏斜：仅有少数议员获得显著收益，这与赢家通吃的市场特征相符。这些结果通过一项基于地理的因果设计得到证实，该设计追踪了各县的捐款模式，显示推特注意力带来的捐款增长不成比例地来自高推特使用率地区。
10.1093/jeea/jvag045.title: The Returns to Viral Media: The Case of US Campaign Contributions,
10.1093/jeea/jvag045.title_zh: 病毒媒体的回报：美国竞选捐款的案例

10.1093/jeea/jvag046.abstract: Joint household decision-making becomes more common as economies develop. Can external intervention advance this transition? We study this question in the context of female employment in India. We randomized which spouse was given a ticket enabling enrollment in a women’s weaving job, and cross-randomized the other to receive no information about the ticket, information, or information and discussion with their spouse. Academic and local experts predict information and discussion should raise enrollment. Instead, information had no effect, and discussion reduced enrollment by 50%. We do not find an effect of giving the wife the job ticket rather than the husband. Our results show that interventions toward joint decision-making about an opportunity can lower take-up.
10.1093/jeea/jvag046.abstract_zh: 随着经济的发展，家庭联合决策变得越来越普遍。外部干预能否推动这一转变？我们在印度女性就业的背景下研究这一问题。我们随机分配了哪一方配偶获得一张可报名参加女性织布工作的票，并交叉随机分配另一方配偶分别处于三种情况：未获知票的信息、获知信息、或获知信息并与配偶讨论。学术专家和当地专家预测，信息与讨论应能提高报名率。然而，信息并未产生效果，而讨论则使报名率降低了50%。我们未发现将工作票给予妻子而非丈夫会产生影响。我们的结果表明，针对机会的联合决策干预措施可能降低参与率。
10.1093/jeea/jvag046.title: Coupling Labor Supply Decisions: An Experiment in India,
10.1093/jeea/jvag046.title_zh: 印度劳动力供给决策的耦合：一项实验研究

10.1093/jeea/jvag047.abstract: Organizational capacity is widely considered central to whether managers or politicians can deliver complex projects in an efficient manner. Yet in practice performance can depend on the interaction of capacity with a host of factors such as political opposition or regulatory constraints. We develop a dynamic theory of project development that examines these interactions. In the model, higher capacity enables faster progress toward completion, but opposing interests may incur costly delays by attempting to revise the distribution of project payoffs. Project designers can avoid revisions by equalizing distributive benefits or inflating project scales to make delays prohibitively costly. We show that welfare is minimized when both capacity and the ability to revise are moderate. More efficient outcomes are either smaller than socially optimal or have highly unequal distributive outcomes.
10.1093/jeea/jvag047.abstract_zh: 组织能力被广泛视为管理者或政治家能否高效交付复杂项目的核心要素。然而，在实践中，绩效可能取决于能力与政治反对或监管约束等多种因素的相互作用。我们构建了一个项目开发的动态理论，以考察这些相互作用。在该模型中，更高的能力能加速项目向完成推进，但反对利益方可能通过试图修订项目收益分配来造成代价高昂的延误。项目设计者可以通过均衡分配收益或扩大项目规模使延误成本过高，从而避免修订。我们证明，当能力和修订能力均处于中等水平时，社会福利最小化。更有效的结果要么规模小于社会最优，要么分配结果高度不均。
10.1093/jeea/jvag047.title: Organizational Capacity and Project Dynamics,

10.1093/jeea/jvag048.abstract: We estimate how the timing of parental job loss shapes children’s human capital by exploiting plant closures in Danish administrative data. We match treated children to observably similar untreated peers and difference out age-invariant selection using children whose parents are displaced after school completion. Job loss during infancy (ages 0–1) reduces ninth-grade mathematics achievement by 0.04 standard deviations and raises non-completion by one percentage point. Effects are smaller in later childhood. Treated infants are 1.4 percentage points less likely to enrol in general upper-secondary programs. We find that liquidity-constrained families drive these results, suggesting that transient income shocks create permanent educational scars.
10.1093/jeea/jvag048.abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦行政数据中的工厂关闭事件，估计了父母失业时机如何影响子女人力资本。我们将受影响的儿童与观察特征相似且未受影响的同龄人进行匹配，并通过父母在子女完成学业后失业的儿童来差分消除年龄不变的筛选效应。婴儿期（0-1岁）父母失业使九年级数学成绩降低0.04个标准差，并使未完成学业的比例上升一个百分点。在儿童后期，影响较小。受影响的婴儿进入普通高中项目的可能性低1.4个百分点。我们发现，流动性受限家庭是这些结果的主要驱动因素，这表明暂时性的收入冲击会留下永久性的教育伤痕。
10.1093/jeea/jvag048.title: When It Hurts the Most: Timing of Parental Job Loss and a Child’s Education,
10.1093/jeea/jvag048.title_zh: 父母失业时机与子女教育：最痛之时

10.1093/jeea/jvag049.abstract: Social media influencers account for a growing share of marketing worldwide. We demonstrate the existence of a novel form of market failure in the advertising market: influencer cartels, where groups of influencers collude to increase their advertising revenue by inflating their engagement. Our theoretical model shows that influencer cartels can improve consumer welfare if they expand social media engagement to the target audience, or reduce welfare if they divert engagement to less relevant audiences. Drawing on the model’s insights, we empirically examine influencer cartels using novel datasets and machine learning tools, and derive policy implications.
10.1093/jeea/jvag049.abstract_zh: 社交媒体影响者在全球营销中的占比日益增长。我们揭示了广告市场中一种新型市场失灵现象：影响者卡特尔，即影响者群体串通一气，通过夸大其互动量来增加广告收入。我们的理论模型表明，若影响者卡特尔能将社交媒体互动扩展至目标受众，则可提升消费者福利；反之，若将互动转移至相关性较低的受众，则可能降低福利。基于模型洞见，我们运用新颖数据集和机器学习工具对影响者卡特尔进行实证研究，并得出政策启示。
10.1093/jeea/jvag049.title: Influencer Cartels

10.1093/jeea/jvag050.abstract: We investigate the channels through which inflation expectations affect household spending by conducting surveys featuring hypothetical scenarios involving an increase in inflation expectations. Most households did not adjust their current spending plans, often because they perceived inflation expectations as irrelevant or adhered to a fixed budget. Among those who did adjust, most decreased their spending, primarily due to wealth effects. Few households increased spending as prescribed by the traditional intertemporal substitution channel. We also document that financial conditions, cognitive ability, and subjective mental models—such as stagflationary expectations—help predict spending responses and the mechanisms households cite. Our findings provide insights into the discussion of using inflation expectations as a policy tool and highlight key frictions to incorporate into theoretical models.
10.1093/jeea/jvag050.abstract_zh: 我们通过开展涉及通胀预期上升假设情景的调查，探究了通胀预期影响家庭支出的渠道。大多数家庭并未调整其当前支出计划，这往往是因为他们认为通胀预期无关紧要或坚持固定预算。在确实进行调整的家庭中，多数减少了支出，主要归因于财富效应。少数家庭按照传统跨期替代渠道的指引增加了支出。我们还发现，财务状况、认知能力以及主观心智模型（如滞胀预期）有助于预测支出反应及家庭所引用的机制。我们的研究结果为关于将通胀预期作为政策工具的讨论提供了见解，并强调了需纳入理论模型的关键摩擦因素。
10.1093/jeea/jvag050.title: How Do Households Respond to Expected Inflation? An Investigation of Transmission Mechanisms,
10.1093/jeea/jvag050.title_zh: 家庭如何应对预期通胀？传导机制研究

10.1093/jeea/jvag051.abstract: Trade networks underpinning the energy transition are endogenous economic objects, and their structure is a source of market power. Using bilateral trade data for thirteen electrification metals over 1995–2023, we show that trade in these materials has reorganised into a hub-and-spoke system centred on China, in sharp contrast to the more diffuse, multilateral structure of fossil fuels. This centrality did not follow from resource endowments: China holds few of the underlying reserves. It was built through processing investment, industrial policy, and commodity-targeted development finance, an equilibrium outcome rather than a geographical accident. We formalise this logic in a stylised model in which a country chooses how central to become, and show that centrality can map into pricing power: the response of the world price of critical minerals to a supply cut is stronger when the network is more concentrated, the downstream demand and the competitive fringe supply are more inelastic. Constructing text-based, commodity-specific supply shocks and estimating local projections, we find that supply contractions in critical metals raise consumer inflation in the European Union and the United States by roughly twice as much as comparable fossil-fuel shocks, and more persistently. Centrality is therefore not merely a descriptive feature of the new resource map: it can create leverage over global prices. The green transition reduces strategic dependence on hydrocarbon exporters but reconstitutes it around the architecture of mineral supply chains.
10.1093/jeea/jvag051.abstract_zh: 支撑能源转型的贸易网络是内生的经济对象，其结构构成市场势力的来源。利用1995年至2023年间十三种电气化金属的双边贸易数据，我们表明这些材料的贸易已重组为以中国为中心的轴辐体系，与化石燃料更为分散、多边的结构形成鲜明对比。这种中心地位并非源于资源禀赋：中国仅持有其中少部分的基础储量。它是通过加工投资、产业政策和针对特定大宗商品的发展融资构建而成，是均衡结果而非地理偶然。我们在一个简约模型中形式化了这一逻辑，在该模型中，一国选择其中心化程度，并表明中心地位可转化为定价权：当网络更为集中、下游需求及竞争性边缘供给更具刚性时，关键矿产的世界价格对供给削减的反应更为强烈。通过构建基于文本的、针对特定商品的供给冲击并估计局部投影，我们发现关键金属的供给收缩使欧盟和美国的消费者通胀上升幅度约为可比化石燃料冲击的两倍，且持续性更强。因此，中心地位不仅是新资源版图的描述性特征：它能够对全球价格产生杠杆作用。绿色转型减少了对碳氢化合物出口国的战略依赖，但围绕矿产供应链的架构重新构建了这种依赖。
10.1093/jeea/jvag051.title: Exorbitant Privilege of the Periodic Table? Geoeconomics, Endogenous Centrality and Strategic Minerals for the Green Transition,
10.1093/jeea/jvag051.title_zh: 周期表的特权？地缘经济学、内生中心性与绿色转型中的战略矿产

10.1093/jeea/jvag052.abstract: This paper investigates the adoption of short-time work by firms and their participating employees. We present a model showing that short-time work can preserve jobs in firms facing severe negative revenue shocks, but not in less affected firms, where hours are reduced without preventing layoffs. Using data from all French establishments during the 2008-2009 Great Recession, we find that short-time work helped save jobs and increased hours worked in firms hit by significant revenue losses, facilitating a faster post-recession recovery. We also identify substantial windfall effects, which raise the policy’s cost per job saved. Nonetheless, short-time work is likely more cost-effective at preserving employment than wage subsidies, potentially resulting in a net negative cost to public finances.
10.1093/jeea/jvag052.abstract_zh: 本文研究了企业及其参与员工采用短时工作制的情况。我们提出一个模型，表明短时工作制能在面临严重负面收入冲击的企业中保住工作岗位，但在受影响较小的企业中则不然，这些企业虽减少了工时却未能避免裁员。利用2008-2009年大衰退期间法国所有机构的数据，我们发现，短时工作制帮助遭受重大收入损失的企业保住了工作并增加了工作时间，促进了衰退后更快的复苏。我们还识别出显著的意外收益效应，这提高了该政策每保住一个工作岗位的成本。尽管如此，短时工作制在维持就业方面可能比工资补贴更具成本效益，并可能对公共财政产生净负成本。
10.1093/jeea/jvag052.title: The Heterogeneous Impact of Short-Time Work: From Saved Jobs to Windfall Effects,
10.1093/jeea/jvag052.title_zh: 短期工作的异质性影响：从保住就业到意外效应

10.1093/jeea/jvag053.abstract: Social norms and formal institutions governing marriage markets vary widely across societies. This paper examines how polygyny norms in Sub-Saharan Africa shape marriage market responses to aggregate economic shocks and their resulting welfare implications. Unlike monogamous markets, polygynous markets feature intense competition for brides between young bachelors and older married men seeking a second (junior) wife. I show, both theoretically and empirically, that the latter group is more responsive than the former to aggregate income shocks in areas where the shadow price of marrying a junior wife is low. This difference in sensitivity leads to distinct equilibrium outcomes: adverse shocks increase the incidence of child marriage in monogamous areas but have no detectable effect in polygynous areas. These divergent equilibrium outcomes generate stark differences in the long-term effects of such shocks on female education, literacy, and the utilization of preventive care services.
10.1093/jeea/jvag053.abstract_zh: 社会规范与正式制度在婚姻市场中的运作方式在不同社会中差异显著。本文探讨了撒哈拉以南非洲的一夫多妻制规范如何塑造婚姻市场对总体经济冲击的响应，及其由此产生的福利影响。与一夫一妻制市场不同，一夫多妻制市场中，年轻单身汉与寻求第二位（次级）妻子的年长已婚男性之间，对 bride 的竞争尤为激烈。我从理论和实证两方面证明，在娶次级妻子的影子价格较低的地区，后者群体对总体收入冲击的敏感度高于前者。这种敏感度差异导致均衡结果截然不同：不利冲击在一夫一妻制地区增加了童婚发生率，但在多妻制地区则无显著影响。这些分化的均衡结果进一步导致此类冲击对女性教育、识字率及预防性保健服务利用的长期效应产生显著差异。
10.1093/jeea/jvag053.title: Polygyny and the Economic Determinants of Family Formation in Sub-Saharan Africa,
10.1093/jeea/jvag053.title_zh: 一夫多妻制与撒哈拉以南非洲家庭形成的经济决定因素

10.1093/jeea/jvag054.abstract: We investigate the effects of trade secret (TS) protection on supplier exclusivity in vertical industrial relations. We show that manufacturers limit their suppliers’ buyer networks under weak TS protection to safeguard sensitive information while encouraging supplier investment. Using worldwide automotive parts contracts data, we find that weak TS protection constrains suppliers to serve only a few Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), sometimes leading to exclusivity, especially for parts with intermediate relationship-specificity. This association strengthens with greater OEM bargaining power, aligning with theoretical insights. We validate these findings by examining supplier attributes, including size, cartel involvement, and ownership structure. F23, O34, L14, L24, L62
10.1093/jeea/jvag054.abstract_zh: 我们研究了商业秘密（TS）保护对纵向产业关系中供应商排他性的影响。研究表明，在商业秘密保护较弱的情况下，制造商为保护敏感信息而限制供应商的客户网络，同时鼓励供应商进行投资。利用全球汽车零部件合同数据，我们发现，薄弱的商业秘密保护约束了供应商仅服务于少数原始设备制造商（OEMs），有时甚至导致排他性，尤其对于关系特定性中等的零部件而言。这一关联随着OEM议价能力的增强而加强，与理论见解相符。我们通过考察供应商特征（包括规模、卡特尔参与情况及所有权结构）验证了这些发现。F23, O34, L14, L24, L62
10.1093/jeea/jvag054.title: Exclusive Secrets,

10.1093/jeea/jvag055.abstract: As America faces an obesity epidemic and its economic consequences, the factors driving weight variation across the U.S. population remain unclear, especially since these differences extend well beyond commonly studied channels like income or education. We leverage a unique thirty-year panel of U.S. registered nurses to examine the changes in body mass index (BMI) with age, the impact of lifestyle choices on body weight in adulthood, and the role of inherited metabolic traits and childhood preference formation. Our empirical findings reveal that among individuals who enter adulthood with a healthy body mass, those in the top diet quality or exercise deciles at age thirty are roughly 50% more likely to maintain a healthy BMI and avoid morbidities three decades later, compared to those in the bottom deciles. To better understand the drivers of weight gain, we propose a novel structural framework of endogenous BMI evolution where initial heterogeneity is amplified by behaviors to explain much of the observed divergence in weight. Counterfactual experiments using the model indicate that initial conditions, such as fixed metabolic types, account for at least one-third of the variance in weight at older ages. While course correction through behaviors can only partially compensate for poor initial conditions at the onset of adulthood, we find that promoting healthy behaviors in adults can reduce total health care expenses by at least 8% annually.
10.1093/jeea/jvag055.abstract_zh: 面对美国日益严峻的肥胖问题及其经济后果，驱动美国人口体重差异的因素仍不明确，尤其是因为这些差异远超收入或教育等常见研究渠道。我们利用一项独特的美国注册护士三十年面板数据，考察了体重指数（BMI）随年龄的变化、成年期生活方式选择对体重的影响，以及遗传代谢特征和童年偏好形成的作用。实证研究发现，在成年初期拥有健康体重的人群中，三十岁时饮食质量或锻炼处于最高十分位者，在三十年后维持健康BMI并避免并发症的可能性比最低十分位者高出约50%。为更深入理解体重增加的驱动因素，我们提出了一种新的内生BMI演化结构框架，其中初始异质性通过行为被放大，以解释观察到的体重差异的大部分。利用模型进行的反事实实验表明，初始条件（如固定的代谢类型）至少解释了老年期体重差异的三分之一。尽管通过行为进行纠偏只能部分弥补成年初期不利初始条件的影响，但我们发现，促进成年人健康行为可使年度总医疗支出至少减少8%。
10.1093/jeea/jvag055.title: Exercise or Extra Fries? Behavioral Drivers of Obesity Over the Life Cycle,
10.1093/jeea/jvag055.title_zh: 锻炼还是额外薯条？生命周期中肥胖的行为驱动因素

10.1093/jeea/jvag056.abstract: The Renaissance era in Western Europe was marked by a flourishing of economic and cultural life that gave rise to numerous discoveries and inventions. This paper studies the role played by Greek knowledge in this process. Using a newly constructed dataset on Greek migrants in Europe after the fall of Constantinople in 1453, I show that a Greek presence in the second half of the fifteenth century increased city growth in the sixteenth century. In terms of mechanisms, I find that a Greek presence increased the available knowledge stock in astronomy, mathematics, medicine, and humanistic subjects – fields in which ancient Greek and Byzantine knowledge was especially advanced. Finally, I document an increase in upper-tail human capital and inventions in these cities. My findings thus show the important role played by Greek migrants in disseminating knowledge and the positive impact that Greek knowledge exerted on city growth in the early modern period.
10.1093/jeea/jvag056.abstract_zh: 西欧文艺复兴时期，经济与文化生活的繁荣催生了众多发现与发明。本文旨在探讨希腊知识在这一进程中所扮演的角色。通过利用新构建的关于1453年君士坦丁堡陷落后欧洲希腊移民的数据集，我揭示了十五世纪下半叶希腊人的存在对十六世纪城市增长的促进作用。在机制分析上，我发现希腊人的存在增加了天文学、数学、医学及人文学科等领域的可用知识存量——这些领域正是古希腊及拜占庭知识尤为先进的领域。最后，我记录了这些城市中高端人力资本与发明的增长。因此，我的研究凸显了希腊移民在知识传播中的重要作用，以及希腊知识对近代早期城市增长的积极影响。
10.1093/jeea/jvag056.title: The Fall of Constantinople and the Rise of the West,
10.1093/jeea/jvag056.title_zh: 君士坦丁堡的陷落与西方的崛起

10.1093/jeea/jvag057.title: Employment and Community: Socioeconomic Cooperation and Its Breakdown
10.1093/jeea/jvag057.title_zh: 就业与社区：社会经济合作及其瓦解

10.1093/jleo/ewag015.abstract: We provide quasi-experimental evidence of the effects of municipal budget rules on the level of local economic activity exploiting the fact that, in 1999, the Italian government imposed a balanced-budget fiscal rule on all municipal governments but in 2001 exempted municipalities below 5,000 inhabitants. Municipalities which remained subject to budget rules increased taxes but also experienced a significant increase in the number of firms and workers. The increase in taxes was largely financed through issuing more building permits, which led to higher urban revenues. To support the claim that building permits is a plausible mechanism which attracts more firms, in the face of higher taxes, we show that the positive impact of budget rules on employment growth and firms’ entry is concentrated in municipalities with no physical constraints to urban planning and development. (JEL D73, H72, R52, R31, R33)
10.1093/jleo/ewag015.abstract_zh: 我们利用1999年意大利政府对所有市级政府实施平衡预算财政规则、但2001年豁免5000人以下市镇的准自然实验，提供了市政预算规则对地方经济活动水平影响的准实验证据。受预算规则约束的市镇在增加税收的同时，企业数量和工人数量也显著增长。税收增长主要通过发放更多建筑许可证来弥补，这带来了更高的城市财政收入。为论证建筑许可是在税收增加背景下吸引更多企业的合理机制，我们证明预算规则对就业增长和企业进入的积极影响，集中体现在城市规划与发展不受物理条件限制的市镇。（JEL分类号：D73, H72, R52, R31, R33）
10.1093/jleo/ewag015.title: The effects of fiscal rules on building permits and economic activity: quasi-experimental evidence
10.1093/jleo/ewag015.title_zh: 财政规则对建筑许可和经济活动的影响：准实验证据

10.1093/jleo/ewag018.abstract: Some product harm is exogenously unknowable until after some consumers have suffered the harm. There is a legal debate over whether such unknowable harm to these early consumers should be given immunity. This article finds that when the seller bears strict liability with compensatory damage on the unknowable harm, the seller’s incentive is distorted. There is an incentive to secretly over-test the product, so the seller can drop or attempt to fix a harmful product to reduce the public’s detection. At the same time, there is also an incentive to under-test the product to avoid a negative test result being leaked out by a whistle-blower. To achieve the socially optimal outcome under strict liability, the damages on the unknowable harm must be punitive and tailored to the events. Granting immunity for unknowable harm can remove inefficiency without complicated damages. (JEL K13, D83).
10.1093/jleo/ewag018.abstract_zh: 部分产品危害在消费者遭受损害之前，从外部无法预知。关于此类早期消费者所遭受的不可知损害是否应给予豁免，存在法律争议。本文发现，当卖方对不可知损害承担严格责任并支付补偿性赔偿时，卖方的激励会被扭曲。卖方有动机秘密过度测试产品，以便放弃或尝试修复有害产品，从而减少公众的察觉。同时，也存在动机不足测试产品，以避免负面测试结果被举报者泄露。为实现严格责任下的社会最优结果，对不可知损害的赔偿必须具有惩罚性，并与具体事件相匹配。对不可知损害给予豁免，可以在无需复杂赔偿机制的情况下消除效率低下问题。（JEL K13, D83）
10.1093/jleo/ewag018.title: Information acquisition and liability for unknowable risk
10.1093/jleo/ewag018.title_zh: 信息获取与不可知风险的责任

10.1093/jleo/ewag019.abstract: Considerable evidence suggests that people are internally motivated to keep their promises. But it is unclear whether such internal motivations create a meaningful level of commitment in economically relevant situations where promisors have strong self-interested reasons to break their promises. Self-interested incentives to break promises compete with—and so may overcome—the moral motivations of those who are internally motivated to keep them. We experimentally investigate the willingness of third parties to altruistically punish promise breaking. Participants observe a transaction between a potential promisor and promisee and can incur personal costs to punish the promisor for uncooperative actions. Our results suggest that the same moral reasons that motivate promisors to keep their promises make third-party observers more likely to punish promise breaking. This suggests that the same underlying promissory norms drive both (i) promise-keeping behavior in the absence of second- and third-party enforcement mechanisms and (ii) non-legal enforcement mechanisms that arise when third parties can punish potential promisors in a decentralized fashion. This makes it more likely that promissory norms support cooperative behavior
10.1093/jleo/ewag019.abstract_zh: 大量证据表明，人们内心有遵守承诺的动机。但在承诺方有强烈自利动机违背承诺的经济相关情境中，这种内在动机能否形成有意义的承诺约束尚不明确。违背承诺的自利激励与内在道德动机相互竞争——甚至可能压倒后者。我们通过实验研究第三方利他性惩罚违背承诺行为的意愿。参与者观察潜在承诺方与受诺方之间的交易，并可通过承担个人成本来惩罚承诺方的不合作行为。研究结果表明，促使承诺方信守承诺的道德理由同样会使第三方观察者更倾向于惩罚违背承诺行为。这意味着相同的承诺规范同时驱动着：（i）在缺乏第二方与第三方执行机制时的信守承诺行为；（ii）当第三方能够以分散化方式惩罚潜在承诺方时产生的非法律执行机制。这使得承诺规范更有可能支持合作行为。
10.1093/jleo/ewag019.title: Norm-based enforcement of promises

10.1093/jleo/ewag022.abstract: Several studies have underscored the significance of familiarity and collegiality in shaping judicial behavior in US federal courts. However, the distinct features of the US judicial system limit the ability to formulate a general theory. This research draws on 84,335 appellate decisions from Taiwanese courts to examine the role of familiarity in a career judge system. In Taiwan, lower court judges are transitorily promoted to appellate courts for 3 years, after which they typically return to their district courts before some of them are permanently promoted. By comparing their reversal patterns during temporary and subsequent permanent promotions to those of permanent appellate judges, we find that transitorily promoted judges reverse less frequently, and judges generally favor district courts where they have previously served. Social identity is likely a key explanatory factor. The size, diversity, and random allocation of cases in our dataset strengthens the generality of judicial behavior theories.
10.1093/jleo/ewag022.abstract_zh: 多项研究强调了熟悉度与同僚关系在美国联邦法院司法行为中的重要性。然而，美国司法体系的独特性限制了构建普适性理论的能力。本研究基于台湾法院的84,335份上诉判决，探讨职业法官体系中熟悉度的作用。在台湾，地方法院法官会临时晋升至上诉法院任职三年，之后通常返回原审法院，其中部分法官最终获得永久晋升。通过比较这些法官在临时晋升与后续永久晋升期间与常任上诉法官的改判模式，我们发现：临时晋升法官的改判频率较低，且法官普遍倾向于偏袒其曾任职的地方法院。社会认同可能是关键解释因素。本数据集在规模、多样性及案件随机分配方面的优势，增强了司法行为理论的普适性。
10.1093/jleo/ewag022.title: How judges’ social identity impacts reversal decisions: evidence from the transitory promotion of judges
10.1093/jleo/ewag022.title_zh: 法官社会身份如何影响改判决定：来自法官临时晋升的证据

10.1093/jleo/ewag028.abstract: This study examines how changes in judicial discretion influence ideological decision-making in the federal courts. Leveraging a pair of unanimous Supreme Court decisions that expanded district judges’ discretion to award attorney’s fees in patent litigation, we investigate whether this procedural reform led to substantive shifts in outcomes. Our differences-in-differences design reveals that conservative judges became significantly more likely to award fees after 2014 while more liberal ones did not. We observe no similar pattern in copyright cases, which experienced no comparable expansion of discretion. This patent-specific effect is driven by accused infringers seeking fees after defeating patent claims, consistent with conservative preferences for deterring frivolous litigation. Even unanimous, procedurally focused appellate rulings can lead to asymmetric ideological effects. These findings have implications for understanding how changes in discretionary authority—including the Court’s recent abandonment of Chevron deference—may systematically empower certain ideological preferences in the federal judiciary.
10.1093/jleo/ewag028.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨司法裁量权的变化如何影响联邦法院的意识形态决策。借助两起一致通过的最高法院判决（这些判决扩大了地区法官在专利诉讼中裁定律师费的裁量权），我们考察了这一程序性改革是否导致了判决结果的实质性转变。采用双重差分法分析发现，2014年后保守派法官裁定律师费的可能性显著增加，而自由派法官则未呈现类似趋势。在版权案件中（其裁量权未经历同等扩张），我们未观察到相似模式。这种专利特有的效应主要由败诉方在专利主张被驳回后寻求律师费补偿所驱动，这与保守派偏好遏制滥诉行为的立场一致。即使是全体一致通过、聚焦程序问题的上诉裁决，也可能引发非对称的意识形态效应。这些发现对于理解裁量权变化——包括最高法院近期放弃雪佛龙尊重原则——如何系统性地强化联邦司法体系中特定意识形态偏好具有启示意义。
10.1093/jleo/ewag028.title: Ideology and the scope of judicial discretion: evidence from the federal district courts
10.1093/jleo/ewag028.title_zh: 意识形态与司法裁量范围：来自联邦地区法院的证据

10.1093/jleo/ewag029.abstract: Mandatory minimum (MM) sentencing is frequently identified as a driver of long sentences among federal drug offenders, but estimating its causal impact is complicated by prosecutorial discretion in charging. First, I show evidence of selective manipulation of MM eligibility, with prosecutors disproportionately choosing minority defendants for eligibility relative to comparable white defendants. This selection behavior creates bias in naive estimates of MM effects on sentence length. To recover the causal impact of MM eligibility, I use a regression discontinuity design with extrapolation that disentangles statutory effects from prosecutorial selection. I find that eligibility increases sentence length by approximately 10 months (14 percent) uniformly across case types, with no discernible heterogeneity across race. Together, these results indicate that racial disparities in MM sentencing arise primarily from prosecutorial charging decisions rather than from features of the statute itself.
10.1093/jleo/ewag029.abstract_zh: 强制性最低刑期（MM）量刑常被视为联邦毒品犯罪者长期监禁的一个驱动因素，但评估其因果影响因检察官在指控中的自由裁量权而变得复杂。首先，我展示了MM资格选择性操纵的证据，检察官相对于类似的白人被告，不成比例地选择少数族裔被告符合资格。这种选择行为在朴素估计MM对刑期长度的影响时造成了偏差。为恢复MM资格的因果效应，我采用带有外推的回归断点设计，以区分法定效应与检察官选择效应。我发现，资格使刑期平均增加约10个月（14%），且在不同案件类型中一致，种族间未观察到明显异质性。综合来看，这些结果表明，MM量刑中的种族差异主要源于检察官的指控决定，而非法规本身的特点。
10.1093/jleo/ewag029.title: How much do mandatory minimums matter?
10.1093/jleo/ewag029.title_zh: 强制性最低刑罚有多重要？

10.1093/jleo/ewag031.abstract: A prosecutor can offer leniency to an eyewitness in exchange for testimony. There is a concern that allowing the prosecutor to make the leniency contingent upon a successful conviction will produce more perjury and the court has thrown out some testimony obtained through such contingent agreements. This article uses a Bayesian jury model to examine the impact of allowing a conviction-motivated prosecutor to design a contingent scheme. It finds that the impact of allowing contingency on the Type 1 error of innocent conviction and the Type 2 error of wrongful acquittal depends on the precision of the additional evidence in the trial. In particular, when the additional evidence is very precise, allowing contingency may reduce both errors. Under a properly designed limit on the amount of leniency, allowing contingency can reduce both innocent conviction and wrongful acquittal.
10.1093/jleo/ewag031.abstract_zh: 检察官可以向目击证人提供宽大处理以换取证词。然而，允许检察官将宽大处理与成功定罪挂钩，可能引发更多伪证问题，法院已因此否决了部分通过此类附条件协议获取的证词。本文运用贝叶斯陪审团模型，探讨允许以定罪为动机的检察官设计附条件方案的影响。研究发现，允许附条件协议对无辜者定罪的第一类错误和错误无罪释放的第二类错误的影响，取决于审判中额外证据的精确度。特别是，当额外证据非常精确时，允许附条件协议可能同时减少这两类错误。在适当设计宽大处理限度的情况下，允许附条件协议能够同时降低无辜者定罪和错误无罪释放的发生率。
10.1093/jleo/ewag031.title: Contingent plea agreements for witness testimony
10.1093/jleo/ewag031.title_zh: 证人证言的附条件认罪协议

10.1093/oxfordhb/9780199215362.013.13.abstract: This article examines self-fulfilling prophecies and the conditions under which they are most likely to arise. The term ‘self-fulfilling prophecy’ (SFP) was coined in 1948 by Robert K. Merton to describe ‘a false definition of the situation evoking a new behavior which makes the originally false conception come true’. SFP is a particular type of dynamic process and is also known as ‘Oedipus effect’, ‘bootstrapped induction’ and ‘Barnesian performativity’. It has been discerned in a variety of processes; for example, between social theory and social reality. This article begins by proposing an explicit definition of SFP, followed by the argument that analytical sociology must be both empirical and theoretical. A summary of methods for investigating SFP is followed by a review of systematic empirical evidence for selected phenomena. Finally, explanations are given for why self-fulfilling prophecies occur: why false or arbitrary beliefs are formed and why they are subsequently fulfilled.
10.1093/oxfordhb/9780199215362.013.13.abstract_zh: 本文探讨自我实现预言及其最易产生的条件。“自我实现预言”（SFP）一词由罗伯特·K·默顿于1948年提出，用以描述“对情境的错误定义引发新行为，使原本虚假的观念变为现实”。SFP是一种特殊的动态过程，也被称为“俄狄浦斯效应”“自举归纳”和“巴恩斯式述行性”。它在多种过程中均有体现，例如社会理论与社会现实之间的互动。本文首先提出SFP的明确定义，继而论证分析社会学必须兼具经验性与理论性。在总结研究SFP的方法后，本文回顾了针对特定现象的系统性经验证据。最后，阐释自我实现预言为何发生：虚假或任意信念如何形成，以及这些信念为何最终得以实现。

10.1093/oxfordhb/9780199238828.013.0009.abstract: Infectious diseases remain a central preoccupation in many countries. This article sets out the economic issues that arise in this highly complex domain. It reviews four main strands of literature on the economics of infectious diseases. It discusses the economic impact of infectious diseases on labor productivity and investment decisions. It focuses on the interplay between disease prevention and treatment and individual risk-taking behavior. It discusses vaccination as an important tool in the prevention of infectious diseases and presents a classic public goods problem. Disease reporting and eradication efforts are also global public goods. A fourth strand of literature is on the optimal design and allocation of resources for prevention and treatment programs. These programs are based on epidemiological models of disease spread that present significant mathematical challenges.
10.1093/oxfordhb/9780199238828.013.0009.abstract_zh: 传染病仍是许多国家的核心关切。本文梳理了这一高度复杂领域中的经济问题，综述了关于传染病经济学的四类主要文献。首先探讨传染病对劳动生产率和投资决策的经济影响，其次聚焦疾病预防与治疗同个体风险行为之间的相互作用。文章将疫苗接种作为预防传染病的重要工具进行讨论，并揭示了经典的公共品问题。疾病报告与根除行动同样属于全球公共品。第四类文献关注预防与治疗项目的最优设计与资源配置，这些项目基于疾病传播的流行病学模型，在数学层面存在显著挑战。

10.1093/oxfordjournals.oep.a041808.abstract: this paper employs a microeconomic cross-section, a sub-sample of some 2,400 adult males drawn from the New Survey of London Life and Labour, conducted between 1928 and 1931. I use this data to analyse the relationship between unemployment benefits and unemployment status. I find a generally positive association between the incidence of unemployment and the estimated benefit/wage ratio, but this relationship is significant only in the case of secondary workers. Survey data suggest that insurance benefits made only a small contribution to interwar unemployment.
10.1093/oxfordjournals.oep.a041808.abstract_zh: 本文采用微观经济截面数据，样本选自1928年至1931年间开展的《伦敦生活与劳动新调查》中约2400名成年男性子样本。利用该数据，我分析了失业救济金与失业状态之间的关系。研究发现，失业发生率与估算的救济金/工资比率总体呈正相关，但这种关系仅在次要劳动力群体中具有统计显著性。调查数据表明，保险救济金对两次世界大战期间的失业问题仅起到微小作用。

10.1093/qje/qjaf043.abstract: Has the dominance of the dollar in global trade rendered monetary policy ineffective? An emerging view contends that if a country invoices its exports in dollars, exchange rates cannot stabilize economic activity, as the classical expenditure-switching channel is muted. This view rests on the premise that export prices are sticky in dollars, breaking the link between export demand and depreciations. But this assumption is not borne out by the data: goods priced in dollars tend to have more flexible prices, along with higher elasticities of substitution. We propose a model with more realistic assumptions and show that even with dollar pricing, depreciating the currency by loosening monetary policy can still boost exports and activity materially. The limit to any expansion is not demand, but supply capacity. We also show that low exchange rate pass-through to dollar prices is not informative about price stickiness. The price response to exchange rates is small when demand elasticities are high, even with flexible prices: low pass-through is an equilibrium result, not evidence of a nominal friction.
10.1093/qje/qjaf043.abstract_zh: 美元在全球贸易中的主导地位是否已使货币政策失效？一种新兴观点认为，若一国以美元计价其出口，汇率便无法稳定经济活动，因为传统的支出转换渠道被削弱。这一观点基于出口价格以美元粘性设定的前提，从而切断了出口需求与货币贬值之间的联系。然而，这一假设并未得到数据支持：以美元计价的商品往往具有更灵活的价格，同时伴随更高的替代弹性。我们提出了一个基于更现实假设的模型，并表明即使采用美元定价，通过放松货币政策使货币贬值仍能显著促进出口和经济增长。扩张的任何限制并非来自需求，而是供给能力。我们还证明，汇率对美元价格的低传导率并不能反映价格粘性。当需求弹性较高时，即使价格灵活，价格对汇率的反应也较小：低传导率是均衡结果，而非名义摩擦的证据。
10.1093/qje/qjaf043.title: Dollar Dominance and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
10.1093/qje/qjaf043.title_zh: 美元主导地位与货币政策的传导

10.1093/qje/qjag023.abstract: We present a theory of choice in which attention to the features of options is determined by the decision maker’s categorization of the current problem in a set of problems she solved in the past. Categorization depends on goal-relevant and contextual problem-level features. The model yields heterogeneity in attention and choice in a given problem based on different past experiences and instability when changes in irrelevant context cause re-categorization. We show that heterogeneous and unstable representations of a choice problem unify major biases in judgment and decision making.
10.1093/qje/qjag023.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种选择理论，其中决策者对选项特征的关注取决于其将当前问题归类于过去解决过的一组问题中的方式。分类过程依赖于与目标相关的问题层面特征及情境特征。该模型表明，在给定问题中，基于不同的过往经历会产生注意力与选择的异质性；而当无关情境的变化引发重新分类时，则会导致不稳定性。我们证明，选择问题表征的异质性与不稳定性统一了判断与决策中的主要偏差。
10.1093/qje/qjag023.title: A Cognitive Theory of Reasoning and Choice
10.1093/qje/qjag023.title_zh: 推理与选择的认知理论

10.1093/qje/qjag024.abstract: This article examines how the American Medical Association (AMA) helped shape the development of the U.S. health insurance system in the critical period after World War II. Working with the political public relations firm Campaigns, Inc., the AMA launched a nationwide campaign to weaken support for national health insurance by framing it as “socialized medicine,” while simultaneously enrolling people in private health insurance plans to shift demand away from a public alternative. Drawing on newly assembled archival data, we find that greater exposure to the campaign explains about 20% of the rise in private health insurance enrollment and a comparable decline in public support for a national program. The campaign also appears to have influenced policy making through coordinated messaging, resolutions passed by civic organizations, congressional rhetoric, and political donations. These findings suggest that the rise of private health insurance in the United States was not solely due to macroeconomic forces or collective bargaining; rather, it was also enabled by a strategic, interest group–financed effort to shape citizen views and influence policy.
10.1093/qje/qjag024.abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国医学会（AMA）在二战后关键时期如何影响美国医疗保险体系的发展。通过与政治公关公司Campaigns, Inc.合作，AMA发起了一场全国性运动，将国家医疗保险框架定义为“社会化医疗”以削弱其支持度，同时引导民众加入私人医疗保险计划，从而将需求从公共替代方案转移。基于新整理的档案数据，我们发现，该运动对私人医疗保险参保率上升的贡献约为20%，并对国家医保计划公众支持率的下降产生了同等程度的影响。该运动还通过协调信息传递、民间组织通过的决议、国会言论以及政治捐款，对政策制定产生了影响。这些发现表明，美国私人医疗保险的兴起并非仅由宏观经济力量或集体谈判驱动，而是由利益集团资助的战略性努力所推动，旨在塑造公民观点并影响政策。
10.1093/qje/qjag024.title: Why Doesn’t the United States Have National Health Insurance? The Political Role of the American Medical Association
10.1093/qje/qjag024.title_zh: 美国为何没有全民医保？美国医学会的政治角色

10.1093/qje/qjag025.abstract: This article investigates how a government should manage international reserves when it faces the risk of a rollover crisis. We ask: Should the government accumulate reserves or reduce debt to make itself less vulnerable? We show that the optimal policy entails initially reducing debt, followed by a subsequent increase in both debt and reserves as the government approaches a safe zone. Furthermore, we find that issuing additional debt to accumulate reserves can lead to a reduction in sovereign spreads. Evidence from a panel of emerging economies is consistent with these predictions: increases in reserves financed by public external borrowing are associated with lower spreads, and reserve holdings are not systematically drawn down during crisis episodes.
10.1093/qje/qjag025.abstract_zh: 本文研究政府面临展期危机风险时应如何管理国际储备。我们提出的问题是：政府应通过积累储备还是减少债务来降低自身脆弱性？研究表明，最优政策路径是先减少债务，随后在政府接近安全区域时同步增加债务与储备。此外，我们发现通过增发债务来积累储备可降低主权利差。来自新兴经济体的面板数据与这些预测一致：由公共外部借款融资的储备增加与利差下降相关，且危机期间储备持有量并未系统性减少。
10.1093/qje/qjag025.title: International Reserve Management Under Rollover Crises
10.1093/qje/qjag025.title_zh: 滚动危机下的国际储备管理

10.1093/qje/qjag026.abstract: We study rainmaking as an instrumental religious belief. We present a model in which a religious leader tries to persuade people to believe. Praying for rain can persuade only where the hazard of rainfall during a dry spell is increasing over time, so that prayer is most likely to succeed when people most want rain. We present evidence from prayers for rain in Murcia, Spain, where the hazard rate is increasing, that the church’s prayers for rain predict rainfall over two centuries. To generalize this finding, we gather an original data set of whether ethnic groups around the world traditionally prayed for rain. We find that ethnic groups facing an increasing rainfall hazard are 47% more likely to pray for rain, consistent with our model’s prediction that societies are more likely to pray for rain where prayer is persuasive.
10.1093/qje/qjag026.abstract_zh: 我们研究求雨作为一种工具性宗教信仰。我们构建了一个模型，其中宗教领袖试图说服人们相信求雨的有效性。只有当干旱期内降雨风险随时间递增时，求雨祈祷才具有说服力——这意味着祈祷最可能在人们最渴望降雨时成功。我们以西班牙穆尔西亚地区的求雨祈祷为证据，该地区降雨风险率呈递增趋势，发现教堂的求雨祈祷在两个世纪中持续预测了实际降雨。为推广这一发现，我们收集了全球各民族是否传统上举行求雨祈祷的原始数据集。研究发现，面临递增降雨风险的民族举行求雨祈祷的可能性高出47%，这与模型预测一致：在祈祷更具说服力的社会中，人们更可能进行求雨祈祷。
10.1093/qje/qjag026.title: Praying for Rain

10.1093/qje/qjag027.abstract: How does proximity to coworkers affect training and productivity? We study software engineers at a Fortune 500 firm from 2019 to 2024, leveraging two shocks to proximity: (i) the office closures in 2020 and (ii) the subsequent return-to-office mandates in 2022 and 2023. In both cases, co-located teams experienced bigger changes in proximity than distributed ones, facilitating difference-in-differences designs. We find that sitting near teammates increases coding feedback by 18.3% and improves code quality. Gains are concentrated among less-tenured and younger employees, who are building human capital. However, there is a tradeoff: experienced engineers write less code when sitting near teammates. In national US data, we find evidence that the rise of remote work has had scarring effects on young college graduates. In remotable jobs, young graduates’ unemployment rate increased relative to older graduates’ post-pandemic (2022−2024) compared to pre-pandemic (2017−2019), a pattern we do not observe in non-remotable jobs.
10.1093/qje/qjag027.abstract_zh: 与同事的邻近性如何影响培训与生产力？我们以2019至2024年间某《财富》500强企业的软件工程师为研究对象，利用两次邻近性冲击：（i）2020年办公室关闭，以及（ii）随后2022至2023年重返办公室的强制要求。在这两种情形下，同地办公团队比分布式团队经历了更大的邻近性变化，这为双重差分设计提供了便利。研究发现，与队友相邻而坐可使编码反馈增加18.3%，并提升代码质量。这些收益主要集中于资历较浅和较年轻的员工，他们正处于人力资本积累阶段。然而，存在一个权衡：经验丰富的工程师在邻近队友就座时编写的代码量会减少。在全美数据中，我们发现远程办公的兴起对年轻大学毕业生产生了持续影响。在可远程办公的岗位中，年轻毕业生在疫情后时期（2022-2024年）的失业率相较于疫情前（2017-2019年）高于年长毕业生，而这一模式在不可远程办公的岗位中并未出现。
10.1093/qje/qjag027.title: The Power of Proximity to Coworkers

10.1093/qje/qjag028.abstract: Theory predicts that outsourcing public services to the private sector can reduce costs and improve efficiency, but can also induce cost-cutting and compromise quality. We assess the Brazilian “Organizações Sociais de Saude” model (OSS), which outsources management of public hospital services to the private sector while the state remains the residual claimant. We show that this enhances hospital production and operational efficiency without adverse effects on hospital quality and equity. Increased inpatient production addresses previously unmet demand, expanding local access to hospital care and reducing population mortality. Performance gains arise from improved operational efficiency achieved through increased hospital management capacity. This facilitates staffing adjustments, favoring higher-skilled personnel, dismissing lower-productivity staff, and adopting flexible, performance-tied employment contracts. Effects are larger among private organizations with more management experience, underscoring returns to managerial capacity. Our findings show that incentive-ownership structures can address the quantity-quality trade-off in public service delivery, even when contracts are incomplete and quality is hard to measure.
10.1093/qje/qjag028.abstract_zh: 理论预测，将公共服务外包给私营部门可降低成本并提高效率，但也可能引发成本削减并损害服务质量。我们评估了巴西的"健康社会组织"（OSS）模式——该模式将公立医院管理服务外包给私营部门，而国家仍保留剩余索取权。研究表明，该模式提升了医院产出与运营效率，且未对医院质量与公平性产生负面影响。住院服务量的增加满足了此前未被满足的需求，扩大了当地医院服务的可及性，并降低了人口死亡率。绩效提升源于医院管理能力增强带来的运营效率改善，这促进了人员结构调整——优先雇佣高技能人员、解雇低生产率员工，并采用灵活且与绩效挂钩的雇佣合同。在管理经验更丰富的私营组织中，效果更为显著，凸显了管理能力的回报。我们的发现表明，即使合同不完善且质量难以衡量，激励性所有权结构仍能解决公共服务供给中的数量-质量权衡问题。
10.1093/qje/qjag028.title: Public Services Under Private Management
10.1093/qje/qjag028.title_zh: 私营管理下的公共服务

10.1093/qje/qjag029.abstract: Stock markets play a dual role: they provide information about firms’ fundamentals, which improves resource allocations, and they provide liquidity. We propose a setting in which these two roles interact: if stocks are used more intensively for liquidity, then prices reveal less information about fundamentals. We structurally estimate stock price informativeness for several countries and show that it declines when alternative liquidity sources, such as banks, are in distress. To study the real effects of this mechanism, we devise a strategy to integrate our stock-trading module into a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms. We calibrate the model to the US and simulate recessions with and without banking distress. In a stand-alone recession, prices become more informative, and allocation improves, mitigating output losses by 4.4%. If the recession coincides with banking distress, agents rely more on stock markets to obtain liquidity, prices become less informative, and allocation deteriorates, magnifying output losses by 22%.
10.1093/qje/qjag029.abstract_zh: 股票市场具有双重作用：一方面提供企业基本面信息以优化资源配置，另一方面提供流动性。我们构建了一个两种作用相互影响的框架：若股票被更密集地用于获取流动性，则价格所反映的基本面信息将减少。我们通过结构估计测度了多国股票价格的信息含量，发现当银行等替代性流动性来源陷入困境时，股价信息含量会下降。为研究该机制的实际经济效应，我们设计策略将股票交易模块嵌入包含异质性企业的动态一般均衡模型。基于美国数据校准模型后，我们模拟了有无银行业困境伴随的经济衰退情景。在独立衰退中，价格信息含量提升，资源配置改善，使产出损失降低4.4%；若衰退伴随银行业困境，经济主体将更依赖股票市场获取流动性，导致价格信息含量下降与资源配置恶化，使产出损失扩大22%。
10.1093/qje/qjag029.title: Business, Liquidity, and Information Cycles
10.1093/qje/qjag029.title_zh: 商业、流动性与信息周期

10.1093/qje/qjag030.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper uses labor force surveys from 160 countries to build a new microdatabase on hours worked covering 97% of the world population in cross section. We also construct time series spanning over 20 years in 86 countries. Hours worked per adult slightly decline with GDP per capita but are weakly correlated with development overall. Hours worked by the young (aged 15-19) and elderly (aged 60+) fall with development, driven entirely by growing school attendance and public pension coverage. Hours worked among prime-age adults (aged 20-59) are stable with development but undergo a great gender reshuffling: falling male hours per worker have been exactly offset by increases in female labor force participation in many countries. Labor income taxes are strongly negatively related to hours worked across countries. This correlation is attenuated when controlling for social spending and disappears when further controlling for working hours regulations. Both social spending and working hours regulations are associated with lower hours worked.</jats:p>
10.1093/qje/qjag030.abstract_zh: 本文利用来自160个国家的劳动力调查，构建了一个覆盖全球97%人口横截面数据的新工作时长微观数据库。我们还构建了86个国家超过20年的时间序列数据。成年人平均工作时长随人均GDP略有下降，但与整体发展水平的关联较弱。青年（15-19岁）和老年（60岁以上）人群的工作时长随发展水平下降，这完全由入学率和公共养老金覆盖率的提高所驱动。壮年（20-59岁）人群的工作时长随发展水平保持稳定，但经历了显著的性别重组：在许多国家，男性人均工作时长的下降恰好被女性劳动参与率的上升所抵消。跨国数据显示，劳动所得税与工作时长呈显著负相关。在控制社会支出后，这种相关性减弱；进一步控制工作时长法规后，相关性消失。社会支出和工作时长法规均与较低的工作时长相关。
10.1093/qje/qjag030.title: Global Working Hours

10.1093/qje/qjag031.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We test for stereotyping—the exaggeration of representative traits—in a high-stakes economic environment. Using both surveys administered among undergraduates at the Ohio State University and large-scale nationally representative data, we measure how US freshmen perceive the relationship between college majors and occupations. We show that students greatly overestimate the likelihood that majors lead to their representative jobs (e.g., counselor for psychology, journalist for journalism). Using an implicit association test, we show that students associate majors with their representative careers and that these associations strongly predict belief biases, in line with a stereotyping mechanism. A simple equilibrium model of the labor market predicts that stereotyping reduces welfare by increasing misallocation, which correlational evidence on job/major mismatch corroborates. In a field experiment, we test a light-touch policy to reduce stereotyping and find significant effects on students’ intentions about what to study as well as the classes and majors they enroll in.</jats:p>
10.1093/qje/qjag031.abstract_zh: 摘要：我们检验了高风险经济环境中的刻板印象——即对代表性特征的夸大。通过俄亥俄州立大学本科生调查和大规模全国代表性数据，我们衡量了美国新生对大学专业与职业之间关系的认知。结果显示，学生严重高估了专业导向其代表性职业的可能性（例如心理学专业对应咨询师、新闻学专业对应记者）。通过内隐联想测试，我们发现学生将专业与其代表性职业相关联，且这些关联强烈预测了信念偏差，这与刻板印象机制一致。一个简单的劳动力市场均衡模型预测，刻板印象通过加剧资源错配降低社会福利，而关于职业/专业错配的相关证据支持了这一结论。在一项实地实验中，我们测试了一种轻触式政策以减少刻板印象，发现该政策对学生关于学习意向、所选课程及专业产生了显著影响。
10.1093/qje/qjag031.title: What Jobs Come to Mind? Stereotypes About Fields of Study
10.1093/qje/qjag031.title_zh: 想到什么工作？关于学科领域的刻板印象

10.1093/qje/qjag032.abstract: We study how people’s beliefs about the economy covary with household-level events, utilizing a unique link between Danish administrative data and a large-scale survey of consumer expectations. We find that compared to actual inflation, people’s inflation forecasts covary much more strongly (and negatively) with both recently realized household income changes and measures of expected future household income changes. We formally establish that these findings are stark deviations from the Bayesian rational expectations benchmark. Similar results hold for perceptions of past inflation (“backcasts” ), suggesting that imperfect recall is a key mechanism for biased forecasts. Building on this, a series of additional tests, some of which utilize data on adverse health events, suggests that the forecast biases are at least partly due to affect-cued recall. That is, negative (positive) household-level events cue negative (positive) recollections, which lead to pessimistic (optimistic) forecasts.
10.1093/qje/qjag032.abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦行政数据与大规模消费者预期调查之间的独特关联，研究了人们对经济的信念如何随家庭层面事件而变化。研究发现，相较于实际通胀率，人们的通胀预测与近期已实现的家庭收入变化以及预期的未来家庭收入变化指标之间存在显著更强的负向协动关系。我们正式证明，这些发现与贝叶斯理性预期基准存在显著偏离。类似结果也适用于对过去通胀的感知（"回溯预测"），表明不完美回忆是导致预测偏差的关键机制。在此基础上，一系列附加检验（部分利用不良健康事件数据）表明，预测偏差至少部分源于情感线索回忆——即负面（正面）家庭层面事件会触发负面（正面）回忆，进而导致悲观（乐观）预测。
10.1093/qje/qjag032.title: Beliefs About the Economy are Excessively Sensitive to Household-Level Shocks: Evidence from Linked Survey and Administrative Data
10.1093/qje/qjag032.title_zh: 家庭层面冲击对经济信念的过度敏感：基于关联调查与行政数据的证据

10.1093/qje/qjag033.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We explore the mechanics of empathy. We show that information about an outgroup can activate and magnify empathy when presented in conjunction with an experience simulating their struggles. This response increases the willingness to help the struggling group. We provide evidence for this effect in an immersive virtual reality experiment where participants (“witnesses”) experience a simulation of the struggle of unauthorized migrants (“protagonists”), then replicate these results in a series of controlled lab experiments. We show that information enhances the witnesses’ empathetic response and drives them to engage in more prosocial behavior when it increases their perceived interpersonal similarity, or relatability to the protagonist — an effect we trace to attention: eye-tracking data reveals that information provision concentrates witnesses’ gaze on the struggles of the protagonist instead of searching through peripheral elements of the scene. Conversely, only information packages that strengthen perceived relatability — an effect that can vary across subgroups with heterogeneous attributes — magnify empathy. Together, our evidence suggests that the ability to put oneself in the shoes of another person or group can be enhanced by activating empathy through simple, targeted, information provision.</jats:p>
10.1093/qje/qjag033.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了共情的运作机制。研究表明，当关于外群体的信息与模拟其困境的体验相结合时，能够激活并放大共情。这种反应会提升帮助困境群体的意愿。我们通过一项沉浸式虚拟现实实验为这一效应提供了证据——参与者（“见证者”）体验了未经授权移民（“主角”）困境的模拟场景，随后在一系列受控实验室实验中复现了这些结果。我们发现，当信息增强了见证者感知到的人际相似性或与主角的关联性时，信息会强化见证者的共情反应，并促使他们采取更多亲社会行为——我们将这一效应归因于注意力：眼动追踪数据显示，信息提供将见证者的目光集中在主角的困境上，而非搜索场景中的外围元素。相反，只有那些能够增强感知关联性的信息包——这一效应可能因具有异质性特征的子群体而异——才会放大共情。综合来看，我们的证据表明，通过简单、有针对性的信息提供激活共情，可以增强个体设身处地理解他人或群体的能力。
10.1093/qje/qjag033.title: In their Shoes: Empathy Through Information
10.1093/qje/qjag033.title_zh: 感同身受：信息中的共情

10.1093/qje/qjag034.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>If unions raise worker wages, who pays? We provide a comprehensive assessment of firm responses to increased unionization, using changes in the tax deductibility of union dues in Norway as a quasi-exogenous source of variation in firm-level union density. In the average private sector firm, higher union density raises labor costs and leads firms to contract employment and production, lowering profits without increasing the labor share. The incidence is shared: consumers bear part of the cost through higher prices, shareholders through lower profits, and the remainder is offset by productivity improvements. The total wage bill falls, with losses concentrated among less-attached “outsider” workers. Firm responses vary systematically by the degree of market competition. In manufacturing, where firms operate in less competitive product and labor markets, the response is reversed: the average firm expands employment and production, reduces labor markdowns, and does not experience profit declines. Instead, higher labor costs are largely passed on to consumers through higher prices, with the remainder offset by productivity gains. Workers benefit as both wages and employment rise. These patterns suggest that unions can offset employer monopsony power and that firm responses–and therefore who ultimately bears the cost-depend importantly on market structure. Overall, unionization in this setting primarily redistributes from consumers rather than shareholders and has effects that differ sharply across firms, including a reallocation toward larger and more productive firms. We rationalize these patterns using a partial-equilibrium model of union bargaining with product- and labor-market power.</jats:p>
10.1093/qje/qjag034.abstract_zh: 如果工会提高工人工资，谁来买单？我们利用挪威工会会费税收抵扣政策的变化作为企业层面工会密度的准外生变动来源，对企业应对工会化程度提高的反应进行了全面评估。在一般私营企业中，工会密度上升会提高劳动力成本，导致企业收缩就业和生产规模，在降低利润的同时并未提高劳动份额。成本负担由多方分摊：消费者通过更高价格承担部分成本，股东通过更低利润承担部分，其余部分则被生产率提升所抵消。总工资支出下降，损失主要集中在关联度较低的“外部”工人群体。企业反应因市场竞争程度不同而呈现系统性差异。在制造业中，由于企业面临竞争程度较低的产品和劳动力市场，其反应截然相反：一般企业会扩大就业和生产规模，降低劳动力市场垄断压价能力，且利润并未下降。相反，更高的劳动力成本主要通过提高价格转嫁给消费者，其余部分被生产率提升所抵消。工人因工资和就业同时上升而获益。这些模式表明，工会能够抵消雇主的买方垄断势力，而企业反应——进而最终由谁承担成本——关键取决于市场结构。总体而言，在此背景下工会化主要实现从消费者而非股东的收入再分配，且对不同企业的影响差异显著，包括资源向规模更大、生产率更高的企业重新配置。我们通过一个包含产品市场与劳动力市场势力的工会谈判局部均衡模型对这些模式进行了合理化解释。
10.1093/qje/qjag034.title: Who Pays for Unions?

10.1093/qje/qjag037.abstract: Information often spreads and influences beliefs regardless of its reliability. We show that this occurs in part because indicators of reliability tend to be lost in the process of word-of-mouth transmission. We conduct controlled experiments where participants listen to economic forecasts and pass them on through voice messages. Other participants listen either to original or transmitted audio recordings and report incentivized beliefs. Across various transmitter incentive schemes, a claim’s reliability is lost in transmission much more than the claim itself. Reliable and unreliable information, once filtered through transmission, impact listener beliefs similarly. Mechanism experiments show that reliability is lost not because it is perceived as less relevant or harder to transmit, but because it is less likely to come to mind during transmission. Evidence from our experiments, a large corpus of everyday conversations, and economic TV news shows that contextual cues can bring reliability to mind and induce its transmission, but situations in which people share information seldom contain such cues.
10.1093/qje/qjag037.abstract_zh: 信息往往在传播过程中影响人们的信念，无论其可靠性如何。我们证明，这种现象部分源于口碑传播过程中可靠性指标容易丢失。我们开展控制实验，让参与者听取经济预测并通过语音信息传递。其他参与者听取原始或转述的录音，并报告受激励的信念。在不同传递者激励方案下，信息的可靠性在传播中的损失程度远高于信息本身。可靠与不可靠的信息经过传播过滤后，对听众信念的影响趋于一致。机制实验表明，可靠性丢失并非因其被认为相关性较低或更难传递，而是因为在传播过程中更不易被想起。来自我们的实验、大规模日常对话语料库以及经济类电视新闻的证据显示，情境线索能够唤起对可靠性的关注并促使其传播，但人们分享信息的情境中很少包含此类线索。
10.1093/qje/qjag037.title: The Transmission of Reliable and Unreliable Information
10.1093/qje/qjag037.title_zh: 可靠与不可靠信息的传播

10.1093/qje/qjag038.abstract: We study the history and geography of wealth accumulation in the United States using newly collected historical property tax records from the early 1800s onward. These records come from the administration of the General Property Tax–a tax that aspired to cover all types of property. We construct wealth series at the state, county, and national levels. At the state level, we use annual assessed values of wealth from state-level reports drawn from multiple sources. Because assessed values may differ from market values, we also require assessment ratios, defined as the ratio of assessed to market wealth. We obtain state-level assessment ratios from decadal U.S. Census wealth data (drawn from various Census reports, including those on “Wealth, Debt, and Taxation”), in which the Census carried out detailed valuation work, complemented with information on changes in assessment practices from the state reports, to build higher-frequency series of assessment ratios. The result is long-run annual wealth series for states from 1850 (or earlier, depending on the state) to 1935. We obtain national wealth series by aggregating these state series. At the county level, we use assessed values (or market values where available) from the U.S. Census wealth data for each decade, and apply either state-level or county-level assessment ratios, where available, to obtain market values of wealth for each decade from 1850 to 1930. We use these data to show, first, that the United States experienced extraordinary wealth accumulation after the Civil War and until the Great Depression. Second, spatial inequality in the United States has been large and highly persistent since the mid-1800s. We also examine the determinants of long-term wealth growth and find, among other results, that counties with a higher share of enslaved property before the Civil War or with higher wealth inequality experienced lower subsequent long-run wealth growth.
10.1093/qje/qjag038.abstract_zh: 我们利用自19世纪初起新收集的历史财产税记录，研究美国的财富积累历史与地理分布。这些记录源自一般财产税的管理实践——该税种旨在覆盖所有类型的财产。我们构建了州、县及国家层面的财富序列。在州级层面，我们依据多来源的州级报告中的年度评估价值。鉴于评估价值可能与市场价值存在差异，我们还需评估比率，即评估财富与市场财富之比。我们从十年一次的美国人口普查财富数据（包括“财富、债务与税收”等各类普查报告）中获取州级评估比率，普查中进行了详尽的估值工作，并辅以州报告中关于评估实践变化的信息，以构建更高频率的评估比率序列。由此，我们得到了各州从1850年（或更早，视州而定）至1935年的长期年度财富序列。国家财富序列则通过汇总这些州级序列获得。在县级层面，我们利用每十年美国人口普查财富数据中的评估价值（或可得情况下的市场价值），并应用州级或县级评估比率（若可得），以获取1850年至1930年间每十年的市场财富价值。利用这些数据，我们首先展示，美国在内战后至大萧条前经历了非凡的财富积累。其次，自19世纪中叶以来，美国的空间不平等显著且高度持续。我们还探讨了长期财富增长的决定因素，发现，在其他结果中，内战前奴隶财产占比更高或财富不平等更严重的县，其后续长期财富增长较低。
10.1093/qje/qjag038.title: Wealth and Property Taxation in the United States
10.1093/qje/qjag038.title_zh: 美国财富与财产税研究

10.1093/qje/qjag039.abstract: Investors’ return expectations are pivotal in stock markets, but the reasoning behind these expectations is not well understood. This paper explores economic agents’ mental models of what drives returns. We survey the general population, retail investors, financial professionals, and academic experts to investigate how they forecast and explain future returns in scenarios with stale news about future company earnings. We find that investors strongly disagree in their forecasts and reasoning. Most academic experts view markets as efficient. By contrast, most households express a perspective we call “expected earnings reasoning”: they directly equate higher expected earnings with higher expected returns. Professionals are split between market efficiency, mispricing, and expected earnings reasoning. In detailed experiments, we dissect why households adopt expected earnings reasoning. We show that it arises from inattention to how stock-price changes affect investor costs — that is, how much investors must pay to acquire a claim to future cash flows — because the typical format and context of investment problems obscure these cost implications. Our results help connect a series of previously documented anomalies in expectation and trading data and highlight the importance of selective attention and context in shaping reasoning and belief formation.
10.1093/qje/qjag039.abstract_zh: 投资者的回报预期在股票市场中至关重要，但这些预期背后的推理机制尚不明确。本文探究经济主体对驱动回报因素的心智模型。我们通过调查普通民众、散户投资者、金融专业人士及学术专家，研究他们在面对未来公司盈利的陈旧信息时，如何预测和解释未来回报。研究发现，投资者在预测和推理上存在显著分歧。大多数学术专家认为市场是有效的。相比之下，多数家庭持有一种我们称之为"预期盈利推理"的观点：他们直接将更高的预期盈利等同于更高的预期回报。专业人士则分为市场有效派、错误定价派和预期盈利推理派。通过精细实验，我们剖析了家庭为何采用预期盈利推理。研究表明，这种推理源于投资者对股价变动如何影响投资成本——即投资者为获取未来现金流索取权所需支付的对价——的忽视，因为投资问题的典型呈现形式和背景掩盖了这些成本含义。我们的研究结果有助于串联此前在预期和交易数据中记录的一系列异常现象，并凸显选择性注意和背景在塑造推理与信念形成中的关键作用。
10.1093/qje/qjag039.title: Mental Models of the Stock Market

10.1093/qje/qjag040.abstract: We study worker noncompete clauses in a large field experiment with two finance firms. Across ~14,000 job offers to freelance recruiters on short-term contracts, we randomize wages and the presence, salience, and duration of noncompetes (all contracts also included a nondisclosure agreement). Removing a noncompete increases mobility between competing employers by 36–52% and raises workers’ total earnings from the two firms by 12–17%. We find no evidence—rejecting even small effects—that removing noncompetes generates secret leakage. We also find no evidence that workers choose noncompete jobs for higher pay. Many workers appear unaware of noncompetes before firms’ post-employment communication. The results align with a model of inattention and uncertainty about enforcement.
10.1093/qje/qjag040.abstract_zh: 我们在两家金融公司开展的大规模实地实验中研究了工人的竞业禁止条款。在向短期合同自由招聘人员发出的约14,000份工作邀请中，我们随机化了工资以及竞业禁止条款的存在性、显著性和持续时间（所有合同均包含保密协议）。移除竞业禁止条款使竞争雇主之间的流动性提高了36%-52%，并使工人在两家公司的总收益增加了12%-17%。我们没有发现任何证据——甚至拒绝了微小效应的存在——表明移除竞业禁止条款会导致秘密泄露。我们也没有发现工人为了更高薪酬而选择竞业禁止工作的证据。许多工人似乎在公司的雇佣后沟通之前对竞业禁止条款并不知情。这些结果与关于注意力不足和执行不确定性的模型相吻合。
10.1093/qje/qjag040.title: Clause and Effect: Theory and Field Experimental Evidence on Noncompete Clauses
10.1093/qje/qjag040.title_zh: 条款与效应：关于竞业禁止条款的理论与实地实验证据

10.1093/qje/qjag041.abstract: This paper constructs the first global dataset on inter-sectoral capital service expenditures. I use this data to disaggregate capital services and intermediate inputs in a dynamic multi-sector trade model. Steady state allocations and responses to shocks are determined by a capital-augmented global input-output matrix. Two properties of the measured network deliver larger long-run consumption gains from globalization than existing estimates, as well as larger gains in more capital-intensive countries. First, more trade-exposed sectors supply capital to more consumption-influential producers. Second, heterogeneity in the network reallocates sectoral expenditures towards producers with larger declines in capital rental prices. These reallocations raise capital incomes and lower consumption price indices.
10.1093/qje/qjag041.abstract_zh: 本文构建了首个全球跨部门资本服务支出数据集。利用该数据，我在动态多部门贸易模型中对资本服务与中间投入进行了分解。稳态配置及对冲击的响应由资本增强型全球投入产出矩阵决定。相较于现有估算，该测算网络的两大特性表明：全球化带来的长期消费收益更大，且资本密集型国家的收益增幅更为显著。其一，贸易暴露度更高的部门向更具消费影响力的生产者提供资本；其二，网络异质性促使部门支出向资本租赁价格降幅更大的生产者重新配置。这种重新配置既提高了资本收入，又降低了消费价格指数。
10.1093/qje/qjag041.title: Capital Services in Global Value Chains
10.1093/qje/qjag041.title_zh: 全球价值链中的资本服务

10.1093/qje/qjag042.abstract: We study the causal impacts of income on a rich array of employment outcomes, leveraging an experiment in which 1,000 low-income individuals were randomized into receiving $1,000 per month unconditionally for three years, with a control group of 2,000 participants receiving $50/month. We gather detailed survey data, administrative records, and data from a mobile phone app. The transfer caused total individual income excluding the transfers to fall by about $1,900/year relative to the control group and a 4.2 percentage point decrease in labor market participation. Participants reduced their work hours as a result of the transfers by 1-2 hours/week and participants’ partners reduced their work hours by a comparable amount. Among other categories of time use, the greatest increase generated by the transfer was in time spent on leisure. Despite asking detailed questions about amenities, we find no impact on quality of employment, and our confidence intervals can rule out even small improvements. Treated participants broadly increase expenditures, led by spending on non-durable goods and services, with smaller increases in spending on durable goods and human capital. We observe no significant effects on degree attainment, though the magnitudes of the estimated effects generally appear larger among younger participants. Measures of subjective well-being are higher among treated participants in the first year of the transfers but then revert to control group levels. Overall, our results suggest a moderate labor supply effect that does not appear offset by other productive activities.
