10.1093/qje/qjag042.abstract_zh: 我们研究收入对一系列就业结果的因果影响，利用了一项实验，其中1000名低收入个体被随机分配为每月无条件获得1000美元，为期三年，对照组2000名参与者每月获得50美元。我们收集了详细的调查数据、行政记录以及手机应用数据。转移支付导致除转移外个人总收入相对于对照组每年下降约1900美元，劳动力市场参与率下降4.2个百分点。参与者因转移支付而减少工作时间每周1-2小时，且参与者的伴侣也减少了相当数量的工作时间。在其他时间使用类别中，转移支付带来的最大增加是休闲时间。尽管我们询问了关于工作条件的详细问题，但未发现对就业质量的影响，且我们的置信区间可以排除即使是微小的改善。受助参与者总体上增加了支出，主要由非耐用品和服务支出带动，耐用品和人力资本支出增加较小。我们未观察到对学位获得的显著影响，尽管估计效应的大小在年轻参与者中通常显得更大。在转移支付的第一年，受助参与者的主观幸福感指标较高，但随后恢复到对照组水平。总体而言，我们的结果表明存在适度的劳动力供给效应，且这一效应并未被其他生产性活动所抵消。
10.1093/qje/qjag042.title: The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States
10.1093/qje/qjag042.title_zh: 保障性收入对就业的影响：来自美国两州的实验证据

10.1093/qje/qjag044.abstract: This paper provides the first comprehensive global evidence on people’s fairness and efficiency preferences, beliefs about the sources of inequality and the efficiency cost of redistribution, and policy attitudes toward redistribution. Using a globally harmonized consequential experiment with more than 65,000 individuals across 60 countries, we show that the source of inequality plays a substantially larger role for inequality acceptance than the efficiency cost of redistribution. At the global level, implemented inequality increases by 85 percent when inequality is caused by merit rather than luck, compared to a 14 percent increase when redistribution entails a 50 percent efficiency cost. We document substantial heterogeneity in fairness views and beliefs both within and across societies. The meritocratic fairness view is most prominent in many richer Western societies, while libertarian and egalitarian fairness views are widespread in many other parts of the world. Globally, people are more likely to believe that inequality reflects luck rather than merit, while beliefs in large efficiency costs of redistribution are relatively weak. Fairness preferences and beliefs are strongly associated with redistribution attitudes and actual redistribution through taxes and transfers across countries. Our findings illustrate how the interaction between fairness views and beliefs may shape redistribution across societies, highlighting the importance of jointly understanding preferences and beliefs in the political economy of redistribution.
10.1093/qje/qjag044.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于人们公平与效率偏好、对不平等根源及再分配效率成本的信念，以及对再分配政策态度的首份全球性综合证据。通过一项涵盖60个国家、超过65,000名参与者的全球统一后果实验，我们表明，不平等的根源在不平等接受度中所起的作用远大于再分配的效率成本。在全球层面，当不平等源于才能而非运气时，实际不平等程度增加了85%，相比之下，当再分配涉及50%的效率成本时，仅增加了14%。我们记录了公平观念和信念在各类社会内部及跨社会间的显著异质性。精英主义的公平观在许多较富裕的西方社会中最为突出，而自由主义和平均主义的公平观在世界其他许多地区广泛存在。全球范围内，人们更倾向于认为不平等反映的是运气而非才能，而对再分配存在高额效率成本的信念相对较弱。公平偏好和信念与再分配态度及各国通过税收和转移支付实现的实际再分配密切相关。我们的发现揭示了公平观念与信念之间的相互作用如何可能塑造各社会的再分配格局，强调了在再分配的政治经济学中共同理解偏好与信念的重要性。
10.1093/qje/qjag044.title: Fairness Across the World

10.1093/restud/rdag021.abstract: How do regional productivity shocks or transportation infrastructure improvements affect aggregate welfare? In a general class of spatial equilibrium models, we provide a formula for aggregate welfare changes, decomposed into terms associated with (i) technology [Fogel (1964), Railroads and American Economic Growth (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins Press), Hulten (1978) “Growth Accounting with Intermediate Inputs”, The Review of Economic Studies, 45, 511–518], (ii) spatial dispersion of marginal utility, (iii) fiscal externalities, (iv) technological externalities, and (v) redistribution. We further use this decomposition to derive a general formula for optimal spatial transfers and show that, whenever optimal transfers are in place, the technology term alone captures the aggregate welfare effects of technological shocks. We apply our framework to study welfare gains from improving the US highway network. We find that changes in the spatial dispersion of marginal utility are as important as technological externalities in accounting for the deviations from the Fogel-Hulten benchmark to assess welfare gains.
10.1093/restud/rdag021.abstract_zh: 区域生产率冲击或交通基础设施改善如何影响总体福利？在一类通用的空间均衡模型中，我们推导出总体福利变化的分解公式，该公式包含以下组成部分：(i) 技术效应 [Fogel (1964), 《铁路与美国经济增长》(巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯出版社)；Hulten (1978)《中间投入的增长核算》，《经济研究评论》，第45卷，511–518页]；(ii) 边际效用的空间分散程度；(iii) 财政外部性；(iv) 技术外部性；以及(v) 再分配效应。我们进一步利用该分解推导出最优空间转移支付的一般公式，并证明当最优转移支付机制存在时，仅技术效应项即可完全捕捉技术冲击对总体福利的影响。我们将该分析框架应用于评估美国高速公路网络改善带来的福利收益，发现边际效用空间分散程度的变化与技术外部性在解释福利收益偏离Fogel-Hulten基准时具有同等重要性。
10.1093/restud/rdag021.title: Unpacking Aggregate Welfare in a Spatial Economy
10.1093/restud/rdag021.title_zh: 解析空间经济中的总体福利

10.1093/restud/rdag024.abstract: What are the effects of supply-side climate policies in the oil market? We use global company-level data to estimate the impact of 84 reforms of production taxes between 2000 and 2019 on oil production, exploration, and discoveries. We find that higher taxes primarily reduce companies’ exploration expenditures and oil discoveries, and also reduce short-term production of unconventional oil. We then quantify the implications for the oil market using a short- and medium-term dynamic model extending until the end of the century. Imposing a global climate royalty surcharge of 20 percentage points on oil producers reduces average annual emissions from oil by 5–7% in the first 5 years, and 9–20% in the medium term. If only OECD countries adopt this policy, 47–73% of the total emission reductions would be offset by increased production in non-OECD countries in the medium term.
10.1093/restud/rdag024.abstract_zh: 供给侧气候政策对石油市场有何影响？我们利用全球企业层面数据，估算了2000年至2019年间84项生产税改革对石油产量、勘探及发现量的影响。研究发现，提高税率主要降低了企业的勘探支出和石油发现量，同时减少了非常规石油的短期产量。随后，我们通过一个延伸至本世纪末的短期与中期动态模型，量化了这些影响对石油市场的含义。若对石油生产商征收20个百分点的全球气候特许权附加费，前五年内石油年均排放量将减少5%至7%，中期内减少9%至20%。若仅由经合组织国家实施该政策，中期内47%至73%的减排总量将被非经合组织国家的产量增长所抵消。
10.1093/restud/rdag024.title: Quantifying Supply-Side Climate Policies

10.1093/restud/rdag025.abstract: We propose a simple and general model of experimentation in which reaching untried levels of a stock variable may, after a stochastic delay, lead to a catastrophe. Hence, at any point in time a catastrophe might well be under way, due to past experiments. We show how to measure this legacy of the past from prior beliefs and the chronicle of stock levels. We characterize the optimal policy as a function of the legacy and show that it leads to a new protocol for planning that applies to a general class of problems, encompassing the study of pandemics or climate change. Several original policy predictions follow, e.g. experimentation can stop but resume later.
10.1093/restud/rdag025.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个简洁且通用的实验模型，在该模型中，当存量变量达到未经尝试的水平时，经过随机延迟后可能引发灾难。因此，在任何时间点，由于过去的实验，灾难可能已经在酝酿之中。我们展示了如何根据先验信念和存量水平的历史记录来衡量这种过去的遗留影响。我们将最优政策刻画为遗留影响的函数，并表明该政策导向一种适用于一般问题类别的新规划协议，涵盖流行病或气候变化研究。由此得出若干原创性政策预测，例如实验可能停止但随后重启。
10.1093/restud/rdag025.title: Catastrophes, Delays, and Learning

10.1093/restud/rdag026.abstract: Multiple hypothesis testing (MHT) practices vary widely, without consensus on which are appropriate when. This article provides an economic foundation for these practices designed to capture leading examples, such as regulatory approval on the basis of clinical trials. MHT adjustments are appropriate in our framework to the extent that research costs are invariant to the number of hypotheses. Control of average size, as for example via a Bonferroni correction, emerges in the limit case where all costs are fixed; in the opposite limit, where costs vary in proportion to the hypothesis count, no correction is needed. We illustrate implications by calculating explicit critical values using data on actual costs in the drug approval process and in program evaluation research; these suggest that some MHT adjustment is warranted in these applications, but not as much as implied by standard practice.
10.1093/restud/rdag026.abstract_zh: 多重假设检验（MHT）的实践方法差异显著，且对于何种情境下应采用何种方法尚未形成共识。本文为这些实践方法提供了经济学基础，旨在涵盖典型案例（如基于临床试验的监管审批）。在我们的框架中，当研究成本不随假设数量变化时，MHT调整是适当的。在成本完全固定的极限情形下，平均检验规模的控制（例如通过邦费罗尼校正）得以实现；而在另一极端情形下，当成本与假设数量成比例变化时，则无需进行校正。我们通过利用药品审批流程及项目评估研究中实际成本数据计算显式临界值，阐释了相关含义：这些结果表明，在上述应用中需进行一定程度的MHT调整，但调整幅度不应如标准实践所暗示的那样大。
10.1093/restud/rdag026.title: A Model of Multiple Hypothesis Testing
10.1093/restud/rdag026.title_zh: 多重假设检验的一个模型

10.1093/restud/rdag029.abstract: Linear instrumental variable estimators, such as two-stage least squares (TSLS), are commonly interpreted as estimating non-negatively weighted averages of causal effects, referred to as local average treatment effects (LATEs). We examine whether the LATE interpretation actually applies to the types of TSLS specifications that are used in practice. We show that if the specification includes covariates—which most empirical work does—then the LATE interpretation does not apply in general. Instead, the TSLS estimator will, in general, reflect treatment effects for both compliers and always/never-takers, and some treatment effects for the always/never-takers will necessarily be negatively weighted. We show that the only specifications that have a LATE interpretation are “saturated” specifications that control for covariates nonparametrically, implying that such specifications are both sufficient and necessary for TSLS to have a LATE interpretation, at least without additional parametric assumptions. This result is concerning because, as we document, empirical researchers almost never control for covariates nonparametrically, and rarely discuss or justify parametric specifications of covariates. We apply our results to thirteen empirical studies and find strong evidence that the LATE interpretation of TSLS is far from accurate for the types of specifications actually used in practice. We offer concrete recommendations for practice motivated by our theoretical and empirical results.
10.1093/restud/rdag029.abstract_zh: 线性工具变量估计量（如两阶段最小二乘法，TSLS）通常被解释为对因果效应的非负加权平均，即局部平均处理效应（LATE）。本文考察了LATE解释是否实际适用于实践中使用的TSLS设定形式。研究表明，若设定中包含协变量（多数实证研究均如此），则LATE解释通常不再适用。此时，TSLS估计量将同时反映依从者与始终/从不接受治疗者的处理效应，且始终/从不接受治疗者的部分处理效应必然被赋予负权重。我们证明，唯一具有LATE解释的设定是“饱和”设定——即通过非参数方式控制协变量，这意味着此类设定既是TSLS获得LATE解释的充分条件也是必要条件（至少在没有额外参数假设的情况下）。这一结论令人担忧，因为据我们记录，实证研究者几乎从未采用非参数方式控制协变量，且极少讨论或论证协变量的参数设定形式。我们将研究结果应用于13项实证研究，发现对于实践中实际使用的设定类型，TSLS的LATE解释远非准确。基于理论与实证结果，我们为实践操作提供了具体建议。
10.1093/restud/rdag029.title: When is TSLS Actually LATE?

10.1093/restud/rdag031.abstract: We study the effect of risk on how firms organize their supply chains. We use transaction-level data on U.S. manufacturing imports to construct a novel measure of input sourcing risk based on the historical volatility of ocean shipping times. Our measure isolates the unexpected component of shipping times that is induced by weather conditions along more than 331,000 maritime routes. We first document that unexpected shipping delays significantly reduce importers’ sales, profits, and employment. We then show that firms actively diversify weather risk by using more routes and foreign suppliers, although their import values decline. To rationalize these findings, we introduce shipping time risk into a general equilibrium model of importing with firm heterogeneity. Our quantitative analysis predicts substantial costs for the U.S. economy associated with supply chain risk.
10.1093/restud/rdag031.abstract_zh: 本文研究风险如何影响企业供应链组织方式。我们利用美国制造业进口的交易层面数据，基于海运时间的历史波动性构建了投入品采购风险的新测度指标。该指标通过分析超过33.1万条海运航线的天气条件，分离出运输时间中由天气因素引发的意外波动。首先，我们证实运输时间的意外延迟会显著降低进口商的销售额、利润和就业水平。其次，我们发现企业会通过增加航线数量和海外供应商来主动分散天气风险，尽管其进口总额有所下降。为解释这些发现，我们将运输时间风险引入具有企业异质性的进口一般均衡模型。定量分析预测，供应链风险将给美国经济带来巨大成本。
10.1093/restud/rdag031.title: Input Sourcing under Climate Risk: Evidence from U.S. Manufacturing Firms
10.1093/restud/rdag031.title_zh: 气候风险下的投入品采购：来自美国制造业企业的证据

10.1093/restud/rdag032.abstract: We show that the financial sector’s asset supply elasticities are sufficient statistics summarizing its macroeconomic effects for a large class of financial frictions. These elasticities are crucial for a wide range of policy questions, ranging from the size of fiscal multipliers to the relative effectiveness of asset purchases targeting the financial sector versus tax cuts targeting households. Workhorse macroeconomic models imply different values of these elasticities, generating output responses to policies that differ by orders of magnitude. We construct empirical measures of these elasticities and evaluate their policy implications in a quantitative model with household heterogeneity and illiquidity.
10.1093/restud/rdag032.abstract_zh: 我们证明，对于一大类金融摩擦而言，金融部门的资产供给弹性是概括其宏观经济效应的充分统计量。这些弹性对于广泛的政策问题至关重要，涵盖从财政乘数的大小到针对金融部门的资产购买与针对家庭的减税政策相对有效性的比较。主流宏观经济模型对这些弹性赋予了不同的数值，导致政策对产出的影响幅度相差数个数量级。我们构建了这些弹性的实证度量指标，并在包含家庭异质性与非流动性的量化模型中评估其政策含义。
10.1093/restud/rdag032.title: Financial Intermediation and Aggregate Demand: A Sufficient Statistics Approach
10.1093/restud/rdag032.title_zh: 金融中介与总需求：一个充分统计量方法

10.1093/restud/rdag033.abstract: When employers face a trade-off between being large and paying low wages—and in this sense have monopsony power—some productive employers decide against building large business networks, forgo sales, and remain small. These decisions have adverse consequences for aggregate labour productivity. Using high-quality administrative data from Germany, we document that East German plants (compared to West German ones) face steeper size-wage curves, invest less in their business networks, remain smaller, and are less productive. A model with labour market monopsony, product market power, and business network investments matching these features of the data predicts a 10% lower aggregate labour productivity in East Germany.
10.1093/restud/rdag033.abstract_zh: 当雇主面临规模扩张与低工资之间的权衡——即在此意义上拥有买方垄断势力时，部分高生产率雇主会选择放弃构建庞大的商业网络、牺牲销售额并维持小规模经营。这些决策对总体劳动生产率产生不利影响。基于德国高质量行政数据，我们证实东德工厂（相较于西德工厂）面临更陡峭的规模-工资曲线，商业网络投资更少，企业规模更小，且生产率更低。一个包含劳动力市场买方垄断、产品市场势力及商业网络投资特征（与数据特征相匹配）的模型预测，东德总体劳动生产率将因此降低10%。
10.1093/restud/rdag033.title: Monopsony Makes Firms Not Only Small but Also Unproductive: Why East Germany has Not Converged
10.1093/restud/rdag033.title_zh: 买方垄断不仅使企业规模变小，还导致其低效率：东德为何未能实现经济趋同

10.1093/restud/rdag035.abstract: Manager pay has increased considerably since 1980, and so has inequality in manager pay. Over the same period, there has been a sharp rise in market power. We start from the premise that the role of managers is to increase firm productivity. When markets are imperfectly competitive, productivity not only helps firm grow in size, productivity also affects market power. We model how imperfect competition in product markets affects manager pay, and break down the contributions of firm size and market power to compensation. We find that market power, on average, accounts for 45.2% of total manager pay. Notably, there is substantial variation across managers. Top managers are disproportionately employed by firms with market power, and they benefit from it: in 2019, 80.3% of top manager pay is attributable to market power. Our main conclusion is that rise of market power explains half of the increase in average manager pay, and nearly all of the increase in manager pay inequality.
10.1093/restud/rdag035.abstract_zh: 自1980年以来，管理者薪酬大幅增长，管理者薪酬不平等程度也随之加剧。同期，市场势力急剧上升。我们基于管理者职责在于提升企业生产率这一前提展开研究。当市场处于不完全竞争状态时，生产率不仅有助于企业规模扩张，还会影响市场势力。我们构建模型分析产品市场不完全竞争对管理者薪酬的影响机制，并分解企业规模与市场势力对薪酬的贡献度。研究发现，市场势力平均占管理者总薪酬的45.2%。值得注意的是，不同管理者之间存在显著差异。高层管理者不成比例地受雇于具有市场势力的企业，并从中获益：2019年，高层管理者薪酬的80.3%可归因于市场势力。我们的主要结论是：市场势力的上升解释了平均管理者薪酬增长的一半，以及管理者薪酬不平等加剧的几乎全部原因。
10.1093/restud/rdag035.title: Manager Pay Inequality and Market Power
10.1093/restud/rdag035.title_zh: 经理薪酬不平等与市场势力

10.1093/restud/rdag037.abstract: I study racial disparities in the criminal justice system by analysing abnormal bunching in the distribution of crack-cocaine amounts used in federal sentencing. I compare cases sentenced before and after the Fair Sentencing Act, a 2010 law that changed the 10-year mandatory minimum threshold for crack-cocaine from 50 g to 280 g. First, I find that after 2010, there is a sharp increase in the fraction of cases sentenced at 280 g (the point that now triggers a 10-year mandatory minimum), and that this increase is disproportionately large for black and Hispanic offenders. I then explore several possible explanations for the observed racial disparities, including racial discrimination that occurs after entry into the criminal justice system. I analyse data from multiple stages in the criminal justice system and find that the increased bunching for minority offenders is driven by prosecutorial discretion, specifically as used by about 20–30% of prosecutors. Moreover, the fraction of cases at 280 g falls in 2013 when evidentiary standards become stricter. Finally, the racial disparity in the increase cannot be explained by differences in education, sex, age, criminal history, seized drug amount, or other elements of the crime, but it can be largely explained by a measure of state-level racial animus. These results shed light on the role of prosecutorial discretion and racial discrimination as causes of racial disparities in sentencing.
10.1093/restud/rdag037.abstract_zh: 本文通过分析联邦量刑中快克可卡因数量分布的异常聚集现象，研究刑事司法体系中的种族差异。我将2010年《公平量刑法》实施前后判决的案件进行对比——该法案将触发10年强制最低刑期的快克可卡因门槛从50克调整为280克。首先发现，2010年后以280克（当前触发10年强制最低刑期的临界点）量刑的案件比例急剧上升，且黑人及西班牙裔罪犯在此增幅中占比显著偏高。随后探讨了导致观察到的种族差异的几种可能解释，包括进入刑事司法体系后发生的种族歧视。通过分析刑事司法体系多个阶段的数据，发现少数族裔罪犯的聚集现象加剧源于检察官的自由裁量权，具体表现为约20-30%检察官的裁量行为。此外，当2013年证据标准趋严时，280克量刑案件比例出现下降。最后，这种增幅中的种族差异无法通过教育程度、性别、年龄、犯罪前科、毒品查获数量或其他犯罪要素来解释，但可在很大程度上由州级种族敌意指标解释。这些研究结果揭示了检察官自由裁量权与种族歧视作为量刑种族差异成因的作用机制。
10.1093/restud/rdag037.title: Racial Disparities in Federal Sentencing: Evidence from Drug Mandatory Minimums
10.1093/restud/rdag037.title_zh: 联邦量刑中的种族差异：来自毒品强制最低刑期的证据

10.1093/restud/rdag038.abstract: The seminal paper by Baron and Ferejohn (1989) leaves significant gaps in our understanding of open rule bargaining. We aim to fill these gaps by providing a fresh analysis of open rule bargaining. Our approach relies on an appealing class of stationary equilibria. In this class, we show that delays tend to be longer and allocations tend to be less egalitarian than originally predicted by Baron and Ferejohn. Our results shed new light on the efficiency and fairness implications of using an open vs. closed rule in legislatures and of bargaining processes in general.
10.1093/restud/rdag038.abstract_zh: Baron与Ferejohn（1989）的开创性论文在开放规则谈判领域留下了显著的研究空白。本文旨在通过提供对开放规则谈判的全新分析来填补这些空白。我们的研究方法依赖于一类具有吸引力的稳态均衡。在该均衡类别中，我们证明谈判延迟往往比Baron与Ferejohn最初预测的更久，而资源分配则更不平均。这一发现为立法机构中开放规则与封闭规则的使用效率及公平性影响，以及更广泛的谈判过程提供了全新视角。
10.1093/restud/rdag038.title: Open Rule Legislative Bargaining

10.1093/restud/rdag039.abstract: Discrete choice data allow researchers to recover differences in utilities, but these differences may not suffice to identify policy-relevant counterfactuals of interest. In fact, in the case of dynamic discrete choice models, only a narrow set of counterfactuals are point-identified. In this paper, we explore how much one can learn about counterfactual outcomes of interest within this framework. We focus on the partial identification of counterfactuals, while allowing for (mild) model restrictions that can gradually shrink the identified set. We derive bounds for low-dimensional objects (such as average welfare) as arguments of optimization programmes, along with a uniformly valid inference procedure. Furthermore, we develop new and tractable computational tools and algorithms suitable for dealing with high-dimensional problems like this. Finally, we illustrate in Monte Carlos, as well as an empirical exercise of firms’ export decisions, the informativeness of the identified sets, and we assess the impact of (common) model restrictions on results.
10.1093/restud/rdag039.abstract_zh: 离散选择数据使研究者能够恢复效用差异，但这些差异可能不足以识别政策相关的反事实结果。事实上，在动态离散选择模型中，仅有一小部分反事实结果能被点识别。本文探讨了在此框架下，我们能对感兴趣的反事实结果了解到何种程度。我们聚焦于反事实的部分识别，同时允许（温和的）模型约束逐步缩小识别集。我们推导了低维对象（如平均福利）作为优化问题参数的边界，并提供了统一有效的推断方法。此外，我们开发了适用于处理此类高维问题的新型可计算工具与算法。最后，通过蒙特卡洛模拟以及企业出口决策的实证研究，我们展示了识别集的信息量，并评估了（常见）模型约束对结果的影响。
10.1093/restud/rdag039.title: Counterfactual Analysis for Structural Dynamic Discrete Choice Models
10.1093/restud/rdag039.title_zh: 结构动态离散选择模型的反事实分析

10.1093/restud/rdag040.abstract: An agent samples projects over time, observing quality for each, while a principal can select at most one. The principal values quality, whereas the agent only wants a project chosen. Transfers are unavailable, but the principal can verify quality by paying a cost. We fully characterize the dynamics of verification by determining optimal mechanisms for this problem. With a low verification cost and a long horizon, the optimal mechanism involves a deterministic selection rule that initially discriminates on quality but chooses a project irrespective of its quality at a deadline. Verification occurs with an intermediate probability before the deadline, declining over time. We show how these conclusions change if the verification cost is high or the horizon is short, and under certain forms of imperfect commitment. Our analysis provides guidelines on how dynamics interact with the benefits of verification.
10.1093/restud/rdag040.abstract_zh: 代理人随时间推移对项目进行抽样，并观察每个项目的质量，而委托人最多只能选择一个项目。委托人重视项目质量，而代理人只希望项目被选中。虽然无法进行转移支付，但委托人可以通过支付成本来验证质量。我们通过确定该问题的最优机制，全面刻画了验证的动态特征。在验证成本较低且时间跨度较长的情况下，最优机制包含一个确定性选择规则：该规则最初根据质量进行区分，但在截止日期前会忽略质量选择项目。验证行为在截止日期前以中等概率发生，且随时间推移而递减。我们展示了当验证成本较高或时间跨度较短时，以及在特定形式的不完全承诺条件下，这些结论如何发生变化。我们的分析为动态因素如何与验证收益相互作用提供了指导原则。
10.1093/restud/rdag040.title: The Dynamics of Verification when Searching for Quality
10.1093/restud/rdag040.title_zh: 质量搜寻中的验证动态

10.1093/restud/rdag041.abstract: We document dramatic changes in euro area interbank money markets during the financial and sovereign debt crises: unsecured borrowing declined across the euro area, while secured market haircuts on sovereign bonds increased, and bank borrowing from the European Central Bank rose in southern countries. We construct a quantitative general equilibrium model to assess the macroeconomic impact of these developments and the associated policy response. Our model features heterogeneous banks and sovereign bonds, secured and unsecured money markets, and a central bank. We compare a benchmark policy—the central bank providing collateralized lending to banks at haircuts lower than the market—with an alternative policy that maintains a constant central bank balance sheet. We show that the fall in output, investment, and capital would have been twice as high under the alternative policy.
10.1093/restud/rdag041.abstract_zh: 本文记录了欧元区银行间货币市场在金融危机和主权债务危机期间的剧烈变化：欧元区无担保借贷普遍下降，主权债券的担保市场折扣率上升，而南部国家银行从欧洲中央银行的借款增加。我们构建了一个定量一般均衡模型，以评估这些变化及其相关政策应对的宏观经济影响。该模型包含异质性银行与主权债券、有担保与无担保货币市场，以及中央银行。我们将基准政策——中央银行以低于市场的折扣率向银行提供抵押贷款——与维持中央银行资产负债表不变的替代政策进行比较。研究表明，在替代政策下，产出、投资和资本的下降幅度将是基准政策的两倍。
10.1093/restud/rdag041.title: Money Markets, Collateral, and Monetary Policy
10.1093/restud/rdag041.title_zh: 货币市场、抵押品与货币政策

10.1093/restud/rdag042.abstract: What are the channels through which monetary policy affects financial stability? Can (and should) central banks prevent financial crises by deviating from price stability? To what extent may monetary policy itself unintentionally breed financial vulnerabilities? We answer these questions using a New Keynesian model with capital accumulation and endogenous financial crises due to adverse selection and moral hazard in credit markets. Our findings are threefold. First, monetary policy affects the probability of a crisis both in the short run (via aggregate demand) and in the medium run (via capital accumulation). Second, the central bank can reduce the incidence of crises in the medium run by tolerating higher inflation volatility in the short run. Third, prolonged periods of loose monetary policy followed by a sharp tightening can lead to financial crises.
10.1093/restud/rdag042.abstract_zh: 货币政策通过哪些渠道影响金融稳定？中央银行能否（且是否应当）通过偏离价格稳定目标来预防金融危机？货币政策本身在多大程度上可能无意中滋生金融脆弱性？我们通过构建一个包含资本积累以及信贷市场中逆向选择与道德风险所引发内生金融危机的新凯恩斯模型来回答这些问题。研究结论有三点：第一，货币政策既在短期（通过总需求渠道）也在中期（通过资本积累渠道）影响危机发生概率；第二，中央银行可通过容忍短期通胀波动率上升来降低中期危机发生率；第三，长期宽松货币政策后骤然收紧可能引发金融危机。
10.1093/restud/rdag042.title: Monetary Policy and Endogenous Financial Crises
10.1093/restud/rdag042.title_zh: 货币政策与内生金融危机

10.1093/restud/rdag043.abstract: Despite the increasing importance of multiple priors in various domains of economics, choice-based incentive-compatible multiple-prior elicitation remains an open problem. This paper develops a solution, comprising a preference-based identification of a subject’s probability interval for an event, and a method for eliciting it. The method applies under weak decision-theoretic assumptions, with no need for probabilistic sophistication. To demonstrate its feasibility, we implement it in three incentivized experiments on artificial and natural sources of uncertainty. Intervals elicited by our method are sensitive to the direction and amount of information and are typically consistent with “objective” probabilities where available. We find a predominance of non-degenerate probability intervals, with intervals being wider when there is less information or predictability. The probability intervals elicited with our method are similar to those stated by subjects on aggregate, suggesting that the method can provide behavioural foundations for the use of stated probability-interval techniques in the field.
10.1093/restud/rdag043.abstract_zh: 尽管多重先验在经济学各领域的重要性日益凸显，基于选择的激励相容多重先验启发仍是一个未解难题。本文提出一套解决方案，包含基于偏好的个体事件概率区间识别方法及其启发技术。该方法在弱决策理论假设下适用，无需概率精炼性假设。为验证可行性，我们针对人工与自然不确定性来源开展三项激励实验。实验表明：该方法启发的概率区间对信息方向与信息量敏感，且在存在客观概率时通常与之吻合。我们发现非退化概率区间占主导地位，当信息量较少或可预测性较低时区间宽度更大。该方法启发的概率区间与受试者整体陈述的区间相似，表明该技术可为实地研究中陈述概率区间方法提供行为基础。
10.1093/restud/rdag043.title: Eliciting Multiple Prior Beliefs

10.1093/restud/rdag044.abstract: Do periods of persistently loose monetary policy increase financial fragility and the likelihood of a financial crisis? This is a central question for policymakers, yet the literature does not provide systematic empirical evidence about this link at the aggregate level. In this article, we fill this gap by analysing long-run historical data. We find that when the stance of monetary policy is accommodative over an extended period, the likelihood of financial turmoil in the medium term increases considerably. We investigate the causal pathways that lead to this result and argue that credit creation and asset price overheating are important intermediating channels.
10.1093/restud/rdag044.abstract_zh: 持续宽松的货币政策时期是否会加剧金融脆弱性并增加金融危机的可能性？这是政策制定者面临的核心问题，然而现有文献并未在宏观层面提供关于这一关联的系统性实证证据。本文通过分析长期历史数据填补了这一空白。研究发现，当货币政策在较长时期内保持宽松立场时，中期内发生金融动荡的可能性显著上升。我们进一步探究了导致这一结果的因果路径，并论证信贷创造与资产价格过热是重要的中介传导渠道。
10.1093/restud/rdag044.title: Loose Monetary Policy and Financial Instability
10.1093/restud/rdag044.title_zh: 宽松货币政策与金融不稳定

10.1093/restud/rdag045.abstract: We analyse discontinuous Markovian strategies for differential games. The best response correspondence uniquely maps almost all profiles of opponents’ strategies back to the strategy space. We thus make Markov-perfect equilibria in a wide class of differential games well-behaved, resolving a long-standing open problem. We provide a readily applicable necessary and sufficient condition for best responses and Markov-perfect Nash equilibria. We demonstrate our methods in a canonical model of non-cooperative mitigation of climate change. Our approach provides novel, economically important results: we obtain the entire set of symmetric Markov-perfect equilibria and demonstrate that the best equilibria can yield a major welfare improvement over the equilibrium which previous literature has focused on. International climate negotiations can be seen as being about coordination on good equilibria, rather than about bargaining over the limited surplus available in a dynamic prisoner’s dilemma.
10.1093/restud/rdag045.abstract_zh: 我们分析了微分博弈中的不连续马尔可夫策略。最优反应对应将几乎所有对手策略的剖面唯一映射回策略空间。由此，我们使广泛一类微分博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡具有良好的性质，解决了一个长期存在的开放性问题。我们给出了一个易于应用的最优反应与马尔可夫完美纳什均衡的充要条件。我们通过一个非合作减缓气候变化的经典模型展示了该方法。我们的方法提供了新颖且具有重要经济意义的结果：我们得到了全部对称马尔可夫完美均衡集，并证明最优均衡相较于以往文献所关注的均衡能够带来显著的福利改善。国际气候谈判可被视为关于良好均衡的协调，而非在动态囚徒困境的有限剩余上进行讨价还价。
10.1093/restud/rdag045.title: Markov-Perfect Equilibria in Differential Games—With an Application to Climate Policy
10.1093/restud/rdag045.title_zh: 微分博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡——兼论其在气候政策中的应用

10.1093/restud/rdag046.abstract: This article reconsiders the question of optimal labour income taxes for the very rich in the context of a flexible moral hazard model. In this setting, risk is not exogenous. Rather, each agent can affect the probabilities of all possible income outcomes by allocating a fixed time endowment across a variety of distinct tasks. I prove that the optimal income tax rates on high-end earners and the optimal Pareto tail index of the pre-tax labour income distribution are both endogenously determined by agent preferences. In particular, a society with less risk-averse agents will find it optimal to impose a lower tax rate on the rich, even though its members’ choices give rise to a smaller Pareto right tail index. In contrast, this kind of negative co-movement between inequality and optimal tax rates is a suboptimal response in the classical Mirrlees (1971)–Diamond (1998)–Saez (2001) setup to changes in the exogenous distribution of skills.
10.1093/restud/rdag046.abstract_zh: 本文在灵活的道德风险模型框架下重新审视了针对极高收入者的最优劳动所得税问题。在此设定中，风险并非外生变量。相反，每个行为人可通过将固定时间禀赋分配至多种不同任务，影响所有可能收入结果的发生概率。本文证明，高收入者的最优所得税率与税前劳动收入分布的最优帕累托尾部指数均由行为人偏好内生决定。具体而言，在行为人风险厌恶程度较低的社会中，即使其成员的选择导致更小的帕累托右尾指数，最优政策仍倾向于对富人征收更低的税率。与之形成对比的是，在经典的Mirrlees（1971）–Diamond（1998）–Saez（2001）框架下，这种不平等程度与最优税率之间的负向联动关系，实为对外生技能分布变化的次优反应。
10.1093/restud/rdag046.title: Optimal Labour Income Taxation: A Flexible Moral Hazard Approach
10.1093/restud/rdag046.title_zh: 最优劳动收入税：一种灵活的道德风险方法

10.1093/restud/rdag047.abstract: This paper studies the long-term effects of technology and know-how transfers on structural transformations. In the 1950s, the Soviet Union supported the construction of the 156 Projects, which were large-scale, capital-intensive industrial clusters in China. These projects included a technology transfer, consisting of state-of-the-art Soviet machinery and equipment, and a know-how transfer, via the training of Chinese engineers, production supervisors, and high-skilled technicians by Soviet experts. We use newly assembled data that follow steel plants for over four decades, and we exploit natural variation in the transfers they eventually received. We find that, while production advantages stemming from Soviet technology faded away if not complemented with training, the know-how transfer had a long-lasting impact on plant performance, stimulated technology upgrade when China was a closed economy, and increased exports to the Western world when China engaged in international trade. The know-how transfer also generated productivity and technology spillovers onto complementary establishments.
10.1093/restud/rdag047.abstract_zh: 本文研究了技术与知识转移对结构转型的长期影响。20世纪50年代，苏联援建了156项工程，这些工程是中国境内大规模、资本密集型的工业集群。这些项目包含技术转移（通过提供苏联最先进的机械设备）和知识转移（通过苏联专家培训中国工程师、生产主管及高级技工）。我们利用新汇编的跨越四十余年的钢铁厂数据，并借助这些工厂最终获得转移项目的自然差异进行分析。研究发现：若缺乏配套培训，源自苏联技术的生产优势会逐渐消退；而知识转移对工厂绩效具有持久影响，在中国封闭经济时期推动了技术升级，并在中国融入国际贸易后增加了对西方世界的出口。此外，知识转移还对配套企业产生了生产率与技术溢出效应。
10.1093/restud/rdag047.title: Technology Transfer and Early Industrial Development: Evidence from the Sino-Soviet Alliance
10.1093/restud/rdag047.title_zh: 技术转移与早期工业发展：来自中苏联盟的证据

10.1093/restud/rdag048.abstract: This article combines personnel records of the U.S. government with census data to study how exposure to greater female representation at work can persistently reduce intergenerational gender gaps in labour market outcomes. Exploiting city-by-department variation in the sudden expansion of female employment during World War I, we find that daughters of civil servants exposed to female co-workers are more likely to work later in life. This intergenerational effect operates through exposed fathers and extends beyond the public sector, reducing the earnings gap by 12%. Consistent with a broader shift in attitudes towards working women, exposure to female co-workers also made male civil servants more likely to marry working women. We show that cities exposed to larger increases in female federal workers saw persistently higher female labour force participation in both the public and the private sector. Increasing gender representation within the public sector can thus have broader labour market implications.
10.1093/restud/rdag048.abstract_zh: 本文结合美国政府人事档案与人口普查数据，研究工作中女性代表性提升如何持续缩小劳动力市场结果的代际性别差距。利用第一次世界大战期间女性就业突然扩张的城市-部门差异，我们发现，接触过女性同事的公务员的女儿在日后更有可能进入职场。这种代际效应通过受影响的父亲发挥作用，并延伸至公共部门之外，使收入差距缩小12%。与对职业女性态度整体转变相一致的是，接触女性同事也使男性公务员更有可能与职业女性结婚。研究表明，接触女性联邦雇员数量增长更大的城市，其公共与私营部门的女性劳动参与率均持续提高。因此，提升公共部门内的性别代表性可能对更广泛的劳动力市场产生深远影响。
10.1093/restud/rdag048.title: Closing Gender Gaps Through Workplace Diversity: The Intergenerational Effects of World War I
10.1093/restud/rdag048.title_zh: 通过职场多样性缩小性别差距：第一次世界大战的代际效应

10.1093/restud/rdag049.abstract: We propose a new model of internal migration, based on persistent and spatially correlated idiosyncratic utility. The model is motivated by a new fact in the data that simple moving cost models struggle to match: the t-year interstate migration rate is proportional to the square root of t. The new model maintains the tractability and flexibility of standard migration models, but better matches the dynamics of migration, including the new fact. It has substantially different welfare implications and makes different counterfactual predictions, especially in terms of dynamic adjustment and long-run responses.
10.1093/restud/rdag049.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于持久且空间相关的异质性效用的内部迁移新模型。该模型的提出源于数据中一个简单迁移成本模型难以匹配的新事实：t年跨州迁移率与t的平方根成正比。新模型保留了标准迁移模型的易处理性和灵活性，但能更好地匹配迁移的动态特征，包括这一新事实。该模型在福利含义上具有显著差异，并得出不同的反事实预测，尤其是在动态调整和长期响应方面。
10.1093/restud/rdag049.title: The Dynamics of Internal Migration: A New Fact and its Implications
10.1093/restud/rdag049.title_zh: 内部迁移的动态：一个新事实及其启示

10.1093/restud/rdag050.abstract: This article presents a theoretical case for replacement of conventional heteroskedasticity-consistent and cluster-robust variance estimators with jackknife variance estimators, in the context of linear regression with heteroskedastic and/or cluster-dependent observations. We examine the bias of variance estimation and the coverage probabilities of confidence intervals. Concerning bias, we show that conventional variance estimators have full downward worst-case bias, while our jackknife variance estimator is never downward biased. Concerning confidence intervals, we show that intervals based on conventional standard errors have worst-case coverage equalling zero, while the jackknife-based confidence interval has coverage probability bounded by the Cauchy distribution, under the auxiliary assumption of normal errors. We also extend the Bell and McCaffrey (2002) student t approximation to our jackknife t-ratio, resulting in confidence intervals with improved coverage probabilities. Our theory holds under broad assumptions, allowing arbitrary cluster sizes, regressor leverage, within-cluster correlation, heteroskedasticity, regression with a single treated cluster, fixed effects, and delete-cluster invertibility failures. Our theoretical findings are consistent with the extensive simulation literature investigating heteroskedasticity-consistent and cluster-robust variance estimation.
10.1093/restud/rdag050.abstract_zh: 本文在异方差和/或聚类相关观测的线性回归背景下，从理论上论证了用刀切法方差估计量替代传统异方差一致性和聚类稳健方差估计量的合理性。我们考察了方差估计的偏差以及置信区间的覆盖概率。关于偏差，我们证明传统方差估计量具有完全向下的最坏情况偏差，而我们的刀切法方差估计量从未出现向下偏差。关于置信区间，我们证明基于传统标准误的区间在最坏情况下覆盖概率为零，而在正态误差辅助假设下，基于刀切法的置信区间覆盖概率受柯西分布约束。我们还将Bell和McCaffrey（2002）的学生t近似方法推广到我们的刀切法t比率，从而得到覆盖概率改进的置信区间。我们的理论在广泛假设下成立，允许任意聚类规模、回归变量杠杆、聚类内相关性、异方差性、单一处理聚类的回归、固定效应以及删除聚类可逆性失效的情况。我们的理论发现与大量关于异方差一致性和聚类稳健方差估计的模拟研究文献一致。
10.1093/restud/rdag050.title: Jackknife Standard Errors for Clustered Regression
10.1093/restud/rdag050.title_zh: 聚类回归的刀切标准误

10.1093/restud/rdag051.abstract: We implement Pigovian transport pricing in a field experiment in urban agglomerations of Switzerland over the course of 8 weeks. Our pricing considers the external costs from climate damages, health outcomes from pollution, accidents and physical activity, and congestion. It varies across time, space and mode of transport and is deducted from a budget provided to GPS-tracked participants. The treatment significantly reduces the external costs of transport during the course of the experiment. The main underlying mechanism is a shift away from driving towards other modes, such as public transport, walking and cycling. Providing information about the external costs of transport alone is insufficient to change the transport behavior for the sample majority. A time-invariant tax on CO2 and health-related externalities would capture most of the welfare gains associated with the first-best policy.
10.1093/restud/rdag051.abstract_zh: 我们在瑞士城市群开展了一项为期8周的实地实验，实施了庇古式交通定价方案。该定价体系综合考虑了气候变化损害、污染导致的健康影响、交通事故、体力活动以及交通拥堵等外部成本，并根据时间、空间和交通方式动态调整。定价金额从提供给GPS追踪参与者的预算中扣除。实验期间，该干预措施显著降低了交通的外部成本。其主要作用机制是促使参与者从驾车出行转向公共交通、步行和骑行等其他交通方式。仅提供交通外部成本信息不足以改变样本中多数人的出行行为。对二氧化碳和健康相关外部性征收时间不变的税收，将能获取与最优政策相关的大部分福利收益。
10.1093/restud/rdag051.title: Pigovian Transport Pricing in Practice

10.1093/restud/rdag052.abstract: For many technologies and behaviors, an agent’s benefit from adopting depends on his contacts adopting, and the benefit to his contacts of adopting depends on their contacts adopting. This paper examines how the architecture of these connections shapes the success or failure of the diffusion of innovations. We start with a standard model of diffusion with the key addition that some agents can coordinate their decisions. This captures the idea that people often talk and make decisions together with friends or family to adopt technologies. We show that insularity of connections, that is, the extent to which agents tend to concentrate their connections to a narrow set of other agents, determines contagion. However, whether insularity helps or hinders depends on the technology being diffused. For technologies that are valuable even without many contacts adopting, we find insular connections hinder adoption, but for technologies that are valuable only when many contacts adopt, insular connections facilitate adoption.
10.1093/restud/rdag052.abstract_zh: 对于许多技术及行为而言，个体采纳的收益取决于其社交圈中他人的采纳情况，而他人采纳的收益又取决于其自身社交圈的采纳状况。本文探讨了这些连接结构如何影响创新扩散的成败。我们以标准扩散模型为基础，关键创新在于允许部分主体协调其决策。这反映了人们常与亲友共同商议并决定是否采纳技术的现实。研究表明，连接的封闭性——即个体将连接集中于狭窄群体的程度——决定了传染效应。然而，封闭性对扩散的促进或阻碍作用取决于技术特性：对于无需大量社交圈采纳即可产生价值的技术，封闭性会抑制采纳；而对于需依赖大量社交圈采纳才能体现价值的技术，封闭性反而促进采纳。
10.1093/restud/rdag052.title: The Architecture of Social Networks and the Diffusion of Innovations
10.1093/restud/rdag052.title_zh: 社交网络结构与创新扩散

10.1093/restud/rdag053.abstract: We propose a novel channel through which rising income inequality affects job creation and macroeconomic outcomes. High-income households save relatively more in stocks and bonds but less in bank deposits. A rising top income share thereby increases the relative financing cost for bank-dependent firms, which in turn create fewer jobs compared to other firms. Exploiting variation in top income shares across US states and an instrumental variable strategy, we provide evidence for this channel. We then build a general equilibrium macroeconomic model with heterogeneous households and heterogeneous firms and calibrate it to our empirical estimates. The model shows that the secular rise in top incomes accounts for 13% of the decline in the employment share of small firms since 1980. Through the new channel, rising inequality also reduces the labor share and aggregate output. Model experiments show that ignoring the link between inequality and job creation understates welfare effects of income redistribution.
10.1093/restud/rdag053.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的传导渠道，通过该渠道，收入不平等加剧会影响就业创造和宏观经济结果。高收入家庭将更多储蓄配置于股票和债券，而较少存入银行存款。因此，顶层收入份额的上升提高了依赖银行融资的企业的相对融资成本，导致这些企业创造的就业岗位少于其他企业。利用美国各州顶层收入份额的差异以及工具变量策略，我们为这一传导渠道提供了证据。随后，我们构建了一个包含异质性家庭和异质性企业的一般均衡宏观经济模型，并根据实证估计结果对其进行校准。模型显示，自1980年以来，顶层收入份额的长期上升解释了小企业就业份额下降的13%。通过这一新渠道，收入不平等加剧还降低了劳动收入份额和总产出。模型实验表明，忽视不平等与就业创造之间的关联会低估收入再分配的福利效应。
10.1093/restud/rdag053.title: Income Inequality and Job Creation
10.1093/restud/rdag053.title_zh: 收入不平等与就业创造

10.1093/restud/rdag054.abstract: We investigate optimal monetary and macroprudential policies in an open economy with aggregate demand externalities and an occasionally binding zero lower bound constraint. Our analysis highlights that the optimal policy balances output stabilization and capital flow management. When macroprudential policy is available, monetary policy stabilizes the output gap. By contrast, when macroprudential policy is not available, monetary policy is used prudentially. However, contrary to a widespread view, raising the interest rate is not necessarily the optimal prudential policy. Finally, we show that international spillovers operate through the world real rate, but macroprudential policies provide insulation from the adverse effects of foreign policies.
10.1093/restud/rdag054.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在存在总需求外部性和零下限约束偶尔生效的开放经济体中，最优货币政策和宏观审慎政策的制定。我们的分析强调，最优政策需要在产出稳定与资本流动管理之间取得平衡。当宏观审慎政策可用时，货币政策用于稳定产出缺口。相反，当宏观审慎政策不可用时，货币政策被审慎地使用。然而，与普遍观点相反，提高利率并非最优的审慎政策。最后，我们表明国际溢出效应通过世界实际利率传导，但宏观审慎政策能够抵御外国政策的不利影响。
10.1093/restud/rdag054.title: Liquidity Traps, Prudential Policies and International Spillovers
10.1093/restud/rdag054.title_zh: 流动性陷阱、审慎政策与国际溢出效应

10.1093/restud/rdag055.abstract: We exploit Germany’s temporary three-percentage-point VAT cut in the second half of 2020 to study the spending response to unconventional fiscal policy. We use survey and scanner data on household consumption expenditures and their perceived pass-through of the tax change into prices, and a HANK model to quantify the effects of this VAT policy. The survey and scanner data show that the temporary VAT reduction led to a relative increase in durable and, to a lesser extent, semi-durable spending for individuals with high perceived pass-through. According to the HANK model, the VAT policy increased total aggregate consumption spending by 4.4 percent on impact.
10.1093/restud/rdag055.abstract_zh: 本文利用德国2020年下半年临时性下调增值税三个百分点的政策，研究非传统财政政策对消费支出的影响。我们采用家庭消费支出的调查与扫描数据，以及消费者对税改价格传导的感知程度，并借助HANK模型量化该增值税政策的效果。调查与扫描数据显示，对于感知传导程度较高的群体，临时性增值税下调显著提升了耐用品支出，半耐用品支出也有较小幅度的增长。根据HANK模型测算，该增值税政策在实施初期使总消费支出增加了4.4%。
10.1093/restud/rdag055.title: A Temporary VAT Cut as Unconventional Fiscal Policy
10.1093/restud/rdag055.title_zh: 作为非常规财政政策的临时增值税减免

10.1093/restud/rdag056.abstract: We study the labor market effects of permanent 30-64% reductions in unemployment insurance benefits available in seven states. Leveraging linked firm-establishment data, we find that establishments based in reform states experience employment increases that are 0.8-1.3% larger than those of the same firm's establishments in other states. Using a similar multi-state firm design, starting salaries are 1.2-5.5% lower in reform states and posted salaries for the same job fall by 3.2-3.5%. The negative co-movement of employment and wages after the reform suggests a labor supply shock, and mitigates against confounding changes in labor demand driving the results. Our findings are consistent with workers lowering their reservation wages as outside options fall, and employers taking advantage of this by offering lower wages and increasing employment.
10.1093/restud/rdag056.abstract_zh: 我们研究了七个州将失业保险金永久性削减30%-64%对劳动力市场的影响。利用关联的企业-机构数据，我们发现，位于改革州的机构，其就业增长比同一企业在其他州的机构高出0.8-1.3%。采用类似的多州企业设计，改革州的起薪降低了1.2-5.5%，同一职位的公布薪资下降了3.2-3.5%。改革后就业与工资的负向联动表明存在劳动力供给冲击，并排除了劳动力需求变化作为驱动结果的混淆因素。我们的发现与以下结论一致：随着外部选择减少，工人降低保留工资，雇主借此提供更低工资并增加就业。
10.1093/restud/rdag056.title: Unemployment Insurance, Starting Salaries, and Jobs: Evidence from Multi-state Firms
10.1093/restud/rdag056.title_zh: 失业保险、起薪与就业：来自多州企业的证据

10.1093/restud/rdag057.abstract: We build a quantitative spatial model in which some workers can substitute on-site effort with work done from home. Ability and propensity to telecommute vary by education and industry. We quantify our framework to match the distribution of jobs and residents across 4,502 U.S. locations. Then we simulate permanent increases in the attractiveness and productivity of telework that lead to greater adoption of hybrid and fully remote work. To validate our model, we show that our results are positively correlated with local changes in residents, jobs, and housing costs since 2019. The rise of telework results in a rich non-monotonic pattern of reallocations of residents and jobs within and across cities. Workers who can telecommute experience welfare gains, and those who cannot suffer losses. Broader access to jobs reduces wage inequality across residential locations, and heralds a partial reversal in the spatial concentration of talent and spending power known as the “Great Divergence.”
10.1093/restud/rdag057.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个量化空间模型，其中部分劳动者可以用居家办公替代现场工作。远程办公的能力与倾向因教育水平和行业类型而异。我们通过量化该框架，使其匹配美国4502个地区的工作岗位与居民分布。随后模拟了远程办公吸引力与生产率永久性提升的情景，这些变化促使混合办公与完全远程办公模式得到更广泛采用。为验证模型有效性，我们展示了研究结果与2019年以来各地区居民、就业岗位及住房成本的本地变化呈正相关。远程办公的兴起导致城市内部及城市间居民与工作岗位出现丰富的非单调性重新配置模式。具备远程办公能力的劳动者获得福利提升，而无法远程办公的劳动者则遭受损失。更广泛的就业机会获取缩小了不同居住地间的工资不平等，预示着被称为"大分化"的人才与消费力空间集聚趋势将出现部分逆转。
10.1093/restud/rdag057.title: Spatial Implications of Telecommuting

10.1093/restud/rdag058.abstract: This paper studies competition under information heterogeneity in selection markets and examines the impact of public information regulations aimed at reducing information asymmetries between competing firms. We develop a novel model and introduce new empirical strategies to analyze imperfect competition in markets where firms have heterogeneous information about consumers, vary in cost structures, and offer differentiated products. Using data from the Italian auto insurance market, we find substantial differences in the precision of risk ratings across insurers, and those with less accurate risk-rating algorithms tend to have more efficient cost structures. We assess the equilibrium effects of giving firms equal access to aggregated risk information from a centralized bureau. This policy significantly reduces prices by increasing competition, leading to a 15.7% boost in consumer surplus, almost reaching the efficiency benchmark where firms have full knowledge of consumers’ true risk. Aggregating information through the bureau favors low-risk consumers and reduces average costs by 12 euros per contract through more efficient insurer-insuree matching.
10.1093/restud/rdag058.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在选择性市场中信息异质性下的竞争问题，并探讨了旨在减少竞争企业间信息不对称的公共信息监管政策的影响。我们构建了一个新颖的模型，并引入了新的实证策略，以分析企业在消费者信息掌握程度、成本结构差异及产品差异化方面存在异质性的不完全竞争市场。利用意大利汽车保险市场的数据，我们发现不同保险公司的风险评级精度存在显著差异，而风险评级算法精度较低的公司往往拥有更高效的成本结构。我们评估了赋予企业平等获取中央机构汇总风险信息这一政策的均衡效应。该政策通过增强竞争显著降低了价格，使消费者剩余提升15.7%，几乎达到企业完全掌握消费者真实风险时的效率基准。通过中央机构汇总信息有利于低风险消费者，并通过更高效的保险公司与投保人匹配，使每份合同平均成本降低12欧元。
10.1093/restud/rdag058.title: Competing under Information Heterogeneity: Evidence from Auto Insurance
10.1093/restud/rdag058.title_zh: 信息异质性下的竞争：来自汽车保险的证据

10.1093/restud/rdag059.abstract: We develop a general model of discrete choice that incorporates peer effects in preferences and consideration sets. We characterize the equilibrium behavior and establish conditions under which all parts of the model can be recovered from a sequence of choices. We allow peers to affect preferences, consideration, or both. We show that these peer-effect mechanisms have different behavioral implications in the data. This allows us to recover the set and the type of connections between the agents in the network. We then use this information to recover each agent’s preferences and consideration mechanisms. These nonparametric identification results allow for general forms of heterogeneity across agents and do not rely on the variation of either exogenous covariates or the set of available options (menus). We apply our results to model expansion decisions by tea chains and find evidence of limited consideration. We simulate counterfactual predictions and show how limited consideration slows market penetration and competition.
10.1093/restud/rdag059.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含偏好与考虑集同群效应的离散选择一般模型。我们刻画了均衡行为特征，并建立了可从选择序列中恢复模型所有组成部分的条件。我们允许同群效应影响偏好、考虑集或两者兼有。研究表明，这些同群效应机制在数据中具有不同的行为含义，从而能够识别网络中各主体之间的连接集合与类型。基于此信息，我们进一步恢复每个主体的偏好与考虑机制。这些非参数识别结果允许主体间存在一般形式的异质性，且不依赖于外生协变量或可选方案集（菜单）的变化。我们将模型应用于茶饮连锁店的扩张决策分析，发现了有限考虑的证据。通过反事实预测模拟，我们揭示了有限考虑如何减缓市场渗透与竞争。
10.1093/restud/rdag059.title: Peer Effects in Consideration and Preferences
10.1093/restud/rdag059.title_zh: 考虑与偏好中的同伴效应

10.1093/restud/rdag060.abstract: Business dynamism -- the process of firm entry, growth and exit -- lies at the heart of modern endogenous growth models. While productivity differences have traditionally been seen as the main driving forces of business dynamism, a growing body of evidence suggests that customer acquisition is at least as important. In light of this evidence, we propose a novel endogenous growth model in which innovating firms must first acquire customers to sell their products. Estimating our model with aggregate and firm-level data, we find that expansions of firms' customer bases (market sizes) boost their incentives to innovate and shift resources towards high-growth businesses (“gazelles”). Combined, these effects explain over 40% of aggregate growth and substantially change predictions about the efficacy of growth policies. Finally, we document support for key model predictions using firm-level micro-data.
10.1093/restud/rdag060.abstract_zh: 商业活力——企业进入、成长与退出的过程——是现代内生增长模型的核心。尽管生产率差异传统上被视为商业活力的主要驱动力，但越来越多的证据表明，客户获取至少同样重要。基于这一证据，我们提出了一种新颖的内生增长模型，其中创新企业必须首先获取客户才能销售其产品。通过使用总体数据和企业层面数据估计该模型，我们发现企业客户基础（市场规模）的扩张会增强其创新激励，并将资源转向高增长企业（“瞪羚企业”）。综合来看，这些效应解释了超过40%的总体增长，并显著改变了关于增长政策有效性的预测。最后，我们利用企业层面微观数据为模型的关键预测提供了支持证据。
10.1093/restud/rdag060.title: Customer Acquisition, Business Dynamism and Aggregate Growth
10.1093/restud/rdag060.title_zh: 客户获取、商业活力与总体增长

10.1093/restud/rdag061.abstract: We investigate how technologies that reduce the costs of monitoring by central authorities have shaped the historical transition from small patrimonial states to large bureaucratic organizations. Our analysis is based on a novel dataset that traces changes in the organizational structure and geographic presence of the U.S. federal government over the nineteenth century. To identify causal effects, we develop a new identification strategy that exploits the expansion of the railroad network as a source of variation in the travel time–and thus monitoring costs–between Washington D.C. and other locations. We present three main findings. First, reductions in travel time to Washington D.C. significantly increased the likelihood of federal government presence in a location. Second, this effect is stronger for occupations and tasks characterized by more severe agency problems. Third, decreases in travel time to Washington D.C. are associated with a decline in patrimonial features of the federal government in the location, in line with enhanced monitoring capacity reducing dependence on personal trust and connections.
10.1093/restud/rdag061.abstract_zh: 我们研究了中央机构降低监控成本的技术如何塑造了从小型世袭国家向大型官僚组织的历史转型。我们的分析基于一个新颖的数据集，该数据集追踪了19世纪美国联邦政府组织结构与地理分布的变化。为识别因果效应，我们开发了一种新的识别策略，利用铁路网络的扩张作为华盛顿特区与其他地点之间旅行时间（即监控成本）变化的来源。我们提出三项主要发现：第一，前往华盛顿特区旅行时间的缩短显著增加了联邦政府在某一地点设立机构的可能性；第二，这种效应在代理问题更严重的职业和任务中更为显著；第三，前往华盛顿特区旅行时间的减少与当地联邦政府世袭特征的减弱相关，这与监控能力增强减少了对个人信任和关系依赖的结论一致。
10.1093/restud/rdag061.title: State Capacity as an Organizational Problem
10.1093/restud/rdag061.title_zh: 组织能力作为一个组织问题

10.1093/restud/rdag062.abstract: We consider an oligopoly model in which each firm chooses not only its price but also its advertising strategy regarding how much, and what, product information to provide. To highlight firms' strategic incentives, we impose no structural restrictions on feasible advertising content, so that each firm can disclose or conceal any information. We obtain a comprehensive characterization of the equilibrium advertising strategy and provide some sufficient conditions for the existence of symmetric pure-price equilibria. We show that intense competition induces firms to provide accurate product information; firms usually obfuscate consumers' relatively low or high values; and requiring firms to provide more product information can reduce social surplus and also be harmful to consumers.
10.1093/restud/rdag062.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个寡头垄断模型，其中每个企业不仅选择其价格，还选择其广告策略，即提供多少以及何种产品信息。为突出企业的策略性激励，我们对可行的广告内容不施加任何结构性限制，因此每个企业可以披露或隐瞒任何信息。我们全面刻画了均衡广告策略的特征，并给出了对称纯价格均衡存在的一些充分条件。研究表明，激烈的竞争会促使企业提供准确的产品信息；企业通常会模糊消费者相对较低或较高的价值；而要求企业提供更多产品信息可能会减少社会剩余，并对消费者造成损害。
10.1093/restud/rdag062.title: Competitive Advertising and Pricing

10.1093/restud/rdag063.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the role of public risk-sharing in markets where firms face substantial cost uncertainty, focusing on public reinsurance in health insurance. We develop a model where insurers internalize cost uncertainty through risk charges that raise effective marginal costs, and create a role for reinsurance. Public reinsurance lowers both expected costs and cost volatility, particularly for smaller insurers, reducing prices and enhancing competition. Using an event study of staggered state-level reinsurance programs, we show that public reinsurance leads insurers to lower prices and private reinsurance purchases, benefiting financially constrained insurers the most. Structural estimates indicate that risk charges account for a substantial share of the premium-cost wedge, and highlight public reinsurance's comparative advantage over premium subsidies by providing risk protection and enhancing competition. Our results underscore the importance of accounting for firms’ risk exposure in policy design and provide a general framework for understanding public risk-sharing policies.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag063.abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业在面临巨大成本不确定性时，公共风险分担的作用，重点关注健康保险中的公共再保险。我们构建了一个模型，其中保险公司通过风险费用将成本不确定性内部化，这提高了有效边际成本，并为再保险创造了作用空间。公共再保险降低了预期成本和成本波动性，尤其对小型保险公司而言，从而降低了价格并增强了竞争。通过一项针对各州级再保险项目交错实施的事件研究，我们证明公共再保险促使保险公司降低价格和私人再保险购买量，其中财务受限的保险公司受益最大。结构估计表明，风险费用在保费与成本差额中占很大比重，并凸显了公共再保险相较于保费补贴的比较优势，因为它能提供风险保护并增强竞争。我们的研究结果强调了在政策设计中考虑企业风险暴露的重要性，并为理解公共风险分担政策提供了一个通用框架。
10.1093/restud/rdag063.title: Insurer Risk and Public Risk-Sharing: Quantifying the Value of Reinsurance
10.1093/restud/rdag063.title_zh: 保险公司风险与公共风险分担：再保险价值的量化

10.1093/restud/rdag064.abstract: In many markets, buyers make discrete choices between differentiated products and negotiate prices that are specific to the choice. We develop for estimation a model for this class of markets which is consistent with non-cooperative models of bargaining between a buyer and competing sellers. We show that when the buyer's utility has GEV disturbances, the model has a tractable likelihood function which can be used with transaction-level data giving the selected product and its price. We estimate the model using data from the UK brick industry and use it to measure market power and analyze mergers. We analyze how spatial differentiation and ownership concentration affect the distribution of market power across transactions. In counterfactuals we find that switching from individually-negotiated to uniform pricing causes markups, and merger price effects, to increase on average but to decrease for a minority of transactions.
10.1093/restud/rdag064.abstract_zh: 在许多市场中，买家在差异化产品之间进行离散选择，并协商与选择相关的特定价格。我们针对这类市场开发了一个用于估计的模型，该模型与买家与竞争卖家之间非合作议价模型保持一致。我们证明，当买家效用具有广义极值（GEV）扰动时，该模型具有易于处理的似然函数，可结合提供所选产品及其价格的交易层面数据进行使用。我们利用英国砖业行业的数据对该模型进行估计，并以此衡量市场势力及分析并购。我们研究了空间差异化和所有权集中度如何影响交易间市场势力的分布。在反事实分析中，我们发现从单独协商定价转向统一定价会导致平均加成率及并购价格效应上升，但少数交易的加成率及并购价格效应反而下降。
10.1093/restud/rdag064.title: Competition in a Spatially-Differentiated Product Market with Negotiated Prices
10.1093/restud/rdag064.title_zh: 谈判价格下的空间差异化产品市场竞争

10.1093/restud/rdag065.abstract: I develop a unified theoretical framework with schools and residential choices to study the welfare consequences of public schools’ switching from the traditional neighborhood assignment to the deferred acceptance mechanism. I find that when families receive higher priorities at neighborhood schools, the deferred acceptance mechanism creates higher aggregate or utilitarian welfare than neighborhood assignment. Under a common school ranking assumption, I also show that the deferred acceptance creates higher aggregate welfare with neighborhood priorities than without them.
10.1093/restud/rdag065.abstract_zh: 我构建了一个包含学校与居住选择的统一理论框架，用以研究公立学校从传统学区分配转向延迟接受机制所带来的福利影响。研究发现，当家庭在学区学校获得更高优先级时，延迟接受机制相较于学区分配能产生更高的总体或功利主义福利。在共同学校排名假设下，我还证明，相较于无学区优先级的情形，带有学区优先级的延迟接受机制能创造更高的总体福利。
10.1093/restud/rdag065.title: School Choice and the Housing Market

10.1093/restud/rdag066.abstract: We study empirically and theoretically the effects of international financial flows on resource allocation. Using the universe of firms in Hungary, we show that removing capital controls lowers firms’ cost of capital and increases household consumption, with the latter playing a dominant role. The consumption channel leads to reallocation of resources toward high expenditure elasticity activities – such as services – promoting both the expansion of incumbents and firm entry. A multi-sector heterogeneous firm model replicates these dynamics. Our model shows that non-homotheticity in consumption can quantitatively account for the reallocation of resources towards services and successfully replicates the dynamics of aggregate productivity following episodes of financial openness.
10.1093/restud/rdag066.abstract_zh: 我们通过实证与理论研究国际金融流动对资源配置的影响。利用匈牙利全部企业数据，我们发现取消资本管制降低了企业的资本成本并增加了家庭消费，其中消费渠道起主导作用。消费渠道导致资源向高支出弹性活动（如服务业）重新配置，既促进了现有企业的扩张，也推动了新企业进入。一个多部门异质性企业模型复现了这些动态变化。我们的模型表明，消费中的非位似性能够从数量上解释资源向服务业重新配置的现象，并成功复现了金融开放后全要素生产率的动态变化。
10.1093/restud/rdag066.title: The Micro and Macro Dynamics of Capital Flows
10.1093/restud/rdag066.title_zh: 资本流动的微观与宏观动态

10.1093/restud/rdag067.abstract: We explore the power that precise information about consumers’ preferences grants an intermediary in shaping competition. We think of an intermediary as an information designer who chooses what information to reveal to firms, which then compete à la Bertrand in a differentiated product market. We analyze the information designs that maximize consumer and producer surplus and uncover systematic differences in how information can be used to intensify or soften competition. Our analysis demonstrates the power that users’ data can endow intermediaries with and speaks directly to current regulatory debates regarding digital marketplaces.
10.1093/restud/rdag067.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了关于消费者偏好的精确信息赋予中间商在塑造竞争中的力量。我们将中间商视为信息设计者，由其选择向企业披露何种信息，随后企业在差异化产品市场中展开伯特兰式竞争。我们分析了最大化消费者剩余和生产者剩余的信息设计，揭示了信息在强化或缓和竞争方面可被系统性运用的差异。我们的分析表明，用户数据能够赋予中间商巨大力量，并直接回应了当前关于数字市场的监管辩论。
10.1093/restud/rdag067.title: Market Segmentation through Information
10.1093/restud/rdag067.title_zh: 基于信息分割的市场细分

10.1093/restud/rdag068.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>I propose a model of skill-replacing routine-biased technological change (SR-RBTC). In this model, technology substitutes for the use of skill in routine tasks, in contrast to standard RBTC models, which assume that technology replaces the workers themselves. The SR-RBTC model explains three key trends that are inconsistent with standard RBTC models: 1) why specifically middle wages declined even though workers in routine occupations are dispersed across the entire bottom half of the wage distribution, 2) why middle wages stopped declining while technological change continued, and 3) why there is no substantial decline in the average wage of workers in routine occupations. I derive two new testable predictions from the model: a decrease in the return to skill and a decrease in skill level in routine occupations. I use an interactive fixed-effects model to confirm both predictions. Since SR-RBTC violates the ignorability assumption required by standard decomposition methods, I introduce a “skewness decomposition” to show that SR-RBTC is the main driver of bottom-half inequality trends.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag068.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文提出一个技能替代型常规偏向技术变革（SR-RBTC）模型。在该模型中，技术替代了常规任务中的技能使用，这与标准RBTC模型（假设技术替代工人本身）形成对比。SR-RBTC模型解释了与标准RBTC模型不一致的三个关键趋势：1）尽管常规职业的工人分散于工资分布整个下半部分，但为何中位数工资出现下降；2）为何在技术持续变革的背景下，中位数工资停止下降；3）为何常规职业工人的平均工资未出现显著下降。基于该模型，我推导出两个可检验的新预测：常规职业的技能回报率下降以及技能水平下降。通过交互固定效应模型，这两个预测均得到验证。由于SR-RBTC违背了标准分解方法所需的可忽略性假设，我引入“偏度分解”方法，证明SR-RBTC是下半部分工资不平等趋势的主要驱动因素。
10.1093/restud/rdag068.title: Skill-Replacing Technology and Bottom-Half Inequality
10.1093/restud/rdag068.title_zh: 技能替代型技术与底层收入不平等

10.1093/restud/rdag070.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We introduce a survey instrument to measure earnings risk allowing for the possibility of quitting or being fired from the current job. We find these transitions to be the key drivers of subjective risk. A link with administrative data provides multiple credibility checks and reveals that subjective earnings risk varies systematically across the population. It is also many times smaller than traditional estimates even when conditioning richly on demographics and job history. We show that subjective earnings risk can help explain why many hold limited liquid assets.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag070.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>我们引入了一种调查工具，用于衡量允许当前工作辞职或被解雇可能性的收入风险。我们发现，这些工作转换是主观风险的关键驱动因素。通过与行政数据的关联，我们进行了多项可信度检验，并揭示出主观收入风险在人群中存在系统性差异。即使在对人口统计特征和工作历史进行丰富条件控制后，主观收入风险仍远小于传统估计值。我们证明，主观收入风险有助于解释为何许多人持有有限的流动资产。</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag070.title: Subjective Earnings Risk

10.1093/restud/rdag071.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper studies the impact of income-based criminal punishments on crime. In Finland, speeding tickets become income-dependent if the driver’s speed exceeds the speeding limit by more than 20 km/h, leading to a substantial jump in the size of the speeding ticket. Contrary to predictions of a traditional Becker model, individuals do not bunch below the fine hike. Instead, the speeding distributions are smooth at the cutoff. However, I demonstrate that the size of the realized speeding ticket has sizable, but short-lived, impacts on reoffending. I use a regression discontinuity design to show that fines that are, on average, 200 euros larger decrease reoffending by 15 percent in the following six months. The drop in reoffending is driven by high-income individuals facing the highest fine at the cutoff. I estimate that a fixed fine hike that matches the current deterrence effect would raise the fine increase faced by the bottom income quartile by about 300% at the cutoff, relative to the increase they face under the current income-based schedule. My empirical results are consistent with an explanation that people operate under information frictions. To illustrate this, I construct a Becker model with misperception and learning that can explain all the empirical findings.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag071.abstract_zh: 本文研究了基于收入的刑事处罚对犯罪的影响。在芬兰，当驾驶员超速超过限速20公里/小时以上时，罚单金额与收入挂钩，导致罚款数额大幅跃升。与传统贝克尔模型的预测相反，个体并未在罚款激增点以下聚集，超速分布在该临界点处平滑。然而，本文证明实际罚单金额对再犯行为具有显著但短暂的影响。利用断点回归设计，本文发现平均高出200欧元的罚款使随后六个月的再犯率降低15%。再犯率的下降主要由临界点处面临最高罚款的高收入群体驱动。本文估算，若采用固定罚款增幅以匹配当前威慑效果，则相对于现行基于收入的罚款方案，底层收入四分位群体在临界点面临的罚款增幅将提高约300%。实证结果与个体存在信息摩擦的解释一致。为阐明这一点，本文构建了包含认知偏差与学习机制的贝克尔模型，该模型能够解释所有实证发现。
10.1093/restud/rdag071.title: How Do People React to Income-Based Fines? Evidence from Speeding Tickets Discontinuities
10.1093/restud/rdag071.title_zh: 人们如何应对基于收入的罚款？来自超速罚单断点回归的证据

10.1093/restud/rdag072.abstract: University access has significantly expanded in OECD countries, and further growth figures prominently in political agendas. We study possible consequences of historical and future expansions in a stochastic, general equilibrium Roy model where tertiary educational attainment is determined by cognitive ability and socioeconomic disadvantage. In our analysis, individual productivity depends not only on education but also directly on cognitive ability. The expansion of university access in the U.K. that started in the 1960s provides an ideal case study to draw lessons for the future. We find that this expansion led to the selection into college of progressively less talented students from advantaged backgrounds. Appropriate counterfactual policies existed that would have achieved the dual goal of increasing college graduates’ cognitive ability while improving tertiary education opportunities for the disadvantaged.
10.1093/restud/rdag072.abstract_zh: 在OECD国家，大学入学机会已显著扩大，且进一步增长在政治议程中占据突出位置。我们研究历史和未来扩张在随机、一般均衡罗伊模型中的可能后果，其中高等教育成就由认知能力和社会经济劣势决定。在我们的分析中，个体生产力不仅取决于教育，还直接取决于认知能力。英国自20世纪60年代开始的大学入学扩张为未来提供了理想案例研究。我们发现，这一扩张导致来自优势背景的学生中，能力逐渐较低者被选拔进入大学。存在适当的反事实政策，本可实现增加大学毕业生认知能力与改善弱势群体高等教育机会的双重目标。
10.1093/restud/rdag072.title: College, Cognitive Ability, and Socioeconomic Disadvantage: Policy Lessons from the U.K. in 1960–2004
10.1093/restud/rdag072.title_zh: 大学、认知能力与社会经济劣势：1960—2004年英国的政策启示

10.1093/restud/rdag073.abstract: This paper studies a multi-product monopolist facing a privately informed consumer with additive and type-increasing valuations. Separate monopoly pricing is robustly optimal with respect to the type distribution if and only if the marginal rate of substitution between each pair of goods is monotone. This result is obtained by extending the conventional Myersonian approach.
10.1093/restud/rdag073.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个面临具有加性且类型递增估值的知情消费者的多产品垄断者。当且仅当每对商品之间的边际替代率是单调的时，分离垄断定价对类型分布具有稳健最优性。这一结果是通过扩展传统的迈尔森方法得出的。
10.1093/restud/rdag073.title: When is Separate Sales Optimal?
10.1093/restud/rdag073.title_zh: 何时单独销售是最优的？

10.1093/restud/rdag074.abstract: In a data economy, transactions of goods and services generate data, which is stored, traded and depreciates. How are the economics of this economy different from traditional production economies? How do these differences matter for measurement of GDP, firm values, depreciation rates, welfare and externalities? We incorporate active experimentation and data as an intangible asset to devise a tractable recursive representation of the data economy. The model rationalizes why apps are often “free” and why even non-digital economic activity might be greater than GDP suggests. Calibrating the model using a combination of macroeconomic and financial moments suggests that the mis-measurement in U.S. GDP due to missing value of data has been as high as 6% in 2018.
10.1093/restud/rdag074.abstract_zh: 在数据经济中，商品和服务的交易会产生数据，这些数据被存储、交易并发生折旧。这种经济体的经济学特征与传统生产经济体有何不同？这些差异如何影响GDP、企业价值、折旧率、福利和外部性的衡量？我们通过引入主动实验和将数据视为无形资产，构建了一个可处理的数据经济递归表示模型。该模型解释了为何应用程序通常“免费”，以及为何即使非数字经济活动也可能大于GDP所显示的水平。结合宏观经济和金融数据的校准结果表明，2018年因数据价值缺失导致的美国GDP测量误差高达6%。
10.1093/restud/rdag074.title: A Model of the Data Economy

10.1093/restud/rdag075.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study structural change in production networks for intermediate inputs (inputoutput network) and new capital (investment network). For each network, we document that the share of output produced by services (relative to goods) is rising over time. While the relative prices of services that produce intermediates and consumption are rising, we find that the relative price of services that produce investment is falling over time. We then develop a multi-sector growth model to study these trends and their implications for economic growth. To match the relative price trends, inputs to intermediates production are complements and inputs to investment production are substitutes. Hence, structural change endogenously reallocates resources to the slowest growing intermediates producers and the fastest growing investment producers. Growth accounting exercises reveal that investment-specific technical change accounts for an increasing share of U.S. aggregate growth, with 20% of aggregate growth since 2000 due to investment structural change. Growth projections from our model show that structural change within investment networks alone can offset stagnating or declining growth in other sectors due to Baumol’s cost disease.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag075.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文研究了中间投入品生产网络（投入产出网络）与新资本生产网络（投资网络）中的结构变迁。针对每个网络，我们记录到服务业（相对于商品）的产出份额随时间推移而上升。尽管生产中间品和消费品的服务业相对价格在上升，但我们发现生产投资品的服务业相对价格却在下降。随后，我们构建了一个多部门增长模型来研究这些趋势及其对经济增长的影响。为匹配相对价格趋势，中间品生产的投入要素具有互补性，而投资品生产的投入要素具有替代性。因此，结构变迁内生地将资源重新配置给增长最慢的中间品生产部门与增长最快的投资品生产部门。增长核算分析表明，投资专用型技术变革在美国总体增长中的占比持续上升，自2000年以来总体增长的20%归因于投资结构变迁。模型增长预测显示，仅投资网络内部的结构变迁即可抵消因鲍莫尔成本病导致的其他部门增长停滞或下降的影响。
10.1093/restud/rdag075.title: Structural Change in Production Networks and Economic Growth
10.1093/restud/rdag075.title_zh: 生产网络中的结构变化与经济增长

10.1093/restud/rdag076.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We conduct an experimental analysis of selective disclosure in communication. In the model, an informed sender aims to influence a receiver by disclosing verifiable evidence that is selected from a larger pool of available evidence. Our experimental design leverages this model’s rich comparative statics, allowing us to systematically quantify the effects of selection relative to concealment. Our findings confirm the key qualitative predictions of the theory, suggesting that selection, rather than concealment, is often the dominant distortion in communication. We also identify deviations from the theory: Some senders are “deception averse” and overcommunicate relative to predictions; receivers respond too optimistically to both concealed and selected evidence, with errors of similar magnitude. Yet selection generates greater overall distortion in receiver behavior because it is far more prevalent than concealment.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag076.abstract_zh: 我们针对沟通中的选择性披露进行了实验分析。在该模型中，掌握信息的发送者旨在通过披露从更大可用证据池中筛选出的可验证证据来影响接收者。我们的实验设计利用了该模型丰富的比较静态分析特性，从而能够系统量化选择相对于隐瞒的影响。研究结果证实了理论的关键定性预测，表明在沟通中，选择而非隐瞒往往是主导性扭曲。同时，我们也发现了与理论的偏离：部分发送者存在“欺骗厌恶”倾向，其沟通程度高于理论预测；接收者对隐瞒和选择证据的反应均过于乐观，且误差幅度相近。然而，由于选择比隐瞒更为普遍，它在接收者行为中造成了更大的整体扭曲。
10.1093/restud/rdag076.title: The Selective Disclosure of Evidence: An Experiment
10.1093/restud/rdag076.title_zh: 证据的选择性披露：一项实验

10.1093/restud/rdag077.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We show that the formalization of representativeness (Kahneman and Tversky (1972)) developed by Gennaioli and Shleifer (2010) features an intrinsic connection between uncertainty and overreaction. In the time series domain, we develop this connection in a smooth version of Diagnostic Expectations (DE), where overreaction varies smoothly with uncertainty. Intuitively, under smoothness, lower uncertainty leaves less room for representativeness to distort beliefs. Smooth DE provides a joint, parsimonious micro-foundation for key features of survey data: overreaction to news, stronger overreaction at longer horizons, overconfidence in subjective uncertainty, and a new stylized fact documented here—overreaction intensifies with higher uncertainty. An analytical Real Business Cycle model with Smooth DE accounts for survey overreaction and overconfidence, as well as three salient business cycle properties: asymmetry, countercyclical macro volatility, and countercyclical micro volatility.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag077.abstract_zh: 我们证明，由Gennaioli和Shleifer（2010）发展的代表性启发式形式化（Kahneman和Tversky（1972））具有不确定性与过度反应之间的内在联系。在时间序列领域，我们通过平滑版本的诊断预期（DE）来发展这一联系，其中过度反应随不确定性平滑变化。直观而言，在平滑条件下，较低的不确定性为代表性启发式扭曲信念留下了更少空间。平滑DE为调查数据的关键特征提供了简洁统一的微观基础：对新闻的过度反应、更长预测期限下更强的过度反应、主观不确定性中的过度自信，以及本文记录的新典型事实——过度反应随不确定性升高而加剧。基于平滑DE的分析性真实商业周期模型不仅解释了调查中的过度反应与过度自信，还解释了三个显著的商业周期特征：非对称性、逆周期的宏观波动性以及逆周期的微观波动性。
10.1093/restud/rdag077.title: Smooth Diagnostic Expectations

10.1093/restud/rdag078.abstract: We study the impact of large, successful manufacturing plants on other local producers in China, focusing on “Million-Rouble Plants” built in the 1950s during a brief alliance with the U.S.S.R. The ephemeral geopolitical situation and the locations of allied and enemy airbases provide exogenous variation in plant siting. We find a boom-and-bust pattern: Counties hosting these plants were 80% more productive than control counties in 1982 but 20% less productive by 2010. This decline reflects the performance of local establishments, which exhibit low productivity, limited innovation, and high markup. Specialization hindered spillovers, preventing the emergence of new clusters and local entrepreneurship.
10.1093/restud/rdag078.abstract_zh: 本文研究了中国大型成功制造工厂对其他本地生产者的影响，重点关注20世纪50年代中苏短暂联盟期间建设的“百万卢布工厂”。短暂的地缘政治局势以及盟军与敌军空军基地的位置，为工厂选址提供了外生变化。我们发现了一种“繁荣-萧条”模式：1982年，拥有这些工厂的县的生产率比对照组县高出80%，但到2010年却低了20%。这一下降反映了本地企业的表现，这些企业呈现出低生产率、有限创新和高加价的特点。专业化阻碍了溢出效应，阻止了新集群的形成和本地创业精神的发展。
10.1093/restud/rdag078.title: Large Industrial Clusters in the Long Run: Evidence from Million-Rouble Plants in China
10.1093/restud/rdag078.title_zh: 长期视角下的大型产业集群：来自中国百万卢布工厂的证据

10.1093/restud/rdag079.abstract: Racial covenants in housing deeds were widely used in the United States during the early 20th century to segregate neighborhoods. In 1948, the Supreme Court decision in Shelley v. Kraemer made racial covenants unenforceable in court, stopping short of prohibiting them entirely. We surmise that even after losing their judicial enforceability, such covenants could have shaped segregation if they served as a focal point for coordination on an initial equilibrium in neighborhood formation, a context characterized by investment durability and path dependency. To test this hypothesis, we assemble novel parcel-level data on racial covenants and develop a quasi-experimental design that exploits delays between covenant execution and housing construction to isolate exposure to enforceable covenants at the time neighborhoods were built. Covenant enforceability indeed affected early-stage neighborhood formation in terms of housing characteristics, public infrastructure placement, and the composition of initial residents. These early differences proved durable: Enforceable covenants account for 6–24% of the observed neighborhood racial segregation from 1980 to 2020 and 3.1–4.4% of housing price differentials in the 21st century. We conclude that by coordinating beliefs and decisions during neighborhood formation, the law generated spatial inequality that has long outlived racial covenants themselves.
10.1093/restud/rdag079.abstract_zh: 20世纪初，美国住房契约中的种族限制条款被广泛用于实施社区隔离。1948年，最高法院在谢利诉克雷默案中裁定此类条款在法庭上不可强制执行，但并未完全禁止其存在。我们推测，即便失去司法强制力，这些条款仍可能通过充当社区形成初期均衡协调的焦点机制（在投资耐久性与路径依赖特征显著的背景下）影响种族隔离格局。为验证这一假说，我们构建了包含种族限制条款的新型宗地级数据集，并利用条款执行与住房建设之间的时间差设计准实验框架，以识别社区建设时期可执行条款的暴露程度。研究发现，条款的可执行性确实影响了社区形成初期的住房特征、公共基础设施布局及首批居民构成。这些早期差异展现出持久性：可执行条款可解释1980-2020年间观测到的社区种族隔离现象的6-24%，以及21世纪房价差异的3.1-4.4%。我们得出结论：法律通过协调社区形成过程中的信念与决策，催生了远超种族限制条款存续期的空间不平等。
10.1093/restud/rdag079.title: The Long Shadow of Housing Discrimination: Evidence from Racial Covenants
10.1093/restud/rdag079.title_zh: 住房歧视的长期阴影：来自种族契约的证据

10.1093/restud/rdag098.abstract: In this paper, I document systematic heterogeneity in ownership and financing of firms across Eurozone countries. To rationalize these differences, I build a quantitative general equilibrium model of workers and entrepreneurs who choose debt and equity financing of their firms, subject to rich country-specific financial frictions. The novel data on firm ownership and financing, combined with the structure of the model, allows me to quantify the level of debt and equity frictions in each country. Quantitatively, I find much larger output effects from equity frictions: harmonizing them across countries would lead to nearly four times larger output effects compared to debt frictions, and removing them would increase aggregate output by 73\% more. The larger impact on output is due not only to the estimated levels and dispersion of equity frictions but also to the greater risk sharing provided by equity, which further incentivizes entrepreneurs to expand their firms. Through their effect on risk sharing, equity frictions also rationalize the observed negative relationship between equity financing and wealth inequality. Quantitatively, they are responsible for over 70\% of the explained variation in top wealth shares across countries.
10.1093/restud/rdag098.abstract_zh: 本文记录了欧元区各国企业在所有权与融资结构上的系统性差异。为解释这些差异，我构建了一个包含工人与企业家的定量一般均衡模型，其中企业家在面临各国特有的金融摩擦条件下，选择债务与股权融资方式。结合关于企业所有权与融资的新颖数据及模型结构，我得以量化各国债务与股权摩擦的程度。定量分析显示，股权摩擦对产出的影响远大于债务摩擦：若各国统一股权摩擦水平，其产出效应将是统一债务摩擦时的近四倍；而完全消除股权摩擦，则可使总产出额外增加73%。股权摩擦对产出的更大影响，不仅源于其估计水平与各国间的离散程度，还在于股权提供的更优风险分担机制，这进一步激励企业家扩大企业规模。通过影响风险分担，股权摩擦还能解释所观察到的股权融资与财富不平等之间的负相关关系。定量上，股权摩擦可解释各国顶层财富份额差异中超过70%的变动。

10.1093/rfs/hhaf079.abstract: We examine how macroeconomic expectations affect consumer decisions, using an experiment with 2,872 credit card customers at a large commercial bank. In the experiment, participants are randomized into receiving expert forecasts of inflation and the nominal exchange rate. We find that forecasts shift inflation and exchange rate expectations, but do not change spending or self-reported consumption plans as predicted by standard models of intertemporal choice. Results from a supplementary survey experiment suggest that consumers are sophisticated enough to anticipate nominal rigidities and reduce spending on durables for precautionary reasons, counteracting the effects predicted by standard models of intertemporal optimization.
10.1093/rfs/hhaf079.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项涉及某大型商业银行2872名信用卡客户的实验，考察宏观经济预期如何影响消费者决策。实验中，参与者被随机分配接收专家对通胀率和名义汇率的预测。研究发现，预测信息会改变通胀率和汇率预期，但并未如标准跨期选择模型所预测的那样改变支出或自我报告的消费计划。一项补充调查实验的结果表明，消费者足够成熟，能够预见到名义刚性，并出于预防性动机减少耐用品支出，从而抵消了标准跨期优化模型所预测的影响。
10.1093/rfs/hhaf079.title: Macroeconomic Expectations and Credit Card Spending
10.1093/rfs/hhaf079.title_zh: 宏观经济预期与信用卡支出

10.1093/rfs/hhag013.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>A core responsibility of the Federal Reserve is to ensure financial stability by acting as the lender of last resort through its Discount Window (DW). The DW, however, has not been effective because its usage is stigmatized. In this paper, we use theory and experiments to study how such stigma can be cured. We find that behavioral inertia makes it difficult to fix a stigmatized DW, but adding a new backstop facility can help mitigate stigma. These results are consistent with the Federal Reserve’s experience. (JEL E58, G01, C92)</jats:p>
10.1093/rfs/hhag013.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>美联储的核心职责之一是通过贴现窗口（DW）履行最后贷款人职能，以维护金融稳定。然而，由于使用贴现窗口存在污名化问题，其实际效果并不理想。本文通过理论分析与实验研究，探讨如何消除此类污名化现象。研究发现，行为惯性使得修复污名化的贴现窗口面临困难，但增设新的后备融资工具有助于缓解污名化问题。这一结论与美联储的实际经验相吻合。（JEL分类号：E58, G01, C92）</jats:p>
10.1093/rfs/hhag013.title: Can Discount Window Stigma Be Cured? An Experimental Investigation
10.1093/rfs/hhag013.title_zh: 贴现窗口污名能被消除吗？一项实验研究

10.1093/rfs/hhag020.abstract: We examine the informativeness of fund risk disclosure by combining fund returns and textual data. We develop a novel measure, INF, to capture the explanatory power of disclosed risks for fund returns. Average INF is 55% after controlling for market risk and remains 26–29% after excluding risks related to fund name or strategy. We explain variations in INF through disclosure costs and benefits: (1) Funds with less informative disclosures face SEC comment letters and reduced flow, (2) informative disclosures attract institutional flows, and (3) performance concerns may disincentivize disclosure. Overall, funds face trade-offs between transparency and maintaining their competitive advantage. (JEL G12)
10.1093/rfs/hhag020.abstract_zh: 我们通过结合基金收益与文本数据，考察了基金风险披露的信息含量。我们构建了一个新颖的指标INF，用以衡量已披露风险对基金收益的解释力。在控制市场风险后，平均INF为55%；在剔除与基金名称或策略相关的风险后，该指标仍保持在26%至29%之间。我们通过披露成本与收益来解释INF的差异：（1）信息披露含量较低的基金会收到美国证券交易委员会的意见函，并面临资金流入减少；（2）信息含量高的披露能吸引机构资金流入；（3）业绩担忧可能抑制披露意愿。总体而言，基金在透明度与维持竞争优势之间面临权衡。（JEL G12）
10.1093/rfs/hhag020.title: Do Mutual Funds Walk the Talk? Evidence from Fund Risk Disclosure
10.1093/rfs/hhag020.title_zh: 共同基金是否言行一致？来自基金风险披露的证据

10.1093/rfs/hhag021.abstract: This study examines whether mutual fund managers generate alpha through thematic investment strategies that select stocks poised to benefit from specific themes.
