10.1111/1467-8489.70135.abstract: Poverty alleviation relocation is an important component of China's anti‐poverty strategy and has reshaped relocated households' living conditions and social integration. Using the Poverty Alleviation Relocation Programme (PARP) as a quasi‐natural experiment, this study examines the impact of relocation on households' social status based on four‐wave panel data from 1351 households. The results show that relocation significantly improves subjective social status, whereas its effect on objective social status is insignificant. The positive effect is more pronounced among young adults aged 18–44, elderly individuals aged 60 and above, households with lower educational attainment, and those resettled in rural areas. Mechanism analysis suggests that social network expansion and improved life satisfaction are important channels through which relocation enhances perceived social standing. The findings also reveal a significant increase in conspicuous consumption after relocation, suggesting stronger aspirations for upward mobility among relocated households. By extending the analysis from material welfare to the social dimensions of relocation, this study provides new evidence on the social consequences of poverty alleviation relocation and offers implications for subsequent support policies.
10.1111/1467-8489.70135.abstract_zh: 易地扶贫搬迁是中国反贫困战略的重要组成部分，重塑了搬迁家庭的生活条件与社会融合。本研究以易地扶贫搬迁项目作为准自然实验，基于1351户家庭的四轮面板数据，考察了搬迁对家庭社会地位的影响。结果表明，搬迁显著提升了主观社会地位，而对客观社会地位的影响则不显著。这一积极效应在18至44岁的青年群体、60岁及以上的老年群体、受教育程度较低的家庭以及迁入农村地区的家庭中更为明显。机制分析表明，社交网络扩展和生活满意度提升是搬迁增强感知社会地位的重要渠道。研究结果还显示，搬迁后炫耀性消费显著增加，表明搬迁家庭具有更强的向上流动意愿。通过将分析从物质福利延伸至搬迁的社会维度，本研究为易地扶贫搬迁的社会后果提供了新的证据，并对后续支持政策具有启示意义。
10.1111/1467-8489.70135.title: Where the Heart Finds Peace, There Is My Home: Changes in Social Status in the Poverty Alleviation Relocation Programme
10.1111/1467-8489.70135.title_zh: 心安之处即是家：易地扶贫搬迁中的社会地位变迁

10.1111/1467-8489.70136.abstract: Rapid growth in digital finance has expanded credit access for rural smallholders, yet financial capability has not kept pace with access. Where fee structures are opaque and search is costly, this gap raises the risk of expensive borrowing in digital financial services. This paper assesses whether a video‐based financial knowledge intervention affects stated willingness to pay for digital credit. Using contingent valuation with a payment card approach, we measure willingness to pay before and after information provision among 694 smallholder households in Meru County, Kenya. Our results show that the video intervention reduced the monthly interest rate that smallholders are willing to pay by 1.4 percentage points. This finding suggests that the intervention increased sensitivity to borrowing costs and reduced stated tolerance for higher‐priced digital credit. It also provides policy‐relevant evidence that brief, targeted video prompts can complement consumer‐protection measures by shifting stated credit choices toward lower interest‐rate categories.
10.1111/1467-8489.70136.abstract_zh: 数字金融的快速发展扩大了农村小农户的信贷获取渠道，但金融能力并未跟上信贷可及性的提升。在费用结构不透明且搜寻成本高昂的情况下，这一差距加剧了数字金融服务中高成本借贷的风险。本文评估了基于视频的金融知识干预是否会影响农户对数字信贷的陈述意愿支付价格。我们采用支付卡法的条件价值评估法，对肯尼亚梅鲁县694户小农户在信息干预前后的支付意愿进行测度。研究结果显示，视频干预使小农户愿意支付的月利率降低了1.4个百分点。这一发现表明，该干预措施提高了农户对借贷成本的敏感度，并降低了其对高息数字信贷的陈述容忍度。同时，该研究提供了具有政策参考价值的证据：简短且有针对性的视频提示能够通过引导陈述信贷选择向低利率类别转移，从而补充消费者保护措施。
10.1111/1467-8489.70136.title: Financial Literacy Intervention and the Willingness to Pay for Digital Credits: A Scalable Video‐Based Approach in Kenya
10.1111/1467-8489.70136.title_zh: 金融素养干预与数字信贷支付意愿：肯尼亚一项可扩展的视频干预方法

10.1111/1467-8489.70137.abstract_zh: 《捷径需求弹性及其他便捷的消费者需求方法》一书将吸引应用经济学家、政策分析师及咨询顾问。作者团队在本书所涉主题上具备卓越的专业优势。肯尼斯·W·克莱门茨教授拥有超过40年的消费者需求研究经验。伊利亚坦比·A·塞尔瓦纳森教授和萨罗贾·塞尔瓦纳森教授，以及刘海燕博士，同样在需求分析和应用计量经济学领域积累了多年的专注研究。此外，乔治·维里基奥斯博士和马克·吉姆·M·马里亚诺博士是可计算一般均衡（CGE）建模领域经验丰富的经济学家，曾承担众多咨询项目。本书汇集了作者及其合作者数十年的协作研究成果，并在一个统一框架内呈现，该框架兼顾经济理论、实证有效性与实际应用性。

10.1111/1467-8489.70138.abstract: ABSTRACT This special issue examines the economics of greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation in agriculture. The papers in the issue study agricultural mitigation from three broad perspectives: the design of mitigation incentives, the economic benefits of mitigation practices and programmes, and the adoption and behavioural responses by producers, consumers and other stakeholders. The papers span a wide range of countries, production systems and policy contexts, and collectively show that translating mitigation potential into mitigation outcomes depends critically on incentive design, measurement and the actions across producers, consumers, regulators and supply‐chain actors.
10.1111/1467-8489.70138.abstract_zh: 摘要 本期特刊探讨农业领域温室气体减排的经济学问题。所收录论文从三大视角研究农业减排：减排激励机制设计、减排实践与项目的经济效益，以及生产者、消费者及其他利益相关方的采纳行为与响应。这些研究覆盖多个国家、生产体系及政策背景，共同表明：将减排潜力转化为实际减排成效，关键取决于激励机制设计、核算方法，以及生产者、消费者、监管机构和供应链参与者的协同行动。

10.1111/1467-8489.70139.abstract: The objective of our study is to examine how migrant labour shifts due to the COVID‐19 pandemic influenced the adaptation behaviour of climate‐vulnerable farmers in Nepal. We examine how the resulting temporary change in climate change adaptation behaviour may be sustainable and improved after migrant labour returns to overseas employment by examining the relationship of institutional factors on climate change adaptation practices. A case study is presented using survey data collected from farmers in the Sunsari district of the eastern plains (Terai) region of Nepal during June 2022. Foreign‐employed migrants were found to have a positive relationship with the adoption of climate change adaptation practices. The finding implies that the presence of migrant household members (younger and more educated) is likely to encourage farmers to adopt more climate change adaptation practices. We further find that improving farmers' access to extension programmes, subsidies and the internet can be potentially used to sustain climate change adaptation practices in the post‐pandemic future. We demonstrate this by estimating the number of climate change adaptation practices by increasing farmers' access to extension programmes and subsidies under post‐pandemic labour scenarios. These estimates provide local policymakers tools to potentially improve accessibility to extension programmes or government subsidies that are likely to enhance farmers' climate change adaptation practices.
10.1111/1467-8489.70139.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨COVID-19疫情导致的移民劳动力变化如何影响尼泊尔气候脆弱农户的适应行为。通过考察制度因素与气候变化适应实践之间的关系，我们分析了移民劳动力暂时性变化所导致的气候变化适应行为调整，在移民劳动力重返海外就业后是否具有可持续性并得以改善。本研究以2022年6月从尼泊尔东部平原（特莱）地区孙萨里县农户收集的调查数据为案例。研究发现，国外就业移民与气候变化适应实践的采纳呈正相关关系。这一发现表明，拥有海外务工家庭成员（较年轻且受教育程度较高）的农户更有可能采纳更多气候变化适应实践。进一步研究发现，改善农户获取推广项目、补贴和互联网的渠道，有望在疫情后时期维持气候变化适应实践。我们通过估算在疫情后劳动力情景下，增加农户获取推广项目和补贴渠道所带来的气候变化适应实践数量来验证这一结论。这些估算为地方政策制定者提供了工具，以改善推广项目或政府补贴的可及性，从而可能增强农户的气候变化适应实践。
10.1111/1467-8489.70139.title:
Do Shifts in Migrant Labour due to
                    <scp>COVID</scp>
                    ‐19 Affect Climate Change Adaptation Practices of Climate‐Vulnerable Farmers? Implications for the Post‐Pandemic Future
10.1111/1467-8489.70139.title_zh: 新冠疫情导致的移民劳工变动是否影响气候脆弱农户的气候变化适应实践？对后疫情时代的启示

10.1111/1467-8489.70140.abstract: Improving diet quality remains a key challenge in post‐poverty rural China. This study examines how women's community participation, a form of public‐sphere agency, relates to household diet quality. We introduce a Food‐Weighted Dietary Diversity Index (FWDDI) that captures variation in diet quality beyond adequacy thresholds in broadly adequate settings and apply it to a three‐wave household panel. Fixed‐effects estimates show a positive association between women's community participation and household diet quality. This association is reflected in broader and more nutrient‐dense diets, with little change in consumption frequency, and in the corresponding pattern in women's intrahousehold decision‐making, consistent with information diffusion and women's decision influence as plausible pathways. This association is concentrated in women's participation in economic activities, among ever‐registered‐poor households and in villages with male agricultural wage premiums. These findings point to women's public engagement, especially in economic activities, as a potential channel for improving household diet quality, particularly where household resource constraints are tighter and women are at a wage disadvantage in local labour markets.
10.1111/1467-8489.70140.abstract_zh: 改善饮食质量仍是后贫困时代中国农村面临的关键挑战。本研究探讨女性社区参与——一种公共领域能动性形式——如何与家庭饮食质量相关联。我们引入了一个食物加权膳食多样性指数（FWDDI），该指数能够捕捉在总体充足情境下超越充足阈值的饮食质量差异，并将其应用于三轮家庭面板数据。固定效应估计显示，女性社区参与与家庭饮食质量之间存在正向关联。这一关联体现在更广泛且营养密度更高的饮食结构中，而消费频率变化甚微，同时与女性家庭内部决策权的相应模式相吻合，这与信息扩散和女性决策影响力作为合理的作用路径相一致。该关联集中于女性参与经济活动的情形，在曾登记贫困家庭以及存在男性农业工资溢价的村庄中尤为显著。这些发现表明，女性公共参与，尤其是经济活动的参与，是改善家庭饮食质量的潜在渠道，特别是在家庭资源约束更为紧张且女性在当地劳动力市场中处于工资劣势的情况下。
10.1111/1467-8489.70140.title: Beyond the Private Sphere: Women's Community Participation and Household Diet Quality in Rural China
10.1111/1467-8489.70140.title_zh: 超越私人领域：中国农村女性社区参与与家庭膳食质量

10.1111/1467-8489.70141.abstract: Excessive water use in rice production is a major source of methane emissions, the dominant greenhouse gas from Vietnam's agricultural sector. Improving water‐use efficiency can enhance water security and reduce emissions, but achieving these gains requires substantial changes in farming practices and significant investment in supporting infrastructure. This study provides an economic analysis of low‐water, low‐emission (LWLE) farming techniques, such as Alternate Wetting and Drying and the System of Rice Intensification, and their associated infrastructure requirements. Using survey data from 14,312 rice‐producing households in Vietnam, we evaluate the economic performance of farmers who adopt LWLE practices and those who do not. The results show that producers adopting LWLE not only achieve higher yields than those using traditional farming techniques—and consequently higher revenues—but also incur higher costs and ultimately earn lower profits. In addition, LWLE entails considerable hidden upfront irrigation costs, posing barriers for farmers and limiting smallholder participation. We also undertake a break‐even carbon price analysis to illustrate the economic trade‐offs in reducing one tonne of CO 2 equivalent through LWLE techniques, and the results suggest that these practices could reduce farmers' vulnerability to future carbon pricing.
10.1111/1467-8489.70141.abstract_zh: 水稻生产中的过度用水是甲烷排放的主要来源，而甲烷是越南农业部门最主要的温室气体。提高用水效率既能增强水安全，又能减少排放，但实现这些效益需要大幅改变耕作方式，并对配套基础设施进行大量投资。本研究对低水低排放（LWLE）耕作技术（如交替干湿灌溉和稻作强化体系）及其相关基础设施需求进行了经济分析。利用越南14,312户水稻生产农户的调查数据，我们评估了采用LWLE实践与未采用农户的经济表现。结果表明，采用LWLE的农户不仅比传统耕作技术获得更高产量（进而获得更高收入），而且承担更高成本，最终利润更低。此外，LWLE还涉及大量隐性前期灌溉成本，这给农户带来障碍并限制了小农户的参与。我们还进行了盈亏平衡碳价分析，以说明通过LWLE技术减少一吨二氧化碳当量所涉及的经济权衡，结果表明这些实践可能降低农户对未来碳定价的脆弱性。
10.1111/1467-8489.70141.title: Economic Analysis of Infrastructure Investment and Break‐Even Carbon Prices for Low‐Water, Low‐Emission Farming Techniques in Vietnam
10.1111/1467-8489.70141.title_zh: 越南低水低排放农业技术的基础设施投资与盈亏平衡碳价格的经济分析

10.1111/1467-8489.70142.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study examines whether household tap water access affects income‐generating work time among employed rural adults in China. While existing studies have mainly examined the effects of improved water access on employment participation, off‐farm transition and household income, this paper focuses on the intensive margin of labour supply within existing livelihood activities. Drawing on household production and time allocation theory, household tap water access is conceptualised as reducing the time cost of routine domestic production, thereby releasing time that may be reallocated to income‐generating work and other household activities. Using rural panel data from the China Family Panel Studies from 2014 to 2022, the analysis applies individual fixed‐effects models and instrumental variables fixed‐effects (IV‐FE) estimates. The fixed effects results show that household tap water access is associated with approximately one additional hour of income‐generating work per week among employed rural adults. Under the IV identifying assumptions, the IV‐FE estimates suggest a larger positive effect. Additional time‐use analysis indicates that household tap water access reduces daily housework time by about 0.29 h and modestly increases midday nap duration, while no statistically significant changes are found for television watching or leisure reading. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that the increase in work time is concentrated among agricultural workers, self‐employed individuals, prime‐age adults and individuals living in households without young children.</jats:p>
10.1111/1467-8489.70142.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了家庭自来水供应是否影响中国农村就业成年人的创收工作时间。现有研究主要关注改善水资源获取对就业参与、非农转移和家庭收入的影响，而本文聚焦于现有生计活动中劳动力供给的集约边际。基于家庭生产与时间分配理论，家庭自来水供应被概念化为降低日常家务生产的时间成本，从而释放出可能重新分配至创收工作及其他家庭活动的时间。利用2014年至2022年中国家庭追踪调查的农村面板数据，本文采用个体固定效应模型和工具变量固定效应估计。固定效应结果显示，家庭自来水供应与农村就业成年人每周约增加一小时的创收工作时间相关。在工具变量识别假设下，工具变量固定效应估计表明存在更大的正向效应。额外的时间使用分析显示，家庭自来水供应使每日家务时间减少约0.29小时，并适度增加午睡时长，而看电视或休闲阅读的时间未发现统计显著变化。异质性分析表明，工作时间的增加主要集中在农业劳动者、自雇者、壮年成年人以及无幼儿家庭中的个体。
10.1111/1467-8489.70142.title: From Tap Water Access to Income‐Generating Work Time: Evidence From Rural China
10.1111/1467-8489.70142.title_zh: 从自来水接入到创收工作时间：来自中国农村的证据

10.1111/1467-8489.70143.abstract: The agricultural sector's share of GDP in growing economies typically declines but, for a century from the early 1850s, Australia's did not. That trend is most evident for the former colony and now State of South Australia (SA). Moreover, that share for SA has been almost flat since 1980 as well, along with the agricultural sector's share of SA exports. This paper seeks to shed light on the forces behind the unusual evolution of these sectoral shares for SA both up to 1950 and since 1980. The extensive time series data compiled for this paper suggest various partial explanations. For 1850–1950, they include the huge arable land area per worker, clearly defined and enforced property rights in settled rural areas as the frontier of European settlement expanded, the absence of a need to do any processing of the main 19th century exports (copper, wool and wheat), a strong public agricultural research and extension system, and the absence of major mining booms after the copper finds in the 1840s and 1860s.
10.1111/1467-8489.70143.abstract_zh: 在经济增长过程中，农业部门占GDP的比重通常会下降，但从19世纪50年代初开始的一个世纪里，澳大利亚的这一比重并未下降。这一趋势在前殖民地、现南澳大利亚州（SA）表现得最为明显。此外，自1980年以来，南澳大利亚州农业部门占GDP的比重以及农业部门占该州出口的比重几乎保持平稳。本文旨在揭示南澳大利亚州在1950年之前及1980年之后这些部门份额异常演变的驱动因素。本文编制的大量时间序列数据提供了多种局部解释。对于1850年至1950年期间，这些因素包括：人均可耕地面积巨大；随着欧洲定居前沿的扩展，定居农村地区明确界定并有效执行的产权；19世纪主要出口产品（铜、羊毛和小麦）无需任何加工；强大的公共农业研究与推广体系；以及19世纪40年代和60年代铜矿发现后未出现重大矿业繁荣。
10.1111/1467-8489.70143.title: Forces Behind South Australia's Unusual Structural Changes Since 1840
10.1111/1467-8489.70143.title_zh: 1840年以来南澳大利亚州异常结构变化背后的驱动力

10.1111/1467-8489.70144.abstract: As a core component of human capital, education plays a pivotal role in shaping labour productivity. In remote and impoverished rural areas, limited access to post‐compulsory education creates a self‐perpetuating cycle of low education, low productivity, and entrenched poverty. Using data from China's Poverty Alleviation Through Relocation programme, this study examines the impact of relocation on children's post‐compulsory education, measured by high school enrolment. Employing a two‐way fixed effects model, we find that relocation increases the probability of high school enrolment by approximately 8.6 percentage points, with results robust to household controls and propensity score matching. Mechanism analysis provides suggestive evidence that these gains are associated with improved school accessibility, higher household income and increased educational investment. The effects are heterogeneous: educational gains are concentrated among male children and those in households with lower‐educated and older heads, are primarily driven by rural relocation, and increase with the duration since resettlement. The findings highlight both the potential and uneven distribution of human capital gains from relocation policies, providing important insights for targeted post‐relocation educational support in other developing country contexts.
10.1111/1467-8489.70144.abstract_zh: 作为人力资本的核心组成部分，教育在塑造劳动生产率方面发挥着关键作用。在偏远贫困的农村地区，义务教育后教育机会的匮乏形成了低教育水平、低生产率与根深蒂固贫困的自我循环。本研究利用中国易地扶贫搬迁项目数据，以高中入学率为衡量指标，考察搬迁对儿童义务教育后教育的影响。通过采用双向固定效应模型，我们发现搬迁使高中入学概率提升约8.6个百分点，该结果在加入家庭层面控制变量及倾向得分匹配后依然稳健。机制分析表明，这些教育收益与学校可达性改善、家庭收入提高及教育投资增加存在关联。异质性分析显示：教育收益集中于男性儿童、户主受教育程度较低及年龄较大的家庭；主要源于农村搬迁驱动；且随安置时间延长而递增。研究结果揭示了搬迁政策在人力资本积累方面的潜力与分配不均问题，为其他发展中国家制定针对性的搬迁后教育支持政策提供了重要启示。
10.1111/1467-8489.70144.title: Relocation and Educational Attainment: Evidence From China's Poverty Alleviation Programme
10.1111/1467-8489.70144.title_zh: 搬迁与教育成就：来自中国扶贫项目的证据

10.1111/1467-8489.70145.abstract: This paper examines the causal impact of agronomic technology adoption, induced by technical assistance programmes, on factor misallocation and aggregate agricultural productivity. While the literature has established the central role of land and capital market imperfections as sources of misallocation in agriculture, the potential of technological adoption to correct these inefficiencies has received limited attention. This paper directly addresses this gap by combining a calibrated equilibrium model with causal inference methods, using Chile as a case study. The results show that, among farmers whose adoption is induced by access to technical assistance programmes, factor misallocation is reduced by approximately 22 percentage points. This effect is robust across alternative efficiency measures, functional specifications and parametric assumptions, and remains stable after purging idiosyncratic productivity from agroclimatic conditions such as rainfall and soil quality. Technological adoption significantly increases participation in land rental markets and access to bank credit, thereby facilitating the reallocation of resources towards more productive farmers. In addition, the analysis identifies local spillover effects: farmers in municipalities with higher adoption rates exhibit lower misallocation. Counterfactual exercises further indicate that these effects are amplified when frictions in land markets are reduced.
10.1111/1467-8489.70145.abstract_zh: 本文考察了由技术援助项目引致的农艺技术采纳对要素错配和农业总生产率的影响。尽管已有文献确立了土地和资本市场不完善是农业错配的主要根源，但技术采纳在纠正这些效率损失方面的潜力却鲜受关注。本文通过将校准均衡模型与因果推断方法相结合，以智利为案例研究，直接填补了这一空白。结果表明，在因获得技术援助项目而采纳技术的农户中，要素错配降低了约22个百分点。这一效应在替代效率测度、函数设定和参数假设下均保持稳健，且在剔除降雨和土壤质量等农业气候条件带来的异质性生产率后依然稳定。技术采纳显著提高了农户参与土地租赁市场和获得银行信贷的机会，从而促进了资源向更具生产率的农户重新配置。此外，分析还识别出局部溢出效应：在技术采纳率较高的市镇，农户的错配程度较低。反事实分析进一步表明，当土地市场摩擦减少时，这些效应会得到放大。
10.1111/1467-8489.70145.title: Beyond Productivity: Technology Adoption and Factor Allocation in Agriculture
10.1111/1467-8489.70145.title_zh: 超越生产力：农业中的技术采纳与要素配置

10.1111/1467-8489.70146.abstract: Incorporating greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions as an undesirable output of agricultural production in a directional distance function provides a better understanding of agricultural production performance. Based on balanced panel data from 126 prefecture‐level regions in the Yangtze River Basin in China, we employed a quadratic directional output‐oriented distance function to measure agricultural production performance in terms of environmental efficiency, relative shadow price of GHG emissions and Morishima elasticities of substitution between inputs. We found an upward trend, with average environmental efficiency of 0.871 during 2000–2020. This indicates that 12.9% more agricultural added value can be achieved, along with a 12.9% reduction in GHG emissions. Agricultural production in the upstream Yangtze River Basin region showed the best performance in terms of environmental efficiency. The estimated relative shadow price of GHG emissions was 4.606 and showed a negative association with environmental efficiency. Morishima elasticities of substitution indicated a substitution relationship of labour and fertiliser to land, and a strong complementary relationship between fertiliser and labour.
10.1111/1467-8489.70146.abstract_zh: 将温室气体排放作为农业生产非期望产出纳入方向性距离函数，有助于更深入理解农业生产绩效。基于中国长江流域126个地级市2000-2020年的平衡面板数据，采用二次型方向性产出距离函数，从环境效率、温室气体排放相对影子价格及投入要素间Morishima替代弹性三个维度测度农业生产绩效。研究发现：样本期间平均环境效率为0.871且呈上升趋势，表明在实现12.9%农业增加值增长的同时可同步减少12.9%的温室气体排放；长江上游地区农业生产的环境效率表现最优；温室气体排放相对影子价格估计值为4.606，且与环境效率呈负相关关系；Morishima替代弹性显示劳动力和化肥对土地存在替代关系，而化肥与劳动力之间呈现强互补关系。
10.1111/1467-8489.70146.title: Synergies or Trade‐Offs Between Environmental and Economic Outcomes? An Analysis of Agricultural Production Performance
10.1111/1467-8489.70146.title_zh: 环境与经济成果之间的协同还是权衡？农业生产绩效分析

10.1111/1467-8489.70148.abstract: Americans across the country are plagued with harmful effects from air and water pollution, resource depletion, land degradation, biodiversity loss and climate change. Protecting the natural environment, ecosystems and humans from these effects will demand substantive changes in production methods, delivery processes and consumption patterns. Amassing resources to effect such changes will likely require both higher taxes and prices. Currently, the literature offers little in the way of estimating or identifying the factors important in determining the public's willingness to pay both higher taxes and higher prices, in principle, for environmental protection. This paper is a first attempt to fill this gap. Using data from the United States 2021 General Social Survey, we estimate a bivariate ordered probit model, enabling us to calculate average marginal effects on and average predicted probabilities of the willingness to pay both higher taxes and higher prices to protect the environment. Without considerable and widespread changes in attitudes and beliefs, results suggest that there is little chance that a majority of Americans will support higher prices, a smaller chance of a majority supporting higher taxes and a still smaller chance that a majority will support both higher taxes and higher prices for environmental protection.
10.1111/1467-8489.70148.abstract_zh: 全美各地民众正遭受空气与水污染、资源枯竭、土地退化、生物多样性丧失及气候变化带来的有害影响。保护自然环境、生态系统及人类免受这些影响，需要生产方式、配送流程和消费模式发生实质性变革。为促成此类变革而筹集资源，很可能需要提高税收和价格。目前，学术界在估算或识别决定公众原则上是否愿意为环境保护同时承担更高税收与更高价格的关键因素方面，几乎未提供任何研究。本文首次尝试填补这一空白。利用美国2021年综合社会调查数据，我们估计了双变量有序概率模型，从而能够计算公众为保护环境同时承担更高税收与更高价格的意愿的平均边际效应和平均预测概率。研究结果表明，若态度与信念未发生广泛且显著的转变，大多数美国人支持更高价格的可能性微乎其微，支持更高税收的可能性更小，而同时支持为环境保护承担更高税收与更高价格的可能性则微乎其微。
10.1111/1467-8489.70148.title: What Is the Probability That the Environmentally Conscious Are Willing to Pay Higher Taxes and Higher Prices to Protect the Environment? Recent Evidence for the United States
10.1111/1467-8489.70148.title_zh: 环保意识者愿意支付更高税收和价格以保护环境的概率是多少？——来自美国的最新证据

10.1111/1467-8489.70149.abstract: With the retirement of 21GW of legacy coal fleet looming, the task to replace Australia's thermal capacity with alternative firmed renewable ‘bulk energy’ solutions is non‐trivial. Indeed, calibrating necessary capital investment in new plant stock with efficient economic outcomes, vis‐à‐vis cost and reliability, represents a fundamental challenge to the ‘dynamic efficiency’ ideal for energy‐only markets. Recently, a major review of Australia's National Electricity Market (NEM) has proposed that underwriting of new energy generation utilise fungible derivative contracts instead of the canonical run‐of‐plant (RoP) revenue contract design. The proposition is based upon re‐linking medium‐ and long‐term energy markets, while mitigating some of the worst externalities attributed to off‐market underwriting policies when implemented at‐scale. However, sound economic theory can collide with applied corporate finance in practice. The very basis of the RoP design has been to address the needs of capital markets vis‐à‐vis revenue quality for new‐entrant plant, making bankability a threshold issue for contract viability. This article examines a set of proposed fungible contract designs, leveraging 100 years of synthetic, stochastic market data to draw conclusions on the compatibility of contract fungibility and bankability. Findings indicate that eliminating incentive incompatibilities between plant dispatch and market signals (which are inherent in the RoP design) appears adequate to counteract ‘shape’ risk—both idiosyncratic and systematic—within the confines of a typical project finance structure. In other words, bankability and fungibility do not appear to be mutually exclusive.
10.1111/1467-8489.70149.abstract_zh: 随着21吉瓦传统燃煤发电机组退役的临近，用替代性固定可再生能源“大宗能源”解决方案来填补澳大利亚热力发电能力的任务绝非易事。实际上，将新电厂所需的资本投资与高效的经济成果（就成本和可靠性而言）进行校准，是对仅靠能源市场实现“动态效率”理想的一个根本性挑战。近期，对澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）的一项重大审查提议，新发电项目的承销应采用可互换衍生品合约，而非传统的按电厂运行（RoP）收入合约设计。该提议基于重新连接中长期能源市场，同时减轻大规模实施场外承销政策所带来的一些最严重外部性。然而，健全的经济理论在实践中可能与应用企业财务相冲突。RoP设计的基本出发点在于满足资本市场对新进入电厂收入质量的需求，使得可融资性成为合约可行性的关键问题。本文考察了一系列拟议的可互换合约设计，利用100年的合成随机市场数据，就合约可互换性与可融资性的兼容性得出结论。研究结果表明，消除电厂调度与市场信号之间的激励不兼容性（这是RoP设计固有的）似乎足以在典型项目融资结构范围内抵消“形状”风险——无论是特质性还是系统性风险。换言之，可融资性与可互换性并非相互排斥。
10.1111/1467-8489.70149.title: Alternative Contract Design: Analysing the Bankability of Fungible Derivative Contracts in Energy‐Only Markets
10.1111/1467-8489.70149.title_zh: 替代性合约设计：能量单一市场中可互换衍生品合约的可融资性分析

10.1111/1467-8489.70150.abstract: Environmental provisions have become important to Regional Trade Agreements (RTAs) and are key in promoting high‐quality trade. Using matched data from China Industrial Enterprise Database and China Customs Database, this study explores the non‐linear impact of the depth of RTA environmental provisions on agri‐food export quality upgrading and its mechanisms. Results show a significant ‘U‐shaped’ effect; beyond a 0.48 depth threshold, environmental provisions exert a sustained positive impact on agri‐food export quality upgrading. Heterogeneity analysis reveals divergent effects across national, firm, product quality and specific provision dimensions, with the ‘Balance between environment and trade/investment’ clause being the dominant influencing factor. We further reveal that cost constraints and innovation compensation effects are the key drivers behind the nonlinear impact. Therefore, this study benchmarks against high‐standard international trade rules and proposes policy recommendations for achieving high‐quality agricultural development.
10.1111/1467-8489.70150.abstract_zh: 环境条款已成为区域贸易协定（RTAs）的重要组成部分，并在推动高质量贸易中发挥关键作用。本研究利用中国工业企业数据库与中国海关数据库的匹配数据，探讨了RTA环境条款深度对农产品出口质量升级的非线性影响及其作用机制。研究结果显示，存在显著的“U型”效应；当深度阈值超过0.48时，环境条款对农产品出口质量升级产生持续的积极影响。异质性分析揭示了在国家、企业、产品质量及具体条款维度上的差异化效应，其中“环境与贸易/投资平衡”条款是主导影响因素。我们进一步揭示，成本约束与创新补偿效应是非线性影响背后的关键驱动力。因此，本研究以高标准国际经贸规则为基准，提出了实现农业高质量发展的政策建议。
10.1111/1467-8489.70150.title: How Environmental Provisions in Regional Trade Agreements Drive Agri‐Food Export Quality Upgrading?—A Regulatory Perspective
10.1111/1467-8489.70150.title_zh: 区域贸易协定中的环境条款如何推动农产品出口质量升级？——基于规制视角的分析

10.1111/1467-8489.70151.abstract: Export bans are frequently used as trade policy instruments to stabilise domestic prices, but they often generate unintended consequences. This study examines the effects of Indonesia's palm oil export ban, introduced in April 2022 and lifted in May 2022, on the performance of the global agricultural sector and the stock markets of palm oil–producing countries. Drawing on a conceptual framework, we develop hypotheses regarding how stock indices with different industrial compositions respond to such trade policy interventions. Using an event study methodology, we analyse daily stock market data from palm oil–producing countries as well as a global agriculture‐specific MSCI index. The analysis encompasses both nationally diversified stock indices and a global sector–specific index. The results reveal statistically significant negative cumulative abnormal returns for the global agricultural index following the introduction of the export ban, whereas national cross‐industry indices show statistically insignificant reactions. Following the lifting of the ban, the global agricultural index experienced statistically significant positive cumulative abnormal returns, whereas national indices exhibited mixed and statistically insignificant responses. These findings are consistent with the conceptual framework, suggesting that the policy primarily affected the global agricultural sector while leaving diversified national stock markets largely unaffected. Importantly, the effects associated with the introduction and subsequent lifting of the ban did not fully offset each other, resulting in an overall negative net effect on the global agricultural index.
10.1111/1467-8489.70151.abstract_zh: 出口禁令常被用作稳定国内价格的贸易政策工具，但往往会产生意想不到的后果。本研究考察了印度尼西亚于2022年4月实施、2022年5月取消的棕榈油出口禁令对全球农业部门表现及棕榈油生产国股票市场的影响。基于一个概念框架，我们提出了关于不同行业构成的股票指数如何应对此类贸易政策干预的假设。采用事件研究法，我们分析了来自棕榈油生产国的每日股市数据以及一个全球农业特定MSCI指数。分析涵盖了国家层面多元化的股票指数和一个全球行业特定指数。结果显示，出口禁令实施后，全球农业指数出现了统计上显著的负向累积异常收益，而国家跨行业指数则表现出统计上不显著的反应。禁令取消后，全球农业指数经历了统计上显著的正向累积异常收益，而国家指数则表现出混合且统计上不显著的响应。这些发现与概念框架一致，表明该政策主要影响了全球农业部门，而对多元化的国内股票市场影响甚微。重要的是，禁令实施及随后取消所关联的效应并未完全相互抵消，导致全球农业指数整体呈现负的净效应。
10.1111/1467-8489.70151.title: Unravelling the Effects of Indonesia's Oil Palm Export Ban on Global Stock Markets
10.1111/1467-8489.70151.title_zh: 印尼棕榈油出口禁令对全球股市影响的解析

10.1111/1467-8489.70152.abstract: Understanding the determinants of illegal rhino horn prices can provide information for the design of policies to conserve wild rhinoceroses. Using a theoretical model, we identify empirical measures that may affect illegal rhino horn prices and derive testable hypotheses about their expected effects. We test these hypotheses using time series data on actual illegal market prices of rhino horn in Vietnam. The price data were collected from consumers who purchased rhino horn in Vietnam between 2001 and 2020. Assuming that the illegal rhino horn markets in China and Vietnam are perfectly integrated, we examine the effects of various regulatory measures implemented in both countries. We find that China's legalisation of trade in rhino horn antiques and the implementation of an anti‐corruption campaign are associated with significant reductions in illegal rhino horn price in Vietnam, whereas Vietnam's increased sanctions on the rhino horn trade and use have no significant effects. These findings suggest that, in addition to wildlife‐specific policies, broader institutional reforms and governance crackdowns in China may substantially affect illegal rhino horn prices in Vietnam.
10.1111/1467-8489.70152.abstract_zh: 了解非法犀牛角价格的决定因素，可为制定保护野生犀牛的政策提供信息。通过理论模型，我们识别出可能影响非法犀牛角价格的实证指标，并推导出关于其预期影响的可检验假设。我们利用越南非法犀牛角实际市场价格的时间序列数据来检验这些假设。价格数据来源于2001年至2020年间在越南购买犀牛角的消费者。假设中国和越南的非法犀牛角市场完全一体化，我们考察了两国实施的各种监管措施的效果。研究发现，中国对犀牛角古董贸易的合法化以及反腐败运动的实施，与越南非法犀牛角价格显著下降相关联，而越南对犀牛角贸易和使用加强制裁则未产生显著影响。这些结果表明，除了针对野生动物的特定政策外，中国更广泛的制度性改革和治理整顿可能对越南非法犀牛角价格产生实质性影响。
10.1111/1467-8489.70152.title: The Price of a Horn: How Governance and Policy Shape an Illegal Wildlife Market
10.1111/1467-8489.70152.title_zh: 象牙之价：治理与政策如何塑造非法野生动物市场

10.1111/1467-8489.70153.abstract: Exotic, invasive conifer tree species, known as ‘wilding conifers’, pose a significant threat to natural ecosystems and are costly to manage, creating a need to identify community preferences in order to inform and balance public investment in their control. Currently, approximately 7% of New Zealand's total land area is covered by invasive wilding conifers, and the rate of spread is approximately 5% per year. This study analysed the preferences of the New Zealand population regarding the control of wilding conifers in indigenous ecosystems using a choice experiment. The results, obtained through a mixed logistic model in willingness‐to‐pay space, showed that the public places significant value on controlling the spread of wilding conifers. Preferences for control displayed distance decay and diminishing marginal utility. The study also examined the spatial heterogeneity of preferences in terms of distance decay and the spatial dimension of scope. Finally, the study estimated the value of controlling the spread of wilding conifers nationally, which was found to be about NZ$147 million annually, and broadly consistent with the economic damage caused by other major invasive weeds in New Zealand. These findings confirm the importance of spatial factors in explaining preferences for the control of invasive trees and demonstrate how policymakers can use the estimated values to measure the benefits of different control options.
10.1111/1467-8489.70153.abstract_zh: 外来入侵性针叶树种，即所谓的“野生针叶树”，对自然生态系统构成重大威胁，且管理成本高昂，因此有必要识别社区偏好，以指导并平衡对其控制措施的公共投资。目前，新西兰约7%的国土面积被入侵性野生针叶树覆盖，且扩散速度约为每年5%。本研究采用选择实验法，分析了新西兰民众对控制本土生态系统中野生针叶树的偏好。通过支付意愿空间中的混合逻辑模型所得结果显示，公众对控制野生针叶树扩散赋予了显著价值。控制偏好表现出距离衰减和边际效用递减的特征。研究还考察了偏好的空间异质性，涉及距离衰减和范围的空间维度。最后，研究估算了全国范围内控制野生针叶树扩散的价值，发现约为每年1.47亿新西兰元，与新西兰其他主要入侵杂草造成的经济损失大致相符。这些发现证实了空间因素在解释对入侵树木控制偏好中的重要性，并展示了政策制定者如何利用估算价值来衡量不同控制方案的收益。
10.1111/1467-8489.70153.title: The Value of Controlling Wilding Conifers in New Zealand
10.1111/1467-8489.70153.title_zh: 控制新西兰野生针叶树的价值

10.1111/1467-8489.70154.abstract: Using three waves of household data from a randomised controlled trial involving 676 rice farmers in Hubei and Jiangxi provinces of China over the period 2017–2019, we estimate the causal effect of information provision on pesticide use and examine heterogeneity with respect to the duration of the intervention, farmers' human capital, and the identity and mode of information providers. The results reveal that 1 year of information provision did not reduce pesticide use intensity, whereas 2 years of provision led to a substantial reduction of 47.2%. This finding remains robust to alternative pesticide measures, sample winsorization, and different regional fixed effects specifications. The pesticide reduction effect is larger among farmers with higher levels of human capital. Information provided by government extension agents significantly reduces pesticide use, particularly when provided through face‐to‐face farmer training and retailer‐mediated dissemination. In contrast, identical information provided by pesticide firms has no significant effect, regardless of the intervention duration or provision mode. Moreover, the provision of pesticide‐reduction information lowers health risks for farmers and environmental risks to ecosystems from toxic exposure without compromising rice yield. These findings imply that future policies should prioritise sustained information provision targeting smallholders, strengthen intervention effectiveness for farmers with lower human capital, and enhance government extension services.
10.1111/1467-8489.70154.abstract_zh: 利用2017至2019年间针对中国湖北和江西两省676名稻农的三轮家庭调查数据，我们评估了信息提供对农药使用的因果效应，并考察了干预持续时间、农民人力资本以及信息提供者身份和方式等方面的异质性。结果显示，为期一年的信息提供并未降低农药使用强度，而两年的信息提供则显著减少了47.2%的农药使用量。这一发现在不同农药衡量指标、样本缩尾处理及不同区域固定效应设定下均保持稳健。人力资本水平较高的农民，其农药减量效果更为显著。政府推广人员提供的信息能显著减少农药使用，尤其是通过面对面的农民培训和零售商中介传播时效果更佳。相比之下，农药企业提供的相同信息无论干预时长或提供方式如何，均无显著效果。此外，提供减药信息降低了农民的健康风险及生态系统因有毒物质暴露所面临的环境风险，且未影响水稻产量。这些发现表明，未来政策应优先考虑面向小农户的持续信息供给，加强对人力资本较低农民的干预效果，并强化政府推广服务。
10.1111/1467-8489.70154.title: Information Provision and Pesticide Reduction in Rice Production: Experimental Evidence From China
10.1111/1467-8489.70154.title_zh: 水稻生产中信息提供与农药减量：来自中国的实验证据

10.1111/1477-9552.70018.abstract: We investigate the impact of air quality regulations targeting fine particulate matter (PM 2.5 ) on farmland values in corn and soybean producing counties in the United States over the period 1997–2022. Using self‐reported farmland value data from the Agricultural Census and county‐level pollution classifications provided by the Environmental Protection Agency, we employ a difference‐in‐differences event‐study design—incorporating inverse probability weighting and doubly robust estimators—to estimate the causal effect of regulatory interventions. Our primary analysis contrasts ‘non‐attainment’ counties, which failed to meet the National Ambient Air Quality Standards for PM 2.5 , with those that consistently maintained compliance. We further assess heterogeneous treatment effects by extending our analysis with a triple‐difference specification comparing counties with high versus low fertiliser use. Additionally, we employ the recentered influence function to conduct an unconditional quantile analysis across the entire distribution of farmland values. Our estimates indicate an 8.80%–8.94% decline in farmland values in ‘non‐attainment’ counties in response to the enforcement of PM 2.5 standards, suggesting that the economic costs of the prescribed standards were capitalised into farmland values, particularly in regions with higher fertiliser use. However, this impact was not uniform, with more pronounced effects observed among counties at the lower end of the farmland value distribution.
10.1111/1477-9552.70018.abstract_zh: 我们研究了针对细颗粒物（PM2.5）的空气质量管理法规对美国玉米和大豆生产县农田价值的影响，时间跨度为1997年至2022年。利用农业普查中自报的农田价值数据以及环境保护局提供的县级污染分类，我们采用双重差分事件研究设计——结合逆概率加权和双稳健估计量——来评估监管干预的因果效应。我们的主要分析对比了未达到国家环境空气质量标准中PM2.5要求的“未达标”县与持续保持合规的县。通过扩展分析，我们采用三重差分规格，比较高化肥使用县与低化肥使用县，进一步评估异质性处理效应。此外，我们运用再中心化影响函数，对农田价值全分布进行无条件分位数分析。我们的估计显示，在PM2.5标准执行后，“未达标”县的农田价值下降了8.80%至8.94%，这表明规定标准的经济成本已资本化到农田价值中，尤其是在化肥使用量较高的地区。然而，这一影响并非均匀分布，在农田价值分布较低端的县中观察到了更为显著的效果。

10.1111/1477-9552.70019.abstract: ABSTRACT Most research questions in agricultural and applied economics are causal in nature: they study how changes in one or more variables (such as policies, prices or weather) affect one or more other variables (e.g., income, crop yields or pollution). Only a minority of these research questions can be studied with experimental methods, so most empirical studies in agricultural and applied economics rely on observational data. However, estimating causal effects with observational data requires an appropriate research design and a transparent discussion of all identifying assumptions, together with a critical discussion of how plausible they are. This paper provides an overview of approaches that are frequently used in agricultural and applied economics to estimate causal effects with observational data. It then provides advice and guidelines for agricultural and applied economists seeking to estimate causal effects with observational data, including how to assess and discuss the identification strategies adopted in their analysis.
10.1111/1477-9552.70019.abstract_zh: 摘要 农业与应用经济学中的大多数研究问题本质上是因果性的：它们探讨一个或多个变量（如政策、价格或天气）的变化如何影响一个或多个其他变量（如收入、作物产量或污染）。这些研究问题中只有少数可以通过实验方法进行研究，因此农业与应用经济学中的大多数实证研究依赖于观测数据。然而，利用观测数据估计因果效应需要适当的研究设计和对所有识别假设的透明讨论，并对其合理性进行批判性评估。本文概述了农业与应用经济学中常用于利用观测数据估计因果效应的方法，随后为寻求利用观测数据估计因果效应的农业与应用经济学家提供建议和指导，包括如何评估和讨论其分析中所采用的识别策略。

10.1111/1477-9552.70020.abstract: The US–China trade war has profoundly reshaped global agricultural markets, yet the consequences of protectionist measures for domestic public attitudes—particularly within collectivist societies like China—have been underexplored. This study investigates how Chinese citizens perceive retaliatory tariffs on US agricultural products and explores how awareness of economic self‐interest shapes their support for such policies. We develop a simple theoretical model showing that trade policy attitudes are shaped by both social values and economic beliefs, with the influence of new information moderated by trust and cognitive capacity. The model predicts that information interventions can recalibrate beliefs towards actual economic interests, with effects varying by information credibility and individual human capital. Employing a randomised controlled trial in 2023, we demonstrate that backing for trade protection in China is robustly associated with collectivist values. Individuals demonstrate a strong propensity of alignment with government positions over economic self‐interests. However, when people learn about how tariffs will personally affect their household costs, they become less supportive of trade protection because they revise their expectations about economic consequences. Notably, the efficacy of these interventions depends critically on the respondents' trust in information and their level of human capital. Our findings offer new insights into the dynamics of public opinion formation in contexts where information flows are state‐mediated, with direct implications for the design of agricultural and trade policy communication strategies.
10.1111/1477-9552.70020.abstract_zh: 中美贸易战深刻重塑了全球农产品市场，然而保护主义措施对国内公众态度的影响——尤其是在中国这样的集体主义社会中——尚未得到充分探讨。本研究考察了中国公民如何看待针对美国农产品的报复性关税，并探讨了对经济自身利益的认识如何影响其对这类政策的支持。我们构建了一个简洁的理论模型，表明贸易政策态度既受社会价值观影响，也受经济信念影响，而新信息的影响力则受到信任和认知能力的调节。模型预测，信息干预能够将信念重新校准至实际经济利益方向，其效果因信息可信度和个人人力资本而异。通过2023年开展的随机对照试验，我们证明中国国内对贸易保护的支持与集体主义价值观密切相关。个体表现出强烈的与政府立场保持一致而非追求经济自身利益的倾向。然而，当人们了解到关税将如何直接影响其家庭成本时，他们对贸易保护的支持度会下降，因为他们修正了对经济后果的预期。值得注意的是，这些干预措施的有效性关键取决于受访者对信息的信任程度及其人力资本水平。我们的研究为信息流动受国家中介的背景下公众舆论形成的动态机制提供了新见解，对农业和贸易政策传播策略的设计具有直接启示意义。

10.1111/1477-9552.70021.abstract: ABSTRACT Most cocoa farmers in Côte d'Ivoire are trapped in a cycle of poverty and farming practices that degrade the environment. This paper aims to provide an in‐depth understanding of the price formation process for cocoa at each stage of the supply chain in the world's largest cocoa‐producing country. By examining potential inefficiencies that affect price pass‐through and could explain exceptionally low farm‐gate prices, the study seeks to identify segments of the supply chain where policy or market interventions could improve outcomes for farmers. Our approach couples econometric analyses using secondary cocoa price data and primary farm household survey data with qualitative assessments of institutional factors specific to the cocoa value chain in Côte d'Ivoire. Notwithstanding the country's highly regulated system of setting cocoa prices, we do not find evidence of inefficiencies that would explain persistently low farm‐gate prices. Nor do we find that the recently introduced ‘Living Income Differential’, a price surcharge on internationally traded cocoa, has benefited farmers. We conclude by advocating that the international cocoa industry strengthens its development programmes in cocoa‐growing communities, and that the government supports these efforts with better provision of infrastructure and other public goods. Such efforts could ultimately serve to increase the opportunity cost of cocoa production, drawing farmers into other employment sectors while improving the resilience and livelihoods of those who remain.
10.1111/1477-9552.70021.abstract_zh: 摘要 科特迪瓦大多数可可种植农深陷贫困与破坏环境的耕作方式循环之中。本文旨在深入理解全球最大可可生产国供应链各阶段的价格形成过程。通过考察影响价格传导并可能解释异常低农场交货价的潜在低效因素，研究旨在识别供应链中政策或市场干预可改善农民收益的环节。我们的方法结合了基于二手可可价格数据和初级农户家庭调查数据的计量经济分析，以及对科特迪瓦可可价值链特定制度因素的定性评估。尽管该国实行高度监管的可可定价体系，我们并未发现能解释持续低农场交货价的低效证据。我们同样未发现近期推出的“生活收入差额”——一种对国际交易可可的价格附加费——惠及农民。最后，我们主张国际可可产业加强其在可可种植社区的发展项目，并建议政府通过改善基础设施及其他公共产品供给来支持这些努力。此类举措最终可能提高可可生产的机会成本，引导农民转向其他就业部门，同时增强留守者的韧性与生计。

10.1111/1477-9552.70022.abstract: ABSTRACT Coffee producers deal with uncertainty due to high volatility in coffee prices. To navigate these challenges, producers must balance the tradeoff between higher yield and better quality utilising heterogeneous technologies, such as intensive production methods and environmental management practices. The aim of this study is to identify the extent to which heterogeneous technologies, particularly those focused on sustainable management, can influence the technical efficiency of Colombian coffee farms. Using the Latent Class Stochastic Frontier Model (LCSFM), we studied the unobserved differences in technologies among 387 Colombian coffee farms in the Andes. Our findings show that farms adhering to sustainable standards achieved an efficiency rate of 95.68%, compared to 74.93% for farms heavily reliant on chemical pesticides. These results underscore the efficiency benefits of sustainable practices and provide targeted recommendations to improve productivity among different groups of coffee growers. This research contributes to the broader understanding of how adopting sustainable technologies can enhance efficiency in coffee production, offering key insights for policymakers and practitioners aiming to stabilise and develop the sector.
10.1111/1477-9552.70022.abstract_zh: 摘要 咖啡生产者因咖啡价格的高度波动而面临不确定性。为应对这些挑战，生产者必须利用异质性技术，如集约化生产方法和环境管理实践，在高产量与高品质之间权衡取舍。本研究旨在确定异质性技术，尤其是侧重于可持续管理的技术，能在多大程度上影响哥伦比亚咖啡农场的技术效率。采用潜在类别随机前沿模型（LCSFM），我们研究了安第斯山脉地区387个哥伦比亚咖啡农场在技术上的未观测差异。研究结果显示，遵循可持续标准的农场实现了95.68%的效率，而严重依赖化学农药的农场效率为74.93%。这些结果凸显了可持续实践的效率优势，并为提升不同咖啡种植者群体的生产力提供了有针对性的建议。本研究有助于更广泛地理解采用可持续技术如何提升咖啡生产效率，为旨在稳定和发展该行业的政策制定者及从业者提供了关键见解。

10.1111/1477-9552.70023.abstract: ABSTRACT Achieving ambitious pesticide reduction goals calls for collaboration and shared vision among multiple stakeholders. This study evaluates whether this is the case in three French pesticide‐intensive production sectors: vine‐growing, orchards and fruits & vegetables farming. To do so, it uses the Q‐method to assess farmers' decision‐making criteria when selecting crop protection strategies, taking stock of technical, economic, and organisational constraints, as well as health and environmental impacts. It also compares these criteria with the perspectives of researchers and advisors on farmers' priorities. After combining a factor analysis with a fractional multilogit model accounting for factor loadings, the findings reveal four distinct profiles across the sample: a competitiveness‐oriented approach; a focus on reducing health and environmental impacts; a risk management perspective; and an integrated vision combining multiple priorities. Being a farmer, advisor or researcher significantly influences the likelihood of belonging to one profile or another. However, close interactions between farmers, researchers, and advisors help bridge differences in priorities, fostering more closely aligned perspectives on crop protection strategies. These results point to key indicators that researchers and advisors could leverage to better inform farmers about alternative crop protection methods, ultimately supporting more sustainable agricultural practices.
10.1111/1477-9552.70023.abstract_zh: 摘要 实现雄心勃勃的农药减量目标，需要多方利益相关者的协作与共同愿景。本研究评估了法国三个农药密集型生产部门——葡萄种植、果园及果蔬种植——是否具备这一条件。为此，采用Q方法评估农户在选择作物保护策略时的决策标准，综合考虑技术、经济和组织约束，以及健康与环境影响。同时，将这些标准与研究人员和顾问对农户优先事项的看法进行比较。通过将因子分析与考虑因子载荷的分数多项逻辑模型相结合，研究结果揭示了样本中四种不同的特征类型：以竞争力为导向的方法；侧重于减少健康与环境影响的方法；风险管理视角；以及综合多重优先事项的整体愿景。作为农户、顾问或研究人员，显著影响归属于某一特征类型的可能性。然而，农户、研究人员和顾问之间的密切互动有助于弥合优先事项上的差异，促进在作物保护策略上形成更为一致的观点。这些结果指出了研究人员和顾问可利用的关键指标，以更好地向农户传达替代作物保护方法，最终支持更可持续的农业实践。

10.1111/1477-9552.70024.abstract: ABSTRACT Research based on farmer surveys is a cornerstone of agricultural economics. Farmer surveys provide unique insights into behavioural variables—such as values, motivations, attitudes, behaviours, and preferences—that are unavailable in secondary datasets. However, the decline in farm numbers across most European countries, combined with a growing number of surveys, is posing a threat to farmer survey research. This paper synthesises current practices in farmer surveys in the Netherlands, Slovenia, and Sweden. Our approach is meta‐scientific, drawing on a survey aimed at researchers responsible for 34 farmer surveys conducted between January 2019 and August 2024. This analysis is complemented by a document analysis and critical reflection workshops. We identify three key challenges: (i) limited consistency and standardisation of socio‐economic survey questions, (ii) long surveys, which are associated with high attrition and low response rates, and (iii) low adoption of open science practices. To address these challenges, we propose a set of best practices to enhance the transparency, comparability, standardisation, and reusability of farmer survey data. These best practices aim to strengthen the quality of survey‐based research in agricultural economics and ensure that farmer surveys continue to support evidence‐based policymaking.
10.1111/1477-9552.70024.abstract_zh: 摘要 基于农户调查的研究是农业经济学的基石。农户调查提供了关于行为变量（如价值观、动机、态度、行为和偏好）的独特见解，这些变量在二手数据集中无法获得。然而，大多数欧洲国家农户数量的下降，加之调查数量的不断增加，正对农户调查研究构成威胁。本文综合了荷兰、斯洛文尼亚和瑞典农户调查的当前实践。我们的方法具有元科学性质，依托一项针对2019年1月至2024年8月期间负责34项农户调查的研究人员的调查。该分析辅以文献分析和批判性反思研讨会。我们识别出三个关键挑战：（i）社会经济调查问题的一致性和标准化程度有限，（ii）调查篇幅过长，导致高流失率和低回复率，以及（iii）开放科学实践的采用率较低。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一套最佳实践，以增强农户调查数据的透明度、可比性、标准化和可重用性。这些最佳实践旨在加强农业经济学中基于调查的研究质量，并确保农户调查继续支持循证政策制定。

10.1111/1477-9552.70025.abstract: The Society's published presidential addresses have embraced a wide range of subject matter, reflecting a ‘road well travelled’ in agricultural economics. The areas covered include the development and use of data and statistics, lessons from history, sectoral analysis, land economics, international trade and international development. There has been a major focus on the application of economic concepts to agricultural and agri‐environmental policy. The addresses also led to consideration of a number of important issues that go beyond the confines of technical analysis to a ‘road less travelled’. These issues include weaknesses in behavioural assumptions in economic theory, the challenge of objectivity in applied analysis, the limitations imposed by a static theoretical framework and the inadequacies of welfare economics in addressing distributional issues in policy choice. The addresses, spanning almost 100 years, demonstrate the role of agricultural economics in evidence‐based policymaking to address critical issues in the use of natural resources. The apparent rejection of the evidence‐based approach in some countries raises the question of whether humankind will be successful in finding a solution to the existential challenge posed by climate change.
10.1111/1477-9552.70025.abstract_zh: 学会发表的会长演讲涵盖了广泛的主题，反映了农业经济学中一条“走过之路”。涉及领域包括数据和统计的发展与应用、历史教训、部门分析、土地经济学、国际贸易及国际发展。重点在于将经济概念应用于农业和农业环境政策。这些演讲还引导了对若干超越技术分析范畴的重要问题的思考，即“未走之路”。这些问题包括经济理论中行为假设的弱点、应用分析中客观性的挑战、静态理论框架带来的局限性，以及福利经济学在处理政策选择中分配问题上的不足。这些跨越近一百年的演讲，展示了农业经济学在基于证据的政策制定中，对解决自然资源利用关键问题所起的作用。一些国家明显拒绝基于证据的方法，这引发了人类能否成功找到应对气候变化这一生存挑战解决方案的疑问。

10.1111/1477-9552.70026.abstract: ABSTRACT Most households in rural Africa are involved in smallholder farming, but off‐farm employment is an important additional income source for many. Previous research has analysed links between off‐farm employment and well‐being, but mostly at the household level, not considering that household members may be affected differently. In particular, gender gaps in employment, nutrition and other well‐being dimensions are widely observed. Here, we use survey data collected in Tanzania and Zambia to examine how women's off‐farm employment influences their individual‐level dietary quality. Regression estimates with instrumental variables show that women's off‐farm employment is associated with improved dietary diversity, including more frequent consumption of nutritious foods such as meat, fish, fruits and vegetables. We also explore potential mechanisms, including changes in household income, women's decision‐making and time allocation. The main results hold across various robustness checks, suggesting that improving women's access to off‐farm employment can help increase household income and reduce widespread gender gaps in rural Africa.
10.1111/1477-9552.70026.abstract_zh: 摘要 非洲农村的大多数家庭从事小规模农业，但对许多家庭而言，非农就业是重要的额外收入来源。以往研究分析了非农就业与福祉之间的联系，但大多集中在家庭层面，未考虑家庭成员可能受到不同影响。尤其是，就业、营养及其他福祉维度上的性别差距普遍存在。本研究利用在坦桑尼亚和赞比亚收集的调查数据，考察女性非农就业对其个人层面膳食质量的影响。采用工具变量的回归估计显示，女性非农就业与膳食多样性改善相关，包括更频繁地消费肉类、鱼类、水果和蔬菜等营养食品。我们还探讨了潜在机制，包括家庭收入变化、女性决策权和时间分配。主要结果在多种稳健性检验中保持一致，表明改善女性非农就业机会有助于增加家庭收入，并缩小非洲农村普遍存在的性别差距。

10.1111/1477-9552.70027.abstract: ABSTRACT Quantifying and improving the environmental performance (EP) of agriculture has become an urgent research and policy priority. Over the past three decades, frontier‐based analytical frameworks have been widely applied to evaluate farm‐level EP. We present a global systematic review and meta‐analysis of 121 studies (comprising 800 unique environmental performance estimates) that use a frontier‐based approach for farm‐level EP evaluation. Adhering to PRISMA guidelines, we extract and synthesise information on modelling approaches, estimation methods, pollutant types, as well as other data and study characteristics. We also consider the determinants for EP. We find that there is inertia in the shift towards more recent and methodologically better environmental performance evaluation techniques, such as the by‐production approach and material balance methods, at the farm level. A random effects meta‐regression reveals that the methodological approach and estimation methods explain the variation in EP. Farm type and inclusion of determinants are also important. We identify multiple significant determinants of environmental performance across agricultural systems. The findings advance academic understanding of how modelling frameworks shape EP estimates. They also offer practical insights to help policymakers understand specific policy variables and farm‐specific factors that could be leveraged to improve environmental performance. For example, fostering pro‐environmental attitudes and encouraging the adoption of sustainable agricultural practices through extension services can help enhance environmental performance in farming.
10.1111/1477-9552.70027.abstract_zh: 摘要 量化并提升农业环境绩效已成为当前研究与政策制定的迫切议题。过去三十年间，基于前沿的分析框架被广泛用于评估农场层面的环境绩效。我们开展了一项全球系统性回顾与元分析，涵盖121项研究（包含800个独特的环境绩效估计值），这些研究均采用前沿方法评估农场环境绩效。遵循PRISMA指南，我们提取并综合了建模方法、估计技术、污染物类型以及其他数据与研究特征的信息，同时探讨了环境绩效的决定因素。研究发现，在农场层面，向更新且方法论上更优的环境绩效评估技术（如副产物法和物质平衡法）的转变存在惯性。随机效应元回归分析显示，方法论途径和估计方法解释了环境绩效的变异，农场类型及决定因素的纳入同样重要。我们识别出多个影响农业系统环境绩效的关键决定因素。这些发现深化了学术界对建模框架如何塑造环境绩效估计的理解，并为政策制定者提供了实用见解，帮助他们识别可通过特定政策变量和农场特定因素来提升环境绩效的途径。例如，通过推广服务培养亲环境态度并鼓励采纳可持续农业实践，有助于增强农业环境绩效。

10.1111/1477-9552.70028.abstract: ABSTRACT Labour contracting, where intermediaries provide farmers with migrant workers, plays a central role in meeting the demand for seasonal labour on labour‐intensive farms. Yet this system poses underresearched challenges for both workers and farmers. A few studies, mostly qualitative, link labour contracting to exploitative conditions, raising concerns about workers' welfare (Sustainable Development Goal 8). However, poor working conditions are widespread in agriculture, and notably, quantitative comparisons between contract and non‐contract workers are lacking. For farmers, these precarious conditions pose a production risk if they lead to higher turnover. However, such links have so far been mainly documented in high‐skilled settings. Here, we address these gaps and provide the first empirical evidence on the links between contract labour, job quality and turnover intention. We use matched worker–employer survey data, rarely available in agricultural research, complemented with qualitative insights from a well‐suited case study: Nigeria's labour‐intensive tomato sector, where farmers recruit workers through personal networks and labour contractors. Using decomposition analysis—commonly used to examine gender gaps—in a novel way, we assess disparities in working conditions between contract and non‐contract workers. Our findings show that contract labour is associated with structural disparities in working conditions. Complementary qualitative insights show how rules, norms and practices embedded in labour contracting systems contribute to these structural inequalities. Paradoxically, despite poorer conditions, contract workers report job satisfaction levels similar to non‐contract workers—likely reflecting limited alternatives. Consequently, turnover intentions are comparable across both groups, with job satisfaction being the primary driver of turnover intentions.
10.1111/1477-9552.70028.abstract_zh: 摘要 劳务承包，即中介机构为农民提供外来务工人员，在满足劳动密集型农场的季节性劳动力需求方面发挥着核心作用。然而，这一体系对工人和农民双方均构成了研究不足的挑战。少数研究，多为定性研究，将劳务承包与剥削性劳动条件联系起来，引发了对工人福利（可持续发展目标8）的担忧。然而，农业领域恶劣的工作条件普遍存在，且值得注意的是，缺乏对合同工与非合同工之间的定量比较。对农民而言，这些不稳定的条件若导致更高的员工流动率，则构成生产风险。然而，此类关联迄今主要在高技能环境中得到记录。在此，我们填补这些空白，首次提供关于合同劳动、工作质量与离职意向之间关联的实证证据。我们使用农业研究中罕见的匹配工人-雇主调查数据，并辅以来自一个适宜案例研究的定性见解：尼日利亚劳动密集型番茄产业，该产业中农民通过个人网络和劳务承包商招募工人。我们创新性地运用分解分析——通常用于考察性别差距——来评估合同工与非合同工之间工作条件的差异。我们的研究结果表明，合同劳动与工作条件的结构性差异相关联。补充的定性见解揭示了劳务承包体系中嵌入的规则、规范和实践如何促成这些结构性不平等。矛盾的是，尽管条件较差，合同工报告的工作满意度与非合同工相似——这可能反映了有限的选择。因此，两组人员的离职意向相当，工作满意度是离职意向的主要驱动因素。

10.1111/1477-9552.70030.abstract: ABSTRACT Developing country governments often launch new agricultural programmes without collecting pre‐implementation survey data, making it difficult to evaluate the effects of such programmes. Leveraging the flexibility of granular pixel‐level satellite panel data and a well‐developed quasi‐experimental policy evaluation design, we study a programme where pre‐implementation data is unavailable. We estimate the effect of cash transfers on agricultural productivity in Telangana, India. Treatment and control regions are within 10 km on either side of the state border. They are identical in all respects except for the difference in exposure to policy treatment. Agricultural productivity increased in the major monsoon cropping season due to the cash transfer programme. The findings also reveal that cash transfers helped reduce productivity gaps between irrigated and rainfed agricultural areas. Our results are robust to two different sources of satellite data, three alternative indicators of productivity, two rounds of full‐scale resampling, 100 rounds of small‐scale resampling and three alternative border designs. Placebo regressions of two previous years also confirm our results. This approach to policy evaluation is applicable anywhere satellite data are available in the world.
10.1111/1477-9552.70030.abstract_zh: 摘要 发展中国家政府经常在未收集实施前调查数据的情况下启动新的农业项目，这使得评估此类项目的效果变得困难。利用高分辨率像素级卫星面板数据的灵活性以及成熟的准实验政策评估设计，我们研究了一个缺乏实施前数据的项目。我们估算了印度特伦甘纳邦现金转移对农业生产力的影响。处理组和对照组区域位于州界两侧各10公里范围内，除政策处理暴露程度不同外，其余各方面均相同。现金转移项目在主要季风种植季节提高了农业生产力。研究结果还显示，现金转移有助于缩小灌溉农业与雨养农业之间的生产力差距。我们的结果对两种不同来源的卫星数据、三种替代生产力指标、两轮全规模重采样、100轮小规模重采样以及三种替代边界设计均保持稳健。前两年的安慰剂回归也证实了我们的结果。这种政策评估方法适用于全球任何可获得卫星数据的地区。

10.1111/1477-9552.70031.abstract: ABSTRACT Biofortified foods offer a promising solution to micronutrient deficiencies affecting billions worldwide, yet their potential remains constrained by limited consumer acceptance. While information plays a critical role in shaping consumers' evaluation of biofortified food products, existing evidence on its effectiveness in improving acceptance remains inconclusive across different contexts. Moreover, there is a notable lack of systematic synthesis of the effects of information interventions, particularly given the wide variation in outcome measures used in the literature. This study examines how information influences consumer evaluations of biofortified foods and identifies factors that moderate its impact. Using meta‐regression analysis based on 87 effect sizes from 34 empirical studies across 22 countries, we estimate the average effect of information provision and explore the influencing factors. Results from random‐effects models and weighted least squares regressions show that information has a significant though modest positive effect on consumer evaluation (Cohen's d = 0.27, 95% CI: 0.25–0.30). Variations in impacts can be explained by product characteristics, information design, study design and contextual factors. Future intervention campaigns should be tailored to enhance consumer acceptance and support biofortified food deployment in regions with nutritional deficits.
10.1111/1477-9552.70031.abstract_zh: 摘要 生物强化食品为解决影响全球数十亿人的微量营养素缺乏问题提供了一种有前景的方案，但其潜力仍受限于消费者接受度不高。尽管信息在塑造消费者对生物强化食品的评价中起着关键作用，但现有关于其提升接受度有效性的证据在不同情境下尚无定论。此外，鉴于文献中结果测量指标的广泛差异，对信息干预效果的系统性综合研究明显不足。本研究考察信息如何影响消费者对生物强化食品的评价，并识别调节其影响的因素。基于对22个国家34项实证研究中87个效应量的元回归分析，我们估计了信息提供的平均效应并探讨了影响因素。随机效应模型和加权最小二乘回归的结果显示，信息对消费者评价具有显著但适度的正向效应（Cohen's d = 0.27，95%置信区间：0.25–0.30）。影响的差异可由产品特征、信息设计、研究设计和情境因素来解释。未来的干预活动应量身定制，以提升消费者接受度，并支持生物强化食品在营养缺乏地区的推广。

10.1111/1477-9552.70032.abstract: ABSTRACT Existing studies generally use “aggregate” temperature measures—such as mean temperature, degree‐days, temperature bins, and piecewise linear functions within the growing season—to estimate the impact of global warming on crop yields. These temperature measures blend temperatures from different phenological stages of crop growth, thereby implicitly assuming that temperatures are additively substitutable within the growing season. However, this assumption contradicts agronomic knowledge, which indicates that crops are more sensitive to temperatures during certain phenological stages. Utilising unique site‐level data on the detailed phenological stages of major crops in China, combined with crop production data and daily weather data, we develop an econometric model with stage‐specific temperature measures. We then compare our estimates with models using traditional aggregate temperature measures. Our results show that adopting an aggregate temperature measure could overestimate the damage of predicted global warming on crop yields by up to two times compared to estimates using stage‐specific temperature measures.
10.1111/1477-9552.70032.abstract_zh: 摘要 现有研究通常采用“总体”温度指标——如生长期内的平均温度、度日、温度区间及分段线性函数——来评估全球变暖对作物产量的影响。这些温度指标混合了作物不同物候阶段的温度，从而隐含假设生长期内温度具有可加替代性。然而，这一假设与农学知识相悖，后者表明作物在特定物候阶段对温度更为敏感。利用中国主要作物详细物候阶段的独特站点级数据，结合作物生产数据和逐日天气数据，我们构建了一个包含阶段特定温度指标的计量经济模型。随后，我们将我们的估计结果与使用传统总体温度指标的模型进行比较。结果显示，与使用阶段特定温度指标的估计相比，采用总体温度指标可能将预测的全球变暖对作物产量的损害高估至多两倍。

10.1111/1477-9552.70033.abstract: As global demand for beef increases, balancing livestock productivity with environmental sustainability has become a policy priority. In response, Uruguay implemented the Sustainable Family Production Programme (PFIS) between 2015 and 2017, providing targeted support for small and medium‐sized cattle farmers to invest in productivity‐enhancing and climate‐adaptive technologies. This study provides the first causal evaluation of a national programme designed to promote these dual objectives in the cattle sector. Using a regression discontinuity design based on a strict eligibility threshold and panel data from 2015 to 2020, we evaluate the programme's effect on five dimensions: (i) the adoption of technology and practices, (ii) engagement in producer organisations, (iii) reported cattle health problems, (iv) beef production per hectare, and (v) greenhouse gas emissions intensity. The intervention significantly increased the application of reproductive and herd management practices, specifically early weaning, controlled mating, and ovarian activity diagnosis, without generating shifts in the other measured outcomes by the 2020 horizon. These results highlight both the potential and the limitations of integrated technology transfer programmes in promoting sustainable intensification of extensive livestock systems. They also suggest the need for longer‐term evaluations to capture potential effects on productivity and emissions that may emerge as these technologies, particularly reproductive ones, influence aggregate outcomes.
10.1111/1477-9552.70033.abstract_zh: 随着全球牛肉需求增长，平衡畜牧业生产力与环境可持续性已成为政策重点。为此，乌拉圭于2015年至2017年间实施了可持续家庭生产计划（PFIS），为中小型养牛户提供针对性支持，以投资于提升生产力和气候适应性技术。本研究首次对旨在促进养牛业双重目标的国家级计划进行因果评估。基于严格资格门槛的断点回归设计及2015-2020年面板数据，我们从五个维度评估该计划的效果：（i）技术与实践采纳率；（ii）生产者组织参与度；（iii）报告牛群健康问题；（iv）每公顷牛肉产量；（v）温室气体排放强度。该干预措施显著提高了繁殖与畜群管理实践的应用率，具体表现为早期断奶、控制配种及卵巢活动诊断，但截至2020年，其他衡量指标未发生显著变化。这些结果既揭示了综合性技术推广计划在促进粗放型畜牧系统可持续集约化方面的潜力，也凸显了其局限性。同时表明，随着这些技术（尤其是繁殖技术）对总体产出产生影响，需开展更长期评估以捕捉其对生产力和排放的潜在效应。
10.1111/1477-9552.70033.title: Outcomes of a Public Program to Support Sustainable Livestock Farming: Evidence From Uruguay
10.1111/1477-9552.70033.title_zh: 乌拉圭支持可持续畜牧业公共项目的成效：来自实证的证据

10.1111/1477-9552.70034.abstract: ABSTRACT Linking payments from agri‐environment schemes to ecological results or to collective outcomes is viewed as a promising way to increase the effectiveness of agri‐environmental conservation. However, the two approaches are rarely combined. In this study, we test the performance of result‐based payments with collective contracts in a contextualised economic experiment with 540 non‐agricultural and agricultural students in Germany. Combining result‐based payments with collective contracts may hold potential by allowing farmers to share the risks associated with result‐based payments within a group. A downside of collective contracts, however, is the creation of a social dilemma, as individual payments depend on group outcomes. We find no evidence of differences in conservation levels under result‐based payments with collective as compared to individual contracts, suggesting that risk‐sharing benefits and effects of the social dilemma offset each other. We further examine the performance of collective contracts for varying risk levels that could, for example, reflect different geological and climatic conditions across Europe. Result‐based payments with collective contracts motivate higher conservation efforts in our experiment when external risks are high. Further, high risks appear to foster group cooperation under collective contracts, potentially leading to more equitable and predictable outcomes.
10.1111/1477-9552.70034.abstract_zh: 摘要 将农业环境计划的支付与生态结果或集体成果挂钩，被视为提升农业环境保护有效性的有前景途径。然而，这两种方法很少被结合使用。在本研究中，我们通过一项情境化经济实验，对德国540名非农业和农业学生进行了基于结果的支付与集体合同的绩效测试。将基于结果的支付与集体合同结合，可能通过允许农民在群体内分担与基于结果的支付相关的风险而具有潜力。然而，集体合同的一个缺点是产生了社会困境，因为个体支付依赖于群体成果。我们发现，在基于结果的支付下，集体合同与个体合同在保护水平上没有差异，这表明风险分担的好处与社会困境的影响相互抵消。我们进一步考察了不同风险水平下集体合同的表现，这些风险水平可能反映欧洲各地不同的地质和气候条件。在我们的实验中，当外部风险较高时，基于结果的支付与集体合同能激励更高的保护努力。此外，高风险似乎促进了集体合同下的群体合作，可能导致更公平和可预测的结果。

10.1111/1477-9552.70035.abstract: ABSTRACT Within the EU and beyond, voluntary agri‐environmental and climate schemes (AES) are used to curtail externalities from agricultural production including nitrate leaching, biodiversity degradation and greenhouse gas emissions. This paper investigates and compares Danish landowners' preferences for temporary and permanent AES using a choice experiment (CE). We focus on landowners, who are the decision makers in terms of permanent land use change. Our study focuses on two land set‐aside contracts: temporary with annual payments and permanent with a lump‐sum payment. Results reveal that landowners require higher compensation if AES design implies giving up direct subsidy payments and hunting rights under both permanent and temporary set aside schemes. Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) direct payments were valued lower in the presence of the CAP agricultural activity requirement in permanent contracts compared to a situation without an activity requirement. As expected, landowners require higher compensation for longer commitments in temporary schemes and for rewetting commitments in permanent schemes. The average implied discount rate for schemes that mirror actual annual and lump‐sum permanent schemes offered to farmers in Denmark is 3.3%–3.4%, while that based on the CE is 1.9%–2.1%. Comparing implicit discount rates of hypothetical CE schemes with current Danish AES highlights a significant policy design misalignment. The implication is that current policy favours flexible annual payments, while the societal benefits from permanent schemes are arguably higher.
10.1111/1477-9552.70035.abstract_zh: 摘要 在欧盟及其他地区，自愿性农业环境与气候计划（AES）被用于遏制农业生产带来的外部性，包括硝酸盐淋溶、生物多样性退化及温室气体排放。本文通过选择实验（CE）调查并比较了丹麦土地所有者对临时性和永久性AES的偏好。我们重点关注土地所有者，他们是永久性土地利用变化的决策者。本研究聚焦于两种土地休耕合同：临时性合同采用年度支付，永久性合同采用一次性支付。结果显示，若AES设计涉及放弃直接补贴支付和狩猎权，土地所有者在永久性和临时性休耕计划下均要求更高的补偿。在永久性合同中，存在共同农业政策（CAP）农业活动要求时，CAP直接支付的价值低于无活动要求的情况。如预期所料，土地所有者对临时性计划中更长的承诺期及永久性计划中的再湿润承诺要求更高的补偿。对于与丹麦农民实际提供的年度和一次性永久性计划相对应的方案，平均隐含贴现率为3.3%–3.4%，而基于CE的贴现率为1.9%–2.1%。将假设性CE方案的隐含贴现率与当前丹麦AES进行比较，揭示了显著的政策设计错位。其含义在于，当前政策偏向于灵活的年度支付，而永久性计划的社会效益可能更高。

10.1111/1477-9552.70036.abstract: ABSTRACT High internal coordination costs may put cooperatives at a disadvantage in the production and marketing of agri‐food products with hedonic quality attributes. The efficiency of cooperatives and non‐cooperatives is therefore compared with respect to their ability to place wines on the market at prices that reflect their measurable quality attributes. The results of a stochastic metafrontier panel of 1240 wine prices from two German wine guides suggest that consumers should purchase wine from cooperatives if they are seeking a favourable relation between market prices and wine quality. In turn, members of wine cooperatives should ask themselves why non‐cooperatives are typically better at achieving higher prices for the respective quality of their wines and how they can close the price gap with non‐cooperative wineries.
10.1111/1477-9552.70036.abstract_zh: 摘要 高昂的内部协调成本可能使合作社在生产和销售具有享乐性质量属性的农产品时处于劣势。因此，本文比较了合作社与非合作社在将葡萄酒以反映其可测量质量属性的价格投放市场方面的效率。基于来自两本德国葡萄酒指南的1240个葡萄酒价格随机元前沿面板数据，结果表明，如果消费者寻求市场价格与葡萄酒质量之间的有利关系，应从合作社购买葡萄酒。反过来，葡萄酒合作社的成员应反思为何非合作社通常更能为其相应质量的葡萄酒获得更高价格，以及如何缩小与非合作社酒庄之间的价格差距。

10.1111/1477-9552.70037.abstract: ABSTRACT Grasslands in Central Europe are increasingly affected by droughts, leading to lower hay yields and reduced profits for dairy farmers. The insurance hypothesis suggests that extensively managed, species‐rich grassland is more drought resistant than intensively managed grassland. However, it produces lower yields in non‐drought years, creating a trade‐off between maximising yield and improving stability. In this study, we analyse how this trade‐off translates into farmers' management decisions. Using a mechanistic bio‐economic model, we evaluate outcomes across a wide range of simulated ecological, climatic and economic input conditions. We apply classification tree analysis to identify key drivers of extensive management under expected utility, cumulative prospect theory and an extension we call reference‐based valuation, where outcomes are valued relative to management‐specific expectations. Results suggest that farmers who evaluate profits against the expected outcome under each management intensity potentially adopt extensive management despite lower expected profit if it offers greater stability during droughts. By contrast, when outcomes are compared to the status quo of intensive management, or when farmers maximise utility, extensive management is only predicted if foregone yields do not outweigh higher drought stability. Our findings highlight that adoption decisions depend strongly on the valuation perspective, motivating further applications of reference‐based behavioural models and research on how farmers' reference profits might evolve under climate change. They also suggest policy entry points: targeted extension services and demonstration farms could broaden evaluation perspectives, while financial incentives such as payments for ecosystem services could reduce adoption thresholds due to forgone yields under profit‐oriented decision‐making.
10.1111/1477-9552.70037.abstract_zh: 摘要 中欧的草原日益受到干旱影响，导致干草产量下降，奶农利润减少。保险假说认为，粗放管理、物种丰富的草原比集约管理的草原更具抗旱性。然而，在非干旱年份其产量较低，从而在最大化产量与提升稳定性之间形成权衡。本研究分析了这一权衡如何转化为农户的管理决策。我们采用机制性生物经济模型，在广泛的模拟生态、气候和经济输入条件下评估结果。我们应用分类树分析，识别在期望效用、累积前景理论以及我们称之为基于参考估值（即结果相对于各管理方式特定预期进行评价）的扩展框架下粗放管理的关键驱动因素。结果表明，若农户将利润与每种管理强度下的预期结果进行比较，即使预期利润较低，也可能因粗放管理在干旱期间提供更高稳定性而采纳该方式。相比之下，当结果与集约管理的现状进行比较，或农户追求效用最大化时，仅当放弃的产量不超过更高的干旱稳定性时，才预测会采纳粗放管理。我们的发现强调，采纳决策强烈依赖于估值视角，这激励了基于参考的行为模型的进一步应用，以及关于气候变化下农户参考利润可能如何演变的研究。这些发现还提示了政策切入点：针对性的推广服务和示范农场可拓宽评估视角，而生态系统服务付费等财政激励可在利润导向决策下降低因放弃产量而产生的采纳门槛。

10.1111/1477-9552.70038.abstract: ABSTRACT Agricultural methane emissions represent a significant contributor to global climate change, with irrigated rice cultivation being one of the primary sources. Despite the availability of effective mitigation technologies, their adoption often remains limited due to behavioural and institutional constraints. Water management practice that extends drainage periods during cultivation can curb methane emissions from irrigated rice at low cost, yet uptake among Japanese farmers remains modest. We surveyed 2219 rice producers in Shiga Prefecture using a labelled choice experiment that embedded two behavioural nudges (social norm and loss aversion) and one informational boost (knowledge enhancement), presented with or without a reminder. Farmers most favoured a 7‐day drainage extension. Social‐norm messages did not robustly shift adoption intentions, but loss‐aversion and knowledge enhancement paired with reminders increased the probability of choosing water management practice by 5–10 percentage points, particularly when financial incentives were modest. The added value of nudges and boosts faded once subsidies approached prevailing ceiling levels, suggesting diminishing marginal returns to stacking instruments. These findings suggest that timely, low‐cost behavioural interventions can effectively complement agri‐environmental payments in resource‐constrained settings, providing a scalable and context‐sensitive strategy to accelerate the adoption of climate‐smart rice practices.
10.1111/1477-9552.70038.abstract_zh: 摘要 农业甲烷排放是全球气候变化的重要贡献因素，其中灌溉水稻种植是主要排放源之一。尽管存在有效的减排技术，但由于行为与制度约束，其采用率往往有限。在种植期间延长排水期的水分管理实践能够以低成本减少灌溉水稻的甲烷排放，然而日本农户的采纳率仍然不高。我们对滋贺县2219名水稻生产者开展了一项标注选择实验，其中嵌入了两种行为助推（社会规范与损失厌恶）和一种信息增强（知识提升），并设置有无提醒的呈现方式。农户最偏好延长排水7天的方案。社会规范信息未能稳健地改变采纳意愿，但损失厌恶和知识提升配合提醒措施，将选择水分管理实践的概率提高了5至10个百分点，尤其在经济激励较为有限时效果显著。当补贴接近现行上限水平时，助推与增强措施的附加价值逐渐消失，表明叠加干预工具的边际回报递减。这些发现表明，及时且低成本的行为干预能够在资源受限环境中有效补充农业环境支付，提供一种可扩展且情境敏感的策略，以加速气候智能型水稻实践的采纳。

10.1111/1477-9552.70039.abstract: ABSTRACT Farmers' adoption of climate change mitigation practices is crucial for reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from food production. One major source of these emissions is chemical fertilizer application. Introducing clover into grassland can mitigate emissions by reducing the need for chemical fertilizers. In this study, we conduct an information experiment with over 300 Irish dairy farmers to examine how information impacts their beliefs about clover adoption, and how this in turn influences subsequent intentions. Methodologically, we contribute to the literature by combining qualitative (i.e., open‐ended questions) and quantitative (i.e., point estimates) belief elicitation measures in our experimental design. This approach provides more detailed insights into farmers' beliefs, as it captures top‐of‐mind concerns without priming responses. Our qualitative belief elicitation reveals that after exposure to the information treatments, while most farmers did not change their opinions, some shifted from concerns such as ‘ bloat ’ and ‘ difficult ’ to terms like ‘ reduction ’ and ‘ possible ’. Our quantitative measures show that farmers underestimated clover's potential to reduce chemical fertilizer use. This finding is key for policymakers, as similar underestimations may apply to other GHG mitigation practices. Importantly, we provide causal evidence that information could reduce misperceptions. This highlights the need for strategies that positively shift beliefs to encourage more widespread uptake of climate change mitigation practices. Nonetheless, there was no meaningful impact of the updated beliefs on intentions, which underlines the complexity of adoption decisions.
10.1111/1477-9552.70039.abstract_zh: 摘要 农民采纳气候变化减缓措施对于减少粮食生产中的温室气体排放至关重要。化学肥料施用是这些排放的主要来源之一。在草地中引入三叶草可通过减少化学肥料需求来减缓排放。本研究通过对300多名爱尔兰奶牛农民进行信息实验，考察信息如何影响他们对三叶草采纳的信念，以及这种信念变化如何进一步影响后续意图。在方法论上，我们通过将定性（即开放式问题）和定量（即点估计）信念引出措施结合到实验设计中，为文献做出贡献。这种方法能更细致地洞察农民的信念，因为它捕捉了首要关注点而不引导回答。我们的定性信念引出显示，在接触信息处理后，尽管大多数农民未改变观点，但部分人从“膨胀”和“困难”等担忧转向“减少”和“可能”等表述。定量测量显示，农民低估了三叶草减少化学肥料使用的潜力。这一发现对政策制定者至关重要，因为类似的低估可能适用于其他温室气体减缓措施。重要的是，我们提供了因果证据表明信息可以减少误解。这凸显了采取策略积极转变信念以促进更广泛采纳气候变化减缓措施的必要性。尽管如此，更新后的信念对意图没有显著影响，这强调了采纳决策的复杂性。

10.1111/1477-9552.70040.abstract: ABSTRACT Small seed packs for demonstration and testing are widely used to stimulate the uptake of improved crop varieties, yet evidence on their effectiveness remains mixed. This study examines whether small seed packs distributed either for free or at a subsidised price enhance farmers' knowledge and subsequent adoption of improved legumes, drought‐tolerant maize, and improved traditional African vegetables in Tanzania and Zambia. Drawing on mobile phone survey data and applying entropy balancing alongside machine‐learning methods to address selection bias, we find consistent evidence that seed packs increase both technical knowledge and adoption of these crops. Knowledge gains are strongest for crops with limited prior exposure, while improvements for familiar crops such as drought‐tolerant maize likely reflect experiential learning rather than new information. Adoption effects are positive across all crops and robust to alternative estimation strategies. Overall, the results indicate that small seed packs can serve as an effective demand‐creation tool, particularly in settings where farmers face information gaps or uncertainty about the performance of improved germplasm.
10.1111/1477-9552.70040.abstract_zh: 摘要 用于示范和测试的小型种子包被广泛用于促进改良作物品种的采用，但其有效性的证据仍然不一。本研究考察了免费或以补贴价格分发的小型种子包是否增强了坦桑尼亚和赞比亚农民对改良豆类、耐旱玉米及改良传统非洲蔬菜的知识及随后的采用情况。利用移动电话调查数据，并应用熵平衡结合机器学习方法以解决选择偏差，我们发现一致的证据表明，种子包同时提高了这些作物的技术知识和采用率。知识增益在先前接触有限的作物上最为显著，而对于如耐旱玉米等熟悉作物的改善可能反映了经验学习而非新信息。采用效应在所有作物中均为正向，并对替代估计策略具有稳健性。总体而言，结果表明小型种子包可作为有效的需求创造工具，尤其是在农民面临信息缺口或对改良种质性能存在不确定性的环境中。

10.1111/1477-9552.70041.abstract: This paper quantifies the economy‐wide consequences of two independent global stress‐tests in livestock production. The first assesses the effects of phasing out antimicrobial growth promoters (AGPs), and the second evaluates the long‐term impacts of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) progression. We use a sequential, one‐way modelling framework combining a global partial equilibrium (PE) model and a global computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to trace how scenario‐defined shocks in livestock production propagate through world agricultural markets and the wider economy. The highest‐impact AGPs phase‐out scenario results in cumulative global livestock production losses, valued at constant 2021–2023 prices, of roughly USD 53 billion over 2025–2040, with annual deviations that peak in the mid‐2020s and then decline as output converges along scenario‐defined recovery paths. In contrast, the highest‐impact AMR scenario produces persistent and compounding reductions by construction, with cumulative production losses of about USD 318 billion by 2040, while cumulative economy‐wide welfare losses in this high‐impact case reach approximately USD 1.25 trillion, concentrated mainly in upper–middle‐income countries. Results are scenario dependent by construction and represent indicative orders of magnitude rather than forecasts. The baseline implicitly reflects prevailing levels of AGPs and AMR embedded in historical production trends. The study provides a framework for quantifying the production effects of antimicrobial use (AMU) and their economy‐wide spillovers, highlighting the asymmetric timing of the economic costs of action and inaction under the imposed scenario structure.
10.1111/1477-9552.70041.abstract_zh: 本文量化了畜牧业生产中两项独立全球压力测试对整体经济的影响。第一项评估了逐步淘汰抗生素生长促进剂（AGPs）的效应，第二项评估了抗生素耐药性（AMR）持续发展的长期影响。我们采用序贯单向建模框架，结合全球局部均衡（PE）模型与全球可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，追踪情景设定的畜牧业生产冲击如何通过世界农产品市场及更广泛的经济体系传导。在影响最大的AGPs淘汰情景下，以2021-2023年不变价格计算，2025-2040年间全球畜牧业累计产量损失约为530亿美元，年度偏离值在2020年代中期达到峰值，随后随产出沿情景设定的恢复路径收敛而下降。相比之下，影响最大的AMR情景因设定机制产生持续且叠加的减产效应，至2040年累计产量损失约达3180亿美元，而该高影响情景下的累计经济福利损失约为1.25万亿美元，主要集中于中高收入国家。研究结果本质上具有情景依赖性，仅代表指示性量级而非预测值。基准情景隐含地反映了历史生产趋势中固有的AGPs与AMR水平。本研究为量化抗生素使用（AMU）的生产效应及其经济溢出提供了分析框架，揭示了在既定情景结构下，采取行动与不采取行动所产生经济成本在时间维度上的非对称性。
10.1111/1477-9552.70041.title: Antimicrobial Use in Livestock: The Economic Cost of Action or Inaction
10.1111/1477-9552.70041.title_zh: 畜牧业中抗生素的使用：行动或不行动的经济成本

10.1111/1477-9552.70042.abstract: ABSTRACT Rising sea levels and salinity intrusion increasingly threaten rice farming in Vietnam's Mekong Delta. Using a district‐level panel dataset from 2000 to 2020, this study examines the impacts of salinity on Winter–Spring rice yields and acreage and how farmers adapt to salinity risk. A Nerlovian adaptive expectations model is applied to assess how past exposure influences land‐use decisions.
