Results show that extreme salinity events exert a stronger and more persistent effect on acreage adjustments than year‐to‐year fluctuations, with reductions most pronounced in salinity‐prone and coastal districts. Spatial heterogeneity underscores the need for location‐specific strategies: infrastructure and salt‐tolerant varieties for inland areas, and support for transitions to alternative land uses in highly exposed regions. Evidence of complementarities between rice and aquaculture suggests integrated systems can sustain production under moderate salinity pressure. These findings highlight the importance of tailored interventions to enhance resilience as salinity intrusion intensifies with sea‐level rise.
10.1111/1477-9552.70042.abstract_zh: 摘要 海平面上升和盐水入侵日益威胁越南湄公河三角洲的水稻种植。利用2000年至2020年区级面板数据，本研究考察了盐度对冬春稻产量及种植面积的影响，以及农民如何适应盐度风险。采用Nerlovian适应性预期模型评估过去暴露如何影响土地利用决策。结果表明，极端盐度事件对种植面积调整的影响比逐年波动更为强烈且持久，其中在易受盐度影响和沿海地区减少最为显著。空间异质性凸显了针对特定地点策略的必要性：在内陆地区推广基础设施和耐盐品种，在高度暴露区域支持向替代土地利用方式转型。水稻与水产养殖之间互补性的证据表明，在中等盐度压力下，综合系统可维持生产。这些发现强调了随着海平面上升导致盐度入侵加剧，采取量身定制的干预措施以增强韧性的重要性。

10.1111/1477-9552.70043.abstract: ABSTRACT Agricultural production and the food supply chain have a significant impact on the environment. To foster an environmentally sustainable food system, it is vital to change consumers' food choice patterns to be more environmentally sustainable. This study presents a concept ladder , a simplified model under which consumers may be at different stages in terms of their willingness and ability to make environmentally sustainable food choices: some may have little concern, others may have more concern but require the impetus of broader social norms to modify their choices, while a final group may have strong concern but in some cases be unable to exercise their preferences because of financial or other constraints. To empirically test this concept, we conducted a large‐scale randomised experiment involving Japanese consumers through two online surveys. In the first survey, respondents were randomly separated into three groups and provided with either environmental issue information (T1), social norm information (T2) or no information (Control). Two weeks later, a follow‐up survey was conducted to compare the actual environmental sustainability of food choice behaviours among the groups. The results show that the treatment effect of T1 is the largest for those with a low level of environmental concern, while the treatment effect of T2 is the largest for those with a moderate level of environmental concern, consistent with the ladder concept. Several robustness checks support these findings.
10.1111/1477-9552.70043.abstract_zh: 摘要 农业生产及食品供应链对环境具有显著影响。为构建环境可持续的食品体系，转变消费者的食品选择模式以更加环境友好至关重要。本研究提出“概念阶梯”这一简化模型，在该模型下，消费者在做出环境可持续食品选择的意愿和能力方面可能处于不同阶段：部分消费者可能关注度较低，另一些则可能关注度较高但需借助更广泛社会规范的推动来调整其选择，而最后一类消费者可能具有强烈关注，但在某些情况下因财务或其他限制而无法践行其偏好。为实证检验这一概念，我们通过两项在线调查对日本消费者进行了大规模随机实验。在第一项调查中，受访者被随机分为三组，分别接收环境问题信息（T1）、社会规范信息（T2）或未接收任何信息（对照组）。两周后，进行后续调查以比较各组食品选择行为的实际环境可持续性。结果显示，T1的处理效应在环境关注度较低的群体中最大，而T2的处理效应在环境关注度中等的群体中最大，这与阶梯概念相符。多项稳健性检验支持了这些发现。

10.1111/1477-9552.70044.abstract: The foods that consumers purchase and how they purchase food are changing over time. In this article, we discuss how health prioritization and environmental concerns, combined with new technologies, are changing consumers' food preferences and retail choices. Wellness trends have increased attention to functional attributes and specific nutrients such as protein, while intensifying scrutiny of ultra‐processed foods. Adoption of personalized technologies, including prescription medications, wearable devices and diet‐tracking apps, may alter the volume and composition of food consumed. Many consumers are also willing to pay a premium for sustainability claims, but may conflate environmental standards and healthfulness, which raises questions about credibility and effective labeling design. All of these considerations may be impacted by affordability concerns following a period of supply‐chain disruptions and disease outbreaks since 2020, causing food price inflation. This, combined with increasing income inequality, has resulted in a bifurcation of demand between value and premium consumer segments. Preferences are further separated by the channel consumers use to purchase food, as many households still purchase groceries online and order meals for delivery after the COVID‐19 pandemic. The availability of highly detailed consumer purchasing and health data allows for compelling future research on the causal relationships that arise from these trends, which will continue to shape the global food environment.
10.1111/1477-9552.70044.abstract_zh: 消费者购买的食物及其购买方式正在随着时间不断演变。本文探讨了健康优先意识与环境关切，结合新技术的发展，如何改变消费者的食品偏好及零售选择。健康趋势增强了对功能性属性和特定营养素（如蛋白质）的关注，同时加剧了对超加工食品的审视。个性化技术的应用，包括处方药物、可穿戴设备和饮食追踪应用程序，可能改变食品消费的数量与构成。许多消费者也愿意为可持续性声明支付溢价，但可能将环境标准与健康性混为一谈，这引发了关于可信度及有效标签设计的问题。自2020年以来，供应链中断和疾病爆发导致食品价格通胀，加之收入不平等加剧，所有这些考量都可能受到可负担性担忧的影响。这一状况与日益扩大的收入差距相结合，导致了价值型与高端消费群体之间需求的二元分化。消费者购买食品的渠道进一步区分了偏好，因为疫情后，许多家庭仍继续在线购买杂货并订购外卖。高度详细的消费者购买和健康数据的可得性，为未来研究这些趋势引发的因果关系提供了有力支持，这些趋势将持续塑造全球食品环境。

10.1111/1477-9552.70045.abstract: We use a discrete choice experiment along with behavioral measures of risk and time preferences to analyze the preferences of Uruguayan cattle producers for three types of sustainable livestock practices: improved grazing systems, sustainable livestock management, and silvopastoral approaches. The results indicate that, on average, producers favor sustainable intensification, are indifferent to improved grazing practices, and require monetary compensation to adopt silvopastoral systems. A latent class model reveals significant preference heterogeneity, identifying two distinct producer profiles: one inclined to adopt the proposed practices and another that requires stronger incentives. These findings underscore the importance of designing differentiated policy instruments tailored to the characteristics and motivations of diverse producer types.
10.1111/1477-9552.70045.abstract_zh: 我们采用离散选择实验，并结合风险与时间偏好的行为度量，分析了乌拉圭养牛生产者对三类可持续畜牧业实践——改良放牧系统、可持续畜牧管理及林牧复合系统——的偏好。结果显示，平均而言，生产者倾向于可持续集约化，对改良放牧实践持中立态度，而采纳林牧复合系统则需要经济补偿。潜在类别模型揭示了显著的偏好异质性，识别出两类不同的生产者特征：一类倾向于采纳所提议的实践，另一类则需要更强的激励措施。这些发现强调了设计差异化政策工具的重要性，以适应不同生产者类型的特征与动机。

10.1111/1477-9552.70046.abstract: ABSTRACT Important developments in infrastructure and institutions characterized 19th‐Century wheat markets in Great Britain. Among these developments was the construction of the national rail system which enabled cheaper and more efficient transport of grain and other bulky cargoes between inland towns and ports. We consider the degree to which wheat markets in twelve British cities were spatially integrated over the nineteenth century by applying conventional threshold models and semi‐nonparametric (generalized additive) models of spatial price linkages. Although results concerning market integration are qualitatively similar, the semi‐nonparametric models capture important nonlinearities that may be missed by conventional threshold models. Both approaches support a high degree of integration among the spatially distinct markets. We then consider two sub‐samples from 1800–1840 and 1870–1913 to capture price transmission before and after the repeal of the Corn Laws, the development of the railway system, the improvement of steam engines for ocean transport, and the introduction of the telegraph system. The nonlinear models suggest faster equilibration in response to large shocks and tighter transaction cost bands in the second period.
10.1111/1477-9552.70046.abstract_zh: 摘要 19世纪英国小麦市场的发展以基础设施和制度的重大进步为特征。其中，全国铁路系统的建设使得谷物及其他大宗货物在内陆城镇与港口之间的运输更加廉价和高效。我们通过应用传统阈值模型和半非参数（广义可加）空间价格联动模型，考察了19世纪英国十二个城市小麦市场在空间上的整合程度。尽管关于市场整合的结果在性质上相似，但半非参数模型捕捉到了传统阈值模型可能遗漏的重要非线性特征。两种方法均支持这些空间上相互分离的市场具有高度整合性。随后，我们选取1800–1840年和1870–1913年两个子样本，以考察《谷物法》废除、铁路系统发展、远洋运输蒸汽机改进以及电报系统引入前后的价格传导情况。非线性模型表明，在第二个时期，市场对较大冲击的均衡调整速度更快，交易成本区间也更窄。

10.1111/1477-9552.70047.abstract: The Orinoquía region is one of Colombia's principal agricultural frontiers and has been shaped by long‐standing armed‐conflict dynamics that continue to influence land governance, producer incentives, and investment decisions. Efforts to promote sustainable cattle production emphasize two key practices: sustainable pasture management (including rotational grazing systems) and ecologically appropriate stocking rates. However, their adoption varies widely because of institutional, economic, and biophysical constraints. This study applies a dual binary choice framework to examine the adoption decisions associated with these two practices and to assess whether they operate sequentially or independently. Results show that tenure security, measured through formal landownership, is strongly associated with the adoption of sustainable pasture management. In contrast, access to technical assistance is negatively associated with adoption, suggesting issues of program quality, targeting, or reverse causality. Older and more experienced producers are less likely to adopt, indicating path dependence. For stocking‐rate decisions, rotational and alternating grazing systems exhibit lower probabilities of meeting sustainable thresholds, likely reflecting implementation challenges in extensive systems. Larger finishing areas also tend to be managed less sustainably, and descriptive evidence suggests that unsustainable stocking in our sample is more frequently associated with understocking than overstocking, with 239 producers (70%) below 1 animal per hectare. These findings illustrate how structural and institutional conditions, including those linked to conflict legacies, shape sustainability transitions in the Orinoquía and can inform more tailored policy interventions for frontier livestock regions.
10.1111/1477-9552.70047.abstract_zh: 奥里诺基亚地区是哥伦比亚主要的农业边疆之一，长期武装冲突动态持续影响着土地治理、生产者激励和投资决策。推动可持续畜牧业发展的努力聚焦于两项关键实践：可持续牧场管理（包括轮牧系统）和生态适宜载畜率。然而，由于制度、经济和生物物理条件的制约，这些实践的采纳程度差异显著。本研究采用二元选择框架，分析这两项实践的采纳决策，并评估其是顺序推进还是独立进行。结果表明，通过正式土地所有权衡量的产权保障与可持续牧场管理的采纳密切相关。相反，技术援助的获取与采纳呈负相关，暗示项目质量、目标定位或反向因果问题。年龄较大、经验更丰富的生产者采纳意愿较低，体现了路径依赖效应。在载畜率决策中，轮牧和交替放牧系统达到可持续阈值的概率较低，这反映了粗放型系统中的实施挑战。较大的育肥区域往往管理更不可持续，描述性证据表明，样本中不可持续载畜更常表现为载畜不足而非过度载畜，239名生产者（70%）的载畜率低于每公顷1头。这些发现揭示了结构性及制度条件（包括与冲突遗留问题相关的条件）如何塑造奥里诺基亚地区的可持续转型，并为针对边疆畜牧区域制定更精准的政策干预提供依据。
10.1111/1477-9552.70047.title: Sustainable Livestock Decisions in a Post‐Conflict Frontier: Evidence From Colombia's Orinoquía
10.1111/1477-9552.70047.title_zh: 后冲突前沿地区的可持续畜牧业决策：来自哥伦比亚奥里诺基亚地区的证据

10.1111/1477-9552.70048.abstract: ABSTRACT Recent trade policy developments have renewed concerns about the vulnerability of agri‐food markets to tariff increases. This paper quantifies the effects of 2025 US tariff hikes and potential tit‐for‐tat retaliation on agri‐food trade, prices, output, and welfare. We employ a sectoral general‐equilibrium gravity model covering 46 agri‐food industries on a 2023 baseline. The framework combines product‐level trade elasticities with sector‐specific supply elasticities based on input‐cost shares, providing a transparent mapping from tariffs to equilibrium outcomes. We simulate the April 2, 2025 (‘Liberation Day’) tariff schedule and the July 31, 2025 revisions, each with and without symmetric retaliation by all trading partners. Without retaliation, US agri‐food exports fall by 22%–25%, output declines by about 3%, the price index rises by 6.8%–7.2%, and welfare falls by 4.4%–4.9%. With retaliation, export losses deepen to 37%–43%, output drops by 4%–5%, the price index rises by 2%–5%, and welfare declines by 6.9%–7.9%. Welfare losses are highly asymmetric: Canada and Mexico experience the largest additional losses under retaliation, reflecting integrated North American supply chains, while contractions are concentrated in processed meats, soybeans, corn, and selected food products. Retaliation amplifies global welfare losses rather than offsetting them, suggesting that cooperative policy restraint yields smaller welfare costs for the United States and its major trading partners.
10.1111/1477-9552.70048.abstract_zh: 摘要 近期贸易政策动态重新引发了人们对农业食品市场在关税上调面前脆弱性的担忧。本文量化了2025年美国关税上调及潜在的对等报复措施对农业食品贸易、价格、产出和福利的影响。我们采用一个涵盖46个农业食品行业、以2023年为基期的部门一般均衡引力模型。该框架将产品层面的贸易弹性与基于投入成本份额的部门特定供给弹性相结合，提供了从关税到均衡结果的透明映射。我们模拟了2025年4月2日（“解放日”）关税方案及2025年7月31日修订版，每种情况均考虑所有贸易伙伴实施对称报复与不实施报复两种情形。在无报复情况下，美国农业食品出口下降22%至25%，产出下降约3%，价格指数上升6.8%至7.2%，福利下降4.4%至4.9%。在有报复情况下，出口损失加深至37%至43%，产出下降4%至5%，价格指数上升2%至5%，福利下降6.9%至7.9%。福利损失高度不对称：加拿大和墨西哥在报复情形下承受最大的额外损失，反映了北美一体化供应链的特征，而收缩集中在加工肉类、大豆、玉米及部分食品产品上。报复措施放大了全球福利损失而非抵消之，这表明合作性的政策克制对美国及其主要贸易伙伴而言能带来更小的福利成本。

10.1111/1477-9552.70049.abstract: To maintain the vital economic benefits of Latin America's livestock sector while minimizing its environmental footprint, producers must adopt clean and climate‐friendly ‘sustainable’ technologies including improved feed, grazing, reproductive, and herd management practices. Yet we have limited evidence on the barriers to and opportunities for the adoption of such technologies, and even less on that topic in Latin America and other developing regions where socioeconomic and geophysical conditions often differ from those in the developed countries. The product of a competitive open call by the Inter‐American Development Bank, the four articles that comprise the Special Focus aim to help fill that gap. Three examine the determinants of adoption in Mexico, Colombia, and Uruguay; and the fourth presents a quasi‐experimental impact evaluation of a program aimed at promoting adoption in Uruguay. The findings suggest that: (i) generalizing about the drivers of the adoption of sustainable livestock technologies in Latin America is ill advised: they are both technology‐ and site‐specific; (ii) land tenure matters; (iii) adopting one sustainable livestock technology does not necessarily increase the chances of adopting others; (iv) adoption does not guarantee significant impacts on targeted outcomes; and (v) two of the most common policy interventions—enhancing access to credit and providing technical extension—are correlated with adoption, at least for some technologies and subgroups.
10.1111/1477-9552.70049.abstract_zh: 为维持拉丁美洲畜牧业的重要经济效益，同时最大限度减少其环境足迹，生产者必须采用清洁且气候友好的"可持续"技术，包括改良饲料、放牧、繁殖及畜群管理实践。然而，关于此类技术采用的障碍与机遇，现有证据十分有限，而在社会经济与地理条件常异于发达国家的拉丁美洲及其他发展中地区，相关研究更为匮乏。作为美洲开发银行公开竞标成果，本专题聚焦的四篇文章旨在填补这一空白：其中三篇分别考察墨西哥、哥伦比亚和乌拉圭的技术采用决定因素，第四篇则对乌拉圭一项旨在促进技术采用的计划进行准实验影响评估。研究结果表明：（一）对拉丁美洲可持续畜牧业技术采用驱动因素进行泛化概括并不可取——这些因素既具有技术特异性又具有地域特异性；（二）土地权属至关重要；（三）采用某项可持续畜牧业技术并不必然增加采用其他技术的可能性；（四）技术采用并不能保证对目标结果产生显著影响；（五）两种最常见的政策干预措施——增强信贷可及性与提供技术推广服务——与技术采用存在相关性，至少对某些技术和子群体而言如此。

10.1111/1477-9552.70050.abstract: Changes towards more sustainable livestock production are often evaluated in terms of whether farms abandon environmentally harmful practices. Less attention has been paid to how farms reallocate production across alternative grazing systems and how the composition of production evolves over time. This paper addresses this question by modelling grazing systems as compositional outcomes and examining how financial, institutional and structural factors shape the distribution of livestock across alternative regimes. We use farm level data from the 2007 and 2022 agricultural censuses in Mexico, covering more than 860,000 cattle farms and estimate a fractional multinomial logit model. Financial and institutional support is associated with economically meaningful reductions in free grazing. However, most of this adjustment occurs through confinement rather than controlled grazing. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that small and dairy farms allocate a larger share of production to confinement systems, whereas large and beef‐dairy farms allocate relatively more to controlled grazing. The results indicate that sustainability outcomes depend on how policy instruments interact with farm scale, production orientation and land constraints.
10.1111/1477-9552.70050.abstract_zh: 向更可持续的畜牧业转型的评估通常聚焦于农场是否放弃环境有害的生产方式，而较少关注农场如何在替代放牧系统间重新配置生产，以及生产结构如何随时间演变。本文通过将放牧系统建模为组合结果，考察金融、制度和结构因素如何影响牲畜在不同生产模式间的分布，从而探讨这一问题。我们利用墨西哥2007年和2022年农业普查中超过86万个牧场的微观数据，估计了分数多项逻辑模型。研究发现，金融与制度支持与自由放牧在经济意义上的显著减少相关，但这一调整主要通过圈养而非控制放牧实现。异质性分析表明，小型牧场和奶牛场将更大比例的生产配置于圈养系统，而大型牧场及肉奶兼用牧场则相对更多采用控制放牧。结果表明，可持续性成效取决于政策工具如何与农场规模、生产导向及土地约束相互作用。

10.1111/1477-9552.70052.abstract: This paper examines the reallocation effects of a typical environmental policy aiming to internalize externalities: the straw burning ban across China. The ban prohibited the traditional farming practice of burning straw while compelling the labour‐intensive practice of straw utilization. We show that the legislation banning straw burning led to an increase in local land renting activities. Our results indicate that implementation of the ban resulted in a within‐village land redistribution, encouraging the exit of less‐productive farmers while promoting land expansion by more‐productive farmers. Consequently, village‐level aggregate agricultural output and productivity increased by 5% and 3%, respectively. A complementary policy instrument to the command‐and‐control ban—establishing biomass power plants to incentivize farmers to collect crop residues—led to a greater land redistribution in villages with a nearby biomass power plant after the ban is imposed, relative to before.
10.1111/1477-9552.70052.abstract_zh: 本文考察了一项旨在内化外部性的典型环境政策——中国秸秆禁烧令——的重新配置效应。该禁令禁止了传统的秸秆焚烧耕作方式，同时强制推行劳动密集型的秸秆利用实践。我们证明，秸秆禁烧立法导致当地土地租赁活动增加。研究结果表明，禁令的实施引发了村内土地重新分配，促使低生产率农户退出，同时推动高生产率农户扩大土地规模。由此，村级农业总产出和生产率分别提升了5%和3%。作为命令控制型禁令的补充政策工具——建立生物质发电厂以激励农户收集农作物残余物——在禁令实施后，相较于实施前，导致邻近生物质发电厂的村庄出现了更显著的土地重新分配。

10.1111/1477-9552.70053.abstract: Repurposing agricultural public resources toward higher‐return incentives and investments can help transform agri‐food systems. This is important for low‐income countries, especially in sub‐Saharan Africa, where limited budgets restrict options for boosting agricultural spending. We demonstrate how, within a tight budget envelope, opportunities exist to achieve better agricultural transformation outcomes. To this end, we developed the policy optimization modelling tool, PolOpT, which combines a multicriteria decision‐making technique and a recursive‐dynamic computable general equilibrium model. We applied it with datasets for six sub‐Saharan African countries, including hundreds of estimated parameters that transmit the effect of policy measures onto agricultural productivity. The approach demonstrates that reallocating agricultural public expenditure across policy measures in these countries can potentially boost agri‐food output by several percentage points, create almost a million off‐farm jobs in rural areas, lift almost 3 million people out of poverty and allow 16 million people more to afford a healthy diet—all without extra funding.
10.1111/1477-9552.70053.abstract_zh: 将农业公共资源重新配置到更高回报的激励措施和投资领域，有助于推动农业食品体系转型。这对低收入国家尤为重要，尤其是撒哈拉以南非洲地区，这些国家有限的预算制约了农业支出增长的选择空间。我们证明，在预算约束范围内，仍存在实现更优农业转型成果的机遇。为此，我们开发了政策优化建模工具PolOpT，该工具融合了多准则决策技术与递归动态可计算一般均衡模型。我们利用六个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的数据集（包含数百个反映政策措施对农业生产率传导效应的估计参数）进行了应用分析。研究结果表明，在这些国家间重新配置农业公共支出，可在不增加额外资金的情况下，使农业食品产出提升数个百分点，在农村地区创造近百万非农就业岗位，帮助近300万人摆脱贫困，并使1600万人能够负担健康膳食。

10.1111/1477-9552.70054.abstract: How large is the potential benefit for farmers from obtaining forecasts of total rainfall in the upcoming season? This critically depends on the local farm system and the crop management actions available to farmers to respond to the forecasts issued. Studies assessing the financial value of seasonal precipitation forecasts have so far focused almost exclusively on start‐of‐season crop sowing decisions using approaches for non‐embedded risk analysis. However, crop management decisions are spread over the entire growing cycle, and considering this realistically could either increase or diminish the financial value of seasonal forecast information from a theoretical perspective. Our simulation analysis demonstrates how this research gap can be closed: we employ a state‐contingent embedded risk approach combining multi‐stage discrete stochastic programming and high‐performance computing to determine optimal crop management responses (crop choice, sowing date, tied‐ridging, relay cropping and fertilization) to seasonal precipitation forecasts throughout the full crop growth cycle. For rain‐fed agriculture in the Central Rift Valley of Ethiopia, we find seasonal forecasts to increase risk‐adjusted expected cash surplus by about 2%–3% at realistic forecast skill levels. For a typical risk‐averse subsistence farming household (0.5 ha), we calculated an increase in long‐term expected cash surplus of 58 USD PPP at 2023 prices. Intra‐seasonal crop management plays an important role in forecast response. A non‐embedded risk approach simulated not more than 35% of the forecast's economic value simulated with the embedded risk approach.
10.1111/1477-9552.70054.abstract_zh: 农民从获取未来季节总降雨量预测中获得的潜在收益有多大？这关键取决于当地农业系统以及农民根据预测可采取的作物管理措施。目前，评估季节性降水预测经济价值的研究几乎完全集中于季初作物播种决策，并采用非嵌入风险分析方法。然而，作物管理决策贯穿整个生长周期，从理论角度看，更现实地考虑这一点可能增加或减少季节性预测信息的经济价值。我们的模拟分析展示了如何填补这一研究空白：采用状态依存的嵌入风险方法，结合多阶段离散随机规划与高性能计算，确定整个作物生长周期中对季节性降水预测的最优作物管理响应（作物选择、播种日期、垄作、间作套种和施肥）。针对埃塞俄比亚中央裂谷地区的雨养农业，我们发现，在现实预测技能水平下，季节性预测可使风险调整后的预期现金盈余增加约2%–3%。对于一个典型的风险规避型自给农户（0.5公顷），我们计算出长期预期现金盈余按2023年价格计算增加了58美元购买力平价。季节内作物管理在预测响应中发挥着重要作用。非嵌入风险方法模拟的经济价值不超过嵌入风险方法模拟的预测经济价值的35%。

10.1111/1477-9552.70059.abstract: We develop a framework for regulated production systems where output generation and pollution abatement impose competing technological demands. Using a multi‐ware technology, we model the production set as the intersection of two input requirement frontiers, one for production and one for abatement, each reflecting distinct trade‐offs. We characterise the efficient set using gaps in efficiency distances and recover shadow prices for smooth and non‐smooth frontiers, clarifying how subdifferentials govern shadow prices at switching points. To address unobserved heterogeneity in technological orientation, we estimate a full‐information maximum likelihood model with endogenous regime‐switching. Applying the framework to Chinese livestock farms, we recover regime‐specific land costs, identify drivers of regime assignment and quantify inefficiency using multi‐ware distances. Results reveal sharp asymmetries in spatial burdens between production and abatement, and systematic switching behaviour driven by inputs and weather. Our framework offers a widely applicable, policy‐relevant tool for evaluating environmental and economic performance. JEL Classification: D24, Q12, Q52
10.1111/1477-9552.70059.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个受监管生产系统的分析框架，其中产出生成与污染减排对技术提出竞争性要求。通过采用多仓库技术，我们将生产集建模为两个投入需求前沿的交集——一个针对生产，另一个针对减排，各自反映不同的权衡关系。我们利用效率距离的缺口刻画有效集，并推导出光滑与非光滑前沿的影子价格，阐明次微分如何在切换点主导影子价格。为解决技术方向中未观测到的异质性，我们估计了一个包含内生机制切换的全信息最大似然模型。将该框架应用于中国畜牧养殖场，我们恢复了机制特定的土地成本，识别了机制分配的驱动因素，并利用多仓库距离量化了无效率。研究结果揭示了生产与减排之间空间负担的显著不对称性，以及由投入和天气驱动的系统性切换行为。我们的框架为评估环境与经济绩效提供了一个广泛适用且具有政策相关性的工具。JEL分类：D24, Q12, Q52

10.1111/1477-9552.70060.abstract: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), scheduled to become fully operational in 2026, is designed to complement the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) by replacing free emission allowances and preventing carbon leakage to non‐EU regions. CBAM initially covers energy‐intensive sectors, including mineral nitrogen (N) fertiliser production. Although mineral N fertiliser production is already included in the EU ETS, it is currently exempt from carbon charges owing to full compensation through free allowances. The phase‐out of these allowances and the introduction of CBAM are expected to increase the prices of both imported and domestically produced fertilisers, indirectly affecting the EU agricultural sector. This study quantitatively assesses the impacts of the expected fertiliser price changes on the EU agricultural sector and related environmental outcomes using the Modular Applied GeNeral Equilibrium Tool (MAGNET) and the Common Agricultural Policy Regionalised Impact (CAPRI) model. The results indicate that the combined effect of phasing out free allowances and implementing CBAM will double mineral N fertiliser prices. Higher prices are projected to reduce demand, leading to a 21.4% decline in domestic production and a 37% reduction in imports. Overall mineral N fertiliser use in the EU is expected to decrease by 22%, partially replaced by manure. Consequently, EU agricultural factor income is projected to fall by 7.7%, primarily affecting high‐input regions. Meanwhile, non‐EU agricultural income is projected to rise slightly by 0.05%, driven by higher exports. EU agricultural greenhouse gas emissions are expected to decrease by 22 megatons of CO 2 ‐equivalent, with no significant increase globally.
10.1111/1477-9552.70060.abstract_zh: 碳边境调节机制（CBAM）计划于2026年全面实施，旨在通过取代免费排放配额并防止碳泄漏至非欧盟地区，对欧盟排放交易体系（ETS）形成补充。CBAM最初覆盖能源密集型行业，包括矿物氮肥生产。尽管矿物氮肥生产已被纳入欧盟ETS，但目前因通过免费配额获得全额补偿而免于碳成本。这些配额的逐步取消及CBAM的引入预计将推高进口和本土化肥价格，间接影响欧盟农业部门。本研究采用模块化应用一般均衡工具（MAGNET）与共同农业政策区域化影响模型（CAPRI），定量评估预期化肥价格变化对欧盟农业部门及相关环境结果的影响。结果表明，取消免费配额与实施CBAM的叠加效应将使矿物氮肥价格翻倍。价格上涨预计将抑制需求，导致本土产量下降21.4%，进口量减少37%。欧盟矿物氮肥总使用量预计下降22%，部分被粪肥替代。受此影响，欧盟农业要素收入预计下降7.7%，高投入地区受冲击最为显著。与此同时，非欧盟地区农业收入因出口增长预计小幅上升0.05%。欧盟农业温室气体排放预计减少2200万吨二氧化碳当量，且全球范围内未出现显著增长。

10.1111/1477-9552.70061.abstract: In recent decades, soy expansion in Brazil has generated significant environmental, social and economic impacts. However, there is no consensus about benefits and drawbacks, calling for a more careful account of the economic and ecological diversity of the territories where this phenomenon has been unfolding. By acknowledging this diversity, we investigate the economic and ecological impacts of soy by applying a synthetic control method to longitudinal data (1990–2019) at state level. We focus on three indicators (GDP, CO 2 emissions and deforestation) and explore how these indicators vary in five states (Goiás, Paraná, Piauí, Rio Grande do Sul, Tocantins). These states differ in terms of underlying conditions and timing of soy expansion but have in common a significant contribution of soy to their GDP. From an environmental perspective, the states where soy consolidated its presence during the period considered (Goiás and Paraná) experienced a general improvement compared to their synthetic counterfactuals, especially in terms of deforestation, while a pioneer state in soy production such as Rio Grande do Sul saw a worsening in environmental indicators, especially right after the 2008 global financial crisis. This is also reflected in the impact of soy on GDP, which has been negative in this state, suggesting that it may have suffered from being a plantation economy, with soy subtracting resources from potentially more beneficial sectors. This geographical and temporal heterogeneity indicates that the economic and environmental impact of soy cannot be reduced to a single dominant trend. The outcome depends on the trade‐offs with other sectors, which is in turn linked to the level of economic development of the state when soy took off.
10.1111/1477-9552.70061.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，巴西的大豆扩张对环境、社会和经济产生了显著影响。然而，关于其利弊尚未形成共识，这要求我们更细致地考量该现象所涉及区域的经济与生态多样性。基于这一多样性，我们采用合成控制法对1990-2019年州级面板数据进行分析，探究大豆种植的经济与生态影响。研究聚焦三项指标（GDP、二氧化碳排放量及森林砍伐率），并考察这些指标在五个州（戈亚斯州、巴拉那州、皮奥伊州、南里奥格兰德州、托坎廷斯州）的差异。这些州的基础条件与大豆扩张时间节点各不相同，但共同特征是大豆对其GDP贡献显著。从环境视角看，研究期内大豆产业已巩固的州（戈亚斯州与巴拉那州）相较于合成对照组呈现整体改善，尤其在森林砍伐方面表现突出；而作为大豆生产先驱的南里奥格兰德州，其环境指标却出现恶化，尤其在2008年全球金融危机后更为明显。这一趋势同样反映在大豆对GDP的影响上——该州大豆对GDP的贡献为负值，表明其可能陷入种植园经济困境，大豆产业挤占了更具发展潜力的其他部门资源。这种地理与时间维度的异质性表明，大豆的经济与环境影响不能简化为单一主导趋势。最终结果取决于大豆与其他部门间的权衡关系，而这种权衡又与大豆产业兴起时各州的经济发展水平密切相关。
10.1111/1477-9552.70061.title: The Economic and Ecological Impact of Soy in Brazil: A Synthetic Control Method Approach
10.1111/1477-9552.70061.title_zh: 巴西大豆的经济与生态影响：基于合成控制法的研究

10.1111/1477-9552.70062.abstract: The UK grazing livestock sector is challenged by declining farm profitability and stringent environmental policy. Innovative technologies such as virtual fencing could enable a balanced economic and environmental performance of beef production. Virtual fencing is a livestock management tool relying on invisible boundaries perceived as auditory, electrical, or vibrational cues emitted by devices worn by grazing animals. This analysis compares virtual and conventional fencing from an economic and environmental perspective using a multi‐objective linear programming model. Optimal livestock management scenarios are identified for two typical UK cattle grazing systems. In intensive lowland beef finishing, virtual fencing achieves the lowest economic performance and a beef carbon emission intensity comparable to electric fencing. In an extensive upland suckler cow system, virtual fencing enables ecological conservation and reduces beef carbon emission intensity but increases labour input compared to set stocking. This ex‐ante assessment illustrates how precision grazing technologies can be simultaneously evaluated against economic and environmental objectives. The results indicate that, under current cost structures, virtual fencing is unlikely to be competitive with electric fencing in intensive lowland beef finishing systems, where it delivers similar environmental outcomes at higher cost. In contrast, in upland suckler cow systems, virtual fencing can support habitat protection and reduce beef carbon emission intensity but remains constrained by capital and labour costs. These findings suggest that virtual fencing is unlikely to be widely adopted on purely commercial grounds but could play a targeted role in the delivery of publicly subsidised conservation programmes such as the UK's Environmental Land Management schemes.
10.1111/1477-9552.70062.abstract_zh: 英国放牧畜牧业面临农场盈利能力下降和严格环境政策的双重挑战。虚拟围栏等创新技术有望实现牛肉生产的经济与环境绩效平衡。虚拟围栏是一种牲畜管理工具，依赖放牧动物佩戴设备发出的听觉、电击或振动信号所感知的隐形边界。本研究采用多目标线性规划模型，从经济与环境视角对比分析虚拟围栏与传统围栏。针对两种典型的英国牛群放牧系统，识别出最优的牲畜管理方案。在集约化低地肉牛育肥系统中，虚拟围栏的经济绩效最低，牛肉碳排放强度与电围栏相当。在粗放型高地哺乳母牛系统中，虚拟围栏虽能促进生态保护并降低牛肉碳排放强度，但相较于固定放牧增加了劳动力投入。这项事前评估展示了如何同时从经济与环境目标维度评价精准放牧技术。结果表明，在当前成本结构下，虚拟围栏在集约化低地肉牛育肥系统中难以与电围栏竞争——其以更高成本实现相似环境效益。相反，在高地哺乳母牛系统中，虚拟围栏可支持栖息地保护并降低牛肉碳排放强度，但仍受资本与劳动力成本制约。这些发现表明，虚拟围栏难以纯粹基于商业理由被广泛采用，但可在英国环境土地管理计划等公共补贴保护项目中发挥针对性作用。
10.1111/1477-9552.70062.title: An Economic and Environmental Analysis of Virtual Fencing for Precision Grazing
10.1111/1477-9552.70062.title_zh: 精准放牧虚拟围栏的经济与环境分析

10.1111/1477-9552.70063.abstract: Regional crop‐livestock integration can reduce dependence on external inputs and improve circularity, but its implementation requires coordination across heterogeneous farms and may generate uneven welfare losses due to technical, economic and behavioural factors, including social norms and peer effects. This study develops a landscape bio‐economic model that integrates heterogeneous farmer preferences, farm‐level constraints and social coordination via social norms and peer networks. Applied to a Dutch case study, the model identifies, from a social planner perspective, coordinated integration strategies that optimise feed and manure exchanges between arable and dairy farms. We show that optimising farm‐to‐farm integration can reduce total nitrogen import by up to 20% with limited losses of farmer welfare relative to the unconstrained welfare‐maximising solution. The model estimates farm‐specific willingness‐to‐accept imposed circularity targets, accounting for losses across economic and non‐economic utility attributes, including social norm conformity. Willingness‐to‐accept increases non‐linearly as nitrogen reduction targets become more stringent, with the burden initially borne mainly by sustainability‐oriented and dairy farms, while extending to arable and conventional farms only at very ambitious targets. We also find that stronger preferences for social norm conformity can ease trade‐offs between farmer welfare and circularity and are associated with greater reliance on local feed exchange and a reduced role for manure exchange, indicating that social influence is practice‐specific. These results motivate targeted and phased policy programmes combined with coordination incentives.
10.1111/1477-9552.70063.abstract_zh: 区域作物-畜牧一体化可减少对外部投入的依赖并提升循环性，但其实现需要协调异质性农场，并可能因技术、经济及行为因素（包括社会规范与同伴效应）导致福利损失不均。本研究构建了一个景观生物经济模型，该模型整合了异质性农户偏好、农场层面约束以及通过社会规范和同伴网络实现的社会协调。以荷兰案例为应用场景，该模型从社会规划者视角识别出协调一体化策略，优化种植农场与奶牛养殖场之间的饲料和粪肥交换。研究表明，相较于无约束的福利最大化方案，优化农场间一体化可使总氮输入减少高达20%，同时农户福利损失有限。模型估算了农场层面接受强制性循环目标所需的最低补偿意愿，涵盖经济与非经济效用属性（包括社会规范遵从性）的损失。随着氮减排目标趋严，最低补偿意愿呈非线性增长：初期负担主要由可持续导向型农场和奶牛养殖场承担，而种植农场和传统农场仅在极高目标下才被波及。研究还发现，对社会规范遵从性的更强偏好可缓解农户福利与循环性之间的权衡，并与本地饲料交换依赖度提升及粪肥交换作用减弱相关，表明社会影响具有实践特异性。这些结论为结合协调激励的定向分阶段政策方案提供了理论依据。
10.1111/1477-9552.70063.title: Planning Crop–Livestock Integration With Social Norms: A Bio‐Economic Model Balancing Circularity and Farmer Welfare
10.1111/1477-9552.70063.title_zh: 基于社会规范的种养结合规划：平衡循环性与农民福利的生物经济模型

10.1111/1477-9552.70064.abstract: Research on adoption of new practices, technologies and systems in agriculture has generated thousands of publications over the past 70 years, covering uptake of agricultural practices spanning more than 100 years. This paper contains selected key lessons from the results of this enormous research effort, drawn from numerous reviews of the literature and shaped by personal experience. The lessons include that trialling is not adoption, that extension is not necessarily the key to increasing adoption, that each new farming practice has its own adoption story, and that adoption is often slower than practice advocates expect, typically taking multiple decades. The identified lessons are juxtaposed with a number of flawed assumptions and misconceptions commonly held by people working in agricultural agencies. A number of methodological weaknesses are still common in existing studies, including neglect or poor representation of key variables, compromising the potential for the research to generate real understanding of adoption. This also inhibits comparison of studies and the application of meta‐analyses. Suggestions are made on ways to add value to the existing research and improve the quality of future research, including the collection and curation of good‐quality adoption data sets, the development of a searchable database of adoption studies, and the creation of best‐practice guidelines for the conduct of adoption research.
10.1111/1477-9552.70064.abstract_zh: 过去70年间，关于农业新实践、新技术和新系统采纳的研究已产出数千篇文献，涵盖跨越百余年的农业实践应用历程。本文从大量文献综述中提炼关键经验，并结合个人研究实践，呈现这项庞大研究工作的核心启示。这些经验包括：试验不等于采纳；技术推广并非提升采纳率的关键；每项新型农业实践都有其独特的采纳路径；采纳速度往往慢于实践倡导者的预期，通常需要数十年时间。本文将这些经验与农业机构从业者普遍存在的若干错误假设和认知误区进行对比分析。现有研究仍普遍存在方法论缺陷，包括关键变量的忽视或表征不足，这不仅削弱了研究对采纳机制的真实理解，也阻碍了跨研究比较与元分析的应用。本文提出提升现有研究价值、改进未来研究质量的建议，包括建立高质量采纳数据集并持续维护、开发可检索的采纳研究数据库，以及制定采纳研究最佳实践指南。
10.1111/1477-9552.70064.title: Reflections on Adoption of New Agricultural Practices
10.1111/1477-9552.70064.title_zh: 关于采纳新农业实践的思考

10.1111/1477-9552.70066.abstract: Agriculture in the Middle East faces severe climate risks, including rising temperatures, declining precipitation, and more frequent extremes. This paper examines long‐run adaptation in Iran using farmland rental prices to capture overall productivity impacts. By combining cross‐sectional and panel models, we distinguish short‐run weather effects from long‐run climate responses and quantify adaptation benefits. While hotter and arid regions experience losses of −5.3% to −41.8% without adaptation, long‐run adjustments generate gains of 11.7%–15.2%, depending on climate scenarios. Farmers primarily adapt by shifting irrigation sources toward deep wells and reallocating acreage to heat‐tolerant crops. Beyond estimating the overall value of adaptation, we examine how climate change shapes these major adaptation practices, highlighting sustainability concerns, including groundwater depletion and distributional impacts in resource‐constrained, developing‐country settings. Our findings link long‐run climate responses to both productivity gains and sustainability trade‐offs.
10.1111/1477-9552.70066.abstract_zh: 中东地区的农业面临严峻的气候风险，包括气温上升、降水减少以及极端天气事件频发。本文利用农田租赁价格来捕捉整体生产力影响，研究伊朗的长期适应情况。通过结合横截面模型与面板模型，我们区分了短期天气效应与长期气候响应，并量化了适应带来的收益。尽管在无适应情况下，更炎热和干旱地区遭受的损失介于-5.3%至-41.8%之间，但长期调整带来的收益在11.7%至15.2%之间，具体取决于气候情景。农民主要通过将灌溉水源转向深井以及将种植面积重新分配至耐热作物来进行适应。除了估算适应的总体价值外，我们还考察了气候变化如何塑造这些主要适应实践，强调了资源受限的发展中国家背景下的可持续性关切，包括地下水枯竭和分配影响。我们的研究将长期气候响应与生产力提升及可持续性权衡联系起来。
10.1111/1477-9552.70066.title: Climate Change and Agricultural Adaptations: Insights from Iran on Crop Choices and Irrigation Shifts
10.1111/1477-9552.70066.title_zh: 气候变化与农业适应：来自伊朗作物选择与灌溉转变的启示

10.1111/1477-9552.70067.abstract: Automation technology has the potential to replace a significant part of the labour force in the food industry. With data from 2002 to 2023, I investigate the causal treatment effects of the adoption of automation technology in the Dutch food industry. Automation technology in the food industry is used in a variety of tasks, such as logistics, safety, quality and production. I present a theoretical model to outline relationships that are tested in the empirical analysis. The outcome variables of interest are gross value added, average wage, employment and the labour share. The empirical analysis finds that the effect of automation on these outcomes is ambiguous and the majority of the estimates are not statistically significant. I study the relationship under various samples of food industry firms and automation definitions. For the full sample, long‐run changes in these outcomes are largely uncorrelated with automation, while food processors show a long‐run decline in gross value added and a rising labour share. A chained difference‐in‐differences design shows that adoption raises gross value added and lowers the labour share and wages among larger firms and food processors. However, most of the effects of automation are not statistically significant. The absence of strong effects of automation could be explained by investments that monitor and control production steps, rather than displace worker roles in production.
10.1111/1477-9552.70067.abstract_zh: 自动化技术有潜力替代食品工业中相当一部分劳动力。利用2002年至2023年的数据，我研究了荷兰食品工业中采用自动化技术的因果处理效应。食品工业中的自动化技术被应用于多种任务，如物流、安全、质量和生产。我提出了一个理论模型来概述实证分析中检验的关系。关注的结果变量包括总增加值、平均工资、就业和劳动份额。实证分析发现，自动化对这些结果的影响并不明确，且大多数估计在统计上不显著。我在不同食品工业企业样本和自动化定义下研究了这一关系。对于全样本，这些结果的长期变化与自动化基本不相关，而食品加工企业则表现出总增加值的长期下降和劳动份额的上升。链式双重差分设计显示，在较大企业和食品加工企业中，采用自动化提高了总增加值，降低了劳动份额和工资。然而，自动化的大部分效应在统计上并不显著。自动化缺乏强烈效应可能归因于投资用于监控和控制生产步骤，而非替代工人在生产中的角色。
10.1111/1477-9552.70067.title: Automating Food Production: Evidence From the Dutch Food Industry
10.1111/1477-9552.70067.title_zh: 自动化食品生产：来自荷兰食品工业的证据

10.1111/1477-9552.70068.abstract: Agricultural and food policy is increasingly shaped by geopolitical instability, ecological constraints, technological disruption, political polarisation and declining trust in expertise. At the same time, calls for food system transformation have gained prominence as evidence accumulates on the environmental, health and social shortcomings of current food systems. Yet reform has frequently stalled despite extensive scientific analysis and broad recognition of the need for change. This paper examines why. After reviewing some traditional explanations for policy persistence, the paper introduces the concept of policy ontologies: underlying ways of understanding what the food system is, how it functions, what it is ultimately for and how change occurs. Three ideal‐type ontologies are identified: a productivity ontology, a power‐focused ontology and an ecological ontology. These ontologies shape the definition of policy problems and the selection of preferred policy responses, helping to explain why stakeholders often appear to talk past one another. As the Society begins its second century in a more turbulent and contested policy environment, the profession's central role remains the production of rigorous evidence. That contribution will be strengthened by a greater awareness of the different ways in which food systems are understood and of how these perspectives shape both policy debates and the interpretation of evidence. Recognising these underlying assumptions can help agricultural economists contribute more effectively to policy debate as honest brokers of policy alternatives.
10.1111/1477-9552.70068.abstract_zh: 农业与食品政策日益受到地缘政治不稳定、生态约束、技术颠覆、政治极化以及对专业知识信任度下降的影响。与此同时，随着关于当前食品体系在环境、健康和社会方面缺陷的证据不断积累，要求食品体系转型的呼声日益高涨。然而，尽管有广泛的科学分析和变革必要性的普遍共识，改革却常常陷入停滞。本文探讨了其中的原因。在回顾了关于政策持续性的传统解释之后，本文引入了政策本体论的概念：即对食品体系是什么、如何运作、其最终目的以及变革如何发生的基本理解方式。本文识别出三种理想类型的本体论：生产力本体论、权力聚焦本体论和生态本体论。这些本体论塑造了政策问题的定义和首选政策响应的选择，有助于解释为何利益相关者常常看似在自说自话。随着学会在一个更加动荡和充满争议的政策环境中开启其第二个世纪，本专业的核心角色仍然是提供严谨的证据。通过增强对食品体系不同理解方式以及这些视角如何影响政策辩论和证据解读的认识，这一贡献将得到加强。认识到这些潜在的假设，有助于农业经济学家作为政策替代方案的诚实中间人，更有效地为政策辩论做出贡献。
10.1111/1477-9552.70068.title: Agri‐Food Policymaking in More Turbulent Times: Reflections at the Centenary of the Agricultural Economics Society
10.1111/1477-9552.70068.title_zh: 动荡时期中的农业食品政策制定：农业经济学学会百年反思

10.1111/1477-9552.70069.abstract: In 1932, Joseph Duncan argued in the Journal of Agricultural Economics that agricultural economists should engage more explicitly with politics. Nearly a century later, the political economy of food and agriculture has expanded in both scope and complexity. This paper revisits the evolution of political economy perspectives on agricultural policy, tracing the shift from early interest‐based explanations centered on farmers and consumers to broader frameworks that incorporate institutions, ideas and the interactions among diverse policy actors. We argue that contemporary transitions from an agricultural policy paradigm to a food systems one require a further rethinking of political economy analysis. Specifically, contemporary food systems pursue multiple and often competing objectives, including productivity, nutrition, environmental sustainability, resilience and equity, while involving a far wider array of stakeholders, from multinational corporations and transnational advocacy networks to technology firms and global governance institutions. At the same time, rising political polarization, populism, digital misinformation and the fragmentation of multilateral governance increasingly shape how policy preferences are formed, coalitions are constructed, and policy compromises are negotiated. These developments complicate traditional assumptions that preferences are driven primarily by material interests and that institutions can reliably facilitate collective action. We illustrate these changing dynamics through brief case studies of the 2024 European farmer protests, Brazil's Amazon Soy Moratorium and Mexico's genetically modified corn dispute. Each case highlights tensions between national sovereignty, global integration, environmental sustainability, and agricultural livelihoods. We conclude that understanding twenty‐first century food policy requires political economy frameworks that integrate interests, institutions, ideas and the changing geopolitical and informational context in which food system decisions are made.
10.1111/1477-9552.70069.abstract_zh: 1932年，约瑟夫·邓肯在《农业经济学杂志》上提出，农业经济学家应更明确地参与政治。近一个世纪后，食品与农业的政治经济学在范围和复杂性上均有所扩展。本文回顾了农业政策政治经济学视角的演变，追溯了从早期以农民和消费者为中心的利益解释，到纳入制度、思想及多元政策行动者互动的更广泛框架的转变。我们认为，当代从农业政策范式向食品系统范式的转型，要求对政治经济学分析进行进一步反思。具体而言，当代食品系统追求多重且往往相互竞争的目标，包括生产力、营养、环境可持续性、韧性和公平，同时涉及从跨国公司、跨国倡导网络到科技企业和全球治理机构等更为广泛的利益相关者。与此同时，日益加剧的政治极化、民粹主义、数字虚假信息以及多边治理的碎片化，正日益影响政策偏好的形成、联盟的构建以及政策妥协的谈判方式。这些发展使传统假设——即偏好主要由物质利益驱动，且制度能够可靠地促进集体行动——变得复杂化。我们通过2024年欧洲农民抗议、巴西亚马逊大豆暂停令以及墨西哥转基因玉米争端的简要案例研究，阐释了这些变化中的动态。每个案例都凸显了国家主权、全球一体化、环境可持续性与农业生计之间的张力。我们得出结论，理解21世纪的食品政策需要整合利益、制度、思想以及食品系统决策所处的不断变化的地缘政治和信息背景的政治经济学框架。
10.1111/1477-9552.70069.title: Revisiting the Political Economy of Agriculture in 21st Century Food Systems
10.1111/1477-9552.70069.title_zh: 重访21世纪粮食系统中的农业政治经济学

10.1111/1477-9552.70070.abstract: We utilize Chinese provincial data to explore how government policies affected grain production between 1952 and 2008. We adapt the Caselli‐Coleman framework to allow multiple inputs including fertilizer, land and capital as well as skilled and unskilled labour. We also extend the method to allow for comparisons of production possibilities over time as well as across provinces. We derive measures of the technological frontier for Chinese agricultural production for each year over the 56‐year period. The empirical estimates illustrate how labour efficiency in Chinese grain production changed from 1952 to 2008, encompassing the Great Leap Forward (1958–1962), the collective farming period (1963–1977), and the rural economic reforms initiated in 1978. Government policies held back agricultural production in the 1960s and 1970s by limiting efficient use of labour at a time when the Green Revolution was raising grain yields dramatically throughout Asia. Reductions in labour efficiency led to a 12.9% average decline in grain output during the Great Leap Forward and little gain during the collective farming period. In contrast, rural reforms that allowed farmers to profit from production above their assigned quotas starting in 1978 significantly enhanced labour efficiency for the more skilled but had little impact on the productive efficiency of unskilled agricultural workers.
10.1111/1477-9552.70070.abstract_zh: 我们利用中国省级数据，探讨了1952年至2008年间政府政策如何影响粮食生产。我们调整了卡塞利-科尔曼框架，以纳入包括化肥、土地和资本以及熟练与非熟练劳动力在内的多种投入要素。同时，我们扩展了该方法，以便在时间维度和省份间进行生产可能性比较。我们推导出了这56年间中国农业生产技术前沿的度量指标。实证估计展示了1952年至2008年间中国粮食生产中劳动力效率的变化，涵盖了“大跃进”时期（1958-1962年）、集体耕作时期（1963-1977年）以及1978年启动的农村经济改革。政府政策在20世纪60年代和70年代限制了劳动力的有效利用，而此时绿色革命正大幅提高整个亚洲的粮食产量，从而阻碍了农业生产。劳动力效率的下降导致“大跃进”期间粮食产量平均下降12.9%，而在集体耕作时期增长甚微。相比之下，自1978年起允许农民从超出分配定额的生产中获利的农村改革，显著提升了技能较高劳动力的效率，但对非熟练农业工人的生产效率影响甚微。
10.1111/1477-9552.70070.title: Government Policy, Low‐ and High‐Skilled Labour, and Technical Inefficiency in Chinese Agriculture, 1952–2008
10.1111/1477-9552.70070.title_zh: 中国政府政策、高低技能劳动力与中国农业技术效率（1952—2008）

10.1111/1477-9552.70071.abstract: International sanctions have been increasingly deployed for political and economic reasons. While the consequences of sanctions on political and macro‐economic outcomes are well‐analysed, rigorous evaluations of the causal impacts of sanctions on the agriculture and food (agri‐food) trade remain limited. We obtain the causal estimates of sanctions' impact on agri‐food trade by utilising samples that have been threatened with but not subject to sanctions to construct the counterfactual of the sanctioned sample. Exploiting an event study approach to analyse data from 154 countries over the period 1960–2016, we find that international sanctions mostly resulted in modest and short‐lived declines in the total agri‐food trade of sanctioned countries as opposed to the counterpart of countries under sanction threats. Trade volumes declined substantially for beef, pork, roots, dairy and fruit products. The decline in the exports of agri‐food commodities resulting from international sanctions was more significant relative to the drop in imports. The study also reveals that the impact of sanctions on agri‐food trade depends partially on the type of the sanction and on the sanction imposer. While the differences in the impact of sanctions across agri‐food commodities largely reflect the fact that the commodities where there are stronger impacts are those produced more in countries subject to sanctions, future studies incorporating analytical tools from industrial organisation may provide more nuanced insights on why and how the trade of differential agri‐food commodities was impacted by sanctions so differently.
10.1111/1477-9552.70071.abstract_zh: 国际制裁日益频繁地被用于政治和经济目的。尽管制裁对政治和宏观经济结果的影响已被充分分析，但关于制裁对农业与食品（农食）贸易因果影响的严谨评估仍然有限。我们通过利用曾受到制裁威胁但未实际遭受制裁的样本，构建受制裁样本的反事实，从而获得制裁对农食贸易影响的因果估计。采用事件研究方法分析1960年至2016年间154个国家的数据，我们发现，与受到制裁威胁的国家相比，国际制裁大多导致受制裁国家农食总贸易量出现温和且短暂的下降。牛肉、猪肉、根茎类作物、乳制品和水果产品的贸易量显著减少。由国际制裁导致的农食商品出口下降相较于进口下降更为显著。研究还揭示，制裁对农食贸易的影响部分取决于制裁类型及实施制裁的主体。尽管不同农食商品间制裁影响的差异在很大程度上反映了受影响较大的商品正是受制裁国家生产较多的商品，但未来结合产业组织分析工具的研究可能为解释不同农食商品贸易为何及如何受到制裁如此不同的影响提供更为细致的见解。
10.1111/1477-9552.70071.title: Identifying the Causal Impacts of International Sanctions on Agricultural Trade: An Event Study Approach
10.1111/1477-9552.70071.title_zh: 识别国际制裁对农产品贸易的因果影响：一项事件研究法分析

10.1111/1477-9552.70072.abstract: Natural disasters increasingly threaten global food security, yet the resilience of mechanized, middle‐income agriculture remains a puzzle. Standard development theory suggests households manage shocks by substituting labor for capital. We show this mechanism fails in modern, mechanized agriculture because substituting labor for destroyed capital is infeasible in the short run. We estimate the impact of the February 2023 earthquakes in Turkiye on agricultural supply, separating extensive margin adjustments (cultivated land) from intensive margin effects (yields). This disaster represents a unique ‘dual shock’: physical capital destruction coincided with a liquidity crisis that blocked asset replacement. To analyse this, we adapt the Agricultural Household Model using a Leontief (fixed‐proportions) representation as a short‐run limiting case. Empirically, we employ a Synthetic Difference‐in‐Differences strategy, combining district‐level crop statistics with remote sensing data. We find a significant contraction at the extensive margin: wheat cultivation declined by 8.5% relative to the pre‐treatment mean in the 2024‐restricted specification. Yet, we identify a ‘Null Yield Effect’ at the intensive margin. Yields remained stable or increased. This aligns with ‘Ricardian Selection,’ where producers—facing binding capital constraints—abandon marginal lands to concentrate resources on prime plots; consistent with this mechanism, the yield gain is concentrated in marginal, low‐quality districts and absent where land is better. Sharp declines in new tractor registrations (24%) and agricultural credit (16.5%) confirm a ‘Scarcity Trap.’ In high‐inflation, mechanized environments, cash transfers are insufficient. Policy must instead prioritize in‐kind capital replacement to bypass liquidity constraints and restore capacity.
10.1111/1477-9552.70072.abstract_zh: 自然灾害日益威胁全球粮食安全，然而机械化、中等收入农业的韧性仍是一个未解之谜。标准发展理论认为，家庭通过以劳动力替代资本来应对冲击。我们证明，这一机制在现代机械化农业中失效，因为在短期内以劳动力替代被摧毁的资本并不可行。我们估算了2023年2月土耳其地震对农业供给的影响，将集约边际调整（耕地面积）与广延边际效应（单产）区分开来。此次灾害构成了一次独特的“双重冲击”：物质资本毁坏与流动性危机同时发生，后者阻碍了资产重置。为分析这一问题，我们采用Leontief（固定比例）生产函数作为短期极限情形，对农业家庭模型进行了适应性改造。在实证方面，我们采用合成双重差分策略，将区级作物统计数据与遥感数据相结合。我们发现广延边际出现显著收缩：在2024年限制性设定中，小麦种植面积较处理前均值下降8.5%。然而，我们在集约边际识别出“零单产效应”——单产保持稳定甚至有所上升。这与“李嘉图选择”相一致，即面临资本约束的生产者放弃边际土地，将资源集中于优质地块；与该机制一致的是，单产增益集中在边际、低质量地区，而在土地质量较好的地区则不存在。新拖拉机注册量（下降24%）和农业信贷（下降16.5%）的急剧减少证实了“稀缺陷阱”的存在。在高通胀、机械化的环境中，现金转移支付不足以解决问题。政策应优先采取实物资本重置的方式，以绕过流动性约束并恢复生产能力。
10.1111/1477-9552.70072.title: Mechanized Fragility in Turkish Agriculture: Earthquakes, Capital Destruction and the Scarcity Trap
10.1111/1477-9552.70072.title_zh: 土耳其农业的机械化脆弱性：地震、资本破坏与稀缺陷阱

10.1111/1477-9552.70073.abstract: On the occasion of the centenary of the Agricultural Economics Society, this study investigates the positioning of the Journal of Agricultural Economics (JAE) within the broader landscape of the main agricultural economics journals. We employ a quantitative text analysis approach, estimating a Structural Topic Model (STM) on a unique corpus of 13,140 abstracts from the JAE and six leading peer journals covering the period 1970–2024. Our results suggest that the JAE shares common trends with its peers, such as an increasing segmentation and specialisation of the topics addressed, and a commensurate growth in the use of specialised techniques, such as causal identification and experimental economics. At the same time, features differentiating the JAE from the other journals emerge as well. These include a strong focus on production issues and agricultural policy, as well as on the environmental and natural resource implications of production decisions. This contrasts with the relatively lower attention devoted to food and nutrition aspects, despite greater focus on consumption dynamics, in line with a general trend in the discipline. Overall, this analysis highlights that the JAE maintains a strong connection with core aspects of the discipline, while differentiating itself in specific areas of investigation.
10.1111/1477-9552.70073.abstract_zh: 值此农业经济学会百年华诞之际，本研究探讨了《农业经济学杂志》（JAE）在主要农业经济学期刊更广泛格局中的定位。我们采用定量文本分析方法，基于1970年至2024年间来自JAE及六本领先同行期刊的13，140篇摘要独特语料库，估计了一个结构主题模型（STM）。结果表明，JAE与其同行期刊共享共同趋势，如所涉主题日益细分与专业化，以及因果识别和实验经济学等专门技术使用相应增长。与此同时，JAE区别于其他期刊的特征亦显现出来，包括对生产问题与农业政策，以及生产决策对环境与自然资源影响的强烈关注。这与其对食品与营养方面相对较低的关注形成对比，尽管对消费动态的关注更多，这与学科总体趋势一致。总体而言，本分析强调，JAE在保持与学科核心方面紧密联系的同时，在特定研究领域展现出自身特色。
10.1111/1477-9552.70073.title:
The
                    <scp>JAE</scp>
                    's Positioning Within Agricultural Economics: A Text‐Based Analysis
10.1111/1477-9552.70073.title_zh: 《农业经济学杂志》在农业经济学中的定位：基于文本的分析

10.1111/1477-9552.70075.abstract: In 2006, Amazon launched the Fulfilment by Amazon (FBA) program, providing support to third‐party sellers for a fee. While the program has the potential to enhance sellers' reputations, evidence regarding its effectiveness is limited. This study estimates the association between FBA usage and seller reputation, measured by the average star rating a seller receives. Using fixed effects and staggered difference‐in‐differences estimation approaches as well as 26 weeks of panel data from Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States, three key findings emerge. First, using FBA is significantly and positively associated with a seller's reputation, leading to higher average ratings in the short term than in the long term. This improvement is mainly due to FBA's competitive advantages, such as eligibility for Amazon Prime, standardised fulfilment quality and excellent customer service. Second, although the correlation between FBA and reputation is positive in every country, we find cross‐country heterogeneity in effect sizes and significance levels, with the largest effects in Canada. Third, we show that large sellers have the best reputation, and all sellers benefit from the FBA program. However, medium‐sized sellers benefit the most from the program. This trend can be attributed to how the benefits of the FBA program accrue optimally to sellers based on their operational scale. These results suggest that the FBA program is indeed effective in enhancing seller reputation, with implications for third‐party sellers, Amazon and regulators.
10.1111/1477-9552.70075.abstract_zh: 2006年年，亚马逊推出了亚马逊物流（FBA）计划，为第三方卖家提供有偿支持服务。尽管该计划有潜力提升卖家的声誉，但关于其有效性的证据仍然有限。本研究通过卖家获得的平均星级评分来衡量声誉，估计了使用FBA与卖家声誉之间的关联。利用固定效应和交错双重差分估计方法，以及来自加拿大、英国和美国的26周面板数据，我们得出了三个关键发现。第一，使用FBA与卖家声誉显著正相关，短期内平均评分提升幅度大于长期。这一改善主要归因于FBA的竞争优势，如符合亚马逊Prime资格、标准化的物流质量和卓越的客户服务。第二，尽管FBA与声誉之间的正相关在每个国家都存在，但我们发现效应大小和显著性水平存在跨国异质性，其中加拿大的效应最大。第三，我们表明大型卖家拥有最佳声誉，且所有卖家均从FBA计划中受益。然而，中型卖家从该计划中获益最多。这一趋势可归因于FBA计划的收益如何根据卖家的运营规模最优地累积。这些结果表明，FBA计划确实能有效提升卖家声誉，对第三方卖家、亚马逊及监管机构均具有启示意义。
10.1111/1477-9552.70075.title: Platform Fulfilment and Seller Reputation: Evidence From Amazon's Marketplace
10.1111/1477-9552.70075.title_zh: 平台履约与卖家声誉：来自亚马逊市场的证据

10.1111/1477-9552.70076.abstract: Agriculture accounts for about one fifth of global greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, making mitigation a key policy priority. Although policymakers are increasingly considering market‐based approaches such as taxes, their broader impacts remain insufficiently assessed. This study examines the environmental, economic and social impacts of a GHG tax on Swiss agriculture. Using the agent‐based sector model SWISSland, representing 3077 farms and capturing heterogeneous responses to taxation and structural change, we simulate tax levels of 100, 200 and 300 CHF/tCO 2 eq for 2024–2030. We consider three mitigation pathways: technical measures, structural changes in land use and livestock numbers, and farm exits. We assess their impacts on GHG emissions, nitrogen surpluses, biodiversity, farm income, food production and food security. A GHG tax activates abatement mechanisms and induces dairy herd reductions, grassland extensification, shifts towards crop production for direct human consumption, and livestock farm exits. At 100 and 200 CHF/tCO 2 eq, emission reductions are mainly driven by technical measures, whereas at 300 CHF/tCO 2 eq they increasingly result from structural adjustment, including livestock farm exits and land reallocation to less emissions‐intensive production. A tax of 100 CHF/tCO 2 eq reduces emissions by 5%, while higher tax rates achieve greater reductions but increase sectoral income losses from 13% to 25%. Food self‐sufficiency and calorie production remain stable. The model also shows environmental co‐benefits, including lower nitrogen surpluses and increased biodiversity areas. These findings highlight synergies and trade‐offs across sustainability dimensions and suggest that redistributing tax revenues could mitigate adverse effects and improve policy outcomes, while enhancing the policy's social acceptability.
10.1111/1477-9552.70076.abstract_zh: 农业约占全球温室气体排放的五分之一，因此减缓排放成为关键的政策优先事项。尽管政策制定者日益考虑基于市场的手段（如税收），但其更广泛的影响仍未得到充分评估。本研究考察了温室气体税对瑞士农业的环境、经济和社会影响。利用基于主体的部门模型SWISSland，该模型代表了3077个农场，并捕捉了对税收和结构变化的异质性反应，我们模拟了2024—2030年间100、200和300瑞士法郎/吨二氧化碳当量的税率水平。我们考虑了三种减缓路径：技术措施、土地利用和牲畜数量的结构变化以及农场退出。我们评估了这些路径对温室气体排放、氮盈余、生物多样性、农场收入、粮食生产和粮食安全的影响。温室气体税激活了减排机制，并导致奶牛群减少、草地粗放化、转向直接供人类消费的作物生产以及畜牧农场的退出。在100和200瑞士法郎/吨二氧化碳当量时，减排主要由技术措施驱动，而在300瑞士法郎/吨二氧化碳当量时，减排越来越多地源于结构调整，包括畜牧农场退出和土地重新配置到排放强度较低的生产。100瑞士法郎/吨二氧化碳当量的税收可使排放减少5%，而更高的税率实现更大的减排，但部门收入损失从13%增加到25%。粮食自给率和热量生产保持稳定。模型还显示了环境协同效益，包括氮盈余降低和生物多样性面积增加。这些发现凸显了各可持续性维度之间的协同效应和权衡，并表明重新分配税收收入可以减轻不利影响、改善政策结果，同时提高政策的社会可接受性。
10.1111/1477-9552.70076.title: Assessing the Environmental, Economic and Social Impacts of a Greenhouse Gas Emission Tax in Swiss Agriculture
10.1111/1477-9552.70076.title_zh: 评估瑞士农业温室气体排放税的环境、经济与社会影响

10.1111/1477-9552.70077.abstract: Understanding farm household (FHH) income has been a central concern of agricultural economists and policymakers for more than a century. This review traces the evolution of concepts, definitions, data sources, analytical approaches and empirical evidence used to estimate and compare FHH incomes. It argues that the central measurement challenge is the distinction between the farm business and the FHH. Farm business income is often observable, but household economic welfare depends on total income, income composition, household structure, wealth, liquidity and exposure to volatility. The evidence does not support a simple conclusion that FHHs are universally income‐disadvantaged. In many developed‐country contexts, average income differences narrow or disappear once household size and composition, in‐kind benefits and the choice of comparison group are taken into account. However, income variability, low‐income incidence, distributional outcomes and asset‐rich but cash‐constrained households remain important policy concerns. The review highlights the limits of farm accountancy data for evaluating income‐support objectives and argues for stronger household‐level and linked administrative data systems. Improved measurement is essential for credible policy targeting, transparent evaluation and analysis of FHH well‐being, resilience, generational renewal and social sustainability.
10.1111/1477-9552.70077.abstract_zh: 理解农户家庭收入一直是农业经济学家和政策制定者一个多世纪以来的核心关注点。本综述追溯了用于估算和比较农户家庭收入的概念、定义、数据来源、分析方法及实证证据的演变过程。文章认为，测量的核心挑战在于区分农业经营实体与农户家庭。农业经营收入通常可观测，但家庭经济福利取决于总收入、收入构成、家庭结构、财富、流动性及面对波动的暴露程度。证据并不支持农户家庭普遍处于收入劣势的简单结论。在许多发达国家情境下，一旦考虑家庭规模和构成、实物福利及比较组的选择，平均收入差距便会缩小或消失。然而，收入波动性、低收入发生率、分配结果以及资产充裕但现金受限的家庭仍是重要的政策关切。本综述强调了农场会计数据在评估收入支持目标方面的局限性，并主张建立更强有力的家庭层面及关联行政数据系统。改进测量对于可信的政策瞄准、透明的评估以及分析农户家庭福祉、韧性、代际更新和社会可持续性至关重要。
10.1111/1477-9552.70077.title: A Century of Farm Household Income Estimation and Comparison
10.1111/1477-9552.70077.title_zh: 一个世纪的农户收入估算与比较

10.1111/1756-2171.70008.abstract: We propose a tractable model of asymmetric platform oligopoly with logit demand in which users from two distinct groups are subject to within‐group and cross‐group network effects and decide which platform to join. We characterize the equilibrium when platforms manage user access by setting participation fees for each user group. We explore the effects of platform entry, a change of incumbent platforms' quality under free entry, and the degree of compatibility. We show how the analysis can be extended to partial user participation.
10.1111/1756-2171.70008.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个可处理的非对称平台寡头模型，该模型采用对数需求函数，其中来自两个不同群体的用户受到组内和组间网络效应的影响，并决定加入哪个平台。我们刻画了平台通过为每个用户群体设定参与费来管理用户接入时的均衡状态。我们探讨了平台进入、自由进入条件下在位平台质量变化以及兼容性程度的影响。我们还展示了如何将分析扩展至部分用户参与的情形。
10.1111/1756-2171.70008.title: Asymmetric Platform Oligopoly

10.1111/1756-2171.70012.abstract: Influencers, from propagandists to sellers, expend vast resources targeting agents who amplify their message through word-of-mouth communication. While agents differ in network position, they also differ in their bias: Agents may naturally read articles with a particular slant or buy products from a certain seller. Absent competition, an influencer prefers targeting central agents and those biased against it. If agents are unbiased, competition leads to influencers targeting more central agents. However, when agents have heterogeneous biases and competition is intense, the incentive to deter one's rival dominates. Influencers protect their base, targeting those with similar beliefs in equilibrium.
10.1111/1756-2171.70012.abstract_zh: 从宣传者到销售者，影响者投入大量资源瞄准那些通过口碑传播放大其信息的代理人。尽管代理人在网络位置上有差异，他们在偏见上也各不相同：代理人可能自然倾向于阅读特定倾向的文章或从特定卖家购买产品。在没有竞争的情况下，影响者偏好瞄准中心代理人及那些对其有偏见的代理人。若代理人无偏见，竞争促使影响者瞄准更中心的代理人。然而，当代理人具有异质性偏见且竞争激烈时，遏制对手的动机占据主导。影响者保护其基本盘，在均衡状态下瞄准信念相近的代理人。

10.1111/1756-2171.70013.abstract: A privately informed sender can commit to any disclosure policy toward a receiver, whose actions affect the utility of the sender. We show that full disclosure is optimal under a sufficient condition with some desirable properties. First, it speaks directly to the parties' utility functions, as opposed to the sender's indirect utility function; this makes it easily interpretable and verifiable. Second, it does not require the sender's payoff to be a function of the posterior mean state. Third, it is weaker than the conditions obtained in the literature for some specific settings.
10.1111/1756-2171.70013.abstract_zh: 拥有私人信息的发送者可以向接收者承诺任何信息披露政策，而接收者的行为会影响发送者的效用。我们证明，在具备某些理想性质的充分条件下，完全披露是最优的。首先，该条件直接针对双方的效用函数，而非发送者的间接效用函数，因此易于解释和验证。其次，它不要求发送者的收益是后验均值状态的函数。第三，它比文献中针对某些特定情境所得出的条件更为宽松。

10.1111/1756-2171.70014.abstract: A platform matches a unit mass of sellers, each owning a single product of heterogeneous quality, to a unit mass of buyers with differing valuations for unit-quality. After matching, sellers make take-it-or-leave-it price-offers to buyers. Initially, valuations of buyers are only known to them and the platform, but sellers make inferences from the matching algorithm. The efficient matching is positive assortative, but buyer-optimal matchings are stochastically negative assortative when there are few low-value buyers (i.e., compared to lower-quality sellers, high-quality ones are matched to buyers with lower expected valuation). Although everyone trades, generating rents for the side lacking bargaining power results in inefficient matching.
10.1111/1756-2171.70014.abstract_zh: 平台将单位质量的卖方（每位卖方拥有一件质量异质的产品）与单位质量的买方（对单位质量具有不同估值）进行匹配。匹配完成后，卖方对买方提出“要么接受，要么放弃”的价格报价。初始时，买方的估值仅为其自身和平台所知，但卖方会从匹配算法中进行推断。有效匹配是正选择性的，但当低价值买方数量较少时（即与低质量卖方相比，高质量卖方匹配到的买方预期估值更低），买方最优匹配在随机意义上是负选择性的。尽管所有交易均能达成，但为缺乏议价能力的一方创造租金会导致匹配效率低下。

10.1111/1756-2171.70015.abstract: We study a long-horizon, oligopolistic market with random shocks to demand that can be arbitraged by two storage operators with finite capacity. This problem applies to any storable commodity—that is, most commodities. Because the arbitrage spread is so sensitive to market power, storage operators face strong incentives to restrain quantities by tacitly colluding. This cooperation takes new forms thanks to the multiplicity of actions they must take: selling, buying, or both. We construct payoff-maximizing equilibria of this stochastic game, and uncover a new form of Partial Cooperation that trades off quantities and delay. While collusive, Partial Cooperation delivers higher consumer surplus thanks to the market power effect. Head-on competition is not always an equilibrium of the long-horizon game when market power becomes large enough. We draw implications for policy and suggest poorly competitive storage is a negative externality to the development of the underlying commodity—for example, renewable energy.
10.1111/1756-2171.70015.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个长期视野下的寡头垄断市场，其中需求受到随机冲击，而两家具有有限容量的存储运营商可以通过套利来应对这些冲击。此问题适用于任何可储存商品——即大多数商品。由于套利价差对市场力量极为敏感，存储运营商面临通过默契合谋来限制数量的强烈激励。鉴于他们必须采取多种行动——出售、购买或两者兼有，这种合作呈现出新的形式。我们构建了该随机博弈中的利润最大化均衡，并揭示了一种新的部分合作形式，它在数量与延迟之间进行权衡。尽管属于合谋性质，部分合作因市场力量效应而带来了更高的消费者剩余。当市场力量足够大时，正面竞争并不总是长期博弈中的均衡状态。我们为政策制定提供了启示，并指出存储领域竞争不足对基础商品——例如可再生能源——的发展构成了一种负外部性。

10.1111/1756-2171.70016.abstract: A long-lived seller sells a new product of unknown value by offering prices and recommendations to short-lived consumers in continuous time. The seller receives consumer feedback about the product at a rate that increases with the instantaneous sales volume. The optimal selling mechanism features episodes of price discounts, during which the seller discontinuously lowers the price and offers unwarranted recommendations to consumers. The optimal pricing strategy depends on the nature of consumer feedback and may involve early or late discounts, dynamic price backtracking, and below-cost pricing.
10.1111/1756-2171.70016.abstract_zh: 长期存在的卖方通过连续时间内的定价与推荐，向短视消费者销售价值未知的新产品。卖方接收消费者反馈的速度随瞬时销售量增加而加快。最优销售机制包含价格折扣阶段，在此期间卖方非连续地降低价格并向消费者提供无依据的推荐。最优定价策略取决于消费者反馈的性质，可能涉及早期或晚期折扣、动态价格回溯及低于成本的定价。

10.1111/1756-2171.70017.abstract: We are grateful to Ronald Davies, Arye Hillman, Robert Schwager, and Holger Strulik for early comments and suggestions, and to our editor and two anonymous referees for valuable and constructive feedback. We also thank participants at the ALDE Applied Economics Meeting, AMES China, ERMAS Cluj-Napoca, Heidelberg University, Munich Summer Institute, National University of Singapore, and ZEW Mannheim Public Finance conference for helpful discussions.
10.1111/1756-2171.70017.abstract_zh: 我们感谢Ronald Davies、Arye Hillman、Robert Schwager和Holger Strulik的早期评论与建议，以及编辑和两位匿名审稿人的宝贵建设性反馈。同时，也感谢ALDE应用经济学会议、AMES中国、ERMAS克卢日-纳波卡、海德堡大学、慕尼黑夏季研究所、新加坡国立大学及ZEW曼海姆公共财政会议与会者的有益讨论。

10.1111/1756-2171.70036.abstract: Biased recommendations arise naturally in markets with heterogeneous consumers. We study a model in which a monopolist offers an experience good to a population of consumers with heterogeneous tastes and makes personalized purchase recommendations. We provide conditions under which a firm makes welfare-reducing purchase recommendations with positive probability, resulting in inflated recommendations. We extend this insight to a setting in which an intermediary makes the recommendations, whereas a seller sets the retail price. Regulatory interventions that forbid inflated recommendations may lead to higher social welfare or may backfire.
10.1111/1756-2171.70036.abstract_zh: 在消费者偏好异质的市场中，偏见性推荐自然产生。我们研究了一个模型，其中垄断者向具有异质品味的消费者群体提供体验品，并做出个性化购买推荐。我们给出了企业在正概率下做出降低福利的购买推荐的条件，导致推荐膨胀。我们将这一见解扩展到中介机构做出推荐、而卖家设定零售价格的情境。禁止膨胀推荐的监管干预可能提高社会福利，也可能适得其反。

10.1111/1756-2171.70038.abstract: We analyze a dynamic model of repeated innovation where inventors may either be acquired by an incumbent or else resist takeover and challenge for leadership. In the short run, acquisitions always spur innovation because of the invention-for-buyout effect. In the longer run, however, they may stifle it because of a countervailing effect, the entrenchment of monopoly. The latter occurs when the incumbent's dominance depends on past levels of activity and is therefore reinforced by recurrent acquisitions. We show that if the entrenchment effect is sufficiently strong, forward-looking policymakers should prohibit acquisitions in anticipation of the long-run negative impact on innovation. This argument sets out a new theory of harm that can be used to block acquisitions that could otherwise go unchallenged.
10.1111/1756-2171.70038.abstract_zh: 我们分析了一个重复创新的动态模型，其中发明者可能被现有企业收购，或者抵制收购并挑战领导地位。短期内，收购总能通过“发明-购买”效应刺激创新。然而，从长远来看，由于一种抵消效应——垄断的固化，收购可能会抑制创新。当现有企业的支配地位依赖于过去的活跃水平，并因此被反复收购所强化时，就会出现这种固化效应。我们证明，如果固化效应足够强，前瞻性的政策制定者应预见收购对创新的长期负面影响而予以禁止。这一论点提出了一种新的损害理论，可用于阻止那些否则可能不受质疑的收购。

10.1111/1756-2171.70039.abstract: Pay-TV firms compete both downstream to attract viewers and upstream to acquire broadcasting rights. Because profits inherited from downstream competition satisfy a convexity property, allocating rights to the dominant firm maximizes the industry profit. Such an exclusive allocation of rights emerges as a robust equilibrium outcome but may fail to maximize welfare. We analyze whether a ban on resale and a ban on package bidding may improve welfare. These corrective policies have no impact on the final allocation but lead to profit redistribution along the value chain.
10.1111/1756-2171.70039.abstract_zh: 付费电视企业在下游争夺观众，同时在上游竞争获取转播权。由于下游竞争所继承的利润满足凸性性质，将转播权分配给主导企业可实现行业利润最大化。这种排他性的转播权分配作为稳健的均衡结果出现，但可能无法实现福利最大化。我们分析禁止转售和禁止组合投标是否能改善福利。这些矫正性政策对最终分配没有影响，但会导致价值链上的利润再分配。

10.1111/1756-2171.70040.abstract: We study strategic trading by a privately informed blockholder who monitors a company and trades its shares. Private information results in larger block sizes in good states, but by increasing the speed of the blockholder's selling, it can result in lower block sizes in bad states. Despite the heterogeneous impact on expected block size, we show that asymmetric information leads to Pareto improvements: it raises stock prices, benefits small uninformed shareholders, and benefits the block owner, despite the negative impact on liquidity.
10.1111/1756-2171.70040.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一位拥有私人信息的控股股东的战略性交易行为，该股东既监督公司又交易其股份。私人信息在良好状态下导致更大的持股规模，但通过加快控股股东的卖出速度，在不利状态下可能导致持股规模减小。尽管对预期持股规模的影响存在异质性，我们表明信息不对称带来了帕累托改进：它提高了股价，惠及小型不知情股东，并有利于控股股东，尽管对流动性产生了负面影响。

10.1111/1756-2171.70041.abstract: I estimate a Bayesian persuasion model to examine how financial incentives and asymmetric information shape physician–patient interactions. This approach offers new insights into the role of insurance. First, the model predicts that patients' coinsurance moderates physicians' responsiveness to increases in service fees. This prediction is supported by a difference-in-differences analysis using Chinese health insurance claims data with random variation in physicians' reimbursement and patients' coinsurance rates. Second, the model implies that lower coinsurance rates reduce both patient price elasticity and skepticism, increasing the likelihood of physicians misdirecting patients toward unnecessary treatments. Using structural model estimates, I show that for a diagnosis where surgical treatment is discretionary, nearly half of the patients who received surgery would not have done so were they fully informed. Such misdirection from physicians is greater when coinsurance rates decrease, highlighting a new inefficiency channel beyond moral hazard. I decompose the effect of lowering coinsurance into moral hazard and the novel greater misdirection effect. Counterfactual analysis shows that, while patients benefit from lower out-of-pocket costs, greater misdirection nearly offsets these welfare gains.
10.1111/1756-2171.70041.abstract_zh: 我估计了一个贝叶斯说服模型，以考察经济激励和信息不对称如何塑造医患互动。这一方法为理解保险的作用提供了新视角。首先，模型预测患者的共付比例会调节医生对服务费用增加的响应程度。这一预测得到了基于中国健康保险索赔数据的双重差分分析的支持，该数据中医生报销比例和患者共付比例存在随机变动。其次，模型暗示较低的共付比例会降低患者的价格敏感性和怀疑程度，从而增加医生将患者误导至不必要治疗的可能性。利用结构模型估计，我表明对于手术属于可选择性治疗的诊断，近半数接受手术的患者若完全知情则不会选择手术。当共付比例下降时，医生的此类误导行为更为严重，这凸显了道德风险之外的一个新的效率损失渠道。我将降低共付比例的影响分解为道德风险和新的更大误导效应。反事实分析显示，尽管患者从较低的自付费用中获益，但更大的误导效应几乎抵消了这些福利收益。

10.1111/1756-2171.70043.abstract: The trade-off between market power and efficiency gains is central to antitrust analyses of mergers, but empirical evidence quantifying efficiencies remains limited. Using transaction-level data from U.S. freight railroads (1985–2005), this article quantifies merger-induced cost efficiencies, driven mainly by eliminating inter-railroad interchange costs and reoptimization of routing and resource allocation within integrated networks. I develop a spatial equilibrium model with oligopolistic competition to assess equilibrium merger effects. Counterfactual analyses show mergers reduce shipment costs by 12.9% and prices by 8.8%. Markups increase by 7.2%, driven primarily by non-merging firms reallocating resources away from regions where merged firms achieve large cost reductions.
10.1111/1756-2171.70043.abstract_zh: 市场势力与效率提升之间的权衡是并购反垄断分析的核心问题，但量化效率的实证证据仍然有限。利用美国货运铁路的微观交易数据（1985-2005年），本文量化了并购带来的成本效率，这些效率主要源于消除铁路间换装成本以及整合网络内路线和资源配置的重新优化。我构建了一个包含寡头竞争的空间均衡模型，以评估并购的均衡效应。反事实分析显示，并购使运输成本降低12.9%，价格下降8.8%。加成率上升7.2%，主要驱动因素是非并购企业将资源从并购企业实现大幅成本降低的区域重新配置出去。

10.1111/1756-2171.70050.abstract: This article examines the welfare implications of third-party informational intermediation. A seller sets the price of a product that is sold through an intermediary, who discloses information about the product to consumers. In a model where the intermediary is consumer-minded—has a payoff that depends on both the seller's revenue and the consumer surplus, we show that total welfare may decrease in the Pareto sense, as the intermediary's consumer-mindedness increases. Furthermore, we show that consumer-mindedness emerges endogenously when a revenue-maximizing intermediary is forward-looking and the consumer base is increasing in past consumer surplus.
10.1111/1756-2171.70050.abstract_zh: 本文考察了第三方信息中介的福利影响。卖方设定通过中介销售的产品价格，中介向消费者披露产品信息。在模型中，中介以消费者为导向——其收益同时取决于卖方收入和消费者剩余，我们证明，随着中介消费者导向程度的提高，总福利可能在帕累托意义上下降。此外，我们表明，当追求收入最大化的中介具有前瞻性，且消费者基数随过去消费者剩余增加时，消费者导向会内生地出现。

10.1111/1756-2171.70051.abstract: This article studies a dynamic project-selection game between a Principal and an Agent with conflicting interests. Only the Agent knows what projects are feasible. In each period before a project is selected, the Principal imposes a restriction set. The Agent can select any feasible project within this set, thereby ending the game. The Agent can also stay silent, in which case the game will proceed to the next period. Importantly, the Principal cannot commit to her future restriction sets. I show that when the Agent is sufficiently patient, the Principal fully delegates to the Agent in the unique equilibrium.
10.1111/1756-2171.70051.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个委托人与代理人之间利益冲突的动态项目选择博弈。只有代理人知晓哪些项目是可行的。在每个项目被选定之前的每个时期，委托人施加一个限制集合。代理人可以在该集合内选择任何可行的项目，从而结束博弈。代理人也可以保持沉默，在这种情况下，博弈将进入下一时期。重要的是，委托人无法承诺其未来的限制集合。我证明，当代理人足够有耐心时，在唯一均衡中，委托人会将决策权完全委托给代理人。

10.1111/1756-2171.70052.abstract: We propose a demand estimation approach that leverages unstructured data to infer substitution patterns. Using pre-trained deep learning models, we extract embeddings from product images and textual descriptions and incorporate them into a mixed logit demand model. This approach enables demand estimation even when researchers lack data on product attributes or when consumers value hard-to-quantify attributes such as visual design. Using a choice experiment, we show this approach substantially outperforms standard attribute-based models at counterfactual predictions of second choices. We also apply it to 40 product categories offered on Amazon.com and consistently find that unstructured data are informative about substitution patterns.
10.1111/1756-2171.70052.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种需求估计方法，利用非结构化数据来推断替代模式。通过使用预训练的深度学习模型，我们从产品图像和文本描述中提取嵌入，并将其纳入混合逻辑需求模型。这种方法使得即使研究者缺乏产品属性数据，或消费者重视难以量化的属性（如视觉设计）时，也能进行需求估计。通过选择实验，我们证明该方法在反事实预测第二选择方面显著优于基于属性的标准模型。我们还将此方法应用于Amazon.com上提供的40个产品类别，并一致发现非结构化数据对替代模式具有信息价值。

10.1111/1756-2171.70056.abstract: This article studies entry preemption in new industries. We first test a key prediction of dynamic entry games: Entry preemption is most relevant in intermediate‐sized markets, where firms face highest uncertainty about future entry. Using US drive‐in theater market (1945–1957) data, we find robust evidence for this non‐monotonic relationship between market size and early entry probability. We then estimate a dynamic entry game, and quantify preemption effects through counterfactual analysis. Preemptive motives increase early entry by up to 40% in mid‐size markets, raising entry costs by 5% and reducing firms' expected value by 1%.
10.1111/1756-2171.70056.abstract_zh: 本文研究新产业中的进入抢占行为。我们首先检验动态进入博弈的一个关键预测：进入抢占在中等规模市场中最为显著，因为此时企业面临最大的未来进入不确定性。利用美国汽车影院市场（1945-1957年）的数据，我们发现了市场规模与早期进入概率之间呈非单调关系的稳健证据。随后，我们估计了一个动态进入博弈模型，并通过反事实分析量化了抢占效应。在中等规模市场中，抢占动机使早期进入率最高增加40%，导致进入成本上升5%，并使企业预期价值降低1%。
10.1111/1756-2171.70056.title: Preemptive Entry and Technology Diffusion: The Market for Drive‐In Theaters
10.1111/1756-2171.70056.title_zh: 先发进入与技术扩散：汽车影院市场

10.1111/1756-2171.70057.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the optimal design of a monopoly platform that interacts with heterogeneous firms and consumers who face uncertainty about product values and prices. Consumers search randomly among firms recommended by the platform. The platform designs a menu of contracts tailored to different firm types and allocates consumer visits across these firms. We show that the optimal platform design creates a “superstar effect,” whereby high‐type firms capture a disproportionately large market share, and improves consumer welfare relative to the no‐design benchmark.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70057.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个垄断平台的最优设计问题，该平台与异质性企业以及面临产品价值和价格不确定性的消费者进行互动。消费者在平台推荐的企业中进行随机搜索。平台针对不同类型的企业设计了一套定制化合同菜单，并将消费者访问量分配给这些企业。研究表明，最优平台设计会产生“超级明星效应”，即高类型企业获得不成比例的巨大市场份额，并且与无设计基准相比，该设计能够改善消费者福利。
10.1111/1756-2171.70057.title: Consumer Search, Firm Heterogeneity, and Platform Design
10.1111/1756-2171.70057.title_zh: 消费者搜索、企业异质性与平台设计

10.1111/1756-2171.70058.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This article studies price discrimination by a seller who uses data on observables that buyers can control (or manipulate) at a cost. If the seller's discriminatory prices are offered covertly, equilibrium market segmentation is always coarse, resulting in limited price discrimination. In contrast, if prices must be transparently posted, every buyer pays a personalized price in equilibrium, though this does not always reduce buyer or social welfare. The analysis sheds new light on calls for transparency in how sellers utilize consumer data to customize prices and highlights potential issues with assessing welfare using (only) observed prices, pricing conduct, and market coverage.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70058.abstract_zh: 本文研究卖方利用买方可以控制（或操纵）的可观测数据进行价格歧视的行为。若卖方的歧视性定价以隐蔽方式提供，均衡市场分割始终较为粗糙，导致有限的价格歧视。相反，若价格必须透明公示，则均衡状态下每位买方均需支付个性化价格，但这并不总能降低买方福利或社会福利。该分析为要求卖方透明化利用消费者数据定制价格的呼声提供了新视角，并揭示了仅依据观测价格、定价行为及市场覆盖率评估福利时可能存在的问题。
10.1111/1756-2171.70058.title: Price Discrimination With Manipulable Observables
10.1111/1756-2171.70058.title_zh: 可操纵观测值下的价格歧视

10.1111/1756-2171.70059.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This article provides a full characterization of the competitive effects of horizontal mergers in the Cournot model with heterogeneous firms and constant marginal costs. We show that price effects depend only on the smaller merging firm's market share and the number of firms but are independent of the distribution of market shares among other firms. Standard concentration measures, instead, are often misleading. We also provide simple—yet general—closed‐form solutions for merger effects based on pre‐merger parameters. Moreover, we extend the model to study the combination of output and input market power and relate our results to the Merger Guidelines.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70059.abstract_zh: 本文全面刻画了异质性企业且边际成本恒定条件下古诺模型中横向合并的竞争效应。研究表明，价格效应仅取决于规模较小合并企业的市场份额及企业数量，而与其他企业的市场份额分布无关。相比之下，标准集中度指标往往具有误导性。我们基于合并前参数，为合并效应提供了简洁而通用的闭式解。此外，我们将模型拓展至产出市场与投入市场势力的联合分析，并将研究结论与《合并指南》相关联。
10.1111/1756-2171.70059.title: The Competitive Effects of Mergers with Cournot Competition
10.1111/1756-2171.70059.title_zh: 古诺竞争下并购的竞争效应

10.1111/1756-2171.70060.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
