10.1111/caje.70081.abstract_zh: 加拿大的儿童福利金数额可观，专门针对儿童发放，并支付给监护母亲，因此可能预期会影响家庭资源配置和配偶间的议价能力。2016年7月推出的加拿大儿童福利金使有子女家庭获得的儿童福利金额增加了一倍以上。我们估计了这一变化对双亲家庭中男性和女性偏好及资源份额的影响。资源份额，即女性相对于男性所消费的家庭支出比例，是集体家庭模型中的重要参数。利用结构集体家庭模型中的双重差分策略，我们发现几乎没有证据表明男性或女性的偏好因儿童福利金的增加而发生变化。然而，我们确实发现该政策提高了女性的资源份额，但仅限于有房家庭（而非租房家庭）。我们讨论了房主与租户之间处理效应的这种异质性，并提出了潜在的潜在机制。
10.1111/caje.70081.title: How did the Canada Child Benefit affect household bargaining?
10.1111/caje.70081.title_zh: 加拿大儿童福利如何影响家庭议价？

10.1111/caje.70082.abstract: This paper examines how firms responded to the disruptions caused by the global supply chain (GSC) shocks induced by the COVID‐19 pandemic. Leveraging firm‐level trade data from France, we analyze shifts in export and import values and prices in response to transportation bottlenecks and pandemic containment measures in partner countries. Our findings reveal that firms adapted to these shocks by temporarily scaling back trade volumes and dropping varieties. During the recovery phase, supply chain bottlenecks stoked price hikes, disproportionately affecting upstream industries. Furthermore, we demonstrate that firms using industrial robots in production and those with prudent inventory management practices were more resilient to the pandemic shock.
10.1111/caje.70082.abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业如何应对由COVID-19疫情引发的全球供应链（GSC）冲击所导致的 disruptions。利用法国企业层面的贸易数据，我们分析了在运输瓶颈及伙伴国疫情管控措施下，出口和进口价值及价格的变动。研究发现，企业通过暂时缩减贸易规模和减少产品种类来适应这些冲击。在复苏阶段，供应链瓶颈加剧了价格上涨，对上游行业影响尤为显著。此外，我们证明，在生产中使用工业机器人的企业以及采取审慎库存管理实践的企业，对疫情冲击表现出更强的韧性。
10.1111/caje.70082.title: Pandemic disruptions in global supply chains: Evidence on trade values and prices from French firms
10.1111/caje.70082.title_zh: 全球供应链中的疫情中断：来自法国企业的贸易价值与价格证据

10.1111/caje.70083.abstract: Through anti‐corruption prosecutions, governments will often look to publicly signal their efforts at tackling corruption as a way of garnering political support. Our analysis combines Chinese data on the public disclosures of anti‐corruption prosecutions and individual well‐being indicators to explore the effect of these efforts for subjective well‐being. We show that while such signals are intended to garner political support, they can inadvertently lower life satisfaction among citizens, especially when political trust is low. Overall, our analysis illustrates how public demonstrations of efforts aimed at addressing issues of concern, despite their intended positive political effects, can erode public well‐being and potentially backfire when trust in the government is weak.
10.1111/caje.70083.abstract_zh: 通过反腐败起诉，政府往往寻求公开宣示其打击腐败的努力，以此获取政治支持。我们的分析结合了中国反腐败起诉公开披露的数据与个体福祉指标，探讨这些努力对主观幸福感的影响。我们表明，尽管此类信号旨在获取政治支持，但它们可能无意中降低公民的生活满意度，尤其是在政治信任度较低的情况下。总体而言，我们的分析揭示了，针对关切问题所采取努力的公开示范，尽管预期具有积极的政治效应，但在政府信任薄弱时，可能侵蚀公众福祉并可能适得其反。
10.1111/caje.70083.title: “Tiger‐hunting” and life satisfaction: A matter of trust
10.1111/caje.70083.title_zh: 猎虎”与生活满意度：信任的作用

10.1111/caje.70084.abstract: This paper develops a Romer (1990)‐type endogenous growth model that incorporates polluting non‐renewable resources and heterogeneous households with varying asset holdings. It contributes to the literature on the taxation of polluting exhaustible resources by examining its impact on consumption inequality, with particular emphasis on the role of natural resources as household assets. In the model, the stock of pollution—accumulating through resource use—affects social welfare. We show that, when distortions from intertemporal knowledge spillovers are not fully corrected, environmental tax policies that slow resource extraction and mitigate the welfare costs of pollution can foster economic growth but exacerbate consumption inequality. To promote growth and reduce the welfare damage caused by pollution without increasing inequality, environmental tax revenues should be allocated for redistributive purposes. Lastly, the paper calibrates the model for quantitative analysis and explores environmental tax policies that maximize social welfare under limited government capacity to correct knowledge spillover distortions, relying on environmental tax revenues for redistribution.
10.1111/caje.70084.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个罗默（1990）式内生增长模型，该模型融入了污染性不可再生资源及资产持有量各异的异质性家庭。本文对污染性可耗竭资源税收研究领域的贡献在于，考察了此类税收对消费不平等的影响，特别强调了自然资源作为家庭资产的作用。在模型中，通过资源使用累积的污染存量影响社会福利。我们证明，当跨期知识溢出的扭曲未被完全纠正时，减缓资源开采并减轻污染福利成本的环境税收政策虽能促进经济增长，却会加剧消费不平等。为在不加剧不平等的前提下促进增长并减少污染造成的福利损害，环境税收收入应被用于再分配目的。最后，本文对模型进行了校准以进行定量分析，并探讨了在政府纠正知识溢出扭曲能力有限、依赖环境税收收入进行再分配的情况下，能够最大化社会福利的环境税收政策。
10.1111/caje.70084.title: Taxing polluting resources: growth, welfare and consumption inequality
10.1111/caje.70084.title_zh: 对污染性资源征税：增长、福利与消费不平等

10.1111/caje.70085.abstract: The seminal 1987 paper by Mathewson and Winter demonstrates that the competitive effects of exclusive dealing depend on firm asymmetries. Revisiting their model with linear demand and constant marginal costs, we show that the equilibrium adoption and welfare impact of exclusive dealing are fully characterized by two sufficient statistics: the standalone surplus ratio (capturing the dominant firm's competitive advantage) and the geometric mean of demand diversion ratios (measuring product substitutability). Exclusive dealing is more likely to arise and harm consumer surplus when competitive advantage is stronger and products are closer substitutes. A stronger competitive advantage also raises the likelihood that exclusive dealing reduces social welfare, while the effect of substitutability on welfare is non‐monotonic. We also show that both competitive advantage and substitutability can be empirically recovered from diversion ratios and market shares under the no‐exclusive dealing regime.
10.1111/caje.70085.abstract_zh: Mathewson和Winter在1987年的开创性论文表明，排他性交易的竞争效应取决于企业的不对称性。通过在线性需求和恒定边际成本下重新审视其模型，我们证明排他性交易的均衡采纳及其福利影响完全由两个充分统计量刻画：独立剩余比率（反映主导企业的竞争优势）和需求转移率的几何平均值（衡量产品替代性）。当竞争优势更强且产品更接近替代品时，排他性交易更可能发生并损害消费者剩余。更强的竞争优势也提高了排他性交易降低社会福利的可能性，而替代性对福利的影响则是非单调的。我们还表明，在无排他性交易制度下，竞争优势和替代性均可通过转移率和市场份额进行实证估计。
10.1111/caje.70085.title: A re‐examination of the competitive effects of exclusive dealing
10.1111/caje.70085.title_zh: 独家交易的竞争效应再考察

10.1111/caje.70086.abstract: We investigate the anticompetitive effects of debt financing and managerial incentives in the presence of managers incurring personal bankruptcy costs. We characterize the strategic value for firms' shareholders of resorting to debt and managerial incentives as complementary devices to sustain collusion among firms, when managerial bankruptcy costs are sufficiently responsive to the severity of financial distress. The shareholders' inability to commit to debt and managerial contracts implies that common lending to different firms constitutes a key driver for collusion. These results square with the well‐documented empirical evidence on debt financing, managerial incentives, and common lending in sectors plagued by collusion.
10.1111/caje.70086.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在管理者承担个人破产成本的情况下，债务融资与管理者激励的反竞争效应。当管理者破产成本对财务困境的严重程度反应足够敏感时，我们刻画了企业股东将债务与管理者激励作为互补工具以维持企业间合谋的战略价值。股东无法承诺债务及管理者契约，意味着对不同企业的共同贷款成为合谋的关键驱动因素。这些结果与关于债务融资、管理者激励及受合谋困扰行业中共同贷款的广泛实证证据相吻合。
10.1111/caje.70086.title: Collusion through debt and managers
10.1111/caje.70086.title_zh: 通过债务与经理人合谋

10.1111/caje.70088.abstract: Suppose that expert witnesses appearing in litigation are, generically, either honest in their assessment of a fact situation or are advocates who testify in favour of their retaining party, regardless of new information. The type of a witness is known to law firms, who engage with them repeatedly, but not to courts. If the only way an honest witness can credibly reveal their type to a court is by agreeing with some of the position of the opposing party, then the question arises of why a law firm would ever retain an honest expert. We show that it can act as a signalling device in a game between the law firms to communicate private information regarding a party's confidence in winning the case. Our results indicate, inter alia, that the “English” rule of costs allocation can make a socially desirable separating equilibrium less likely, compared to the “American” rule.
10.1111/caje.70088.abstract_zh: 假设在诉讼中出庭的专家证人，大体上可分为两类：一类对其所面对的事实情况评估诚实，另一类则是不论新信息如何，都倾向于为其委托方作证的辩护型证人。律师事务所因与证人反复打交道而知晓其类型，但法院对此并不知情。如果诚实证人能向法院可信地揭示其类型的唯一途径，是部分认同对方当事人的立场，那么问题便产生了：律师事务所为何会聘请诚实专家？我们证明，在律师事务所之间传递关于其案件胜诉信心的私人信息博弈中，这可以作为一种信号机制。我们的研究结果尤其表明，与“美国”规则相比，“英国”的费用分配规则可能使社会期望的分离均衡更难以实现。
10.1111/caje.70088.title: Of hired guns and ideologues: Why would a law firm ever retain an honest expert witness?
10.1111/caje.70088.title_zh: 雇佣枪手与意识形态者：律师事务所为何会聘请诚实的专家证人？

10.1111/caje.70089.abstract: Primary health care is the doorkeeper for individual health and the cornerstone of universal health coverage. Despite global efforts to promote universal health coverage, the underuse of primary health‐care services remains prevalent in rural areas, resulting in significant health concerns for rural residents. As a part of the policy to strengthen primary health care, the Chinese government has established a rural physician program to deliver immediate and convenient health‐care services. This paper provides the first evaluation of the effects of the rural physician program. We find that although most rural physicians have limited education and lack professional training, the program significantly improves rural residents' health outcomes. The improvement is mainly attributed to changes in health awareness and health‐seeking behaviours among rural residents, enhanced accessibility to nearby health‐care providers, regular health examinations and the diagnosis of simple diseases. However, the program demonstrates limited effect in addressing complex chronic diseases. Moreover, a cost‐benefit analysis indicates that the benefits derived from the program outweigh the associated costs. Therefore, this paper highlights a relatively cost‐effective way to improve the health status of rural and impoverished populations, particularly in developing countries and regions.
10.1111/caje.70089.abstract_zh: 初级卫生保健是个人健康的守门人，也是全民健康覆盖的基石。尽管全球致力于推动全民健康覆盖，但在农村地区，初级卫生保健服务的利用不足依然普遍存在，给农村居民的健康带来了重大隐患。作为加强初级卫生保健政策的一部分，中国政府设立了乡村医生项目，以提供即时便捷的医疗卫生服务。本文首次评估了乡村医生项目的效果。研究发现，尽管大多数乡村医生受教育程度有限且缺乏专业培训，该项目仍显著改善了农村居民的健康结果。这一改善主要归因于农村居民健康意识和就医行为的转变、邻近医疗服务可及性的增强、定期健康检查以及常见疾病的诊断。然而，该项目在应对复杂慢性疾病方面效果有限。此外，成本效益分析表明，该项目带来的收益超过了相关成本。因此，本文揭示了一种相对经济有效的途径，用以改善农村及贫困人口的健康状况，尤其是在发展中国家和地区。
10.1111/caje.70089.title: Rural physician program and health outcomes: Evidence and mechanisms
10.1111/caje.70089.title_zh: 农村医生项目与健康结果：证据与机制

10.1111/cjag.70011.abstract: We estimate the environmentally adjusted productivity growth and shadow price for Ontario dairy farms. We use an input‐oriented directional distance function and farm‐level data from 2000 to 2020. First, we find that while GHG emissions per cow increase with higher milk yields, emission intensity decreases as milk yield per cow increases. We also find that emission intensity decreased over the study period. Second, we find that environmentally adjusted productivity growth is higher than unadjusted productivity growth. Technological change contributed more to both environmentally adjusted and unadjusted productivity growth than did efficiency change. Third, the estimated shadow price for GHG emissions was CAN$286 per metric ton.
10.1111/cjag.70011.abstract_zh: 我们估算了安大略省奶牛场的环境调整后生产率增长及影子价格。我们采用投入导向型方向性距离函数，并使用2000年至2020年的农场层面数据。首先，我们发现尽管每头奶牛的温室气体排放量随牛奶产量的提高而增加，但排放强度却随着每头奶牛产奶量的增加而下降。同时，我们还发现研究期间排放强度有所降低。其次，我们发现环境调整后的生产率增长高于未调整的生产率增长。技术进步对两种生产率增长的贡献均大于效率变化。第三，估算的温室气体排放影子价格为每公吨286加元。

10.1111/cjag.70014.abstract: Abstract Supply management (SM) has recently attracted a lot of attention nationally and internationally. A bill (C‐202) to safeguard SM from future international trade negotiations was voted unanimously by the Canadian parliament in 2025. At the international level, tariffs associated with SM have been criticized by the Trump administration. Given that SM is based on a tacit social contract between SM farmers and society at large, as well as its political significance, it appears important to assess the level of knowledge of Canadians regarding this policy, as well as their perception of SM themes raised in the media. This paper reports the literacy score and perceptions on SM of a national survey of over 1200 respondents. To analyze the data, perceptions on SM themes are regressed on respondents’ level of SM literacy, sociodemographic data, as well as on two questions that are of a more ideological nature. Results indicate that Canadians have little knowledge of the working or scope of SM. Furthermore, after providing neutral information on themes related to SM that are or have been in the media, we find that the views toward SM policy are mostly negative, with the most negative perceptions held by respondents with ideologies that we loosely classify as economic conservatism.
10.1111/cjag.70014.abstract_zh: 摘要 供应管理（SM）近年来在国内和国际上引起了广泛关注。一项旨在保护供应管理免受未来国际贸易谈判影响的法案（C-202）于2025年在加拿大议会获得一致通过。在国际层面，与供应管理相关的关税受到了特朗普政府的批评。鉴于供应管理基于供应管理农民与整个社会之间的一种隐性社会契约，以及其政治重要性，评估加拿大人对该政策的了解程度以及他们对媒体中提及的供应管理议题的看法显得尤为重要。本文报告了一项全国性调查中超过1200名受访者的供应管理素养得分及其看法。为分析数据，我们将受访者对供应管理议题的看法回归于其供应管理素养水平、社会人口统计数据以及两个更具意识形态性质的问题。结果表明，加拿大人对供应管理的运作方式或范围知之甚少。此外，在提供关于媒体中已出现或正在出现的供应管理相关议题的中立信息后，我们发现对供应管理政策的看法大多为负面，其中持有我们粗略归类为经济保守主义意识形态的受访者所持看法最为负面。

10.1111/cjag.70016.abstract: Abstract True dietary change typically occurs through consumer preferences, and when changes in product attributes reflect these preferences, category‐level demand can be substantially rearranged. In this study, we show that a successful new product may fundamentally change the nature of an entire category, and change consumers' nutrient consumption by altering the nutrient content of the food products they consume. Greek yogurt, for example, offers a very different combination of nutrients relative to other types of yogurts. The fact that it was immediately successful after its introduction provides an example of a transformational new product—one that potentially changed the nutrient‐consumption profiles of yogurt buyers. We use a quasi‐experimental approach with propensity score matching (DiD + PSM) to identify the effect of introducing Greek yogurt on yogurt buyers’ nutrient consumption. We find that the introduction of Greek yogurt led to yogurt purchases with greater overall protein and calorie content, but lower fat and carbohydrate content. We use the case of Greek yogurt to show that a relatively simple innovative common consumer product can have far‐reaching implications for the nature of nutrients consumed from that category. Our findings point to the importance of information policies, and their interaction with consumer preferences, on changing dietary outcomes.
10.1111/cjag.70016.abstract_zh: 真正的饮食变化通常源于消费者偏好的转变，当产品属性的变化反映出这些偏好时，类别层面的需求可能会发生显著重组。本研究表明，一款成功的新产品可能从根本上改变整个类别的性质，并通过改变消费者所消费食品的营养成分来影响其营养摄入。例如，希腊酸奶相较于其他类型的酸奶，提供了截然不同的营养组合。其上市后迅速取得成功，成为变革性新产品的典范——这类产品可能改变了酸奶购买者的营养摄入结构。我们采用准实验方法，结合倾向得分匹配（双重差分法+倾向得分匹配法，DiD+PSM），以识别希腊酸奶引入对酸奶购买者营养摄入的影响。研究发现，希腊酸奶的引入导致酸奶购买中总蛋白质和热量含量增加，而脂肪和碳水化合物含量降低。我们以希腊酸奶为例，说明一个相对简单的创新性大众消费品可能对该类别中摄入的营养成分性质产生深远影响。我们的研究结果强调了信息政策及其与消费者偏好相互作用在改变饮食结果方面的重要性。

10.1111/cjag.70017.abstract: With the widespread adoption of sugar‐sweetened beverage (SSB) taxes, top‐down facilitation measures—designed to influence consumer tax cognition—have limited impact, even though they are widely promoted as a means of enhancing tax effectiveness. This study introduces a bottom‐up facilitation approach that targets immediate and direct information available to consumers. We examine how these two types of facilitation measures jointly affect tax policy efficacy. Results indicate that top‐down measures, such as public health education campaigns, do not significantly reduce SSB purchases when implemented alone. However, when combined with bottom‐up measures—such as displaying the specific tax amount on product labels—the tax's effectiveness increases substantially. In addition, a difference‐in‐differences style analysis reveals that the combination of top‐down and bottom‐up facilitation measures significantly reduces consumer willingness to purchase SSBs and helps mitigate reactance observed under top‐down‐only conditions, particularly among consumers who are more likely to ignore or discount the top‐down educational information about the SSB tax. These findings provide actionable insights into how the design of public health taxation—such as SSB taxes—can be optimized to strengthen behavioral responses and enhance policy outcomes.
10.1111/cjag.70017.abstract_zh: 随着含糖饮料（SSB）税收政策的广泛实施，旨在影响消费者税收认知的“自上而下”促进措施——尽管被广泛宣传为提升税收有效性的手段——实际效果有限。本研究引入了一种针对消费者即时直接信息的“自下而上”促进方法，考察这两类促进措施如何共同影响税收政策效能。结果表明，单独实施公共卫生教育宣传等自上而下措施时，并未显著减少含糖饮料购买行为。然而，当与在产品标签上显示具体税额等自下而上措施结合使用时，税收有效性大幅提升。此外，基于双重差分法的分析显示，自上而下与自下而上促进措施的组合能显著降低消费者购买含糖饮料的意愿，并有助于缓解仅在自上而下条件下观察到的消费者逆反心理——尤其对更易忽视或低估含糖饮料税自上而下教育信息的消费者群体效果显著。这些发现为优化含糖饮料税等公共卫生税收政策设计、强化行为响应及提升政策成效提供了可操作的见解。
10.1111/cjag.70017.title: Facilitating sugar taxes with top‐down and bottom‐up information: A combined approach for improved tax efficacy
10.1111/cjag.70017.title_zh: 自上而下与自下而上信息促进糖税：提升税收效力的综合方法

10.1111/cjag.70018.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study expands the framework for analyzing the interplay of agricultural area and crop diversity on agroecosystem services by incorporating the species‐area relationship concept from biology. We estimate panel fixed effects models that include both agricultural area and crop diversity, along with their interaction term. This approach allows us to derive a crop diversity threshold‐the point at which agricultural land no longer exerts a negative marginal effect on water quality, driven by adjustments along the intensive margin rather than the extensive margin. By replicating well‐established water quality models from the literature and conducting robustness checks, we validate this framework. Our results empirically demonstrate that crop diversity can mitigate the adverse impact of agricultural land on water quality, aligning with the goals of conservation programs. This framework provides a more comprehensive understanding of agriculture's non‐unidirectional contributions to water quality, rather than only negative impacts, which are pervasive in the literature. Moreover, the thresholds identified in this study provide valuable insights for prioritizing regions for landscape‐based, crop diversity‐driven conservation strategies and policy design.</jats:p>
10.1111/cjag.70018.abstract_zh: 本研究通过引入生物学中的物种-面积关系概念，拓展了分析农业面积与作物多样性对农业生态系统服务交互作用的框架。我们估计了包含农业面积、作物多样性及其交互项的面板固定效应模型。这一方法使我们能够推导出作物多样性阈值——即农业用地通过集约边际调整而非粗放边际调整，不再对水质产生负面边际效应的临界点。通过复现文献中成熟的水质模型并进行稳健性检验，我们验证了这一框架的有效性。实证结果表明，作物多样性能够缓解农业用地对水质的负面影响，这与保护项目的目标一致。该框架有助于更全面地理解农业对水质的非单向贡献（而非文献中普遍强调的单一负面影响）。此外，本研究识别的阈值可为优先区域划定提供依据，助力基于景观格局、以作物多样性为导向的保护策略与政策设计。
10.1111/cjag.70018.title: Interplay of crop diversity and agricultural area in agroecosystem services: Analytical and empirical study on local water quality
10.1111/cjag.70018.title_zh: 作物多样性与农业面积在农业生态系统服务中的相互作用：基于地方水质的分析与实证研究

10.1111/cjag.70019.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Conventional price indexes partially address product heterogeneity. This paper considers the variety and quality of products in each market, the combination of region and year, and constructs panel price indexes using household scanner data on non‐alcoholic beverages in urban China. By comparing our panel price indexes to a conventional one, we find that ignoring product heterogeneity could largely underestimate the cross‐market price differences for non‐alcoholic beverages. We also find that product variety increases with urban population and income per capita, but that quality decreases with urban population, suggesting that wealthier provincial urban markets tend to have higher consumer welfare.</jats:p>
10.1111/cjag.70019.abstract_zh: 传统价格指数仅部分解决了产品异质性问题。本文考虑每个市场（地区与年份的组合）中产品的多样性和质量，利用中国城市非酒精饮料的家庭扫描数据构建了面板价格指数。通过将我们的面板价格指数与传统价格指数进行比较，我们发现忽略产品异质性可能会严重低估非酒精饮料的跨市场价格差异。研究还发现，产品多样性随城市人口和人均收入增加而上升，但产品质量随城市人口增加而下降，这表明更富裕的省级城市市场往往具有更高的消费者福利。
10.1111/cjag.70019.title: Product heterogeneity, price index bias, and their link to provincial urban size: Evidence from urban China's beverage market
10.1111/cjag.70019.title_zh: 产品异质性、价格指数偏差及其与省级城市规模的关联：来自中国城市饮料市场的证据

10.1111/cjag.70020.abstract: Abstract This study utilizes nationally representative panel data on rural Chinese households to investigate the interrelationship between smallholders’ participation in land rental markets and their agricultural commercialization while also evaluating the interactive effects of these market‐oriented farming practices on agricultural land and labor productivity. We adopted a bivariate Tobit model, fixed effects models, and instrumental variable methods to address the endogeneity problems. Results reveal a mutually reinforcing relationship between farm households’ land rental area and commercialization decisions. Furthermore, renting farmland is associated with improved agricultural labor productivity and reduced land productivity. Agricultural commercialization shows a positive correlation with the productivity of both land and labor for farm households. Finally, commercialization could positively moderate the association between land renting and agricultural productivity. Policymakers should design policies and strategies to promote the development of the land rental market and the commercialization of farmers, which could improve labor and land productivity.
10.1111/cjag.70020.abstract_zh: 本研究利用具有全国代表性的中国农村家庭面板数据，探讨小农户参与土地租赁市场与其农业商业化之间的相互关系，同时评估这些市场化农业实践对农业土地和劳动生产率的交互效应。我们采用双变量Tobit模型、固定效应模型和工具变量方法来解决内生性问题。结果显示，农户土地租赁面积与商业化决策之间存在相互促进的关系。此外，租赁耕地与农业劳动生产率提高和土地生产率下降相关。农业商业化与农户土地和劳动生产率均呈正相关。最后，商业化能够正向调节土地租赁与农业生产率之间的关系。政策制定者应设计促进土地租赁市场发展和农民商业化的政策与策略，从而提升劳动和土地生产率。
10.1111/cjag.70020.title: Agricultural commercialization and productivity: Evidence from land market participation in rural China
10.1111/cjag.70020.title_zh: 农业商业化与生产率：来自中国农村土地市场参与的实证证据

10.1111/cjag.70021.abstract: In Naylor, Deaton, and Ker (2025), we discuss an appropriate econometric method for estimating the pass‐through of the Nutrition North subsidy in the presence of heterogeneous effects and endogenous sampling. Applying this method to the data set compiled by Galloway and Li (2023), who conclude that there is “large leakage” of the subsidy, we fail to find evidence that supports their conclusion. After our paper was published, Galloway and Li published both a corrigendum to their 2023 article and a comment to our paper based on that corrigendum. In their comment, Galloway and Li (2026) claim that after “minor but easily justified” changes to their original data, our econometric approach leads to either imprecise or incomplete estimates of pass‐through. In our response we show that: (i) Galloway and Li (2026) choose a classification of market structure that differs from the one recommended by federal government officials and from the classification they themselves use in their most recent work, including Galloway and Li (2025b) and Li, Daley, and Watson (2025); (ii) the classification structure consistent with the recommendations of federal government officials and their aforementioned research supports full pass‐through; (iii) Galloway and Li's (2026) removal of 75% of the original sample is not minor; and (iv) Galloway and Li's (2026) repeated emphasis on sub‐sampling, robustness, and statistical power is incomplete and thus misleading. Importantly, our response emphasizes that the correct econometric approach does not turn on whether one can selectively find a data set in which the empirical estimate of pass‐through changes.
10.1111/cjag.70021.abstract_zh: 在Naylor、Deaton与Ker（2025）的研究中，我们探讨了在存在异质性效应与内生抽样条件下，估算“营养北方”补贴传导效应的适当计量方法。将该方法应用于Galloway与Li（2023）编制的数据集（该研究得出补贴存在“大量渗漏”的结论）后，我们未能发现支持其结论的证据。论文发表后，Galloway与Li针对其2023年文章发布了勘误，并基于该勘误对我们的论文发表了评论。在评论中，Galloway与Li（2026）声称，对其原始数据进行“微小但易于论证”的调整后，我们的计量方法对传导效应的估算要么不精确，要么不完整。我们的回应表明：（i）Galloway与Li（2026）选择的市场结构分类，既不同于联邦政府官员推荐的分类标准，也不同于其自身最新研究（包括Galloway与Li（2025b）及Li、Daley与Watson（2025））所使用的分类；（ii）与联邦政府官员建议及上述研究一致的分类结构支持完全传导效应；（iii）Galloway与Li（2026）剔除75%原始样本的做法并非“微小调整”；（iv）Galloway与Li（2026）反复强调子样本分析、稳健性与统计功效的做法不完整且具有误导性。重要的是，我们的回应强调：正确的计量方法并不取决于能否选择性找到传导效应实证估计值发生变化的数据集。
10.1111/cjag.70021.title: Reply to Comment on “On the pass‐through rate of the Nutrition North Canada subsidy”
10.1111/cjag.70021.title_zh: 回复《关于加拿大北部营养补贴传导率的评论》

10.1111/cjag.70022.abstract: Naylor, Deaton and Ker provide estimates of Nutrition North Canada subsidy pass‐through using data we collected and an identification strategy we devised. They propose an alternative econometric specification based on estimating passthrough for separate monopoly and non‐monopoly sub‐samples and aggregating the coefficients using subsidy share weights. They argue that this specification is more appropriate for estimating overall subsidy pass‐through and conclude that its application to our data provides evidence for full subsidy pass‐through. We show that their conclusions are not warranted by making two distinct but related points. First, we show that conclusions based on their specification are not robust to two changes in the estimating sample. Correcting two subsidy assignment and one monopoly classification error in the original data set, or using a time period more relevant for comparing heterogeneous effects across monopoly and non‐monopoly communities, leads to estimates that either reinforce our original finding of incomplete passthrough or that are too imprecise to be informative. Second, we provide a graphical illustration and power calculation to make a more general point about the appropriateness and limitations of the type of sub‐sample analysis they propose in settings with limited sample size and statistical power.
10.1111/cjag.70022.abstract_zh: Naylor、Deaton和Ker利用我们收集的数据及我们设计的识别策略，估算了“营养北方加拿大”补贴的传导效应。他们提出了一种替代性计量模型，基于对垄断与非垄断子样本分别估算传导效应，并通过补贴份额权重对系数进行加总。他们认为该模型更适合估算整体补贴传导效应，并据此得出结论：将该模型应用于我们的数据可证明补贴完全传导。我们通过两个独立但相关的论点表明，其结论缺乏依据。第一，我们证明其模型结论对估算样本的两项调整缺乏稳健性。修正原始数据集中的两项补贴分配错误和一项垄断分类错误，或采用更适用于比较垄断与非垄断社区异质性效应的时段，所得估算结果要么强化了我们最初关于不完全传导的发现，要么因精度过低而无法提供有效信息。第二，我们通过图形说明和统计功效计算，就其在样本量有限且统计功效不足的背景下所提出的子样本分析方法的适用性与局限性，提出更一般性的观点。
10.1111/cjag.70022.title: Comment on “On the pass‐through rate of the Nutrition North Canada subsidy”
10.1111/cjag.70022.title_zh: 对“加拿大北方营养补贴传导率”一文的评论

10.1111/cjag.70023.abstract: Controlled environment agriculture is important in regions where traditional farming is constrained by short growing seasons. Of particular relevance, vertical farming is an innovative agricultural technology that enables year‐round production in Canada. However, Canadian consumers’ preferences for vertically farmed products remain a knowledge gap. This study investigates how nudges and local food labelling change market outcomes for identical food produced using different production methods. In a pre‐registered field experiment, 610 Canadian consumers bid on vertically farmed, greenhouse grown, and field grown lettuce, each further differentiated by local and non‐local labels, using the Becker‐DeGroot‐Marschak (BDM) mechanism. Nudges highlighting the benefits of vertical farming were randomized between‐subject at the individual level. Results show that consumers are willing to pay a significant premium for local lettuce, regardless of the production method. Although consumers respond positively to nudges, local labelling is by far the largest contributor to willingness‐to‐pay premium. This study underscores the importance of advancing innovative food production technologies to enhance the availability of locally grown food year‐round.
10.1111/cjag.70023.abstract_zh: 受控环境农业在传统农业受限于短生长季的地区具有重要意义。其中，垂直农业作为一种创新农业技术，能够在加拿大实现全年生产。然而，加拿大消费者对垂直农产品的偏好仍存在认知空白。本研究探讨了助推措施和本地食品标签如何改变采用不同生产方式生产的相同食品的市场结果。在一项预先注册的实地实验中，610名加拿大消费者使用Becker-DeGroot-Marschak（BDM）机制，对垂直农场种植、温室种植和田间种植的生菜进行竞价，每种生菜进一步按本地和非本地标签进行区分。强调垂直农业益处的助推措施在个体层面进行了受试者间随机分配。结果表明，无论生产方式如何，消费者都愿意为本地生菜支付显著溢价。尽管消费者对助推措施反应积极，但本地标签是支付意愿溢价的最大贡献因素。本研究强调了推进创新食品生产技术以增强全年本地食品供应的重要性。
10.1111/cjag.70023.title: Is local all that matters?: An experiment on Canadian consumers’ preferences for produce
10.1111/cjag.70023.title_zh: 本地因素是否至关重要？——关于加拿大消费者对农产品偏好的实验研究

10.1111/cjag.70024.abstract: This paper uses a structural gravity model to examine the partial equilibrium effects of the European Monetary Union (EMU) on trade for the agricultural sector. We find robust evidence that EMU has increased trade both between members and between EMU and non‐EMU member countries. This positive link is found in most member countries. Moreover, the overall impact of EMU on trade between members has not been different for late and early joiners. The year‐by‐year and period‐by‐period analyses show that the effect of EMU is increasing over time. In addition, we conduct a counterfactual general equilibrium experiment that reveals a remarkable welfare‐enhancing effect of EMU for its member countries.
10.1111/cjag.70024.abstract_zh: 本文运用结构引力模型，考察了欧洲货币联盟（EMU）对农业部门贸易的部分均衡效应。我们发现有力证据表明，EMU不仅促进了成员国之间的贸易，也增进了EMU与非成员国之间的贸易。这一正向关联在大多数成员国中均有所体现。此外，EMU对成员国间贸易的总体影响在后期加入国与早期加入国之间并无显著差异。逐年及逐期分析显示，EMU的效应随时间递增。进一步地，我们实施了一项反事实一般均衡实验，结果表明EMU为其成员国带来了显著的福利增进效应。
10.1111/cjag.70024.title: EMU and trade: The euro effect on the agricultural sector
10.1111/cjag.70024.title_zh: 欧洲经济货币联盟与贸易：欧元对农业部门的影响

10.1111/cjag.70026.abstract: Behavioral interventions, for example, through the use of incentives and information, are widely used by policymakers to induce welfare‐improving behavior. When these interventions are used in specific contexts such as environmental conservation, individual knowledge, experience, and attitudes can lead to motivational crowding and may limit their efficacy. In this article, we investigate how incentives and information affect the behavior of recreational hunters in Alberta when tasked with curbing the spread of chronic wasting disease (CWD), a deadly wildlife disease. Embedded in a framed multiple‐threshold public goods game, we test hunters’ responses to various real‐world policy instruments designed to increase hunting trips. We find that hunters take more trips (increase their contribution to the public good) in response to monetary incentives framed as extra hunting tags but do not respond to direct monetary rewards. These findings advance our knowledge of how incentives can lead to motivational crowding and provide meaningful policy guidance for wildlife management and other environmental programs.
10.1111/cjag.70026.abstract_zh: 行为干预，例如通过激励和信息手段，被政策制定者广泛用于引导福利改善行为。当这些干预措施应用于环境保护等特定情境时，个体知识、经验和态度可能导致动机挤兑，从而限制其效果。本文探讨了在阿尔伯塔省，激励和信息如何影响休闲猎人在遏制慢性消耗性疾病（CWD）——一种致命野生动物疾病——传播过程中的行为。通过嵌入一个框架化的多阈值公共物品博弈实验，我们测试了猎人对旨在增加狩猎出行次数的各种现实政策工具的反应。研究发现，猎人在面对以额外狩猎标签形式呈现的货币激励时，会增加出行次数（即增加对公共物品的贡献），但对直接货币奖励并无响应。这些发现深化了我们对激励如何引发动机挤兑的理解，并为野生动物管理及其他环境项目提供了有意义的政策指导。
10.1111/cjag.70026.title: Incentives and motivational crowding to address chronic wasting disease: An experiment with Alberta hunters
10.1111/cjag.70026.title_zh: 激励与动机挤占应对慢性消耗性疾病：一项针对阿尔伯塔省猎人的实验

10.1111/ecca.70035.abstract: This paper examines the electoral impact of economic growth through increased foreign tourism using data from Croatia. To identify causal effects, the paper applies an instrumental variable strategy, which uses variation in the ruggedness of the local terrain to estimate the network of least-cost paths. The results suggest that an increase in foreign tourism reduces nationalist voting, and increases the centre-left vote share. In addition, I find that the increase in tourism rates led to population and employment growth, demographic shifts within municipalities, and positive spillovers on manufacturing, providing several potential mechanisms behind the voting results.
10.1111/ecca.70035.abstract_zh: 本文利用克罗地亚的数据，考察了通过增加外国旅游业带来的经济增长对选举的影响。为识别因果效应，本文采用工具变量策略，利用当地地形崎岖度的变化来估算最低成本路径网络。结果表明，外国旅游业的增长减少了民族主义投票，并增加了中左翼政党的得票份额。此外，我发现旅游率的提升导致了人口和就业增长、市政区域内的人口结构变化，以及对制造业的正向溢出效应，为投票结果提供了几个潜在的作用机制。

10.1111/ecca.70037.abstract: This paper is part of the Economica 100 Series. Economica, the LSE “house journal” is now 100 years old. To commemorate this achievement, we are publishing 100 papers by former students, as well as current and former faculty. Author Richard Dickens recieved his MSc in Economics in 1991 from the London School of Economics and author George Mackerron recieved his PhD from the London School of Economics in 2011.
10.1111/ecca.70037.abstract_zh: 本文属于《Economica》百年系列论文之一。《Economica》作为伦敦政治经济学院的“院刊”，现已创刊百年。为纪念这一里程碑，我们特此出版100篇由往届学生及现任、前任教职员工撰写的论文。作者理查德·狄更斯于1991年获得伦敦政治经济学院经济学硕士学位，作者乔治·麦克伦于2011年获得该校博士学位。

10.1111/ecca.70038.abstract: This paper presents a non-price-based conservation experiment performed among 6723 college dorm residents. We analyse the effectiveness of a behavioural intervention delivered through email, featuring one of two types of social-comparison-based energy consumption feedback: a quintile social comparison message and a mean comparison message. The quintile social comparison message ranks residents' relative energy consumption in quintiles, while the mean comparison message compares their consumption to the average. Our results show that the relative effectiveness of these messages depends on residents' baseline consumption patterns. Users in the higher quintiles (fourth and fifth) are more likely to reduce their energy consumption, while those in the lower quintiles (first and second) tend to increase their electricity usage after receiving the messages. We also observe that this adjustment towards the median consumption level appears to be more pronounced in single- and double-student rooms compared to multiple-student rooms. Using a causal forest approach to examine heterogeneity, we find that certain individual traits and physical factors may influence these room dynamics.
10.1111/ecca.70038.abstract_zh: 本文开展了一项基于非价格手段的节能实验，研究对象为6723名大学宿舍居民。我们分析了一种通过电子邮件实施的 behavioural 干预措施的有效性，该干预包含两种基于社会比较的能耗反馈之一：五分位社会比较信息与均值比较信息。五分位社会比较信息将居民的相对能耗按五分位排名，而均值比较信息则将其能耗与平均水平进行比较。我们的结果显示，这些信息的相对有效性取决于居民的基线能耗模式。处于较高五分位（第四和第五）的用户更倾向于减少能耗，而处于较低五分位（第一和第二）的用户在收到信息后往往增加用电量。我们还观察到，这种向中位能耗水平调整的趋势在单人及双人宿舍中比在多人宿舍中更为显著。通过使用因果森林方法考察异质性，我们发现某些个体特征和物理因素可能影响这些宿舍动态。

10.1111/ecca.70039.abstract: This paper is part of the Economica 100 Series. Economica, the LSE “house journal” is now 100 years old. To commemorate this achievement, we are publishing 100 papers by former students, as well as current and former faculty. Author Gordon Anderson recieved his PhD in 1980 from the London School of Economics.
10.1111/ecca.70039.abstract_zh: 本文属于《Economica》百年系列论文之一。《Economica》作为伦敦政治经济学院的“院刊”，现已创刊100周年。为纪念这一里程碑，我们特此出版100篇由往届学生及现任、前任教职员工撰写的论文。作者戈登·安德森于1980年获得伦敦政治经济学院博士学位。

10.1111/ecca.70040.abstract: This paper examines the long-term effects of ‘Apni Beti Apna Dhan’ (ABAD), a unique conditional cash transfer programme implemented in the north Indian state of Haryana from 1994 to 1998. The programme provided bonds to female beneficiaries at birth, redeemable on attaining 18 years of age, if they remained unmarried. In particular, we examine the programme effects on prevalence of early marriage and then on educational attainment. Exploiting the exogenous variation in the birth year of females born when the programme was implemented, we find a significant reduction in the likelihood of early marriage before age 18 among ABAD beneficiaries. Additionally, the prevalence of marriage by age 16, 17 or 18 is found to reduce, though the likelihood of being married by age 19 remains unchanged. We further observe robust improvements in their educational attainment. Despite reduction in early marriage and years of education, we do not find any discernible evidence of improvements in labour market participation, time allocation patterns, women empowerment indicators or intergenerational spillover. We provide suggestive evidence of parents utilizing the educational gains to ensure marital association with families of higher social status.
10.1111/ecca.70040.abstract_zh: 本文考察了“Apni Beti Apna Dhan”（ABAD）这一独特的有条件现金转移项目的长期效应，该项目于1994年至1998年在印度北部哈里亚纳邦实施。该项目为女性受益人在出生时提供债券，若她们在年满18岁时保持未婚，则可兑现。我们特别关注该项目对早婚普遍性及其后教育成就的影响。利用项目实施期间出生女性出生年份的外生变异，我们发现ABAD受益人在18岁前早婚的可能性显著降低。此外，16岁、17岁或18岁时的结婚率也有所下降，但19岁时的结婚可能性未发生变化。我们还观察到她们教育成就的显著提升。尽管早婚减少且受教育年限增加，我们未发现劳动市场参与、时间分配模式、女性赋权指标或代际溢出效应有任何明显改善的证据。我们提供了暗示性证据，表明父母利用教育收益来确保与更高社会地位家庭的婚姻联系。

10.1111/ecca.70041.abstract: In June 2020, Idaho announced the Return to Work Bonus (RWB) programme, which provided residents who returned to work with bonuses of up to $1500. We present difference-in-differences, triple differences, event studies and synthetic control estimates suggesting that the programme may have supported employment and workforce participation following its enactment. For example, from difference-in-differences estimates, we find that the employment–population ratio rose by 3.6 percentage points, the unemployment rate fell by 0.7 percentage points, and the non-participation rate fell by 2.9 percentage points in Idaho relative to other states following the introduction of the RWB programme. If these results from Idaho were to generalize to the economy as a whole, then they would not be enough to arrest a moderate recession, but they would meaningfully accelerate labour market recovery. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first paper to study the effects of re-employment bonuses on the US labour market outside an experimental setting.
10.1111/ecca.70041.abstract_zh: 2020年6月，爱达荷州宣布实施“重返工作奖励”（RWB）计划，为重返工作岗位的居民提供高达1500美元的奖金。我们采用了双重差分法、三重差分法、事件研究法及合成控制法进行估计，结果表明该计划在实施后可能促进了就业和劳动力参与。例如，根据双重差分估计，我们发现与其它州相比，爱达荷州在引入RWB计划后，就业人口比率上升了3.6个百分点，失业率下降了0.7个百分点，非参与率下降了2.9个百分点。若这些来自爱达荷州的结果能推广至整个经济体，虽不足以遏制温和衰退，但将显著加速劳动力市场的复苏。据我们所知，这是首篇在实验环境之外研究再就业奖金对美国劳动力市场影响的论文。

10.1111/ecca.70042.abstract: This paper documents significant cross-country variation in the strength of the service sector pulling women into the market work. We find the composition of the service sector to be the crucial driver of this heterogeneity. Specifically, a larger public administration sector is associated with lower elasticity, while a higher female share within business services has a positive association. The relationship between female share within business services and elasticity also depends on the size of the food and accommodation services, reflecting a marketization channel. Service sector composition alone explains 54% of the cross-country variation, rising to 60% when controlling for labour market policies. These findings show that the sub-sectoral structure of the service sector is the critical determinant of its ability to pull women into market work.
10.1111/ecca.70042.abstract_zh: 本文记录了服务业在吸引女性进入市场工作方面强度的显著跨国差异。我们发现，服务业的结构构成是这一异质性的关键驱动因素。具体而言，公共管理部门的规模越大，弹性越低，而商业服务中女性占比越高，则与更高的弹性正相关。商业服务中女性占比与弹性之间的关系还取决于食品和住宿服务业的规模，这反映了市场化渠道的作用。仅服务业构成一项就能解释跨国差异的54%，在控制劳动力市场政策后，这一比例升至60%。这些发现表明，服务业的分部门结构是决定其吸引女性进入市场工作能力的关键因素。

10.1111/ecca.70043.abstract: This study leverages an online behavioural experiment to analyse whether politicians' decisions align with citizens' preferences and with citizens' decisions within the same decision environment. We recruited 760 local politicians and 655 non-politicians in France to participate as policymakers in a taxation-redistribution game. In the game, two policymakers compete to choose a flat tax rate for a group of citizens selected from the French general population. We manipulate (i) the information provided to policymakers about citizens' preferred tax rates, and (ii) the incentives associated with applying citizens' preferred tax rate. We also measure policymakers' beliefs regarding citizens' preferences. We observe that policymakers react positively to information, but they often deviate from it, which can be mostly explained by their beliefs. Incentivizing responsiveness has no impact on these results. This suggests that politicians trade off their own preferences about the policy outcome with an intrinsic motivation to implement citizens' preferences. Finally, we find that politicians believe that citizens want lower tax rates and are more confident in their beliefs than non-politicians. Once beliefs are accounted for, we observe minor differences between the two samples. Our findings highlight the importance of politicians' beliefs and non-financial motivations as determinants of their decisions.
10.1111/ecca.70043.abstract_zh: 本研究利用在线行为实验，分析在同一决策环境下，政治家的决策是否与公民的偏好及公民自身的决策相一致。我们在法国招募了760名地方政治家和655名非政治家，参与一项税收-再分配博弈中的政策制定者角色。在该博弈中，两名政策制定者竞争，为从法国普通人群中选出的公民群体设定统一税率。我们操纵了（i）提供给政策制定者关于公民偏好税率的信息，以及（ii）与实施公民偏好税率相关的激励措施。同时，我们还测量了政策制定者对公民偏好的信念。我们观察到，政策制定者对信息反应积极，但常常偏离信息，这主要可归因于他们的信念。激励响应性对这些结果没有影响。这表明，政治家在自身对政策结果的偏好与实施公民偏好的内在动机之间进行权衡。最后，我们发现，政治家认为公民希望更低的税率，并且比非政治家对自己的信念更为自信。在考虑信念因素后，两个样本之间的差异较小。我们的研究结果强调了政治家的信念和非财务动机作为其决策决定因素的重要性。

10.1111/ecca.70044.abstract: This paper is part of the Economica 100 Series. Economica, the LSE “house journal” is now 100 years old. To commemorate this achievement, we are publishing 100 papers by former students, as well as current and former faculty. Chiara Criscuolo is an associate at the Centre for Economic Performance (CEP) at the London School of Economics.
10.1111/ecca.70044.abstract_zh: 本文属于《Economica》百年系列论文之一。《Economica》作为伦敦政治经济学院的“院刊”，现已创刊百年。为纪念这一里程碑，我们特此出版100篇由往届学生及现任、前任教职员工撰写的论文。Chiara Criscuolo是伦敦政治经济学院经济绩效中心（CEP）的副研究员。

10.1111/ecca.70045.abstract: Taking advantage of the random assignment of students in Uruguay to either a conventional introductory microeconomics course or one based on the Curriculum Open-access Resources in Economics (CORE) project, we provide causal evidence on the effects of CORE on students' academic performance, learning experience and study practices. We find no systematic differences in pass or dropout rates between the two courses. Similarly, we observe no significant differences in performance in the concurrent calculus course or in a subsequent advanced microeconomics course. Therefore we find no evidence of disadvantages in related subsequent courses resulting from the use of a CORE-based course. Consistent with the project's objectives, our results also show that students assigned to the non-conventional course are 18% more likely than those in the traditional course to believe that it contributed to their academic and professional development. Furthermore, assignment to CORE reduces the likelihood of students paying for private microeconomics tutoring outside school hours, and increases both class attendance and the likelihood of studying in groups.
10.1111/ecca.70045.abstract_zh: 利用乌拉圭学生被随机分配至传统微观经济学入门课程或基于经济学课程开放获取资源（CORE）项目的课程这一自然实验，我们提供了关于CORE对学生学业表现、学习体验及学习习惯影响的因果证据。我们发现，两种课程在通过率或辍学率上并无系统性差异。同样，在同步进行的微积分课程或后续高级微观经济学课程中，我们未观察到显著的表现差异。因此，我们没有发现使用基于CORE的课程对相关后续课程造成不利影响的证据。与项目目标一致，我们的结果还显示，被分配至非传统课程的学生比传统课程的学生更有可能认为该课程对其学术和职业发展有所贡献，这一可能性高出18%。此外，分配至CORE课程降低了学生课外付费接受私人微观经济学辅导的可能性，同时提高了课堂出勤率和小组学习的可能性。

10.1111/ecca.70046.abstract: We present evidence on the role of local labour markets in driving the persistent and gendered impact of rainfall shocks on learning outcomes in rural India. We find contrasting impacts of rainfall shocks by variation in soil texture, which serves as an exogenous driver of female and children's labour force participation. Strikingly, in non-loamy soil (high female and child labour force participation) areas, exposure to positive shocks in early life is associated with a higher likelihood of dropping out of school and being in a lower grade than is age-appropriate, while effects are considerably attenuated in loamy areas. Furthermore, we examine dynamic complementarities and find that female children in non-loamy areas bear the highest learning losses from a positive rainfall shock in their school-going years, especially when they have faced positive shocks in early life. We investigate potential mechanisms by studying children's labour market response under rainfall shocks, and show that the gains or losses in learning outcomes are systematic to local labour market conditions, which influence the opportunity cost of schooling under shocks.
10.1111/ecca.70046.abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于地方劳动力市场在印度农村地区降雨冲击对学习成果产生持久且具有性别差异影响中所起作用的证据。我们发现，降雨冲击的影响因土壤质地不同而呈现对比性结果，而土壤质地作为女性和儿童劳动力参与的外生驱动因素。引人注目的是，在非壤土（女性和儿童劳动力参与率高）地区，早年经历正向冲击与辍学可能性增加及年级低于适龄水平相关，而在壤土地区，这些影响则显著减弱。此外，我们考察了动态互补性，发现非壤土地区的女童在学龄期遭遇正向降雨冲击时承受最大的学习损失，尤其是当她们在早年也经历过正向冲击时。我们通过研究降雨冲击下儿童的劳动力市场反应来探究潜在机制，并表明学习成果的得失与地方劳动力市场条件系统相关，这些条件在冲击下影响上学的机会成本。

10.1111/ecca.70047.abstract: We study how incumbent exporters adjust to firm-specific export demand shocks, using matched firm-, product- and destination-level data for Finnish and Swedish manufacturing firms over 1999–2014. We construct an exogenous measure of firm-level demand shocks based on changes in destination–product imports, and analyse responses at both the intensive and extensive margins of trade. Despite similar levels of openness and export structure, exporters in the two countries exhibit distinct adjustment patterns. Swedish firms respond strongly to positive demand shocks by expanding exports while simultaneously narrowing their export portfolio, reallocating sales towards core markets and products. Finnish firms, in contrast, show limited export expansion and adjust less along the product margin, instead reallocating sales towards domestic markets during downturns. We find limited evidence that firms' financial strength explains these differences. The results highlight the central role of firm-level extensive-margin adjustments in shaping aggregate export dynamics, and provide a micro-level explanation for the diverging post global financial crisis export trajectories of Finland and Sweden.
10.1111/ecca.70047.abstract_zh: 我们利用1999年至2014年间芬兰和瑞典制造业企业的匹配企业、产品及目的地层面数据，研究在位出口商如何应对企业特定出口需求冲击。我们基于目的地-产品进口变化构建了一个外生的企业层面需求冲击度量，并从贸易的集约边际和扩展边际两方面分析其反应。尽管两国的开放程度和出口结构相似，但两国出口商展现出截然不同的调整模式。瑞典企业通过扩大出口对正向需求冲击作出强烈反应，同时收窄其出口组合，将销售重新配置至核心市场和产品。相比之下，芬兰企业在正向冲击下出口扩张有限，在产品边际上的调整较少，反而在衰退期间将销售转向国内市场。我们发现企业财务实力对这些差异的解释作用有限。研究结果凸显了企业层面扩展边际调整在塑造总体出口动态中的核心作用，并为芬兰和瑞典在全球金融危机后出口轨迹的分化提供了微观层面的解释。

10.1111/ecca.70048.abstract: We study how citizens' right to directly decide on policies through popular initiatives affects the attractiveness of extreme candidates in representative elections. In our theoretical framework, single prominent policy issues on which individual voters hold extreme views get a large weight in their assessment of candidates, thereby favouring ideologically extreme ones. If citizens can decide the controversial policy issues separately on the ballot, then this decouples the issues from legislative politics, and moderate candidates become relatively more attractive to voters. We apply our theory to US state legislative elections, and find that ideologically extreme candidates receive significantly lower voter support in initiative than in non-initiative states. This holds in particular for states with low qualification requirements for initiatives. In concurrent elections for the US House of Representatives, we do not observe this difference in the electoral success of extreme candidates between initiative and non-initiative states. The effect seems to be partly mediated by lower campaign donations to extreme candidates.
10.1111/ecca.70048.abstract_zh: 我们研究了公民通过民众倡议直接决定政策的权利如何影响代议制选举中极端候选人的吸引力。在我们的理论框架中，选民对个别突出政策议题持有极端观点，这些议题在评估候选人时占据较大权重，从而有利于意识形态极端的候选人。如果公民能在选票上分别决定争议性政策议题，这将使这些议题与立法政治脱钩，温和候选人对选民而言相对更具吸引力。我们将理论应用于美国州立法选举，发现意识形态极端的候选人在倡议州获得的选民支持显著低于非倡议州。这一现象在倡议资格要求较低的州尤为明显。在同时举行的美国众议院选举中，我们未观察到倡议州与非倡议州之间极端候选人选举成功的这种差异。该效应似乎部分由极端候选人获得的竞选捐款减少所中介。

10.1111/ecca.70049.abstract: Do terrorist attacks affect life satisfaction and mental health? To explore this question, we analyse data on all casualty-causing terrorist incidents in Great Britain from 1992 to 2020, and combine this information with individual-level data from the British Household Panel Survey and the UK Household Longitudinal Study over the same period. To get as close as possible to a causal interpretation, we exploit variation within individuals, net of potential attack-specific and aggregate temporal factors, and report an array of different specifications and robustness tests. Our analysis reveals that geographic proximity to terrorist attacks decreases life satisfaction, particularly when the incidents occurred within the month before the interview. We also find that individuals with pre-existing mental vulnerabilities exhibit higher distress levels following a recent terrorism shock.
10.1111/ecca.70049.abstract_zh: 恐怖袭击是否会影响生活满意度和心理健康？为探究此问题，我们分析了1992年至2020年间英国所有造成伤亡的恐怖事件数据，并将这些信息与同期英国家庭面板调查和英国纵向家庭研究的个体层面数据相结合。为尽可能接近因果解释，我们利用个体内部的变异，排除潜在的袭击特定因素和总体时间因素，并报告了一系列不同的设定和稳健性检验。我们的分析表明，地理上接近恐怖袭击会降低生活满意度，尤其是当事件发生在访谈前一个月内时。我们还发现，先前存在心理脆弱性的个体在近期恐怖主义冲击后表现出更高的痛苦水平。

10.1111/ecca.70050.abstract: [Correction added on 12 May 2026, after first online publication: The author's name “Jani Sastamoinen” has now been corrected to “Jani Saastamoinen” in this version]
10.1111/ecca.70050.abstract_zh: [更正说明：2026年5月12日首次在线发布后添加：作者姓名“Jani Sastamoinen”在本版本中已更正为“Jani Saastamoinen”]

10.1111/ecca.70051.abstract: Pay transparency measures are widely adopted policy instruments to decrease the gender pay gap. This paper studies a policy that grants access to wage information only upon request, analysing a German pay transparency law that grants workers the right to request information about the earnings of colleagues in comparable positions. Using large-scale administrative data and exploiting variation in exposure to the policy due to an exogenous cut-off in firm size, we investigate the causal impact of this pay transparency policy. Wages and the gender wage gap in treated firms were unaffected. The right to request wage information alone, that is, the endogenous access to wage information, is not an effective policy tool. These findings are robust, with no detectable effects in firms where pay transparency may be particularly powerful.
10.1111/ecca.70051.abstract_zh: 薪酬透明度措施是缩小性别薪酬差距的广泛采用的政策工具。本文研究了一项仅在提出请求时才授予工资信息获取权的政策，分析了德国一项薪酬透明度法律，该法律赋予工人请求了解可比职位同事收入信息的权利。利用大规模行政数据，并利用企业规模外生截断点导致的政策暴露差异，我们考察了这项薪酬透明度政策的因果影响。受处理企业的工资和性别薪酬差距未受影响。仅凭请求工资信息的权利，即对工资信息的内生获取，并非有效的政策工具。这些发现具有稳健性，在薪酬透明度可能尤为有效的企业中，也未检测到任何效应。

10.1111/ecca.70052.abstract: In this paper, I study how the wages of job-stayers respond within the year to changes in firm sales, using quarterly matched employer–employee data from Hungary. The analysis compares firm-specific and sectoral shocks with an instrumental variables strategy based on leave-one-out sectoral sales growth. Three main results emerge. Wages are almost fully insured against idiosyncratic firm shocks, with elasticities around 2%. In contrast, wages co-move strongly with aggregate shocks: the elasticity with respect to sectoral sales changes is about 0.07, and even higher in manufacturing, construction and machine-operator jobs. These results show that aggregate shocks pass through even on a short, quarterly time horizon, while firms provide insurance against firm-specific shocks. This implies that changing macroeconomic or monetary conditions can affect wages even at the quarterly level.
10.1111/ecca.70052.abstract_zh: 本文利用匈牙利季度匹配的雇主-雇员数据，研究了留任员工工资如何随企业销售变化在年内作出反应。分析通过基于留一法部门销售增长的工具变量策略，比较了企业特定冲击与部门冲击。主要发现有三点：工资几乎完全抵御了企业特定冲击，弹性约为2%；相反，工资与总体冲击紧密联动，对部门销售变化的弹性约为0.07，在制造业、建筑业及机器操作岗位中甚至更高。这些结果表明，总体冲击即使在短期的季度时间跨度内也能传导至工资，而企业则针对特定冲击提供保险。这意味着宏观经济或货币条件的变化即使在季度层面也能影响工资水平。

10.1111/ecca.70053.abstract: Regular exercise offers well‐documented health benefits, and mobile applications are increasingly used to promote physical activity. In this study, we conduct a large‐scale randomized controlled trial with 20,187 users of the WeWard app in France to evaluate the effectiveness of different message framings and intervention durations on app engagement and walking behaviour. Participants were randomly assigned to receive one of three types of messages, each leveraging distinct behavioural features such as peer comparison, self‐comparison or a generic reminder, over a period of one or three weeks. Our results show that peer‐comparison messages positively influence the extensive margin of app utilization. However, despite these increases in app usage, neither type of message led to a significant increase in the number of steps walked. These findings highlight the limitations of relying on engagement metrics alone when evaluating app‐based interventions aimed at behaviour change.
10.1111/ecca.70053.abstract_zh: 规律运动对健康有明确益处，而移动应用程序正越来越多地被用于促进体育活动。本研究在法国WeWard应用的20,187名用户中开展大规模随机对照试验，评估不同信息框架和干预时长对应用参与度及步行行为的影响。参与者被随机分配接收三种类型的信息（分别利用同伴比较、自我比较或通用提醒等不同行为特征），干预周期为一周或三周。结果显示，同伴比较信息对应用使用的广延边际产生正向影响。然而，尽管应用使用频率有所提升，但各类信息均未显著增加步行步数。这些发现揭示了在评估基于应用的行为改变干预措施时，仅依赖参与度指标的局限性。
10.1111/ecca.70053.title: Step into action: how reminders shape engagement in fitness apps
10.1111/ecca.70053.title_zh: 步入行动：提醒如何塑造健身应用中的用户参与度

10.1111/ecca.70054.abstract: We examine how changes in task content over time condition occupational wage development. Using survey data from Germany, we document substantial heterogeneity in within‐occupation changes in task content. Combining this evidence with administrative data on individual employment outcomes over a 25‐year period, we find important heterogeneity in wage penalties amongst jobs that were initially routine‐task‐intensive. While occupations that remain (relatively) routine‐intensive generate substantial wage penalties, occupations with a decreasing routine intensity experience stable or even increasing wages. These findings suggest that changing task profiles of occupations is an important adaptation mechanism to technological change. They cannot be explained by composition or cohort effects.
10.1111/ecca.70054.abstract_zh: 本文考察了任务内容随时间的变化如何影响职业工资发展。利用德国调查数据，我们记录了职业内部任务内容变化的显著异质性。结合25年间个体就业结果的行政数据，我们发现初始常规任务密集型岗位的工资惩罚存在重要异质性。那些保持（相对）常规密集型的职业会产生显著的工资惩罚，而常规强度下降的职业则经历工资稳定甚至增长。这些发现表明，职业任务特征的改变是应对技术变革的重要适应机制，且无法通过构成效应或队列效应加以解释。
10.1111/ecca.70054.title: How important are within‐occupation task changes for wage growth? Evidence from administrative micro data
10.1111/ecca.70054.title_zh: 职业内任务变化对工资增长的重要性：基于行政微观数据的证据

10.1111/ecca.70055.abstract: Researchers have sought to quantify the extent of inequality that is inherited from previous generations or factors that are predetermined at birth in multiple ways, including a large body of work on intergenerational mobility and inequality of opportunity. Many of the most frequently used approaches to measuring mobility or inequality of opportunity fit within a general framework that involves, as a first step, an estimation of the extent to which inherited personal characteristics can predict current incomes. We suggest a new approach, within that broad framework, that is sensitive to differences across the entire conditional distributions of relevant population subgroups, rather than just in their means. Sensitivity to differences in higher moments of the conditional distributions allows for a comprehensive assessment of inherited inequality. We apply this approach to household income distributions in China, India, South Africa and the USA, to illustrate how the method performs in different settings. We find that inherited inequality accounts for large shares of total inequality, from 36% in the USA to 59% in China, 62% in India, and 81% in South Africa.
10.1111/ecca.70055.abstract_zh: 研究者们通过多种方式试图量化代际传承或出生前既定因素所导致的不平等程度，其中包括大量关于代际流动与机会不平等的研究。许多最常用的流动性与机会不平等测量方法均适用于一个通用框架：该框架的第一步是评估先天个人特征对当前收入的预测能力。我们在此框架内提出一种新方法，该方法关注相关人口子群体整个条件分布（而非仅均值）的差异。对条件分布高阶矩差异的敏感性，使我们能够全面评估继承性不平等。我们将该方法应用于中国、印度、南非和美国家庭收入分布数据，以展示该方法在不同情境下的表现。研究发现，继承性不平等占总不平等的比重从美国的36%到中国的59%、印度的62%以及南非的81%不等。
10.1111/ecca.70055.title:
Inherited inequality and the distribution of opportunities in the
                    <scp>USA</scp>
                    , China, India and South Africa
10.1111/ecca.70055.title_zh: 继承性不平等与美国、中国、印度和南非的机会分布

10.1111/ecca.70057.abstract: Anton Chekhov's story ‘The ninny’ meets the question: ‘What is the meaning of economic theory?’
10.1111/ecca.70057.abstract_zh: 安东·契诃夫的小说《傻瓜》与这样一个问题相遇：“经济理论的意义是什么？
10.1111/ecca.70057.title: A ninny, an idiot and an economic theorist
10.1111/ecca.70057.title_zh: 一个傻瓜、一个白痴与一位经济理论家

10.1111/ecca.70058.abstract: How individuals make trade‐offs between socially proximate or distant groups impacts upon a wide range of social, political and economic behaviours. This paper exploits Norwegian administrative register data over the 2012–2022 period to assess whether, and if so how, such ‘(moral) universalism’ develops as individuals age and go through major life events. We show that ageing is associated with increases in universalism in early adulthood and declining universalism among older individuals, but the magnitude of these changes remains very small. Similarly, major life events—such as starting higher education, first‐time parenthood, positive income shocks and retirement—are linked to at best minor and short‐lived changes in universalism. These results add important insights regarding the (in)stability of individuals' value orientations during adulthood, and raise new questions about the potential influence of broader social forces on universalism across cohorts.
10.1111/ecca.70058.abstract_zh: 个体如何在社交亲近或疏远群体之间进行权衡，会影响广泛的社会、政治和经济行为。本文利用挪威2012-2022年期间的行政登记数据，评估这种“（道德）普遍主义”是否会随年龄增长及经历重大人生事件而发生变化，以及如何变化。我们发现，年龄增长与成年早期普遍主义的上升及老年个体普遍主义的下降相关，但这些变化的幅度非常微小。同样，重大人生事件——如开始接受高等教育、首次成为父母、正向收入冲击及退休——最多仅与普遍主义的微小且短暂变化相关。这些结果为了解成年期个体价值取向的（不）稳定性提供了重要见解，并引发了关于更广泛社会力量对不同世代普遍主义潜在影响的新问题。
10.1111/ecca.70058.title: Universalism: an 11‐year longitudinal study
10.1111/ecca.70058.title_zh: 普遍主义：一项11年纵向研究

10.1111/ecca.70059.abstract: It is well‐known that the wealthier are less likely to have Left‐leaning political preferences. In addition, we consider here the role of the individual's starting position, and in particular their upward social mobility relative to their parents. In 18 waves of UK panel data, both own and parental social status are independently negatively associated with Left‐leaning voting and political preferences; given their own social status, the upwardly mobile are therefore more Left‐wing. We replicate these findings using US data, and show that in both countries, the choice of specification when controlling for the respondent's own current status is crucial and may explain some of the mixed findings on mobility and political preferences in the existing literature.
10.1111/ecca.70059.abstract_zh: 众所周知，财富水平较高者持有左翼政治偏好的可能性较低。此外，本文进一步考察了个体初始社会地位的作用，特别是其相对于父母的向上社会流动性。基于英国18轮面板数据，个人自身社会地位与父母社会地位均与左翼投票倾向及政治偏好呈独立负相关关系；在控制自身社会地位后，向上流动者反而表现出更强的左翼倾向。我们利用美国数据复现了上述发现，并表明在两国样本中，控制受访者当前自身社会地位时的模型设定选择至关重要，这或可解释现有文献中关于社会流动性与政治偏好关系的部分矛盾结论。
10.1111/ecca.70059.title: Are the upwardly mobile more Left‐wing?

10.1111/ecca.70060.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of creativity on technological advancement, long‐term economic development, and social welfare, where creativity is determined endogenously through interactions within social networks. The analysis shows that an economy remains stagnant, exhibiting neither networking nor long‐term growth, when the size of the creative class falls below a positive threshold. Once this threshold is exceeded, active networking between creative and non‐creative individuals emerges, fostering sustained technological progress and income growth. The model is calibrated and used to simulate the transition from stagnation to sustained growth. The results indicate meaningful welfare gains from such a transition, driven by the cumulative effects of technological progress facilitated by networking.
10.1111/ecca.70060.abstract_zh: 本文研究了创造力对技术进步、长期经济发展及社会福利的影响，其中创造力通过社会网络内部的互动内生决定。分析表明，当创意阶层规模低于某个正阈值时，经济将陷入停滞，既无网络互动也无长期增长。一旦超过该阈值，创意与非创意个体之间将形成活跃的网络互动，从而推动持续的技术进步与收入增长。本文对模型进行了校准，并用于模拟从停滞到持续增长的转型过程。结果表明，这种转型能带来显著的福利提升，其驱动力源于网络互动所促进的技术进步的累积效应。
10.1111/ecca.70060.title: Creative‐class dynamics, technological evolution and growth
10.1111/ecca.70060.title_zh: 创意阶层动态、技术演进与经济增长

10.1111/ecca.70061.abstract: I argue that economists' distinction between ‘pure’ and ‘applied’ economic theory is often based on papers' stylistic markers rather than their methodology or scope. I illustrate this point with a model of price competition for boundedly rational consumers, due to Piccione and Spiegler. I first present its original, ‘pure style’ version. I then offer several ‘applied style’ modifications, and speculate how audiences would react to the various versions.
10.1111/ecca.70061.abstract_zh: 我认为，经济学家对“纯”经济理论与“应用”经济理论的区分，往往基于论文的风格标记而非其方法论或范围。我以Piccione和Spiegler提出的有限理性消费者价格竞争模型为例说明这一点。首先呈现其原始的“纯风格”版本，随后提出若干“应用风格”的修改，并推测受众对不同版本的反应。
10.1111/ecca.70061.title: Applied theory makeovers

10.1111/ecca.70062.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Pathogen‐stress and terror‐management theories predict that lethal epidemics heighten parochial cooperation. We test this prediction experimentally in two nationally representative US samples surveyed before and at the onset of the COVID‐19 pandemic. We compare trust and expected trustworthiness across the two waves in monetarily incentivized trust games involving non‐Hispanic Whites, African Americans and Hispanics. We find significant ingroup favouritism in both waves. However, the aggregate ingroup premium fell by about one‐half between waves. This decline was concentrated among left‐leaning and moderate respondents. While non‐Hispanic Whites tended to reduce their ingroup bias in expected trustworthiness, the opposite was found for African Americans. Respondents more exposed to COVID‐19 displayed higher intergroup trust, altruism and expected trustworthiness than others. These results contradict the hypothesis that lethal epidemics intensify parochialism, also suggesting that the response may be diversified across groups.</jats:p>
10.1111/ecca.70062.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>病原体应激与恐怖管理理论预测，致命性流行病会加剧群体内合作。我们通过两项具有全国代表性的美国样本（分别在COVID-19疫情爆发前后进行调查）对这一预测进行了实验检验。我们比较了涉及非西班牙裔白人、非洲裔美国人和西班牙裔的货币激励信任博弈中两轮调查的信任与预期可信度。研究发现两轮调查均存在显著的群体内偏袒现象。然而，群体内溢价的总量在两轮调查间下降了约一半，这一下降主要集中在左倾和温和派受访者中。非西班牙裔白人倾向于降低其在预期可信度方面的群体内偏见，而非洲裔美国人则呈现相反趋势。相较于其他受访者，更易接触COVID-19的受访者表现出更高的群体间信任、利他主义和预期可信度。这些结果与致命性流行病会加剧群体内偏见的假设相矛盾，同时表明不同群体的反应可能存在差异。</jats:p>
10.1111/ecca.70062.title: Did the outbreak of COVID‐19 and individual exposure to it increase ingroup bias in the USA? An experimental investigation of interethnic trust
10.1111/ecca.70062.title_zh: COVID-19疫情爆发及个体暴露程度是否加剧了美国的内群体偏见？一项关于族裔间信任的实验研究

10.1111/ecca.70063.abstract: Abstract Meritocratic systems are commonly understood as those that assign tasks to individuals who can best perform them. But future performance is not known prior to assignment, and must be inferred from other traits. We consider a model in which performance depends on two attributes—ability and training—where ability is endowed and unobserved, and training is acquired and observed. The potential to acquire training depends on ability and resource access, so ability affects performance through two channels: indirectly through training, and directly through the performance function. The population consists of two groups, each with the same ability distribution, but with differential access to resources. We show that performance‐maximizing allocations are not necessarily group‐blind or monotonic in training, and can involve greater representation of groups with lower resource access than would arise if the only criteria for selection were past performance. If policies are constrained to be monotonic due to the possibility of strategic applicant behaviour, then these representation effects can be mitigated or amplified, depending on the fraction of the population that is selected.
10.1111/ecca.70063.abstract_zh: 摘要 精英体制通常被理解为将任务分配给最能胜任者的制度。但未来表现无法在分配前预知，必须通过其他特征推断。我们构建了一个模型，其中表现取决于两种属性——能力与训练——能力是先天赋予且不可观测的，训练是后天获得且可观测的。获得训练的潜力取决于能力与资源获取渠道，因此能力通过两条渠道影响表现：间接通过训练，直接通过表现函数。人口由两个群体组成，每个群体具有相同的能力分布，但资源获取渠道存在差异。研究表明，表现最大化分配未必是群体盲视的或关于训练单调的，且可能使资源获取较少的群体获得比仅以过往表现为唯一选拔标准时更高的代表性。若因策略性申请者行为的存在而需对政策施加单调性约束，则这些代表性效应可能被削弱或放大，具体取决于被选拔人口的比例。
10.1111/ecca.70063.title: Meritocracy in the face of group inequality
10.1111/ecca.70063.title_zh: 群体不平等面前的精英统治

10.1111/ecca.70064.abstract: Abstract We estimate the trade and income effects of regulatory developments concerning standard‐like non‐tariff measures (NTMs) over 2012–2017 combining structural gravity estimates and general equilibrium projections. The trade cost effects of regulatory changes vary at the country‐pair level and across sectors. Overall, NTM‐related regulatory changes over 2012–2017 increased trade costs in goods, which reduced global trade by 1.2%. The majority of this reduction corresponds to a decline in goods trade equivalent to about 40% of the actual worldwide decrease of nominal goods trade over this period. Yet the implied reduction of real income is small. We highlight significant variation of these effects at the country and sector level, and show that excluding pair‐specific trade frictions and third‐country effects introduces omitted variable bias. Our findings imply that advances in international coordination of technical regulation can further reduce trade frictions and enhance trade and real income.
10.1111/ecca.70064.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文结合结构引力估计与一般均衡预测，评估了2012–2017年间标准类非关税措施监管变化对贸易和收入的影响。监管变化的贸易成本效应在国家-行业层面存在异质性。总体而言，2012–2017年间与非关税措施相关的监管变化提高了商品贸易成本，导致全球贸易下降1.2%。这一降幅中，大部分对应商品贸易的减少量，约占同期全球名义商品贸易实际下降幅度的40%。然而，由此导致的实际收入下降幅度较小。我们强调这些效应在国家与行业层面存在显著差异，并表明忽略国家-行业特定贸易摩擦及第三国效应会引入遗漏变量偏误。研究结果表明，技术监管国际协调的进展可进一步减少贸易摩擦，促进贸易与实际收入增长。
10.1111/ecca.70064.title: General equilibrium effects of technical non‐tariff measures: evidence from bilateral trade cost estimates
10.1111/ecca.70064.title_zh: 技术性非关税措施的一般均衡效应：基于双边贸易成本估计的证据

10.1111/ecca.70065.abstract: Abstract This paper examines the implications of the EU–UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement (TCA) using a dynamic spatial general equilibrium model. Unlike previous studies that primarily projected potential impacts of Brexit based on uncertain scenarios, this analysis introduces new estimates of tariffs and non‐tariff measures specified by the TCA. The findings show that while the TCA will necessitate substantial adjustments for some sectors, Brexit will not fundamentally alter the overall structure of the UK economy. However, the main impacts will manifest as significant hits to real wages and productivity, exacerbating the long‐standing economic challenges faced by the UK.
10.1111/ecca.70065.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文运用动态空间一般均衡模型，评估了欧盟-英国贸易与合作协定（TCA）的经济影响。与以往主要基于不确定情景预测英国脱欧潜在影响的研究不同，本文引入了TCA所规定的关税与非关税措施的最新估算。研究结果表明，尽管TCA将迫使部分行业进行重大调整，但英国脱欧并不会从根本上改变英国经济的整体结构。然而，其主要影响将体现为实际工资与生产率的显著下降，从而加剧英国长期面临的经济挑战。
10.1111/ecca.70065.title: Counting the costs: a quantitative assessment of the effects of Brexit on UK regions and sectors
10.1111/ecca.70065.title_zh: 量化成本：英国脱欧对英国各地区和行业影响的定量评估

10.1111/ecca.70066.abstract: <jats:p>We examine the unintended effects of gender‐based hiring quotas on task allocation and organizational performance using a controlled laboratory experiment designed to mirror team formation and delegation decisions. Participants in the role of employers selected workers and assigned them to either simple or challenging tasks, where performance determined firm earnings. In the absence of quotas, high‐ability women were less likely than their male counterparts to be hired or assigned to high‐responsibility tasks. Imposing a 50% gender quota increased overall female representation and their access to complex tasks, but did not improve outcomes for high‐performing women, who remain relatively less likely to be assigned to high‐responsibility tasks compared to comparable men. Moreover, firm performance declined under the quota due to weaker alignment between worker ability and task assignment. These findings suggest that while quotas enhance representational equity, they may unintentionally reduce efficiency when organizational processes fail to support merit‐based allocation—offering important implications for the design of equity‐enhancing labour market policies.</jats:p>
10.1111/ecca.70066.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项受控实验室实验，研究了基于性别的招聘配额对任务分配和组织绩效的非预期影响。该实验旨在模拟团队组建和授权决策。扮演雇主的参与者选择工人，并将其分配到简单或具有挑战性的任务中，任务表现决定企业收益。在没有配额的情况下，高能力女性被雇佣或分配到高责任任务的可能性低于同等能力的男性。实施50%的性别配额提高了女性的整体代表性及其接触复杂任务的机会，但并未改善高绩效女性的结果——与同等能力的男性相比，她们被分配到高责任任务的可能性仍然相对较低。此外，由于工人能力与任务分配之间的匹配度减弱，配额下的企业绩效出现下降。这些发现表明，虽然配额增强了代表性公平，但当组织流程未能支持基于能力的分配时，它们可能无意中降低效率——这对设计促进公平的劳动力市场政策具有重要启示。
10.1111/ecca.70066.title: Unintended effects of gender quotas on task assignment and firm performance
10.1111/ecca.70066.title_zh: 性别配额对任务分配和企业绩效的非预期影响

10.1111/ecca.70067.abstract: We study the role of job‐to‐job transitions in shaping wage dynamics in the UK. We show that job moves have continued to generate substantial wage gains for movers even during a period of real wage stagnation and declining labour market mobility. Using an econometric model that accounts for worker, firm and match heterogeneity, we decompose the job mobility premium, and find a limited role for worker and firm effects, with most of the return explained by match‐specific factors. We also examine the determinants of job mobility, and show that much of its recent decline reflects compositional changes in the workforce, particularly ageing and increasing occupational professionalization. We conclude by discussing the policy challenges of promoting job mobility as a driver of wage growth and more efficient labour market reallocation.
10.1111/ecca.70067.abstract_zh: 我们研究了英国工作转换在塑造工资动态中的作用。我们表明，即使在实际工资停滞和劳动力市场流动性下降的时期，工作变动仍持续为流动者带来可观的工资收益。通过一个考虑工人、企业和匹配异质性的计量经济学模型，我们分解了工作流动溢价，发现工人和企业效应作用有限，大部分回报归因于匹配特定因素。我们还考察了工作流动的决定因素，并显示其近期下降很大程度上反映了劳动力构成的变化，特别是老龄化及职业专业化程度的提高。最后，我们讨论了促进工作流动作为工资增长和更有效劳动力市场再配置驱动力的政策挑战。
10.1111/ecca.70067.title:
Changing jobs: worker mobility and wages in the
                    <scp>UK</scp>
                    labour market
10.1111/ecca.70067.title_zh: 换工作：英国劳动力市场中的工人流动性与工资

10.1111/ecca.70068.abstract: We study productivity disparities across metropolitan and non‐metropolitan areas in Great Britain. Spatial disparities in productivity are large and persistent. Using a development accounting framework, we show that differences in area size and in the spatial distribution of human and business capital are key explanatory factors. A combination of area size and human capital explains 30% of the productivity variance, increasing to 43–57% once we add measures of business capital stocks. Applying our framework to a case study of Greater Manchester, we show that large increases in both types of capital are needed to narrow productivity disparities with London, illustrating the scale of the challenge for policies aimed at reducing spatial inequality.
10.1111/ecca.70068.abstract_zh: 我们研究了英国大都市与非大都市地区之间的生产率差异。空间上的生产率差异既大且持久。运用发展核算框架，我们表明区域规模以及人力资本和商业资本的空间分布差异是关键解释因素。区域规模与人力资本的结合解释了生产率变异的30%，而一旦加入商业资本存量指标，这一比例提升至43%至57%。将我们的框架应用于大曼彻斯特的案例研究，我们发现，要缩小与伦敦的生产率差距，需要大幅增加这两类资本，这凸显了旨在减少空间不平等的政策所面临的挑战规模。
10.1111/ecca.70068.title: Spatial productivity disparities in Great Britain
10.1111/ecca.70068.title_zh: 英国空间生产率差异研究

10.1111/ecca.70069.abstract: How do perceptions, mindsets, and beliefs influence policy views? In this lecture, I present a simple conceptual framework that highlights the roles of different factors (such as self interest and broader social concerns, fairness views, or mindsets) in shaping policy views. I then present evidence from large‐scale social economics surveys and experiments, for four policy areas—taxation, inflation management, trade, and climate action. The experimental show that information that addresses people's concerns about fairnes.
10.1111/ecca.70069.abstract_zh: 感知、心态与信念如何影响政策观点？在本次讲座中，我提出了一个简洁的概念框架，用以阐明不同因素（如自身利益、更广泛的社会关切、公平观念或心态）在塑造政策观点中的作用。随后，我展示了来自大规模社会经济学调查和实验的证据，覆盖四个政策领域——税收、通胀管理、贸易及气候行动。实验表明，针对人们公平关切的信息能够产生显著影响。
10.1111/ecca.70069.title: Coase Lecture—Perceptions, mindsets and beliefs shaping policy views
10.1111/ecca.70069.title_zh: 科斯讲座——塑造政策观点的认知、心态与信念

10.1111/ecca.70071.title: From Coase to culture? Visible Hands Build Equilibria
10.1111/ecca.70071.title_zh: 从科斯到文化？看得见的手构建均衡

10.1111/ecin.70028.abstract: Recent work suggests that cross-country convergence has strengthened over time. Here we explore mobility and convergence in relative income and relative total factor productivity (TFP) using finite state Markov chains. We find that low-income countries rarely improve their position relative to the US. Since capital-output ratios have approached or exceeded the US level and human capital is converging, the persistence of low relative income seems to originate in low relative TFP. We study the dynamics of relative TFP, how they have changed, and how they interact with absolute levels of human capital, casting new light on the future of convergence.
10.1111/ecin.70028.abstract_zh: 近期研究指出，跨国间的经济趋同现象随时间推移有所增强。本文利用有限状态马尔可夫链，探讨了相对收入与相对全要素生产率（TFP）中的流动性与趋同趋势。研究发现，低收入国家相对于美国的位置鲜有改善。鉴于资本产出比已接近或超越美国水平，且人力资本正趋于一致，低收入国家相对收入持续低迷的根源似乎在于相对TFP的低下。我们进一步分析了相对TFP的动态变化、其演变方式及其与人力资本绝对水平的相互作用，为未来趋同前景提供了新的视角。

10.1111/ecin.70029.abstract: Can consumer confidence account for the leading indicator property of household investment (HI) over the US business cycle? We find that it does. Consumer confidence leads HI and housing starts by two and one-quarter, respectively. Household investment increases persistently after a positive confidence shock, and so do total hours worked, output, and real house prices. Quantitatively, confidence shocks account for a substantial share of the forecast error variation in these variables. They are also unrelated to future supply-side fundamentals. Demand-side forces, originating from consumers' social and psychological factors, are therefore relevant to HI dynamics.
10.1111/ecin.70029.abstract_zh: 消费者信心能否解释美国家庭投资（HI）在经济周期中的领先指标特性？我们发现确实如此。消费者信心领先家庭投资两个季度，领先房屋开工率一个季度。正向信心冲击后，家庭投资持续增长，总工作时间、产出和实际房价也随之上升。定量分析显示，信心冲击在这些变量的预测误差变动中占据了显著份额。此外，这些冲击与未来供给侧基本面无关。因此，源于消费者社会和心理因素的需求侧力量，对家庭投资动态具有相关性。

10.1111/ecin.70030.abstract: Previous literature suggests that the pass-through of oil price shocks to inflation rates became weaker since the 1970s. I use a time-varying parameter VAR to show that this trend has recently been reversed with headline and core inflation rates responding more sensitive to oil price shocks. Based on a counterfactual analysis, I offer evidence that increasingly important second round effects propagated via inflation expectations play a key role for these dynamics. Finally, I illustrate that oil price shocks in general and this expectation channel more specifically contributed substantially to the recent surge in inflation rates.
10.1111/ecin.70030.abstract_zh: 既有文献表明，自1970年代以来，石油价格冲击向通胀率的传导效应已有所减弱。我采用时变参数向量自回归模型（TVP-VAR）证明，这一趋势近期已发生逆转，总体通胀率与核心通胀率对石油价格冲击的反应变得更加敏感。基于反事实分析，我提供的证据表明，通过通胀预期传播的日益重要的第二轮效应在这些动态变化中扮演了关键角色。最后，我阐明石油价格冲击总体上，尤其是这一预期渠道，对近期通胀率的飙升贡献显著。

10.1111/ecin.70032.abstract: We build an endogenous growth model that distinguishes productive and welfare government expenditures and embeds fiscal externalities. The model yields three testable hypotheses: (i) productive expenditure raises growth (Barro effect); (ii) productive expenditure generates cross-country productivity spillovers; (iii) government expenditure structure exhibits spatial dependence. Estimation with a spatial-panel dataset for 30 European economies (EU27 + 3) corroborates all three hypotheses. We further show that positive productivity externalities induce an international free-rider problem, causing systematic under-investment in productive expenditure, while negative welfare externalities trigger a “welfare tournament” and over-spending on non-productive expenditure.
10.1111/ecin.70032.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个内生增长模型，该模型区分了生产性政府支出与福利性政府支出，并嵌入了财政外部性。模型提出了三个可检验的假设：（i）生产性支出促进增长（巴罗效应）；（ii）生产性支出产生跨国生产率溢出效应；（iii）政府支出结构表现出空间依赖性。利用包含30个欧洲经济体（EU27+3）的空间面板数据集进行估计，结果支持了所有三个假设。我们进一步表明，正向的生产率外部性引发国际搭便车问题，导致生产性支出系统性投资不足，而负向的福利外部性则触发“福利竞赛”，导致非生产性支出过度。

10.1111/ecin.70033.abstract: In a basic New Keynesian DSGE model with involuntary unemployment, we study the role of labor markets in the transmission of persistent monetary policy shocks that increase households' inflation expectations. The model predicts that, in contrast to the standard nominal interest rate shocks, labor market conditions can affect the outcomes of persistent monetary policy shocks suggesting a trade-off between inflation and output growth: restricted labor market access leads to higher inflation response with smaller effects on output. Using a vector autoregression analysis, we further provide empirical evidence consistent with the predictions of our theoretical model.
10.1111/ecin.70033.abstract_zh: 在一个包含非自愿失业的基础新凯恩斯主义DSGE模型中，我们研究了劳动力市场在传导持续性货币政策冲击（该冲击提高家庭通胀预期）中的作用。模型预测，与标准的名义利率冲击相反，劳动力市场状况能够影响持续性货币政策冲击的结果，这表明通胀与产出增长之间存在权衡：劳动力市场准入受限导致通胀反应增强，而对产出的影响则较小。通过向量自回归分析，我们进一步提供了与理论模型预测相一致的实证证据。

10.1111/ecin.70035.abstract: In this paper, we report on two experimental studies that examine the impact of social distance on delegation and uncover the role of anonymity driving delegation in a principal-agent setting. Study 1 shows that reducing the social distance makes principals less likely to delegate. Study 2 offers evidence that the likelihood of delegation is not affected by whether the principal is informed that the recipients will not find out whether the principal is their friend or a stranger. Our findings have implications for the underlying sources of pro-sociality in organizational settings where managers make their decisions through hiring external agents.
10.1111/ecin.70035.abstract_zh: 本文报告了两项实验研究，探讨社会距离对委托的影响，并揭示了匿名性在委托-代理情境中驱动委托行为的作用。研究一表明，缩短社会距离会降低委托人进行委托的可能性。研究二提供证据显示，委托人是否被告知接收者不会知晓其身份（朋友或陌生人）并不影响委托的可能性。我们的发现对组织环境中管理者通过雇佣外部代理人做出决策时亲社会行为的潜在来源具有启示意义。

10.1111/ecin.70036.abstract: We examine the regional impacts of the Sino–Japan dispute over the Diaoyu/Senkaku Islands that sparked a Chinese consumer boycott of travel to Japan from August 2012. This boycott caused significant and varied regional impacts across Japan. Prefectures that had higher pre-boycott dependency on Chinese visitors, particularly tourists, experienced the largest negative effects. While the boycott's intensity was strongest in the first 6 months, substantial negative impacts were still observable when averaging across 24 months post-boycott. Our results demonstrate the importance of diversification across traveler types and countries of origin in providing travel services to mitigate risks from political conflicts.
10.1111/ecin.70036.abstract_zh: 我们考察了中日关于钓鱼岛/尖阁诸岛争端引发的区域影响，该争端自2012年8月起导致中国消费者抵制赴日旅游。这一抵制对日本各地产生了显著且多样的区域影响。在抵制前对中国游客，尤其是旅游观光客依赖度较高的县，遭受了最大的负面冲击。尽管抵制的强度在最初6个月内最为强烈，但在抵制后24个月的平均水平上，仍可观察到显著的负面效应。我们的研究结果表明，在提供旅游服务时，跨游客类型和来源国的多元化对于缓解政治冲突带来的风险至关重要。

10.1111/ecin.70037.abstract: We show that culturally transmitted individualism is an important determinant of working from home (WFH). Using individual-level data from the U.S. Current Population Survey (CPS) and the European Social Survey (ESS), we compare immigrants and their descendants from different cultural backgrounds residing in the same location. A 10-point increase in country-of-origin individualism (0–100 scale) increases the likelihood of WFH by 3.9 percentage points and WFH hours by 1.12 per week in the CPS, and frequent WFH by 2 percentage points in the ESS. Individualism appears to affect WFH partly through higher educational attainment and occupational selection.
10.1111/ecin.70037.abstract_zh: 我们证明，文化传承的个人主义是居家办公（WFH）的一个重要决定因素。利用美国当前人口调查（CPS）和欧洲社会调查（ESS）的个体层面数据，我们比较了居住在同一地区的不同文化背景的移民及其后代。在原籍国个人主义指数（0-100分制）上每增加10分，CPS中居家办公的可能性提高3.9个百分点，每周居家办公小时数增加1.12小时；在ESS中，频繁居家办公的比例提高2个百分点。个人主义似乎部分通过更高的教育成就和职业选择影响居家办公。

10.1111/ecin.70038.abstract: Using panel data on union locals in the United States we examine the dynamics of the union sector, investigating the impact of inter-union competition on locals' productivity and survival. We find low entry rates, high exit rates and high levels of productivity dispersion in the sector.
