The Kerala economy was based on rice, and it remained so. The article therefore contributes to the growing historiography which stresses internal regional economies rather than external trading as the best guide for understanding pre‐modern development, as opposed to world‐systems theories, but it also aims to show in detail why it was that the pepper trade had relatively little impact on its producer region. Kerala was the only source of pepper for the whole Eurasian world until the late Middle Ages. This article argues that, despite the importance of pepper to the trading systems of the medieval period, the impact of that trade on Kerala was of relatively small importance, and discusses why.
10.1111/ehr.70125.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了开罗藏经库文献、中国陶瓷分布、旅行者报告（这是最知名但重要性最低的数据集），以及16至17世纪早期葡萄牙人关于如何最佳利用胡椒的讨论。随后将这些证据与喀拉拉邦本地的史料进行对照。研究发现，尽管胡椒在中世纪贸易体系中具有重要地位，但该贸易对喀拉拉邦的影响相对较小。喀拉拉邦的经济以稻米为基础，且始终如此。因此，本文为强调以区域内部经济而非外部贸易作为理解前现代发展最佳路径的史学新范式提供了佐证——这与世界体系理论形成对比；同时旨在详细阐释为何胡椒贸易对其产地影响甚微。喀拉拉邦直至中世纪末期仍是整个欧亚大陆唯一的胡椒产地。本文论证指出，尽管胡椒在中世纪贸易体系中举足轻重，但该贸易对喀拉拉邦的影响相对有限，并探讨了其成因。
10.1111/ehr.70125.title: The profits of pepper. Indian Ocean trade and the economy of Kerala, 800–1600
10.1111/ehr.70125.title_zh: 胡椒的利润：印度洋贸易与喀拉拉邦经济（800–1600年）

10.1111/ehr.70126.abstract: To persuade creditors to lend, cities in the Low Countries relied on a community responsibility system that made all citizens personally liable for public debt. This exposed itinerant citizens to significant risks: their merchandise could be confiscated by creditors, and they could even be imprisoned for debt. Although it is usually difficult to assess how such sanctions were enforced in practice, this study examines a unique account of a group of creditors actively pursuing repayment. Their principal debt collector was a monk of the Carthusian order who travelled tirelessly throughout the Lower Rhine region in search of inhabitants of the county of Holland. This monk‐turned‐bounty‐hunter primarily targeted merchants and their goods but also sought to seize financial instruments and real estate owned by Hollanders. Whilst existing literature emphasizes reputation‐based mechanisms to explain polities’ access to credit, this evidence suggests that sanction‐based mechanisms were equally important: reprisals proved effective in recovering debts. Considering that the community responsibility system exposed merchants to sanctions, its survival into the early modern period is quite striking. I argue that the creation of public debt secured political and economic privileges that cities valued more highly than the safety of their merchants.
10.1111/ehr.70126.abstract_zh: 为说服债权人放贷，低地国家的城市依赖一种社区责任制度，该制度使所有公民对公共债务承担个人责任。这使流动公民面临重大风险：他们的商品可能被债权人没收，甚至可能因债务而入狱。尽管通常难以评估此类制裁在实践中如何执行，但本研究考察了一组债权人积极追讨债务的独特案例。他们的主要收债人是一位加尔都西会修士，他不知疲倦地在下莱茵地区奔波，寻找荷兰郡的居民。这位转行做赏金猎人的修士主要针对商人及其货物，但也试图没收荷兰人持有的金融工具和不动产。现有文献强调基于声誉的机制来解释政体获得信贷的途径，但这一证据表明，基于制裁的机制同样重要：报复手段在追回债务方面被证明是有效的。考虑到社区责任制度使商人面临制裁，其存续至近代早期相当引人注目。我认为，公共债务的创造保障了城市高度重视的政治和经济特权，其重要性甚至超过商人的安全。
10.1111/ehr.70126.title: Hunting for Hollanders: The community responsibility system, trade sanctions, and public debt in the late‐medieval Low Countries
10.1111/ehr.70126.title_zh: 追寻荷兰人：中世纪晚期低地国家的社区责任体系、贸易制裁与公共债务

10.1111/ehr.70127.abstract: When studying French prices between 1938 and 1949, economists and historians face a paradox: whilst a vast black market shaped daily life, official indices recorded only state‐controlled prices. This article addresses the issue by introducing a new consumer price index that incorporates both official and black market prices. Drawing on extensive new data, it quantifies black market activity and estimates household reliance on it. As a result, the price dynamics have been considerably under‐evaluated between 1940 and 1944, and equally considerably over‐evaluated between 1944 and 1948. The index reshapes our understanding of price dynamics by challenging the common narrative that the Vichy regime successfully tamed wartime inflation whilst the postwar democratic regime failed to control it. Instead, the apparent postwar acceleration of inflation is revealed as a statistical illusion. Consequently, we show that real wages dropped dramatically during the German Occupation of France, which proves much more consistent with contemporary testimonies.
10.1111/ehr.70127.abstract_zh: 在研究1938年至1949年法国价格问题时，经济学家和历史学家面临一个悖论：尽管庞大的黑市塑造了日常生活，官方指数却仅记录国家管控价格。本文通过引入同时包含官方价格与黑市价格的新型消费者价格指数来解决这一问题。基于大量新数据，本文量化了黑市活动规模，并估算了家庭对其的依赖程度。研究结果表明，1940年至1944年间的价格动态被严重低估，而1944年至1948年间的价格动态则被严重高估。该指数通过挑战"维希政权成功抑制战时通胀，而战后民主政权却未能控制通胀"的普遍叙事，重塑了我们对价格动态的理解。事实上，战后通胀的明显加速被揭示为一种统计幻觉。据此，我们证明在德国占领法国期间，实际工资急剧下降，这与同时代证词高度吻合。
10.1111/ehr.70127.title: The many prices of war and occupation: Black markets and the cost‐of‐living index in France, 1938–1949
10.1111/ehr.70127.title_zh: 战争与占领的多重代价：法国黑市与生活成本指数（1938–1949）

10.1111/ehr.70128.abstract: This article provides the first systematic estimates of living standards in Al‐Andalus (the Muslim‐ruled Iberian Peninsula) in 950, 1000, and 1200. Drawing on prices and wages from legal documents and market regulation treatises, it reconstructs real wages and welfare ratios. The results indicate that living standards in Al‐Andalus during the tenth century were high in both absolute and comparative terms. Unskilled workers in Córdoba around 950 and 1000 attained welfare ratios comparable to those observed in Fatimid Egypt and the poorer parts of Europe before the nineteenth century. By 1200, real wages declined, particularly for skilled labour, reflecting rising prices and stagnant nominal wages. These findings are robust to alternative basket assumptions and are consistent with independent qualitative and quantitative evidence on welfare levels, urbanization, monetary capacity, and aggregate output. The article contributes to debates on the timing of the Great Divergence by documenting another episode of high living standards under non‐Western institutions.
10.1111/ehr.70128.abstract_zh: 本文首次系统估算了安达卢斯（穆斯林统治下的伊比利亚半岛）在公元950年、1000年和1200年的生活水平。基于法律文献和市场管理论著中的价格与工资数据，本文重建了实际工资与福利比率。结果表明，10世纪安达卢斯的生活水平在绝对和比较意义上均处于高位。公元950年和1000年前后，科尔多瓦的非熟练工人所获得的福利比率，与法蒂玛王朝时期的埃及以及19世纪前欧洲较贫困地区相当。到1200年，实际工资出现下降，尤其是熟练劳动力，这反映了物价上涨与名义工资停滞。这些发现在替代性消费篮子假设下依然稳健，并与关于福利水平、城市化、货币能力及总产出的独立定性与定量证据一致。本文通过记录非西方制度下另一个高生活水平的案例，为关于“大分流”时间节点的讨论提供了新证据。
10.1111/ehr.70128.title: The Golden Age of Al‐Andalus? Living standards in Muslim Iberia (950–1200)
10.1111/ehr.70128.title_zh: 安达卢斯的黄金时代？穆斯林伊比利亚的生活水平（950–1200）

10.1111/ehr.70129.abstract: This article uses the township‐level data on welfare expenditure and provision gathered by parish officers in England and Wales at three points between 1776 and 1815 to illuminate regional and local differences during the period. These data have been linked to geographic information system (GIS) mapping systems, facilitating the mapping of parish/township level welfare data across a wide range of variables. Appropriate linkage to the 1801 and 1811 census data and the 1815 income tax property valuations also permits new village‐level estimates of the prevalence, affordability, and typology of welfare provision. The results challenge current hypotheses about regional differences in how the Poor Law was administered.
10.1111/ehr.70129.abstract_zh: 本文利用1776年至1815年间英格兰与威尔士教区官员收集的三个时间点的乡镇级福利支出与供给数据，揭示该时期区域与地方差异。这些数据已与地理信息系统（GIS）制图系统关联，从而能够基于广泛变量绘制教区/乡镇级福利数据地图。通过将数据与1801年及1811年人口普查数据、1815年所得税财产估值进行适当关联，还可对福利供给的普及程度、可负担性及类型进行新的村级估算。研究结果对当前关于济贫法实施区域差异的假说提出了挑战。
10.1111/ehr.70129.title: Regional and local divergence in welfare provision in England and Wales, 1776–1815
10.1111/ehr.70129.title_zh: 1776-1815年英格兰与威尔士福利供给的区域与地方分化

10.1111/ehr.70130.abstract: We study the market for common white bread in the city of Toledo through a new 266‐year‐long series of bread prices, obtained from the cash purchases and wholesale bread‐for‐wheat contracts of large institutions. Our data are strongly consistent with fragmentary evidence on retail price regulation, as well as with shorter series from other regional markets, suggesting they can be considered representative of consumer bread costs for a broad area of New Castile. We show that, in different periods, Toledo's bread prices were substantially lower than two common series used in the comparative literature. We also explore the role of urban institutions in stabilizing prices. We econometrically demonstrate that Toledo's wheat price fluctuations were consistent with a 1‐year storage cycle, suggesting that urban supply management systems were effective at smoothing the extreme fluctuations in early modern harvest yields. The amount of bread in a respectability basket was generally within reach of urban wage earners up to 1750. Resurgent inflation and the breakdown in regulatory institutions resulted in a marked deterioration in the affordability of bread in the second half of the eighteenth century.
10.1111/ehr.70130.abstract_zh: 本文通过大型机构现金采购和面包换小麦批发合同，构建了长达266年的托莱多市普通白面包价格序列。该数据与零售价格管制的零散证据及其他区域市场的短序列高度吻合，表明其可代表新卡斯蒂利亚广大地区消费者面包成本。研究发现，在不同时期，托莱多的面包价格显著低于比较文献中常用的两种序列。我们还探讨了城市机构在稳定价格中的作用。计量分析表明，托莱多小麦价格波动符合一年期储存周期规律，说明城市供应管理系统有效平抑了近代早期收成产量的极端波动。直至1750年，城市工薪阶层基本能负担体面生活所需的面包量。但18世纪下半叶，通胀回升与监管体系瓦解导致面包可负担性显著恶化。
10.1111/ehr.70130.title: The bread of Toledo: Prices and political economy, 1535–1800
10.1111/ehr.70130.title_zh: 托莱多的面包：价格与政治经济学，1535–1800

10.1111/ehr.70131.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Using newly collected discount rate data for six Swiss cities from 1846 to 1893, we find no evidence of increasing integration during a 30‐year period of lightly regulated free banking. We attribute this to two structural issues: banks had incentives to ward off competitors by protecting their local monopolies or forming cartels, and there was always a risk (which varied across banks) that banknotes were not accepted or converted at par. We use a novel counterfactual to show that these issues increased discount rate dispersion, and argue that as a result, public regulation of payments infrastructure was necessary for money market integration.</jats:p>
10.1111/ehr.70131.abstract_zh: 摘要：利用1846至1893年间瑞士六座城市新收集的贴现率数据，我们发现在30年轻度监管的自由银行时期，市场一体化程度并未增强。我们将此归因于两个结构性问题：银行有动机通过保护本地垄断或组建卡特尔来抵御竞争对手，且始终存在银行券不被按面值接受或兑换的风险（该风险因银行而异）。我们采用新颖的反事实分析方法表明，这些问题加剧了贴现率离散程度，并据此论证：支付基础设施的公共监管对于货币市场一体化具有必要性。
10.1111/ehr.70131.title: Private money and money market integration: The role of payments infrastructure in nineteenth‐century Switzerland
10.1111/ehr.70131.title_zh: 私人货币与货币市场一体化：19世纪瑞士支付基础设施的作用

10.1111/ehr.70132.abstract: Why do elite families often maintain their social and economic status across generations? This paper examines the role of adoption in sustaining elite persistence in prewar Japan. Under the Japanese inheritance system, families without a biological son could adopt an heir to continue the family lineage and transfer assets and social status. Using novel father–heir linked data constructed from the Personnel Inquiry Records (1903–39), we compare elite outcomes between biological and adopted heirs. We find that adopted heirs were substantially more likely to remain elite and to reach the extreme upper tail of the income distribution than biological heirs. The results are robust to family, regional, occupational, and educational controls. Overall, the findings suggest that adoption functioned as an institutional mechanism that expanded the pool of potential successors beyond biological lineage, thereby strengthening intergenerational elite persistence in prewar Japan.
10.1111/ehr.70132.abstract_zh: 为何精英家族常能代际维持其社会经济地位？本文考察了收养制度在战前日本精英持续性中的作用。在日本继承制度下，无亲生儿子的家族可通过收养继承人延续家族血脉并转移资产与社会地位。利用《人事调查记录》（1903-1939年）构建的新型父子关联数据，我们比较了亲生继承人与收养继承人的精英地位结果。研究发现，收养继承人比亲生继承人更可能维持精英地位并进入收入分配的极端顶端。该结果在控制家庭、区域、职业及教育变量后依然稳健。总体而言，研究结果表明，收养作为一种制度机制，将潜在继承人的范围扩展至血缘关系之外，从而强化了战前日本的代际精英持续性。
10.1111/ehr.70132.title: Elite persistence in family: The role of adoption in prewar Japan
10.1111/ehr.70132.title_zh: 家族中的精英延续：战前日本收养制度的作用

10.1111/ehr.70133.abstract: Abstract Using existing and new price data sets, we provide the first estimates of market integration across England over the entire 200 years of the industrial revolution. We document a significant, though not huge, integration improvement for markets furthest from London. Full integration was achieved by the 1830s. Our price data sets vary in quality (type of average, price rounding, frequency of stale prices). We show that this severely biases some standard statistical tests of market integration, and we develop and implement new techniques to ensure valid inference. We discuss the application of these techniques to other historical data sets.
10.1111/ehr.70133.abstract_zh: 摘要 利用现有及新增的价格数据集，我们首次估算了工业革命整个200年间英格兰市场的整合程度。研究发现，距离伦敦最远的市场在整合方面取得了显著（尽管并非巨大）的改善。到19世纪30年代，市场已实现完全整合。我们的价格数据集在质量上存在差异（包括平均值类型、价格取整、陈旧价格频率）。我们证明，这些差异严重扭曲了某些市场整合的标准统计检验，并开发并实施了新技术以确保推断的有效性。我们还讨论了这些技术在其他历史数据集中的应用。
10.1111/ehr.70133.title: The big impact of small change: Fresh estimates of English wheat market integration, 1693–1893
10.1111/ehr.70133.title_zh: 小变化的巨大影响：英国小麦市场整合的新估计，1693–1893

10.1111/ehr.70134.abstract: Abstract Between 1807 and 1815, US imports of manufactured goods were slashed dramatically by a trade embargo, non‐importation measures, and the War of 1812. These disruptions are commonly believed to have promoted the growth of nascent domestic manufacturers and thereby spurred early US industrialization. This paper uses disaggregated data on US industrial production to investigate how this interruption of foreign competition affected domestic manufacturing. On balance, the trade disruptions did not accelerate US industrialization, as trend growth in industrial output was little changed over this period. However, the disruptions may have played a role in shifting resources, at least temporarily, from trade‐dependent industries (such as shipbuilding) to domestic infant industries (such as cotton textiles).
10.1111/ehr.70134.abstract_zh: 摘要 1807年至1815年间，贸易禁运、非进口措施及1812年战争导致美国制成品进口大幅削减。这些贸易中断通常被认为促进了新兴国内制造业的发展，从而推动了美国早期工业化。本文利用美国工业生产的细分数据，研究外国竞争的中断如何影响国内制造业。总体而言，贸易中断并未加速美国工业化，因为这一时期工业产出的趋势性增长几乎没有变化。然而，这些中断可能至少在短期内促使资源从依赖贸易的行业（如造船业）转向国内新兴行业（如棉纺织业）。
10.1111/ehr.70134.title: Trade disruptions and early US industrialization
10.1111/ehr.70134.title_zh: 贸易中断与美国早期工业化

10.1111/ehr.70135.abstract: In Two Paths to Prosperity, Greif, Mokyr, and Tabellini (GMT) apply their formidable analytical powers to explaining the divergent trajectories followed by China and Western Europe. In the book's conclusion it is observed that, while much of the economic history literature is focused on the persistence of differences between societies, over the very long run historical reversals have also existed (p.468). Two Paths to Prosperity discusses such a reversal: the shift in the world's centre of economic gravity away from and then back towards China. GMT's description of their book as ‘a study of comparative economic history’ (p. 454) is simultaneously accurate and excessively modest. As I will set out in this short review, the book excels as such a study and so much more. I can only touch on a fraction of the many novel arguments they develop, however.
10.1111/ehr.70135.abstract_zh: 在《通往繁荣的两条路径》中，Greif、Mokyr与Tabellini（简称GMT）运用其卓越的分析能力，阐释了中国与西欧所遵循的迥异发展轨迹。该书结论部分指出，尽管经济史文献多聚焦于社会间差异的持续性，但在极长的时间跨度内，历史逆转现象亦曾存在（第468页）。《通往繁荣的两条路径》探讨了这样一种逆转：世界经济重心先远离中国，后又回归中国的转变。GMT将其著作描述为“一项比较经济史研究”（第454页），这一表述既准确又过于谦逊。正如本短评所述，该书作为此类研究堪称典范，其内涵远不止于此。然而，我只能触及他们提出的众多新颖论点中的一小部分。
10.1111/ehr.70135.title: Two paths to prosperity: Culture and institutions in Europe and China, 1000–2000AvnerGreif, JoelMokyr, and GuidoTabellini, (Princeton University Press, 2025. Pp. 533. ISBN 9780691265940. Hbk £35).
10.1111/ehr.70135.title_zh: 两条通往繁荣之路：欧洲与中国的文化与制度，1000–2000年

10.1111/ehr.70136.abstract: A third edition of An economic history of Europe has now appeared, with Markus Lampe joining the late Karl Gunnar Persson and his protégé Paul Sharp as a co-author. The book has by this point established itself as a widely used synthesis of European economic history for undergraduate economics students, and this new edition invites the simple question, ‘what has actually changed?’.
10.1111/ehr.70136.abstract_zh: 《欧洲经济史》第三版现已问世，马库斯·兰佩加入了已故的卡尔·贡纳尔·佩尔松及其门生保罗·夏普的行列，成为合著者。此书至此已成为经济学本科生广泛使用的欧洲经济史综合教材，而这一新版引出了一个简单的问题：“究竟有何变化？
10.1111/ehr.70136.title: An economic history of Europe: Knowledge, institutions and welfare, prehistory to the presentKarl GunnarPersson, PaulSharp, and MarkusLampe, (3rd edition, Cambridge University Press, 2026. Pp. 314. ISBN 9781009613989. Sbk £35).
10.1111/ehr.70136.title_zh: 欧洲经济史：知识、制度与福利——从史前到当代

10.1111/ehr.70137.abstract: Few questions in economic history feel more urgent in 2026 than those posed at the opening of this volume. That is, when one country tries to damage another's trade or resources, what results are to be expected, why have those results so often been disappointed, and can economic measures be effective if unaccompanied by force, or the credible threat of it? Professors Stephen Broadberry and Mark Harrison, whose previous collaborations on the economics of the two world wars set the standard for the field, have assembled a team of leading scholars to look for answers across three centuries. The result is a volume that is at once both a worthy successor to those earlier collections and a distinctive intervention in current debates about the use of sanctions against Iran, Russia, China, and others. It complements the recent work of Nicholas Mulder (The economic weapon, 2022) and Lance Davis and Stanley Engerman (Naval blockades in peace and war, 2006) by extending the chronology and broadening the comparative framework.
10.1111/ehr.70137.abstract_zh: 在2026年，经济史中几乎没有比本卷开篇提出的问题更为紧迫的了。即，当一个国家试图损害另一国的贸易或资源时，预期会产生何种结果，为何这些结果常常令人失望，以及如果经济措施没有武力或可信武力威胁的伴随，它们能否有效？斯蒂芬·布罗德伯里教授和马克·哈里森教授，他们此前在两次世界大战经济学方面的合作树立了该领域的标杆，现已召集了一支顶尖学者团队，跨越三个世纪寻找答案。其结果是一部既是对早期文集当之无愧的继承，又是对当前关于对伊朗、俄罗斯、中国等国制裁辩论的独特介入之作。它通过延长时间跨度和拓宽比较框架，补充了尼古拉斯·穆尔德（《经济武器》，2022年）和兰斯·戴维斯与斯坦利·恩格尔曼（《和平与战争中的海上封锁》，2006年）近期的研究。
10.1111/ehr.70137.title: Economic warfare and sanctions since 1688StephenBroadberry and MarkHarrison, Eds., (Cambridge University Press, 2025. Pp. 298. ISBN 9781009474863. PbK £28).

10.1111/ehr.70138.abstract: Japan's regional convergence of productivity levels throughout the twentieth century can be best described as a cumulative process of ‘catching up, forging ahead, and falling behind’. Using a novel dataset spanning 135 years (1874–2008), this study finds support for a crucial role played by structural transformation in convergence. The pace of productivity catch‐up and convergence accelerated in the mid‐1950s with the help of structural transformation, particularly in the period from 1955 to 1965. Structural transformation explains, on average, about 30 per cent of the aggregate productivity growth, and its effect intensified in prefectures with faster movements of labour across sectors and larger sectoral productivity gaps. However, since the early 1970s, its contribution to the convergence was frequently offset by within‐sector productivity growth, in turn thwarting the pace of convergence. These counter‐balancing effects contributed to the diverse pathways of productivity catch‐up at the prefecture level.
10.1111/ehr.70138.abstract_zh: 20世纪日本各区域生产率水平的收敛过程，可被最恰当地描述为“追赶、领先与落后”的累积性进程。本研究利用覆盖135年（1874-2008年）的新数据集，发现结构转型在收敛过程中发挥了关键作用。20世纪50年代中期，在结构转型的推动下，生产率追赶与收敛速度显著加快，尤其在1955年至1965年期间。结构转型平均解释了约30%的总体生产率增长，且其效应在劳动力跨部门流动更快、部门间生产率差距更大的县级行政区中更为显著。然而自20世纪70年代初以来，结构转型对收敛的贡献常被部门内生产率增长所抵消，进而阻碍了收敛进程。这些相互抵消的效应导致了县级层面生产率追赶路径的多元化。
10.1111/ehr.70138.title: The role of structural transformation in regional convergence in Japan: 1874–2008
10.1111/ehr.70138.title_zh: 日本区域趋同中的结构转型作用：1874–2008

10.1111/ehr.70139.abstract: Barry Eichengreen has written an ambitious, detailed, elegant, and altogether fascinating account of how currencies become international, or globalized, and also when, how, why, and in what circumstances they stop playing that role. At the end he delivers a sharp warning that irresponsible policies are harming the United States as well as undermining the credibility of the dollar as a global currency.
10.1111/ehr.70139.abstract_zh: 巴里·艾肯格林撰写了一部雄心勃勃、详尽而优雅的著作，全面探讨了货币如何走向国际化或全球化，以及它们在何种时机、方式、原因和情境下停止扮演这一角色。在书末，他发出尖锐警告，指出不负责任的政策正在损害美国自身，同时削弱美元作为全球货币的信誉。
10.1111/ehr.70139.title: Money Beyond Borders: Global Currencies From Croesus to CryptoBarryEichengreen, Princeton University Press, 2026. Pp. 344. £25 (Hbk). ISBN 9780691280530
10.1111/ehr.70139.title_zh: 超越国界的货币：从克罗伊斯到加密货币的全球货币

10.1111/ehr.70140.abstract: How might the evidence of hoards of coins of small value shift the terms of the Great Divergence Debate? Focused on coins, mints, and wages, Luccassen's meticulous volume expands the scope of this important topic. It begins by overturning Immanuel Wallerstein's (The Modern World System, Vol. 2, 1974) understanding of the inflow of American bullion and its hoarding in India/Asia. Instead, it points to the growing monetization that was at work in India/Asia from the sixteenth century.
10.1111/ehr.70140.abstract_zh: 大量小额硬币窖藏的发现如何可能改变大分流辩论的论题？卢卡森这部细致入微的著作聚焦于硬币、铸币厂与工资，拓展了这一重要议题的范围。它首先推翻了伊曼纽尔·沃勒斯坦（《现代世界体系》第二卷，1974年）关于美洲白银流入及其在印度/亚洲窖藏的理解。相反，它指出自十六世纪起，印度/亚洲正在发生的货币化进程日益增强。
10.1111/ehr.70140.title: Money of the Masses: Copper coin production and circulation in India 1500–1900JanLucassen, (Manohar, 2026. Pp. 1068. ISBN 9789360806675. Hbk £93)
10.1111/ehr.70140.title_zh: 大众的货币：印度铜币的生产与流通（1500–1900年）

10.1111/ehr.70142.title: The first bear raid and squeeze: Isaac Le Maire and the Dutch East India Company
10.1111/ehr.70142.title_zh: 第一次熊市袭击与逼空：艾萨克·勒迈尔与荷兰东印度公司

10.1111/ehr.70143.abstract: Making an Industrial Revolution: Skill, Knowledge, Community and Innovation Gillian Cookson, (Woodbridge, the Boydell Press, 2025. Pp. 252. Hbk $85.23, Pbk $32.26).
10.1111/ehr.70143.abstract_zh: 打造工业革命：技能、知识、社区与创新 吉莉安·库克森著，（伍德布里奇，博伊德尔出版社，2025年。共252页。精装本85.23美元，平装本32.26美元）。
10.1111/ehr.70143.title: Making an Industrial Revolution: Skill, Knowledge, Community and InnovationGillianCookson, (Woodbridge, the Boydell Press, 2025. Pp. 252. Hbk $85.23, Pbk $32.26).

10.1111/ehr.70144.abstract: The 2008 financial crisis sparked a massive wave of scholarship reviewing the history of capitalism. To these ambitious narratives of economic history has now been added Trevor Jackson's The Insatiable Machine. Distinguishing itself in a crowded field, Jackson's incisive book covers the history of capitalism's global dominance in just over 300 pages, in which he seeks to explain ‘where capitalism came from, how it spread around the world, and how it came to be the dominant way of organizing human lives’ (p. 2).
10.1111/ehr.70144.abstract_zh: 2008年金融危机引发了一波大规模学术研究，重新审视资本主义历史。在这些宏大的经济史叙事中，如今又添上了特雷弗·杰克逊的《永不满足的机器》。在众多著作中脱颖而出，杰克逊这本见解深刻的书仅用300余页篇幅，涵盖了资本主义全球主导地位的历史，旨在解释“资本主义源自何处，如何传播至世界各地，以及如何成为组织人类生活的主导方式”（第2页）。
10.1111/ehr.70144.title: The Insatiable Machine: How Capitalism Conquered the WorldTrevorJackson (W. W. Norton & Company, 2026. Pp. 320. Hbk £21. ISBN 9781324106876).
10.1111/ehr.70144.title_zh: 永不满足的机器：资本主义如何征服世界

10.1111/ehr.70145.abstract: The fate of the handloom cotton textile industry is one of the most debated topics in the economic history of India. This paper presents novel employment estimates for cotton textile handweaving and spinning in the period 1800–1940. I put together plausible values for labour productivity and combine these with aggregate input usage to generate employment estimates. I then examine a number of related topics: the regional question, the relationship between handloom and power‐loom cloth from the consumer's perspective, the standard of living of handloom weavers, and the impact of technological progress within the handloom industry.
10.1111/ehr.70145.abstract_zh: 手织棉纺织业的命运是印度经济史中争论最为激烈的话题之一。本文提供了1800年至1940年间棉纺织手工织造与纺纱的新颖就业估算。我整合了合理的劳动生产率数值，并将其与总体投入使用情况相结合，以生成就业估算。随后，我探讨了若干相关议题：区域性问题、从消费者视角看手织机与动力织机布料之间的关系、手织机织工的生活水平，以及手织机行业内技术进步的影响。
10.1111/ehr.70145.title: Indian deindustrialization revisited: New data, estimates, and interpretations
10.1111/ehr.70145.title_zh: 印度去工业化再探讨：新数据、估算与解释

10.1111/ehr.70146.abstract: The present article employs probate records to analyse private wealth accumulation and distribution in Montevideo between 1760 and 1825. The results reveal four major findings. Firstly, there was a sustained rise in average wealth over time, even in the face of independence‐related wars. Secondly, asset portfolios became more complex and urban‐oriented. Thirdly, wealth inequality declined over the period under study. Finally, Montevideo exhibited relatively low levels of inequality in comparison with other contemporary global regions. The distribution of urban real estate and enslaved individuals, in particular, became more equitable, revealing a distinctive pattern of slave ownership. Notwithstanding these more general improvements, the top decile continued to accumulate significant fortunes. The findings are consistent with the importance of frontier conditions, institutional frameworks, and warfare for understanding distributive outcomes in this setting. The case of Montevideo highlights the historical contingency of inequality trajectories over time.
10.1111/ehr.70146.abstract_zh: 本文利用遗嘱认证记录，分析了1760年至1825年间蒙得维的亚的私人财富积累与分配情况。研究结果揭示了四大主要发现。首先，即便在独立战争期间，平均财富也呈现出持续增长的趋势。其次，资产组合变得更加复杂且偏向城市导向。第三，在所研究期间，财富不平等程度有所下降。最后，与同期全球其他地区相比，蒙得维的亚的不平等水平相对较低。特别是城市房地产和被奴役人口的分配变得更加公平，显示出一种独特的奴隶所有权模式。尽管存在这些总体改善，但最富有的十分之一人口仍持续积累巨额财富。这些发现与边疆条件、制度框架和战争对理解该地区分配结果的重要性相吻合。蒙得维的亚的案例凸显了不平等轨迹随时间变化的历史偶然性。
10.1111/ehr.70146.title: Wealth and inequality in Spanish America, from colonial rule to the eve of independence in Montevideo
10.1111/ehr.70146.title_zh: 从殖民统治到独立前夕：西班牙美洲的财富与不平等——以蒙得维的亚为例

10.1111/ehr.70147.abstract: This study examines social‐class and urban–rural differentials in childhood mortality in Sweden from 1880 to 1910, a period of steady mortality decline, ongoing industrialization, and urbanization. Urbanization brought improvements in water quality and sanitation but also increased risks from overcrowding, pollution, and infectious diseases. It remains unexplored whether these changes narrowed or widened the class gap in infant and child mortality. We use full‐count Swedish censuses linked to the Swedish Death Index (SDI), which provides near‐comprehensive coverage of all deaths and allows for reliable estimation of mortality in ages 1–9 years. Detailed census data enable analysis of parental household characteristics. Due to undercounting of infant deaths, we use under‐five sex ratios as a proxy for infant mortality. Results show a strong urban penalty in both infant and child mortality in the late nineteenth century, which diminished in the early twentieth century. Pronounced class differences existed in child mortality in both urban and rural areas but not in infant mortality. Although absolute class differences narrowed over time, relative inequalities persisted in urban areas but largely disappeared in rural settings. These findings reveal substantial inequalities in child survival during industrialization linked to both urban residence and social class.
10.1111/ehr.70147.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了1880年至1910年间瑞典儿童死亡率的阶层与城乡差异，这一时期死亡率持续下降，工业化与城市化同步推进。城市化带来了水质与卫生条件的改善，但也增加了过度拥挤、污染及传染病传播的风险。这些变化究竟是缩小还是扩大了婴儿及儿童死亡率的阶层差距，此前尚无研究探讨。我们利用与瑞典死亡索引（SDI）关联的全量瑞典人口普查数据，该索引几乎覆盖所有死亡记录，可对1至9岁年龄段的死亡率进行可靠估计。详尽的普查数据使我们能够分析父母家庭特征。鉴于婴儿死亡存在漏报问题，我们采用五岁以下性别比作为婴儿死亡率的代理指标。结果显示，19世纪末城市地区在婴儿及儿童死亡率方面均存在显著劣势，但这一劣势在20世纪初有所减弱。城乡地区儿童死亡率均存在显著阶层差异，而婴儿死亡率则未见明显阶层分化。尽管绝对阶层差距随时间推移有所缩小，但相对不平等在城市地区持续存在，而在农村地区则基本消失。这些发现揭示了工业化时期儿童生存机会中与城市居住及社会阶层相关的显著不平等。
10.1111/ehr.70147.title: The mortality gradient in town and country: Social class and childhood mortality in Sweden at the turn of the twentieth century
10.1111/ehr.70147.title_zh: 城乡死亡率梯度：二十世纪初瑞典的社会阶层与儿童死亡率

10.1111/ehr.70148.abstract: Between the seventeenth and twentieth centuries, billions of cowries arrived in West Africa, leaving one of the few quantitative traces available for historians to measure the Atlantic trade's impact on the precolonial market economy. Yet, current estimates substantially underestimate the volume of cowry imports. Drawing on unexplored and underutilized sources, most notably French records, this article presents a new annual time series of cowry imports into West Africa between 1650 and 1905. This series reframes three long‐standing debates. First, contrary to arguments that the slave trade's negative economic impacts were already evident in its early phases, cowry imports grew as the slave trade progressed. Second, by reconstructing the nominal cowry stock, the article shows that the end of the slave trade in a context without a clear alternative caused a lasting contraction of the market economy. Third, the interplay between cowry and coin imports challenges the influential ‘great inflation’ thesis by showing that the region absorbed much larger currency inflows than previously assumed. Together, these findings reveal a highly responsive but exposed monetary system that alternated between rapid growth and deep depressions, a pattern that shaped the Atlantic trade's long‐run economic impact in West Africa.
10.1111/ehr.70148.abstract_zh: 在十七至二十世纪之间，数十亿枚贝币抵达西非，为历史学家衡量大西洋贸易对前殖民时期市场经济的影响留下了少数可量化的痕迹之一。然而，现有的估算严重低估了贝币进口的规模。本文利用未被探索和未被充分利用的资料，尤其是法国档案，构建了1650年至1905年间西非贝币进口的新的年度时间序列。这一序列重新审视了三个长期存在的争论。首先，与奴隶贸易的负面经济影响在其早期阶段已显而易见的论点相反，贝币进口随奴隶贸易的推进而增长。其次，通过重建名义贝币存量，本文表明，在缺乏明确替代方案的情境下，奴隶贸易的终结导致了市场经济的持续收缩。第三，贝币与铸币进口之间的相互作用挑战了颇具影响力的“大通胀”论点，表明该地区吸收的货币流入远超先前假设。综合来看，这些发现揭示了一个高度敏感但脆弱的货币体系，它在快速增长与深度萧条之间交替，这一模式塑造了大西洋贸易对西非的长期经济影响。
10.1111/ehr.70148.title: Atlantic trade and the West African market economy: New evidence from cowry imports, 1650–1905
10.1111/ehr.70148.title_zh: 大西洋贸易与西非市场经济：来自贝壳货币进口的新证据（1650–1905）

10.1111/ehr.70149.abstract: Financial history is plagued by a visibility trap. Using the Brussels Stock Exchange (1850–1913), we demonstrate that asset illiquidity introduced selection bias, which systematically inflated historical risk premia. Applying a latent return model, we argue that correcting for this illiquidity decreases the equity and corporate bond risk premia and collapses the risk–return relationship. We show that the assets that were more exposed to selection bias underperformed in subsequent months. We identify two institutional drivers of this phenomenon: censored price lists curated by the financial media and the exchange's policy to cease publishing bids and ask quotes in its official price lists from 1889 onwards.
10.1111/ehr.70149.abstract_zh: 金融历史深受一种“可见性陷阱”的困扰。利用布鲁塞尔证券交易所（1850-1913年）的数据，我们证明资产流动性不足引入了选择偏差，这系统性地抬高了历史风险溢价。通过应用潜在收益模型，我们认为纠正这一流动性不足会降低股票和公司债券的风险溢价，并使风险-收益关系趋于消失。我们显示，那些更易受选择偏差影响的资产在随后几个月中表现不佳。我们识别出这一现象的两个制度性驱动因素：金融媒体策划的删减价格列表，以及交易所自1889年起停止在其官方价格列表中公布买卖报价的政策。
10.1111/ehr.70149.title: Risk premia reconsidered: Illiquidity and selection bias for stocks and corporate bonds in the pre‐First World War period
10.1111/ehr.70149.title_zh: 风险溢价再探讨：第一次世界大战前股票与公司债券的流动性不足与选择偏差

10.1111/ehr.70151.abstract: Recent historical national accounting data show that the timing of the Great Divergence hinges on the different trends in north‐west Europe and the Yangzi Delta region of China. Although north‐west Europe only pulled ahead of the Yangzi Delta after 1700, both the positive trend of GDP per capita in north‐west Europe after 1700 and the negative trend in the Yangzi Delta were continuations of a process that began in the fourteenth century, driven by different paths of innovation. We provide an analytic narrative of the Great Divergence based on the proximate sources of growth and the fundamental sources of innovation.
10.1111/ehr.70151.abstract_zh: 近期历史国民经济核算数据显示，大分流的时机取决于西北欧与中国长江三角洲地区不同的发展趋势。尽管西北欧仅在1700年后才超越长江三角洲，但西北欧人均GDP在1700年后的正向趋势与长江三角洲的负向趋势，都是始于14世纪进程的延续，这一进程由不同的创新路径所驱动。我们基于增长的直接来源与创新的根本来源，对大分流进行了分析性叙述。
10.1111/ehr.70151.title: Innovation and the great divergence

10.1111/ehr.70152.title: Slavery, freedom, and development By Warren C.Whatley, (Cambridge University Press, 2026). Pp. 237. Hbk £35. ISBN 9781009407144.

10.1111/ehr.70154.abstract: This study investigates the health consequences of coal smoke during Japan's early industrialization. Using fixed‐effects models and a prefecture‐level panel dataset on actual coal consumption and infant mortality from 1899 to 1910, this study finds that higher coal consumption was positively associated with infant mortality. The baseline estimate suggests that a one‐standard‐deviation increase in the log of coal consumption was associated with approximately 2.1 additional infant deaths per 1000 live births, and that the growth in coal use was associated with an increase in infant mortality equivalent to approximately 11.8 per cent of the overall rise in infant mortality during the sample period. Further estimates using infant deaths by age interval show that this association was weak during the neonatal period but became more pronounced during the post‐neonatal period, particularly from 1 month to under 6 months after birth. These findings suggest that coal‐based industrialization carried health costs in a non‐Western industrializing economy and that the timing of pollution‐related infant mortality differed from that observed in modern contexts.
10.1111/ehr.70154.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了日本早期工业化时期煤炭烟雾对健康的影响。利用固定效应模型及1899年至1910年间县级实际煤炭消费量与婴儿死亡率的面板数据，研究发现煤炭消费量的增加与婴儿死亡率呈正相关。基准估计表明，煤炭消费量对数值每增加一个标准差，与每千名活产婴儿中约增加2.1例死亡相关，且煤炭使用的增长与样本期间婴儿死亡率总体上升中约11.8%的增幅相关联。进一步按婴儿死亡年龄区间进行的估计显示，这一关联在新生儿期较弱，而在新生儿后期，尤其是出生后1个月至6个月期间，表现得更为显著。这些发现表明，在非西方工业化经济体中，以煤炭为基础的工业化带来了健康成本，且污染相关婴儿死亡的时间分布与现代情境下观察到的有所不同。
10.1111/ehr.70154.title: Impacts of coal smoke on infant mortality: Evidence from industrializing Japan
10.1111/ehr.70154.title_zh: 煤烟对婴儿死亡率的影响：来自日本工业化时期的证据

10.1111/ehr.70155.title: Life, Death, and Migration in the Early Modern City: The Urban Historical Demography of WürzburgJandeVries, (Cambridge University Press, 2026. Pp. 304. ISBN 9781009641517. Hbk £95)
10.1111/ehr.70155.title_zh: 近代早期城市中的生、死与迁移：维尔茨堡的城市历史人口学研究

10.1111/ehr.70156.abstract: Government regulation of the banking sector is pervasive, making it difficult to empirically analyse when banks would voluntarily choose to issue equity if there were no minimum requirements on capital adequacy. A unique historical setting occurred in the late nineteenth‐century United Kingdom when joint‐stock banks were free to choose their capital structures. We show that during this era, banks were willing to issue equity as part of restructuring processes, but were reluctant to do so on a regular basis to offset increases in liabilities. We find that large issues of uncalled capital were made as a replacement for unlimited liability, and this uncalled capital continued to restrain risk‐taking as shown by an analysis of bank loan books. Banks were also willing to issue stock to finance mergers and acquisitions, but this was generally just used to absorb the equity of target banks so did not increase aggregate paid‐up capital. Equity issuance did not keep pace with deposit growth, leading to the erosion of capital adequacy over the long run.
10.1111/ehr.70156.abstract_zh: 政府对银行业的监管无处不在，这使得在缺乏最低资本充足率要求的情况下，难以实证分析银行何时会自愿选择发行股票。十九世纪末的英国出现了一个独特的历史背景，当时股份制银行可以自由选择其资本结构。我们表明，在那个时代，银行愿意在重组过程中发行股票，但不愿定期这样做以抵消负债的增加。我们发现，大量未缴资本的发行是为了替代无限责任，而这种未缴资本通过银行贷款账簿的分析显示，持续抑制了风险承担。银行也愿意发行股票以资助并购活动，但这通常仅用于吸收目标银行的股权，因此并未增加总实缴资本。股票发行未能跟上存款增长的步伐，导致资本充足率在长期内逐渐侵蚀。
10.1111/ehr.70156.title: Free to choose: Bank capital in Britain, 1878–1939
10.1111/ehr.70156.title_zh: 自由选择：英国银行资本，1878–1939

10.1111/iere.12781.abstract: We establish that inefficiently lax financial regulation can arise democratically. Lax regulation leads to banks issuing risky mortgages at less than actuarially fair interest rates. This creates additional demand for houses and increases house prices, generating nontrivial distribution of winners and losers. Renters and individuals with large nonhousing wealth suffer from the induced banking fragility, while young middle-wealth households benefit from mispriced mortgages and old homeowners benefit from higher house prices. When these latter two groups constitute a majority, regulatory failure can be a democratic outcome. Voting patterns in US Congress provide empirical support for this mechanism.
10.1111/iere.12781.abstract_zh: 我们证实，效率低下的宽松金融监管可能通过民主程序产生。宽松监管导致银行以低于精算公平利率的水平发放高风险抵押贷款，这额外推高了住房需求并抬升房价，从而在赢家与输家之间形成不容忽视的分布格局。租房者及拥有大量非住房财富的个人因由此引发的银行脆弱性而受损，而年轻的中等财富家庭则从错误定价的抵押贷款中获益，老年房主则因房价上涨而受益。当后两个群体构成多数时，监管失灵便可能成为民主选举的结果。美国国会的投票模式为这一机制提供了实证支持。

10.1111/iere.70019.abstract: We formulate quantum computing solutions to a large class of dynamic nonlinear asset pricing models using algorithms, in theory exponentially more efficient than classical ones, which leverage the quantum properties of superposition, entanglement, and interference. The equilibrium asset pricing solution is a quantum state. We use quantum decision-theoretic foundations of ambiguity and model/parameter uncertainty to deal with model selection.
10.1111/iere.70019.abstract_zh: 我们利用量子计算解决方案，针对一大类动态非线性资产定价模型，采用在理论上比经典算法指数级更高效的算法，这些算法利用了叠加、纠缠和干涉的量子特性。均衡资产定价解表现为一个量子态。我们运用基于量子决策理论的模糊性及模型/参数不确定性处理框架，来应对模型选择问题。

10.1111/iere.70023.abstract: Funding: This work received financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant Numbers 71910107001 and 72471248) and Central South University Innovation-Driven Research Program (Grant Number 2023CXQD069).

10.1111/iere.70031.abstract: This paper is a revised version of the first chapter of my dissertation. I would like to thank Randall Wright for his invaluable guidance, and Erwan Quintin and Marzena Rostek for their continuous support. For insightful suggestions, I am indebted to the coeditor, Masaki Aoyagi, and two anonymous referees. 10.1111/iere.70031.abstract_zh: 本文是我博士论文第一章的修订版。我要感谢Randall Wright的宝贵指导，以及Erwan Quintin和Marzena Rostek的持续支持。对于富有洞见的建议，我深感于联合主编Masaki Aoyagi和两位匿名审稿人的恩惠。同时，我也感激Yu Awaya、Zach Bethune、Saki Bigio、Michael Choi、Kim-Sau Chung、Dean Corbae、Charles Engel、Lucas Herrenbrueck、Kazuya Kamiya、Rishabh Kirpalani、Yi-Hsuan Lin、Peter Norman、Wei Qiao、Guillaume Rocheteau、Harald Uhlig、Makoto Watanabe、Ariel Zetlin-Jones、Shengxing Zhang、Yu Zhu以及众多研讨会和会议参与者的有益评论。本研究得到JSPS KAKENHI基金项目JP22K13366和JP23H00054的资助。

10.1111/iere.70035.abstract: Allowing risk preferences to depend on the correlation between lottery outcomes can explain behavioral anomalies, while empirical evidence is limited and mixed. Using the framework of correlation sensitivity, we classify preferences into three types and adapt a choice task to categorize subjects. Experiments show that aggregate choices exhibit correlation sensitivity opposite to regret and salience theory predictions. Clustering analysis reveals that a correlation-sensitive minority drives these patterns, while most subjects display no sensitivity. We further disentangle deliberate within-state comparisons from incidental payoff comparisons, finding that both contribute to correlation sensitivity, with deliberate comparisons exerting slightly stronger effects.
10.1111/iere.70035.abstract_zh: 允许风险偏好依赖于彩票结果之间的相关性，可以解释行为异常现象，而实证证据有限且不一。利用相关性敏感性框架，我们将偏好分为三类，并调整选择任务以对受试者进行分类。实验表明，总体选择表现出与遗憾理论和显著性理论预测相反的相关性敏感性。聚类分析揭示，一个相关性敏感的少数群体驱动了这些模式，而大多数受试者则未表现出敏感性。我们进一步区分了有意的状态内比较与偶然的收益比较，发现两者均对相关性敏感性有所贡献，其中有意的比较影响略强。

10.1111/iere.70036.abstract: The shift from offline to online purchasing is reshaping trade patterns: a weaker effect of distance has been observed in digital transactions. This study analyzes these dynamics at an unprecedented scale and granularity, using interregional gravity models estimated from billions of geolocated French card transactions. Using a matched sample of merchants active in both online and offline channels, with unambiguous regional identification, we compare purchasing behavior across channels. We estimate that distance matters 35% less online than offline on average, but for durables, 69% lower online; 43% lower online for nondurables; a negligible online–offline difference is found for services.
10.1111/iere.70036.abstract_zh: 从线下购物向线上购物的转变正在重塑贸易格局：数字交易中距离的影响有所减弱。本研究利用数十亿条地理定位的法国银行卡交易数据，通过区域间引力模型，在前所未有的规模和粒度上分析了这些动态变化。采用同时活跃于线上和线下渠道的商户匹配样本，并确保区域识别无误，我们比较了不同渠道的购买行为。估计结果显示，平均而言，线上交易中距离的影响比线下低35%，但耐用品线上低69%；非耐用品线上低43%；而服务业的线上与线下差异则可忽略不计。

10.1111/iere.70037.abstract: This paper documents that agricultural sectors diversify less than other manufacturing activities. A simple model shows that this difference can contribute to welfare divergence in a way that is qualitatively different to what results when uneven growth happens in the intensive margin. When consumers have love of variety, they endogenously reduce their expenditure share on the sector that diversifies production the least, pushing terms of trade against the lagging economy. Empirical evidence supports these patterns in agricultural economies. Uneven product diversification plays a relevant quantitative role in explaining expenditure share shifts and terms of trade movements, which complements existing explanations.
10.1111/iere.70037.abstract_zh: 本文记录了农业部门相对于其他制造业活动的多元化程度较低。一个简单模型表明，这种差异可能以与集约边际上不均衡增长所导致的结果在性质上不同的方式，促成福利分化。当消费者具有品种偏好时，他们会内生地减少对生产多元化程度最低部门的支出份额，从而推动贸易条件对落后经济体不利。实证证据支持了农业经济中的这些模式。产品多元化的不均衡在解释支出份额变动和贸易条件变化方面发挥着重要的定量作用，这补充了现有的解释。

10.1111/iere.70038.abstract: We propose a model of categorization in financial markets where states are defined by payoff-relevant variables, but all securities are measurable with respect to strict subsets of these variables. This limits insurance against variable interactions: no combination of securities can compensate the absence of an instrument targeting a given set of variables. We provide a decomposition result that identifies the uninsurable component of income risk for any market. We derive a lower bound on the number of securities required for efficiency. Using the same techniques, we characterize the payoff space when individuals condition only on a personal set of variables.
10.1111/iere.70038.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个金融市场中的分类模型，其中状态由与收益相关的变量定义，但所有证券仅对这些变量的严格子集可测。这限制了对变量间交互作用的保险能力：没有任何证券组合能够弥补针对特定变量集合的工具缺失。我们提供一个分解结果，识别任何市场中收入风险的不可保险部分。我们推导出实现效率所需证券数量的下界。运用相同技术，我们刻画了当个体仅依据个人变量集进行条件判断时的收益空间。

10.1111/iere.70039.abstract: An earlier version of this paper was circulated under the title “Ambiguity Averse Portfolio Choices in an Aging Population.”
10.1111/iere.70039.abstract_zh: 本文早期版本曾以“老龄化人口中的模糊厌恶投资组合选择”为题流传。

10.1111/iere.70040.abstract: We investigate the sources of the dealer centrality premium in the over-the-counter market for corporate bonds. We model dealer heterogeneity by allowing the dealer's status in the network to determine search effort and inventory costs when choosing to conduct riskless principal or principal trades. Structural estimates match the observed centrality premium across transaction types and trade count deciles. Counterfactual analyses reveal that measures that limit core dealer bargaining power vis-a-vis clients reduce roundtrip spreads. Removing core dealers' advantage in search relative to peripheral dealers has little effect on transaction costs.
10.1111/iere.70040.abstract_zh: 我们探究了公司债券场外交易市场中交易商中心性溢价的来源。通过允许交易商在网络中的地位决定其选择进行无风险本金交易或本金交易时的搜索努力和库存成本，我们对交易商异质性进行了建模。结构估计结果与观察到的不同交易类型及交易次数十分位上的中心性溢价相吻合。反事实分析显示，限制核心交易商相对于客户的议价能力的措施会降低往返价差。而消除核心交易商相对于外围交易商在搜索方面的优势，对交易成本影响甚微。

10.1111/iere.70041.abstract: The standard permanent and transitory income model is known to be misspecified. Estimates of income volatility within this model differ depending on the specific data moments used—whether they are in levels or differences—and how these moments are weighted during estimation. We suggest a simple modification to the standard model: allowing for two transitory shocks that persist for different lengths of time. Our proposed model, which introduces only one additional parameter, consistently and accurately identifies the parameters of the income process, regardless of the estimation method used .
10.1111/iere.70041.abstract_zh: 标准持久与暂时性收入模型已知存在设定偏误。在该模型内，收入波动性的估计结果因所使用的具体数据矩（无论是水平值还是差分形式）以及估计过程中这些矩的加权方式不同而有所差异。我们建议对标准模型进行一项简单修改：允许存在两个持续时间不同的暂时性冲击。我们提出的模型仅引入一个额外参数，无论采用何种估计方法，都能一致且准确地识别收入过程的参数。

10.1111/iere.70042.abstract: This paper studies Chinese firms' export status, distinguishing state and privately controlled enterprises. A dynamic model of export decisions is estimated by ownership types. The estimated models capture distinctive differences between ownership types including the productivity gap between exporters and nonexporters, the interaction between domestic and foreign sales, the skewed distribution of export shares, and the dynamic response of employment to changes in export status. Our analysis highlights the crucial role of demand shocks and labor adjustment costs in shaping the dynamics of export status, especially for privately controlled enterprises. The estimated model is used to study tariffs and uncertainty.
10.1111/iere.70042.abstract_zh: 本文研究了中国企业的出口状态，区分了国有控股和私人控股企业。我们按所有权类型估计了一个出口决策的动态模型。估计模型捕捉了所有权类型之间的显著差异，包括出口商与非出口商之间的生产率差距、国内销售与国外销售之间的相互作用、出口份额的偏态分布，以及就业对出口状态变化的动态响应。我们的分析强调了需求冲击和劳动力调整成本在塑造出口状态动态中的关键作用，尤其是对私人控股企业而言。估计模型被用于研究关税和不确定性。

10.1111/iere.70043.abstract: We propose a model for network-mediated interactions incorporating higher-order relationships such as triadic interactions. The marginal utility of an individual's action depends explicitly on endogenous actions of multiple units. Conditions ensuring a unique Nash equilibrium are derived using a variational inequality approach. We estimate the model parameters via maximum likelihood and derive their large sample properties. Applying our model to data from a primary school teamwork experiment in China, we find that the peer effects associated with externally assigned teammates vary depending on preexisting friendship networks. The teamwork intervention enhances peer influence on attitudes while diminishing academic competition among students.
10.1111/iere.70043.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个模型，用以纳入如三元互动等更高阶关系的网络中介交互。个体行为的边际效用明确依赖于多个单元的内生行为。通过变分不等式方法，我们推导出确保纳什均衡唯一性的条件。我们利用最大似然法估计模型参数，并推导其大样本性质。将我们的模型应用于中国一所小学团队合作实验的数据，我们发现与外部指派队友相关的同伴效应，会因既有友谊网络的不同而有所变化。该团队合作干预增强了同伴对态度的影响，同时减弱了学生间的学业竞争。

10.1111/iere.70045.abstract: We study a platform's incentives to remove IP-infringing products and the effects of holding the platform liable for such infringements on innovation and welfare. We first show that platform liability can lead to either higher or lower commission rates, depending on how screening affects transaction volume. We then show that liability may spur or hinder innovation, depending on the intensity of cross-group network externalities, which determines participation elasticities on each side. If platform liability lowers innovation, all market participants—the platform, innovators, imitators, and buyers—are worse off. We also provide a sufficient condition for platform liability to raise welfare.
10.1111/iere.70045.abstract_zh: 我们研究平台移除知识产权侵权产品的激励，以及平台对此类侵权承担责任对创新和福利的影响。我们首先表明，平台责任可能导致佣金率上升或下降，这取决于筛选如何影响交易量。接着，我们证明责任可能促进或阻碍创新，这取决于跨群体网络外部性的强度，该强度决定了各方的参与弹性。如果平台责任降低了创新，所有市场参与者——平台、创新者、模仿者和买家——都将受损。我们还提供了平台责任提升福利的一个充分条件。

10.1111/iere.70047.abstract: A previous version of this paper circulated under the title “Centralized Assignment of Students to Majors: Evidence from the University of Costa Rica.”
10.1111/iere.70047.abstract_zh: 本文早期版本曾以“学生专业集中分配：来自哥斯达黎加大学的证据”为题流传。

10.1111/iere.70048.abstract: Motivated by the substantial growth and upfront investments of venture capital (VC)-backed firms observed in administrative US Census data, this study develops a life-cycle firm dynamics model. In the model, startups choose the source of financing from VC, angel investors, or banks, depending on their growth potential, and invest in innovation. The calibrated model explains the life-cycle dynamics of firms with different sources of financing and suggests that venture capitalists' managerial advice accounts for around 22% of the growth in VC-backed firms. A counterfactual economy without VC financing would experience an aggregate consumption loss of around 0.46%.
10.1111/iere.70048.abstract_zh: 受美国行政人口普查数据中风险投资（VC）支持企业显著增长及前期投资的启发，本研究构建了一个企业生命周期动态模型。在该模型中，初创企业根据其增长潜力，从风险投资、天使投资人或银行中选择融资来源，并进行创新投资。校准后的模型解释了不同融资来源企业的生命周期动态，并表明风险投资家的管理建议约占风险投资支持企业增长的22%。一个没有风险投资融资的反事实经济将遭受约0.46%的总消费损失。

10.1111/iere.70050.abstract: We study the identification and estimation of large network games in which individuals choose continuous actions while holding private information about their links and payoffs. Extending the framework of Galeotti et al., we build a tractable empirical model of such network games and show that the parameters in individual payoffs are identified under large-market asymptotics in which the number of individuals increases to infinity on a single large network. We then propose a semiparametric two-step M-estimator for these individual payoffs and demonstrate its good finite-sample performance in simulations.
10.1111/iere.70050.abstract_zh: 我们研究大型网络博弈的识别与估计问题，其中个体在持有关于其链接和收益的私人信息时选择连续行动。通过扩展Galeotti等人的框架，我们构建了此类网络博弈的一个易于处理的实证模型，并证明在大型市场渐近性下，即个体数量在单一大型网络上趋于无穷时，个体收益中的参数是可识别的。随后，我们提出了一种半参数两步M估计量来估计这些个体收益，并通过模拟展示了其在有限样本中的良好表现。

10.1111/iere.70051.abstract: This paper develops a model of platform liability for ex post compensation of consumer harm caused by third-party sellers. A platform chooses how liability is shared with sellers, but assumes no liability because it reduces sellers' safety investments. Mandated platform liability can increase or decrease consumer surplus: it is more likely to be beneficial when the platform has weak market power or faces competition, but less so when it sells first-party goods or third-party sellers are judgment-proof. When the platform invests in screening judgment-proof sellers, liability regulation encourages investment, increasing welfare gains. Regulations targeting only incumbents may deter platform entry.
10.1111/iere.70051.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个平台责任模型，旨在对第三方卖家造成的消费者损害进行事后补偿。平台选择如何与卖家分担责任，但因其会降低卖家的安全投入而不承担任何责任。强制平台责任可能增加或减少消费者剩余：当平台市场力量较弱或面临竞争时，更可能有益；但当平台销售自营商品或第三方卖家无力偿债时，则效果减弱。当平台投资于筛选无力偿债的卖家时，责任监管会鼓励此类投资，从而增加福利收益。仅针对现有企业的监管可能阻碍平台进入。

10.1111/iere.70052.abstract: Flexible repayment benefits borrowers, but practitioners fear increased moral hazard. Investigating their concerns requires disentangling repayment choices from repayment capacity, which is typically infeasible in field studies. We use a lab-in-the-field experiment with 645 microcredit borrowers to cleanly identify the effect of repayment flexibility on moral hazard. We also quantify social pressure. Payoff maximization predicts low repayment in our rigid benchmark contract, and increased repayment with flexibility. Results suggest the opposite: Repayment in the rigid contract is high, and drops substantially under flexible repayment. Social pressure decreases. Our results are consistent with a strong social norm for repayment, which is weakened by introducing flexibility. Norms, which may be inculcated by the lender, may help explain several recent puzzles in microfinance research, including high and equal repayment rates across individual- and joint-liability contracts, and excessive peer pressure. Importantly, norm-driven behavior may erode with the introduction of flexibility.
10.1111/iere.70052.abstract_zh: 灵活还款对借款人有利，但从业者担忧其可能加剧道德风险。探究这些担忧需将还款选择与还款能力区分开来，而这在实地研究中通常难以实现。我们通过一项包含645名微型信贷借款人的实验室实地实验，清晰识别了还款灵活性对道德风险的影响，并量化了社会压力。支付最大化预测在刚性基准合同下还款率低，而灵活性增加则还款率上升。然而，结果却相反：刚性合同下还款率高，而灵活还款下还款率显著下降，社会压力亦随之减弱。我们的结果与强烈的还款社会规范相一致，而灵活性的引入削弱了这一规范。这些规范可能由贷方灌输，有助于解释微型金融研究中的几个近期谜团，包括个人责任与连带责任合同下高且相等的还款率，以及过度的同伴压力。重要的是，规范驱动的行为可能随灵活性的引入而逐渐侵蚀。

10.1111/iere.70053.abstract: This paper documents that households with higher marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) consume goods with more flexible prices. Consequently, they face more cyclical and volatile inflation, and experience higher inflation following expansionary monetary policy shocks. We embed this MPC-price stickiness relationship into a tractable multi-sector two-agent New Keynesian (TANK) model and show that it dampens monetary policy effectiveness by about 15% relative to a homogeneous-basket benchmark. Introducing heterogeneous consumption baskets also generates an inefficient flexible-price equilibrium, leading to a novel trade-off between stabilization and redistribution, which alters the optimal monetary policy prescription.
10.1111/iere.70053.abstract_zh: 本文档记录了边际消费倾向（MPCs）较高的家庭消费价格更为灵活的商品。因此，他们面临更具周期性和波动性的通胀，并在扩张性货币政策冲击后经历更高的通胀。我们将这种MPC-价格粘性关系嵌入一个易于处理的多部门双主体新凯恩斯（TANK）模型中，并表明相对于同质篮子基准，这使货币政策有效性减弱了约15%。引入异质性消费篮子还产生了低效的灵活价格均衡，导致稳定与再分配之间出现新的权衡，从而改变了最优货币政策处方。

10.1111/iere.70054.abstract: How do rental investors affect housing price dynamics? I develop a search model that allows housing owners to invest in rental housing. The model matches the high investor share and housing price increase observed in a housing boom in Oslo, Norway, while featuring increasing price-to-rent, and correlation of the buy-to-let share with housing price growth. In the model, an exogenous shock to population inflow increases demand for both owned and rented housing. Increased rental demand induces more buy-to-let investors to enter the market, adding extra demand to the housing market. Search frictions are important to explain an increasing price-to-rent ratio.
10.1111/iere.70054.abstract_zh: 租赁投资者如何影响房价动态？我构建了一个允许住房所有者投资于租赁住房的搜寻模型。该模型与挪威奥斯陆住房繁荣期间观察到的高投资者占比和房价上涨现象相吻合，同时呈现出房价租金比上升以及购房出租份额与房价增长之间的相关性。在模型中，人口流入的外生冲击增加了对自有住房和租赁住房的需求。租赁需求的增加促使更多购房出租投资者进入市场，为住房市场增添了额外需求。搜寻摩擦对于解释房价租金比上升至关重要。

10.1111/iere.70056.abstract: We examine a two-stage selling mechanism design problem, where the buyer makes her report and the seller endogenously decides his effort (hidden investment) to generate a possibly better outside offer. The optimal mechanism shows that the seller's effort depends on the reported value of the buyer; a higher value lowers the seller's incentive to invest in the outside offer. After the price of the outside offer is realized, if the buyer's virtual value is less than the price, the seller takes the outside offer, and a termination fee equal to the virtual value is paid to the buyer.
10.1111/iere.70056.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个两阶段销售机制设计问题，其中买方进行报告，卖方内生地决定其努力（隐性投资）以可能产生更优的外部报价。最优机制表明，卖方的努力取决于买方报告的价值；较高的价值会降低卖方投资于外部报价的激励。当外部报价的价格实现后，如果买方的虚拟价值低于该价格，卖方将接受外部报价，并向买方支付相当于虚拟价值的终止费用。

10.1111/iere.70058.abstract: To better understand the structure and core mechanisms of a broad class of climate-growth models, we study a simplified version of the dynamic integrated model of climate and the economy (DICE) through the lens of growth theory. We analytically show that this model features a continuum of saddle-point stable steady states. Initial conditions of stock variables, which are notoriously difficult to calibrate, matter for long-run economic and climate outcomes. However, we also demonstrate that a misspecified initial stock of capital has a significantly smaller impact than a misspecified initial CO2 stock. These insights have important implications for the consequences of delayed climate policy implementation and the optimal carbon tax. Using a calibrated version of the model, solved numerically for the big transition, we show that postponing optimal climate policy raises both peak temperature and the steady-state temperature. The findings extend to a large set of analytical and numerical integrated assessment models. The simple DICE, augmented by the finite amplitude impulse-response (FAIR) carbon cycle model, exhibits a continuum of steady states over time horizons spanning several centuries. Peak and long-run temperatures depend on initial conditions, a result that is also confirmed for DICE-2023. We further show that the social cost of carbon to GDP ratio is largely constant despite transitional dynamics; however, its level depends on the timing of optimal policy implementation.
10.1111/iere.70058.abstract_zh: 为深入理解一类广泛的气候-增长模型的结构与核心机制，我们通过增长理论的视角，研究了一个简化版的气候与经济动态综合模型（DICE）。我们分析性地证明，该模型具有连续统的鞍点稳定稳态。存量变量的初始条件，这些通常难以校准的因素，对长期经济与气候结果具有重要影响。然而，我们也展示了，初始资本存量的错误设定对结果的影响显著小于初始CO2存量的错误设定。这些见解对延迟气候政策实施的后果及最优碳税具有重要启示。利用模型的校准版本，通过数值求解大转型过程，我们表明，推迟最优气候政策会同时提高峰值温度和稳态温度。这些发现可推广至大量分析性和数值性的综合评估模型。简单DICE模型，辅以有限振幅脉冲响应（FAIR）碳循环模型，在跨越数个世纪的时间范围内展现出连续统的稳态。峰值温度和长期温度依赖于初始条件，这一结果在DICE-2023中也得到了证实。我们进一步表明，尽管存在转型动态，碳的社会成本与GDP之比大体保持恒定；然而，其水平取决于最优政策实施的时间安排。

10.1111/iere.70059.abstract: This paper investigates strategic dynamics under the behavioral rule of pairwise interact and imitate (PII), which requires minimal information and emphasizes outperforming opponents in pairwise interactions. We characterize PII using weak tournament graphs and, for a broad class of dynamics, establish a one-shot stability result for stochastic stability. Applications include Cournot competition, strategic complements and substitutes, externalities, Nash demand games, and status-seeking contests. The analysis highlights the competing roles of spite effects and perturbations in favoring relative success versus efficiency.
10.1111/iere.70059.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在“两两互动与模仿”（PII）行为规则下的策略动态，该规则要求最少的信息，并强调在两两互动中超越对手。我们利用弱锦标赛图来刻画PII，并针对一类广泛的动态，建立了随机稳定性的单次稳定性结果。应用领域包括古诺竞争、策略互补与替代、外部性、纳什需求博弈以及地位追求竞赛。分析凸显了恶意效应与扰动在偏好相对成功与效率之间的竞争性作用。

10.1111/iere.70060.abstract: Proof-of-Work cryptocurrencies employ miners to sustain the system through algorithmic reward adjustments. We develop a stochastic model of the multicurrency mining and identify conditions for stable transaction speeds. Bitcoin's algorithm requires hash supply elasticity <
10.1111/iere.70060.abstract_zh: 工作量证明加密货币通过算法奖励调整来维持系统运行，依赖矿工参与。我们构建了一个多币种挖矿的随机模型，并确定了交易速度稳定的条件。比特币的算法要求哈希供给弹性小于

10.1111/iere.70061.abstract: In the United States, workers must satisfy two requirements to receive unemployment insurance (UI): a tenure requirement of a minimum work spell and a monetary requirement of past minimum earnings. Using discontinuity of UI rules at state borders, we find that both requirements reduce unemployment and that the monetary requirement decreases the number of employers and the share of part-time workers, while the tenure requirement has the opposite effect. We develop a heterogeneous agents model with history-dependent UI benefits to explain these results and quantify an optimal utilitarian UI design. The optimal policy has a high monetary and a short tenure requirement.
10.1111/iere.70061.abstract_zh: 在美国，工人必须满足两项要求才能领取失业保险（UI）：一项是最低工作期限的任职要求，另一项是过去最低收入的经济要求。利用州界处失业保险规则的不连续性，我们发现这两项要求均降低了失业率，且经济要求减少了雇主数量及兼职工作者比例，而任职要求则产生相反效果。我们构建了一个具有历史依赖型失业保险福利的异质性主体模型，以解释这些结果并量化最优功利主义失业保险设计。最优政策包含较高的经济要求和较短的任职要求。

10.1111/iere.70062.abstract: We document that 11 percent of recent U.S. high school graduates did not apply for federal student aid due to difficulty in applying, mistaken beliefs, or lack of awareness. Not applying due to such application frictions negatively predicts college enrollment after controlling for other attributes. We represent application frictions as heterogeneous filing costs in a general equilibrium life cycle model of college enrollment. We find that eliminating these frictions generates modest gains on average because less than half of those affected would ultimately utilize aid. However, welfare gains are large for the affected few with high skill and poor parents.
10.1111/iere.70062.abstract_zh: 我们记录到，近期美国高中毕业生中有11%因申请困难、误解或缺乏了解而未申请联邦学生资助。在控制其他特征后，因这类申请摩擦而未申请的行为对大学入学率有负面预测作用。我们将申请摩擦表示为大学入学一般均衡生命周期模型中的异质性申报成本。研究发现，消除这些摩擦平均而言仅带来适度收益，因为受影响者中不到一半最终会利用资助。然而，对于少数技能高且父母贫困的受影响个体，福利收益显著。

10.1111/iere.70063.abstract: Using a nonlinear VAR, we examine the asymmetric effects of shocks to long-run inflation expectations. Negative shocks, which temporarily lower long-run inflation expectations, have a stronger and more persistent impact on output, investment, and firm entry compared to positive shocks. We provide a novel theoretical explanation, demonstrating how these shocks influence the second-order components of the model, shaping firms' “wait-and-see” behavior—particularly along both the intensive and extensive margins of the investment channel.
10.1111/iere.70063.abstract_zh: 利用非线性VAR模型，我们考察了长期通胀预期冲击的非对称效应。相较于正向冲击，负向冲击虽暂时降低长期通胀预期，但对产出、投资及企业进入的影响更为强劲且持久。我们提出了一种新颖的理论解释，展示了这些冲击如何作用于模型的二阶成分，塑造企业的“观望”行为——尤其是在投资渠道的集约边际与扩展边际上。

10.1111/iere.70064.abstract: Heterogeneous agent incomplete markets models offer a new perspective on price and inflation determination. In contrast to complete markets, the price level is determined from the asset‐market clearing condition. Fiscal and monetary policy then jointly and uniquely determine the finite steady‐state price level and the inflation rate, including in a steady state in which the nominal interest rate is constant. Fiscal policy can determine the long‐run inflation rate for a fiscal rule which sets the growth rate of nominal government debt, whereas both fiscal and monetary policy determine the long‐run inflation rate under different tax rules.
10.1111/iere.70064.abstract_zh: 异质性主体不完全市场模型为价格与通胀决定提供了新视角。与完全市场不同，价格水平由资产市场出清条件决定。财政与货币政策共同且唯一地决定了有限稳态价格水平与通胀率，包括名义利率保持不变的稳态情形。在设定名义政府债务增长率的财政规则下，财政政策可决定长期通胀率；而在不同税收规则下，财政与货币政策共同决定长期通胀率。
10.1111/iere.70064.title: A Demand Theory of the Price Level

10.1111/iere.70066.abstract: We study a signaling game where agents signal their type by choosing when to quit pursuing an uncertain project. High types observe news about project quality and quit when bad news arrives. Low types who do not observe any news may mimic high types by quitting continuously over a phase of time. The reputation dynamics may exhibit nonmonotonicity with respect to quitting time. Our analysis offers a unifying explanation for how and when both early and late quitting can enhance reputation and suggests novel welfare and policy implications.
10.1111/iere.70066.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个信号博弈模型，其中代理人通过选择何时放弃追求不确定项目来传递其类型信号。高类型者能观察到关于项目质量的新闻，并在坏消息到来时退出。未观察到任何新闻的低类型者可能通过在一段时间内持续退出，模仿高类型者的行为。声誉动态可能随退出时间呈现非单调性。我们的分析为早期和晚期退出如何及何时能提升声誉提供了统一的解释，并提出了新颖的福利与政策含义。

10.1111/iere.70067.abstract: We document how childcare costs and the location of extended family influence the labor supply and mobility of US women. Women return to their home locations immediately before fertility events, suggesting that informal childcare needs may motivate home migration. Women who live near their parents have lower child earnings penalties. We then build a model of labor supply and migration to assess the impacts of childcare subsidies. Childcare subsidies increase earnings and mobility among US women and ignoring migration can understate the welfare benefits of these policies, especially for college-educated women and those whose parents' locations have poor amenities.
10.1111/iere.70067.abstract_zh: 我们记录了育儿成本及大家庭地理位置如何影响美国女性的劳动供给与流动性。女性在生育事件前夕返回原籍地，这表明非正式育儿需求可能促使返乡迁移。居住于父母附近的女性，其子女带来的收入惩罚较低。随后，我们构建了一个劳动供给与迁移模型，以评估育儿补贴的影响。育儿补贴提升了美国女性的收入与流动性，而忽视迁移因素可能会低估这些政策的福利效益，尤其是对受过大学教育的女性及父母所在地环境条件较差的女性而言。

10.1111/iere.70068.abstract: We establish connections between dynamic mode decompositions (DMDs), vector autoregressions, and linear state-space models, showing that DMD provides a computationally efficient, SVD-based estimator of low-rank first-order VAR projection coefficients in high-dimensional settings. When the measurement matrix has full column rank, the recovered nonzero eigenvalues coincide with those of the underlying state transition matrix. We apply DMD to a 100-household heterogeneous-agent economy with complete markets and Gorman aggregation. From high-dimensional household income and consumption panels, DMD recovers latent aggregate dynamics, and cross-sectional loadings reveal the sharing rule governing redistribution, demonstrating DMD's capacity to extract economically meaningful structure from microeconomic panels.
10.1111/iere.70068.abstract_zh: 我们建立了动态模式分解（DMDs）、向量自回归与线性状态空间模型之间的联系，表明在高维设定下，DMD提供了一种基于SVD的计算高效的低秩一阶VAR投影系数估计器。当测量矩阵具有满列秩时，恢复的非零特征值与底层状态转移矩阵的特征值一致。我们将DMD应用于一个包含100个家庭、具有完全市场和高尔曼聚合的异质性主体经济模型。从高维家庭收入与消费面板数据中，DMD恢复了潜在的总体动态，而横截面载荷揭示了支配再分配的共享规则，展示了DMD从微观经济面板中提取经济上有意义结构的能力。

10.1111/iere.70069.abstract: Economists have long studied how parental behavior shapes within-family inequality, yet empirical findings remain mixed. Using twins data from China and Sweden, we examine the predominant mechanisms reported in the literature. Parents in both countries invest similarly during childhood. Inter vivos transfers, however, differ: Chinese parents reinforce income inequality, whereas Swedish parents distribute wealth equally; the reinforcing pattern reflects exchange motives. Bequests are divided equally in both countries. Parental education plays a key role: less educated parents reinforce income inequality, whereas more educated parents transfer wealth equally. Cross-country differences in parental education may thus help explain the mixed findings.
10.1111/iere.70069.abstract_zh: 经济学家长期研究父母行为如何塑造家庭内部不平等，但实证结果仍不一致。利用中国和瑞典的双胞胎数据，我们考察了文献中报告的主要机制。两国的父母在子女童年时期的投资相似。然而，生前转移存在差异：中国父母加剧收入不平等，而瑞典父母则平均分配财富；这种加剧模式反映了交换动机。两国在遗产分配上均采取均分方式。父母教育水平起着关键作用：教育程度较低的父母加剧收入不平等，而教育程度较高的父母则平均转移财富。因此，跨国父母教育差异可能有助于解释这些不一致的研究发现。

10.1111/iere.70070.abstract: We study the evolution of China's production and trade patterns during its integration into the global economy. Using firm-level microdata, we document how production and exports shifted across industries and within industries across firms. We quantify a Ricardian–Heckscher–Ohlin model with heterogeneous firms to account for these changes. Counterfactuals show capital deepening pushed China's production and exports toward greater capital intensity, while labor-biased productivity growth provided an offsetting force. The model generates an inverted-U pattern in China's trade openness—peaking in the mid-2000s and declining through the 2020s—alongside a continuous rise in the world's exposure to Chinese exports.
10.1111/iere.70070.abstract_zh: 我们研究中国融入全球经济过程中生产与贸易模式的演变。利用企业层面的微观数据，我们记录了生产与出口如何在行业间及行业内企业间发生转移。我们量化了一个包含异质性企业的李嘉图-赫克歇尔-俄林模型，以解释这些变化。反事实分析显示，资本深化推动中国的生产与出口向更高资本密集度方向发展，而偏向劳动力的生产率增长则提供了抵消力量。该模型呈现出中国贸易开放度的倒U型模式——在2000年代中期达到顶峰，并在2020年代持续下降——同时世界对中国出口的暴露度持续上升。

10.1111/iere.70071.abstract: I study a novel two‐way feedback between credit and labor market frictions. Running from credit to labor markets, amplitude in capital demand caused by collateral constraints spills over onto labor demand due to the complementarity of capital and labor; and, furthermore, credit frictions raise effective financial hiring costs, prompting firms to delay hiring in recessions. Running back from labor to credit markets, search frictions imply that wages move less than one‐to‐one with productivity; this induces greater volatility of net worth, via the wage bill, which then spills over onto capital demand. Together, these considerably amplify labor and capital market dynamics.
10.1111/iere.70071.abstract_zh: 本文研究信贷摩擦与劳动力市场摩擦之间一种新颖的双向反馈机制。从信贷市场向劳动力市场的传导路径中，抵押约束引发的资本需求波动会通过资本与劳动的互补性溢出至劳动力需求；此外，信贷摩擦提高了有效金融雇佣成本，促使企业在经济衰退期延迟招聘。从劳动力市场向信贷市场的反向传导路径中，搜寻摩擦导致工资变动幅度小于生产率变动幅度，这通过工资账单渠道加剧了净值的波动性，进而溢出至资本需求。两种机制共同作用，显著放大了劳动力市场与资本市场的动态波动。
10.1111/iere.70071.title: The Interaction Between Credit and Labor Market Frictions
10.1111/iere.70071.title_zh: 信贷与劳动力市场摩擦的相互作用

10.1111/iere.70072.abstract: We investigate a land policy in China that allocated more urban land quotas to underdeveloped regions to reduce regional gaps. Empirically, the policy decreased productivity in eastern areas relative to the inland. A spatial equilibrium model with migration, land quota constraints, and agglomeration shows the policy distorts labor and production across regions, causing substantial output losses. Though regional gaps narrowed, workers from underdeveloped areas migrated less and earned less. Without the policy, national output would have been 1.8% higher, and workers in underdeveloped areas would have earned 1.6% more in 2010. Regional transfers offer a less distortionary alternative for reducing inequality.
10.1111/iere.70072.abstract_zh: 我们研究了中国一项旨在通过向欠发达地区分配更多城市土地配额以缩小区域差距的土地政策。实证结果显示，该政策降低了东部地区相对于内陆地区的生产率。一个包含迁移、土地配额约束及集聚效应的空间均衡模型表明，该政策扭曲了区域间的劳动力与生产配置，导致了显著的产出损失。尽管区域差距有所缩小，但欠发达地区的工人迁移减少且收入降低。若无此政策，2010年全国产出将高出1.8%，欠发达地区工人的收入将增加1.6%。区域转移支付为缩小不平等提供了一种扭曲程度较低的替代方案。

10.1111/iere.70073.abstract: From 2006 until 2020, the probability of selling a house in the U.S. declined sharply after listing for 2 weeks. Moreover, sales within the first 2 weeks of listing (“quick sales”) and sales happening afterward (“slow sales”) behaved differently over the housing cycle. The probability and associated price of a quick sale recovered from the slump sooner, faster, and more prominently than a slow sale. This paper demonstrates that a calibrated stock-flow matching model not only generates quantitatively consistent sales, prices, listings, and time on the market but also captures distinctions between fast and slow sales over the housing cycle.
10.1111/iere.70073.abstract_zh: 从2006年至2020年，美国房屋挂牌两周后售出的概率急剧下降。此外，挂牌后两周内售出（“快速销售”）与之后售出（“慢速销售”）在房地产周期中的表现存在差异。快速销售的概率及其相关价格从低谷中恢复得更早、更快且更为显著，相比之下慢速销售则不然。本文证明，一个校准的存量-流量匹配模型不仅能在数量上生成一致的销售量、价格、挂牌量及市场停留时间，还能捕捉住房周期中快速与慢速销售之间的差异。

10.1111/iere.70075.abstract: We examine the decentralization of liquor policies in Texas during the Post-Prohibition era using newly collected historical legislative roll call data. By combining these data with local referendum vote shares, we analyze both legislators' and constituents' preferences on liquor policy. We develop a probabilistic voting model incorporating spillovers and peer effects. Results reveal substantial heterogeneity in preferences among voters, reflecting differing attitudes toward alcohol regulation. Spillover effects are significant, yet the model predicts notable gains from decentralization. Finally, we link legislators' policy preferences to alcohol consumption data and compare model-based welfare estimates with traditional consumption-based measures.
10.1111/iere.70075.abstract_zh: 我们利用新收集的历史立法唱名表决数据，考察了禁酒令后时期得克萨斯州酒类政策的权力下放情况。通过将这些数据与地方公投投票份额相结合，我们分析了立法者与选民在酒类政策上的偏好。我们构建了一个包含溢出效应和同伴效应的概率投票模型。结果显示，选民偏好存在显著异质性，反映了对酒精监管的不同态度。溢出效应显著，但模型预测权力下放能带来显著收益。最后，我们将立法者的政策偏好与酒精消费数据相关联，并比较了基于模型的福利估计与传统基于消费的衡量指标。

10.1111/iere.70076.abstract: How does the targeting of personal income tax cuts affect the output multiplier? This paper provides quantitative evidence using a heterogeneous-agent New-Keynesian model calibrated to match US distributions of income, wealth, marginal tax rates, and marginal propensities to consume. Labor supply is determined by household preferences on the intensive margin and search frictions on the extensive margin. The model evaluates tax cuts for the bottom-90 (B90%) and top-10% of the income distribution in national and cross-region settings, replicating influential empirical research designs. B90 tax cuts generate larger output effects while incentive effects play a central role in transmission.
10.1111/iere.70076.abstract_zh: 个人所得税减税的目标定位如何影响产出乘数？本文利用一个校准至美国收入、财富、边际税率及边际消费倾向分布的异质性主体新凯恩斯模型，提供了量化证据。劳动供给由家庭在集约边际上的偏好和扩展边际上的搜寻摩擦共同决定。该模型评估了针对收入分布底部90%（B90%）和顶部10%的减税措施，在国家和跨区域情境下的效应，并复现了具有影响力的实证研究设计。B90减税产生更大的产出效应，而激励效应在传导过程中发挥核心作用。

10.1111/iere.70077.abstract: We embed labor market monopsony into a dynamic heterogeneous-firm general equilibrium model with exporting, horizontal FDI, and rich firm lifecycle dynamics. Rising marginal costs with monopsony slow and limit incumbent firm growth in response to liberalization, shifting adjustment to the extensive margin. Calibrated to US micro data, welfare gains from tariff reduction are over four times larger under monopsony than with perfect labor markets. The difference is mostly driven by new exporter creation and firm entry along the transition path. By contrast, lowering outward FDI taxes gives powerful quantitative welfare losses under monopsony, as firms undertake FDI to escape domestic wage pressure.
10.1111/iere.70077.abstract_zh: 我们将劳动力市场买方垄断嵌入一个包含出口、水平型外商直接投资及丰富企业生命周期动态的异质性企业一般均衡模型中。买方垄断下边际成本的上升减缓并限制了在位企业应对自由化的增长，将调整转向广延边际。以美国微观数据校准后，买方垄断情形下关税削减带来的福利收益是劳动力市场完全竞争情形下的四倍以上。这一差异主要源于转型路径上新出口商的创建与企业进入。相比之下，在买方垄断下降低对外直接投资税则带来显著的量化福利损失，因为企业通过对外直接投资以规避国内工资压力。

10.1111/iere.70078.abstract: We investigate whether different criteria are used in evaluating male and female leaders when outcomes are determined by unobservable choices and luck. Evaluators form beliefs about leaders’ choices (perceived intentions) and make discretionary payments. We find that while payments to male leaders are determined by both outcomes and perceived intentions, those to female leaders are determined by outcomes only. We label this new source of gender bias as the gender criteria gap . Our findings imply that high outcomes are necessary for women to get bonuses, but men can receive bonuses for low outcomes if evaluators hold them in high regard.
10.1111/iere.70078.abstract_zh: 我们研究了当结果由不可观测的选择和运气决定时，评价男性与女性领导者是否采用不同标准。评价者会形成对领导者选择（感知意图）的信念，并据此进行酌情支付。研究发现，男性领导者的薪酬由结果和感知意图共同决定，而女性领导者的薪酬仅由结果决定。我们将这种新的性别偏见来源称为"性别标准差异"。研究结果表明，高绩效是女性获得奖金的必要条件，但若评价者对男性评价较高，即使其绩效较低，男性仍可获得奖金。
10.1111/iere.70078.title: Gender Criteria Gap in Evaluation: Role of Perceived Intentions and Outcomes
10.1111/iere.70078.title_zh: 评价中的性别标准差距：感知意图与结果的作用

10.1111/iere.70079.abstract: We analyze market entry efficiency in single‐ and two‐sector closed‐economy Melitz–Ottaviano (MO) models without an outside good. Comparing market and second‐best outcomes, we find that market entry is efficient in the single‐sector model. This efficiency also holds in a symmetric two‐sector setting. When sectors have asymmetric demand and the level of asymmetry is sufficiently small, the market yields excessive entry into the “high‐demand” sector. This inefficiency arises from the presence of an additional aggregator in MO preferences.
10.1111/iere.70079.abstract_zh: 本文分析了无外部商品的单部门与两部门封闭经济Melitz–Ottaviano（MO）模型中的市场进入效率。通过比较市场结果与次优结果，我们发现单部门模型中的市场进入是有效的。这一有效性在对称的两部门设定中同样成立。当部门间存在非对称需求且非对称程度足够小时，市场会导致“高需求”部门出现过度进入。这种无效率源于MO偏好中额外加总因子的存在。
10.1111/iere.70079.title: Entry and Welfare in General Equilibrium With Heterogeneous Firms and Endogenous Markups
10.1111/iere.70079.title_zh: 异质性企业与内生加成定价下的一般均衡进入与福利

10.1111/iere.70080.abstract: College loans facilitate access to education, but the repayment burden may distort posteducation human capital investment. We examine the role of college loans and loan repayment policies through a structural model of individuals' dynamic decisions on borrowing/saving, labor supply, and costly human capital investment. We estimate two versions of the model using data from NLSY79: one with natural borrowing limits and another with parameterized limits. Counterfactual simulations suggest that, relative to the standard fixed repayment plan, income‐driven repayment (IDR) plans modestly increase educational attainment, lifetime earnings, and individual welfare; accounting for lifetime income taxes, they also increase government revenue.
10.1111/iere.70080.abstract_zh: 大学贷款有助于促进教育机会获取，但还款负担可能扭曲毕业后的教育人力资本投资。我们通过构建个体在借贷/储蓄、劳动供给及有成本人力资本投资方面的动态决策结构模型，考察了大学贷款及贷款还款政策的作用机制。基于NLSY79数据，我们估计了两种模型版本：一种采用自然借贷约束，另一种采用参数化约束。反事实模拟表明，相较于标准固定还款计划，收入驱动型还款计划能适度提升教育成就、终身收入及个人福利；在考虑终身所得税后，该计划还能增加政府财政收入。
10.1111/iere.70080.title: College Loans and Human Capital Investment
10.1111/iere.70080.title_zh: 大学贷款与人力资本投资

10.1111/iere.70081.abstract: We develop a structural framework to identify the sources of cross‐state heterogeneity in response to U.S. tariff changes. A unilateral 25‐percentage‐point U.S. tariff increase across sectors induces consumption changes ranging from −0.8% in Oregon to 2.3% in Montana. This variation stems from the interaction between states' internal comparative advantage and the nation's external comparative advantage. Factor mobility lowers aggregate consumption and reshapes the cross‐state impacts by shifting resources toward more distorted states and sectors. Consequently, preferred tariff changes vary systematically across states, necessitating transfers to align regional policy incentives. Foreign retaliation reduces aggregate gains while perpetuating cross‐state variation.
10.1111/iere.70081.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个结构性框架，用以识别美国关税变化中各州异质性反应的来源。若美国对各行业统一加征25个百分点的关税，各州消费变化幅度从俄勒冈州的-0.8%到蒙大拿州的2.3%不等。这种差异源于各州内部比较优势与国家外部比较优势之间的相互作用。要素流动性通过将资源向扭曲程度更高的州和行业转移，降低了总体消费水平并重塑了跨州影响。因此，各州偏好的关税变化呈现系统性差异，需要通过转移支付来协调区域政策激励。外国报复性措施在减少总体收益的同时，进一步加剧了跨州差异。
10.1111/iere.70081.title: What Determines State Heterogeneity in Response to U.S. Tariff Changes?
10.1111/iere.70081.title_zh: 美国关税变化下各州异质性反应的决定因素是什么？

10.1111/iere.70082.abstract: We develop a rational, Walrasian model of speculative bubbles inspired by the Kindleberger–Minsky view, which describes bubbles as wave‐like market processes. Touched off by an initial shock, price booms are initially self‐reinforcing but become self‐destructive later when prices surpass fundamental value. Previous models in this vein have been criticized due to ad hoc features, such as prices driven by behavioral forces or particular trading protocols. Our model allays these concerns by relying only on multidimensional uncertainty to prevent unraveling via backward induction. Standard market clearing, moreover, makes the model more compatible with established macroeconomic and asset pricing frameworks.
10.1111/iere.70082.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个受金德尔伯格-明斯基观点启发的理性瓦尔拉斯投机泡沫模型，该模型将泡沫描述为波浪式的市场过程。在初始冲击触发下，价格繁荣初期呈现自我强化特征，但当价格超越基本面价值后则转向自我毁灭。此前同类模型因依赖行为因素驱动价格或特定交易规则等特设性设定而受到批评。我们的模型仅通过多维不确定性来防止逆向归纳导致的泡沫瓦解，从而缓解了这些担忧。此外，标准市场出清机制使该模型与既有的宏观经济和资产定价框架更具兼容性。
10.1111/iere.70082.title: Rational Expectations Fools' Bubbles

10.1111/iere.70083.abstract: We study social security reforms in economies with segmented labor markets and pension systems. We develop a life‐cycle general equilibrium model with heterogeneous agents and endogenous retirement and sectoral choice across public, formal, and informal jobs. Calibrated to Brazil, the model shows that unifying pension systems and raising the minimum retirement age reduce the pension deficit by nearly 40 percent, while increasing output, capital accumulation, and welfare, despite redistributive effects across age groups, sectors, and along the transition path. Sectoral reallocation plays a central role in shaping reform effects, and ignoring these margins substantially underestimates the macroeconomic consequences of pension reforms.
10.1111/iere.70083.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在劳动力市场与养老金体系存在分割的经济体中实施社会保障改革的效果。我们构建了一个包含异质性主体、内生退休决策以及公共部门、正规部门与非正规部门间职业选择的生命周期一般均衡模型。基于巴西数据的校准结果显示：统一养老金体系并提高最低退休年龄可使养老金赤字降低近40%，同时提升产出、资本积累与社会福利水平——尽管这一过程伴随着不同年龄群体、不同部门以及转型路径上的再分配效应。部门间重新配置在塑造改革效果中发挥核心作用，若忽略这些调整维度，将显著低估养老金改革的宏观经济影响。
10.1111/iere.70083.title: Social Security Reforms, Retirement, and Sectoral Decisions
10.1111/iere.70083.title_zh: 社会保障改革、退休与部门决策

10.1111/iere.70084.abstract: We quantitatively analyze the impact of US banking deregulation in the 1980s on the aggregate economy. Using recent econometric techniques, we first reexamine existing empirical evidence on the real effects of banking deregulation. We then construct a quantitative model that integrates imperfectly competitive banks into a general equilibrium framework of firm dynamics and occupational choice. Consistent with the empirical evidence, deregulation significantly increases output growth and firm entry. Increased competition among banks and the entrepreneurs' occupational choices play an important role in shaping the economy's response to deregulation.
10.1111/iere.70084.abstract_zh: 本文定量分析了20世纪80年代美国银行业放松管制对总体经济的影响。利用最新的计量经济学方法，我们首先重新审视了关于银行业放松管制实际效应的现有实证证据。随后，我们构建了一个将不完全竞争银行纳入企业动态与职业选择一般均衡框架的定量模型。与实证证据一致，放松管制显著提升了产出增长与企业进入率。银行间竞争的加剧以及企业家的职业选择在塑造经济对放松管制的反应中发挥了关键作用。
10.1111/iere.70084.title: Entrepreneurship and Financial Deregulation

10.1111/iere.70085.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper rationalizes the adoption of a complementary currency (CC) in a small, local economy. A local money shortage occurs when the supply of official currency, determined endogenously by trade with a larger economy, falls short of the liquidity needed for first‐best activity. A CC then supplements liquidity and boosts local trade at the expense of external trade; the welfare‐maximizing CC supply is strictly positive.
