A calibration to coca‐growing villages in Colombia, where coca‐base circulates as a local CC, suggests its liquidity role raises local trade by roughly a third.</jats:p>
10.1111/iere.70085.abstract_zh: 本文对小型地方经济中采用补充货币（CC）的行为进行了理性阐释。当由与较大经济体贸易内生决定的官方货币供给，不足以支撑最优经济活动所需的流动性时，便会出现地方性货币短缺。此时，补充货币可补充流动性，并在减少外部贸易的同时促进地方贸易；福利最大化的补充货币供给严格为正。通过对哥伦比亚古柯种植村庄（当地以古柯碱作为补充货币流通）进行校准分析，结果表明其流动性作用使地方贸易额提升了约三分之一。
10.1111/iere.70085.title: Money Shortages and Complementary Currencies in Small Local Economies
10.1111/iere.70085.title_zh: 小型地方经济中的货币短缺与补充货币

10.1111/iere.70086.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We quantify the role of heterogeneity in households' financial constraints in explaining the link between the decline in aggregate consumption and the decline in house values between 2006 and 2009 using individual‐level data. Constraints that are triggered by a decline in house values, and a small fraction of consumers facing particularly severe constraints prior to the decline in house values explain 76% of the aggregate response. Local general equilibrium feedback and a decline in bank credit to consumers make up the remaining 24%. We find no contribution of a pure wealth effect in explaining the consumption decline.</jats:p>
10.1111/iere.70086.abstract_zh: 我们利用个体层面数据，量化了家庭金融约束异质性在解释2006年至2009年间总消费下降与房屋价值下降之间关联中的作用。由房屋价值下降触发的约束，以及在房屋价值下降前已面临特别严重约束的一小部分消费者，解释了总消费反应的76%。局部一般均衡反馈和银行对消费者信贷的下降构成了剩余的24%。我们发现，纯财富效应在解释消费下降中并无贡献。
10.1111/iere.70086.title: Housing Wealth and Consumption: The Role of Heterogeneous Credit Constraints
10.1111/iere.70086.title_zh: 住房财富与消费：异质性信贷约束的作用

10.1111/iere.70087.abstract: ABSTRACT The gender gap in non‐agricultural employment in developing countries is concentrated among rural married workers. Within‐family specialization is central: Married women spend more time on home production, work fewer market hours, and are less likely to incur fixed costs of entering non‐agriculture. We develop a general equilibrium Roy model with joint household decisions, sector‐neutral gender labor wedges, and entry barriers. Calibrated to China in 2010, the model reproduces the observed gender employment gap. Gender labor wedges explain about 80% of it, amplified by within‐family specialization, while changing entry barriers account for its widening from 2000 to 2010.
10.1111/iere.70087.abstract_zh: 摘要 发展中国家非农就业中的性别差距主要集中在农村已婚劳动者群体。家庭内部分工是核心因素：已婚女性在家务劳动上投入更多时间，市场工作时间更少，且更不愿承担进入非农部门所需的固定成本。我们构建了一个包含联合家庭决策、部门中性性别劳动楔子及进入壁垒的一般均衡罗伊模型。基于2010年中国数据的校准结果显示，该模型能够复现观测到的性别就业差距。其中，性别劳动楔子解释了约80%的差距，并通过家庭内部分工机制被放大；而进入壁垒的变化则解释了2000年至2010年间该差距的扩大趋势。
10.1111/iere.70087.title: Home Production and Gender Gap in Structural Change
10.1111/iere.70087.title_zh: 家庭生产与结构变迁中的性别差距

10.1111/iere.70088.abstract: ABSTRACT We explore implications of social status concerns for redistribution, income inequality, and growth in a political economy framework. Salience of such concerns leads to a propagation mechanism, whereby initial income inequality and reduced willingness to redistribute income reinforce each other, potentially giving rise to multiple steady states. An extension illustrates the possibility of a high redistribution cum low inequality steady state resulting in a higher steady‐state income level. Some of the model features are shown to be consistent with empirical regularities as reflected in survey data on social status attitudes.
10.1111/iere.70088.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文在政治经济学框架下探讨社会地位关注对再分配、收入不平等及经济增长的影响。此类关注的显著性会引发一种传导机制，其中初始收入不平等与再分配意愿的降低相互强化，可能形成多重稳态。扩展分析表明，高再分配与低不平等并存的稳态可能导致更高的稳态收入水平。模型的部分特征与社会地位态度调查数据所反映的实证规律具有一致性。
10.1111/iere.70088.title: Social Status, Inequality, and Redistribution
10.1111/iere.70088.title_zh: 社会地位、不平等与再分配

10.1111/iere.70090.abstract: We study how the interaction between demographic changes and spatial sorting affects marriage matching across space. Using data from China, we first present stylized facts on the diverging spatial distribution of singlehood characterized by a high singles rate for females (males) in more (less) developed cities. We then build a quantitative spatial equilibrium model. It reveals that more highly educated women sort into the service sector in more developed cities than men. With persistent social norms of hypergamy, this results in more failed marriage matches for females (males) in more (less) developed cities, thereby lowering the national marriage rate.
10.1111/iere.70090.abstract_zh: 本文研究人口结构变化与空间分选之间的相互作用如何影响跨区域的婚姻匹配。利用中国数据，我们首先呈现了单身现象空间分布分化的典型事实：在较发达城市，女性单身率较高；而在欠发达城市，男性单身率较高。随后，我们构建了一个定量空间均衡模型。模型揭示，相较于男性，更多高学历女性倾向于在较发达城市的服务部门集聚。在持续存在的“上嫁”社会规范下，这导致较发达城市中女性婚姻匹配失败率上升，而欠发达城市中男性婚姻匹配失败率上升，进而降低了全国婚姻率。
10.1111/iere.70090.title: Sex and the City: Demographics, Spatial Sorting, and the Marriage Market
10.1111/iere.70090.title_zh: 城市与性：人口结构、空间分选与婚姻市场

10.1111/iere.70091.abstract: We show that politicians facing a binding term limit are more likely to engage in financial deliberalization than those facing reelection, but only in the wake of a financial crisis. In particular, they implement policies that tend to favor incumbent financial institutions over the general population, such as increasing barriers to entry in the banking sector. We propose a conceptual framework and several mechanisms to rationalize this behavior and show that revolving doors between the government and the financial sector play a key role in encouraging bank‐friendly policies after crises.
10.1111/iere.70091.abstract_zh: 我们表明，面临任期限制的政客比面临连任的政客更有可能实施金融去自由化，但仅在金融危机之后如此。具体而言，他们倾向于实施有利于现有金融机构而非普通民众的政策，例如提高银行业准入门槛。我们提出了一个概念框架和若干机制来解释这一行为，并表明政府与金融部门之间的旋转门在危机后鼓励亲银行政策方面发挥了关键作用。
10.1111/iere.70091.title: Political Accountability During Crises: Evidence From 40 Years of Financial Policies
10.1111/iere.70091.title_zh: 危机时期的政治问责：来自40年金融政策的证据

10.1111/iere.70092.abstract: In this paper, we study optimal prevention in the presence of a correlated nonfinancial background risk. Under positive correlation, cross‐prudence in the nonfinancial attribute reduces optimal prevention. We establish this result in the most direct extension of the standard prevention problem with binary marginal distributions and show that it extends to richer settings. Our analysis highlights a broader implication: in economically relevant cases with loss probabilities below one‐half and positive correlation, cross‐prudence emerges as an additional force that discourages prevention. As a result, optimal prevention can fall below the expected‐cost minimizing level, even when agents are risk‐averse.
10.1111/iere.70092.abstract_zh: 本文研究了存在相关非金融背景风险时的最优预防行为。在正相关条件下，非金融属性的交叉审慎性会降低最优预防水平。我们通过标准预防问题最直接的二元边际分布扩展形式确立了这一结论，并证明该结论可推广至更丰富的设定。分析揭示了一个更广泛的意义：在损失概率低于二分之一且存在正相关的经济相关情形中，交叉审慎性成为抑制预防行为的额外因素。因此，即便代理人具有风险厌恶特征，最优预防水平仍可能低于预期成本最小化水平。
10.1111/iere.70092.title: Cross‐Prudence and Optimal Prevention

10.1111/iere.70093.abstract: This study proposes a novel methodology to measure the stringency of building height regulations. This measure gauges the difference in building heights with and without regulations. The primary challenge is to recover unobserved building heights in the absence of regulations. I develop a dynamic discrete choice model of building height decision‐making by parcel owners and conduct a counterfactual experiment that removes height regulations. An application to residential buildings in central Tokyo presents three findings. Without height restrictions, the number of stories would increase by 2.7%, and housing prices would change by 3.7%. Regulatory stringency is stronger near the central area, while the static model tends to overestimate it.
10.1111/iere.70093.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种新颖的方法来衡量建筑高度管制的严格程度。该度量方法评估了有无管制情况下建筑高度的差异。主要挑战在于恢复无管制条件下未被观测到的建筑高度。我构建了一个地块所有者关于建筑高度决策的动态离散选择模型，并进行了一项反事实实验，即移除高度管制。以东京中心城区的住宅建筑为应用对象，研究得出三项发现：若无高度限制，楼层数将增加2.7%，房价将变动3.7%；管制严格程度在中心区域附近更为显著，而静态模型往往高估了这一严格程度。
10.1111/iere.70093.title: Measuring the Stringency of Building Height Regulations
10.1111/iere.70093.title_zh: 衡量建筑高度法规严格程度

10.1111/iere.70094.abstract: Larger firms feature (i) longer hours worked, (ii) higher wages, and (iii) smaller (larger) wage penalties for working long (short) hours. We reconcile these patterns in a general equilibrium model, which features the endogenous interaction of hours, wages, and firm size. In the model, workers willing to work longer hours sort into larger firms that offer a wage premium. Complementarities in hours generate wage penalties that increase with the distance from the usual hours. We use the model to argue that variation in average hours across firms contributes significantly to wage inequality.
10.1111/iere.70094.abstract_zh: 大企业具有以下特征：（i）工作时间更长，（ii）工资更高，（iii）对长时间（短时间）工作的工资惩罚更小（更大）。我们在一个一般均衡模型中调和了这些模式，该模型包含了工作时间、工资与企业规模的内生互动。在模型中，愿意工作更长时间的工人会进入提供工资溢价的大企业。工作时间上的互补性产生了工资惩罚，这些惩罚随着与常规工作时间的距离增加而增大。我们利用该模型论证，企业间平均工作时间的差异对工资不平等有显著贡献。
10.1111/iere.70094.title: Labor Supply and Firm Size
10.1111/iere.70094.title_zh: 劳动力供给与企业规模

10.1111/iere.70095.abstract: We study the impact of techies—engineers and other technically trained workers—on firm‐level productivity. We first report new facts on techies in the firm using French administrative data. Techies are STEM‐skill intensive and associated with innovation, technology adoption, management, and diffusion within firms. Using structural econometric methods, we estimate the effect of techies on firm‐level Hicks‐neutral productivity in manufacturing and nonmanufacturing. We find that techies raise productivity, and that this effect goes beyond R&D workers, extending to ICT and other techies. In nonmanufacturing firms, the impact operates mostly through ICT and other techies, not R&D workers.
10.1111/iere.70095.abstract_zh: 我们研究了技术人员——工程师及其他受过技术训练的工人——对企业层面生产率的影响。首先，我们利用法国行政数据报告了关于企业内部技术人员的新事实。技术人员高度集中于STEM技能，并与企业内部的创新、技术采纳、管理及知识扩散相关联。运用结构计量经济学方法，我们估算了技术人员对制造业和非制造业企业层面希克斯中性生产率的影响。我们发现技术人员能提升生产率，且这一效应超越了研发人员，延伸至信息技术及其他技术人员。在非制造业企业中，该影响主要通过信息技术及其他技术人员发挥作用，而非研发人员。
10.1111/iere.70095.title: Techies and Firm‐Level Productivity
10.1111/iere.70095.title_zh: 技术人员与企业生产率

10.1111/iere.70096.abstract: We study the distributional implications of uncertainty shocks by developing a model that links macroeconomic aggregates to the US distribution of earnings and consumption. Our findings suggest that the fraction of low‐earning workers decreases initially, while the share of households reporting low consumption increases. At longer horizons, the fraction of low‐income workers increases, but the consumption distribution reverts to its preshock shape. While the first phase reduces income inequality and increases consumption inequality, in the second stage income inequality rises, and the effects on consumption inequality dissipate.
10.1111/iere.70096.abstract_zh: 我们通过构建一个将宏观经济总量与美国收入与消费分布联系起来的模型，研究不确定性冲击的分配效应。研究结果表明，低收入工人比例初期下降，而报告低消费的家庭比例上升。在较长时期内，低收入工人比例增加，但消费分布恢复至冲击前形态。第一阶段降低了收入不平等并加剧了消费不平等，而第二阶段收入不平等上升，对消费不平等的影响则逐渐消散。
10.1111/iere.70096.title: The Distributional Effects of Economic Uncertainty*
10.1111/iere.70096.title_zh: 经济不确定性的分配效应

10.1111/iere.70097.abstract: The gradual rise in temperatures motivates conceptualizing climate change as a phenomenon shaping the propagation of macroeconomic shocks, rather than as an independent shock. We formalize this in a theoretical model, showing that climate change induces a structural shift by steepening the aggregate supply curve, exacerbating the price effects of demand shocks while dampening the output response. Our empirical evidence is consistent with this prediction: higher temperatures raise the share of inflation variation attributable to demand shocks by up to 10 percentage points, underscoring the role of climate change in intensifying stagflationary dynamics rather than independently driving business cycles.
10.1111/iere.70097.abstract_zh: 气温的逐步上升促使我们将气候变化概念化为一种塑造宏观经济冲击传播的现象，而非独立冲击。我们在理论模型中对此进行了形式化，表明气候变化通过使总供给曲线更加陡峭引发结构性转变，加剧了需求冲击的价格效应，同时削弱了产出响应。我们的实证证据与这一预测一致：气温升高使需求冲击导致的通胀变动份额最多增加10个百分点，凸显了气候变化在加剧滞胀动态而非独立驱动商业周期中的作用。
10.1111/iere.70097.title: Climate Change and Economic Dynamics: Temperature‐Dependent Shock Propagation
10.1111/iere.70097.title_zh: 气候变化与经济动态：温度依赖的冲击传导

10.1111/iere.70098.abstract: We present a model showing that when the demand for labor services is inelastic and individual behavior is imperfectly monitored, a firm's employees may prefer to protect its shirkers and conceal information about peers' performance from the firm.
10.1111/iere.70098.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，表明当劳动服务需求缺乏弹性且个体行为受到不完全监督时，企业的员工可能倾向于保护其偷懒者，并向企业隐瞒关于同事绩效的信息。
10.1111/iere.70098.title: Labor Associations: The Blue Wall of Silence

10.1111/iere.70099.abstract: We develop a growth model that endogenizes the occupational choice of workers with different ability levels to study how digitalization affects labor income inequality. The framework incorporates digitalization's multifaceted effects on the economy: (i) it influences economic growth through automation, and (ii) it affects labor income inequality through labor productivity (demand side) and labor time modulation (supply side). We examine how these channels influence wage inequality between skilled and unskilled workers, within each skill group, and economy‐wide. The analysis reveals that digitalization's impact on labor income inequality—whether exacerbating or mitigating disparities—depends on the inequality metric employed.
10.1111/iere.70099.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个增长模型，将不同能力水平工人的职业选择内生化，以研究数字化如何影响劳动收入不平等。该框架整合了数字化对经济的多方面效应：（i）通过自动化影响经济增长，（ii）通过劳动生产率（需求侧）和劳动时间调节（供给侧）影响劳动收入不平等。我们考察了这些渠道如何影响技能与非技能工人之间、各技能群体内部以及整个经济范围内的工资不平等。分析表明，数字化对劳动收入不平等的影响——无论是加剧还是缓解差距——取决于所采用的不平等度量指标。
10.1111/iere.70099.title: Does Digitalization Widen Labor Income Inequality?
10.1111/iere.70099.title_zh: 数字化会扩大劳动收入不平等吗？

10.1111/iere.70100.abstract: This paper models fertility as the outcome of gender‐biased technological progress interacting with endogenous social norms governing childcare. When rising female wages outpace norm adjustment, the inherited norm makes reallocating childcare toward fathers costly, so mothers bear a disproportionate burden and the shadow price of children rises. In cross‐country data, fertility falls faster where women's relative standing rises, especially where norms are tighter or more rigid. Calibrated to South Korea (1976–2016), the model shows that strong, slow‐adjusting norms deepen the decline. Despite smaller short‐run effects, male childcare subsidies yield larger long‐run gains than female subsidies by accelerating convergence to egalitarian norms.
10.1111/iere.70100.abstract_zh: 本文将生育率建模为性别偏见技术进步与内生社会规范（管理育儿责任）相互作用的结果。当女性工资增长超过规范调整速度时，继承的规范使得将育儿责任重新分配给父亲变得代价高昂，因此母亲承担不成比例的负担，孩子的影子价格上升。跨国数据显示，在女性相对地位提升较快的地方，生育率下降更快，尤其是在规范更严格或更僵化的地区。以韩国（1976-2016年）为校准对象，模型表明，强大且调整缓慢的规范加深了生育率下降。尽管短期效应较小，但男性育儿补贴通过加速向平等规范的收敛，比女性补贴带来更大的长期收益。
10.1111/iere.70100.title: The Dynamics of Gender Norms and Fertility Decline
10.1111/iere.70100.title_zh: 性别规范动态与生育率下降

10.1111/iere.70101.abstract: This paper studies how population aging shapes regional adjustment to local shocks. I develop a dynamic spatial general equilibrium model that incorporates aggregate demographic change, life‐cycle variation in migration and employment choices, and forward‐looking investment in local capital. Applying the model to Japan, I find that aging can mitigate welfare losses from a negative local shock. Although older populations are less mobile, reduced outmigration sustains local capital demand and slows capital disinvestment, limiting declines in labor productivity. An extension illustrates the model's use for post‐disaster policy evaluation, highlighting a potential tradeoff between spatial equity and aggregate welfare.
10.1111/iere.70101.abstract_zh: 本文研究了人口老龄化如何影响区域对局部冲击的调整。我构建了一个动态空间一般均衡模型，该模型整合了总体人口结构变化、迁移与就业选择的生命周期差异，以及前瞻性的地方资本投资。将该模型应用于日本，我发现老龄化能够缓解负面局部冲击带来的福利损失。尽管老年人口流动性较低，但减少的向外迁移维持了地方资本需求，并减缓了资本撤资，从而限制了劳动生产率的下降。一项扩展研究展示了该模型在灾后政策评估中的应用，强调了空间公平与总体福利之间可能存在的权衡。
10.1111/iere.70101.title: Local Shocks and Regional Dynamics in an Aging Economy
10.1111/iere.70101.title_zh: 老龄化经济中的局部冲击与区域动态

10.1111/iere.70102.abstract: How does infrastructure shape rural development? Using household panel data from a nationally representative sample of Chinese villages, matched to high‐resolution highway maps, we find that road expansion between 2000 and 2015 operates mainly through reallocation, with less productive farmers scaling down or exiting and more productive farmers remaining and expanding. We quantify the aggregate and distributional consequences in a dynamic spatial equilibrium model with heterogeneous households and endogenous migration. Improved connectivity not only accelerates urbanization but also increases aggregate rural output by 2.2%–5.3% in the long run, even as the rural workforce declines.
10.1111/iere.70102.abstract_zh: 基础设施如何塑造农村发展？利用来自中国村庄全国代表性样本的家庭面板数据，并结合高分辨率公路地图，我们发现2000年至2015年间道路扩张主要通过重新配置发挥作用，生产效率较低的农户缩减规模或退出，而生产效率较高的农户则留存并扩张。我们在一个包含异质性家庭和内生迁移的动态空间均衡模型中量化了总体及分配效应。改善连通性不仅加速了城市化进程，而且长期内使农村总产出增加2.2%至5.3%，即便农村劳动力减少也是如此。
10.1111/iere.70102.title: Connectivity and Selective Rural Migration
10.1111/iere.70102.title_zh: 连通性与选择性农村迁移

10.1111/iere.70104.abstract: To study how college‐admissions competition shapes parental investment and child‐development policies, we develop a heterogeneous‐agent life‐cycle model in which parents invest in children's human capital to raise future labor productivity and compete for limited college seats. Because families ignore their spending's effects on others' admission chances, competition creates a rat race with overinvestment. Estimating the model with Chinese data, we find that this externality accounts for a substantial share of parental monetary investment. Policies that reduce competition raise current‐generation welfare but may diminish future human capital. Taxing private education spending while subsidizing public investment can balance this trade‐off and improve overall welfare.
10.1111/iere.70104.abstract_zh: 为探究大学入学竞争如何影响父母投资与儿童发展政策，我们构建了一个异质性主体生命周期模型，其中父母投资于子女人力资本以提升其未来劳动生产率，并争夺有限的大学名额。由于家庭忽视其支出对他人录取机会的影响，竞争引发了一场过度投资的“军备竞赛”。利用中国数据对模型进行估计，我们发现这一外部性在父母货币投资中占据了显著比例。旨在减少竞争的政策能提升当代福利，但可能削弱未来人力资本。对私人教育支出征税，同时补贴公共投资，可平衡这一权衡并增进整体福利。
10.1111/iere.70104.title: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Competition for College Admissions
10.1111/iere.70104.title_zh: 高校招生竞争对宏观经济的影响

10.1111/iere.70105.abstract: We develop and estimate a model of endogenous schooling and earnings to isolate the causal effect of parents' education on children's outcomes. Identification uses earnings differences among children with equal schooling whose parents have different schooling. Health and Retirement Study data indicate that the observed intergenerational schooling correlation is largely driven by correlated unobserved preferences for schooling. This is partly offset by a slightly negative structural relationship between parents' and children's schooling choices. Nevertheless, an exogenous one‐year increase in parents' schooling raises children's lifetime earnings by 2 % on average.
10.1111/iere.70105.abstract_zh: 我们构建并估计了一个关于内生教育与收入的经济模型，旨在分离父母教育对子女结果的因果效应。识别策略利用的是，在子女教育水平相同但父母教育背景不同的情况下，其收入差异。健康与退休研究数据显示，观察到的代际教育相关性主要由未观测到的教育偏好相关性驱动。这一效应部分被父母与子女教育选择之间略微负向的结构性关系所抵消。尽管如此，父母教育年限外生增加一年，平均可使子女终身收入提高2%。
10.1111/iere.70105.title: The Causal Effect of Parents' Education on Children's Earnings
10.1111/iere.70105.title_zh: 父母教育对子女收入的因果效应

10.1111/iere.70106.abstract: Hospital payment schemes designed to control expenditure could also influence the medical resource allocation. We study hospital responses to the introduction of a blended payment scheme—a diagnosis‐based payment scheme with a predetermined global budget—and their distributional consequences. Exploiting a quasi‐experimental reform in China, we find hospitals respond by upcoding, shifting admissions toward categories with higher upcoding potential, and increasing total admissions. Hospitals’ heterogeneous responses widen the disparity in their payments, primarily through heterogeneous upcoding. Hospitals with more coding knowledge, greater reform exposure, higher tier, and larger size secure a larger share of the social health insurance fund.
10.1111/iere.70106.abstract_zh: 旨在控制支出的医院支付方案也可能影响医疗资源配置。我们研究了医院对引入混合支付方案——一种基于诊断且设有预定总预算的支付方案——的反应及其分配后果。利用中国的一项准实验改革，我们发现医院通过升级编码、将入院病例转向具有更高升级编码潜力的类别，以及增加总入院量来应对。医院的异质性反应扩大了其支付差距，主要通过异质性升级编码实现。拥有更多编码知识、改革暴露程度更高、等级更高及规模更大的医院，在社会医疗保险基金中占据了更大份额。
10.1111/iere.70106.title: Hospital Heterogeneous Responses to a Blended Payment Scheme Reform and the Distributional Consequences
10.1111/iere.70106.title_zh: 医院对混合支付制度改革的不同反应及其分配效应

10.1111/iere.70108.abstract: This discussion develops a parsimonious framework for norm dynamics. The interaction between social pressure to conform and older generations attachment to past practices generates intergenerational inertia and a persistent wedge between behavior and the frictionless optimum. I characterize the determinants of this wedge and highlight the role of demographic transition. I illustrate the framework's broader applicability to scientific paradigms and policy reform.
10.1111/iere.70108.abstract_zh: 本讨论构建了一个关于规范动态的简约框架。社会遵从压力与老一代对过往实践的依恋之间的相互作用，导致了代际惯性，并在行为与无摩擦最优状态之间形成了持续偏差。我刻画了这一偏差的决定因素，并强调了人口结构转型的作用。我展示了该框架在科学范式与政策改革中的更广泛适用性。
10.1111/iere.70108.title: Discussion of “The Dynamics of Gender Norms and Fertility Decline”
10.1111/iere.70108.title_zh: 讨论“性别规范动态与生育率下降

10.1111/iere.70109.abstract: This paper studies aggregate markup cyclicality through firm‐level heterogeneity, reallocation, and aggregation. Using the U.S. firm data for 1990–2016, we find that markups are procyclical for young firms and countercyclical for older firms following monetary policy shocks. Economic activity also reallocates modestly toward young firms. As the firm population ages, the aggregate markup response shifts from acyclical or mildly procyclical to countercyclical. These findings help reconcile conflicting evidence on markup cyclicality and imply that firm demographics shape monetary‐policy transmission and the roles of demand and supply shocks in business cycles.
10.1111/iere.70109.abstract_zh: 本文通过企业层面的异质性、重新配置与加总效应，研究总体加成率的周期性特征。利用1990年至2016年的美国企业数据，我们发现，在货币政策冲击后，年轻企业的加成率呈顺周期性，而成熟企业则呈逆周期性。经济活动也适度向年轻企业重新配置。随着企业群体年龄增长，总体加成率的响应从无周期性或温和顺周期性转变为逆周期性。这些发现有助于调和关于加成率周期性的相互矛盾的证据，并表明企业人口结构塑造了货币政策的传导机制以及需求与供给冲击在经济周期中的作用。
10.1111/iere.70109.title: Heterogeneous Markups Cyclicality and Monetary Policy
10.1111/iere.70109.title_zh: 异质性加成周期性与货币政策

10.1111/iere.70110.abstract: This paper examines the effect of idiosyncratic uncertainty on trade elasticities in a canonical heterogeneous‐firm model. We identify two channels through which uncertainty affects elasticities: a selection effect, whereby uncertainty lowers export participation thresholds and a dispersion effect, whereby uncertainty lowers the dispersion of export selection shocks, with an ambiguous impact on elasticities. We develop a methodology to quantify trade elasticities under uncertainty and apply it to Brazilian firm‐level export data. Relative to a complete‐information framework, uncertainty amplifies trade elasticities on average, with heterogeneous effects across industries that are largest among highly substitutable and high‐uncertainty products.
10.1111/iere.70110.abstract_zh: 本文在经典异质性企业模型中考察了特质性不确定性对贸易弹性的影响。我们识别出不确定性影响弹性的两个渠道：选择效应，即不确定性降低了出口参与门槛；以及离散效应，即不确定性降低了出口选择冲击的离散度，对弹性的影响方向不明确。我们开发了一种方法，用于量化不确定性条件下的贸易弹性，并将其应用于巴西企业层面的出口数据。与完全信息框架相比，不确定性平均放大了贸易弹性，且各行业间存在异质性影响，在高度可替代和高不确定性的产品中表现最为显著。
10.1111/iere.70110.title: Demand Uncertainty, Selection, and Trade
10.1111/iere.70110.title_zh: 需求不确定性、选择与贸易

10.1111/iere.70111.title: Discussion of “Does Digitalization Widen Labor Income Inequality?”
10.1111/iere.70111.title_zh: 关于“数字化是否扩大了劳动收入不平等？”的讨论

10.1111/jems.12643.abstract: We examine the effects of regulation requiring data portability and interoperability in digital platform competition. Data portability and interoperability have the effect of eliminating switching costs between platforms and enlarging network externalities but increasing the risk of data breaches. We show that in the absence of data breaches, the regulation improves welfare by reducing switching costs and increasing network benefits. We also show that with data breach accidents, ensuring data portability and interoperability increases the accident probability, but the joint and several liability with negligence standards can attain the social optimum by inducing firms to take efficient care to prevent accidents.
10.1111/jems.12643.abstract_zh: 我们考察了数字平台竞争中要求数据可携带性和互操作性的监管效应。数据可携带性和互操作性具有消除平台间转换成本并扩大网络外部性的效果，但同时也增加了数据泄露的风险。我们证明，在没有数据泄露的情况下，该监管通过降低转换成本和增加网络效益来提升社会福利。我们还证明，在发生数据泄露事故的情况下，确保数据可携带性和互操作性会增加事故概率，但结合过失标准的连带责任能够通过促使企业采取有效预防措施来达到社会最优状态。

10.1111/jems.12644.abstract: This paper studies large banks' incentives to engage in misconduct by abusing their dominant position in the market for loans and by mis-selling an add-on financial product to depositors. We draw new connections between stability-focused prudential regulation and misconduct by studying the impact of higher capital requirements on misconduct incentives. Higher capital requirements are more likely to increase misconduct incentives when incumbents enjoy a significant equity funding cost advantage over challenger banks. These results highlight the importance of regulatory coordination in the areas of bank conduct and financial stability.
10.1111/jems.12644.abstract_zh: 本文研究了大型银行通过滥用其在贷款市场中的主导地位及向储户不当销售附加金融产品而从事不当行为的激励。我们通过考察更高资本要求对不当行为激励的影响，建立了以稳定性为核心的审慎监管与不当行为之间的新联系。当现有银行相对于挑战者银行享有显著的股权融资成本优势时，更高的资本要求更可能增加不当行为的激励。这些结果凸显了银行行为与金融稳定领域监管协调的重要性。

10.1111/jems.12645.abstract: Collusion theory robustly predicts non-cartel rivals will raise their prices and increase their output. As a typical cartel cuts back production, its competitors are expected to gain market share during the collusive period and to lose market share in the period following the cartel's demise. We provide empirical support for this prediction by showing that it applies to the European truck cartel. We also illustrate how our analysis can be used in the prosecution stage. One truck manufacturer denied cartel participation, whereas the proposed market share test supports the European Commission's finding that this firm was, in fact, a member.
10.1111/jems.12645.abstract_zh: 合谋理论稳健地预测，非卡特尔竞争对手将提高价格并增加产量。由于典型卡特尔削减生产，其竞争对手预计在合谋期间获得市场份额，并在卡特尔瓦解后的时期失去市场份额。我们通过证明这一预测适用于欧洲卡车卡特尔，为其提供了实证支持。我们还展示了我们的分析如何在起诉阶段得到应用。一家卡车制造商否认参与卡特尔，而所提出的市场份额检验支持了欧盟委员会关于该公司实际上是成员的认定。

10.1111/jems.70000.abstract: We compare the merger participants' profits under a merger and under cross ownership (CO) in an oligopolistic industry with horizontally differentiated products. We show under Cournot competition that the merger participants would be better off under a symmetric CO than a merger. This result holds under symmetric and asymmetric costs. Considering a unilateral CO under Cournot competition, we show that the participating firms may prefer CO compared to a merger under asymmetric CO. We further show under Cournot competition that a symmetric CO may create higher consumer surplus and welfare compared to both merger and noncooperation in the presence of cost asymmetry and technology transfer between the firms engaging in CO or merger. If there is Bertrand competition, we show that the merger participants will not be better off under a symmetric CO than a merger.
10.1111/jems.70000.abstract_zh: 我们比较了在水平差异化产品的寡头垄断行业中，合并与交叉持股（CO）下合并参与者的利润。我们表明，在古诺竞争下，合并参与者在对称交叉持股下的境况优于合并。这一结果在成本对称和不对称的情况下均成立。考虑古诺竞争下的单边交叉持股，我们显示，在不对称交叉持股下，参与企业可能更偏好交叉持股而非合并。我们进一步表明，在古诺竞争下，当存在成本不对称以及参与交叉持股或合并的企业间技术转移时，对称交叉持股可能比合并和非合作产生更高的消费者剩余和福利。若存在伯特兰竞争，我们显示，合并参与者在对称交叉持股下的境况不会优于合并。

10.1111/jems.70001.abstract: Patenting an intermediate research innovation can lead to competition for the development of a final commercial innovation and potentially induce wasteful duplicative R&D efforts. This study examines the effects of different protection strategies and patent life on the incentives to protect an intermediate innovation by considering a two-stage sequential innovation model. In this model, the success of a patentable final innovation depends on information about prior intermediate innovations and on complementary inspiration received by innovators. Protecting an intermediate innovation through secrecy can be socially superior if the final innovation involves a high cost and the idea essential to its implementation is common. Acquisition of specialized assets under patenting may increase duplication of resources, and secrecy can act as a social control to limit the entry by many firms. If the idea for the final innovation is scarce, on the other hand, patenting can be optimal for both the innovator of an intermediate innovation and society, and the innovator's incentive is well aligned with social welfare. A broad patent scope can facilitate the adjustment of patent life to align private incentives with the social optimum when the idea for the final innovation is scarce.
10.1111/jems.70001.abstract_zh: 对中间研究创新授予专利，可能引发对最终商业创新开发的竞争，并可能诱发浪费性的重复研发努力。本研究通过构建一个两阶段序贯创新模型，探讨不同保护策略及专利期限对保护中间创新激励的影响。在该模型中，可专利化最终创新的成功取决于对先前中间创新信息的掌握以及创新者所获得的互补性灵感。若最终创新涉及高成本且其实施所需的核心思想为普遍所知，则通过保密方式保护中间创新可能在社会层面更为优越。在专利制度下获取专用资产可能增加资源重复，而保密可作为社会控制手段，限制众多企业的进入。另一方面，若最终创新的思想稀缺，则专利保护对中间创新者及社会均可能为最优选择，且创新者的激励与社会福利高度一致。当最终创新的思想稀缺时，宽泛的专利范围有助于调整专利期限，使私人激励与社会最优状态相契合。

10.1111/jems.70002.abstract: Our article investigates the impact of vertical integration (without foreclosure) on innovation. We compare cases where either (i) two manufacturers or (ii) a manufacturer and a vertically integrated retailer invest. Then, the independent manufacturer(s) and the retailer bargain over nonlinear contracts before selling to consumers. We show that vertical integration always increases the incentives to invest in the integrated product, which stifles (resp. spurs) the investment of the independent manufacturer when spillovers are low (resp. high). In contrast, when investments are sequential, if the buyer power is high, and the independent manufacturer chooses its investment first, it invests more (resp. less) to discourage the integrated retailer's investment when spillovers are low (resp. high). Furthermore, vertical integration is always profitable even when it is not desirable for the industry and welfare. Overall, vertical integration is desirable for the industry when the buyer power is high, and may harm welfare when both the buyer power and spillovers are low.
10.1111/jems.70002.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了纵向一体化（不含排他性行为）对创新的影响。我们比较了两种情形：一是两家制造商分别投资，二是制造商与纵向一体化零售商共同投资。随后，独立制造商与零售商在向消费者销售前就非线性合同进行谈判。研究表明，纵向一体化总是提升一体化产品的投资激励，在溢出效应低（高）时，这会抑制（促进）独立制造商的投资。相反，在投资顺序进行的情况下，若买方势力较强，且独立制造商先行选择投资，则其在溢出效应低（高）时会增加（减少）投资以抑制一体化零售商的后续投资。此外，纵向一体化始终具有盈利性，即便在行业整体及社会福利角度并非最优时亦然。总体而言，当买方势力较强时，纵向一体化对行业有利；而当买方势力与溢出效应均较低时，可能损害社会福利。

10.1111/jems.70003.abstract: New business formation is a key driver of regional transformation and development. While we know that a region's attractiveness for new businesses depends on its resources, infrastructure, and human capital, we know little about the role of local business networks in promoting or impeding the birth of new firms. We construct local business networks connecting more than 350 million nodes consisting of managers, owners, and firms using data on the universe of German businesses. Differentiating between firms founded by serial and de novo entrepreneurs and different network measures (average degree and transitivity of the largest component), we show that the connectedness between actors within a region matters for firm entry and individual firm performance. We show a positive relationship between a region's connectedness and firm entry by serial entrepreneurs. Networks are also linked to individual firm performance, especially in terms of larger entry size of de-novo firms and higher employment growth for both de-novo and serial entrepreneurship.
10.1111/jems.70003.abstract_zh: 新企业创建是区域转型与发展的关键驱动力。尽管我们已知一个地区对新企业的吸引力取决于其资源、基础设施和人力资本，但对于本地商业网络在促进或阻碍新企业诞生中所扮演的角色，我们知之甚少。我们利用德国全部企业的数据，构建了连接超过3.5亿个节点（包括经理、所有者及企业）的本地商业网络。通过区分连续创业者和新创企业家所创立的企业，并采用不同的网络指标（最大连通分量的平均度与传递性），我们揭示了区域内行为者之间的连接性对企业进入及个体企业绩效的影响。研究显示，区域连接性与连续创业者的企业进入之间存在正相关关系。网络还与个体企业绩效相关联，尤其体现在新创企业更大的初始规模以及新创和连续创业企业更高的就业增长上。

10.1111/jems.70004.abstract: This paper analyzes a model of innovation diffusion with case-based individuals a la Gilboa and Schmeidler, who decide whether to consume an incumbent or a new product based on their and their social neighbors' previous consumption experiences. I analyze how diffusion patterns change with individual characteristics, innovation characteristics, and social networks. In particular, information about a superior innovation could be overwhelmed by information about the incumbent product, leading to inefficient asymptotic diffusion. Radical innovation or innovation with a strong R&D focus leads to higher initial speed but lower acceleration than incremental innovation or innovation with a strong marketing effort. Social networks with stronger overall social ties, lower degrees of homophily, or higher exposure to reviews from early adopters speed up the diffusion of innovation.
10.1111/jems.70004.abstract_zh: 本文分析了一个基于案例推理的个体（遵循Gilboa和Schmeidler的理论）的创新扩散模型，这些个体根据自身及社交邻居以往的消费经验，决定是消费现有产品还是新产品。我探讨了扩散模式如何随个体特征、创新特征及社交网络的变化而改变。特别是，关于更优创新的信息可能被现有产品的信息所淹没，导致低效的渐近扩散。相较于渐进式创新或侧重营销努力的创新，激进式创新或研发导向强的创新虽初期扩散速度更快，但加速度较低。社交网络中，整体社交联系更强、同质性程度更低或早期采纳者评价曝光度更高的网络，能加速创新的扩散。

10.1111/jems.70005.abstract: We study how serial investors who regularly face unknown competitors attempt to make their projects dominant. Innovating in new markets often involves uncertainty over the nature of the final product and who the key competitors will be. Such projects also have long-term funding needs, so a commitment to provide the necessary funds imparts a strategic advantage vis-a-vis potential rivals. We show that cultivating a reputation as a reliable financier can create a desirable competitive advantage across an investor's portfolio of projects. The downside is excessive reputation-seeking, which results in aggressive competition and over-investment in many product markets. Our results rationalize real-life aspects of innovation and provide new testable predictions.
10.1111/jems.70005.abstract_zh: 我们研究那些经常面对未知竞争对手的连续投资者如何试图使其项目占据主导地位。在新市场中创新往往涉及最终产品性质及关键竞争对手的不确定性。此类项目还需长期资金支持，因此承诺提供必要资金能赋予其相对于潜在对手的战略优势。我们表明，培养作为可靠融资者的声誉可以在投资者的项目组合中创造理想的竞争优势。其弊端在于过度追求声誉，导致在许多产品市场中竞争激烈且投资过度。我们的研究结果合理化了现实中的创新现象，并提供了新的可检验预测。

10.1111/jems.70006.abstract: We develop a theory of postacquisition integration that distinguishes between one-way (acquirer-only) and two-way (mutual) effort strategies. We argue that the method of payment—cash versus shares—may serve as an ex ante commitment mechanism to a particular integration strategy, where cash deals align with unilateral effort, and share deals induce mutual engagement. Using transaction-level mergers and acquisitions data covering 1986–2009, we show that stock-financed acquisitions yield higher postmerger productivity, particularly in knowledge-intensive industries, but also exhibit greater performance variance. These higher-mean and higher-variance tendencies for share-financed vis-à-vis cash-financed acquisitions involve countervailing effects when factoring stock-market valuations; further, share-financed acquisitions are discounted when financial markets are characterized by high degrees of risk aversion. Overall, our findings highlight how financial structure shapes integration dynamics and synergy realization.
10.1111/jems.70006.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于并购后整合的理论，该理论区分了单向（仅收购方）与双向（相互）努力策略。我们认为，支付方式——现金对股份——可能作为特定整合策略的事前承诺机制，其中现金交易与单方面努力相契合，而股份交易则促使双方共同参与。利用覆盖1986年至2009年的交易层面并购数据，我们显示，股票融资的收购在并购后生产率上表现更高，尤其是在知识密集型行业，但同时也展现出更大的绩效波动性。相较于现金融资的收购，股票融资的收购在考虑股市估值时，其高均值与高方差倾向涉及抵消效应；此外，在金融市场风险厌恶程度较高时，股票融资的收购会遭到折价。总体而言，我们的发现强调了金融结构如何塑造整合动态及协同效应的实现。

10.1111/jems.70007.abstract: ABSTRACT Prior research on user innovation fails to explain its low adoption rate and neglects its impact on increased product stickiness. To bridge these gaps, we conducted an empirical investigation into user innovations within the video game sector. Our study reveals that embracing user innovation leads to an upsurge in the number of active players for a game. Furthermore, the marginal effect of user innovations varies depending on their recency and quality , with low‐quality user innovations leading to user attrition. The effect is also contingent on the stage in the product life cycle in which user innovation is adopted.
10.1111/jems.70007.abstract_zh: 摘要 先前关于用户创新的研究未能解释其低采纳率，并忽视了其对产品粘性增强的影响。为弥补这些空白，我们对视频游戏行业的用户创新进行了实证调查。研究发现，采纳用户创新能显著提升游戏的活跃玩家数量。此外，用户创新的边际效应因其新颖性和质量而异，低质量的用户创新会导致用户流失。该效应还取决于用户创新被采纳时所处的产品生命周期阶段。

10.1111/jems.70008.abstract: In hit‐driven industries, product development is associated with a right‐skewed unconditional distribution of performance, and products in the right tail have outsized impacts. Understanding how exceptional performance is generated can improve resource allocation, but the literature advances two different narratives: one emphasizes postrelease demand discovery, and the other emphasizes prerelease factors, including project quality, management teams, and uncertainties associated with product development. The model in this paper facilitates assessing the relative importance of the different narratives. Estimation employs data on movies—the primary setting where demand discovery has been emphasized. The results reject the primacy of demand discovery; most project‐specific variation in return‐on‐investment is associated with uncertainty resolved during product development. Higher managerial ability is associated with better product‐development performance. Parameter estimates are compatible with nearly efficient and approximately positive assortative matching of projects and managers. The results suggest that emphasizing prerelease factors should be the presumptive narrative in all hit‐driven industries.
10.1111/jems.70008.abstract_zh: 在热门驱动型行业中，产品开发与右偏的无条件绩效分布相关联，右尾产品具有超常影响力。理解卓越绩效如何产生有助于优化资源配置，但文献中提出了两种不同的叙事：一种强调发布后的需求发现，另一种则强调发布前的因素，包括项目质量、管理团队及产品开发相关的不确定性。本文构建的模型有助于评估不同叙事的相对重要性。估计采用电影数据——这是需求发现被强调的主要场景。结果否定了需求发现的首要地位；投资回报中大部分项目特定变异与产品开发期间解决的不确定性相关。更高的管理能力与更好的产品开发绩效相关联。参数估计与项目和管理者之间近乎高效且近似正选型匹配相容。结果表明，在所有热门驱动型行业中，强调发布前因素应成为默认叙事。

10.1111/jems.70009.abstract: The decisions of funding agencies greatly influence the direction of scientific research; however, our understanding of how applicants' research directions affect the selection process remains limited. In this study, we investigate how a project's coherence with a scientist's previous work and its alignment with current scientific trends affect the probability of winning a renowned research fellowship. Employing a neural network algorithm to compute these indicators, we analyze the text of 2494 research projects proposed by scholars competing for the Sloan Research Fellowship, one of the most prestigious fellowships for early‐career researchers in North America. Our findings reveal notable differences across fields in the effect of coherence and alignment on the probability of being awarded, reflecting distinct organizational norms. For instance, applicants with coherent and aligned projects have higher chances of winning in life sciences & chemistry. In contrast, in physics, bibliometric measures such as the number of publications and citations outweigh research direction characteristics in the selection process. This study aims to offer valuable insights into the factors influencing scientific selection processes, exhibiting how they shape the research landscape for early‐career scientists across various academic fields.
10.1111/jems.70009.abstract_zh: 资助机构的决策极大地影响着科学研究的方向；然而，我们对于申请者的研究方向如何影响选拔过程的理解仍然有限。在本研究中，我们探讨了一个项目与科学家先前工作的一致性及其与当前科学趋势的契合度，如何影响获得著名研究奖学金的可能性。通过运用神经网络算法计算这些指标，我们分析了2494个由学者为竞争斯隆研究奖学金而提出的研究项目文本，该奖学金是北美早期职业研究者中最负盛名的奖学金之一。我们的发现揭示了不同领域中一致性和契合度对获奖概率影响的显著差异，反映了各自独特的组织规范。例如，在生命科学与化学领域，拥有连贯且契合项目的申请者获奖机会更高。相反，在物理学领域，诸如发表物数量和引用次数等文献计量指标在选拔过程中超过了研究方向特征的重要性。本研究旨在为影响科学选拔过程的因素提供有价值的见解，展示它们如何塑造不同学术领域中早期职业科学家的研究格局。

10.1111/jems.70010.abstract: This article examines how increased competition affects product and process innovation. I combine plausibly exogenous variation in foreign competition induced by large tariff cuts with a difference‐in‐differences strategy and find that firms increase their product patenting in response to increased foreign competition, but, on average, foreign competition has no effect on process patenting. Firms operating in industries where patents are an effective means of protecting their competitive advantage increase their patenting more in response to competition. Initially large and productive firms engage in more process innovation in response to competitive pressure.
10.1111/jems.70010.abstract_zh: 本文考察了竞争加剧如何影响产品创新与过程创新。我将关税大幅削减所引发的看似外生的外国竞争变化与双重差分策略相结合，发现企业会因外国竞争加剧而增加产品专利申请，但平均而言，外国竞争对过程专利申请没有影响。在专利能有效保护其竞争优势的行业中，企业会因竞争而更多地增加专利申请。初始规模较大且生产率较高的企业，在竞争压力下会更多地参与过程创新。

10.1111/jems.70011.abstract: This paper shows that product positioning affects the incentives to invest in process innovation. The result is found using a model of price competition with three firms under horizontal product differentiation—and then extended to a more general Bertrand triopoly. The central firm may have a higher gain from a cost reduction than the peripheral firms, even if it reaps a lower profit or has a lower demand. By contrast, the peripheral firms have a larger gain if, and only if, they also have larger profits. Furthermore, we argue that the central firm exploits a reduction in the marginal cost mainly to expand its sales, whereas the peripheral ones to increase their markup. We finally show that the aggregate innovation incentives are larger the more clustered toward the center are the firms and the larger the preinnovation cost asymmetry. We also analyze the effects of mergers on innovation incentives, confirming that they tend to reduce the merged firms' incentives to innovate.
10.1111/jems.70011.abstract_zh: 本文表明，产品定位影响工艺创新的投资激励。这一结论通过一个包含三家企业、水平产品差异化的价格竞争模型得出，并进一步扩展至更一般的伯特兰三头垄断情形。中心企业可能从成本降低中获得比外围企业更高的收益，即便其利润较低或需求较小。相反，外围企业只有在利润也更高时，其收益才会更大。此外，我们认为中心企业主要利用边际成本的降低来扩大销售，而外围企业则旨在提高其加成率。最后，我们证明，企业越向中心聚集，且创新前成本不对称性越大，总体创新激励越强。我们还分析了并购对创新激励的影响，确认并购往往降低合并企业的创新激励。

10.1111/jems.70012.abstract: This paper examines firms' incentives to integrate free, advertising‐financed online services with hardware products and their implications. Our analysis shows that service integration has a non‐monotonic effect on hardware prices while reducing advertising levels. Moreover, when the quality advantage is sufficiently large, integration increases both firms' profit by enabling them to monetize different user segments. However, for small to intermediate quality advantage, service integration can make the dominant firm better off and the rival firm worse off when the nuisance cost of advertisement is small to intermediate, and both firms better off when the nuisance cost of advertisement is sufficiently large. Finally, service integration can benefit users but harm advertisers.
10.1111/jems.70012.abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业将免费、广告资助的在线服务与硬件产品整合的动机及其影响。我们的分析表明，服务整合对硬件价格具有非单调效应，同时降低了广告水平。此外，当质量优势足够大时，整合通过使企业能够从不同用户群体中获利，提高了双方的利润。然而，对于较小至中等程度的质量优势，当广告的干扰成本较小至中等时，服务整合可能使主导企业受益而竞争对手受损；当广告的干扰成本足够大时，则使双方企业均受益。最后，服务整合可能惠及用户，但损害广告商的利益。

10.1111/jems.70013.abstract: ABSTRACT It is well established that a vertically integrated firm may have an incentive to raise its rivals' costs by increasing the wholesale price of inputs. We show that this incentive can lead vertical integration to facilitate entry into the downstream market: higher input costs weaken incumbent rivals, thereby improving the entrant's competitive position. Our framework considers an upstream firm that offers observable two‐part tariff contracts to downstream firms. The downstream market consists of two incumbents and one potential entrant, with competition modeled à la Cournot. In addition, downstream firms may also source inputs from an alternative, less efficient supplier. We fully characterize the conditions under which entry‐encouraging vertical integration is profitable and arises in equilibrium, and demonstrate that in most cases it enhances overall welfare. By contrast, we also identify a (small) region where vertical integration reduces the entrant's profits and deters entry. In such cases, vertical integration is always detrimental to welfare.
10.1111/jems.70013.abstract_zh: 摘要 众所周知，垂直一体化企业可能通过提高投入品的批发价格来增加竞争对手的成本。我们证明，这种激励可能导致垂直一体化促进下游市场的进入：更高的投入成本削弱了现有竞争对手，从而改善了进入者的竞争地位。我们的框架考虑一个上游企业向下游企业提供可观察的两部分 tariff 合同。下游市场由两家现有企业和一家潜在进入者组成，竞争以古诺（Cournot）模式进行。此外，下游企业也可能从替代性但效率较低的供应商处获取投入品。我们全面刻画了鼓励进入的垂直一体化在何种条件下有利可图并在均衡中出现，并证明在大多数情况下，这种一体化提升了整体福利。相反，我们也识别出一个（较小的）区域，其中垂直一体化降低了进入者的利润并阻碍了进入。在这种情况下，垂直一体化总是对福利有害。

10.1111/jems.70014.abstract: We experimentally investigate the spillover effects of monitoring. In a controlled laboratory experiment, participants simultaneously self‐report their payoffs in two tasks. Holding lies in the untargeted task to never be penalized, we vary the observability and the punishment for lying in the targeted task as follows: (1) the experimenter cannot observe the random draw that determines the payoff the participant should report, (2) the experimenter observes the participants' random draw, and (3) a penalty is imposed on the participant if the self‐reported payoff and the random draw are not consistent. The results showed that while participants lied less in the targeted task given a higher level of monitoring, they significantly increased their lies in the untargeted task.
10.1111/jems.70014.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了监督的溢出效应。在一项受控实验室实验中，参与者在两项任务中同时自我报告其收益。在未目标任务中的谎言永远不会受到惩罚的前提下，我们变化了目标任务中谎言的可见性和惩罚机制，具体如下：（1）实验者无法观察到决定参与者应报告收益的随机抽取结果，（2）实验者观察到参与者的随机抽取结果，以及（3）若自我报告的收益与随机抽取结果不一致，则对参与者施加惩罚。结果显示，尽管在更高水平的监督下，参与者在目标任务中减少了谎言，但他们显著增加了在未目标任务中的谎言。

10.1111/jems.70015.abstract: I develop a model that investigates the developmental role of negative feedback, where a worker can improve his skills after receiving feedback from a supervisor. The supervisor faces a trade-off: negative feedback promotes skill development, while positive feedback preserves the worker's confidence. The analysis shows that negative feedback is provided when skill development succeeds with sufficiently high probability. A key result is that while the supervisor with higher evaluation ability has stronger incentives to conceal bad news, her higher ability to detect it prevails, implying greater provision of negative feedback. These findings offer managerial implications for mentoring practices.
10.1111/jems.70015.abstract_zh: 我构建了一个模型，探讨负面反馈在发展中的作用，即员工在收到主管反馈后能够提升自身技能。主管面临权衡：负面反馈促进技能发展，而正面反馈则维护员工信心。分析表明，当技能发展成功的概率足够高时，会提供负面反馈。一个关键结果是，尽管评估能力更强的主管更有动机隐瞒坏消息，但其更高的识别能力占据上风，意味着负面反馈的提供更为充分。这些发现为辅导实践提供了管理启示。

10.1111/jems.70016.abstract: Although numerous studies compare the R&D performance of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and nonstate-owned enterprises (NSOEs), few investigate the underlying mechanisms. Using a novel data set on the market value of patents held by Chinese publicly listed firms, we find that SOEs generate lower private economic value from innovation than NSOEs, while the scientific value of their innovations does not differ significantly. Our analysis suggests that the ownership-related gap in R&D performance arises more from differences in firm objectives than from differences in capabilities. Specifically, SOEs exhibit weaker profit-seeking incentives, which lead to lower private returns on innovation. These findings imply that SOEs' R&D activities generate greater positive externalities than those of NSOEs, underscoring the distinctive social contributions of SOE innovation and its nonsubstitutability by NSOE innovation.
10.1111/jems.70016.abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量研究比较了国有企业与非国有企业在研发绩效上的差异，但鲜有研究深入探讨其背后的机制。利用一项关于中国上市公司所持专利市场价值的新数据集，我们发现国有企业从创新中获得的私人经济价值低于非国有企业，而两者创新的科学价值并无显著差异。我们的分析表明，所有制相关的研发绩效差距更多源于企业目标的不同，而非能力的差异。具体而言，国有企业表现出较弱的利润追求激励，这导致其创新带来的私人回报较低。这些发现意味着，国有企业的研发活动相比非国有企业产生了更大的正外部性，凸显了国有企业创新的独特社会贡献及其非国有企业创新所不可替代的特性。

10.1111/jems.70017.abstract: This study examines a causal relationship between fiscal pressure and the market structure of government‐controlled factors of production, by exploiting a city‐level panel data set on urban land transactions in China. We find that in the face of higher fiscal pressure, local governments tend to transfer fewer land parcels and make the urban land market more concentrated. This kind of concentration, in turn, will lead to higher housing prices. This study has implications for other countries where the government controls certain types of production factors, such as land or natural resources.
10.1111/jems.70017.abstract_zh: 本研究利用中国城市土地交易的面板数据，探讨了财政压力与政府控制生产要素市场结构之间的因果关系。研究发现，面对较高的财政压力，地方政府倾向于减少土地出让地块数量，导致城市土地市场更加集中。这种集中化进而推高了住房价格。本研究对于政府控制土地或自然资源等生产要素的其他国家具有借鉴意义。

10.1111/jems.70018.abstract: Many successful brand manufacturers, such as Apple and Nike, have invested extensively in international networks of direct retail outlets. Systematic evidence on this development has been lacking because official foreign direct investment (FDI) data are classified according to the main industry of the investing firm and therefore most branded retail investments are classified as manufacturing or wholesale trade. Using novel project-level data, we show that direct retail FDI now accounts for more than 5% of global FDI flows—about five times the FDI in official data. We provide empirical evidence that FDI in branded retail outlets is driven by brand owners’ need to control brand value, especially when it is difficult to contract and monitor sales and service quality.
10.1111/jems.70018.abstract_zh: 许多成功的品牌制造商，如苹果和耐克，已大量投资于国际直营零售网络。由于官方外国直接投资（FDI）数据按投资企业的主要行业分类，因此大多数品牌零售投资被归类为制造业或批发贸易，导致这一发展的系统性证据一直缺失。利用新颖的项目级数据，我们表明直营零售FDI现占全球FDI流量的5%以上——约为官方数据中FDI的五倍。我们提供实证证据，表明品牌零售网点的FDI受品牌所有者控制品牌价值的需求驱动，尤其是在销售和服务质量难以契约化及监控的情况下。

10.1111/jems.70019.abstract: ABSTRACT Policies that target a single aspect of agents' motivation may lead to their diminished efforts in other areas. This paper examines the effect of the European Union's flight delay compensation policy on flight on‐time performance by exploiting a unique policy variation in a difference‐in‐differences framework. The policy requires airlines to offer cash compensation to passengers for delays lasting more than 3 h. I find that, while the policy decreases the proportion of delays exceeding 180 min by 0.3 percentage points (20 percent), it also reduces the proportion of delays less than 15 min by 3.6 percentage points (5 percent). This effect spillovers to routes without the policy variation. Evidence suggests that the results are related to airlines' delay management practices. I also show that the results hold under a variety of robustness checks, and alternative explanations are ruled out. This paper provides insights into airlines' strategic responses to regulatory incentives and informs the design of related transportation policies and quality regulation.
10.1111/jems.70019.abstract_zh: 摘要 针对个体动机单一方面的政策可能导致其在其他领域努力减少。本文利用差异中的差异框架中的独特政策变异，考察了欧盟航班延误补偿政策对航班准点表现的影响。该政策要求航空公司对延误超过3小时的乘客提供现金补偿。我发现，尽管该政策将超过180分钟的延误比例降低了0.3个百分点（20%），但也将少于15分钟的延误比例降低了3.6个百分点（5%）。这种效应溢出至无政策变异的航线。证据表明，这些结果与航空公司的延误管理实践相关。我还表明，在多种稳健性检验下结果依然成立，并排除了其他替代解释。本文为航空公司对监管激励的战略性回应提供了见解，并为相关交通政策及质量监管的设计提供参考。

10.1111/jems.70020.abstract: We study a duopoly model of behavior-based pricing in which consumers can either disclose or hide their data. We contrast two data policies. Under an open data policy, disclosed data is shared with all firms. In the unique equilibrium, all consumers disclose, and firms price discriminate, leading to welfare losses from inefficient poaching. Under an exclusive data policy, disclosed data is accessible only to the firm from which a consumer previously purchased. In the unique equilibrium, all consumers hide, prices are uniform, and the market is efficient. We test these contrasting predictions in an experiment. Under the open data treatment, subjects predominantly act as predicted but do not fully disclose. Under the exclusive data treatment, buyers initially excessively disclose as sellers reward loyalty, but shift toward hiding as sellers begin employing poaching strategies. The discrepancy between theoretical and observed privacy choices can be explained by the presence of consumers who, irrespective of the data policy, are committed to either disclosing or hiding their data.
10.1111/jems.70020.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个基于行为定价的双寡头模型，其中消费者可以选择披露或隐藏其数据。我们对比了两种数据政策。在开放数据政策下，披露的数据对所有企业共享。在唯一均衡中，所有消费者都选择披露，企业实施价格歧视，导致因低效挖角而产生的福利损失。在独家数据政策下，披露的数据仅对消费者之前购买过的企业可见。在唯一均衡中，所有消费者都选择隐藏，价格统一，市场效率高。我们通过实验检验了这些对比鲜明的预测。在开放数据处理下，受试者主要按预测行事，但并未完全披露。在独家数据处理下，买家最初因卖家奖励忠诚而过度披露，但随着卖家开始采用挖角策略，他们转向隐藏。理论与观察到的隐私选择之间的差异，可以通过存在一些消费者来解释，这些消费者无论数据政策如何，都坚定地选择披露或隐藏其数据。

10.1111/jems.70021.abstract: In a two-period model of behaviour-based price discrimination, we consider the strategic incentives of competing oligopolistic firms in creating false expectations about the horizontal attributes of the products. In the case of exogenous real locations, we show that misleading advertising is profitable for firms as long as the equilibrium advertised product differentiation is greater than the real one. We also show that when firms adopt misleading advertising, behaviour-based price discrimination might increase the profits with respect to uniform pricing. When the real locations are endogenously chosen by firms, misleading advertising yields lower real product differentiation in equilibrium, but, due to the increase of the expected product differentiation, the final impact on the equilibrium profits is always positive. We also illustrate the implications of misleading advertising for consumer surplus and welfare, and we outline some policy prescriptions.
10.1111/jems.70021.abstract_zh: 在行为性价格歧视的两期模型中，我们考察了竞争性寡头企业在制造关于产品水平属性的虚假预期方面的战略动机。在真实位置外生给定的情况下，我们证明，只要均衡广告中的产品差异化程度大于实际差异化程度，误导性广告对企业而言就是有利可图的。我们还表明，当企业采用误导性广告时，相对于统一定价，行为性价格歧视可能会增加利润。当真实位置由企业内生选择时，误导性广告在均衡中导致较低的真实产品差异化，但由于预期产品差异化的增加，对均衡利润的最终影响始终是正面的。我们还阐述了误导性广告对消费者剩余和社会福利的影响，并概述了一些政策建议。

10.1111/jems.70022.abstract: This paper uses a quasi‐experimental design, a unique dataset of physical books, and a sample of vintage former bestsellers to examine copyright's impact on price, sales, and availability in the book market. We find that copyright increases sales, raises price, especially for top‐selling titles, and increases the number of old titles being sold in the market. These findings challenge the traditional access/incentive tradeoff and the view that society benefits when titles enter the public domain. Policy implications include reconsideration of uniform copyright terms and exploration of renewal‐based systems that allow rights holders to self‐select into extended protection.
10.1111/jems.70022.abstract_zh: 本文采用准实验设计、独特的实体书籍数据集以及一批经典旧版畅销书样本，考察版权对图书市场价格、销量及可获得性的影响。研究发现，版权提升了销量，提高了价格，尤其是对畅销书而言，并增加了市场上旧版书籍的销售数量。这些发现挑战了传统的获取/激励权衡观念，以及认为作品进入公共领域对社会有益的观点。政策启示包括重新考虑统一的版权期限，并探索基于续展的制度，使权利持有人能够自主选择延长保护。

10.1111/jems.70024.abstract: We analyze a setting in which physicians, who differ in their degree of altruism, first exert diagnostic effort before deciding whether to administer a test to determine the most appropriate treatment. Diagnostic effort yields an imperfect private signal of the patient's type, whereas the test provides a more accurate assessment. Absent corrective transfers, physicians exert too little diagnostic effort and may rely excessively on testing. When altruism is either homogeneous or observable, the first-best allocation can be decentralized through a payment scheme consisting of (i) a pay-for-performance (P4P) component, based on the proportion of correctly treated patients, to induce the optimal diagnostic effort and (ii) a fixed component to ensure both the optimal testing decision and physician participation. When altruism is heterogeneous and privately known to physicians, the two-part tariff that decentralizes the first-best is no longer incentive compatible. The optimal contract is pooling rather than separating, an instance of nonresponsiveness. Its uniform P4P component induces more altruistic physicians to exert higher diagnostic effort, while the fixed component must be conditioned on diagnostic test costs to promote optimal testing decisions.
10.1111/jems.70024.abstract_zh: 我们分析了一个情境，其中利他主义程度不同的医生，首先付出诊断努力，然后决定是否进行测试以确定最合适的治疗方案。诊断努力产生关于患者类型的不完美私人信号，而测试则提供更准确的评估。在没有纠正性转移支付的情况下，医生付出的诊断努力过少，并可能过度依赖测试。当利他主义是同质的或可观察时，通过一种支付方案可以实现最优配置的分散化，该方案包括：（i）基于正确治疗患者比例的按绩效付费（P4P）组成部分，以诱导最优诊断努力；（ii）固定组成部分，以确保最优测试决策和医生参与。当利他主义是异质的且为医生私人所知时，分散化最优配置的两部定价不再具有激励相容性。最优合同是混同而非分离，这是非响应性的一个实例。其统一的P4P组成部分促使更具利他主义的医生付出更高的诊断努力，而固定组成部分则必须根据诊断测试成本进行调整，以促进最优测试决策。

10.1111/jems.70025.abstract: We study a game in which universities compete by making unobservable investments in education quality. Subsequently, the graduates are considered for a single placement by an organization. A merit-based evaluator compares the realized skill of each graduate. A prestige-based evaluator only observes a noisy signal of the universities' relative education quality. Though a prestige-based evaluator does not know the true skills of the graduates, we derive conditions under which an increase in the probability of the prestige-based evaluator incentivizes higher investment and benefits the organization.
10.1111/jems.70025.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个博弈模型，其中大学通过进行不可观测的教育质量投资来竞争。随后，毕业生被一个组织考虑进行单一职位安置。基于能力的评估者会比较每位毕业生实际展现的技能。而基于声望的评估者仅能观察到大学相对教育质量的噪声信号。尽管基于声望的评估者不了解毕业生的真实技能，我们推导出条件，在这些条件下，增加基于声望评估者的概率会激励更高的投资，并使组织受益。

10.1111/jems.70026.abstract: The literature on learning‐by‐exporting has largely overlooked the role of information and communication technology (ICT). Given the growing importance of this issue, this study examines whether firms' entry into export markets induces additional ICT investments and how such investments influence performance. Using firm‑level data from India for 2002–2019, the analysis applies a two‑step method: propensity score matching (PSM) to identify export‑driven ICT spending, followed by production function estimation to evaluate its effects. The results show that exporting leads firms to raise their ICT spending, and that this export‑driven component is associated with larger gains in value‐added than the counterfactual ICT spending. Further evidence indicates that export‑driven ICT expenditures support capital formation, and the resulting ICT capital stocks yield higher gains than their counterfactuals. At the sectoral level, less ICT‑intensive industries benefit more from ICT expenditure flows, whereas highly ICT‑intensive industries gain more from ICT capital stocks. Robustness checks based on direct productivity analysis and the PSM difference‑in‑differences approach confirm these findings. Taken together, the evidence highlights the importance of integrated policies that align digital investment strategies with export support initiatives.
10.1111/jems.70026.abstract_zh: 关于“出口中学”的文献在很大程度上忽视了信息与通信技术（ICT）的作用。鉴于这一问题日益重要，本研究探讨企业进入出口市场是否引发额外的ICT投资，以及此类投资如何影响企业绩效。利用2002年至2019年印度企业层面的数据，分析采用两步法：首先运用倾向得分匹配（PSM）识别由出口驱动的ICT支出，随后通过生产函数估计评估其效应。结果显示，出口促使企业增加ICT支出，且这一由出口驱动的部分相较于反事实ICT支出，能带来更大的增加值收益。进一步证据表明，出口驱动的ICT支出支持资本形成，由此产生的ICT资本存量相较于反事实情形带来更高收益。在行业层面，ICT密集度较低的行业从ICT支出流中获益更多，而ICT密集度较高的行业则从ICT资本存量中获益更多。基于直接生产率分析和PSM双重差分法的稳健性检验证实了上述发现。综合来看，这些证据凸显了将数字投资战略与出口支持举措相结合的综合政策的重要性。

10.1111/jems.70028.abstract: Economists and management scholars have argued that the scope of incentives to increase cooperation in organizations is limited as their use may signal the prevalence of free-riding among employees. This paper tests this hypothesis with an artefactual field experiment that assigns managers and employees from a large company to stylized roles within a controlled game. We exogenously vary whether managers are informed about prevailing cooperation levels among employees before they can set incentives to promote cooperation. In addition, employees matched to informed managers learn that the manager could base their incentive choice on cooperation levels. We find no evidence for the hypothesized signaling effect. Having an informed manager set the incentive does not change employees' beliefs about the cooperativeness of others. Incentives, hence, have strong positive effects on cooperative beliefs, irrespective of information. The absence of the signaling effect appears to reflect employees' perceptions of managerial intentions: incentives are interpreted not as signals of low cooperation, but as rewards for expected cooperation. A follow-up survey experiment supports this mechanism, showing that a cooperative culture affects the interpretation of managerial actions.
10.1111/jems.70028.abstract_zh: 经济学家和管理学者认为，在组织中通过激励手段促进合作的范畴有限，因为采用此类激励可能向员工传递出搭便车行为普遍存在的信号。本文通过一项人工实地实验来检验这一假设，该实验将一家大型企业的经理与员工分配至受控游戏中的设定角色。我们外生地变化经理在设定激励以促进合作前是否知晓员工当前的合作水平。此外，与知情经理匹配的员工会得知经理可能依据合作水平来决定激励措施。我们未发现支持该假设性信号效应的证据。由知情经理设定激励并未改变员工对他人合作性的信念。因此，无论信息状况如何，激励对合作信念均产生强烈的正向影响。信号效应的缺失似乎反映了员工对管理意图的感知：激励并非被视为低合作水平的信号，而是被理解为对预期合作的奖励。一项后续调查实验支持了这一机制，表明合作文化会影响对管理行为的解读。

10.1111/jems.70029.abstract: We experimentally examine the effects of cheap talk communication and information structure on trust and reciprocity in an infinitely repeated favor exchange game without immediate reciprocity. Theory predicts that full trust is not incentive compatible under private information, in contrast to the public information setting. Yet, our results show that while public information yields better outcomes, subjects under private information still exhibit substantial trust and reciprocity, achieving average payoff efficiency exceeding 80% of the maximum possible. Allowing subjects to communicate freely through unrestricted text chat reinforces this outcome, whereas structured communication using pre-formulated messages has no significant effect. Content analysis suggests that free-form communication is effective in enabling subjects to develop a better understanding of one another's messages. Strategy analysis indicates that subjects predominantly adopt the strategy that achieves the socially optimal outcome, even when it is not an equilibrium under private information. This provides a strategic rationale for the observed levels of trust and reciprocity and suggests that subjects are not always beholden to incentive-compatibility. A sophisticated class of strategies explains a significant proportion of the data only under private information. This explains the lower frequency of trusting and reciprocal behaviors in this setting, as these strategies constrain such actions.
10.1111/jems.70029.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验考察了廉价交谈沟通与信息结构在无即时互惠的无限重复互惠博弈中对信任与互惠行为的影响。理论预测，在私人信息条件下，完全信任并非激励相容，这与公共信息环境形成对比。然而，我们的结果显示，尽管公共信息带来更优结果，私人信息下的受试者仍展现出显著的信任与互惠行为，平均收益效率超过最大可能值的80%。允许受试者通过无限制文本聊天自由沟通强化了这一结果，而使用预设消息的结构化沟通则无显著影响。内容分析表明，自由形式沟通有效促使受试者更好地理解彼此的信息。策略分析显示，受试者主要采用实现社会最优结果的策略，即便在私人信息下该策略并非均衡。这为观察到的信任与互惠水平提供了策略性解释，并表明受试者并非总是受制于激励相容性。一类复杂策略仅在私人信息下解释了数据的显著比例，这解释了该环境中信任与互惠行为频率较低的原因，因为这些策略限制了此类行为。

10.1111/jems.70030.abstract: Reward schemes may affect not only agents' effort but also their incentives to gather information in order to reduce the riskiness of the productive activity. In a laboratory experiment using a novel task, we find that the relationship between incentives and evidence gathering depends critically on the availability of information about peers' strategies and outcomes. When no peer information is available, competitive rewards are associated with more evidence gathering than noncompetitive rewards. In contrast, when decision-makers know what or how their peers are doing, competitive rewards schemes are associated with less active evidence gathering than noncompetitive schemes. The nature of the feedback—whether subjects receive information about peers' strategies, outcomes, or both—also affects subjects' incentives to engage in evidence gathering. Specifically, only combined feedback about peers' strategies and performance—from which subjects may assess the overall relationship between evidence gathering, riskiness, and success—is associated with less evidence gathering when rewards are based on relative performance; we find no similar effect for noncompetitive rewards.
10.1111/jems.70030.abstract_zh: 奖励方案不仅可能影响代理人的努力程度，还可能影响他们收集信息以降低生产活动风险的动机。在一项采用新颖任务的实验室实验中，我们发现激励与证据收集之间的关系关键取决于关于同伴策略和结果信息的可获得性。当没有同伴信息时，竞争性奖励比非竞争性奖励与更多的证据收集相关联。相反，当决策者了解同伴在做什么或如何做时，竞争性奖励方案与非竞争性方案相比，与较少的主动证据收集相关联。反馈的性质——受试者是否收到关于同伴策略、结果或两者的信息——也影响受试者参与证据收集的动机。具体而言，只有结合同伴策略和表现的反馈——受试者据此可评估证据收集、风险性与成功之间的整体关系——才与基于相对表现的奖励下较少的证据收集相关联；对于非竞争性奖励，我们未发现类似效应。

10.1111/jems.70031.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of robot adoption on firm-level inefficiency gaps, defined as the wedge between the value of the marginal product of labor and the market wage. We develop a theoretical framework where firms endogenously assign robots and labors to different production tasks based on comparative advantage. Because robots incur lower adjustment costs than human labor, a higher robot-to-labor ratio enhances operational flexibility. This flexibility allows firms to respond to exogenous demand shocks through more frequent, incremental adjustments, thereby maintaining labor inputs at their optimal levels and narrowing the inefficiency gap. Testing this model with a comprehensive survey of Chinese manufacturing firms (2000–2013), we find a 10%
10.1111/jems.70031.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了机器人采用对企业层面效率缺口的影响，该缺口定义为劳动边际产品价值与市场工资之间的楔子。我们构建了一个理论框架，在该框架中，企业基于比较优势将机器人和劳动力内生地分配到不同的生产任务中。由于机器人的调整成本低于人力劳动，较高的机器人对劳动比率增强了运营灵活性。这种灵活性使企业能够通过更频繁、渐进式的调整来应对外生需求冲击，从而将劳动投入维持在最优水平，并缩小效率缺口。利用2000至2013年中国制造业企业的综合调查数据对该模型进行检验，我们发现10%的

10.1111/jems.70032.abstract: Recent debates regarding the relative efficiency of hybrid and pure platform modes have become central in platform economics. This paper investigates the effect of the platform mode in a setting where downstream sellers on the platform purchase products from an upstream manufacturer before competing in quantities. The choice between the hybrid and pure platform modes alters the upstream manufacturer's pricing incentives and, in turn, affects total market quantity and welfare. I derive the conditions under which the hybrid platform mode yields a higher, lower, or equal total quantity compared to the pure platform mode. The key determinant is the modularity of demand, which depends on the elasticity of marginal revenue. These results highlight that platform regulation should jointly consider demand structure, upstream pricing behavior, and market structure.
10.1111/jems.70032.abstract_zh: 关于混合平台模式与纯平台模式相对效率的近期争论已成为平台经济学的核心议题。本文在平台上的下游卖家从上游制造商购买产品后进行数量竞争的背景下，考察了平台模式的影响。混合平台模式与纯平台模式的选择改变了上游制造商的定价激励，进而影响市场总产量与福利。我推导出混合平台模式相较于纯平台模式产生更高、更低或相等总产量的条件。关键决定因素为需求的可模块性，其取决于边际收益的弹性。这些结果强调，平台监管应综合考虑需求结构、上游定价行为及市场结构。

10.1111/jems.70034.abstract: This paper presents a model of vertical market structure that integrates multiple determinants previously studied in isolation. It shows how the nature of market growth, whether through existing or new applications of an input, and the type of fixed costs, whether exogenous or endogenous, affect the emergence of external suppliers for the input. The role of such suppliers depends on the input's technological generalizability, its potential for improvement, and the breadth and differentiation among downstream applications. Together, these factors shape whether a vertical market structure persists and can potentially drive multiple transitions between vertical integration and outsourcing.
10.1111/jems.70034.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个整合先前孤立研究的多种决定因素的垂直市场结构模型。该模型揭示了市场增长的性质（通过现有应用或新应用实现投入增长）以及固定成本的类型（外生或内生）如何影响投入品外部供应商的出现。此类供应商的作用取决于投入品的技术通用性、其改进潜力，以及下游应用的广度与差异化程度。这些因素共同决定了垂直市场结构是否持续存在，并可能推动垂直整合与外包之间的多重转型。
10.1111/jems.70034.title: The Rise and Fall of Input Suppliers

10.1111/jems.70035.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the contracts offered by a large healthcare purchaser to health service providers. Contracts are based on the DRG principle that all hospitalizations in a diagnosis group are reimbursed at the same rate. This principle is relaxed in practice, as in several cases, the amount reimbursed within each DRG exhibits considerable variability. We build a theoretical model which explains this variability as the attempt of the health authority to ensure appropriate matching between hospitals and patients. We test the model using a very large and detailed administrative data set for the largest region in Italy. In line with our theoretical results, we show that the state funded purchaser offers providers a system of incentives such that, as required by optimality, that providers which treat more patients receive a higher average reimbursement per treatment, suggesting therefore that they treat on average more difficult patients and are compensated for doing so.
10.1111/jems.70035.abstract_zh: 本文研究大型医疗采购方向医疗服务提供者提供的合同。合同基于诊断相关分组（DRG）原则，即同一诊断组内的所有住院治疗均按相同费率报销。然而在实践中，这一原则有所放宽——在多个案例中，每个DRG内的报销金额呈现出显著差异。我们构建了一个理论模型，将这种差异解释为卫生当局为确保医院与患者之间实现恰当匹配的尝试。我们利用意大利最大地区极为详尽的管理数据集对模型进行检验。与理论结果一致，我们发现，国家资助的采购方向提供者提供了一套激励机制：根据最优性要求，治疗患者数量越多的提供者，其每次治疗的平均报销金额越高，这表明他们平均治疗了病情更复杂的患者，并因此获得相应补偿。
10.1111/jems.70035.title: Optimal Healthcare Contracts: Theory and Empirical Evidence
10.1111/jems.70035.title_zh: 最优医疗保健合同：理论与实证证据

10.1111/jems.70037.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We investigate input price discrimination under secret contracting between a manufacturer and competing retailers, whose investment activities exhibit retail effort spillovers. We show that the economic effects of input price discrimination vary with the sign and magnitude of retail effort spillovers according to the contractual structure, namely, linear or two‐part tariffs. Retail effort spillovers and product differentiation affect the pass‐through of input price to retail quantity, which is defined under each contractual structure. Our analysis provides novel insights into the role of retail effort spillovers and into the evaluation of quantity pass‐through in the antitrust scrutiny of input price discrimination.</jats:p>
10.1111/jems.70037.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文研究了制造商与竞争性零售商之间秘密合同下的投入品价格歧视问题，其中零售商的投资活动存在零售努力溢出效应。研究表明，投入品价格歧视的经济效应随零售努力溢出的正负及大小而变化，且这种变化取决于合同结构（线性关税或两部收费制）。零售努力溢出与产品差异化会影响投入品价格向零售数量的传导效应，该传导效应在不同合同结构下具有不同定义。本文分析为理解零售努力溢出的作用机制，以及反垄断审查中评估数量传导效应对投入品价格歧视的影响提供了全新视角。
10.1111/jems.70037.title: Input Price Discrimination: The Role of Retail Effort Spillovers
10.1111/jems.70037.title_zh: 投入品价格歧视：零售努力溢出效应的作用

10.1111/jems.70038.abstract: Off‐label use regulation has the potential to change pharmaceutical firms' behavior and—consequently—affect patient welfare. We investigate the impact of changes in off‐label regulation on pharmaceutical firms' behavior in seeking formal marketing approval for supplemental uses. In 2012, a US court decision protected truthful off‐label promotion, providing pharmaceutical companies more leeway to promote off‐label uses of their drug. Using a unique data set of pharmaceutical firms' research and development projects, we exploit this regulatory change to understand how firms react to government policies. Results demonstrate that the hazard of approval declined for supplemental uses, relative to original uses, after the policy change. Patent protection, potential market size, and competition are also important determinants of the hazard of approval. These results have implications not only for innovation policy but for the creation of high‐quality data for certain indications.
10.1111/jems.70038.abstract_zh: 超说明书用药监管可能改变制药企业的行为，进而影响患者福利。本文研究了超说明书用药监管变化对制药企业寻求补充用途正式上市许可行为的影响。2012年美国一项法院裁决保护了真实的超说明书推广行为，使制药公司获得更大空间推广其药物的超说明书用途。我们利用制药企业研发项目的独特数据集，借助这一监管变化来理解企业如何应对政府政策。结果表明，政策变化后，补充用途相较于原始用途的获批风险有所下降。专利保护、潜在市场规模和竞争也是影响获批风险的重要因素。这些发现不仅对创新政策具有启示意义，也对特定适应症高质量数据的生成产生影响。
10.1111/jems.70038.title: Strategic Submissions: An Analysis of Supplemental Drug Approvals
10.1111/jems.70038.title_zh: 策略性提交：补充药物批准的分析

10.1111/jems.70039.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    This study empirically examines the effects of High Involvement Management (
                    <jats:italic>HIM</jats:italic>
                    ) on establishment productivity. To achieve this it draws on a large‐scale panel data set representative of the German economy. The identification strategy exploits the bracketing property of fixed effects and lagged dependent variable models and supplements this with a selection‐on‐observables approach to estimate causal effects. Descriptive evidence indicates that decision makers value the joint implementation of the pillars of HIM (
                    <jats:italic>Knowledge</jats:italic>
                    ,
                    <jats:italic>Power</jats:italic>
                    ,
                    <jats:italic>Information</jats:italic>
                    , and
                    <jats:italic>Rewards</jats:italic>
                    ), as they tend to cluster and factor analysis confirms that the included management practices reflect a single underlying management orientation. The causal analysis reveals significant productivity gains from
                    <jats:italic>HIM</jats:italic>
                    and each of its four pillars. These effects materialize for
                    <jats:italic>HIM</jats:italic>
                    adoption,
                    <jats:italic>HIM</jats:italic>
                    intensification and the presence of a
                    <jats:italic>HIM</jats:italic>
                    philosophy. While the results are in line with a monotonically increasing effect as additional pillars are adopted, no synergies between the pillars or underlying practices emerge. Finally, the findings reveal no meaningful differences in the effectiveness of
                    <jats:italic>HIM</jats:italic>
                    across establishment size, sector, knowledge intensity, or innovation strategy, suggesting that its impact is broadly consistent across organizational contexts.
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/jems.70039.abstract_zh: 本研究利用代表德国经济的大型面板数据集，实证检验了高参与管理（HIM）对机构生产率的影响。识别策略利用固定效应和滞后因变量模型的区间估计特性，并辅以基于可观测变量的选择方法以估计因果效应。描述性证据表明，决策者重视HIM四大支柱（知识、权力、信息与奖励）的协同实施——这些支柱往往呈现聚类特征，且因子分析证实所涵盖的管理实践反映单一潜在管理导向。因果分析揭示HIM及其四大支柱均能带来显著的生产率提升。这些效应体现在HIM的采纳、强化以及HIM理念的存在性上。研究结果与“随支柱采纳数量增加而单调递增”的效应模式一致，但未发现支柱间或基础实践间存在协同效应。最后，研究发现HIM的有效性在机构规模、行业类型、知识密集度或创新战略维度上均无显著差异，表明其影响在不同组织情境中具有广泛一致性。

10.1111/jems.70040.abstract: Using staggered state‐level changes in noncompete enforceability, we document that reduced enforcement increases profitability, valuation, productivity, and plant‐level growth in knowledge‐worker‐intensive firms relative to other firms. Critically, these gains are concentrated among the most productive knowledge‐worker firms, consistent with an assortative matching mechanism in which top firms attract the most productive workers when noncompetes no longer bind. Using inventor‐level data, we find direct evidence of this sorting: more productive inventors migrate toward more productive firms following reductions in enforceability. Consequently, performance dispersion widens across knowledge‐worker‐intensive industries, as the most productive firms pull further ahead of their less productive peers.
10.1111/jems.70040.abstract_zh: 利用各州对竞业限制可执行性的交错调整，我们研究发现：相较于其他企业，降低竞业限制执行力度会提升知识密集型企业的盈利能力、估值、生产率及工厂层面的增长。关键的是，这些收益集中在最具生产力的知识密集型企业中，这与"分类匹配机制"的推论一致——当竞业限制不再具有约束力时，顶尖企业能够吸引最具生产力的劳动者。基于发明者层面的数据，我们发现了这种分类效应的直接证据：在竞业限制执行力度降低后，更具生产力的发明者会向更具生产力的企业迁移。由此，知识密集型行业内的绩效差距持续扩大，最具生产力的企业进一步拉开与低效同行的差距。
10.1111/jems.70040.title: Worker Heterogeneity and the Effect of Noncompetes on Firm Performance
10.1111/jems.70040.title_zh: 工人异质性与竞业限制对企业绩效的影响

10.1111/jmcb.13095.abstract: We examine the social and agent‐specific welfare effects of monetary and macroprudential policy in a four‐agent estimated macro‐economic model comprising “ banked simple households ,” “ underbanked simple households ,” “ firm owners ,” and “ bank owners .” Optimal capital requirement and loan loss provisions ratios improve all agent‐specific and social welfare, but imply smaller gains for simple households and firm owners that rely on credit. Countercyclical capital buffers support firm owners and bank owners with smaller gains for the two simple households, while countercyclical loan loss provisions improve social welfare only for specific shocks. Coordination between monetary and macroprudential policies yields higher social welfare than no coordination.
10.1111/jmcb.13095.abstract_zh: 我们考察了货币政策和宏观审慎政策在包含“银行化简单家庭”、“非银行化简单家庭”、“企业主”和“银行所有者”四类主体的估计宏观经济模型中的社会及主体特定福利效应。最优资本充足率和贷款损失准备金比率能够改善所有主体特定福利及社会福利，但对依赖信贷的简单家庭和企业主而言，其福利改善幅度较小。逆周期资本缓冲有利于企业主和银行所有者，但对两类简单家庭的福利改善较小；而逆周期贷款损失准备金仅在特定冲击下才能提升社会福利。货币政策与宏观审慎政策之间的协调比不协调能带来更高的社会福利。
10.1111/jmcb.13095.title: Monetary and Macroprudential Policy and Welfare in an Estimated Four‐Agent New Keynesian Model
10.1111/jmcb.13095.title_zh: 估计四主体新凯恩斯模型中的货币与宏观审慎政策及福利

10.1111/jmcb.13198.abstract: We produce the first measure of Divisia money for Mexico. Various structural VAR identifications with Divisia M4 as an indicator of monetary policy yield responses of production and prices that are in every case at least as sensible as—and generally offer an improvement over—their counterpart specifications with a short‐term offer rate as the indicator. Importantly, we find that our Divisia specifications do not require expanding the model's information set with commodity prices or the real exchange rate for a resolution of the price puzzle. We reach similar conclusions for Mexico to those Keating et al. (2019) arrive at for the U.S. economy.
10.1111/jmcb.13198.abstract_zh: 我们构建了墨西哥首个Divisia货币度量指标。采用多种结构VAR识别方法，以Divisia M4作为货币政策指标，所得产出与价格响应在各类情形下至少与以短期利率为指标的对应设定同样合理，且通常表现更优。重要的是，我们发现Divisia设定无需在模型信息集中加入大宗商品价格或实际汇率即可解决价格之谜。我们得出的关于墨西哥的结论，与Keating等人（2019）针对美国经济的研究发现相呼应。

10.1111/jmcb.13212.abstract: We build a two‐country currency union dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model with endogenous growth to assess the role of product market regulation (PMR) and labor market regulation (LMR) for growth and the adjustment to shocks. We show that with endogenous growth, there is no reason to expect real income convergence. Large shocks can lead to permanent changes of output and real exchange rates. Differences are exacerbated by different PMR and LMR. Less regulated economies have higher trend growth and recover faster from negative shocks. Results are consistent with higher inflation, lower employment, and disappointing total factor productivity (TFP) growth rates experienced in more regulated euro area members.
10.1111/jmcb.13212.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含内生增长的两国货币联盟动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，以评估产品市场监管（PMR）和劳动力市场监管（LMR）对经济增长及冲击调整的作用。研究表明，在内生增长条件下，实际收入趋同并无必然性。大规模冲击可能导致产出与实际汇率的永久性变化。不同的产品市场监管与劳动力市场监管会加剧这种差异。监管程度较低的经济体具有更高的趋势增长率，且能从负面冲击中更快恢复。这一结果与监管更严格的欧元区成员国所经历的高通胀、低就业以及令人失望的全要素生产率（TFP）增长率表现相一致。
10.1111/jmcb.13212.title: Market Regulation, Cycles, and Growth Dynamics in a Monetary Union
10.1111/jmcb.13212.title_zh: 货币联盟中的市场监管、周期与增长动态

10.1111/jmcb.13216.abstract: This paper shows that the supply side of credit is a major factor for hampered monetary policy transmission in monopolistic banking markets. Our stress test data containing projected interest rates of all 1,555 small and medium‐sized banks in Germany under two hypothetical scenarios provide a clear way to partial out demand shocks that are unrelated to monetary policy; we are thus able to show that while market power banks charge higher loan rates, they spare their borrowers a part of exogenous monetary policy contractions and withhold a substantial part of rising rates from their depositors. Because high market power banks are relatively more profitable, these banks could be able to insure their relationship customers against adverse shocks.
