10.1111/jmcb.70064.abstract_zh: 本文在包含金融摩擦与污染外部性的动态随机一般均衡模型中，研究了两种替代性碳定价政策——碳税与总量控制与交易机制——如何影响宏观经济动态及经济周期的福利成本。金融摩擦在塑造经济周期冲击跨碳定价机制传导路径中发挥关键作用。研究发现，在存在金融摩擦的情况下，总量控制与交易机制下的福利成本通常低于碳税政策，原因在于其顺周期性的排放配额价格能够抑制金融加速器效应。随着信贷市场效率提升或逆周期宏观审慎监管削弱冲击传导机制，两种政策间的福利差距将逐步收窄。
10.1111/jmcb.70064.title: Climate Policies, Macroprudential Regulation, and the Welfare Cost of Business Cycles
10.1111/jmcb.70064.title_zh: 气候政策、宏观审慎监管与商业周期的福利成本

10.1111/jmcb.70065.abstract: I investigate the empirical asset pricing implications of a three‐factor macro model that extends the baseline consumption model Consumption Capital Asset Pricing Model (CCAPM) by adding the innovations in expected long‐run consumption growth (consumption growth news) and expected long‐run consumption variance (variance news) as risk factors. By using a reasonable cross‐section of equity risk premia, such a model is largely rejected (both on statistical and economic grounds), as the factor risk prices are either insignificant and/or economically implausible, whereas the pricing errors are very large. Thus, long‐run consumption risks (LRR) do not rescue the CCAPM, which represents a major challenge for the voluminous LRR literature.
10.1111/jmcb.70065.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个三因子宏观模型的实证资产定价含义，该模型在基准消费模型——消费资本资产定价模型（CCAPM）的基础上，将预期长期消费增长（消费增长新闻）和预期长期消费方差（方差新闻）的冲击作为风险因子。通过使用合理的横截面股权风险溢价，该模型在统计和经济层面均被显著拒绝，因为因子风险价格要么不显著，要么在经济上不合理，而定价误差则非常大。因此，长期消费风险（LRR）未能挽救CCAPM，这对大量LRR文献构成了重大挑战。
10.1111/jmcb.70065.title: Another Look at the (Ir)Relevance of Long‐Run Risks for Equity Risk Premia
10.1111/jmcb.70065.title_zh: 长期风险对股权风险溢价的（不）相关性再审视

10.1111/jmcb.70066.abstract: In this paper, we propose incorporating both self‐fundamentals, defined as the fundamentals of two economies in one currency pair, and cross‐fundamentals, defined as the fundamentals of other major economies, to forecast exchange rates in line with the theory of “third‐country effects” of Berg and Mark (2015). We utilize the Mallows model averaging method proposed in Hansen (2007) to optimally combine the predictions provided by fundamental submodels. We find that our approach significantly outperforms the random walk and the alternatives for one‐month‐ahead predictions and that both the self‐ and cross‐fundamentals play important roles in prediction. Furthermore, according to our prediction, we obtain meaningful investment profit trading on currencies and bonds.
10.1111/jmcb.70066.abstract_zh: 本文提出将“自身基本面”（定义为货币对中两个经济体的基本面）与“交叉基本面”（定义为其他主要经济体的基本面）相结合，以预测汇率，这与Berg和Mark（2015）提出的“第三国效应”理论一致。我们采用Hansen（2007）提出的Mallows模型平均方法，对基本面子模型提供的预测进行最优组合。研究发现，该方法在提前一个月的预测中显著优于随机游走模型及其他替代模型，且自身基本面与交叉基本面均在预测中发挥重要作用。此外，基于我们的预测，在货币和债券交易中可获得显著的投资利润。
10.1111/jmcb.70066.title: Self‐Fundamentals, Cross‐Fundamentals, and Exchange Rate Predictions
10.1111/jmcb.70066.title_zh: 自我基本面、交叉基本面与汇率预测

10.1111/jmcb.70067.abstract: Activity shortfalls are more costly than strong activity. I consider optimal monetary policy under discretion with an asymmetric (shortfalls) loss function in a natural rate model. The optimal monetary policy exacerbates shortfalls, owing to the adjustment of expectations implied by the natural rate hypothesis, and leads to an inflationary bias. Mandating a central bank objective with greater symmetry lowers activity shortfalls and inflation bias. The model also implies that an optimal monetary policy does not accommodate fluctuations from aggregate demand shocks. The analysis implies that monetary accommodation of strong economic activity requires justifications other than asymmetric costs of shortfalls.
10.1111/jmcb.70067.abstract_zh: 活动缺口比强劲活动代价更高。本文在自然率模型下，考虑具有非对称（缺口）损失函数的相机抉择最优货币政策。由于自然率假说所隐含的预期调整，最优货币政策会加剧活动缺口，并导致通胀偏差。设定更具对称性的央行目标可降低活动缺口与通胀偏差。该模型还表明，最优货币政策不会对总需求冲击引发的波动进行调节。分析表明，对强劲经济活动的货币调节需要以缺口非对称成本之外的理由作为依据。
10.1111/jmcb.70067.title: Monetary Policy, Employment Shortfalls, and the Natural Rate Hypothesis
10.1111/jmcb.70067.title_zh: 货币政策、就业缺口与自然率假说

10.1111/jmcb.70068.abstract: The European Union Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) experienced sharp allowance price increases from 2018 onward, prompting claims that rational bubbles were driving the surge. We reassess this hypothesis using expectations based on futures prices. We modify an existing testing approach under risk‐neutrality and show that this version of the test is valid in the presence of a dynamic risk premium and robust when the underlying fundamental exhibits a unit root or mildly explosive behavior. Using weekly spot and futures data from 2013 to 2023, we find no evidence of rational bubbles. The evidence is consistent with shifting allowance‐scarcity expectations.
10.1111/jmcb.70068.abstract_zh: 欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）自2018年起经历了配额价格大幅上涨，引发关于理性泡沫推动价格飙升的论断。我们基于期货价格所反映的预期重新评估了这一假说。通过修正风险中性条件下的现有检验方法，我们证明该检验版本在存在动态风险溢价时依然有效，且当基础基本面呈现单位根或轻度爆炸性行为时具有稳健性。基于2013年至2023年的周度现货与期货数据，我们未发现理性泡沫的证据。研究结果与配额稀缺性预期变化这一解释相一致。
10.1111/jmcb.70068.title: EU ETS Market Expectations and Rational Bubbles
10.1111/jmcb.70068.title_zh: 欧盟排放交易体系市场预期与理性泡沫

10.1111/jmcb.70069.abstract: We study the two‐way relationship between fixed‐rate mortgages (FRMs) and monetary policy in a panel of up to 35 countries observed over the last two decades. The data set includes quarterly information on the composition of mortgage flows and stocks by type of rate‐fixation and monetary policy shocks cleaned of information effects. Using instrumental‐variable local projections, we show that FRMs induce both path‐ and state‐dependency in monetary transmission. Changes in policy rates shape mortgage choice, increasing (decreasing) the share of FRMs during easing (tightening) cycles. Over time, this mechanism alters the composition of the outstanding mortgage stock which, in turn, affects the central bank's ability to stabilize the economy ex‐post . A greater (lower) prevalence of FRMs weakens (strengthens) monetary policy transmission to real private consumption and GDP.
10.1111/jmcb.70069.abstract_zh: 本文基于过去二十年间最多35个国家的面板数据，研究了固定利率抵押贷款（FRMs）与货币政策之间的双向关系。数据集包含按利率固定类型划分的抵押贷款流量与存量的季度信息，以及剔除信息效应后的货币政策冲击。通过工具变量局部投影法，我们证明FRMs在货币政策传导中同时引发路径依赖与状态依赖。政策利率的变化会塑造抵押贷款选择：在宽松（紧缩）周期中，FRMs占比上升（下降）。随着时间推移，这一机制改变了未偿还抵押贷款存量的构成，进而影响央行事后稳定经济的能力。FRMs的较高（较低）普及率会削弱（增强）货币政策向实际私人消费与GDP的传导效果。
10.1111/jmcb.70069.title: Long‐Term Debt and Short‐Term Rates: Fixed‐Rate Mortgages and Monetary Transmission
10.1111/jmcb.70069.title_zh: 长期债务与短期利率：固定利率抵押贷款与货币政策传导

10.1111/jmcb.70070.abstract: We investigate monetary policy transmission and energy saving incentives in response to rising energy prices. We add energy in consumption and production, and energy conservation capital, to a tractable New Keynesian model with heterogeneous agents, unemployment risk, and nominal asset holdings. We find that monetary policy influences the energy conservation through both unemployment risk and asset returns; energy price shocks intensify monetary policy trade‐offs in terms of stabilizing inflation and output. A weaker policy response is beneficial in terms of agents' welfare despite higher inflation. The Ramsey policy predicts a strong rise in the policy rate with a decline afterward.
10.1111/jmcb.70070.abstract_zh: 本文研究了能源价格上涨背景下货币政策的传导机制与节能激励。我们将能源纳入消费与生产环节，并引入节能资本，构建了一个包含异质性主体、失业风险与名义资产持有的可处理新凯恩斯模型。研究发现：货币政策通过失业风险与资产回报双重渠道影响节能行为；能源价格冲击加剧了货币政策在稳定通胀与产出之间的权衡。尽管通胀水平上升，但较弱的政策响应更有利于提升主体福利。拉姆齐政策预测政策利率将先大幅上升后回落。
10.1111/jmcb.70070.title: A Heterogeneous Agent Model of Energy Consumption and Energy Conservation
10.1111/jmcb.70070.title_zh: 能源消费与节能的异质性主体模型

10.1111/jmcb.70071.abstract: Using a continuous‐time overlapping generations model with semi‐endogenous growth, this study analyzes the impact of population aging on income inequality. We characterize the stationary distributions of household income and wealth and examine how increases in life expectancy and declines in fertility rates affect these distributions. Numerical simulations indicate that longer life expectancy reduces inequality, whereas lower fertility rates increase it. We further explore the distributional effects of exogenous productivity growth under varying degrees of population aging.
10.1111/jmcb.70071.abstract_zh: 本研究采用包含半内生增长的连续时间世代交叠模型，分析人口老龄化对收入不平等的影响。我们刻画了家庭收入与财富的稳态分布特征，并考察预期寿命延长和生育率下降如何影响这些分布。数值模拟表明，预期寿命延长会降低不平等程度，而生育率下降则会加剧不平等。我们进一步探讨了在不同人口老龄化程度下，外生生产率增长对收入分配的影响。
10.1111/jmcb.70071.title:
Population Aging and Income Inequality in a Semi‐Endogenous Growth Model
                    <sup>*</sup>
10.1111/jmcb.70071.title_zh: 半内生增长模型中的人口老龄化与收入不平等

10.1111/jmcb.70072.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    This paper argues that lower government debt issuance is equivalent to a central bank–operated asset purchase program, commonly known as quantitative easing (QE), as both reduce anticipated future bond supply. However, as it involves neither asset purchases nor associated reserves creation, it is labeled
                    <jats:italic>passive</jats:italic>
                    QE. A novel classification scheme of central bank balance sheet policies ranks passive QE as stimulative. Supportive evidence from a temporary lowering of government debt issuance in Denmark suggests that declines in long‐term yields reflected both reduced term premia, consistent with supply‐induced portfolio balance effects, and increased safety premia, consistent with safe assets scarcity effects.
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/jmcb.70072.abstract_zh: 本文认为，政府债务发行减少与央行操作的资产购买计划（即通常所称的量化宽松，QE）具有等效性，因为两者均会降低预期的未来债券供给。然而，由于该过程既不涉及资产购买，也不产生相应的准备金创造，因此被称为**被动型**量化宽松。本文提出了一种新的央行资产负债表政策分类框架，将被动型量化宽松归类为具有刺激效应的政策。来自丹麦临时性降低政府债务发行的实证证据表明，长期收益率下降既反映了期限溢价的降低（与供给驱动的投资组合平衡效应一致），也反映了安全溢价的上升（与安全资产稀缺效应一致）。
10.1111/jmcb.70072.title: Passive Quantitative Easing: Bond Supply Effects through Lower Debt Issuance
10.1111/jmcb.70072.title_zh: 被动量化宽松：通过降低债务发行实现的债券供给效应

10.1111/jmcb.70073.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study investigates the impact of central bank transparency (CBT) on foreign exchange market vulnerability, measured by exchange market pressure (EMP). Using panel autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) analysis on a sample of 32 countries, the results show that greater CBT significantly reduces EMP. The findings remain robust after controlling for U.S. monetary policy uncertainty, economic policy uncertainty, and financial development. However, no evidence is found that CBT becomes more effective during periods of heightened uncertainty. Further analysis indicates that exchange rate flexibility and financial integration strengthen the mitigating effect of CBT on EMP in emerging markets but not in developed markets.</jats:p>
10.1111/jmcb.70073.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了中央银行透明度（CBT）对外汇市场脆弱性（以汇率市场压力（EMP）衡量）的影响。通过对32个国家的面板自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型分析，结果表明，更高的中央银行透明度显著降低了汇率市场压力。在控制美国货币政策不确定性、经济政策不确定性和金融发展水平后，该结论依然稳健。然而，未发现中央银行透明度在不确定性加剧时期更为有效的证据。进一步分析表明，汇率灵活性和金融一体化增强了中央银行透明度对新兴市场汇率市场压力的缓解效应，但在发达市场中并不显著。
10.1111/jmcb.70073.title: Does Central Bank Transparency Curb Foreign Exchange Vulnerability?
10.1111/jmcb.70073.title_zh: 中央银行透明度能否抑制外汇脆弱性？

10.1111/jmcb.70074.abstract: We use recent cross‐country experiences to assess the impact of shrinking central bank balance sheets through quantitative tightening (QT). QT announcements increase government bond yields, steepening the yield curve and potentially signaling a greater commitment to raising policy interest rates, but have more limited effects on most other financial market indicators. Active QT has a larger impact than passive QT, particularly on longer maturities. Increased demand by domestic nonbanks has largely compensated for reduced central bank bond holdings. Overall, QT has (to date) had more of an impact than “paint drying,” but far less than simply reversing the effects of quantitative easing programs.
10.1111/jmcb.70074.abstract_zh: 我们利用近期跨国经验评估了通过量化紧缩（QT）缩减央行资产负债表的影响。QT公告推高了政府债券收益率，使收益率曲线陡峭化，并可能释放出更坚定加息的政策承诺信号，但对大多数其他金融市场指标的影响较为有限。主动型QT比被动型QT影响更大，尤其在长期限债券方面。国内非银行机构需求的增加在很大程度上弥补了央行债券持有量的减少。总体而言，QT（迄今为止）的影响远非“乏善可陈”，但远未达到简单逆转量化宽松政策效果的程度。
10.1111/jmcb.70074.title: Quantitative Tightening Around the Globe: What Have We Learned?
10.1111/jmcb.70074.title_zh: 全球量化紧缩：我们学到了什么？

10.1111/jmcb.70075.abstract: This paper shows that forecasts from professional economists in the Livingston survey imply countercyclical variation in expected excess returns on U.S. stocks. These expectations are approximately rational and strongly positively correlated with expected excess returns from the log‐utility investor of Martin (2017), the habit model of Campbell and Cochrane (1999), and the long‐run risk model of Bansal and Yaron (2004). The Livingston survey also implies countercyclical cash flow expectations based on forecasts of tax‐adjusted corporate profits. However, this feature is not matched by either the habit or the long‐run risk model.
10.1111/jmcb.70075.abstract_zh: 本文表明，利文斯顿调查中专业经济学家的预测暗示了美国股票预期超额收益的反周期变动。这些预期大致理性，并与马丁（2017）的对数效用投资者、坎贝尔和科克伦（1999）的习惯模型以及班萨尔和亚龙（2004）的长期风险模型所隐含的预期超额收益呈强烈正相关。利文斯顿调查还基于对税后企业利润的预测，暗示了现金流预期的反周期特征。然而，这一特征并未在习惯模型或长期风险模型中得到体现。
10.1111/jmcb.70075.title: Countercyclical Return Expectations: Evidence from the Livingston Survey
10.1111/jmcb.70075.title_zh: 逆周期收益预期：来自利文斯顿调查的证据

10.1111/jmcb.70076.abstract: This paper shows that dollar appreciations reduce GDP, investment, and private credit in emerging market economies, and documents the relative contribution and dynamics of four transmission channels, finding that financial channels dominate trade channels. Higher dollar‐denominated credit generates persistent contractions, with GDP falling 0.3 and investment 0.5 percentage points in the medium term. Low monetary policy credibility amplifies the initial GDP contraction by 0.2–0.3 percentage points, but only in the short run. The traditional Mundell–Fleming trade channel is muted, as dominant currency pricing and global value chain integration weaken the link between exchange rates and trade flows.
10.1111/jmcb.70076.abstract_zh: 本文表明，美元升值会降低新兴市场经济体的GDP、投资和私人信贷，并记录了四种传导渠道的相对贡献与动态变化，发现金融渠道主导了贸易渠道。以美元计价的信贷增加会引发持续性收缩，中期内GDP下降0.3个百分点，投资下降0.5个百分点。低货币政策可信度会使初始GDP收缩幅度扩大0.2-0.3个百分点，但仅限于短期。传统的蒙代尔-弗莱明贸易渠道作用减弱，因为主导货币定价与全球价值链整合削弱了汇率与贸易流动之间的关联。
10.1111/jmcb.70076.title: The Dollar and Emerging Market Economies: Channels and Impacts
10.1111/jmcb.70076.title_zh: 美元与新兴市场经济体：传导渠道与影响

10.1111/jmcb.70077.abstract: We analyze foreign exchange (FX) trading on FIFA World Cup game days in comparison to “normal” days. The FX market is an interesting case to study, as it has an institutional feature that allows participants to shift their trading needs to a counterparty bank so that the bank executes the trades at the London 4 p.m. fix. This “trade‐shifting” allows the client to avoid actively managing their trades and spend more time on World Cup‐related events. Using data from two different sources (EBS and CLS), we document this behavior and find that the effects are statistically and economically significant.
10.1111/jmcb.70077.abstract_zh: 本文分析了国际足联世界杯比赛日与“正常”日的外汇交易行为。外汇市场是值得研究的有趣案例，因其制度特征允许参与者将交易需求转移至对手方银行，由该银行在伦敦下午4点定盘价时执行交易。这种“交易转移”机制使客户无需主动管理交易，从而将更多时间投入世界杯相关活动。基于两个不同数据源（EBS和CLS）的实证分析，我们记录了这一行为，并发现其影响在统计和经济意义上均具有显著性。
10.1111/jmcb.70077.title: Foreign Exchange Trading During World Cup Events (or I will watch the game while you trade)
10.1111/jmcb.70077.title_zh: 世界杯赛事期间的外汇交易（或：你看比赛我交易）

10.1111/jmcb.70078.abstract: This paper studies how progressive fiscal policy shapes monetary policy in a heterogeneous‐agent economy. Progressive labor taxation, though distortionary, can mitigate the inflation bias of monetary policy by redistributing income. I examine this commitment channel through the lens of political conflict. When agents vote on monetary and fiscal instruments, progressivity curbs inflation bias by creating distributional tensions: lower productivity agents support higher labor taxes to protect the value of money holdings and shift tax distortions toward higher productivity agents. Anticipating lower inflation, all agents ultimately prefer adopting a progressive fiscal system.
10.1111/jmcb.70078.abstract_zh: 本文研究累进性财政政策如何在异质性主体经济中塑造货币政策。尽管累进劳动税具有扭曲效应，但可通过收入再分配缓解货币政策的通胀偏差。本文通过政治冲突视角考察这一承诺渠道。当经济主体对货币与财政工具进行投票时，累进税制通过制造分配性张力抑制通胀偏差：低生产率主体支持提高劳动税以保护货币持有价值，并将税收扭曲转嫁给高生产率主体。由于预期通胀水平降低，所有经济主体最终都倾向于采用累进性财政体系。
10.1111/jmcb.70078.title: Fiscal Progressivity and the Time Consistency of Monetary Policy
10.1111/jmcb.70078.title_zh: 财政累进性与货币政策的时间一致性

10.1111/jofi.70040.abstract: Combining a randomized controlled trial with administrative and survey data, this paper shows that credit limit extensions significantly increase total spending and income expectations. By controlling for changes in personal income expectations, the spending response to credit limit extensions weakens by approximately 30%. For financially unconstrained consumers, expectation changes account for around two‐thirds of the spending responses to limit extensions. These findings are consistent with consumers inferring future income from credit supply.
10.1111/jofi.70040.abstract_zh: 本文通过将随机对照试验与行政及调查数据相结合，发现信用额度提升显著增加了总支出和收入预期。在控制个人收入预期变化后，信用额度提升对支出的影响减弱约30%。对于财务不受约束的消费者而言，预期变化解释了约三分之二的额度提升支出反应。这些发现与消费者从信贷供给中推断未来收入的推论一致。
10.1111/jofi.70040.title: Learning in the Limit: Income Inference from Credit Extensions
10.1111/jofi.70040.title_zh: 极限学习：从信贷扩展中推断收入

10.1111/jofi.70042.abstract: Republicans start more firms than Democrats. In a sample of 40 million party‐identified Americans between 2005 and 2017, we find that 5.5% of Republicans and 3.7% of Democrats become entrepreneurs. This partisan entrepreneurship gap is time‐varying—Republicans increase their relative entrepreneurship during Republican administrations and decrease it during Democratic administrations, amounting to a partisan reallocation of 170,000 new firms over our 13‐year sample. We find sharp changes in partisan entrepreneurship around the elections of President Obama and President Trump, with the strongest effects among the most politically active partisans: those that donate and vote.
10.1111/jofi.70042.abstract_zh: 共和党人比民主党人创办了更多企业。在2005年至2017年间4000万有党派归属的美国人的样本中，我们发现5.5%的共和党人和3.7%的民主党人成为企业家。这种党派创业差距具有时变性——共和党人在共和党执政期间相对创业率上升，在民主党执政期间下降，在我们的13年样本期内，这相当于17万家新企业的党派间重新配置。我们发现，在奥巴马总统和特朗普总统当选前后，党派创业行为发生了急剧变化，其中对政治参与度最高的党派成员（即捐款和投票者）影响最为显著。
10.1111/jofi.70042.title: Partisan Entrepreneurship

10.1111/jofi.70043.abstract: Using two decades of French administrative data, we find that post‐leveraged buyout (LBO), target firms reduce within‐firm pay gaps while increasing profitability relative to control firms. Employee turnover drives the pay‐gap reduction. In target and control firms alike, turnovers reduce average pay more at the top of the wage distribution than at the bottom because separated employees are paid more—new joiners less—than similar employees, especially among skilled employees. LBOs amplify this effect through increased turnover among managers. Post‐buyout, p90/p10, gender, age, and managers/non‐managers pay gaps decline by 3%, 9%, 21%, and 4% and the employee pool becomes younger.
10.1111/jofi.70043.abstract_zh: 利用法国二十年的行政数据，我们发现，在杠杆收购（LBO）后，目标企业相较于对照组企业，在提升盈利能力的同时缩小了企业内部薪酬差距。员工流动是薪酬差距缩小的主要驱动因素。在目标企业与对照组企业中，员工流动对工资分布顶端平均薪酬的削减效应均强于底端，这是因为离职员工的薪酬高于同类在职员工，而新入职员工的薪酬则低于同类在职员工——这一现象在技能型员工中尤为显著。杠杆收购通过增加管理层的流动率放大了这一效应。收购完成后，p90/p10薪酬比、性别薪酬差距、年龄薪酬差距及管理层/非管理层薪酬差距分别下降3%、9%、21%和4%，员工队伍呈现年轻化趋势。
10.1111/jofi.70043.title: Private Equity and Pay Gaps Inside the Firm
10.1111/jofi.70043.title_zh: 私募股权与企业内部薪酬差距

10.1111/jofi.70044.abstract: Using information in returns, we identify the stochastic process of consumption. We find that aggregate consumption reacts over multiple quarters to innovations spanned by financial markets. This persistent component accounts for over a quarter of consumption variation. These shocks command a large and significant risk premium, driving a large share of stocks' and a small yet significant fraction of bonds' time‐series variation. Nevertheless, we find no support for stochastic volatility of consumption driving time‐varying risk premia. Finally, an otherwise standard recursive utility model based on our estimated process explains equity premium and risk‐free rate puzzles with low‐risk aversion.
10.1111/jofi.70044.abstract_zh: 利用收益率中的信息，我们识别了消费的随机过程。研究发现，总体消费对金融市场所涵盖的冲击会持续多个季度作出反应。这一持久性成分解释了超过四分之一的消费波动。这些冲击具有显著且规模较大的风险溢价，驱动了股票时间序列变化的主要部分以及债券时间序列变化中虽小但显著的部分。然而，我们并未发现消费的随机波动性驱动时变风险溢价的证据。最后，基于我们估计过程的递归效用模型（在其他方面均为标准设定）在低风险厌恶水平下解释了股权溢价和无风险利率之谜。
10.1111/jofi.70044.title: Consumption in Asset Returns

10.1111/jofi.70045.abstract: We infer risk‐free rates from index option prices to estimate safe asset convenience yields in 10 G11 currencies. Countries' convenience yields increase with the level of their interest rates, with U.S. convenience yields fifth largest. During financial crises, convenience yields grow, but the difference between United States and foreign convenience yields generally does not. Covered interest parity (CIP) deviations using our option‐implied rates are a similar size between the United States and each other country. A model in which convenience yields depend on domestic financial intermediaries, but CIP deviations reflect the funding costs of international arbitrageurs financed with dollar‐denominated debt, explains these results.
10.1111/jofi.70045.abstract_zh: 我们从指数期权价格中推断无风险利率，以估算10种G11货币的安全资产便利收益率。各国的便利收益率随其利率水平上升而增加，其中美国的便利收益率位列第五。在金融危机期间，便利收益率上升，但美国与外国便利收益率之间的差异通常并未扩大。使用我们基于期权隐含利率计算的抛补利率平价（CIP）偏差，在美国与其他国家之间规模相近。一个模型解释了这些结果：便利收益率取决于国内金融中介机构，而CIP偏差则反映了以美元计价债务融资的国际套利者的融资成本。
10.1111/jofi.70045.title: Risk‐Free Rates and Convenience Yields around the World
10.1111/jofi.70045.title_zh: 全球无风险利率与便利收益

10.1111/jofi.70046.abstract: I propose a dynamic equilibrium model of rental markets that endogenously gives rise to defaults on rents and evictions. In the model, eviction protections make it harder to evict delinquent renters, but higher default costs to landlords increase equilibrium rents. I quantify the model using micro data on evictions, rents, and homelessness. I find that stronger eviction protections exacerbate housing insecurity and lower welfare. The key empirical driver of this result is the persistent nature of risk underlying rent delinquencies. Rental assistance reduces housing insecurity and improves welfare because it lowers the likelihood that renters default ex ante.
10.1111/jofi.70046.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个内生产生租金违约与驱逐现象的租赁市场动态均衡模型。模型中，驱逐保护政策提高了驱逐违约租户的难度，但房东承担的更高违约成本会推高均衡租金。我利用关于驱逐、租金和无家可归的微观数据对模型进行量化分析，发现强化驱逐保护会加剧住房不安全并降低社会福利。这一结果的关键实证驱动因素在于租金违约风险的持续性特征。租金援助通过降低租户事前违约概率，有效缓解住房不安全并提升社会福利。
10.1111/jofi.70046.title: The Equilibrium Effects of Eviction Policies

10.1111/jofi.70047.abstract: We introduce a simple measure of informed trading risk, , the residual to liquidity quote‐improvement‐to‐deterioration ratio times . When facing with increased informed trading risk, liquidity providers compete less to provide liquidity, reducing their undercutting activity. Reductions in undercutting leave footprints in trade and quote data that are captured by . Unlike prior measures, is easy to construct, can be computed intraday, and is orthogonal to liquidity. The measure outperforms prominent existing alternatives in reflecting the extent of information asymmetry before earnings announcements, predicting unscheduled press releases, and identifying informed trading spillovers around them.
10.1111/jofi.70047.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种衡量知情交易风险的简易指标，即流动性报价改善与恶化比率乘以的残差。当面临知情交易风险上升时，流动性提供者会减少流动性供给竞争，从而降低其削价行为。削价行为的减少会在交易与报价数据中留下可被该指标捕捉的痕迹。与以往指标不同，该指标易于构建、可日内计算，且与流动性正交。在反映盈余公告前信息不对称程度、预测非计划性新闻发布以及识别其引发的知情交易溢出效应方面，该指标优于现有主流替代指标。
10.1111/jofi.70047.title: Detecting Informed Trading Risk from Undercutting Activity
10.1111/jofi.70047.title_zh: 从压价行为中识别知情交易风险

10.1111/jofi.70048.abstract: Dealer quotes in corporate bonds, though indicative, lower trading costs and increase trading volume. Dealers offering higher quality quotes attract more order flow and execute trades at favorable prices. Dealers advertise quotes to manage their inventories and attract orders from nonrelationship clients. However, quote competition is imperfect. The best quotes often fail to attract orders, and trade‐throughs are common. Nevertheless, quote competition is important as clients exploit quotes from other dealers in negotiations, forcing dealers with lower quality quotes to offer price improvements. Quoting is not a zero‐sum game, as more active bond‐level quoting leads to more bond‐level trading.
10.1111/jofi.70048.abstract_zh: 公司债券中的交易商报价虽为指示性报价，却能降低交易成本并提升交易量。提供更优质报价的交易商能吸引更多订单流，并以有利价格执行交易。交易商通过报价来管理库存并吸引非关系型客户的订单。然而，报价竞争并不完美。最优报价往往未能吸引订单，且"穿透交易"现象普遍存在。尽管如此，报价竞争仍至关重要——客户会在谈判中利用其他交易商的报价，迫使报价质量较低的交易商提供价格改善。报价并非零和博弈，因为更活跃的债券层面报价会带来更多债券层面交易。
10.1111/jofi.70048.title: Quote Competition in Corporate Bonds
10.1111/jofi.70048.title_zh: 公司债券中的报价竞争

10.1111/jofi.70049.abstract: Using granular data covering both regulated (brokerage‐financed) and unregulated (shadow‐financed) margin accounts in China, we provide novel evidence on retail investors' margin trading behavior and its price implications. We first show that retail investors' decisions to lever up in stock trading despite the hefty borrowing cost is related to their lottery preferences. We then show that margin borrowing affects investors' trading behavior—investors are more likely to liquidate their holdings as they approach margin calls. Finally, we show that margin‐induced trading aggregates to affect asset prices and contributes to shock spillovers across stocks (e.g., from lottery stocks to nonlottery stocks).
10.1111/jofi.70049.abstract_zh: 利用涵盖中国受监管（券商融资）和未受监管（影子融资）保证金账户的颗粒化数据，我们提供了关于散户投资者保证金交易行为及其价格影响的新证据。首先，我们证明散户投资者在股票交易中尽管面临高昂的借贷成本仍选择加杠杆的行为，与其博彩偏好相关。其次，我们揭示保证金借贷会影响投资者的交易行为——当投资者接近追加保证金通知时，更倾向于抛售持仓。最后，我们证明由保证金驱动的交易会聚合影响资产价格，并加剧股票间的冲击溢出效应（例如，从博彩类股票向非博彩类股票传导）。
10.1111/jofi.70049.title: The Drivers and Implications of Retail Margin Trading
10.1111/jofi.70049.title_zh: 零售保证金交易的驱动因素及其影响

10.1111/jofi.70050.abstract: This paper documents a new stylized fact: the cross‐sectional variation in CEO pay levels has declined precipitously in recent years. We offer one explanation for this decline, namely, firms are increasingly benchmarking CEO compensation to industry peers closest in size, thereby creating pay clusters. Our empirical tests provide support for this explanation and suggest that the rise of industry‐size benchmarking is driven by three institutional factors: the mandatory disclosure of compensation peer groups, proxy advisory influence, and say‐on‐pay regulation. Our findings highlight a consequence of adopting a one‐size‐fits‐all standard in the pay‐setting process.
10.1111/jofi.70050.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了一个新的典型事实：近年来，CEO薪酬水平的截面差异急剧缩小。我们对此现象提出一种解释：企业日益倾向于以行业内规模最接近的同行作为薪酬基准，从而形成薪酬聚类。实证检验支持这一解释，并表明行业规模基准化的兴起由三项制度因素驱动：薪酬对标群体的强制披露、代理投票顾问的影响力以及薪酬话语权监管。研究结果凸显了在薪酬制定过程中采用"一刀切"标准所带来的后果。
10.1111/jofi.70050.title: Why Have CEO Pay Levels Become Less Diverse?
10.1111/jofi.70050.title_zh: 为何CEO薪酬水平变得不那么多样化？

10.1111/jofi.70051.abstract: We examine how digital disruption affects bank competition using the staggered rollout of 3G mobile networks. 3G expansion increased mobile banking adoption among tech‐savvy households, reducing branch networks—especially in younger counties. Banks' strategies diverged: Less branch‐reliant banks closed branches and competed on price, while more branch‐reliant banks maintained branches but raised spreads. A structural model shows that perceived digital service improvements among younger consumers drove these shifts, reducing welfare for older savers. Counterfactuals demonstrate that subsidizing adoption for older savers can cost‐effectively reduce these disparities, facilitating a smoother digital transition.
10.1111/jofi.70051.abstract_zh: 本文利用3G移动网络的分阶段推广，考察数字冲击如何影响银行竞争。3G网络的扩展提升了精通技术的家庭对移动银行的采用率，导致银行分支网络收缩——尤其在人口较年轻的县。银行策略出现分化：对分支依赖度较低的银行关闭网点并展开价格竞争，而对分支依赖度较高的银行则维持网点但提高利差。结构模型表明，年轻消费者对数字服务感知的改善驱动了这些变化，但降低了老年储户的福利。反事实分析显示，为老年储户提供采用补贴可低成本缩小此类差距，从而推动更平稳的数字转型。
10.1111/jofi.70051.title: Bank Competition Amid Digital Disruption: Implications for Financial Inclusion
10.1111/jofi.70051.title_zh: 数字冲击下的银行竞争：对金融包容性的影响

10.1111/jofi.70054.abstract: We show that FX interventions can be effective, particularly in attenuating global financial spillovers. We exploit global financial shocks and Brazilian central bank interventions in FX derivatives using three matched administrative registers: bank credit (to firms), foreign credit to banks, and employer‐employees. After the U.S. Taper Tantrum (followed by emerging markets' FX turbulence), Brazilian banks with more foreign debt cut credit supply, reducing firm‐level employment. A subsequent large policy intervention supplying derivatives against FX risks — hedger of last resort — halved the negative effects. A 2008 to 2015 panel exploiting global FX shocks and local FX interventions confirms the results and the hedging channel. However, the FX policy entails fiscal and moral hazard costs.
10.1111/jofi.70054.abstract_zh: 我们证明外汇干预是有效的，尤其是在缓解全球金融溢出效应方面。我们利用全球金融冲击和巴西央行在外汇衍生品领域的干预措施，结合三组匹配的行政登记数据：银行对企业信贷、银行的外国信贷以及雇主-雇员数据。在美国缩减恐慌（随后引发新兴市场外汇动荡）之后，外债较多的巴西银行削减了信贷供给，导致企业层面的就业减少。随后，一项大规模的政策干预——作为最后对冲者提供外汇衍生品以对冲外汇风险——将负面效应减半。利用2008年至2015年面板数据，结合全球外汇冲击与本地外汇干预的分析，进一步证实了上述结果及对冲渠道的作用。然而，外汇政策也带来了财政成本和道德风险成本。
10.1111/jofi.70054.title: Hedger of Last Resort: Evidence from Brazilian FX Interventions, Local Credit, and Global Financial Cycles
10.1111/jofi.70054.title_zh: 最后避险对冲者：来自巴西外汇干预、本地信贷与全球金融周期的证据

10.1111/jofi.70055.abstract: We study the asset allocation and investment performance of U.S. private foundations that support the charitable sector. Large foundations generated positive risk‐adjusted returns before 2008, driven by early access to private equity and venture capital funds, but have underperformed since. The median foundation underperforms by more than 100 bps. Foundations with concentrated stock holdings achieve higher returns but assume more risk. Due to the constraints imposed by the 5% minimum spending rule and accommodating monetary policy, foundations increase risk‐taking and reach for yield. Over time, a conservative asset allocation decreases real wealth, reducing charitable giving.
10.1111/jofi.70055.abstract_zh: 本文研究美国私人基金会在支持慈善事业中的资产配置与投资绩效。大型基金会在2008年前通过早期进入私募股权和风险投资基金获得了正向风险调整收益，但此后表现不佳。中位数基金会业绩落后超过100个基点。持有集中股票的基金会获得更高收益，但承担更多风险。受5%最低支出规则约束及宽松货币政策影响，基金会增加风险承担并追逐收益。长期来看，保守型资产配置会减少实际财富，进而降低慈善捐赠。
10.1111/jofi.70055.title: Investing with Purpose: Evidence from Private Foundations
10.1111/jofi.70055.title_zh: 有目的的投资：来自私人基金会的证据

10.1111/jofi.70058.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    We examine optimal capital requirements in a quantitative general equilibrium model with banks exposed to nondiversifiable borrower default risk. Contrary to standard models of bank default risk, our framework captures the limited upside, but significant downside risk of loan portfolio returns. This helps to reproduce the frequency and severity of
                    <jats:italic>twin defaults</jats:italic>
                    : simultaneously high firm and bank defaults. Hence, the optimal bank capital requirement, which trades off a lower frequency of twin defaults against restricting credit provision, is higher than under default risk models which underestimate the impact of borrower default on bank solvency.
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/jofi.70058.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>本文在银行面临不可分散的借款人违约风险的量化一般均衡模型中，考察了最优资本要求。与标准的银行违约风险模型不同，我们的框架捕捉了贷款组合收益的有限上行空间，但显著的下行风险。这有助于再现“双重违约”（即企业违约与银行违约同时高发）的频率与严重程度。因此，最优银行资本要求——在降低双重违约频率与限制信贷供给之间进行权衡——高于那些低估借款人违约对银行偿付能力影响的违约风险模型所给出的水平。</jats:p>
10.1111/jofi.70058.title: Twin Defaults and Bank Capital Requirements
10.1111/jofi.70058.title_zh: 双重违约与银行资本要求

10.1111/jofi.70059.abstract: This paper provides novel empirical evidence that cash‐rich firms have higher equity payouts and higher stock prices in response to expansionary monetary policy surprises. Stock prices rise despite weak cash‐flow, investment, and credit responses to monetary policy. I rationalize the empirical evidence in a heterogeneous‐firm New Keynesian model where firms finance investment with cash and equity issuance. Monetary easing weakens precautionary cash demand, leading cash‐rich firms to optimally allocate excess funds to shareholders. Since payouts are procyclical, cash‐rich firms earn higher returns in expansionary periods. My findings highlight a payout channel through which monetary policy impacts asset prices.
10.1111/jofi.70059.abstract_zh: 本文提供了新颖的经验证据，表明在扩张性货币政策冲击下，现金充裕的企业具有更高的股权支付率和更高的股票价格。尽管现金流、投资和信贷对货币政策的反应较弱，股票价格仍出现上涨。我在一个异质性企业新凯恩斯模型中合理化这一经验证据，该模型中企业通过现金和股权发行来为投资融资。货币宽松削弱了预防性现金需求，导致现金充裕的企业将多余资金最优地分配给股东。由于支付具有顺周期性，现金充裕的企业在扩张期获得更高回报。我的发现揭示了货币政策影响资产价格的一个支付渠道。
10.1111/jofi.70059.title: Cash Heterogeneity and the Payout Channel of Monetary Policy
10.1111/jofi.70059.title_zh: 现金异质性与货币政策的支付渠道

10.1111/jofi.70060.abstract: We propose a measure of the valuation gap between debt and equity—debt‐equity spread (DES)—based on the difference between actual and equity‐implied credit spreads. DES predicts cross‐sectional stock and bond returns in opposite directions. This predictability is unique compared to existing mispricing measures and cannot be explained by exposures to various risk factors. High‐DES firms are more likely to issue equity and retire debt, and have more insider equity selling. These findings are consistent with DES capturing relative mispricing between debt and equity, and provide empirical support for the model of partially segmented markets in Greenwood, Hanson, and Liao (2018, Review of Financial Studies 31, 3307–3343).
10.1111/jofi.70060.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种衡量债务与股权估值差距的指标——债务-股权利差（DES），该指标基于实际信用利差与股权隐含信用利差之间的差异。DES能够反向预测股票和债券的横截面收益。这种预测能力相较于现有的错误定价指标具有独特性，且无法通过各类风险因子的暴露来解释。高DES企业更倾向于发行股票并偿还债务，同时内部人股权出售行为更为频繁。这些发现与DES捕捉债务与股权相对错误定价的结论一致，并为Greenwood、Hanson和Liao（2018，《金融研究评论》第31卷，第3307–3343页）提出的部分分割市场模型提供了实证支持。

10.1111/jofi.70061.title:
Report of the Editor of
                    The Journal of Finance
                    for the Year 2025

10.1111/jofi.70062.abstract: We present results from a field experiment that introduced digital payroll accounts to unbanked factory workers to examine how inexperienced consumers learn to use a new financial technology. We find that exposure to payroll accounts leads to increased account use, accelerated learning, and avoidance of common consumer protection risks. Those receiving electronic wage payments gradually build trust in the technology, learn to use accounts without assistance, and avoid illicit fees. Using experimental variation in assignment to bank versus mobile money accounts, we show that these impacts are concentrated in mobile money accounts, the newer, more complex, and less trusted financial technology.
10.1111/jofi.70062.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项实地实验，向无银行账户的工厂工人引入数字工资账户，以考察缺乏经验的消费者如何学习使用新型金融技术。研究发现，接触工资账户能提升账户使用率、加速学习进程，并帮助规避常见的消费者保护风险。接受电子工资支付的工人逐渐建立起对该技术的信任，学会独立使用账户，并避免支付非法费用。通过实验性分配银行账户与移动货币账户的差异，我们证明这些影响主要集中在移动货币账户上——这是一种更新颖、更复杂且信任度较低的金融技术。
10.1111/jofi.70062.title: Learning to Navigate a New Financial Technology
10.1111/jofi.70062.title_zh: 学习驾驭新型金融技术

10.1111/jofi.70064.abstract: This study examines the income loss following forced CEO turnovers using income data from the official records at the Danish Tax Authority. We find that dismissed CEOs’ personal income is 40% lower in the five years following forced turnovers. The decline is driven by labor market outcomes: labor and entrepreneurial incomes decline, while other sources of income increase. We find larger declines in income for executives with poor performance during their tenures, consistent with the executive labor market being the main channel for the lower income. Overall, the findings suggest that executives face significant personal costs from forced turnovers.
10.1111/jofi.70064.abstract_zh: 本研究利用丹麦税务局官方记录的收入数据，考察了强制CEO更替后的收入损失。我们发现，被解雇CEO在强制更替后五年内的个人收入降低了40%。这一下降主要由劳动力市场结果驱动：劳动收入和创业收入减少，而其他收入来源增加。我们发现，任期内表现不佳的高管收入下降幅度更大，这与高管劳动力市场是收入降低的主要渠道相一致。总体而言，研究结果表明，高管因强制更替而面临显著的个人成本。
10.1111/jofi.70064.title: Personal Costs of Executive Turnovers

10.1111/jofi.70065.abstract: Mergers are associated with large and persistent earnings declines for incumbent employees in target firms. Linking employer‐employee administrative data with information on merger activity in Brazil, I find the negative effects concentrate on employees who exit target firms and reflect displacement in the short run and wage declines in the long run. Low‐skilled, managerial, and older employees fare worse. Overall, I conclude that mergers are followed by substantial reallocation costs reflecting losses of firm‐specific wage premiums, matching inefficiencies, and industry‐specific human capital depreciation, with employees transitioning to lower paying firms considered to be of lower productivity and employment value.
10.1111/jofi.70065.abstract_zh: 并购与目标企业现有员工的大幅且持续的收入下降相关。通过将巴西雇主-雇员行政数据与并购活动信息相关联，我发现负面效应主要集中在离职的目标企业员工身上，这既反映了短期内的岗位流失，也体现了长期内的工资下降。低技能、管理岗位及年长员工受到的影响更为严重。总体而言，我得出结论：并购之后会出现显著的重新配置成本，这反映了企业特定工资溢价的损失、匹配效率低下以及行业特定人力资本的贬值，员工转而流向被认为生产率和就业价值较低的低薪企业。
10.1111/jofi.70065.title: M&As, Employee Costs, and Labor Reallocation
10.1111/jofi.70065.title_zh: 并购、员工成本与劳动力再配置

10.1111/jofi.70066.abstract: Banks adjust loan spreads after observing natural disasters linked to climate change. We isolate this updating process by identifying loans to borrowers at risk of, but not directly affected by, such disasters. Loan spreads for these borrowers spike in both primary and secondary markets, while no such updating occurs for non–climate‐related disasters. Evidence suggests a heightened perceived credit risk, which nonetheless cannot fully explain the increase in rates. Taken altogether, increased spreads are explained primarily by salience bias, as they are short‐lived and amplified by media attention. This salience impacts financial decisions at bank‐dependent firms.
10.1111/jofi.70066.abstract_zh: 银行在观察到与气候变化相关的自然灾害后，会调整贷款利差。我们通过识别那些面临此类灾害风险但未直接受影响的借款人的贷款，来分离这一更新过程。这些借款人的贷款利差在一级市场和二级市场均出现飙升，而与气候无关的灾害则未引发此类调整。证据表明，感知信用风险有所上升，但这并不能完全解释利率的上涨。综合来看，利差上升主要由显著性偏差解释，因其持续时间短暂且受媒体关注放大。这种显著性偏差影响了依赖银行的企业的财务决策。
10.1111/jofi.70066.title: The Rising Tide Lifts Some Interest Rates: Climate Change, Natural Disasters, and Loan Pricing
10.1111/jofi.70066.title_zh: 潮涨推高部分利率：气候变化、自然灾害与贷款定价

10.1111/jofi.70067.abstract: This paper estimates the cross‐sectional distribution of Epstein‐Zin preferences using the wealth and risky portfolio shares of a large panel of Swedish households. We find modestly heterogeneous risk aversion (standard deviation 0.97, median 7.50) and a meaningfully heterogeneous and right‐skewed time preference rate (TPR; standard deviation 7.31%, median 4.08%) and elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS; standard deviation 3.17, median 0.70). Risk aversion and the EIS are only very weakly negatively correlated. We estimate lower risk aversion for households with riskier labor income, and a higher TPR and lower EIS for households that enter our sample with low wealth.
10.1111/jofi.70067.abstract_zh: 本文利用瑞典家庭大样本的财富与风险资产组合份额，估计了Epstein-Zin偏好的横截面分布。研究发现：风险厌恶程度呈现适度异质性（标准差0.97，中位数7.50），而时间偏好率（TPR；标准差7.31%，中位数4.08%）与跨期替代弹性（EIS；标准差3.17，中位数0.70）则表现出显著的异质性与右偏分布特征。风险厌恶与EIS仅存在极弱的负相关关系。对于劳动收入风险较高的家庭，其风险厌恶程度较低；而初始财富水平较低的家庭则呈现更高的TPR与更低的EIS。
10.1111/jofi.70067.title: The Cross‐Section of Household Preferences
10.1111/jofi.70067.title_zh: 家庭偏好的横截面分析

10.1111/jofi.70068.abstract: Customers in over‐the‐counter (OTC) markets must find a counterparty to trade. Little is known about this process, however, because existing data consist of transaction records, which only reveal the outcome of a search. Using data from a trading platform for corporate bonds, we unpack the search process. We analyze how long it takes customers to trade and how dealers' offers evolve across repeated inquiries. We estimate that it takes two to three days to complete a transaction after an unsuccessful attempt, with substantial variation across trade and customer characteristics. Our analysis offers insights into the sources of trading delays in OTC markets.
10.1111/jofi.70068.abstract_zh: 在场外交易（OTC）市场中，客户必须寻找交易对手方。然而，由于现有数据仅包含交易记录，仅能揭示搜索的结果，因此对这一过程知之甚少。利用公司债券交易平台的数据，我们揭示了搜索过程。我们分析了客户完成交易所需的时间，以及交易商在多次询价中报价的演变情况。我们估计，在一次不成功的尝试后，完成一笔交易需要两到三天时间，且这一时长因交易和客户特征的不同而有显著差异。我们的分析为理解OTC市场交易延迟的根源提供了见解。
10.1111/jofi.70068.title: Sequential Search for Corporate Bonds

10.1111/jofi.70069.abstract: Why do fire sales occur if many risks are hedgeable? We study a version of Brunnermeier and Sannikov (2014, American Economic Review 104, 379–421) in which all fundamental risks can be hedged frictionlessly. Our analysis shows that fire sales are inherently self‐fulfilling. Fundamental shocks can never cause fire sales, and an efficient, safe equilibrium exists. On the other hand, there exists an equilibrium in which agents coordinate fire sales on nonfundamental shocks. A simple refinement based on vanishingly small perceived fundamental risk eliminates the safe equilibrium and selects the fire‐sale equilibrium as the unique outcome.
10.1111/jofi.70069.abstract_zh: 如果许多风险都是可对冲的，为何还会发生抛售潮？我们研究了Brunnermeier和Sannikov（2014，《美国经济评论》第104卷，第379–421页）的一个版本，其中所有基础性风险均可无摩擦对冲。分析表明，抛售潮本质上是自我实现的。基础性冲击永远不会引发抛售潮，且存在一个高效、安全的均衡。另一方面，存在一个均衡，其中经济主体在非基础性冲击上协调引发抛售潮。一个基于极小感知基础性风险的简单精炼方法消除了安全均衡，并将抛售潮均衡选为唯一结果。
10.1111/jofi.70069.title: Dynamic Self‐Fulfilling Fire Sales
10.1111/jofi.70069.title_zh: 动态自我实现的抛售潮

10.1111/jofi.70070.abstract: We derive tight pricing kernel restrictions from options with same‐day expiration (“0DTEs”). These restrictions concern the volatility of small and frequent asset price moves that the equity and options markets must agree on in a frictionless economy. Their violation leads to pseudo‐arbitrage opportunities, characterized by nontrivial reward‐to‐risk ratios over arbitrarily short horizons and achieved by a combined position in 0DTEs and the underlying asset. Empirically, we find no evidence of feasible pseudo‐arbitrage opportunities, as transaction costs, estimation risk, and short‐term volatility risk prevent investors from taking advantage of small and infrequent disagreements about volatility between equity and options markets.
10.1111/jofi.70070.abstract_zh: 我们从同日到期的期权（“0DTEs”）中推导出严格的价格核约束。这些约束涉及股票和期权市场在无摩擦经济中必须达成一致的小幅频繁资产价格波动的波动性。违反这些约束会导致伪套利机会，其特征是在任意短的时间范围内具有非平凡的收益风险比，并通过在0DTEs和标的资产中建立组合头寸来实现。实证上，我们没有发现可行的伪套利机会的证据，因为交易成本、估计风险和短期波动风险阻止了投资者利用股票与期权市场之间关于波动性的微小且不频繁的分歧。
10.1111/jofi.70070.title: Do Equity and Options Markets Agree about Volatility?
10.1111/jofi.70070.title_zh: 股票与期权市场在波动率上是否一致？

10.1111/jofi.70071.abstract: How does demand uncertainty affect firms' investment decisions? We examine this question in the context of electricity‐producing firms' planned investments in new power plants. We measure uncertainty about future electricity demand using plausibly exogenous variation in temperature projections across scientific climate models. The results show that uncertainty increases investment in power plants with flexible production technologies, while reducing investment in less flexible technologies. Overall, the net effect of uncertainty on investment is positive when firms have access to flexible investment opportunities. These findings are consistent with models in which production flexibility shapes the investment response to demand uncertainty.
10.1111/jofi.70071.abstract_zh: 需求不确定性如何影响企业的投资决策？我们以电力生产企业对新电厂的投资计划为背景研究这一问题。利用不同科学气候模型对温度预测的外生差异，我们衡量了未来电力需求的不确定性。结果表明，不确定性增加了对采用灵活生产技术电厂的投资，同时减少了对灵活性较低技术的投资。总体而言，当企业拥有灵活的投资机会时，不确定性对投资的净效应为正。这些发现与生产灵活性决定投资对需求不确定性反应的模型一致。
10.1111/jofi.70071.title: Climate Change, Demand Uncertainty, and Firms' Investments: Evidence from Planned Power Plants
10.1111/jofi.70071.title_zh: 气候变化、需求不确定性与企业投资：来自计划发电厂的证据

10.1111/jofi.70072.abstract: We explore the dynamics of venture capital (VC)‐backed startup boards using novel data on director entry, exit, and characteristics. At formation, a typical board is entrepreneur‐controlled. Independent directors join the median board after the second financing and hold a tie‐breaking vote. Their presence is particularly likely when potential VC‐entrepreneur conflicts are larger. At later stages, control switches to VCs and independent director characteristics change. These patterns align with key financial contracting theories, but also highlight unique roles of independent directors over the life cycle: mediation followed by advising. Independent directors thus represent another potential source of value‐add to startup performance.
10.1111/jofi.70072.abstract_zh: 我们利用关于董事进入、退出及特征的新数据，探讨了风险投资支持的初创企业董事会的动态变化。成立之初，典型董事会由企业家控制。独立董事在第二轮融资后加入中位数董事会，并持有决定性投票权。当风险投资与企业家之间潜在冲突较大时，独立董事的出现尤为可能。在后期阶段，控制权转移至风险投资方，独立董事的特征也随之改变。这些模式与关键金融契约理论相符，但也凸显了独立董事在生命周期中的独特角色：先是调解，后是咨询。因此，独立董事构成了初创企业绩效增值的另一潜在来源。
10.1111/jofi.70072.title: Board Dynamics over the Startup Life Cycle
10.1111/jofi.70072.title_zh: 初创企业生命周期中的董事会动态

10.1111/jofi.70073.abstract: Discretionary announcement timing generates high conditional risk premia of stock returns and a pattern of negative drifts followed by positive jumps. Average announcement returns are much larger than unconditional risk premia. Capital Asset Pricing Model alphas turn negative when conditioning on nondisclosure because betas rise faster than risk premia prior to disclosures, but average announcement returns may appear to be too large relative to market risk when betas are estimated from past returns. The effects are amplified when multiple firms exercise discretion over the timing of correlated announcements. We present evidence that firms time earnings announcements in a manner consistent with our model.
10.1111/jofi.70073.abstract_zh: 自主择时公告会产生股票回报的高条件风险溢价，以及负漂移后跟随正跳变的模式。平均公告回报远大于无条件风险溢价。当以未披露为条件时，资本资产定价模型阿尔法值转为负值，因为披露前贝塔值上升速度快于风险溢价，但若贝塔值基于历史回报估计，平均公告回报相对于市场风险可能显得过大。当多家企业对相关公告的时机行使自主权时，这些效应会被放大。我们提供的证据表明，企业选择盈利公告时机的行为与我们的模型一致。
10.1111/jofi.70073.title: Discretionary Announcement Timing and Stock Returns
10.1111/jofi.70073.title_zh: 自主公告时机与股票收益

10.1111/jofi.70074.abstract: We propose a new method to estimate the marginal value of capital under minimal assumptions. By combining asset prices with fundamentals, our method provides a quasi‐model‐free marginal q together with a simple correction for measurement error in (average) Tobin's Q using linear regressions. Marginal q yields plausible and robust estimates of adjustment costs and investment sensitivities to fundamentals. The widening gap between marginal q and Tobin's Q is driven primarily by market power and intangible capital. Our novel findings strongly support the neoclassical theory of investment and challenge the widespread use of Tobin's Q as proxy for investment opportunities.
10.1111/jofi.70074.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在最小假设下估计资本边际价值的新方法。通过将资产价格与基本面相结合，我们的方法提供了一种准模型无关的边际q，并利用线性回归对（平均）托宾Q中的测量误差进行了简单修正。边际q得出了关于调整成本和投资对基本面敏感性的合理且稳健的估计。边际q与托宾Q之间日益扩大的差距主要由市场势力和无形资本驱动。我们的新发现有力地支持了新古典投资理论，并对广泛使用托宾Q作为投资机会代理变量的做法提出了挑战。
10.1111/jofi.70074.title: Marginal Q

10.1111/jofi.70075.abstract: How did #MeToo alter collaboration between women and men? I show junior female researchers start fewer projects after #MeToo. A decrease in collaborations with male coauthors—especially new senior male coauthors at the same institution—largely explains the decline. The decrease is larger at universities with higher perceived harassment accusation risk and smaller where both women and men publicly express greater awareness of gender issues. I find no evidence that reduced collaboration improves research outcomes for junior female researchers. The results suggest that #MeToo led to a breakdown in trust that came at a cost for junior women's career opportunities.
10.1111/jofi.70075.abstract_zh: #MeToo如何改变了女性与男性之间的合作？我展示了在#MeToo之后，初级女性研究员开始的项目数量减少。与男性合著者——尤其是同一机构内新晋资深男性合著者——合作的减少在很大程度上解释了这一下降趋势。在感知到骚扰指控风险较高的大学，下降幅度更大；而在女性和男性都公开表达出更高性别问题意识的大学，下降幅度则较小。我没有发现证据表明合作减少能改善初级女性研究员的研究成果。结果表明，#MeToo导致了信任的破裂，这对初级女性的职业机会造成了代价。
10.1111/jofi.70075.title: The Unintended Consequences of #MeToo: Evidence from Research Collaborations in Economics and Finance
10.1111/jofi.70075.title_zh: #MeToo的意外后果：来自经济学与金融学研究合作的证据

10.1111/jofi.70076.abstract: A majority of small U.S. businesses attempting to reorganize in bankruptcy fail to do so. Subchapter V of Chapter 11 (SubV) streamlines bankruptcy for small firms by reducing bankruptcy costs and negotiation frictions, and enables entrepreneurs to retain ownership. We show that many businesses reorganize under SubV that otherwise would liquidate. Creditor recoveries and postbankruptcy survival rates are at least as high in SubV as in traditional Chapter 11s. Our results show the increase in reorganizations is not associated with continuation of unviable firms, and that creditors are not harmed by a shift in bargaining power toward small business owners.
10.1111/jofi.70076.abstract_zh: 美国大多数试图通过破产重组的小型企业未能成功。第11章第V分章（SubV）通过降低破产成本和谈判摩擦，为小企业简化了破产程序，并使企业家能够保留所有权。我们表明，许多原本会清算的企业在SubV下得以重组。债权人的回收率和破产后生存率在SubV中至少与传统第11章一样高。我们的结果显示，重组增加与不可持续企业的延续无关，且债权人并未因谈判权力向小企业主转移而受损。
10.1111/jofi.70076.title: Can Small Businesses Survive Chapter 11?
10.1111/jofi.70076.title_zh: 小企业能否在第十一章破产保护中生存？

10.1111/jofi.70077.abstract: Annuities, long‐term care insurance, and reverse mortgages remain puzzlingly unpopular to manage post‐retirement longevity, health, and housing price risks. We use a flexible life‐cycle model structurally estimated with a unique stated‐preference survey experiment of Canadian households to understand why. Key factors include high risk aversion, concern over long‐run risks, strong discounting of valuation in disability states, imperfect housing substitutability, and bequest motives. The remaining disinterest is accounted for by information frictions and inertia. We also document evidence of public insurance crowding out, spousal co‐insurance, and responsiveness to product bundling.
10.1111/jofi.70077.abstract_zh: 年金、长期护理保险和反向抵押贷款在管理退休后长寿、健康及房价风险方面仍出人意料地不受欢迎。我们利用一个灵活的生命周期模型，该模型通过针对加拿大家庭的独特陈述偏好调查实验进行结构估计，以理解其原因。关键因素包括高风险厌恶、对长期风险的担忧、对残疾状态下价值评估的强烈折现、住房替代的不完全性以及遗赠动机。剩余的不感兴趣则归因于信息摩擦和惯性。我们还记录了公共保险挤出效应、配偶共同保险以及对产品捆绑销售的响应性证据。
10.1111/jofi.70077.title: Longevity, Health, and Housing Risk Management in Retirement
10.1111/jofi.70077.title_zh: 退休中的长寿、健康与住房风险管理

10.1111/jofi.70078.abstract: We present a model of competition between environmental, social, and governance (ESG) raters who acquire information about multiple unrelated categories and sell ratings. Raters specializing in different categories maximize the amount of information transmitted and surplus, and can be an equilibrium outcome. When investors place a high value on ESG performance across multiple categories, the unique equilibrium is for the raters to generalize—splitting their effort among the categories, resulting in less informative ratings. Greenwashing by firms can make generalization the only equilibrium. We also demonstrate that specialization maximizes ratings disagreement, and thus empirical measures of disagreement may be poor measures of surplus.
10.1111/jofi.70078.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，探讨环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级机构之间的竞争，这些机构获取关于多个不相关类别的信息并出售评级。专注于不同类别的评级机构能最大化信息传递量和剩余价值，这可以成为均衡结果。当投资者高度重视跨多个类别的ESG表现时，唯一均衡是评级机构采取泛化策略——将努力分散到各个类别，导致评级信息含量降低。企业的漂绿行为可能使泛化成为唯一均衡。我们还证明，专业化能最大化评级分歧，因此实证中的分歧指标可能无法有效衡量剩余价值。
10.1111/jofi.70078.title: The Market for ESG Ratings

10.1111/jofi.70079.abstract: This paper studies asset pricing under expectations‐based reference‐dependent preferences in a general equilibrium framework. We show that reference‐dependent preferences can generate self‐fulfilling risk panics, producing sentiment‐driven asset price fluctuations through a feedback loop between current prices and perceived future downside risk—dynamics impossible under standard expected utility. The model helps explain empirical puzzles including (i) excess volatility, (ii) asymmetric volatility, (iii) asymmetric sentiment over the business cycle, (iv) excess asset price comovement, and (v) weak correlations between stock returns and economic fundamentals, alongside a sizable equity premium. Additional empirical evidence based on closed‐end fund discounts and quantitative analysis support the theory.
10.1111/jofi.70079.abstract_zh: 本文在一般均衡框架下研究基于预期参照依赖偏好的资产定价问题。我们证明，参照依赖偏好能够引发自我实现的恐慌情绪，通过当前价格与感知的未来下行风险之间的反馈循环，产生由情绪驱动的资产价格波动——这种动态在标准期望效用下是不可能出现的。该模型有助于解释一系列实证谜团，包括（i）过度波动性，（ii）非对称波动性，（iii）商业周期中的非对称情绪，（iv）资产价格的过度联动，以及（v）股票回报与经济基本面之间的弱相关性，同时伴随显著的股权溢价。基于封闭式基金折价和定量分析的额外实证证据支持了这一理论。
10.1111/jofi.70079.title: Reference‐Dependent Preferences and Sentiment‐Driven Asset Prices
10.1111/jofi.70079.title_zh: 参考依赖偏好与情绪驱动的资产价格

10.1111/joie.70016.abstract: We provide a novel empirical analysis of the role of technology licensing, between competitors, for genetically engineered (GE) traits in the US seed industry. We extend the standard differentiated-product Bertrand pricing model to include trait licensing, which permits us to recover marginal costs and (otherwise unobserved) royalty rates. Estimation relies on a large dataset of farm-level seed purchases. We find that markups over marginal cost are sizeable, and royalties for GE traits contribute a non-trivial amount to these markups. Licensing GE traits to competitors benefits all seed sellers and, notwithstanding its strategic effect on pricing, also increases total market surplus.
10.1111/joie.70016.abstract_zh: 我们针对美国种子行业中，竞争对手之间基因工程（GE）性状技术许可的作用，提供了一项新颖的实证分析。我们将标准差异化产品伯特兰定价模型扩展至包含性状许可，从而能够恢复边际成本和（原本不可观测的）特许权使用费率。估计依赖于农场层面种子购买的大型数据集。我们发现，边际成本之上的加成幅度显著，且GE性状的特许权使用费对这些加成贡献了不可忽视的部分。将GE性状许可给竞争对手有利于所有种子销售商，并且，尽管其对定价具有战略影响，也增加了总市场剩余。

10.1111/joie.70017.abstract: A data analytics company delivers an efficiency by supplying a pricing algorithm that allows prices to more effectively respond to demand variation. In this setting, I consider a new form of hub-and-spoke collusion: A data analytics company (hub) coordinates the prices of competitors (spokes) through its pricing algorithm. A novel finding is that the data analytics company's efficiency is a facilitating factor for collusion; a rise in this efficiency increases the supracompetitive markup and the incremental profit from collusion. Thus, markets in which a third party's services are solidly grounded in efficiency still warrant scrutiny by competition authorities because they are more prone to the emergence of collusion and anticompetitive harm.
10.1111/joie.70017.abstract_zh: 一家数据分析公司通过提供定价算法来提升效率，使价格能更有效地响应需求变化。在此背景下，我探讨了一种新型的轴辐式合谋形式：数据分析公司（轴心）通过其定价算法协调竞争对手（辐条）的价格。一个新颖的发现是，数据分析公司的效率是促进合谋的因素；这种效率的提升会增加超竞争加成和合谋带来的增量利润。因此，即使第三方服务基于坚实的效率基础，市场仍应受到竞争当局的审查，因为这些市场更易出现合谋和反竞争损害。

10.1111/joie.70018.abstract: Platform interoperability is considered a powerful tool to promote competition in digital markets when network effects are at play. We study the incentives of two competing ad-funded platforms to provide interoperability in a setting where consumers can single-home or multi-home and decide how much time to spend online. When the platforms are symmetric, perfect interoperability emerges in equilibrium and is socially efficient. When a larger platform has an installed base of customers, its incentive to make its services interoperable is lower than for the smaller platform. Interoperability does not emerge in equilibrium if the installed base is sufficiently large. However, mandating interoperability between the asymmetric platforms is not always socially optimal.
10.1111/joie.70018.abstract_zh: 平台互操作性被视为在网络效应发挥作用时促进数字市场竞争的有力工具。我们研究了在消费者可以选择单归属或多归属并决定在线时间投入的背景下，两家竞争性广告支持型平台提供互操作性的激励。当平台对称时，完全互操作性在均衡中出现且具有社会效率。当较大平台拥有既定的客户基础时，其提供互操作服务的激励低于较小平台。若既定基础足够大，互操作性不会在均衡中出现。然而，强制不对称平台之间的互操作性并非总是社会最优的。

10.1111/joie.70019.abstract: We study an agency model with two sequential tasks, an initial task (e.g., development), which requires unverifiable effort, and a final task (e.g., production), whose environment is privately known only to the agent. The principal can either perform the initial task herself (hands-on management) or delegate it to the agent (hands-off management). We show that when the cost of effort for the initial task is low, hands-on management is optimal, as it mitigates the distortion caused by agent shirking. However, as the cost of effort increases, hands-off management becomes preferable. Under hands-on management, the principal's inability to commit leads her to overinvest in the initial task, which in turn exacerbates inefficiencies in the final task due to the agent's information rent. In contrast, hands-off management, despite the agent's shirking incentive, helps better target effort toward favorable project environments. Our analysis also reveals how effort costs can create systematic biases toward one management style over the other.
10.1111/joie.70019.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含两个连续任务的代理模型：初始任务（如开发），需要不可验证的努力；以及最终任务（如生产），其环境仅由代理私下知晓。委托人可以选择亲自执行初始任务（亲力亲为式管理），或将其委托给代理（放手式管理）。我们表明，当初始任务的努力成本较低时，亲力亲为式管理为最优，因为它能缓解代理偷懒所导致的扭曲。然而，随着努力成本的增加，放手式管理变得更为可取。在亲力亲为式管理下，委托人无法承诺会导致其对初始任务过度投资，进而因代理的信息租金而加剧最终任务中的效率低下。相比之下，放手式管理尽管存在代理的偷懒激励，却有助于将努力更精准地投向有利的项目环境。我们的分析还揭示了努力成本如何系统性地偏向于某一种管理风格。

10.1111/joie.70020.abstract: We focus on the determinants of pharmaceutical drug prices. Using data from the Brazilian pharmaceutical market, we find large variations in drug prices across buyers, drug classes, and time periods. Our estimation results provide evidence that transaction-specific determinants between buyers and sellers (e.g., transaction volume, buyer's loyalty, multiple drug purchases from the same seller) exert strong effects on drug prices. Our counterfactuals show that group purchasing organizations achieve price reductions that vary across drug classes and that these price reductions primarily depend on buyer price sensitivity.
10.1111/joie.70020.abstract_zh: 我们聚焦于药品价格的决定因素。利用巴西药品市场的数据，我们发现药品价格在购买者、药品类别及时间段之间存在显著差异。估计结果表明，买卖双方之间的交易特定因素（如交易量、购买者忠诚度、从同一卖方购买多种药品）对药品价格产生强烈影响。反事实分析显示，团体采购组织实现的降价幅度因药品类别而异，且这些降价主要取决于购买者的价格敏感度。

10.1111/joie.70021.abstract: Consider suppliers whose comparative advantages, which are unknown to a buyer, depend on the quantity procured. The distortions of the buyer purchase policy differs depending on the market characteristics. In a large market, either it overbuys to suppliers with steep marginal costs, who are better at producing a small volume; or it withholds the demand it addresses to suppliers with flatter marginal costs, who are better at producing a large volume. The latter policy is implemented through a concave tariff offered to the less capacity constrained suppliers. In a small market, demand withholding prevails and some suppliers can be excluded.
10.1111/joie.70021.abstract_zh: 考虑那些比较优势不为买方所知、且取决于采购数量的供应商。买方采购政策的扭曲程度因市场特征而异。在大市场中，要么对边际成本陡峭、擅长小批量生产的供应商过度采购；要么对边际成本平缓、擅长大批量生产的供应商缩减需求。后一种政策通过向产能约束较小的供应商提供凹形关税来实现。在小市场中，需求缩减占主导地位，部分供应商可能被排除在外。

10.1111/joie.70022.abstract: This paper examines the effects of incentivizing industrial users to reduce their electricity consumption using demand response auctions, in which rewards for curtailment depend on auction outcomes. Because true baseline consumption is unobserved, firms can strategically adjust both bids and consumption, leading to upward-biased estimates of program effectiveness. Using data on bids, auction outcomes, and hourly electricity consumption from steel producers in Taiwan, this paper employs a regression discontinuity design to show that not accounting for firms' strategic bidding behavior can lead to an overestimation of electricity reductions by at least 50%.
10.1111/joie.70022.abstract_zh: 本文考察了通过需求响应拍卖激励工业用户减少电力消耗的效果，其中削减用电的奖励取决于拍卖结果。由于真实基线消费不可观测，企业可能策略性地调整投标和消费行为，导致对项目有效性的估计产生向上偏差。利用台湾钢铁生产商的投标、拍卖结果及每小时电力消耗数据，本文采用断点回归设计表明，若不考虑企业的策略性投标行为，电力削减量可能被高估至少50%。

10.1111/joie.70023.abstract: How does antitrust enforcement affect innovation when patents are the main barrier to entry? I address this question by empirically studying the US antitrust case against Xerox, the former monopolist in the market for plain-paper copiers. In 1975, Xerox accepted a consent decree whose primary remedy was compulsory licensing of all its copier-technology patents in the US and abroad. I show that this antitrust intervention promoted innovation by other firms in the copier industry, measured by a disproportionate increase in patenting in technology classes with a higher propensity for containing copier-related inventions. This effect is driven by Japanese competitors, whose patenting became more novel and diverse as they started developing smaller desktop copiers.
10.1111/joie.70023.abstract_zh: 当专利构成主要进入壁垒时，反垄断执法如何影响创新？我通过实证研究美国针对施乐公司（前普通纸复印机市场垄断者）的反垄断案件来回答这一问题。1975年，施乐接受了同意令，其主要救济措施是强制许可其在美国及国外的所有复印机技术专利。我证明，这一反垄断干预促进了其他企业在复印机行业的创新，表现为在更可能包含复印机相关发明的技术类别中，专利数量不成比例地增加。这一效应由日本竞争者驱动，随着他们开始开发更小的台式复印机，其专利变得更加新颖和多样化。

10.1111/joie.70025.abstract: We study optimal simple rating systems that partition sellers into a finite number of tiers. We show that optimal ratings must be threshold partitions, and that for linear supply and Cournot competition with constant marginal cost, optimal thresholds solve a k-means clustering problem requiring only the quality distribution. For convex (concave) supply functions, optimal thresholds are higher (lower) than the k-means solution. For log-concave distributions, two-tier certification captures at least 50% of maximum welfare gains from full disclosure, with five tiers typically achieving over 90%. Applications to eBay and Medicare Advantage data illustrate our method.
10.1111/joie.70025.abstract_zh: 我们研究将卖家划分为有限等级的最优简单评级系统。我们证明，最优评级必须是阈值划分，并且在线性供给和恒定边际成本的古诺竞争下，最优阈值解决一个仅需质量分布的k均值聚类问题。对于凸（凹）供给函数，最优阈值高于（低于）k均值解。对于对数凹分布，两层认证能捕获完全信息披露下最大福利收益的至少50%，而五层通常能达到90%以上。对eBay和Medicare Advantage数据的应用展示了我们的方法。

10.1111/joie.70026.abstract: We study RPM and vertical integration in a common agency setting with two differentiated manufacturers and one retailer, where consumer demand depends on both the manufacturers' and retailer's noncontractible efforts. Under vertical separation, the adoption of maximum RPM by both manufacturers is an equilibrium and intensifies competition, since manufacturing margins are positive to incentivize manufacturing effort. This benefits consumers and may lower industry profits relative to a scenario where RPM is not available. Vertical integration between the retailer and one of the manufacturers increases industry profits and, when retail effort is also important, may benefit consumers by mitigating double marginalization.
10.1111/joie.70026.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含两家差异化制造商和一家零售商的共同代理框架下的转售价格维持（RPM）与纵向一体化问题，其中消费者需求同时取决于制造商和零售商不可契约化的努力水平。在纵向分离情形下，两家制造商均采用最高转售价格维持构成均衡状态，并加剧了市场竞争——这是因为制造商需维持正利润空间以激励其努力投入。相较于无法实施RPM的情形，这种机制使消费者获益，但可能降低行业整体利润。当零售商与其中一家制造商实现纵向一体化时，行业利润得以提升；若零售努力同样重要，该模式还能通过缓解双重边际化效应使消费者受益。
10.1111/joie.70026.title: RPM and Vertical Integration With Upstream Competition and Noncontractible Efforts
10.1111/joie.70026.title_zh: 上游竞争与非契约努力下的转售价格维持与纵向一体化

10.1111/joie.70027.abstract: In this paper, we investigate how competition among NGOs to attract donations shapes the incentives that NGOs provide to their employees. NGOs hire workers to undertake development projects, which are horizontally and vertically differentiated. Workers perform constructive activities that enhance project quality, but can also engage in non‐observable destructive activities that harm the employing organization. NGOs offer monetary incentives to encourage constructive effort, but also need monitoring to curb destructive behavior. Our analysis yields the following results: (i) a high mission orientation on the part of NGOs makes workers' misconduct harder to eliminate; (ii) increased competition in the market for donations leads to higher constructive effort and project quality, but also to greater destructive effort; (iii) relative to the social optimum, the market outcome entails inadequate monitoring and excessive destructive behavior.
10.1111/joie.70027.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非政府组织（NGO）在吸引捐款的竞争如何影响其向员工提供的激励措施。NGO雇佣工人开展发展项目，这些项目在横向和纵向维度上存在差异。工人从事提升项目质量的建设性活动，但也可能进行损害雇佣组织的不可观测的破坏性活动。NGO通过货币激励鼓励建设性努力，同时需要监督机制遏制破坏性行为。分析得出以下结论：（i）NGO的高使命导向使员工不当行为更难以消除；（ii）捐款市场竞争加剧会提升建设性努力和项目质量，但也会增加破坏性行为；（iii）与社会最优水平相比，市场均衡结果表现为监督不足和过度破坏性行为。
10.1111/joie.70027.title: Bad NGOs? Competition in the Market for Donations and Workers' Misconduct
10.1111/joie.70027.title_zh: 不良非政府组织？捐赠市场竞争与员工不当行为

10.1111/joie.70028.abstract: Delaying bill payments to public utilities may provide an important strategy for households with volatile incomes to smooth their consumption. At the same time, allowing late payments may reduce net revenues for utilities, which often leads to higher prices to cover costs. Using billing records from a large water utility in Manila, this paper estimates a household consumption and savings model to evaluate counterfactual payment policies. A popular proposal to ensure upfront payments—prepaid metering—recoups less revenue than is needed to compensate households for their loss of consumption smoothing. Alternatively, a revenue-neutral policy allowing more late payments increases welfare by encouraging greater consumption smoothing.
10.1111/joie.70028.abstract_zh: 延迟支付公共事业账单可能为收入波动较大的家庭提供一种重要的消费平滑策略。同时，允许延迟支付可能会减少公用事业公司的净收入，这往往导致价格上涨以覆盖成本。利用马尼拉一家大型水务公司的账单记录，本文估计了一个家庭消费与储蓄模型，以评估反事实支付政策。一项确保预付款的流行提议——预付费计量——所回收的收入不足以补偿家庭因失去消费平滑而遭受的损失。相反，一项允许更多延迟支付的收入中性政策通过鼓励更大的消费平滑来增加福利。

10.1111/joie.70029.abstract: This paper studies the effect of media market competition on confirmatory bias, the tendency to confirm common priors to appear competent, while accounting for both single‐ and multi‐homing. It finds that competition helps sustain informative reporting when priors are relatively precise, but has the opposite effect when priors are diffuse. The reason is that when competing outlets are perceived as similarly competent, consumers optimally multi‐home. This creates strategic complementarity in informative reporting and helps sustain it when the priors are relatively precise. However, when perceived competencies diverge, consumers single‐home with the outlet they view as most competent, creating incentives for confirmatory reporting when the priors are diffuse.
10.1111/joie.70029.abstract_zh: 本文研究了媒体市场竞争对确认性偏差（即倾向于确认共同先验以显得专业）的影响，同时考虑了单归属与多归属两种情形。研究发现，当先验信息相对精确时，竞争有助于维持信息性报道；但当先验信息模糊时，竞争则产生相反效果。其原因在于：当竞争性媒体被视为具有相似专业能力时，消费者会最优地选择多归属。这种选择在信息性报道中形成策略互补性，并在先验信息相对精确时有助于维持该报道模式。然而，当感知的专业能力存在差异时，消费者会单归属至其认为最专业的媒体，从而在先验信息模糊时产生确认性报道的激励。
10.1111/joie.70029.title: Media Market Structure and Confirmatory News
10.1111/joie.70029.title_zh: 媒体市场结构与确认性新闻

10.1111/joie.70030.abstract: Firms can share data to discover potential synergies between their data sets and algorithms, eventually leading to more efficient mergers and acquisitions (M&A) decisions. However, data sharing also modifies the competitive balance when firms do not merge, and a company may be reluctant to share data with potential rivals. Under general conditions, we show that firms benefit from (partially) sharing data. By doing so, they can merge conditionally based on high synergies. Compared to a laissez‐faire situation, the presence of a regulator allowing or refusing the M&A may increase or decrease data sharing, with a concomitant increase or decrease in consumer surplus. Hence, regulation can reduce the surplus of consumers it is willing to protect. We revisit the Google/Fitbit acquisition through the lens of this interplay between strategic data sharing and antitrust policy.
10.1111/joie.70030.abstract_zh: 企业可以通过共享数据来发现其数据集与算法之间的潜在协同效应，最终促成更高效的并购决策。然而，当企业未进行合并时，数据共享也会改变竞争格局，导致企业可能不愿与潜在竞争对手共享数据。在一般条件下，我们证明企业能从（部分）数据共享中获益。通过这种方式，它们可以基于高协同效应有条件地实施合并。与放任自流的情形相比，允许或拒绝并购的监管机构的存在可能增加或减少数据共享，并随之带来消费者剩余的增加或减少。因此，监管可能反而会降低其本意要保护的消费者剩余。我们通过战略数据共享与反垄断政策之间的这种互动关系，重新审视了谷歌/飞特必收购案。
10.1111/joie.70030.title: Make or Buy Decisions and Data Sharing
10.1111/joie.70030.title_zh: 自制或外购决策与数据共享

10.1111/joie.70031.abstract: This paper analyzes optimal licensing contracts when a licensee faces the risk of future infringement claims by unknown patent holders. In a setting where a noncompeting licensor contracts with a monopolistic manufacturer, fixed‐fee licensing is optimal absent such claims. We show that the possibility of future patent claims makes it optimal to include a per‐unit royalty. The royalty reduces the surplus available to potential third‐party claimants and serves as a rent‐protection device, trading off allocative inefficiency against hold‐up risk. Restrictions on the contracting space can be justified when more realistic features of demand uncertainty or stochastic patent arrival are considered.
10.1111/joie.70031.abstract_zh: 本文分析了当被许可方面临未知专利持有人未来侵权索赔风险时的最优许可合同。在非竞争性许可方与垄断制造商签订合同的背景下，若无此类索赔，固定费用许可为最优选择。研究表明，未来专利索赔的可能性使得引入单位特许权使用费成为最优方案。该使用费降低了潜在第三方索赔方可获得的剩余，并充当租金保护机制，在配置效率损失与敲竹杠风险之间进行权衡。当考虑需求不确定性或专利随机出现等更现实的特征时，对合同空间的限制具有合理性。
10.1111/joie.70031.title: Lurking Patent Claims and Strategic Royalty Contracts
10.1111/joie.70031.title_zh: 潜伏性专利权利要求与战略性许可合同

10.1111/joie.70033.abstract: We propose a new approach to production function estimation that integrates the strengths of the proxy‐variable (PV) and dynamic panel data (DPD) methods. Our framework augments the set of instruments for the level equation in Blundell and Bond [8] with a Berkson‐type instrument motivated by economic theory, following Olley and Pakes [28], Levinsohn and Petrin [24], and Ackerberg et al. [4]. This modification allows unobserved productivity to include both a time‐invariant (“fixed‐effect”) component and a time‐varying component that follows a potentially nonlinear Markov process. Whereas the PV approach accommodates nonlinear Markov dynamics but not fixed effects, and the DPD approach accounts for fixed effects but only with linear Markov dynamics, our method relaxes both restrictions. Our estimator is straightforward to implement using GMM. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that it outperforms the canonical PV and DPD estimators when productivity persistence is low and fixed‐effect heterogeneity is substantial.
10.1111/joie.70033.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种新的生产函数估计方法，融合了代理变量法与动态面板数据法的优势。我们的框架在Blundell和Bond [8]的水平方程工具变量集中，引入了一个基于经济理论的Berkson型工具变量，遵循Olley和Pakes [28]、Levinsohn和Petrin [24]以及Ackerberg等人[4]的思路。这一改进允许不可观测的生产率同时包含时不变（“固定效应”）成分和遵循潜在非线性马尔可夫过程的时变成分。代理变量法虽能处理非线性马尔可夫动态但无法应对固定效应，动态面板数据法则能处理固定效应但仅适用于线性马尔可夫动态，而我们的方法同时放宽了这两项限制。该估计量可通过广义矩估计法简便实现。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，当生产率持续性较低且固定效应异质性显著时，本方法优于经典代理变量法和动态面板数据法估计量。
10.1111/joie.70033.title: A Unified Approach to Estimating Production Functions: Proxy Variables and Dynamic Panel Data
10.1111/joie.70033.title_zh: 生产函数估计的统一方法：代理变量与动态面板数据

10.1111/joie.70034.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the joint role of strategic timing, asymmetric private demand and cost information, and common ownership in shaping equilibrium outcomes in oligopolistic markets. We develop a three‐firm model and study Cournot and Stackelberg competition. The main results are as follows. (1) Mover advantages are determined by relative signal precision: the leader benefits most when the second mover has a more precise signal, the second mover benefits most when the last mover has high signal precision, and the last mover benefits when both followers have sufficiently noisy signals. (2) Cournot competition generates greater consumer and total surplus and lower total profits than Stackelberg competition if neither follower has significantly higher signal precision than the leader. (3) Common ownership increases consumer and total surplus but reduces total profits in Stackelberg competition if and only if the last mover is not substantially better informed than the leader. These findings have implications for contests, partnership, network, public good, common resource, and gas emission games with altruistic preferences. Since total profit in oligopoly models can be interpreted as aggregate welfare in these environments, the welfare rankings are reversed.
10.1111/joie.70034.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了战略时机、非对称私有需求与成本信息以及共同所有权在寡头垄断市场均衡结果中的联合作用。我们构建了一个三企业模型，并分析了古诺竞争与斯塔克伯格竞争。主要结论如下：（1）先动优势取决于相对信号精度：当后动者拥有更精确的信号时，先动者获益最大；当最后动者信号精度较高时，第二动者获益最大；当两个追随者的信号均足够模糊时，最后动者获益最大。（2）若任一追随者的信号精度未显著高于先动者，古诺竞争比斯塔克伯格竞争能带来更高的消费者剩余与总剩余，但总利润更低。（3）在斯塔克伯格竞争中，当且仅当最后动者的信息优势未显著超过先动者时，共同所有权会提升消费者剩余与总剩余，但降低总利润。这些发现对存在利他偏好的竞赛、合伙、网络、公共品、公共资源及气体排放博弈具有启示意义。由于寡头模型中的总利润可被解释为这些环境中的总福利，福利排序将发生逆转。
10.1111/joie.70034.title: Simultaneous and Sequential Competition With Asymmetric Information and Externalities
10.1111/joie.70034.title_zh: 不对称信息与外部性下的同时与序贯竞争

10.1111/joie.70035.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    We study how a blockholder who controls a firm should acquire a minority stake in a rival: directly, creating
                    <jats:italic>common ownership</jats:italic>
                    , or indirectly through the controlled firm, creating
                    <jats:italic>cross‐ownership</jats:italic>
                    . Common ownership generates stronger internalization of competitive externalities and allows the blockholder to capture the resulting gains without sharing them with dispersed shareholders. However, it may also create conflicts of interest with minority shareholders that can lead to a loss of control. Cross‐ownership avoids this governance risk but internalizes competition less effectively. We characterize how the optimal acquisition mode depends on the nature of product market competition and the strength of corporate governance.
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/joie.70035.abstract_zh: 我们研究控制一家公司的大股东应如何获取竞争对手的少数股权：是直接获取（形成共同所有权），还是通过所控制的公司间接获取（形成交叉所有权）。共同所有权能更有效地内化竞争外部性，并使大股东在不与分散股东分享收益的情况下获取由此产生的收益。然而，这可能会与少数股东产生利益冲突，进而导致控制权丧失。交叉所有权可规避这种治理风险，但内化竞争的效果较差。我们刻画了最优收购模式如何取决于产品市场竞争的性质以及公司治理的强度。
10.1111/joie.70035.title: Strategic Stake Acquisitions in Rival Firms: Common vs. Cross‐Ownership
10.1111/joie.70035.title_zh: 竞争对手企业中的战略性股权收购：共同所有权与交叉所有权

10.1111/joie.70036.abstract: We study the retail price pass‐through of four major tax changes in petroleum products using daily pricing data from gas stations on small Greek islands. We find that (i) the pass‐through of the tax hikes is five times higher than for the tax decrease, (ii) the pass‐through of the tax hikes increases with competition, while that of the tax decrease does not, (iii) there is significant asymmetry in the speed of price adjustments, and (iv) the asymmetric price adjustment can be rationalized by either tacit collusion or consumer search behavior, as the most plausible explanations.
10.1111/joie.70036.abstract_zh: 我们利用希腊小岛上加油站的每日定价数据，研究了石油产品四次重大税收变动的零售价格传导效应。研究发现：（i）税收上调的传导效应是税收下调的五倍；（ii）税收上调的传导效应随竞争程度增强而提高，而税收下调的传导效应则不受竞争影响；（iii）价格调整速度存在显著的不对称性；（iv）这种不对称价格调整最合理的解释是默契合谋或消费者搜寻行为。
10.1111/joie.70036.title: Asymmetric Pass‐Through and Competition

10.1111/joie.70037.abstract: We study how consumer feedback affects a credence good market where consumers sequentially visit a monopolistic expert. Each consumer's problem can be minor or major. Before treatment, the expert performs a diagnosis which may fail. Each consumer reveals the received treatment and its outcome. Consumers observe feedback history and decide whether to visit the expert. We find that consumer feedback can lead to inefficiency. When diagnosis fails, the expert overtreats consumers even though the probability of a major problem is low. This behavior does not arise without consumer feedback.
10.1111/joie.70037.abstract_zh: 我们研究消费者反馈如何影响一个信任品市场，在该市场中，消费者依次访问垄断专家。每位消费者的问题可能是轻微的或严重的。在治疗前，专家进行诊断，但诊断可能失败。每位消费者会透露所接受的治疗及其结果。消费者观察反馈历史并决定是否访问专家。我们发现，消费者反馈可能导致效率低下。当诊断失败时，即使严重问题的概率较低，专家也会过度治疗消费者。这种行为在没有消费者反馈的情况下不会出现。
10.1111/joie.70037.title: Credence Goods, Consumer Feedback and (in)Efficiency
10.1111/joie.70037.title_zh: 信任品、消费者反馈与（非）效率

10.1111/joie.70038.abstract: We revisit the standard regularity assumption used to ensure uniqueness of the optimal price in monopoly models, namely that the Virtual Value (VV) function is monotone. This condition is typically imposed through strong distributional assumptions, such as log‐concavity, that restrict the model's flexibility and implicitly discipline the sign of comparative statics. We show that these assumptions can be relaxed without compromising tractability or uniqueness. Our main contribution is to introduce ‐Regularity, a weaker condition that requires monotonicity of the VV only beyond the threshold where marginal revenue becomes nonnegative. We demonstrate that many common non‐regular, unimodal distributions satisfy this local condition. This shift in focus allows standard first‐order methods to remain valid, and it enlarges the set of tractable demand primitives in applied IO. As an implication, when hazard rates are not monotone over the relevant pricing range, comparative statics need not follow the direction imposed by log‐concavity. The framework also reduces the need for ironing when modeling with heavy‐tailed demand.
10.1111/joie.70038.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了垄断模型中用于确保最优价格唯一性的标准正则性假设，即虚拟价值函数单调的条件。这一条件通常通过强分布假设（如对数凹性）来施加，但这些假设限制了模型的灵活性，并隐含地约束了比较静态的方向。我们证明，这些假设可以在不牺牲可处理性或唯一性的前提下被放宽。本文的主要贡献在于引入“局部正则性”这一更弱的条件，该条件仅要求虚拟价值函数在边际收入变为非负的阈值之后保持单调。我们证明，许多常见的非正则单峰分布满足这一局部条件。这一视角的转变使得标准的一阶方法仍然有效，并扩大了应用产业组织中可处理的需求基元集合。其含义在于，当风险率在相关定价范围内不单调时，比较静态的方向不必遵循对数凹性所施加的路径。该框架还减少了在建模重尾需求时进行“熨平”处理的必要性。
10.1111/joie.70038.title: Non‐Regular Distributions, Virtual Values and Monopoly Problems
10.1111/joie.70038.title_zh: 非正则分布、虚拟价值与垄断问题

10.1111/joie.70039.abstract: Favoritism as a mode of corruption is a major concern in public procurement (PP) in many countries. We propose a regression discontinuity design (RDD) test arguing that the winning history of marginal winners and losers can be used to detect favoritism. We apply the empirical test to PP of cleaning services in Finland and find evidence of favoritism even in this relatively low corruption environment. First, winners of close races in terms of win margin tend to have won more also in the past, which is in contrast to competitive environment. Second, to rule out an alternative explanation of collusion based on incumbency, we show that these winners also tend to submit their bids the last, indicating information sharing about rival bids from the buyer to the favored bidder.
10.1111/joie.70039.abstract_zh: 偏袒作为一种腐败形式，是许多国家公共采购（PP）中的主要问题。我们提出了一种断点回归设计（RDD）检验，认为边际获胜者与失败者的获胜历史可用于检测偏袒行为。我们将该实证检验应用于芬兰清洁服务公共采购中，发现即使在腐败程度相对较低的环境中，偏袒现象依然存在。首先，以微弱优势获胜的竞标者（即获胜幅度接近的竞标者）往往在过去也赢得更多合同，这与竞争性环境形成对比。其次，为排除基于在位优势的合谋替代解释，我们证明这些获胜者还倾向于最后提交标书，这表明买方与受偏袒的竞标者之间存在关于竞争对手报价的信息共享。
10.1111/joie.70039.title: Detecting Favoritism in Public Procurement
10.1111/joie.70039.title_zh: 检测公共采购中的偏袒行为

10.1111/joie.70040.abstract: We study the effects of consumers' unsystematic perception mistakes on market outcomes and consumer welfare. In the model, two firms produce goods of different quality and compete by choosing prices. Consumers observe the qualities and/or the prices with noise and make choice mistakes as a result. When the magnitude of mistakes grows, the lower‐quality firm increases its price while the higher‐quality firm initially reduces its price before increasing it. We show that this price reduction effect is so strong that consumers eventually benefit from making a small amount of unsystematic mistakes despite the sub‐optimal choices and the increasing price of the lower‐quality firm.
10.1111/joie.70040.abstract_zh: 我们研究了消费者非系统性感知错误对市场结果和消费者福利的影响。在模型中，两家企业生产不同质量的商品，并通过选择价格进行竞争。消费者在观察质量和/或价格时存在噪声，从而导致选择错误。当错误幅度增大时，低质量企业提高其价格，而高质量企业则先降低价格后再提高。我们表明，这种降价效应如此显著，以至于消费者最终会因犯少量非系统性错误而受益，尽管存在次优选择及低质量企业价格上涨的情况。
10.1111/joie.70040.title: Good Unsystematic Mistakes

10.1111/joie.70041.abstract: This paper investigates the interplay between interoperability and the incentives to invest in cybersecurity in digital markets. We develop a two‐sided symmetric duopoly model in which cyberattacks create a congestion‐like externality, and interoperability amplifies hackers' incentives to target connected platforms.
