We show that interoperability affects cybersecurity investment through multiple channels, potentially producing a non‐monotonic relationship: Low interoperability promotes risk‐mitigation efforts, whereas high interoperability may discourage investment due to a public good effect. We then compare private and social incentives to adopt interoperability, identifying potential sources of misalignment. Finally, we extend the baseline model to account for additional factors shaping the desirability of interoperability, including platforms' business models, users' awareness of cyber risk, asymmetries in user bases, and the role of alternative compensation schemes.
10.1111/joie.70041.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了互操作性如何影响数字市场中网络安全投资的激励。我们构建了一个双边对称双寡头模型，其中网络攻击产生类似拥堵的外部性，而互操作性则增强了黑客针对互联平台的攻击动机。我们证明，互操作性通过多种渠道影响网络安全投资，可能产生非单调关系：低互操作性促进风险缓解努力，而高互操作性可能因公共物品效应抑制投资。随后，我们比较了采用互操作性的私人激励与社会激励，识别出潜在的错位来源。最后，我们将基线模型扩展，以纳入影响互操作性可取性的额外因素，包括平台商业模式、用户对网络风险的认知、用户基础的异质性以及替代补偿方案的作用。
10.1111/joie.70041.title: Cyber(in)security and Interoperability in Digital Services
10.1111/joie.70041.title_zh: 数字服务中的网络（不）安全与互操作性

10.1111/joie.70042.abstract: I study the potential for collusion before and after the American Airlines‐US Airways merger. Results suggest the merger increased major airlines' incentives to coordinate their pricing decisions. US Airways was disinclined to collude prior to the merger due to its unique route structure which was highly dependent on connecting products. The merger, by combining the networks of US Airways and American Airlines, reduced US Airways' dependence on connecting products and enhanced its incentives to collude. Absent US Airways' unique premerger network structure, the merger would not have substantially increased major airlines' incentives to collude.
10.1111/joie.70042.abstract_zh: 我研究了美国航空与全美航空合并前后共谋的可能性。结果表明，合并增强了主要航空公司协调定价决策的动机。合并前，全美航空因其独特的航线结构，高度依赖中转产品，而不倾向于共谋。合并通过整合全美航空与美国航空的网络，降低了全美航空对中转产品的依赖，并增强了其共谋动机。若无全美航空合并前独特的网络结构，该合并不会显著增强主要航空公司的共谋动机。
10.1111/joie.70042.title: Coordinated Effects in the American Airlines‐US Airways Merger
10.1111/joie.70042.title_zh: 美国航空与美国航空集团合并中的协调效应

10.1111/sjoe.12602.abstract: In a simple lending model with informational asymmetry, we investigate the effect of bank market structure on the amount of collateral provided by firms. We analyze the strategic decision of a potential entrepreneur regarding the amount of wealth to pledge as collateral to secure a loan. The novel result is that the equilibrium collateral can be lower in a monopoly market than under perfect competition. A policy intervention designed to enhance lending is always Pareto-improving in a monopoly but not in a competitive banking industry, even though the associated policy costs are lower in the latter setting.
10.1111/sjoe.12602.abstract_zh: 在存在信息不对称的简单借贷模型中，我们探讨了银行市场结构对企业提供的抵押品数量的影响。我们分析了一个潜在企业家在决定以多少财富作为抵押以获得贷款时的战略选择。新颖的结论是，在垄断市场中的均衡抵押品可能低于完全竞争市场。旨在促进贷款的政策干预在垄断市场中总是帕累托改进的，但在竞争性银行行业中并非如此，尽管在后者情境下相关的政策成本更低。

10.1111/sjoe.12603.abstract: This paper examines the long-term effects of economic depressions – defined as multi-year peak-to-trough GDP declines of at least 10 percent – experienced until young adulthood on the wealth distribution and portfolio allocation of older individuals in Europe. We document that experiencing more economic depression years when young has a positive effect on wealth at older ages. By analyzing individual portfolio choices, preferences, and personality, we find that, while experiencing a depression makes individuals more risk averse, it also increases their financial planning horizon and conscientiousness. These results provide evidence that individuals who experienced economic depressions when young invest less in risky assets but save more, and thus tend to accumulate more wealth in the long run.
10.1111/sjoe.12603.abstract_zh: 本文考察了经济萧条——定义为至少10%的多年峰值至谷底GDP下降——在个体年轻时期经历至成年早期，对欧洲老年人财富分配及资产组合配置的长期影响。我们记录到，年轻时经历更多经济萧条年份对老年时财富具有正向效应。通过分析个体投资组合选择、偏好及性格特征，我们发现，尽管经历萧条使个体更加风险厌恶，但也延长了其财务规划视野并增强了尽责性。这些结果提供了证据表明，年轻时经历过经济萧条的个体在风险资产上投资较少，但储蓄更多，从而在长期倾向于积累更多财富。

10.1111/sjoe.70001.abstract: We extend the standard model of Hotelling competition to allow consumers, at personal cost, to change the default horizontal characteristic of the product they purchase. The potential to change this characteristic can cause the market equilibrium to switch from one in which each seller serves only its closest consumers to one in which one seller serves all consumers. This potential can also lead to the non-existence of equilibria. Although default-switching costs can reduce a seller's profit by reducing its product's appeal, they can also commit the seller to compete less vigorously for “distant” consumers, and thereby increase equilibrium profit.
10.1111/sjoe.70001.abstract_zh: 我们扩展了霍特林竞争的标准模型，允许消费者以个人成本改变所购产品的默认水平特性。改变这一特性的可能性可能导致市场均衡从每个卖家仅服务其最近消费者的状态，转变为单一卖家服务所有消费者的状态。这种可能性也可能导致均衡不存在。尽管默认切换成本可能通过降低产品吸引力来减少卖家的利润，但它们也能使卖家承诺对“远距离”消费者竞争不那么激烈，从而增加均衡利润。

10.1111/sjoe.70003.abstract: We study a seat allocation problem in public transportation with potential seating restrictions. We first demonstrate that the commonly used procedure suffers from significant drawbacks, including welfare losses due to unfilled seats. We then introduce a new mechanism that addresses these deficiencies while also satisfying several other desirable properties under various seating restrictions. We also show that our proposed mechanism ensures that the maximum number of agents are seated while respecting agents' preferences and priority rankings.
10.1111/sjoe.70003.abstract_zh: 我们研究公共交通中可能存在的座位限制下的座位分配问题。首先，我们证明常用程序存在显著缺陷，包括因空座导致的福利损失。随后，我们引入一种新机制，该机制在解决这些缺陷的同时，还满足多种座位限制下的其他理想性质。我们还表明，我们提出的机制确保在尊重乘客偏好和优先级排序的前提下，尽可能多的乘客能够就座。

10.1111/sjoe.70004.abstract: Based on a sample of elderly individuals from the Survey of Health, Ageing, and Retirement in Europe, we investigate the relationship between job and marital stability over the life cycle. We argue that an unobserved, time-varying social skill affects stability in both markets. Using a grouped fixed-effects estimator, we show that unobserved relationship stability in both markets is significantly and positively associated. Instability in both markets is associated with lower levels of trust and conscientiousness, and higher levels of extraversion and neuroticism. The absence of the father during childhood perpetuates higher instability later in life. Higher instability is also costly as it is associated with lower levels of late-life well-being.
10.1111/sjoe.70004.abstract_zh: 基于欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查中老年个体的样本，我们考察了生命周期中职业与婚姻稳定性的关系。我们认为，一种未被观测到的、随时间变化的社会技能影响着两个市场的稳定性。采用分组固定效应估计方法，我们发现在两个市场中，未被观测到的关系稳定性之间存在显著的正向关联。两个市场中的不稳定性与较低的信任度和尽责性，以及较高的外向性和神经质水平相关。童年时期父亲的缺失会加剧晚年生活中的更高不稳定性。更高的不稳定性代价高昂，因为它与晚年福祉水平较低相关联。

10.1111/sjoe.70005.abstract: Empirical models of trade agreements implicitly assume that withdrawal from a trade agreement has an equal and opposite trade effect as accession (i.e., symmetry). With increasing opposition to international economic cooperation, it becomes urgent to test this assumption. We analyze a quasi-natural experiment to explicitly test the symmetry assumption in the context of the termination of a free trade agreement (FTA) using the gravity model. In 2004, Estonia joined the European Union, which mandated that it withdraw from its FTA with Ukraine. Carefully controlling for possible confounding effects of European Union enlargement using a variety of methods, we isolate the FTA withdrawal effect and find strong support in favour of symmetry. Moreover, while import tariffs matter, the bulk of the effect comes from non-tariff effects of an FTA. General equilibrium estimates suggest that the FTA withdrawal led to a noticeable welfare loss for members.
10.1111/sjoe.70005.abstract_zh: 贸易协定的实证模型隐含地假设，退出贸易协定与加入贸易协定具有相等且相反的贸易效应（即对称性）。随着对国际经济合作的反对日益加剧，检验这一假设变得尤为迫切。我们利用一个准自然实验，通过引力模型明确检验了自由贸易协定（FTA）终止情境下的对称性假设。2004年，爱沙尼亚加入欧盟，这要求其退出与乌克兰之间的自由贸易协定。通过多种方法仔细控制欧盟扩大的潜在混淆效应，我们分离出自由贸易协定退出的效应，并发现强烈支持对称性的证据。此外，尽管进口关税具有重要性，但大部分效应源自自由贸易协定的非关税影响。一般均衡估计表明，自由贸易协定的退出给成员国带来了显著的福利损失。

10.1111/sjoe.70006.abstract: We study the effect of introducing a market for green energy attributes on the market for the energy itself. In Europe, renewable energy producers receive Guarantees of Origin (GOs) that they can sell to consumers who wish to declare their electricity consumption as “green”. We introduce GOs in a model of the spot electricity market with price competition and capacity constraints. As GOs are issued only for dispatched electricity, we find that the GO market has a pro-competitive effect on the spot electricity market, leading to reduced electricity prices. Importantly, this pro-competitive effect disappears if the GO market were to be restricted by the transmission capacity in the spot market.
10.1111/sjoe.70006.abstract_zh: 我们研究了引入绿色能源属性市场对能源市场本身的影响。在欧洲，可再生能源生产商获得原产地保证（GOs），可将其出售给希望宣称其电力消费为“绿色”的消费者。我们在一个包含价格竞争和容量约束的现货电力市场模型中引入GOs。由于GOs仅针对已调度电力发放，我们发现GO市场对现货电力市场具有促进竞争的作用，导致电价下降。重要的是，如果GO市场因现货市场中的输电容量限制而受到约束，这种促进竞争的效果将消失。

10.1111/sjoe.70007.abstract: In this study, we analyze a symmetric policy game in a two-country model in which domestic policy affects a Ricardian comparative advantage. Considering a two-good, one-factor set-up in which each country's government provides a productive public good, we show that ex ante identical countries under free trade always choose different levels of public goods in the Nash equilibrium – meaning symmetry-breaking always occurs. We also examine how our analysis is modified in the presence of trade costs and in a multi-good set-up. Moreover, we present a more elaborate model with input–output linkages and entry regulation in an upstream market as an application.
10.1111/sjoe.70007.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们分析了一个两国模型中的对称政策博弈，其中国内政策影响李嘉图比较优势。考虑一个两商品、单要素的框架，其中每个国家的政府提供生产性公共物品，我们证明，在自由贸易下，事前相同的国家在纳什均衡中总是选择不同水平的公共物品——即对称性破缺总是发生。我们还考察了贸易成本的存在以及多商品框架下我们的分析如何被修正。此外，我们提出了一个更精细的模型，包含投入产出关联和上游市场进入规制，作为应用。

10.1111/sjoe.70008.abstract: We study how the correlation of employment across generations affects the intergenerational persistence of earnings in a simple model of labor market transitions and human capital accumulation. Using data from the United Kingdom, we first document that individuals whose father is employed have an 8 percentage points higher probability of being employed, driven by a 50 percent higher job-finding probability. We do not find similar patterns for job-separation probabilities. Calibrating our model to match these patterns, we find that the estimated job-finding probability differentials can account for up to 9 percent of the intergenerational persistence of earnings.
10.1111/sjoe.70008.abstract_zh: 我们研究就业跨代相关性如何影响劳动力市场转换与人力资本积累简单模型中的收入代际持续性。利用英国数据，我们首先记录到，父亲就业的个体就业概率高出8个百分点，这源于求职成功概率高出50%。我们未发现离职概率存在类似模式。将模型校准以匹配这些模式，我们发现估计的求职成功概率差异可解释收入代际持续性的高达9%。

10.1111/sjoe.70009.abstract: Sustainable growth has emerged as a critical policy challenge worldwide. We investigate the influence of conventional gender norms on fertility and economic growth to explain the phenomena recently observed across high-income countries. To this end, we construct an overlapping generations model with endogenous fertility and labor supply, incorporating gender norms and R&D activities. We demonstrate that conventional gender norms can impede fertility and economic growth. Specifically, when gender norms are sufficiently conservative, income growth stagnates and population erosion eventually occurs. Our results underscore the need to address and correct gender norms to achieve sustainable growth and improve welfare.
10.1111/sjoe.70009.abstract_zh: 可持续增长已成为全球面临的关键政策挑战。我们考察传统性别规范对生育率和经济增长的影响，以解释近期高收入国家观察到的现象。为此，我们构建了一个包含内生生育率和劳动供给、并纳入性别规范与研发活动的重叠世代模型。我们证明，传统性别规范可能阻碍生育率和经济增长。具体而言，当性别规范足够保守时，收入增长停滞，人口萎缩最终发生。我们的结果强调，为实现可持续增长并改善福利，有必要正视并纠正性别规范。

10.1111/sjoe.70010.abstract: We examine the cyclicality of the stepping-stone effect of temporary agency work in Germany across three business cycles using administrative data and a timing-of-events model. We estimate in- and post-treatment effects and their response to the unemployment rate. We find a strong lock-in effect of agency employment, particularly in tight labor markets, suggesting that firms rarely use agency work for screening. The positive post-treatment effect is larger in downturns, indicating that workers activate the networks built during agency jobs. The matching quality improves for those transitioning directly into regular employment, with greater gains in upturns.
10.1111/sjoe.70010.abstract_zh: 我们利用行政数据和事件时间模型，考察了德国三个商业周期中临时机构工作的垫脚石效应的周期性。我们估计了处理期间及处理后的效应及其对失业率的响应。我们发现机构就业存在强烈的锁定效应，尤其在劳动力市场紧张时更为显著，这表明企业很少利用机构工作进行筛选。处理后的正向效应在经济下行期更大，表明工人激活了在机构工作期间建立的网络。直接过渡到正规就业者的匹配质量有所提升，且在经济上行期收益更大。

10.1111/sjoe.70011.abstract: Utilizing a quasi-natural experiment design, we identify an exogenous cut in local taxes accompanied by an equivalent reduction in local government spending, and we estimate the impact of these exogenous changes on income. We exploit a unique regional dataset that combines local income data with local voting outcomes on current expense tax levies. Taxes and the associated spending change abruptly at the 50 percent vote share cutoff below which a tax levy fails to pass. This cutoff determines which observations serve as controls and which receive treatment: a reduction in local taxes and government spending. Voting percentages around the cutoff are a source of exogenous variation, with observations around this quasi-randomly assigned and very similar across characteristics. We find that balanced budget reductions in taxes and spending cause a large drop in local incomes in the first two years after the vote, suggesting that government expenditure effects on income are larger than fiscal revenue effects. The cumulative government spending multiplier of a balanced-budget change in spending for our baseline is a sizable 1.5. This effect of local tax-financed government spending is prominent in low-income and high-poverty areas, suggestive of mechanisms related to the share of liquidity-constrained agents.
10.1111/sjoe.70011.abstract_zh: 利用准自然实验设计，我们识别出地方税收的外生削减及与之等额的地方政府支出减少，并估计这些外生变化对收入的影响。我们利用一个独特的地域数据集，该数据集将地方收入数据与地方现行支出税征收的投票结果相结合。税收及相关支出在50%投票份额临界点处发生突变，低于此临界点，税收征收提案无法通过。这一临界点决定了哪些观测值作为对照组，哪些接受处理：即地方税收和政府支出的减少。临界点附近的投票百分比是外生变异的来源，这些观测值在此准随机分配下，各特征高度相似。我们发现，在投票后的头两年内，平衡预算下的税收与支出削减导致地方收入大幅下降，这表明政府支出对收入的影响大于财政收入效应。在我们的基线设定中，平衡预算支出变动的累积政府支出乘数高达1.5。这种地方税收融资的政府支出效应在低收入和高贫困地区尤为显著，暗示了与流动性受限代理人比例相关的机制。

10.1111/sjoe.70012.abstract: How do regional comparative advantages influence the long-term effects of government interventions? This paper explores this question using disaggregated data on factor endowments and industrial construction in China under the centrally planned economic system during 1953–1978. These investment decisions, primarily driven by political considerations, led to significant variations in the congruence between the factor intensity of policy-targeted industries and local endowment structure. Our findings show that while government interventions can have positive and lasting impacts on the size and efficiency of local industries, misalignments between the production technology of targeted industries and the factor endowment structure significantly weaken these effects.
10.1111/sjoe.70012.abstract_zh: 区域比较优势如何影响政府干预的长期效应？本文利用1953年至1978年间中国中央计划经济体系下要素禀赋与工业建设的细分数据，探讨了这一问题。这些主要受政治因素驱动的投资决策，导致了政策目标产业的要素密集度与地方禀赋结构之间契合度的显著差异。我们的研究结果表明，尽管政府干预能够对地方产业的规模与效率产生积极且持久的影响，但目标产业的生产技术与要素禀赋结构之间的错配会显著削弱这些效应。

10.1111/sjoe.70013.abstract: We study how acquisition-related foreign direct investment during economic crises affects R&D investments and the direction of innovation of target firms, compared with acquisitions made during periods of strong economic growth. Using a panel of Spanish firms, we find that foreign multinationals cherry-pick the best domestic firms, irrespective of the timing of acquisition. Using matching and difference-in-differences regressions, we find that firms acquired during economic crises experience smaller declines in R&D than those acquired during boom periods. Our results are consistent with the opportunity cost theory of R&D over the business cycle: during recessions, the relative cost of R&D falls, incentivizing innovation, particularly in new product development. However, only firms with sufficient access to finance can capitalize on these conditions. Our results suggest that acquisitions can ease financial constraints at a critical time, enabling target firms to sustain or redirect innovation efforts when incentives are most favorable.
10.1111/sjoe.70013.abstract_zh: 我们研究了经济危机期间与并购相关的外国直接投资如何影响目标企业的研发投资及创新方向，并与经济强劲增长期间的并购进行比较。利用西班牙企业面板数据，我们发现外国跨国公司无论并购时机如何，都会挑选国内最优企业。通过匹配和双重差分回归，我们发现经济危机期间被收购的企业，其研发下降幅度小于繁荣期被收购的企业。我们的结果与研发机会成本理论在经济周期中的表现一致：衰退期间，研发的相对成本下降，激励创新，尤其是在新产品开发方面。然而，只有具备充足融资渠道的企业才能利用这些条件。我们的结果表明，并购可以在关键时刻缓解融资约束，使目标企业在激励最有利时维持或调整创新努力。

10.1111/sjoe.70014.abstract: Is long-term economic stress from occupational decline linked to poor health or death? Using Swedish administrative data matched with US occupational trends, I examine this in reduced form and using instrumental variables. Workers who in 1985 worked in occupations that subsequently declined unexpectedly were more likely to die early than similar workers in non-declining occupations, with effect sizes of 6–19 percent of mean mortality. Cardiovascular deaths rose among men, while women faced higher mortality from alcohol, drugs, and suicide. Hospitalization days rose, as did prescription drug use for mental health problems. Effects were strongest for the lowest-paid.
10.1111/sjoe.70014.abstract_zh: 职业衰退带来的长期经济压力是否与健康状况不佳或死亡相关？利用瑞典行政数据匹配美国职业趋势，我通过简化形式及工具变量方法对此进行了考察。1985年从事后来意外衰退职业的工人，相较于非衰退职业中的类似工人，更可能早逝，效应规模为平均死亡率的6%至19%。男性心血管疾病死亡率上升，而女性则面临更高的酒精、药物及自杀相关死亡率。住院天数增加，精神健康问题的处方药使用也随之上升。这些影响在收入最低群体中最为显著。

10.1111/sjoe.70015.abstract: This paper incorporates labor market inactivity and long-term unemployment into the framework of optimal redistributive taxation. We examine how a combination of education policy, public employment programs, unemployment benefits, and optimal income taxation can effectively address both redistributive goals and the persistent challenges of long-term unemployment. Our analysis shows that the second-best optimal policy typically implies overprovision of education compared with a policy rule that reflects only direct marginal benefits and costs. At the same time, public employment programs and unemployment benefits tend to be underprovided. Using numerical simulations, we illustrate how this policy mix adapts to varying preferences for redistribution, productivity disparities, and the proportion of individuals at risk of long-term unemployment.
10.1111/sjoe.70015.abstract_zh: 本文将劳动力市场非活跃状态与长期失业纳入最优再分配税收框架之中。我们探讨了教育政策、公共就业项目、失业救济金及最优所得税如何协同作用，以有效应对再分配目标与长期失业这一持久挑战。分析表明，相较于仅反映直接边际收益与成本的政策规则，次优最优政策通常意味着教育供给过度。与此同时，公共就业项目与失业救济金则倾向于供给不足。通过数值模拟，我们展示了这一政策组合如何适应不同的再分配偏好、生产率差异以及面临长期失业风险人群的比例变化。

10.1111/sjoe.70016.abstract: If old firms are, on average, much larger than young firms, does this mean that firms get better with age? Using Danish administrative data on firms aged 0–65, we study the relationship between size and age. In the cross-section, average size is increasing with age. However, by exploiting the panel structure through the estimation of fixed effects or by using a partial identification approach to the so-called age–period–cohort problem, we find evidence that firm size increases with age only for the first 10–15 years, and falls after that. Moreover, sample composition effects seem to be important to understand the patterns in the cross-section: we find significant differences in exit rates by firm size and strong cohort effects for firms entering in the late 1950s. We also find that the exit rate is not monotonically decreasing with age; for smaller firms, it starts increasing again in their 20s, spiking in their late 30s.
10.1111/sjoe.70016.abstract_zh: 如果老企业平均而言远大于年轻企业，这是否意味着企业会随年龄增长而变得更好？利用丹麦0至65岁企业的行政数据，我们研究了规模与年龄之间的关系。在横截面上，平均规模随年龄增长而增加。然而，通过利用面板结构进行固定效应估计，或采用部分识别方法处理所谓的年龄-时期-队列问题，我们发现企业规模仅在最初10至15年内随年龄增长，之后则下降。此外，样本构成效应似乎对理解横截面模式至关重要：我们发现不同规模企业的退出率存在显著差异，且对1950年代末期进入的企业存在强烈的队列效应。我们还发现，退出率并非随年龄单调递减；对于较小企业，退出率在20多岁时再次上升，并在30多岁后期达到峰值。

10.1111/sjoe.70017.abstract: In two separate field experiments with Swedish school children aged 10–16, we evaluate Environmental Education Programs designed to promote pro-environmental behavior; specifically, reduce household waste. We match the addresses of participating students with high-resolution administrative records on collected household waste. This allows us to estimate causal effects on the waste generated in households where a child was treated. Across both experiments, we find no detectable reductions in household waste. In the second experiment, we are also able to estimate the effect of regular environmental education within the Swedish school curriculum, and find little indication that this affects household waste.
10.1111/sjoe.70017.abstract_zh: 在针对瑞典10至16岁学龄儿童开展的两项独立实地实验中，我们评估了旨在促进亲环境行为、特别是减少家庭废弃物的环境教育项目。我们将参与学生的住址与高分辨率行政记录中收集的家庭废弃物数据进行匹配，从而能够估计儿童接受干预后对其家庭产生废弃物量的因果效应。在两项实验中，我们均未发现家庭废弃物有可检测的减少。在第二项实验中，我们还能估计瑞典学校课程中常规环境教育的影响，并发现几乎没有迹象表明这会影响家庭废弃物。

10.1111/sjoe.70018.abstract: We examine the health effects of a labor market activation policy in Sweden, the Youth Job Guarantee. To estimate causal effects, we implement a regression discontinuity design using the policy's age-eligibility threshold, together with detailed administrative data on health-related outcomes, including indicators of mental health. Health effects could arise indirectly, via effects on employment, or directly, for example via improved daily routines. In contrast to most existing studies on the health effects of active labor market programs, our results indicate that the activation policy did not have clear positive effects on health one year after the start of unemployment, measured by prescribed medication or medical contacts.
10.1111/sjoe.70018.abstract_zh: 我们考察了瑞典一项劳动力市场激活政策——“青年就业保障”对健康的影响。为估计因果效应，我们利用该政策的年龄资格门槛实施断点回归设计，并结合详细的行政数据，涵盖健康相关结果，包括心理健康指标。健康效应可能通过就业影响间接产生，或直接产生，例如通过改善日常作息。与大多数关于积极劳动力市场计划健康效应的现有研究相比，我们的结果表明，该激活政策在失业开始一年后，并未对健康产生明确的积极影响，这一结论基于处方药使用或医疗接触的测量。

10.1111/sjoe.70019.abstract: This paper develops a theory of when annuitization improves or reduces social welfare. The analysis is based on a small open economy with exogenous prices, populated by overlapping generations of non-altruistic agents. Annuities provide longevity risk insurance and above-market returns, but also reduce accidental bequests that transfer resources from the old to the young. I show that the welfare trade-off between these channels is governed by the interest rate: above a threshold, the cost of reducing bequests dominates and no annuitization is socially optimal; below it, partial annuitization improves welfare. Socially optimal allocations can be implemented by mandating a savings portfolio with a predetermined share invested in annuities. Governments that instead mandate annuities through fully funded pensions cannot replicate these allocations, even when annuity markets are missing and agents cannot borrow against future benefits. Although derived for small open economies, the results provide a benchmark for identifying when annuitization raises or lowers welfare and presumably extend to closed economies, where the boundary may still depend on the rate of return but now through threshold values of the parameters that determine it.
10.1111/sjoe.70019.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个理论框架，探讨年金化何时能增进或降低社会福利。分析基于一个价格外生的小型开放经济体，其中居住着无利他主义的世代交叠个体。年金提供长寿风险保险及高于市场水平的回报，但同时也减少了将资源从老年一代转移至年轻一代的意外遗产。研究表明，这些渠道间的福利权衡由利率决定：当利率高于某一阈值时，减少遗产的代价占据主导，此时不进行年金化是社会最优选择；而当利率低于该阈值时，部分年金化能提升社会福利。社会最优配置可通过强制规定储蓄组合中投资于年金的预定比例来实现。相比之下，即使年金市场缺失且个体无法以未来收益为抵押借款，政府通过完全基金制养老金强制推行年金也无法复制这些最优配置。尽管结论源于小型开放经济模型，但为识别年金化提升或降低福利的条件提供了基准，并可能推广至封闭经济，其中边界仍可能依赖于回报率，但此时是通过决定回报率的参数阈值来体现。

10.1111/sjoe.70020.abstract: We study how poor hand-to-mouth and wealthy hand-to-mouth households in the United States form their expectations as compared to unconstrained households. To do so, we use monthly household data for the period 2005:2 to 2013:6 with information on the exact survey day for each household within a month. Utilizing a timeline of financial crisis events along with changes in stock market values and uncertainty in the days around those events, we assess the response of these households' expectations regarding inflation, unemployment, and the interest rate. Our estimates imply differences in the formation of expectations for liquidity-constrained households relative to unconstrained households. Wealthy hand-to-mouth households tend to revise their inflation expectations downwards substantially so that they make lower forecast errors following adverse financial crisis events that lower the actual future inflation rate, while other households appear inattentive to these shocks. This suggests that the wealthy hand-to-mouth households decipher these financial events' noisy signal regarding lower future inflation more accurately than other households, in line with having a greater incentive to do so.
10.1111/sjoe.70020.abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国贫困手口相济家庭与富裕手口相济家庭在形成预期时，相较于无约束家庭有何不同。为此，我们使用了2005年2月至2013年6月期间的月度家庭数据，其中包含每户家庭在月内具体调查日的信息。利用金融危机事件的时间线，以及这些事件前后几天内股市价值变化和不确定性，我们评估了这些家庭对通胀、失业率和利率预期的反应。我们的估计结果显示，流动性受限家庭与无约束家庭在预期形成上存在差异。富裕手口相济家庭倾向于大幅下调其通胀预期，从而在不利金融危机事件导致实际未来通胀率下降时，产生较低的预测误差，而其他家庭似乎对这些冲击不够关注。这表明，富裕手口相济家庭能比其他家庭更准确地解读这些金融事件中关于未来通胀下降的噪声信号，这与他们拥有更强的动机去这样做相符。

10.1111/sjoe.70021.abstract: An important transmission channel of monetary policy is the expectations channel. However, although this channel is important in theory, it has received limited attention in the empirical literature. One reason for this lack of focus is the scarcity of data on firms' expectations. This paper uses a novel data set on firms' expectations and estimates how they respond to monetary policy announcements. I find that firms respond to unexpected changes in the current policy rate by revising downward expectations about price pressure, output and employment growth, and labor market tightness. However, following an unexpected tightening in the future path of monetary policy, firms revise upward expectations about output growth. While the first result is in line with the predictions of the New Keynesian model, the second provides support for the information effect of monetary policy.
10.1111/sjoe.70021.abstract_zh: 货币政策的重要传导渠道之一是预期渠道。然而，尽管这一渠道在理论上至关重要，但在实证文献中却受到的关注有限。缺乏关注的一个原因在于企业预期数据的稀缺性。本文利用一套关于企业预期的新数据集，估计了企业对货币政策公告的反应。研究发现，企业对当前政策利率的意外变动会下调对价格压力、产出与就业增长以及劳动力市场紧张程度的预期。然而，在货币政策未来路径出现意外收紧后，企业却上调了对产出增长的预期。虽然第一个结果与新凯恩斯模型的预测相符，但第二个结果则为货币政策的“信息效应”提供了支持。

10.1111/sjoe.70023.abstract: In this paper, we evaluate the link between job insecurity and one of the most important decisions that individuals take: homeownership. The 1999 rise in the French Delalande tax on firms that laid off older workers produced an unexpected exogenous rise in job insecurity for younger workers. A difference-in-differences analysis of panel data from the European Community Household Panel shows that this greater job insecurity significantly reduced the probability of becoming a homeowner. This drop seems more attributable to individual preferences rather than greater capital constraints, consistent with individuals reducing their exposure to long-term financial commitments in more uncertain environments.
10.1111/sjoe.70023.abstract_zh: 本文评估了工作不安全感与个人最重要的决策之一——购房之间的联系。1999年法国对解雇老年工人的企业征收的德拉朗德税上调，意外地外生地增加了年轻工人的工作不安全感。基于欧洲共同体住户面板数据的双重差分分析显示，这种更高的工作不安全感显著降低了成为房主的概率。这一下降似乎更多归因于个人偏好，而非更大的资本约束，这与个人在更不确定的环境中减少长期财务承诺暴露的倾向相一致。

10.1111/sjoe.70024.abstract: Does financial intermediation affect structural change? We address this question both theoretically and empirically, focusing on whether financial development reinforces structural change during the post‐industrialization phase, where employment, value‐added, and expenditure shares change towards services and away from manufacturing. We build a dynamic general equilibrium model in which structural change may be driven by mutually independent engines – sectoral productivity gaps, asymmetric factor elasticities – as well as by learning‐by‐doing. In all its variants, the model robustly predicts that exogenous reductions in intermediation costs (e.g., deregulation shocks) reinforce structural change. We take this prediction to the data by examining the effects of bank branching deregulation in the United States in the period from the 1960s to the 1990s. Within a staggered difference‐in‐differences framework, we show that bank branching deregulation reinforces the pattern of structural change already underway, leading to an increase in the services share of output and employment in deregulated states.
10.1111/sjoe.70024.abstract_zh: 金融中介是否影响结构变迁？我们从理论与实证两个层面探讨这一问题，重点关注金融发展在后工业化阶段是否强化了结构变迁——即就业、增加值与支出份额从制造业向服务业转移的过程。我们构建了一个动态一般均衡模型，其中结构变迁可能由相互独立的驱动因素——部门生产率差距、非对称要素弹性——以及干中学效应共同推动。在所有模型变体中，该模型稳健地预测：中介成本的外生降低（如放松管制冲击）会强化结构变迁。为验证这一预测，我们考察了美国20世纪60年代至90年代银行分支放松管制的效应。在交错双重差分框架下，我们证明银行分支放松管制强化了已在进行中的结构变迁模式，导致放松管制州的服务业产出与就业份额上升。
10.1111/sjoe.70024.title: Financial intermediation and structural change
10.1111/sjoe.70024.title_zh: 金融中介与结构性变化

10.1111/sjoe.70025.abstract: We analyse the general equilibrium implications of introducing a universal basic income (UBI) for employment and income in an economy characterized by involuntary unemployment. Our framework allows tax revenues and workers' reservation wages to adjust endogenously with employment to satisfy the government's budget constraint. We show that multiple equilibria may emerge and that a UBI can support higher employment when the initial equilibrium is characterized by high taxes. However, in this setting, replacing unemployment benefit schemes with UBI proves less effective at fostering employment, ultimately requiring higher taxes and yielding more limited welfare gains.
10.1111/sjoe.70025.abstract_zh: 我们分析了在存在非自愿失业的经济体中引入全民基本收入（UBI）对就业和收入的一般均衡影响。我们的框架允许税收收入和工人的保留工资随就业内生调整，以满足政府预算约束。研究表明，可能出现多重均衡，且当初始均衡以高税收为特征时，UBI能够支持更高的就业水平。然而，在此设定下，用UBI替代失业救济计划在促进就业方面效果较弱，最终需要更高的税收，且带来的福利收益更为有限。
10.1111/sjoe.70025.title: Basic income and employment

10.1111/sjoe.70026.abstract: In 2018, two compensating‐income variation studies, based on Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia, reported sharply different monetary health values: A$42,000–A$67,000 for a full quality‐adjusted life year (QALY) gain versus A$162,000 for a 0.10 QALY loss (implying A$1.6 million per QALY under linear scaling). We embark on econometric detective work to identify the sources of these discrepancies, carefully aligning samples, cross‐examining methodologies, and uncovering methodological differences that drive the divergent results. Gain–loss framing is the largest margin (consistent with willingness‐to‐accept/willingness‐to‐pay evidence), while estimator choice (instrumental variables versus reduced form) and income equivalization further magnify differences, jointly resulting in the order‐of‐magnitude gaps with implications beyond health.
10.1111/sjoe.70026.abstract_zh: 2018年，两项基于澳大利亚家庭、收入与劳动动态调查的补偿性收入变化研究，报告了截然不同的货币化健康价值：完全质量调整生命年（QALY）增益为42,000–67,000澳元，而0.10 QALY损失则为162,000澳元（在线性缩放下相当于每QALY 160万澳元）。我们展开计量经济学侦探工作，以识别这些差异的来源，仔细对齐样本、交叉检验方法论，并揭示导致结果分歧的方法论差异。得失框架是最大的差异来源（与意愿接受/意愿支付证据一致），而估计量选择（工具变量与简化形式）及收入等值化进一步放大了差异，共同导致了数量级上的差距，其影响超越了健康领域。
10.1111/sjoe.70026.title: Following the money: an econometric investigation into health valuations
10.1111/sjoe.70026.title_zh: 追踪资金流向：健康价值评估的计量经济学研究

10.1111/sjoe.70027.abstract: Public tenders typically involve uncertainty and unforeseen costs, which might not be fully known to the bidders themselves. This uncertainty may also concern adaptation costs to the procurer after the delivery, and information about such adaptation costs may influence the bidding strategies, even though the cost is paid by the procurer. Consequently, the availability of information matters, and if it is obtained by the procurer, withholding information from bidders may be better than sharing all of it. To investigate the methods of gathering information, we consider pre‐qualification stage questionnaires designed to obtain information from the bidders. If suitably designed, they can be used to disclose information of which the bidders are themselves unaware and can thereby serve as a tool for revealing the inherent tendency of the cost for the bidders, so that the unforeseen future cost can be estimated.
10.1111/sjoe.70027.abstract_zh: 公开招标通常涉及不确定性和不可预见的成本，投标人自身可能无法完全了解这些成本。这种不确定性还可能涉及交付后采购方的适应成本，尽管该成本由采购方承担，但有关此类适应成本的信息仍可能影响投标策略。因此，信息的可获得性至关重要。若采购方掌握了信息，对投标人隐瞒信息可能比完全共享更优。为探究信息收集方法，我们考虑在资格预审阶段设计问卷，以获取投标人的信息。若设计得当，此类问卷可用于披露投标人自身尚未意识到的信息，从而成为揭示投标人成本内在趋势的工具，进而对不可预见的未来成本进行估算。
10.1111/sjoe.70027.title: Information disclosure and questionnaires in public tenders
10.1111/sjoe.70027.title_zh: 公开招标中的信息披露与问卷调查

10.1111/sjoe.70028.abstract: People may create or seek out performance‐inhibiting obstacles to avoid negative feedback about their ability. This behavior, called self‐handicapping, allows agents to attribute failures to self‐imposed obstacles rather than to lack of competence. I model rational agents with preferences for maintaining self‐esteem, and provide sufficient conditions under which they engage in rational self‐handicapping behavior. I consider two policy applications: education and tournaments. Exams with noisier questions strictly increase studying. Policies encouraging particular groups to apply for jobs can result in strategic adjustment, decreasing applications from the targeted group.
10.1111/sjoe.70028.abstract_zh: 人们可能会制造或寻求阻碍表现的因素，以避免关于自身能力的负面反馈。这种被称为自我妨碍的行为，使个体能够将失败归因于自我设置的障碍，而非能力不足。本文构建了具有维护自尊偏好的理性主体模型，并给出了其从事理性自我妨碍行为的充分条件。研究涉及两项政策应用：教育与锦标赛。噪声更大的考试题目会显著提升学习投入。鼓励特定群体申请工作的政策可能导致策略性调整，反而降低目标群体的申请率。
10.1111/sjoe.70028.title: Self‐esteem and rational self‐handicapping

10.1111/sjoe.70029.abstract: Public pension and public health care policies – collectively referred to here as social security policies – are costly and increasingly challenged by demographic shifts. Using a two‐period overlapping generations model in which health investment affects both mortality and morbidity, we analytically study the optimal design of social security. Our model incorporates three market imperfections: an intergenerational externality, a constraint on saving for future consumption, and incomplete insurance markets. It also considers three policy instruments: subsidies for health investment, subsidies for health expenditures, and a pay‐as‐you‐go pension replacement rate. We analyze how the imperfections, along with evolving trends in mortality and morbidity, shape the optimal set‐up of social security policies. Our findings show that there is no universal design for optimal social security: the effectiveness of each instrument depends on the others and on market conditions, with stronger prevention policies emerging as key in aging societies and in systems with less generous pensions.
10.1111/sjoe.70029.abstract_zh: 公共养老金与公共医疗政策——统称为社会保障政策——成本高昂，且日益受到人口结构变化的挑战。本文采用一个两期世代交叠模型（其中健康投资同时影响死亡率和发病率），从理论层面分析社会保障的最优设计。模型纳入三种市场不完善因素：代际外部性、未来消费储蓄约束以及不完全保险市场；同时考虑三种政策工具：健康投资补贴、医疗支出补贴以及现收现付制养老金替代率。我们分析了这些市场不完善因素如何与死亡率和发病率的演变趋势共同塑造社会保障政策的最优配置。研究结果表明，最优社会保障并不存在统一模式：每种工具的有效性取决于其他工具及市场条件，在老龄化社会及养老金待遇较低的制度中，强化预防性政策成为关键举措。
10.1111/sjoe.70029.title: On the optimality of social security instruments
10.1111/sjoe.70029.title_zh: 论社会保障工具的最优性

10.1111/sjoe.70030.abstract: In many environmental problems, emissions are hard to monitor and abatement costs are privately known. We study how efficient abatement nevertheless can be induced through market‐like arrangements that condition transfers on verifiable abatement rather than on measured emissions. We characterize the transfer schemes that implement efficient abatement in unique dominant strategies and show that a single scheme, the beneficiaries‐compensate transfer scheme, emerges under two distinct characterizations: one based on equilibrium properties and one grounded in classical fairness axioms. Under the beneficiaries‐compensate transfer scheme, each agent compensates others according to the benefits received from their abatement. We illustrate its usefulness in two applications.
10.1111/sjoe.70030.abstract_zh: 在许多环境问题中，排放难以监测且减排成本属于私人信息。我们研究如何通过类似市场的安排——即依据可验证的减排量而非实测排放量进行转移支付——仍能实现有效减排。我们刻画了在唯一占优策略下实现有效减排的转移方案，并表明一种单一方案——受益者补偿转移方案——可通过两种不同特征化方式得出：一种基于均衡性质，另一种基于经典公平性公理。在受益者补偿转移方案下，每个参与者根据从他人减排中获得的收益对他人进行补偿。我们通过两个应用案例说明其有效性。
10.1111/sjoe.70030.title: Shifting the reference point in environmental regulation: from polluter‐pays to beneficiaries‐compensate
10.1111/sjoe.70030.title_zh: 环境规制中的参照点转移：从污染者付费到受益者补偿

10.1111/sjoe.70031.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the 2025 Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel to Philippe Aghion, Peter Howitt, and Joel Mokyr “for having explained innovation‐driven economic growth”. This paper examines their contributions in the context of the development process as a whole. Aghion and Howitt established the centrality of creative destruction in the growth process of advanced economies, identifying the displacement of existing technologies by superseding ones as a key mechanism in sustaining economic growth. Mokyr highlighted the role of a tightening link between theoretical knowledge and practical application during the Scientific Revolution and the Enlightenment in fostering technological progress in Western Europe on the eve of the Industrial Revolution. These frontier‐centered perspectives transformed our understanding of the causes and consequences of innovation‐driven growth in advanced economies operating near the technological frontier. Yet, throughout much of the development process, the central challenge to growth has depended less on the creation of new technologies than on the emergence of fundamental conditions conducive to skill formation, fertility decline, and societal adaptation, which have shaped the timing of the transition to modern growth, the pace of economic growth thereafter, and the contemporary inequality in the wealth of nations. A comprehensive account of sustained growth and contemporary inequality across societies requires anchoring the growth process in its broader historical arc.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70031.abstract_zh: 瑞典皇家科学院将2025年瑞典中央银行纪念阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔经济学奖授予菲利普·阿吉翁、彼得·豪伊特和乔尔·莫基尔，以表彰他们“解释了创新驱动的经济增长”。本文从整体发展进程的角度审视了他们的贡献。阿吉翁和豪伊特确立了创造性破坏在发达经济体增长过程中的核心地位，指出新兴技术对现有技术的替代是维持经济增长的关键机制。莫基尔则强调了科学革命和启蒙运动期间理论知识与应用实践之间日益紧密的联系，在工业革命前夕推动西欧技术进步中所发挥的作用。这些以技术前沿为中心的视角，深刻改变了我们对接近技术前沿的发达经济体中创新驱动增长的成因与后果的理解。然而，在整个发展进程中，增长面临的核心挑战与其说取决于新技术的创造，不如说取决于有利于技能形成、生育率下降和社会适应性的基本条件的出现——这些条件塑造了向现代增长转型的时机、此后经济增长的速度，以及当代国家间财富的不平等。要全面解释社会间持续增长与当代不平等现象，就必须将增长进程置于更广阔的历史脉络之中。
10.1111/sjoe.70031.title: Engines of growth and inequality in the wealth of nations
10.1111/sjoe.70031.title_zh: 国家财富增长与不平等的引擎

10.1111/sjoe.70033.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Among economists, the analysis of social mobility and the role of parental background is largely carried out in two separate strands of research. The intergenerational mobility literature estimates parent–child persistence in some outcome of interest, such as income. In contrast, the equality of opportunity literature is rooted in a normative framework, and has only more recently started generating empirical evidence. Intergenerational mobility regressions are relatively straightforward to estimate, but their normative implications are less obvious. Measures of equality of opportunity have a policy‐relevant interpretation, but are very data‐demanding, requiring a large set of observable determinants of socioeconomic status for large samples. But maybe the two approaches capture similar dynamics? We compare the approaches by estimating both equality of opportunity and intergenerational mobility measures – as well as sibling correlations – across 16 birth cohorts and 126 Swedish local labor markets. Using these estimates, we find that the different measures correlate strongly, suggesting that (variation in) intergenerational mobility is indeed informative about equality of opportunity.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70033.abstract_zh: 摘要：在经济学界，对社会流动性和父母背景作用的分析主要分为两个独立的研究方向。代际流动性文献估计了父母与子女在收入等特定结果变量上的持续性关联。相比之下，机会平等文献植根于规范性框架，直到近期才开始产生实证证据。代际流动性回归的估计相对直接，但其规范性含义却不甚明确。机会平等指标具有政策相关的解释意义，但对数据要求极高，需要大样本中大量可观测的社会经济地位决定因素。然而，这两种方法是否捕捉到了相似的动态特征？我们通过估算16个出生队列和126个瑞典地方劳动力市场的机会平等指标、代际流动性指标以及同胞相关性，对这两种方法进行了比较。基于这些估计，我们发现不同指标之间存在强相关性，这表明代际流动性的（变化）确实能够反映机会平等状况。
10.1111/sjoe.70033.title: The relationship between intergenerational mobility and equality of opportunity
10.1111/sjoe.70033.title_zh: 代际流动与机会平等之间的关系

10.1111/sjoe.70034.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In this paper, we investigate changes in time allocated to routine housework around four life events – cohabitation, marriage, first birth, and divorce – to explore the influence of social norms on gendered housework patterns. Using data from the German Socio‐Economic Panel (1991–2019), a timing‐based event study design reveals that gender differences intensify with cohabitation and parenthood. Women's housework hours increase significantly with the first child, while men's decrease. Marriage has no additional impact beyond cohabitation, and divorce leads to a rise in men's and a reduction in women's housework. Couples with higher‐earning women and those in East Germany show weaker adherence to these social roles.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70034.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察同居、结婚、生育第一个子女和离婚四个人生事件前后日常家务劳动时间的变化，探究社会规范对性别化家务分工模式的影响。基于德国社会经济面板数据（1991-2019年）的时间事件研究设计显示，性别差异在同居和成为父母后加剧。女性家务劳动时间在生育第一个子女后显著增加，而男性则减少。婚姻对家务时间的影响未超出同居效应，离婚则导致男性家务时间上升、女性家务时间下降。女性收入较高的夫妻以及东德地区的夫妻，对社会角色的遵循程度较弱。
10.1111/sjoe.70034.title: Uncovering the choreography of life: the impact of life transitions on gendered housework patterns
10.1111/sjoe.70034.title_zh: 揭示生活的编排：生命转折对性别化家务模式的影响

10.1111/sjoe.70035.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper examines the impact of importer dispersion on exchange rate pass‐through. Theoretically, we demonstrate that greater importer dispersion – characterized by larger variations in import size across importers – leads to higher demand elasticity and lower exporter markups, thereby resulting in greater exchange rate pass‐through. Using transaction‐level customs data from Colombia, we provide robust empirical evidence supporting this prediction. The quantitative effect of importer dispersion on exchange rate pass‐through is significant: the importer dispersion channel is at least as important as the traditional exporter heterogeneity channel. Our results are robust to various empirical specifications and become even stronger in the context of the dominant currency paradigm.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70035.abstract_zh: 本文研究了进口商分散度对汇率传递的影响。理论上，我们证明进口商分散度越高——即各进口商进口规模差异越大——会导致需求弹性上升和出口商加成率下降，从而增强汇率传递效应。基于哥伦比亚交易级海关数据，我们提供了支持这一预测的稳健实证证据。进口商分散度对汇率传递的量化影响显著：该渠道的重要性至少与传统出口商异质性渠道相当。研究结果在多种实证设定下保持稳健，且在主导货币范式背景下效应更为显著。
10.1111/sjoe.70035.title: Importer dispersion and exchange rate pass‐through
10.1111/sjoe.70035.title_zh: 进口商分散度与汇率传递效应

10.1111/sjoe.70036.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We investigate the existence of a middle‐income trap using finite state Markov chains, constant growth thresholds, and mean first passage times. As well as studying output per head, we examine the dynamics of its proximate determinants: total factor productivity (TFP), the capital–output ratio, and human capital. We find upward mobility in the relative capital–output ratio and human capital, but not in relative TFP. The persistence of relative TFP differences, particularly from intermediate income levels, implies slower progression toward frontier income. A middle‐income trap may therefore reflect asymmetric convergence dynamics near the frontier rather than a universal growth slowdown.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70036.abstract_zh: 我们利用有限状态马尔可夫链、恒定增长阈值和平均首次通过时间，研究了中等收入陷阱的存在性。除了考察人均产出外，我们还分析了其直接决定因素的动态变化：全要素生产率（TFP）、资本产出比和人力资本。研究发现，相对资本产出比和人力资本呈现向上流动性，但相对全要素生产率并未如此。相对全要素生产率差异的持续性，尤其是从中等收入水平来看，意味着向前沿收入水平的进展更为缓慢。因此，中等收入陷阱可能反映了靠近前沿水平时的不对称趋同动态，而非普遍的增长放缓。
10.1111/sjoe.70036.title: At the threshold: the increasing relevance of the middle‐income trap
10.1111/sjoe.70036.title_zh: 在门槛处：中等收入陷阱日益凸显的相关性

10.1111/sjoe.70037.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the 2025 Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel to Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion, and Peter Howitt “for having explained innovation‐driven economic growth”. Mokyr's work explains why sustained growth was historically rare: prosperity required societies capable of generating, diffusing, and applying useful knowledge. The theory of creative destruction established by Aghion and Howitt explains why economic progress is inherently disruptive, as new technologies continuously replace older technologies, firms, and rents. In this paper, I argue that these ideas moved innovation from the periphery to the center of growth economics and recast growth theory as a dynamic process driven by experimentation, rivalry, entry, and reallocation. Recent research has extended these insights in numerous directions, including heterogeneous firms, business dynamism, talent allocation, artificial intelligence, and green innovation. I conclude by arguing that the central challenge of modern growth policy is not simply to accelerate innovation, but to sustain institutions that keep economies open to creative destruction while preserving competition, broad opportunity, and political support for technological change.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70037.abstract_zh: 瑞典皇家科学院将2025年瑞典中央银行纪念阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔经济学奖授予乔尔·莫基尔、菲利普·阿吉翁和彼得·霍伊特，以表彰他们“解释了创新驱动的经济增长”。莫基尔的研究解释了为何持续增长在历史上极为罕见：繁荣需要社会具备生成、传播和应用有用知识的能力。阿吉翁与霍伊特建立的创造性破坏理论则阐明，经济进步本质上具有颠覆性，因为新技术不断取代旧技术、旧企业和旧租金。本文认为，这些思想将创新从增长经济学的边缘推向核心，并将增长理论重塑为由实验、竞争、进入和重新配置驱动的动态过程。近期研究已将这些洞见拓展至多个方向，包括异质性企业、商业活力、人才配置、人工智能和绿色创新。最后，本文指出现代增长政策的核心挑战并非简单加速创新，而是维持那些使经济对创造性破坏保持开放的制度，同时保护竞争、广泛机遇以及技术变革的政治支持。

10.1111/sjoe.70038.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In this paper, we analyze the impact of public dental care coverage – universal versus targeted – on access, pricing, and public spending in a model with two competing dental practices and heterogeneous patient income groups. We evaluate two types of reimbursement schemes: fixed subsidies and cost sharing. Our findings show that public coverage improves access for low‐income patients but increases producer prices due to reduced price elasticity of demand. Targeted coverage provides greater access at lower public cost compared with universal coverage, especially under cost‐sharing schemes. With fixed subsidies, both schemes achieve similar access, but targeted coverage remains more cost‐efficient. The policy that maximizes utilitarian welfare is targeted coverage with a fixed subsidy, balancing improved access for low‐income patients against higher prices for high‐income patients. This trade‐off highlights challenges in implementing targeted policies but provides insights for designing efficient and equitable public dental care systems.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70038.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建包含两家竞争性牙科诊所与异质性患者收入群体的模型，分析了公共牙科保险覆盖（全民覆盖与定向覆盖）对可及性、定价及公共支出的影响。我们评估了两种报销机制：固定补贴与成本分摊。研究结果表明：公共覆盖改善了低收入患者的可及性，但因需求价格弹性降低导致生产者价格上涨；相较于全民覆盖，定向覆盖能以更低的公共成本实现更高的可及性，尤其在成本分摊机制下更为显著。在固定补贴机制下，两种覆盖方案的可及性效果相近，但定向覆盖仍更具成本效率。实现功利主义福利最大化的政策方案是采用固定补贴的定向覆盖，该方案在改善低收入患者可及性与抑制高收入患者价格上涨之间取得平衡。这一权衡凸显了实施定向政策面临的挑战，但为设计高效且公平的公共牙科医疗体系提供了重要启示。
10.1111/sjoe.70038.title: Public coverage of dental care: universal or targeted?
10.1111/sjoe.70038.title_zh: 牙科护理的公共覆盖：全民还是定向？

10.1111/sjoe.70039.abstract: Abstract This paper studies the anchoring of inflation expectations at the individual forecaster level. It proposes a novel measure of anchoring based on both point and density forecasts, and uses data from the European Central Bank Survey of Professional Forecasters to examine its co‐movement with expectations about monetary policy and key cost‐push factors. The anchoring measure is constructed for each forecaster and regressed on expectations regarding the European Central Bank policy rate, crude oil prices, the US dollar/euro exchange rate, and unit labor costs. Although the cross‐sectional mean of long‐term inflation expectations appears largely stable, substantial heterogeneity emerges during periods of heightened macroeconomic uncertainty, with some forecasters exhibiting signs of de‐anchoring. The results show that individual anchoring is systematically related to expectations about future policy rates and unit labor cost changes. In addition, these relationships have strengthened since 2020 and display asymmetries depending on whether inflation expectations lie above or below the target.
10.1111/sjoe.70039.abstract_zh: 摘要  本文从个体预测者层面研究通胀预期的锚定情况。本文提出了一种基于点预测和密度预测的新型锚定度量方法，并利用欧洲央行专业预测者调查数据，考察其与货币政策预期及关键成本推动因素之间的协同变动关系。该锚定度量针对每位预测者构建，并基于其对欧洲央行政策利率、原油价格、美元/欧元汇率及单位劳动力成本的预期进行回归分析。尽管长期通胀预期的截面均值总体保持稳定，但在宏观经济不确定性加剧时期，预测者之间呈现出显著异质性，部分预测者表现出脱锚迹象。结果表明，个体锚定程度与未来政策利率及单位劳动力成本变化的预期存在系统性关联。此外，自2020年以来，这些关联性有所增强，且根据通胀预期高于或低于目标水平而呈现非对称特征。
10.1111/sjoe.70039.title: Anchoring of inflation expectations and the role of monetary policy and cost‐push factors
10.1111/sjoe.70039.title_zh: 通胀预期的锚定及货币政策与成本推动因素的作用

10.1111/sjoe.70040.abstract: I study the interaction between spiteful preferences and interdependent values in auctions. While spite causes overbidding in both auction formats, interdependent values affect spiteful bidders' incentives differently depending on the auction format. Relative to independent values, bidders with interdependent values are less affected by spite in first‐price auctions, but more affected in second‐price auctions: the decrease in bid shading is smaller in the former, while the increase in above‐value bidding is greater in the latter. This format‐dependent behaviour reflects the trade‐off between increased competitiveness driven by spite and caution induced by the winner's curse.
10.1111/sjoe.70040.abstract_zh: 本文研究了拍卖中恶意偏好与相互依存价值的交互作用。尽管恶意行为在两种拍卖形式中均导致过度出价，但相互依存价值对恶意竞拍者激励的影响因拍卖形式而异。相较于独立价值，具有相互依存价值的竞拍者在第一价格拍卖中受恶意影响较小，但在第二价格拍卖中受恶意影响更大：前者中出价折扣的降幅较小，而后者中高于价值出价的增幅较大。这种依赖于拍卖形式的行为，反映了恶意驱动的竞争性增强与赢家诅咒引发的谨慎性之间的权衡。
10.1111/sjoe.70040.title: Interdependent‐value auctions with spiteful bidders
10.1111/sjoe.70040.title_zh: 恶意竞拍者参与的相互依赖价值拍卖

10.1111/sjoe.70041.abstract: This study examines how young adults respond to local labor market disruptions caused by military base closures in Sweden between 1998 and 2005. The results show substantial differences in responses between men and women, reflecting the sharp gender imbalance in military roles. Affected men increase enrollment in tertiary education, particularly when living in proximity to higher education institutions. In contrast, women experience improved labor market outcomes a few years after a closure, with higher earnings and employment rates. This suggests that the structural transformation of the local labor market, following the exit of a major male‐dominated employer, benefits young women as they transition into employment in expanding sectors.
10.1111/sjoe.70041.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了1998年至2005年间瑞典军事基地关闭所引发的当地劳动力市场冲击对年轻人的影响。结果显示，男性和女性在应对方式上存在显著差异，这反映了军事岗位中严重的性别失衡。受影响的男性更倾向于接受高等教育，尤其是当他们居住在高等教育机构附近时。相比之下，女性在基地关闭数年后劳动力市场状况有所改善，表现为收入提高和就业率上升。这表明，随着以男性为主导的大型雇主退出，当地劳动力市场的结构性转型使年轻女性受益，她们得以进入扩张中的行业就业。
10.1111/sjoe.70041.title: Effects of military base closures on young adults
10.1111/sjoe.70041.title_zh: 军事基地关闭对年轻人的影响

10.1111/sjoe.70042.abstract: This study estimates the effects of an employment programme for disadvantaged unemployed individuals. The programme emphasized on‐the‐job training and contracting the unemployed for a few paid weekly work hours as a stepping stone into the labour market. Evaluated through a randomized controlled trial with 3,727 participants, the programme was found to accelerate transitions into part‐time work. Contrary to its intention, it permanently increased the share of participants receiving disability pensions among most disadvantaged groups. To explain this finding, we suggest that training, while enhancing productivity for some, simultaneously provided information of employability used in the assessment of disability pension eligibility.
10.1111/sjoe.70042.abstract_zh: 本研究评估了一项针对弱势失业者的就业计划的效果。该计划强调在职培训，并安排失业者每周从事数小时的有偿工作，作为进入劳动力市场的跳板。通过一项包含3，727名参与者的随机对照试验评估，发现该计划加速了向兼职工作的转变。与预期相反，它在大多数最弱势群体中永久性地提高了领取残疾抚恤金的参与者比例。为解释这一发现，我们认为培训在提升部分人生产力的同时，也提供了用于评估残疾抚恤金资格的可就业性信息。
10.1111/sjoe.70042.title: Stepping stone or exit path: experimental evidence on training the long‐term unemployed
10.1111/sjoe.70042.title_zh: 垫脚石还是退出通道：针对长期失业者培训的实验证据

10.1111/sjoe.70043.abstract: We present a model of optimal regulation in the presence of spillover effects and asymmetric countries, and we use it to study strategic interaction among countries in pharmaceutical price regulation, where the spillovers result from innovation in drug development. Regulators' pricing decisions affect welfare both directly and indirectly, via firms' R&D policies. We characterize two types of equilibrium, depending on whether countries price at, or above, the minimum level the industry is willing to accept to serve the market. The combination of these two equilibria may imply a U‐shaped relationship between countries' pharmaceutical prices and relative market size. Using data for 83 cancer drugs across 23 OECD countries, our empirical analysis supports this hypothesis, with results being robust to correcting for the impact of confidential price discounts and a range of different model specifications. Our findings contribute to the academic debate about the relationship between prices and market size, as well as the policy debate about using supranational procurement policies to lower prices. In particular, we show that joint procurement can lower or raise prices according to the sizes of the domestic markets that join to create a single purchasing authority.
10.1111/sjoe.70043.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个在存在溢出效应与不对称国家情形下的最优规制模型，并以此研究各国在药品价格规制中的策略互动，其中溢出效应源于药物研发领域的创新。监管者的定价决策通过企业的研发政策，既直接又间接地影响社会福利。我们刻画了两种均衡类型，其区分依据在于各国定价是处于行业愿意接受以服务市场的最低水平，还是高于该水平。这两种均衡的组合可能意味着国家间药品价格与相对市场规模之间存在U型关系。利用涵盖23个OECD国家、83种抗癌药物的数据，我们的实证分析支持了这一假设，且结果在考虑保密性价格折扣的影响及多种不同模型设定后依然稳健。我们的发现为关于价格与市场规模关系的学术辩论，以及关于运用超国家集中采购政策以降低价格的政策讨论均作出了贡献。特别是，我们表明，联合采购根据组成单一采购机构的各国内部市场规模的不同，既可能降低也可能抬高价格。
10.1111/sjoe.70043.title: Market size and strategic interaction in pharmaceutical price regulation
10.1111/sjoe.70043.title_zh: 药品价格监管中的市场规模与策略互动

10.1111/sjoe.70044.abstract: We evaluate the impact of the disclosure of artificial intelligence (AI) involvement in a charitable fundraising experiment, where participants received either AI‐generated or human‐written fundraising letters, with or without the disclosure of their origin. We find that both AI‐generated letters (whether edited by humans or not) and human‐written letters (whether edited by AI or not) significantly increase donations, producing similar positive effects. Importantly, these effects disappear when AI involvement is disclosed, regardless of whether the letters are generated or edited by AI. These findings suggest that, while AI improves the effectiveness of charitable fundraising, disclosing its use offsets this benefit.
10.1111/sjoe.70044.abstract_zh: 我们评估了在慈善募捐实验中披露人工智能（AI）参与的影响，该实验中，参与者收到了由AI生成或人类撰写的募捐信函，并可能被告知其来源。我们发现，无论是AI生成的信函（无论是否经过人工编辑）还是人类撰写的信函（无论是否经过AI编辑），都能显著增加捐款，且产生相似的正向效果。重要的是，当披露AI参与时，这些效果消失，无论信函是由AI生成还是编辑。这些发现表明，尽管AI提升了慈善募捐的有效性，但披露其使用却抵消了这一益处。
10.1111/sjoe.70044.title: AI helps until you say it does

10.1111/twec.70081.abstract: This paper examines the unintended consequences of the 2018–2019 US‐China trade war for Vietnam, a key bystander economy, using quarterly HS 8‐digit US import data from 2017Q1 to 2020Q4. While the average treatment effect on Vietnam's exports to the US is small and statistically insignificant, substantial heterogeneity arises from pre‐war revealed comparative advantages (RCAs). Vietnam experienced markedly stronger export growth in sectors where China held high pre‐war RCA, consistent with trade diversion and substitution effects. These gains were nonlinear and most pronounced in sectors where Vietnam initially had low comparative advantage, reflecting the exploitation of previously untapped export opportunities. Consequently, Vietnam captured meaningful trade‐diversion benefits primarily outside its pre‐existing areas of comparative strength. In addition, we provide consistent evidence that the relocation of MNCs is strongly associated with the observed export surge. By quantifying these spillovers, our study contributes to the literature on global value chain dynamics and trade protectionism.
10.1111/twec.70081.abstract_zh: 本文利用2017年第一季度至2020年第四季度美国HS 8位数进口季度数据，考察了2018-2019年中美贸易战对关键旁观经济体越南的意外后果。尽管越南对美出口的平均处理效应较小且统计上不显著，但战前显性比较优势（RCA）的差异导致了显著的异质性。在中国战前RCA较高的行业中，越南出口增长明显更为强劲，这与贸易转移和替代效应一致。这些收益呈非线性特征，且在越南初始比较优势较低的行业中最为显著，反映了对先前未开发出口机会的利用。因此，越南主要在其既有比较优势领域之外获得了显著的贸易转移收益。此外，我们提供了一致证据表明，跨国公司的迁移与观察到的出口激增密切相关。通过量化这些溢出效应，本研究为全球价值链动态与贸易保护主义相关文献做出了贡献。

10.1111/twec.70089.abstract: This paper examines indications of shifts in the European Union's (EU) import relationships in an increasingly fragmented global trade environment. Using highly disaggregated product‐level trade data, we provide an initial exploration of the reallocation of EU import flows over the 2021–2024 period, considering what these emerging patterns may imply for diversification and price developments. The timing of this analysis is relevant given rising geopolitical uncertainties and the parallel rollout of EU initiatives aimed at enhancing internal capacities and mitigating risks in critical supply chains. Our findings indicate that the EU's supply chains show initial signs of adaptability within the evolving global landscape. Despite sectoral differences, our analysis points to a recent overall shift in EU imports away from countries lacking bilateral trade initiatives with the EU towards the EU itself, as well as neighbouring and distant partners engaged in such initiatives. We find indications that this development is associated with higher overall diversification in EU imports across all partners. However, the reallocation seems more focused on a subset of agreement partners, which may partly reflect the gradual adjustment needed to build capacity elsewhere. In addition, we find mixed evidence of short‐term upward pressure on prices. All in all, the paper aims to highlight emerging trends in EU imports and the related challenges of balancing efficiency and resilience.
10.1111/twec.70089.abstract_zh: 本文考察了在全球贸易环境日益碎片化的背景下，欧盟进口关系发生变化的迹象。利用高度细化的产品层面贸易数据，我们初步探索了2021-2024年期间欧盟进口流的重新配置，并探讨这些新兴模式对多元化和价格发展的潜在影响。鉴于地缘政治不确定性上升，以及欧盟同步推出旨在增强内部能力并降低关键供应链风险的举措，本研究的时机具有现实意义。我们的研究结果表明，欧盟供应链在全球格局演变中展现出初步的适应能力。尽管存在行业差异，但分析指出，近期欧盟进口整体上正从缺乏双边贸易协定的国家转向欧盟自身，以及参与此类协定的邻近和远距离伙伴。我们发现，这一趋势与欧盟进口在所有伙伴中的整体多元化程度提高相关。然而，重新配置似乎更集中于部分协定伙伴，这在一定程度上可能反映了在其他地区建设产能所需的渐进调整过程。此外，关于短期价格上行压力，我们发现了不一致的证据。总体而言，本文旨在揭示欧盟进口的新兴趋势，以及平衡效率与韧性所面临的相关挑战。

10.1111/twec.70091.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Chinese state‐owned enterprises (SOEs) serve as critical institutional anchors in supply chains. Utilising panel data from 1076 Chinese A‐share listed firms during the period of 2008–2016, this study examines the impact of SOEs on global value chain (GVC) participation of their suppliers. The empirical results from difference‐in‐differences method demonstrate that SOEs significantly enhance their suppliers' GVC participation. Mechanism tests reveal that SOEs boost their suppliers' GVC participation through operational enhancements, supply chain efficiency and FDI attraction improvements. In addition, this study identifies that resource misallocation and coordination costs negatively moderate the effect of SOEs on their suppliers' GVC participation. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the positive effects of SOEs are stronger for large suppliers and those suppliers without micro and small enterprises (MSEs) as major customers. Notably, SOEs enhance the intensive‐margin of GVCs but have a negligible effect on the extensive‐margin. These findings position SOEs as catalysts for GVC participation, offering policy insights for other economies with SOEs.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70091.abstract_zh: 中国国有企业在供应链中扮演着关键的制度锚点角色。本研究利用2008-2016年间1076家中国A股上市公司的面板数据，考察国有企业对其供应商全球价值链参与度的影响。基于双重差分法的实证结果表明，国有企业显著提升了其供应商的全球价值链参与度。机制检验显示，国有企业通过运营优化、供应链效率提升以及外商直接投资吸引力增强等途径，促进了供应商的全球价值链参与。此外，本研究发现资源错配与协调成本会负向调节国有企业对供应商全球价值链参与度的促进作用。异质性分析表明，对于大型供应商以及不以微型和小型企业为主要客户的供应商而言，国有企业的正向效应更为显著。值得注意的是，国有企业主要强化了全球价值链的集约边际，而对扩展边际的影响微乎其微。这些发现将国有企业定位为全球价值链参与的催化剂，为其他拥有国有企业的经济体提供了政策启示。
10.1111/twec.70091.title: Do China's State‐Owned Enterprises Promote Their Suppliers' Participation in Global Value Chains?
10.1111/twec.70091.title_zh: 中国国有企业是否促进了其供应商参与全球价值链？

10.1111/twec.70094.abstract: This paper examines the effects of bank FinTech on credit risk inefficiency using data for Chinese commercial banks from 2008 to 2017. We first construct a bank FinTech index with the help of web crawler technology and the data mining theory. Then, we examine the effects of bank FinTech on credit risk inefficiency. The results show that the development of bank FinTech significantly reduces credit risk inefficiency. Further, we explore the indirect effects and find that bank FinTech increases non‐interest business and thus reduces credit risk inefficiency. Finally, we find that the beneficial effects of bank FinTech on credit risk inefficiency are weaker for listed banks and state‐owned banks.
10.1111/twec.70094.abstract_zh: 本文利用2008—2017年中国商业银行数据，考察银行金融科技对信贷风险非效率的影响。首先，借助网络爬虫技术和数据挖掘理论构建银行金融科技指数；其次，检验银行金融科技对信贷风险非效率的作用。结果表明，银行金融科技的发展显著降低了信贷风险非效率。进一步探究间接效应发现，银行金融科技通过增加非利息业务从而降低信贷风险非效率。最后，研究发现银行金融科技对信贷风险非效率的积极效应在上市银行和国有银行中较弱。

10.1111/twec.70095.abstract: This study investigates the impact of bank capital regulation on firms' export behaviour within a two‐country theoretical framework that explicitly incorporates the banking sector. We show that more stringent capital requirements discourage firms from exporting and reduce export scale by increasing financing costs through tighter lending conditions. Using a comprehensive dataset of listed firms in China, we find that higher bank capital adequacy ratios are associated with lower export propensity and export volumes, with effects particularly pronounced for firms more reliant on bank credit. We further explore the moderating roles of financial market development and monetary policy. The results indicate that more developed financial markets amplify the adverse effects of bank capital regulation on firms' export performance, whereas tighter monetary policy mitigates these effects. By integrating banking regulation, financial conditions, and firm‐level trade outcomes, this study contributes to the literature on banking and international trade and offers policy‐relevant insights for regulators seeking to balance financial stability with firms' international competitiveness.
10.1111/twec.70095.abstract_zh: 本研究在明确纳入银行部门的两国理论框架下，探讨了银行资本监管对企业出口行为的影响。研究表明，更严格的资本要求通过收紧贷款条件提高融资成本，从而抑制企业出口意愿并降低出口规模。基于中国上市公司综合数据集，我们发现银行资本充足率越高，企业出口倾向与出口量越低，且该效应在更依赖银行信贷的企业中尤为显著。我们进一步探究了金融市场发展与货币政策的调节作用：结果显示，更发达的金融市场会放大银行资本监管对企业出口绩效的负面效应，而紧缩性货币政策则能缓解该影响。通过整合银行监管、金融条件与企业层面贸易结果，本研究为银行业与国际贸易领域的文献做出贡献，并为寻求平衡金融稳定与企业国际竞争力的监管者提供政策启示。

10.1111/twec.70096.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In this paper, we analyse the determinants of maritime connections, with a special focus on the importance of foreign direct investments (FDI) in improving maritime transportation networks and in restructuring them. We are also interested in how China, in particular, impacts countries' integration to global supply chains through maritime transportation. We work on a heterogeneous panel of bilateral maritime connections as measured by UNCTAD's bilateral liner shipping connectivity index, and we find that FDIs between two partner countries do not significantly impact their maritime connection. However, we do find that Chinese FDIs in countries concerned by the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) reinforce bilateral maritime connections between countries, in general, be they BRI countries or not. The Chinese influence is also significant via their maritime presence: maritime connections between two countries are significantly higher when host countries have strong maritime ties to China. A deeper analysis through several interaction effects also shows the Chinese influence is conditional on host countries' attributes. For instance, a maritime connection with China is more beneficial to developing/poorer host countries, who see their connection to origin countries increase more as compared to developed/richer host countries.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70096.abstract_zh: 本文分析了海上连接的决定因素，特别关注外国直接投资在改善海上运输网络及其结构调整中的重要性。我们还重点研究了中国如何通过海上运输影响各国融入全球供应链。基于联合国贸发会议双边班轮航运连接指数衡量的异质性双边海上连接面板数据，我们发现两国之间的外国直接投资并未显著影响其海上连接。然而，中国在“一带一路”倡议相关国家的直接投资普遍加强了各国（无论是否为“一带一路”国家）之间的双边海上连接。中国的海上存在也产生了显著影响：当东道国与中国有紧密的海上联系时，两国之间的海上连接显著更高。通过多种交互效应的深入分析表明，中国的影响取决于东道国的特征。例如，与中国建立海上连接对发展中国家/较贫穷的东道国更为有利，这些国家与来源国的连接提升幅度大于发达国家/较富裕的东道国。
10.1111/twec.70096.title: Foreign Direct Investment and Maritime Transportation Infrastructure: Competition Effects Under the Belt and Road Initiative
10.1111/twec.70096.title_zh: 外商直接投资与海上交通基础设施：“一带一路”倡议下的竞争效应

10.1111/twec.70097.abstract: This paper uses datasets on Chinese public firms to examine the impact of clan culture on firm export activities in China. We find that a one standard deviation increase in our clan culture measure leads to a 10.27% increase in the firm export intensity on average. Mechanism analysis shows that the role of clan culture in promoting export activities is due to the rapid information sharing among clan members. Moreover, these effects are more pronounced in regions predominantly inhabited by Han Chinese and those with low levels of marketization.
10.1111/twec.70097.abstract_zh: 本文利用中国上市公司数据集，考察宗族文化对企业出口活动的影响。研究发现，宗族文化强度每增加一个标准差，企业出口强度平均提升10.27%。机制分析表明，宗族文化促进出口活动的作用源于宗族成员间的快速信息共享。此外，这种效应在汉族人口占主导地位以及市场化程度较低的地区更为显著。

10.1111/twec.70098.abstract: This paper examines how environmental stringency influences firms' participation in Global Value Chains (GVCs) in developing countries. Using the World Bank Enterprise Surveys data, we analyse the effects of domestic environmental regulations and environmental treaties on both the extensive and intensive margins of GVC participation. Our findings reveal that domestic environmental regulations increase firms' likelihood of GVC integration under both simple and strict definitions, lending support to the Porter Hypothesis. Additionally, we find that these positive effects are amplified when firms invest in R&D. Both SMEs and large firms benefit from environmental stringency, with SMEs particularly gaining when they hold foreign certification and have foreign ownership. However, the effect of environmental treaties remains inconclusive, likely due to weak enforcement or vague provisions. The results remain robust in different specifications and after controlling for the endogeneity of such regulations and treaties.
10.1111/twec.70098.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了环境规制强度如何影响发展中国家企业参与全球价值链（GVCs）的行为。基于世界银行企业调查数据，我们分析了国内环境法规与环境条约对GVC参与广度与深度的影响。研究发现，在简单定义与严格定义下，国内环境法规均能提升企业融入GVC的可能性，这一结果支持了波特假说。此外，我们发现当企业进行研发投入时，这些积极效应会进一步增强。中小企业与大型企业均能从环境规制中获益，其中持有外国认证及外资持股的中小企业获益尤为显著。然而，环境条约的影响尚不明确，这可能是由于执行力度不足或条款模糊所致。在控制法规与条约内生性后，不同模型设定下的结果仍保持稳健。

10.1111/twec.70099.abstract: Digitally deliverable services (DDS) are playing a growing role in global trade, yet empirical evidence on how Aid for Trade (AfT) relates to DDS remains limited. This study examines the bilateral association between AfT and DDS using data for 29 donors and 134 recipients from 2005 to 2019 within a PPML‐based structural gravity framework. AfT is positively associated with DDS exports from donors to recipients, whereas AfT from EU institutions is significantly associated only with DDS imports from EU member states to recipients. Digital trade agreement (DTA) shows positive but limited associations, largely concentrated on donor‐to‐recipient DDS exports. Among AfT components, support for trade‐related infrastructure (INF) and building productive capacity (BPC) are most consistently associated with higher DDS exports, while assistance with trade policy regulation and trade‐related adjustments (TPR) shows weaker links with DDS exports but more frequent associations with higher DDS imports. Sector‐level estimates indicate heterogeneous responses across DDS categories, with stronger associations for non‐LDC and high‐governance recipients. Finally, the results suggest that AfT can help expand digital trade, but its impact would be strong if more support were directed at improving recipients' export capabilities and regulatory frameworks.
10.1111/twec.70099.abstract_zh: 数字可交付服务（DDS）在全球贸易中的作用日益凸显，但关于"贸易援助"（AfT）与DDS关联性的实证证据仍较为有限。本研究基于2005-2019年29个援助国与134个受援国的数据，采用基于PPML的结构性引力模型框架，考察了AfT与DDS之间的双边关联。研究发现，AfT与援助国对受援国的DDS出口呈正相关，而欧盟机构的AfT仅与欧盟成员国对受援国的DDS进口存在显著关联。数字贸易协定（DTA）虽呈现正向关联但影响有限，主要集中在援助国对受援国的DDS出口领域。在AfT构成要素中，贸易相关基础设施支持（INF）与生产能力建设（BPC）与DDS出口增长关联最为稳定，而贸易政策法规及贸易调整援助（TPR）与DDS出口关联较弱，但与DDS进口增长关联更为频繁。行业层面估计显示，不同DDS类别的反应存在异质性，非最不发达国家及治理水平较高的受援国表现出更强的关联性。最后，研究结果表明AfT有助于扩大数字贸易，但若将更多支持用于提升受援国的出口能力与监管框架，其影响将更为显著。

10.1111/twec.70100.abstract: This study investigates whether South–South cooperation delivers tangible economic benefits by examining the impact of the BRICS Plus platform on the economic development of participating countries. Using national‐level panel data for 125 countries from 2009 to 2022 and applying a staggered Difference‐in‐Differences approach, we find that BRICS Plus participation is associated with an average annual GDP per capita growth rate increase of approximately 3.42% compared to non‐participating countries on the same continent. Mechanism analysis suggests that the positive effect is driven by enhanced foreign direct investment, improvements in trade balances, and expanded financing channels, with India and China playing leading roles through investment, and South Africa contributing through regional financing. Participation is also linked to improved governance and reductions in civil conflicts but shows no significant increase in aid inflows from other international organizations. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the positive economic effects are concentrated in Asian and African countries, among low‐ and lower‐middle‐income economies with higher agricultural shares, and in countries with stronger initial infrastructure. Overall, the results provide empirical support for the developmental potential of institutionalized South–South cooperation through platforms like BRICS Plus.
10.1111/twec.70100.abstract_zh: 本研究通过考察金砖+平台对参与国经济发展的影响，探究南南合作是否带来切实的经济效益。基于2009至2022年间125个国家的跨国面板数据，采用交错双重差分法，我们发现：相较于同大洲的非参与国，金砖+参与国的年均人均GDP增长率约提高3.42%。机制分析表明，这一积极效应源于外国直接投资增长、贸易平衡改善及融资渠道拓宽——其中印度和中国通过投资发挥引领作用，南非则通过区域融资作出贡献。参与金砖+还与治理水平提升及国内冲突减少相关，但未显著增加其他国际组织的援助流入。异质性分析显示，积极经济效应集中于亚洲和非洲国家、农业占比较高的低收入及中低收入经济体，以及初始基础设施较完善的国家。总体而言，本研究为通过金砖+等平台实现制度化的南南合作的发展潜力提供了实证支持。

10.1111/twec.70101.abstract: This paper evaluates two core export‐promotion tools: internationalization grants and matchmaking services provided by the Portuguese export promotion agency (AICEP). We merge administrative records with customs and firm data for 2012–2021. We employ an event‐study approach with firm and year fixed effects in a setup of staggered adoption of the programs. Internationalization grants increase treated firms' total exports by approximately 13%, while matchmaking services raise exports to France by approximately 32%. Effects are larger for micro and small firms (grants 18%; matchmaking 40%) and concentrated in traditional manufacturing sectors. Results also show that both export promotion programs are effective when supporting firms with a permanent presence in international markets, versus occasional exporters. Event‐study diagnostics show flat pre‐trends, and placebo and anticipation checks support identification. Complementarily, finite‐duration robustness tests show no rapid fadeout after 3 years, and a simple cost–benefit analysis indicates that both programs have favorable cost–benefit outcomes.
10.1111/twec.70101.abstract_zh: 本文评估了两种核心出口促进工具：葡萄牙出口促进机构（AICEP）提供的国际化补贴和配对服务。我们整合了2012-2021年的行政记录、海关数据与企业数据。在项目分阶段推行的设定下，采用包含企业固定效应和年份固定效应的事件研究方法。国际化补贴使受处理企业的总出口额增加约13%，而配对服务使对法国的出口额增加约32%。对微型和小型企业的影响更大（补贴效应18%；配对效应40%），且集中于传统制造业部门。研究结果还表明，当支持企业在国际市场保持长期存在时，两种出口促进工具均比支持偶发性出口商更为有效。事件研究诊断显示预处理期趋势平稳，安慰剂检验和预期效应检验支持识别有效性。此外，有限期稳健性检验表明，三年后效应未快速衰减，简单的成本收益分析显示两种项目均具有有利的成本收益结果。

10.1111/twec.70102.abstract: Production networks influence economic outcomes through several channels. On the one hand, linkages within such networks enhance productivity and have been pivotal for development. On the other hand, integration into Global Value Chains (GVCs) can drive economic upgrading. This paper provides a comprehensive empirical analysis of these mechanisms over the long run. Using a long-run multi-country input–output dataset (1965–2014), we trace the origins and evolution of global production networks (GPNs). By employing parsimonious measures of production structure (namely, upstreamness and downstreamness), we show that both national and international linkages relate to different dimensions of economic performance. Although highly correlated, the two measures exhibit distinct associations with sectoral performance. At the aggregate country level, only downstreamness remains robustly associated with growth, even after controlling for an extensive set of covariates. Finally, we show that growth is not driven by centrality in GPNs per se, but by embeddedness through its connection to the share of intermediate goods in production.
10.1111/twec.70102.abstract_zh: 生产网络通过多种渠道影响经济成果。一方面，此类网络内部的联系提升了生产率，并对发展起到了关键作用。另一方面，融入全球价值链（GVCs）能够推动经济升级。本文对这些机制进行了长期全面的实证分析。利用一个长期多国投入产出数据集（1965-2014年），我们追溯了全球生产网络（GPNs）的起源与演变。通过采用生产结构的简约度量指标（即上游度和下游度），我们展示了国内与国际联系如何与经济绩效的不同维度相关联。尽管这两个指标高度相关，但它们与部门绩效的关联却呈现出显著差异。在国家总体层面，即使在控制了大量协变量之后，只有下游度与增长保持稳健的相关性。最后，我们指出增长并非由在全球生产网络中的中心地位本身驱动，而是通过其与生产中中间品份额的关联所体现的嵌入性所驱动。

10.1111/twec.70103.abstract: This paper investigates whether and how U.S. exporters circumvent China's anti‐dumping (AD) measures by re‐routing trade through third countries. Using detailed data on AD cases and monthly trade flows of China and U.S. from 2002 to 2011, we apply a triple‐differences (DDD) approach to identify abnormal trade‐flow adjustments consistent with third‐country re‐routing. We find evidence of such patterns in a subset of cases following final AD rulings. Product characteristics, such as lower differentiation, higher financial leverage, and greater inventory pressure, are associated with variation in the feasibility and intensity of circumvention. Moreover, circumvention tends to occur through countries that are institutionally closer to the U.S. and geographically concentrated in Asia‐Oceania routes. The possible circumvention emerges after final rulings rather than during investigations.
10.1111/twec.70103.abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国出口商是否以及如何通过第三国转运来规避中国的反倾销措施。基于2002年至2011年间中国与美国的反倾销案例详细数据及月度贸易流量，我们采用三重差分法识别与第三国转运模式相符的异常贸易流量调整。研究发现，在最终反倾销裁决后的部分案例中存在此类模式。产品特征（如差异化程度较低、财务杠杆较高及库存压力较大）与规避行为的可行性和强度差异相关。此外，规避行为往往通过与美国制度距离较近且地理上集中于亚洲-大洋洲路线的国家发生。可能的规避行为出现在最终裁决之后，而非调查期间。

10.1111/twec.70105.abstract: The recent surge in outward foreign direct investment (OFDI) from developing countries has sparked concerns that inadequate environmental regulations in these nations could result in adverse environmental impacts on host countries through such investments. Focusing on the typical representative of developing countries' OFDI, this study explores the impact of China's greenfield investment on green total factor productivity (GTFP) in host countries, and analyzes the moderating effect of environmental regulations on greenfield investment according to the theory of Directed Technical Change. The results indicate that China's greenfield investment significantly boosts the host countries' GTFP, balancing the relationship between economic development and environmental pollution. Mechanism analysis shows that China's greenfield investment promotes GTFP via industrial structure optimization and technological spillover effect. The former is significant at lower percentiles, while the latter only shows a learning effect without forming an overall demonstration effect to drive endogenous innovation. Compared with host countries' independent environmental regulation, relative environmental regulation presents more effective moderating effects. Heterogeneity tests confirm better moderating roles in medium intensity and developing host countries. This study offers valuable insights into how to better promote the green development impact of investments from developing countries.
10.1111/twec.70105.abstract_zh: 近年来，发展中国家对外直接投资的激增引发担忧：这些国家环境规制不足，可能通过此类投资对东道国环境产生负面影响。本研究以发展中国家对外直接投资的典型代表为切入点，探讨中国绿地投资对东道国绿色全要素生产率的影响，并基于定向技术变革理论分析环境规制对绿地投资的调节效应。结果表明，中国绿地投资显著提升了东道国的绿色全要素生产率，平衡了经济发展与环境污染之间的关系。机制分析显示，中国绿地投资通过产业结构优化和技术溢出效应促进绿色全要素生产率提升：前者在较低分位数水平上显著，而后者仅呈现学习效应，尚未形成驱动内生创新的整体示范效应。相较于东道国独立环境规制，相对环境规制表现出更有效的调节作用。异质性检验证实，中等强度环境规制及发展中国家东道国的调节效果更优。本研究为如何更好促进发展中国家投资对绿色发展的影响提供了重要启示。

10.1111/twec.70106.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Rising deglobalization has increased external uncertainty for the global economy. This paper develops a China–US Trade Equilibrium (CUTE) model that integrates monetary mechanisms and Hicksian welfare decomposition to examine the effects of U.S. tariff hikes on China and the U.S., as well as China's policy responses. A key contribution is the comparison of policy responses under identical policy costs. The results show that the direct macroeconomic impact of U.S. tariffs on China is modest, reflecting limited trade exposure and strong substitution effects, while broad tariffs generate larger welfare losses for the America through price increases and real income erosion. The reaction directly supporting household income and consumption yield substantially higher welfare returns than trade retaliation, government spending or monetary easing, as tariffs reduce real purchasing power. We suggest within the institutional settings considered, prioritizing household‐based demand support is a more effective response to external tariff shocks than retaliatory trade measures.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70106.abstract_zh: 去全球化趋势加剧了全球经济的外部不确定性。本文构建了一个整合货币机制与希克斯福利分解的中美贸易均衡（CUTE）模型，用以考察美国加征关税对中国和美国的影响，以及中国的政策应对。本文的关键贡献在于，在相同政策成本条件下比较了不同政策应对的效果。研究结果表明，美国关税对中国的直接宏观经济影响较为温和，这反映了有限的贸易敞口和较强的替代效应；而广泛性关税则通过价格上涨和实际收入侵蚀，给美国带来更大的福利损失。相较于贸易报复、政府支出或货币宽松政策，直接支持家庭收入和消费的应对措施能产生显著更高的福利回报，原因在于关税削弱了实际购买力。我们建议，在所考虑的体制环境下，优先采取基于家庭的需求支持政策，是应对外部关税冲击比报复性贸易措施更为有效的策略。
10.1111/twec.70106.title: Domestic Demand or Trade Retaliation? China's Policy Responses to U.S. Tariff Hikes
10.1111/twec.70106.title_zh: 国内需求还是贸易报复？中国对美国加征关税的政策回应

10.1111/twec.70107.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>U.S. overseas military deployments, as a strategic instrument for maintaining hegemony, structurally reconfigure international capital flows through a security‐economy nexus. While prior studies focus on host‐country perspectives, the third‐party economic spillovers of such deployments remain underexplored. This study investigates how they affect Chinese multinationals' foreign direct investment. The findings reveal a significant negative impact of U.S. military presence on Chinese FDI in host countries.
