Mechanism tests identify two channels: (1) institutional erosion—U.S. security patronage undermines host‐state governance, elevating political risk premiums that deter Chinese investment; (2) strategic anchoring—military presence strains host countries' relations with China, coupled with deep U.S. economic entrenchment, crowds out Chinese capital through both political and market channels. Heterogeneity analysis reinforces this logic. At the micro level, U.S. deployments heighten Chinese managers' perception of geopolitical risk, reshaping their attention allocation and subsequent investment decisions. These findings suggest that U.S. military retrenchment may reshape the strategic calculus of China's outward investment. By extending traditional FDI risk theory, this paper contributes to a nuanced understanding of the spillover effects of U.S. foreign military strategy amid great‐power competition, offering critical insights into the strategic value of the Belt and Road Initiative and guidance for Chinese firms seeking to reposition their global investment footprint.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70107.abstract_zh: 美国海外军事部署作为维护霸权的战略工具，通过安全-经济联动机制结构性重塑国际资本流动。现有研究多聚焦东道国视角，但此类部署的第三方经济溢出效应仍待深入探究。本文考察美国军事部署如何影响中国跨国企业对外直接投资，发现美国军事存在显著抑制中国对东道国的直接投资。机制检验识别出两条传导路径：（1）制度侵蚀效应——美国安全庇护削弱东道国治理能力，抬升政治风险溢价，抑制中国投资；（2）战略锚定效应——军事部署加剧东道国对华关系紧张，叠加美国深度经济嵌入，通过政治与市场双重渠道挤出中国资本。异质性分析进一步印证该逻辑。微观层面，美国军事部署强化中国管理者对地缘政治风险的感知，重塑其注意力配置与后续投资决策。研究表明，美国军事收缩可能重构中国对外投资的战略考量。本文通过拓展传统FDI风险理论，为理解大国竞争背景下美国海外军事战略的溢出效应提供新视角，同时揭示"一带一路"倡议的战略价值，为中国企业优化全球投资布局提供决策参考。
10.1111/twec.70107.title: Military Presence and Risk Mitigation: The Impact of U.S. Overseas Deployments on Chinese Firms' Foreign Direct Investment
10.1111/twec.70107.title_zh: 军事存在与风险缓解：美国海外部署对中国企业对外直接投资的影响

10.1111/twec.70108.abstract: Exploring the Role of Energy Consumption and Labour Productivity in Understanding the Effects of Climate Change on International Trade
10.1111/twec.70108.abstract_zh: 探讨能源消费与劳动生产率在理解气候变化对国际贸易影响中的作用

10.1111/twec.70109.abstract: This paper develops a multi-sector growth model to analyse the general equilibrium effects of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) on growth, structural transformation and international trade. It introduces a crucial distinction between high-skill, high-income, highly digitalized, tradable services and low-skill, less digitalized, less-tradable services, allowing GenAI to differentially affect sectors through both supply-side productivity gains and demand-side shifts in consumer preferences. The model generates testable implications consistent with emerging empirical evidence and delivers several novel predictions. Unless GenAI adoption is broad-based and accompanied by the creation of new products that shift demand toward skill-intensive activities, its aggregate growth effects are likely to be modest. The paper highlights the risk of ‘premature de-professionalization’—a contraction in the capacity of economies, particularly developing ones, to generate well-paid jobs in high-skill services. This process is primarily driven by domestic general equilibrium forces, as productivity gains in high-skill sectors may outpace demand expansion and reduce labour absorption. International trade plays a critical amplifying role in shaping both the timing and severity of this process: falling global relative prices of high-skill tradable services, combined with delayed AI adoption, can erode comparative advantage and lock countries into low-skill, low-income specializations. In this respect, premature de-professionalization parallels the well-documented phenomenon of premature de-industrialization, but operates through high-skill services rather than manufacturing—potentially narrowing development pathways at earlier stages of income.
10.1111/twec.70109.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个多部门增长模型，用以分析生成式人工智能（GenAI）对经济增长、结构转型及国际贸易的总体均衡效应。模型引入了高技能、高收入、高度数字化且可贸易的服务业与低技能、数字化程度较低且可贸易性较弱的服务业之间的关键区分，从而使GenAI能够通过供给侧生产率提升和需求侧消费者偏好转变，对各部门产生差异化影响。该模型得出的可检验推论与新兴经验证据相符，并提出了若干新颖预测。除非GenAI的采用具有广泛基础，并伴随新产品创造以将需求转向技能密集型活动，否则其总体增长效应可能较为有限。本文强调了“过早去职业化”的风险——即经济体（尤其是发展中经济体）在高技能服务业中创造高薪岗位能力的收缩。这一过程主要由国内总体均衡力量驱动，因为高技能部门的生产率提升可能超过需求扩张，从而减少劳动力吸纳。国际贸易在塑造这一过程的时间与严重程度方面发挥着关键的放大作用：全球高技能可贸易服务相对价格下降，加之AI采用滞后，可能侵蚀比较优势，并将国家锁定在低技能、低收入的专业化分工中。就此而言，过早去职业化与广为人知的过早去工业化现象相似，但其作用渠道是高技能服务业而非制造业——这可能在更早的收入阶段就收窄了发展路径。

10.1111/twec.70110.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This article examines the impact of the European Union's post‐March 2014 and post‐February 2022 sanctions episodes against Russia on trade between Russia and the Visegrad countries (Czechia, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia) over 2013–2024. Changes are analysed at both the aggregate level and—based on an original identification of EU sanction coverage—across selected sanctioned product chapters and non‐sanctioned reference groups. The empirical framework combines descriptive statistics on the distribution of the selected product groups with two complementary econometric approaches: a gravity‐based Poisson pseudo‐maximum likelihood model (PPML) with fixed effects, estimated in a difference‐in‐differences design relative to control markets, and a PPML interrupted time‐series model used as a robustness check to identify structural breaks and post‐intervention trends. Empirically, the effects of EU sanctions on Visegrad exports to Russia were strongly negative already under the post‐March 2014 sanctions regime, particularly for highly sanctioned manufactured product groups such as machinery and electrical equipment, and intensified further following the substantial expansion of sanctions after February 2022. Import effects were initially weaker but intensified markedly from 2022 onward, most notably for energy sources. The findings point to episode‐specific trade responses, pronounced heterogeneity across product groups, and a clear asymmetry between export and import adjustments.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70110.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2013—2024年间，欧盟在2014年3月后及2022年2月后对俄罗斯实施的两轮制裁对俄罗斯与维谢格拉德国家（捷克、匈牙利、波兰和斯洛伐克）之间贸易的影响。分析涵盖总体层面，并基于对欧盟制裁覆盖范围的原创识别，在选定的受制裁产品章节和未受制裁参考组之间展开。实证框架结合了所选产品组分布的描述性统计与两种互补的计量经济学方法：一是基于引力模型的泊松伪最大似然估计（PPML）固定效应模型，采用双重差分设计相对于对照市场进行估计；二是作为稳健性检验的PPML中断时间序列模型，用于识别结构断点和干预后趋势。实证结果显示，早在2014年3月后的制裁体制下，欧盟制裁对维谢格拉德国家向俄罗斯的出口已产生强烈负面影响，尤其对机械和电气设备等受高度制裁的制成品组影响显著，并在2022年2月后制裁大幅扩展后进一步加剧。进口影响最初较弱，但从2022年起显著增强，最突出的是能源类产品。研究结果揭示了针对不同制裁事件的贸易反应差异、产品组间的显著异质性，以及出口与进口调整之间的明显不对称性。
10.1111/twec.70110.title:
Trade Effects of
                    EU
                    Sanctions Against Russia: Evidence From the Visegrad Group
10.1111/twec.70110.title_zh: 欧盟对俄制裁的贸易效应：来自维谢格拉德集团的证据

10.1111/twec.70111.abstract: Based on panel data of China's urban trade exports from 2006 to 2023, this study employs the National Innovative City Pilot (NICP) policy as a quasi-natural experiment and adopts a Time-varying Difference-in-differences approach to investigate the impact of innovation policies on urban export sophistication. The findings reveal that the NICP policy significantly enhances urban export sophistication, validating the positive efficacy of innovation policies in China's export sector. Mechanism analysis indicates that the policy promotes urban export sophistication by optimising urban infrastructure, stimulating technological innovation and advancing industrial structure upgrading. Furthermore, the empowering effect of this policy is more pronounced in late-developing cities, especially in the less-developed western regions, small and medium-sized cities and cities with relatively scarce resource endowments. This study also explores the synergistic effects between the Low-Carbon City Policy and the NICP policy, as well as between the Broadband China Policy and the NICP policy, finding that these policy synergies further enhance urban export sophistication. The research enriches the literature on urban export sophistication and provides valuable insights for China and other countries in refining policy design and implementation, as well as urban planning and development to boost export sophistication and foster foreign trade growth.
10.1111/twec.70111.abstract_zh: 本研究基于2006至2023年中国城市贸易出口的面板数据，以创新型城市试点政策作为准自然实验，采用时变双重差分法探讨了创新政策对城市出口复杂度的影响。研究发现，创新型城市试点政策显著提升了城市出口复杂度，验证了创新政策在中国出口领域的积极效能。机制分析表明，该政策通过优化城市基础设施、激发技术创新及推动产业结构升级，进而促进城市出口复杂度的提升。此外，该政策的赋能效应在欠发达城市中更为显著，尤其是在发展较落后的西部地区、中小城市及资源禀赋相对匮乏的城市中表现突出。本研究还探讨了低碳城市政策与创新型城市试点政策之间，以及宽带中国政策与创新型城市试点政策之间的协同效应，发现这些政策协同进一步增强了城市出口复杂度。本研究丰富了关于城市出口复杂度的文献，并为中国及其他国家在完善政策设计与实施、以及城市发展规划以提升出口复杂度和促进外贸增长方面提供了有价值的参考。

10.1111/twec.70112.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>During China's transformation from a quantity‐oriented to a quality‐oriented trading nation, industrial policy consistency (IPC) between central and local governments has been an important driving force for firm exports. We investigate this IPC by extracting information on the preferential industries mentioned in the Chinese 10th to 12th Five‐Year Plans (FYPs) and empirically analyze the relationship between IPC and firm exports on the basis of Chinese firm‐level data from 2001 to 2015. The results indicate that IPC expands the firms' export scales but reduces the quality of products exported. This phenomenon is driven primarily by increasing subsidy reliance, intensifying excessive market competition and weakening innovation incentives. The heterogeneity analysis indicates that IPC has a more profound effect on the export outcomes of state‐owned enterprises, large firms, pillar industries and regions facing high levels of official promotion pressure. We further find that comparative advantages can relatively mitigate the decline in quality caused by policy consistency. Our findings have important policy implications for coordinating regional industrial policies and improving export competitiveness.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70112.abstract_zh: 在中国从数量导向型贸易大国向质量导向型贸易大国转型过程中，中央与地方政府间的产业政策一致性（IPC）已成为推动企业出口的重要驱动力。本文通过提取中国第十至第十二个五年规划中提及的优先发展产业信息，基于2001-2015年中国企业层面数据，实证分析了产业政策一致性与企业出口之间的关系。研究结果表明，产业政策一致性扩大了企业出口规模，但降低了出口产品质量。这一现象主要源于补贴依赖度上升、过度市场竞争加剧以及创新激励弱化。异质性分析显示，产业政策一致性对国有企业、大型企业、支柱产业以及面临较高官员晋升压力地区的出口表现影响更为显著。进一步研究发现，比较优势能够相对缓解政策一致性导致的质量下降。本研究对协调区域产业政策、提升出口竞争力具有重要政策启示。
10.1111/twec.70112.title: Policy Catering or Market Choice: Industrial Policy Consistency and Firm Exports
10.1111/twec.70112.title_zh: 政策迎合还是市场选择：产业政策一致性与企业出口

10.1111/twec.70113.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The link between environment and trade has long been the subject of intense policy debate. This study reviews the existing literature and addresses key gaps. We develop a unified framework that incorporates environmental externalities (local versus global), abatement, political competition, and trade. The model shows how producer and consumer/environmentalist lobbying incentives over pollution stringency interact, and how these incentives vary with the nature and magnitude of environmental externalities, the structure of environmental agreements (unilateral versus multilateral), and trade regimes. It also highlights the roles of abatement and terms‐of‐trade effects in shaping the equilibrium outcomes. In a large open economy, cooperative policy internalises the costs of emission leakage induced by lobbying, making it more welfare‐improving than noncooperative policy. Producer and consumer lobbying generally exert countervailing pressures, with their relative influence determined by the weights the government assigns to each group.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70113.abstract_zh: 环境与贸易之间的联系长期以来一直是政策辩论的焦点。本研究回顾了现有文献，并填补了关键空白。我们构建了一个统一的分析框架，将环境外部性（本地与全球）、减排措施、政治竞争和贸易纳入其中。该模型揭示了生产者和消费者/环保主义者围绕污染严格程度的游说激励如何相互作用，以及这些激励如何随环境外部性的性质与规模、环境协议的结构（单边与多边）以及贸易体制而变化。模型还强调了减排效应和贸易条件效应在塑造均衡结果中的作用。在大型开放经济体中，合作性政策内化了游说引发的排放泄漏成本，因此比非合作性政策更能提升福利。生产者和消费者的游说通常产生相互抵消的压力，其相对影响力取决于政府赋予各群体的权重。
10.1111/twec.70113.title: Political Economy of Environmental Policy Under Trade
10.1111/twec.70113.title_zh: 贸易条件下环境政策的政治经济学

10.1111/twec.70114.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study examines how Eco‐industrial Parks (EIPs) in China shape firm green innovation and, furthermore, explores its implications for trade competitiveness. We find that EIPs significantly boost green patent applications, particularly substantive innovations. This effect is stronger in cleaner industries, environmentally stringent cities and firms with high media exposure. Mechanisms include eased financing constraints, and increased R&D investment. Extending the analysis to the trade domain, we further show that EIP‐induced green innovation enhances firms' performance in green exports. Thus, EIPs serve as a pivotal policy that fosters green innovation and cultivates competitive advantages in global green markets.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70114.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国生态工业园区（EIPs）如何影响企业绿色创新，并进一步探讨其对贸易竞争力的启示。我们发现，生态工业园区显著促进了绿色专利申请，尤其是实质性创新。这一效应在清洁行业、环境规制严格的城市以及媒体曝光度高的企业中更为显著。其作用机制包括缓解融资约束和增加研发投入。将分析拓展至贸易领域后，我们进一步表明，生态工业园区引致的绿色创新提升了企业在绿色出口方面的绩效。因此，生态工业园区作为一项关键政策，能够促进绿色创新，并在全球绿色市场中培育竞争优势。
10.1111/twec.70114.title: Eco‐Industrial Parks, Green Innovation and Green Export Performance: Evidence From China
10.1111/twec.70114.title_zh: 生态工业园区、绿色创新与绿色出口绩效：来自中国的证据

10.1111/twec.70116.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The study focuses on the analysis of neutral states' exports to the Russian Federation via SDID and their comparison with more diligent enforcers of European sanctions, emphasising thus the changes that took place after the Russian invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. The investigation seeks to identify if the invasion and its subsequent repercussions resulted in significant changes in the commodity structure of trade of the neutral states, indicating their engagement in sanction‐busting behaviour. The research is based on 13 synthetic difference‐in‐difference panel data models for each sampled state using data from the UN Comtrade database. The results highlight an increase in the value of sanctioned commodities exported to Russia in all nine instances, where a significant change occurred solely in Kazakhstan and Türkiye. The findings of the study are consistent with the existing literature, and they reveal several directions for future research.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70116.abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于中立国通过SDID向俄罗斯联邦的出口情况，并将其与更严格执行欧洲制裁的国家进行对比，重点分析了2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后发生的变化。研究旨在探究此次入侵及其后续影响是否导致中立国贸易商品结构发生显著变化，从而揭示其参与规避制裁的行为。研究基于联合国商品贸易统计数据库的数据，为每个样本国家构建了13个合成双重差分面板数据模型。结果显示，在所有9个案例中，向俄罗斯出口的受制裁商品价值均有所增加，其中仅哈萨克斯坦和土耳其出现了显著变化。研究结论与现有文献一致，并为未来研究指明了若干方向。
10.1111/twec.70116.title: Friend or Foe? Analysing Neutral States' Exports to the Russian Federation Using Synthetic Difference‐In‐Differences
10.1111/twec.70116.title_zh: 朋友还是敌人？利用合成双重差分法分析中立国对俄罗斯联邦的出口

10.1111/twec.70117.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In recent years, the acceleration of de‐globalization has reconfigured global supply chains. Using listed firm‐level global supplier‐customer relationship data from the FactSet Revere database spanning January 2017 to December 2019, this paper examines whether and how firm‐supplier relationships change after the U.S.–China trade tensions. Our findings indicate that the U.S.–China trade tensions are followed by a significant relative decline in U.S. listed firms' reliance on direct Chinese suppliers. This phenomenon is pronounced in the manufacturing and information industries, especially in high‐tech industries. Mechanism analysis suggests that, following the trade frictions, U.S. firms appear to reduce their reliance on direct Chinese suppliers by diversifying and shortening contracts, while also taking adjustment costs into account. The extended analysis explicitly shows that U.S. firms continue to rely on China indirectly—via upstream inputs embedded in domestic suppliers and through third‐country firms closely tied to Chinese production networks. Additionally, U.S. firms tend to increase supplier links with countries that have higher institutional quality, consistent with a search for greater supply chain ‘security’.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70117.abstract_zh: 近年来，去全球化进程加速，全球供应链格局随之重构。本文利用FactSet Revere数据库2017年1月至2019年12月期间美国上市公司层面的全球供应商-客户关系数据，考察中美贸易摩擦是否以及如何改变企业-供应商关系。研究发现，中美贸易摩擦后，美国上市公司对中国直接供应商的依赖程度出现显著相对下降。这一现象在制造业与信息行业尤为突出，特别是高科技领域。机制分析表明，贸易摩擦发生后，美国企业通过多元化供应商选择与缩短合同期限来降低对中国直接供应商的依赖，同时兼顾调整成本。拓展分析进一步揭示，美国企业仍通过嵌入国内供应商的上游投入品以及与华生产网络紧密关联的第三国企业，间接依赖中国。此外，美国企业倾向于增加与制度质量较高国家的供应商联系，这与寻求更高供应链"安全性"的行为一致。
10.1111/twec.70117.title: Trade Tensions and the Reconfiguration of Supply Chain Linkages: Evidence From U.S. Listed Firms
10.1111/twec.70117.title_zh: 贸易紧张与供应链关联重构：来自美国上市公司的证据

10.1111/twec.70118.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper examines the effects of economic sanctions on the taxation of natural resources in targeted countries, distinguishing between de jure and de facto measures of the average effective tax rate (AETR) on resource rents. The analysis relies on a sample of 20 African countries for the de jure AETR and a global panel of 75 developing and developed countries for the de facto AETR over the period 2000–2020. Using a Spatial Durbin Model that accounts for spatial spillovers in both taxation and sanctions, we document three main results. First, both resource taxation (de jure and de facto) and economic sanctions exhibit significant spatial dependence across neighbouring countries. Second, economic sanctions affect de jure rent capture, while their impact on de facto AETR is limited and operates mainly through indirect and spillover channels rather than through a direct strengthening of effective tax enforcement. Third, the effects vary by the type and origin of sanctions, with financial sanctions exerting stronger effects than trade sanctions, and UN and US sanctions proving more influential than EU sanctions. The results are robust to alternative measures of sanction intensity, proxied by the number of sanctions imposed, as well as to alternative estimation strategies addressing endogeneity, and dynamic treatment effects. These findings suggest that sanctioned countries adjust formal tax policy in response to sanctions, which contribute to limit the adverse effect of sanctions on their de facto taxation of the resource rent.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70118.abstract_zh: 本文考察了经济制裁对目标国自然资源税收的影响，区分了资源租金平均有效税率（AETR）的法律规定与实际执行指标。分析基于2000-2020年期间两个样本：20个非洲国家的法律规定AETR，以及75个发达国家与发展中国家组成的全球面板数据的实际执行AETR。采用考虑税收与制裁空间溢出效应的空间杜宾模型，我们得出三项主要结论。第一，资源税收（包括法律规定与实际执行）和经济制裁在邻国间均呈现显著的空间依赖性。第二，经济制裁影响法律规定的租金获取，但对实际执行AETR的影响有限，且主要通过间接和溢出渠道发挥作用，而非直接强化有效税收执法。第三，制裁效果因类型和来源而异：金融制裁的影响强于贸易制裁，联合国和美国制裁的影响力超过欧盟制裁。上述结果在采用制裁数量作为制裁强度替代指标、处理内生性的替代估计策略以及动态处理效应检验中均保持稳健。这些发现表明，受制裁国会根据制裁调整正式税收政策，这有助于限制制裁对其资源租金实际征税的不利影响。
10.1111/twec.70118.title: Economic Sanctions and Taxation of Natural Resource Rent: Evidence From Spatial Analysis
10.1111/twec.70118.title_zh: 经济制裁与自然资源租金征税：来自空间分析的证据

10.1111/twec.70120.abstract: Employing the quasi‐natural experiment of the emission reduction targets of the 11th Five‐Year Plan in 2006, this study investigates the impact of environmental regulation on FDI stocks and flows in China. We find that stringent environmental regulations lead to a “shift” of FDI to less regulated regions due to the “rising cost effect” and “innovation compensation effect”. The effect is prominent for firms with a high capital‐labor ratio, that are state‐owned, in non‐high‐tech or pollution‐intensive sectors. An examination of FDI flows indicates that the observed redirection of FDI is largely driven by foreign investors favouring regions with lenient environmental regulations. Further investigation focusing on parent‐subsidiary relationships reveals that environmental regulations lead to a decrease in the number of subsidiaries established locally by enterprises in regions with stringent regulations. Subsidiaries receive more FDI when the gap in environmental regulation intensity between the location of the parent enterprises and the location of the subsidiaries is larger.
10.1111/twec.70120.abstract_zh: 本研究以2006年“十一五”规划减排目标为准自然实验，探讨环境规制对中国外商直接投资存量与流量的影响。研究发现，严格的环境规制因“成本上升效应”与“创新补偿效应”导致外商直接投资向规制较宽松地区“转移”。这一效应在资本劳动比高、国有、非高技术或污染密集型行业的企业中尤为显著。对FDI流量的分析表明，观察到的FDI转向主要由外国投资者偏好环境规制宽松地区所驱动。进一步聚焦母子公司关系的研究揭示，环境规制导致规制严格地区企业在本土设立的子公司数量减少。当母公司所在地与子公司所在地的环境规制强度差距越大时，子公司获得的外商直接投资越多。
10.1111/twec.70120.title:
The Effects of Environmental Regulation on
                    <scp>FDI</scp>
                    : New Evidence From Inward
                    <scp>FDI</scp>
                    Flows in China
10.1111/twec.70120.title_zh: 环境规制对外商直接投资的影响：来自中国内向FDI流入的新证据

10.1111/twec.70121.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper examines the environmental consequences of capital goods imports, employing China's subsidy policy as a natural experiment. The policy, which provides reimbursement to firms for the cost of imported capital, has an unintended impact on the environmental outcomes of firms. We employ the difference‐in‐differences methodology to distinguish between firms highly expose to the policy as the treatment group and less exposed ones as the control group. The results indicate that the subsidy policy significantly reduces firms' total chemical oxygen demand emissions by 21.2% and their emission intensity by 21.8%, revealing notable unanticipated environmental benefits of the policy. The reduction in emissions is primarily attributable to improvements in the production process rather than post‐production abatement. State‐owned firms and firms with a higher proportion of skilled workers exhibit more pronounced reductions. Additionally, our findings suggest that the import of capital goods fosters green innovation, a crucial mechanism through which the subsidy policy exerts an influence on emission reductions. This study offers insights into the environmental consequences of trade policies and the combined effects of production and innovation strategies in response to non‐environmental incentives.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70121.abstract_zh: 本文考察了资本品进口的环境后果，以中国的补贴政策作为自然实验。该政策为企业进口资本成本提供报销，却意外影响了企业的环境表现。我们采用双重差分法，将受政策影响较大的企业作为处理组，影响较小的企业作为对照组。结果表明，补贴政策显著降低了企业化学需氧量总排放量21.2%，排放强度下降21.8%，揭示了该政策显著且未预期的环境效益。排放减少主要归因于生产过程的改进，而非生产后的末端治理。国有企业及高技能工人比例较高的企业表现出更显著的减排效果。此外，我们的发现表明，资本品进口促进了绿色创新，这是补贴政策影响减排的关键机制。本研究为贸易政策的环境后果以及企业在非环境激励下生产与创新策略的联合效应提供了洞见。
10.1111/twec.70121.title: Unintended Environmental Consequences of Capital Goods Imports: Evidence From China
10.1111/twec.70121.title_zh: 资本品进口的非预期环境后果：来自中国的证据

10.1111/twec.70122.abstract: Using Iranian household microdata and welfare metrics grounded in consumer theory, we show that the 2012 SWIFT sanctions inflicted unequal welfare losses. Poorer households lost 2.3–2.8 times more than wealthier ones (quartile comparison) in terms of pre‐sanctions real expenditure. Public‐sector households needed 35%–41% more compensation than private‐sector peers; manufacturing/services households needed 37%–42% more than agriculture/construction households. Financial sanctions hurt the poor most, reversing oil sanctions predictions.
10.1111/twec.70122.abstract_zh: 利用伊朗家庭微观数据及基于消费者理论的福利度量指标，我们揭示2012年SWIFT制裁造成了不平等的福利损失。以制裁前实际支出衡量，较贫困家庭（按四分位比较）的损失是较富裕家庭的2.3至2.8倍。公共部门家庭所需补偿比私营部门同行高出35%至41%；制造业/服务业家庭所需补偿比农业/建筑业家庭高出37%至42%。金融制裁对贫困群体冲击最大，这一结果与石油制裁的预测相反。
10.1111/twec.70122.title: Sanctions and Household Welfare: Evidence From Iran
10.1111/twec.70122.title_zh: 制裁与家庭福利：来自伊朗的证据

10.1111/twec.70123.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study analyses weekly port calls from 2019 to 2026 to evaluate the Russia–Ukraine war's impact on maritime trade. The data reveals clear structural shifts that Ukrainian traffic moved from high‐risk areas like Odesa to safer Danube River ports. On the other hand, Russia sustained its maritime activity by navigating sanctions and redirecting exports to Asian markets. The Black Sea Grain Initiative also improved navigation conditions for both countries. Overall, the war caused domestic port substitution within Ukraine and a broader logistical reorganization for Russia.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70123.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了2019年至2026年的周度港口停靠数据，以评估俄乌战争对海上贸易的影响。数据揭示了明显的结构性转变：乌克兰的航运从敖德萨等高危地区转移至更安全的多瑙河港口。另一方面，俄罗斯通过规避制裁并将出口转向亚洲市场，维持了其海上活动。黑海谷物倡议也改善了两国的航行条件。总体而言，战争导致了乌克兰国内港口的替代效应，并引发了俄罗斯更广泛的物流重组。
10.1111/twec.70123.title: The Impact of Russia–Ukraine War in Maritime Data
10.1111/twec.70123.title_zh: 俄乌战争对海事数据的影响

10.1111/twec.70124.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Information and communication technology (ICT) goods are central to digital transformation, technological upgrading and participation in global production networks. Yet relatively little is known about whether immigrant networks shape international trade in these knowledge‐intensive goods. Using bilateral panel data for 172 countries over the 2000–2021 period, we estimate gravity‐based specifications, Tobit models and linear fixed‐effects models for ICT goods trade. The results show a positive and statistically significant relationship between immigrant networks and ICT goods trade, especially exports. The export relationship remains positive after controlling for productive capacity, while the import relationship weakens. Interaction models further show that immigrant networks are more strongly related to ICT goods trade when immigrants' home countries have greater ICT export capacity. Marginal‐effect estimates indicate that the relationship operates through both the extensive and intensive margins of trade. The findings suggest that immigrant networks are especially relevant for ICT goods trade when cross‐border social and commercial ties connect destination markets to technologically capable home countries.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70124.abstract_zh: 信息与通信技术（ICT）产品是数字化转型、技术升级及参与全球生产网络的核心要素。然而，关于移民网络是否影响这类知识密集型产品的国际贸易，学界认知仍相对有限。本研究基于2000—2021年间172个国家的双边面板数据，采用引力模型设定、Tobit模型及线性固定效应模型对ICT产品贸易进行估计。结果显示，移民网络与ICT产品贸易（尤其是出口）之间存在显著正向统计关系。在控制生产能力后，出口关系仍保持正向，而进口关系则有所减弱。交互模型进一步表明，当移民母国具备更强的ICT出口能力时，移民网络与ICT产品贸易的关联性更为显著。边际效应估计显示，该关系通过贸易的扩展边际与集约边际共同发挥作用。研究结论表明，当跨境社会与商业联系将目的地市场与技术能力较强的母国相连接时，移民网络对ICT产品贸易具有特殊重要性。
10.1111/twec.70124.title:
Immigrant Networks, Productive Capacity and Trade in
                    ICT
                    Goods
10.1111/twec.70124.title_zh: 移民网络、生产能力与ICT产品贸易

10.1111/twec.70125.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>As globalization faces headwinds from rising geopolitical tensions, the interaction between international politics and trade has become increasingly complex. Moving beyond static gravity models, this paper examines the dynamic co‐evolution of international political relations and the global trade network. Using a Stochastic Actor‐Oriented Model (SAOM) on a dataset of 139 economies from 1996 to 2023, we model the global trade network as an endogenous and evolving system rather than a set of independent dyads. The results show that diplomatic proximity significantly increases the likelihood of trade‐tie formation, and that this effect strengthens markedly after 2016, approaching the explanatory importance of geographic distance. The estimates also reveal strong reciprocity and triadic closure in the trade network, indicating that trade ties emerge within clustered and path‐dependent structures. Overall, the findings suggest that the contemporary trade system is increasingly shaped by the interaction between geopolitical affinity and network embeddedness.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70125.abstract_zh: 随着地缘政治紧张局势加剧，全球化面临阻力，国际政治与贸易之间的互动日益复杂。本文超越静态引力模型，考察国际政治关系与全球贸易网络的动态共同演化。基于1996年至2023年139个经济体的数据集，采用随机行动者导向模型（SAOM），我们将全球贸易网络建模为一个内生且不断演化的系统，而非一组独立的双边关系。结果表明，外交亲近度显著提升了贸易联系形成的可能性，且这一效应在2016年后明显增强，其解释力接近地理距离。估计结果还揭示了贸易网络中强烈的互惠性和三角闭合性，表明贸易联系出现在具有聚类和路径依赖特征的结构中。总体而言，研究结果表明，当代贸易体系日益受到地缘政治亲和性与网络嵌入性之间互动的影响。
10.1111/twec.70125.title: The Dynamic Co‐Evolution of International Politics and the Global Trade Network: Evidence From a Stochastic Actor‐Oriented Model
10.1111/twec.70125.title_zh: 国际政治与全球贸易网络的动态共演化：来自随机行动者导向模型的证据

10.1111/twec.70126.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the impact of global value chain (GVC) participation on firms' innovation, productivity, and other indicators of technical change. Our dataset encompasses heterogeneous firms from 144 countries at different income levels over the period 2006–2025. Using difference‐in‐differences and matching strategies, we find that GVC participation leads to increased innovation and other technological improvements, with gains driven primarily at the extensive margin and by importing rather than exporting activities. Among innovation types, product innovation responds more strongly than process innovation. Importantly, the nature of innovation differs systematically across development levels: GVC participants in lower‐income countries benefit from access to foreign technology, while those operating in more advanced economies engage more in formal, R&D‐intensive innovation.</jats:p>
                  <jats:p>
                    <jats:bold>JEL Classification</jats:bold>
                    : C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70126.abstract_zh:
我们研究了全球价值链（GVC）参与对企业创新、生产率及其他技术变革指标的影响。数据集涵盖2006–2025年间来自144个不同收入水平国家的异质性企业。通过双重差分法和匹配策略，我们发现GVC参与促进了创新及其他技术进步，其收益主要源于集约边际，且进口活动的作用强于出口活动。在创新类型中，产品创新的响应程度强于流程创新。重要的是，创新性质在不同发展水平上呈现系统性差异：低收入国家的GVC参与者受益于外国技术获取，而发达经济体的企业则更多从事正式的、研发密集型创新。

JEL分类：C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
10.1111/twec.70126.title: Technical Change Through Global Value Chains: Evidence From Firms Worldwide
10.1111/twec.70126.title_zh: 全球价值链中的技术变革：来自全球企业的证据

10.1111/twec.70127.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Utilising microdata from Chinese A‐share listed firms matched to the China Customs Database over the period 2007–2016, this paper exploits a quasi‐natural experiment based on Google's exit from mainland China and constructs a difference‐in‐differences (DID) model to systematically examine the impact of information access barriers on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness. The results indicate that information access barriers have a significant negative effect on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness, primarily reflected in narrowing export product scope, reducing export technological sophistication and weakening their centrality in the export trade network. Mechanism analyses reveal that information access barriers suppress firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness through multiple channels, including increasing transaction costs, constraining technological innovation, weakening capital investment, reducing productivity and aggravating financial constraints. Moreover, heterogeneity tests reveal that the impact of information access barriers on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness varies significantly across regions, industries and firm types. Extending the scope beyond export performance, further analysis shows that restricted information access significantly impairs firms' short‐term profitability and long‐term market valuation. Taken together, this study underscores the critical role of information access barriers in firms' export competitiveness and upgrading, offering important insights for better leveraging information technology to improve export patterns.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70127.abstract_zh: 利用2007–2016年中国A股上市公司与海关数据库匹配的微观数据，本文以谷歌退出中国大陆为准自然实验，构建双重差分模型系统考察信息获取壁垒对企业多维出口竞争力的影响。结果表明，信息获取壁垒对企业多维出口竞争力具有显著负向效应，主要表现为缩小出口产品范围、降低出口技术复杂度、削弱其在出口贸易网络中的中心度。机制分析显示，信息获取壁垒通过增加交易成本、抑制技术创新、削弱资本投入、降低生产率及加剧融资约束等多重渠道抑制企业多维出口竞争力。异质性检验表明，信息获取壁垒对不同地区、行业及类型企业的多维出口竞争力影响存在显著差异。将研究范畴拓展至出口绩效之外，进一步分析发现，信息获取受限显著损害企业短期盈利能力和长期市场估值。综上，本研究揭示了信息获取壁垒在企业出口竞争力与升级中的关键作用，为更好利用信息技术优化出口格局提供了重要启示。
10.1111/twec.70127.title: Access Denied, Performance Declined: Information Access Barriers and the Multi‐Dimensional Export Competitiveness in China
10.1111/twec.70127.title_zh: 访问受限，绩效下滑：信息获取壁垒与中国多维出口竞争力

10.1111/twec.70128.abstract: It would be nice to have a credible book on ‘How to avoid a trade war’, but, Soumaya Keynes and Chad P Bown argue in their Introduction, in April 2026, that is an impossible dream: ‘President Trump [is] setting fire to the global economic order’ and the many choke-holds on international trade provide apparently attractive tools both for him and his opponents. ‘We reassured ourselves’, they write, ‘that ours was a reluctant guide to trade wars as well as a necessary one, given that the fighting was here to stay. We also believed that although winning could mean racing ahead of a geopolitical rival technologically, economically, and militarily, it could also mean minimizing one's own wounds. Our goals are constructive ones: to arm you with evidence of what does and doesn't work on the battlefield, and to help you see what conflict lies ahead.’
10.1111/twec.70128.abstract_zh: 如果能有一本可信的著作，讲述“如何避免贸易战”，那将是件好事。然而，苏玛雅·凯恩斯和查德·P·鲍恩在2026年4月的引言中指出，这是一个不可能实现的梦想：“特朗普总统正在点燃全球经济秩序的火焰”，而国际贸易中的诸多制约因素，为他及其对手提供了看似诱人的工具。他们写道：“我们自我安慰说，鉴于战斗将持续下去，我们这本指南既是不得已而为之，也是必要的。我们还相信，尽管胜利可能意味着在技术、经济和军事上超越地缘政治对手，但也可能意味着最大限度地减少自身的创伤。我们的目标是建设性的：用战场上有效与无效的证据武装你，并帮助你预见前方的冲突。
10.1111/twec.70128.title: How to Win a Trade War: An Optimistic Guide to an Anxious Global Economy. By SoumayaKeynes and Chad P.Bown, New York, NY: Simon & Schuster, 2026. 288 pp. $30.00 (hardcover). ISBN: 978‐1‐66‐822131‐0
10.1111/twec.70128.title_zh: 如何赢得贸易战：焦虑全球经济中的乐观指南

10.1111/twec.70130.abstract: ABSTRACT This study aims to explore the relationship between trade sophistication and economic development stages, including in the context of digitalization. We employ nonparametric, semiparametric, and parametric methods, covering the period from 2003 to 2024 across 119 countries, categorized into three income groups. Our findings show that GDP per capita has a positive but diminishing relationship with export and import sophistication, suggesting that trade sophistication grows rapidly at lower levels of economic development but slows down as economies become more economically advanced. The evolution patterns of export and import sophistication are relatively similar throughout the stages of economic development; however, the level of export sophistication consistently exceeds that of import sophistication across all income groups. In the context of digital transformation, digitalization is found to positively affect trade sophistication in high and middle‐income countries, while GDP per capita remains positively associated with trade sophistication, but with diminishing marginal effects. For low‐income countries, GDP per capita is the primary driver of increased trade sophistication, while in high‐income countries, digitalization stands out as the dominant factor. These findings remain robust after controlling for human capital, FDI, and institutional quality, highlighting the importance of formulating stage‐specific economic policies to enhance trade sophistication in the rapidly evolving digital era.
10.1111/twec.70130.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究旨在探讨贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段之间的关系，并纳入数字化背景进行分析。我们采用非参数、半参数及参数方法，覆盖2003年至2024年间119个国家，并将其划分为三个收入组别。研究结果表明，人均GDP与出口及进口复杂度呈正向但边际递减的关系，即贸易复杂度在经济发展水平较低阶段增长较快，但随着经济体日趋成熟而增速放缓。出口与进口复杂度的演变模式在经济发展各阶段相对相似；然而，在所有收入组别中，出口复杂度水平始终高于进口复杂度。在数字化转型背景下，数字化对高收入及中等收入国家的贸易复杂度具有正向影响，而人均GDP仍与贸易复杂度保持正向关联，但边际效应递减。对于低收入国家，人均GDP是提升贸易复杂度的主要驱动力；而在高收入国家，数字化则成为主导因素。在控制人力资本、外商直接投资及制度质量后，上述结论依然稳健，凸显了在快速演变的数字时代制定分阶段经济政策以提升贸易复杂度的重要性。
10.1111/twec.70130.title: Trade Sophistication and Economic Development Stages in the Context of Global Digitalization
10.1111/twec.70130.title_zh: 全球数字化背景下的贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段

10.1111/twec.70131.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    In the current confrontational geopolitical climate, countries have intensified the use of selective trade restrictions to exert economic coercion. This paper introduces
                    <jats:italic>targeted</jats:italic>
                    trade restrictions between a US‐centric bloc and a China‐centric bloc into a general equilibrium trade model that features nonlinear adjustments and input–output connections. We study how micro‐level restrictions—based on data identifying high‐weaponization‐potential products—affect welfare and the macroeconomic structure of global value chains (GVCs). Our findings reveal that while global economic integration is marginally affected, its topology changes: chains become more regional and rely more on non‐aligned countries acting as connectors between opposing blocs, in ways that may be hard to detect in standard trade data.
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70131.abstract_zh: 在当前对抗性地缘政治气候下，各国强化了选择性贸易限制手段以实施经济胁迫。本文将美国主导集团与中国主导集团之间的针对性贸易限制引入具有非线性调整特征和投入产出关联的一般均衡贸易模型。基于识别高武器化潜力产品的微观数据，我们研究了微观层面的限制措施如何影响福利与全球价值链的宏观经济结构。研究结果表明，尽管全球经济一体化受到轻微影响，但其拓扑结构发生了改变：价值链呈现区域化趋势，并更依赖不结盟国家作为对立集团之间的连接枢纽——这种变化在标准贸易数据中可能难以察觉。
10.1111/twec.70131.title:
Fragmentation and the Future of
                    <scp>GVCs</scp>
10.1111/twec.70131.title_zh: 碎片化与全球价值链的未来

10.1111/twec.70132.abstract: ABSTRACT Oil is the lifeblood of industry, serving as the core source of power for the operation of industrial machinery. Ensuring its stable supply is crucial for the smooth production process, which in turn is a key determinant in enhancing the quality of export products for enterprises. This study empirically examines the impact of energy supply on the quality of export products and the mechanism of its effect by using a staggered difference‐in‐differences (DID) method with the implementation of China's West‐to‐East Oil Transportation Project as a quasi‐natural experiment. The empirical results show that a dependable energy supply substantially boosts the quality of goods produced for export by various companies. The mechanism analysis shows that energy supply improves export product quality through enterprise performance improvement effects, industry agglomeration effects and supply chain stabilization effects, and it mainly improves export product quality in energy‐importing regions, technology‐intensive industries, private enterprises, and general trade enterprises. Further analysis reveals that a stable supply of energy helps enhance the sustainability of enterprise exports while helping enterprises realize value chain upgrading, helping China get rid of the curse of locking the bottom of the export value chain. The findings of this study help clarify the intrinsic mechanism between energy supply and export product quality and provide an empirical basis for the cross‐regional energy dispatch strategy to help China's export value chain upgrade.
10.1111/twec.70132.abstract_zh: 摘要 石油是工业的血液，是工业机械运转的核心动力来源。确保其稳定供应对于生产过程的顺利进行至关重要，而这又是提升企业出口产品质量的关键决定因素。本研究以中国“西油东送”工程实施为准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法实证检验了能源供应对出口产品质量的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，可靠的能源供应显著提升了各类企业的出口产品质量。机制分析显示，能源供应通过企业绩效提升效应、产业集聚效应和供应链稳定效应改善了出口产品质量，并且主要提升了能源输入地区、技术密集型行业、民营企业和一般贸易企业的出口产品质量。进一步分析发现，稳定的能源供应有助于增强企业出口的可持续性，同时帮助企业实现价值链升级，助力中国摆脱出口价值链低端锁定的困境。本研究结论有助于厘清能源供应与出口产品质量之间的内在机理，并为跨区域能源调度策略助力中国出口价值链升级提供经验依据。
10.1111/twec.70132.title: Engine Run, Quality Enhance: Examining the Effects of Energy Steady Supply on Chinese Export Product Quality
10.1111/twec.70132.title_zh: 引擎运转，质量提升：能源稳定供应对中国出口产品质量的影响研究

10.1111/twec.70133.abstract: The Visa‐Free Transit Policy is a major opening‐up initiative launched by China to eliminate barriers to cross‐border personnel mobility and build an interconnected cross‐border network. Using a sample of China's A‐share listed firms from 2006 to 2019, this paper adopts the Difference‐in‐Differences (DID) model to empirically examine whether the policy can effectively improve the innovation quality of firms in visa‐free transit cities. The results show that the policy significantly improves local firms' innovation quality. It can function via two mediating mechanisms: promoting corporate supply chain diversification and facilitating inter‐firm collaborative innovation. Heterogeneity analysis shows that its innovation‐boosting effect is stronger for three groups of firms: firms in regions with strong intellectual property protection, those in transportation hubs and small and medium‐sized enterprises (SMEs). In addition, the 144‐h visa‐free transit policy also exerts a significant positive effect on corporate innovation quality. However, the limited observation period and confounding effects of prior policies impede the accurate estimation of the policy's net effect.
10.1111/twec.70133.abstract_zh: 免签过境政策是中国为消除跨境人员流动障碍、构建互联互通跨境网络而推出的重大开放举措。本文以2006年至2019年中国A股上市公司为样本，采用双重差分（DID）模型实证检验该政策能否有效提升免签过境城市企业的创新质量。研究结果表明，该政策显著提升了当地企业的创新质量。其作用机制主要有两条中介路径：促进企业供应链多元化以及推动企业间协同创新。异质性分析显示，该政策对三类企业的创新促进效应更为显著：知识产权保护力度较强地区的企业、交通枢纽城市的企业以及中小企业（SMEs）。此外，144小时免签过境政策对企业创新质量同样具有显著的正向影响。然而，有限的观测期及先前政策的混杂效应制约了对该政策净效应的精确估计。
10.1111/twec.70133.title: The Impact of Cross‐Border Personnel Mobility Facilitation on Corporate Innovation Quality: A Study Based on the Visa‐Free Transit Policy
10.1111/twec.70133.title_zh: 跨境人员流动便利化对企业创新质量的影响——基于过境免签政策的研究

10.1111/twec.70134.abstract: This paper examines how tariffs and non‐tariff measures (NTMs) imposed by Brazil's major agricultural trading partners affect the country's exports at the country–product level over the period 2000–2017. Using a newly assembled dataset of NTMs from the TRAINS database and a novel methodology for constructing unilateral trade flows in a single‐exporter setting, we estimate a reduced‐form Poisson pseudo‐maximum likelihood (PPML) model. The results show that tariffs exert large and consistently negative effects on export performance, while NTMs have heterogeneous impacts that depend on their economic characteristics and on the treatment of Brazilian products relative to competing exporters. We also introduce a measure of the cumulative trade frictions arising from the joint application of tariffs and NTMs, showing that multilateral NTMs substantially amplify the trade‐reducing effects of tariffs, particularly for price and quantity measures. Finally, an event‐study analysis based on the Local Projections Difference‐in‐Differences (LP‐DiD) estimator indicates that the introduction of a new NTM temporarily reduces the export share of the affected product, with recovery beginning in the third year after implementation.
10.1111/twec.70134.abstract_zh: 本文考察了巴西主要农业贸易伙伴实施的关税与非关税措施（NTMs）如何影响该国在2000年至2017年间国家-产品层面的出口。利用从TRAINS数据库新汇编的非关税措施数据集，以及一种在单一出口国情境下构建单边贸易流的新方法，我们估计了一个简化形式的泊松伪最大似然（PPML）模型。结果表明，关税对出口绩效产生了显著且持续的负面影响，而非关税措施的影响则具有异质性，取决于其经济特征以及巴西产品相对于竞争出口国的待遇。我们还引入了一种衡量关税与非关税措施联合应用所产生的累积贸易摩擦的指标，显示多边非关税措施显著放大了关税的贸易缩减效应，尤其是对价格和数量措施而言。最后，基于局部投影双重差分（LP-DiD）估计量的事件研究分析表明，新非关税措施的引入会暂时降低受影响产品的出口份额，并在实施后第三年开始恢复。
10.1111/twec.70134.title: Modelling the Effects of Tariffs and Non‐Tariff Measures on Agricultural Products: Evidence From a Developing Country
10.1111/twec.70134.title_zh: 关税与非关税措施对农产品影响的建模：来自发展中国家的证据

10.1111/twec.70135.abstract: We empirically investigate the utilization rates of the two existing regional trade agreements (RTAs) in Japan's monthly imports from Vietnam from January 2017 to December 2021. In particular, we explore the changes in these rates before and after the commencement of the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans‐Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), focusing on the products for which CPTPP offered the lowest tariffs. We did not find significant changes in the utilization rates of either existing RTAs or the most‐favoured nation (MFN) regime before CPTPP's entry in January 2019. However, exporters familiar with the use of preferences (i.e., existing RTA users) appear to have switched to CPTPP first, followed by unfamiliar users (MFN users) who switched to it gradually. Consequently, the introduction of a new RTA was associated with a sustained expansion of trade, unlike the gradual tariff reduction in a single RTA observed in the previous study.
10.1111/twec.70135.abstract_zh: 本文实证研究了2017年1月至2021年12月期间，日本从越南月度进口中两项现有区域贸易协定（RTAs）的利用率。我们特别关注《全面与进步跨太平洋伙伴关系协定》（CPTPP）生效前后这些利用率的变化，重点分析CPTPP提供最低关税的产品。研究发现，在2019年1月CPTPP生效前，现有RTAs或最惠国待遇（MFN）机制的利用率并未出现显著变化。然而，熟悉优惠使用的出口商（即现有RTA用户）似乎率先转向CPTPP，随后不熟悉优惠使用的用户（MFN用户）逐步跟进。因此，新RTAs的引入与贸易的持续扩张相关联，这与先前研究中单一RTA逐步降税所观察到的模式有所不同。
10.1111/twec.70135.title: Switching Between Existing and New Trade Agreements: Evidence From Japan's Imports From Vietnam
10.1111/twec.70135.title_zh: 现有贸易协定与新贸易协定之间的切换：来自日本从越南进口的证据

10.1111/twec.70137.abstract: The US Entity List policy, by severing access to critical intermediate inputs and technology transfers for specific Chinese enterprises, potentially exacerbates supply ‐ demand imbalance. Using panel data of Chinese listed enterprises from 2010 to 2023, this paper treats the imposition of Entity List sanctions on enterprises as a quasi‐natural experiment, with the aim of assessing the causal impact of these sanctions on enterprise capacity utilisation (CU). The empirical results indicate that: (1) The Entity List has led to a significant decline in the CU of Chinese enterprises; (2) The Entity List suppresses CU primarily by deteriorating enterprise performance and tightening financing constraints; (3) University‐industry collaboration and government subsidies serve as effective mitigating factors, significantly alleviating the negative impact of the Entity List on CU; (4) Heterogeneity analysis demonstrates that the negative impact is more pronounced for enterprises characterised by higher asset depreciation rates, weaker market competitiveness, greater centralised supplier concentration and those not deploying within the Belt and Road countries. These findings demonstrate that the US Entity List has driven China's structural contradictions to spread into high‐tech industries, no longer confined solely to traditional sectors such as steel and cement. Simultaneously, the results highlight the critical role of knowledge spillovers from domestic universities and strategic government support in helping enterprises withstand shocks like supply disruptions.
10.1111/twec.70137.abstract_zh: 美国实体清单政策通过切断特定中国企业获取关键中间投入品和技术转让的渠道，可能加剧供需失衡。利用2010年至2023年中国上市企业面板数据，本文将企业遭受实体清单制裁视为准自然实验，旨在评估制裁对企业产能利用率的因果影响。实证结果表明：（1）实体清单导致中国企业产能利用率显著下降；（2）实体清单主要通过恶化企业绩效和收紧融资约束来抑制产能利用率；（3）产学研合作与政府补贴作为有效的缓解因素，显著减轻了实体清单对产能利用率的负面影响；（4）异质性分析显示，对于资产折旧率较高、市场竞争力较弱、供应商集中度较高以及未在“一带一路”国家布局的企业，负面影响更为显著。这些发现表明，美国实体清单已推动中国结构性矛盾向高科技产业蔓延，不再局限于钢铁、水泥等传统行业。同时，结果凸显了国内大学知识溢出和战略性政府支持在帮助企业抵御供应中断等冲击中的关键作用。
10.1111/twec.70137.title:
The Impact of
                    <scp>US</scp>
                    Export Controls on the Capacity Utilisation of Chinese Enterprises: An Empirical Study Based on the Entity List
10.1111/twec.70137.title_zh: 美国出口管制对中国企业产能利用率的影响：基于实体清单的实证研究

10.1111/twec.70139.abstract: This paper examines whether Aid for Trade promotes foreign direct investment using bilateral panel data over 2005–2019. Conventional estimators show mixed results across donors, with no significant effects for Japanese aid. To address potential selection bias, we employ a Bartik‐style instrumental variable exploiting donor sectoral specialization and recipient revealed needs. The 2SLS estimates reveal substantial heterogeneity. Only Japanese AfT demonstrates strong causal effects, while other donors show no significant relationships when instrumented. The contrast between conventional and IV estimates suggests Japan systematically targets recipients with lower FDI potential, creating negative selection bias that masks true effects in conventional estimators. These findings highlight the importance of addressing endogeneity in aid effectiveness research and suggest donor strategies shape both aid allocation and outcomes.
10.1111/twec.70139.abstract_zh: 本文利用2005年至2019年的双边面板数据，考察了“贸易援助”是否促进了外国直接投资。传统估计方法在不同捐助国间显示出混合结果，对日本援助未发现显著效应。为应对潜在的选择性偏差，我们采用了基于巴蒂克风格的工具变量，利用捐助国的部门专业化及受援国的显性需求。两阶段最小二乘估计揭示了显著的异质性。仅日本的贸易援助展现出强烈的因果效应，而其他捐助国在工具变量法下未显示出显著关系。传统估计与工具变量估计之间的对比表明，日本系统性地瞄准了外国直接投资潜力较低的受援国，造成了负向选择性偏差，在传统估计方法中掩盖了真实效应。这些发现强调了在援助有效性研究中处理内生性的重要性，并表明捐助国策略同时塑造了援助分配及其结果。
10.1111/twec.70139.title: Selection Bias in Aid Effectiveness: Evidence From Aid for Trade and Foreign Direct Investment
10.1111/twec.70139.title_zh: 援助有效性中的选择偏差：来自贸易援助与外国直接投资的证据

10.1111/twec.70140.abstract: This paper asks how US tariffs on Chinese imports reshape trade across the nation's customs districts, and whether a district's earlier reliance on China shapes how deeply its imports fall. We build a monthly panel of HS6‐level US imports from eleven source countries arriving through eight customs districts between January 2017 and December 2025, and estimate product‐specific import‐demand elasticities by Poisson Pseudo‐Maximum Likelihood with three‐way high‐dimensional fixed effects. The estimated elasticity, which we interpret as a conditional import‐demand response among observed foreign suppliers rather than a fully structural Armington parameter, is substantially larger than earlier nationally aggregated studies have reported. This gap matters because it suggests that aggregation across entry points and product categories has long hidden how severe the trade destruction really is. Districts heavily dependent on Chinese imports before the tariff wave experience much sharper declines than less‐exposed ports. The pattern is sharpest for differentiated goods in which Chinese suppliers had already dominated before the tariff hit, where no obvious alternative source stands ready to absorb displaced demand. A further decomposition separates the contemporaneous response from anticipatory pre‐positioning and shows that a nontrivial share of what has been called the static elasticity actually reflects firms acting on expectations of future tariffs. Trade diversion flows mainly towards ASEAN economies, and distance plays essentially no role.
10.1111/twec.70140.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了美国对华进口关税如何重塑全国各海关地区的贸易格局，以及某一地区早期对中国的依赖程度是否影响其进口下降的深度。我们构建了一个月度面板数据集，涵盖2017年1月至2025年12月期间，来自11个来源国、经由8个海关地区进入美国的HS6级进口数据，并采用带有三维高维固定效应的泊松伪极大似然法估计产品层面的进口需求弹性。我们所估计的弹性，被解释为观测到的外国供应商之间的条件性进口需求反应，而非完全结构化的阿明顿参数，其数值显著大于此前全国性汇总研究的结果。这一差异至关重要，因为它表明，跨入境点和产品类别的汇总长期以来掩盖了贸易破坏的严重程度。在关税浪潮前高度依赖中国进口的地区，其进口下降幅度远大于暴露程度较低的港口。这一模式在差异化产品中最为显著，尤其是那些中国供应商在关税冲击前已占据主导地位的产品，这些产品缺乏明显的替代来源来吸收被转移的需求。进一步的分解将同期反应与预期性提前备货区分开来，并表明所谓的静态弹性中，有相当一部分实际上反映了企业基于对未来关税的预期而采取的行动。贸易转移主要流向东盟经济体，而距离因素几乎不起作用。
10.1111/twec.70140.title:
Tariff Transmission Across
                    <scp>US</scp>
                    Customs Districts: Product‐Level Evidence From Successive Trade Shocks
10.1111/twec.70140.title_zh: 美国海关各区关税传导：来自连续贸易冲击的产品层面证据

10.1111/twec.70141.abstract: This paper investigates how Chinese film exports shape international perceptions of China and associated economic outcomes, drawing on high‐frequency media data from the Global Database of Events, Language and Tone. We match the overseas release dates of 906 Chinese films across more than 120 countries to 355,867 media reports spanning April 2013 to October 2025, treating release timing as a quasi‐natural experiment. A difference‐in‐differences design identifies the causal effect of film exposure on country image, proxied by the sentiment of local media coverage. Baseline estimates indicate that releases produce a statistically significant improvement in the average tone of China‐related reporting, a result that withstands an extensive battery of sensitivity checks. The effect is modest in magnitude, consistent with the limited overseas box‐office reach of most Chinese films, and concentrated in the short run, operating chiefly by altering the surrounding media information environment rather than through mass theatrical viewership. Heterogeneity analyses reveal stronger responses in culturally proximate settings, middle‐ and high‐income economies, Belt and Road Initiative partners, and contexts where prior sentiment toward China is comparatively favourable, with international co‐productions and higher‐rated films yielding larger gains. Mechanism evidence shows that exposure heightens public attention and information‐seeking, thereby fostering more positive evaluations. These improvements carry economically meaningful consequences, including increased imports from China and enhanced appeal as a destination for international students. Because gains accrue primarily among already favourable audiences, the findings suggest a reinforcement rather than persuasion mechanism, illustrating both the potential and the constraints of film as a soft‐power instrument.
10.1111/twec.70141.abstract_zh: 本文利用全球事件、语言与语调数据库中的高频媒体数据，考察中国电影出口如何塑造国际社会对中国的认知及其相关经济后果。我们将906部中国电影在120多个国家的海外上映日期与2013年4月至2025年10月间的355,867篇媒体报道进行匹配，并将上映时点视为准自然实验。通过双重差分设计，我们识别出电影曝光对国家形象（以当地媒体报道情感倾向为代理变量）的因果效应。基准估计表明，电影上映显著改善了涉华报道的平均语调，且该结果在大量敏感性检验中保持稳健。效应幅度较为温和，与多数中国电影有限的海外票房影响力相符，且集中于短期，主要通过改变周边媒体信息环境而非大规模影院观影发挥作用。异质性分析显示，在文化相近情境、中高收入经济体、“一带一路”倡议伙伴国以及先前对华情感相对友好的环境中，响应更为显著；国际合拍片和评分较高的电影带来更大增益。机制证据表明，电影曝光提升了公众关注度和信息搜寻行为，从而促进更积极的评价。这些改善具有经济层面的实质意义，包括增加从中国的进口以及提升作为国际学生目的地的吸引力。由于增益主要集中于本就持友好态度的受众群体，研究结果提示一种强化而非说服机制，既展示了电影作为软实力工具的潜力，也揭示了其局限性。
10.1111/twec.70141.title: Do Cultural Exports Shape Country Image? Evidence From Chinese Film Releases and Global Media Data
10.1111/twec.70141.title_zh: 文化出口是否塑造国家形象？来自中国电影发行与全球媒体数据的证据

10.1111/twec.70142.abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) on trade, productivity, and welfare using a multi‐country, multi‐sector Ricardian model with input–output linkages. Gravity estimates reveal asymmetric trade effects: BRI participation increases imports from China in textiles, wood and paper, and electrical machinery, while raising exports to China in metals. These effects are not driven by tariff reductions and are stronger among countries with regional trade agreements (RTAs) with China in several sectors. I then recover model‐implied country‐sector productivity and estimate its response to BRI participation using difference‐in‐differences methods. I find no broad productivity gains from BRI participation. Instead, sectors whose input needs are more closely matched with China's upstream exports experience stronger productivity growth relative to other sectors within the same country, becoming significant in the third year after participation. Counterfactual simulations show that removing the estimated trade cost and productivity effects reduces welfare in BRI countries and China, while generating smaller losses for non‐BRI countries. When the United States raises tariffs on China, China's welfare loss is slightly larger in the absence of the BRI, suggesting that the BRI provides a modest buffer against adverse tariff shocks.
10.1111/twec.70142.abstract_zh: 本文利用一个包含投入产出关联的多国、多部门李嘉图模型，评估了“一带一路”倡议（BRI）对贸易、生产率和福利的影响。引力模型估计揭示了不对称的贸易效应：参与BRI增加了从中国进口的纺织品、木材与纸张以及电气机械，同时提高了向中国出口的金属产品。这些效应并非由关税削减驱动，且在多个部门中，与中国签订区域贸易协定（RTAs）的国家中效应更为显著。随后，我恢复了模型隐含的国家-部门生产率，并采用双重差分法估计其对BRI参与的响应。我发现BRI参与并未带来广泛的生产率提升。相反，其投入需求与中国上游出口更为匹配的部门，在同一国家内相对于其他部门经历了更强的生产率增长，并在参与后的第三年变得显著。反事实模拟显示，消除估计的贸易成本和生产率效应会降低BRI国家和中国的福利，而对非BRI国家造成的损失较小。当美国对中国提高关税时，若无BRI，中国的福利损失略大，这表明BRI为应对不利关税冲击提供了适度的缓冲。
10.1111/twec.70142.title: Barriers and Bridges: The Trade, Productivity, and Welfare Effects of the Belt and Road Initiative
10.1111/twec.70142.title_zh: 《障碍与桥梁：“一带一路”倡议的贸易、生产率与福利效应》

10.1111/twec.70143.abstract: China's rapid ascent as a global machinery exporter raises fundamental questions about competitive resilience of incumbent economies. This paper examines whether China's gains in revealed comparative advantage (RCA) are associated with declining competitive positions among 24 incumbent economies and whether such changes coincide with structural regime transitions. Using a balanced panel of 25 economies over 2009–2024, we decompose machinery into five sub‐sectors (MC1–MC5) and combine fixed‐effects panel regressions with a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) to identify gradual erosion and regime‐level transitions. A one‐unit increase in China's machinery RCA is associated with a decline of 0.531 units in competitor RCA ( p p
10.1111/twec.70143.abstract_zh: 中国作为全球机械出口国的迅速崛起，引发了关于现有经济体竞争力韧性的根本性问题。本文考察了中国在显性比较优势（RCA）上的提升是否与24个现有经济体竞争地位的下降相关，以及此类变化是否伴随结构性体制转型。利用2009—2024年间25个经济体的平衡面板数据，我们将机械行业分解为五个子部门（MC1–MC5），并结合固定效应面板回归与隐马尔可夫模型（HMM），以识别渐进式侵蚀及体制层面的转型。中国机械RCA每增加一个单位，与竞争对手RCA下降0.531个单位相关（p
10.1111/twec.70143.title: China's Export Surge and the Persistence of Machinery Competitiveness: Panel Evidence From 25 Countries
10.1111/twec.70143.title_zh: 中国出口激增与机械竞争力的持续性：来自25个国家的面板证据

10.1111/twec.70144.abstract: This study investigates the impact of government accounting supervision on the adoption of supply chain finance (SCF) among Chinese listed firms. Using a difference‐in‐differences (DID) approach and a comprehensive dataset spanning 1999 to 2022, we find robust evidence that government accounting supervision significantly promotes the adoption of SCF. This relationship remains resilient across a battery of robustness checks, including parallel trend analysis, propensity score matching (PSM‐DID), placebo tests, and alternative sample specifications. Mechanism analysis reveals that the positive impact of government accounting supervision is primarily driven by enhanced supply chain transparency and the suppression of abnormal related‐party transactions. Furthermore, cross‐sectional analyses reveal that this effect is more pronounced in firms with higher supplier concentration or those lacking political connections. Overall, our findings offer important insights into the role of institutional oversight in fostering financial innovation and enhancing supply chain sustainability.
10.1111/twec.70144.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了政府会计监督对中国上市公司采纳供应链金融（SCF）的影响。采用双重差分法（DID）及覆盖1999年至2022年的综合数据集，我们发现了强有力的证据表明，政府会计监督显著促进了供应链金融的采纳。这一关系在多项稳健性检验中依然稳固，包括平行趋势分析、倾向得分匹配（PSM-DID）、安慰剂检验及替代样本设定。机制分析揭示，政府会计监督的积极影响主要源于供应链透明度的提升及对异常关联方交易的抑制。此外，横截面分析显示，在供应商集中度较高或缺乏政治关联的企业中，这一效应更为显著。总体而言，我们的研究为制度监督在促进金融创新及增强供应链可持续性方面的作用提供了重要见解。
10.1111/twec.70144.title: The Watchful Eye: Government Accounting Supervision and Its Effects on Supply Chain Finance
10.1111/twec.70144.title_zh: 警惕之眼：政府会计监督及其对供应链金融的影响

10.1111/twec.70147.abstract: Using a state‐of‐the‐art structural gravity model, we investigate the impact of various (post‐)colonial cocoa trading arrangements on the cocoa trade between developing cocoa producer countries and rich industrial cocoa consumer nations in the time period 1951–1999. We find that in particular the trading arrangements of the European (Economic) Community (EEC/EC), such as the Association, Yaoundé and Lomé Agreements, as well as the UNCTAD International Cocoa Agreement, had a measurable positive impact on cocoa trade flows, in contrast to the British Commonwealth partnership or the GATT Generalised System of Preferences. In particular, the Yaoundé Agreement not only increased the trade between other EEC/EC members and the signatory cocoa producers, but also strengthened the trading relationship between the former coloniser countries and their cocoa producing former colonies, in fact more than offsetting the negative effect of independence.
10.1111/twec.70147.abstract_zh: 利用最先进的结构引力模型，我们研究了1951年至1999年间各种（后）殖民时期可可贸易安排对发展中国家可可生产国与富裕工业可可消费国之间可可贸易的影响。我们发现，尤其是欧洲（经济）共同体（EEC/EC）的贸易安排，如联系协定、雅温得协定和洛美协定，以及联合国贸发会议的国际可可协定，对可可贸易流产生了显著的正面影响，这与英联邦伙伴关系或关贸总协定普遍优惠制形成对比。特别是雅温得协定，不仅促进了其他EEC/EC成员国与签署国可可生产国之间的贸易，还加强了前殖民国家与其可可生产前殖民地之间的贸易关系，实际上其正面效应超过了独立带来的负面影响。
10.1111/twec.70147.title: International Cocoa Trading Arrangements Between Industrialised and Developing Countries 1951–1999: A Structural Gravity Analysis
10.1111/twec.70147.title_zh: 工业化国家与发展中国家之间的国际可可贸易安排（1951—1999年）：结构引力分析

10.1111/twec.70149.title: An Alternative Trade Agreement Design for Global Value Chain Integration
10.1111/twec.70149.title_zh: 全球价值链整合的替代性贸易协定设计

10.1111/twec.70150.abstract: The determinants and optimality of implemented export taxes have long been understudied. In this work, I analyze how a country's optimal export taxes on products are influenced by their usage as inputs in traded final products. I decompose the influence of input–output linkages in the Global Value Chain (GVC) on optimal export policy into three channels in a two‐country trade model with multiple industries and roundabout production. Using China's applied export taxes from 2003 to 2012, I empirically demonstrate that the terms‐of‐trade effect and the three GVC effects are partially accounted for in China's export tax rates. The GVC effects underwent changes following the Global Financial Crisis in 2008. The comparison between calibrated optimal export tax rates and applied export tax rates reveals political bias in China's export tax on differentiated products, particularly in incorporating GVC effects.
10.1111/twec.70150.abstract_zh: 已实施的出口税的决定因素及其最优性长期以来未得到充分研究。本文分析了一国对产品的最优出口税如何受到这些产品作为贸易最终产品投入品使用的影响。我在一个包含多行业及循环生产的两国贸易模型中，将全球价值链（GVC）中的投入产出关联对最优出口政策的影响分解为三个渠道。利用中国2003年至2012年实施的出口税数据，我实证表明，贸易条件效应及三种GVC效应在中国出口税率中得到了部分体现。GVC效应在2008年全球金融危机后发生了变化。校准的最优出口税率与实际实施的出口税率之间的比较揭示了中国对差异化产品出口税中的政治偏向，尤其是在纳入GVC效应方面。
10.1111/twec.70150.title: Optimal Export Taxes in Global Value Chain
10.1111/twec.70150.title_zh: 全球价值链中的最优出口税

10.1162/rest.a.1768.abstract: This paper uncovers that input tariff reductions result in less domestic innovation, but standard models of trade ensure a positive correlation between importing and innovation. Hence, the paper develops a dynamic framework with a task-specific laboraugmenting productivity and a non-homothetic import demand system to rationalize this finding. The model implies that input liberalization enables firms to use cheaper intermediate imports as a substitute for self-made inputs, a strategy that decreases marginal production costs but also discourages firms from investing in their own inhouse varieties. Finally, the paper compares the effectiveness of trade and innovation policies in boosting aggregate productivity growth.
10.1162/rest.a.1768.abstract_zh: 本文发现，投入品关税削减导致国内创新减少，而标准贸易模型却认为进口与创新之间存在正相关关系。为此，本文构建了一个包含任务特定劳动增强型生产率与非同质进口需求体系的动态框架，以解释这一发现。模型表明，投入品自由化使企业能够用更便宜的进口中间品替代自制投入品，这一策略虽降低了边际生产成本，但也抑制了企业对自主开发内部品种的投资。最后，本文比较了贸易政策与创新政策在促进全要素生产率增长方面的有效性。
10.1162/rest.a.1768.title: Globalization, Innovation, and Margins of Sourcing
10.1162/rest.a.1768.title_zh: 全球化、创新与采购边际

10.1162/rest.a.1769.abstract: Market power is costly to build and, once established, is typically persistent and difficult to change. This paper investigates the impact of large economic shocks (serious epidemics) on the redistribution of market power in manufacturing industries. Using a model of firms’ dynamic decisions on production, pricing, and inventory holding, we demonstrate the importance of inventory stock and demand uncertainty in understanding market power and propose a new measure of market power. We find that the 2003 SARS shock in China significantly reduced the market power of firms in SARS-impacted areas. This effect is long lasting. SARS also substantially increased the inventory of affected firms, which partially contributed to the redistribution of market power.
10.1162/rest.a.1769.abstract_zh: 市场势力的构建成本高昂，且一旦形成便具有显著的持久性和难以改变的特征。本文探究了重大经济冲击（严重流行病）对制造业市场势力再分配的影响。通过构建企业生产、定价与库存持有动态决策模型，我们论证了库存规模与需求不确定性在理解市场势力中的关键作用，并提出了一种新的市场势力测度方法。研究发现，2003年中国非典疫情冲击显著降低了疫区企业的市场势力，且该效应具有长期持续性。非典疫情还大幅增加了受影响企业的库存水平，这在一定程度上推动了市场势力的再分配。
10.1162/rest.a.1769.title: How Do Large Epidemics Redistribute Market Power? Evidence from the 2003 SARS Shock in China
10.1162/rest.a.1769.title_zh: 大型流行病如何重新分配市场力量？来自2003年中国SARS冲击的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1770.abstract: Since 1970, the share of Black individuals living in suburbs of large cities has risen from 16% to 36%. We first show that Black suburbanization has led to major changes in neighborhoods, accounting for the majority of recent increases in both the average Black individual’s neighborhood quality and income segregation within the Black population. We then use an accounting exercise to show that changes in relative suburban amenities and housing prices explain a large share of Black suburbanization, while regional reallocation, changing educational attainment, and gentrification of Black city neighborhoods play only minor roles.
10.1162/rest.a.1770.abstract_zh: 自1970年以来，居住在大城市郊区的黑人比例已从16%上升至36%。我们首先表明，黑人郊区化导致了社区的重大变化，这解释了近年来黑人个体平均社区质量提升以及黑人群体内部收入隔离加剧的大部分原因。随后，我们通过核算分析表明，郊区相对便利设施和房价的变化解释了黑人郊区化的很大一部分原因，而区域重新分配、教育程度变化以及黑人城市社区的绅士化仅起到次要作用。
10.1162/rest.a.1770.title: Black Suburbanization: Causes and Consequences of a Transformation of American Cities
10.1162/rest.a.1770.title_zh: 黑人郊区化：美国城市转型的原因与后果

10.1162/rest.a.1771.abstract: We study how regional housing market disruptions spill over across US local markets through multimarket firm networks. Using granular barcode-level data linked to producer information, we exploit variation in firms’ exposure to local house price declines. A firm’s local sales respond more strongly to indirect housing price declines in its other markets than to direct local declines. The barcode-level data reveal a novel uniform product replacement mechanism: Firms respond to adverse shocks by replacing higher-value products with lower-value alternatives uniformly across all markets. This propagates regional demand shocks through the supply side, with new implications for regional economics.
10.1162/rest.a.1771.abstract_zh: 本文研究区域住房市场冲击如何通过跨市场企业网络在美国地方市场间传导。利用与生产者信息相关联的细粒度条形码级数据，我们考察了企业对当地房价下跌的暴露程度差异。研究发现，企业在其其他市场面临的间接房价下跌对其本地销售的影响，比直接本地房价下跌更为显著。条形码级数据揭示了一种新颖的统一产品替代机制：企业通过在所有市场中统一用低价值产品替代高价值产品来应对不利冲击。这一机制通过供给侧将区域需求冲击进行传导，为区域经济学提供了新的启示。
10.1162/rest.a.1771.title: Spillovers through Multimarket Firms: The Uniform Product Replacement Channel
10.1162/rest.a.1771.title_zh: 多市场企业的溢出效应：统一产品替代渠道

10.1162/rest.a.1772.abstract: We document that in response to intensified competition from China in the U.S., poor countries reduce their export prices relative to rich countries, consistent with conventional wisdom. Interestingly, however, the opposite is true for export quantities. To reconcile these facts, we develop and estimate a general equilibrium model of trade featuring (i) cross-country heterogeneity in the ability to produce high-quality goods and (ii) a two-dimensional Bertrand competition on price and quality. Our model explains the empirical facts by showing that rich countries have a comparative advantage in quality upgrading, whereas a nested model without quality cannot do so.
10.1162/rest.a.1772.abstract_zh: 我们记录到，面对中国在美国市场竞争加剧的情况，贫困国家相对于富裕国家降低了出口价格，这与传统观点一致。然而有趣的是，出口数量却呈现相反趋势。为调和这些事实，我们构建并估计了一个包含以下特征的贸易一般均衡模型：（i）各国生产高质量产品能力的异质性，以及（ii）价格与质量二维伯特兰竞争。该模型通过揭示富裕国家在质量升级方面具有比较优势来解释实证现象，而嵌套的无质量模型则无法做到这一点。
10.1162/rest.a.1772.title: Cross-Country Heterogeneous Response to Competition: Theory and Evidence from Trade Data
10.1162/rest.a.1772.title_zh: 跨国竞争反应的异质性：理论与贸易数据的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1773.abstract: How do import tariffs affect employment? We develop an empirical strategy to identify the effects of tariffs using a difference-in-differences strategy, comparing antidumping (AD) investigations resulting in AD tariffs to those not resulting in AD tariffs. We find that an AD tariff decreases imports and increases employment in the protected sector. Moreover, employment in downstream firms decreases, while upstream firms are unaffected because the protected sector sources inputs abroad. Using a model to quantify the aggregate effects, we find that the Brazilian AD policy increased employment by 0.06% at a welfare loss of 2.4%.
10.1162/rest.a.1773.abstract_zh: 进口关税如何影响就业？我们采用双重差分策略来识别关税效应，通过比较导致反倾销税的反倾销调查与未导致反倾销税的反倾销调查。研究发现，反倾销税会减少进口并增加受保护部门的就业。此外，下游企业的就业减少，而上游企业未受影响，因为受保护部门从国外采购投入品。通过模型量化总体效应，我们发现巴西的反倾销政策使就业增加0.06%，但福利损失达2.4%。
10.1162/rest.a.1773.title: The Employment Consequences of Anti-Dumping Tariffs: Lessons from Brazil
10.1162/rest.a.1773.title_zh: 反倾销关税的就业后果：来自巴西的教训

10.1162/rest.a.1774.abstract: Against a backdrop of sharply rising inequality, the Tokyo Round of the GATT resulted in a 1.6 percentage point reduction in average US tariffs – larger than CUSFTA, NAFTA, and the liberalization accompanying the granting of PNTR to China. We construct a novel IV based on the so-called “Swiss formula” that governed the Tokyo Round tariff liberalization to provide evidence of its effects on imports and inequality. Instrumented tariff reductions explain approximately 20% of the rise in income inequality between non-production and production workers between 1979 and 1988. This effect is largest among women, workers in routine occupations, and workers in more technology-intensive industries, suggesting a complementarity between trade liberalization and skill-biased technological change.
10.1162/rest.a.1774.abstract_zh: 在收入不平等急剧加剧的背景下，关贸总协定东京回合使美国平均关税降低了1.6个百分点——这一降幅大于美加自由贸易协定、北美自由贸易协定以及给予中国永久正常贸易关系地位时的贸易自由化幅度。我们基于指导东京回合关税自由化的所谓"瑞士公式"构建了一个新的工具变量，以证明其对进口和不平等的影响。工具变量估计的关税削减解释了1979年至1988年间非生产工人与生产工人之间收入不平等上升的约20%。这一效应在女性、从事常规职业的工人以及技术密集型行业的工人中最为显著，表明贸易自由化与技能偏向型技术进步之间存在互补性。
10.1162/rest.a.1774.title: Trade and U.S. Inequality in the Tokyo Round
10.1162/rest.a.1774.title_zh: 东京回合中的贸易与美国不平等

10.1162/rest.a.1775.abstract: We provide the first estimates of intergenerational income mobility using tax data for a large developing country, namely Brazil. We measure formal income from tax and payroll data, and we train machine learning models on census and survey data to predict informal income. We quantify the estimation bias resulting from income imputation and other sources of measurement error, and show that such bias remains negligible in our context. A 10 percentile increase in parental income rank is associated on average with a 5.5 percentile increase in child income rank, with considerable variation across sociodemographic groups and geographical areas.
10.1162/rest.a.1775.abstract_zh: 我们利用巴西这一大型发展中国家的税收数据，首次估算了代际收入流动性。通过税收和工资数据衡量正规收入，并基于人口普查和调查数据训练机器学习模型以预测非正规收入。我们量化了因收入估算及其他测量误差导致的估计偏差，并证明此类偏差在我们的研究中可忽略不计。父母收入排名每提高10个百分位，子女收入排名平均上升5.5个百分位，且不同社会人口群体和地理区域之间存在显著差异。
10.1162/rest.a.1775.title: Intergenerational Mobility in the Land of Inequality
10.1162/rest.a.1775.title_zh: 不平等之地中的代际流动性

10.1162/rest.a.1776.abstract: Urban forests are ubiquitous, yet their impacts and values remain largely unknown. We study a massive urban afforestation policy in Beijing that planted 1/3 of a million acres of greenery in less than a decade. We conduct a remote-sensing audit of the program, finding that it contributes to a substantial greening up of the city. This causes significant downwind air quality improvement, reducing average PM2.5 concentration at city population hubs by 4.2%. Rapid vegetation growth unexpectedly led to a 7.4% increase in pollen exposure. Analysis of medical claims data shows that increased aeroallergens triggered emergency room visits, mirroring pollution effects though much less severe. Monetized net health benefits of the program amount to 1.5% of the city’s GDP. Urban forests are only partially capitalized in housing values, with buyers mainly appreciating proximity to green spaces but not the air quality improvements they bring.
10.1162/rest.a.1776.abstract_zh: 城市森林无处不在，但其影响和价值在很大程度上仍不为人知。我们研究了北京一项大规模的城市造林政策，该政策在不到十年内种植了33万英亩的绿地。通过对该项目的遥感审计，我们发现它显著提升了城市的绿化水平。这带来了显著的下风向空气质量改善，使城市人口聚集区的平均PM2.5浓度降低了4.2%。然而，植被的快速生长意外导致花粉暴露量增加了7.4%。对医疗索赔数据的分析显示，空气过敏原的增加引发了急诊就诊，其影响与污染类似，但严重程度远低于污染。该政策的货币化净健康效益相当于该市GDP的1.5%。城市森林仅部分资本化于住房价值中，购房者主要看重靠近绿地的便利性，而非其带来的空气质量改善。
10.1162/rest.a.1776.title: Urban Forests: Environmental Health Values and Risks
10.1162/rest.a.1776.title_zh: 城市森林：环境健康价值与风险

10.1162/rest.a.1777.abstract: Pharmacy benefit managers dominate the U.S. pharmaceutical market but are controversial and poorly understood. We analyze PBMs as market intermediaries that operate formulary contests in which on-patent brand-drug makers compete for favorable placement by offering rebates off list price. These formulary contests deliver efficiency gains compared to drug makers selling directly to consumers; PBMs capture some of these gains. Our approach answers key questions regarding the determinants of efficiency, rebates, list prices, and PBM market power in the pharmaceutical market. Our analysis also explains how common contracting practices, federal regulations, and incentives within formulary contests can undermine market efficiency.
10.1162/rest.a.1777.abstract_zh: 药品福利管理公司主导着美国药品市场，但颇具争议且认知度较低。我们将PBM视为市场中介机构，其运作处方集竞争机制——专利品牌药制造商通过提供标价折扣来争夺有利的处方集地位。相较于药企直接面向消费者销售的模式，这种处方集竞争机制能带来效率提升；PBM则从中获取部分收益。我们的分析框架解答了关于药品市场效率决定因素、折扣机制、标价形成及PBM市场势力的关键问题。研究同时揭示了处方集竞争中的常见合同实践、联邦监管规定及激励机制如何可能削弱市场效率。
10.1162/rest.a.1777.title: Common Agent or Double Agent? Pharmacy Benefit Managers in the Prescription Drug Market
10.1162/rest.a.1777.title_zh: 共同代理人还是双重代理人？处方药市场中的药品福利管理者

10.1162/rest.a.1778.abstract: Nonprofit organizations rely on donations from large competitive marketplaces to provide key social service goods. Most research focuses on competition in output markets without considering philanthropic markets where nonprofits make decisions about how much effort to put into fundraising. We develop and estimate a model that highlights the strategic nature of fundraising, showing that rival NP’s fundraising responses can be strategic complements or substitutes. We find evidence of strategic substitutes. NPs demonstrate nontrivial strategic responses to rival’s fundraising and, in totality, the across sector impacts are important to consider. Counterfactual exercises show that reducing competition decreases equilibrium fundraising levels.
10.1162/rest.a.1778.abstract_zh: 非营利组织依赖大型竞争性市场的捐赠来提供关键的社会服务产品。现有研究大多关注产出市场的竞争，而未考虑非营利组织在慈善市场中决定投入多少募捐努力的问题。我们构建并估计了一个模型，该模型凸显了募捐的战略性质，表明竞争对手非营利组织的募捐反应可能是战略互补或战略替代的。我们发现了战略替代的证据。非营利组织对竞争对手的募捐表现出不可忽视的战略反应，总体而言，跨部门的影响值得重视。反事实模拟表明，减少竞争会降低均衡募捐水平。
10.1162/rest.a.1778.title: Competition and Nonprofit’s Strategic Responses: Evidence from Fundraising in Donative Markets
10.1162/rest.a.1778.title_zh: 竞争与非营利组织的战略回应：来自捐赠市场筹款的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1779.abstract: We investigate the role financial conditions play in the composition of U.S. growth-at-risk. We document that, by a wide margin, growth-at-risk is investment-at-risk. That is, if financial conditions indicate U.S. real GDP growth will be in the lower tail of its conditional distribution, we know that quantitatively, the main contributor is a decline in investment. Consumption contributes under extreme financial stress. Government spending and net exports do not play a role. We show that leverage plays a key role in determining both consumption- and investment-at-risk, which provides support to the financial accelerator mechanism proposed by Bernanke et al. (1999).
10.1162/rest.a.1779.abstract_zh: 我们研究了金融状况在美国增长风险构成中的作用。实证表明，增长风险在很大程度上即为投资风险。也就是说，若金融状况预示美国实际GDP增长将处于条件分布的下尾端，从量化角度看，其主要贡献因素来自投资下降。消费仅在极端金融压力下有所贡献，而政府支出与净出口则未发挥显著作用。我们进一步发现，杠杆水平在决定消费风险与投资风险中均扮演关键角色，这为Bernanke等（1999）提出的金融加速器机制提供了实证支持。
10.1162/rest.a.1779.title: Growth-at-Risk Is Investment-at-Risk

10.1162/rest.a.1780.abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on how dietary habits – a key health behavior – are transmitted across generations, exploiting unique grocery transaction data linked with administrative records. We document strong intergenerational persistence in dietary habits, exceeding that of income, and consider several channels that might explain this pattern. Specifically, we find that socioeconomic status and geography account for only a small share of the transmission. Combined with the absence of a dietary response following a parent’s unexpected lifestyle-related death, these findings underscore the importance of early-life influences and habit formation.
10.1162/rest.a.1780.abstract_zh: 本文利用与行政记录相关联的独特杂货交易数据，提供了关于饮食习惯——这一关键健康行为——如何代际传递的新证据。我们记录了饮食习惯中显著的代际持续性，其程度超过收入，并考察了可能解释这一模式的若干渠道。具体而言，我们发现社会经济地位和地理因素仅能解释传递中的一小部分。结合父母因生活方式相关意外死亡后饮食行为未发生变化的发现，这些结果强调了早期生活影响和习惯形成的重要性。
10.1162/rest.a.1780.title: The Apple Does Not Fall Far From the Tree: Intergenerational Persistence of Dietary Habits
10.1162/rest.a.1780.title_zh: 苹果不会落在离树太远的地方：饮食习惯的代际持续性

10.1162/rest.a.1781.abstract: This paper investigates the long-term impacts of China’s nationwide public health campaigns targeting malaria, measles, and meningitis between the 1960s and 1980s. Exploiting regional variation in precampaign disease prevalence across birth cohorts, we show that these interventions generated sizable improvements in education, cognition, health, and income. As an illustrative case, individuals from high-malaria regions who were fully exposed to the eradication campaign attained about 0.5 additional years of schooling and earned over 10% higher income in adulthood, with cognitive and schooling gains explaining a substantial share of the income effects. Extending the same approach to measles and meningitis vaccination campaigns reveals comparably large benefits, with internal rates of return ranging from 21% to 34%. Together, these findings highlight the lasting socioeconomic returns to early-life health interventions and underscore the role of public health as a foundation for human capital accumulation and long-run economic growth.
10.1162/rest.a.1781.abstract_zh: 本文研究了20世纪60至80年代中国针对疟疾、麻疹和脑膜炎开展的全国性公共卫生运动的长期影响。利用不同出生队列在运动前疾病流行率的地区差异，我们证明这些干预措施显著改善了教育、认知、健康和收入水平。以疟疾为例，来自高疟疾地区且完全暴露于根除运动的个体，其受教育年限平均增加约0.5年，成年后收入提高超过10%，其中认知能力和教育水平的提升解释了收入效应的很大一部分。将相同方法应用于麻疹和脑膜炎疫苗接种运动后，同样发现了可观的收益，内部收益率介于21%至34%之间。这些发现共同凸显了早期健康干预的持久社会经济回报，并强调了公共卫生作为人力资本积累和长期经济增长基础的关键作用。
10.1162/rest.a.1781.title: Public Health, Human Capital, and Economic Growth: The Lasting Effects of Disease Control in China
10.1162/rest.a.1781.title_zh: 公共卫生、人力资本与经济增长：中国疾病控制的持久影响

10.1162/rest.a.1782.abstract: We examine firm responses to state hiring and investment subsidies. We leverage institutional features of the California Competes Tax Credit (CCTC), a large-scale business incentive program that incorporates best practices from prior job creation policies. The CCTC award selection procedure combines formula-based and discretionary components. Leveraging applicant score eligibility cutoffs in a regression discontinuity design and taking advantage of rich longitudinal microdata on establishments and their parent firms, we find that businesses expand employment in California in response to CCTC awards. There is little evidence that these expansions come at the expense of firms’ operations in other states. Our results suggest that targeted and audited hiring and investment subsidies can be effective in promoting local business expansions without inducing significant cross-state displacement effects.
10.1162/rest.a.1782.abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业对州级雇佣与投资补贴的响应。我们利用加州竞争税收抵免（CCTC）的制度特征——这一大规模商业激励计划整合了以往就业创造政策的最佳实践。CCTC奖项评选程序结合了公式化与自由裁量两种机制。通过运用断点回归设计，基于申请者评分资格临界值，并借助涵盖企业及其母公司的丰富纵向微观数据，我们发现企业因获得CCTC奖项而在加州扩大了就业规模。几乎没有证据表明这种扩张是以牺牲企业在其他州的运营为代价。我们的研究结果表明，经过精准定位与审计的雇佣及投资补贴，能够有效促进本地企业扩张，且不会引发显著的跨州替代效应。
10.1162/rest.a.1782.title: Firm Responses to Hiring and Investment Subsidies: Regression Discontinuity Evidence from the California Competes Tax Credit
10.1162/rest.a.1782.title_zh: 企业应对招聘与投资补贴的反应：来自加州竞争税收抵免的断点回归证据

10.1162/rest.a.1783.abstract: We study the role of war bonds and inflation in post-WWII federal elections. After WWII, major bouts of inflation in 1946-48 and 1950-51 depressed the real returns of the bonds sold to households during the war. In a difference-in-differences framework, we find that counties with higher war bond purchases shifted their votes towards the Republican Party in postwar elections. To address the endogeneity of war bond purchases, we use an instrumental variables design, and obtain similar results. Bond ownership raised the saliency of inflation, and the severe rise in prices after the war triggered a backlash against the incumbent Democrats.
10.1162/rest.a.1783.abstract_zh: 我们研究了二战后的战争债券与通货膨胀在联邦选举中的作用。二战后，1946-48年和1950-51年的两次重大通胀压低了战争期间向家庭出售债券的实际回报。在双重差分框架下，我们发现战争债券购买量更高的县在战后选举中投票转向共和党。为解决战争债券购买的内生性问题，我们采用工具变量设计，并得到类似结果。债券持有提高了通胀的显著性，战后物价的急剧上涨引发了选民对在任民主党人的强烈反对。
10.1162/rest.a.1783.title: Inflation, War Bonds, and Voter Backlash in the 1950s
10.1162/rest.a.1783.title_zh: 20世纪50年代的通胀、战争债券与选民反弹

10.1162/rest.a.1784.abstract: This study explores the relationship between legalized sports gambling, unexpected emotional cues stemming from NFL home team upset losses and reported intimate partner violence (IPV).
