10.1257/pol.20240393.abstract: This paper examines the impacts of health care provider exits on patient outcomes and displacement. Leveraging data on the universe of long-stay nursing home patients, I estimate the mortality effects of 1,104 nursing home closures using a difference-in-differences approach. Displaced residents face a substantial short-run increase in mortality, with this disruption effect strongest among older and frailer patients. However, surviving patients tend to transfer to higher-quality providers. I find suggestive evidence that for certain subgroups this reallocation may lead to improved long-term survival, net of the initial disruption effect. The findings highlight the immediate health risks of displacement and the potential for quality-driven reallocation to mitigate them. *
10.1257/pol.20240393.abstract_zh: 本文研究了医疗服务提供者退出对患者结局与转移的影响。利用长期护理机构住院患者的全样本数据，我采用双重差分法估算了1104家养老院关闭对死亡率的影响。被转移的居民在短期内面临显著的死亡率上升，这种中断效应在年长及体弱患者中最为强烈。然而，幸存患者倾向于转入更高质量的护理机构。我发现了提示性证据：对于某些亚群体而言，这种重新配置可能带来长期生存率的改善，抵消了初始中断效应的影响。研究结果凸显了患者转移的即时健康风险，以及以质量为导向的重新配置在缓解这些风险方面的潜力。
10.1257/pol.20240393.title: Disruption and Displacement in Health Care: Evidence from Nursing Home Closures
10.1257/pol.20240393.title_zh: 医疗保健中的中断与替代：来自养老院关闭的证据

10.1257/pol.20240403.abstract: This paper studies taxpayer responses to an increase in the top marginal tax rate in South Africa, drawing on rich administrative data and a transparent identification strategy. We show that treated taxpayers strongly reduced their reported taxable income in response to the reform, with adjustments along a broad range of taxable income components. While tax evasion and avoidance explain a sizable share of this response, there is also indication for reduced work effort and business performance of South African corporations led by treated taxpayers—suggesting that raising taxes on top incomes may entail broader economic repercussions.
10.1257/pol.20240403.abstract_zh: 本文利用丰富的行政数据和透明的识别策略，研究了南非最高边际税率上调后纳税人的反应。我们发现，受影响的纳税人显著减少了其申报的应税收入，调整涉及应税收入的多个组成部分。尽管逃税和避税行为在很大程度上解释了这一反应，但也有迹象表明，受影响的纳税人所领导的南非企业的工作努力程度和经营业绩有所下降——这表明对高收入群体增税可能带来更广泛的经济影响。
10.1257/pol.20240403.title: Taxing Top Incomes in the Emerging World—Fiscal and Economic Impact under the Microscope
10.1257/pol.20240403.title_zh: 新兴世界中的高收入征税——财政与经济影响的微观审视

10.1257/pol.20240429.abstract: In 1916, Margaret Sanger established the first birth control clinic in US history. From the mid-1920s, “Sanger clinics” spread over the entire US These clinics advised women on contraception, mainly by fitting diaphragms and explicitly instructing women how to use them effectively. Combining newly digitized data on the roll-out of these clinics, full-count Census data, and historical vital statistics, we find that the clinics accounted for 5.4–6.5 percent of the overall fertility decline across the US until 1940. By increasing the spacing between births and reducing fertility, the clinics generated important health effects and reduced stillbirths and infant mortality.
10.1257/pol.20240429.abstract_zh: 1916年，玛格丽特·桑格在美国历史上建立了第一家节育诊所。自20世纪20年代中期起，“桑格诊所”遍布全美。这些诊所为女性提供避孕指导，主要通过安装子宫托并明确指导女性如何有效使用。结合新近数字化的诊所推广数据、全量人口普查数据及历史生命统计资料，我们发现，截至1940年，这些诊所对美国整体生育率下降的贡献率为5.4%至6.5%。通过延长生育间隔并降低生育率，诊所产生了重要的健康效应，减少了死产和婴儿死亡率。
10.1257/pol.20240429.title: The Impact of Margaret Sanger’s Birth Control Clinics on Early 20th Century US Fertility and Mortality
10.1257/pol.20240429.title_zh: 玛格丽特·桑格避孕诊所在20世纪初美国生育率与死亡率中的影响

10.1257/pol.20240436.abstract: We provide novel evidence on the incidence of business taxes using comprehensive survey and experimental data from German firms. Managers respond asymmetrically to randomized hypothetical tax changes of opposite signs, consistent with asymmetric profit tax incidence. They indicate that tax cuts would be primarily passed on to workers and used for investment projects, while tax increases would be shifted to consumers via higher prices and absorbed by firm owners via lower profit distributions. We further show that the stated incidence on workers rises with the absolute size of the tax change, partially offsetting the burden borne by firm owners.
10.1257/pol.20240436.abstract_zh: 我们利用德国企业的综合调查与实验数据，提供了关于商业税归宿的新证据。管理者对随机设定的正负向税收变化表现出非对称反应，这与利润税的非对称归宿特征一致。他们指出，减税将主要转嫁给劳动者并用于投资项目，而增税则会通过提高价格转嫁给消费者，并通过降低利润分配由企业主承担。我们进一步发现，税收变化绝对规模越大，劳动者承担的税负比例越高，这在一定程度上抵消了企业主所承受的负担。
10.1257/pol.20240436.title: The Asymmetric Incidence of Business Taxes: Survey Evidence from German Firms
10.1257/pol.20240436.title_zh: 企业税负的非对称影响：来自德国企业的调查证据

10.1257/pol.20240478.abstract: Minority workers tend to be disproportionately harmed by negative economic shocks. Indeed, we show that Hispanic populations experienced worse employment losses due to import competition from China, relative to whites, largely due to lower education levels. In contrast, Black-white employment and wage gaps actually narrowed due to relative growth in non-manufacturing sectors. We show that Black workers were less attached to manufacturing by 2000, compared to whites, and were therefore more poised to take advantage of China shock induced reallocation to services. The lasting negative impacts of the China shock on exposed communities were primarily driven by white workers.
10.1257/pol.20240478.abstract_zh: 少数族裔工人往往在经济负面冲击中遭受不成比例的损害。事实上，我们表明，相较于白人，西班牙裔人口因中国进口竞争而面临更严重的就业损失，这主要归因于其较低的教育水平。相比之下，由于非制造业部门的相对增长，黑人与白人之间的就业和工资差距实际上有所缩小。我们指出，到2000年，黑人工人对制造业的依赖程度低于白人，因此他们更有能力利用中国冲击所引发的服务业重新配置。中国冲击对受影响社区造成的持久负面影响主要由白人工人驱动。
10.1257/pol.20240478.title: Racial and Ethnic Inequality and the China Shock
10.1257/pol.20240478.title_zh: 种族与民族不平等及中国冲击

10.1257/pol.20240520.abstract: Seasonal allergies affect over 400 million people globally, yet the broader economic consequences of pollen exposure remain understudied. Evidence from Japan’s ambulance records suggests that high-pollen days are associated with increases in accidents, including traffic accidents and work-related injuries, which may reflect impaired cognitive performance. Retail scanner data and cellphone mobility records indicate that individuals already engage in avoidance behaviors, such as purchasing allergy products and limiting outdoor activities on weekends. This suggests that relying on individual self-protection may be insufficient to offset these risks, and thus greater government intervention may be warranted to mitigate pollen-related harm.
10.1257/pol.20240520.abstract_zh: 季节性过敏影响全球超过4亿人口，然而花粉暴露带来的更广泛经济后果仍未得到充分研究。来自日本救护车记录的证据表明，高花粉日与事故增加相关，包括交通事故和工作相关伤害，这可能反映了认知能力受损。零售扫描数据和手机移动记录显示，个体已采取回避行为，如购买过敏产品并在周末限制户外活动。这表明依赖个体自我保护可能不足以抵消这些风险，因此可能需要加强政府干预以减轻花粉相关危害。
10.1257/pol.20240520.title: Seasonal Allergies and Accidents
10.1257/pol.20240520.title_zh: 季节性过敏与意外事故

10.1257/pol.20240532.abstract: I study the job impacts of the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG), a federal program which provides local governments with block grants to flexibly invest in low-income neighborhoods. I leverage a one-time shock to the formula allocation process which permanently re-shuffled grant generosity, simultaneously creating large funding shocks in both directions. While job counts increased in positively shocked localities relative to unaffected localities, job counts remained steady in negatively shocked localities. I document asymmetric effects on local public finance mechanisms to support these findings. I also leverage itemized CDBG expenditure data to uncover correlates of high-impact place-based investments.
10.1257/pol.20240532.abstract_zh: 我研究了社区发展整笔拨款（CDBG）的就业影响，这是一项联邦计划，向地方政府提供整笔拨款，以灵活投资于低收入社区。我利用公式分配过程中的一次性冲击，该冲击永久性地重新调整了拨款慷慨程度，同时造成了两个方向上的大规模资金冲击。尽管受到正向冲击的地方相对于未受影响的地方就业人数有所增加，但受到负向冲击的地方就业人数保持稳定。我记录了地方公共财政机制中的不对称效应，以支持这些发现。我还利用逐项列出的CDBG支出数据，揭示了高影响地点型投资的相关因素。
10.1257/pol.20240532.title: Building Blocks of Prosperity: The Job Impacts of Federal Block Grants for Developing Low-Income Communities
10.1257/pol.20240532.title_zh: 繁荣的基石：联邦整笔拨款对低收入社区发展的就业影响

10.1257/pol.20240544.abstract: Are Building Codes an Effective Adaptation to Wind Risk? Evidence from Remotely Detected Blue Tarps by David Wolf and Kenji Takeuchi. Published in volume 18, issue 3, pages 509-40 of American Economic Journal: Economic Policy, August 2026, Abstract: Hurricanes cause significant wind and water damage...
10.1257/pol.20240544.abstract_zh:
建筑规范能否有效应对风灾风险？基于遥感蓝色防水布数据的证据  
作者：David Wolf, Kenji Takeuchi  
发表于《美国经济杂志：经济政策》第18卷第3期，第509-540页，2026年8月  

摘要：飓风会造成严重的风灾和水灾……
10.1257/pol.20240544.title: Are Building Codes an Effective Adaptation to Wind Risk? Evidence from Remotely Detected Blue Tarps
10.1257/pol.20240544.title_zh: 建筑规范能否有效适应风灾风险？基于遥感检测蓝色防水布的证据

10.1257/pol.20240586.abstract: This paper documents a socioeconomic gradient in adult labor market penalties stemming from a single chronic and treatable childhood health shock in a country with universal access to healthcare. Using childhood onset Type 1 Diabetes, Danish administrative registry data, and causal forests, we estimate substantial variation in the employment and earnings penalties at age 30. These penalties vary systematically with parental income and maternal educational attainment. Our findings help explain the income-health gradient and have important implications for policy discussions related to the design of healthcare systems.
10.1257/pol.20240586.abstract_zh: 本文记录了在全民医保国家中，单一慢性且可治疗的儿童期健康冲击对成年劳动力市场惩罚的社会经济梯度。利用儿童期发病的1型糖尿病、丹麦行政登记数据及因果森林方法，我们估计出30岁时就业与收入惩罚存在显著差异。这些惩罚随父母收入及母亲教育程度呈现系统性变化。研究结果有助于解释收入-健康梯度现象，并对医疗体系设计相关的政策讨论具有重要启示。
10.1257/pol.20240586.title: Childhood Health Shocks and the Intergenerational Transmission of Inequality
10.1257/pol.20240586.title_zh: 儿童健康冲击与不平等的代际传递

10.1257/pol.20240611.abstract: This paper explores the labor market returns to working for a victorious political campaign. Using unique administrative data from Brazil, we track campaign workers’ employment and earnings before and after close mayoral elections over nearly 20 years. We find sizable returns to working for a winning campaign, especially in areas with large informal sectors and for workers connected to challengers. Returns are concentrated in the public sector, where connected hires are more educationally qualified, including at higher levels of the bureaucracy. Our findings suggest that personal connections, not simply party ties, facilitate the hiring of capable, though inexperienced, civil servants.
10.1257/pol.20240611.abstract_zh: 本文探究了为获胜政治竞选工作所带来的劳动力市场回报。利用巴西独特的行政数据，我们追踪了近20年市长选举前后竞选工作人员的就业与收入情况。研究发现，为获胜竞选工作能带来可观的回报，尤其是在非正规部门规模较大的地区，以及与挑战者存在关联的工人群体中。这些回报主要集中在公共部门，其中通过关系入职的人员在学历资质上更为优秀，甚至包括更高层级的官僚机构。我们的研究结果表明，个人关系（而非单纯的党派联系）促进了有能力但缺乏经验的公务员的聘用。
10.1257/pol.20240611.title: Campaign Connections

10.1257/pol.20240794.abstract: Climate policies often increase electricity prices by more than they increase prices of fossil fuels. Using administrative data on German manufacturing plants from 2009 to 2017, we provide evidence that these price changes induce plants to generate electricity onsite using fossil fuels. Not all manufacturing plants are subject to emissions pricing under the EU’s Emissions Trading System, and we find evidence of emissions leakage: Electricity generation shifts from regulated power plants to unregulated manufacturing plants.
10.1257/pol.20240794.abstract_zh: 气候政策往往导致电价涨幅超过化石燃料价格涨幅。基于2009年至2017年德国制造业工厂的行政数据，我们证实此类价格变化会促使工厂利用化石燃料进行现场发电。并非所有制造业工厂都受欧盟排放交易体系的排放定价约束，我们发现了排放泄漏的证据：发电活动从受监管的发电厂转移至未受监管的制造业工厂。
10.1257/pol.20240794.title: Climate Policies and Electricity Prices: Why Abate When You Can Generate?
10.1257/pol.20240794.title_zh: 气候政策与电价：为何不减排而选择发电？

10.1257/pol.20240808.abstract: What is the impact and value of hurricane forecasts? We study this question using the universe of landfalling US hurricanes between 2005–2022. We find that forecasts drive adaptive protective expenditures, and that erroneous underforecasts result in a significant increase in total hurricane damage. Using a theoreticallygrounded approach for estimating the marginal value of forecast improvements, we find that improvements since 2007, after the implementation of a national policy to improve hurricane forecasts, have reduced total costs by 19%, averaging $2 billion per hurricane. These benefits far exceed the annual budget of the policy and of all federal weather forecasting.
10.1257/pol.20240808.abstract_zh: 飓风预报的影响与价值何在？我们以2005年至2022年间登陆美国的所有飓风为研究对象，发现预报能够驱动适应性防护支出，而错误的低估预报会导致飓风总损失显著增加。通过基于理论的方法估算预报改进的边际价值，我们发现自2007年实施国家飓风预报改进政策以来，预报质量的提升使总成本降低了19%，平均每次飓风减少20亿美元损失。这些收益远超该政策年度预算及联邦所有气象预报的年度总投入。
10.1257/pol.20240808.title: The Social Value of Hurricane Forecasts

10.1257/pol.20240812.abstract: Governments increasingly use changes in tax rules to combat evasion. We develop a general approach to point-identify tax compliance along with supply and demand elasticities. Identification requires data on prices and quantities, variation in tax policy, and a demand or supply shifter. We illustrate our approach using data on Airbnb collection agreements, where taxes are enforced by shifting the statutory burden away from hosts and onto renters via the platform. We find that taxes are paid on roughly zero to 1.6 percent of Airbnb transactions prior to enforcement.
10.1257/pol.20240812.abstract_zh: 政府越来越多地通过调整税收规则来打击逃税行为。我们提出了一种通用方法，用于点识别税收合规性以及供需弹性。识别过程需要价格和数量数据、税收政策的变化以及需求或供给的变动因素。我们利用Airbnb代收协议的数据来展示这一方法，在该协议中，税收通过将法定负担从房东转移至租客（经由平台）得以强制执行。研究发现，在强制执行前，Airbnb交易中约有0%至1.6%的税款被缴纳。
10.1257/pol.20240812.title: Identifying Tax Compliance from Variation in Tax Policy: Theory and Empirics
10.1257/pol.20240812.title_zh: 从税收政策变化中识别税收遵从：理论与实证

10.1257/pol.20240813.abstract: This paper assesses the effects of corporate tax cuts on small firms and their workers. Following a reform in Quebec, Canada, firms receiving tax cuts expand and their workers' earnings increase com- pared to workers and firms without tax cuts. We estimate that overall workers bear 35 percent of the tax burden, with larger inci- dence falling on those with ownership in the companies they work through increased profits. Additionally, workers across each ter- cile of the within-firm earnings distribution beneffit from tax cuts, possibly because fair-wage concerns matter when after-tax profits rise due to close interactions among workers in small corporate environments.
10.1257/pol.20240813.abstract_zh: 本文评估了企业减税对小企业及其员工的影响。基于加拿大魁北克省的一项改革，享受减税政策的企业规模扩大，其员工收入相较于未受减税政策影响的企业及员工有所增长。我们估算，员工整体承担了35%的税负，其中更大比例的税负通过利润增长落到了持有所在企业股权的员工身上。此外，在企业内部收入分布的各三分位组中，员工均从减税中获益，这可能是因为在小企业环境中员工间的密切互动使得公平工资关切在税后利润上升时发挥了作用。
10.1257/pol.20240813.title: Impacts of Corporate Tax Cuts on Firms and Workers: Evidence from Small Businesses
10.1257/pol.20240813.title_zh: 企业减税对企业与工人的影响：来自小企业的证据

10.1257/pol.20240814.abstract: This paper measures how cost-sharing impacts older low-income patients, exploiting a disconti-nuity in eligibility for a prescription drug subsidy for those who lose access to the Medicaid-linked program. Higher drug prices resulting from subsidy loss lead to a 40% reduction in prescription expenditures, driven by a 16% quantity reduction of prescriptions filled. Patients economize on purchases of higher-priced drugs, irrespective of their health benefits. For example, patients re-duce insulin purchases by 35%. There is no evidence that cost-sharing prompts switching from branded drugs to generics. This behavior suggests that cost-sharing reduces prescription accessibility without enhancing cost-effectiveness.
10.1257/pol.20240814.abstract_zh: 本文利用与医疗补助计划挂钩的处方药补贴资格中断现象，测度成本分摊对老年低收入患者的影响。补贴资格丧失导致药价上涨，使处方药支出减少40%，其中处方药配药量下降16%是主要驱动因素。患者会减少高价药品的购买，而不考虑其健康效益。例如，患者将胰岛素购买量减少35%。没有证据表明成本分摊会促使患者从品牌药转向仿制药。这一行为表明，成本分摊在未提升成本效益的情况下，反而降低了处方药的可及性。
10.1257/pol.20240814.title: Prioritizing Benefit? How Low-Income Patients Respond to Prescription Cost-Sharing
10.1257/pol.20240814.title_zh: 优先考虑收益？低收入患者如何应对处方费用分摊

10.1257/pol.20240815.abstract: Each year, about a thousand public schools in the US close, displacing hundreds of thousands of students. I examine the impact of public school closures on displaced students using linked schooling and labor market data from Texas. Using within-school acrosstime/ cohort variation in exposure to school closures, I implement difference-in-differences strategies to identify causal effects. I find that school closures decrease test scores, increase absenteeism, and lead to more disciplinary actions. Furthermore, school closures decrease high school completion, college attainment, employment, and earnings at ages 25–27. These impacts are larger for secondary school students and those from economically disadvantaged backgrounds.
10.1257/pol.20240815.abstract_zh: 美国每年约有上千所公立学校关闭，导致数十万学生被迫转学。本文利用德克萨斯州关联的学校教育与劳动力市场数据，考察公立学校关闭对受影响学生的影响。通过利用同一学校内不同时期/年级群体受学校关闭影响程度的差异，我采用双重差分策略识别因果效应。研究发现：学校关闭导致学生考试成绩下降、缺勤率上升，并引发更多纪律处分。此外，学校关闭还降低了学生在25-27岁期间的高中毕业率、大学入学率、就业率及收入水平。这些影响对中学生及经济弱势背景学生更为显著。
10.1257/pol.20240815.title: The Long Shadow of School Closures: Impacts on Students’ Educational and Labor Market Outcomes
10.1257/pol.20240815.title_zh: 学校关闭的长期阴影：对学生教育与劳动力市场结果的影响

10.1257/pol.20240830.abstract: We investigate whether removing a previously-obtained criminal record improves employment outcomes. We estimate the causal impact of criminal record remediation laws that have been widely enacted with the goal of improving employment opportunities for millions of individuals with records. We find consistent evidence that removing an existing record does not improve labor market outcomes, on average. A notable exception is participation in gig work through online platforms, which often screen workers based on their records but not their employment histories. The evidence is consistent with records initially scarring labor market trajectories in a way that is difficult to undo later.
10.1257/pol.20240830.abstract_zh: 我们研究了消除先前犯罪记录是否能改善就业结果。我们评估了旨在改善数百万有犯罪记录者就业机会而广泛实施的犯罪记录补救法的因果影响。研究发现，一致证据表明，消除现有记录平均而言并未改善劳动力市场结果。一个显著的例外是通过在线平台参与零工工作，这些平台通常根据犯罪记录而非就业历史筛选工作者。证据表明，犯罪记录最初会以难以事后弥补的方式损害劳动力市场轨迹。
10.1257/pol.20240830.title: Can You Erase the Mark of a Criminal Record? Labor Market Impacts of Criminal Record Remediation
10.1257/pol.20240830.title_zh: 能否抹去犯罪记录的印记？犯罪记录修复对劳动力市场的影响

10.1257/pol.20240883.abstract: Recent firm-level studies find R&D tax incentives to be much more effective at stimulating firms’ R&D investment than aggregate analyses suggest. Based on a distributed analysis of official R&D survey and administrative tax relief microdata for 19 OECD countries, we show that two factors can reconcile these contrasting results. Firstly, the limited uptake of R&D tax incentives in most countries makes aggregate studies underestimate the effectiveness of R&D tax incentives. Secondly, R&D tax incentives are (much) less effective for large and R&D-intensive firms, which account for a small share of R&D-performing firms but most aggregate R&D tax relief.
10.1257/pol.20240883.abstract_zh: 近期基于企业层面的研究发现，研发税收激励对刺激企业研发投资的效力远高于宏观分析所显示的水平。通过对19个OECD国家官方研发调查数据与行政税收减免微观数据的分布式分析，我们揭示两个因素可调和上述矛盾结论：其一，多数国家研发税收激励的有限采用率导致宏观研究低估其有效性；其二，研发税收激励对大型及高研发密集型企业（虽仅占研发企业的小部分，却集中了大部分宏观研发税收减免）的效力显著偏低。
10.1257/pol.20240883.title: How Effective Are R&D Tax Incentives? Reconciling the Micro and Macro Evidence
10.1257/pol.20240883.title_zh: 研发税收激励的有效性如何？调和微观与宏观证据

10.1257/pol.20240889.abstract: This paper shows that retailers increase prices in response to organized retail crime. We match store-level crime data to scanner data from the universe of transactions for cannabis retailers in Washington state. Using quasi-experimental variation from robberies and burglaries, we find a 1.7-1.8% price increase at victimized stores and nearby competitors. This rise is not driven by short-to-medium-term demand changes but is consistent with crime-related cost shocks. Effects are larger for independent stores and less concentrated markets. We estimate that crime imposes a 1% ‘hidden’ unit tax on affected stores, implying $30.7 million additional social costs, primarily borne by consumers.
10.1257/pol.20240889.abstract_zh: 本文表明，零售商在应对有组织零售犯罪时会提高价格。我们将门店层面的犯罪数据与华盛顿州大麻零售商的全量交易扫描数据相匹配。利用抢劫和入室盗窃带来的准实验性变化，我们发现受害门店及其附近竞争对手的价格上涨了1.7%-1.8%。这一价格上涨并非由短期至中期的需求变化驱动，而是与犯罪相关的成本冲击相一致。独立门店及市场集中度较低的区域受影响更大。我们估算，犯罪对受影响门店施加了1%的“隐性”单位税，这意味着额外社会成本达3070万美元，主要由消费者承担。
10.1257/pol.20240889.title: The Pass-Through of Retail Crime

10.1257/pol.20240893.abstract: We combine detailed information on US temporary trade barriers during 1989-2020 with input-output data to study the effects of trade protection along supply chains. We focus on measures imposed against China, which has been the main target of trade protection during the last decades. To deal with endogeneity concerns, we use an instrumental variable strategy, exploiting changes in the identity of swing states across presidential terms and heterogeneous exposure to these political shocks across industries. We find that politically motivated trade protection generates winners and losers: it fosters employment growth in protected industries, but hampers employment growth in downstream industries.
10.1257/pol.20240893.abstract_zh: 我们结合1989-2020年美国临时贸易壁垒的详细信息与投入产出数据，研究贸易保护在供应链中的影响。重点关注针对中国的措施——过去几十年间，中国一直是贸易保护的主要目标。为应对内生性问题，我们采用工具变量策略，利用总统任期更迭中摇摆州身份的变化以及各行业对这些政治冲击的异质性暴露程度。研究发现，政治驱动的贸易保护产生了赢家与输家：它促进了受保护行业的就业增长，但抑制了下游行业的就业增长。
10.1257/pol.20240893.title: Trade Protection Along Supply Chains

10.1257/pol.20240899.abstract: This paper investigates how federal oversight not precipitated by a major scandal influences policing behavior and public safety. The high-profile events triggering such scandals can independently affect policing and crime, confounding estimates of oversight effects. I examine a 2011 federal investigation into the Seattle Police Department. In response to the heightened scrutiny from the investigation, officers immediately and significantly reduced stops, particularly suspicious-activity and traffic stops in minority neighborhoods. These reductions had no detectable effect on public safety. I conclude that federal oversight implemented in the absence of scandals may lower the social cost of policing.
10.1257/pol.20240899.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了并非由重大丑闻引发的联邦监督如何影响警务行为与公共安全。触发此类丑闻的高关注度事件可能独立影响警务与犯罪，从而混淆监督效应的估计。我研究了2011年对西雅图警察局的联邦调查。为应对调查带来的高度关注，警员立即显著减少了拦截行为，尤其是在少数族裔社区的嫌疑活动拦截和交通拦截。这些减少对公共安全未产生可察觉的影响。我得出结论：在无丑闻背景下实施的联邦监督可能降低警务的社会成本。
10.1257/pol.20240899.title: What Does Federal Oversight Do to Policing and Public Safety? Evidence from Seattle
10.1257/pol.20240899.title_zh: 联邦监督对警务与公共安全有何影响？来自西雅图的证据

10.1257/pol.20240903.abstract: We study the economic effects of transfers to local governments using a reform of the Finnish municipal grant system as a source of exogenous variation. We find that higher grants lead to lower municipal taxes and fees, higher public spending and improved budget balance. These changes in local fiscal policy lead to an increase in private sector jobs. Our estimates imply a cost per job of e33,000. The increase in jobs is paired with a reduction in commuting to other municipalities. The effect on migration seems small, suggesting grants bring local benefits without drastically affecting where households choose to live.
10.1257/pol.20240903.abstract_zh: 我们利用芬兰市政拨款制度改革作为外生变动的来源，研究了对地方政府转移支付的经济效应。研究发现，更高的拨款导致市政税费降低、公共支出增加以及预算平衡改善。这些地方财政政策的变化带来了私营部门就业岗位的增加。我们的估算显示，每个就业岗位的成本为33,000欧元。就业增长的同时，通勤至其他市镇的人数有所减少。对迁移的影响似乎较小，这表明拨款在带来地方利益的同时，并未显著改变家庭居住地的选择。
10.1257/pol.20240903.title: Fiscal Transfers to Local Governments and the Distribution of Economic Activity
10.1257/pol.20240903.title_zh: 财政转移支付与地方经济活动分布

10.1257/pol.20250007.abstract: To reduce Russia’s funding for its Ukraine invasion, Western governments imposed, after a delay, a price ceiling on Russian seaborne oil exports utilizing Western services. To evade that ceiling, Russia developed a “shadow fleet” using no such services. We simulate a calibrated model driven by this fleet’s expansion to assess various sanctions. Mainly, sanctions—from a price ceiling to its extreme service ban version—significantly reduce the present value of Russia’s profits. However, tighter price caps will not necessarily harm Russia if they raise the world price. Shortening the delay between sanctions announcement and implementation can harm Russia more.
10.1257/pol.20250007.abstract_zh: 为削减俄罗斯对乌克兰战争的资金支持，西方政府经延迟后对依赖西方服务的俄罗斯海运石油出口实施价格上限。为规避该上限，俄罗斯组建了不使用此类服务的"影子船队"。我们通过校准模型模拟该船队扩张情景，评估各类制裁措施的效果。主要发现：从价格上限到其极端版本的服务禁令，各类制裁均显著降低俄罗斯利润现值。然而，若更严格的价格上限推高全球油价，则未必对俄罗斯造成损害。缩短制裁宣布与实施之间的延迟期，可对俄罗斯造成更大打击。
10.1257/pol.20250007.title: The Dynamics of Evasion: The Price Cap on Russian Oil Exports and the Amassing of the Shadow Fleet
10.1257/pol.20250007.title_zh: 逃避的动态：俄罗斯石油出口价格上限与影子舰队扩张

10.1257/pol.20250265.abstract: Public programs that provide benefits through private markets contend with strategic firm behavior. We study this dynamic in Medicare Part D. The Affordable Care Act closed a coverage gap in Part D by mandating drug manufacturers cover 50% of branded drug costs in the gap. Beneficiaries became 5 percentage points less likely to forgo prescriptions upon reaching the gap. However, manufacturers' response led to 21% higher drug prices, partially offsetting the insurance expansion. The closure was intended to be a $100 transfer to beneficiaries financed by manufacturers, but instead resulted in a $55 transfer to beneficiaries financed by the government.
10.1257/pol.20250265.abstract_zh: 通过私人市场提供福利的公共项目需应对企业的策略性行为。我们以联邦医疗保险D部分为研究对象，分析这一动态机制。《平价医疗法案》通过强制要求药品制造商承担覆盖缺口内品牌药50%的成本，填补了D部分的保障缺口。受益人在进入覆盖缺口后放弃处方的概率降低了5个百分点。然而，制造商的应对措施导致药品价格上涨21%，部分抵消了保险覆盖扩大的效果。该缺口填补政策本意是由制造商出资向受益人转移100美元，但最终演变为由政府出资向受益人转移55美元。
10.1257/pol.20250265.title: The Effect of Public Insurance Design on Pharmaceutical Prices: Evidence from Medicare Part D
10.1257/pol.20250265.title_zh: 公共保险设计对药品价格的影响：来自医疗保险D部分的证据

10.1257/pol.20250309.abstract: This paper studies the impacts of administrative burdens across multiple welfare programs and application stages via an increasingly widespread phenomenon: the automation of caseworker assistance. Leveraging a natural experiment phased in across Indiana’s counties and administrative records for 3 million recipients, we find that SNAP, TANF, and Medicaid enrollments fell by 15%, 24%, and 4% after automation. Heterogeneous declines are attributable to cross-program differences in recertification costs. Needier individuals exited while less needy individuals were screened out at entry, potentially reconciling some conflicting results in the literature and best understood through a dynamic selection model of certification and recertification.
10.1257/pol.20250309.abstract_zh: 本文通过日益普遍的行政自动化现象，研究跨多个福利项目及申请阶段的行政负担影响。利用印第安纳州各县分阶段实施的自然实验及300万受助者的行政记录，我们发现自动化后，SNAP、TANF和Medicaid的注册人数分别下降了15%、24%和4%。异质性下降可归因于不同项目在重新认证成本上的差异。需求更迫切的个体退出，而需求较低的个体在进入阶段被筛选排除，这一发现可能调和了文献中部分相互矛盾的结果，并通过认证与重新认证的动态选择模型得以最佳解释。
10.1257/pol.20250309.title: Certification and Recertification in Welfare Programs: What Happens When Automation Goes Wrong?
10.1257/pol.20250309.title_zh: 福利项目中的认证与再认证：自动化出错时会发生什么？

10.1257/pol.20250324.abstract: Given labor informality in developing countries, addressing employment shocks is challenging. We study Indonesia’s new approach for on-demand online applications for temporary cash assistance and online job training. Through 20 lotteries over two years, 11 million beneficiaries were selected. In nationwide, representative surveys matched with administrative data, most beneficiaries report not receiving the assistance, with no detectable impacts on employment or consumption. In contrast, survey data from applicants with working phones reveal high reported take-up and higher incomes. The results suggest that while flexible, on-demand assistance has potential, design features that allow for flexibility could hinder receipt and, thus, impact.
10.1257/pol.20250324.abstract_zh: 鉴于发展中国家普遍存在的非正规就业现象，应对就业冲击颇具挑战性。我们研究了印度尼西亚针对临时现金援助和在线职业培训的新型按需在线申请模式。通过两年间20轮抽签，共筛选出1100万受益人。在匹配行政数据的全国代表性调查中，多数受益人报告未收到援助，且未发现对就业或消费产生可检测的影响。相比之下，对拥有可用电话的申请者进行的调查数据显示，其报告领取率较高且收入水平更高。研究结果表明，尽管灵活的按需援助具有潜力，但允许灵活性的设计特征可能阻碍实际领取，进而影响政策效果。
10.1257/pol.20250324.title: On-Demand Assistance: Experimental Evidence from Indonesia
10.1257/pol.20250324.title_zh: 按需援助：来自印度尼西亚的实验证据

10.1257/pol.20250473.abstract: I use a randomized controlled trial to study how nonresident tuition affects where highly skilled workers eventually live and work. For every $10,000 of tuition relief, the university receives $1,903 from increased enrollment and loses $2,738 from reduced tuition, yielding a small $835 loss. Treated students are more likely to stay in-state 12 years later and eventually earn $25,302 more in present value within the local economy, showing that the university’s profit-maximizing tuition level is suboptimal from the state’s perspective. The effects are driven by higher retention of inframarginal students and by out-of-state US nationals rather than international students.
10.1257/pol.20250473.abstract_zh: 我采用随机对照试验，研究非居民学费如何影响高技能工人最终的生活与工作地点。每减免10,000美元学费，大学因入学人数增加获得1,903美元收益，但因学费降低损失2,738美元，净损失为835美元。受助学生更可能在12年后留在本州，并在当地经济中最终获得现值25,302美元的额外收入，这表明从州的角度看，大学追求利润最大化的学费水平并非最优。这些效应主要由边际内学生的更高留存率以及来自美国其他州而非国际学生所驱动。
10.1257/pol.20250473.title: Nonresident Tuition and Human Capital Flows: Evidence from a Lottery
10.1257/pol.20250473.title_zh: 非居民学费与人力资本流动：来自抽签的证据

10.1257/pol.20250505.title: Index-Based Price Adjustment in US Strategic Petroleum Reserve Drawdowns
10.1257/pol.20250505.title_zh: 美国战略石油储备释放中基于指数的价格调整

10.1257/pol.20250543.abstract: We evaluate a guaranteed job program in Austria in 2020–2024. Our evaluation is based on three approaches, pairwise matched randomization, a pre-registered synthetic control at the municipality level, and a comparison to individuals in control municipalities. This allows us to estimate direct effects, anticipation effects, and spillover effects. We find positive impacts on economic and non-economic wellbeing. At the municipality level, we find a reduction of long-term unemployment and no negative employment spillovers. There are positive anticipation effects on well-being, status, and social inclusion. We estimate program costs of 237 Euro per participant and month. Participant income increased by 102 Euro.
10.1257/pol.20250543.abstract_zh: 我们评估了奥地利2020-2024年的一项保障就业项目。该评估基于三种方法：配对匹配随机化、预先注册的市级合成控制法，以及与对照市镇个体的比较。这使我们能够估计直接效应、预期效应和溢出效应。研究发现，该项目对经济和非经济福祉均产生了积极影响。在市级层面，长期失业率有所下降，且未发现负面的就业溢出效应。预期效应对福祉、社会地位和社会融入产生了积极影响。我们估算的项目成本为每位参与者每月237欧元，参与者收入增加了102欧元。
10.1257/pol.20250543.title: Employing the Unemployed of Marienthal: Evaluation of a Guaranteed Job Program
10.1257/pol.20250543.title_zh: 利用马里恩塔尔的失业者：一项保障就业计划的评估

10.1257/pol.20250583.abstract: This paper characterizes the optimal taxation of top earners in a world with externalities. It develops a reduced-form approach that allows for a flexible relationship between top earnings and the distribution of earnings capacities in the population. The optimal top tax rate is expressed in terms of simple sufficient statistics formulas that depend on the magnitude and distribution of net externalities. In general, externalities that run from top earners to bottom earners have much stronger policy implications than externalities within top earners. The theory is linked to evidence on the externalities of top entrepreneurs and a calibration analysis is provided.
10.1257/pol.20250583.abstract_zh: 本文刻画了存在外部性时对高收入者的最优税收政策。研究提出了一种简化形式方法，允许高收入群体收入与人群收入能力分布之间存在灵活关系。最优高收入税率通过简单的充分统计量公式表达，该公式取决于净外部性的规模与分布。一般而言，从高收入者流向低收入者的外部性比高收入群体内部的外部性具有更强的政策含义。本文将理论与顶级企业家外部性的实证证据相联系，并提供了校准分析。
10.1257/pol.20250583.title: Externalities and the Taxation of Top Earners
10.1257/pol.20250583.title_zh: 外部性与高收入者税收

10.1257/pol.20250610.abstract: Preparing young people for citizenship is a foundational purpose of public education, yet little is known about whether or how K-12 schools impact civic engagement. Using education, birth, and voting records for nine cohorts of students in Indiana, I estimate and assess the validity of high school e!ects on voting. School e!ects on voting are significant and practically meaningful: a one standard deviation increase in school civic e!ects increases the probability of voting by 2.1 percentage points (5.3 percent) and also predicts increases in voter registration and times voting. School civic e!ects are positively associated with peer parental civic norms.
10.1257/pol.20250610.abstract_zh: 培养年轻人的公民意识是公共教育的基本目标，但关于K-12学校是否以及如何影响公民参与的研究仍十分有限。本研究利用印第安纳州九届学生的教育、出生及投票记录数据，对高中教育对投票行为的影响效应进行估计与效度评估。研究发现，学校对投票行为的影响具有显著的实际意义：学校公民教育效应每提升一个标准差，学生投票概率将提高2.1个百分点（增幅达5.3%），同时选民登记率与投票次数也呈现增长趋势。学校公民教育效应与同伴家长的公民规范呈正相关关系。
10.1257/pol.20250610.title: High School Effects on Civic Engagement
10.1257/pol.20250610.title_zh: 高中教育对公民参与的影响

10.1257/pol.20250924.abstract: Can African countries deter industrial fishing vessels from near-shore waters reserved for artisanal fishers? Using radar data released in 2024, this paper provides the first causal evaluation of these Inshore Exclusion Zones (IEZs). Regression discontinuity estimates reveal deterrence in 6 of 20 African countries. Next, we apply bunching estimators to obtain counterfactual vessel distributions uncontaminated by spillovers outside IEZ boundaries. We capture extensive-margin effects by calibrating a discrete choice vessel location model to our bunching estimates. Bioeconomic calculations indicate that IEZs increase artisanal fisher catch by enough to meet key micronutrient requirements for 7 million people.
10.1257/pol.20250924.abstract_zh: 非洲国家能否阻止工业渔船进入为手工渔民保留的近岸水域？本文利用2024年发布的雷达数据，首次对这些近岸禁渔区（IEZs）进行了因果效应评估。断点回归估计结果显示，在20个非洲国家中有6个国家产生了威慑效应。随后，我们应用聚束估计量获取了不受禁渔区边界外溢出效应污染的反事实船舶分布。通过将离散选择船舶定位模型校准至聚束估计结果，我们捕捉了集约边际效应。生物经济核算表明，近岸禁渔区使手工渔民的渔获量增加幅度足以满足700万人的关键微量营养素需求。
10.1257/pol.20250924.title: Deterring Industrial Vessels from African Coastal Fisheries
10.1257/pol.20250924.title_zh: 阻止工业渔船进入非洲沿海渔业

10.1257/pol.20260196.abstract: Cesarean section rates vary widely across U.S. counties, but whether this variation reflects patients’ medical risk, beliefs, and preferences or obstetric care environments, including clinicians’ practice styles and delivery facilities, remains unclear. Using 1989–2019 U.S. birth records, we study closures of counties’ last operating obstetric units, which redirect mothers to counties with different baseline C-section rates. In an instrumental variables framework, we find that a one-percentage-point increase in the delivery county’s C-section rate raises a mother’s C-section probability by approximately one percentage point, highlighting the central role of where mothers receive obstetric care in determining C-section use.
10.1257/pol.20260196.abstract_zh: 美国各县的剖宫产率差异显著，但这种差异究竟反映的是患者的医疗风险、信念与偏好，还是产科护理环境（包括临床医生的实践风格和分娩设施）的影响，目前尚不明确。利用1989年至2019年美国出生记录，我们研究了各县最后一个运营产科单位的关闭情况，这促使产妇被转至基线剖宫产率不同的县。在工具变量框架下，我们发现，分娩所在县的剖宫产率每提高一个百分点，产妇接受剖宫产的概率约增加一个百分点，这凸显了产妇接受产科护理的地点对剖宫产使用所起的核心决定作用。
10.1257/pol.20260196.title: Disentangling Sources of Variation in C-Section Rates
10.1257/pol.20260196.title_zh: 剖宫产率变异来源的分解

10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481.abstract: Do job seekers consider the race or gender of an employer when applying for a job? Although we have extensive research on employer-side discrimination, we know less about employee-side biases and their consequences. In this study, we examine how the gender and race of the employer shape the willingness of prospective employees to apply for a job. To examine this, we conducted a field experiment where we randomized real jobseekers into three conditions according to employer demographics. We find that job candidates were less likely to apply to a job when they learn that the founders are Black, and, when they did apply, they requested 10% higher salary. In addition, the more qualified a candidate, the less likely they were to apply to Black founders, leaving Black founders with a pool of candidates that is smaller, worse, and more expensive than their White peers. We find no gender penalty for White female founders. Findings from two survey experiments suggest that the penalty is unique to White applicants evaluating Black founders and reflects a concern among White applicants that they will be less likely to fit within a firm and that the firm is less likely to be successful in the long run. We find no evidence of a widespread applicant homophily where all applicants favor founders of their own ethnic group, nor do we find evidence of widespread statistical discrimination whereby all applicants penalize Black founders for being atypical members of the entrepreneurial class. This paper was accepted by Olav Sorenson, organizations. Funding: Financial support from the INSEAD Alumni Fund is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481 .
10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481.abstract_zh: 求职者在申请工作时，是否会考虑雇主的种族或性别？尽管关于雇主方歧视的研究已相当丰富，但我们对雇员方偏见及其后果知之甚少。本研究探讨了雇主的性别和种族如何影响潜在求职者的申请意愿。为此，我们开展了一项实地实验，根据雇主的人口统计特征，将真实求职者随机分配到三种情境中。研究发现，当求职者得知创始人为黑人时，他们申请该职位的可能性较低；即便申请，他们要求的薪资也高出10%。此外，候选人资质越高，申请黑人创始人职位的可能性越低，这导致黑人创始人面临的候选人群体规模更小、质量更差且成本更高，与白人创始人相比处于劣势。我们未发现白人女性创始人面临性别惩罚。两项调查实验的结果表明，这种惩罚仅出现在白人求职者评估黑人创始人时，反映出白人求职者担心自己在该公司难以融入，且认为该公司长期成功的可能性较低。我们未发现广泛的求职者同质性偏好，即所有求职者都偏向于同族裔创始人；也未发现广泛的统计性歧视，即所有求职者因黑人创始人是创业者阶层中的非典型成员而对其施加惩罚。本文由组织领域编辑Olav Sorenson接受。资金支持：感谢欧洲工商管理学院校友基金提供的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481.title: Do Job Applicants Consider Founder Race and Gender? Evidence from a Field Experiment
10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481.title_zh: 求职者会考虑创始人的种族和性别吗？来自实地实验的证据

10.1287/mnsc.2022.01740.abstract: Unstructured text provides decision makers with a rich data source in many domains, ranging from product reviews in retail to nursing notes in healthcare. To leverage this information, words are typically translated into word embeddings—vectors that encode the semantic relationships between words—through unsupervised learning algorithms such as matrix factorization. However, learning word embeddings from new domains with limited training data can be challenging because the meaning/usage may be different in the new domain; for example, the word “positive” typically has positive sentiment, but often has negative sentiment in medical notes because it may imply that a patient tested positive for a disease. In practice, we expect that only a small number of domain-specific words may have new meanings. We propose an intuitive two-stage estimator that exploits this structure via a group-sparse penalty to efficiently transfer learn domain-specific word embeddings by combining large-scale text corpora (such as Wikipedia) with limited domain-specific text data. We bound the generalization error of our transfer learning estimator, proving that it can achieve high accuracy with substantially less domain-specific data when only a small number of embeddings are altered between domains. Furthermore, we prove that all local minima identified by our nonconvex objective function are statistically indistinguishable from the global minimum under standard regularization conditions, implying that our estimator can be computed efficiently. Our results provide the first bounds on group-sparse matrix factorization, which may be of independent interest. We empirically evaluate our approach compared with state-of-the-art fine-tuning heuristics from natural language processing. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization. Funding: The authors gratefully acknowledge indispensable financial support from the Wharton Analytics Initiative and the Wharton Dean’s Fund. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01740 .
10.1287/mnsc.2022.01740.abstract_zh: 非结构化文本为决策者在众多领域提供了丰富的数据来源，从零售中的产品评论到医疗保健中的护理记录。为利用这些信息，词语通常通过无监督学习算法（如矩阵分解）转换为词嵌入——编码词语间语义关系的向量。然而，在新领域中使用有限训练数据学习词嵌入可能具有挑战性，因为新领域中词语的含义或用法可能有所不同；例如，“positive”一词通常带有积极情感，但在医疗记录中往往带有消极情感，因为它可能暗示患者检测出某种疾病阳性。在实践中，我们预期只有少数领域特定词语可能具有新含义。我们提出一种直观的两阶段估计器，利用这种结构，通过组稀疏惩罚，结合大规模文本语料库（如维基百科）与有限的领域特定文本数据，高效地迁移学习领域特定词嵌入。我们限定了迁移学习估计器的泛化误差，证明当仅少量嵌入在领域间发生变化时，它能以显著更少的领域特定数据实现高精度。此外，我们证明在标准正则化条件下，我们的非凸目标函数所识别的所有局部最小值在统计上与全局最小值不可区分，这意味着我们的估计器可以高效计算。我们的结果首次提供了组稀疏矩阵分解的界限，这可能具有独立的研究价值。我们通过实证评估，将我们的方法与自然语言处理中最先进的微调启发式方法进行比较。本文由Chung Piaw Teo（优化方向）接受。资助：作者衷心感谢沃顿分析计划及沃顿院长基金提供的不可或缺的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01740获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2022.01740.title: Group-Sparse Matrix Factorization for Transfer Learning of Word Embeddings
10.1287/mnsc.2022.01740.title_zh: 词嵌入迁移学习的群稀疏矩阵分解

10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682.abstract: In a bug bounty program (BBP), organizations incentivize hackers—who could otherwise be “enemies”—to report security vulnerabilities by publicly offering monetary rewards. This paper develops an analytical framework to characterize BBPs and their strategic and economic impacts. Strategically, BBPs induce some hackers to self-select into cooperative vulnerability discovery and reporting, diverting them away from attacking (attack diversion) and delegating part of the protection effort to them (protection delegation). We show that (i) BBPs can be beneficial even when hackers are inefficient at vulnerability identification, yet more participants might make BBPs less attractive to firms. (ii) Although BBPs improve security, they might encourage competitive hackers (i.e., attackers) to exert more efforts. (iii) The coopetition dynamics can render a firm’s provision of rewards and in-house efforts socially inefficient. Common cybersecurity regulations, such as breach penalties and bounty reward subsidies, may exacerbate the inefficiency. We find complementarity between bounty subsidies and breach penalties, suggesting that combining and customizing them according to firm characteristics could enhance BBP efficiency. (iv) Contrary to the conventional wisdom that crowdsourcing rewards increase with participant size, we identify scenarios in which a firm should reduce or make nonmonotonic adjustments to a bounty reward as participant size increases. (v) Legal safe harbor for security testing or policies that reduce duplicate report submissions can lower firm payoffs under BBPs. We draw related implications for research and practice in information security and crowdsourcing. This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems. Funding: This research is supported in part by the HKSAR General Research Fund Project 16503620. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682 .
10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682.abstract_zh: 在漏洞赏金计划（BBP）中，组织通过公开提供金钱奖励，激励那些原本可能成为“敌人”的黑客报告安全漏洞。本文构建了一个分析框架，以刻画BBP及其战略和经济影响。从战略角度看，BBP促使部分黑客自我选择参与合作性的漏洞发现与报告，从而将其从攻击行为中转移（攻击转移），并将部分防护工作委托给他们（防护委托）。我们表明：（i）即使黑客在漏洞识别方面效率不高，BBP也可能有益，但参与者增多可能使企业对BBP的兴趣降低。（ii）尽管BBP提升了安全性，但它们可能鼓励竞争性黑客（即攻击者）投入更多努力。（iii）这种合作竞争动态可能导致企业提供的奖励和内部努力在社会效率上不尽如人意。常见的网络安全法规，如违规处罚和赏金补贴，可能加剧这种低效率。我们发现赏金补贴与违规处罚之间存在互补性，表明根据企业特征进行组合和定制可以提升BBP效率。（iv）与传统观念认为众包奖励随参与者规模增加而增加相反，我们识别出一些情境，其中企业应随着参与者规模增加而减少或非单调调整赏金奖励。（v）为安全测试提供的法律安全港或减少重复报告提交的政策，可能降低企业在BBP下的收益。我们为信息安全与众包领域的研究和实践提出了相关启示。本文被信息系统方向编辑Hemant Bhargava接受。资助：本研究部分受香港特别行政区研究资助局优配研究金项目16503620支持。补充材料：在线附录见https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682。
10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682.title: Crowdsourcing from Hackers: Strategic Coopetition and Governance in Bug Bounty Programs
10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682.title_zh: 众包黑客：漏洞赏金计划中的战略竞合与治理

10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773.abstract: We use career backgrounds of initial employees from a full cohort of U.S. startups to measure founding teams’ skillsets. Startups with more diverse prior industry experience grow faster than same-industry local peers. One-standard-deviation-higher diversity is associated with 16% (10%) higher five-year employment (sales) growth, controlling for demographic diversity, prestartup wages, and other observables. Startups in innovative industries and facing lower coordination costs among team members drive the results. To address endogeneity, we exploit shocks in which teams suddenly lose members with unduplicated skills. Overall, combining individual specialization with team-level diversification allows teams to act as “jacks of all trades and masters of each.” This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Funding: This research uses data from the Census Bureau’s Longitudinal Employer Household Dynamics Program, which was partially supported by the National Science Foundation [Grants SES-9978093, SES-0339191 and ITR-0427889], the National Institute on Aging [Grant AG018854], and grants from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773 .
10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773.abstract_zh: 我们利用美国初创企业完整队列中初始员工的职业背景来衡量创始团队的技能组合。拥有更多元化先前行业经验的初创企业，其增长速度超过同行业本地同行。在控制人口统计多样性、创业前工资及其他可观测因素后，多样性每增加一个标准差，五年期就业（销售）增长率分别提高16%（10%）。这一效应在创新行业及团队成员间协调成本较低的初创企业中更为显著。为解决内生性问题，我们利用团队突然失去拥有不可复制技能成员的冲击。总体而言，将个人专业化与团队层面多元化相结合，使团队能够成为“多面手且各有所长”。本文由金融学编辑Bo Becker接受。资助：本研究使用人口普查局纵向雇主-家庭动态项目的数据，该项目部分得到国家科学基金会[资助号SES-9978093、SES-0339191和ITR-0427889]、国家老龄化研究所[资助号AG018854]及阿尔弗雷德·P·斯隆基金会资助。补充材料：网络附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773.title: Entrepreneurial Teams: Prior Industry Experience and Early-Stage Growth
10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773.title_zh: 创业团队：过往行业经验与早期成长

10.1287/mnsc.2023.00913.abstract: Normative theories assume that people have stable preferences across logically equivalent decision contexts. Preference reversals, cases where preferred options vary across decision contexts, violate this assumption and suggest that preferences are constructed during the decision-making process. We contribute to this literature by identifying a boundary condition for these context effects. We theorize that monetary preference elicitations, such as willingness to pay (WTP) and willingness to accept (WTA), evoke comparisons to external out-of-context standards, such as the market price of similar goods. These out-of-context comparisons should weaken the influence of the local context. Our theory predicts that context effects will be weaker for (1) monetary versus nonmonetary preference elicitations (e.g., WTP/WTA versus choice) and when (2) options differ on attributes highly correlated with market prices of similar goods and services. Across 22 studies, we find support for these predictions using three canonical decision context effects (intertemporal tradeoffs, framing effects, and attraction effects), incentive-compatible and stated preferences, and different response formats (binary, continuous, and mixed). Preferences for a wide range of goods and services—including baked goods, apartments, and lotteries—exhibit these patterns. Our theory explains substantial variance in context effects and offers testable predictions for when context effects will arise in research and practice. This paper was accepted by George Wu, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This work was supported by Connaught Fund. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00913 .
10.1287/mnsc.2023.00913.abstract_zh: 规范性理论假设人们在逻辑等价的决策情境中拥有稳定的偏好。偏好反转，即在不同决策情境中偏好选项发生变化的现象，违反了这一假设，并表明偏好是在决策过程中构建的。我们通过识别这些情境效应的边界条件，为该文献做出贡献。我们理论化认为，货币性偏好诱导方法，如支付意愿（WTP）和接受意愿（WTA），会引发与外部情境外标准（如类似商品的市场价格）的比较。这些情境外比较应削弱局部情境的影响。我们的理论预测，情境效应在以下情况下会较弱：（1）货币性偏好诱导与非货币性偏好诱导（例如，WTP/WTA与选择）相比，以及（2）当选项在属性上高度相关于类似商品和服务的市场价格时。通过22项研究，我们使用三种经典的决策情境效应（跨期权衡、框架效应和吸引效应）、激励兼容和陈述性偏好，以及不同的响应格式（二元、连续和混合），找到了支持这些预测的证据。对广泛商品和服务的偏好——包括烘焙食品、公寓和彩票——均表现出这些模式。我们的理论解释了情境效应中的大量方差，并为研究和实践中情境效应何时会出现提供了可检验的预测。本文由乔治·吴（George Wu）在行为经济学与决策分析领域接受。资助：本研究由康诺特基金（Connaught Fund）支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00913 获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2023.00913.title: Why Context Influences Preferences Elicited with Willingness to Pay Less Than Preferences Elicited with Choice
10.1287/mnsc.2023.00913.title_zh: 为何支付意愿所揭示的偏好受情境影响小于选择所揭示的偏好

10.1287/mnsc.2023.01823.abstract: We study a newsvendor problem with unknown demand distribution in a nonstationary demand environment over a multiperiod time horizon. The demand in each period consists of a time-varying demand level and an additive random shock. Neither the demand level nor the random shock is separately observable. The amount of change in the demand level over the time horizon is measured by a cumulative variation metric. The problem has widespread applications, such as perishable inventory planning, staffing, and medical resource capacity planning in the wake of COVID-19. We design a family of nonparametric dynamic ordering policies, termed two-stage estimation (2SE) policies, that track the shifts in the unknown demand level while accounting for the unobservable random demand shocks. To compute the order quantity in each period, these policies only need the past demand observations, without any access to the underlying demand distribution. For a finite variation “budget,” we prove that our ordering policies are first-order optimal in the sense that their regret grows at the smallest possible rate. We also extend our analysis to the case of asymptotically large variation budgets. Through case studies based on real-life data, we show that our policies can save more than 20% of overage and underage costs, relative to policies widely used for perishable inventory replenishment and nurse staffing. Moreover, our simulation experiments indicate that our policies consistently maintain superior performance across diverse patterns of nonstationary demand environments. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, operations management. Funding: N. B. Keskin and J.-S. Song were supported by the Duke University Fuqua School of Business, and X. Min was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72401195] and the China Postdoctoral Science Foundation [2025T180216]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01823 .
10.1287/mnsc.2023.01823.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个在非平稳需求环境下，多期时间范围内需求分布未知的报童问题。每期的需求由时变的需求水平与加性随机冲击构成，而需求水平与随机冲击均无法单独观测。需求水平随时间变化的幅度通过累积变化度量来衡量。该问题具有广泛的应用背景，如易腐品库存规划、人员配置以及新冠疫情背景下的医疗资源容量规划。我们设计了一族非参数动态订货策略，称为两阶段估计策略，该策略在考虑不可观测的随机需求冲击的同时，追踪未知需求水平的变化。这些策略在计算每期订货量时，仅需历史需求观测数据，无需接触潜在的需求分布。对于有限的变化“预算”，我们证明了所提出的订货策略在遗憾值以最小可能速率增长的意义下是一阶最优的。我们还将分析扩展至渐近大变化预算的情形。基于真实数据的案例研究表明，与广泛用于易腐品库存补货和护士配置的策略相比，我们的策略能节省超过20%的超储与缺货成本。此外，模拟实验表明，我们的策略在多样化的非平稳需求环境模式下始终保持优越性能。本文由David Simchi-Levi负责运营管理方向审阅。资金支持：N. B. Keskin和J.-S. Song获得了杜克大学富卡商学院的支持，X. Min获得了国家自然科学基金[批准号72401195]和中国博士后科学基金[2025T180216]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01823获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2023.01823.title: The Nonstationary Newsvendor: Data-Driven Nonparametric Learning
10.1287/mnsc.2023.01823.title_zh: 非平稳报童问题：数据驱动的非参数学习

10.1287/mnsc.2023.01924.abstract: Observable priority queues, where some customers are served ahead of others, are prevalent in many service systems, ranging from the entertainment industry to emergency departments (EDs). In this paper, we study the rational abandonment behavior of utility-maximizing customers in the context of an observable two-class priority queue and identify novel performance and pricing implications. We first characterize the structure of the rational abandonment strategy and show that it has a threshold-based last-come, first-abandon structure. We then examine the steady-state performance of the system under the rational abandonment strategy and in contrast with an exogenous abandonment model commonly used in the literature. We show that using the exogenous abandonment model could result in highly suboptimal decisions when considering capacity planning to meet target waiting times and/or abandonment rates. We further investigate optimal pricing strategies under rational abandonment. Our results highlight the importance of the timing of payments. We show that welfare maximization requires charging only a service fee and no entrance fee. In contrast, revenue maximization generally requires a combination of both an entrance and a service fee. Furthermore, welfare-maximizing prices always involve abandonment, whereas revenue maximization may require pricing strategies that prevent abandonment. Finally, we discuss the implications of our results for our motivating applications, including the perils of charging nonurgent ED patients upfront. This paper was accepted by Baris Ata, stochastic models and simulation. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01924 .
10.1287/mnsc.2023.01924.abstract_zh: 可观测优先队列在许多服务系统中普遍存在，其中部分顾客优先于其他顾客获得服务，应用范围从娱乐行业到急诊部门（EDs）。本文研究了在可观测的两类优先队列背景下，追求效用最大化的顾客的理性放弃行为，并识别出新颖的绩效与定价含义。我们首先刻画了理性放弃策略的结构，并证明其具有基于阈值的后到先弃特征。随后，我们考察了理性放弃策略下系统的稳态性能，并与文献中常用的外生放弃模型进行对比。研究表明，在考虑满足目标等待时间和/或放弃率的容量规划时，使用外生放弃模型可能导致高度次优的决策。我们进一步探讨了理性放弃下的最优定价策略。我们的结果强调了支付时机的重要性。我们证明，福利最大化要求仅收取服务费而不收取入场费。相反，收入最大化通常需要同时结合入场费和服务费。此外，福利最大化价格总是涉及放弃，而收入最大化可能要求防止放弃的定价策略。最后，我们讨论了研究结果对激励应用的启示，包括对非紧急急诊患者预先收费的风险。本文由Baris Ata接受，涉及随机模型与仿真。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01924获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2023.01924.title: Rational Abandonment from Observable Priority Queues: Equilibrium Strategy, Performance, and Pricing Implications
10.1287/mnsc.2023.01924.title_zh: 可观察优先队列中的理性放弃：均衡策略、绩效与定价启示

10.1287/mnsc.2023.02150.abstract: Consumer experiences are inherently dynamic. When engaging in a sequence of activities, consumers are influenced by past experiences in two ways: negatively by their objective quality, through quality contrast; and positively by their subjective appreciation of them, through affect assimilation. How should experience curators sequence activities to maximize consumer satisfaction in the presence of such intertemporal effects? We formulate an experience curator’s problem as a dynamic optimization program. We show that, because of affect assimilation, the best activity may be scheduled at the beginning or in the middle of an experience, in contrast to the common peak-end rule—this provides a rationale for the saying that “first impressions matter.” Under uncertainty, it may be valuable to save the best activity as a “wild card” to recover from bad outcomes. We calibrate our model to four distinct experiential contexts (namely, watching movies, reading books, visiting touristic attractions, and eating out) and consistently find the presence of both quality contrast and affect assimilation. Through a counterfactual study in the context of touristic tours, we show that experience curators may significantly benefit from offering different fixed sequences to different types of consumers, but they tend to gain little from dynamically adjusting them. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, operations management. Funding: This work was supported by the Agencia Estatal de Investigación [Grant PID2020-116135GB-I00 MCIN/AEI/10.13039/50110001]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02150 .
10.1287/mnsc.2023.02150.abstract_zh: 消费者体验本质上是动态的。在参与一系列活动时，消费者会以两种方式受到过往经历的影响：一方面，通过质量对比，客观质量产生负面影响；另一方面，通过情感同化，主观欣赏产生正面影响。在此类跨期效应存在的情况下，体验策划者应如何安排活动顺序以最大化消费者满意度？我们将体验策划者的问题构建为动态优化模型。研究表明，由于情感同化的作用，最佳活动可能被安排在体验的开始或中间阶段，这与常见的“峰终定律”相悖——这为“第一印象至关重要”的说法提供了理论依据。在不确定性条件下，保留最佳活动作为“王牌”以应对不良结果可能具有价值。我们将模型校准至四种不同的体验情境（即观影、阅读书籍、游览旅游景点及外出就餐），并一致发现质量对比与情感同化同时存在。通过旅游观光情境下的反事实研究，我们表明体验策划者通过向不同类型的消费者提供不同的固定序列可显著获益，但动态调整序列所带来的收益往往甚微。本文由David Simchi-Levi（运营管理领域）接受。资助：本研究受西班牙国家研究机构[基金号PID2020-116135GB-I00 MCIN/AEI/10.13039/50110001]支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02150获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2023.02150.title: The Engineering of Consumer Experiences Under Affect Assimilation and Quality Contrast
10.1287/mnsc.2023.02150.title_zh: 情感同化与质量对比下的消费者体验工程

10.1287/mnsc.2023.02165.abstract: Since 2015, global progress in improving energy efficiency has lagged behind the targets set by the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, in part due to behavioral barriers to such improvement. Rising renewable energy adoption may impact energy efficiency improvement by raising or lowering these barriers. The well-documented rebound effect—where renewable energy adoption may increase energy consumption—could hinder efficiency gains, whereas renewable energy adoption may also raise awareness of energy use, thereby driving efficiency improvement. This paper examines whether and how renewable energy adoption influences energy efficiency improvement. Using data from 183 sites of a multinational industrial conglomerate from 2015 to 2020, we estimate the impact of changes in renewable energy usage and procurement methods on energy efficiency improvement. We find that using renewable energy to satisfy an additional 10% of a site’s energy demand caused an additional 2.8%–6.1% improvement in energy efficiency. However, the impact varies significantly depending on the procurement approach. Sourcing off-site renewable energy led to energy efficiency improvement, whereas installing on-site renewable energy generation had either no effect or a negative effect. To understand the mechanism, we surveyed site managers and conducted further analysis by leveraging variations in on-site generation costs. Our results indicate that the rebound effect prevailed when sites adopted renewable energy with low ongoing costs. For corporations expanding renewable energy usage, we offer evidence of additional energy efficiency benefits, but capitalizing on these benefits requires careful consideration of the procurement approach. For policymakers, we provide guidance on prioritizing certain procurement methods to accelerate progress toward net-zero. This paper was accepted by Jay Swaminathan, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02165 .
10.1287/mnsc.2023.02165.abstract_zh: 自2015年以来，全球在提高能源效率方面的进展一直落后于联合国可持续发展目标设定的目标，部分原因在于此类改进面临的行为障碍。可再生能源应用的增加可能通过提高或降低这些障碍来影响能源效率的改进。有充分文献记载的回弹效应——即可再生能源应用可能增加能源消耗——可能阻碍效率提升，而可再生能源应用也可能提高对能源使用的认识，从而推动效率改进。本文考察了可再生能源应用是否以及如何影响能源效率改进。利用2015年至2020年间一家跨国工业集团183个场址的数据，我们估计了可再生能源使用量及采购方式的变化对能源效率改进的影响。研究发现，使用可再生能源满足场址额外10%的能源需求，带来了2.8%至6.1%的额外能源效率改进。然而，这种影响因采购方式的不同而存在显著差异。采购场外可再生能源促进了能源效率改进，而安装场内可再生能源发电设施则要么没有效果，要么产生负面影响。为理解其机制，我们对场址管理者进行了调查，并利用场内发电成本的差异进行了进一步分析。结果表明，当场址采用运营成本较低的可再生能源时，回弹效应占据主导。对于扩大可再生能源使用的企业，我们提供了额外能源效率效益的证据，但利用这些效益需要仔细考虑采购方式。对于政策制定者，我们提供了关于优先考虑某些采购方式以加速实现净零目标的指导。本文已被运营管理领域的Jay Swaminathan接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02165获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2023.02165.title: Does Renewable Energy Renew Energy Efficiency?
10.1287/mnsc.2023.02165.title_zh: 可再生能源能否提升能源效率？

10.1287/mnsc.2023.02419.abstract: This paper presents the multinomial logit model with repeated customer interactions. In each period, the same customer selects a product from the recommended assortment or opts out. From the seller’s perspective, the choice probability in the current period is updated based on the purchase history of the customer. We derive this conditional choice probability and study the adaptive assortment recommendation strategy. Although the problem is generally intractable, we discover the structures of the optimal assortment when the customer interacts with the seller for two periods and the available products to recommend are identical in the two periods. For a general number of periods, we find that the optimal fixed assortments that are not adapted to the purchase history can achieve 50% of the optimal expected revenue, and the approximation ratio increases to 68.47% when the available products across periods are disjoint. Using real-world data sets, we demonstrate that the model with repeated customer interactions can better predict the purchase behavior and generate higher revenues. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization. Funding: The authors gratefully acknowledge the funding support from Meituan. C. Wang’s research was supported by the National Science Foundation of China [Grants 72495133, 72172104] and China Postdoctoral Science Foundation [Grant 2025M780760]. P. Gao’s research was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72522026, 72201234, and 72192805], Collaborative Research Funding [Grant C6032-21G] of the Hong Kong Research Grants Council, and the Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Mathematical Foundations for Artificial Intelligence [Grant 2023B1212010001]. Y. Wang’s research was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 12371513] and the Major Program of National Fund of Philosophy and Social Science of China [Grant 23&ZD135]. 10.1287/mnsc.2023.02419.abstract_zh: 本文提出了考虑顾客重复交互的多项Logit模型。在每个周期内，同一顾客从推荐的商品集合中选择一件商品或选择退出。从卖方的角度来看，当前周期的选择概率会根据顾客的购买历史进行更新。我们推导了这一条件选择概率，并研究了自适应推荐策略。尽管该问题通常难以处理，但当顾客与卖方互动两个周期且两个周期内可供推荐的商品相同时，我们发现了最优商品集合的结构。对于一般周期数，我们发现不随购买历史调整的最优固定商品集合能够达到最优期望收入的50%，而当各周期可供商品不重叠时，近似比率提高至68.47%。利用真实世界的数据集，我们证明了考虑顾客重复交互的模型能更好地预测购买行为并产生更高的收入。本文由Chung Piaw Teo在优化领域接受。资助：作者感谢美团提供的资金支持。C. Wang的研究得到了国家自然科学基金[批准号72495133、72172104]和中国博士后科学基金[批准号2025M780760]的资助。P. Gao的研究得到了国家自然科学基金[批准号72522026、72201234和72192805]、香港研究资助局合作研究基金[批准号C6032-21G]以及广东省人工智能数学基础重点实验室[批准号2023B1212010001]的资助。Y. Wang的研究得到了国家自然科学基金[批准号12371513]和国家哲学社会科学基金重大项目[批准号23&ZD135]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02419获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2023.02419.title: Assortment Optimization for the Multinomial Logit Model with Repeated Customer Interactions
10.1287/mnsc.2023.02419.title_zh: 重复顾客互动下多项Logit模型的分类优化

10.1287/mnsc.2023.02505.abstract: We develop a simple theory of realized illiquidity, defined as the ratio of realized volatility to trading volume. Building on the widely used price impact measure of Amihud (2002), we introduce the realized Amihud, which significantly improves measurement accuracy. Our theoretical and numerical results show that it robustly captures cumulative intraday price sensitivity to trading, accounting for stochastic volatility, microstructure noise, and information jumps. Empirically, we uncover distinct time-series patterns in realized stock illiquidity—heterogeneous clustering, leverage effects—and show that it predicts short-term returns. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: A. Ranaldo acknowledges financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation [SNSF Grant 182303]. P. Santucci de Magistris also acknowledges the research support of the Project 2 Grant of the Danish Council for Independent Research (IRFD), Social Sciences, No. 8019-00015A, and of the European Union’s - Next Generation EU program through the Italian PRIN 2022 -M4C2, Investment 1.1 - “Monitoring Risks in Financial Markets” – Codice Cineca: 2022NEL482 - CUP: I53D23003410008. D. Lacava acknowledges that part of this research was carried out while he was affiliated with Luiss University, within the project “Financial Modeling under Non-Gaussian Distributions”. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02505 .
10.1287/mnsc.2023.02505.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于已实现非流动性的简洁理论，将其定义为已实现波动率与交易量的比率。基于Amihud（2002）广泛使用的价格冲击度量，我们引入了已实现Amihud指标，显著提升了测量精度。我们的理论和数值结果表明，该指标稳健地捕捉了日内价格对交易的累积敏感性，同时考虑了随机波动率、微观结构噪声和信息跳跃。在实证方面，我们揭示了已实现股票非流动性的独特时间序列模式——异质性聚类、杠杆效应——并展示了其对短期收益的预测能力。本文由Agostino Capponi（金融领域）接受。资金支持：A. Ranaldo感谢瑞士国家科学基金会的资助[项目编号182303]。P. Santucci de Magistris亦感谢丹麦独立研究委员会（IRFD）社会科学领域项目2资助（编号8019-00015A），以及欧盟“下一代欧盟”计划通过意大利PRIN 2022 -M4C2，投资1.1——“金融市场风险监测”——Cineca代码：2022NEL482 - CUP: I53D23003410008提供的支持。D. Lacava感谢部分研究在Luiss大学进行，隶属于“非高斯分布下的金融建模”项目。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02505获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2023.02505.title: Realized Illiquidity

10.1287/mnsc.2023.03696.abstract: Frontline health workers are an indispensable asset in the healthcare ecosystem of low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). They not only provide clinical care to patients but also frequently shoulder nonclinical responsibilities such as inventory management. However, many lack the necessary skills to effectively manage inventories, leading to the pervasive problem of health commodity stock-outs. To address this problem, several LMICs have launched training programs aimed at enhancing the inventory management skills and capabilities of frontline health workers. Leveraging fine-grained data over a five-year period (2015–2019) from approximately 17,000 health facilities across Indonesia—where the public health supply chain operates as a hybrid push–pull model—we evaluate the impact of a large-scale inventory management training program on contraceptive stock-outs. Applying difference-in-differences estimations, we find that the training program is associated with a significant reduction in stock-outs (i.e., 6.52 percentage points, or approximately 30%). Our numerical calculations suggest that the training program prevents, on average, more than 800 unintended pregnancies and saves 4.25 maternal and newborn lives per 100,000 women of reproductive age within the catchment area of a treated health facility. A counterfactual benefit–cost analysis shows that on-site delivery of the training program (i.e., on the job within a health facility) yields operational and public health benefits that significantly exceed those achieved through off-site delivery (i.e., outside the health facility in a classroom). Our research highlights the practicality and scalability of human-capital-focused interventions in improving health commodity availability and public health outcomes in LMICs. This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03696 .
10.1287/mnsc.2023.03696.abstract_zh: 一线卫生工作者是中低收入国家（LMICs）医疗体系中不可或缺的资产。他们不仅为患者提供临床护理，还经常承担非临床职责，如库存管理。然而，许多人缺乏有效管理库存所需的技能，导致卫生产品缺货问题普遍存在。为解决这一问题，多个中低收入国家已启动旨在提升一线卫生工作者库存管理技能与能力的培训项目。利用印度尼西亚约17,000家卫生机构在五年期间（2015-2019年）的细粒度数据——该国的公共卫生供应链采用混合推拉模式——我们评估了一项大规模库存管理培训项目对避孕药具缺货的影响。通过双重差分估计，我们发现该培训项目与缺货率显著下降相关（即下降6.52个百分点，约30%）。我们的数值计算表明，该培训项目平均可预防超过800例意外怀孕，并在受训卫生机构服务区域内，每10万名育龄妇女中挽救4.25名母婴生命。反事实成本效益分析显示，现场实施培训项目（即在卫生机构内进行在职培训）所产生的运营和公共卫生效益显著超过非现场实施（即在卫生机构外的教室环境中进行培训）。我们的研究强调了以人力资本为重点的干预措施在改善中低收入国家卫生产品可及性和公共卫生结果方面的实用性与可扩展性。本文已被Stefan Scholtes在医疗管理领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03696获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2023.03696.title: Training Frontline Health Workers in Low- and Middle-Income Countries to Reduce Contraceptive Stock-Outs: Evidence from Indonesia
10.1287/mnsc.2023.03696.title_zh: 在中低收入国家培训一线卫生工作者以减少避孕药具缺货：来自印度尼西亚的证据

10.1287/mnsc.2023.03801.abstract: We study periodic review perishable inventory systems with a fixed product lifetime, positive replenishment lead times, and a general issuance policy under the average cost criterion. The optimal replenishment policy for such systems is notoriously complex and computationally intractable because of the curse of dimensionality. To address this challenge, we propose a class of projected inventory level (PIL) policies, which maintain a constant expected on-hand inventory level, and compare them with conventional base-stock (BS) policies that maintain a constant inventory position. For both backlogging and lost-sales systems, we show that the best PIL policy is asymptotically optimal with large unit penalty costs for a broad class of unbounded demand distributions. When demand is bounded and the unit penalty cost is sufficiently large, we prove that the best BS policy is optimal under first-in-first-out issuance, whereas the best PIL policy is optimal under last-in-first-out issuance (under certain conditions). Furthermore, we show that both policies are asymptotically optimal as the demand population size grows large, and their optimality gaps diminish exponentially fast in backlogging systems under a broad range of issuance policies. To facilitate computation, we introduce a class of approximate PIL (APIL) policies and extend most theoretical results for PIL to the APIL policy. Numerical results show that both PIL and APIL policies perform very close to optimal and significantly outperform BS policies. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. Funding: X. Gong and H. Yin were partially supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72425008] and the Hong Kong Research Grants Council General Research Fund [Grant CUHK14500120]. J. Bu was partially supported by the Hong Kong Research Grants Council General Research Fund [Grant PolyU15504525]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03801 .
10.1287/mnsc.2023.03801.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有固定产品寿命、正补货提前期以及一般发放策略的周期性审查易腐品库存系统，在平均成本准则下进行探讨。此类系统的最优补货策略因维度灾难而著称，极为复杂且计算上难以处理。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一类投影库存水平（PIL）策略，该策略维持恒定的预期现有库存水平，并将其与维持恒定库存位置的传统基准库存（BS）策略进行比较。对于缺货回补和销售损失两种系统，我们证明在广泛的无界需求分布类别中，最优PIL策略在大单位惩罚成本下具有渐近最优性。当需求有界且单位惩罚成本足够大时，我们证明在先进先出发放规则下最优BS策略为最优，而在后进先出发放规则下（在特定条件下）最优PIL策略为最优。此外，我们表明随着需求总体规模增大，两种策略均具有渐近最优性，且在缺货回补系统中，在广泛的发放策略下，其最优性差距以指数速度缩小。为便于计算，我们引入了一类近似PIL（APIL）策略，并将PIL的大部分理论结果扩展至APIL策略。数值结果表明，PIL和APIL策略的表现均非常接近最优，且显著优于BS策略。本文由Jeannette Song负责运营管理方向接受。资助：X. Gong和H. Yin部分受国家自然科学基金[批准号72425008]及香港研究资助局优配研究金[批准号CUHK14500120]资助。J. Bu部分受香港研究资助局优配研究金[批准号PolyU15504525]资助。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03801获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2023.03801.title: Managing Perishable Inventory Systems with Positive Lead Times: Inventory Position vs. Projected Inventory Level
10.1287/mnsc.2023.03801.title_zh: 正提前期下易逝品库存系统管理：库存位置与预测库存水平

10.1287/mnsc.2023.04203.abstract: Supply uncertainty, characterized by stochastic lead times and random supply quantities, has attracted increasing attention from academia, industries, and governments, particularly in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic. In this paper, we consider the problem of managing lost-sales inventory systems with general supply uncertainty: stochastic lead times and random supplies. Unlike the previous studies, we assume the decision maker has no prior information on the stochastic demand and supply. We propose the first provably effective learning algorithm for inventory management problems with censored demand and supply data under general supply uncertainty. Then, we establish a cumulative regret of [Formula: see text] for this learning algorithm compared with the best constant-order policy, where [Formula: see text] is the upper bound of the random part, and L is the deterministic part of the stochastic lead times. We also conduct numerical experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm. Our approach lies in developing a new framework for transformed convexity. Furthermore, we address the unique challenges of our problem through new techniques, for example, estimating the long-run cost by establishing coupling and concentration results utilizing the system structures. These techniques are also of independent interest. Beyond our problem, our framework provides broad implications for other operations management (OM) problems exhibiting transformed convexity. 10.1287/mnsc.2024.04409.abstract: We examine the decision to become an entrepreneur in the context of online business. Using data on entrepreneurs from a large e-commerce marketplace in China, we find that individuals are more likely to start online businesses after observing the salient success of nearby stores. Leveraging the platform’s store rating system and detailed geographic information in rural China, we show that an upgrade in a local store’s rating leads to a significant increase in new store entries nearby. This effect diminishes with physical distance and intensifies with the salience of the upgrade. However, these entry decisions appear to be suboptimal; entrants driven by local upgrade events underperform in sales and are more likely to exit, especially during downturns in overall market conditions. Our findings are consistent with salience-based theories of decision making, in which individuals overweight highly visible local information. This paper was accepted by Lin William Cong, finance. 10.1287/mnsc.2024.04409.abstract_zh: 我们考察了在网络商业背景下成为创业者的决策。利用中国大型电子商务市场平台上的创业者数据，我们发现个体在观察到附近店铺的显著成功后，更有可能开始线上创业。借助平台的店铺评级系统及中国农村地区的详细地理信息，我们证明，当地一家店铺评级的提升会导致周边新店铺入驻数量显著增加。这一效应随物理距离的增大而减弱，并随评级提升的显著性增强而加剧。然而，这些入驻决策似乎并非最优；受当地评级提升事件驱动的入驻者在销售业绩上表现不佳，且更可能退出市场，尤其是在整体市场环境低迷时期。我们的发现与基于显著性的决策理论相符，即个体过度重视高可见度的本地信息。本文已被金融领域编辑Lin William Cong接受。资助：C. Lin感谢中国国家自然科学基金[项目72192841]及中国香港特别行政区研究资助局[项目T35-710/20-R]的财政支持。S. Liu感谢中国香港特别行政区研究资助局[项目12503324]的财政支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04409获取。

10.1287/mnsc.2024.04439.abstract: This study investigates how the platform’s disintermediation governance policy (i.e., the policy that disciplines complementors and consumers circumventing the platform to transact directly) affects complementors’ product innovation and launching strategies. We leverage a change in the Communication Guideline on Amazon.com (i.e., the focal platform), which prohibits complementors (i.e., sellers) from sending external website links, telephone numbers, and email addresses to buyers in direct messaging, as a policy shock to Amazon complementors. By conducting a difference-in-differences analysis, we find that the governance policy significantly reduces product innovation on the focal platform among complementors with direct selling channels as measured by the number of new products and the innovativeness of new products. These main effects are mitigated by complementor reputation on Amazon and complementor multihoming. Mechanism analyses show that complementors with direct selling channels increase the number of new products launched through those channels after the policy change (i.e., the switching effect). Moreover, complementors tend to strategically switch innovative and high-value products away from the focal platform while leaving less innovative but price-competitive products on it to attract Amazon consumers before diverting to their direct selling channels (i.e., the bait effect). Our results have implications for platform governance policies regarding disintermediation and its impact on complementor product innovation and launch strategies both on and off the focal platform. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Funding: G. Gu gratefully acknowledges research support from the USC Marshall School of Business. 10.1287/mnsc.2024.04439.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了平台的去中介化治理政策（即对绕过平台直接交易的互补者与消费者进行约束的政策）如何影响互补者的产品创新及发布策略。我们利用亚马逊（即焦点平台）《沟通指南》的一次变更作为对亚马逊互补者的政策冲击，该指南禁止互补者（即卖家）在直接消息中向买家发送外部网站链接、电话号码和电子邮件地址。通过双重差分分析，我们发现，该治理政策显著降低了拥有直销渠道的互补者在焦点平台上的产品创新，具体表现为新产品数量及新产品创新性的下降。这些主效应受到互补者在亚马逊上的声誉及互补者多归属行为的缓解。机制分析表明，政策变更后，拥有直销渠道的互补者增加了通过这些渠道发布的新产品数量（即转移效应）。此外，互补者倾向于策略性地将创新性强、高价值的产品从焦点平台转移，而将创新性较低但具有价格竞争力的产品留在平台上，以吸引亚马逊消费者，随后将其引导至直销渠道（即诱饵效应）。我们的研究结果对平台关于去中介化的治理政策及其对互补者在焦点平台内外产品创新和发布策略的影响具有启示意义。本文已被信息系统领域编辑D. J. Wu接受。资助：G. Gu感谢南加州大学马歇尔商学院的研究支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04439获取。

10.1287/mnsc.2024.04499.abstract: Wisdom of crowds estimates can be compromised when some agents’ predictions are systematically biased. A natural remedy is to aggregate predictions from a subset of more accurate agents rather than the entire crowd. I propose cluster weight on advice (CWOA), a novel “two-shot” algorithm to identify a more accurate subgroup in a single-prediction-problem context. CWOA first applies kernel density estimation to identify clusters of similar initial predictions. If multiple clusters emerge—indicating potential heterogeneity in agents’ information—the algorithm proceeds to present a piece of numerical advice (e.g., the group mean) and elicit updated predictions. This enables the calculation of the weight on advice (WOA)—the scaled magnitude of each agent’s belief revision. CWOA then averages the updated predictions within the cluster with the lowest mean WOA. A behavioral model and simulations explain both why and when cluster-level WOA signals accuracy. Better-informed agents—having already incorporated higher-quality information—perceive less corrective value in the advice and therefore, exhibit lower WOA. CWOA does not require agents to know the true biases or the composition of the crowd; a modest relative advantage in perceived estimation bias by better-informed agents may be sufficient, even under misperceptions of variance, advice quality, and psychological biases in advice taking. Empirically, I first test and confirm the model’s key insight in a controlled experimental setting. I then validate CWOA’s performance across multiple preregistered and archival data sets, including a study in which numerical advice comes from artificial intelligence. CWOA consistently outperforms benchmarks, including the state-of-the-art metaprediction-based methods. This paper was accepted by Jack Soll, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04499 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.04499.abstract_zh: 群体智慧估计可能因部分代理的预测存在系统性偏差而受损。一种自然的补救措施是聚合来自更准确代理子集的预测，而非整个群体。本文提出了一种新颖的“两阶段”算法——聚类建议权重法（CWOA），用于在单次预测问题情境中识别更准确的子群体。CWOA首先应用核密度估计来识别相似初始预测的聚类。若出现多个聚类——表明代理信息可能存在异质性——算法随后提供一条数值建议（如群体均值）并征询更新后的预测。这使计算建议权重（WOA）成为可能，即每位代理信念修正的缩放幅度。CWOA随后在平均WOA最低的聚类内对更新后的预测进行平均。行为模型与模拟解释了聚类级WOA为何以及何时能指示准确性。信息更充分的代理——因已纳入更高质量信息——感知到建议的修正价值较低，因此表现出较低的WOA。CWOA不要求代理知晓真实偏差或群体构成；信息更充分的代理在感知估计偏差上具备适度相对优势可能就足够，即使在方差、建议质量及建议采纳中的心理偏差存在误判的情况下亦然。实证方面，我首先在受控实验环境中检验并确认了模型的关键洞见。随后，我在多个预注册及档案数据集中验证了CWOA的表现，包括一项数值建议来自人工智能的研究。CWOA始终优于基准方法，包括基于元预测的最新方法。本文由Jack Soll在行为经济学与决策分析领域接受。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04499获取。

10.1287/mnsc.2024.05042.abstract: Using China’s randomized pre-initial public offering on-site inspection program, we examine the causal effects of proactive public enforcement on the financial reporting quality of initial public offering applicants. Our analysis shows that the program enhances the reporting quality of selected applicants by screening out firms with questionable financial disclosures. More importantly, it generates a significant deterrence effect, discouraging future applicants from submitting low-quality financial reports. However, we also find that public enforcement can lead to the rejection of some firms that may otherwise merit approval. These findings highlight both the benefits and costs of employing public enforcement to improve financial reporting in settings with weak institutional oversight. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Funding: K. Guo acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72302146 and 72132006], the Shanghai Pujiang Program, and the National Social Science Fund of China [Grant 22AZD034]. 10.1287/mnsc.2024.05042.abstract_zh: 利用中国随机性的首次公开募股前现场检查项目，我们考察了主动公共执法对首次公开募股申请人财务报告质量的因果效应。我们的分析表明，该项目通过筛选出财务披露存在问题的企业，提升了被选中申请人的报告质量。更重要的是，它产生了显著的威慑效应，阻止未来申请人提交低质量的财务报告。然而，我们也发现公共执法可能导致一些本应获得批准的企业被拒绝。这些发现凸显了在制度监督薄弱的环境中，利用公共执法改善财务报告所带来的益处与成本。本文被会计学编辑Eric So接受。资金支持：K. Guo感谢国家自然科学基金[批准号72302146和72132006]、上海浦江计划及国家社会科学基金[批准号22AZD034]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05042获取。
