10.1287/mnsc.2024.05424.abstract: The design of online algorithms for matching markets and revenue management settings is usually bound by the assumption that the demand process is formed by a fixed-length sequence of queries with unknown types, each drawn independently. This notion of serial independence implies that the demand of each type, that is, the number of queries of a given type, has low variance and is approximately Poisson distributed. This paper proposes a nonparametric framework for modeling arrival sequences in online stochastic matching that departs from the serial independent assumption. We propose two models, Indep and Correl, that capture different forms of serial correlations by combining a nonparametric distribution for the demand with standard assumptions on the arrival patterns: adversarial or random order. The Indep model can capture arbitrary serial correlations within each customer type but assumes cross-sectional independence across types, whereas the Correl model captures common shocks across customer types. We demonstrate that fluid relaxations, which rely solely on demand expectations, have arbitrarily bad performance guarantees. In contrast, we develop new algorithms that achieve optimal (constant factor) performance guarantees in each model. Our mathematical analysis includes tighter linear programming (LP) relaxations that leverage distribution knowledge and a new lossless randomized LP rounding scheme for Indep. We test our new LP relaxations and rounding scheme in simulations on real and synthetic data and find that they consistently outperform well-established matching algorithms, especially on real data sequences that exhibit greater demand variance. This paper was accepted by Itai Ashlagi, revenue management and market analytics. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05424 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.05424.abstract_zh: 在线匹配市场和收益管理环境中在线算法的设计通常受制于一个假设，即需求过程由一系列固定长度的查询构成，这些查询的类型未知且各自独立抽取。这种序列独立的概念意味着每种类型的需求，即给定类型的查询数量，具有低方差且近似服从泊松分布。本文提出了一种非参数框架，用于建模在线随机匹配中的到达序列，该框架偏离了序列独立的假设。我们提出了两个模型，Indep和Correl，通过将需求的非参数分布与到达模式的标准假设（对抗性或随机顺序）相结合，捕捉不同形式的序列相关性。Indep模型可以捕捉每种客户类型内的任意序列相关性，但假设跨类型截面独立，而Correl模型则捕捉跨客户类型的共同冲击。我们证明，仅依赖需求期望的流体松弛具有任意差的性能保证。相比之下，我们开发了新算法，在每个模型中实现了最优（常数因子）性能保证。我们的数学分析包括利用分布知识的更紧的线性规划（LP）松弛，以及针对Indep的一种新的无损随机LP舍入方案。我们在真实和合成数据上通过模拟测试了我们的新LP松弛和舍入方案，发现它们始终优于成熟的匹配算法，尤其是在表现出更大需求方差的真实数据序列上。本文由Itai Ashlagi接受，属于收益管理和市场分析领域。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05424获取。

10.1287/mnsc.2024.05504.abstract: We examine whether U.S. media sentiment on foreign countries influences domestic investors’ international asset allocation. Using flows to country-specific mutual funds as a proxy for investor demand, we find that negative media sentiment, measured by the interaction of negative tone and media attention given to foreign countries, is strongly associated with reduced investor flows into funds targeting those countries. This relationship is driven, at least in part, by media sentiment that is unrelated to the economic fundamentals of the targeted countries. We employ The Wall Street Journal’s acquisition by News Corp to support the causal interpretation of our findings. Our results highlight the perception-shaping role of media narratives in driving global investment decisions. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Funding: L. Ma acknowledges funding support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72103008]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05504 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.05504.abstract_zh: 我们考察了美国媒体对外国的情绪是否影响国内投资者的国际资产配置。以针对特定国家的共同基金资金流动作为投资者需求的代理指标，我们发现，负面媒体情绪——通过负面语气与对外国媒体关注度的交互作用来衡量——与流向这些国家基金的资金减少密切相关。这一关系至少部分由与目标国家经济基本面无关的媒体情绪所驱动。我们利用《华尔街日报》被新闻集团收购的事件来支持我们发现的因果解释。我们的结果凸显了媒体叙事在塑造认知、推动全球投资决策中的作用。本文被金融学编辑Will Cong接受。资助：L. Ma感谢国家自然科学基金[批准号72103008]的资助支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05504获取。

10.1287/mnsc.2024.06051.abstract: This paper investigates how environmental regulatory uncertainty affects green innovation in polluting firms. The findings suggest that, instead of adopting a passive “wait-and-see” strategy, polluting firms proactively engage in green innovation and R&D activities. To address endogeneity, I employ an instrumental variable approach using political polarization in roll-call votes on environmental and climate issues in the U.S. House of Representatives. I also exploit the proposal of the Affordable Clean Energy rule in 2018 as an exogenous shock in a difference-in-differences framework. The results are consistent with the growth options view of green innovation in polluting firms. Additional evidence suggests that environmental regulatory uncertainty leads to reductions in toxic emissions. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06051 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.06051.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了环境监管不确定性如何影响污染企业的绿色创新。研究发现，污染企业并未采取被动的“观望”策略，而是主动参与绿色创新与研发活动。为应对内生性问题，我采用工具变量方法，利用美国众议院关于环境与气候议题唱名投票中的政治极化作为工具。同时，我利用2018年《清洁能源负担规则》的提议作为外生冲击，在双重差分框架下进行分析。结果与污染企业绿色创新的增长期权观点一致。额外证据表明，环境监管不确定性导致有毒排放减少。本文由金融学编辑Camelia Kuhnen接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06051获取。

10.1287/mnsc.2024.06147.abstract: We return to the theoretical foundations of absorptive capacity and test the idea that personal experience in a field makes it easier for a firm’s inventors to recognize and build upon knowledge in that field from other local firms. We propose a new empirical model of localized knowledge diffusion, which (1) measures a firm’s absorptive capacity by its inventors’ prior experience in a field, (2) uses a death instrument to exogenously vary the availability of knowledge of the same collaborative patent in different regions, and (3) estimates the difference in citation likelihood from all subsequent inventors across both regions as a function of a potentially citing inventor’s prior experience in the field. Consistent with the original theory of absorptive capacity, firms whose inventors have prior experience in a field are more likely to use locally available interpersonal knowledge from other firms; furthermore, this effect declines monotonically with distance. Although the effects strengthen for more recent experience and multidisciplinary knowledge, the greatest benefits accrue to firms in the interaction—those whose inventors have more recent experience and that seek to absorb multidisciplinary knowledge. Interpersonal absorptive capacity within firms does not appear to localize. This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, business strategy. 10.1287/mnsc.2024.06147.abstract_zh: 我们回归吸收能力的理论基础，检验一个观点：个人在某一领域的经验能帮助企业发明者更容易识别并利用该领域来自其他本地企业的知识。我们提出了一种新的本地化知识扩散实证模型，该模型（1）通过发明者在某一领域的先前经验来衡量企业的吸收能力，（2）利用死亡工具来外生地变化同一合作专利在不同地区知识的可用性，以及（3）估计所有后续发明者跨地区引用可能性的差异，作为潜在引用发明者在该领域先前经验的函数。与吸收能力的原始理论一致，发明者在某一领域有先前经验的企业更有可能利用来自其他企业的本地人际知识；此外，这种效应随距离增加而单调递减。虽然对于较近期的经验和跨学科知识，这种效应会增强，但最大的收益归于处于互动中的企业——即那些发明者拥有较新近经验且寻求吸收跨学科知识的企业。企业内部的人际吸收能力似乎并未表现出本地化特征。本文已被商业策略领域的Anita McGahan接受。资助：作者感谢阿尔弗雷德·P·斯隆基金会及国家科学基金会[资助号1360228]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06147获取。

10.1287/mnsc.2024.06147.title_zh: 发明人去世所揭示的吸收能力微观基础

10.1287/mnsc.2024.06339.abstract: Credit card use among college students declined sharply following the enactment of the Credit Card Accountability, Responsibility, and Disclosure Act of 2009. Title 3, Section 304 of the Act specifically restricted the marketing and sale of credit cards on college campuses. Using a difference-in-differences approach that treats incoming freshmen who would have been unaffected by this marketing as the control group, we document an apparent spillover that increased student loan borrowing by 8.4%, and by 14% for less affluent students. A survey of students matched to their administrative records finds evidence of this substitutability between credit cards and student loans; further, it reveals that a lack of financial literacy and knowledge of financial history are correlated with the misallocation of debt between them. Using these combined empirical findings, we develop and calibrate a model of optimal student borrowing to assess the benefits of the spillovers and find the policy increased welfare. A complementary analysis indicates improvements in grade point averages and on-time graduation rates subsequent to the Act. This paper was accepted by John Beshears, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06339 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.06339.abstract_zh: 在2009年《信用卡问责、责任与信息披露法案》实施后，大学生信用卡使用量显著下降。该法案第三章第304条特别限制了信用卡在校园内的营销和销售。采用双重差分方法，将不受此营销影响的新生作为对照组，我们记录到一种明显的溢出效应，即学生贷款借款增加了8.4%，对于经济条件较差的学生则增加了14%。一项将学生调查与其行政记录相匹配的研究发现了信用卡与学生贷款之间这种替代性的证据；此外，该研究还揭示，金融知识匮乏和对财务历史了解不足与两者间债务错配相关。结合这些实证发现，我们开发并校准了一个最优学生借款模型，以评估这些溢出效应的益处，并发现该政策增进了福利。一项补充分析表明，该法案实施后，平均绩点和按时毕业率有所提高。本文由John Beshears在行为经济学与决策分析领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06339获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.06339.title: When Consumer Financial Protection Spills Over: Student Loan Borrowing Under the CARD Act
10.1287/mnsc.2024.06339.title_zh: 当消费者金融保护外溢：《信用卡法案》下的学生贷款借款

10.1287/mnsc.2024.06477.abstract: The United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA)’s 510(k) pathway allows manufacturers to gain medical device approval by demonstrating substantial equivalence to a legally marketed device. However, the inherent ambiguity of this regulatory procedure has been associated with high recall among many devices cleared through this pathway, raising significant safety concerns. In this paper, we develop a combined human-algorithm approach to assist the FDA in improving its 510(k) medical device clearance process by reducing recall risk and regulatory workload. We first develop machine learning methods to estimate the risk of recall of 510(k) medical devices based on the information available at the time of submission. We then propose a data-driven clearance policy that recommends acceptance, rejection, or deferral to FDA’s committees for in-depth evaluation. We conduct an empirical study using a unique data set of over 31,000 submissions that we assembled based on data sources from the FDA and Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services. Compared to the FDA’s current practice, which has a recall rate of 10.3% and a normalized workload measure of 100%, a conservative evaluation of our policy shows a 32.9% improvement in the recall rate and a 40.5% reduction in the workload. Our analyses further suggest annual cost savings of approximately $1.7 billion for the healthcare system driven by avoided replacement costs, which is equivalent to 1.1% of the entire United States annual medical device expenditure. Our findings highlight the value of a holistic and data-driven approach to improve the FDA’s current 510(k) pathway. This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06477 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.06477.abstract_zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的510(k)途径允许制造商通过证明其产品与已合法上市的器械具有实质性等同性来获得医疗器械批准。然而，这一监管程序固有的模糊性与该途径下许多器械的高召回率相关联，引发了重大的安全隐患。本文开发了一种结合人类与算法的综合方法，以协助FDA改进其510(k)医疗器械审批流程，旨在降低召回风险并减轻监管负担。我们首先利用机器学习方法，基于提交时可获得的信息来估计510(k)医疗器械的召回风险。随后，我们提出了一种数据驱动的审批政策，建议接受、拒绝或将产品转交FDA委员会进行深入评估。我们利用从FDA和医疗保险与医疗补助服务中心收集的数据源，构建了一个包含超过31,000份提交的独特数据集，并进行了实证研究。与FDA当前实践（召回率为10.3%，标准化工作量指标为100%）相比，我们政策的保守评估显示召回率改善了32.9%，工作量减少了40.5%。进一步分析表明，通过避免替换成本，每年可为医疗系统节省约17亿美元，这相当于美国全年医疗器械支出的1.1%。我们的研究结果凸显了采用整体性和数据驱动方法改进FDA现行510(k)途径的价值。本文由Stefan Scholtes（医疗管理领域）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06477获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.06477.title: Harmonizing Safety and Speed: A Human-Algorithm Approach to Enhance the FDA’s Medical Device Clearance Policy
10.1287/mnsc.2024.06477.title_zh: 协调安全与速度：人机算法协同优化FDA医疗器械审批政策

10.1287/mnsc.2024.06968.abstract: This paper introduces a novel methodology for analyzing anomalies in conditional asset pricing models with time-varying risk exposures and premia. Our approach extends the conventional two-pass methodology to include both ordinary and weighted least-squares estimation in a conditional setting. We establish closed-form standard errors to statistically dissect anomalies, including a version robust to global misspecification. We introduce a novel R 2 criterion to quantify the joint contribution of large anomaly sets in explaining cross-sectional stock return variations. Our analysis highlights the significant impact of anomalies during economic and financial crises, linking them closely with market conditions. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: This project has received funding from the postdoctoral fellowships programme Beatriu de Pinos, funded by the Secretary of Universities and Research (Government of Catalonia) and by the Horizon 2020 programme of research and innovation of the European Union under the [Marie Sktodowska-Curie Grant Agreement 801370]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06968 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.06968.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法论，用于分析具有时变风险暴露和溢价的条件资产定价模型中的异常现象。我们的方法将传统的两阶段方法论扩展至条件环境下的普通最小二乘与加权最小二乘估计。我们建立了闭式标准误，以统计方式剖析异常现象，包括对全局误设具有稳健性的版本。我们引入了一个新颖的R²准则，用以量化大型异常集合在解释横截面股票收益变动中的联合贡献。我们的分析强调了异常在经济和金融危机期间的重要影响，将其与市场状况紧密联系起来。本文由Kay Giesecke（金融领域）接受。资助：本项目获得了Beatriu de Pinos博士后奖学金计划的资助，该计划由加泰罗尼亚政府大学与研究秘书处以及欧盟Horizon 2020研究与创新计划下的[Marie Sktodowska-Curie Grant Agreement 801370]提供资金。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06968获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.06968.title: Dissecting Anomalies in Conditional Asset Pricing
10.1287/mnsc.2024.06968.title_zh: 分解条件资产定价中的异象

10.1287/mnsc.2024.07050.abstract: Gender-anonymous hiring practices have been widely advocated as a means to reduce labor market inequalities, such as the gender wage gap and the underrepresentation of women in leadership. However, their effectiveness remains debated. This paper studies an experimental labor market where employee candidates set their own performance targets for a real-effort task and employers hire based on these self-set targets. In many professional settings, such targets serve as performance indicators and influence hiring and promotion decisions. In an online experiment with 4,674 participants, we vary in a 2 × 2 design (1) whether employers know the candidates’ genders and (2) the severity of the payoff consequences if the hired employee misses their target. This allows us to examine the interaction effects of gender anonymity in hiring and the performance target’s payoff relevance. We find that given equal ability, women set lower targets than men. Higher targets increase the likelihood of being hired, whereas a larger expected target-performance gap reduces hiring chances, particularly when missing the target has severe consequences for the employer. Importantly, our findings suggest that gender-anonymous applications may have unintended consequences. When gender is revealed, employers appear to adjust for gender differences in target setting, expecting a smaller target-performance gap for women than for men. As a result, women are more likely to be hired and receive higher payoffs when their gender is known. These results indicate that gender-anonymous hiring may backfire for women by preventing employers from accounting for behavioral gender differences (e.g., in self-promotion), ultimately reducing women’s hiring prospects. This paper was accepted by Dorothea Kübler, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This work was supported by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) under Germany’s Excellence Strategy [Grant EXC 2126/1–390838866]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07050 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.07050.abstract_zh: 性别匿名招聘作为一种减少劳动力市场不平等（如性别工资差距和女性在领导层中代表性不足）的手段已被广泛提倡。然而，其有效性仍存在争议。本文研究了一个实验性劳动力市场，其中求职者为自己设定真实努力任务的绩效目标，雇主根据这些自设目标进行招聘。在许多专业环境中，此类目标作为绩效指标，影响招聘和晋升决策。在一项包含4，674名参与者的在线实验中，我们采用2×2设计，变化（1）雇主是否知晓求职者的性别，以及（2）若被雇佣员工未达目标时薪酬后果的严重程度。这使我们能够考察招聘中性别匿名性与绩效目标薪酬相关性的交互效应。我们发现，在能力相同的情况下，女性设定的目标低于男性。更高的目标增加被雇佣的可能性，而更大的预期目标-绩效差距则降低雇佣机会，尤其是当未达目标对雇主产生严重后果时。重要的是，我们的发现表明，性别匿名申请可能产生意想不到的后果。当性别被揭示时，雇主似乎会调整对性别差异的考量，预期女性比男性有更小的目标-绩效差距。因此，当性别已知时，女性更有可能被雇佣并获得更高的薪酬。这些结果表明，性别匿名招聘可能对女性产生反效果，因为它阻止了雇主考虑行为上的性别差异（例如，在自我推销方面），最终降低了女性的就业前景。本文由Dorothea Kübler在行为经济学与决策分析领域接受。资助：本研究由德国研究联合会（DFG，德国研究基金会）在德国卓越战略下资助[Grant EXC 2126/1–390838866]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07050获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.07050.title: The Impact of Gender Information on Hiring Decisions Based on Self-Set Performance Targets
10.1287/mnsc.2024.07050.title_zh: 性别信息对基于自设绩效目标的招聘决策的影响

10.1287/mnsc.2024.07450.abstract: Explainable artificial intelligence (AI) models have been proposed to mitigate overreliance and underreliance on AI, which reduce the effectiveness of human-AI collaborative tools. Yet, empirical evidence is mixed, and the impact of explainable AI on the cognitive effort and fatigue of a decision maker (DM) is often overlooked. This paper offers a theoretical perspective on these issues. We develop an analytical model that incorporates the defining features of human and machine intelligence, capturing the limited but flexible nature of human cognition with imperfect machine recommendations. Crucially, we represent how AI-based explanations influence the DM’s belief in the algorithm’s predictive quality. Our results indicate that explainable AI has varying effects depending on the level of explainability provided. Although low explainability levels have no impact on decision accuracy and reliance behavior, they lessen the cognitive burden on the DM. In contrast, higher explainability levels enhance accuracy by improving overreliance but at the expense of increased underreliance. Further, the relative impact of explainability is higher when the DM is more cognitively constrained, when the decision task is sufficiently complex, or when the stakes are lower. Importantly, higher explainability levels can escalate the DM’s cognitive burden (and hence, overall processing time and fatigue) precisely when explanations are most needed (i.e., when the DM is pressed for time to complete a complex task and doubts the machine’s quality). Our study clarifies how explainability affects decision outcomes and cognitive effort, informing the design of effective human-AI systems across decision environments. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07450 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.07450.abstract_zh: 可解释人工智能（AI）模型已被提出，以缓解对AI的过度依赖和依赖不足问题，这些问题削弱了人机协作工具的有效性。然而，实证证据不一，且可解释AI对决策者认知努力和疲劳的影响常被忽视。本文从理论视角探讨这些问题。我们构建了一个分析模型，融合了人类智能与机器智能的定义性特征，捕捉了人类认知的有限但灵活特性，并结合了不完美的机器建议。关键的是，我们刻画了基于AI的解释如何影响决策者对算法预测质量的信念。我们的结果表明，可解释AI的效果因提供的可解释性水平而异。尽管低可解释性水平对决策准确性和依赖行为无影响，但它们减轻了决策者的认知负担。相反，较高的可解释性水平通过改善过度依赖来提升准确性，但代价是增加了依赖不足。此外，当决策者认知受限更严重、决策任务足够复杂或风险较低时，可解释性的相对影响更大。重要的是，较高的可解释性水平恰恰在解释最被需要时（即决策者时间紧迫需完成复杂任务且怀疑机器质量时）可能加剧决策者的认知负担（从而增加整体处理时间和疲劳）。我们的研究阐明了可解释性如何影响决策结果和认知努力，为在不同决策环境中设计有效的人机系统提供了指导。本文被运营管理领域的Jeannette Song接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07450获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.07450.title: Beyond the Black Box: Unraveling the Role of Explainability in Human-Artificial Intelligence Collaboration
10.1287/mnsc.2024.07450.title_zh: 超越黑箱：解析可解释性在人机协作中的作用

10.1287/mnsc.2024.07615.abstract: We examine the value of skilled immigrants in finance by exploiting evidence from visa lotteries. We find that hedge fund management companies that secure more H-1B visas in random lotteries deliver higher alphas, Sharpe ratios, and information ratios. The superior performance of funds with high H-1B visa allocations can be attributed to well-paid and highly educated H-1B workers with quantitative skills. H-1B workers add value by helping hedge funds develop distinctive investment strategies, arbitrage prominent stock anomalies, and overcome capacity constraints. Hedge funds appear to exploit labor market frictions as alpha generation is greatest by workers from countries with the longest wait times for U.S. permanent residency. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07615 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.07615.abstract_zh: 我们利用签证抽签的证据，考察了金融领域技术移民的价值。研究发现，在随机抽签中获得更多H-1B签证的对冲基金管理公司，其阿尔法、夏普比率和信息比率均更高。高H-1B签证配额基金的卓越表现可归因于具备量化技能、高薪且高学历的H-1B员工。H-1B员工通过帮助对冲基金开发独特投资策略、套利显著股票异象以及克服容量限制来增加价值。对冲基金似乎利用了劳动力市场摩擦，因为来自美国永久居留等待时间最长国家的员工所产生的阿尔法最大。本文已被金融领域的Lukas Schmid接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07615获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.07615.title: Immigrants in Finance: Evidence from Hedge Funds
10.1287/mnsc.2024.07615.title_zh: 金融领域的移民：来自对冲基金的证据

10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930.abstract: We document that interactions with manipulated clinical decision support (CDS) systems can induce not only short-term, but also long-term changes in physicians’ opioid prescribing behavior. Physicians in our sample adopted electronic health record software from a list of federally certified vendors in 2011. Between 2016 and Spring 2019, one vendor secretly embedded a biased CDS function designed to promote extended-release opioid sales. Affected physicians not only increased opioid claims relative to the control group during the treatment window, but also maintained a higher propensity to prescribe opioids, even after the biased function was removed. This long-term behavioral change persisted even after affected physicians moved to new locations, changed their affiliations, or faced stricter state-level opioid regulations. Increasing physician awareness helped mitigate this impact. Using machine-learning algorithms, we estimate that decision-making distortion accounts for approximately 54% of the treatment effects in a physician decision model with dynamic learning. This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930.abstract_zh: 我们记录到，与受操纵的临床决策支持（CDS）系统的交互不仅会引发医生阿片类药物处方行为的短期变化，还会导致长期改变。在我们的样本中，医生于2011年从联邦认证供应商名单中采用了电子健康记录软件。在2016年至2019年春季期间，一家供应商秘密嵌入了一个旨在促进缓释阿片类药物销售的偏倚CDS功能。受影响的医生不仅在治疗窗口期内相对于对照组增加了阿片类药物索赔，而且在偏倚功能被移除后，仍保持较高的阿片类药物处方倾向。这种长期行为变化甚至在受影响的医生迁往新地点、更换隶属关系或面临更严格的州级阿片类药物监管后依然持续。提高医生的认知有助于缓解这一影响。利用机器学习算法，我们估计在具有动态学习的医生决策模型中，决策扭曲约占治疗效应的54%。本文被信息系统领域的Hemant Bhargava接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930.title: The Impact of Manipulated Clinical Decision Support Algorithm on Opioid Prescribing Decision
10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930.title_zh: 操纵性临床决策支持算法对阿片类药物处方决策的影响

10.1287/mnsc.2024.08235.abstract: Randomized experiments have become the standard method for companies to evaluate the performance of new products or services. Beyond aiding managerial decision making, experiments mitigate risk by limiting the proportion of customers exposed to innovations. Because many experiments are conducted sequentially over time, an emerging strategy to further derisk the process is to allow managers to “peek” at the results as new data become available and stop the test if the results are statistically significant. The class of statistical methods that allow managers to peek and still provide valid inference are often called anytime valid because they maintain proper uniform type 1 error guarantees. In this paper, we extend existing anytime-valid approaches to accommodate the more complex yet standard settings in time series, switchback, and panel experiments. To achieve this, we leverage the design-based approach to focus on assumption-light and managerially relevant finite-sample estimands defined on the study participants as a direct measure of the risks incurred by companies. As a special case, our (asymptotic) results also provide a robust method for achieving always-valid inference in A/B tests. We further provide a variance reduction technique incorporating modeling assumptions and covariates. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach through a simulation study and three real-world applications from Netflix. Our results show that using our confidence sequence, harmful experiments could be stopped after observing only a handful of units; for instance, our method would have stopped a 30,000-person Netflix experiment after the first 100 people. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08235 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08235.abstract_zh: 随机化实验已成为企业评估新产品或服务性能的标准方法。除了辅助管理决策外，实验通过限制暴露于创新中的客户比例来降低风险。由于许多实验随时间顺序进行，一种进一步降低过程风险的新兴策略是允许管理者在新数据可用时“窥视”结果，并在结果统计显著时停止测试。允许管理者窥视且仍能提供有效推断的统计方法类别通常被称为随时有效，因为它们保持了适当的均匀第一类错误保证。在本文中，我们将现有的随时有效方法扩展到更复杂但标准的场景，包括时间序列、切换和面板实验。为实现这一目标，我们利用基于设计的方法，聚焦于定义在研究参与者上的轻假设且与管理相关的有限样本估计量，作为公司所承担风险的直接度量。作为特例，我们的（渐近）结果也为A/B测试中实现始终有效推断提供了一种稳健方法。我们进一步提供了一种结合建模假设和协变量的方差缩减技术。最后，我们通过模拟研究和来自Netflix的三个实际应用证明了所提方法的有效性。我们的结果表明，使用我们的置信序列，有害实验可以在仅观察少量单元后停止；例如，我们的方法本可以在前100人后停止一个30,000人的Netflix实验。本文被J. George Shanthikumar接受，数据科学领域。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08235获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08235.title: Design-Based Confidence Sequences: A General Approach to Risk Mitigation in Panel Experiments
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08235.title_zh: 基于设计的置信序列：面板实验中风险缓解的一种通用方法

10.1287/mnsc.2024.08306.abstract: We study randomized experiments in a service system when stochastic congestion can arise from temporarily limited supply or excess demand. Such congestion gives rise to cross-unit interference between the waiting customers, and analytic strategies that do not account for this interference may be biased. In current practice, one of the most widely used ways to address stochastic congestion is to use switchback experiments that turn a target intervention on and off for the whole system in alternation. We find, however, that under a queueing model for stochastic congestion, the standard way of analyzing switchbacks is inefficient and that estimators that leverage the queueing model can be materially more accurate. Additionally, we show how the queueing model enables estimation of total policy gradients from unit-level randomized experiments, thus giving practitioners an alternative experimental approach they can use without needing to precommit to a fixed switchback length before data collection. This paper was accepted by Vivek Farias, data science. Funding: This work was supported by the ONR [Grant N000142412091]. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08306 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08306.abstract_zh: 我们研究在服务系统中，当随机拥塞可能源于暂时性供应不足或需求过剩时进行的随机实验。这种拥塞导致等待顾客之间存在跨单元干扰，而未考虑此干扰的分析策略可能产生偏差。当前实践中，应对随机拥塞最广泛使用的方法之一是切换实验，即对整个系统交替开启和关闭目标干预措施。然而，我们发现，在随机拥塞的排队模型下，标准的切换分析方式效率较低，而利用排队模型的估计器能显著提高准确性。此外，我们展示了排队模型如何从单元级随机实验中估计总政策梯度，从而为实践者提供一种替代实验方法，无需在数据收集前预先设定固定的切换长度。本文被Vivek Farias接受，数据科学领域。资助：本研究由ONR [Grant N000142412091]支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08306 获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08306.title: Experimenting Under Stochastic Congestion
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08306.title_zh: 随机拥堵下的实验研究

10.1287/mnsc.2024.08333.abstract: We find that shifts toward more liberal (i.e., less probusiness) courts predict reductions in local small business activity. A one-standard-deviation increase in liberal ideology predicts a 1% reduction in firm count relative to bordering counties in different federal court jurisdictions. This effect has more than doubled since 2000 and is particularly pronounced in circuit-years with elevated small business–related federal cases or public attention to the legal environment. The effect manifests predominantly through the exit of young firms, not firm relocations, and coincides with a shift away from litigation-sensitive industries. In summary, we provide the first evidence that small businesses consider judicial ideology, and the accompanying variation in expected litigation costs, when deciding whether or where to operate. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08333 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08333.abstract_zh: 我们发现，转向更自由（即较少亲商）的法院预测地方小企业活动减少。自由派意识形态每增加一个标准差，相对于不同联邦法院辖区内的相邻县，企业数量预计减少1%。这一效应自2000年以来已翻倍以上，在涉及小企业相关联邦案件或法律环境受到公众关注度较高的巡回法院年份中尤为显著。该效应主要通过年轻企业的退出显现，而非企业迁移，并且与诉讼敏感行业的转移同时发生。总之，我们提供了首个证据表明，小企业在决定是否经营或在哪里经营时，会考虑司法意识形态及其伴随的预期诉讼成本变化。本文由金融学编辑Bo Becker接受。补充材料：网络附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08333获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08333.title: Small Business Judging Judges

10.1287/mnsc.2024.08448.abstract: Firms increasingly rely on voluntary training programs to enhance employees’ skills, yet such initiatives often suffer from high dropout rates. We investigate whether providing employees with information about their relative training performance affects their persistence in voluntary training. Social comparison theory suggests that relative performance information (RPI) addresses employees’ inherent need to assess their ability relative to others and maintain a positive self-image by improving their standing. However, whether RPI on training performance is sufficient to increase persistence in voluntary training in the field is unclear. Besides particularly low barriers for dropping out, voluntary training is typically noncore to employees’ primary tasks and often lacks a meaningful comparison group because participants come from a large, heterogeneous, and largely anonymous pool of employees. This calls into question whether the conditions required for social comparison mechanisms are sufficiently met for RPI to take effect. We study this question using a field experiment in a firm offering a voluntary online training program. During the training, employees either receive RPI about their training performance relative to others or only their own performance score. We show that RPI significantly increases employees’ persistence in the training. Consistent with our proposed theoretical mechanism, this effect is particularly pronounced for more competitive individuals. We further find that the likelihood of completing the training is higher and people return to the training quicker if they receive RPI. Our study highlights a simple and cost-effective way to enhance the effectiveness of voluntary training. This paper was accepted by Jan Bouwens, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08448 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08448.abstract_zh: 企业日益依赖自愿性培训项目来提升员工技能，然而此类举措常面临高辍学率的问题。我们探讨了向员工提供其相对培训表现的信息是否会影响他们在自愿培训中的坚持度。社会比较理论认为，相对表现信息（RPI）满足了员工评估自身相对于他人能力的内在需求，并通过提升自身地位来维护积极的自我形象。然而，在实地环境中，关于培训表现的RPI是否足以增强自愿培训的坚持度尚不明确。除了退出的门槛特别低之外，自愿培训通常不是员工主要任务的核心部分，且往往缺乏有意义的比较群体，因为参与者来自一个庞大、异质且基本匿名的员工群体。这引发了疑问：社会比较机制所需的条件是否充分满足，以使RPI发挥作用。我们通过在一家提供自愿在线培训项目的公司进行实地实验来研究这一问题。在培训期间，员工要么收到关于其相对于他人培训表现的RPI，要么仅收到自己的表现分数。我们表明，RPI显著提高了员工在培训中的坚持度。与我们提出的理论机制一致，这一效应在更具竞争性的个体中尤为显著。我们进一步发现，如果员工收到RPI，他们完成培训的可能性更高，并且返回培训的速度更快。我们的研究突显了一种简单且成本效益高的方式来增强自愿培训的有效性。本文被Jan Bouwens（会计学）接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08448获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08448.title: The Impact of Relative Performance Information on Employees’ Persistence in Voluntary Training
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08448.title_zh: 相对绩效信息对员工自愿培训坚持度的影响

10.1287/mnsc.2024.08526.abstract: Theoretical research suggests internal information asymmetry (IIA) between top managers and divisional managers can reduce productivity by distorting internal resource allocation. The net effect, however, is unclear because IIA also reflects valuable private information within divisions, and empirical evidence is limited because of the unobservability of managers’ private information sets. Using a measure of IIA that exploits differences in returns to insider trading by top and divisional managers, we find that higher IIA is associated with lower total factor productivity. A one standard deviation increase in IIA corresponds to a 2.6% decrease in productivity relative to industry peers. This effect is comparable in magnitude to other important internal informational frictions, such as internal control weaknesses, and is distinct from internal information quality. Cross-sectional analyses indicate that the negative association is stronger when curative measures are limited and when agency conflicts between top managers and shareholders are greater. Mechanism tests indicate that IIA reduces internal capital market efficiency and increases underinvestment. Finally, using brokerage mergers and closures as a plausibly exogenous shock, we find that increases in IIA lead to declines in productivity. Overall, we provide empirical evidence that IIA is an economically important determinant of firm-level productivity. This paper was accepted by Jan Bouwens, accounting. Supplemental Material: The code and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08526 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08526.abstract_zh: 理论研究指出，高层管理者与部门管理者之间的内部信息不对称（IIA）可能通过扭曲内部资源配置而降低生产率。然而，由于IIA同时也反映了部门内部有价值的私有信息，其净效应尚不明确，且因管理者私有信息集合的不可观测性，实证证据有限。利用一种基于高层与部门管理者内幕交易收益差异来衡量IIA的指标，我们发现更高的IIA与更低的全要素生产率相关联。IIA每增加一个标准差，相对于行业同行，生产率下降2.6%。这一效应在规模上与内部控制缺陷等其他重要内部信息摩擦相当，并且与内部信息质量有所区别。横截面分析表明，当纠正措施受限以及高层管理者与股东之间的代理冲突加剧时，这种负相关关系更为显著。机制检验显示，IIA降低了内部资本市场效率并加剧了投资不足。最后，利用券商合并与关闭作为准自然实验冲击，我们发现IIA的增加导致生产率下降。总体而言，我们提供了实证证据表明IIA是企业层面生产率的重要经济决定因素。本文已被Jan Bouwens在会计学领域接受。补充材料：代码和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08526获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08526.title: How Important Is Internal Information Asymmetry for Firm-Level Productivity?
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08526.title_zh: 企业内部信息不对称对企业生产率的影响有多重要？

10.1287/mnsc.2024.08851.abstract: We study the equity factor zoo using a duration-matching return-decomposition approach that adjusts factor returns by subtracting returns on duration-matched government bond portfolios. By doing so, we remove the component of factor returns attributable to interest rate movements while preserving shocks to expected growth and risk premia observed in the data. Among commonly used factors, the value, investment, and profitability premia increase after duration matching, while the market and size premia decrease, over the post-1981 sample period. Furthermore, the effect of duration matching on mean factor returns depends importantly on the interest rate environment, consistent with our return decomposition framework. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08851 .
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08851.abstract_zh: 我们采用期限匹配的收益分解方法研究股票因子动物园，该方法通过减去期限匹配的政府债券组合收益来调整因子收益。通过这一处理，我们剔除了因子收益中归因于利率变动的部分，同时保留了数据中观察到的预期增长与风险溢价冲击。在常用因子中，价值、投资和盈利溢价在期限匹配后有所增加，而市场与规模溢价在1981年后的样本期内则有所下降。此外，期限匹配对平均因子收益的影响在很大程度上取决于利率环境，这与我们的收益分解框架相一致。本文已被Kay Giesecke（金融领域）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08851获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08851.title: The Factor Multiverse: The Role of Interest Rates in Factor Return Measurement
10.1287/mnsc.2024.08851.title_zh: 因子多元宇宙：利率在因子收益度量中的作用

10.1287/mnsc.2025.00201.abstract: Traders devote significant resources to producing private information. The value of such information is eroded when it is leaked. We study the use of multiple brokers by institutions to help mitigate information leakage. We document that trades using multiple brokers better predict future returns and have higher future profits, consistent with information possessed by investors driving the decision to use multiple brokers. We find that trades using multiple brokers are more informed and, yet, have lower price impacts, lower implementation shortfalls, and fewer follower trades than similar single-broker trades. The results suggest that traders use multiple brokers to successfully reduce information leakage. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00201 .
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00201.abstract_zh: 交易者投入大量资源以生成私有信息。此类信息的价值在泄露时便会受损。我们研究了机构使用多家经纪商以帮助减轻信息泄露的情况。我们记录到，使用多家经纪商的交易能更好地预测未来收益，并带来更高的未来利润，这与投资者所掌握的信息驱动其选择多家经纪商的决定相一致。我们发现，使用多家经纪商的交易更具信息含量，然而，与相似的单经纪商交易相比，其价格影响更低、执行缺口更小，且跟随交易者更少。这些结果表明，交易者利用多家经纪商成功减少了信息泄露。本文由Camelia Kuhnen（金融领域）接受。补充材料：网络附录及数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00201 获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00201.title: Preventing Information Leakage

10.1287/mnsc.2025.00480.abstract: People and organizations often set goals to self-motivate and achieve better outcomes in challenging tasks. But goals—and their effectiveness—might depend on what people expect to happen. Do goals reflect expectations, or do goals set expectations? How do goals and expectations affect performance? These distinctions are important for motivation and intervention design. We run an online real-effort task to answer these two questions by introducing exogenous variation in goals and expectations. First, we find that goals mostly reflect existing expectations rather than set expectations. Second, practicing an easier version of a task leads to higher expectations and higher performance. Third, eliciting a goal also leads to higher average performance, and changing the goal level has local effects that pull people toward the goal. However, revising goals has little effect on average performance. Our findings imply that increasing expectations is an important motivating tool that increases goals and performance. Having any goal helps performance; however, people cannot fool themselves into expecting and doing more simply by choosing a different goal. This paper was accepted by John Beshears, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: Financial support from the University of California San Diego Academic Senate and the Willard Graham Research Fund at Chicago Booth is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00480 .
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00480.abstract_zh: 人们和组织常常设定目标以自我激励，在具有挑战性的任务中取得更好的成果。但目标及其有效性可能取决于人们对未来的预期。目标是反映预期，还是设定预期？目标与预期如何影响绩效？这些区分对于激励和干预设计至关重要。我们通过在线实际努力任务，引入目标和预期的外生变化，来回答这两个问题。首先，我们发现目标主要反映现有预期，而非设定预期。其次，练习任务的简易版本会提高预期和绩效。第三，设定目标也会提高平均绩效，且改变目标水平具有局部效应，将人们拉向目标。然而，修订目标对平均绩效影响甚微。我们的发现表明，提高预期是重要的激励工具，能提升目标和绩效。拥有任何目标都有助于绩效；然而，人们无法仅通过选择不同目标而自欺欺人地期待并做得更多。本文被行为经济学与决策分析领域的John Beshears接受。资金支持：感谢加州大学圣地亚哥分校学术评议会和芝加哥布斯商学院威拉德·格雷厄姆研究基金的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00480获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00480.title: Goals, Expectations, and Performance

10.1287/mnsc.2025.00611.abstract: We present one of the first systematic audits of cryptocurrency market data quality across leading vendors. We document pervasive mislabeling, identifier instability, and large cross-provider discrepancies in prices, market caps, and volumes. To address these issues, we develop an aggregation method that yields asymptotically correct data by autonomously identifying and filtering unreliable observations. Using this framework, we construct an index to measure data quality over time and a grading system to benchmark providers. Our findings show that data inconsistencies can materially distort empirical research and investment analysis. They highlight possible oversight gaps in the market for crypto data. This paper was accepted by Will Cong for the Special Issue on Digital Finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00611 .
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00611.abstract_zh: 我们对领先供应商的加密货币市场数据质量进行了首批系统性审计之一。我们记录了普遍存在的标签错误、标识符不稳定以及价格、市值和成交量方面的跨供应商巨大差异。为解决这些问题，我们开发了一种聚合方法，通过自主识别并过滤不可靠观测值，生成渐近正确的数据。利用这一框架，我们构建了一个衡量数据质量随时间变化的指数，以及一个用于基准评估供应商的分级系统。我们的研究结果表明，数据不一致可能实质性扭曲实证研究和投资分析。它们突显了加密数据市场中可能存在的监管空白。本文由Will Cong为数字金融特刊接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00611获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00611.title: Aggregate Confusion in Crypto Market Data
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00611.title_zh: 加密货币市场数据中的总体混淆

10.1287/mnsc.2025.00669.abstract: We investigate the heritability of risk, uncertainty, and time preferences using a large-scale field experiment with adult twins, complemented by a comprehensive meta-analysis of prior studies. Our research introduces a novel empirical approach that integrates behavioral genetics with structural econometrics, enabling us to directly quantify the heritability of latent preference parameters in behavioral models of decision making, without relying on observed proxies. Our incentive-compatible experiment is the first to simultaneously elicit all three types of preferences within the same individuals in a twin study. Our findings reveal a stronger genetic influence on risk and uncertainty preferences than previously reported. We demonstrate that conventional proxy measures for preferences and simplified structural models tend to overstate the influence of unique environmental factors. These results help contextualize preference heterogeneity as a driver of persistent differences in decision making across individuals, leaders, and organizations. This paper was accepted by Aurélien Baillon, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: Support from the University of Technology Sydney and from the Australian Government through the Australian Research Council’s Centre of Excellence for Children and Families over the Life Course [Project IDs CE140100027 and CE200100025] is gratefully acknowledged. This research was facilitated through access to Twins Research Australia, a national resource supported by the National Health & Medical Research Council since 1981, administered by the University of Melbourne. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00669 .
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00669.abstract_zh: 我们利用一项针对成年双胞胎的大规模实地实验，结合对先前研究的全面元分析，探讨了风险偏好、不确定性偏好和时间偏好的遗传性。我们的研究引入了一种新颖的实证方法，将行为遗传学与结构计量经济学相结合，使我们能够直接量化行为决策模型中潜在偏好参数的遗传性，而无需依赖观察到的代理指标。我们的激励相容实验是首个在同卵双胞胎研究中同时引出所有三种偏好的实验。我们的发现表明，风险与不确定性偏好的遗传影响比先前报道的更强。我们证明，传统的偏好代理测量方法和简化结构模型往往高估了独特环境因素的影响。这些结果有助于将偏好异质性作为个体、领导者和组织间决策持久差异的驱动因素进行情境化理解。本文已被行为经济学与决策分析领域的编辑Aurélien Baillon接受。资金支持：感谢悉尼科技大学和澳大利亚政府通过澳大利亚研究委员会“儿童与家庭生命周期卓越中心”项目（项目编号CE140100027和CE200100025）提供的支持。本研究得以进行得益于澳大利亚双胞胎研究资源的访问，该资源自1981年以来由澳大利亚国家健康与医学研究委员会支持，由墨尔本大学管理。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00669获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00669.title: An Analysis of Heritability in Preferences Using Behavioral Models of Decision Making
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00669.title_zh: 基于决策行为模型对偏好遗传度的分析

10.1287/mnsc.2025.00761.abstract: In online markets, consumers tend to search and purchase prominently positioned products. We develop an experimental paradigm to distinguish between two mechanisms driving this behavior: position-specific search costs and beliefs about expected returns to search. Using incentivized experiments, we find that both mechanisms exist, and short-term randomization of rankings alone does not separate the two mechanisms. Failing to account for beliefs leads to biased estimates of search costs and incorrect consumer welfare predictions under alternative recommendation systems, such as platform self-preferencing. We discuss solutions for estimating unbiased search costs in real-world search settings. This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing. Funding: This work was supported by the UC Berkeley Fisher Center for Business Analytics. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00761 .
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00761.abstract_zh: 在网络市场中，消费者倾向于搜索并购买位于显著位置的商品。我们设计了一种实验范式，以区分驱动这一行为的两种机制：位置特定的搜索成本与对搜索预期回报的信念。通过激励性实验，我们发现这两种机制均存在，且仅靠排名的短期随机化无法将二者区分开来。若未能考虑信念因素，将导致对搜索成本的估计产生偏差，并在替代推荐系统（如平台自我偏好）下得出错误的消费者福利预测。我们探讨了在现实搜索环境中估计无偏搜索成本的解决方案。本文已被Raphael Thomadsen接受，市场营销领域。资助：本研究由加州大学伯克利分校费雪商业分析中心支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00761 获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00761.title: Consumer Inferences from Product Rankings: The Role of Beliefs in Search Behavior
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00761.title_zh: 消费者对产品排名的推断：信念在搜索行为中的作用

10.1287/mnsc.2025.00782.abstract: When designing product rankings, online retailers and platforms choose which outcome to maximize: revenues from commissions or markups, the number of transactions, or consumer welfare. These objectives need not align, creating potential trade-offs. This paper studies how rankings differ between objectives and quantifies the resulting trade-offs. I provide descriptive evidence showing that lower-priced and high-utility alternatives gain more demand when ranked higher, suggesting that ranking them higher increases transactions and consumer welfare but may decrease revenues. To quantify these trade-offs, I develop and estimate a structural demand model in which consumers search and discover products, and construct rankings for each objective. The results show that these counterfactual rankings all increase consumer welfare, transactions, and platform revenues relative to a neutral benchmark and the status quo and that trade-offs between these rankings are limited. This paper was accepted by Jean-Pierre Dube, marketing. Funding: R. P. Greminger received financial support from the Nederlandse Organisatie voor Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek [Research Talent Grant 406.18.568]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00782 .
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00782.abstract_zh: 在设计产品排名时，在线零售商和平台需选择最大化何种目标：来自佣金或加价的收入、交易数量，或是消费者福利。这些目标未必一致，从而可能产生权衡取舍。本文研究了不同目标下排名如何差异，并量化由此产生的权衡。我提供的描述性证据表明，价格更低且效用更高的替代品在被排名更高时会获得更多需求，这表明将其排名提高会增加交易量和消费者福利，但可能减少收入。为量化这些权衡，我开发并估计了一个结构性需求模型，其中消费者进行搜索并发现产品，同时为每个目标构建排名。结果显示，相对于中性基准和现状，这些反事实排名均能提升消费者福利、交易量及平台收入，且这些排名之间的权衡有限。本文已被营销领域的Jean-Pierre Dube接受。资助：R. P. Greminger获得了荷兰科学研究组织的研究人才资助[编号406.18.568]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00782获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00782.title: Trade-Offs Between Ranking Objectives: Descriptive Evidence and Structural Estimation
10.1287/mnsc.2025.00782.title_zh: 排名目标之间的权衡：描述性证据与结构估计

10.1287/mnsc.2025.01277.abstract: Organizations increasingly face polarized beliefs about issues such as sustainability and environmental action. This paper demonstrates that such polarization can, paradoxically, be leveraged as a managerial advantage. When individuals’ subjective beliefs diverge from market probabilities, organizations can design state-specific payouts, where bonuses or refunds are tied to verifiable future outcomes. Under such schemes, individuals receive larger payouts in the states they overestimate relative to market probabilities. This increases an initiative’s subjective expected value without affecting its objective expected cost. Across multiple large-scale experiments spanning corporate and public contexts, state-specific payouts substantially increase support for contested initiatives, particularly among individuals whose beliefs deviate from market probabilities. Additional studies explore ethical and practical boundaries. Together, the results introduce a principle of belief-based design. By applying insights from financial engineering to managerial decision making, organizations can align incentives with heterogeneous beliefs and transform polarization from a barrier into a strategic asset. This paper was accepted by Aurelien Baillon, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01277 .
10.1287/mnsc.2025.01277.abstract_zh: 组织日益面临关于可持续性和环境行动等问题上的两极分化信念。本文证明，这种极化现象反而可以被转化为管理上的优势。当个体的主观信念与市场概率相偏离时，组织可以设计状态特定的支付方案，其中奖金或退款与可验证的未来结果挂钩。在此类方案下，个体在其相对于市场概率高估的状态下将获得更大的支付。这增加了某项倡议的主观预期价值，而不影响其客观预期成本。在涵盖企业及公共情境的多项大规模实验中，状态特定支付显著提升了对争议性倡议的支持度，尤其是在那些信念偏离市场概率的个体中。进一步的研究探讨了伦理与实践的边界。综合来看，这些结果引入了一项基于信念的设计原则。通过将金融工程的见解应用于管理决策，组织能够使激励机制与异质性信念相协调，将极化从障碍转变为战略资产。本文由Aurelien Baillon接受，涉及行为经济学与决策分析。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01277 获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2025.01277.title: Beating Expectations: Turning Polarized Beliefs into Support for Sustainable Initiatives
10.1287/mnsc.2025.01277.title_zh: 超越预期：将极化信念转化为对可持续倡议的支持

10.1287/mnsc.2025.02111.abstract: Research on discrimination has predominantly relied on audit studies, which provide clean causal estimates through randomized profile testing but offer only static snapshots of bias. We adopt a dynamic perspective to examine how racial discrimination evolves over time. Using observational panel data from an online educational platform, we first find that African-American teachers receive 30.2% fewer bookings, and their opened classes are 3.3% less likely to be booked compared with their White counterparts during their first week on the platform, a gap that may indicate initial discrimination. Employing individual fixed effects models, we estimate how this gap evolves over time. The results show a striking 1,007% widening of the initial gap over the 12-week period. Our mechanism analysis shows that new students are significantly less likely to book classes with African-American teachers than with White teachers, even when African-American and White teachers have minimal or comparable reputation metrics. As a result, African-American teachers accumulate reputation metrics and customers more slowly than White teachers. Over time, the growing gaps in reputation and customer base further exacerbate the booking gap, driven by both new and repeat students. Our findings suggest that traditional audit studies may significantly underestimate the long-term consequences of early-stage discrimination and highlight how reputation and repeat customer accumulation serve as bias amplifiers on online platforms. We also show that this amplification mechanism operates regardless of whether the initial gap stems from racial discrimination and thus generalizes to other contexts. This paper was accepted by Srikanth Jagabathula, market design, platform, and demand analytics. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02111 .
10.1287/mnsc.2025.02111.abstract_zh: 关于歧视的研究主要依赖于审计研究，这种方法通过随机化档案测试提供了干净的因果估计，但仅能捕捉到偏见的静态快照。我们采用动态视角来考察种族歧视如何随时间演变。利用来自在线教育平台的观测面板数据，我们首先发现，非洲裔美国教师在平台上的第一周内，其预约次数比白人教师少30.2%，且其开设的课程被预订的可能性低3.3%，这一差距可能表明初始歧视的存在。通过使用个体固定效应模型，我们估计了这一差距随时间的变化情况。结果显示，在12周期间，初始差距惊人地扩大了1007%。我们的机制分析表明，新学生显著更不可能预订非洲裔美国教师的课程，而非白人教师的课程，即使当非洲裔美国教师和白人教师拥有最小或相当的信誉指标时也是如此。因此，非洲裔美国教师积累信誉指标和客户的速度慢于白人教师。随着时间推移，信誉和客户基础的日益扩大差距进一步加剧了预订差距，这既受到新学生也受到重复学生的影响。我们的研究结果表明，传统的审计研究可能显著低估了早期歧视的长期后果，并强调了信誉和重复客户积累如何作为在线平台上的偏见放大器。我们还表明，无论初始差距是否源于种族歧视，这种放大机制都会运作，因此可推广至其他情境。本文已被Srikanth Jagabathula接受，涉及市场设计、平台和需求分析。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02111获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2025.02111.title: Evolution of Discrimination on Online Platforms

10.1287/mnsc.2025.02314.abstract: The future architecture of financial systems is a subject of contention, with centralized and decentralized governance proponents. Here, we ask the following question. Would the architecture affect the quality of decision making? We propose a game where financial network participants demarcate the ownership of claims to income. This governance task can be decentralized (shared authority), centralized (single authority), or hybrid (alternating authority). Without communication, all architectures supported poor outcomes. With communication, decentralization ensured good governance and maximum profits, whereas centralization did not—lowering communication’s potency in promoting socially optimal decisions. This indicates that there is scope for decentralization in innovating financial institutions. This paper has been accepted by Camelia Kuhnen for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance. Funding: N. Chemaya acknowledges partial financial support from the NET Institute. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02314 .
10.1287/mnsc.2025.02314.abstract_zh: 金融体系的未来架构是一个争议性话题，支持者分别主张集中治理与分散治理。在此，我们提出以下问题：架构是否会影响决策质量？我们构建了一个博弈模型，其中金融网络参与者界定对收入索取权的归属。这一治理任务可以采取分散化（共享权威）、集中化（单一权威）或混合型（交替权威）形式。在没有沟通的情况下，所有架构均导致不良结果。而在存在沟通时，分散化确保了良好治理并实现利润最大化，而集中化则未能如此——削弱了沟通在促进社会最优决策方面的效力。这表明，在金融制度创新中，分散化具有潜在空间。本文已被Camelia Kuhnen接受，收录于数字金融虚拟特刊。资助信息：N. Chemaya感谢NET研究所的部分财务支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02314 获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2025.02314.title: Centralization vs. Decentralization: First Evidence from the Laboratory
10.1287/mnsc.2025.02314.title_zh: 集中化与分散化：来自实验室的首个证据

10.1287/mnsc.2025.02735.abstract: By extracting information from economic news articles, this paper proposes a novel measure of narrative-based ambiguity that captures investors’ attitudes toward narrative uncertainty and exhibits strong in- and out-of-sample predictive power for the stock market returns. It reveals general ambiguity aversion except in high loss probability scenarios in which ambiguity tolerance emerges. Further tests confirm the significant pricing power and distinct information of the narrative ambiguity on top of existing ambiguity measures, such as survey- and return-based ambiguity. By aligning industry-specific narrative ambiguity, we construct a superior predictor for market returns with the predictability predominantly driven by the ambiguity from consumption-, energy-, and technology-related sectors. Our findings also carry broad implications as the predictability remains significant across international markets and other asset classes. This paper has been accepted by Will Cong for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance. Funding: Q. Zhang acknowledges research support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72573098], the National Natural Science Foundation of China Excellent Young Researcher Project [Grant 72222013], and the National Key R&D Program of China [Grant 2023YFA1009200]. X. Wei acknowledges research support from the Capital University of Economics and Business Scientific Research Project [Grant XRZ2025010]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02735 .
10.1287/mnsc.2025.02735.abstract_zh: 本文通过从经济新闻文章中提取信息，提出了一种基于叙事的新颖不确定性度量方法，该方法捕捉了投资者对叙事不确定性的态度，并对股票市场回报展现出强大的样本内和样本外预测能力。研究揭示了普遍的不确定性规避现象，但在高损失概率情境下则表现出不确定性容忍。进一步测试证实，在现有不确定性度量（如基于调查和基于回报的不确定性）之上，叙事不确定性具有显著的定价能力和独特信息。通过整合行业特定的叙事不确定性，我们构建了一个更优的市场回报预测指标，其预测能力主要由消费、能源和技术相关行业的不确定性驱动。我们的发现还具有广泛意义，因为这种预测能力在国际市场和其他资产类别中依然显著。本文已被Will Cong接受，用于数字金融虚拟特刊。资助：Q. Zhang感谢国家自然科学基金[批准号72573098]、国家自然科学基金优秀青年科学基金项目[批准号72222013]及国家重点研发计划[批准号2023YFA1009200]的研究支持。X. Wei感谢首都经济贸易大学科研项目[批准号XRZ2025010]的研究支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02735获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2025.02735.title: Narrative Ambiguity Matters

10.1287/mnsc.2025.03120.abstract: We study the impact of inventory constraints on bundling in a dynamic pricing setting, challenging the classical view that bundling consistently enhances revenue. Traditional bundling theory, which typically assumes abundant inventory and static pricing, often asserts that bundling generates higher revenue than selling products individually. However, we show that limited inventory, in fact, distorts the revenue-extraction capability of bundling, favoring the sale of products or services separately. We study the optimal dynamic mixed bundling strategy in a large market regime where the market size grows relative to limited inventory. Leveraging this framework, we derive optimal dynamic pricing policies and value functions for commonly used bundling strategies, including mixed bundling, pure bundling, bundle size pricing, and component pricing. Our analysis reveals that as inventory becomes more constrained relative to market size, the optimal dynamic mixed bundling strategy converges to a dynamic component pricing strategy, outperforming both dynamic bundle size pricing and dynamic pure bundling. Moreover, the performance gap between these strategies increases with the number of items, a factor typically viewed as favoring bundling when inventory is abundant. Notably, our numerical experiments reveal that these structural insights extend to policies derived from the standard fluid regime. As the market size grows relative to the inventory, the dynamic mixed bundling policy obtained by resolving the deterministic fluid problem also reduces to a dynamic component pricing policy. This paper was accepted by Karan Girotra, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03120 .
10.1287/mnsc.2025.03120.abstract_zh: 我们研究了动态定价环境中库存约束对捆绑销售的影响，挑战了捆绑销售总能提升收入的传统观点。传统捆绑理论通常假设库存充裕且定价静态，常主张捆绑销售比单独销售产品能带来更高收入。然而，我们表明，有限的库存实际上扭曲了捆绑销售的收益提取能力，反而有利于产品或服务的单独销售。我们研究了市场规模相对于有限库存增长的大市场机制下的最优动态混合捆绑策略。利用这一框架，我们推导了常用捆绑策略的最优动态定价策略和价值函数，包括混合捆绑、纯捆绑、捆绑规模定价和组件定价。我们的分析揭示，随着库存相对于市场规模变得更加受限，最优动态混合捆绑策略收敛于动态组件定价策略，其表现优于动态捆绑规模定价和动态纯捆绑。此外，这些策略之间的绩效差距随项目数量增加而扩大，而这一因素在库存充裕时通常被视为有利于捆绑销售。值得注意的是，我们的数值实验表明，这些结构性见解也适用于从标准流体机制推导出的策略。随着市场规模相对于库存增长，通过求解确定性流体问题获得的动态混合捆绑策略同样简化为动态组件定价策略。本文由Karan Girotra接受发表于运营管理领域。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03120获取。
10.1287/mnsc.2025.03120.title: The Diminishing Value of Bundling Under Inventory Scarcity
10.1287/mnsc.2025.03120.title_zh: 库存稀缺下捆绑销售的递减价值

10.1287/mnsc.2025.03520.abstract: In prior publications, we introduced a global system of interconnected E-ledgers that produces—in as close to real time as practicable—accurate, comparable, and verifiable accounts of the cradle-to-gate (net) greenhouse gas emissions in any product or service that transacts in the economy. In this paper, we delve more deeply into the accounting infrastructure required for the E-ledgers system, including the specific journal entries for recording E-liabilities and E-assets. We explain how the E-ledgers of different entities in the economy articulate with each other and how they connect with jurisdictional E-ledgers that record emissions from end consumers. These entity and jurisdictional E-ledgers can be aggregated into a geological master ledger that tracks anthropogenic GHG emissions and removals, as debits and credits, to a geological carbon equity account. We also provide summary insights from computational technology and pilot studies to guide rapid and cost-effective E-ledgers deployment at scale. This paper was accepted by Shiva Rajgopal, accounting. Funding: Funding for R. S. Kaplan’s research was provided by Harvard Business School. K. Ramanna receives a salary from Oxford University. The authors are co-founders of E-ledgers Institute, a nonprofit organization, which seeks to implement the E-ledgers carbon accounting method in practice.
10.1287/mnsc.2025.03520.abstract_zh: 在先前的研究中，我们介绍了一个全球互联的电子分类账系统，该系统能够尽可能接近实时地生成经济中任何产品或服务从摇篮到大门（净）温室气体排放的准确、可比且可验证的账目。本文更深入地探讨了电子分类账系统所需的会计基础设施，包括记录环境负债和环境资产的特定日记账分录。我们解释了经济中不同实体的电子分类账如何相互衔接，以及它们如何与记录终端消费者排放的辖区电子分类账相连接。这些实体和辖区的电子分类账可以汇总成一个地质总分类账，以借方和贷方的形式追踪人为温室气体排放与清除，并计入地质碳权益账户。我们还提供了计算技术和试点研究的总结性见解，以指导大规模快速且成本效益高的电子分类账部署。本文由会计领域的Shiva Rajgopal接受。资金支持：R. S. Kaplan的研究由哈佛商学院提供资金支持。K. Ramanna从牛津大学领取薪水。作者是电子分类账研究所（一个非营利组织）的共同创始人，该组织旨在实践中推行电子分类账碳会计方法。
10.1287/mnsc.2025.03520.title: E-ledgers Carbon Accounting

10.1287/mnsc.2026.00184.abstract: Adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) by authors has accelerated production of academic articles and increased submission rates to journals, thereby straining review capacity and hurting journal outcome metrics, such as turnaround time and decision accuracy. Academic journals face an imperative to improve review quality and productivity by incorporating generative AI tools in the review workflow. As a concrete first step toward this idea, we outline a particular workflow that deploys large language models as a structured, trained, frontline reviewer. The workflow underlines that AI-produced evaluations must be transparent and contestable by authors. We emphasize the need for AI-infused peer review to be journal specific, designed for efficiency, accuracy, and accountability, within a human-in-the-loop oversight framework. We build a mathematical model of journal operations to compare outcomes under a status quo no-AI workflow and the proposed AI-infused workflow. The model captures how governed AI reconfigures human reviewer effort and illuminates conditions under which the AI-infused workflow can improve vital metrics, such as turnaround time and decision accuracy. Our essential point is that journals need to adopt a deliberate and institutionally governed approach for using AI in the review process. We recognize that identifying an “optimal” AI-infused peer review workflow or even definitively projecting the consequences of one will require substantial experimentation to calibrate and configure the workflow across multiple alternative designs. This discussion was accepted by Christoph Loch. Funding: D. Zantedeschi acknowledges support for this research from the Muma College of Business Dean’s Research Fund. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2026.00184 .
10.1287/mnsc.2026.00184.abstract_zh: 作者采用人工智能（AI）加速了学术论文的生产，提高了期刊投稿率，从而对审稿能力造成压力，并损害了期刊的成果指标，如周转时间和决策准确性。学术期刊面临迫切需求，通过将生成式AI工具整合进审稿流程中，以提升审稿质量和效率。作为实现这一构想的具体第一步，我们概述了一种特定工作流程，该流程部署大型语言模型作为结构化、经过训练的前线审稿人。该工作流程强调，AI生成的评价必须对作者透明且可质疑。我们强调，AI辅助的同行评审需针对期刊特定设计，旨在实现效率、准确性和问责制，并在人机协同监督框架内运作。我们构建了一个期刊运营的数学模型，以比较现状无AI工作流程与所提出的AI融合工作流程下的结果。该模型捕捉了受治理的AI如何重新配置人类审稿人的努力，并阐明了AI融合工作流程在何种条件下能改善关键指标，如周转时间和决策准确性。我们的核心观点是，期刊需要在审稿过程中采用一种审慎且机构治理的方法来使用AI。我们认识到，确定“最优”的AI融合同行评审工作流程，甚至明确预测其后果，都需要大量实验来校准和配置多种替代设计下的工作流程。本讨论由Christoph Loch接受。资助：D. Zantedeschi感谢Muma商学院院长研究基金对本研究的支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2026.00184获取。

10.1287/mnsc.2026.02441.abstract: This commentary responds to “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship” [Bhargava HK, Bana S, Zhang Z, Brandimarte L, Choudary V, Li F, Loupos P, Zantedeschi D (2026) Fighting fire with fire: Infusing AI into peer review to sustain quality scholarship. Management Sci. Forthcoming.]. It shares the paper’s core position, that journals should govern artificial intelligence openly rather than leave it to the shadows, but it questions the premise that rising submission volume poses an existential threat. The safeguard is human judgment. Our shared fatigue with derivative, repetitive work is a sensor more discerning than any AI detector, because a model trained on what we have already rewarded cannot produce the novelty that our community prizes. The threat to a journal like Management Science is thus more contained than the original alarm implies, provided AI remains a non-final input and humans retain ownership of novelty and contribution. One test should govern any AI workflow: does it ask more of human judgment, or less? This commentary was accepted by Christoph Loch.
10.1287/mnsc.2026.02441.abstract_zh: 本评论回应了“以火攻火：将人工智能注入同行评审以维持高质量学术”一文[Bhargava HK, Bana S, Zhang Z, Brandimarte L, Choudary V, Li F, Loupos P, Zantedeschi D (2026) 以火攻火：将人工智能注入同行评审以维持高质量学术。《管理科学》即将出版]。本文赞同该文的核心立场，即期刊应公开治理人工智能，而非任其在暗处运作，但对其关于投稿量上升构成生存威胁的前提提出质疑。保障在于人类判断力。我们对重复性、衍生性工作的共同倦怠，是一种比任何人工智能检测器都更敏锐的传感器，因为基于我们已奖励内容训练的模型无法产生我们学术界所珍视的新颖性。因此，对《管理科学》这类期刊的威胁比原文所暗示的更为有限，前提是人工智能仍作为非最终输入，而人类保留对新颖性和贡献的所有权。任何人工智能工作流程都应遵循一项检验标准：它是对人类判断力的要求更高，还是更低？本评论由克里斯托夫·洛赫接受。
10.1287/mnsc.2026.02441.title: The Sound We Haven’t Heard Before: A Commentary on “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship”
10.1287/mnsc.2026.02441.title_zh: 我们未曾听过的声音：评“以火攻火：将人工智能融入同行评审以维持学术质量

10.1287/mnsc.2026.02442.abstract: This commentary responds to “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship” [Bhargava et al. (2026) Management Sci. Forthcoming.]. It supports the paper’s call for a governed approach to the use of AI in peer review. It argues that the key issue is not whether AI will enter peer review, but whether its use will remain informal and hidden or become transparent, auditable, and institutionally accountable. While endorsing journal-managed AI review as a response to the problem of “shadow AI,” the comment highlights several implementation risks, including AI hallucination, human accountability, authors’ perceptions of procedural dignity, and the evolving boundary between structured assessment and value judgment. It concludes that AI-assisted peer review should be treated as an important starting point for continued experimentation and refinement. This commentary was accepted by Christoph Loch.
10.1287/mnsc.2026.02442.abstract_zh: 本评论回应了“以火攻火：将人工智能注入同行评审以维持学术质量”一文[Bhargava等（2026）《管理科学》，即将发表]。评论支持该文关于在同行评审中采用受治理方式使用人工智能的呼吁，并指出关键问题并非人工智能是否会介入同行评审，而是其使用将保持非正式且隐蔽，还是变得透明、可审计且具有机构问责性。在赞同期刊管理式人工智能评审作为应对“影子人工智能”问题的同时，本评论强调了若干实施风险，包括人工智能幻觉、人类问责、作者对程序尊严的感知，以及结构化评估与价值判断之间不断演变的界限。评论最后指出，人工智能辅助同行评审应被视为持续实验与改进的重要起点。本评论由克里斯托夫·洛赫接受。
10.1287/mnsc.2026.02442.title: From Shadow AI to Governed AI Review: A Commentary on “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship”
10.1287/mnsc.2026.02442.title_zh: 从影子人工智能到受治理的人工智能评审：对“以火攻火：将人工智能融入同行评审以维持学术质量”的评论

10.1287/mnsc.2026.02443.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly being proposed as a tool to improve the efficiency of academic peer review. While such applications may alleviate reviewer shortages and enhance productivity, they largely preserve the existing architecture of scientific publishing. In this commentary I propose that AI also creates an opportunity to reimagine more fundamental aspects of how knowledge is evaluated and disseminated. Drawing on concepts from operations management and innovation, I propose disruptive alternatives that challenge the underlying design of the current process. Rather than simply helping referees review papers faster, AI may enable new models of scientific communication that are more open, timely, and adaptive to the needs of modern scholarship. This commentary was accepted by Christoph Loch.
10.1287/mnsc.2026.02443.abstract_zh: 人工智能正日益被提出作为提升学术同行评审效率的工具。尽管此类应用可能缓解审稿人短缺问题并提高生产力，但它们大体上保留了科学出版现有的架构。在这篇评论中，我提出人工智能也创造了机会，重新构想知识评估与传播中更为根本的方面。借鉴运营管理与创新的概念，我提出了颠覆性的替代方案，挑战当前流程的基本设计。与其仅仅帮助审稿人更快地审阅论文，人工智能或许能促成新的科学交流模式，这些模式更加开放、及时，并能适应现代学术的需求。本评论由克里斯托夫·洛赫接受发表。

10.1525/curh.1950.18.101.1.abstract: This paper examines the political consequences of introducing the welfare state targeted at blue-collar workers in 19th-century Germany. I conceptualize Bismarck’s reform as an accommodation strategy to combat the socialist party as an emerging challenger party. The result of a difference-in-differences design shows that the socialist party benefited in elections due to the reform. The mechanism analysis points to the socialists’ issue ownership by adopting a stronger reformist stance. The results are not driven by other political and economic channels related to the reform.
10.1525/curh.1950.18.101.1.abstract_zh: 本文考察了19世纪德国针对蓝领工人引入福利国家的政治后果。我将俾斯麦的改革概念化为一种调和策略，旨在对抗作为新兴挑战党的社会主义政党。双重差分设计的结果显示，社会主义政党因该改革在选举中受益。机制分析指出，社会主义者通过采取更为改良主义的立场，获得了议题所有权。这些结果并非由与改革相关的其他政治和经济渠道所驱动。

10.1596/1813-9450-11196.abstract: This paper provides insights into human capital investments during wartime by presenting evidence from 3 experiments of an online tutoring program for Ukrainian students amid Russia's invasion. Conducted between 2023 and 2024, the experiments reached 10,000 students across Ukraine. The program offered 3 hours per week of small-group tutoring in math and Ukrainian language over 6 weeks, and used academic and psychosocial tools to address student challenges at different intensities of disruption. Results show that the program led to substantial improvements in learning—0.49 standard deviations in math and 0.40 standard deviations in Ukrainian language—and consistent reductions in stress—0.12 standard deviations. High take-up and engagement rates were observed, and 4 mechanisms were identified as drivers of impact: structured peer interactions, improved attitudes toward learning, enhanced socio-emotional skills, and increased student investments. A complementary experiment using information nudges highlights challenges in promoting parental investments in a conflict setting. The program was cost-effective, with benefit-to-cost ratios ranging from 31-56, and scalable given its reliance on existing infrastructure and capacity.
10.1596/1813-9450-11196.abstract_zh: 本文通过介绍俄罗斯入侵期间针对乌克兰学生的在线辅导项目的三项实验证据，揭示了战时人力资本投资的深层机制。实验于2023至2024年间开展，覆盖乌克兰各地10,000名学生。该项目每周提供3小时、为期6周的小组辅导（数学与乌克兰语），并运用学术与心理社会工具应对不同强度干扰下的学生困境。结果显示：项目显著提升了学业表现——数学成绩提高0.49个标准差，乌克兰语成绩提高0.40个标准差——同时持续降低压力水平（0.12个标准差）。研究观察到较高的参与率与投入度，并识别出四种驱动机制：结构化同伴互动、学习态度改善、社会情感技能提升及学生投资增加。一项采用信息助推的补充实验揭示了冲突情境下促进家长投资的挑战。该项目具有成本效益，收益成本比介于31至56之间，且依托现有基础设施与能力具备可扩展性。

10.1596/1813-9450-11385.abstract: This paper studies the interaction of the contribution-benefit link with tax evasion in the context of parental benefits in Hungary and Latvia. Across the two countries, institutional settings, and time periods, earnings and employment patterns suggest substantial pre-pregnancy underreporting, followed by partial formalization during pregnancy to increase benefits. Using policy reforms, the paper shows that the reporting response tracks changing incentives. The results indicate that even with third-party reporting, income underreporting can be common. Linking benefits to contributions when earnings are underreported may reduce evasion temporarily but can impose net fiscal costs depending on program design.
10.1596/1813-9450-11385.abstract_zh: 本文研究了匈牙利和拉脱维亚育儿福利背景下，缴费-福利关联与逃税行为的相互作用。在两国的制度环境与时间跨度中，收入与就业模式显示，孕前存在大量低报收入现象，而孕期则出现部分正规化以增加福利。通过政策改革分析，本文证明申报行为随激励变化而调整。结果表明，即便存在第三方报告机制，收入低报仍可能普遍存在。当收入被低报时，将福利与缴费挂钩虽能暂时减少逃税，但根据项目设计不同，可能产生净财政成本。

10.1596/1813-9450-11408.abstract: This study analyzes the impact of the Romania Secondary Education Project, which was designed to improve student retention, graduation rates and pass rates on a national end-of-high-school exam for low-achievement high schools in Romania. The program was implemented in three waves, September 2017, September 2018, and September 2020, with eligible high schools randomly assigned to each. The study exploits this staggered implementation to measure the project’s causal impacts on students. The estimates indicate that the Romania Secondary Education Project had no significant impact on (i) student preferences for attending a program high school, (ii) student retention rates, (iii) high school graduation rates, (iv) enrollment in the post-high school baccalaureate exam, (v) baccalaureate exam pass rates, or (vi) baccalaureate exam scores. There was a small increase in girls’ passing rates (3 percentage points). However, there was little heterogeneity in the null effects by grant size, urban-rural status, student achievement levels, town income levels, and type of curriculum taught.
10.1596/1813-9450-11408.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了罗马尼亚中等教育项目的影响，该项目旨在提高罗马尼亚低学业表现高中的学生保留率、毕业率及全国高中毕业会考的通过率。该项目分三批实施（2017年9月、2018年9月和2020年9月），符合条件的高中被随机分配到各批次。研究利用这种分阶段实施机制来测量项目对学生的因果效应。估计结果表明，罗马尼亚中等教育项目对以下指标均无显著影响：（i）学生对就读项目高中的偏好，（ii）学生保留率，（iii）高中毕业率，（iv）高中后学士学位考试注册率，（v）学士学位考试通过率，以及（vi）学士学位考试成绩。女生通过率略有提升（3个百分点）。然而，按补助金额、城乡状况、学生学业水平、城镇收入水平及课程类型划分的零效应异质性极小。
