10.2139/ssrn.4293615.abstract: we develop an analytical and a quantitative model of the vehicle fleet. Analysis of these models suggests that tighter exhaust standards increase social welfare and that increasing registration fees on dirty vehicles yields even larger gains by accelerating scrap, though both reforms have complex effects on inequality.
10.2139/ssrn.4293615.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于车辆 fleet 的分析模型与定量模型。对这些模型的分析表明，更严格的排放标准能提升社会福利，而对高污染车辆提高注册费则通过加速报废带来更大的收益，尽管这两项改革对不平等状况的影响颇为复杂。
10.2139/ssrn.4293615.title: Regulating Untaxable Externalities: Are Vehicle Air Pollution Standards Effective and Efficient?
10.2139/ssrn.4293615.title_zh: 规制不可征税的外部性：车辆空气污染标准是否有效且高效？

10.2139/ssrn.4364830.abstract: We study a model of popular demand for anti-elite populist reforms that drain the swamp: replace experienced public servants with novices that will only acquire experience with time. Voters benefit from experienced public servants because they are more effective at delivering public goods and more competent at detecting emergency threats. However, public servants’ policy preferences do not always align with those of voters. This tradeoff produces two key forces in our model: public servants’ incompetence spurs disagreement between them and voters, and their effectiveness grants them more power to dictate policy. Both of these effects fuel mistrust between voters and public servants, sometimes inducing voters to drain the swamp in cycles of anti-elite populism. We study which factors can sustain a responsive democracy or induce a technocracy. When instead populism arises, we discuss which reforms may reduce the frequency of populist cycles, including recruiting of public servants and isolating them from politics. Our results support the view that a more inclusive and representative bureaucracy protects against anti-elite populism. We provide empirical evidence that lack of trust in public servants is a key force behind support for anti-elite populist parties and argue that our model helps explain the rise of anti-elite populism in large robust democracies.
10.2139/ssrn.4364830.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种反精英民粹主义改革的大众需求模型，该改革旨在“排干沼泽”：用缺乏经验的新人替换经验丰富的公务员，而这些新人将随时间积累经验。选民受益于经验丰富的公务员，因为他们能更有效地提供公共产品，并更胜任识别紧急威胁。然而，公务员的政策偏好并不总是与选民一致。这种权衡在我们的模型中产生了两种关键力量：公务员的无能加剧了他们与选民之间的分歧，而他们的有效性则赋予他们更多主导政策的权力。这两种效应都加剧了选民与公务员之间的不信任，有时会诱使选民以反精英民粹主义的周期循环“排干沼泽”。我们研究了哪些因素能够维持回应型民主或催生技术官僚体制。当民粹主义出现时，我们讨论了哪些改革可能减少民粹主义周期的频率，包括公务员的招募以及使其与政治隔离。我们的结果支持以下观点：更具包容性和代表性的官僚体系能够抵御反精英民粹主义。我们提供了实证证据，表明对公务员缺乏信任是支持反精英民粹主义政党的关键力量，并论证我们的模型有助于解释大型稳健民主国家中反精英民粹主义的兴起。
10.2139/ssrn.4364830.title: Drain the Swamp: A Theory of Anti-Elite Populism
10.2139/ssrn.4364830.title_zh: 排干沼泽：反精英民粹主义理论

10.2139/ssrn.4428283.abstract: Under collusion, firms deviate from current profit maximization in anticipation of future rewards. As current profit maximization places little restrictions on firms' pricing behaviour, collusive conduct is hard to infer. Under collusion -- however -- firms' behaviour should instantaneously respond to the anticipation of future changes in their ability to sustain it. We show that bids from certain firms in the Colombian wholesale electricity market collapsed immediately after the announcement, and before the implementation, of a reform that potentially made collusion harder to sustain. A forensic analysis uncovers a type of coordinated behaviour among cartel members that likely required explicit communication and provides suggestive evidence that such communication might have occurred. A quantification exercise supports the reduced-form evidence on collusion and quantifies its costs. Dynamic enforcement constraints should be taken seriously by policy-makers fighting collusion.
10.2139/ssrn.4428283.abstract_zh: 在合谋状态下，企业会为预期未来收益而偏离当前利润最大化行为。由于当前利润最大化对企业定价行为的约束极小，合谋行为难以被推断。然而，在合谋状态下，企业行为应当会即时响应其对未来维持合谋能力变化的预期。我们研究发现，哥伦比亚批发电力市场中某些企业的报价，在一项可能削弱合谋可持续性的改革方案宣布后、实施前，便立即出现暴跌。法证分析揭示了卡特尔成员间一种很可能需要显性沟通的协调行为，并提供了此类沟通可能存在的暗示性证据。量化分析支持了关于合谋的简约形式证据，并估算了其成本。反合谋政策制定者应严肃对待动态执行约束问题。
10.2139/ssrn.4428283.title: Relational Collusion in the Colombian Electricity Market
10.2139/ssrn.4428283.title_zh: 哥伦比亚电力市场中的关系性合谋

10.2139/ssrn.4440716.abstract: This paper studies the economic impacts of carbon pricing. Exploiting institutional features of the European carbon market and high-frequency data, I identify carbon policy shocks and trace their dynamic effects. A restrictive carbon policy shock raises energy prices, reduces emissions, spurs green innovation, but decreases economic activity—disproportionately burdening poorer households. Not only are the poor more affected because of their higher energy spending, but they also experience larger income losses. These indirect, general-equilibrium effects via income and employment play an important role in the transmission of carbon pricing policies, accounting for about two-thirds of the aggregate consumption response.
10.2139/ssrn.4440716.abstract_zh: 本文研究了碳定价的经济影响。利用欧洲碳市场的制度特征和高频数据，我识别了碳政策冲击并追踪其动态效应。紧缩性碳政策冲击推高能源价格，减少排放，激发绿色创新，但同时也降低了经济活动——不成比例地加重了贫困家庭的负担。贫困家庭不仅因能源支出占比更高而受影响更大，还面临更大的收入损失。这些通过收入和就业渠道传导的间接一般均衡效应，在碳定价政策的传导机制中扮演重要角色，约占总体消费反应的三分之二。
10.2139/ssrn.4440716.title: The Unequal Economic Consequences of Carbon Pricing
10.2139/ssrn.4440716.title_zh: 碳定价的不平等经济后果

10.2139/ssrn.4541374.abstract: We show that during the period of the Public Sector Purchase Program (PSPP) implemented by the Eurosystem, the prices of German sovereign bonds targeted by the PSPP increase predictably towards month-end and drop subsequently. We propose a sequential search-bargaining model that captures salient features of the implementation of the PSPP such as the commitment to buy within an explicit time horizon. The model can explain the predictable pattern as a result of imperfect competition between dealers that are counterparties to the Eurosystem. Motivated by the model’s predictions, we show that the price pattern is more pronounced (a) for bonds that are targeted by the PSPP, (b) for monthly windows where the Eurosystem has fewer counterparties, and (c) for monthly windows where the Eurosystem targets a larger amount of purchases. We discuss the implications of our analysis for future purchase programs. *We thank ECB and Bundesbank market operations and risk management colleagues and seminar participants at the European Central Bank for helpful comments. The views expressed are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect those of the Eurosystem.
10.2139/ssrn.4541374.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在欧洲系统实施的公共部门购买计划（PSPP）期间，PSPP目标德国主权债券的价格会在月末可预测地上涨，随后下跌。我们提出了一个序贯搜索-议价模型，该模型捕捉了PSPP实施的关键特征，例如在明确时间范围内承诺购买。该模型能够解释这一可预测模式，其根源在于作为欧洲系统交易对手的交易商之间的不完全竞争。基于模型预测，我们进一步证明，价格模式在以下情况下更为显著：（a）针对PSPP目标债券，（b）在欧洲系统交易对手较少的月度窗口期，以及（c）在欧洲系统目标购买量较大的月度窗口期。我们讨论了分析对未来购买计划的启示。*感谢欧洲央行和德国央行市场操作与风险管理部门的同事，以及欧洲央行研讨会的参与者提供的宝贵意见。本文观点仅代表作者本人，并不必然反映欧洲系统的立场。
10.2139/ssrn.4541374.title: Is the Bond Market Competitive? Evidence from the ECB's Asset Purchase Program
10.2139/ssrn.4541374.title_zh: 债券市场是竞争性的吗？来自欧洲央行资产购买计划的证据

10.2139/ssrn.4584974.abstract: This paper examines the impact of economic sanctions on the choice of invoicing currencies in international trade, focusing on the sanctions imposed on Russia following its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. Using transaction-level data on Russia’s imports from 2016 to 2023, we document a significant shift away from US dollar (USD) invoicing toward increased use of the Chinese renminbi (CNY), particularly in trade with China and other neutral economies. By the second half of 2023, the CNY accounted for over a third of Russia’s import value, up from less than 4 percent in 2021. Employing a difference-in-difference approach, we identify several mechanisms driving this shift: geopolitical alignment, financial infrastructure such as currency swap lines with the People’s Bank of China, the threat of secondary sanctions, and rising transaction costs in Western currencies. Strategic complementarities and the exit of Western firms further accelerated this currency switching. Our findings suggest that trade sanctions, beyond reshaping trade flows, also contribute to fragmentation in the international monetary system, with long-term implications for the dominance of the USD in global commerce.
10.2139/ssrn.4584974.abstract_zh: 本文考察了经济制裁对国际贸易中计价货币选择的影响，重点关注2022年2月俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后所遭受的制裁。利用2016年至2023年俄罗斯进口的交易级数据，我们记录了从美元计价向人民币计价显著转变的现象，尤其是在与中国及其他中立经济体的贸易中。到2023年下半年，人民币占俄罗斯进口总额的比重已超过三分之一，而2021年这一比例尚不足4%。通过双重差分方法，我们识别出推动这一转变的若干机制：地缘政治联盟、中国人民银行货币互换等金融基础设施、次级制裁的威胁，以及西方货币交易成本的上升。战略互补性和西方企业的退出进一步加速了这一货币转换。我们的研究结果表明，贸易制裁不仅重塑了贸易流向，还促进了国际货币体系的分裂，对美元在全球商业中的主导地位具有长期影响。

10.2139/ssrn.4647828.abstract: We develop a two-country business-cycle model of the US and the rest of the world with dollar dominance in trade invoicing, in cross-border credit, and in safe assets. The interplay between these elements---dollar trinity---rationalizes salient features of the Global Financial Cycle in the data: When its tide subsides, the dollar appreciates, financial conditions tighten, the world business cycle slows down, and emerging-market central banks face a trade-off between mitigating the recession and dampening price pressures. We find the dollar is no sideshow in this, but central for the transmission of the Global Financial Cycle to the world economy.
10.2139/ssrn.4647828.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含美国与世界其他地区的两国商业周期模型，其中美元在贸易计价、跨境信贷和安全资产领域占据主导地位。这些要素之间的相互作用——美元三位一体——合理化了数据中全球金融周期的显著特征：当美元潮汐退去时，美元升值，金融状况收紧，全球商业周期放缓，新兴市场央行面临缓解经济衰退与抑制价格压力之间的权衡。我们发现，美元在此过程中并非次要因素，而是全球金融周期向世界经济传导的核心环节。
10.2139/ssrn.4647828.title: Dollar Trinity and the Global Financial Cycle
10.2139/ssrn.4647828.title_zh: 美元三位一体与全球金融周期

10.2139/ssrn.4787392.abstract: We estimate that investors systematically overreact to perceptions about multiple fundamental shocks in a macro-dynamic system, generating asymmetric compositional effects when real-world events produce conflicting signals with counteracting market implications. We show that such events can lead the market to underreact to news, even when investors overreact to all shocks.
10.2139/ssrn.4787392.abstract_zh: 我们估计，投资者在宏观动态系统中系统性地过度反应于对多重基本面冲击的感知，当现实事件产生相互冲突的信号并带来抵消性的市场影响时，会引发非对称的构成效应。我们证明，此类事件可能导致市场对新闻反应不足，即便投资者对所有冲击均表现出过度反应。
10.2139/ssrn.4787392.title: What Hundreds of Economic News Events Say About Belief Overreaction in the Stock Market
10.2139/ssrn.4787392.title_zh: 数百个经济新闻事件揭示的股市信念过度反应

10.2139/ssrn.4804170.title: Gender Promotion Gaps in Knowledge Work: The Role of Task Assignment in Teams
10.2139/ssrn.4804170.title_zh: 知识工作中的性别晋升差距：团队任务分配的作用

10.2139/ssrn.4835079.abstract: This paper proposes a novel mechanism linking common ownership to anticompetitive outcomes. Common owners promote shareholder-friendly governance policies in their portfolio firms, empowering interventions by activist hedge funds that discourage managers from investing. The cumulative impact of hedge fund activism contributes to anticompetitive outcomes, without collusion between managers. Effectively, and possibly unintentionally, common owners exert monopsonistic power over labor by reducing aggregate investment. Subsequently, the artificially depressed wages result in transfer of wealth to shareholders. While hedge fund activism generally improves social welfare in a competitive equilibrium, it may reduce social welfare under common ownership. The symbiotic relationship between common owners and activist hedge funds can be detrimental to society. The paper establishes a new connection between the rise of institutional ownership, adoption of shareholder-friendly policies, increased hedge fund activism, reduced investment and labor share, and heightened capital market returns.
10.2139/ssrn.4835079.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的机制，将共同所有权与反竞争结果联系起来。共同所有者在投资组合公司中推行有利于股东的公司治理政策，从而增强了激进对冲基金的干预能力，这些干预会抑制管理层的投资意愿。对冲基金激进主义的累积效应导致了反竞争结果，而无需管理层之间的合谋。实际上，共同所有者可能无意中通过减少总投资的途径，对劳动力施加了买方垄断力量。随后，人为压低的工资导致财富向股东转移。尽管在竞争均衡中，对冲基金激进主义通常能改善社会福利，但在共同所有权下，它可能反而降低社会福利。共同所有者与激进对冲基金之间的共生关系可能对社会造成损害。本文建立了机构所有权上升、股东友好型政策采纳、对冲基金激进主义增加、投资与劳动份额下降以及资本市场回报率提高之间的新联系。

10.2139/ssrn.486084.abstract: Many international treaties come into force only after a minimum number of countries have signed and ratified the treaty. Why do countries agree to introduce a minimum participation constraint among the rules characterising an international treaty? This question is particularly relevant in the case of environmental treaties dealing with global commons, where free-riding incentives are strong. Is a minimum participation rule a way to offset these free-riding incentives? Why do countries that know they have an incentive to free-ride accept to tie their hands through the introduction of a minimum participation constraint? This paper addresses the above questions by analysing a three-stage non-cooperative coalition formation game. In the first stage, countries set the minimum coalition size that is necessary for the treaty to come into force. In the second stage, countries decide whether to sign the treaty. In the third stage, the equilibrium values of the decision variables are set. At the equilibrium, both the minimum participation constraint and the number of signatories - the coalition size - are determined. This paper shows that a non-trivial partial coalition, sustained by a binding minimum participation constraint, forms at the equilibrium. This paper thus explains why in international negotiations all countries often agree on a minimum participation rule even when some of them do not intend to sign the treaty. The paper also analyses the optimal size of the minimum participation constraint.
10.2139/ssrn.486084.abstract_zh: 许多国际条约只有在达到最低签署与批准国家数量后方可生效。为何各国同意在界定国际条约的规则中引入最低参与约束？这一问题在处理全球公共品环境条约时尤为突出——此类条约中"搭便车"动机极为强烈。最低参与规则能否抵消这种搭便车倾向？明知自身存在搭便车动机的国家，为何甘愿通过引入最低参与约束来束缚自身行动？本文通过构建三阶段非合作联盟形成博弈模型，对上述问题展开分析。第一阶段，各国设定条约生效所需的最低联盟规模；第二阶段，各国决定是否签署条约；第三阶段，确定决策变量的均衡值。在均衡状态下，最低参与约束与签署国数量（即联盟规模）同时内生决定。研究表明，均衡中会形成由具有约束力的最低参与约束所支撑的非平凡部分联盟。由此，本文解释了为何在国际谈判中，即便部分国家无意签署条约，所有国家仍常就最低参与规则达成共识。本文还进一步分析了最低参与约束的最优规模。
10.2139/ssrn.486084.title: Endogenous Minimum Participation in International Environmental Treaties
10.2139/ssrn.486084.title_zh: 国际环境条约中的内生最低参与度

10.2139/ssrn.4951075.abstract: This paper studies how cross-border financial connections affect the response of exchange rates to trade shocks. Theoretically, we develop a multi-country model whereby a country's exchange rate depends on the financiers' ability to manage capital flows between this country and its counterparties (direct connection) and between its counterparties and their trading partners (indirect connection). Empirically, we quantify the network of financial connections using granular data on cross-border claims and liabilities of globally active banks. Consistent with our theoretical predictions, we find that indirect connection can either amplify or mitigate the impact of trade shocks on future exchange rate returns, depending on the shock's origin and size, while direct connection always dampens these effects.
10.2139/ssrn.4951075.abstract_zh: 本文研究了跨境金融联系如何影响汇率对贸易冲击的响应。理论上，我们构建了一个多国模型，其中一国的汇率取决于金融家管理该国与其交易对手之间资本流动的能力（直接联系），以及其交易对手与其贸易伙伴之间的资本流动能力（间接联系）。实证上，我们利用全球活跃银行的跨境债权与债务的细粒度数据，量化了金融联系网络。与我们的理论预测一致，我们发现间接联系可能放大或缓解贸易冲击对未来汇率回报的影响，这取决于冲击的来源和规模，而直接联系则始终削弱这些效应。
10.2139/ssrn.4951075.title: Beyond Bilateral Flows: Indirect Connections and Exchange Rates
10.2139/ssrn.4951075.title_zh: 超越双边流动：间接联系与汇率

10.2139/ssrn.4997456.abstract: We develop and estimate a structural model of firms’ card demand, utilization, and default choice, accounting for imperfect competition and the correlation between utilization and default. We find that while the correlation between utilization and delinquency leads to modestly higher rates, they are primarily explained by markups rather than lender costs, making business card provision highly profitable. In counterfactual analyses we show that under systematic stress scenarios, absent large shocks to lender funding costs, lender profits tend to rise in times of borrower stress, as higher revenue from utilization more than offsets increases in delinquency. Finally, we evaluate proposed capital regulations that add a portion of undrawn credit limits to bank risk-weighted assets. Such rules reduce bank credit provision and push some lending outside the regulated banking sector, while modestly reducing firm surplus. Because credit card lending tends to be more profitable in times of stress, such regulations may be counterproductive for bank stability.
10.2139/ssrn.4997456.abstract_zh: 我们构建并估计了一个关于企业信用卡需求、使用及违约选择的结构模型，该模型考虑了不完全竞争以及使用率与违约之间的相关性。研究发现，尽管使用率与逾期之间的相关性会导致违约率略有上升，但这一现象主要源于加价而非贷款成本，这使得企业信用卡业务具有极高的盈利性。反事实分析表明，在系统性压力情景下，若贷款机构融资成本未遭受重大冲击，贷款机构利润往往在借款人承压时期上升，因为使用率带来的更高收入足以抵消逾期率的增加。最后，我们评估了拟议的资本监管规则——该规则将未提取信用额度的一部分纳入银行风险加权资产。此类规则会减少银行信贷供给，并将部分贷款业务推向受监管银行体系之外，同时适度降低企业剩余。由于信用卡贷款在压力时期往往更具盈利性，此类监管可能对银行稳定性产生反效果。

10.2139/ssrn.4998858.title: The Comovement of Voter Preferences: Insights from U.S. Presidential Election Prediction Markets Beyond Polls
10.2139/ssrn.4998858.title_zh: 选民偏好联动性：来自美国大选预测市场超越民调的洞见

10.2139/ssrn.5035207.abstract: We investigate their implications for monetary policy by developing and estimating a tractable nonlinear New Keynesian Climate model featuring climate damages and mitigation policies for the global economy. We find that mitigation policies aligned with the Paris Agreement result in higher, more persistent inflation than laissez-faire policies. Central banks can attenuate this inflationary pressure by accounting for the rising natural rate of interest, at the cost of lower GDP during the transition. This short-term trade-off ensures long-term macroeconomic stability resulting from a net-zero emission world.
10.2139/ssrn.5035207.abstract_zh: 我们通过构建并估计一个包含气候损害与全球减缓政策的可处理非线性新凯恩斯气候模型，探讨其对货币政策的影响。研究发现，与《巴黎协定》相一致的减缓政策会导致比放任政策更高且更持久的通胀。中央银行可通过考虑自然利率的上升来缓解这一通胀压力，但代价是转型期间GDP下降。这一短期权衡确保了净零排放世界带来的长期宏观经济稳定。
10.2139/ssrn.5035207.title: The New Keynesian Climate Model
10.2139/ssrn.5035207.title_zh: 新凯恩斯主义气候模型

10.2139/ssrn.5054239.abstract: This study reveals the pivotal impact of the prehistoric out-of-Africa migration on global variation in the degree of cultural diversity within ethnic and national populations. Drawing on novel diversity measures—encompassing folkloric and musical traditions among indigenous ethnic groups, as well as norms, values, and attitudes in modern societies—an intriguing pattern emerges: societies whose ancestors migrated farther from humanity’s cradle in Africa exhibit lower cultural diversity. These striking findings underscore: (i) the profound role of cultural dynamics in shaping the enduring effects of the out-of-Africa migration on social cohesion, innovativeness, and living standards; (ii) the origins of persistent global variations in cultural expressions within an increasingly interconnected world; and (iii) the roots of variations in societal adaptability to evolving economic and technological landscapes.
10.2139/ssrn.5054239.abstract_zh: 本研究揭示了史前“走出非洲”迁徙对全球族群及国家人口内部文化多样性程度的决定性影响。借助新颖的多样性度量指标——涵盖原住民族群的民俗与音乐传统，以及现代社会的规范、价值观与态度——一个引人注目的模式浮现：祖先从人类摇篮非洲迁徙距离更远的社会，展现出较低的文化多样性。这些显著发现强调了：（i）文化动态在塑造“走出非洲”迁徙对社会凝聚力、创新能力及生活水平的持久影响中的深远作用；（ii）在日益互联的世界中，全球文化表达持久差异的起源；（iii）社会对不断演变的经济与技术环境适应能力差异的根源。
10.2139/ssrn.5054239.title: Roots of Cultural Diversity

10.2139/ssrn.5066156.abstract: This paper provides new evidence on the nexus between railroads and inventive activities in Italy in the period 1861-1936. We develop two new georeferenced datasets on railway stations and patents. By adopting the staggered difference in differences identification strategy by Callaway and Sant’Anna (2021), we show that the impact of railroad construction on innovation is only visible for the first wave of construction of the period of the Destra storica (1861-1878), when the network was expanded following a state building strategy. However, these effects became noticeable only after more than two decades and concern mostly independent inventors and low-quality patents.
10.2139/ssrn.5066156.abstract_zh: 本文为1861-1936年间意大利铁路建设与发明活动之间的关联提供了新的证据。我们构建了两个新的地理参照数据集，分别涉及火车站和专利。采用Callaway和Sant’Anna（2021）提出的交错差分识别策略，我们表明铁路建设对创新的影响仅在“历史右翼”时期（1861-1878）的第一波建设浪潮中显现，当时铁路网络的扩展遵循了国家建设战略。然而，这些效应在二十多年后才变得显著，且主要涉及独立发明者和低质量专利。

10.2139/ssrn.5097443.abstract: We study beliefs about fiscal dominance in a survey of German households. We first use a randomized controlled trial to identify how fiscal news impact individual debt-to-GDP and inflation expectations. We document that the link between debt and inflation crucially depends on individuals’ views about the fiscal space. News leading individuals to expect higher debt-to-GDP ratios make them more likely to revise upward their inflation expectations. These average effects are due to individuals who think that fiscal resources are more stretched than others. In contrast, individuals who think there is fiscal space do not associate debt with inflation. We then rationalize these results in a New Keynesian model where agents have heterogeneous beliefs about the fiscal space. We show that the heterogeneity of beliefs implies a policy tradeoff for the central bank. Agents who expect fiscal dominance in the future exert upward pressure on inflation. An active central bank may choose to partially tolerate this higher inflation due to the real costs of completely stabilizing prices.
10.2139/ssrn.5097443.abstract_zh: 我们在一项针对德国家庭的调查中研究了关于财政主导地位的信念。首先，我们通过随机对照试验来识别财政新闻如何影响个人对债务占GDP比率及通胀预期的看法。我们记录了债务与通胀之间的联系，这一联系关键取决于个人对财政空间的看法。那些导致个人预期债务占GDP比率上升的新闻，使他们更可能上调通胀预期。这些平均效应源于那些认为财政资源比其他人更为紧张的个人。相反，认为存在财政空间的个人则不会将债务与通胀联系起来。随后，我们在一个新型凯恩斯模型中合理化这些结果，该模型中代理人对财政空间持有异质性信念。我们表明，信念的异质性意味着中央银行面临政策权衡。预期未来财政主导地位的代理人会对通胀产生上行压力。一个积极的中央银行可能因完全稳定物价的实际成本而选择部分容忍这种较高的通胀。
10.2139/ssrn.5097443.title: Household Beliefs about Fiscal Dominance
10.2139/ssrn.5097443.title_zh: 家庭对财政主导地位的信念

10.2139/ssrn.5106503.abstract: this paper provides causal evidence of how colocation between employees affects internal communication within firms. A machine learning analysis of email content reveals that colocation is a substitute for horizontal, coordination-related communication, but---somewhat surprisingly---a complement to vertical, monitoring-related communication.
10.2139/ssrn.5106503.abstract_zh: 本文提供了员工同地办公如何影响企业内部沟通的因果证据。对电子邮件内容进行的机器学习分析显示，同地办公是横向、协调性沟通的替代品，但——略显意外的是——却是纵向、监督性沟通的补充。

10.2139/ssrn.5160731.abstract: We develop new methods to construct forecast confidence intervals for expected returns obtained from neural networks. We show that neural network forecasts of expected returns share the same asymptotic distribution as classic nonparametric methods, enabling a closed-form expression for their standard errors. We also propose a computationally feasible bootstrap to obtain the asymptotic distribution. We incorporate these forecast confidence intervals into an uncertainty-averse investment framework. This provides an economic rationale for shrinkage implementations of portfolio selection. Empirically, our methods improve out-of-sample performance.
10.2139/ssrn.5160731.abstract_zh: 我们开发了新的方法来构建从神经网络获得的预期收益预测置信区间。我们证明，神经网络的预期收益预测与经典非参数方法具有相同的渐近分布，从而能够为其标准误提供闭式表达式。我们还提出了一种计算上可行的自助法来获取渐近分布。我们将这些预测置信区间纳入一个厌恶不确定性的投资框架中。这为投资组合选择的收缩实现提供了经济学依据。实证上，我们的方法提升了样本外表现。
10.2139/ssrn.5160731.title: The Uncertainty of Machine Learning Predictions in Asset Pricing
10.2139/ssrn.5160731.title_zh: 机器学习预测在资产定价中的不确定性

10.2139/ssrn.5241807.abstract: We study the interaction between banks’ adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in credit scoring and relationship lending. Using a unique dataset on Italian banks’ investments in AI for the purpose of integrating their credit scoring techniques, matched with credit register data from one year before and one year after the outbreak of the Covid-19 crisis, we find that AI investments help banks mitigate the typical countercyclical effects of relationship lending on firms’ credit supply, as well as on their investment and employment decisions.
10.2139/ssrn.5241807.abstract_zh: 我们研究了银行在信用评分中采用人工智能（AI）与关系型贷款之间的相互作用。利用一项关于意大利银行在整合其信用评分技术方面进行AI投资的独特数据集，并结合新冠疫情爆发前后各一年的信贷登记数据，我们发现，AI投资有助于银行缓解关系型贷款对企业信贷供应及其投资和就业决策所产生的典型逆周期效应。
10.2139/ssrn.5241807.title: Artificial Intelligence and Relationship Lending
10.2139/ssrn.5241807.title_zh: 人工智能与关系型贷款

10.2139/ssrn.5335165.title_zh: 自然灾害损失：县级损害、受伤与死亡数据

10.2139/ssrn.5350325.abstract: This paper explores a repositioning of Europe’s labor market institutions as potential drivers of the transatlantic gap in macroeconomic performance. Institutional diagnoses were prominent in times of high European unemployment in the 1980-90s. But interest waned as joblessness fell—even though the decline was uneven, precarious work arrangements have grown, and labor markets remain largely unreformed (unlike product and financial markets). Yet, rigid labor market institutions might continue to matter because they can stifle labor market and business dynamism: Europeans switch jobs much less frequently, and restructuring is much rarer. Recent research argues that such immobility impedes wage and productivity growth. Moreover, this low dynamism might contribute to Europe’s specific underperformance in tech, R&D, disruptive innovation, ICT adoption—where creative destruction requires fluid reallocation. This institutional labor market perspective on European competitiveness complements prevailing diagnoses focused on capital and product market fragmentation. Tight labor markets, lower unemployment, and shrinking labor supply might keep this nexus timely.
10.2139/ssrn.5350325.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了欧洲劳动力市场制度作为跨大西洋宏观经济表现差距潜在驱动因素的重新定位。在1980-90年代欧洲高失业时期，制度性诊断曾备受关注。但随着失业率下降，相关兴趣逐渐消退——尽管下降并不均衡，非正规就业安排有所增加，且劳动力市场在很大程度上仍未改革（与产品和金融市场不同）。然而，僵化的劳动力市场制度可能仍然重要，因为它们可能抑制劳动力市场和企业活力：欧洲人更换工作的频率远低于美国，企业重组也更为罕见。近期研究认为，这种流动性不足阻碍了工资和生产率增长。此外，这种低活力可能加剧欧洲在科技、研发、颠覆性创新及ICT应用方面的相对落后——在这些领域，创造性破坏需要灵活的重新配置。这种基于制度性劳动力市场的欧洲竞争力视角，补充了侧重于资本和产品市场碎片化的主流诊断。紧张的劳动力市场、较低的失业率以及不断萎缩的劳动力供给，可能使这一关联保持其现实意义。
10.2139/ssrn.5350325.title: Eurosclerosis at 40: Labor Market Institutions, Dynamism, and European Competitiveness
10.2139/ssrn.5350325.title_zh: 四十年的欧洲硬化症：劳动力市场制度、活力与欧洲竞争力

10.2139/ssrn.5359193.abstract: This study estimates the impact of a carbon tax on welfare, considering modal shifts to less carbon-intensive transport, as well as its effects on environmental and fiscal externalities. We calibrate a modal competition model using logit demand functions for a specific long-distance connection in France and simulate the introduction of a Pigouvian tax. Our key findings are: First, a €190/tCO2 carbon tax is nearly welfare-neutral but significantly detrimental to consumer surplus; Second, rail price regulation has the side effect of reducing greenhouse gas emissions by subsidizing the cleanest transport mode; Third, the widespread adoption of electric vehicles enhances overall welfare without significantly harming consumer surplus.
10.2139/ssrn.5359193.abstract_zh: 本研究评估了碳税对福利的影响，同时考虑了向低碳密集型交通方式的转变，以及其对环境和财政外部性的效应。我们利用逻辑需求函数，针对法国某特定长途线路校准了一个交通方式竞争模型，并模拟了庇古税的引入。主要发现如下：第一，每吨二氧化碳190欧元的碳税几乎对福利中性，但对消费者剩余显著不利；第二，铁路价格管制通过补贴最清洁的交通方式，附带减少了温室气体排放；第三，电动汽车的广泛普及提升了整体福利，且未显著损害消费者剩余。
10.2139/ssrn.5359193.title: Welfare Implications of a Carbon Tax in a Long-Distance Passenger Market
10.2139/ssrn.5359193.title_zh: 长途客运市场中碳税的福利影响

10.2139/ssrn.5460014.abstract: This paper reviews the cultural economics literature which has examined the persistence and transformation of gendered beliefs and norms across the globe. While this innovative work has been expanding, in general, our understanding in economics of gender norm formation and evolution is still quite nascent and there are many exciting possibilities for future research.
10.2139/ssrn.5460014.abstract_zh: 本文回顾了文化经济学文献中关于全球性别观念与规范持续性与转变的研究。尽管这一创新性工作正在不断扩展，但总体而言，经济学领域对性别规范形成与演变的认知仍处于初步阶段，未来研究存在诸多令人振奋的可能性。

10.2139/ssrn.5515874.abstract: We develop a theoretical framework where debt issuance decisions take into account heterogenous demand of investors in terms of their response to changes in the price of currency risk.
10.2139/ssrn.5515874.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个理论框架，其中债务发行决策考虑了投资者对货币风险价格变化反应的异质性需求。

10.2139/ssrn.5560383.abstract: We study how firms’ investment responds to interest rate changes based on a German firm survey, combining hypothetical vignettes, open-ended questions, and rich firm data. We estimate a 7 percent semi-elasticity of investment to loan rates—about half the total corporate investment response to monetary policy shocks. Adjustment is heterogeneous: many firms do not react, citing cash buffers or a lack of opportunities, while adjusters revise sharply. Managers’ narratives about monetary policy transmission to investment emphasize direct borrowing-cost effects and rarely mention general-equilibrium channels. Local projections show this direct channel is central to output dynamics after monetary policy shocks.
10.2139/ssrn.5560383.abstract_zh: 基于德国企业调查数据，结合假设情景模拟、开放式问题及丰富的企业微观数据，我们研究了企业投资如何响应利率变化。研究发现，投资对贷款利率的半弹性约为7%——约占企业总投资对货币政策冲击总响应幅度的一半。调整行为呈现异质性：许多企业因持有现金缓冲或缺乏投资机会而未作出反应，而进行调整的企业则显著修正投资计划。管理者关于货币政策传导至投资渠道的叙述强调直接借贷成本效应，极少提及一般均衡渠道。局部投影法分析表明，该直接渠道是货币政策冲击后产出动态的核心驱动因素。
10.2139/ssrn.5560383.title: The Impact of Interest: Firms' Investment Sensitivity to Interest Rates
10.2139/ssrn.5560383.title_zh: 利率的影响：企业投资对利率的敏感度

10.2139/ssrn.5686145.abstract: We examine the impact of fatal and nonfatal health shocks on household defaults on financial obligations. We show that fatal shocks significantly increase the likelihood of defaults and provide evidence that housing wealth serves as an important self-insurance mechanism. Surviving spouses experiencing the greatest income losses are more likely to liquidate their homes, and those lacking housing wealth face a heightened risk of debt collection. Notably, these shocks have intergenerational consequences. Nonfatal health shocks cause a smaller rise in default risk and housing wealth is less predictive of defaults. These findings suggest that improving survivors' benefits for those who lack resources could enhance welfare across generations.
10.2139/ssrn.5686145.abstract_zh: 我们研究了致命与非致命健康冲击对家庭金融债务违约的影响。结果显示，致命冲击显著提高了违约可能性，并提供了证据表明住房财富作为一种重要的自我保险机制。经历最大收入损失的丧偶配偶更可能出售房产，而那些缺乏住房财富的个体面临更高的债务追讨风险。值得注意的是，这些冲击具有跨代影响。非致命健康冲击导致的违约风险上升幅度较小，且住房财富对违约的预测作用较弱。这些发现表明，为缺乏资源的幸存者改善遗属福利，可能提升跨代福祉。
10.2139/ssrn.5686145.title: When Loss Strikes Twice: Severe Health Shocks and Financial Well-Being
10.2139/ssrn.5686145.title_zh: 当损失双重来袭：严重健康冲击与财务福祉

10.2139/ssrn.5870544.title: Riders in the Smog: How Air Pollution Affects Workers in Urban Environments
10.2139/ssrn.5870544.title_zh: 雾霾中的骑行者：空气污染如何影响城市环境中的劳动者

10.2139/ssrn.5903984.abstract: We develop a simple model that jointly determines the level of trade and the extent of trade-disruption risk associated with geopolitical conflict. Any pair of countries is likely to settle into one of two steady states: (i) a low level of trade coupled with high trade-disruption risk, or (ii) a high level of trade coupled with low trade-disruption risk. Intermediate cases are unstable. Examining bilateral trade flows between 1966 and 2015, we find, first, that the extent of trade varies systematically with trade-disruption risk and, second, that trade between country pairs tends to converge over time toward these polar cases.
10.2139/ssrn.5903984.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简洁模型，该模型同时决定贸易水平及与地缘政治冲突相关的贸易中断风险程度。任意两国组合可能稳定于两种稳态之一：（i）低贸易水平伴随高贸易中断风险，或（ii）高贸易水平伴随低贸易中断风险。中间情形则不稳定。通过考察1966年至2015年间的双边贸易流，我们首先发现，贸易程度随贸易中断风险呈系统性变化；其次，国家间的贸易随时间趋于向这些极端情形收敛。
10.2139/ssrn.5903984.title: Geopolitical Conflict and Trade: Montesquieu Revisited
10.2139/ssrn.5903984.title_zh: 地缘政治冲突与贸易：重访孟德斯鸠

10.2139/ssrn.6030467.title: Battle of the markups: conflict inflation and the aspirational channel of monetary policy transmission
10.2139/ssrn.6030467.title_zh: 加价之战：冲突性通胀与货币政策传导的期望渠道

10.2139/ssrn.6093299.abstract: We examine performance using data on over 5,000 German air force pilots during World War II. Pilots' effort is hard to monitor; motivation is key to success. Fighter pilot performance increases markedly as they approach eligibility for a medal before falling off upon receipt of the award. The same effort path repeats itself as the pilot nears the next higher-prestige medal. Status-conscious pilots also exert more effort when new medals are introduced. We show that medals serve as substitutes for other forms of status. Medal cachet declines over time as lower-ability pilots receive them, making the introduction of new medals desirable. These results suggest that a tiered, expanding system of status-based incentives can repeatedly leverage worker status concerns to extract effort.
10.2139/ssrn.6093299.abstract_zh: 我们利用二战期间超过5000名德国空军飞行员的数据来考察其表现。飞行员的努力程度难以监控，而动机则是成功的关键。战斗机飞行员的表现随着他们接近获得勋章的资格而显著提升，但在获得奖项后则有所下滑。当飞行员接近下一个更高声望的勋章时，同样的努力路径会再次出现。注重地位的飞行员在新勋章引入时也会付出更多努力。我们证明，勋章可作为其他形式地位的替代品。随着能力较低的飞行员获得勋章，勋章的魅力随时间递减，这使得引入新勋章变得可取。这些结果表明，一个分层且不断扩展的基于地位的激励体系，能够反复利用工人的地位关切来激发努力。
10.2139/ssrn.6093299.title: Never Enough: Dynamic Status Incentives in Organizations
10.2139/ssrn.6093299.title_zh: 永不知足：组织中的动态地位激励

10.2139/ssrn.6200403.abstract: we develop a framework for analyzing the determinants of economic development and their implications for policy. We distinguish between classical determinants—such as inputs into education and health, access to credit, and geography—and non-classical determinants—including cultural values, social norms, beliefs, identity, and social organization. We classify these determinants along two policy-relevant dimensions: whether they can be clearly ranked in terms of their contribution to development (vertical versus horizontal) and whether they can be directly altered through policy intervention (manipulable versus non-manipulable). We show that even for classical determinants, policy impacts are often hard to predict and are mediated by local social and cultural context. These issues are more pronounced for non-classical determinants, which are more complicated to change through policy intervention and more difficult to rank in welfare terms. In some cases, traits commonly viewed as obstacles to development may be well-adapted to local conditions or even supportive of economic performance, a possibility we refer to as “reverse vertical.” Building on Hirschman’s (1967) distinction between trait-making and trait-taking policymaking, we argue that interventions that attempt to directly transform non-classical determinants often rest on fragile assumptions about ranking and manipulability and risk generating unintended or adverse effects. By contrast, many of the most successful development episodes of the past several decades relied on policies that took existing social and cultural traits as given and designed institutions, technologies, and incentives that worked within those contexts rather than attempting to overturn them.
10.2139/ssrn.6200403.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个分析经济发展决定因素及其政策含义的框架。我们将决定因素区分为经典决定因素——如教育卫生投入、信贷获取和地理条件——与非经典决定因素——包括文化价值观、社会规范、信念、身份认同和社会组织。我们沿着两个与政策相关的维度对这些决定因素进行分类：它们能否在发展贡献上被明确排序（纵向与横向），以及它们能否通过政策干预直接改变（可操控与不可操控）。我们表明，即便是经典决定因素，政策影响也往往难以预测，并受到当地社会文化背景的中介作用。这些问题在非经典决定因素中更为突出，因为它们通过政策干预加以改变更为复杂，且在福利意义上排序更为困难。在某些情况下，通常被视为发展障碍的特质可能适应当地条件，甚至有助于经济表现，我们将这种可能性称为“反向纵向”。基于赫希曼（1967）关于特质创造与特质利用政策制定的区分，我们认为，试图直接转变非经典决定因素的干预措施往往依赖于关于排序和可操控性的脆弱假设，并可能引发意外或不利后果。相比之下，过去几十年许多最成功的发展案例依赖于将现有社会文化特质视为既定条件，并设计在这些情境内运作的制度、技术和激励机制，而非试图颠覆它们。

10.2139/ssrn.6326703.abstract: A central insight from neoclassical economics is that international trade operates like an improvement in production technology. It generates mutual aggregate welfare gains for countries as a whole, but creates winners and losers within countries. Tariffs are a tax on this trading technology and distort the prices faced by domestic consumers and producers. Large countries can use tariffs to improve their terms of trade on world markets. But if all countries try to do so, they can end up with lower welfare than if they cooperated to liberalize trade. Tariffs can be used to redistribute income between the winners and losers from trade within countries. But there can be other more efficient ways to achieve redistribution. Policies to promote economic activity in critical industries can be rationalized based on externalities or national security. But these arguments typically rationalize targeted policies towards those industries and tariffs can be dominated by other policy interventions. Empirical findings from the recent waves of U.S. tariffs suggest that most of the incidence of these tariffs has been borne by U.S. importers, wholesalers, retailers and consumers rather than by foreign exporters. These tariffs have led to a large-scale reorganization of U.S. supply chains away from China to third countries. Although this reorganization has substantially reduced China’s share of U.S. imports, the U.S. remains indirectly exposed to China through the imports of these third countries.
10.2139/ssrn.6326703.abstract_zh: 新古典经济学的核心观点认为，国际贸易如同生产技术的改进，能为各国整体带来相互的福利增益，但也会在国家内部产生赢家和输家。关税是对这种贸易技术征收的税收，会扭曲国内消费者和生产者面临的价格。大国可以利用关税改善其在世界市场上的贸易条件。但如果所有国家都试图这样做，最终可能比合作实现贸易自由化时的福利水平更低。关税可用于在国家内部贸易赢家和输家之间进行收入再分配，但可能存在其他更有效的再分配方式。基于外部性或国家安全理由，可以合理化对关键产业的经济活动促进政策，但这些论点通常支持对这些产业实施针对性政策，而关税可能被其他政策干预手段所取代。近期美国关税浪潮的实证结果表明，这些关税的负担主要由美国进口商、批发商、零售商和消费者承担，而非外国出口商。这些关税导致美国供应链大规模重组，从中国转向第三国。尽管这种重组大幅降低了中国在美国进口中的份额，但美国仍通过从这些第三国的进口间接暴露于中国的影响之下。
10.2139/ssrn.6326703.title: The Economics of Tariffs

10.2139/ssrn.6380898.abstract: Menstrual stigma affects adolescent girls worldwide, yet its impact on human capital development remains largely unexamined. We use a field experiment in 140 schools in Madagascar to evaluate interventions designed to reduce menstrual stigma and promote hygiene behaviors (N =2,250). Teacher-led sensitization on stigma and hygiene, menstrual products, and sanitation infrastructure together substantially improve girls' learning outcomes on standardized tests (+0.2 SD). These gains do not operate by improving school attendance or health, the channels typically invoked to justify menstrual hygiene programs. Instead, the improvements appear to arise from psychosocial mechanisms, including reduced menstrual stigma (measured using lab-in-the-field exercises, enumerator observations, and self-reports) and reduced stress (lower heart rate). We also test a novel approach for norm change by identifying "positive deviants"-girls within schools willing to openly challenge menstrual stigma. Selecting and training these positive deviants to serve as peer ambassadors for norm change produces significant additional improvements in self-reported stigma and hygiene behavior. The results demonstrate that addressing gender-specific psychosocial barriers can substantially improve girls' education outcomes in highly deprived contexts, while highlighting both the promise and limitations of leveraging positive deviance for social norm change.
10.2139/ssrn.6380898.abstract_zh: 月经污名影响着全球青春期女孩，但其对人力资本发展的影响在很大程度上尚未被研究。我们在马达加斯加的140所学校进行了一项实地实验，评估旨在减少月经污名并促进卫生行为的干预措施（样本量N=2,250）。由教师主导的关于污名与卫生的宣传教育、月经用品及卫生设施共同显著提高了女孩在标准化测试中的学习成果（+0.2标准差）。这些收益并非通过改善学校出勤率或健康来实现，而这两者通常是论证月经卫生项目合理性的渠道。相反，这些改善似乎源于心理社会机制，包括减少月经污名（通过实地实验室练习、调查员观察和自我报告测量）以及降低压力（心率降低）。我们还测试了一种新颖的规范变革方法，通过识别学校内愿意公开挑战月经污名的“积极偏差者”——即那些女孩。选拔并培训这些积极偏差者作为同伴大使推动规范变革，在自我报告的污名和卫生行为方面产生了显著的额外改善。结果表明，在高度贫困的环境中，解决性别特定的心理社会障碍可以显著提升女孩的教育成果，同时凸显了利用积极偏差促进社会规范变革的潜力与局限。

10.2139/ssrn.6458138.abstract: We study how institutional constraints on executive selection shape redistributive policy using a 1919 Danish reform that allowed town councils to democratically elect mayors. Although the reform applied uniformly, it made left-wing executive control feasible, especially where prior Social Democratic support was strong. Using 1917 vote shares interacted with the post-reform period, we identify the causal effect of Social Democratic mayors on local public finance. Social Democratic rule led to substantial increases in social spending, particularly poor relief and public assistance, financed mainly through higher direct taxes, with no robust evidence of adverse effects on local economic activity
10.2139/ssrn.6458138.abstract_zh: 我们利用1919年丹麦的一项改革——该改革允许市议会民主选举市长——研究了行政长官选拔的制度约束如何影响再分配政策。尽管改革统一实施，但它使左翼行政控制成为可能，尤其是在先前社会民主党支持率较高的地区。通过将1917年得票率与改革后时期进行交互分析，我们识别出社会民主党市长对地方公共财政的因果效应。社会民主党执政导致社会支出大幅增加，尤其是贫困救济和公共援助，这些支出主要通过提高直接税来融资，且没有稳健证据表明其对地方经济活动产生不利影响。
10.2139/ssrn.6458138.title: Left in Charge: Political Rule and the Rise of Local Welfare
10.2139/ssrn.6458138.title_zh: 留守掌权：政治统治与地方福利的兴起

10.2139/ssrn.6527025.abstract: We develop a new approach to estimating earnings, job, and employment dynamics using subjective expectations data from the NY Fed Survey of Consumer Expectations. These data provide beliefs about future earnings offers and acceptance probabilities, offering direct information on counterfactual outcomes and enabling identification under weaker assumptions. Our framework avoids biases from selection and unobserved heterogeneity that affect models using realized outcomes. First-step fixed-effects regressions identify risk, persistence, and transition effects; second-step GMM recovers the covariance structure of unobserved heterogeneities such as ability, mobility, and match quality. We find lower risk and persistence of the individual productivity component than in prior work, but greater heterogeneity in ability and match quality. Simulations show that reduced-form estimates overstate persistence and volatility on individual-level productivity due to job transitions and sorting. After accounting for heterogeneity, volatility declines and becomes flat across the earnings distribution. These results underscore the value of expectations data.
10.2139/ssrn.6527025.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种新方法，利用纽约联储消费者预期调查中的主观预期数据来估计收入、工作及就业动态。这些数据提供了关于未来收入报价及接受概率的信念，直接揭示了反事实结果的信息，从而在较弱的假设下实现识别。我们的框架避免了使用已实现结果模型中的选择偏差和未观测异质性影响。第一步固定效应回归识别风险、持续性和转换效应；第二步广义矩方法恢复未观测异质性（如能力、流动性和匹配质量）的协方差结构。我们发现个体生产力组成部分的风险和持续性低于先前研究，但能力和匹配质量的异质性更大。模拟显示，简化形式估计因工作转换和排序效应而高估了个体层面生产力的持续性和波动性。在考虑异质性后，波动性下降并在收入分布中趋于平坦。这些结果凸显了预期数据的价值。
10.2139/ssrn.6527025.title: Subjective Earnings and Employment Dynamics

10.2139/ssrn.6596700.abstract: We study the interconnection between the productivity and pricing effects of financial shocks. Combining administrative records on firm-level output prices and quantities with quasi-experimental variation in credit supply, we show that a tightening of credit conditions has a persistent, yet delayed, negative effect on firms' long-run physical productivity growth (TFPQ) but also induces firms to change their pricing policies. Commonly used revenue-based productivity measures (TFPR)-which conflate price and productivity-offer biased predictions regarding the consequences of financial shocks for firms' productivity growth, underestimating the long-run elasticity of physical productivity to credit supply by half. We also show that the pricing adjustments themselves have productivity implications. Firms use low pricing as a source of internal financing, allowing them to avoid cutting expenditures on productivityenhancing activities, thereby softening the impact of financial shocks. We incorporate these forces into a quantitative model of firm dynamics to quantify the importance of productivity and pricing dynamics (and their interplay) in driving the scarring effects of financial crises on aggregate productivity and welfare.
10.2139/ssrn.6596700.abstract_zh: 本文研究了金融冲击对生产率与定价效应之间的内在关联。通过将企业层面产出价格与数量的行政记录数据与信贷供给的准实验性变化相结合，我们发现：信贷条件收紧对企业长期实物生产率增长（TFPQ）具有持续但滞后的负面影响，同时也会促使企业调整其定价策略。常用的基于收入的生产率指标（TFPR）——该指标混淆了价格与生产率——对金融冲击影响企业生产率增长的预测存在偏差，导致对实物生产率相对于信贷供给的长期弹性低估了约50%。我们还发现，定价调整本身具有生产率效应。企业将低价策略作为内部融资来源，从而避免削减生产率提升活动的支出，进而缓解金融冲击的影响。我们将这些机制纳入企业动态定量模型，以量化生产率与定价动态（及其相互作用）在驱动金融危机对总生产率和福利造成疤痕效应中的重要性。

10.2139/ssrn.6665542.abstract: We study the macroeconomic effects of government-funded and privately funded innovation on postwar US productivity and economic growth. Using newly digitized data that allow us to distinguish innovations by funding source and ownership, we document systematic differences in how public and private innovation translate into aggregate outcomes. Government-funded but privately owned patents—though accounting for only about 2 per cent of total patenting— explain roughly 20 per cent of medium-term fluctuations in total factor productivity and GDP growth and are associated with strong spillovers to business-sector R&D and investment. Privately funded patents also contribute to aggregate fluctuations, but with smaller effects, while publicly owned patents display muted average impacts despite being disproportionately represented among highly disruptive innovations, particularly in health and biotechnology. Across federal agencies, innovations funded by the NIH and NSF exhibit the strongest links to subsequent productivity growth, and research institutes and universities outperform for-profit firms in converting public funding into aggregate gains. Taken together, our results highlight how the institutional design of public support for innovation shapes medium-term productivity dynamics and plays a central role in sustaining US economic growth.
10.2139/ssrn.6665542.abstract_zh: 我们研究了政府资助与私人资助的创新对战后美国生产率及经济增长的宏观影响。利用新近数字化的数据，使我们能够根据资金来源和所有权区分创新类型，我们记录了公共与私人创新如何转化为总体结果的系统性差异。政府资助但私人拥有的专利——尽管仅占总专利数的约2%——却解释了全要素生产率与GDP增长中期波动的约20%，并与商业部门研发和投资产生强烈的溢出效应相关联。私人资助的专利同样对总体波动有所贡献，但影响较小，而公共拥有的专利尽管在高度颠覆性创新中占比不成比例地高，特别是在健康与生物技术领域，其平均影响却显得较为温和。在各联邦机构中，由国立卫生研究院和国家科学基金会资助的创新与后续生产率增长的联系最为紧密，研究机构和大学在将公共资金转化为总体收益方面优于营利性企业。综合来看，我们的研究结果凸显了公共创新支持制度设计如何塑造中期生产率动态，并在维持美国经济增长中发挥核心作用。

10.2139/ssrn.6910978.abstract: This paper documents that firms connected with superstar buyers experience larger real losses when hit by financial shocks. Using Italian loan-level data, we show that firms most affected by the credit crunch induced by the 2011 sovereign debt crisis reduced exports more sharply. Importantly, export declines were larger for exporters connected with foreign superstar buyers prior to the shock. This amplification is explained by superstar buyers disproportionately reallocating purchases away from exposed suppliers, which also experienced lower sales and employment. Partial-equilibrium aggregation implies that this superstar penalty explains around one-third of the aggregate negative effect of the credit supply shock.
10.2139/ssrn.6910978.abstract_zh: 本文记录了与超级明星买家有关联的企业在遭受金融冲击时面临更大的实际损失。利用意大利贷款层面的数据，我们表明，受2011年主权债务危机引发的信贷紧缩影响最严重的企业，其出口下降更为剧烈。重要的是，对于在冲击前与外国超级明星买家有关联的出口商而言，出口下降幅度更大。这种放大效应可归因于超级明星买家不成比例地将采购从受冲击供应商处转移，这些供应商还经历了较低的销售额和就业。局部均衡加总表明，这种超级明星惩罚解释了信贷供给冲击总体负面效应的约三分之一。
10.2139/ssrn.6910978.title: The Superstar Buyer Penalty during Financial Crises: Evidence from Firm-to-Firm Trade Data
10.2139/ssrn.6910978.title_zh: 金融危机期间超级明星买家的惩罚：来自企业间贸易数据的证据

10.2139/ssrn.7116732.abstract: We revisit the debate on the effectiveness of central bank communication on exchange rates, contrasting a skeptical view, which holds that communication neither moves exchange rates nor influences them in the desired direction, with an optimistic view that it does. Using nearly 100 official ECB statements on exchange rates made during its monetary policy press conferences since 2002, we show that the ECB tends to mention the exchange rate when the real effective exchange rate deviates from its equilibrium value, whereas journalists' questions are mainly responsive to the nominal exchange rate. Studying the effects of these mentions, our findings by and large support the skeptical view: after controlling for monetary policy shocks, exchange rate communication has limited immediate effects on the euro exchange rate, which fade quickly. Effectiveness is particularly limited when interest rates are at their effective lower bound.
10.2139/ssrn.7116732.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视关于中央银行沟通对汇率有效性的辩论，对比了两种观点：一种持怀疑态度，认为沟通既不能推动汇率变动，也不能引导其朝预期方向发展；另一种则持乐观态度，认为沟通确实有效。基于自2002年以来欧洲央行在货币政策新闻发布会上发布的近100份关于汇率的官方声明，我们发现，当实际有效汇率偏离其均衡值时，欧洲央行倾向于提及汇率问题，而记者的提问则主要针对名义汇率。研究这些提及的影响，我们的发现大体上支持怀疑观点：在控制货币政策冲击后，汇率沟通对欧元汇率的即时影响有限，且这种影响迅速消退。尤其在利率触及有效下限时，其有效性更为受限。
10.2139/ssrn.7116732.title: ECB Exchange Rate Communication

10.2139/ssrn.898570.abstract: This paper presents new evidence on the child-quantity/child-quality trade-off. Our empirical strategy exploits exogenous variation in family size due to twin births and preferences for a mixed sibling-sex composition, as well as ethnic differences in the effects of these variables and preferences for male births in some ethnic groups. We use these sources of variation to look at the causal effect of family size on completed educational attainment, fertility, and earnings. For the purposes of this analysis, we constructed a unique matched data set linking Israeli Census data with information on the demographic structure of families drawn from a population registry. Our results show no evidence of a quantity-quality trade-off, though some estimates from one sub-sample suggest that first-born girls from large families marry sooner.
10.2139/ssrn.898570.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于子女数量与子女质量之间权衡关系的新证据。我们的实证策略利用了因双胞胎出生和子女性别混合偏好所导致的家庭规模外生变异，以及这些变量在不同族群中的效应差异和某些族群对男性子女生育的偏好。我们利用这些变异来源，考察家庭规模对最终受教育程度、生育率和收入水平的因果效应。为此，我们构建了一个独特的匹配数据集，将以色列人口普查数据与来自人口登记系统的家庭人口结构信息相链接。研究结果显示，未发现数量-质量权衡的证据，尽管来自某个子样本的估计表明，大家庭中的头胎女孩会较早结婚。

10.2307/2297461.abstract: Thin equity markets cannot accommodate temporary bulges of buy or sell orders without large price movements. The resulting volatility can induce risk-averse transactors who face transaction costs to desert these markets. Thus thinness and the related price volatility may become joint self-perpetuating features of an equity market, irrespective of the volatility of asset fundamentals. If, however, appropriate incentive schemes are adopted to encourage entry by additional investors, this vicious circle can be broken, eventually shifting the market to a self-sustaining, superior equilibrium characterized by a higher number of transactors, lower price volatility and larger supply of the asset.
10.2307/2297461.abstract_zh: 薄弱的股票市场无法在不引发大幅价格波动的情况下容纳临时性的买卖订单激增。由此产生的波动性可能导致面临交易成本的风险规避型交易者退出这些市场。因此，市场薄弱性及其相关的价格波动可能成为股票市场的自我强化特征，无论资产基本面波动性如何。然而，如果采用适当的激励机制鼓励更多投资者进入市场，这种恶性循环可以被打破，最终使市场转向一个自我维持的、更优的均衡状态，其特征是交易者数量更多、价格波动性更低以及资产供给量更大。
