10.2307/2601112.title: Price-level Targeting versus Inflation Targeting: A Free Lunch?
10.2307/2601112.title_zh: 价格水平目标与通胀目标：免费午餐？

10.2307/3038229.abstract: This paper is an attempt to gauge how much the conclusions derived from the standard analysis of labour supply may have to be altered when we allow for such 'unemployed' workers. For the sample of married women in the UK which we investigate, the standard model appears to exaggerate the positive impact which reductions in marginal wages may have on participation and reduces the possibilities for a backward-bending supply curve of labour. The probability of being in a state of unemployment, as defined above, is found to depend on certain demand-side factors, age and a number of other demographic characteristics.
10.2307/3038229.abstract_zh: 本文旨在评估，当我们将此类“失业”工人纳入考量时，标准劳动供给分析所得结论可能需要做出多大程度的修正。基于我们所研究的英国已婚女性样本，标准模型似乎夸大了边际工资下降对劳动参与率的正向影响，并降低了劳动供给曲线向后弯曲的可能性。研究发现，处于上述定义的失业状态的概率取决于某些需求侧因素、年龄以及其他若干人口特征。

10.2307/3968363.title: DP21631 Anchors aweigh? The effect of communicating forecast uncertainty
10.2307/3968363.title_zh: DP21631 锚定效应？传达预测不确定性的影响

10.31235/osf.io/em3js.abstract: This paper examines the impact of ethnic fractionalization on public service use by exploiting a major constitutional reform in Kenya. Following an important period of inter-ethnic conflict, responsibility for local health services was decentralized to 47 newly created county governments. Using an event-study design, we find that use of public clinics for births increased significantly after the reform, but only in counties that were relatively ethnically homogeneous. We also find a significant increase in the correlation between county ethnic fractionalization and a range of other measures of public health service use. Services in these counties are also less likely to require payments after decentralization. Using within-county variation to investigate mechanisms, we find healthcare use increases were concentrated among areas and individuals of the same ethnicity as members of the new county government executives. Overall, the results suggest that more ethnically homogeneous sub-national jurisdictions can rapidly increase public service use.
10.31235/osf.io/em3js.abstract_zh: 本文利用肯尼亚一次重大宪法改革，考察了民族分裂程度对公共服务使用的影响。在经历了一段重要的民族间冲突时期后，地方卫生服务责任被下放至47个新成立的县级政府。通过事件研究设计，我们发现改革后公立诊所用于分娩的使用率显著增加，但仅出现在民族相对同质的县。我们还发现，县级民族分裂程度与一系列其他公共卫生服务使用指标之间的相关性显著增强。权力下放后，这些县的服务也更少需要付费。利用县内差异探究机制，我们发现医疗保健使用率的增长集中在与新任县级政府行政人员同属一个民族的地区和个人中。总体而言，研究结果表明，民族更为同质的地方行政辖区能够迅速提高公共服务使用率。
10.31235/osf.io/em3js.title: Decentralization, Ethnic Fractionalization, and Public Services: Evidence from Kenyan Healthcare
10.31235/osf.io/em3js.title_zh: 分权、民族分裂与公共服务：来自肯尼亚医疗保健的证据

10.3368/jhr.0224-13403r2.abstract: The rapid rise in smartphone use among youth has raised concerns about its effects on well-being and learning. Using administrative and survey data with an event-study design, I show that banning smartphones in middle schools has no average effect on education or mental health but masks important gender differences. Bans reduce psychological health care use among girls, lower bullying for both genders, and improve girls’ GPAs and academic track placement, especially among those from disadvantaged backgrounds. These results suggest smartphone bans can be a low-cost policy to improve outcomes, particularly for girls.
10.3368/jhr.0224-13403r2.abstract_zh: 青少年智能手机使用的迅速增加引发了对其福祉和学习影响的担忧。利用行政与调查数据，并采用事件研究设计，我发现中学禁止智能手机对教育或心理健康平均无影响，但掩盖了重要的性别差异。禁令减少了女孩的心理健康护理使用，降低了双方的欺凌现象，并提升了女孩的GPA及学术轨道安置，尤其对来自弱势背景的学生效果显著。这些结果表明，智能手机禁令可作为一种低成本政策来改善结果，特别是对女孩而言。
10.3368/jhr.0224-13403r2.title: Smartphone Bans, Student Outcomes and Mental Health
10.3368/jhr.0224-13403r2.title_zh: 智能手机禁令、学生学业成果与心理健康

10.3368/jhr.0225-14107r2.abstract: We estimate the effects of welfare program participation on the labor supply of those who are on the margin of participation. We develop a local IV method that can semiparametrically estimate the shape of the marginal labor supply response curve as participation grows and declines. In an application to the historical AFDC program and using an instrument for program participation costs, we estimate a quadratic curve, rising and then falling as participation rates rise The average work disincentive is modest in size but there are some margins where effects are sizable and some where it is effectively zero.
10.3368/jhr.0225-14107r2.abstract_zh: 我们估算了福利计划参与对处于参与边缘人群劳动供给的影响。我们开发了一种局部工具变量方法，能够半参数地估计随着参与率上升和下降时边际劳动供给响应曲线的形状。在应用于历史上的AFDC计划并使用一个针对参与成本的工具变量时，我们估计出一条二次曲线，该曲线随参与率上升先增后减。平均工作抑制效应规模适中，但在某些边际上效应显著，而在另一些边际上则几乎为零。
10.3368/jhr.0225-14107r2.title: A Model of the Marginal Labor Supply Response to Transfer Programs, with a Historical Illustration
10.3368/jhr.0225-14107r2.title_zh: 转移支付项目边际劳动供给响应模型：一个历史例证

10.3368/jhr.0324-13487r2.abstract: We study the effects of in utero exposure to a large cash transfer program on the health of children. Using data from South Africa, we use the age-eligibility threshold of the Older Person’s Grant and the variation in age differences between children and a coresident elderly to show that in utero exposure to the cash transfer led to a 0.26 SD increase in height-for-age of children. Among older children, we leverage the variation in the timing of the start of benefits to show important out-sized benefits of in utero exposure compared to starting later in early life. These results are robust to a variety of different checks including controlling for endogenous household formation. Given the importance of early child health in determining long-term outcomes, our results suggest that extending child-specific cash transfer programs to pregnant mothers can have long-term positive impacts.
10.3368/jhr.0324-13487r2.abstract_zh: 我们研究了子宫内暴露于大规模现金转移项目对儿童健康的影响。利用南非的数据，我们依据老年人补助金的年龄资格门槛及儿童与同住老年人年龄差异的变化，证明子宫内暴露于现金转移使儿童身高别年龄指数提高了0.26个标准差。在年龄较大的儿童中，我们利用福利开始时间的差异，展示了与生命早期较晚阶段开始相比，子宫内暴露带来的显著超额益处。这些结果在多种检验下依然稳健，包括控制内生性家庭构成。鉴于早期儿童健康对长期结果的决定性作用，我们的研究结果表明，将针对儿童的现金转移项目扩展至孕妇，可产生长期的积极影响。
10.3368/jhr.0324-13487r2.title: The Health Effects of In Utero Exposure To Cash Transfers
10.3368/jhr.0324-13487r2.title_zh: 产前现金转移暴露的健康效应

10.3368/jhr.0325-14141r2.abstract: We study gender discrimination in an online health care market. Statistical discrimination implies that the impact of gender on prices should decline, and the impact of reviews increase, as reviews accumulate. However, in our context these implications do not hold, because doctors choose how strongly to signal gender. We develop a new test for the implications of statistical discrimination based on this choice. We find evidence consistent with statistical discrimination against female doctors in male-dominated fields, and vice versa. For example, female doctors mask gender more strongly initially in male-dominated fields, and the gender gap in signaling declines as reviews accumulate.
10.3368/jhr.0325-14141r2.abstract_zh: 我们研究在线医疗市场中的性别歧视。统计歧视理论表明，随着评论的积累，性别对价格的影响应减弱，而评论的影响应增强。然而，在我们的情境中，这些推论并不成立，因为医生会选择如何强烈地传达性别信号。我们基于这一选择开发了一种新的检验统计歧视推论的方法。我们发现证据与统计歧视一致，即在男性主导领域中针对女性医生存在歧视，反之亦然。例如，在男性主导领域中，女性医生最初更强烈地隐藏性别，而随着评论的积累，性别信号差距逐渐缩小。
10.3368/jhr.0325-14141r2.title: Gender Reveals in the Labor Market
10.3368/jhr.0325-14141r2.title_zh: 劳动力市场中的性别揭示

10.3368/jhr.0325-14156r1.abstract: We study how working from home (WFH) relates to wages and wage growth. We propose a labor supply framework with WFH and on-site work modes, and an empirical strategy linking work arrangements to wages and wage growth while addressing selection into WFH. We find no statistically significant relationship between WFH and contemporaneous wages. Men with higher WFH intensity experience slower wage growth; estimates for women are not distinguishable from zero. These patterns are unlikely to be explained by occupational composition or selection. The findings are consistent with WFH affecting human capital accumulation inputs, while having limited implications for contemporaneous productivity.
10.3368/jhr.0325-14156r1.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了居家办公（WFH）与工资及工资增长之间的关系。我们构建了一个包含居家办公和现场办公两种工作模式的劳动力供给框架，并提出了一种实证策略，用以关联工作安排与工资及工资增长，同时处理选择进入居家办公的内生性问题。研究发现，居家办公与当期工资之间不存在统计上显著的关系。对于居家办公强度较高的男性，其工资增长速度较慢；而女性的估计结果则与零无显著差异。这些模式不太可能由职业构成或选择性解释。研究结果与居家办公影响人力资本积累要素、但对当期生产率影响有限的看法相一致。
10.3368/jhr.0325-14156r1.title: Working From Home and Wage Dynamics

10.3368/jhr.0325-14167r2.abstract: In 1981, President Mitterrand regularized the status of undocumented immigrants in France, who comprised 12 percent of the non-French workforce and about 1 percent of all workers. Employers have monopsony power over undocumented workers because the undocumented find it costly to participate in the open market. By alleviating this labor market imperfection, a regularization program can move the market closer to the efficient competitive equilibrium and increase employment and wages for the authorized workforce. Our empirical analysis reveals that the Mitterrand regularization program raised employment and wages for low-skill native and immigrant men and increased per-capita GDP.
10.3368/jhr.0325-14167r2.abstract_zh: 1981年，法国总统密特朗对无证移民的身份进行了合法化，这些移民占非法国籍劳动力的12%，约占全体工人的1%。由于无证移民参与公开市场的成本高昂，雇主对他们拥有买方垄断权力。通过缓解这一劳动力市场的不完善，合法化计划能使市场更接近有效竞争均衡，并提高合法劳动力的就业率和工资。我们的实证分析表明，密特朗合法化计划提升了低技能本土及移民男性的就业与工资水平，并增加了人均GDP。
10.3368/jhr.0325-14167r2.title: Monopsony, Efficiency, and the Regularization of Undocumented Immigrants
10.3368/jhr.0325-14167r2.title_zh: 垄断、效率与非法移民的规范化

10.3368/jhr.0424-13527r2.abstract: We examine the impact of changes in testing standards on the new teacher pipeline by exploiting a quasi-experimental change in the minimum passing score required for admission into teacher training programs. Using institution-level data, we find that higher testing standards sharply reduce teacher preparation program enrollments and graduations. Increases in testing standards are also associated with declines in the number of new teacher licenses awarded. According to our estimates, the average increase in standards led to a nine percent decrease in graduations from teacher training programs, accounting for more than one-third of the overall decline in teacher training graduates.
10.3368/jhr.0424-13527r2.abstract_zh: 我们通过利用教师培训项目入学最低通过分数的一项准实验性变化，考察了考试标准变动对新教师输送渠道的影响。基于机构层面的数据，我们发现，提高考试标准显著减少了教师培训项目的注册人数和毕业人数。考试标准的提升还与新教师执照颁发数量的下降相关联。根据我们的估算，标准平均提高导致教师培训项目毕业人数减少9%，这占教师培训毕业生总体下降数量的三分之一以上。
10.3368/jhr.0424-13527r2.title: Teacher Testing Standards and the New Teacher Pipeline
10.3368/jhr.0424-13527r2.title_zh: 教师考试标准与新手教师培养渠道

10.3368/jhr.0424-13535r2.abstract: Using administrative data from Texas, I track individuals from high school through college to the workforce to determine the effects of local labor markets on occupational choice. I find local labor market conditions are countercyclical with selection into teaching. Individuals sorting into teaching because of poor local labor market conditions are of higher ability (standardized tests) and have higher productivity (value-added). The findings suggest local labor market fluctuations shape career decisions well before individuals participate in the labor market, and increasing the relative economic standing of teaching as a career has the potential to improve the future supply of teachers.
10.3368/jhr.0424-13535r2.abstract_zh: 利用德克萨斯州的行政数据，我追踪个体从高中到大学直至进入劳动力市场的全过程，以探究地方劳动力市场对职业选择的影响。研究发现，地方劳动力市场状况与选择从事教师职业呈逆周期关系。因地方劳动力市场不佳而选择进入教育行业的个体，其能力（以标准化测试衡量）和生产力（以增值衡量）均较高。这些发现表明，地方劳动力市场的波动早在个体进入劳动力市场之前就已塑造其职业决策，而提升教师职业的相对经济地位有望改善未来教师的供给。
10.3368/jhr.0424-13535r2.title: Local Labor Markets and Selection into the Teaching Profession
10.3368/jhr.0424-13535r2.title_zh: 地方劳动力市场与教师职业选择

10.3368/jhr.0424-13537r2.abstract: Abstract Child protective services investigate a third of child-homes for maltreatment, yet repercussions for parents remain unclear. I show that mothers face considerable adversity when referred for alleged child maltreatment. Using a novel strategy that combines event studies with variation in intervention tendency across investigators, I find that child protective services interventions increase mothers’ enrollment in mental health and substance abuse treatment services for a year, even when those services are not mandated. Earnings and employment are unaffected. Marginal interventions can lead to persistent involvement with social services for years.
10.3368/jhr.0424-13537r2.abstract_zh: 摘要 儿童保护服务对三分之一的儿童家庭进行了虐待调查，然而这对父母的影响仍不明确。我证明，当母亲因涉嫌儿童虐待而被转介时，她们面临相当大的困境。通过一种结合事件研究与调查员干预倾向差异的新策略，我发现儿童保护服务的干预措施增加了母亲在心理健康和物质滥用治疗服务中的注册率，持续一年，即使这些服务并非强制要求。收入与就业未受影响。边缘性干预可能导致与社会服务持续多年的牵连。
10.3368/jhr.0424-13537r2.title: Effects of the Child Protection System on Parents
10.3368/jhr.0424-13537r2.title_zh: 儿童保护制度对父母的影响

10.3368/jhr.0520-10939r3.abstract: This paper estimates the direct and intergenerational effects of one of the world’s largest school expansion policies. Starting in 1993-94, the District Primary Education Programme (DPEP) constructed over 100,000 new schools and served over 50 million children in India. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design I show that the policy increased enrollment, literacy and years of education for both male and female direct beneficiaries. Further, I find that children whose mothers were DPEP beneficiaries had higher scores on vernacular (18 percent), math (13 percent), and English (15 percent) tests, while Father’s DPEP exposure had no effect on children’s learning.
10.3368/jhr.0520-10939r3.abstract_zh: 本文评估了全球规模最大的学校扩张政策之一的直接效应与代际效应。自1993-94年起，地区初等教育计划（DPEP）在印度新建了超过10万所学校，惠及逾5000万儿童。利用模糊断点回归设计，我发现该政策提高了直接受益男性和女性的入学率、识字率及受教育年限。此外，研究显示，母亲为DPEP受益者的儿童在方言（18%）、数学（13%）和英语（15%）测试中得分更高，而父亲接触DPEP对儿童学习无显著影响。
10.3368/jhr.0520-10939r3.title: School Construction and Intergenerational Human Capital
10.3368/jhr.0520-10939r3.title_zh: 学校建设与代际人力资本

10.3368/jhr.0524-13615r1.abstract: We present new evidence on the long-run evolution of occupational task content by race in the United States, 1900-2021. Black workers began the transition to better paid, cognitiveintensive modern jobs at least a generation after white workers; substantial convergence only occurred after 1960. Longitudinal data suggests that task transitions were racially biased: Black men moved to jobs with lower rewarded task content than white men, conditional on initial tasks, though gaps decreased after 1940. Routine-intensive Black workers were less likely to move up into non-routine analytic work in all periods. The results suggest that task-displacement shocks widen Black-white inequality.
10.3368/jhr.0524-13615r1.abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于美国1900至2021年间按种族划分的职业任务内容长期演变的新证据。黑人劳动者向薪酬更高、认知密集型现代职业的转变至少比白人劳动者晚了一代人；显著的趋同现象直到1960年后才出现。纵向数据表明，任务转换存在种族偏见：在初始任务条件相同的情况下，黑人男性转向的任务内容回报低于白人男性，尽管这一差距在1940年后有所缩小。在所有时期，从事常规密集型工作的黑人劳动者晋升至非常规分析性工作的可能性都较低。研究结果表明，任务替代冲击加剧了黑人与白人之间的不平等。
10.3368/jhr.0524-13615r1.title: Tasks and Black-white Inequality over the Long Twentieth Century
10.3368/jhr.0524-13615r1.title_zh: 长期二十世纪中的任务与黑白不平等

10.3368/jhr.0525-14310r2.abstract: This paper studies how increased immigration enforcement in the destination country impacts labor markets in the origin country. Using variation in Mexican migrant networks and Secure Communities (SC), a policy which expanded local immigration enforcement, I show that the deportation of Mexican migrants from the U.S. increases return migration to Mexico and decreases monthly earnings for workers there. The negative earnings effects are largest for workers most similar to return migrants in terms of their demographics, occupations, and employment types, and are consistent with increased labor market competition.
10.3368/jhr.0525-14310r2.abstract_zh: 本文研究了目的地国家加强移民执法如何影响来源国的劳动力市场。利用墨西哥移民网络及“安全社区”（Secure Communities, SC）政策——该政策扩大了地方移民执法范围——的变异，我证明美国对墨西哥移民的驱逐增加了返回墨西哥的移民数量，并降低了当地工人的月收入。负面收入效应在那些与返回移民在人口特征、职业及就业类型上最为相似的工人中最为显著，这与劳动力市场竞争加剧的解释相一致。
10.3368/jhr.0525-14310r2.title: Immigration Enforcement and Origin Country Labor Markets
10.3368/jhr.0525-14310r2.title_zh: 移民执法与来源国劳动力市场

10.3368/jhr.0623-12964r2.abstract: Abstract I explore the interplay between cash welfare and health-related outcomes using Canadian administrative data. Healthcare use rises sharply before a welfare application, especially for plausibly work-limiting diagnoses, then partially normalizes within three years. Using application adjudicators’ decisions as "judge IVs", I estimate that welfare receipt has limited effects on subsequent health-related outcomes. Because Canadian healthcare is free and universal, these findings are unrelated to health insurance. An exception is pharmaceuticals, which are free for welfare recipients but not for non-recipients — consistent with this, welfare receipt strongly increases pharmaceutical use, implying that incomplete insurance limits medication among those excluded from welfare.
10.3368/jhr.0623-12964r2.abstract_zh: 我利用加拿大行政数据探讨了现金福利与健康相关结果之间的相互作用。在申请福利之前，医疗保健使用量急剧上升，尤其是对于可能限制工作的诊断，随后在三年内部分恢复正常。利用申请裁决者的决定作为“法官工具变量”，我估计福利领取对后续健康相关结果的影响有限。由于加拿大医疗保健免费且普及，这些发现与健康保险无关。一个例外是药品，福利领取者免费获得药品，而非领取者则不然——与此一致的是，福利领取显著增加了药品使用，这表明不完整的保险限制了被排除在福利之外者的用药。
10.3368/jhr.0623-12964r2.title: Cash Welfare and Health Spending

10.3368/jhr.0725-14408r2.abstract: Abstract Leveraging a major Italian reform enacted in July 2012 that eroded employment protection to workers on permanent contracts, we use detailed worker level administrative data to estimate how this reduction affected the cost of job loss. We employ a stacked event-study research design, comparing treated and untreated workers as they move from employment into nonemployment. Weakening employment protection led to additional penalties in terms of lower re-hiring earnings and lower re-employment probabilities. Heterogeneous effects of the reform deepened pre-existing divides, penalizing labor market outsiders, such as young workers, and curbing employment opportunities for individuals in poorer regions, such as the South.
10.3368/jhr.0725-14408r2.abstract_zh: 摘要 利用意大利2012年7月实施的一项重大改革，该改革削弱了对永久合同工人的就业保护，我们采用详细的工人层面行政数据，估计这一削减如何影响失业成本。我们运用堆叠事件研究设计，比较受改革影响与未受影响的工人在从就业转向非就业过程中的差异。就业保护的弱化导致再就业收入降低和再就业概率下降的额外惩罚。改革的异质性效应加深了原有的分化，对劳动力市场边缘群体（如年轻工人）造成不利影响，并限制了较贫困地区（如南部）个体的就业机会。
10.3368/jhr.0725-14408r2.title: Does Weaker Employment Protection Lower the Cost of Job Loss?
10.3368/jhr.0725-14408r2.title_zh: 更弱的就业保护会降低失业成本吗？

10.3368/jhr.0823-13067r1.abstract: This study examines the effects of timing of exposure to the Asian financial crisis on higher education and early labor market outcomes. We estimate a generalized difference-in-differences model exploiting variation in age at exposure and regional severity of the recession in South Korea. Using the Census and Youth Panel data, we find that individuals from hard-hit regions are less likely to attain a college education, tend to shift away from humanities to STEM majors, and have lower-quality first jobs, than their peers in the same cohort. These effects are more pronounced among individuals who experienced the recession at younger ages.
10.3368/jhr.0823-13067r1.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了亚洲金融危机暴露时机对高等教育及早期劳动力市场结果的影响。我们采用广义双重差分模型，利用韩国经济衰退期间暴露年龄与地区严重程度的差异进行分析。基于人口普查与青年面板数据，我们发现，来自受冲击严重地区的个体相较于同队列中的同龄人，更不可能获得大学教育，倾向于从人文学科转向STEM专业，并且初始工作质量较低。这些效应在较年轻时期经历经济衰退的个体中更为显著。
10.3368/jhr.0823-13067r1.title: The Effects of Exposure to a Large-Scale Recession on Higher Education and Early Labor Market Outcomes
10.3368/jhr.0823-13067r1.title_zh: 大规模经济衰退对高等教育及早期劳动力市场结果的影响

10.3368/jhr.0824-13810r1.abstract: Abstract Entry into many occupations is regulated to screen out the least able candidates, but available evidence suggests that this objective is rarely achieved. Using microdata covering the universe of Italian law school graduates (2007-2013), we show that this result is largely due to the strong intergenerational transmission of occupations within regulated professions. We find that having relatives already active as lawyers significantly increases the probability of passing the entry exam and boosts earnings, particularly for those who performed poorly in law school.
10.3368/jhr.0824-13810r1.abstract_zh: 摘要：许多职业的准入受到监管，旨在筛选出能力最弱的候选人，但现有证据表明这一目标很少实现。利用覆盖意大利法学院毕业生总体（2007-2013年）的微观数据，我们表明这一结果在很大程度上归因于受监管职业内部强烈的代际职业传承。我们发现，已有亲属从事律师职业显著提高了通过入职考试的概率，并提升了收入，尤其是对法学院表现不佳者而言。
10.3368/jhr.0824-13810r1.title: Quality and selection in regulated professions
10.3368/jhr.0824-13810r1.title_zh: 受监管职业中的质量与选择

10.3368/jhr.0825-14475.abstract: Abstract Prior research suggests that students exposed to domestic violence impose substantial negative externalities on peers’ learning and labor market outcomes. We test whether these findings generalize using nine-years of student data from a large urban school district linked to geocoded police records of at-home violence. In contrast to prior work, we find negligible peer effects. Adding one exposed peer to a classroom of 20 students reduces English and math scores by a statistically insignificant 0.006 standard deviations and increases disciplinary incidents by 3.2%. We reject achievement reductions greater than 0.017 standard deviations and disciplinary increases larger than 8.3%.
10.3368/jhr.0825-14475.abstract_zh: 摘要：先前研究表明，遭受家庭暴力的学生会对同伴的学习及劳动力市场结果产生显著的负面外部效应。我们利用一个大城市学区九年的学生数据，结合地理编码的警方家庭暴力记录，检验这些发现是否具有普遍性。与先前研究相反，我们发现同伴效应微乎其微。在一个20名学生的班级中增加一名受暴露同伴，会使英语和数学成绩下降0.006个标准差，但统计上不显著，同时纪律事件增加3.2%。我们排除了成绩下降超过0.017个标准差及纪律事件增加超过8.3%的可能性。
10.3368/jhr.0825-14475.title: Reconsidering Peer Effects from Schoolmates Exposed to Violence at Home
10.3368/jhr.0825-14475.title_zh: 重新审视家庭暴力暴露同伴的同伴效应

10.3368/jhr.0922-12567r3.abstract: Using harmonized administrative data from Scandinavia, we find that intergenerational rank associations in income have increased uniformly across Sweden, Denmark, and Norway for cohorts born between 1951 and 1979. By gender, father-son mobility remains stable, while correlations for mothers and daughters rise. Similar patterns appear in US survey data, albeit with different timing. We show that the decline in income mobility reflects a stronger link between female income and underlying productivity, rather than stronger intergenerational transmission of human capital or changes in assortative mating. Finally, we show that parent-child correlations increase mainly when women gain access to jobs that match their productivity.
10.3368/jhr.0922-12567r3.abstract_zh: 利用斯堪的纳维亚地区统一的行政数据，我们发现，对于1951年至1979年间出生的群体，瑞典、丹麦和挪威的收入代际排名关联性均呈现一致增强趋势。按性别划分，父子间的流动性保持稳定，而母亲与女儿间的相关性则上升。美国调查数据中出现了类似模式，尽管时间节点有所不同。我们证明，收入流动性的下降反映了女性收入与其潜在生产力之间更强的联系，而非人力资本代际传递的增强或匹配性婚姻的变化。最后，我们指出，亲子相关性主要是在女性获得与其生产力相匹配的工作机会时增加。
10.3368/jhr.0922-12567r3.title: Intergenerational Mobility Trends and the Changing Role of Female Labor
10.3368/jhr.0922-12567r3.title_zh: 代际流动趋势与女性劳动角色的变迁

10.3368/jhr.0923-13099r4.abstract: This paper examines the economic costs of absenteeism from acute illness, which reduces labor market participation and burdens workers and firms. I extend a search, matching, and bargaining framework to incorporate medical care use, illness dynamics, health capital, and employer-sponsored health insurance (ESHI). Using data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS), I estimate the model and find that acute illness lowers productivity, raises medical expenditures, and reduces welfare. Counterfactual analyses show subsidizing health capital improves total welfare. Moreover, while both a universal ESHI mandate and a penaltybased policy expand coverage, the penalty-based approach yields greater welfare gains.
10.3368/jhr.0923-13099r4.abstract_zh: 本文考察了急性疾病导致的缺勤所带来的经济成本，这种缺勤降低了劳动力市场参与度，并给工人和企业带来负担。我将搜索、匹配与谈判框架扩展至涵盖医疗服务使用、疾病动态、健康资本及雇主提供的健康保险（ESHI）。利用医疗支出小组调查（MEPS）的数据，我估计了该模型，并发现急性疾病降低了生产率、增加了医疗支出并减少了福利。反事实分析表明，补贴健康资本能提升总体福利。此外，尽管强制性的ESHI规定和基于惩罚的政策均能扩大保险覆盖范围，但基于惩罚的方法能带来更大的福利增益。
10.3368/jhr.0923-13099r4.title: Search, Acute Illness, and Absenteeism

10.3368/jhr.0924-13814r2.abstract: We explore whether a civic integration exam component dedicated to labor market training, namely the ONA - a type of job search assistance program, boosts refugees’ economic outcomes and the quality of firms they work for. Using linked employer-employee (monthly) data from 2014 to 2021 for the Netherlands and Regression Discontinuity design, we find that taking the ONA sped up and deepened the economic integration of refugees for at least 3 years in terms of increased employment probability and higher hourly wages. We further show that taking the ONA results in refugees working for larger, less routine-task intensive, higher wage firms. These results reflect improvements in both match efficiency and match quality. The ONA therefore does more than reduce search frictions: it equips refugees with the knowledge to navigate the labor market effectively and find employment that aligns better with their existing abilities and human capital.
10.3368/jhr.0924-13814r2.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了公民融合考试中专门针对劳动力市场培训的一个组成部分，即ONA——一种求职援助项目，是否能提升难民的经济成果及其所服务企业的质量。利用荷兰2014年至2021年关联雇主-雇员（月度）数据及断点回归设计，我们发现参加ONA加速并深化了难民的经济融合，至少在3年内表现为就业概率提高和小时工资上升。我们进一步表明，参加ONA导致难民在规模更大、常规任务密集度较低、工资更高的企业中工作。这些结果反映了匹配效率和匹配质量的提升。因此，ONA不仅仅减少了搜索摩擦：它赋予难民有效驾驭劳动力市场的知识，并找到与其现有能力和人力资本更契合的就业机会。
10.3368/jhr.0924-13814r2.title: Refugees’ Economic Integration and Firms

10.3368/jhr.0925-14511r1.abstract: Abstract Children’s mental health is the defining public health crisis of our time. Using the largest repository of private insurance claims in the United States, I provide the first systematic quantification of the variation in children’s mental health prescribing in the U.S. I separate variation due to 1) primary care provider (PCP) prescribing intensities, 2) regional practice environments, and 3) child health and demand. Equalizing PCP intensities would reduce the variance of provider prescribing rates by 50 percent for ADHD and 65 percent for antidepressants. Analyzing geographic variation alone significantly understates the extent of treatment variation and the role of providers.
10.3368/jhr.0925-14511r1.abstract_zh: 摘要 儿童心理健康是我们时代决定性的公共卫生危机。利用美国最大的私人保险索赔数据库，我首次系统量化了美国儿童心理健康处方开具的变异情况。我将变异来源区分为：1）初级保健提供者（PCP）的处方强度，2）区域实践环境，以及3）儿童健康与需求。若使PCP处方强度均等化，注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的提供者处方率方差将减少50%，抗抑郁药则减少65%。仅分析地理变异会显著低估治疗变异程度及提供者的作用。
10.3368/jhr.0925-14511r1.title: Providers, Places, and Children’s Mental Health Care
10.3368/jhr.0925-14511r1.title_zh: 医疗服务提供者、场所与儿童心理健康照护

10.3368/jhr.1024-13901r2.abstract: In this paper, we use narrowly-decided elections and housing transactions data to test for private returns from public office in the context of school boards in the U.S. We find no detectable effect of election to the school board on home prices in the neighborhoods of winning candidates. Stratifying by political affiliation reveals that homes appreciate in winning Republicans’ neighborhoods, but the estimate is not statistically robust. We do not find corresponding evidence for improvements in local school productivity, but we show that neighborhood public schools of Republican members also shift to serving more white students through attendance zone adjustments.
10.3368/jhr.1024-13901r2.abstract_zh: 本文利用势均力敌的选举结果与住房交易数据，检验美国学区董事会中公职的私人回报。我们发现，当选学区董事对获胜候选人所在社区的房价无显著影响。按政治派别分层分析显示，共和党获胜者所在社区的房价有所上涨，但该估计在统计上并不稳健。我们未发现当地学校生产率改善的相应证据，但表明共和党成员所在社区的公立学校通过调整招生区域，转向服务更多白人学生。
10.3368/jhr.1024-13901r2.title: Selection into Public Service

10.3368/jhr.1024-13929r2.abstract: Abstract Technology is integral to police departments, automating officer tasks, but inherently changing their time allocation. We investigate this by studying ShotSpotter, a technology that automates gunfire detection. Following a detection, officers are dispatched to the scene, thereby reallocating their time. We leverage this shock to officers’ time allocation using the rollout of ShotSpotter across Chicago police districts to study the effects on 911 response. We find consequences for calls unrelated to gunfire—officers are dispatched slower (22%), arrive on-scene later (13%), and the probability of arrest is decreased 9%. Consequently, departments must evaluate their resource capacities prior to implementing technologies.
10.3368/jhr.1024-13929r2.abstract_zh: 摘要 技术已成为警察部门不可或缺的一部分，自动化了警员的任务，但同时也从根本上改变了他们的时间分配。我们通过研究ShotSpotter——一种自动化枪击检测技术——来探讨这一问题。在检测到枪击后，警员会被派遣至现场，从而重新分配其时间。我们利用ShotSpotter在芝加哥各警区的推广作为警员时间分配的外生冲击，研究其对911响应的影响。我们发现，对于与枪击无关的呼叫产生了后果——警员派遣速度减慢（22%），到达现场时间延迟（13%），逮捕概率下降9%。因此，部门在实施技术之前必须评估其资源能力。
10.3368/jhr.1024-13929r2.title: The Unintended Consequences of Policing Technology

10.3368/jhr.1122-12630r5.abstract: We investigate the short-term impact of the first placement in out-of-home care on child health, schooling and crime. Using administrative data and an event study, we document the development in outcomes for the average child in care. We find that primary health care utilization rises temporarily when entering care before returning to pre-intervention levels. School absenteeism and criminal charges decline markedly after placement and remain lower than preplacement levels within two years of placement. Using monthly data, we infer that the decision to place a child in care may be triggered by acute events such as hospitalization or criminality.
10.3368/jhr.1122-12630r5.abstract_zh: 我们考察了首次安置于家庭外照护对儿童健康、学业及犯罪行为的短期影响。利用行政数据及事件研究方法，我们记录了接受照护的平均儿童在各项结果上的发展变化。研究发现，进入照护时，初级医疗保健使用率暂时上升，随后回落至干预前水平。安置后，学校缺勤率与刑事指控显著下降，并在安置后两年内保持低于安置前水平。通过月度数据分析，我们推断，将儿童安置于照护的决定可能由住院或犯罪等急性事件触发。
10.3368/jhr.1122-12630r5.title: Before and after out-of-home placement

10.3368/jhr.1123-13231r2.abstract: Abstract Men’s historical advantage in educational attainment has recently been reversed in many countries. I study the implications for family formation of the new female advantage in education in the marriage market, exploiting a Finnish school reform that increased women’s relative level of education. I analyze the reduced-form relationship between marriage market exposure to the reform and family outcomes. I find decreases in marriage and fertility in marriage markets with a larger female educational advantage. These results are mostly driven by the mismatch between the educational distributions of men and women, and might have negative consequences for low-educated men’s mental health.
10.3368/jhr.1123-13231r2.abstract_zh: 摘要 男性在教育程度上的历史优势近年来在许多国家已被逆转。本文利用芬兰一项提升女性相对教育水平的学校改革，研究了婚姻市场中女性教育新优势对家庭形成的影响。我分析了婚姻市场受改革影响程度与家庭结果之间的简化形式关系。研究发现，在女性教育优势较大的婚姻市场中，结婚率和生育率有所下降。这些结果主要由男女教育分布的不匹配所驱动，并可能对低教育水平男性的心理健康产生负面影响。
10.3368/jhr.1123-13231r2.title: The Impact of the Female Advantage in Education on the Family
10.3368/jhr.1123-13231r2.title_zh: 女性教育优势对家庭的影响

10.3368/jhr.1125-14624r1.abstract: Abstract Interracial marriage increased substantially in the late 20th century, concurrently with declines in regional and residential segregation. This paper studies whether these trends are related using two historical quasiexperiments and a stylized model of the marriage market. I use a shift-share instrument to find that the Great Migration increased interracial marriage in receiving communities, though this effect was absent in highly segregated cities. Using railroad density as an instrument, I also find that residential segregation decreased interracial marriage. Together, these findings indicate that internal migration and declining segregation contributed to the rise of interracial marriage in the non-Southern United States.
10.3368/jhr.1125-14624r1.abstract_zh: 摘要 20世纪末，跨种族婚姻显著增加，与此同时，区域和居住隔离现象有所减少。本文通过两个历史准实验和一个婚姻市场的简化模型，探讨这些趋势是否相互关联。我采用份额转移工具发现，大迁徙增加了接收社区的跨种族婚姻，但在高度隔离的城市中这一效应并不存在。利用铁路密度作为工具变量，我还发现居住隔离降低了跨种族婚姻的发生率。综合这些发现，表明内部迁移和隔离程度的下降促进了美国非南部地区跨种族婚姻的兴起。
10.3368/jhr.1125-14624r1.title: Migration, Segregation, and Interracial Marriage
10.3368/jhr.1125-14624r1.title_zh: 迁移、隔离与跨种族婚姻

10.3368/jhr.1223-13300r3.abstract: Abstract Labor markets in advanced economies have undergone substantial change due to globalization, technological improvements, and organizational changes, making language proficiency increasingly important even in less skilled jobs. Has this development led employers to shy away from hiring immigrants with limited host-country language skills? We shed light on this question by conducting a large-scale field experiment, where we introduce common second-language features in immigrants’ resumes. We also conduct employer surveys to interpret our experimental results. Our main finding is that language proficiency has a strong positive effect on being invited to a job interview, even in typical immigrant entry jobs.
10.3368/jhr.1223-13300r3.abstract_zh: 摘要 发达经济体的劳动力市场因全球化、技术进步和组织变革而经历了重大变化，使得语言能力即使在技能要求较低的岗位中也日益重要。这一发展是否导致雇主回避雇佣东道国语言能力有限的移民？我们通过开展大规模实地实验来探讨此问题，在实验中我们在移民简历中引入了常见的第二语言特征。同时，我们还进行了雇主调查以解读实验结果。我们的主要发现是，语言能力对获得面试邀请具有显著的正向影响，即使在典型的移民入门级工作中也是如此。
10.3368/jhr.1223-13300r3.title: Employers’ Language Proficiency Requirements and Hiring of Immigrants
10.3368/jhr.1223-13300r3.title_zh: 雇主语言能力要求与移民雇佣

10.3368/jhr.1224-14012r2.abstract: We utilize region-day variation in actual vs. forecasted weather conditions (i.e. forecasting errors) to comprehensively investigate the effects of the first public warning system for extreme heat events on behavioral and health outcomes in Japan. We find that heat alerts led to a 16% increase in ambulance-related hospital visits. An analysis of mechanisms suggests this is primarily driven by increased awareness and thus reporting of heat strokes that would otherwise have gone undetected, as opposed to substitution in health diagnoses. We further document evidence of avoidance behaviors (e.g. electricity usage).
10.3368/jhr.1224-14012r2.abstract_zh: 我们利用实际天气状况与预报天气状况之间的区域-日度差异（即预报误差），全面考察了日本首个极端高温事件公共预警系统对行为与健康结果的影响。研究发现，高温预警导致与救护车相关的医院就诊量增加了16%。机制分析表明，这一增长主要源于预警提高了公众意识，从而报告了原本可能未被发现的日射病病例，而非健康诊断上的替代效应。我们还记录了规避行为（如电力使用）的证据。
10.3368/jhr.1224-14012r2.title: Unveiling the Unseen Illness

10.3368/le.102.3.intro.abstract: There is a long tradition in environmental economics of using visits to outdoor recreation sites to value environmental goods. Recreation demand (or travel cost) models combine data on trips individuals make to recreation destinations with imputed travel costs and attributes of recreation sites to
10.3368/le.102.3.intro.abstract_zh: 环境经济学中有一个悠久的传统，即利用户外休闲场所的访问量来评估环境物品的价值。休闲需求（或旅行成本）模型将个人前往休闲目的地的出行数据与估算的旅行成本及休闲场所的属性相结合，以
10.3368/le.102.3.intro.title: Introduction to the Special Issue

10.3368/le.103.1.012425-0003r1.abstract: Abstract Flood risk is increasing in the United States, but how property markets respond to this hazard is unclear. Focusing on Houston, Texas, we analyze changes in flood risk capitalization in property prices after three major Gulf Coast hurricanes. We compare two measures of flood risk–floodplain designations from the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), and a hydrologically-imputed, continuous measure, Height Above the Nearest Drainage (HAND). HAND affects property prices after a storm in intuitive ways, while we observe counterintuitive post-storm price premiums within FEMA floodplains. Plausibly exogenous measures like HAND may be useful tools for characterizing flood risk in economic analyses.
10.3368/le.103.1.012425-0003r1.abstract_zh: 摘要 美国洪水风险日益加剧，但房地产市场如何应对这一灾害尚不明确。本文以德克萨斯州休斯顿为研究对象，分析三次重大墨西哥湾飓风后洪水风险资本化对房产价格的影响。我们比较了两种洪水风险衡量指标——联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）划定的洪泛区，以及基于水文模拟的连续指标“最近排水高度”（HAND）。研究发现，HAND在飓风后以直观方式影响房产价格，而FEMA洪泛区内的房产在飓风后却出现反直觉的价格溢价。具有外生性特征的指标（如HAND）或可作为经济分析中刻画洪水风险的有效工具。
10.3368/le.103.1.012425-0003r1.title: Who Has the Upper HAND in a Hurricane?

10.3368/le.103.1.020926-0023.abstract: Abstract Rural electrification is widely promoted to improve livelihoods, yet its land-use consequences in forest frontiers remain unclear. Using longitudinal household surveys linked to property boundaries and satellite land cover in the Brazilian Amazon, we apply heterogeneity-robust staggered-adoption difference-in-differences. Electrification increases cattle income over the medium term but has no detectable effect on annual property-level deforestation. Income gains appear to reflect herd expansion on existing pasture and a modest refrigerated-milk price premium rather than higher per-animal productivity.
10.3368/le.103.1.020926-0023.abstract_zh: 摘要：农村电气化被广泛推广以改善生计，但其在森林前沿地区的土地利用后果仍不明确。利用与巴西亚马逊地区财产边界及卫星土地覆盖数据相关联的纵向家庭调查，我们采用了异质性稳健的分阶段采用双重差分法。电气化在中期内增加了养牛收入，但对年度财产层面的森林砍伐无显著影响。收入增长似乎源于现有牧场的牛群扩张以及适度的冷藏牛奶价格溢价，而非单头动物生产力的提升。
10.3368/le.103.1.020926-0023.title: Rural Electrification in the Brazilian Amazon
10.3368/le.103.1.020926-0023.title_zh: 巴西亚马逊地区的农村电气化

10.3368/le.103.1.060225-0043r.abstract: The article estimates the effect of extreme temperature on labor in the manufacturing and services sectors in the Philippines. We use firm-level survey and temperature data and exploit the exogenous annual variation of maximum temperature. We find a rise in the projected annual increase of extreme temperature from climate change by 0.08℃, reduces employment by 14 workers for a firm with 136 employees in export-focused industries in dry regions. Male, temporary, skilled workers in large, technology-dependent, non-food firms, are most affected by extreme temperature. The mechanism is the reduction in capital investment leading to a complementary reduction in labor hired.
10.3368/le.103.1.060225-0043r.abstract_zh: 本文估算了极端温度对菲律宾制造业和服务业部门劳动力的影响。我们利用企业层面调查数据和温度数据，并借助最高温度的外生年度变化进行分析。研究发现，气候变化导致的极端温度预计年均上升0.08℃，将使干旱地区出口导向型行业中拥有136名员工的企业减少14个就业岗位。大型、技术依赖型、非食品类企业中的男性、临时工、熟练工人受极端温度影响最为显著。其作用机制在于资本投资减少，进而导致雇佣劳动力出现互补性下降。
10.3368/le.103.1.060225-0043r.title: The Effect of Extreme Temperature Shocks on the Type of Firm Labor Hired
10.3368/le.103.1.060225-0043r.title_zh: 极端温度冲击对企业雇佣劳动力类型的影响

10.3368/le.103.1.072325-0063r.abstract: The wildlife valuation literature largely focuses on eliciting willingness-to-pay for wildlife conservation, not recreation, and frequently groups species together under the banner of “wildlife”. This study employs the contingent valuation method to value the likelihood of viewing specific wildlife in Grand Teton National Park (GTNP). We estimate willingness-to-pay (WTP) and willingness-to-accept (WTA) for species-specific recreation trips to explore substitutability between popular wildlife species. Estimates across species better equip wildlife managers to balance the inherent tradeoffs associated with climate impacts on habitats and populations as well as changing interests among recreationists.
10.3368/le.103.1.072325-0063r.abstract_zh: 野生动物价值评估文献主要关注的是为野生动物保护（而非休闲娱乐）而引致的支付意愿，且常将不同物种笼统归为“野生动物”范畴。本研究采用条件价值评估法，对在大提顿国家公园观赏特定野生动物的概率进行价值评估。我们估算了针对特定物种的休闲旅行支付意愿与接受意愿，以探究热门野生动物物种之间的可替代性。跨物种的估算结果能更好地帮助野生动物管理者平衡气候变化对栖息地与种群造成的固有权衡，以及休闲者兴趣变化带来的影响。
10.3368/le.103.1.072325-0063r.title: Species-specific wildlife recreation demand
10.3368/le.103.1.072325-0063r.title_zh: 物种特异性野生动物休闲需求

10.3368/le.103.1.090225-0075r.abstract: Abstract Rationed access is an important tool to promote sustainable use of public lands. However, online reservation systems can lead to “buying frenzies” when low prices create excess demand. Using transaction-level data for river permits in the United States sold both by reservation-system buying frenzy and lottery, I show successful frenzy buyers reside in wealthier zip codes than those selected at random. This effect increases with congestion and leads to an unequal distribution of consumption benefits where high-income zip codes receive 25 percent more recreational trip value. These effects can undermine park managers’ efforts to provide equitable access through low fees.
10.3368/le.103.1.090225-0075r.abstract_zh: 摘要 配额准入是促进公共土地可持续利用的重要工具。然而，当低价引发超额需求时，在线预订系统可能导致“抢购热潮”。利用美国河流许可证的交易层面数据（这些许可证通过预订系统抢购和抽签两种方式出售），我发现成功抢购者所在的邮政编码区域比随机中签者更为富裕。这种效应随拥挤程度加剧而增强，并导致消费收益分配不均——高收入邮政编码区域获得的休闲旅行价值高出25%。这些影响可能削弱公园管理者通过低收费实现公平准入的努力。
10.3368/le.103.1.090225-0075r.title: Online Reservation Systems, Buying Frenzies and Equitable Access to Public Lands
10.3368/le.103.1.090225-0075r.title_zh: 在线预订系统、抢购热潮与公共土地公平准入

10.3368/le.103.1.091425-0079r.abstract: This paper develops a pilot timber asset account for the United States, demonstrating how a novel discount price method can value timber stocks in Georgia. While valuing merchantable timber is straightforward, an important methodological challenge is valuing trees that are not yet harvestable. Our approach values young stands by discounting their expected harvest price until they reach merchantable size. This method requires standard forest inventory data and market prices currently available in the U.S., making it promising candidate for scaling nationally. For southern yellow pine in Georgia, we estimate timber assets of $5.9 billion, with pre-merchantable timber contributing $257.7 million.
10.3368/le.103.1.091425-0079r.abstract_zh: 本文为美国构建了一个试点性木材资产账户，展示了如何运用一种新颖的折现价格方法对佐治亚州的木材存量进行估值。虽然对可采伐木材进行估值相对直接，但一个重要的方法论挑战在于如何评估尚未达到采伐规模的树木。我们的方法通过对幼龄林分的预期采伐价格进行折现，直至其达到可采伐规模。该方法仅需美国现有标准的森林资源清查数据和市场价格，因此具备在全国范围内推广的潜力。针对佐治亚州的南方黄松，我们估算其木材资产价值为59亿美元，其中未成熟木材贡献了2.577亿美元。
10.3368/le.103.1.091425-0079r.title: Toward a timber asset account for the United States
10.3368/le.103.1.091425-0079r.title_zh: 构建美国木材资产账户

10.3368/le.103.1.100825-0084r.abstract: Abstract Providing home energy information to home buyers makes efficiency more salient in purchasing. We study the impact of disclosed energy efficiency information on housing prices in Portland, Oregon after the introduction of a Home Energy Score mandate for houses on the market. We find a $1 decrease in annual energy costs is associated with an approximate increase in housing value of $24 to $40. This effect is stronger for houses that are already energy efficient and for larger houses.
10.3368/le.103.1.100825-0084r.abstract_zh: 摘要 向购房者提供家庭能源信息，使能效在购房决策中更加凸显。我们研究了俄勒冈州波特兰市实施房屋上市强制披露家庭能源评分政策后，公开的能效信息对房价的影响。研究发现，年能源成本每降低1美元，住房价值约增加24至40美元。这一效应在已具备能效优势的房屋及面积较大的房屋中更为显著。
10.3368/le.103.1.100825-0084r.title: Mandatory Disclosure of Home Energy Efficiency
10.3368/le.103.1.100825-0084r.title_zh: 强制披露家庭能源效率

10.3386/w10533.abstract: If interest rates (country spreads) rise, debt can rapidly be subject to a snowball effect, which then becomes self-fulfilling with regard to the fundamentals themselves.This is a market imperfection, because we cannot be confident that the unaided market will choose the "good equilibrium" over the "bad equilibrium".We see here a fundamental flaw in the process of market discipline.We propose a policy intervention to deal with this structural weakness in the mechanisms of international capital flows.This is based on a simple taxonomy that enables us to break down the origin of crises into three components: a crisis of confidence (spreads and currency crisis), a crisis of fundamentals (real growth rate), and a crisis of economic policy (primary deficit).The policy would seek to shortcircuit confidence crises, partly by using IMF support to improve ex ante incentives.
10.3386/w10533.abstract_zh: 如果利率（国家利差）上升，债务可能迅速陷入雪球效应，进而对基本面本身产生自我实现的机制。这是一种市场缺陷，因为我们无法确信未受干预的市场会在“坏均衡”与“好均衡”之间选择后者。在此，我们看到了市场纪律运行过程中的一个根本性缺陷。为此，我们提出一项政策干预方案，以应对国际资本流动机制中的这一结构性弱点。该方案基于一个简单的分类框架，将危机根源分解为三个组成部分：信心危机（利差与货币危机）、基本面危机（实际增长率）以及经济政策危机（基本赤字）。该政策旨在通过部分借助国际货币基金组织的支持来改善事前激励，从而阻断信心危机的传导链条。
10.3386/w10533.title: Dealing with Destabilizing 'Market Discipline'
10.3386/w10533.title_zh: 应对破坏稳定的“市场纪律

10.3386/w16640.abstract: this paper, we present a simple model that can account for the observed effects of financial liberalization. The model emphasizes the role of imperfect enforcement of domestic debts and the interactions between domestic and international financial transactions. In the model, financial liberalization might lead to different outcomes: (i) domestic capital flight and ambiguous effects on net capital flows, investment, and growth; (ii) large capital inflows and higher investment and growth; or (iii) volatile capital flows and unstable domestic financial markets. The model shows how these outcomes depend on the level of development, the depth of domestic financial markets, and the quality of institutions
10.3386/w16640.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个简约模型，用以解释金融自由化可观测到的效应。该模型着重强调了国内债务执行不完善的作用，以及国内与国际金融交易之间的相互作用。在模型中，金融自由化可能导致三种不同结果：（i）国内资本外逃，且对净资本流动、投资和增长产生不确定影响；（ii）大规模资本流入，伴随投资与增长提升；（iii）资本流动波动加剧，国内金融市场不稳定。模型揭示了这些结果如何取决于发展水平、国内金融市场深度以及制度质量。

10.3386/w21397.abstract: This paper studies growth and structural transformation of the Chinese economy from 1953 to 2012 through a lens of a two‐sector growth model. The main goal of the paper is to provide a systematic analysis of both the pre‐1978 reform and post‐1978 reform periods in a unified framework. First, we construct a dataset that allows the application of the neoclassical model and computation of wedges, their components, and rates of TFP growth. Second, we determine the key quantitative factors behind growth and structural transformation. The changes in the intersectoral labor wedge play the dominant role in accounting for the change in the share of labor force in agriculture. TFP growth and changes in the intersectoral wedges are the two most significant factors contributing to GDP growth. Further decomposing the effects of reduction in wedges, we find that two components: the production component (the gap between the ratio of the marginal products of labor and relative wages) and the consumption component (the gap between the marginal rate of substitution and the relative prices) play a particularly large role. Third, we use the pre‐reform period as a key benchmark to measure the success of the post‐1978 reforms. We show that reforms yielded a significant growth and structural transformation differential. GDP growth is 4.2 percentage points higher and the share of the labor force in agriculture is 23.9 percentage points lower compared with the continuation of the pre‐1978 policies. We provide extensive historical evidence for the reforms that are consistent with the evolution of the components of the wedges. The decrease in the production component of the intersectoral wedge is consistent with increased competition and demonopolization of the economy. The decrease in the consumption component of the wedge is consistent with the price and housing reforms. Finally, we project the path of the Chinese economy until 2050 and also calculate a lower bound on future growth by projecting pre‐reform trends.
10.3386/w21397.abstract_zh: 本文通过两部门增长模型的视角，研究了中国经济从1953年至2012年的增长与结构转型。本文的主要目标是在统一框架下，对1978年改革前及改革后两个时期进行系统性分析。首先，我们构建了一个数据集，使得新古典模型的应用及楔子、其组成部分及全要素生产率增长率的计算成为可能。其次，我们确定了增长与结构转型背后的关键量化因素。部门间劳动力楔子的变化在解释农业劳动力份额变化中起着主导作用。全要素生产率增长与部门间楔子的变化是促进GDP增长的两个最重要因素。进一步分解楔子减少的影响，我们发现两个组成部分：生产组成部分（劳动力边际产品比率与相对工资之间的差距）和消费组成部分（边际替代率与相对价格之间的差距）发挥了特别重要的作用。第三，我们以改革前时期作为关键基准，来衡量1978年后改革成功的程度。我们表明，改革带来了显著的增长与结构转型差异。与延续1978年前政策相比，GDP增长率高出4.2个百分点，农业劳动力份额低23.9个百分点。我们提供了广泛的历史证据，证明改革与楔子各组成部分的演变相一致。部门间楔子生产组成部分的下降与经济竞争加剧及去垄断化相符。楔子消费组成部分的下降与价格及住房改革相符。最后，我们预测了中国经济直至2050年的路径，并通过预测改革前趋势，计算了未来增长的下限。

10.3386/w21430.abstract: The unemployment rate in the euro area appears to contain a significant nonstationary component, suggesting that some shocks have permanent effects on that variable. I explore possible sources of this nonstationarity through the lens of a New Keynesian model with unemployment, and assess their empirical relevance.
10.3386/w21430.abstract_zh: 欧元区的失业率似乎包含显著的非平稳成分，这表明某些冲击对该变量具有永久性影响。我通过一个包含失业的新凯恩斯主义模型的视角，探讨了这种非平稳性的可能来源，并评估了它们的实证相关性。
10.3386/w21430.title: Hysteresis and the European Unemployment Problem Revisited
10.3386/w21430.title_zh: 滞后效应与欧洲失业问题再探讨

10.3386/w21987.abstract: this paper, we examine whether another form of human capital, health, is also largely transmitted from generation to generation, contributing to limited socio-economic mobility. Using data from the NLSY, we first present new evidence on intergenerational transmission of health outcomes in the U.S., including weight, height, the body mass index (BMI), asthma and depression for both natives and immigrants. We show that both native and immigrant children inherit a prominent fraction of their health status from their parents, and that, on average, immigrants experience higher persistence than natives in weight and BMI. We also find that mothers’ education decreases children’s weight and BMI for natives, while single motherhood increases weight and BMI for both native and immigrant children. Finally, we find that the longer immigrants remain in the U.S., the less intergenerational persistence there is and the more immigrants look like native children. Unfortunately, the more generations immigrant families remain in the U.S., the more children of immigrants resemble natives’ higher weights, higher BMI and increased propensity to suffer from asthma.
10.3386/w21987.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了另一种形式的人力资本——健康，是否也很大程度上代际传递，从而限制了社会经济流动性。利用NLSY数据，我们首先提供了美国健康结果代际传递的新证据，包括体重、身高、身体质量指数（BMI）、哮喘和抑郁，覆盖本土居民和移民群体。我们发现，本土和移民儿童均从父母那里继承了相当比例的健康状况，且平均而言，移民在体重和BMI上的代际持续性高于本土居民。我们还发现，母亲的教育水平降低了本土儿童的体重和BMI，而单亲母亲身份则增加了本土和移民儿童的体重和BMI。最后，我们发现，移民在美国居住时间越长，代际持续性越低，移民儿童越接近本土儿童的特征。不幸的是，移民家庭在美国的代际越多，移民后代越倾向于呈现本土儿童的高体重、高BMI及更高的哮喘易感性。
10.3386/w21987.title: Intergenerational Persistence of Health in the U.S.: Do Immigrants Get Healthier as they Assimilate?
10.3386/w21987.title_zh: 美国健康代际持续性：移民同化过程中健康状况是否改善？

10.3386/w23916.abstract: this paper, we draw on new high-resolution evidence to document how amenities vary across space within twenty developing countries. We focus on measures of health, housing quality, crime and pollution. These vary substantially across space, and they can be carefully measured with highly comparable data. We find that in almost all countries, and for almost all measures, amenities are constant or increasing in population density. In addition, net internal migration flows are directed toward denser areas in every country. These findings are hard to reconcile with a spatial equilibrium. Instead, they suggest that developing countries are undergoing a reallocation of workers to densely populated areas, which offer higher living standards on average.
10.3386/w23916.abstract_zh: 本文利用新的高分辨率证据，记录了二十个发展中国家中便利设施在空间上的分布差异。我们重点关注健康、住房质量、犯罪和污染等方面的指标。这些指标在空间上差异显著，且可通过高度可比的数据进行精确测量。我们发现，在几乎所有国家及几乎所有指标中，便利设施随人口密度保持恒定或呈增加趋势。此外，每个国家的净内部迁移流均指向人口更密集的地区。这些发现难以与空间均衡理论相协调。相反，它们表明发展中国家正经历劳动力向人口密集区域重新配置的过程，这些区域平均而言提供了更高的生活水平。
10.3386/w23916.title: In Search of a Spatial Equilibrium in the Developing World
10.3386/w23916.title_zh: 探索发展中国家的空间均衡

10.3386/w24684.abstract: this paper is to simultaneously unbundle two interacting reduced-form building blocks of traditional macroeconomic models: the representative agent and the aggregate production function. We introduce a broad class of disaggregated general equilibrium models with Heterogeneous Agents and Input-Output networks (HA-IO). We characterize their properties through two sets of results describing the propagation and the aggregation of shocks. Our results shed light on many seemingly disparate applied questions, such as: sectoral comovement in business cycles; factor-biased technical change in task-based models; structural transformation; the effects of corporate taxation; and the dependence of fiscal multipliers on the composition of government spending.
10.3386/w24684.abstract_zh: 本文旨在同时解构传统宏观经济模型中两个相互作用的简化构建模块：代表性主体与总量生产函数。我们引入了一类广泛的异质性主体与投入产出网络（HA-IO）的分散化一般均衡模型。通过两组描述冲击传播与加总的结果，我们刻画了这些模型的性质。我们的研究为许多看似分散的应用问题提供了启示，例如：商业周期中的部门联动；基于任务模型中的要素偏向型技术变革；结构转型；企业税收的影响；以及财政乘数对政府支出构成的依赖性。
10.3386/w24684.title: Macroeconomics with Heterogeneous Agents and Input-Output Networks
10.3386/w24684.title_zh: 异质性主体与投入产出网络下的宏观经济学

10.3386/w29702.abstract: Statistically significant results are more rewarded than insignificant ones, so researchers have the incentive to pursue statistical significance. Such p-hacking reduces the informativeness of hypothesis tests by making significant results much more common than they are supposed to be in the absence of true significance. To address this problem, we construct critical values of test statistics such that, if these values are used to determine significance, and if researchers optimally respond to these new significance standards, then significant results occur with the desired frequency. Such incentive-compatible critical values allow for p-hacking so they are larger than classical critical values. Using evidence from the social and medical sciences, we find that the incentive-compatible critical value for any test and any significance level is the classical critical value for the same test with approximately one fifth of the significance level-a form of Bonferroni correction. For instance, for a z-test with a significance level of 5%, the incentivecompatible critical value is 2.31 instead of 1.65 if the test is one-sided and 2.57 instead of 1.96 if the test is two-sided.
10.3386/w29702.abstract_zh: 统计上显著的结果比不显著的结果获得更多奖励，因此研究者有动机追求统计显著性。这种p-hacking行为使得显著结果远比在无真实效应时应出现的频率更为常见，从而降低了假设检验的信息量。为解决这一问题，我们构建了检验统计量的临界值，使得若采用这些值判定显著性，且研究者对这些新显著性标准作出最优反应，则显著结果将以期望频率出现。这种激励相容的临界值允许p-hacking存在，因此它们大于经典临界值。利用社会科学和医学领域的证据，我们发现，对于任何检验和任何显著性水平，激励相容的临界值等同于同一检验在约五分之一显著性水平下的经典临界值——这是一种Bonferroni校正形式。例如，对于显著性水平为5%的z检验，若为单侧检验，激励相容的临界值为2.31而非1.65；若为双侧检验，则为2.57而非1.96。

10.3386/w29936.abstract: We show how to use field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and their associated high-level synthesis (HLS) compilers to solve heterogeneous agent models with incomplete markets and aggregate uncertainty (Krusell and Smith, 1998). We document that the acceleration delivered by one single FPGA is comparable to that provided by using 74 CPU cores in a conventional cluster. We describe how to achieve multiple acceleration opportunities—pipeline, data-level parallelism, and data precision—with minimal modification of the C code written for a traditional sequential processor, which we then deploy on FPGAs easily available at Amazon Web Services. We quantify the speedup and cost of these accelerations. Our paper is the first step toward a new field, electrical engineering economics, focused on designing computational accelerators for economics to tackle challenging quantitative models.
10.3386/w29936.abstract_zh: 我们展示了如何利用现场可编程门阵列（FPGAs）及其相关的高级综合（HLS）编译器，来解决具有不完全市场和总体不确定性的异质主体模型（Krusell and Smith, 1998）。我们记录到，单个FPGA提供的加速效果可与传统集群中使用74个CPU核心相媲美。我们描述了如何以对传统顺序处理器编写的C代码进行最小修改的方式，实现多种加速机会——流水线、数据级并行和数据精度——随后将这些代码部署在亚马逊网络服务上易于获取的FPGAs上。我们量化了这些加速带来的速度提升和成本。我们的论文是向新领域——电气工程经济学——迈出的第一步，该领域专注于为经济学设计计算加速器，以应对具有挑战性的定量模型。

10.3386/w30731.abstract: Diversity poses fundamental challenges to state-building and development. We study the effects of one of post-colonial Africa's largest policy experiments -the Tanzanian Ujamaa policywhich attempted to address these challenges. Ujamaa aimed to create a national identity and consolidate state authority by mandating a highly diverse population to live in planned villages, where children received political education. We combine differences in exposure to Ujamaa across space and age to identify long-term impacts of the policy. We show persistent, positive effects on national identity based on surveys and inter-ethnic marriages. We observe no systematic differences for cohorts that were above or below treatment-age during Ujamaa. Our preferred interpretation, supported by evidence that considers alternative hypotheses, is that changes to educational content drive our findings. Moreover, while Ujamaa contributed to establishing the Tanzanian state as a legitimate central authority, it appears to have lowered demands for democratic accountability.
10.3386/w30731.abstract_zh: 多样性对国家建设和发展构成根本性挑战。我们研究了后殖民时代非洲最大规模的政策实验之一——坦桑尼亚的乌贾马政策——该政策旨在应对这些挑战。乌贾马试图通过强制高度多样化的民众居住于规划村庄，并在其中对儿童进行政治教育，来构建国家认同并巩固国家权威。我们结合了乌贾马政策在空间和年龄上的暴露差异，以识别该政策的长期影响。基于调查和跨族裔婚姻的数据，我们展示了该政策对国家认同具有持续且积极的影响。对于乌贾马时期处于或超过治疗年龄的队列，我们未观察到系统性差异。我们更倾向于的解释是，教育内容的改变驱动了我们的发现，这一解释得到了考虑替代假说的证据支持。此外，尽管乌贾马政策有助于确立坦桑尼亚国家作为合法中央权威的地位，但它似乎降低了对民主问责的要求。
10.3386/w30731.title: State-Building in a Diverse Society
10.3386/w30731.title_zh: 多元社会中的国家建设

10.3386/w32779.abstract: We use Bayesian meta-analysis methods to estimate the impact of unconditional cash transfers (UCTs).Aggregating evidence from 115 studies of 72 UCT programs in middle and low income countries, we find strong and positive average treatment effects on ten of thirteen outcomes: monthly household total and food consumption, monthly income, labor supply, school enrollment, food security, psychological well-being, total assets, financial assets, and children height-for-age.We examine seven specific theoretical and policy hypotheses, such as presence of savings frictions, dynamic effects, curvature of marginal returns, targeting effects, "nudge" effects, labor supply elasticity and related "dependency" theories, and contextual heterogeneity.
10.3386/w32779.abstract_zh: 我们采用贝叶斯元分析方法来评估无条件现金转移（UCTs）的影响。汇总来自中低收入国家72个UCT项目的115项研究证据，我们发现，在十三个结果指标中，有十个显示出强烈且正面的平均处理效应：月度家庭总消费与食品消费、月度收入、劳动力供给、学校入学率、食品安全、心理健康、总资产、金融资产以及儿童身高年龄比。我们考察了七个具体的理论与政策假设，包括储蓄摩擦的存在、动态效应、边际收益的曲率、目标定位效应、“助推”效应、劳动力供给弹性及相关“依赖”理论，以及情境异质性。

10.3386/w33079.abstract: Utilizing critical recent data advances, we analyze empirical evidence on long-run samples of shortmaturity real interest rates as well as term spreads based on multi-century data.In contrast to an extensive literature on short-maturity real interest rates over the past few decades, we find strong and consistent evidence of trend stationarity in long horizon series, relatively fast adjustment speeds, and a paucity of structural breaks -results that we show to survive out of sample tests.The use of very long-run data offers a fresh perspective for ongoing monetary policy debates surrounding r*, and also provides a crucial missing link to reconstructing the long-run properties of term spreads.On balance and against limited post-COVID data, our evidence suggests caution on the idea of a break in short-term real interest rate behavior and instead points to elements of continuity over very long time periods.Relatedly, we show that term spreads are secularly rising while inflation volatility trends in the exact opposite direction -a finding questioning the emphasis of influential term structure models.
10.3386/w33079.abstract_zh: 利用近期关键数据进展，我们基于多世纪数据，对短期实际利率的长期样本及期限利差进行了实证分析。与过去几十年来关于短期实际利率的大量文献不同，我们发现长期时间序列中存在强烈且一致的趋势平稳性证据，调整速度相对较快，且结构性断裂较少——这些结果在样本外测试中依然稳健。利用超长期数据为围绕r*的现行货币政策辩论提供了新视角，同时也为重构期限利差的长期特性提供了关键缺失环节。总体而言，面对有限的疫情后数据，我们的证据提示应对短期实际利率行为发生断裂的观点持谨慎态度，反而指向了极长时间跨度上的连续性要素。相关地，我们显示期限利差呈长期上升趋势，而通胀波动性趋势则完全相反——这一发现对具有影响力的期限结构模型的侧重点提出了质疑。

10.3386/w33377.abstract: How do environmental goods and policies shape spatial patterns of economic activity? How will climate change modify these impacts over the coming decades? How do agglomeration, commuting, and other spatial forces and policies affect environmental quality? We distill theoretical and empirical research linking urban, regional, and spatial economics to the environment. We present stylized facts on spatial environmental economics, describe insights from canonical environmental models and spatial models, and discuss the building blocks for papers and the research frontier in enviro-spatial economics. Most enviro-spatial research remains bifurcated into either primarily environmental or spatial papers. Research is only beginning to realize potential insights from more closely combining spatial and environmental approaches.
10.3386/w33377.abstract_zh: 环境商品与政策如何塑造经济活动的空间格局？气候变化将在未来几十年如何改变这些影响？集聚、通勤及其他空间力量和政策又如何影响环境质量？我们梳理了将城市、区域及空间经济学与环境领域相连接的理论与实证研究。我们呈现了空间环境经济学的典型事实，描述了经典环境模型与空间模型的洞见，并探讨了论文构建的要素及环境-空间经济学的研究前沿。多数环境-空间研究仍主要分为以环境为主或以空间为主的论文。研究才刚刚开始意识到更紧密地结合空间与环境方法所能带来的潜在洞见。
10.3386/w33377.title: Spatial Environmental Economics

10.3386/w33385.abstract: this paper measures the progressivity of taxes and transfers at the U.S. federal level and separately for each state. The findings are as follows. (i) The federal tax and transfer system is progressive. (ii) State and local tax and transfer systems are close to proportional, on average. (iii) There is substantial heterogeneity in tax levels and tax progressivity across states. (iv) States that are funded mostly by sales and property taxes tend to have regressive tax systems and low average tax rates. States that are funded mostly by income taxes tend to have progressive tax systems and high average tax rates. (v) Regressive states are concentrated in the South and attract more inter-state net migration, especially of high-income migrants. (vi) State progressivity has remained broadly stable between 2005 and 2016. (vii) Incorporating corporate income and business taxes decreases average state progressivity but increases federal progressivity. (viii) Including spending on public goods and services as a transfer has a large positive impact on measured progressivity.
10.3386/w33385.abstract_zh: 本文衡量了美国联邦层面及各个州分别的税收与转移支付的累进性。研究发现如下：（i）联邦税收与转移支付体系具有累进性。（ii）州及地方税收与转移支付体系平均而言接近比例性。（iii）各州在税收水平和税收累进性上存在显著差异。（iv）主要依赖销售税和财产税的州往往拥有累退性税收体系和较低的平均税率；而主要依赖所得税的州则倾向于拥有累进性税收体系和较高的平均税率。（v）累退性州集中在南部，并吸引了更多的跨州净迁移，尤其是高收入移民。（vi）2005年至2016年间，各州的累进性总体保持稳定。（vii）将公司所得税和营业税纳入考量后，平均州级累进性下降，但联邦累进性上升。（viii）将公共物品和服务的支出视为转移支付，对测得的累进性有显著的正面影响。
10.3386/w33385.title: Fiscal Progressivity of the U.S. Federal and State Governments
10.3386/w33385.title_zh: 美国联邦与州政府的财政累进性

10.3386/w33929.abstract: Macro shocks produce high dispersion in firm-level equity returns, sales growth, and other outcomes.We show that this dispersion reflects observable differences in business characteristics.To do so, we combine firm-level returns on stock market ``jump" days with text about business risks in prior 10-K filings to construct firm-specific shock exposures.Our exposure measures explain firm-level abnormal returns through interpretable variation in language.They also explain most of the increased dispersion in firm-level revenue growth after major shocks and much of the dispersion in employment growth, investment rates, and earnings surprises.Our evidence yields a novel interpretation for countercyclical dispersion, highlighting the key role of heterogeneous business characteristics in macro shock transmission.
10.3386/w33929.abstract_zh: 宏观冲击导致企业层面的股票回报率、销售增长及其他经营结果出现高度离散。我们证明，这种离散反映了企业特征中可观察到的差异。为此，我们将股票市场“跳跃”日的企业层面回报与先前10-K文件中的业务风险文本相结合，构建企业特定的冲击暴露度指标。我们的暴露度衡量指标通过语言中可解释的变化，解释了企业层面的异常回报。这些指标还解释了重大冲击后企业层面收入增长离散度增加的大部分，以及就业增长、投资率和盈利惊喜离散度的很大一部分。我们的证据为逆周期离散提供了新的解释，强调了异质性企业特征在宏观冲击传导中的关键作用。
10.3386/w33929.title: Macro Shocks and Firm-Level Response Heterogeneity
10.3386/w33929.title_zh: 宏观冲击与企业层面的响应异质性

10.3386/w34391.abstract: China's unprecedented expansion of higher education in 1999, increased annual college enrollment from 1 million to 9.6 million by 2020.We trace the global ripple effects of that expansion by examining its impact on US graduate education and local economies surrounding college towns.Combining administrative data from China's college admissions system and US visa data, we leverage the centralized quota system governing Chinese college admissions for identification and present three key findings.First, the expansion of Chinese undergraduate education drove graduate student flows to the US: every additional 100 college graduates in China led to 3.6 Chinese graduate students in the US.Second, Chinese master's students generated positive spillovers, driving the birth of new master's programs, and increasing the number of other international and American master's students, particularly in STEM fields.And third, the influx of international students supported local economies around college towns, raising job creation rates outside the universities, as well.Our findings highlight how domestic education policy in one country can reshape the academic and economic landscape of another through student migration and its broader spillovers.
10.3386/w34391.abstract_zh: 中国1999年启动的高等教育史无前例的扩招，使年度大学招生人数从100万增至2020年的960万。我们通过考察该扩招对美国研究生教育及大学城周边地方经济的影响，追溯其全球涟漪效应。结合中国高考录取系统的行政数据与美国签证数据，我们利用中国大学录取的集中配额制度进行识别，并提出三项核心发现。第一，中国本科教育的扩张推动了赴美研究生流动：中国每增加100名本科毕业生，美国便增加3.6名中国研究生。第二，中国硕士生产生正向溢出效应，催生新硕士项目的设立，并带动其他国际学生及美国本土硕士生人数增长，尤其在STEM领域表现显著。第三，国际学生涌入为大学城周边地方经济提供支撑，同时提升了大学外部就业岗位的创造率。我们的研究揭示了一国国内教育政策如何通过学生迁移及其广泛溢出效应，重塑另一国的学术与经济格局。

10.3386/w34625.abstract: We examine the short-term employment effects of the act. Drawing on quarterly industry-by-county data from the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW), we implement two county-level difference-in-difference designs, the first comparing counties with pre-existing semiconductor facilities to other counties with high-tech industries and the second comparing counties with semiconductor fabrication facilities (which were targeted for the bulk of the CHIPS funding) to counties with non-fabrication semiconductor facilities. Using both approaches, we find robust, positive employment impacts in affected counties. The effects began at the time of the passage in the Senate of a precursor bill, in anticipation of the signing of the CHIPS Act. Our preferred estimates suggest an increase of 110 jobs per affected county in the first design and 180 jobs per affected county in the second design. We also find robust positive impacts on local construction employment. Evidence on total employment and GDP at the county level, as well as on employment in upstream input sectors, is mixed. Simple back-of-the-envelope calculations (which come with caveats) suggest national direct employment effects of approximately 15,000-16,000 jobs in the core semiconductor sector and indirect effects of 28,000-35,000 jobs in related sectors.
10.3386/w34625.abstract_zh: 我们考察了该法案的短期就业效应。利用《季度就业与工资普查》（QCEW）中的季度行业-县数据，我们实施了两种县级双重差分设计：第一种比较了已有半导体设施的县与其他拥有高科技产业的县，第二种比较了设有半导体制造设施（这些设施获得了《芯片法案》大部分资金）的县与设有非制造类半导体设施的县。通过这两种方法，我们发现受影响县出现了稳健的正向就业影响。这些效应始于参议院通过一项前驱法案之时，即市场预期《芯片法案》将签署之际。我们的首选估计显示，第一种设计中每个受影响县增加110个工作岗位，第二种设计中每个受影响县增加180个工作岗位。我们还发现对当地建筑就业产生了稳健的正向影响。关于县级总就业和GDP，以及上游投入部门就业的证据则较为混杂。简单的粗略估算（附带一定条件）表明，核心半导体部门的全国直接就业效应约为15,000至16,000个工作岗位，相关部门的间接效应为28,000至35,000个工作岗位。
10.3386/w34625.title: Employment Impacts of the CHIPS Act

10.3386/w34715.abstract: The monumental task of rebuilding postwar Ukraine requires early planning and identification of growth strategies.The earlier accession of Eastern European countries to the European Union and NATO offers a template that relies on massive foreign direct investment and public structural funds.This approach helps to raise incomes directly and can create a virtuous circle where capital deepening facilitates technological upgrades and repatriation of war refugees, which in turn stimulate more investment.We show theoretically that the government can refine this strategy by internalizing positive externalities from having a higher capital stock: Investment in physical capital relaxes borrowing constraints (thus allowing more capital inflows) and raises wages (thus encouraging more Ukrainian refugees to return home).
10.3386/w34715.abstract_zh: 重建战后乌克兰的艰巨任务需要早期规划并明确增长战略。东欧国家早前加入欧盟和北约提供了一个模板，该模板依赖于大规模的外国直接投资和公共结构基金。这种方法有助于直接提高收入，并能形成一种良性循环，其中资本深化促进技术升级和战争难民遣返，进而激发更多投资。我们从理论上表明，政府可以通过内化更高资本存量带来的正外部性来优化这一战略：实物资本投资放宽了借贷约束（从而允许更多资本流入）并提高了工资（从而鼓励更多乌克兰难民回国）。
10.3386/w34715.title: You Only Live Twice: Financial Inflows and Growth in a Westward-Facing Ukraine
10.3386/w34715.title_zh: 《你只活两次：面向西方的乌克兰的资本流入与增长》

10.3386/w34857.abstract: How does the expectation of aid change behavior?We propose a simple approach to separate expectations effects from the direct effects of relaxing resource constraints: compare the promise of a program to the program itself.We test this approach in a four-arm randomized controlled trial of cash transfers in Uganda.Both those who received cash and those promised-to-receive cash increase their labor supply and investment.Immediate transfers also increase household expenditures and savings.Our results are not consistent with standard life-cycle models; they are better explained by a model in which the transfer increases individual labor productivity.
10.3386/w34857.abstract_zh: 援助预期如何改变行为？我们提出了一种简单方法，用以区分预期效应与资源约束放松的直接效应：将项目承诺与项目本身进行比较。我们在乌干达进行的一项四组随机对照试验中，对现金转移支付进行了测试。无论是实际收到现金的群体，还是被承诺将收到现金的群体，其劳动供给和投资均有所增加。即时转移支付还提升了家庭支出和储蓄水平。我们的结果与标准生命周期模型不符；它们更符合一个将转移支付视为提升个体劳动生产率的模型解释。
10.3386/w34857.title: Great Expectations: Responses to Current and Future Transfers for Low-Income Individuals
10.3386/w34857.title_zh: 远大期望：低收入个体对当前及未来转移支付的回应

10.3386/w35182.title: Growth is Getting Harder to Find, Not Ideas
