10.3386/w35366.abstract: When estimating nonlinear models for binary outcomes, such as probit and logit models, researchers often rely on average partial effects (APEs) to summarize the effect of a regressor. Because the marginal effect of a variable in these models depends on the values of all other variables, the value of an APE hinges on the portion of the sample used for the calculations. When averaged over parts of the sample drawn from a subpopulation not used to define the object of interest, the APE may be misleading. This paper highlights common situations, such as differences-in-means with a secondary group and difference-in-differences designs, where APEs calculated for the full sample deviate from marginal effects for the appropriate part of the sample. We propose a simple and costless solution in specific cases and demonstrate through simulations that recalculating APEs over the appropriate subsample yields unbiased results. Reexamining published results from multiple papers, we find statistically significant discrepancies between the reported estimates and the appropriately calculated APEs.
10.3386/w35366.abstract_zh: 在估计二元结果变量的非线性模型（如Probit和Logit模型）时，研究者通常依赖平均偏效应（APEs）来概括解释变量的影响。由于此类模型中变量的边际效应取决于所有其他变量的取值，APEs的数值会因计算时使用的样本范围不同而产生差异。当基于非目标子总体抽取的部分样本计算平均值时，APEs可能产生误导性结论。本文聚焦常见研究情境（如含次级分组的均值差异分析及双重差分设计），揭示全样本计算的APEs与目标子样本边际效应之间的系统性偏差。我们针对特定情形提出简单零成本的解决方案，并通过模拟实验证明：在适当子样本上重新计算APEs可获得无偏估计结果。通过重新检验多篇已发表论文的实证结果，我们发现其报告估计值与正确计算的APEs之间存在统计显著的差异。
10.3386/w35366.title: Misleading Estimates from Nonlinear Models with a Binary Outcome
10.3386/w35366.title_zh: 二元结果非线性模型的误导性估计

10.3386/w35367.abstract: Many effects of pollution exposure on health and education outcomes of children have been identified, but little is known about education effects on preschool-aged children. We estimate the effect of particulate matter air pollution on preschool attendance using restricted administrative data from the state of Georgia. We use thermal inversions, weather phenomena that trap pollutants, as an instrumental variable for pollution. A one-unit increase in the county-week average ambient particulate pollution level decreases attendance by around 2 percentage points. Effects seem to be larger for racial minorities and for children with working parents.
10.3386/w35367.abstract_zh: 已有研究证实污染暴露对儿童健康与教育成果的多重影响，但关于污染对学龄前儿童教育的影响仍知之甚少。本研究利用佐治亚州的受限行政数据，评估颗粒物空气污染对学前教育出勤率的影响。我们采用热逆温现象（一种滞留污染物的天气现象）作为污染的工具变量。结果显示，县级周均环境颗粒物污染水平每增加一个单位，出勤率下降约2个百分点。该效应在少数族裔儿童及父母双职工家庭中更为显著。
10.3386/w35367.title: Air Pollution and Early Childhood Outcomes: Evidence from Georgia Childcare Providers
10.3386/w35367.title_zh: 空气污染与儿童早期发展结果：来自佐治亚州儿童保育机构的证据

10.3386/w35368.abstract: People with disabilities are disproportionately represented in low-wage work, raising concerns that higher wage floors may reduce their employment opportunities, particularly for workers with more severe disabilities. We examine the effects of state minimum wage increases and state subminimum wage terminations on employment outcomes for people with disabilities using American Community Survey data from 2010–2023. We find little evidence that minimum wage increases reduce employment or labor force participation among people with disabilities, including those with more severe disabilities. While many estimates are statistically imprecise, confidence intervals generally rule out economically meaningful negative employment effects. We likewise find no evidence that terminating subminimum wages reduces employment opportunities for affected workers, and some estimates suggest positive employment effects for groups most likely to have been employed under subminimum wage arrangements. These gains may reflect complementary policies that often accompany repeal, such as Employment First initiatives. Overall, the results provide little support for the view that higher wage floors create disproportionate employment barriers for people with disabilities.
10.3386/w35368.abstract_zh: 残疾人在低薪工作中占比过高，这引发担忧：更高的工资下限可能减少其就业机会，尤其是对残疾程度更重的劳动者。我们利用2010-2023年美国社区调查数据，研究各州最低工资上调及取消次级最低工资对残疾人就业结果的影响。研究发现，几乎没有证据表明最低工资上调会降低残疾人（包括重度残疾者）的就业率或劳动参与率。尽管许多估计值在统计上不够精确，但置信区间通常排除了具有经济意义的负面就业效应。同样，我们未发现取消次级最低工资会减少受影响劳动者的就业机会，部分估计甚至表明，最可能受次级最低工资制度影响的群体出现了积极就业效应。这些改善可能源于伴随废除政策实施的配套措施（如“就业优先”计划）。总体而言，研究结果不支持“更高工资下限会为残疾人制造不成比例的就业障碍”这一观点。
10.3386/w35368.title: Do Wage Floors Increase Employment Risk for Workers with Disabilities? Evidence from Minimum Wage Increases and Subminimum Wage Repeal
10.3386/w35368.title_zh: 最低工资标准是否增加了残疾工人的就业风险？来自最低工资上调与次最低工资废除的证据

10.3386/w35369.abstract: This paper studies the effect of unanticipated inflation in the labor market. When wages are contracted in nominal terms, inflation reduces real wages, leading workers to intensify on-the-job search to obtain wage-adjusting outside offers. Both the search effort and the resulting job mobility are costly, yet that same mobility raises output by moving workers toward more productive matches. To quantify these costs and benefits, we extend the canonical job ladder of Postel-Vinay and Robin (2002) to a nominal environment with privately chosen search effort, and calibrate it to standard moments from the pre-pandemic US labor market. A one-time inflation shock scaled to the COVID episode generates an average welfare loss of 0.44% of consumption, with workers at the top of the wage distribution bearing losses over six times those at the bottom. Once the offsetting transfer of surplus to firms and productivity gains from reallocation are accounted for, the net aggregate cost is close to zero. Second, inflation volatility imposes asymmetric costs: worker welfare is approximately invariant to the volatility regime because firms compensate workers for expected search costs at hiring, but social welfare declines meaningfully because the resource cost of search effort is not undone by compensation. This second finding identifies a distinct, labor-market source of welfare costs from inflation volatility, complementing the price-dispersion costs emphasized in the New Keynesian literature.
10.3386/w35369.abstract_zh: 本文研究了劳动力市场中未预期通胀的影响。当工资以名义条款签订合同时，通胀会降低实际工资，促使劳动者加强在职搜寻以获得能够调整工资的外部工作机会。搜寻努力及其引发的岗位流动均存在成本，但岗位流动通过将劳动者配置到更具生产力的匹配岗位中提升了产出。为量化这些成本与收益，我们将Postel-Vinay和Robin（2002）的经典工作阶梯模型扩展至包含私人选择搜寻努力的名义环境，并基于疫情前美国劳动力市场的标准矩进行校准。一次与新冠疫情规模相当的一次性通胀冲击会导致平均福利损失相当于消费的0.44%，其中工资分布顶端的劳动者承担的损失是底端劳动者的六倍以上。若考虑企业获得的剩余转移以及岗位再配置带来的生产率提升，净总成本接近于零。其次，通胀波动性会带来非对称成本：劳动者福利几乎不受波动性制度的影响，因为企业在雇佣时会补偿劳动者预期的搜寻成本；但社会福利显著下降，因为搜寻努力的资源成本无法通过补偿抵消。这一发现揭示了通胀波动性在劳动力市场中独特的福利成本来源，补充了新凯恩斯主义文献中强调的价格离散成本。
10.3386/w35369.title: The Search Costs of Inflation in the Labor Market
10.3386/w35369.title_zh: 劳动力市场中通胀的搜寻成本

10.3386/w35370.abstract: We evaluate a parent-directed empathy development program for middle school students in China using a randomized trial with 2,246 students. The four-month mobile app intervention produced short-run gains in empathy and reduced bullying but no immediate academic effects. Over the longer term, treatment students were 3.2 percentage points more likely to enter elite high schools and 2.5 percentage points less likely to miss the entrance exam. We trace these gains to improved self-beliefs and a restructuring of classroom friendship networks that reduced academic homophily, revealing a social channel of cross-productivity: non-cognitive investments can reshape peer relationships to improve academic outcomes.
10.3386/w35370.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项包含2,246名学生的随机试验，评估了一项针对中国中学生、由家长指导的共情发展项目。为期四个月的移动应用干预在短期内提升了学生的共情能力并减少了欺凌行为，但未对学业成绩产生即时影响。从长期来看，实验组学生进入重点高中的概率提高了3.2个百分点，而错过升学考试的概率降低了2.5个百分点。我们将这些成效归因于学生自我信念的改善以及课堂友谊网络的重构——后者降低了学业同质性，揭示了一种跨领域生产力的社会传导机制：非认知能力投资能够重塑同伴关系，进而提升学业表现。
10.3386/w35370.title: Empathy, Social Networks, and Academic Achievement: Experimental Evidence on Cross-Productivity in Skill Formation
10.3386/w35370.title_zh: 共情、社交网络与学业成就：技能形成中交叉生产率的实验证据

10.3386/w35371.abstract: What factors drove human migration before modern states, markets, and borders? We develop a sorting framework in which climate-specific subsistence knowledge depreciates with ecological distance. To test this, we use ancient DNA identity-by-descent segments to construct bilateral migration flows across Western Eurasia over the last 10,000 years. We document three main findings. First, migration flows decline with differences in growing degree days, precipitation, and soil characteristics between origins and destinations. Second, the binding factor varies across subsistence systems: farmers exhibit strong thermal and soil matching, while pastoralists match most strongly on precipitation. Third, periods of warming increase farmer expansion while cooling increases pastoral expansion in patterns that recover known archaeological migration episodes. Migration also acts as a margin of climate adaptation: populations exposed to temperature change move to destinations that partly offset the shift.
10.3386/w35371.abstract_zh: 在现代国家、市场和边界形成之前，哪些因素驱动了人类迁徙？我们构建了一个分类框架，其中特定气候的生存知识会随生态距离的增加而贬值。为验证这一理论，我们利用古DNA中的同源片段数据，构建了过去一万年间欧亚大陆西部的双边迁徙流。研究得出三项主要发现：第一，迁徙流随原住地与目的地之间生长度日、降水量及土壤特征差异的扩大而递减；第二，不同生计系统中的约束因素存在差异——农耕者表现出强烈的热量与土壤匹配性，而游牧者则对降水量匹配最为显著；第三，气候变暖时期促进农耕者扩张，而气候变冷时期则推动游牧者扩张，其模式与已知考古迁徙事件相吻合。迁徙同时构成气候适应的调节机制：经历温度变化的人口会迁往能部分抵消气候偏移的目的地。
10.3386/w35371.title: Climate and Prehistoric Migration

10.3386/w35373.abstract: We examine how state policies requiring firms to facilitate workplace retirement saving affect household balance sheets. Using data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP), we compare private-sector workers likely exposed to Oregon’s Automatic-Enrollment Individual Retirement Account (Auto-IRA) policy with similar workers in not-yet-adopting states. We find that the Auto-IRA policy is associated with increases in IRA and employer-sponsored retirement plan ownership and assets. We also find increases in checking or savings account ownership and balances, as well as higher credit card debt. The results suggest that Auto-IRA policies spill over to household liquidity management and borrowing.
10.3386/w35373.abstract_zh: 本文考察了要求企业促进职场退休储蓄的州政策如何影响家庭资产负债表。利用收入与项目参与调查（SIPP）数据，我们将可能受俄勒冈州自动注册个人退休账户（Auto-IRA）政策影响的私营部门员工与尚未实施该政策的州的类似员工进行比较。研究发现，Auto-IRA政策与IRA及雇主资助退休计划的持有率及资产增加相关。同时，该政策还伴随着支票或储蓄账户持有率及余额的提升，以及信用卡债务的增加。结果表明，Auto-IRA政策会溢出至家庭流动性管理与借贷行为。
10.3386/w35373.title: How Do State “Auto-IRA” Policies Affect Household Balance Sheets?
10.3386/w35373.title_zh: 州“自动IRA”政策如何影响家庭资产负债表？

10.3386/w35374.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are lowering the entry barriers to working with exciting data sources that used to require strong data science skills, such as handwritten ledgers, text, images, or sound recordings. This guide provides an introduction for researchers who are new to LLMs. It sets out a step-by-step workflow for turning a research idea into working code and data, and describes the four main ways of interacting with an LLM: the chat window, editor-integrated assistants, agentic coding tools, and the API. It then works through the decisions a practitioner meets in sequence, beginning with whether an LLM is the right tool and whether the data are allowed to be sent to one, then how to select models, write prompts, manage context limits, and control costs, and finally how to validate, reproduce, document, and correct LLM-generated measures in regression settings. A review of recent research shows how these tools already extract, link, harmonize, and classify historical data at scale. Four worked examples with replication files illustrate the use of LLMs. They classify emotions in paintings, link census records without names, measure newspaper salience and sentiment around the 1882 Chinese Exclusion Act, and score the emotional delivery of Franklin D. Roosevelt's wartime speeches. The guide also condenses the workflow, the best-practice recommendations, and the preparation of replication packages into summary tables and checklists to aid applied economists.
10.3386/w35374.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正在降低处理以往需要较强数据科学技能（如手写账本、文本、图像或录音）的优质数据源的准入门槛。本指南为初涉LLM的研究者提供入门指导，系统阐述了将研究构想转化为可运行代码与数据的逐步工作流程，并介绍了与LLM交互的四种主要方式：聊天窗口、编辑器集成助手、自主编码工具及应用程序编程接口（API）。随后，指南按序梳理实践者需应对的决策环节：首先判断LLM是否为合适工具及数据是否允许传输至模型，继而探讨模型选择、提示词编写、上下文限制管理及成本控制策略，最后阐述如何在回归分析场景中验证、复现、记录并修正LLM生成的度量指标。近期研究综述表明，这些工具已能大规模实现历史数据的提取、关联、整合与分类。四个附有复现文件的实操案例展示了LLM的应用场景：对画作中的情感进行分类、无姓名关联人口普查记录、测量1882年《排华法案》相关报纸的显著性与情感倾向，以及评估富兰克林·D·罗斯福战时演讲的情感表达。本指南还将工作流程、最佳实践建议及复现包准备要点凝练为汇总表格与核查清单，以辅助应用经济学研究者。
10.3386/w35374.title: A Practitioner's Guide to Using Large Language Models and Generative AI in Economic History
10.3386/w35374.title_zh: 经济学史中大型语言模型与生成式AI应用实践指南

10.3386/w35375.abstract: Parents may invest differently across children by compensating the disadvantaged child or by reinforcing the child with higher expected returns. We study this question using a conditional cash transfer experiment that uniquely randomized transfers at the student level, generating exogenous variation in transfer exposure across siblings within the same household. The transfers increased short-run attendance among treated students but generated negative spillovers on untreated siblings: untreated siblings of treated students were 3.7 percentage points less likely to graduate from college, a decline of about 30 percent relative to the control mean. We interpret these effects using a dynamic model of household schooling decisions that identifies parental aversion to inequality in children’s educational outcomes. The estimated model implies limited aversion to inequality in children’s educational outcomes and reproduces held-out treatment effects not used in estimation. A decomposition shows that the negative spillover is primarily driven by substitution in educational investments toward the treated child.
10.3386/w35375.abstract_zh: 父母可能会通过补偿处于劣势的孩子或强化预期回报更高的孩子，在不同子女间进行差异化投资。我们利用一项在个体学生层面随机分配转移支付的现金转移实验来研究这一问题，该实验在同一家庭内的兄弟姐妹间产生了外生的转移支付暴露差异。转移支付提高了受助学生的短期出勤率，但对未受助的兄弟姐妹产生了负面溢出效应：受助学生的未受助兄弟姐妹大学毕业的可能性降低了3.7个百分点，相对于对照组均值下降了约30%。我们通过一个家庭学校教育决策的动态模型来解释这些效应，该模型识别出父母对子女教育成果不平等的规避程度。估计模型表明，父母对子女教育成果不平等的规避程度有限，并复现了未用于估计的保留样本中的处理效应。分解分析显示，负面溢出效应主要由教育投资向受助子女的替代效应驱动。
10.3386/w35375.title: Compensation vs. Reinforcement: Experimental Identification of Parental Aversion to Inequality in Offspring
10.3386/w35375.title_zh: 补偿与强化：父母对子女不平等厌恶的实验识别

10.3386/w35376.abstract: What information do policymakers need to design Pigouvian taxes or subsidies? Standard logic suggests that it is sufficient to know the size of the externality and unnecessary to know about quantities. Yet this logic is incorrect if interventions have fixed costs, taxes create deadweight losses, or there are distributional concerns. We present a model in which these considerations can make it more valuable for policymakers to learn about equilibrium quantities. We apply the model to congestion pricing, which has high fixed costs, and to a proposed housing subsidy in Boston that features deadweight losses and distributional concerns.
10.3386/w35376.abstract_zh: 政策制定者设计庇古税或补贴时需要哪些信息？标准逻辑认为，只需了解外部性的大小，无需掌握数量信息。然而，若干预措施存在固定成本、税收产生无谓损失或涉及分配问题，这一逻辑便不再成立。我们构建了一个模型，表明在这些考量下，政策制定者了解均衡数量可能更具价值。我们将该模型应用于具有高固定成本的拥堵定价，以及波士顿一项涉及无谓损失和分配问题的拟议住房补贴。
10.3386/w35376.title: Prices Versus Quantities Revisited: What Do Policymakers Need to Know to Set Pigouvian Taxes and Subsidies?
10.3386/w35376.title_zh: 价格与数量再探讨：政策制定者设定庇古税与补贴需要了解什么？

10.3386/w35377.abstract: This article introduces the evidence and associated modeling frameworks contemporary economists use to understand the effects of trade and trade policy on labor markets, with a particular emphasis on labor-market frictions and adjustment dynamics. The effects of trade shocks differ across industries, regions, and occupations, implying the presence of important adjustment frictions in labor markets, and these effects evolve slowly over time, implying the need for dynamic frameworks rationalizing slow transitions. After reviewing the key insights from this literature, we discuss policies aimed at mitigating costs to workers and ensuring that the gains from trade are shared more equitably.
10.3386/w35377.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了当代经济学家用于理解贸易及贸易政策对劳动力市场影响的实证证据及相关建模框架，特别关注劳动力市场摩擦与调整动态。贸易冲击的影响因行业、地区和职业而异，这表明劳动力市场中存在重要的调整摩擦，且这些影响随时间缓慢演变，意味着需要构建能够解释缓慢转型的动态框架。在梳理该领域关键见解后，本文探讨了旨在减轻工人成本、确保贸易收益更公平分配的政策措施。
10.3386/w35377.title: Labor Market Responses to Tariffs: Frictions, Dynamics, and Policy Responses
10.3386/w35377.title_zh: 关税对劳动力市场的影响：摩擦、动态与政策应对

10.3386/w35378.abstract: We ask how far the choice of which moments to match can push estimates in misspecified structural models. The answer is: very far. Under regularity conditions, an adversarial researcher informed about the data distribution can choose moments that render any parameter value the unique solution to the population moment-matching problem. Moreover, in many cases they can do so with little increase in model-implied standard errors relative to maximum likelihood. We illustrate both results in a menu-cost model.
10.3386/w35378.abstract_zh: 我们探讨在错误设定的结构模型中，选择匹配哪些矩条件能在多大程度上影响估计结果。答案是：影响极大。在正则条件下，一位了解数据分布信息的对抗性研究者可以选择矩条件，使得任何参数值都成为总体矩匹配问题的唯一解。此外，在许多情况下，他们这样做时，模型隐含的标准误相较于最大似然估计仅有微小增加。我们通过一个菜单成本模型对这两个结论进行了说明。
10.3386/w35378.title: The Incredible Flexibility of Moment Matching

10.3386/w35379.abstract: A large share of secular variation in real interest rates can be understood as the effect of monetary policy leaning against experience-based long-run inflation expectations. Survey microdata show that adaptive learning from experienced inflation generates highly persistent, slow-moving long-run inflation expectations. When expectations are shaped by experience, central banks cannot anchor them through communication. Instead, when expectations deviate from the inflation target, monetary policy must remain persistently hawkish or dovish to generate realized inflation outcomes that, through agents’ belief updating, gradually pull long-run expectations back toward the target. Consistent with this mechanism, I find a strong positive relationship between experience-based long-run inflation expectations and real interest rates in the U.S., Germany, the U.K., and Japan. Under their subjective expectations, private-sector agents do not anticipate future reversals in inflation and short-term real interest rates. As a result, long-term real interest rates move with experience-based long-run inflation expectations about as much as short-term real interest rates do, consistent with the data. Secular movements in real rates are also accompanied by persistent patterns in interest-rate forecast errors. Overall, the interaction of monetary policy and learning from experience generates a distinct source of secular real-rate variation, beyond movements in the natural rate of interest.
10.3386/w35379.abstract_zh: 实际利率长期波动的很大一部分可以理解为货币政策对抗基于经验的长期通胀预期的影响。调查微观数据显示，基于经历通胀的自适应学习会产生高度持久、缓慢变动的长期通胀预期。当预期由经验塑造时，央行无法通过沟通来锚定这些预期。相反，当预期偏离通胀目标时，货币政策必须持续保持鹰派或鸽派立场，以产生实际通胀结果，通过经济主体的信念更新，逐步将长期预期拉回目标水平。与这一机制一致，我发现美国、德国、英国和日本的基于经验的长期通胀预期与实际利率之间存在强正相关关系。在其主观预期下，私营部门经济主体并未预期未来通胀和短期实际利率会出现逆转。因此，长期实际利率随基于经验的长期通胀预期变动的幅度与短期实际利率大致相同，这与数据一致。实际利率的长期波动还伴随着利率预测误差的持续性模式。总体而言，货币政策与经验学习的相互作用，在自然利率变动之外，产生了实际利率长期波动的独特来源。
10.3386/w35379.title: Leaning Against Inflation Experiences

10.3386/w35380.abstract: Health care reforms are often enacted before implementation, creating uncertainty that can shape firms’ decisions. We examine how Medicare Part D affected the retail pharmacy industry using 2000-2009 establishment-level data, leveraging the fact that Part D disproportionately affected counties with larger elderly populations. Consistent with predictions from a conceptual model in which pre-implementation uncertainty discourages entry and lower post-implementation margins prevent full recovery, we find that Part D was associated with a 5-percent reduction in pharmacies, driven by fewer openings rather than more closures. We also find suggestive evidence that reduced pharmacy access dampened Part D’s mortality benefits.
10.3386/w35380.abstract_zh: 医疗改革往往在实施前就已颁布，由此产生的不确定性会影响企业的决策。我们利用2000-2009年的机构层面数据，并借助D部分（Part D）对老年人口比例较高县的影响更为显著这一事实，考察了医疗保险D部分如何影响零售药店行业。与概念模型的预测一致——该模型认为实施前的不确定性抑制了市场进入，而实施后较低的利润率又阻碍了完全恢复——我们发现D部分与药店数量减少5%相关，这主要是由于新店开业减少而非关店增加所致。我们还发现初步证据表明，药店可及性的降低削弱了D部分在降低死亡率方面的益处。
10.3386/w35380.title: Health Care Reform and Firm Dynamics: Evidence from Medicare Part D and the Retail Pharmacy Industry
10.3386/w35380.title_zh: 医疗改革与企业动态：来自Medicare D部分与零售药房行业的证据

10.3386/w35381.abstract: This paper studies migration and earnings dynamics in poor neighborhoods using new administrative data linking residential location and earnings. Out-migration rates are higher in poor neighborhoods than elsewhere, and the majority of people who leave a poor neighborhood move to a richer one. Residents of poor neighborhoods also see significant earnings mobility, with average growth rates similar to richer areas. Estimates based on idiosyncratic, firm-specific pay changes show that increases in earnings are linked to migration to better neighborhoods. This results in the earnings of the cohort who lived in a poor neighborhood at baseline growing more than twice as fast as the earnings of these neighborhoods' contemporaneous residents. Overall, our results highlight an underappreciated reason why poor neighborhoods stay poor: initial residents whose earnings grow tend to move away.
10.3386/w35381.abstract_zh: 本文利用连接居住地与收入的新行政数据，研究贫困社区的迁移与收入动态。贫困社区的迁出率高于其他地区，且大多数离开贫困社区的人会迁往更富裕的社区。贫困社区居民的收入流动性也显著，其平均增长率与富裕地区相当。基于个体层面及企业特定薪酬变化的估计表明，收入增长与迁往更优社区存在关联。这导致基线期居住在贫困社区的群体收入增长速度，是同期仍居住在这些社区的居民收入增速的两倍以上。总体而言，我们的研究结果揭示了一个未被充分认识的贫困社区持续贫困的原因：收入增长的初始居民往往会迁离。
10.3386/w35381.title: Dynamic Individuals, Static Neighborhoods: Migration and Earnings Changes in Poor Neighborhoods
10.3386/w35381.title_zh: 动态个体，静态社区：贫困社区的迁移与收入变化

10.3386/w35382.abstract: Real GDP per person is a widely used proxy for living standards, but it can be a poor welfare measure when new goods or quality improvements matter, when nonmarket goods are significant, and when preferences are nonhomothetic --- all of which are true in practice. We propose an alternative that is robust to these concerns: under weak conditions, the growth rate of the value of a statistical life (VSL), together with standard Euler-equation objects, identifies the growth rate of lifetime utility. The intuition is that people routinely trade off consumption against mortality risk, and their willingness to pay for small risk reductions reveals the value of remaining lifetime utility. Implementing this approach for the United States suggests that lifetime utility may have risen by more than a factor of five since 1940, whereas conventional consumption-based calculations using a stable log/CRRA flow utility imply much smaller gains, on the order of a doubling. This calculation is sensitive to measures of the growth rate of the VSL, the rate of time preference, and the interest rate. For example, if the correct interest rate is 4 percentage points higher than the T-bill rate, then lifetime utility would be measured to have declined by more than half since 1940.
10.3386/w35382.abstract_zh: 人均实际GDP是衡量生活水平的常用指标，但当新商品或质量改进至关重要、非市场商品具有显著影响、且偏好非位似时（这些情况在实践中普遍存在），该指标可能成为糟糕的福利度量。我们提出一种对这些担忧具有稳健性的替代方案：在弱条件下，统计生命价值（VSL）的增长率与标准欧拉方程变量共同识别终身效用的增长率。其直觉在于，人们通常会在消费与死亡风险之间进行权衡，而其为微小风险降低所支付的意愿揭示了剩余终身效用的价值。将该方法应用于美国的数据表明，自1940年以来，终身效用可能增长了五倍以上，而基于稳定对数/CRRA流动效用的传统消费计算仅显示约两倍的增长。这一计算对VSL增长率、时间偏好率和利率的度量高度敏感。例如，若实际利率比国库券利率高4个百分点，则自1940年以来终身效用将被测算为下降超过一半。
10.3386/w35382.title: When GDP Misleads: Inferring Living Standards from the Value of a Statistical Life
10.3386/w35382.title_zh: 当GDP误导：从统计生命价值推断生活水平

10.3386/w35384.abstract: Vision problems are prevalent among Medicare beneficiaries, with the majority having treatable conditions including uncorrected refractive error and cataracts. However, traditional Medicare does not cover routine eye exams or eyeglasses, and Medicare Advantage supplemental vision benefits often include low annual limits. We examine the effects of Medicaid routine vision benefits among adults dually eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, a population with high rates of vision impairment, morbidity, and disability. Using 2002-2019 Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate that Medicaid routine vision benefits increase past-year eye exams, eyeglasses purchases, and Medicaid spending on eyeglasses while reducing out-of-pocket spending. We also find suggestive evidence of spillovers to Medicare Advantage spending on eyeglasses, consistent with Medicaid routine vision coverage inducing additional eyeglasses purchases among Medicare Advantage enrollees with supplemental vision benefits, although estimates are modest.
10.3386/w35384.abstract_zh: 视力问题在医疗保险受益人中普遍存在，其中多数人患有可治疗的眼部疾病，包括未矫正屈光不正和白内障。然而，传统医疗保险不覆盖常规眼科检查或眼镜费用，而医疗保险优势计划的补充视力福利通常包含较低的年度限额。本研究考察了医疗补助常规视力福利对同时符合医疗保险和医疗补助资格的成年人的影响——该群体视力损伤、患病率和残疾率均较高。基于2002-2019年医疗保险当前受益人调查数据，采用双重差分法，我们估算出医疗补助常规视力福利使过去一年眼科检查率、眼镜购买量及医疗补助眼镜支出增加，同时减少了自付费用。我们还发现存在向医疗保险优势计划眼镜支出的溢出效应证据，这与医疗补助常规视力覆盖促使已享有补充视力福利的医疗保险优势计划参保人额外购买眼镜的现象一致，尽管估算结果较为温和。
10.3386/w35384.title: When Medicaid Pays the Bill: Routine Vision Benefits, Eye Care Use, and Eyeglasses Spending Among Dual-eligible Medicare Enrollees
10.3386/w35384.title_zh: 当医疗补助支付账单：双重资格医疗保险参保者的常规视力福利、眼科护理使用与眼镜支出

10.3386/w35385.abstract: We study fragility in semi-liquid private credit funds, which have expanded rapidly and now manage over $300 billion in assets. These funds perform liquidity transformation by holding far more illiquid loans than traditional loan mutual funds while allowing investors to redeem at NAV through quarterly repurchase offers, typically capped at 5% of shares outstanding. We show that cash buffers and contractual loan repayments are insufficient to fund repeated 5% quarterly redemptions; inflows decline precisely when outflows rise; and net outflows are met with sales of illiquid loans, external borrowing, and delayed payments through repurchases payable. As a result, strategic complementarity arises, because redemptions impose liquidation and leverage costs on the remaining investors. We show that loan liquidation, leverage increase, and NAV inflation play an important role in amplifying the current episodes of run-like redemptions. Overall, our evidence suggests that quarterly gates and redemption caps do not eliminate run-like fragility in semi-liquid private credit funds, raising cautions about expanding retail access to private credit markets.
10.3386/w35385.abstract_zh: 本文研究了半流动性私募信贷基金的脆弱性。这类基金近年来迅速扩张，目前管理资产规模已超过3000亿美元。这些基金通过持有远多于传统贷款共同基金的流动性较差的贷款来实现流动性转换，同时允许投资者通过季度回购要约（通常上限为流通份额的5%）按资产净值赎回。我们证明，现金缓冲和合同约定的贷款偿还不足以应对持续5%的季度赎回；资金流入恰恰在流出上升时减少；净流出通过出售流动性较差的贷款、外部借款以及通过应付回购延迟支付来应对。因此，战略互补性出现，因为赎回对剩余投资者施加了清算和杠杆成本。我们表明，贷款清算、杠杆增加和资产净值膨胀在当前类似挤兑的赎回事件放大中发挥了重要作用。总体而言，我们的证据表明，季度赎回门槛和赎回上限并未消除半流动性私募信贷基金中类似挤兑的脆弱性，这为扩大零售投资者进入私募信贷市场敲响了警钟。
10.3386/w35385.title: The Fragility of Semi-Liquid Private Credit Funds
10.3386/w35385.title_zh: 半流动性私募信贷基金的脆弱性

10.3386/w35386.abstract: This paper develops a calibrated general-equilibrium model to study how different configurations of trade and financial policy reshape the hierarchy of global currencies—and the U.S. dollar's position at its anchor. Currency safety and anchor status arise endogenously from each economy's 'effective size'—the weight its domestic shocks carry in setting world prices. Tariffs reduce this effective size on the goods side; capital controls do the same on the financial side. A unifying result emerges: The economy that maintains the deepest integration with the global trading network retains the largest safety premium and gains anchor status. We use this framework to evaluate the effects of three policy levers for Europe that affect the effective size of the euro: internal harmonization and enlargement, trade openness, and capital-account openness. The stakes are large: In our model, shifts in currencies' safety can redirect global capital flows and alter sovereign borrowing costs by hundreds of billions of dollars annually.
10.3386/w35386.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个校准的一般均衡模型，用以研究贸易与金融政策的不同配置如何重塑全球货币的层级结构——以及美元在其中的锚定地位。货币的安全性与锚定地位内生于各经济体的“有效规模”——即其国内冲击在设定世界价格时所承载的权重。关税会降低商品侧的有效规模；资本管制则在金融侧产生相同效果。一个统一的结论由此显现：与全球贸易网络保持最深度融合的经济体，将保留最大的安全溢价并赢得锚定地位。我们运用这一框架评估了影响欧元有效规模的三种欧洲政策杠杆的效果：内部协调与扩张、贸易开放度以及资本账户开放度。其影响极为重大：在我们的模型中，货币安全性的变动能够重新引导全球资本流动，并每年改变主权借贷成本高达数千亿美元。
10.3386/w35386.title: Openness, Integration, and the International Monetary Order
10.3386/w35386.title_zh: 开放、一体化与国际货币秩序

10.3386/w35387.abstract: GLP-1 medications generate large weight loss and may also alter social and economic outcomes. Using the Understanding America Study, I compare women starting GLP-1s for weight loss with matched women who would like to start a GLP-1 but have not. Single women’s marriage/cohabitation rates rise by 29 percentage points and employment among baseline non-employed women rises 27 percentage points after six or more quarters. Existing partnerships do not dissolve, and already-employed women show no upward job mobility. The pattern suggests that part of the female obesity penalty operates at new-match formation rather than only through health or incumbent productivity.
10.3386/w35387.abstract_zh: GLP-1药物能显著减轻体重，并可能改变社会与经济结果。利用《理解美国研究》数据，我将因减重而开始使用GLP-1的女性与匹配的、有意愿但尚未使用GLP-1的女性进行比较。在六个季度或更长时间后，单身女性的婚姻/同居率上升29个百分点，基线未就业女性的就业率上升27个百分点。现有伴侣关系并未瓦解，而已就业女性未表现出向上职业流动性。这一模式表明，女性肥胖惩罚的部分作用机制在于新匹配关系的形成，而非仅通过健康或现有生产力途径实现。
10.3386/w35387.title: GLP-1–Induced Weight Loss and the Female Obesity Penalty
10.3386/w35387.title_zh: GLP-1诱导的体重减轻与女性肥胖惩罚

10.3386/w35388.abstract: The asset management industry is increasingly shifting toward tailored portfolios, fund proliferation, and decentralization of stewardship—trends partly driven by growing heterogeneity in investor preferences. While these developments better align investment products with investor demands, they also reshape ownership structures, potentially leading to more fragmented ownership and weaker managerial oversight. We develop a framework to evaluate these trade-offs and show that fund proliferation does not necessarily weaken governance: Stronger incentives for asset managers and concentrated portfolios of specialized funds can offset these effects, especially when investor preferences are intense. However, strong investor preferences can also induce asset managers to compete on a new margin—granting investors control by decentralizing stewardship and adopting pass-through voting—without internalizing the associated governance costs.
10.3386/w35388.abstract_zh: 资产管理行业正日益转向定制化投资组合、基金数量激增以及管理权分散化——这些趋势部分源于投资者偏好的异质性增强。虽然这些发展使投资产品与投资者需求更加匹配，但也重塑了所有权结构，可能导致所有权更加分散、管理层监督弱化。我们构建了一个评估这些权衡关系的分析框架，并发现基金数量激增未必会削弱公司治理：更强的资产管理人激励措施以及专业基金的集中化投资组合可以抵消这些影响，尤其在投资者偏好强烈时更为显著。然而，强烈的投资者偏好也可能促使资产管理人在新维度上展开竞争——通过分散管理权和采用传递投票机制将控制权让渡给投资者——却未将相应的治理成本内部化。
10.3386/w35388.title: Fragmentation of Shareholder Power

10.3386/w35389.abstract: This paper studies how geopolitical risk shapes financial fragmentation and international risk-sharing, using bilateral official lending data from 1910 to 2024. We document that when geopolitical risk is high, bilateral lending increasingly follows geopolitical alignment. Because geopolitically aligned countries experience more synchronized shocks, this fragmentation limits the effectiveness of international risk-sharing. To rationalize these patterns, we introduce geopolitical considerations into a limited-commitment model of sovereign borrowing. The model shows that, even with non-discriminatory default, higher geopolitical tensions redirect international lending toward allied countries and weaken risk-sharing.
10.3386/w35389.abstract_zh: 本文利用1910年至2024年的双边官方贷款数据，研究地缘政治风险如何塑造金融碎片化与国际风险分担。我们记录到，当地缘政治风险较高时，双边贷款日益遵循地缘政治联盟。由于地缘政治联盟国家面临更同步的冲击，这种碎片化限制了国际风险分担的有效性。为解释这些模式，我们将地缘政治因素引入有限承诺的主权借款模型。模型表明，即使存在非歧视性违约，更高的地缘政治紧张局势也会将国际贷款转向盟国，并削弱风险分担。
10.3386/w35389.title: International Risk-Sharing in a Fragmented World
10.3386/w35389.title_zh: 碎片化世界中的国际风险分担

10.3386/w35390.abstract: Modern theories of the business cycle do not allow for the simultaneous rational choice of both prices and quantities, instead assuming that an “invisible hand” determines one of these variables to clear markets. In this paper, we develop a macroeconomic model in which both prices and quantities are chosen optimally by firms and exchange is both voluntary and efficient. As a consequence, individual markets will generically be in Walrasian disequilibrium: either slack (over-supplied) or rationed (under-supplied). The absence of market clearing changes pricing and production in qualitatively important ways: markups are governed by the probability of rationing rather than the elasticity of demand, and higher uncertainty reduces production and increases markups. Marrying the Old and New Keynesian traditions, we study general Walrasian disequilibrium with rational expectations and optimal firm decisions. On a technical level, we characterize cross-market spillovers arising from rationed demand with differentiated goods, overcoming the standard combinatorial problem that arises when studying multi-market disequilibrium. Unlike in New Keynesian economies, monetary shocks propagate by reducing product-market slack, raising aggregate labor productivity and consumption with muted effects on employment, while uncertainty shocks act as stagflationary cost-push shocks.
10.3386/w35390.abstract_zh: 现代商业周期理论不允许同时理性选择价格和数量，而是假设“看不见的手”决定其中一个变量以出清市场。本文构建了一个宏观经济模型，其中价格和数量均由企业最优选择，且交换既是自愿的也是有效的。因此，单个市场通常处于瓦尔拉斯非均衡状态：要么松弛（供给过剩），要么配给（供给不足）。市场非出清在本质上改变了定价与生产行为：加成率由配给概率而非需求弹性决定，更高的不确定性会减少产量并提高加成率。融合新旧凯恩斯主义传统，我们研究了具有理性预期和企业最优决策的一般瓦尔拉斯非均衡。在技术层面，我们刻画了差异化商品因配给需求产生的跨市场溢出效应，克服了研究多市场非均衡时面临的标准组合问题。与新凯恩斯主义经济不同，货币冲击通过减少产品市场松弛来传导，从而提高总劳动生产率和消费，但对就业影响有限；而不确定性冲击则表现为滞胀型成本推动冲击。
10.3386/w35390.title: Pricing and Production Without the Invisible Hand
10.3386/w35390.title_zh: 无形之手缺失下的定价与生产

10.3386/w35391.abstract: We study the equilibrium effects of financial repression on government funding costs in an endowment economy with limited asset market participation. We show how a broad set of repression policies operates through a wedge in the Euler equation responsive to government size or by affecting fiscal redistribution between agents. Repression intensity is captured by a policy feedback rule that depends positively on net government spending. When fiscal policy is profligate and monetary policy accommodates, we show that such a repression policy raises bond values, reduces the inflationary cost of unfunded fiscal expansions, and lowers bond risk premia. Repression is not a free lunch for bondholders---they pay a lower inflation tax but also earn lower future real returns. When monetary policy does not accommodate fiscal policy, repression can provide stopgap funding for deficits, allowing the central bank to retain control over inflation while making government debt a hedge for fiscal inflation.
10.3386/w35391.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在有限资产市场参与的禀赋经济中，金融抑制对政府融资成本的均衡效应。研究表明，一系列广泛的抑制政策通过影响欧拉方程中与政府规模相关的楔子，或通过改变主体间的财政再分配发挥作用。抑制强度由一项与净政府支出正相关的政策反馈规则来刻画。当财政政策挥霍无度且货币政策具有适应性时，此类抑制政策会提升债券价值，降低无资金支持的财政扩张的通胀成本，并压低债券风险溢价。抑制并非债券持有人的免费午餐——他们虽支付较低的通胀税，但未来实际回报率也更低。当货币政策不配合财政政策时，抑制可为赤字提供临时融资，使央行在保持通胀控制力的同时，让政府债务成为对冲财政通胀的工具。
10.3386/w35391.title: Government Funding Costs Under Financial Repression
10.3386/w35391.title_zh: 金融抑制下的政府融资成本

10.3386/w35392.abstract: Between 1880 and 1920, more than 20 million immigrants settled in the United States. We study how this migration wave affected innovation and growth. Using a newly constructed dataset linking individual census records to historical immigration records and the universe of US patents, we highlight a new channel through which immigrants contributed to growth: they disproportionately settled in urban innovation hubs. To quantify the aggregate and regional effects of this mass migration episode, we develop a new spatial growth model in which skilled workers have a comparative advantage in innovation and sort endogenously across space. We find that international arrivals after 1880 raised US income per capita by 8.2% by 1940. Removing the subsequent immigration restrictions of the 1920s would have raised income per capita by a further 1.7% by 2000. Immigrants' skill composition and their concentration in urban hubs are key drivers of these effects.
10.3386/w35392.abstract_zh: 1880年至1920年间，超过2000万移民在美国定居。本研究考察了此次移民浪潮对创新与经济增长的影响。通过构建将个人人口普查记录、历史移民记录及美国全部专利数据相关联的新数据集，我们揭示了移民促进经济增长的新渠道：移民不成比例地聚集于城市创新中心。为量化此次大规模移民事件的总体与区域效应，我们构建了新型空间增长模型，其中技能型劳动者在创新领域具有比较优势，并在地理空间上实现内生性分类。研究发现，1880年后的国际移民使1940年美国人均收入提升8.2%。若取消1920年代后续实施的移民限制，2000年人均收入将额外增长1.7%。移民的技能构成及其在城市创新中心的集聚效应是上述影响的关键驱动因素。
10.3386/w35392.title: Immigration, Innovation, and the Geography of Growth
10.3386/w35392.title_zh: 移民、创新与增长的地理分布

10.3386/w35393.abstract: We study how wealth inequality shapes safe-asset demand in heterogeneous-agent economies. Asset bubbles arise when agents face sufficiently high probabilities of falling into extreme poverty. In such cases, assets insulated from idiosyncratic risk become infinitely large relative to agents' wealth ex-post, which makes them infinitely valuable ex-ante. This mechanism is fundamentally different from classic rational bubbles, generates bubbles even under stationary wealth distributions, and requires no aggregate uncertainty or growth. Using this insight, we revisit the pricing of aggregate assets in standard heterogeneous-agent economies, and show that prior analyses may be incomplete due to overlooked possibility of transversality condition violation.
10.3386/w35393.abstract_zh: 本文研究财富不平等如何塑造异质性主体经济体中的安全资产需求。当主体面临足够高的极端贫困概率时，资产泡沫便会形成。在此情形下，免受异质性风险影响的资产相对于主体事后财富而言变得无限大，从而使其事前价值趋于无穷。这一机制与经典理性泡沫存在本质差异，即便在稳态财富分布下也能产生泡沫，且无需依赖总体不确定性或经济增长。基于这一发现，我们重新审视标准异质性主体经济体中总体资产的定价问题，并指出由于横截条件可能被违反这一被忽视的可能性，先前的分析可能存在不完整性。
10.3386/w35393.title: Wealth Inequality and Safe Asset Demand
10.3386/w35393.title_zh: 财富不平等与安全资产需求

10.3386/w35394.abstract: Road traffic injuries are the leading cause of death among people aged 5–29. Where traffic laws are weakly enforced, it is unclear whether road safety interventions can change behavior. We run a randomized controlled trial among 203 Kenyan minibuses, testing whether an incentive scheme improves safety overall or merely shifts unsafe driving to unmonitored times. Drivers reduce speeding by 29 percent and harsh braking by 13 percent, improving a safety index by 0.096 standard deviations. Labor-supply and earnings effects are modest, with little displacement across times or places. Improvements fade quickly, suggesting lasting change requires sustained enforcement or stronger incentives.
10.3386/w35394.abstract_zh: 道路交通伤害是5至29岁人群的首要死因。在交通法规执行不力的地区，道路安全干预措施能否改变行为尚不明确。我们对203辆肯尼亚小巴开展了一项随机对照试验，检验激励计划是全面改善安全性，还是仅仅将危险驾驶行为转移至未受监控时段。驾驶员超速行为减少29%，急刹车减少13%，安全指数提升0.096个标准差。劳动力供给与收入效应较为温和，且未出现显著的时间或空间替代效应。但改善效果迅速消退，表明持久改变需要持续执法或更强激励。
10.3386/w35394.title: Safer Driving for a Price: Evidence on Behavior and Habits in Kenyan Minibuses
10.3386/w35394.title_zh: 价格换取更安全的驾驶：肯尼亚小巴行为与习惯的证据

10.3386/w35395.abstract: Empirical evidence commonly cited as indicating that inflation expectations have become better anchored includes the declining sensitivity of expectations to inflation surprises over time, particularly around the adoption of inflation targeting. These patterns are typically attributed to the influence of explicit or implicit inflation targets on inflation expectations. We show that this evidence is consistent with a model of experience-based learning in which individuals learn solely from their life-time history of realized inflation, without anchoring their expectations to an announced inflation target. In this model, the prolonged experience of low short-run inflation persistence in the pre-COVID decades renders long-run expectations insensitive to inflation surprises, matching the patterns observed in empirical anchoring tests. A unique prediction of the experience-based learning model is also borne out in the data: the decline in surprise sensitivity since the 1980s is strongest among younger individuals. The memory of low inflation persistence experiences further explains why long-run inflation expectations remained stable in the face of the post-COVID inflation surge. At the same time, simulations indicate that the sensitivity of long-run expectations to inflation surprises would rise sharply if individuals were to experience another sustained episode of highly persistent inflation. Overall, long-run inflation expectations may be less firmly anchored than commonly believed.
10.3386/w35395.abstract_zh: 通常被引用来表明通胀预期已更好锚定的实证证据包括：预期对通胀意外冲击的敏感性随时间推移而下降，尤其是在采用通胀目标制前后。这些模式通常被归因于明确或隐含的通胀目标对通胀预期的影响。我们证明，这一证据与基于经验的学习模型一致——在该模型中，个体仅依据其一生经历的实际通胀历史进行学习，而无需将预期锚定于公布的官方通胀目标。在该模型下，新冠疫情前数十年间低短期通胀持续性的长期经历，使得长期预期对通胀意外冲击不敏感，这与实证锚定检验中观察到的模式相吻合。数据还验证了基于经验的学习模型的一个独特预测：自20世纪80年代以来，年轻群体对通胀意外冲击敏感性的下降幅度最大。对低通胀持续性经历的记忆进一步解释了为何长期通胀预期在新冠疫情后通胀飙升期间保持稳定。同时，模拟表明，若个体再次经历持续的高通胀时期，长期预期对通胀意外冲击的敏感性将急剧上升。总体而言，长期通胀预期的锚定程度可能低于普遍认知。
10.3386/w35395.title: Seemingly Anchored Inflation Expectations

10.3386/w35396.abstract: We study the relationship between health and social status in China using genealogical data from the 14th to 19th centuries. The data covers broad segments of the population linking husbands, wives, and sons, allowing us to examine whether status was associated with survival not only for adult men but also across households and generations. In a sample centered on the early 1700s, the typical lifespan of married men is 52, but varies widely. High-status men have a 22 percent higher probability of living past 50 than low-status men, resulting in a lifespan advantage of seven years. High status is also associated with significant survival advantages for wives and children. The lifespan premium of the wife of a high-status man over the wife of a commoner exceeds 10 years, and the chance that the son of a high-status man dies before reaching 10 years is less than half that of a low-status man’s son. Up to the 17th century the lifespan advantage is largely confined to those with top status, while the health-status gradient across all status levels emerges during the 18th century. The findings provide new evidence on health-status inequality in a less-studied setting, and suggest that health-status inequality is usefully analyzed from a family and intergenerational perspective.
10.3386/w35396.abstract_zh: 本文利用14至19世纪中国的家谱数据，研究健康与社会地位之间的关系。数据覆盖了广泛的社会阶层，将丈夫、妻子和儿子联系起来，使我们能够考察地位是否不仅与成年男性的生存相关，还涉及家庭内部及代际之间的影响。在以18世纪初为中心的样本中，已婚男性的典型寿命为52岁，但个体差异显著。高地位男性活过50岁的概率比低地位男性高出22%，寿命优势达七年。高地位还与妻子和子女的显著生存优势相关：高地位男性妻子的寿命比平民妻子高出十年以上，而高地位男性之子在10岁前死亡的概率不到低地位男性之子的一半。直至17世纪，寿命优势主要局限于最高地位群体，而18世纪期间，所有地位层级均出现了健康-地位梯度。这些发现为较少被研究的背景下的健康-地位不平等提供了新证据，并表明从家庭和代际视角分析健康-地位不平等具有重要价值。
10.3386/w35396.title: New Evidence on the Health-Status Gradient from Imperial China
10.3386/w35396.title_zh: 来自中华帝国的健康状况梯度新证据

10.3386/w35397.abstract: This study provides pre-registered, experimental evidence on the use of non-generative artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots to support students in large-enrollment undergraduate courses. We find the chatbot messaging increased students’ final grades and engagement with academic supports, such as tutoring. Treatment effects were generally consistent across student demographics, with the exception of treated women in a Microeconomics course, who earned final grades that were seven percentage points higher than women in the control group. This study provides evidence that integrating AI-enabled outreach and communication to students in their college courses can enhance student engagement, learning, and course performance.
10.3386/w35397.abstract_zh: 本研究提供了关于在大型本科课程中使用非生成式人工智能（AI）聊天机器人辅助学生的预注册实验证据。我们发现，聊天机器人信息提高了学生的期末成绩以及参与学术支持（如辅导）的积极性。处理效应在不同学生群体中总体一致，但微观经济学课程中接受干预的女性除外，其期末成绩比对照组女性高出七个百分点。本研究证明，将人工智能驱动的外联与沟通融入大学课程中，能够增强学生的参与度、学习效果及课程表现。
10.3386/w35397.title: Let’s Chat: Leveraging Chatbot Outreach for Improved Course Performance
10.3386/w35397.title_zh: 让我们聊聊：利用聊天机器人外联提升课程表现

10.3386/w35398.abstract: This paper shows that the currency in which traded goods are invoiced has a first-order implication for the short-run impact of tariffs on the economy. If prices are set in terms of producer’s currency (PCP), a unilateral tariff is contractionary on impact, reducing GDP, and causing a deterioration in the trade balance. By contrast, with prices pre-set in buyers currency (LCP), the same tariff shock is expansionary, and improves the trade balance. The key difference between the two regimes lies in the differential exchange rate pass- through under PCP relative to LCP. In welfare terms however, the situation is reversed. A tariff under LCP leads to a fall in short-run welfare, as consumption and investment fall sharply, while the same tariff may be welfare enhancing under PCP. Under dollar currency pricing (DCP), we find results intermediate between the two invoicing regimes. With retaliation, the stark difference in pricing regimes is attenuated.
10.3386/w35398.abstract_zh: 本文表明，贸易商品计价货币的选择对关税对经济的短期影响具有首要意义。若以生产者货币定价（PCP），单边关税在短期内具有紧缩效应，导致GDP下降并引发贸易逆差恶化。相比之下，若以买方货币预设定价（LCP），同等关税冲击则具有扩张效应，并改善贸易平衡。两种机制的核心差异在于PCP与LCP下汇率传导效应的不同。然而从福利角度看，情况则截然相反：LCP下的关税导致短期福利下降（因消费与投资急剧萎缩），而PCP下的同等关税可能提升福利。在美元定价（DCP）机制下，我们发现结果介于两种计价模式之间。当存在报复性关税时，定价机制间的显著差异会有所减弱。
10.3386/w35398.title: The Pass-through of Tariffs and Exchange Rates
10.3386/w35398.title_zh: 关税与汇率的传导效应

10.3386/w35399.abstract: The implementation and unwinding of the FFCRA's continuous coverage requirement generated historically large changes in Medicaid enrollment during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using a combination of descriptive and causal analyses, we examine the substantial cross-state differences in these changes, which remain little understood. We find that policies designed to ease unwinding frictions, as well as federal fiscal assistance to states, have little predictive power, suggesting limited roles for administrative design or liquidity constraints. Political preferences have modest predictive power during the unwinding period. Pandemic-era Medicaid expansions and more generous baseline eligibility thresholds are strongly associated with larger net enrollment gains.
10.3386/w35399.abstract_zh: FFCRA持续覆盖要求的实施与解除，导致新冠疫情期间医疗补助计划参保人数出现历史性的大幅波动。通过结合描述性分析与因果分析，我们研究了各州在这些变化中存在的显著差异——这些差异至今仍鲜有深入理解。研究发现，旨在缓解解除摩擦的政策以及联邦对各州的财政援助，其预测能力均较弱，表明行政设计或流动性约束的作用有限。政治倾向在解除期间仅具有适度的预测能力。疫情期间医疗补助计划的扩展以及更宽松的基线资格门槛，与更大的净参保人数增长显著相关。
10.3386/w35399.title: Understanding Cross-State Variations in Medicaid Enrollment During and After the COVID-19 Pandemic
10.3386/w35399.title_zh: 新冠疫情期间及之后医疗补助参保率的跨州差异研究

10.3386/w35400.abstract: We build a model that combines (i) heterogeneous households with incomplete markets, and (ii) state-dependent pricing with strategic complementarities by firms, to analyze the effects of large macroeconomic shocks and policy interventions. Both features significantly influence the transmission of fiscal stimulus and monetary policy—heterogeneous households because of failures of Ricardian equivalence, and state-dependent pricing because of its nonlinear effects on inflation. We use our model to quantify how monetary and fiscal policy shaped macroeconomic dynamics in response to the large shocks of 2020, and how alternative policy choices could have led to different aggregate and distributional outcomes. We find large departures from Ricardian equivalence and strong stepping-on-a-rake effects of interest rate changes. The large unfunded fiscal transfer program helped prevent deflation in 2020 and significantly raised output throughout 2021 and 2022, but led to permanently higher prices. The monetary easing through 2020 and 2021 also contributed to preventing deflation, but had a minimal impact on GDP. The monetary tightening from 2022 lowered the maximum inflation rate, but contributed to persistently above-trend inflation. These policies led to net welfare gains for low-wealth households and net welfare losses for high-wealth households, but those welfare effects are due to incomplete markets for idiosyncratic risk not aggregate stabilization. Alternative commitments to funding fiscal stimulus could have achieved similar short-term effects on inflation and output with a much smaller long-term increase in the price level.
10.3386/w35400.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个结合（i）异质性家庭与不完全市场，以及（ii）企业具有战略互补性的状态依存定价的模型，以分析大规模宏观经济冲击与政策干预的影响。这两个特征均显著影响财政刺激与货币政策的传导机制——异质性家庭因李嘉图等价失效，而状态依存定价则因其对通胀的非线性效应。我们利用该模型量化了2020年大规模冲击下货币与财政政策如何塑造宏观经济动态，并探讨了替代性政策选择可能导致的总体与分配结果差异。研究发现，李嘉图等价存在显著偏离，且利率变动具有强烈的“踩耙子效应”。大规模无资金支持的财政转移计划虽有助于防止2020年通缩，并在2021至2022年间显著提升产出，但导致价格永久性上升。2020至2021年的货币宽松政策同样有助于防止通缩，但对GDP影响甚微。2022年起的货币紧缩政策降低了通胀峰值，却导致通胀持续高于趋势水平。这些政策使低财富家庭获得净福利收益，而高财富家庭则承受净福利损失，但此类福利效应源于异质性风险的不完全市场，而非总需求稳定。若采用替代性财政刺激资金承诺，可在实现类似短期通胀与产出效果的同时，大幅降低长期价格水平的上升幅度。
10.3386/w35400.title: How Does Monetary and Fiscal Policy Affect the Economy in the Face of Large Shocks?
10.3386/w35400.title_zh: 货币与财政政策如何应对大规模冲击下的经济影响？

10.3386/w35401.abstract: The secular decline in birth rates across the globe over the past seven decades has slowed population growth, raised average ages, and reshaped labor markets and the macroeconomy. Contrary to the widespread expectation that these trends hamper economic growth, we find lower birth rates are associated with higher growth in GDP per working-age adult across countries and higher wage growth across US commuting zones, with no negative impact on aggregate GDP or earnings. These patterns are not explained by educational upgrading, rising female labor force participation, the declining importance of agriculture, or neoclassical-Solow mechanisms. We argue that they reflect the endogenous, labor-saving response of technology to the scarcity of younger workers. Consistent with this interpretation, countries and regions with lower birth rates exhibit more labor-saving patents and growing high-tech activity. There is also higher TFP growth across countries and industries. Exploiting cross-country variation in WWII military and civilian deaths, we find that declines in younger population, rather than population size per se, drive our results.
10.3386/w35401.abstract_zh: 过去七十年间全球生育率的长期下降，减缓了人口增长，提高了平均年龄，并重塑了劳动力市场与宏观经济。与普遍认为这些趋势会阻碍经济增长的预期相反，我们发现，较低生育率与各国劳动年龄人口人均GDP的更高增长以及美国通勤区工资的更高增长相关，且对总体GDP或收入无负面影响。这些模式无法通过教育升级、女性劳动参与率上升、农业重要性下降或新古典索洛机制来解释。我们认为，这反映了技术对年轻劳动力稀缺的内生性、节约劳动力的响应。与此解释一致的是，生育率较低的国家和地区拥有更多节约劳动力的专利，且高科技活动日益增长。各国及各行业也呈现出更高的全要素生产率增长。利用二战期间各国军事与平民死亡人数的跨国差异，我们发现，年轻人口减少（而非人口规模本身）驱动了我们的研究结果。
10.3386/w35401.title: Baby Busts and Growth Booms: Demographic Change and the Macroeconomy
10.3386/w35401.title_zh: 婴儿潮衰退与增长繁荣：人口变迁与宏观经济

10.3386/w35402.abstract: How exposed are open economies to global demand shocks? In equilibrium, foreign booms can be absorbed either by domestic consumption ("quantities") or by real exchange rate appreciation ("prices"). We show that failures of Ricardian equivalence and global financial market imperfections, two frictions popular in much recent work, have opposite effects on the split: while elevated marginal propensities to consume push towards quantities, financial frictions instead increase price adjustment. As the flexible-price equilibrium generally features a mix of quantity and price responses, policy needs to be contractionary to achieve flexible-price outcomes if the spending effect dominates, and vice-versa if financial frictions are severe. In our quantitative explorations the spending effect tends to win the race, necessitating aggressive domestic policy action.
10.3386/w35402.abstract_zh: 开放经济体对全球需求冲击的暴露程度如何？在均衡状态下，国外经济繁荣可通过国内消费（“数量”）或实际汇率升值（“价格”）两种渠道吸收。本文证明，李嘉图等价失效与全球金融市场不完善——近期研究中常见的两种摩擦——对上述分配机制产生相反影响：边际消费倾向上升会推动数量调整，而金融摩擦则强化价格调整。由于弹性价格均衡通常兼具数量与价格反应特征，当支出效应占主导时，政策需采取紧缩措施以实现弹性价格结果；反之，若金融摩擦严重，则需采取扩张政策。在量化分析中，支出效应往往占据上风，这要求采取积极的国内政策干预。
10.3386/w35402.title: Importing Aggregate Demand

10.3386/w35403.abstract: Consider an analyst interested in predicting the size of an effect. She has identified a set of prior published studies of similar effects. We provide a toolkit for (i) summarizing the prior literature, (ii) making predictions of effects in new contexts, and (iii) correcting for the bias from selectivity in the prior literature. We illustrate these methods with empirical examples from labor, public, behavioral, environmental, and development economics. Some of the tools are relevant even when only three prior studies are available. We show how it is possible to use covariates to transparently make predictions for a new context by reweighting prior estimates. The mean effect—after correcting for selectivity—is between 12% and 21% of the simple mean in our empirical examples. We conclude with a cookbook for practitioners producing meta-analyses.
10.3386/w35403.abstract_zh: 考虑一位分析师，其目标是预测某一效应的大小。她已确定一组关于类似效应的先前已发表研究。我们提供了一套工具包，用于：(i) 总结先前文献，(ii) 预测新情境下的效应，以及 (iii) 纠正先前文献中选择性偏差带来的偏误。我们通过来自劳动经济学、公共经济学、行为经济学、环境经济学和发展经济学的实证案例来展示这些方法。即便仅有三项先前研究可用，部分工具仍具相关性。我们展示了如何通过重新加权先前估计值，利用协变量透明地预测新情境下的效应。在我们的实证案例中，经选择性偏差校正后的平均效应，仅为简单均值的12%至21%。最后，我们为从事元分析的研究者提供了一份实践指南。
10.3386/w35403.title: Literature Review and Evidence Aggregation: a Toolkit for Applied Micro
10.3386/w35403.title_zh: 文献综述与证据汇总：应用微观经济学工具包

10.3386/w35404.abstract: Community colleges are more financially, academically, and geographically accessible than four-year institutions. Yet despite most community college students intending to earn a bachelor’s degree, few successfully transfer and complete one. Community College Baccalaureate (CCB) programs have emerged as an alternative pathway, allowing community colleges to confer bachelor’s degrees directly. However, little is known about how employers value these credentials in the labor market. To address this question, we conduct the first resume audit study of CCB degrees, submitting fictitious applications to real job vacancies while experimentally varying applicants’ educational credentials, degree-granting institutions, and demographic signals. In this pilot study, we focus on the early childhood education (ECE) labor market, a rapidly growing CCB field characterized by labor shortages and increasing educational requirements. We find that employers view CCB degrees similarly to both traditional bachelor’s and associate degrees, with statistically indistinguishable interview-request rates across degree types. A text analysis of employer callback messages reveals little evidence that employers communicate differently with CCB applicants, while a net-price simulation suggests that sticker-price comparisons substantially overstate the affordability advantage of CCB programs. Together, these findings provide new evidence on the labor market value and affordability of CCB degrees and inform an ongoing large-scale audit study across additional fields and labor markets.
10.3386/w35404.abstract_zh: 社区学院在财务、学业和地理可及性方面均优于四年制院校。然而，尽管大多数社区学院学生有意获得学士学位，但成功转学并完成学业者寥寥无几。社区学院学士学位项目作为替代路径应运而生，允许社区学院直接授予学士学位。但鲜有研究探讨雇主在劳动力市场中对这类学历的认可程度。为解答这一问题，我们开展了首项针对社区学院学士学位的简历审计研究，通过向真实职位空缺提交虚构申请，实验性调整申请人的教育背景、学位授予机构及人口统计学信号。在本试点研究中，我们聚焦于早期儿童教育劳动力市场——该领域是社区学院学士学位快速发展的方向，具有劳动力短缺与教育要求持续提升的双重特征。研究发现，雇主对社区学院学士学位的认可度与传统学士学位及副学士学位相当，不同学位类型对应的面试邀请率在统计上无显著差异。对雇主回访信息的文本分析显示，雇主与社区学院学士学位申请者的沟通方式几乎不存在差异；而净价格模拟表明，标价比较会显著高估社区学院学士学位项目的经济可负担性。综合来看，这些发现为社区学院学士学位的劳动力市场价值与可负担性提供了新证据，并为正在开展的跨领域、跨劳动力市场的大规模审计研究奠定基础。
10.3386/w35404.title: The Labor Market Value of Community College Bachelor’s Degrees: Initial Evidence from a Resume Audit Study in Early Childhood Education
10.3386/w35404.title_zh: 社区大学学士学位的劳动力市场价值：基于早期儿童教育简历审计研究的初步证据

10.3386/w35405.abstract: We uncover a new mechanism that links growth and a decline in the energy intensity of production, observed globally since 1990. Using microdata from India and a causal research design, we demonstrate that the expenditure share of energy declines steeply with firm scale, due both to physical scaling laws and technology investment. Given that average firm size increases with growth, this scale dependence implies that production endogenously becomes less energy-intensive along the growth path. We develop a model of this mechanism in general equilibrium, and quantify significant reductions in aggregate energy intensity as low-income countries like India grow. We conclude with a discussion of the future path of emissions in India.
10.3386/w35405.abstract_zh: 我们揭示了一种新机制，该机制将经济增长与1990年以来全球观察到的生产能源强度下降联系起来。利用印度微观数据及因果研究设计，我们证明企业能源支出份额随规模扩大而急剧下降，这既源于物理规模法则，也源于技术投资。鉴于企业平均规模随经济增长而扩大，这种规模依赖性意味着生产在增长路径上会内生地降低能源强度。我们构建了该机制的一般均衡模型，并量化了印度等低收入国家经济增长过程中总体能源强度的显著下降。最后，我们探讨了印度未来排放路径。
10.3386/w35405.title: Growth, Firm Scale, and the Energy Intensity of Production
10.3386/w35405.title_zh: 增长、企业规模与生产的能源强度

10.3386/w35406.abstract: Many governments and institutions use marginal price signals, such as fuel and carbon taxes, to meet emission reduction targets. However, the responses of firms and individuals to these price signals are often calculated using average prices commonly reported in economic data, rather than marginal prices. This paper first documents that the marginal price of electricity paid by U.S. manufacturing plants is 50% lower than the average price. To do so, we construct a novel dataset of both average and marginal electricity prices, and the wedge between these, using plant-level microdata from the U.S. Census and utility-level electricity rate schedules for over two hundred utilities. Second, we provide guidance on when average prices are an appropriate proxy for marginal prices in price elasticities by identifying economic and geographic characteristics that predict variation in this wedge. Overall, the magnitude of this wedge suggests that the standard use of average energy prices to calculate responses to carbon taxes may underestimate the energy price increases needed to meet emissions targets by 50%.
10.3386/w35406.abstract_zh: 许多政府与机构采用边际价格信号（如燃油税与碳税）以实现减排目标。然而，企业与个人对这些价格信号的响应，通常基于经济数据中普遍报告的平均价格而非边际价格进行计算。本文首先发现，美国制造业工厂支付的电价边际价格比平均价格低50%。为此，我们利用美国人口普查局的工厂级微观数据及覆盖两百多家公用事业公司的电价费率表，构建了包含平均电价、边际电价及其差额的新型数据集。其次，通过识别预测该差额变化的经济与地理特征，本文为平均价格在何种情况下可作为边际价格弹性分析的合理代理变量提供了指导。总体而言，这一差额的规模表明：若以标准方式使用平均能源价格计算碳税响应，可能使实现排放目标所需的能源价格涨幅被低估50%。
10.3386/w35406.title: The Use and Misuse of Average and Marginal Energy Prices: Implications for Climate Policy
10.3386/w35406.title_zh: 平均与边际能源价格的使用与误用：对气候政策的启示

10.3386/w35407.abstract: There is a long-running debate over using standardized test scores to inform college and graduate admissions decisions, with some arguing that test scores are an important signal of academic strength and others arguing that they are biased and exclusionary. Here we revisit this issue by analyzing a novel dataset of more than 13,000 applications over roughly a decade to a large public policy master’s program in the United States. Consistent with past work, we find that GRE scores substantially improve predictions of first-year grades relative to predictions based on GPA alone. However, when these predictions are used to inform admissions decisions, we find that test scores only modestly improve the expected academic quality of admitted students. The gap shrinks further when we augment the test-aware and test-blind predictive models with more fine-grained information available in student transcripts and other application materials. Specifically, we estimate that incorporating standardized test scores in our setting would result in admitting students who perform, on average, only 0.03 grade points better. We show—both empirically and theoretically—that this pattern stems from a subtle distinction between predictions and decisions. Even with improved predictions, the downstream admissions decisions are often the same; and where there are differences, they often involve selecting between similarly qualified applicants. Our results indicate that standardized test scores may be less important for university admissions than previously suggested.
10.3386/w35407.abstract_zh: 关于是否应将标准化考试成绩作为大学及研究生招生依据的争论由来已久。一方认为考试成绩是衡量学术能力的重要指标，另一方则指出其存在偏见与排斥性。本研究通过分析美国某大型公共政策硕士项目十余年间逾13,000份申请数据重新审视该问题。与既往研究一致，我们发现相较于仅依据GPA的预测模型，加入GRE成绩能显著提升对一年级学业成绩的预测精度。然而当将这些预测结果用于招生决策时，考试成绩对录取学生预期学术质量的提升作用有限。当我们在考虑/不考虑考试成绩的预测模型中进一步纳入成绩单及其他申请材料中的精细化信息时，这种差距进一步缩小。具体而言，本情境下引入标准化考试成绩仅能使录取学生的平均绩点提升0.03分。我们通过实证与理论分析表明，这一现象源于预测与决策之间的微妙差异：即便预测精度有所提升，下游招生决策往往保持不变；即便存在差异，也通常涉及资质相近的申请者之间的选择。研究结果表明，标准化考试成绩对大学招生的实际影响可能低于此前文献的论断。
10.3386/w35407.title: Reassessing the Role of Standardized Tests in University Admissions
10.3386/w35407.title_zh: 重新评估标准化考试在大学招生中的作用

10.3386/w35408.abstract: Intensifying climate change makes protection against natural disaster risk – either through ex ante insurance or ex post aid – a first-order public policy issue. Flood risk protection in the U.S. traditionally featured ex post aid through FEMA and heavily subsidized insurance through the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP). In an effort to correct subsidy-induced overbuilding and under-mitigation in flood-prone areas, the NFIP recently moved to actuarially fair insurance premiums. But this change has two unintended consequences: a fiscal spillover onto FEMA disaster aid as insurance coverage declines in flood-prone areas, and household exposure to uninsurable reclassification risk from uncertain climate projections. We develop a model of optimal flood insurance that incorporates the static and dynamic tradeoffs of subsidizing premiums. We then use a variety of identification strategies and data to estimate the five key parameters needed to implement this model. We find that the fiscal spillover and reclassification risk protection benefits significantly outweigh the moral hazard costs, and that the optimal subsidy to flood insurance is 52%, comparable to the level of subsidization before the recent reform.
10.3386/w35408.abstract_zh: 气候变化加剧使得防范自然灾害风险——无论是通过事前保险还是事后援助——成为首要公共政策问题。美国传统的洪水风险防范体系以联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）的事后援助和国家洪水保险计划（NFIP）的高额补贴保险为特征。为纠正补贴导致的洪泛区过度建设与减灾不足问题，NFIP近期转向精算公平保费。但这一改革产生了两项非预期后果：一是随着洪泛区保险覆盖率下降，FEMA灾害援助产生财政溢出效应；二是家庭面临因气候预测不确定性导致的不可保重分类风险。我们构建了最优洪水保险模型，将保费补贴的静态与动态权衡纳入分析框架。随后采用多种识别策略与数据，估算实施该模型所需的五个关键参数。研究发现，财政溢出效应与重分类风险保护带来的收益显著超过道德风险成本，最优洪水保险补贴率为52%，与改革前的补贴水平相当。
10.3386/w35408.title: Optimal Flood Insurance in a Second-Best World: Fiscal Spillovers, Reclassification Risk and Moral Hazard
10.3386/w35408.title_zh: 次优世界中的最优洪水保险：财政溢出效应、重分类风险与道德风险

10.3386/w35409.abstract: We examine pandemic related racial and ethnic disparities in test scores, absenteeism, and disciplinary incidents for K-12 students in the State of Connecticut through the 2024-25 school year. Notably, most existing pandemic studies only cover absenteeism through 2022-23, and minimal quantitative evidence exists on the post-pandemic incidence of student discipline related behaviors. Consistent with prior studies, we find persistent negative effects of the pandemic on test scores, as well as substantial disparities in test scores along racial and ethnic lines. For middle school, we also find persistent post-pandemic increases in both severe disciplinary incidents overall and racial and ethnic disparities in severe discipline incidents. However, we document substantial recovery in racial and ethnic disparities in attendance rates and chronic absenteeism by 2024-25. For all outcomes, most of the increases in disparities are associated with Black and Latinx students attending schools that had worse pre-pandemic outcomes and higher pre-pandemic shares of students who are either economically disadvantaged or face learning barriers.
10.3386/w35409.abstract_zh: 我们考察了康涅狄格州K-12学生截至2024-25学年的疫情相关种族与族裔差异，涵盖考试成绩、缺勤率及违纪事件。值得注意的是，现有疫情研究大多仅覆盖至2022-23学年的缺勤数据，且关于疫情后学生违纪行为发生率的量化证据极为有限。与既往研究一致，我们发现疫情对考试成绩存在持续性负面影响，且考试成绩在种族与族裔维度上呈现显著差异。在中学阶段，我们还发现疫情后严重违纪事件总体发生率以及种族与族裔间严重违纪事件差异均持续扩大。然而，到2024-25学年，出勤率与长期缺勤率方面的种族与族裔差异已出现显著恢复。就所有结果而言，差异扩大的主要原因是黑人与拉丁裔学生就读的学校在疫情前已存在更差的表现，且这些学校中经济弱势或面临学习障碍的学生比例在疫情前就更高。
10.3386/w35409.title: Racial Disparities in Education During and Following the Pandemic: Evidence in Connecticut through 2025
10.3386/w35409.title_zh: 疫情期间及之后教育中的种族差异：基于康涅狄格州截至2025年的证据

10.3386/w35410.abstract: How does a person’s own learning experience affect their ability to learn from others? We conduct a field experiment on chlorination in Pakistan, where randomized “learning-arm” households use a tool to track their children’s diarrhea before and after chlorine distribution. Learning-arm households with learning-arm neighbors chlorinate significantly more one year after the withdrawal of the tool, with children’s health improving by 0.08 SD relative to all other households receiving chlorine. Neither learning households without learning-arm neighbors, nor non-learning households with learning-arm neighbors, exhibit sustained behavior change, results which have significant implications for intervention and evaluation design.
10.3386/w35410.abstract_zh: 个人的学习经历如何影响其向他人学习的能力？我们在巴基斯坦开展了一项关于氯消毒的实地实验，随机分配的“学习组”家庭使用工具记录其子女在氯消毒前后的腹泻情况。一年后，当该工具被撤除时，拥有学习组邻居的学习组家庭的氯消毒使用率显著更高，其子女健康状况相较于其他所有接受氯消毒的家庭提升了0.08个标准差。既无学习组邻居的学习组家庭，亦无学习组邻居的非学习组家庭，均未表现出持续的行为改变。这一结果对于干预措施设计与评估方法具有重要启示。
10.3386/w35410.title: Experiential and Social Learning

10.3386/w35411.abstract: With uncertainty about persistence, we show that forecasts necessarily become more persistent and over-react at long horizons. For these reasons, correctly specified and Bayesian forecasts may under-react at short horizons and over-react at long horizons. These results provide a unified explanation for several asset pricing and forecasting puzzles, including: (i) the excess responsiveness of long-horizon rates to short rates, (ii) the dominance of apparent term premia for long-term rates, (iii) the ex post predictability of bond yields, (iv) the excess volatility of long-horizon forward prices, (v) the excess persistence of long-horizon forecasts, and (vi) the over-reaction of long-horizon forecasts.
10.3386/w35411.abstract_zh: 在存在持续性不确定性的情况下，我们证明预测必然变得更加持久，并在长期范围内过度反应。基于这些原因，正确设定的贝叶斯预测可能在短期范围内反应不足，而在长期范围内过度反应。这些结果为多个资产定价与预测谜题提供了统一解释，包括：（i）长期利率对短期利率的过度响应，（ii）长期利率中显性期限溢价的支配地位，（iii）债券收益率的后验可预测性，（iv）长期远期价格的过度波动，（v）长期预测的过度持续性，以及（vi）长期预测的过度反应。
10.3386/w35411.title: Forecasting with Uncertain Persistence
10.3386/w35411.title_zh: 不确定持续性下的预测

10.3386/w35412.abstract: We study the emerging market for tokenized US Treasuries and yield-bearing dollar instruments on public blockchains. Using a comprehensive dataset that combines on-chain transactions, protocol-level total value locked, pool yields, and monetary policy and stress events, we document three core findings. First, yields can be decomposed into distinct components reflecting issuer fees, lending premia, leverage, basis-trade carry, and collateral pledgability, with the latter generating economically large implicit convenience yields. Second, monetary policy transmission into on-chain dollar markets is highly heterogeneous across product designs, with administratively set rates adjusting slowly and basis-trade-backed instruments displaying economically amplified responses to policy shocks. Third, tokenized Treasuries serve as digital safe havens during episodes of cross-asset stress, attracting large inflows during risk-off events while simultaneously exposing new fragilities arising from the interaction between on-chain composability and off-chain reserve structures, particularly through stablecoin balance sheets. Overall, we provide insights into the distinctive dynamics of pricing, transmission, and fragility of digital Treasuries as decentralized and traditional financial infrastructures increasingly integrate.
10.3386/w35412.abstract_zh: 本文研究了新兴的代币化美国国债及公共区块链上生息美元工具市场。通过整合链上交易、协议级锁定总价值、资金池收益率以及货币政策与压力事件的综合数据集，我们得出三项核心发现。第一，收益率可分解为反映发行人费用、贷款溢价、杠杆、基差交易利差及抵押品可质押性的不同组成部分，其中后者产生了经济意义上显著的隐性便利收益率。第二，货币政策向链上美元市场的传导在不同产品设计间呈现高度异质性：行政设定利率调整缓慢，而基差交易支持的工具对政策冲击表现出经济意义上放大的响应。第三，代币化国债在跨资产压力时期充当数字安全港，在风险规避事件期间吸引大量资金流入，同时暴露出链上可组合性与链下储备结构相互作用所产生的新型脆弱性，尤其是通过稳定币资产负债表。总体而言，随着去中心化与传统金融基础设施日益融合，本文为数字国债在定价、传导及脆弱性方面的独特动态提供了洞见。
10.3386/w35412.title: Digital Safe Havens: The Economics of Tokenized Treasuries
10.3386/w35412.title_zh: 数字避风港：代币化国债的经济学

10.3386/w35413.abstract: Portfolio choice involves substituting across many assets at once, complicating inference about asset demand. An elementary condition often captures this behavior in theory and practice: homogeneous substitution conditional on observables (e.g., factor loadings, maturity, credit ratings). We characterize natural experiments identifying demand elasticity and price impact under this condition. Cross-sectional IV and difference-in-differences identify relative elasticity, own- minus cross-price elasticity for assets sharing observables. But a missing-coefficient problem leaves substitution unidentified: the coefficients on observables mechanically absorb it. Identifying substitution requires time-series regressions on portfolios sorted on observables. We apply the framework to corporate bonds, comparing alternative Fed asset-purchase programs.
10.3386/w35413.abstract_zh: 投资组合选择涉及同时跨多种资产进行替代，这使资产需求的推断变得复杂。一个基本条件常在理论和实践中捕捉到这一行为：基于可观测变量（如因子载荷、期限、信用评级）的同质替代。我们刻画了在该条件下识别需求弹性和价格冲击的自然实验。横截面工具变量法和双重差分法可识别相对弹性，即共享可观测变量的资产的自价格弹性减去交叉价格弹性。但缺失系数问题导致替代效应无法识别：可观测变量的系数会机械地吸收替代效应。识别替代效应需要对按可观测变量排序的投资组合进行时间序列回归。我们将该框架应用于公司债券，比较了美联储不同资产购买计划的效果。
10.3386/w35413.title: Causal Inference for Asset Pricing
10.3386/w35413.title_zh: 资产定价中的因果推断

10.3386/w35414.abstract: Large cities worldwide have adopted congestion pricing to reduce urban traffic, with well-documented benefits for travel speeds, accident rates, and air quality. This paper identifies a novel external benefit: faster emergency medical service response times. We provide the first evidence on how the congestion pricing program in New York City – the first comprehensive cordon-based congestion pricing system in the U.S. that was implemented on January 5th 2025 – affects emergency medical service (EMS) response performance. Exploiting the sharp geographic boundary of New York City's congestion relief zone at 60th Street and a difference-in-discontinuities design applied to approximately 1.6 million EMS incidents, we find that the January 2025 implementation of congestion pricing reduced passenger vehicle traffic by roughly 21 percent near the boundary and improved total EMS travel times by 63–70 seconds, approximately 5–6 percent. Effects emerged quickly and show little evidence of displacement to adjacent areas. A concurrent FDNY directive requiring transport to the nearest hospital confounds standard difference-in-differences estimates but not our boundary-based design. These findings suggest that cost-benefit analyses of congestion pricing systematically understate net social benefits by omitting emergency response improvements.
10.3386/w35414.abstract_zh: 全球各大城市已普遍采用拥堵收费政策以减少城市交通拥堵，其在提升通行速度、降低事故率及改善空气质量方面的效益已有充分文献佐证。本文识别出一项新的外部效益：急救医疗服务响应速度的提升。我们首次提供了关于纽约市拥堵收费计划——美国首个于2025年1月5日实施的综合性区域拥堵收费系统——如何影响急救医疗服务响应绩效的证据。利用纽约市拥堵缓解区在第60街的清晰地理边界，并结合对约160万起急救医疗事件的双重断点回归设计，我们发现2025年1月实施的拥堵收费使边界附近乘用车交通量减少约21%，并将急救医疗总行程时间缩短63至70秒，降幅约为5%至6%。该效应迅速显现，且几乎没有证据表明其向邻近区域产生转移效应。纽约消防局同期发布的将患者送往最近医院的指令干扰了标准双重差分估计，但未影响我们基于边界的识别策略。这些发现表明，拥堵收费的成本效益分析因忽略应急响应改善而系统性地低估了净社会效益。
10.3386/w35414.title: Congestion Pricing and EMS Response Time: Evidence From New York City
10.3386/w35414.title_zh: 拥堵收费与急救响应时间：来自纽约市的证据

10.3386/w35415.abstract: Growth theory is based on the assumption of exponential total factor productivity (TFP) growth, or that the conditional expectation of the next TFP increment is proportional to the current level of TFP. In the U.S., we find strong evidence that TFP growth is conditionally additive, not exponential. Even starting from low priors, Bayesian estimation selects the additive model over the exponential one. In addition, professional forecasts and international TFP series are consistent with the additive model but not with the exponential one.
10.3386/w35415.abstract_zh: 增长理论建立在全要素生产率（TFP）呈指数增长或下一期TFP增量的条件期望与当前TFP水平成比例的假设之上。在美国，我们发现了强有力的证据表明TFP增长是条件可加的，而非指数形式。即使从较低的先验概率出发，贝叶斯估计也倾向于选择可加模型而非指数模型。此外，专业预测数据与国际TFP序列均与可加模型一致，而与指数模型不符。
10.3386/w35415.title: Is Growth Additive?

10.3386/w35416.abstract: We develop a tractable quantitative model of international trade in which agents make bilateral investments in resilience under general equilibrium uncertainty. Under both complete and incomplete financial markets, we show that these bilateral investments solve a portfolio problem of choosing trade partners. Countries' risk profiles become determinants of trade flows, income and welfare, whose first moments are affected by the second moments of productivity and trade costs. Changes in global economic uncertainty have heterogeneous effects across countries, depending on how they affect real hedging opportunities. The opening of trade can raise or reduce income volatility, but is revealed-preferred to autarky.
10.3386/w35416.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个可量化的国际贸易模型，其中经济主体在一般均衡不确定性下对韧性进行双边投资。在完全金融市场与不完全金融市场两种情形下，我们证明这些双边投资可归结为选择贸易伙伴的投资组合问题。国家的风险特征成为决定贸易流、收入与福利的关键因素，而这些变量的第一矩受生产率与贸易成本第二矩的影响。全球经济不确定性的变化对不同国家产生异质性效应，其影响方向取决于这些变化如何改变实际对冲机会。贸易开放可能提高或降低收入波动性，但通过显示性偏好分析可知，其福利水平优于自给自足状态。
10.3386/w35416.title: International Trade in an Uncertain World
10.3386/w35416.title_zh: 不确定世界中的国际贸易

10.3386/w35417.abstract: Using diaries covering 25-61-year-olds in the American Time Use Survey 2009-24, this study demonstrates that temporal variety—doing more different things in a day—is income superior. Linking these data to underlying Current Population Surveys, propensity-score models show that people stating that they have a mobility/physical disability in each of two consecutive annual surveys undertake almost 4 percent fewer activities per day than other, demographically identical individuals. They also earn about 50 percent less. Combining the estimated impact of income on temporal variety with the implied reductions in variety incurred by those with the disability yields a monetary equivalent of lost variety exceeding that of lost earnings. Measuring disability status only once yields much smaller estimated shortfalls in temporal variety and earnings. That suggests that one-time self-reports of disabilities, which underlie the bulk of studies on the impacts of disabilities on earnings, also underestimate long-term effects.
10.3386/w35417.abstract_zh: 本研究利用2009-2024年美国时间使用调查中25-61岁人群的日记数据，证明时间多样性（即一天内从事更多不同活动）具有收入优越性。通过将这些数据与基础当前人口调查相关联，倾向得分模型显示，在连续两次年度调查中均报告存在行动/身体残疾的个体，其每日活动数量比人口统计学特征相同的其他群体少近4%，收入也低约50%。将收入对时间多样性的估计影响与残疾群体所承受的多样性减少幅度相结合，得出多样性损失的货币等价物超过了收入损失。仅单次测量残疾状态时，时间多样性和收入缺口的估计值显著偏小。这表明，基于单次自我报告残疾状态（多数残疾对收入影响研究的基础）会低估长期效应。
10.3386/w35417.title: Losses from a Disability: Temporal Variety and Earnings in the Long Run
10.3386/w35417.title_zh: 残疾导致的损失：长期中的时间变化与收入

10.3386/w35418.abstract: Do tax subsidies prompt investors to take on risk? We address this question by looking at investors' responses to changes to the Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) program, which reduces capital gains taxes on startup investing. We do so under a framework in which some startup investors — venture capitalists (VCs) — combine outside funding with incentive-based compensation, while others invest their own funds. Using bunching, triple-differences, and matching designs that exploit industry eligibility, investment vintage, and holding-period requirements, we analyze data from 158 thousand investor–firm pairings over two decades. We identify strategic investment timing, with subsidies prompting bunching at tax-eligible holding-period thresholds. Most notably, when and where tax subsidies apply, VCs shift their project selection toward riskier ventures: they invest more in pre-commercial stage startups, become more likely to provide startups with their initial capital, and invest more in startups with pre-existing debt, while becoming less likely to co-syndicate their investments. Tax-subsidized VC-backed ventures show higher failure rates, but on the flip side, attain higher valuations at exit and are more likely to reach "unicorn status." None of these patterns are observed for comparable non-VC investors in startups exposed to the same tax subsidies. Our tests further show that tax incentives lead to reallocation toward more innovative industries, yielding more impactful patents. Our study is the first to show that tax policy can shift entrepreneurial financing toward riskier, more innovative, and valuable startups.
10.3386/w35418.abstract_zh: 税收补贴是否会促使投资者承担风险？我们通过考察投资者对合格小型企业股票（QSBS）计划变化的反应来探讨这一问题，该计划降低了初创企业投资的资本利得税。我们在一个框架下进行分析，其中部分初创企业投资者——风险投资家（VC）——将外部资金与基于激励的薪酬相结合，而其他投资者则使用自有资金。利用行业资格、投资年份和持有期要求，我们采用聚束分析、三重差分和匹配设计，对二十年间15.8万个投资者-企业配对数据进行分析。我们识别出策略性投资时机，即补贴促使投资者在符合税收优惠的持有期阈值处出现聚束现象。最值得注意的是，在税收补贴适用时，风险投资家将项目选择转向风险更高的企业：他们更多投资于商业化前阶段的初创企业，更可能为初创企业提供初始资本，并更多投资于已有债务的初创企业，同时减少联合投资。获得税收补贴的风险投资支持企业失败率更高，但另一方面，它们在退出时获得更高估值，且更可能达到"独角兽地位"。在面临相同税收补贴的可比非风险投资投资者中，未观察到这些模式。我们的进一步检验表明，税收激励导致资源向更具创新性的行业重新配置，产生更具影响力的专利。本研究首次证明，税收政策可将创业融资转向风险更高、更具创新性和价值的初创企业。
10.3386/w35418.title: Tax Incentives and Venture Capital Risk-Taking: Evidence from the QSBS Program
10.3386/w35418.title_zh: 税收激励与风险资本风险承担：来自QSBS项目的证据

10.3386/w35419.abstract: Experimental and quasi-experimental studies show that childhood neighborhoods have substantial causal impacts on children’s adult earnings and other long-term socioeconomic outcomes. Several market failures are likely to lead to excessive residential segregation by parental income and to an under-supply of mixed-income neighborhoods. Missing markets for opportunity originate in capital market imperfections for borrowing on children’s future earnings, neighbor spillovers, behavioral biases, and housing search frictions. Customized housing mobility services combined with subsidized housing vouchers can help low-income families move to higher-opportunity areas. Place-based policies that create mixed-income neighborhoods appear to increase long-term outcomes for less-advantaged children.
10.3386/w35419.abstract_zh: 实验与准实验研究表明，童年居住社区对儿童成年后的收入及其他长期社会经济结果具有显著的因果影响。多种市场失灵可能导致按父母收入划分的居住隔离过度，并造成混合收入社区供给不足。机会缺失的市场源于儿童未来收入借贷的资本市场不完善、邻里溢出效应、行为偏差以及住房搜寻摩擦。定制化住房流动服务与补贴性住房券相结合，可帮助低收入家庭迁往机会更多的区域。创建混合收入社区的属地化政策似乎能改善弱势儿童的长期发展结果。
10.3386/w35419.title: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity
10.3386/w35419.title_zh: 邻里效应与机会市场的缺失

10.3386/w35420.abstract: Environmental decisions often impact health, yet morbidity valuation remains challenging, with current approaches like cost-of-illness (COI) measures and Quality-Adjusted Life Years failing to reflect individuals’ willingness to pay to avoid adverse health states. This paper introduces a novel framework for valuing morbidity across health conditions, deriving willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates using widely available preference weights and a baseline condition with known WTP. Our analysis reveals WTP estimates significantly exceeding commonly used COI measures, indicating undervaluation of health states in policy evaluations. Sensitivity analyses highlight variations consistent with those for the value of statistical life, underscoring the method's robustness. This framework offers a practical tool for integrating morbidity into analyses of environmental policy.
10.3386/w35420.abstract_zh: 环境决策常影响健康，但疾病负担的估值仍面临挑战。当前的成本-疾病法（COI）和质量调整生命年等指标未能反映个体为避免不良健康状态而愿意支付的金额。本文提出一种跨健康状况评估疾病负担的新框架，通过广泛可用的偏好权重和已知支付意愿的基准健康状况，推导出支付意愿（WTP）估计值。分析显示，WTP估计值显著高于常用的COI指标，表明政策评估中健康状态被低估。敏感性分析揭示了与统计生命价值一致的变异特征，凸显了该方法的稳健性。该框架为将疾病负担纳入环境政策分析提供了实用工具。
10.3386/w35420.title: From Minor Ailments to Major Illnesses: A Practical Framework for Valuing Morbidity in Environmental Policy Analysis
10.3386/w35420.title_zh: 从轻微不适到重大疾病：环境政策分析中疾病负担评估的实用框架

10.3386/w35421.abstract: We show that quantitative easing (QE) worsens government debt sustainability. In our model, the government has a negative primary balance and downward-sloping debt demand that makes interest rates endogenous. The central bank has long-term capital and remits profits to the fiscal authority. QE depletes this capital stock, reducing future remittances and crisis-fighting reserves.
