10.3386/w35529.abstract: We study how temperature fluctuations affect U.S. state-level economic conditions using high frequency, weekly data from 1987 to 2024. The impulse response to a temperature shock from a panel local projection framework reveals a modest short-run increase in economic conditions followed by a delayed and persistent medium-run decline. Nonlinearities show that the medium-run decline is larger and more persistent at higher base temperatures. A decomposition of the economic conditions index points to the labor market as the primary channel. To interpret these findings, we develop a weekly labor search and matching model featuring a labor disutility channel, a heat damage stock, and a slow-moving adaptation mechanism.
10.3386/w35529.abstract_zh: 本文利用1987年至2024年的高频周度数据，研究温度波动如何影响美国各州经济状况。基于面板局部投影框架的温度冲击脉冲响应显示，经济状况在短期内温和上升，随后出现延迟且持续的中期下降。非线性分析表明，在较高基准温度下，中期下降幅度更大且更持久。对经济状况指数的分解表明，劳动力市场是主要传导渠道。为解释这些发现，我们构建了一个包含劳动负效用渠道、热损害存量以及缓慢调整适应机制的周度劳动力搜索与匹配模型。
10.3386/w35529.title: Temperature Fluctuations and Economic Conditions: Evidence from Weekly U.S. Data
10.3386/w35529.title_zh: 温度波动与经济状况：来自美国周度数据的证据

10.3386/w35530.abstract: As renewable generation plays a growing role in the energy system, periods of negative wholesale electricity prices are becoming increasingly common and are expected to grow dramatically over the next ten years. Traditionally, system operators respond by paying generators, especially renewables, to curtail production, or mandating that they do so without compensation. In this study, we propose and test a novel alternative: exposing consumers to free and negative prices to stimulate demand when supply is abundant. We implemented large-scale nationwide natural field experiments simultaneously in Great Britain and Spain, with roughly 60,000 residential customers in each country randomized to receive varying financial incentives to “turn up” their electricity. We found that demand increased substantially as prices fell to zero, but paying customers to consume beyond zero price yielded little additional response. Households with electric vehicles and rooftop solar had a larger elasticity than households without such technologies, suggesting demand turn-up becomes more effective as households adopt low-carbon technologies. In Great Britain, consumption was largely shifted from adjacent hours, while in Spain the increase appeared to represent net new demand. We develop a welfare framework showing conditions under which demand turn-up improves on curtailment; we find that by inducing additional consumption in periods and locations where the marginal cost of supply is low, demand turn-up generates welfare gains that curtailment leaves uncaptured.
10.3386/w35530.abstract_zh: 随着可再生能源在能源系统中扮演日益重要的角色，负批发电价现象正变得愈发普遍，预计未来十年将大幅增长。传统上，系统运营商会通过向发电商（尤其是可再生能源发电商）支付费用要求其削减产量，或强制其无偿减产来应对这一情况。本研究提出并检验了一种创新替代方案：在供应充裕时，通过向消费者提供零电价甚至负电价来刺激需求。我们在英国和西班牙同步开展了大规模全国性自然现场实验，每个国家约有6万户居民被随机分配接受不同力度的经济激励，以"提升"其用电量。研究发现，当电价降至零时，需求显著增长；但通过付费激励消费者在零电价基础上进一步增加用电，收效甚微。拥有电动汽车和屋顶太阳能的家庭需求弹性显著高于未配备此类技术的家庭，这表明随着家庭采用低碳技术，"需求提升"策略将更为有效。在英国，用电增量主要来自相邻时段的用电转移；而在西班牙，用电增长则表现为净新增需求。我们构建了一个福利分析框架，揭示了"需求提升"优于"削减产量"的条件：通过在供应边际成本较低的时段和区域诱导额外消费，"需求提升"能够产生"削减产量"策略无法实现的福利增益。
10.3386/w35530.title: A Demand-Side Alternative to Renewable Curtailment: Natural Field Experimental Evidence from Two Countries
10.3386/w35530.title_zh: 可再生能源弃电的需求侧替代方案：来自两国的自然实地实验证据

10.3386/w35531.abstract: This paper examines reforms in China’s imperial examination system during the Northern Song dynasty that anonymized exam submissions and ended local officials’ discretion to recommend candidates. Using prefecture-level data from 960–1127 and a difference-in-differences design, we compare areas with and without prominent elite families, where corruption and elite capture were more likely. The reforms increased the share of successful candidates from commoner backgrounds and narrowed their performance gaps with elites in scholarship and political achievement, indicating better selection of commoner talent. Treated prefectures also saw less social unrest. Overall, the reforms strengthened meritocracy, broadened political access, and promoted stability.
10.3386/w35531.abstract_zh: 本文考察了北宋时期科举制度的改革，该改革对考卷进行匿名处理，并终止了地方官员推荐考生的自由裁量权。利用960年至1127年的府级数据，并采用双重差分法，我们比较了存在显著精英家族的地区（这些地区更易发生腐败和精英俘获）与其他地区的情况。改革提高了来自平民背景的考生中举比例，并缩小了他们与精英阶层在学术造诣和政治成就上的表现差距，表明对平民人才的选拔更为有效。受改革影响的府级地区社会动荡也有所减少。总体而言，改革强化了贤能政治，拓宽了政治参与渠道，并促进了社会稳定。
10.3386/w35531.title: Elite Capture, Meritocracy and Social Stability: Evidence from the Chinese Imperial Examinations
10.3386/w35531.title_zh: 精英俘获、精英统治与社会稳定：来自中国科举制度的证据

10.3386/w35532.abstract: Total fertility rates in East Asia have fallen to levels without historical precedent, even though the region’s Confucian heritage long placed extraordinary emphasis on family continuity and large families. We argue that this “Confucian Fertility Paradox” dissolves once we separate two strands of the tradition and recognize that modernization affected them very differently. The pro-natal strand, built on lineage continuity, ancestor worship, and reliance on sons for old-age support, was gradually switched off as child mortality fell, incomes rose, women entered the labor force, and state pensions replaced the family as the main source of security in old age. What survived was the second strand: the veneration of education and of status won through examination success, rooted in the imperial examination tradition. Under modern conditions this surviving strand reverses sign with respect to its effect on fertility. Where the historical examination system rewarded having many sons so that one might succeed, the modern single-ranking tournament rewards concentrating resources on one or two intensively educated children, and the quantity–quality tradeoff turns a once pro-natal culture into a powerful engine of low fertility. Drawing on recent empirical evidence from China and Korea, we show how education competition becomes the channel through which traditional values now suppress childbearing. We explain why standard pro-natalist policies, such as removing birth restrictions or offering cash subsidies, accomplish little when the underlying problem is a competitive equilibrium in parental investment, and we argue that policies aimed at the source of the distortion, such as structural reform of educational pathways, hold more promise.
10.3386/w35532.abstract_zh: 东亚地区的总和生育率已降至史无前例的低水平，尽管该地区悠久的儒家传统历来极度重视家族延续与多子多福。本文认为，一旦我们将这一传统中的两条脉络加以区分，并认识到现代化对它们产生了截然不同的影响，所谓的"儒家生育悖论"便迎刃而解。第一条鼓励生育的脉络——建立在宗族延续、祖先崇拜以及养儿防老基础之上——随着儿童死亡率下降、收入增长、女性进入劳动力市场以及国家养老金取代家庭成为老年保障的主要来源而逐渐消退。留存下来的是第二条脉络：对教育的尊崇以及通过科举成功获得社会地位的追求，这一传统根植于帝国科举制度。在现代条件下，这条留存下来的脉络对生育的影响发生了逆转。历史上的科举制度奖励多生儿子以增加中举概率，而现代单一排名的锦标赛式竞争则鼓励将资源集中投入于一两个接受精英教育的子女身上。数量与质量的权衡使曾经鼓励生育的文化转变为低生育率的强大引擎。基于来自中国和韩国的最新实证证据，我们揭示了教育竞争如何成为传统价值观抑制生育的传导渠道。我们解释了为何当根本问题在于父母投资中的竞争均衡时，诸如取消生育限制或提供现金补贴等标准鼓励生育政策收效甚微，并论证了针对扭曲根源的政策——例如教育路径的结构性改革——更具前景。
10.3386/w35532.title: The Confucian Fertility Paradox: Education Competition and Ultra-Low Fertility in East Asia
10.3386/w35532.title_zh: 儒家生育悖论：教育竞争与东亚超低生育率

10.3386/w35533.abstract: This paper examines the long-term effects of early-life exposure to county health departments (CHDs), a public health initiative aimed at providing affordable healthcare access to disadvantaged and underserved areas during the early decades of the 20th century, on later-life longevity. We employ Social Security Administration death records linked with the 1940 census and implement a difference-in-differences estimation strategy to compare the longevity of individuals exposed at different ages to the county-specific year of CHD establishment. We find that exposure to a CHD opening in the county of birth during fetal development and early years of life is associated with a 1-4-month increase in longevity. We observe considerable heterogeneity in the results, such that the effects are more concentrated among non-white individuals and individuals with lower-educated parents. Contemporaneous fertility and infant mortality data suggest reductions in infant mortality rates and increases in birth rates following CHD openings. Additionally, we find significant improvements in educational attainment, socioeconomic status, and income in early adulthood. We argue that enhancements in the fetal environment, improved fetal survival, and better early life health capital resulting from CHD exposure contribute to improvements in human capital during adulthood, with potential implications for later-life longevity.
10.3386/w35533.abstract_zh: 本文考察了早期接触县级卫生部门（CHDs）对晚年寿命的长期影响。CHDs是20世纪早期旨在为弱势和医疗服务不足地区提供可负担医疗服务的公共卫生举措。我们利用与1940年人口普查相关联的社会保障管理局死亡记录，并采用双重差分估计策略，比较不同年龄接触县级卫生部门设立年份的个体的寿命差异。研究发现，在胎儿发育期和生命早期接触出生县CHD的设立与寿命延长1-4个月相关。结果存在显著异质性，非白人个体及父母教育水平较低的个体受影响更为集中。同期生育率和婴儿死亡率数据显示，CHD设立后婴儿死亡率下降、出生率上升。此外，我们发现早期成年期的教育程度、社会经济地位和收入均有显著改善。我们认为，CHD接触带来的胎儿环境改善、胎儿存活率提升及早期健康资本积累，促进了成年期人力资本提升，并对晚年寿命产生潜在影响。
10.3386/w35533.title: Early Life Healthcare Access and Later-life Mortality: Evidence Using Openings of County Health Departments
10.3386/w35533.title_zh: 早期医疗保健可及性与晚年死亡率：基于县级卫生部门设立的证据

10.3386/w35534.abstract: Tax avoidance through personal holding companies has long been viewed as a key challenge for progressive income taxation. We exploit twenty years of administrative micro-data linking firms to owners in Sweden and Norway to analyze how the use of personal holding companies varies across the income distribution and to quantify its implications in a quasi-experimental setting. About half of the income of the top 0.1% is retained in personal holding companies defined, as in US tax law, as firms for which five or fewer owners own more than 50% of the stock and that derive more than 60% of income from investment income. Event studies of shocks to operational firms’ value-added show that holding companies shield around half of dividend distributions from individual income taxation. Profits tend to remain in holding companies for long periods of time, with cumulative payout rates of 15%–20% over two decades for the highest income groups. Wealth taxes do not provide an effective backstop due to the low valuation (or exemption) of shares in private businesses. As a result, effective tax rates, all taxes included, fall from about 50% for the upper middle class to about 15%–20% among the highest-net-worth individuals. Accounting for income in holding companies erases half of the difference in the 1980–2020 rise of the top 1% fiscal income share between Nordic countries and the United States, where rules penalizing the use of holding companies have been in place since the 1930s.
10.3386/w35534.abstract_zh: 通过个人控股公司避税长期以来被视为累进所得税制面临的关键挑战。我们利用瑞典和挪威二十年来将企业与所有者关联的行政微观数据，分析个人控股公司的使用如何随收入分配变化，并在准实验环境中量化其影响。根据美国税法定义，个人控股公司指由不超过五名所有者持有超过50%股份、且超过60%收入来源于投资收入的企业。在最高收入前0.1%群体中，约半数收入留存于此类公司。对运营企业增加值冲击的事件研究表明，控股公司约将半数股息分配从个人所得税中屏蔽。利润往往长期留存于控股公司，最高收入群体二十年累计派息率仅为15%-20%。由于私人企业股份估值偏低（或享受豁免），财富税无法提供有效补充。因此，包含所有税种在内的实际税率，从中上阶层的约50%降至最高净值人群的约15%-20%。若将控股公司收入纳入统计，1980-2020年间北欧国家与美国的顶层1%财政性收入份额增长差异将缩小一半——美国自1930年代起便实施限制控股公司使用的规则。
10.3386/w35534.title: Personal Holding Companies, Tax Progressivity, and Inequality
10.3386/w35534.title_zh: 个人控股公司、税收累进性与不平等

10.3386/w35535.abstract: We document arguably unintended returns of biodiversity conservation to science discovery, exploiting the 2002 fishing ban in China—an ecosystem restoration policy without explicit science-related objectives, which allows us to implement a difference-in-differences design across fish species. We find that the ban substantially increased research on affected species: funded programs rose by 21.5%, total funding by 22.8%, publications per program by 97.0%, and citations per paper by 106.7%. The effect is concentrated among researchers with geographic access to the river, and is stronger for non-extinct species and non-farmed fish species, suggesting that conservation expanded the supply of biological materials available for research. The ban also increased related public influence and patents. These results reveal that biodiversity conservation generates a significant scientific dividend through the restoration of natural research inputs, with implications for evaluating the broader benefits of ecosystem protections in an underdiscussed dimension for the science of science.
10.3386/w35535.abstract_zh: 我们记录了生物多样性保护对科学发现的意外回报，利用2002年中国实施的禁渔令——一项没有明确科学相关目标的生态系统恢复政策，这使得我们能够对鱼类物种进行双重差分设计。研究发现，禁渔令显著增加了受影响物种的研究：资助项目数量上升21.5%，总资助金额增加22.8%，每个项目的论文产出提高97.0%，每篇论文的引用量增长106.7%。这一效应集中在具有河流地理接近性的研究人员中，且对非灭绝物种和非养殖鱼类更为显著，表明保护措施扩大了可供研究的生物材料供给。禁渔令还提升了相关的公众影响力及专利数量。这些结果揭示，生物多样性保护通过恢复自然研究投入产生了显著的科学红利，对在科学学中尚未充分讨论的维度上评估生态系统保护的更广泛效益具有启示意义。
10.3386/w35535.title: The Scientific Return of Biodiversity Conservation: Evidence from Fishing Bans Along the Yangtze River
10.3386/w35535.title_zh: 生物多样性保护的科学回报：来自长江禁渔政策的证据

10.3386/w35536.abstract: Progressive taxation is central to high-income countries' tax systems, but developing countries typically rely on less progressive instruments. We study the introduction of progressive property taxation in a large Congolese city through a citywide field experiment conducted in partnership with the provincial government. Neighborhoods were randomly assigned to a progressive or a proportional schedule. The progressive schedule increased revenue by 56% relative to the proportional one. Gains occurred throughout the property value distribution: at the top, higher statutory rates mechanically raised revenue despite modest compliance losses; at the bottom, lower rates induced compliance gains large enough to offset lower liabilities. Cross-randomized information treatments show that taxpayers responded primarily to their own rates, not to others' rates or to the perceived fairness of the overall schedule. Effective tax rates – taxes paid as a share of property value – declined with property value and were most regressive under the progressive schedule. However, after a progressive schedule was scaled up citywide in subsequent years, targeted enforcement among high-value properties reversed this pattern, aligning statutory and effective rates. Together, the results suggest that progressive property taxation can raise fiscal capacity in low-income settings and, when paired with targeted enforcement, further shift the tax burden onto wealthier property owners.
10.3386/w35536.abstract_zh: 累进税制是高收入国家税收体系的核心，但发展中国家通常采用累进性较弱的税制。我们与省政府合作，在刚果某大城市开展了一项全市范围的实地实验，研究累进财产税的引入效果。社区被随机分配至累进税率或比例税率方案。相较于比例税率，累进税率使税收收入增加56%。这一增长覆盖了全部房产价值区间：在高端房产中，尽管存在适度的合规损失，但更高的法定税率机械性地提升了收入；在低端房产中，较低的税率带来的合规收益足以抵消税负减少的影响。交叉随机信息干预实验表明，纳税人主要对自身税率做出反应，而非他人税率或整体税制的公平性感知。有效税率（即实际缴纳的税款占房产价值的比例）随房产价值递减，且在累进税制下呈现最强的累退性。然而，当累进税制在后续年份推广至全市范围后，针对高价值房产的定向执法扭转了这一趋势，使法定税率与有效税率趋于一致。综合来看，研究结果表明：累进财产税能够提升低收入地区的财政汲取能力，若配合定向执法，可进一步将税负转移至更富裕的房产所有者。
10.3386/w35536.title: Does Progressivity Raise Tax Capacity? Experimental Evidence from the D.R. Congo
10.3386/w35536.title_zh: 累进性是否提升税收能力？来自刚果（金）的实验证据

10.3386/w35537.abstract: Financial incentives may encourage vaccination, but their cost-effectiveness depends on targeting patients who are most responsive. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 57,579 adult patients in an integrated health system during the 2021–2022 influenza season. Patients with an upcoming appointment were randomized to a no-contact control, a simple reminder, a $1 cash incentive, or a scratch-off lottery ticket incentive worth up to $5,000. Any active intervention increased vaccination at the scheduled appointment by 2 percentage points (an 8% increase over the control mean) and by 1.5 percentage points over the full influenza season. The three active arms did not differ significantly, indicating that small financial incentives provided no additional benefit beyond a reminder. Using electronic health records and area-level characteristics, we used causal forests to estimate conditional average treatment effects. Predicted responsiveness varied substantially: patients in the top quartile were 3–4 times more likely to respond to incentives than those in the bottom quartile, whereas reminder effects were relatively homogeneous. These findings suggest that low-cost reminders can increase influenza vaccination, while machine-learning methods can help identify patients most responsive to small financial incentives.
10.3386/w35537.abstract_zh: 经济激励可能促进疫苗接种，但其成本效益取决于能否精准锁定最易响应的患者群体。我们在2021-2022年流感季期间，对某整合医疗系统中57,579名成年患者开展随机对照试验。将近期有预约的患者随机分为四组：无接触对照组、简单提醒组、1美元现金激励组、最高价值5000美元的刮刮乐彩票激励组。任何主动干预措施均使预约接种率提升2个百分点（较对照组均值增长8%），整个流感季接种率提升1.5个百分点。三个干预组间无显著差异，表明小额经济激励相较于单纯提醒并未产生额外效益。我们利用电子健康档案与区域特征数据，通过因果森林模型估计条件平均处理效应。预测响应度呈现显著异质性：响应度最高四分位患者对激励措施的反应概率是低四分位患者的3-4倍，而提醒效应的异质性相对较小。研究结果表明，低成本提醒可提升流感疫苗接种率，机器学习方法则有助于识别对小额经济激励最敏感的患者群体。
10.3386/w35537.title: Effects of Lottery Incentives for Influenza Vaccination: Evidence from a Large-Scale Randomized Trial and Causal Forest Analysis
10.3386/w35537.title_zh: 彩票激励对流感疫苗接种的影响：来自大规模随机试验与因果森林分析的证据

10.3386/w35538.abstract: We analyze the association between cognitive impairments and long-term care use in the 65+ population in the Netherlands. For this, we use data from the Lifelines Cohort Study that are linked to administrative records available through Statistics Netherlands. We find that, among those with cognitive impairments, long-term care use is concentrated in a subgroup: 42% of those with cognitive impairments do not use any long-term care. At the same time, individuals with cognitive impairments who use long-term care have high expenditures, in particular when living in nursing homes. Further analyses reveal that many individuals with cognitive impairments report functional limitations and that cognitive impairment is associated with long-term care use above and beyond these impairments. These findings highlight the importance of taking cognitive impairments into account when seeking to explain the determinants of long-term care use in research and when tailoring long-term care programs to the needs of the elderly when considering policy reforms.
10.3386/w35538.abstract_zh: 我们分析了荷兰65岁及以上人群中认知障碍与长期护理使用之间的关联。为此，我们利用了Lifelines队列研究的数据，这些数据与荷兰统计局提供的行政记录相链接。我们发现，在认知障碍患者中，长期护理的使用集中于一个亚群：42%的认知障碍患者未使用任何长期护理。同时，使用长期护理的认知障碍个体支出较高，尤其是在养老院居住时。进一步分析显示，许多认知障碍个体报告存在功能限制，且认知障碍与长期护理使用之间的关联超出了这些功能限制的影响。这些发现强调了在研究中解释长期护理使用决定因素时考虑认知障碍的重要性，以及在政策改革中根据老年人需求定制长期护理计划时的重要性。
10.3386/w35538.title: Cognitive Limitations and Long-Term Care Use in the Netherlands: Evidence from the Lifelines Cohort Study
10.3386/w35538.title_zh: 认知限制与荷兰长期照护使用：来自生命线队列研究的证据

10.3386/w35539.abstract: Using text-as-data methods, we quantify the U.S. discourse on China, place it in historical perspective, and compare its evolution across different sources of public narrative. Our analysis is based on a large corpus of materials drawn from public records (presidential and congressional records, newspaper articles, social media, think tank reports). We develop two measures of narrative discourse: an indicator of the frequency with which China is covered and a proxy for how positively or negatively China is presented. We document a sustained decline in net sentiment towards China in presidential sources since the early 2000s, predating Donald Trump’s first term in office. In contrast to presidential documents, congressional, news media, social media, and think tank sources exhibit persistent negative sentiment towards China even in decades prior to the 2000s. Instead of a deterioration in sentiment across the board, what we find is a convergence in presidential sentiment to other sources of narrative discourse. We find no evidence that presidential leadership has played a significant role in setting the narrative tone for the nation as a whole. Historical and shorter-term evidence both point to a bottom-up process of diffusion of narratives, rather than top-down diffusion.
10.3386/w35539.abstract_zh: 运用文本数据方法，我们量化了美国关于中国的论述，将其置于历史视角中，并比较了不同公共叙事来源间的演变。我们的分析基于大量来自公共记录（总统与国会记录、报纸文章、社交媒体、智库报告）的语料库。我们开发了两种叙事论述的度量指标：一个是中国被提及频率的指示器，另一个是反映中国被呈现为正面或负面程度的代理变量。我们记录了自21世纪初以来，总统来源中对中国的净情感持续下降，这一趋势早于唐纳德·特朗普的首个任期。与总统文件相比，国会、新闻媒体、社交媒体及智库来源在2000年代之前的数十年间就已表现出对中国的持续负面情感。我们发现的并非整体情感的恶化，而是总统情感向其他叙事论述来源的趋同。我们没有发现证据表明总统领导力在全国范围内设定叙事基调方面发挥了重要作用。历史及短期证据均指向叙事传播的自下而上过程，而非自上而下的扩散。
10.3386/w35539.title: The China Backlash: Quantifying the Narrative Discourse on China
10.3386/w35539.title_zh: 中国反弹：量化关于中国的叙事话语

10.3386/w3554.abstract: The current debate in Western Europe centers on the relationship between economic and political integration. To address this problem, we construct a simple general equilibrium model in which the returns to trading are directly affected by the availability of a public good. In our model, heterogeneous agents choose both a club and a market to belong to. In the club, agents vote over the public good, are taxed to finance this good, and receive access to it when they trade. In the market, they are randomly matched with a partner. If a match occurs between traders of different clubs, they both suffer a transactions cost.
10.3386/w3554.abstract_zh: 当前西欧的辩论焦点在于经济一体化与政治一体化之间的关系。为解决这一问题，我们构建了一个简单的一般均衡模型，其中贸易收益直接受到公共品可得性的影响。在该模型中，异质性主体需同时选择加入某个俱乐部和某个市场。在俱乐部内部，成员通过投票决定公共品供给，缴纳相应税收以资助该公共品，并在贸易时获得其使用权；而在市场中，主体则随机匹配交易伙伴。若交易双方来自不同俱乐部，则需承担交易成本。
10.3386/w3554.title: DP511 Public Goods in Trade: On the Formation of Markets and Political Jurisdictions
10.3386/w3554.title_zh: DP511 贸易中的公共品：论市场与政治管辖区的形成

10.3386/w35540.abstract: Many public-sector decisions require allocating scarce attention under uncertainty. We examine whether algorithmic risk assessments improve child-protection decisions, where supervisors decide which cases need closer scrutiny. In a randomized evaluation of 4,752 child referrals over 14 months in Northampton County, supervisors received an algorithmic risk score alongside standard case records. Access to the score increased foster-care placements and services for children at highest predicted risk, with little change for lower-risk cases, and it reduced subsequent maltreatment referrals. We find no evidence that the score widened racial disparities in decisions or outcomes, suggesting algorithms can improve targeting while preserving human discretion.
10.3386/w35540.abstract_zh: 许多公共部门的决策需要在不确定性下分配稀缺的注意力。我们考察了算法风险评估是否能改善儿童保护决策，其中主管需决定哪些案件需要更细致的审查。在北安普顿县为期14个月、涉及4,752例儿童转介的随机评估中，主管在标准案件记录之外还获得了算法风险评分。获取该评分增加了对预测风险最高儿童群体的寄养安置和服务提供，而对低风险案件的变化甚微，并减少了后续的虐待转介。我们未发现该评分在决策或结果上扩大了种族差异的证据，这表明算法能在保留人类判断力的同时改善目标定位。
10.3386/w35540.title: Predictive Risk Scores in the Public Sector: Experimental Evidence from Child-Protection Investigations
10.3386/w35540.title_zh: 公共部门中的预测性风险评分：来自儿童保护调查的实验证据

10.3386/w35541.abstract: Does financial opening necessarily lead to currency internationalization? To study the competition between incumbent and rising powers under financial interdependence, we develop a model of asset demand with microfounded network effects. Search frictions with currency-specialized intermediaries generate distinct notions of liquidity at asset-market and currency-area levels, which jointly shape the trajectory of currency competition. In the U.S.-China context, China at early stages of financial development benefits from pooling its assets with the dollar area, which reinforces the status quo. As China's financial markets deepen, RMB issuance allows China to internalize network effects and erode the dollar's dominance, triggering a discrete shift toward fragmentation. This transition is further shaped by sanctions, financial repression, and third-country responses, highlighting how financial interdependence transforms cooperation into rivalry in the evolution of the international financial order.
10.3386/w35541.abstract_zh: 金融开放是否必然导致货币国际化？为研究金融相互依存下在位大国与新兴大国之间的竞争，我们构建了一个具有微观基础网络效应的资产需求模型。带有货币专业化中介的搜索摩擦在资产市场与货币区域两个层面产生了不同的流动性概念，二者共同塑造了货币竞争的轨迹。在中美背景下，中国在金融发展初期通过将其资产与美元区域合并而获益，这强化了现状。随着中国金融市场深化，人民币发行使中国能够内化网络效应并削弱美元的主导地位，从而引发向碎片化的离散转变。这一转变进一步受到制裁、金融抑制及第三国反应的影响，凸显了金融相互依存如何在国际金融秩序演变中将合作转化为竞争。
10.3386/w35541.title: Financial Interdependence and Currency Internationalization
10.3386/w35541.title_zh: 金融相互依存与货币国际化

10.3386/w35542.abstract: Using U.S. administrative data, we find that technology-driven creative destruction in the product market passes through to worker earnings. The passthrough to incumbent worker earnings is both asymmetric and concentrated: profit drops from rival innovations lead to proportionally greater earnings declines and changes in the likelihood of job destruction than profit gains from their own firm’s innovations, while top workers are significantly more exposed than the average worker. We develop an endogenous-growth model with monopsonistic labor markets and worker heterogeneity that replicates this asymmetry and the distribution of earnings risk. In the model, creative destruction exposes high-income workers to concentrated downside risk while increasing upward mobility for lower-income workers, shaping the welfare consequences of innovation policy.
10.3386/w35542.abstract_zh: 利用美国行政数据，我们发现产品市场中技术驱动的创造性破坏会传导至工人收入。这种传导对在职工人收入的影响既不对称又集中：竞争对手创新导致的利润下降，相较于企业自身创新带来的利润增长，会引发更大比例的收入下降及工作毁灭可能性的变化，而顶尖工人相较于普通工人面临的风险显著更高。我们构建了一个包含垄断性劳动力市场与工人异质性的内生增长模型，该模型复现了这种不对称性及收入风险的分布特征。在模型中，创造性破坏使高收入工人面临集中的下行风险，同时提升低收入工人的向上流动性，从而塑造创新政策的福利后果。
10.3386/w35542.title: Winners and Losers: Competition, Creative Destruction, and Labor Income Risk
10.3386/w35542.title_zh: 赢家与输家：竞争、创造性破坏与劳动收入风险

10.3386/w35543.abstract: Unnecessary treatment reflects a gap between what patients believe about their health and their true condition; people often seek and consume care for diseases they suspect, but do not know that actually have. The value a patient places on testing therefore depends on their priors about being sick, and when those beliefs are biased, the resulting testing rate might be sub-optimal and leave welfare on the table. We study diagnosis-contingent incentive contracts, which tie treatment incentives to diagnostic results. For malaria, the contract subsidizes rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) and antimalarials (ACTs) only for patients who test positive. In a cluster-randomized experiment across 140 Kenyan pharmacies, both patient subsidies and provider incentives roughly tripled testing and sharply reduced unnecessary ACT purchases among test-negative patients, working through distinct channels: patient subsidies through lower prices, provider incentives through information and advice. A model of patient choice implies these contracts raise social welfare well above their cost. Estimating the model structurally, we find that because patients substantially overestimate their infection risk, loading incentives onto diagnosis-contingent treatment discounts delivers four times the welfare gains of free testing programs.
10.3386/w35543.abstract_zh: 不必要的治疗反映了患者对自身健康状况的认知与其真实状况之间的差距；人们常常因怀疑自己患有某种疾病而寻求并接受医疗服务，但实际上并不知晓自己是否真的患病。因此，患者对检测的重视程度取决于其对患病可能性的先验信念，而当这些信念存在偏差时，由此产生的检测率可能并非最优，从而造成福利损失。我们研究了与诊断结果挂钩的激励合同，即将治疗激励与诊断结果相关联。针对疟疾，该合同仅对检测呈阳性的患者补贴快速诊断测试（RDTs）和青蒿素联合疗法（ACTs）。在一项覆盖肯尼亚140家药店的整群随机实验中，患者补贴和提供者激励均使检测率大约提高了两倍，并显著减少了检测阴性患者中不必要的ACT购买，二者通过不同渠道发挥作用：患者补贴通过降低价格，提供者激励则通过信息和建议。患者选择模型表明，这些合同带来的社会福利提升远超其成本。通过对模型进行结构化估计，我们发现，由于患者大幅高估其感染风险，将激励加载到基于诊断结果的治疗折扣上，其福利收益是免费检测项目的四倍。
10.3386/w35543.title: Tying Incentives to Information: Diagnosis-Contingent Contracts and Biased Beliefs in Healthcare
10.3386/w35543.title_zh: 将激励与信息挂钩：基于诊断的合同与医疗中的认知偏差

10.3386/w35544.abstract: Consider a referee report containing the sentence: “Assignment to treatment was voluntary, though the authors acknowledge this as a limitation in the conclusion.” The Editor would summarily reject. Now replace “assignment to treatment” with “entry into the experimental sample,” and the sentence describes the modal published experiment. This study shows that both biases are the same mathematical object. The bias from non-random sample entry is the sorting-on-gains term from the classic selection decomposition. Interestingly, they both admit an isomorphic Roy micro-foundation and inverse-Mills characterization. A simple calibration reveals that for the typical experiment, the observed bias can be large. One solution to this bias is to conduct a natural field experiment (NFE). When an NFE is not possible, three alternative reporting practices are offered.
10.3386/w35544.abstract_zh: 考虑一份审稿报告中包含的句子：“治疗分配是自愿的，尽管作者在结论中承认这是局限性。”编辑会立即拒绝。现在将“治疗分配”替换为“进入实验样本”，该句子描述的是典型已发表实验的情况。本研究表明，这两种偏差在数学上是同一对象。非随机样本进入导致的偏差，正是经典选择分解中的收益排序项。有趣的是，两者都允许同构的罗伊微观基础及逆米尔斯函数表征。一个简单的校准显示，对于典型实验而言，观察到的偏差可能很大。解决此偏差的一种方法是进行自然田野实验（NFE）。当无法进行NFE时，本文提供了三种替代性的报告实践。
10.3386/w35544.title: Two Selection Problems, One Bias Term: Experimental Sign-Up Is Treatment Choice in Disguise
10.3386/w35544.title_zh: 两个选择问题，一个偏差项：实验报名实为伪装的处置选择

10.3386/w35545.abstract: Explaining why some countries grow rich while others remain poor requires knowing how — and when — institutions change. A large body of research argues that institutional change often occurs at critical junctures: moments when multiple institutional futures are possible, including a return to the status quo. Yet most empirical work examines critical junctures only in retrospect, risking the omission of pivotal moments when institutions were in flux but ultimately remained unchanged. We develop a new empirical approach to detect critical junctures as they unfold. Our key insight is to understand critical junctures as moments of uncertainty about institutions, which provides a text classifier with a theoretically motivated object to detect in contemporaneous discourse. In this chapter, we apply this idea to the study of historical critical junctures using newspaper text as a rich source of information regarding contemporary beliefs about institutional uncertainty. We translate this insight into a measurement strategy by training a large language model-based classifier, which we apply to the Times of London archive — 11.95 million articles spanning 1800 to 2019 — while focusing our main empirical analysis on 120 years of reporting from 1900 to 2019. This produces the first long-run, text-based measure of institutional uncertainty grounded in the concept of critical junctures. Compared to established indices of geopolitical and economic risk, our measure innovates on several fronts: (i) it captures high uncertainty even in periods without formal institutional change, consistent with ex-ante definitions of critical junctures; (ii) it provides earlier signals of major global convulsions, such as World War I; (iii) it evaluates candidate critical junctures using a common ex ante measure; and (iv) it opens new avenues for studying how critical junctures shape institutions and long-run development. Today, our Times-based index suggests that institutional uncertainty in the US and UK is as elevated as it was in the early 1940s — a signal missed by other leading measures of risk.
10.3386/w35545.abstract_zh: 解释为何一些国家走向富裕而另一些国家却陷入贫困，关键在于理解制度如何变迁以及何时变迁。大量研究指出，制度变迁往往发生在“关键节点”——即多种制度未来路径并存，包括回归原状的可能性的时刻。然而，多数实证研究仅从事后视角审视关键节点，这可能导致遗漏那些制度处于变动之中但最终未发生根本改变的 pivotal 时刻。我们开发了一种新的实证方法，用以在关键节点展开之际即时识别它们。我们的核心洞见在于，将关键节点理解为关于制度的不确定性时期，这为文本分类器提供了一个具有理论依据的检测对象，使其能在同期话语中捕捉此类信号。在本章中，我们运用这一理念，借助报纸文本作为关于当时制度不确定性信念的丰富信息来源，研究历史关键节点。我们将此洞见转化为测量策略，训练了一个基于大型语言模型的分类器，并将其应用于《泰晤士报》档案——涵盖1800年至2019年的1195万篇文章——同时将主要实证分析聚焦于1900年至2019年的120年报道。这产生了首个基于关键节点概念、长期且以文本为基础的制度不确定性度量。与现有的地缘政治和经济风险指数相比，我们的度量在多个方面实现了创新：（i）它能在没有正式制度变迁的时期捕捉到高度不确定性，符合关键节点的前向定义；（ii）它为重大全球动荡（如第一次世界大战）提供了更早的信号；（iii）它使用统一的前向度量评估候选关键节点；（iv）它为研究关键节点如何塑造制度及长期发展开辟了新途径。当前，基于《泰晤士报》的指数显示，美国和英国的制度不确定性水平与20世纪40年代初相当——这一信号是其他主流风险指标所遗漏的。
10.3386/w35545.title: Detecting Critical Junctures as They Unfold: Foundations, Measurement, and Applications from 120 Years of Reporting
10.3386/w35545.title_zh: 在展开中识别关键节点：来自120年报道的基础、测量与应用

10.3386/w35546.abstract: Economists increasingly use professional profile data to reconstruct employment histories and measure skill supply. We show that these records are not fixed historical snapshots, but mutable accounts that workers revise over time. Using monthly vintages of Revelio Labs data from 2020–2026, we document that 19.7 percent of established U.S. LinkedIn users retroactively edit the title or description of a job they have already left. These “time-travel” edits are closely tied to labor market transitions: around such edits, workers are much more likely to change employers as compared to later-editing users. This mutability can bias historical measures of skills, but it also reveals workers’ beliefs about which skills are in demand. Retroactive edits show sharp post-2022 increases in AI-related language and recent reductions in work-from-home and DEI language. Finally, LLM-associated writing markers surge after ChatGPT, especially among less-educated groups and MBAs from lower-ranked programs, revealing heterogeneous AI-assisted profile editing.
10.3386/w35546.abstract_zh: 经济学家日益利用职业档案数据来重构就业历史并衡量技能供给。我们表明，这些记录并非固定的历史快照，而是劳动者随时间不断修订的可变账户。利用2020至2026年间Revelio Labs数据的月度版本，我们记录了19.7%的美国成熟LinkedIn用户会对其已离职工作的职位或描述进行追溯性编辑。这些“时间旅行”式编辑与劳动力市场转型密切相关：在此类编辑前后，劳动者更换雇主的可能性远高于后期编辑用户。这种可变性可能使历史技能衡量产生偏差，但也揭示了劳动者对哪些技能具有需求的认识。追溯性编辑显示，2022年后与人工智能相关的语言显著增加，而居家办公及DEI相关语言则近期减少。最后，与大型语言模型相关的写作标记在ChatGPT问世后激增，尤其在教育程度较低群体及排名较低项目的MBA中表现突出，揭示了异质性的人工智能辅助档案编辑现象。
10.3386/w35546.title: Time Travel on Professional Profiles
10.3386/w35546.title_zh: 职业档案中的时间旅行

10.3386/w35547.abstract: We study identification and optimal policy design in a broad class of principal-agent models. We show that the most common empirical framework within the literature is equivalent to an unstructured potential-outcomes model augmented with three specific assumptions: the Law of Demand (LoD), or treatment-effect monotonicity; extrapolative model structure (EMS), which rules out lumpy agent responses to price changes; and rank invariance (RI), which restricts unobserved heterogeneity (UH) to be one-dimensional. This decomposition isolates the identifying content of each assumption and clarifies its economic role. The LoD and MS are empirically testable using exogenous price variation; RI, on the other hand, is a strong assumption ruling out many economically plausible behaviors, and also not empirically testable. We derive sharp bounds on counterfactual outcomes when RI is relaxed. The conventional 1-dimensional model delivers an upper bound on planner objectives, while the lower bound, which allows for arbitrary multi-dimensional UH, has an adversarial interpretation for policy design. We estimate empirical bounds and apply them to nonlinear pricing of rideshare services. The resulting robust pricing policy fully insures against worst-case latent selection while preserving most of the profit and consumer-surplus gains predicted by the conventional model. Our framework provides a tractable approach to robust policy design in adverse-selection settings including Mirrleesian taxation, regulation, labor supply, and procurement.
10.3386/w35547.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一类广泛的委托-代理模型中的识别与最优政策设计问题。我们证明，该文献中最常见的实证框架等价于一个非结构化的潜在结果模型，并附加了三个特定假设：需求定律（LoD），即处理效应单调性；外推模型结构（EMS），排除了代理人对价格变化的非连续响应；以及秩不变性（RI），将未观测异质性（UH）限制为一维。这一分解隔离了每个假设的识别内容，并阐明了其经济作用。需求定律和模型结构可利用外生价格变动进行实证检验；而秩不变性则是一个强假设，排除了许多经济上合理的行为，且无法进行实证检验。我们在放宽秩不变性时推导出反事实结果的尖锐边界。传统的一维模型提供了规划者目标的上界，而下界允许任意多维未观测异质性，对政策设计具有对抗性解释。我们估计了实证边界，并将其应用于网约车服务的非线性定价。由此产生的稳健定价政策完全对冲了最坏情况下的潜在选择，同时保留了传统模型预测的大部分利润和消费者剩余收益。我们的框架为逆向选择环境中的稳健政策设计提供了一种易处理的方法，包括米尔利斯式税收、规制、劳动供给和采购等领域。
10.3386/w35547.title: Designing Around Selection: Identification and Inference Under Multi-Dimensional Unobserved Heterogeneity
10.3386/w35547.title_zh: 围绕选择的设计：多维不可观测异质性下的识别与推断

10.3386/w35548.abstract: We examine the role of central bank reserves and public liquidity when secondary markets may freeze. Central bank reserves help intermediaries purchase assets during stress but crowd out investment. Under laissez-faire, intermediaries hold insufficient reserves, overlooking how aggregate liquidity reduces freeze risk. We propose a "market-backstop principle", akin to Bagehot’s principle for intermediaries. It combines state-contingent buyer-of-last-resort interventions to restore trading with modest liquidity requirements to limit moral hazard. The welfare benefits of restoring market functioning exceed the fiscal costs of interventions. We explore implications for the size and composition of central bank balance sheets.
10.3386/w35548.abstract_zh: 我们考察了当二级市场可能冻结时，中央银行储备和公共流动性的作用。中央银行储备有助于中介机构在压力时期购买资产，但会挤出投资。在自由放任政策下，中介机构持有的储备不足，忽视了总体流动性如何降低冻结风险。我们提出了一项“市场最后支持原则”，类似于针对中介机构的巴杰特原则。该原则结合了视状态而定的最后买家干预措施以恢复交易，并辅以适度的流动性要求以限制道德风险。恢复市场运作的福利收益超过了干预的财政成本。我们探讨了这对中央银行资产负债表规模和构成的启示。
10.3386/w35548.title: Reserves and the Buyer of Last Resort

10.3386/w35549.abstract: The U.S. federal government spends roughly $150 billion a year on research and development through mechanisms ranging from grants and contracts to prizes, advance market commitments, and tax credits. These funding mechanisms differ markedly in risk allocation, decision authority, and incentive power, yet policymakers have little systematic guidance for choosing among them. We develop a framework that asks the policymaker three initial questions about the contracting environment: Can they articulate the work to be done? Can they specify what would constitute a successful solution? Can they identify the most capable performers to contract with? The answers considerably narrow the set of viable mechanisms, enabling a more tractable choice of the efficient mechanism based on further considerations from the innovation-economics literature.
10.3386/w35549.abstract_zh: 美国联邦政府每年通过拨款、合同、奖金、预先市场承诺及税收抵免等多种机制，在研究与开发上支出约1500亿美元。这些资助机制在风险分配、决策权限和激励效力上存在显著差异，然而政策制定者在选择时缺乏系统性的指导。我们构建了一个框架，向政策制定者提出关于合同环境的三个初始问题：他们能否清晰阐述待完成的工作？能否明确何为成功的解决方案？能否识别出最合适的执行方进行合作？这些答案显著缩小了可行机制的范围，使得基于创新经济学文献的进一步考量，能够更便捷地选择高效机制。
10.3386/w35549.title: Selecting Innovation Funding Mechanisms: A Framework for Policymakers
10.3386/w35549.title_zh: 选择创新资助机制：政策制定者框架

10.3386/w35550.abstract: Clarity of responsibility is an essential element of political accountability. We develop a rational model of Bayesian updating in the presence of ambiguous attribution and we test its predictions using an original survey. We show that respondents’ partisanship, assessment of public healthcare quality, and beliefs over which layer of government is responsible for healthcare are correlated as predicted: good-assessment voters attribute responsibility to the layer governed by their preferred party, while bad-assessment voters blame the layer governed by the party they dislike. These partisan patterns of credit and blame, often interpreted as evidence of motivated reasoning or partisan bias, can thus arise from rational Bayesian updating under attribution ambiguity. No such partisan patterns exist where the same party is in charge of regional and central government. A survey experiment in which we inform subjects of the official quality of healthcare has them update in the predicted, partisan, direction. Model and empirical results show that partisan priors are extremely hard to dislodge when attribution is ambiguous.
10.3386/w35550.abstract_zh: 责任明确性是政治问责制的核心要素。我们构建了一个在归因模糊情境下进行贝叶斯更新的理性模型，并通过一项原创调查检验其预测。研究显示，受访者的党派立场、对公共医疗质量的评估，以及其对哪一层级政府负责医疗事务的信念，三者之间的相关性符合模型预测：评估良好的选民将责任归于其偏好政党所治理的层级，而评估不佳的选民则归咎于其不喜欢的政党所治理的层级。这种党派性的功劳与责备模式，常被解读为动机性推理或党派偏见的证据，但在归因模糊条件下，其亦可源于理性的贝叶斯更新。当同一政党同时掌控地区与中央政府时，此类党派模式则不复存在。在一项调查实验中，我们向受试者告知官方医疗质量信息，其更新方向符合预测的党派倾向。模型与实证结果表明，在归因模糊的情况下，党派先验信念极难被撼动。
10.3386/w35550.title: Ambiguous Attribution: Theory and Evidence

10.3386/w35551.abstract: China’s technological progress in recent decades has been viewed with admiration, alarm, and (in some cases) doubt. To better understand the Chinese innovation ecosystem, we compile a dataset of almost 14 million domestic Chinese patent publications. We focus on the subset of critical technologies identified by the U.S. Department of Defense. Several surprising patterns emerge from the data: Chinese patenting is strongly associated with other measures of innovative progress; patents are not concentrated in corporate giants such as Huawei; universities have played a key role in innovation, much greater than state-owned enterprises or government-owned facilities; and fewer than one in ten Chinese critical technology patents involves an inventor with U.S. experience or training. Finally, using four text-based measures of patent quality, we show that the rise of Chinese patenting in critical technologies has not been associated with a decline in quality relative to the U.S. awards.
10.3386/w35551.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，中国的技术进步既受到赞赏，也引发警觉，有时甚至招致质疑。为更深入地理解中国的创新生态系统，我们汇编了一个包含近1400万件中国国内专利出版物的数据集，并聚焦于美国国防部认定的关键技术子集。数据揭示了几个令人意外的模式：中国专利活动与其他创新进展指标紧密相关；专利并非集中于华为等企业巨头；大学在创新中扮演了关键角色，其作用远超国有企业或政府所属机构；在关键技术的中国专利中，拥有美国经验或培训背景的发明人不足十分之一。最后，通过四种基于文本的专利质量衡量指标，我们表明，中国在关键技术领域专利数量的增长并未伴随相对于美国授权专利的质量下降。
10.3386/w35551.title: Chinese Sputnik Moments?
10.3386/w35551.title_zh: 中国的斯普特尼克时刻？

10.3386/w35552.abstract: This paper examines the impact of credit frictions arising from firm-level default risk on aggregate economic performance. We build a micro-to-macro model with heterogeneous firms and sector-specific production functions, showing that perceived default risk is a sufficient statistic for credit frictions. Using UK administrative data (2004–2019) matched to S&P risk measures, counterfactual estimates reveal that relaxing frictions raises output by 25% and wages by 23%. Ignoring equilibrium wage adjustments overstates output gains, while fixed-capital misallocation approaches understate them. Most gains reflect aggregate capital accumulation. Credit frictions remain above pre-crisis levels, reshape firm size dynamics, increase misallocation across firms, and dampen productivity growth over time.
10.3386/w35552.abstract_zh: 本文考察了由企业层面违约风险引发的信贷摩擦对总体经济表现的影响。我们构建了一个包含异质性企业和部门特定生产函数的微观至宏观模型，表明感知违约风险是信贷摩擦的充分统计量。利用英国行政数据（2004-2019年）与标普风险度量相匹配，反事实估计显示，缓解摩擦可使产出提高25%，工资提高23%。忽略均衡工资调整会高估产出收益，而固定资本错配方法则低估这些收益。大部分收益源于总体资本积累。信贷摩擦仍高于危机前水平，重塑了企业规模动态，加剧了企业间的错配，并随时间推移抑制了生产率增长。
10.3386/w35552.title: The Equilibrium Impact of Credit Frictions: Evidence from Default Risk Using Firm-Level Data
10.3386/w35552.title_zh: 信贷摩擦的均衡影响：基于企业层面数据的违约风险证据

10.3386/w35553.abstract: In the depths of the 2010 financial crisis the Portuguese government enacted a series of reforms in its prescription drug reimbursement system. Over the next three years value added per pharmacist in retail pharmacies fell by a third, reflecting a rise in generic substitution and reductions in the markups allowed for prescription drugs. This massive shock led to pay cuts for incumbent pharmacists and the introduction of a two-tier pay system for new hires, with little or no reduction in the growth of employment. We use detailed longitudinal records from the Quadros de Pessoal data base, merged with information on collective bargaining settlements and firm financial records, to study the impacts of the reforms. We estimate that between 2009 and 2022 average wages of pharmacists fell by a third; most of this reduction was due to lower wages for newly entering cohorts. The implied responsiveness of wages to productivity is substantially above most estimates in the rent-sharing literature, arguably reflecting the strong attachment of workers to the sector and the steady inflow of newly graduating pharmacists. Stepping back, we then consider how wages of pharmacists have diverged relative to wages of other health care professionals in Portugal, and the decisions of recent college applicants to enter the profession.
10.3386/w35553.abstract_zh: 在2010年金融危机的深渊中，葡萄牙政府对其处方药报销体系实施了一系列改革。随后的三年里，零售药店中每位药剂师带来的附加值下降了三分之一，这反映了仿制药替代的增加以及处方药允许加价幅度的减少。这一巨大冲击导致在职药剂师薪资削减，并为新入职者引入了两级薪酬体系，而就业增长几乎没有或完全没有放缓。我们利用《员工名册》数据库中的详细纵向记录，结合集体谈判协议信息和企业财务记录，来研究这些改革的影响。我们估计，在2009年至2022年间，药剂师的平均工资下降了三分之一；这一降幅主要归因于新入职群体的较低薪资。工资对生产率的隐含响应度显著高于租金分享文献中的大多数估计值，这大概反映了工人对该行业的强烈依附以及新毕业药剂师的稳定流入。进一步来看，我们考虑了药剂师工资相对于葡萄牙其他医疗保健专业人员工资的差异，以及近期大学申请者选择进入该职业的决策。
10.3386/w35553.title: Sharing the Burden: The Impacts of Pharmacy Sector Reforms on the Labor Market for Pharmacists in Portugal
10.3386/w35553.title_zh: 共担重负：葡萄牙药房部门改革对药剂师劳动力市场的影响

10.3386/w35554.abstract: We develop a theory of firm wage dynamics that integrates the canonical wage-posting model à la Burdett and Mortensen (1998) with firm dynamics. Firms offer dynamic wage contracts under an equal-treatment constraint in the presence of search frictions. We provide an analytical characterization of equilibrium wage contracts and firm growth as functions only of the distribution of marginal surplus. Consistent with recent empirical evidence, the model implies that (i) firm wages are strongly linked to firm growth but not to firm size; (ii) firm wages decline over the firm life cycle; and (iii) the pass-through of permanent productivity shocks to wages is higher in the short run than in the long run. Firms at the top of the job ladder face excessive labor market competition, so the optimal policy subsidizes their hiring. At the macro level, the optimal policy elevates business dynamism in the steady state, and even more so along the transition.
10.3386/w35554.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个企业工资动态理论，该理论将经典的Burdett和Mortensen（1998）式工资设定模型与企业动态相结合。在存在搜索摩擦的情况下，企业提供动态工资合同，并受到平等对待约束。我们给出了均衡工资合同和企业增长的解析特征，这些特征仅取决于边际剩余的分布。与近期实证证据一致，该模型表明：（i）企业工资与企业增长紧密相关，但与企业规模无关；（ii）企业工资随企业生命周期下降；（iii）永久性生产率冲击对工资的传导在短期内高于长期。处于工作阶梯顶端的企业面临过度的劳动力市场竞争，因此最优政策补贴其招聘行为。在宏观层面，最优政策提升了稳态下的商业活力，且在转型过程中效果更为显著。
10.3386/w35554.title: A Theory of Firm Wage Dynamics

10.3386/w35555.abstract: This paper analyzes foreign demand for U.S. assets, with particular emphasis on U.S. Treasury securities. It documents compositional shifts in U.S. bilateral external positions across geographic regions and asset classes, providing estimates of creditor positions closer to a nationality-based concept. While rising U.S. equity prices explain a sizable share of the deterioration in the net external position, foreign purchases of U.S. Treasury securities have been the largest source of U.S. current account financing. The share of these securities held by foreign official investors has declined sharply during the past decade, while the share held by foreign private investors (especially through financial centers) has risen. The decline in foreign official holdings is well explained by lower reserve accumulation, increased Federal Reserve holdings, and dollar appreciation against other reserve currencies. The evidence is consistent with central banks rebalancing their portfolios to avoid large swings in currency shares. Geoeconomic fragmentation is negatively correlated with official demand for U.S. Treasuries, while foreign private demand remains sensitive to safe-haven dynamics. Overall, the paper assesses how these structural shifts affect portfolio preferences for U.S. assets and their potential implications for the U.S. external position amid heightened geopolitical and fiscal uncertainty.
10.3386/w35555.abstract_zh: 本文分析了外国对美国资产的需求，特别关注美国国债。文章记录了美国双边外部头寸在地理区域和资产类别上的构成变化，提供了更接近国籍概念的债权人头寸估计。尽管美国股票价格的上涨在很大程度上解释了净外部头寸的恶化，但外国购买美国国债一直是美国经常账户融资的最大来源。在过去十年中，外国官方投资者持有的这些证券份额急剧下降，而外国私人投资者（尤其是通过金融中心）持有的份额则有所上升。外国官方持有量的下降可以很好地由储备积累减少、美联储持有量增加以及美元对其他储备货币升值来解释。证据与中央银行重新平衡其投资组合以避免货币份额大幅波动的行为一致。地缘经济碎片化与外国官方对美国国债的需求呈负相关，而外国私人需求仍对避险动态敏感。总体而言，本文评估了这些结构性变化如何影响对美国资产的组合偏好，以及在地缘政治和财政不确定性加剧的背景下，它们对美国外部头寸的潜在影响。
10.3386/w35555.title: The United States and Its Creditors: Assessing Foreign Demand for U.S. Assets
10.3386/w35555.title_zh: 美国及其债权人：评估外国对美国资产的需求

10.3386/w35556.abstract: Institutions that claim to reward merit often also serve as engines that drive the formation of important social networks. We examine this dual role in China’s Imperial Examination, one of history’s longest-lived meritocratic systems. We draw on exam performance data for 24,269 individuals across 112 national examinations in the Qing dynasty (1644–1905) and trace who among them rose to become top officials. Strong exam performance increased the likelihood of attaining high office, but advancement also depended on individuals’ ties to powerful examiners. Because performance and ties to powerful examiners were strongly complementary, individuals’ success appeared to rest on merit even as social networks played a role. Following the major political transformations of the 1840s, the importance of examiner ties persisted, although the influential examiners themselves changed. These findings help explain why such systems retain legitimacy even when networks matter greatly.
10.3386/w35556.abstract_zh: 宣称奖励才能的制度，往往同时也充当着构建重要社会网络的引擎。我们在此考察了中国科举制度——历史上寿命最长的精英选拔体系之一——中的这一双重角色。我们利用清朝（1644-1905年）112次全国考试中24,269名考生的考试成绩数据，追踪其中哪些人晋升为高级官员。优异的考试成绩增加了获得高官职位的机会，但晋升同样依赖于个人与有权势考官之间的联系。由于考试成绩与考官关系之间存在强烈的互补性，个人的成功看似基于才能，即便社会网络也发挥了作用。在19世纪40年代重大政治变革之后，考官关系的重要性依然存在，尽管有影响力的考官本身发生了变化。这些发现有助于解释为何此类制度即便在网络因素影响显著时仍能保持其合法性。
10.3386/w35556.title: Meritocracy and the Networks It Forged: China’s Imperial Examination
10.3386/w35556.title_zh: 贤能政治及其缔造的网络：中国的科举制度

10.3386/w35557.abstract: We study the demand for safety and liquidity in the crypto ecosystem. We do so under a framework in which a representative investor allocates liquidity across stablecoin deposits in lending pools and traditional safe assets (e.g., MMF shares). Our model delivers three main predictions: (i) the stablecoin deposit premium co-moves with the Treasury premium when investors value the safety and liquidity services of stablecoins; (ii) increases in Treasury supply reduce the stablecoin deposit premium; and (iii) drops in the perceived safety and liquidity of stablecoin deposits (e.g., due to de-pegs or hacker attacks) reduce their premium. Using granular data from hundreds of DeFi pools spanning multiple protocols, tokens, and blockchains, we find evidence supporting these predictions. Investors treat stablecoin deposits as money-like instruments that are borderless and permissionless, yet as fragile as other forms of privately produced safe assets.
10.3386/w35557.abstract_zh: 我们研究了加密生态系统中对安全性和流动性的需求。我们在一个代表性投资者在借贷池中的稳定币存款与传统安全资产（如货币市场基金份额）之间分配流动性的框架下进行分析。我们的模型提出了三个主要预测：（i）当投资者重视稳定币的安全性和流动性服务时，稳定币存款溢价与国债溢价共同变动；（ii）国债供给的增加会降低稳定币存款溢价；（iii）稳定币存款感知安全性和流动性的下降（例如，由于脱钩或黑客攻击）会减少其溢价。利用涵盖多个协议、代币和区块链的数百个DeFi池的细粒度数据，我们找到了支持这些预测的证据。投资者将稳定币存款视为无国界、无需许可的货币类工具，但同时也像其他形式的私人生产的安全资产一样脆弱。
10.3386/w35557.title: Demand for Safety in the Crypto Ecosystem
10.3386/w35557.title_zh: 加密生态系统中的安全需求

10.3386/w35558.abstract: Timely high school completion is a critical step in successful transitions to post-secondary schooling and the labor market. This randomized controlled trial, deployed in two urban, disadvantaged school districts, tests the effectiveness of a mature and comprehensive student-support program on an unusually large scale (n=2,528). While overall effects on graduation rates are small and statistically insignificant, exploratory analyses reveal notable variation by site and over time, mirroring heterogeneity in treatment timing and program implementation. These findings highlight the challenges of scaling interventions and raise concerns about generalizing results from small-scale, single-site evaluations.
10.3386/w35558.abstract_zh: 及时完成高中学业是成功过渡到高等教育和劳动力市场的关键一步。本随机对照试验在两个城市弱势学区实施，测试了一项成熟且全面的学生支持项目在异常大规模（n=2,528）上的有效性。尽管对毕业率的总体影响较小且统计上不显著，探索性分析揭示了因地点和时间而异的显著差异，反映了治疗时机和项目实施中的异质性。这些发现凸显了扩大干预规模的挑战，并对从小规模、单一地点评估中推广结果的普遍性提出了担忧。
10.3386/w35558.title: Unpacking Treatment Effect Heterogeneity in a Large-Scale Dropout-Prevention Experiment
10.3386/w35558.title_zh: 大规模辍学预防实验中处理效应异质性的解析

10.3386/w35559.abstract: Can automation harm workers without replacing them? We study jobs in which workers value both producing useful output and knowing that the output depends on their own contribution. A credible machine alternative can weaken that second source of meaning even when the firm retains the worker. Our model shows that this loss raises compensation when wages adjust fully; when they adjust only partly, workers bear some of the loss themselves. It can also make automation more likely. An external developer may profit by publicly demonstrating a machine before licensing it, because the demonstration lowers the value of the human alternative. This "meaning externality" can create demand for the machine and make profitable development socially harmful. Better technical quality and greater public salience have different effects: quality improves output, while salience alone weakens human work. Automation can, therefore, reduce the value of work before it eliminates jobs.
10.3386/w35559.abstract_zh: 自动化是否会不通过替代工人而对其造成伤害？我们研究那些工人既重视产出有用成果，又重视成果取决于自身贡献的工作。即使企业保留工人，一个可信的机器替代方案也能削弱第二种意义来源。我们的模型表明，当工资完全调整时，这种损失会提高补偿；当工资仅部分调整时，工人自身需承担部分损失。这还可能使自动化更有可能发生。外部开发者可能通过公开演示机器来获利，即使尚未授权，因为演示降低了人类替代方案的价值。这种“意义外部性”能创造对机器的需求，并使有利可图的开发对社会有害。更好的技术质量和更高的公众关注度具有不同影响：质量提升产出，而仅关注度本身削弱人类工作。因此，自动化可能在消除工作岗位之前就降低工作的价值。
10.3386/w35559.title: Replaceable but Employed: Automation and the Meaning of Work
10.3386/w35559.title_zh: 可替代却被雇佣：自动化与工作的意义

10.3386/w35560.abstract: We study the effects of H-1B immigration on U.S. industries that employ H-1B workers and their trading partners. Using a novel cross-industry design and the 1999–2003 expansion of the H-1B visa cap for identification, we find that H-1B exposure raised incomes for natives and pre-existing immigrants, with gains concentrated in non-STEM occupations. Income gains propagate forward through supply chains to downstream industries but not backward to upstream industries, consistent with a productivity shock rather than a labor supply shock. We find no direct effect on patenting, suggesting that productivity gains arise from better task execution rather than patentable invention.
10.3386/w35560.abstract_zh: 我们研究了H-1B移民对雇佣H-1B工人的美国行业及其贸易伙伴的影响。利用新颖的跨行业设计，并以1999-2003年H-1B签证上限的扩大作为识别依据，我们发现H-1B暴露提高了本土居民及先前移民的收入，且收益集中在非STEM职业。收入增长通过供应链向前传导至下游行业，但未向后传导至上游行业，这与生产率冲击而非劳动力供给冲击的特征相符。我们未发现对专利活动的直接影响，这表明生产率提升源于更好的任务执行，而非可专利的发明创造。
10.3386/w35560.title: Long-Run Effects of H-1B Immigration on the U.S. Economy
10.3386/w35560.title_zh: H-1B移民对美国经济的长期影响

10.3386/w35561.abstract: Tariffs raise the prices of goods made at home, not just the imports they tax—an effect that standard pass-through estimates largely miss. Studying the 2025 U.S. tariffs, we find that about 26 percent of the tariff increase passes through to consumer prices. These estimates are measured relative to less-exposed goods and hold aggregate conditions fixed. The direct effect accounts for 64 percent of this increase, as tariffs raise the consumer prices of foreign varieties of a good. The remaining 36 percent arises indirectly—tariffs raise the cost of imported inputs used by U.S. producers, and domestic producers raise their markups because they face less competition from higher-priced imports. The direct effect passes through quickly, since tariffs raise import prices almost immediately, but the indirect effect takes nine to twelve months to work its way through supply chains. As a result, tariffs have a larger and more drawn-out impact on consumers than the direct effect alone would suggest.
10.3386/w35561.abstract_zh: 关税不仅提高了其所征税的进口商品的价格，也抬高了国内生产的商品价格——这一效应在标准的汇率传导估算中大多被忽视。通过研究2025年美国关税，我们发现约26%的关税增幅传导至消费者价格。这些估算相对于受关税影响较小的商品进行衡量，并保持总体经济条件不变。直接效应占这一增幅的64%，因为关税提高了某商品外国品种的消费者价格。其余36%则间接产生——关税提高了美国生产商使用的进口投入品成本，而国内生产商因面临来自高价进口商品的竞争减少而提高其加成率。直接效应传导迅速，因为关税几乎立即推高了进口价格，但间接效应需要九到十二个月才能通过供应链逐步显现。因此，关税对消费者的影响比仅考虑直接效应所暗示的更为显著且持续时间更长。
10.3386/w35561.title: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-through into Consumer Prices
10.3386/w35561.title_zh: 关税传导至消费者价格的结构解析

10.3386/w35562.abstract: This paper investigates why China’s recurrent credit expansions have coincided with persistently weak inflation. We argue that this pattern reflects the country’s production-oriented monetary regime. At the aggregate level, faster monetary-financial expansion temporarily raises PPI inflation but depresses it over longer horizons. At the sectoral level, liability growth among listed industrial firms is followed by weaker producer prices, lower profitability, higher leverage, rising inventories, and reduced capacity utilization. We also find asymmetric supply-chain transmission: downstream liability growth raises upstream PPI inflation, while upstream liability growth does not generate a corresponding downstream price response. These findings indicate that credit expansion in China tends to sustain production and balance sheets rather than stimulate final demand. As a result, monetary policy operates less as a conventional tool for demand management and durable reflation, and more as a mechanism for preserving production capacity and supporting growth.
10.3386/w35562.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了中国周期性信贷扩张为何与持续疲弱的通胀并存。我们认为，这一现象反映了该国以生产为导向的货币体制。在总体层面，更快的货币金融扩张短期内推高生产者价格指数（PPI）通胀，但在更长时期内则抑制之。在行业层面，上市工业企业负债增长后，伴随生产者价格走弱、盈利能力下降、杠杆率上升、库存增加及产能利用率降低。我们还发现不对称的供应链传导效应：下游负债增长推升上游PPI通胀，而上游负债增长并未引发相应的下游价格反应。这些发现表明，中国的信贷扩张倾向于维持生产和资产负债表，而非刺激最终需求。因此，货币政策更多作为保全生产能力和支持增长的一种机制，而非传统的需求管理和持久再通胀工具。
10.3386/w35562.title: Monetary Policy in Mandarin Capitalism
10.3386/w35562.title_zh: 普通话资本主义下的货币政策

10.3386/w35563.abstract: This paper incorporates the Lucas (1973) island model into a standard DSGE framework. It demonstrates that self-fulfilling stochastic inflation equilibria, which are driven by intrinsic uncertainty or pure sentiments, can exist under rational expectations. Furthermore, it shows that these sentiment-driven stochastic equilibria exhibit monetary non-neutrality, even when the fundamental equilibrium is unique and monetarily neutral. As the aggregate price or inflation rate can appear to fluctuate independently of the money supply, our model explains the complex relationship between inflation and the money supply in the real world, where the basic quantity theory of money often seems invalid.
10.3386/w35563.abstract_zh: 本文将Lucas（1973）岛屿模型融入标准DSGE框架，证明在理性预期下，由内在不确定性或纯粹情绪驱动的自我实现随机通胀均衡可能存在。进一步，本文表明，即使基础均衡唯一且货币中性，这些情绪驱动的随机均衡仍表现出货币非中性。由于总体价格或通胀率看似独立于货币供应波动，本模型解释了现实世界中通胀与货币供应之间复杂的关系，其中基本货币数量论往往显得失效。
10.3386/w35563.title: Incomplete Information and Self-Fulfilling Inflation Dynamics—Lucas meets Keynes
10.3386/w35563.title_zh: 不完全信息与自我实现的通胀动态——卢卡斯遇见凯恩斯

10.3386/w35564.abstract: This article provides an overview of the literature on financial literacy. It covers the initial measurement that created the Big Three questions and measures of personal finance knowledge featuring 28 questions. It shows that levels of financial literacy are low and have not been improving over time. This is true not only in the United States but also in countries worldwide. These findings matter because financial literacy is conducive to savvy financial behaviors, from holding precautionary savings to planning for retirement to many other financial decisions. Financial education programs have grown exponentially over time, providing important insights into their cost-effectiveness. Personal finance courses have been added to high school and college curricula, and the evidence indicates that they are useful initiatives to improve financial knowledge and downstream behavior.
10.3386/w35564.abstract_zh: 本文对金融素养相关文献进行了综述。它涵盖了最初构建“三大问题”的测量方法，以及包含28个问题的个人财务知识测量指标。研究表明，金融素养水平普遍较低，且随时间推移并未得到改善。这一现象不仅存在于美国，也见于全球各国。这些发现之所以重要，是因为金融素养有助于促进明智的财务行为，从持有预防性储蓄到规划退休，乃至其他众多财务决策。金融教育项目随时间呈指数级增长，为其成本效益提供了重要见解。个人理财课程已被纳入高中和大学课程体系，证据表明，这些举措对于提升财务知识及后续行为具有积极作用。
10.3386/w35564.title: Improving Financial Literacy: From Corporate Finance to Personal Finance
10.3386/w35564.title_zh: 提升金融素养：从公司金融到个人金融

10.3386/w35565.abstract: We provide the first empirical evidence that common ownership can facilitate explicit collusion. Our unique setting, the population of legal cartels in Sweden, lets us observe cartel formation, duration, and dissolution without the sample-selection bias that plagues studies of detected cartels. Combining hand-collected ownership data with the universe of registered cartels, we compute firm-pair profit weights (κ) that measure how much one firm internalizes a rival's profits. Higher profit weights are associated with a greater likelihood of cartel participation, predict future cartel involvement, and are linked to longer cartel duration. Firms also reduce their profit weights immediately after a cartel dissolves. However, this relationship is concentrated among pairs in which the firm that internalizes the rival firm's profits colludes while the rival does not. Common ownership therefore complements a firm’s own participation in explicit collusion but substitutes for cartel participation by the rival whose profits it internalizes.
10.3386/w35565.abstract_zh: 我们提供了首个经验证据，表明共同所有权能促进显性共谋。我们的独特研究背景——瑞典合法卡特尔全体样本——使我们能够观察卡特尔的形成、持续与解散，而避免了困扰已侦测卡特尔研究的样本选择偏差。结合手工收集的所有权数据与全部注册卡特尔记录，我们计算了企业对的利润权重（κ），该指标衡量一家企业在多大程度上内化竞争对手的利润。更高的利润权重与卡特尔参与可能性增大相关，能预测未来的卡特尔参与，并与更长的卡特尔持续时间相关联。企业在卡特尔解散后也会立即降低其利润权重。然而，这种关系集中在那些内化竞争对手利润的企业参与共谋而竞争对手未参与的企业对中。因此，共同所有权补充了企业自身在显性共谋中的参与，但替代了其利润被内化的竞争对手的卡特尔参与。
10.3386/w35565.title: Common Ownership and Collusion

10.3386/w35566.abstract: We use U.S. nationally representative longitudinal data to estimate the effects of cognitive and behavioral impairments in childhood on health in adulthood. We focus on work-limiting health conditions and fair or poor self-rated health but also consider adequacy of sleep, body weight, and health behaviors (use of various substances and preventive health care) as potential pathways. In household fixed effects models, we find that both impairments are strongly associated with having a work-limiting health condition in adulthood; specifically, cognitive impairments increase the probability of a work-limiting condition by 70% and behavioral impairments increase the probability by 60%. Individuals with cognitive impairments in childhood are 43% more likely to report being in fair or poor health in adulthood compared to individuals without cognitive impairments. The effects of cognitive impairments on health do not appear to operate through insufficient sleep, obesity, or health behaviors. Individuals with childhood behavioral impairments are no more likely to report being in fair or poor health but are more likely to get insufficient sleep and to be obese, compared to individuals without behavioral impairments, suggesting that insufficient sleep and obesity could potentially lie on the pathway from behavioral impairments in childhood to work-limiting health conditions in adulthood.
10.3386/w35566.abstract_zh: 我们利用美国全国代表性的纵向数据，估算了童年期认知和行为障碍对成年期健康的影响。我们重点关注限制工作的健康状况及自评健康为一般或较差的情况，同时也考虑了睡眠充足性、体重及健康行为（包括各类物质使用和预防性医疗保健）作为潜在的影响途径。在家庭固定效应模型中，我们发现这两种障碍均与成年期存在限制工作的健康状况密切相关；具体而言，认知障碍使限制工作状况的概率增加70%，行为障碍则使其增加60%。与无认知障碍的个体相比，童年期有认知障碍的个体在成年期报告健康为一般或较差的可能性高出43%。认知障碍对健康的影响似乎并非通过睡眠不足、肥胖或健康行为发挥作用。相比之下，童年期有行为障碍的个体在成年期报告健康为一般或较差的可能性并未增加，但相较于无行为障碍的个体，他们更可能睡眠不足和肥胖，这表明睡眠不足和肥胖可能构成从童年期行为障碍到成年期限制工作健康状况的潜在中间路径。
10.3386/w35566.title: Childhood Cognitive and Behavioral Impairments and Adult Health
10.3386/w35566.title_zh: 儿童认知与行为障碍及成年期健康

10.3386/w35567.abstract: Behavioral interventions have become central to modern public policy, but their empirical promise remains contested because estimated treatment effects often appear small. We argue that a policy response is economically meaningful only relative to the response generated by alternative policies. We assemble more than 1,200 estimates from over 600 studies comparing “nudges” and traditional price interventions in the markets for cigarettes, alcohol, influenza vaccination, electricity, and residential water. Translating nudge effects into equivalent price changes, we find that behavioral interventions often correspond to enormous fiscal interventions, from an 11% tax on electricity to a 100% subsidy on influenza vaccinations. Nudges are also more cost-effective than price instruments in all markets, but cost-effectiveness does not predict the welfare ranking of policies. Using a behavioral extension of the Marginal Value of Public Funds, we show that nudges have high welfare returns at the margin, while price instruments often generate larger total surplus at scale.
10.3386/w35567.abstract_zh: 行为干预已成为现代公共政策的核心，但其经验上的承诺仍存争议，因为估计的处理效应往往显得微小。我们认为，一项政策回应只有在与替代政策所产生的回应相比较时，才具有经济意义。我们汇集了超过600项研究中关于“助推”与传统价格干预在香烟、酒精、流感疫苗接种、电力和居民用水市场上的1200多个估计值。将助推效应转化为等价的价格变化，我们发现行为干预往往对应着巨大的财政干预，从对电力征收11%的税到对流感疫苗接种提供100%的补贴。在所有市场中，助推也比价格工具更具成本效益，但成本效益并不能预测政策的福利排序。利用公共资金边际价值的行
10.3386/w35567.title: The Value of Behavioral Policies

10.3386/w35568.abstract: The study of bureaucracy as a key dimension of state capacity has gained increasing attention in economics. What organizational features create an effective bureaucracy, however, remains subject to debate. This paper focuses on the central role of civil service protections in delineating the boundary between politics and administration. I introduce a simple principal-agent framework to discuss the key theoretical channels through which political insulation can shape bureaucrat performance. Guided by the framework, I establish stylized facts and organize evidence from historical and contemporary civil service reforms. Overall, the micro-level evidence documents a positive effect of civil service protections on the quality of public service delivery. I conclude with open questions about the political economy of reform adoption.
10.3386/w35568.abstract_zh: 官僚制作为国家能力的关键维度，其研究在经济学中日益受到关注。然而，何种组织特征能造就有效的官僚体系，仍是争论焦点。本文聚焦于公务员保护在界定政治与行政边界中的核心作用。我引入一个简洁的委托-代理框架，探讨政治隔离影响官僚绩效的主要理论渠道。在此框架指导下，我确立了若干典型事实，并系统整理了历史及当代公务员制度改革的相关证据。总体而言，微观层面的证据表明，公务员保护对公共服务供给质量具有积极影响。最后，我提出关于改革采纳的政治经济学未解问题。
10.3386/w35568.title: The Economics of Civil Service Protections

10.3386/w35569.abstract: We trace the family origins of Members of Congress (MC) born between 1830 and 1950, linking each MC, their parents, and their brothers to the complete-count censuses. Future MCs have always been economic outliers. By 1940, close to 60 percent of MCs aged 18--40 held a college degree, against under 5 percent of comparable young men outside Congress. In the 19th-century censuses, MCs as adults held roughly three times the wealth of demographically matched controls. They also come from economically elite families: their fathers earn more, attain more education, and hold more wealth. The brothers of future MCs sit between the population and the MCs themselves. Across the socioeconomic measures we compare, we calculate that roughly half of an MC's adult premium is shared with his brother and the other half is his own. Even as the American economy and political system have changed, the family background gap has widened over the last century and a half. Wealth, household servants, and four separate occupation-based scores all show the gap holding or growing across cohorts. We study four Progressive-Era reforms in a triple-difference design---women's suffrage, the secret ballot, direct primaries, and the direct election of senators---and none produce detectable shifts in who reaches Congress. Our results document a Congress drawn from the most fortunate families in American society in every cohort we observe.
10.3386/w35569.abstract_zh: 我们追溯了1830年至1950年间出生的国会议员（MC）的家庭出身，将每位议员、其父母及兄弟与完整人口普查数据相链接。未来的国会议员历来都是经济上的异类。到1940年，18至40岁的国会议员中近60%拥有大学学位，而国会外同龄年轻男性中这一比例不足5%。在19世纪的人口普查中，作为成年人的国会议员所拥有的财富约为人口统计特征匹配对照组的三倍。他们也出身于经济精英家庭：其父亲收入更高、受教育程度更高、财富更多。未来国会议员的兄弟们则介于普通民众与议员本人之间。在我们比较的各项社会经济指标中，我们估算出议员成年期优势中约有一半与其兄弟共享，另一半则为其个人独有。即便美国经济和政治体制不断变迁，家庭背景差距在过去一个半世纪中仍在扩大。财富、家中仆役数量以及四种基于职业的评分均显示，这一差距在各代际间保持或扩大。我们采用三重差分设计研究了进步时代四项改革——妇女选举权、无记名投票、直接初选和参议员直接选举——均未对进入国会的人员构成产生可检测的变化。我们的研究结果表明，在我们观察的每一代人中，国会成员均来自美国社会中最幸运的家庭。
10.3386/w35569.title: Fortunate Sons: Elite Political Selection in American History
10.3386/w35569.title_zh: 幸运之子：美国历史上的精英政治选拔

10.3386/w35570.abstract: We study the optimal design and analysis of experiments for estimating spillover effects. Assuming a known (e.g., linear) exposure mapping, we characterize the treatment-assignment distribution and regression-based estimator that minimize worst-case asymptotic variance against a broad class of distributions of unobservables. The design problem yields an intuitive solution in which the planner trades off spillover signal strength against diffusion of spillover variation. The analysis problem yields a simple recentered instrumental variable estimator to best leverage this variation. This framework produces natural solutions in several benchmark cases -- such as clustered exposure-- and suggests computationally tractable approximations for general networks, including bipartite settings. We illustrate these new tools in semi-synthetic experiments based on two applications from development economics. Our approach yields large standard error reductions in both experiments, increasing effective sample sizes by 50–100% or more.
10.3386/w35570.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在估计溢出效应时实验的最优设计与分析。假设暴露映射已知（例如线性），我们刻画了处理分配分布及基于回归的估计量，这些能在广泛的不可观测变量分布类别中最小化最坏情况下的渐近方差。设计问题给出了一个直观的解决方案，其中规划者在溢出信号强度与溢出变异扩散之间进行权衡。分析问题则产生了一个简单的重新中心化工具变量估计量，以最佳利用这种变异。该框架在几个基准情形下——如聚类暴露——提供了自然解决方案，并为一般网络（包括二分设置）提出了计算上可行的近似方法。我们基于发展经济学的两个应用在半合成实验中展示了这些新工具。我们的方法在两个实验中均大幅降低了标准误，使有效样本量增加了50%至100%或更多。
10.3386/w35570.title: Robust Signal Maximization in Spillover Experiments
10.3386/w35570.title_zh: 溢出实验中稳健信号最大化

10.3386/w35571.abstract: Union growth has historically happened in spurts. We combine union election data from 1961–2025 with a large-scale information experiment involving 9,000 low-wage workers to study the role of social learning in union growth. Observationally, close election wins cause future wins within state-industries. Experimentally, information about recent union wins increases union support and beliefs about co-worker support, with effects concentrated among workers with weak information environments and low baseline coworker support. In contrast, information about labor market tightness has little effect. Our results highlight social learning as a mechanism for union growth.
10.3386/w35571.abstract_zh: 工会增长在历史上呈现间歇性爆发。我们结合1961年至2025年的工会选举数据，以及一项涉及9000名低工资工人的大规模信息实验，研究社会学习在工会增长中的作用。从观察上看，接近的选举胜利会导致州行业内未来的胜利。实验上，关于近期工会胜利的信息增加了工会支持度及对同事支持的信念，其效应集中在信息环境薄弱和同事支持基线较低的工人中。相比之下，关于劳动力市场紧张的信息影响甚微。我们的结果凸显了社会学习作为工会增长的一种机制。
10.3386/w35571.title: Winning is Contagious: Social Learning and the Dynamics of Union Support
10.3386/w35571.title_zh: 胜利具有传染性：社会学习与工会支持动态

10.3386/w35572.abstract: We show that quantitative asset pricing models, built to address the equity premium and risk-free rate puzzles, systematically fail when applied to open economies: they cannot generate the large and persistent interest rate differentials we observe between risky and safe currencies. This failure stems from the key mechanism that produces their success in matching both closed-economy puzzles: In these models, the mean of the stochastic discount factor offsets its variance nearly one-for-one, which immobilizes interest rates --- so that differences in expected currency returns across countries must arise almost exclusively from predictable changes in exchange rates, at odds with the data. We prove this result in a broad class of models that allows for market incompleteness and exchange rate disconnect, requiring only that each country's risk-free asset is priced by investors who demand compensation for risk in line with observed risk premia. We argue this tension between canonical asset pricing and international macroeconomic models is a key reason researchers have struggled to reconcile the observed behavior of exchange rates, interest rates, and capital flows across countries.
10.3386/w35572.abstract_zh: 我们证明，旨在解决股权溢价和无风险利率之谜的定量资产定价模型，在应用于开放经济体时系统性地失效：它们无法生成我们在风险货币与安全货币之间观察到的巨大且持续的利率差异。这一失败源于使这些模型在匹配封闭经济体两大谜题时取得成功的关键机制：在这些模型中，随机贴现因子的均值几乎一对一地抵消其方差，从而固定了利率——因此，各国之间预期货币回报的差异几乎必须完全来源于可预测的汇率变动，这与数据不符。我们在一个广泛的模型类别中证明了这一结果，该类别允许市场不完全性和汇率脱钩，仅要求每个国家的无风险资产由那些要求风险补偿与观察到的风险溢价相一致的投资者定价。我们认为，经典资产定价与国际宏观经济模型之间的这种张力，是研究者们难以调和各国汇率、利率和资本流动观察行为的关键原因。
10.3386/w35572.title: A Currency Premium Puzzle

10.3386/w35573.abstract: This paper develops a theory of balanced growth and optimal climate policy in an integrated assessment framework. Balanced growth is possible despite climate change, but at a slower rate. Two distinct policy regimes emerge because emissions permanently raise carbon stocks. For low damages, optimal growth coincides with the laissez-faire and carbon is priced at a constant rate. For high damages, optimal policy caps temperature growth to prevent escalating losses and achieve faster economic growth than in the laissez-faire by pricing carbon at an increasing rate. We quantify our model and show that empirical damage estimates span both regimes. For low damages, optimal policy achieves a 1% welfare gain with 3 to 8°C of warming per century and no change in long-run growth. For high damages, optimal policy raises annual growth by 0.8 percentage points and achieves a 26% welfare gain by capping warming at 0.4°C per century.
10.3386/w35573.abstract_zh: 本文在综合评估框架下构建了平衡增长与最优气候政策的理论。尽管存在气候变化，平衡增长仍可实现，但增速放缓。由于排放会永久性提高碳存量，因此出现了两种截然不同的政策机制。在低损害情形下，最优增长与自由放任政策一致，碳定价保持恒定比率。在高损害情形下，最优政策通过设定温度增长上限以防止损失加剧，并以递增的碳定价实现比自由放任更快的经济增长。我们对模型进行了量化分析，表明经验损害估计跨越了这两种机制。在低损害下，最优政策实现1%的福利增益，每世纪升温3至8摄氏度，且长期增长不变。在高损害下，最优政策通过将升温限制在每世纪0.4摄氏度，使年增长率提高0.8个百分点，并实现26%的福利增益。
10.3386/w35573.title: Balancing Growth in a Warming World
10.3386/w35573.title_zh: 变暖世界中的增长平衡

10.3386/w35574.abstract: We ask a representative sample to write prompts seeking spending and investing advice from LLMs, then simulate the lifetime effects of following the advice under realistic asset and labor market conditions. Applying this method to GPT-5.2, we find following the advice would move respondents toward life cycle theory: broader participation in diversified equity funds, age-declining equity shares, and larger savings buffers. Recommendations vary systematically by gender, prior AI experience, and financial literacy. For gender, two-thirds of recommended equity-share differences arise from men and women writing different prompts (demand), while one-third arise from gender labels attached to otherwise identical prompts (supply).
10.3386/w35574.abstract_zh: 我们邀请了一个具有代表性的样本，撰写向大语言模型寻求支出与投资建议的提示词，然后在现实的资产与劳动力市场条件下，模拟遵循这些建议所产生的终身影响。将此方法应用于GPT-5.2，我们发现遵循其建议会使受访者更接近生命周期理论：更广泛地参与多元化股票基金、随年龄递减的股票配置比例，以及更大的储蓄缓冲。建议因性别、先前人工智能经验及金融素养的不同而呈现系统性差异。就性别而言，建议中股票配置差异的三分之二源于男性和女性撰写了不同的提示词（需求侧），而三分之一源于性别标签附着于原本相同的提示词（供给侧）。
10.3386/w35574.title: AI Financial Advice: Supply, Demand, and Life Cycle Implications
10.3386/w35574.title_zh: 人工智能金融咨询：供给、需求与生命周期影响

10.3386/w35575.abstract: Using a randomized survey experiment in the Italian Survey of Consumer Expectations, we study how observability and commonality shape responses to a €1,000 employer bonus. Making an idiosyncratic bonus observable to coworkers lowers the marginal propensity to consume by 3 percentage points. Conditional on observability, extending the bonus to all coworkers raises it by 6 percentage points. Under a social-interactions model, the latter effect implies a social-interaction parameter of 0.16 and a multiplier of 1.2. Thus, consumption responses depend not only on resources but also on whether income shocks are private, public, or shared within a salient peer group.
10.3386/w35575.abstract_zh: 利用意大利消费者预期调查中的随机调查实验，我们研究了可观察性与共同性如何影响对1000欧元雇主奖金的反应。将一项特定奖金向同事公开，会使边际消费倾向降低3个百分点。在可观察的条件下，将奖金扩展至所有同事，则使其提高6个百分点。在社会互动模型下，后一效应意味着社会互动参数为0.16，乘数为1.2。因此，消费反应不仅取决于资源，还取决于收入冲击是私人的、公共的，还是在显著同伴群体内共享的。
10.3386/w35575.title: Observability and Social Interactions in Consumption
10.3386/w35575.title_zh: 消费中的可观测性与社会互动

10.3386/w35576.abstract: Parents’ and teachers’ expectations and aspirations are critical drivers of educational outcomes, yet what causally shapes these expectations remains unclear. In the present study, we address this question by deploying the random experiment of meiosis: namely, conditional on parental genotype, offspring genotype is random, allowing for the unconfounding of unique child characteristics from the more general family and household environment. Using the Wisconsin Longitudinal Study, we employ Mendelian imputation to estimate the direct genetic effects of 18 polygenic indices on college encouragement, net of parental genetic background. The genetic propensity for educational attainment and mathematical ability predict stronger expectations of college attendance, while smoking behavior predicts weaker expectations. Psychiatric traits show no effects after multiple-testing correction, indicating that responses are concentrated on cognitive and behavioral traits. Mediation analysis finds that prospectively measured teachers’ encouragement accounts for roughly a quarter of the genetic effects on educational attainment for cognitive traits, but not for psychiatric traits. Genetic effects on expectations are amplified among high-SES parents and first-born children. Thus, genetic influences on educational expectations are narrow in trait scope and uneven across families, with encouragement serving as one channel linking genetic differences to educational inequality.
10.3386/w35576.abstract_zh: 父母和教师的期望与抱负是教育成果的关键驱动因素，然而，究竟是什么因果性地塑造了这些期望，目前尚不明确。在本研究中，我们通过运用减数分裂的随机实验来解决这一问题：即，在父母基因型给定的条件下，后代的基因型是随机的，从而能够将独特的儿童特征从更广泛的家庭和住户环境中分离出来，避免混淆。利用威斯康星纵向研究，我们采用孟德尔插补法，在控制父母遗传背景的情况下，估计了18个多基因指数对大学鼓励的直接遗传效应。教育成就和数学能力的遗传倾向预示着更强的大学入学期望，而吸烟行为则预示着较弱的期望。经过多重检验校正后，精神特质未显示出显著效应，表明反应集中在认知和行为特质上。中介分析发现，前瞻性测量的教师鼓励在认知特质上解释了教育成就遗传效应的大约四分之一，但对精神特质则无此作用。遗传对期望的影响在高社会经济地位父母和长子/长女中有所放大。因此，遗传对教育期望的影响在特质范围上较为狭窄，且在家庭间分布不均，鼓励作为连接遗传差异与教育不平等的一条渠道发挥作用。
10.3386/w35576.title: Do Children's Genes Evoke Educational Expectations? Direct Genetic Effects on Parents' and Teachers' College Encouragement
10.3386/w35576.title_zh: 儿童基因会唤起教育期望吗？基因对父母和教师大学鼓励的直接效应

10.3386/w35577.abstract: In 2008, the aggregate market value of U.S.-listed firms was roughly one-third higher than that of European-listed firms. By 2023, it was more than 300% higher, a difference of $34 trillion. The valuation gap is broad-based, rather than concentrated among a few superstar firms, and is driven by differences in firm values, not in the number of listed firms. Across sectors, the gap is larger in R&D-intensive industries and in industries with high returns to scale. European firms’ size is strongly correlated with home-country GDP, whereas U.S. firms’ size is unrelated to home-state GDP. Smaller European firms also face a particularly large cost-of-capital gap and do not appear able to substitute debt for limited access to equity financing, including venture capital. Taken together, these facts suggest that financial and product-market frictions constrain European firms’ ability to scale.
10.3386/w35577.abstract_zh: 2008年，美国上市公司的总市值比欧洲上市公司高出约三分之一。到2023年，这一差距扩大至超过300%，差额达34万亿美元。这一估值差距具有广泛性，并非集中于少数几家超级明星企业，且主要由企业价值差异驱动，而非上市公司数量差异所致。从行业来看，研发密集型行业及规模报酬较高的行业中，这一差距更为显著。欧洲企业的规模与其母国GDP密切相关，而美国企业的规模则与所在州的GDP无关。较小的欧洲企业还面临尤为巨大的资本成本差距，且似乎无法通过债务融资来弥补股权融资（包括风险投资）渠道受限的问题。综合这些事实表明，金融和产品市场摩擦制约了欧洲企业的扩张能力。
10.3386/w35577.title: The Value Gap: Europe Cannot Scale
10.3386/w35577.title_zh: 价值缺口：欧洲无法实现规模化

10.3386/w35578.abstract: Do corporate bond investors earn compensation for bearing credit risk? We construct a new historical corporate bond database spanning 128 years to estimate a corporate bond counterpart to the equity risk premium. Combining hand-collected archival data with modern sources, we assemble a panel of over 100,000 bonds and 7 million observations. While recent samples suggest corporate bond excess returns largely reflect the term premium, our long sample reveals a sizable and statistically significant credit risk premium. Credit spreads predict future corporate bond returns and macroeconomic aggregates, though their ability to forecast business cycle fluctuations weakens when prewar data are included.
10.3386/w35578.abstract_zh: 企业债券投资者是否因承担信用风险而获得补偿？我们构建了一个跨越128年的全新历史企业债券数据库，用以估算与股票风险溢价相对应的企业债券风险溢价。通过将手工收集的档案数据与现代数据源相结合，我们汇集了一个包含超过10万只债券、700万条观测值的面板数据集。尽管近期样本显示企业债券超额收益主要反映期限溢价，但我们的长期样本揭示了一个规模可观且统计显著的信用风险溢价。信用利差能够预测未来企业债券回报及宏观经济总量，尽管在纳入战前数据后，其预测商业周期波动的能力有所减弱。
10.3386/w35578.title: Reconstructing a Century of U.S. Corporate Bonds: Credit Risk in Historical Perspective
10.3386/w35578.title_zh: 重构美国公司债百年史：历史视角下的信用风险

10.3386/w35579.abstract: We identify a strong common risk factor structure that is pervasive across corporate securities: stocks, corporate bonds, and options.
