Conditional on experience, specialty, and outcome year, recession-cohort physicians bill Medicare more per beneficiary despite seeing healthier patients—particularly on discretionary, revenue-generating services—and sort into practice settings with higher-powered financial incentives. The additional spending does not produce detectable improvements in patient health. Taken together, our findings point to stronger financial motivation among those drawn into medicine when outside options are weak and suggest that medical school admissions screen imperfectly on the attributes that ultimately shape how physicians practice.
10.3386/w35631.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了美国医学专业选择如何影响医生的执业风格。我们利用医学院申请时的宏观经济状况作为申请者群体的外生冲击，发现其他声望较高领域的劳动力市场衰退会增加医学院的申请人数，并使入学群体的构成向非医学预科背景的学生倾斜。引人注目的是，这些外部选择较差的群体在数十年后的执业方式有所不同。在控制经验、专业和结果年份的条件下，经济衰退时期的医生尽管面对更健康的患者，却对每位受益人的医疗保险账单更高——尤其是在可自由支配、创收性服务上——并倾向于选择财务激励更强的执业环境。额外支出并未带来可检测的患者健康改善。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，当外部选择较弱时，被吸引进入医学领域的人具有更强的财务动机，并暗示医学院招生在最终塑造医生执业方式的特质筛选上并不完美。
10.3386/w35631.title: Selection into Medicine

10.3386/w35632.abstract: Navigating the tax system often requires information and judgment that taxpayers may lack. Although taxpayers sometimes rely on human experts, AI could provide comparable assistance at substantially lower cost. Yet there is no causal evidence on how taxpayers use AI tax agents or how these tools affect their behavior. We fill this gap with a field experiment in the context of property tax appeals. We recruited a sample of 645 households in Dallas County, Texas. All households received access to a website providing personalized information, filing instructions, and supporting evidence for an appeal. Half were randomly assigned to a version of the website that also included an AI chatbot capable of answering questions and providing guidance tailored to their circumstances. Chatbot take-up was high: 78% initiated a conversation. Access to the chatbot increased the probability of filing an appeal without a human agent by 9.1 pp, from 41.4% to 50.5%. Evidence from clickstream data and conversation transcripts suggests that the chatbot helped households exercise judgment—that is, evaluate and act on the available information. The increase in appeal filing was smaller among less-advantaged households, providing suggestive evidence that the chatbot widened existing disparities. Our results demonstrate the potential of AI tax assistance while highlighting that who benefits depends not only on access, but also on how taxpayers use the technology.
10.3386/w35632.abstract_zh: 应对税务系统往往需要纳税人可能缺乏的信息和判断力。尽管纳税人有时依赖人类专家，但人工智能或许能以显著更低的成本提供类似的协助。然而，关于纳税人如何使用人工智能税务代理或这些工具如何影响其行为，尚无因果证据。我们通过在房产税上诉背景下的实地实验填补了这一空白。我们招募了德克萨斯州达拉斯县645户家庭作为样本。所有家庭均可访问一个提供个性化信息、申请指南及支持证据的网站。其中一半家庭被随机分配至包含人工智能聊天机器人的网站版本，该机器人能够回答提问并提供针对其具体情况定制的指导。聊天机器人的使用率很高：78%的家庭发起了对话。使用聊天机器人使无人工代理提交上诉的概率提高了9.1个百分点，从41.4%升至50.5%。点击流数据和对话记录的证据表明，聊天机器人帮助家庭行使判断力——即评估并利用现有信息。在条件较不利的家庭中，上诉提交的增加幅度较小，这为聊天机器人扩大了现有差距提供了提示性证据。我们的结果展示了人工智能税务协助的潜力，同时强调受益者不仅取决于获取途径，还取决于纳税人如何使用该技术。
10.3386/w35632.title: Taxpayer Behavior in the Age of AI: A Field Experiment on Property Tax Appeals
10.3386/w35632.title_zh: 人工智能时代的纳税人行为：房产税申诉的实地实验

10.3386/w35633.abstract: In instrumental-variable (IV) studies, researchers often evaluate multiple candidate instruments and selectively report the specification with the most favorable first- or second-stage statistics. We show that this form of instrument selection (“instrument-hacking”) induces median bias in IV estimators toward the OLS estimand, undermining the rationale for using IV. When all candidate instruments have the same true strength, median bias increases monotonically with the number of available instruments. More generally, when candidate instruments differ in true strength, monotonicity need not hold because increasing the number of instruments can lead researchers to select genuinely stronger instruments. Nonetheless, in simulations calibrated to the empirical distribution of instrument strengths in the IV literature, median bias increases monotonically with the number of available instruments. Furthermore, it is substantial in magnitude, even when only a few instruments are available.
10.3386/w35633.abstract_zh: 在工具变量（IV）研究中，研究者常评估多个候选工具变量，并选择性地报告一阶段或二阶段统计量最有利的规格。我们证明，这种工具选择形式（“工具操纵”）会导致IV估计量向OLS估计量产生中位数偏误，削弱了使用IV的合理性。当所有候选工具变量具有相同的真实强度时，中位数偏误随可用工具数量的增加而单调递增。更一般地，当候选工具变量在真实强度上存在差异时，单调性不一定成立，因为增加工具数量可能促使研究者选择真正更强的工具。然而，在基于IV文献中工具强度经验分布校准的模拟中，中位数偏误随可用工具数量的增加而单调递增。此外，即使仅有少量工具可用，其偏误幅度也相当可观。
10.3386/w35633.title: Instrument Hacking

10.3386/w35634.abstract: We design a method for measuring the risk preferences of agents in the deep past. The method combines a structural model of crop choice as a portfolio allocation with machine-learning prediction of expected crop returns, using historic agronomic and climate data. We estimate county-level risk preferences for the United States and farmer-level preferences in Kansas from 1889 to 1929. More risk averse farmers leveraged less, were less likely to purchase novel WWI Liberty Bonds, and were more likely to participate in local risk-sharing institutions. We show that higher risk aversion predicts slower tractor adoption and farm mechanization during the 1920s.
10.3386/w35634.abstract_zh: 我们设计了一种衡量远古时期个体风险偏好的方法。该方法将作物选择的结构性模型视为投资组合配置，并结合机器学习预测预期作物收益，利用历史农业与气候数据。我们估算了美国县级风险偏好及1889年至1929年间堪萨斯州农民个体层面的偏好。风险规避程度更高的农民杠杆使用较少，购买一战新型自由债券的可能性较低，而更倾向于参与本地风险分担机制。我们证明，更高的风险规避程度预示着20世纪20年代拖拉机采用及农业机械化进程的放缓。
10.3386/w35634.title: The Yeoman's Portfolio: Measuring Historical Risk Preferences Using Crop Choice
10.3386/w35634.title_zh: 《自耕农的投资组合：利用作物选择衡量历史风险偏好》

10.3386/w35635.abstract: We examine whether occupational licensing improves service quality and safety using trip-level Uber data that include driver ratings and telematics-based measures of driving behavior. Exploiting quasi-random assignment from proximity-based dispatch, we compare trips served by licensed and unlicensed drivers in two settings: a cross-border comparison between New York City and New Jersey, and a deregulation event in Houston. Across settings and specifications, including instrumental variable estimates, we find no consistent evidence that licensing improves consumer outcomes. In Houston, post-deregulation entrants are indistinguishable from previously licensed drivers on ratings and driving behavior, despite differing markedly in experience and age.
10.3386/w35635.abstract_zh: 我们利用包含司机评分和基于远程信息处理的驾驶行为指标的Uber行程级数据，考察职业许可是否提升服务质量和安全性。借助基于邻近调度的准随机分配，我们在两种情境下比较持牌与无牌司机服务的行程：纽约市与新泽西州的跨境对比，以及休斯顿的放松管制事件。跨情境和规格（包括工具变量估计）中，我们发现没有一致证据表明许可改善消费者结果。在休斯顿，放松管制后进入者与先前持牌司机在评分和驾驶行为上难以区分，尽管他们在经验和年龄上差异显著。
10.3386/w35635.title: Occupational Licensing of Uber Drivers
10.3386/w35635.title_zh: 优步司机的职业许可制度

10.3386/w35636.abstract: I decompose stock returns into a duration-matched Treasury component, identified from monetary policy surprises, and a payoff component. Risk and returns rise much less with duration for stocks than for their matched Treasuries. Stock volatility is dampened by rate insurance: rates fall in bad times, so the bond inside a stock provides insurance against the stock’s payoff risk. Expected stock returns are dampened because the insurance works in reverse: rates rise in good times, so stocks’ payoff gains hedge the losses borne by investors holding net duration, notably government bonds when Ricardian equivalence fails. This framework helps reconcile positive bond premia with negative stock-bond covariance, sheds light on equity anomalies and the collapse of the value premium, implies that fiscal and monetary policy shape bond and equity premia, and motivates a two-factor model that jointly prices stocks and bonds. Rate insurance can even turn the price of long-run risk negative, explaining why long bonds beat long stocks.
10.3386/w35636.abstract_zh: 我将股票收益分解为期限匹配的国债成分（通过货币政策冲击识别）与支付成分。股票的风险和收益随期限上升的幅度远低于其匹配国债。股票波动性受到利率保险的抑制：利率在经济低迷时下降，因此股票内部的债券成分对股票的支付风险提供了保险。预期股票收益受到抑制，因为保险机制反向运作：利率在经济繁荣时上升，因此股票的支付收益对冲了投资者持有净期限敞口（尤其是当李嘉图等价失效时政府债券）所承受的损失。这一框架有助于调和正债券溢价与负股票-债券协方差，揭示股票异象及价值溢价的崩溃，表明财政与货币政策塑造债券和股票溢价，并推动了一个联合定价股票和债券的双因子模型。利率保险甚至能使长期风险的价格转为负值，从而解释长期债券跑赢长期股票的现象。
10.3386/w35636.title: Rate Risk and Rate Insurance

10.3386/w35637.abstract: Firms shape public policy not only from the outside through lobbying and campaign contributions, but also from the inside when business owners hold public office. We study this channel using a novel dataset that links state legislators’ personal financial disclosures to bill sponsorship records across 26 U.S. states from 2009 to 2023. The disclosures allow us to observe business ownership during legislative service and to distinguish entrepreneurs, defined as legislators who both own and actively manage a firm, from passive shareholders and employees. Applying a large language model to bill text, we classify legislation as pro-business and identify a subset of pro-entry bills that reduce barriers facing new firms. Entrepreneurs are a substantial presence in state legislatures, accounting for over 40 percent of legislators, and their representation varies primarily across states rather than within states over time. Although entrepreneurs do not sponsor more bills overall, they initiate a greater share of bills as first or sole primary sponsor. They also do not appear to be generic advocates for business. Relative to legislators with other business ties, entrepreneurs are no more likely to sponsor pro-business bills or bills endorsed by state Chambers of Commerce. Instead, they selectively advance pro-entry legislation, especially bills related to deregulation and innovation rather than antitrust or access to capital. These findings document an important channel through which entrepreneurs shape the policy environment for entrepreneurship from within political institutions.
10.3386/w35637.abstract_zh: 企业不仅通过游说和竞选捐款等外部途径影响公共政策，还通过企业主担任公职这一内部渠道发挥作用。我们利用一项新颖的数据集来研究这一渠道，该数据集将美国26个州2009年至2023年间州议员的个人财务披露与法案提案记录相链接。财务披露使我们能够观察到议员在任职期间的企业所有权情况，并将企业家——即既拥有又积极管理企业的议员——与被动股东和雇员区分开来。我们运用大型语言模型对法案文本进行分类，将立法划分为亲商类型，并识别出一类减少新企业面临障碍的亲准入法案。企业家在州议会中占据重要地位，占议员总数的40%以上，其代表性差异主要体现为州际差异，而非州内随时间的变化。尽管企业家总体上并未提出更多法案，但他们作为第一或唯一主要提案人发起法案的比例更高。此外，他们并非笼统的商业利益代言人。相较于具有其他商业关联的议员，企业家提出亲商法案或获得州商会支持法案的可能性并未更高。相反，他们有针对性地推进亲准入立法，尤其是与放松管制和创新相关的法案，而非反垄断或资本获取方面的法案。这些发现揭示了企业家从政治机构内部塑造创业政策环境的重要渠道。
10.3386/w35637.title: Political Entrepreneurs

10.3386/w35638.abstract: How slow are bank transfers, and how do transfer delays affect deposit demand? Using transaction-level data from millions of depositors, we measure transfer delays by matching debits and credits across accounts held by the same depositor. Shorter delays correlate with more transfers and lower balances. Exploiting county-level exposure to Zelle’s staggered rollout, we find that faster payments reduce delays and deposit growth. Calibrating a deposit-management model, we find that transfer delays raise deposit demand, and the magnitude of this effect varies with interest rates and consumption volatility. Payment frictions therefore shape transactional deposit demand and monetary transmission.
10.3386/w35638.abstract_zh: 银行转账有多慢，转账延迟又如何影响存款需求？利用数百万储户的交易级数据，我们通过匹配同一储户账户间的借方与贷方来度量转账延迟。较短的延迟与更多的转账次数和更低的账户余额相关联。利用县级对Zelle分阶段推出的暴露度，我们发现更快的支付减少了延迟并降低了存款增长。校准一个存款管理模型后，我们发现转账延迟提高了存款需求，且这一效应的大小随利率和消费波动性而变化。因此，支付摩擦塑造了交易性存款需求和货币传导机制。
10.3386/w35638.title: Tracing the Impact of Payment Convenience on Deposits: Evidence from Depositor Activeness
10.3386/w35638.title_zh: 支付便利性对存款的影响追踪：来自存款人活跃度的证据

10.3386/w35639.abstract: We examine how contractions in local labor demand during the Great Recession affected children's academic achievement. We combine county-level test scores for grades 3–8 from the Stanford Education Data Archive with a shift-share design that interacts counties' 2005 industry composition with national industry employment growth, isolating demand-driven changes in local employment. Following recent advances in the shift-share literature, we validate the design with balance, pre-trend, and Rotemberg-weight diagnostics and report exposure-robust standard errors throughout. A one-standard-deviation adverse shock lowers mathematics achievement by about 0.03 student-level standard deviations and widens the White–Black and economic-disadvantage achievement gaps in both subjects. Within a common geography, losses concentrate among economically disadvantaged students. English language arts estimates point in the same direction but are harder to separate from the Great Recession's housing bust, and we interpret them as the combined effect of the labor-demand contraction and the associated decline in house prices. The achievement response is concentrated in the recession window. The post-2014 period, identified mainly by the oil-price cycle, yields a precise null, so our estimates measure the response to severe contractions rather than a general business-cycle parameter. School funding did not respond contemporaneously to these shocks, while family income, child poverty, and house prices all did.
10.3386/w35639.abstract_zh: 我们考察了大衰退期间地方劳动力需求收缩对儿童学业成绩的影响。我们将斯坦福教育数据档案中3至8年级的县级考试成绩与一种“份额-转移”设计相结合，该设计将各县2005年的产业结构与全国行业就业增长进行交互，从而分离出地方就业中由需求驱动的变化。遵循份额-转移文献的最新进展，我们通过平衡性检验、事前趋势检验和Rotemberg权重诊断来验证该设计的有效性，并在全文中报告暴露稳健的标准误。一个标准差的不利冲击会使数学成绩降低约0.03个学生层面标准差，并扩大白人与黑人之间以及经济弱势群体之间的成绩差距，且这一效应在数学和英语两科中均存在。在共同的地理范围内，损失集中于经济弱势学生群体。英语语言艺术的估计结果指向相同方向，但难以与大衰退时期的房地产泡沫破裂相区分，因此我们将其解释为劳动力需求收缩及相关房价下跌的联合效应。学业成绩的响应集中出现在衰退窗口期内。2014年之后，主要由油价周期识别的时期产生了精确的零效应，因此我们的估计衡量的是对严重收缩的响应，而非一般性的商业周期参数。学校经费对这些冲击没有即时响应，而家庭收入、儿童贫困率和房价均有所反应。
10.3386/w35639.title: Local Labor Demand and Achievement Gaps: Evidence from the Great Recession
10.3386/w35639.title_zh: 地方劳动力需求与学业成就差距：来自大衰退的证据

10.3386/w35640.abstract: How do firms set wages? How should governments set income taxes? If labor supply is inelastic to wages, firms can pay workers less than their marginal products, and governments can increase taxes without eroding the base. However, the structure of labor supply elasticities in the economy is complex. Recent empirics document variation across workers, firms, and margins (which firm to work at versus how many hours to work). To account for this rich structure of labor supply elasticities we extend the neoclassical model to include a discrete choice over which firm to work at, production complementarities and strategic interaction between heterogeneous, granular firms. In terms of wage setting, we find that novel effects of worker heterogeneity account for 78 percent of the variable component of labor supply elasticities and markdowns, and 89 percent of markdown differences between large and small firms. In terms of policy, higher progressivity makes labor supply less elastic, eroding the tax base by widening markdowns and worsening sorting. These channels (i) produce large declines in earnings following increases in marginal tax rates, consistent with empirical studies, and (ii) reduce optimal tax progressivity by one-third and associated welfare gains by two-thirds.
10.3386/w35640.abstract_zh: 企业如何设定工资？政府应如何设定所得税？如果劳动力供给对工资缺乏弹性，企业可以支付低于其边际产出的工资，政府也可以在不侵蚀税基的情况下提高税收。然而，经济中劳动力供给弹性的结构十分复杂。近期实证研究记录了工人、企业以及不同边际（选择在哪家企业工作与选择工作多少小时）之间的差异。为解释劳动力供给弹性这一丰富结构，我们扩展了新古典模型，纳入对工作企业的离散选择、生产互补性以及异质性、颗粒型企业之间的战略互动。在工资设定方面，我们发现工人异质性的新效应解释了劳动力供给弹性和加价折价（markdowns）可变部分的78%，以及大企业与小企业之间加价折价差异的89%。在政策方面，更高的累进性使劳动力供给弹性降低，通过扩大加价折价和恶化匹配（sorting）侵蚀税基。这些渠道（i）导致边际税率提高后收入大幅下降，与实证研究一致；（ii）使最优税收累进性降低三分之一，相关福利收益减少三分之二。
10.3386/w35640.title: Labor Market Power with Worker and Firm Heterogeneity
10.3386/w35640.title_zh: 具有工人与企业异质性的劳动力市场势力

10.3386/w35641.abstract: Public AI benchmarks steer research and allocate investments. They are therefore market designs. Public examples can reveal the process behind a private final test, while a finite public score cannot cover a broad task space inherent to general intelligence. I show how both gaps become profitable when scores move capital and how targeted effort erodes the signal used by later investors. The market design lesson is to separate development from certification: publish practice tasks, but choose the investment-consequential generator after the submitted system's evaluation policy is fixed.
10.3386/w35641.abstract_zh: 公共人工智能基准引导研究方向并分配投资，因此它们属于市场设计。公开示例能揭示私人最终测试背后的过程，而有限的公开分数无法覆盖通用智能固有的广泛任务空间。我展示了当分数驱动资本流动时，这两个缺口如何变得有利可图，以及针对性努力如何侵蚀后续投资者所使用的信号。市场设计的启示在于将开发与认证分离：发布练习任务，但在提交系统的评估策略固定之后，再选择对投资具有决定性影响的生成器。
10.3386/w35641.title: Benchmark Mineability and the Financing of AI Innovation
10.3386/w35641.title_zh: 基准可开采性与人工智能创新的融资

10.3386/w35642.abstract: The possibility of fiscal dominance in the representative-agent New Keynesian model (RANK) hinges on the assumption that income is perpetually demand-determined: fiscal deficits can drive output and inflation within that model only insofar as they trigger infinitely lasting, self-sustained shifts in aggregate spending and income. Moving to heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian models (HANK) opens the door to a different pathway: classical non-Ricardian effects, due to finite horizons or liquidity constraints. A refinement motivated by the model's intended focus on short-run phenomena—requiring a return to flexible-price outcomes in finite time—arrests the infinite feedback loop between spending and income, leaving only the classical non-Ricardian mechanism, and makes sure that the study of monetary-fiscal interactions is not centered on hard-to-test assumptions regarding beliefs at infinity.
10.3386/w35642.abstract_zh: 在代表性主体新凯恩斯模型（RANK）中，财政主导的可能性取决于收入永久由需求决定的假设：在该模型内，财政赤字只有在引发总支出和收入无限期持续、自我维持的变动时，才能推动产出和通胀。转向异质性主体新凯恩斯模型（HANK）则开辟了一条不同的路径：由于有限视野或流动性约束导致的经典非李嘉图效应。基于模型旨在聚焦短期现象——要求在有限时间内回归弹性价格结果——的细化，阻断了支出与收入之间的无限反馈循环，仅保留经典非李嘉图机制，并确保货币-财政相互作用的研究不依赖于关于无穷远处信念的难以检验的假设。
10.3386/w35642.title: Monetary-Fiscal Interactions: A Reappraisal

10.3386/w35643.abstract: Survival analysis methods are often used to predict the time until the onset of an event in settings when the true time-to-event (TTE) may be censored during training. Such approaches typically assume uncensored data are representative of censored data and that the probability of censoring conditioned on the covariates remains constant over time, i.e., there is no censoring distribution shift. However, both assumptions can fail in practice when censoring results from interventions targeted to individuals with particular comorbidities or genetic markers (such as prophylactic surgery when predicting time to cancer onset, or scheduled cesarean delivery and induction when predicting time to spontaneous labor) and changes in clinical policies alter which individuals are targeted for these interventions over time. To address this, we propose a new approach, cluster-weighted inference of time-to event (CWITE), that remains accurate when these assumptions do not hold. Unlike existing approaches that ignore times-to-censoring (TTC) or treat them only as a lower bound of the TTE, CWITE leverages the insight that a subset of censored individuals are likely censored close to their true TTEs, and uses a novel mechanism to learn from such individuals. On the task of predicting time to spontaneous labor using real-world data, CWITE improves TTE accuracy for individuals similar to censored training data (mean absolute error: 6.50 days, 95% CI: [5.55, 7.40] vs. 7.82 days, [6.82, 8.82]) while maintaining comparable performance for those similar to uncensored training data (6.50 days, [5.54, 7.61] vs. 6.63 days, [5.67,7.69]). Our results demonstrate that incorporating more specific supervision from censored training data can significantly improve TTE predictions in settings with limited overlap and censoring distribution shift, challenges common in real-world clinical data. Code to implement CWITE and reproduce all experiments in the paper is available at https://github.com/MLD3/CWITE.
10.3386/w35643.abstract_zh: 生存分析方法常用于预测事件发生前的时间，在训练过程中真实事件发生时间（TTE）可能被审查的情况下。这类方法通常假设未审查数据能代表审查数据，并且给定协变量时审查概率随时间保持不变，即不存在审查分布偏移。然而，在实践中，当审查源于针对具有特定合并症或遗传标记个体的干预措施（如预测癌症发病时间时的预防性手术，或预测自然分娩时间时的计划剖宫产和引产）以及临床政策随时间变化导致针对这些干预措施的个体目标改变时，这两个假设都可能失效。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新方法，即聚类加权事件时间推断（CWITE），该方法在这些假设不成立时仍能保持准确性。与现有方法忽略审查时间（TTC）或仅将其视为TTE的下界不同，CWITE利用了一个洞察：一部分被审查的个体可能在其真实TTE附近被审查，并通过一种新颖机制从这些个体中学习。在利用真实世界数据预测自然分娩时间的任务中，CWITE提高了与审查训练数据相似个体的TTE预测准确性（平均绝对误差：6.50天，95%置信区间：[5.55, 7.40]对比7.82天，[6.82, 8.82]），同时在与未审查训练数据相似个体上保持了相当的性能（6.50天，[5.54, 7.61]对比6.63天，[5.67, 7.69]）。我们的结果表明，在重叠有限和审查分布偏移的情况下，从审查训练数据中融入更具体的监督信息能显著改善TTE预测，这些挑战在真实临床数据中常见。实现CWITE并复现论文中所有实验的代码可在https://github.com/MLD3/CWITE获取。
10.3386/w35643.title: Survival Analysis with Limited Overlap and Censoring Distribution Shift
10.3386/w35643.title_zh: 有限重叠与删失分布偏移下的生存分析

10.3386/w35644.abstract: Support for populist and authoritarian regimes is rising worldwide, despite evidence that they tend to underperform economically. We examine the role of (mis)perceptions of regime performance as drivers of political attitudes, leveraging two survey experiments with 11,377 respondents during Argentina’s 2023 presidential elections. Optimistic beliefs about the performance of populist and non-democratic regimes were widespread, and displayed a strong correlation with support for these regimes. When exposed to randomly assigned informational treatments challenging optimistic views about these political regimes, individuals significantly adjusted their beliefs, and reduced their support for candidates they associate with populist and authoritarian leanings. Exploring the impact of different information sources, we find that academic sources and newspapers were more influential than social media. Although individuals adjusted their beliefs and attitudes in response to information on regime performance, contradicting their prior beliefs reduced their demand for additional information, consistent with an important role for motivated reasoning.
10.3386/w35644.abstract_zh: 尽管有证据表明民粹主义和威权政权往往在经济上表现不佳，但全球范围内对其支持率仍在上升。我们通过阿根廷2023年总统选举期间对11,377名受访者进行的两项调查实验，考察了（错误）认知对政权表现作为政治态度驱动因素的作用。关于民粹主义和非民主政权表现的乐观信念普遍存在，并与对这些政权的支持显示出强烈相关性。当接触到随机分配的信息干预，挑战对这些政治政权表现的乐观看法时，个体显著调整了其信念，并减少了对他们与民粹主义和威权倾向相关联的候选人的支持。通过探索不同信息来源的影响，我们发现学术来源和报纸比社交媒体更具影响力。尽管个体根据政权表现的信息调整了其信念和态度，但与其先前信念相矛盾的信息减少了他们对额外信息的需求，这与动机性推理的重要作用相一致。
10.3386/w35644.title: Where the Grass Seems Greener: Economic Misperceptions and Support for Democracy
10.3386/w35644.title_zh: 草更绿之处：经济误解与民主支持

10.3386/w35645.abstract: The diffusion of technological innovation depends on incentives, regulations, and firms’ strategic behaviors. We study these intersections within cardiac procedure markets following Medicare’s expansion of non-hospital facility options for treatment, enabled by clinical advancements. State-level regulations restrain federal pro-competition policy. Where market entry occurs, business stealing is concentrated among the lowest cost treatment settings, rather than high-cost hospitals––increasing Medicare spending by approximately $2.5 million. Medicare policy also generates externalities for untargeted procedures and other payers, except when hospitals and physicians are vertically integrated. Federal rulemaking interacts with and is mitigated by complex market dynamics––including in potentially unanticipated ways.
10.3386/w35645.abstract_zh: 技术创新扩散取决于激励、监管及企业战略行为。我们研究了在临床进步推动下，医疗保险扩大非医院设施治疗选择后，心脏手术市场中的这些交叉因素。州级监管限制了联邦促进竞争政策。在市场准入发生之处，业务抢夺集中于成本最低的治疗环境，而非高成本医院——导致医疗保险支出增加约250万美元。医疗保险政策还对未涉及的手术及其他支付方产生外部效应，除非医院与医生实现纵向整合。联邦规则制定与复杂市场动态相互作用，并受其缓和——包括可能以未预见的方式。
10.3386/w35645.title: Stress Testing Cardiac Care Markets through Deregulation
10.3386/w35645.title_zh: 通过放松管制对心脏护理市场进行压力测试

10.3386/w35647.abstract: We develop stress tests based on an original International Monetary System (IMS) model with regime switchings. The model is calibrated for nine reference currencies from the beginning of the Classical Gold Standard to the present. Regime switchings in currency dominance are related to combinations of conditions on a multidimensional environment variable that includes five classes of shocks: technology; development; monetary, financial and fiscal institutions; democracy and conflicts; and the regulatory environment. We provide an original database of events for these five classes of shocks, which is used for calibration. The calibration highlights the important role of the democracy and conflicts component in regime switchings. The calibrated model is then used to perform stress tests on the current prospects of currency dominance for a broad set of scenarios. A salient result from the scenarios we tested is that the dominance of the US dollar is at most marginally affected. No other currency emerges as a major player, suggesting strong inertia in the system’s current centripetal dynamics.
10.3386/w35647.abstract_zh: 我们基于一个包含制度切换的原创国际货币体系（IMS）模型开发了压力测试。该模型针对从古典金本位制初期至今的九种参考货币进行了校准。货币主导地位中的制度切换与一个多维环境变量的条件组合相关，该变量涵盖五类冲击：技术；发展；货币、金融和财政制度；民主与冲突；以及监管环境。我们为这五类冲击提供了一个原创的事件数据库，用于校准。校准结果凸显了民主与冲突成分在制度切换中的重要作用。随后，校准后的模型被用于对广泛情景下当前货币主导地位前景进行压力测试。我们测试的情景中一个显著结果是，美元的主导地位至多受到轻微影响。没有其他货币成为主要参与者，这表明系统当前向心动态中存在强烈的惯性。
10.3386/w35647.title: Currency Dominance Is Not Forever: Some Insights from a Non-Linear Dynamic Model
10.3386/w35647.title_zh: 货币主导地位并非永恒：来自非线性动态模型的一些启示

10.3386/w35648.abstract: Buprenorphine prescribing for opioid use disorder remains far below the scale of the overdose crisis. We estimate the causal effect of county-level synthetic opioid overdose mortality shocks on the volume of buprenorphine treatment delivered, exploiting the staggered geographic diffusion of synthetic opioids from 2013 to 2023. Linking IQVIA Longitudinal Prescription Claims to National Vital Statistics System mortality records, we implement a difference-in-differences estimator with propensity score matching under three complementary exposure measures. Treatment volume increases significantly under all three definitions, with no evidence of differential pre-trends; point estimates for buprenorphine prescribing rates range from 5 to 17 percent of pre-treatment means, emerge within one to two quarters, and grow monotonically thereafter. Our design does not separately identify changes in patient demand and provider behavior, but the increase in unique prescribers is consistent with a provider-side response. The response is concentrated among advanced practice providers, Medicaid patients, and counties with pre-existing buprenorphine infrastructure; counties with little baseline prescribing show no response. Local mortality information acts as a determinant of treatment volume, with effects comparable in magnitude to major legislative interventions aimed at expanding treatment, but appear only where prescribing capacity already exists.
10.3386/w35648.abstract_zh: 阿片类药物使用障碍的丁丙诺啡处方量仍远低于药物过量危机的规模。我们估算了县级合成阿片类药物过量死亡率冲击对丁丙诺啡治疗量的因果效应，利用2013年至2023年合成阿片类药物在地理上的交错扩散。将IQVIA纵向处方索赔数据与国家生命统计系统死亡率记录相链接，我们在三种互补暴露度量下实施带有倾向得分匹配的双重差分估计。在三种定义下，治疗量均显著增加，且无差异化前趋势的证据；丁丙诺啡处方率的点估计值介于治疗前均值的5%至17%之间，在一至两个季度内显现，此后单调增长。我们的设计无法分别识别患者需求与提供者行为的变化，但独特处方提供者数量的增加与供给侧响应一致。该响应集中于高级执业提供者、医疗补助患者以及已有丁丙诺啡基础设施的县；基线处方量较低的县未显示响应。地方死亡率信息作为治疗量的决定因素，其效应在量级上与旨在扩大治疗的主要立法干预相当，但仅在已有处方能力的地区显现。
10.3386/w35648.title: Do Local Synthetic Opioid Overdose Deaths Affect Provider Prescribing of Buprenorphine?
10.3386/w35648.title_zh: 地方合成阿片类药物过量死亡是否影响医生丁丙诺啡处方行为？

10.3386/w35649.abstract: Childcare services can offer an opportunity for women to develop their careers and increase household income. At the same time, it can affect the development of children, depending on the quality of care. We first develop a collective model of the household as a conceptual framework to show how improving the availability of childcare can affect mothers’ labor market opportunities and earnings and how it can affect child development. We then review the literature on the effects of childcare on the employment and earnings of women and on child development. Childcare can increase mothers’ employment. However, limited work opportunities or strict norms against maternal work can keep mothers out of the labor force. When other family members provide care, childcare can free these caregivers to work or attend school. When studies measure the impact on child development, the results are mixed and depend on both context and quality of provision.
10.3386/w35649.abstract_zh: 育儿服务能为女性提供发展职业生涯和增加家庭收入的机会。同时，根据照护质量的不同，它也可能影响儿童的发展。我们首先构建了一个家庭集体模型作为概念框架，用以说明改善育儿服务的可及性如何影响母亲的劳动力市场机会和收入，以及如何影响儿童发展。随后，我们回顾了关于育儿服务对女性就业、收入及儿童发展影响的文献。育儿服务可以提高母亲的就业率。然而，有限的工作机会或对母亲就业的严格社会规范可能使母亲留在劳动力市场之外。当其他家庭成员提供照护时，育儿服务可以解放这些照护者，使其能够工作或上学。在衡量对儿童发展影响的研究中，结果不一，且取决于具体情境和服务的质量。
10.3386/w35649.title: The Effect of Childcare on Female Labor Supply and Child Development in Low and Middle Income Countries
10.3386/w35649.title_zh: 中低收入国家儿童保育对女性劳动供给和儿童发展的影响

10.3386/w35650.abstract: American colleges and universities are highly stratified by pre-college academic achievement, family background, and institutional resources. We study the meritocratic consensus in American higher education: colleges that high-testing students (who are generally also from high-income families) attend spend dramatically more on instruction than do those that enroll lower-testing students. Stratification by test scores has been largely stable since the 1960s, but the stratification of instructional resources has risen sharply since 1970 at both private and public institutions. Non-academic admissions criteria like athletics, legacy, and affirmative action are second-order in determining the allocation of students to universities. Potential economic justifications for the positive association of instructional expenditures with student prior achievement—q-complementarity between achievement and resources, convex social returns to high human capital, and incentives to invest in learning prior to college—have little empirical support. Resource stratification across universities has not increased in the past decade, largely due to increased public funding of universities that enroll lower-testing students through financial aid programs like California's CalGrant, but stratification within institutions is now rising swiftly.
10.3386/w35650.abstract_zh: 美国高校在入学前的学业成就、家庭背景及院校资源方面高度分层。我们研究了美国高等教育中的精英主义共识：高分学生（通常也来自高收入家庭）所就读的大学在教学上的支出远高于录取低分学生的院校。自1960年代以来，按考试成绩的分层大体保持稳定，但自1970年以来，私立和公立院校中教学资源的分层急剧加剧。非学术录取标准，如体育特长、校友子女偏好及平权行动，在学生分配到大学的过程中属于次要因素。教学支出与学生先前成就正相关的潜在经济理由——成就与资源之间的q互补性、高人力资本的社会回报凸性以及大学前学习投资的激励——缺乏实证支持。过去十年间，大学间的资源分层并未加剧，这主要归因于通过如加利福尼亚州的CalGrant等财政援助项目，增加了对录取低分学生大学的公共资助，但院校内部的分层如今正在迅速上升。
10.3386/w35650.title: The Meritocratic Consensus and Stratification in Higher Education
10.3386/w35650.title_zh: 精英共识与高等教育分层

10.3386/w35651.abstract: Fertility has fallen in nearly all high-income countries. People also report wanting fewer children: between 2012 and 2022 the ideal number of children fell from 2.42 to 2.31 and the share of respondents intending a child within three years fell from 28 to 21 percent over a similar period. Why? Using two cross-national surveys that ask respondents about their attitudes and their fertility preferences, both fielded twice roughly a decade apart, we decompose each decline into the contribution of a broad and competing set of attitudes. Three stand out: children are increasingly seen as interfering with the freedom of parents; views on whether mothers of young children should work have become markedly more progressive and account for a substantially larger share of the decline among the tertiary-educated; and fewer people believe that women or men need children to lead a fulfilled life. This last attitude changed most over the decade and is the largest contributor to the fall in intended fertility, above all among less-educated women. The changing division of household work and increasing work-family conflict have minor contributions to changing fertility preferences.
10.3386/w35651.abstract_zh: 几乎所有高收入国家的生育率均有所下降。人们也报告称希望生育更少的孩子：在2012年至2022年间，理想子女数从2.42降至2.31，而在相近时期内，表示三年内有意生育孩子的受访者比例从28%降至21%。原因何在？利用两项跨国调查，这些调查询问受访者的态度及生育偏好，且每项调查均相隔约十年进行两次，我们将每次下降分解为一系列广泛且相互竞争的态度所贡献的部分。其中三项态度尤为突出：孩子日益被视为妨碍父母自由的因素；对于年幼孩子的母亲是否应工作的看法已显著变得更加进步，并在高等教育程度群体中占据了下降份额的更大比例；以及越来越少的人认为女性或男性需要孩子才能过上充实的生活。最后一种态度在十年间变化最大，并且是导致预期生育率下降的最大贡献因素，尤其是在教育程度较低的女性中。家务分工的变化及工作与家庭冲突的加剧对生育偏好变化的影响较小。
10.3386/w35651.title: Falling Fertility: The Changing Value of Freedom, Fulfillment, and Family
10.3386/w35651.title_zh: 生育率下降：自由、自我实现与家庭价值的变迁

10.3386/w35652.abstract: We develop a general-equilibrium model of the global economy that integrates heterogeneous firms competing in product markets with countries that allocate capital around the world. Combining a hedonic demand system on the product side with a mean-variance portfolio system on the asset side, we obtain almost closed-form solutions for the equilibrium of the model. We use firm-level data on balance sheets, geographic breakdowns of revenue and employment, and business descriptions along with country-level data on bilateral equity holdings and trade costs to quantify the model to a cross section of roughly 23,000 listed firms in 48 countries. We use the model to evaluate the reallocation and welfare effects of globalization. Both financial and trade liberalization concentrate activity among the largest firms and raise welfare, with gains being larger in emerging and mid-sized open economies respectively. Product- and capital-market frictions amplify each other, meaning that liberalizing one market reduces the gains from liberalizing the other.
10.3386/w35652.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个全球经济的总体均衡模型，该模型将产品市场中竞争的异质性企业与在全球范围内配置资本的国家相结合。通过将产品侧的享乐需求系统与资产侧的均值-方差投资组合系统相结合，我们得到了模型均衡的近似闭式解。我们利用企业层面的资产负债表数据、收入和就业的地理分布数据以及业务描述，结合国家层面的双边股权持有和贸易成本数据，将模型量化应用于48个国家约23,000家上市公司的横截面数据。我们运用该模型评估全球化带来的重新配置和福利效应。金融和贸易自由化均将活动集中于规模最大的企业并提升福利，其中新兴经济体和中型开放经济体分别获得更大的收益。产品市场和资本市场的摩擦相互放大，这意味着对其中一个市场的自由化会减少另一个市场自由化的收益。
10.3386/w35652.title: A Model of Global Firms and Capital Markets
10.3386/w35652.title_zh: 全球企业与资本市场模型

10.3386/w35653.abstract: We introduce the notion of marginal cumulative multiplier — the effect of either government spending or taxation on output holding the other fiscal instrument constant — and apply it to a well known panel of consolidation episodes in 16 countries in the period 1978-2020. In our benchmark specification we estimate a marginal spending multiplier at two years of 1.5 and a marginal tax multiplier close to 0. We also estimate similar multipliers by applying the policy counterfactual method of McKay and Wolf (2023). In an extensive robustness analysis we never find spending multipliers below 1.3 or tax multipliers higher than -1. These findings are seemingly in contrast to those of much of the existing literature on fiscal multipliers, which typically finds higher tax than spending multipliers. We show that this contradiction disappears once the fiscal variables used in the literature are scaled by the proper factor.
10.3386/w35653.abstract_zh: 我们引入了边际累积乘数的概念——即在保持另一财政工具不变的情况下，政府支出或税收对产出的影响——并将其应用于一个涵盖1978年至2020年间16个国家财政整顿事件的知名面板数据集。在我们的基准设定中，估计两年期的边际支出乘数为1.5，而边际税收乘数接近于0。我们还通过应用McKay和Wolf（2023）的政策反事实方法估计了类似的乘数。在广泛的稳健性分析中，我们从未发现支出乘数低于1.3或税收乘数高于-1的情况。这些发现似乎与现有财政乘数文献中的多数结论相悖，后者通常发现税收乘数高于支出乘数。我们表明，一旦文献中使用的财政变量按适当因子进行缩放，这一矛盾便消失。
10.3386/w35653.title: To Tax or To Ax? Marginal Tax and Spending Multipliers in Consolidations
10.3386/w35653.title_zh: 征税还是削减？财政整顿中的边际税收与支出乘数

10.3386/w35654.abstract: The green energy transition will be powered by the mining and processing of lithium, nickel, and cobalt, which are critical for the production of advanced batteries. These minerals are concentrated geographically but traded globally, allowing key mining countries to exercise market power through policy intervention. Advanced batteries use multiple minerals in combination, and this joint use creates interdependence across mineral markets. We study the geopolitical implications of these forces and their consequences for green technology adoption worldwide. We quantify supply chain vulnerability, international policy spillovers, and the potential for mineral cartels.
10.3386/w35654.abstract_zh: 绿色能源转型将由锂、镍和钴的开采与加工驱动，这些矿物对先进电池的生产至关重要。这些矿物在地理上集中分布，但全球范围内交易，使得主要采矿国能够通过政策干预行使市场力量。先进电池组合使用多种矿物，这种联合使用在矿物市场间形成了相互依存关系。我们研究这些力量的地缘政治影响及其对全球绿色技术采纳的后果。我们量化供应链脆弱性、国际政策溢出效应以及矿物卡特尔的可能性。
10.3386/w35654.title: Critical Minerals, Geopolitics, and the Green Transition
10.3386/w35654.title_zh: 关键矿产、地缘政治与绿色转型

10.3386/w35655.abstract: The 2016 Panama Papers leak tightened regulatory enforcement around money laundering and offshore banking. We investigate whether the diversion of foreign aid in developing countries led to a shift to cryptocurrency as an alternative laundering platform. We develop a disbursement-timed forensic measure of cryptocurrency activity, combining on-chain Bitcoin transactions and wallet creation, off-chain exchange records, and IP-linked web traffic, and apply it to World Bank aid disbursements covering $238 billion across the 93 recipient countries in our estimation sample during 2018-2024. Exploiting the administrative timing of aid tranche arrivals, we find sharp, short-lived surges of crypto activity at the disbursement month, driven mainly by anonymous and newly created wallets on both tax-haven and mainstream exchanges. Blockchain forensics reveal patterns consistent with the placement, layering, and integration sequence of conventional money laundering. We estimate an implied leakage of 2 to 6 cents per aid dollar, which amounts to roughly 1.7 to 4.4 billion dollars of aid diversion across the tranche arrivals we study. Capture carries no funding penalty: the four sectors where we detect it, Transport, Water and Sanitation, Social Protection, and Governance, still absorb half of subsequent World Bank funding. Cryptocurrency facilitates aid diversion, but its transparent ledgers also leave forensic traces that may help detect and recover diverted funds.
10.3386/w35655.abstract_zh: 2016年巴拿马文件泄露事件加强了围绕洗钱和离岸银行业务的监管执法。我们研究发展中国家对外援助的转移是否导致了向加密货币作为替代洗钱平台的转变。我们开发了一种基于支付时间点的法证测量方法，结合链上比特币交易和钱包创建、链下交易所记录以及IP关联的网络流量，并将其应用于世界银行2018-2024年间覆盖我们估计样本中93个受援国、总额达2380亿美元的援助支付。利用援助款项分批到账的行政时间安排，我们发现援助支付当月加密货币活动出现急剧且短暂的激增，主要由匿名和新创建的钱包在避税天堂和主流交易所驱动。区块链取证揭示了与传统洗钱中的放置、分层和整合阶段相一致的模式。我们估计每援助美元隐含泄漏2至6美分，在我们研究的款项到账事件中，相当于约17亿至44亿美元的援助转移。被捕获的转移行为不带来资金惩罚：我们检测到转移的四个部门——交通、供水和卫生、社会保护以及治理——仍然吸收了世界银行后续资金的一半。加密货币便利了援助转移，但其透明账本也留下了可能有助于检测和追回被转移资金的取证痕迹。
10.3386/w35655.title: Crypto Capture of Foreign Aid
10.3386/w35655.title_zh: 加密货币对外国援助的俘获

10.3386/w35656.abstract: What gave rise to the mosaic of cultural expressions across the globe? Why are some societies more culturally diverse than others? This study develops a unified theory of cultural evolution, characterizing the forces that have governed this process over the course of human existence. The research advances the hypothesis that population movements and socioeconomic transformations generated a mismatch between inherited cultural traits and prevailing ecological and societal conditions, setting in motion an evolutionary process governed by adaptation-based vertical transmission, horizontal diffusion, and fitness-based evolutionary selection. The theory generates novel testable predictions concerning the origins of the global cultural mosaic and the cross-societal variation in cultural diversity. First, greater ecological distance between ancestral environments generated greater cultural distance across societies. Second, prehistoric differences in ancestral diversity contributed to divergent adaptive capacity and greater cultural distance. Third, societies descended from more diverse prehistoric populations exhibit greater cultural diversity despite convergence induced by adaptation to a common environment and societal norms. Drawing on measures of cultural distance and diversity derived from folkloric and musical traditions among ethnic groups, visual representations of common concepts, and the dispersion of norms, values, and attitudes, the empirical analysis lends credence to the predictions of the theory.
10.3386/w35656.abstract_zh: 是什么造就了全球文化表现形式的马赛克式多样性？为何某些社会的文化多样性程度高于其他社会？本研究构建了一个统一的文化演化理论，刻画了在人类历史进程中主导这一过程的种种力量。研究提出假设，认为人口迁移与社会经济转型导致了遗传下来的文化特质与当时生态及社会条件之间的错配，从而启动了一个由基于适应的垂直传递、水平扩散及基于适应性的进化选择所支配的演化过程。该理论就全球文化马赛克的起源及跨社会文化多样性差异提出了新颖的可检验预测。首先，祖先环境间更大的生态距离导致了跨社会间更大的文化距离。其次，史前祖先多样性的差异促成了不同的适应能力及更大的文化距离。第三，尽管因适应共同环境和社会规范而出现趋同，源自更大多样性史前人口的社会仍展现出更大的文化多样性。基于从族群间的民俗与音乐传统、共同概念的视觉表征以及规范、价值观和态度的分布中提取的文化距离与多样性度量，实证分析为理论的预测提供了支持。
10.3386/w35656.title: Cultural Evolution

10.3386/w35657.abstract: In recent decades, economists studying international trade have gained access to an unprecedented volume and variety of data. These data have provided new insights and a more granular understanding of the mechanics of trade. Analyzing a large corpus of papers, we document that the nature of research has also shifted. Previously, the typical trade paper was either purely theoretical or an empirical paper testing theoretical predictions. More recently, scholarship has shifted toward a more integrated approach, particularly quantitative modeling. This development is surprising. We might have expected the data revolution (and contemporaneous credibility revolution) to increase the share of primarily empirical papers—although the markers of these revolutions are clearly evident in the rise of causal inference within empirical work. This article reviews these developments, assessing the strengths and limitations of different modes of inquiry, and plotting a path forward to harness the growing richness of data within the field.
10.3386/w35657.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，研究国际贸易的经济学家得以接触到前所未有的海量且多样化的数据。这些数据为理解贸易机制提供了新的洞见和更为精细的视角。通过分析大量论文，我们发现研究性质也发生了转变。以往，典型的贸易论文要么是纯理论性的，要么是检验理论预测的实证研究。而近年来，学术研究趋向于更加综合的方法，尤其是定量建模。这一发展出乎意料。我们或许会预期数据革命（以及同时期的可信度革命）会增加以实证为主的论文比例——尽管这些革命的标志在实证研究中因果推断的兴起中显而易见。本文回顾了这些发展，评估了不同研究模式的优势与局限，并规划了在该领域内利用日益丰富数据的未来路径。
10.3386/w35657.title: The Data Revolution, and Its Uses, in International Trade
10.3386/w35657.title_zh: 数据革命及其在国际贸易中的应用

10.3386/w35658.abstract: Ordinal mechanisms use rankings but not preference intensities. Cardinal mechanisms also elicit school utilities, allowing them to use students’ preferences over assignment lotteries. We compare probabilistic serial with four cardinal mechanisms that maximize the same welfare objective under successively stronger restrictions: capacity-only, ε-envy-free, envy-free, and a welfare-maximizing cardinal-preference pseudomarket. Because the feasible sets are nested, maximum welfare weakly falls as the restrictions tighten from capacity alone to approximate no-envy, exact no-envy, and equal budgets with common prices. We establish positive and negative results on large-market truthtelling. All 44 theorem parts in the paper are machine-checked in the Lean 4 proof assistant. We develop methods for computing cardinal-preference pseudomarket equilibria for Seattle’s 898 students and 11 schools. Using set-identified cardinal preferences from Seattle high-school choice data, we estimate that, under exact capacity, capacity-only raises mean welfare over probabilistic serial by 0.053, equivalent to shifting 5.3 percentage points of assignment probability from the average student’s worst school to the top school. Exact envy-freeness retains 79% of this gain; best-found pseudomarket equilibria yield a mean gain of 0.002. The estimates show both the value of cardinal information and the welfare cost of pseudomarket fairness restrictions.
10.3386/w35658.abstract_zh: 序数机制使用排名但不使用偏好强度。基数机制还引出学校效用，从而能够利用学生对分配抽签的偏好。我们将概率序列与四种基数机制进行比较，这些机制在依次增强的限制条件下最大化相同的福利目标：仅容量限制、ε-无嫉妒、无嫉妒，以及福利最大化的基数偏好伪市场。由于可行集是嵌套的，随着限制从仅容量到近似无嫉妒、精确无嫉妒以及具有共同价格的均等预算逐步收紧，最大福利呈弱下降趋势。我们在大市场诚实报告方面建立了正反两方面的结果。论文中所有44个定理部分均在Lean 4证明助手中进行了机器验证。我们开发了计算西雅图898名学生和11所学校基数偏好伪市场均衡的方法。利用西雅图高中选择数据中集合识别的基数偏好，我们估计，在精确容量下，仅容量限制相对于概率序列将平均福利提高了0.053，相当于将平均学生从最差学校到顶尖学校的分配概率转移了5.3个百分点。精确无嫉妒保留了这一增益的79%；最佳发现的伪市场均衡产生的平均增益为0.002。这些估计既显示了基数信息的价值，也揭示了伪市场公平限制的福利成本。
10.3386/w35658.title: Measuring the Welfare Gains from Cardinal-Preference Mechanisms in School Choice
10.3386/w35658.title_zh: 衡量学校选择中基数偏好机制的福利收益

10.3386/w35659.abstract: As of July 2026, 23 states had approved policies that disallow spending of SNAP benefits on sugary drinks. The effects of such restrictions on consumption are unclear, however, since most households can simply switch to buying sugary drinks with non-SNAP funds. Using a difference-in- differences design with nationwide grocery purchase panel data, we estimate that restrictions in the first 10 states reduced the average SNAP household’s retail purchases of excluded drinks by 12.4 percent (standard error = 1.0) over the first half of 2026. In states that excluded only some sugary drinks, SNAP households partially substituted to non-excluded drinks. Surveys we carried out before and after implementation show that the restrictions increased SNAP recipients’ perceptions of stigma. We combine our estimated consumption reductions with external parameters to model welfare effects given an over-consumption internality and a fiscal externality via public health care spending. In our model, excluding all sugary drinks from SNAP nationwide would provide benefits of about $1.1 billion per year, of which about 70 percent is from reduced health care costs.
10.3386/w35659.abstract_zh: 截至2026年7月，已有23个州批准了禁止使用SNAP福利购买含糖饮料的政策。然而，此类限制对消费的影响尚不明确，因为大多数家庭可以简单地改用非SNAP资金购买含糖饮料。利用全国杂货购买面板数据，采用双重差分设计，我们估计前10个州的限制措施使平均SNAP家庭在2026年上半年对排除饮品的零售购买量减少了12.4%（标准误=1.0）。在仅排除部分含糖饮料的州，SNAP家庭部分转向了未被排除的饮品。我们在实施前后进行的调查显示，这些限制增加了SNAP受助者对污名化的感知。我们将估算的消费减少量与外部参数相结合，在过度消费内部性和通过公共卫生保健支出的财政外部性框架下，对福利效应进行建模。在我们的模型中，全国范围内将SNAP中所有含糖饮料排除在外，每年可带来约11亿美元的收益，其中约70%来自医疗保健成本的降低。
10.3386/w35659.title: The Effects of SNAP Sugary Drink Restrictions on Consumption and Welfare
10.3386/w35659.title_zh: SNAP含糖饮料限制对消费与福利的影响

10.3386/w35660.abstract: We study the supply of political communication highlighting perceived threats, using the 2014 Ebola scare as a natural experiment. Analyzing Twitter posts and congressional newsletters from US House and Senate candidates, we find Republicans increased Ebola-related communication, emphasizing negative sentiment and links to immigration. This response was strongest in safe Republican seats, consistent with base signaling. The supply side was active, not reactive: the Republican response did not vary with proximity to diagnosed cases despite concentrated voter anxiety, politician tweets predicted public Ebola activity but not vice-versa, and more intensive messaging correlated with better electoral outcomes, controlling for local conditions.
10.3386/w35660.abstract_zh: 我们以2014年埃博拉恐慌作为自然实验，研究强调感知威胁的政治沟通供给。通过分析美国众议院和参议院候选人的推特帖子及国会通讯，我们发现共和党人增加了与埃博拉相关的沟通，强调负面情绪并将其与移民问题相联系。这一反应在共和党安全席位中最为强烈，与基础选民信号传递一致。供给方是主动而非被动的：共和党的反应并未因与确诊病例的距离而变化，尽管选民焦虑集中；政治人物的推文预测了公众埃博拉活动，但反之不然；且在控制地方条件后，更密集的信息传递与更好的选举结果相关。
10.3386/w35660.title: Fear as a Campaign Tool: Evidence from the 2014 U.S. Ebola Scare
10.3386/w35660.title_zh: 恐惧作为竞选工具：来自2014年美国埃博拉恐慌的证据

10.3386/w35661.abstract: This paper studies the joint behavior over time of the mean and dispersion of U.S. import tariff rates across goods at the HTS 6-digit level, as well as the macroeconomic consequences of the shocks that drive these two moments. We document that the cross-sectional mean and the cross-sectional dispersion of import tariffs move closely together over time. Using a state-space model, we find that both are driven primarily by common shocks, while mean- and dispersion-specific tariff shocks play a negligible role. Thus, effectively, there are no separate mean-tariff shocks or tariff-dispersion shocks; there are only mean-dispersion tariff shocks. These common shocks account for a sizable share of movements in imports and the trade balance but only a small fraction of movements in output. A positive transitory mean-dispersion tariff shock reduces the import-to-output ratio and improves the trade-balance-to-output ratio; a positive permanent mean-dispersion tariff shock also reduces the import-to-output ratio but has a muted effect on the trade-balance-to-output ratio. Positive transitory mean-dispersion tariff shocks are expansionary, whereas positive permanent mean-dispersion tariff shocks are contractionary in the short run and expansionary in the medium run.
10.3386/w35661.abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国进口关税税率在HTS六位数商品层面的均值与离散度随时间变化的联合行为，以及驱动这两个矩的冲击所产生的宏观经济后果。我们记录了进口关税的截面均值与截面离散度随时间紧密同步变动的现象。利用状态空间模型，我们发现两者主要由共同冲击驱动，而均值特定和离散度特定的关税冲击作用甚微。因此，实际上不存在独立的均值关税冲击或离散度关税冲击，仅存在均值-离散度关税冲击。这些共同冲击对进口和贸易余额的变动贡献显著，但对产出的变动影响甚小。正向的暂时性均值-离散度关税冲击降低了进口对产出之比，并改善了贸易余额对产出之比；正向的永久性均值-离散度关税冲击同样降低了进口对产出之比，但对贸易余额对产出之比的影响较为温和。正向的暂时性均值-离散度关税冲击具有扩张效应，而正向的永久性均值-离散度关税冲击在短期内具有收缩效应，在中期则呈现扩张效应。
10.3386/w35661.title: Tariff-Dispersion Shocks: The Mean is the Variance
10.3386/w35661.title_zh: 关税离散冲击：均值即方差

10.3386/w35662.abstract: One of the most comprehensive fiscal policies to improve diet was adopted by the Navajo Nation; the Healthy Diné Nation Act (HDNA) of 2014-15 consists of two parts: 1) an exemption from sales tax for healthy foods and beverages; and 2) a tax increase on unhealthy foods and beverages. Together, they create a price wedge of 7-8% between healthy and unhealthy foods. We estimate difference-in-difference models and event studies that estimate the effect of the HDNA on a variety of health conditions relating to diet and weight for newborns and mothers which are recorded in birth certificate data. We find no evidence that the HDNA improved these outcomes; our estimates are precise enough to rule out improvements in gestational diabetes as large as those reported for U.S. city SSB taxes. Possible explanations for the null results include incomplete retailer implementation and cross-border shopping.
10.3386/w35662.abstract_zh: 纳瓦霍族实施了最全面的改善饮食的财政政策之一；2014-15年度的《健康迪内民族法案》（HDNA）包含两部分：1）对健康食品和饮料免征销售税；2）对不健康食品和饮料增税。两者共同在健康与不健康食品之间形成了7%-8%的价格差。我们采用双重差分模型和事件研究法，估计HDNA对出生证明数据中记录的新生儿及母亲与饮食和体重相关的多种健康状况的影响。我们未发现HDNA改善这些结果的证据；我们的估计精确到足以排除妊娠期糖尿病改善幅度达到美国城市含糖饮料税所报告水平的可能性。无效结果的可能解释包括零售商执行不完整和跨境购物。
10.3386/w35662.title: The Impact of Fiscal Policy to Promote Healthy Diets: Evidence from the Navajo Nation
10.3386/w35662.title_zh: 促进健康饮食的财政政策影响：来自纳瓦霍族的证据

10.3386/w35663.abstract: Most LLM benchmarks rank models on their ability to automate work tasks. In practice, however, models are often used to assist other (human or LLM) agents. The question that drives model selection is therefore not only which model produces the best output, but which model most improves the work of another (weaker) agent. We introduce a unified framework that evaluates the capability of models to automate and augment another agent's performance. Across seven economically grounded real-world tasks, an assistant model writes assistance text for a standardized lower-capacity worker model, which produces the deliverable. In automation mode, the assistant produces the output directly. Outputs are scored through blind pairwise comparisons by an LLM judge panel with task-specific rubrics, replicated across ten runs. Rankings across the two regimes are only modestly correlated, and the automation winner loses augmentation on five of seven tasks. Assistance is not reliably positive. The unaided worker outranks every assisted condition on three tasks, and only one model's guidance beats no guidance on average. These results suggest that automation ability is an incomplete proxy for assistance quality, motivating benchmarks that evaluate models according to the roles they play in human-AI and multi-agent systems.
10.3386/w35663.abstract_zh: 大多数LLM基准测试根据模型自动化工作任务的能力对其进行排名。然而，在实践中，模型常被用来辅助其他（人类或LLM）代理。因此，驱动模型选择的问题不仅在于哪个模型能产出最佳结果，还在于哪个模型最能提升另一个（较弱的）代理的工作表现。我们引入了一个统一框架，用于评估模型自动化及增强另一代理表现的能力。在七个基于经济学的现实任务中，一个辅助模型为标准化低能力工人模型撰写辅助文本，后者负责产出最终成果。在自动化模式下，辅助模型直接生成输出。输出通过具有任务特定评分标准的LLM评审团进行盲法配对比较，并在十次运行中重复验证。两种模式下的排名仅呈适度相关性，自动化胜出者在七个任务中有五个在增强模式下失利。辅助并非总是正面的。在三个任务中，未受辅助的工人模型排名高于所有受辅助条件，且仅有一个模型的指导在平均情况下优于无指导。这些结果表明，自动化能力仅是辅助质量的非完全代理，这促使基准测试应根据模型在人类-AI及多代理系统中所扮演的角色来评估它们。
10.3386/w35663.title: CentaurBench: Benchmarking LLM Capabilities on Augmenting vs. Automating Real-World Work Tasks
10.3386/w35663.title_zh: 半人马基准：评估大语言模型在增强与自动化现实工作任务中的能力

10.3386/w35664.abstract: We document an increase in U.S. income risk from 1969 to 2019 using newly digitized IRS tax returns, distinguishing permanent from transitory risk. Since the 1970s, permanent income risk increased across the distribution, but most sharply among high earners, rising nearly 70% among the top 5%. We show that, even among top earners, large negative income shocks strongly predict financial distress and higher income risk is linked with higher savings. In a quantitative life-cycle model, rising income risk concentrated at the top lowers the risk-free rate by 0.7pp, increases wealth inequality, and contributes to the "savings glut of the rich."
10.3386/w35664.abstract_zh: 我们利用新近数字化的美国国税局纳税申报数据，记录了1969年至2019年间美国收入风险的上升情况，并区分了永久性与暂时性风险。自1970年代以来，永久性收入风险在各收入阶层中均有所增加，但在高收入群体中尤为显著，其中前5%人群的风险上升了近70%。我们表明，即使在最高收入者中，大规模负面收入冲击也能强烈预测财务困境，且更高的收入风险与更高的储蓄相关联。在一个定量生命周期模型中，集中于顶层的收入风险上升使无风险利率降低了0.7个百分点，加剧了财富不平等，并促成了“富人储蓄过剩”现象。
10.3386/w35664.title: Rising Income Risk at the Top

10.3386/w35665.abstract: We study how opening private markets to retail investors affects investors and firms. Calibrating a production-based asset-pricing model, we find that democratization raises retail investors' welfare, but barely. Retail investors benefit little from democratization even if they face no extra cost or other disadvantage relative to institutional investors. The private market is simply too small for improved risk sharing to matter much. Whether or not private-market retail investing is costly, democratization substantially reshapes private firms' ownership and materially reduces their cost of capital, leading them to grow. Private equity earns a positive CAPM alpha, which shrinks after democratization.
10.3386/w35665.abstract_zh: 我们研究了向散户投资者开放私募市场对投资者和企业的影响。通过校准一个基于生产的资产定价模型，我们发现民主化提升了散户投资者的福利，但效果甚微。即便散户投资者相对于机构投资者不承担额外成本或其他劣势，他们从民主化中获得的收益依然有限。私募市场规模过小，以至于改善风险分担所带来的影响微不足道。无论散户投资私募市场是否有成本，民主化都显著重塑了私营企业的所有权结构，并实质性降低了其资本成本，从而促进其增长。私募股权获得正的CAPM阿尔法，该值在民主化后有所缩减。
10.3386/w35665.title: Democratizing Private Markets: Equilibrium Predictions
10.3386/w35665.title_zh: 私有市场民主化：均衡预测

10.3386/w35666.abstract: Health technology assessment bodies and policymakers have grappled with the issue of whose preferences – the general healthy population or the patient population – should be incorporated into traditional cost-effectiveness analysis. This debate arises because healthy individuals and patients often value the same health state differently, and cost-effectiveness will undervalue health-related quality of life (HRQoL) for individuals with chronic illness or disability because it cannot account for adaptation. Prospect theory (PT) provides a framework that permits adaptation since it assumes individuals evaluate outcomes relative to a reference point. We estimate utility over HRQoL in a PT framework in a nationally representative U.S. population and compare directly with utility estimates in an EU framework from the same population. Consistent with previous studies in the monetary and health domains, we find evidence of probability weighting bias and loss aversion over health. Using the PT utility estimates, we demonstrate how PT can be incorporated into healthcare value assessment and present the resulting implications for medical decision making.
10.3386/w35666.abstract_zh: 卫生技术评估机构与政策制定者一直面临一个难题：在传统成本-效果分析中，应纳入谁的偏好——一般健康人群还是患者人群？这一争论源于健康个体与患者往往对同一健康状态赋予不同价值，且成本-效果分析无法解释适应性，因而会低估慢性疾病或残疾患者的健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）。前景理论（PT）提供了一个允许适应性存在的框架，因为它假设个体相对于参考点来评估结果。我们在具有全国代表性的美国人群中，基于前景理论框架估计了HRQoL效用，并将其与同一人群在欧盟框架下的效用估计直接进行比较。与先前在货币和健康领域的研究一致，我们发现概率加权偏差和健康损失厌恶的证据。利用前景理论效用估计，我们展示了如何将前景理论纳入医疗价值评估，并呈现其对医疗决策的启示。
10.3386/w35666.title: Making Everyone’s Preferences Count: A Prospect Theory Approach to Valuing Health Improvements
10.3386/w35666.title_zh: 让每个人的偏好都算数：前景理论视角下的健康改善价值评估

10.3386/w35667.abstract: Official lending is large, senior, and countercyclical, continuing after sovereigns fall into arrears on private debt. We ask why sovereign finance exhibits this division of labor across creditors. In a production economy where a risk-averse sovereign privately allocates imported inputs, commitment is limited on both sides, and monitoring generates a noisy signal, the constrained-optimal allocation is decentralized by defaultable private debt, senior non-defaultable multilateral debt, and concessional bilateral debt whose relief is tied to the signal. Production remains distorted, but the sovereign is never excluded: official lending is monitored liquidity provision. A calibration reproduces procyclical private and countercyclical official debt.
10.3386/w35667.abstract_zh: 官方贷款规模庞大、优先且逆周期，在主权国家拖欠私人债务后仍持续提供。我们探究为何主权融资在债权人之间呈现这种分工。在一个风险规避型主权国家私下分配进口投入品的生产经济中，双方承诺均受限，监督产生噪声信号，受约束的最优配置通过可违约的私人债务、优先的不可违约多边债务以及与信号挂钩的减让性双边债务实现分散化。生产仍存在扭曲，但主权国家从未被排除在外：官方贷款是受监督的流动性提供。校准结果再现了顺周期的私人债务与逆周期的官方债务。
10.3386/w35667.title: A Theory of International Official Lending

10.3386/w35668.abstract: Unemployment rates are substantially higher and more volatile in the euro area relative to the United States. We ask to what extent the lack of cross-country labor mobility can account for unemployment dynamics in Europe. Our analytical model incorporates downward nominal wage rigidity and an endogenous migration decision. Firms are unable to freely adjust wages during economic contractions, generating an asymmetric distribution of unemployment over the business cycle. The model is calibrated to the dynamics of unemployment and net migration in a typical euro area country. An increase in labor mobility to that observed in the United States and holding all other parameters fixed would reduce the volatility of euro area unemployment by 28% and return over 1,000,000 unemployed to the workforce. The welfare cost to a typical euro area country of the currency union is 4.1 percent of permanent consumption; increasing labor mobility reduces this cost to about 3.55 percent.
10.3386/w35668.abstract_zh: 欧元区的失业率相对于美国显著更高且波动性更大。我们探讨了跨国劳动力流动性不足在多大程度上可以解释欧洲的失业动态。我们的分析模型融入了名义工资下行刚性和内生迁移决策。在经济收缩期间，企业无法自由调整工资，导致失业在商业周期中呈现不对称分布。该模型针对典型欧元区国家的失业和净迁移动态进行了校准。若将劳动力流动性提升至美国水平，并保持所有其他参数不变，欧元区失业率的波动性将降低28%，并使超过100万失业者重返劳动力市场。货币联盟对典型欧元区国家的福利成本相当于永久消费的4.1%；提高劳动力流动性可将这一成本降至约3.55%。
10.3386/w35668.title: Labor Mobility and the Level of Unemployment in a Currency Union
10.3386/w35668.title_zh: 货币联盟中的劳动力流动性与失业水平

10.3386/w35669.abstract: This paper investigates the determinants of international investors’ portfolio choices between gold and sovereign bonds in an environment shaped by economic and geopolitical shocks. We develop an endogenous portfolio choice model where reserve safety has a political dimension — sovereign bonds issued by the dominant reserve country are more liquid but exposed to the issuer’s sanctions authority, while gold offers sanctions protection at the cost of lower liquidity. Our model implies that US convenience yields fall during periods of high sanction risk, as safe-asset demand fragments along geopolitical lines. Empirically, periods of elevated geopolitical risk coincide with higher gold prices and 10-year Treasury yields. In such periods, the average composition of official reserves shifts toward gold, with countries less aligned with the US increasing their holdings to a greater extent.
10.3386/w35669.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在经济与地缘政治冲击交织的环境下，国际投资者在黄金与主权债券之间进行投资组合选择的决定因素。我们构建了一个内生投资组合选择模型，其中储备安全性具有政治维度——由主导储备货币国家发行的主权债券流动性更强，但面临发行国制裁权力的风险，而黄金则提供制裁保护，代价是流动性较低。我们的模型表明，在制裁风险高企时期，美国的便利收益率下降，因为安全资产需求沿地缘政治界限分化。实证上，地缘政治风险上升的时期与黄金价格及10年期国债收益率走高相吻合。在此类时期，官方储备的平均构成向黄金倾斜，且与美国立场不一致的国家增持黄金的幅度更大。
10.3386/w35669.title: Fool's Gold? How the USD lost its Shine
10.3386/w35669.title_zh: 愚人金？美元如何失去光泽

10.3386/w35670.abstract: Nearly the entire world's population breathes air exceeding WHO pollution guidelines, but the extent to which that exposure impairs the accumulation of human capital is not well understood. We study this using longitudinal PSAT data on nearly 10 million U.S. high school students, comparing the same student's scores across attempts preceded by differing air quality and instrumenting for local PM2.5 with smoke from distant wildfires. A year of observed pollution exposure reduces learning by 0.04-0.06 standard deviations, or 14-19% of typical annual score growth. The damage comes almost entirely from moderate pollution days (8–12 μg/m3), below the EPA's historical standard, and from exposure during the school year rather than summer, pointing to instructional disruption as a mechanism. Effects are three times larger in disadvantaged schools and among Black and Hispanic students, who are harmed more by the same exposure. Exposure to air pollution widens achievement gaps.
10.3386/w35670.abstract_zh: 全球几乎全部人口呼吸的空气都超过了世界卫生组织的污染指导值，但这种暴露在多大程度上损害了人力资本的积累尚不明确。我们利用近1000万名美国高中生的纵向PSAT数据对此进行研究，比较同一学生在不同空气质量条件下参加考试的成绩，并以远处野火产生的烟雾作为当地PM2.5的工具变量。一年的观测污染暴露使学习成果降低0.04至0.06个标准差，即典型年度成绩增长的14%至19%。这种损害几乎完全来自中度污染日（8–12 μg/m³），低于美国环保局的历史标准，且主要源于学年期间的暴露而非暑假，这表明教学中断是一个作用机制。在弱势学校以及黑人和西班牙裔学生中，影响效应高出三倍，他们对相同暴露受到的伤害更大。空气污染暴露加剧了成就差距。
10.3386/w35670.title: Air Pollution and Learning

10.3386/w35671.abstract: Private tutoring chains like Kumon and Sylvan have expanded rapidly in recent decades. Combining data on business locations, household spending, and district test scores, we study who uses these centers and how they affect academic skills. Nearly half of tutoring users are from the top income decile, with Asian and White households five and two times as likely to purchase tutoring as Black and Hispanic households. A staggered differences-in-differences design shows the opening of a district's first chain center raises district-wide math and reading scores by 0.02-0.03 standard deviations, at a much lower cost than public spending typically producing similar gains. Math effects are largest for White and Asian students, so that center entry widens racial achievement gaps, though less so in more racially integrated districts. These private investments help their users, deepen educational inequality, and shape outcomes by which state accountability systems and families judge schools.
10.3386/w35671.abstract_zh: 像Kumon和Sylvan这样的私人辅导连锁机构在近几十年迅速扩张。结合商业地点、家庭支出和学区考试成绩的数据，我们研究了谁在使用这些中心以及它们如何影响学业技能。近一半的辅导使用者来自收入最高的十分位群体，亚裔和白人家庭使用辅导服务的可能性分别是黑人和西班牙裔家庭的五倍和两倍。一项交错双重差分设计显示，某学区首家连锁中心的开设使全区数学和阅读成绩提高了0.02至0.03个标准差，其成本远低于通常产生类似效果的公共支出。数学成绩的提升对白人和亚裔学生最为显著，因此中心的进入扩大了种族间的学业成就差距，但在种族融合程度较高的学区中，这种差距扩大程度较小。这些私人投资惠及了其使用者，加深了教育不平等，并通过各州问责制度和家庭评价学校的方式塑造了教育结果。
10.3386/w35671.title: Kumon Up: Private Tutoring Centers and Student Achievement
10.3386/w35671.title_zh: 公文式辅导：私人补习中心与学生学业成绩

10.3386/w35672.abstract: Police in England and Wales are asked to predict the likelihood of serious recidivism in domestic abuse cases, with little support beyond a flawed questionnaire. To analyze their decisions, we first develop methods to deal with a censoring problem that arises because the officer’s prediction may change the outcome she was attempting to predict. Even after adjusting for censoring, we find predictive performance to be low, even lower in some cases than what one would expect by chance. We next ask whether their predictions represent mistakes, and provide several types of confirmatory evidence. We ask how officers formulate their predictions, and we find evidence consistent with representativeness bias, overreaction, and categorization and selective attention. We find that higher-skill officers use information not captured by the questionnaire to improve their predictions, whereas lower-skill officers use such information in ways that reduce accuracy.
10.3386/w35672.abstract_zh: 英格兰和威尔士的警察被要求预测家庭暴力案件中严重再犯的可能性，而他们除了一个存在缺陷的问卷外，几乎没有其他支持工具。为了分析他们的决策，我们首先开发了处理审查问题的方法，该问题源于警官的预测可能改变她试图预测的结果。即使在调整了审查之后，我们发现预测性能仍然较低，在某些情况下甚至低于随机预期。接下来，我们探讨这些预测是否代表错误，并提供多种类型的确认性证据。我们研究警官如何形成预测，并发现与代表性偏差、过度反应以及分类和选择性注意相一致的证据。我们发现，技能较高的警官利用问卷未涵盖的信息来改进预测，而技能较低的警官使用此类信息反而降低了准确性。
10.3386/w35672.title: Explaining the Predictive Performance of Police in Cases of Domestic Abuse
10.3386/w35672.title_zh: 解释警方在家庭虐待案件中的预测表现

10.3386/w35673.abstract: Post-pandemic inflation raised fears that U.S. monetary tightening would trigger a repeat of the 1982 sudden stop in capital flows to emerging economies. Yet as of 2026 no global recession has followed. We establish three stylized facts distinguishing the 1980s from the 2020s, beyond the shift to flexible exchange rates: monetary policy effectiveness, fiscal space, and external vulnerabilities. We rationalize them in a Mundell-Fleming framework with a fiscal space constraint, which predicts a central role for fiscal space in transmitting foreign currency risk-free rate increases. Cross-country evidence confirms that fiscal space shapes economic performance post-tightening.
10.3386/w35673.abstract_zh: 疫情后的通货膨胀引发了人们的担忧，即美国货币紧缩将重演1982年新兴经济体资本流入的突然停止。然而，截至2026年，全球并未出现衰退。我们确立了三个典型事实，用以区分1980年代与2020年代，除了转向浮动汇率制度之外：货币政策有效性、财政空间和外部脆弱性。我们在一个包含财政空间约束的蒙代尔-弗莱明框架中对其进行了合理化解释，该框架预测财政空间在传导外币无风险利率上升中扮演核心角色。跨国证据证实，财政空间塑造了紧缩后的经济表现。
10.3386/w35673.title: This Time Is (Mostly) Different: U.S. Tightening Cycles and Global Resilience in the 1980s vs 2020s
10.3386/w35673.title_zh: 这一次（大体上）不同：20世纪80年代与21世纪20年代美国紧缩周期与全球韧性之比较

10.3386/w35674.abstract: Amid renewed policy interest, the academic literature on place-based programs has expanded dramatically in recent years. In this essay, we review recent theoretical and empirical work in an effort to assess when and why place-based job creation policies succeed or fail. Drawing on theory, we describe key dimensions on which place-based programs vary and discuss evidence on the consequences of different design choices. We conclude with several lessons for the next generation of place-based programs.
10.3386/w35674.abstract_zh: 随着政策关注度的再度升温，近年来关于区域导向型项目的学术文献显著增加。本文旨在回顾近期理论与实证研究，以评估区域导向型就业创造政策在何种条件下及为何能成功或失败。基于理论，我们阐述了区域导向型项目在关键维度上的差异，并讨论了不同设计选择所带来的后果证据。最后，我们为下一代区域导向型项目总结了几点经验教训。
10.3386/w35674.title: Can We Build More Effective Place-Based Policies? Theory and Evidence
10.3386/w35674.title_zh: 我们能否制定更有效的地域导向政策？理论与证据

10.3386/w35675.abstract: The economic burden of natural disasters is shaped by who is exposed, who experiences losses, how those losses alter individual economic trajectories, and how affected communities evolve in the aftermath. We link property-level damage data from over 100 U.S. wildfires to administrative tax and Census data to understand individual-level relationships between disaster damage and economic outcomes. Residents of burned areas are wealthier than the U.S. population on average, but within these wildfire perimeters the likelihood that a home burns is negatively correlated with pre-fire income. Home destruction imposes costs beyond rebuilding the property: occupants of destroyed homes experience lower income for three years post-fire, producing cumulative income losses equal to 26 percent of pre-fire annual income. We do not detect income or employment effects for residents without direct property damage. Community recovery is slow and accompanied by changes in composition. Four years after a fire, half of destroyed addresses remain unoccupied and reoccupied addresses house residents with substantially higher incomes than before.
10.3386/w35675.abstract_zh: 自然灾害的经济负担取决于谁暴露于灾害、谁遭受损失、这些损失如何改变个人经济轨迹，以及受灾社区在灾后如何演变。我们将美国100多起野火的房产级损失数据与行政税务及人口普查数据相结合，以理解灾害损失与个人经济结果之间的关系。受灾区域的居民平均而言比美国总体人口更富裕，但在这些野火边界内，房屋被烧毁的可能性与火灾前收入呈负相关。房屋毁坏带来的成本远超重建房产本身：被毁房屋的居住者在火灾后三年内收入较低，累计收入损失相当于火灾前年收入的26%。对于未遭受直接财产损失的居民，我们未检测到收入或就业方面的影响。社区恢复缓慢，并伴随人口构成的变化。火灾四年后，一半被毁地址仍无人居住，而重新入住的地址所居住的居民收入显著高于灾前水平。
10.3386/w35675.title: The Distribution and Consequences of Natural Disasters: Evidence from U.S. Wildfire Victims
10.3386/w35675.title_zh: 自然灾害的分布与后果：来自美国野火受害者的证据

10.3386/w35676.abstract: We study how dominant employers can act as *electoral monopsonies*, using local labor market power to shape political preferences and electoral outcomes. We first present original survey evidence showing that workers at major local employers are more likely to experience employer political communication and to report that their employers influence their voting behavior and career expectations. We then develop a model in which a dominant employer can affect voters’ preferences by shaping their expectations about how wages and employment depend on electoral outcomes. We distinguish a passive channel, through which workers internalize firms’ economic interests, from an active channel, through which dominant employers strategically influence these expectations. Under the active channel, labor market power translates into political power and can generate political failures by inducing voters to oppose policies they would otherwise support. The model also shows how electoral monopsonies can contribute to political polarization, constrain political platforms, and substitute for campaign spending. Using U.S. individual-level voting data and a shift-share design based on national industry concentration shocks and predetermined local employment shares, we show that greater electoral monopsony power increases Republican voter turnout. Counterfactual estimates imply that reducing electoral monopsony power could have narrowly changed the outcomes of the 2016 and 2024 presidential elections.
10.3386/w35676.abstract_zh: 我们研究了主导雇主如何充当“选举性买方垄断者”，利用本地劳动力市场力量来塑造政治偏好和选举结果。我们首先呈现原始调查证据，表明大型本地雇主的工人更可能经历雇主的政治沟通，并报告其雇主影响他们的投票行为和职业期望。接着，我们构建了一个模型，在该模型中，主导雇主可以通过塑造工人对工资和就业如何取决于选举结果的预期来影响选民偏好。我们区分了被动渠道——工人内化企业的经济利益，与主动渠道——主导雇主战略性地影响这些预期。在主动渠道下，劳动力市场力量转化为政治力量，并可能通过诱导选民反对他们原本会支持的政策而导致政治失灵。该模型还展示了选举性买方垄断如何加剧政治极化、限制政治纲领，并替代竞选支出。利用美国个体层面的投票数据以及基于全国行业集中度冲击和预定地方就业份额的转移份额设计，我们证明更大的选举性买方垄断力量会增加共和党选民的投票率。反事实估计表明，减少选举性买方垄断力量可能以微弱优势改变2016年和2024年总统选举的结果。
10.3386/w35676.title: Firms as Electoral Monopsonies
10.3386/w35676.title_zh: 企业作为选举中的垄断买方

10.3386/w35677.abstract: We measure how workers use genAI for their jobs in a nationally representative survey linking genAI adoption to detailed occupations and tasks. Our data provide the first task-level genAI adoption indexes, which we show can inform analyses of genAI’s labor market impact. Exposure scores explain some, but far from all, of the variation in adoption across occupations and tasks. We also distinguish our indexes from measures based on genAI platform chat logs, which differ conceptually and tend to over-classify chats into generic activities spanning many occupations. Finally, we highlight that current adoption is widespread but shallow: genAI is used across many occupations and tasks, yet within most of them, fewer than half of workers adopt. This indicates substantial variation among workers doing very similar work, suggesting that understanding who adopts may matter as much as understanding which tasks genAI assists.
10.3386/w35677.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项全国代表性调查，衡量了工人在工作中如何使用生成式人工智能（genAI），并将genAI的采用与详细的职业和任务联系起来。我们的数据提供了首个任务层面的genAI采用指数，并证明这些指数能为分析genAI对劳动力市场的影响提供信息。暴露度评分解释了职业和任务间采用差异的一部分，但远非全部。我们还将我们的指数与基于genAI平台聊天记录的度量区分开来，后者在概念上有所不同，且倾向于将聊天过度归类为跨越众多职业的通用活动。最后，我们强调当前的采用虽广泛但浅层：genAI在许多职业和任务中均有使用，但在大多数情况下，采用者不足半数工人。这表明从事非常相似工作的工人之间存在显著差异，提示理解谁在采用genAI可能与理解genAI辅助哪些任务同等重要。
10.3386/w35677.title: What Work Does Generative AI Do?
10.3386/w35677.title_zh: 生成式人工智能做什么工作？

10.3386/w35678.abstract: With complete-information bilateral bargaining in network settings, holdup is eliminated when contracts across the network are agreed atomically (all or none) via a smart contract. Applications include over-the-counter asset trading, third-party-financed purchase agreements, and land assembly. Under a novel extensive-form bargaining protocol, a firm can give a “greenlight” to the terms of a contract proposed to that firm, and the protocol automatically converts those terms into a binding contract if the terms proposed to all other firms are likewise given greenlights. In any Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium with Markov strategies, firms immediately agree on socially efficient contracts.
10.3386/w35678.abstract_zh: 在完全信息双边谈判的网络环境中，当网络中的合同通过智能合约以原子方式（全有或全无）达成一致时，敲竹杠问题得以消除。应用场景包括场外资产交易、第三方融资的购买协议以及土地整合。在一种新颖的扩展形式谈判协议下，一家公司可以对向其提出的合同条款给予“绿灯”，若向所有其他公司提出的条款同样获得绿灯，则该协议自动将这些条款转化为具有约束力的合同。在任何采用马尔可夫策略的完美贝叶斯均衡中，各公司会立即就社会效率最优的合同达成一致。
10.3386/w35678.title: Smart Contracting in Network Markets
10.3386/w35678.title_zh: 网络市场中的智能合约

10.3386/w35679.abstract: Liquidity savings mechanisms (LSMs) reduce the quantity of reserve balances that banks need to process payments. An LSM can mitigate coordination failures in which banks delay their payments to each other because they expect that other banks will do the same. We provide the design and properties of a maximally efficient new form of LSM.
10.3386/w35679.abstract_zh: 流动性节约机制（LSMs）减少了银行处理支付所需的准备金余额数量。LSM能够缓解协调失灵问题，即银行因预期其他银行也会延迟支付而相互拖延付款。我们提供了一种效率最大化的新型LSM的设计及其特性。
10.3386/w35679.title: An Efficient Liquidity Savings Mechanism
10.3386/w35679.title_zh: 一种高效的流动性储蓄机制

10.3386/w35680.abstract: Surveys provide much of what we know in social science and are often the only source of information on private behaviors, attitudes and expectations. Strands of the literature document four broad error sources: survey coverage, unit non-response, item non-response, and measurement error. Yet the absence of comparable error measures across sources and over time has left the relative severity of error sources difficult to assess, limiting efforts by survey producers to improve accuracy and users to interpret survey statistics. We unify the fragmented literature by analyzing and decomposing survey error in an empirical Total Survey Error (TSE) framework, quantifying for the first time every error component on a common scale of bias and absolute error. We apply our approach to comprehensively measure survey error in eighteen income and program receipt variables from the CPS ASEC – one of the oldest and most rigorously tested surveys, and the official source of income and poverty statistics in the U.S. – using linked administrative records over more than two decades. For nearly half of the variables, bias exceeds 40 percent and eliminating all individual-level error would require changing more than 80 percent of the true total. Contrary to the conventional emphasis on non-response, we find that the dominant source of bias is measurement error among respondents who fail to report receipt (false negatives). The largest potential gains therefore come from improving the accuracy of respondent reporting rather than raising response rates. This underreporting also propagates into imputed values for non-respondents, which are drawn from (misreported) responses and are particularly noisy, with positive and negative errors that tend to offset in net terms. Moreover, net bias can be an incomplete guide to data quality, as we find that absolute error has tended to rise over time even when net bias is stable. Overall, our approach provides a new method for measuring and decomposing survey error, clarifying which sources of bias require user corrections and where survey design improvements could be most consequential.
10.3386/w35680.abstract_zh: 调查问卷提供了社会科学中我们所知的大部分内容，并且往往是关于私人行为、态度和期望的唯一信息来源。文献中的多个分支记录了四大类错误来源：调查覆盖范围、单位无回应、项目无回应以及测量误差。然而，由于缺乏跨来源和跨时间的可比误差度量，错误来源的相对严重性难以评估，限制了调查生产者提高准确性和使用者解读调查统计数据的努力。我们通过在一个实证总调查误差（TSE）框架中分析和分解调查误差，统一了分散的文献，首次以偏差和绝对误差的通用尺度量化了每一个误差组成部分。我们将此方法应用于全面测量来自CPS ASEC——这一历史最悠久、测试最严格的调查之一，也是美国官方收入与贫困统计来源——的十八个收入及项目领取变量中的调查误差，使用了超过二十年的关联行政记录。对于近一半的变量，偏差超过40%，而消除所有个体层面误差将需要改变超过80%的真实总量。与对无回应的传统强调相反，我们发现偏差的主要来源是未能报告领取（假阴性）的受访者中的测量误差。因此，最大的潜在改进来自于提高受访者报告的准确性，而非提高回应率。这种漏报也传播到无回应者的插补值中，这些值来源于（误报的）回应，且特别嘈杂，正负误差往往在净额上相互抵消。此外，净偏差可能不是数据质量的完整指南，因为我们发现即使净偏差稳定，绝对误差也往往随时间上升。总体而言，我们的方法提供了一种新的测量和分解调查误差的手段，阐明了哪些偏差来源需要使用者修正，以及调查设计改进可能在哪里产生最大影响。
10.3386/w35680.title: The Anatomy and Evolution of Survey Error
10.3386/w35680.title_zh: 调查误差的解剖与演变

10.3386/w35681.abstract: We derive four facts from experiments on the spillover effects of cash and in-kind transfer programs onto non-recipients: (1) average spillovers on consumption and asset value are negligible; (2) negative psychological spillovers emerge in the longer term among households randomly excluded from transfers by within-village lotteries; (3) these spillovers are concentrated in consumption-poor households; and (4) they do not appear when the selection of transfer recipients is eligibility-based. These findings are consistent with household preferences against within-village randomization of transfers, and point to additional benefits of cluster-level randomized designs over household-level ones.
10.3386/w35681.abstract_zh: 我们从关于现金与实物转移支付项目对非受益者溢出效应的实验中得出四个事实：（1）对消费和资产价值的平均溢出效应可忽略不计；（2）在村内抽签随机排除在转移支付之外的住户中，长期内出现了负面的心理溢出效应；（3）这些溢出效应集中在消费贫困家庭中；（4）当转移支付受益者的选择基于资格标准时，这些效应并未显现。这些发现与家庭对村内随机分配转移支付的偏好相悖，并指出了集群级随机设计相对于家庭级设计的额外优势。
10.3386/w35681.title: Spillover Effects of Transfer Programs
10.3386/w35681.title_zh: 转移支付项目的溢出效应

10.3386/w35682.abstract: How much does pricing pollution cut aggregate emissions, and at what cost? We develop a microfounded equilibrium model of firm production and abatement that can be estimated from standard firm financial and emissions data, without observing abatement effort directly. The model captures three adjustment margins: short-run input substitution, reallocation of output from dirty to cleaner firms, and long-run clean technology adoption. Applying it to the first 17 years of the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU-ETS), we find input substitution is rigid: firms cannot cut emissions in the short run without cutting output. Reallocation instead drives nearly all of the short-run aggregate emissions response, concentrated in sectors with heterogeneous emissions intensities, like power and cement, or with elastic demand, like refining. Clean technology adoption also responds causally to permit price shocks, reducing firms’ emissions intensity over the five years that follow. Doubling the permit price cuts aggregate emissions 23% in the short run and 31% in the longer run after induced clean technology adoption. In the short run, output falls by 4%, primarily because carbon costs pass from upstream polluting industries like electricity to downstream producers. In the long run, output falls just 2.5%, as clean technology adoption dampens these supply-chain impacts. Carbon pricing thus delivers substantial emissions reductions with moderate output effects, and much of the economic burden falls on downstream firms through higher upstream input costs.
10.3386/w35682.abstract_zh: 污染定价能在多大程度上减少总体排放，其成本又是多少？我们构建了一个基于微观基础的企业生产与减排均衡模型，该模型可利用标准的企业财务和排放数据进行估计，而无需直接观测减排努力。模型涵盖了三种调整途径：短期投入替代、产出从高污染企业向清洁企业的重新配置，以及长期清洁技术采纳。将其应用于欧盟排放交易体系（EU-ETS）前17年的数据，我们发现投入替代具有刚性：企业在短期内无法在不削减产出的情况下减少排放。相反，重新配置驱动了几乎所有短期总体排放响应，且集中于排放强度异质性显著的行业（如电力和水泥）或需求弹性较大的行业（如炼油）。清洁技术采纳也对配额价格冲击产生因果性响应，在随后的五年中降低了企业的排放强度。将配额价格翻倍，短期内可使总体排放减少23%，在诱导清洁技术采纳后的较长时期内减少31%。短期内，产出下降4%，主要原因是碳成本从电力等上游污染行业传导至下游生产者。长期来看，产出仅下降2.5%，因为清洁技术采纳缓解了这些供应链影响。因此，碳定价能在产出影响适中的情况下实现显著的减排效果，且大部分经济负担通过上游投入成本上升而落在下游企业身上。
10.3386/w35682.title: Pollution Pricing in Equilibrium: Production, Reallocation, and Aggregate Impacts
10.3386/w35682.title_zh: 均衡中的污染定价：生产、再配置与总体影响

10.3386/w35683.abstract: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA, P.L. 119-21) eliminates the federal GradPLUS loan program for new borrowers effective July 1, 2026, replacing nearly two decades of uncapped federal graduate lending with annual limits of $20,500 ($50,000 for eleven professional fields) and new aggregate caps. The resulting financing gap — approximately $8 billion annually across roughly 370,000 affected borrowers — raises the question of whether and how private capital will substitute for displaced federal lending. This paper analyzes the economics of that transition. Before GradPLUS, private lenders filled the gap between federal Stafford limits and graduate program costs, with nonfederal graduate originations reaching $5.3 billion (constant 2024 dollars) by 2005–06. After GradPLUS extended federal borrowing to the full cost of attendance in 2006, private lending collapsed — falling more than 70 percent within a few years and never recovering.
