The federal program provided not only credit but, through income-driven repayment and Public Service Loan Forgiveness, insurance against earnings risk that no private product could replicate. The same features that crowded out private lending generated compounding distortions: borrowing untethered to repayment capacity, upward pressure on tuition, and a reversal from projected federal surpluses to losses exceeding thirty cents per GradPLUS dollar lent. Linking institution-by-field federal borrowing data to institution-by-field earnings outcomes, I examine the relationship between historical borrowing above the new OBBBA caps and post-completion earnings across programs. I find substantial variation in the extent to which different degree programs would likely support above-cap borrowing from private lenders or other sources. In fields such as law and MBA, earnings rise steeply with borrowing exposure, providing a basis for program-level risk pricing; in fields such as social work, counseling psychology, and physical therapy, the earnings-to-borrowing gradient is essentially flat. I also examine features of the private capital market and institutional responses shaping the transition — including capital constraints on scaling private lending, legal barriers to using program-level outcomes data in underwriting, and the emerging role of institutions as intermediaries between lenders and students.
10.3386/w35683.abstract_zh: 《一项重大美丽法案》（OBBBA，公法119-21）自2026年7月1日起取消联邦GradPLUS贷款计划对新借款人的资格，以每年20,500美元（十一个专业领域为50,000美元）的年度限额和新的总限额取代了近二十年无上限的联邦研究生贷款。由此产生的融资缺口——每年约80亿美元，涉及约37万名受影响借款人——引发了私人资本是否以及如何替代被取代的联邦贷款的问题。本文分析了这一转变的经济学逻辑。在GradPLUS计划之前，私人贷款机构填补了联邦斯塔福德贷款限额与研究生项目成本之间的缺口，非联邦研究生贷款发放额在2005-06年度达到53亿美元（按2024年不变美元计算）。2006年GradPLUS将联邦借款扩展至全部就读成本后，私人贷款急剧萎缩——几年内下降超过70%，且从未恢复。联邦计划不仅提供信贷，还通过收入驱动还款和公共服务贷款豁免提供了收入风险保险，这是任何私人产品都无法复制的。正是这些挤出私人贷款的特征产生了叠加的扭曲效应：借款与还款能力脱钩、对学费形成上行压力，以及联邦盈余预期逆转至每发放一美元GradPLUS贷款损失超过三十美分的局面。通过将按院校-专业划分的联邦借款数据与按院校-专业划分的收入结果相匹配，我考察了超出新OBBBA上限的历史借款与各项目毕业后期收入之间的关系。我发现不同学位项目在多大程度上可能支持从私人贷款机构或其他来源进行超上限借款方面存在显著差异。在法律和MBA等领域，收入随借款敞口急剧上升，为项目层面风险定价提供了基础；而在社会工作、咨询心理学和物理治疗等领域，收入与借款之间的梯度基本持平。我还考察了塑造这一转型的私人资本市场特征和机构应对措施——包括私人贷款规模扩张的资本约束、在承保中使用项目层面结果数据的法律障碍，以及机构作为贷款人与学生之间中介的新兴角色。
10.3386/w35683.title: Can Private Markets Fill the Gap? Graduate Student Lending After the Elimination of GradPLUS
10.3386/w35683.title_zh: 私人市场能否填补空白？GradPLUS取消后的研究生贷款

10.3386/w35684.abstract: Using a new firm-level measure of AI investment based on AI-skilled employment—spanning machine learning through generative and agentic AI—we show that AI investments are associated with productivity growth in recent years, but not over the previous decade. We trace the productivity gains to the accumulation of organization capital that AI helps create: durable firm-specific knowledge acquired through learning-by-doing that enables more efficient production. We build a novel measure of organization capital based on workers’ job descriptions and document that productivity gains are driven by AI-skilled jobs that build organization capital. Overall, our findings suggest that AI investment generates productivity growth by creating organization capital.
10.3386/w35684.abstract_zh: 基于人工智能技能就业的新型企业层面AI投资衡量指标——涵盖从机器学习到生成式及代理式AI——我们表明，近年来AI投资与生产率增长相关联，但在过去十年中并非如此。我们将生产率收益追溯至AI助力积累的组织资本：通过干中学获得的持久企业特定知识，这些知识能够实现更高效的生产。我们基于员工职位描述构建了一种新颖的组织资本衡量方法，并记录到生产率提升主要由构建组织资本的AI技能岗位驱动。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，AI投资通过创造组织资本来促进生产率增长。
10.3386/w35684.title: Canaries in the Gold Mine: Early Productivity Gains from Artificial Intelligence Creating Organization Capital
10.3386/w35684.title_zh: 金矿中的金丝雀：人工智能创造组织资本的早期生产率提升

10.3386/w35685.abstract: We study international cooperation in a general environment with pecuniary and non-pecuniary externalities across countries. We derive two main theorems, each demonstrating that market-access commitments, a form of shallow integration, are sufficient to implement globally efficient policies. When all cross-border externalities are pecuniary, the first theorem provides a new and unifying perspective on a series of results by Bagwell and Staiger. When some cross-border externalities are non-pecuniary, the second theorem shows that market-access commitments, properly extended, still sustain global efficiency. These extended market-access commitments reinterpret cross-border externalities as additional goods that are traded and priced at their social values. We discuss the implications for international cooperation on climate change and geopolitics.
10.3386/w35685.abstract_zh: 我们研究在存在跨国金钱性外部性与非金钱性外部性的普遍环境中的国际合作。我们推导出两个主要定理，各自证明市场准入承诺——一种浅层一体化形式——足以实施全球高效政策。当所有跨境外部性均为金钱性时，第一个定理为巴格韦尔和斯泰格的一系列结果提供了新的统一视角。当部分跨境外部性为非金钱性时，第二个定理表明，适当扩展的市场准入承诺仍能维持全球效率。这些扩展的市场准入承诺将跨境外部性重新解释为按其社会价值交易和定价的额外商品。我们讨论了这些发现对气候变化和地缘政治国际合作的启示。
10.3386/w35685.title: A Deep Case for Shallow Integration

10.3386/w35686.abstract: State legislatures enacted numerous public-health laws during the twentieth century, most of which likely had negligible effects on mortality. Using data on the universe of state-level public-health laws and regulations, I test whether these laws, taken together, account for a meaningful decline in mortality. To address endogeneity, I instrument for public-health legislation using the legislative calendar. Both OLS and IV estimates indicate that public-health laws reduced mortality, whereas other laws and repeals of public-health laws did not. Legislatures were most effective at reducing deaths from waterborne and drainage-related diseases, half as effective for airborne communicable diseases, and one-fifth as effective for noncommunicable diseases. I use text analysis to classify the laws into twenty topics and find that laws targeting particular causes of death produced larger mortality declines for those causes. The universe of public-health laws can account for approximately two-thirds of the mortality decline during the study period.
10.3386/w35686.abstract_zh: 二十世纪期间，各州立法机构颁布了大量公共卫生法律，其中大多数可能对死亡率的影响微乎其微。利用涵盖全美各州公共卫生法律与法规的全面数据，我检验了这些法律整体上是否导致了死亡率的显著下降。为应对内生性问题，我利用立法日历作为公共卫生立法的工具变量。无论是普通最小二乘法还是工具变量估计结果均显示，公共卫生法律降低了死亡率，而其他法律及公共卫生法律的废止则未产生此类效果。立法机构在减少水源性和排水相关疾病导致的死亡方面最为有效，对空气传播传染病的效果为其一半，对非传染性疾病的效果则为其五分之一。我运用文本分析将法律归类为二十个主题，发现针对特定死因的法律对这些死因的死亡率下降产生了更大影响。在研究期间，全部公共卫生法律可解释约三分之二的死亡率下降。
10.3386/w35686.title: Legislating Longevity: State Public Health Laws and Mortality in the Early Twentieth Century
10.3386/w35686.title_zh: 立法长寿：二十世纪初州公共卫生法与死亡率

10.3386/w35687.abstract: Safe public debt can become a drag on aggregate demand even while the sovereign remains solvent. Its safety requires rollover support, market-making, and balance-sheet capacity. As these resources become scarce, the marginal cost of producing safe Treasury claims rises. The resulting fiscal adjustment reduces aggregate expenditure and can eventually outweigh the expansionary effect of increasing the supply of safe assets. Debt’s stationary contribution to aggregate demand then peaks, and the equilibrium safe rate reaches its maximum at the same debt stock. Beyond this point, further issuance lowers aggregate demand and the safe rate even though the debt remains safe. Empirically, I combine cash- Treasury and real-duration premia with estimates of how additional private supply reprices the outstanding Treasury stock. Over the past decade, the benchmark marginal cost more than doubled, rising from about 80 basis points in 2015Q1 to 187 basis points in 2026Q1. Using a 330-basis-point benchmark for the rate-equivalent wealth benefit, the safe-debt margin—the difference between this benefit and marginal cost—fell from about 250 to 143 basis points. At the CBO’s 2026 borrowing pace, the remaining safe-debt margin shrinks by about 18 basis points in one year, with further erosion accelerating as debt rises relative to financial capacity.
10.3386/w35687.abstract_zh: 安全公共债务即便在主权国家保持偿付能力的情况下，也可能成为总需求的拖累。其安全性要求展期支持、做市以及资产负债表能力。随着这些资源变得稀缺，生产安全国债的边际成本上升。由此产生的财政调整减少了总支出，并最终可能超过增加安全资产供给所带来的扩张效应。债务对总需求的稳态贡献随之达到峰值，均衡安全利率在同一债务存量水平上达到最大值。超过这一临界点后，进一步发行债券会降低总需求和安全利率，即便债务仍然安全。实证方面，我将现金国债与实物久期溢价，与额外私人供给如何重新定价存量国债的估计相结合。过去十年间，基准边际成本翻了一倍以上，从2015年第一季度的约80个基点上升至2026年第一季度的187个基点。以330个基点作为利率等价财富收益的基准，安全债务边际——即该收益与边际成本之差——从约250个基点下降至143个基点。按照国会预算办公室2026年的借款节奏，剩余安全债务边际在一年内缩减约18个基点，且随着债务相对于金融能力的上升，进一步侵蚀将加速。
10.3386/w35687.title: The Safe-Debt Laffer Curve

10.3386/w35688.abstract: AI-generated assessments of manuscripts could improve the quality of peer review, but sharing them with reviewers might decrease the information that editors possess about the manuscript. Human peer reviews add value because reviewers add what the AI assessment reveals. When both reviewers see the same assessment and make similar errors, they can replicate each other’s mistakes, coincidentally investigate related areas, and share the same blind spots. If AI assessment improves the quality of reviewers’ work while they investigate the manuscript, giving the report to only one reviewer can better combine AI assistance with independent, human investigation. If some reviewers already use AI-generated assessments on their own, changing the journal policy to allow sharing the assessment can improve peer review if the change takes some of the burden of investigation off private tools that make similar errors, though giving the assessment to only one reviewer may still outperform giving it to both or neither. Even a report delivered after the reviews are submitted can still shift what reviewers investigate if they know in advance which issues it will check. Journal policy will depend on the AI’s effects on reviewer effort and the questions they investigate, whether reviewers are willing and able to comply with the policy, the monitoring costs, and the journal’s ability to protect the confidentiality of reviewer identities and emails. Journals can evaluate competing policies without knowing the true quality of the manuscripts they review by randomly varying who receives the assessment and then comparing reviewer disagreement across different levels of report sharing.
10.3386/w35688.abstract_zh: AI生成的稿件评估有望提升同行评审质量，但将其分享给评审人可能会减少编辑所掌握的稿件信息。人工同行评审之所以具有价值，是因为评审人能够补充AI评估所揭示的内容。当两位评审人看到相同的评估并犯下相似错误时，他们可能重复彼此的失误，巧合地探究相关领域，并共享相同的盲点。如果AI评估在评审人调查稿件期间能提升其工作质量，那么仅将报告提供给一位评审人，可以更好地将AI辅助与独立的人工调查相结合。若部分评审人已自行使用AI生成的评估，改变期刊政策以允许分享评估，可在一定程度上减轻私人工具（这些工具可能产生类似错误）的调查负担，从而改善同行评审，尽管仅向一位评审人提供评估可能仍优于向两位或都不提供。即使在评审意见提交后才送达的报告，若评审人预先知晓其将核查哪些问题，仍可能改变他们的调查方向。期刊政策将取决于AI对评审人努力程度及其调查问题的影响、评审人是否愿意且能够遵守政策、监控成本，以及期刊保护评审人身份和电子邮件机密性的能力。期刊可通过随机分配谁接收评估，并比较不同报告分享水平下评审人之间的分歧，来评估竞争性政策，而无需知晓其所评审稿件的真实质量。
10.3386/w35688.title: Designing AI-Augmented Peer Review

10.3386/w35689.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used for political advice. We study an AI that is better informed about a payoff-relevant state and cares both about accuracy and about the perceived welfare of the individual it advises. The AI then has an incentive to tilt advice toward what the individual would like to believe, altering both the political content and the informativeness of its messages. Sophisticated individuals anticipate this distortion and filter out its predictable political component, yet still learn less because the AI makes its messages less responsive to the state. Individuals who underestimate the incentive instead mistake political accommodation for information, allowing political preferences to distort factual beliefs and generate polarization and radicalization. The model also shows that better-informed individuals receive more informative and less politically tilted advice, while greater sophistication can improve interpretation yet worsen communication itself. Contrary to the familiar echo-chamber intuition, political distortion is mitigated when political preferences and prior beliefs coincide and is most consequential when they diverge. We show how independently varying individuals’ stated preferences and prior beliefs can recover the AI’s responsiveness to the state even when the underlying state cannot be manipulated.
10.3386/w35689.abstract_zh: 人工智能日益被用于提供政治建议。我们研究了一种人工智能，它对于与收益相关的状态拥有更充分的信息，并且既关注准确性，也关注其所建议个体的感知福利。因此，该人工智能有动机将建议偏向于个体所愿意相信的方向，从而改变其信息内容的政治倾向及信息量。精明的个体会预见到这种扭曲，并过滤掉其可预测的政治成分，然而，由于人工智能使其信息对状态的响应性降低，他们仍会学到更少的内容。低估这种动机的个体反而会将政治迎合误认为信息，从而使政治偏好扭曲事实信念，并引发两极分化和激进化。该模型还表明，信息更充分的个体会获得更具信息量且政治倾向更弱的建议，而更高的精明程度虽能改善解读，却可能损害沟通本身。与常见的回音室直觉相反，当政治偏好与先验信念一致时，政治扭曲会得到缓解；而当二者相悖时，其影响最为显著。我们展示了如何通过独立变化个体所陈述的偏好与先验信念，即使在潜在状态无法被操控的情况下，也能恢复人工智能对状态的响应性。
10.3386/w35689.title: Artificial Intelligence and Political Advice

10.3386/w35690.abstract: Local elected officials oversee critical infrastructure, often with limited electoral accountability. This paper studies how this distorts investment across California drinking-water systems. We document that pollution responds to shifts in the political environment, motivating a dynamic model of public investment. We measure welfare returns to investment directly, combining event-study estimates of investment effectiveness and costs with those of residents’ clean-water valuations, recovered from housing choices. Investment choices identify policymakers’ responsiveness to those returns. Weak accountability diverts investment from high-return systems and conventional policies imperfectly offset these distortions: subsidy takeup is misaligned with returns, while uniform mandates induce welfare losses.
10.3386/w35690.abstract_zh: 地方选举官员负责监管关键基础设施，但往往面临有限的选举问责。本文研究这一现象如何扭曲加州饮用水系统的投资配置。我们记录了污染对政治环境变化的响应，由此构建了一个公共投资的动态模型。我们直接衡量投资的福利回报，将投资有效性和成本的事件研究估计与居民清洁用水价值评估（从住房选择中恢复）相结合。投资选择揭示了政策制定者对这些回报的响应程度。薄弱的问责机制将投资从高回报系统中转移出去，而常规政策无法完全抵消这些扭曲：补贴采纳与回报不匹配，统一指令则导致福利损失。

10.3386/w35690.title_zh: 地方基础设施的低效问题：来自加利福尼亚饮用水的证据

10.3386/w35691.abstract: We develop a model for fiscal and monetary policy determination in the tradition of Sargent and Wallace (1981). Ex-ante, the government has incentives to delegate monetary policy to a central bank with an inflation targeting mandate. Ex-post, however, the government faces temptations to revoke the mandate to generate seigniorage revenues. The likelihood that the government will adhere to its commitment depends on shocks to fiscal fundamentals and the costs of reneging on the mandate. The economy endogenously transitions between a “monetary-dominant” regime where monetary policy adheres to its commitment and a “fiscal-dominant” regime where the fiscal authority interferes with monetary policy. These two regimes sharply differ in their implications for the comovement of inflation and debt-to-GDP ratios. We use the model as a measurement device to interpret the fiscal and monetary history in Colombia, Chile, and the U.S.
10.3386/w35691.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个遵循萨金特与华莱士（1981）传统的财政与货币政策决定模型。事前，政府有动机将货币政策委托给一个以通胀目标为使命的中央银行。然而，事后政府面临撤销该使命以获取铸币税收入的诱惑。政府坚守承诺的可能性取决于财政基本面的冲击及违背使命的成本。经济内生地在“货币主导”体制（货币政策坚守承诺）与“财政主导”体制（财政当局干预货币政策）之间转换。这两种体制在通胀与债务占GDP比率的联动性上表现出显著差异。我们利用该模型作为测量工具，解读哥伦比亚、智利及美国的财政与货币历史。

10.3386/w35723.abstract: We propose a model of costly voting in a canonical spatial setting that reconciles key empirical features of electoral turnout. We integrate citizens with prosocial voting motives who realize higher payoffs from voting when (i) they expect more fellow supporters to vote, (ii) such votes collectively matter more for winning probabilities, and (iii) they care more about which candidate wins. We establish existence of Nash equilibria satisfying an additional condition that ensures equilibria correspond to those in a finite setting with many voters. We derive how electoral primitives—e.g., voter ideology, voting costs, elite polarization, expected closeness—affect outcomes such as turnout, turnout rates, and winning margins. We relate the predictions to empirical findings both from existing studies and our original data work. With all three prosocial motive components, our model reconciles the empirical regularities qualitatively and quantitatively; while existing models fail on multiple dimensions.
10.3386/w35723.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个在经典空间设定下的昂贵投票模型，该模型调和了选举投票率的关键经验特征。我们将具有亲社会投票动机的公民纳入其中，这些公民在以下情况下从投票中获得更高收益：（i）他们预期更多支持者会投票，（ii）此类投票在整体上对获胜概率的影响更大，以及（iii）他们更关心哪位候选人获胜。我们确立了满足附加条件的纳什均衡的存在性，该条件确保均衡对应于具有众多选民的有限设定中的均衡。我们推导出选举基本要素——例如，选民意识形态、投票成本、精英极化、预期竞争激烈程度——如何影响结果，如投票率、投票率比例和获胜差距。我们将预测与现有研究及我们原创数据工作的经验发现相关联。结合所有三个亲社会动机组成部分，我们的模型在定性和定量上调和了经验规律；而现有模型在多个维度上未能做到这一点。

10.3386/w35723.title_zh: 基于亲社会动机的投票行为经验理论
