10.3386/w3576.abstract: This paper proposes a tractable and realistic nonlinear model of exchange rate dynamics, and argues that its predictions are consistent with available empirical evidence on exchange rate and interest differential behavior in real-life target zones. In our model, the exchange rate fluctuates between given boundaries for random lengths of time and jumps discretely when devaluations occur. We allow for stochastic variability in the likelihood and size of devaluations, and we provide explicit solutions for the stochastic processes followed by the exchange rate and by the expected rate of depreciation. The model produces realistic patterns of covariation between exchange rates and interest rate differentials, and provides interesting interpretations of available empirical evidence. We also specify how to infer devaluation risk from target zone data.
10.3386/w3576.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个易于处理且贴近现实的汇率动态非线性模型，并论证其预测结果与真实目标汇率区中汇率与利差行为的现有实证证据一致。在该模型中，汇率在给定边界内随机时长波动，并在发生贬值时发生离散跳跃。我们允许贬值概率与幅度存在随机变化性，同时为汇率及预期贬值率所遵循的随机过程提供显式解。该模型生成了汇率与利差之间符合现实的协动模式，并对现有实证证据提供了有趣的解释。我们还阐明了如何从目标汇率区数据中推断贬值风险。
10.3386/w3576.title: DP513 Stochastic Devaluation Risk and the Empirical Fit of Target Zone Models
10.3386/w3576.title_zh: DP513 随机贬值风险与目标区间模型的经验拟合

10.3386/w5797.abstract: Inflation targeting is shown to imply inflation forecast targeting; the central bank’s inflation forecast becomes an explicit intermediate target. Inflation forecast targeting simplifies both implementation and monitoring of monetary policy. The weight on output stabilization determines how quickly the inflation forecast is adjusted towards the inflation target. Money growth or exchange rate targeting is generally inferior than inflation targeting and leads to higher inflation variability. Commitment to ‘target rules’ may be better than commitment to ‘instrument rules’.
10.3386/w5797.abstract_zh: 研究表明，通胀目标制实质上意味着通胀预测目标制；央行的通胀预测成为明确的中介目标。通胀预测目标制简化了货币政策的实施与监控。产出稳定权重决定了通胀预测向通胀目标调整的速度。货币增长目标制或汇率目标制通常劣于通胀目标制，并会导致更高的通胀波动性。对"目标规则"的承诺可能优于对"工具规则"的承诺。
10.3386/w5797.title: Inflation Forecast Targeting: Implementing and Monitoring Inflation Targets
10.3386/w5797.title_zh: 通胀预测目标制：通胀目标的实施与监控

10.3386/w5930.title: To Each According To...? Markets, Tournaments, and the Matching Problem with Borrowing Constraints
10.3386/w5930.title_zh: 各尽所能，按需分配？市场、锦标赛与借贷约束下的匹配问题

10.3386/w5960.abstract: This paper surveys the evolution of international capital mobility since the late-nineteenth century. It begins with an overview of empirical evidence on the fall and rise of integration in the global capital market. A discussion of institutional developments focuses on the use of capital controls and the pursuit of domestic macroeconomic policy objectives in the context of changing monetary regimes. A fundamental macroeconomic policy trilemma has forced policy-makers to trade off conflicting goals. The natural implication of the trilemma is that capital mobility has prevailed and expanded under circumstances of widespread political support either for an exchange rate subordinated monetary policy regime (e.g. the gold standard), or for a monetary regime geared mainly towards domestic objectives at the expense of exchange rate stability (e.g. the recent float). Through its effect on popular attitudes towards both the gold standard and the legitimate scope for government macroeconomic intervention, the Great Depression emerges as the key turning point in the recent history of international capital markets.
10.3386/w5960.abstract_zh: 本文梳理了自19世纪末以来国际资本流动性的演变历程。首先概述了全球资本市场一体化兴衰的实证证据。在制度发展讨论中，重点分析了资本管制手段的运用，以及不同货币制度背景下各国追求国内宏观经济政策目标的行为。一个根本性的宏观经济政策三难困境迫使决策者在相互冲突的目标间进行权衡。该三难困境的自然推论是：当汇率从属于货币政策（如金本位制）或货币政策主要服务于国内目标而牺牲汇率稳定（如近期浮动汇率制）获得广泛政治支持时，资本流动性便得以盛行并扩张。通过影响民众对金本位制及政府宏观经济干预合理范围的认知，大萧条成为国际资本市场近代史中的关键转折点。
10.3386/w5960.title: The Great Depression as a Watershed: International Capital Mobility over the Long Run
10.3386/w5960.title_zh: 大萧条作为分水岭：长期国际资本流动

10.3386/w6211.abstract: We investigate whether a welfare-maximizing government ought to pursue a programme of strategic trade intervention or instead commit itself to free trade when, in the former case, domestic firms will have an opportunity to manipulate the government’s choice of the level of intervention. Domestic firms may over-invest in physical and knowledge capital in a regime of strategic intervention in order to influence the government’s choice of subsidy. In the event, a commitment to free trade may be desirable even in settings where profit-shifting would be possible. We analyse the desirability of such a commitment when the government is well informed about firms’ types and actions, and when it suffers from an informational disadvantage.
10.3386/w6211.abstract_zh: 本文探讨在以下情境中，追求社会福利最大化的政府是否应实施战略性贸易干预政策，抑或应承诺自由贸易：在前一种情形下，国内企业将有机会操纵政府对干预水平的选择。在战略性干预体制下，国内企业可能过度投资于物质资本和知识资本，以影响政府对补贴水平的决策。因此，即便存在利润转移的可能性，承诺自由贸易仍可能是可取的选择。我们分析了政府在充分了解企业类型与行为，以及面临信息劣势时，此类承诺的合意性。

10.3982/ecta14518.abstract: We introduce firm and worker heterogeneity into a model of innovationâ€ driven endogenous growth. Individuals who differ in ability sort into either a research activity or a manufacturing sector. Research projects generate new varieties of a differentiated product. Projects differ in quality and the resulting technologies differ in productivity. In both sectors, there is a complementarity between firm quality and worker ability. We study the coâ€ determination of growth and income inequality in both the closed and open economy, as well as the spillover effects of policy in one country to outcomes in others.
10.3982/ecta14518.abstract_zh: 我们将企业与劳动者的异质性引入创新驱动的内生增长模型中。能力不同的个体选择进入研发活动或制造业部门。研发项目产生差异化产品的新品种，项目质量各异，由此产生的技术生产率也不同。在两个部门中，企业质量与劳动者能力之间存在互补性。我们研究了封闭经济与开放经济中增长与收入不平等的共同决定因素，以及一国政策对其他国家的溢出效应。
10.3982/ecta14518.title: Growth, Trade, and Inequality

10.3982/ecta20506.abstract: <jats:p>Customs data reveal the heterogeneity and granularity of relationships among buyers and sellers, showing how more exports to a destination break down into more firms selling there and more buyers per exporter. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching that builds on this insight to separate the roles of iceberg costs and matching frictions in gravity. In the cross section, we find matching frictions as important as iceberg costs in impeding trade, and more sensitive to distance. Because domestic and imported intermediates compete directly with labor in performing production tasks, our model also fits the heterogeneity of labor shares across French producers. Applying the framework to the 2004 expansion of the European Union, reduced iceberg costs and reduced matching frictions contributed equally to the increase in French exports to the new members. While workers benefited overall, those competing most directly with imports gained less, even losing in some countries entering the EU.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta20506.abstract_zh: 海关数据揭示了买卖双方关系的异质性和颗粒度，显示对某一目的地的出口增长如何分解为更多企业在该地销售以及每个出口商拥有更多买家。我们构建了一个企业间匹配的量化一般均衡模型，基于这一洞察，将冰山成本与匹配摩擦在引力模型中的作用分离开来。在横截面分析中，我们发现匹配摩擦在阻碍贸易方面与冰山成本同等重要，且对距离更为敏感。由于国内和进口中间品在生产任务中直接与劳动力竞争，我们的模型也拟合了法国各企业劳动份额的异质性。将该框架应用于2004年欧盟扩张，冰山成本的降低与匹配摩擦的减少对法国向新成员国出口增长的贡献相当。尽管工人整体受益，但与进口竞争最直接的工人获益较少，甚至在部分加入欧盟的国家中遭受损失。
10.3982/ecta20506.title: Firm‐to‐Firm Trade: Imports, Exports, and the Labor Market
10.3982/ecta20506.title_zh: 企业间贸易：进口、出口与劳动力市场

10.3982/ecta21084.abstract: This paper studies how the risk of hold‐up affects procurement. I use data on the universe of solar power auctions in India. The Indian context allows clean estimates of counterparty risk, because solar plants set up in the same states, by the same firms, are procured in auctions intermediated by either risky states themselves or the trusted central government. I find that the counterparty risk of an average state increases solar prices by 10%. This risk premium sharply reduces investment, because demand for green energy is elastic. Contract intermediation by the central government eliminates the counterparty risk premium.
10.3982/ecta21084.abstract_zh: 本文研究了敲竹杠风险如何影响采购。我利用印度太阳能电力拍卖的全面数据进行分析。印度的情况使得对交易对手风险的估计变得清晰，因为同一企业在同一州建立的太阳能电站，其拍卖由风险较高的州政府或信誉良好的中央政府中介进行。我发现，平均州的交易对手风险使太阳能价格上升了10%。这一风险溢价显著减少了投资，因为绿色能源需求具有弹性。中央政府的中介合同消除了交易对手风险溢价。

10.3982/ecta21097.abstract: We analyze marital matching on income using an extremely rich Dutch data set containing all income tax files over seven years. We develop a novel methodology that directly extends previous contributions to allow for highly flexible matching patterns. Investigating all marriages that took place between 2013 and 2019, we find that marital patterns are particularly intriguing. While a majority of couples match assortatively, a small but significant minority display negative assortative matching. We also show that standard approaches, which consider all married couples using current incomes (as opposed to pre‐marriage incomes used in our approach), may generate misleading conclusions.
10.3982/ecta21097.abstract_zh: 我们利用一份极为丰富的荷兰数据集，该数据集包含七年内所有所得税档案，对收入层面的婚姻匹配进行了分析。我们开发了一种新颖的方法论，直接扩展了先前的研究贡献，以允许高度灵活的匹配模式。通过考察2013年至2019年间发生的所有婚姻，我们发现婚姻模式尤为引人注目。尽管大多数夫妻呈现同型匹配，但少数但显著的群体表现出负向同型匹配。我们还表明，采用标准方法（即考虑所有已婚夫妇的当前收入，而非我们方法中使用的婚前收入）可能会得出误导性结论。

10.3982/ecta21835.abstract: Apprenticeships play a key role in enabling successful school‐to‐work transitions in many countries, but in the presence of imperfect information, the specificity of this type of training may entail important costs for those working outside their training fields. I study this issue in one of the most prominent training settings, the German apprenticeship system. Using administrative data and a broad occupational classification, I find that 40% of individuals work in occupations different from their training. I estimate the cost of mismatch using vacancy instruments and extend methodological approaches in high‐dimensional selection settings. Lacking training in one's occupation entails an average wage penalty of 14%, the equivalent of two years of work experience. The penalty increases with the task distance between training and occupation. My findings suggest that retraining is crucial to mitigate the adverse consequences from imperfect information in specialized training settings.
10.3982/ecta21835.abstract_zh: 学徒制在许多国家促进从学校到工作的顺利过渡中发挥着关键作用，但在信息不完全的情况下，这种培训类型的特定性可能给那些在培训领域之外工作的人带来重大成本。我在最突出的培训体系之一——德国学徒制中研究这一问题。利用行政数据和广泛的职业分类，我发现40%的人所从事的职业与其培训领域不同。我通过职位空缺工具估计了错配成本，并扩展了高维选择情境下的方法论途径。缺乏本职业培训平均导致14%的工资惩罚，相当于两年工作经验的价值。这一惩罚随培训与职业之间任务距离的增加而加剧。我的研究结果表明，再培训对于减轻专业化培训环境中信息不完全带来的不利后果至关重要。

10.3982/ecta21839.abstract: <jats:p>This paper explores the impact of information design on the auctioneer's revenue in the U.S. offshore oil/gas lease auctions where, post‐auction, the winner decides whether to explore the auctioned tract and must pay the government a royalty on its production value. I first document that there is a positive correlation between the exploration rate and publicly observed losing bids. This suggests that the winning bidder uses the rivals' bids to infer their private information about the tract's potential. I then characterize the equilibrium bidding strategy when the auctioneer designs and commits to how to reveal information on losing bids to the winning bidder. Counterfactual exercises reveal that alternative bid disclosure policies significantly improve auctioneer revenue.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta21839.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了信息设计对美国海上油气租赁拍卖中拍卖方收益的影响。在拍卖结束后，中标者需决定是否对拍卖地块进行勘探，并须按其生产价值向政府支付特许权使用费。我首先发现，勘探率与公开观察到的未中标报价之间存在正相关关系。这表明，中标者利用竞争对手的报价来推断其关于地块潜力的私人信息。随后，我刻画了当拍卖方设计并承诺如何向中标者披露未中标报价信息时的均衡投标策略。反事实分析表明，替代性的报价披露政策能够显著提高拍卖方收益。
10.3982/ecta21839.title: Information Design in Common Value Auction With Moral Hazard: Application to OCS Leasing Auctions
10.3982/ecta21839.title_zh: 道德风险下的共同价值拍卖信息设计：在OCS租赁拍卖中的应用

10.3982/ecta21849.abstract: We apply a revealed preference approach to administrative data from Washington to show that constraints on work hours are widespread: Workers have limited discretion over hours at a given employer, and there is substantial mismatch of workers who prefer long hours to employers that provide short hours. Voluntary job transitions imply a ratio of the marginal rate of substitution of earnings for hours to the wage rate of 0.5–0.6 for prime‐age workers. The average absolute deviation between observed and optimal hours is about 15%, and low‐wage workers face particularly acute constraints on hours. On average, observed hours tend to be less than preferred levels, and workers would require a 12% higher wage with their current employer to be as well off as with an employer offering ideal hours. These findings suggest that hour constraints are an equilibrium feature of the labor market because long‐hour jobs are costly to employers.
10.3982/ecta21849.abstract_zh: 我们运用显示性偏好方法分析华盛顿州的行政数据，揭示工作时间约束普遍存在：员工在给定雇主处对工作小时数的自主权有限，且偏好长工时的员工与提供短工时的雇主之间存在显著错配。自愿职业转换表明，对于主要劳动年龄工人，收入对工时的边际替代率与工资率之比为0.5至0.6。观测工时与最优工时之间的平均绝对偏差约为15%，而低工资工人面临尤为严峻的工时约束。平均而言，观测工时往往低于偏好水平，工人若要与提供理想工时的雇主获得同等福利，需在当前雇主处获得高出12%的工资。这些发现表明，工时约束是劳动力市场的均衡特征，因为长工时岗位对雇主而言成本高昂。

10.3982/ecta21854.abstract: This paper studies the economic effects of rural‐urban migration on Brazilian cities. Using a shift‐share IV design, we show that, over a decade, drought‐induced immigration reduces informality, has no effect on unemployment, and increases the number of formal firms and jobs. Downward formal wage adjustments play a key role, as these long‐run effects are weaker in regions with stronger wage rigidity. In the short run, when wage rigidity is strongest, we replicate the informality‐increasing effects documented in the literature. We develop and estimate a model of firm dynamics and informality that rationalizes these results. The counterfactuals reveal that, in the short run, the informal sector absorbs the expanding labor force and acts as a “stepping‐stone” to formality for firms and workers. In the long run, however, it reduces the aggregate benefits from immigration by allowing the least productive firms to survive.
10.3982/ecta21854.abstract_zh: 本文研究了农村向城市迁移对巴西城市的经济效应。利用shift-share IV设计，我们表明，在十年间，干旱引发的移民降低了非正规性，对失业率无影响，并增加了正规企业和就业岗位的数量。下行正规工资调整在此过程中发挥关键作用，因为这些长期效应在工资刚性较强的地区较弱。在短期内，当工资刚性最强时，我们复现了文献中记载的非正规性增强效应。我们构建并估计了一个企业动态与非正规性模型，以合理解释这些结果。反事实分析揭示，在短期内，非正规部门吸收了扩张的劳动力，并作为企业和工人迈向正规化的“踏脚石”。然而，从长期来看，它通过允许效率最低的企业存活，减少了移民带来的总体收益。

10.3982/ecta21926.abstract: <jats:p>Personalizing policies can theoretically increase their effectiveness. However, personalization is difficult when individual types are unobservable and the preferences of policymakers and individuals are not aligned, which could cause individuals to misreport their type. Mechanism design offers a strategy to overcome this issue: offer an “incentive‐compatible” menu of policy choices designed to induce participants to select the variant intended for their type. Using a field experiment that personalized incentives for exercise among 6,800 adults with diabetes and hypertension in urban India, we show that personalizing with an incentive‐compatible choice menu substantially improves program performance, increasing the treatment effect of incentives on exercise by 80% without increasing incentive costs relative to a one‐size‐fits‐all benchmark. Offering choice achieves similar performance to personalizing with an extensive set of observable variables, but without the same data requirements.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta21926.abstract_zh: 个性化政策在理论上可以提升其有效性。然而，当个体类型不可观测，且政策制定者与个体的偏好不一致时，个性化难以实现，因为这可能导致个体虚报其类型。机制设计提供了一种解决该问题的策略：提供一份“激励相容”的政策选择菜单，旨在引导参与者选择针对其类型设计的方案。通过在印度城市地区对6800名患有糖尿病和高血压的成年人进行一项实地实验，我们证明，采用激励相容的选择菜单进行个性化激励，能显著提升项目绩效：与一刀切的基准方案相比，在不增加激励成本的情况下，将激励对锻炼的处理效应提高了80%。提供选择菜单所达到的效果，与利用大量可观测变量进行个性化处理的效果相当，但无需相同的数据要求。
10.3982/ecta21926.title: Mechanism Design for Personalized Policy: A Field Experiment Incentivizing Exercise
10.3982/ecta21926.title_zh: 个性化政策的机制设计：一项激励运动的实地实验

10.3982/ecta22022.abstract: A buyer and seller bargain in continuous time over a good. Bargainers can be rational or committed to some fixed price. A rational buyer has a private value and outside option. If the set of buyer values and commitment types is rich and the probability of commitment vanishes, outcomes are partially consistent with the Coase conjecture: the seller chooses a price below the maximum of the lowest outside option and half the lowest value; the buyer immediately accepts or takes his outside option.
10.3982/ecta22022.abstract_zh: 买方与卖方在连续时间内就一件商品进行讨价还价。讨价还价者可能是理性的，也可能承诺于某个固定价格。理性买方拥有私人价值和外部选择权。若买方价值集合与承诺类型集合丰富，且承诺概率趋近于零，则结果与科斯猜想部分一致：卖方选择的价格低于最低外部选择权与最低价值一半中的最大值；买方立即接受或采取其外部选择权。

10.3982/ecta22110.abstract: <jats:p>I document that the right tail of the firm size distribution systematically thickens with economic development. To rationalize this fact, I develop a parsimonious idea search model in which both aggregate growth and the firm size distribution are endogenously determined. The model features an asymptotic balanced growth path along which Gibrat's law holds at each date, and the right tail of the firm size distribution thickens monotonically toward Zipf's law. The model also implies that policies favoring large firms can improve welfare by better utilizing the diffusion externalities arising from idea search.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta22110.abstract_zh: 本文发现，企业规模分布的右尾随经济发展系统性增厚。为解释这一事实，我构建了一个简约的思想搜寻模型，其中总量增长与企业规模分布均为内生决定。该模型具有渐进平衡增长路径特征，在此路径上各期均满足吉布拉定律，且企业规模分布的右尾单调增厚直至趋近齐普夫定律。模型还表明，偏好大企业的政策可通过更充分利用思想搜寻产生的扩散外部性来提升社会福利。
10.3982/ecta22110.title: Economic Growth and the Rise of Large Firms
10.3982/ecta22110.title_zh: 经济增长与大型企业的崛起

10.3982/ecta22451.abstract: <jats:p>We construct a dynamic integrated assessment model of climate and the economy with very high geographic resolution. Migration is free within, but not allowed across, countries. The model parameterization uses a wealth of data, including the distribution of output, population, energy sources and use, and estimates of the local damages from climate change. It implies very large geographic dispersion in damages from warming. We conduct three kinds of policy experiments. In one, we note that a modest, uniform carbon tax limits global warming and damages around the world substantially. In a second experiment, we let the poorest countries not tax carbon, while the rest compensate by setting higher taxes; the efficiency losses are large. In a final experiment, we find that fast green technology growth alone is a poor substitute for carbon taxes, whether globally available or not.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta22451.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个具有极高地理分辨率的动态气候与经济综合评估模型。模型设定中，人口可在国家内部自由迁移，但禁止跨国流动。模型参数化过程运用了丰富的数据集，包括产出分布、人口分布、能源来源与使用情况，以及气候变化对各地造成的损失估算。该模型揭示了全球变暖损失在地理分布上的巨大差异性。我们开展了三类政策实验：其一，适度的统一碳税能够显著抑制全球变暖并大幅降低全球损失；其二，若允许最贫困国家免征碳税，而其他国家通过提高税率进行补偿，则会产生巨大的效率损失；其三，我们发现，无论绿色技术是否实现全球普及，仅靠其快速增长都无法有效替代碳税政策。
10.3982/ecta22451.title: Walras–Bowley Lecture: Climate Policy in the Wide World
10.3982/ecta22451.title_zh: 瓦尔拉斯-鲍利讲座：广阔世界中的气候政策

10.3982/ecta22488.abstract: We investigate how formularies used by pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) affect equilibrium manufacturer rebates for branded drugs through tiering and exclusion. We develop a theoretical model of multidimensional contracting in which a PBM negotiates with drug manufacturers over menus of formulary‐contingent rebates and chooses a formulary. We then estimate consumer demand responses to tier placement for statins using claims data from Princeton University, a large employer contracting with a single PBM to offer prescription drug coverage to its employees. Combining the theoretical model with demand estimates and observed list prices, we quantify how allowing for differential tier placement and exclusion affect equilibrium rebates. Our predictions are consistent with available aggregate rebate data, and we find that allowing a PBM to place branded drugs on preferred‐ and non‐preferred tiers can substantially increase negotiated rebate payments.
10.3982/ecta22488.abstract_zh: 我们研究了药房福利管理者（PBMs）所使用的处方集如何通过分级和排除机制影响品牌药品的制造商回扣均衡。我们构建了一个多维契约理论模型，其中PBM与药品制造商就一系列基于处方集的回扣菜单进行谈判，并选择处方集。随后，我们利用普林斯顿大学的索赔数据，估计了消费者对汀类药物分级安置的需求反应，普林斯顿大学是一家与单一PBM签约、为其员工提供处方药覆盖的大型雇主。结合理论模型、需求估计及观察到的标价，我们量化了允许差异化分级安置和排除对均衡回扣的影响。我们的预测与可获得的总体回扣数据一致，并发现允许PBM将品牌药品置于优选和非优选层级可显著增加谈判达成的回扣支付。

10.3982/ecta22542.abstract: <jats:p>This paper develops a macroeconomic model that combines an incomplete‐markets overlapping‐generations economy with a job ladder featuring sequential wage bargaining, endogenous search effort of employed and non‐employed workers, and differences in match quality. With these ingredients, our model provides a joint microfoundation for the three main inputs in aggregate production: capital, employment, and labor efficiency. The calibrated model offers a good fit to the empirical age profiles of search activity, job‐finding rates, wages, and savings. We use the model to analyze the impact of tax and transfer policies for labor market dynamics and aggregate economic activity via capital, employment, and labor efficiency channels. Lower unemployment benefits and a less progressive tax schedule bring about welfare losses for a newborn worker which are mainly driven by higher consumption risk and costlier search effort; both policies have differential effects along the age, income, and wealth dimensions.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta22542.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个宏观经济学模型，该模型将不完全市场的世代交叠经济与包含序贯工资谈判、就业与非就业工人内生搜寻努力以及匹配质量差异的工作阶梯相结合。基于这些要素，我们的模型为总生产中的三个主要投入——资本、就业和劳动效率——提供了统一的微观基础。校准后的模型较好地拟合了搜寻活动、工作找到率、工资和储蓄的年龄分布经验特征。我们利用该模型分析税收与转移支付政策通过资本、就业和劳动效率渠道对劳动力市场动态及总体经济活动的影响。降低失业救济金和减少税收累进性会给新生工人带来福利损失，这主要源于更高的消费风险和更昂贵的搜寻努力；这两种政策在年龄、收入和财富维度上具有差异化效应。
10.3982/ecta22542.title: Job Ladder and Wealth Dynamics in General Equilibrium
10.3982/ecta22542.title_zh: 一般均衡中的职业阶梯与财富动态

10.3982/ecta22613.abstract: We cast the problem of communicating scientific uncertainty as one of reporting a posterior distribution on an unknown parameter to an audience of Bayesian decision‐makers. We establish novel bounds on the audience's regret when the analyst reports an approximation to a posterior that the audience treats as exact. Under a palatable restriction on the audience's decision problems, the bounds take an especially convenient form. Under a further restriction on the audience's priors, a bootstrap distribution can be used as a stand‐in posterior. We propose a practical recipe for checking whether a conventional statistical report (say, a normal parameterized by a point estimate and standard error) is a good approximation, and for improving the report if it is not. We illustrate our proposals using the articles in the 2021 American Economic Review that use a bootstrap for inference.
10.3982/ecta22613.abstract_zh: 我们将科学不确定性沟通问题视为向贝叶斯决策者受众报告未知参数后验分布的过程。我们为当分析师报告一个受众视为精确的后验近似值时，受众的遗憾建立了新的界限。在对受众决策问题施加一个可接受的限制条件下，这些界限呈现出特别便捷的形式。进一步限制受众的先验分布时，自助法分布可作为后验的替代。我们提出了一种实用方法，用于检查常规统计报告（例如，由点估计和标准误参数化的正态分布）是否构成良好近似，并在非近似时改进报告。我们利用2021年《美国经济评论》中使用自助法进行推断的文章来阐述我们的建议。

10.3982/ecta22979.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    The U.S. Supreme Court's 2010 decision in
                    <jats:italic>Citizens United v. Federal Election Commission</jats:italic>
                    deregulated campaign finance, enabling the rise of a new political action committee (the Super PAC) with broad freedom to raise and spend money. This led to an unprecedented surge in spending in primary and general elections. To evaluate the impact of Super PACs, I estimate a multistage model of political competition using data from U.S. Congressional elections between 2010 and 2020. I find that Super PAC spending by both sides prompts offsetting responses, resulting in limited net equilibrium effects. However, by amplifying the role of donors, Super PACs still have the potential to reshape the electoral landscape.
                  </jats:p>
10.3982/ecta22979.abstract_zh: 美国最高法院2010年就"联合公民诉联邦选举委员会案"作出的裁决放松了对竞选资金的监管，催生了一种新型政治行动委员会（超级政治行动委员会），使其在筹款和支出方面拥有广泛自由。这导致初选和大选中的支出出现前所未有的激增。为评估超级政治行动委员会的影响，我利用2010年至2020年美国国会选举数据，估计了一个多阶段政治竞争模型。研究发现，双方超级政治行动委员会的支出会引发对冲性反应，导致均衡效应有限。然而，通过放大捐赠者的作用，超级政治行动委员会仍有可能重塑选举格局。
10.3982/ecta22979.title: The Equilibrium Effects of Campaign Finance Deregulation on U.S. Elections
10.3982/ecta22979.title_zh: 竞选财务放松管制对美国选举的均衡效应

10.3982/ecta23049.abstract: <jats:p>We consider a dynamic buyer–seller interaction. Instead of the buyer's valuation, it is the frequency with which he needs to trade that is the buyer's private information. The difference matters. With commitment, full surplus extraction is possible, for instance via limited‐time offers. Without commitment, ratcheting is mitigated, as not buying is not necessarily a sign of strength. Because time is informative, the seller learns and may adjust her behavior over time. When finding a suitable alternative seller is easy, she starts with a pooling offer before permanently switching to a screening offer. When finding a suitable alternative seller takes time, she starts with a pooling offer before occasionally experimenting with separating offers.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23049.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种动态的买卖双方互动关系。与买方估值不同，买方需要交易的频率才是其私人信息。这一差异至关重要。在有承诺的情况下，完全剩余提取是可能的，例如通过限时报价。在没有承诺的情况下，棘轮效应得到缓解，因为不购买并不一定意味着买方处于强势地位。由于时间具有信息价值，卖方会随着时间推移学习并可能调整其行为。当寻找合适的替代卖方较为容易时，她会先提出混合报价，然后永久转向筛选报价。当寻找合适的替代卖方需要时间时，她会先提出混合报价，然后偶尔尝试分离报价。
10.3982/ecta23049.title: Dynamic Screening of Buyers With Heterogeneous Purchase Frequency
10.3982/ecta23049.title_zh: 异质性购买频率下买家的动态筛选

10.3982/ecta23174.abstract: <jats:p>We study instrumental variables models characterized by: (i) Unobserved heterogeneity consisting of potential outcomes and response types that describe how the instrument determines treatment choice; (ii) Conditional independence of the instrument and the unobserved heterogeneity; and (iii) Convex restrictions on the distribution of unobserved heterogeneity. We show certain causal parameters are identified in these models if and only if a version of the kappa of Abadie (2003) exists. Our identification results are constructive in yielding estimating moment conditions. Focusing on a leading special case, we develop asymptotically normal estimators based on a doubly robust version of these moment conditions.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23174.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有以下特征的工具变量模型：（i）未观测异质性由潜在结果和描述工具如何决定处理选择的响应类型构成；（ii）工具与未观测异质性条件独立；（iii）未观测异质性分布满足凸性约束。我们证明，当且仅当Abadie（2003）的kappa统计量存在时，这些模型中的某些因果参数可被识别。我们的识别结果是建设性的，能够导出估计矩条件。聚焦于一个主要特例，我们基于这些矩条件的双重稳健版本开发了渐近正态估计量。
10.3982/ecta23174.title: Identification in Instrumental Variables Models: The Central Role of Abadie's Kappa
10.3982/ecta23174.title_zh: 工具变量模型中的识别：Abadie's Kappa的核心作用

10.3982/ecta23334.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    Evidence from the laboratory and the field has uncovered both underreaction and overreaction to new information. We provide new experimental evidence on the underlying mechanisms of under‐ and overreaction by comparing how people make inferences
                    <jats:italic>and</jats:italic>
                    revise forecasts in the same information environment. Participants underreact to signals when inferring about underlying states, but overreact to the same signals when revising forecasts about future outcomes—a phenomenon we term “the inference‐forecast gap.” We show that this gap is largely driven by different simplifying heuristics used in the two tasks. Additional treatments suggest that the choice of heuristics is affected by the similarity between statistics in the information environment and the statistic elicited by the belief‐updating problem.
                  </jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23334.abstract_zh: 来自实验室和现场的证据揭示了人们对新信息既存在反应不足也存在反应过度。我们通过比较人们在相同信息环境下如何进行推断和修正预测，提供了关于反应不足与反应过度内在机制的新实验证据。参与者在推断潜在状态时对信号反应不足，但在修正对未来结果的预测时却对相同信号反应过度——我们将这一现象称为“推断-预测差距”。研究表明，这一差距主要由两项任务中使用的不同简化启发式策略驱动。额外实验处理表明，启发式策略的选择受到信息环境中的统计量与信念更新问题所引发的统计量之间相似性的影响。
10.3982/ecta23334.title: The Inference‐Forecast Gap in Belief Updating
10.3982/ecta23334.title_zh: 信念更新中的推断-预测差距

10.3982/ecta23345.abstract: <jats:p>We consider impulse response inference in a locally misspecified vector autoregression (VAR) model. The conventional local projection (LP) confidence interval has correct coverage even when the misspecification is so large that it can be detected with probability approaching 1. This result follows from a “double robustness” property analogous to that of popular partially linear regression estimators. By contrast, the conventional VAR confidence interval with short‐to‐moderate lag length can severely undercover for misspecification that is small, difficult to detect statistically, and cannot be ruled out based on economic theory. The VAR confidence interval has robust coverage if, and only if, the lag length is so large that the interval is as wide as the LP interval.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23345.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在局部误设定的向量自回归（VAR）模型中脉冲响应推断的问题。传统的局部投影（LP）置信区间即使在误设定程度大到能以趋近于1的概率被检测到时，仍能保持正确的覆盖率。这一结果源于一种与流行的部分线性回归估计量相似的“双重稳健性”性质。相比之下，采用短至中等滞后长度的传统VAR置信区间，在面对较小、难以从统计上检测且无法基于经济理论排除的误设定时，可能严重低估覆盖率。VAR置信区间只有在滞后长度足够大，使其区间宽度与LP区间相当时，才具有稳健的覆盖率。
10.3982/ecta23345.title: Double Robustness of Local Projections and Some Unpleasant VARithmetic
10.3982/ecta23345.title_zh: 局部投影的双重稳健性与一些令人不快的VAR算术

10.3982/ecta23358.abstract: <jats:p>Unlike gender or race, class background is rarely a focus of research on career progression, or of DEI efforts in elite occupations. Should it be? In this paper, we document a large class gap in career progression in one occupation—U.S. tenure‐track academia—using parental education to proxy for class background. First‐generation college graduates are 10% less likely to be tenured at an R1, are tenured at institutions ranked 11% lower, earn 3% less, and report 5% lower job satisfaction, than their former PhD classmates (from the same institution and field) with a parent with a non‐PhD graduate degree. Neither selection out of academia nor different preferences explain this gap; differential research productivity also plays little role. Instead, likely drivers are differences in cultural and social capital. We also find a class gap in career progression for PhDs who work in industry, suggesting this phenomenon generalizes outside academia.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23358.abstract_zh: 与性别或种族不同，阶级背景很少成为职业发展研究或精英职业领域多元化、公平与包容（DEI）举措的关注焦点。那么，它是否应该被重视？本文以美国终身教职制学术界这一职业为例，利用父母教育程度作为阶级背景的代理变量，揭示了职业发展中的显著阶级差距。与父母拥有非博士研究生学位的同届博士同学（来自同一院校和领域）相比，第一代大学毕业生在R1研究型大学获得终身教职的可能性低10%，其任职院校排名低11%，收入少3%，且工作满意度低5%。这一差距既非源于学术界的选择性退出，也非偏好差异所致；研究生产力的差异同样作用甚微。相反，文化资本和社会资本的差异是可能的驱动因素。此外，我们发现在产业界工作的博士群体中也存在职业发展的阶级差距，这表明该现象具有超越学术界的普遍性。
10.3982/ecta23358.title: The Class Gap in Career Progression: Evidence From U.S. Academia
10.3982/ecta23358.title_zh: 职业晋升中的阶级差距：来自美国学术界的证据

10.3982/ecta23862.abstract: Certain extremum estimators have asymptotic distributions that are non‐Gaussian, yet characterizable as the distribution of the arg max of a Gaussian process. This paper presents high‐level sufficient conditions under which such asymptotic distributions admit a continuous distribution function. The plausibility of the sufficient conditions is demonstrated by verifying them in three examples, namely, maximum score estimation, empirical risk minimization, and threshold regression estimation. In turn, the continuity result buttresses several recently proposed inference procedures whose validity seems to require a result of the kind established herein. A notable feature of the high‐level assumptions is that one of them is designed to enable us to employ the Cameron–Martin theorem. In a leading special case, the assumption in question is demonstrably weak and appears to be close to minimal.
10.3982/ecta23862.abstract_zh: 某些极值估计量的渐近分布并非高斯分布，但可表征为高斯过程最大值参数的分布。本文提出了高阶充分条件，在这些条件下，此类渐近分布具有连续分布函数。通过三个实例——最大得分估计、经验风险最小化和阈值回归估计——验证了这些充分条件的可行性。连续性结果进而支持了几种近期提出的推断方法，这些方法的有效性似乎依赖于本文所确立的这类结果。高阶假设的一个显著特点是，其中一项旨在使我们能够运用Cameron–Martin定理。在一个主要特例中，该假设被证明是弱的，且接近最小化。

10.3982/ecta24060.abstract: In the context of one‐to‐one matching markets, we study myopic‐farsighted stable sets , which are internally and externally stable when myopic agents consider immediate payoffs from their deviations, while farsighted agents anticipate counter‐deviations and consider final payoffs. We constructively prove the existence of a (rational expectations) myopic‐farsighted stable set, in which farsighted agents receive a single payoff while myopic agents may receive multiple payoffs. Our existence result extends to settings with enforcing coalitions of arbitrary size, yielding coalitional myopic‐farsighted stable sets , and to settings where not all members of an enforcing coalition must strictly gain, yielding myopic‐farsighted weakly stable sets . When all farsighted agents have unit demand, our results also extend to many‐to‐one matching markets. As a key corollary, we provide a foundation for the efficiency‐adjusted deferred acceptance algorithm by showing that its outcome constitutes a singleton myopic‐farsighted stable set when one side is farsighted and the other is myopic.
10.3982/ecta24060.abstract_zh: 在一对一匹配市场的背景下，我们研究了近视-远视稳定集，当近视主体考虑其偏离行为的即时收益，而远视主体预期反偏离并考虑最终收益时，该集合在内部和外部均保持稳定。我们构造性地证明了（理性预期）近视-远视稳定集的存在性，其中远视主体获得单一收益，而近视主体可能获得多重收益。我们的存在性结果扩展至具有任意规模执行联盟的情形，从而产生联盟性近视-远视稳定集，并进一步扩展至执行联盟中并非所有成员必须严格获益的情形，从而产生近视-远视弱稳定集。当所有远视主体具有单位需求时，我们的结果也适用于多对一匹配市场。作为一个关键推论，我们为效率调整的延迟接受算法提供了理论基础，表明当一方为远视而另一方为近视时，其结果构成一个单元素近视-远视稳定集。

10.3982/ecta24210.abstract: Biopharmaceuticals advance health and economic growth. Unlike central bargaining abroad, the United States uses private firms, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), to manage medicine access and spending. Yet, PBMs' roles in advancing efficiency are understudied. Ho and Lee model PBMs' use of tiered formularies, lists of covered medicines, without the use of proprietary data on the price concessions drug makers offer for preferred placement. They find PBMs' use of tiered formularies generate significant payor savings through competition. Complementing Ho and Lee, Feng and Maini (2024) model how patient demand inertia limits PBMs' ability to extract price concessions from drug makers which consequently erodes the efficacy gains of PBM formularies. Conti, Frandsen, Powell, and Rebitzer (2021) model formulary auctions where PBM size drives payor savings, but also spurs endogenously set high list prices, reducing patient access. Future economic research should focus on PBM market entry and vertical integration, pharmacy steering, and effects on innovation.
10.3982/ecta24210.abstract_zh: 生物制药推动健康与经济增长。与国外集中谈判不同，美国依靠私营企业——药品福利管理者（PBMs）来管理药品获取与支出。然而，关于PBMs在提升效率方面的作用研究尚不充分。Ho和Lee构建了PBMs使用分级处方集（即承保药品清单）的模型，而未利用药企为获得优先地位而提供的价格优惠专有数据。他们发现，PBMs通过分级处方集的使用，借助竞争机制为支付方带来了显著的成本节省。作为对Ho和Lee研究的补充，Feng和Maini（2024）建模分析了患者需求惯性如何限制PBMs从药企获取价格优惠的能力，进而削弱了PBM处方集的效率收益。Conti、Frandsen、Powell和Rebitzer（2021）则对处方集拍卖进行了建模，指出PBM规模虽能驱动支付方节省成本，但也促使药企内生地设定高昂标价，从而降低了患者的药品可及性。未来经济研究应聚焦于PBM市场进入与纵向整合、药房引导行为及其对创新的影响。

10.3982/ecta24365.abstract: Tirole (1985) studied an overlapping generations model with capital accumulation and showed that the emergence of asset bubbles solves the capital over‐accumulation problem. His Proposition 1(c) claims that if the dividend growth rate is above the bubbleless interest rate (the steady‐state interest rate in the economy without the asset) but below the population growth rate, then bubbles are necessary in the sense that there exists no bubbleless equilibrium but there exists a unique bubbly equilibrium. We show that this result (as stated) is incorrect by presenting an example economy that satisfies all assumptions of Proposition 1(c) but its unique equilibrium is bubbleless. We also restore Proposition 1(c) under the additional assumptions that initial capital is sufficiently large and dividends are sufficiently small. We show through examples that these conditions are essential.
10.3982/ecta24365.abstract_zh: Tirole（1985）研究了一个包含资本积累的代际交叠模型，并指出资产泡沫的出现解决了资本过度积累问题。其命题1(c)声称，若股息增长率高于无泡沫利率（即无资产经济中的稳态利率）但低于人口增长率，则泡沫是必要的，即不存在无泡沫均衡，但存在唯一的有泡沫均衡。我们通过构造一个满足命题1(c)所有假设但唯一均衡为无泡沫的示例经济体，证明了该结果（如所述）是不正确的。我们还在额外假设初始资本足够大且股息足够小的条件下，恢复了命题1(c)。我们通过示例表明，这些条件是必不可少的。

10.3982/ecta944sum.title: Submission of Manuscripts to the Econometric Society Monograph Series
10.3982/ecta944sum.title_zh: 向计量经济学会专著系列投稿

10.3982/qe173bm.title: Backmatter of Quantitative Economics Vol. 17 Iss. 3
10.3982/qe173bm.title_zh: 数量经济学第17卷第3期附录

10.3982/qe173fm.title: Frontmatter of Quantitative Economics Vol. 17 Iss. 3
10.3982/qe173fm.title_zh: 《计量经济学》第17卷第3期卷首语

10.3982/qe2385.abstract: <jats:p>We study the binary choice problem in a data‐rich environment with asymmetric loss functions. The econometrics literature covers nonparametric binary choice problems but does not offer computationally attractive solutions in data‐rich environments. The machine learning literature has many algorithms but is focused mostly on loss functions that are independent of covariates. We show that theoretically valid decisions on binary outcomes with general loss functions can be achieved via a very simple loss‐based reweighting of logistic regression or state‐of‐the‐art machine learning techniques. We apply our analysis to algorithmic fairness in pretrial detentions.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2385.abstract_zh: 我们研究在数据丰富环境下具有非对称损失函数的二元选择问题。计量经济学文献涵盖了非参数二元选择问题，但未提供在数据丰富环境中具有计算吸引力的解决方案。机器学习文献包含许多算法，但主要关注与协变量无关的损失函数。我们证明，通过基于损失的简单重新加权逻辑回归或最先进的机器学习技术，可以在一般损失函数下实现对二元结果的理论有效决策。我们将分析应用于审前羁押中的算法公平性。
10.3982/qe2385.title: Binary choice under asymmetric loss in a data‐rich environment: Theory and an application to algorithmic fairness
10.3982/qe2385.title_zh: 数据丰富环境下非对称损失下的二元选择：理论与算法公平性应用

10.3982/qe2442.abstract: <jats:p>Using a heterogeneous agent model calibrated to match spending dynamics over four years following an income shock (Fagereng, Holm, and Natvik (2021)), we assess the effectiveness of three fiscal stimulus policies implemented during recent recessions. Unemployment insurance (UI) extensions are the “bang for the buck” winner when the metric is effectiveness in boosting utility. Stimulus checks are second‐best and have two advantages (over UI): they arrive faster, and are scalable. A temporary (two‐year) cut in wage taxation is considerably less effective than the other policies and has negligible effects in the version of our model without a multiplier.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2442.abstract_zh: 基于一个异质性主体模型（该模型校准后能复现收入冲击后四年内的支出动态，参见Fagereng, Holm, and Natvik (2021)），我们评估了近期经济衰退期间实施的三项财政刺激政策的有效性。以提升效用的有效性为衡量标准，失业保险（UI）延期是“性价比”最高的政策。刺激性支票次之，并具有两大优势（相对于失业保险）：到账更快且具有可扩展性。临时性（两年期）工资税削减的效果远不及其他政策，且在我们模型的无乘数版本中，其影响微乎其微。
10.3982/qe2442.title: Welfare and spending effects of consumption stimulus policies
10.3982/qe2442.title_zh: 消费刺激政策的福利与支出效应

10.3982/qe2529.abstract: <jats:p>Large VARs are increasingly used in structural analysis as a unified framework to study the impacts of multiple structural shocks simultaneously. However, the concurrent identification of multiple shocks using sign and ranking restrictions poses significant practical challenges to the point where existing algorithms cannot be used with such large VARs. To address this, we introduce a new numerically efficient algorithm that facilitates the estimation of impulse responses and related measures in large structural VARs identified with a large number of structural restrictions on impulse responses. The methodology is illustrated using a 35‐variable VAR with over 100 sign and ranking restrictions to identify 8 structural shocks.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2529.abstract_zh: 大型VAR模型越来越多地被用于结构分析，作为同时研究多种结构性冲击影响的统一框架。然而，利用符号约束和排序约束同时识别多种冲击，在实际操作中面临重大挑战，以至于现有算法无法应用于此类大型VAR模型。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的数值高效算法，该算法有助于在大型结构VAR模型中估计脉冲响应及相关指标，这些模型通过大量关于脉冲响应的结构性约束进行识别。该方法通过一个包含35个变量、超过100个符号约束和排序约束的VAR模型进行说明，用于识别8种结构性冲击。
10.3982/qe2529.title: Large structural VARs with multiple sign and ranking restrictions
10.3982/qe2529.title_zh: 具有多重符号与排序约束的大型结构向量自回归模型

10.3982/qe2638.abstract: <jats:p>In density forecasts, respondents are asked to assign probabilities to a response scale with pre‐specified ranges of inflation. In two large‐scale experiments, one conducted in the US and one in Germany, we show how the specifics of the response scale determine the results: Shifting, compressing, or expanding the scale leads to shifted, compressed, and expanded forecasts. Quantifying this effect using the scale most widely used among central banks, we find that mean forecast, uncertainty, and disagreement can vary by several percentage points. Density forecasts may severely misestimate the “true” inflation expectations, and may generate spurious changes in reported inflation uncertainty. The analysis suggests several ways to reduce this bias.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2638.abstract_zh: 在密度预测中，受访者需将概率分配给具有预设通胀区间的响应量表。通过在美国和德国开展的两项大规模实验，我们展示了响应量表的具体特征如何决定预测结果：移动、压缩或扩展量表会导致预测值相应移动、压缩或扩展。采用央行最广泛使用的量表量化这一效应后，我们发现平均预测值、不确定性和分歧程度可能相差数个百分点。密度预测可能严重误估"真实"通胀预期，并导致报告的通胀不确定性出现虚假变化。分析表明，可通过多种方式减少这一偏差。
10.3982/qe2638.title: Measuring inflation expectations: How the response scale shapes density forecasts
10.3982/qe2638.title_zh: 衡量通胀预期：响应量表如何塑造密度预测

10.3982/qe2674.abstract: Seasonal migration is a common strategy to mitigate rural seasonal deprivation, but migrants need to remit money during the lean season to family members facing food shortages. We observe counterintuitively low remittances in rural Nepal during periods of seasonal hunger, and migrants return with remittances later during harvest when food is relatively abundant. To indirectly overcome this apparent constraint in remittance timing, we provide a $90 consumption loan to randomly selected rural households during the pre‐harvest lean season. Loan‐recipient households increase pre‐harvest investments in fertilizer and time spent working on their own farm, smooth consumption, and save more of their migration income to bring it back home. Food security, subjective well‐being, rice harvest, and revenues improve. Ninety‐eight percent of beneficiaries repay the loan with the increased harvest‐period remittance. In a two‐period model of household decision making, we show that remittance frictions—a market failure—are necessary to qualitatively match our experimental results.
10.3982/qe2674.abstract_zh: 季节性迁移是缓解农村季节性匮乏的常见策略，但迁移者需在食物短缺的淡季向家人汇款。我们在尼泊尔农村观察到，在季节性饥饿期间汇款额反常偏低，而迁移者往往在收获季节食物相对充裕时才携带汇款返乡。为间接克服这种汇款时间上的明显约束，我们向随机选取的农村家庭在收获前淡季提供90美元消费贷款。获得贷款的家庭增加了淡季的化肥投资和自有农场劳动时间，实现了消费平滑，并将更多迁移收入储蓄后带回。粮食安全、主观幸福感、稻谷收成及收入均得到改善。98%的受益者通过增加收获期汇款偿还贷款。在家庭决策的两期模型中，我们证明汇款摩擦（一种市场失灵）是定性匹配实验结果的关键条件。
10.3982/qe2674.title: Remittance frictions and seasonal poverty
10.3982/qe2674.title_zh: 汇款摩擦与季节性贫困

10.3982/qe2681.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    An easy‐to‐interpret rule for the optimal risk‐adjusted social cost of carbon is derived using perturbation analysis. This rule internalizes the adverse effects of global warming on the risk of recurring climate‐related disasters, the risk of irreversible cascading climate tipping points, and the usual effect on total factor productivity. It and its three components approximate the true numerical optimum well, especially if the small parameters (i.e., the share of damages in GDP, the sensitivity of the risk of disasters to temperature and the risk of climate tipping) are small enough and the discount rate is not too small. The rule is also accurate if applied to AK models with a different supply side, for example, with ongoing technical progress in fossil‐fuel production or multiple economic sectors. With a growth‐adjusted discount rate of 2%/year, the SCC is $172/tCO
                    <jats:sub>2</jats:sub>
                    , 70% of which is due to recurring climate disasters and 9% to climate tipping risk.
                  </jats:p>
10.3982/qe2681.abstract_zh: 本文通过扰动分析推导出一个易于解释的最优风险调整社会碳成本规则。该规则内化了全球变暖对气候相关灾害复发风险、不可逆级联气候临界点风险以及对全要素生产率的常规影响。该规则及其三个组成部分能够很好地逼近真实数值最优解，尤其是当小参数（即损害占GDP的比重、灾害风险对温度的敏感度以及气候临界点风险）足够小且贴现率不太低时。该规则同样适用于供给侧不同的AK模型，例如化石燃料生产持续技术进步或多经济部门模型。在增长调整贴现率为每年2%的情况下，社会碳成本为172美元/吨二氧化碳，其中70%源于气候灾害复发风险，9%源于气候临界点风险。
10.3982/qe2681.title: Three reasons to price carbon under uncertainty: Accuracy of simple rules
10.3982/qe2681.title_zh: 不确定性下碳定价的三个理由：简单规则的准确性

10.3982/qe2719.abstract: <jats:p>We provide a complete description of the set of all solutions to a vector autoregressive law of motion. Every solution is shown to be the sum of three components, each corresponding to a directed flow of time. One component flows forward from the arbitrarily distant past, one flows backward from the arbitrarily distant future, and one flows outward from time zero. The three components are obtained by applying three complementary spectral projections to the solution, these corresponding to a separation of the eigenvalues of the autoregressive coefficient matrix according to whether they are inside, outside, or on the unit circle. We establish a one‐to‐one correspondence between the set of all solutions and a finite‐dimensional space of initial conditions.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2719.abstract_zh: 我们完整描述了向量自回归运动方程所有解集的构成。每个解均可分解为三个分量之和，分别对应三种定向时间流：一个分量从任意遥远的过去向前流动，一个分量从任意遥远的未来向后流动，一个分量从零时刻向外流动。这三个分量通过将三种互补谱投影应用于解而获得，其依据是自回归系数矩阵的特征值是否位于单位圆内、外或圆上。我们建立了所有解集与有限维初始条件空间之间的一一对应关系。
10.3982/qe2719.title: The general solution to an autoregressive law of motion
10.3982/qe2719.title_zh: 自回归运动定律的通解

10.3982/qe2768.abstract: <jats:p>The theory of infinitely repeated games may lack predictive power due to its insensitivity to, for example, changes in some game parameters, the timing of players' moves, and communication possibilities. We propose a new approach by studying an infinitely repeated prisoner's dilemma game and its variants where preferences for cooperation are heterogeneous, and strategic risk arises from incomplete information about opponents' preferences. Our model generates a rich set of comparative static predictions in a variety of settings. We show that, unlike standard theory and other existing models, our approach organizes the findings of a host of experiments including our novel experiments.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2768.abstract_zh: 无限重复博弈理论可能因对某些博弈参数变化、玩家行动时机及沟通可能性等因素不敏感而缺乏预测力。我们通过研究无限重复囚徒困境博弈及其变体提出新方法，其中合作偏好存在异质性，且战略风险源于对手偏好的不完全信息。我们的模型在多种情境下生成丰富的比较静态预测。研究表明，与标准理论及其他现有模型不同，我们的方法系统性地解释了包括我们新实验在内的一系列实验结果。
10.3982/qe2768.title: A new approach to the analysis of cooperation under the shadow of the future: Theory and experimental evidence
10.3982/qe2768.title_zh: 未来阴影下合作分析的新方法：理论与实验证据

10.3982/te213bm.title: Backmatter of Theoretical Economics Vol. 21 Iss. 3
10.3982/te213bm.title_zh: 理论经济学第21卷第3期附录

10.3982/te213fm.title: Frontmatter of Theoretical Economics Vol. 21 Iss. 3
10.3982/te213fm.title_zh: 理论经济学前沿 第21卷第3期

10.3982/te6170.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    We study the welfare effects of ambiguous product information for a buyer with
                    <jats:italic>α</jats:italic>
                    ‐max‐min preferences and a price‐setting seller. The buyer privately receives information about her valuation. We show that both the seller and the buyer can benefit when this information is ambiguous, and we characterize all possible combinations of producer and consumer surplus, as evaluated under ambiguity‐sensitive preferences. Ambiguity concerning the valuation perceived by the buyer when making the purchase decision can induce the seller to change the price. Before receiving information, ambiguity concerning the purchase decision can make the buyer optimistic about buying only for high valuations, which relaxes the participation constraint.
                  </jats:p>
10.3982/te6170.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有α-最大最小偏好的买方与定价卖方之间，模糊产品信息对福利的影响。买方私下获取关于其估值的信号。研究表明，当该信息具有模糊性时，买卖双方均可能获益，并刻画了在模糊敏感偏好下评估的所有可能的生产者剩余与消费者剩余组合。买方在做出购买决策时所感知的估值模糊性，可能促使卖方调整价格。在获取信息之前，购买决策的模糊性可能使买方对仅在高估值时购买持乐观态度，从而放宽了参与约束。
10.3982/te6170.title: Benefits and challenges of ambiguous product information
10.3982/te6170.title_zh: 模糊产品信息的益处与挑战

10.3982/te6187.abstract: <jats:p>In the context of Krugman's (1979) canonical new trade model, we demonstrate that a country is better off in autarky than in free and costless trade when the productivity of its trading partner is sufficiently low.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6187.abstract_zh: 在克鲁格曼（1979）经典新贸易模型的框架下，我们证明：当贸易伙伴的生产率足够低时，一国在自给自足状态下的福利水平优于无成本自由贸易。
10.3982/te6187.title: When autarky trumps free and costless trade
10.3982/te6187.title_zh: 当自给自足胜过自由且零成本的贸易

10.3982/te6224.abstract: <jats:p>Nonpartisan voters can become polarized not because of ideology but because it is optimal for them to remain uninformed and cancel out the votes of uninformed voters on “the other side.” Indeed, when stuck in such a state of polarization, it is socially optimal to do so. Dynamics can lead an otherwise well‐functioning assembly into irreversible polarization. Reputation effects might only make things worse.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6224.abstract_zh: 无党派选民可能走向极化，并非源于意识形态，而是因为保持信息闭塞、抵消“对立阵营”中信息闭塞选民的选票对其而言是最优选择。事实上，当陷入这种极化状态时，从社会整体来看，这样做也是最优的。动态过程可能使原本运作良好的议会陷入不可逆转的极化。声誉效应可能只会让情况雪上加霜。
10.3982/te6224.title: Ruth, Anthony, and Clarence

10.3982/te6338.abstract: <jats:p>I study the impact of consumer reviews on the incentives for firms to participate in the market. I develop a model of endogenous entry in which firms produce goods of heterogeneous, unknown quality. Consumers engage in directed search, and prices are exogenously fixed. A rater uses consumer reviews to construct firm‐specific ratings that are informative of quality and help consumers direct their search. The main insight of the paper is that suppressing the reviews of highly‐rated firms strengthens entry incentives and improves consumer welfare.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6338.abstract_zh: 本文研究了消费者评价对企业参与市场激励的影响。我构建了一个内生进入模型，其中企业生产异质性且质量未知的商品。消费者进行定向搜索，价格外生给定。评分者利用消费者评价构建企业特定评分，这些评分能反映质量信息并帮助消费者引导搜索。本文的主要发现是：抑制高评分企业的评价会增强企业进入市场的激励，并提升消费者福利。
10.3982/te6338.title: Ratings design and barriers to entry

10.3982/te6424.abstract: <jats:p>We present a model in which news media shape beliefs by providing information (signals about an exogenous state) and narratives (models of what determines outcomes). To amplify consumers' engagement, the media maximize their anticipatory utility. We characterize the optimal monopolistic media strategy, highlighting the synergy between false narratives and biased information. Consumer heterogeneity gives rise to a novel menu‐design problem due to an “equilibrium data externality” among consumers. The optimal menu includes false narratives, and can generate polarized beliefs and choices without any information transmission. False narratives and polarization also feature in a competitive version of our model, albeit coupled with complete information. Nevertheless, competition can make some consumers objectively worse off.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6424.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中新闻媒体通过提供信息（关于外生状态的信号）和叙事（解释结果决定因素的模型）来塑造信念。为提升消费者参与度，媒体最大化其预期效用。我们刻画了最优垄断媒体策略，揭示了虚假叙事与有偏信息之间的协同效应。消费者异质性引致了一个新颖的菜单设计问题，其根源在于消费者间的“均衡数据外部性”。最优菜单包含虚假叙事，且能在无任何信息传递的情况下催生极化信念与选择。在竞争性版本模型中，尽管伴随完全信息，虚假叙事与极化现象依然存在。然而，竞争可能使部分消费者的客观福利恶化。
10.3982/te6424.title: News media as suppliers of narratives (and information)
10.3982/te6424.title_zh: 新闻媒体作为叙事（及信息）的提供者

10.3982/te6439.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    A decision‐maker faces uncertainty governed by a data‐generating process (DGP), which is only known to belong to a set of sequences of independent but possibly non‐identical distributions. A robust decision maximizes the expected payoff against the worst possible DGP in this set. This paper characterizes when and how such robust decisions can be
                    <jats:italic>objectively</jats:italic>
                    improved with data; that is, can yield higher expected payoffs under the true DGP regardless of which DGP is the truth. It further develops simple and novel inference procedures that achieve such improvement, while common methods (e.g., maximum likelihood) may fail to do so.
                  </jats:p>
10.3982/te6439.abstract_zh: 决策者面临由数据生成过程（DGP）主导的不确定性，该过程仅已知属于一组独立但可能非同分布序列的集合。稳健决策旨在最大化该集合中最差可能DGP下的期望收益。本文刻画了何时以及如何利用数据实现此类稳健决策的**客观**改进——即无论真实DGP为何，均能在真实DGP下获得更高的期望收益。本文进一步开发了实现此类改进的简洁新颖推断程序，而常见方法（如极大似然法）可能无法达成此目标。
10.3982/te6439.title: Improving robust decisions with data
10.3982/te6439.title_zh: 利用数据改进稳健决策

10.3982/te6479.abstract: <jats:p>This paper compares digital and physical currency, focusing on a single intrinsic difference: digital, unlike physical currency, allows the monetary authority to trace the monetary flows in and out of the accounts. We show that this technological advance in recordkeeping can be used by the monetary authority to improve upon physical currency and achieve efficiency in a wide range of circumstances.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6479.abstract_zh: 本文比较了数字货币与实物货币，聚焦于一个本质区别：与实物货币不同，数字货币使货币当局能够追踪账户中的资金流入与流出。我们证明，货币当局可利用这一记账技术的进步，在实物货币基础上实现改进，并在广泛情境下达到效率最优。
10.3982/te6479.title: Physical versus digital currency A difference that makes a difference
10.3982/te6479.title_zh: 实物货币与数字货币：一种产生差异的差异

10.3982/te6567.abstract: <jats:p>We investigate the management of information provision to maximize user engagement. A principal sequentially reveals signals to an agent who has a limited amount of information processing capacity and can choose to exit at any time. We identify a “dilution” strategy—sending rare but highly informative signals—that maximizes user engagement. The platform's engagement metric shapes the direction and magnitude of biases in provided information relative to a user‐optimal benchmark. Even without intertemporal commitment, the platform replicates full‐commitment revenue by inducing the user's belief to remain “as uncertain as” the prior until the rare, decisive signal arrives and induces stopping. We apply our results to two contexts: an ad‐supported internet media platform and a teacher attempting to engage test‐motivated students.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6567.abstract_zh: 我们研究了信息提供管理以最大化用户参与度的问题。一位委托人向具有有限信息处理能力且可随时选择退出的代理人顺序揭示信号。我们识别出一种“稀释”策略——发送罕见但信息量大的信号——以最大化用户参与度。平台的参与度指标决定了所提供信息相对于用户最优基准的偏差方向和幅度。即使没有跨期承诺，平台也能通过使用户信念保持“与先验一样不确定”，直到罕见的关键信号到来并引发停止，从而复制完全承诺下的收益。我们将研究结果应用于两个场景：一个广告支持的互联网媒体平台，以及一位试图吸引考试驱动型学生的教师。
10.3982/te6567.title: Engagement maximization

10.3982/te6575.abstract: <jats:p>This paper develops a general theory to recover the inverse welfare function that rationalizes a given tax schedule as optimal. Our theory allows for complex environments including the presence of multidimensional tax schedules, bunching/jumping behavior, optimization frictions, general equilibrium effects, and externalities. We show that inverse welfare functions can be used to test for Pareto efficiency, construct Pareto improving reforms, and characterize the set of welfare improving local reforms, thereby extending previous results to more general environments. We show numerically that allowing for such generalities can have meaningful impacts on inverse welfare functions.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6575.abstract_zh: 本文发展了一个一般性理论，用于恢复将给定税收计划视为最优的逆福利函数。该理论适用于复杂环境，包括多维税收计划的存在、聚集/跳跃行为、优化摩擦、一般均衡效应以及外部性。我们证明，逆福利函数可用于检验帕累托效率、构建帕累托改进改革，并刻画福利改进局部改革的集合，从而将先前的研究结果扩展到更一般的环境中。数值分析表明，考虑这些一般性因素会对逆福利函数产生显著影响。
10.3982/te6575.title: A general theory of inverse welfare functions
10.3982/te6575.title_zh: 逆福利函数的一般理论

10.3982/te6786.abstract: <jats:p>We study markets where heterogeneous agents first make investment decisions and then engage in a costly search to form productive matches. The trading process is a random search and bargaining with explicit search costs. Despite potential hold‐up and matching problems, we prove that the constrained efficient allocation is an equilibrium: the agents' private incentives to invest and to accept/reject potential partners as they search are perfectly aligned with the social benefit. Furthermore, we establish a new sorting result for two‐sided markets, equilibrium existence, and conditions for uniqueness.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6786.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个市场，其中异质性主体首先进行投资决策，随后通过成本高昂的搜索来形成生产性匹配。交易过程涉及随机搜索和带有明确搜索成本的讨价还价。尽管存在潜在的敲竹杠和匹配问题，我们证明了受约束的有效配置是一种均衡：主体在投资以及搜索过程中接受或拒绝潜在合作伙伴时的私人激励与社会福利完全一致。此外，我们为双边市场建立了一个新的分类结果，证明了均衡的存在性，并给出了唯一性的条件。
10.3982/te6786.title: Efficient investment, search, and sorting in matching markets
10.3982/te6786.title_zh: 匹配市场中的有效投资、搜寻与分类

10.3982/te6816.abstract: <jats:p>We compare the degree of coalitional manipulability across stable school‐choice mechanisms. Although no stable mechanism is group strategy‐proof for all school choice contexts, we show that the student‐optimal stable mechanism is the least manipulable by coalitions, whereas the school‐optimal stable mechanism is the most coalitionally manipulable. These results still hold when students can only report truncated preferences, when the set of coalitions is limited, or when schools cannot be declared unacceptable as long as there are more available seats than students. In contrast, if there is a shortage of seats and students have no outside options, the school‐optimal stable mechanism can be less manipulable by coalitions than the student‐optimal stable mechanism.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6816.abstract_zh: 我们比较了不同稳定择校机制在联盟操纵性上的差异。尽管没有任何稳定机制在所有择校情境下都满足群体策略防操纵性，但我们发现：学生最优稳定机制是联盟操纵性最低的机制，而学校最优稳定机制则是联盟操纵性最高的机制。即使学生只能报告截断偏好、联盟集合受到限制，或当可用学额多于学生数时学校不能被声明为不可接受，这些结论依然成立。相反，若学额短缺且学生没有外部选择，学校最优稳定机制可能比学生最优稳定机制具有更低的联盟操纵性。
10.3982/te6816.title: Coalitional manipulability in school choice
10.3982/te6816.title_zh: 学校选择中的联盟可操纵性

10.4337/9781845421441.00008.abstract: This Paper analyses the relationship between different equity rules and the incentives to sign and ratify a climate agreement. A widespread conjecture suggests that a more equitable distribution of the burden of reducing emissions would enhance the incentives for more countries ? particularly big emitters ? to accept an emission reduction scheme defined within an international climate agreement. This Paper shows that this conjecture is only partly supported by the empirical evidence that can be derived from the recent outcomes of climate negotiations. Even though an equitable sharing of the costs of controlling GHG emissions can provide better incentives to sign and ratify a climate agreement than the burden sharing implicit in the Kyoto agreement, a stable global agreement cannot be achieved. A possible strategy to achieve a global agreement without free-riding incentives is a policy mix in which global emission trading is coupled with a transfer mechanism designed to offset incentives to free ride.
10.4337/9781845421441.00008.abstract_zh: 本文分析了不同公平规则与签署及批准气候协议激励之间的关系。一种普遍观点认为，更公平地分配减排负担将增强更多国家（尤其是排放大国）接受国际气候协议中减排方案的激励。本文表明，这一观点仅部分得到近期气候谈判结果中可推导出的经验证据支持。尽管公平分担温室气体排放控制成本比《京都议定书》隐含的负担分担更能提供签署和批准气候协议的激励，但稳定的全球协议仍无法实现。实现无搭便车激励的全球协议的可能策略是政策组合：将全球排放交易与旨在抵消搭便车激励的转移机制相结合。

10.5089/9781455209316.001.abstract: Financial frictions have been identified as key factors affecting both short-term economic fluctuations and long-term growth. An important policy question therefore is whether institutional reforms can reduce financial frictions and, if so, which reforms are best? We address this question by empirically investigating the effects of institutions on financial frictions using a canonical investment model. We consider two channels by which frictions affect investment: (i) through financial transaction costs at the individual firm (micro) level; and (ii) through the required rate of return at the country (macro) level. Using a panel of 75,000 firm-years across 48 countries for the period 1990-2007, we examine how, through these frictions, institutions affect investment. We find that improved corporate governance (e.g., less severe informational problems) and enhanced contractual enforcement reduce financial frictions affecting investment, while stronger creditor rights (e.g., lower collateral constraints) are less important.
10.5089/9781455209316.001.abstract_zh: 金融摩擦已被确认为影响短期经济波动与长期增长的关键因素。因此，一个重要的政策问题是：制度性改革能否减少金融摩擦？若能，何种改革最为有效？本文通过运用经典投资模型，实证研究制度对金融摩擦的影响，以回答上述问题。我们考察了摩擦影响投资的两条渠道：（i）通过单个企业（微观）层面的金融交易成本；（ii）通过国家（宏观）层面的必要回报率。基于1990-2007年间48个国家75,000个企业-年度观测值构成的面板数据，我们分析了制度如何通过上述摩擦渠道影响投资。研究发现：改善公司治理（如降低信息不对称程度）与强化契约执行能有效减少影响投资的金融摩擦，而增强债权人权利（如降低抵押约束）的作用相对较弱。
10.5089/9781455209316.001.title: Financial Frictions, Investment, and Institutions

10.5089/9781455209576.001.a001.abstract: We present a novel and comprehensive dataset of bilateral gross and net external positions in various financial instruments for the main advanced and emerging economies and regions, designed to improve our understanding of cross-border financial linkages. The data show no strong correspondence between country or region pairs with the largest gross versus net external positions, and the importance of international financial centers, including offshore centers, in intermediating financial flows. We also highlight some important data gaps in completing a network of cross-border holdings, related to the limited available information on the size and geographical pattern of external claims and liabilities of offshore centers, oil exporters, and other mostly emerging markets.
10.5089/9781455209576.001.a001.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个新颖且全面的双边总外部头寸与净外部头寸数据集，涵盖主要发达经济体与新兴经济体及地区在各类金融工具中的头寸情况，旨在深化对跨境金融关联的理解。数据显示，国家或地区对之间最大的总外部头寸与净外部头寸之间并无显著对应关系，同时凸显了国际金融中心（包括离岸中心）在金融流动中介中的关键作用。此外，我们还指出了构建跨境持有网络时存在的一些重要数据缺口，这些缺口与离岸中心、石油出口国及其他主要新兴市场在外部债权与负债规模及地理分布模式方面可获取信息的局限性相关。
10.5089/9781455209576.001.a001.title: Bilateral Financial Linkages and Global Imbalances: A View on The Eve of the Financial Crisis
10.5089/9781455209576.001.a001.title_zh: 双边金融联系与全球失衡：金融危机前夕的视角

10.56347/jle.v5i1.421.abstract: The global expansion of the halal industry has placed considerable pressure on food supply chains, particularly among small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in West Java's food sector. This research examines the interplay between halal operations management practices and supply chain integration to determine their combined effects on logistics performance, addressing persistent gaps in halal logistics efficiency. A quantitative approach employing partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) analyzes survey responses from 186 food SMEs across West Java, treating halal operations management and supply chain integration as key independent constructs, with logistics performance as the dependent variable; mediation effects were tested through bootstrapping procedures. Halal operations management significantly improves logistics performance, while supply chain integration fully mediates this relationship — West Java SMEs show measurable gains in on-time delivery and inventory efficiency when halal practices are structurally aligned with supply chain coordination. The cross-sectional design limits causal inference, and findings may not generalize beyond food SMEs in West Java; future research should examine longitudinal effects and multi-sector applications across Indonesia. This study is among the first to connect halal operations management with supply chain integration in explaining logistics performance among Indonesian SMEs, addressing theoretical gaps between Islamic business practices and modern supply chain theory while offering a practical framework for West Java's halal sector development.
10.56347/jle.v5i1.421.abstract_zh: 全球清真产业的扩张对食品供应链造成了显著压力，尤其是对西爪哇食品行业的中小企业（SMEs）而言。本研究探讨了清真运营管理实践与供应链整合之间的相互作用，以确定其对物流绩效的综合影响，从而解决清真物流效率中持续存在的空白。采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）的定量方法，分析了来自西爪哇186家食品中小企业的调查数据，将清真运营管理和供应链整合作为关键自变量，物流绩效作为因变量；通过自助法程序检验中介效应。清真运营管理显著提升了物流绩效，而供应链整合完全中介了这一关系——当清真实践与供应链协调在结构上保持一致时，西爪哇中小企业在准时交付和库存效率方面表现出可衡量的改善。横截面设计限制了因果推断，研究结果可能无法推广至西爪哇以外的食品中小企业；未来研究应考察纵向效应及印度尼西亚多行业应用。本研究首次将清真运营管理与供应链整合联系起来，以解释印度尼西亚中小企业的物流绩效，填补了伊斯兰商业实践与现代供应链理论之间的理论空白，同时为西爪哇清真产业发展提供了实用框架。
10.56347/jle.v5i1.421.title: The Interplay of Halal Operations Management and Supply Chain Integration on Logistics Performance in West Java's SMEs
10.56347/jle.v5i1.421.title_zh: 西爪哇中小企业中清真运营管理与供应链整合对物流绩效的交互作用

10.56347/jle.v5i1.424.abstract: E-commerce purchasing behavior among Generation Z warrants serious scholarly attention — this cohort constitutes the largest segment of active digital users whose decision-making processes are shaped in ways older consumer models do not adequately capture. This study examined the influence of social media, marketing communications, and customer reviews on e-commerce purchasing decisions in Medan City, focusing on Generation Z students at several private universities. A quantitative survey design was employed, with data collected via structured questionnaires distributed to 100 respondents and analyzed using SPSS 26, encompassing validity and reliability tests, classical assumption tests, multiple linear regression, t-tests, F-tests, and coefficient of determination. Each independent variable returned a positive and statistically significant effect on purchasing decisions. The simultaneous test confirmed that the three variables together exert a positive and significant influence on e-commerce purchasing decisions in Medan City. The Adjusted R Square of 0.417 indicates that 41.7% of the variance is accounted for by the model; the remaining 58.3% reflects variables outside the model's scope, including on-time delivery and discount practices.
10.56347/jle.v5i1.424.abstract_zh: Z世代群体的电子商务购买行为值得学界严肃关注——这一群体构成活跃数字用户的最大组成部分，其决策过程受到的影响是传统消费者模型无法充分捕捉的。本研究考察了社交媒体、营销传播和客户评价对棉兰市电子商务购买决策的影响，重点关注该市几所私立大学的Z世代学生。采用定量调查设计，通过结构化问卷向100名受访者收集数据，并运用SPSS 26进行分析，包括效度和信度检验、经典假设检验、多元线性回归、t检验、F检验和决定系数检验。每个自变量对购买决策均呈现正向且统计显著的影响。联合检验证实，三个变量共同对棉兰市电子商务购买决策产生正向且显著的影响。调整后的R平方值为0.417，表明模型解释了41.7%的方差；剩余58.3%反映模型范围之外的变量，包括准时配送和折扣实践。
10.56347/jle.v5i1.424.title: The Effect of Social Media, Marketing Communication, and Customer Reviews on Purchasing Decisions in E-Commerce among Generation Z Students in Medan City
10.56347/jle.v5i1.424.title_zh: 社交媒体、营销沟通与顾客评价对棉兰市Z世代学生电子商务购买决策的影响

10.56347/jle.v5i1.426.abstract: This study examines the role of State Administrative Law in promoting efficiency in the economic sector and social welfare through business licensing regulations. This issue is important because business licensing is not only an instrument of government control but also influences business actor behavior, transaction costs, legal certainty, and market competitiveness. The purpose of this study is to analyze government authority in terms of business licensing regulations and assess the extent of its influence on economic efficiency and public welfare. This study uses a normative juridical method with a statutory regulatory approach and a conceptual approach. Data were collected through a literature review of statutory regulations, state administrative law literature, and legal and economic studies. The analysis was conducted qualitatively by examining the relationship between administrative authority, licensing services, business actor compliance, and their impact on economic activity. The results of this study indicate that simple, transparent, and accountable business licensing can reduce bureaucratic barriers, increase compliance, and create certainty for business actors. Thus, State Administrative Law contributes significantly to building efficient, fair, and social welfare-oriented economic governance.
10.56347/jle.v5i1.426.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨国家行政法在通过商业许可法规促进经济部门效率与社会福利中的作用。该议题的重要性在于，商业许可不仅是政府管控的工具，更影响商业行为主体的决策、交易成本、法律确定性及市场竞争力。本研究旨在分析政府在商业许可法规中的行政权限，并评估其对经济效率与公共福利的影响程度。采用规范性法学研究方法，结合成文法路径与概念分析路径。通过文献综述收集成文法规定、国家行政法文献及法律经济学研究资料，运用定性分析方法考察行政权限、许可服务、商业主体合规性及其对经济活动影响的关联性。研究结果表明，简化、透明且可问责的商业许可制度能够降低官僚壁垒、提升合规水平，并为商业主体创造确定性。因此，国家行政法在构建高效、公平且以社会福利为导向的经济治理体系中发挥着关键作用。
10.56347/jle.v5i1.426.title: Perizinan Berusaha dalam Perspektif Hukum Administrasi Negara dan Ekonomi
10.56347/jle.v5i1.426.title_zh: 行政许可在国家行政法与经济学视角下的研究

10.56347/jle.v5i1.427.abstract: This study examined the understanding and compliance of taxpayers with respect to Value Added Tax (VAT) and Income Tax (PPh) Article 21 in West Java Province. Tax revenue constitutes the primary fiscal base of the Indonesian state, and the country's self-assessment system places the full burden of calculation, payment, and reporting on the taxpayer — making their level of understanding a direct determinant of compliance outcomes. A quantitative survey method was employed, with data gathered through structured questionnaires distributed to individual and corporate taxpayers subject to VAT and/or PPh Article 21 obligations. The findings indicate that taxpayer understanding of VAT and PPh Article 21 regulations does not produce a positive effect on compliance levels, whether measured through reporting behavior or payment conduct. Although overall compliance was relatively adequate, gaps in technical knowledge — particularly in tax administration procedures — remained apparent. Sustained investment in tax education and public outreach is therefore necessary to build more durable compliance patterns across West Java.
10.56347/jle.v5i1.427.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了西爪哇省纳税人对增值税（VAT）和第21条所得税（PPh）的理解与遵从情况。税收收入构成印度尼西亚国家的主要财政基础，而该国实行的自我评估制度将计算、缴纳和申报的全部责任置于纳税人身上——因此，纳税人的理解程度直接决定了其遵从结果。本研究采用定量调查方法，通过结构化问卷向负有增值税和/或第21条所得税义务的个人及企业纳税人收集数据。研究结果表明，纳税人对增值税和第21条所得税法规的理解，无论通过申报行为还是缴纳行为来衡量，均未对遵从水平产生正向影响。尽管总体遵从程度相对充足，但技术知识——尤其是税务管理程序方面的知识——仍存在明显缺口。因此，有必要持续投入税收教育和公众宣传，以在西爪哇省建立更持久的遵从模式。
10.56347/jle.v5i1.427.title: Pemahaman dan Kepatuhan Wajib Pajak terhadap PPN dan PPh Pasal 21 di Jawa Barat
10.56347/jle.v5i1.427.title_zh: 西爪哇省纳税人对增值税和第21条所得税的理解与遵从度

10.59576/sr.1195.abstract: We develop a unified approach to studying cost-price dynamics in the cross-section of firms in order to jointly explain the time series of aggregate inflation and the frequency of price changes, both during normal times and inflation surges. A key novelty is the use of microdata on firms’ prices and production costs to construct an empirical measure of price gaps—the deviation between a firm’s listed and optimal price. Conditional on the path of aggregate cost shocks extracted from the data, a state-dependent pricing model with strategic complementarities accounts well for both the linear cost-price dynamics of the pre-pandemic period and the nonlinear increase in inflation and frequency of price adjustment that followed.
10.59576/sr.1195.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种统一的方法，用于研究企业截面中的成本-价格动态，以共同解释总体通胀的时间序列和价格调整频率，无论是在正常时期还是通胀激增时期。一个关键创新在于，利用企业价格和生产成本的微观数据，构建了价格缺口（即企业标价与最优价格之间的偏差）的经验度量。在从数据中提取的总体成本冲击路径条件下，一个具有战略互补性的状态依赖定价模型，既能很好地解释疫情前时期的线性成本-价格动态，也能解释随后出现的通胀和价格调整频率的非线性上升。

10.65864/hr6fzcovxd.abstract: This paper reviews the constraints and difficult choices the government faces in managing the debt crisis. We explore two possible paths. In the first approach, the government seeks to avoid restructuring at all costs. For debt to remain sustainable, it needs to maintain extremely tight fiscal policy for an extended period and refinance existing debt at very low interest rates. We provide quantification of both efforts, and show that such a strategy could work, albeit under very narrow – and to some extent – unlikely, assumptions: the level of consolidation expected would probably deteriorate economic growth and be counterproductive, or politically unsustainable. Moreover, the level of bilateral or multilateral support would need to be substantial: only by securing partners willing to take risks at low interest rates could Senegal refinance its debt due in 2026 and 2027. It would also require large net financing from regional banks, thus transferring risks to the monetary union. In the second approach, the government aims to negotiate with its bilateral and private external creditors to restructure its debt under an IMF program. We argue that this could be achieved through a less radical fiscal adjustment than in the previous scenario, where restructuring is avoided. It would seek to avoid implicating regional lenders, arguing that doing so would worsen the country's prospects and even those of its external creditors. Such a strategy would also involve mobilizing the international community through new multilateral concessional loans, along with high-level political commitments from its main bilateral creditors, France and China, to achieve fast and comprehensive debt relief, comparable to that achieved by private creditors. It also requires strengthening fiscal and prudential oversight within the zone. We argue that while there are considerable pressures to repay, the economic literature teaches us that the costs of delaying a restructuring are higher.
10.65864/hr6fzcovxd.abstract_zh: 本文回顾了政府在管理债务危机中所面临的约束与艰难抉择。我们探讨了两条可能的路径。第一种路径中，政府力求不惜一切代价避免债务重组。为使债务保持可持续性，政府需在较长时期内维持极度紧缩的财政政策，并以极低的利率对现有债务进行再融资。我们对这两种努力进行了量化分析，并表明该策略虽有可能奏效，但前提假设极为狭窄——在某种程度上甚至不太可能成立：预期的财政整顿力度可能会恶化经济增长，产生反效果，或在政治上难以维系。此外，双边或多边支持的水平需相当可观：唯有获得愿意以低利率承担风险的合作伙伴，塞内加尔才能为其2026年和2027年到期的债务进行再融资。这还需从区域银行获得大规模净融资，从而将风险转移至货币联盟。第二种路径中，政府旨在与国际货币基金组织（IMF）项目框架下，与其双边及私人外部债权人进行谈判，以重组其债务。我们认为，相较于前一种避免重组的方案，此路径可通过力度较小的财政调整来实现。该策略力求避免牵涉区域贷款机构，并主张这样做将恶化国家前景，甚至损害其外部债权人的利益。这一策略还将涉及通过新的多边优惠贷款动员国际社会，并借助其主要双边债权人法国和中国的高层政治承诺，以实现快速而全面的债务减免，其程度可与私人债权人达成的减免相媲美。同时，还需加强区域内财政与审慎监管。我们认为，尽管存在相当大的偿还压力，但经济文献告诉我们，拖延重组的代价更高。

10.65864/hr6fzcovxd.title_zh: 塞内加尔债务危机导航的战略指南针

manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:15.abstract: Contingent behavior (CB) studies typically analyze changes in recreation demand at single sites by presenting identical scenarios to all respondents. This prevents assessing demand responses under diverse future conditions and across broader spatial scales. The present study applies the CB method using a general population survey, integrating self-reported site characteristics with an experimental design to define CB scenarios. This allows recreation demand to be modeled as a function of multiple environmental attributes and analyzed regionally but requires adjusting the prediction procedure. Using data on forest recreation in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Germany, we propose approaches for site- and region-level predictions. JEL Codes: Q51Q26
manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:15.abstract_zh: 条件行为（CB）研究通常通过向所有受访者呈现相同的情景，来分析单一地点的休闲需求变化。这阻碍了在不同未来条件及更广泛空间尺度下评估需求响应的能力。本研究采用一般人口调查应用CB方法，将自我报告的场地特征与实验设计相结合以定义CB情景。这使得休闲需求能够作为多种环境属性的函数进行建模，并在区域层面进行分析，但需要对预测程序进行调整。利用德国梅克伦堡-前波莫瑞州的森林休闲数据，我们提出了场地级和区域级预测的方法。JEL分类号：Q51Q26
manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:15.title: Applying the contingent behavior method at the regional level
manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:15.title_zh: 应用条件行为法于区域层面

manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:18.abstract: Cash crops can boost local economies but compete with forests for land. We quantify this tension in Benin using variation in cashew cultivation driven by heterogenous local responses to global cashew price volatility. We develop high-resolution cashew maps using a deep learning model trained on field data and pair it with gridded GDP data. Cashew cultivation degrades forests without generating detectable income gains. Muted income effects reflect (i) concentrated benefits obscured in coarse GDP data, and (ii) farmers valuing income-smoothing benefits of cashews over first order gains. Costbenefit calculations show each dollar earned from cashews incurs $16 in ecological costs. Keywords: Agriculturedevelopmentdeforestationcash cropsBenin
manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:18.abstract_zh: 经济作物能促进地方经济，但会与森林争夺土地。我们利用贝宁当地对全球腰果价格波动的异质性反应所驱动的腰果种植变化，量化了这一矛盾。我们开发了基于实地数据训练的深度学习模型生成的高分辨率腰果分布图，并将其与网格化GDP数据相结合。研究发现，腰果种植导致森林退化，却未产生可检测到的收入增长。收入效应微弱的原因在于：（i）收益集中，在粗略的GDP数据中被掩盖；（ii）农民更看重腰果带来的收入平滑效应，而非首要的收益增长。成本效益分析显示，每从腰果中获得1美元收入，需承担16美元的生态成本。关键词：农业发展；森林退化；经济作物；贝宁
manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:18.title: Cash Crops and the Development-Environment Tradeoff
manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:18.title_zh: 经济作物与发展-环境权衡

manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:36.abstract: Repeated surveys of New York State anglers eliciting fishing trips taken are used to estimate the willingness-to-pay to avoid fish consumption advisories. We consider over 1,300 in-state origins and 1,700 destinations and use site-specific constants to address time-invariant unobserved characteristics. Conditional logit models produce WTP values between $2.91 and $5.96 per day, while mixed logit models give average values of $1.16 to $1.72. We also estimate the values of recreational amenities (such as boat launches), which can be used to offset resource losses. JEL Codes: Q26H41C25
manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:36.abstract_zh: 通过对纽约州垂钓者进行重复调查，获取其钓鱼出行数据，用以估算规避鱼类消费建议的支付意愿。我们考虑了超过1，300个州内出发地和1，700个目的地，并采用地点特定常数来处理时间不变的非观测特征。条件Logit模型得出的支付意愿值介于每天2.91美元至5.96美元之间，而混合Logit模型的平均值为1.16美元至1.72美元。我们还估算了休闲设施（如船只下水坡道）的价值，这些可用于抵消资源损失。JEL代码：Q26H41C25

manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:36.title_zh: 渔业场所受损造成的自然资源损害

manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:37.abstract: Auctions have the potential to improve the cost-effectiveness of nonpoint source pollution abatement to which applying the polluter pays principle is difficult. Laboratory experiments have shown that revealing the environmental impacts of reducing polluting inputs to nonpoint sources (potential sellers) leads to the deterioration of auction performance. The auction mechanism that simultaneously achieves cost-effectiveness and transparency for reducing nonpoint source pollution remains unclear. Through a laboratory experiment, I find that although the disclosure of information on environmental impacts deteriorates auction performance, contrary to theoretical predictions, market segmentation improves performance and cancels out these impacts. JEL Q15Q53 This open access article is distributed under the terms of the CC-BY-NC-ND license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0) and is freely available online at: https://le.uwpress.org
manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:37.abstract_zh: 拍卖有潜力提升非点源污染治理的成本效益，而在此类污染中，应用污染者付费原则较为困难。实验室实验表明，向非点源（潜在卖方）披露减少污染投入的环境影响信息，会导致拍卖绩效恶化。目前，能够同时实现非点源污染削减成本效益与透明度的拍卖机制尚不明确。通过实验室实验，我发现尽管环境信息披露会恶化拍卖绩效，但与理论预测相反，市场分割能够改善绩效并抵消这些影响。JEL Q15Q53 本开放获取文章依据CC-BY-NC-ND许可（https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0）分发，并可在以下网址免费在线获取：https://le.uwpress.org

manual:2026-08-05-nodoi-2:37.title_zh: 非点源污染减排拍卖中的质量信息与市场细分

url:000e7bce45a41ddf.abstract: The labour force participation rate in the euro area has risen in recent years while it has declined in the US, significantly narrowing the gap between the two. This column analyses how demographic shifts are influencing the rate in both economies and finds that demographic changes are pushing participation lower, while education is an offsetting factor. The key distinction lies in within-group changes: in the euro area, these changes have significantly boosted participation, whereas in the US, they have had a small negative effect.
url:000e7bce45a41ddf.abstract_zh: 近年来，欧元区的劳动力参与率有所上升，而美国则出现下降，两者之间的差距显著缩小。本文分析人口结构变化如何影响这两个经济体的参与率，发现人口结构变化正推动参与率下降，而教育则是一个抵消因素。关键区别在于组内变化：在欧元区，这些变化显著提升了参与率，而在美国，它们产生了轻微的负面影响。
url:000e7bce45a41ddf.title: A comparison of labour force participation trends in the euro area and the US
url:000e7bce45a41ddf.title_zh: 欧元区与美国劳动力参与趋势的比较
