url:0d910368a6b8cd64.abstract: What role do firms play in geographic wage disparities? This paper exploits establishment mobility as a novel source of identification to separate firm sorting from location treatment effects, i.e., the local wage premium for a given worker at a given firm (due to, e.g., geography, infrastructure, amenities). Using data from France and the U.S., we first document key facts about establishment relocation: 4% of establishments move each year, retaining their activity and structure while adjusting their workforce and wages. Combining establishment and worker mobility in France, we estimate a model that decomposes wage variation due to workers, firms, and locations. Spatial wage differences are primarily driven by sorting: worker composition accounts for 30%, firm composition for 17%, and their co-location for 34%. Residual location effects explain only 2–4%. Establishment sorting also accounts for most of the urban wage premium and the higher wage growth in larger cities.
url:0d910368a6b8cd64.abstract_zh: 企业在地区工资差异中扮演何种角色？本文利用企业迁移作为新的识别来源，将企业分类效应与区位处理效应（即给定工人和给定企业在特定地点获得的工资溢价，例如由地理、基础设施、便利设施等因素导致）分离开来。基于法国和美国的数据，我们首先记录了企业迁移的关键事实：每年有4%的企业迁移，它们在保留自身活动和结构的同时调整员工队伍和工资水平。结合法国企业和工人的流动性，我们估计了一个分解工人、企业和地点对工资变化影响的模型。空间工资差异主要由分类效应驱动：工人构成解释30%，企业构成解释17%，两者共同定位解释34%。残余的区位效应仅解释2-4%。企业分类效应还解释了大部分城市工资溢价以及大城市中更高的工资增长。
url:0d910368a6b8cd64.title: Location Effects or Sorting? Evidence from Firm Relocation

url:0df9010781f45fc6.abstract: This paper evaluates a socio-emotional skills training programme for 4,728 urban Tanzanian youth who were not in full-time employment, education, or training. A randomized design compared awareness (for example, self-awareness, empathy, and active listening), management (for example, self-control, personal initiative, and negotiation), and combined curricula. Socio-emotional skills were measured using self-reported and behavioral indicators. Training increased self-reported socio-emotional skills in the short run across both domains, but had limited effects on behavioral measures, and all socio-emotional skills gains faded after one year. Modest but sustained employment gains were observed among men who were job seekers at baseline. Training did not improve labor market outcomes for women. No differential effects were found across training types, and each training affected skills in the alternative domain, suggesting that socio-emotional skills domains are interrelated. These findings indicate that socio-emotional skills training may improve labor market outcomes only for specific subgroups, particularly in the absence of complementary interventions tackling barriers to employment.
url:0df9010781f45fc6.abstract_zh: 本文评估了一项针对坦桑尼亚4,728名未处于全职就业、教育或培训状态的城市青年的社会情感技能培训项目。采用随机设计，比较了认知（例如自我认知、同理心和积极倾听）、管理（例如自我控制、个人主动性和谈判）以及综合课程的效果。社会情感技能通过自我报告和行为指标进行测量。培训在短期内提高了两个领域的自我报告社会情感技能，但对行为指标的影响有限，且所有社会情感技能的提升在一年后均消失。在基线时为求职者的男性中观察到适度但持续的就业改善。培训未能改善女性的劳动力市场结果。不同培训类型之间未发现差异化效应，且每种培训均影响了另一领域的技能，这表明社会情感技能领域相互关联。这些发现表明，社会情感技能培训可能仅对特定亚群体改善劳动力市场结果，尤其是在缺乏解决就业障碍的补充干预措施的情况下。
url:0df9010781f45fc6.title: Gender and Goals Matter for Youth Employment: Returns to Socio-Emotional Skills Training in Tanzania

url:0dfc428d15f8e89e.abstract: We examine how the impact of exports of goods and services on income per capita varies depending on the extent of labour rights violations in the export sector. In a sample of low- and middle-income countries, we find that specialising in sectors with high labour rights violations tends to reduce per capita income, due to lower productivity in those sectors. The negative impact of specialising in sectors with high labour rights violations is stronger in middle-income countries than in low-income countries.
url:0dfc428d15f8e89e.abstract_zh: 本文考察了商品与服务出口对人均收入的影响如何因出口部门劳动权益侵犯程度的不同而有所差异。基于中低收入国家样本，我们发现，专门从事劳动权益侵犯程度较高的部门往往会降低人均收入，其原因在于这些部门的生产率较低。相较于低收入国家，中等收入国家中专门从事高劳动权益侵犯部门所带来的负面效应更为显著。

url:0dff31ecd47cab31.abstract: Amid public skepticism toward trade, we investigate whether evidence-based information - concise statements of research findings - can shape trade policy preferences. In survey experiments conducted on U.S. general population samples from 2018-2022, we consistently uncover a “backfire effect”: information highlighting the benefits of trade, such as job gains in productive sectors or lower prices for consumers, induces protectionist preferences. We interpret this effect as stemming from prior-biased belief updating, whereby the information activates pre-existing concerns about competition for jobs and trade relations with China. These associations are evoked particularly among limited-attention respondents, as well as politically-engaged Republicans.
url:0dff31ecd47cab31.abstract_zh: 在公众对贸易持怀疑态度的背景下，我们探究基于证据的信息——即研究发现的简明陈述——能否影响贸易政策偏好。通过对2018-2022年美国普通人群样本进行的调查实验，我们一致发现了一种“反噬效应”：强调贸易益处（如生产性部门的就业增长或消费者价格降低）的信息，反而引发了保护主义偏好。我们将这一效应解释为源于先验偏误信念更新，即信息激活了关于就业竞争及对华贸易关系的既有担忧。这种关联在注意力有限的受访者以及政治参与度高的共和党人中尤为显著。
url:0dff31ecd47cab31.title: Can Evidence-Based Information Shift Preferences Towards Trade Policy?
url:0dff31ecd47cab31.title_zh: 基于证据的信息能否改变人们对贸易政策的偏好？

url:0e0e08a5bf502d85.abstract: COVID-19 became a global health emergency when it threatened the catastrophic collapse of health systems as demand for health goods and services and their relative prices surged. Governments responded with lockdowns and increases in transfers. Empirical evidence shows that lockdowns and healthcare saturation contribute to explain the cross-country variation in GDP drops even after controlling for COVID-19 cases and mortality. We explain this output-pandemia tradeoff as resulting from a shock to subsistence health demand that is larger at higher capital utilization in a model with entrepreneurs and workers. The health system moves closer to saturation as the gap between supply and subsistence narrows, which worsens consumption and income inequality. An externality distorts utilization, because firms do not internalize that lower utilization relaxes healthcare saturation. The optimal policy response includes lockdowns and transfers to workers. Quantitatively, strict lockdowns and large transfer hikes can be optimal and yield sizable welfare gains because they prevent a sharp rise in inequality. Welfare and output costs vary in response to small parameter changes or deviations from optimal policies. Weak lockdowns coupled with weak transfers programs are the worst alternative and yet are in line with what several emerging and least developed countries have implemented.
url:0e0e08a5bf502d85.abstract_zh: COVID-19成为全球卫生紧急事件，因为随着健康商品和服务的需求及其相对价格飙升，卫生系统面临灾难性崩溃的威胁。各国政府以封锁和增加转移支付作为应对措施。经验证据表明，即使在控制COVID-19病例数和死亡率之后，封锁和医疗系统饱和也有助于解释各国GDP下降的差异。我们在一个包含企业家和工人的模型中，将这种产出与大流行的权衡解释为源于生存性健康需求的冲击，该冲击在资本利用率更高时更大。随着供给与生存需求之间的差距缩小，卫生系统更接近饱和，这加剧了消费和收入不平等。一种外部性扭曲了利用率，因为企业没有内化较低的利用率会缓解医疗系统饱和这一事实。最优政策应对包括封锁和对工人的转移支付。定量分析显示，严格的封锁和大规模转移支付增加可能是最优的，并能带来可观的福利收益，因为它们防止了不平等的急剧上升。福利和产出成本会因参数的小幅变化或偏离最优政策而产生差异。弱封锁配合弱转移支付计划是最差的选择，然而这正是若干新兴经济体和最不发达国家所实施的政策。
url:0e0e08a5bf502d85.title: A Macroeconomic Model of Healthcare Saturation, Inequality & the Output-Pandemia Tradeoff
url:0e0e08a5bf502d85.title_zh: 医疗饱和、不平等与产出-大流行病权衡的宏观经济模型

url:0e397905d5f01cb1.abstract: This paper provides empirical evidence on the negative effects of political polarization on human capital allocation and hospital outcomes. Levering Spain’s centralized rank-based system for allocating recently graduated doctors to hospitals, we obtain (i) a precise measure of each doctor’s quality and (ii) their work-location choices. Exploiting a plausibly exogenous increase in political polarization in a Spanish region, we find that polarization reduces the average quality of incoming doctors, as higher-ranked candidates become less likely to select positions in the affected region. Examining the underlying mechanisms, we find evidence consistent with conflict avoidance rather than ideological sorting. Consistent with the documented decrease in doctors’ quality, we document an increase in risk-adjusted in-hospital mortality rates. Our findings highlight the broader economic and social costs of political polarization, particularly its impact on the distribution of skilled professionals and health.
url:0e397905d5f01cb1.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于政治极化对人力资本配置和医院结果负面影响的实证证据。利用西班牙基于中央排名的系统，将新毕业医生分配到各医院，我们获得了（i）每位医生质量的精确度量及（ii）其工作地点选择。利用西班牙某地区政治极化程度看似外生的增加，我们发现极化降低了新进医生的平均质量，因为排名较高的候选人选择受影响地区职位的可能性降低。在考察潜在机制时，我们发现了与冲突规避而非意识形态分类相一致的证据。与所记录的医生质量下降相一致，我们观察到风险调整后院内死亡率的上升。我们的发现凸显了政治极化更广泛的经济和社会成本，特别是其对熟练专业人员分布和健康的影响。
url:0e397905d5f01cb1.title: Political Polarization and Human Capital Allocation
url:0e397905d5f01cb1.title_zh: 政治极化与人力资本配置

url:0e3be3da482a95e4.abstract: We develop an information-based intervention against sexual harassment and test it in a randomized control trial across small groups of military recruits in the boot camp of the Norwegian military. The intervention seeks to bridge two knowledge gaps with implications for sexual harassment prevalence. We tell some recruits about their peers' beliefs that "telling sexualized jokes can be labeled sexual harassment" and about women soldiers' equal performance on military skill tests. This treatment gives lasting improvements in knowledge about what sexual harassment is and about women's job performance. The impact on sexual harassment prevalence is directionally negative but statistically insignificant. We discuss measurement error and use survey responses about a harassment scenario to argue that the intervention likely affected behavior. Our study provides the first field experiment to evaluate whether a prevention method against sexual harassment reduces prevalence in a work setting. We use insights from our research process to identify methodological pitfalls and provide guidance for future field experiments in this area.
url:0e3be3da482a95e4.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于信息的性骚扰干预措施，并在挪威军队新兵训练营的小规模新兵群体中通过随机对照试验进行了测试。该干预措施旨在弥合两个与性骚扰发生率相关的认知差距。我们向部分新兵告知其同伴认为“讲黄色笑话可被视为性骚扰”的观点，以及女兵在军事技能测试中表现同样出色的信息。这一干预措施显著提升了受试者对性骚扰定义及女性工作表现的认知，且效果具有持续性。干预对性骚扰发生率的影响呈负向趋势，但未达到统计显著性。我们讨论了测量误差问题，并利用关于骚扰情境的问卷调查结果论证该干预措施可能影响了实际行为。本研究提供了首个通过实地实验评估工作场所性骚扰预防措施有效性的证据。我们基于研究过程中的洞察识别了方法论陷阱，并为该领域未来的实地实验提供了指导建议。

url:0e3e2f1164c23aa1.abstract: This paper reviews firm-level data on artificial intelligence and the emerging evidence on AI's economic effects. It argues that measurement is central: different AI datasets capture different objects (including invention versus use, internal capability building versus outsourcing, and realized activity versus investor perceptions) and can therefore lead to different conclusions. The paper develops a framework for choosing among these measures and surveys available data sources on firm AI efforts. It synthesizes evidence on AI's effects on firm growth, valuation, productivity, risk, labor, competition, financial markets and applications. The paper concludes by suggesting some ideas for future research.
url:0e3e2f1164c23aa1.abstract_zh: 本文回顾了企业层面的人工智能数据及关于AI经济影响的新兴证据。文章强调测量至关重要：不同的AI数据集捕捉不同的对象（包括发明与使用、内部能力建设与外包、实际活动与投资者认知），因此可能导致不同的结论。本文构建了一个选择这些测量指标的框架，并调查了关于企业AI努力的现有数据来源。文章综合了AI对企业增长、估值、生产率、风险、劳动力、竞争、金融市场及应用方面影响的证据。最后，本文提出了一些未来研究方向的建议。

url:0e57bac241ebf977.abstract: How does terrorism affect labor markets in developing countries? We combine georeferenced data on terrorist incidents with nationally representative employment data from Nigeria to examine this question. Exploiting within-location variation in exposure to terrorist attacks over time, we show that terrorism reduces employment. A one standard deviation increase in exposure lowers the probability of employment by 0.7 percentage points, or roughly 1 percent of average employment, with substantially larger effects for women. Beyond reducing employment, terrorism shifts workers away from regular and cash-paying jobs and lowers employment in sales, services, and unskilled manual occupations. The findings identify labor market disruption as an important economic cost of insecurity in developing countries.
url:0e57bac241ebf977.abstract_zh: 恐怖主义如何影响发展中国家的劳动力市场？我们将恐怖袭击的地理参照数据与尼日利亚具有全国代表性的就业数据相结合来研究这一问题。通过利用同一地区在不同时期遭受恐怖袭击暴露程度的差异，我们发现恐怖主义会降低就业水平。恐怖袭击暴露程度每增加一个标准差，就业概率将下降0.7个百分点（约占平均就业率的1%），且对女性的影响显著更大。除减少就业外，恐怖主义还促使劳动者从正规就业和现金支付岗位转移，并导致销售、服务业及非熟练体力劳动岗位的就业下降。研究结果表明，劳动力市场紊乱是发展中国家不安全局势的重要经济代价。

url:0e7478b409238a2c.abstract: Secure property rights support efficient allocation and investment, yet their effects in affluent urban markets remain understudied. We examine Jerusalem properties built on church-owned land under 99-year leases approaching expiration, creating substantial legal and political uncertainty. Using all residential transactions from 2004–2024, we compare nearby properties with secure and insecure rights within the same blocks. Insecure rights reduce transaction likelihood by about 20 percent and prices by 10–15 percent on average, revealing large costs of legal uncertainty. A present-value framework implies that market participants assign a substantial, but far from certain, probability to losing rights.
url:0e7478b409238a2c.abstract_zh: 稳定的产权有助于资源的有效配置和投资，然而其在富裕城市市场中的影响尚未得到充分研究。我们考察了耶路撒冷建于教会所有土地上的房产，这些房产的99年租约即将到期，由此产生了重大的法律和政治不确定性。利用2004年至2024年的所有住宅交易数据，我们比较了同一街区内产权安全与不安全的邻近房产。不安全的产权使交易可能性平均降低约20%，价格下降10%至15%，揭示了法律不确定性的巨大成本。一个现值框架表明，市场参与者对失去产权的可能性赋予了显著但远非确定的概率。
url:0e7478b409238a2c.title: The Economic Consequences of Insecure Property Rights

url:0eed249bc3ff64cd.abstract: This Paper considers the implications of incomplete exchange rate pass-through for optimal monetary and exchange rate policy. A two-country model is presented which allows an explicit derivation of welfare functions in terms of a weighted sum of the second moments of producer prices and the nominal exchange rate. From a single country perspective the optimal exchange rate variance depends on the degree of pass-through, the size and openness of the economy, the elasticity of labour supply and the volatility of foreign producer prices. The optimal coordinated equilibrium can be supported by requiring national central banks to minimize loss functions, which are a weighted sum of the variances of producer prices and the exchange rate, where the weight on the exchange rate variance depends on the degree of pass-through.
url:0eed249bc3ff64cd.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了不完全汇率传递对最优货币与汇率政策的含义。通过构建两国模型，以生产者价格与名义汇率的二阶矩加权和形式明确推导出福利函数。从单一国家视角来看，最优汇率方差取决于汇率传递程度、经济体规模与开放度、劳动供给弹性以及外国生产者价格的波动性。最优协调均衡可通过要求各国央行最小化损失函数来实现，该损失函数由生产者价格方差与汇率方差的加权和构成，其中汇率方差的权重取决于汇率传递程度。

url:0f0f15b21f910f06.abstract: Data show that trade sanctions reduce commerce between the countries imposing them and their targets. But this bilateral success can conceal a wider failure if the sanctions induce the target to build stronger trade links elsewhere. This column uses sector-level trade data, including domestic sales, to estimate both the bilateral trade destruction and the third-country trade creation effects together. Across 22 sectors, complete sanctions usually promote trade between targets and third countries. Russia’s 2006 embargo on Georgia illustrates this fact: additional trade to third markets more than offset the estimated 57% decline in exports to Russia.
url:0f0f15b21f910f06.abstract_zh: 数据显示，贸易制裁减少了实施国与目标国之间的商业往来。然而，这种双边层面的成功可能掩盖了更广泛的失败，如果制裁促使目标国在其他地方建立更紧密的贸易联系。本文利用包括国内销售在内的部门级贸易数据，同时估计了双边贸易破坏效应和第三国贸易创造效应。在22个部门中，全面制裁通常促进目标国与第三国之间的贸易。俄罗斯2006年对格鲁吉亚的禁运说明了这一事实：对第三市场增加的贸易量超过了向俄罗斯出口估计下降57%的影响。

url:0f24a5503edb8e7d.abstract: This paper tests whether partially unemployed workers value future preserved benefits when they bunch at the kink of the unemployment insurance benefit-withdrawal schedule. I extend the bunching formula of Saez (2010) to a dynamic setting that accounts for the value of future benefits tied to taxation. This yields new tests of tax-benefit linkage based on bunching heterogeneity. I verify in quasi-experiments that U.S. UI extension programs that decrease the value of future benefits lead to more bunching and to lower labor supply. Last, a quantification exercise of the dynamic bunching formula provides extra support for a strong tax-benefit linkage.
url:0f24a5503edb8e7d.abstract_zh: 本文检验了部分失业工人在失业保险金递减计划的拐点处聚集时，是否重视未来保留的福利。我将Saez（2010）的聚集公式扩展至动态环境，该环境考虑了与税收挂钩的未来福利价值，从而基于聚集异质性提出了税收-福利关联的新检验。通过准实验验证，美国失业保险延长计划降低了未来福利价值，导致更多聚集现象和更低的劳动供给。最后，动态聚集公式的量化分析进一步支持了税收-福利关联的强存在性。
url:0f24a5503edb8e7d.title: Taxes Today, Benefits Tomorrow

url:0f2ecf6d18205c92.abstract: Many public institutions are now experimenting with AI tools to support surveillance, supervision, and policy analysis, raising questions about which analytical tasks can be delegated to machines and which still require expert judgement. Comparing several GPT models with IMF economists’ assessments of Article IV staff reports, this column shows that today’s best models perform well on structured, factual tasks but remain less reliable on nuanced rating questions, where human judgement still matters.
url:0f2ecf6d18205c92.abstract_zh: 许多公共机构正尝试运用人工智能工具来辅助监控、监管及政策分析，这引发了关于哪些分析任务可交由机器处理、哪些仍需专家判断的疑问。通过对比多种GPT模型与国际货币基金组织经济学家对第四条磋商工作人员报告的评估，本专栏指出，当前最先进的模型在结构化、事实性任务上表现出色，但在涉及细微差别的评级问题上仍不够可靠，这些领域人类的判断依然至关重要。

url:0f382ef1e2dcc6ed.abstract: It has been argued in the literature that interjurisdictional competition forces the public sector to increase its efficiency and thus helps to tame Leviathan governments. The paper addresses this hypothesis by means of a simple tax-competition model with a Leviathan state. It is seen that the effects of increased factor mobility on the efficiency of the public sector are ambiguous. A calibration of the model shows that a reduction in public-sector efficiency is possible for parameter constellations which are not unrealistic.
url:0f382ef1e2dcc6ed.abstract_zh: 文献中已有观点认为，辖区间竞争迫使公共部门提升效率，从而有助于约束利维坦式政府。本文通过一个包含利维坦政府的简单税收竞争模型验证这一假说。研究发现，要素流动性增强对公共部门效率的影响具有不确定性。模型校准表明，在并非不现实的参数组合下，公共部门效率下降是可能出现的。

url:0f3ce025e58d0517.abstract: This paper leverages the unexpected successful activation of a sea wall built to protect Venice from rising tides to estimate the capitalization into property values of public investment in resilience infrastructure. Using a difference-in-differences hedonic approach with high-frequency microdata on residential and commercial properties, we show that properties above the sea wall activation threshold experience a permanent reduction in flood risk and expected damages, reflected in higher prices. To account for city-wide effects and potential ex-post government bailouts, we analyze the effect of the second-largest flood in Venice centuries-long history on properties prices relative to the mainland as well as data on government claims matched with property elevations. Our findings indicate that capitalized benefits and projected government savings cover approximately 52% (101%) of the sea wall costs in a status-quo (sea-level-rise) scenario. Lastly, we calculate a break-even discount rate of 1.1%, which increases to to 2.5% under sea-level-rise projections.
url:0f3ce025e58d0517.abstract_zh: 本文利用威尼斯为抵御潮汐上涨而修建的海堤意外成功激活这一事件，评估韧性基础设施公共投资对房产价值的资本化效应。采用双重差分特征价格法，结合住宅与商业地产的高频微观数据，我们发现：位于海堤激活阈值以上的房产，其洪水风险与预期损失出现永久性降低，并反映为更高的价格。为考量全市范围的影响及潜在的灾后政府救助，我们分析了威尼斯数百年历史上第二大洪水对房产价格（相对于大陆地区）的影响，并匹配了政府索赔数据与房产海拔信息。研究结果表明：在现状情景下，资本化收益与预计政府节省的成本可覆盖海堤建设成本的约52%；在海平面上升情景下，这一比例升至101%。最后，我们测算出盈亏平衡贴现率为1.1%，而在海平面上升预测下，该比率将升至2.5%。

url:0f3f241a884f0ea3.abstract: This paper examines the drivers of wage growth in Europe and assesses whether the 2022–23 inflation surge has altered wage-setting dynamics, using cross-country macro evidence for 26 European economies, agreement-level collective bargaining data for Spain, and estimates of minimum and public sector wage spillovers. We find that the slope of the wage Phillips curve has not materially changed since the pandemic—labor market slack continues exerting a restraining influence on wage growth. However, postpandemic wage growth was higher than predicted by historical relationships, reflecting the outsized inflation shock and a higher sensitivity of wages to past inflation. Wage-setting is found to differ markedly across regions. In Central, Eastern, and Southeastern European Economies (CESEE), wage formation remains more backward-looking, with past inflation playing a dominant role, whereas in Advanced Economies (AEs) inflation expectations are more important. In AEs, the recent wage response followed a sequential pattern: the wage drift rose early as employers granted ad hoc increases, while negotiated wages adjusted with a lag as collective agreements were renewed and workers recouped accumulated real wage losses. Micro evidence from Spain shows that institutional features of collective bargaining conditionally amplify inflation pass-through: CPI indexation clauses, sector-level bargaining, and shorter contract duration are each associated with stronger wage responses to past inflation. In parallel, minimum wage pass-through has strengthened markedly in CESEE since 2015, while public sector wages dampened aggregate wage growth in AEs but amplified it in CESEE during 2022–24. Taken together, these findings suggest that while the core Phillips curve mechanism remains intact, future inflation shocks could generate more persistent wage pressures where wage-setting is more backward-looking, inflation compensation becomes institutionalized (including through indexation that interacts with downward nominal rigidity), or discretionary minimum and public sector wage policies add impetus.
url:0f3f241a884f0ea3.abstract_zh: 本文利用26个欧洲经济体的跨国宏观数据、西班牙的协议层面集体谈判数据以及最低工资与公共部门工资溢出效应的估算，考察了欧洲工资增长的驱动因素，并评估2022-23年通胀飙升是否改变了工资设定动态。研究发现，自疫情以来，工资菲利普斯曲线的斜率并未发生实质性变化——劳动力市场松弛仍对工资增长产生抑制作用。然而，疫情后工资增长高于历史关系预测水平，这反映了巨大的通胀冲击以及工资对过去通胀的更高敏感性。工资设定在不同地区存在显著差异。在中东欧及东南欧经济体（CESEE）中，工资形成仍更偏向回顾性，过去通胀起主导作用；而在发达经济体（AEs）中，通胀预期更为重要。在发达经济体中，近期的工资反应遵循了顺序模式：工资漂移率先上升，因为雇主提供了临时性加薪，而随着集体协议更新和工人弥补累积的实际工资损失，协商工资则滞后调整。来自西班牙的微观证据表明，集体谈判的制度特征有条件地放大了通胀传导：CPI指数化条款、行业层面谈判以及较短的合同期限均与工资对过去通胀的更强反应相关。与此同时，自2015年以来，最低工资传导在CESEE显著增强，而公共部门工资在2022-24年间抑制了发达经济体的总体工资增长，但在CESEE却放大了工资增长。综合来看，这些发现表明，尽管核心菲利普斯曲线机制保持完整，但未来通胀冲击可能在以下情况下产生更持久的工资压力：工资设定更偏向回顾性、通胀补偿变得制度化（包括通过指数化与名义向下刚性相互作用）、或自由裁量的最低工资和公共部门工资政策增加推动力。

url:0f5786d3023afca0.abstract: Do higher aspirations for the future motivate people living in poverty to make long-term investments? Do their aspirations increase when economic conditions improve? To answer these questions, we run a 415-village field experiment with 8,300 women living in poverty in rural Kenya. We design an 80-minute workshop to help people set higher aspirations and plan to achieve them.
url:0f5786d3023afca0.abstract_zh: 对未来更高的期望是否会激励贫困人口进行长期投资？当经济条件改善时，他们的期望是否会随之提高？为解答这些问题，我们在肯尼亚农村开展了一项涉及415个村庄、8300名贫困女性的实地实验。我们设计了一个80分钟的研讨会，旨在帮助参与者树立更高的期望并规划实现路径。
url:0f5786d3023afca0.title: Aspiring to a Better Future: Can a Simple Psychological Intervention Reduce Poverty?
url:0f5786d3023afca0.title_zh: 追求更美好的未来：一项简单的心理干预能否减少贫困？

url:0f62f6ba54cb5b26.abstract: This paper studies the macroeconomic dynamics of climate policy in a multi-sector dynamic general equilibrium model with renewable and non-renewable energy, sector-specific capital adjustment frictions, household energy demand, and endogenous fossil resource dynamics. The central mechanism is that decarbonization requires reallocating energy use and installed capital: fossil energy demand can contract immediately, while renewable capacity and abatement adjust only gradually. The analysis delivers four results. First, gradual policy implementation sharply reduces transition costs: relative to immediate implementation, gradual emissions caps improve welfare by 2.26 percentage points under comprehensive regulation and by 5.06 percentage points under firm-only regulation. Second, renewable energy subsidies and non-renewable energy taxes support renewable capital accumulation and reduce, but do not eliminate, the welfare cost of front-loaded tightening. Third, sectoral coverage changes the welfare ranking across implementation speeds. Firm-only regulation performs better under gradual implementation because it shields utility-relevant household energy services, but becomes nearly as costly as the carbon-price-only transition under immediate implementation. Fourth, endogenous fossil exploration and stock-dependent extraction costs transmit climate policy into lower extraction, fewer discoveries, and a declining shadow value of reserves, providing a structural mechanism for stranded fossil assets. The results show that deep decarbonization can be achieved at substantially lower macroeconomic cost when policy manages the speed and incidence of energy-capital reallocation.
url:0f62f6ba54cb5b26.abstract_zh: 本文在多部门动态一般均衡模型中研究气候政策的宏观经济动态，该模型包含可再生能源与不可再生能源、部门特定的资本调整摩擦、家庭能源需求以及内生的化石资源动态。核心机制在于：脱碳需要重新配置能源使用和已安装资本——化石能源需求可立即收缩，而可再生能源产能与减排措施仅能逐步调整。分析得出四项结论。第一，渐进式政策实施能显著降低转型成本：相较于立即实施，在全面监管下渐进式排放上限可使福利提升2.26个百分点，在企业单独监管下则提升5.06个百分点。第二，可再生能源补贴与不可再生能源税有助于促进可再生能源资本积累，并降低（但无法消除）前置收紧带来的福利成本。第三，部门覆盖范围会改变不同实施速度下的福利排序。渐进式实施中企业单独监管表现更优，因其保护了与效用相关的家庭能源服务，但在立即实施下其成本几乎与仅依赖碳价格的转型相当。第四，内生的化石能源勘探与储量依赖型开采成本使气候政策传导为开采量下降、发现量减少及储量影子价值降低，为化石资产搁浅提供了结构性机制。研究结果表明，当政策能够管理能源-资本重新配置的速度与影响范围时，深度脱碳可在显著降低宏观经济成本的条件下实现。
url:0f62f6ba54cb5b26.title: Climate Policy and The Energy Transition

url:0f7cea7ee74c4eba.abstract: Divorce reshapes family life, yet little is known about one of its most consequential features: the allocation of child custody. We study the impact of joint versus sole custody on both parents and children using rich administrative data from Sweden linked to over 25 years of newly-collected court custody rulings. To address selection concerns, we exploit random assignment of custody disputes to judges who differ sharply in their propensity to grant joint custody. For fathers, joint custody substantially raises earnings and improves mental health, consistent with sustained paternal involvement enhancing labor market attachment and psychological well-being. In contrast, there are no measurable labor market or mental health effects for mothers. Turning to children, joint custody increases standardized test scores and school quality without affecting mental health outcomes. Joint custody increases fathers
url:0f7cea7ee74c4eba.abstract_zh: 离婚重塑了家庭生活，然而关于其最具深远影响的特征之一——子女监护权的分配，我们知之甚少。我们利用瑞典超过25年新收集的法院监护裁决行政数据，研究共同监护与单独监护对父母及子女的影响。为应对选择性问题，我们利用监护争议案件随机分配给在授予共同监护倾向上存在显著差异的法官这一机制。对父亲而言，共同监护显著提高了其收入并改善了心理健康，这与持续的父职参与增强劳动力市场依附和心理福祉相一致。相比之下，对母亲则未观察到可测量的劳动力市场或心理健康效应。就子女而言，共同监护提高了标准化测试成绩和学校质量，且未影响心理健康结果。共同监护增加了父亲的
url:0f7cea7ee74c4eba.title: Life After Divorce: Effects of Joint Custody on Parents and Children
url:0f7cea7ee74c4eba.title_zh: 离婚后的生活：共同监护对父母及子女的影响

url:0f8727467995d6b6.abstract: Agrifood systems (AFS) in Colombia and Peru generate substantial economic value but also impose significant environmental and social externalities that remain unpriced and largely invisible in policy and market decisions. Using the Global Impact Database (GID) and a True Cost Accounting (TCA) framework, this paper quantifies the hidden costs embedded in 19 AFS sectors, with a focus on seven major crop sectors. As one of the first cross-country applications of GID data in Latin America, the analysis offers a harmonized and comprehensive assessment of the true costs of food production, processing, and distribution. Results show that externalities are equivalent to 12 percent of AFS output in Colombia and 13 percent in Peru—a substantial burden that is not captured by conventional economic indicators. Environmental externalities dominate in both countries, driven primarily by land occupation, climate change, air pollution, and use of scarce water. Social externalities—especially underpayment, child labor, and gender wage gaps—are smaller in aggregate but become markedly more significant within crop sectors, as labor intensity and informality characterize production systems. Livestock, dairy, and bovine meat products consistently emerge as the most externality‑intensive sectors, while cereals, rice, sugarcane, oilseeds, and fruits and vegetables exhibit comparatively lower externality costs. Value‑chain decomposition shows that most externalities originate at the production stage (at farm level). These findings highlight several clear leverage points for targeted policy and investment: reducing environmental pressures in livestock systems, improving labor conditions in crop sectors, and integrating TCA metrics into national planning and sustainability strategies. Making the hidden costs visible is essential for advancing more sustainable, equitable, inclusive, and resilient food systems in Colombia and Peru.
url:0f8727467995d6b6.abstract_zh: 哥伦比亚和秘鲁的农粮系统（AFS）创造了可观的经济价值，但也带来了重大的环境和社会外部性，这些外部性在政策和市场决策中仍未定价且基本不可见。本文利用全球影响数据库（GID）和真实成本核算（TCA）框架，量化了19个农粮系统部门中隐含的隐性成本，重点关注七个主要作物部门。作为拉丁美洲GID数据首批跨国应用之一，本分析提供了对粮食生产、加工和分配真实成本的统一且全面的评估。结果显示，外部性相当于哥伦比亚农粮系统产出的12%和秘鲁的13%——这一沉重负担未被传统经济指标所捕捉。两国均以环境外部性为主导，主要驱动因素为土地占用、气候变化、空气污染和稀缺水资源的使用。社会外部性——尤其是工资不足、童工和性别工资差距——在总量上较小，但在作物部门内显著更为突出，因为生产系统以劳动密集和非正规化为特征。畜牧业、乳制品和牛肉产品始终是外部性最密集的部门，而谷物、水稻、甘蔗、油籽以及水果和蔬菜的外部性成本相对较低。价值链分解显示，大多数外部性产生于生产阶段（农场层面）。这些发现凸显了若干明确的政策和投资杠杆点：减少畜牧系统环境压力、改善作物部门劳动条件，以及将TCA指标纳入国家规划和可持续性战略。使隐性成本可见对于推进哥伦比亚和秘鲁更可持续、公平、包容和有韧性的粮食系统至关重要。
url:0f8727467995d6b6.title: Assessing environmental and social burdens in agrifood systems: Insights from Colombia and Peru
url:0f8727467995d6b6.title_zh: 评估农业食品系统中的环境与社会负担：来自哥伦比亚和秘鲁的启示

url:0f957154561c91da.abstract: We test the effectiveness of different AI-delivered conversation protocols to increase people's motivation for change. In a large-scale experiment with 2,719 social media users, we randomly assign participants to a control conversation or one of three treatment arms: two Motivational Interviewing protocols promoting self-persuasion (change focus or decisional balance) and a direct persuasion protocol providing unsolicited advice and information. All conversations are led by an AI interviewer, enabling standardized delivery of each protocol at scale. Our results show that all three interventions significantly increase motivation for change and the perceived costs of social media use, with change-focused self-persuasion yielding the largest effects. These effects persist and translate into self-reported reductions in social media use more than two weeks after the intervention. Our findings illustrate how AI-led conversations can serve as a scalable platform both for delivering behavioral interventions and for testing what makes them effective by systematically varying how conversations are conducted.
url:0f957154561c91da.abstract_zh: 我们测试了不同AI引导对话协议在提升人们改变动机方面的有效性。在一项包含2719名社交媒体用户的大规模实验中，我们将参与者随机分配至对照组对话或三种实验组之一：两种基于动机性访谈的自我说服协议（聚焦改变或决策平衡），以及一种提供主动建议与信息的直接说服协议。所有对话均由AI访谈员主导，从而实现对每种协议的大规模标准化实施。结果显示，三种干预措施均显著提升了参与者的改变动机及对社交媒体使用成本的感知，其中聚焦改变的自我说服协议效果最为显著。这些效应在干预实施两周后依然持续存在，并转化为参与者自我报告的社交媒体使用减少。我们的研究结果表明，AI主导的对话可作为可扩展平台，既用于实施行为干预，也可通过系统性地改变对话方式，检验干预措施的有效性机制。
url:0f957154561c91da.title: Evaluating Behavioral Interventions at Scale with AI
url:0f957154561c91da.title_zh: 利用人工智能大规模评估行为干预措施

url:0fd4212539746b63.title: Does the stepping‐stone effect of temporary agency employment vary over the business cycle?
url:0fd4212539746b63.title_zh: 临时派遣就业的垫脚石效应是否随经济周期变化？

url:0fd9f776952ff8d4.abstract: We present a new constraint on the size of the Fed’s balance sheet: repo market capacity. Calibrating a structural model to the recent monetary tightening cycle, we show that repo market capacity—driven by money market fund liquidity supply—is the binding constraint on the Fed’s balance sheet, not bank reserve demand, which was highlighted in the events of September 2019. We also demonstrate a novel complementarity between interest rate and balance sheet policies: higher policy rates expand repo capacity, allowing the central bank to operate with a smaller balance sheet.
url:0fd9f776952ff8d4.abstract_zh: 我们提出了美联储资产负债表规模的新约束条件：回购市场容量。通过将结构性模型校准至近期的货币紧缩周期，我们表明，由货币市场基金流动性供给驱动的回购市场容量才是美联储资产负债表的约束性条件，而非2019年9月事件中凸显的银行准备金需求。我们还揭示了利率政策与资产负债表政策之间一种新颖的互补关系：更高的政策利率会扩大回购市场容量，从而使央行能够以更小的资产负债表规模运作。
url:0fd9f776952ff8d4.title: Beyond Reserves: The Federal Reserve's Balance Sheet and the Repo Market
url:0fd9f776952ff8d4.title_zh: 超越储备：美联储资产负债表与回购市场

url:0fe05fc9aba47f6d.abstract: This working paper explores strategies and interventions that LTC systems in ECA could adopt to strengthen the climate resilience of people with functional limitations and their caregivers. After a short section on methodology and conceptual framing, the paper introduces the IPCC climate risk framework and outlines the main climate hazards projected for ECA, noting their varying frequency and intensity across the region. It then examines how individual vulnerability shapes the impact of these hazards, with a focus on older people and people with disabilities, whose functional limitations and care needs increase their susceptibility. The analysis considers biological and health factors, social circumstances, and structural conditions that heighten vulnerability to both climate shocks and gradual changes such as rising temperatures. The paper then turns to international experience, highlighting approaches from selected OECD countries that have modified their LTC systems or introduced innovations to protect people with care needs—and, in some cases, a broader population of older people and people with disabilities from climate risks. Building on these case studies and a wider literature review, the paper identifies a set of strategies across LTC system functions t hat ECA countries could apply before, during, and after climate hazards to maintain essential care, address emerging needs, and extend support to groups not currently covered. The paper concludes with questions for further research and analysis.
url:0fe05fc9aba47f6d.abstract_zh: 本工作论文探讨了欧洲与中亚地区长期照护系统可采取的策略与干预措施，以增强功能性受限人群及其照护者的气候韧性。在简要阐述方法论与概念框架后，论文引入IPCC气候风险框架，概述了欧洲与中亚地区预计面临的主要气候灾害，并指出这些灾害在该区域不同地区的频率与强度差异。随后，论文分析了个体脆弱性如何影响这些灾害的冲击效应，重点关注老年人和残障人士——其功能性限制与照护需求加剧了脆弱性。分析涵盖生物与健康因素、社会境况及结构性条件，这些因素均会加剧对气候冲击及气温上升等渐进变化的脆弱性。接着，论文转向国际经验，重点介绍部分OECD国家调整长期照护系统或引入创新措施以保护有照护需求人群（部分案例中还包括更广泛的老年人和残障人士）免受气候风险影响的做法。基于这些案例研究与更广泛的文献综述，论文识别出欧洲与中亚国家可在气候灾害发生前、中、后阶段应用的长期照护系统功能策略，以维持基本照护、应对新出现的需求，并将支持扩展至当前未覆盖群体。论文最后提出需进一步研究与分析的问题。
url:0fe05fc9aba47f6d.title: The Heat is On : How Can Long-Term Care Systems in Europe and Central Asia Promote Climate Adaptation?
url:0fe05fc9aba47f6d.title_zh: 高温来袭：欧洲与中亚长期照护体系如何促进气候适应？

url:100a8a445aa1faa4.abstract: Women often struggle to re-enter employment after career breaks, possibly because employers are uncertain about their productivity. We study whether hiring subsidies help firms overcome this uncertainty and hire from this group. Exploiting an Italian policy that temporarily cut payroll taxes for women hired from non-employment, we find that firms persistently hire more women with career breaks, including mothers, following subsidy adoption. Consistent with employer learning about target-group productivity, firms with better initial matches later hire more from this group. Subsidized workers also show stronger labor-market attachment. These findings suggest demand-side interventions can complement supply-side policies in addressing gender gaps.
url:100a8a445aa1faa4.abstract_zh: 女性在职业中断后往往难以重返就业市场，这可能是因为雇主对其生产力存在不确定性。我们研究招聘补贴是否能帮助企业克服这种不确定性，并雇佣这一群体。利用意大利一项暂时削减非就业女性招聘 payroll taxes 的政策，我们发现，在采用补贴后，企业持续更多地雇佣有职业中断经历的女性，包括母亲。与雇主对目标群体生产力的学习过程一致，初始匹配较好的企业后来会更多地从该群体中招聘。受补贴工人也表现出更强的劳动力市场依附性。这些发现表明，需求侧干预可以补充供给侧政策，以解决性别差距问题。
url:100a8a445aa1faa4.title: DP21825 Female-Targeted Hiring Subsidies, Firm Learning, and Women’s Employment
url:100a8a445aa1faa4.title_zh: DP21825 针对女性的招聘补贴、企业学习与女性就业

url:100f2ac8d526ff38.title: Viewpoint: Housing supply and housing affordability in Canada
url:100f2ac8d526ff38.title_zh: 观点：加拿大住房供给与住房可负担性

url:10125f14b6719c70.abstract: Causal evidence from random assignment has been labeled "the most credible." We argue it is generally incomplete in finance/economics, omitting central parts of the true empirical causal chain. Random assignment, in eliminating self-selection, simultaneously precludes signaling via treatment choice. However, outside experiments, agents enjoy discretion to signal, thereby caus- ing changes in beliefs and outcomes. Therefore, if the goal is informing discretionary decisions, rather than predicting outcomes after forced/mistaken actions, randomization is problematic. As shown, signaling can amplify, attenuate, or reverse signs of causal e¤ects. Thus, traditional methods of empirical finance, e.g. event studies, are often more credible/useful.
url:10125f14b6719c70.abstract_zh: 随机分配产生的因果证据常被标榜为“最可信的”。我们认为，在金融/经济学领域，这类证据通常是不完整的，遗漏了真实经验因果链中的核心部分。随机分配在消除自我选择的同时，也排除了通过治疗选择进行信号传递的可能性。然而，在实验之外，主体拥有信号传递的自主权，从而引发信念与结果的变动。因此，若目标是指导自主决策，而非预测强制或错误行为后的结果，随机化则存在问题。如所示，信号传递可以放大、减弱或逆转因果效应的方向。由此，传统实证金融方法，如事件研究法，往往更为可信且实用。
url:10125f14b6719c70.title: Signaling, Random Assignment, and Causal Effect Estimation
url:10125f14b6719c70.title_zh: 信号传递、随机分配与因果效应估计

url:10206a09b764f828.abstract: This study examines the macroeconomic drivers of corporate investment in the United Kingdom using a multivariate time-series framework. Focusing on five key variables-interest rates, inflation, GDP growth, exchange rates, and corporate profits-the analysis investigates their combined effects on aggregate corporate investment using annual data from 1990 to 2022. By concentrating on macroeconomic determinants rather than firm-level factors, the study provides evidence on how monetary and real-sector conditions shape investment behavior in a mature, market-based economy. The contribution of this study lies in integrating long-run macroeconomic trends within a multivariate econometric framework that captures interactions between corporate profits, inflation, and exchange-rate movements in the UK over three decades of evolving policy regimes. Given the mixed order of integration among the variables, the study employs an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) bounds testing approach to examine long-run relationships and short-run adjustment dynamics. OLS and Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) estimates are retained as benchmark and robustness checks. The results indicate that higher interest rates exert a significant positive effect on corporate investment, consistent with the endogenous and pro-cyclical nature of UK monetary policy. Corporate profits have a strong positive influence, highlighting the importance of internal finance. Inflation exhibits a negative and significant impact, while GDP growth shows a weak accelerator effect and exchange-rate movements are statistically insignificant. These findings underscore the dominance of profitability and policy credibility in driving UK investment and offer relevant insights for sustaining long-term capital formation.
url:10206a09b764f828.abstract_zh: 本研究采用多元时间序列框架，考察英国企业投资的宏观经济驱动因素。聚焦利率、通胀、GDP增长、汇率及企业利润五大关键变量，基于1990年至2022年的年度数据，分析其对总体企业投资的综合影响。通过聚焦宏观层面而非企业层面的决定因素，本研究揭示了货币与实体部门条件如何塑造成熟市场经济体的投资行为。本研究的贡献在于，将长期宏观经济趋势整合至多元计量框架中，捕捉英国三十年间政策体制演变下企业利润、通胀与汇率波动之间的交互作用。鉴于变量间存在混合阶数整合特征，研究采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）边界检验法，考察长期关系与短期调整动态。同时保留普通最小二乘法（OLS）与两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）的估计结果，作为基准检验与稳健性验证。结果表明：利率上升对企业投资具有显著正向效应，这与英国货币政策的内生性与顺周期性特征一致；企业利润呈现强正向影响，凸显内部融资的重要性；通胀具有显著负向影响，而GDP增长仅呈现微弱加速效应，汇率波动则无统计显著性。这些发现强调了盈利能力与政策可信度对英国投资的主导作用，为维持长期资本形成提供了相关启示。

url:102dcdb11572cf15.abstract: The effectiveness of many interventions depends on implementer quality; as programs scale and the pool of implementers broadens, average quality falls. Conversation-based interventions, such as counseling or peer mentoring, are particularly sensitive to implementer skill. LLMs offer a natural way out: they can hold personalized exchanges at zero marginal cost and uniform quality. Whether AI can replicate, or even improve on, the human skills thought to make such interventions effective remains an open question. We run a nationwide experiment in Chile (N=41,000) comparing an AI-powered chatbot, Kai, with trained human counselors. Both arms reach high school seniors via WhatsApp and aim to motivate them toward teaching careers, addressing future teacher shortages. Among students with baseline interest in teaching (the main target of the intervention) Kai significantly increases the probability of ranking an education major first as well as the share of education majors in students' choice sets; estimates in the human arm are smaller and not statistically significant. We use text analysis to characterize conversational attributes and test mechanisms. Both arms cover a comparable breadth of topics, but Kai concentrates on factual content while human counselors lean on subjective, socioemotional material. Kai's exchanges are substantially faster and more dynamic, with near-instantaneous responses and shorter student gaps, and more semantically coherent on both sides. Human counselors, in turn, score substantially higher on motivation and empathy. We interpret these results as evidence that AI relaxes the implementer-quality constraint in conversation-based interventions at scale.
url:102dcdb11572cf15.abstract_zh: 许多干预措施的有效性取决于实施者的素质；随着项目规模扩大和实施者群体拓宽，平均素质会下降。基于对话的干预措施（如咨询或同伴指导）对实施者的技能尤为敏感。大语言模型提供了一种自然的解决方案：它们能够以零边际成本和统一质量进行个性化交流。人工智能能否复制甚至提升被认为使此类干预措施有效的人类技能，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们在智利开展了一项全国性实验（样本量N=41,000），将人工智能驱动的聊天机器人Kai与受过培训的人类咨询师进行对比。两组干预均通过WhatsApp联系高中毕业生，旨在激励他们选择教师职业，以应对未来教师短缺问题。在基线阶段对教学职业感兴趣的学生（干预的主要目标群体）中，Kai显著提高了他们将教育专业列为第一志愿的概率，以及教育专业在学生选择组合中的占比；而人类咨询师组的估计值较小且未达到统计显著性。我们通过文本分析来刻画对话特征并检验作用机制。两组干预覆盖的话题广度相当，但Kai侧重于事实性内容，而人类咨询师更依赖主观的社会情感素材。Kai的对话速度更快、互动性更强，表现为近乎即时的回复和更短的学生回应间隔，且双方对话的语义连贯性更高。相比之下，人类咨询师在动机激发和共情能力方面得分显著更高。我们将这些结果解读为：人工智能在规模化实施基于对话的干预措施时，能够缓解实施者素质这一约束条件。

url:107d2c46af446285.abstract: Trade growth stalled after the Global Financial Crisis, and world trade is now splitting along geopolitical lines. This poses a distinctive challenge for the EU, whose two largest trading partners are willing to use trade as leverage. This column argues that the fragmentation is best understood through the lens of geoeconomics, in which trade dependencies are weaponised in pursuit of geopolitical goals. China's rise has shifted geoeconomic power in its favour, eroding Western leverage. Europe must now weigh the gains from specialisation against the costs of dependency, while also strengthening internal political coordination.
url:107d2c46af446285.abstract_zh: 全球金融危机后，贸易增长陷入停滞，世界贸易正沿地缘政治界限分裂。这对欧盟构成了独特挑战，因其两大贸易伙伴均愿意将贸易作为施压工具。本文认为，这种分裂最好通过地缘经济学的视角来理解，即贸易依赖被武器化以追求地缘政治目标。中国的崛起使地缘经济力量向其倾斜，削弱了西方的杠杆作用。欧洲现在必须在专业化收益与依赖成本之间权衡，同时加强内部政治协调。

url:10a544d03e0bb5f1.abstract: The social environment is key to sustaining gender inequalities but many policies and programs target only women and do not involve the wider community. Can such approaches work or, by pushing women to break accepted norms, do they expose women to stress and backlash? What are the impacts of engaging the wider community? We use a 3-armed RCT covering 5000 adolescent girls across 125 communities in rural Rajasthan to explore these questions. We assess the impacts of weekly Girl Groups that worked only with adolescent girls and the impacts of additionally engaging the wider community. Both models led to a reduction in school dropout and early marriage. However, targeting adolescent girls without involving the broader community led to an increase in girls adopting a ruminative thinking style and no improvements in depression and anxiety. By contrast, when the wider community was engaged, girls' symptoms of depression and anxiety fell by 0.16 SD and 0.17 SD respectively and there were no negative impacts on rumination. We show evidence that such improvements in mental health may have resulted from the community engagement changing prevailing attitudes and internalized norms.
url:10a544d03e0bb5f1.abstract_zh: 社会环境是维持性别不平等的关键因素，但许多政策和项目仅针对女性，并未涉及更广泛的社区。这类方法能否奏效，或者，通过促使女性打破公认规范，是否会使她们面临压力和反弹？让更广泛的社区参与进来又会带来哪些影响？我们利用一项覆盖拉贾斯坦邦农村125个社区中5000名青春期女孩的三臂随机对照试验来探讨这些问题。我们评估了仅与青春期女孩合作的每周女孩小组的影响，以及额外让更广泛社区参与的影响。两种模式均导致辍学率和早婚率下降。然而，仅针对青春期女孩而不涉及更广泛社区的做法，导致女孩采用反刍思维风格的情况增加，且抑郁和焦虑症状未见改善。相比之下，当更广泛的社区参与进来时，女孩的抑郁和焦虑症状分别下降了0.16个标准差和0.17个标准差，且对反刍思维无负面影响。我们提供的证据表明，心理健康的改善可能源于社区参与改变了主流态度和内化规范。

url:11043c2b6667c381.abstract: In this paper we evaluate the challenges of funding retirement in the aftermath of the Covid pandemic. We first show that the pandemic had only modest effects on life expectancy and employment. These effects were small relative to longer term trends. Nevertheless, they worsened pension funding problems, highlighting the need for future pension reforms. Next, we highlight key evidence on how labor supply responds to pension reforms. Evidence suggests that incentivising later retirement can reduce pension deficits.
url:11043c2b6667c381.abstract_zh: 本文评估了新冠疫情后退休资金筹措面临的挑战。我们首先指出，疫情对预期寿命和就业的影响相对有限，这些影响相较于长期趋势而言较小。然而，它们加剧了养老金资金问题，凸显了未来养老金改革的必要性。接着，我们重点展示了劳动力供给如何响应养老金改革的关键证据。证据表明，激励延迟退休有助于减少养老金赤字。
url:11043c2b6667c381.title: Retirement Policy in a Post-Covid World
url:11043c2b6667c381.title_zh: 后疫情时代的退休政策

url:1108621b880131f1.abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage, into which they may be reincarnated. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line. These findings suggest that high fertility in sub-Saharan Africa rests on moral foundations that standard, externally designed interventions tend to overlook.
url:1108621b880131f1.abstract_zh: 传统人口模型系统性地高估了撒哈拉以南非洲地区的生育率下降趋势。本文提出一种基于普遍存在但研究不足的信仰体系的补充解释：祖先影响生者，并寻求其血脉延续，生者可能转世为后代。在这种世界观中，生育子女成为一项道德与集体义务，根植于确保血脉存续的精神责任。通过利用一手数据、新颖的民族志信息以及历史与当代调查，本文记录了祖先信仰与生育率之间在不同情境与时间跨度中呈现的强烈且数量显著的正向关联。一个将子女视为血脉公共品的简单模型，合理化了数据中观察到的模式：祖先信仰对生育率的影响集中于父系社会，且兄弟姐妹间因子女延续同一家族血脉而出现特定形式的搭便车行为。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲的高生育率建立在道德基础之上，而标准的外部干预措施往往忽视这一基础。
url:1108621b880131f1.title: Paths to the Rainforests: Ancestral Beliefs and Fertility in Sub-Saharan Africa
url:1108621b880131f1.title_zh: 通往雨林之路：撒哈拉以南非洲的祖先信仰与生育率

url:1116521912127f20.abstract: The share of young Australians reporting poor mental health has risen sharply over the past two decades, a pattern mirrored across many high-income countries. A central question is whether this reflects a genuine deterioration in underlying mental health or shifts in how different birth cohorts report their symptoms. Using 22 years of nationally representative longitudinal survey data from Australia (2002-2023), we construct a predicted mental health index from respondents
url:1116521912127f20.abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，澳大利亚年轻人报告心理健康状况不佳的比例急剧上升，这一趋势在许多高收入国家中同样显现。核心问题在于，这是否反映了潜在心理健康的真实恶化，还是不同出生队列报告症状方式的转变。利用澳大利亚2002年至2023年间22年的全国代表性纵向调查数据，我们构建了一个基于受访者预测的心理健康指数。

url:113082666ba8eb74.abstract: We study multidimensional mean-preserving contractions (MPC) and their extreme and exposed points. Proposition 1 focuses on extreme MPCs of a measure μ. Necessarily, each finitely supported extreme MPC ν induces a partition of X, the domain of μ, in convex sets such that the support of ν on each element of the partition is an affinely independent set, and such that the restriction of ν on each element of the partition is itself a MPC of the restriction of the prior μ on that element. Proposition 2 connects finitely supported Lipschitz-exposed points (measures that are unique optimizers of Lipschitz-continuous objectives) and power diagrams, which are divisions of a space into convex polyhedral cells according to a weighted proximity criterion. Power diagrams are very useful in a number of economic applications such as optimal transport and mechanism design. Finally, we apply the above results to several questions concerning moment persuasion and categorization
url:113082666ba8eb74.abstract_zh: 我们研究了多维均值保持压缩（MPC）及其极值点与暴露点。命题1聚焦于测度μ的极值MPC。必然地，每个有限支撑的极值MPC ν在μ的定义域X上诱导出一个由凸集构成的分割，使得ν在每个分割元素上的支撑集是仿射独立的集合，并且ν在每个分割元素上的限制本身是该元素上先验测度μ限制的MPC。命题2将有限支撑的Lipschitz暴露点（即Lipschitz连续目标函数的唯一优化者所对应的测度）与幂图联系起来，幂图是根据加权邻近准则将空间划分为凸多面体单元的结构。幂图在诸多经济应用中极为有用，如最优运输和机制设计。最后，我们将上述结果应用于关于矩说服和分类的几个问题。
url:113082666ba8eb74.title: The Extreme Points of Mean-Preserving Contractions
url:113082666ba8eb74.title_zh: 均值保持压缩的极值点

url:1144b5923afa68db.abstract: Since the 1990s, the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) has reported much more rapid growth in U.S. private sector employer establishments than has the Census Bureau – the gap reached roughly 1.6 million by 2023. Using linked BLS-Census microdata, we document two main drivers. First, a large and growing number of employers providing services to the elderly and persons with disabilities are in scope for the BLS frame but not the Census Bureau’s. Second, many firms appear with substantially more establishments in the BLS frame. These discrepancies substantially affect the measured establishment size distribution and quantitative policy analysis.
url:1144b5923afa68db.abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，美国劳工统计局（BLS）报告的私营部门雇主机构数量增速远超人口普查局——截至2023年，两者差距已达约160万家。通过关联BLS与人口普查局的微观数据，我们揭示了两大驱动因素：其一，为老年人和残障人士提供服务的雇主机构中，有大量且持续增长的机构属于BLS统计框架范围，但未被纳入人口普查局框架；其二，许多企业在BLS框架中显示的机构数量显著更多。这些差异对测度的机构规模分布及量化政策分析产生了实质性影响。

url:117f1a8053f9e53f.abstract: Using Danish registry data, we study how managers’ gender attitudes shape gender inequality in the workplace by exploiting the birth of a daughter - as opposed to a son - as a plausibly exogenous shock to male managers’ gender attitudes. Comparing within-firm changes in women’s labor outcomes depending on the gender of the manager’s newborn child, we find that women’s relative earnings and employment increase by 4.4% and 2.9% respectively following the birth of the manager’s first daughter.
url:117f1a8053f9e53f.abstract_zh: 利用丹麦登记数据，我们通过利用经理生育女儿（相对于儿子）作为对男性经理性别态度的一种看似外生的冲击，研究经理的性别态度如何塑造职场中的性别不平等。通过比较企业内部女性劳动成果的变化，依据经理新生儿性别，我们发现，在经理生育第一个女儿后，女性的相对收入和就业率分别增加了4.4%和2.9%。

url:11bfa69a6b2131ba.abstract: Liquidity is central to modern fixed-income markets, yet it is often treated too simply. Bonds are commonly described as liquid or illiquid, as though liquidity were a fixed quality built into the security itself. This book challenges that view. It argues that liquidity is not a permanent feature of a bond, but a fragile condition created by market structure, financing arrangements, collateral rules, dealer capacity, valuation practices, regulation, and investor behaviour. The Endogeneity of Liquidity Risk in Leveraged Fixed-Income Systems develops a clear theory of how liquidity is created inside the financial system and how it can disappear under stress. A bond may appear easy to sell in calm markets, financeable through repo, acceptable as collateral, and stable in daily valuation. Yet those qualities may depend on conditions that change quickly when volatility rises, funding tightens, or many investors try to exit at the same time.
url:11bfa69a6b2131ba.abstract_zh: 流动性是现代固定收益市场的核心，但常被过于简单化地对待。债券通常被描述为具有流动性或缺乏流动性，仿佛流动性是证券本身固有的固定属性。本书挑战了这一观点，认为流动性并非债券的永久特征，而是由市场结构、融资安排、抵押品规则、交易商能力、估值实践、监管及投资者行为共同塑造的脆弱状态。《杠杆固定收益系统中流动性风险的内生性》构建了一套清晰的理论，阐释流动性如何在金融体系内部被创造，又如何在压力下消失。一只债券在平静市场中可能看似易于出售、可通过回购融资、可被接受为抵押品且日常估值稳定，但这些特质可能依赖于某些条件——当波动性上升、资金收紧或大量投资者同时试图退出时，这些条件会迅速改变。

url:11ecfd1240472270.title: The Productivity Effect of High Involvement Management: Causal Evidence From Germany
url:11ecfd1240472270.title_zh: 高参与管理的生产率效应：来自德国的因果证据

url:1201a6e0c3d2fc6a.title_zh: 外交关系变化如何影响海湾国家对外投资：以埃及为例

url:12095119afd103ba.title: Harnessing draft animal power: boosting efficiency in smallholder conventional farming
url:12095119afd103ba.title_zh: 利用役畜动力：提升小农传统农业效率

url:121c72c1193b4081.abstract: Mobility barriers hinder structural transformation and economic growth. This paper examines how land market frictions constrain labor mobility. In developing countries, rural households risk losing land if they stop cultivating it. This implicit barrier is made explicit through China’s hukou system. Typically, the wife remains in agriculture while the husband moves to non-agriculture. Using two land reforms that reduce this barrier, we construct a novel county-level reform index and show that these land reforms induce rural women to leave agriculture at higher rates than rural men, while also lowering urban women’s employment and wages relative to urban men. Incorporating this index into a two-sector model with intra-household employment decisions replicates the observed uneven impacts and has significant effects on agricultural productivity.
url:121c72c1193b4081.abstract_zh: 流动性障碍阻碍了结构转型与经济增长。本文探讨了土地市场摩擦如何制约劳动力流动。在发展中国家，农村家庭若停止耕作，则面临失去土地的风险。这一隐性障碍通过中国的户籍制度变得显性化。通常情况下，妻子留守农业，而丈夫转向非农产业。利用两项减少此障碍的土地改革，我们构建了一个新颖的县级改革指数，并表明这些土地改革促使农村女性以高于农村男性的比例离开农业，同时相对于城市男性，降低了城市女性的就业率与工资水平。将此指数纳入包含家庭内部就业决策的两部门模型中，能够复现观察到的非均衡影响，并对农业生产力产生显著效应。
url:121c72c1193b4081.title: Sowing Seeds of Mobility: The Uneven Impact of Land Reform
url:121c72c1193b4081.title_zh: 播种流动的种子：土地改革的不均衡影响

url:1223ef23a75d452b.abstract: The EU’s fiscal governance framework was built to contribute to overall macroeconomic stability through compliance with fiscal rules and the commitment not to bail-out countries in trouble. Yet successive crises have revealed vulnerabilities under systemic stress: countries with a propensity to run deficits push frugal ones into ex-post bail-out arrangements to avert collapse, thus undermining the ex-ante credibility of the framework. The absence of a permanent, preventive instrument forces the Union to oscillate between leniency and emergency intervention. A permanent RRF-like mechanism - linking EU funds to reform and investment projects - offers an incentive compatible solution and a possible bridge to a larger EU budget.
url:1223ef23a75d452b.abstract_zh: 欧盟的财政治理框架旨在通过遵守财政规则以及不救助陷入困境国家的承诺，促进整体宏观经济稳定。然而，接连不断的危机揭示了系统性压力下的脆弱性：倾向于赤字运行的国家迫使节俭国家在事后采取救助安排以避免崩溃，从而削弱了该框架的事前可信度。由于缺乏永久性的预防工具，欧盟不得不在宽松政策与紧急干预之间摇摆。一个类似复苏与韧性基金的永久性机制——将欧盟资金与改革和投资项目挂钩——提供了一种激励相容的解决方案，并可能成为迈向更大规模欧盟预算的桥梁。
url:1223ef23a75d452b.title: Addressing the EU’s fiscal dilemma: From ex-post transfers to ex-ante resilience
url:1223ef23a75d452b.title_zh: 应对欧盟财政困境：从事后转移支付转向事前韧性

url:1227be5c71f0366f.title: Fiscal Policy Regimes in Resource‐Rich Economies
url:1227be5c71f0366f.title_zh: 资源丰富经济体的财政政策体制

url:122b23eadc0f066c.abstract: We consider the classical problem of allocating m objects to n agents where $m \geq n .$ In the $m = n$ case, we analyze preference domains (called UPN-priority domains) where every strategy-proof, non-bossy and unanimous profile neutral (UPN) allocation rule is a priority rule. We show that a simple condition called the closure property characterizes priority domains. The only domain satisfying the closure property and a mild richness condition is the universal domain. We extend this result to the $m n$ case. We also consider the case where allocation rules satisfy a stronger neutrality property.
url:122b23eadc0f066c.abstract_zh: 我们考虑将m个物品分配给n个代理人的经典问题，其中$m \geq n$。在$m = n$的情形下，我们分析偏好域（称为UPN优先域），其中每个满足策略证明性、非专断性和一致性的中立（UPN）分配规则均为优先规则。我们证明，一个称为封闭性的简单条件刻画了优先域。唯一同时满足封闭性和温和丰富性条件的域是全域。我们将这一结果推广至$m > n$的情形。此外，我们还考虑了分配规则满足更强中立性属性的情形。
url:122b23eadc0f066c.title: Priority domains

url:125ba0a6896e441e.abstract: This paper analyzes trends in agricultural total factor productivity in Bolivia between 2008 and 2015 and the factors driving these trends using national agricultural surveys. On balance, the findings suggest that agricultural total factor productivity increased by 1.8% annually between 2008-2015. Among productive inputs, land shows the largest marginal effect on the value of agricultural production. Regarding temperature shocks, the study finds that each additional harmful degree day during the growing season is associated, on average, with a 9.8% decrease in the value of agricultural output. With regards to policy drivers, no statistically significant effect of land titling within the last two years is detected on productivity. Public irrigation infrastructure has a positive effect on productivity, though its magnitude decreases with rising incidence of precipitation. These findings underscore the importance of continuing to invest public resources efficiently in infrastructure that can boost agricultural productivity and prioritize investments targeting regions with the lowest productivity growth rates and with the smallest share of land and workers.
url:125ba0a6896e441e.abstract_zh: 本文利用全国农业调查数据，分析了2008年至2015年间玻利维亚农业全要素生产率的趋势及其驱动因素。总体而言，研究结果表明，2008-2015年间农业全要素生产率年均增长1.8%。在生产投入要素中，土地对农业产值的边际效应最大。关于温度冲击，研究发现，生长季节每增加一个有害度日，农业产值平均下降9.8%。在政策驱动因素方面，未发现过去两年内土地确权对生产率具有统计上显著的影响。公共灌溉基础设施对生产率具有正向效应，但其影响程度随降水频率上升而递减。这些发现凸显了持续将公共资源高效投资于能够提升农业生产率的基础设施的重要性，并应优先针对生产率增长率最低、土地与劳动力占比最小的地区进行投资。
url:125ba0a6896e441e.title: An Analysis of Agricultural Total Factor Productivity Growth and Its Determinants in Bolivia
url:125ba0a6896e441e.title_zh: 玻利维亚农业全要素生产率增长及其决定因素分析

url:126068d80c2389c8.abstract: There has been a dramatic rise in disability employment since the pandemic. At the same time, work from home (WFH) has risen four-fold. This paper asks whether the two are causally related. Controlling for compositional changes and labor market tightness, a 1 percentage point increase in WFH increases full-time employment by 1.0% for individuals with a physical disability. The postpandemic increase in working from home explains 68%-85% of the rise in full-time employment. Wage data suggests that WFH increased the supply of workers with a physical disability, likely by reducing commuting costs and enabling better control of working conditions.
url:126068d80c2389c8.abstract_zh: 自疫情以来，残障人士就业率显著上升。与此同时，居家办公比例增长了四倍。本文探究两者是否存在因果关系。在控制人口结构变化与劳动力市场紧张程度后，居家办公比例每上升1个百分点，身体残障人士的全职就业率将提高1.0%。疫情后居家办公的普及可解释全职就业率增长的68%-85%。工资数据显示，居家办公通过降低通勤成本并改善工作条件自主性，有效扩大了身体残障人士的劳动力供给。
url:126068d80c2389c8.title: Work from Home and Disability Employment
url:126068d80c2389c8.title_zh: 居家办公与残疾人就业

url:12734cd7e97637dd.abstract: We study how negative sentiment around an industry impacts beliefs and behaviors, focusing on demands for racial justice after the murder of George Floyd and the salience of the ``defund the police" movement. We assess stakeholder beliefs on the impact of protests on the stock prices of police-affiliated firms. In our survey experiment, laypeople and finance professionals predicted more negative stock price outcomes when they lacked details on the products supplied by such firms. Exposure to narratives about the context of the protests further reduced the prediction accuracy of these groups. In contrast, product information improved the prediction accuracy of respondents. Turning to real-life behavior, we find that mutual funds exposed to protests were 20% less likely to hold police stocks, after the protests, than funds in areas without protests. Political support for maintaining police funding, though in the majority, declined by 4.3 percentage points in protest areas. The salience of the ``defund the police" narrative led to significant overreactions in both financial predictions and real-life behavior.
url:12734cd7e97637dd.abstract_zh: 我们研究了围绕某一行业的负面情绪如何影响信念与行为，重点关注乔治·弗洛伊德谋杀案后对种族正义的需求以及“撤资警察”运动的显著性。我们评估了利益相关者对抗议活动对警察关联公司股价影响的信念。在我们的调查实验中，普通民众和金融专业人士在缺乏这些公司所供应产品细节的情况下，预测了更为负面的股价结果。接触关于抗议背景的叙述进一步降低了这些群体的预测准确性。相比之下，产品信息提高了受访者的预测准确性。转向现实生活中的行为，我们发现，接触抗议活动的共同基金在抗议后持有警察相关股票的可能性比无抗议地区的基金低20%。尽管支持维持警察经费的政治立场仍占多数，但在抗议地区下降了4.3个百分点。“撤资警察”叙述的显著性导致了金融预测和现实行为中的显著过度反应。
url:12734cd7e97637dd.title: Mispricing Narratives after Social Unrest
url:12734cd7e97637dd.title_zh: 社会动荡后的错误定价叙事

url:128c8e99e1cb31a7.title_zh: 不完全市场下开放经济中的直升机撒钱

url:1297efce0529b2c4.abstract: We estimate the spillovers of demand- and supply-driven shocks in China to foreign countries and firms. We combine a Structural Vector Autoregression (SVAR) framework with a broad-based measure of domestic economic activity in China and narrative evidence on domestic shocks to distinguish supply versus demand components of Chinese growth. We then assess the responses to such shocks of GDP (revenue) in other countries (firms). The results suggest that: (i) global GDP responds more to Chinese supply shocks than to Chinese demand shocks; (ii) both supply and demand slowdowns in China are followed by declines in partner country GDP and firm revenue, especially in countries and firms with stronger trade linkages to China; and (iii) Chinese supply shocks have larger impacts on countries and firms with relatively stronger input linkages to China, while Chinese demand shocks have larger impacts on countries and firms with relatively stronger output linkages to China.
url:1297efce0529b2c4.abstract_zh: 我们估算了中国需求驱动与供给驱动冲击对国外国家及企业的溢出效应。我们将结构向量自回归（SVAR）框架与中国国内经济活动的广泛衡量指标相结合，并利用国内冲击的叙事证据，以区分中国经济增长中的供给与需求成分。随后，我们评估了这些冲击对其他国家和企业GDP（收入）的影响。结果表明：（i）全球GDP对中国供给冲击的反应大于对中国需求冲击的反应；（ii）中国供给与需求的双重放缓均伴随着伙伴国GDP及企业收入的下降，尤其是在与中国贸易联系较强的国家和企业中；（iii）中国供给冲击对与中国投入联系相对较强的国家和企业影响更大，而中国需求冲击则对与中国产出联系相对较强的国家和企业影响更大。
url:1297efce0529b2c4.title: China Spillovers: Aggregate and Firm-Level Evidence
url:1297efce0529b2c4.title_zh: 中国溢出效应：总量与公司层面的证据

url:12a02c87164701c8.title_zh: 生育减少是否意味着寿命缩短：中国生育政策与老年人福祉

url:12a91426d421a275.title: What are the carbon services from cover‐crop adoption worth from farmers' perspective?
url:12a91426d421a275.title_zh: 从农户视角看，覆盖作物采纳的碳服务价值几何？

url:12cccde4382b5a11.abstract: Over the past century, the United States has provided dollar liquidity abroad through both the US Treasury and the Federal Reserve, but the appropriate mode of liquidity injection depends on the economic, financial, and geopolitical contexts. The Treasury is the more appropriate lending conduit when geopolitical concerns dominate, while Fed dollar provision should primarily be targeted toward global stability objectives and be more insulated from short-term foreign policy motives. Up to now, political abuses of these foreign lending channels have been constrained to some degree by laws, norms, and intergovernmental understandings, but adherence can no longer be assumed, so more formal guardrails are needed.
url:12cccde4382b5a11.abstract_zh: 过去一个世纪以来，美国通过财政部和美联储向海外提供美元流动性，但适当的流动性注入模式取决于经济、金融和地缘政治背景。当地缘政治关切占主导地位时，财政部是更合适的贷款渠道，而美联储的美元供给应主要针对全球稳定目标，并更少受短期外交政策动机的影响。迄今为止，法律、规范及政府间谅解在一定程度上约束了这些对外贷款渠道的政治滥用，但已无法假定各方会继续遵守，因此需要更正式的防护措施。
url:12cccde4382b5a11.title: Taking geopolitically motivated US swap lines too far would harm the dollar and Fed independence
url:12cccde4382b5a11.title_zh: 将地缘政治驱动的美国互换额度推得太远将损害美元和美联储独立性

url:12d2ca04e68ff34b.title: Should Platforms be Held Liable for Defective Third‐Party Goods?
url:12d2ca04e68ff34b.title_zh: 平台是否应对第三方缺陷产品承担责任？

url:12ed821bd3fd02f4.abstract: Poverty is not a static condition but a dynamic process. Yet the at-risk-of-poverty rate, which underpins EU poverty monitoring, captures who is poor in a given year but says nothing about how long people have been poor. This column introduces complementary measures to assess dynamic poverty in the EU, which suggest that poverty is more widespread and persistent than annual rates alone suggest and experiences vary sharply across countries. Social protection systems differ markedly in their ability to reduce long-duration poverty. These findings have direct relevance for the EU’s newly adopted Anti-Poverty Strategy.
url:12ed821bd3fd02f4.abstract_zh: 贫困并非一种静态状况，而是一个动态过程。然而，作为欧盟贫困监测核心指标的贫困风险率，仅能反映特定年份的贫困人口状况，却无法揭示贫困持续的时间。本文引入补充性指标以评估欧盟动态贫困状况，结果表明：贫困现象比年度数据所呈现的更为普遍且持久，且各国经历差异显著。不同社会保障体系在减少长期贫困方面的能力存在明显差异。这些发现对欧盟新近通过的《反贫困战略》具有直接参考价值。
url:12ed821bd3fd02f4.title: Beyond the snapshot: How poverty really unfolds over time in the EU
url:12ed821bd3fd02f4.title_zh: 超越快照：欧盟贫困如何随时间真实演变

url:12f044ffd0792909.abstract: Job mobility is risky, workers are risk averse, and insurance markets are incomplete. This paper studies how these features curb and distort job-to-job transitions by making workers excessively cautious: they place too much weight on job safety over wage and productivity gains. We demonstrate this tradeoff by eliciting employed workers’ wage-safety indifference curves in a custom, representative survey. On average, employed US workers require a 1.63% pay raise to accept each additional percentage point of annual unemployment risk in a new job. We assess the macroeconomic consequences of our mechanism by embedding it into a general equilibrium search model. Jobs differ in both wages (productivity) and unemployment risk, and risk-averse workers self-insure against unemployment risk through a non-state-contingent bond while searching on and off the job. We find that a complete markets counterfactual would boost job mobility by 12% and productivity by 0.19%. We also highlight a new role for unemployment insurance: it encourages employed workers to accept risky but high-productivity offers, thereby increasing productivity (by 1.3%) and job creation—as well as job loss and unemployment.
url:12f044ffd0792909.abstract_zh: 工作流动性具有风险，工人是风险规避的，且保险市场不完善。本文研究这些特征如何通过使工人过度谨慎来抑制和扭曲工作间转换：他们过分重视工作安全性，而忽视工资和生产率收益。我们通过一项定制、具有代表性的调查，引出在职工人的工资-安全性无差异曲线，从而展示这一权衡。平均而言，美国在职工人要求每增加一个百分点的新工作年度失业风险，需获得1.63%的加薪作为补偿。我们通过将该机制嵌入一般均衡搜索模型来评估其宏观经济后果。工作不仅在工资（生产率）上存在差异，也在失业风险上有所不同，风险规避的工人通过非状态依赖债券进行自我保险，同时在职或离职状态下进行搜索。我们发现，一个完全市场的反事实情景将使工作流动性提高12%，生产率提高0.19%。我们还强调了失业保险的新作用：它鼓励在职工人接受风险高但生产率高的职位，从而提高生产率（1.3%）和就业创造——同时也增加了失业和失业率。
url:12f044ffd0792909.title: DP21861 Cautious Careers: Job Mobility under Incomplete Markets
url:12f044ffd0792909.title_zh: DP21861 谨慎的职业路径：不完全市场下的工作流动性

url:13028d13d614a1d9.abstract: We explain the empirical puzzle why mergers reduce profits, and raise share prices. If being an 'insider' is better than being an 'outsider', firms may merge to preempt their partner merging with a rival. The stock-value is increased, since the risk of becoming an outsider is eliminated. We also show that mergers increasing consumers' prices, while increasing competitors' profits, may reduce the competitors' share-prices. Thus, event-studies may not detect anti-competitive mergers. These results are derived in an endogenous-merger model, predicting the conditions under which mergers occur, the time of merger, and the split of surplus.
url:13028d13d614a1d9.abstract_zh: 我们解释了为何并购会降低利润却推高股价这一实证谜题。若成为"内部人"优于成为"外部人"，企业可能通过并购先发制人，防止其合作伙伴与竞争对手合并。由于消除了沦为外部人的风险，股票价值得以提升。我们还证明，并购虽会提高消费者价格并增加竞争对手利润，却可能压低竞争对手的股价。因此，事件研究法可能无法识别反竞争性并购。这些结论源于一个内生并购模型，该模型预测了并购发生的条件、时机以及剩余分配方式。
url:13028d13d614a1d9.title: Why Mergers Reduce Profits, and Raise Share-Prices

url:13a3f5a150667947.abstract: We analyze the conflict of interest that arises when universal banks engage in proprietary trading of borrower stocks, which has been a prominent concern in the regulatory debates for a long time. We combine trade-by-trade supervisory data with credit registry information in Germany. Our findings reveal that lending relationships inform banks’ prop trading. To separate bank expertise and private information from lending as explanations, we study prop trading around corporate events. We show that banks execute purchases (sales) in borrower stocks in the weeks before positive (negative) news events, even when these events are unscheduled and surprising to the market. We link this trading pattern to situations when banks possess private borrower information, and rule out that it is explained by specialized expertise. We also find evidence consistent with information flows through banks’ centralized risk management, that banks alter trading patterns once they acquire private information, consistent with shrouding of informed trading, and that OTC counter-parties price-protect against relationship banks. Our evidence highlights the difficulty of avoiding conflicts in universal banking.
url:13a3f5a150667947.abstract_zh: 我们分析了全能银行在从事借款方股票自营交易时产生的利益冲突问题，这一直是监管讨论中的突出关切。我们将逐笔交易监管数据与德国信用登记信息相结合。研究结果显示，贷款关系为银行的自营交易提供了信息。为区分银行的专业知识与私人信息作为解释因素，我们围绕公司事件研究了自营交易行为。我们表明，在正面（负面）新闻事件发生前的数周内，银行会执行对借款方股票的买入（卖出）操作，即使这些事件是未安排的且对市场而言出乎意料。我们将这种交易模式与银行掌握借款方私人信息的情形联系起来，并排除了其由专业知识解释的可能性。我们还发现了与信息通过银行集中风险管理流动相一致的证据，即银行一旦获取私人信息便会改变交易模式，这与知情交易被掩盖的现象相符，并且场外交易对手方会对关系银行采取价格保护措施。我们的证据凸显了在全能银行中避免利益冲突的难度。
url:13a3f5a150667947.title: DP21836 Conﬂicts of Interest in Banks: Evidence from Proprietary Trading

url:13a6edba715350ed.abstract: The rapid expansion of high-speed internet has intensified concerns about how digital technologies affect early childhood. Using the staggered rollout of fibre optic to the home in Uruguay as a natural experiment, this column finds that greater lifetime exposure to high-speed internet reduces children’s scores in communication, problem solving, personal-social and socio-emotional skills. The effects are partly explained by indirect channels, through the displacement of valuable activities for child development and alterations in caregivers’ behaviour.
url:13a6edba715350ed.abstract_zh: 高速互联网的快速普及加剧了人们对数字技术如何影响幼儿发展的担忧。本文以乌拉圭光纤到户的分阶段推广作为自然实验，研究发现，儿童一生中接触高速互联网的时间越长，其在沟通、解决问题、个人社交及社会情感技能方面的得分越低。这种影响部分可通过间接渠道解释，即替代了有益于儿童发展的活动，并改变了照护者的行为模式。

url:13f6f941706fb123.abstract: How do armed groups reshape cities? This article argues that Rio de Janeiro’s milícias—paramilitary organizations, frequently led by current and former security officers,—govern territory through “build-to-hold” urbanization. Rather than simply extracting rents, milícias construct informal housing to expand captive populations that generate recurring income, electoral leverage, and political protection. Combining geospatial data on territorial control with satellite-derived measures of urban development from 2016–2023, I use staggered difference-in-differences estimators to show that milícia entry causes sustained increases in building density and height. These effects are absent in gang-controlled areas and persist in territories transitioning from gangs to milícias, indicating that densification is specific to the milícia governance model. I further show that increased construction does not increase formal housing prices or transaction activity, consistent with a system in which armed actors retain control over housing assets rather than integrating them into formal markets. The findings demonstrate how criminal organizations actively produce urban space in ways that entrench coercive authority and blur the boundary between criminal governance and state power.
url:13f6f941706fb123.abstract_zh: 武装团体如何重塑城市？本文认为，里约热内卢的民兵组织——通常由现任或前任安全官员领导的准军事组织——通过“建设-持有”城市化模式统治领土。民兵组织并非单纯攫取租金，而是建造非正规住房以扩大受控人口规模，从而获取持续性收入、选举筹码和政治庇护。通过将领土控制的地理空间数据与2016-2023年卫星衍生的城市发展指标相结合，我采用交错双重差分估计量证明：民兵组织进入会导致建筑密度和高度持续增长。这种效应在帮派控制区域不存在，而在从帮派过渡到民兵组织的领土中持续存在，表明密度增长是民兵治理模式的特有现象。我进一步证明，建筑增加并未推高正规住房价格或交易活跃度，这与武装行为体保留住房资产控制权而非将其纳入正规市场的体系特征一致。研究结果揭示了犯罪组织如何通过主动生产城市空间来巩固强制权力，并模糊犯罪治理与国家权力之间的边界。

url:141fea65ad21d02c.abstract: Financial markets are highly differentiated: firms issue many products beyond stocks and bonds. This variety is consequential because the products firms use determine which issuers raise capital, on what terms, and which risks investors absorb. We propose a model of variety and firms’ allocation across products. Products repackage firms’ cash flows and differ in expected payoff per unit of exposure to aggregate risk and firm-specific risk passed to investors. Aggregate exposure raises the compensation all issuers must offer, whereas firm-specific risk lowers only the issuing firm’s payoff. We show that specialized products coexist with widely adopted ones through trade-offs between these two dimensions.
url:141fea65ad21d02c.abstract_zh: 金融市场高度分化：企业发行的产品远不止股票和债券。这种多样性意义重大，因为企业所使用的产品决定了哪些发行者能筹集资本、以何种条件筹集，以及投资者承担哪些风险。我们提出了一个关于产品多样性及企业跨产品配置的模型。产品重新组合企业的现金流，并在传递给投资者的总体风险和企业特定风险的单位暴露预期回报上存在差异。总体暴露提高了所有发行者必须提供的补偿，而企业特定风险仅降低发行企业自身的回报。我们证明，专业化产品与广泛采用的产品通过这两个维度之间的权衡而共存。

url:14642318ad18bf12.abstract: The World Bank Enterprise Surveys contain multiple questions pertaining to corruption. One popular question asks how much firms typically pay in bribes. The manager can answer in two ways: as a per cent of sales or in local currency. In principle, the reported amount should not depend upon how the manager chooses to answer. In practice, it does. Those opting to answer as percentages report paying far more than managers opting to answer in local currency in most countries. This article proposes a new method for estimating the discrepancy and other parameters taking this into account. Hypothesis tests consistently favour the modified model over the basic model that does not control for the different reporting methods.
url:14642318ad18bf12.abstract_zh: 世界银行企业调查包含多个与腐败相关的问题。其中一个常见问题询问企业通常支付多少贿赂。管理者可以以两种方式回答：按销售额的百分比或按当地货币金额。原则上，报告金额不应取决于管理者选择如何回答。然而在实践中，情况并非如此。在大多数国家，选择以百分比回答的管理者报告支付的金额远高于选择以当地货币回答的管理者。本文提出了一种新方法，用于估计这一差异及其他参数，并对此加以考虑。假设检验一致地支持修正模型，而非未控制不同报告方式的基本模型。
url:14642318ad18bf12.title: Estimating how firm characteristics affect corruption using enterprise survey data

url:146d6072b979d7d1.abstract: This paper investigates how the mode of entry into a foreign market can be influenced by the intensity of R&D in an industry and the protection of intellectual property rights (IPR) in a recipient country. It then analyzes the link between the IPR regime and policies that place limits on the degree of foreign ownership in a joint venture (JV). In particular, we study the effect of the IPR regime of the host country (South) on a multinational?s decision between serving a market via greenfield foreign direct investment to avoid the exposure of its technology or entering a JV with a local firm, which allows R&D spillovers to a third firm under imperfect IPRs. JV is the equilibrium market structure when extra rents can be gained from a JV. This occurs when R&D intensity is moderate and IPRs strong. The South can gain from increased IPR protection by encouraging a JV, whereas policies to limit foreign ownership in a JV gain importance in technology intensive industries as complementary policies to strong IPRs. The South never finds it optimal to fully protect IPRs and concede all bargaining power in a JV to the Northern firm.
url:146d6072b979d7d1.abstract_zh: 本文研究了行业研发强度与东道国知识产权保护如何影响企业进入外国市场的模式，进而分析了知识产权制度与限制合资企业中外资持股比例政策之间的关联。具体而言，我们考察了东道国（南方国家）的知识产权制度对跨国公司决策的影响——即选择通过绿地外商直接投资进入市场以避免技术泄露，还是与当地企业组建合资企业（在知识产权保护不完善的情况下，该模式可能导致研发溢出至第三方企业）。当合资企业能产生额外租金时，其将成为均衡市场结构，这一情形出现在研发强度适中且知识产权保护较强的条件下。南方国家可通过强化知识产权保护鼓励合资企业模式获益，而在技术密集型产业中，限制合资企业外资持股比例的政策作为强知识产权保护的补充手段愈发重要。研究发现，南方国家永远不会选择完全保护知识产权，也不会将合资企业中的所有议价权让渡给北方企业。
url:146d6072b979d7d1.title: Intellectual Property Rights and Entry into a Foreign Market: FDI vs Joint Ventures
url:146d6072b979d7d1.title_zh: 知识产权与进入外国市场：外商直接投资与合资企业的选择

url:1475186647063c42.abstract: Circulation into and out of the top one percent is pronounced in the U.S. One third exit after a year and two-thirds exit after a decade. This mobility lowers top income shares when shifting from annual to multi-year income measures. Intragenerational mobility over two decades lowers recent top one percent fiscal income shares by over 10 percent. Two-decade mobility reduces top 0.1% shares by over 20 percent, top 0.01% shares by 30 percent, and top 0.001% shares by 40 percent. Effects of variability on wealth inequality are similar in magnitude, although more modest as a share of top wealth inequality.
url:1475186647063c42.abstract_zh: 美国收入前1%群体的流入与流出变动显著：一年后三分之一退出，十年后三分之二退出。这种流动性在将收入衡量周期从年度扩展至多年时，会降低顶层收入份额。二十年的代内流动性使近期前1%的财政总收入份额下降超过10%，前0.1%份额下降超过20%，前0.01%份额下降30%，前0.001%份额下降40%。收入波动对财富不平等的影响幅度与之相似，但就顶层财富不平等占比而言更为温和。

url:14d1cd210b6f6451.abstract: How households behave in an environment with deposit rates below zero is important for monetary transmission, but the literature is scant. This column studies household behaviour in the context of a major episode of negative interest rates in Denmark. This authors find that the negative deposit rates led to a strong decrease in deposits. Households appear to react more sharply when interest rates below zero are cut compared to when rates are positive. As depositors seem to consume more rather than hold more cash, policy rate cuts in negative territory may have particularly strong consumption effects.
url:14d1cd210b6f6451.abstract_zh: 家庭在存款利率为负的环境中的行为对货币传导至关重要，但相关文献较为匮乏。本文以丹麦负利率重大事件为背景，研究家庭行为。作者发现，负存款利率导致存款大幅减少。与正利率时期相比，当利率降至负值区间时，家庭反应更为剧烈。由于储户似乎更倾向于增加消费而非持有更多现金，负利率区间的政策利率下调可能对消费产生尤为显著的影响。

url:14e52c1da7483d36.abstract: In this paper we explore the effect of short memories on political outcomes in a model in which politics is viewed as a collective learning process . We analyse a dynamic model in which voters use past observations to learn about the optimal policy and political parties are self-interested, with polarised ideal policies. Voters balance party loyalty with a desire to vote for the party whose policy is based on a better interpretation of past observations. We show that short-term memory leads to political cycles of polarisation and convergence. Historical periods of convergence lead parties to polarise, whereas periods of polarisation imply convergence of platforms. Our framework also allows us to model the strategic use of biased histories and narratives in political competition, such as the use of nostalgia.
url:14e52c1da7483d36.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在将政治视为集体学习过程的模型中，短期记忆对政治结果的影响。我们分析了一个动态模型，其中选民利用过去的观察来学习最优政策，而政党则追求自身利益，拥有两极化的理想政策。选民在政党忠诚与投票给基于对过去观察更佳解读的政党之间寻求平衡。我们表明，短期记忆导致政治极化与趋同的周期循环。历史上的趋同期促使政党走向极化，而极化期则意味着政纲的趋同。我们的框架还允许我们模拟政治竞争中偏见历史和叙事的策略性使用，例如怀旧情绪的运用。
url:14e52c1da7483d36.title: Short-term political memory and the inevitability of polarisation

url:1512b6cbab191ae9.title: A series of (un)fortunate events: Commercial bank interest rates and deposit reallocation during the Great Depression in the Netherlands

url:15351ff1757daa77.abstract: Quantifying spillovers from scientific knowledge to technology is important for understanding the social returns to science and for designing policy. A key challenge is how to credit scientific work with the value generated in downstream technologies when ideas diffuse through chains of follow-on research. We propose a new measure---Science Rank---that uses the combined patent and paper citation network to assign a share of the private value of patented inventions to the scientific papers they directly or indirectly rely on. Validated against various types of scientific awards, the measure substantially outperforms direct patent-to-paper citation counts in identifying influential science. We document large heterogeneity in spillovers across countries, disciplines, and institutions. The US emerges from our analysis as a powerhouse of science spillovers, benefiting both domestic and foreign technology development. We apply our methodology to examine how different countries and individual institutions contribute to innovation that addresses global challenges such as climate change or more equal economic development. We find that a relatively large share of the total value generated by research in Lower and Middle Income Country (LMIC) feeds into climate change related innovation. We also highlight countries and institutions that are making particular contributions to LMIC innovation.
url:15351ff1757daa77.abstract_zh: 量化科学知识向技术的溢出效应，对于理解科学的社会回报以及制定相关政策至关重要。当思想通过后续研究的链条传播时，如何将下游技术产生的价值归功于科学工作，是一个关键挑战。我们提出了一种新指标——科学排名（Science Rank）——利用专利与论文的联合引用网络，将专利发明的私人价值份额分配给其直接或间接依赖的科学论文。经多种科学奖项验证，该指标在识别具有影响力的科学成果方面，显著优于直接的专利-论文引用计数。我们记录了不同国家、学科和机构之间溢出效应的巨大异质性。分析显示，美国是科学溢出的强国，其科学成果惠及国内外技术发展。我们应用该方法考察了不同国家和机构如何为应对气候变化或促进更公平经济发展等全球挑战的创新做出贡献。研究发现，中低收入国家（LMIC）研究产生的总价值中，有相对较大的一部分流向了与气候变化相关的创新。我们还重点指出了那些为LMIC创新做出特殊贡献的国家和机构。
url:15351ff1757daa77.title: DP21778 Spillovers from Science
