url:15589f64ad56bbe9.abstract: We analyze the effects of increased trade exposure to China on the Polish labor market during the period 2011–2019. Utilizing detailed industry-level data and an instrumental variable strategy based on trade flows from other Visegrad Group countries, we disentangle the impacts of import competition and access to imported intermediate inputs. We find that while import competition induced job losses in specific sectors, industries benefiting from access to Chinese intermediate inputs experienced substantial employment gains. Critically, this positive input channel effect was sufficient to offset the majority of displacement losses caused by import competition. Although manufacturing as a whole faced a slight net decline, the aggregate economy experienced net employment expansion. These results identify a “China Boost” driven by intermediate inputs, suggesting that Chinese imports act as strategic complements to domestic labor in Poland, contrasting sharply with the “China Shock” observed in the United States.
url:15589f64ad56bbe9.abstract_zh: 我们分析了2011-2019年间中国贸易敞口增加对波兰劳动力市场的影响。利用详细的行业层面数据，并基于维谢格拉德集团其他国家的贸易流量构建工具变量策略，我们区分了进口竞争与进口中间品获取的影响。研究发现，尽管进口竞争导致特定行业就业岗位流失，但受益于中国中间品输入的行业却实现了显著的就业增长。关键在于，这种正向的投入渠道效应足以抵消进口竞争造成的大部分岗位替代损失。虽然制造业整体面临轻微净下降，但总体经济却经历了就业扩张。这些结果揭示了由中间品驱动的"中国助推"效应，表明中国进口品与波兰国内劳动力形成战略互补关系，这与美国观察到的"中国冲击"形成鲜明对比。
url:15589f64ad56bbe9.title: China Shock or China Boost? Intermediate Inputs and Manufacturing Resilience in Poland
url:15589f64ad56bbe9.title_zh: 中国冲击还是中国助推？中间投入与波兰制造业韧性

url:156074336e9dca7f.abstract: Motivated by a secular increase in the concentration of the U.S. banking industry, I develop a new macroeconomic model with oligopolistic financial intermediaries and heterogeneous firms. Market power allows banks to price discriminate and charge firm-specific markups, exerting greater market power over productive and more financially constrained firms. This dampens capital accumulation and amplifies the effects of macroeconomic shocks. During a crisis, banks exploit the higher share of financially constrained firms to extract higher markups, inducing a larger decline in real activity. When a large bank fails, the remaining banks use their increased market power to restrict credit supply, worsening and prolonging the downturn.
url:156074336e9dca7f.abstract_zh: 受美国银行业集中度长期上升的启发，本文构建了一个包含寡头金融中介与异质性企业的新型宏观经济模型。市场势力使银行能够实施价格歧视，对异质性企业收取差异化加成率，对生产率更高且融资约束更强的企业施加更大的市场势力。这一机制抑制了资本积累，并放大了宏观经济冲击的影响。危机期间，银行利用融资约束企业占比上升的机会提取更高加成率，导致实际经济活动更大幅度下滑。当大型银行倒闭时，幸存银行凭借增强的市场势力限制信贷供给，加剧并延长经济衰退。
url:156074336e9dca7f.title: Macro Shocks and Firm Dynamics with Oligopolistic Financial Intermediaries

url:15aa146bfcbe95f6.abstract: A well-documented phenomenon in the literature is that consumers exhibit persistence in their choices. Using data from the mineral water category on a price comparison platform that delivers real-time prompts of cheaper alternatives through ``swap and save" buttons, this study examines whether and how these prompts influence persistent product choices in online grocery shopping. The findings reveal that shoppers who switched to an alternative product after receiving a prompt were 23.7 percentage points more likely to select that alternative product in subsequent visits, with this effect lasting for up to 10 shopping trips. Our analysis suggests that this sustained impact is driven not by long-term cost savings but by product discovery enabled through these real-time prompts.
url:15aa146bfcbe95f6.abstract_zh: 文献中一个被充分记录的现象是消费者在选择中表现出持续性。本研究利用价格比较平台上矿泉水品类的数据，该平台通过“换购省钱”按钮实时提示更便宜的替代品，考察了这些提示是否以及如何影响在线杂货购物中的持续性产品选择。研究发现，收到提示后转而选择替代产品的购物者，在后续访问中选择该替代产品的可能性高出23.7个百分点，且这一效应持续长达10次购物行程。我们的分析表明，这种持续影响并非由长期成本节省驱动，而是通过实时提示实现的产品发现所促成。
url:15aa146bfcbe95f6.title: DP21901 Swap and Save: How a Button Shapes Lasting Online Grocery Shopping Behavior

url:15c52b253f255d78.abstract: The White House Faith Office is expanding federal support for religious organisations. Can government policy change how religious citizens are, and what does blurring the line between church and state do to attitudes and polarisation? Exploiting the staggered rollout of ‘faith-based initiatives’ across US states from 1996 to 2009, this column shows that church attendance rose sharply among Protestants, new faith-based organisations multiplied, and social views hardened against abortion and homosexuality, while the rest of the population continued to secularise.
url:15c52b253f255d78.abstract_zh: 白宫信仰办公室正在扩大对宗教组织的联邦支持。政府政策能否改变宗教公民的信仰状态，而模糊教会与国家界限又会对态度和极化产生何种影响？利用1996年至2009年间美国各州“信仰倡议”分阶段推行的自然实验，本专栏显示，新教徒的教堂出席率显著上升，新兴信仰组织数量倍增，社会观念在堕胎和同性恋问题上趋于强硬，而其余人口则继续世俗化。
url:15c52b253f255d78.title: Government support of religion strengthened religiosity and divided America
url:15c52b253f255d78.title_zh: 政府对宗教的支持强化了宗教虔诚并加剧了美国社会分裂

url:1600db9f56ef62ce.abstract: China’s efforts to develop commodity futures markets and enhance its influence over commodity pricing are best understood as part of a broader strategy to reduce financial vulnerabilities and increase strategic autonomy within a hierarchical global financial system. Commodity pricing power – defined as the capacity to shape the infrastructures, regulation, participation and currency denomination of derivative markets through which prices are formed – has become an increasingly important component of geopolitical competition. For China, this is not about economic efficiency, but control over the terms under which strategically important commodities are valued and traded.
url:1600db9f56ef62ce.abstract_zh: 中国发展商品期货市场并增强其对大宗商品定价影响力的努力，应被理解为在层级化全球金融体系中减少金融脆弱性、提升战略自主性的更广泛战略的一部分。大宗商品定价权——即塑造衍生品市场基础设施、监管规则、参与主体及货币计价方式的能力，而价格正是通过这一市场形成的——已成为地缘政治竞争日益重要的组成部分。对中国而言，这并非关乎经济效率，而是对战略性大宗商品估值与交易条件的掌控。
url:1600db9f56ef62ce.title: Pricing the Future: China’s Ambitions for Commodity Derivatives Markets
url:1600db9f56ef62ce.title_zh: 定价未来：中国对商品衍生品市场的雄心

url:162d11df1fb2ed91.abstract: Asia-Pacific has undergone a profound transformation over the past few decades, increasing its share in global trade and GDP. This paper assesses to what extent Asia-Pacific’s role in global finance has expanded commensurately and whether it has become more integrated by systematically analyzing crossborder financial data. We combine descriptive analyses of past trends in financial positions with network analysis to understand how inter- and intra- regional financial linkages have evolved for economies in the region. We find that Asia-Pacific’s role in global finance still significantly lags its role in global trade and that there is considerable heterogeneity within the region. Advanced economies in the region are well integrated into global financial markets, whereas most emerging markets exhibit more limited integration. Financial integration within the region is also low but diverges significantly by instrument. Intra-regional financial integration is advancing in foreign direct investment (FDI) and cross-border banking (the latter from low levels), but has remained limited in foreign portfolio investment (FPI). Gravity model analysis indicates a significant association between trade and FDI, but not between trade and FPI. We conclude the paper with policy recommendations to promote resilient financial integration in Asia-Pacific.
url:162d11df1fb2ed91.abstract_zh: 亚太地区在过去几十年经历了深刻变革，其在全球贸易和GDP中的份额不断提升。本文通过系统分析跨境金融数据，评估亚太地区在全球金融中的角色是否相应扩大，以及其金融一体化程度是否加深。我们结合对金融头寸历史趋势的描述性分析与网络分析，以理解该地区经济体之间及区域内金融联系的演变。研究发现，亚太地区在全球金融中的作用仍显著落后于其在全球贸易中的地位，且区域内存在较大异质性。该地区的发达经济体已深度融入全球金融市场，而大多数新兴市场的融入程度则较为有限。区域内金融一体化水平同样较低，但不同工具间差异显著。区域内金融一体化在外商直接投资（FDI）和跨境银行业务（后者起点较低）方面有所推进，但在外国证券投资（FPI）方面仍较为有限。引力模型分析表明，贸易与FDI之间存在显著关联，但贸易与FPI之间并无显著关联。本文最后提出政策建议，以促进亚太地区具有韧性的金融一体化。
url:162d11df1fb2ed91.title: The Changing Landscape of Financial Integration in Asia-Pacific
url:162d11df1fb2ed91.title_zh: 亚太金融一体化的格局演变

url:1669ee60e949db3c.abstract: The Covid pandemic dramatically altered patterns of daily life, particularly through widespread declines in mobility due to lockdowns and social distancing measures. While the economic and epidemiological effects of these restrictions have been widely studied, their broader health implications remain underexplored. This paper investigates the relationship between mobility decline during the Covid pandemic and hypertension outcomes in India. Leveraging district-level variation in mobility from Google Community Mobility Reports and health data from the 2019–2021 Indian Demographic and Health Survey (DHS), we find that a 1 percentage point reduction in mobility over the 30 days prior to interview is associated with a 0.3 percentage point decrease in the likelihood of having normal blood pressure. The effect is driven by increases in pre-hypertensive and mildly elevated blood pressure, with no significant changes in more severe hypertension. We examine potential mechanisms—healthcare access, stress (proxied by alcohol use), and reduced physical activity—and find limited explanatory power for the former two. These findings suggest that reduced physical mobility likely played a key role in worsening cardiovascular risk profiles. The results underscore the importance of integrating chronic disease considerations into the design of mobility-restricting public health interventions.
url:1669ee60e949db3c.abstract_zh: 新冠疫情深刻改变了日常生活模式，尤其通过封锁和社交距离措施导致人口流动性普遍下降。尽管这些限制措施的经济和流行病学影响已被广泛研究，但其对健康的更广泛影响仍待深入探讨。本文研究了新冠疫情期间印度人口流动性下降与高血压结果之间的关联。利用谷歌社区流动性报告中的地区级流动性差异数据，以及2019-2021年印度人口与健康调查（DHS）的健康数据，我们发现：受访前30天内流动性每降低1个百分点，血压正常的概率下降0.3个百分点。该效应主要由高血压前期和轻度血压升高病例增加驱动，而重度高血压未见显著变化。我们检验了潜在机制——医疗可及性、压力（以饮酒为代理变量）和体力活动减少——发现前两者的解释力有限。这些结果表明，体力活动减少可能在恶化心血管风险特征中发挥了关键作用。研究结果强调，在设计限制流动性的公共卫生干预措施时，必须将慢性病防控纳入考量。
url:1669ee60e949db3c.title: Public Health Trade-Offs During a Pandemic: Mobility Decline and Hypertension Risk in Indialoven
url:1669ee60e949db3c.title_zh: 疫情期间的公共卫生权衡：印度流动性下降与高血压风险

url:166f28b2ae37bbc1.abstract: We study how macroeconomic developments affect asset prices by analyzing the response of equity yields to a well-identified long-run growth shock. Using synthetic equity yield data from Giglio et al. (2024), we show that a positive long-run shock steepens the equity yield curve by increasing expected dividend growth while leaving discount rates largely unchanged. We examine how the investment driving this growth is financed and how yields respond across value and growth firms. Growth-firm yields respond more strongly than value-firm yields, reflecting larger changes in expected dividend growth. Ai et al. (2018)'s model, modified to separate cash dividends from total payout, best matches these responses relative to benchmark equity term structure models.
url:166f28b2ae37bbc1.abstract_zh: 本文通过分析股票收益率对明确识别的长期增长冲击的反应，研究宏观经济变化如何影响资产价格。利用Giglio等人（2024）的合成股票收益率数据，我们发现正向长期冲击通过提高预期股息增长率使股票收益率曲线陡峭化，而贴现率基本保持不变。我们考察了驱动这一增长的投资融资方式，以及价值型与成长型公司收益率的差异化反应。成长型公司收益率对冲击的反应强于价值型公司，这反映了其预期股息增长率的更大变化。相较于基准股票期限结构模型，Ai等人（2018）的模型（经修正以分离现金股息与总派息）最能匹配这些反应特征。
url:166f28b2ae37bbc1.title: The Response of Equity Yields to a Long-Run Shock
url:166f28b2ae37bbc1.title_zh: 股权收益率对长期冲击的反应

url:16761602fd1236ec.abstract: Did globalisation benefit consumers in poor countries? Using data on trade in goods for 138 countries, we measure the welfare gains from wider variety and higher quality of imported goods over the past quarter-century. The variety gains are large, a median 19 percent fall in the cost of living, and strongly pro-poor: poorer countries gained twice as much as richer ones. Because they derive from falling trade costs, variety gains made poor countries richer in real consumption even in the absence of income growth. Quality, by contrast, tracks income, and because income barely converged, neither did quality.
url:16761602fd1236ec.abstract_zh: 全球化是否惠及贫困国家的消费者？基于138个国家的商品贸易数据，我们测算了过去25年间进口商品种类扩大与质量提升所带来的福利收益。种类扩大带来的收益显著，使生活成本中位数下降19%，且具有强烈的亲贫效应：贫困国家的收益是富裕国家的两倍。由于这些收益源于贸易成本下降，即便收入未增长，种类扩大仍使贫困国家的实际消费水平提升。相比之下，质量提升与收入水平挂钩，而由于收入趋同现象微弱，质量趋同亦未实现。
url:16761602fd1236ec.title: Globalisation, Income, and Welfare: Imported Goods Variety and Quality
url:16761602fd1236ec.title_zh: 全球化、收入与福利：进口商品的多样性与质量

url:16b5818cec6fe9d4.abstract: Gender gaps in pay and leadership roles are well documented across labor markets. However, the literature on low- and middle-income countries is limited, and it remains unclear whether these gaps reflect sorting into lucrative, high-skill sectors or differential career progression within those sectors. This paper examines gender differences in compensation, advancement, and career-relevant mechanisms within such a high-skill sector, focusing on finance in Ethiopia and using evidence from the country’s largest commercial bank, the Commercial Bank of Ethiopia, which is estimated to account for roughly one-quarter of employment in the country’s finance sector. Using six years of administrative records covering the universe of nearly 50,000 employees, combined with large-scale employee and manager surveys, the paper documents substantial gender gaps in compensation and career advancement: women earn approximately 85 percent as much as men, are 80 percent less likely to hold supervisory roles, and are 68 percent less likely to hold managerial roles. These gaps are not explained by differences in education, experience, or internal performance evaluations. The study finds little support for commonly cited mechanisms emphasized in high-income settings, including gender differences in willingness to compete for promotions, negotiate, or access professional networks. Instead, gender differences emerge in access to career-enhancing opportunities and in constraints on work flexibility. Together, these findings suggest that gender gaps in advancement arise not from lower ambition or weaker effort but from differences in exposure to advancement-relevant opportunities and in time allocation and geographic mobility, some of which may be amplified through supervisors’ perceptions. The bank under study performs relatively well on aggregate gender indicators and has explicitly prioritized women’s advancement, suggesting that these estimates are likely lower bounds on gender gaps elsewhere in the financial sector and that substantial disparities can persist even in comparatively favorable institutional settings.
url:16b5818cec6fe9d4.abstract_zh: 劳动力市场中的薪酬和领导职位性别差距已有充分记录。然而，针对低收入和中等收入国家的研究仍然有限，且尚不清楚这些差距是反映了向高薪、高技能行业的分类选择，还是反映了这些行业内部的职业发展差异。本文考察了此类高技能行业中的性别差异，涵盖薪酬、晋升及与职业相关的机制，重点关注埃塞俄比亚的金融业，并利用该国最大商业银行——埃塞俄比亚商业银行的数据，该银行估计占该国金融业就业人数的约四分之一。通过使用覆盖近5万名员工全体的六年行政记录，结合大规模员工和管理者调查，本文记录了薪酬和职业晋升方面的显著性别差距：女性收入约为男性的85%，担任主管职位的可能性低80%，担任管理职位的可能性低68%。这些差距无法用教育背景、工作经验或内部绩效评估的差异来解释。研究发现，对高收入环境中常被引用的机制支持甚少，包括性别在竞争晋升、谈判或获取职业网络意愿方面的差异。相反，性别差异体现在获取职业发展机会的途径以及工作灵活性方面的限制上。综合来看，这些发现表明，晋升中的性别差距并非源于较低的抱负或较弱的努力，而是源于接触晋升相关机会的差异以及时间分配和地理流动性的差异，其中部分可能通过主管的认知被放大。所研究的银行在总体性别指标上表现相对较好，并明确优先考虑女性晋升，这表明这些估计可能是在金融业其他领域性别差距的下限，且即使在相对有利的制度环境中，显著的不平等现象仍可能持续存在。
url:16b5818cec6fe9d4.title: Gender Gaps in Pay and Advancement within Firms: Evidence from Ethiopia’s Financial Sector
url:16b5818cec6fe9d4.title_zh: 企业内薪酬与晋升的性别差距：来自埃塞俄比亚金融部门的证据

url:16c43af5d0af7067.abstract: This paper studies how the durability of assets affects financing. We show that more durable assets require larger down payments making them harder to finance, because durability affects the price of assets and hence the overall financing need more than their collateral value. Durability affects technology adoption, the choice between new and used capital, and the rent versus buy decision. Constrained firms invest in less durable assets and buy used assets. More durable assets are more likely to be rented. Economies with weak legal enforcement invest more in less durable, otherwise dominated assets and are net importers of used assets.
url:16c43af5d0af7067.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了资产耐用性如何影响融资。我们证明，更耐用的资产需要更高的首付，从而使其更难融资，因为耐用性影响资产价格，进而对整体融资需求的影响超过其抵押价值。耐用性影响技术采纳、新旧资本的选择以及租赁与购买决策。受约束的企业投资于耐用性较低的资产并购买二手资产。更耐用的资产更可能被租赁。法律执行薄弱的经济体更多投资于耐用性较低、在其他方面处于劣势的资产，并成为二手资产的净进口国。
url:16c43af5d0af7067.title: Financing Durable Assets

url:16f530539bd65c28.abstract: A long literature in economics and public health has examined the relationship between socioeconomic status (SES) and health, often relying on area-based measures when individual-level data are unavailable. Using comprehensive Dutch administrative data, we build on work estimating income-health gradients (e.g., Chetty et al. 2016) and study how the level of aggregation systematically shapes estimates by inducing so-called ecological or atomistic biases. Individual and area income proxy for different channels (e.g., personal resources vs. local surroundings), but are obviously correlated. Aggregating to the area level reduces meaningful variation and attenuates non-linearities. We find that area-level estimates exaggerate the income gradient relative to individual-level estimates and are less robust to including individual and area-level controls respectively. Moreover, interaction analyses reveal that area exposure is highly unequal: the health of low-income households are far more sensitive to neighbourhood conditions than high-income households. Together, these findings shed light on the sources of SES–health gradients and show how data aggregation affects both interpretation and empirical estimates.
url:16f530539bd65c28.abstract_zh: 经济学与公共卫生领域的长期文献已探讨了社会经济地位（SES）与健康之间的关系，当个体层面数据不可得时，常依赖基于区域的度量指标。利用全面的荷兰行政数据，我们在估计收入-健康梯度的工作基础上（如Chetty等人，2016），研究了聚合层级如何通过引发所谓的生态或原子主义偏差而系统性影响估计结果。个体与区域收入分别代理不同的作用渠道（如个人资源与周边环境），但二者显然相关。将数据聚合至区域层面会减少有意义的变异并削弱非线性特征。我们发现，相较于个体层面估计，区域层面估计夸大了收入梯度，并且在分别纳入个体与区域层面控制变量时稳健性较差。此外，交互分析揭示区域暴露存在高度不平等：低收入家庭的健康对邻里条件的敏感度远高于高收入家庭。综合来看，这些发现揭示了SES-健康梯度的来源，并展示了数据聚合如何同时影响解释与实证估计。
url:16f530539bd65c28.title: DP21612 Explaining the Atomistic versus Ecological Fallacies in SES-Health Gradients
url:16f530539bd65c28.title_zh: 解释SES-健康梯度中的原子主义与生态学谬误

url:170c62736e77c0df.abstract: This paper shows that unilateral decarbonization pays for itself in large economies. We estimate economic damages from global temperature shocks and combine them with a climate-economy model to construct Domestic Costs of Carbon: $226 per ton for the United States and $216 per ton for the European Union. When compared to marginal abatement costs, these values imply over 80% unilateral decarbonization for both economies, an order of magnitude larger than under conventional damages estimated based on local temperature.
url:170c62736e77c0df.abstract_zh: 本文表明，在大型经济体中，单边脱碳能够自我补偿。我们估算了全球温度冲击造成的经济损失，并将其与气候-经济模型相结合，构建了国内碳成本：美国为每吨226美元，欧盟为每吨216美元。与边际减排成本相比，这些数值意味着两个经济体可实现超过80%的单边脱碳，这一比例比基于当地温度估算的传统损害所隐含的水平高出一个数量级。
url:170c62736e77c0df.title: DP19938 Does Unilateral Decarbonization Pay For Itself?
url:170c62736e77c0df.title_zh: DP19938 单边脱碳能否自我补偿？

url:17166bfc070db7ae.abstract: Governments frequently intervene to support domestic industries, but a surprising amount of this support goes to ailing sectors. We explain this with a lobbying model that allows for entry and sunk costs. Specifically, policy is influenced by pressure groups that incur lobbying expenses to create rents. In expanding industry, entry tends to erode such rents, but in declining industries, sunk costs rule out entry as long as the rents are not too high. This asymmetric appropriability of rents means losers lobby harder. Thus it is not that government policy picks losers, it is that losers pick government policy.
url:17166bfc070db7ae.abstract_zh: 政府经常干预以支持国内产业，但令人惊讶的是，大量此类支持流向了陷入困境的行业。我们通过一个允许进入和沉没成本的游说模型来解释这一现象。具体而言，政策受到压力集团的影响，这些集团通过承担游说费用来创造租金。在扩张性行业中，进入往往会侵蚀此类租金，但在衰退行业中，只要租金不过高，沉没成本就会排除进入的可能性。这种租金的不对称可获取性意味着失败者会更努力地进行游说。因此，并非政府政策选择了失败者，而是失败者选择了政府政策。
url:17166bfc070db7ae.title: Entry and Asymmetric Lobbying: Why Governments Pick Losers
url:17166bfc070db7ae.title_zh: 进入与不对称游说：为何政府选择失败者

url:171d525677eca0cf.abstract: We discuss the conditions under which global imbalances, such as China being a large foreign creditor and the United States being a large foreign debtor, might also generate power imbalances. We highlight possible theoretical channels and empirical measures that the future literature could investigate in a full treatment of this topic.
url:171d525677eca0cf.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了全球失衡（如中国作为大型外国债权国、美国作为大型外国债务国）可能引发权力失衡的条件。我们指出了未来文献在全面探讨此议题时可能研究的理论渠道与实证度量方法。
url:171d525677eca0cf.title: Global Imbalances and Power Imbalances

url:17247184469e35ca.abstract: We show that the optimal monetary policy and exchange rate framework depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions may vary with the commodity cycle, and we compute the welfare-optimal policy in the presence of price and wage rigidities. Stabilizing domestic prices is welfare-optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But for economies that use commodities as inputs in production, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ the direct and indirect effects of commodity shocks on domestic prices; this contrasts with some earlier findings and policy practice (which only ‘looks through’ the direct effect). Exchange-rate pegs increase welfare for commodity importers because they stabilize wages and employment, though it is not a robustly optimal policy. In emerging and developing economies, where financial conditions are more tied to the commodity cycle, trade-offs are starker and implementing the optimal policy may be challenging, since it requires enough credibility to keep inflation expectations anchored amidst greater volatility in some nominal variables.
url:17247184469e35ca.abstract_zh: 我们证明，最优货币政策与汇率框架的关键取决于经济体的商品敞口。我们构建了一个灵活且易于处理的模型经济体，其中包含商品出口与进口，且国际金融状况可能随商品周期而变化，并在存在价格与工资刚性的情况下计算了福利最优政策。对于商品出口国而言，稳定国内价格是福利最优的，这与标准开放经济政策建议一致。但对于将商品作为生产投入的经济体，最优政策在很大程度上会“忽略”商品冲击对国内价格的直接与间接影响——这与早期的一些发现及政策实践（仅“忽略”直接影响）形成对比。对商品进口国而言，汇率盯住制度能提升福利，因其可稳定工资与就业，但这并非稳健的最优政策。在新兴及发展中经济体，金融状况与商品周期的关联更为紧密，政策权衡更为严峻，实施最优政策可能面临挑战，因为这需要足够的公信力，以便在部分名义变量波动加剧时仍能锚定通胀预期。
url:17247184469e35ca.title: How Should Central Banks Respond to Commodity Price Shocks? Optimal Monetary and Exchange Rate Frameworks for Commodity-Exposed Economies
url:17247184469e35ca.title_zh: 中央银行应如何应对大宗商品价格冲击？大宗商品暴露经济体的最优货币与汇率框架

url:172e8bcd5f0f0726.abstract: Using a large and representative panel of U.S. brokerage accounts, we show that retail investors trade as contrarians after large earnings surprises, especially for loser stocks, and that such contrarian trading contributes to price momentum and post earnings announcement drift (PEAD). We show that extreme return streaks and surprises are not enough for stocks to exhibit PEAD and momentum and that the intensity of contrarian retail trading plays a key role: the PEAD of loser stocks with bad earnings surprises becomes increasingly more negative as retail buying pressure increases, and he PEAD of the stocks with the highest past returns and largest earnings surprises is the most positive for the stocks with the biggest net retail outflow. Finer sorts confirm the results, as do sorts by firm size and institutional ownership level. Younger and more attentive individuals are more likely to be contrarian, and a firm’s dividend yield, leverage, size, book to market, and analyst coverage are associated with the fraction of contrarian trades they face around earnings announcements. The disposition effect and stale limit orders, while present in our sample, do not explain our results. Our findings are consistent with investors’ conservatism, sticky beliefs, and cognitive uncertainty, as well as an incorrect belief in the Law of Small Numbers.
url:172e8bcd5f0f0726.abstract_zh: 利用美国经纪账户的大规模代表性面板数据，我们表明散户投资者在重大盈利意外后，尤其是对亏损股票，会进行反向交易，且此类反向交易促进了价格动量及盈余公告后漂移（PEAD）。我们证明，极端的收益连续性和意外本身不足以使股票表现出PEAD和动量，而反向散户交易的强度起着关键作用：对于盈利意外不佳的亏损股票，随着散户买入压力的增加，其PEAD变得越来越负；而对于过去收益最高且盈利意外最大的股票，其PEAD在散户净流出最大的股票中最为正向。更细分的分类确认了这些结果，按公司规模和机构持股水平的分类也是如此。较年轻且更为关注的个体更可能进行反向交易，而公司的股息收益率、杠杆率、规模、账面市值比和分析师覆盖度与盈余公告期间其面临的反向交易比例相关。处置效应和过期限价订单虽然存在于我们的样本中，但并不能解释我们的结果。我们的发现与投资者的保守主义、信念粘性、认知不确定性以及对小数定律的错误信念相一致。
url:172e8bcd5f0f0726.title: DP20487 Retail Investors’ Contrarian Behavior Around News, Attention, and the Momentum Effect
url:172e8bcd5f0f0726.title_zh: DP20487 新闻、关注与动量效应背景下散户投资者的逆向行为

url:173f93d2fa9e95ce.abstract: Raising the retirement age is a common policy response when social security schemes face fiscal pressures. We develop and estimate a dynamic life cycle model to study optimal retirement and tax policy when individuals face health shocks and income risk and make endogenous retirement decisions. The model incorporates key features of Social Security, Medicare, income taxation, and savings incentives and distinguishes three channels through which health affects retirement: nonconvexities in labor supply due to health-dependent fixed costs of working, earnings reductions, and mortality risk. We estimate our model to match US microdata and show that labor supply nonconvexities play a dominant role in driving early retirement, making rigid increases in the retirement age welfare reducing. In contrast, more flexible policies, such as increasing the dependence of Social Security benefits on the claiming age, can improve welfare and pay for themselves with a fiscal surplus. We map a range of policy reforms to their marginal values of public funds (MVPFs), showing that certain incentives to delay claiming offer MVPFs of infinity while broad-based retirement age increases have negative willingness-to-pay. These findings offer novel retirement policy prescriptions and challenge the prevailing emphasis on raising the retirement age.
url:173f93d2fa9e95ce.abstract_zh: 提高退休年龄是社会保障体系面临财政压力时常见的政策应对措施。我们构建并估计了一个动态生命周期模型，以研究当个体面临健康冲击和收入风险并做出内生退休决策时的最优退休与税收政策。该模型整合了社会保障、医疗保险、所得税和储蓄激励的核心特征，并区分了健康影响退休的三个渠道：因健康依赖的固定工作成本导致的劳动力供给非凸性、收入减少以及死亡风险。我们通过匹配美国微观数据估计模型，发现劳动力供给非凸性在推动提前退休中起主导作用，这使得刚性提高退休年龄的政策会降低福利。相比之下，更灵活的政策（如增加社会保障福利对领取年龄的依赖程度）既能改善福利，又能通过财政盈余实现自我融资。我们将一系列政策改革映射到其公共资金边际价值（MVPF），发现某些延迟领取激励措施的MVPF为无穷大，而广泛提高退休年龄的政策则具有负支付意愿。这些发现提出了新颖的退休政策建议，并对当前强调提高退休年龄的主流观点构成挑战。
url:173f93d2fa9e95ce.title: DP20322 Flexible Retirement and Optimal Taxation
url:173f93d2fa9e95ce.title_zh: DP20322 灵活退休与最优税收

url:1754ea6642656d81.abstract: We study risk-neutral control in Markov decision processes with an absorbing catastrophic state. Even though rewards are linear and the agent has no utility curvature, probability weighting, or framing dependence, standard Bellman optimality produces three prospect-theory-like signatures: an S-shaped value-function profile (convex near catastrophe, concave in the far field), an endogenous loss-sensitivity coefficient $\lambda^*(S) > 1$, and a reflection-effect policy reversal. Across 495 configurations, the optimal policy plays safe near catastrophe in positive-drift (growth) regimes despite the risky action
url:1754ea6642656d81.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有吸收性灾难状态的马尔可夫决策过程中的风险中性控制。尽管奖励是线性的，且主体没有效用曲率、概率加权或框架依赖，标准贝尔曼最优性仍产生三种类似前景理论的特征：S形价值函数轮廓（在灾难附近凸，在远场凹）、内生的损失敏感系数$\lambda^*(S) > 1$，以及反射效应策略反转。在495种配置中，最优策略在正漂移（增长）机制下于灾难附近采取安全行动，尽管存在风险行动。
url:1754ea6642656d81.title: Prospect-Theory Behavior from Bellman Optimality in MDPs with Catastrophic States
url:1754ea6642656d81.title_zh: 具有灾难状态的MDP中来自贝尔曼最优性的前景理论行为

url:17569756825f517b.abstract: Vision problems are prevalent among Medicare beneficiaries, with the majority having treatable conditions including uncorrected refractive error and cataracts. However, traditional Medicare does not cover routine eye exams or eyeglasses, and Medicare Advantage supplemental vision benefits often include low annual limits. We examine the effects of Medicaid routine vision benefits among adults dually eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, a population with high rates of vision impairment, morbidity, and disability. Using 2002-2019 Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate that Medicaid routine vision benefits increase past-year eye exams, eyeglasses purchases, and Medicaid spending on eyeglasses while reducing out-of-pocket spending. We also find suggestive evidence of spillovers to Medicare Advantage spending on eyeglasses, consistent with Medicaid routine vision coverage inducing additional eyeglasses purchases among Medicare Advantage enrollees with supplemental vision benefits, although estimates are modest.
url:17569756825f517b.abstract_zh: 视力问题在医疗保险受益人中普遍存在，其中大多数人患有可治疗的眼部疾病，包括未矫正的屈光不正和白内障。然而，传统医疗保险并不覆盖常规眼科检查或眼镜，而医疗保险优势计划的补充视力福利往往设有较低的年度限额。我们研究了医疗补助常规视力福利对同时符合医疗保险和医疗补助资格的成年人的影响，这一人群视力损伤、患病率和残疾率较高。利用2002-2019年医疗保险当前受益人调查数据及双重差分设计，我们估计医疗补助常规视力福利增加了过去一年的眼科检查、眼镜购买及医疗补助在眼镜上的支出，同时减少了自付费用。我们还发现了对医疗保险优势计划眼镜支出溢出效应的提示性证据，这与医疗补助常规视力覆盖促使拥有补充视力福利的医疗保险优势计划参保者额外购买眼镜相一致，尽管估计值较为温和。
url:17569756825f517b.title: When Medicaid Pays the Bill: Routine Vision Benefits, Eye Care Use, and Eyeglasses Spending Among Dual-eligible Medicare Enrollees

url:179d88dc1598d8de.abstract: Natural disasters undermine economic development, destroying lives, livelihoods, the built and natural environment. Public assistance programs follow, but knowledge of their reach, impact and evolution is limited. We address this gap, analyzing population-representative longitudinal survey data collected in Indonesia before and for two decades after the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami which was followed by a large recovery program involving multiple major actors. Those who lived, at the time of the tsunami, in communities that were badly damaged, were far more likely to receive aid and received larger amounts than residents of other areas immediately after the tsunami. Those gaps were small and insignificant four years post-tsunami. Conditional on exposure, individual attributes also shaped receipt which reached the vulnerable, particularly poor and female-headed households. Housing assistance, distributed several years post-tsunami to those who lost homes, was critical in the eyes of recipients, playing a key role as they rebuilt livelihoods.
url:179d88dc1598d8de.abstract_zh: 自然灾害破坏经济发展，夺走生命，摧毁生计、建成环境与自然环境。随后会有公共援助项目跟进，但关于这些项目的覆盖范围、影响及其演变过程的知识却十分有限。我们针对这一空白进行了研究，分析了在2004年印度洋海啸之前及之后二十年期间，在印度尼西亚收集的具有人口代表性的纵向调查数据。海啸之后，一个涉及多个主要行动方的大型恢复项目随之展开。在海啸发生时居住于受损严重社区的人们，在海啸后立即获得援助的可能性远高于其他地区的居民，且获得的援助金额也更大。然而，在海啸四年后，这些差距已变得微小且不显著。在受灾害影响的前提下，个人特征也影响了援助的获取，援助惠及了弱势群体，尤其是贫困家庭和女性户主家庭。住房援助在海啸后数年发放给失去家园的人们，在受助者眼中至关重要，在他们重建生计的过程中发挥了关键作用。

url:17e8f02258720842.abstract: More frequent large macroeconomic shocks since the global financial crisis have entrenched uncertainty, particularly in Europe. This has increased the premium on central bank communication in guiding expectations and strengthening macroeconomic resilience. European central banks have responded by adapting their communication toolkits and styles. This study provides a systematic assessment of recent central bank communication across advanced and emerging European economies, combining a survey of institutional communication frameworks with novel text-miningbased indicators on monetary policy guidance in these economies over 2009-2025. While communication toolkits are broadly similar, their intensity and transparency differ markedly, with central banks in advanced economies making greater use of forward-looking tools. Central banks in both groups respond primarily to inflation uncertainty. However, communication strategies diverge, as central banks in advanced economies increasingly shift toward forward-looking language, whereas those in emerging markets shift toward more backward-looking communication. These patterns highlight credibility and institutional capacity as key determinants of central bank communication under uncertainty.
url:17e8f02258720842.abstract_zh: 自全球金融危机以来，频繁发生的宏观经济冲击加剧了不确定性，尤其是在欧洲地区。这提升了央行沟通在引导预期和增强宏观经济韧性方面的价值。欧洲各国央行通过调整其沟通工具包和风格予以应对。本研究结合对机构沟通框架的调查，以及基于文本挖掘技术构建的2009-2025年欧洲发达与新兴经济体货币政策指引新指标，系统评估了近期欧洲各国央行的沟通实践。尽管沟通工具包大致相似，但其使用强度和透明度存在显著差异——发达经济体央行更频繁运用前瞻性工具。两组央行均主要对通胀不确定性作出反应，但沟通策略呈现分化：发达经济体央行日益转向前瞻性表述，而新兴市场央行则更多采用后顾式沟通。这些模式凸显了在不确定性环境下，可信度与制度能力是决定央行沟通策略的关键因素。
url:17e8f02258720842.title: Central Bank Communication in Times of Uncertainty: AI-assisted Decoding of Recent Trends in Europe
url:17e8f02258720842.title_zh: 不确定性时期的央行沟通：欧洲近期趋势的AI辅助解读

url:17fe92d413d4f89a.abstract: This paper develops a new public database to estimate inflation heterogeneity across socio-demographic groups in the United States in real time. These distributional CPIs (D-CPIs) are fully consistent with the methodology of the official CPI and are available from 2002 to the present day by household income, age, race and other characteristics. Using this database, I establish three results showing that D-CPIs have important implications for the measurement of long-run trends in inequality and poverty, as well as of real wage dynamics during crises. First, "real" inequality across household income quintiles increased about 45 % faster with DCPIs between 2002 and 2019, compared to the official CPI. While the pre-tax income gap between the top and bottom household income quintiles increased by 15.6 % during this period according to the official CPI, it increased by 22.6 % with D-CPIs. Similarly large adjustments apply to consumption inequality and inequality in pre-tax and post-tax national incomes. Second, today 2.3 million people are below the "real" poverty line using D-CPIs but above the poverty threshold using the official CPI. Third, during the inflation burst following the Covid-19 pandemic, inflation was higher for the middle class, compared to low-income and high-income households. This pattern is driven by gas and vehicles and implies that the compression of "real" wages was about 25 % faster with D-CPIs than with the official CPI. Similar patterns of inflation heterogeneity hold in extensions allowing for geographic heterogeneity in inflation, non-homothetic price indices, and expanding the analysis back to 1983.
url:17fe92d413d4f89a.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个新的公共数据库，用于实时估算美国不同社会经济群体的通胀差异。这些分配性消费者价格指数（D-CPIs）与官方CPI的方法论完全一致，并自2002年起至今，按家庭收入、年龄、种族及其他特征提供数据。利用该数据库，我得出三项结果，表明D-CPIs对衡量长期不平等和贫困趋势，以及危机期间实际工资动态具有重要意义。首先，在2002年至2019年间，使用D-CPIs衡量的家庭收入五分位组间的“实际”不平等增速比官方CPI快约45%。根据官方CPI，此期间最高与最低家庭收入五分位组间的税前收入差距增加了15.6%，而使用D-CPIs则增加了22.6%。类似的大幅调整同样适用于消费不平等以及税前和税后国民收入的不平等。其次，目前有230万人使用D-CPIs衡量处于“实际”贫困线以下，但根据官方CPI则高于贫困阈值。第三，在新冠疫情后的通胀爆发期间，中产阶级的通胀率高于低收入和高收入家庭。这一模式主要由汽油和车辆价格驱动，并意味着使用D-CPIs衡量的“实际”工资压缩速度比官方CPI快约25%。在允许通胀地理异质性、非齐次价格指数以及将分析扩展至1983年的扩展分析中，通胀异质性呈现出相似模式。
url:17fe92d413d4f89a.title: Distributional Consumer Price Indices

url:184352110b1e8216.abstract: This paper develops a framework for identification, estimation, and inference on the causal mechanisms driving endogenous social network formation. Identification is challenging because of unobserved confounders and reverse causality; inference is complicated by questions of equilibrium and sampling. We leverage repeated observations of a network over time and random variation in initial ties to address challenges to causal identification. Our design-based approach sidesteps questions of sampling and asymptotics by treating both the set of nodes (individuals) and potential outcomes as non-random. We apply our approach to data from a large professional services firm, where new hires are randomly assigned to project teams within offices. We estimate the causal effect on tie formation of indirect ties, network degree, and local network density. Indirect ties have a strong and significant positive effect on tie formation, while the effects of degree and density are smaller and less robust.
url:184352110b1e8216.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个用于识别、估计和推断内生社交网络形成因果机制的分析框架。由于存在未观测到的混杂因素和反向因果关系，识别过程面临挑战；而均衡与抽样问题则使推断变得复杂。我们利用网络随时间推移的重复观测数据以及初始联系的随机变异，以应对因果识别中的挑战。这种基于设计的方法将节点（个体）集合与潜在结果均视为非随机变量，从而规避了抽样与渐近性问题。我们将该方法应用于一家大型专业服务公司的数据——该公司新员工被随机分配到办公室内的项目团队中。我们估算了间接联系、网络度数及局部网络密度对联系形成的因果效应。结果表明，间接联系对联系形成具有显著且稳健的正向影响，而网络度数与密度的效应则相对较小且不够稳健。
url:184352110b1e8216.title: Causal inference for social network formation
url:184352110b1e8216.title_zh: 社交网络形成的因果推断

url:184a1e01a2b8d3a7.abstract: I introduce a dynamic framework to analyze platforms. The (single) platform owner sets prices at the beginning of each period. Agents (buyers, sellers, readers, consumers, merchants, etc) make platform membership decisions occasionally. I show that optimal platform pricing addresses two externalities: across sides and across time periods. This results in optimal prices which depend on platform size in a non-trivial way. By means of numerical simulations, I examine the determinants of equilibrium platform size, showing that the stationary distribution of platform size may be bi-modal, that is, with some probability the platform remains very low or takes very long to increase in size. I also contrast the dynamics of proprietary vs non-proprietary (i.e., zero-priced) platforms; and consider the specific case of asymmetric platforms (one side cares about the other but not vice-versa).
url:184a1e01a2b8d3a7.abstract_zh: 我引入了一个动态框架来分析平台。平台（单一）所有者在每期初设定价格。代理人（买家、卖家、读者、消费者、商家等）偶尔做出平台成员决策。我表明，最优平台定价需解决两种外部性：跨边外部性和跨期外部性。这导致最优价格以非平凡方式依赖于平台规模。通过数值模拟，我考察了均衡平台规模的决定因素，显示平台规模的平稳分布可能是双峰的，即平台以一定概率保持极低水平或需要很长时间才能增长。我还对比了专有平台与非专有（即零价格）平台的动态；并考虑了不对称平台的具体情形（一方关心另一方，但反之不然）。
url:184a1e01a2b8d3a7.title: Towards a Theory of Platform Dynamics

url:185a9a16cb787648.abstract: This paper estimates the economic effects of communal riots in India using a new district–year panel for 1994–2013 that combines extended riot data with nightlights, manufacturing outcomes, infrastructure, and district-level credit. To address endogeneity, we use quasi-random variation generated when major Hindu festivals fall on a Friday (Fridays draw large Muslim congregations for weekly prayers) and construct a spatially weighted instrument for local riot risk. Instrumental variable estimates show that higher riot exposure leads to sizable and persistent economic losses. A one-unit increase in distance-weighted exposure reduces nightlights by about 0.105 log points, implying a GDP decline of roughly 0.45\%. We trace several channels, including contractions in firm output and employment, fewer bank branches, less agricultural credit, and a thinner market infrastructure. Using the timing of household surveys relative to riots, we also find that trust in state institutions declines. Together, the results quantify the economic costs of communal riots and identify the mechanisms through which social conflict depresses local economic activity.
url:185a9a16cb787648.abstract_zh: 本文利用1994-2013年印度地区-年份面板数据，结合扩展的骚乱数据、夜间灯光、制造业产出、基础设施及地区信贷数据，估算了社区骚乱的经济影响。为处理内生性问题，我们利用印度教主要节日恰逢周五（周五大量穆斯林聚集进行每周祈祷）时产生的准随机变异，构建了本地骚乱风险的空间加权工具变量。工具变量估计表明，骚乱暴露程度越高，经济损失越大且具有持续性。距离加权暴露度每增加一个单位，夜间灯光指数下降约0.105个对数点，相当于GDP下降约0.45%。我们追溯了若干传导渠道，包括企业产出和就业收缩、银行网点减少、农业信贷下降以及市场基础设施薄弱。利用家庭调查相对于骚乱发生的时间节点，我们还发现对国家机构的信任度下降。综合来看，这些结果量化了社区骚乱的经济成本，并揭示了社会冲突抑制地方经济活动的机制。
url:185a9a16cb787648.title: DP21638 The Economic Costs of Religious Riots in India

url:1875eeba43b046d9.abstract: Analyzing more than 300,000 articles across 40 top-tier journals between 2000 and 2022, this study demonstrates that China’s 2006 National Medium-and Long-Term Plan for the Development of Science and Technology catalyzed a surge in publication volume and citations, propelling China past the United States as the world’s leading producer of scientific research. Controlling for national income, population, and human capital, we find these gains are concentrated in fields explicitly targeted by the government’s plan—physics, chemistry, biology, and medicine—while fields excluded from the plan, such as mathematics and economics, show significantly less growth. Our findings suggest that targeted state-led investment can effectively drive scientific progress, at least within a centrally planned economy. JEL Classification: F63, H52, I28, O38, P27
url:1875eeba43b046d9.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了2000年至2022年间40种顶级期刊上的超过30万篇文章，表明中国2006年《国家中长期科学和技术发展规划纲要》催化了论文发表量和引用量的激增，推动中国超越美国成为全球领先的科学研究产出国家。在控制国民收入、人口和人力资本因素后，我们发现这些增长集中在政府计划明确针对的领域——物理学、化学、生物学和医学——而计划未涵盖的领域，如数学和经济学，增长则显著较少。我们的研究结果表明，至少在中央计划经济体制内，有针对性的国家主导投资能够有效推动科学进步。JEL分类号：F63, H52, I28, O38, P27
url:1875eeba43b046d9.title: The rise of China in academic research

url:18a92c8fda65f363.title: Noncooperative oligopoly in markets with a continuum of traders and a strongly connected set of commodities: A limit theorem
url:18a92c8fda65f363.title_zh: 具有连续交易者和强连通商品集的非合作寡头市场：一个极限定理

url:18c21464040f4022.abstract: This article examines how accelerating automation and the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in advanced economies reshape labor markets across the Global South through interconnected channels of production, migration, and remittances. Drawing on the theories and practices of economic geography, labor economics, and development studies, the analysis conceptualizes automation as a transnational shock that contracts demand for migrant labor while simultaneously amplifying employment precarity in labor-surplus economies. The article advances a geographically grounded framework linking technology adoption in core industries with labor displacement, youth unemployment, and urban labor saturation in South Asia and North Africa. It further highlights the macroeconomic vulnerabilities in developing countries arising from remittance dependence and the role of digital media in shaping youth mobilization and political unrest in their native countries. By integrating comparative regional field evidence with a technology–labor–space framework, the study contributes to economic geography by demonstrating how digital transformation reconfigures development patterns across regions and countries. The findings underscore the limits of technology-led growth strategies in labor-abundant contexts and call for employment-centered digital policies that are spatially differentiated and institutionally grounded. Keywords: automation, artificial intelligence, labor markets, remittances, youth unemployment, economic geography, Global South.
url:18c21464040f4022.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了发达经济体加速自动化和人工智能应用如何通过生产、移民和汇款等相互关联的渠道重塑全球南方的劳动力市场。基于经济地理学、劳动经济学和发展研究的理论与实践，本文将自动化概念化为一种跨国冲击，它既压缩了对移民劳动力的需求，同时加剧了劳动力过剩经济体的就业不稳定性。文章提出了一个基于地理视角的分析框架，将核心产业的技术采纳与南亚和北非地区的劳动力转移、青年失业及城市劳动力饱和联系起来。文章进一步强调了发展中国家因依赖汇款而产生的宏观经济脆弱性，以及数字媒体在塑造本国青年动员和政治动荡中的作用。通过将区域比较实地证据与技术—劳动力—空间框架相结合，本研究展示了数字化转型如何重构跨区域和国家的发展模式，从而为经济地理学做出贡献。研究结果揭示了在劳动力充裕背景下以技术为主导的增长战略的局限性，并呼吁制定以就业为中心、具有空间差异性和制度基础的数字政策。关键词：自动化，人工智能，劳动力市场，汇款，青年失业，经济地理学，全球南方。

url:18c6d59c1e671988.abstract: This paper studies how online dating platforms have impacted marital outcomes, assortative matching, and sexually transmitted disease (STD) rates in the United States. We construct county-level measures of online dating usage using data from website-based platforms (2002–2013) and mobile app-based platforms (2017–2023). Leveraging county-level variation and an instrumental variable strategy, we show in the desktop era, a 1% increase in online dating sessions raises divorce rates by 0.50%, while in the mobile era, a 1% increase in online dating activity lowers marriage and divorce rates by 0.40% and 0.33%, respectively. We also document shifts in assortative matching. Desktop sites reduce sorting along education and employment dimensions, whereas mobile sites reduce sorting by employment, but increase sorting by race. Across both eras, we find no evidence that greater online dating usage increases average STD rates. Average effects are negative or statistically insignificant, but are positive for some subpopulations. We develop a search and matching model where technological changes impact search costs, market size, and market noise can explain our empirical findings.
url:18c6d59c1e671988.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在线约会平台如何影响美国的婚姻结果、分类匹配以及性传播疾病（STD）发病率。我们利用基于网站的平台（2002-2013年）和基于移动应用的平台（2017-2023年）的数据，构建了县级层面的在线约会使用率指标。借助县级层面的差异和工具变量策略，我们发现在桌面互联网时代，在线约会次数每增加1%，离婚率上升0.50%；而在移动互联网时代，在线约会活动每增加1%，结婚率和离婚率分别下降0.40%和0.33%。我们还记录了分类匹配的变化：桌面网站降低了基于教育和就业维度的分类匹配，而移动网站则降低了基于就业的分类匹配，但增加了基于种族的分类匹配。在两个时代中，我们均未发现在线约会使用率提高会显著增加平均STD发病率的证据。平均效应为负或统计上不显著，但对某些子群体而言呈正效应。我们构建了一个搜索与匹配模型，其中技术变革影响搜索成本、市场规模和市场噪音，该模型能够解释我们的实证发现。

url:1913a84bba28397a.abstract: This paper explores the effects of labor and product market reforms in a New Keynesian, small open economy model with labor market frictions and endogenous producer entry. We show that it takes time for reforms to pay off, typically at least a couple of years. This is partly because the benefits materialize through firm entry and increased hiring, both of which are gradual processes, while any reform-driven layoffs are immediate. Some reforms---such as reductions in employment protection---increase unemployment temporarily. Implementing a broad package of labor and product market reforms minimizes transition costs. Importantly, reforms do not have noticeable deflationary effects, suggesting that the inability of monetary policy to deliver large interest rate cuts in their aftermath---either because of the zero bound on policy rates or because of membership in a monetary union---may not be a relevant obstacle to reform. Alternative simple monetary policy rules do not have a large effect on transition costs.
url:1913a84bba28397a.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在新凯恩斯小型开放经济模型中，劳动力与产品市场改革的影响，该模型包含劳动力市场摩擦与内生性企业进入。我们表明，改革产生成效需要时间，通常至少数年。部分原因在于，改革收益通过企业进入和招聘增加得以实现，而这两者均为渐进过程，而改革引发的裁员则是即时的。某些改革——如降低就业保护——会暂时性推高失业率。实施涵盖劳动力与产品市场的广泛改革方案，能最小化转型成本。重要的是，改革并未产生显著的通缩效应，这表明货币政策在改革后无法大幅降息——无论是因政策利率触及零下限，还是因成员国身份限制——可能并非改革面临的实质性障碍。替代性的简单货币政策规则对转型成本的影响不大。
url:1913a84bba28397a.title: Short-Term Pain for Long-Term Gain: Market Deregulation and Monetary Policy in Small Open Economies
url:1913a84bba28397a.title_zh: 短期阵痛与长期收益：小开放经济体中的市场放松管制与货币政策

url:19142e1092ff4356.abstract: Central bank independence is a major area of study, but the economic literature has been characterized by numerous misstatements regarding how U.S. monetary policy independence has operated over time. Against this backdrop, this paper lays out major elements of the practice of central bank independence in the United States in the period from 1951 to 2006—a time span that encompasses the William McChesney Martin, Jr., through Alan Greenspan tenures as the head of the Federal Reserve. Many documentary materials and policymaker quotations not considered in previous research on U.S. monetary policy are highlighted. The analysis covers both institutional aspects (statutory objectives, formalities of Federal Reserve structure, and conventions followed in regularizing the central bank’s interactions with the legislative and executive branches) and the conceptual basis for independence, as expressed by leading Federal Reserve officials, particularly Chairs. It is shown—with heavy reliance on their own words—how Federal Reserve Chairs have characterized the position of the central bank within the governmental structure of the United States and how they have set out the case for monetary policy independence. What emerges is that successive Chairs over the decades made essentially the same, three-part, economic case for independence. This case does not rely on the arguments associated with economic research on time inconsistency.
url:19142e1092ff4356.abstract_zh: 中央银行独立性是一个重要的研究领域，但关于美国货币政策独立性如何随时间运作的经济学文献中，存在诸多不准确表述。在此背景下，本文梳理了1951年至2006年间美国中央银行独立性的实践要素——这一时期涵盖小威廉·麦克切斯尼·马丁至艾伦·格林斯潘担任美联储主席的任期。本文重点引用了此前美国货币政策研究中未涉及的诸多文献资料与政策制定者言论。分析涵盖制度层面（法定目标、美联储组织架构形式、规范央行与立法及行政部门互动的惯例）以及美联储主要官员（尤其是主席）所阐述的独立性概念基础。通过大量引用其原话，本文展示了美联储主席如何界定央行在美国政府架构中的地位，以及如何论证货币政策独立性的必要性。研究表明，数十年来历任主席实质上提出了相同的、由三部分构成的经济独立性论证。这一论证并不依赖于与时间不一致性相关的经济学研究论点。
url:19142e1092ff4356.title: The Practice of U.S. Monetary Policy Independence from Martin to Greenspan

url:197cf4ebe7ab5ec4.abstract: We investigate the systemic risk contribution of 3,500 Money Market Funds (MMFs) in normal periods and during asset price bubbles in the US from January 2004 to December 2022. Using state-of-the-art statistical techniques for bubble detection and granular fund-level data, we show that MMF characteristics significantly influence systemic risk. Large MMFs and government MMFs, which invest exclusively in US Treasury securities, are associated with reduced systemic risk, while prime MMFs contribute to higher systemic risk. MMFs denominated in US dollars but domiciled offshore exhibit no significant differences from their US-domiciled counterparts.
url:197cf4ebe7ab5ec4.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2004年1月至2022年12月期间，美国3,500只货币市场基金在正常时期及资产价格泡沫期间的系统性风险贡献。运用前沿的泡沫检测统计技术与精细的基金层面数据，我们发现货币市场基金特征对系统性风险具有显著影响。大型货币市场基金及仅投资于美国国债的政府货币市场基金与系统性风险降低相关，而优质货币市场基金则加剧了系统性风险。以美元计价但注册于离岸的货币市场基金，其系统性风险表现与在美注册基金无显著差异。

url:19ac3705e6961d7a.abstract: Occupational licensing has attracted growing attention in advanced economies, yet little has been known about its prevalence outside the US. This column presents new evidence from 44 countries using nationally representative surveys. It shows that licensing is widespread around the world and, surprisingly, is often more common in developing economies than in richer nations. Higher occupational licensing is associated with lower per capita incomes and higher informal employment rates. These patterns suggest occupational licensing deserves greater attention as part of the broader debate over labour market regulation, informality, and economic development.
url:19ac3705e6961d7a.abstract_zh: 职业许可在发达经济体中日益受到关注，但对其在美国以外地区的普及程度却知之甚少。本文利用44个国家的全国代表性调查数据提供了新证据。研究表明，职业许可在全球范围内广泛存在，且令人意外的是，其在发展中国家的普及程度往往高于富裕国家。较高的职业许可率与较低的人均收入和较高的非正规就业率相关。这些模式表明，在关于劳动力市场监管、非正规经济与经济发展的更广泛讨论中，职业许可问题应得到更多关注。
url:19ac3705e6961d7a.title: Occupational licensing across countries: New evidence from 44 nations
url:19ac3705e6961d7a.title_zh: 跨国职业许可：来自44个国家的新证据

url:19b0f7df83eb28e3.abstract: National public health awareness campaigns that emphasize peer-to-peer support are increasingly adopted, but evidence on the effects of peer-based programs at scale remains limited. Using quasi-experimental methods, we examine whether the prominent nationwide “R U OK? Day” campaign affects short-term mental health outcomes in Australia. Leveraging survey and administrative data, we find R U OK? Day leads to a 4% of a standard deviation increase in self-reported mental wellbeing, with the effect particularly pronounced among middle-aged males who experience a 9% of a standard deviation increase. We find no detectable effects on mental health care utilization, and we detect no statistically significant changes in suicide-related deaths in the short run, though the mortality outcomes are rare and power is limited. Our results underscore that peer-based campaigns can improve mental wellbeing, especially for high-risk groups, and point to a distinction between short-run psychological responses and outcomes that require behavioural follow-through.
url:19b0f7df83eb28e3.abstract_zh: 强调同伴支持的国家公共卫生意识宣传活动日益普及，但关于大规模同伴项目效果的证据仍然有限。我们采用准实验方法，考察了澳大利亚全国性知名活动“你还好吗？日”对短期心理健康结果的影响。利用调查和行政数据，我们发现“你还好吗？日”使自我报告的心理健康水平提高了标准差的4%，其中中年男性的效果尤为显著，达到了标准差的9%。我们未发现该活动对心理健康服务利用产生可检测的影响，也未在短期内检测到自杀相关死亡率的统计显著变化，尽管死亡率结果较为罕见且统计效力有限。我们的研究结果强调，同伴宣传活动能够改善心理健康，尤其是针对高风险群体，并指出了短期心理反应与需要行为跟进的结果之间的区别。
url:19b0f7df83eb28e3.title: Are You Okay? Effects of a National Peer-Support Campaign on Mental Health
url:19b0f7df83eb28e3.title_zh: 你还好吗？全国同伴支持运动对心理健康的影响

url:19c4f70806540c36.abstract: Previous studies have shown that banks avoid passing negative monetary policy rates through to depositors, implying losses in deposit taking that erode equity and eventually have a negative impact on the lending of capital constrained banks. This paper shows that unconstrained banks respond differently, increasing loan supply even more with a deposit zero lower bound (D-ZLB) than without it. As a result, rate cuts below zero can be more stimulative than in positive territory, provided enough banks are unconstrained. A calibrated dynamic model finds this effect substantial, increasing aggregate loan supply by about 9% despite equity erosion pressures.
url:19c4f70806540c36.abstract_zh: 以往研究表明，银行会避免将负利率货币政策传导至储户，这导致存款业务亏损侵蚀银行资本，并最终对资本受限银行的贷款产生负面影响。本文发现，未受资本约束的银行对此表现出不同反应：在存款零下限（D-ZLB）约束下，其贷款供给增幅甚至超过无此约束时的水平。因此，当存在足够多的未受约束银行时，负利率政策下的降息可能比正利率区间更具刺激效应。通过校准动态模型测算，尽管存在资本侵蚀压力，该效应仍使总贷款供给增加约9%。
url:19c4f70806540c36.title: Transmission of Negative Interest Rates: Reversal or Amplification?
url:19c4f70806540c36.title_zh: 负利率的传导：逆转还是放大？

url:19e249a9e66d5863.abstract: Using a sample of Australians who display high rates of early school-leaving, we compare the trajectories of respondents who left school at each incremental age between 14 and 17 with respondents who left at 18 years old or more, in terms of homelessness, incarceration, substance use and mental health issues. Leveraging recent methodological advances, we estimate a staggered difference-in-difference to: eliminate biases arising from reverse causality or unobserved time-invariant unobserved heterogeneity and account for heterogenous treatment effects across cohorts and time. Results indicate that leaving school before age 18 increases males’ likelihood of experiencing homeless, being incarcerated, using cannabis daily and illegal street drugs weekly several years after school-leaving. In contrast, for females the difference-in-difference strategy eliminates the correlations between school-leaving age and their outcomes, providing some support for a causal interpretation of our findings. To minimise concerns that gender specific time-varying unobserved heterogeneity may be driving our results, we also show that while the occurrence and timing of parental separation and other adverse behaviours coincide with early school-leaving, our results are robust to accounting for these. Taken together, our findings suggest that preventing early school-leaving can help disadvantaged youth break cycles of multi-dimensional disadvantage.
url:19e249a9e66d5863.abstract_zh: 利用一组早期辍学率较高的澳大利亚样本，我们比较了在14至17岁之间各年龄辍学的受访者与18岁及以上辍学的受访者在无家可归、监禁、物质使用和心理健康问题方面的轨迹。借助近期方法论上的进展，我们采用交错双重差分法，以消除由反向因果或未观测到的时不变异质性引起的偏差，并考虑不同队列和时间上的处理效应异质性。结果显示，18岁前辍学增加了男性在辍学数年后经历无家可归、被监禁、每日使用大麻及每周使用非法街头药物的可能性。相比之下，对于女性，双重差分策略消除了辍学年龄与其结果之间的相关性，这在一定程度上支持了我们发现的因果解释。为尽量减少性别特定的时变异质性可能驱动结果的担忧，我们还表明，尽管父母分居及其他不良行为的发生和时机与早期辍学相吻合，但我们的结果在考虑这些因素后依然稳健。综合来看，我们的发现表明，防止早期辍学有助于弱势青年打破多维劣势的循环。
url:19e249a9e66d5863.title: Lifting up the Lives of Extremely Disadvantaged Youth: The Role of Staying in School Longer
url:19e249a9e66d5863.title_zh: 提升极度弱势青年的生活境遇：延长在校时间的作用

url:19e5dbe5b66798fe.abstract: This study examines how fluctuations in firm-level uncertainty arise over the business cycle and how they influence aggregate economic activity. To do so, it develops a general equilibrium incomplete-markets model in which heterogeneous, risk-averse firms face idiosyncratic demand uncertainty and aggregate shocks to consumer credit conditions. A change in aggregate credit affects not only the expected level of firm demand, but also the cross-sectional dispersion of sales per worker by shifting the probability that firms operate at capacity. Thus, first-moment shocks give rise to endogenous second-moment effects. The model is disciplined using U.S. Compustat data on firm sales and employment and proprietary customer traffic data. The calibrated economy reproduces key cross-sectional moments and business-cycle comovements, including countercyclical dispersion in firm outcomes. Quantitatively, endogenous uncertainty accounts for roughly one quarter of the output response and one third of the employment response to aggregate credit shocks. The results suggest that uncertainty is not only an independent source of aggregate fluctuations, but also an endogenous propagation mechanism through which changes in demand conditions amplify business cycles.
url:19e5dbe5b66798fe.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨企业层面不确定性如何随经济周期波动，以及这种波动如何影响总体经济活动。为此，构建了一个一般均衡不完全市场模型，其中异质性风险厌恶企业面临异质性需求不确定性和消费者信贷条件的总体冲击。总体信贷变化不仅影响企业需求的预期水平，还通过改变企业产能利用率概率，导致人均销售额的横截面离散度发生变化。因此，一阶矩冲击会引发内生性二阶矩效应。该模型采用美国Compustat数据库的企业销售与就业数据以及专有客流量数据进行校准。校准后的经济模型再现了关键横截面矩特征与经济周期联动性，包括企业绩效的反周期离散度。定量分析表明，内生不确定性解释了总体信贷冲击对产出响应的约四分之一，以及对就业响应的约三分之一。研究结果表明，不确定性不仅是总体经济波动的独立来源，更是需求条件变化放大经济周期的内生传导机制。
url:19e5dbe5b66798fe.title: Demand Shocks and Endogenous Uncertainty
url:19e5dbe5b66798fe.title_zh: 需求冲击与内生不确定性

url:19fae3a6d1ad3640.title: Information design with endogenous state verification
url:19fae3a6d1ad3640.title_zh: 内生状态验证下的信息设计

url:19fb7ffdb808b25d.abstract: Timely assessment of economic activity is crucial for effective policymaking at the national, regional, and global levels. However, many economies still do not publish GDP data at a quarterly basis, creating persistent information gaps. In 2025, 34% of economies publish only annual GDP statistics. This lack of higher-frequency and timely data is particularly restrictive for emerging market and developing economies, where economic volatility and spillover risks are often highest. The problem is more severe for historical data: only 42% of economies have quarterly GDP estimates for a period longer than 20 years. To address these gaps, this paper develops a model that estimates missing quarterly GDP series by leveraging global and regional economic interconnections. The method transforms sparse annual data into quarterly estimates by exploiting higher-frequency information from the rest of the world, enabling real-time policymaking in both data-scarce economies and in global-level discussions. Moreover, this method ensures internally consistent estimates of regional and global economic activity, allowing both top-down and bottom-up scenario analyses.
url:19fb7ffdb808b25d.abstract_zh: 及时评估经济活动对于国家、区域及全球层面的有效政策制定至关重要。然而，许多经济体仍未按季度发布GDP数据，导致持续存在信息缺口。2025年，34%的经济体仅发布年度GDP统计数据。这种高频及时数据的缺失对新兴市场和发展中经济体尤为不利，这些地区的经济波动和溢出风险往往最高。历史数据问题更为严峻：仅有42%的经济体拥有超过20年的季度GDP估算数据。为弥补这些缺口，本文构建了一个模型，通过利用全球和区域经济相互关联性来估算缺失的季度GDP序列。该方法借助世界其他地区的高频信息，将稀疏的年度数据转化为季度估算值，从而支持数据稀缺经济体及全球层面的实时政策制定。此外，该方法能确保区域和全球经济活动估算的内部一致性，支持自上而下与自下而上的情景分析。
url:19fb7ffdb808b25d.title: Nowcasting Low-Income Countries Through Global Linkages
url:19fb7ffdb808b25d.title_zh: 通过全球联系对低收入国家进行即时预测

url:1a03b0c5e6e44305.abstract: This paper provides a theory of foreign equity investment restrictions. We consider a model where the demand function for domestic shares differs between domestic and foreign investors because of dead-weight costs in holding domestic and foreign securities that depend on the country of residence of investors. We show that domestic entrepreneurs maximize firm value by discriminating between domestic and foreign investors. The model implies that countries benefiting from capital flight have binding ownership restrictions such that foreign investors pay a higher price for shares than domestic investors. The empirical implications of this theory are supported by evidence from Switzerland.

url:1a86208b93671e28.abstract: Does a more persistent demand shock always generate a larger output response? Conventional wisdom says yes: forward-looking agents front-load spending in anticipation of higher lifetime resources, and the more lasting the shock, the stronger the expansion. This paper shows that this logic fails in New Keynesian models with an active monetary policy. The interplay between persistence and monetary policy stance governs a fundamental trade-off between two opposing forces: a permanent income channel that amplifies output, and a real interest rate channel that dampens it. Their balance generates three monetary policy regimes. In the empirically relevant intermediate regime, the output multiplier is hump-shaped in persistence.
url:1a86208b93671e28.abstract_zh: 更持久的需求冲击是否总会带来更大的产出响应？传统观点认为如此：前瞻性主体会因预期到终身资源增加而提前支出，且冲击持续时间越长，扩张效应越强。本文证明，在实施积极货币政策的凯恩斯模型中，这一逻辑并不成立。冲击持久性与货币政策立场之间的相互作用，主导着两种对立力量之间的根本权衡：放大产出的永久收入渠道与抑制产出的实际利率渠道。两者的平衡产生了三种货币政策体制。在具有经验相关性的中间体制中，产出乘数随持久性呈现驼峰形变化。
url:1a86208b93671e28.title: The Power of Persistence: How Demand Shocks and Monetary Policy Shape Macroeconomic Outcomes

url:1a86f177418e595c.abstract: Bond yields react to macroeconomic surprises, but the magnitude of this responsiveness depends on macroeconomic forecast disagreement and monetary policy uncertainty. Using intraday responses of US Treasury futures to surprises in macroeconomic data releases, we find that greater forecast disagreement about an economic indicator prior to its release dampens the yield curve response, while higher monetary policy uncertainty amplifies it. An exception is inflation surprises: prior to the post-COVID inflation surge, bond yield reactions to inflation surprises were not amplified by monetary policy uncertainty.
url:1a86f177418e595c.abstract_zh: 债券收益率会对宏观经济意外做出反应，但这种反应的程度取决于宏观经济预测分歧和货币政策不确定性。通过利用美国国债期货对宏观经济数据发布意外的日内反应，我们发现，在某一经济指标发布前，对该指标的预测分歧越大，会抑制收益率曲线的反应，而货币政策不确定性越高则会放大这种反应。一个例外是通胀意外：在新冠疫情后的通胀飙升之前，债券收益率对通胀意外的反应并未因货币政策不确定性而放大。

url:1aad2201cc074b42.abstract: Firm-level geoeconomic risk can affect even broadly diversified mutual fund portfolios. We study U.S. export controls that restrict sales of cutting-edge technology to selected Chinese firms for national security reasons. The stock prices of affected domestic suppliers drop immediately after the policy introduction. Mutual funds holding these stocks experience increased volatility and lower returns. Fund managers respond by selling stocks of exporters to China, buying lottery-like stocks, and increasing portfolio concentration. While stock-picking and market-timing skills do not help, specialist and high-fee funds are better at navigating geoeconomic risk.
url:1aad2201cc074b42.abstract_zh: 企业层面的地缘经济风险甚至可能影响广泛分散化的共同基金投资组合。本文研究美国出于国家安全原因限制向特定中国企业销售尖端技术的出口管制政策。受政策影响的国内供应商股价在政策出台后立即下跌。持有这些股票的共同基金面临波动性上升和回报率下降。基金经理通过抛售对华出口企业股票、购买彩票型股票以及提高投资组合集中度来应对。虽然选股能力和择时能力无助于应对风险，但专业型基金和高费率基金在规避地缘经济风险方面表现更优。

url:1aae6fe4c9867eac.abstract: We develop a theoretical model that explains these findings, and estimate it to quantify the importance of salient unfair prices. We find that a 20 percentage-point salient difference between local and international prices is equivalent to a 1% increase in the price of the local product itself. Next, we use the model and its estimated parameters to calculate the impact of the regulation on consumer utility. We find that utility declined for some products included in the regulation. This happens when the disutility from observing that other consumers pay less exceeds the added utility from reduced prices and increased consumption. We discuss potential implications of our findings for optimal pricing strategies, price rigidity, and theoretical models of salient thinking.
url:1aae6fe4c9867eac.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个理论模型来解释这些发现，并对其进行估计以量化显著不公平价格的重要性。我们发现，本地价格与国际价格之间20个百分点的显著差异，相当于本地产品本身价格上涨1%。接着，我们利用该模型及其估计参数来计算监管对消费者效用的影响。结果显示，监管涵盖的部分产品效用有所下降。这种情况发生在观察到其他消费者支付更低价格所带来的负效用，超过了因价格降低和消费增加而获得的额外效用时。我们讨论了我们的发现对最优定价策略、价格刚性以及显著性思维理论模型的潜在启示。

url:1b1c2358677fa6fa.abstract: Using newly-linked administrative and commercial data from Virginia spanning 25 years, we study the consequences of incarceration. While previous research has examined labor market outcomes and recidivism, we focus on two of the primary channels through which low-income households build wealth: asset ownership (homes and cars) and human capital formation. To identify causal effects, we use a matched difference-in-differences design. In line with much of the literature on the impact of incarceration in the U.S., we find no evidence of scarring effects on labor market outcomes or changes in recidivism beyond the incapacitation period. However, we find that incarceration leads to a persistent reduction in asset accumulation: seven years after sentencing, homeownership has declined by 1.1 percentage points (12.1%) and car ownership by 2.7 percentage points (18.1%). Incarceration also lowers human capital formation, reducing college enrollment by 1.4 percentage points (15.1%).
url:1b1c2358677fa6fa.abstract_zh: 利用弗吉尼亚州跨越25年的新链接行政与商业数据，我们研究了监禁的后果。尽管先前的研究已考察了劳动力市场结果和再犯情况，我们则聚焦于低收入家庭积累财富的两大主要途径：资产所有权（住房和汽车）及人力资本形成。为识别因果效应，我们采用了匹配的双重差分设计。与美国关于监禁影响的大量文献一致，我们发现监禁对劳动力市场结果无疤痕效应，且在监禁期后未改变再犯率。然而，我们发现监禁导致资产积累持续减少：判决后七年，住房拥有率下降1.1个百分点（12.1%），汽车拥有率下降2.7个百分点（18.1%）。监禁还降低了人力资本形成，使大学入学率下降1.4个百分点（15.1%）。

url:1b2a41affcc018b0.abstract: Tax avoidance through personal holding companies has long been viewed as a key challenge for progressive income taxation. We exploit twenty years of administrative micro-data linking firms to owners in Sweden and Norway to analyze how the use of personal holding companies varies across the income distribution and to quantify its implications in a quasi-experimental setting. About half of the income of the top 0.1% is retained in personal holding companies defined, as in US tax law, as firms for which five or fewer owners own more than 50% of the stock and that derive more than 60% of income from investment income. Event studies of shocks to operational firms' value-added show that holding companies shield around half of dividend distributions from individual income taxation. Profits tend to remain in holding companies for long periods of time, with cumulative payout rates of 15%-20% over two decades for the highest income groups. Wealth taxes do not provide an effective backstop due to the low valuation (or exemption) of shares in private businesses. As a result, effective tax rates, all taxes included, fall from about 50% for the upper middle class to about 15%-20% among the highest-net-worth individuals.
url:1b2a41affcc018b0.abstract_zh: 通过个人控股公司进行避税长期以来一直被视为累进所得税制面临的关键挑战。我们利用瑞典和挪威二十年间将企业与所有者关联的行政微观数据，分析个人控股公司的使用如何随收入分配变化，并在准实验环境中量化其影响。根据美国税法定义，个人控股公司指由五名或更少所有者持有超过50%股份，且超过60%收入来源于投资收入的企业。在最高收入0.1%群体中，约一半收入留存于此类控股公司。对经营性企业增加值冲击的事件研究表明，控股公司能规避约一半股息分配的个人所得税。利润往往长期留存于控股公司，最高收入群体在二十年间的累计派息率仅为15%-20%。由于私人企业股份估值偏低（或免税），财富税无法有效弥补这一漏洞。因此，包括所有税收在内的有效税率，从中上阶层的约50%降至最高净值个人的约15%-20%。

url:1b2c20a77339b56a.abstract: A student's future log-wage is given by the sum of a skill premium and a random personal ?ability? term. Students observe only a private, noisy signal of their ability, and universities can condition admission decisions on the results of noisy tests. We assume first that universities are maximizing social surplus, and contrast the results with those obtained when they maximize rents. If capital markets are perfect, and if test results are public knowledge, then, there is no sorting on the basis of test scores. Students optimally self-select as a result of pricing only. In the absence of externalities generated by an individual's higher education, the optimal tuition is then greater than the university's marginal cost. If capital markets are perfect but asymmetries of information are bilateral, i.e., if universities observe a private signal of each student's ability, or if there are borrowing constraints, then, the optimal policy involves a mix of pricing and pre-entry selection based on the university's private information. Optimal tuition can then be set below marginal cost, and can even become negative, if the precision of the university's private assessment of students' abilities is high enough.
url:1b2c20a77339b56a.abstract_zh: 学生的未来对数工资由技能溢价和随机个人“能力”项之和决定。学生仅能观察到自身能力的私人噪声信号，而大学可依据噪声测试结果决定录取条件。我们首先假设大学以最大化社会剩余为目标，并将其与追求租金最大化时的结果进行对比。若资本市场完善且测试结果为公共知识，则不存在基于测试分数的筛选。学生仅通过定价机制实现最优自我选择。在个人高等教育不产生外部性的前提下，最优学费将高于大学的边际成本。若资本市场完善但信息不对称具有双向性——即大学能观察到每位学生能力的私人信号，或存在借贷约束——则最优政策需结合定价与基于大学私人信息的入学前筛选。当大学对学生能力的私人评估精度足够高时，最优学费可低于边际成本，甚至可能为负值。

url:1b38ded7c5f156f0.abstract: Increased vertical integration and coordination are defining features of transforming and modernizing agricultural value chains in low- and middle-income countries, with important implications for market efficiency and farm-level transformation. However, research documenting these processes in modernizing domestic value chains is limited, and tends to focus on foreign direct investment and high-value food products. We study the rice value chain – the most important staple in Southeast Asia – in Myanmar and use unique data from domestic rice mills and farmers to analyze millers’ expansion into other businesses and services. We show that both modern and traditional mills serve as key nodes in local rice value chains, fulfilling diverse roles beyond processing at both the farm and post-farm levels and highlighting a co-development of modern processing and vertical integration. Yet, statistical tests that control for mill and farmer characteristics, respectively, show that modern mills are more engaged in vertical integration and coordination, particularly in post-farm value chain segments, highlighting the co-development of modern processing and business expansion. Consistent with this pattern in the miller data, farmers using a modern mill are more likely to receive complementary services – especially post-farm – and to adopt modern production practices more broadly. However, this expansion is uneven, reaching large farms more frequently than small and medium farms.
url:1b38ded7c5f156f0.abstract_zh: 在中低收入国家，农业价值链的转型与现代化进程中，纵向整合与协调的增强是显著特征，这对市场效率和农场层面转型具有重要影响。然而，关于国内价值链现代化进程中这些过程的文献研究有限，且往往聚焦于外国直接投资和高价值食品。我们以缅甸稻米价值链——东南亚最重要的主食——为研究对象，利用国内稻米加工厂和农户的独特数据，分析加工厂向其他业务和服务的扩张。研究表明，现代和传统加工厂均作为当地稻米价值链的关键节点，在农场和农场后层面发挥超越加工环节的多元作用，凸显了现代加工与纵向整合的协同发展。然而，分别控制加工厂和农户特征的统计检验显示，现代加工厂在纵向整合与协调方面参与度更高，尤其在农场后价值链环节，这进一步印证了现代加工与业务扩张的协同发展。与加工厂数据中的这一模式一致，使用现代加工厂的农户更有可能获得补充性服务（尤其是农场后服务），并更广泛地采用现代生产实践。然而，这种扩张并不均衡，大型农场比中小型农场更频繁地受益。

url:1b51518c83643ccb.abstract: We develop an incomplete-contracting model in which the government engages a private contractor to provide a public good. Over time, adaptations of the good to changing circumstances may become desirable. The contractor privately learns the costs of implementing these adaptations. We compare two organizational forms. In a public-private partnership, the government actively participates in project management and, by incurring information-gathering costs, may ascertain the contractor's adaptation costs. Under traditional procurement, the government lacks direct involvement in project management, preventing it from ascertaining the adaptation costs. We show that the government's potentially enhanced access to the contractor's information in a public-private partnership can either support or undermine the case for such partnerships.

url:1b9f3c052a1b07ca.abstract: There are several real world examples of local governments that, faced with budget problems, circulate a fiat token in parallel to the official currency. url:1bad7b23d2cae030.abstract: This paper addresses two main questions. First, what proportion of people are exposed to climate hazards in Latin America and the Caribbean, especially among the poor versus the nonpoor? Second, do certain areas—hotspots—have high rates of bothhazard exposure and poverty that require targeted policy? Using poverty maps and georeferenced climate hazard data, three innovations are introduced: five climate hazards are analyzed (droughts, hurricanes, heatwaves, floods, and landslides); official poverty data at administrative level 2 are used, instead of only administrative level 1; and an interpolation method estimates poverty-plus-exposure rates across countries with varying data sources. The estimates indicate that 36.9 percent of the population is exposed to at least one of the five climate hazards under consideration. Considering the population in poverty only, the percentage is higher, 44.6 percent, whereas the exposure rate for the nonpoor is 34.0 percent. Some areas experience high exposure to climate hazards and high poverty rates. These hotspots include about 10 percent of the region’s population. These areas are in the Brazilian northeast; the upper-Amazon region of Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Brazil; the Chaco region of Argentina, Brazil, and Paraguay; the islands of the Caribbean; the western coast of the Gulf of California; and the Yucatan Peninsula.
url:1bad7b23d2cae030.abstract_zh: 本文主要探讨两个问题：第一，拉丁美洲和加勒比地区有多少人口暴露于气候灾害中，尤其是贫困与非贫困群体之间的差异？第二，是否存在某些区域——即灾害暴露与贫困率均较高的“热点地区”——需要针对性政策干预？通过整合贫困地图与地理参照气候灾害数据，本文引入三项创新：分析五种气候灾害（干旱、飓风、热浪、洪水和山体滑坡）；采用二级行政区划的官方贫困数据（而非仅使用一级行政区划数据）；并运用插值法估算不同数据来源国家间的“贫困-暴露”复合率。估算结果显示，36.9%的人口至少暴露于所研究的五种气候灾害之一。若仅考虑贫困人口，该比例上升至44.6%，而非贫困人口的暴露率为34.0%。部分区域同时呈现高气候灾害暴露率与高贫困率，这些热点地区约占区域总人口的10%，主要分布于巴西东北部；哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔、秘鲁与巴西的上亚马逊地区；阿根廷、巴西与巴拉圭的大查科地区；加勒比群岛；加利福尼亚湾西海岸以及尤卡坦半岛。

url:1bb25268974b1d67.abstract: The paper develops a forward-looking comprehensive accounting framework for the public sector. By integrating the public sector budget constraint forward in time the government's present value budget constraint (PVBC) is obtained. In addition to the familiar financial assets and liabilities, comprehensive public sector net worth contains the following items: the value of the public sector capital stock; the value of public sector property rights in land and natural resources; the present value of future seigniorage, the present value of future taxes net of transfers and subsidies and the present value of future planned public sector capital formation, privatization or nationalization programmes. From the "stock" PVBC a number of different "flow" deficit concepts are derived; each one emphasizes a different aspect of the "sustainability" of current and/or prospective fiscal and financial plans. Together they provide a framework for organizing facts and plans about fiscal, financial and monetary policy and for evaluating the consistency of spending and revenue projections or scenarios, public sector debt objectives and monetary targets.
url:1bb25268974b1d67.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个面向公共部门的前瞻性综合核算框架。通过将公共部门预算约束向前延伸，推导出政府现值预算约束（PVBC）。除常见的金融资产与负债外，综合公共部门净值包含以下项目：公共部门资本存量价值；公共部门对土地及自然资源的产权价值；未来铸币税收入的现值；未来转移支付与补贴净额的税收现值；以及未来计划中的公共部门资本形成、私有化或国有化项目的现值。基于“存量”PVBC，衍生出多种不同的“流量”赤字概念，每种概念分别强调当前及/或预期财政金融计划“可持续性”的不同维度。这些概念共同构成一个分析框架，用于整理财政、金融与货币政策的事实与规划，评估支出与收入预测或情景、公共部门债务目标及货币目标之间的一致性。

url:1be3151c0817624b.abstract: Background and Aims: Blind boxes are physical gambling-like products that consumers buy to receive random prizes, often only with a small chance of obtaining a specific product they desire. These products became globally popular in 2025 and are currently not legally regulated as a form of gambling, so children can buy them. Stakeholders are concerned about potential risks, including overspending and gambling-related harm. China is the first and only country to publish dedicated blind box regulatory policy, requiring age restrictions and transparency. Children under 8 are not allowed to buy blind boxes, and minors aged between 8 and 17 must have parental consent for purchasing. The probabilities of obtaining different random prizes must be disclosed. We assessed whether these policies have been duly implemented on the physical packaging of blind boxes manufactured and sold in China. Design: We conveniently purchased a diverse range of 50 blind boxes, including both well-known brands and lesser-known products. We then analysed all information shown on the physical packaging to identify compliance-related elements. Setting: Shenzhen, China Cases: 50 physical blind boxes purchased in November 2025. Measurements: The presence of age restriction information, parental consent requirement, and probability disclosures, and the visual prominence of probability disclosures. Findings: All products (100%) stated that they are not suitable for young children under 8, but 40% failed to also highlight the parental consent requirement for older children aged between 8 and 17. Probabilities were disclosed accurately and completely by 32% of blind boxes, whilst another 48% provided rounded up but still reasonably accurate and complete disclosures, so only 20% failed to disclose sufficiently or at all. The majority (66%) of blind boxes’ disclosed probabilities reasonably visually prominently, but a minority hid relevant information on multiple sides of the packaging (12%) or within a block of descriptive text (8%), making them harder for consumers to find. Conclusions: We observed relatively high compliance with Chinese blind box regulations, in terms of age restrictions and probabilistic transparency, although further improvements are required, particularly in relation to the parental consent requirement for older children and the visual prominence of probability disclosures.
url:1be3151c0817624b.abstract_zh:
背景与目的：盲盒是一种类似赌博的实体产品，消费者购买后随机获得奖品，通常只有极小概率能抽到心仪商品。这类产品于2025年在全球流行，目前尚未被法律界定为赌博形式，因此儿童可以购买。利益相关方担忧其潜在风险，包括过度消费和赌博相关危害。中国是首个也是唯一发布专门盲盒监管政策的国家，要求实施年龄限制和信息透明。8岁以下儿童禁止购买盲盒，8至17岁未成年人购买需经家长同意，且必须公开不同随机奖品的获取概率。本研究评估了这些政策是否在中国制造和销售的盲盒实体包装上得到有效落实。  
设计：我们便利购买了50个涵盖知名品牌与冷门产品的多样化盲盒，随后分析实体包装上所有信息以识别合规相关要素。  
场景：中国深圳  
案例：2025年11月购买的50个实体盲盒。  
测量指标：年龄限制信息、家长同意要求、概率披露的呈现情况，以及概率披露的视觉显著性。  
发现：所有产品（100%）均标注“不适用于8岁以下幼童”，但40%未同时强调8至17岁儿童需家长同意的要求。32%的盲盒准确完整披露了概率，另有48%提供了四舍五入但依然合理准确的完整披露，仅20%未充分披露或完全未披露。大多数盲盒（66%）的概率披露在视觉上具有合理显著性，但少数产品将相关信息隐藏在包装多个侧面（12%）或描述性文本段落中（8%），增加了消费者查找难度。  
结论：在年龄限制和概率透明度方面，中国盲盒法规的合规率相对较高，但仍有改进空间，尤其需强化对较大儿童的家长同意要求及概率披露的视觉显著性。

url:1c01f8a293a05489.abstract: Europe is under attack from the US, and under a different kind of attack from China. That is Olivier Blanchard's diagnosis. Blanchard (MIT, Paris School of Economics, Peterson Institute) is one of four economists leading Europe 2050, a new CEPR initiative asking where Europe wants to be in 25 years, and how it gets there. Blanchard's overriding principle: a vision without plumbing goes nowhere, and plumbing without vision is just reacting to the next tweet. Who can combine the vision and the plumbing, and produce ideas that we haven't seen before? Europe might be short of solutions to its current malaise, but it is not short of people with ideas: the project sent out 50 invitations for policy papers. Blanchard expected 30 replies. He got 48.
url:1c01f8a293a05489.abstract_zh: 欧洲正遭受来自美国的攻击，以及来自中国的另一种形式的攻击。这是奥利维尔·布兰查德（Olivier Blanchard）的诊断。布兰查德（麻省理工学院、巴黎经济学院、彼得森国际经济研究所）是领导"欧洲2050"项目的四位经济学家之一。这是CEPR发起的一项新倡议，探讨欧洲25年后应处于何种位置，以及如何实现这一目标。布兰查德的首要原则是：缺乏具体规划的愿景将寸步难行，而缺乏愿景的具体规划只会沦为对下一个推文的被动回应。谁能将愿景与具体规划相结合，并产生前所未有的创意？欧洲或许缺乏解决当前困境的方案，但绝不缺乏有想法的人才：该项目发出了50份政策论文邀请函。布兰查德预计会收到30份回复，结果收到了48份。

url:1c61ceaeca5aa7dc.abstract: Many managers adopt ‘toxic’ behaviors that create hostile work environments. How to prevent these behaviors remains unknown. We implemented CBT-oriented skills training for Bangladeshi garment factory supervisors, targeting behaviors that fuel hostility and aggression. Because psychologists delivering the training provided role models for respectful communication, by demonstrating concern for trainees, we compare treatment to both an active control group that received health advice from physicians and to pure control. Both interventions improved productivity, but only health training reduced toxic behaviors. Our results emphasize the need for active control groups and suggest that showing concern for managers may reduce aggressive behaviors.
url:1c61ceaeca5aa7dc.abstract_zh: 许多管理者采取“有毒”行为，营造出充满敌意的工作环境。如何预防这些行为仍属未知。我们对孟加拉国服装厂主管实施了以认知行为疗法为导向的技能培训，针对助长敌意和攻击性的行为。由于提供培训的心理学家通过展现对学员的关怀，为尊重性沟通树立了榜样，我们将治疗组与接受医生健康建议的积极对照组及纯对照组进行比较。两种干预均提升了生产力，但只有健康培训减少了有毒行为。我们的结果强调了积极对照组的重要性，并表明对管理者展现关怀可能减少攻击性行为。
