url:2554d768a1e8fe7e.abstract: We examine how liberalizing inheritance law can affect the diffusion of wealth beyond family dynasties. Exploiting a reform that reduced mandatory estate shares for children and surviving parents, we analyze testator responses in a unique dataset of 16,887 anonymous online wills. We find that greater testamentary freedom led testators to increase transfers primarily to spouses and life partners, but also to nonrelatives and charitable organizations. Our estimated ’marginal diffusion propensity’ reveals that, for each additional percentage point of freely disposable wealth, approximately one third was reallocated towards recipients outside the core family. Extrapolating this effect suggests that liberalization could result in additional annual extra-dynastic bequests of up to 0.8% of national income in countries with restrictive inheritance rules.
url:2554d768a1e8fe7e.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了放宽继承法如何影响财富在家族王朝之外的扩散。利用一项减少子女及在世父母法定继承份额的改革，我们分析了一个包含16,887份匿名在线遗嘱的独特数据集中立遗嘱人的反应。我们发现，更大的遗嘱自由促使立遗嘱人主要增加对配偶及生活伴侣的转移，同时也向非亲属和慈善组织转移。我们估算的“边际扩散倾向”显示，每增加一个百分点的自由支配财富，大约有三分之一被重新分配至核心家庭之外的受益人。将此效应外推表明，在继承规则严格的国家，放宽继承法可能导致每年额外高达国民收入0.8%的跨王朝遗赠。

url:25b0cb48554ad7d1.abstract: Many effects of pollution exposure on health and education outcomes of children have been identified, but little is known about education effects on preschool-aged children. We estimate the effect of particulate matter air pollution on preschool attendance using restricted administrative data from the state of Georgia. We use thermal inversions, weather phenomena that trap pollutants, as an instrumental variable for pollution. A one-unit increase in the county-week average ambient particulate pollution level decreases attendance by around 2 percentage points. Effects seem to be larger for racial minorities and for children with working parents.
url:25b0cb48554ad7d1.abstract_zh: 已有研究证实污染暴露对儿童健康与教育成果的多重影响，但关于学龄前儿童教育影响的研究仍较为有限。本研究利用佐治亚州的受限行政数据，评估颗粒物空气污染对学前教育出勤率的影响。我们采用热逆温现象（一种滞留污染物的天气现象）作为污染的工具变量。数据显示，县级周均环境颗粒物污染水平每上升1个单位，学前教育出勤率将下降约2个百分点。该影响在少数族裔儿童及父母双职工家庭中更为显著。

url:25d11fef9721deb3.abstract: The dollar's role as the world's reserve currency has been blamed for an overvalued exchange rate that hollows out US manufacturing. This column quantifies what would happen if foreign investors stopped treating US safe assets as international liquidity. In a calibrated two-country model, the exchange-rate consequences are present but modest – a permanent real depreciation of roughly 9% – while the larger effects fall on US interest rates, which rise by around 90 basis points, and on national wealth, where the lost seigniorage is worth close to one year of GDP. The recent decline in convenience yields and foreign ownership of US public debt suggests the transition may already be under way.
url:25d11fef9721deb3.abstract_zh: 美元作为全球储备货币的角色，被指责导致汇率高估，进而掏空了美国制造业。本文量化分析了如果外国投资者不再将美国安全资产视为国际流动性工具，将会发生什么。在一个经过校准的两国模型中，汇率影响确实存在但较为温和——实际汇率永久性贬值约9%——而更大的影响则体现在美国利率上，利率上升约90个基点，以及国民财富方面，损失的铸币税接近一年的GDP。近期便利收益率下降以及外国持有美国公共债务减少表明，这一转变可能已经开始。

url:2609d7fb4e91af37.abstract: We examine how a platform’s governance shock reshapes the strategic value of app connectivity. We distinguish between connectivity’s functional value and commercial value. We theorize that governance interventions restricting access to directly monetizable user-level data reduce the commercial returns to connectivity while leaving functional incentives unchanged. Leveraging Apple’s App Tracking Transparency (ATT) policy—a shock that curtailed cross-app tracking—we analyze nearly 1,000 Health & Fitness apps on iOS and Android from 2018 to 2021. We find that applications with greater pre-ATT exposure to connected data along the 3Vs (Volume, Variety, Velocity) significantly reduce connectivity after the shock relative to Android counterparts, especially tracking-intensive and single-homing applications. Connectivity’s performance benefits weaken after ATT. Our findings clarify how platform governance reshapes complementors’ incentives.
url:2609d7fb4e91af37.abstract_zh: 我们考察平台治理冲击如何重塑应用连接性的战略价值。我们区分了连接性的功能价值与商业价值。我们提出理论，认为限制访问可直接变现的用户级数据的治理干预会降低连接性的商业回报，同时保持功能激励不变。借助苹果的应用追踪透明度（ATT）政策——一项限制跨应用追踪的冲击——我们分析了2018年至2021年间iOS和Android平台上近1000款健康与健身类应用。我们发现，在ATT之前对连接数据（按3V：体量、多样性、速度）暴露程度较高的应用，在冲击后相对于Android同类应用显著减少了连接性，尤其是追踪密集型及单宿主应用。连接性的绩效优势在ATT之后有所减弱。我们的研究结果阐明了平台治理如何重塑互补者的激励。

url:26105030b93d9a1d.abstract: We develop a quantitative macroeconomic framework with heterogeneous financial intermediaries and liquidity management. Banks manage idiosyncratic deposit withdrawal risk through an iterative over-the-counter interbank market with endogenous intensive and extensive margins and equilibrium positive-assortative matching based on balance sheet size. We validate our framework using administrative data from Germany encompassing the universe of bank-to-bank exposures. Our findings strongly support the presence of positive-assortative matching in the data, thereby confirming the model's key mechanism. We show that assortative matching is stable but inefficient relative to the constrained-efficient benchmark, leading to reduced trading volumes and a broader region of inaction in the interbank market, a smaller and riskier banking sector, and lower aggregate demand. Using our empirically validated framework, we study the transmission of monetary policy, secular trends in interbank trading and banking concentration, and the role of deposit market power.
url:26105030b93d9a1d.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含异质性金融中介与流动性管理的定量宏观经济框架。银行通过一个具有内生密集边际和广延边际的迭代场外银行间市场来管理特有的存款提取风险，该市场基于资产负债表规模呈现均衡的正向匹配。我们利用涵盖德国银行间全部敞口的行政数据验证了该框架。研究结果强烈支持数据中存在正向匹配现象，从而证实了模型的关键机制。我们表明，相对于约束有效的基准，匹配是稳定的但效率低下，导致银行间市场交易量减少、不行动区域扩大，银行部门规模更小且风险更高，以及总需求下降。借助这一经验验证的框架，我们研究了货币政策的传导、银行间交易与银行集中度的长期趋势，以及存款市场势力的作用。

url:2638fbb25aec69dc.abstract: In the context of the growing share of public workers in the Spanish labour force, this paper analyses opportunistic behaviour in sick leave duration and return-to-work probabilities among teachers. We use administrative microdata (2011-2019), transformed into an original monthly spell-level panel. The analysis employs a tailored regression within a difference-in-differences framework exploiting the academic calendar and comparing professional sick leaves among pre-university teachers in public and private schools. Results show that the timing of sick leave endings systematically responds to the school calendar. Public-school teachers display longer sick leave durations and lower return-to-work probabilities than private-school teachers, consistent with ex post moral hazard under more generous employment protection and sick leave coverage. Around the summer break, these differences become more pronounced: public-school teachers extend their leaves further relative to private-school teachers. Simultaneously, the usual gap in return-to-work probabilities temporarily reverses, with public-school teachers becoming more likely to end their leave immediately after summer. These patterns are especially strong among mid-career workers, women, and cases involving more subjective or difficult-to-diagnose injuries.
url:2638fbb25aec69dc.abstract_zh: 在西班牙劳动力中公共部门工作者占比日益增长的背景下，本文分析了教师群体在病假时长与返岗概率中的机会主义行为。我们利用2011-2019年行政微观数据，将其转化为原创的月度个体面板数据。分析采用基于双重差分框架的定制化回归模型，利用学年周期特征，比较公立与私立学校大学预科教师的职业病假情况。结果显示，病假结束时间系统性地响应学年安排。相较于私立学校教师，公立学校教师病假持续时间更长、返岗概率更低，这与更优厚的就业保障和病假覆盖下的事后道德风险一致。在暑假前后，这些差异更为显著：公立学校教师相对于私立学校教师进一步延长病假。与此同时，通常存在的返岗概率差距暂时逆转，公立学校教师在暑假结束后立即结束病假的可能性更高。这些模式在职业生涯中期工作者、女性群体以及涉及主观性强或难以诊断的伤病案例中尤为突出。

url:263f16ed2642503a.abstract: Modern protectionism has increasingly taken the form of decentralized trade coercion rather than multilateral escalation. What tariffs prevail in such local trade wars? How are welfare consequences shared between participants and bystanders? And can targeted economies credibly deter unilateralism? Using a multi-country, multi-sector Armington model that distinguishes the elasticity of substitution between domestic and imported goods from that across foreign varieties, we show that bilateral tariffs generate substantial third-market leakage. Applied to recent U.S. trade policy, this leakage magnifies U.S. losses and bystander gains under Trump 1.0, with bilateral Nash tariffs that are lower but more costly than those implied by standard models with a uniform trade elasticity. Trump 2.0's Liberation Day tariffs reverse these patterns by largely shutting down third-market leakage through broad-based tariff escalation. In a dynamic setting, no individual trading partner can credibly deter U.S. unilateralism: bilateral retaliation is either too weak or too costly. Only a near-universal coalition, broadly resembling the WTO membership, can flip U.S. incentives.
url:263f16ed2642503a.abstract_zh: 现代保护主义日益表现为分散化的贸易胁迫，而非多边层面的升级。在此类局部贸易战中，关税水平如何？福利后果如何在参与方与旁观者之间分配？受针对的经济体能否可信地威慑单边主义？我们采用一个区分国内与进口商品间替代弹性与外国品种间替代弹性的多国、多部门阿明顿模型，证明双边关税会产生显著的第三方市场溢出。应用于近期美国贸易政策时，这一溢出在特朗普1.0时期放大了美国损失与旁观者收益，双边纳什关税低于但代价高于采用统一贸易弹性的标准模型所隐含的水平。特朗普2.0的“解放日”关税通过广泛关税升级基本阻断第三方市场溢出，逆转了上述模式。在动态设定下，任何单个贸易伙伴都无法可信地威慑美国的单边主义：双边报复要么过弱，要么代价过高。唯有近乎普遍的联盟——大致相当于WTO成员国范围——才能扭转美国的激励。
url:263f16ed2642503a.title: DP21832 Local Trade Wars

url:265115cc7bb350c3.abstract: Climate disasters tend to be associated with increased sovereign default risk. Countries face an “impossible trilemma”: scale up adaptation investment, keep debt sustainable amidst high borrowing costs and avoid the higher risk of default from delayed adaptation. Using a global panel of disaster event-level shocks, we find that a 1pp increase in disaster related losses as a share of GDP raises the odds of sovereign default by approximately 2-3 percent. An additional US$1 billion in cumulative Official Development Assistance (ODA) is associated with a 0.13 point gain in a country’s adaptive capacity. Using average marginal effects and our predicted margins we then map concessional ODA finance to default probability and translate these relationships into a practical budgeting yardstick for calibrating needed ODA to sovereign default risk reduction targets. In a context of declining ODA, our findings highlight the crucial role of well-designed support in climate adaptation policies.
url:265115cc7bb350c3.abstract_zh: 气候灾害往往与主权违约风险上升相关。各国面临一个"不可能三角"：扩大适应投资规模、在高借贷成本下维持债务可持续性、以及避免因延迟适应而导致的更高违约风险。基于全球灾害事件冲击层面的面板数据，我们发现灾害相关损失占GDP比重每增加1个百分点，主权违约概率将上升约2-3%。累计官方发展援助每增加10亿美元，与一国适应能力提升0.13个点相关。通过运用平均边际效应与预测边际值，我们将优惠性官方发展援助资金映射至违约概率，并将这些关系转化为实用的预算标尺，用于校准实现主权违约风险降低目标所需的官方发展援助。在官方发展援助持续缩减的背景下，我们的研究凸显了精心设计的支持在气候适应政策中的关键作用。

url:2658d498a780fdac.abstract: In 2008, the US stock market was worth $3 trillion more than the combined European stock market; in 2023, the gap was $34 trillion. This column argues that the valuation gap is not driven by differences in GDP, number of listed firms, sectoral composition, or the presence of a few superstar firms, but by European firms’ inability to scale. European firms remain tethered to their home market. Small European firms face a much larger cost of capital and cannot substitute debt with access to equity financing, including venture capital. Therefore, even if they have profitable growth opportunities, European firms cannot grow as their US counterparts.
url:2658d498a780fdac.abstract_zh: 2008年，美国股市市值比欧洲股市总和高出3万亿美元；到2023年，这一差距扩大至34万亿美元。本专栏认为，这一估值差距并非源于GDP差异、上市公司数量、行业结构或少数超级明星企业的存在，而是由于欧洲企业缺乏扩张能力。欧洲企业始终受制于本土市场。小型欧洲企业面临更高的资本成本，且无法以债务融资替代股权融资渠道，包括风险投资。因此，即便拥有盈利增长机会，欧洲企业也难以像美国同行那样实现成长。
url:2658d498a780fdac.title: Small and stuck: Why European firms can’t scale

url:266541121487247b.abstract: What is the relationship between bank capital, the risk of a financial crisis, and its severity? This paper introduces the first comprehensive analysis of the long-run evolution of the capital structure of modern banking using newly constructed data for banks’ balance sheets in 17 countries since 1870. In addition to establishing stylized facts on the changing funding mix of banks, we study the nexus between capital structure and financial instability. We find no association between higher capital and lower risk of banking crisis. However, economies with better capitalized banking systems recover faster from financial crises as credit begins to flow back more readily.
url:266541121487247b.abstract_zh: 银行资本、金融危机风险及其严重程度之间存在何种关系？本文利用新构建的17个国家自1870年以来的银行资产负债表数据，首次对现代银行业资本结构的长期演变进行了全面分析。除了确立银行融资结构变化的标准事实外，我们还研究了资本结构与金融不稳定之间的联系。我们发现，更高的资本与较低的银行危机风险之间并无关联。然而，资本化程度更高的银行体系所在经济体，在金融危机后复苏更快，信贷流动恢复更为迅速。

url:2670bdfcaf7fbc4a.abstract: Advanced manufacturing industries targeted by the Made in China 2025 strategy, such as robots, semiconductors, electric vehicles (EVs, including autonomous driving), and batteries, have grown exponentially since 2015. With the exception of semiconductors, several categories within robots, batteries, and EVs have exceeded the localization targets outlined in the strategy. China now holds an overall value chain advantage over South Korea in these sectors. Across R&D, procurement (supply chain), production, services, and demand markets (both domestic and overseas), China maintains an edge in robots, EVs, batteries, and autonomous vehicles. Korea retains superiority in equipment procurement, sales and maintenance services, and overseas demand for the semiconductor industry, driven by its memory chip competitiveness. Korea also maintains a slight lead in robotics R&D capabilities for product development and design. While the expanding rivalry poses threats to Korean industries, opportunities exist to differentiate in advanced and niche markets. China’s price competitiveness, its expanding dominance in new AI-based markets, and its internalizing supply chains are common threats. However, leveraging its overall technological prowess and process expertise in materials, components, and equipment, Korea maintains a qualitative advantage in certain categories. Korea must seek to enter global premium markets, such as the US and the EU, emphasizing stability and reliability. Up to now, Korean industry has pursued an “ultra-gap” strategy, in which firms sought to maintain wide competitive moats against their Chinese competitors. This strategy is no longer viable. Korea urgently needs to shift its policy toward competitive cooperation and strategic utilization, and secure a position in the future ecosystems that China aims to dominate, actively utilizing China’s high-tech and technological ecosystems. We must discover new cooperative models that combine China’s technology, production base, and data with Korea’s innovative ideas.
url:2670bdfcaf7fbc4a.abstract_zh: 《中国制造2025》战略所瞄准的先进制造业，如机器人、半导体、电动汽车（含自动驾驶）及电池等领域，自2015年以来呈现指数级增长。除半导体外，机器人、电池和电动汽车中的多个类别已超出该战略设定的本地化目标。目前，中国在这些领域对韩国拥有整体价值链优势。在研发、采购（供应链）、生产、服务及需求市场（国内外）各环节，中国在机器人、电动汽车、电池及自动驾驶汽车方面均保持领先。韩国凭借其存储芯片竞争力，在半导体行业的设备采购、销售与维护服务及海外需求方面仍保有一定优势，并在机器人产品开发与设计的研发能力上略微领先。尽管不断扩大的竞争对韩国产业构成威胁，但在高端及细分市场实现差异化仍存在机遇。中国的价格竞争力、在基于人工智能的新兴市场中日益增强的主导地位及其供应链内部化是共同的威胁。然而，凭借在材料、零部件和设备领域整体技术实力及工艺专长，韩国在特定品类中仍保持质量优势。韩国必须寻求进入美国、欧盟等全球高端市场，强调稳定性与可靠性。迄今为止，韩国产业奉行“超差距”战略，即企业力求对华竞争对手维持宽泛的竞争护城河。这一战略已不再可行。韩国亟需转向竞争性合作与战略性利用的政策导向，在中国旨在主导的未来生态系统中占据一席之地，积极利用中国的高科技及技术生态系统。我们必须探索将中国的技术、生产基地和数据与韩国的创新理念相结合的新型合作模式。

url:269f72d8dcece17b.abstract: How do labor demand shocks affect workforce diversity in the absence of targeted diversity policies? A conceptual framework illustrates the potential trade-off between the demographic and quality composition of a workforce when there is a positive labor demand shock. Exploiting the German reunification as a natural experiment, we analyze the academic labor market where nearly all social sciences professors in East Germany were replaced while STEM faculty remained largely unchanged. Using administrative data and a regional difference-in-differences design, we find increased dispersion in the institutional quality of hires, indicating that the new hires came from less select departments. At the same time, female representation did not increase despite qualified women in the pipeline. Instead, East German hiring patterns converged to those in West Germany in terms of gender composition. In simulations, we investigate implied losses: Under conservative assumptions, we show that, considering the pipeline of qualified applicants, the marginal female hire’s quality is approximately half a standard deviation higher than the marginal male hire’s quality.
url:269f72d8dcece17b.abstract_zh: 在缺乏针对性多元化政策的情况下，劳动力需求冲击如何影响劳动力多样性？一个概念框架揭示了正向劳动力需求冲击下，劳动力人口结构与质量构成之间可能存在的权衡关系。以德国统一作为自然实验，我们分析了学术劳动力市场——东德几乎所有社会科学教授均被替换，而STEM领域教职基本保持不变。基于行政数据与区域双重差分设计，我们发现新聘人员的机构质量离散度上升，表明新入职者来自学术选拔性较低的院系。与此同时，尽管具备资质的女性候选人储备充足，女性代表性并未提升。相反，东德在性别构成上的招聘模式逐渐趋同于西德。通过模拟分析，我们探究了隐含损失：在保守假设下，考虑合格申请者储备池时，边际女性新聘人员的质量比边际男性新聘人员高出约半个标准差。

url:2720f5d810ca042e.abstract: This paper provides new evidence on the prevalence and potential effects of non-compete and related clauses in Canada using OECD surveys of workers and firms. It finds that these clauses are widespread, increasingly used, and often applied beyond roles where they are most justified. Many appear overly broad and legally weak, yet a substantial share of workers report having been prevented from changing jobs or starting a business. Their impact is reinforced by behavioural factors, including reputational and ethical concerns. The findings also bring into closer focus the use of (firm-to-firm) no-poaching and wage fixing agreements that restrict labour market competition and, thus, raise broader concerns for the Canadian Competition Bureau.
url:2720f5d810ca042e.abstract_zh: 本文利用经合组织（OECD）对劳动者和企业的调查，为加拿大竞业限制及相关条款的普遍性及其潜在影响提供了新证据。研究发现，这些条款广泛存在、使用日益频繁，且常被应用于最缺乏合理性的岗位。许多条款过于宽泛且法律效力薄弱，但仍有相当比例的劳动者表示，这些条款阻碍了其更换工作或创业。其影响因声誉和道德关切等行为因素而进一步强化。研究结果还更聚焦于（企业间）互不挖角协议和薪资固定协议的使用，这些协议限制了劳动力市场竞争，从而引发了加拿大竞争局的更广泛担忧。

url:2728f84ef63584b0.abstract: We study how expatriates cope when conflict breaks out in their homeland. Using Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine as a natural experiment, we identify causal effects using a matched difference-in-differences design, comparing incumbent Ukrainian migrants in Sweden to matched migrants from other countries. We show that Ukrainian expatriates experience immediate and persistent mental health deterioration—a 30 percent increase in psychiatric prescription use that remains elevated three years later—while simultaneously increasing employment and earnings. A simple framework rationalizes this pattern through two channels operating in opposite directions: concern for family safety worsens mental health and raises the disutility of work, while heightened financial responsibilities raise the return to earning income. Consistent with reduced reservation wages, Ukrainians take on secondary jobs, exit unemployment faster into lower-quality jobs, and earn less than comparable coworkers. Earnings effects concentrate among migrants from more war-exposed regions, while mental health effects attenuate in Swedish municipalities with more Ukrainian refugee arrivals. Results replicate in European and US survey data. As global migration and armed conflict both reach historic highs, the findings show that the welfare costs of war extend across borders, shaping the well-being and economic behavior of expatriates worldwide.
url:2728f84ef63584b0.abstract_zh: 我们研究了外籍人士在祖国爆发冲突时的应对方式。以2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰作为自然实验，我们采用匹配双重差分法识别因果效应，将瑞典境内的乌克兰移民与来自其他国家的匹配移民进行比较。研究表明，乌克兰外籍人士的心理健康立即且持续恶化——精神类药物处方使用量增加30%，并在三年后仍保持高位——同时其就业率和收入却有所提升。一个简单框架通过两个反向作用渠道解释了这一模式：对家人安全的担忧加剧心理健康问题并提高工作的负效用，而经济责任加重则提升了创收的回报。与保留工资下降一致，乌克兰移民从事兼职工作、更快脱离失业状态但进入质量较低的工作岗位，且收入低于可比同事。来自战争更激烈地区的移民收入效应更为显著，而乌克兰难民接收人数较多的瑞典市镇中，心理健康效应有所减弱。研究结果在欧洲及美国调查数据中均得到验证。随着全球移民与武装冲突均达到历史高位，这些发现表明战争的福利成本跨越国界，深刻影响着全球外籍人士的福祉与经济行为。

url:2748c397bc3d34db.abstract: This paper provides a framework for context-aware industrial policy by applying economic complexity theory to a newly constructed dataset of twelve key clean energy supply chains (CESCs). We find that CESCs are diverse but highly interdependent; they are also growing faster and are more concentrated than other industries. CESCs exhibit substantial entry, exit and competitive churn, and countries are more likely to enter CESC industries that are related to their existing productive capabilities. We also explore changing global competitiveness and country positioning in these industries, and draw out implications of these patterns for industrial policymakers.
url:2748c397bc3d34db.abstract_zh: 本文通过将经济复杂性理论应用于新构建的十二个关键清洁能源供应链（CESCs）数据集，为情境感知型产业政策提供了一个分析框架。我们发现，清洁能源供应链具有多样性但高度相互依赖；同时，它们比其他行业增长更快且更为集中。清洁能源供应链表现出显著的进入、退出和竞争更替现象，且各国更倾向于进入与其现有生产能力相关的清洁能源供应链行业。我们还探讨了这些行业中全球竞争力及国家定位的变化，并提炼出这些模式对产业政策制定者的启示。

url:2782e1b01ca3386d.abstract: How much fraud is there in Medicare and who commits it? We provide an answer for Medicare home health, a setting widely considered especially rife with fraud. We define a home health agency (HHA) as fraudulent if it was prosecuted by a federal strike force. Combining Medicare claims data on all HHAs with hand-collected prosecution records from the nine federal judicial districts where strike forces operated between 2009 and 2013, we train a machine learning model to predict, out of sample, the probability that each HHA in the remaining 85 districts would have been prosecuted had a strike force been present. We estimate that in 2008, 3.4% of Medicare home health spending — about $520 million — was billed by fraudulent HHAs. The strike forces were well-targeted: their nine districts contained only 40% of home health spending but 65% of fraudulent spending. Fraudulent HHAs display intuitive characteristics: they are more likely to rely on extremely high-volume referring physicians, to exhibit unusually uniform patterns of care, and to serve healthier-than-average patients.
url:2782e1b01ca3386d.abstract_zh: 医疗保险欺诈的规模有多大？欺诈者是谁？我们以医疗保险家庭健康服务（普遍被认为欺诈高发领域）为研究对象，将曾遭联邦特别行动组起诉的家庭健康机构（HHA）定义为欺诈机构。通过整合全美所有HHA的医疗保险索赔数据，以及手工收集的2009至2013年间九个联邦司法辖区特别行动组的起诉记录，我们训练机器学习模型，预测其余85个司法辖区的HHA若遭遇特别行动组调查时被起诉的概率。研究估算，2008年医疗保险家庭健康支出中有3.4%（约5.2亿美元）由欺诈性HHA开具账单。特别行动组的靶向性显著：其覆盖的九个辖区虽仅占家庭健康总支出的40%，却集中了65%的欺诈性支出。欺诈性HHA呈现典型特征：更依赖超高转诊量的医师，护理模式异常趋同，且服务对象健康水平高于平均水平。
url:2782e1b01ca3386d.title: Medicare Home Health Fraud: How Much, Where, and Who?

url:278d932d6d021a48.abstract: This paper studies how short-term variations in fine particulate matter (PM2.5) pollution affects cognitive performance across tasks of varying complexity. While prior work shows that pollution impairs performance in highly demanding cognitive settings, it remains unclear whether these effects extend to simpler tasks. We examine this question using data from official Rubik's Cube tournaments in the United States and India. Solving different cube sizes provides a natural proxy for task complexity, while solving time measures cognitive performance. To identify causal effects, we exploit exogenous variation in local PM2.5 generated by wind direction. We find that PM2.5 pollution has negligible effects on simple tasks but significantly slows performance on complex ones for tournaments in the United States. In India, where baseline PM2.5 levels are substantially higher, we find similar effect patterns but none of the effects are statistically significant. We show that this pattern is explained by diminishing marginal sensitivity to short-term PM2.5 shocks as baseline PM2.5 pollution levels increase. Our findings provide causal evidence that the cognitive costs of PM2.5 pollution depend critically on task complexity.
url:278d932d6d021a48.abstract_zh: 本文研究了细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染的短期波动如何影响不同复杂度任务的认知表现。尽管已有研究表明污染会损害高认知需求环境下的表现，但尚不清楚这种影响是否延伸至简单任务。我们利用美国和印度官方魔方锦标赛的数据检验这一问题。不同尺寸魔方的求解过程自然反映了任务复杂度，而求解时间则衡量认知表现。为识别因果效应，我们利用风向引起的本地PM2.5外生变化。研究发现，PM2.5污染对美国锦标赛中简单任务的影响微乎其微，但显著降低了复杂任务的表现速度。在基线PM2.5水平显著更高的印度，我们观察到相似的影响模式，但所有效应均未达到统计显著性。我们证明，这一模式可通过短期PM2.5冲击的边际敏感性随基线污染水平升高而递减来解释。研究结果提供了因果证据，表明PM2.5污染的认知成本关键取决于任务复杂度。
url:278d932d6d021a48.title: Air Pollution and Cognitive Performance Under Varying Task Complexity
url:278d932d6d021a48.title_zh: 不同任务复杂度下的空气污染与认知表现

url:27b449f37138fd9b.abstract: We demonstrate that the estimation of gravity equations of trade flows suffers from an omitted variable bias when firms are granular and behave oligopolistically. We show how to correct for this bias in the estimation of both firm- and industry-level gravity. Using French and Chinese export data, we find that the oligopoly bias leads to a substantial underestimation of the effects of distance on trade flows. In a calibrated version of the model, the welfare gains from a trade liberalization are found to be almost twice as large under oligopoly as under monopolistic competition.
url:27b449f37138fd9b.abstract_zh: 我们证明，当企业具有颗粒性并表现出寡头垄断行为时，贸易流量的引力方程估计会遭受遗漏变量偏差。我们展示了如何在企业和行业层面的引力估计中纠正这一偏差。利用法国和中国的出口数据，我们发现寡头垄断偏差导致距离对贸易流量的影响被显著低估。在模型校准版本中，贸易自由化的福利收益在寡头垄断下几乎是垄断竞争下的两倍。
url:27b449f37138fd9b.title: DP15374 Gravity with Granularity

url:27cc87495164abf4.abstract: In this paper we evaluate internationally agreed limits on public sector debt and deficits, such as those agreed by the EC countries in the Treaty of Maastricht as preconditions for membership in a monetary union. These fiscal convergence criteria require that general government budget deficits should not exceed 3% of GDP and that the gross debt of the general government should not be above 60% of GDP. The Maastricht requirements, especially the debt criterion, are much more stringent than those required to ensure public sector solvency. Their implementation would require an excessive degree of fiscal retrenchment which would adversely affect the level of economic activity. The deficit guideline does not appear to be sensible, since the numerical criterion refers to the nominal interest payments-inclusive financial deficit, with no corrections for inflation and real output growth, no cyclical adjustment and no appropriate allowance for future revenue-producing public sector investment. The verbal qualifications are too vague to neutralize the potential for serious damage attached to the numerical guidelines. We discuss the various `externality' arguments in favour of binding fiscal rules and find them wanting, both theoretically and empirically. An argument in favour of external enforcement of binding fiscal rules might be made in the presence of `excessive deficits' due to political distortions. We conclude that the fiscal convergence criteria should be disregarded or applied quite loosely in order to avoid the risk of serious fiscal overkill.
url:27cc87495164abf4.abstract_zh: 本文评估了国际社会对公共部门债务与赤字设定的限制性标准，例如欧盟国家在《马斯特里赫特条约》中作为货币联盟成员资格前提条件所达成的协议。这些财政趋同标准要求：一般政府预算赤字不得超过GDP的3%，一般政府总债务不得超过GDP的60%。《马斯特里赫特条约》的要求，尤其是债务标准，远高于确保公共部门偿付能力所需的水平。实施这些标准将要求过度的财政紧缩，从而对经济活动水平产生不利影响。赤字指导原则似乎并不合理，因为该数值标准针对的是包含名义利息支付的财政赤字，既未对通胀和实际产出增长进行调整，也未进行周期性调整，更未对未来能产生收入的公共部门投资给予适当考量。其文字性限定条件过于模糊，无法抵消数值指导原则可能造成的严重损害。我们探讨了支持具有约束力财政规则的各种“外部性”论点，发现这些论点在理论和实证层面均存在不足。在因政治扭曲导致“过度赤字”的情况下，或许可以提出支持外部强制实施约束性财政规则的理由。我们的结论是：为避免严重财政过度紧缩的风险，应忽略或宽松适用这些财政趋同标准。
url:27cc87495164abf4.title: DP750 `Excessive Deficits': Sense and Nonsense in the Treaty of Maastricht
url:27cc87495164abf4.title_zh: DP750 `过度赤字'：马斯特里赫特条约中的合理与荒谬

url:27d054540f294b92.abstract: This paper interprets the Great Divergence as the cumulative influence of small asymmetries in technology or various initial conditions, amplified through conflict over resources. It introduces a tractable framework that integrates demography, technological progress, and conflict into a unified growth model. The amplification effect of resource appropriation is characterized by conflict multipliers in both the short- and long-run. Conflict is a source of substantial divergence, as the appropriation of resources allows some countries to develop faster at the expense of others. Reconvergence is, however, possible through population growth, due to strategic complementarities in fertility decisions and staggered demographic transitions. Rich and non-linear dynamics display key features of comparative economic development between the West and the Global South, but also shed light on a variety of historical case studies that share such dynamics of divergence and reconvergence, as well as more dramatic episodes of population extinction in a dominated country. Our framework can easily be extended to study the role of resource exhaustion or the fundamental trade-off between trade and conflict.
url:27d054540f294b92.abstract_zh: 本文将大分流解释为技术或初始条件中微小不对称性通过资源冲突放大后的累积影响。我们构建了一个可处理的框架，将人口学、技术进步与冲突整合为统一增长模型。资源侵占的放大效应通过短期与长期冲突乘数得以刻画。冲突是导致显著分流的根源——部分国家通过侵占他国资源实现更快发展。然而，由于生育决策中的战略互补性与交错人口转型，人口增长可能推动重新趋同。丰富的非线性动态既展现了西方与全球南方比较经济发展的关键特征，也揭示了共享这种分流与趋同动态的多种历史案例，以及被支配国家中更为剧烈的人口灭绝事件。本框架可便捷扩展至资源枯竭作用或贸易与冲突间根本权衡的研究。

Employing some of the most rigorous empirical approaches in the literature, including mother fixed-effects models, the study reports five main findings, several of which offer new insights for the literature. url:27de608dff1bc17f.abstract_zh: 本研究首次利用覆盖18年、与人口普查记录关联的全人口出生登记数据，考察了澳大利亚超过120万儿童出生体重与一系列综合社会经济因素在均值及分布层面的关系。通过采用文献中最严谨的实证方法（包括母亲固定效应模型），本研究得出五项主要发现，其中多项为文献提供了新见解。第一，母亲和父亲的教育水平均与儿童出生体重呈正相关。

url:2845e750492565e9.abstract: Focus Exuberance about new technologies often brings about investment booms. The race among firms to capture a share of the revenues can result in excessive investment that makes the boom prone to a disruptive end. The boom-bust cycle recurs across history, from the canal and railway manias of the 19th century to the dotcom boom of the 1990s. The current artificial intelligence (AI) build-out ranks among the largest technology-driven investment booms in US history. Could it share the same fate as prior episodes?
url:2845e750492565e9.abstract_zh: 对新技术的狂热关注常常引发投资热潮。企业为争夺收入份额而展开的竞争可能导致过度投资，使热潮容易以破坏性结局收场。从19世纪的运河与铁路狂热到20世纪90年代的互联网泡沫，繁荣-萧条周期在历史上反复出现。当前的人工智能基础设施建设规模，堪称美国历史上规模最大的技术驱动型投资热潮之一。它是否会重蹈此前历次热潮的覆辙？
url:2845e750492565e9.title: The AI investment race

url:288c38e270d65ec0.abstract: In an economy with financial imperfections, Ricardian equivalence holds when prices are flexible and the steady-state distribution of consumption is uniform, or labor is inelastic. With different steady-state consumption levels, Ricardian equivalence fails, but tax cuts, somewhat paradoxically, are contractionary; the present-value multiplier on consumption is, however, zero. With sticky prices, Ricardian equivalence always fails. A Robin-Hood, revenue-neutral redistribution to borrowers is expansionary on aggregate activity. A uniform cut in taxes financed with public debt has a positive present-value multiplier on consumption, stemming from intertemporal substitution by the savers, who hold the public debt.
url:288c38e270d65ec0.abstract_zh: 在存在金融摩擦的经济体中，当价格具有弹性且稳态消费分布均匀，或劳动供给缺乏弹性时，李嘉图等价成立。当稳态消费水平存在差异时，李嘉图等价失效，但减税政策反而具有收缩效应——尽管消费的现值乘数为零。在价格粘性条件下，李嘉图等价始终不成立。针对借款者的罗宾汉式收入中性再分配政策对总体经济活动具有扩张效应。通过公共债务融资的普遍减税政策对消费产生正向现值乘数，这一效应源于持有公共债务的储蓄者的跨期替代行为。

url:29680bc8bc27b5f6.abstract: This paper proposes a novel mechanism linking common ownership to anticompetitive outcomes. Common owners promote shareholder-friendly governance policies in their portfolio firms, empowering interventions by activist hedge funds that discourage managers from investing. The cumulative impact of hedge fund activism contributes to anticompetitive outcomes, without collusion between managers. Effectively, and possibly unintentionally, common owners exert monopsonistic power over labor by reducing aggregate investment. Subsequently, the artificially depressed wages result in transfer of wealth to shareholders. While hedge fund activism generally improves social welfare in a competitive equilibrium, it may reduce social welfare under common ownership. The symbiotic relationship between common owners and activist hedge funds can be detrimental to society. The paper establishes a new connection between the rise of institutional ownership, adoption of shareholder-friendly policies, increased hedge fund activism, reduced investment and labor share, and heightened capital market returns.
url:29680bc8bc27b5f6.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的机制，将共同所有权与反竞争结果联系起来。共同所有者在投资组合公司中推行有利于股东的公司治理政策，从而增强激进对冲基金的干预能力，抑制管理层的投资行为。对冲基金激进主义的累积效应导致了反竞争结果，而无需管理层之间的合谋。实际上，共同所有者可能无意中通过减少总投资来对劳动力施加垄断买方权力。随后，人为压低的工资导致财富向股东转移。尽管在竞争均衡中，对冲基金激进主义通常能改善社会福利，但在共同所有权下，它可能降低社会福利。共同所有者与激进对冲基金之间的共生关系可能对社会有害。本文建立了机构所有权上升、股东友好政策采纳、对冲基金激进主义增加、投资与劳动份额下降以及资本市场回报率提高之间的新联系。
url:29680bc8bc27b5f6.title: Common Ownership and Hedge Fund Activism: An Unholy Alliance?
url:29680bc8bc27b5f6.title_zh: 共同所有权与对冲基金激进主义：不洁的联盟？

url:29799f9faa9c45a5.abstract: On August 1, 2019, North Dakota repealed its Sunday closing law, which had required most non-grocery stores to close between midnight and noon on Sundays. Using this policy change and detailed GPS data on consumer movement, we study the impact of store opening hours on shopping behavior and welfare. We compare store visits before and after the repeal in North Dakota and neighboring states, using difference-in-differences and event study designs. The repeal led to a large increase in Sunday morning store visits in North Dakota. This change reflects a rise in overall shopping frequency, along with intertemporal substitution (mainly from Sunday afternoon), substitution across store types (from grocery stores), and cross-border shopping to Minnesota. We find that the welfare loss from the Sunday sales restriction for Walmart stores is equivalent to increasing the travel distance to Walmart by about 1.7 miles for each consumer.
url:29799f9faa9c45a5.abstract_zh: 2019年8月1日，北达科他州废除了其周日歇业法，该法曾要求大多数非杂货店在周日午夜至中午期间关闭。利用这一政策变化及消费者移动的详细GPS数据，我们研究了商店营业时间对购物行为及福利的影响。我们通过双重差分法和事件研究设计，比较了北达科他州及邻近州在废除前后商店访问量的变化。废除该法导致北达科他州周日上午商店访问量大幅增加。这一变化反映了整体购物频率的上升，以及跨期替代（主要来自周日下午）、跨商店类型替代（来自杂货店）和跨境购物至明尼苏达州的现象。我们发现，周日销售限制对沃尔玛商店造成的福利损失，相当于每位消费者前往沃尔玛的出行距离增加了约1.7英里。
url:29799f9faa9c45a5.title: Opening Hours and Consumer Behavior: Evidence from GPS Data and Deregulation
url:29799f9faa9c45a5.title_zh: 营业时间与消费者行为：来自GPS数据和放松管制的证据

url:29831aeff41b4806.abstract: Firms often rebrand to counter negative shocks, but can it work? Using a historical natural experiment, we analyze a large sample of companies from the same industry (banking) that shared very similar names, but overwhelmingly decided to change them in response to a common, negative news shock. U.S. entry into World War I in 1917 created a sudden anti-German backlash against anything that invoked an association with the now enemy. The shock itself was thus orthogonal to bank fundamentals and pre-existing trends, but pushed banks to reconsider their brands. After 1917, the few German-named banks that kept their tainted names saw significant declines in assets, deposits, and market share relative to other banks. However, German-named banks that rebranded mitigated much of the negative shock. Specifically, German-named banks that adopted a new non-ethnic brand name avoided between 75% and 85% of the anti-German effect, and those that adopted a new patriotic brand name were able to neutralize it completely. Overall, we find that "crisis rebranding" paid off in our historical setting regardless of the chosen brand, with patriotic rebranding proving the most effective at offsetting the exogenous shock.
url:29831aeff41b4806.abstract_zh: 企业常通过品牌重塑应对负面冲击，但这一策略是否有效？借助历史自然实验，我们分析了同一行业（银行业）中大量名称高度相似的公司样本，这些公司在面临共同负面新闻冲击时，绝大多数选择更改名称。1917年美国加入第一次世界大战，引发了对任何与敌国（德国）相关事物的突然反德情绪。这一冲击本身与银行基本面及既有趋势正交，却促使银行重新审视其品牌。1917年后，少数保留受污名化德文名称的银行，其资产、存款及市场份额相较于其他银行显著下滑。然而，进行品牌重塑的德文名称银行在很大程度上缓解了负面冲击。具体而言，采用非族裔新品牌名称的德文名称银行避免了75%至85%的反德效应，而采用爱国新品牌名称的银行则完全抵消了这一影响。总体而言，我们发现无论选择何种品牌，历史情境下的“危机品牌重塑”均取得了成效，其中爱国品牌重塑在抵消外生冲击方面最为有效。
url:29831aeff41b4806.title: Banking on a Corporate Rebrand

url:29a431f8a9a19a9e.abstract: This paper highlights an underexplored margin of heterogeneity that shapes resilience to disruptions in global shipping - the differential reliance of countries and sectors on specific categories of vessels. We combine US bills of lading records with ship registry and AIS-based port call data to document new stylized facts on vessel deployment, including switching patterns across ships, country specialization in shipbuilding, and the composition of fleets serving different country pairs. Exploiting the 2016 Panama Canal expansion as a quasi-natural experiment, we further provide the first direct estimate for the elasticity of substitution between vessels across size classes. Building on the empirical evidence, we then introduce endogenous vessel choice into a quantitative general equilibrium trade model that features multiple transport modes and a global market for shipping services. The model allows us to quantify the trade and welfare effects of two recent policy proposals that target specific types, namely, fees for Chinese-built vessels entering US ports and the inclusion of the maritime transport sector in the EU Emission Trading System.
url:29a431f8a9a19a9e.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了一个尚未充分探索的异质性维度——各国及各部门对不同类别船舶的差异化依赖——如何影响其对全球航运中断的韧性。我们结合美国提单记录、船舶登记数据以及基于AIS的港口停靠数据，系统梳理了船舶部署的新典型事实，包括船舶间的切换模式、各国在造船领域的专业化分工，以及服务于不同国家配对航线的船队构成。以2016年巴拿马运河扩建为准自然实验，我们首次直接估算了不同吨位级别船舶之间的替代弹性。基于实证证据，我们进一步将内生船舶选择引入一个包含多种运输方式及全球航运服务市场的量化一般均衡贸易模型。该模型使我们能够量化两项近期针对特定类型船舶的政策提案的贸易与福利效应：一是针对中国建造船舶进入美国港口征收的费用，二是将海运部门纳入欧盟排放交易体系。
url:29a431f8a9a19a9e.title: Quantitative Trade with Ships

url:29bb043b9e0bf7d8.abstract: Trade networks underpinning the energy transition are endogenous economic objects, and their structure is a source of market power. Using bilateral trade data for thirteen electrification metals over 1995–2023, we show that trade in these materials has reorganised into a hub-and-spoke system centred on China, in sharp contrast to the diffuse, multilateral structure of fossil fuels. This centrality did not follow from resource endowments: China holds few of the underlying reserves. It was built through processing investment, industrial policy, and commodity-targeted development finance—an equilibrium outcome rather than a geographical accident. We formalise this in a stylised model in which a country chooses how central to become, and show that centrality maps into pricing power: the world price response to a strategic supply cut is stronger when the network is more concentrated and downstream demand and fringe supply are more inelastic. Constructing text-based, commodity-specific supply shocks and estimating local projections, we find that supply contractions in critical metals raise US and EU consumer prices by roughly twice as much as comparable fossil-fuel shocks, and more persistently. Centrality is therefore not merely descriptive: it creates leverage over global prices. The green transition reduces strategic dependence on hydrocarbon exporters but reconstitutes it around mineral supply chains. That's 200 words. Main cuts: removed the redundant "response to a strategic supply cut" phrasing fix (corrected the original "price...response" agreement), trimmed the closing "architecture of," and compressed a few connectors without losing any substantive claim.Please provide a short description (less than 180 characters) of the paper's findings. url:29bb043b9e0bf7d8.abstract_zh: 支撑能源转型的贸易网络是内生的经济对象，其结构构成市场势力的来源。利用1995-2023年间十三种电气化金属的双边贸易数据，我们发现这些材料的贸易已重组为以中国为中心的轴辐式体系，与化石燃料分散的多边结构形成鲜明对比。这种中心地位并非源于资源禀赋——中国持有的基础储量很少，而是通过加工投资、产业政策和针对特定商品的发展融资构建而成，是均衡结果而非地理偶然。我们通过一个简约模型将这一过程形式化，其中一国选择其中心化程度，并证明中心度映射为定价权：当网络更集中、下游需求和边缘供给更缺乏弹性时，战略性供给削减对世界价格的冲击更强。通过构建基于文本的特定商品供给冲击并估计局部投影，我们发现关键金属的供给收缩使美国和欧盟消费者价格涨幅约为可比化石燃料冲击的两倍，且持续性更强。因此，中心度不仅是描述性概念，更创造了影响全球价格的杠杆。绿色转型减少了对碳氢化合物出口国的战略依赖，但将其重构于矿产供应链之上。

url:29cdab1aad7ed121.abstract: This paper shows that relative-wage compression is conducive to higher employer-initiated job turnover, and argues that wage-setting institutions and job security provisions differ across countries in ways that are both consistent with rough uniformity of job turnover statistics and readily explained by intuitive theoretical considerations. When viewed as a component of the mix of institutional differences in Europe and North America, European dismissal restrictions are essential to a proper interpretation of both similar patterns in job turnover, and marked differences in unemployment flows.
url:29cdab1aad7ed121.abstract_zh: 本文表明，相对工资压缩有利于提高雇主发起的岗位流动率，并论证各国工资设定制度与工作保障条款的差异，既与岗位流动统计数据的粗略一致性相符，也可通过直观的理论考量得到合理解释。当将欧洲与北美的制度差异组合视为整体时，欧洲的解雇限制对于正确解读岗位流动的相似模式以及失业流动的显著差异至关重要。
url:29cdab1aad7ed121.title: Institutions and Labour Reallocation

url:29d40c72bc25b500.abstract: we investigate the relative efficiency of different tax schemes in fostering political and charitable donations. We document that repealing the existing non-refundable income-tax credit decreases charitable donations but not political donations, pointing toward greater fiscal incentives behind charitable giving. We next show that, conditional on giving, matching – where the government matches individual donations at a fixed rate –increases both political and charitable giving, but that it decreases the probability of giving to charities at the extensive margin. Finally, using a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and generic machine learning, we document important dimensions of heterogeneity, and discuss the policy implications of our findings.
url:29d40c72bc25b500.abstract_zh: 我们考察了不同税收方案在促进政治捐赠和慈善捐赠方面的相对效率。研究显示，取消现有的不可退还所得税抵免会减少慈善捐赠，但对政治捐赠无显著影响，这表明财政激励对慈善捐赠的推动作用更为显著。进一步地，我们发现在给予捐赠的前提下，匹配机制——即政府按固定比例匹配个人捐赠——能同时增加政治和慈善捐赠，但在广泛边际上降低了向慈善机构捐赠的概率。最后，通过主成分分析（PCA）和通用机器学习方法，我们揭示了异质性的重要维度，并探讨了研究结果的政策含义。
url:29d40c72bc25b500.title: Should Charitable and Political Donations Benefit from Similar Tax Treatments? Evidence from a Survey Experiment

url:2a1264cd89e4ff52.abstract: Inflation in the US has receded from its 2022 peak. This column uses payroll records from 2016 to 2025 to show that many workers have experienced a lasting reduction in their purchasing power, and argues that the lack of systematic wage indexation in the US is central to this story. When inflation surged, most firms continued to grant familiar raises of 2% to 4%, allowing purchasing power to fall. Once inflation slowed, those raises again produced modest real wage growth but did not compensate workers for what they had already lost.
url:2a1264cd89e4ff52.abstract_zh: 美国通胀已从2022年的峰值回落。本文利用2016年至2025年的工资记录显示，许多工人的购买力经历了持久性下降，并认为美国缺乏系统性的工资指数化机制是这一现象的核心原因。当通胀飙升时，大多数企业继续给予2%至4%的常规加薪，导致购买力下降。一旦通胀放缓，这些加薪再次带来温和的实际工资增长，但并未补偿工人此前已遭受的损失。
url:2a1264cd89e4ff52.title: The inflation rate fell but many workers’ pay cheques did not keep up

url:2a3cf0a01e14b207.abstract: We show that the optimal monetary policy and exchange rate framework depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions may vary with the commodity cycle, and we compute the welfare-optimal policy in the presence of price and wage rigidities. Stabilizing domestic prices is welfare-optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But for economies that use commodities as inputs in production, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ the direct and indirect effects of commodity shocks on domestic prices; this contrasts with some earlier findings and policy practice (which only ‘looks through’ the direct effect). Exchange-rate pegs increase welfare for commodity importers because they stabilize wages and employment, though it is not a robustly optimal policy. In emerging and developing economies, where financial conditions are more tied to the commodity cycle, trade-offs are starker and implementing the optimal policy may be challenging, since it requires enough credibility to keep inflation expectations anchored amidst greater volatility in some nominal variables.
url:2a3cf0a01e14b207.abstract_zh: 我们证明，最优货币政策与汇率框架的关键取决于经济体的商品敞口程度。我们构建了一个兼具灵活性与可操作性的模型经济体，该模型包含商品进出口部门，且国际金融条件可能随商品周期变化，并在存在价格与工资粘性的条件下计算了福利最优政策。对于商品出口国而言，稳定国内价格是福利最优选择，这与标准开放经济政策建议一致。但对于将商品作为生产投入的经济体，最优政策在很大程度上会"忽略"商品冲击对国内价格的直接与间接影响——这与部分早期研究发现及政策实践（仅"忽略"直接影响）形成对比。对商品进口国而言，钉住汇率制度能提升福利水平，因其可稳定工资与就业，但这并非稳健的最优政策。在新兴市场与发展中经济体，金融条件与商品周期的关联更为紧密，政策权衡更为严峻，实施最优政策可能面临挑战——这要求政策具备足够公信力，以便在部分名义变量波动加剧时仍能锚定通胀预期。
url:2a3cf0a01e14b207.title: How Should Central Banks Respond to Commodity Price Shocks? Optimal Monetary and Exchange Rate Frameworks for Commodity-Exposed Economies

url:2a865ce2897ef563.abstract: this study, we examine the impact of the ASEAN-China Free Trade Agreement (ACFTA) on the likelihood of becoming a wage worker in Indonesia, which serves as a proxy for better paid employment in the Indonesian context. Our findings suggest that reductions in import and export tariffs did not, on average, increase the probability of becoming a wage worker, except among those with more than a primary education (25% of the working-age population). The estimated impact on various subgroups and sectors appears to vary considerably across regions, being stronger in Java, the most densely populated and economically dynamic island. In line with these limited average effects at worker level, we also find no significant changes in employment or value added in large and medium-sized manufacturing firms, which are the main providers of salaried jobs. Our results suggest that, if anything, the ACFTA had a regressive impact on access to better-paying jobs.
url:2a865ce2897ef563.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了东盟-中国自由贸易协定（ACFTA）对印度尼西亚成为工资劳动者可能性的影响，这一指标在印尼背景下被视为获得更高薪酬就业的代理变量。我们的研究结果表明，平均而言，进出口关税的削减并未提高成为工资劳动者的概率，除非是那些接受过小学以上教育的人群（占劳动年龄人口的25%）。对各子群体和部门的影响估计在不同地区间差异显著，在爪哇岛——人口最密集且经济最具活力的岛屿——影响更为明显。与工人层面这些有限的平均效应相一致，我们也未发现大中型制造业企业（这些企业是带薪岗位的主要提供者）在就业或附加值方面发生显著变化。我们的研究结果表明，若要说有何影响，ACFTA对获得更高薪酬工作的机会产生了倒退性影响。
url:2a865ce2897ef563.title: Creating Better-Paid Jobs Thanks to Regional Trade Agreements? Evidence from Indonesia

url:2a892fa6632cd238.abstract: Two important welfare implications of network effects are that (1) market forces often result in suboptimal standardization, that is, left alone the market may fail to achieve standardization when it is socially desirable and (2) even if the market settles on a standard, the chosen standard may be inferior. Some policy makers have interpreted these results to mean that when there are strong network effects, regulators should play an active role in setting standards. Others have urged regulators not to intervene despite the presence of network effects, unless owners of proprietary standards take strategic actions to influence the adoption decisions of consumers. One action that has raised regulatory (antitrust) concerns is strategic product preannouncements or 'vaporware'. In this paper, we empirically test for network effects and vaporware effects in the DVD market and examine the role played by the Internet.
url:2a892fa6632cd238.abstract_zh: 网络效应的两个重要福利含义是：（1）市场力量往往导致次优标准化，即若放任市场自行发展，当标准化具有社会合意性时，市场可能无法实现标准化；（2）即使市场最终确立了某种标准，所选标准也可能并非最优。部分政策制定者将这些结论解读为：当存在强网络效应时，监管机构应在标准制定中发挥积极作用。另一些政策制定者则主张，即便存在网络效应，除非专有标准所有者采取战略性行动影响消费者的采纳决策，否则监管机构不应干预。其中引发监管（反垄断）关注的一种行为是战略性产品预发布或"雾件"。本文通过实证检验DVD市场中的网络效应与雾件效应，并考察互联网在其中发挥的作用。
url:2a892fa6632cd238.title: Network Effects, Standardization, and the Internet: What Have We Learned From The DVD Vs. DIVX Battle?

url:2ab79988688ba071.abstract: Using novel data from the Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking, we examine how labor market tightness affects workers’ job quality. We estimate that a 10 percent increase in job vacancies not only increases the probability of changing jobs, it yields an 11–18 percent increase in the (unconditional) probability of switching to a better job overall, and one with greater pay and benefits, interest in the work, and advancement opportunities. Because tight labor markets improve both worker pay and job amenities in roughly the same proportion, their benefits to workers are underestimated when based on pay alone.
url:2ab79988688ba071.abstract_zh: 利用来自家庭经济与决策调查的新数据，我们研究了劳动力市场紧张程度如何影响工人的工作质量。我们估计，职位空缺每增加10%，不仅会提高工人更换工作的概率，还会使工人（无条件）转向整体更优工作的概率提升11%至18%，这类工作通常伴随更高的薪酬与福利、更强的工作兴趣以及更多的晋升机会。由于紧张的劳动力市场在提升工人薪酬与工作环境舒适度方面大致保持相同比例，仅基于薪酬评估会低估其对工人的整体益处。

url:2ac540e0e20a7185.abstract: Using UK longitudinal data on dual-earner couples, this paper estimates a model of intrahousehold housework decisions, which combines a randomized experimental framework eliciting counterfactual choices with gender norms differences across ethnicities and cohorts to identify the impacts of individual preferences and gender identity norms. Equal sharing of tasks yields greater utility for both men and women, with women disliking domestic chores as much as men. Although couples would want to use housework arrangements to compensate for differentials in labor market involvement, women end up performing a substantially larger share of housework. This is not due to specialization, rather social norms play a key role. Exposure to more egalitarian gender attitudes significantly increases the probability of choosing an equal share of housework. Were attitudes evened up to the most progressive levels observed in the sample, women doing more housework than their partners would stop to be the norm already among present-day households, except for households with children.
url:2ac540e0e20a7185.abstract_zh: 本文利用英国双职工夫妇的纵向数据，估计了一个家庭内家务劳动决策模型，该模型结合了引出反事实选择的随机实验框架与不同种族和世代间的性别规范差异，以识别个人偏好和性别认同规范的影响。家务劳动的平等分担对男性和女性均带来更高的效用，且女性对家务劳动的厌恶程度与男性相当。尽管夫妇倾向于利用家务安排来补偿劳动力市场参与的差异，但女性最终承担了显著更大份额的家务劳动。这并非源于专业化分工，而是社会规范发挥了关键作用。接触更平等的性别态度显著提高了选择平等分担家务的概率。若态度提升至样本中观察到的最进步水平，女性承担多于伴侣家务的现象在当今家庭中将不再成为常态，但育有子女的家庭除外。

url:2ae93615709ab260.abstract: Poverty and mortality are the two major sources of well-being losses. We propose new summary indicators of well-being that account for mortality while being (i) conceptually sound, (ii) easily interpretable and implementable and (iii) sensitive to the distribution of well-being. Our main indicator is the poverty-adjusted life expectancy index. Following the expected life-cycle utility approach a la Harsanyi, it is based on a single normative parameter that transparently captures the trade-off between poverty and mortality. Empirically, we compare countries over time and focus on these situations in which mortality is in conflict with poverty. Once we assume that being poor is (at least weakly) preferable to being dead, we find that about a third of these conflicting comparisons can be unambiguously ranked by the poverty-adjusted life expectancy index. Finally, this indicator naturally defines a new and simple index of multidimensional poverty, the expected deprivation index, which also accounts for unequal lifespans.
url:2ae93615709ab260.abstract_zh: 贫困与死亡率是福祉损失的两大主要来源。我们提出了新的福祉综合指标，该指标在考虑死亡率的同时，具备以下特征：（i）概念严谨，（ii）易于解释与实施，（iii）对福祉分布具有敏感性。我们的核心指标是贫困调整预期寿命指数。遵循哈萨尼式的预期生命周期效用方法，该指数基于单一规范性参数，能够透明地反映贫困与死亡率之间的权衡关系。在实证层面，我们通过跨国时间序列比较，聚焦于死亡率与贫困存在冲突的情形。一旦假设贫困状态（至少弱）优于死亡状态，我们发现约三分之一的此类冲突比较可通过贫困调整预期寿命指数获得明确排序。最后，该指标自然衍生出一个新颖且简洁的多维贫困指数——预期剥夺指数，该指数同样考虑了寿命不平等问题。
url:2ae93615709ab260.title: A transparent index of well being accounting for mortality: Poverty Adjusted Life Expectancy.

url:2b082036b33c58b6.abstract: Despite unprecedented access to information in the digital age, young citizens face growing challenges related to news consumption and misinformation. This large-scale randomized controlled trial examines the impact of two complementary interventions designed to foster media literacy and the consumption of high-quality news among high-school students, implemented in France over the 2024-25 academic year. The study involves 243 high schools (for a total number of 9,628 students), randomly assigned to a control group or to receive one or both of the following interventions: (i) a one-year free digital subscription to the leading national newspaper, and (ii) media education modules implemented by teachers. Exploiting unique data on students' actual online news consumption, we document a very large uptake of the free subscription, which translates into persistent and large increases in news consumption (+0.49 to 0.60 sd) and demand for future news, including an 8pp increase in paid subscriptions nearly a year after the intervention. We also observe a 0.20 to 0.31 sd increase in news knowledge for students enrolled in deprived schools, reducing baseline information inequality by 45-70%. Finally, we show that both free news access and media education improve media literacy skills (+0.08 to 0.26 sd), with larger effects among students taught by teachers with prior experience in media education.
url:2b082036b33c58b6.abstract_zh: 尽管数字时代信息获取空前便捷，但年轻公民在新闻消费与应对虚假信息方面仍面临日益严峻的挑战。本项大规模随机对照试验考察了两项互补性干预措施的效果——旨在培养高中生媒介素养并促进高质量新闻消费，于2024-25学年在法国实施。研究涵盖243所高中（共计9,628名学生），随机分配至对照组或接受以下一项或两项干预：（i）为期一年的全国性主流报纸免费数字订阅；（ii）由教师实施的媒介教育模块。通过利用学生实际在线新闻消费的独特数据，我们发现免费订阅的采纳率极高，这转化为新闻消费的持续大幅增长（效应量0.49至0.60个标准差）及未来新闻需求的提升，包括干预实施近一年后付费订阅率增加8个百分点。在贫困学校就读的学生中，我们还观察到新闻知识水平提升0.20至0.31个标准差，使基线信息不平等程度降低45-70%。最后，研究表明免费新闻获取与媒介教育均能提升媒介素养技能（效应量0.08至0.26个标准差），且对由具备媒介教育经验的教师授课的学生影响更大。

url:2b12d76f0e5fa9a7.abstract: Research on managerial delegation typically suggests that firms in a Cournot duopoly compete more aggressively in the product market post-delegation, causing their profits to decline. This paper investigates the profitability of delegation by incorporating a sales-delegation strategy into a spatial barbell model, where consumers are asymmetrically distributed at the two endpoints of a line segment. We find that the firm located closer to the more populated market may benefit from delegation. Notably, this occurs when the locational equilibrium shifts from agglomeration to separation following delegation. Although the firms compete more intensely under delegation, social welfare decreases when the locational equilibrium changes from separation to agglomeration and the transport rate is sufficiently high.
url:2b12d76f0e5fa9a7.abstract_zh: 关于管理授权的研究通常表明，在古诺双寡头市场中，企业授权后会在产品市场上展开更激烈的竞争，导致其利润下降。本文通过将销售授权策略引入空间杠铃模型（其中消费者非对称地分布于线段两端）来研究授权的盈利性。研究发现，位于人口更密集市场附近的企业可能从授权中获益。值得注意的是，当授权导致区位均衡从集聚转向分离时，这一现象才会出现。尽管授权下企业竞争更为激烈，但当区位均衡从分离转向集聚且运输费率足够高时，社会福利反而会下降。
url:2b12d76f0e5fa9a7.title: The profitability of managerial delegation with endogenous locations

url:2b14121f7932ae24.abstract: we estimate maturity-specific demand functions and elasticities of different investors and the Fed, and integrate them into a dynamic equilibrium model of the Treasury market with risk-averse arbitrageurs. url:2b141b18dbd653e6.abstract: This paper disentangles the roles of within-firm improvement and between-firm selection and market reallocation in determining aggregate energy intensity. Our analysis shows that selection and market reallocation play a stronger role than within-firm improvement in driving aggregate declines in energy intensity, despite the strong focus on within-firm response to climate policy measures in the existing empirical literature. We also find that these mechanisms, in particular the selection channel, can be leveraged by environmental policy.

url:2ba134a1f53ee507.abstract: This paper studies how beliefs about racial inequalities and their causes vary and shape support for race-targeted and redistribution policies among Black and white Americans, including both adults and teenagers. We collect original large-scale survey data to provide new evidence on perceptions, attitudes, and policy views on racial issues and study the causal impact of information on policy views. We highlight significant heterogeneity along racial and partisan lines in perceived racial gaps in income and mobility. Yet, the biggest discrepancies are in how people explain the existence of these gaps, i.e., their perceived causes. White Democratic and Black respondents are much more likely to attribute racial inequities to systemic factors, such as adverse past and present circumstances, and want to act on them with race-targeted and general redistribution policies. White Republicans are more likely to attribute racial gaps to individual-based factors, such as individual effort or actions. These views are already deeply entrenched in teenagers, based on their race and their parents' political affiliation. A policy decomposition shows that the perceived causes of racial inequities are the strongest predictors of support for race-targeted or redistribution policies, a finding confirmed by the experimental results.
url:2ba134a1f53ee507.abstract_zh: 本文研究了关于种族不平等及其成因的信念如何在美国黑人与白人成年人及青少年中变化，并如何影响他们对针对种族的政策及再分配政策的支持。我们收集了原创的大规模调查数据，以提供关于种族问题的认知、态度和政策观点的新证据，并研究信息对政策观点的因果影响。我们强调了在收入和流动性方面的种族差距感知中，沿着种族和党派界限存在的显著异质性。然而，最大的分歧在于人们如何解释这些差距的存在，即他们感知的成因。白人民主党受访者和黑人受访者更可能将种族不平等归因于系统性因素，如过去和现在的不利环境，并希望通过针对种族的政策和普遍再分配政策来应对。白人共和党受访者更可能将种族差距归因于个体因素，如个人努力或行为。这些观点在青少年中已根深蒂固，基于他们的种族及父母的政治归属。一项政策分解显示，感知的种族不平等成因是支持针对种族或再分配政策的最强预测因素，这一发现得到了实验结果的证实。
url:2ba134a1f53ee507.title: Perceptions of Racial Gaps, their Causes, and Ways to Reduce Them

url:2bdd277711c1f9dd.abstract: The year 2025 was unprecedented in the frequency, complexity, and volatility of US trade policy interventions. This column uses a new database tracking US tariff announcements during the year to show that confusion about the current state of tariff policy led to a decline in US imports that was similar in size to the reduction caused by tariff increases alone, meaning that confusion doubled the negative impact of tariffs. Product customisation, relationship trust, and partner reputation can help firms maintain trade activity during information shocks.
url:2bdd277711c1f9dd.abstract_zh: 2025年，美国贸易政策干预的频率、复杂性和波动性达到了前所未有的程度。本文利用一个追踪该年度美国关税公告的新数据库，表明对关税政策现状的困惑导致美国进口下降，其幅度与仅因关税上调造成的减少量相当，这意味着困惑使关税的负面影响翻倍。产品定制化、关系信任及合作伙伴声誉有助于企业在信息冲击期间维持贸易活动。
url:2bdd277711c1f9dd.title: Tariff confusion

url:2bed9463cfc911d2.abstract: It is customary to suggest that the asymmetry in the transmission of oil price shocks to real output is well established. Much of the empirical work cited as being in support of asymmetries, however, has not directly tested the hypothesis of an asymmetric transmission of oil price innovations. Moreover, many of the papers quantifying these asymmetric responses are based on censored oil price VAR models which recently have been shown to be invalid. Other studies are based on dynamic correlations in the data that do not shed light on the central question of whether the structural responses of real output triggered by positive and negative oil price innovations are asymmetric. Recently, a number of new methodologies have been introduced and applied to the problem of testing and quantifying asymmetric responses of U.S. real economic activity to positive and negative oil price innovations. Our objective is to put this literature in perspective, to contrast it with more traditional approaches, to highlight directions for further research, and to reconcile some seemingly conflicting results reported in the literature.
url:2bed9463cfc911d2.abstract_zh: 通常认为，石油价格冲击对实际产出的非对称传导已得到充分证实。然而，多数被引证支持非对称性的实证研究并未直接检验石油价格冲击的非对称传导假设。此外，许多量化这些非对称响应的论文基于经审查的石油价格VAR模型，而此类模型近期已被证明无效。另一些研究则依赖数据中的动态相关性，未能阐明核心问题——即正向与负向石油价格冲击所引发的实际产出结构性响应是否具有非对称性。近年来，一系列新方法被引入并应用于检验与量化美国实际经济活动对正负石油价格冲击的非对称响应。本文旨在系统梳理该领域文献，将其与传统方法进行对比，指出未来研究方向，并调和文献中看似矛盾的若干结论。

url:2c3d118976c474e3.abstract: The results of ballot referenda have often been used to infer the preferences of voters for various types of policy. However, voters may be influenced by the appearance of competing ballot referenda. We propose a simple theoretical framework for considering the substitutability or complementarity of various land use policies and apply this framework to a novel dataset of 603 land-related municipal ballot measures in California. We find that the appearance of a competing anti-growth measure decreases support for other anti-growth measures, while the appearance of pro-growth measures do not affect the likelihood of passage for anti-growth or pro-growth measures. JEL R52D72
url:2c3d118976c474e3.abstract_zh: 投票公投的结果常被用来推断选民对不同类型政策的偏好。然而，选民可能受到竞争性投票公投出现的影响。我们提出了一个简单的理论框架，用以考虑各种土地使用政策的可替代性或互补性，并将此框架应用于加利福尼亚州603项与土地相关的市政投票措施的新数据集。我们发现，竞争性反增长措施的出现会降低对其他反增长措施的支持，而增长促进措施的出现则不影响反增长或增长促进措施通过的可能性。JEL R52D72

url:2c3d8e326fef9053.abstract: Labour force participation among prime-aged American men has fallen for over half a century, and standard explanations leave much of the decline unaccounted for. This column combines panel and survey data to show that the labour markets these men experienced while growing up shaped their willingness to work decades later. These effects survive childhood moves across states and likely operate through men’s beliefs about whether work will pay off. If temporary downturns in labour demand can persistently influence labour supply, anchoring expectations about employment, not just inflation, may have a place in macroeconomic policy.
url:2c3d8e326fef9053.abstract_zh: 美国壮年男性劳动力参与率已持续下降逾半个世纪，而标准解释未能完全说明这一下降的原因。本专栏结合面板数据与调查数据表明，这些男性在成长过程中经历的劳动力市场状况，会影响他们数十年后的工作意愿。即便在童年跨州迁移的情况下，这种影响依然存在，且很可能通过男性对工作是否值得付出的信念发挥作用。如果劳动力需求的暂时低迷能够持续影响劳动力供给，那么锚定就业预期（而不仅仅是通胀预期）或许应在宏观经济政策中占有一席之地。

url:2ce494145e0cae43.abstract: Frontier Market (FM) status serves as a steppingstone for Low-Income Countries (LICs) aspiring to become Emerging Markets (EMs). Since the concept first emerged over three decades ago, FMs have gained substantial investment appeal, particularly after the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. At the same time, the recent series of global shocks starting with the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the countries’ persistent vulnerabilities. This paper seeks to deepen our understanding of FMs by offering new analysis on the determinants of frontier market status and, using a dynamic country sample, examining the factors that help LICs attain and lose FM status. It finds that building robust macroeconomic fundamentals and ensuring good governance are critical for becoming an FM. In addition, the paper identifies flexible exchange rates, substantial official reserve buffers, and relatively low public debt and deficit levels as key contributors to lessening the sensitivity of FMs’ sovereign spreads to changes in global financial conditions.
url:2ce494145e0cae43.abstract_zh: 前沿市场（FM）地位是低收入国家（LICs）迈向新兴市场（EMs）的跳板。自三十多年前这一概念首次提出以来，FM已获得显著的投资吸引力，尤其是在2008年全球金融危机之后。与此同时，从新冠疫情开始的一系列近期全球冲击凸显了这些国家持续存在的脆弱性。本文旨在通过提供关于前沿市场地位决定因素的新分析，并利用动态国家样本，考察帮助低收入国家获得和失去FM地位的因素，从而加深我们对FM的理解。研究发现，构建稳健的宏观经济基本面并确保良好的治理是成为FM的关键。此外，本文指出，灵活的汇率制度、充足的外汇储备缓冲、以及相对较低的公共债务和赤字水平，是降低FM主权利差对全球金融状况变化敏感性的关键因素。

url:2d14baa3af959410.abstract: This study investigates the differences between oral and written responses to open-ended survey questions. Through a series of randomized controlled trials across three surveys (focused on AI, public policy, and international relations), we assigned respondents to answer either by audio or text. Respondents who provided audio answers gave longer, though lexically simpler, responses compared to those who typed. By leveraging LLMs, we evaluated answer informativeness and found that oral responses differ in both quantity and quality, offering more information and containing more personal experiences than written responses. These findings suggest that oral responses to open-ended questions can capture richer, more personal insights, presenting a valuable method for understanding individual reasoning.
url:2d14baa3af959410.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了开放式调查问题中口头与书面回答之间的差异。通过在三项调查（聚焦于人工智能、公共政策与国际关系）中开展一系列随机对照试验，我们将受访者分配至以音频或文本方式作答。提供音频回答的受访者相较于打字者，给出了更长但词汇更简单的回答。借助大语言模型，我们评估了回答的信息量，发现口头回答在数量与质量上均有所不同，提供的信息更多，且包含更多个人经历，而非书面回答。这些发现表明，对开放式问题的口头回答能够捕捉更丰富、更个人化的见解，为理解个体推理提供了一种有价值的方法。

url:2d24ae3b237e67b0.abstract: Focus We examine how geopolitical risks affect sovereign risk premia for emerging market economies (EMEs). url:2d4686f0a1929d0e.abstract: Does limiting the largest firm's capacity always lower prices? We model firms competing in supply schedules with multiple technologies, each with constant marginal cost up to capacity. In a tractable model, in which capacity and technological efficiency coexist as distinct sources of market power, we find that when the largest firm leads by efficiency, a small transfer of higher‑cost capacity to the leader raises concentration yet lowers prices, contrary to standard antitrust intuition. Larger transfers raise prices, restoring standard intuition and tracing a non‑monotone price‑concentration relation. We prove existence and uniqueness of equilibrium, derive closed‑form conditions for when transfers raise or lower prices, and extend the results to other oligopoly models. Evidence from Colombia's wholesale electricity market, where weather shocks shift hydropower capacity across technology‑diversified firms, supports the pattern. Counterfactual transfers lower prices up to 30% in the least concentrated markets. We draw implications for capacity caps, divestitures, and mergers.
url:2d4686f0a1929d0e.abstract_zh: 限制最大企业的产能是否总能降低价格？我们构建了一个多技术、每项技术具有恒定边际成本直至产能上限的企业在供给曲线上竞争的模型。在一个可处理的模型中，产能与技术效率并存作为市场势力的不同来源，我们发现，当最大企业凭借效率领先时，将较高成本产能小幅转移给该领导者会提高集中度，却降低价格，这与标准反垄断直觉相悖。较大规模的转移则会推高价格，恢复标准直觉，并描绘出价格与集中度之间的非单调关系。我们证明了均衡的存在性与唯一性，推导出转移提高或降低价格的闭式条件，并将结果推广至其他寡头垄断模型。来自哥伦比亚批发电力市场的证据支持了这一模式，其中天气冲击在不同技术多元化的企业间转移水电产能。反事实转移在集中度最低的市场中可使价格降低高达30%。我们据此对产能上限、资产剥离和并购提出了启示。
url:2d4686f0a1929d0e.title: Capacity, Technology Portfolios, and the Paradox of Concentration
url:2d4686f0a1929d0e.title_zh: 产能、技术组合与集中悖论

url:2d46f6cca7591c96.abstract: Cross-cultural databases are bounded by expert coding and missing observations. The Ethnographic Atlas (EA) codes 1,265 societies on 104 variables, with about 960 societies observed per variable on average, and the Standard Cross-Cultural Sample (SCCS) codes 186 societies on 1,717 variables, with about 105 observed per variable. I use a large language model and the 2,564-motif Berezkin catalogue to extract coverage, what motifs discuss, and stance, what positions they take. Stance, what a motif says, is strongest. Across 26 researcher-designed dimensions, stance is multidimensional (leading component 15.1%, matching ethnographic data) and largely independent of the coverage complexity gradient. On the two dimensions with direct human benchmarks, stance agrees on whether challenged characters succeed (kappa = 0.64) and whether antisocial behavior succeeds or is punished (kappa = 0.49), near the strongest available human benchmark of kappa about 0.57. Among 20 dimensions with no database equivalent, 18 have reliable group-level stance ratios across three runs (ICC >= 0.5$). Nine stance-outcome links survive continent fixed effects, false-discovery correction, and a complexity control, led by outsiders contact for lower GDP and emotional expression for higher female labor participation. Coverage succeeds differently. Across 1,805 usable codebook concepts, coverage predicts 65 of 88 EA variables and detects signal in 35 of 46 pooled SCCS domains, but this information concentrates in one factor. The first principal component explains 43% of score variance versus 15% in EA data, and the resulting complexity index predicts GDP within continents (R^2 = 0.55). Folklore measurement is one-dimensional only when the question is coverage. Researcher-defined concepts become measurable across 958 societies for $0.03 to $1.70.
url:2d46f6cca7591c96.abstract_zh: 跨文化数据库受限于专家编码与观测缺失。《民族志图谱》（EA）对1265个社会的104个变量进行编码，平均每个变量约960个观测值；《标准跨文化样本》（SCCS）对186个社会的1717个变量进行编码，平均每个变量约105个观测值。我利用大语言模型与包含2564个母题的别列兹金目录，提取了覆盖范围（即母题讨论的内容）与立场（即母题所持的立场）。其中，立场（即母题表述的内容）最为显著。在26个研究者设计的维度中，立场呈现多维性（主成分解释方差15.1%，与民族志数据匹配），且基本独立于覆盖范围的复杂度梯度。在具有直接人类基准的两个维度上，立场在受挑战角色是否成功（kappa=0.64）以及反社会行为是否成功或受惩罚（kappa=0.49）上达成一致，接近现有最强人类基准（kappa约0.57）。在20个无数据库对应维度的维度中，18个维度在三次运行中具有可靠的群体层面立场比率（ICC≥0.5）。九个立场-结果关联在控制大陆固定效应、错误发现率校正及复杂度控制后依然显著，其中外部接触与较低GDP、情感表达与较高女性劳动参与率关联最强。覆盖范围则以不同方式发挥作用。在1805个可用编码手册概念中，覆盖范围预测了88个EA变量中的65个，并在46个合并SCCS领域中的35个中检测到信号，但这一信息集中于单一因子。第一主成分解释43%的得分方差（EA数据中为15%），由此产生的复杂度指数可预测大陆内部的GDP（R²=0.55）。只有当问题聚焦于覆盖范围时，民俗测量才呈现单维性。研究者定义的概念可在958个社会中以0.03至1.70美元的成本实现可测量性。
url:2d46f6cca7591c96.title: What Oral Traditions Are About and What They Say

url:2d5dea10b23876f5.abstract: Public K–12 systems legally require children to attend a large number of instructional hours each year, but official budgets recognize only the cost of adult labor. This creates an accounting puzzle: is there any fiscal object that explicitly values student time? We propose a framework to quantify this fiscal nonrecognition. We define Compulsory Student Hours (CSH) as the total mandated student time, where CSH = Σᵢ EᵢHᵢwᵢ, Eᵢ is enrollment in group i, Hᵢ is required hours per year for group i, and wᵢ is a compulsion weight. We impute a dollar value, Imputed Student Time Value (ISTV), by multiplying CSH by an hourly benchmark V. We identify any actual Recognized Student-Time Dollars (RSD), defined as direct payments to students for required attendance, and compute the Student Time Recognition Rate (STRR), where STRR = RSD/ISTV. Using national data of approximately 49.2 million public K–12 students, roughly 1, 000 statutory hours per year, and a conservative federal minimum-wage benchmark of $7.25 per hour, the resulting ISTV is on the order of $3.57 × 10¹¹. In ordinary public finance there are effectively no direct student-time payments, yielding STRR ≈ 0. These are order-of-magnitude illustrations: if H = 1, 080 or V = $15, ISTV rises, but RSD remains approximately zero. The results highlight a stark asymmetry: schools’ budgets explicitly account for teacher and staff time, but institutionally required student time has virtually no direct fiscal counterpart. This is a descriptive accounting exercise, not a claim that students are owed wages or a policy proposal. The contribution is a neutral, replicable method for measuring the gap between adult labor accounting and student-time accounting in K–12 finance.
url:2d5dea10b23876f5.abstract_zh: 公立K–12系统依法要求儿童每年完成大量教学时数，但官方预算仅承认成人劳动力的成本。这产生了一个会计谜题：是否存在明确评估学生时间价值的财政对象？我们提出一个量化这种财政不承认现象的框架。将强制性学生时数（CSH）定义为法定要求的学生总时间，其中CSH = Σᵢ EᵢHᵢwᵢ，Eᵢ为第i组学生注册人数，Hᵢ为第i组学生每年要求时数，wᵢ为强制权重。通过将CSH乘以每小时基准值V，估算出隐含学生时间价值（ISTV）。我们识别任何实际存在的学生时间认可美元（RSD），即因要求出勤而直接支付给学生的款项，并计算学生时间认可率（STRR），其中STRR = RSD/ISTV。基于全国约4920万公立K–12学生数据、每年约1000法定学时以及保守的联邦最低工资基准7.25美元/小时，估算出的ISTV约为3.57×10¹¹美元。在常规公共财政中，实际上不存在直接的学生时间支付，因此STRR≈0。这些是数量级示例：若H=1080或V=15美元，ISTV上升，但RSD仍近似为零。结果凸显出显著的不对称性：学校预算明确核算教师和员工时间，但制度性要求学生时间几乎无直接财政对应项。这是一项描述性会计练习，并非主张学生应获工资或政策建议。其贡献在于提供一种中立、可复制的方法，用于衡量K–12财政中成人劳动核算与学生时间核算之间的差距。
url:2d5dea10b23876f5.title: Fiscal Nonrecognition of Student Time: Measuring Compulsory Student Hours in U.S. Public K–12 Education
url:2d5dea10b23876f5.title_zh: 学生时间的财政不承认：衡量美国公立K-12教育中的强制性学生学时

url:2d61ad738c392f0f.abstract: This paper analyses U.S. secured repo spreads by jointly looking into reserves, dealer balance-sheet usage, hedge fund leverage, and Treasury issuance. Using a quantile regression framework, the results show that repo market dynamics are strongly state-dependent. Higher level of reserves consistently compress repo spreads to the Federal Reserve’s overninght reverse repo offering rate and remain the primary stabilizing force, particularly in tighter funding conditions. Hedge fund activity appears to amplify dealer balance-sheet pressures in lower quantiles, reflecting the impact of leveraged demand in normal markets. As spreads rise, this effect weakens. Instead, heavier Treasury issuance appears to weigh on repo spreads via its stronger effect on dealer balance sheet pressures. Overall, U.S. repo spreads are affected by the supply of central bank liquidity, demand for leverage, Treasury issuance and intermediary capacity. Crucially, these drivers are not equally relevant across the distribution of funding conditions.
url:2d61ad738c392f0f.abstract_zh: 本文通过联合考察准备金、交易商资产负债表使用情况、对冲基金杠杆率及国债发行，分析了美国有担保回购利差。基于分位数回归框架的研究结果表明，回购市场动态具有显著的状态依赖性。较高的准备金水平持续压缩回购利差至美联储隔夜逆回购利率，并始终是主要的稳定力量，尤其在融资条件趋紧时更为显著。对冲基金活动在较低分位数上会放大交易商资产负债表压力，反映出正常市场中杠杆需求的影响。随着利差上升，这一效应逐渐减弱。相反，国债发行增加通过加剧交易商资产负债表压力，对回购利差产生更大影响。总体而言，美国回购利差受到央行流动性供给、杠杆需求、国债发行及中介能力的共同影响。关键在于，这些驱动因素在融资条件分布的不同区间内并非同等重要。
url:2d61ad738c392f0f.title: Repo Rate Dynamics: The Role of Dealers, Hedge Funds, and Issuance
url:2d61ad738c392f0f.title_zh: 回购利率动态：交易商、对冲基金与发行量的作用

url:2dc16aef35c17145.title_zh: 人们为何对股价驱动因素存在分歧

url:2dce7b3d3d3a83b8.abstract: Using UK longitudinal data on dual-earner couples, this paper estimates a model of intrahousehold housework decisions, which combines a randomized experimental framework eliciting counterfactual choices with gender norms differences across ethnicities and cohorts to identify the impacts of individual preferences and gender identity norms. Equal sharing of tasks yields greater utility for both men and women, with women disliking domestic chores as much as men. Although couples would want to use housework arrangements to compensate for differentials in labor market involvement, women end up performing a substantially larger share of housework. This is not due to specialization, rather social norms play a key role. Exposure to more egalitarian gender attitudes significantly increases the probability of choosing an equal share of housework. Were attitudes evened up to the most progressive levels observed in the sample, women doing more housework than their partners would stop to be the norm already among present-day households, except for households with children.
url:2dce7b3d3d3a83b8.abstract_zh: 本文利用英国双职工夫妇的纵向数据，估计了一个家庭内家务劳动决策模型，该模型结合了引出反事实选择的随机实验框架与不同种族和世代间的性别规范差异，以识别个人偏好和性别认同规范的影响。家务劳动的平等分担对男性和女性均带来更高的效用，且女性对家务劳动的厌恶程度与男性相当。尽管夫妇倾向于利用家务安排来补偿劳动力市场参与的差异，但女性最终承担了显著更大份额的家务劳动。这并非源于专业化分工，而是社会规范发挥了关键作用。接触更平等的性别态度显著提高了选择平等分担家务的概率。若态度提升至样本中观察到的最进步水平，女性承担多于伴侣家务的现象在当今家庭中将不再成为常态，但育有子女的家庭除外。
url:2dce7b3d3d3a83b8.title: Dividing Housework between Partners: Individual Preferences and Social Norms
url:2dce7b3d3d3a83b8.title_zh: 伴侣间家务分工：个人偏好与社会规范

url:2dd74b54f6455a09.abstract: Since 2010, a growing proportion of doctoral graduates have been taking jobs outside academia. This column explores where elite early-career economists work, using a dataset covering all PhD graduates from US economics programmes. The findings revealt that recent elite PhD graduates are more likely to leave academia, to take jobs outside the US, and to be absorbed by a tech sector that draws broadly across gender, ethnicity, and programme prestige. However, East Asian candidates continue to face a substantial penalty in access to top academic positions. Within academia, elite advisor networks continue to confer advantages, reinforcing stratification at the top.
url:2dd74b54f6455a09.abstract_zh: 自2010年以来，越来越多的博士毕业生选择在学术界之外就业。本文利用涵盖美国经济学项目所有博士毕业生的数据集，探讨了精英早期职业经济学家的就业去向。研究发现，近年来，精英博士毕业生更倾向于离开学术界，前往美国以外地区工作，并被科技行业广泛吸纳，这一趋势跨越了性别、种族及项目声望的界限。然而，东亚候选人在获取顶尖学术职位方面仍面临显著劣势。在学术界内部，精英导师网络持续带来优势，加剧了顶层的分层现象。
url:2dd74b54f6455a09.title: Expanding opportunities: Economics PhD placement in the 21st century
url:2dd74b54f6455a09.title_zh: 扩大机会：21世纪经济学博士就业去向
