url:3568a9f9f686ce59.abstract: We develop a general-equilibrium model of the global economy that integrates heterogeneous firms competing in product markets with countries that allocate capital around the world. Combining a hedonic demand system on the product side with a mean-variance portfolio system on the asset side, we obtain almost closed-form solutions for the equilibrium of the model. We use firm-level data on balance sheets, geographic breakdowns of revenue and employment, and business descriptions along with country-level data on bilateral equity holdings and trade costs to quantify the model to a cross section of roughly 23,000 listed firms in 48 countries. We use the model to evaluate the reallocation and welfare effects of globalization. Both financial and trade liberalization concentrate activity among the largest firms and raise welfare, with gains being larger in emerging and mid-sized open economies respectively. Product- and capital-market frictions amplify each other, meaning that liberalizing one market reduces the gains from liberalizing the other.
url:3568a9f9f686ce59.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个全球经济的总体均衡模型，该模型将产品市场中竞争的异质性企业与在全球范围内配置资本的国家相结合。通过在产品侧结合享乐需求系统，在资产侧结合均值-方差投资组合系统，我们得到了模型均衡的近似闭式解。我们利用企业层面的资产负债表数据、收入和就业的地理分布、业务描述，以及国家层面的双边股权持有和贸易成本数据，将模型量化应用于48个国家约23,000家上市公司的横截面数据。我们运用该模型评估全球化带来的重新配置和福利效应。金融和贸易自由化均使活动集中于规模最大的企业，并提升福利，其中新兴经济体和中型开放经济体分别获得更大的收益。产品市场和资本市场的摩擦相互放大，意味着对其中一个市场的自由化会减少另一个市场自由化带来的收益。
url:3568a9f9f686ce59.title: DP21878 A Model of Global Firms and Capital Markets
url:3568a9f9f686ce59.title_zh: DP21878 全球企业与资本市场模型

url:357886da09f9b9e5.abstract: Over the past two decades, many emerging market economies have become more resilient to external financial shocks. This paper assesses whether such resilience is broadly shared across emerging markets and developing economies by classifying them into three tiers based on economic size, income level, institutional strength, and financial integration. The analysis shows that first-tier emerging markets and developing economies have improved their external balance sheets and reduced dependence on official support. However, second- and third-tier emerging markets and developing economies have experienced growing external vulnerabilities since the global financial crisis, marked by rising external debt liabilities and declining foreign exchange reserves. Using a range of indicators, including sovereign defaults, arrears, partial defaults, and International Monetary Fund lending, the paper identifies episodes of external financial distress and shows that distress remains widespread among second- and third-tier emerging markets and developing economies. The empirical analysis confirms that key components of the net international investment position - especially external debt and foreign exchange reserves - predict the onset of external financial distress, with institutional quality shaping the impact. Weak institutions amplify risks, while strong institutions mitigate them. These findings highlight the importance of recognizing heterogeneity across emerging markets and developing economies, strengthening institutional quality alongside external balance-sheet management, and rebuilding buffers to safeguard against renewed global financial stress.
url:357886da09f9b9e5.abstract_zh: 过去二十年，许多新兴市场经济体对外部金融冲击的抵御能力有所增强。本文根据经济规模、收入水平、制度实力和金融一体化程度，将新兴市场和发展中经济体分为三个层级，评估这种韧性是否广泛分布于各层级经济体。分析表明，第一层级新兴市场和发展中经济体改善了外部资产负债表，并减少了对官方支持的依赖。然而，自全球金融危机以来，第二和第三层级新兴市场和发展中经济体的外部脆弱性持续加剧，表现为外债负债上升和外汇储备下降。通过运用主权违约、拖欠、部分违约及国际货币基金组织贷款等一系列指标，本文识别了外部金融困境事件，并发现困境在第二和第三层级新兴市场和发展中经济体中依然普遍存在。实证分析证实，净国际投资头寸的关键组成部分——尤其是外债和外汇储备——能够预测外部金融困境的发生，而制度质量则影响这一作用机制。薄弱的制度会放大风险，而强大的制度则能缓解风险。这些发现凸显了认识新兴市场和发展中经济体异质性的重要性，强调了在加强外部资产负债表管理的同时提升制度质量，并重建缓冲以防范新一轮全球金融压力的必要性。
url:357886da09f9b9e5.title: External Finance in Emerging Markets and Developing Economies: A Tale of Differences in Vulnerabilities
url:357886da09f9b9e5.title_zh: 新兴市场与发展中经济体的外部融资：脆弱性差异的启示

url:3581ca2a7da94ea6.abstract: When an intermediary procures services for end users and receives a commission from the provider, a tension arises: procurement designs that more effectively extract provider rents can simultaneously raise prices and reduce total surplus. We formalize this commission paradox in a first-score auction model and estimate the model using procurement data from the prison telecommunications industry. The paradox emerges empirically, as commissions reduce provider rents but raise call rates. We also find that when commissions enter the scoring rule, increased competition among providers raises payments to the correctional authority but does not lower rates. Banning commissions restores the link between competition and lower rates. Our estimates indicate that recent federal regulations banning commissions and capping rates would lower costs for incarcerated individuals while preserving provider profitability.
url:3581ca2a7da94ea6.abstract_zh: 当中间商为终端用户采购服务并从服务提供商处获取佣金时，便会产生一种矛盾：更有效提取服务提供商租金的采购设计，可能同时推高价格并减少总剩余。我们通过首分拍卖模型对这一佣金悖论进行形式化建模，并利用监狱电信行业的采购数据进行模型估计。实证结果表明该悖论确实存在——佣金虽降低了服务提供商的租金，却推高了通话费率。我们还发现，当佣金被纳入评分规则时，服务提供商之间的竞争加剧虽能提高惩教机构的收入，但并未降低通话费率。禁止佣金制度则能恢复竞争与费率下降之间的关联。估算显示，近期联邦法规禁止佣金并设定费率上限，将在保障服务提供商盈利能力的同时，降低被监禁人员的通话成本。
url:3581ca2a7da94ea6.title: DP21635 The Commission Paradox: Evidence from Prison Telecommunications
url:3581ca2a7da94ea6.title_zh: DP21635 委员会悖论：来自监狱电信的证据

url:3582438d1b5f0856.abstract: GLP-1 medications generate large weight loss and may also alter social and economic outcomes. Using the Understanding America Study, I compare women starting GLP-1s for weight loss with matched women who would like to start a GLP-1 but have not. Single women’s marriage/cohabitation rates rise by 29 percentage points and employment among baseline non-employed women rises 27 percentage points after six or more quarters. Existing partnerships do not dissolve, and already-employed women show no upward job mobility. The pattern suggests that part of the female obesity penalty operates at new-match formation rather than only through health or incumbent productivity.
url:3582438d1b5f0856.abstract_zh: GLP-1药物能带来显著的体重下降，并可能同时改变社会与经济结果。利用“理解美国研究”数据，我将开始使用GLP-1进行减肥的女性与匹配的、有意愿但尚未开始使用GLP-1的女性进行比较。在六个季度或更长时间后，单身女性的结婚/同居率上升了29个百分点，基线时未就业女性的就业率上升了27个百分点。现有伴侣关系并未解体，而已就业女性未表现出向上的职业流动性。这一模式表明，女性肥胖惩罚的一部分作用于新匹配的形成过程，而非仅通过健康或现有员工生产力发挥作用。
url:3582438d1b5f0856.title: GLP-1–Induced Weight Loss and the Female Obesity Penalty
url:3582438d1b5f0856.title_zh: GLP-1诱导的体重减轻与女性肥胖惩罚

url:35bac9754b1326ed.abstract: Cooperative game theory has proposed different notions of powerful players. For example, big-boss games (Muto et al. 1988 On Big Boss Games. In: The economic studies quarterly 39.4:303–321")) and clan games (Potters et al. 1989 Clan Games. In: Games and Economic Behavior 1.3:275–293")) are particular cases of veto games (Bahel 2016 On the Core and Bargaining Set of a Veto Game. In: International Journal of Game Theory 45.3:543–566")). The present paper extends these veto games by assuming that there is a given subset of powerful (or essential) players, but only a few (as opposed to all) essential players are required for a coalition to have a positive group value. The resulting games, which are called r -essential games, encompass convex games (Shapley 1971 Cores of Convex Games. In: International Journal of Game Theory 1.1:11–26")) and veto games. We show that r -essential games have a nonempty core. We give a recursive description of the core. Moreover, it is shown that the core and the bargaining set are equivalent for r -essential games. An application to networks is provided. Similar content being viewed by others
url:35bac9754b1326ed.abstract_zh: 合作博弈理论提出了多种关于强有力参与者的概念。例如，大老板博弈（Muto等，1988，《论大老板博弈》，载于《经济研究季刊》第39卷第4期，第303-321页）和宗族博弈（Potters等，1989，《宗族博弈》，载于《博弈与经济行为》第1卷第3期，第275-293页）是否决博弈（Bahel，2016，《否决博弈的核心与谈判集》，载于《国际博弈论杂志》第45卷第3期，第543-566页）的特例。本文通过假设存在一个给定的强有力（或关键）参与者子集，但仅需少数（而非全部）关键参与者即可使联盟具有正群体价值，从而扩展了这些否决博弈。由此产生的博弈被称为r-关键博弈，它涵盖了凸博弈（Shapley，1971，《凸博弈的核心》，载于《国际博弈论杂志》第1卷第1期，第11-26页）和否决博弈。我们证明r-关键博弈具有非空核心，并给出了核心的递归描述。此外，研究表明对于r-关键博弈，核心与谈判集是等价的。本文还提供了在网络中的应用。
url:35bac9754b1326ed.title: Essentiality of degree

url:35c658e34fe1be86.abstract: Stablecoin transfers are often interpreted as payments. On programmable blockchains, however, they are frequently embedded in atomically executed transaction bundles that combine trading, lending, arbitrage, liquidity provision, and settlement. We show that ignoring this structure materially distorts the interpretation of stablecoin activity. Using 593 million event logs from 141 million Ethereum transactions involving three major U.S. dollar stablecoins, we develop a replicable framework to measure transaction complexity from archive node data, public contract labels, and event signatures.
url:35c658e34fe1be86.abstract_zh: 稳定币转账常被解读为支付行为。然而，在可编程区块链上，这些转账往往嵌入在原子化执行的交易包中，这些交易包整合了交易、借贷、套利、流动性提供和结算等功能。我们证明，忽略这一结构会严重扭曲对稳定币活动的解读。通过分析涉及三种主要美元稳定币的1.41亿笔以太坊交易中的5.93亿条事件日志，我们开发了一个可复制的框架，利用归档节点数据、公开合约标签和事件签名来衡量交易复杂性。
url:35c658e34fe1be86.title: The anatomy of stablecoin transactions

url:364c85eac3884884.abstract: During the 19th century, colonial empires expanded substantially, with at their heart flourishing trade relationships between the imperial power and its colonies. Notably, imperial powers adopted distinct commercial strategies: while some pursued an ``open door'' policy, others implemented preferential tariff regimes. This paper introduces the first comprehensive dataset documenting the trade policies of the major colonial empires from 1815 to 1960. We develop a theoretical framework that identifies three central determinants of these policies: inter--imperial competition, the progressive extension of the franchise in the imperial power and variation in imperial institutional structure. We then evaluate the model's predictions using the newly assembled dataset, and find robust empirical support for its key implications.
url:364c85eac3884884.abstract_zh: 19世纪，殖民帝国大幅扩张，其核心是帝国与其殖民地之间繁荣的贸易关系。值得注意的是，帝国列强采取了截然不同的商业策略：一些国家奉行“门户开放”政策，而另一些则实施特惠关税制度。本文首次构建了涵盖1815年至1960年主要殖民帝国贸易政策的全面数据集。我们提出了一个理论框架，识别出这些政策的三个核心决定因素：帝国间竞争、帝国本土选举权的逐步扩大以及帝国制度结构的差异。随后，我们利用新整理的数据集评估了模型的预测，并发现其关键推论得到了稳健的实证支持。

url:36d5d668595efa41.abstract: The period after the Global Financial Crisis (GFC) was characterized by a considerable risk migration within global liquidity flows, away from cross-border bank lending towards international bond issuance. We show that the post-GFC shifts in the risk sensitivities of global liquidity flows are related to the tightness of the balance sheet (capital and leverage) constraints faced by international (bank and non-bank) lenders and to the migration of borrowers across funding sources. We document that the risk sensitivity of global liquidity flows is higher when funding is provided by financial intermediaries that are facing greater balance sheet constraints. We also provide evidence that the post-GFC migration of borrowers from cross-border loans to international debt securities was associated with a decline in the risk sensitivity of global liquidity flows to EME borrowers.
url:36d5d668595efa41.abstract_zh: 全球金融危机（GFC）之后的时期，全球流动性流动中出现了显著的风险迁移，从跨境银行贷款转向国际债券发行。我们表明，后金融危机时期全球流动性流动风险敏感性的变化，与国际（银行和非银行）贷款机构面临的资产负债表（资本和杠杆）约束的紧密度以及借款人在不同融资来源之间的迁移有关。我们记录了当资金由面临更大资产负债表约束的金融中介提供时，全球流动性流动的风险敏感性更高。我们还提供了证据表明，后金融危机时期借款人从跨境贷款向国际债务证券的迁移，与全球流动性流动对新兴市场经济体（EME）借款人风险敏感性的下降相关联。

url:37051e0614ad369b.abstract: We explore the effects of early life income shocks on human capital using oil price fluctuations in a large sample of relevant African countries and employing micro data from multiple waves of the Demographic and Health Survey (DHS). Such shocks enable human capital investment via the standard income effect; but also crowd it out because of substitutability between natural resource and human capital income sources. The relative strength of the two effects depends on the age at which the shock is experienced. Consistent with these insights, we find that income shocks in early life are associated with enhanced educational attainment and wealth but are sometimes linked to reduced levels of such outcomes if experienced in adolescence. These results survive multiple robustness checks, and their broader implications are discussed.
url:37051e0614ad369b.abstract_zh: 我们利用多个非洲相关国家的大样本数据及人口与健康调查（DHS）多轮微观数据，探讨了早期生命阶段收入冲击对人力资本的影响，这些冲击源于石油价格波动。此类冲击通过标准的收入效应促进人力资本投资；但同时，由于自然资源与人力资本收入来源之间的可替代性，也可能挤出这种投资。两种效应的相对强度取决于冲击发生的年龄阶段。与这些见解一致，我们发现，早期生命中的收入冲击与教育成就和财富的提升相关联，但若在青春期经历，有时则与这些结果的降低有关。这些结果通过了多项稳健性检验，并讨论了其更广泛的意义。

url:3716b1b17e3e9948.abstract: This paper examines how bank behavior contributes to capital misallocation from the supply side, leveraging China's 2008 fiscal stimulus as a quasi-experimental setting. Using proprietary loan-level data from a major state-owned bank, we document systematic credit misallocation favoring state-owned enterprises (SOEs) over private firms. Following the stimulus announcement, the bank reduced interest rates significantly more for SOEs than for comparable private enterprises-a differential reduction of 0.36 standard deviations-despite SOEs exhibiting higher default rates and unchanged credit ratings. We identify the mechanism as a loosening of risk-based pricing: interest rates became less sensitive to internal credit ratings for SOEs. This risk-based pricing misallocation largely relates to the industrial policy in supporting government-preferred industries. Notably, no such distortion appears in bankers' acceptances, a less-regulated shadow banking activity, suggesting policy intervention-not financial frictions-drives the observed misallocation. Our findings provide direct micro-level evidence on how government directives and industrial policy induce capital misallocation through weakened credit risk management in state-owned banks.
url:3716b1b17e3e9948.abstract_zh: 本文利用中国2008年财政刺激政策作为准自然实验，从供给侧探讨银行行为如何导致资本错配。基于一家大型国有银行的专有贷款数据，我们记录了系统性信贷错配现象，即信贷资源偏向国有企业而非私营企业。在刺激政策宣布后，该银行对国有企业的利率下调幅度显著大于可比私营企业——差异达0.36个标准差——尽管国有企业违约率更高且信用评级未变。我们识别出的机制是风险定价的放松：国有企业的利率对内部信用评级的敏感度下降。这种风险定价错配在很大程度上与支持政府偏好产业的产业政策相关。值得注意的是，在银行承兑汇票（一种监管较少的影子银行活动）中并未出现此类扭曲，这表明政策干预而非金融摩擦驱动了所观察到的错配现象。我们的研究为政府指令和产业政策如何通过削弱国有银行信用风险管理而导致资本错配提供了直接的微观层面证据。

url:37b89b0fb9eef3d9.abstract: We provide direct evidence on how the public expects the government to satisfy its intertemporal budget constraint. In a representative survey of U.S. households, respondents expect only 45% of government debt to be financed by future primary surpluses and 23% to be rolled over indefinitely without ever generating surpluses, as if sustained by a bubble. Experts perceive an even larger bubble (37%). Beliefs respond to fundamentals: at a debt-to-GDP ratio of 150%, the perceived bubble shrinks to 15%. A New Keynesian model calibrated to these beliefs implies a 13% larger government spending multiplier.
url:37b89b0fb9eef3d9.abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于公众如何预期政府满足其跨期预算约束的直接证据。在一项具有代表性的美国家庭调查中，受访者预期仅有45%的政府债务将由未来基本盈余融资，而23%的债务将被无限期滚动而不产生任何盈余，仿佛由泡沫支撑。专家感知到的泡沫更大（37%）。信念对基本面因素有所反应：当债务与GDP之比达到150%时，感知到的泡沫缩小至15%。一个根据这些信念校准的新凯恩斯模型显示，政府支出乘数将增加13%。

url:37dc1d2082d13926.abstract: This paper develops a framework to analyze partial population experiments, a generalization of the cluster experimental design where clusters are assigned to different treatment intensities. The framework allows for heterogeneity in cluster sizes and outcome distributions. The paper studies the large-sample behavior of OLS estimators and cluster-robust variance estimators and shows that (i) ignoring cluster heterogeneity may result in severely underpowered experiments and (ii) the cluster-robust variance estimator may be upward-biased when clusters are heterogeneous. The paper derives formulas for power, minimum detectable effects, and optimal cluster assignment probabilities. All the results apply to cluster experiments, a particular case of the framework. The paper sets up a potential outcomes framework to interpret the OLS estimands as causal effects. It implements the methods in a large-scale experiment to estimate the direct and spillover effects of a communication campaign on property tax compliance. The analysis reveals an increase in tax compliance among individuals directly targeted with the mailing, as well as compliance spillovers on untreated individuals in clusters with a high proportion of treated taxpayers.
url:37dc1d2082d13926.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析部分总体实验的框架，这是对聚类实验设计的一种推广，其中聚类被分配至不同的处理强度。该框架允许聚类规模与结果分布存在异质性。本文研究了OLS估计量及聚类稳健方差估计量的大样本性质，并表明：（i）忽略聚类异质性可能导致实验统计功效严重不足；（ii）当聚类存在异质性时，聚类稳健方差估计量可能存在向上偏误。本文推导了统计功效、最小可检测效应及最优聚类分配概率的公式。所有结论均适用于聚类实验（该框架的一个特例）。本文构建了一个潜在结果框架，将OLS估计量解释为因果效应。通过一项大规模实验实施该方法，用以估计通信宣传对财产税合规性的直接效应与溢出效应。分析显示，直接收到邮件的个体税收合规性有所提升，且在受处理纳税人比例较高的聚类中，未受处理的个体也出现了合规性溢出效应。

url:37e3ccecf148eb7b.abstract: Governments in resource-rich countries may use a sizable share of the revenue from their underground wealth to buy support through public employment. This occurs in both democratic governments (which need to be re-elected) and autocratic governments (which have to prevent riots and regime change). Using the Worldwide Bureaucracy Indicators dataset provided by the World Bank, we analyse the effect of natural resources on public employment in developing countries from 2000 to 2018. We find that resource rents may have an effect on public sector characteristics. However, uncovering the heterogeneous effects of different types of natural resources, we find that oil and gas wealth may increase public employment in countries that are not fully democratic, while forest wealth has a positive impact for all values of democracy. At the same time, the public sector wage premium is positively affected by oil and forest in non-democratic countries and by gas when the level of democracy is very high.
url:37e3ccecf148eb7b.abstract_zh: 资源丰富的国家政府可能会利用其地下财富带来的可观收入，通过公共就业来购买支持。这种现象既出现在民主政府（需寻求连任）中，也出现在专制政府（需防止骚乱与政权更迭）中。利用世界银行提供的全球官僚体系指标数据集，我们分析了2000年至2018年间自然资源对发展中国家公共就业的影响。我们发现，资源租金可能对公共部门特征产生影响。然而，通过揭示不同类型自然资源的异质性效应，我们发现石油和天然气财富可能增加非完全民主国家的公共就业，而森林财富对所有民主程度的国家均有积极影响。同时，公共部门的工资溢价在非民主国家中受到石油和森林资源的正向影响，而在民主程度极高时，则受到天然气资源的正向影响。

url:380dafe726068e48.abstract: this study, we develop a concept of sustainability focusing on the controllability of public finances. In so doing, we adopt the approach of the Maastricht Treaty, to assume sustainability as long as a country does not violate the double standards of the deficit (3%) and the debt (60% of GDP) criterion. When the benign assumption does not hold, we distinguish between the symptoms of non-sustainability of public finances, which can be determined in a relatively straightforward way, and the underlying institutional causes, which are more difficult to identify. Correcting the symptoms requires a disaggregate view of the government budget. Successful consolidation requires the fiscal policy problem to be addressed ?at the source?, i.e. the adjustment of those items of the government budget that produced the build-up of a non-sustainable deficit in the first place. Lasting consolidation also requires a correction of the institutional weaknesses that are the ultimate causes of a non-sustainable deficit. After reviewing the theoretical and empirical arguments for a disaggregate and institutions-oriented approach to correcting non-sustainable deficits, we propose a practical procedure to assess the sustainability of a country?s public finances.
url:380dafe726068e48.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种聚焦于公共财政可控性的可持续性概念。为此，我们采用《马斯特里赫特条约》的分析框架，将可持续性定义为：只要一国未违反赤字（占GDP的3%）与债务（占GDP的60%）双重标准，即视为具备可持续性。当这一良性假设不成立时，我们需区分公共财政不可持续性的两类表征：一类是可通过相对直接方式判定的症状，另一类则是更难以识别的深层制度性成因。纠正症状需要对政府预算进行分项审视。成功的财政整顿要求从源头解决财政政策问题，即首先调整那些导致不可持续性赤字累积的政府预算项目。持久的财政整顿还需修正作为不可持续性赤字根本诱因的制度缺陷。在梳理以分项分析与制度导向方法纠正不可持续性赤字问题的理论与实证依据后，本文提出了一套评估一国公共财政可持续性的实践操作流程。
url:380dafe726068e48.title: Sustainability of Public Finances

url:384e1d7be23c7f0a.abstract: Housing shortages and rising rents have become a source of political pressure in many countries, prompting calls for stronger intervention in rental markets. This column shows that the effects of such intervention can outlast the policy itself: in Berlin, the 2020 rent cap was followed by continued debate over expropriation and further regulation, and the city’s price-rent ratio remained 10%–15% below trend even three years after repeal. The findings suggest that credible threats of future intervention can depress housing valuations, alter market structure, and weaken construction activity even when no regulation is currently in force.
url:384e1d7be23c7f0a.abstract_zh: 住房短缺与租金上涨已成为多国政治压力的来源，促使人们呼吁对租赁市场进行更强有力的干预。本专栏指出，此类干预的影响可能比政策本身更为持久：在柏林，2020年的租金上限政策之后，关于征用和进一步监管的讨论持续不断，即便在政策废除三年后，该市的房价租金比仍低于趋势水平10%至15%。研究结果表明，即使当前没有实施任何监管，未来干预的可信威胁也能压低住房估值、改变市场结构，并削弱建设活动。

url:387fbd24a96700b9.abstract: This paper uses barcode-level price data for 16 advanced and emerging market countries over the period 2005–2022 to investigate the role of individual firms and product categories in aggregate inflation. We decompose inflation into the component due to macroeconomic shocks and the granular residuals capturing the impact of individual firms and product categories, respectively. In advanced economies, the firm granular residual accounts for 41% of the variance of overall inflation, while the product category granular residual accounts for another 15%. Most of the variation in the firm granular residual is due to idiosyncratic shocks rather than to higher sensitivity of larger firms to common shocks. In the cross-section of countries, granular residuals are less important in economies with less concentrated market shares and higher inflation, such as emerging markets. Granular forces also contributed to the post-COVID inflation surge, with the firm-level component explaining roughly one-third of the 2021–2022 inflation in advanced economies. Finally, granularities are associated with a more sluggish response of inflation to monetary policy shocks, suggesting that market concentration can influence monetary non-neutrality.
url:387fbd24a96700b9.abstract_zh: 本文利用2005年至2022年间16个发达与新兴市场国家的条码级价格数据，探讨了单个企业与产品类别在总体通货膨胀中的作用。我们将通货膨胀分解为宏观经济冲击引起的部分，以及分别捕捉单个企业和产品类别影响的颗粒残差。在发达经济体中，企业颗粒残差占总体通胀方差的41%，而产品类别颗粒残差则额外贡献了15%。企业颗粒残差的大部分变动源于特质性冲击，而非大型企业对共同冲击更高的敏感度。在国家间的横截面比较中，颗粒残差在市场份额集中度较低且通胀率较高的经济体中（如新兴市场）重要性较小。颗粒力量也助推了新冠疫情后的通胀飙升，其中企业层面的组成部分解释了2021-2022年发达经济体约三分之一的通胀。最后，颗粒性与通胀对货币政策冲击的响应更为迟缓相关联，这表明市场集中度可能影响货币非中性。

url:38babe354d02eec5.abstract: This paper examines the circumstances under which firms facilitate occupational transitions, complementing prior work that focuses on workers’ decisions. We link unemployment insurance records with application diaries and clickstream data from a recruitment platform to causally assess how candidates’ occupational histories shape recruiters’ hiring decisions. We find that the average candidate from a different occupation faces a 7% lower contact rate than equally qualified candidates who last worked in a recruiter’s searched occupation. Using a new measure of skill overlap, we show that 60% of this penalty reflects that movers meet fewer skill requirements than incumbents. Occupational experience and qualifications further reduce the mover penalty, such that certain candidates returning to a prior occupation face no penalty at all. Finally, recruiters adapt to scarcity and contact more movers in tight occupations. Changes in firm behavior account for one-third of the increase in movers’ application success in tight versus slack labor markets.
url:38babe354d02eec5.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了企业在何种情况下促进职业转换，补充了以往聚焦于劳动者决策的研究。我们将失业保险记录与招聘平台的申请日志及点击流数据相结合，以因果方式评估求职者的职业经历如何影响招聘者的录用决策。我们发现，与最后从事招聘者所搜索职业且资质相当的候选人相比，来自不同职业的平均候选人联系率低7%。利用一种新的技能重叠度量，我们表明这一惩罚的60%反映了转行者满足的技能要求少于在职者。职业经验和资质进一步降低了转行者惩罚，以至于某些回归先前职业的候选人完全不受惩罚。最后，招聘者会适应稀缺性，在紧缺职业中联系更多转行者。在劳动力市场紧张与宽松的情况下，企业行为的变化解释了转行者申请成功率提升的三分之一。
url:38babe354d02eec5.title: Adapting to Scarcity: The Role of Firms in Occupational Transitions
url:38babe354d02eec5.title_zh: 适应稀缺性：企业在职业转型中的作用

url:38cb78d04117aeb4.abstract: This study examines the economic and structural determinants of premature mortality, measured in years of potential life lost. Using county-level panel data from 2014–2020, covering 2,880 U.S. counties and over 20,000 county-year observations, this study employed an instrumental variables approach to address endogeneity and estimate causal effects. A ten-day increase in mentally unhealthy days per month was associated with a 1.29-year reduction in life expectancy, driven by increased mortality from suicide, drug overdoses, and alcohol-related diseases. A five-percentage-point rise in child poverty led to a 0.72-year decline in life expectancy through food insecurity, adverse childhood experiences, and long-term chronic health conditions. Increasing primary care providers by one per 10,000 residents extended life expectancy by 0.91 years, with larger effects in economically distressed and racially segregated counties. The analysis explored underlying mechanisms linking these determinants to mortality outcomes, including subgroup analyses across counties stratified by racial composition, poverty levels, rural – urban classification, and U.S. census regions. Mental health distress amplified the negative effects of economic deprivation on mortality. Limited healthcare access constrained preventive interventions. These findings highlight the need for integrated policy solutions to expand mental health services, reduce child poverty, and improve healthcare accessibility in vulnerable communities. KEYWORDS: Premature mortality human capital mental health distress child poverty healthcare access JEL CLASSIFICATION: I12 I14 I18 J24
url:38cb78d04117aeb4.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了以潜在寿命损失年衡量的过早死亡率的经济与结构性决定因素。利用2014—2020年涵盖2880个美国县及超过20000个县-年观测值的县级面板数据，采用工具变量法处理内生性问题并估计因果效应。每月心理健康不良天数增加10天，与预期寿命缩短1.29年相关，其驱动因素为自杀、药物过量及酒精相关疾病死亡率的上升。儿童贫困率上升5个百分点，通过粮食不安全、不良童年经历及长期慢性健康问题导致预期寿命下降0.72年。每万居民增加一名初级保健提供者可使预期寿命延长0.91年，该效应在经济困难及种族隔离程度较高的县更为显著。分析探究了将这些决定因素与死亡率结果相联系的潜在机制，包括按种族构成、贫困水平、城乡分类及美国人口普查区域分层的县级亚组分析。心理健康困扰放大了经济剥夺对死亡率的负面影响。医疗可及性不足制约了预防性干预措施的实施。这些发现凸显了在脆弱社区扩大心理健康服务、减少儿童贫困及改善医疗可及性的综合政策解决方案的必要性。关键词：过早死亡率 人力资本 心理健康困扰 儿童贫困 医疗可及性 JEL分类：I12 I14 I18 J24

url:391db9fbb3163d93.abstract: Using a novel indicator for the People's Bank of China monetary policy stance, we estimate a policy rule that accounts for the dual nature of its price stability mandate-encompassing domestic inflation and the exchange rate-and for the evolution of its operational framework. The Ins: The domestic transmission follows textbook patterns, with exceptions due to the active management of the renminbi and the financial account. The Outs: International spillovers are powerful and affect commodity markets, global production and trade. The pass-through to foreign (US) prices is substantial. Financial spillovers are second-order, and mostly derivative from trade spillovers.
url:391db9fbb3163d93.abstract_zh: 我们采用一种新颖的指标来衡量中国人民银行货币政策立场，据此估算了一项政策规则，该规则兼顾了其价格稳定任务的双重性质——涵盖国内通胀与汇率——以及其操作框架的演变。内部传导遵循教科书模式，但因人民币的积极管理和金融账户而存在例外。外部溢出效应显著，影响大宗商品市场、全球生产与贸易。对国外（美国）价格的传导效应显著。金融溢出效应为二阶性质，主要源自贸易溢出。

url:394f9ff5ddabef34.abstract: GLP-1 therapies for obesity promise substantial health improvements, but little is known about how their benefits vary across socioeconomic and demographic groups. Using a nationally representative microsimulation model of US adults and Shapely-value decomposition, we estimate the lifetime health and economic benefits of GLP-1 treatment and examine how those gains vary across individuals. The largest differences emerge across education. Individuals with less than a high school education experience experience roughly 14% higher gains in lifetime net social value, 16-17% larger improvements in discounted generalized risk- and severity-adjusted life-years (GRASA-QALYs), and 20% greater increases in life expectancy relative to the cohort mean, whereas individuals with college degrees experience gains 15-27% below the mean across these outcomes. Black and Hispanic individuals also tend to experience larger improvements in health outcomes and social value than White individuals, including larger gains in GRASA-QALYs and life expectancy and larger reductions in diabetes risk and duration. Females likewise experience larger predicted treatment gains than men. These patterns are consistent with the idea that the largest gains arise among populations facing greater socioeconomic constraints in sustaining behavioral weight control. GLP-1 innovation may therefore mitigate inequality in obesity-related disease and survival, advancing equity in population health.
url:394f9ff5ddabef34.abstract_zh: GLP-1肥胖疗法有望带来显著的健康改善，但关于其收益在不同社会经济和人口群体间的差异尚知之甚少。利用具有全国代表性的美国成年人微观模拟模型和沙普利值分解方法，我们估算了GLP-1治疗带来的终生健康与经济收益，并考察了这些收益在个体间的差异。最大差异出现在教育水平上：与队列均值相比，高中以下学历人群的终生净社会价值收益高出约14%，贴现后广义风险与严重程度调整生命年（GRASA-QALYs）改善幅度高出16-17%，预期寿命增长高出20%；而拥有大学学历人群在上述指标上的收益则低于均值15-27%。黑人和西班牙裔个体在健康结果和社会价值方面的改善幅度也往往大于白人群体，包括GRASA-QALYs和预期寿命的更大提升，以及糖尿病风险与病程的更大程度降低。女性预测的治疗收益同样高于男性。这些模式与以下观点一致：在维持行为体重控制方面面临更大社会经济约束的人群，其收益最大。因此，GLP-1创新可能缓解肥胖相关疾病与生存方面的不平等，促进人口健康公平。
url:394f9ff5ddabef34.title: GLP-1 Therapy and the Reshaping of Socioeconomic Gradients in Health

url:395a4dadef8dfad6.abstract: Fuel and food constitute significant portions of consumer baskets, yet their prices are highly volatile. The renewed energy price shock in March 2026, driven by geopolitical disruptions and supply constraints, has highlighted the macroeconomic and distributional importance of how international price shocks transmit to domestic markets. Spikes in these prices can have major social, political, and economic implications. The conventional policy approach is to allow domestic retail prices to align with international prices while protecting the most vulnerable. However, many countries intervene in price settings to shield their domestic markets from global fluctuations. This paper provides a comprehensive assessment of the passthrough from global to domestic retail prices for four commodities: gasoline, diesel, wheat, and rice over the past two decades in many countries. We employ a dynamic model of local projections building on the work of Kpodar and Abdallah (2017). Our findings indicate that average passthrough is incomplete, with fuel exhibiting higher and faster passthrough than food. The extent of passthrough varies by period, region, and between commodity exporters and importers. We also examine asymmetric responses to global price shocks and find evidence of a ratchet effect: price increases are more likely to be passed through than decreases.
url:395a4dadef8dfad6.abstract_zh: 燃料和食品在消费者支出篮子中占据重要份额，但其价格波动剧烈。2026年3月，受地缘政治动荡和供应限制影响，新一轮能源价格冲击凸显了国际价格冲击如何传导至国内市场的宏观经济效应与分配效应。此类价格飙升可能产生重大的社会、政治和经济影响。传统政策路径是允许国内零售价格与国际价格接轨，同时保护最脆弱群体。然而，许多国家通过干预价格设定来隔离国内市场免受全球波动影响。本文对过去二十年间多个国家四种大宗商品（汽油、柴油、小麦和大米）从全球到国内零售价格的传导机制进行了全面评估。我们基于Kpodar和Abdallah（2017）的研究构建了局部投影动态模型。研究结果表明，平均传导效应不完全，其中燃料的传导速度和幅度均高于食品。传导程度因时期、区域以及大宗商品出口国与进口国之间的差异而有所不同。我们还考察了对全球价格冲击的非对称反应，并发现了棘轮效应的证据：价格上涨比下跌更易被传导。
url:395a4dadef8dfad6.title: Pumps and Plates: Passthrough of International Fuel and Food Price Shocks to Domestic Markets
url:395a4dadef8dfad6.title_zh: 泵与盘：国际燃料与食品价格冲击对国内市场的传导

url:39ba66492d16b540.abstract: We show that monetary policy transmission is shaped not only by a sector’s own financial frictions but also by those prevailing in the broader production network. The latter, indirect frictions amplify the output and price effects of monetary policy and empirically dominate the direct ones. The amplification results from a downstream demand channel, as customers respond to tighter policy by purchasing fewer inputs. This is partly offset by an upstream cost channel, reflecting that suppliers raise prices to protect margins when financing costs rise. We inspect the mechanism in a multi-sector general equilibrium model with input-output linkages and working-capital constraints. JEL Classification: C32, C67, E31, E32, E52
url:39ba66492d16b540.abstract_zh: 我们证明，货币政策传导不仅受到部门自身金融摩擦的影响，还受到更广泛生产网络中普遍存在的摩擦的影响。后者，即间接摩擦，放大了货币政策对产出和价格的影响，并在实证上主导了直接摩擦。这种放大效应源于下游需求渠道，因为客户在应对更紧缩的政策时会减少购买投入品。这一效应部分被上游成本渠道所抵消，反映出当融资成本上升时，供应商会提高价格以保护利润空间。我们在一个包含投入产出关联和营运资本约束的多部门一般均衡模型中检验了这一机制。JEL分类：C32, C67, E31, E32, E52

url:39f2ee1ee06d83d1.abstract: we estimate and simulate the non-linear model. We then study the recent inflation surge and the implications of state-dependent prices and wages for monetary policy in the estimated non-linear model. Unlike conventional models, our framework does not primarily explain inflation dynamics by exogenous supply shocks. Instead, the impact of shocks on inflation depends on their timing, size, and the business cycle. Consequently, the inflation-output stabilization trade-off faced by monetary policy is state-dependent. For example, monetary policy is more effective in curbing inflation, and supply shocks have larger effects during periods of high inflation.
url:39f2ee1ee06d83d1.abstract_zh: 我们估计并模拟了非线性模型。随后，我们研究了近期通胀飙升现象，以及状态依赖的价格与工资对估计的非线性模型中货币政策的影响。与常规模型不同，我们的框架并非主要通过外生供给冲击来解释通胀动态。相反，冲击对通胀的影响取决于其发生时机、规模及商业周期状况。因此，货币政策面临的通胀-产出稳定权衡是状态依赖的。例如，在高通胀时期，货币政策在抑制通胀方面更为有效，且供给冲击的影响也更大。

url:39fa2d55eee4b519.abstract: We estimate a dynamic model of the U.S. space launch industry. The model allows past launches to improve rocket reliability and lower launch costs. It also allows the government to make forward-looking procurement choices. We use the model to analyze policy-relevant issues in the recent history of the industry: the 2006 United Launch Alliance "merger-to-monopoly" and the effects of efficiencies in the form of learning synergies; innovations, such as SpaceX's Falcon 9 and ULA's recent introduction of Vulcan Centaur; the costs and benefits of forward-looking procurements; and, the trade-offs between the advantages of centralized control and possible inefficiencies.
url:39fa2d55eee4b519.abstract_zh: 我们估算了一个美国太空发射行业的动态模型。该模型允许过去的发射活动提升火箭可靠性并降低发射成本，同时允许政府做出前瞻性的采购决策。我们利用此模型分析该行业近期历史中与政策相关的问题：2006年联合发射联盟的“垄断式合并”及其以学习协同效应形式带来的效率影响；创新，如SpaceX的猎鹰9号和ULA近期推出的火神半人马座；前瞻性采购的成本与收益；以及集中控制的优势与潜在低效之间的权衡。
url:39fa2d55eee4b519.title: Competition, Procurement and Learning-By-Doing in the Space Launch Industry
url:39fa2d55eee4b519.title_zh: 太空发射行业中的竞争、采购与干中学

url:3a2abae6c9ca66b3.abstract: The US Inflation Reduction Act’s Energy Communities provisions aimed to increase clean-energy investment in areas vulnerable to the energy transition, create jobs, and build political support for decarbonisation. This column combines data on renewable energy investment, job vacancies, and elections with survey evidence on public opinion to argue that the provisions successfully promoted solar investment, but generated little employment and did not shift political attitudes.
url:3a2abae6c9ca66b3.abstract_zh: 美国《通胀削减法案》中的“能源社区”条款旨在促进能源转型脆弱地区的清洁能源投资，创造就业机会，并为脱碳构建政治支持。本文结合可再生能源投资、职位空缺和选举数据，以及关于公众舆论的调查证据，论证这些条款成功推动了太阳能投资，但产生的就业效应有限，且未能改变政治态度。
url:3a2abae6c9ca66b3.title: The Inflation Reduction Act’s regional incentives promoted green investment, but did not create jobs
url:3a2abae6c9ca66b3.title_zh: 《通胀削减法案》的区域激励措施促进了绿色投资，但未创造就业

url:3a2add05f8723f88.abstract: Over the past 20 years, Portugal has gone through a boom, a slump, a sudden stop, and now a timid recovery. Unemployment has decreased, but remains high, and output is still far below potential. Competitiveness has improved, but more is needed to keep the current account in check as the economy recovers. Private and public debt are high, both legacies of the boom, the slump and the sudden stop. Productivity growth remains low. Because of high debt and low growth, the recovery remains fragile. We review the history and the main mechanisms at work. We then review a number of policy options, from fiscal consolidation to fiscal expansion, cleaning up of non-performing loans, labor market reforms, product market reforms, and euro exit. We argue that at this point, the main focus of macroeconomic policy should be twofold. The first is the treatment of non-performing loans, which would allow for an increase in demand in the short run and an increase in supply in the medium run. We argue that, to the extent that such treatment requires recapitalization, it may make sense to finance it through an increased fiscal deficit, even in the face of high public debt. The second is product market reforms, and reforms aimed at increasing micro-exibility in the labor market. Symmetrically, we also argue that at this point, some policies would be undesirable, among them faster fiscal consolidation, measures aimed at decreasing nominal wages and prices, and euro exit.
url:3a2add05f8723f88.abstract_zh: 过去二十年，葡萄牙经历了繁荣、衰退、突然停滞，以及如今缓慢的复苏。失业率虽有所下降，但仍处高位，产出远低于潜在水平。竞争力有所提升，但经济复苏过程中仍需更多努力以维持经常账户平衡。私人和公共债务高企，皆为繁荣、衰退及突然停滞时期的遗留问题。生产率增长依然低迷。鉴于高债务与低增长，复苏态势依然脆弱。我们回顾了历史及主要作用机制，随后探讨了一系列政策选项，从财政整顿到财政扩张、不良贷款清理、劳动力市场改革、产品市场改革，乃至退出欧元区。我们认为，当前宏观经济政策应聚焦于两方面。首要任务是处理不良贷款，这既能短期内刺激需求，又能在中期提升供给。我们主张，若此类处理需资本重组，即便公共债务高企，通过增加财政赤字来融资或许合理。其次是产品市场改革，以及旨在增强劳动力市场微观灵活性的改革。相应地，我们也认为，当前某些政策并不可取，包括加速财政整顿、旨在降低名义工资和物价的措施，以及退出欧元区。
url:3a2add05f8723f88.title: Boom, Slump, Sudden stops, Recovery, and Policy Options. Portugal and the Euro
url:3a2add05f8723f88.title_zh: 繁荣、衰退、骤停、复苏与政策选择：葡萄牙与欧元

url:3a927fd0c5c7be93.abstract: We study a parsimonious model of a competitive labor market in which firms privately screen workers to identify talent. The equilibrium exhibits dispersion in wages and productivity; when talent is scarce, firms with superior screening skills post higher wages, attract better applicants, and recruit more talented workers.
url:3a927fd0c5c7be93.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个竞争性劳动力市场的简约模型，其中企业私下筛选工人以识别人才。均衡状态表现出工资和生产率的分化；当人才稀缺时，筛选技能更优的企业会提供更高的工资，吸引更优秀的申请者，并招募到更有才华的工人。
url:3a927fd0c5c7be93.title: Recruiting Talent

url:3aae01e18f60745f.abstract: We experimentally study decentralized one-to-one matching markets with transfers. We vary the information available to participants, complete or incomplete, and the surplus structure, supermodular or submodular. Several insights emerge.
url:3aae01e18f60745f.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究具有转移支付的分散式一对一匹配市场。我们变化参与者可获得的信息，即完全或不完全信息，以及剩余结构，即超模或子模。由此得出若干洞见。
url:3aae01e18f60745f.title: Paying to Match: Decentralized Markets with Information Frictions

url:3ab813b08d0bf5bb.abstract: We design a novel survey to study how education shapes households’ joint beliefs about inflation, unemployment, and monetary policy transmission. College-educated respondents perceive the inflation-unemployment trade-off and hold views similar to professional forecasters, while less educated respondents favor supply-side narratives. When exposed to hypothetical monetary policy interventions, the more educated update expectations and adjust consumption and saving in line with standard models, whereas the less educated display greater rigidity. This education gradient persists after controlling for information sources, financial literacy, and institutional trust, pointing to differences in abstract reasoning. Open-ended responses are consistent with college-educated households holding mental models aligned with standard macroeconomic theory.
url:3ab813b08d0bf5bb.abstract_zh: 我们设计了一项新颖的调查，研究教育如何塑造家庭对通胀、失业及货币政策传导的共同信念。受过大学教育的受访者能够感知通胀与失业之间的权衡关系，其观点与专业预测者相似；而教育程度较低的受访者则更倾向于供给侧叙事。在接触假设性的货币政策干预措施时，受教育程度较高的群体会更新预期，并按照标准模型调整消费与储蓄行为，而受教育程度较低的群体则表现出更强的刚性。这种教育梯度在控制信息来源、金融素养和制度信任等因素后依然存在，表明其源于抽象推理能力的差异。开放式回答的结果与以下结论一致：受过大学教育的家庭所持有的心智模型与标准宏观经济理论相吻合。
url:3ab813b08d0bf5bb.title: DP21641 Households’ Macroeconomic Beliefs: The Role of Education
url:3ab813b08d0bf5bb.title_zh: DP21641 家庭宏观经济信念：教育的作用

url:3acb7eab5273f623.abstract: Privately issued money usually bears devaluation risk that lowers its liquidity and usefulness as a medium of exchange. We evaluate the real economic consequences of eliminating devaluation risk and increasing the safety of private monies in the historical context of the National Banking Act of 1864 in the United States. The Act introduced a new type of federally-regulated bank that supplied safe currency to the local economy as an alternative to the previously existing varieties of unsecured notes. Towns faced a discontinuous cost in creating these banks, which we leverage as a source of exogenous variation in the change in their monetary transaction costs. We estimate the effects of gaining access to safe private money using a market access approach derived from general equilibrium trade theory, and we find that lowering monetary transaction costs increased production of traded goods overall, increased the production share of trade-cost sensitive goods, and spurred structural transformation with more manufacturing output, manufacturing employment, and urban population. Moreover, the growth in manufacturing output overall appears driven by employment and inputs rather than capital investment. These effects indicate that supplying safer money that lowered overall trade costs had a causal impact on US economic development.
url:3acb7eab5273f623.abstract_zh: 私人发行的货币通常面临贬值风险，这降低了其流动性及作为交换媒介的效用。我们以美国1864年《国家银行法》的历史背景为依托，评估消除贬值风险及提升私人货币安全性所带来的实际经济后果。该法案引入了一种新型联邦监管银行，向地方经济提供安全货币，作为先前存在的各类无担保票据的替代选择。城镇在设立此类银行时面临非连续性的成本，我们利用这一点作为其货币交易成本变化的外生变异来源。我们采用源自一般均衡贸易理论的市场准入方法，估计获得安全私人货币的效应，并发现降低货币交易成本总体上增加了可贸易商品的生产，提高了对交易成本敏感商品的生产份额，并促进了结构转型，表现为制造业产出、制造业就业及城市人口的增加。此外，制造业产出的整体增长似乎主要由就业和投入要素驱动，而非资本投资。这些效应表明，提供更安全货币以降低整体贸易成本，对美国经济发展产生了因果性影响。
url:3acb7eab5273f623.title: DP17164 Real effects of supplying safe private money
url:3acb7eab5273f623.title_zh: DP17164 供给安全私人货币的实际效应

url:3ad9c2747c7bfa3e.abstract: We document market power in U.S. equity securities lending and examine its origins and consequences. We develop a dynamic model of securities lending and estimate it on the cross-section of U.S. equities, showing that the dominant custodian-intermediated market structure emerges as a response to short sellers’ information-leakage concerns. Short sellers prefer this opaque market structure over a centralized alternative, particularly for smaller stocks, despite the associated non-competitive fees. This is because their trading strategies become unprofitable if information leaks prematurely. Thus, unlike in standard product markets, the demand side in securities lending values opacity, which is important for regulatory design.
url:3ad9c2747c7bfa3e.abstract_zh: 我们记录了美国股票证券借贷中的市场势力，并考察了其起源与后果。我们构建了一个证券借贷的动态模型，并基于美国股票截面数据进行了估计，结果表明，以托管机构为中介的主导型市场结构是对卖空者信息泄露担忧的回应。尽管这种不透明的市场结构伴随着非竞争性费用，但卖空者仍偏好于此，而非集中化的替代方案，尤其是对于小盘股而言。这是因为，如果信息过早泄露，他们的交易策略将变得无利可图。因此，与标准产品市场不同，证券借贷的需求方看重不透明性，这对监管设计具有重要意义。

url:3addb5d80891eacb.abstract: We develop novel high-frequency indices that measure climate attention across a wide range of developed and emerging economies. By analyzing the text of over 23 million Tweets published by leading national newspapers, we find that a country experiencing more severe climate news shocks tends to see both an inflow of capital and an appreciation of its currency. In addition, brown stocks experience large and persistent negative returns after a global climate news shock if located in highly exposed countries. A risk-sharing model in which investors price climate news shocks and trade consumption and investment goods in global markets rationalizes these findings.
url:3addb5d80891eacb.abstract_zh: 我们构建了覆盖发达与新兴经济体的新型高频气候关注度指数。通过分析2300余万条主流全国性报纸推文文本，研究发现：遭受更严重气候新闻冲击的国家往往出现资本流入与本币升值。此外，若棕色股票所在国气候暴露度较高，全球气候新闻冲击将导致其持续大幅负收益。基于投资者对气候新闻冲击定价、并在全球市场交易消费与投资品的风险分担模型，可合理解释上述发现。
url:3addb5d80891eacb.title: International Climate News

url:3ae028956873f25a.abstract: This paper investigates whether early-life adversity (ELA) affects later-life health in India using nationally representative LASI data and quasi-experimental variation from cohort differences and the Bengal Famine. We estimate probit models, KHB mediation, and GSEM across seven outcomes: underweight, food insufficiency, poor self-rated health, low cognition, depression, ADL, and IADL. ELA shows a monotonic dose-response relationship with all seven outcomes. Education mediates most of the ELA effect on cognition and IADL, while life satisfaction dominates for depression. Direct effects persist, indicating biological scarring. The Bengal Famine produced lasting health deficits, except for IADL where mortality selection dominates. Heterogeneity reveals larger cognitive penalties for women, stronger physical/functional penalties in Central/Eastern India, and wealth buffers underweight but not depression or self-rated health. These findings survive extensive robustness checks (IV-PSM, inverse probability weighting, alternative ELA measures, birth cohort analysis, and machine learning). Results imply that early-life interventions, especially universal education, can substantially reduce later-life health inequalities in India.
url:3ae028956873f25a.abstract_zh: 本文利用印度全国代表性LASI数据，以及基于队列差异和孟加拉饥荒的准实验变异，研究早期逆境（ELA）是否影响印度人群的晚年健康。我们针对七项健康指标（体重过轻、食物不足、自评健康差、认知能力低、抑郁、日常生活活动能力障碍及工具性日常生活活动能力障碍）估计了Probit模型、KHB中介效应分析和广义结构方程模型。结果显示，早期逆境与所有七项指标均呈现单调剂量-反应关系。教育在早期逆境对认知能力和工具性日常生活活动能力的影响中起主要中介作用，而生活满意度在抑郁路径中占主导地位。直接效应持续存在，表明存在生物性疤痕效应。除工具性日常生活活动能力受死亡率选择主导外，孟加拉饥荒造成了持久的健康缺陷。异质性分析揭示：女性面临更大的认知惩罚，印度中部和东部地区承受更强的身体/功能性惩罚，财富能缓冲体重过轻风险，但对抑郁和自评健康无保护作用。上述结论通过了广泛稳健性检验（工具变量-倾向得分匹配、逆概率加权、替代早期逆境测量指标、出生队列分析及机器学习）。研究结果表明，早期干预措施（尤其是普及教育）可显著减少印度晚年健康不平等。
url:3ae028956873f25a.title: Early Life Adversity and Multi-Dimensional Health Consequences in India: Quasi-Causal Evidence from the Longitudinal Ageing Study in India
url:3ae028956873f25a.title_zh: 印度早期生活逆境与多维健康后果：来自印度纵向老龄化研究的准因果证据

url:3afbd0ce8d481741.abstract: We present a model of endogenous schooling and earnings to isolate the causal effect of parents' education on children's education and earnings outcomes. The model suggests that parents' education is positively related to children's earnings, but its relationship with children's education is ambiguous. Identification is achieved by comparing the earnings of children with the same length of schooling, whose parents have different lengths of schooling. The model also features heterogeneous preferences for schooling, and is estimated using HRS data. The observed correlation between parents' and children's years of schooling is largely driven by the correlation between parents' schooling and children's unobserved preferences for schooling. This is partly offset by a slightly negative, structural relationship between parents' and children's schooling choices, resulting in an IV coefficient smaller than OLS when exogenously increasing parents' schooling. Nonetheless, an exogenous one-year increase in parents' schooling raises children's lifetime earnings by 2 percent on average.
url:3afbd0ce8d481741.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个内生教育年限与收入模型，以分离父母教育对子女教育及收入结果的因果效应。模型表明，父母教育与子女收入呈正相关，但与子女教育的关系并不明确。通过比较父母教育年限不同但子女受教育年限相同的个体收入，实现了因果识别。该模型还纳入了对教育偏好的异质性，并利用HRS数据进行估计。观察到的父母与子女教育年限的相关性，主要源于父母教育与子女未观测到的教育偏好之间的相关性。这一效应部分被父母与子女教育选择之间微弱的负向结构性关系所抵消，导致当外生提高父母教育年限时，工具变量估计系数小于普通最小二乘法。尽管如此，父母教育年限外生增加一年，仍能使子女终身收入平均提高2%。
url:3afbd0ce8d481741.title: The Causal Effect of Parents' Education on Children's Earnings
url:3afbd0ce8d481741.title_zh: 父母教育对子女收入的因果效应

url:3b0bf82cf802fc05.abstract: We propose a Bayesian VAR model with stochastic volatility and time varying skewness to estimate the degree of labour at risk in the euro area and in the United States. We model the asymmetry of the shocks to changes in the unemployment rate as a function of real activity and financial risk factors. We find that the conditional distribution of the changes in the unemployment rate displays time-varying volatility and skewness, with peaks coinciding with the Global Financial Crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic. We take advantage of the multivariate nature of our parametric model to measure stagflation risk defined as the possible joint event of large increases in the unemployment rate and large annual rates of inflation. We find an increasing risk of stagflation for the euro area in 2022 while in the United States stagflation risk increased earlier in 2021 and started decreasing more recently. Notwithstanding the significantly high levels of inflation, stagflation risks have been contained by the resilient performance of the labour market in both areas. Labour at risk is therefore important for the assessment of the inflation-unemployment trade-off.
url:3b0bf82cf802fc05.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个包含随机波动和时变偏度的贝叶斯向量自回归模型，用于估计欧元区和美国的劳动风险程度。我们将失业率变化冲击的非对称性建模为实际经济活动与金融风险因素的函数。研究发现，失业率变化的条件分布呈现时变波动性和偏度特征，其峰值与全球金融危机和新冠疫情时期相吻合。我们利用参数模型的多元特性，将滞胀风险定义为失业率大幅上升与年通胀率高企可能同时发生的联合事件。测算结果显示，欧元区滞胀风险在2022年持续攀升，而美国滞胀风险则更早于2021年上升，近期已开始回落。尽管通胀水平显著高企，但两大经济体的劳动力市场韧性表现有效抑制了滞胀风险。因此，劳动风险对于评估通胀-失业权衡关系具有重要参考价值。
url:3b0bf82cf802fc05.title: Labour at risk

url:3b183daa7a8b030f.title: Careers in multinational enterprises
url:3b183daa7a8b030f.title_zh: 跨国企业中的职业发展

url:3b1c7c3d309608a2.abstract: The paper analyses tax and tariff policy for trade between economies which each contain a monopolistically competitive industry producing differentiated products. The consequences of tax changes by a single country are examined, and the general desirability of taxing imports more heavily than domestically produced goods is established. Customs union theory is analysed by studying coordinated tax changes by a group of countries; circumstances under which customs union formation and enlargement will benefit members are found. Game theoretic techniques are used to investigate which countries will coalesce into a customs union.
url:3b1c7c3d309608a2.abstract_zh: 本文分析了各经济体均包含一个生产差异化产品的垄断竞争行业时的税收与关税政策。研究考察了单一国家税收变动的后果，并确立了进口商品税负高于国内生产商品的普遍合理性。通过研究一组国家协调税收变动，分析了关税同盟理论；发现了关税同盟形成与扩大将使成员国受益的条件。运用博弈论方法探究了哪些国家会联合形成关税同盟。
url:3b1c7c3d309608a2.title: DP38 Customs Union, Tariff Reform and Trade in Differentiated Products
url:3b1c7c3d309608a2.title_zh: DP38 关税同盟、关税改革与差异化产品贸易

url:3b2de77181fa94e0.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了城市的产业结构
url:3b2de77181fa94e0.title: Industrial Concentration, Property Values, and Municipal Bond Spreads
url:3b2de77181fa94e0.title_zh: 产业集中度、房产价值与市政债券利差

url:3b31b8b9611f436c.abstract: This paper specifies a new convenient algorithm to construct policy projections conditional on alternative anticipated policy-rate paths in linearized dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models, such as Ramses, the Riksbank's main DSGE model. Such projections with anticipated policy-rate paths correspond to situations where the central bank transparently announces that it, conditional on current information, plans to implement a particular policy-rate path and where this announced plan for the policy rate is believed and then anticipated by the private sector. The main idea of the algorithm is to include among the predetermined variables (the 'state' of the economy) the vector of nonzero means of future shocks to a given policy rule that is required to satisfy the given anticipated policy-rate path.
url:3b31b8b9611f436c.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的便捷算法，用于在线性化动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型（如瑞典央行的主要DSGE模型Ramses）中，构建基于替代性预期政策利率路径的政策预测。此类包含预期政策利率路径的预测，对应于中央银行在现有信息条件下透明地宣布其计划实施特定政策利率路径，且该宣布的政策利率计划被私人部门相信并预期的情况。该算法的核心思想是，在预定变量（即经济“状态”）中纳入未来对给定政策规则冲击的非零均值向量，该向量需满足给定的预期政策利率路径。
url:3b31b8b9611f436c.title: DP8176 Anticipated Alternative Instrument-Rate Paths in Policy Simulations
url:3b31b8b9611f436c.title_zh: DP8176 政策模拟中预期的替代性利率路径

url:3b7a9d654be5c945.abstract: Discrete choice experiments are widely used to estimate workers' willingness to pay (WTP) for job amenities under the assumption that varying an attribute does not change workers' beliefs about other job attributes. We test this assumption by embedding an amenity with a known market price, a popular monthly public transport pass, in a large-scale discrete choice experiment with German workers. Many workers, including public transport users, overvalue the ticket by more than 100%, despite WTP for other attributes aligning with the literature. A complementary belief-elicitation experiment shows that advertising an amenity, such as the pass but also common amenities like work from home, causally shifts beliefs about unlisted attributes of the job. Posted wages similarly signal unlisted attributes so that wage variation, the money metric for WTP calculation, is itself contaminated by belief spillovers---such as higher pay signaling heightened stress. These spillovers imply that discrete choice estimates capture perceived bundles rather than isolated attributes, and distort current estimates of non-wage compensation and monopsony power.
url:3b7a9d654be5c945.abstract_zh: 离散选择实验被广泛用于估算工人对工作福利的支付意愿，其前提假设是改变某一属性不会改变工人对其他工作属性的信念。我们通过将一项具有已知市场价格的工作福利——德国广受欢迎的月度公共交通通票——嵌入一项针对德国工人的大规模离散选择实验来检验这一假设。许多工人（包括公共交通使用者）对该通票的估值高出实际价格100%以上，尽管对其他属性的支付意愿与现有文献一致。一项补充性的信念诱导实验表明，宣传某项工作福利（如通票，以及居家办公等常见福利）会因果性地改变工人对工作未列明属性的信念。公布的工资同样会传递未列明属性的信号，因此作为支付意愿计算货币度量的工资变动本身也受到信念溢出效应的影响——例如，高薪可能意味着更高的工作压力。这些溢出效应意味着离散选择实验的估计值反映的是工人感知到的福利组合，而非孤立的属性，并扭曲了当前对非工资补偿和买方垄断势力的估算。

url:3b8ee4df9182d95b.abstract: Whether exporters can take advantage of increases in foreign demand depends on the scalability of their input suppliers—that is, suppliers’ ability to expand production when demand rises. Using bilateral trade data linked to international input-output tables, I measure supplier scalability at the country-industry level and examine how it shapes downstream export growth. I find that supplier scalability varies sharply across industries within countries, that scalable suppliers tend to be connected to scalable suppliers themselves, and that downstream country-sectors exposed to more scalable suppliers respond more strongly to positive foreign demand shocks in sectors with relationship-sticky inputs. I rationalize these facts in a multicountry, multi-sector general-equilibrium trade model with input-output linkages, heterogeneous upward-sloping supplier supply curves, and gradually adjusting sourcing relationships. In the calibrated model, supplier bottlenecks substantially attenuate the export and welfare gains from a global demand expansion, while relationship stickiness determines where bottlenecks bind. Counterfactuals show that supplier upgrading and pre-arranged access to flexible sourcing networks are most valuable when targeted toward economically central, relationship-sticky, and bottleneck-exposed parts of the production network.
url:3b8ee4df9182d95b.abstract_zh: 出口商能否利用外国需求的增长，取决于其投入品供应商的可扩展性——即供应商在需求上升时扩大生产的能力。通过将双边贸易数据与国际投入产出表相结合，我在国家-行业层面衡量了供应商的可扩展性，并考察其如何影响下游出口增长。研究发现，供应商可扩展性在国家内部各行业间差异显著，可扩展的供应商往往与其他可扩展供应商相互关联，且下游国家-部门若接触更多可扩展供应商，则在涉及关系粘性投入品的行业中，对正向外国需求冲击的反应更为强烈。我将这些事实纳入一个包含投入产出联系、异质性向上倾斜的供应商供给曲线以及逐步调整的采购关系的多国、多部门一般均衡贸易模型中加以解释。在校准模型中，供应商瓶颈显著削弱了全球需求扩张带来的出口与福利收益，而关系粘性则决定了瓶颈在何处产生约束。反事实分析表明，当供应商升级及预先安排灵活采购网络的可及性被定向于生产网络中经济核心、关系粘性且面临瓶颈暴露的部分时，其价值最为显著。

url:3b9bfcf8eeb015ef.abstract: The harshest criticism of econometrically based policy evaluation is undoubtedly the sensitivity of its conclusions to assumptions concerning the information available to policy-makers or to misspecification of the econometric models used in the evaluation. Economists appear to have accepted this criticism without examining how far it is justified and to what extent it can be overcome. These sensitivities can be broadly classified into those due to information errors (non-controllable shocks external to the economy, as modelled) and those due to modelling errors (errors caused by differences between the true structure of the economy and the specification of the econometric model). This paper considers the former case and studies the sensitivity of macroeconomic policy design to information errors in a multicountry setting. It argues that a policy regime of cooperation produces more robust policy designs than does non-cooperative policy-making, particularly when policy-makers exploit their freedom to revise their decisions in the light of past errors. The investigation involves some theoretical analysis and numerical sensitivity analysis using two different empirical models (extending work done earlier with Andries Brandsma) and complements a study by Hughes Hallett and Holtham on robustness and model errors (presented at an International Economic Association conference, organized by CEPR on Global Macroeconomics: Policy Conflict and Cooperation, February 1987).
url:3b9bfcf8eeb015ef.abstract_zh: 对基于计量经济学的政策评估最严厉的批评，莫过于其结论对政策制定者信息可得性假设的敏感性，或对评估所用计量经济模型设定错误的敏感性。经济学家似乎在不加审视这种批评的合理性及其可克服程度的情况下，便接受了这一观点。这些敏感性可大致分为两类：信息误差（模型化经济体系外部不可控冲击所致）与建模误差（经济真实结构与计量模型设定差异所致）。本文聚焦前者，在多国框架下研究宏观经济政策设计对信息误差的敏感性。研究表明，合作型政策体制比非合作型决策能产生更稳健的政策设计，尤其当政策制定者利用自由裁量权根据既往错误修正决策时。本研究通过两个不同实证模型（延续与Andries Brandsma的早期合作研究）进行理论分析与数值敏感性检验，并补充了Hughes Hallett与Holtham关于稳健性与模型误差的研究（该研究于1987年2月由CEPR组织的国际经济学协会"全球宏观经济学：政策冲突与合作"会议上发表）。

url:3bb16a9e526fe858.abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model where loan securitization is an endogenous outcome in a credit market where information asymmetries lead to adverse selection across financial intermediaries. Securitization occurs when the resources saved by investors acquiring limited information about the risk-class of some borrowers outweigh the cost of being selected against by loan originators. This results in a time-varying market share of individually risk-priced loans held by banks, and of securitized loans held by the secondary market. We analyze the impact of conventional monetary policies and credit market policies in response to an increase in default risk, and discuss its welfare implications. Overall securitization allows more efficient funding of loans, at the expense of increased volatility in risky interest rates, consumption, and inflation over the business cycle.
url:3bb16a9e526fe858.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中贷款证券化是信贷市场中信息不对称导致金融中介之间逆向选择的内生结果。当投资者获取部分借款人风险等级信息所节省的资源超过其因贷款发起人逆向选择而承担的成本时，证券化便会产生。这导致银行持有的个别风险定价贷款与二级市场持有的证券化贷款的市场份额随时间动态变化。我们分析了常规货币政策与信贷市场政策在应对违约风险上升时的效果，并探讨其福利影响。总体而言，证券化能够更高效地为贷款提供资金，但代价是加剧了经济周期中风险利率、消费和通胀的波动性。

url:3bb32e9f6a1f96ed.abstract: A principal (such as a centrist political party) can partially influence the allocation of power between two competing parties. However, once the Enemy gains power, the principal embraces him in exchange for policy moderation.

url:3c282b48bff1472a.abstract: We analyze how a regulator can learn about the \textit{aggregate} health of banks by asking \textit{individual} banks to understand and communicate risks. Focused learning (banks report on the same risks) disciplines banks, yielding higher quality information. Broad learning (reporting on different risks) yields better coverage of information. The information gain from either approach is undermined by banks reducing their exposure to designated risks, resulting in correlated risk exposures and regulatory blind spots. Having each bank report on all risks appears to combine the benefits of focused and broad learning -- but instead increases strategic complementarities across banks and weakens discipline.
url:3c282b48bff1472a.abstract_zh: 我们分析监管者如何通过要求个别银行理解和沟通风险，来了解银行的总体健康状况。聚焦式学习（银行报告相同的风险）对银行形成约束，产生更高质量的信息。广泛式学习（报告不同的风险）则能提供更全面的信息覆盖。然而，这两种方式带来的信息增益都会因银行减少对指定风险的敞口而受损，导致风险敞口相关化及监管盲区。让每家银行报告所有风险看似结合了聚焦式与广泛式学习的优势——但实际上却加剧了银行间的战略互补性，削弱了约束力。

url:3c531a760b86af7b.abstract: Business operators, investment decision-makers and risk managers have increasingly emphasized data factors as drivers of development. This study uses data from Chinese A-share listed companies from 2012 to 2022 to examine how data element marketization (DEM) reduces corporate default risk. The results show that DEM and default distance have a significantly positive relationship, indicating that DEM lowers default risk. The study finds that external monitoring, information asymmetry and investment efficiency are the main mechanisms through which DEM affects default risk. Moreover, executives’ digital backgrounds can significantly strengthen DEM’s impact on default risk. Finally, DEM can significantly reduce the default risk of high-tech companies or those in the decline stage of the business life cycle. This research not only helps policymakers understand how DEM can mitigate firm default risk but can also be generalized globally. KEYWORDS: Data elements marketization default risk information asymmetry investment efficiency executive digital background JEL CLASSIFICATION: G32 D22 O16 Acknowledgements We thank the editor (Dierk Herzer) and the two anonymous reviewers. All remaining errors are our own.
url:3c531a760b86af7b.abstract_zh: 经营者、投资决策者与风险管理者日益重视数据要素作为发展驱动力。本研究基于2012至2022年中国A股上市公司数据，考察数据要素市场化如何降低企业违约风险。结果表明，数据要素市场化与违约距离呈显著正相关关系，说明数据要素市场化降低了违约风险。研究发现，外部监督、信息不对称与投资效率是数据要素市场化影响违约风险的主要机制。此外，高管数字背景能够显著强化数据要素市场化对违约风险的影响。最后，数据要素市场化能显著降低高科技企业或处于生命周期衰退阶段企业的违约风险。本研究不仅有助于政策制定者理解数据要素市场化如何缓解企业违约风险，其结论亦可推广至全球范围。关键词：数据要素市场化；违约风险；信息不对称；投资效率；高管数字背景 JEL分类：G32 D22 O16 致谢：感谢编辑Dierk Herzer及两位匿名审稿人。文中所有疏漏由作者自行承担。

url:3c6936d523587d36.abstract: Rising temperatures may influence everyday food choices in ways that have important implications for nutrition and public health. This paper studies how short-run exposure to extreme temperatures affects the composition of household grocery purchases in the United States. Using a nationally representative household panel dataset of grocery transactions merged with local weather information, we exploit within-household variation and estimate two-way fixed effects models to identify causal effects. We find that hotter weeks consistently shift food purchases toward less healthy items and reduce overall diet quality, with little change in total grocery spending. In contrast, unusually cold weeks lead to slight increases in total spending but do not significantly alter the nutritional composition of purchases. These results suggest that heat exposure primarily induces households to reallocate spending toward less healthy foods rather than to change how much they spend, whereas cold exposure mainly affects the volume of groceries purchased. The heat-induced effects on healthiness of food purchases are modest in the short run but are highly robust and more pronounced for households with less healthy baseline purchasing patterns. These findings highlight an underexplored channel through which rising temperatures may degrade diet quality, underscoring the potential public health and welfare costs of climate change.
url:3c6936d523587d36.abstract_zh: 气温上升可能会以对营养和公共健康具有重要影响的方式改变日常食品选择。本文研究了短期极端温度暴露如何影响美国家庭杂货购买的结构。利用一个全国代表性的家庭面板数据集，其中包含杂货交易记录并与当地天气信息相匹配，我们利用家庭内部变动，并估计双向固定效应模型以识别因果效应。研究发现，较热的周持续将食品购买转向较不健康的项目，并降低整体饮食质量，而总杂货支出变化不大。相反，异常寒冷的周导致总支出略有增加，但并未显著改变购买的营养构成。这些结果表明，热暴露主要促使家庭将支出重新分配至较不健康的食品，而非改变其支出总额，而冷暴露则主要影响所购杂货的数量。热诱导的食品购买健康性影响在短期内较为温和，但高度稳健，并且对于基线购买模式较不健康的家庭更为显著。这些发现突显了一个未被充分探索的渠道，通过该渠道，气温上升可能降低饮食质量，强调了气候变化潜在的公共健康与福利成本。
url:3c6936d523587d36.title: Can Temperature Shock Lead to Higher Spending on Unhealthy Foods among U.S. Households

url:3c6f3b4959927eaf.abstract: Focus We examine what happens when investors question fiscal sustainability and demand higher sovereign bond yields as compensation for higher risk. We call these episodes fiscal risk shocks. Such shocks can arise, for example, from a government announcing new spending or tax cuts, or from news that worsens its budget outlook. We develop a new method to identify these shocks from daily movements in bond yields. When fiscal concerns intensify, investors retreat from government bonds and shift towards the safest corporate bonds, resulting in negative co-movement in the yields of these bonds. Exploiting this relationship, we extract fiscal risk shocks for 12 economies. We then trace how these shocks propagate through exchange rates, equity markets, inflation and output.
url:3c6f3b4959927eaf.abstract_zh: 焦点  本文研究当投资者质疑财政可持续性并要求更高的主权债券收益率以补偿更高风险时会发生什么。我们将此类事件称为财政风险冲击。例如，此类冲击可能源于政府宣布新增支出或减税，或源于恶化其预算前景的消息。我们开发了一种新方法，通过债券收益率的日常变动来识别这些冲击。当财政担忧加剧时，投资者会从政府债券中撤出，转向最安全的公司债券，导致这些债券收益率出现负向联动。利用这一关系，我们提取了12个经济体的财政风险冲击。随后，我们追踪这些冲击如何通过汇率、股票市场、通胀和产出进行传导。
