url:52a22a9bc9147b63.abstract: This paper presents a critical survey of theories of migration, their welfare and policy implications and their empirical relevance. We also develop some extensions to the theory beginning with a general encompassing model of migration which treats the Harris and Todaro (HT) model as a special case. In particular, we show how standard policy, a reduction of the wage gap between an advanced and a backward region to reduce the rate of migration, follows from the standard model, but ceases to be valid if borrowing constraints on the potential migrant are introduced. The HT model is extended to examine risk-averse behaviour within families where the migration of members of families serves to diversify risk. The welfare implications of the individual migration decision and government intervention in the form of employment subsidies are also examined.
url:52a22a9bc9147b63.abstract_zh: 本文对迁移理论、其福利与政策含义及实证相关性进行了批判性综述。我们首先构建了一个涵盖性迁移模型，将哈里斯-托达罗（HT）模型作为特例纳入其中，并在此基础上对理论进行了若干拓展。具体而言，我们展示了标准政策——即通过缩小发达地区与欠发达地区之间的工资差距来降低迁移率——如何从标准模型中推导得出，但若引入潜在迁移者的借贷约束，该政策便不再有效。此外，我们对HT模型进行了扩展，以考察家庭内部的风险规避行为，其中家庭成员迁移旨在分散风险。本文还探讨了个人迁移决策的福利含义，以及政府以就业补贴形式进行干预的影响。

url:52cca722188771fc.abstract: This paper examines the personal characteristics that determine the extent of Trust in Government, using over 400,000 observations from 97 countries provided by surveys held during the years 1990-2023. These survey data reveal how persons’ individual characteristics influence such trust. Most of these relationships are intuitive, for example that people who are satisfied, secured, immigrants, elderly and female, tend to trust government more. On the other hand, those in employment and living in cities tend to have lower trust, for reasons that we explain. Perhaps our main finding, and the key result of the paper, is that those who obtain their news primarily from traditional sources, i.e. newspapers and television, tend to trust government more, while those who have their main source of information from social media trust government less. We also study whether the geographical location of the respondent influences their Trust in Government. What we find is that the effect of these personal characteristics is remarkably common, wherever the respondent is located, unlike the response to other external economic and geopolitical factors which tend often to vary between one region and another.
url:52cca722188771fc.abstract_zh: 本文利用1990年至2023年间在97个国家进行的调查所获得的超过40万个观测数据，探讨了决定政府信任程度的个人特征。这些调查数据揭示了个人特征如何影响其对政府的信任。多数关系符合直觉，例如，对生活满意、安全感强、移民身份、年长及女性群体往往更倾向于信任政府。相反，就业者及城市居民则表现出较低的信任度，我们对此给出了解释。或许本文的主要发现及核心结论在于，主要从传统媒体（即报纸和电视）获取新闻的个体倾向于更信任政府，而主要依赖社交媒体获取信息的个体则对政府的信任度较低。我们还研究了受访者的地理位置是否影响其对政府的信任。研究发现，无论受访者身处何地，这些个人特征的影响具有显著的普遍性，这与外部经济及地缘政治因素在不同地区间常表现出的差异性反应形成对比。
url:52cca722188771fc.title: The Personal Characteristics that Affect Trust in Government: A Global Analysis Across Regions

url:52e71b839b416c7e.abstract: Standard macroeconomic data do not cleanly separate the systematic and non-systematic components of monetary policy. We show that incorporating unstructured text data into the structural estimation of a DSGE model can sharpen this distinction. We augment a standard state-space model with a non-core measurement block that links structural shocks to time series derived from FOMC transcripts, using a spike-and-slab prior to let the data select which series are informative. In a medium-scale New Keynesian model for the U.S., incorporating text improves predictive performance and materially alters structural inference: the new model estimates a lower response of the policy rate to inflation, higher price stickiness and lower price indexation, implying a flatter and less backward-looking price Phillips curve.
url:52e71b839b416c7e.abstract_zh: 标准宏观经济数据无法清晰区分货币政策的系统性与非系统性成分。我们证明，将非结构化文本数据纳入DSGE模型的结构估计能够强化这一区分。我们通过一个非核心测量模块对标准状态空间模型进行扩展，该模块将结构性冲击与源自联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）会议记录的时序数据相关联，并采用尖峰-板状先验让数据自行选择具有信息量的序列。在美国中等规模新凯恩斯模型中，引入文本数据不仅提升了预测表现，还显著改变了结构性推断：新模型估计的政策利率对通胀的响应更低，价格粘性更高且价格指数化程度更低，这意味着更平坦且更少后顾性的价格菲利普斯曲线。
url:52e71b839b416c7e.title: Structural Estimation with Unstructured Data

url:538bb47d9592c433.abstract: This paper examines how global greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI) flows are evolving amid rising geoeconomic fragmentation. We use difference-in-differences and event study approaches to analyze changes in FDI around key bilateral inflection points. We find a decline in FDI from the US and broader Group of Seven Plus (G7+) into the PRC, concentrated in trade-exposed, efficiency-seeking sectors. Investment diversion—particularly from the PRC to Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) members and Latin America—is evident, but this growth was concentrated in less global value chain (GVC)-integrated activities, suggesting that GVC links may act as a constraint on investment relocation. These findings suggest that while tensions may be reshaping global investment, GVC dependencies are likely limiting firms’ ability to reallocate production at scale, making the “great reallocation” least evident where it was most expected.
url:538bb47d9592c433.abstract_zh: 本文考察了在地缘经济碎片化加剧的背景下，全球绿地外商直接投资（FDI）流动的演变趋势。我们采用双重差分法和事件研究法，分析关键双边关系转折点前后FDI的变化。研究发现，美国及更广泛的七国集团+（G7+）对中国的FDI出现下降，且主要集中在贸易敏感、效率寻求型行业。投资转移现象明显——尤其是从中国流向东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）成员国和拉丁美洲——但这种增长集中于全球价值链（GVC）整合程度较低的活动，表明GVC联系可能对投资重新布局构成制约。这些发现表明，尽管地缘紧张局势可能正在重塑全球投资格局，但GVC依赖关系很可能限制了企业大规模重新配置生产能力，使得“大转移”在最被预期发生的领域反而最不明显。

url:539de14a289c2f19.abstract: Urban overheating is increasingly recognised as a major public health challenge under climate change, yet existing frameworks remain heavily focused on acute medical risk and clinically vulnerable populations. This paper introduces \textit{hidden vulnerability} to describe a broader population who remain socially and economically active under ordinary conditions but experience progressive destabilisation during sustained indoor heat exposure. Drawing on a sensor-enhanced longitudinal housing survey in Southwark, London during the summer of 2023, combining indoor environmental monitoring with weekly health and wellbeing questionnaires, the study examines how overheating affects everyday urban life. The findings reveal that impacts extended well beyond thermal discomfort. Participants described cascading disruptions across physical, functional, and psychological domains, sleep loss, exhaustion, impaired self-care, reduced concentration, emotional strain, and increased caring burdens, that interacted and reinforced one another, progressively eroding the capacity to maintain ordinary routines. Critically, these processes were observed not only among participants with chronic conditions but also among those without formally recognised health vulnerabilities, suggesting that the threshold for destabilisation is lower, and more widely distributed, than existing frameworks assume. The paper argues that hidden vulnerability is an urban condition, produced by the intersection of housing quality, social infrastructure, and accumulated disadvantage. The response calls for a conceptual framework for redefining heat vulnerability beyond demographic and clinical categories, and an empirical foundation for a social cure approach to urban heat governance.
url:539de14a289c2f19.abstract_zh: 城市过热日益被视为气候变化下的一项重大公共健康挑战，然而现有研究框架仍高度聚焦于急性医疗风险及临床意义上的脆弱人群。本文提出"隐性脆弱性"概念，用以描述在常规条件下保持社会与经济活跃、但持续暴露于室内高温时经历渐进式失稳的广泛人群。基于2023年夏季在伦敦南华克区开展的传感器增强型纵向住房调查，结合室内环境监测与每周健康福祉问卷，本研究考察了过热对日常城市生活的影响。研究结果表明，其影响远超热不适范畴。参与者描述了身体、功能及心理层面的级联式干扰——睡眠剥夺、疲惫、自我照护能力受损、注意力下降、情绪压力及照护负担加重——这些因素相互交织、彼此强化，逐步侵蚀维持日常活动的能力。关键的是，这些过程不仅出现在患有慢性疾病的参与者中，也出现在无正式认定的健康脆弱性的参与者中，表明失稳阈值低于现有框架假设，且分布更为广泛。本文认为，隐性脆弱性是一种城市状态，由住房质量、社会基础设施与累积劣势的交织作用所产生。应对策略要求构建超越人口统计与临床分类的热脆弱性概念框架，并为城市热治理的社会疗愈路径提供实证基础。

url:53a77a4a134040b4.abstract: This paper studies whether countries with larger foreign exchange and gold reserve buffers exhibit smaller exchange-rate responses to US monetary policy surprises. We test a central-bank reserve balance-sheet channel in which large reserve stocks can deter speculative pressure by signaling credible dollar-liquidity capacity, collateral value, and future intervention capacity, even without contemporaneous reserve sales. For identification, we use high-frequency FOMC monetary surprises, minute-level exchange rates, and predetermined reserve holdings for 18 countries. Countries with larger dollar reserves exhibit smaller exchange-rate depreciations after US monetary tightening, while non-dollar reserves do not display the same pattern. Gold reserves are also associated with smaller depreciations. These buffer effects are concentrated in countries without swap and repo lines and are strongest where dollar exposure, especially external dollar liabilities, is larger. The results show that reserve composition and access to dollar liquidity facilities, not only aggregate reserve size, are empirically relevant for exchange-rate resilience.
url:53a77a4a134040b4.abstract_zh: 本文研究外汇与黄金储备缓冲规模较大的国家，其汇率对美国货币政策意外变动的反应是否较小。我们检验了一个央行储备资产负债表渠道，即大规模储备存量可通过传递可信的美元流动性能力、抵押品价值及未来干预能力来抑制投机压力，即便当期并未动用储备进行销售。为识别因果效应，我们利用高频联邦公开市场委员会货币政策意外、分钟级汇率数据以及18个国家的预定储备持有量。美元储备较多的国家在美国货币政策收紧后汇率贬值幅度较小，而非美元储备则未呈现相同模式。黄金储备亦与较小幅度的贬值相关联。这些缓冲效应集中于未获得互换和回购额度的国家，且在美元敞口，尤其是外部美元负债较大的情况下最为显著。结果表明，储备构成及美元流动性便利的获取渠道，而非仅储备总量，对汇率韧性具有实证相关性。

url:5431d48705a9677c.abstract: We study how subjective survival beliefs and financial literacy jointly shape saving and portfolio decisions later in life. Using data from the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing, we document that individuals who underestimate their survival probabilities are less likely to participate in risky financial markets. To identify the underlying mechanisms, we conduct a randomized survey experiment that cross-randomizes survival and financial literacy interventions and independently randomizes participation costs. Survival literacy updates subjective longevity beliefs, whereas financial literacy increases risky-asset participation by attenuating the deterrent effect of participation costs. We then build a heterogeneous-agent life-cycle model to evaluate survey-informed, revenue-neutral policy interventions. The counterfactuals show that financial literacy is the main driver of market entry, while survival literacy is complementary to financial literacy in raising the share of wealth invested in risky assets; only survival literacy, however, delivers positive welfare gains once financing costs are taken into account.
url:5431d48705a9677c.abstract_zh: 我们研究了主观生存信念与金融素养如何共同影响晚年储蓄及投资组合决策。利用英国老龄化纵向研究数据，我们发现低估自身生存概率的个体参与风险金融市场的可能性较低。为识别潜在机制，我们开展了一项随机调查实验，该实验交叉随机化生存干预与金融素养干预，并独立随机化参与成本。生存素养更新了主观寿命预期，而金融素养通过削弱参与成本的阻碍效应来提高风险资产参与度。随后，我们构建了一个异质性主体生命周期模型，以评估基于调查信息且收入中性的政策干预。反事实分析表明，金融素养是市场进入的主要驱动力，而生存素养在提高风险资产财富占比方面对金融素养具有互补作用；然而，仅生存素养在考虑融资成本后能带来正向福利收益。

url:547acc4e777eacc9.abstract: We study the short-run macroeconomic transmission of a US–China tariff war in an open economy multi-sector New Keynesian model with input–output linkages, sectoral nominal rigidities, and heterogeneous currency invoicing. A reciprocal 10 percentage-point tariff increase generates asymmetric incidence: the tariff-imposing country bears more of the inflationary burden, while the targeted country experiences the larger output contraction. Production networks amplify this contraction by propagating the shock beyond the directly tariffed bilateral margin. Currency invoicing further shapes transmission. Under heterogeneous invoicing, dollar-priced border prices weaken the expenditure-switching role of exchange rates, deepening the contraction in China relative to producer-currency pricing and altering third-country spillovers. The EA response is small in the aggregate, but only because positive trade-diversion margins are offset by weaker demand from China and multilateral adjustments. We then exploit the model’s sectoral structure by imposing tariffs on one Chinese sector at a time. Sectoral incidence is highly concentrated, but aggregate effects cannot be inferred from the directly tariffed sector alone: domestic propagation offsets own-sector gains in the US, reinforces own-sector losses in China, and leaves the EA as a net object shaped by opposing trade margins. The results show that tariff incidence depends jointly on where the tariff lands, how the shock propagates through production networks, and how invoicing governs border-price adjustment. A framework that combines these margins delivers a materially different assessment from one built on bilateral trade shares alone. JEL Classification: E31, E32, E52, F13, F41, F42
url:547acc4e777eacc9.abstract_zh: 我们研究中美关税战在开放经济多部门新凯恩斯模型中的短期宏观经济传导，该模型包含投入产出关联、部门名义刚性和异质性货币计价。互征10个百分点关税会产生不对称的归宿效应：征收关税的国家承担更多通胀压力，而目标国家则经历更大的产出收缩。生产网络通过将冲击传播至直接受关税影响的双边边际之外，放大了这种收缩。货币计价进一步塑造了传导机制。在异质性计价下，美元计价的边境价格削弱了汇率的支出转换作用，相较于生产者货币计价，加深了中国的产出收缩，并改变了第三国的溢出效应。欧元区的总体反应较小，但这仅仅是因为正向的贸易转移边际被来自中国的需求减弱和多边调整所抵消。随后，我们利用模型的部门结构，逐一对中国单个部门征收关税。部门层面的归宿高度集中，但总体效应无法仅从直接受关税影响的部门推断：国内传播抵消了美国本部门的收益，强化了中国本部门的损失，并使欧元区成为由相反贸易边际塑造的净对象。结果表明，关税归宿共同取决于关税落点、冲击通过生产网络的传播方式，以及计价机制如何主导边境价格调整。一个综合这些边际的框架得出的评估，与仅基于双边贸易份额的框架存在实质性差异。JEL分类号：E31, E32, E52, F13, F41, F42

url:549e2a111dfd1fcd.abstract: Using firm-bank linked data for 10 Asian emerging market economies (EMEs) over 2005–2021, we study the domestic and cross-border implications of zombie firms. We document three main findings. First, the number of zombie firms in emerging Asia has increased significantly over the past 15 years, sustained by evergreening practices from weak banks. Second, zombie prevalence domestically depresses firm performance, crowds out healthy firms, and depresses inflation and GDP growth. Third, the macroeconomic effects of zombie firms extend across borders: expo sure to zombie firms in Asian EMEs significantly reduces inflation and growth in advanced economies. These spillover effects operate mainly through global value chains (GVCs) and an intermediate goods import price channel, while cross-border bank linkages do not play any major role.
url:549e2a111dfd1fcd.abstract_zh: 利用2005至2021年间10个亚洲新兴市场经济体（EMEs）的企业-银行关联数据，我们研究了僵尸企业在国内及跨境层面的影响。我们记录了三个主要发现。第一，过去15年间，亚洲新兴市场中的僵尸企业数量显著增加，这得益于弱质银行的持续注资行为。第二，僵尸企业在国内的存在抑制了企业绩效，挤出了健康企业，并压低了通货膨胀和GDP增长。第三，僵尸企业的宏观经济效应跨越国界：亚洲新兴市场中的僵尸企业敞口显著降低了发达经济体的通胀和增长。这些溢出效应主要通过全球价值链（GVCs）和中间品进口价格渠道发挥作用，而跨境银行联系并未扮演重要角色。

url:54ee6d80c7f14df9.abstract: While the COVID-19 pandemic is affecting all countries, output losses vary considerably across countries. We provide a first analysis of robust determinants of observed initial output losses using model-averaging techniques—Weighted Average Least Squares and Bayesian Model Averaging. The results suggest that countries that experienced larger output losses are those with lower GDP per capita, more stringent containment measures, higher deaths per capita, higher tourism dependence, more liberalized financial markets, higher pre-crisis growth, lower fiscal stimulus, higher ethnic and religious fractionalization and more democratic regimes. With respect to the first factor, lower resilience of poorer countries reflects the higher economic costs of containment measures and deaths in such countries and less effective fiscal and monetary policy stimulus.
url:54ee6d80c7f14df9.abstract_zh: 尽管新冠疫情影响了所有国家，但各国的产出损失差异显著。我们运用模型平均技术——加权平均最小二乘法与贝叶斯模型平均法，首次分析了观察到的初始产出损失的稳健决定因素。结果表明，产出损失较大的国家具有以下特征：人均GDP较低、防控措施更为严格、人均死亡人数较高、旅游业依赖度较高、金融市场更为自由化、危机前增长较快、财政刺激力度较小、种族与宗教分裂程度较高以及民主制度较为成熟。就第一个因素而言，较贫穷国家韧性较低，反映了这些国家防控措施和死亡带来的更高经济成本，以及财政和货币政策刺激效果较弱。

url:551d1504b8cde08e.abstract: This paper studies the role of global banks as a source of shocks to global liquidity. Shifts in global liquidity can drive cross-border flows, asset prices, and exchange rates, with implications for financial stability. While the existing literature emphasizes global banks as amplifiers of global shocks, I provide causal evidence that idiosyncratic leverage shocks to these institutions loosen global liquidity conditions. The analysis exploits the high concentration of global banking to construct a Granular Instrumental Variable from the size-weighted sum of bank-level idiosyncratic leverage shocks. These shocks are estimated using Instrumented Principal Component Analysis, using observable bank characteristics (e.g., size, profitability, liquidity, and risk metrics) as instruments to account for bank-specific and time-varying exposures to common global factors. Using the instrument and panel local projections, I estimate the dynamic causal effects of these banks’ leverage shocks on key global liquidity measures for an unbalanced panel of 74 advanced and emerging market economies from 2000Q1 to 2022Q4. Positive shocks to global banks’ leverage significantly appreciate exchange rates against the dollar, reduce US dollar-denominated bond spreads, and increase gross cross-border inflows. Significant effects on total cross-border flows indicate broader spillovers across asset markets. These findings underscore the systemic relevance of G-SIBs in driving global financial conditions and support macro-financial models where financial intermediaries’ leverage is a key state variable influencing risk-taking and asset prices. By showing that global banks can originate, rather than merely transmit, global shocks, this paper adds to the literature on the global financial cycle and the international transmission of financial conditions.
url:551d1504b8cde08e.abstract_zh: 本文研究了全球银行作为全球流动性冲击来源的作用。全球流动性的变化能够驱动跨境资本流动、资产价格及汇率变动，并对金融稳定产生影响。尽管现有文献强调全球银行是放大全球冲击的渠道，本文提供了因果证据，表明这些机构特有的杠杆冲击会放宽全球流动性条件。分析利用全球银行业的高度集中性，通过银行层面特有杠杆冲击的规模加权总和构建了一个粒度工具变量。这些冲击采用工具变量主成分分析法进行估计，利用可观测的银行特征（如规模、盈利能力、流动性和风险指标）作为工具，以考虑银行特定及随时间变化的对共同全球因素的暴露。结合该工具与面板局部投影法，本文估算了2000年第一季度至2022年第四季度期间，74个发达经济体和新兴市场经济体组成的不平衡面板中，这些银行杠杆冲击对关键全球流动性指标的动态因果效应。全球银行杠杆的正向冲击显著使汇率对美元升值，降低美元计价债券利差，并增加总跨境流入。对总跨境流动的显著影响表明，冲击在资产市场间存在更广泛的溢出效应。这些发现强调了全球系统重要性银行在驱动全球金融状况中的系统性重要性，并支持金融中介杠杆作为影响风险承担和资产价格的关键状态变量的宏观金融模型。通过证明全球银行能够引发而非仅仅传导全球冲击，本文为全球金融周期及金融状况国际传导的相关文献做出了贡献。
url:551d1504b8cde08e.title: Global Banks’ Leverage and Global Liquidity

url:5548f04cb377eac0.abstract: This paper presents theoretical arguments and empirical evidence from British manufacturing for the view that the first of these is the most serious with important dimensions in the measurement of capital and output as well as that of utilization. New light is shed on two classic questions. One was first raised by Feldstein (1967) who observed in a cross-section context that the elasticity of output w. r. t. average observed hours of work significantly exceeded the elasticity w. r. t. employment. Craine (1973) observed a similar result for time-series data. The other question is one with which most researchers on productivity have struggled: how to correct productivity for cyclical variations in the utlization of inputs. A novel answer based on the use of overtime hours data is found to give excellent empirical results.
url:5548f04cb377eac0.abstract_zh: 本文从理论论证和英国制造业的经验证据出发，认为上述第一个问题最为严重，且在资本与产出的测度以及利用率维度上均具有重要影响。研究为两个经典问题提供了新视角。其一是由Feldstein（1967）首次提出，他在横截面分析中发现，产出相对于平均观测工时弹性显著高于相对于就业弹性；Craine（1973）在时间序列数据中也观察到类似结果。另一个问题是大多数生产率研究者长期面临的挑战：如何校正投入要素利用率周期性波动对生产率的影响。本文基于加班工时数据提出创新性解决方案，实证结果表现优异。

url:556b6b2fe848eabf.abstract: We provide new estimates of the return on US external claims and liabilities using confidential, high-quality, security-level data. The excess return is positive on average, since claims are relatively more tilted toward higher-return equities. The excess return is large and positive in normal times and large and negative during global crises, reflecting the global insurance role of the US external balance sheet. With an increased frequency of global crises, the excess return has declined over the recent period. When controlling for issuer's nationality, US investors have larger exposure to equity issued by Asia-headquartered corporations than reported in aggregate statistics. Equity portfolios are concentrated in 'superstar' firms, but for US liabilities foreign holdings are less concentrated than the overall market.
url:556b6b2fe848eabf.abstract_zh: 我们利用保密、高质量、证券层面的数据，对美国外部债权与负债的回报率提供了新的估计。平均而言，超额回报为正，因为债权相对更倾向于高回报的股权。在正常时期，超额回报大且为正，而在全球危机期间则大且为负，这反映了美国外部资产负债表的全球保险作用。随着全球危机频率的增加，近期超额回报有所下降。在控制发行人国籍后，美国投资者对总部位于亚洲的公司发行的股权敞口大于汇总统计数据所显示的水平。股权组合集中于“超级明星”企业，但对于美国负债而言，外国持有集中度低于整体市场。

url:557baced4b843cdb.abstract: Voters in multiparty systems often fail to coordinate on majority-preferred parties. Using constituency-level election data linked to party-ideology measures across 96 countries, we show that in 20–30% of multiparty elections since 1940 the Condorcet winner does not win, and in roughly 10% the winner is the Condorcet loser. Failures are most common under plurality rule and in fragmented, volatile party systems, and systematically disadvantage opposition and culturally liberal parties while benefiting organizationally strong ones. Can information fix this? In four pre-registered experiments around Indian elections (N > 4,000), constituency-level polls shift voting intentions by at most 2 percentage points, a precisely estimated null, despite modest belief updating, though undecided voters become 7 points more likely to support a viable party. A model with expressive motives rationalizes both results: polls refine beliefs but lack the leverage to overcome entrenched attachments, identifying boundary conditions on polls as coordination devices.
url:557baced4b843cdb.abstract_zh: 在多党制中，选民往往难以协调支持多数偏好的政党。通过将96个国家的选区级选举数据与政党意识形态指标相关联，我们发现自1940年以来，20%至30%的多党选举中孔多塞胜者未能获胜，约10%的选举中胜者实为孔多塞败者。此类失败在单一选区制、碎片化且不稳定的政党体系中最为常见，并系统性地不利于反对党及文化自由主义政党，而有利于组织力量强大的政党。信息能否解决这一问题？在围绕印度选举开展的四项预注册实验中（样本量>4000），选区级民调对投票意向的影响至多为2个百分点——这一精确估计的零效应，尽管存在适度的信念更新，但未决选民支持可行政党的概率提升了7个百分点。一个包含表达性动机的模型可同时解释这两项结果：民调虽能修正信念，却缺乏克服根深蒂固依附关系的杠杆作用，从而界定了民调作为协调机制的条件边界。
url:557baced4b843cdb.title: DP21790 Majority Lost: Global Evidence and Field Experiments on Electoral Miscoordination
url:557baced4b843cdb.title_zh: DP21790 多数派失利：选举协调失灵的全球证据与实地实验

url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.abstract: The macroeconomic theory that is taught in graduate schools, and used in the conduct of monetary and fiscal policy around the world today, emerged from a revolution in economics that was led by Ned Phelps. This column discusses Phelps’s theoretical contributions and how they created a micro foundation for macroeconomics.
url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.abstract_zh: 如今研究生院教授并被全球用于货币与财政政策制定的宏观经济理论，源于由内德·菲尔普斯引领的经济学革命。本文探讨了菲尔普斯的理论贡献，以及这些贡献如何为宏观经济学奠定了微观基础。
url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.title: Ned Phelps and modern macroeconomics
url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.title_zh: 内德·菲尔普斯与现代宏观经济学

url:55907d5000df2527.abstract: Accurate stock price forecasting has consistently remained a pivotal yet challenging FinTech task that underpins quantitative trading and investment decision making. Recent efforts have been dedicated to modeling various complex relationships among stocks in the stock market toward more reliable stock price forecasting.These methods depend heavily on strong static prior assumptions by modeling either temporal dependencies within individual stocks or spatial dependencies across different stocks based on predefined structures, while the complex market dynamics that drive stock price movements remain unexplored. To alleviate this issue, we propose a novel game-theoretic modeling method that captures heterogeneous investor interactions for stock price forecasting. The core idea is to embed game-theoretic mechanisms into the heterogeneous graph structure to finely model the dynamic strategic interactions among heterogeneous investors with respect to target stocks. Additionally, temporal positional encoding is adopted to reflect the differentiated influences of each game event at different time steps within the time window on future stock price movements. Leveraging heterogeneous graph networks, we proxy the intricate dynamics of the stock market through investor games and enable real-time information propagation and node updates among all nodes. Extensive experiments conducted on two real-world benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method effectively outperforms state-of-the-art stock price forecasting methods.
url:55907d5000df2527.abstract_zh: 准确的股票价格预测一直是支撑量化交易与投资决策的关键且具有挑战性的金融科技任务。近期研究致力于建模股票市场中各类复杂关系，以实现更可靠的股价预测。这些方法高度依赖强静态先验假设，要么基于预定义结构建模单只股票的时间依赖性，要么建模不同股票间的空间依赖性，但驱动股价波动的复杂市场动态仍未被充分探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种新颖的博弈论建模方法，通过捕捉异质投资者互动来实现股价预测。其核心思想是将博弈论机制嵌入异质图结构，精细建模目标股票相关异质投资者间的动态策略互动。此外，采用时间位置编码来反映时间窗口内不同时间步的博弈事件对未来股价波动的差异化影响。借助异质图网络，我们通过投资者博弈代理股票市场的复杂动态，实现所有节点间的实时信息传播与节点更新。在两个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法有效超越了现有最优的股价预测方法。

url:55a5d3028a7d40f5.abstract: This paper examines whether regulatory liquidity buffers enable banks to support corporate borrowers during financial stress. Using confidential bank-firm credit data and handcollected Liquidity Coverage Ratio regulation (LCR) disclosures during COVID-19, we find that banks with higher LCR buffers above the regulatory minimum provided significantly more credit to firms with large undrawn credit lines in March 2020. Critically, only buffers, not overall LCR levels, matter, revealing that the regulatory minimum operates as a binding constraint during stress. The effect is concentrated among high-quality borrowers with clean credit profiles and disappears by mid-2020, confirming that LCR buffers provide selective, temporary liquidity insurance during acute stress.
url:55a5d3028a7d40f5.abstract_zh: 本文考察了监管流动性缓冲是否能使银行在金融压力时期为企业借款人提供支持。利用新冠疫情期间的机密银行-企业信贷数据及手工收集的流动性覆盖率（LCR）监管披露信息，我们发现，在2020年3月，LCR缓冲高于监管最低要求的银行，向拥有大量未提取信贷额度的企业提供了显著更多的信贷。关键在于，只有缓冲水平而非整体LCR水平产生影响，这表明监管最低要求在压力时期构成了具有约束力的限制。这一效应集中于信用记录良好的高质量借款人，并在2020年年中消失，证实了LCR缓冲在严重压力时期提供了选择性、临时性的流动性保险。
url:55a5d3028a7d40f5.title: The Last Taxi: LCR Buffers and Bank Liquidity Provision
url:55a5d3028a7d40f5.title_zh: 最后的出租车：流动性覆盖率缓冲与银行流动性供给

url:55bc1fb36be56faa.abstract: In response to rising urban air pollution, European cities have adopted Low Emission Zones (LEZs), restricting the most polluting vehicles. While effective in improving air quality, these policies remain controversial due to concerns over fairness and acceptability. This paper examines the impact of London’s 2021 and 2023 Ultra Low Emission Zone (ULEZ) expansions on Subjective Well-Being (SWB). Using panel data from the UK Household Longitudinal Study and a staggered difference-in-differences design with individual and year fixed effects, we compare changes in life satisfaction among residents inside and outside the affected areas. We find that the 2021 expansion led to a decline in life satisfaction by approximately 0.4 points. We explore the mechanisms driving this decline and find that the well-being loss is mediated by car dependency and transport mode availability. While the policy increased reliance on public transport, we show that a better accessibility to public transport mitigates the decline in life satisfaction among London residents. Furthermore, we show that the well-being costs of the policy are regressive, disproportionately affecting lower-income households. These findings suggest that LEZs can generate short-term and unequal well-being costs despite achieving modest behavioural change, highlighting the need for complementary measures to enhance social acceptability.
url:55bc1fb36be56faa.abstract_zh: 针对城市空气污染日益加剧的问题，欧洲城市采取了低排放区（LEZs）措施，限制高污染车辆的使用。尽管这些政策在改善空气质量方面成效显著，但因其公平性与可接受性方面的担忧而备受争议。本文考察了伦敦2021年及2023年超低排放区（ULEZ）扩展对主观幸福感（SWB）的影响。利用英国家庭纵向研究的面板数据，并采用包含个体及年份固定效应的交错双重差分设计，我们比较了受影响区域内外居民生活满意度的变化。研究发现，2021年的扩展导致生活满意度下降约0.4个百分点。我们进一步探究了这一下降背后的机制，发现幸福感损失受汽车依赖度及交通方式可用性的中介作用影响。尽管政策增加了对公共交通的依赖，但研究表明，更好的公共交通可达性能够缓解伦敦居民生活满意度的下降。此外，我们还发现该政策的幸福感成本具有累退性，对低收入家庭的影响尤为显著。这些发现表明，低排放区在实现适度行为改变的同时，可能产生短期且不平等的幸福感成本，凸显了采取补充措施以增强社会可接受性的必要性。
url:55bc1fb36be56faa.title: The Well-Being Costs of Low Emission Zones: Evidence from London's ULEZ Expansions
url:55bc1fb36be56faa.title_zh: 低排放区的福利成本：来自伦敦ULEZ扩展的证据

url:55c3842b51bbf2dc.abstract: We examine the potential role of international agreements on product standards through a stylized model where countries have different regulatory preferences and firms incur fixed costs of regulatory diversity. Overall, our analysis suggests that the common perception of regulatory agreements as playing a key role in promoting harmonization may have been over- stated. We show that regulatory harmony can arise even in the absence of an agreement, and that “spontaneous” harmonization may be inefficient, suggesting that the role of regulatory agreements could be to promote regulatory diversity rather than harmonization. Moreover, the role of regulatory cooperation depends in important ways on the pattern of trade: in the presence of intra-industry trade, the potential role of an agreement tends to be more limited, and under some conditions it can only play a coordination role. Finally, through the lens of our model, we examine the “Pop Critique” of regulatory agreements, according to which lobbying by corporate interests may lead to welfare-reducing harmonization. Our analysis lends only limited support to this critique.
url:55c3842b51bbf2dc.abstract_zh: 我们通过一个风格化模型探讨了国际产品标准协议可能发挥的作用，在该模型中，各国具有不同的监管偏好，而企业则需承担监管多样性的固定成本。总体而言，我们的分析表明，关于监管协议在促进协调统一方面发挥关键作用的普遍看法可能被夸大了。我们证明，即使在没有协议的情况下，监管和谐也可能出现，而“自发”的和谐可能效率低下，这表明监管协议的作用或许在于促进监管多样性而非统一。此外，监管合作的作用在很大程度上取决于贸易模式：在存在产业内贸易的情况下，协议潜在作用往往更为有限，并且在某些条件下，它只能发挥协调作用。最后，通过我们模型的视角，我们审视了针对监管协议的“大众批评”，该批评认为企业利益的游说可能导致福利降低的和谐化。我们的分析对此批评仅提供了有限的支持。
url:55c3842b51bbf2dc.title: DP19840 Harmonization. . . What Else? The Role for International Regulatory Agreements
url:55c3842b51bbf2dc.title_zh: DP19840 协调一致……还有何其他？国际监管协定的作用

url:55c5b03346c60c24.title: Income distribution, taxation and shifting in a federal fiscal structure
url:55c5b03346c60c24.title_zh: 联邦财政结构中的收入分配、税收与转移

url:55c9307c9f7c952c.abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage, into which they may be reincarnated. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line. These findings suggest that high fertility in sub-Saharan Africa rests on moral foundations that standard, externally designed interventions tend to overlook.
url:55c9307c9f7c952c.abstract_zh: 传统人口模型系统性地高估了撒哈拉以南非洲地区的生育率下降趋势。本文提出一种基于普遍存在但研究不足的信仰体系的补充性解释：祖先会影响生者，并寻求其血脉的延续，而祖先可能通过转世回归这一血脉。在这种世界观中，生育子女成为一项道德与集体义务，根植于确保血脉存续的精神责任。通过利用一手数据、新颖的民族志信息以及历史与当代调查，我记录了祖先信仰与生育率之间在不同情境与时间跨度中呈现的强烈且数量显著的正向关联。一个将子女视为血脉公共品的简单模型，合理化了数据中观察到的模式：祖先信仰对生育率的影响集中于父系社会，且兄弟姐妹之间出现一种特定形式的搭便车行为——其子女延续同一家族血脉。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲的高生育率建立在道德基础之上，而标准的外部干预设计往往忽视了这一点。

url:55d4feaa14998470.abstract: This paper examines whether financial incentives for general practitioners (GPs) can effectively replace patient cost-sharing within a gatekeeper healthcare system in which the GP regulates access to specialist care. We estimate the effects of incentives provided to GPs by exploiting a field experiment in which treated GPs received a share of the cost savings they achieved. There was also a set of control practices. The patient population includes about 26,000 individuals and is largely representative of the overall population in the Netherlands. We estimate the effects of incentives for patients provided by a deductible using a simulated instrumental variables approach. For both sets of analyses, we use the same measures of healthcare costs, the same time period, and the same population of patients. Our findings show that the incentives provided to GPs reduce costs by 4.3 percent, mainly by decreasing less-urgent specialist care. A small patient deductible of 375 euros per year reduces costs by 27.8 percent in each month in which patients still have to pay out-of-pocket and 10.4 percent at the annual level, impacting all types of care. In contrast, physicians discriminate by type and priority of care. We do not find clear patterns for the interaction of incentives provided to GPs and patients. Our results suggest that GP incentives may complement but not fully replace patient deductibles in managing healthcare costs effectively.
url:55d4feaa14998470.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在守门人医疗体系中，全科医生（GPs）的财务激励能否有效替代患者费用分摊，其中全科医生负责调控专科医疗的准入。我们利用一项实地实验来估计对全科医生提供的激励效应，实验中受激励的全科医生可获得其实现的成本节约份额，同时设有对照组诊所。患者群体约包含26,000人，在很大程度上代表了荷兰总体人口。我们采用模拟工具变量方法，估计了由免赔额提供的患者激励效应。对于两组分析，我们使用了相同的医疗成本衡量指标、相同的时间段以及相同的患者群体。研究结果显示，对全科医生提供的激励使成本降低了4.3%，主要通过减少非紧急专科医疗服务实现。每年375欧元的小额患者免赔额在患者仍需自付费用的月份中每月降低成本27.8%，年度水平上降低10.4%，影响所有类型的医疗服务。相比之下，医生会根据护理类型和优先级进行区分。我们未发现全科医生与患者激励交互作用的明确模式。我们的结果表明，在有效管理医疗成本方面，全科医生激励可能补充但无法完全替代患者免赔额。
url:55d4feaa14998470.title: Is physician cost-sharing an alternative to patient cost-sharing?
url:55d4feaa14998470.title_zh: 医生费用分担能否替代患者费用分担？

url:55f406cc6b906572.title: Strategic Submissions: An Analysis of Supplemental Drug Approvals
url:55f406cc6b906572.title_zh: 策略性提交：补充药物批准的分析

url:55fcfa08b82db855.abstract: Much of the controversy about labour migration concerns an aspect which is not easily measured, the 'quality' of the flow. The first part of the paper applies logit analysis to a sample of emigrants from an Irish border county for some insight on the issue. The results suggest that while those who leave are relatively better educated than their neighbours, kinship variables such as parental attitudes and emigrant sponsors, are also important. The second part of the paper weighs 'life-cycle' losses from post-war Irish migration against receipts from emigrant tourism and remittances. It turns out that these items make a big dent in the losses.
url:55fcfa08b82db855.abstract_zh: 关于劳动力迁移的诸多争议集中于一个难以衡量的方面，即迁移流的“质量”。论文第一部分运用逻辑回归分析，对来自爱尔兰边境郡的移民样本进行考察，以探究该问题。结果表明，尽管离境者相较于其邻人受教育程度更高，但亲属关系变量（如父母态度与移民担保人）同样具有重要影响。第二部分则权衡了战后爱尔兰移民的“生命周期”损失与移民旅游及汇款收入。结果显示，这些收入显著抵消了部分损失。
url:55fcfa08b82db855.title: DP52 On Two Aspects of Post-War Irish Emigration
url:55fcfa08b82db855.title_zh: DP52 论战后爱尔兰移民的两个方面

url:560211faf8528205.abstract: This paper proposes a sign-narrative VAR approach to identifying financial shocks in currency markets. The approach imposes minimal sign restrictions shared across canonical exchange rate models, leveraging their key insights while remaining robust to misspecification relative to structural models typically used in the literature. To sharpen the identification, sign restrictions are complemented with narrative restrictions anchored on episodes of well documented FX market dysfunction. Focusing on two emerging economies (Brazil and Chile), our estimates suggest that financial shocks account for about one third of UIP fluctuations, and contribute less than 10% to the variance of macro variables including output and inflation. While infrequent, when they do materialize, financial shocks trigger sharp declines in output, suggesting economically meaningful spillovers from frictions in currency markets to the real economy.
url:560211faf8528205.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种符号叙事向量自回归方法，用于识别货币市场中的金融冲击。该方法施加了跨经典汇率模型共享的最小符号限制，利用其关键见解，同时相对于文献中通常使用的结构模型，对错误设定保持稳健性。为增强识别的精确性，符号限制辅以基于文献记载充分的汇率市场功能障碍事件的叙事限制。聚焦于两个新兴经济体（巴西和智利），我们的估计表明，金融冲击解释了约三分之一的未抛补利率平价波动，并对包括产出和通胀在内的宏观变量方差贡献不足10%。尽管这些冲击不频繁，但一旦发生，便会引发产出的急剧下降，暗示货币市场摩擦对实体经济具有经济意义上的显著溢出效应。
url:560211faf8528205.title: Financial Shocks in Currency Markets: Evidence from UIP Premia
url:560211faf8528205.title_zh: 货币市场中的金融冲击：来自UIP溢价的经验证据

url:560bf8c5f1b72ed6.abstract: Digital platforms allocate buyer attention across sellers that differ in quality and breadth of appeal. We study a monopoly platform that sets meeting rates between buyers and two seller types --- niche sellers whose high-quality good is valued by a fraction of buyers and mass-market sellers whose good is valued by all. Sellers compete by posting prices à la Burdett and Judd (1983), so buyer surplus requires competition, while platform revenue requires seller rents. This difference creates a systematic distortion: as search capacity grows, the platform keeps high-quality niche attention just past the point where extra exposure stops creating rents and starts eroding them — its saturation point — and diverts the rest to mass-market sellers. The resulting buyer-surplus loss converges to a finite limit proportional to the quality gap between the two goods, split equally between an allocative loss from too little high-quality exposure and excess rent extracted by sellers. Applying the model to Amazon product search and Google passage-ranking data indicates that, for captive buyers, both platforms operate past the saturation point, with buyer-surplus losses of 63 and 44 percent of the planner's benchmark, respectively. Allowing buyer participation to respond to the platform's recommendation strategy disciplines the platform and shrinks this loss.
url:560bf8c5f1b72ed6.abstract_zh: 数字平台在质量与吸引力广度各异的卖家之间分配买家注意力。我们研究了一个垄断平台，该平台设定买家与两类卖家之间的匹配率——利基卖家（其高质量商品仅被部分买家青睐）与大众市场卖家（其商品被所有买家青睐）。卖家按照Burdett和Judd（1983）的模型进行价格竞争，因此买家剩余依赖于竞争，而平台收入则依赖于卖家租金。这一差异造成了系统性扭曲：随着搜索能力的增长，平台将高质量利基卖家的注意力维持在刚好超过额外曝光不再创造租金、反而开始侵蚀租金的临界点——即其饱和点——并将剩余注意力转移给大众市场卖家。由此导致的买家剩余损失收敛于一个有限极限，该极限与两种商品的质量差距成正比，并均分为两部分：高质量曝光不足造成的配置损失，以及卖家攫取的超额租金。将该模型应用于亚马逊产品搜索与谷歌段落排名数据后发现，对于被锁定的买家而言，两个平台的运营均已超过饱和点，买家剩余损失分别达到规划者基准水平的63%和44%。允许买家参与度对平台推荐策略做出反应，能够约束平台行为并缩小这一损失。
url:560bf8c5f1b72ed6.title: DP21637 Platform-Controlled Search and Distortions in Attention Allocation
url:560bf8c5f1b72ed6.title_zh: DP21637 平台控制的搜索与注意力分配中的扭曲

url:5617c7fb0be9e0ac.abstract: Large cities worldwide have adopted congestion pricing to reduce urban traffic, with well-documented benefits for travel speeds, accident rates, and air quality. This paper identifies a novel external benefit: faster emergency medical service (EMS) response times. We provide the first evidence on how the congestion pricing program in New York City – the first comprehensive cordon-based congestion pricing system in the U.S. that was implemented on January 5th, 2025 – affects EMS performance. Exploiting the sharp geographic boundary of New York City’s congestion relief zone at 60th Street and a difference-in-discontinuities design, we first document substantial changes in traffic and mobility near the boundary: vehicular traffic declines by roughly 18 to 21 percent, accompanied by increases in pedestrian and bicycle activity. Consistent with these first-stage mechanisms, we find that congestion pricing improves EMS performance, reducing total travel times by 63–70 seconds (approximately 5–6 percent). Effects emerged quickly and show little evidence of displacement to adjacent areas. A concurrent FDNY directive requiring transport to the nearest hospital confounds standard difference-in-differences estimates but not our boundary-based design. These findings suggest that cost-benefit analyses of congestion pricing systematically understate net social benefits by omitting emergency response improvements.
url:5617c7fb0be9e0ac.abstract_zh: 全球各大城市已普遍采用拥堵收费政策以减少城市交通拥堵，其在提升通行速度、降低事故率及改善空气质量方面的效益已有充分文献佐证。本文识别出一项新型外部效益：急救医疗服务响应时间的缩短。我们首次提供了关于纽约市拥堵收费计划——美国首个于2025年1月5日实施的综合性区域拥堵收费系统——如何影响急救医疗服务绩效的证据。利用纽约市拥堵缓解区在第60街的清晰地理边界及断点回归设计，我们首先记录了边界附近交通与出行模式的显著变化：机动车流量下降约18%至21%，同时伴随步行与自行车活动的增加。与这些第一阶段机制相一致，我们发现拥堵收费改善了急救医疗服务绩效，将总行程时间缩短63至70秒（约5%至6%）。该效应迅速显现，且几乎没有证据表明其向邻近区域转移。纽约市消防局同时实施的将患者送往最近医院的指令混淆了传统双重差分估计结果，但未影响基于边界的识别设计。这些发现表明，拥堵收费的成本效益分析因忽略应急响应改善而系统性低估了净社会效益。
url:5617c7fb0be9e0ac.title: Congestion Pricing and Emergency Medical Service Response: Evidence from New York City
url:5617c7fb0be9e0ac.title_zh: 拥堵收费与紧急医疗服务响应：来自纽约市的证据

url:56185758398c9ce3.title: Wage insurance against short‐term sales changes
url:56185758398c9ce3.title_zh: 短期销售变化下的工资保险

url:561fd6ef92a89f79.abstract: Economic historians have long placed culture at the centre of the rise of the West, but have lacked a measure of culture spanning the emergence of modern growth. Using 23,064 historical books, this column constructs an ‘innovation wedge’ that separates the values texts endorse from the social arrangements they merely depict. The wedge falls by 51% between 1000 and 1920. In a calibrated growth model, that decline accounts for about two-thirds of the first sustained acceleration in productivity growth between 1500 and 1700.
url:561fd6ef92a89f79.abstract_zh: 经济史学家长期以来将文化置于西方崛起之核心，但一直缺乏一种能够跨越现代增长兴起的文化度量。本文利用23,064本历史书籍，构建了一个“创新楔子”，用以区分文本所推崇的价值观与仅作为描绘对象的社会安排。该楔子在1000年至1920年间下降了51%。在一个校准的增长模型中，这一下降解释了1500年至1700年间生产率增长首次持续加速的大约三分之二。
url:561fd6ef92a89f79.title: Nine centuries of cultural change and the productivity of ideas
url:561fd6ef92a89f79.title_zh: 九个世纪的文化变迁与思想生产力

url:5623ce5d8333acf0.abstract: U.S. policy increasingly seeks to slow China's technological rise by restricting its access to American science, on the assumption that Chinese innovation depends on U.S. science. Linking the full corpus of Chinese invention patents to the global scientific literature, we show that this dependence has fallen in recent years: the share of the China-produced science behind Chinese patents rose from 1% in 2000 to 26% in 2025, overtaking the U.S. share in 2021. As China's reliance on U.S.-produced science fades, policies restricting access fall out of alignment with the U.S.' actual strategic position.
url:5623ce5d8333acf0.abstract_zh: 美国政策日益试图通过限制中国获取美国科学成果来减缓其技术崛起，其前提假设是中国创新依赖于美国科学。通过将中国发明专利的完整语料库与全球科学文献相链接，我们表明这种依赖性近年来已有所下降：中国专利背后由中国产出的科学所占份额从2000年的1%上升至2025年的26%，并于2021年超过了美国所占份额。随着中国对美国产出的科学依赖逐渐减弱，限制获取的政策与美国实际战略地位已不再相符。
url:5623ce5d8333acf0.title: The Growing Self-Reliance of Chinese Innovation
url:5623ce5d8333acf0.title_zh: 中国创新日益增强的自立自强

url:5628ca71dbe91b82.abstract: The paper proposes an intertemporal equilibrium model with monopolistic competition and start-up investment with variable capacity to explain the nexus between business formation and medium-run growth. An investment externality is identified that results in under-accumulation of capital in the decentralized market equilibrium and, thus, creates investment multipliers. Some form of investment promotion is called for. The paper compares the effectiveness of policies to promote small business formation with a general investment tax credit.
url:5628ca71dbe91b82.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含垄断竞争与可变产能初创投资的跨期均衡模型，用以解释企业形成与中期增长之间的关联。研究发现存在一种投资外部性，导致分散市场均衡中的资本积累不足，进而产生投资乘数效应。因此需要采取某种形式的投资促进政策。本文比较了促进小企业形成的政策与一般性投资税收抵免的有效性。
url:5628ca71dbe91b82.title: Business Formation and Aggregate Investment

url:5638e6b0c344c80a.abstract: The research explores the effect of industrialization on human capital formation. Exploiting exogenous regional variations in the adoption of steam engines across France, the study establishes that, in contrast to conventional wisdom that views early industrialization as a predominantly deskilling process, the industrial revolution was conducive for human capital formation, generating wide-ranging gains in literacy rates and educational attainment.
url:5638e6b0c344c80a.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了工业化对人力资本形成的影响。利用法国各地蒸汽机采用的外生区域差异，研究发现，与将早期工业化视为主要去技能化过程的传统观点相反，工业革命有利于人力资本的形成，带来了识字率和教育程度的广泛提升。
url:5638e6b0c344c80a.title: DP11865 Technology-Skill Complementarity in Early Phases of Industrialization
url:5638e6b0c344c80a.title_zh: DP11865 工业化早期阶段的技术与技能互补性

url:563c8ee2762ce798.abstract: Data centers now account for 4.4% of United States electricity demand, yet the grid-level effectiveness of the renewable energy certificates (RECs) and power purchase agreements (PPAs) hyperscalers use to claim carbon neutrality remains unclear. We develop a game-theoretic model in which a data center operator chooses among RECs, PPAs, and behind-the-meter colocation while generators make entry decisions under endogenous financing costs. The model identifies a timing wedge -- the mismatch between consumption and credited renewable generation -- as a central mechanism through which AI demand degrades reliability, raises prices, and increases emissions even when RECs cover 100% of annual consumption. Colocation with storage addresses this wedge directly and induces the greatest renewable entry by eliminating generator revenue risk. We test these predictions by exploiting the staggered release of large language models as a natural experiment, using difference-in-differences on a novel dataset linking AI activity to local grid outcomes. AI demand significantly increases fossil generation, wholesale prices (up to 25% in treated PJM zones), and outage frequency (0.5--1 additional outages per year) near data centers, with impacts scaling in model size. Data centers with on-site generation exhibit a sign reversal in power-quality effects, consistent with the model's prediction that behind-the-meter capacity absorbs demand spikes. Counterfactual analyses show that edge inference, spatial reallocation, and colocated storage each substantially mitigate grid impacts, while REC-only strategies do not. Together, our results demonstrate that the externalities of AI to the grid are tightly coupled to procurement design and the spatial organization of data center infrastructure.
url:563c8ee2762ce798.abstract_zh: 数据中心目前占美国电力需求的4.4%，然而，超大规模企业用于宣称碳中和的可再生能源证书（RECs）和购电协议（PPAs）在电网层面的有效性仍不明确。我们构建了一个博弈论模型，其中数据中心运营商在RECs、PPAs和表后共置方案之间进行选择，而发电商则在内生融资成本下做出进入决策。该模型识别出一个时间错配——即电力消费与可归因的可再生能源发电之间的时间差——作为核心机制，通过这一机制，即使RECs覆盖100%的年度消费，人工智能需求仍会降低电网可靠性、推高电价并增加碳排放。与储能设施共置直接解决了这一时间错配问题，并通过消除发电商的收入风险，最大程度地促进了可再生能源的进入。我们利用大语言模型的分阶段发布作为自然实验，通过双重差分法对连接人工智能活动与地方电网结果的新数据集进行检验，以验证这些预测。人工智能需求显著增加了数据中心附近化石燃料发电量、批发电价（在受影响的PJM区域最高上涨25%）以及停电频率（每年额外增加0.5至1次停电），且影响程度随模型规模扩大而增强。配备自备发电设施的数据中心在电能质量效应上表现出符号反转，这与模型预测一致，即表后容量能够吸收需求尖峰。反事实分析表明，边缘推理、空间重新布局以及共置储能均能显著缓解电网影响，而仅依赖RECs的策略则无法实现。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，人工智能对电网的外部性与采购设计及数据中心基础设施的空间组织紧密相关。

url:5644c08f5396f681.abstract: How does informality shape the impact of minimum wage policy? We study this question using evidence from Mexico’s 145% real increase in the minimum wage since 2016, together with a general equilibrium model featuring endogenous informality and household heterogeneity. Reduced-form estimates of the implemented increases indicate limited effects on employment and formalization, alongside modest wage gains at the bottom of the formal wage distribution that arguably reflect incomplete enforcement. The calibrated model reproduces these patterns but predicts that, under full enforcement, higher wage floors generate nonlinear effects: the share of firms reallocating toward informality rises sharply, lowering productivity and aggregate welfare. These losses fall disproportionately on low-skill households, who bear the brunt of the reduction in transfers caused by lower tax revenue yet, as predominantly informal workers, gain little directly from the minimum wage. The minimum wage’s effectiveness as a redistributive tool is therefore limited.
url:5644c08f5396f681.abstract_zh: 非正规性如何影响最低工资政策的效果？我们利用墨西哥自2016年以来最低工资实际增长145%的证据，结合包含内生非正规性与家庭异质性的一般均衡模型来研究这一问题。对已实施最低工资上调的简化形式估计表明，其对就业和正规化的影响有限，同时正规工资分布底端出现温和的工资增长——这在一定程度上反映了执法不完善。校准后的模型复现了这些特征，但预测在完全执法条件下，更高的工资下限会产生非线性效应：转向非正规部门的企业比例急剧上升，从而降低生产率和总体福利。这些损失不成比例地由低技能家庭承担——他们因税收减少导致的转移支付下降而首当其冲，但作为以非正规就业为主的劳动者，却几乎无法直接从最低工资中获益。因此，最低工资作为再分配工具的有效性十分有限。
url:5644c08f5396f681.title: Minimum Wages and the Informality Constraint
url:5644c08f5396f681.title_zh: 最低工资与非正规约束

url:564cd6365b3bdca9.abstract: Multinational firms tend to earn higher stock returns than purely domestic firms, raising questions about what drives their differential exposure to aggregate risk. This column presents evidence that firms run by CEOs with multinational expertise are more likely to expand abroad, and domestic firms that will go on to become multinationals carry higher risk premia before they even expand. The authors explain these patterns through a model that predicts that managerial ability amplifies the risk premia of domestic firms (through the option value of becoming multinational) while dampening the risk premia of multinationals (through operating leverage), and discuss the implications for tax policy.
url:564cd6365b3bdca9.abstract_zh: 跨国公司往往比纯国内企业获得更高的股票回报，这引发了关于其面临总体风险差异驱动因素的疑问。本文提供的证据表明，由具备跨国经验的首席执行官领导的企业更有可能向海外扩张，而即将成为跨国公司的国内企业在扩张前就已承担更高的风险溢价。作者通过一个模型解释这些现象，该模型预测管理能力会放大国内企业的风险溢价（通过成为跨国公司的期权价值），同时通过经营杠杆削弱跨国公司的风险溢价，并讨论了这一发现对税收政策的影响。
url:564cd6365b3bdca9.title: The origins of the multinational premium: Managerial talent, firm risk, and corporate taxation

url:56540dfd6a5119f6.abstract: We develop a multi-country, multi-sector New Keynesian model with incomplete markets, input-output linkages, and heterogeneous sectoral price rigidities to study the macroeconomic effects of tariffs. Tariffs act simultaneously as demand and supply shocks. A risk-sharing wedge, driven by terms-of-trade effects and revalued net foreign assets, summarizes the wealth transfer in general equilibrium and determines whether the tariff-imposing country gains or loses. This wedge interacts with a propagation matrix encoding network structure, sectoral rigidity, and cross-country monetary policy heterogeneity, which governs how inherited real marginal-cost distortions feed into inflation and consumption. Through input-output linkages, transitory tariffs generate persistent distortions, unlike standard New Keynesian benchmarks. These distortions exceed what N-country monetary policy can offset, even under flexible exchange rates. Quantitatively, the 2025-2026 tariffs are stagflationary for the U.S. and yield inflation or deflation abroad depending on trade diversion and monetary policy heterogeneity. Tariff threats alone generate inflation shaped by retaliation expectations.
url:56540dfd6a5119f6.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含不完全市场、投入产出关联及异质性部门价格粘性的多国多部门新凯恩斯模型，用以研究关税的宏观经济效应。关税同时发挥需求冲击与供给冲击的作用。由贸易条件效应与重估后的净外国资产驱动的风险分担楔子，概括了一般均衡中的财富转移，并决定了征收关税国家的损益状况。该楔子与一个编码了网络结构、部门粘性及跨国货币政策异质性的传播矩阵相互作用，后者决定了继承的实际边际成本扭曲如何传导至通胀与消费。通过投入产出关联，临时性关税会产生持续性扭曲，这与标准新凯恩斯基准模型不同。即便在浮动汇率制度下，这些扭曲也超出了N国货币政策所能抵消的范围。定量分析表明，2025-2026年关税对美国具有滞胀效应，并根据贸易转移与货币政策异质性导致国外通胀或通缩。仅关税威胁本身就会产生由报复预期塑造的通胀。
url:56540dfd6a5119f6.title: Global Networks, Monetary Policy, Trade
url:56540dfd6a5119f6.title_zh: 全球网络、货币政策与贸易

url:568e18ebd5780046.abstract: Fuel and food constitute significant portions of consumer baskets, yet their prices are highly volatile. The renewed energy price shock in March 2026, driven by geopolitical disruptions and supply constraints, has highlighted the macroeconomic and distributional importance of how international price shocks transmit to domestic markets. Spikes in these prices can have major social, political, and economic implications. The conventional policy approach is to allow domestic retail prices to align with international prices while protecting the most vulnerable. However, many countries intervene in price settings to shield their domestic markets from global fluctuations. This paper provides a comprehensive assessment of the passthrough from global to domestic retail prices for four commodities: gasoline, diesel, wheat, and rice over the past two decades in many countries. We employ a dynamic model of local projections building on the work of Kpodar and Abdallah (2017). Our findings indicate that average passthrough is incomplete, with fuel exhibiting higher and faster passthrough than food. The extent of passthrough varies by period, region, and between commodity exporters and importers. We also examine asymmetric responses to global price shocks and find evidence of a ratchet effect: price increases are more likely to be passed through than decreases.
url:568e18ebd5780046.abstract_zh: 燃料和食品在消费者篮子中占据重要份额，但其价格波动剧烈。2026年3月由地缘政治干扰和供应约束引发的新一轮能源价格冲击，凸显了国际价格冲击向国内市场传导的宏观经济和分配重要性。这些价格的飙升可能带来重大的社会、政治和经济影响。传统政策做法是允许国内零售价格与国际价格接轨，同时保护最弱势群体。然而，许多国家通过干预价格设定来保护其国内市场免受全球波动的影响。本文对过去二十年间多个国家中四种商品（汽油、柴油、小麦和大米）从全球价格向国内零售价格的传导进行了全面评估。我们采用基于Kpodar和Abdallah（2017）研究的动态局部投影模型。研究结果表明，平均传导是不完全的，燃料的传导速度和程度均高于食品。传导程度因时期、地区以及商品出口国和进口国之间的差异而有所不同。我们还考察了对全球价格冲击的非对称反应，并发现了棘轮效应的证据：价格上涨比下跌更可能被传导。
url:568e18ebd5780046.title: Pumps and Plates: Passthrough of International Fuel and Food Price Shocks to Domestic Markets
url:568e18ebd5780046.title_zh: 泵与餐盘：国际燃料和食品价格冲击向国内市场的传导

url:5691160609b1a2db.abstract: We develop two proposals to enhance the prospects for both liberalization of services trade and regulatory reform. The first is for governments to create mechanisms ('services knowledge platforms') to bring together regulators, trade officials and stakeholders to discuss services regulatory reform. Such mechanisms could identify reform priorities and opportunities for utilization of 'aid for trade' resources, thereby putting in place the preconditions for future market opening. The second proposal is for a new approach to negotiations in the WTO, with a critical mass of countries that account for the bulk of services production agreeing to lock-in applied levels of protection and pre-committing to reform of policies affecting FDI and international movement for individual service providers--two areas where current policy is most restrictive and potential benefits from liberalization are greatest. If these proposals cannot be fully implemented in the Doha time frame, then any Doha agreement could at least lay the basis for a forward-looking program of international cooperation along the proposed lines.
url:5691160609b1a2db.abstract_zh: 我们提出两项建议，以提升服务贸易自由化与监管改革的前景。第一项建议是，各国政府应建立机制（“服务知识平台”），将监管机构、贸易官员和利益相关方聚集在一起，讨论服务监管改革。此类机制可确定改革优先事项及利用“贸易援助”资源的机会，从而为未来的市场开放奠定前提条件。第二项建议是针对世贸组织谈判采取新方法，由占服务生产绝大部分的关键国家群体同意锁定现行保护水平，并预先承诺改革影响外国直接投资和个体服务提供者国际流动的政策——这两个领域当前政策限制最为严格，而自由化的潜在收益也最大。如果这些建议无法在多哈回合时间框架内完全实施，那么任何多哈协议至少可为按照上述方向开展前瞻性国际合作计划奠定基础。
url:5691160609b1a2db.title: Services Trade Liberalization and Regulatory Reform: Re-invigorating International Cooperation
url:5691160609b1a2db.title_zh: 服务贸易自由化与监管改革：重振国际合作

url:569bbbfb16f09d0c.abstract: This paper tests the insiders? dilemma hypothesis in a laboratory experiment. The insiders? dilemma means that a profitable merger does not occur, because it is even more profitable for each firm to unilaterally stand as an outsider (Stigler, 1950; Kamien and Zang, 1990 and 1993). The experimental data provides support for the insiders? dilemma, and thereby for endogenous rather than exogenous merger theory. More surprisingly, our data suggests that fairness (or relative performance) considerations also make profitable mergers difficult. Mergers that should occur in equilibrium do not, since they require an unequal split of surplus.
url:569bbbfb16f09d0c.abstract_zh: 本文通过实验室实验检验了内部人困境假说。内部人困境是指一项有利可图的合并未能发生，因为每个企业单方面作为局外人反而能获得更高利润（Stigler, 1950; Kamien and Zang, 1990, 1993）。实验数据支持内部人困境的存在，从而验证了内生性合并理论而非外生性合并理论。更令人意外的是，我们的数据表明，公平性（或相对绩效）考量同样阻碍了有利可图的合并。本应在均衡状态下发生的合并未能实现，原因在于这些合并要求对剩余进行不平等分配。
url:569bbbfb16f09d0c.title: DP5016 The Insiders' Dilemma: An Experiment on Merger Formation
url:569bbbfb16f09d0c.title_zh: DP5016 内部人的困境：合并形成的实验研究

url:56b0d483755e9251.abstract: This paper uses five rounds of Mexican and Brazilian census extracts to evaluate the accuracy of different model specifications and estimation methods that use survey and census data to generate small area estimates of poverty. Models that utilize more granular data for prediction (household- and/or village-level predictors) tend to produce more accurate estimates of poverty than models estimated only using area-level predictors. Differences in accuracy across models and methods that utilize household or village level predictors are minor. Models that omit household-level predictors tend to be more robust than unit-level models to the use of old census data and classical measurement error in survey predictors. The performance of the Fay-Herriot area-level model falls in the presence of sample selection bias and small sample sizes. Rescaling sample weights is important in Mexico, where the sample is informative within areas. Applying raw sample weights without rescaling in this case greatly reduces the accuracy of estimates from linear models and distorts methodological comparisons. Overall, no one approach dominates across all contexts, but when sample weights are rescaled there is no downside to using more granular data for prediction.
url:56b0d483755e9251.abstract_zh: 本文利用墨西哥和巴西五轮人口普查数据，评估了不同模型设定及估计方法（结合调查与普查数据生成贫困小区域估计值）的准确性。相较于仅使用区域层面预测变量的模型，采用更细粒度数据（家庭层面和/或村庄层面预测变量）进行预测的模型往往能生成更准确的贫困估计值。在利用家庭或村庄层面预测变量的模型与方法之间，其准确性差异较小。省略家庭层面预测变量的模型在使用旧普查数据及调查预测变量存在经典测量误差时，通常比单元层面模型更具稳健性。Fay-Herriot区域层面模型在样本选择偏差和小样本量情况下表现下降。在墨西哥，由于样本在区域内具有信息性，重新调整样本权重至关重要。若在此情况下直接使用未经调整的原始样本权重，将大幅降低线性模型估计值的准确性，并扭曲方法比较结果。总体而言，没有任何一种方法在所有情境下均占优，但当样本权重经过重新调整后，使用更细粒度数据进行预测不会产生负面影响。
url:56b0d483755e9251.title: Evaluating Alternative Approaches to Small Area Estimation of Poverty with Survey and Census Data

url:56e04a110d3742cd.abstract: This paper examines the credit supply effects of sale-of-business (SoB) bank resolutions under the post-Global Financial Crisis regulatory framework, focusing on the resolution of a major Spanish bank. We provide the first micro-level evidence of how an SoB resolution reshapes credit allocation. The acquiring bank preserved lending relationships, prioritizing support for riskier inherited borrowers most exposed to competing banks' retrenchment. This stabilization was achieved despite tighter capital conditions, as the acquiring bank strategically reallocated credit within its broader portfolio, shifting away from more capital-intensive exposures.
url:56e04a110d3742cd.abstract_zh: 本文研究了后全球金融危机监管框架下业务出售型银行处置的信贷供给效应，重点关注一家西班牙大型银行的处置案例。我们首次提供了微观层面证据，揭示业务出售型处置如何重塑信贷配置。收购方银行保留了借贷关系，优先支持那些面临其他银行收缩信贷时风险敞口最大的继承借款人。尽管资本条件趋紧，收购方银行仍通过在其更广泛的资产组合中战略性重新配置信贷（减少资本密集型敞口）实现了这一稳定效应。
url:56e04a110d3742cd.title: Credit supply in the wake of distressed bank acquisitions
url:56e04a110d3742cd.title_zh: 困境银行收购后的信贷供给

url:56f44912ef05ce36.abstract: We construct and estimate a small open economy DSGE model featuring a regime-switching reserve requirement (RR) ratio rule within a banking sector that has access to foreign assets. The model incorporates key financial characteristics of the Chinese economy and examines the implications of changes in the RR-ratio. Estimation results reveal that the RR-ratio follows a feedback rule with a regime-dependent coefficient on net foreign lending during two distinct phases between 2006 and 2017. The state-contingent rule is temporarily suspended during the Global Financial Crisis, but is reactivated in the post-crisis period amid recovered capital inflows. On the one hand, the RR-ratio has almost negligible real effects on output and inflation; but on the other hand, it proves effective as a macroprudential instrument by mitigating financial instability through a reduced risk of self-fulfilling bank runs by about 25%.
url:56f44912ef05ce36.abstract_zh: 我们构建并估计了一个小型开放经济DSGE模型，该模型在拥有外国资产的银行部门中引入了带有体制转换特征的法定存款准备金率规则。模型纳入了中国经济的核心金融特征，并考察了法定存款准备金率变动的影响。估计结果显示，在2006年至2017年间的两个不同阶段，法定存款准备金率遵循一个反馈规则，该规则对净外国贷款具有体制依赖系数。这一状态依存的规则在全球金融危机期间被暂时中止，但在危机后随着资本流入恢复而重新激活。一方面，法定存款准备金率对产出和通胀的实际影响几乎可以忽略不计；但另一方面，它作为宏观审慎工具被证明是有效的，通过将自我实现的银行挤兑风险降低约25%，从而缓解了金融不稳定。

url:570e5a60fbce256b.abstract: We find that whether US import tariffs have supply-side effects or demand-side effects on US manufacturing sectors depends on where the affected sectors are located in the US production network. Using local projections in a panel of US manufacturing sectors, we find that US import tariffs —including the 2018-19 tariff hikes— led to sectoral output contractions via two different channels: (1) Tariff increases act as negative supply shifters for sectors that use goods from tariff-facing sectors as input in production and thus face rising input costs. (2) Tariff increases act as negative demand shifters for sectors whose customer sectors suffer negative supply side effects due to tariffs and reduce their production. We show that these results are consistent with a stylized production network model featuring complementarities in production. Overall, our finding suggests that tariffs markedly reduce US manufacturing production and that the role of input–output linkages is key for understanding the transmission of import tariff shocks to output and producer prices. JEL Classification: E23, E32, F13
url:570e5a60fbce256b.abstract_zh: 我们发现，美国进口关税对美国制造业部门的影响究竟是供给侧效应还是需求侧效应，取决于受影响部门在美国生产网络中的位置。基于美国制造业部门面板数据的局部投影法分析表明，美国进口关税（包括2018-2019年的关税上调）通过两种不同渠道导致部门产出收缩：（1）关税上调对使用受关税影响部门产品作为生产投入的部门构成负向供给冲击，使其面临投入成本上升；（2）关税上调对客户部门因关税遭受负向供给冲击而缩减生产的部门构成负向需求冲击。我们证明，这些结果与一个包含生产互补性的简化生产网络模型一致。总体而言，我们的发现表明关税显著抑制了美国制造业产出，而投入产出关联在理解进口关税冲击向产出和生产者价格传导的过程中起着关键作用。JEL分类号：E23, E32, F13

url:5718d55bfc377122.abstract: Arguably the most widely used techniques for estimating price overcharges from competition law infringements are the dummy variable and the forecasting approaches using linear regression analysis. While rarely used in practice, in this note we make use of the fully interacted dummy variable approach to review some basic properties of all three approaches. We show under which conditions and for which estimands of interest these approaches are equivalent and when they differ. We also note some interesting additional choices an interaction approach allows.
url:5718d55bfc377122.abstract_zh: 可以说，在估算竞争法侵权导致的超额价格时，最广泛使用的技术是虚拟变量法和基于线性回归分析的预测方法。尽管在实践中很少使用，但在本文中，我们利用完全交互的虚拟变量方法来审视这三种方法的一些基本特性。我们展示了在何种条件下、针对哪些感兴趣的估计目标，这些方法是等价的，以及它们何时存在差异。我们还注意到，交互方法允许一些有趣的额外选择。

url:5760386a48924f2c.abstract: Standard economic rationale suggests that an enhancement of conflict-effort efficiency or sabotage efficiency in contests, benefits the player who is experiencing the improvement. This paper presents a model of sabotage in the context of attacker-defender contest with ‘gun’ and ‘butter’ (as posited by Chowdhury and Topolyan in 2026). We observe a strikingly counter-intuitive outcome – any increase in sabotage efficiency is counter-productive (even for the player experiencing the increase) in terms of equilibrium payoffs. The channel through which the result holds for both players (the attacker and the defender) is the shrinking size of the defender’s ‘butter’ when sabotage efficiency (of either player) increases. The paper also contradicts the findings of Chung in 2024 and Glökler, Pull and Stadler in 2022 who claim that endogenization of the prize alleviates or eliminates sabotage.
url:5760386a48924f2c.abstract_zh: 标准经济理论认为，在竞赛中提升冲突努力效率或破坏效率，将使效率提升的一方获益。本文基于Chowdhury与Topolyan（2026）提出的"枪炮与黄油"攻防竞赛框架，构建了破坏行为模型。我们观察到一种显著反直觉的结果——任何破坏效率的提升（即使对效率提升方而言）在均衡收益层面都会适得其反。该结论对攻防双方均成立的作用机制在于：当任意一方的破坏效率提升时，防御方的"黄油"规模会相应缩减。本文同时反驳了Chung（2024）以及Glökler、Pull与Stadler（2022）的研究结论——后者主张将奖品内生化可缓解或消除破坏行为。

url:5784e5a3bc7b1387.abstract: In sub-Saharan Africa, women constitute the majority of new Christian membership (including Evangelical and Pentecostal denominations), and this gender gap exceeds that of any other religion. Existing explanations for conversion to these churches emphasize demand for mutual help or informal insurance. We instead show that emancipation is central: these churches provide services that support women's economic advancement and help them challenge patriarchal norms. Using experimental data from Benin, we find that women randomly offered an economic opportunity become more likely to convert, partly because these churches help counter witchcraft threats, a risk that disproportionately targets economically successful women. To assess external validity, we combine large African datasets with local variation in exposure to positive economic shocks - using exogenous changes in cash crop prices and the implementation of world bank projects with a gender focus. Women are more likely to join new Christian churches following such shocks, especially where witchcraft beliefs are widespread. There, women work more, have fewer children, and exercise greater decisionâ€‘making power, while both women and men reject traditional beliefs, rituals, and authorities.
url:5784e5a3bc7b1387.abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，女性构成了新兴基督教教会（包括福音派和五旬节派）新信徒的主体，这一性别差距超过任何其他宗教。现有对改信这些教会的解释强调对互助或非正式保险的需求。然而，我们证明解放是核心因素：这些教会提供支持女性经济进步并帮助她们挑战父权规范的服务。利用贝宁的实验数据，我们发现，随机获得经济机会的女性更可能改信，部分原因在于这些教会帮助对抗巫术威胁——这种风险不成比例地针对经济成功的女性。为评估外部有效性，我们将大型非洲数据集与正向经济冲击的局部暴露变化相结合——利用经济作物价格的外生变化以及以性别为重点的世界银行项目的实施。女性在经历此类冲击后更可能加入新兴基督教教会，尤其是在巫术信仰普遍的地区。在那里，女性工作更多、生育更少、拥有更大的决策权，同时女性和男性都摒弃传统信仰、仪式和权威。

url:57b20585e5b53a70.abstract: We study the role of heterogenous preferences at the spousal level and that of spousal mutual insurance against wage shocks for couples’ labor supply in a time-use model. We estimate the model for couples in the German Time-Use Survey with Bayesian techniques and generate gender-specific wage-elasticities of market hours in the cross-section and for all couples. Missing mutual insurance ignores males’ behavior which we find to be substantial. Together with preference heterogeneity it shapes the elasticities’ size and distribution, especially for high and low hours worked and wage groups. Our setting is suitable to analyze nonlinear and distributional economic policy.
url:57b20585e5b53a70.abstract_zh: 本文在时间利用模型中研究了配偶层面异质性偏好以及配偶间工资冲击相互保险对夫妻劳动供给的作用。我们采用贝叶斯方法，基于德国时间利用调查数据对模型进行估计，并生成了截面层面及所有夫妻的性别特异性市场工时工资弹性。缺失相互保险会忽略男性的行为，而我们的研究发现这种行为影响显著。与偏好异质性共同作用，这种缺失塑造了弹性的大小与分布，尤其在高、低工时及工资群体中表现突出。我们的研究框架适用于分析非线性及分布性经济政策。

url:57b93c3aae94a0ed.abstract: This study examines the public health impact of early dairy regulation in the United States by analyzing the relationship between raw milk laws and child mortality from 1850 to 1950. Using linked census microdata from the Integrated Public Use Microdata Series (IPUMS) full-count datasets, intercensal child mortality rates are constructed for children aged 0-5, and a staggered adoption difference-in-differences design is employed to estimate the causal effects of dairy regulations. The identification strategy exploits the heterogeneous timing of raw milk law adoption across counties, with regulations emerging in 1914. The analysis tracks approximately 54.8 million children across ten decade pairs, focusing on families with successfully linked parents to minimize measurement error in mortality estimation. Results indicate that comprehensive dairy regulations did not, on average, reduce child mortality. The preferred specification restricts estimation to individually-verified municipal ordinance counties, the jurisdictions where mandates were most plausibly binding, and is the only specification satisfying the parallel trends assumption. Remaining specifications fail the parallel trends test, consistent with positive selection of urbanizing, lower-mortality counties into treatment. The null result is consistent with voluntary pre-adoption, weak enforcement outside major cities, and declining milk-borne exposure as concurrent water infrastructure improvements reduced competing causes of child death.
url:57b93c3aae94a0ed.abstract_zh: 本研究通过分析1850年至1950年间生奶法律与儿童死亡率之间的关系，考察了美国早期乳制品监管的公共卫生影响。利用综合公共使用微观数据系列（IPUMS）全量普查微观数据，构建了0-5岁儿童的人口普查间隔期死亡率，并采用交错采纳的双重差分设计来估计乳制品监管的因果效应。识别策略利用了各县采纳生奶法律的时间差异，相关法规于1914年开始出现。分析追踪了十个十年配对中约5480万名儿童，重点关注父母成功关联的家庭，以最小化死亡率估计中的测量误差。结果表明，全面的乳制品监管平均而言并未降低儿童死亡率。首选规格将估计限制在经个体验证的市政条例县，即法规最可能具有约束力的司法管辖区，且是唯一满足平行趋势假设的规格。其余规格均未通过平行趋势检验，这与城市化程度较高、死亡率较低的县正向选择进入处理组的情况一致。零结果与采纳前的自愿行为、主要城市以外执法力度薄弱，以及同期供水基础设施改善减少了儿童死亡竞争性原因从而降低了乳源性暴露风险的解释相一致。

url:57e63a621ae595eb.abstract: Thailand's transition to high-income status is, at its core, an urban challenge. Bangkok generates nearly half of the national gross domestic product, yet its dominance is increasingly constrained by congestion, environmental stress, and diminishing returns to further concentration. Successive National Spatial Development Strategies have called for a more multi-nodal urban hierarchy, but the analytical basis for evaluating that ambition has remained thin. This paper builds and calibrates a Dynamic Recursive Spatial Quantitative General Equilibrium model for Thailand's urban system from 2025 to 2050, and uses it to evaluate three counterfactual policy portfolios that allocate the same aggregate productivity-investment envelope (roughly 2.3 percent of 2030 urban gross domestic product) across Bangkok and the eleven designated secondary cities in different proportions: a Bangkok-leaning portfolio (80/20), a balanced portfolio (50/50), and a secondary-leaning portfolio (20/80). The Bangkok-leaning portfolio leads through 2045, but the secondary-leaning portfolio overtakes it between 2045 and 2050, delivering a 12.38 percent gain in national gross domestic product per capita above the no-investment baseline against 11.62 percent for the Bangkok-leaning alternative. The balanced portfolio is dominated by both skewed alternatives in 2050, reflecting a threshold property of agglomeration economies. A two-dimensional envelope-by-split sweep shows that the relative ranking is genuinely contingent on the scale and horizon of the commitment: below a certain tipping point, the Bangkok-leaning portfolio dominates; above it, the secondary-leaning portfolio does. A modest, well-allocated spatial-investment program is unlikely to be the engine of Thailand's high-income transition; sufficient scale of commitment is a precondition.
url:57e63a621ae595eb.abstract_zh: 泰国迈向高收入地位的转型，其核心在于城市挑战。曼谷贡献了近半数的国内生产总值，但其主导地位日益受到拥堵、环境压力及进一步集聚收益递减的制约。历次国家空间发展战略均呼吁构建更为多节点的城市层级体系，然而评估这一愿景的分析基础仍显薄弱。本文构建并校准了一个适用于泰国城市系统的动态递归空间量化一般均衡模型，时间跨度为2025年至2050年，并利用该模型评估了三种反事实政策组合，这些组合将相同的总生产率投资包（约占2030年城市国内生产总值的2.3%）按不同比例分配给曼谷及十一个指定次级城市：偏向曼谷的组合（80/20）、均衡组合（50/50）及偏向次级城市的组合（20/80）。偏向曼谷的组合在2045年前领先，但偏向次级城市的组合在2045年至2050年间超越前者，使全国人均国内生产总值较无投资基准线高出12.38%，而偏向曼谷的替代方案则为11.62%。均衡组合在2050年被两种倾斜方案所主导，这反映了集聚经济的阈值特性。二维的包络-分配扫描显示，相对排名确实取决于承诺的规模与时间跨度：低于某一临界点，偏向曼谷的组合占优；高于该临界点，则偏向次级城市的组合胜出。一个适度且配置得当的空间投资计划不太可能成为泰国高收入转型的引擎；足够的承诺规模是前提条件。

url:58020df20162aca1.abstract: We document and dissect a stylized fact about firm growth: the shift from labor to intermediate inputs. This shift occurs in input quantities, cost and output shares, and output elasticities. We establish this regularity in firm data for Germany and in firm (and industry) data for 11 (20) additional countries, and also in response to exogenous product demand shocks. We explain this regularity through a parsimonious model with two features: (i) an elasticity of substitution between intermediates and labor above one, and (ii) an increasing shadow price of labor (monopsony or adjustment costs). Our firm growth regressions identify a labor-intermediates substitution elasticity between 1.8 and 4.2. Labor-intermediates substitution also accounts for much of the labor share decline that we document accompanies firm and industry growth.
url:58020df20162aca1.abstract_zh: 我们记录并剖析了关于企业增长的一个典型事实：从劳动向中间投入品的转变。这一转变体现在投入数量、成本与产出份额以及产出弹性上。我们在德国企业数据以及11个（20个）其他国家的企业（及行业）数据中确立了这一规律，并且该规律也响应于外生产品需求冲击。我们通过一个简约模型解释这一规律，该模型包含两个特征：（i）中间投入品与劳动之间的替代弹性大于一，（ii）劳动影子价格递增（买方垄断或调整成本）。我们的企业增长回归识别出劳动与中间投入品之间的替代弹性介于1.8至4.2之间。劳动与中间投入品的替代还解释了伴随企业和行业增长而出现的劳动份额下降的很大一部分，这一下降我们也有记录。

url:5816da25940d9054.abstract: this paper we provide a simple and intuitive story for supply chain disruptions driven by the rigidities in the transportation sector. Focusing on maritime shipping, we argue that the frequent macroeconomic shocks that shape demand for transportation, meet a highly inelastic supply curve for transportation services. The steepness is driven by equilibrium bottlenecks in ships (transportation agents) and ports (transportation infrastructure). This leads to highly volatile shipping prices and port congestion, affecting importers and exporters worldwide. We discuss how both global trade and inflation react to these costs, so that disruptions pass through to the entire economy.
url:5816da25940d9054.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个关于运输部门刚性导致供应链中断的简单直观解释。聚焦于海运领域，我们认为，频繁影响运输需求的宏观经济冲击，遭遇了高度缺乏弹性的运输服务供给曲线。该曲线的陡峭程度源于船舶（运输主体）与港口（运输基础设施）中的均衡瓶颈。这导致航运价格和港口拥堵高度波动，影响全球进出口商。我们探讨了全球贸易和通胀如何对这些成本作出反应，从而使中断传导至整个经济体。
url:5816da25940d9054.title: Rigidities in Transportation and Supply Chain Disruptions
url:5816da25940d9054.title_zh: 运输刚性中的供应链中断

url:58183d3a5bed872a.abstract: The ultimate objective of macroprudential policy is to minimise the frequency and severity of economic losses arising from severe financial distress. Critically, any policymaker seeking to achieve this goal must be able to assess the stringency or laxity of their policy settings. Applying the lessons of monetary policy, we note that doing this requires a normative measure of policy stance based on a framework comprising an objective, tools, and a model linking the two. In this paper, we propose using growth-at-risk to define an overarching objective for macroprudential policy and then show how it can form the basis for a measure of policy stance. We proceed to discuss the challenges inherent in the implementation of our framework. These include the availability of appropriate data, choices among multiple tools, and gauging the uncertain responses of the economy and financial system to macroprudential policy actions.
url:58183d3a5bed872a.abstract_zh: 宏观审慎政策的最终目标是最大限度地减少因严重金融困境而引发的经济损失的频率和严重性。关键在于，任何旨在实现这一目标的政策制定者都必须能够评估其政策设置的严格性或宽松性。借鉴货币政策的经验教训，我们注意到，要做到这一点，需要基于一个包含目标、工具及连接两者的模型的框架，来制定一个规范性的政策立场衡量标准。在本文中，我们提议使用风险增长值来定义宏观审慎政策的总体目标，并进而展示它如何构成政策立场衡量标准的基础。随后，我们讨论了实施我们框架所固有的挑战，包括适当数据的可用性、多种工具的选择，以及评估经济和金融体系对宏观审慎政策行动的不确定性反应。
url:58183d3a5bed872a.title: Using growth-at-risk to assess the stance of macroprudential policy
url:58183d3a5bed872a.title_zh: 运用增长风险法评估宏观审慎政策立场

url:5826a329cb902f7c.abstract: Africa's interior-to-coast roads are well placed to export natural resources, but not to support regional trade. Are they the optimal response to geography and comparative advantage, or the result of suboptimal political distortions? We investigate the political determinants of road paving in West Africa in 1965-2014. Controlling for geography and comparative advantage, we find that autocracies focused more than democracies on connecting metal and mineral deposits to ports, resulting in more interior-to-coast networks. This deposit-to-port bias was only present for deposits located on the elite's ethnic homeland, suggesting that Africa's interior-to-coast roads were the result of ethnic favoritism by autocracies.
url:5826a329cb902f7c.abstract_zh: 非洲内陆至沿海的公路在出口自然资源方面布局合理，但不利于支持区域贸易。这些公路是对地理与比较优势的最优回应，还是次优政治扭曲的结果？我们考察了1965年至2014年间西非公路铺设的政治决定因素。在控制地理与比较优势后，我们发现，相较于民主国家，专制政体更侧重于将金属和矿产矿床与港口相连，导致形成更多内陆至沿海的公路网络。这种矿床至港口的偏向仅出现在精英族群故乡的矿床中，这表明非洲内陆至沿海的公路是专制政体下族群偏袒的产物。
url:5826a329cb902f7c.title: Priority Roads: the Political Economy of Africa's Interior-to-Coast Roads
url:5826a329cb902f7c.title_zh: 优先道路：非洲内陆至沿海公路的政治经济学

url:58416cfa7e4b6a22.abstract: We analyze the Probability of Default (PD) of non-financial corporations in Europe using Random Forests (RF) and assess implications for stress testing the banking sector. To this end, we exploit data on firms’ financial statements (Orbis) and banks’ credit registry (Anacredit). We show that RF displays stronger risk sensitivity than logistic regression in stress testing, shedding new light on the non-linear effect of scenario severity on PD. Moreover, we show how RF-based PD can be used in a network of banks and firms to stress test the banking sector through loan exposures as a key transmission channel of adverse scenarios. A granular inspection of banks’ riskiness indices derived from this network sheds light also on RF’s superior ability in capturing non-linearity thanks to its capability in identifying “tail banks”. Our work is relevant for central banks and banking supervisors alike. JEL Classification: C53, C55, C58, G17, G21
url:58416cfa7e4b6a22.abstract_zh: 我们利用随机森林（RF）方法分析了欧洲非金融企业的违约概率（PD），并评估了其对银行业压力测试的启示。为此，我们采用了企业财务报表数据（Orbis）和银行信贷登记数据（Anacredit）。研究表明，在压力测试中，随机森林比逻辑回归展现出更强的风险敏感性，为情景严重程度对违约概率的非线性影响提供了新的视角。此外，我们展示了如何将基于随机森林的违约概率应用于银行与企业网络，通过贷款敞口作为不利情景的关键传导渠道，对银行业进行压力测试。对该网络衍生出的银行风险指数进行细致检查，进一步揭示了随机森林在捕捉非线性方面的优越性，这得益于其识别“尾部银行”的能力。我们的工作对中央银行及银行业监管者均具有参考价值。JEL分类号：C53, C55, C58, G17, G21
