url:58892f9ed223df29.abstract: This paper evaluates the unintended consequences of China's 2021 "Double Reduction" policy, which aimed to ease students' academic burden by limiting homework and private tutoring. Using a tailored household survey, a constructed policy enforcement index, and a difference-in-differences design, we find that the policy increased private tutoring enrollment, household tutoring expenditures, and parental time spent on helping children with schoolwork. These effects disproportionately harmed low-income families, resulting in worse academic outcomes. Our findings suggest that the policy's effects run counter to its intended goals and may exacerbate educational inequality.
url:58892f9ed223df29.abstract_zh: 本文评估了中国2021年“双减”政策的非预期后果，该政策旨在通过限制作业和校外培训来减轻学生学业负担。利用定制化家庭调查、构建的政策执行指数以及双重差分设计，我们发现该政策增加了校外培训参与率、家庭培训支出以及家长辅导孩子功课的时间投入。这些效应不成比例地损害了低收入家庭，导致其学业表现恶化。研究结果表明，该政策的实际效果与其预期目标背道而驰，并可能加剧教育不平等。

url:589ef0e40177c8ba.abstract: We estimate the cyclical response of labour force participation to growth shocks across EU regions. We use a shift-share instrumental variable approach and local projections on EU Labour Force Survey microdata covering 15 countries and 114 regions over 2000–2020. The aggregate labour force participation rate is remarkably resilient, a clear contrast to the highly cyclical participation rate documented for the U.S. However, this resilience masks pronounced demographic heterogeneity. Men’s participation declines significantly while women’s remains stable, reflecting sectoral segregation and the added worker effect. Young workers exhibit the most persistent responses, with effects lasting up to eight years, consistent with hysteresis through human capital erosion. Less-educated and non-native workers bear disproportionate employment costs. The findings imply that aggregate slack measures may miss important distributional dimensions relevant for monetary, fiscal, and structural policy. JEL Classification: J21, E24, E32, R23
url:589ef0e40177c8ba.abstract_zh: 我们估算了欧盟各地区劳动力参与率对增长冲击的周期性反应。我们采用转移份额工具变量法，并基于覆盖2000至2020年间15个国家、114个地区的欧盟劳动力调查微观数据进行局部投影分析。总体劳动力参与率表现出显著的韧性，这与美国所记录的高度周期性参与率形成鲜明对比。然而，这种韧性掩盖了明显的人口结构异质性。男性参与率显著下降，而女性则保持稳定，这反映了部门隔离和附加工人效应。年轻工人的反应最为持久，影响持续长达八年，与人力资本侵蚀导致的滞后效应一致。受教育程度较低和非本土工人承担了不成比例的就业成本。研究结果表明，总体松弛指标可能遗漏了对货币、财政和结构政策具有重要意义的分维度信息。JEL分类：J21, E24, E32, R23
url:589ef0e40177c8ba.title: Hidden in the aggregate: the cyclicality of EU labour force participation
url:589ef0e40177c8ba.title_zh: 隐藏在总量之中：欧盟劳动力参与率的周期性

url:58d448e3abc744f8.abstract: Government regulation of the banking sector is pervasive, making it difficult to empirically analyze when banks would voluntarily choose to issue equity if there were no minimum requirements on capital adequacy. A unique historical setting occurred in the late nineteenth-century United Kingdom when joint-stock banks were free to choose their capital structures. We show that during this era, banks were willing to issue equity as part of restructuring processes, but were reluctant to do so on a regular basis to offset increases in liabilities. We find that large issues of uncalled capital were made as a replacement for unlimited liability, and this uncalled capital continued to restrain risk taking as shown by an analysis of bank loan books. Banks were also willing to issue stock to finance mergers and acquisitions, but this was generally just used to absorb the equity of target banks so did not increase aggregate paid-up capital. Equity issuance did not keep pace with deposit growth, leading to the erosion of capital adequacy over the long run.
url:58d448e3abc744f8.abstract_zh: 政府对银行业的监管无处不在，这使得在缺乏最低资本充足率要求的情况下，难以实证分析银行何时会自愿选择发行股本。19世纪末的英国提供了一个独特的历史背景，当时股份制银行可以自由选择其资本结构。我们表明，在那个时代，银行愿意在重组过程中发行股本，但不愿定期这样做以抵消负债的增加。我们发现，大量未缴资本的发行是为了替代无限责任，而这种未缴资本继续约束着风险承担，这一点通过对银行贷款账簿的分析得以证实。银行也愿意发行股票以资助并购活动，但这通常仅用于吸收目标银行的股本，因此并未增加总实缴资本。股本发行未能跟上存款增长的步伐，导致长期资本充足率逐渐侵蚀。
url:58d448e3abc744f8.title: Free to Choose: Bank Capital in Britain, 1878-1939
url:58d448e3abc744f8.title_zh: 自由选择：英国银行资本，1878-1939

url:58eb38a85c47fde2.abstract: This paper studies the impact of offshoring by US firms on voting patterns in the US. Using county-level voting data combined with industry-level offshoring data from 2000 to 2020, we ask whether an increase in employment at foreign affiliates of US multinational firms in vertically oriented industries is associated with an increase in the vote share for the incumbent party candidate in Presidential, House, and Senate elections. We find that offshoring leads to a significant increase in the incumbent vote share for counties with higher shares of college educated workers, and a significant decrease for counties with higher shares of workers in the manufacturing sector and in occupations that are more easily relocated abroad. These results are consistent with the labor market literature on offshoring and our own findings, which show that offshoring has heterogenous effects on workers’ employment based on skill and occupational tasks. This suggests that voters respond to the economic effects of offshoring by rewarding or punishing incumbent party candidates.
url:58eb38a85c47fde2.abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国企业离岸外包对美国投票模式的影响。利用2000年至2020年县级投票数据结合行业级离岸外包数据，我们探讨了美国跨国公司在垂直导向行业中的海外附属机构就业增长，是否与总统、众议院及参议院选举中现任政党候选人得票份额的增加相关联。研究发现，离岸外包显著提升了拥有较高比例受过大学教育工人的县的现任候选人得票份额，而对于制造业工人比例较高及职业更易转移至海外的县，则显著降低了现任候选人的得票份额。这些结果与关于离岸外包的劳动力市场文献及我们自身的发现相吻合，表明离岸外包对工人就业的影响因技能和职业任务而异。这暗示选民会通过奖励或惩罚现任政党候选人，来回应离岸外包带来的经济效应。
url:58eb38a85c47fde2.title: DP21844 Offshoring and Voting Patterns in the US

url:591c961f03875574.abstract: This paper examines how forced displacement shapes child development beyond socioeconomic disadvantage. The paper uses original data on roughly 1,600 Venezuelan refugees, Colombian internally displaced individuals, and nondisplaced children in Medellín, Colombia. The analysis adapts rank-rank regressions from the intergenerational mobility literature to a forced displacement setting, ranking each child’s developmental outcomes against household wealth. The paper documents substantial gaps that persist after holding wealth and parental background fixed. It also shows that the cause of displacement shapes the nature of the gaps. Venezuelan refugees displaced by acute material deprivation fall 19 and 13 rank points behind in cognitive and physical development, respectively. Colombian children displaced by armed conflict fall 12 rank points behind in depression and exhibit elevated trauma. Access to regularization and social services is associated with narrower gaps.
url:591c961f03875574.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了被迫流离失所如何超越社会经济劣势影响儿童发展。研究基于哥伦比亚麦德林约1600名委内瑞拉难民、哥伦比亚国内流离失所者及非流离失所儿童的一手数据。分析将代际流动性文献中的排名-排名回归方法适配至被迫流离失所情境，依据家庭财富对每位儿童的发展成果进行排序。研究发现，在控制财富与父母背景后，发展差距依然显著存在。同时，流离失所的成因决定了差距的性质：因严重物质匮乏而流离失所的委内瑞拉难民儿童，其认知与身体发展分别落后19个和13个排名位次；因武装冲突而流离失所的哥伦比亚儿童，其抑郁指标落后12个排名位次，并表现出更高的创伤水平。获得合法身份与社会服务与缩小发展差距存在关联。
url:591c961f03875574.title: Consequences of Growing Up Displaced: Evidence from Displaced Children in Colombia
url:591c961f03875574.title_zh: 流离失所成长的后果：来自哥伦比亚流离失所儿童的证据

url:5956ee12f4322842.abstract: 미·중 간 기술 패권 경쟁이 지속되면서 미국 등 주요국은 핵심 과학기술 분야에서 자국 기술과 산업을 보호·육성하기 위한 전략을 강화하고 있다. 각국 정부는 연구개발 투자를 확대하는 동시에 기술 보호 및 육성을 위한 법·제도적 기반을 정비하고 있으며, 기술 경쟁력 확보뿐만 아니라 국가 안보와 산업 생태계 강화를 목표로 하고 있다. 주요 선진국들은 핵심 기술 분야의 발전을 지원하면서 불필요한 규제를 완화하고, 기술 보호를 위한 새로운 규제를 도입하는 등 정교한 정책 설계를 시도하고 있다. 이러한 규제 혁신 전략을 분석함으로써 선진국의 과학기술 발전 전략과 혁신 생태계 조성 방식, 산업 발전을 위한 정책적 접근법을 비교·분석할 필요가 있다. 본 연구에서는 기존 연구에서 다루지 않았던 과학기술 분야별 규제 혁신 전략들에 대한 다면적 분석을 통해 빠른 속도로 변하고 있는 과학기술 분야 미래 규제 환경에 대한 우리의 효과적 대응 전략을 제시한다. As the competition for technological hegemony intensifies between the U.S. and China, major advanced countries around the world, including the U.S., are increasingly strengthening their strategies to protect and foster their technologies and industries in core science and technology fields. The governments of individual countries are expanding R&D investment, reorganizing legal and institutional foundations for technology protection and fostering, and aiming to strengthen national security and industrial ecosystems as well as securing technological competitiveness.
url:5956ee12f4322842.abstract_zh: 随着美中之间技术霸权竞争的持续，美国等主要国家正加强在核心科学技术领域保护和培育本国技术与产业的战略。各国政府在扩大研发投资的同时，也在完善技术保护与培育的法律制度基础，其目标不仅在于确保技术竞争力，还在于强化国家安全与产业生态系统。主要发达国家在支持核心技术领域发展的同时，正尝试通过放宽不必要的监管、引入新的技术保护监管等精细化的政策设计。通过分析这些监管创新战略，有必要对发达国家的科技发展战略、创新生态构建方式以及促进产业发展的政策路径进行比较分析。本研究通过对现有研究尚未涉及的科技领域监管创新战略进行多维度分析，为快速变化的科技领域未来监管环境提出有效的应对策略。

url:5981f1866013ea86.abstract: We develop a simple model of content filtering-the tendency of individuals to selectively forward information that aligns with their ideological preference-to study how network structure shapes the distribution of political content. In our framework, individuals and content are horizontally differentiated into three types (left, middle, right). We show that content filtering can amplify the middle or the extremes and may result in only centrist content (full moderation) or only extreme content (full polarization). The outcome depends on the interaction between two forces: a preference advantage from the relative prevalence of types in the population, and a pairwise comparison advantage that systematically favors centrist content. Network density plays a critical role. Sparse networks robustly yield moderation, even when extreme types dominate the population, while dense networks replicate the population's type distribution. Intermediate densities generate non-monotonic comparative statics, including sharp transitions between moderation and polarization. These findings complement existing empirical results that emphasize the types of connections individuals have on social media by highlighting how the number of connections, holding their composition fixed, may fundamentally shape the information environment in ways that foster/mitigate populism and polarization.
url:5981f1866013ea86.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于内容过滤的简洁模型——即个体倾向于选择性地转发与其意识形态偏好相符的信息——以研究网络结构如何塑造政治内容的分布。在我们的框架中，个体与内容在水平维度上被划分为三种类型（左、中、右）。我们证明，内容过滤可能放大中间派或极端派，并可能导致仅剩中间派内容（完全温和化）或仅剩极端内容（完全极化）。这一结果取决于两种力量的相互作用：一是人口中类型相对普遍性带来的偏好优势，二是系统性地偏向中间派内容的成对比较优势。网络密度起着关键作用。稀疏网络稳健地产生温和化结果，即使极端派在人口中占主导地位也是如此，而密集网络则复制人口的类型分布。中等密度产生非单调的比较静态分析结果，包括温和化与极化之间的急剧转变。这些发现补充了现有强调社交媒体上个体连接类型的实证结果，通过突出连接数量（在保持其构成不变的情况下）如何可能从根本上塑造信息环境，从而促进或缓解民粹主义与极化。
url:5981f1866013ea86.title: The Polarization Paradox: Why More Connections Can Divide Us
url:5981f1866013ea86.title_zh: 极化悖论：为何更多联系反而使我们分裂

url:59cc560a5485dcd6.abstract: we investigate the long-run eﬀects of such tax reforms on ﬁrm dynamics. We ﬁnd that they can substantially increase business dynamism, potentially oﬀsetting the large decline in the U.S. startup rate observed over recent decades. This result is driven by indirect equilibrium forces: the tax reform stimulates ﬁrm entry, leading to an increase in labor demand and wages, which in turn makes ﬁrm selection more stringent. Related to this is a large boost of the number of ﬁrms and of aggregate output, investment and employment.
url:59cc560a5485dcd6.abstract_zh: 我们研究了此类税制改革对企业动态的长期影响。研究发现，这些改革能显著提升商业活力，可能抵消近几十年来美国创业率的大幅下滑。这一结果由间接均衡力量驱动：税制改革刺激企业进入，导致劳动力需求和工资上升，进而使企业筛选更为严格。与此相关的是，企业数量、总产出、投资和就业均大幅增长。
url:59cc560a5485dcd6.title: Reviving American Entrepreneurship? Tax Reform and Business Dynamism
url:59cc560a5485dcd6.title_zh: 重振美国创业精神？税收改革与商业活力

url:59cc7ebc9f2bd4ab.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between intergenerational social mobility, migration aspirations, and participation in political demonstrations. Using individual-level data from the Latinobarómetro between 2002 and 2023, we show that individuals experiencing negative intergenerational educational mobility are more likely to express a desire to migrate and to participate into peaceful protests, whereas those with positive mobility exhibit the opposite pattern. Our analysis further suggests that the decision to migrate and to protest may be shaped by a common underlying decision process. Finally, we find that confidence in political institutions and positive economic expectations substantially mitigate expressions of social discontent in the form of migration aspirations and protest participation. Overall, the results indicate that unequal opportunities across generations are an important determinant of both migration intentions and political engagement.
url:59cc7ebc9f2bd4ab.abstract_zh: 本文研究了代际社会流动、移民意愿与政治示威参与之间的关系。利用2002年至2023年间拉丁美洲晴雨表的个体层面数据，我们发现，经历负向代际教育流动的个体更可能表达移民意愿并参与和平抗议，而经历正向代际教育流动的个体则呈现相反模式。进一步分析表明，移民与抗议决策可能受共同潜在决策过程的影响。最后，研究发现对政治体制的信心与积极的经济预期能够显著缓解以移民意愿和抗议参与形式表现的社会不满情绪。总体而言，研究结果表明代际机会不平等是移民意向与政治参与的重要决定因素。
url:59cc7ebc9f2bd4ab.title: Social mobility, Protests, and Migration: Evidence from Latin American Countries.
url:59cc7ebc9f2bd4ab.title_zh: 社会流动、抗议与移民：来自拉丁美洲国家的证据

url:59cf5dc22568532f.abstract: Standard optimal capital tax theory abstracts from modeling asset prices, making it unsuitable for thinking about capital gains and wealth taxation. We study optimal redistributive taxation in an environment with asset price movements, adopting the modern finance view that asset prices fluctuate not only because of changing cash flows, but also due to other factors ("discount rates''). We show that a combination of realization-based capital gains and cash flow taxes implements the optimal allocation regardless of the source of asset-price fluctuations. Moreover, the capital gains tax avoids distortions in portfolio choice (the so-called lock-in effect) by targeting total net trades rather than gains from selling individual assets. These results stand in contrast to the classic Haig-Simons comprehensive income tax concept as well as recent proposals for wealth or accrual-based capital gains taxes.
url:59cf5dc22568532f.abstract_zh: 标准最优资本税理论在建模时抽象掉了资产价格，因此不适用于思考资本利得和财富税问题。我们在资产价格波动的环境中研究最优再分配税收，采纳现代金融学的观点，即资产价格不仅因现金流变化而波动，还受其他因素（“贴现率”）影响。我们证明，基于实现的资本利得税与现金流税的组合，无论资产价格波动的来源如何，都能实现最优配置。此外，资本利得税通过针对总净交易而非出售个别资产的收益，避免了投资组合选择中的扭曲（即所谓的“锁定效应”）。这些结果与经典的Haig-Simons综合所得税概念以及近期提出的财富税或基于应计制的资本利得税建议形成鲜明对比。
url:59cf5dc22568532f.title: Putting the 'Finance' into 'Public Finance': A Theory of Capital Gains Taxation
url:59cf5dc22568532f.title_zh: 将“财政”融入“公共财政”：资本利得税理论

url:59d01346e5553343.title: Brazil’s pacifying police units revisited: A failed democratic policing project and lessons for institutional reforms
url:59d01346e5553343.title_zh: 巴西安抚警察部队再审视：一项失败的民主警务项目及其对制度改革的启示

url:59e67f4dc185a160.abstract: We examine how social comparison within endogenously formed peer networks affects different measures of young adult mental health. Using over 2 million smartphone-based communication records from the NetHealth Study, we construct objective social networks among university students and estimate a structural model in which individuals choose their peers and mental health depends on the income of chosen peers. When networks are treated as exogenous, higher average peer income predicts better mental health; once network formation is modelled endogenously, the relationship reverses: exposure to higher-income peers significantly worsens depressive symptoms. Income gaps harm mental health in both directions, consistent with inequality aversion rather than relative deprivation. The reversal survives extending binary links to message-weighted networks, and counterfactual exercises show that policies reducing the volume of messages exchanged with peers improve mental health, increasingly so with the size of the reduction, though the effect of targeted reductions depends on which ties are attenuated. Ignoring endogenous peer selection can thus yield qualitatively misleading conclusions about peer effects on mental health.
url:59e67f4dc185a160.abstract_zh: 我们考察了内生形成的同伴网络中的社会比较如何影响年轻成人心理健康的多种衡量指标。利用NetHealth研究中超过两百万条基于智能手机的通信记录，我们构建了大学生之间的客观社交网络，并估计了一个结构模型，在该模型中，个体选择其同伴，而心理健康则取决于所选同伴的收入水平。当网络被视为外生时，较高的平均同伴收入预示着更好的心理健康；一旦网络形成被建模为内生过程，这一关系便发生逆转：接触高收入同伴显著加剧了抑郁症状。收入差距在两个方向上都损害心理健康，这与不平等厌恶而非相对剥夺的假设相一致。这一逆转在将二元联系扩展至消息加权网络后依然成立，且反事实实验表明，减少与同伴交换消息量的政策能改善心理健康，且改善程度随减少幅度增大而增强，尽管定向减少的效果取决于被削弱的具体联系。因此，忽视内生的同伴选择可能会对同伴效应影响心理健康得出性质上误导性的结论。
url:59e67f4dc185a160.title: DP21916 Social Comparison and Young Adult Mental Health with Endogenous Network Formation
url:59e67f4dc185a160.title_zh: 内生网络形成下的社会比较与青年心理健康研究

url:5a00e71b0dba2a1e.abstract: This paper investigates the role of resolvability as a new regulatory constraint for restricting bank behaviour. Using a regression-discontinuity design, we exploit the 2019 regulatory shock that made banks with assets below the $250 billion asset threshold exempt to mandatory resolution-planning (living will) requirements. We find that affected banks experience an increase in their profitability and their complexity. They also lend more and at more favorable terms. Credit granting is boosted especially in less resolvable loans with no covenant restrictions and in countries with poor creditor rights. Our findings suggest that by enforcing crisis plans, resolution requirements may contract credit supply.
url:5a00e71b0dba2a1e.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了可处置性作为一项新的监管约束在限制银行行为中的作用。利用断点回归设计，我们借助2019年的监管冲击，该冲击使得资产低于2500亿美元门槛的银行免于强制性处置规划（生前遗嘱）要求。我们发现，受影响的银行盈利能力与复杂性有所提升，同时贷款发放增加且条件更为优惠。信贷投放尤其在不含契约限制、可处置性较低的贷款以及债权人权利保护较弱的国家中得到显著增强。我们的研究结果表明，通过强制实施危机计划，处置要求可能会收缩信贷供给。
url:5a00e71b0dba2a1e.title: DP21835 Strong Wills, Strong Outcomes? Bank Resolvability and Credit Supply
url:5a00e71b0dba2a1e.title_zh: DP21835 坚强的意志，强劲的成效？银行可处置性与信贷供给

url:5a0f498a4e115c1e.title: Training time, robots and technological unemployment
url:5a0f498a4e115c1e.title_zh: 培训时间、机器人与技术性失业

url:5a1e7207b6700451.abstract: This article examines whether and how stronger the board monitoring in a ultimate parent company of SOEs influence the soft budget constraints of affiliated subsidiary firms. Using a quasi-natural experiment in China, we empirically document that strengthening board monitoring at the parent company help reduce soft budget constraints in its listed subsidiaries. Mechanism analysis identifies channels in such a relationship, such as a reduction in political intervention. Furthermore, we find that the impact is more pronounced in state-owned enterprises, where controlling shareholders’ boards exhibit greater independence and in firms experiencing more intense political intervention prior to the reforms. This paper not only expands the research on the influence of political interference on financial market, but also contributes to the literature on the governance effect of controlling shareholders and board reform.
url:5a1e7207b6700451.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了国有企业最终母公司加强董事会监督是否以及如何影响其下属子公司的软预算约束。利用中国的准自然实验，我们实证发现，加强母公司层面的董事会监督有助于减少其上市子公司的软预算约束。机制分析揭示了这一关系中的传导渠道，如政治干预的减少。此外，我们发现，在控股股东董事会独立性更强的国有企业以及改革前经历更强烈政治干预的企业中，这一影响更为显著。本文不仅拓展了关于政治干预对金融市场影响的研究，也为控股股东治理效应及董事会改革的文献做出了贡献。
url:5a1e7207b6700451.title: Board reform of controlling shareholders and soft budget constraints in state-owned enterprises: evidence from a parent board reform in China
url:5a1e7207b6700451.title_zh: 控股股东董事会改革与国有企业软预算约束：来自中国母公司董事会改革的证据

url:5a36856a1d075019.abstract: Food loss is a significant source of economic inefficiency in value chains. In many developing countries, including Nigeria, a majority of fruits, vegetables, and other perishable foods are lost after harvest, due in large part to inadequate postharvest handling or low adoption of post-harvest management technologies, particularly cooling technologies such as temperature-controlled transportation and cold storage. To examine the economic impacts of cool transportation connecting vegetable-producing states in northeast Nigeria to large demand centers in Nigeria’s southern regions, we introduced a randomized controlled trial. Cool transportation was found to have a large and statistically significant impact: sales price, revenues, and profits increased substantially for the origin-state marketers. A larger portion of sales price increase at the destination market is attributed to refrigeration, that is, quality preservation through cooling. About 66 percent of this increase comes from cooling, with an additional 34 percent from transportation. An information experiment further showed that improved quality information through labelling that identifies the origin of the produce creates price premiums at the destination market. This implies that significant economic gains can be generated not only from narrowing supply–demand gaps in different markets but also, potentially, through mitigating spatial asymmetric information.
url:5a36856a1d075019.abstract_zh: 食物损失是价值链中经济效率低下的重要来源。在包括尼日利亚在内的许多发展中国家，大部分水果、蔬菜及其他易腐食品在收获后发生损失，其主要原因在于采后处理不当或采后管理技术（尤其是温控运输和冷藏等冷却技术）的采用率较低。为考察连接尼日利亚东北部蔬菜生产州与南部地区大型需求中心的冷链运输的经济影响，我们开展了一项随机对照试验。研究发现，冷链运输具有显著且统计意义重大的影响：原产地销售商的销售价格、收入和利润均大幅提升。目的地市场销售价格的上涨中，更大比例归因于冷藏（即通过冷却保持品质），其中约66%的涨幅来自冷却，另外34%来自运输。一项信息实验进一步表明，通过标注产地信息的标签传递品质改善信号，可在目的地市场产生价格溢价。这意味着，不仅缩小不同市场的供需缺口能带来显著经济收益，缓解空间信息不对称同样具有潜在的经济效益。
url:5a36856a1d075019.title: Spatial disparity, information, and the economics of cool transportation: Insights from a randomized controlled trial in Nigeria
url:5a36856a1d075019.title_zh: 空间差异、信息与酷交通经济学：来自尼日利亚随机对照试验的启示

url:5a44bac63e764b50.abstract: We link administrative data on tax returns across two generations of Italians to study the degree of intergenerational mobility. We estimate that a child with parental income below the median is expected to belong to the 44th percentile of its own income distribution as an adult, and the probability of moving from the bottom to the top quintile of the income distribution within a generation is 0.10. The rank-rank correlation is 0.25, and rank persistence at the top is significantly higher than elsewhere in the income distribution. Upward mobility is higher for sons, first-born children, children of self-employed parents, and for those who migrate once adults. The data reveal large variation in child outcomes conditional on parental income rank. Part of this variation is explained by the location where the child grew up. Provinces in Northern Italy, the richest area of the country, display upward mobility levels 3-4 times as large as those in the South. This regional variation is strongly correlated with local labor market conditions, indicators of family instability, and school quality.
url:5a44bac63e764b50.abstract_zh: 我们将两代意大利人的税务申报行政数据关联起来，以研究代际流动的程度。我们估计，父母收入低于中位数的孩子，成年后预期处于其自身收入分布的第44百分位，且在一代人间从收入分布底部跃升至顶层的概率为0.10。排名-排名相关系数为0.25，且顶层的排名持续性显著高于收入分布的其他部分。向上流动性在儿子、长子、父母为自雇人士的子女以及成年后迁移的人群中更高。数据显示，在给定父母收入排名的情况下，子女结果存在巨大差异。这种差异部分由孩子成长所在地解释。意大利北部省份，即该国最富裕地区，其向上流动性水平是南部的3至4倍。这种区域差异与当地劳动力市场状况、家庭不稳定指标及学校质量密切相关。
url:5a44bac63e764b50.title: "And Yet, It Moves": Intergenerational Mobility in Italy
url:5a44bac63e764b50.title_zh: 然而，它在移动”：意大利的代际流动性

url:5a45cbc0b84c1773.abstract: Egypt's demographic trajectory has shifted markedly over recent decades, with fertility declines in the 1980s and 1990s followed by a reversal that peaked at 3.5 children per woman in 2014. While previous research has examined determinants such as women's employment, contraceptive use, and migration, the role of housing policy remains largely unexplored. This study investigates the impact of Egypt's 1996 rental market liberalization on fertility. Using four waves of the Egypt Labor Market Panel Survey (ELMPS) combined with district-level housing data from the 2006 Census, we exploit geographic and temporal variation in exposure to the reform. We examine whether women of marriageable age in 1996 living in districts with greater availability of liberalized rental units experienced different fertility outcomes. Results show that exposure to the reform increased the likelihood of childbearing and positively affected other fertility measures, including age at first birth and parity at ages 25, 30, and 35. Evidence suggests that earlier marriage is the main mechanism, consistent with the reform lowering housing constraints for young couples.
url:5a45cbc0b84c1773.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，埃及的人口结构轨迹发生了显著变化：20世纪80年代至90年代生育率下降后出现逆转，于2014年达到每名妇女生育3.5个子女的峰值。尽管已有研究探讨了女性就业、避孕措施使用及人口迁移等影响因素，但住房政策的作用仍鲜有涉及。本研究考察了埃及1996年租赁市场自由化对生育率的影响。通过运用四轮埃及劳动力市场面板调查数据，结合2006年人口普查中的地区级住房数据，我们利用改革暴露程度的地理与时间差异进行分析。研究检验了1996年处于婚育年龄的女性中，居住在自由化租赁住房供应更充足地区的群体是否呈现不同的生育结果。结果表明，改革暴露程度提高了生育可能性，并对其他生育指标产生正向影响，包括初育年龄及25岁、30岁、35岁时的生育数量。证据表明，早婚是主要作用机制，这与改革降低了年轻夫妇住房约束的结论一致。

url:5aa6cb5f053abd0c.abstract: Households do not simply choose how much macroeconomic information to acquire; they choose among sources that differ in representativeness and credibility. Using a survey of 46,285 consumers in 47 countries, this column shows that reliance on shopping, utility bills, and other local signals is associated with larger macroeconomic perception and expectation errors. Households that use official reports, newspapers, and television for information make smaller errors. Crucially, distrust of governments and central banks helps explain why more representative aggregate information is dismissed.
url:5aa6cb5f053abd0c.abstract_zh: 家庭并非简单地选择获取多少宏观经济信息；他们是在代表性和可信度各异的信源之间做出选择。基于对47个国家46,285名消费者的调查，本专栏显示，依赖购物、公用事业账单及其他本地信号与更大的宏观经济认知和预期误差相关。而使用官方报告、报纸和电视获取信息的家庭，其误差较小。关键在于，对政府和中央银行的不信任有助于解释为何更具代表性的总体信息被忽视。

url:5ab6491052a8dfc2.abstract: While economists have extensively studied gender norms affecting women, masculinity norms---social norms about how men should behave ---remain underexplored. This review first synthesizes how other disciplines have studied masculinity, providing economists with conceptual foundations and empirical patterns for understanding masculinity norms. We then discuss how the study of masculinity norms can inform the economics literature on gender gaps and men
url:5ab6491052a8dfc2.abstract_zh: 尽管经济学家已广泛研究了影响女性的性别规范，但关于男性应如何行为的社会规范——即男性气质规范——仍未被充分探索。本综述首先综合了其他学科对男性气质的研究，为经济学家理解男性气质规范提供了概念基础和实证模式。随后，我们探讨了男性气质规范的研究如何为关于性别差距和男性的经济学文献提供启示。

url:5b06fb9d63d553e0.abstract: Public debt and wealth concentration have co-moved persistently across advanced economies and historical periods, defying standard theories of wealth inequality, particularly given that rising inequality has coincided with falling real interest rates in recent decades. I develop a stylized Diamond model with household heterogeneity and progressive taxation to formalize how public debt, through its tax burden, endogenously dictates tax progressivity and thereby affects the wealth distribution. In this framework, permanent debt shocks alter tax progressivity depending on the macroeconomic regime, with debt expansions increasing progressivity when interest rates are high but reducing it when interest rates are low. The resulting impact of public debt on wealth inequality is nonlinear in the overall level of the tax burden, disequalizing below a threshold and equalizing above it. Cross-country empirical evidence supports these predictions and shows that public debt is a quantitatively important, and often dominant, driver of postwar wealth inequality, with sizable effects transmitted primarily through the tax burden. These findings establish the distribution of the tax burden as a primary driver of long-run wealth inequality, and public debt as a central mediating channel through which structural shocks, such as population aging or artificial intelligence, propagate to the wealth distribution.
url:5b06fb9d63d553e0.abstract_zh: 公共债务与财富集中度在发达经济体及历史时期中持续同步变动，这挑战了标准的财富不平等理论，尤其是在近几十年不平等加剧的同时实际利率却下降的背景下。我构建了一个包含家庭异质性和累进税制的简化Diamond模型，以形式化说明公共债务如何通过其税收负担内生地决定税收累进性，进而影响财富分配。在此框架下，永久性债务冲击会根据宏观经济体制改变税收累进性：当利率较高时，债务扩张增加累进性；而当利率较低时，则降低累进性。公共债务对财富不平等的影响在总体税收负担水平上呈现非线性特征，低于某一阈值时加剧不平等，高于该阈值时则缓解不平等。跨国经验证据支持这些预测，并表明公共债务是战后财富不平等的一个数量上重要且往往占主导地位的驱动因素，其显著效应主要通过税收负担传导。这些发现确立了税收负担分配作为长期财富不平等的主要驱动因素，以及公共债务作为结构性冲击（如人口老龄化或人工智能）向财富分配传导的核心中介渠道。

url:5b561b132f832db9.abstract_zh: 焦点 汇率变动对消费者价格的影响程度在不同国家和时期通常存在显著差异。尽管已有大量关于汇率传递效应的实证研究文献，但关于哪些具体因素驱动汇率传递效应的大小以及这些不同因素的相对贡献，目前仍知之甚少。

url:5b56eafd861bc3e2.abstract: This study analyzes the fresh produce market in Papua New Guinea (PNG) using unique market flow and price data collected by the Fresh Produce Development Agency (FPDA) over the past 15 years across multiple markets. We document substantial flows of fresh produce from diverse production zones to major urban centers, with Port Moresby emerging as the primary terminal market. Hard fresh produce and sweet potato supplied there largely originate from the Highlands, while other staples and soft fresh produce are mostly sourced from other regions. Price analysis reveals four key patterns: (i) fresh produce prices have risen significantly relative to non-food products, particularly for items less supplied by the Highlands; (ii) prices exhibit strong seasonality—lowest at year-end and highest mid-year (June–August)—reflecting major cultivation periods and possibly seasonality in household labor availability; (iii) marketing margins have increased substantially, especially for soft fresh produce, creating new opportunities for Highland producers to compete in Port Moresby markets; and (iv) in 2023–2025, marketing and wastage costs accounted for the largest share of retail prices in Port Moresby—up to 85 percent for cabbage—while producer shares ranged from 15 percent for cabbage to 61 percent for Irish potatoes. These findings underscore evolving market dynamics and the critical role of supply chain efficiency in PNG’s fresh produce sector.
url:5b56eafd861bc3e2.abstract_zh: 本研究利用巴布亚新几内亚（PNG）新鲜农产品发展局（FPDA）过去15年间在多个市场收集的独特市场流量与价格数据，对该国新鲜农产品市场进行了分析。我们记录了从不同生产区域流向主要城市中心的大量新鲜农产品流动情况，其中莫尔兹比港成为主要的终端市场。该市场供应的硬质新鲜农产品和甘薯主要来自高地地区，而其他主食和软质新鲜农产品则大多来自其他区域。价格分析揭示了四个关键特征：（i）新鲜农产品价格相对于非食品产品显著上涨，尤其是高地地区供应较少的品种；（ii）价格呈现强烈的季节性波动——年末最低，年中（6月至8月）最高——这反映了主要种植周期，并可能与家庭劳动力可用性的季节性变化有关；（iii）营销利润率大幅上升，尤其是软质新鲜农产品，为高地生产者在莫尔兹比港市场竞争创造了新机遇；（iv）在2023至2025年间，营销与损耗成本占莫尔兹比港零售价格的最大份额——卷心菜高达85%——而生产者份额则从卷心菜的15%到爱尔兰土豆的61%不等。这些发现凸显了市场动态的演变以及供应链效率在巴布亚新几内亚新鲜农产品行业中的关键作用。

url:5bb0a09f27398abc.abstract: The United States and China put parts of the global economy at risk in 2025 through their trade war over critical minerals and technology. A series of escalatory tariffs and export restrictions led to shortages of essential inputs, nearly forcing automakers worldwide to shut down production. The costly policies reflected uncoordinated and uncommunicated efforts by both countries to reduce their mutual economic dependence. This paper explores a novel path for the United States and China to "cooperate" over how they reduce their dependence on each other in technology and critical minerals, with the aim of limiting future escalation risks and avoiding unnecessary costs. The proposal draws on a version of the reciprocal approach to negotiations developed under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, modified to accommodate a mutual reduction in each country's market dominance in key sectors.
url:5bb0a09f27398abc.abstract_zh: 2025年，美国与中国围绕关键矿产和技术的贸易战使全球经济面临风险。一系列不断升级的关税和出口限制导致关键投入品短缺，几乎迫使全球汽车制造商停产。这些代价高昂的政策反映了两国在减少相互经济依赖方面缺乏协调与沟通的努力。本文探索了一条美中两国在技术和关键矿产领域“合作”减少相互依赖的新路径，旨在限制未来升级风险并避免不必要的成本。该提议借鉴了《关税与贸易总协定》框架下发展出的互惠谈判方式，并加以调整，以适应两国在关键领域市场主导地位的共同削减。

url:5bc5d3dbaee8161b.abstract: Moral regulation is widespread across societies, yet its consequences have seldom been examined empirically. We study the Hays Code (July 1934-1960s), which imposed systematic moral guidelines on American cinema. Using a regression-discontinuity design, with non-U.S. films providing a comparison group, we find that the moral compliance of U.S. films rose sharply after 1935 and remained high for two decades. The Code also reshaped protagonists and political tone: protagonists became less likely to be women or working class, and political tones grew more conservative. Filmmakers adapted both by increasing compliance within genres and by shifting across them: less-compliant Drama declined while more-compliant Western and Action rose. Companies with a larger market size and immigrant film directors exhibited stronger responses. These findings reveal how moral constraint, market, and identity jointly shape cultural production and how well-intentioned moral regulation can produce broad and often unintended spillovers.
url:5bc5d3dbaee8161b.abstract_zh: 道德规范在社会中普遍存在，但其后果鲜少得到实证研究。本文以《海斯法典》（1934年7月至20世纪60年代）为研究对象，该法典对美国电影施加了系统性的道德准则。通过采用断点回归设计，并以非美国电影作为对照组，我们发现美国电影的道德合规性在1935年后急剧上升，并持续保持高位长达二十年。该法典还重塑了主角形象与政治基调：主角中女性及工人阶级的比例显著下降，政治基调趋于保守。电影制作人通过两种方式适应这一变化：既在类型片内部提升合规性，又进行类型片之间的转移——合规性较低的剧情片产量下降，而合规性较高的西部片与动作片产量上升。市场份额较大的电影公司及移民导演表现出更强的应对反应。这些发现揭示了道德约束、市场与身份认同如何共同塑造文化生产，以及出于善意的道德规范如何产生广泛且往往非预期的溢出效应。
url:5bc5d3dbaee8161b.title: Moral Regulation and Cultural Production: Evidence from Hollywood
url:5bc5d3dbaee8161b.title_zh: 道德规制与文化生产：来自好莱坞的证据

url:5bc8e90fe69a7711.abstract: Can monetary incentives improve health behaviors in the long run, and do commonly used surrogate outcomes capture these effects? We study these questions in the context of vaccination using a large-scale eld experiment. The experiment combines commonly used surrogates|vaccination intentions, intermediate behavioral proxies, and short-run vaccination|with long-run administrative vaccination records. We first document that incentives increase vaccination rates in the long run: guaranteed $20 incentives raise COVID-19 booster uptake by 9 percentage points. Lottery-based incentives also increase long-run uptake, while prosocial incentives primarily accelerate vaccination. Second, using surrogacy methods, we study whether surrogates can predict long-run impacts. Although the surrogates are strongly correlated with eventual vaccination, the assumptions required for surrogacy methods are often violated, and they do not accurately predict long-run impacts. Our ndings highlight both the ability of incentives to change behavior and the importance of measuring long-run outcomes rather than relying solely on surrogates.
url:5bc8e90fe69a7711.abstract_zh: 货币激励能否长期改善健康行为？常用的替代指标能否捕捉这些效应？我们通过一项大规模实地实验，以疫苗接种为背景研究上述问题。该实验将常用替代指标（疫苗接种意愿、中间行为代理变量及短期疫苗接种）与长期行政疫苗接种记录相结合。首先，我们证实激励措施能长期提升疫苗接种率：20美元保证性激励使新冠加强针接种率提高9个百分点。基于抽奖的激励同样能提升长期接种率，而亲社会激励主要加速疫苗接种进程。其次，通过替代指标方法，我们检验替代指标能否预测长期影响。尽管替代指标与最终疫苗接种存在强相关性，但替代指标方法所需假设常被违反，且无法准确预测长期影响。研究结果既凸显了激励措施改变行为的能力，也揭示了测量长期结果而非仅依赖替代指标的重要性。
url:5bc8e90fe69a7711.title: Incentives, Surrogates, and Long-run Vaccination
url:5bc8e90fe69a7711.title_zh: 激励、替代指标与长期疫苗接种

url:5bc93bbb8a80638e.abstract: We provide a first-ever long-run index of wages of stable rural workers in early-modern Tuscany. These wages speak to two longstanding debates. The first concerns whether Italy’s early-modern downturn was an urban phenomenon only or an all-embracing one. Our data lend support to the former, since we do not detect any downturn in our early-modern rural wages. The second debate concerns whether high-waged workers prompted the Industrial Revolution. Earlier studies in this debate have been criticised for comparing urban wages when early factories emerged in rural areas. By comparing rural wages, we find that English labour cost only 10 per cent more than their Italian counterparts in 1650, but a staggering 150 per cent more in 1800. The revised timing of the divergence between England and Italy, and its overlap with England’s early mechanisation, raise a significant identification problem. Did high wages encourage mechanisation, or did mechanisation boost wages?
url:5bc93bbb8a80638e.abstract_zh: 我们首次构建了近代早期托斯卡纳地区稳定农村工人工资的长期指数。这些工资数据涉及两个长期存在的争论。第一个争论是关于意大利近代早期的经济衰退是否仅为城市现象，还是全面性的。我们的数据支持前者，因为我们在近代早期农村工资中未检测到任何衰退迹象。第二个争论涉及高工资工人是否促进了工业革命。此前关于此争论的研究因比较城市工资而受到批评，因为早期工厂出现在农村地区。通过比较农村工资，我们发现1650年英国劳动力成本仅比意大利高出10%，但到1800年这一差距惊人地达到了150%。英国与意大利之间分化时间的修正，及其与英国早期机械化的重叠，提出了一个重要的识别问题：是高工资促进了机械化，还是机械化提升了工资？
url:5bc93bbb8a80638e.title: Italy and the Industrial Revolution: Evidence from Stable Employment in Rural Areas
url:5bc93bbb8a80638e.title_zh: 意大利与工业革命：来自农村地区稳定就业的证据

url:5bd5b3391be2b64e.abstract: We document how foreign firms, inputs, and subsidies have shaped the development of Viet Nam's solar panel industry. We use firm-to-firm transaction data from Panjiva as well as firm-level data from the Vietnamese Enterprise Survey to trace solar panel value chains. We uncover three key findings: First, parts and components from subsidizing countries are 30% cheaper than alternatives. Those from China, which provides the majority of solar inputs to Vietnamese producers, are cheapest. Foreign subsidies may thus spill over across countries via value chains. Second, Chinese FDI firms dominate Viet Nam's solar industry, accounting for 75% of exports and 50% of jobs, while exporting solar panels that are 38% cheaper than those of other producers in Viet Nam. Third, local firms supplying parts and components to these Chinese FDI firms experience positive productivity gains. Our findings show how Viet Nam's solar boom emerged through deep integration into China's subsidized supply chains.
url:5bd5b3391be2b64e.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了外资企业、中间投入品及补贴如何塑造了越南太阳能光伏产业的发展格局。我们利用Panjiva的企业间交易数据以及越南企业调查的企业层面数据，追溯了太阳能光伏价值链的演变。研究得出三项核心发现：第一，来自补贴国的零部件价格比替代品低30%，而来自中国（越南太阳能投入品的主要供应国）的零部件价格最低。这表明外国补贴可能通过价值链产生跨国溢出效应。第二，中国外商直接投资企业在越南太阳能产业中占据主导地位，贡献了75%的出口额和50%的就业岗位，其出口的太阳能电池板价格比越南其他生产商低38%。第三，向这些中国外商直接投资企业供应零部件的本土企业实现了正向生产率提升。研究结论表明，越南太阳能产业的繁荣是通过深度融入中国补贴供应链实现的。

url:5c0e073221488469.abstract: There is a large body of evidence showing that for many countries the structure of wages and pensions and the labor law legislation are different for public and private employees. Such differences affect the occupational choice of agents and might generate some type of misallocation. We develop a life-cycle model with endogenous occupational choice and heterogeneous agents to study the implications of an overpaid public sector. The model is estimated to be consistent with micro and macro evidence for Brazil, a country with a high public sector earnings premium. Our counterfactual exercises demonstrate that public-private earnings premium can generate important allocation effects and sizeable productivity losses. For instance, a reform that would decrease the public-private wage premium from its benchmark value of $19\%$ to $15\%$ and would align the pension of public sector workers with the one in place for private sector workers could increase aggregate output by $11.2\%$ in the long-run without any decrease in the supply of public infrastructure. We provide a decomposition of the aggregate effect into changes in factors accumulation and changes in TFP and implement a welfare distributive analysis.
url:5c0e073221488469.abstract_zh: 大量证据表明，在许多国家，公共部门与私营部门员工的工资结构、养老金制度及劳动法规存在差异。这些差异影响个体的职业选择，并可能引发某种形式的资源配置不当。我们构建了一个包含内生职业选择与异质性主体的生命周期模型，以研究公共部门薪酬过高所带来的影响。该模型基于巴西的微观与宏观证据进行校准，巴西是一个公共部门收入溢价较高的国家。我们的反事实实验表明，公共与私营部门间的收入溢价能产生重要的配置效应及显著的生产率损失。例如，一项改革若将公共与私营部门的工资溢价从基准值的19%降至15%，并使公共部门员工的养老金与私营部门员工保持一致，长期内可使总产出增加11.2%，且不减少公共基础设施的供给。我们将总体效应分解为要素积累变化与全要素生产率变化两部分，并进行福利分配分析。

url:5c268c9b96d623d2.abstract: Evaluating optimized AI systems for asset pricing is fundamentally difficult for two reasons. First, models are trained on all data, implying that any backtest or analysis using historical data suffers from look-ahead bias. In addition, markets are reflexive — as investors adopt AI, prices adjust — which may erode the very patterns the AI system was trained to exploit. We introduce a real-time, out-of-sample benchmark designed to sidestep both problems. The benchmark measures how well AI systems can explain contemporaneous stock returns around earnings announcements using only information available at announcement time, including the text of the announcement itself. Applying this benchmark to a range of agentic AI systems — which extract structured signals from earnings call transcripts and optimize over those signals — we find that the best-optimized systems more than double the explained variation in returns relative to standard benchmarks (R2 increasing from 8% to close to 20%). We show that AI-based optimization can deliver efficiency gains relative to traditional machine learning methods while also improving interpretability as our approach produces human-readable economic mechanisms that explain price movements. These learned rules can be compared to the drivers of realized returns in existing asset pricing models to identify missing sources of variation in a data-driven, self-evolving way that integrates empirical learning with economic structure. We release an SDK for researchers to improve on our results. Saturating this benchmark would represent fundamental progress in understanding how capital markets process firm-level information.
url:5c268c9b96d623d2.abstract_zh: 评估针对资产定价优化的AI系统存在两个根本性困难。首先，模型基于全部数据训练，这意味着任何使用历史数据的回测或分析都存在前瞻性偏差。其次，市场具有反身性——随着投资者采用AI技术，价格会相应调整——这可能导致AI系统原本训练利用的模式逐渐消失。我们引入了一个实时、样本外的基准测试，旨在规避这两个问题。该基准测试衡量AI系统仅利用公告发布时可获取的信息（包括公告文本本身）来解释盈余公告期间同期股票收益的能力。将该基准应用于一系列智能体AI系统（这些系统从财报电话会议记录中提取结构化信号并对其进行优化），我们发现最优化的系统相较于标准基准，其解释的收益变异程度提升了一倍以上（R²从8%提升至接近20%）。研究表明，基于AI的优化相较于传统机器学习方法能带来效率提升，同时增强可解释性——我们的方法可生成解释价格变动的人类可读经济机制。这些学习到的规则可与现有资产定价模型中实际收益的驱动因素进行对比，以数据驱动、自我演进的方式识别缺失的变异来源，实现经验学习与经济结构的融合。我们发布了SDK供研究者改进我们的结果。饱和该基准测试将标志着理解资本市场如何处理公司层面信息的根本性进展。

url:5c3950b814268286.abstract: This paper shows that expected capital gains in several MSAs were higher for relatively lower-priced, rather than higher-priced, houses during the U.S. boom of the 2000s. Because buyers of lower-priced houses tend to be more sensitive to credit conditions than buyers of higher-priced houses, this paper documents patterns that are consistent with an interaction of beliefs and credit conditions in a time period where direct evidence on house price beliefs is scarce. Documenting this interaction is important for unifying beliefs and credit conditions as joint, instead of competing, explanations for the U.S. housing boom of the 2000s.
url:5c3950b814268286.abstract_zh: 本文表明，在2000年代美国房地产繁荣期间，多个大都市统计区（MSAs）中，相对低价房屋的预期资本收益高于高价房屋。由于低价房屋的购房者往往比高价房屋的购房者对信贷条件更为敏感，本文记录的模式与信念和信贷条件在房价信念直接证据稀缺时期的相互作用一致。记录这种相互作用对于将信念和信贷条件作为共同而非竞争性解释因素来统一说明2000年代美国房地产繁荣具有重要意义。

url:5c48ceab98af2ef2.abstract: We find consistent evidence across ratings and regions that delta-hedged credit index options have large negative Sharpe ratios and much more so than their equity index counterparts. Risk-factors extracted from equity index options have only moderate explanatory power for the time-series and cross-sectional variation in credit option returns, while a single credit-specific factor explains much of the remaining variation. We link this factor to credit option order flow in a manner that is consistent with the predictions of a demand-based option pricing model, where order-flow risk is priced in equilibrium.
url:5c48ceab98af2ef2.abstract_zh: 我们通过评级和地区的一致证据发现，Delta对冲的信用指数期权具有较大的负夏普比率，且其负值程度远超股票指数期权。从股票指数期权中提取的风险因子对信用期权收益的时间序列和截面变化的解释力有限，而一个单一的信用特定因子则解释了剩余的大部分变化。我们将该因子与信用期权订单流联系起来，这一关联符合基于需求的期权定价模型的预测，在该模型中，订单流风险在均衡状态下被定价。

url:5c6a3112d295f4c6.abstract: China's accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001 marked the beginning of one of the most consequential episodes in the history of global trade. The subsequent surge in Chinese exports–often referred to as the "China Shock"–has been widely associated with large adjustments in production patterns, labor markets, and trade balances across the global economy (Autor et al. 2016; Pierce and Schott 2016).
url:5c6a3112d295f4c6.abstract_zh: 中国于2001年加入世界贸易组织，标志着全球贸易史上最具深远影响的事件之一的开端。随后中国出口的激增——常被称为“中国冲击”——已被广泛认为与全球经济中生产模式、劳动力市场及贸易平衡的重大调整密切相关（Autor等，2016；Pierce和Schott，2016）。

url:5c6e779be9d750eb.abstract: We measure how workers use genAI for their jobs in a nationally representative survey. Our data provide the first task-level genAI adoption indexes, which can inform analyses of genAI's labor market impact. Exposure scores explain some, but far from all, of the variation in adoption across occupations and tasks. Chat-log measures differ conceptually and tend to over-classify chats into generic activities. Current adoption is widespread but shallow: genAI is used across many occupations and tasks, yet within most, fewer than half of workers adopt. Understanding who adopts may thus matter as much as understanding which tasks genAI assists.
url:5c6e779be9d750eb.abstract_zh: 我们在全国代表性调查中衡量了工人如何在工作中使用生成式人工智能。我们的数据提供了首个任务层面的生成式人工智能采用指数，可为分析生成式人工智能对劳动力市场的影响提供信息。暴露度评分解释了职业和任务间采用差异的一部分，但远非全部。聊天记录指标在概念上有所不同，且倾向于将聊天过度归类为一般性活动。当前采用情况广泛但浅层：生成式人工智能应用于众多职业和任务，但在大多数领域内，采用者不足半数。因此，理解谁在采用可能与分析生成式人工智能辅助哪些任务同样重要。

url:5c8e7782ab7fd131.abstract: We study the extent to which exposure to COVID-19 relates to healthcare professionals’ prosociality. Drawing on empirical evidence from an incentivized experiment and a companion survey of healthcare professionals (HCPs) at a large Italian hospital (N = 194), we find that different forms of exposure to COVID-19 predict their altruistic motivation in heterogeneous ways. HCPs who worked in COVID 19 wards or had a close relative or friend severely affected by the virus are more than 5 percentage points more likely to prioritize patient welfare over personal gain, with the association for professional exposure being mostly driven by female HCPs, especially nurses. Conversely, personally contracting COVID-19 is associated with a 6 percentage point decline in prosociality. Our results highlight that different experiences of need shape prosocial behavior in hospital settings.
url:5c8e7782ab7fd131.abstract_zh: 我们研究了接触COVID-19与医护人员亲社会性之间的关联程度。基于一项激励性实验及对意大利一家大型医院医护人员（N=194）的配套调查所获得的实证证据，我们发现，不同形式的COVID-19暴露对其利他动机的预测作用存在异质性。在COVID-19病房工作或近亲或好友严重感染该病毒的医护人员，将患者福祉置于个人利益之上的可能性高出5个百分点以上，其中职业暴露的关联主要由女性医护人员，尤其是护士驱动。相反，个人感染COVID-19与亲社会性下降6个百分点相关。我们的结果凸显了不同需求经历如何塑造医院环境中的亲社会行为。

url:5c97f8dd3cf61e07.abstract: This paper examines whether mobile money reduces gender gaps in financial autonomy across six Sahelian countries using Afrobarometer Round 9 data (2021-2023, N=6, 540). Instrumenting adoption with distance to traditional financial services, we find pronounced heterogeneity: mobile money increases women's autonomy by 11 percentage points in Senegal (26% gap reduction) and 16 points in Sudan (38% reduction), with no detectable effects in four other countries. This variation correlates with ecosystem maturity, agent density, and regulatory quality. Mechanisms include transactional discretion, informal credit access, and enhanced security. Transformative impacts require 10-14 years ecosystem maturation and agent density above 1 per 2, 000 inhabitants. Digital finance advances women's empowerment only under specific institutional conditions.
url:5c97f8dd3cf61e07.abstract_zh: 本文利用非洲晴雨表第9轮数据（2021-2023年，样本量N=6,540），考察移动货币是否缩小了萨赫勒地区六国女性金融自主权的性别差距。通过以距离传统金融服务的远近作为移动货币采纳的工具变量，我们发现显著的异质性：移动货币使塞内加尔女性金融自主权提升11个百分点（性别差距缩小26%），苏丹提升16个百分点（性别差距缩小38%），而在其他四个国家未观察到显著影响。这种差异与生态系统成熟度、代理网点密度及监管质量相关。其作用机制包括交易自主权、非正规信贷获取及安全性提升。变革性影响需10-14年生态系统成熟期，且代理网点密度需达到每2000名居民至少1个。数字金融仅在特定制度条件下才能促进女性赋权。

url:5cc28f4442e6fa98.abstract: Investors reward reform progress. Econometric results suggest that holistic reforms, fiscal spending discipline, and monetary policy credibility are associated with a tightening of Qatar’s external sovereign credit spreads. In particular, investors may view fiscal spending discipline as an integral part of Qatar’s holistic reform and economic diversification. Greater broad-based reform progress also boosts the resilience of sovereign credit spreads to external shocks. The findings support fiscal and monetary policy reforms as part of the broader reform agenda in a holistic manner, as planned under the Third National Development Strategy.
url:5cc28f4442e6fa98.abstract_zh: 投资者对改革进展给予回报。计量经济学结果表明，整体性改革、财政支出纪律和货币政策可信度与卡塔尔外部主权信用利差的收紧相关。特别是，投资者可能将财政支出纪律视为卡塔尔整体改革和经济多元化不可或缺的一部分。更广泛的全面改革进展也增强了主权信用利差抵御外部冲击的韧性。这些发现支持将财政和货币政策改革作为更广泛改革议程的一部分，以整体方式推进，正如第三国家发展战略所规划的那样。

url:5ccbecd72d645250.abstract: This paper studies the environmental effects of the large-scale deployment of AI-driven monitoring systems across French wastewater treatment plants operated by a global leader in water supply services. Exploiting quasi-experimental variation in both the timing of adoption and outages thanks to high-frequency data, we estimate the causal impact of AI on energy use and carbon emissions. We find that AI has allowed treated plants to reduce their electricity consumption and carbon emissions by 5.4% and 6% respectively, and electricity costs by 8.2%, resulting in negative abatement costs, and still improved water effluent quality. The additional electricity demand generated by AI servers represents less than 1% of these savings. Beyond average effects, AI-equipped plants exhibit greater resilience to high operational stress, including extreme meteorological events and chemical pollutant peaks. They also improve load management by reallocating consumption from peak toward off-peak hours. Finally, we assess the aggregate implications of our findings for global climate and welfare using the DICE model. We find large estimated global welfare gains associated with our estimate of AI-induced CO2 reductions.
url:5ccbecd72d645250.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由全球水务服务领导者运营的法国污水处理厂大规模部署人工智能驱动监控系统的环境效应。利用高频数据中采纳时机与系统故障的准实验变异，我们估计了人工智能对能源使用和碳排放的因果影响。研究发现，人工智能使受处理工厂的电力消耗和碳排放分别降低了5.4%和6%，电力成本下降了8.2%，实现了负减排成本，同时改善了出水水质。人工智能服务器产生的额外电力需求仅占这些节约量的不到1%。除平均效应外，配备人工智能的工厂在极端气象事件和化学污染物峰值等高运营压力下展现出更强的韧性，并通过将用电从高峰时段重新分配至非高峰时段改善了负荷管理。最后，我们利用DICE模型评估了研究结果对全球气候和福利的总体影响，发现人工智能带来的二氧化碳减排估计值对应着巨大的全球福利增益。

url:5ce4da245ad965cd.abstract: Globalization offers unparalleled opportunities to expand welfare through cooperation across large networks of unrelated individuals. Social exclusion – permanent or temporary – and monetary exchange are institutions that in theory can incentivize cooperation. In an experiment, we evaluate their relative performance and interaction in anonymous networks of different sizes. Permanent social exclusion (ostracism) reduces long-run economic potential by leading to sparse networks. Monetary exchange and temporary social exclusion perform similarly well in small networks. In large networks, however, monetary exchange is the only institution that promotes full cooperation by crowding out ostracism and keeping the network complete. An insight is that monetary systems outperform social exclusion mechanisms in promoting cooperation in globalized social and economic networks.
url:5ce4da245ad965cd.abstract_zh: 全球化通过跨越大量无亲缘关系个体的广泛网络合作，为扩展福利提供了前所未有的机遇。社会排斥——无论是永久性的还是暂时性的——以及货币交换，在理论上都是能够激励合作的制度。在一项实验中，我们评估了它们在不同规模匿名网络中的相对表现及其相互作用。永久性社会排斥（放逐）通过导致网络稀疏化，削弱了长期经济潜力。在小规模网络中，货币交换与暂时性社会排斥表现相当。然而，在大规模网络中，货币交换是唯一能通过挤出放逐行为并保持网络完整性来促进全面合作的制度。一个洞见是，在全球化社会与经济网络中，货币体系在促进合作方面优于社会排斥机制。

url:5d1f3309dc39d411.abstract: The Turkish central bank cut interest rates over 2021-2023, on the politically driven view that higher rates cause inflation. This column analyses the policies used instead: foreign exchange interventions, a foreign-exchange-protected deposit scheme, and eventually financial repression and soft capital controls. These interventions did not remove currency risk but moved it onto the government, widened sovereign spreads, and converted a monetary problem into a fiscal one. After the 2023 elections, orthodox policy returned. However, the costs of this experiment are large and still being paid, making the eventual adjustment larger than the one avoided.
url:5d1f3309dc39d411.abstract_zh: 土耳其中央银行在2021年至2023年间下调利率，其背后是受政治驱动的观点，认为高利率会导致通胀。本文分析了替代政策的使用：外汇干预、外汇保护存款计划，以及最终的金融抑制和温和资本管制。这些干预措施并未消除货币风险，而是将其转移至政府，扩大了主权利差，并将货币问题转化为财政问题。2023年选举后，正统政策回归。然而，这一实验的成本巨大且仍在支付中，使得最终的调整规模大于所避免的调整。

url:5d39618356959f79.abstract: Emerging market economies (EMEs) have historically been vulnerable to external shocks. Recently the global economy has experienced several major shocks yet EMEs have been remarkably resilient. Some of this improved performance can be attributed to prudent policies and stronger economic fundamentals, but the existing literature points to an overperformance mystery by some EMEs with weaker fundamentals. We evaluate an alternative measure of vulnerability based on the concept of a natural level of capital flows (KF*). Specifically, we hypothesize that EMEs are more vulnerable when prior to a large global shock capital flows—portfolio inflows, to be specific—exceed KF*. Results indicate that for major global shocks over the past two decades the pre-shock gap between actual portfolio and KF* has substantial predictive power for the post-shock performance of EMEs.
url:5d39618356959f79.abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体（EMEs）历来易受外部冲击影响。近期，全球经济经历了数次重大冲击，然而新兴市场经济体表现出显著的韧性。这种表现的改善部分可归因于审慎的政策和更为坚实的经济基本面，但现有文献指出，一些基本面较弱的新兴市场经济体存在表现超预期的谜团。我们基于资本流动的自然水平（KF*）概念，评估了一种替代性的脆弱性衡量指标。具体而言，我们假设，在大型全球冲击发生前，若资本流动——具体指证券投资流入——超过KF*，则新兴市场经济体更为脆弱。结果表明，在过去二十年的重大全球冲击中，冲击前实际证券投资与KF*之间的缺口，对新兴市场经济体冲击后的表现具有显著的预测能力。
url:5d39618356959f79.title: Mind the KF* Gap: EME Vulnerabilities to Global Shocks
url:5d39618356959f79.title_zh: 注意KF*缺口：新兴市场经济体对全球冲击的脆弱性

url:5d3b933f2e416eeb.abstract: Free trade in audio-visual services has faced opposition on the grounds that foreign media undermine domestic culture, and ultimately, global diversity. We assess the media-culture link using name frequencies as a measure of tastes. Using a 47-year panel of French birth registries, we first show that names appearing on television shows, movies, or in songs are about five times more popular than other names. Most, but not all, of this relationship arises from endogeneity: song and script writers, as well as performers and their parents, select names that would be popular anyways. Using name attributes, fixed effects, and lagged popularity as controls, our regression results suggest that media affect choices by informing parents of unfamiliar names.
url:5d3b933f2e416eeb.abstract_zh: 视听服务自由贸易面临反对，理由在于外国媒体会侵蚀本土文化，并最终损害全球文化多样性。我们以名字使用频率作为文化品味的衡量指标，评估媒体与文化之间的关联。基于法国出生登记系统47年的面板数据，我们首先发现：出现在电视节目、电影或歌曲中的名字，其流行度约为其他名字的五倍。这种关联大部分（但非全部）源于内生性：歌曲和剧本作者、表演者及其父母会优先选择本就可能流行的名字。通过控制名字属性、固定效应及滞后流行度变量，回归结果表明：媒体通过向父母传递不熟悉的名字信息，从而影响其选择。
url:5d3b933f2e416eeb.title: Exposure to Foreign Media and Changes in Cultural Traits: Evidence from Naming Patterns in France
url:5d3b933f2e416eeb.title_zh: 接触外国媒体与文化特征变化：来自法国命名模式的证据

url:5d4eaf2ec2645e91.abstract: We review the current state of the estimation of DSGE models. After introducing a general framework for dealing with DSGE models, the state-space representation, we discuss how to evaluate moments or the likelihood function implied by such a structure. We discuss, in varying degrees of detail, recent advances in the field, such as the tempered particle filter, approximated Bayesian computation, the Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, variational inference, and machine learning, methods that show much promise, but that have not been fully explored yet by the DSGE community. We conclude by outlining three future challenges for this line of research.
url:5d4eaf2ec2645e91.abstract_zh: 我们回顾了DSGE模型估计的当前状态。在引入处理DSGE模型的一般框架——状态空间表示之后，我们探讨了如何评估由此结构隐含的矩或似然函数。我们以不同程度的细节讨论了该领域的最新进展，如温和粒子滤波、近似贝叶斯计算、哈密顿蒙特卡洛、变分推断及机器学习等方法，这些方法展现出巨大潜力，但尚未被DSGE研究社群充分探索。最后，我们概述了该研究方向未来面临的三大挑战。
url:5d4eaf2ec2645e91.title: Estimating DSGE Models: Recent Advances and Future Challenges
url:5d4eaf2ec2645e91.title_zh: 估计DSGE模型：近期进展与未来挑战

url:5d596bcb0673cda5.abstract: Standard welfare evaluations of means-tested transfers typically treat eligibility enforcement as affecting only households directly exposed to the rule. We show that this direct-only approach is incomplete when enforcement events transmit information through workplace networks, inducing other beneficiaries to adjust formal employment and reported earnings. We study Uruguay's AFAM-PE conditional cash transfer, in which household income eligibility is verified monthly using administrative records of formal earnings and households exceeding the threshold may lose benefits, while most beneficiaries are largely unaware of the income rule. Linking program records, social security employment histories, and firm identifiers, we build workplace networks defined six months before each peer's exposure to enforcement and identify spillovers using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design that exploits quasi-random variation in whether a peer crosses the income threshold. Coworkers of peers just above the cutoff reduce registered labor earnings by 20%, and the corresponding fuzzy-RD estimate implies a decline of about one-third of baseline earnings in response to a peer's suspension. These effects emerge within two months and persist for at least 12 months. The response operates almost entirely on the extensive margin of formal employment, and most of the decline reflects transitions to informal work rather than exit from the labor force. Spillovers are concentrated in small firms and among similar coworkers, are nearly three times larger when the suspended peer actively contacted the program's support service, and are absent among non-beneficiary coworkers. This pattern is consistent with information transmission as the main channel. Incorporating these indirect responses lowers the estimated MVPF of the program as implemented with enforcement from 0.53 to 0.36. Because the same information channel operates wherever means-tested programs are enforced through records of formal earnings, evaluations that count only directly exposed households systematically understate the cost of enforcement.
url:5d596bcb0673cda5.abstract_zh: 对家计调查型转移支付的福利评估通常将资格核查视为仅影响直接受规则约束的家庭。我们证明，当核查事件通过工作场所网络传递信息，促使其他受益人调整正规就业和申报收入时，这种仅关注直接影响的评估方法是不完整的。本研究以乌拉圭AFAM-PE有条件现金转移项目为对象，该项目每月通过行政记录核实家庭收入资格，超出阈值的家庭可能失去福利，但多数受益人对收入规则知之甚少。通过关联项目记录、社保就业历史及企业标识，我们构建了每位同伴接受核查前六个月的工作场所网络，并利用同伴是否跨越收入阈值的准随机变化，采用模糊断点回归设计识别溢出效应。结果显示，略高于收入阈值的同伴的同事，其登记劳动收入下降20%；对应的模糊断点回归估计表明，同伴被暂停资格后，其同事基线收入下降约三分之一。这些影响在两个月内显现并持续至少12个月。反应几乎完全体现在正规就业的集约边际上，收入下降主要源于向非正规工作的转移而非退出劳动力市场。溢出效应集中于小型企业和相似同事群体中；当被暂停资格的同伴主动联系项目支持服务时，溢出效应扩大近三倍，而非受益同事中则无此现象。这一模式与信息传递作为主要渠道的假设一致。将间接反应纳入评估后，该项目在核查机制下的估计边际价值公共资金（MVPF）从0.53降至0.36。由于凡是通过正规收入记录执行家计调查的项目均存在相同的信息传递渠道，仅统计直接受影响家庭的评估方法会系统性低估核查成本。
url:5d596bcb0673cda5.title: Enforcement Spillovers and the Efficiency Costs of Means-Tested Transfers: Evidence from Workplace Networks
url:5d596bcb0673cda5.title_zh: 执法溢出效应与收入审查型转移支付的效率成本：基于职场网络的证据

url:5d6c8d7a2f9e3ef5.abstract: This study provides a comprehensive understanding of the Great Fire’s effects on London’s economic geography. Our analysis reveals both continuity and change. There was a swift postfire recovery accompanied by some shift in economic activity towards the City of Westminster by 1690, with markets spreading outside the City, but financial services largely remaining inside. Analysis of London Hearth Tax records further illustrates a significant change in the wealth distribution, with wealthier households returning to fire-impacted areas, reshaping the city’s housing and social structure.
url:5d6c8d7a2f9e3ef5.abstract_zh: 本研究全面探讨了伦敦大火对城市经济地理的影响。分析揭示了连续性与变革并存的现象。火灾后迅速恢复的同时，至1690年经济活动有所向威斯敏斯特市转移，市场扩展至城外，但金融服务仍主要集中于城内。对伦敦壁炉税记录的分析进一步展示了财富分布的显著变化，较富裕家庭回归受火灾影响区域，重塑了城市的住房与社会结构。
url:5d6c8d7a2f9e3ef5.title: When London Burned to Sticks: The Economic Impact of the Great Fire of 1666
url:5d6c8d7a2f9e3ef5.title_zh: 当伦敦化为灰烬：1666年大火的经济影响

url:5d85357532696fae.abstract: We examine the implications of the U.S. Research and Experimentation Tax Credit, introduced in 1981, and alternative protectionist policies. Key findings are: First, the tax credit generates substantial gains over medium and long horizons. Second, protectionist measures generate large dynamic losses by distorting the firms’ innovation incentives. Third, the optimal R&D subsidy decreases in trade openness. Fourth, the optimal unilateral import tariff is zero for all policy horizons.
url:5d85357532696fae.abstract_zh: 我们考察了1981年实施的美国研究与实验税收抵免及其替代性保护主义政策的影响。主要发现如下：第一，税收抵免在中长期内带来显著收益。第二，保护主义措施通过扭曲企业创新激励，造成巨大的动态损失。第三，最优研发补贴随贸易开放度下降而减少。第四，对所有政策期限而言，最优单边进口关税为零。
url:5d85357532696fae.title: Innovation and Trade Policy in a Globalized World
url:5d85357532696fae.title_zh: 全球化世界中的创新与贸易政策

url:5d895ebee552ed50.abstract: We study whether workplace flexibility is a key driver of the motherhood penalty. Greater exposure to flexible work substantially reduces mothers
url:5d895ebee552ed50.abstract_zh: 我们研究工作场所灵活性是否为“母职惩罚”的关键驱动因素。利用新冠疫情后居家办公合同在双重差分框架下的急剧且异质性扩散，我们将意大利所有居家办公合同的行政数据与匹配的雇主-雇员记录、母亲-父亲关联数据、生育记录及企业资产负债表相结合。对灵活工作的更高接触显著降低了母亲

url:5db458811c2f6fef.abstract: Exploiting three decades of detailed regional data for Germany, we find that when the Green Party is successful at the polls, local hazardous emissions decline. The level of political representation matters, too. Green politicians’ gaining influence at county level is followed largely by a decline in air pollutants that have an immediate adverse health effect. In contrast, when the Green party joins the state government, only greenhouse gas emissions that affect the welfare of future generations via climate change decline. The primary mechanism to achieve lower emissions appears to be a reduction in output, rather than more efficient energy use.
url:5db458811c2f6fef.abstract_zh: 利用德国三十年来详尽的区域数据，我们发现当绿党在选举中获胜时，当地有害排放物会减少。政治代表程度同样重要。绿党政客在县级层面获得影响力后，主要伴随的是对健康有直接不利影响的空气污染物减少。相比之下，当绿党加入州政府时，只有通过气候变化影响后代福利的温室气体排放会减少。实现较低排放的主要机制似乎是产出减少，而非能源利用效率提升。
url:5db458811c2f6fef.title: Walking the Talk? Green Politicians and Pollution Patterns

url:5db9c212ef4b2ea3.abstract: We study monopolistic certification in markets where sellers possess partial private information about product quality. A certifier can provide information through two channels: screening sellers’ private information (soft information) and acquiring new quality data (hard information). We prove that any certification menu achieving less than maximal screening is Pareto dominated by one with full screening.
url:5db9c212ef4b2ea3.abstract_zh: 我们研究在卖方拥有产品质量部分私人信息的市场中垄断性认证问题。认证机构可通过两种渠道提供信息：筛选卖方的私人信息（软信息）以及获取新的质量数据（硬信息）。我们证明，任何未能实现最大程度筛选的认证菜单，均会被完全筛选的认证菜单帕累托占优。
url:5db9c212ef4b2ea3.title: Informative Certification: Screening vs. Acquisition

url:5e064ad80fedba53.abstract: Amid public skepticism toward trade, we investigate whether evidence-based information - concise statements of research findings - can shape trade policy preferences. In survey experiments conducted on U.S. general population samples from 2018-2022, we consistently uncover a “backfire effect”: information highlighting the benefits of trade, such as job gains in productive sectors or lower prices for consumers, induces protectionist preferences. We interpret this effect as stemming from prior-biased belief updating, whereby the information activates pre-existing concerns about competition for jobs and trade relations with China. These associations are evoked particularly among limited-attention respondents, as well as politically-engaged Republicans.
url:5e064ad80fedba53.abstract_zh: 在公众对贸易持怀疑态度的背景下，我们探究了基于证据的信息——即研究结论的简明陈述——能否影响贸易政策偏好。基于2018-2022年间对美国普通人群样本开展的调查实验，我们持续发现一种"反火效应"：强调贸易益处（如生产部门就业增长或消费者价格降低）的信息反而会诱发保护主义偏好。我们将这一效应解释为源于先验偏差信念更新机制——信息激活了公众对就业竞争及中美贸易关系的既有担忧。这种关联效应在注意力有限的受访者以及政治参与度高的共和党人中尤为显著。
url:5e064ad80fedba53.title: Can Evidence-Based Information Shift Preferences Towards Trade Policy?
