url:5e18be6e9b2ce390.title: What Happens to Diet Quality When Food Prices Rise? Revealed Preference From National Household Scanner Data, 2015–2018
url:5e18be6e9b2ce390.title_zh: 食品价格上涨时饮食质量如何变化？基于2015–2018年全国家庭扫描数据的显示性偏好分析

url:5e1979b2ebe6775a.abstract: Using linked survey and administrative wage records, we measure workers’ financial monitoring through the accuracy of their self-reported earnings. An unsupervised latent-class model distinguishes transitory reporting errors from rounding behavior and persistent reporting biases, allowing us to interpret lower reporting uncertainty as more precise knowledge of one’s wages. Among low-wage workers, reporting precision exhibits a pronounced pay-cycle pattern: it increases by approximately 12 percent in the days leading up to payday and declines immediately afterward. No comparable pattern emerges among higher-wage workers. These findings suggest that predictable liquidity constraints lead low-wage workers to monitor their personal finances more closely as payday approaches.
url:5e1979b2ebe6775a.abstract_zh: 利用关联的调查数据与行政工资记录，我们通过工人自报收入的准确性来衡量其财务监控程度。采用无监督潜类别模型，将暂时性报告误差与四舍五入行为及持续性报告偏差区分开来，从而将较低的报告不确定性解释为对自身工资更精确的认知。在低收入工人群体中，报告精确性呈现出显著的薪酬周期模式：发薪日前数天精确性提升约12%，发薪日后立即下降。而高收入工人中未发现类似模式。这些发现表明，可预测的流动性约束导致低收入工人在发薪日临近时更密切地监控个人财务状况。
url:5e1979b2ebe6775a.title: DP21775 Payday and the Monthly Attention Cycle of Low-Wage Workers
url:5e1979b2ebe6775a.title_zh: DP21775 发薪日与低薪工人的月度注意力周期

url:5e50b47c6eebf8d0.abstract: This paper empirically reassesses monetary policy transmission in emerging and frontier market economies in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA EFMs). Using the identification approach of Romer and Romer (2004), we construct measures of monetary policy shocks and provide evidence on transmission mechanisms in the region. We show that monetary policy shocks pass through quickly to short-term market interest rates and lead to persistent increases in bank deposit and lending rates in most economies, indicating an operative bank-based interest rate channel. By contrast, exchange rates generally do not appreciate and, in many cases, depreciate following monetary tightening, consistent with the exchange rate puzzle—suggesting that interest rate hikes alone may be insufficient to systematically influence exchange rate movements. We also find that contractionary monetary policy reduces both output and inflation, with effects that are modest and notably weaker than in more developed economies. In addition, we find that transmission is stronger in economies that have adopted, or are transitioning toward, inflation-targeting regimes. Finally, we show that cross-country heterogeneity in transmission largely reflects differences in monetary policy transparency, financial development, and, to a lesser extent, fiscal dominance.
url:5e50b47c6eebf8d0.abstract_zh: 本文对撒哈拉以南非洲新兴及前沿市场经济体（SSA EFMs）的货币政策传导机制进行了实证再评估。采用Romer与Romer（2004）的识别方法，我们构建了货币政策冲击的度量指标，并提供了该区域传导机制的证据。研究表明，货币政策冲击能迅速传导至短期市场利率，并在多数经济体中导致银行存款利率与贷款利率持续上升，表明银行主导的利率渠道具有有效性。相比之下，汇率在货币紧缩后通常不会升值，反而在多数情况下出现贬值，这与"汇率之谜"现象一致——暗示单纯加息可能不足以系统性影响汇率变动。我们还发现，紧缩性货币政策会同时降低产出与通胀，但其影响幅度温和且显著弱于发达经济体。此外，在已采用或正转向通胀目标制的经济体中，货币政策传导效应更强。最后，研究表明跨国传导异质性主要源于货币政策透明度、金融发展水平的差异，而财政主导地位的影响相对较小。
url:5e50b47c6eebf8d0.title: Monetary Policy Transmission in Sub-Saharan Africa: Evidence from Emerging and Frontier Markets
url:5e50b47c6eebf8d0.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的货币政策传导：来自新兴与前沿市场的证据

url:5e663f25f7e50d14.title: Information design in smooth games
url:5e663f25f7e50d14.title_zh: 平滑博弈中的信息设计

url:5e79499a6f925eb0.abstract: We use a randomized controlled trial to examine how out-of-pocket costs affect contraceptive method choice, pregnancy, abortion, and childbirth among uninsured U.S. women. The study recruited women seeking care through Title X—a national family planning program subsidizing reproductive health services for low-income Americans—and randomized vouchers, making the full spectrum of contraception highly discounted or free. We find that subsidizing contraception has large and persistent effects on the choice of con- traceptive method, resulting in significantly fewer pregnancies and abortions at 26 months. The effects on births are inconclusive.
url:5e79499a6f925eb0.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，考察自付费用如何影响美国无保险女性的避孕方法选择、怀孕、堕胎及分娩。研究招募了通过Title X（一项为低收入美国人提供生殖健康服务补贴的国家计划生育项目）寻求医疗服务的女性，并随机发放代金券，使各类避孕措施大幅降价或免费。我们发现，补贴避孕措施对避孕方法的选择产生了显著且持续的影响，在26个月时导致怀孕和堕胎数量显著减少。对分娩的影响尚无定论。
url:5e79499a6f925eb0.title: Does Increasing Financial Access to Contraception in the U.S. Reduce Unintended Pregnancies? Evidence from the M-CARES Randomized Control Trial at Two Years
url:5e79499a6f925eb0.title_zh: 美国增加避孕药具的经济可及性是否能减少意外怀孕？来自M-CARES两年随机对照试验的证据

url:5e7dea291f24e054.title: Distributional Vector Autoregression: Eliciting Macro and Financial Dependence
url:5e7dea291f24e054.title_zh: 分布向量自回归：揭示宏观与金融依赖性

url:5e861f576bf82c84.abstract: This study investigates how the interaction of political accountability and local officials' career incentives shapes the market for Municipal Corporate Bonds (MCBs) in China, taking the 2017 local government debt personal responsibility rule as a quasi-natural experiment. We develop a stylized incomplete-information bargaining model to analyze how the rule reshapes the bargaining equilibrium by rendering officials' observable characteristics credible signals of bailout incentives. Using a dataset of prefecture-level MCBs from 2008 to 2020, we empirically test the model's predictions and focus on separating officials' incentive effects from their inherent ability. Our core findings show that post-announcement of the rule, each additional year of a local party secretary's remaining time to retirement, a proxy for bailout incentives, reduces MCB spreads by approximately 2.5 basis points and increases issuance volume by about 2.0%. These effects are significantly amplified in fiscally stressed cities. Notably, under the 2017 rule, cities led by party secretaries with stronger bailout incentives can expand MCB issuance, which is contrary to the rule's original intent to rein in local borrowing.
url:5e861f576bf82c84.abstract_zh: 本研究以2017年地方政府债务终身问责制为准自然实验，探究政治问责与地方官员职业激励的交互作用如何塑造中国市政企业债券市场。我们构建了一个简约的不完全信息讨价还价模型，分析该制度如何通过使官员可观测特征成为纾困激励的可信信号，重塑讨价还价均衡。基于2008-2020年地级市市政企业债券数据集，我们实证检验模型预测，并重点分离官员激励效应与内在能力差异。核心发现表明：该制度实施后，地方党委书记退休剩余年限（纾困激励代理变量）每增加一年，市政企业债券利差下降约2.5个基点，发行规模增长约2.0%。上述效应在财政压力较大的城市显著增强。值得注意的是，在2017年问责制下，由纾困激励更强的党委书记领导的城市反而能够扩大市政企业债券发行规模，这与该制度抑制地方举债的初始意图相悖。
url:5e861f576bf82c84.title: Political Accountability and Local Government Debt: Evidence from China
url:5e861f576bf82c84.title_zh: 政治问责与地方政府债务：来自中国的证据

url:5e944e8e0818219b.abstract: We study unanticipated tariffs on imports of intermediate goods in a setting with firm-to-firm supply relationships. Firms that produce differentiated products conduct costly searches for potential input suppliers and negotiate bilateral prices with those that pass a reservation level of match productivity. Global supply chains are formed in anticipation of free trade. Once they are in place, the home government surprises with an input tariff. This can lead to renegotiation with initial suppliers or new search for replacements. We identify circumstances in which renegotiation generates improvement or deterioration in the terms of trade. The welfare implications of a tariff are ambiguous in this second-best setting, but plausible parameter values suggest a welfare loss that rises rapidly at high tariff rates.
url:5e944e8e0818219b.abstract_zh: 我们研究在具有企业间供应关系的环境中，对进口中间品征收意外关税的情况。生产差异化产品的企业会进行成本高昂的搜索以寻找潜在投入品供应商，并与那些通过匹配生产率保留水平的供应商进行双边价格谈判。全球供应链是在预期自由贸易的前提下形成的。一旦这些供应链建立起来，本国政府便意外地引入投入品关税。这可能导致与初始供应商重新谈判，或寻找新的替代供应商。我们识别了重新谈判导致贸易条件改善或恶化的情形。在这种次优环境中，关税的福利影响是不明确的，但合理的参数值表明，在高关税税率下，福利损失会迅速增加。
url:5e944e8e0818219b.title: When Tariffs Disturb Global Supply Chains
url:5e944e8e0818219b.title_zh: 关税扰乱全球供应链之时

url:5e9913d34d5df0db.abstract: This paper develops a simple time-series model of emigration and applies it to data for emigration from the UK between 1870 and 1913. The model is derived from a microeconomic analysis of the migration decision and provides a specific functional form and dynamic structure. It encompasses many of the features of models used in earlier research in which the specifications have been essentially ad hoc. The results support the model strongly in most respects. Both wage rates and employment rates in the sending and the receiving countries influenced fluctuations in emigration. The short-run fluctuations were driven largely by variations in employment rates while the long-run level of emigration was determined largely by the relative wage.
url:5e9913d34d5df0db.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个简洁的移民时间序列模型，并将其应用于1870年至1913年间英国移民数据的实证分析。该模型基于移民决策的微观经济学分析，提供了具体的函数形式与动态结构，涵盖了早期研究中诸多本质上具有临时性特征的模型规范。实证结果在多数维度上显著支持该模型：迁出地与迁入地的工资率与就业率共同影响移民波动。短期波动主要由就业率变化驱动，而长期移民水平则主要由相对工资水平决定。
url:5e9913d34d5df0db.title: DP771 A Model of UK Emigration, 1870-1913

url:5eb1b1e6a5dee3bb.title: Who Pays Bribes? Gender, Education, and Petty Corruption in Mexico, 2011-2023
url:5eb1b1e6a5dee3bb.title_zh: 谁在行贿？墨西哥的性别、教育与轻微腐败（2011-2023）

url:5eb4037954bcc120.abstract: Budget-constrained environmental agencies across the United States are limited in their ability to monitor water quality changes using traditional in situ sampling. Satellite-based monitoring systems represent a lower-cost alternative. It is unclear, however, how this transition will impact nonmarket valuation estimates of perceived water quality. To answer this question, we merge housing information with Secchi depth and satellite estimates of water clarity from over 100 lakes in Wisconsin. A comparison of hedonic price functions reveals satellite estimates of water clarity provide a stronger statistical fit of housing price and produce implicit prices up to 11% larger in magnitude. JEL Q51Q57
url:5eb4037954bcc120.abstract_zh: 美国各地受预算约束的环境机构在利用传统原位采样监测水质变化方面能力有限。基于卫星的监测系统代表了一种成本更低的替代方案。然而，这一转变将如何影响感知水质的非市场价值评估估计尚不明确。为回答此问题，我们将住房信息与威斯康星州100多个湖泊的Secchi深度及卫星估算的水体清澈度数据相结合。对特征价格函数的比较显示，卫星估算的水体清澈度对住房价格具有更强的统计拟合度，并产生幅度高达11%的隐含价格。JEL Q51Q57
url:5eb4037954bcc120.title: Convergent Validity of Satellite and Secchi Disk Measures of Water Clarity in Hedonic Models
url:5eb4037954bcc120.title_zh: 享乐模型中卫星与塞奇盘水质透明度测量的收敛效度

url:5eb99f25cc9e3fb7.abstract: This article advances a new conception of labour history as the history of industrial relations, understood broadly as the changing relationships between workers, trade unions, employers and the state. The first half of the paper examines the major interpretative traditions in British labour history, from the Webbs and the 'Oxford School' to the postwar social historians and the 'rank-and-filists'. It shows that despite their many differences, both institutionalists and social historians explain the development of labour institutions by reference to the objective interests of social groups, and goes on to raise some theoretical objections to this form of explanation. The second half of the paper draws on the findings of recent research on the history of work and industrial relations in late nineteenth and twentieth century Britain to argue that relationships between workers and employers were shaped less by informal groups or spontaneous social and economical processes than by institutional forces: by organizations such as trade unions, shop stewards' committees, business enterprises, employers' associations and the state; and by the rules and procedures governing their interaction such as collective agreements, conciliation and arbitration boards, wages councils and legislati.
url:5eb99f25cc9e3fb7.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的劳工史概念，即将其视为劳资关系史，广义上理解为工人、工会、雇主与国家之间不断变化的关系。论文前半部分考察了英国劳工史的主要阐释传统，从韦伯夫妇与“牛津学派”到战后社会史学家及“基层活动派”。研究表明，尽管制度主义者与社会史学家存在诸多差异，但两者均通过参照社会群体的客观利益来解释劳工制度的发展，并进而对这种解释模式提出若干理论质疑。论文后半部分借鉴近期关于19世纪末至20世纪英国工作与劳资关系史的研究成果，论证工人与雇主之间的关系更多受到制度力量而非非正式群体或自发社会经济进程的影响：这些制度力量包括工会、车间代表委员会、企业、雇主协会及国家等组织，以及集体协议、调解与仲裁委员会、工资委员会及立法等规范其互动的规则与程序。
url:5eb99f25cc9e3fb7.title: DP145 From Labour History to the History of Industrial Relations
url:5eb99f25cc9e3fb7.title_zh: DP145 从劳工史到劳资关系史

url:5ec70931882e5020.abstract: Academic freedom has been declining over the past decade across the world. This column analyses over 25,000 economics working papers to show that, beyond direct intervention by authorities, political pressure also breeds self-censorship. After US federal agencies began screening research for a list of flagged words in early 2025, economists at universities most dependent on federal funding reduced politically sensitive content – even in research without any direct federal funding.
url:5ec70931882e5020.abstract_zh: 过去十年间，全球学术自由持续下滑。本专栏分析了超过25,000篇经济学工作论文，揭示出除当局直接干预外，政治压力亦催生自我审查。自2025年初美国联邦机构开始对研究进行敏感词汇筛查以来，最依赖联邦资助的大学经济学家，即便在未获任何直接联邦资金支持的研究中，也减少了政治敏感内容。
url:5ec70931882e5020.title: When political pressure trumps academic freedom
url:5ec70931882e5020.title_zh: 当政治压力凌驾于学术自由之上

url:5ecbe62a61f91c6c.abstract: When Credit Suisse failed in March 2023, Swiss authorities, against market expectations, set aside the resolution plan and arranged a UBS takeover backed by public guarantees, sparing the bail-in bondholders who were next in line to absorb losses. This column traces how that choice reshaped investor beliefs about bail-in across Europe. Spreads on bail-in debt narrowed, the funding penalty on weaker banks shrank, and yields moved less on earnings news. Each points the same way: investors now see bail-in as less likely, a sign that its credibility has declined.
url:5ecbe62a61f91c6c.abstract_zh: 2023年3月瑞信倒闭时，瑞士当局违背市场预期，搁置处置计划并安排瑞银在公共担保支持下进行收购，使本应承担损失的保释债持有人得以幸免。本专栏追踪了这一选择如何重塑欧洲投资者对保释机制的信念。保释债利差收窄，弱势银行的融资惩罚缩小，收益率对盈利消息的反应减弱。这些现象均指向同一结论：投资者如今认为保释可能性降低，表明其可信度已然下降。
url:5ecbe62a61f91c6c.title: After Credit Suisse, markets find bail-in less credible
url:5ecbe62a61f91c6c.title_zh: 瑞信事件后，市场对内部纾困机制的信任度下降

url:5ed862e0d3bed36d.abstract: Labor markets feature large heterogeneity in employment stability: some careers provide lifetime employment, while others involve frequent transitions in and out of work. While this heterogeneity shapes earnings dynamics and labor market risk, its implications for household saving behavior remain poorly understood. We document two new empirical facts. More stable careers (i) exhibit steeper life-cycle earnings growth and (ii) accumulate significantly more wealth per dollar of income, even within narrowly defined worker groups. To interpret these facts, we develop a life-cycle search-and-saving model with heterogeneous employment stability, job-to-job mobility, endogenous human capital accumulation, and incomplete markets. The model matches both life-cycle earnings and wealth dynamics across careers. Our central finding is that heterogeneity in employment stability reshapes the nature of saving. Stable careers generate sustained earnings growth with a focus on life-cycle saving, while unstable careers are characterized by precautionary, buffer-stock behavior that limits long-run wealth accumulation. Quantitatively, differential earnings growth accounts for about 60% of the wealth gap across careers. These microeconomic differences have important macroeconomic implications. We demonstrate that heterogeneity in employment stability amplifies wealth inequality and substantially increases the macroeconomic consumption response to unemployment shocks.
url:5ed862e0d3bed36d.abstract_zh: 劳动力市场在就业稳定性方面存在显著异质性：部分职业提供终身雇佣保障，而另一些职业则频繁经历就业与失业的转换。尽管这种异质性塑造了收入动态与劳动力市场风险，但其对家庭储蓄行为的影响仍鲜有研究。我们揭示了两项新的实证事实：稳定性较高的职业（i）具有更陡峭的生命周期收入增长曲线，且（ii）即使在严格定义的工人群体内部，每单位收入积累的财富也显著更多。为解释这些事实，我们构建了一个包含异质性就业稳定性、岗位间流动、内生人力资本积累及不完全市场的生命周期搜寻-储蓄模型。该模型能够匹配不同职业的生命周期收入与财富动态。核心发现是：就业稳定性异质性重塑了储蓄的本质。稳定职业产生持续的收入增长，聚焦于生命周期储蓄；而不稳定职业则呈现预防性缓冲库存行为，限制了长期财富积累。量化分析表明，收入增长差异解释了约60%的职业间财富差距。这些微观差异具有重要的宏观经济含义：我们证明就业稳定性异质性会加剧财富不平等，并显著放大宏观经济对失业冲击的消费响应。
url:5ed862e0d3bed36d.title: Employment Stability, Earnings Dynamics, and Life-Cycle Savings
url:5ed862e0d3bed36d.title_zh: 就业稳定性、收入动态与生命周期储蓄

url:5edc1ed87daeea1a.title: Measuring Consumer Sustainability Benefits
url:5edc1ed87daeea1a.title_zh: 衡量消费者可持续性收益

url:5edc23274385f070.abstract: This paper investigates the role of the exchange rate regime in the process of trade adjustment, by examining the relationship between trade prices and exchange rate regimes. The theoretical framework is a dynamic one à la Froot-Klemperer (1989). The empirical investigation takes advantage of the simultaneous occurrence, since 1979, of relatively stable exchange rates inside the ERM and instable rates outside to engage in a controlled experiment on the impact of the exchange rate regime on trade prices. The results suggest that a system of pegged rates like the EMS, although helpful, is not necessary to achieve a smooth process of trade adjustment. It appears that the absence of misalignment rather than the type of exchange rate regime is the crucial factor for fulfilling such an objective.
url:5edc23274385f070.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察贸易价格与汇率制度之间的关系，探究汇率制度在贸易调整过程中的作用。理论框架采用Froot-Klemperer（1989）的动态模型。实证研究利用1979年以来欧洲汇率机制（ERM）内部汇率相对稳定而外部汇率不稳定的同期现象，开展关于汇率制度对贸易价格影响的受控实验。结果表明，尽管欧洲货币体系（EMS）等钉住汇率制度有所助益，但并非实现平稳贸易调整过程的必要条件。实现该目标的关键因素似乎在于避免汇率失调，而非汇率制度类型本身。
url:5edc23274385f070.title: DP810 Exchange Rate Regimes and Trade Prices: Does the EMS Matter?
url:5edc23274385f070.title_zh: DP810 汇率制度与贸易价格：欧洲货币体系是否重要？

url:5edd8a4ffbea78ec.title: The relationship between general equilibrium models with infinitely-lived agents and overlapping generations models, and some applications

url:5ee9ff2fbfab5ed8.abstract: This paper leverages cross-country policy variation during the 2020 Covid crisis to assess differential impacts of bans on stock liquidity, prices, and volatility. Results suggest that bans improved liquidity and stabilized prices for illiquid stocks but temporarily diminished liquidity for highly liquid stocks. The findings support theories in which short sale bans may improve liquidity by selectively filtering out informed—potentially predatory—traders. Thus, policies that target the most illiquid stocks may deliver better overall market quality than uniform short sale bans imposed on all stocks.
url:5ee9ff2fbfab5ed8.abstract_zh: 本文利用2020年新冠危机期间各国政策的差异性，评估了卖空禁令对股票流动性、价格及波动性的差异化影响。结果表明，禁令改善了流动性不佳股票的流动性并稳定了价格，但暂时降低了高流动性股票的流动性。研究结果支持了这样一种理论：卖空禁令通过选择性过滤掉知情——可能具有掠夺性——的交易者，从而可能提升流动性。因此，针对流动性最差股票的政策可能比对所有股票实施统一的卖空禁令更能提升整体市场质量。

url:5f0b62370194cdf7.abstract: The rapid digitalisation of banking and the widespread use of social media are transforming competition for retail deposits. Using US branch-level data, this column shows that digital banks pay higher deposit rates and pass policy rate changes through to depositors more quickly than traditional banks. It also finds that stronger social media activity further increases the responsiveness of deposit rates by accelerating information diffusion and heightening depositor attention. These developments strengthen monetary policy transmission while raising important questions for banks' funding strategies, deposit franchise values and competition in increasingly digital financial markets.
url:5f0b62370194cdf7.abstract_zh: 银行业快速数字化与社交媒体的广泛使用，正重塑零售存款市场的竞争格局。基于美国分行层面数据，本专栏研究表明：数字银行提供的存款利率更高，且将政策利率变动传导至储户的速度快于传统银行。研究还发现，社交媒体活跃度的提升通过加速信息扩散、增强储户关注度，进一步提高了存款利率的响应弹性。这些变化在强化货币政策传导机制的同时，也对银行的资金策略、存款特许权价值及日益数字化的金融市场中的竞争格局提出了重要议题。

url:5f33a19fead0e6e0.abstract: Populist leaders increasingly cast public sector experts, oversight bodies, and career civil servants as illegitimate ‘elites’ standing in the way of the popular will. But bureaucratic institutions may protect the economy from the very disruptions that populists invite. This column examines the role of bureaucracy in mediating the negative effects of populist governments at the US state level. The results suggest that bureaucracy matters. In countries and states with career civil‐service protections, the usual drag of populist governance largely vanishes, but without those institutional cushions, the economy takes a hit. What matters is whether the bureaucracy is professional and insulated from political control.
url:5f33a19fead0e6e0.abstract_zh: 民粹主义领导人日益将公共部门专家、监督机构及职业公务员视为阻碍民意的非法“精英阶层”。然而，官僚机构或许能保护经济免受民粹主义所引发的动荡。本专栏考察了美国州级层面官僚机构在调节民粹主义政府负面影响中的作用。研究结果表明，官僚机构至关重要。在拥有职业公务员保护制度的国家与州，民粹主义治理通常带来的经济拖累基本消失；但若缺乏这些制度缓冲，经济将遭受冲击。关键在于官僚体系是否具备专业性且不受政治控制。
url:5f33a19fead0e6e0.title: Don’t drain the swamp! Populism, bureaucracy, and economic performance
url:5f33a19fead0e6e0.title_zh: 不要抽干沼泽！民粹主义、官僚主义与经济绩效

url:5f43b7bb08d9040f.abstract: We empirically examine the role of both official monetary policy announcements and policymakers' speeches in the transmission of monetary policy to financial markets and the real economy in the euro area. Using intraday data covering a broad cross-section of financial assets, we construct the Euro Area Extended Monetary Policy Event-Study Database (EA-EMPD). We refine the identification of monetary policy surprises by exploiting granular, quote-level data on individual participants' bid and ask submissions. This novel dataset expands the set of identifiable policy events by an order of magnitude relative to databases based solely on scheduled rate-setting meetings. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, speeches by euro area policymakers exert statistically and economically significant effects on asset prices across maturities, with magnitudes comparable to those observed following official policy announcements. Second, the transmission of speech-induced short-rate changes to the real economy closely mirrors that of policy decisions and combining both types of surprises significantly enhances the precision of statistical inference. Finally, when speeches are included in the measurement of policy surprises, the share of real-economy variance attributable to monetary policy increases fivefold, although its absolute magnitude remains relatively modest.
url:5f43b7bb08d9040f.abstract_zh: 我们实证考察了官方货币政策公告与政策制定者演讲在欧元区货币政策向金融市场及实体经济传导中的作用。利用覆盖广泛金融资产的日内数据，我们构建了欧元区扩展货币政策事件研究数据库（EA-EMPD）。通过利用个体参与者买卖报价的细粒度报价级数据，我们优化了货币政策冲击的识别方法。这一新颖数据集将可识别政策事件的范围相较于仅基于预定利率设定会议的数据库扩大了一个数量级。我们的分析得出三项主要发现。首先，欧元区政策制定者的演讲对各期限资产价格产生了统计上和经济上显著的影响，其幅度与官方政策公告后观察到的效应相当。其次，演讲引发的短期利率变化向实体经济的传导与政策决策的传导路径高度相似，且将两类冲击结合使用能显著提升统计推断的精确度。最后，当演讲被纳入政策冲击的衡量时，货币政策可解释的实体经济方差份额增加了五倍，尽管其绝对规模仍相对有限。

url:5f615cff742626b4.abstract: We examine pharmaceutical regulations and incentives for innovation from an international perspective, highlighting the public good nature of healthcare innovation and its cross-border diffusion. We summarize the empirical evidence on how push and pull incentives shape R\D investment, innovation, and global access. We emphasize the role of strategic interdependencies and spillovers, including free-riding in R\D financing, learning-by-doing effects, drug shortages, reference pricing, and parallel trade. We then provide new evidence on the international spillovers of pull incentives on innovation, showing that international cooperation and innovative institutions are necessary to better align national regulations with the global objective of sustaining pharmaceutical innovation.
url:5f615cff742626b4.abstract_zh: 我们从国际视角审视药品监管与创新激励，强调医疗创新及其跨国传播的公共产品属性。我们总结了关于推动与拉动激励如何影响研发投资、创新及全球可及性的实证证据。我们着重探讨战略相互依赖与溢出效应，包括研发融资中的搭便车行为、干中学效应、药品短缺、参考定价及平行贸易。随后，我们提供了关于拉动激励对创新国际溢出的新证据，表明国际合作与创新制度对于更好地协调国家监管与维持药品创新的全球目标至关重要。
url:5f615cff742626b4.title: Pharmaceutical Regulation and Incentives for Innovation in an International Perspective

url:5fb56af929ba7022.abstract: We study how wars and military threats affect financial markets. Leveraging more than 300,000 monthly price observations since 1822, we create an external currency bond index for more than 90 countries - the EXBI. Using the EXBI, we document large effects of wars on returns and borrowing costs. In a global external bond portfolio, a one-standard-deviation war shock lowers returns by five percentage points. At the country level, wars at home generate sharp losses and increase default risk. Military threats depress bond prices in threatened states, but not in threatening ones, highlighting their role as a channel for eoeconomic coercion.
url:5fb56af929ba7022.abstract_zh: 我们探讨战争与军事威胁如何影响金融市场。利用自1822年以来超过30万个月度价格观测数据，我们构建了一个覆盖90多个国家的外部货币债券指数——EXBI。借助EXBI，我们记录了战争对回报率和借贷成本的显著影响。在全球外部债券组合中，一个标准差战争冲击会使回报率下降五个百分点。在国家层面，本土战争导致剧烈损失并增加违约风险。军事威胁压低受威胁国家的债券价格，但对威胁发起国无此影响，凸显了其作为经济胁迫渠道的作用。
url:5fb56af929ba7022.title: Wars, threats, and the sovereign bond market

url:5fdad9f39478feae.abstract: Social movements are associated with large societal changes, but evidence of their causal effects is limited. We study the effect of the MeToo movement on an important personal decision—reporting a sex crime to the police. Victims often do not report sex crimes due to the personal costs involved, but the reporting of sex crimes can have positive externalities and therefore, improve social welfare. Using a difference-in-differences strategy comparing sex crimes and non-sex crimes before and after the MeToo movement started, we find that the movement increased the number of sex crimes reported by approximately 10% and that the effect persisted until the end of our data, 15-27 months after the movement started. The result is confirmed using a triple-difference strategy comparing countries with strong and weak MeToo movements. Using detailed US data, we show that the MeToo movement not only increased reporting but also increased arrests for sexual assaults; and that in contrast to a common criticism of the movement, the effects are similar across racial and socioeconomic groups. Based on additional survey and crime data, we find that the increased reporting reflects a higher propensity to report sex crimes rather than an increase in the incidence of sex crimes. Our results demonstrate that social movements can rapidly and persistently change high-stakes decisions.
url:5fdad9f39478feae.abstract_zh: 社会运动往往伴随着重大的社会变革，但关于其因果效应的证据仍然有限。本研究聚焦于MeToo运动对一项重要个人决策——向警方举报性犯罪——的影响。由于涉及个人成本，受害者通常不愿举报性犯罪，但举报性犯罪可能产生正外部性，从而提升社会福利。通过采用双重差分策略，比较MeToo运动前后性犯罪与非性犯罪的举报情况，我们发现该运动使性犯罪举报数量增加了约10%，且这一效应持续至数据截止期（即运动开始后的15至27个月）。三重差分策略（比较MeToo运动强度高与低的国家）进一步验证了这一结果。基于美国详细数据，我们表明MeToo运动不仅提高了举报率，还增加了性侵犯案件的逮捕数量；与对该运动的常见批评相反，其影响在不同种族和社会经济群体间具有一致性。结合补充调查与犯罪数据，我们发现举报增加反映的是举报倾向的提升，而非性犯罪发生率的上升。本研究证明，社会运动能够迅速且持久地改变高风险决策行为。
url:5fdad9f39478feae.title: The Effects of Social Movements: Evidence from #MeToo
url:5fdad9f39478feae.title_zh: 社会运动的影响：来自#MeToo运动的证据

url:5ffe5f04afca9e33.abstract: we develop a quantitative general equilibrium (GE) model of RS and combine it with a unique new database. In the theory, we show that the welfare implications of RS are ambiguous, depending on an interplay between what is akin to an export tax (+) and a labor market distortion (−). Empirically, we combine the near-universe of RS rollouts by MNE subsidiaries in Costa Rica since 2009 with firm-to-firm transactions and matched employer- employee microdata. We find that RS rollouts lead to significant reductions in firm sales and employment at exposed suppliers, an increase in their salaries to initially low-wage workers and a reduction in their low-wage employment share. We then use the estimated effects and the microdata to calibrate the model and quantify GE counterfactuals. We find that while MNE RS policies have led to significant gains among the roughly one third of low-wage workers employed at exposed suppliers ex ante, the majority of low-wage workers lose due to adverse indirect effects on their wages and the domestic price index.
url:5ffe5f04afca9e33.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于RS的定量一般均衡（GE）模型，并将其与一个独特的新数据库相结合。在理论层面，我们证明RS的福利影响具有模糊性，取决于类似出口税（+）与劳动力市场扭曲（−）之间的相互作用。在实证层面，我们结合了自2009年以来哥斯达黎加跨国企业子公司实施的近乎全量的RS推广数据，以及企业间交易和匹配的雇主-雇员微观数据。我们发现，RS推广导致受影响供应商的企业销售额和就业显著下降，其最初低工资工人的薪资有所提高，而低工资就业份额则有所减少。随后，我们利用估计效应和微观数据对模型进行校准，并量化一般均衡反事实分析。结果显示，尽管跨国企业的RS政策为事前受影响的供应商中约三分之一的低工资工人带来了显著收益，但大多数低工资工人因对其工资和国内价格指数的负面间接效应而遭受损失。
url:5ffe5f04afca9e33.title: Responsible Sourcing? Theory and Evidence from Costa Rica
url:5ffe5f04afca9e33.title_zh: 负责任的采购？来自哥斯达黎加的理论与证据

url:602db0bdc795aee9.abstract: We study barriers preventing jobseekers from pursuing reskilling in high-demand occupations. Using a discrete choice experiment, we quantify the demand for reskilling among Italian jobseekers in two white-collar high-demand occupations—information technology assistant and construction technician—and identify its main determinants. Willingness to pay estimates show that participants are willing to pay to reskill into IT, but would require compensation to reskill into construction. Beliefs about monetary returns and social status help explain differences in reskilling demand, but perceived identity fit in the target occupation emerges as the most important individual-level factor shaping reskilling decisions. A light-touch randomized information intervention providing data on occupational returns significantly increases both stated interest in reskilling and actual engagement in real- world training.
url:602db0bdc795aee9.abstract_zh: 我们研究了阻碍求职者向高需求职业进行技能再培训的障碍。通过一项离散选择实验，我们量化了意大利求职者对两种白领高需求职业——信息技术助理和建筑技术员——的技能再培训需求，并识别了其主要决定因素。支付意愿估计显示，参与者愿意为转向信息技术领域支付费用，但转向建筑领域则需要补偿。对货币回报和社会地位的信念有助于解释技能再培训需求的差异，但目标职业中的感知身份契合度成为影响技能再培训决策的最重要的个体层面因素。一项提供职业回报数据的轻触式随机信息干预显著提高了对技能再培训的表态兴趣以及实际参与现实世界培训的积极性。
url:602db0bdc795aee9.title: Unwilling to Reskill? Experimental Evidence from Real-World Jobseekers
url:602db0bdc795aee9.title_zh: 不愿再培训？来自真实求职者的实验证据

url:604c52d1e9d657eb.abstract: We investigate whether term limits can help historically underrepresented groups, such as women, gain faster access to positions of political power. We exploit evidence from Italian local elections where, in a context of rapidly increasing women's presence in politics, mayoral term limits were extended from two to three five-year terms in municipalities with less than 3,000 inhabitants in 2014 and in those with a population between 3,000 and 5,000 in 2022. Using as control group slightly larger municipalities, we find that longer term limits delay younger cohorts' access to mayoral roles, significantly slowing the increase in female representation. The magnitude of the effect is substantial; the share of female mayors would be 4-10 percentage points higher if term limits had not been extended. The impact is stronger in municipalities with a larger presence of women at lower political levels and where gender quotas are in place, suggesting a complementarity between these policies. Our findings suggest that term limits help bridge the representational gap between entry and top-level political positions, especially in times of rapid societal change.
url:604c52d1e9d657eb.abstract_zh: 我们探讨任期限制是否有助于历史上处于弱势地位的群体（如女性）更快地获得政治权力职位。我们利用意大利地方选举的证据，在女性政治参与迅速增加的背景下，市长任期限制从两届延长至三届，每届五年，适用于2014年人口少于3000人的市镇及2022年人口在3000至5000人之间的市镇。以稍大的市镇作为对照组，我们发现更长的任期限制延迟了较年轻群体担任市长职务的机会，显著减缓了女性代表性的增长。这一效应规模显著；若未延长任期限制，女性市长的比例将高出4至10个百分点。在较低政治层级女性参与度较高及实施性别配额制的市镇中，这一影响更为强烈，表明这些政策之间存在互补性。我们的研究结果表明，任期限制有助于缩小进入政治体系与高层政治职位之间的代表性差距，尤其是在社会快速变革时期。

url:60a5b577a78cc0de.abstract: This paper studies alternative methods of privatizing a formerly communist firm in the presence of imperfect risk markets. The methods include cash sales, a give-away scheme, and a participation contract where the government retains a sleeping fractional ownership in the firm. It is shown that with competitive bidding, the participation contract dominates cash sales because it generates both more private restructuring investment and a higher expected present value of revenue for the government. Under weak conditions the participation contract will induce more investment than the giveaway scheme, and it may even share the cash sales' virtue of incentive compatibility.
url:60a5b577a78cc0de.abstract_zh: 本文研究在不完全风险市场条件下，对前共产主义企业进行私有化的替代方案。这些方案包括现金出售、无偿分配计划，以及政府保留企业部分被动股权的参与合同。研究表明，在竞标机制下，参与合同优于现金出售，因为它既能促进更多私人重组投资，又能为政府带来更高的预期收入现值。在较弱条件下，参与合同比无偿分配计划更能激励投资，甚至可能兼具现金出售在激励相容性方面的优势。

url:60cefea708d7629d.abstract: U. S. economic growth slowed by more than half from 3.2 percent per year during 1970-2006 to only 1.4 percent during 2006-16, and this decline was divided equally between slower growth in hours of work and slower growth in output per hour. In explaining slower growth in hours, particular emphasis is placed on the slower secular rise of life expectancy in the U.S. compared to other developed countries. Further contributions to slowing growth are made by a decline in the population share of both legal and illegal immigration and a turnaround from rising to declining labor force participation. Causes of declining productivity growth begin with the slowdown in the rate of increase of educational attainment. Why did productivity growth decline after 2006 despite an increase in the rate at which new U.S. patents were issued in 2006-16 compared to earlier decades? Part of the slowdown is attributed to the maturity of the IT revolution, which also helps to explain the trajectory of the college wage premium. Aspects of the productivity growth slowdown include the declining productivity of research workers, diminishing returns to drug innovation, and the evolutionary rather than revolutionary impact of robots and artificial intelligence.
url:60cefea708d7629d.abstract_zh: 美国经济增长速度从1970年至2006年间年均3.2%放缓至2006年至2016年间仅1.4%，降幅超过一半，且这一下降在工时增长放缓与每小时产出增长放缓之间平分。在解释工时增长放缓时，特别强调了美国与其他发达国家相比，人均预期寿命的长期增长较为缓慢。此外，合法与非法移民人口占比的下降，以及劳动力参与率从上升转为下降的趋势，也对增长放缓有所贡献。生产力增长放缓的原因始于教育程度提升速度的减缓。为何在2006年至2016年间，尽管美国新专利发放速度较前几十年有所加快，生产力增长却出现下滑？部分放缓归因于信息技术革命的成熟，这也助于解释大学教育工资溢价的走势。生产力增长放缓的多个方面包括研究人员生产力的下降、药物创新回报的递减，以及机器人及人工智能带来的影响更偏向于渐进式而非革命性。
url:60cefea708d7629d.title: Why Has Economic Growth Slowed When Innovation Appears To Be Accelerating?

url:60d6a2e34c61415e.abstract: Debt sustainability analysis typically focuses on debt stocks and the interest rate-growth rate differential, but these are not perfect predictors of fiscal stress. This column argues that debt-service costs are key to understanding when fiscal adjustments become necessary. Using long-run historical evidence, it shows that primary surpluses are more closely associated with debt-service costs than with debt ratios, and that fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate. Overall, debt-service costs represent the immediate claim of public debt on government resources and therefore provide a more direct measure of fiscal pressure than debt ratios alone.
url:60d6a2e34c61415e.abstract_zh: 债务可持续性分析通常关注债务存量及利率与增长率之差，但这些指标并非财政压力的完美预测因子。本文认为，偿债成本是理解何时需要进行财政调整的关键。基于长期历史证据表明，基本盈余与偿债成本的关联性高于与债务比率的关联性，且当融资条件恶化时，财政应对措施会显著加强。总体而言，偿债成本代表了公共债务对政府资源的即时索取权，因此相较于单纯的债务比率，它能更直接地衡量财政压力。
url:60d6a2e34c61415e.title: Debt service and fiscal sustainability

url:60ff263712d1892e.abstract: Central banks can move policy rates, but transmission depends on households acting on them. This column shows that central banks can mitigate monetary policy’s ‘last-mile problem’ with direct communication. In Ireland, a mortgage refinancing reminder increased refinancing with borrowers' existing lender by up to 76% relative to the control group, from 8.9% to 15.7% of borrowers. The results suggest that inattention is a key friction and that central bank communication holds promise.
url:60ff263712d1892e.abstract_zh: 中央银行能够调整政策利率，但其传导效果取决于家庭对此作出的反应。本文指出，中央银行可通过直接沟通来缓解货币政策的“最后一公里难题”。在爱尔兰，一项抵押贷款再融资提醒措施使得借款人在现有贷款机构进行再融资的比例相较于对照组提升了高达76%，即从8.9%上升至15.7%。研究结果表明，注意力不足是关键的摩擦因素，而中央银行的沟通策略展现出积极前景。

url:61289920ad34ec08.abstract: Solar and wind power account for a growing share of electricity generation in China and now dominate new capacity additions. As the power system transitions toward renewable generation, greater flexibility will be required to maintain system stability. This paper uses a computable general equilibrium model to assess the macroeconomic implications of this transition. Model results indicate a modest increase in electricity prices in the near-term, followed by sustained declines as renewable shares rise, particularly when variability is managed through battery storage rather than coal-fired backup generation. While the transition requires substantial adjustments in electricity supply and investment, it raises GDP in the long run and strengthens energy security. Battery-based flexibility outperforms continued reliance on coal across multiple dimensions, even when accounting for rising electricity demand from emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence. However, this transition pathway also increases the risk of stranded assets in the coal power sector.
url:61289920ad34ec08.abstract_zh: 太阳能和风能在中国电力生产中所占份额日益增长，目前已成为新增装机容量的主导力量。随着电力系统向可再生能源转型，维持系统稳定性将需要更大的灵活性。本文运用可计算一般均衡模型评估这一转型的宏观经济影响。模型结果显示，短期内电价将温和上涨，随后随着可再生能源占比上升而持续下降，尤其是在通过电池储能而非燃煤备用发电来管理波动性的情况下。尽管这一转型要求电力供应和投资进行大幅调整，但从长远来看，它将提升国内生产总值并增强能源安全。即使在考虑人工智能等新兴技术带来的电力需求增长时，基于电池的灵活性方案在多个维度上仍优于继续依赖煤炭。然而，这一转型路径也增加了煤电行业资产搁浅的风险。
url:61289920ad34ec08.title: Macroeconomic Impacts of China’s Energy Transition

url:613178bd6eb3d7d1.abstract: Close to 20% of secondary school students in Amsterdam - and elsewhere - transfer between secondary schools at some point, even when initially placed in their most-preferred school. School switching is costly for the students involved and disrupts the learning environment of their former and new classmates. Using data from the Amsterdam secondary-school match linked to administrative registers, we show that switching can be predicted by hard-to-rationalize initial school choices. Over 60% of switchers can be correctly identified at the admission stage. Simulations indicate that encouraging predicted switchers to adjust their preference ranking of schools could reduce the switching rate by almost 15%.
url:613178bd6eb3d7d1.abstract_zh: 阿姆斯特丹及其他地区约有近20%的中学学生在某个阶段会在学校之间转学，即便他们最初被分配到了最心仪的学校。转学对涉及的学生而言成本高昂，并扰乱了原班级和新班级同学的学习环境。利用与行政登记数据相连的阿姆斯特丹中学匹配数据，我们表明，转学行为可以通过难以理性化的初始学校选择来预测。超过60%的转学者能在录取阶段被准确识别。模拟结果显示，鼓励预测的转学者调整他们对学校的偏好排序，可将转学率降低近15%。

url:6131f105225d7546.abstract: Flooding is the natural disaster that causes the most damage. Postflood, many families are not insured and do not have sufficient savings for rebuilding, and governmental aid can be limited. We undertake, using a stated preference survey, the first willingness-to-pay (WTP) elicitation for flood insurance in the United States. WTP increases with modeled flood risk and flood-risk perceptions. WTP for residents in our study area’s 100-year floodplain is 47% to 59% of the median flood insurance premium, which suggests the need for financial assistance for families who are at risk of flood damage and are unable to afford risk-based premiums. url:6131f105225d7546.abstract_zh: 洪水是造成损失最严重的自然灾害。灾后，许多家庭既未投保，也缺乏足够的储蓄用于重建，而政府援助可能有限。我们通过一项陈述偏好调查，首次在美国进行了洪水保险支付意愿（WTP）的测度。支付意愿随模拟洪水风险和洪水风险认知的增加而提高。我们研究区域内百年一遇洪水淹没区居民的支付意愿为洪水保险中位保费的47%至59%，这表明，对于面临洪水风险且无力承担基于风险的保费的家庭，有必要提供财务援助。JEL Q54Q58 本开放获取文章依据CC-BY-NC-ND许可协议（http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0）分发，并可在以下网址免费在线获取：http://le.uwpress.org。

url:614c30e08d7f2f25.abstract: This paper examines how tokenization and distributed ledger technology may transform Financial Market Infrastructures (FMIs) by enabling smart contracts to perform a growing share of functions traditionally undertaken by central securities depositories, central counterparties, and trade repositories. It argues that while record-keeping, settlement, collateral management, and reporting can increasingly be executed on-chain, key functions requiring legal certainty, governance, accountability, and discretion remain institutional in nature. The analysis assesses which activities across issuance, clearing, settlement, and reporting can migrate to code, where limitations persist, and how risks evolve in tokenized environments. It finds that tokenization is more likely to reconfigure than eliminate FMIs, creating new efficiencies while introducing novel operational and governance risks. The most plausible outcome is a hybrid FMI model in which technology and institutions jointly provide the trust, resilience, and oversight required for financial stability.
url:614c30e08d7f2f25.abstract_zh: 本文探讨代币化与分布式账本技术如何通过使智能合约承担中央证券存管机构、中央对手方及交易数据库等传统金融基础设施（FMIs）中日益增多的职能，从而推动其变革。研究指出，尽管记录保存、结算、抵押品管理及报告等环节可逐步迁移至链上执行，但涉及法律确定性、治理、问责及自由裁量权的关键职能仍具有制度属性。本文系统评估了发行、清算、结算及报告等环节中哪些活动可迁移至代码执行、现存局限性所在，以及代币化环境下风险演变特征。研究发现，代币化更可能重构而非消除金融基础设施，在创造新效率的同时引入新型操作与治理风险。最可能的结果是形成混合型金融基础设施模式——技术与机构共同提供金融稳定所需的信任、韧性及监管能力。

url:61c94ecdddbb75ea.abstract: We document an unprecedented change in the size and the quality of China's transport-infrastructure network between 2000 and 2013. This documentation is based on hand-collected and digitized data on roads and railways. The changes are summarized and portrayed as shortest-possible transport times of people and goods between 330 prefectures of mainland China. A quantitative model of China's prefectures and a Rest of the World, featuring both goods trade and migration, suggests that the long-run consequences of the transport-infrastructure changes induce regional convergence of lagging-behind prefectures in terms of population density and, to a lesser extent, in terms of real per-capita income. Not only changes in highway and high-speed-railway networks but also ones in lower-level road and railway networks are quantitatively important. Key drivers behind the effects are the facilitation of goods transport as well as technology diffusion, while the reduction of mobility costs and the diffusion of amenities appear less important.
url:61c94ecdddbb75ea.abstract_zh: 我们记录了2000年至2013年间中国交通基础设施网络在规模与质量上的空前变化。这一记录基于手工收集并数字化的公路与铁路数据。这些变化被概括并描绘为中国大陆330个地级市之间人员与货物最短运输时间的变化。一个涵盖中国各地级市及世界其他地区、同时涉及商品贸易与人口迁移的量化模型表明，交通基础设施变化的长期后果促使落后地级市在人口密度方面实现区域趋同，而在实际人均收入方面的趋同程度则相对较小。不仅高速公路和高铁网络的变化，而且较低等级公路和铁路网络的变化，在数量上均具有重要意义。其影响背后的关键驱动因素在于促进了货物运输及技术扩散，而流动性成本的降低和便利设施的扩散则显得不那么重要。

url:61f3fd563fbcb529.abstract: We examine the welfare costs of ignoring this observable information by incorporating either a wealth- or a health-based correction factor to the current program. For the analysis, we build a rich life-cycle model in which married men decide their savings, labor supply, and benefits-claiming age, and are heterogeneous in many dimensions, most notably their fixed health type. We find that the average welfare losses from ignoring wealth-related differences in life expectancy at the claiming age are equivalent to a 1.69% permanent reduction in consumption, with both health types experiencing welfare losses. By contrast, ignoring health-related information at the claiming age generates average welfare gains of 0.72%, but with highly uneven welfare effects across health types: while the tax burden of the transfers is concentrated largely among health type 1 individuals, health type 2 households experience a welfare loss equivalent to a 6.84% permanent consumption fall.
url:61f3fd563fbcb529.abstract_zh: 我们考察了在当前计划中纳入基于财富或健康的修正因子而忽略这一可观测信息所带来的福利成本。为进行分析，我们构建了一个丰富的生命周期模型，其中已婚男性决定其储蓄、劳动供给及领取福利的年龄，并在多个维度上具有异质性，尤其是其固定的健康类型。我们发现，在领取年龄时忽略与财富相关的预期寿命差异，平均福利损失相当于永久性消费减少1.69%，且两种健康类型均遭受福利损失。相比之下，在领取年龄时忽略与健康相关的信息，平均福利收益为0.72%，但不同健康类型间的福利效应极不均衡：虽然转移支付的税收负担主要集中在健康类型1个体身上，但健康类型2家庭经历的福利损失相当于永久性消费下降6.84%。

url:62027536d756e2a1.abstract: This paper measures and analyzes management practices in the Kenyan health care sector, drawing on a nationally representative survey and linked administrative data. The paper adapts the World Management Survey to measure management quality in primary health care facilities and hospitals, surveying 429 primary health care facilities and 73 hospitals. Management quality is low on average, and the distribution is highly compressed. The analysis uses administrative data to test the association between the management quality and performance of primary health care facilities, measured by outpatient attendance, during a period of disruption that included the COVID-19 pandemic and a public health workers
url:62027536d756e2a1.abstract_zh: 本文基于全国代表性调查及关联行政数据，对肯尼亚医疗部门的管理实践进行了测度与分析。研究采用世界管理调查方法，对429家初级卫生保健机构和73家医院的管理质量进行评估。初级卫生保健机构作为多数患者的首要接触点，承担常见传染病、慢性病治疗及母婴健康相关服务。结果显示，管理质量整体偏低且分布高度集中。通过行政数据检验，本文分析了在包含新冠疫情及公共卫生工作者罢工的动荡时期，初级卫生保健机构管理质量与门诊就诊量绩效指标之间的关联性。

url:62168ef490e03297.abstract: This paper argues that the financing model of property-rights institutions is a central determinant of their distributional consequences. Following the Napoleonic reforms, Spain’s Liberal governments created a modern, nationally integrated land registry, but financed access through user fees and tied registration to the collection of transfer taxes. This arrangement reduced the administrative cost of reform and gave the Treasury transaction revenue at a time when the cadastral basis of direct land taxation was increasingly obsolete. Yet it also created a regressive access regime: because notarial fees, registry charges, and taxes were largely fixed, the proportional cost of formalisation was highest for low-value and fragmented properties. Drawing on fee schedules, fiscal series, and provincial evidence, the paper reconstructs this cost structure, documents the growing fiscal weight of transaction taxation, and shows that the incidence of formalisation costs was greatest where registry participation was weakest. Because pricing produced the exclusion rather than incomplete coverage, extending such a registry need not narrow inequality and may reproduce it. Spain’s experience shows that a legally universal property-rights institution could remain economically unequal in practice, and that the funding model should be treated as a first-order variable in explaining its historical performance.
url:62168ef490e03297.abstract_zh: 本文认为，产权制度的融资模式是其分配后果的核心决定因素。继拿破仑改革之后，西班牙自由派政府创建了一个现代、全国一体化的土地登记体系，但通过用户费用为其提供资金，并将登记与转让税的征收挂钩。这一安排在直接土地税的测地基础日益过时之际，降低了改革的行政成本，并为国库带来了交易收入。然而，这也造成了一种累退性的准入制度：由于公证费、登记费及税费大体固定，正式化的比例成本对低价值及碎片化财产最高。借助费用表、财政序列及省级证据，本文重构了这一成本结构，记录了交易税财政权重的增长，并表明正式化成本的负担在登记参与最薄弱的地区最为沉重。由于定价导致了排斥而非覆盖不全，扩展此类登记体系未必能缩小不平等，反而可能使其再生产。西班牙的经验表明，一个法律上普遍适用的产权制度在实践中可能仍保持经济上的不平等，且融资模式应被视为解释其历史绩效的一阶变量。

url:6224933529279ffc.abstract: This paper analyses Switzerland?s experience of migration, centring on two main issues: the economic effects of migration and the labour market performance of immigrants. Two main results emerge from our study: first, as a result of shortcomings of the Swiss migration policy, immigrants tend to have a negative impact on the Swiss economy; and second, the analysis of labour market performance shows that there are substantial discrepancies in the performance of immigrants from different countries of origin. Immigrants from North European countries largely outperform immigrants from South European and non-European countries. On the basis of the empirical analysis, this study finally outlines some reform options for Swiss migration policy.
url:6224933529279ffc.abstract_zh: 本文分析了瑞士的移民经验，重点关注两个主要问题：移民的经济效应以及移民的劳动力市场表现。研究得出两个主要结论：首先，由于瑞士移民政策的缺陷，移民往往对瑞士经济产生负面影响；其次，劳动力市场表现分析显示，来自不同原籍国的移民在表现上存在显著差异。来自北欧国家的移民在很大程度上优于来自南欧和非欧洲国家的移民。基于实证分析，本研究最后为瑞士移民政策提出了一些改革方案。

We find that receiving cash transfers increases HAZ by 0.6 to 0.8 standard deviations. Additionally, the transfers reduce the incidence of both underweight and overweight status based on WAZ scores. url:62876026579a48d5.abstract_zh: 本研究评估了全球最大规模针对难民的人道主义无条件现金转移项目——紧急社会安全网（ESSN）项目——对儿童营养与生长发育结果的影响。基于包含叙利亚难民代表性样本的2018年土耳其人口与健康调查数据，并采用断点回归设计，我们分析了该项目对儿童生长发育指标（以年龄别身高Z评分（HAZ）、年龄别体重Z评分（WAZ）和身高别体重Z评分（WHZ）及其极端值衡量）以及儿童营养状况（涵盖五大主要食物类别）的作用。研究发现，获得现金转移使HAZ提高了0.6至0.8个标准差。此外，基于WAZ评分的低体重和超重发生率均有所下降。WHZ评分及基于该指标的儿童超重发生率也呈现降低趋势。进一步分析项目

url:62a5a288f5a2b9a2.abstract: This paper investigates whether banks' information technology (IT) can substitute for local branch presence in the provision of small business credit. Our identification strategy relies on loan-level data and the unique institutional features of the Italian public guarantee scheme during Covid-19. Despite the availability of online applications and low screening incentives, small business lending remains local, even for first-time borrowers. However, IT partly mitigates the impact of local branch presence: banks with better IT provide more, cheaper and faster guaranteed loans and lend more in areas where they have no bank branches, especially to first-time borrowers.
url:62a5a288f5a2b9a2.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了银行的信息技术（IT）是否能在小企业信贷供给中替代当地分支机构的存在。我们的识别策略依赖于贷款层面的数据以及意大利在新冠疫情期间公共担保计划的独特制度特征。尽管在线申请可用且筛选激励较低，小企业贷款仍保持本地化，即便是对首次借款人也是如此。然而，IT在一定程度上缓解了当地分支机构存在的影响：拥有更优IT的银行提供更多、更便宜且更快的担保贷款，并在其无分支机构的地区发放更多贷款，尤其是面向首次借款人。

url:62bd15a6acbf6a29.abstract: This paper investigates how telecommunications infrastructure affects economic growth. This issue is important and has received considerable attention in the popular press concerning the creation of the 'information superhighway' and its potential impacts on the economy. We use evidence from 21 OECD countries over a twenty-year period to examine the impacts that telecommunications developments may have had. We estimate a structural model, which endogenizes telecommunication investment by specifying a micro-model of supply and demand for telecommunication investments. The micro-model is then jointly estimated with the macro-growth equation. After controlling for country-specific fixed effects, we find evidence of a significant positive causal link, especially when a critical mass of telecommunications infrastructure is present. Interestingly, the critical mass appears to be at a level of telecommunications infrastructure that is near universal service.
url:62bd15a6acbf6a29.abstract_zh: 本文探讨电信基础设施如何影响经济增长。这一问题至关重要，且因"信息高速公路"的构建及其对经济的潜在影响，已在主流媒体中引发广泛关注。我们利用21个OECD国家二十年的数据，考察电信发展可能产生的影响。通过构建一个将电信投资内生化处理的微观供需模型，我们对该结构模型进行估计。该微观模型与宏观增长方程联合估计后，在控制国家固定效应的情况下，发现电信基础设施与经济增长之间存在显著的正向因果关联——尤其当电信基础设施达到临界规模时更为明显。值得注意的是，这一临界规模恰好接近实现普遍服务的电信基础设施水平。

url:62e8729c1c28cde8.abstract: This paper shows that human capital accumulation can accelerate structural transformation without accelerating growth. We study China’s 1999 higher education expansion, a large, rapid, and largely unanticipated increase in college graduates. We find that more exposed prefectures experienced larger increases in the skilled-labor share and shifted employment and value added from agriculture toward services. The reallocation extended to low-skilled workers. Consumer services absorbed most of the increase in employment, while producer services accounted for a disproportionate share of high-skilled employment growth. Yet more-exposed prefectures did not grow faster. A four-sector model rationalizes these patterns, showing how greater skill supply can generate broad-based servitization, but also a Baumol-type growth penalty when labor reallocates toward slower-growing sectors. Our findings highlight that the payoff to higher education depends not only on how much skill it creates, but also on whether the resulting structural transformation directs resources toward the economy’s engines of productivity growth.
url:62e8729c1c28cde8.abstract_zh: 本文表明，人力资本积累能够加速结构转型，却未必加速经济增长。我们研究了中国1999年的高等教育扩张，这是一次大规模、迅速且在很大程度上未预料到的大学生数量激增。我们发现，受影响较大的地级市经历了技能劳动力份额的更大增长，并将就业和增加值从农业转向服务业。这种重新配置也延伸至低技能劳动者。消费服务业吸收了就业增长的大部分，而生产性服务业则在高端技能就业增长中占据了不成比例的份额。然而，受影响较大的地级市并未实现更快的经济增长。一个四部门模型合理化了这些现象，展示了技能供给增加如何引发广泛的“服务化”，但当劳动力重新配置向增长较慢的部门时，也可能带来鲍莫尔式的增长惩罚。我们的发现强调，高等教育的回报不仅取决于其创造的技能数量，还取决于由此产生的结构转型是否将资源导向经济中生产率增长的引擎。
url:62e8729c1c28cde8.title: DP21895 Educating like China

url:62f407d791a8327f.abstract: Mientras está bien documentada la importancia del liderazgo de los rectores, poco se sabe sobre cómo desarrollar sus competencias, especialmente entre aquellos que están en ejercicio. La presente investigación estudia cómo el programa más importante de desarrollo profesional de rectores en Colombia, Rectores Líderes Transformadores (RLT), promueve las competencias necesarias para el ejercicio del liderazgo. Haciendo seguimiento a dos cohortes del programa durante dos años, se encuentran cinco acciones concretas e intencionadas que RLT implementa para impulsar las competencias de los rectores: (i) hacer énfasis en las competencias personales; ii) crear ambientes adecuados para la relación entre pares; iii) propiciar múltiples espacios de reflexión; iv) realizar acompañamiento directo; v) entregar herramientas prácticas y efectivas. A pesar de que RLT impulsa importantes habilidades, los resultados sugieren que el programa no desarrolla algunas competencias cruciales para el ejercicio del liderazgo educativo tales como gestión del cambio, innovación, negociación, toma de decisiones, manejo de conflictos, pensamiento estratégico, pensamiento sistémico y tolerancia a la presión. Finalmente, se concluye que las metodologías experienciales y el enfoque en el desarrollo del ser, son las que potencian el desarrollo de las demás competencias.
url:62f407d791a8327f.abstract_zh: 尽管校长领导力的重要性已有充分文献记载，但关于如何培养其能力，尤其是在职校长的能力发展方面，相关研究仍较为匮乏。本研究探讨了哥伦比亚最重要的校长专业发展项目——“变革型领导者校长项目”（RLT）如何促进校长行使领导力所需的能力。通过对该项目两届学员为期两年的跟踪调查，研究发现RLT实施了五项具体且有意的行动来推动校长能力提升：（i）强调个人能力；（ii）营造有利于同伴关系的环境；（iii）提供多种反思空间；（iv）开展直接辅导；（v）提供实用有效的工具。尽管RLT推动了重要技能的发展，但研究结果表明，该项目并未培养教育领导力实践中某些关键能力，如变革管理、创新、谈判、决策、冲突处理、战略思维、系统思维以及抗压能力。最后，研究得出结论：体验式方法论和以“人的发展”为核心的取向，是促进其他能力发展的关键因素。

url:62f9c1ffd7d04927.abstract: How do international investors adjust portfolios in response to biodiversity risk? Fund managers reduced exposures to extremely high biodiversity risk without seizing low biodiversity risk as an opportunity for profit, characterizing biodiversity as downside risk factor. url:62f9c1ffd7d04927.abstract_zh: 国际投资者如何根据生物多样性风险调整投资组合？利用投资基金的月度组合数据，我们发现2021年《昆明宣言》促使基金经理将投资组合从高生物多样性风险国家重新配置至风险较低的国家，而最终基金投资者对此并未作出反应。基金经理在降低极高生物多样性风险敞口的同时，并未将低生物多样性风险视为盈利机会，从而将生物多样性定性为下行风险因素。投资基金的重新配置引发了显著的资本流动，使同一地理区域内但非基金所在国受益，从而推动了跨国溢出效应。

url:62fd4f4bda2caccb.abstract: We investigate a structural model of demographic-economic interactions for England during 1570 to 1850. We estimate that the annual rate of population growth consistent with constant real wages was 0.4 per cent before 1760 but 1.5 per cent thereafter. We find that exogenous shocks increased population growth dramatically in the early decades of the Industrial Revolution. Simulations of our model show that if these demographic shocks had occurred before the Industrial revolution the impact on real wages would have been catastrophic and that these shocks were largely responsible for very slow growth of real wages during the Industrial Revolution.
url:62fd4f4bda2caccb.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个针对1570年至1850年间英格兰人口与经济互动的结构模型。我们估算，在1760年之前，与恒定实际工资相符合的人口年增长率为0.4%，而此后则为1.5%。我们发现，外生冲击在工业革命早期几十年间显著促进了人口增长。模型模拟显示，若这些人口冲击发生在工业革命之前，其对实际工资的影响将是灾难性的，并且这些冲击在很大程度上导致了工业革命期间实际工资增长极为缓慢。
url:62fd4f4bda2caccb.title: The Race between Population and Technology: Real wages in the First Industrial Revolution
url:62fd4f4bda2caccb.title_zh: 人口与技术的赛跑：第一次工业革命中的实际工资

url:6307f909b4b122ba.abstract: Following Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine, official trade sanctions were accompanied by private sanctions: voluntary decisions by firms to reduce or cease supplying the Russian market. This paper examines whether private sanctions curtailed trade beyond official restrictions. We use trademark information to connect transaction-level data on Russian imports with trademark owners’ public statements on their Russian operations. Imports linked to firms announcing private sanctions declined significantly relative to those associated with firms making no such commitments, indicating substantial compliance with withdrawal pledges. These declines also affected goods not covered by official sanctions, broadening the effective scope of trade restrictions, although third-country intermediation weakened the effects. The results are robust to instrumental-variable strategy exploiting variation in investor scrutiny, proxied by public listing status, and imply effects equivalent to ad valorem tariffs of 9–84 percent under plausible trade elasticities. These findings show that public pressure can have meaningful geopolitical consequences.
url:6307f909b4b122ba.abstract_zh: 2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，官方贸易制裁与私人制裁同步实施：企业自愿决定减少或停止向俄罗斯市场供货。本文旨在检验私人制裁是否在官方限制之外进一步抑制了贸易。我们利用商标信息，将俄罗斯进口的交易层面数据与商标所有者关于其在俄业务的公开声明进行匹配。与未作出此类承诺的企业相关的进口相比，宣布实施私人制裁的企业所关联的进口显著下降，这表明撤资承诺得到了实质性遵守。这些下降还波及了官方制裁未覆盖的商品，从而扩大了贸易限制的实际范围，尽管第三国中介效应削弱了其影响。基于投资者关注度差异（以公开上市状态为代理变量）的工具变量策略验证了结果的稳健性，并在合理贸易弹性假设下，其影响相当于9%至84%的从价关税。这些发现表明，公众压力可产生重要的地缘政治后果。
url:6307f909b4b122ba.title: DP21774 Not wearing Prada: Do private sanctions reinforce official sanctions?
url:6307f909b4b122ba.title_zh: DP21774 不穿普拉达：私人制裁是否强化了官方制裁？

url:63134ad56087b803.abstract: We develop democratic mechanisms where individual utilities are not observable by other people at the legislative stage. We show that an appropriate combination of three rules can yield efficient provision of public projects: first, flexible and double majority rules where the size of the majority depends on the proposal and verifiable parameters and taxed and non-taxed individuals need to support the proposal; second, flexible agenda costs where the agenda-setter has to pay a certain amount of money if his proposal does not generate enough supporting votes; third, a ban on subsidies. We provide a rationale why double majority rules are used in practice. We also show that higher degrees of uncertainty about project parameters can make it easier to achieve first-best allocations and that universal equal treatment with regard to taxation is undesirable.
url:63134ad56087b803.abstract_zh: 我们构建了在立法阶段个体效用不为他人所知的民主机制。研究表明，三种规则的适当组合能够实现公共项目的有效供给：其一，灵活的双重多数规则——多数规模取决于提案内容与可验证参数，且纳税人与非纳税人均需支持该提案；其二，灵活的议程成本机制——若议程设定者的提案未获得足够支持票数，则需支付特定金额；其三，禁止补贴条款。本文为实践中采用双重多数规则提供了理论依据，同时证明项目参数不确定性程度的提高反而更易实现最优配置，且税收领域的普遍平等对待并不可取。
url:63134ad56087b803.title: Democratic Mechanisms: Double Majority Rules and Flexible Agenda Costs
url:63134ad56087b803.title_zh: 民主机制：双重多数规则与灵活议程成本

url:6316294fec9303ba.title: Overbuying, Demand Withholding, and Single Sourcing Under Decreasing Returns
url:6316294fec9303ba.title_zh: 递减收益下的过度采购、需求抑制与单一来源采购

url:6327cc2e9b45fbd1.abstract: We develop an information-based intervention against sexual harassment and test it in a randomized control trial across small groups of military recruits in the boot camp of the Norwegian military. The intervention seeks to bridge two knowledge gaps with implications for sexual harassment prevalence. We tell some recruits about their peers
url:6327cc2e9b45fbd1.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一项基于信息的性骚扰干预措施，并在挪威军队新兵训练营的小规模新兵群体中通过随机对照试验进行了测试。该干预措施旨在弥合两个与性骚扰发生率相关的知识缺口。我们向部分新兵告知其同伴的情况。
url:6327cc2e9b45fbd1.title: Targeting Attitudes to Combat Sexual Harassment: A Randomized Intervention in the Norwegian Military
url:6327cc2e9b45fbd1.title_zh: 针对态度以打击性骚扰：挪威军队中的随机干预实验

url:6330c6f844168c3f.title: Opportunistic Upskilling in European Labour Markets—Evidence From a Wide Replication
url:6330c6f844168c3f.title_zh: 欧洲劳动力市场中的机会性技能提升——基于广泛复制的证据

url:63377656575a5fe8.abstract: A longstanding puzzle in monetary economics is that policy tightening has stronger effects than easing. This column shows that the multiplicity of financing constraints notably dampens the transmission of expansionary monetary policy to firm borrowing and investment, while amplifying the transmission of policy tightening. This asymmetry arises because, when policy tightens, the most responsive constraint binds; whereas, when policy eases, the least responsive constraint limits the expansion of borrowing. A standard New Keynesian framework incorporating this mechanism shows that the decline in aggregate investment following contractionary monetary shocks is twice as large as the increase following equally sized expansionary shocks.
url:63377656575a5fe8.abstract_zh: 货币经济学中一个长期存在的谜题是，政策紧缩的效果强于政策宽松。本文表明，多重融资约束显著削弱了扩张性货币政策向企业借贷和投资的传导，同时放大了政策紧缩的传导效果。这种非对称性产生的原因是：当政策收紧时，最敏感的约束条件生效；而当政策宽松时，最不敏感的约束条件限制了借贷扩张。一个纳入这一机制的标准新凯恩斯框架显示，紧缩性货币冲击后总投资的下降幅度，是同等规模扩张性冲击后上升幅度的两倍。
url:63377656575a5fe8.title: Monetary policy under multiple financing constraints
url:63377656575a5fe8.title_zh: 多重融资约束下的货币政策

url:633b7a47c587b80a.abstract: Legislators often justify legalizing controversial markets, such as sports betting, by citing the potential for new tax revenue to fund popular public...
url:633b7a47c587b80a.abstract_zh: 立法者常常以新税收收入可用于资助受欢迎的公共项目为由，为体育博彩等争议性市场的合法化辩护。
url:633b7a47c587b80a.title: Gambling with State Budgets: Legalized Sports Betting and Lost Lottery Revenue
url:633b7a47c587b80a.title_zh: 赌博与国家预算：合法化体育博彩与彩票收入损失

url:63509b05aa9c3138.title: Welfare debt relief: Impact on employment, benefit receipt, and mental health
url:63509b05aa9c3138.title_zh: 福利债务减免：对就业、福利领取及心理健康的影响

url:6357502f16375ddb.abstract: We study how internal hierarchies affect productivity, wages, and labor shares in Chinese manufacturing firms. Using detailed information on professional titles from the 2004 Annual Survey of Industrial Production, we construct firm-level measures of hierarchical structure and compare private firms with state-owned enterprises (SOEs). Private firms operate leaner hierarchies and exhibit rising labor productivity as organizational layers expand. In contrast, SOEs adopt prematurely deep and top-heavy hierarchies associated with declining labor productivity but higher wages. As a result, labor shares are substantially higher in SOEs. Counterfactual exercises show that distortions in hiring and organizational design account for a large fraction of the labor share gap between SOEs and private firms, pointing to inefficient internal organization as an important source of aggregate misallocation.
url:6357502f16375ddb.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了内部层级结构如何影响中国制造业企业的生产率、工资及劳动份额。利用2004年工业年度调查中关于专业职称的详细数据，我们构建了企业层面的层级结构指标，并对私营企业与国有企业进行了比较。私营企业采用更为精简的层级结构，随着组织层级的增加，劳动生产率呈上升趋势。相反，国有企业过早地形成了深且头重脚轻的层级结构，这与劳动生产率下降但工资水平较高相关联。因此，国有企业的劳动份额显著更高。反事实分析表明，招聘和组织设计中的扭曲解释了国有企业与私营企业之间劳动份额差距的很大一部分，指出低效的内部组织是总体资源错配的重要来源。
url:6357502f16375ddb.title: Firm Hierarchies and Misallocation

url:635c5f6e7b772c27.abstract: We study the impact of foreign exchange interventions during periods of tight credit constraints. Expanding on the Gabaix and Maggiori (2015) model, we predict that long-lived spot interventions have larger effects on exchange rates than shortlived swaps, unanticipated interventions are more impactful, and tighter credit constraints amplify effects. Using high-frequency data on Brazilian Central Bank interventions from 1999 to 2023, we find that unanticipated spot sales of USD reserves lead to significant domestic currency appreciation and reduced covered interest parity deviations. Spot interventions outperform swaps, especially when global intermediaries are constrained, and enhance market efficiency by lowering USD borrowing costs.
url:635c5f6e7b772c27.abstract_zh: 我们研究了信贷约束紧缩时期外汇干预的影响。在扩展Gabaix和Maggiori（2015）模型的基础上，我们预测，长期即期干预对汇率的影响大于短期互换，未预期到的干预更具影响力，且更紧的信贷约束会放大这些效应。利用1999年至2023年巴西中央银行干预的高频数据，我们发现，未预期到的美元储备即期卖出导致本币显著升值，并减少了抛补利率平价偏离。即期干预优于互换，尤其是在全球中介机构受约束时，并通过降低美元借贷成本提升了市场效率。
url:635c5f6e7b772c27.title: Foreign Exchange Interventions and Intermediary Constraints
url:635c5f6e7b772c27.title_zh: 外汇干预与中介机构约束

url:637293681c35bfca.title: Do Unconditional Full Refunds Benefit Consumers?
url:637293681c35bfca.title_zh: 无条件全额退款对消费者有利吗？

url:637536cba2728898.abstract: We study disease spread on a social network where individuals adjust contacts to avoid infection. Susceptible individuals rewire links from infectious individuals to other susceptibles, reducing infections and causing the disease to only become endemic at higher infection rates. We formulate the planner’s problem of implementing targeted lockdowns to control endemic disease as a semidefinite program that is computationally tractable even with many groups. Rewiring complements policy by allowing more intergroup contact as the rewiring rate increases. We apply our model to compute optimal spatially targeted lockdowns for the Netherlands during Covid-19 using a population-level contact network for 17.26 million individuals. Our findings indicate that, with rewiring, a targeted lockdown policy permits 12% more contacts compared to one without rewiring, underscoring the significance of accounting for network endogeneity in effective policy design.
url:637536cba2728898.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个社交网络上的疾病传播模型，其中个体通过调整接触以避免感染。易感个体将连接从传染者转向其他易感者，从而减少感染，并使得疾病仅在较高感染率下才能成为地方性流行病。我们将规划者实施针对性封锁以控制地方性流行病的问题表述为一个半定规划，该规划即使在群体众多的情况下也计算上可行。重新连接行为通过允许随着重新连接率的增加而增加群体间接触，从而补充了政策效果。我们应用该模型，利用包含1726万个体的人口层面接触网络，为荷兰在新冠疫情期间计算最优的空间针对性封锁策略。我们的研究结果表明，在考虑重新连接的情况下，针对性封锁政策相比无重新连接的情况允许增加12%的接触，这强调了在有效政策设计中考虑网络内生性的重要性。
url:637536cba2728898.title: Network Rewiring and Spatial Targeting: Optimal Disease Mitigation in Multilayer Social Networks
url:637536cba2728898.title_zh: 网络重构与空间靶向：多层社交网络中的最优疾病缓解策略

url:6378987523fef1f4.abstract: We examine how the empirical content of revealed preference theory depends on the dimensionality of the choice environment. While higher-dimensional choice problems may appear more demanding, we show that revealed preference restrictions become less informative. Using Selten's Area measure, we establish that for any fixed number of observations, the empirical content of GARP converges to zero exponentially fast in the number of goods. We provide complementary proofs based on revealed preference graphs and the Afriat inequalities, and show in simulations calibrated to scanner data that the effect is quantitatively large. We also evaluate potential responses in observational and experimental settings and find that, while these can slow the rate, they do not eliminate this loss of empirical content.
url:6378987523fef1f4.abstract_zh: 我们考察了显示偏好理论的经验内容如何依赖于选择环境的维度。尽管高维选择问题看似要求更高，但我们证明显示偏好约束的信息量反而更少。利用塞尔滕面积测度，我们确立：对于任意固定观测次数，GARP的经验内容随商品数量呈指数级收敛至零。我们基于显示偏好图与阿弗里亚特不等式提供了互补性证明，并在基于扫描数据校准的模拟中显示该效应在数量上十分显著。我们还评估了观测与实验情境中的潜在应对措施，发现这些措施虽能减缓收敛速度，但无法消除经验内容的损失。

url:637e31c60522246c.abstract: The 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure drove fertilizer prices sharply higher, prompting a broad federal response focused on supply-side capacity, logistics, and producer income support. This paper examines the demand-side channel that has received less policy attention: the margin at which corn producers may reduce nitrogen fertilizer application rates in response to elevated input prices. The agronomic literature suggests reductions of 12 to 16 percent are feasible without measurable expected yield loss; this paper examines a more conservative 5 percent scenario. Two features of the Federal Crop Insurance Program, Good Farming Practices standards and the multi-year Actual Production History calculation, may create marginal friction for producers contemplating reduction under shock-price conditions, though neither is likely determinative relative to agronomic and weather considerations. Simulation results suggest a 5 percent reduction across insured corn acres would conserve roughly 300, 000 short tons of nitrogen, raise federal indemnities by approximately $0.10 billion, and leave approved insurance provider returns above the Standard Reinsurance Agreement target. The paper closes by asking whether existing FCIP mechanisms, GFP interpretation guidance, yield-modification provisions, and AIP make-whole arrangements, warrant further examination in the current price environment.
url:637e31c60522246c.abstract_zh: 2026年霍尔木兹海峡封锁导致化肥价格大幅上涨，促使联邦政府从供给侧产能、物流及生产者收入支持等方面采取广泛应对措施。本文聚焦于政策关注较少的消费侧传导机制：玉米生产者在投入品价格高企时可能降低氮肥施用量的边际空间。农学文献表明，在不造成可测量的预期产量损失前提下，12%至16%的减施幅度具有可行性；本文则采用更为保守的5%情景进行分析。联邦农作物保险计划的两项机制——良好农业操作规范标准与多年实际产量历史计算法——可能对生产者在价格冲击条件下考虑减施行为产生边际摩擦，但相较于农艺与气象因素，两者均不构成决定性影响。模拟结果显示，若参保玉米种植面积统一减施5%，可节约约30万短吨氮肥，联邦赔付额将增加约1亿美元，同时经批准的保险机构收益率仍高于标准再保险协议目标。本文最终提出：在当前价格环境下，现有FCIP机制、GFP解释指南、产量调整条款及AIP补偿安排是否需要进一步审查。
url:637e31c60522246c.title: Crop Insurance and Nitrogen Reduction Under Elevated Fertilizer Prices
url:637e31c60522246c.title_zh: 化肥价格上涨背景下的作物保险与氮肥减量

url:63959bc8e4001f58.abstract: We study the labor-market effects of brand capital, a demand-side intangible asset that differentiates firms' products. Brand capital is difficult to study because its investments are typically unobserved. We leverage firm-to-firm trademark transfers, which create discrete changes in the ownership of legal rights over established brands. We link the universe of Italian trademark transfers to firm financial statements and matched employer-employee records, allowing us to document how acquiring brand capital affects firm scale, pay, labor composition, and labor shares. In a matched event-study design, trademark acquisitions raise intangible assets by 19%, sales by 8%, and employment by 6%, while leaving average weekly earnings unchanged. Since sales rise more than the wage bill, acquirers' labor shares fall. Employment gains are concentrated in market-facing work, as marketing and sales employment rises roughly twice as much as other employment. More generally, employment growth is concentrated among white-collar and managerial workers. Combining buyers and sellers, trademark transfers increase total sales and employment among transacting firms, and lower their combined labor share. Brand capital thus leads to firms' expansion, shifts labor demand toward market-facing tasks, and provides a micro-level channel through which demand-side intangible capital can lower labor shares.
url:63959bc8e4001f58.abstract_zh: 我们研究了品牌资本（一种使企业产品差异化的需求侧无形资产）对劳动力市场的影响。由于品牌资本的投资通常难以观测，相关研究面临困难。我们利用企业间的商标转让——这一行为会导致既有品牌法律所有权的离散变化——将意大利商标转让的完整数据与企业财务报表及匹配的雇主-雇员记录相链接，从而揭示收购品牌资本如何影响企业规模、薪酬、劳动力构成及劳动份额。在匹配事件研究设计中，商标收购使无形资产增加19%，销售额增长8%，就业人数上升6%，而周平均工资保持不变。由于销售额增幅超过工资总额，收购方的劳动份额下降。就业增长集中于面向市场的工作岗位，营销与销售岗位的就业增幅约为其他岗位的两倍。更广泛而言，就业增长集中在白领及管理人员群体。综合买卖双方来看，商标转让提高了交易企业的总销售额与就业人数，并降低了其合并劳动份额。因此，品牌资本推动企业扩张，将劳动力需求转向面向市场的任务，并为需求侧无形资产降低劳动份额提供了微观层面的传导渠道。
url:63959bc8e4001f58.title: DP21799 The Labor Demand Implications of Brand Capital: Evidence from Trademark Transactions
url:63959bc8e4001f58.title_zh: DP21799 品牌资本的劳动力需求含义：来自商标交易的证据

url:639b455ddc12838d.abstract: A central insight from neoclassical economics is that international trade operates like an improvement in production technology. It generates mutual aggregate welfare gains for countries as a whole, but creates winners and losers within countries. Tariffs are a tax on this trading technology and distort the prices faced by domestic consumers and producers. Large countries can use tariffs to improve their terms of trade on world markets. But if all countries try to do so, they can end up with lower welfare than if they cooperated to liberalize trade. Tariffs can be used to redistribute income between the winners and losers from trade within countries. But there can be other more efficient ways to achieve redistribution. Policies to promote economic activity in critical industries can be rationalized based on externalities or national security. But these arguments typically rationalize targeted policies towards those industries and tariffs can be dominated by other policy interventions. Empirical findings from the recent waves of U.S. tariffs suggest that most of the incidence of these tariffs has been borne by U.S. importers, wholesalers, retailers and consumers rather than by foreign exporters. These tariffs have led to a large-scale reorganization of U.S. supply chains away from China to third countries. Although this reorganization has substantially reduced China’s share of U.S. imports, the U.S. remains indirectly exposed to China through the imports of these third countries.
url:639b455ddc12838d.abstract_zh: 新古典经济学的核心见解之一是，国际贸易如同生产技术的改进，为各国整体带来相互的总体福利增益，但在国家内部却产生赢家和输家。关税是对这种贸易技术征收的税种，会扭曲国内消费者和生产者面临的价格。大国可以利用关税改善其在世界市场上的贸易条件。但如果所有国家都试图这样做，最终可能比合作实现贸易自由化时的福利水平更低。关税可用于在国内贸易赢家和输家之间进行收入再分配，但可能存在其他更有效的再分配方式。基于外部性或国家安全理由，可以合理化对关键产业的经济活动促进政策，但这些论点通常支持针对这些产业实施精准政策，而关税可能被其他政策干预手段所取代。近期美国关税浪潮的实证结果表明，这些关税的负担主要由美国进口商、批发商、零售商和消费者承担，而非外国出口商。这些关税导致美国供应链大规模重组，从中国转向第三国。尽管这种重组大幅降低了中国在美国进口中的份额，但美国仍通过从这些第三国的进口间接暴露于中国的影响之下。
url:639b455ddc12838d.title: The Economics of Tariffs

url:639d0851cadd8ddb.abstract: This paper uses a structural model calibrated to an aid-dependent economy to analytically explore the macroeconomic and distributional effects of a permanent aid cut under three alternative policy responses: non-concessional borrowing, domestic revenue mobilization, and uncompensated spending cuts. We find that a borrowing-only response leads to unsustainable debt and highly regressive outcomes. An uncompensated cut results in economic stagnation, higher poverty, and adverse inequality. Within the model, a strategy combining moderate borrowing with ambitious domestic revenue mobilization, while painful in the medium term, produces the most favorable path to fiscal sustainability and moderates the rise in poverty and inequality. These findings are analytical and model-based; they illustrate the trade-offs inherent in fiscal adjustment under aid dependence rather than prescribing specific policy actions.
url:639d0851cadd8ddb.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个校准至援助依赖型经济的结构模型，从分析层面探讨了在三种替代性政策应对方案下——即非优惠借款、国内收入动员及无补偿性支出削减——永久性援助削减对宏观经济与分配效应的影响。研究发现：仅依赖借款的应对方案将导致不可持续的债务负担及高度倒退性结果；无补偿性支出削减则引发经济停滞、贫困加剧及不平等恶化。在该模型框架下，将适度借款与积极的国内收入动员相结合的策略，尽管中期内会带来阵痛，却能最有效地实现财政可持续性路径，并缓解贫困与不平等程度的上升。上述结论基于模型分析，旨在阐明援助依赖型经济在财政调整中固有的权衡取舍，而非提供具体政策建议。
url:639d0851cadd8ddb.title: Closing the Gap: A LIC’s Policy Options Under an Aid Shock
url:639d0851cadd8ddb.title_zh: 缩小差距：援助冲击下低收入国家的政策选择
