url:74c3c81042fd1491.abstract: Large cities worldwide have adopted congestion pricing to reduce urban traffic, with well-documented benefits for travel speeds, accident rates, and air quality. This paper identifies a novel external benefit: faster emergency medical service (EMS) response times. We provide the first evidence on how the congestion pricing program in New York City – the first comprehensive cordon-based congestion pricing system in the U.S. that was implemented on January 5th, 2025 – affects EMS performance. Exploiting the sharp geographic boundary of New York City’s congestion relief zone at 60th Street and a difference-in-discontinuities design, we first document substantial changes in traffic and mobility near the boundary: vehicular traffic declines by roughly 18 to 21 percent, accompanied by increases in pedestrian and bicycle activity. Consistent with these first-stage mechanisms, we find that congestion pricing improves EMS performance, reducing total travel times by 63–70 seconds (approximately 5–6 percent). Effects emerged quickly and show little evidence of displacement to adjacent areas. A concurrent FDNY directive requiring transport to the nearest hospital confounds standard difference-in-differences estimates but not our boundary-based design. These findings suggest that cost-benefit analyses of congestion pricing systematically understate net social benefits by omitting emergency response improvements.
url:74c3c81042fd1491.abstract_zh: 全球各大城市已普遍采用拥堵收费政策以减少城市交通拥堵，其在提升通行速度、降低事故率及改善空气质量方面的效益已有充分文献佐证。本文识别出一项新的外部效益：紧急医疗服务响应速度的提升。我们首次提供了关于纽约市拥堵收费计划——美国首个于2025年1月5日实施的综合性区域拥堵收费系统——如何影响紧急医疗服务绩效的证据。利用纽约市拥堵缓解区在第60街处的清晰地理边界及断点回归设计，我们首先记录了边界附近交通与出行模式的显著变化：机动车流量下降约18%至21%，同时步行与自行车活动增加。与这些第一阶段机制相一致，我们发现拥堵收费改善了紧急医疗服务绩效，使总响应时间减少63至70秒（约5%至6%）。该效应迅速显现，且几乎没有证据表明其向邻近区域转移。纽约市消防局同时实施的将患者送往最近医院的指令混淆了传统双重差分估计结果，但未影响基于边界的识别设计。这些发现表明，拥堵收费的成本效益分析因忽略紧急响应改善而系统性地低估了净社会效益。
url:74c3c81042fd1491.title: Congestion Pricing and Emergency Medical Service Response: Evidence from New York City
url:74c3c81042fd1491.title_zh: 拥堵收费与紧急医疗服务响应：来自纽约市的证据

url:74d2e16d9885d9c5.abstract: How does culture respond to institutional change? We study the collapse of the Holy Roman Empire (1789–1815), when half of Central Europe changed rulers. Using 44 million birth records from hundreds of cities between 1700 and 1850, we measure cultural traits in real time. Cities that experienced ruler change saw greater naming turnover, dispersion, and novelty. We construct control groups using diplomatic records to isolate these effects, which emerged immediately and persisted. The collapse of hegemonic authority weakened state-aligned identities while strengthening religiosity and nationalism. These shifts undermined subsequent state building, highlighting challenges of ideological integration after regime change.
url:74d2e16d9885d9c5.abstract_zh: 文化如何应对制度变迁？我们以神圣罗马帝国的解体（1789-1815年）为研究对象，彼时中欧半数地区更换了统治者。利用1700年至1850年间数百座城市的4400万条出生记录，我们实时衡量了文化特征。经历统治者更迭的城市，其命名更替率、多样性和新颖性均有所提升。我们借助外交档案构建对照组以隔离这些效应，发现其影响即时显现且持续存在。霸权权威的崩溃削弱了与国家一致的认同，同时强化了宗教情感与民族主义。这些转变进而阻碍了后续的国家建设，凸显了政权更迭后意识形态整合所面临的挑战。
url:74d2e16d9885d9c5.title: DP20715 Identity and Institutional Change: Evidence from First Names in Germany, 1700–1850
url:74d2e16d9885d9c5.title_zh: DP20715 身份与制度变迁：来自德国1700—1850年名字的证据

url:74fe9e0c92b397c5.abstract: Measuring the local economic effects of Ukrainian long-range strikes on Russian oil refineries is difficult because reliable local data are scarce and both information and statistics are tightly controlled. This column uses nighttime lights as a proxy for economic activity to show that strikes on fixed industrial assets can generate economically meaningful and persistent local losses. They also illustrate how these losses can be measured when conventional data are unavailable, delayed, or difficult to verify independently.
url:74fe9e0c92b397c5.abstract_zh: 衡量乌克兰远程打击俄罗斯炼油厂对当地经济的影响十分困难，因为可靠的当地数据稀缺，且信息与统计均受到严格管控。本专栏以夜间灯光作为经济活动的代理指标，表明对固定工业资产的打击能够造成具有经济意义且持续性的当地损失。同时，这些发现也展示了在传统数据不可获取、存在滞后或难以独立验证的情况下，如何衡量此类损失。
url:74fe9e0c92b397c5.title: After the fire: How Ukrainian strikes disrupt local economies around Russian refineries
url:74fe9e0c92b397c5.title_zh: 火灾之后：乌克兰袭击如何扰乱俄罗斯炼油厂周边的地方经济

url:750705ddcf618717.abstract: This paper examines long-run unconditional convergence of labour productivity in manufacturing across 48 contiguous U.S. states. We construct a detailed panel data set of state-industry pairs with over 120 industries covering the period 1880-2007. The remarkable finding is a rapid rate of unconditional β-convergence: 7.6% per year in the period 1880-2007, and about 6.5% in each period 1880-1940 and 1958-2007. We also find a steep rise in unconditional convergence from 5.5% in 1930-1940 to 10.6% in 1940-1947 and 9.4% in 1947-1958, followed by a considerable drop thereafter. In the years 1958-2007, the rate of convergence in ICT industries (8.3%) is higher than in 1st-Industrial-Revolution (6.3%) or 2nd-Industrial-Revolution (7.0%) industries. We interpret our results as a process of technological catch up between initially laggard Southern manufacturing and manufacturing industries in the North.
url:750705ddcf618717.abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国本土48个州制造业劳动生产率在长期内的无条件收敛情况。我们构建了一个包含超过120个行业、覆盖1880年至2007年的州-行业配对详细面板数据集。显著发现是快速的无条件β-收敛率：在1880年至2007年间为每年7.6%，而在1880年至1940年及1958年至2007年各时期约为每年6.5%。我们还发现，无条件收敛率在1930年至1940年的5.5%急剧上升至1940年至1947年的10.6%及1947年至1958年的9.4%，此后则显著下降。在1958年至2007年间，信息通信技术行业的收敛率（8.3%）高于第一次工业革命行业（6.3%）或第二次工业革命行业（7.0%）。我们将结果解释为初始落后的南方制造业与北方制造业之间技术追赶的过程。
url:750705ddcf618717.title: A Long-Run Perspective on Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing: Evidence from U.S. Industrialization
url:750705ddcf618717.title_zh: 美国工业化证据：制造业无条件趋同的长期视角

url:750cd3fff90f2944.abstract: News aggregators are among the primary gatekeepers of online news, shaping both consumption and production through the algorithms that rank stories and sources. We provide the first large scale estimates of this algorithmic power using the example of Yandex News, Russia’s largest aggregator. Combining archived front pages with 12.3 million published articles and outlet-level traffic data, we estimate that occupying the entire top-5 news block for a day raises an outlet’s traffic by roughly 380,000 visitors. After a 2016 law made aggregators liable for cited content, Yandex halved its references to independent outlets, yet consumers did not penalize the manipulation: its referrals converted readers at the same rate, and its market share did not fall. Removed outlets shifted toward longer articles and stopped optimizing headlines for the algorithm, showing that aggregator algorithms shape not only news consumption but also production.
url:750cd3fff90f2944.abstract_zh: 新闻聚合器是在线新闻的主要守门人，通过排序报道和来源的算法，同时塑造新闻消费与生产。我们以俄罗斯最大的聚合器Yandex News为例，首次大规模估算了这种算法的影响力。结合存档首页、1230万篇已发表文章以及媒体层面的流量数据，我们估算出，占据前五名新闻板块一整天可使一家媒体的流量增加约38万访客。2016年一项法律要求聚合器对引用的内容负责后，Yandex将独立媒体的引用量减半，但消费者并未惩罚这种操纵：其引荐的读者转化率保持不变，市场份额也未下降。被移除的媒体转向发布更长的文章，并停止为算法优化标题，这表明聚合器算法不仅塑造新闻消费，也影响新闻生产。
url:750cd3fff90f2944.title: DP21789 Platform Power in News Aggregation
url:750cd3fff90f2944.title_zh: DP21789 新闻聚合中的平台权力

url:751a4551ebd99368.abstract: Drafting in the swim leg of mass-start triathlon transfers a hydrodynamic cost advantage to the bike and run, where it surfaces as a change in relative rank. I use cross-stage rank improvement as a reverse proxy for free-riding and study its determinants in a ten-year panel of athlete × event records centred on 2020, when COVID-19 response policies replaced mass starts with individually staggered starts and mechanically curtailed drafting. A compact two-stage contest model, in which drafting enters the bike–run stage as a multiplicative cost shifter, organises the predictions. Identification combines pooled OLS with athlete and event fixed effects and a sharp regression-discontinuity design at the 2019/2020 cut-off. Free-riding was substantial before 2020, fell sharply in 2020 (a local-linear RDD estimate of about −31 rank places; a local-cubic estimate of about −92), and recovered only partially afterwards. The gains are largest for weaker swimmers and deeper drafting positions, the gender gap is modest, and they rise with swim-group size at an estimated log–log elasticity of about 0.43. The 2020 disruption thus acts as a contraction of the feasible set for free-riding, and its recovery is uneven rather than broad-based.
url:751a4551ebd99368.abstract_zh: 在集体出发游泳赛段中跟游所产生的流体力学成本优势会转移至自行车与跑步阶段，并表现为相对排名的变化。本文以跨赛段排名提升作为搭便车行为的反向代理指标，基于以2020年为中心的十年期运动员×赛事面板数据，研究其决定因素——2020年新冠疫情应对政策将集体出发改为间隔出发，从机制上限制了跟游行为。通过构建紧凑的两阶段竞赛模型（将跟游作为乘数型成本转移因子纳入自行车-跑步阶段）来组织预测。识别策略结合了混合OLS回归、运动员与赛事固定效应，以及以2019/2020年为断点的锐化回归断点设计。2020年前搭便车现象显著，2020年急剧下降（局部线性RDD估计值约为-31个排名位次；局部立方估计值约为-92），此后仅部分恢复。游泳能力较弱的运动员和跟游位置更靠后的选手获益最大，性别差异较小，且收益随游泳组规模扩大而增加（估计对数-对数弹性约为0.43）。因此，2020年的冲击相当于收缩了搭便车的可行集，其恢复呈现非均衡特征而非全面复苏。

url:7544524b2fe993b6.abstract: As COVID-19 pandemic accelerated the digitalization of healthcare, prompting large public investments in the sector, it remains unclear whether the initial shock generated a stable adoption of digital health tools and the full exploitation of their functionalities. Using the case of the Electronic Health Records (EHR) in Italy, we show that a remarkable increase in its use in the aftermath of the pandemic is not necessarily associated to an equal understanding of its scope and functions by potential patients. Exploiting a 2020 reform and variation in pandemic exposure, we show that a one-standard- deviation increase in exposure increased EHR reported use by 39%, driven by records feeding and medical needs. We then leverage a December 2024 national media campaign on the EHR to conduct an original survey focused on its adoption. Among the main evidence is that the acknowledgment of the EHR existence does not translate into effective knowledge, access, or regular use. Engagement is more strongly associated with trust and digital attitudes than with most traditional socio-economic factors. Progress along the adoption chain depends on perceived needs, institutional confidence, and willingness to engage with digital tools. To provide an understanding of how to increase perceived benefits and willingness to engage with the EHR, we randomize information treatments based on the Technology Acceptance Model. Overall, our findings suggest that the effectiveness of large-scale digital health investments depends critically on citizens' awareness, trust, and engagement, and that more tailored information campaigns are needed to improve the general literacy of digital tools once they are introduced or potentiated.
url:7544524b2fe993b6.abstract_zh: 随着新冠疫情加速医疗数字化进程并推动该领域大规模公共投资，尚不明确的是，这一初始冲击是否催生了数字健康工具的稳定采用及其功能的充分开发。以意大利电子健康档案（EHR）为例，我们发现疫情后其使用量显著增长，但潜在患者对其范围与功能的认知未必同步提升。利用2020年改革及疫情暴露程度的差异，我们证明疫情暴露程度每增加一个标准差，EHR报告使用率将提升39%，这一增长主要由记录录入和医疗需求驱动。随后，我们借助2024年12月全国性EHR媒体宣传活动开展了一项聚焦其采纳情况的原创调查。主要证据表明：对EHR存在的认知并未转化为有效知识、实际访问或常规使用。相较于大多数传统社会经济因素，用户参与度与信任度及数字态度关联更为紧密。采纳链条的推进取决于感知需求、制度信心及数字工具使用意愿。为理解如何提升EHR的感知收益与使用意愿，我们基于技术接受模型随机分配信息干预。总体而言，研究结果表明：大规模数字健康投资的有效性关键取决于公民的认知、信任与参与度，且需通过更具针对性的信息宣传活动，在数字工具引入或强化后提升公众对其的普遍素养。
url:7544524b2fe993b6.title: Infrastructure or Knowledge? Investment Priorities for Promoting the Adoption of Digital Health Tools
url:7544524b2fe993b6.title_zh: 基础设施还是知识？促进数字健康工具采纳的投资优先序

url:7561cc30ee0faea7.abstract: We develop a Heterogeneous Agent New Keynesian model of two countries (HANK²) and show in closed form that a monetary union shifts the adjustment to a shock horizontally - across countries - within the brackets of the union-wide wealth distribution rather than vertically - that is, across the brackets of the union-wide wealth distribution. Calibrating the model to the euro area reveals that a monetary union alters the impact of shocks most strongly in the tails of the wealth distribution but leaves the middle class almost unaffected.
url:7561cc30ee0faea7.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个两国异质性主体新凯恩斯模型（HANK²），并以闭式解形式证明，货币联盟将冲击的调整方式从纵向——即跨越联盟整体财富分布的各层级——转变为横向——即在联盟内各国之间进行。将该模型校准至欧元区数据后发现，货币联盟对财富分布尾部的冲击影响最为显著，而对中产阶级几乎无影响。

url:75b2a278c3b508c1.abstract: We examine market entry and post-entry debt dynamics in Frontier Economies by grouping countries based on durability of market access using a two-step framework combining first Eurobond issuance with the reliance on private external creditors, validated through an unsupervised K-mean clustering. A discrete-time event LOGIT model finds that favorable global liquidity conditions and investor appetite open issuance windows for countries, but domestic pull factors—income, institutions, growth, and reserve buffers—ultimately determine success of market entry. Post-entry, Frontier Economies shift rapidly toward market borrowing, with looser fiscal stance as new financing source is unlocked. Along increased exposure to rollover and global financial cycle risks, debt decomposition exercise shows a worsening interest–growth differential and rising debt, driven mainly by primary deficits and higher interest burdens. Results underscore the need for credible medium-term fiscal frameworks, stronger debt management, and reserve buffers to manage the transition to market financing.
url:75b2a278c3b508c1.abstract_zh: 我们通过两步法框架，将国家按市场准入的持久性进行分组，结合首次欧元债券发行与对私人外部债权人的依赖程度，并借助无监督K均值聚类进行验证，从而考察前沿经济体的市场进入及进入后的债务动态。离散时间事件LOGIT模型发现，有利的全球流动性条件和投资者偏好为各国打开了发行窗口，但国内拉动因素——收入水平、制度质量、经济增长和储备缓冲——最终决定了市场进入的成功与否。进入市场后，前沿经济体迅速转向市场借贷，随着新融资来源的解锁，财政政策趋于宽松。在面临展期风险和全球金融周期风险加剧的同时，债务分解分析显示，利息-增长差恶化且债务上升，主要源于基本赤字和更高的利息负担。研究结果强调了建立可信的中期财政框架、加强债务管理以及储备缓冲的必要性，以应对向市场融资的转型。

url:75c095ce0f3fdca7.abstract: Were either the exceptional defense spending needs of the government or the sharp increase in the cost-of-living of poorer households factors that rationalize the National Bank of Ukraine’s temporary fix of the Hryvnia when Russia invaded in 2022? To test the validity of these explanations, we develop a small open-economy two-agent New Keynesian (SOE-TANK) model of Ukraine featuring: 1) a government that finances military imports and 2) low- and high-income households. We find that the surge in foreign-currency-denominated military spending alone does not justify a temporary exchange-rate peg. However, when the consumption of low income households is close to subsistence levels, we find that the optimal exchange rate regime becomes state-contingent: exchange-rate flexibility is desirable for small shocks, whereas for a large-scale invasion shock, a fixed exchange rate dominates a floating regime with a standard Taylor rule.
url:75c095ce0f3fdca7.abstract_zh: 政府异常庞大的国防开支需求，或是贫困家庭生活成本急剧上升，是否构成了乌克兰国家银行在2022年俄罗斯入侵时临时固定赫里夫尼亚汇率的合理依据？为检验这些解释的有效性，我们构建了一个乌克兰的小型开放经济双主体新凯恩斯主义（SOE-TANK）模型，该模型包含：1）一个为军事进口融资的政府；2）低收入与高收入家庭。研究发现，仅以外币计价的军事支出激增并不足以证明临时汇率挂钩的合理性。然而，当低收入家庭的消费接近生存水平时，最优汇率制度变得依状态而定：对于小规模冲击，汇率灵活性更为可取；而对于大规模入侵冲击，固定汇率则优于采用标准泰勒规则的浮动汇率制度。

url:75d810a7682228c8.abstract: During a distinguished career that spanned more than five decades, Assaf Razin, who passed away in July 2026, established himself as one of the leading international economists of his generation. This column describes how, across a range of topics including international trade, international finance, fiscal policy, taxation, migration, the welfare state, and financial crises, he combined theoretical innovation with an abiding concern for policy and for the ways in which globalisation expands national opportunities while constraining national choices.
url:75d810a7682228c8.abstract_zh: 在跨越五十余载的杰出学术生涯中，于2026年7月逝世的阿萨夫·拉津（Assaf Razin）奠定了其作为同代顶尖国际经济学家的地位。本专栏将阐述他如何在国际贸易、国际金融、财政政策、税收、移民、福利国家及金融危机等一系列议题中，将理论创新与对政策的持久关注相结合，并深入探讨全球化如何在拓展国家机遇的同时约束国家选择。

url:76246c76518ec034.abstract: This article uses Anglican marriage registers from colonial and post-colonial Uganda to investigate long-term trends and determinants of intergenerational social mobility among Christian African men. We show that the colonial era opened up new labour opportunities for our African converts enabling them to take large steps up the social ladder regardless of their social origin. Contrary to the widespread belief that British indirect rule perpetuated the power of pre-colonial African elites, we show that a remarkably fluid colonial labour economy actually undermined their social advantages. Sons of traditional landed chiefs gradually lost their high social-status monopoly to a new commercially-orientated and well-educated class of Anglican Ugandans, who mostly came from non-elite and even lower-class backgrounds. We also document that the colonial administration and the Anglican mission functioned as key steps on the ladder to upward mobility, and that mission education helped provide the skills and social reference needed to climb it. These social mobility patterns persisted throughout the post-colonial era despite rising informal labour during Idi Amin’s dictatorship.
url:76246c76518ec034.abstract_zh: 本文利用殖民时期及后殖民时期乌干达的英国国教婚姻登记记录，探讨基督教非洲男性代际社会流动的长期趋势及其决定因素。研究表明，殖民时代为非洲皈依者开辟了新的劳动机会，使他们能够不论出身背景，在社会阶梯上实现大幅跃升。与普遍认为英国间接统治延续了前殖民时期非洲精英权力的观点相反，本文揭示，一个高度流动的殖民劳动经济实际上削弱了这些精英的社会优势。传统地主酋长之子逐渐丧失其高社会地位的垄断，取而代之的是一个以商业为导向且受过良好教育的乌干达英国国教徒新阶层，他们大多出身于非精英甚至下层背景。本文还记录到，殖民行政机构与英国国教传教团充当了向上流动阶梯中的关键环节，而传教教育则提供了攀登这一阶梯所需的技能与社会参照。这些社会流动模式在后殖民时期持续存在，尽管在伊迪·阿明独裁统治期间非正规劳动有所增加。

url:768554989bdcbbae.abstract: We quantify barriers to cross-border banking within the euro area and their consequences for credit allocation and output. Using loan-level data from the European credit registry (AnaCredit) and group structures (RIAD), we estimate barriers to relationship formation, loan pricing, and banks’ branching decisions at the country-pair level. We find that barriers to cross-border relationships between banks and firms and cross-border bank entry are large while wedges on interest rates and loan quantities are comparatively small. The estimated edges are strongly associated with differences in national banking regulations, measured using a novel dataset on regulatory distances. We embed our estimates into a quantitative spatial general equilibrium model with heterogeneous banks and firms subject to cross-border frictions in relationship formation, loan pricing, and bank entry. Partially relaxing frictions predicts sizable and heterogeneous output gains across euro area countries. These gains are primarily driven by increases in capital and labor rather than improvements in allocative efficiency.
url:768554989bdcbbae.abstract_zh: 我们量化了欧元区内跨境银行业务的障碍及其对信贷配置和产出的影响。利用欧洲信贷登记系统（AnaCredit）的贷款层面数据和集团结构数据（RIAD），我们在国家-国家配对层面估计了关系建立、贷款定价以及银行分支决策的障碍。研究发现，银行与企业之间的跨境关系建立以及跨境银行进入的障碍较大，而利率和贷款数量的楔子相对较小。这些估计的楔子与各国银行业监管差异（通过一套新的监管距离数据集衡量）密切相关。我们将这些估计嵌入一个包含异质性银行和企业的定量空间一般均衡模型中，该模型考虑了关系建立、贷款定价和银行进入方面的跨境摩擦。部分放松这些摩擦预计将在欧元区各国带来显著且异质性的产出增长。这些增长主要源于资本和劳动的增加，而非配置效率的改善。

url:76f1d40c30c99b98.abstract: Evaluations of microenterprise credit typically measure effects only on borrowing firms. But what about their customers? If microenterprises sell relatively undifferentiated goods and services, as is often hypothesized, credit may simply reallocate sales across firms and create little consumer benefit. In a randomized controlled trial in Chile, large loans increased treated firms’ profits by USD 292 per month, a 13.4% increase. Customer survey data indicate even larger benefits for customers: a gain of USD 494 per month in consumer surplus. Furthermore, using a sample of more than 125,000 non-treated firms operating in the same markets, we find little evidence of business stealing. The welfare gains from credit expansion thus extend well beyond the borrowers themselves.
url:76f1d40c30c99b98.abstract_zh: 微型企业信贷的评估通常仅衡量对借款企业的影响。但借款企业的客户呢？如果微型企业销售的商品和服务相对同质化，正如常被假设的那样，信贷可能仅仅在厂商之间重新分配销售额，而对消费者几乎不产生益处。在智利进行的一项随机对照试验中，大额贷款使受助企业的月利润增加了292美元，增幅达13.4%。客户调查数据显示，客户获得的益处甚至更大：消费者剩余每月增加494美元。此外，利用同一市场中超过12.5万家未受助企业的样本，我们几乎没有发现业务侵占的证据。因此，信贷扩张带来的福利收益远不止于借款者本身。
url:76f1d40c30c99b98.title: When Microenterprises Grow, Are Consumers Better Off? Evidence from Large Loans to Microenterprises in Chile

url:770fd3589f7f209a.abstract: Contingent convertible capital (CoCo) is a debt instrument that converts to equity or is written off if the issuing bank fails to meet a distress threshold. The conversion increases the issuer's loss-absorption capacity, but results in wealth transfers between CoCo holders and shareholders, which may change risk-shifting incentives to shareholders. Higher risk increases the probability of CoCo conversion, while lowering the wealth transfer. We show that for Principal-Write-Down (PWD) CoCos, the net effect is to always increase risk-shifting incentives, while for equity-converting CoCos, it depends on the extent of dilution after conversion. We integrate the analysis in a game-theoretic optimal capital regulation framework and show that use of PWD or insufficiently dilutive CE CoCos requires higher capital requirements for given asset structure to offset the rising risk-shifting incentives these instruments give rise to.
url:770fd3589f7f209a.abstract_zh: 或有可转换资本（CoCo）是一种债务工具，当发行银行未能达到困境阈值时，其转换为股权或被减记。转换增强了发行人的损失吸收能力，但导致CoCo持有者与股东之间的财富转移，这可能改变股东的风险转移激励。更高的风险增加了CoCo转换的概率，同时降低了财富转移。我们证明，对于本金减记型（PWD）CoCo，净效应总是增加风险转移激励，而对于股权转换型CoCo，则取决于转换后的稀释程度。我们将此分析整合进一个博弈论最优资本监管框架中，并表明，在给定资产结构下，使用PWD或稀释不足的CE CoCo需要更高的资本要求，以抵消这些工具引发的不断上升的风险转移激励。

url:78367c09faff9832.abstract: This paper studies the political economy of inflation and real wages using U.S. county-level data on family budget costs, nominal income, and electoral results for President and Congress during this period. Exploiting within-state, cross-county variation in changes in local prices over time, it examines how inflation, real wage growth, and purchasing power relate to changes in vote shares of incumbents, vote margins, and turnout. Real wage decline, rather than higher inflation, is predictive of Republican electoral gains, in line with an economic voting rationale. Inflation, however, retains an association with presidential vote shares beyond pure economic voting.
url:78367c09faff9832.abstract_zh: 本文利用美国县级家庭预算成本、名义收入以及总统和国会选举结果的数据，研究通货膨胀与实际工资的政治经济学。通过利用州内、县际间地方价格随时间变化的差异，本文考察了通货膨胀、实际工资增长及购买力如何与现任者得票份额变化、投票差距及投票率相关联。实际工资下降，而非更高的通货膨胀，预示着共和党在选举中的收益，这与经济投票的逻辑相符。然而，通货膨胀仍与总统得票份额保持关联，超越了纯粹的经济投票因素。

url:7850544a347e76e3.abstract: Weather shocks increasingly threaten agricultural productivity in Sub-Saharan Africa. While the negative effects of drought on production have been documented in numerous studies, the behavioral dimension of adaptation, particularly how households perceive drought and what shapes these perceptions, remains less explored. The study focuses on Uganda to distinguish between self-reported drought (subjective) and data-driven drought (objective) and how their divergence is associated with agricultural outcomes. The study relies on four waves of household surveys (UNPS for 2009/10, 2010/11, 2011/12, and 2013/14) with historical re-analysis data on temperature and precipitation from 1981 to 2015. Log-linear and logit models are applied to estimate the association between drought, perception, and household characteristics on production and drought perception formation. Objective drought is negatively associated with total value of production. Subjective drought perception has a positive association with production. Self-reported drought captures differences in households’ behavioral responses or preparedness, rather than observed weather shocks. Households that underestimate drought conditions tend to exhibit lower production outcomes, while households reporting a drought when this is not observed in objective data tend to maintain their production levels. Access to the Drought Early Warning System (DEWS), technology adoption, higher education levels, farming experience, and greater off-farm assets are positively associated with higher production. Conversely, lower production is associated with a higher share of female labor, female-headed households, and poverty. The results highlight the importance of distinguishing between perceived and observed drought and improving households’ access to timely information to plan adaptation strategies.
url:7850544a347e76e3.abstract_zh: 天气冲击日益威胁撒哈拉以南非洲的农业生产。尽管大量研究已证实干旱对生产的负面影响，但适应行为维度——尤其是家庭如何感知干旱以及影响这些感知的因素——仍鲜有探讨。本研究聚焦乌干达，区分自我报告的干旱（主观）与数据驱动的干旱（客观），并分析两者差异与农业产出的关联。研究采用四轮家庭调查数据（乌干达国家面板调查2009/10、2010/11、2011/12和2013/14年度）及1981至2015年历史再分析气温与降水数据，运用对数线性模型和逻辑模型估计干旱、感知及家庭特征对生产和干旱感知形成的影响。客观干旱与生产总价值呈负相关，而主观干旱感知与生产呈正相关。自我报告的干旱反映的是家庭行为响应或准备程度的差异，而非实际观测到的天气冲击。低估干旱条件的家庭往往产出较低，而在客观数据未显示干旱时报告干旱的家庭则能维持生产水平。获取干旱早期预警系统、采用技术、较高教育水平、务农经验及更多非农资产与更高产出正相关；反之，女性劳动力占比高、女性户主家庭及贫困则与较低产出相关。研究结果凸显区分感知干旱与观测干旱的重要性，并强调需改善家庭获取及时信息的渠道以规划适应策略。

url:78576e1279a2d20b.abstract: With the rise of new industries, often new jobs emerge. Evolutionary Economic Geography and in particular Industry Life Cycle perspectives predict that these activities first emerge in a limited number of cities to then diffuse to other locations as job descriptions become more standardized. Here, we focus on a particularly important new industry: software development, an activity that is economically important, quickly changing, and has a pronounced spatial concentration in a small number of global IT hubs. We use an online database of over 60 million questions and answers about problems in software development that yields a longitudinal dataset of 237 software skills. By geo-locating 3 million posting users at regular intervals, we link these skills to cities worldwide. We find that, in spite of its digital nature, the software industry exhibits similar spatial regularities as previously observed in more traditional sectors. First, cities diversify into skills that are related to their existing ones. Second, new skills first emerge in cities with large and diversified software sectors, and later diffuse -- mostly unhindered by geographical distance -- to smaller cities specialized in closely related skills. We find suggestive but limited support for a windows of locational opportunity account: although even brand-new skills still emerge first in cities with strong prior specialization in related skills, concentrations of related activities impact less the emergence of new skills than the diffusion of existing ones.
url:78576e1279a2d20b.abstract_zh: 随着新兴产业的崛起，新职业往往随之涌现。演化经济地理学，特别是产业生命周期理论预测，这些活动最初会在少数城市出现，随后随着职位描述日趋标准化而扩散至其他地区。本文聚焦于一个尤为重要的新兴产业——软件开发：这一经济活动具有重要经济价值、快速迭代特征，且高度集中于少数全球IT枢纽城市。我们利用一个包含超过6000万条软件开发问题与答案的在线数据库，构建了涵盖237项软件技能的纵向数据集。通过对300万用户进行定期地理定位，我们将这些技能与全球城市相关联。研究发现，尽管软件开发具有数字属性，但其空间分布规律与传统行业高度相似：首先，城市会向与其现有技能相关的领域进行多元化拓展；其次，新技能最初出现在软件产业规模庞大且多元化的城市，随后——基本不受地理距离阻碍——向专精于相近技能的小城市扩散。我们发现了支持"区位机会窗口"理论的初步证据，但该理论解释力有限：尽管全新技能仍优先出现在相关技能基础雄厚的城市，但相关活动的集聚程度对新技能涌现的影响，要弱于对现有技能扩散的影响。

url:78711ce723ca869a.abstract: Using three independent archival sources, we previously documented substantial declines in stunting and wasting in Portugal during the mid-twentieth century. This note revisits the original evidence, clarifies the descriptive scope of our analysis, and situates the observed anthropometric changes within the broader evolution of public health, nutrition, and social policy in Portugal. We show that the timing and magnitude of the declines are robust to the alternative data restrictions and aggregation choices examined here, and that the documented improvements are consistent with contemporaneous expansions in health infrastructure and access documented in the historical record.
url:78711ce723ca869a.abstract_zh: 利用三个独立的档案来源，我们先前记录了二十世纪中叶葡萄牙发育迟缓与消瘦现象的显著下降。本注释重新审视原始证据，明确我们分析的描述性范围，并将观察到的体格测量变化置于葡萄牙公共卫生、营养及社会政策更广泛演变背景中。我们表明，这些下降的时间与幅度对于此处考察的替代数据限制和聚合选择具有稳健性，且记录到的改善与历史记载中同期卫生基础设施及可及性的扩展相一致。

url:78b8b885d7af2de1.abstract: We study the extent to which exposure to COVID-19 relates to healthcare professionals' prosociality. Drawing on empirical evidence from an incentivized experiment and a companion survey of healthcare professionals (HCPs) at a large Italian hospital (N = 194), we find that different forms of exposure to COVID-19 predict their altruistic motivation in heterogeneous ways. HCPs who worked in COVID-19 wards or had a close relative or friend severely affected by the virus are more than 5 percentage points more likely to prioritize patient welfare over personal gain, with the association for professional exposure being mostly driven by female HCPs, especially nurses. Conversely, personally contracting COVID-19 is associated with a 6 percentage point decline in prosociality. Our results highlight that different experiences of need shape prosocial behavior in hospital settings
url:78b8b885d7af2de1.abstract_zh: 我们研究了接触COVID-19与医护人员亲社会性之间的关联程度。基于一项激励性实验及对意大利一家大型医院医护人员（N=194）的配套调查所获得的实证证据，我们发现不同形式的COVID-19接触对其利他动机的预测作用存在异质性。在COVID-19病房工作过或身边有亲属或好友因该病毒而受到严重影响的人员，其将患者福祉置于个人利益之上的可能性高出超过5个百分点，其中职业暴露的关联效应主要由女性医护人员（尤其是护士）驱动。相反，个人感染COVID-19则与亲社会性下降6个百分点相关。我们的研究结果凸显了不同的需求经历如何塑造医院环境中的亲社会行为。

url:78c0eea0857a3daa.abstract: We develop a model in which a manufacturer contracts with hybrid retailers selling both in-store and online. We find that, by eliminating wasteful price dispersion, dual pricing allows the manufacturer to induce the industry monopoly outcome, whereas uniform pricing does not. Despite this, a ban on dual pricing has negative welfare effects if the online market is small, if the offline consumers' search costs are high, and if the monopoly pass-through is high.
url:78c0eea0857a3daa.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中制造商与同时经营实体店和线上渠道的混合零售商签订合同。研究发现，通过消除无谓的价格差异，双重定价能使制造商引导行业达到垄断结果，而统一定价则无法实现。尽管如此，若线上市场规模较小、线下消费者的搜寻成本较高，且垄断传导率较高，则禁止双重定价会对福利产生负面影响。

url:78c9581d130de58c.abstract: We provide empirical evidence that central banks can mitigate economic crises more efficiently when they extend eligibility for their discount facility to any safe asset or solvent agent. Nineteenth-century France serves as case study to circumvent endogeneity. Following 1863, an agricultural pandemic increased defaults outside agriculture. We exploit specificities of the discount window to create exogenous variation in central bank access. Regressions show that while the demand shock brought about by the pandemic led to an increase in defaults outside agriculture by 20 percent, this effect was reduced significantly whenever a branch office of the central bank was present.
url:78c9581d130de58c.abstract_zh: 我们提供的经验证据表明，当中央银行将其贴现窗口的资格扩展至任何安全资产或偿付能力良好的主体时，能更有效地缓解经济危机。以19世纪的法国作为案例研究，以规避内生性问题。1863年后，一场农业疫情导致农业以外的违约增加。我们利用贴现窗口的特性来创造中央银行准入的外生变异。回归分析显示，尽管疫情引发的需求冲击使农业以外的违约增加了20%，但每当中央银行设有分支办事处时，这一效应便显著减弱。

url:78c99daa68feafbe.abstract: We develop a Trend-Cycle Bayesian VAR that jointly estimates the real neutral rate of interest, r_t^*, and identifies monetary policy shocks. A key innovation is that cyclical shocks, notably monetary policy shocks, can affect the trend of macroeconomic variables, providing a way to assess whether transitory disturbances have persistent effects. Using external instruments, we find that contractionary shocks reduce r_t^* and lower trend GDP growth. Although they generate sizable movements, their contribution to the secular decline in r_t^* is modest and slightly positive since the early 1990s. Cross-country evidence shows similar patterns.
url:78c99daa68feafbe.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个趋势-周期贝叶斯向量自回归模型，该模型联合估计实际中性利率r_t^*并识别货币政策冲击。一项关键创新在于，周期性冲击，尤其是货币政策冲击，能够影响宏观经济变量的趋势，从而提供了一种评估暂时性扰动是否具有持久效应的方法。利用外部工具，我们发现紧缩性冲击降低了r_t^*并抑制了趋势GDP增长。尽管这些冲击引发了显著波动，但自1990年代初以来，它们对r_t^*长期下降的贡献较为温和且略呈正向。跨国证据显示了相似的模式。

url:790e6735cf07391e.abstract: This Paper addresses this question by defining the appropriate counterfactual: what would have happened to investing firms if they had not invested abroad. It applies propensity score matching to derive these hypothetical performance trajectories from a sample of national firms which have never invested abroad. For a sample of Italian firms, it finds that investments improve growth of total factor productivity and output. It also finds no significant effects on employment. These results support the view that foreign investments strengthen rather than deplete home activities.
url:790e6735cf07391e.abstract_zh: 本文通过界定恰当的反事实情形来探讨这一问题：若企业未进行对外投资，其境况将会如何。采用倾向得分匹配法，从从未对外投资的国内企业样本中推导出这些假设性的绩效轨迹。针对意大利企业样本的研究发现，对外投资促进了全要素生产率与产出的增长，但对就业未产生显著影响。这些结果支持了对外投资增强而非削弱本国活动的观点。

url:792f0c47ca9c5ff2.abstract: This paper develops and tests a life-cycle hypothesis of sleep investment. Motivated by evidence from psychology, aging, and sleep research that the consequences of insufficient sleep become increasingly severe with age, we argue that individuals facing stronger productivity incentives should increasingly preserve sleep as they age. We formalize this idea in a simple life-cycle framework in which sleep is a productive activity that competes with work and leisure for time. We test the framework using longitudinal data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health (Add Health). We focus on adolescent physical attractiveness and college education as two characteristics associated with occupational sorting and long-run productivity incentives. While both characteristics exhibit little association with sleep duration in early adulthood, their relationships with sleep become increasingly positive over the life cycle. Attractive individuals and college graduates experience substantially less negative declines in sleep duration with age and increasingly sleep longer relative to their counterparts in later adulthood. Additional analyses show that these patterns are strongest among workers and are not readily explained by mental health, sleep difficulties, social participation, or reverse causality through sleep affecting later attractiveness. More broadly, the findings suggest that differences in long-run productivity incentives contribute to divergent sleep trajectories over adulthood and support a life-cycle perspective on sleep investment.
url:792f0c47ca9c5ff2.abstract_zh: 本文构建并检验了睡眠投资的生命周期假说。基于心理学、老龄化及睡眠研究中的证据——睡眠不足的后果随年龄增长而日益严重——我们认为，面临更强生产力激励的个体应随年龄增长而愈发注重保持睡眠。我们在一个简洁的生命周期框架中形式化这一观点，其中睡眠被视为一种生产性活动，与工作和闲暇争夺时间。我们利用全国青少年至成人健康纵向研究（Add Health）的数据对该框架进行检验，重点关注青少年时期的外貌吸引力和大学教育这两个与职业分流及长期生产力激励相关的特征。尽管这两个特征在成年早期与睡眠时长几乎无关联，但它们与睡眠的关系在生命周期中逐渐转为正向。外貌吸引力较高者及大学毕业生在年龄增长过程中睡眠时长的下降幅度显著较小，并在成年后期相对于其对照群体睡眠时间日益延长。进一步分析显示，这些模式在工作者中最为显著，且无法由心理健康、睡眠障碍、社会参与或睡眠反向影响后期外貌的因果倒置所充分解释。更广泛地，研究结果表明，长期生产力激励的差异促成了成年期睡眠轨迹的分化，并支持了睡眠投资的生命周期视角。
url:792f0c47ca9c5ff2.title: Sleeping Investment: A Life-Cycle Hypothesis
url:792f0c47ca9c5ff2.title_zh: 沉睡的投资：生命周期假说

url:793efedb7db52056.abstract: This paper explores factors driving the internationalization of Renminbi (RMB) trading, using data from the 2025 BIS Triennial Survey of global foreign exchange turnover. We analyze both short-term (three-year) trading growth and long-term RMB turnover levels across jurisdictions. Unlike recent studies that struggled to identify sizable effects of real or financial links with China, we find that financial factors, especially banking links with China, play a key role, even over short horizons. These financial links reinforce market-driven "convergence" patterns, whereby RMB trading adjusts based on its under- or over-representation in total currency trading in a given location. However, this convergence is slower than previously reported, while financial drivers have grown in importance. For the long-term geographical distribution of RMB trading, financial links with China, including policy-driven variables such as qualified investor licenses, dominate, though trade links also contribute significantly. We also find that bilateral trade effects are stronger for cross-border RMB trading, and we report new insights on the dynamics in Asian financial centers and trading in spot versus derivatives.
url:793efedb7db52056.abstract_zh: 本文利用2025年国际清算银行（BIS）三年期全球外汇交易调查数据，探讨推动人民币交易国际化的因素。我们分析了各司法管辖区的短期（三年）交易增长与长期人民币交易规模。与近期难以识别与中国实体或金融联系显著影响的研究不同，我们发现金融因素（尤其是与中国的银行联系）发挥着关键作用，即便在短期视角下也是如此。这些金融联系强化了市场驱动的“趋同”模式，即人民币交易会根据其在特定地区总货币交易中的占比不足或过度情况进行调整。然而，这种趋同速度较此前报告更为缓慢，而金融驱动因素的重要性则日益增强。就人民币交易的长期地理分布而言，与中国的金融联系（包括合格投资者牌照等政策驱动变量）占据主导地位，尽管贸易联系也贡献显著。我们还发现，双边贸易效应对跨境人民币交易的影响更为强烈，并报告了关于亚洲金融中心动态以及即期与衍生品交易的新见解。

For the long-term geographical distribution of RMB trading, financial links with China, including policy-driven variables such as qualified investor licenses, dominate, though trade links also contribute significantly. We also find that bilateral trade effects are stronger for cross-border RMB trading, and we report new insights on the dynamics in Asian financial centers and trading in spot versus derivatives.
url:793efedb7db52056.title_zh: 本文利用2025年国际清算银行三年期全球外汇交易调查数据，探讨推动人民币交易国际化的因素。我们分析了各司法管辖区人民币交易的短期（三年）增长与长期交易规模。与近期难以发现与中国实体或金融联系具有显著影响的研究不同，我们发现金融因素（尤其是与中国的银行联系）即使在短期内也发挥关键作用。这些金融联系强化了市场驱动的“趋同”模式，即人民币交易根据其在特定地区总货币交易中的占比偏低或偏高进行调整。然而，这种趋同速度慢于此前报告，而金融驱动因素的重要性有所上升。就人民币交易的长期地理分布而言，与中国的金融联系（包括合格投资者牌照等政策驱动变量）占据主导地位，但贸易联系也贡献显著。我们还发现，双边贸易效应对跨境人民币交易更为显著，并报告了关于亚洲金融中心动态以及即期与衍生品交易的新见解。

url:79439c17f959471b.title: The Effect of University Science on Corporate Innovation
url:79439c17f959471b.title_zh: 大学科学对企业创新的影响

url:794696d9c5c38421.abstract: Motivated by increasing threats to pollinator health and increasing pollination contract fees, we develop a simulation model for the honey bee pollination and honey production market. The model, calibrated using 2015 and 2016 data, incorporates population dynamics, 15 crops, and transportation of managed honey bee colonies across several states. In our model, forage that bees need is particularly scarce, and further increases in almond acreage will have little effect on the fees paid for pollination services. However, increases in bees’ winter mortality will lead to increases in early-season pollination fees and declines in late-season fees. JEL Q11
url:794696d9c5c38421.abstract_zh: 受传粉者健康威胁日益加剧及授粉合同费用不断上升的驱动，我们构建了一个模拟模型，用以分析蜜蜂授粉与蜂蜜生产市场。该模型基于2015年和2016年的数据进行校准，整合了种群动态、15种作物以及跨州管理的蜜蜂蜂群运输情况。在我们的模型中，蜜蜂所需的蜜源植物尤为稀缺，而杏仁种植面积的进一步扩大对授粉服务费用影响甚微。然而，蜜蜂冬季死亡率的上升将导致早季授粉费用增加，而晚季费用则下降。JEL分类号：Q11
url:794696d9c5c38421.title: Honey Bees, Almonds, and Colony Mortality: An Economic Simulation of the U.S. Pollination Market
url:794696d9c5c38421.title_zh: 蜜蜂、杏仁与蜂群死亡率：美国授粉市场的经济模拟

url:794c28a72a175840.abstract: This paper assesses whether recent global developments have created an opportunity for the euro to expand its international role. Progress in the euro’s internationalization has been mixed — falling short of optimists’ hopes of dethroning the dollar while exceeding skeptics’ predictions of failure. Though the euro has not surpassed the combined global share of its legacy currencies, it has outperformed earlier challengers to the dollar, such as the Deutsche mark and Japanese yen at their peak internationalization in the 1990s, and it remains significantly ahead of the renminbi today. Recent developments in the U.S — concerns over its economic stability, growth prospects, and reliability as a global partner — have intensified scrutiny of the dollar’s safe haven status, potentially creating an opportunity for the euro to gain ground globally. To capitalize on this opening, Europe must strengthen its economic foundations, conclude new trade agreements and enhance its cross-border payment infrastructure with key trading partners, so as to bolster trade invoicing in euro. Fostering pan-European markets for equities, corporate bonds, and securitizations would boost liquidity and scale, enhancing the euro’s appeal as a global financing and investment currency. And establishing a unified euro-denominated safe asset to finance public goods such as defense, while bolstering Europe’s geopolitical credibility, would be critical to achieving these goals.
url:794c28a72a175840.abstract_zh: 本文评估了近期全球发展是否已为欧元扩大其国际角色创造了机遇。欧元国际化的进展喜忧参半——既未达到乐观者所期望的取代美元地位，也超出了怀疑者对其失败的预测。尽管欧元尚未超越其前身货币的全球合计份额，但它已优于早先对美元的挑战者，如20世纪90年代国际化巅峰时期的德国马克和日元，并且至今仍显著领先于人民币。美国近期的发展——对其经济稳定性、增长前景及作为全球伙伴可靠性的担忧——加剧了对美元避险地位的审视，这可能为欧元在全球范围内扩大影响力创造契机。为抓住这一机遇，欧洲必须夯实经济基础，缔结新的贸易协定，并加强与主要贸易伙伴的跨境支付基础设施，以促进欧元在贸易计价中的使用。培育泛欧洲的股票、公司债券及证券化市场将提升流动性与规模，增强欧元作为全球融资和投资货币的吸引力。此外，建立以欧元计价的统一安全资产，用于资助国防等公共产品，同时增强欧洲的地缘政治信誉，对于实现这些目标至关重要。
url:794c28a72a175840.title: An Opening for the Euro

url:7969da188ec33060.abstract: We study opinion dynamics in a social network consisting of two groups. Agents update their opinions by conforming to members of their own group while rejecting the views of the opposing group (affective polarization), and by listening to a media outlet that may provide biased information.
url:7969da188ec33060.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个由两个群体组成的社会网络中的观点动态。个体通过遵循本群体成员的意见并排斥对立群体的观点（情感极化）来更新自己的看法，同时也会听取可能提供有偏信息的媒体渠道。
url:7969da188ec33060.title: Affective Polarization, Media Outlets, and Opinion Dynamics
url:7969da188ec33060.title_zh: 情感极化、媒体渠道与舆论动态

url:796e13ac47d11045.abstract: How do international investors adjust portfolios in response to biodiversity risk? Using monthly data on investment fund portfolios, we show that the 2021 Kunming Declaration led fund managers to reallocate portfolios from high-biodiversity risk countries to less risky ones, while ultimate fund investors remained unresponsive. Fund managers reduced exposures to extremely high biodiversity risk without seizing low biodiversity risk as an opportunity for profit, characterizing biodiversity as downside risk factor. Investment funds drive cross-country spillovers as the reallocation triggers significant capital flows beneï¬ ting countries in the same geographic region, but outside of a fund
url:796e13ac47d11045.abstract_zh: 国际投资者如何根据生物多样性风险调整投资组合？利用投资基金的月度组合数据，我们发现2021年《昆明宣言》促使基金经理将投资组合从高生物多样性风险国家重新配置至风险较低的国家，而最终基金投资者对此并未作出反应。基金经理减少了极端高生物多样性风险的敞口，但并未将低生物多样性风险视为盈利机会，从而将生物多样性定性为下行风险因素。投资基金通过这种重新配置引发了显著的资本流动，使同一地理区域内但基金所在国以外的国家受益，从而推动了跨国溢出效应。

url:79708ae0ac197a1b.title: What's the worth of a promise? Evaluating the long‐term effects of a programme to reduce early marriage in India
url:79708ae0ac197a1b.title_zh: 承诺的价值何在？评估印度减少早婚项目的长期效果

url:7971b20ebc979edd.abstract: Public procurement of innovation (PPI) is widely regarded as a powerful demand-side policy instrument to stimulate innovation, but its role in shaping regional technological diversification remains unclear. Drawing on evolutionary economic geography, this study examines how PPI affects technological diversification under different spatial sourcing strategies. Using 2.24 million procurement contracts and 2.41 million patents from China (2016-2021), we find that PPI facilitates path-breaking diversification, but mainly through non-local procurement. Compared with local procurement, non-local procurement is more conducive to path-breaking diversification in purchasing regions, while its benefits do not spill over symmetrically to supplying regions. By reconceptualizing PPI as a spatially embedded and relational mechanism, this study extends evolutionary accounts of regional diversification beyond a purely territorial lens and highlights how the spatial organization of public demand shapes uneven opportunities for regional technological development.
url:7971b20ebc979edd.abstract_zh: 创新导向的公共采购（PPI）被广泛视为刺激创新的强大需求侧政策工具，但其在塑造区域技术多样化方面的作用仍不明确。借鉴演化经济地理学，本研究考察了在不同空间采购策略下，PPI如何影响技术多样化。利用中国2016至2021年间224万份采购合同和241万项专利数据，我们发现PPI促进了突破性多样化，但主要通过非本地采购实现。与本地采购相比，非本地采购更有利于采购区域的突破性多样化，而其益处并未对称地溢出至供应区域。通过将PPI重新概念化为一种空间嵌入且关系性的机制，本研究将区域多样化的演化解释拓展至纯粹地域视角之外，并强调了公共需求的空间组织如何塑造区域技术发展的不均等机会。
url:7971b20ebc979edd.title: Public Procurement of Innovation and Regional Technological Diversification. The Role of Local and Non-local Sourcing in China
url:7971b20ebc979edd.title_zh: 公共采购促进创新与区域技术多样化：中国本地与非本地采购的作用

url:7974ec3b01d03317.abstract: We investigate a model of liquidity sources that incorporates a general equilibrium feature of liquidity: when banks hold more liquidity, other sectors of the economy hold less of it and will consequently supply less in times of crisis. The private allocation of liquidity is inefficient and optimal liquidity regulation depends on the source of liquidity to which it is applied. Our model also identifies a limited role for public provision of liquidity, arising only when there is a general liquidity shortage in the economy but not if the shortage materializes solely in the banking system.
url:7974ec3b01d03317.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含流动性一般均衡特征的流动性来源模型：当银行持有更多流动性时，经济中其他部门持有的流动性减少，因此在危机时期供应的流动性也会减少。私人流动性配置效率低下，最优流动性监管取决于其适用的流动性来源。我们的模型还识别了公共流动性供给的有限作用，这种作用仅在整体经济出现流动性短缺时显现，而如果短缺仅发生在银行体系中则不会出现。
url:7974ec3b01d03317.title: Sources of Liquidity and Liquidity Shortages
url:7974ec3b01d03317.title_zh: 流动性来源与流动性短缺

url:797b4c86765ea560.title: The hold-up problem with flexible unobservable investments
url:797b4c86765ea560.title_zh: 灵活不可观测投资下的敲竹杠问题

url:799118cc99e7f9b4.abstract: This paper presents new monthly capital gain, dividend yield, and total return indices for common equities quoted on British exchanges during 1869-1929. I construct indices for 25 domestic sectors, calculate capital asset pricing model betas for each sector, and construct a 30-stock blue chip index. I splice the new broad market index to Turner et al.’s (2009) pre-1870 index to create a century-long (1825-1929) monthly equity index. I use the new indices to examine the timing of British business cycles and compare the returns on home and foreign UK investment during 1870-1929.
url:799118cc99e7f9b4.abstract_zh: 本文呈现了1869-1929年间英国交易所上市普通股的新月度资本利得、股息收益率及总回报指数。我为25个国内行业构建了指数，计算了各行业的资本资产定价模型贝塔值，并构建了一个包含30只股票的蓝筹股指数。我将新的广义市场指数与特纳等人（2009）的1870年前指数拼接，形成了一个长达一个世纪（1825-1929年）的月度股票指数。利用这些新指数，我考察了英国商业周期的时点，并比较了1870-1929年间英国本土与海外投资的回报情况。
url:799118cc99e7f9b4.title: Stocks for the Long Run: New Monthly Indices of British Equities, 1869-1929
url:799118cc99e7f9b4.title_zh: 长期持有股票：1869-1929年英国股票新月度指数

url:799449edb36f6b09.title: Can Innovation Policies Enhance Export Sophistication? Evidence From China
url:799449edb36f6b09.title_zh: 创新政策能否提升出口复杂度？来自中国的证据

url:7999f62e621f14c2.abstract: This paper studies how individual risk attitudes shape occupational choice and wealth accumulation. Using self-reported individual risk preferences from the German Socioeconomic Panel (GSOEP), we estimate that an increase in risk tolerance raises the probability of a worker transitioning to self-employment. We also develop a life-cycle model of occupational choice with Epstein-Zin preferences and heterogeneous risk attitudes to study how risk aversion interacts with entrepreneurial ability and wealth in determining entry into self-employment and its aggregate implications. Counterfactual simulations show that increasing business risk reduces entry but improves selection by entrepreneurial skills. In contrast, Germany’s “1-Euro GmbH” reform of 2008 weakened the role of risk tolerance for entry and increased participation by more risk-averse individuals.
url:7999f62e621f14c2.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了个人风险态度如何影响职业选择与财富积累。利用德国社会经济面板（GSOEP）中自我报告的个人风险偏好数据，我们估计出风险容忍度的提升会增加工人转向自主创业的概率。同时，我们构建了一个包含Epstein-Zin偏好及异质性风险态度的生命周期职业选择模型，以研究风险厌恶如何与创业能力及财富相互作用，决定进入自主创业的决策及其总体影响。反事实模拟显示，增加商业风险会降低进入率，但能通过创业技能改善选择质量。相比之下，德国2008年的“1欧元有限责任公司”改革削弱了风险容忍度对进入决策的作用，并增加了更风险厌恶个体的参与度。
url:7999f62e621f14c2.title: Heterogeneous Risk Preferences, Entrepreneurship, and Wealth
url:7999f62e621f14c2.title_zh: 异质性风险偏好、创业与财富

url:79aa4d5104723474.abstract: IMF borrowers have demonstrated a very strong track record of timely repayments to the IMF since the 1990s—indeed, no new episodes of protracted overdue financial obligations (OFOs) have occurred since 2001. This represents a marked improvement from the experience of the 1980s and early 1990s. Through quantitative modeling we find that countries’ international reserves coverage of debt service due to the IMF and other creditors, external debt levels, macroeconomic conditions, and broad institutional strength played key roles in distinguishing between past cases with timely repayments and those with protracted arrears. However, we also find that policy reforms and changes in other qualitative factors since the 1990s weakened the relationship between quantitative indicators of repayment capacity and the likelihood of protracted arrears episodes. While stronger macroeconomic and institutional fundamentals of borrowers have contributed to greater timeliness of repayments, a large portion of the improvement remains unexplained by country-specific factors. The timing of this improvement is consistent with implementation of a cooperative strategy on OFOs and other policies that have incentivized cooperation and mitigated “residual” risks on IMF lending relative to the underlying fundamentals of borrowers.
url:79aa4d5104723474.abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，国际货币基金组织（IMF）借款人在按时还款方面表现出色——事实上，自2001年以来未再出现新的长期逾期债务（OFOs）事件。这与20世纪80年代及90年代初的情况相比有了显著改善。通过定量建模，我们发现，各国对IMF及其他债权人到期债务的国际储备覆盖率、外债水平、宏观经济状况以及广泛的制度实力，是区分过去按时还款案例与长期拖欠案例的关键因素。然而，我们也发现，自20世纪90年代以来的政策改革及其他定性因素的变化，削弱了还款能力的定量指标与长期拖欠事件发生概率之间的关系。尽管借款人更强的宏观经济和制度基础有助于提高还款及时性，但大部分改善仍无法用国家特定因素解释。这一改善的时间点与OFOs合作策略及其他政策的实施相吻合——这些政策激励了合作，并相对于借款人的基本面因素，降低了IMF贷款中的“残余”风险。
url:79aa4d5104723474.title: What Explains Timely Repayments to the IMF? The Roles of Policy Reforms and Borrower Fundamentals
url:79aa4d5104723474.title_zh: 国际货币基金组织及时还款的解释：政策改革与借款国基本面的作用

url:79ab861752cd8e5b.abstract: Many decisions are taken jointly by multiple individuals. When outcomes are uncertain, decision-makers may have different subjective expectations (“beliefs”) about the consequences of different choices. We develop a tractable empirical framework for identifying the relative influence of joint decision-makers’ beliefs without assuming Pareto optimality when beliefs differ. We apply the framework to contraceptive choices in Nigeria, examining the relative weight couples place on wives’ versus husbands’ beliefs. We find that spouses have different subjective expectations, and that the weight placed on each spouse’s beliefs varies across domains. Therefore, the optimal targeting of information interventions to husbands or wives is domain-dependent.
url:79ab861752cd8e5b.abstract_zh: 许多决策由多人共同作出。当结果不确定时，决策者可能对不同选择的后果持有不同的主观预期（“信念”）。我们开发了一个易于处理的实证框架，用于识别联合决策者信念的相对影响力，无需在信念差异时假设帕累托最优。我们将该框架应用于尼日利亚的避孕选择，考察夫妻对妻子与丈夫信念的相对权重。我们发现配偶双方持有不同的主观预期，且对每位配偶信念的权重在不同领域间有所变化。因此，信息干预措施针对丈夫或妻子的最优定向取决于具体领域。
url:79ab861752cd8e5b.title: DP21887 Subjective Expectations of Husbands and Wives and Couples’ Decision-Making Under Uncertainty
url:79ab861752cd8e5b.title_zh: DP21887 丈夫与妻子的主观预期及不确定性下的夫妻决策

url:79dbc1aaaa017ed0.abstract: The sequence-space Jacobian (SSJ) method of Auclert et al. (2021a) has made heterogeneous-agent models far easier to solve, fueling an explosion of applications. But even SSJ strains against capacity constraints when state spaces grow very large, as in economies with overlapping generations of heterogeneous agents (HA-OLG). We show how to exploit the special properties of age—finite planning horizons and deterministic transitions between ages—to compute the Jacobians of a general class of HA-OLG models orders of magnitude faster. We provide rigorous proofs, age-specific Jacobians that decompose aggregate dynamics across cohorts, an application to the dynamic general-equilibrium effects of secularly declining birth rates, and an accessible cookbook for adopting our method.
url:79dbc1aaaa017ed0.abstract_zh: Auclert等人（2021a）提出的序列空间雅可比（SSJ）方法显著简化了异质性主体模型的求解过程，推动了相关应用的爆发式增长。然而，当状态空间规模极大时（例如在包含异质性主体的世代交叠（HA-OLG）经济中），SSJ方法仍面临计算容量约束。我们通过利用年龄的特殊性质——有限规划期与年龄间的确定性转移——将通用HA-OLG模型类别的雅可比矩阵计算速度提升数个数量级。本文提供严格的理论证明、可分解跨队列总体动态的年龄特异性雅可比矩阵、针对长期出生率下降的动态一般均衡效应的应用分析，以及便于采用本方法的实用指南。
url:79dbc1aaaa017ed0.title: Sequence-Space Jacobians of Life-Cycle Models
url:79dbc1aaaa017ed0.title_zh: 生命周期模型的序列空间雅可比矩阵

url:79eea587ff3071f9.abstract: A major claim for the benefits of locational marginal pricing (LMP) in electricity markets has related to increased efficiency in locational investment decisions. However, there has to date been little empirical evidence for this claim. Using a very large dataset of more than 1000 new plant investments in PJM over more than 20 years, we test whether LMPs have shaped investment decisions using quartiles and logistical regression techniques. We show that LMPs and locational capacity prices have been statistic ally significant in relation to where investments in solar and gas-fired generation across PJM, but not for wind generation. We also show that on an intrazonal basis LMP differences appear significant with respect to locational investment decisions for new solar generation within the Dominion zone of PJM. Finally, we note that while LMPs over longer periods of time are difficult to predict as they reflect natural gas prices and other economic variables, LMP basis differentials to a small number of traded hubs are much more predictable, consistent with new generators being able to hedge most price risks at a small number of traded hub prices.
url:79eea587ff3071f9.abstract_zh: 电力市场节点边际电价（LMP）的一大优势主张与其在提升区位投资决策效率方面的作用相关。然而，迄今为止，关于这一主张的经验证据尚显匮乏。本研究利用PJM市场超过20年间1000多个新建电厂投资的大型数据集，通过四分位数和逻辑回归技术，检验LMP是否影响了投资决策。结果显示，LMP及区位容量价格在PJM区域内对太阳能和燃气发电的投资选址具有统计学上的显著影响，但对风电投资则不然。此外，在PJM的Dominion区域内，对于新建太阳能发电的区位投资决策，区内LMP差异表现出显著相关性。最后，我们指出，尽管长期LMP因反映天然气价格及其他经济变量而难以预测，但相对于少数交易枢纽的LMP基差差异则更具可预测性，这与新建发电商能够通过少数交易枢纽价格对冲大部分价格风险的情况相符。
url:79eea587ff3071f9.title: Does Generation Investment Follow Locational Price Signals? Long-term Evidence from the PJM Electricity Market
url:79eea587ff3071f9.title_zh: 发电投资是否遵循位置价格信号？来自PJM电力市场的长期证据

url:79f108f9b488d5a3.title: On the Optimality of Full Disclosure

url:79f81faafee14aa1.abstract: Adolescence and young adulthood are sensitive periods for the development of mental distress, and timely support can prevent early signs of distress from escalating. This review examines the effectiveness of early intervention and secondary prevention approaches for supporting the mental health and wellbeing of young people and rangatahi aged 12-24 years, with a particular focus on those experiencing low to moderate distress. The review draws on a structured scan of published and grey literature, identifying 20 evaluation papers covering 16 interventions across therapy-based brief interventions, community-based services, e-therapy, digital tools, and family-integrated approaches. Overall, the evidence suggests that many early intervention and secondary prevention supports, including brief and low-intensity approaches, can reduce distress and improve wellbeing, functioning, and coping. Effects were most consistent for broad outcomes such as distress, wellbeing, and functioning, while findings for anxiety and depressive symptoms were more mixed. Accessibility, youth-friendly delivery, sustained engagement, and co-design with young people emerged as important enablers of effectiveness. Culturally appropriate, co-designed, and Indigenous-led approaches also appear important for improving acceptability and engagement for rangatahi Māori. However, the evidence base remains uneven, with a need for stronger evaluation of what works best, for whom, and under what delivery conditions.
url:79f81faafee14aa1.abstract_zh: 青春期和成年初期是心理困扰发展的敏感时期，及时的支持可以防止早期困扰症状升级。本综述评估了早期干预和二级预防方法对支持12-24岁青少年及毛利青年心理健康与福祉的有效性，特别关注那些经历轻中度困扰的群体。研究基于对已发表文献和灰色文献的结构化扫描，识别出20篇评估论文，涵盖16项干预措施，涉及基于治疗的简短干预、社区服务、电子治疗、数字工具及家庭整合方法。总体而言，证据表明许多早期干预和二级预防支持措施（包括简短和低强度方法）能够减轻困扰、改善福祉、功能及应对能力。对于困扰、福祉和功能等广泛结局，效果最为一致，而焦虑和抑郁症状的发现则更为复杂。可及性、青年友好型服务提供、持续参与以及与青年共同设计成为有效性的重要促进因素。文化适宜、共同设计及原住民主导的方法对于提高毛利青年的接受度和参与度也显得尤为重要。然而，证据基础仍不均衡，需要更有力的评估来明确何种干预措施最有效、适用于哪些人群以及在何种服务条件下实施。

url:7a1027f31c360b28.abstract: We develop a state-space framework that jointly estimates central bank credibility as a scalar latent variable and the associated time-varying monetary policy reaction function. The Kalman filter extracts an unobservable credibility index from observed inflation expectations, while Recursive Least Squares continuously updates the reaction function coefficients using the Kalman innovations sequence, ensuring that parameter estimation operates on long-run trend components rather than transitory fluctuations. Under standard regularity conditions, we establish consistency of the credibility estimator and show that the reaction function coefficients attain the Cramer-Rao bound when the innovation variance is constant; a GLS variant achieves efficiency in the heteroskedastic case. url:7a1027f31c360b28.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个状态空间框架，用于联合估计作为标量潜变量的中央银行可信度及其相关的时变货币政策反应函数。卡尔曼滤波器从观测到的通胀预期中提取不可观测的可信度指数，而递归最小二乘法利用卡尔曼创新序列持续更新反应函数系数，确保参数估计基于长期趋势成分而非暂时性波动。在标准正则性条件下，我们建立了可信度估计量的一致性，并证明当创新方差恒定时，反应函数系数达到克拉美-罗下界；在异方差情况下，广义最小二乘变体实现了有效性。将该框架应用于2002-2024年期间的墨西哥银行，我们识别出四个不同的可信度阶段：采用通胀目标制后的巩固阶段（2002-2008年）、全球金融危机期间的暂时冲击（2008-2009年）、持续的高可信度均衡（2010-2020年），以及与疫情后通胀相关的压力阶段（2021-2023年）及随后的部分恢复。时变反应系数揭示出墨西哥银行

url:7a7db1e7b86706a2.abstract: This paper studies interdependent durations as equilibrium outcomes of a synchronization game, a continuous-time stopping game in which the incentive to stop increases when other players stop. We allow the payoffs to vary with both common shocks and observed and unobserved agent characteristics. The common shocks follow a spectrally negative Lévy process, a semiparametric process that includes Brownian motion as a special case but may also have jumps. We show that equilibrium outcomes can be represented as interdependent hitting times and use this to establish the game's nonparametric identification from data on stopping times and covariates. We develop maximum simulated likelihood and method of simulated moments estimators and evaluate their finite-sample and computational performance in Monte Carlo experiments. The results provide a tractable framework for identifying and estimating synchronization games from interdependent duration data.
url:7a7db1e7b86706a2.abstract_zh: 本文研究同步博弈均衡结果中的相互依存持续时间，该博弈是一种连续时间停止博弈，其中当其他参与者停止时，个体停止的激励会增强。我们允许收益随共同冲击以及观测和未观测到的个体特征而变化。共同冲击遵循谱负Lévy过程，这是一种半参数过程，布朗运动是其特例，但该过程也可能包含跳跃。我们证明均衡结果可表示为相互依存的首次通过时间，并据此建立该博弈基于停止时间与协变量数据的非参数识别方法。我们开发了最大模拟似然估计量和模拟矩方法估计量，并通过蒙特卡洛实验评估其有限样本表现与计算性能。研究结果为基于相互依存持续时间数据识别和估计同步博弈提供了可操作的框架。

url:7ae2bce598a8529d.abstract: This Paper analyses the relationship between different equity rules and the incentives to sign and ratify a climate agreement. A widespread conjecture suggests that a more equitable distribution of the burden of reducing emissions would enhance the incentives for more countries ? particularly big emitters ? to accept an emission reduction scheme defined within an international climate agreement. This Paper shows that this conjecture is only partly supported by the empirical evidence that can be derived from the recent outcomes of climate negotiations. Even though an equitable sharing of the costs of controlling GHG emissions can provide better incentives to sign and ratify a climate agreement than the burden sharing implicit in the Kyoto agreement, a stable global agreement cannot be achieved. A possible strategy to achieve a global agreement without free-riding incentives is a policy mix in which global emission trading is coupled with a transfer mechanism designed to offset incentives to free ride.
url:7ae2bce598a8529d.abstract_zh: 本文分析了不同公平规则与签署及批准气候协议激励之间的关系。一种普遍观点认为，更公平地分配减排负担将增强更多国家（尤其是主要排放国）接受国际气候协议中减排方案的意愿。本文表明，这一观点仅部分得到近期气候谈判结果所揭示的经验证据支持。尽管公平分担温室气体排放控制成本比《京都议定书》中隐含的负担分摊更能激励各国签署和批准气候协议，但稳定的全球协议仍难以实现。实现无搭便车激励的全球协议的可能策略是采取政策组合：将全球排放交易与旨在抵消搭便车激励的转移机制相结合。

url:7b48c381e157c9cf.abstract: This paper studies how financial conditions affect research and development (R&D) by firms specialized in green innovation. Using U.S. patent data matched with Compustat, we identify “green innovators” as firms with a high cumulative share of green patents. Although they account for a small share of total green patenting, these firms occupy central positions in the green-innovation ecosystem. Estimating firm-level impulse responses to exogenous changes in broad financial conditions, we find that tightening has a disproportionately large and persistent negative effect on the R&D of specialized green innovators. In contrast, R&D by diversified innovators and non-innovators responds only weakly. Green innovators are younger, smaller, and more dependent on external finance, suggesting that financial tightening introduces a systematic bias against upstream green technological development.
url:7b48c381e157c9cf.abstract_zh: 本文研究金融状况如何影响专注于绿色创新的企业的研发活动。通过将美国专利数据与Compustat数据库匹配，我们将“绿色创新者”定义为绿色专利累计占比高的企业。尽管这些企业在绿色专利总量中占比很小，但它们处于绿色创新生态系统的核心位置。通过估计企业层面对外生广义金融状况变化的脉冲响应，我们发现金融紧缩对专业化绿色创新企业的研发产生了不成比例的大幅且持续的负面效应。相比之下，多元化创新者和非创新者的研发反应较弱。绿色创新者通常更年轻、规模更小且更依赖外部融资，这表明金融紧缩对上游绿色技术发展引入了系统性偏差。

url:7b6fa3766872a515.abstract: This paper studies formal employment dynamics using linked employer-employee data from eight countries spanning a wide income range from Kenya to Chile. First, we show that formality rates increase with development, both between and within countries, because more workers enter the formal sector, not because they spend more time in formal jobs. Second, formal labor market fluidity increases with development, as workers hold more formal jobs, spend less time in each job, and less time between jobs. Third, greater fluidity is associated with higher life-cycle wage growth, which is largely accounted for by within- rather than between-firm wage gains.
url:7b6fa3766872a515.abstract_zh: 本文利用涵盖从肯尼亚到智利等八个收入水平差异显著国家的关联雇主-雇员数据，研究正规就业的动态变化。首先，我们发现正规就业率随经济发展而上升，这一趋势既体现在国家间也体现在国家内部，其原因是更多劳动者进入正规部门，而非他们在正规岗位上的工作时间延长。其次，正规劳动力市场的流动性随经济发展而增强，表现为劳动者从事更多正规工作、每份工作持续时间缩短、以及工作转换间隔时间减少。第三，更高的流动性伴随着更显著的职业生涯工资增长，这主要归因于企业内部而非企业间的工资提升。

url:7b7952ab23f3d9b5.abstract: The German universal long-term care (LTC) insurance program offers beneficiaries the choice between in-kind services and a cash benefit, which can be used for anything, including informal care. The optimal level of the cash benefit depends on substitution between formal and informal care options, the cost of public funds, and distributional considerations. To evaluate various policy options, we estimate a random-coefficients demand model for the period 1999-2015 using data on the universe of LTC patients supplemented with micro moments from the German Mikrozensus. Results show strong heterogeneity in patient preferences for the three different LTC options: informal, ambulatory and stationary care. A counterfactual analysis predicts that abolishing the cash subsidy leads to a decline in patient surplus that far outweighs the savings in public expenditure. It suggests that many countries could benefit from the introduction of a cash subsidy option for LTC.
url:7b7952ab23f3d9b5.abstract_zh: 德国普遍性长期护理（LTC）保险计划为受益人提供了两种选择：实物服务或现金补贴，后者可用于任何用途，包括非正式护理。现金补贴的最优水平取决于正式与非正式护理选项之间的替代关系、公共资金的成本以及分配考量。为评估各种政策选项，我们利用1999-2015年间覆盖所有长期护理患者的数据，并结合德国微观人口普查的微观矩，估计了一个随机系数需求模型。结果显示，患者对三种不同的长期护理选项——非正式护理、门诊护理和住院护理——存在显著的偏好异质性。反事实分析预测，取消现金补贴将导致患者剩余下降，其幅度远超公共支出的节省。这表明，许多国家可能从引入长期护理现金补贴选项中受益。

url:7c7925eb1f578a3a.abstract: The bibliometric analysis delves into the progression and influence of research concerning the quality of tourism, emphasizing the patterns, inputs, and thematic advancements within the domain. According to the study, conference papers provide a lesser percentage of insightful material than journal articles, which indicates a strong emphasis on peer-reviewed research and accounts for the majority of relevant literature. Since 1983, the field of study has changed dramatically. Notable growth began in the late 1990s and peaked in the most recent years, indicating a rise in scholarly interest in high-quality tourism. Important journals like "The Journal of Quality Assurance in Hospitality and Tourism," "Sustainability Switzerland," and "Tourism Management," are crucial in influencing the conversation. Keywords that stand out are "quality of life," "tourism," and "sustainability," with an emphasis on global viewpoints, particularly as they relate to China. The field has advanced thanks to significant contributions from people like Carneiro, Eusébio, and Uysal as well as organizations like Universidade Q9 and the Hong Kong Polytechnic University. Strong international cooperation is highlighted by the citation network, which shows strong connections between China, the United States, the United Kingdom, Spain, and Portugal. The study emphasizes a multidisciplinary strategy that integrates environmental and managerial factors into the quality of tourism. Although the study offers a thorough overview, its limitations include methodological issues, temporal and linguistic biases, and dependence on particular data sources. All things considered, the analysis presents a vibrant and cooperative field characterized by significant scholarly involvement and an increasing focus on sustainability and interdisciplinary research.
url:7c7925eb1f578a3a.abstract_zh: 文献计量分析深入探讨了旅游质量研究的进展与影响力，重点关注该领域的模式、投入及主题演进。研究表明，会议论文提供的洞察性材料占比低于期刊论文，这表明同行评审研究受到高度重视，并构成了相关文献的主体。自1983年以来，该研究领域发生了显著变化。显著增长始于20世纪90年代末，并在最近几年达到顶峰，反映出学术界对高质量旅游的兴趣日益浓厚。《酒店与旅游质量保证期刊》、《瑞士可持续发展》和《旅游管理》等重要期刊在引导学术讨论中发挥了关键作用。突出的关键词包括“生活质量”、“旅游”和“可持续性”，尤其关注全球视角，特别是与中国相关的研究。Carneiro、Eusébio和Uysal等学者以及Universidade Q9和香港理工大学等机构为该领域的进步做出了重要贡献。引文网络凸显了强大的国际合作，显示中国、美国、英国、西班牙和葡萄牙之间存在紧密联系。研究强调了一种跨学科策略，将环境和管理因素融入旅游质量中。尽管该研究提供了全面的概述，但其局限性包括方法论问题、时间与语言偏差，以及对特定数据源的依赖。总体而言，该分析呈现了一个充满活力且协作性强的领域，其特点是显著的学术参与度，以及对可持续性和跨学科研究的日益关注。

url:7c9c29396787d9a1.abstract: We investigate work as informal redistribution and the drivers underlying these preferences. In a field experiment in Kampala, Uganda, we find that employers and workers consistently choose work redistribution over cash transfers, both revealing a willingness to pay for work. By randomizing work tasks---including busywork---we show that work production value does not explain work redistribution choices: employers pay for zero marginal product work. Choices are also not explained by relational benefits such as signaling or networking; instead, motivations are normative. Experimental evidence suggests a norm for work redistribution rooted in incentive arguments on the demand side, as employers stop requiring work when recipients have verifiable emergencies, and a combination of reciprocity and dignity from earning on the supply side. This norm impacts the organization of production: firms appear larger and less productive. Effective firm size is 6.4% smaller, and revenues per hour are 9.3% higher when accounting for symbolic work.
url:7c9c29396787d9a1.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了工作作为非正式再分配的形式及其偏好背后的驱动因素。在乌干达坎帕拉的一项实地实验中，我们发现雇主和工人一致选择工作再分配而非现金转移，双方均表现出为工作付费的意愿。通过随机分配工作任务——包括无意义工作——我们证明工作生产价值并不能解释工作再分配的选择：雇主为边际产出为零的工作支付报酬。这些选择也不能由信号传递或社交网络等关系性收益来解释；相反，动机是规范性的。实验证据表明，存在一种基于需求方激励论点的工作再分配规范，当受助者面临可验证的紧急情况时，雇主不再要求工作；而在供给方，则源于互惠和通过劳动获得尊严的结合。这一规范影响了生产组织方式：企业显得规模更大但效率更低。考虑象征性工作后，有效企业规模缩小了6.4%，每小时收入则提高了9.3%。
url:7c9c29396787d9a1.title: Informal Redistribution Through Work
url:7c9c29396787d9a1.title_zh: 通过工作的非正式再分配

url:7cb132f099575f39.title: Fiscal policy and economic activity: new causal evidence
url:7cb132f099575f39.title_zh: 财政政策与经济活动：新的因果证据

url:7cbc0dff07c60fb4.title_zh: 税收与银行流动性创造

url:7cc8ca01d97ba321.abstract: This paper investigates how marginal utility varies with health status (e.g. health-state dependence) while allowing this relationship to differ across income levels. Building on the existing literature, we develop a framework that quantifies the income adjustments necessary to maintain individuals’ wellbeing when they become disabled. Using SHARE data, we empirically estimate how health affects the marginal utility of consumption across the income distribution for older adults in Europe. Our results show that health-state dependence is negative among low-income individuals, indicating that their marginal utility of consumption declines when their health worsens. In contrast, at the very top of the income distribution, health-state dependence is positive, implying that marginal utility of consumption rises as health deteriorates.
url:7cc8ca01d97ba321.abstract_zh: 本文研究了边际效用如何随健康状况变化（即健康状态依赖性），并允许这种关系在不同收入水平上存在差异。在现有文献基础上，我们构建了一个框架，用以量化个体在残疾时维持其福祉所需的收入调整。利用SHARE数据，我们实证估计了健康如何影响欧洲老年人消费边际效用的收入分布差异。研究结果表明，低收入群体的健康状态依赖性为负，即其健康状况恶化时消费边际效用下降。相反，在收入分布顶端，健康状态依赖性为正，意味着健康状况恶化时消费边际效用上升。
url:7cc8ca01d97ba321.title: Income Gradients in Health-State Dependence
url:7cc8ca01d97ba321.title_zh: 健康状态依赖中的收入梯度

url:7cd77c06c1940dbc.abstract: Discussions on Japan’s ‘lost decades’ have long focused on sluggish demand and the survival of ‘zombie’ firms. However, new evidence from microdata suggests a fundamental shift. This column argues that Japan’s productivity dynamics are moving from internal firm improvements to market-driven reallocation and reveals that the country’s unique ‘negative exit effect’ is largely driven by the mergers and acquisitions activity of high-productivity firms.
url:7cd77c06c1940dbc.abstract_zh: 关于日本“失去的几十年”的讨论，长期以来聚焦于需求疲软和“僵尸”企业的存续。然而，来自微观数据的新证据表明，情况发生了根本性转变。本专栏认为，日本的生产率动态正从企业内部改进转向市场驱动的重新配置，并揭示该国独特的“负退出效应”在很大程度上是由高生产率企业的并购活动所驱动的。
url:7cd77c06c1940dbc.title: Japan’s productivity transformation: From within-firm stagnation to market-driven reallocation
url:7cd77c06c1940dbc.title_zh: 日本生产率转型：从企业内部停滞到市场驱动的再配置

url:7cf2e27547d8c01c.abstract: We examine aggregate fluctuations in crypto markets and their relationship to global equity markets and US monetary policy. First, we document that changes in the correlation between crypto and global equity markets can be explained by changes in the participation of institutional investors in crypto markets. Second, we find that US monetary policy significantly affects crypto markets, but only when the participation of institutional investors is high. Finally, we rationalize our empirical results in a heterogeneous-agent model with time-varying aggregate risk aversion, in which large investors holding both asset classes create a direct link between them.
url:7cf2e27547d8c01c.abstract_zh: 我们考察了加密货币市场的总体波动及其与全球股票市场和美国货币政策的关系。首先，我们记录了加密货币与全球股票市场之间相关性的变化，这可以通过机构投资者在加密货币市场参与度的变化来解释。其次，我们发现美国货币政策显著影响加密货币市场，但仅在机构投资者参与度较高时如此。最后，我们在一个具有时变总体风险厌恶的异质代理人模型中合理化我们的实证结果，在该模型中，持有两类资产的大型投资者在它们之间建立了直接联系。
url:7cf2e27547d8c01c.title: The Crypto Cycle and Institutional Investors
url:7cf2e27547d8c01c.title_zh: 加密货币周期与机构投资者

url:7cf8d6c9c234feca.title: The effects on inequality and mobility of exposure to Soviet Communism in Eastern Europe
url:7cf8d6c9c234feca.title_zh: 东欧苏联共产主义经历对不平等与流动性的影响

url:7d0f11730b006198.abstract: Compared to metropolitan residents, rural residents face a disparity in access to local mental health providers that is even larger than for other health care services. Telehealth appears to be a natural solution to this issue: Patients should be able to more easily access providers from metro areas, reducing disparities in access to mental health care. In this paper, we consider the flip side of this argument, which has not yet received enough attention. Mental health providers, especially in areas where demand for their services exceeds supply, become more easily able to access patients and therefore may become more selective. We show evidence that access to telehealth services is 8-9 percentage points lower for non-metro residents, even after accounting for potential differences in stigma and internet access. We also show that self-payment is a significant predictor of telehealth utilization in mental health and provide suggestive evidence that the increase of telehealth in mental health treatments has coincided with reduced access to mental health care for publicly insured patients, despite growth in provider numbers across counties. We caution that expansions in telehealth need to be combined with policies to promote equitable reimbursement and reduce barriers for independent providers to bill public and private insurance.
url:7d0f11730b006198.abstract_zh: 与城市居民相比，农村居民在获取本地心理健康服务提供者方面面临更大差距，这一差距甚至超过其他医疗保健服务。远程医疗似乎是解决这一问题的自然方案：患者应能更容易地接触到城市地区的服务提供者，从而缩小心理健康护理获取方面的差距。本文探讨了这一论点的另一面，而这一面尚未得到充分关注。心理健康服务提供者，尤其是在服务需求超过供给的地区，更容易接触到患者，因此可能变得更加挑剔。我们提供的证据表明，即使考虑了污名化和互联网接入方面的潜在差异，非城市居民获得远程医疗服务的可能性仍低8至9个百分点。我们还发现，自费支付是心理健康领域远程医疗使用的重要预测因素，并提供了初步证据表明，心理健康治疗中远程医疗的增加与公共保险患者获取心理健康护理机会的减少同时发生，尽管各县服务提供者数量有所增长。我们提醒，远程医疗的扩展需与促进公平报销的政策相结合，并减少独立服务提供者向公共和私人保险收费的障碍。
url:7d0f11730b006198.title: Mental Health Care Access in Rural Communities Amid the Expansion of Telehealth
url:7d0f11730b006198.title_zh: 远程医疗扩展背景下农村社区心理健康服务的可及性

url:7d134e0e89c9dc8f.abstract: Despite major institutional reforms, the European Banking Union remains incomplete. Banking markets remain fragmented along national lines, which constrains Europe’s growth potential. This column uses loan-level data from the European credit registry combined with the bank group structure dataset to quantify where the barriers to cross-border lending lie, what role cross-country regulatory differences play, and how much output Europe forgoes as a result. It finds that the binding constraints sit on the extensive margin, that is, forming relationships and entering markets, that they are closely related to regulatory fragmentation, and that lifting them may deliver sizeable economic gains.
url:7d134e0e89c9dc8f.abstract_zh: 尽管经历了重大制度改革，欧洲银行业联盟仍不完善。银行业市场仍沿国界分割，这制约了欧洲的增长潜力。本专栏利用欧洲信贷登记机构的贷款级数据，结合银行集团结构数据集，量化了跨境贷款的障碍所在、跨国监管差异的作用，以及由此导致的欧洲产出损失。研究发现，约束性障碍主要存在于广延边际层面，即建立关系和进入市场方面，这些障碍与监管碎片化密切相关，而消除这些障碍可能带来可观的经济收益。
url:7d134e0e89c9dc8f.title: Why Europe's banks stay home: Regulatory fragmentation and the cost of an incomplete banking union
url:7d134e0e89c9dc8f.title_zh: 欧洲银行留守本土的原因：监管碎片化与不完整银行联盟的成本
