url:84d9c506d3d04e06.abstract: This paper exploits the random assignment of court cases to justices who exhibit varying degrees of strictness to examine how convicting corrupt officials affects local government outcomes in the Philippines. I document that convictions improve the management of local public finances and reduce associated corruption. An exploration of mechanisms suggests that legal deterrence effects contribute to these findings. The results further indicate that convictions are effective at stifling corruption among bureaucrats, but not politicians. Consistent with this heterogeneity, convictions reduce electoral competition and consequently weaken accountability for incumbent politicians.
url:84d9c506d3d04e06.abstract_zh: 本文利用法院案件随机分配给严格程度各异的法官这一自然实验，考察了菲律宾腐败官员定罪对地方政府结果的影响。研究发现，定罪改善了地方公共财政管理，并减少了相关腐败现象。机制探索表明，法律威慑效应是这些发现的重要成因。结果进一步显示，定罪在遏制官僚腐败方面有效，但对政治家无效。与这一异质性相符，定罪降低了选举竞争，从而削弱了对现任政治家的问责机制。
url:84d9c506d3d04e06.title: Convicting Corrupt Officials: Evidence from Randomly Assigned Cases
url:84d9c506d3d04e06.title_zh: 随机分配案件下腐败官员的定罪：来自随机分配案件的证据

url:84e19a5fb45d4eaa.abstract: This paper, based on the Stanley Fischer Memorial Lecture that the author delivered at the Annual Bank Conference on Development Economics (ABCDE) 2026, examines two structural impediments to broad-based economic development: dysfunctional central bank currency systems and inadequately resolved sovereign debt burdens. On currency, the paper argues that floating exchange rate regimes and multiple exchange rate systems—as practiced in countries such as Ethiopia, Nigeria, and Egypt—systematically transfer wealth from low-income wage earners to a narrow-privileged class, deepening poverty rather than alleviating it. Using Ethiopia as a central case study, the paper documents how successive devaluations have raised the national poverty rate from 33 percent in 2016 to a projected 43 percent by 2025, while eroding the real value of development assistance disbursed in local currency. The paper proposes that currency stabilization, low-cost digital payment infrastructure, and unsterilized central bank intervention offer a more direct path to rising median incomes than current IMF-endorsed exchange rate flexibility. On sovereign debt, the paper evaluates the performance of the G20 Common Framework and the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable against the benchmark of the 1989 Brady Plan, finding that contemporary frameworks have generated intensive creditor engagement but minimal net present value reduction for debtor countries. Key failures identified include the absence of a single comparable discount rate for measuring debt relief, incomplete participation by China and commercial creditors, growing opacity in collateralized sovereign transactions, and the risks posed by value recovery instruments to the durability of restructuring agreements. The paper concludes that neither the Common Framework nor the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable, in their current forms, are fit for purpose, and calls for replacement frameworks that prioritize measurable median income gains over creditor accommodation. Absent reforms on both fronts, per capita income growth in low-income developing economies is projected to remain at approximately 2 percent annually, leaving 5.6 billion people with incomes less than one-tenth of those in advanced economies and widening the global development gap.
url:84e19a5fb45d4eaa.abstract_zh: 本文基于作者在2026年发展经济学年度银行会议（ABCDE）上发表的斯坦利·费希尔纪念演讲，探讨了阻碍广泛经济发展的两大结构性障碍：功能失调的央行货币体系与未充分解决的主权债务负担。在货币方面，本文指出，浮动汇率制度及多重汇率体系——如埃塞俄比亚、尼日利亚和埃及等国所实行的制度——系统性地将财富从低收入工薪阶层转移至少数特权阶层，加剧而非缓解贫困。以埃塞俄比亚为核心案例，本文记录了连续贬值如何使全国贫困率从2016年的33%上升至2025年预计的43%，同时侵蚀了以本币拨付的发展援助的实际价值。本文提出，相较于当前国际货币基金组织认可的汇率弹性政策，货币稳定、低成本数字支付基础设施及未冲销的央行干预措施，为提升中位收入提供了更直接的路径。在主权债务方面，本文以1989年布雷迪计划为基准，评估了二十国集团共同框架与全球主权债务圆桌会议的表现，发现当代框架虽促成了密集的债权人参与，但对债务国而言净现值削减微乎其微。识别出的关键失败包括：缺乏衡量债务减免的统一可比贴现率、中国及商业债权人参与不完整、抵押主权交易日益不透明，以及价值回收工具对重组协议持久性构成的威胁。本文结论认为，共同框架与全球主权债务圆桌会议目前的形式均不适用，并呼吁建立以可衡量的中位收入增长而非债权人妥协为核心的替代框架。若这两方面改革缺失，低收入发展中经济体的人均收入增长预计将维持在每年约2%的水平，导致56亿人口的收入不足发达经济体的十分之一，从而扩大全球发展差距。
url:84e19a5fb45d4eaa.title: Stanley Fischer Memorial Lecture: Public Debt and Central Banks — The World Bank Group ABCDE Conference
url:84e19a5fb45d4eaa.title_zh: 斯坦利·费希尔纪念讲座：公共债务与中央银行——世界银行集团ABCDE会议

url:84eec7de39661652.abstract: Third-party litigation financing involves an external party funding a legal claim, taking on the risk of loss in exchange for a share of any potential recovery. As European regulators prepare to establish a common regulatory framework for third-party litigation financing, this article draws on existing law and economics literature to examine the unique characteristics of third-party litigation financing, vis-a-vis other forms of financial support of litigation. Our findings highlight the strengths and weaknesses of different litigation-financing mechanisms in promoting socially desirable levels of litigation, adding a political economy perspective to the ongoing debates on the issue.
url:84eec7de39661652.abstract_zh: 第三方诉讼融资是指由外部方资助法律索赔，承担败诉风险，以换取潜在赔偿金的一部分。在欧洲监管机构准备为第三方诉讼融资建立统一监管框架之际，本文借鉴现有法律与经济学文献，探讨第三方诉讼融资相较于其他诉讼资助形式的独特特征。研究结果凸显了不同诉讼融资机制在促进社会合意诉讼水平方面的优势与不足，并为当前相关争论增添了政治经济学视角。
url:84eec7de39661652.title: The Economics of Litigation Financing

url:851105f814d7d6bb.abstract: This paper develops a novel trade-off theory of capital structure. When frequent re-balancing of firm leverage is restricted due to capital structure stickiness (or refinancing frictions), optimal capital structure reflects current and future investment profitability. That is, optimal leverage crucially depends on the asset growth and tax rate, and yields various capital structure equilibria, such as all-debt, all-equity, and debt-equity financing, by balancing the tax benefits of debt and the cash benefits of equity. Notably, the model endogenously generates low and zero leverage and also offers insights into the determinants of leverage life-cycle patterns observed in practice
url:851105f814d7d6bb.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种新颖的资本结构权衡理论。当频繁调整企业杠杆受到资本结构粘性（或再融资摩擦）限制时，最优资本结构反映了当前及未来的投资盈利能力。即，最优杠杆率关键取决于资产增长率和税率，并通过平衡债务的税收利益与股权的现金利益，产生多种资本结构均衡，如全债务、全股权及债务-股权混合融资。值得注意的是，该模型内生地产生了低杠杆和零杠杆现象，并为实践中观察到的杠杆生命周期模式的决定因素提供了洞见。
url:851105f814d7d6bb.title: Investment-Based Trade-Off Theory

url:851488b0b9043533.abstract: This paper develops novel natural language methods to analyze the empirical determinants and economic value of these rights using a new collection of 30,000 CBAs from Canada in the period 1986-2015. We parse legally binding rights (e.g., “workers shall receive…”) and obligations (e.g., “the employer shall provide…”) from contract text, and validate our measures through evaluation of clause pairs and comparison to firm surveys on HR practices. Using time-varying province-level variation in labor income tax rates, we find that higher taxes increase the share of worker-rights clauses while reducing pre-tax wages in unionized firms, consistent with a substitution effect away from taxed wages toward untaxed rights. Further, an exogenous increase in the value of outside options (from a leave-one-out instrument for labor demand) increases the share of worker rights clauses in CBAs. Combining the regression estimates, we infer that a one-standard-deviation increase in worker rights is valued at about 5.7% of wages.
url:851488b0b9043533.abstract_zh: 本文开发了新颖的自然语言处理方法，利用1986-2015年间加拿大收集的30,000份集体 bargaining 协议（CBAs）新数据集，分析这些权利的经验决定因素及其经济价值。我们从合同文本中解析具有法律约束力的权利（如“工人应获得……”）和义务（如“雇主应提供……”），并通过评估条款对及与企业人力资源实践调查的比较来验证我们的度量。利用省级劳动所得税率的时变差异，我们发现较高的税收增加了工人权利条款的比例，同时降低了工会化企业的税前工资，这与从征税工资向未征税权利的替代效应一致。此外，外部选择价值的外生增加（通过留一法工具变量衡量劳动需求）提高了CBA中工人权利条款的比例。结合回归估计，我们推断工人权利的一个标准差增加约相当于工资的5.7%的价值。
url:851488b0b9043533.title: Worker Rights in Collective Bargaining
url:851488b0b9043533.title_zh: 集体谈判中的工人权利

url:85626aeb613a3658.abstract: This paper explores the integration of Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) into the construction of net-zero (NZ) portfolios of sovereign bonds. Based on both backward-looking (2015–2021) and forward-looking (2021–2030) analyses, we compare the effectiveness of scenarios using constant greenhouse gas (GHG) intensities and NDC-based trajectories in reducing the portfolio’s GHG intensity while minimizing the tracking error relative to the business-as-usual benchmark. The backward-looking exercise reveals that NDC-based portfolios achieve similar GHG intensity reductions with lower tracking errors compared to constant-intensity scenarios, demonstrating their efficacy in building an NZ portfolio. Conversely, constant-intensity strategies require more aggressive rebalancing, leading to higher tracking errors and uneven allocations. In the forward-looking exercise, the more ambitious second round of NDCs announced before COP26 enables substantial GHG intensity reductions at a marginal financial cost. Overall, our results highlight the potential of NDCs as a forward-looking tool to align sovereign bond portfolios with climate objectives while maintaining financial performance. However, imposing weight restrictions by country or region, to ensure more equitable investment between advanced and emerging economies, significantly limits the ability to meet reduction targets and increases tracking errors.
url:85626aeb613a3658.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了将国家自主贡献（NDCs）纳入主权债券净零（NZ）投资组合构建的实践。基于回溯性（2015-2021年）与前瞻性（2021-2030年）两种分析，我们比较了采用恒定温室气体（GHG）强度与基于NDC的减排路径两种情景在降低投资组合GHG强度、同时最小化相对于常规基准的跟踪误差方面的有效性。回溯性分析显示，与恒定强度情景相比，基于NDC的投资组合在实现相似的GHG强度降低的同时，具有更低的跟踪误差，从而证明了其在构建净零投资组合中的有效性。相反，恒定强度策略要求更为激进的再平衡操作，导致较高的跟踪误差及不均衡的配置。在前瞻性分析中，COP26之前宣布的更具雄心的第二轮NDC使得在边际财务成本较低的情况下实现显著的GHG强度削减。总体而言，我们的研究结果凸显了NDC作为前瞻性工具，在保持财务绩效的同时，使主权债券投资组合与气候目标相一致的潜力。然而，为确保发达经济体与新兴经济体之间更为均衡的投资，按国家或地区施加权重限制，则会显著限制实现减排目标的能力，并增加跟踪误差。

url:858c646a170a003e.abstract: This paper provides a simple unified discrete-choice framework for analyzing differentiated duopolies. This framework nests models of horizontal and vertical differentiation, including standard textbook models (Hotelling and Shaked-Sutton). Contrary to these models, it also applies to economic environments where horizontal differentiation coincides with positive correlation of product valuations across consumers, and environments where vertical differentiation coincides with negative correlation. The paper provides an equilibrium characterization that is applicable independently of the type of differentiation and the sign of the valuation correlation.
url:858c646a170a003e.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个简单统一的离散选择框架，用于分析差异化双寡头市场。该框架涵盖了横向与纵向差异化模型，包括标准教科书模型（霍特林模型与谢克德-萨顿模型）。与这些模型不同，该框架同样适用于横向差异化与消费者产品估值正相关并存的经济环境，以及纵向差异化与估值负相关并存的经济环境。本文给出了一个独立于差异化类型及估值相关符号的均衡特征刻画。

url:85ca440452310fc2.abstract: With the rise of new industries, often new jobs emerge. Evolutionary Economic Geography and in particular Industry Life Cycle perspectives predict that these activities first emerge in a limited number of cities to then diffuse to other locations as job descriptions become more standardized. Here, we focus on a particularly important new industry: software development, an activity that is economically important, quickly changing, and has a pronounced spatial concentration in a small number of global IT hubs. We use an online database of over 60 million questions and answers about problems in software development that yields a longitudinal dataset of 237 software skills. By geo-locating 3 million posting users at regular intervals, we link these skills to cities worldwide. We find that, in spite of its digital nature, the software industry exhibits similar spatial regularities as previously observed in more traditional sectors. First, cities diversify into skills that are related to their existing ones. Second, new skills first emerge in cities with large and diversified software sectors, and later diffuse -- mostly unhindered by geographical distance -- to smaller cities specialized in closely related skills. We find suggestive but limited support for a windows of locational opportunity account: although even brand-new skills still emerge first in cities with strong prior specialization in related skills, concentrations of related activities impact less the emergence of new skills than the diffusion of existing ones.
url:85ca440452310fc2.abstract_zh: 随着新兴产业的崛起，新职业往往随之涌现。演化经济地理学，特别是产业生命周期理论预测，这些活动最初会在少数城市出现，随后随着职位描述逐渐标准化而扩散至其他地区。本文聚焦于一个尤为重要的新兴产业——软件开发。这一经济活动具有重要经济价值、快速迭代特征，且高度集中于少数全球IT枢纽城市。我们利用一个包含超过6000万个软件开发问题与答案的在线数据库，构建了涵盖237项软件技能的纵向数据集。通过对300万用户进行定期地理定位，我们将这些技能与全球城市建立关联。研究发现，尽管软件开发具有数字属性，但其空间分布规律与传统行业存在相似性：首先，城市会向与其现有技能相关的领域进行多元化拓展；其次，新技能首先在拥有大规模、多元化软件产业的城市出现，随后——基本不受地理距离阻碍——扩散至专注于紧密关联技能的小型城市。我们发现了支持区位机会窗口理论的有限证据：尽管全新技能仍优先出现在相关技能基础雄厚的城市，但相关活动的集聚程度对新技能涌现的影响，要弱于对现有技能扩散的影响。
url:85ca440452310fc2.title: The Changing Global Division of Labor in Software: Emergence and Diffusion of New Programming Skills across IT Hubs
url:85ca440452310fc2.title_zh: 软件业全球劳动分工的变迁：新兴编程技能在IT枢纽的出现与扩散

url:85d0969336e5b0fa.abstract: This paper tests whether inequality shapes the redistributive impact of democratization by examining changes to the governance of councils providing poor relief — rudimentary social insurance — in nineteenth-century Britain. An 1894 reform removed institutional features — a graduated franchise, property qualifications, the absence of a secret ballot, and the participation of unelected magistrates — that allowed landowners to control spending on poor relief after the 1832 Great Reform Act. The empirical analysis uses a new annual dataset of poor law spending from 1884-1905 to test whether higher pre-reform inequality amplified the effect of democratic reform on redistribution. The results support the Meltzer-Richard hypothesis: higher local income inequality led to higher poor relief spending after 1894. Areas where landed elites held political power saw smaller increases in expenditure, indicating that de facto elite influence muted the effect of democratization. These findings provide empirical support for models of democratization that focus on demands for redistribution.
url:85d0969336e5b0fa.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察19世纪英国济贫理事会治理结构的变化，检验不平等是否塑造了民主化的再分配效应。1894年的一项改革取消了允许地主在1832年《大改革法案》后控制济贫支出的制度特征——包括分级选举权、财产资格限制、无记名投票的缺失以及非选举治安法官的参与。实证分析利用1884年至1905年间新的济贫法支出年度数据集，检验改革前更高的不平等是否放大了民主改革对再分配的影响。结果支持梅尔策-理查德假说：1894年后，地方收入不平等程度越高，济贫支出增加越多。土地精英掌握政治权力的地区支出增幅较小，表明事实上的精英影响力削弱了民主化的效应。这些发现为强调再分配需求的民主化模型提供了实证支持。
url:85d0969336e5b0fa.title: Democracy, Redistribution, and Inequality: Evidence from the English Poor Law
url:85d0969336e5b0fa.title_zh: 民主、再分配与不平等：来自英国济贫法的证据

url:85d70c4ba9d45c12.abstract: We study the aggregation of individuals’ beliefs into their collective judgment on a certain proposition, called the conclusion , which is logically related to other preliminary propositions. While the literature has highlighted the crucial dependency of voting outcomes on the selection of an agenda —i.e., the set of propositions voted on—the structure of this dependency is not well understood. We introduce two novel premise-based rules, defined through the conjunctive normal form and disjunctive normal form of the conclusion. Our theorem shows that for any profile of voters’ beliefs, these rules respectively yield the highest and lowest voting outcomes, with respect to a given total order over the set of truth values, within the class of all premise-based rules. This result clarifies the extent to which a voting outcome can be manipulated through the selection of an agenda. Similar content being viewed by others
url:85d70c4ba9d45c12.abstract_zh: 本文研究个体信念如何聚合为对某一命题（称为“结论”）的集体判断，该结论与其他前提性命题存在逻辑关联。现有文献虽已强调投票结果对议程（即被投票的命题集合）选择的关键依赖性，但这一依赖关系的结构尚未得到充分理解。我们引入两种基于前提的新规则，分别通过结论的合取范式与析取范式进行定义。定理表明：对于任意选民信念分布，在给定真值集合的全序关系下，这两类规则分别在所有基于前提的规则中产生最高与最低的投票结果。该结论揭示了通过议程选择操纵投票结果的可能边界。

url:85eecf6d04ca0b94.abstract_zh: 我们研究工作场所灵活性是否为“母职惩罚”的关键驱动因素。利用新冠疫情后居家办公合同在双重差分框架下的急剧且异质性扩散，我们将意大利所有居家办公合同的行政数据与匹配的雇主-雇员记录、母亲-父亲关联数据、生育记录及企业资产负债表相结合。对灵活工作的更高接触显著降低了母亲

url:85f1683c1f854121.abstract: This paper exploits the division of Germany after the Second World War and the reunification of East and West Germany in 1990 as a natural experiment to provide evidence of the importance of market access for economic development. In line with a standard new economic geography model, we find that following division cities in West Germany that were close to the new border between East and West Germany experienced a substantial decline in population growth relative to other West German cities. We provide several pieces of evidence that the decline of the border cities can be entirely accounted for by their loss in market access and is neither driven by differences in industrial structure nor differences in the degree of war related destruction. Finally, we also find some first evidence of a recovery of the border cities after the reunification of East and West Germany.
url:85f1683c1f854121.abstract_zh: 本文利用二战后德国分裂及1990年东西德统一作为自然实验，为市场准入对经济发展的重要性提供了证据。与标准的新经济地理模型一致，我们发现，分裂后，西德靠近东西德新边界的城市相对于其他西德城市经历了人口增长的显著下降。我们提供了多项证据表明，边境城市的衰退完全可归因于其市场准入的丧失，既非产业结构差异所致，也非战争破坏程度差异造成。最后，我们还发现了东西德统一后边境城市复苏的初步证据。

url:861dff724d80274e.abstract: When governments face fiscal stress, they frequently manage consolidation by delaying cash payments on legally incurred obligations rather than cutting explicit appropriations. This "execution wedge" reduces the real resources available for public production while leaving formal appropriations unchanged. We identify the causal effect of this adjustment margin using monthly administrative data from Ecuadors public health system, exploiting institutional features that make the cash execution pipeline observable and its frictions plausibly exogenous. A one-standard-deviation increase in the execution wedge reduces hospital discharges by 19.9 percent and increases the conditional inpatient mortality rate after 48 hours by 59 percent. Conversely, mortality within 48 hours an indicator of patient severity at arrival, is unaffected. These findings demonstrate that payment timing operates as an active fiscal policy variable with first-order welfare costs that are unmeasured in standard fiscal policy analysis.
url:861dff724d80274e.abstract_zh: 当政府面临财政压力时，它们常常通过延迟支付合法产生的债务现金，而非削减明确的拨款，来实施财政整顿。这种“执行缺口”减少了可用于公共生产的实际资源，同时正式拨款保持不变。我们利用厄瓜多尔公共卫生系统的月度行政数据，识别了这一调整边际的因果效应，利用制度特征使现金执行流程可观察，且其摩擦具有合理的外生性。执行缺口每增加一个标准差，医院出院人数减少19.9%，48小时后的条件住院死亡率增加59%。相反，48小时内的死亡率——作为入院时患者严重程度的指标——则不受影响。这些发现表明，支付时点作为一种活跃的财政政策变量，其福利成本的一阶效应在标准财政政策分析中未被计量。

url:86295fa6a087189a.abstract: We show that credit constraints significantly increase the risk that firms are infiltrated by organized crime, defined as the covert involvement of criminal organizations in corporate decision-making. Using confidential data on criminal investigations, credit ratings, and loan histories for the universe of Italian firms, we find that a downgrade to substandard credit status reduces credit availability by 30% over five years and increases the probability of infiltration by 5%, relative to comparable firms. A local randomization design comparing firms just above and below the downgrade threshold confirms this result. The effect is pervasive across sectors and regions, but particularly strong in real estate, where the probability of infiltration rises by 10% following a downgrade. Infiltrated firms also display higher survival rates than other downgraded firms, despite similar declines in employment and revenues. These findings suggest that organized crime can serve as a financial backstop — sustaining non-viable businesses and potentially redirecting their strategies to serve criminal interests.
url:86295fa6a087189a.abstract_zh: 我们证明，信贷约束显著增加了企业被有组织犯罪渗透的风险——即犯罪组织秘密介入企业决策。基于意大利全体企业的刑事调查、信用评级及贷款历史机密数据，我们发现：相较于可比企业，信用评级降至次级标准的企业五年内信贷可得性下降30%，被渗透概率上升5%。采用降级阈值附近企业的局部随机化设计验证了这一结果。该效应普遍存在于各行业与地区，但在房地产领域尤为显著——降级后该行业企业被渗透概率上升10%。尽管被渗透企业与其它降级企业同样面临就业与收入下滑，但其存活率更高。这些发现表明，有组织犯罪可充当财务后盾——维持无生存能力的企业运营，并可能引导其战略转向服务于犯罪利益。

url:8652b3f4c89965fa.abstract: We document the macroeconomic patterns that characterize labor market recovery from financial crises. Using a sample of postwar recession episodes from around the world, we show that financial crises are typically followed by jobless recoveries, with a sluggish recovery in employment relative to output. A departure from this empirical regularity occurs in emerging-market crises with high inflation, which feature strong employment recoveries but persistent declines in real wages and result in “wageless recoveries.” Our findings highlight the central role of financial components in labor input costs and nominal wage rigidities in shaping labor market dynamics following economic crises.
url:8652b3f4c89965fa.abstract_zh: 本文记录了金融危机后劳动力市场复苏的宏观经济特征。基于全球战后经济衰退案例样本，我们发现金融危机通常伴随无就业复苏，即就业相对于产出的恢复较为缓慢。这一经验规律在新兴市场高通胀危机中出现例外——此类危机呈现强劲的就业复苏，但实际工资持续下降，形成"无工资复苏"现象。研究结果凸显了劳动力投入成本中的金融成分与名义工资刚性在塑造经济危机后劳动力市场动态中的核心作用。

url:86823628ce9bf001.abstract: This paper reports key findings from the Sub-Saharan Africa Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) and Digital Payments Survey, shedding light on the motivations, benefits, and challenges of CBDC adoption, as well as the developments of digital private money and crypto assets in sub-Saharan Africa. It emphasizes the pivotal role of collaboration and shared knowledge in navigating the intricate landscape of digital currencies and assets in sub-Saharan Africa. As this evolving digital frontier is explored, the experiences and aspirations of the region's central banks, as expressed in the survey, will help harness the potential for digital currencies, assets, and payments, and foster cooperation among countries in sub-Saharan Africa. A forthcoming IMF Departmental Paper will focus on key issues for countries in sub-Saharan Africa pertaining to CBDCs, private digital payments, and crypto assets. It will provide a deeper discussion of the benefits, costs, and risks of these digital payment systems and present policy options to enhance financial digital development and inclusion, while safeguarding macroeconomic and financial stability.
url:86823628ce9bf001.abstract_zh: 本文报告了撒哈拉以南非洲中央银行数字货币（CBDC）与数字支付调查的关键发现，揭示了该地区CBDC采纳的动机、益处与挑战，以及私人数字货币和加密资产的发展动态。文章强调了合作与知识共享在应对撒哈拉以南非洲数字货币与资产复杂格局中的关键作用。随着这一不断演变的数字前沿被探索，调查中所反映的该地区中央银行的经历与愿景，将有助于挖掘数字货币、资产及支付的潜力，并促进撒哈拉以南非洲各国间的合作。即将发布的国际货币基金组织部门论文将聚焦于撒哈拉以南非洲国家在CBDC、私人数字支付及加密资产方面的关键问题，深入探讨这些数字支付系统的益处、成本与风险，并提出政策选项，以促进金融数字化发展与包容性，同时维护宏观经济和金融稳定。

url:868cbbcd2c461f72.abstract: Startup accelerators are a leading gateway to venture capital, but top programs often require founders to relocate to a venture hub. From a hand-collected census of U.S. accelerator startups (2008-2011) followed for five years, we estimate a two-sided matching model that separates two channels behind the gender funding gap, geographic mobility and sorting across accelerator tiers. Women raise about 60% less than men over five years; the gap concentrates among non-relocating women, is largest at active-childrearing ages, and vanishes for relocators, while the mobility cost is near zero for men. Removing mobility frictions raises women's match quality but not their tier; reaching the high-funding top tier also requires removing the sorting disadvantage that women face. The 2012 JOBS Act eased the legal barrier and capacity grew tenfold, yet the U.S. VC dollar gap still tripled (2011-2020): closing it needs mobility, sorting, and capacity together.
url:868cbbcd2c461f72.abstract_zh: 创业加速器是通往风险资本的主要门户，但顶级项目通常要求创始人迁至创业中心。基于一项手工收集的美国加速器初创企业普查数据（2008-2011年，并追踪五年），我们估计了一个双边匹配模型，以分离性别融资差距背后的两个渠道：地理流动性和加速器层级的分类效应。五年间，女性融资额比男性低约60%；这一差距集中在未迁居的女性群体中，在育儿活跃年龄段最为显著，而迁居者的差距则消失，同时男性的流动性成本几乎为零。消除流动性摩擦可提高女性的匹配质量，但无法提升其所在层级；要进入高融资的顶级层级，还需消除女性面临的分类劣势。2012年《创业企业扶助法》降低了法律障碍，加速器容量增长了十倍，但美国风险资本美元差距仍扩大了三倍（2011-2020年）：缩小这一差距需要同时解决流动性、分类和容量问题。

url:87172b609c9b92e5.abstract: Firm organizations are designed to compress unit costs in general, and wage costs in particular. We build on this intuition to study how minimum wages affect firms' organizations, production costs and, ultimately, productivity. To this end, we construct a general equilibrium model in which firms rely on optimal hierarchies to optimize the use of labor and associated knowledge (training). The introduction of a minimum wage constraint in such an environment alters firms' optimal strategies when knowledge acquisition costs are large relative to management costs. We calibrate this model on French data to quantify the impact of the large increases in the minimum wage (up to 8.5% in real terms) that occurred for some firms between 2003 and 2006. We find that the endogenous contraction and flattening responses of firms' organizations strongly contributes to mitigating the overall loss in output (simulated at about 2%). This is driven by gains in revenue productivity (by about 4%) and wages (6.8%), while the impact on quantity-based productivity indices is not monotonic across firm types. These results are confirmed in the French data, both qualitatively and quantitatively, by regression analyses combining difference-in-differences and instrumental variable strategies. Further simulations show that the relative cost of minimum wage constraints tends to be amplified in economies with more efficient communication technologies, and mitigated in economies with more efficient information or problem-solving technologies. However, this last result does not hold for large technological shocks, which suggests that the current waves of new AI-based technologies, as well as the massive investments in communication technologies during the recent Covid-19 pandemic, are likely to necessitate a thorough re-examination of cost-benefit analyses of labor market institutions and regulations.
url:87172b609c9b92e5.abstract_zh: 企业组织设计的核心目标在于压缩单位成本，尤其是工资成本。基于这一直觉，我们研究最低工资如何影响企业组织、生产成本，并最终影响生产率。为此，我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中企业通过最优层级结构来优化劳动力使用及其相关知识（培训）的配置。当知识获取成本相对于管理成本较高时，最低工资约束的引入会改变企业的最优策略。我们利用法国数据对该模型进行校准，以量化2003年至2006年间部分企业面临的最低工资大幅上涨（实际涨幅高达8.5%）的影响。研究发现，企业组织的内生性收缩与扁平化调整显著缓解了总产出损失（模拟结果约为2%）。这一调整通过收入生产率提升（约4%）和工资增长（6.8%）实现，但基于数量的生产率指数在不同类型企业间呈现非单调变化。通过结合双重差分法与工具变量策略的回归分析，这些结果在法国数据中得到了定性与定量层面的验证。进一步模拟表明，在通信技术更高效的经济体中，最低工资约束的相对成本会被放大；而在信息或问题解决技术更高效的经济体中，该成本则被缓解。然而，这一结论在面临重大技术冲击时不再成立，这意味着当前基于人工智能的新技术浪潮，以及近期新冠疫情期间对通信技术的大规模投资，可能需要对劳动力市场制度与监管的成本效益分析进行彻底重新审视。

url:8755dc5ee4fb63fb.abstract: We test whether a conditional cash lottery targets prevention on those doing too little because of inverse-S probability distortion that also causes overvaluation of a lottery. Consistent with theory, Filipinos perceiving their cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk in a wide intermediate interval (10%, 85%] are 3 percentage points (60%) less likely to have a check-up before baseline if they exhibit inverse- S distortion. A random lottery offer conditional on going for a check-up (CVD screening) increases the probability by 47 points overall. Estimates of compliance and lottery-induced CVD preventive care are larger (not significantly) for inverse- S (but also S) types perceiving intermediate risk.
url:8755dc5ee4fb63fb.abstract_zh: 我们检验了条件现金彩票是否针对那些因逆S型概率扭曲而预防行为不足的个体，这种扭曲同时导致对彩票的高估。与理论一致，感知自身心血管疾病风险处于宽泛中间区间（10%，85%]的菲律宾人，若表现出逆S型扭曲，则在基线前接受体检的可能性低3个百分点（60%）。一项以接受体检（心血管疾病筛查）为条件的随机彩票提供，总体上将这一概率提高了47个百分点。对逆S型（也包括S型）且感知中等风险的个体，其依从性和彩票诱导的心血管疾病预防护理的估计值更大（虽不显著）。

url:87589d3680e35d55.abstract: We construct standardized climate anomalies from daily observations and carefully calibrate physical thresholds to identify storms, floods, droughts, heatwaves, and cold snaps across 196 countries over the period 1970–2023. Using a local projections framework, we estimate the contemporaneous and 2-year effects of each disaster type and collectively on real GDP growth. We find that storms, floods, droughts, and heatwaves significantly reduce growth on impact (by roughly 0.1–0.2 percentage points on average), with the largest effects observed in emerging markets and developing economies. Cold spells have no statistically significant impacts. Our estimations also indicate that the initial drop in GDP growth is often not fully offset by a quick rebound, leaving GDP below the pre-disaster trend in the subsequent two years. Severe disasters impose far larger costs. Catastrophic floods can lower growth by up to 3 percentage points (with once-in-100-year storms or heatwaves reducing growth by ~0.5pp and extreme droughts by ~1pp). By combining the estimated global coefficients with each country’s own disaster intensity, we translate the aggregate results into localized growth effects and cross-check them against estimates from a dynamic heterogenous panel model. Finally, rolling-window estimates indicate that the contemporaneous growth impact of storms and heatwaves has attenuated in recent decades, whereas droughts have become increasingly damaging, reflecting divergent adaptation or even maladaptation and vulnerability trends over time.
url:87589d3680e35d55.abstract_zh: 我们基于每日观测数据构建了标准化的气候异常指标，并仔细校准了物理阈值，以识别1970-2023年间196个国家的风暴、洪水、干旱、热浪和寒潮事件。通过局部投影框架，我们估算了每种灾害类型及其综合对实际GDP增长的当期影响和两年期效应。研究发现，风暴、洪水、干旱和热浪在冲击当期显著抑制经济增长（平均约0.1-0.2个百分点），其中新兴市场和发展中经济体的影响最为显著。寒潮则未呈现统计显著影响。我们的估算还表明，GDP增长的初始下降通常无法通过快速反弹完全弥补，导致后续两年GDP仍低于灾前趋势水平。严重灾害造成的成本远高于平均水平：灾难性洪水可使增长率下降高达3个百分点（百年一遇的风暴或热浪约降低0.5个百分点，极端干旱约降低1个百分点）。通过将全球估计系数与各国自身灾害强度相结合，我们将汇总结果转化为局部增长效应，并与动态异质性面板模型的估计结果进行交叉验证。最后，滚动窗口估计表明，近几十年来风暴和热浪的当期增长冲击有所减弱，而干旱的破坏性持续增强，这反映了随时间推移出现的适应性分化乃至适应不良与脆弱性趋势的演变。

url:877faa026b931d69.abstract: How do households respond when deposit rates drop below zero? Using administrative micro data and exploiting cross-bank variation in interest rate policies, we study a major episode of negative deposit rates in Denmark affecting two thirds of household deposits. We find that households strongly reduced deposit balances when exposed to negative deposit rates, allocating funds to stock portfolios and consumption. In a large-scale survey, we document important roles for loss aversion, perceived unfairness, intertemporal substitution and return considerations in driving these responses. Our findings suggest that monetary policy can have strong consumption effects in negative territory.
url:877faa026b931d69.abstract_zh: 当存款利率降至负值时，家庭会如何应对？利用行政微观数据并借助银行间利率政策的差异，我们研究了丹麦一次影响三分之二家庭存款的重大负存款利率事件。研究发现，当家庭面临负存款利率时，会大幅减少存款余额，将资金配置至股票投资组合和消费领域。通过大规模调查，我们证实损失厌恶、感知不公、跨期替代及收益考量在驱动这些行为中发挥重要作用。研究结果表明，货币政策在负利率区间可能对消费产生显著影响。

url:87afb75323a06a97.abstract: The alpha male, associated with traditional masculinity features such as competitiveness, assertiveness, and risk tolerance, embodies a biologically grounded dimension of personality. We construct a novel dataset of political leaders' masculinity---measured by facial width-to-height ratio, an established biological marker for traditional masculine behavior driven by testosterone---for more than 2,000 national leaders across 184 countries over 150 years. Leaders’ masculinity has increased over the past 70 years in both democracies and autocracies, across rich and poor countries, and across all regions. Benchmarking against Olympic athletes, Wikipedia-notable individuals, and U.S.\ population data, we document that political leaders exhibit systematically higher masculinity than other groups, in both democracies and autocracies. Leaders' masculinity surges during periods of geopolitical uncertainty, such as the World Wars, the Cold War, and recent decades. Two empirical applications show that masculine leaders are related to democratic change and international war, and these links depend on the institutional environment.
url:87afb75323a06a97.abstract_zh: 阿尔法男性特质，如竞争性、自信和风险承受力，与传统男性气质相关，体现了一种基于生物基础的人格维度。我们构建了一个涵盖150年间184个国家2000多位国家领导人的新型数据集，以面部宽高比（一种由睾酮驱动的传统男性行为的既定生物标志）衡量其男性气质。过去70年间，无论是民主国家还是专制国家、富裕国家还是贫穷国家、以及所有地区，领导人的男性气质均有所上升。通过与奥运运动员、维基百科知名人士及美国人口数据对比，我们发现政治领导人的男性气质在民主和专制国家中均系统性高于其他群体。在地缘政治不确定时期（如两次世界大战、冷战及近几十年），领导人的男性气质显著激增。两项实证研究表明，男性气质与民主变革及国际战争存在关联，且这种关联取决于制度环境。
url:87afb75323a06a97.title: Tha Alpha Politocal Male

url:87b34f87c61cced2.abstract: Discrete policy thresholds are pervasive in tax and regulatory systems and can substantially distort behavior. We show that notches acting as barriers to mobility within a distribution generate distortions extending far beyond the threshold. The same mechanism biases conventional difference-in-differences estimators, and we propose a new methodology to recover causal effects. Applying the method to the abolition of a size-based payroll tax notch, we find that the notch reduced the number of firms above the threshold by 18 percent and lowered treated firms’ employment, capital stock, and value added by 10 percent, whereas conventional difference-in-differences estimates imply negligible effects.
url:87b34f87c61cced2.abstract_zh: 离散政策阈值在税收和监管体系中普遍存在，并可能显著扭曲行为。我们证明，作为分布内流动性障碍的阈值缺口会引发远超阈值本身的扭曲效应。这一机制导致传统双重差分估计量产生偏差，为此我们提出一种恢复因果效应的新方法。将该方法应用于基于企业规模的工资税缺口废除案例，我们发现该缺口使阈值以上企业数量减少18%，并导致受处理企业的就业、资本存量和增加值下降10%，而传统双重差分估计显示的影响可忽略不计。
url:87b34f87c61cced2.title: DP21779 Policy Thresholds as Growth Barriers: Theory and Evidence from a Payroll Tax Notch
url:87b34f87c61cced2.title_zh: DP21779 政策阈值作为增长障碍：来自工资税断点的理论与证据

url:87b73fb1a4f18817.abstract: In his work “A System of Logic”, John Stuart Mill presented four methods of experimental inquiry, structured into five canons, aimed at determining the circumstances that relate to the considered phenomenon by an invariable law. This study delves into Mill’s methods through the lens of social choice theory and discovers the synchronicity between these theories. Our primary finding is that Approval Voting and the Leximax rule are characterized by consistently (and neutrally) extending Mill’s first canon (the method of agreement) and his second canon (the method of difference). Furthermore, we explore the interplay among the five canons. Our findings demonstrate that the Leximax rule successfully adheres to the first four canons while maintaining consistency and neutrality. These results underscore the intricate connection between causal inference and social choice theory, establishing a foundational link for the application of preference aggregation theory to data aggregation in causal inference and vice versa. Similar content being viewed by others
url:87b73fb1a4f18817.abstract_zh: 约翰·斯图尔特·密尔在其著作《逻辑体系》中提出了四种实验探究方法，并将其归纳为五条准则，旨在通过不变法则确定与所考察现象相关的条件。本研究从社会选择理论的视角深入剖析密尔的方法，发现这些理论之间存在同步性。我们的主要发现是：批准投票规则和Leximax规则能够一致且中立地扩展密尔的第一准则（求同法）和第二准则（求异法）。此外，我们探讨了五条准则之间的相互作用。研究结果表明，Leximax规则在保持一致性和中立性的前提下，成功遵循了前四条准则。这些发现凸显了因果推断与社会选择理论之间的复杂联系，为偏好聚合理论在因果推断中的数据聚合应用以及反向应用奠定了基础性关联。
url:87b73fb1a4f18817.title: Revisiting J. S. Mill’s methods: causal inference and social choice theory

url:87cc6dbe44742749.abstract: We study how commodity booms affect productivity using administrative microdata from Chile combining firm exports by product and destination, employer-employee records, and firm-to-firm production networks. Exploiting differential Chinese demand across Chilean commodity products, we measure firms’ exposure to the boom and trace its effects on productivity and resource allocation. We find three mechanisms. First, more exposed firms experience larger revenue increases but no differential productivity gains, channeling revenues into wages and materials. Second, among exposed firms, low-productivity firms expand employment while high-productivity firms do not, hiring workers from more productive employers. Third, domestic suppliers with greater indirect exposure show larger sales and productivity gains. We develop a model with heterogeneous export wedges and labor market frictions in which commodity booms can reduce sectoral productivity by exacerbating input misallocation, consistent with firm-level and aggregate evidence. Calibrated to Chile, this mechanism explains half of the mining TFP decline from 2005 to 2013.
url:87cc6dbe44742749.abstract_zh: 我们利用智利的行政微观数据，结合企业按产品和目的地的出口、雇主-雇员记录以及企业间生产网络，研究大宗商品繁荣如何影响生产率。通过利用中国对不同智利大宗商品产品的差异化需求，我们衡量了企业对该繁荣的暴露程度，并追踪其对生产率和资源配置的影响。我们发现三种机制。首先，暴露程度更高的企业收入增长更大，但生产率提升并无差异，收入被导向工资和原材料。其次，在暴露企业中，低生产率企业扩大就业，而高生产率企业并未如此，它们从生产率更高的雇主处招聘工人。第三，间接暴露更大的国内供应商显示出更高的销售额和生产率提升。我们构建了一个包含异质性出口楔子和劳动力市场摩擦的模型，在该模型中，大宗商品繁荣可能通过加剧投入错配来降低部门生产率，这与企业层面和总体证据一致。以智利为校准对象，该机制解释了2005年至2013年矿业全要素生产率下降的一半。

url:88110fc439c06a2f.abstract: The consensus that surrounded the granting of central bank independence in the pursuit of a price stability oriented monetary policy has been challenged in the aftermath of the global financial crisis, in the light of the rise of populism on the one hand and the expanded mandates of central banks on the other hand. After considering the economic case for independence and the three Ds (distributional, directional and duration effects), the paper examines three different dimensions in the debate of how the rise in populism - or simply general discontent with the status quo - affects central bank independence. Finally, the paper examines how to interpret the legality of central bank mandates, and whether or not central banks have exceeded their powers. This analysis leads us in turn to consider accountability and, in particular, the judicial review of central bank actions and decisions. It is important to have in place adequate mechanisms to ‘guard the guardians’ of monetary and financial stability.
url:88110fc439c06a2f.abstract_zh: 围绕追求价格稳定导向的货币政策而授予中央银行独立性的共识，在全球金融危机后受到了挑战，一方面是由于民粹主义的兴起，另一方面则是中央银行职责范围的扩大。在考量了支持独立性的经济理由及三个D（分配效应、方向效应和持续时间效应）之后，本文探讨了民粹主义抬头——或仅仅是对现状普遍不满——如何影响中央银行独立性的辩论中的三个不同维度。最后，本文审视了如何解读中央银行职责的合法性，以及中央银行是否超越了其权限。这一分析进而引导我们考虑问责制，特别是对中央银行行动与决策的司法审查。建立适当的机制来“守护货币与金融稳定的守护者”至关重要。

url:881f5b0bd814c764.abstract: This paper estimates Korea's long-run real neutral interest rate and quantifies the structural forces behind its decline since 1990. Using semiannual data for 12 advanced economies over 1990-2024, we estimate a cross-country panel state-space model that separates country-specific productivity and demographic trends from common global components. Korea's neutral rate falls from about 1.6% in 1990 to roughly 0.7% in 2024. The model attributes this decline mainly to slower trend productivity growth, the post-2014 reversal in the working-age population share, and spillovers from major advanced economies. Safe-asset market forces also contribute, but supply and demand effects partly offset each other. Counterfactual simulations suggest that removing global spillovers would raise the 2024 estimate by about 0.6 percentage points, while holding the working-age share at its 2014 level would raise it by about 0.5 percentage points. Conditional demographic scenarios imply continued downward pressure absent offsetting structural changes, highlighting implications for monetary policy space.
url:881f5b0bd814c764.abstract_zh: 本文估算了韩国的长期实际中性利率，并量化了1990年以来其下降背后的结构性因素。利用1990-2024年间12个发达经济体的半年度数据，我们估计了一个跨国面板状态空间模型，该模型将国家特定的生产率和人口趋势与共同的全球成分分离开来。韩国的中性利率从1990年的约1.6%下降至2024年的约0.7%。模型将这一下降主要归因于趋势生产率增长放缓、2014年后劳动年龄人口占比的逆转以及主要发达经济体的溢出效应。安全资产市场力量也起到一定作用，但供给和需求效应部分相互抵消。反事实模拟表明，消除全球溢出效应将使2024年的估计值提高约0.6个百分点，而将劳动年龄人口占比维持在2014年水平则会使估计值提高约0.5个百分点。条件性人口情景表明，若无抵消性结构变化，下行压力将持续存在，这对货币政策空间具有重要启示。
url:881f5b0bd814c764.title: Demographic Changes and Neutral Interest Rates: Evidence from theWorld's Fastest-Aging Economy
url:881f5b0bd814c764.title_zh: 人口变化与中性利率：来自全球最快老龄化经济体的证据

url:883d7e3105a1401a.abstract: How Western donors respond to China’s expanding development finance remains contested, with competing hypotheses and limited systematic evidence. This study estimates the effect of Chinese aid on bilateral official development assistance (ODA) provided by donors in the OECD Development Assistance Committee (OECD-DAC). Using a Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood estimator on a four-dimensional panel covering 31 donors, 130 recipients, and 13 sectors from 2001 to 2019, the analysis exploits within-recipient-sector-year variation in Chinese aid shocks and incorporates an extensive set of multi-way fixed effects to address endogeneity concerns. While no average competitive response is detected across all donors, we find consistent evidence that Japan systematically increased its ODA commitments in reaction to Chinese engagement—amounting to an estimated US$ 49.2â€¯billion, or 22% of Japan’s total ODA commitments during the study period. Japan’s competitive responses are concentrated in geographically proximate and more democratic recipients, consistent with its geopolitical and normative priorities. No comparable response is detected for other major OECD-DAC donors, including the United States, Germany, France, and the United Kingdom. Taken together, the results show that Japan’s behaviour illustrates how a traditional donor can strategically deploy ODA as part of a broader foreign policy and industrial strategy, while the muted responses of other donors suggest that the OECD-DAC system remains more resilient than often assumed.
url:883d7e3105a1401a.abstract_zh: 西方捐助者如何应对中国不断扩大的发展融资仍存在争议，相关假设相互竞争且缺乏系统性证据。本研究评估了中国援助对经合组织发展援助委员会（OECD-DAC）捐助者提供的双边官方发展援助（ODA）的影响。采用泊松伪极大似然估计法，基于涵盖2001年至2019年31个捐助者、130个受援国及13个行业的四维面板数据，利用受援国-行业-年份层面的中国援助冲击变异，并纳入广泛的多维固定效应以处理内生性问题。尽管未发现所有捐助者存在平均竞争性反应，但研究一致表明日本系统性地增加了其ODA承诺以应对中国的参与——估计金额达492亿美元，占研究期间日本ODA承诺总额的22%。日本的竞争性反应集中于地理邻近且民主程度较高的受援国，这与其地缘政治和规范性优先事项相符。其他主要OECD-DAC捐助者（包括美国、德国、法国和英国）未发现类似反应。综合来看，结果表明日本的行为展示了传统捐助者如何将ODA作为更广泛外交政策和产业战略的一部分进行战略性部署，而其他捐助者的温和反应则表明OECD-DAC体系比通常假设的更具韧性。
url:883d7e3105a1401a.title: Compete or Retreat? Evidence from aid competition between China and Western donor countries
url:883d7e3105a1401a.title_zh: 竞争还是撤退？来自中国与西方援助国之间援助竞争的证据

url:883dba32286a754e.abstract: Corruption is the great disease of government. It undermines the efficiency of the public sector in many countries around the world. We experimentally study civic engagement (CE) as a constraint on corruption when incentives are stacked against providing CE. We show that CE is powerful in curbing corruption when citizens can encourage each other to provide CE through social approval. Social approval induces strategic complementarity among conditional cooperators which counteracts the strategic substitutability (which tends to limit beneficial effects of CE) built into our design. We also show that civic engagement in the lab is correlated with civic engagement in the field, and that the effects of social approval are surprisingly robust to framing in our setting.
url:883dba32286a754e.abstract_zh: 腐败是政府的一大顽疾，它削弱了全球许多国家公共部门的效率。我们通过实验研究了当激励因素不利于公民参与（CE）时，公民参与如何作为对腐败的制约。研究表明，当公民能通过社会认可相互鼓励提供公民参与时，公民参与在遏制腐败方面效果显著。社会认可在条件合作者之间引发了策略互补性，这抵消了我们设计中固有的策略替代性（这种替代性往往限制公民参与的积极效果）。我们还发现，实验室中的公民参与与实际场域中的公民参与相关联，且在我们的设定中，社会认可的效果对框架的变动出人意料地稳健。
url:883dba32286a754e.title: Civic Engagement as a Constraint on Corruption
url:883dba32286a754e.title_zh: 公民参与对腐败的制约作用

url:884c53853c1fae8e.abstract: In the wake of the 2018–19 U.S.-China tariff hikes, there has been a significant shift in U.S. supply chains, with Mexico emerging as the largest supplier of U.S. imports, surpassing China. This shift has been attributed in part to Mexico gaining a cost advantage over China following the U.S tariffs on China.
url:884c53853c1fae8e.abstract_zh: 在2018-19年美中关税上调之后，美国供应链发生了显著转变，墨西哥超越中国成为美国进口商品的最大供应国。这一转变部分归因于美国对华关税实施后，墨西哥相对于中国获得了成本优势。
url:884c53853c1fae8e.title: Mexico in U.S. Supply Chains: Lessons from 2018-19 Tariffs
url:884c53853c1fae8e.title_zh: 墨西哥在美国供应链中的角色：2018-19年关税的启示

url:8854aedb8b25b482.title: Who bears the cost: Financial frictions and labor markdown
url:8854aedb8b25b482.title_zh: 谁承担成本：金融摩擦与劳动力加价

url:886045a17e6357a7.abstract: This paper investigates a unique policy designed to maintain employment during the privatization of East German firms after the fall of the Iron Curtain. The policy required new owners of the firms to commit to employment targets, with penalties for non-compliance. Using a dynamic model, we highlight three channels through which employment targets impact firms: distorted employment decisions, increased productivity, and higher exit rates. Our empirical analysis, using a novel dataset and instrumental variable approach, confirms these findings. We estimate a 22% points higher annual employment growth rate, a 14% points higher annual productivity growth, and a 3.6% points higher probability of exit for firms with binding employment targets. Our calibrated model further demonstrates that without these targets, aggregate employment would have been 15% lower after 10 years. Additionally, an alternative policy of productivity investment subsidies proved costly and less effective in the short term.
url:886045a17e6357a7.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一项旨在铁幕倒塌后东德企业私有化过程中维持就业的特殊政策。该政策要求企业新所有者承诺就业目标，并对未达标者实施处罚。通过构建动态模型，我们揭示了就业目标影响企业的三个渠道：扭曲的雇佣决策、生产率提升以及退出率上升。基于新颖数据集与工具变量法的实证分析证实了上述发现。我们估算出，受约束就业目标的企业年就业增长率高出22个百分点，年生产率增长率高出14个百分点，退出概率高出3.6个百分点。校准模型进一步表明，若无此类目标，十年后总就业量将降低15%。此外，替代性的生产率投资补贴政策在短期内成本高昂且效果欠佳。
url:886045a17e6357a7.title: Committing to Grow: Privatizations and Firm Dynamics in East Germany
url:886045a17e6357a7.title_zh: 承诺增长：东德的私有化与企业动态

url:8861e83bfece8154.abstract: This paper provides causal evidence on how pension income affects labor supply after retirement. We exploit the introduction of the German Earned Income Pension Credit (Grundrente), which permanently increased pension income for retirees with long contribution histories and comparatively low lifetime earnings. The reform generates exogenous variation in non-labor income without creating additional labor supply distortions, allowing us to isolate pure income effects. Using administrative data covering the universe of German retirees and a difference-in-differences design, we find that a 1,200 euro increase in annual pension income reduces unconditional labor earnings by approximately 122 euros, implying a marginal propensity to earn out of unearned income of -0.1. Two thirds of this response reflects extensive margin adjustments, which operate through both increased exit and reduced re-entry, with the remainder driven by intensive margin reductions. Effects are stronger for younger, more labor-market-attached cohorts.
url:8861e83bfece8154.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于养老金收入如何影响退休后劳动供给的因果证据。我们利用德国劳动收入养老金补贴（Grundrente）的引入，该政策永久性地提高了缴费年限长且终身收入相对较低的退休人员的养老金收入。这项改革在非劳动收入中产生了外生变化，且未造成额外的劳动供给扭曲，从而使我们能够分离出纯粹的收入效应。基于覆盖德国全体退休人员的行政数据及双重差分设计，我们发现年度养老金收入增加1200欧元会使无条件劳动收入减少约122欧元，这意味着非劳动收入的边际劳动收入倾向为-0.1。其中三分之二的效应来自劳动参与边际调整，既通过增加退出也通过减少重新进入实现，其余部分则由劳动强度边际调整驱动。对于更年轻、劳动市场依附性更强的群体，该效应更为显著。
url:8861e83bfece8154.title: DP21645 Pension Income and Post-Retirement Labor Supply
url:8861e83bfece8154.title_zh: DP21645 养老金收入与退休后劳动供给

url:8863600505f057f3.abstract: We study the intergenerational distributional effects of carbon pricing during the green transition in an overlapping-generations New Keynesian model calibrated to euro-area household micro data. Climate policy generates systematic redistribution across cohorts through two channels: a labor-income channel, driven by wage compression and lower labor demand, and a financial-wealth channel, driven by asset revaluation and higher real returns. The labor- income channel dominates quantitatively , generating persistent welfare losses of up to 6 percent in permanent-consumption equivalents for working-age households, while retirees experience comparable gains. Revenue recycling can mitigate these asymmetries, requiring 40 to 68 per- cent of carbon-tax revenues to be directed toward financial-income tax relief. Monetary policy has limited influence on the overall redistributive pattern.
url:8863600505f057f3.abstract_zh: 我们研究了绿色转型过程中碳定价的代际分配效应，基于一个以欧元区家庭微观数据校准的世代交叠新凯恩斯模型。气候政策通过两个渠道在代际间产生系统性再分配：一是劳动收入渠道，由工资压缩和劳动力需求下降驱动；二是金融财富渠道，由资产重估和实际回报率上升驱动。劳动收入渠道在数量上占主导地位，导致劳动年龄家庭的永久消费等价福利损失高达6%，而退休群体则获得相应收益。收入循环利用可缓解这种不对称性，需将40%至68%的碳税收入用于金融收入税减免。货币政策对整体再分配格局的影响有限。
url:8863600505f057f3.title: Intergenerational Redistribution in the Green Transition
url:8863600505f057f3.title_zh: 绿色转型中的代际再分配

url:8892146d114970f0.title: Threshold spatial panel regression with fixed effects
url:8892146d114970f0.title_zh: 固定效应阈值空间面板回归

url:8892ca415299b348.abstract: Abstract Canonical urban models fail to jointly account for flexible housing demand, non-degenerate city sizes, and observed urban systems. We introduce a unifying urban framework based on price-independent generalized linear (PIGL) preferences in which housing is a necessity. Non-homothetic housing demand generates income effects that cause urban costs to scale more strongly with population than wages, restoring a unique interior efficient city size under standard assumptions. The framework nests existing canonical models, remains tractable, and is consistent with key empirical regularities, including Zipf’s law and observed housing price elasticities. We also encapsulate a monocentric city model into our framework.
url:8892ca415299b348.abstract_zh: 摘要 经典城市模型未能同时解释灵活的住房需求、非退化城市规模及观察到的城市体系。我们引入一个基于价格独立广义线性（PIGL）偏好的统一城市框架，其中住房为必需品。非齐次住房需求产生收入效应，导致城市成本随人口增长的幅度超过工资，从而在标准假设下恢复唯一的内生有效城市规模。该框架涵盖现有经典模型，保持可操作性，并与关键经验规律（包括齐普夫定律和观察到的住房价格弹性）相一致。我们还将单中心城市模型纳入此框架。
url:8892ca415299b348.title: A Unified Urban Model With Non-Homothetic Housing Demand
url:8892ca415299b348.title_zh: 非位似住房需求下的统一城市模型

url:88992722fb3fc6f9.abstract: We study central bank asset purchases (APs) in bond markets where rational investors face position limits and learn from private signals and market prices. APs affect information aggregation, altering the informativeness of prices and their sensitivity to fundamentals through an information channel distinct from risk-premium effects. Consistent with this mechanism, we find that U.S. Federal Reserve APs strengthened the pass-through of labor market news to Treasury yields. Dispersed beliefs and position limits also provide a microfoundation for the optimality of APs.
url:88992722fb3fc6f9.abstract_zh: 我们研究理性投资者面临头寸限制并从私人信号和市场价格中学习的债券市场中，央行资产购买（APs）的影响。资产购买通过一个区别于风险溢价效应的信息渠道，影响信息聚合，改变价格的信息含量及其对基本面的敏感度。与这一机制一致，我们发现美联储资产购买增强了劳动力市场消息对国债收益率的传导效应。信念分散与头寸限制也为资产购买的最优性提供了微观基础。
url:88992722fb3fc6f9.title: The Information Channel of Asset Purchases

url:889df9ae4be1ab3a.abstract: We propose a data-based approximation of the effects of trade sanctions. We validate the approximation by comparing it with exact responses simulated from a canonical multi-country multi-sector model. The approximation is palatable for a broad range of elasticities of substitution, except for extremely low ones. It is based on a decomposition of high order trade according to destination or inputs markets and can readily be computed on the basis of international input-output data. As such it provides a practical shortcut to evaluating the consequences of trade sanctions without having to make difficult calibration choices. We implement our approximation to evaluate the consequences of trade sanctions between Europe and Russia. Our approximated effects are within the range of existing estimates, but they mask vast asymmetries. First, the effects of sanctions are about fifteen times larger on Russia than on Europe. Second, the effects within Europe are enormously asymmetric, with much larger consequences on ex-“satellite” countries of the Soviet Union than on large Western European economies. We then adapt our approach to show that the most affected European countries do not typically have access to substitute markets and are in fact highly dependent on Russia. We show that this extreme dependence on Russia is at least partly explained by the existence of specific energy transporting infrastructure (pipelines) that appear to constrain tightly the production of electricity in those heavily affected East European economies. These findings illustrate the practical potentiality of our approximation in a variety of different contexts.
url:889df9ae4be1ab3a.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于数据的贸易制裁效应近似方法。通过将其与经典多国多部门模型模拟的精确响应进行对比，验证了该近似的有效性。除极低替代弹性情形外，该近似在广泛的替代弹性范围内均具有适用性。其原理基于按目的地或投入品市场分解的高阶贸易结构，可直接利用国际投入产出数据计算。因此，该方法为评估贸易制裁后果提供了实用捷径，无需进行复杂的校准参数选择。我们将该近似方法应用于评估欧俄贸易制裁的后果，所得效应估计值处于现有研究区间内，但揭示了巨大的非对称性：首先，制裁对俄罗斯的影响约为对欧洲影响的十五倍；其次，欧洲内部效应呈现极端非对称性，前苏联"卫星国"遭受的冲击远大于西欧主要经济体。进一步调整方法后发现，受影响最严重的欧洲国家通常缺乏替代市场，且对俄罗斯存在高度依赖。研究表明，这种极端依赖至少部分源于特定能源运输基础设施（管道）的存在——这些设施严重制约了受冲击严重的东欧经济体的电力生产。上述发现充分展示了该近似方法在不同情境下的实践潜力。
url:889df9ae4be1ab3a.title: An Empirical Approximation of the Effects of Trade Sanctions with an Application to Russia
url:889df9ae4be1ab3a.title_zh: 贸易制裁效果的实证近似：以俄罗斯为例

url:88a1ca8544b16682.abstract: When the US imposed sweeping tariff increases in 2025, most economic forecasters predicted a sharp rise in consumer prices and significant import disruption. Instead, retail prices rose modestly and import-dependent sectors held up. This column uses data for the 50 largest US trading partners to show that foreign exporters absorbed roughly 40–50% of the 2025 US tariff increases through lower export prices – much more than earlier studies suggested. The absorption was highly unequal: dominant suppliers bore the bulk, while smaller ones passed the tariff on almost fully. The aggregate result vindicates optimal tariff theory. It does not mean the tariffs made America better off.
url:88a1ca8544b16682.abstract_zh: 当美国于2025年实施大规模关税上调时，多数经济预测者预计消费者价格将急剧上升，进口将遭受重大干扰。然而，零售价格仅温和上涨，依赖进口的行业也保持了稳定。本文利用美国前50大贸易伙伴的数据表明，外国出口商通过降低出口价格吸收了2025年美国关税上调的约40%至50%——这一比例远高于早期研究的估计。这种吸收效应极不均衡：主导供应商承担了大部分负担，而较小的供应商则几乎将关税完全转嫁出去。总体结果印证了最优关税理论。但这并不意味着关税使美国变得更富裕。
url:88a1ca8544b16682.title: Foreign exporters absorbed nearly half of the 2025 US tariff shock
url:88a1ca8544b16682.title_zh: 外国出口商吸收了2025年美国关税冲击的近一半

url:88a928b56832db98.abstract: Social media platforms are often credited with empowering grassroots movements in the pursuit of political freedoms. In this paper, we show how social media can also be exploited by political elites to undermine democratic institutions, using the January 6th, 2021 Capitol insurrection as a case study. We present three main findings. First, by exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in Twitter usage, we document that social media exposure predicts participation in the Capitol attack, donations for anti-democratic causes, beliefs in election fraud, and support for the January 6th rioters. Second, Donald Trump's tweets questioning the election's integrity were followed by spikes in "Stop the Steal" activity on Twitter and pro-Trump donations originating from high Twitter usage counties. Third, the insurrection and Trump's account deletion were followed by a decrease in the public expression of toxic political and "Stop the Steal" messaging by pro-Trump users on Twitter, but had little effect on privately held beliefs about the election outcome and pro-Trump donations.
url:88a928b56832db98.abstract_zh: 社交媒体平台常被视为赋能草根运动、追求政治自由的工具。本文以2021年1月6日国会山暴乱为案例，展示社交媒体如何被政治精英利用以削弱民主制度。我们提出三项主要发现。首先，通过利用Twitter使用中看似外生的变异，我们记录了社交媒体接触能预测参与国会山袭击、为反民主事业捐款、相信选举舞弊以及支持1月6日暴乱者的行为。其次，唐纳德·特朗普质疑选举公正性的推文之后，Twitter上“停止偷窃”活动及来自高Twitter使用率县的支持特朗普捐款出现激增。第三，暴乱事件及特朗普账号被删除后，Twitter上支持特朗普用户公开发表的毒性政治及“停止偷窃”信息有所减少，但对私下持有的关于选举结果及支持特朗普捐款的信念影响甚微。
url:88a928b56832db98.title: Social Media vs. Democracy: Evidence from the January 6th Insurrection
url:88a928b56832db98.title_zh: 社交媒体与民主：来自1月6日暴乱的证据

url:88b38be3ba2c3e00.abstract: How does the location of affordable housing affect the distribution of assistance, tenant welfare, and segregation? Using administrative data, we firs...
url:88b38be3ba2c3e00.abstract_zh: 经济适用房的地理位置如何影响援助分配、租户福利及居住隔离？利用行政数据，我们首先...
url:88b38be3ba2c3e00.title: Where to Build Affordable Housing? Evaluating the Tradeoffs of Location
url:88b38be3ba2c3e00.title_zh: 经济适用房应建在何处？评估选址的权衡

url:88be3b3b3c5228f3.abstract: Do the determinants of technology adoption depend on technological architecture? Using administrative data on Turkish firms from 2021 to 2024, we compare the adoption of traditional and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI). We show that GenAI adoption is driven by workforce skill intensity and is not positively associated with firm size, whereas traditional AI depends on both scale and skills. Firms that adopt both technologies are distinct and represent the most persistent adoption mode. Conditional on adoption, the skill-to-size ratio governs technology choice, and transition dynamics indicate a sequential process in which firms adopt GenAI before expanding to hybrid use. Exploiting the release of ChatGPT as a quasi-experimental reduction in access costs, we find that high-skill firms differentially increased GenAI adoption, while firm size played a limited role. These results suggest that the canonical size-based diffusion pattern is not universal but depends on the cost structure of technologies, with implications for innovation policy and productivity dispersion.
url:88be3b3b3c5228f3.abstract_zh: 技术采纳的决定因素是否取决于技术架构？利用2021至2024年土耳其企业的行政数据，我们比较了传统人工智能与生成式人工智能（GenAI）的采纳情况。我们发现，GenAI的采纳受劳动力技能密集度驱动，且与企业规模无正相关关系，而传统人工智能则同时依赖于规模与技能。同时采纳两种技术的企业具有独特性，并代表了最持久的采纳模式。在条件于采纳的情况下，技能与规模之比主导技术选择，且转换动态表明存在一个序贯过程，即企业先采纳GenAI，再扩展至混合使用。利用ChatGPT发布作为获取成本准实验性降低的契机，我们发现高技能企业差异化地增加了GenAI采纳，而企业规模作用有限。这些结果表明，基于规模的经典扩散模式并非普遍适用，而是取决于技术的成本结构，这对创新政策和生产率离散度具有启示意义。
url:88be3b3b3c5228f3.title: Skills, Not Scale: GenAI and Technology Adoption
url:88be3b3b3c5228f3.title_zh: 技能，而非规模：生成式人工智能与技术采纳

url:88cd3ec01634071c.title: Transfer estimates for causal effects across heterogeneous sites
url:88cd3ec01634071c.title_zh: 异质性站点间因果效应的迁移估计

url:88d8f1cb3fad879e.abstract: The UK economy experienced significant macroeconomic adjustments following the 2016 referendum on its withdrawal from the European Union. To understand these adjustments, this paper presents empirical facts using novel UK macroeconomic data and estimates a small open economy model with tradable and non-tradable sectors. We demonstrate that the referendum outcome can be interpreted as news about a future decline in productivity growth in the tradable sector. An immediate fall in the relative price of non-tradable goods induces a temporary “sweet spot” for tradable producers. Economic activity in the tradable sector expands in the short run, while the non-tradable sector contracts. Aggregate output, consumption and investment growth decelerate.
url:88d8f1cb3fad879e.abstract_zh: 英国经济在2016年关于退出欧盟的公投后经历了显著的宏观经济调整。为理解这些调整，本文利用新颖的英国宏观经济数据呈现实证事实，并估算了一个包含可贸易与非可贸易部门的小型开放经济模型。我们证明，公投结果可被解读为关于可贸易部门未来生产率增长下降的消息。非可贸易品相对价格的即时下跌为可贸易生产者创造了一个暂时的“甜蜜点”。短期内，可贸易部门的经济活动扩张，而非可贸易部门则收缩。总产出、消费和投资增长均放缓。
url:88d8f1cb3fad879e.title: The Brexit Vote, Productivity Growth and Macroeconomic Adjustments in the United Kingdom
url:88d8f1cb3fad879e.title_zh: 英国脱欧公投、生产率增长与英国宏观经济调整

url:88e4154a15cf7c76.abstract: Analysis of population aging is typically framed in terms of chronological age. However, chronological age itself is not necessarily deeply informative about the aging process. This paper reviews literature and conducts empirical analyses aimed at investigating whether chronological age is a reliable proxy for physiological functioning when used in models of economic behavior and outcomes. We show that chronological age is an unreliable proxy for physiological functioning due to appreciable differences in how aging unfolds across people, health domains, and over time. We further demonstrate that chronological age either fails to predict economic variables when used in lieu of physiological functioning, or that it predicts additional effects on economic behavior and outcomes that are largely unrelated to physiological aging. Continued reliance on chronological age as a proxy for physiological functioning might impede the ability of societies to fully harness the benefits of increasing longevity.
url:88e4154a15cf7c76.abstract_zh: 人口老龄化的分析通常以实际年龄为框架。然而，实际年龄本身并不一定对老龄化过程具有深刻的信息价值。本文回顾相关文献并进行实证分析，旨在探究在实际年龄作为经济行为与结果模型中的代理变量时，其是否能可靠地反映生理功能。我们表明，由于老龄化在不同人群、健康领域及时间维度上的显著差异，实际年龄作为生理功能的代理指标并不可靠。进一步地，我们证明，当实际年龄替代生理功能使用时，要么无法预测经济变量，要么预测出的经济行为与结果额外效应与生理老龄化基本无关。持续依赖实际年龄作为生理功能的代理变量，可能会阻碍社会充分利用寿命延长带来的益处。
url:88e4154a15cf7c76.title: On the Limits of Chronological Age

url:88ee82b55925acee.abstract: We study the liquidity choice of a bank subject to rollover risk and support from a lender of last resort (LLR) and study the consequences for bank stability, funding costs, and liquidity regulation. The liquidity choice balances forgoing profitable yet illiquid investment with fewer panic runs and cheaper debt. A higher LLR penalty rate increases bank liquidity and has a V-shaped effect on ex-ante bank stability. Turning to normative implications, the availability of the LLR reduces welfare for a large social cost of bank failure. The anticipation of ex-post support mitigates panic runs but induces lower bank liquidity ex ante, which increases funding costs and the frequency of bank failure. Liquidity regulation aligns private with social incentives and increases the social value of LLR support.
url:88ee82b55925acee.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一家面临展期风险并接受最后贷款人（LLR）支持的银行的流动性选择，并探讨了其对银行稳定性、融资成本及流动性监管的影响。流动性选择需要在放弃盈利但缺乏流动性的投资与减少恐慌性挤兑及降低债务成本之间进行权衡。更高的LLR惩罚利率会提升银行流动性，并对事前银行稳定性产生V形效应。从规范意义上看，LLR的可得性在银行破产社会成本较高时会降低社会福利。对事后支持的预期虽能缓解恐慌性挤兑，但会降低银行事前流动性，从而增加融资成本及银行破产频率。流动性监管能够协调私人激励与社会激励，并提升LLR支持的社会价值。
url:88ee82b55925acee.title: Bank Runs, Lender of Last Resort, and Liquidity Regulation
url:88ee82b55925acee.title_zh: 银行挤兑、最后贷款人与流动性监管

url:88f0b1426175d348.abstract: Why do political campaigns so often yield unexpected results? We address this question by separately estimating the direct effect of a campaign on targeted voters and the indirect effect on others in the same social environment. Partnering with a local NGO during Argentina’s 2023 presidential election, we randomized the distribution of leaflets providing an expert assessment of the consequences of the potentially dangerous proposals by the outsider candidate Javier Milei. Exploiting Argentina’s unique sub-precinct election reporting system, we show that the campaign reduced Milei’s support among directly treated voters, as expected, but increased his support among untreated voters in treated precincts, producing a backfiring, net-positive effect for Milei. A pre-registered replication confirmed these opposite-signed effects. Using theory and a survey experiment, we show that the minority of voters who disbelieved the campaign were more motivated to discuss it with peers, convincing them to support Milei. This mobilization effect appears especially likely when campaigns criticize outsider candidates. Our results highlight how campaigns aimed at anti-elite candidates can unintentionally mobilize support for them.
url:88f0b1426175d348.abstract_zh: 为何政治竞选活动常常产生出人意料的结果？我们通过分别估算竞选活动对目标选民的直接影响，以及对同一社会环境中其他选民的间接影响来探讨这一问题。在阿根廷2023年总统大选期间，我们与一家当地非政府组织合作，随机分发传单，内容为专家对局外人候选人哈维尔·米莱提出的潜在危险提案后果的评估。利用阿根廷独特的次选区选举报告系统，我们发现，该竞选活动如预期般降低了直接受干预选民对米莱的支持率，但反而提高了受干预选区中未受干预选民对他的支持率，从而对米莱产生了适得其反的净正面效应。一项预先注册的复制实验证实了这些符号相反的效应。通过理论分析和调查实验，我们证明，少数不相信该竞选活动的选民更有动力与同伴讨论此事，从而说服他们支持米莱。这种动员效应在竞选活动批评局外人候选人时尤为显著。我们的研究结果凸显了针对反精英候选人的竞选活动如何可能无意中为其动员支持。

url:89753faae5705b13.abstract: Market thinness can be an important determinant of the riskiness of stock returns, because it reduces the reliability of stock prices as predictors of future dividends. This paper analyses the relationship between market size and risk as the outcome of rational expectations equilibrium in a multiasset model with transaction costs, and shows that: (i) the conditional and measured variance of stock returns should be higher for thin issues ceteris paribus, and (ii) this thinness-variability relationship should arise only from the unsystematic component of the variance. These predictions are tested on data from the Milan Stock Exchange and appear to be supported by the evidence.
url:89753faae5705b13.abstract_zh: 市场流动性不足可能是股票收益风险性的重要决定因素，因为它降低了股票价格作为未来股息预测指标的可靠性。本文通过构建包含交易成本的多资产模型，将市场规模与风险的关系分析为理性预期均衡的结果，并表明：（i）在其他条件相同的情况下，流动性较差的股票其条件方差与已实现方差应更高；（ii）这种流动性-波动性关系应仅源于方差的非系统性成分。这些预测在米兰证券交易所的数据中得到检验，且实证结果支持上述结论。

url:899393fa29a6edb6.abstract: Do bettors misperceive expected returns, and does bringing their beliefs closer to the regulatory benchmark change betting and financial allocation decisions? Using a survey experiment in Brazil, we document that bettors are motivated by financial gain and entertainment and expect to receive approximately R$1.75 for every R$1 wagered, far above the R$0.85 regulatory benchmark. A randomized information treatment lowers bettors’ reported beliefs about expected returns by 28% to 37% but reduces the share of windfall income allocated to betting by only 2.1 percentage points. The treatment has a larger effect on the probability of allocating any money to betting than on the amount allocated among those who continue to bet. A parsimonious model rationalizes these findings: when betting provides substantial direct utility, more accurate beliefs have limited effects on betting expenditure and saving. Still, reducing overconfidence limits expected wealth losses, because overconfident bettors consume more today in anticipation of betting winnings that do not materialize on average. Information disclosure may therefore make beliefs more accurate without substantially reducing betting expenditure.
url:899393fa29a6edb6.abstract_zh: 投注者是否误解了预期回报，而将他们的信念调整至更接近监管基准是否会改变其投注及财务分配决策？通过在巴西进行的一项调查实验，我们发现投注者既受财务收益也受娱乐动机驱动，他们预期每投注1雷亚尔能获得约1.75雷亚尔的回报，远高于0.85雷亚尔的监管基准。一项随机信息干预使投注者对预期回报的报告信念降低了28%至37%，但仅将意外之财收入中用于投注的比例减少了2.1个百分点。该干预对是否将任何资金用于投注的概率影响大于对继续投注者投注金额的影响。一个简约模型合理化了这些发现：当投注提供大量直接效用时，更准确的信念对投注支出和储蓄的影响有限。尽管如此，减少过度自信限制了预期财富损失，因为过度自信的投注者预期到平均而言不会实现的投注收益，从而在当前消费更多。因此，信息披露可能使信念更加准确，而不会大幅减少投注支出。
url:899393fa29a6edb6.title: DP21834 Overconfidence and Financial Behavior in Online Betting Markets

url:89a0d60462012034.abstract: This study investigates the effect of the large shock to energy prices following the Russian invasion of Ukraine on bank credit to firms. To isolate the causal effect of the shock, it compares bank lending to high-energy-intensive firms to that of similar low-energy-intensive firms. Following the shock, bank credit to high-energy-intensive firms persistently declined, while their interest rates on new loans rose and other loan terms tightened. Across the distribution, safer firms reduced outstanding credit lines and paid unchanged interest rates on new bank loans, while riskier firms borrowed at higher interest rates. JEL Classification: G21, G32, Q43
url:89a0d60462012034.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了俄乌冲突后能源价格大幅冲击对企业银行信贷的影响。为隔离该冲击的因果效应，本文对比了银行对高能耗企业与类似低能耗企业的贷款情况。冲击发生后，银行对高能耗企业的信贷持续下降，同时其新增贷款利率上升，其他贷款条件收紧。从分布特征来看，风险较低的企业减少了未偿信贷额度，且新增银行贷款利率保持不变；而风险较高的企业则以更高利率借款。JEL分类号：G21, G32, Q43

url:89b1f98ab906c2c0.abstract: Managing chronic medical conditions requires daily adherence to pharmaceutical regimens, yet low-income families frequently face unstable budget constraints that force immediate spending trade-offs between nutrition and out-of-pocket healthcare costs. This paper explores how the time since benefit receipt of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) affects healthcare access for low-income families managing chronic medical conditions. Empirical estimation reveals significant fluctuations in medication use, particularly during Days 20–23, when benefits are nearly exhausted. We observe a unique dual-peak pattern in medication use: an initial spike right after benefits are received (Days 0–3) due to immediate shopping disruptions, followed by a sharp increase in medication rationing around three weeks later, driven by liquidity constraints. We also identify sub-population heterogeneity based on benefit adequacy and food insecurity. Low-allotment households exhibit a 23 percentage point increase in medication non-adherence early in the cycle (Days 8–11) compared to those with higher allotments. Conversely, while high-allotment households remain stable early on, their adherence rates decline significantly by the third week, indicating depleted financial buffers. These results suggest that improving SNAP benefit amounts and adjusting issuance frequency could enhance medication adherence and alleviate healthcare access challenges for vulnerable families.
url:89b1f98ab906c2c0.abstract_zh: 管理慢性疾病需要每日坚持用药方案，然而低收入家庭常常面临不稳定的预算约束，迫使他们在营养与自付医疗费用之间做出即时的支出权衡。本文探讨了补充营养援助计划（SNAP）福利领取后的时间长度如何影响管理慢性疾病的低收入家庭的医疗可及性。实证估计揭示了药物使用的显著波动，尤其是在福利即将耗尽时的第20至23天。我们观察到药物使用中一种独特的双峰模式：福利领取后立即出现初始峰值（第0至3天），源于即时的购物中断效应；随后约三周后，受流动性约束驱动，药物配给现象急剧增加。我们还基于福利充足性和食品不安全状况识别出亚群体异质性。低配额家庭在周期早期（第8至11天）的药物不依从率比高配额家庭高出23个百分点。相反，高配额家庭在早期保持稳定，但其依从率在第三周显著下降，表明财务缓冲已耗尽。这些结果表明，提高SNAP福利金额并调整发放频率可以增强药物依从性，并缓解弱势家庭面临的医疗可及性挑战。
url:89b1f98ab906c2c0.title: SNAP Cycle and Cost-Related Delays in Medical Care
url:89b1f98ab906c2c0.title_zh: SNAP周期与医疗护理中的费用相关延误

url:89c59dd2b67c8109.abstract: Informal commercialisation of agricultural products is widespread in Colombian food systems. It plays a central role in supporting rural livelihoods and affordable food access, but may limit value creation, create fiscal pressures, and undermine the evidence base for policymaking. This paper examines why small-scale farmers in Colombia rely on informal markets, with particular attention to Afro-Colombian and Indigenous communities. It situates informality within the broader context of rural areas and the structure of the agri-food supply chain. It proposes a characterisation of the main barriers that hinder small-scale farmers’ engagement with formal buyers, drawing on desk research and interviews with government officials, industry stakeholders, community representatives, and academics. It suggests that formal market participation could be facilitated by prioritising the provision of rural public goods, improving data and evidence on informality in food systems, better aligning agricultural policies with producer-financed parafiscal funds, and adopting a demand-driven approach to agricultural policy.
url:89c59dd2b67c8109.abstract_zh: 农产品非正规商业化在哥伦比亚食品体系中普遍存在。它在支撑农村生计和保障食品可负担性方面发挥着核心作用，但可能限制价值创造、造成财政压力，并削弱政策制定的证据基础。本文探讨了哥伦比亚小农户依赖非正规市场的原因，特别关注非裔哥伦比亚人和原住民社区。研究将非正规性置于农村地区及农业食品供应链结构的更广泛背景下，通过案头研究及对政府官员、行业利益相关者、社区代表和学者的访谈，提出了阻碍小农户与正规买家合作的主要障碍特征。研究表明，通过优先提供农村公共产品、改善食品体系中非正规性的数据与证据、更好地协调农业政策与生产者资助的准财政基金，以及采取需求导向的农业政策方法，可促进正规市场参与。
url:89c59dd2b67c8109.title: Inclusive food systems and market development: Insights from Colombia
url:89c59dd2b67c8109.title_zh: 包容性粮食体系与市场发展：来自哥伦比亚的启示

url:89d27642a6b06576.abstract: Using genealogical records of Chinese families from 1300 to 1920, this paper examines how the fundamental wheels of change identified by Unified Growth Theory operated within the Ming–Qing context. It finds that families with moderate fertility were more likely to attain higher levels of education and to experience greater reproductive success across generations, revealing a trade-off between high fertility and long-term lineage outcomes. Employing negative binomial regression and instrumental variable methods, the study shows that a preference for child quality conferred an evolutionary advantage—suggesting that, if this evolutionary pattern was present globally during the epoch of stagnation, it may have been central to the demographic transition and the emergence of modern economic growth.
url:89d27642a6b06576.abstract_zh: 本文利用1300年至1920年间中国家族谱系记录，考察统一增长理论所识别的变革基本动力在明清时期的运作机制。研究发现，适度生育水平的家族更可能获得更高教育成就，并在代际间实现更优的繁衍成功，揭示了高生育率与长期宗族发展之间的权衡关系。通过采用负二项回归与工具变量方法，研究表明对子女质量的偏好赋予了进化优势——这意味着，若该进化模式在停滞时代全球范围内普遍存在，则可能对人口转型与现代经济增长的出现具有核心作用。
url:89d27642a6b06576.title: Evolutionary advantage of moderate fertility during Ming–Qing China: a unified growth perspective
url:89d27642a6b06576.title_zh: 明清中国适度生育的进化优势：统一增长视角

url:89f3883ac768061c.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model of seigniorage in which economies' equilibrium paths reflect the ongoing strategic interaction between an optimizing government and a rational public. The model extends existing positive models of monetary policy and inflation by explicitly incorporating the intertemporal linkages among budget deficits, debt and inflation. A central finding is that the public's rational responses to government policies may well create incentives for the government to reduce inflation and the public debt over time. A sufficiently myopic government may, however, provoke a rising equilibrium path of inflation and public debt.
url:89f3883ac768061c.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个铸币税的动态模型，其中经济体的均衡路径反映了最优化政府与理性公众之间持续的策略互动。该模型通过明确纳入预算赤字、债务与通胀之间的跨期关联，拓展了现有的货币政策和通胀实证模型。核心发现是：公众对政府政策的理性反应很可能随时间推移为政府创造降低通胀和公共债务的激励。然而，一个足够短视的政府可能引发通胀与公共债务不断攀升的均衡路径。

url:8a0ce4f1605d013e.abstract: A prediction-market share is read as a probability about an event. In an oracle-settled market the cash flow is fixed not by the event but by the outcome that the resolution mechanism certifies, so the price can come apart from the event. We test whether prices forecast the event or the adjudication by reading them inside the on-chain settlement window of disputed Polymarket markets, the interval between a bonded proposer’s assertion of the outcome and the UMA token vote that fixes the payoff. Inside that window the real-world event is already frozen while the payoff is still pending, so a discount on the asserted-correct claim cannot be ordinary forecasting of an unrealized event. Using 233 disputed markets with a clear audited rule-correct winner, coded by a search-grounded language-model audit formed independently of how the oracle ruled and matched to each market’s UMA Optimistic Oracle lifecycle, we find the token vote overturns the audited winner in 12.4 percent of markets, an upper bound inherited from the coding model. Six hours after the first dispute the audited-correct claim already trades at a discount that is 0.83 higher in markets the oracle will overturn, and the discount climbs toward one as the vote approaches while the upheld claim falls toward zero. The pricing pattern survives the choice of coding model, the removal of deadline questions, restriction to the markets that escalate to the vote, and a treatment limited to the hand-verified overturns. The complete UMA voting record shows the deciding votes to be broad and near unanimous, and the dispute-time price predicts the vote share itself. Prices in contested prediction markets are therefore best read not as beliefs about the world but as forecasts of how a decentralized rule will be adjudicated.
url:8a0ce4f1605d013e.abstract_zh: 预测市场的份额被解读为关于某一事件的概率。在由预言机结算的市场中，现金流并非由事件本身决定，而是由解决机制认证的结果决定，因此价格可能与事件脱节。我们通过在Polymarket争议市场的链上结算窗口内解读价格，来检验价格预测的是事件还是裁决——该窗口介于有担保的提议者断言结果与UMA代币投票确定支付之间的间隔。在此窗口内，现实世界的事件已经冻结，而支付仍悬而未决，因此对断言正确主张的折价不能被视为对未实现事件的常规预测。利用233个具有明确审计规则正确赢家的争议市场，这些市场通过基于搜索的语言模型审计编码，独立于预言机的裁决方式，并与每个市场的UMA乐观预言机生命周期相匹配，我们发现代币投票在12.4%的市场中推翻了审计赢家，这一上限源自编码模型。在首次争议六小时后，审计正确的主张已经以折价交易，在预言机将推翻的市场中，该折价高出0.83，且随着投票临近，折价趋近于1，而被维持的主张则趋近于零。这一定价模式在编码模型选择、剔除截止日期问题、限制于升级至投票的市场以及仅限人工验证推翻的处理中均保持稳健。完整的UMA投票记录显示，决定性投票广泛且近乎一致，争议时价格本身预测了投票份额。因此，争议预测市场中的价格最好不被解读为对世界的信念，而是对去中心化规则如何被裁决的预测。

url:8a4d77e32aaa0e1a.abstract: this paper is to understand the implications for consumption and portfolio choice of the separation of an investor?s risk aversion and elasticity of intertemporal substitution that is made possible by recursive utility, in contrast to expected utility, where the two are governed by the same parameter. In particular, we study exactly how risk aversion and elasticity of intertemporal substitution affect optimal dynamic consumption and portfolio decisions. For a three-date, discrete-time model with a stochastic interest rate, we obtain an exact analytic solution for the optimal consumption and portfolio policies. We find that, in general, the consumption and portfolio decisions depend on both risk aversion and the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. Only in the case where the investment opportunity set is constant, is the optimal portfolio weight independent of the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. We also find that the size of risk aversion relative to unity determines the sign of the intertemporal hedging component in the optimal portfolio, while elasticity of intertemporal substitution affects only the magnitude of the hedging component.
url:8a4d77e32aaa0e1a.abstract_zh: 本文旨在理解递归效用（recursive utility）相较于预期效用（expected utility）所实现的投资者风险厌恶（risk aversion）与跨期替代弹性（elasticity of intertemporal substitution）分离对消费与投资组合选择的影响——在预期效用框架下，两者由同一参数决定。具体而言，我们精确研究了风险厌恶与跨期替代弹性如何影响最优动态消费与投资组合决策。针对一个包含随机利率的三期离散时间模型，我们推导出最优消费与投资组合策略的精确解析解。研究发现，一般而言，消费与投资组合决策同时取决于风险厌恶与跨期替代弹性。仅当投资机会集恒定时，最优投资组合权重才独立于跨期替代弹性。此外，风险厌恶相对于1的大小决定了最优投资组合中跨期对冲成分的符号，而跨期替代弹性仅影响该对冲成分的规模。

url:8a890cf7a83c9e84.abstract: Motivated by the recent surge in union drives, we present a theoretical model of the factors that influence unionization. An employee seeking to unionize their workplace assembles organizers to persuade coworkers to vote in favor. If unionization benefits workers, it is more likely to succeed when the organizers are credible. Credibility depends on the organizers not being overly biased and/or bearing significant orga- nizational costs. Our theory explains why grassroots movements, rather than estab- lished unions, often succeed in organizing workplaces. Interestingly, the likelihood of successful unionization, when it benefits workers, is non-monotonic with respect to organizational costs. When such costs are low, a firm that opposes unionization and targets organizers may paradoxically increase the chances of success. However, the unionization drive is ineffective if the firm’s opposition is sufficiently strong, as this makes organizational costs prohibitive.
url:8a890cf7a83c9e84.abstract_zh: 受近期工会组织浪潮的启发，我们构建了一个理论模型，探讨影响工会化的因素。寻求在工作场所建立工会的员工会召集组织者，以说服同事投票支持。若工会化对工人有利，则当组织者具有可信度时，成功可能性更大。可信度取决于组织者不过度偏颇及/或承担显著的组织成本。我们的理论解释了为何草根运动而非既有工会往往能在组织工作场所中取得成功。有趣的是，当工会化对工人有利时，成功概率与组织成本呈非单调关系。当此类成本较低时，反对工会化并针对组织者的企业可能反而增加成功机会。然而，若企业反对力度足够强大，使组织成本变得难以承受，则工会化运动将无效。

url:8aa0fd7ab0344496.abstract: This paper examines how monetary policy announcements affect firms’ employment expectations. Using German survey data, we combine high-frequency monetary policy surprises with survey response dates to identify the immediate and dynamic effects of monetary policy on firm-level expectations and subsequent employment. Contractionary shocks lead firms to revise employment plans downward immediately and persistently, eventually reducing employment growth. Initially, hiring plans are reduced, while layoffs increase later. Production expectations adjust twice as often but revert faster, consistent with greater labour market rigidity. Labour market institutions shape these responses: firms subject to the minimum wage or with lower collective bargaining coverage revise employment expectations more strongly. Financially constrained firms exhibit disproportionately larger downward revisions, indicating that the financial accelerator operates already at the expectation formation stage. Because firms adjust plans well before effects appear in aggregate data, employment expectations provide an early measure of monetary policy transmission to the labour market. JEL Classification: E24, E52, J20, J63
url:8aa0fd7ab0344496.abstract_zh: 本文考察了货币政策公告如何影响企业的就业预期。利用德国调查数据，我们将高频货币政策意外与调查回复日期相结合，以识别货币政策对企业层面预期及后续就业的即时与动态效应。紧缩性冲击导致企业立即且持续地下调就业计划，最终降低就业增长。起初，招聘计划被削减，而裁员则在后期增加。生产预期的调整频率是就业预期的两倍，但恢复速度更快，这与劳动力市场刚性较强相一致。劳动力市场制度塑造了这些反应：受最低工资约束或集体谈判覆盖率较低的企业，其就业预期修正幅度更大。财务受限企业表现出不成比例的更大下调幅度，表明金融加速器在预期形成阶段就已发挥作用。由于企业在总体数据显现效应之前就已调整计划，就业预期为货币政策向劳动力市场传导提供了早期衡量指标。JEL分类：E24, E52, J20, J63
