url:91bd9e43f00ef88c.abstract: We show that incorporating uninsurable countercyclical income risk into a standard international RBC model can qualitatively and quantitatively account for the quantity puzzles in open-economy macro, namely (i) the Backus-Smith puzzle, (ii) the Backus-Kehoe-Kydland puzzle and (iii) the weak correlation between the trade balance and the exchange rate. We also show that our model can simultaneously account for the Fama puzzle and the evidence that high interest rate countries have stronger currencies---which representative-agents models that rely only on financial or demand shocks cannot jointly account for. Crucially, our model resolves all these puzzles while relying solely on productivity shocks, and thus generates the observed domestic and cross-country macroeconomic comovement.
url:91bd9e43f00ef88c.abstract_zh: 我们证明，将不可保险的反周期收入风险纳入标准国际实际经济周期模型，能够从定性和定量角度解释开放经济宏观经济学中的数量谜题，即：（i）巴克斯-史密斯谜题、（ii）巴克斯-基欧-基德兰德谜题以及（iii）贸易余额与汇率之间的弱相关性。我们还证明，该模型能够同时解释法玛谜题以及高利率国家拥有更强货币的证据——而仅依赖金融或需求冲击的代表性主体模型无法共同解释这些现象。关键在于，我们的模型仅依靠生产率冲击就解决了所有这些谜题，从而生成了观察到的国内及跨国宏观经济协同波动。

url:91e0b389717fb3aa.abstract: this paper we relate gender differences in willingness to commute to the gender wage gap. Using unique administrative data on job search criteria, we first document that unemployed women have a lower reservation wage than comparable men and that the maximum commute they are willing to accept is smaller. We also find that they get lower wages and shorter commutes in their next job. We then identify indifference curves between wage and commute using the joint distributions of reservation job attributes and of accepted job bundles. Indifference curves are steeper for women, who value commute around 20% more than men. Through the lens of a job search model where commuting matters, we estimate that around 10% of the gender wage gap is accounted for by gender differences in the willingness to pay for a shorter commute. Finally, we use job application data to test the robustness of our results and to show that female workers do not receive less demand from far-away employers, confirming that most of the gender gap in commute is supply-side driven.
url:91e0b389717fb3aa.abstract_zh: 本文将通勤意愿的性别差异与性别工资差距联系起来。利用关于求职标准的独特行政数据，我们首先记录到，失业女性的保留工资低于条件相当的男性，且她们愿意接受的最大通勤距离也更短。我们还发现，她们在下一份工作中获得的工资较低，通勤距离也较短。接着，我们利用保留工作属性与已接受工作组合的联合分布，识别出工资与通勤之间的无差异曲线。女性的无差异曲线更为陡峭，她们对通勤的重视程度比男性高出约20%。通过一个考虑通勤因素的工作搜索模型，我们估计，性别工资差距中约有10%可由女性对缩短通勤的支付意愿差异来解释。最后，我们利用求职申请数据来检验结果的稳健性，并表明女性劳动者并未收到来自远距离雇主的更少需求，从而确认通勤性别差距主要源于供给方因素。
url:91e0b389717fb3aa.title: Gender Differences in Job Search: Trading off Commute Against Wage
url:91e0b389717fb3aa.title_zh: 求职中的性别差异：通勤与工资的权衡

url:921951d101ce08a9.abstract: In high-inequality states the opportunity cost of delayed fertility do not resonate with youth, undermining the effectiveness of sex education. Teen fertility remains high despite widespread mandates for school-based sex education, perhaps due to heterogeneous topic coverage and variation in classroom implementation. Social inequality affects teens’ need for school-based education and response to the content. Using staggered difference-indifferences estimation that is reversal-robust, we find that teen fertility rises in highinequality states when sex education is required in schools. We conclude that policy design and implementation are distinct dimensions of sex education, and they must be tailored to local social conditions.
url:921951d101ce08a9.abstract_zh: 在高不平等州，延迟生育的机会成本难以引起年轻人的共鸣，从而削弱了性教育的有效性。尽管学校性教育被广泛强制推行，青少年生育率仍然居高不下，这可能是由于话题覆盖的异质性和课堂实施的差异所致。社会不平等影响了青少年对学校性教育的需求及其对教育内容的反应。通过使用对反转稳健的渐进双重差分估计，我们发现，在要求学校开展性教育的高不平等州，青少年生育率反而上升。我们得出结论：政策设计与实施是性教育的两个不同维度，必须根据当地社会条件进行定制。
url:921951d101ce08a9.title: When Do Sex Ed Mandates Reduce Teen Births? Evidence on Inequality
url:921951d101ce08a9.title_zh: 性教育强制令何时减少青少年生育？关于不平等性的证据

url:921ece2afe8dee14.abstract: this paper explores how firms with high Environmental and Social (ES) ratings fare during the first quarter of 2020 compared to other firms. We show that stocks with high ES ratings have significantly higher returns, lower return volatilities, and higher trading volumes than other stocks. Firms with high ES ratings and high advertising expenditures perform especially well during the crash. This paper highlights the importance of ES policies in making firms more resilient during a time of crisis.
url:921ece2afe8dee14.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在2020年第一季度，环境与社会（ES）评级较高的企业相较于其他企业的表现。我们发现，ES评级高的股票在回报率上显著更高，回报波动性更低，且交易量更大。在危机期间，ES评级高且广告支出高的企业表现尤为突出。本文强调了ES政策在增强企业危机时期韧性方面的重要性。
url:921ece2afe8dee14.title: Love in the Time of COVID-19: The Resiliency of Environmental and Social Stocks

url:9232ce827d527c79.abstract: We examine how social interactions and friendships shape students' political opinions in a natural experiment at Sciences Po, a leading French university specializing in social and political sciences. The quasi-random assignment of students into short-term integration groups before their academic curriculum reduces political opinion gaps and fosters friendship formation. Using same-group membership as an instrumental variable for friendship, we find that after 6 months friendship reduces opinion differences by 50% of the mean opinion gap. Our evidence supports a homophily-enforced mechanism: friendships form among initially politically similar students, leading them to join political associations together, reinforcing their similarity. However, friendship does not significantly influence politically dissimilar pairs. Instead, it reduces opinion divergence without enforcing ideological convergence.
url:9232ce827d527c79.abstract_zh: 我们在一项自然实验中考察了社会互动与友谊如何塑造学生的政治观点，该实验在法国顶尖的社会与政治科学大学——巴黎政治学院进行。学生在学术课程开始前被准随机分配到短期融合小组，这一安排缩小了政治观点差距并促进了友谊的形成。利用同组成员身份作为友谊的工具变量，我们发现6个月后，友谊将观点差异缩小至平均观点差距的50%。我们的证据支持一种由同质性强化机制：友谊最初在政治观点相似的学生之间形成，促使他们共同加入政治社团，从而进一步强化了他们的相似性。然而，友谊对政治观点不同的配对并无显著影响。相反，它减少了观点分歧，而未强制推行意识形态上的趋同。
url:9232ce827d527c79.title: Friendship Networks and Political Opinions

url:9243ae2283d38100.abstract: We build a model of the mortgage market where banks attain their optimal mortgage portfolio by setting rates and steering customers. “Sophisticated” households know which mortgage type is best for them; “naive” are susceptible to bank’s steering. Using data on the universe of Italian mortgages, we estimate the model and quantify the welfare implications of steering. The average cost of the distortion is equivalent to 19% of the annual mortgage payment. Since steering also conveys information about mortgages, restricting steering results in a 4% loss. A financial literacy campaign is beneficial for naive households, but hurts sophisticated ones.
url:9243ae2283d38100.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个抵押贷款市场模型，其中银行通过设定利率和引导客户来实现最优抵押贷款组合。“精明”的家庭知晓哪种抵押贷款类型最适合他们；“天真”的家庭则易受银行引导的影响。利用意大利抵押贷款全量数据，我们估计了该模型并量化了引导行为的福利影响。扭曲的平均成本相当于年度抵押贷款还款额的19%。由于引导也传递了抵押贷款相关信息，限制引导会导致4%的损失。金融素养宣传活动对天真家庭有益，但会损害精明家庭的利益。
url:9243ae2283d38100.title: The Cost of Steering in Financial Markets: Evidence from the Mortgage Market
url:9243ae2283d38100.title_zh: 金融市场中的引导成本：来自抵押贷款市场的证据

url:92983980aa3babf9.abstract: We study how fatal and nonfatal health shocks affect households’ ability to meet their financial obligations. We find that fatal shocks substantially increase the likelihood of default and that housing wealth plays a key role as a self-insurance mechanism. Surviving spouses who experience the largest income losses are more likely to sell their homes, and those without housing wealth face a sharply higher risk of debt collection. In the most financially vulnerable families, these shocks even generate intergenerational spillovers. In contrast, nonfatal health shocks lead to only modest increases in default risk. Taken together, our findings suggest that strengthening survivors’ benefits for households with limited resources could improve welfare across generations.
url:92983980aa3babf9.abstract_zh: 我们研究了致命与非致命健康冲击对家庭履行财务义务能力的影响。研究发现，致命冲击显著增加了违约可能性，而住房财富作为自我保险机制发挥着关键作用。遭受最大收入损失的丧偶者更可能出售房屋，且无住房财富的家庭面临债务催收的风险急剧上升。在最脆弱的家庭中，这些冲击甚至会产生代际溢出效应。相比之下，非致命健康冲击仅导致违约风险小幅上升。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，为资源有限的家庭加强遗属福利可改善跨代福利水平。
url:92983980aa3babf9.title: When loss strikes twice: severe health shocks and financial well-being
url:92983980aa3babf9.title_zh: 当损失两次降临：严重健康冲击与财务福祉

url:9299621f8f0ca14c.title_zh: 中国冲击2.0：中国当前出口激增与21世纪初的差异

url:929cc919b2e82cd6.abstract: Although continuous genetic improvement of crops cultivated by smallholder farmers is a well-known route to increasing agricultural productivity, our understanding of varietal adoption, turnover, and concentration in farmers’ fields is limited. Often, the greatest challenge to our understanding lies in the measurement approach (farmer self-reports versus DNA fingerprinting), as well as in the analysis and interpretation of the available data. To address this issue, we explore variety-level data on four main crops (wheat, maize, teff, and common bean) in Ethiopia. We estimate the area-weighted average varietal age (AWAVA) of each crop using data from a nationally representative sample survey of farm households and a unique genotyping dataset based on seed samples collected from the fields of sampled farm households. We also calculate indices to explore the concentration of varieties in farmers’ fields, which serves to substantiate the varietal age analysis. Overall, results show considerable variation in average varietal age across crops, ranging from 12.5 years for wheat to 28.2 years for common bean. Analysis of area shares of individual varieties for each crop indicates that slower varietal turnover (i.e., higher varietal age) is driven by the continued dominance of older varieties, despite the presence of newer varieties in the market. Slow varietal turnover in the presence of new varieties suggests the need for greater investment in the systems and markets through which seed is distributed to farmers. This includes stronger coordination of research and extension activities, improvement of variety-specific popularization and marketing efforts, and continued experimentation in seed sector development in Ethiopia.
url:929cc919b2e82cd6.abstract_zh: 尽管小农户种植作物的持续遗传改良是提高农业生产率的公认途径，但我们对农民田间品种采用、更替和集中度的理解仍然有限。通常，理解的最大挑战在于测量方法（农民自我报告与DNA指纹识别），以及现有数据的分析和解读。为解决这一问题，我们研究了埃塞俄比亚四种主要作物（小麦、玉米、苔麸和普通菜豆）的品种层面数据。我们利用全国代表性农户调查数据和基于样本农户田间采集种子样本的独特基因分型数据集，估算了每种作物的面积加权平均品种年龄（AWAVA）。同时，我们计算了相关指数以探究农民田间品种的集中度，从而佐证品种年龄分析。总体而言，结果显示不同作物的平均品种年龄存在显著差异，从小麦的12.5年到普通菜豆的28.2年不等。对每种作物单个品种面积份额的分析表明，尽管市场上有新品种存在，但老品种持续占据主导地位，导致品种更替缓慢（即品种年龄较高）。新品种存在下的缓慢品种更替表明，需要加大对种子分发至农民的系统与市场的投资。这包括加强研究与推广活动的协调、改进品种特定推广和营销工作，以及在埃塞俄比亚种子部门发展中持续进行试验。
url:929cc919b2e82cd6.title: Varietal adoption, turnover, and concentration for major crops in Ethiopia: Evidence from household surveys and field sample genotyping
url:929cc919b2e82cd6.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚主要作物的品种采用、更替与集中度：基于家庭调查与田间样本基因分型的证据

url:92bfd17498c25801.abstract: We study how expatriates cope when conflict breaks out in their homeland. Using Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine as a natural experiment, we identify causal effects using a matched difference-in-differences design, comparing incumbent Ukrainian migrants in Sweden to matched migrants from other countries. We show that Ukrainian expatriates experience immediate and persistent mental health deterioration—a 30 percent increase in psychiatric prescription use that remains elevated three years later—while simultaneously increasing employment and earnings. A simple framework rationalizes this pattern through two channels operating in opposite directions: concern for family safety worsens mental health and raises the disutility of work, while heightened financial responsibilities raise the return to earning income. Consistent with reduced reservation wages, Ukrainians take on secondary jobs, exit unemployment faster into lower-quality jobs, and earn less than comparable coworkers. Earnings effects concentrate among migrants from more war-exposed regions, while mental health effects attenuate in Swedish municipalities with more Ukrainian refugee arrivals. Results replicate in European and US survey data. As global migration and armed conflict both reach historic highs, the findings show that the welfare costs of war extend across borders, shaping the well-being and economic behavior of expatriates worldwide.
url:92bfd17498c25801.abstract_zh: 我们研究了外籍人士在祖国爆发冲突时的应对机制。以2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰作为自然实验，采用匹配双重差分法，将瑞典境内的乌克兰移民与来自其他国家的匹配移民进行对比，识别出因果效应。研究表明，乌克兰外籍人士的心理健康立即且持续恶化——精神类药物处方量增加30%，三年后仍维持高位——同时其就业率和收入同步上升。一个简单框架通过两个反向作用渠道解释了这一模式：对家人安全的担忧加剧心理健康问题并提高工作负效用，而经济责任加重则提升了收入回报。与保留工资下降一致，乌克兰移民从事副业、更快脱离失业状态但进入低质量岗位，且收入低于可比同事。来自战争更激烈地区的移民收入效应更为显著，而乌克兰难民接收量较多的瑞典市镇中，心理健康效应有所减弱。该结果在欧洲及美国调查数据中均得到验证。在全球移民与武装冲突均达历史高位的背景下，研究显示战争福利成本跨越国界，深刻影响着全球外籍人士的福祉与经济行为。
url:92bfd17498c25801.title: Beyond the Battlefield: The Impact of War on Expatriates’ Health and Livelihoods
url:92bfd17498c25801.title_zh: 超越战场：战争对外籍人士健康与生计的影响

url:92d905cddf29c511.title: Gender equality through turnover: Quasi-experimental evidence from term limit reforms in Italy
url:92d905cddf29c511.title_zh: 通过人员更替实现性别平等：来自意大利任期限制改革的准实验证据

url:92dac6791c36f415.abstract: We analyze a multidimensional screening model in which a principal offers a menu of quality-price pairs to a consumer with multiple dimensions of private information and a quasilinear utility function. We derive necessary conditions for optimality, and use them to provide insight into optimal exclusion, positive trade, and screening. We then recast the problem in terms of incremental quality levels and prices, the so-called demand-profile approach (DPA). Under DPA, the problem decouples across increments and can be solved one at a time. We provide novel conditions under which DPA recovers the solution to the full problem exactly or approximately, and which make the necessary conditions sufficient for optimality: essentially, valuations must be sufficiently correlated across quality increments. Applied to empirical estimates of demand for health insurance, we show that DPA is approximately valid, and we apply it to understand equilibrium outcomes in a monopoly insurance market.
url:92dac6791c36f415.abstract_zh: 我们分析了一个多维筛选模型，其中委托人向具有多维私人信息和拟线性效用函数的消费者提供一系列质量-价格组合。我们推导了最优性的必要条件，并利用这些条件深入探讨了最优排除、正向交易和筛选问题。随后，我们将问题重新表述为增量质量水平和价格的形式，即所谓的需求轮廓方法（DPA）。在DPA框架下，问题在增量间解耦，可以逐一求解。我们提出了新颖的条件，在这些条件下，DPA能够精确或近似地恢复完整问题的解，并使必要条件成为最优性的充分条件：本质上，估值必须在质量增量间充分相关。应用于健康保险需求的实证估计，我们展示了DPA近似有效，并将其应用于理解垄断保险市场中的均衡结果。
url:92dac6791c36f415.title: Multidimensional Screening for Quality with an Application to Health Insurance
url:92dac6791c36f415.title_zh: 质量的多维筛选及其在健康保险中的应用

url:92fbac2010babbda.title_zh: 欧洲国家政府支出的相互依赖：生产率溢出与战略互动

url:9307b19f9a21dd81.abstract: Liquidity is central to modern fixed-income markets, yet it is often treated too simply. Bonds are commonly described as liquid or illiquid, as though liquidity were a fixed quality built into the security itself. This book challenges that view. It argues that liquidity is not a permanent feature of a bond, but a fragile condition created by market structure, financing arrangements, collateral rules, dealer capacity, valuation practices, regulation, and investor behaviour. The Endogeneity of Liquidity Risk in Leveraged Fixed-Income Systems develops a clear theory of how liquidity is created inside the financial system and how it can disappear under stress. A bond may appear easy to sell in calm markets, financeable through repo, acceptable as collateral, and stable in daily valuation. Yet those qualities may depend on conditions that change quickly when volatility rises, funding tightens, or many investors try to exit at the same time.
url:9307b19f9a21dd81.abstract_zh: 流动性是现代固定收益市场的核心，但往往被过于简单地对待。债券通常被描述为具有流动性或缺乏流动性，仿佛流动性是证券本身固有的固定属性。本书挑战了这一观点，认为流动性并非债券的永久特征，而是一种由市场结构、融资安排、抵押品规则、交易商能力、估值实践、监管和投资者行为共同创造的脆弱状态。《杠杆固定收益系统中流动性风险的内生性》构建了一套清晰的理论，阐释流动性如何在金融体系内部被创造出来，又如何在压力下消失。一只债券在平静市场中可能看似易于出售、可通过回购融资、可被接受为抵押品且日常估值稳定，但这些特质可能依赖于某些条件——当波动性上升、资金收紧或大量投资者同时试图退出时，这些条件会迅速改变。
url:9307b19f9a21dd81.title: The Endogeneity of Liquidity Risk in Leveraged Fixed-Income Systems Book

url:932ede7fc38d799b.abstract: In the digital era, organizations are increasingly relying on employee-generated communication to shape their employer brand image. This study proposes an integrative conceptual framework that examines the relationships between personal branding, employee advocacy, and employer brand attractiveness, while accounting for the moderating role of social media use. Drawing on Social Identity Theory, identity expressiveness theory and Social Exchange Theory, it argues that employees who actively develop their personal brand enhance their visibility, credibility, and professional image, which motivates them to engage in promotional behaviors that benefit their organization. These promotional behaviors, in turn, influence the organization's external image and strengthen the appeal of the employer brand, defined as the perceived benefits of working for a given organization. Furthermore, this theoretical framework suggests that the use of social media strengthens these ties by providing a platform through which employees can express both their personal identity and organizational identity, and reach a wider audience. Methodologically, this study adopts a theory-based integrative literature review relying on a structured analysis of prior research in the fields of organizational behavior, communication, and employer branding. By integrating previously fragmented lines of research, this study contributes to the literature by highlighting the role of employee advocacy as a key mediating mechanism and the use of social media as a contextual moderator in the relationship between personal branding and employer brand attractiveness. The study concludes that personal branding positively influences employee advocacy, which in turn strengthens employer brand attractiveness, while social media use amplifies these relationships in digital environments.From a managerial perspective, it emphasizes the importance of empowering employees to act as agents of strategic communication in order to enhance the organization's appeal in competitive labor markets. Keywords : Personal branding, Employee advocacy, Employer brand attractiveness, Social media use.
url:932ede7fc38d799b.abstract_zh: 在数字化时代，组织日益依赖员工生成的沟通来塑造其雇主品牌形象。本研究提出了一个综合性的概念框架，探讨个人品牌、员工倡导与雇主品牌吸引力之间的关系，并考虑社交媒体使用的调节作用。基于社会认同理论、身份表达理论和社会交换理论，本研究认为，积极发展个人品牌的员工能够提升其可见度、可信度和专业形象，从而激励他们参与有利于组织的推广行为。这些推广行为反过来影响组织的外部形象，并增强雇主品牌的吸引力，即感知到的在特定组织工作的益处。此外，该理论框架表明，社交媒体的使用通过提供一个平台，使员工能够同时表达个人身份和组织身份，并触达更广泛的受众，从而强化这些联系。在方法论上，本研究采用基于理论的结构化综合文献综述方法，系统分析组织行为学、传播学和雇主品牌领域的先前研究。通过整合以往分散的研究线索，本研究为文献贡献在于强调员工倡导作为关键中介机制，以及社交媒体使用作为个人品牌与雇主品牌吸引力之间关系的情境调节因素。研究得出结论：个人品牌正向影响员工倡导，进而增强雇主品牌吸引力，而社交媒体使用在数字环境中放大了这些关系。从管理视角来看，本研究强调赋权员工作为战略沟通代理人的重要性，以增强组织在竞争激烈的劳动力市场中的吸引力。关键词：个人品牌、员工倡导、雇主品牌吸引力、社交媒体使用。

url:935e602f08cfce80.abstract: We reappraise the Arrow problem by studying the aggregation of choice functions. We do so in the general framework of judgment aggregation, in which choice functions are naturally representable by specifying, for each menu A and each alternative x in A , whether x is choosable from A , or not. Our framework suggests a natural strengthening of Arrow’s independence condition positing that the collective choosability of an alternative from a menu depends on the individual views on that issue, and that issue alone. Our analysis reveals that Arrovian impossibility results crucially hinge on what internal consistency requirements we impose on choice functions. While the aggregation of ‘binary’ choice functions, i.e.those satisfying both contraction (\(\alpha \)) and expansion (\(\gamma \)) consistency, is necessarily dictatorial, possibilities in the form of oligarchic rules emerge for path-independent choice functions, that is, when the expansion property \(\gamma \) is replaced by the so-called Aizerman condition. Remarkably, the Arrovian aggregation of choice functions is shown to be almost dictatorial already under property \(\gamma \) alone. When giving up expansion consistency, specific quota rules become possible.
url:935e602f08cfce80.abstract_zh: 我们通过研究选择函数的加总问题，重新审视了阿罗悖论。在判断加总的通用框架下，选择函数可自然地表示为：针对每个菜单A及其中的每个备选项x，明确x是否可从A中被选出。该框架提出了对阿罗独立性条件的自然强化，即集体对某备选项从某菜单中的可选择性，仅取决于个体对该议题的判断，且仅取决于该议题本身。分析表明，阿罗式不可能性结果的关键在于我们对选择函数施加何种内部一致性要求。当加总满足收缩一致性（\(\alpha\)）与扩张一致性（\(\gamma\)）的"二元"选择函数时，结果必然具有独裁性；而对于路径独立型选择函数（即用所谓的艾泽曼条件替代扩张性质\(\gamma\)），则可能出现寡头规则形式的可能性。值得注意的是，仅凭性质\(\gamma\)，阿罗式选择函数加总已近乎呈现独裁特征。若放弃扩张一致性，则特定配额规则成为可能。

url:937dcb91bf2acc41.abstract: This paper examines how global greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI) flows are evolving amid rising geoeconomic fragmentation. We use difference-in-differences and event study approaches to analyze changes in FDI around key bilateral inflection points. We find a decline in FDI from the US and broader Group of Seven Plus (G7+) into the PRC, concentrated in trade-exposed, efficiency-seeking sectors. Investment diversion—particularly from the PRC to Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) members and Latin America—is evident, but this growth was concentrated in less global value chain (GVC)-integrated activities, suggesting that GVC links may act as a constraint on investment relocation. These findings suggest that while tensions may be reshaping global investment, GVC dependencies are likely limiting firms’ ability to reallocate production at scale, making the “great reallocation” least evident where it was most expected.
url:937dcb91bf2acc41.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在地缘经济碎片化加剧的背景下，全球绿地外商直接投资（FDI）流动的演变趋势。我们采用双重差分法和事件研究法，分析关键双边关系转折点前后FDI的变化。研究发现，来自美国及更广泛的七国集团+（G7+）经济体对中国的FDI有所下降，且主要集中在贸易敏感型、效率寻求型行业。投资转移现象明显——尤其是从中国流向东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）成员国和拉丁美洲——但这种增长集中于全球价值链（GVC）整合程度较低的活动，表明GVC联系可能对投资重新布局构成制约。这些发现表明，尽管地缘紧张局势可能正在重塑全球投资格局，但GVC依赖关系很可能限制了企业大规模重新配置生产能力，使得“大转移”在最被预期的领域反而最不明显。

url:93a9c0e839c9fd32.abstract: This paper examines the impact of labour and product market reforms on private investment across 26 advanced economies from 1975 to 2020. To this end, we combine a narrative database on major structural reforms with local projections and augmented inverse probability weighting. We find that a major labour market reform typically increases the level of real private investment by 5% cumulatively within six years, while a major product market reform yields an impact of 3%. Structural reforms are particularly effective in stimulating private investment when the private sector has access to ample external finance and the rule of law is strong. Overall, our findings point to an important role for structural reforms in boosting private investment and thus long-term growth prospects in advanced economies. JEL Classification: E22, O43, L51
url:93a9c0e839c9fd32.abstract_zh: 本文考察了1975年至2020年间26个发达经济体中劳动力市场与产品市场改革对私人投资的影响。为此，我们结合了关于重大结构性改革的叙事数据库，并运用局部投影法及增强逆概率加权法进行分析。研究发现，一项重大的劳动力市场改革通常在六年内使实际私人投资水平累计增加5%，而一项重大的产品市场改革则带来3%的影响。当私营部门能够获得充足的外部融资且法治环境健全时，结构性改革在刺激私人投资方面尤为有效。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，结构性改革在促进私人投资及进而推动发达经济体长期增长前景方面发挥着重要作用。JEL分类号：E22, O43, L51

url:93b57c23c40777e6.abstract: Focus Stablecoins – digital tokens with the goal to function as money – offer easy access to US dollar liquidity. As a result, one of the main use cases of stablecoins to date has been to serve as a store of value in emerging market and developing economies. However, relatively little is known about the drivers and behaviour of "stablecoin dollarisation", how it may interact with more conventional forms of dollarisation and how it may affect monetary policy.
url:93b57c23c40777e6.abstract_zh: 焦点稳定币——旨在充当货币的数字代币——为获取美元流动性提供了便捷渠道。因此，稳定币迄今的主要应用场景之一，是在新兴市场和发展中经济体充当价值储存手段。然而，关于"稳定币美元化"的驱动因素与行为特征、其与传统美元化形式的潜在互动机制，以及可能对货币政策产生的影响，目前仍知之甚少。

url:93c32e686700f3e1.abstract: We show that commodity export booms can propagate up the value chain, reshape production networks, and drive growth and transformation in the service sector. We study Uruguay’s beef export boom to China in the 2010s, combining customs, firm-to-firm transactions, employer-employee, and balance sheet data. Domestic suppliers to beef exporters that expanded trade with China recorded higher sales, especially in services, with associated gains in employment, wages, and sales per worker, along with increased imports of high-quality products. Aggregate sales in the economy rose by 1.79%, with each export dollar generating 46 more cents in domestic sales, including 10 cents in services. Over time, service firms reoriented their connections toward beef exporters, amplifying their gains from trade.
url:93c32e686700f3e1.abstract_zh: 我们证明，大宗商品出口繁荣能够沿价值链向上传导，重塑生产网络，并推动服务业的增长与转型。我们以2010年代乌拉圭对华牛肉出口繁荣为研究对象，结合海关数据、企业间交易记录、雇主-雇员匹配数据及资产负债表数据进行分析。与扩大对华贸易的牛肉出口商有国内供应关系的企业，其销售额有所增长，尤其在服务业领域表现突出，同时伴随就业、工资及人均销售额的提升，以及高质量产品进口的增加。整体经济总销售额增长了1.79%，每1美元出口额额外带动46美分的国内销售，其中服务业贡献10美分。随着时间推移，服务企业将其业务联系重新导向牛肉出口商，从而放大了其从贸易中获得的收益。

url:93dc1405e1294de3.abstract: This study examines how configurations of public financial management performance, sectoral spending, and governance context shape education and health outcomes across developing and middle-income economies. Using fuzzy set qualitative comparative analysis and Bayesian robustness checks, the analysis identifies multiple sufficient pathways linking budget execution credibility to primary education, secondary education, universal health coverage, and under five mortality outcomes. The findings confirm that public financial management conditions operate through conjunctural combinations rather than linear channels, their explanatory reach is stronger for intermediate than longer term outcomes, and strong aggregate and revenue execution can compensate for low sectoral spending. Budget credibility at the execution stage emerges as the central operative mechanism.
url:93dc1405e1294de3.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了公共财政管理绩效、部门支出与治理环境的不同组合如何影响发展中及中等收入经济体的教育与健康成果。运用模糊集定性比较分析与贝叶斯稳健性检验，分析识别出多条充分路径，将预算执行可信度与初等教育、中等教育、全民健康覆盖及五岁以下儿童死亡率等结果联系起来。研究发现证实，公共财政管理条件通过组合性联动而非线性渠道发挥作用，其解释力对中期成果强于长期成果，且强劲的总量与收入执行可弥补部门支出的不足。执行阶段的预算可信度成为核心运作机制。
url:93dc1405e1294de3.title: How Public Financial Management Shapes Education and Health Outcomes: A Configurational Perspective
url:93dc1405e1294de3.title_zh: 公共财政管理如何塑造教育与健康结果：一种组态视角

url:93e54749c2b554b9.abstract: Employment protection legislation often varies with firm or establishment size and age, and many evaluations of EPL reforms exploit these thresholds. This paper develops a search-and-matching model with multi-establishment firms to disentangle direct effects from general-equilibrium spillovers. We combine the model with quasi-experimental evidence from a 2009 Portuguese reform that restricted fixed-term contracts in young establishments of large firms. Spillovers barely distort the reduced-form estimate, yet they overturn the aggregate conclusion: extrapolating the reduced-form estimate implies a 1.51% employment decline, compared with a 0.11% increase in general equilibrium. Counterfactuals show that conditioning EPL on size versus age can yield opposite welfare effects, even when employment effects are similar, and that fixed-term contract and firing restrictions must be evaluated jointly.
url:93e54749c2b554b9.abstract_zh: 就业保护立法通常随企业或机构规模及年龄而变化，许多对就业保护改革效果的评估利用了这些门槛。本文构建了一个包含多机构企业的搜索匹配模型，以区分直接效应与一般均衡溢出效应。我们将该模型与2009年葡萄牙改革中的准实验证据相结合，该改革限制了大企业年轻机构中的固定期限合同。溢出效应几乎不扭曲简化形式估计，但会颠覆总体结论：外推简化形式估计意味着就业下降1.51%，而一般均衡中则增长0.11%。反事实分析表明，即使就业效应相似，基于规模与基于年龄的就业保护条件可能产生相反的福利效应，且固定期限合同限制与解雇限制必须联合评估。

url:94227a97b0b8e1e8.abstract: This paper provides a general review of recent developments in the application of control theory to macroeconomic policy design. It starts by highlighting the crucial difference between the engineering and economic control problem, in that the latter, unlike the former, is concerned with the control of intelligent systems. It examines the problems that this creates for macroeconomic policy formulation, and considers the usefulness of the rational expectations assumption in this context. Policy formulation is then analysed in the context of an interdependent world, and the dangers of single country policy optimisation are highlighted. It is argued that the most pressing issue is that of formulating appropriate rules, supported by penalty strategies, for the orderly conduct of macroeconomic policy in an international setting. The paper concludes by examining the conduct of United Kingdom macropolicy over the past five years, arguing that greater attention to issues of macropolicy design would have avoided some serious deficiencies in the conduct of policy.
url:94227a97b0b8e1e8.abstract_zh: 本文综述了控制理论在宏观经济政策设计中的最新应用进展。首先，文章强调了工程控制问题与经济控制问题的关键区别：后者与前者不同，涉及对智能系统的控制。文章探讨了这种区别对宏观经济政策制定带来的问题，并评估了理性预期假设在此背景下的适用性。随后，在相互依存的世界背景下分析了政策制定，并指出了单一国家政策优化的风险。文章认为，最紧迫的问题是在国际环境中制定适当的规则，并辅以惩罚策略，以有序实施宏观经济政策。最后，文章通过考察过去五年英国宏观政策的实施情况，指出若更关注宏观政策设计问题，本可避免政策实施中的若干严重缺陷。
url:94227a97b0b8e1e8.title: DP36 Macroeconomic Policy Design and Control Theory - A Failed Partnership?
url:94227a97b0b8e1e8.title_zh: DP36 宏观经济政策设计与控制理论——一场失败的联姻？

url:94499231bf5c652d.abstract: This paper throws light on these matters by means of an aggregate production function for British manufacturing estimated on quarterly data for 1956-83. This makes it possible to distinguish cyclical movements in productivity caused by variations in labour utilization from underlying trends. The measure of labour utilization rests on information on weekly hours of overtime work as a fraction of the normal work week. The paper also considers measurement problems in output for which several significant observable proxies are available and in capital, the latter being compared with the CBI's capacity utilization data and Bennett and Smith-Gavine's Percentage Utilization of Labour index. Estimates are provided of measurement biases in output and comparisons made between crude output per head and a productivity measure corrected for variations in utilization and measurement biases in output.
url:94499231bf5c652d.abstract_zh: 本文通过1956-1983年英国制造业季度数据估算的总量生产函数，揭示了相关问题。该函数能够区分由劳动利用率变化引起的生产率周期性波动与潜在趋势。劳动利用率的衡量基于每周加班工时占正常工时的比例。本文还探讨了产出（存在多个显著可观测代理变量）与资本（将其与英国工业联合会产能利用率数据、贝内特与史密斯-加文的劳动利用率百分比指数进行对比）的测量问题。研究提供了产出测量偏差的估计值，并对粗放式人均产出与经利用率变化及产出测量偏差校正后的生产率指标进行了比较。

url:9494178ed596d4ab.abstract: The currency of invoicing in international trade is central for the international transmission of shocks and macroeconomic policies. Using a new dataset on currency invoicing for Belgian firms, we analyze how firms make their currency choice, for both exports and imports, and the implications of this choice for exchange rate pass-through into prices and quantities. We derive our estimating equations from a theoretical framework that features variable markups, international input sourcing, and staggered price setting with endogenous currency choice, and also allowing for the dominant currency choice. Our structural specification provides a new test of the allocative consequences of nominal rigidities, by estimating the treatment effect of foreign-currency price stickiness on the dynamic response of prices and quantities to exchange rate changes, controlling for the endogeneity of the firm's currency choice. We show that flexible-price determinants of exchange rate pass-through are also the key firm characteristics that determine currency choice. In particular, small non-importing firms tend to price their exports in euros (producer currency) and exhibit close to complete exchange-rate pass-through into destination prices at all horizons. In contrast, large import-intensive firms tend to denominate their exports in foreign currencies, and especially in the US dollar, exhibiting a lower pass-through of the euro-destination exchange rate and a pronounced sensitivity to the dollar-destination exchangerate. Finally, the effects of foreign-currency price stickiness are still significant beyond the one-year horizon, but gradually dissipate in the long run, consistent with sticky price models of currency choice.
url:9494178ed596d4ab.abstract_zh: 国际贸易中的计价货币选择对于冲击的国际传导和宏观经济政策至关重要。利用比利时企业计价货币的新数据集，我们分析了企业如何在出口和进口中做出货币选择，以及这一选择对汇率传递至价格和数量的影响。我们从包含可变加成、国际投入采购以及具有内生货币选择的分阶段定价的理论框架中推导出估计方程，并允许主导货币选择。我们的结构规范通过估计外币价格粘性对价格和数量对汇率变化动态响应的处理效应，为名义刚性的配置后果提供了新的检验，同时控制了企业货币选择的内生性。我们表明，汇率传递的弹性价格决定因素也是决定货币选择的关键企业特征。特别是，小型非进口企业倾向于以欧元（生产者货币）计价其出口，并在所有时间范围内表现出对目的地价格几乎完全的汇率传递。相比之下，大型进口密集型企业倾向于以外币，尤其是美元计价其出口，表现出对欧元-目的地汇率较低的传递性，并对美元-目的地汇率具有显著敏感性。最后，外币价格粘性的影响在一年期之后仍然显著，但在长期内逐渐消散，这与货币选择的粘性价格模型一致。

url:94cadce043d7dd54.abstract: This paper proposes a simultaneous-equation approach to the estimation of the contribution of transport infrastructure accumulation to regional growth. We model explicitly the political-economy process driving infrastructure investments; in doing so, we eliminate a potential source of bias in production-function estimates and generate testable hypotheses on the forces that shape infrastructure policy. Our empirical findings on a panel of France's regions over 1985-91 suggest that influence activities were, indeed, significant determinants of the cross-regional allocation of transportation infrastructure investments. Moreover, we find little evidence of concern for the maximization of economic returns to infrastructure spending, even after controlling for pork-barrel and when imposing an exogenous preference for convergence in regional productivity levels.
url:94cadce043d7dd54.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种联立方程方法，用于估算交通基础设施积累对区域增长的贡献。我们明确构建了驱动基础设施投资的政治经济学过程模型；通过这一方法，我们消除了生产函数估计中潜在的偏误来源，并生成了关于塑造基础设施政策力量的可检验假设。基于法国各地区1985-1991年面板数据的实证结果表明，游说活动确实是交通基础设施投资跨区域分配的重要决定因素。此外，即使在控制政治分肥因素并施加外生的区域生产率趋同偏好后，我们仍发现基础设施支出经济回报最大化的考量证据不足。

url:94d371a7c418db8d.abstract: How exposed are open economies to global demand shocks? In equilibrium, foreign booms can be absorbed either by domestic consumption ("quantities") or by real exchange rate appreciation ("prices"). We show that failures of Ricardian equivalence and global financial market imperfections, two frictions popular in much recent work, have opposite effects on the split: while elevated marginal propensities to consume push towards quantities, financial frictions instead increase price adjustment. As the flexible-price equilibrium generally features a mix of quantity and price responses, policy needs to be contractionary to achieve flexible-price outcomes if the spending effect dominates, and vice-versa if financial frictions are severe. In our quantitative explorations the spending effect tends to win the race, necessitating aggressive domestic policy action.
url:94d371a7c418db8d.abstract_zh: 开放经济体对全球需求冲击的暴露程度如何？在均衡状态下，国外经济繁荣可通过国内消费（“数量”）或实际汇率升值（“价格”）两种渠道吸收。本文证明，李嘉图等价失效与全球金融市场不完善——近期研究中常见的两类摩擦——对上述分配机制具有相反影响：边际消费倾向上升会推动数量调整，而金融摩擦则强化价格调整。由于弹性价格均衡通常兼具数量与价格反应特征，当支出效应占主导时，政策需采取紧缩措施以实现弹性价格均衡；反之，若金融摩擦严重，则需采取扩张政策。在量化分析中，支出效应往往占据上风，这要求采取积极的国内政策干预。

url:952e1073fc4cce42.abstract: Since its independence in 1960, Mauritania has implemented several development strategies, the most recent being the Strategy for Accelerated Growth and Shared Prosperity (SCAPP 2016-2030). The SCAPP is structured around three strategic pillars, the second of which emphasizes the development of human capital and access to basic services. This underscores the relevance of examining the relationship between educational capital and economic growth in Mauritania over the period 1995-2024, in order to contribute to formulating recommendations and rethinking the existing strategic framework. This article investigates this relationship in both the short and long term through an ARDL (Auto-Regressive Distributed Lag) approach. Public expenditure on education is used as the explanatory variable of interest for educational capital, while the GDP growth rate is retained as the dependent variable measuring economic growth. The findings reveal a positive and statistically significant short-term relationship between educational capital and economic growth, with an estimated lag of two years. In the long term, however, the estimation indicates a negative and statistically significant relationship between educational capital and economic growth, attributable to the inefficiency of public education expenditure, which consists mainly of operating expenses.
url:952e1073fc4cce42.abstract_zh: 自1960年独立以来，毛里塔尼亚实施了多项发展战略，最新的一项为《加速增长与共享繁荣战略（SCAPP 2016-2030）》。该战略围绕三大战略支柱构建，其中第二支柱强调人力资本开发及基本服务的获取。这凸显了考察1995-2024年间毛里塔尼亚教育资本与经济增长之间关系的现实意义，旨在为提出建议及反思现有战略框架作出贡献。本文通过ARDL（自回归分布滞后）方法，从短期和长期两个维度探究这一关系。公共教育支出作为教育资本的解释变量，而GDP增长率则作为衡量经济增长的被解释变量。研究结果显示，短期内教育资本与经济增长之间存在正向且统计显著的关系，估计滞后期为两年。然而，长期来看，估计结果表明教育资本与经济增长之间存在负向且统计显著的关系，这归因于公共教育支出的低效率，其构成主要为经常性支出。

url:956132518f06890e.abstract: We propose using penalized withdrawals from retirement savings accounts, identified from U.S. tax records, as a revealed-preference tool to analyze households’ valuation of liquidity. A simple dynamic model formalizes the notion that the prevalence of withdrawals can be used to characterize American households’ valuation of liquidity over time and space. Over time, we find that declines in household income lead to sudden, large, and persistent jumps in the probability of penalized withdrawals, providing evidence that shocks are imperfectly insured and that households have high valuation of liquidity. Across space, we show that both local economic conditions and persistent household characteristics play an important role, with the average valuation of liquid- ity being higher in financially underdeveloped areas as well as in black communities, consistent with them being marginalized from the credit market. Applying our tool to the Great Recession, we further find that more affected areas saw larger increases in penalized withdrawals, likely driven by tightening of local credit conditions. Overall, our analysis offers a new tool to study the valuation of liquidity, and our results point to sizable welfare gains from social insurance policies targeted at both households and locations over time.
url:956132518f06890e.abstract_zh: 我们提议利用美国税务记录中识别出的退休储蓄账户罚款性取款，作为一种揭示偏好的工具，来分析家庭对流动性的估值。一个简洁的动态模型形式化了这一概念，即取款的普遍性可用于刻画美国家庭在时间和空间维度上对流动性的估值。随时间变化，我们发现家庭收入的下降会导致罚款性取款概率的突然、大幅且持续的跃升，这为冲击未被完全保险以及家庭对流动性有高估值提供了证据。在空间维度上，我们表明当地经济条件和持久性家庭特征都发挥着重要作用，平均流动性估值在金融发展不发达地区以及黑人社区中更高，这与他们在信贷市场中被边缘化的情况相符。将我们的工具应用于大衰退时期，我们进一步发现，受影响更严重的地区罚款性取款增加更多，这很可能由当地信贷条件收紧所驱动。总体而言，我们的分析提供了一种研究流动性估值的新工具，而我们的结果则指向针对家庭和地区的社会保险政策能带来可观的福利收益。

url:9592fe6c0ae69cd1.abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on how public disclosure of air pollution information affects private health insurance demand. Exploring the staggered rollout of China's real-time air pollution monitoring and disclosure program as a quasi-natural experiment, we combine household-level survey data with satellite-based pollution measures and estimate a difference-in-differences model. We find that when pollution information becomes publicly available, higher pollution levels significantly increase the likelihood of purchasing private health insurance. A one-unit increase in aerosol optical depth raises insurance coverage by about 2.2 percentage points, an economically meaningful effect given the low baseline coverage rate. The effect is robust to alternative specifications, individual fixed effects, and placebo tests. Mechanism analyses show that the response is driven by heightened pollution risk perception and health concerns rather than income or labor supply effects. The effect is stronger among more risk-averse, less educated individuals and those with lower trust in insurance. The results highlight the role of external information in shaping financial behavior and health risk management decisions.
url:9592fe6c0ae69cd1.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于空气污染信息公开如何影响私人健康保险需求的新证据。以中国实时空气污染监测与公开项目的分阶段推广为准自然实验，我们结合家庭层面调查数据与基于卫星的污染测量指标，并采用双重差分模型进行估计。研究发现，当污染信息向公众公开后，更高的污染水平显著增加了购买私人健康保险的可能性。气溶胶光学厚度每增加一个单位，保险覆盖率约提高2.2个百分点，考虑到较低的基准覆盖率，这一影响具有经济显著性。该效应在替代性设定、个体固定效应及安慰剂检验中均保持稳健。机制分析表明，这一反应主要由增强的污染风险感知与健康担忧驱动，而非收入或劳动力供给效应。在风险规避程度更高、受教育程度较低及对保险信任度较低的群体中，该效应更为显著。研究结果凸显了外部信息在塑造金融行为与健康风险管理决策中的关键作用。

url:95a364db265ed6a6.abstract: In a coordinated effort to curb tax evasion, governments systematically exchange information about bank accounts with foreign owners. We study the compliance effects of the policy in the context of South Africa using information reports on 1 million foreign bank accounts linked to income and audit data. We find that self-reported foreign income increased sharply and persistently at the onset of information exchange, but remained much below the true foreign income implied by the information reports. We explain the partial compliance response by showing that, contrary to standard theory of third-party reporting, the detection risk associated with non-compliance was modest.
url:95a364db265ed6a6.abstract_zh: 为协同打击逃税，各国政府系统性地交换外国居民银行账户信息。我们以南非为背景，利用与收入和审计数据关联的100万个外国银行账户信息报告，研究该政策的合规效应。研究发现，信息交换启动后，自报境外收入出现持续显著增长，但仍远低于信息报告所隐含的真实境外收入水平。我们通过论证发现，与第三方报告标准理论相悖的是，违规行为面临的稽查风险较低，这解释了部分合规响应的现象。

url:95c149f6ff26fc6a.abstract: We design an econometric framework to simulate multiple adverse macro-financial scenarios that can be used in top-down stress tests. First, we create a financial stress index informed by shocks generated via a non-parametric copula estimated on a large dataset of daily financial indicators. Second, we simulate the joint dynamics of macroeconomic indicators conditional on the copula-based financial shocks in a large multi-country Bayesian VAR model. This framework,which we refer to as the Multiple macro-financial stress scenario Simulation Engine, MuSE, allows us to replicate thousands of macro-financial stress scenarios where adverse shocks generated in the financial sector propagate into the overall economy, triggering significant macroeconomic fluctuations. We demonstrate its functionality by generating a large number of scenarios inspired from past crises capturing stress stemming from financial markets, sovereign debt, and geopolitical tensions. Using a top-down solvency stress test model, based on recent EU-wide stress tests, we project the capital depletion for euro area banks and find that adverse scenarios triggered by stock market and sovereign shocks appear to threaten the resilience of the euro area banking sector the most at this juncture. JEL Classification: C15, G01, G17, G21
url:95c149f6ff26fc6a.abstract_zh: 我们设计了一个计量经济学框架，用于模拟多种不利的宏观金融情景，这些情景可应用于自上而下的压力测试。首先，我们构建了一个金融压力指数，该指数基于通过非参数copula在大型每日金融指标数据集上估计的冲击生成。其次，我们在一个大型多国贝叶斯向量自回归模型中，模拟以copula为基础的金融冲击条件下的宏观经济指标联合动态。这一框架，我们称之为多重宏观金融压力情景模拟引擎（MuSE），使我们能够复制数千种宏观金融压力情景，其中金融部门产生的不利冲击会传导至整体经济，引发显著的宏观经济波动。我们通过生成大量受过去危机启发的场景来展示其功能，这些场景捕捉了来自金融市场、主权债务和地缘政治紧张局势的压力。利用基于近期欧盟范围内压力测试的自上而下偿付能力压力测试模型，我们预测了欧元区银行的资本消耗，并发现当前阶段，由股票市场和主权冲击引发的不利情景似乎对欧元区银行业韧性构成最大威胁。JEL分类：C15, G01, G17, G21

url:95c5000364f2b4e1.abstract: We study whether LLMs and cognitive skills influence the evaluation of novices’ intellectual tasks, when these evaluations depend on standard and well-defined performance criteria. This is a common case (junior employees, students’ exams) making our question relevant. In a 2×2 randomized control trial, we assign 1,053 first-year undergraduates in economics, management and finance to one of four conditions: a training on causal reasoning (as a relevant cognitive skill for intellectual tasks), ChatGPT Edu access (GPT-4o), both, or neither. We provide a real-world merchandising business problem and ask experts to evaluate the participants’ solutions according to standard metrics in marketing. We find that causal reasoning changes how students think, leading to mechanism-based solutions and a greater diversity of ideas. However, causal reasoning does not improve evaluations, unlike ChatGPT. Greater textual coherence and a higher number of ideas explain about half of the ChatGPT effect, suggesting that, for novices facing well-defined problems, LLMs produce solutions that resemble expert recommendations not only in textual quality, but also in content. We also find that, when combined with causal training, ChatGPT increases the use of coherent logic, falsification logic, and the attempt to understand why (mechanisms). Overall, we find that human causal reasoning produces effects independently of LLMs, particularly on the diversity of ideas, and therefore it is worth cultivating causal reasoning in a world in which students use LLMs. Probably less appreciated is that the value of diverse ideas also requires an evaluation system that demands diversity rather than standard solutions.
url:95c5000364f2b4e1.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了当评估依赖于标准且定义明确的绩效标准时，大语言模型与认知技能是否会影响对新手智力任务的评价。这一情形颇为常见（如初级员工、学生考试），使得我们的研究问题具有现实意义。在一项2×2随机对照试验中，我们将1053名经济学、管理学及金融学专业的一年级本科生分配至四种条件之一：因果推理训练（作为智力任务相关的认知技能）、ChatGPT Edu访问权限（GPT-4o）、两者兼具，或两者皆无。我们提供了一个现实世界的商品营销商业问题，并邀请专家依据营销领域的标准指标对参与者的解决方案进行评估。研究发现，因果推理改变了学生的思维方式，促使其提出基于机制的解决方案，并产生更多样化的想法。然而，与ChatGPT不同，因果推理并未提升评估结果。文本连贯性的增强及想法数量的增加解释了ChatGPT效应的大约一半，这表明，对于面对定义明确问题的新手而言，大语言模型生成的解决方案不仅在文本质量上，而且在内容上，都与专家建议相似。我们还发现，当与因果训练相结合时，ChatGPT增强了连贯逻辑、证伪逻辑的运用，以及探究原因（机制）的尝试。总体而言，我们发现人类因果推理独立于大语言模型产生效应，尤其在想法多样性方面，因此，在学生使用大语言模型的时代，培养因果推理能力仍具价值。或许较少被认识到的是，多样化想法的价值同样需要一个要求多样性而非标准答案的评价体系。

url:95ff5dc458a22b56.abstract: The existence of aggregate welfare gains from trade is one of the classic insights from international economics. However, these conventional welfare gains are static, in the sense that they take existing factor supplies and production technologies at a point in time as given. Recent research has highlighted dynamic effects of trade through endogenous factor accumulation and technological innovation over time, although there remains less consensus about the quantitative magnitude of these dynamic effects than about their static counterparts. Key insights from this research are that short-run and long-run responses to trade liberalization differ; capital accumulation amplifies the impact of international trade shocks; trade can facilitate technology adoption and the diffusion of ideas by changing the composition of suppliers; effects on lifetime welfare differ substantially from those on steady-state welfare, once transition dynamics are taken into account; and market failures can either magnify the overall welfare gains from trade or rationalize activist trade and industrial policies.
url:95ff5dc458a22b56.abstract_zh: 贸易带来的总体福利增益存在，是国际经济学中的经典洞见之一。然而，这些传统福利增益是静态的，即它们假定某一时点的要素供给和生产技术为既定。近期研究强调了贸易通过内生要素积累和技术创新随时间产生的动态效应，尽管对这些动态效应的量化规模共识程度不如静态对应效应。该研究的关键洞见包括：贸易自由化的短期与长期反应存在差异；资本积累放大国际贸易冲击的影响；贸易通过改变供应商构成促进技术采纳和思想传播；考虑转型动态后，对终身福利的影响与对稳态福利的影响显著不同；市场失灵可能放大贸易的总体福利增益，或为积极的贸易和产业政策提供合理性依据。
url:95ff5dc458a22b56.title: DP21819 Dynamic Effects of Trade

url:961c9e125256b0b1.abstract: In the context of the growing share of public workers in the Spanish labour force, this paper analyses opportunistic behaviour in sick leave duration and return-to-work probabilities among teachers. We use administrative microdata (2011-2019), transformed into an original monthly spell-level panel. The analysis employs a tailored regression within a difference-in-differences framework exploiting the academic calendar and comparing professional sick leaves among pre-university teachers in public and private schools. Results show that the timing of sick leave endings systematically responds to the school calendar. Public-school teachers display longer sick leave durations and lower return-to-work probabilities than private-school teachers, consistent with ex post moral hazard under more generous employment protection and sick leave coverage. Around the summer break, these differences become more pronounced: public-school teachers extend their leaves further relative to private-school teachers. Simultaneously, the usual gap in return-to-work probabilities temporarily reverses, with public-school teachers becoming more likely to end their leave immediately after summer. These patterns are especially strong among mid-career workers, women, and cases involving more subjective or difficult-to-diagnose injuries.
url:961c9e125256b0b1.abstract_zh: 在西班牙劳动力中公共部门工作者占比日益增长的背景下，本文分析了教师群体在病假时长与返岗概率中的机会主义行为。我们采用2011-2019年行政微观数据，将其转化为原创的月度个体面板数据。分析基于双重差分框架，利用学年周期进行定制化回归，比较公立与私立学校大学预科教师的职业病假情况。结果显示，病假结束时间系统性地响应学年周期。相较于私立学校教师，公立学校教师病假持续时间更长、返岗概率更低，这与更优厚的就业保障和病假覆盖下的事后道德风险一致。在暑假前后，这些差异更为显著：公立学校教师相对于私立学校教师进一步延长病假。与此同时，返岗概率的常规差距暂时逆转，公立学校教师在暑假结束后立即结束病假的可能性更高。这些模式在职业生涯中期工作者、女性以及涉及更主观或难以诊断的伤病案例中尤为突出。

url:961ca827d321bb11.abstract: this study, we explore the economic consequences of landmine clearance in Mozambique, the only country that has moved from "heavily-contaminated" in 1992 to "mine-free" status in 2015. First, we compile a dataset detailing the evolution of clearance, collecting thousands of reports from the numerous demining actors. Second, we exploit the timing of demining to assess its impact on local economic activity, as reflected in satellite images of light density at night. The analysis reveals a moderate positive association that masks sizeable heterogeneity. Economic activity responds strongly to clearance of the transportation network, trade hubs, and more populous areas, while the demining-development association is weak in rural areas of low population density. Third, recognizing that landmine removal recon˝figured the accessibility to the transportation infrastructure, we apply a "market-access" approach to quantify both its direct and indirect effects. The market-access estimates reveal substantial improvements on aggregate economic activity. The market-access benefits of demining are also present in localities without any contamination. Fourth, counterfactual policy simulations project considerable gains had the fragmented process of clearance in Mozambique been centrally coordinated, prioritizing clearance of the colonial transportation routes.
url:961ca827d321bb11.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了莫桑比克排雷行动的经济后果，该国是唯一一个从1992年的“重度污染”状态转变为2015年“无雷”状态的国家。首先，我们编制了一个详细记录排雷进展的数据集，收集了众多排雷行动方数千份报告。其次，我们利用排雷的时间节点来评估其对当地经济活动的影响，这通过卫星图像中的夜间灯光密度得以反映。分析显示，存在一种适度的正向关联，但掩盖了显著的异质性。经济活动对交通网络、贸易枢纽及人口更稠密地区的排雷反应强烈，而在人口密度较低的农村地区，排雷与发展的关联则较弱。第三，鉴于地雷清除重新配置了交通基础设施的可达性，我们采用“市场准入”方法量化其直接与间接效应。市场准入估计显示，总体经济活动有显著改善。排雷的市场准入效益也惠及无污染地区。第四，反事实政策模拟预测，若莫桑比克碎片化的排雷过程曾由中央协调，优先清除殖民时期的交通路线，将带来可观收益。
url:961ca827d321bb11.title: Landmines and Spatial Development

url:963e9ee4e8fc514f.abstract: This paper develops a theory in which the degree of automation in the aggregate economy emerges endogenously as an equilibrium outcome and can be inferred from standard macroeconomic data. We define the degree of automation as the share of tasks performed by capital rather than labor and embed it in a task-based production framework with endogenous technology adoption. Aggregating task-level decisions generates a CES production function in which the economy-wide degree of automation emerges endogenously. This structure provides a transparent mapping from standard macroeconomic observables, such as the capital-labor ratio, output per worker, and the elasticity of substitution, into the degree of automation, allowing automation to be measured without relying on technology-specific indicators. Applying the framework to Japanese manufacturing industries, we show that automation increased through capital deepening even during periods of slow productivity growth. url:963e9ee4e8fc514f.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个理论框架，其中经济总体自动化程度作为均衡结果内生形成，并可通过标准宏观经济数据推断得出。我们将自动化程度定义为资本而非劳动执行的任务份额，并将其嵌入一个包含内生技术采纳的任务型生产框架中。通过加总任务层面的决策，我们推导出包含内生经济总体自动化程度的CES生产函数。该结构建立了从标准宏观经济可观测变量（如资本劳动比、人均产出和替代弹性）到自动化程度的透明映射关系，使得无需依赖特定技术指标即可衡量自动化水平。将该框架应用于日本制造业部门后，我们发现即使在生产率增长缓慢时期，自动化仍通过资本深化过程持续提升。
url:963e9ee4e8fc514f.title: The macroeconomics of automation

url:9674282b781c699c.abstract: We show that the global human capital increase during the 20th-century contributed to structural transformation. We document that almost half of the decline in aggregate agricultural employment was driven by new birth cohorts entering the labor market. We use data on educational attainment and compile a comprehensive list of policy reforms to interpret the differences in agricultural employment across cohorts. We find that the increase in schooling led to a sharp reduction in the agricultural labor supply by equipping younger cohorts with skills more valued out of agriculture. Interpreted through an equilibrium model of frictional labor reallocation, these facts imply that human capital growth accounts for about 20% of the global decline in agricultural employment.
url:9674282b781c699c.abstract_zh: 我们证明，20世纪全球人力资本的提升促进了结构转型。我们记录到，农业总就业下降中近一半是由新出生队列进入劳动力市场所驱动的。我们利用教育成就数据，并汇编了一份全面的政策改革清单，以解释不同队列间农业就业的差异。我们发现，教育程度的提高通过赋予年轻队列在农业之外更受重视的技能，导致了农业劳动力供给的急剧减少。通过一个摩擦性劳动力再配置的均衡模型进行解读，这些事实表明，人力资本增长解释了全球农业就业下降的约20%。

url:967911b85949afe4.abstract: This study explores the effects of COVID-19 school closures on labor market outcomes of Canadian parents of school-aged children. Using newly collected data on grade-level-specific school closures across 141 Canadian cities along with individual-level panel data from the Labour Force Survey, difference-in-differences estimates provide robust evidence that restrictions on in-person schooling reduced employment among partnered mothers of school-aged children by approximately 2 percentage points. For fathers, labor supply adjustments are much weaker and concentrated on single fathers. Finally, auxiliary analyses using administrative tax records provide suggestive evidence that school closures increased public benefit receipt among single parents.
url:967911b85949afe4.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了COVID-19学校关闭对加拿大有学龄儿童父母劳动力市场结果的影响。利用新收集的覆盖141个加拿大城市的分年级学校关闭数据，以及来自劳动力调查的个体层面面板数据，双重差分估计提供了稳健证据，表明面对面教学限制使有学龄儿童的已婚母亲就业率下降了约2个百分点。对于父亲而言，劳动力供给调整较弱，且主要集中在单亲父亲群体。最后，利用行政税务记录的辅助分析提供了提示性证据，表明学校关闭增加了单亲父母领取公共福利的情况。
url:967911b85949afe4.title: The Effect of School Disruptions on Parental Labor Supply: Evidence from Canadian Panel Data

url:969d44b0653cb0c5.abstract: In this paper, we revisit the classical question of how partial passive cross-ownership (PPCO) influences competition in network industries. Contrary to conventional wisdom, our findings reveal that PPCO benefits firms only when ownership shares are of limited size, and in some cases, it may reduce profitability. These unconventional results are more likely to hold with higher network externality intensity and lower product compatibility. The work characterises the conditions on the model’s parameters and provides empirical and policy implications. Similar content being viewed by others
url:969d44b0653cb0c5.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了部分被动交叉持股（PPCO）如何影响网络产业竞争这一经典问题。与传统认知相反，我们的研究发现，只有当持股比例有限时，PPCO才能为企业带来收益，在某些情况下甚至可能降低盈利能力。这些非传统结果在网络外部性强度更高、产品兼容性更低时更可能出现。本研究刻画了模型参数的条件，并提供了实证与政策启示。

url:96c06cde3c58345c.abstract: This paper investigates why the post-COVID inflation surge, though globally synchronized, led to widely divergent outcomes across countries. Using cross-country regressions for 130 economies and local projections methods for 70 advanced and emerging markets, we analyze the structural, institutional, and policy determinants of post-pandemic inflation dynamics. The results indicate that historical inflation and the scale of domestic energy price shocks account for most of the cross-country variation in cumulative post-COVID inflation. In contrast, many frequently cited country-specific, macroeconomic fundamentals and institutional features exhibit limited power to explain cross-country variation. The association between post-COVID inflation and domestic policy responses is also weak, although endogeneity complicates a clear causal interpretation. The analysis further reveals that pass-through from energy prices to headline inflation intensified markedly in the post-COVID period, particularly in emerging markets, in non-inflation-targeting regimes, and in countries that did not expand fossil fuel subsidies. These findings highlight the asymmetric transmission of supply shocks and underscore the importance of credibility, historical inflation experience, and energy policy design in shaping inflation persistence. Strengthening central bank credibility and anchoring expectations may be essential to bolster resilience against future global supply disruptions.
url:96c06cde3c58345c.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了为何新冠疫情后的通胀飙升虽具有全球同步性，却在各国间产生了截然不同的结果。基于对130个经济体的跨国回归分析以及对70个发达和新兴市场的局部投影方法研究，我们剖析了疫情后通胀动态的结构性、制度性及政策决定因素。结果表明，历史通胀水平与国内能源价格冲击的规模解释了新冠疫情后累计通胀的大部分跨国差异。相比之下，许多常被引用的国别特定因素、宏观经济基本面及制度特征在解释跨国差异方面能力有限。新冠疫情后通胀与国内政策响应之间的关联也较弱，尽管内生性问题使因果关系的清晰解读变得复杂。分析进一步揭示，疫情后能源价格向整体通胀的传导效应显著增强，尤其在新兴市场、非通胀目标制国家以及未扩大化石燃料补贴的经济体中。这些发现凸显了供给冲击的非对称传导机制，并强调了可信度、历史通胀经验及能源政策设计在塑造通胀持续性中的关键作用。加强央行可信度并锚定通胀预期，对于增强抵御未来全球供给中断的韧性至关重要。
url:96c06cde3c58345c.title: One Global Shock, Many Inflation Paths: Explaining Post-COVID Inflation Divergence

url:96db08a2edd27b4b.abstract: Formulating an education production function and using estimates of student and class discipline levels, this paper seeks to identify the relations between discipline, class size, teaching quality and scholastic outcomes. The data shows both individual and class-level discipline to be a powerful predictor of the PISA math score, while variance in discipline among classmates has a strongly negative effect. Furthermore, class discipline is correlated with larger classes. As a structural simulation demonstrates, the correlations observed in the data can be well explained by how schools allocate students and teachers to classes. This analysis allows for a break-down of the contribution of educational production factors and highlights the role of individual and class discipline to student achievements.
url:96db08a2edd27b4b.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建教育生产函数，并利用学生与班级纪律水平的估计值，旨在识别纪律、班级规模、教学质量与学业成果之间的关系。数据显示，个体及班级层面的纪律水平对PISA数学成绩具有显著预测力，而同学间纪律水平的差异则产生强烈的负面效应。此外，班级纪律与较大班级规模存在相关性。结构模拟表明，数据中观察到的相关性可通过学校如何将学生与教师分配至班级得到合理解释。该分析能够分解教育生产因素的贡献，并凸显个体与班级纪律对学生学业成就的重要作用。
url:96db08a2edd27b4b.title: Class Discipline, Class Size and Scholastic Achievement Across Countries: A Theoretical and Empirical View of Educational Production

url:973a9ee512391d0f.abstract: This paper studies market power in Mexican industries over the period 2008-23 using establishment-level data from the Mexican Economic Census. We document a substantial increase in the average price markup over marginal costs, from 12 percent in 2008 to 27 percent in 2023. The sources of this increase vary across sectors and time: services, particularly wholesale and retail trade, account for most of the increase in markups until 2018, while manufacturing, led by transportation equipment and export-oriented industries, plays a larger role in more recent years. Rising markups in services are associated with greater local labor market concentration, suggestive of increasing monopsony power. In manufacturing, markup growth is linked to higher capital expenditure, consistent with firms sustaining larger markups to recover higher fixed costs. Moreover, rising markups in manufacturing are positively associated with total factor productivity, whereas in services they are uncorrelated with productivity. Overall, these findings suggest that while market power has increased over time, its underlying drivers have shifted from monopsonistic power in labor markets to higher fixed costs, with more favorable efficiency implications in recent years.
url:973a9ee512391d0f.abstract_zh: 本文利用墨西哥经济普查的企业层面数据，研究了2008年至2023年间墨西哥行业的市场势力。我们记录了平均价格加成率相对于边际成本的显著上升，从2008年的12%增至2023年的27%。这一增长的来源在不同部门和时间段有所差异：服务业，尤其是批发和零售贸易，在2018年前贡献了加成率增长的大部分；而制造业，以运输设备和出口导向型行业为主导，在近年发挥了更大作用。服务业加成率的上升与地方劳动力市场集中度的提高相关，暗示着买方垄断势力的增强。在制造业中，加成率的增长与更高的资本支出相关联，这与企业维持较大加成率以回收更高固定成本的现象一致。此外，制造业中加成率的上升与全要素生产率呈正相关，而在服务业中则与生产率无相关性。总体而言，这些发现表明，尽管市场势力随时间增强，其潜在驱动因素已从劳动力市场的买方垄断势力转向更高的固定成本，且近年来的效率影响更为有利。

url:9759bb1f28c23817.abstract: We document market power in U.S. equity securities lending and examine its origins and consequences. We develop a dynamic model of securities lending and estimate it on the cross-section of U.S. equities, showing that the dominant custodian-intermediated market structure emerges as a response to short sellers’ information-leakage concerns. Short sellers prefer this opaque market structure over a centralized alternative, particularly for smaller stocks, despite the associated non-competitive fees. This is because their trading strategies become unprofitable if information leaks prematurely. Thus, unlike in standard product markets, the demand side in securities lending values opacity, which is important for regulatory design.
url:9759bb1f28c23817.abstract_zh: 我们记录了美国股票证券借贷中的市场势力，并考察了其起源与后果。我们构建了一个证券借贷的动态模型，并基于美国股票截面数据进行了估计，结果表明，以托管机构为中介的主导型市场结构是对卖空者信息泄露担忧的回应。尽管这种不透明的市场结构伴随着非竞争性费用，但卖空者仍偏好于此，而非集中化替代方案，尤其是对于小盘股而言。这是因为，如果信息过早泄露，他们的交易策略将无利可图。因此，与标准产品市场不同，证券借贷的需求方看重不透明性，这对监管设计具有重要意义。

url:9761ed41f1b516ff.abstract: We establish that macroprudential policies limiting capital flows can curb risks arising from corporate foreign currency borrowing in emerging markets. Using detailed firm- level data from India, we show that propensity to issue foreign currency debt for the same firm is higher when the difference in short-term interest rates between India and the US is higher, i.e., when the dollar ‘carry trade’ is more profitable; this behavior is driven by the period after the global financial crisis. The positive relationship between issuance and the ‘carry trade’ breaks down once regulators institute more stringent interest-rate caps on foreign currency borrowing. Riskier borrowers such as importers and those with higher interest costs cut issuance most. Firm equity exposure to foreign exchange risk rose after issuance in favorable funding conditions and emerged as a source of external sector vulnerability during the ‘taper tantrum’ of 2013. Macroprudential policy action limiting capital flows is able to nullify this effect, such as during the market stress due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
url:9761ed41f1b516ff.abstract_zh: 我们证实，限制资本流动的宏观审慎政策能够抑制新兴市场企业外币借款所引发的风险。基于印度企业层面的详细数据，研究发现：当印度与美国短期利率差扩大（即美元"套利交易"盈利空间增大）时，同一企业发行外币债务的倾向显著上升——这一行为主要出现在全球金融危机之后。一旦监管机构对外币借款实施更严格的利率上限，发行行为与"套利交易"的正相关关系即告瓦解。进口商及利息成本较高的风险偏好型借款企业降幅最为显著。在有利融资条件下，企业股权的外汇风险敞口随债务发行而扩大，并在2013年"缩减恐慌"期间成为外部脆弱性的来源。限制资本流动的宏观审慎政策能够有效消除此效应，例如在新冠疫情引发的市场压力期间。

url:97cabffc1790e7c0.abstract: Recent work in economics has developed survey-based measures of economic preferences that are “experimentally” or “behaviorally validated.” We scrutinize this approach focusing on the Global Preference Survey (Falk et al., 2018, 2023). Replicating their behavioral validation on almost 2,000 participants in five countries, China, Colombia, Iran, Kenya, and the US, we find that many items correlate significantly with behavior in incentivized choice experiments, but coefficients vary and are not always sizable. While hypothetical versions of an experiment consistently show the strongest correlations, qualitative self-assessments are also almost always among the best single-item modules predicting behavior in all countries. Within- and across-preference principal component analyses, as well as comparison in terms of predictive validity, suggest that qualitative self-assessments and behavioral measures capture distinct dimensions of the same latent construct of an economic preference, casting doubt on the use of one instrument as an easy substitute for the other.
url:97cabffc1790e7c0.abstract_zh: 近期的经济学研究开发了基于调查的经济偏好测量方法，这些方法经过“实验性”或“行为性”验证。我们审视了这一方法，重点关注全球偏好调查（Falk等人，2018，2023）。通过在中国、哥伦比亚、伊朗、肯尼亚和美国五个国家近2000名参与者中复制其行为验证，我们发现许多条目与激励性选择实验中的行为显著相关，但系数各异且并非总是显著。虽然实验的假设版本始终显示出最强的相关性，但定性自我评估也几乎在所有国家中始终是预测行为的最佳单项模块之一。偏好内和偏好间的主成分分析，以及预测效度的比较表明，定性自我评估和行为测量捕捉了同一经济偏好潜在结构的不同维度，这对使用一种工具作为另一种工具的简单替代提出了质疑。

url:9837e2571a6c97d0.abstract: GLP-1 therapies for obesity promise substantial health improvements, but little is known about how their benefits vary across socioeconomic and demographic groups. Using a nationally representative microsimulation model of US adults and Shapely-value decomposition, we estimate the lifetime health and economic benefits of GLP-1 treatment and examine how those gains vary across individuals. The largest differences emerge across education. Individuals with less than a high school education experience experience roughly 14% higher gains in lifetime net social value, 16-17% larger improvements in discounted generalized risk- and severity-adjusted life-years (GRASA-QALYs), and 20% greater increases in life expectancy relative to the cohort mean, whereas individuals with college degrees experience gains 15-27% below the mean across these outcomes. Black and Hispanic individuals also tend to experience larger improvements in health outcomes and social value than White individuals, including larger gains in GRASA-QALYs and life expectancy and larger reductions in diabetes risk and duration. Females likewise experience larger predicted treatment gains than men. These patterns are consistent with the idea that the largest gains arise among populations facing greater socioeconomic constraints in sustaining behavioral weight control. GLP-1 innovation may therefore mitigate inequality in obesity-related disease and survival, advancing equity in population health.
url:9837e2571a6c97d0.abstract_zh: GLP-1肥胖疗法有望带来显著的健康改善，但关于其收益如何在不同社会经济和人口群体间分布的研究尚不充分。通过使用具有全国代表性的美国成年人微观模拟模型和沙普利值分解方法，我们估算了GLP-1治疗带来的终身健康与经济收益，并考察了这些收益在不同个体间的差异。最大差异出现在教育水平层面：与队列均值相比，高中以下学历者在终身净社会价值上的收益高出约14%，贴现后广义风险与严重程度调整生命年（GRASA-QALYs）改善幅度高出16-17%，预期寿命增长高出20%；而拥有大学学历者在这三项指标上的收益则低于均值15-27%。黑人和西班牙裔个体在健康结果和社会价值方面的改善幅度也普遍高于白人群体，包括GRASA-QALYs和预期寿命的更大提升，以及糖尿病风险与病程的更大程度降低。女性预测的治疗收益同样高于男性。这些模式与以下观点一致：在维持行为体重控制方面面临更大社会经济约束的人群，其收益最为显著。因此，GLP-1创新可能有助于缓解肥胖相关疾病与生存率方面的不平等，促进人口健康公平。

url:98510ac540db3cb6.abstract: We study inference via heteroskedasticity in linear models commonly used for macroeconomic policy analysis, where covariate endogeneity must often be addressed with limited time and data. Our framework nests standard heteroskedasticity-based approaches, allows for new non-nested restrictions, and does not require ex-ante regime labelling. We propose an easily implementable weak-identification-robust test and derive sufficient conditions for its validity. Simulation results show good size and power properties in a wide range of settings. Empirical applications to the fuel-price passthrough in Sierra Leone, the effect of remittances on consumption in the Philippines, and exchange-rate passthroughs in many countries illustrate the versatility and scalability of our approach.
url:98510ac540db3cb6.abstract_zh: 本文研究线性模型中异方差性推断方法，该模型常用于宏观经济政策分析，其中协变量内生性问题通常需在有限时间和数据条件下加以处理。我们的框架涵盖了标准的基于异方差性的方法，允许引入新的非嵌套约束条件，且无需事先设定制度标签。我们提出了一种易于实施的弱识别稳健性检验，并推导出其有效性的充分条件。模拟结果表明，该方法在多种设定下具有良好的检验水平和检验功效。通过对塞拉利昂燃料价格传导、菲律宾汇款对消费的影响以及多国汇率传导的实证应用，展示了我们方法的通用性与可扩展性。

url:987c334ea67843dc.abstract: We examine the effects of laxer non-financial disclosure regulation on operating costs and access to external financing for micro firms in Italy. Starting in 2016, firms below certain size thresholds were exempted from filing reports with qualitative information that complements standard balance sheet items. Compliance rates were higher among older and more productive firms, in line with strategic considerations that play a role in policy adoption. However, the benefits of simplified reporting appear limited: in a regression discontinuity design that exploits the multidimensional size cut-offs that determine eligibility, we find no evidence of cost savings. We instead document a negative impact on ownership transfers and access to credit markets due to increased opacity, suggesting that the reduction of information disclosure to stakeholders may hinder business dynamism.
url:987c334ea67843dc.abstract_zh: 我们考察了意大利微型企业在非财务披露监管放宽后，其运营成本和外部融资渠道所受的影响。自2016年起，低于特定规模门槛的企业被豁免提交包含定性信息的报告，这些信息原本是对标准资产负债表项目的补充。合规率在较老且生产率较高的企业中更高，这与政策采纳中战略考量所起的作用相符。然而，简化报告的好处似乎有限：在利用决定资格的多维规模断点的回归不连续设计中，我们未发现成本节约的证据。相反，我们记录了因透明度降低而对所有权转移和信贷市场准入产生的负面影响，这表明向利益相关者减少信息披露可能阻碍商业活力。

url:98c6883d7aa0fc1e.abstract: How do households respond when deposit rates drop below zero? Using administrative micro data and exploiting cross-bank variation in interest rate policies, we study a major episode of negative deposit rates in Denmark affecting two thirds of household deposits. We find that households strongly reduced deposit balances when exposed to negative deposit rates, allocating funds to stock portfolios and consumption. In a large-scale survey, we document important roles for loss aversion, perceived unfairness, intertemporal substitution and return considerations in driving these responses. Our findings suggest that monetary policy can have strong consumption effects in negative territory.
url:98c6883d7aa0fc1e.abstract_zh: 当存款利率降至负值时，家庭会如何应对？利用行政微观数据并借助银行间利率政策的差异，我们研究了丹麦一次影响三分之二家庭存款的重大负存款利率事件。研究发现，当家庭面临负存款利率时，其存款余额显著减少，资金被重新配置至股票投资组合和消费领域。通过大规模调查，我们证实损失厌恶、感知不公、跨期替代及收益考量在驱动这些行为中发挥重要作用。研究结果表明，货币政策在负利率区间可能对消费产生显著影响。

url:99028cfa4f23b869.abstract: Quantifying merger effects and conducting other counterfactual analyses is often difficult in platform markets because direct and indirect network effects link demand within and across market sides. We develop a general empirical framework for two-sided markets that incorporates these effects within an otherwise standard empirical IO approach. The framework does not impose a particular demand specification: researchers can estimate flexible demand systems on each side, for example, using BLP-type demand on one side or both. We allow direct and indirect network effects to vary across groups. Standard one-sided merger simulation emerges as a special case when network effects are absent. We provide sufficient conditions for uniqueness in the coordination game within and across market sides and for existence and uniqueness in the firms’ pricing game. These conditions are testable. When these conditions hold, the framework supports recovery of marginal costs from firms’ first-order conditions and can be used to conduct counterfactual analysis, including merger simulation.
url:99028cfa4f23b869.abstract_zh: 在平台市场中，量化并购效应及开展其他反事实分析往往较为困难，因为直接和间接网络效应将市场内及跨市场的需求相互关联。我们为双边市场构建了一个通用实证框架，在保留标准实证产业组织方法的基础上，将这些效应纳入其中。该框架不强制设定特定的需求函数形式：研究者可在各市场侧估计灵活的需求系统，例如在一侧或双侧采用BLP型需求模型。我们允许直接和间接网络效应在不同群体间存在差异。当不存在网络效应时，标准单边市场并购模拟即成为该框架的特例。我们为市场内及跨市场协调博弈的唯一性，以及企业定价博弈的存在性与唯一性提供了充分条件，这些条件均可检验。当这些条件成立时，该框架支持从企业一阶条件中反推边际成本，并可用于开展包括并购模拟在内的反事实分析。

url:992dd87e2fe39a2f.abstract: We document that migration flows upon retirement are predominantly from richer, more urban to poorer, more rural regions. In theory, the local economic implications of senior in-migration are ambiguous, while empirically there is little existing evidence on whether attracting mobile seniors can be an effective tool to promote economic development among lagging regions. We combine a unique collection of microdata from France with a new empirical strategy to fill this gap. We find that senior inflows have significant positive effects on the local economy over the course of a decade, including increases in the working-age population, total employment, GDP, average incomes, fiscal revenues and housing construction. These effects are particularly pronounced among initially poorer regions. They are accompanied by an increase in the share of services in the local economy, driven by employment growth in health, food services and retail sectors. Combining these estimates with observed region-to-region net migration flows, we find that mobile seniors have become a significant force for reducing the concentration of employment and GDP across regions.
url:992dd87e2fe39a2f.abstract_zh: 我们记录到，退休迁移流主要从较富裕、城市化程度较高的地区流向较贫困、乡村化的地区。理论上，老年人口迁入对当地经济的影响尚不明确，而实证上，关于吸引流动老年人是否能成为促进落后地区经济发展的有效工具，现有证据寥寥。我们结合法国独特的微观数据集合与新的实证策略，填补了这一空白。研究发现，老年人口流入对当地经济在十年期间产生显著正面效应，包括劳动年龄人口、总就业、GDP、平均收入、财政收入及住房建设的增长。这些效应在初始较贫困地区尤为突出，并伴随当地经济中服务业占比的提升，主要由健康、餐饮服务和零售业的就业增长驱动。将这些估计与观察到的区域间净迁移流相结合，我们发现流动老年人已成为减少区域间就业和GDP集中度的重要力量。
url:992dd87e2fe39a2f.title: Senior Migration, Local Economic Development and Spatial Concentration

url:9941e4a04aac5865.abstract: this paper, we build a general equilibrium model that takes the institutional details of the foreign exchange market into account and allows for deviations from full information rational expectations (FIRE) in a way consistent with forecast survey data and traders’ asset positions. We show that the testable implications of this model — related to foreign exchange derivatives positions, and both realized and expected exchange rates — are strongly supported in the data. Moreover, we argue that the particular form of deviation from FIRE implied by the data can help resolve important exchange rate puzzles, such as the Fama puzzle and the delayed overshooting puzzle, and can generate hump-shaped dynamics of exchange rates.
url:9941e4a04aac5865.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个一般均衡模型，该模型考虑了外汇市场的制度细节，并以与预测调查数据和交易者资产头寸一致的方式，允许偏离完全信息理性预期（FIRE）。我们证明，该模型的可检验含义——涉及外汇衍生品头寸、已实现汇率和预期汇率——在数据中得到了有力支持。此外，我们认为，数据所隐含的偏离FIRE的特定形式，有助于解决重要的汇率谜题，例如Fama谜题和延迟超调谜题，并能产生汇率的驼峰形动态特征。
url:9941e4a04aac5865.title: Individual Beliefs, Demand for Currency, and Exchange Rate Dynamics
url:9941e4a04aac5865.title_zh: 个体信念、货币需求与汇率动态

url:994780e5710a84e8.abstract: We analyse how banks’ climate sentiments affect credit risk adjustments and lending conditions for high- and low- carbon investments and the implications for firms’ investments and the decarbonization of the economy. We model climate sentiments as banks forming expectations about firms’ performance in the low-carbon transition scenarios of the Network for Greening the Financial System, based on firms’ energy technology alignment and on perceived policy credibility. We distinguish between high climate sentiments, i.e. banks’ strong confidence in the success of climate policies and the future performance of low-carbon firms, and low sentiments. To anaylse these dynamics we tailor and extend EIRIN, a macro-financial Stock-Flow Consistent model of an open economy, and widely used by financial supervisors. EIRIN is populated by a limited number of heterogeneous agents and sectors, with the real and financial side of the economy treated in an integrated way. Calibrating EIRIN on the Austrian economy, we find that high banks’ climate sentiments can reinforce the impact of climate policies, resulting in a 4.5% reduction in the GHG emissions to GDP ratio and in a 0.6% increase in GDP growth, compared to the Net Zero scenario without climate sentiments. Conversely, low climate sentiments can counteract climate policy impacts, leading to an 8.5% increase in GHG emissions to GDP ratio. Furthermore, credit constraints on low-carbon investments can further hinder the low-carbon transition, increasing the GHG emissions to GDP ratio by 15%. Our findings highlight the importance for policy makers to deliver clear and credible messages about the low-carbon transition to the banking sector, in order to align expectations and investment decisions.
url:994780e5710a84e8.abstract_zh: 我们分析了银行的气候情绪如何影响高碳与低碳投资的信用风险调整及贷款条件，以及这些因素对企业投资和经济脱碳进程的影响。我们将气候情绪建模为银行基于企业的能源技术契合度及对政策可信度的感知，对企业在绿色金融体系网络（Network for Greening the Financial System）低碳转型情景下表现所形成的预期。我们区分了高气候情绪，即银行对气候政策成功及低碳企业未来表现抱有强烈信心，与低气候情绪。为分析这些动态，我们定制并扩展了EIRIN模型，这是一个开放经济的宏观金融存量-流量一致模型，被金融监管机构广泛使用。EIRIN模型包含有限数量的异质性主体和部门，并将经济的实体面与金融面进行一体化处理。以奥地利经济为校准对象，我们发现银行的高气候情绪能强化气候政策的影响，与无气候情绪下的净零情景相比，可使温室气体排放与GDP之比降低4.5%，GDP增长提高0.6%。相反，低气候情绪可能抵消气候政策的效果，导致温室气体排放与GDP之比上升8.5%。此外，对低碳投资的信贷约束会进一步阻碍低碳转型，使温室气体排放与GDP之比增加15%。我们的研究结果强调了政策制定者向银行部门传递清晰且可信的低碳转型信息的重要性，以协调预期和投资决策。

url:99adf30bf4598c9f.abstract: This paper studies how relationship-specific learning affects the joint dynamics of exports and trade finance. Using micro-level Chilean data, it documents that new exporters initially rely on cash-in-advance payments and gradually transition to providing trade credit as relationships mature, with faster transitions in riskier destinations and for less experienced firms. Motivated by this, the paper develops a general equilibrium trade model that integrates learning about foreign demand and counterparty risk together with firms’ endogenous export and trade finance choices. The model is used to investigate the role of learning and risks in shaping export adjustments and quantify the impact of shocks to the cost of trade finance on aggregate exports. The analysis finds that the response to these shocks depends on the riskiness of the destination and is amplified by the disruption of long-term trading relationships.
url:99adf30bf4598c9f.abstract_zh: 本文研究关系专用性学习如何影响出口与贸易融资的联合动态。基于智利微观企业数据，本文发现新出口商最初依赖预付款交易，随着贸易关系成熟逐步转向提供贸易信贷，且在风险更高的目的地及经验较少的企业中，这一转型速度更快。受此现象启发，本文构建了一个整合外国需求与交易对手风险学习机制、以及企业内生出口与贸易融资选择的一般均衡贸易模型。该模型用于探究学习机制与风险在塑造出口调整中的作用，并量化贸易融资成本冲击对总出口的影响。分析表明，出口对上述冲击的反应取决于目的地的风险水平，且长期贸易关系的中断会放大这种影响。

url:99eac22a6c0eae6a.abstract: Emerging market economies (EMEs) regularly tap domestic and international capital markets through scheduled sovereign bond auctions. In this paper, we leverage a novel dataset covering over 75,000 sovereign issuance events and 20,000 securities from 20 EMEs between the early 2000s and 2023 to analyze the determinants of bond issuance choices, focusing on volume, maturity, and currency denomination. We find that local currency debt issuance is largely associated with refinancing needs, while foreign currency issuance reflects more strategic and cyclical considerations. In particular, foreign currency issuance correlates with global macroeconomic conditions, interest rate differentials, and investor sentiment. Our findings suggest that EME governments differentiate their debt management strategies based on the currency of issuance, with local currency issuance shaped by domestic budget mechanics and foreign currency issuance by external constraints and opportunities.
url:99eac22a6c0eae6a.abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体（EMEs）通过定期主权债券拍卖，持续进入国内和国际资本市场。本文利用2000年代初至2023年间覆盖20个新兴市场经济体超过75,000次主权发行事件及20,000只证券的新数据集，分析债券发行选择的决定因素，重点关注发行规模、期限和货币计价。研究发现，本币债券发行主要与再融资需求相关，而外币债券发行则更多反映战略性和周期性考量。具体而言，外币债券发行与全球宏观经济状况、利率差异及投资者情绪存在关联。研究结果表明，新兴市场经济体政府会根据发行货币差异化其债务管理策略：本币发行受国内预算机制驱动，外币发行则受外部约束与机遇影响。
