url:9a21537a04fb1720.abstract: Agentic AI systems are increasingly being deployed as productive resources in organizational workflows, yet existing evaluation methods primarily measure isolated technical performance rather than economic contribution. This paper introduces \emph{Agentomics}, a workflow-based framework for valuing, attributing, and pricing human and artificial agents. The framework models a workflow as a configuration of heterogeneous agents whose collective performance determines gross value, deployment cost, reliability, and expected failure loss. Workflow value is treated as a team-level quantity that may include complementarities, substitution effects, bottlenecks, and nonlinear production; additive stage-level value is only a special case. Building on this workflow model, the paper formulates AI deployment as a coalition-formation problem and defines coalition value as the incremental net surplus generated relative to a benchmark human workflow. The Shapley value is then used to attribute economic surplus among participating AI agents, yielding a principled connection among valuation, accountability, and market pricing. The resulting Shapley pricing equilibrium provides a normative benchmark for assessing whether agent prices reflect expected marginal contribution. A security-operations case study illustrates how the framework accounts for productivity gains, deployment costs, reliability losses, and coalition-level complementarities in hybrid human--AI workflows.
url:9a21537a04fb1720.abstract_zh: 自主型人工智能系统正越来越多地被部署为组织工作流程中的生产性资源，然而现有评估方法主要衡量孤立的技术性能而非经济贡献。本文提出"Agentomics"框架，这是一个基于工作流程的评估框架，用于对人类与人工智能代理进行价值评估、贡献归因和定价。该框架将工作流程建模为异质性代理的配置组合，其集体绩效决定了总价值、部署成本、可靠性和预期故障损失。工作流程价值被视为团队层面的量值，可能包含互补性、替代效应、瓶颈和非线性生产；可加性的阶段层面价值仅为特例。基于此工作流程模型，本文将人工智能部署形式化为联盟形成问题，并将联盟价值定义为相对于基准人类工作流程所产生的增量净剩余。随后采用沙普利值对参与的人工智能代理进行经济剩余归因，从而在价值评估、问责机制与市场定价之间建立原则性关联。由此产生的沙普利定价均衡为评估代理价格是否反映预期边际贡献提供了规范性基准。通过安全运营案例研究，本文展示了该框架如何核算人机混合工作流程中的生产力增益、部署成本、可靠性损失及联盟层面互补性。
url:9a21537a04fb1720.title: Agentomics: Economic Foundations for the Valuation, Attribution, and Pricing of AI Agents in Human-AI Workflows
url:9a21537a04fb1720.title_zh: Agentomics：人机工作流中AI代理的估值、归因与定价的经济学基础

url:9a23080c5a4cce4e.abstract: A salient feature of the post-COVID inflation surge is that economic activity has remained resilient despite unfavorable supply-side developments. We develop a macroeconomic model with nonlinear price and wage Phillips curves, endogenous intrinsic indexation, and an unobserved components representation of a cost-push shock that is consistent with these observations. In our model, a persistent large adverse supply shock can lead to a persistent inflation surge while output expands if the central bank follows an inflation forecast-based policy rule and thus abstains from hiking policy rates for some time as it (erroneously) expects inflationary pressures to dissipate quickly. A standard linearized formulation of our model cannot account for these observations under identical assumptions. Our nonlinear framework implies that the standard prescription of "looking throughâ€ supply shocks is a good policy for small shocks when inflation is near the central bank's target, but that such a policy may be quite risky when economic activity is strong and large shocks drive inflation well above target. Moreover, our model implies that the economic costs of "going the last mileâ€ -i.e., a tight stance aimed at returning inflation quickly to target-can be substantial.
url:9a23080c5a4cce4e.abstract_zh: 后疫情时代通胀飙升的一个显著特征是，尽管供给侧形势不利，经济活动仍保持韧性。我们构建了一个宏观经济模型，该模型包含非线性的价格和工资菲利普斯曲线、内生性固有指数化机制，以及一个与上述观察相符的成本推动冲击的不可观测成分表示。在我们的模型中，如果中央银行遵循基于通胀预测的政策规则，并因此（错误地）预期通胀压力将迅速消散而在一段时间内避免加息，那么持续的大规模不利供给冲击可能导致持续的通胀飙升，同时产出扩张。在相同假设下，我们模型的标准线性化形式无法解释这些观察结果。我们的非线性框架表明，当通胀接近中央银行目标时，标准建议“透视”供给冲击对于小规模冲击是良好政策，但当经济活动强劲且大规模冲击将通胀推至远高于目标水平时，此类政策可能相当冒险。此外，我们的模型表明，“走完最后一英里”——即旨在迅速将通胀回归目标的紧缩政策立场——的经济成本可能相当可观。
url:9a23080c5a4cce4e.title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Scares

url:9a2b0313c054d017.abstract: Policymakers learned the wrong lessons about bank governance from the 2008 financial crisis — and the response to Credit Suisse's collapse demonstrates that these misconceptions persist. Post-crisis commentators blamed agency conflicts between shareholders and management, focusing on short-term behaviours. The real culprit was risk-shifting: shareholders, boards, and management together transferring risk to debtholders and taxpayers. The policy response was counterproductive: say-on-pay provisions, deferred equity compensation, and enhanced shareholder engagement do not reduce risk-taking — they amplify it. Supervision failed to prevent risk-shifting because regulators operate reactively, intervening only after problems materialise. Credit Suisse exemplifies this dynamic: despite repeated regulatory interventions, its shareholder value-oriented board continued to pursue ever riskier strategies. Concrete solutions exist, but they require fundamental reform of managerial compensation and of the role of boards and supervisors. Instead of exclusive equity-based compensation, regulators could impose pay that aligns with creditors' interests and financial stability. More boldly, banks could adopt structures giving creditors and supervisors governance powers commensurate with risk exposure. The point is to move from reactive supervision — which attempts to constrain risk-shifting after the fact — to prophylactic governance: restructuring the incentive environment so that risk-shifting cannot operate effectively, rather than treating its symptoms after they have manifested themselves.
url:9a2b0313c054d017.abstract_zh: 政策制定者从2008年金融危机中关于银行治理汲取了错误的教训——而对瑞士信贷倒闭的应对表明，这些误解依然存在。危机后的评论者将矛头指向股东与管理层之间的代理冲突，聚焦于短期行为。真正的罪魁祸首是风险转移：股东、董事会和管理层共同将风险转嫁给债权人和纳税人。政策应对适得其反：股东投票权条款、递延股权薪酬以及增强股东参与度并未减少风险承担——反而加剧了它。监管未能阻止风险转移，因为监管机构采取被动应对方式，仅在问题显现后才进行干预。瑞士信贷正是这一动态的例证：尽管监管屡次干预，其以股东价值为导向的董事会仍继续追求日益高风险的战略。具体解决方案是存在的，但它们需要对管理层薪酬以及董事会和监管机构的角色进行根本性改革。与其采用纯粹的股权薪酬，监管者可以强制实施与债权人利益和金融稳定相一致的薪酬结构。更大胆的是，银行可以采用赋予债权人和监管机构与风险敞口相称的治理权力的结构。关键在于从被动监管——试图在事后约束风险转移——转向预防性治理：重构激励环境，使风险转移无法有效运作，而非在其症状显现后再加以处理。
url:9a2b0313c054d017.title: DP21136 Bank Governance: Lessons Still Not Learned

url:9a40806dba36c826.abstract: We examine the long-term pattern of state formation and the mythical historical Chinese unity under one single political regime based on the compilation of a large geocoded annual data series of political regimes and incidences of warfare between 221 BC and 1911 AD. By classifying our data sets into two types of regimes - agrarian and nomadic – and three types of warfare– agrarian/nomadic, agrarian/agrarian and internal rebellions – and applying an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model, we find that nomadic-agrarian warfare and internal rebellion strengthens unification but agrarian/agrarian warfare entrenches fragmentation. Our research highlights the combination of China’s precocious ideology of a single unified ruler, environmental circumscription on the easternmost end of Eurasia and persistent agrarian-nomadic warfare as the driving force behind China’s eventual unity. We further discuss the long-run implications of Chinese unity on economic performance in a global context.
url:9a40806dba36c826.abstract_zh: 我们基于公元前221年至公元1911年间大规模地理编码的年度政治体制与战争事件数据序列，考察了单一政治体制下国家形成的长期模式及神话般的中国历史统一。通过将数据集划分为两类政体——农耕与游牧——以及三类战争——农耕/游牧、农耕/农耕及内部叛乱——并应用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型，我们发现游牧-农耕战争与内部叛乱强化了统一，而农耕/农耕战争则固化了分裂。我们的研究凸显了中国早熟的单一天命统治者意识形态、欧亚大陆最东端的环境限制以及持续的农耕-游牧战争三者结合，作为中国最终统一的驱动力。我们进一步在全球背景下讨论了中国统一对经济绩效的长期影响。
url:9a40806dba36c826.title: States and Wars: China’s Long March towards Unity and its Consequences, 221 BC – 1911 AD

url:9a7739ea25d7559e.abstract: This paper studies how a Covid-19 lockdown affected residential lease payments. Survey data on 1511 Israeli renter households show nearly one in eight households not paying full rent during the lockdown, with these households holding back, on average, a third of their contractually due rent. Financially fragile households with greater income cuts, and households with leases lacking provisions that effectively provide for damages upon non-payment pay a lower share of contract rent. So do households with more frequent encounters with their landlord, or longer tenure in the apartment. Bargaining and relational contracts theories help explain these results.
url:9a7739ea25d7559e.abstract_zh: 本文研究了新冠疫情封锁如何影响住宅租赁支付。针对1511户以色列租房家庭的调查数据显示，封锁期间近八分之一的家庭未全额支付租金，这些家庭平均扣留了合同规定租金的三分之一。财务脆弱、收入削减更大的家庭，以及租赁合同中缺乏有效违约赔偿条款的家庭，支付的合同租金比例较低。同样，与房东接触更频繁或在公寓居住时间更长的家庭也是如此。议价理论和关系契约理论有助于解释这些结果。
url:9a7739ea25d7559e.title: Agreements Must Be Kept? Residential Leases during Covid-19
url:9a7739ea25d7559e.title_zh: 契约必须信守？新冠疫情下的住宅租赁合同

url:9a7c262b083404f5.abstract: This paper analyzes the effects of dividend tax reforms on tax revenues, income shifting, and earnings retention. It examines two significant policy changes in Israel during the 2010s. Using administrative tax records, we study a permanent five-percentage point increase in the dividend tax rate in 2012, and a temporary tax relief enacted in 2017. The permanent tax hike triggered an immediate surge of over 100% in reported dividend income and tax revenues. It did not generate a lasting shift in dividend flows. In contrast, the temporary relief of 2017 led to a sharp decline in dividend payments upon its expiration. Notably, firms increased earnings retention after the preferential rate ended, potentially anticipating similar future relief. We also find evidence of income shifting via wage-to-dividend conversions for tax planning. Finally, increased earnings retention after 2017 produced a 1–2 percentage point downward bias in the top 1% income share due to unreported dividend income.
url:9a7c262b083404f5.abstract_zh: 本文分析了股息税改革对税收收入、收入转移及留存收益的影响。研究聚焦于2010年代以色列两项重大政策变革。基于行政税收记录，我们考察了2012年股息税率永久性提高5个百分点，以及2017年实施的临时性税收减免政策。永久性增税导致申报股息收入及税收收入立即激增逾100%，但并未引发股息流的持续性转移。相比之下，2017年的临时性减免政策在到期后导致股息支付急剧下降。值得注意的是，企业在优惠税率终止后增加了留存收益，这可能是预期未来将出现类似减免措施。我们还发现了通过工资-股息转换进行税务筹划的收入转移证据。最后，2017年后留存收益的增加导致未申报股息收入使顶层1%收入份额产生1-2个百分点的低估偏差。
url:9a7c262b083404f5.title: Capital Taxation, Income Shifting, and Retained Earnings: Evidence from Dividend Tax Reforms
url:9a7c262b083404f5.title_zh: 资本税、收入转移与留存收益：来自股息税改革的证据

url:9a8029f5ddcfb5eb.abstract: In recent decades, economists studying international trade have gained access to an unprecedented volume and variety of data. These data have provided new insights and a more granular understanding of the mechanics of trade. Analyzing a large corpus of papers, we document that the nature of research has also shifted. Previously, the typical trade paper was either purely theoretical or an empirical paper testing theoretical predictions. More recently, scholarship has shifted toward a more integrated approach, particularly quantitative modeling. This development is surprising. We might have expected the data revolution (and contemporaneous credibility revolution) to increase the share of primarily empirical papers—although the markers of these revolutions are clearly evident in the rise of causal inference within empirical work. This article reviews these developments, assessing the strengths and limitations of different modes of inquiry, and plotting a path forward to harness the growing richness of data within the field.
url:9a8029f5ddcfb5eb.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，研究国际贸易的经济学家得以接触到前所未有的海量且多样化的数据。这些数据为理解贸易机制提供了新的洞见和更为精细的视角。通过分析大量论文，我们发现研究性质也发生了转变。以往，典型的贸易论文要么是纯理论性的，要么是检验理论预测的实证研究。而近年来，学术界更倾向于采用一种更为综合的方法，尤其是定量建模。这一发展出乎意料。我们或许会预期，数据革命（以及同时期的可信度革命）会提高以实证为主的论文比例——尽管这些革命的标志在实证研究中因果推断的兴起中显而易见。本文回顾了这些发展，评估了不同研究模式的优势与局限，并规划了在该领域内利用日益丰富数据的未来路径。
url:9a8029f5ddcfb5eb.title: DP21851 The Data Revolution, and It's Uses, in International Trade
url:9a8029f5ddcfb5eb.title_zh: DP21851 数据革命及其在国际贸易中的应用

url:9a953d6d1a7ee0ba.abstract: We develop a two-country business-cycle model of the US and the rest of the world with dollar dominance in trade invoicing, in cross-border credit, and in safe assets. The interplay between these elements---dollar trinity---rationalizes salient features of the Global Financial Cycle in the data: When its tide subsides, the dollar appreciates, financial conditions tighten, the world business cycle slows down, and emerging-market central banks face a trade-off between mitigating the recession and dampening price pressures. We find the dollar is no sideshow in this, but central for the transmission of the Global Financial Cycle to the world economy.
url:9a953d6d1a7ee0ba.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含美国与世界其他地区的两国商业周期模型，其中美元在贸易计价、跨境信贷和安全资产领域占据主导地位。这些要素之间的相互作用——美元三位一体——合理化了数据中全球金融周期的显著特征：当美元潮汐退去时，美元升值，金融状况收紧，全球商业周期放缓，新兴市场央行面临缓解经济衰退与抑制价格压力之间的权衡。我们发现，美元在此过程中并非配角，而是全球金融周期向世界经济传导的核心环节。
url:9a953d6d1a7ee0ba.title: Dollar Trinity and the Global Financial Cycle
url:9a953d6d1a7ee0ba.title_zh: 美元三位一体与全球金融周期

url:9abda654aee1e9ff.title: Adapting to Changing Rainfall and Developing Off‐Farm Employment: Implications for the Adoption of Direct Seeding in Rice Production
url:9abda654aee1e9ff.title_zh: 适应降雨变化与发展非农就业：对水稻生产采用直播种植的影响

url:9ac5133e0e64c8f5.abstract: This study evaluates the effectiveness of separate biowaste collection implemented by French local authorities by assessing its impact on the quantities of residual household waste collected per capita. Using a staggered Difference-in-Differences approach, we first examine the dynamic effect of biowaste separation policies on residual household waste. We then explore the heterogeneity of this effect across various economic and sociodemographic contexts, as well as under different waste pricing systems. Our findings reveal that, in the period following adoption, there was a significant average reduction of approximately 19.56 kg per capita in residual household waste among intermunicipal entities that implemented separate biowaste collection. However, this initial reduction is not sustained over time. The heterogeneity analysis shows that low-density areas and intermunicipal entities with limited tourist accommodations experience larger reductions in residual household waste after implementing separate biowaste collection, compared to high-density and high-tourism areas. Furthermore, our results suggest that incentive-based pricing systems significantly contribute to reducing residual household waste. Based on these results, we suggest ways to improve local public waste management policies.
url:9ac5133e0e64c8f5.abstract_zh: 本研究评估了法国地方政府实施生物垃圾单独收集政策的有效性，通过分析该政策对人均剩余生活垃圾收集量的影响。采用交错双重差分法，我们首先考察了生物垃圾分类政策对剩余生活垃圾的动态效应，进而探究该效应在不同经济与社会人口背景以及不同垃圾定价体系下的异质性。研究结果显示，在政策实施后的时期内，实施生物垃圾单独收集的市镇联合体人均剩余生活垃圾量平均显著减少约19.56公斤。然而，这一初始减量效果并未持续。异质性分析表明，与高密度和高旅游地区相比，低密度地区及旅游住宿设施有限的市镇联合体在实施生物垃圾单独收集后，剩余生活垃圾减量幅度更大。此外，研究结果提示，基于激励的定价体系对减少剩余生活垃圾具有显著作用。基于上述发现，我们提出了改进地方公共垃圾管理政策的建议。
url:9ac5133e0e64c8f5.title: Assessing the Impact of Separate Biowaste Collection on Residual Household Waste an Analysis at the French Intermunicipal Level
url:9ac5133e0e64c8f5.title_zh: 评估单独生物垃圾收集对剩余家庭垃圾的影响：法国市际层面的分析

url:9acf57c6dfc2aa73.abstract: The announcements by President Trump in April 2025, of unilateral hikes of 10-50 percentage points on US import tariffs on all countries’ goods, are under threat of coming into force on 8 July 2025. This article estimates their likely effects on trade in alcoholic beverages, using a global model of national beverage markets. Various scenarios are compared. They suggest that if the tariff hike was restricted to just 20% on goods from the European Union, the value of global trade in each of the three beverages would shrink by one-tenth. But the US tariff hikes are to apply to all countries’ goods, which is estimated to shrink global exports by 13% for wine, 22% for spirits and 33% for beer. In that broader scenario, most countries’ wine exports would shrink, but exports of beer and spirits would expand for some countries thanks to the trade divergence generated by the varying tariff hikes. If the increasing uncertainty associated with these developments led to a cumulated 2% drop in consumer spending, virtually all wine-exporting countries would sell less wine to both the US and the rest of the world. That is, wine trade destruction would outweigh trade diversion.
url:9acf57c6dfc2aa73.abstract_zh: 特朗普总统于2025年4月宣布，将对所有国家的商品单方面提高美国进口关税10至50个百分点，该措施面临于2025年7月8日生效的风险。本文利用一个全球性的国家饮料市场模型，评估了这些措施对酒精饮料贸易可能产生的影响。文章比较了多种情景。研究结果表明，若关税上调仅限于对欧盟商品加征20%，全球三种饮料的贸易总值将缩减十分之一。然而，美国关税上调适用于所有国家的商品，预计这将使全球葡萄酒出口缩减13%，烈酒缩减22%，啤酒缩减33%。在这一更广泛的情景下，大多数国家的葡萄酒出口将缩减，但由于不同关税上调引发的贸易分化，部分国家的啤酒和烈酒出口可能会增长。如果这些动态带来的不确定性增加导致消费者支出累计下降2%，几乎所有葡萄酒出口国对美国和世界其他地区的葡萄酒销量都将减少。也就是说，葡萄酒贸易的破坏效应将超过贸易转移效应。
url:9acf57c6dfc2aa73.title: Impacts of a US-led Tariff War on International Trade in Wine, Beer and Spirits
url:9acf57c6dfc2aa73.title_zh: 美国主导的关税战对葡萄酒、啤酒和烈酒国际贸易的影响

url:9af3d2cca4ddf8b3.abstract: In January 2012, the Federal Reserve began publishing the Summary of Economic Projections (SEP) "dot plot," revealing FOMC participants' projections for the federal funds rate. This paper documents a dual role for SEP projections in the formation of private interest-rate expectations. On one hand, SEP projections contain valuable information, achieving lower forecast errors than consensus surveys, VAR models, and several market-based measures at many horizons. Because the SEP is informative, some reliance on it by private forecasters is natural. On the other hand, because the SEP is updated only quarterly, SEP projections that are useful when released can become stale between updates. If private forecasts continue to place excessive weight on those earlier projections, they may respond too slowly to newly arriving information. Consistent with this prediction, survey forecast errors-and, to a weaker extent, market-based forecast errors-are systematically related to the gap between current expectations and lagged SEP projections, even after controlling for macroeconomic conditions, risk premia, and other predictors of forecast errors. The findings imply that official guidance can simultaneously improve average forecast accuracy while reducing the speed with which new information is incorporated into expectations.
url:9af3d2cca4ddf8b3.abstract_zh: 2012年1月，美联储开始发布《经济预测摘要》（SEP）“点阵图”，披露联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）成员对联邦基金利率的预测。本文揭示了SEP预测在私人利率预期形成中的双重作用。一方面，SEP预测包含有价值的信息，在多个预测期限上，其预测误差低于共识调查、VAR模型及若干市场指标。由于SEP信息含量丰富，私人预测者对其产生一定依赖是自然的。另一方面，由于SEP仅每季度更新一次，发布时有效的预测可能在更新间隔期间变得过时。若私人预测持续过度依赖这些早期预测，则可能对新信息的反应过于迟缓。与这一预测一致的是，调查预测误差（以及程度较弱的基于市场的预测误差）与当前预期和滞后SEP预测之间的缺口存在系统性关联，即使在控制宏观经济状况、风险溢价及其他预测误差预测因子后依然如此。研究结果表明，官方指引能够同时提升平均预测准确性，但会降低新信息融入预期的速度。
url:9af3d2cca4ddf8b3.title: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

url:9b02f9ce44a35e63.abstract: Voluntary adoption of pollution prevention (P2) practices has been used to reduce toxic emissions in the US. Spillovers among facilities owned by the same firm likely play an important role in the diffusion of P2 practices. This article estimates the intrafirm spillover effects of P2 adoption. Using instrumental variables methods applied to facility panel data from the Toxics Release Inventory, we find that a facility’s own adoption of P2 practices increases in response to greater P2 adoption by facilities from the same firm. Intrafirm spillovers are stronger among small firms and firms with higher degree of sibling homophily. JEL Q55Q58
url:9b02f9ce44a35e63.abstract_zh: 美国通过自愿采纳污染预防（P2）实践来减少有毒排放。同一企业旗下设施之间的溢出效应可能在P2实践的扩散中发挥重要作用。本文估计了P2采纳的企业内溢出效应。利用应用于有毒物质排放清单设施面板数据的工具变量方法，我们发现，当同一企业内其他设施采纳P2实践增多时，设施自身采纳P2实践的可能性也随之增加。企业内溢出效应在小企业和兄弟设施同质性较高的企业中更为显著。JEL分类号：Q55，Q58
url:9b02f9ce44a35e63.title: Does Peer Adoption Increase the Diffusion of Pollution Prevention Practices?
url:9b02f9ce44a35e63.title_zh: 同行采纳是否会增加污染预防实践的扩散？

url:9b520ee9e0d5e24a.abstract: The European Union designates 26% of its landmass as protected areas, limiting economic development for biodiversity. We use the staggered introduction of protected areas between 1985 and 2019 to study the selection of protected land and the causal effect of protection on vegetation cover and nightlights. We find no meaningful impacts on either outcome across four decades, countries, protection cohorts, or land characteristics. These null effects are consistent with the political economy of EU land protection: weak incentives to internalize biodiversity gains, green-glow motives, and area-based targets shape local siting and stringency choices. In practice, strict protection is applied where development pressure is low–so that protection has little bite—while in high-pressure regions, protection is typically weak, imposing only limited constraints on economic activity.
url:9b520ee9e0d5e24a.abstract_zh: 欧盟将其26%的陆地面积划定为保护区，从而限制经济发展以保护生物多样性。我们利用1985年至2019年间保护区逐步设立的过程，研究保护区的选址机制以及保护措施对植被覆盖率和夜间灯光数据的因果效应。研究发现，在四十年间、不同国家、不同保护批次或不同土地特征下，保护措施对上述两项指标均未产生显著影响。这种零效应与欧盟土地保护的政治经济学逻辑一致：内部化生物多样性收益的激励不足、"绿色光环"动机以及基于面积的目标设定，共同塑造了地方选址与保护强度的选择。实践中，严格保护措施往往施加于开发压力较低的区域——因此保护效果甚微——而在高开发压力地区，保护措施通常较为薄弱，对经济活动仅构成有限约束。

url:9b952a143299904f.abstract: We examine the role of central bank reserves and public liquidity when secondary markets may freeze. Central bank reserves help intermediaries purchase assets during stress but crowd out investment. Under laissez-faire, intermediaries hold insufficient reserves, overlooking how aggregate liquidity reduces freeze risk. We propose a ``market-backstop principle", akin to Bagehot’s principle for intermediaries. It combines state-contingent buyer-of-last-resort interventions to restore trading with modest liquidity requirements to limit moral hazard. The welfare benefits of restoring market functioning exceed the fiscal costs of interventions. We explore implications for the size and composition of central bank balance sheets.
url:9b952a143299904f.abstract_zh: 我们考察了在二级市场可能冻结时，中央银行储备和公共流动性的作用。中央银行储备有助于中介机构在压力时期购买资产，但会挤出投资。在自由放任政策下，中介机构持有的储备不足，忽视了总体流动性降低冻结风险的作用。我们提出了一项“市场后盾原则”，类似于针对中介机构的巴杰特原则。该原则结合了状态依存的最后买家干预措施以恢复交易，并辅以适度的流动性要求以限制道德风险。恢复市场运作的福利收益超过了干预的财政成本。我们探讨了这对中央银行资产负债表规模和构成的影响。

url:9b9828f82f92f765.abstract: We show that incorporating uninsurable countercyclical income risk into a standard international RBC model can qualitatively and quantitatively account for the quantity puzzles in open-economy macro, namely (i) the Backus-Smith puzzle, (ii) the Backus-Kehoe-Kydland puzzle and (iii) the weak correlation between the trade balance and the exchange rate. We also show that our model can simultaneously account for the Fama puzzle and the evidence that high interest rate countries have stronger currencies---which representative-agents models that rely only on financial or demand shocks cannot jointly account for. Crucially, our model resolves all these puzzles while relying solely on productivity shocks, and thus generates the observed domestic and cross-country macroeconomic comovement.
url:9b9828f82f92f765.abstract_zh: 我们证明，将不可保险的反周期收入风险纳入标准国际实际经济周期模型，能够从定性和定量角度解释开放经济宏观经济学中的数量谜题，即：(i) 巴克斯-史密斯谜题、(ii) 巴克斯-基欧-基德兰德谜题以及(iii) 贸易余额与汇率之间的弱相关性。我们还证明，该模型能够同时解释法玛谜题以及高利率国家拥有更强货币的证据——而仅依赖金融或需求冲击的代表性主体模型无法共同解释这些现象。关键在于，我们的模型仅依靠生产率冲击就解决了所有这些谜题，从而生成了观察到的国内及跨国宏观经济协同波动。

url:9beac3fec4401dd2.abstract: We draw on evidence from the 2026 Iran War to assess the validity of estimates of the short-run price elasticity of oil supply reported in the literature. Our analysis confirms that the one-month and one-quarter U.S. oil supply elasticity is effectively zero, consistent with estimates in Newell and Prest (2019). The data strongly reject the much higher elasticity estimates reported by more recent studies. This finding is consistent with evidence from surveys of oil company executives and with industry data about how long it takes to complete a well and start pumping oil. It is also consistent with theoretical arguments that the short-run oil supply elasticity is zero if adjusting oil production is costly, as is the case in practice. Our results have important implications for the construction and credibility of structural VAR models of the global oil market.
url:9beac3fec4401dd2.abstract_zh: 我们利用2026年伊朗战争的证据，评估文献中报告的石油供给短期价格弹性估计的有效性。我们的分析证实，美国石油供给的一个月和一季度弹性实际上为零，这与纽厄尔和普雷斯特（2019）的估计一致。数据强烈否定了近期研究报告的更高弹性估计。这一发现与对石油公司高管的调查证据以及关于完成一口井并开始抽油所需时间的行业数据相符。同时，它也支持理论论点，即如果调整石油生产是有成本的（实际情况正是如此），那么短期石油供给弹性为零。我们的结果对全球石油市场结构性VAR模型的构建和可信度具有重要意义。

url:9c58ae281ec33e3a.abstract: In this paper, we examine the transplantation of British company law into the Cape Colony in the late nineteenth century. The Cape Colony Companies Act of 1892 was like its British counterpart in that it provided minimal investor protection. This meant that promoters were free to choose the level and types of shareholder safeguards in their company’s articles of association. We analyse the shareholder protection offered in the articles of Cape Colony companies established in the decade after 1892. We find that Cape companies offered higher protection than British ones. They were also much more likely to adopt the gold-standard blueprint articles of association from the Act’s appendix. We find that companies adopting these blueprint articles had more diffuse ownership but lower survival rates, suggesting trade-offs between investor protection and corporate longevity in the Cape Colony.
url:9c58ae281ec33e3a.abstract_zh: 本文考察了19世纪末英国公司法在开普殖民地的移植情况。1892年的开普殖民地《公司法》与其英国对应法案相似，仅提供了最低限度的投资者保护。这意味着发起人可以自由选择其公司章程中股东保障的水平与类型。我们分析了1892年后十年间成立的開普殖民地公司章程中所提供的股东保护。研究发现，开普公司提供的保护水平高于英国公司，且它们更可能采纳该法案附录中的黄金标准蓝本公司章程。我们发现，采用这些蓝本章程的公司股权更为分散，但存活率较低，这表明在开普殖民地，投资者保护与公司长期存续之间存在权衡取舍。

url:9c83758ae663ba3e.abstract: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) for HIV/AIDS has expanded rapidly across low-income countries since 2000, generating large gains in life expectancy. Exploiting spatial and temporal variation in ART availability, this paper examines the health and economic consequences of ART introduction across a comprehensive set of outcomes in rural Malawi, a low-income setting with high HIV prevalence. We find that ART substantially reduces prime-age mortality. Although these health gains raise individual prime-age labor supply, total household labor supply and household earnings are unchanged. We show that this divergence reflects the outward migration of prime-age household members, particularly men. Consistent with this mechanism, households receive sizable increases in remittances. Our findings identify migration as an important, but previously overlooked channel through which health shapes household economic outcomes.
url:9c83758ae663ba3e.abstract_zh: 自2000年以来，低收入国家针对HIV/AIDS的抗逆转录病毒疗法（ART）迅速普及，显著提升了预期寿命。本文利用马拉维农村地区（一个HIV感染率高、收入水平低的地区）ART可及性的时空差异，系统考察了该疗法引入对一系列健康与经济结果的影响。研究发现，ART显著降低了壮年人口死亡率。尽管这一健康改善提高了个人壮年劳动力供给，但家庭总劳动力供给与家庭收入并未发生变化。研究表明，这种分化源于壮年家庭成员（尤其是男性）的外迁。与这一机制相符的是，家庭收到的汇款显著增加。我们的发现揭示了迁移作为健康影响家庭经济结果的重要渠道，而这一渠道此前未被充分关注。

url:9c90d92151c54035.abstract: This paper presents a model of how organizations develop complex products. Decentralizing the process into autonomous units increases the potential value of production but raises the risk of miscoordination. The organization coordinates the process through costly and imperfectly reliable coordination channels. It optimally creates redundancy in these channels, thereby determining the robustness of the process to miscoordination. The incentive to invest in robustness strengthens as long as returns to decentralization are increasing. Hence, organizations either centralize processes or decentralize them substantially to exploit increasing returns to decentralization. Small reductions in coordination costs can trigger substantial decentralization and, paradoxically, undermine process reliability. Larger reductions in coordination costs also enhance reliability.
url:9c90d92151c54035.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于组织如何开发复杂产品的模型。将流程分散至自主单元，虽能提升生产的潜在价值，却增加了协调失误的风险。组织通过成本高昂且可靠性有限的协调渠道来统筹流程，并最优地在这些渠道中构建冗余，从而决定流程对协调失误的稳健性。只要分散化的回报递增，投资于稳健性的激励便会增强。因此，组织要么集中流程，要么大幅分散以充分利用分散化的递增回报。协调成本的小幅降低可能引发大幅分散化，并矛盾地削弱流程可靠性；而协调成本的大幅降低则同时增强可靠性。

url:9ceb69fd64e59ebc.abstract: We investigate how fertility relates to work from home (WFH) in the post-pandemic era, drawing on original data from our Global Survey of Working Arrangements and U.S. Survey of Working Arrangements and Attitudes. Realized fertility from 2023 to 2025 and future planned fertility are higher among adults who WFH at least one day a week and, for couples, higher yet when both partners do so. Estimated lifetime fertility is greater by 0.32 children per woman when both partners WFH one or more days per week as compared to the case where neither does. The implications for national fertility rates differ across countries due mainly to large differences in WFH rates. In a complementary analysis using other U.S. data before and after the pandemic, one-year fertility rates rise with WFH opportunities in one’s own occupation and, for couples, in the partner’s occupation.
url:9ceb69fd64e59ebc.abstract_zh: 本文利用全球工作安排调查和美国工作安排与态度调查的原始数据，探究后疫情时代生育率与居家办公（WFH）之间的关系。每周至少居家办公一天的成年人，其2023至2025年已实现的生育率及未来计划生育率均更高；对于夫妻而言，当双方均居家办公时，生育率提升更为显著。相较于双方均不居家办公的情况，若夫妻双方每周居家办公一天或以上，其预估终身生育率每名女性将增加0.32个孩子。由于各国居家办公率存在显著差异，该效应对国家生育率的影响亦有所不同。在利用疫情前后其他美国数据进行的补充分析中，个人所在职业的居家办公机会增加时，其一年的生育率随之上升；对于夫妻而言，配偶职业的居家办公机会增加同样会提升生育率。
url:9ceb69fd64e59ebc.title: Work from Home and Fertility

url:9ced59894349bc07.abstract: We develop a nonlinear model in which trend inflation and inflation tail risks emerge endogenously in equilibrium from the interaction between the primary deficit and the risk of supply disruptions. The key friction is limited fiscal responsibility: the government stabilizes debt in the long run but, unwilling to let debt accumulate too quickly, pressures the central bank to restrain interest-rate increases rather than adjust its own budget. The fiscal limit binds asymmetrically across shocks, with inflationary supply shocks especially likely to push monetary policy against the constraint. As supply-shock volatility rises and fiscal space narrows, the constraint binds more often. Anticipating this, agents raise their inflation expectations, causing trend inflation and upside inflation tail risks to rise even before the constraint binds. Movements in supply-shock volatility and fiscal space together account for much of the ratcheting up and down of U.S. trend inflation between 1965 and 1990. Interpreted through the model, the post-pandemic rise in long-run inflation expectations reflects a higher probability of fiscally constrained monetary policy.
url:9ced59894349bc07.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个非线性模型，其中趋势通胀与通胀尾部风险通过基本赤字与供给中断风险的相互作用在均衡中内生形成。核心摩擦在于有限财政责任：政府虽在长期内稳定债务，但因不愿让债务过快累积，转而施压央行限制利率上调而非调整自身预算。财政约束对不同冲击呈现非对称约束效应——通胀性供给冲击尤其容易迫使货币政策触碰该约束。随着供给冲击波动率上升与财政空间收窄，约束触发频率显著增加。预期到这一机制，经济主体提前上调通胀预期，导致趋势通胀与上行通胀尾部风险在约束实际生效前已然攀升。1965年至1990年间，供给冲击波动率与财政空间的协同变动，解释了美国趋势通胀大部分阶梯式升降现象。通过模型解读，后疫情时期长期通胀预期的上升，反映了财政约束型货币政策发生概率的提高。

url:9cf7c06221f1acc3.abstract: Secondary stakeholders increasingly seek to discipline firms by attacking morally contested corporate actions. In this paper, we focus on a specific and consequential outcome of their attacks: shaping financial analysts’ recommendations. Drawing on research on moral evaluations and political ideology, we theorize that secondary stakeholder attacks increase analysts’ likelihood of issuing ‘sell’ recommendations, but that this effect is stronger among liberal analysts compared to their conservative peers. We further argue that this ideological divergence is amplified when analysts have greater reputational discretion to issue recommendations based on moral values, and when attacks concern violations that are less intrinsic to the firm’s core business and therefore more unexpected. We test these arguments using a novel dataset combining hand-collected information on analysts’ political ideology with data on secondary stakeholder attacks targeting publicly traded defense firms in the U.S. from 1998 to 2017. Our results support the theoretical predictions and further show that liberal analysts’ stronger responses to SSAs do not translate into superior returns. These findings also help explain the heterogeneous effectiveness of SSAs in capital markets.
url:9cf7c06221f1acc3.abstract_zh: 次要利益相关者日益试图通过攻击企业道德上有争议的行为来约束企业。本文聚焦于其攻击的一个具体且重要的后果：影响金融分析师的推荐意见。基于道德评价与政治意识形态的研究，我们提出理论假设：次要利益相关者的攻击会增加分析师发布“卖出”推荐的可能性，但这一效应在自由派分析师中强于保守派分析师。我们进一步论证，当分析师拥有更大的声誉裁量权以基于道德价值观提出推荐时，以及当攻击涉及与企业核心业务关联较小、因而更出乎意料的违规行为时，这种意识形态分歧会加剧。我们利用一个新颖的数据集检验这些论点，该数据集结合了手工收集的分析师政治意识形态信息以及1998年至2017年间针对美国上市国防企业的次要利益相关者攻击数据。结果支持理论预测，并进一步表明，自由派分析师对次要利益相关者攻击的更强反应并未转化为超额回报。这些发现也有助于解释次要利益相关者攻击在资本市场中效果的异质性。
url:9cf7c06221f1acc3.title: When Do Secondary Stakeholder Attacks Matter to Financial Analysts? The Role of Analysts’ Political Ideology
url:9cf7c06221f1acc3.title_zh: 次级利益相关者攻击何时影响财务分析师？分析师政治意识形态的作用

url:9d0402494c0b9846.abstract: We develop a dynamic multi-country trade model with trade-related technology diffusion and endogenous R&D to quantify the impacts of trade policies and trade wars on innovation, technology rivalry, and welfare. We estimate the model using data on trade and patent citations and validate it in the context of U.S. export controls on China. Counterfactual analysis yields three main results. First, U.S. export controls on China reduce technological progress in both countries: China experiences a sharp contraction in knowledge inflows, while the U.S. faces a decline in R&D. Second, trade-driven diffusion and endogenous innovation substantially amplify the technological and welfare gains in the U.S. and losses in other major economies from the 2025 Liberation Day tariffs. Third, U.S. optimal tariffs on China, under varying geopolitical concerns, reflect a trade-off between curbing technology diffusion to China and sustaining U.S. innovation.
url:9d0402494c0b9846.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含贸易驱动技术扩散与内生研发的动态多国贸易模型，用以量化贸易政策及贸易战对创新、技术竞争和福利的影响。基于贸易与专利引用数据对模型进行估计，并以美国对华出口管制为背景验证模型有效性。反事实分析得出三项主要结论：第一，美国对华出口管制将抑制两国技术进步——中国面临知识流入急剧收缩，而美国则遭遇研发活动衰退；第二，贸易驱动的技术扩散与内生创新机制显著放大了2025年解放日关税对美国的技术与福利增益，同时加剧其他主要经济体的损失；第三，在不同地缘政治关切下，美国对华最优关税体现了遏制技术向中国扩散与维持美国创新活力之间的权衡。

url:9d0c5270800a97ed.abstract: We model negotiations over patent royalties in the shadow of litigation through a Nash-in-Nash approach, where outside options, triggered in case of disagreement, are derived from a subsequent game of litigation. The outcome of litigation depends both on "hard determinants", such as relative patent strength, and on "soft determinants", such as parties' efficacy in litigation or their (known) preparedness to disrupt negotiations in favor of litigation. Amongst other things, this has implications for the interpretation of observed royalties in empirical analysis.
url:9d0c5270800a97ed.abstract_zh: 我们采用纳什-纳什方法，在诉讼阴影下对专利许可费谈判进行建模，其中，若谈判破裂，外部选项源自后续的诉讼博弈。诉讼结果既受“硬性决定因素”影响，如相对专利强度，也受“软性决定因素”影响，如双方在诉讼中的效力或其（已知的）倾向于破坏谈判以诉诸诉讼的准备程度。这尤其对实证分析中观察到的许可费解释具有启示意义。
url:9d0c5270800a97ed.title: Bargaining over Royalties in the Shadow of Litigation
url:9d0c5270800a97ed.title_zh: 诉讼阴影下的专利费谈判

url:9d0f8b3f1dd6d0af.title_zh: 土地交易背后的认知：多元森林价值取向如何影响中国农村的意愿、价格预期与林地流转行为

url:9d150dca9fbc8521.abstract: Financial liberalization is often seen as a way to deepen credit markets and stimulate economic growth, but it may also fuel credit booms that end in crisis. We construct a new cross-country database of banking regulation policies covering 21 regulatory indicators for 18 advanced economies since World War II. We distinguish liberalizations that directly relax constraints on credit supply from broader financial reforms. Liberalizations that directly affect credit supply lead to substantial expansions in private credit. Credit expansion is concentrated in non-tradable sectors and is not accompanied by higher interest rates or credit spreads in the short run, consistent with an outward shift in credit supply. Real GDP rises over the following 2 to 4 years, but the gains are temporary. On average, GDP returns to trend in the medium run, and there is an increase in the risk of financial crisis and worse downside growth outcomes. Only liberalizations that directly expand credit supply generate these boom-bust dynamics. Based on these estimates, financial liberalization is welfare-improving for coefficients of relative risk aversion below 7.2, a moderately high value.
url:9d150dca9fbc8521.abstract_zh: 金融自由化常被视为深化信贷市场、刺激经济增长的途径，但也可能助长最终引发危机的信贷繁荣。我们构建了一个涵盖二战后18个发达经济体21项监管指标的新跨国银行业监管政策数据库。我们将直接放松信贷供给约束的自由化措施与更广泛的金融改革加以区分。直接影响信贷供给的自由化措施会导致私人信贷大幅扩张。信贷扩张集中于非贸易部门，且短期内并未伴随利率或信用利差的上升，这与信贷供给曲线外移的特征一致。实际GDP在随后2至4年内有所增长，但这种收益是暂时的。平均而言，中期内GDP回归趋势水平，同时金融危机风险上升，经济增长下行风险加剧。只有直接扩大信贷供给的自由化措施才会产生这种繁荣-萧条动态。基于这些估算，当相对风险厌恶系数低于7.2（一个中等偏高的数值）时，金融自由化能够提升社会福利。
url:9d150dca9fbc8521.title: Financial Liberalizations, Booms, and Crashes
url:9d150dca9fbc8521.title_zh: 金融自由化、繁荣与崩溃

url:9d15ff68be13a25a.abstract: This paper examines how climate change and natural resource dynamics contribute to conflict, with a focus on the implications of the green transition. It reviews empirical evidence showing that extreme weather events - such as droughts, floods, and heatwaves - are linked to increased violence, particularly through economic disruptions, reduced agricultural productivity, and displacement. The analysis also explores the mechanisms through which climate shocks influence conflict, including opportunity costs, resource competition, and behavioral responses to environmental stress. The discussion then turns to the role of natural resource exploitation, especially in the context of rising demand for minerals essential to low-carbon technologies. The paper highlights how resource price and availability shocks can trigger conflict, often depending on the type of resource, extraction method, and local governance. It also addresses the overlap between climate- and resource-driven conflict risks, emphasizing that their interaction may amplify instability. Throughout, the paper identifies open research questions related to prediction, the effects of long-run environmental changes, and the design of policy responses. These include insurance schemes, climate adaptation strategies, infrastructure investment, and regulatory frameworks for resource governance. The findings point to the need for research that integrates climate and conflict dynamics, with the goal of informing policies that can mitigate the risks associated with environmental change and resource pressures.
url:9d15ff68be13a25a.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了气候变化与自然资源动态如何促成冲突，特别关注绿色转型的影响。文章回顾了实证证据，表明极端天气事件——如干旱、洪水和热浪——与暴力事件增加相关联，尤其是通过经济中断、农业生产力下降和人口迁移等途径。分析还探讨了气候冲击影响冲突的机制，包括机会成本、资源竞争以及对环境压力的行为反应。随后，讨论转向自然资源开采的作用，特别是在低碳技术所需关键矿产需求上升的背景下。文章强调了资源价格和供应冲击如何可能触发冲突，这往往取决于资源类型、开采方式及地方治理状况。同时，文章也指出了气候驱动与资源驱动的冲突风险之间的重叠，强调它们的相互作用可能加剧不稳定。全文识别了与预测、长期环境变化影响及政策应对设计相关的未决研究问题，这些问题包括保险机制、气候适应策略、基础设施投资以及资源治理的监管框架。研究结果表明，需要整合气候与冲突动态的研究，旨在为减轻环境变化和资源压力相关风险的政策提供信息。
url:9d15ff68be13a25a.title: Climate Change, Natural Resources, and Conflict
url:9d15ff68be13a25a.title_zh: 气候变化、自然资源与冲突

url:9d6b6ac79f8af4e5.abstract: Emigration of labour and its subsequent repatriation can best be understood as phases of an intertemporal exchange process, of a relatively abundant factor, namely unskilled labour, for a relatively scarce factor, namely capital. This capital flow initially consists of financial capital, that is of emigrant remittances, and of human capital at the time of repatriation. This analytical hypothesis is empirically tested on Greek data and seems to be validated by the empirical evidence presented. The formulation of the emigration-repatriation cycle as an intertemporal phenomenon highlights the need for forward-looking policies. The analysis suggests that planning for the period of net immigration and of reduced remittances should be an integral component of policy in the sending country.
url:9d6b6ac79f8af4e5.abstract_zh: 劳动力外迁及其后续遣返，可被理解为一种跨期交换过程的不同阶段——即以相对充裕要素（即非熟练劳动力）换取相对稀缺要素（即资本）。这一资本流动最初表现为金融资本（即移民汇款），并在遣返阶段体现为人力资本。该分析假设基于希腊数据进行了实证检验，且似乎得到了所呈现经验证据的验证。将移民-遣返周期界定为跨期现象，凸显了前瞻性政策的必要性。分析表明，对净移民流入及汇款减少时期的规划，应成为输出国政策不可或缺的组成部分。

url:9d8946be31b5bdba.abstract: We use Gallup World Poll data from over 150 countries from 2009-2019 at both the individual and country levels to revisit the relationship between income and subjective wellbeing. Our inspiration is the paradox first proposed by Easterlin (1974), where higher incomes are associated with greater happiness in cross-sections, yet rising country GDP per head does not necessarily increase its average wellbeing. In our analysis subjective wellbeing (or happiness) is measured by the Cantril ladder on a 0-10 scale. Across individuals, other things equal, one unit of log income raises subjective wellbeing by 0.4 points. In other words, doubling income raises wellbeing by 0.3 points out of 10. Across countries, a crude regression of wellbeing on log per capita income gives a higher coefficient of 0.6. But, once social variables like health and social support are introduced, the picture changes. In rich countries, income no longer has a significant independent effect, either in country cross-sections or in time series. For low-income countries the result is also clear cut - income raises happiness in both cross-section and time series, whether the social variables are controlled for or not. For middle-income countries the result is mixed.
url:9d8946be31b5bdba.abstract_zh: 我们利用2009-2019年间覆盖150多个国家的盖洛普世界民意调查数据，从个体和国家两个层面重新审视收入与主观幸福感之间的关系。研究灵感源于伊斯特林（1974）首次提出的悖论：在横截面数据中，较高收入与更高幸福感相关，但国家人均GDP增长未必能提升其平均福祉水平。本研究中，主观幸福感（或幸福感）采用坎特里尔阶梯量表（0-10分制）进行测量。在个体层面，其他条件不变时，对数收入每增加一个单位，主观幸福感提升0.4分。换言之，收入翻倍可使幸福感在10分制中提升0.3分。在国家层面，对幸福感与人均对数收入进行简单回归，得到0.6的更高系数。然而，一旦引入健康与社会支持等社会变量，情况便发生变化。在富裕国家，无论是国家横截面数据还是时间序列数据，收入均不再具有显著的独立效应。对于低收入国家，结果同样明确——无论是否控制社会变量，收入在横截面和时间序列中均能提升幸福感。而中等收入国家的结果则呈现混合特征。

url:9d92d1f64508b2a4.title: Left-Digit Bias, Quality Choice, and Channel Coordination
url:9d92d1f64508b2a4.title_zh: 左侧数字偏差、质量选择与渠道协调

url:9d9982226ccde5f6.abstract: We develop an integrated framework to characterize multi-objective policymaking and apply it to the case of critical materials. The model considers that national policy decisions will be influenced by domestic agencies with different priorities and goals and be informed by actions taken by other countries pertaining to critical materials. This creates a potential basis for a group of countries to form a critical materials club to reduce the probability of supply shocks and/or their consequences. We show that in an environment with multiple policy-active governments, criticality assessments embedded in a multi-objective government with domain-specific bureaucracies and multiple instruments can rationalize divergent policy choices under similar risk environments, provide conditions under which international coordination is more or less likely and apply the model to consider the design and political economy of plurilateral arrangements for critical materials.
url:9d9982226ccde5f6.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个综合框架来描述多目标政策制定过程，并将其应用于关键材料案例。该模型认为，国家政策决策将受到具有不同优先事项和目标的国内机构的影响，并参考其他国家在关键材料方面采取的行动。这为一批国家组建关键材料俱乐部、降低供应冲击概率及其后果提供了潜在基础。研究表明，在存在多个政策活跃政府的背景下，嵌入多目标政府（包含特定领域官僚机构与多种政策工具）的关键性评估机制，能够解释相似风险环境下政策选择的差异性，揭示国际协调更易或更难实现的条件，并运用该模型探讨关键材料诸边安排的设计与政治经济学逻辑。
url:9d9982226ccde5f6.title: A Simple Model of Government Decision-Making and Plurilateral Cooperation on Critical Materials
url:9d9982226ccde5f6.title_zh: 政府决策与关键材料多边合作的简单模型

url:9daa844ab2d3e81b.abstract: The past half century has witnessed widespread gender convergence across many labor market outcomes, including hours worked, earnings, and occupations. This paper shows that, over the same period, men's and women's sectors of employment actually diverged. It structurally decomposes the rise in sectoral segregation into three underlying drivers representing changes in preferences, discrimination, and technologies. Changes in the employment preferences of married women are the most important factor, explaining 59% of the rise in segregation. These changes in preferences also reduce the gender earnings gap because the non-wage amenities women value are increasingly prevalent in higher paying sectors.
url:9daa844ab2d3e81b.abstract_zh: 过去半个世纪见证了劳动力市场诸多结果中性别趋同的广泛现象，包括工作时间、收入和职业。本文表明，在同一时期，男性和女性的就业部门实际上出现了分化。本文从结构上分解了部门隔离上升的三个潜在驱动因素，分别代表偏好、歧视和技术的变化。已婚女性就业偏好的变化是最重要的因素，解释了隔离上升的59%。这些偏好变化也缩小了性别收入差距，因为女性所重视的非工资福利在高薪部门中日益普遍。
url:9daa844ab2d3e81b.title: Gender Divergence in Sectors of Work

url:9dd2099939b4d474.abstract: This paper examines the performance of alternative models for predicting turning points in the UK growth cycle. The models are based upon an interpretation of movements in the CSO's composite longer and shorter leading indicators. The difference between the models lies in the choice of method adopted for separating and classifying observations into a pattern corresponding to an upturn and downturn regime, together with the decision rule applied in recognizing when a regime shift has occurred. The models involved include a simple mechanical rule based upon an interpretation of consecutive movements in the leading indicator and two probabilistic methods, namely a standard Bayesian model and the sequential probability model developed by Neftci (1982). The results of the exercise suggest that usefulness of the shorter leading index is extremely limited; prediction based upon this series is typically outperformed by naive, non-indicator methods. The information content of the longer leading index appears somewhat greater. The signal extracted by the sequential probability model is particularly well-defined in this respect giving rise to a lead time of between four and six months at peaks and six months for troughs. At horizons beyond six months, however, the sequential probability model is outperformed by a more conventional Bayesian method.
url:9dd2099939b4d474.abstract_zh: 本文考察了预测英国增长周期转折点的替代模型的表现。这些模型基于对英国中央统计局（CSO）综合长期与短期先行指标变动的解释。模型之间的差异在于：对观测值进行分离和分类以对应上升与下降阶段模式所采用的方法选择，以及识别阶段转换发生时所应用的决策规则。涉及的模型包括：基于先行指标连续变动解释的简单机械规则，以及两种概率方法——标准贝叶斯模型和Neftci（1982）开发的序贯概率模型。实证结果表明，短期先行指数的实用性极为有限；基于该序列的预测通常被朴素的无指标方法所超越。长期先行指数的信息含量似乎更大。序贯概率模型提取的信号在这方面尤为清晰，在峰值处可提供四至六个月的领先时间，在谷底处则为六个月。然而，在超过六个月的预测区间上，序贯概率模型的表现逊于更传统的贝叶斯方法。
url:9dd2099939b4d474.title: DP833 Turning Point Prediction for the UK using CSO Leading Indicators
url:9dd2099939b4d474.title_zh: 基于CSO先行指标的英国经济转折点预测

url:9ddb10fb50aeaea7.abstract: We examine the future of remote work by drawing parallels between two contexts: The move from home to factory-based production during the Industrial Revolution and the shift to work from home today. In both cases, new technology induced new working arrangements, and this shift was associated with a similar trade-off in the past as it is today: productivity advantages and cost savings versus organizational barriers such as coordinating workers under the new workplace arrangement. Using contemporary data, we show that the COVID-19 pandemic moved even sectors with high organizational barriers to working from home. Without further technological or organizational innovations, this shift is likely to be reversed, and remote work may not be here to stay just yet.
url:9ddb10fb50aeaea7.abstract_zh: 我们通过类比两种情境来审视远程工作的未来：工业革命期间从家庭生产向工厂生产的转变，以及当今向居家办公的迁移。在这两种情形中，新技术催生了新的工作安排，而这种转变在过去与今天都伴随着相似的权衡：生产力优势与成本节约，相对于新工作场所安排下协调工人等组织性障碍。利用当代数据，我们表明，COVID-19疫情甚至将组织性障碍较高的行业也推向了居家办公。若无进一步的技术或组织创新，这一转变可能会逆转，远程工作或许尚未成为持久趋势。
url:9ddb10fb50aeaea7.title: Away from Home and Back: Coordinating (Remote) Workers in 1800 and 2020
url:9ddb10fb50aeaea7.title_zh: 离家与归家：1800年与2020年（远程）工人的协调

url:9de0f7c3cd258477.abstract: We develop a theoretical model of religious conversion in which potential adherents face changing payoff structures, spiritual or instrumental, triggered by the arrival of a new religious movement, the conversion of monarchs, or other shocks that alter the relative returns to conversion. Coupled with non-linear private returns in the share of co-religionists and intergenerational transmission of religious beliefs, our model yields multiple, stable steady-states in the community’s religious composition. We use this model to rationalize the spread of Islam in West Africa post-1500. The Atlantic slave trade altered payoffs in favor of Islam because Muslim rulers offered a de facto protection from enslavement, but only to their co-religionists. This created strong incentives for conversion among non-Muslims in regions exposed to slave raiding. Using newly compiled historical data alongside contemporary survey-based measures of Islamic presence, we show that communities under Islamic rule during 1500-1900 and exposed to Atlantic slavery exhibit persistently higher Muslim presence both after the end of slavery and today.
url:9de0f7c3cd258477.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于宗教皈依的理论模型，其中潜在信徒面临由新宗教运动兴起、君主皈依或其他改变皈依相对回报的冲击所引发的不断变化的回报结构，这些回报既包括精神层面的，也包括工具性的。结合同信仰者比例中的非线性私人回报以及宗教信仰的代际传递，我们的模型在社区宗教构成中产生了多个稳定的稳态。我们利用此模型来解释1500年后伊斯兰教在西非的传播。大西洋奴隶贸易改变了回报结构，使之有利于伊斯兰教，因为穆斯林统治者对其同信仰者提供了事实上的免于奴役保护，但仅限于此。这为遭受奴隶掠夺地区的非穆斯林群体创造了强烈的皈依激励。利用新编纂的历史数据以及当代基于调查的伊斯兰存在度量，我们表明，在1500-1900年间处于伊斯兰统治下并暴露于大西洋奴隶制的社区，在奴隶制结束后及至今，均持续展现出更高的穆斯林人口比例。

url:9de60aee52a0790a.abstract: This paper estimates the economic effects of communal riots in India using a new district-year panel for 1994-2013 that combines extended riot data with nightlights, manufacturing outcomes, infrastructure, and district-level credit. To address endogeneity, we use quasi-random variation generated when major Hindu festivals fall on a Friday (Fridays draw large Muslim congregations for weekly prayers) and construct a spatially weighted instrument for local riot risk. Instrumental variable estimates show that higher riot exposure leads to sizable and persistent economic losses. A one-unit increase in distance-weighted exposure reduces nightlights by about 0.105 log points, implying a GDP decline of roughly 0.45%. We trace several channels, including contractions in firm output and employment, fewer bank branches, less agricultural credit, and a thinner market infrastructure. Using the timing of household surveys relative to riots, we also find that trust in state institutions declines. Together, the results quantify the economic costs of communal riots and identify the mechanisms through which social conflict depresses local economic activity.
url:9de60aee52a0790a.abstract_zh: 本文利用1994-2013年印度地区-年份面板数据，将扩展的骚乱数据与夜间灯光、制造业产出、基础设施及地区信贷相结合，估算了社区骚乱的经济影响。为解决内生性问题，我们利用印度主要印度教节日恰逢周五（周五吸引大量穆斯林聚集进行每周祈祷）时产生的准随机变异，构建了衡量当地骚乱风险的空间加权工具变量。工具变量估计表明，更高的骚乱暴露度会导致显著且持续的经济损失。距离加权暴露度每增加一个单位，夜间灯光指数下降约0.105个对数点，相当于GDP下降约0.45%。我们追溯了若干传导渠道，包括企业产出与就业收缩、银行网点减少、农业信贷萎缩以及市场基础设施薄弱。通过利用家庭调查相对于骚乱发生的时间节点，我们还发现对国家机构的信任度下降。综合来看，这些结果量化了社区骚乱的经济成本，并揭示了社会冲突抑制地方经济活动的机制。

url:9e5574e0f063b4fa.abstract: Word embeddings are vectors of real numbers associated with words, designed to capture semantic and syntactic similarity between the words in a corpus of text. We estimate the word embeddings of the European Central Bank's introductory statements at monetary policy press conferences by using a simple natural language processing model (Word2Vec), only based on the information and model parameters available as of each press conference. We show that a measure based on such embeddings contributes to improve core inflation forecasts multiple quarters ahead. Other common textual analysis techniques, such as dictionary-based metrics or sentiment metrics do not obtain the same results. The information contained in the embeddings remains valuable for out-of-sample forecasting even after controlling for the central bank inflation forecasts, which are an important input for the introductory statements.
url:9e5574e0f063b4fa.abstract_zh: 词嵌入是与词语相关联的实数向量，旨在捕捉文本语料库中词语之间的语义和句法相似性。我们仅基于每次新闻发布会当时可用的信息和模型参数，通过使用简单的自然语言处理模型（Word2Vec），对欧洲央行货币政策新闻发布会开场陈述进行词嵌入估计。研究表明，基于此类词嵌入的指标有助于改善未来多个季度的核心通胀预测。其他常见的文本分析技术，如基于词典的指标或情绪指标，并未获得相同结果。即使在控制了央行通胀预测（这是开场陈述的重要输入信息）之后，词嵌入中包含的信息对于样本外预测仍具有重要价值。

url:9e6c776e20b10eef.abstract: this paper, we address these issues by modeling the joint evolution of institutions and culture. In doing so, we place the various hypotheses of economic divergence into one, unifying framework. We highlight the role that cultural transmission plays in reinforcing institutional evolution toward either theocratic or secular states. We extend the model to shed light on political decentralization and technological change in the two regions.
url:9e6c776e20b10eef.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建制度与文化共同演化的模型来探讨这些问题。我们将关于经济分化的各种假说纳入一个统一的框架之中。我们强调了文化传播在强化制度演化方向（无论是走向神权国家还是世俗国家）中所起的作用。我们进一步扩展模型，以揭示这两个地区政治分权与技术变革的深层机制。
url:9e6c776e20b10eef.title: Culture, Institutions & the Long Divergence

url:9e89afe38d1e40a8.abstract: We discuss the impacts of the Russian invasion on Ukrainian science. Using newly collected data, we show that the war has already had significant effects on science in Ukraine: research papers produced by Ukrainian scientists declined by about 10%, approximately 5% of the most prolific scientists are publishing with a foreign affiliation, 22% of top universities have faced destruction of physical capital, and international collaborations with Russian scientists have declined by more than 40%. Drawing upon the economics of science and innovation literature, we highlight three primary channels through which wars impact science: 1) the loss of human capital, 2) the destruction of physical capital, and 3) reductions in international scientific cooperation. The evidence from the literature on the long-run effects of losing human or physical capital indicates that shocks to physical capital can be remedied more easily than shocks to human capital. Our new data also suggests that human capital shocks are the main drivers of the reduction in Ukrainian research output that has occurred since the beginning of the war. Hence, reconstruction efforts should be focused on supporting scientists to continue in the research sector and to return to Ukraine after the war has ended.
url:9e89afe38d1e40a8.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了俄罗斯入侵对乌克兰科学的影响。利用新收集的数据，我们表明战争已对乌克兰科学产生了显著影响：乌克兰科学家产出的研究论文数量下降了约10%，约5%的高产科学家正以国外附属机构名义发表论文，22%的顶尖大学面临物理资本损毁，与俄罗斯科学家的国际合作减少了超过40%。借鉴科学与创新经济学文献，我们强调了战争影响科学的三个主要渠道：1）人力资本损失，2）物理资本破坏，以及3）国际科学合作减少。关于人力或物理资本损失的长期影响的文献证据表明，物理资本冲击比人力资本冲击更容易修复。我们的新数据也表明，自战争开始以来，人力资本冲击是乌克兰研究产出减少的主要驱动因素。因此，重建工作应侧重于支持科学家继续留在研究领域，并在战争结束后返回乌克兰。
url:9e89afe38d1e40a8.title: War and Science in Ukraine

url:9ed01ca3b9de4c0a.abstract: Much of the observed cross-country variation in fertility aligns with the predictions of classic theories of the fertility transition: countries with higher levels of human capital, higher GDP per capita, or lower mortality rates tend to exhibit lower fertility. However, when examining changes within countries over the past 60 years, larger fertility declines are only weakly associated with greater improvements in human capital, per capita GDP, or survival rates. To understand why, we focus on the role of family institutions, particularly marriage and inheritance customs. We argue that, together with the diffusion of cultural norms, they help explain variations in the timing, speed and magnitude of the fertility decline. We propose a stylized model integrating economic, health, institutional and cultural factors to study how these factors interact to shape fertility transition paths. We find that family institutions can mediate the effect of economic development by constraining fertility responses.
url:9ed01ca3b9de4c0a.abstract_zh: 观察到的跨国生育率差异，在很大程度上与经典生育转型理论的预测相符：人力资本水平较高、人均GDP较高或死亡率较低的国家，往往表现出较低的生育率。然而，在审视过去60年各国国内变化时，较大的生育率下降与人力资本、人均GDP或生存率的更大改善之间仅存在微弱关联。为理解这一现象，我们聚焦于家庭制度的作用，特别是婚姻和继承习俗。我们认为，这些制度与文化规范的传播相结合，有助于解释生育率下降在时间、速度和幅度上的差异。我们提出一个整合经济、健康、制度和文化的简化模型，以研究这些因素如何相互作用塑造生育转型路径。我们发现，家庭制度可能通过约束生育反应来调节经济发展的影响。
url:9ed01ca3b9de4c0a.title: Family Institutions and the Global Fertility Transition
url:9ed01ca3b9de4c0a.title_zh: 家庭制度与全球生育率转型

url:9f2156ed0563e5e8.abstract: We build a New Keynesian model of the business cycle with sticky prices and real wage rigidities motivated by efficiency wages of the gift exchange variety. Compared to a standard sticky price model, our Fair Wage model provides an explanation for structural employment and generates more plausible labour market dynamics, notably accounting for the low correlation between wages and employment. The fair wage induced real wage rigidity also significantly reduces the elasticity of marginal cost with respect to output. The smoother dynamics of real marginal cost increase both amplification and persistence of output responses to monetary shocks, thus remedying the well-known lack of internal propagation of standard sticky price models. We take these improvements as a strong endorsement of the addition of real wage rigidities to nominal price rigidities and conclude that the fair wage extension of this Paper constitutes a promising platform for an enriched New Keynesian synthesis.
url:9f2156ed0563e5e8.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含粘性价格与效率工资（礼物交换型）引发的实际工资刚性的新凯恩斯商业周期模型。相较于标准粘性价格模型，我们的公平工资模型不仅解释了结构性就业问题，还生成了更符合现实的劳动力市场动态，尤其能够解释工资与就业之间的低相关性。由公平工资引发的实际工资刚性显著降低了边际成本对产出的弹性。实际边际成本的平滑动态增强了产出对货币冲击的放大效应与持续性，从而弥补了标准粘性价格模型在内部传导机制上的不足。我们将这些改进视为对名义价格刚性基础上引入实际工资刚性的有力支持，并认为本文提出的公平工资扩展为丰富新凯恩斯综合理论提供了富有前景的研究平台。
url:9f2156ed0563e5e8.title: Fair Wages in a New Keynesian Model of the Business Cycle
url:9f2156ed0563e5e8.title_zh: 新凯恩斯主义商业周期模型中的公平工资

url:9f2da96686133ec1.abstract: Financial frictions have been identified as key factors affecting both short-term economic fluctuations and long-term growth. An important policy question therefore is whether institutional reforms can reduce financial frictions and, if so, which reforms are best? We address this question by empirically investigating the effects of institutions on financial frictions using a canonical investment model. We consider two channels by which frictions affect investment: (i) through financial transaction costs at the individual firm (micro) level; and (ii) through the required rate of return at the country (macro) level. Using a panel of 75,000 firm-years across 48 countries for the period 1990-2007, we examine how, through these frictions, institutions affect investment. We find that improved corporate governance (e.g., less severe informational problems) and enhanced contractual enforcement reduce financial frictions affecting investment, while stronger creditor rights (e.g., lower collateral constraints) are less important.
url:9f2da96686133ec1.abstract_zh: 金融摩擦已被确认为影响短期经济波动与长期增长的关键因素。因此，一个重要的政策问题是：制度性改革能否减少金融摩擦？若能，何种改革最为有效？为回答这一问题，我们采用经典投资模型，实证研究了制度对金融摩擦的影响。我们考虑了摩擦影响投资的两条渠道：（i）通过单个企业（微观）层面的金融交易成本；（ii）通过国家（宏观）层面的必要回报率。基于1990-2007年间48个国家75,000个企业-年度观测值构成的面板数据，我们考察了制度如何通过上述摩擦渠道影响投资。研究发现：改善公司治理（如减轻信息不对称问题）与强化合同执行力度能够降低影响投资的金融摩擦，而增强债权人权利（如降低抵押品约束）的作用相对较弱。
url:9f2da96686133ec1.title: Financial Frictions, Investment, and Institutions

url:9f393cfe16dfa8e0.abstract: We examine the effect of close ties with the NSDAP on the stock price of listed firms in 1932-33. We consider not only links between the National Socialists and executives, as was common in earlier work, but also with supervisory board members ? whose importance is hard to overestimate in the case of German industry. One implication of our work is that, weighted by stock market capitalization in 1932, more than half of listed firms on the Berlin stock exchange had substantive links with the NSDAP. Crucially, stock market investors recognized the value of these links, sending the share prices of connected firms up as the new regime became firmly established. While the market as a whole rose after Hitler?s accession to power, firms with board members known to favour the party (or backing it financially) outperformed the market by 5-10% between January and May 1933. We show that this finding is robust to a range of additional control variables and alternative estimation techniques.
url:9f393cfe16dfa8e0.abstract_zh: 本文考察了1932-1933年间与纳粹党（NSDAP）的密切关系对上市公司股票价格的影响。我们不仅考虑了纳粹党与高管之间的联系（这在早期研究中较为常见），还关注了与监事会成员的联系——在德国工业的背景下，后者的重要性无论如何强调都不为过。我们的研究结论之一是，按1932年股票市值加权计算，柏林证券交易所超过一半的上市公司与纳粹党存在实质性联系。关键在于，股票市场投资者认识到了这些联系的价值，随着新政权稳固建立，关联企业的股价随之上涨。尽管希特勒上台后整个市场整体上扬，但在1933年1月至5月期间，董事会成员已知支持该党（或为其提供资金支持）的企业表现优于市场5-10%。我们证明，这一发现在一系列额外控制变量和替代估计方法下依然稳健。

url:9f92ae725106e127.abstract: Official Russian statistics report a mild recession in 2022 following the full-scale of Ukraine but suggest that Russia has since fully recovered. This column argues that data on nighttime lights emitted by Russian cities suggest otherwise. The authors find evidence of a significant economic slowdown due to the war, and substantial redistribution of economic activity across Russia’s regions. The costs appear to have been concentrated where it matters: in the economic and political core of Russia.
url:9f92ae725106e127.abstract_zh: 俄罗斯官方统计数据显示，2022年乌克兰全面冲突后俄罗斯经历了一场轻度衰退，但表明此后经济已完全复苏。本文认为，俄罗斯城市夜间灯光数据所反映的情况并非如此。作者发现，战争导致了显著的经济放缓，并且俄罗斯各地区的经济活动发生了大规模重新分配。这些代价似乎集中在关键之处：俄罗斯的经济与政治核心区域。
url:9f92ae725106e127.title: When statistics lie: Using satellite data to track Russia’s wartime economy

url:9fb9e21e5ac38cf3.abstract: Education and corruption are negatively correlated at the cross-national level, but little is known about the causal relationship between the two. We combine newly-collected data on timing and locations of Vietnam's national expansion of universities with detailed survey data on experiences of corruption from over 170,000 respondents in 320 districts across 12 years. Using staggered difference-in-differences, we show that cohorts exposed to the university expansion are 78% more likely to have a university education. However, this increase neither translates into fewer individuals being affected by corruption nor increases the propensity to denounce corrupt officials. Instead, we find that education increases exposure to corruption at the individual level. The mechanism for this increase that is most consistent with our data is that education raises household income and higher income leads to more bribe payments.
url:9fb9e21e5ac38cf3.abstract_zh: 教育与腐败在国家层面呈负相关，但两者间的因果关系尚不明确。本研究将越南全国大学扩张的时间与地点新数据，与涵盖12年间320个地区逾17万受访者腐败经历详情的调查数据相结合。采用交错双重差分法分析发现，受大学扩张影响的群体接受高等教育的概率提升78%。然而，这一增长既未转化为受腐败影响人数的减少，也未提高举报腐败官员的倾向。相反，我们发现教育在个体层面增加了腐败暴露风险。与数据最吻合的机制解释是：教育提高了家庭收入，而更高收入导致更多贿赂支出。
url:9fb9e21e5ac38cf3.title: The Effects of Education on Corruption: Evidence from Vietnam's University Expansion

url:9ffca9e51db58194.abstract: We develop a framework to quantify this trade-off, using rich panel data on energy spending and income, alongside price and policy variation from the 2022-23 European Energy Crisis. We show that, in the absence of policy intervention, average household welfare losses would have been equivalent to 6% of income, with some households facing much larger losses. A combination of an energy price subsidy and universal transfers reduced both the mean and dispersion of household losses but incurred efficiency costs equivalent to 12% of the total funds spent on the relief package. Under a range of social preferences, better targeted transfers would have reduced the optimal subsidy rate, though not eliminated it entirely.
url:9ffca9e51db58194.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个框架来量化这一权衡，利用关于能源支出和收入的丰富面板数据，以及2022-23年欧洲能源危机期间的价格和政策变化。我们表明，在没有政策干预的情况下，平均家庭福利损失将相当于收入的6%，而一些家庭则面临更大的损失。能源价格补贴与普遍转移支付的组合，虽然降低了家庭损失的平均值和离散度，但产生了相当于救济包总支出12%的效率成本。在一系列社会偏好下，更精准的转移支付本可降低最优补贴率，但并未完全消除补贴需求。
url:9ffca9e51db58194.title: The Welfare Effects of Price Shocks and Household Relief Packages: Evidence from an Energy Crisis

url:a00cf1e1259c9d02.abstract: China's unprecedented expansion of higher education in 1999, increased annual college enrollment from 1 million to 9.6 million by 2020. We trace the global ripple effects of that expansion by examining its impact on US graduate education and local economies surrounding college towns. Combining administrative data from China's college admissions system and US visa data, we leverage the centralized quota system governing Chinese college admissions for identification and present three key findings. First, the expansion of Chinese undergraduate education drove graduate student flows to the US: every additional 100 college graduates in China led to 3.6 Chinese graduate students in the US. Second, Chinese master's students generated positive spillovers, driving the birth of new master's programs, and increasing the number of other international and American master
url:a00cf1e1259c9d02.abstract_zh: 中国于1999年实施的前所未有的高等教育扩招政策，使得年度大学招生人数从100万激增至2020年的960万。我们通过考察这一扩招对美国研究生教育及大学城周边地方经济的影响，追溯其全球涟漪效应。结合中国高考录取系统的行政数据与美国签证数据，我们利用中国大学录取的集中配额制度进行识别，并提出三项主要发现。首先，中国本科教育的扩张推动了研究生流向美国：中国每增加100名大学毕业生，便会有3.6名中国研究生赴美深造。其次，中国硕士生带来了正向溢出效应，促进了新硕士项目的诞生，并增加了其他国际及美国本土硕士生的数量。

url:a02ed1e16f2bab22.abstract: This paper examines the impact of access to housing on fertility rates using random variation from housing credit lotteries in Brazil. We find that obtaining housing increases the average probability of having a child by 3.8% and the number of children by 3.2%. For 20 to 25-year-olds, the corresponding effects are 32% and 33%, with no increase in fertility for people above age 40. The lifetime fertility increase for a 20-year old is twice as large from obtaining housing immediately relative to obtaining it at age 30. The increase in fertility is stronger for households in areas with lower quality housing, greater rental expenses relative to income, and those with lower household income and lower female income share. These results suggest that alleviating housing credit and physical space constraints can significantly increase fertility.
url:a02ed1e16f2bab22.abstract_zh: 本文利用巴西住房信贷抽签产生的随机变动，考察了获得住房对生育率的影响。我们发现，获得住房使平均生育概率提高3.8%，子女数量增加3.2%。对于20至25岁的人群，相应效应分别为32%和33%，而40岁以上人群的生育率未见增长。对于20岁个体而言，立即获得住房相较于30岁时获得，其终身生育率增幅是后者的两倍。生育率的提升在住房质量较低、租金占收入比例较高、家庭收入较低及女性收入份额较低的地区更为显著。这些结果表明，缓解住房信贷和物理空间约束能显著促进生育率。
url:a02ed1e16f2bab22.title: Housing and Fertility

url:a031ae941b9dcd63.abstract: How do demographic trends shape the adoption of AI and automation technologies? This paper provides the first large-scale cross-country firm-level test of the demographic–automation hypothesis using World Bank Enterprise Surveys data covering 89,380 firms across 144 countries from 2022 to 2025. I classify adopters by applying a large language model to firms’ open-ended process innovation descriptions, identifying 1,656 AI and automation adopters (1.9 percent of the sample). A ten-percentage-point increase in the old-age dependency ratio raises process adoption probability by approximately 0.6 percentage points, after accounting for countries’ income levels, digital infrastructure, firm size and sector, and broad regional and time differences. The result is robust across specifications and supported by an instrumental variable strategy based on predetermined demographic cohort structure. Heterogeneity analysis shows the effect concentrates in manufacturing, large firms, and developing economies for the broad adoption measure; restricting to firms with explicit references to AI reverses the sector pattern, with services firms significantly more likely to adopt than manufacturing firms, pointing to distinct sectoral profiles for software-based AI and hardware-based automation. Aging also predicts firms’ development of AI-enabled products across both manufacturing and services. The results indicate that demographic aging shapes AI and automation adoption through both process and product innovation channels: firms substitute technology for increasingly scarce and costly labor in production, and separately develop AI-enabled products for labor-constrained customers.
url:a031ae941b9dcd63.abstract_zh: 人口结构趋势如何影响人工智能与自动化技术的采用？本文利用世界银行企业调查数据，覆盖2022至2025年间144个国家的89，380家企业，首次进行了大规模跨国企业层面的“人口结构—自动化”假说检验。我通过将大语言模型应用于企业对开放式流程创新描述的分类，识别出1，656家人工智能与自动化采用者（占样本的1.9%）。在控制国家收入水平、数字基础设施、企业规模与行业以及广泛的区域和时间差异后，老年抚养比每上升十个百分点，流程采用概率约提高0.6个百分点。该结果在多种设定下保持稳健，并得到基于预定人口队列结构的工具变量策略的支持。异质性分析表明，在广义采用指标下，效应集中于制造业、大型企业和发展中经济体；而将样本限制为明确提及人工智能的企业后，行业模式发生逆转，服务业企业显著比制造业企业更可能采用，这揭示了基于软件的人工智能与基于硬件的自动化具有不同的行业特征。人口老龄化同样预测了制造业和服务业中企业开发人工智能赋能产品的行为。结果表明，人口老龄化通过流程创新和产品创新两条渠道塑造人工智能与自动化的采用：企业以技术替代生产中日益稀缺和昂贵的劳动力，并同时为面临劳动力约束的客户开发人工智能赋能产品。
url:a031ae941b9dcd63.title: Aging Economies and AI Adoption: Firm-Level Evidence from the World Bank Enterprise Surveys
url:a031ae941b9dcd63.title_zh: 老龄化经济体与人工智能采纳：来自世界银行企业调查的企业层面证据

url:a03ac268719bd31f.abstract: We construct a new dataset of FOMC meeting transcripts from 1966 to 1990 to analyze the sources of heterogeneity in individual monetary policy preferences and study how this heterogeneity shapes policy decisions. Using these detailed discussions, we manually quantify and characterize each FOMC participants’ preferred policies along with their reasoning and justification. We show that participants' beliefs about the effects of monetary policy—specifically, their perceived slope of the Phillips Curve—play a central role. Participants who believe monetary policy has stronger effects on real activity are more likely to cite output as a justification for easing, while those perceiving stronger price effects emphasize inflation as a reason for tightening. We then show that the Chair plays a unique and powerful role in reconciling these views, not just in setting policy rates, but also in minimizing dissent. The latter occurs because dissenters find their ability to influence policy in subsequent meetings is significantly curtailed.
url:a03ac268719bd31f.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个涵盖1966年至1990年联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）会议记录的新数据集，以分析个体货币政策偏好的异质性来源，并研究这种异质性如何影响政策决策。利用这些详尽的讨论内容，我们手动量化并刻画了每位FOMC参与者的偏好政策及其理由和论证。研究表明，参与者对货币政策效果的信念——特别是他们对菲利普斯曲线斜率的感知——起着核心作用。认为货币政策对实际经济活动影响更强的参与者，更倾向于将产出作为宽松政策的理由；而那些感知价格效应更强的参与者，则强调通胀作为紧缩政策的依据。随后，我们指出，主席在调和这些观点中扮演着独特且强有力的角色，不仅体现在设定政策利率上，还体现在最小化异议方面。后者之所以发生，是因为持异议者在后续会议中影响政策的能力显著受限。
url:a03ac268719bd31f.title: How Monetary Policy Is Made: Lessons from Historical FOMC Discussions

url:a064a33b249d82e8.abstract: Sixty-three percent of large companies worldwide had made a net zero commitment by 2023, up from close to none in 2018. But if the target date is 2050, that's several corporate lifetimes away, and the planet needs emission reductions today. What actually changes in the boardroom when a pledge is signed? Simon Dietz (LSE, CEPR) has tracked climate management practices and emissions at nearly 2,000 companies to find out. He tells Tim Phillips that the picture is not the one that either side of the debate might expect. A net zero pledge doesn't usually signify an immediate cut in emissions, but there is a clear and early shift in how companies plan for net zero that has often started before the announcement. What is left is something is harder to spot: firms making a strategic pivot, of which the public commitment is only one part.
url:a064a33b249d82e8.abstract_zh: 截至2023年，全球63%的大型企业已做出净零排放承诺，而2018年这一比例几乎为零。但若目标期限设定在2050年，这相当于跨越数个企业生命周期，而地球亟需当下的减排行动。当企业签署承诺书时，董事会层面究竟发生了哪些实质性变化？伦敦政治经济学院及经济政策研究中心的西蒙·迪茨追踪了近2000家企业的气候管理实践与排放数据，试图揭示真相。他向蒂姆·菲利普斯表示，实际情况可能出乎辩论双方的预期。净零承诺通常不会立即带来排放削减，但企业规划净零转型的方式会提前出现明显转变——这种转变往往在公开承诺前就已启动。更难以察觉的是：企业正在实施战略转向，而公开承诺仅是其中一环。
url:a064a33b249d82e8.title: Are Net Zero Commitments Greenwash?
url:a064a33b249d82e8.title_zh: 净零承诺是漂绿行为吗？

url:a0698633658cf8e0.abstract: This paper develops a tractable model of offender location choice and police resource allocation across multiple areas. Individuals differ in the cost of apprehension and choose whether to commit crime and, if so, where. Each area contains a fixed value of criminal opportunities, so offenders impose congestion on one another, while policing affects expected apprehension. For arbitrary policing levels, equilibrium sorts offenders by apprehension cost across areas ordered by policing per unit of criminal opportunity value. With a fixed police budget, welfare maximization equalizes policing-to-value ratios across all active areas. The model shows when place-based policing should target the value of criminal opportunities rather than observed crime counts alone, since observed crime may already reflect prior police allocation and offender displacement.
url:a0698633658cf8e0.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个可处理的模型，用于分析犯罪者跨区域选址行为与警力资源分配问题。个体在逮捕成本上存在差异，需决定是否实施犯罪及选择犯罪地点。每个区域拥有固定价值的犯罪机会，因此犯罪者之间会产生相互拥挤效应，而警务活动则影响预期逮捕概率。在任意警力配置水平下，均衡状态会按照单位犯罪机会价值对应的警力密度，将犯罪者按逮捕成本排序至不同区域。在警力预算固定的条件下，社会福利最大化要求所有活跃区域的警力-价值比趋于均等。该模型表明，基于地点的警务策略应瞄准犯罪机会的价值而非仅关注观测到的犯罪数量——因为后者可能已反映先前的警力配置与犯罪者转移效应。

url:a17711df02abfdff.abstract: This article examines the economics of paid sick leave from both theoretical and empirical perspectives. Research on paid sick leave has evolved dynamically over the last decade, primarily driven by the spread of U.S. sick pay mandates, which have increased paid sick leave access from 63 percent to 77 percent in all U.S. jobs. We begin by discussing the economic rationales for government regulation of paid sick leave, particularly the negative externalities associated with contagious diseases when individuals work while sick. After that, we discuss the key trade-offs in the general design of paid sick leave schemes, along with the trade-offs when setting specific policy parameters. Finally, we review economic modeling approaches to study optimal paid sick leave policies.
url:a17711df02abfdff.abstract_zh: 本文从理论与实证两个维度探讨了带薪病假的经济学问题。过去十年间，带薪病假研究动态演进，主要受美国病假政策普及推动，该政策使全美工作中带薪病假的可及性从63%提升至77%。我们首先讨论政府对带薪病假进行监管的经济学理据，特别是当个体带病工作时，传染病所伴随的负外部性。随后，我们探讨带薪病假方案总体设计中的关键权衡，以及设定具体政策参数时的权衡。最后，我们回顾了研究最优带薪病假政策的经济学建模方法。
url:a17711df02abfdff.title: The Economics of Paid Sick Leave

url:a181e6f01b35eddb.abstract: This paper reviews the evidence on the levels and trends of income and consumption inequality around the world during 2000–2019. It examines how inequality levels vary across countries, whether inequality has been rising more often than declining, and how conclusions depend on the underlying income concept and data source. The analysis draws on two types of evidence: inequality estimates derived from household surveys and contained in harmonized databases such as WIID, PIP, and LIS, and estimates based on distributional national accounts from the World Inequality Database. The analysis pays particular attention to differences between income- and consumption-based measures, the under-coverage of top incomes in household surveys, and the assumptions underlying distributional national accounts. Two findings emerge. First, inequality levels differ substantially not only across countries, but also across concepts and data sources within countries. Measures based on national income generally show higher inequality than those based on household surveys, while consumption-based measures tend to yield lower inequality than income-based ones. Second, trends prove more robust than levels: across sources, inequality was more often declining or stable than increasing during the two decades preceding the pandemic. There is also some evidence of convergence, with declines more common among initially high-inequality countries and increases more frequent among initially low-inequality countries.
url:a181e6f01b35eddb.abstract_zh: 本文回顾了2000年至2019年间全球收入与消费不平等水平及其变化趋势的证据。研究探讨了各国不平等程度的差异、不平等是否更常呈上升而非下降趋势，以及结论如何依赖于所采用的基本收入概念和数据来源。分析基于两类证据：一类源自住户调查并收录于WIID、PIP和LIS等统一数据库中的不平等估计；另一类则基于世界不平等数据库中的分配性国民账户估计。分析特别关注基于收入与基于消费的衡量指标之间的差异、住户调查对高收入群体覆盖不足的问题，以及分配性国民账户所依赖的假设。研究得出两项发现。第一，不平等水平不仅在各国间存在显著差异，在同一国家内，因概念和数据来源不同也差异明显。基于国民收入的衡量通常显示的不平等程度高于基于住户调查的结果，而基于消费的衡量往往比基于收入的衡量产生更低的不平等水平。第二，趋势比水平更具稳健性：从各数据来源看，在疫情前的二十年里，不平等下降或保持稳定的情况多于上升。同时，也存在一定的趋同证据，即初始不平等程度较高的国家更常出现下降，而初始不平等程度较低的国家则更常出现上升。
url:a181e6f01b35eddb.title: Is Income Inequality on the Rise Everywhere?
url:a181e6f01b35eddb.title_zh: 收入不平等是否在全球范围内加剧？

url:a1a01656d7c1d124.abstract: Improving access to formal finance is crucial for the growth of women-owned enterprises in emerging economies. This paper investigates whether the use of technology enhances access to formal credit for women entrepreneurs in India’s unorganized sector. Based on enterprise-level data from the Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (ASUSE) 2022–2023 round, we present the following key findings: (1) Women-owned enterprises are significantly less likely to obtain formal credit and, when they obtain loans, they secure smaller loan amounts, confirming a gender gap in accessing formal credit. (2) Technology usage, captured by computer and internet usage, improves both the likelihood of receiving formal loans and the size of loans for women-owned firms, reflecting the positive effect of technology adoption in bridging the gender gap. (3) Women-owned enterprises adopting technology witness improved access to formal credit through the use of the internet for banking and accessing other financial services. (4) The positive formal credit access-enhancing effect of technology usage is driven by rural firms in terms of loan access and by both rural and urban firms in terms of loan amounts. These results have significant implications for promoting gender equity in accessing formal finance through targeted digital interventions for women entrepreneurs. KEYWORDS: financial inclusion gender gap technology adoption women entrepreneurs JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 J16 L26 O33
url:a1a01656d7c1d124.abstract_zh: 改善正规融资渠道对于新兴经济体中女性创办企业的成长至关重要。本文探究了技术应用是否有助于印度非正规部门女性创业者获得正规信贷。基于2022-2023年度《非正规部门企业年度调查》（ASUSE）的企业层面数据，我们得出以下主要发现：（1）女性创办企业获得正规信贷的可能性显著更低，且即使获得贷款，其贷款金额也较小，这证实了正规信贷获取中存在性别差距。（2）以计算机和互联网使用衡量的技术应用，既提高了女性创办企业获得正规贷款的可能性，也增加了贷款规模，反映出技术采纳在弥合性别差距方面的积极作用。（3）采用技术的女性创办企业通过使用互联网进行银行业务及获取其他金融服务，改善了正规信贷的可及性。（4）技术应用对正规信贷获取的积极促进作用，在贷款可得性方面由农村企业驱动，而在贷款金额方面则由城乡企业共同驱动。这些结论对于通过针对女性创业者的定向数字干预措施促进正规融资领域的性别平等具有重要政策启示。关键词：金融包容性 性别差距 技术采纳 女性创业者 JEL分类号：G21 J16 L26 O33

url:a1c29711cb3dd334.abstract: We present a model of the yield curve in which the central bank can provide market participants with forward guidance on both future short rates and on future Quantitative Easing (QE) operations, which affect bond supply. Forward guidance on short rates works through the expectations hypothesis, while forward guidance on QE works through expected future bond risk premia. If a QE operation is expected to be undone in the near term, then its announcement will have a hump-shaped effect on the yield and forward-rate curves; otherwise the effect may be increasing with maturity. Humps associated to QE announcements typically occur at maturities longer than those associated to short-rate announcements, even when the effects of the former are expected to last over a shorter horizon. We use our model to re-examine the empirical evidence on QE announcements in the US.
url:a1c29711cb3dd334.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个收益率曲线模型，其中中央银行可以向市场参与者提供关于未来短期利率及未来量化宽松（QE）操作的远期指引，这些操作影响债券供给。关于短期利率的远期指引通过预期假说发挥作用，而关于QE的远期指引则通过预期未来债券风险溢价起作用。如果一项QE操作预期在短期内被逆转，则其公告将对收益率和远期利率曲线产生驼峰状效应；否则，该效应可能随期限增加而增强。与QE公告相关的驼峰通常出现在比短期利率公告相关的驼峰更长的期限上，即使前者的效应预期持续时间较短。我们利用该模型重新审视美国QE公告的实证证据。

url:a2361d6c329e90fa.abstract: How do households respond when deposit rates drop below zero? Using administrative micro data and exploiting cross-bank variation in interest rate policies, we study a major episode of negative deposit rates in Denmark affecting two thirds of household deposits. We find that households strongly reduced deposit balances when exposed to negative deposit rates, allocating funds to stock portfolios and consumption. In a large-scale survey, we document important roles for loss aversion, perceived unfairness, intertemporal substitution and return considerations in driving these responses. Our findings suggest that monetary policy can have strong consumption effects in negative territory.
url:a2361d6c329e90fa.abstract_zh: 当存款利率降至负值时，家庭会如何应对？利用行政微观数据并借助银行间利率政策的差异，我们研究了丹麦一次影响三分之二家庭存款的重大负存款利率事件。研究发现，当家庭面临负存款利率时，其存款余额显著减少，资金被重新配置至股票投资组合和消费领域。通过大规模调查，我们证实损失厌恶、感知不公、跨期替代及收益考量在驱动这些行为中发挥重要作用。研究结果表明，货币政策在负利率区间可能对消费产生显著影响。
