url:a8d40b133b422453.title_zh: CAP 2023-2027第一支柱改革下意大利可耕地农场的经济结果与生产选择：作物轮作生态计划的作用

url:a8ed664164a5f637.title: Workplace Incentives and Organizational Learning
url:a8ed664164a5f637.title_zh: 工作场所激励与组织学习

url:a8f10da057902449.abstract: This paper examines how firms trade off commercial objectives against humanitarian obligations. Using 1.1 billion ship positions, we study responses to 1,395 distress alerts during the Mediterranean migration crisis. Event-study estimates show that commercial ships are about 90% less likely than equally distant NGO vessels to render assistance within the first five hours. Opportunity costs determined by load and trip destination shape merchant-vessel responses, suggesting competitive pressures suppress prosocial conduct. At the route level, traffic on affected corridors falls by 14% over the subsequent year, consistent with re-routing to reduce expected rescue exposure and, in turn, shifting global trade flows.
url:a8f10da057902449.abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业在商业目标与人道主义义务之间如何权衡。利用11亿条船舶位置数据，我们研究了地中海移民危机期间对1,395次遇险警报的响应情况。事件研究估计显示，在最初五小时内，商业船只提供援助的可能性比距离相同的非政府组织船只低约90%。由载货量和航程目的地决定的机会成本塑造了商船的响应行为，这表明竞争压力抑制了亲社会行为。在航线层面，受影响走廊的交通量在随后一年内下降了14%，这与为减少预期救援暴露而重新规划航线一致，并进而改变了全球贸易流向。
url:a8f10da057902449.title: Humanitarian Action under Market Pressure
url:a8f10da057902449.title_zh: 市场压力下的人道主义行动

url:a9076d98649d97be.title: Shocks, Agricultural Productivity, Self‐Help Groups and Food Security in Tanzania
url:a9076d98649d97be.title_zh: 冲击、农业生产力、自助小组与坦桑尼亚的粮食安全

url:a932f8922c2f630e.title: News shocks and seafood exports: Evidence from the Fukushima ALPS-treated water release announcement
url:a932f8922c2f630e.title_zh: 新闻冲击与海产品出口：来自福岛ALPS处理水排放公告的证据

url:a9435521c9b77d7d.abstract: We develop a market-based measure of firms' and industries' exposure to foreign trade disruptions. Combining this approach with detailed supervisory data, we quantify large U.S. banks' exposure to such disruptions and propose a novel bank-level vulnerability index. We show that banks with greater exposure experienced significantly larger stock price declines following the April 2025 tariff announcements. Our vulnerability index explains 18% of the cross-sectional variation in bank returns during this episode.
url:a9435521c9b77d7d.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一种基于市场的企业及行业对外贸易中断风险敞口度量方法。结合详尽的监管数据，我们量化了美国大型银行对此类风险的敞口程度，并提出了一种新颖的银行层面脆弱性指数。研究表明，在2025年4月关税政策宣布后，风险敞口较大的银行股价跌幅显著更大。该脆弱性指数可解释此轮银行股收益率截面差异的18%。
url:a9435521c9b77d7d.title: Disruptions to Foreign Trade and U.S. Banks' Returns
url:a9435521c9b77d7d.title_zh: 外贸中断与美国银行收益

url:a94846112d70c45f.title: DP9 International Trade in Identical Commodities: Cournot Equilibrium with Free Entry
url:a94846112d70c45f.title_zh: DP9 同质商品的国际贸易：自由进入条件下的古诺均衡

url:a94899bf7f79fc46.abstract: Empirical evidence commonly cited as indicating that inflation expectations have become better anchored includes the declining sensitivity of expectations to inflation surprises over time, particularly around the adoption of inflation targeting. These patterns are typically attributed to the influence of explicit or implicit inflation targets on inflation expectations. We show that this evidence is consistent with a model of experience-based learning in which individuals learn solely from their life-time history of realized inflation, without anchoring their expectations to an announced inflation target. In this model, the prolonged experience of low short-run inflation persistence in the pre-COVID decades renders long-run expectations insensitive to inflation surprises, matching the patterns observed in empirical anchoring tests. A unique prediction of the experience-based learning model is also borne out in the data: the decline in surprise sensitivity since the 1980s is strongest among younger individuals. The memory of low inflation persistence experiences further explains why long-run inflation expectations remained stable in the face of the post-COVID inflation surge. At the same time, simulations indicate that the sensitivity of long-run expectations to inflation surprises would rise sharply if individuals were to experience another sustained episode of highly persistent inflation. Overall, long-run inflation expectations may be less firmly anchored than commonly believed.
url:a94899bf7f79fc46.abstract_zh: 通常被引用的经验证据表明，通胀预期已更好地锚定，包括预期对通胀意外事件的敏感性随时间下降，尤其是在采纳通胀目标制前后。这些模式通常被归因于明确或隐含的通胀目标对通胀预期的影响。我们证明，这一证据与一种基于经验的学习模型相符，在该模型中，个体仅从自身一生中经历的实际通胀历史中学习，而不将其预期锚定于公布的通胀目标。在此模型中，新冠疫情前几十年间低短期通胀持续性的长期经历，使得长期预期对通胀意外事件不敏感，与实证锚定测试中观察到的模式相匹配。基于经验的学习模型的一个独特预测也在数据中得到验证：自20世纪80年代以来，意外事件敏感性的下降在年轻个体中最为显著。对低通胀持续性经历的记忆进一步解释了为何长期通胀预期在新冠疫情后通胀飙升面前保持稳定。同时，模拟表明，如果个体再次经历持续的高通胀时期，长期预期对通胀意外事件的敏感性将急剧上升。总体而言，长期通胀预期的锚定程度可能比普遍认为的要弱。
url:a94899bf7f79fc46.title: DP21632 Seemingly Anchored Inflation Expectations
url:a94899bf7f79fc46.title_zh: DP21632 看似锚定的通胀预期

url:a97491df64e00e33.abstract: We present new evidence on the impact of fiscal variables on long-term interest rates and term premia in the United States. To alleviate endogeneity problems, we follow the seminal methodology by Laubach (2009) and resort to long-term projections of interest rates and fiscal variables. After incorporating an additional 20 years of data into our sample, the estimated effects of debt and deficits on interest rates show little change from Laubach’s findings. However, we show that the link between long-term rates and fiscal variables is not stable over time. It was close to zero during the years of relative fiscal prudence around the turn of the century and it has been increasing since fiscal positions have started to deteriorate markedly
url:a97491df64e00e33.abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于美国财政变量对长期利率及期限溢价影响的新证据。为缓解内生性问题，我们遵循Laubach（2009）的开创性方法，利用长期利率与财政变量的预测数据。在将额外20年的数据纳入样本后，债务和赤字对利率的估计效应与Laubach的发现相比变化不大。然而，我们表明长期利率与财政变量之间的联系并非随时间保持稳定。在世纪之交相对财政审慎的年份里，这一联系接近于零，而自财政状况显著恶化以来，这一联系一直在增强。
url:a97491df64e00e33.title: The Impact of Debt and Deficits on Long Term Interest Rates in the US
url:a97491df64e00e33.title_zh: 美国债务与赤字对长期利率的影响

url:a977ebbe39cf42fb.abstract: Organizations often require employees to collaborate with others who may see the world differently, yet we know little about how misalignment in personal values affects performance within firms. Using survey and administrative data from a world-leading bank, we show that employees whose values diverge from those of their manager perform worse. This effect is not explained by demographic diversity or misalignment with organizational values. The productivity loss from moving from the least to the most misaligned worker is nearly four times larger than that associated with having a manager of a different gender. In contrast, value differences with teammates do not generate similar effects. We show, both empirically and theoretically, that the performance costs of value misalignment with managers can be explained by a decline in employee-led communication: fear of misunderstanding suppresses voice and information-seeking, increasing uncertainty about managerial expectations and lowering output.
url:a977ebbe39cf42fb.abstract_zh: 组织常常要求员工与那些可能对世界持有不同看法的人合作，然而我们对于个人价值观不一致如何影响企业内部绩效知之甚少。利用一家世界领先银行的调查和行政数据，我们表明，那些价值观与其经理相左的员工表现更差。这一效应并不能由人口统计多样性或与组织价值观的不一致来解释。从最一致到最不一致的员工，其生产力损失几乎是拥有不同性别经理所带来的损失的四倍。相比之下，与团队成员之间的价值观差异并未产生类似效应。我们通过实证和理论两方面证明，与经理价值观不一致导致的绩效成本可归因于员工主导沟通的减少：害怕误解抑制了发言和信息寻求，增加了对经理期望的不确定性，从而降低了产出。
url:a977ebbe39cf42fb.title: DP19929 Value Dissonance at Work

url:a97bd235920ef390.abstract: This paper constructs a new database based on China
url:a97bd235920ef390.abstract_zh: 本文基于中国构建了一个新的数据库。
url:a97bd235920ef390.title: Two Decades of Chinese Industry Subsidies

url:a97f8e13203a5767.abstract: We develop a dynamic model in which individuals allocate time between work and religious activities, and parents invest in their children's human capital and religious belief. The model delivers, in a unified framework, the two empirical regularities documented by Barro and McCleary (2003) and McCleary and Barro (2019): controlling for religious activities, stronger belief raises economic growth because it raises human capital investment; controlling for belief, more time spent on religious activities lowers growth by crowding out labor supply. While the labor-supply margin is individually optimal, the human-capital margin is not: parents do not internalize that greater human-capital investment crowds out future religious transmission through the socialization channel, leading to inefficiently high human capital in equilibrium under strong socialization externality. We extend this baseline framework in three directions. First, introducing a complementarity between religious belief and human capital—capturing the Protestant-ethic channel of Weber (1930)—we show that the efficiency of equilibrium depends non-monotonically on the strength of this complementarity. Second, allowing for cultural conflict between two religious groups à la Bisin and Verdier (2000),, we show that cultural intolerance depresses human capital investment and, if human capital raises labor productivity, reduces economic growth. Third, embedding the model in a system of cities, we show that larger, more productive cities endogenously attract workers who invest more in human capital and spend less time on religious activities, generating a negative cross-city relationship between city size and religiosity that is consistent with the empirical evidence in McCleary and Barro (2019).
url:a97f8e13203a5767.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个动态模型，其中个体在工作和宗教活动之间分配时间，父母则投资于子女的人力资本和宗教信仰。该模型在一个统一框架内，再现了Barro和McCleary（2003）及McCleary和Barro（2019）所记录的两个经验规律：在控制宗教活动的情况下，更强的信仰通过提高人力资本投资促进经济增长；在控制信仰的情况下，更多时间投入宗教活动则通过挤出劳动供给降低增长。虽然劳动供给边际在个体层面是最优的，但人力资本边际并非如此：父母未内化更高的人力资本投资会通过社会化渠道挤出未来的宗教传承，导致在强社会化外部性下均衡中人力资本无效率地偏高。我们在三个方向上扩展了这一基准框架。首先，引入宗教信仰与人力资本之间的互补性——捕捉韦伯（1930）的新教伦理渠道——我们表明均衡效率随这种互补性的强度呈非单调变化。其次，允许两个宗教群体之间的文化冲突（仿照Bisin和Verdier（2000）），我们表明文化不容忍会抑制人力资本投资，并且如果人力资本提高劳动生产率，则会降低经济增长。第三，将模型嵌入城市体系中，我们表明更大、更具生产力的城市会内生地吸引那些在人力资本上投资更多、在宗教活动上花费时间更少的工人，从而产生城市规模与宗教虔诚度之间的负向跨城市关系，这与McCleary和Barro（2019）的经验证据一致。
url:a97f8e13203a5767.title: Believing and Practicing: How Religion Shapes Human Capital and Growth
url:a97f8e13203a5767.title_zh: 信仰与实践：宗教如何塑造人力资本与增长

url:a99578c3edf9002d.abstract: How reliable are public debt statistics? This paper quantifies the magnitude, characteristics, and timing of hidden debt by tracking ex post revisions to sovereign debt statistics. We assemble a comprehensive new database of 119 editions, or vintages, of League of Nations, United Nations, IMF, and World Bank debt statistics, covering up to 187 countries over more than a century. We show that public debt is systematically underreported, with upward revisions averaging roughly one percent of GDP across advanced and developing economies, external and domestic debt, and all reporting systems we examine. Hidden debt accumulates in good times and tends to be revealed in bad times, often during IMF programs and sovereign defaults. Over the past one hundred years, nearly half of all sovereign defaults have coincided with substantial upward revisions to reported public debt. We incorporate these patterns into a quantitative sovereign default model and show that hidden debt raises default risk and borrowing costs, and thereby contributes to debt intolerance. Differences in the reliability of debt data across countries account for roughly 20% of the observed gap in debt-carrying capacity between low and high-income economies.
url:a99578c3edf9002d.abstract_zh: 公共债务统计的可靠性如何？本文通过追踪主权债务统计的事后修正，量化了隐性债务的规模、特征及其出现时机。我们汇编了一个全面的新数据库，涵盖国际联盟、联合国、国际货币基金组织和世界银行债务统计的119个版本（即“代际”），覆盖多达187个国家，时间跨度超过一个世纪。研究表明，公共债务被系统性低估，向上修正平均约为GDP的1%，这一现象在发达经济体与发展中经济体、外部债务与国内债务以及我们所考察的所有报告体系中均普遍存在。隐性债务在经济繁荣时期累积，往往在经济衰退时期暴露，尤其是在国际货币基金组织项目期间及主权违约发生时。过去一百年中，近一半的主权违约事件伴随着报告公共债务的大幅向上修正。我们将这些模式纳入一个量化的主权违约模型，并显示隐性债务提高了违约风险和借贷成本，从而加剧了“债务不耐受”现象。各国债务数据可靠性的差异，解释了低收入与高收入经济体之间债务承载能力差距的约20%。
url:a99578c3edf9002d.title: DP21902 Hidden Debt Revelations

url:a9c92048da28cbe2.abstract: This paper studies how short-term variations in fine particulate matter (PM2.5) pollution affects cognitive performance across tasks of varying complexity. While prior work shows that pollution impairs performance in highly demanding cognitive settings, it remains unclear whether these effects extend to simpler tasks. We examine this question using data from official Rubik's Cube tournaments in the United States and India. Solving different cube sizes provides a natural proxy for task complexity, while solving time measures cognitive performance. To identify causal effects, we exploit exogenous variation in local PM2.5 generated by wind direction. We find that PM2.5 pollution has negligible effects on simple tasks but significantly slows performance on complex ones for tournaments in the United States. In India, where baseline PM2.5 levels are substantially higher, we find similar effect patterns but none of the effects are statistically significant. We show that this pattern is explained by diminishing marginal sensitivity to short-term PM2.5 shocks as baseline PM2.5 pollution levels increase. Our findings provide causal evidence that the cognitive costs of PM2.5 pollution depend critically on task complexity.
url:a9c92048da28cbe2.abstract_zh: 本文研究了细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染的短期波动如何影响不同复杂度任务中的认知表现。尽管已有研究表明污染会损害高认知需求环境下的表现，但尚不清楚这些影响是否延伸至简单任务。我们利用美国和印度官方魔方锦标赛的数据来探究这一问题。不同尺寸魔方的解法可作为任务复杂度的自然代理变量，而解题时间则衡量认知表现。为识别因果效应，我们利用风向引起的当地PM2.5外生变化。研究发现，PM2.5污染对美国锦标赛中简单任务的影响微乎其微，但显著降低了复杂任务的表现速度。在基线PM2.5水平显著更高的印度，我们观察到相似的影响模式，但所有效应均未达到统计显著性。我们证明，这一模式可通过短期PM2.5冲击的边际敏感性随基线PM2.5污染水平升高而递减来解释。研究结果提供了因果证据，表明PM2.5污染的认知成本关键取决于任务复杂度。

url:a9ee00aec29de697.abstract: Why is war so economically costly? Our answer is that modern war lowers output not only by destroying productive factors, but also by making the surviving economy work less efficiently. Using uniquely comprehensive firm-level data collected during Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, we document a dramatic collapse in allocative productivity in Ukraine. To sharpen identification and explore key mechanisms (including the role of war intensity, internal displacement, reallocation, and macroeconomic instability), we exploit spatial heterogeneity across Ukrainian districts and comparisons with Russian aggression in 2014 and the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. Our key policy implication is that restoring allocative efficiency--and preparing institutional arrangements that facilitate rapid reallocation in times of stress--is critical for sustaining economic capacity, defense, and national security.
url:a9ee00aec29de697.abstract_zh: 为何战争的经济代价如此高昂？我们的答案是，现代战争不仅通过摧毁生产要素来降低产出，还使幸存经济体的运作效率下降。利用2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰期间收集的独特且全面的企业层面数据，我们记录了乌克兰配置生产率的大幅崩溃。为了强化识别并探索关键机制（包括战争强度、国内流离失所、重新配置及宏观经济不稳定的作用），我们利用了乌克兰各地区间的空间异质性，并与2014年俄罗斯侵略及2008年全球金融危机进行了比较。我们的核心政策启示是，恢复配置效率——并准备好在压力时期促进快速重新配置的制度安排——对于维持经济能力、国防和国家安全至关重要。

url:a9f39a07bfb28947.abstract: What are the determinants of an organization's investment in the loyalty and motivation of its workers? We develop a simple principal-agent model where the standard optimal contract is to offer a bonus that trades off incentive provision versus rent extraction. We allow the principal to undertake two types of motivational investments - one that increases the agent's disutility from deviating from a prescribed effort level, and another that increases the agent's on-the-job satisfaction. We argue that these two types of investments can capture a range of organizational practices - other than extrinsic rewards - that aim to raise worker motivation. We show that the two types of motivational investments are complements and both are substitutes to financial incentives. Our analysis implies that technological improvements in the form of improved worker productivity or greater observability of output will induce profit-maximizing firms to make greater use of financial incentives and less use of motivational investments. The reason is that while financial incentives have constant returns in terms of its effect on the worker's effort level, motivational investments by their very nature have decreasing returns.
url:a9f39a07bfb28947.abstract_zh: 组织对其员工忠诚度与积极性进行投资的决定因素是什么？我们构建了一个简单的委托-代理模型，其中标准最优合同是提供一种在激励提供与租金抽取之间权衡的奖金。我们允许委托人进行两类动机投资——一类增加代理人偏离规定努力水平时的负效用，另一类提升代理人的工作满意度。我们认为，这两类投资能够涵盖除外在奖励之外旨在提升员工动机的一系列组织实践。我们证明，这两类动机投资互为补充，且均与财务激励互为替代。我们的分析表明，以提升员工生产力或增强产出可观测性形式出现的技术进步，将促使追求利润最大化的企业更多采用财务激励，而减少动机投资的使用。原因在于，财务激励对员工努力水平的影响具有恒定回报，而动机投资本质上则呈现递减回报。
url:a9f39a07bfb28947.title: Guilt, Esteem, and Motivational Investments
url:a9f39a07bfb28947.title_zh: 内疚、自尊与动机性投资

url:aa1578de8b803667.abstract: We study participation in sponsored-search auctions when sellers can also appear as organic results. Under the platform’s ex post revenue-maximizing display rule, organic placement acts as an endogenous outside option: the best-matched sellers shade their bids and entry into bidding remains incomplete. The platform gains by committing to show more sponsored results than is ex post optimal, degrading match quality. Empirically, using Amazon search data and a Gini-based measure of query breadth, we confirm the model’s predictions: narrower queries receive fewer sponsored results, and sponsored results are worse matched than organic ones, especially for narrow queries.
url:aa1578de8b803667.abstract_zh: 我们研究了当卖家也能以自然搜索结果出现时，其参与赞助搜索拍卖的行为。在平台事后收益最大化的展示规则下，自然排名充当了内生外部选择：匹配度最高的卖家会压低出价，且竞价参与仍不充分。平台通过承诺展示比事后最优更多的赞助结果来获益，但这会降低匹配质量。基于亚马逊搜索数据及基尼系数衡量的查询广度，我们实证验证了模型预测：窄查询获得的赞助结果更少，且赞助结果的匹配质量低于自然结果，尤其在窄查询中更为显著。

url:aa35bd51d0916c81.abstract: Trust in official economic statistics has become an increasingly salient policy issue, including in the US where the Commissioner of the Bureau of Labor Statistics was dismissed in August 2025 amid allegations that agency data had been manipulated. This column shows that the events produced a sharp increase in economic policy uncertainty, with existing estimates linking uncertainty to macroeconomic outcomes implying that the resulting loss of confidence may have reduced US GDP by roughly $20 billion. While some economic activity postponed during periods of uncertainty may eventually occur later, there are reasons to believe that at least part of the effect could be lasting.
url:aa35bd51d0916c81.abstract_zh: 对官方经济统计数据的信任已成为日益突出的政策问题，包括在美国，劳工统计局局长于2025年8月因机构数据被操纵的指控而被解雇。本专栏显示，这些事件导致经济政策不确定性急剧上升，现有估计将不确定性与宏观经济结果联系起来，表明由此产生的信心丧失可能使美国GDP减少约200亿美元。尽管在不确定性期间推迟的部分经济活动最终可能发生，但有理由相信至少部分影响可能是持久的。
url:aa35bd51d0916c81.title: When trust in official statistics declines

url:aa44badaccb55ed8.abstract: If frontier AI models can be used to develop their next models, this may lead to an ‘intelligence explosion’ and give a large boost to technological advancement. This column develops a framework for understanding how AI may transform the economy through new feedback loops. It shows that the potential for explosive growth depends on the labour share, the returns to research effort, and the share of automated tasks in each sector, and that the threshold may be surprisingly low. Bottlenecks in tasks that remain human, physical constraints on compute, and the pace of automation will shape whether these dynamics materialise.
url:aa44badaccb55ed8.abstract_zh: 如果前沿AI模型能够被用于开发其下一代模型，这可能导致“智能爆炸”，并极大地推动技术进步。本专栏构建了一个框架，用以理解AI如何通过新的反馈循环变革经济。研究表明，爆炸性增长的可能性取决于劳动份额、研究努力的回报以及各部门中自动化任务的占比，且这一门槛可能低得惊人。人类仍承担的任务中的瓶颈、计算能力的物理限制以及自动化的步伐，将决定这些动态是否会成为现实。
url:aa44badaccb55ed8.title: AI feedback loops and the conditions for explosive growth
url:aa44badaccb55ed8.title_zh: 人工智能反馈循环与爆炸性增长的条件

url:aa68912ad52c65bd.abstract: We propose a methodology to test for the null hypothesis that the alphas of a panel of asset returns are jointly equal to zero in a linear factor pricing model with observable and tradable factors — that is, the null of “zero alpha”. The test is based on equation-by- equation estimation, using a randomized version of the estimated alphas, which only requires rates of convergence. The distinct features of the proposed methodology are that it does not require the estimation of any covariance matrix, and that it allows for both N and T to pass to infinity, with the former possibly faster than the latter. Further, unlike extant approaches, the procedure can accommodate conditional heteroskedasticity, non-Gaussianity, and strong cross-sectional dependence in the error terms. We also propose a derandomized decision rule to choose in favor or against the correct specification of a linear factor pricing model. Monte Carlo simulations show that the test has satisfactory properties and it compares favorably to several existing tests. The usefulness of the testing procedure is illustrated through an application of linear factor pricing models to the constituents of the S&P 500.
url:aa68912ad52c65bd.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种检验方法，用于在线性因子定价模型中，针对可观测且可交易因子，检验一组资产收益的alpha是否联合为零的原假设——即“零alpha”原假设。该检验基于逐方程估计，采用估计alpha的随机化版本，仅需收敛速率即可。所提方法的显著特点在于，它无需估计任何协方差矩阵，并且允许N和T同时趋于无穷大，其中前者可能快于后者。此外，与现有方法不同，该程序能够适应误差项中的条件异方差性、非高斯性以及强横截面依赖性。我们还提出了一种去随机化决策规则，以选择支持或反对线性因子定价模型的正确设定。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，该检验具有令人满意的性质，并且优于若干现有检验。通过将线性因子定价模型应用于标普500指数成分股，我们展示了该检验程序的实际效用。
url:aa68912ad52c65bd.title: DP21904 A General Randomized Test for Alpha
url:aa68912ad52c65bd.title_zh: DP21904 一种通用的Alpha随机化检验

url:aac1532842b24259.abstract: Profit shifting by multinational enterprises (MNEs) increases after-tax earnings but can expose firms to regulatory and reputational risks. We examine how stock markets price profit shifting using global profit shifting estimates from approximately 30,000 MNE-year observations between 2010 and 2020. We find that a one standard deviation increase in profit shifting is associated with 6.4% higher monthly stock returns, indicating that stock markets require compensation for the underlying risks. The identified effects become significant only after the initiation of the Base Erosion and Profit Shifting program and gain further strength following the implementation of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.
url:aac1532842b24259.abstract_zh: 跨国企业（MNEs）的利润转移提高了税后收益，但可能使企业面临监管和声誉风险。我们利用2010年至2020年间约30,000个跨国企业-年度观测值的全球利润转移估计，考察股票市场如何对利润转移进行定价。研究发现，利润转移每增加一个标准差，月度股票回报率相应提高6.4%，这表明股票市场要求对潜在风险进行补偿。这一效应仅在税基侵蚀与利润转移项目启动后才变得显著，并在《减税与就业法案》实施后进一步增强。

url:aaf460f1aaba7f91.abstract: this paper contributes to this literature by investigating factors determining the demand for hospitalization in Germany. While most previous studies have found a significant impact of social insurance on the demand for hospital trips, the empirical results presented here cast doubts on the propelling role of those economic incentives in the German case. There are also important differences in the hospitalization behaviour of men and women and between the full sample and those who are chronically ill, which have been neglected by the literature. The analysis relies on various count data models including Poisson, NEGBIN, ZIP (/), hurdle Poisson and NEGBIN panel models, and the findings are rather robust.
url:aaf460f1aaba7f91.abstract_zh: 本文通过探究德国住院需求的决定因素，为该领域文献做出贡献。尽管以往多数研究发现社会保险对住院需求具有显著影响，但本文的实证结果对经济激励在德国案例中的推动作用提出了质疑。此外，男性和女性在住院行为上存在显著差异，全样本与慢性病患者群体之间也存在重要差异，而这些差异此前被文献所忽视。本研究采用多种计数数据模型进行分析，包括泊松模型、负二项模型、零膨胀泊松模型、障碍泊松模型及负二项面板模型，研究结果具有较高的稳健性。
url:aaf460f1aaba7f91.title: Economic Incentives and Hospitalization in Germany
url:aaf460f1aaba7f91.title_zh: 德国经济激励与住院率

url:aaf8dedde1d72b15.abstract: The rise of generative AI has raised hopes that high-quality, personalised financial advice might finally become cheap and universally accessible. This column develops a method to quantify the impact of following AI financial advice over a lifetime. The authors find that on the decisions that matter most for long-run wealth, such as investing in diversified equity or building a savings buffer, today’s leading models give advice broadly consistent with what economists would prescribe. But what people get from AI depends as much on the model's ability as on how they write their prompts, with the advice varying by gender, financial literacy, and prior AI experience.
url:aaf8dedde1d72b15.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能的兴起引发了人们的期待：高质量、个性化的财务建议或许终于能够变得廉价且普及。本文提出了一种方法，用以量化遵循人工智能财务建议对一生财富的影响。作者发现，在影响长期财富的关键决策上，例如投资多元化股票或建立储蓄缓冲，当前领先的模型给出的建议与经济学家通常推荐的内容基本一致。然而，人们从人工智能中获得的建议不仅取决于模型的能力，还取决于他们如何编写提示词，且建议内容因性别、金融素养和先前的人工智能使用经验而异。
url:aaf8dedde1d72b15.title: ChatGPT’s financial advice: Supply, demand, and the life cycle
url:aaf8dedde1d72b15.title_zh: ChatGPT的金融建议：供给、需求与生命周期

url:ab155538ea744998.abstract: This paper develops an analytical structure for assessing the process of international trade negotiations that includes interest groups and self-interested negotiators as fundamental elements. The central conclusion of the analysis is that it is likely to be very difficult for a government that wishes to promote national welfare to do so. The political economy analysis suggests there are strong incentives facing politicians to produce agreements whose profile appears distinctly liberalizing while significant protectionist character flaws tend to be buried in the esoterica. The primary need is to design institutions that will help to introduce much greater transparency in both regional and multilateral agreements and thereby encourage the mobilization of diffuse consumer interests. Only then will significant progress towards liberalization - whether regional or multilateral - become more likely.
url:ab155538ea744998.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析国际贸易谈判进程的分析框架，将利益集团与自利型谈判者作为核心要素。分析的核心结论是：试图提升国民福利的政府很可能难以实现这一目标。政治经济学分析表明，政治家面临强烈激励去达成表面呈现显著自由化特征、而重大保护主义缺陷往往深藏于晦涩条款中的协议。当务之急是设计有助于提升区域及多边协议透明度的制度安排，从而激励分散的消费者利益群体形成合力。唯有如此，无论是区域还是多边层面的自由化进程才更有可能取得实质性突破。
url:ab155538ea744998.title: DP747 What to Expect from Regional and Multilateral Trade Negotiations: A Public Choice Perspective
url:ab155538ea744998.title_zh: DP747 区域与多边贸易谈判的预期：公共选择视角

url:ab17ab3f024a0970.abstract: This paper develops an empirical model to predict episodes of debt servicing difficulties (“debt distress”) in low-income countries, with three main contributions to the existing literature. First, it develops more refined measures of external debt distress episodes that allow timing the onset of distress episodes with increased precision. Second, it develops a systematic algorithm to comprehensively assess the out-of-sample predictive performance of more than 550,000 candidate binary prediction models using J-K-fold cross-validation. Third, it tests whether more sophisticated machine learning algorithms can outperform simple probit models. The paper finds that simple single-equation probit models have better predictive power for debt distress than more sophisticated algorithms and are comparable in terms of predictive performance to important policy benchmarks such as the IMF and World Bank debt sustainability framework for low-income countries.
url:ab17ab3f024a0970.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个实证模型，用以预测低收入国家债务偿付困难（“债务困境”）的阶段，对现有文献有三项主要贡献。第一，它开发了更为精细的外债困境阶段度量方法，使得能够更精确地确定困境阶段的起始时间。第二，它设计了一套系统性算法，通过J-K折交叉验证，全面评估超过55万个候选二元预测模型的样本外预测性能。第三，它检验了更为复杂的机器学习算法是否能超越简单的概率单位模型。研究发现，简单的单方程概率单位模型在预测债务困境方面优于更复杂的算法，并且在预测性能上与诸如国际货币基金组织和世界银行针对低收入国家的债务可持续性框架等重要政策基准相当。
url:ab17ab3f024a0970.title: Predicting Debt Distress in Low-Income Countries
url:ab17ab3f024a0970.title_zh: 预测低收入国家的债务困境

url:ab1af4da6d0fad79.abstract: Post-pandemic inflation raised fears that U.S. monetary tightening would trigger a repeat of the 1982 sudden stop in capital flows to emerging economies. Yet as of 2026 no global recession has followed. We establish three stylized facts distinguishing the 1980s from the 2020s, beyond the shift to flexible exchange rates: monetary policy effectiveness, fiscal space, and external vulnerabilities. We rationalize them in a Mundell-Fleming framework with a fiscal space constraint, which predicts a central role for fiscal space in transmitting foreign currency risk-free rate increases. Cross-country evidence confirms that fiscal space shapes economic performance post-tightening.
url:ab1af4da6d0fad79.abstract_zh: 疫情后的通胀引发了人们的担忧，即美国货币紧缩将重演1982年新兴经济体资本流入的突然停止。然而，截至2026年，全球并未出现衰退。我们确立了三个典型事实，用以区分1980年代与2020年代，除了转向浮动汇率制之外：货币政策有效性、财政空间和外部脆弱性。我们在一个包含财政空间约束的蒙代尔-弗莱明框架中对其进行了合理化解释，该框架预测财政空间在传导外币无风险利率上升中发挥核心作用。跨国证据证实，财政空间塑造了紧缩后的经济表现。
url:ab1af4da6d0fad79.title: DP21874 This Time Is (Mostly) Different: U.S. Tightening Cycles and Global Resilience in the 1980s vs 2020s
url:ab1af4da6d0fad79.title_zh: 这一次（大体上）不同：1980年代与2020年代美国紧缩周期与全球韧性比较

url:ab3a9a5ddf1b985e.abstract: We study the anatomy of the international portfolio finance network. As global financial linkages have become denser over time, cross-border portfolio equity positions have grown in importance relative to debt for Emerging markets and Advanced economies. Using the framework developed by Stavrakeva and Rey (2024), we construct a novel proxy of daily foreign investor holdings in both equity and long-term sovereign debt markets across 32 currency areas. Leveraging an instrumental variable strategy, we identify an effect of foreign equity ETF inflows on exchange rates and local stock market prices. Our high-frequency proxy enables us to interpret episodes of turbulence in international finance. It should prove useful to assess how persistent the current shocks to the international financial system are likely to be.
url:ab3a9a5ddf1b985e.abstract_zh: 本文研究了国际组合金融网络的结构。随着全球金融联系日益紧密，跨境组合股权头寸在新兴市场和发达经济体中的重要性相对于债务持续上升。基于Stavrakeva与Rey（2024）构建的分析框架，我们创新性地构建了涵盖32个货币区域的股票及长期主权债券市场每日外国投资者持有量的代理指标。通过工具变量策略，我们识别出外国股权ETF资金流入对汇率及本地股票市场价格存在显著影响。这一高频代理指标使我们能够解读国际金融市场的动荡时期，并为评估当前国际金融体系冲击的持续性提供分析工具。
url:ab3a9a5ddf1b985e.title: Interpreting Turbulent Episodes in International Finance
url:ab3a9a5ddf1b985e.title_zh: 解读国际金融中的动荡时期

url:ab408d99af2514d5.abstract: Marriage payments are transfers made in connection with marriage and are among the most widespread and enduring institutions in human history. They can be categorized into three forms: bride price, paid by the groom or his family to the bride’s parents; dowry, transferred from the bride’s family to the groom or his kin; and dower, paid by the groom directly to the bride and retained as her property. Although their prevalence has declined in many industrialized societies, marriage payments remain common across large parts of Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and Oceania. Their persistence reflects the fact that they serve multiple economic and social functions simultaneously. Marriage payments can facilitate matching in marriage markets, redistribute marital surplus, transfer wealth across generations, provide insurance within marriage, and signal status, prestige, and adherence to social norms. Marriage payments influence a wide range of outcomes, including household savings, fertility decisions, child marriage, educational investments, migration, bargaining power within marriage, and marital stability. Their effects often extend beyond the married couple themselves, shaping intergenerational patterns of wealth transmission and human capital formation. As such, the consequences of marriage payments are far-reaching. Their welfare implications depend critically on the direction of transfers, who retains control over them after marriage, and the broader legal and social institutions in which they are embedded. In some settings, marital transfers can enhance women’s economic security and bargaining power. In others, they may contribute to gender inequality, violence, coercion, son preference, and constraints on women’s autonomy. The significance of these welfare consequences warrants the attention of policymakers. Accordingly, marriage payments have generated considerable debate and ongoing efforts toward legal reform. At the same time, the diversity of marriage payment systems suggests caution in the design of public policy. Blanket prohibitions or externally imposed reforms may overlook the multiple functions these institutions perform and may generate unintended consequences. More promising approaches may focus on mitigating specific harmful features while preserving functions that families value, particularly where marriage payments remain deeply embedded in local social, economic, and legal systems.
url:ab408d99af2514d5.abstract_zh: 婚姻支付是与婚姻相关的财产转移，是人类历史上最普遍且最持久的制度之一。其形式可分为三类：聘礼，由新郎或其家庭支付给新娘父母；嫁妆，从新娘家庭转移给新郎或其亲属；以及聘金，由新郎直接支付给新娘并作为其个人财产保留。尽管在众多工业化社会中婚姻支付的盛行程度有所下降，但在亚洲、非洲、中东和大洋洲的大部分地区，婚姻支付仍然普遍存在。其持续性反映了这些支付同时服务于多种经济和社会功能。婚姻支付可以促进婚姻市场中的匹配、重新分配婚姻剩余、实现代际财富转移、在婚姻内部提供保险，并传递地位、声望及对社会规范的遵从。婚姻支付影响广泛的结果，包括家庭储蓄、生育决策、童婚、教育投资、迁移、婚姻内部议价能力以及婚姻稳定性。其影响往往超越夫妻本身，塑造代际财富传递模式和人力资本形成。因此，婚姻支付的后果具有深远影响。其福利效应关键取决于转移的方向、婚后谁保留对转移财产的控制权，以及这些支付所嵌入的更广泛的法律和社会制度。在某些情境下，婚姻转移可以增强女性的经济安全和议价能力；在其他情境下，则可能加剧性别不平等、暴力、胁迫、男孩偏好以及对女性自主权的限制。这些福利后果的重要性值得政策制定者关注。相应地，婚姻支付引发了大量争论和持续的法律改革努力。同时，婚姻支付体系的多样性提示公共政策设计需谨慎。全面禁止或外部强加的改革可能忽视这些制度所履行的多重功能，并可能产生意外后果。更有前景的方法可能是聚焦于减轻特定有害特征，同时保留家庭所珍视的功能，尤其是在婚姻支付仍深深嵌入当地社会、经济和法律体系的地区。
url:ab408d99af2514d5.title: The Economics of Marriage Payments: Bride Price, Dowry, and Dower
url:ab408d99af2514d5.title_zh: 婚姻支付的经济学：聘礼、嫁妆与寡妇产

url:ab5355a3c0e97ced.abstract: Institutions persisting from colonial rule affect the spatial structure and conditions under which 100’s of millions of people live in Sub-Saharan African cities. In a sample of 318 cities, Francophone cities have more compact development than Anglophone, overall, in older colonial sections, and at clear extensive margins long after the colonial era. Compactness covers intensity of land use, gridiron road structures, and leapfrogging of new developments. Why the difference? Under British indirect and dual mandate rule, colonial and native sections developed without coordination. In contrast, integrated city planning and land allocation were featured in French direct rule. These differences in planning traditions persist.
url:ab5355a3c0e97ced.abstract_zh: 殖民时期延续下来的制度影响着撒哈拉以南非洲城市中数亿人口居住的空间结构与环境条件。在对318个城市的样本分析中，法语区城市相较于英语区城市，在整体上、老殖民区域以及殖民时代结束很久后的明显扩展边缘地带，均展现出更为紧凑的发展形态。紧凑性涵盖土地利用强度、棋盘式道路结构以及新开发区域的跳跃式扩展情况。为何存在这种差异？在英国间接统治及双重委任统治下，殖民区与本地区域的发展缺乏协调。相反，法国直接统治则强调统一的城市规划与土地分配。这些规划传统的差异延续至今。
url:ab5355a3c0e97ced.title: Colonial legacies: Shaping African cities
url:ab5355a3c0e97ced.title_zh: 殖民遗产：塑造非洲城市

url:ab5675ceea837849.abstract: We develop a framework to compare the relative effectiveness of subsidizing alternative emission-reducing technologies. We show that an intermediate technology may reduce emissions more effectively than the cleanest technology if it induces sufficiently greater substitution away from the prevailing high-emission technology. We apply the framework to the South Korean passenger vehicle market using a demand model that incorporates mileage heterogeneity, an important determinant of fuel-type choice. First, reallocating existing subsidies from battery electric vehicles (BEVs), the cleanest technology, to hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs), an intermediate technology, would reduce total greenhouse gas emissions by an additional 47\%. Second, for a BEV-focused subsidy policy to outperform an HEV-focused policy, the carbon intensity of electricity generation would need to fall by approximately 45\%. Our findings suggest that HEV subsidies remain more effective than BEV subsidies until consumers become sufficiently willing to switch to BEVs or electricity generation becomes sufficiently decarbonized.
url:ab5675ceea837849.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析框架，用于比较补贴不同减排技术的相对有效性。研究表明，若中间技术能显著促使消费者从当前高排放技术转向该技术，其减排效果可能优于最清洁技术。我们将该框架应用于韩国乘用车市场，采用了一个考虑里程异质性（影响燃料类型选择的关键因素）的需求模型。研究发现：第一，将现有补贴从最清洁的纯电动汽车（BEV）重新分配至中间技术的混合动力汽车（HEV），可使温室气体总排放量额外降低47%；第二，若要使以BEV为核心的补贴政策效果优于以HEV为核心的政策，电力生产的碳强度需下降约45%。结论表明，在消费者对BEV的转换意愿足够强烈或电力生产实现充分脱碳之前，HEV补贴始终比BEV补贴更有效。
url:ab5675ceea837849.title: DP21757 Which Green Technology to Subsidize? Evidence from Electric Vehicles in South Korea

url:ab996f361862e091.abstract: This paper examines how homeownership status shapes attention to inflation and its impact on durable consumption. Using randomized controlled trials on U.S. households (2021–2023), we document systematic heterogeneity in responses to inflation-related information. Homeowners exhibit greater baseline awareness and update their expectations less than renters. Exploiting exogenous variation in inflation expectations induced by the treatments, we find that homeowners adjust durable spending significantly, whereas renters do not. These results highlight homeownership as a key factor in the formation of inflation expectations and their influence on economic behavior.
url:ab996f361862e091.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了住房所有权状态如何影响对通货膨胀的关注及其对耐用品消费的影响。通过对美国家庭（2021-2023年）进行随机对照试验，我们记录了与通胀相关信息反应中的系统性异质性。房主表现出更高的基线认知度，并且其预期调整幅度小于租户。利用由实验处理引起的外生通胀预期变化，我们发现房主显著调整耐用品支出，而租户则未作调整。这些结果凸显了住房所有权在通胀预期形成及其对经济行为影响中的关键作用。

url:abd5fd538cb00072.abstract: Macroprudential policy is designed to make the financial system safer, but it can also reshape the finance available to innovative firms. Using patent data matched to 2,844 firms in 21 European countries over 1990-2021, this column finds that macroprudential tightening is followed by lower patenting and lower patent quality. The effect is strongest when credit growth is weak and among financially constrained firms, and it is concentrated in instruments that directly restrict credit. By contrast, financial-resilience tools carry no measurable short-run innovation cost and may support innovation over longer horizons. The findings suggest that policymakers can protect financial stability without systematically penalising innovation, provided they are selective about which instruments they deploy.
url:abd5fd538cb00072.abstract_zh: 宏观审慎政策旨在提升金融体系的安全性，但同时也可能重塑创新型企业可获得的融资环境。本文利用1990年至2021年间覆盖21个欧洲国家2844家企业的专利数据，发现宏观审慎政策的收紧伴随着专利申请数量及专利质量的下降。这一效应在信贷增长疲软时期及面临融资约束的企业中尤为显著，且主要集中在直接限制信贷的工具上。相比之下，金融韧性工具在短期内未带来可测的创新成本，并可能在更长时期内支持创新活动。研究结果表明，政策制定者能够在保障金融稳定的同时，避免系统性抑制创新，前提是审慎选择所采用的工具类型。

url:ac02d41149e2cca0.abstract: Why do some cultures go extinct while others prevail? In this paper, we show that a society's risk of cultural extinction, proxied by language loss, is shaped by its ancestral gender norms and by how these norms differ from those of competing cultures. Using the Ethnologue and the Male Dominance Index for a global sample of languages, we start by showing that languages from more gender-equal societies face a higher likelihood of extinction than those from male-dominant societies. We propose a conceptual framework in which male-dominant societies are more expansionist via two channels: (i) military capacity sustained through surplus extraction, and (ii) demographic pressure through women's specialization in domestic and reproductive labor. As a result, they expand at the expense of more gender-egalitarian groups. We test this prediction in two empirical settings. Leveraging European colonization as a natural experiment, we find that Indigenous societies with more gender-equal norms than their colonizers are more vulnerable to cultural extinction. We examine alternative pre-colonial societal arrangements and find that cultural extinction is best explained by asymmetries in male dominance rather than in hierarchy or dominance more broadly. Exploiting local variation in neighboring groups' gender structure across Africa, we further show that languages from gender-egalitarian societies are less likely to survive in grid cells located close to male-dominant neighbors, with military capacity and population pressure predicting language expansion across the continent.
url:ac02d41149e2cca0.abstract_zh: 为何某些文化消亡而另一些文化存续？本文表明，一个社会文化消亡的风险（以语言丧失为代理指标）受其祖先性别规范及这些规范与竞争文化差异的影响。利用《民族语》和全球语言样本中的男性主导指数，我们首先发现，来自性别更平等社会的语言面临比来自男性主导社会语言更高的消亡可能性。我们提出一个概念框架，其中男性主导社会通过两条渠道更具扩张性：（i）通过剩余榨取维持的军事能力，及（ii）通过女性在家庭和生育劳动中的专业化形成的人口压力。因此，它们以牺牲性别更平等群体为代价进行扩张。我们在两个实证环境中检验这一预测。利用欧洲殖民作为自然实验，我们发现，与殖民者相比性别规范更平等的原住民社会更易遭受文化消亡。我们考察了前殖民时期的其他社会安排，发现文化消亡最好由男性主导的不对称性而非等级制或更广泛的主导性来解释。利用非洲相邻群体性别结构的局部差异，我们进一步表明，来自性别平等社会的语言在靠近男性主导邻居的网格单元中存续可能性较低，而军事能力和人口压力可预测整个大陆的语言扩张。
url:ac02d41149e2cca0.title: DP21906 Male Dominance and Cultural Extinction
url:ac02d41149e2cca0.title_zh: DP21906 男性主导与文化消亡

url:ac1306993af194fb.abstract: We study how entrepreneurs respond to investment opportunities created by new technologies. Using the staggered rollout of broadband internet in Norway as a natural experiment, we find that access to the new technology increases startup rates by about 25% without reducing their quality. The effects are strongest in ICT-intensive industries, and treated entrepreneurs are more likely to invest in complementary assets such as computers. Consistent with existing literature, established firms show a more muted response to the new technology. Our findings suggest that entrepreneurs play a key role in adapting the economy to technological change.
url:ac1306993af194fb.abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业家如何应对新技术带来的投资机会。利用挪威宽带互联网分阶段推广作为自然实验，我们发现新技术的接入使创业率提高了约25%，且并未降低创业质量。这一效应在ICT密集型行业最为显著，受技术影响的企业家更倾向于投资计算机等互补性资产。与现有文献一致，现有企业对新技术反应较为平缓。研究结果表明，企业家在推动经济适应技术变革中发挥着关键作用。
url:ac1306993af194fb.title: New Technology and Entrepreneurship

url:ac13bae7a2377a3e.abstract: Quantitative easing has faced recent criticism for causing large central bank losses and contributing to the post-COVID inflation, raising the question of under what conditions it may be warranted as a tool to fight recessions. This column employs a model that allows for an empirically realistic account of the key transmission mechanisms of quantitative easing and finds significant macroeconomic and fiscal benefits of using it to fight recessions when inflation is expected to remain well below the central bank’s target for a protracted period. However, there is reason for caution when deploying it in shallow recessions where it runs more risk of causing the economy to overheat.
url:ac13bae7a2377a3e.abstract_zh: 量化宽松政策近期因导致央行巨额亏损及助长疫情后通胀而受到批评，这引发了一个问题：在何种条件下，该政策可作为应对衰退的合理工具。本文采用了一个能够对量化宽松关键传导机制进行符合实证现实的建模分析，发现当通胀预期将在较长时间内持续远低于央行目标时，运用量化宽松应对衰退可带来显著的宏观经济与财政效益。然而，在浅度衰退中部署该政策需保持谨慎，因其更易引发经济过热风险。
url:ac13bae7a2377a3e.title: Rethinking the use of quantitative easing for macro stimulus
url:ac13bae7a2377a3e.title_zh: 重新思考量化宽松用于宏观刺激的作用

url:ac1ebc53fd0b9937.abstract: this paper we solve a particular type of stochastic process switching problem where the terminal date is fixed but the terminal price may depend on past prices. We apply this framework to the effect of various conversion modalities currently discussed on exchange rate dynamics in the transition phase towards Stage III of EMU. The conclusions from our analysis may provide guidelines not only for the initial EMU members, but also for the countries that join at a later stage.
url:ac1ebc53fd0b9937.abstract_zh: 本文解决了一类特定的随机过程转换问题，其中终止日期固定，但终止价格可能取决于历史价格。我们将这一框架应用于当前讨论的各种转换模式对欧洲经济货币联盟第三阶段过渡期内汇率动态的影响。分析结论不仅可为初始欧洲经济货币联盟成员国提供指导，也可为后续加入的国家提供参考。
url:ac1ebc53fd0b9937.title: Stochastic Process Switching and Stage III of EMU
url:ac1ebc53fd0b9937.title_zh: 随机过程转换与欧洲货币联盟第三阶段

url:ac264e205a20758d.abstract: This paper shows that sovereign bond spreads are shaped not only by absolute debt levels but also by a country’s relative debt position within its peer group. Using panel fixed effects for over 80 emerging and developing economies over 1993-2024, we find that relative debt—especially benchmarked by income and commodity status—has greater explanatory power for spreads than gross debt alone. A one–standard deviation increase in relative debt raises spreads by roughly 0.2–0.3 standard deviations, comparable in magnitude to global risk indicators. Similarly, a 10 percent increase in relative debt is associated with a 3.8 percent increase in sovereign spreads, all else equal. The effect of relative debt is state-dependent, being stronger in countries with better institutions, access to concessional lending, and during periods of low risk aversion and ample global liquidity. These results hold across alternative specifications, sample periods, methodologies, and controls, which underscores the comparative nature of investor assessments and the importance of benchmarking for fiscal policy, debt management, and international surveillance.
url:ac264e205a20758d.abstract_zh: 本文表明，主权债券利差不仅受绝对债务水平影响，还取决于一国在其同类国家中的相对债务位置。基于1993-2024年间80多个新兴经济体和发展中经济体的面板固定效应模型，我们发现相对债务——尤其是以收入和商品类别为基准衡量的相对债务——对利差的解释力强于总债务。相对债务每增加一个标准差，利差约上升0.2-0.3个标准差，其影响幅度与全球风险指标相当。类似地，在其他条件不变的情况下，相对债务每增加10%，主权利差将上升3.8%。相对债务的影响具有状态依赖性：在制度质量较高、可获得优惠贷款的国家，以及全球风险规避程度较低、流动性充裕的时期，其效应更为显著。上述结论在替代设定、样本区间、方法论及控制变量下均保持稳健，凸显了投资者评估的比较属性，以及基准化分析对财政政策、债务管理和国际监督的重要性。
url:ac264e205a20758d.title: Peer Pressure: How Relative Debt Drives Emerging Market Sovereign Spreads
url:ac264e205a20758d.title_zh: 同伴压力：相对债务如何驱动新兴市场主权利差

url:ac55c6fb70ba75b3.title: Can Cash Transfers Save Lives? Evidence from a Large-Scale Experiment in Kenya
url:ac55c6fb70ba75b3.title_zh: 现金转移能否拯救生命？来自肯尼亚大规模实验的证据

url:ac5c245876583cad.abstract: This paper investigates the drivers of labor productivity growth in the Nordic countries, using both sectoral and firm-level data over the period 2000–2024. The sectoral analysis documents a broad-based slowdown in labor productivity growth, driven primarily by within-industry developments rather than shifts in the sectoral composition of employment. Firm-level evidence shows that productivity growth is increasingly concentrated among frontier firms—the most productive firms within each industry—while the rest of the firm distribution (“laggards”) has experienced weak or stagnant productivity growth. A decomposition of frontier productivity growth reveals that gains among incumbent frontier firms account for most productivity growth at the frontier across countries. The contribution of net firm entry is highly heterogeneous, and is positive mainly in countries where young entering firms exhibit strong productivity momentum upon joining the frontier. The paper finds evidence of productivity diffusion from frontier to laggard firms but shows that the speed of diffusion has declined since the 2010s. The slower diffusion is closely associated with rising persistence at the productivity frontier: when the same firms remain at the frontier for longer periods, opportunities for laggards to catch up are reduced. Overall, the findings highlight that sustaining aggregate productivity growth hinges not only on innovation at the frontier but also on firm dynamism—particularly entry, exit, and turnover at the frontier—to ensure that productivity gains diffuse broadly across the economy.
url:ac5c245876583cad.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2000年至2024年间北欧国家劳动生产率增长的驱动因素，利用部门与企业层面的数据进行分析。部门分析揭示了劳动生产率增长普遍放缓的现象，这一趋势主要由行业内发展动态所驱动，而非就业部门构成的变化所致。企业层面的证据表明，生产率增长日益集中于各行业内的前沿企业——即最具生产力的企业，而其余企业分布（“落后者”）则经历了疲弱或停滞的生产率增长。对前沿生产率增长的分解显示，现有前沿企业的收益贡献了各国前沿生产率增长的大部分。净企业进入的贡献高度异质，主要在对加入前沿的年轻进入企业展现出强劲生产率动力的国家中表现为正效应。本文发现了从前沿企业向落后企业扩散生产率的证据，但指出自2010年代以来扩散速度有所下降。较慢的扩散与生产率前沿持久性的上升密切相关：当同一批企业长期占据前沿位置时，落后者追赶的机会减少。总体而言，研究结果强调，维持总体生产率增长不仅依赖于前沿的创新，还依赖于企业活力——尤其是前沿的进入、退出和更替——以确保生产率收益在整个经济中广泛扩散。
url:ac5c245876583cad.title: Labor Productivity Growth in the Nordics: The Roles of Frontier Firms and Diffusion
url:ac5c245876583cad.title_zh: 北欧劳动生产率的增长：前沿企业与技术扩散的作用

url:ac699d29ae12a136.abstract: Networks can help political actors survive violence in revolutions. Connections could protect against reprisals and provide information. However, personal networks are not randomly assigned, making it difficult to causally trace their role. The French Constituent Assembly of 1789 randomly assigned legislators to smaller groups, which we use to assess outcomes in the ensuing revolution such as violent death and emigration. Violent death was contagious among the nobility in these networks. However, connections to two key leaders, Lafayette and Robespierre, were protective against violent death, encouraging emigration, regardless of ideological differences. We argue that nobles drew an informational advantage from their connections.
url:ac699d29ae12a136.abstract_zh: 网络在革命中有助于政治行动者幸存。人际关系可以提供保护，避免报复，并传递信息。然而，个人网络并非随机分配，这使得因果追踪其作用变得困难。1789年法国制宪议会将立法者随机分配到较小的小组中，我们利用这一安排来评估随后革命中的结果，如暴力死亡和流亡。在这些网络中，暴力死亡在贵族中具有传染性。然而，与两位关键领导人拉法耶特和罗伯斯庇尔的联系，则对暴力死亡具有保护作用，并鼓励了流亡，无论意识形态差异如何。我们认为，贵族从这些联系中获得了信息优势。
url:ac699d29ae12a136.title: DP21171 Random Connections and Violence in the French Revolution
url:ac699d29ae12a136.title_zh: DP21171 随机联系与法国大革命中的暴力

url:ac7bdc2c53350c0c.abstract: We consider a medium-scale macroeconomic model where the zero lower bound on interest rates remains binding permanently. We estimate the model for the Japanese economy, encompassing both active and passive fiscal policy scenarios. Our findings reveal a predominantly passive fiscal policy stance during the period spanning from 1995 to 2023. We compute fiscal multipliers for various policy instruments, showing that under the backdrop of passive fiscal policy: i) multipliers are lower than in an active fiscal policy regime; ii) government spending multipliers remain below one; iii) tax reductions can be associated with a decrease in output and inflation. A counterfactual analysis suggests that a more active fiscal policy would have resulted in a higher price level without increasing output volatility.
url:ac7bdc2c53350c0c.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个中等规模的宏观经济模型，其中利率零下限永久性具有约束力。我们利用日本经济数据对该模型进行估计，涵盖了积极与消极财政政策两种情景。研究结果表明，在1995年至2023年期间，日本主要采取消极财政政策立场。我们计算了不同政策工具的财政乘数，发现在消极财政政策背景下：（i）乘数低于积极财政政策体制；（ii）政府支出乘数始终小于1；（iii）减税可能导致产出与通胀下降。反事实分析表明，若采取更积极的财政政策，将实现更高的价格水平，且不会增加产出波动性。
url:ac7bdc2c53350c0c.title: Fiscal Policy in a Permanent Liquidity Trap: Evidence from Japan
url:ac7bdc2c53350c0c.title_zh: 永久流动性陷阱中的财政政策：来自日本的证据

url:ac7ed6e2d1d16599.title: A Simple Measure of Robustness for External Validity under Covariate Shifts
url:ac7ed6e2d1d16599.title_zh: 协变量偏移下外部有效性的一个简单稳健性度量

url:ac8fb44addb0f588.title: You’d be hard to replace: Provider competition in narrow network insurance markets
url:ac8fb44addb0f588.title_zh: 难以替代：窄网络保险市场中的提供者竞争

url:ac949bcb460d19ee.abstract: We compare employment and wage polarization in the U.S. using different sample periods and the inclusion or not of agricultural occupations, reporting three main findings. First, a similar degree of employment polarization can emerge together or without wage polarization, depending on the sample period considered. Next, we show that removing agricultural occupations from the sample dramatically changes the results with respect to the case in which these are included: i) wage polarization emerges and the degree of employment polarization increases and ii) the timing of employment polarization changes, and some U-shape of changes in employment shares is observed before 1980.
url:ac949bcb460d19ee.abstract_zh: 我们比较了美国就业与工资极化现象，采用不同样本期间及是否包含农业职业，得出三项主要发现。首先，相似的就业极化程度可能伴随或不伴随工资极化出现，这取决于所考察的样本期间。其次，我们表明，从样本中剔除农业职业会显著改变结果，与包含这些职业的情况相比：i) 工资极化显现，且就业极化程度增强；ii) 就业极化的时间节点发生变化，且在1980年前观察到就业份额变化的某些U型形态。
url:ac949bcb460d19ee.title: A Note on Employment and Wage Polarization in the U.S.
url:ac949bcb460d19ee.title_zh: 关于美国就业与工资两极化的一个注记

url:ac9a2461a86509ca.abstract: We study how regional heterogeneity shapes the aggregate transmission of monetary policy and its distributional implications across space. We build a multi-region Heterogeneous-Agent New Keynesian model with 3,140 U.S. counties and cross-county differences in (i) intertemporal Marginal Propensities to Consume (MPCs) and (ii) non-tradable employment shares. We analytically characterize the nationwide consumption response to monetary policy in terms of the joint distribution of (i) and (ii). Using U.S. and Italian micro-data, we construct novel empirical measures of regional MPCs to validate our theory. Quantitatively, geographic heterogeneity leads to large distributional consequences of monetary policy across space and can sizably amplify its aggregate effects.
url:ac9a2461a86509ca.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了区域异质性如何塑造货币政策的总体传导及其在空间上的分配效应。我们构建了一个包含美国3140个县的多区域异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型，并考虑了跨县差异：(i)跨期边际消费倾向(MPCs)与(ii)非贸易部门就业份额。我们从理论上刻画了全国消费对货币政策的响应，该响应取决于(i)与(ii)的联合分布。利用美国和意大利的微观数据，我们构建了新颖的区域MPC实证度量以验证我们的理论。在量化层面，地理异质性导致货币政策在空间上产生显著的分配后果，并可能大幅放大其总体效应。
url:ac9a2461a86509ca.title: DP21076 The Regional Keynesian Cross
url:ac9a2461a86509ca.title_zh: DP21076 区域凯恩斯交叉模型

url:acaaa81fdf83bda9.abstract: We compare the informativeness of order statistics in a sample of conditionally independent draws from a distribution F(x|θ) as the sample size n increases. The k-th highest of n+1 draws is more accurate than the k-th highest of n if and only if the cumulative reverse hazard − log F(x|θ) is log-supermodular. Symmetrically, the k-th lowest is more accurate if and only if the cumulative hazard − log (1−F(x|θ)) is log-supermodular. Reversals are exceptional, occurring only for experiments that are, up to increasing transformations, exponential location experiments. In large samples, middle order statistics are asymptotically fully informative, while bounded lower and upper ranks require unbounded informativeness tail conditions. When full learning fails, bounded ranks converge to location experiments, and more central ranks are Blackwell more informative. Extending the analysis from scalar order statistics to blocks of selected data, we obtain multidimensional comparisons under log-supermodularity of hazard rates. The results unify and extend information-aggregation results in auctions and provide a new order-statistic approach to strategic voting.
url:acaaa81fdf83bda9.abstract_zh: 我们比较了在条件独立抽样分布F(x|θ)中，随着样本量n增大，顺序统计量的信息含量。当且仅当累积逆风险函数−log F(x|θ)为对数超模时，n+1次抽样中的第k高顺序统计量比n次抽样中的第k高顺序统计量更精确。对称地，当且仅当累积风险函数−log (1−F(x|θ))为对数超模时，第k低顺序统计量更精确。反转情况极为罕见，仅出现在经过递增变换后等价于指数位置实验的实验中。在大样本条件下，中间顺序统计量渐近地具有完全信息含量，而有限的下界和上界秩次则需要无界信息含量尾部条件。当完全学习失效时，有界秩次收敛于位置实验，且更中心的秩次在Blackwell意义上具有更高信息含量。将分析从标量顺序统计量扩展至选定数据块后，我们在风险率对数超模条件下获得了多维比较结果。这些结论统一并拓展了拍卖中的信息聚合结果，并为策略性投票提供了新的顺序统计量分析方法。
url:acaaa81fdf83bda9.title: DP21759 Information Comparison of Order Statistics, with Applications to Auctions and Voting
url:acaaa81fdf83bda9.title_zh: DP21759 顺序统计量的信息比较及其在拍卖与投票中的应用

url:acb0d9785080832e.abstract: Fertility has fallen in nearly all high-income countries. People also report wanting fewer children: between 2012 and 2022 the ideal number of children fell from 2.42 to 2.31 and the share of respondents intending a child within three years fell from 28 to 21 percent over a similar period. Why? Using two cross-national surveys that ask respondents about their attitudes and their fertility preferences, both fielded twice roughly a decade apart, we decompose each decline into the contribution of a broad and competing set of attitudes. Three stand out: children are increasingly seen as interfering with the freedom of parents; views on whether mothers of young children should work have become markedly more progressive and account for a substantially larger share of the decline among the tertiary-educated; and fewer people believe that women or men need children to lead a fulfilled life. This last attitude changed most over the decade and is the largest contributor to the fall in intended fertility, above all among less-educated women. The changing division of household work and increasing work-family conflict have minor contributions to changing fertility preferences.
url:acb0d9785080832e.abstract_zh: 几乎所有高收入国家的生育率均有所下降。人们也报告称希望生育更少的孩子：从2012年到2022年，理想子女数从2.42降至2.31，而在相近时期内，表示三年内有意生育孩子的受访者比例从28%降至21%。原因何在？利用两项跨国调查，这些调查询问受访者的态度和生育偏好，且每项调查均相隔约十年进行了两次，我们将每次下降分解为一系列广泛且相互竞争的态度所贡献的部分。其中三项态度尤为突出：孩子日益被视为妨碍父母自由；对于年幼孩子的母亲是否应工作的看法显著趋于进步，且在高等教育程度群体中，这一态度对下降的贡献占比明显更大；以及越来越少的人认为，无论男女，都需要孩子才能过上充实的生活。最后一种态度在十年间变化最大，并且是导致预期生育率下降的最大因素，尤其是在教育程度较低的女性中。家务分工的变化以及工作与家庭冲突的加剧，对生育偏好变化的影响较小。
url:acb0d9785080832e.title: DP21864 Falling Fertility: The Changing Value of Freedom, Fulfillment, and Family
url:acb0d9785080832e.title_zh: DP21864 生育率下降：自由、成就与家庭价值的变迁

url:acb6ed1ea09bdd55.title: How does demand switch affect newsvendor’s inventory decisions?
url:acb6ed1ea09bdd55.title_zh: 需求转换如何影响报童的库存决策？

url:acb8650d6f0a4ca1.abstract: This paper analyzes 630,000 paintings from 1400 onward to uncover how visual art reflects its socioeconomic context. We develop a learning algorithm to predict nine basic emotions conveyed in each painting and isolate a context effect — the emotional signal shared across artworks created in the same location and year — controlling for artist, genre, and epoch-specific influences. These emotion distributions encode subtle but meaningful information about the living standards, uncertainty, or inequality characterizing the context in which the artworks were produced. We propose this emotion-based measure, derived from historical artworks, as a novel lens to examine how societies experienced major socioeconomic transformations, including climate variability, trade dynamics, technological change, shifts in knowledge production, and political transitions.
url:acb8650d6f0a4ca1.abstract_zh: 本文分析了自1400年以来63万幅绘画作品，旨在揭示视觉艺术如何反映其社会经济背景。我们开发了一种学习算法，用以预测每幅画作传达的九种基本情绪，并分离出情境效应——即在同一地点和年份创作的艺术品间共享的情绪信号，同时控制艺术家、流派及时代特定影响。这些情绪分布编码了关于创作这些艺术品所处情境的生活水平、不确定性或不平等性的微妙而有意义的信息。我们提出这一基于历史艺术品的情绪度量，作为新颖视角，用以考察社会如何经历重大社会经济转型，包括气候变异、贸易动态、技术变革、知识生产转变及政治过渡。
url:acb8650d6f0a4ca1.title: State of the Art: Economic Development Through the Lens of Paintings

url:acc81488d7fb469b.abstract: Human actions can alter the climate via land use. We analyze the 1930s Great Plains Shelterbelt, a large-scale forestation program across the US Midwest. The program increased precipitation and decreased temperatures for decades. We measure these changes in downwind counties where no trees were planted, isolating the effects of climate from those of afforestation and enabling us to study adaptation. Improved growing conditions allowed farmers to expand corn acreage and adopt water-intensive practices. In a period of farm consolidation, this altered the structure of the agricultural sector, contributing to the survival of small farms but less farm machine usage. The findings demonstrate the endogeneity of climate to land use change and the long-term impacts of tree planting on agricultural development.
url:acc81488d7fb469b.abstract_zh: 人类活动可通过土地利用改变气候。我们分析了20世纪30年代大平原防护林带——一项横跨美国中西部的规模化植树造林项目。该项目在数十年间增加了降水并降低了气温。我们测量了未植树的下风县中的这些变化，从而将气候效应与造林效应分离开来，并使我们能够研究适应性行为。改善的生长条件使农民得以扩大玉米种植面积并采用耗水型耕作方式。在农场整合时期，这改变了农业部门的结构，促进了小农场的存续，但减少了对农业机械的使用。研究结果表明，气候对土地利用变化具有内生性，且植树对农业发展具有长期影响。

url:ace73f7d6b9939f3.abstract: We study the effect of ambiguity on timing decisions. An agent faces a stopping problem with an uncertain stopping payoff and a stochastic time limit. The agent is unsure about the correct model quantifying the uncertainty and seeks to maximize her payoff guarantee over a set of plausible models. As time passes and the agent updates, the worst-case model used to evaluate a given strategy can change, creating a problem of dynamic inconsistency. We characterize the stopping behavior in this environment and show that, while the agent's myopic incentives are fragile to small changes in the set of considered models, the best consistent plan from which no future self has incentives to deviate is robust.
url:ace73f7d6b9939f3.abstract_zh: 我们研究了模糊性对时机决策的影响。代理人面临一个具有不确定终止收益和随机时间限制的停止问题。代理人不确定量化不确定性的正确模型，并试图在一组合理模型中最大化其收益保障。随着时间推移和代理人更新信息，用于评估给定策略的最坏情况模型可能发生变化，从而产生动态不一致性问题。我们刻画了这种环境下的停止行为，并表明：尽管代理人的短视激励对考虑模型集的微小变化较为脆弱，但未来自我没有动机偏离的最佳一致计划具有稳健性。

url:ad19e6b09ce70879.abstract: We study whether AI methods applied to large-scale portfolio holdings data can improve macroprudential financial regulation. We build a graph-based deep learning model tailored to security-level data on the holdings of financial intermediaries. The architecture incorporates economic priors and learns latent representations of both assets and investors from the network structure of portfolio positions. Applied to the universe of non-bank financial intermediaries, covering nearly $40 trillion in wealth, the model substantially outperforms existing approaches in out-of-sample forecasts of intermediary trading behavior, including in crisis episodes. The model has more than ten times the explanatory power for the cross-sectional variation in asset returns during stress events compared to traditional approaches, and it outperforms existing systemic risk metrics at the institution level. Its learned representations show that the holdings network encodes rich, economically interpretable information about fire- sale vulnerability. The architecture is fully inductive, producing informative estimates even when entire asset classes or investors are withheld from training. We embed our empirical approach into a macroprudential optimal policy framework to formalize why these objects matter for policy and welfare. We show that even in an equilibrium environment subject to the Lucas critique, the predictive information from the model improves welfare by sharpening the cross-sectional targeting of policy interventions, and we demonstrate a complementarity between prediction and structural knowledge.
url:ad19e6b09ce70879.abstract_zh: 本文研究人工智能方法应用于大规模投资组合持仓数据能否改善宏观审慎金融监管。我们构建了一个基于图的深度学习模型，专门针对金融中介机构持有的证券级数据。该模型架构融合了经济先验知识，通过投资组合持仓的网络结构学习资产与投资者的潜在表征。将该模型应用于覆盖近40万亿美元财富的非银行金融中介机构全样本后，其在预测中介交易行为（包括危机时期）的样本外表现显著优于现有方法。在压力事件期间，该模型对资产收益率截面变异的解释力是传统方法的十倍以上，且在机构层面优于现有系统性风险指标。模型习得的表征表明，持仓网络编码了关于抛售脆弱性的丰富且具有经济可解释性的信息。该架构具有完全归纳能力，即便在训练数据中完全剔除某类资产或投资者时，仍能产生具有信息量的估计结果。我们将实证方法嵌入宏观审慎最优政策框架，以形式化论证这些变量对政策与福利的重要性。研究表明，即使在面临卢卡斯批判的均衡环境中，该模型的预测信息通过强化政策干预的截面精准度提升了社会福利，并揭示了预测能力与结构性知识之间的互补关系。

url:ad65984ec9349235.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between borderlands and political violence in Africa. Do African conflicts relocate or expand across borders? Using spatiotemporal data on conflict events from 1997 to 2024 alongside the innovative OECD/SWAC Spatial Conflict Dynamics indicator (SCDi), the paper suggests that borderlands experience more conflict than non-borderlands. Approximately half of all violent events occur within 100 km of a border. In Africa, political violence also tends to decrease very rapidly with distance from borders. The proportion of violent events recorded in borderlands varies over time and mirrors the cycles of violence that affect specific regions. This share was very high in the early 2000s due to the wars in the Gulf of Guinea and the Great Lakes region. It then declined for less than a decade before increasing substantially in the 2010s. Finally, the paper demonstrates that when conflicts diffuse across borders, they tend to occupy a greater spatial extent rather than simply moving from one side of the border to the other. These findings suggest that more policy efforts should be devoted to monitor the circulation of armed groups across West African borders.
url:ad65984ec9349235.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了非洲边境地区与政治暴力之间的关系。非洲冲突是否会跨境转移或扩散？利用1997年至2024年冲突事件的时空数据，并结合创新的OECD/SWAC空间冲突动态指标（SCDi），本文发现边境地区比非边境地区经历更多冲突。约半数暴力事件发生在距边境100公里范围内。在非洲，政治暴力随距边境距离增加而急剧减少。边境地区记录的暴力事件比例随时间变化，并反映了影响特定区域的暴力周期。由于几内亚湾和大湖地区的战争，这一比例在21世纪初非常高；随后下降不到十年，在2010年代又大幅上升。最后，本文证明，当冲突跨境扩散时，它们往往占据更大的空间范围，而非简单地从边境一侧转移到另一侧。这些发现表明，应投入更多政策努力来监测西非边境地区武装团体的流动。
url:ad65984ec9349235.title: Political violence in African borderlands
url:ad65984ec9349235.title_zh: 非洲边境地区的政治暴力

url:ad6d8de554f7858c.abstract: In hedonic studies of how environmental disamenities influence house prices, the homes that are treated are typically unknown. We propose a new method for defining treatment buffers and apply our technique to disamenities that have thus far received little attention: surface coal mines. Our leave-one-out cross-validation approach identifies an optimal buffer of 2,300 m in two Appalachian counties at which effects dissipate. Hedonic regressions indicate that treated homes sell for 15.5% less than untreated homes. We supplement these results with nearest-neighbor covariate matching models and recover average treatment effects on the treated of 14.7% price reductions. JEL Q32C21
url:ad6d8de554f7858c.abstract_zh: 在关于环境不利因素如何影响房价的特征价格研究中，受处理的房屋通常是未知的。我们提出了一种定义处理缓冲区的新方法，并将我们的技术应用于迄今较少受到关注的不利因素：露天煤矿。我们的留一交叉验证方法在两个阿巴拉契亚县识别出最优缓冲区为2300米，在此范围内效应逐渐消散。特征价格回归表明，受处理房屋的售价较未受处理房屋低15.5%。我们通过最近邻协变量匹配模型补充这些结果，并得出受处理组的平均处理效应为价格下降14.7%。JEL Q32C21

url:ad862a2e72f4711e.abstract: As populations in rich countries age and fewer youngsters enter the labour force, employers and politicians bemoan labour ‘shortages’. This column turns to historical evidence to highlight why governments should learn to love labour shortages. Between 1792 and 1815, as Britain and France fought each other for global dominance, more than one out of every ten British men ended up in the army or navy, resulting in acute labour shortages and upward pressure on wages. The authors show how this labour scarcity and a skill abundance complemented each other in driving technology diffusion, boosting British productivity in the long run.
url:ad862a2e72f4711e.abstract_zh: 随着富裕国家人口老龄化及年轻劳动力减少，雇主和政界人士纷纷抱怨劳动力"短缺"。本文通过历史证据揭示政府为何应学会拥抱劳动力短缺。1792年至1815年间，当英法为争夺全球霸权而战时，超过十分之一的英国男性最终服役于陆军或海军，导致严重劳动力短缺并推高工资水平。作者论证了这种劳动力稀缺与技能充裕如何相互促进，推动技术扩散，最终在长期内提升了英国的生产率。

url:adbb8cd39b305c1c.abstract: Public goods are meant to be universal, but they are inherently place-based. This paper systematically measures spatial access to public goods and quantifies the implications of distance to public facilities for income inequality. First, we map all schools and hospitals across Belgium. We compute the distance to facilities for each of the 20, 000 neighborhoods and document large spatial inequalities in access to public facilities. Second, we find that this unequal distribution favors high-income neighborhoods: allocating public goods spending proportionally to our access index increases income inequality compared to measures based solely on disposable income. Third, we show that the positive relationship between income and access can be rationalized by a simple model of public goods allocation with an inequality-neutral social planner. Finally, we provide evidence that access is strongly correlated with educational and health outcomes, emphasizing the need to consider the place-based nature of public goods when measuring inequality.
url:adbb8cd39b305c1c.abstract_zh: 公共物品本应具有普遍性，但其本质上却具有地域性。本文系统衡量了公共物品的空间可达性，并量化了距离公共设施远近对收入不平等的影响。首先，我们绘制了比利时所有学校和医院的地图，计算了2万个社区中每个社区到设施的距离，并记录了公共设施可达性方面的巨大空间不平等。其次，我们发现这种不平等分布有利于高收入社区：与仅基于可支配收入的衡量标准相比，按我们的可达性指数比例分配公共物品支出会增加收入不平等。第三，我们证明收入与可达性之间的正相关关系可以通过一个具有不平等中立社会规划者的简单公共物品分配模型来合理化。最后，我们提供的证据表明，可达性与教育和健康结果密切相关，强调在衡量不平等时需要考虑公共物品的地域性特征。
url:adbb8cd39b305c1c.title: Do Public Goods Actually Reduce Inequality?

url:addb1e675df9f6f0.abstract: This paper introduces the African Debt Database (ADD) - a new, comprehensive dataset that traces both domestic and external debt instruments at a granular level. The main innovation is a detailed mapping of Africa's domestic debt markets, drawing on rich, new data extracted from government auction reports and bond prospectuses. The database covers over 50,000 individual government loans and securities issued by 54 African countries between 2000 and 2024, amounting to a total of USD 6.3 trillion in debt. For each instrument, it provides harmonized micro-level information on currency, maturity, interest rates, instrument type, and creditor. The data reveal the growing dominance of domestic debt in Africa - albeit with substantial cross-country variation. Four stylized facts stand out: (i) the rapid expansion of domestic debt markets, especially in middle-income countries; (ii) the wide dispersion in borrowing costs and real interest rates; (iii) large cross-country differences in maturity structures and associated rollover risks; and (iv) a rising debt-service burden, particularly due to international bonds. Generally, this project shows that debt transparency is both feasible and valuable, even in data-scarce environments.
url:addb1e675df9f6f0.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了非洲债务数据库（ADD）——一个全新的、全面的数据集，该数据集以微观层面追踪了国内外债务工具。其主要创新在于，基于从政府拍卖报告和债券募集说明书中提取的丰富新数据，对非洲国内债务市场进行了详细映射。该数据库涵盖了2000年至2024年间54个非洲国家发行的超过5万笔政府贷款和证券，债务总额达6.3万亿美元。针对每项工具，它提供了关于货币、期限、利率、工具类型和债权人的统一微观层面信息。数据显示，非洲国内债务的主导地位日益增强——尽管各国之间存在显著差异。四个典型事实尤为突出：（i）国内债务市场快速扩张，尤其是在中等收入国家；（ii）借贷成本和实际利率存在广泛差异；（iii）期限结构及相关展期风险存在巨大的跨国差异；以及（iv）偿债负担不断上升，尤其是国际债券带来的负担。总体而言，本项目表明，即使在数据稀缺的环境中，债务透明度既可行又具有重要价值。
url:addb1e675df9f6f0.title: Africa's Domestic Debt Boom: Evidence from the African Debt Database
url:addb1e675df9f6f0.title_zh: 非洲国内债务激增：来自非洲债务数据库的证据

url:ade25a80619f1f9e.abstract: This paper examines whether environmental policy uncertainty undermines clean-technology investment in the United States by weakening policy-induced investment incentives. Using quarterly project-level data on U.S. greenfield investments from 2007Q1 to 2019Q1, combined with novel news-based indices that separately measure environmental policy salience and environmental policy uncertainty, we find that policy uncertainty substantially offsets the positive investment effects of environmental policy. At the aggregate level, a one-standard-deviation increase in environmental policy uncertainty eliminates roughly 75% of the policy-induced increase in the number of cleantech projects and around 50% of the increase in capital expenditure. The deterrence effect is substantially stronger for foreign than for domestic investors, consistent with greater informational frictions facing cross-border capital. These effects persist for at least two years following an uncertainty shock and are corroborated by country- and firm-level analyses, though results for capital expenditure are less robust at disaggregated levels. The findings imply that policy credibility is a first-order determinant of clean investment: an environmental policy framework that is ambitious but perceived as unstable may fail to mobilize the capital it is designed to attract. JEL Classification: Q58, F21, F23, E22
url:ade25a80619f1f9e.abstract_zh: 本文考察了环境政策不确定性是否通过削弱政策引致的投资激励，从而抑制了美国的清洁技术投资。利用2007年第一季度至2019年第一季度美国绿地投资的季度项目层面数据，并结合分别衡量环境政策显著性与环境政策不确定性的新型新闻指数，我们发现政策不确定性显著抵消了环境政策对投资的积极效应。在总体层面，环境政策不确定性每增加一个标准差，将消除约75%的政策引致的清洁技术项目数量增长，以及约50%的资本支出增长。这一威慑效应对外国投资者而言显著强于国内投资者，这与跨境资本面临更大的信息摩擦相一致。这些效应在不确定性冲击后至少持续两年，并得到国家层面和企业层面分析的佐证，尽管在细分层面资本支出的结果稳健性较弱。研究结果表明，政策可信度是清洁投资的一阶决定因素：一项雄心勃勃但被认为不稳定的环境政策框架，可能无法调动其旨在吸引的资本。JEL分类号：Q58, F21, F23, E22
url:ade25a80619f1f9e.title: Environmental policy uncertainty and cleantech FDI
url:ade25a80619f1f9e.title_zh: 环境政策不确定性与清洁技术外商直接投资

url:adecc320ecd2f0f4.abstract: Episode recorded on 19 June 2026 at the PSE-CEPR Policy Forum in Paris. Twice before, the world's savings and debts have piled up in the wrong places, and twice the imbalance broke something. The first time it took the Plaza Accord to fix it. The second time it took a global financial crisis. Now we are in a third wave. Gita Gopinath (Harvard, former IMF Chief Economist and First Deputy Managing Director) and Philip Lane (European Central Bank, CEPR) join Tim Phillips to ask what is different this time. Household and bank balance sheets are stronger than before 2008. But the fragility has moved to governments carrying much higher debt, and to non-bank financial institutions whose exposures and links to banks are only partly visible. Foreign investors hold US$40.7 trillion of US equities, 44% of world GDP outside the US, much of it riding on the AI boom. Lane's overriding principle: central banks can calm bond markets under stress, but they must be just as clear about what they will not do if debt is unsustainable.
url:adecc320ecd2f0f4.abstract_zh: 2026年6月19日，在巴黎举行的PSE-CEPR政策论坛上录制了本期节目。此前，全球储蓄与债务曾两次堆积于错误之处，两次失衡均引发危机。第一次靠《广场协议》化解，第二次则酿成全球金融危机。如今我们正经历第三次浪潮。哈佛大学、前国际货币基金组织首席经济学家兼第一副总裁吉塔·戈皮纳特与欧洲央行、CEPR的菲利普·莱恩共同探讨本次有何不同。家庭与银行资产负债表较2008年前更为稳健，但脆弱性已转移至背负更高债务的政府，以及风险敞口与银行关联仅部分可见的非银行金融机构。外国投资者持有40.7万亿美元美国股票，占美国以外全球GDP的44%，其中大量资金依托于人工智能热潮。莱恩的核心原则是：央行能够稳定承压的债券市场，但若债务不可持续，它们必须同样明确表明不会采取何种行动。
url:adecc320ecd2f0f4.title: Addressing Global Imbalances

url:adf92d76279e8dd4.abstract: We study productivity shocks in a New Keynesian model with endogenous entry, selection, and nominal rigidities. Adjustment along the extensive margin fundamentally alters the transmission of TFP shocks. Under sticky prices, productivity disturbances generate a large “entry multiplier”: firm entry-exit responds much more strongly than under flexible prices, even when output is allocatively efficient to first order. Introducing wage stickiness breaks this neutrality. Adverse TFP shocks reduce profits, trigger exit, and generate a negative output gap while remaining inflationary. Productivity shocks therefore behave as true supply shocks, without resorting to ad hoc cost-push or markup disturbances. Unlike standard markup shocks, TFP shocks in our framework imply procyclical profits and entry, consistent with the data. When wages are sufficiently sticky, expansionary monetary policy raises entry, closes the negative output gap, and improves welfare. The model remains analytically tractable and isomorphic to the standard New Keynesian framework, with entry and selection appearing as simple wedges.
url:adf92d76279e8dd4.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含内生进入、选择效应和名义刚性的新凯恩斯模型中的生产率冲击。沿扩展边际的调整从根本上改变了全要素生产率冲击的传导机制。在价格粘性条件下，生产率扰动会产生巨大的"进入乘数"效应：即使产出在一阶条件下达到配置效率，企业进入与退出对生产率冲击的反应仍远强于灵活价格情形。引入工资粘性会打破这种中性效应。不利的全要素生产率冲击会降低利润、引发企业退出，并在保持通胀压力的同时产生负向产出缺口。因此，生产率冲击无需借助特设的成本推动或加成率扰动，即可表现为真正的供给冲击。与标准加成率冲击不同，我们框架中的全要素生产率冲击意味着顺周期的利润与进入行为，这与数据特征一致。当工资粘性足够强时，扩张性货币政策能够促进企业进入、缩小负向产出缺口并提升社会福利。该模型保持解析可处理性，且与标准新凯恩斯框架同构，其中进入与选择效应以简单楔子形式呈现。

url:ae3390a643b9b3f5.abstract: This paper studies how geopolitical risk shapes financial fragmentation and international risk-sharing, using bilateral official lending data from 1910 to 2024. We document that when geopolitical risk is high, bilateral lending increasingly follows geopolitical alignment. Because geopolitically aligned countries experience more synchronized shocks, this fragmentation limits the effectiveness of international risk-sharing. To rationalize these patterns, we introduce geopolitical considerations into a limited-commitment model of sovereign borrowing. The model shows that, even with non-discriminatory default, higher geopolitical tensions redirect international lending toward allied countries and weaken risk-sharing.
url:ae3390a643b9b3f5.abstract_zh: 本文利用1910年至2024年的双边官方贷款数据，研究地缘政治风险如何塑造金融碎片化与国际风险分担。我们发现，当地缘政治风险较高时，双边贷款日益遵循地缘政治结盟。由于地缘政治结盟国家经历更为同步的冲击，这种碎片化限制了国际风险分担的有效性。为合理化这些模式，我们将地缘政治考量引入主权借款的有限承诺模型。模型表明，即使存在非歧视性违约，更高的地缘政治紧张局势也会将国际贷款引向盟国，并削弱风险分担。
url:ae3390a643b9b3f5.title: International Risk-Sharing in a Fragmented World
url:ae3390a643b9b3f5.title_zh: 碎片化世界中的国际风险分担

url:ae3b10a89da1b7b9.abstract: We estimate the causal effect of exclusionary citizenship policies on communicable disease transmission. In 2013, the Dominican Republic's Constitutional Court Ruling 168-13 retroactively revoked citizenship from roughly 10 percent of the population—primarily individuals of Haitian descent—thereby restricting their access to healthcare. Leveraging municipality-level variation in exposure within a difference-in-differences framework as well as individual administrative data, we identify a two-stage dynamic in dengue incidence. In the short run, reported cases decline by 13.5 percent in high-exposure municipalities, consistent with healthcare avoidance among affected populations. This decline reverses after six months, as untreated infections generate spillover transmission to non-Haitian populations, increasing cases by 16.7 percent. Overall, the findings demonstrate that restricting healthcare access through citizenship policy imposes substantial public health costs that extend beyond the targeted population.
url:ae3b10a89da1b7b9.abstract_zh: 我们估计了排他性公民身份政策对传染病传播的因果效应。2013年，多米尼加共和国宪法法院第168-13号裁决追溯性地剥夺了约10%人口（主要是海地裔）的公民身份，从而限制了他们获得医疗服务的权利。利用市级层面暴露程度的差异，结合双重差分框架及个体行政数据，我们识别出登革热发病率的两个阶段动态变化。短期内，高暴露地区的报告病例下降13.5%，这与受影响人群回避就医的行为一致。六个月后，这一下降趋势发生逆转，未治疗的感染引发向非海地人群的溢出传播，导致病例增加16.7%。总体而言，研究结果表明，通过公民身份政策限制医疗获取权会带来巨大的公共卫生成本，且其影响超出了目标人群本身。
url:ae3b10a89da1b7b9.title: Citizenship Policy and the Spread of Communicable Diseases: Evidence from the Dominican Republic
url:ae3b10a89da1b7b9.title_zh: 国籍政策与传染病传播：来自多米尼加共和国的证据

url:ae5a5e7b6db46116.abstract: We investigate how politico-economic factors shaped government responses to the spread of COVID-19. Our simple framework uses epidemiological, economic and politico-economic arguments. Confronting the theory with US state level data we find strong evidence for partisanship even when we control for fundamentals including the electorate's political views. Moreover, we detect an important role for the proximity of elections which we interpret as indicative of career concerns. Finally, we find suggestive evidence for complementarities between voluntary activity reductions and government imposed restrictions.
url:ae5a5e7b6db46116.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了政治经济因素如何影响政府对COVID-19传播的应对措施。我们的简明框架融合了流行病学、经济学及政治经济学论点。将理论与美国州级数据相对照，我们发现，即便在控制包括选民政治观点在内的基本面因素后，党派偏见的影响依然显著。此外，我们识别出选举临近性的重要作用，这被解读为职业关切的体现。最后，我们获得了关于自愿活动减少与政府强制限制之间存在互补性的初步证据。
url:ae5a5e7b6db46116.title: The Political Economy of Early COVID-19 Interventions in US States

url:ae8d76d0e489c0df.abstract: This paper studies the dynamics of U.S. sectoral producer prices in a large Bayesian Vector Auto Regression (BVAR) model where the Input-Output (IO) matrix is used to structure their long-run relationships. The model provides evidence of a sectoral spillover channel in driving headline inflation without imposing such a mechanism in the model’s structure. Forecasts of headline inflation have accuracy comparable to the Survey of Professional Forecasters’ and greater than those generated by a standard BVAR with the Minnesota prior, confirming that the IO matrix long-run prior conveys relevant information about the data. The study of an oil price shock shows that adding the production network prior alters the transmission of the shock, amplifying headline inflation. Across sectors, the peak price response to the oil shock increases with oil intensity. A narrowly sector-specific disturbance, such as a cereal price shock, has non-negligible aggregate effects once the production network is accounted for. Sectoral asymmetries are crucial for evaluating the macroeconomic consequences of macroeconomic shocks such as an energy price shock and a monetary policy shock, as industries with slower price adjustments amplify inflation persistence, even after the shock dissipates. JEL Classification: C11, C55, E30
url:ae8d76d0e489c0df.abstract_zh: 本文在一个大型贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR）模型中研究了美国部门生产者价格的动态，其中投入产出（IO）矩阵被用于构建其长期关系。该模型提供了部门溢出渠道驱动总体通胀的证据，而无需在模型结构中施加此类机制。总体通胀的预测精度与专业预测者调查相当，且高于使用明尼苏达先验的标准BVAR模型所生成的预测，证实了IO矩阵长期先验传达了关于数据的相关信息。对油价冲击的研究表明，加入生产网络先验改变了冲击的传导，放大了总体通胀。在各行业间，价格对油价冲击的峰值响应随石油强度增加而上升。一个狭窄的部门特定扰动，如谷物价格冲击，在考虑生产网络后具有不可忽视的总体效应。部门不对称性对于评估宏观经济冲击（如能源价格冲击和货币政策冲击）的宏观经济后果至关重要，因为价格调整较慢的行业会放大通胀持续性，即使在冲击消退后也是如此。JEL分类：C11, C55, E30
