url:aea1ae26d63f2f7f.abstract: We explore how members of a collective pension scheme can share inflation risks in the absence of suitable financial market instruments. Using intergenerational risk sharing arrangements, risks can be allocated better across the various participants of a collective pension scheme than would be the case in a strictly individual- or cohort-based pension scheme, as these can only lay off risks via existing financial market instruments. Hence, intergenerational sharing of these risks enhances welfare. In view of the sizes of their funded pension sectors, this would be particularly beneficial for the Netherlands and the U.K.
url:aea1ae26d63f2f7f.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在缺乏合适金融市场工具的情况下，集体养老金计划的成员如何能够分担通货膨胀风险。通过代际风险分担安排，相较于严格基于个人或群体的养老金计划，这些风险能够在集体养老金计划的不同参与者之间得到更优的配置，因为后者仅能通过现有的金融市场工具来转移风险。因此，代际间对这些风险的分担增进了福利。鉴于其基金制养老金部门的规模，这对荷兰和英国尤为有利。
url:aea1ae26d63f2f7f.title: Intergenerational Sharing of Unhedgeable Inflation Risk
url:aea1ae26d63f2f7f.title_zh: 不可对冲通胀风险的代际分担

url:aea7d8c7b585fc02.abstract: This paper quantitatively evaluates other countries' optimal tariffs and the prospects of sustaining international trade cooperation when a large player — the United States — exits the cooperative trade regime. To guide the analysis, we rely on an analytical characterization of the optimal tariff in a simplified multi-country trade model with endogenous labor supply. A country's optimal import tariffs are a function of its trade partners' expenditure shares on its goods, and the trade and labor supply elasticities. In both the simplified model and the full quantitative multi-country, multi-sector global network model, the impact of the US withdrawal from free trade on other countries' optimal tariffs and the sustainability of the cooperative trade regime is minimal. This is because quantitatively, the key determinants of these objects — domestic and international trade shares of other countries — change little from the US withdrawal. This main finding is not sensitive to the trade or labor supply elasticities. Thus, the fall of the US free trade domino is unlikely to cause further dominoes to fall.
url:aea7d8c7b585fc02.abstract_zh: 本文定量评估了当一个大国——美国——退出合作贸易体制时，其他国家的关税最优水平及维持国际贸易合作的前景。为引导分析，我们依赖于一个简化多国贸易模型中关税最优水平的解析特征，该模型包含内生劳动供给。一个国家的进口关税最优水平是其贸易伙伴对其商品支出份额以及贸易和劳动供给弹性的函数。在简化模型和完整的定量多国、多部门全球网络模型中，美国退出自由贸易对其他国家的关税最优水平及合作贸易体制可持续性的影响微乎其微。这是因为从数量上看，这些对象的关键决定因素——其他国家的国内和国际贸易份额——在美国退出后变化不大。这一主要发现对贸易或劳动供给弹性并不敏感。因此，美国自由贸易多米诺骨牌的倒下不太可能导致更多骨牌相继倒下。
url:aea7d8c7b585fc02.title: Falling Dominoes? The Impact of the US Exit from Free Trade on the Sustainability of Trade Cooperation

url:aef8bc9b0a7eb5bf.abstract: The Covid pandemic dramatically altered patterns of daily life, particularly through widespread declines in mobility due to lockdowns and social distancing measures. While the economic and epidemiological effects of these restrictions have been widely studied, their broader health implications remain underexplored. This paper investigates the relationship between mobility decline during the Covid pandemic and hypertension outcomes in India. Leveraging district-level variation in mobility from Google Community Mobility Reports and health data from the 2019–2021 Indian Demographic and Health Survey (DHS), we find that a 1 percentage point reduction in mobility over the 30 days prior to interview is associated with a 0.3 percentage point decrease in the likelihood of having normal blood pressure. The effect is driven by increases in pre-hypertensive and mildly elevated blood pressure, with no significant changes in more severe hypertension. We examine potential mechanisms—healthcare access, stress (proxied by alcohol use), and reduced physical activity—and find limited explanatory power for the former two. These findings suggest that reduced physical mobility likely played a key role in worsening cardiovascular risk profiles. The results underscore the importance of integrating chronic disease considerations into the design of mobility-restricting public health interventions.
url:aef8bc9b0a7eb5bf.abstract_zh: 新冠疫情深刻改变了日常生活模式，尤其通过封锁和社交距离措施导致人口流动性普遍下降。尽管这些限制措施的经济和流行病学影响已被广泛研究，但其对健康的更广泛影响仍待深入探讨。本文研究了新冠疫情期间印度人口流动性下降与高血压结果之间的关系。利用谷歌社区流动性报告中地区层面的流动性变化数据，以及2019-2021年印度人口与健康调查（DHS）的健康数据，我们发现：受访前30天内流动性每降低1个百分点，血压正常的概率将下降0.3个百分点。这一效应主要源于高血压前期和轻度血压升高病例的增加，而重度高血压未见显著变化。我们考察了潜在机制——医疗可及性、压力（以酒精使用为代理变量）和体力活动减少——发现前两者的解释力有限。这些结果表明，身体活动减少可能在心血管风险恶化中发挥了关键作用。研究结果强调，在设计限制流动性的公共卫生干预措施时，必须将慢性病防控纳入考量。
url:aef8bc9b0a7eb5bf.title: Public Health Trade-Offs During a Pandemic: Mobility Decline and Hypertension Risk in Indialoven
url:aef8bc9b0a7eb5bf.title_zh: 疫情期间的公共卫生权衡：印度流动性下降与高血压风险

url:aef9915c7dd89f62.abstract: This paper examines the effect of digital connectivity on income of women-headed households in Viet Nam. Using the Viet Nam Digital Economy Access Index and the Viet Nam Household Living Standards Survey, empirical evidence shows that increased digital connectivity significantly improves the income of women headed households. Disadvantaged groups, such as those with limited educational attainment and lower income levels, and living in rural areas, benefit more from having digital connectivity. We explore the mechanisms behind this relationship and find that digital connectivity is related to increased participation in the labor market, particularly in the services sector. This paper offers new insights into the inclusive effects of digital connectivity and provides policy recommendations for advancing digital infrastructure development.
url:aef9915c7dd89f62.abstract_zh: 本文考察了数字连接对越南女性户主家庭收入的影响。基于越南数字经济接入指数与越南家庭生活水平调查数据，实证结果表明：数字连接的增强显著提升了女性户主家庭的收入水平。教育程度有限、收入水平较低及居住在农村地区的弱势群体，从数字连接中获益更多。我们进一步探究了该影响的作用机制，发现数字连接与劳动力市场参与度的提升密切相关，尤其在服务业领域。本研究为数字连接的包容性效应提供了新见解，并为推进数字基础设施建设提出了政策建议。
url:aef9915c7dd89f62.title: Digital Connectivity and Household Income: Evidence from Women-Headed Households in Viet Nam

url:af29c3a6bbc7c986.abstract: This paper studies formal employment dynamics using linked employer–employee data from eight countries spanning a wide income range from Kenya to Chile. First, we show that formality rates increase with development, both between and within countries, because more workers enter the formal sector, not because they spend more time in formal jobs. Second, formal labor market fluidity increases with development, as workers hold more formal jobs, spend less time in each job, and less time between jobs. Third, greater fluidity is associated with higher life-cycle wage growth, which is largely accounted for by within- rather than between-firm wage gains.
url:af29c3a6bbc7c986.abstract_zh: 本文利用涵盖从肯尼亚到智利等八个收入水平差异显著国家的关联雇主-雇员数据，研究正规就业动态。首先，我们表明，正规就业率随发展水平提高而上升，无论是在国家间还是国家内部，这主要是因为更多工人进入正规部门，而非他们在正规工作岗位上停留时间更长。其次，正规劳动力市场的流动性随发展水平增强，表现为工人持有更多正规工作、每份工作持续时间更短、工作间隔时间更短。第三，更高的流动性与更高的生命周期工资增长相关，而这种增长主要源于企业内部的工资提升，而非企业间的变动。
url:af29c3a6bbc7c986.title: Formal Labor Market Dynamics and Development

url:af58c2579f415d6a.abstract: Consider an analyst interested in predicting the size of an effect. She has identified a set of prior published studies of similar effects. We provide a toolkit for (i) summarizing the prior literature, (ii) making predictions of effects in new contexts, and (iii) correcting for the bias from selectivity in the prior literature. We illustrate these methods with empirical examples from labor, public, behavioral, environmental, and development economics. Some of the tools are relevant even when only three prior studies are available. We show how it is possible to use covariates to transparently make predictions for a new context by reweighting prior estimates. The mean effect---after correcting for selectivity---is between 12% and 21% of the simple mean in our empirical examples. We conclude with a cookbook for practitioners producing meta-analyses.
url:af58c2579f415d6a.abstract_zh: 考虑一位分析师，其目标是预测某一效应的大小。她已确定一组关于类似效应的先前已发表研究。我们提供了一套工具包，用于：(i) 总结先前文献，(ii) 预测新情境下的效应，以及 (iii) 纠正先前文献中选择性偏差带来的偏误。我们通过来自劳动经济学、公共经济学、行为经济学、环境经济学和发展经济学的实证案例来展示这些方法。即便仅有三项先前研究可用，部分工具仍具适用性。我们展示了如何通过重新加权先前估计值，利用协变量透明地预测新情境下的效应。在我们的实证案例中，经选择性偏差校正后的平均效应，仅为简单均值的12%至21%。最后，我们为从事元分析的研究者提供了一份操作指南。
url:af58c2579f415d6a.title: Literature Review and Evidence Aggregation: a Toolkit for Applied Micro
url:af58c2579f415d6a.title_zh: 文献综述与证据汇总：应用微观经济学工具包

url:af6ce807167923c8.abstract: What role does wealth play in shaping educational choices? While theoretical frameworks generate elaborate, testable predictions, there are significant hurdles in empirically assessing this relationship. In modern societies, compulsory education laws conceal the impact of wealth on educational decisions. To address this challenge, we draw on a unique dataset from 1858 that records municipal-level wealth shares alongside primary school enrollment across Sicily, an ideal historical setting in which schools were present in nearly every municipality, yet attendance was voluntary. Leveraging the long-term effects of historical earthquakes on land and property distribution-effects that reshaped the wealth structure of Sicilian municipalities in the mid-19th century, we examine the impact of wealth on schooling decisions. Our analysis shows that wealth played a significant role in educational outcomes even in a largely agrarian context: a 10% increase in the share of wealthy households was associated with a 0.6% increase in primary school enrollment.
url:af6ce807167923c8.abstract_zh: 财富在塑造教育选择中扮演何种角色？尽管理论框架能够产生详尽且可检验的预测，但在实证评估这一关系时仍面临重大障碍。在现代社会中，义务教育法掩盖了财富对教育决策的影响。为应对这一挑战，我们利用1858年一项独特的数据集，该数据集记录了西西里各市镇的财富份额与小学入学率。这一历史背景具有理想的研究条件：几乎每个市镇都设有学校，但入学完全自愿。借助历史地震对土地与财产分配的长期影响——这些影响在19世纪中期重塑了西西里各市镇的财富结构，我们考察了财富对教育决策的作用。分析表明，即便在高度农业化的背景下，财富对教育成果仍具有显著影响：富裕家庭比例每增加10%，小学入学率相应提高0.6%。
url:af6ce807167923c8.title: Wealth and the origins of the education take-off
url:af6ce807167923c8.title_zh: 财富与教育起飞的起源

url:af747aaec5855d78.abstract: Using county data from California between 2004 and 2017, this article exploits changes in households’ exposure to hazardous waste recycling to identify the effects on potential environmental and economic outcomes. While a 10% rise in recycling per household is associated with a 0.28% and 0.94% improvement in air quality and a decline in the number of unhealthy days in a year, recycling is associated with a rise in net energy generation and fuel consumption and not associated with economic activity. There is some evidence that households in zip codes with higher housing values and population density value reductions in hazardous waste. JEL Q53Q58
url:af747aaec5855d78.abstract_zh: 本文利用2004年至2017年间加利福尼亚州的县级数据，通过家庭暴露于危险废物回收的变化来识别其对潜在环境和经济结果的影响。尽管每户回收量增加10%与空气质量改善0.28%和0.94%以及一年中不健康天数减少相关，但回收与净能源发电量和燃料消耗的增加相关，且与经济活动无关联。有证据表明，住房价值较高和人口密度较大的邮政编码区域内的家庭更看重危险废物的减少。JEL分类号：Q53，Q58
url:af747aaec5855d78.title: Is Recycling Effective? Evidence from California between 2004 and 2017

url:afb503cbb8118a06.abstract: We investigate how information frictions affect the efficacy of contraception provision programs. We study a Costa Rican initiative that combined free access to long-acting reversible contraceptives and a tailored information campaign to correct for baseline misinformation. Using administrative data and geographic variation in the initiative, we find a 16% decrease in the teen birth rate. We show information complements access – an extra year of exposure to the information campaign is equivalent to the effect of contraception access alone. Using surveys on sexual behavior, we show the policy changed the information source from personal networks to healthcare professionals, amending misinformation on sexual health.
url:afb503cbb8118a06.abstract_zh: 我们研究了信息摩擦如何影响避孕措施提供项目的有效性。我们聚焦于哥斯达黎加的一项举措，该举措结合了长效可逆避孕药的免费获取与针对性的信息宣传，以纠正基线信息偏差。利用行政数据及该举措的地理差异，我们发现青少年生育率下降了16%。研究表明，信息与获取渠道具有互补效应——额外一年的信息宣传接触所产生的效果，等同于仅提供避孕措施的效果。通过性行为调查数据，我们发现该政策将信息源从个人社交网络转向医疗专业人员，从而修正了关于性健康的信息偏差。
url:afb503cbb8118a06.title: The Complementary Role of Information and Contraceptive Access in Teen Pregnancy
url:afb503cbb8118a06.title_zh: 信息与避孕措施可及性在青少年怀孕中的互补作用

url:afc3ceb3c3bedda3.abstract: Business plan competitions aim to identify and spur high-growth entrepreneurs. Two experiments were embedded into in a Kenyan competition to test how intensity of selection and of capital determine entrepreneurial outcomes. Applicants received a US$9,000 grant after a streamlined process or went through multiple selection stages and were randomly assigned US$9,000 or US$36,000. All grants initially generated jobs, but the impacts only persisted over three years under multi-stage selection. The larger grants did not yield greater long-term impacts than the multi-stage US$9,000 grant, suggesting diminishing returns to capital and limited lumpy investment opportunities. Selection, rather than grant size, determines long-run firm growth.
url:afc3ceb3c3bedda3.abstract_zh: 商业计划竞赛旨在识别并激励高成长型企业家。通过在肯尼亚的一场竞赛中嵌入两项实验，本研究检验了筛选强度与资本规模如何决定创业成果。申请者经简化流程后获得9000美元资助，或需通过多阶段筛选并随机分配9000美元或36000美元。所有资助最初均创造了就业岗位，但只有经过多阶段筛选的资助在三年后仍持续产生效应。更大规模的资助并未比多阶段筛选下的9000美元资助带来更显著的长期影响，这表明资本存在边际收益递减效应，且大规模投资机会有限。决定企业长期增长的关键因素是筛选机制，而非资助金额。
url:afc3ceb3c3bedda3.title: Selection or More Capital? Experimental Evidence on High-Growth Entrepreneurs in Kenya
url:afc3ceb3c3bedda3.title_zh: 选择还是更多资本？肯尼亚高增长企业家的实验证据

url:afe13de44cd9e2cf.abstract: Using matched employer–employee data on more than 62,000 master’s graduates, this paper examines how gender differences in wage returns to fields of study vary by migration background and how educational specialisation contributes to the gender wage gap. We estimate wage regressions and apply a decomposition approach to separate sorting across fields from differences in pay within fields. Returns vary widely, with law, economics and management, and science yielding the highest returns, and women earning less than men within all fields, especially in high-paying ones. First-generation immigrants from developing countries obtain the lowest returns regardless of field of study, while second-generation immigrants approach but do not fully match natives. Fields of study explain a substantial share of gender wage inequality among natives and second-generation immigrants, whereas among first-generation immigrants broader wage disadvantages dominate. Results further vary with the number of parents originating from developing countries and with age at arrival.
url:afe13de44cd9e2cf.abstract_zh: 本文利用超过6.2万名硕士毕业生的匹配雇主-雇员数据，考察了不同学科领域工资回报的性别差异如何随移民背景变化，以及教育专业化如何影响性别工资差距。我们估计了工资回归模型，并采用分解方法将跨领域的选择效应与领域内的工资差异分离开来。研究结果显示，各领域的回报差异显著，其中法律、经济与管理以及科学领域的回报最高，而在所有领域中，女性的收入均低于男性，尤其是在高薪领域。来自发展中国家的第一代移民无论学习何种领域，其回报均最低，而第二代移民虽接近但未能完全达到本土居民的水平。学科领域解释了本土居民和第二代移民中性别工资不平等的主要部分，但在第一代移民中，更广泛的工资劣势占据主导地位。此外，结果还因父母来自发展中国家的数量以及移民到达时的年龄而异。

url:afedb4873a6bc914.abstract: This paper measures and analyzes management practices in the Kenyan health care sector, drawing on a nationally representative survey and linked administrative data. The paper adapts the World Management Survey to measure management quality in primary health care facilities and hospitals, surveying 429 primary health care facilities and 73 hospitals. Primary health care facilities are the primary point of contact for most patients, providing treatment for common infectious diseases and chronic conditions, as well as services related to maternal and child health. Management quality is low on average, and the distribution is highly compressed. The analysis uses administrative data to test the association between the management quality and performance of primary health care facilities, measured by outpatient attendance, during a period of disruption that included the COVID-19 pandemic and a public health workers
url:afedb4873a6bc914.abstract_zh: 本文基于全国代表性调查及关联行政数据，对肯尼亚医疗部门的管理实践进行了测度与分析。研究采用世界管理调查法，对429家初级卫生保健机构和73家医院的管理质量进行评估。初级卫生保健机构作为多数患者的首要接触点，承担常见传染病、慢性病治疗及母婴健康相关服务。结果显示，管理质量整体偏低且分布高度集中。通过行政数据检验管理质量与初级卫生保健机构绩效（以门诊就诊量为衡量指标）之间的关联性，研究时段涵盖新冠疫情及公共卫生工作者罢工等干扰事件。
url:afedb4873a6bc914.title: Management of Health Care Facilities and Patient Attendance during Major Disruptions : Evidence from Kenya
url:afedb4873a6bc914.title_zh: 重大干扰期间医疗设施管理与患者就诊率：来自肯尼亚的证据

url:aff376bb44cd2090.abstract: European countries paved the way for modern economic growth in the 19th century with large-scale reforms facilitating human capital accumulation. The literature has looked at the role of elites in broad education investments, but less attention has been devoted to reforms promoting workers' health, a key component of human capital. This paper studies the impact of the 1866 cholera outbreak on modern waterworks construction in the German Empire to test the hypothesis whether concerns about workers' health may have compelled elites to invest in health-enhancing public goods. We find that the epidemic raised the annual probability of building waterworks by about 35%. Exogenous variation relying on the cholera-spreading effect of military movements during the Austro-Prussian War in 1866 further underpins this result. Quantitative and qualitative evidence indicates that non-agricultural elites employing more productive capital and better-skilled workers pushed for reform to avoid the costly prospect of future labour shocks. Long-term analyses show sizeable and persisting effects of the epidemic on public health and development outcomes shortly before the First World War.
url:aff376bb44cd2090.abstract_zh: 欧洲国家在19世纪通过大规模改革促进人力资本积累，为现代经济增长奠定了基础。现有文献关注了精英阶层在广泛教育投资中的作用，但较少关注促进工人健康（人力资本的关键组成部分）的改革。本文以1866年霍乱疫情对德意志帝国现代供水系统建设的影响为研究对象，检验以下假设：对工人健康的担忧是否可能促使精英阶层投资于增进健康的公共品。研究发现，疫情使供水系统建设的年概率提高了约35%。利用1866年普奥战争期间军事调动对霍乱传播的外生性影响，进一步验证了这一结果。定量与定性证据表明，雇佣更多生产性资本和技能更熟练工人的非农业精英阶层推动改革，以避免未来劳动力冲击带来的高昂成本。长期分析显示，疫情对第一次世界大战前夕的公共卫生与发展成果产生了显著且持续的影响。
url:aff376bb44cd2090.title: Private Interest in the Public Good: Cholera and the Origins of Sanitary Reform
url:aff376bb44cd2090.title_zh: 公共利益中的私人利益：霍乱与卫生改革的起源

url:b01ac82739bff00f.title: Financial intermediation and structural change
url:b01ac82739bff00f.title_zh: 金融中介与结构性变化

url:b025c7f2e45105e6.abstract: This paper explains why these policies were the most popular savings vehicle of their day. Ordinary life policies were well suited to the early twentieth-century economic environment. They had good returns; low risks; tax advantages; and little correlation with returns of competing investments, like bank deposits, building and loan shares, postal savings deposits, real estate, or stocks. The policies protected households from poverty in old age, from the premature death of their breadwinner, and from other risks including disability and deflation. Understanding how households saved in the past has implications for a wide range of literatures in the social sciences.
url:b025c7f2e45105e6.abstract_zh: 本文解释了为何这些保单成为当时最受欢迎的储蓄工具。普通寿险保单完美契合了20世纪初的经济环境：其收益可观、风险较低、享有税收优惠，且与银行存款、建房贷款股份、邮政储蓄存款、房地产或股票等竞争性投资工具的收益率相关性极低。这类保单既能防止家庭因年老陷入贫困，又能抵御家庭经济支柱早逝、残疾及通货紧缩等风险。理解历史上的家庭储蓄方式，对社会科学领域的诸多研究具有启示意义。
url:b025c7f2e45105e6.title: Ordinary Life Insurance: The Best-Performing Financial Asset of the 1930s
url:b025c7f2e45105e6.title_zh: 普通人寿保险：20世纪30年代表现最佳的金融资产

url:b025e6a418eaba93.abstract: Although flexible employment policies can help employed individuals balance caregiving and paid work, limited evidence has been devoted to examining the effect of working flexibly on the supply of care to older adults. In this paper, we study the impact of flexible working conditions on the supply of informal adult care and mental health. We exploit variation from the 2014 expansion of the Right to Request Flexible Work (RRFW) to employees in the UK. Our findings point to a gendered response to increased employment flexibility. We document a 1.3-percentage-point increase in the likelihood that men provide informal care within the household, alongside less regular daytime work, greater control over working hours, and higher engagement in home production. In contrast, among potential female caregivers, we find that the reform reduced the probability of high-intensity caregiving, which is typically incompatible with employment or related activities. We document that the increased workplace flexibility not only encourages caregiving but also helps reduce gender disparities in unpaid care. We additionally find suggestive evidence of improved mental health outcomes, particularly among men.
url:b025e6a418eaba93.abstract_zh: 尽管弹性就业政策有助于在职人员平衡照护责任与有偿工作，但关于弹性工作安排对老年人照护供给影响的实证证据仍然有限。本文研究了弹性工作条件对非正式成人照护供给及心理健康的影响。我们利用2014年英国《弹性工作请求权利》（RRFW）扩展至雇员的政策变动作为识别策略。研究结果揭示了就业弹性增加带来的性别差异化反应。我们发现，男性在家庭内提供非正式照护的可能性上升了1.3个百分点，同时其常规日间工作时间减少、对工作时间的掌控力增强，且参与家庭生产的程度提高。相比之下，在潜在的女性照护者群体中，该改革降低了高强度照护的概率，而高强度照护通常与就业或相关活动难以兼容。我们进一步发现，工作场所弹性的增加不仅促进了照护供给，还有助于缩小无偿照护中的性别差距。此外，我们还发现了心理健康状况改善的初步证据，尤其是在男性群体中。
url:b025e6a418eaba93.title: Caring Flexibly? Working Conditions and the Supply of Adult Care
url:b025e6a418eaba93.title_zh: 灵活关怀？工作条件与成人照护供给

url:b0365660b6456444.title_zh: 场外交易市场中的搜寻与库存

url:b03c00718609d630.abstract: Models to explain the chances of economic activity, employment and full-time work in a national cross-section of British women in 1980 in terms of a number of demographic and economic variables are estimated by OLS. Marital status differentials are minor once the presence of dependent children and the level of alternative income are controlled. Earning power is also an important factor; it is imputed on the basis of work history information at the level of pay associated with the best paying occupation, not necessarily that current or most recent, on the grounds that mature women workers are often over-qualified for the jobs with which they combine domestic responsibilities. Regional variations, remote childbearing and marital history, and fertility intentions have little or no explanatory power. Participation rates among women who are neither students nor permanently sick are also reduced by responsibility for adult dependents, being married to a non-earning husband and living in an area of high unemployment. Through the last two factors adverse demand conditions reduce both the chances of women having jobs, and to a smaller extent, of married women describing themselves as economically active.
url:b03c00718609d630.abstract_zh: 本文利用1980年英国全国横截面数据，通过普通最小二乘法（OLS）估计了若干人口与经济变量对女性经济活动、就业及全职工作概率的解释模型。在控制受抚养子女存在及替代收入水平后，婚姻状况差异的影响微乎其微。收入能力同样是重要因素——基于工作历史信息，以与最高薪酬职业（而非当前或最近职业）对应的薪资水平进行归因，理由是成熟女性劳动者往往因兼顾家庭责任而从事与其资质不符的工作。区域差异、生育间隔与婚姻史、生育意愿的解释力较弱或可忽略。既非学生亦非长期病患的女性，其劳动参与率还会因以下因素降低：需照料成年受抚养人、配偶无收入、居住在高失业率地区。通过后两个因素，不利需求条件既降低了女性获得工作的概率，也在较小程度上降低了已婚女性自评为经济活动人口的概率。

url:b07399d8774f7292.abstract: We study frictionless matching models in large production economies with and without market imperfections and/or incentive problems. We provide necessary and sufficient distribution-free conditions for monotone matching which depend on the relationship between what we call the segregation payoff - a generalization of the individually rational payoff - and the feasible set for a pair of types. Imperfections have two distinct effects that are relevant for equilibrium matching patterns: they can overwhelm the complementarity properties of the production technology and they can introduce nontransferabilities that make equilibrium matching inefficient. We also use our framework to reveal the source of differences in the comparative static properties of some models in the literature and to explore the effects of distribution on the equilibrium matching pattern.
url:b07399d8774f7292.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在存在或不存在市场缺陷及/或激励问题的大型生产经济中的无摩擦匹配模型。我们提出了单调匹配的充分必要条件（无需分布假设），这些条件取决于我们称之为“隔离收益”（个体理性收益的推广）与一对类型的可行集之间的关系。市场缺陷对均衡匹配模式产生两种不同的影响：它们可能压倒生产技术的互补性特征，也可能引入非可转移性，导致均衡匹配效率低下。此外，我们利用该框架揭示了文献中某些模型比较静态性质差异的根源，并探讨了分布对均衡匹配模式的影响。
url:b07399d8774f7292.title: Monotone Matching In Perfect And Imperfect Worlds

url:b10ce76ca634da60.abstract: Immigration may affect income inequality not only by changing factor prices but also by inducing policy makers to adjust the prevailing income tax system. We assess the relative importance of these economic and political channels using administrative data from Switzerland where local authorities have a high degree of tax autonomy. We show that immigrant inflows not only raise gross earnings inequality but also reduce the progressivity of local income taxes, further increasing after-tax inequality. Our estimates suggest that around 10 percent of the impact of immigration on the net interquartile and interdecile earnings gaps can be attributed to the political channel.
url:b10ce76ca634da60.abstract_zh: 移民不仅可能通过改变要素价格影响收入不平等，还可能促使政策制定者调整现行所得税制度。我们利用瑞士的行政数据评估了这些经济与政治渠道的相对重要性，该国地方当局拥有高度的税收自主权。我们证明，移民流入不仅提高了总收入的差距，还降低了地方所得税的累进性，进一步加剧了税后不平等。我们的估计表明，移民对净四分位距和十分位距收入差距的影响中，约有10%可归因于政治渠道。
url:b10ce76ca634da60.title: Immigration, Inequality and Income Taxes

url:b12c12912b54d848.abstract: We study how grocery prices paid by households respond to local economic conditions, using the 2014 oil price collapse as a regional unemployment shock in Norway and combining transaction histories for 100,000 households with weekly store-level price data. We derive an exact decomposition of the change in the average price a household pays, whose components, assigned to retailer pricing or distinct household behaviors, sum to the total causal effect when estimated by regression. Prices paid are procyclical: retailer price responses account for about ten percent of the decline, while the dominant channel — over half the total effect — is households timing purchases to temporary sales. The dominance of within-quarter timing implies that unit-value price indexes conflate retailer pricing with household behavior, increasingly so in downturns.
url:b12c12912b54d848.abstract_zh: 我们利用2014年油价暴跌作为挪威区域性失业冲击，结合10万户家庭的交易记录与每周店铺层面的价格数据，研究家庭支付的食品杂货价格如何响应地方经济状况。我们推导出家庭平均支付价格变化的精确分解，其各组成部分——归因于零售商定价或不同家庭行为——在通过回归估计时，总和等于总因果效应。支付价格呈顺周期性：零售商价格响应约占下降幅度的十分之一，而主导渠道——占总效应的一半以上——是家庭将购买时机对准临时促销。季度内时机选择的主导地位意味着，单位价值价格指数混淆了零售商定价与家庭行为，且在经济衰退时期这种混淆程度加剧。

url:b134e89da271fb46.abstract: We investigate how credit availability affects the organization of firms' labor. We construct a firm-specific credit supply instrument derived from firm-bank credit linkages, and conduct an event study analyzing labor restructuring decisions within Portuguese firms. Our analysis uncovers a clear nexus between credit availability and labor adjustments. Specifically, firms that invest in machines and equipment are more sensitive to credit shortages. As a result, they tend to adjust their workforce by reducing the number of production and specialized workers closely associated with machine operations. These findings shed light on how credit dynamics shape labor decisions within firms, providing insights into aggregate responses to financial limitations.
url:b134e89da271fb46.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了信贷可得性如何影响企业的劳动力组织。我们构建了一个基于企业-银行信贷联系的企业特定信贷供给工具，并通过事件研究法分析了葡萄牙企业内部的重组决策。分析揭示出信贷可得性与劳动力调整之间存在明确关联。具体而言，投资于机器设备的企业对信贷短缺更为敏感。因此，这些企业倾向于通过减少与机器操作紧密相关的生产工人和专业人员数量来调整其劳动力结构。这些发现阐明了信贷动态如何塑造企业内部劳动力决策，为理解金融限制下的总体反应提供了洞见。

url:b13ad996e5b266d6.abstract: Using large-scale high-granularity data from a food delivery platform and granular pollution and weather information, we study how PM 2.5 fluctuations affect riders' absenteeism, productivity, and accidents. Exploiting exogenous pollution variation from inverse boundary layer height, we find that higher pollution increases absenteeism for all workers and raises delivery times and accident rates only among (e-)bike riders, who must exert physical effort while working. Affected workers compensate productivity losses by working longer hours. Monetary incentives mitigate the effects on absenteeism but do not offset the decline in productivity and appear to exacerbate accident risk.
url:b13ad996e5b266d6.abstract_zh: 利用某外卖平台的大规模高粒度数据以及细颗粒物污染与天气信息，我们研究了PM2.5波动如何影响骑手的缺勤、生产率及事故发生率。借助逆边界层高度带来的外生污染变化，我们发现污染加剧会增加所有工人的缺勤率，并仅提高（电动）自行车骑手的配送时间和事故率，这些骑手在工作中需付出体力劳动。受影响的工人通过延长工作时间来弥补生产率损失。金钱激励缓解了缺勤效应，但并未抵消生产率下降，反而似乎加剧了事故风险。

url:b1495b1a35845384.abstract: This paper examines how model uncertainty affects the price of catastrophe risk insurance. We use unique data on expected loss rate projections from seven hurricane risk models approved by regulators for use in Florida property insurance rate setting to quantify model uncertainty. By combining these data with newly published information on local property insurance markets, we are able to empirically test the relationship between model uncertainty and insurance premiums across Florida ZIP codes and over time. Controlling for confounding variables and time-invariant latent factors that may be correlated with observed variables, we find strong empirical support for the hypothesis that greater dispersion among model forecasts leads to higher homeowners insurance premiums. Our findings suggest that, had model dispersion been ten percent lower than that observed in 2021, a typical Florida homeowner would have saved $50 to $90 on her annual homeowners insurance premium.
url:b1495b1a35845384.abstract_zh: 本文研究了模型不确定性如何影响巨灾风险保险的定价。我们利用佛罗里达州监管机构批准的七个飓风风险模型所生成的预期损失率预测数据，对模型不确定性进行量化。通过将这些数据与新发布的当地财产保险市场信息相结合，我们能够从实证角度检验佛罗里达州各邮政编码区域及不同时间维度上模型不确定性与保险保费之间的关系。在控制混杂变量及可能与观测变量相关的时不变潜在因素后，我们发现了强有力的实证证据支持以下假设：模型预测结果的离散程度越大，房主保险保费越高。研究结果表明，若2021年模型离散程度比实际观测值低10%，则典型佛罗里达房主每年可节省50至90美元的房主保险保费。
url:b1495b1a35845384.title: Model Uncertainty and the Pricing of Hurricane Risk in Florida

url:b1cbdebfdda02b4f.abstract: We investigate how individuals interpret corporate sustainability disclosures in a pre-registered survey experiment. We provide novel evidence that participants can meaningfully distinguish greener from browner firms, yet their assessments exhibit a central tendency bias. Interestingly, this bias is asymmetric: respondents overestimate the greenness of browner firms while underestimating the greenness of greener firms more strongly. The same pattern persists among finance professionals and sustainability experts, suggesting that expertise alone does not eliminate interpretation errors. Consequently, firms’ incentives to invest in emissions reductions may be attenuated. We further identify disclosure design features that enhance individuals’ ability to differentiate firms’ emissions performance.
url:b1cbdebfdda02b4f.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项预注册的问卷调查实验，探究个体如何解读企业可持续发展披露信息。我们提供了新颖的证据，表明参与者能够有意义地区分更环保与更不环保的企业，然而其评估存在中心趋势偏差。有趣的是，这种偏差具有不对称性：受访者高估了较不环保企业的绿色程度，同时更显著地低估了更环保企业的绿色程度。这一模式在金融专业人士和可持续发展专家中同样存在，表明专业知识本身并不能消除解读错误。因此，企业投资于减排的激励可能被削弱。我们进一步识别出能够增强个体区分企业排放绩效能力的披露设计特征。
url:b1cbdebfdda02b4f.title: DP21803 Objective vs. Perceived Corporate Greenness: Do Individuals Understand Corporate Sustainability Information?
url:b1cbdebfdda02b4f.title_zh: 客观绿色度与感知绿色度：个体能否理解企业可持续信息？

url:b1d1e8f36aeae60c.abstract: This paper analyses four costs which may be associated with monetary union. First it (obviously) allows no `relative' monetary accommodation of the kind which may assist when dealing with asymmetric shocks. This can impose significant adjustment costs. Second it does not of itself prevent `absolute' accommodation to an inflation shock originating in all members, or even one member, of the union. Third, the distribution of benefits of membership of the union may be skewed. Finally, a union may require significant fiscal flexibility to mitigate against the adjustment costs. We investigate the form of fiscal flexibility which may be required, and we also propose a form of Soft Monetary Union which might alleviate the first problem.
url:b1d1e8f36aeae60c.abstract_zh: 本文分析了与货币联盟可能相关的四种成本。首先，（显然）货币联盟不允许那种有助于应对非对称冲击的“相对”货币调节，这可能带来显著的调整成本。其次，货币联盟本身并不阻止对源于所有成员国甚至单一成员国的通胀冲击进行“绝对”调节。第三，联盟成员国的收益分配可能不均衡。最后，货币联盟可能需要显著的财政灵活性以缓解调整成本。我们探讨了可能需要的财政灵活性形式，并提出了一种可能缓解第一个问题的“软性货币联盟”模式。
url:b1d1e8f36aeae60c.title: DP517 Adjustment Difficulties within a European Monetary Union: Can They be Reduced?
url:b1d1e8f36aeae60c.title_zh: DP517 欧洲货币联盟内部的调整困难：能否缓解？

url:b1d5e38d87881b41.abstract: This paper constructs a real business cycle model in which real money balances yield utility. We calibrate the model to fit the first moments of US data and simulate a set of impulse response functions that are generated by the model for GDP, the rate of interest, money growth and real balances. These theoretical impulse responses are compared with actual impulse responses from US data. The model does a reasonably good job of capturing the dynamic interactions of money and real variables in US data. It differs from most existing approaches by choosing a parameterization of utility for which the model admits the existence of indeterminate equilibria. It is argued that this fact is critical in explaining the monetary propagation mechanism.
url:b1d5e38d87881b41.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个真实货币余额产生效用的实际经济周期模型。我们通过校准模型使其拟合美国数据的一阶矩，并模拟了模型生成的GDP、利率、货币增长及实际余额的一组脉冲响应函数。将这些理论脉冲响应与美国数据的实际脉冲响应进行比较，发现该模型较好地捕捉了美国数据中货币与实际变量的动态交互关系。与现有大多数方法不同，本文选择了允许模型存在不确定均衡的效用参数化设定。研究认为，这一特性对于解释货币传导机制至关重要。
url:b1d5e38d87881b41.title: Money in a Real Business Cycle Model
url:b1d5e38d87881b41.title_zh: 真实商业周期模型中的货币

url:b1e6e1795d45001d.abstract: Europe has devoted substantial resources to fostering innovation and AI diffusion, through both centralised EU initiatives and national programmes. This column combines an experiment on 3,316 euro area firms with data from a large firm survey to demonstrate that that the decision to adopt AI is primarily driven by competition pressures rather than informational spillovers. If firms systematically underestimate their competitors’ AI investment – especially those abroad – informational gaps could be driving underinvestment. Reducing invisible barriers to knowledge sharing across regions may be just as vital as financial support for closing gaps in AI investment and innovation across Europe.
url:b1e6e1795d45001d.abstract_zh: 欧洲通过欧盟集中倡议和国家计划投入了大量资源，以促进创新和人工智能的扩散。本专栏结合一项针对3316家欧元区企业的实验以及大型企业调查数据，表明企业采用人工智能的决策主要受竞争压力驱动，而非信息溢出效应。如果企业系统性地低估其竞争对手（尤其是海外竞争对手）的人工智能投资，信息差距可能导致投资不足。减少跨区域知识共享的隐形障碍，对于缩小欧洲人工智能投资与创新差距而言，可能与财政支持同等重要。
url:b1e6e1795d45001d.title: Innovation without borders

url:b20400d378167e08.abstract: We develop a dynamic multi-country trade model with trade-related technology diffusion and endogenous R&D to quantify the impacts of trade policies and trade wars on innovation, technology rivalry, and welfare. We estimate the model using data on trade and patent citations and validate it in the context of U.S. export controls on China. Counterfactual analysis yields three main results. First, U.S. export controls on China reduce technological progress in both countries: China experiences a sharp contraction in knowledge inflows, while the U.S. faces a decline in R&D. Second, trade-driven diffusion and endogenous innovation substantially amplify the technological and welfare gains in the U.S. and losses in other major economies from the 2025 Liberation Day tariffs. Third, U.S. optimal tariffs on China, under varying geopolitical concerns, reflect a trade-off between curbing technology diffusion to China and sustaining U.S. innovation.
url:b20400d378167e08.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含贸易驱动技术扩散与内生研发的动态多国贸易模型，用以量化贸易政策及贸易战对创新、技术竞争和福利的影响。基于贸易与专利引用数据对模型进行估计，并以美国对华出口管制为背景验证模型有效性。反事实分析得出三项主要结论：第一，美国对华出口管制将抑制两国技术进步——中国面临知识流入急剧收缩，而美国则遭遇研发活动衰退；第二，贸易驱动的技术扩散与内生创新机制显著放大了2025年解放日关税对美国的技术与福利增益，同时加剧其他主要经济体的损失；第三，在不同地缘政治关切下，美国对华最优关税体现了遏制技术向中国扩散与维持美国创新活力之间的权衡。
url:b20400d378167e08.title: Trade War and Technology Rivalry

url:b20d0984d548e186.abstract: The EU's fiscal rules in force since 2024 are often criticised for their complexity. The official implementation requires thousands of lines of code and a sophisticated debt sustainability analysis. This column argues that the central result can be approximated by a remarkably simple formula: the required primary balance equals the largest debt-stabilising primary balance in a ten-year period plus roughly 1% of the debt ratio. While this simplification cannot replace the full calculations, it helps demystify the debt rules and provides a shortcut for assessing the impact of policies on debt sustainability.
url:b20d0984d548e186.abstract_zh: 自2024年起生效的欧盟财政规则常因其复杂性而受到批评。官方实施需要数千行代码和复杂的债务可持续性分析。本文认为，其核心结果可通过一个极为简单的公式近似得出：所需的基本财政余额等于十年期内最大的债务稳定基本余额加上约1%的债务比率。尽管这一简化无法替代完整计算，但它有助于揭开债务规则的神秘面纱，并为评估政策对债务可持续性的影响提供了一条捷径。
url:b20d0984d548e186.title: Opening the black box of Europe’s new fiscal rules
url:b20d0984d548e186.title_zh: 揭开欧洲新财政规则的黑箱

url:b213d6adee8878d4.abstract: Using a novel indicator for the People's Bank of China monetary policy stance, we estimate a policy rule that accounts for the dual nature of its price stability mandate-encompassing domestic inflation and the exchange rate-and for the evolution of its operational framework. The Ins: The domestic transmission follows textbook patterns, with exceptions due to the active management of the renminbi and the financial account. The Outs: International spillovers are powerful and affect commodity markets, global production and trade. The pass-through to foreign (US) prices is substantial. Financial spillovers are second-order, and mostly derivative from trade spillovers.
url:b213d6adee8878d4.abstract_zh: 我们采用一项衡量中国人民银行货币政策立场的新指标，估算了一条政策规则，该规则既考虑了其价格稳定目标的双重属性——涵盖国内通胀与汇率——也考虑了其操作框架的演变。内部传导方面：遵循教科书模式，但由于人民币和金融账户的积极管理而存在例外。外部溢出方面：国际溢出效应显著，影响大宗商品市场、全球生产与贸易。对国外（美国）价格的传导效应相当大。金融溢出效应属于次要层面，主要源于贸易溢出效应。
url:b213d6adee8878d4.title: The Ins & Outs of Chinese Monetary Policy Transmission
url:b213d6adee8878d4.title_zh: 中国货币政策传导的来龙去脉

url:b218ac300b9093b5.abstract: This paper compares statistical experiments in discounted problems, ranging from the simplest ones where the state is fixed and the flow of information exogenous to more complex ones, where the decision-maker controls the flow of information or the state changes over time.
url:b218ac300b9093b5.abstract_zh: 本文比较了贴现问题中的统计实验，从最简单的状态固定且信息流外生的情形，到更复杂的决策者控制信息流或状态随时间变化的情形。
url:b218ac300b9093b5.title: Comparing Experiments in Discounted Problems
url:b218ac300b9093b5.title_zh: 比较贴现问题中的实验

url:b222294d235f0452.title: Bayesian Model Averaging in Causal Instrumental Variable Models
url:b222294d235f0452.title_zh: 因果工具变量模型中的贝叶斯模型平均

url:b22e95475ef5aeed.abstract: Loan modifications can either amplify or mitigate credit losses depending on the strategy lenders employ. Using detailed supervisory data and a model incorporating various frictions that could encourage modifications (liquidity constraints, foreclosure costs, and loss recognition costs), I assess why banks extend CRE loans. I find that extensions predominantly address temporary payment frictions, both in normal times and following the Spring 2023 bank stress episode. Contrary to concerns about banks “extending-and-pretending” following that episode, banks increased income and principal paydown requirements for extensions, contributing to strong ex-post performance for extended loans.
url:b22e95475ef5aeed.abstract_zh: 贷款修改可能放大或减轻信用损失，具体取决于贷款机构采用的策略。利用详细的监管数据以及一个纳入可能促使修改的各种摩擦因素（流动性约束、止赎成本和损失确认成本）的模型，我评估了银行发放商业房地产贷款的原因。我发现，无论是在正常时期还是在2023年春季银行压力事件之后，展期主要都是为了解决临时性支付摩擦。与对该事件后银行“展期并假装”的担忧相反，银行提高了展期贷款的收入和本金偿还要求，从而使得展期贷款在事后表现出强劲的业绩。
url:b22e95475ef5aeed.title: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

url:b230f41384c71e5d.title: Peasants into Muslims: Poverty and conversions to Islam in Ottoman Bosnia
url:b230f41384c71e5d.title_zh: 从农民到穆斯林：奥斯曼波斯尼亚的贫困与改宗伊斯兰教

url:b23dfba5def008b2.title: Choice experiments on land managers' participation in environmental programs: A systematic review and meta‐analysis of estimate validity
url:b23dfba5def008b2.title_zh: 土地管理者参与环境项目的选择实验：估计有效性的系统综述与元分析

url:b257056914251ac1.title: Why Firms Lay Off Workers Instead of Cutting Wages: Evidence From Linked Survey-Administrative Data
url:b257056914251ac1.title_zh: 企业为何裁员而非降薪：来自关联调查与行政数据的证据

url:b274ded1d96027ff.title: The Determinants of Negotiated Pharmaceutical Prices
url:b274ded1d96027ff.title_zh: 谈判药品价格的决定因素

url:b27f2de92519fd37.title: The Distributional Impact of the Pandemic

url:b28aef1b91921a06.title: Existence and calculation of optimal monetary equilibria on overlapping generations economies
url:b28aef1b91921a06.title_zh: 重叠世代经济中最优货币均衡的存在性与计算

url:b2a07fd3658fccca.abstract: Startup accelerators are a leading gateway to venture capital, but top programs often require founders to relocate to a venture hub. From a hand-collected census of U.S. accelerator startups (2008-2011) followed for five years, we estimate a two-sided matching model that separates two channels behind the gender funding gap, geographic mobility and sorting across accelerator tiers. Women raise about 60% less than men over five years; the gap concentrates among non-relocating women, is largest at active-childrearing ages, and vanishes for relocators, while the mobility cost is near zero for men. Removing mobility frictions raises women's match quality but not their tier; reaching the high-funding top tier also requires removing the sorting disadvantage that women face. The 2012 JOBS Act eased the legal barrier and capacity grew tenfold, yet the U.S. VC dollar gap still tripled (2011-2020): closing it needs mobility, sorting, and capacity together.
url:b2a07fd3658fccca.abstract_zh: 创业加速器是通往风险资本的主要门户，但顶级项目通常要求创始人迁至创业中心。基于一项手工收集的美国加速器初创企业普查数据（2008-2011年，追踪五年），我们估计了一个双边匹配模型，以分离性别融资差距背后的两个渠道：地理流动性和加速器层级的分类效应。五年间，女性融资额比男性低约60%；这一差距集中在未迁址的女性群体中，在育儿活跃年龄段最大，而迁址女性的差距消失，同时男性的流动性成本几乎为零。消除流动性摩擦可提高女性的匹配质量，但无法提升其层级；要进入高融资的顶级层级，还需消除女性面临的分类劣势。2012年《创业企业扶助法》降低了法律障碍，加速器容量增长了十倍，但美国风险资本美元差距仍扩大了两倍（2011-2020年）：缩小这一差距需要同时解决流动性、分类和容量问题。
url:b2a07fd3658fccca.title: Getting There and Getting In: How Mobility and Sorting Keep Women out of Top Startup Accelerators
url:b2a07fd3658fccca.title_zh: 到达与进入：流动性与分类如何将女性排除在顶级创业加速器之外

url:b2b48a57dc970dde.abstract: Falling agricultural prices have been found to generally increase armed civil conflict in producing regions, but not the risk of the most lethal conflicts – civil wars. This column shows that the evidence for civil-war onset is consistent with the broader evidence on armed civil conflict when agricultural price indices isolate changes in world prices from changes in countries’ exports. Across 118 countries over 1957–2007, a one standard deviation decline in world agricultural prices raised the risk of civil-war onset by around 30%, with larger effects in sub-Saharan Africa. The evidence points to falling producer incomes, rather than rising consumer food prices, as the mechanism.
url:b2b48a57dc970dde.abstract_zh: 研究发现，农产品价格下跌通常会加剧产粮地区的武装冲突，但并不会增加最致命冲突——内战的风险。本文专栏指出，当农业价格指数将世界价格变动与各国出口变动区分开来时，关于内战爆发的证据与更广泛的武装冲突证据相一致。在1957年至2007年间覆盖118个国家的研究中，世界农产品价格每下降一个标准差，内战爆发的风险约增加30%，且在撒哈拉以南非洲地区影响更为显著。证据表明，其作用机制在于生产者收入下降，而非消费者食品价格上涨。
url:b2b48a57dc970dde.title: World agricultural prices and the outbreak of civil war
url:b2b48a57dc970dde.title_zh: 世界农产品价格与内战爆发

url:b2b615442863e887.title: Size‐based regulation and water quality: Evidence from the Iowa hog industry
url:b2b615442863e887.title_zh: 基于规模的监管与水质：来自爱荷华州生猪产业的证据

url:b2ba7e0a22f2fd5a.abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative AI has revived fears that a new wave of automation will inevitably shift income away from workers. This column uses data covering nearly the universe of French firms between 1994 and 2019 to test the relationship between automation and the labour share of income at the firm level. While firms clearly automated extensively over this period, the evidence shows that it can profoundly reshape jobs and production without necessarily shifting income from labour to capital.
url:b2ba7e0a22f2fd5a.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能的迅速普及重新引发了人们的担忧，即新一轮自动化浪潮将不可避免地使收入从劳动者手中转移。本文利用1994年至2019年间覆盖几乎所有法国企业的数据，检验了自动化与企业层面劳动收入份额之间的关系。尽管在此期间企业确实广泛实施了自动化，但证据表明，自动化能够深刻重塑就业和生产，却未必会将收入从劳动转向资本。
url:b2ba7e0a22f2fd5a.title: Automation does not lower the labour share
url:b2ba7e0a22f2fd5a.title_zh: 自动化并未降低劳动份额

url:b2e99733b806ecc7.abstract: This paper develops a long-run theory of labor effort, defined as the product of hours worked times work intensity. Under empirically plausible parameter values, the model predicts that intensity rises with income as hours decline. The theory provides a unified interpretation of several empirical regularities: cross-country disparities in hourly productivity among workers with comparable skills and technologies; higher workplace stress in richer economies; limited effectiveness of work-organization reforms in poor regions; patterns of non-work at work. The model is calibrated to match the large joint shift in hours and work intensity in the United States during the first half of the twentieth century. It shows that cross-country differences in intensity matter for welfare as much as differences in hours and suggests that accounting for intensity would significantly narrow measured welfare differences between rich and poor countries. The analysis identifies a key mechanism underlying the reorganization of work and leisure during the transition from poor traditional economies to affluent industrial ones.
url:b2e99733b806ecc7.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于劳动努力的长期理论，将劳动努力定义为工作时间与工作强度的乘积。在经验上合理的参数取值下，模型预测工作强度随收入上升而增加，而工作时间则随之下降。该理论为若干经验规律提供了统一解释：技能与技术条件相似的劳动者在小时生产率上存在的跨国差异；富裕经济体中更高的工作场所压力；贫困地区工作组织改革的有限成效；以及“在职非工作”的行为模式。模型经过校准，以匹配20世纪上半叶美国工作时间和工作强度的大幅联合变动。研究表明，跨国工作强度差异对福利的影响与工作时间差异同等重要，并指出若将工作强度纳入考量，将显著缩小富国与穷国之间测度上的福利差距。分析揭示了从贫困传统经济向富裕工业经济转型过程中，工作与休闲重组背后的关键机制。
url:b2e99733b806ecc7.title: Work Intensity and Welfare Across Countries and Over Time
url:b2e99733b806ecc7.title_zh: 跨国与跨时期的工作强度与福利

url:b2ef3de6606f5aa5.title: Clustered network connectedness: A new measurement framework with application to global equity markets
url:b2ef3de6606f5aa5.title_zh: 聚类网络关联性：一种新的测度框架及其在全球股票市场中的应用

url:b32d4df69a1b41c6.abstract: We survey and extend work on the Federal Reserve’s effect on the stock market, focusing on three empirical findings: The effect of monetary policy surprises in a narrow window around announcements from the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the pre-FOMC announcement drift, and the FOMC cycle in stock returns. We discuss the magnitude of the Fed’s impact (directional effects or effects on average stock returns), the types of shocks coming from the Fed (pure monetary policy shocks, reaction function news, or information about the Fed’s view of the economy), and the asset pricing channels through which effects emerge (an equity premia for news from the Fed, or changes to yields, equity premia, or expected dividends). We also consider the information transmission (communication) channels. The Fed’s effect on the stock market is large, even for average stock returns earned over periods of several decades. Fed-induced changes to both yields and equity premia play substantial roles, with less direct evidence available regarding cash flows. For stocks, reaction function news appears to be more important than Fed information effects. Communication flows outside announcements windows are important.
url:b32d4df69a1b41c6.abstract_zh: 本文综述并拓展了关于美联储对股票市场影响的研究，重点关注三项实证发现：联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告前后窄窗口期内货币政策冲击的影响、FOMC公告前的漂移现象，以及股票收益中的FOMC周期。我们探讨了美联储影响的程度（方向性效应或对平均股票收益的影响）、来自美联储的冲击类型（纯货币政策冲击、反应函数信息或美联储对经济看法的信息），以及效应产生的资产定价渠道（美联储消息的股权溢价，或收益率、股权溢价、预期股息的变化）。我们还考虑了信息传递（沟通）渠道。美联储对股票市场的影响是巨大的，即使是在数十年期间获得的平均股票收益方面也是如此。美联储引发的收益率和股权溢价变化均发挥了重要作用，而关于现金流的直接证据较少。对于股票而言，反应函数信息似乎比美联储信息效应更为重要。公告窗口外的沟通流动具有重要影响。
url:b32d4df69a1b41c6.title: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

url:b33152d9d59b3d93.title: A meta‐analysis on the productive value of crop biodiversity
url:b33152d9d59b3d93.title_zh: 作物生物多样性生产价值的元分析

url:b331c28047c25b6a.abstract: Phone surveys emerged as a critical data collection tool in low- and middle-income countries during the COVID-19 pandemic and have since become a permanent feature of the data landscape in many settings. This paper draws on the experience of the Living Standards Measurement Study High-Frequency Phone Surveys — one of the longest-running and largest longitudinal phone survey initiatives in low- and middle-income countries. The paper examines three methodological challenges central to the sustainable implementation of the surveys: individual-level data collection and respondent selection, attrition, and integration of phone and in-person surveys in mixed-mode data systems. The Living Standards Measurement Study High-Frequency Phone Surveys initiative has provided continuous monitoring since April 2020 across six African countries, supporting more than 120 phone survey rounds and more than 200,000 interviews alongside a parallel system of in-person surveys. The paper shows that survey design choices can mitigate biases in individual-level data collection, although at the cost of interview length and logistical complexity. Attrition has been non-negligible but has not translated into significant sample bias. The paper discusses analytical and survey design strategies for addressing coverage bias and potential mode effects. It identifies priorities for future research, including ex-post adjustment methods for mode effects, high-frequency welfare measurement through proxy-based imputation, and the cost-quality-feasibility trade-offs of mixed-mode survey design. The Living Standards Measurement Study High-Frequency Phone Surveys experience demonstrates that the infrastructure, methods, and evidence base now exist to build genuinely integrated survey systems delivering reliable, timely, high-frequency data at substantially lower unit cost than in-person surveys alone.
url:b331c28047c25b6a.abstract_zh: 在COVID-19疫情期间，电话调查成为低收入和中等收入国家关键的数据收集工具，此后更成为许多地区数据格局中的常设组成部分。本文借鉴了生活水平测量研究高频电话调查的经验——这是低收入和中等收入国家中运行时间最长、规模最大的纵向电话调查项目之一。文章探讨了可持续实施这些调查所面临的三个核心方法论挑战：个体层面数据收集与受访者选择、样本流失，以及电话调查与面对面调查在混合模式数据系统中的整合。生活水平测量研究高频电话调查项目自2020年4月以来在六个非洲国家持续提供监测数据，支持了超过120轮电话调查和20多万次访谈，并辅以并行的面对面调查系统。本文表明，调查设计选择可以减轻个体层面数据收集中的偏差，但代价是增加访谈时长和后勤复杂性。样本流失虽不可忽视，但并未转化为显著的样本偏差。文章讨论了应对覆盖偏差和潜在模式效应的分析与调查设计策略，并确定了未来研究的优先事项，包括模式效应的事后调整方法、基于代理插补的高频福利测量，以及混合模式调查设计的成本-质量-可行性权衡。生活水平测量研究高频电话调查的经验表明，当前已具备基础设施、方法和证据基础，能够构建真正整合的调查系统，以远低于仅依赖面对面调查的单位成本提供可靠、及时、高频的数据。
url:b331c28047c25b6a.title: Six Years of High-Frequency Phone Surveys: Lessons from Sub-Saharan Africa
url:b331c28047c25b6a.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲六年高频电话调查的经验教训

url:b333a219dd61b088.abstract: We consider a monopolist selling a product to differentially informed consumers: some consumers are uncertain about their tastes, whereas other consumers are perfectly informed. The monopolist sets a uniform price and can make personalized product recommendations. We characterize conditions under which the monopolist biases its recommendations – that is, some consumers with values below the marginal cost follow the recommendation to buy the product or some consumers with values above the marginal cost follow the recommendation not to buy the product.
url:b333a219dd61b088.abstract_zh: 我们考察一个垄断者向信息差异化的消费者销售产品的情形：部分消费者对自己的偏好不确定，而其他消费者则完全知情。垄断者设定统一价格，并能提供个性化的产品推荐。我们刻画了垄断者偏向其推荐的条件——即，一些价值低于边际成本的消费者遵循推荐购买产品，或一些价值高于边际成本的消费者遵循推荐不购买产品。
url:b333a219dd61b088.title: DP20368 Biased Recommendations and Differentially Informed Consumers
url:b333a219dd61b088.title_zh: DP20368 有偏推荐与信息差异化的消费者

url:b33870a0440a85ea.title: Aggregate productivity effect of labour and capital market distortions in Canada
url:b33870a0440a85ea.title_zh: 加拿大劳动力与资本市场扭曲的总生产率效应

url:b33a98a9e6c34cc7.abstract: Can local government spending spur economic activity? We exploit a reform in Peru that redistributed natural resource tax revenues to municipalities in non-extractive areas, generating exogenous variation in inter-governmental transfers. Between 2006 and 2018, we estimate a dynamic cumulative fiscal multiplier of around 1.3, going up to 1.6 in more closed, rural areas. We show that the resulting windfalls boosted public investment, as intended by the reform. Using micro-data, we find increases in labor force participation, wage earnings and revenues for household firms and farms, with the strongest effects in agriculture. Consistent with this, we show that rural areas benefited the most, experiencing rises in income and consumption, and declines in poverty.
url:b33a98a9e6c34cc7.abstract_zh: 地方政府支出能否刺激经济活动？我们利用秘鲁的一项改革，该改革将自然资源税收收入重新分配给非采掘地区的市政当局，从而产生了政府间转移支付的外生变化。在2006年至2018年间，我们估计动态累积财政乘数约为1.3，在更为封闭的农村地区则上升至1.6。我们表明，由此产生的意外之财按改革初衷促进了公共投资。利用微观数据，我们发现劳动力参与率、工资收入以及家庭企业和农场的收入均有所增加，其中农业领域的效果最为显著。与此一致的是，我们显示农村地区受益最多，经历了收入和消费的增长以及贫困率的下降。
url:b33a98a9e6c34cc7.title: Resource Windfalls, Public Expenditure and Local Economies
url:b33a98a9e6c34cc7.title_zh: 资源横财、公共支出与地方经济

url:b33d2f025dbb0944.abstract: This paper uses own built historical register tracing the evolution of Italian higher education from the High Middle Ages to 2010 to analyse the economic effects of the rise of modern universities. The registry data prompts the creation of a panel dataset measuring higher education supply across 110 Italian provinces from 1870 to 2010, which corresponds to the transition from elite to mass higher education in Italy. Our econometric approach combines a fixed effects estimator with Bartik-style instruments that exploit the historical cross-province distribution of higher education institutions in Italy. We find significant economic returns of universities, particularly in synergy with industrialisation, contributing to Italy’s transition to sustained growth. Our estimates predict that a province exposed to an average supply (equivalent to 7 universities, approximately) experiences an annual 2% increase in real gross value added per capita compared to a province with a zero supply. We show that about two thirds of these returns arise locally, while the remaining third originates from externalities. We argue that such high local concentration of economic returns contribute to fostering inequalities between small peripheral areas and large university hubs. Similar content being viewed by others
url:b33d2f025dbb0944.abstract_zh: 本文利用自建的历史登记册，追溯意大利高等教育从中世纪盛期至2010年的演变历程，分析现代大学兴起的经济效应。该登记册数据构建了一个面板数据集，用于衡量1870年至2010年间意大利110个省份的高等教育供给，这一时期对应意大利从精英教育向大众教育的转型。我们的计量方法结合了固定效应估计量与巴蒂克式工具变量，后者利用了意大利各省份高等教育机构的历史分布差异。研究发现，大学具有显著的经济回报，尤其在与工业化协同作用时，推动了意大利向持续增长的转型。我们的估计预测，与零供给的省份相比，面临平均供给（约相当于7所大学）的省份，其人均实际总增加值每年增长2%。我们表明，这些回报中约三分之二产生于本地，其余三分之一源于外部性。我们认为，这种经济回报的高度本地集中加剧了小型边缘地区与大型大学中心之间的不平等。类似内容被其他读者阅读。
url:b33d2f025dbb0944.title: Keeping up with the Joneses? The rise of modern universities and local economic development in Italy
url:b33d2f025dbb0944.title_zh: 追赶琼斯？现代大学的兴起与意大利地方经济发展

url:b343e9c4d3917c5c.title: A uniformly valid test for instrument exogeneity
url:b343e9c4d3917c5c.title_zh: 工具变量外生性的一致有效检验

url:b34f8c43513f289c.abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of large shareholders and firm policies, where a blockholder engages with the firm to improve asset productivity and influence decisions on investment, financing, and executive compensation. In equilibrium, the blockholder’s ownership stake may grow or shrink over time driven by gains from trade that result from the relationship between ownership, corporate policies, and control. A feedback loop emerges: as the blockholder increases their ownership, it boosts investment and the firm's debt capacity, while higher returns from debt and investment incentivize the blockholder to increase their stake. While firm policies need not maximize dispersed shareholder value when the blockholder is in control, limiting blockholder influence ultimately reduces blockholder ownership and firm value.
url:b34f8c43513f289c.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于大股东与企业政策动态关系的理论模型。在该模型中，大宗持股者通过参与公司治理提升资产生产率，并影响投资、融资及高管薪酬等决策。在均衡状态下，大宗持股者的所有权份额会随时间推移而增减，这种变化源于所有权结构、企业政策与控制权之间的交易收益关系。由此形成反馈循环：当大宗持股者增持股份时，会促进投资并提升企业债务容量，而债务与投资带来的更高回报又激励其进一步增持。尽管在大宗持股者控制下，企业政策未必能最大化分散股东价值，但限制其影响力最终将导致持股比例下降与企业价值受损。
url:b34f8c43513f289c.title: Ownership Dynamics and Firm Policies with a Large Shareholder
url:b34f8c43513f289c.title_zh: 大股东持股下的所有权动态与企业政策

url:b35451de5d07109f.title_zh: 重复2×2反协调博弈中策略的演化

url:b35ccd880aa668f3.title_zh: 1850–1960年间极端气候事件对英属西印度群岛农业多样化的影响

url:b36474539cea1dcf.title: Why Didn't I Get a Payout? Understanding Farmer Choices, Index Insurance, and Basis Risk
url:b36474539cea1dcf.title_zh: 为什么我没有获得赔付？理解农民选择、指数保险与基差风险

url:b383ead9b461c184.abstract: Despite the formal end of Apartheid in 1994, South Africa remains one of the most unequal countries in the world. This paper investigates the mechanisms behind this persistence of inequality by developing a spatial dynastic model with heterogeneous agents, incomplete markets, and endogenous choices over education, occupation, savings, and location. Drawing on newly assembled micro-geographic data, we document a shift in inequality from being primarily across races to increasingly within the Black population, with spatial segregation — especially the legacy of Townships — playing a key role. Our model, disciplined by detailed spatial and socioeconomic data, captures the slow intergenerational convergence in education and occupational outcomes observed in post-Apartheid South Africa. It shows how inherited spatial disadvantages — through high commuting costs, disparities in school quality, and limited access to credit — continue to shape households’ educational, occupational, and locational choices, reinforcing inequality long after formal legal barriers have been removed. Quantitatively, we find that removing persistent spatial distortions in Townships accelerates the transition to a race-blind equilibrium by 40% and reduces income inequality by 10%.
url:b383ead9b461c184.abstract_zh: 尽管种族隔离制度在1994年正式结束，南非仍是世界上不平等程度最高的国家之一。本文通过构建一个包含异质性主体、不完全市场以及教育、职业、储蓄和区位内生选择的空间动态模型，探讨了不平等持续存在的机制。利用新整理的微观地理数据，我们记录了不平等从主要跨种族差异转向黑人群体内部日益加剧的过程，其中空间隔离——尤其是乡镇（Townships）遗留问题——扮演了关键角色。我们的模型，依据详细的空间和社会经济数据进行校准，捕捉到了后种族隔离时代南非教育及职业成果缓慢的代际趋同现象。模型揭示了继承性空间劣势如何通过高通勤成本、学校质量差异及信贷获取受限，持续影响家庭的教育、职业和区位选择，从而在正式法律障碍消除后长期强化不平等。定量分析显示，消除乡镇中持续存在的空间扭曲，可使向种族中立均衡的过渡加速40%，并降低10%的收入不平等。
url:b383ead9b461c184.title: End of Apartheid, Not of Inequality: The Slow Transition in a Segregated Economy
url:b383ead9b461c184.title_zh: 种族隔离的终结，不平等的延续：隔离经济中的缓慢转型

url:b38850280b5c03f3.abstract: Banks use their internal models to estimate capital requirements in a risk-sensitive way, subject to a set of rules laid down in banking regulation. However, these models are not flawless as the usage of models suffers from imperfections, such as oversimplifications or wrong assumptions. As a result, risks may be underestimated. This is particularly troublesome, where models are used to assess risks to banks’ solvency. In this paper we address an important gap in the literature with regard to such model risk. We find that a small set of high severity deficiencies in models is responsible for the majority of the counterfactual RWA burden imposed by supervisory capital add-ons. We trace the underlying non-compliances to a subset of CRR articles that mostly govern the handling of IRB-relevant data by banks. Our results help improve the supervision of IRB-banks by proposing more efficient use of scarce supervisory resources. JEL Classification: G21, G28, G29
url:b38850280b5c03f3.abstract_zh: 银行利用内部模型以风险敏感的方式估算资本要求，并遵循银行业监管规定中的一系列规则。然而，这些模型并非完美无缺，因为模型的使用存在缺陷，如过度简化或错误假设。因此，风险可能被低估。在模型被用于评估银行偿付能力风险的情况下，这一问题尤为棘手。本文针对文献中关于此类模型风险的重要空白进行了探讨。我们发现，少数高严重性的模型缺陷导致了监管资本附加费所施加的反事实风险加权资产负担的大部分。我们将潜在的不合规行为追溯至《资本要求监管条例》中主要规范银行处理内部评级法相关数据的若干条款。我们的研究结果通过提出更有效地利用稀缺监管资源，有助于改进对内部评级法银行的监管。JEL分类：G21, G28, G29
url:b38850280b5c03f3.title: Severity over quantity. Drivers of supervisory capital add-ons in internal ratings-based models
url:b38850280b5c03f3.title_zh: 严重性重于数量：内部评级法模型中监管资本附加的驱动因素

url:b398aabd143778df.title: Macroprudential Policy and Capital Flows
url:b398aabd143778df.title_zh: 宏观审慎政策与资本流动

url:b3990a16680c2760.abstract: Family-friendly policies aim to help women balance work and family life, encouraging them to participate in the labor market. How effective are such policies in increasing fertility? We answer this question using a search model of the labor market where firms make hiring, promotion, and firing decisions, taking into account how these decisions affect workers' fertility incentives and labor force participation decisions. We estimate the model using administrative data from Spain, a country with very low fertility and a highly regulated labor market. We use the model to study family-friendly policies and demonstrate that firms' reactions result in a trade-off: policies that increase fertility reduce women's participation in the labor market and lower their lifetime earnings.
url:b3990a16680c2760.abstract_zh: 家庭友好型政策旨在帮助女性平衡工作与家庭生活，鼓励她们参与劳动力市场。此类政策在提高生育率方面效果如何？我们通过一个劳动力市场搜寻模型来回答这一问题，在该模型中，企业做出雇佣、晋升和解雇决策，并考虑这些决策如何影响工人的生育激励和劳动力参与决策。我们利用西班牙的行政数据估计该模型，西班牙是一个生育率极低且劳动力市场监管高度严格的国家。我们运用该模型研究家庭友好型政策，并证明企业的反应导致了一种权衡：提高生育率的政策会减少女性在劳动力市场的参与，并降低其终身收入。
url:b3990a16680c2760.title: Family-Friendly Policies and Fertility: What Firms Have to Do With It?
url:b3990a16680c2760.title_zh: 家庭友好政策与生育：企业为何与之相关？

url:b39a739f42a394c3.abstract: This paper introduces a labour force participation choice into a standard labour market matching model embedded in a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium set-up. The participation choice is modelled as a trade-off between forgoing the expected benefits of being search active and engaging in costly labour market search. In contrast to models with constant labour force participation, the model that we analyse induces a symmetry in firms' and workers' search decision since both sides of the labour market vary search effort at the extensive margins. We show that this set-up is (a) of considerable analytical convenience, and (b) that the introduction of a participation choice leads to a strong tendency for procyclical unemployment, very low volatility of labour market tightness, and for a positively sloped Beveridge curve. These implications are summarized by a linear relationship between the vu-ratio and the marginal utility of consumption that we refer to as the consumption-tightness puzzle given its counterfacutal implications. Moreover, we show that this relationship survives a number of extentions of the standard model and that it derives from the allowance for an endogeneous labour market participation choice.
url:b39a739f42a394c3.abstract_zh: 本文将劳动力参与选择引入嵌入动态随机一般均衡框架的标准劳动力市场匹配模型。参与选择被建模为放弃参与搜索活动的预期收益与承担高成本劳动力市场搜索之间的权衡。与劳动力参与率恒定的模型不同，本文分析的模型在企业和工人的搜索决策中引入了对称性，因为劳动力市场的双方都在集约边际上调整搜索努力。研究表明，这一设定（a）具有显著的分析便利性，且（b）引入参与选择会导致失业呈现强顺周期性、劳动力市场紧度波动性极低，以及贝弗里奇曲线呈正斜率。这些特征通过失业-职位空缺比率与消费边际效用之间的线性关系得以概括，鉴于其反事实含义，我们将其称为“消费-紧度之谜”。此外，我们证明这一关系在标准模型的多种扩展中依然成立，且其根源在于允许内生化的劳动力市场参与选择。
url:b39a739f42a394c3.title: The Consumption-Tightness Puzzle

url:b3a02bd2a6fd2aec.title: Unwillingly informed: the prosocial impact of third-party informers
url:b3a02bd2a6fd2aec.title_zh: 非自愿知情：第三方告知者的亲社会影响

url:b3a58253cdb46b23.abstract: The relationship between unemployment and the rate of change of money wages in interwar Britain is re-examined. It is argued that improved estimates of the wage equation can be obtained by taking account explicitly of factors which change the level of excess demand associated with the measured unemployment rate. In particular, the evidence suggests that long-term unemployment did not act as a restraint on the growth of money wages. New estimates of the wage equation imply that the NAIRU rose during the 1930s as the proportion of unemployment that was long term was higher than in the late 1920s.
url:b3a58253cdb46b23.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了两次世界大战期间英国失业率与货币工资变动率之间的关系。研究表明，通过明确考虑那些改变与实测失业率相关的超额需求水平的因素，可以获得对工资方程的更优估计。具体而言，证据表明长期失业并未对货币工资增长起到抑制作用。工资方程的新估计表明，由于20世纪30年代长期失业占比高于20年代末，该时期的非加速通货膨胀失业率有所上升。
url:b3a58253cdb46b23.title: DP147 Long-Term Unemployment, Excess Demand and the Wage Equation in Britain, 1925-39
url:b3a58253cdb46b23.title_zh: DP147 英国长期失业、超额需求与工资方程（1925-1939）

url:b3b47a8f54e0dde7.abstract: Policymakers frequently implement environmental policies that are less ambitious than what voters would prefer. We document this gap using findings from previous research as well as evidence from climate policy in Austria
url:b3b47a8f54e0dde7.abstract_zh: 政策制定者经常实施的环境政策，其力度往往低于选民所期望的水平。我们通过先前研究的发现以及奥地利气候政策的证据，记录了这一差距。
url:b3b47a8f54e0dde7.title: Voter Preferences, Party Politics and Environmental Policy Reform
url:b3b47a8f54e0dde7.title_zh: 选民偏好、政党政治与环境政策改革

url:b3bb07812669ed0b.abstract: This paper presents the first systematic city-level mapping of global scientific talent, analysing the top 200,000 star scientists across 3,635 cities worldwide annually between 2019 and 2023. We use a novel Knowledge Generation Index (KGI) that combines researcher quantity with research impact to reveal extreme spatial concentration in knowledge production. Just four cities — New York, Boston, London and the San Francisco Bay Area — host 12% of the world's star scientists, while much of the Global South remains virtually excluded from frontier research. Beijing's ascent into the global top ten represents a rare challenge to established hierarchies. Our analysis uncovers striking disciplinary variations. Resource-intensive fields like clinical medicine cluster heavily and traditionally dispersed disciplines are increasingly gravitating toward major hubs. Despite these differences, concentration is intensifying across most scientific fields. Even the pandemic's remote collaboration experiment failed to level the playing field. Established innovation centres continued strengthening their advantages while peripheral regions fell further behind. Overall, we find that geography remains destiny, with profound implications for innovation policy confronting widening spatial inequalities in global scientific capacity.
url:b3bb07812669ed0b.abstract_zh: 本文首次对全球科学人才进行了系统性的城市级图谱分析，涵盖了2019年至2023年间全球3，635个城市中排名前20万的顶尖科学家。我们采用了一种新颖的知识生成指数（KGI），该指数结合了研究者数量与研究影响力，揭示了知识生产中极端的空间集中现象。仅四个城市——纽约、波士顿、伦敦和旧金山湾区——就汇聚了全球12%的顶尖科学家，而全球南方的大部分地区则几乎被排斥在前沿研究之外。北京跻身全球前十，对既有等级秩序构成了罕见的挑战。我们的分析揭示了显著的学科差异。资源密集型领域如临床医学高度集中，而传统上分散的学科正日益向主要枢纽聚集。尽管存在这些差异，大多数科学领域的集中趋势仍在加剧。即便是疫情期间的远程协作实验也未能拉平竞争环境。既有的创新中心持续强化其优势，而边缘地区则进一步落后。总体而言，我们发现地理因素仍是决定性的，这对应对全球科学能力空间不平等日益扩大的创新政策具有深远意义。
url:b3bb07812669ed0b.title: Finding Stars: Mapping the Geography of the World’s Scientific Elites

url:b3db9d93caa088c1.abstract: Using administrative data on the largest group of German labor market entrants - graduates from an apprenticeship in a specific occupation - this paper studies the effect of entry conditions on occupational mismatch. Higher entry unemployment entails persistent earnings losses driven by full-time wage effects. Concurrently, occupational matching falls, accounting for 20% of the wage effect. A framework shows that mismatch can arise from cyclical training firm retention or occupation-specific shocks, which I confirm empirically using novel data on occupation-specific unemployment. The findings highlight that specific skills protect graduates from unemployment but may expose them to costly occupational mismatch.
url:b3db9d93caa088c1.abstract_zh: 本文利用德国最大规模劳动力市场新进入群体（特定职业学徒毕业生）的行政数据，研究进入条件对职业错配的影响。更高的进入期失业率会通过全职工资效应导致持续的收入损失。与此同时，职业匹配度下降，占工资效应的20%。一个分析框架表明，错配可能源于周期性培训企业留用或职业特定冲击，本文利用职业特定失业率的新数据对此进行了实证验证。研究结果强调，特定技能虽能保护毕业生免于失业，但可能使其面临代价高昂的职业错配。

url:b44149b9d1d7f899.abstract: This study provides evidence that geopolitical considerations systematically shape funding evaluations of international collaboration proposals. We examine this dynamic in the consequential context of U.S.–China collaboration. Across two large-scale randomized experiments with U.S. policymakers and U.S.-based scientists, we find substantial and consistent penalties for proposals involving China-based collaborators. Policymakers express much greater unconditional support for proposals with Germany-based collaborators than for otherwise identical proposals with China-based collaborators (68% vs. 28%). Crucially, this penalty is not confined to policymakers: scientists themselves exhibit a sizeable 18 percentage-point gap (48% vs. 30%), despite professional expectations of merit-based evaluation. Much of the difference reflects a shift from unconditional to conditional approval rather than outright rejection. These penalties are remarkably consistent across scientific fields and respondent characteristics, with little evidence of heterogeneity, indicating that they reflect geopolitical rather than domain-specific concerns. Overall, the findings suggest that geopolitics influences gatekeeping judgments in government funding, with broad implications for peer review, scientific norms, and the future of international collaboration in an era of intensifying geopolitical competition.
url:b44149b9d1d7f899.abstract_zh: 本研究提供证据表明，地缘政治考量系统性地影响了对国际合作提案的资助评估。我们在中美合作这一重要背景下考察了这一动态。通过对美国政策制定者及美国本土科学家进行的两项大规模随机实验，我们发现涉及中国合作者的提案遭受了显著且一致的惩罚。政策制定者对涉及德国合作者的提案所表达的无条件支持远高于对条件相同但涉及中国合作者的提案（68%对比28%）。至关重要的是，这种惩罚并不仅限于政策制定者：科学家自身也表现出高达18个百分点的差距（48%对比30%），尽管专业规范期望基于绩效的评估。这一差异大部分反映了从无条件批准向有条件批准的转变，而非直接否决。这些惩罚在不同科学领域及受访者特征中表现出高度一致性，几乎没有异质性的证据，表明它们反映的是地缘政治关切而非特定领域的问题。总体而言，研究结果表明，地缘政治影响着政府资助中的把关判断，对同行评审、科学规范以及在地缘政治竞争日益激烈的时代国际合作的未来具有广泛启示。

url:b48ade223b318072.abstract: Fiscal multipliers are larger during natural disasters. Using aggregate and state-level U.S. data, we show that the government-spending multiplier is significantly magnified when natural disasters occur. To rationalize this finding, we develop a New-Keynesian model augmented with disaster risk, in which higher public spending generates a larger output expansion through a strengthened investment channel. Two mechanisms are at work. First, by destroying productive capacity, a disaster raises the marginal productivity of capital, which further crowds in private investment. Second, wealth destruction leads households to draw down less of their savings in response to the fiscal shock, which boosts capital supply.
url:b48ade223b318072.abstract_zh: 自然灾害期间财政乘数显著增大。基于美国全国及州级数据，我们发现当自然灾害发生时，政府支出乘数会显著放大。为解释这一现象，我们构建了纳入灾害风险的新凯恩斯模型，其中公共支出通过强化投资渠道产生更大的产出扩张效应。两种机制在发挥作用：其一，灾害破坏生产能力后，资本边际生产率提升，进而挤出私人投资；其二，财富损失导致家庭在面临财政冲击时减少储蓄消耗，从而增加资本供给。
url:b48ade223b318072.title: Fiscal Multipliers during Natural Disasters

url:b4a3461b5613612e.abstract: this paper, we provide a comprehensive analysis of how changes in capital requirements affect bank lending. We use a theoretical framework to assess and nuance the trade-off. We show that imperfect competition, general equilibrium effects, and asset heterogeneity among banks result in lending responses that are complex and difficult to estimate. Armed with these theoretical insights, we assess existing strategies in the empirical literature and provide guidance for future research.
url:b4a3461b5613612e.abstract_zh: 本文全面分析了资本要求变化如何影响银行放贷。我们运用理论框架来评估并细化这一权衡关系。研究表明，不完全竞争、一般均衡效应以及银行间资产异质性导致放贷反应复杂且难以估计。基于这些理论洞见，我们评估了实证文献中的现有策略，并为未来研究提供指导。

url:b4e1901ea23525d0.abstract: Monetary policy is usually evaluated through its effect on aggregate output and inflation, with less attention to how it reallocates innovative investment across firms. Existing evidence shows that higher rates reduce innovation, but the firms driving this response remain unclear. Combining Norway’s R&D survey with administrative data and narrative monetary shocks for 2001–2018, we estimate heterogeneous firm responses. Contractionary policy reduces R&D most in high-growth firms with recent equity issuance, consistent with asset-price channels of monetary transmission. Standard debt-based measures explain little heterogeneity. Monetary policy therefore has long-run real effects primarily through its effects on R&D in high-growth firms.
url:b4e1901ea23525d0.abstract_zh: 货币政策通常通过其对总产出和通货膨胀的影响来评估，而较少关注其如何在企业间重新配置创新投资。现有证据表明，较高的利率会减少创新，但驱动这一反应的企业类型尚不明确。结合挪威的研发调查、行政数据以及2001-2018年间的叙事性货币冲击，我们估计了企业的异质性反应。紧缩性政策对近期有股权发行的高增长企业的研发削减最为显著，这与货币传导的资产价格渠道相符。基于债务的标准指标对异质性的解释力有限。因此，货币政策主要通过其对高增长企业研发的影响产生长期实际效应。

url:b4f3ac3aeb18128c.abstract: This paper examines the limitations of spot markets in providing adequate investment incentives to support zero-carbon investments in electricity markets. In contrast, properly designed long-term contracts have the potential to mitigate price volatility and facilitate the funding of the investments. A theoretical model is developed to analyze contract design under conditions of moral hazard and adverse selection, emphasizing the trade-offs that arise when exposing firms to price and quantity risk. The findings inform optimal contract design for nuclear and renewable energy projects, offering policy recommendations to enhance investment incentives while minimizing productive inefficiencies and excessive rents.
url:b4f3ac3aeb18128c.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了现货市场在提供充足投资激励以支持电力市场零碳投资方面的局限性。相比之下，设计得当的长期合同具有缓解价格波动并促进投资融资的潜力。本文构建了一个理论模型，用于分析道德风险和逆向选择条件下的合同设计，重点揭示了企业在面临价格与数量风险时所产生的权衡关系。研究结论为核能与可再生能源项目的最优合同设计提供了依据，并提出了相关政策建议，以在增强投资激励的同时，减少生产效率损失与超额租金。
url:b4f3ac3aeb18128c.title: Designing Contracts for the Energy Transition

url:b4f4bdc4f724b837.abstract: Banking Union (BU) membership comes with costs, such as foregoing the ability to tailor domestic banking regulation to the country’s needs and preferences; and benefits, such as a more efficient provision of deposit insurance. We use a general equilibrium model that features a rich financial sector, risk shocks, optimal bank capital regulation and government-provided deposit insurance to evaluate the implications of BU membership for welfare, macroeconomic activity and financial stability. BU participation is favored by a riskier and more consequential --for economic activity-- banking sector. Nevertheless, there are cases of welfare improving membership that are not associated with higher and more stable macroeconomic performance and financial stability.
url:b4f4bdc4f724b837.abstract_zh: 银行联盟（BU）成员身份既带来成本，例如放弃根据本国需求和偏好调整国内银行监管的能力；也带来收益，例如更高效的存款保险供给。我们采用包含复杂金融部门、风险冲击、最优银行资本监管及政府提供存款保险的一般均衡模型，评估BU成员身份对福利、宏观经济活动及金融稳定的影响。风险更高且对经济活动影响更显著的银行部门更倾向于加入BU。然而，存在福利改善型成员身份案例，其并未伴随更高且更稳定的宏观经济表现与金融稳定。

url:b544ab1445a567c8.abstract: This study examines financial challenges faced by justice-involved individuals using 2023-2024 Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking data. Individuals with justice system contact experience substantially worse financial outcomes than those without criminal records, with disparities widening by severity of involvement. Compared to individuals with no prior records, those arrested but not convicted are 4 percentage points less likely to report doing at least okay financially, while formerly convicted as well as incarcerated adults are 15 percentage points less likely. Formerly incarcerated individuals are also 21 percentage points less likely to have credit scores above 660 and 13 percentage points less likely to have credit cards. These disparities mirror patterns observed across education levels, where adults with lower educational attainment experience lower financial well-being and inclusion. Our findings document substantial barriers to financial stability among justice-involved populations and may inform policies promoting financial inclusion and improving economic outcomes for this group.
url:b544ab1445a567c8.abstract_zh: 本研究利用2023-2024年美国家庭经济与决策调查数据，考察了涉法个体面临的金融挑战。与无犯罪记录者相比，有司法系统接触经历的个体在财务结果上显著更差，且差距随涉法程度加深而扩大。相较于无前科者，曾被逮捕但未被定罪者报告财务状况至少尚可的概率低4个百分点，而曾被定罪及监禁的成年人则低15个百分点。曾被监禁者信用评分超过660分的概率低21个百分点，持有信用卡的概率低13个百分点。这些差异与不同教育水平群体中观察到的模式一致——受教育程度较低的成年人财务福祉与金融包容性更低。研究结果揭示了涉法群体在金融稳定性方面面临的重大障碍，可为促进该群体金融包容性、改善其经济状况的政策制定提供参考。
url:b544ab1445a567c8.title: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

url:b559dceb1e691290.abstract: 본 연구는 새로운 지식(혁신)의 창출 현황을 ‘국가-산업 간 네트워크’ 관점에서 살펴보고 ‘혁신 네트워크’ 참여의 경제적 함의에 대해 분석하였다. 지금까지 정책 입안자들은 기술을 발전시키고 혁신 역량을 강화하면서 의례히 자국의 R&D 투자 총액을 늘리는 데 집중해 왔다. 하지만 현대 사회에서 혁신은 한 국가, 산업 또는 기업의 자체적인 R&D만으로는 달성이 불가능하다. 한 국가 내에서뿐만 아니라 국경을 넘어 다른 나라에서의, 다른 산업에서의 혁신은 또 다른 국가로, 또 다른 산업으로 여러 경로를 통해 공유되고 전파되므로 이 점을 충분히 고려하여 정책을 만들어 나가야 한다. 특히 한국의 경우 네트워크의 중요성은 다시 한번 강조될 필요가 있다. This research project examines the current state of new knowledge creation from the perspective of global knowledge networks and analyzes the economic implications of participating in the so-called ‘innovation network.’ Policymakers have as a matter of course prioritized increasing their own country’s total R&D investment to advance technology and strengthen innovation. This research, however, asserts that in our current economic environment innovation cannot be achieved solely through the R&D of a single country, industry, or company. Policies must be formulated with the full understanding that innovation is shared and disseminated across borders—flowing from other countries and industries to new ones through various channels. For Korea, in particular, participating in these networks are critical.
url:b559dceb1e691290.abstract_zh: 本研究从“国家-产业间网络”视角审视新知识（创新）的创造现状，并分析了参与“创新网络”的经济含义。迄今为止，政策制定者在推动技术发展、强化创新能力时，通常侧重于增加本国研发投资总额。然而，在现代社会中，创新无法仅凭单一国家、产业或企业自身的研发实现。创新不仅在一国内部，更跨越国界，从其他国家、其他产业通过多种渠道共享与传播至另一国家或产业，因此政策制定必须充分考虑这一点。尤其对韩国而言，网络的重要性需要再次强调。

url:b57c3d6bee9916cb.abstract: Governments increasingly use protection and targeted subsidies to promote domestic firms. These policies are usually evaluated in the market they target. This column uses India's 4G rollout to show why that can be misleading when products and infrastructure are complements. Restricting low-priced Chinese phones slowed 4G network expansion and did not raise Indian phone firms' profits, while a subsidy open to all 4G phones accelerated coverage more than a domestic-only subsidy.
url:b57c3d6bee9916cb.abstract_zh: 各国政府日益采用保护措施和定向补贴来扶持本土企业。这些政策通常在所针对的市场中进行评估。本文利用印度4G网络的推广案例，说明当产品与基础设施为互补品时，此类评估可能产生误导。限制低价中国手机减缓了4G网络的扩展，且并未提升印度手机企业的利润，而面向所有4G手机的补贴在加速网络覆盖方面，效果优于仅限本土企业的补贴。
url:b57c3d6bee9916cb.title: Industrial policy in complementary markets: Lessons from India's 4G rollout
