url:be01d86987215aa9.abstract: This paper examines how early socio-emotional skills shape adolescent offending in England and the school pathways through which they operate. I use administrative data linking teacher-reported child development assessments at age five to school and criminal justice records through age 17. Factor analysis of these assessments reveals two underlying domains of early difficulty, cognitive and socio-emotional. Both raise the probability of a caution or conviction between ages 11 and 17 by around 15%, but through distinct channels. Cognitive difficulties act primarily through academic attainment, while socio-emotional difficulties operate largely through school exclusions yet retain a substantial direct effect, accounting for around 40% of the total effect. The socio-emotional effect is robust to unobserved school and family heterogeneity and shapes both the type and frequency of offending. Statutory support for learning difficulties and social care services attenuates the associations between early skill deficits and offending. These findings suggest that differentiated support is needed based on the type of difficulty.
url:be01d86987215aa9.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了早期社会情感技能如何塑造英格兰青少年的犯罪行为及其通过学校路径发挥作用的机制。我利用行政数据，将五岁时教师评估的儿童发展结果与至17岁的学校及刑事司法记录相链接。对这些评估的因子分析揭示了早期困难的两个潜在领域：认知与社会情感。两者均使11至17岁期间受到警告或定罪的概率提高约15%，但通过不同的渠道发挥作用。认知困难主要通过学业成就起作用，而社会情感困难则主要通过学校排斥产生影响，但仍保留显著的直接效应，约占总效应的40%。社会情感效应在考虑未观测到的学校与家庭异质性后依然稳健，并影响犯罪类型及频率。针对学习困难和社会关怀服务的法定支持减弱了早期技能缺陷与犯罪行为之间的关联。这些发现表明，根据困难类型需要提供差异化的支持。
url:be01d86987215aa9.title: Early socio-emotional skills and adolescent offending: evidence from administrative data
url:be01d86987215aa9.title_zh: 早期社会情感技能与青少年犯罪：来自行政数据的证据

url:be1f14e96b113666.abstract: Human beings often combat the free-riding tendency by establishing punishment institutions in social dilemmas. This paper investigates the interaction between formal and informal punishment institutions and explores how their combination affects cooperation. The experiment incorporates the Formal Punishment Treatment (FT), Informal Punishment Treatment (IPT), and their combination (F&IPT) to analyze their impact on contributions to public goods. The results show that the combination of formal and informal punishment (F&IPT) leads to significantly higher contributions compared to both the formal punishment institution (FT) and the informal punishment institution (IPT) alone, demonstrating a complementary relationship between the two. This study highlights the complementary relationship between formal and informal punishment mechanisms in sustaining higher levels of cooperation in public goods provision.
url:be1f14e96b113666.abstract_zh: 人类常通过在社会困境中建立惩罚机制来遏制搭便车行为。本文研究了正式与非正式惩罚机制之间的相互作用，并探讨两者结合如何影响合作水平。实验设置了正式惩罚机制（FT）、非正式惩罚机制（IPT）及其组合机制（F&IPT），分析其对公共品贡献的影响。结果表明，正式与非正式惩罚的组合机制（F&IPT）带来的贡献水平显著高于单独使用正式惩罚机制（FT）或非正式惩罚机制（IPT），两者呈现互补关系。本研究揭示了正式与非正式惩罚机制在维持公共品供给中更高合作水平方面的互补性。
url:be1f14e96b113666.title: Interaction between formal punishment institution and informal centralized punishment institution

url:be59c0c0f715359b.abstract: Ecolabels are supposed to reduce the information asymmetry between producers and consumers, but they may also produce a warm glow of “green” behavior. We design discrete choice experiments to measure the relative importance of these motivations for choosing ecolabeled seafood products. We find that choice probability increases if the product carries an ecolabel, but the magnitude of this effect depends on which further information is provided about the sustainability of the product. Overall, we attribute 63% of the ecolabel’s original effect on choice probability to consumer demand for sustainable products, and further 24% to warm glow. url:be59c0c0f715359b.abstract_zh: 生态标签旨在减少生产者与消费者之间的信息不对称，但同时也可能激发“绿色”行为的温暖光辉。我们设计了离散选择实验，以衡量这些动机在选择生态标签海产品时的相对重要性。研究发现，若产品带有生态标签，其选择概率会上升，但这一效应的大小取决于所提供关于产品可持续性的额外信息。总体而言，我们将生态标签对选择概率原始效应的63%归因于消费者对可持续产品的需求，另有24%归因于温暖光辉效应。JEL分类号：C25 Q21 本文为开放获取文章，遵循CC-BY-NC-ND许可协议（http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0），并可在以下网址免费获取：http://le.uwpress.org。

url:be5d51d1377c7ff6.abstract: Glyphosate, the active ingredient of the herbicide RoundUp, has been subject to extensive scrutiny since the introduction of genetically engineered glyphosate tolerant crops in 1995. However, both a lack of observational studies and continued uncertainty around the toxicity of glyphosate emissions contribute to international political controversy and numerous civil actions at a time when US rural health measures are worsening and youth cancer rates are rising. Recent quasi-experimental studies using genetically engineered crop adoption as a source of exposure variation found glyphosate applications caused deleterious infant health effects in rural US areas, but we are unsure their exposure is truly exogenous. We reassess glyphosate’s effects on infant health using two sources of exposure variation in two-stage least squares instrumental variable approaches for twelve different infant health measures. We first similarly employ genetically engineered crop adoption but using seed sale marketing data, which is a more accurate measure of adoption relative to previous attempts. We then use changes in glyphosate product characteristics from the introduction of generic product types using product sales marking data, which is a novel separate source of variation. We do not find any consistent significant health changes from glyphosate exposure, where estimates are generally precise, pass typical assumption tests, and are robust to alternative specifications. By investigating the association between genetically engineered crop adoption and several rural co-occurring health and agricultural trends, we obtain evidence exposure variation from genetically engineered crop adoption is probably not independent from other agricultural production externalities. While this study provides evidence glyphosate did not contribute to rural health problems from 1995 to 2013, we believe pesticide data limitations, continued glyphosate controversy, and remaining potential for toxic agricultural emissions justifies evaluations of improved environmental monitoring.
url:be5d51d1377c7ff6.abstract_zh: 草甘膦，作为除草剂RoundUp的活性成分，自1995年转基因耐草甘膦作物引入以来，一直受到广泛关注。然而，观察性研究的缺乏以及草甘膦排放毒性方面的持续不确定性，在美国农村健康指标恶化、青少年癌症发病率上升之际，引发了国际政治争议和大量民事诉讼。近期利用转基因作物采用作为暴露变异来源的准实验研究发现，草甘膦施用对美国农村地区婴儿健康产生了不良影响，但我们不确定其暴露是否真正外生。我们重新评估草甘膦对婴儿健康的影响，采用两种暴露变异来源，通过两阶段最小二乘工具变量方法，针对十二项不同的婴儿健康指标进行分析。首先，我们同样利用转基因作物的采用情况，但使用种子销售市场数据，这比以往尝试更能准确衡量采用程度。其次，我们利用产品市场销售数据，通过引入非专利产品类型导致的草甘膦产品特性变化，这是一个新颖且独立的变异来源。我们未发现草甘膦暴露导致任何一致且显著的健康变化，估计结果普遍精确，通过常规假设检验，并对不同规格设定具有稳健性。通过探究转基因作物采用与农村地区同时发生的健康及农业趋势之间的关联，我们获得证据表明，转基因作物采用带来的暴露变异可能并非独立于其他农业生产外部性。尽管本研究提供了1995年至2013年间草甘膦未导致农村健康问题的证据，但我们认为，农药数据局限性、持续的草甘膦争议以及有毒农业排放的潜在风险，都要求对改进环境监测进行评估。
url:be5d51d1377c7ff6.title: Perhaps Still the Lesser Evil? The Trouble Investigating Glyphosate Health Effects in the US
url:be5d51d1377c7ff6.title_zh: 或许仍是较轻之恶？美国草甘膦健康效应调查之困境

url:be7837fb8dc29cea.abstract: This paper analyzes a global map of dollar exposures and examines the relationship between net dollar exposures, defined as the difference between dollar assets and liabilities, and covered interest parity (CIP) deviations. We find that the cross-sectional relationship is significantly negative in advanced economies but positive in emerging markets. CIP deviations represent the hedging cost that foreign holders of dollar assets or liabilities incur to manage exchange rate risk. To explain, we develop a model in which the CIP deviations are determined by the demand and the supply side of hedging. The negative correlation in advanced economies can be explained by the variations in hedging demand. Larger net dollar exposures increase the hedging demand, raising hedging costs (reflected as more negative CIP deviations) and producing a negative correlation. In contrast, the positive correlation in emerging markets is explained by the supply side of the hedging market. Limited hedging supply leads to wider CIP deviations (more negative), encouraging firms to borrow in U.S. dollars rather than local currencies, thereby reducing net dollar exposures and generating a positive correlation.
url:be7837fb8dc29cea.abstract_zh: 本文分析了全球美元敞口分布图，并考察了净美元敞口（定义为美元资产与负债之差）与套息平价（CIP）偏离之间的关系。我们发现，在发达经济体中，这一横截面关系显著为负，而在新兴市场中则为正。CIP偏离代表了美元资产或负债的外国持有者为管理汇率风险而产生的对冲成本。为解释这一现象，我们构建了一个模型，其中CIP偏离由对冲需求方和供给方共同决定。发达经济体中的负相关可由对冲需求的变动来解释。较大的净美元敞口增加对冲需求，推高对冲成本（表现为更负的CIP偏离），从而产生负相关关系。相反，新兴市场中的正相关则由对冲市场的供给方解释。有限的对冲供给导致CIP偏离扩大（更负），促使企业以美元而非本币借款，从而减少净美元敞口，并产生正相关关系。

url:beb7a37c34f705d8.abstract: This paper empirically tests whether Rolex watches may be considered safe-haven assets. To accomplish this, we employ Local Gaussian Correlations and spectral analysis spanning from 19 January 2017 to 7 July 2023, examining the relationship between the Rolex market index (indicating the average market price of the watches) and more conventional assets, namely: S&P 500, Oil, Nikkei, Eurostoxx, Gold, REIT, EEM and Bitcoin. The results revealed that the Rolex market index, and hence Rolex watches, exhibited safe-haven properties during the pandemic crisis in the majority of the cases (except for Gold and REIT). This finding is vital for global investors since the identified safe-haven features might help enhance portfolio diversification strategies in anticipation of future crises.
url:beb7a37c34f705d8.abstract_zh: 本文实证检验了劳力士手表是否可被视为避险资产。为此，我们采用局部高斯相关性和谱分析方法，研究时间跨度自2017年1月19日至2023年7月7日，考察劳力士市场指数（反映手表平均市场价格）与更传统资产之间的关系，这些资产包括：标普500指数、石油、日经指数、欧洲斯托克指数、黄金、房地产投资信托基金、新兴市场指数及比特币。结果显示，在疫情期间，劳力士市场指数及其所代表的劳力士手表在多数情况下展现出避险属性（黄金和房地产投资信托基金除外）。这一发现对全球投资者至关重要，因为识别出的避险特征可能有助于在未来危机前优化投资组合多元化策略。

url:bee4c4fad562dcf1.abstract: During the five decades since the creation of the Bank of Israel in 1954 Israel experienced high and extremely variable inflation. Price stability (as defined by current international norms) was finally achieved at the beginning of the twenty first century. The paper divides the 1954-2015 sample into six sub-periods characterized by different inflation environments. The first part of the paper documents the impact of those different inflation environments on the average speed of individual price adjustments, the related pass-through from the exchange rate to domestic prices, inflation uncertainty, the extent of dollarization, relative price variability and the cost and time to maturity of the public debt. There are major quantitative differences in the above mentioned variables between the five inflationary sub-periods and the more recent price stability period. Among those are dramatic changes in the anchoring of inflation expectations, in the pass-through coefficient, inflation uncertainty, the speed of price adjustments, relative price variability, the (rather late) disappearance of dollarization in the real estate market and the benefits induced by price stability for the financing of the public debt. The paper provides an explanation for the fact that high inflation was stabilized in ?one shot? while the subsequent moderate inflation was stabilized gradually within an inflation targeting framework. It argues that the second stabilization fits into the mold of the opportunistic approach to disinflation. The second part of the paper focuses solely on the period of price stability. It documents major, non-inflation related, structural changes since the turn of the century and discusses current policy dilemmas. Among the major structural changes are a persistent switch from current account deficits to surpluses, increased flexibility in the labor market, a reduction in the size of government, separation of pension and provident funds from the banking system and the emergence of a corporate bond market. Particularly remarkable is the macroeconomic resilience of the Israeli economy to the world financial crisis. As in many developed economies both the inflation gap and the output gap are recently in the negative range implying that, on both counts, monetary policy should be expansionary. The current policy rate is indeed almost at the zero bound. On one hand this policy, along with occasional interventions in the forex market, partially offsets overvaluation pressures on the exchange rate. On the other it reinforces a nine year long cycle of price increases in the real estate market.
url:bee4c4fad562dcf1.abstract_zh: 自1954年以色列银行成立以来的五十年间，以色列经历了高且波动剧烈的通货膨胀。直至二十一世纪初，才最终实现了价格稳定（按当前国际标准定义）。本文将1954年至2015年的样本划分为六个具有不同通胀环境的子时期。论文第一部分记录了这些不同通胀环境对个体价格调整平均速度、汇率对国内价格的传导效应、通胀不确定性、美元化程度、相对价格变动性以及公共债务成本与到期期限的影响。在五个通胀子时期与近期的价格稳定时期之间，上述变量存在显著的定量差异。其中包括通胀预期锚定的剧烈变化、传导系数、通胀不确定性、价格调整速度、相对价格变动性、房地产市场美元化（较晚）的消失，以及价格稳定对公共债务融资带来的益处。本文解释了为何高通胀得以“一次性”稳定，而随后的温和通胀则在通胀目标框架内逐步稳定的现象，并认为第二次稳定符合机会主义式反通胀方法的模式。论文第二部分仅聚焦于价格稳定时期，记录了自世纪之交以来与通胀无关的重大结构性变化，并讨论了当前的政策困境。主要的结构性变化包括：经常账户从赤字持续转向盈余、劳动力市场灵活性增强、政府规模缩减、养老金和公积金基金与银行体系分离，以及公司债券市场的兴起。尤为显著的是以色列经济对世界金融危机的宏观韧性。与许多发达经济体一样，近期的通胀缺口和产出缺口均为负值，这意味着从两方面看，货币政策都应采取扩张性立场。当前政策利率确实几乎处于零下限。一方面，这一政策加上对外汇市场的偶尔干预，部分抵消了汇率高估的压力；另一方面，它也加剧了房地产市场长达九年的价格上涨周期。

url:bf0a182b535abc65.abstract: Artificial intelligence is advancing at the same time as the global economy is becoming more fragmented. AI innovation is concentrated in a small number of economies, while the gains from AI depend on technologies, intermediate inputs, data, investment, and know-how moving across borders. This column shows that fragmentation can therefore shape not only the size of the global gains from AI, but also who receives them. For economies not at the technological frontier, preserving diversified links may be a valuable form of economic optionality.
url:bf0a182b535abc65.abstract_zh: 人工智能的发展与全球经济日益碎片化同步推进。人工智能创新集中于少数经济体，而其收益则依赖于技术、中间投入、数据、投资和专业知识在跨国界的流动。本专栏指出，碎片化因此不仅影响人工智能全球收益的规模，也决定其分配格局。对于处于技术前沿之外的经济体而言，保持多元化的联系可能是一种宝贵的经济选择权。
url:bf0a182b535abc65.title: AI in a fragmenting world: Why ‘connector’ economies can still gain

url:bf1d55b0ec42b312.abstract: We propose an empirically consistent theory of business cycles driven by fluctuations in the sentiment of a small number of firms. Using computational linguistics and analyst forecasts, we find that around 50 firms can account for over 60% of the variation in U.S. sentiment and macroeconomic outcomes. Our â€ Granular Sentiment Indexâ€ , which measures the sentiment of these firms, is dominated by downstream firms that are close to the final consumer. Incorporating endogenous attention choice into a general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms, we show that this heterogeneity arises because downstream firms act as natural "information agglomeratorsâ€ . A calibrated version of the model shows that sentiment shocks to the 20% most downstream firms explain 70% of sentiment-driven (and 20% of aggregate) fluctuations.
url:bf1d55b0ec42b312.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种经验上一致的经济周期理论，该理论由少数企业情绪的波动驱动。利用计算语言学和分析师预测，我们发现约50家企业可以解释美国情绪和宏观经济结果超过60%的变动。我们构建的“颗粒情绪指数”衡量这些企业的情绪，其中占主导地位的是靠近最终消费者的下游企业。通过将内生注意力选择纳入一个包含异质性企业的一般均衡模型，我们表明这种异质性源于下游企业作为天然的“信息聚合体”。模型的校准版本显示，对最下游20%企业的情绪冲击解释了70%的情绪驱动波动（以及20%的总波动）。

url:bf2a88a3b14ec492.abstract: We estimate the effects of worker voice on productivity, job quality, and separations. We study the 1991 introduction of a right to worker representation on boards or advisory councils in Finnish firms, designed primarily to facilitate workforce-management communication. The reform only affected firms with at least 150 employees, permitting a difference-in-differences design to analyze its causal effects. Consistent with information sharing theories, worker voice slightly raised labor productivity, firm survival, and capital intensity. In contrast to the exit-voice theory, we find no effects on voluntary job separations, and at most small positive effects on other measures of job quality (job security, health, subjective job quality, and wages). A 2008 introduction of shop-floor representation had similarly limited effects.
url:bf2a88a3b14ec492.abstract_zh: 我们估算了员工话语权对生产率、工作质量及离职率的影响。我们研究了1991年芬兰企业引入的关于董事会或咨询委员会中员工代表权的规定，该规定主要旨在促进管理层与员工之间的沟通。这项改革仅影响员工人数至少为150人的企业，从而允许采用双重差分设计来分析其因果效应。与信息共享理论一致，员工话语权略微提高了劳动生产率、企业生存率和资本密集度。与退出-话语权理论相反，我们发现员工话语权对自愿离职没有影响，并且对其他工作质量指标（如工作保障、健康状况、主观工作质量和工资）最多只有微小的正面影响。2008年引入的车间代表制度的影响同样有限。

url:bf2e9d2a01468644.abstract: Can energy-rich developing countries convert cheap electricity into AI compute exports? This paper develops a capacity-constrained trade model of AI compute services with bilateral frictions in delivery, regulation, and trust. Calibrating the model across 85 countries shows that several developing economies can produce compute at low cost, but this advantage rarely becomes export competitiveness. Because hardware dominates unit costs and is globally priced, cross-country production costs differ by only 12–20 percent. Modest regulatory, financing, and trust frictions can therefore erase the gains from cheap power. The binding constraint is institutional credibility rather than electricity prices, including enforceable data governance, stable regulation, credible power contracts, access to finance, and geopolitical alignment with buyers.
url:bf2e9d2a01468644.abstract_zh: 能源丰富的发展中国家能否将廉价电力转化为人工智能算力出口？本文构建了一个受容量约束的人工智能算力服务贸易模型，该模型纳入了交付、监管和信任方面的双边摩擦。通过对85个国家的模型校准发现，部分发展中经济体能够以低成本生产算力，但这种优势很少能转化为出口竞争力。由于硬件成本在单位成本中占主导地位且具有全球统一定价特征，各国间生产成本差异仅为12%-20%。因此，适度的监管、融资和信任摩擦足以抵消廉价电力带来的收益。制约发展的关键因素并非电价，而是制度可信度，包括可执行的数据治理、稳定的监管环境、可靠的电力合同、融资渠道以及与买方的地缘政治协调。

url:bf34c1e61c8992ec.abstract: Evidence on the long-run mental health effects of disasters remains limited. This study estimates the causal effects of exposure to extreme weather events (EWEs) on mental health treatment among working-age adults in New Zealand. Unlike much of the existing literature, which focuses on single disasters, short-term outcomes, and self-reported distress, we use longitudinal administrative population data within a staggered difference-in-differences framework to exploit variation in the timing and frequency of exposure across individuals and regions. The analysis distinguishes between moderate and severe mental health conditions and estimates effects on both the probability of receiving treatment and the number of treatment days. We find no statistically significant population-level effects of EWE exposure on treatment of either moderate or severe mental illness. However, subgroup analyses indicate some heterogeneity, particularly among individuals in the lowest income tercile and younger adults for moderate outcomes. Overall, the findings suggest that increases in psychological distress documented in the broader disaster literature do not necessarily translate into broad-based or sustained changes in formal mental health treatment. The study provides new evidence on how climate-related shocks shape realised mental healthcare utilisation over time.
url:bf34c1e61c8992ec.abstract_zh: 关于灾害对心理健康长期影响的证据仍然有限。本研究利用新西兰劳动年龄人口数据，估计极端天气事件暴露对心理健康治疗的因果效应。与现有文献多聚焦单一灾害、短期结果及自我报告的心理困扰不同，我们采用交错双重差分框架下的纵向行政人口数据，利用个体与地区间暴露时间及频率的差异进行分析。研究区分了中度与重度心理健康状况，并评估了极端天气事件对接受治疗概率及治疗天数的影响。结果显示，极端天气事件暴露对中度或重度精神疾病治疗均未产生统计上显著的人口层面效应。然而，亚组分析表明存在一定异质性，尤其在收入最低三分位群体及年轻成年人中，中度心理健康结果呈现差异。总体而言，研究提示灾害文献中记录的心理困扰增加未必转化为广泛或持续的正式心理健康治疗变化。本研究为气候相关冲击如何随时间影响实际心理健康服务利用提供了新证据。

url:c0063d53faf68bea.abstract: Using US data from the S&P 1500 indexed firms, we offer empirical evidence concerning the impact of ESG greenwashing on firms’ risk of future stock price crash. Specifically, we show that ESG greenwashing is positively associated with firms’ risk of a future stock price crash. Our findings are robust to instrumental variable, difference-in-differences, and entropy balancing approaches. Furthermore, we identify five potential channels (mediating factors) through which ESG greenwashing can increase the risk of a future stock price crash – the degree of private corporate news hiding, financial analysts’ forecast dispersion, investment inefficiency, excessive managerial risk-taking, and equity mispricing. Our findings suggest that firms exhibiting higher levels of ESG greenwashing tend to have greater degrees of private corporate news hiding, wider financial analysts’ forecast dispersions, increased investment inefficiency, heightened managerial risk-taking, and equity mispricing, all contributing to an elevated risk of future stock price crashes.
url:c0063d53faf68bea.abstract_zh: 基于标普1500指数成分企业的美国数据，本文提供了关于ESG漂绿行为对企业未来股价崩盘风险影响的实证证据。具体而言，我们发现ESG漂绿与企业未来股价崩盘风险呈正相关关系。该结论在工具变量法、双重差分法和熵平衡法下均保持稳健。进一步地，我们识别出ESG漂绿加剧未来股价崩盘风险的五个潜在渠道（中介因素）：企业私有信息隐藏程度、金融分析师预测分歧度、投资非效率性、管理层过度风险承担以及权益错误定价。研究结果表明，ESG漂绿程度较高的企业往往呈现更严重的私有信息隐藏、更宽泛的分析师预测分歧、更突出的投资非效率、更激进的管理层风险承担及更显著的权益错误定价，这些因素共同推高了未来股价崩盘风险。
url:c0063d53faf68bea.title: ESG greenwashing and stock price crash risk: a channel analysis
url:c0063d53faf68bea.title_zh: ESG漂绿与股价崩盘风险：渠道分析

url:c00d0c5743068a8c.abstract: The Value of a Statistical Life (VSL) serves as the definitive metric for allocative efficiency in Health Economics and Benefit-Cost Analysis (BCA). However, the production and application of VSL estimates have become stratified into four distinct groups-econometric producers, practitioner appliers, scholarly supporters, and scholarly objectors-that largely operate in isolation. This paper argues that this lack of cross-disciplinary discourse has allowed foundational assumptions to persist without adequate scrutiny, compromising the scientific validity of the VSL. This study provides a critical methodological re-evaluation of the hedonic wage models used to derive VSL. The central contribution is a microeconomic examination of labor demand elasticity. Standard VSL regression analyses presume that observed wage differentials between "safe" and "risky" sectors accurately reflect the worker's risk premium. This paper demonstrates, through a partial equilibrium framework, that this equality holds true only under the highly specific condition of perfectly inelastic labor demand. By relaxing this assumption to reflect the reality of elastic labor demand, the analysis shows that observed wage differentials systematically underestimate the true compensation workers require for risk. Furthermore, the paper identifies an "information paradox" in current VSL theory. Standard models assume workers possess perfect knowledge of occupational risks to price them into their wages . Yet, regulatory agencies commission epidemiologists and engineers to identify these same risks, premised on the fact that they are unknown to the layperson. If workers already possessed the knowledge assumed by VSL producers, such expert analysis would be redundant. The analysis also challenges the "job-desperation effect, " where low-income workers with limited bargaining power accept high-risk positions at lower wages. This "missing variable" of risk awareness occasionally results in data showing negative risk premiums that defy economic intuition. The paper further critiques the assumption of risk neutrality, arguing that extrapolating small risk probabilities linearly to a full statistical life creates logical inconsistencies. If preferences were truly linear, individuals would logically accept wagers involving high probabilities of death for proportional monetary gains-a conclusion that contradicts observed human behavior. Additionally, the paper introduces the "Regulatory Indifference Paradox." If standard VSL assumptions were strictly accurate-specifically that wages perfectly compensate for risk-then workers, on average, should be economically indifferent to safety regulations. According to the model, any safety improvement would be offset by an exactly proportional reduction in wages, neutralizing the net benefit to the worker. Finally, the paper addresses the issue of false precision. It argues that the "statistical" label is a semantic shield used to deflect ethical scrutiny regarding life valuation. Moreover, the reliance on calculating the median of widely divergent study results creates an illusion of scientific consensus that masks the unreliability of the underlying estimates. The paper concludes by proposing a framework that integrates insights from behavioral economics to restore scientific integrity to the valuation of life.
url:c00d0c5743068a8c.abstract_zh: 统计生命价值（VSL）是健康经济学与成本效益分析（BCA）中衡量配置效率的权威指标。然而，VSL估算的生产与应用已分化为四个彼此割裂的群体——计量生产者、实践应用者、学术支持者与学术反对者。本文认为，这种跨学科对话的缺失使得基础假设未经充分审视便持续存在，损害了VSL的科学有效性。本研究对推导VSL的享乐主义工资模型进行了批判性方法论重估，核心贡献在于对劳动力需求弹性的微观经济学检验。标准VSL回归分析假定"安全"与"风险"行业间的工资差异能准确反映工人的风险溢价。本文通过局部均衡框架证明，该等式仅在劳动力需求完全无弹性这一高度特定条件下成立。放宽这一假设以反映弹性劳动力需求的现实后，分析表明观测到的工资差异会系统性低估工人实际要求的风险补偿。此外，本文指出现有VSL理论存在"信息悖论"：标准模型假设工人完全知晓职业风险以将其纳入工资定价，但监管机构却委托流行病学家与工程师识别这些风险——其前提正是外行人对这些风险一无所知。若工人真如VSL生产者假设般掌握风险信息，此类专业分析将毫无意义。分析还挑战了"求职绝望效应"——即议价能力有限的低收入工人以更低工资接受高风险岗位。这种风险认知的"缺失变量"有时会导致数据呈现违背经济学直觉的负风险溢价。本文进一步批判风险中性假设，认为将小概率风险线性外推至完整统计生命存在逻辑矛盾：若偏好确实呈线性，个体理应接受涉及高死亡概率的赌注以换取比例货币收益——这一结论与人类实际行为相悖。此外，本文提出"监管无差异悖论"：若标准VSL假设严格成立（即工资完全补偿风险），则工人平均而言应对安全监管持经济无差异态度。根据模型，任何安全改善都将被等比例工资削减所抵消，使工人的净收益归零。最后，本文探讨虚假精确性问题，指出"统计"标签实为规避生命价值伦理审视的语义盾牌。更关键的是，依赖计算差异悬殊研究结果的中位数，制造了科学共识的假象，掩盖了基础估算的不可靠性。本文最终提出融合行为经济学洞见的框架，以恢复生命价值评估的科学严谨性。
url:c00d0c5743068a8c.title: The True Value of, the Value of a Statistical Life (VSL), in Benefit-Cost Analysis: How Might the VSL Be Different from What We Have Been Told?
url:c00d0c5743068a8c.title_zh: 效益成本分析中统计生命价值（VSL）的真实价值：VSL与我们被告知的可能有何不同？

url:c00fa394897fa397.abstract: Employment polarisation – the decline of middle-skill routine occupations relative to both ends of the skill distribution – is usually documented from repeated cross-sections. However, the time evolution of cross-sections is driven by workers’ flows across occupational categories and in and out of the labour market. Drawing on an administrative panel that follows French workers over 1984–2021, this column shows that polarisation emerged through a collapse in entry into routine jobs from non-employment, not through displacement of incumbent routine workers. The findings redirect policy attention from protecting existing jobs towards the entry margin.
url:c00fa394897fa397.abstract_zh: 就业极化——即中等技能常规职业相对于技能分布两端的衰退——通常通过重复截面数据加以记录。然而，截面的时间演变是由工人在职业类别间的流动以及进出劳动力市场的动态所驱动的。基于追踪法国工人1984年至2021年情况的行政面板数据，本专栏表明，极化现象源于非就业状态进入常规职业的通道崩溃，而非现有常规工人的被迫转移。研究结果将政策关注点从保护现有就业转向进入环节。
url:c00fa394897fa397.title: The anatomy of job polarisation: Evidence from four decades of French worker flows
url:c00fa394897fa397.title_zh: 工作两极化的解剖：来自法国工人流动四十年数据的证据

url:c0150c467500cff5.abstract: We analyse the media’s role in channelling information about the Fed’s monetary policy stance to the public. Using LLMs, we find a tight correspondence between FOMC communication and media coverage, although with significant variation over time. The communication pass-through weakened during the ZLB period and improved with the introduction of press conferences, which now exert strong influence on the media. Media coverage effects households' inflation expectations, particularly when inflation is high and volatile, while we do not detect a direct impact of FOMC communication. This underscores the media’s crucial function in channelling central banks’ communication to the public.
url:c0150c467500cff5.abstract_zh: 我们分析了媒体在向公众传递美联储货币政策立场信息中所扮演的角色。利用大型语言模型，我们发现联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）的沟通与媒体报道之间存在紧密对应关系，尽管随时间存在显著变化。沟通传导在零利率下限（ZLB）时期有所减弱，并随着新闻发布会制度的引入而改善，后者如今对媒体产生强烈影响。媒体报道影响家庭的通胀预期，尤其是在通胀高企且波动较大时，而我们未检测到FOMC沟通的直接影响。这凸显了媒体在将央行沟通传导至公众中的关键作用。
url:c0150c467500cff5.title: Monetary Policy in the News: Communication Pass-Through and Inflation Expectations
url:c0150c467500cff5.title_zh: 新闻中的货币政策：沟通传导与通胀预期

url:c03333a7d385436f.abstract: This paper interprets Brexit as a two-stage institutional rupture that reshaped migration through expectations, exposure, and stress channels. Using a UK–Germany Difference-in-Differences framework, I show that the 2016 referendum generated a sharp decline in UK net migration relative to Germany, driven primarily by a contraction in immigration rather than simple outward flight. The 2021 termination of EU free movement reinforced this adjustment on the gross inflow margin, completing the structural reallocation of mobility flows. Migration responses were not uniform: countries more deeply integrated into EU mobility networks prior to 2016 experienced significantly stronger contractions, confirming that Brexit propagated along pre-existing exposure channels. Embedding macro-financial stress interactions reveals that institutional fragility amplified the referendum shock, particularly during the expectations phase. Stress intensified migration contractions in exposed settings in 2016, while post-2021 responses became more heterogeneous, especially on the emigration margin. Together, the results support a sequential interpretation: an anticipatory expectations shock in 2016 followed by regime completion in 2021. Beyond short-run behavioral adjustments, the findings are consistent with the fiscal self-selection framework. Increases in perceived institutional risk alter the relative returns to skill and investment, reshaping both the composition of migration and foreign direct investment. Because skilled labor and FDI are complementary, institutional credibility shocks can generate self-reinforcing declines in human capital inflows and investment. Brexit therefore emerges not merely as a trade or regulatory event, but as an institutional credibility shock in which migration operates both as an outcome and as a transmission mechanism linking regime change to long-run growth dynamics.
url:c03333a7d385436f.abstract_zh: 本文将英国脱欧解读为一个两阶段的制度性断裂，通过预期、暴露和压力渠道重塑了移民格局。利用英德双重差分框架，本文表明2016年公投导致英国净移民相对于德国急剧下降，这主要源于移民流入的收缩，而非简单的向外逃离。2021年欧盟自由流动的终止强化了总流入边际上的这一调整，完成了流动性流动的结构性再配置。移民反应并非均匀一致：在2016年前更深度融入欧盟流动性网络的国家经历了显著更强的收缩，这证实了英国脱欧沿着既有的暴露渠道传播。嵌入宏观金融压力交互作用后发现，制度脆弱性放大了公投冲击，尤其是在预期阶段。2016年，压力加剧了暴露环境中的移民收缩，而2021年后的反应则变得更加异质，尤其是在迁出边际上。综合来看，这些结果支持一种序列性解释：2016年的预期性预期冲击，随后是2021年的制度完成。除了短期行为调整外，这些发现与财政自选择框架一致。感知到的制度风险上升改变了技能和投资的相对回报，从而重塑了移民构成和外国直接投资。由于熟练劳动力与外国直接投资具有互补性，制度可信度冲击可能引发人力资本流入和投资的自我强化式下降。因此，英国脱欧不仅是一个贸易或监管事件，更是一个制度可信度冲击，其中移民既是结果，也是连接制度变迁与长期增长动态的传导机制。
url:c03333a7d385436f.title: Institutional Shocks and Migration Adjustment: Evidence from the Syrian Crisis and Brexit’s Referendum and Implementation
url:c03333a7d385436f.title_zh: 制度冲击与移民调整：来自叙利亚危机及英国脱欧公投与实施的证据

url:c037b96544cbc701.abstract: This paper develops a framework to evaluate the potential economic gains from deeper participation in global value chains (GVCs). The approach combines measures of revealed comparative advantage with estimates of value-added distribution along GVCs to identify opportunities for upgrading into higher–value-added production stages. It then quantifies the long-term economic effects of such upgrading using a structural gravity model. The framework is applied to Costa Rica’s electronics sector, a key focus of the country’s strategy to expand its role in the semiconductor value chain. The findings indicate that strengthening Costa Rica’s position within the electronics GVC could lead to substantial long-term increases in exports, output, and real wages.
url:c037b96544cbc701.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个评估深度参与全球价值链（GVCs）潜在经济收益的分析框架。该框架将显性比较优势指标与全球价值链中增加值分布的估算相结合，以识别向更高附加值生产阶段升级的机遇，进而运用结构引力模型量化此类升级的长期经济效应。将该框架应用于哥斯达黎加电子行业——该国扩大半导体价值链参与战略的核心领域，研究结果表明：强化哥斯达黎加在电子全球价值链中的地位，可带来出口、产出与实际工资的长期显著增长。
url:c037b96544cbc701.title: Assessing the gains from moving along the global value chain: Evidence from Costa Rica’s electronics sector
url:c037b96544cbc701.title_zh: 评估沿全球价值链移动的收益：来自哥斯达黎加电子部门的证据

url:c09aefaa26172e47.abstract: This paper studies the impact of demographic change on experienced workers' relative wages and employment rates. We investigate empirical predictions from a framework of supply and demand for experience skill, using variation across U.S. local labor markets (LLMs) over the last decades and instrumenting experience skill supply by the LLMs' age structures a decade earlier. We find that aging substantially reduces experienced workers' relative wages and full-time employment rates, and also their labor market participation rates. Our results imply that the effect of demographic change on labor markets might be more severe than previously recognized, as it reaches beyond wages.
url:c09aefaa26172e47.abstract_zh: 本文研究了人口结构变化对经验丰富工人相对工资和就业率的影响。我们利用美国地方劳动力市场（LLMs）过去几十年的变化，并借助这些市场十年前年龄结构作为经验技能供给的工具变量，检验了经验技能供需框架下的实证预测。研究发现，人口老龄化显著降低了经验丰富工人的相对工资和全职就业率，同时也降低了他们的劳动参与率。我们的结果表明，人口结构变化对劳动力市场的影响可能比先前认识到的更为严重，因为它超出了工资范畴。
url:c09aefaa26172e47.title: Make Yourselves Scarce: The Effect of Demographic Change on the Relative Wages and Employment Rates of Experienced Workers
url:c09aefaa26172e47.title_zh: 让自己变得稀缺：人口结构变化对经验丰富工人相对工资与就业率的影响

url:c0b7656c0ae9b68f.abstract: We study how land market frictions affect men and women differently during structural transformation, exploiting two major Chinese land reforms that strengthened farmers' rental rights. Using large-language-model text analysis, we construct a county-level reform index and combine it with large panel data to identify causal effects. The reforms shift rural women out of agriculture more than men and reduce urban women's employment and wages relative to men. A multisector model with intra-household labor allocation rationalizes these findings: gender-neutral land market frictions act as gender-specific mobility barriers, and their removal disproportionately accelerates women's transition into non-agricultural employment.
url:c0b7656c0ae9b68f.abstract_zh: 本文研究土地市场摩擦如何在中国结构转型过程中对男性和女性产生差异化影响，利用两项强化农民租赁权的重大土地改革。通过大语言模型文本分析，我们构建了县级改革指数，并结合大规模面板数据识别因果效应。改革使农村女性比男性更大幅度地脱离农业，同时降低了城市女性相对于男性的就业率和工资。一个包含家庭内部劳动力分配的多部门模型解释了这些发现：性别中性的土地市场摩擦充当了性别特定的流动障碍，其消除不成比例地加速了女性向非农就业的转型。

url:c0e298f32e06ddbe.abstract: This study investigates the temporal and contextual stability of social risk preferences across health and wealth, focusing on both gains and losses. Using a large representative Dutch panel, we replicated the experimental design of Attema et al. (2023) which elicited social risk preferences through allocation decisions involving two anonymous recipients under risk. The design allows us to distinguish three dimensions of preferences: risk preferences, inequality aversion, and social risk preferences arising from trade-offs between risk and inequality, corresponding to utilitarian, ex-ante, and ex-post perspectives on social welfare. At the aggregate level, the main patterns documented in the original study are largely replicated: inequality aversion is prevalent and risk aversion is weaker in the loss domain than in the gain domain. At the individual level, however, stability is more limited. Test-retest correlations are positive but modest, and the proportion of identical choices across waves varies across domains and framings. Parametric estimations further reveal substantial heterogeneity in social risk preferences. A latent-class analysis identifies utilitarian preferences as the largest group, followed by ex-post and exante perspectives. Overall, the results highlight the coexistence of persistence, contextual effects, and heterogeneity in social risk preferences
url:c0e298f32e06ddbe.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了社会风险偏好在健康与财富领域中的时间稳定性与情境稳定性，重点关注收益与损失两种情境。我们利用荷兰大型代表性面板数据，复现了Attema等人（2023）的实验设计——该实验通过涉及两名匿名受助者在风险条件下的分配决策来测度社会风险偏好。该设计允许我们从三个维度区分偏好：风险偏好、不平等厌恶，以及由风险与不平等权衡产生的社会风险偏好，分别对应社会福利的功利主义视角、事前视角与事后视角。在总体层面，原始研究记录的主要模式基本得到复现：不平等厌恶普遍存在，且损失域中的风险厌恶程度弱于收益域。然而，在个体层面，稳定性较为有限。重测相关性呈正值但幅度较小，不同波次间选择完全一致的比例因领域和框架而异。参数估计进一步揭示了社会风险偏好存在显著异质性。潜在类别分析显示，功利主义偏好群体规模最大，其次为事后视角与事前视角群体。总体而言，研究结果凸显了社会风险偏好中持续性、情境效应与异质性的共存特征。
url:c0e298f32e06ddbe.title: On the Stability of Social Risk Preferences for Health and Wealth

url:c11401e98b1a9c22.abstract: Many countries have adopted different price regulations to contain pharmaceutical prices, even in markets exposed to generic competition. This column documents subtle pricing patterns in the Swedish pharmaceutical market, where consumers get full reimbursement only by buying the cheapest product (the “product of the month”) and can only purchase their prescribed medicine in the packet size specified in their prescription. While the product-of-the-month regime substantially decreased prices and expenditure per pill initially, prices per pill are 4-5 times higher in package sizes sold by monopoly producers. These firms appear to have learned to exploit quirks of the regulation to increase their market power.
url:c11401e98b1a9c22.abstract_zh: 许多国家已采取不同的价格监管措施来控制药品价格，即便在面临仿制药竞争的市场中也是如此。本文记录了瑞典药品市场中微妙的定价模式，在该市场中，消费者只有购买最便宜的产品（“月度产品”）才能获得全额报销，并且只能按照处方中指定的包装规格购买所开具的药品。尽管“月度产品”制度初期显著降低了价格和每片药的支出，但在垄断生产商销售的包装规格中，每片药的价格高出4至5倍。这些企业似乎已学会利用监管中的特殊之处来增强其市场支配力。
url:c11401e98b1a9c22.title: Competition or collusion: Entry decisions in the Swedish pharmaceutical market

url:c117c3c3680c8e87.abstract: Are firms adapting to climate change? We combine World Bank Enterprise Survey data covering 160,000 firms in 134 countries with spatially granular weather data to estimate temperature response functions. Firms in low- and lower-middle income countries (LMCs) are negatively affected by rising heat: revenues decline by 12 percent when temperatures are 0.5◦C above historical averages for small and medium firms. Labor productivity and wages fall and energy costs rise, with effects concentrated in heat sensitive sectors. However, only one-third of firms in LMCs take adaptive measures. Information on policy constraints suggests that limited financing and burdensome regulation constrain firm-level adaption.
url:c117c3c3680c8e87.abstract_zh: 企业是否正在适应气候变化？我们将覆盖134个国家16万家企业的世界银行企业调查数据与空间精细的天气数据相结合，以估算温度响应函数。在低收入和中等偏低收入国家（LMCs）中，企业受到气温升高的负面影响：当气温比历史平均值高出0.5摄氏度时，中小企业的收入下降12%。劳动生产率与工资下降，能源成本上升，这些影响集中在热敏感行业。然而，在LMCs中，仅有三分之一的企业采取了适应性措施。关于政策约束的信息表明，有限的融资和繁重的监管限制了企业层面的适应能力。
url:c117c3c3680c8e87.title: Firm-Level Climate Change Adaptation: Micro Evidence from 134 Nations

url:c127e6b06f2a927f.abstract: We develop a novel measure of trust in the Federal Reserve using Generative Artificial Intelligence to analyse millions of tweets about the Fed, its leadership and its policy framework and decisions. Our measure reacts in an intuitive way to various macro-financial variables and indicators of U.S. monetary policy. To study the effects of trust shocks, we use a narrative identification approach based on ethical scandals embroiling some FOMC members, and we study the effects of these shocks using a daily VAR. We find that trust shocks have highly persistent effects on macroeconomic variables despite having short-lived effects on our trust measure: they weaken business conditions, the stock market and news sentiment, while increasing the VIX index. Inflation expectations also increase following a trust shock, worsening the inflation-output trade-off.
url:c127e6b06f2a927f.abstract_zh: 我们利用生成式人工智能开发了一种衡量对美联储信任度的新颖指标，通过分析数百万条关于美联储、其领导层、政策框架及决策的推文。该指标对各类宏观金融变量和美国货币政策指标的反应符合直觉。为研究信任冲击的影响，我们采用基于涉及部分联邦公开市场委员会成员的伦理丑闻的叙事识别方法，并利用日度VAR模型考察这些冲击的效应。我们发现，信任冲击对宏观经济变量具有高度持续的影响，尽管其对我们的信任指标的影响是短暂的：它们削弱了商业状况、股市和新闻情绪，同时推高了VIX指数。信任冲击后，通胀预期亦上升，恶化了通胀与产出之间的权衡关系。
url:c127e6b06f2a927f.title: In the Fed we Trust? Measuring Trust in Central Banking and its Effects on the Macroeconomy

url:c1362fb8b99776bd.abstract: We use population data on capital income and wealth holdings for Norway to measure asset positions and wealth returns before individuals marry and after the household is formed. These data allow us to establish a number of novel facts. First, individuals sort on personal wealth rather than parental wealth. Second, people match also on their personal returns to wealth and assortative mating on returns is as strong as that on wealth.
url:c1362fb8b99776bd.abstract_zh: 我们利用挪威关于资本收入和财富持有的人口数据，来衡量个体在结婚前及家庭形成后的资产状况与财富回报。这些数据使我们得以确立一系列新颖的事实。首先，个体倾向于依据个人财富而非父母财富进行匹配。其次，人们在财富回报率上也存在匹配现象，且基于回报率的选型配对强度与基于财富的相当。
url:c1362fb8b99776bd.title: Marriage, Assortative Mating and Wealth Inequality

url:c13a843dcb73f9c7.abstract: Using the universe of incorporated firms in the United Kingdom, we document that long term debt that is not secured by specific corporate assets (commonly referred to as cash-flow-based debt) is ubiquitous, even among very young firms. Consistent with cash-flow-based lending depending on firms' continuation value, both the timing and the amount of cash-flow-based debt at first financing are strongly related to future performance. In fact, the age at which firms first access cash-flow-based long-term debt is a strong predictor of firm outcomes up to twenty years later. In contrast, the age at which firms access asset-based lending does not predict future performance. To understand how lending based on continuation value impacts firm dynamics, we develop a tractable theory of firm life cycle dynamics with permanent heterogeneity and financing frictions -- where access to finance can be based on signals of both current and future performance. The model highlights the importance of financing based on future value in matching the predictability of cash-flow-based financing observed in the data. It also highlights how frictions to financing based on available collateral vs. future value lead to differential selection and hence very different distributions of firms that survive and grow. The degree to which firms can access financing based on future value is therefore fundamentally intertwined with aggregate firm dynamics.
url:c13a843dcb73f9c7.abstract_zh: 基于英国全部注册公司的数据，我们发现未以特定企业资产担保的长期债务（通常称为现金流债务）普遍存在，即便是非常年轻的企业也不例外。与现金流贷款依赖企业持续经营价值这一逻辑一致，首次融资时现金流债务的时机和规模均与未来业绩密切相关。事实上，企业首次获得现金流长期债务的年龄，能够强有力地预测其后长达二十年的经营表现。相比之下，企业首次获得资产担保贷款的年龄则无法预测未来业绩。为理解基于持续经营价值的贷款如何影响企业动态，我们构建了一个包含永久异质性和融资摩擦的企业生命周期动态理论模型——其中融资可得性可同时基于当前业绩和未来业绩的信号。该模型凸显了基于未来价值的融资在匹配数据中观察到的现金流融资可预测性方面的重要性，同时揭示了基于现有抵押品与基于未来价值的融资摩擦如何导致差异化选择，进而形成截然不同的存活与成长企业分布。因此，企业基于未来价值获取融资的能力与总体企业动态存在根本性关联。

url:c1528f2104db0c4a.abstract: We develop an agent-based model to study how the Covid-19 pandemic may have affected the distribution of paid and unpaid work in families. The behavior of the agents in our model is informed by theories from psychology and sociology, as well as by economic considerations. We study two channels which were important during the pandemic: changes in time availability, resulting from an increase in unemployment and short-time work, and increased care work, triggered by the closure of kindergartens and schools, among others. Starting from a baseline scenario which is empirically calibrated with Austrian data on time use, we show that, on its own, each channel only exerts marginal post-pandemic effects. In combination, however, the model suggests that these channels promote a small, but significant egalitarian redistribution of paid and unpaid work. Social influence plays a crucial role in these results. A sensitivity analysis suggests that long-run regressive effects would also be possible, but only if the increased time availability fell to a much stronger extent on women, which seems to be empirically implausible.
url:c1528f2104db0c4a.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个基于主体的模型，研究新冠疫情如何影响家庭中有偿与无偿工作的分配。模型中的主体行为基于心理学、社会学理论以及经济学考量。我们重点考察了疫情期间两个重要渠道：失业与短时工作增加导致的时间可用性变化，以及幼儿园和学校关闭等引发的照护工作增加。基于奥地利时间使用数据经验校准的基准情景，研究表明：单独来看，每个渠道仅产生微弱的疫情后效应；但两者结合时，模型显示这些渠道会促进有偿与无偿工作向平等主义方向发生虽小却显著的再分配。社会影响在这些结果中起关键作用。敏感性分析表明，长期倒退效应也可能出现，但前提是时间可用性增加需更大幅度地集中于女性——这在经验上似乎不具现实性。

url:c1a7b0565c390d1b.abstract: we investigate the impact on private consumption of income-support policies, such as lump-sum transfers and withdrawals of funds from the contributors’ mandatory pension accounts. We find that both emergency income and pension withdrawals had statistically significant effects with an estimated average marginal propensity to consume of about 20 percent. Consumption of durable goods is more sensitive to these policies than other goods, especially in the programs’ initial stages. Higher educational attainment and financial leverage, proxying better access to bank credit, are associated with weaker consumption reaction across municipalities.
url:c1a7b0565c390d1b.abstract_zh: 本文研究了收入支持政策（如一次性转移支付及从强制性养老金账户中提取资金）对私人消费的影响。我们发现，紧急收入与养老金提取均具有统计显著效应，估计的平均边际消费倾向约为20%。耐用品消费对这些政策的敏感度高于其他商品，尤其在政策实施初期。以更高教育程度和财务杠杆衡量的银行信贷获取能力更强的地区，其消费反应相对较弱。

url:c1b16ff5ac7c91a1.abstract: Sudan’s agricultural sector in 2026 is facing unprecedented challenges due to the ongoing conflict, economic instability, and climate-related shocks. These overlapping crises have severely disrupted farming activities, market systems, and rural livelihoods across the country. The situation is particularly critical for smallholder farmers, who form the backbone of Sudan’s food production and rural economy. This report assesses the state of agriculture in conflict-affected Sudan, with a focus on input use, crop production, market access, and farming household-level challenges. It draws data from the Sudan 2024 Smallholder Farmers Survey, conducted across 13 of Sudan’s 18 states. The survey covered both the 2023/24 winter cropping season and preparations for the 2024 summer season. The findings reveal that Sudan’s agriculture sector has been severely disrupted by the ongoing conflict. Migration and displacement due to the conflict are reshaping the structure of farming households, while asset losses, reduced cultivated land, and declining livestock holdings undermine their resilience. Household incomes have contracted sharply. Engagement in agricultural activities has dropped, while reliance of farming households on non-agricultural businesses, casual labor, and humanitarian assistance has increased. Food insecurity has reached alarming levels—fewer than one in four households are food secure, while over half are severely food insecure. Food-insecure households are most prevalent in conflict-affected states, such as South Kordofan, North Kordofan, and Blue Nile. However, improvements were seen in access to input and output markets and the adoption of agricultural inputs in the 2023/24 winter season compared to the 2023 summer season. Farmers reported better availability of improved seed and fertilizer and more reliable input markets and crop-selling channels. However, these gains are overshadowed by growing uncertainty—a large portion of farmers indicated that they did not plan to cultivate crops during the 2024 summer season. Farmer’s access to finance and external assistance remained highly constrained. Farming households that used credit primarily relied on informal credit sources. More than three-quarters reported receiving no external assistance in 2024. Where support is available, its distribution remains uneven, with conflict-affected areas facing severe delivery challenges. Farmers report widespread exposure to both idiosyncratic and covariate shocks such as illness, flooding, theft, and violence—all of which compound their vulnerability. The coping strategies they use include selling household goods, reducing agricultural investment, or liquidating assets. Such choices provide short-term relief but jeopardize their long-term recovery. Perceptions of insecurity remain widespread, particularly in states experiencing active conflict. Overall, the findings paint a picture of a farming sector under extreme strain in Sudan. Without urgent, state-specific, and conflict-sensitive interventions, rural livelihoods will continue to deteriorate, further threatening national food security. The report concludes with recommendations to strengthen humanitarian support, revitalize agricultural input and finance systems, protect the assets of farming households, restore markets, and invest in building the resilience of farming households to both conflict and climate risks. Tailored interventions are needed to address state-level disparities, including food and security support in the Kordofan region, water and health services in Red Sea and Kassala states, and agricultural inputs in Aj Jazirah and River Nile. Long-term strategies must also invest in climate-smart agriculture, strengthen social protection systems, and ensure conflict-sensitive approaches that protect farmers and rebuild trust in rural communities.
url:c1b16ff5ac7c91a1.abstract_zh: 2026年，苏丹农业部门因持续冲突、经济不稳定和气候相关冲击面临前所未有的挑战。这些叠加危机严重扰乱了全国范围内的农业活动、市场体系和农村生计。作为苏丹粮食生产和农村经济支柱的小农户处境尤为严峻。本报告评估了受冲突影响的苏丹农业现状，重点关注投入品使用、作物生产、市场准入及农户层面的挑战。数据来源于2024年苏丹小农户调查，覆盖苏丹18个州中的13个州，调查涵盖2023/24年冬季种植季及2024年夏季种植季的准备工作。调查结果显示，苏丹农业部门因持续冲突遭受严重破坏。冲突导致的迁移和流离失所正在重塑农户结构，而资产损失、耕地面积减少及牲畜存栏量下降削弱了其恢复能力。农户收入急剧萎缩，农业活动参与率下降，而对非农经营、临时务工和人道主义援助的依赖程度上升。粮食不安全已达到警戒水平——不足四分之一的农户实现粮食安全，超过半数农户处于严重粮食不安全状态。受冲突影响的州（如南科尔多凡州、北科尔多凡州和青尼罗州）粮食不安全农户比例最高。然而，与2023年夏季相比，2023/24年冬季农户在投入品和产出品市场准入及农业投入品采用方面有所改善。农民报告称改良种子和化肥的可获得性提高，投入品市场和作物销售渠道更加可靠。但这些进展被日益增长的不确定性所掩盖——大部分农民表示未计划在2024年夏季种植作物。农民获得资金和外部援助的渠道仍严重受限。使用信贷的农户主要依赖非正规信贷来源。超过四分之三的农户报告称2024年未获得任何外部援助。即使存在援助，其分配仍不均衡，受冲突影响地区面临严重的交付挑战。农民普遍遭受特质性和协变性冲击（如疾病、洪水、盗窃和暴力），这些冲击加剧了其脆弱性。其应对策略包括出售家庭物品、减少农业投资或变卖资产。此类选择虽能提供短期缓解，但危及长期恢复。不安全感知普遍存在，尤其在持续冲突的州。总体而言，调查结果描绘了苏丹农业部门承受极端压力的图景。若无紧急、针对州情且具有冲突敏感性的干预措施，农村生计将持续恶化，进一步威胁国家粮食安全。报告最后提出建议：加强人道主义支持、振兴农业投入品和金融体系、保护农户资产、恢复市场，并投资建设农户应对冲突和气候风险的韧性。需制定针对性干预措施解决州级差异，包括科尔多凡地区的粮食与安全支持、红海州和卡萨拉州的水资源与卫生服务、杰济拉州和尼罗河州的农业投入品。长期战略必须投资气候智慧型农业、强化社会保障体系，并确保采取保护农民、重建农村社区信任的冲突敏感性方法。

url:c1e6ad990006c32d.abstract: This paper studies how municipal governments jointly manage spending, credit market borrowing, and a public employee pension system. I model governments as levered investors who must meet non-defaultable pension obligations and may value government spending more than citizens. I quantify the model using data on California cities, including a new record of fiscal emergencies, tax increases required to maintain essential city services.
url:c1e6ad990006c32d.abstract_zh: 本文研究了市政府如何协同管理支出、信贷市场借贷以及公共雇员养老金体系。我将政府建模为必须履行不可违约养老金义务的杠杆投资者，且可能比市民更重视政府支出。我利用加利福尼亚州各城市的数据对模型进行量化，其中包括一份新的财政紧急事件记录，以及为维持基本城市服务所需的增税措施。

url:c26b43eba4e70bcb.abstract: We study the industrial incidence of net zero in DICE-IO, a 33-sector climate-economy model calibrated to global input--output data. The standard smokestack principle suggests that the largest direct emitters should bear the largest transition burden. We show that this incidence logic breaks down in a production network: carbon costs propagate downstream and can weigh most heavily on industries that use carbon-intensive inputs. We summarize this mechanism with a sufficient statistic for first-order price incidence, the Leontief-based embodied-emissions multiplier, which we call Downstream Emission Centrality (DEC). DEC equals the sectoral price response to a marginal Scope-1 carbon tax and explains nearly all cross-sectional price variation along the nonlinear net-zero transition. Achieving the Paris Agreement target requires a carbon tax rising to about $1,300 per ton of CO2 by 2050. The Scope-1 transition has a consumption-equivalent welfare cost of 0.7% relative to laissez-faire, while a Scope-3-style tax on embodied carbon in purchases yields a welfare gain of 1.1%.
url:c26b43eba4e70bcb.abstract_zh: 我们研究了DICE-IO模型中净零排放的产业影响，该模型是一个校准至全球投入产出数据的33部门气候经济模型。标准的“烟囱原则”认为，直接排放量最大的行业应承担最大的转型负担。我们表明，这种影响逻辑在生产网络中失效：碳成本向下游传导，可能对使用碳密集型投入的行业影响最为沉重。我们通过一个充分统计量来概括这一机制，用于一阶价格影响，即基于列昂惕夫的隐含排放乘数，我们称之为下游排放中心性（DEC）。DEC等于部门对边际范围一碳税的价格响应，并解释了非线性净零转型中几乎所有的横截面价格变动。实现巴黎协定目标要求碳税到2050年升至每吨二氧化碳约1300美元。相对于放任自流，范围一转型的消费等价福利成本为0.7%，而对购买中隐含碳征收范围三式税收则带来1.1%的福利收益。
url:c26b43eba4e70bcb.title: DP21881 Beyond the Smokestack: Supply Chains and the Industrial Incidence of Net Zero

url:c28bc69e82c25a17.abstract: This article investigates the role of spatial scale in recovering resident preferences and evaluating policy effects after changes in environmental amenities. As homeowners choose locations, different trade-offs occur across spatial scales, which jointly determine observed choices and equilibrium outcomes. To explore these trade-offs, we develop a multispatial residential location choice model at the school attendance boundary and the residential neighborhood levels that demonstrates the spatially varying influence of environmental amenities on location choice. Furthering this analysis, welfare simulations provide evidence that trade-offs interact across space in various ways to shape welfare implications and distributional outcomes arising from policy. JEL Q51C35
url:c28bc69e82c25a17.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了空间尺度在环境设施变化后恢复居民偏好及评估政策效应中的作用。随着房主选择居住地点，不同空间尺度上会出现各种权衡，这些权衡共同决定了观察到的选择与均衡结果。为探究这些权衡，我们构建了一个涵盖学校招生边界与居住社区层面的多空间居住选址模型，该模型展示了环境设施对选址决策影响的空间差异性。进一步分析中，福利模拟提供了证据，表明权衡在空间上以多种方式相互作用，从而塑造了政策引发的福利影响及分配结果。JEL Q51C35

url:c2c0ae318f2f599b.abstract: We study the evolution of bank branch networks in ten CESEE countries between 2013 and 2021. Using a manually compiled dataset of all branches and their geocoordinates, we document a decline exceeding 30%, with substantial heterogeneity across and within countries. We show that banking market consolidation is a key driver of closures, while profitability and local economic growth mitigate them. Branches in highly urban or very rural areas close more often. Competitive effects are nonlinear: moderate clustering lowers closure risk, but intense competition increases it. These patterns differ markedly across CESEE banking systems during the entire period we analyze. JEL Classification: D53, G21, R12
url:c2c0ae318f2f599b.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2013年至2021年间十个中东欧及东南欧国家（CESEE）银行分支网络的变化。基于手动编制的全部分支机构及其地理坐标数据集，我们记录了超过30%的降幅，且各国及国内各地区存在显著异质性。研究表明，银行市场整合是分支机构关闭的关键驱动因素，而盈利能力和地方经济增长则能缓解这一趋势。高度城市化或偏远地区的分支机构关闭频率更高。竞争效应呈现非线性特征：适度集聚降低关闭风险，但激烈竞争则增加该风险。在我们分析的整个时期内，这些模式在CESEE各银行体系中存在显著差异。JEL分类号：D53, G21, R12
url:c2c0ae318f2f599b.title: The changing geography of banking in CESEE. Branch closures outpace openings
url:c2c0ae318f2f599b.title_zh: 中东欧及东南欧银行业地理格局变迁：分行关闭速度超过新设

url:c2c29731a5b742fe.abstract: Accounting for multiple responses to weather shocks drastically changes policy implications for adaptation to increasingly variable weather. Kenyan households react to temperature anomalies by sending migrants, by transiting to less climate-sensitive occupations, and by changing livestock species. Evidence suggests these are short-term adjustments, which respond significantly to common interventions. Randomised income transfers cushion consumption losses and decrease adaptation pressure, such as migration. Better infrastructure, instead, eases occupational transitions, reducing alternative adjustments, including migration and livestock composition. A model of joint migration, occupation, and livestock choices reveals long-term effects of these short-term shocks. Transitions to non-agriculture first act as a substitute for migration and subsequently as a stepping stone for later migration.
url:c2c29731a5b742fe.abstract_zh: 考虑对天气冲击的多重反应，会极大地改变针对日益多变气候的适应政策含义。肯尼亚家庭通过迁移移民、转向对气候敏感度较低的职业以及改变牲畜种类来应对温度异常。证据表明，这些是短期调整，且对常见干预措施反应显著。随机收入转移缓解了消费损失，并降低了适应压力，如迁移。相反，更好的基础设施则促进了职业转换，减少了包括迁移和牲畜构成在内的其他调整方式。一个联合迁移、职业和牲畜选择的模型揭示了这些短期冲击的长期效应。向非农业的转变起初作为迁移的替代，随后成为后续迁移的跳板。
url:c2c29731a5b742fe.title: DP21830 Coping with weather shocks

url:c2f3d494d909fd67.abstract: This paper studies firms? incentives to provide quality when this decision affects the goods? degree of horizontal differentiation. Intuitively, one is inclined to argue that private incentives to provide quality are insufficient relative to the social optimum if a quality improvement reduces horizontal differentiation. We find that this argument depends on whether the game is simultaneous or sequential. In the former case private incentives prove excessive relative to the social optimum, and in the latter case, insufficient. As a result, a regulator might want to impose either minimum or maximum quality standards.
url:c2f3d494d909fd67.abstract_zh: 本文研究了当质量决策影响商品水平差异化程度时，企业提供质量的激励问题。直观上，人们倾向于认为，若质量提升会降低水平差异化，则私人提供质量的激励相对于社会最优水平将不足。我们发现，这一论点取决于博弈是同时进行还是序贯进行。在前一种情形下，私人激励相对于社会最优水平表现为过度；在后一种情形下则表现为不足。因此，监管者可能需设定最低或最高质量标准。
url:c2f3d494d909fd67.title: Attribute Dependence and the Provision of Quality

url:c320943d2b46fd5e.abstract: Conflicts between management and workers are common and can have significant impacts on productivity. We study how workers in a large Bangladeshi sweater factory responded to management’s decision to lay off about a quarter of the workers following a period of labor unrest. Our main finding is that the mass layoff resulted in a large and persistent reduction in the productivity of surviving workers. Moreover, it is specifically the firing of peers with whom workers had social connections – \textit{friends} – that matters. We also provide suggestive evidence of deliberate shading of performance by workers in order to punish the factory’s management, and a corresponding deliberate attempt by the factory to win the angry workers back by selectively giving them tasks that are more rewarding. By combining ethnographic and survey data on the socialization process with the factory’s internal records, the paper provides a rare glimpse into the aftermath of an episode of labor unrest. A portrait of the firm emerges as a web of interconnected relational agreements supported by social connections.
url:c320943d2b46fd5e.abstract_zh: 管理层与工人之间的冲突屡见不鲜，且可能对生产力产生重大影响。我们研究了孟加拉国一家大型毛衣工厂在经历一段劳工动荡后，管理层决定裁减约四分之一的工人，工人们对此如何反应。我们的主要发现是，大规模裁员导致幸存工人的生产力出现大幅且持续的下降。此外，关键在于被解雇的是那些与工人有社会联系的同伴——即“朋友”。我们还提供了暗示性证据，表明工人故意降低工作表现以惩罚工厂管理层，而工厂则相应地试图通过有选择地分配更有回报的任务来挽回愤怒的工人。通过将关于社会化过程的人种学与调查数据同工厂内部记录相结合，本文为劳工动荡事件后的情形提供了罕见的洞察。企业形象由此浮现为一个由社会联系支撑的相互关联的关系协议网络。
url:c320943d2b46fd5e.title: DP15106 Layoffs and Productivity at a Bangladeshi Sweater Factory
url:c320943d2b46fd5e.title_zh: DP15106 孟加拉国毛衣工厂的裁员与生产率

url:c32bd90ef9f1d809.abstract: We introduce a methodology to measure cross-country trends in innovation capability- "technological trajectoriesâ€ and implement this on a new rich dataset covering patents between 1836 and 2016 across multiple countries. Intuitively, trajectories are revealed by a country's sustained increases in patenting across multiple patent offices. We first describe the data patterns, showing the relative decline of the UK, and the rise first of the US and Germany, and then later of Japan and China. We then econometrically estimate trajectories on (i) the post-1902 period for France, Germany, Japan, the UK and US, and (ii) the post-1960 period for a wider sample of 40 countries. Our trajectories are strongly positively correlated with Total Factor Productivity growth, and also (but less strongly) associated with the growth of labour productivity and capital intensity. We show that future trajectories are predicted by a country's initial levels of R&D, education and defence spending, classic drivers of innovation in modern growth theory.
url:c32bd90ef9f1d809.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种衡量各国创新能力跨国趋势的方法——“技术轨迹”，并将其应用于一个涵盖1836年至2016年间多国专利的新丰富数据集。直观上，技术轨迹通过一国在多个专利局持续增加的专利申请量得以显现。我们首先描述了数据模式，展示了英国的相对衰退，以及美国、德国先崛起，随后日本和中国相继崛起的趋势。接着，我们运用计量经济学方法估计了（i）1902年后法国、德国、日本、英国和美国的技术轨迹，以及（ii）1960年后更广泛样本中40个国家的技术轨迹。我们的技术轨迹与全要素生产率增长呈强正相关，同时（虽然较弱）也与劳动生产率增长和资本密集度相关联。我们还发现，未来的技术轨迹可由一国初始的研发投入、教育水平和国防支出预测，这些正是现代增长理论中创新的经典驱动因素。
url:c32bd90ef9f1d809.title: Mapping Technological Trajectories: Evidence from Two Centuries of Patent Data
url:c32bd90ef9f1d809.title_zh: 技术轨迹的映射：来自两个世纪专利数据的证据

url:c35686369bc0db95.abstract: Supply chain disruptions have become a recurring feature of recent economic dynamics and an increasing concern in inflation policy discussions. This column argues that inflationary effects of these disruptions operate through more than higher import and transportation costs: when supply-chain bottlenecks make products harder to replenish, firms’ pricing power increases, and these price increases are further amplified by strategic responses to competitors’ disruptions. Using new data that link consumer prices to US maritime import shipments by consumer goods producers, the authors show that these competitive pricing spillovers substantially amplified the price effects of supply chain disruptions in the aftermath of the pandemic in the US.
url:c35686369bc0db95.abstract_zh: 供应链中断已成为近期经济动态中反复出现的特征，并在通胀政策讨论中日益受到关注。本专栏认为，这些中断的通胀效应不仅通过提高进口和运输成本发挥作用：当供应链瓶颈导致产品补货困难时，企业的定价能力增强，而这些价格上涨还会因企业对竞争对手中断的战略反应而进一步放大。通过使用将消费者价格与美国消费品生产商的海运进口货物联系起来的新数据，作者表明，这些竞争性定价溢出效应显著放大了疫情后美国供应链中断的价格影响。
url:c35686369bc0db95.title: The price of delay: How supply chain disruptions spread into consumer prices
url:c35686369bc0db95.title_zh: 延迟的代价：供应链中断如何传导至消费者价格

url:c3712e91db8e2d5c.abstract: I study the role of industries’ position in supply chains in shaping the transmission of final demand shocks. First, I use a novel shift-share design leveraging destination-specific final demand shocks and a new measure of destination exposure accounting for direct and indirect linkages. I find that demand shocks amplify significantly as they propagate upstream, with upstream industries experiencing output elasticities up to three times larger than final good producers, consistent with the bullwhip effect. To rationalize these empirical results, I develop a tractable production network model with inventories and study how the properties of the network and the cyclicality of inventories interact to determine whether final demand shocks amplify or dissipate upstream. I test the mechanism by directly estimating the model-implied relationship between output growth and demand shocks, mediated by network position and inventories. I find that the presence of inventories increases output elasticities by 18% on average, highlighting the macroeconomic significance of this channel. Finally, I use the model to quantitatively study the effects of long-run trends of lengthening supply chains and rising inventories on the volatility of the economy.
url:c3712e91db8e2d5c.abstract_zh: 我研究了产业在供应链中的位置如何影响最终需求冲击的传导。首先，我采用了一种新颖的份额-变动设计，利用目的地特定的最终需求冲击，并引入了一种新的目的地暴露度衡量方法，该方法考虑了直接和间接联系。我发现，需求冲击在上游传播时显著放大，上游产业的产出弹性比最终产品生产者高出多达三倍，这与牛鞭效应一致。为了合理化这些实证结果，我构建了一个包含库存的可处理生产网络模型，并研究了网络特性与库存周期性如何相互作用，以决定最终需求冲击在上游是放大还是消散。我通过直接估计模型隐含的产出增长与需求冲击之间的关系来检验机制，该关系受网络位置和库存的中介作用。我发现，库存的存在使产出弹性平均增加18%，凸显了这一渠道的宏观经济重要性。最后，我利用该模型定量研究了供应链延长和库存上升的长期趋势对经济波动性的影响。
url:c3712e91db8e2d5c.title: Inventories, Demand Shocks Propagation, and Amplification in Supply Chains
url:c3712e91db8e2d5c.title_zh: 供应链中的库存、需求冲击传导与放大效应

url:c38a64464e1e84e8.title: Is free trade good for renewable resources? Brander and Taylor redux

url:c3bd9fff50d917db.abstract: This paper examines the gender pay gap among youth aged 15-29 in Egypt, Jordan, and Palestine using the 2021 Labor Force Surveys. The analysis identifies the main determinants of wages for young men and women and estimates the extent of gender-based wage disparities. The Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition is used to distinguish the share of the wage gap explained by observable characteristics from the unexplained component, often associated with discrimination. Melly's quantile decomposition is applied from the 10th to the 90th percentile. The findings show that youth wages are positively associated with higher education and professional experience. A significant gender pay gap favoring young men is found in Egypt and Palestine, with Egypt showing the largest disparity. In Jordan, the average gap is small and statistically insignificant, with young women slightly out-earning young men. However, the decomposition results reveal a significant positive unexplained component across all three countries, suggesting persistent disparities after accounting for observable factors. The quantile analysis further shows a "sticky floorâ€ effect in Egypt and a "glass ceilingâ€ effect in Palestine.
url:c3bd9fff50d917db.abstract_zh: 本文利用2021年劳动力调查数据，考察埃及、约旦和巴勒斯坦15-29岁青年的性别工资差距。分析确定了青年男性和女性工资的主要决定因素，并估算了基于性别的工资差异程度。采用奥克萨卡-布林德分解法，将可观测特征解释的工资差距部分与通常归因于歧视的未解释部分区分开来。同时，应用梅利分位数分解法，从第10百分位到第90百分位进行分析。研究结果表明，青年工资与高等教育和职业经验呈正相关。在埃及和巴勒斯坦，存在显著有利于青年男性的性别工资差距，其中埃及的差距最大。在约旦，平均差距较小且统计上不显著，青年女性收入略高于青年男性。然而，分解结果显示，三个国家均存在显著的正向未解释成分，表明在控制可观测因素后，差距依然持续存在。分位数分析进一步揭示了埃及的“粘地板”效应和巴勒斯坦的“玻璃天花板”效应。

url:c4222042ca44ea61.abstract: A criticism against individual-based stated preference surveys is that people seldom make choices in social isolation. An approach used in response to this is deliberative valuation. We conduct a series of valuation workshops including a choice experiment. This involves providing respondents with information and opportunity to discuss. They made their choices individually both before and after the discussion. On average respondents stated different preferences after the discussion compared to before, and the stated preferences became more consistent after deliberation. Unexpectedly, persons stating high certainty of pre-deliberation choices changed stated preferences more after deliberation than persons stating lower certainty of choices. JEL Q51Q57
url:c4222042ca44ea61.abstract_zh: 针对基于个体的陈述偏好调查，一个批评是人们在做出选择时很少处于社会孤立状态。为应对此问题，一种方法是审议式评估。我们开展了一系列评估工作坊，其中包括一项选择实验。这涉及向受访者提供信息并给予讨论机会。他们在讨论前后分别独立做出选择。平均而言，受访者在讨论后陈述的偏好与讨论前相比有所不同，且审议后陈述的偏好变得更加一致。出乎意料的是，在审议前选择中表示高度确定性的个体，在审议后改变陈述偏好的程度大于表示较低确定性的个体。JEL分类号：Q51 Q57

url:c443474a65c0ea84.abstract: When countries are hit by supply shocks, central banks often face the dilemma of either looking through such shocks or reacting to them to ensure that inflation expectations remain anchored. In this paper, we propose a tractable framework to capture this dilemma and explore optimal policy under various assumptions on how agents form their expectations and the sophistication with which those expectations account for the central bank’s announced policies. While our analysis covers a wide range of potential specifications, our baseline results focus on level-k thinking (LKT) – a form of bounded rationality that enjoys significant support in the experimental literature and encompasses both adaptive expectations (AE) and rational expectations (RE) as special cases. Nonetheless, we show that the optimal policy under LKT is qualitatively very different from its analogues under AE and RE, exhibiting abrupt pivots in the policy stance. In particular, it is optimal for the central bank to initially look through supply shocks until a threshold is reached, then pivot discontinuously to a more hawkish anti-inflationary stance. We find that such pivots can, if optimally executed, be compatible with soft landings in the sense that most (or even all) of the reduction in inflation occurs through re-anchoring of expectations rather than economic slack. We also discuss risks and why policy errors in terms of tightening too late or too slowly can be especially costly in such an environment.
url:c443474a65c0ea84.abstract_zh: 当各国遭遇供给冲击时，央行常面临两难抉择：是选择忽略此类冲击，还是主动应对以锚定通胀预期。本文构建了一个易于处理的框架来刻画这一困境，并探讨在关于经济主体预期形成方式及其对央行政策声明理解深度的不同假设下，最优政策选择。尽管我们的分析涵盖多种潜在设定，但基准结果聚焦于层级思维（LKT）——这种有限理性形式在实验文献中获得广泛支持，并将适应性预期（AE）和理性预期（RE）作为其特例。然而研究表明，LKT下的最优政策与AE和RE下的对应政策存在本质差异，表现为政策立场的突变式转向。具体而言，央行最优策略是：在供给冲击初期选择忽略，直至达到某个阈值后，突然转向更鹰派的抗通胀立场。我们发现，若此类转向得以最优执行，可兼容经济软着陆——即通胀下降主要源于预期重新锚定而非经济疲软。本文还讨论了相关风险，并指出在此环境下，过迟或过慢收紧的政策失误将付出尤为高昂的代价。

url:c4beb01946b6d678.abstract: We study the roles of globalization and structural change in the evolution of international GDP comovement among industrialized countries over the period 1978-2007. In recent decades, trade integration between advanced economies increased rapidly while average GDP correlations remained stable. We show that structural change – trend reallocation of economic activity towards services – plays an important part in resolving this apparent puzzle. Business cycle shocks in the service sector are less internationally correlated than in manufacturing, and thus structural change lowers GDP comovement by increasing the share of less correlated sectors in GDP. Globalization – trend reductions in trade costs – exerts two opposing effects on cross-border GDP comovement. On the one hand, greater trade linkages increase international transmission of shocks and therefore comovement. On the other, globalization induces structural change towards services because it reduces the relative price of traded goods, and services and goods are complements. We use a multi-country, multi-sector model of international production and trade to quantify these effects. The two opposing effects of globalization on comovement largely cancel each other out, limiting the net contribution of globalization to increasing international comovement over this period.
url:c4beb01946b6d678.abstract_zh: 我们研究了1978年至2007年间全球化与结构性变化在工业化国家国际GDP联动性演变中的作用。近几十年来，发达经济体之间的贸易一体化迅速加深，而平均GDP相关性却保持稳定。我们表明，结构性变化——经济活动向服务业趋势性再配置——在解释这一表面上的悖论中扮演了重要角色。服务业中的商业周期冲击在国际间的相关性低于制造业，因此，结构性变化通过提高GDP中相关性较低部门的份额，降低了GDP联动性。全球化——贸易成本的趋势性降低——对跨境GDP联动性产生两种相反的影响。一方面，更强的贸易联系增强了冲击的国际传导，从而提高了联动性。另一方面，全球化通过降低贸易商品的相对价格，且服务与商品为互补品，促使经济结构向服务业转变。我们运用一个多国、多部门国际生产与贸易模型来量化这些效应。全球化对联动性的两种相反影响在很大程度上相互抵消，限制了全球化在该时期对提升国际联动性的净贡献。

url:c4cfe211c7364012.abstract: The optimal investment to mitigate climate change crucially depends on the discount rate used to evaluate the investment?s uncertain future benefits. The appropriate discount rate is a function of the horizon over which these benefits accrue and the riskiness of the investment. In this paper, we estimate the term structure of discount rates for an important risky asset class, real estate, up to the very long horizons relevant for investments in climate change abatement. We show that this term structure is steeply downward-sloping, reaching 2.6% at horizons beyond 100 years. We explore the implications of these new data within both a general asset pricing framework that decomposes risks and returns by horizon and a structural model calibrated to match a variety of asset classes. Our analysis demonstrates that applying average rates of return that are observed for traded assets to investments in climate change abatement is misleading. We also show that the discount rates for investments in climate change abatement that reduce aggregate risk, as in disaster-risk models, are bounded above by our estimated term structure for risky housing, and should be below 2.6% for long-run benefits. This upper bound rules out many discount rates suggested in the literature and used by policymakers. Our framework also distinguishes between the various mechanisms the environmental literature has proposed for generating downward-sloping discount rates.
url:c4cfe211c7364012.abstract_zh: 减缓气候变化的最优投资，关键取决于用于评估投资不确定未来收益的折现率。合适的折现率是这些收益累积的时间跨度及投资风险性的函数。本文中，我们估算了重要风险资产类别——房地产——直至与气候变化减缓投资相关的极长周期内的折现率期限结构。我们证明，这一期限结构呈陡峭下行趋势，在超过100年的周期上降至2.6%。我们分别在按周期分解风险与收益的一般资产定价框架内，以及校准以匹配多种资产类别的结构模型中，探讨了这些新数据的含义。我们的分析表明，将交易资产观察到的平均回报率应用于气候变化减缓投资是具有误导性的。我们还证明，在灾害风险模型中，用于减少总体风险的气候变化减缓投资的折现率，其上限受我们估算的风险住房期限结构约束，长期收益应低于2.6%。这一上限排除了文献中及政策制定者使用的许多折现率建议。我们的框架还区分了环境文献中提出的产生下行折现率期限结构的各种机制。

url:c511c5688ff3a9ba.abstract: The EU’s Recovery and Resilience Facility has become a central test case for performance-based fiscal policy. Its experience offers lessons for the design of the next Multiannual Financial Framework. This column reviews evidence on the facility’s economic impact, implementation, and use of milestones and targets. It argues that the facility has supported demand, helped advance reforms, and strengthened EU fiscal integration, but that complex plans and administrative bottlenecks have slowed disbursement. Future EU budget instruments should link reforms and investment while keeping plans focused, flexible, and aligned with implementation capacity.
url:c511c5688ff3a9ba.abstract_zh: 欧盟复苏与韧性基金已成为绩效导向型财政政策的核心试验案例，其经验为下一期多年期财政框架的设计提供了借鉴。本专栏梳理了该基金在经济影响、实施过程及里程碑与目标运用方面的实证证据，指出该基金在支撑需求、推动改革及强化欧盟财政一体化方面发挥了积极作用，但复杂的计划与行政瓶颈导致资金拨付进度放缓。未来欧盟预算工具应在保持计划聚焦性、灵活性与实施能力匹配度的前提下，实现改革与投资的联动。

url:c54abdfee23d23d4.abstract: Lose your job at 25 and someone will help you find another. Lose it at 55 and the talk quietly turns to how you might wind down towards retirement. Policymakers tend to assume job search training works for the young and not the old, so they rarely spend money trying. Bas van der Klaauw (Tinbergen Institute) thinks they got that wrong. In this week's VoxTalks Economics, he tells Tim Phillips about a Dutch experiment that put older unemployed workers through an intensive programme built on one idea: teach people over 50 to find work the way younger workers already do, by working their social network. Participants left unemployment faster, there was a 10% increase in job finding, and the savings in benefits more than covered the cost. The catch: it helped the better educated most and was tested in a recession. Will it work just as well in today's labour market, where even the young and well-educated are struggling to find good jobs?
url:c54abdfee23d23d4.abstract_zh: 25岁失业，会有人帮你找新工作；55岁失业，人们却悄悄谈论如何让你平稳过渡到退休。政策制定者往往认为求职培训对年轻人有效，对年长者无效，因此很少为此投入资金。丁伯根研究所的巴斯·范德克劳认为他们错了。在本周的VoxTalks经济学节目中，他向蒂姆·菲利普斯介绍了一项荷兰实验：该实验让年长失业者参加一个强化项目，核心理念是——教50岁以上的人像年轻人一样利用社交网络找工作。参与者更快脱离失业状态，就业率提升10%，节省的福利金远超项目成本。但局限在于：该项目对高学历者效果最佳，且测试期正值经济衰退。在当今连年轻高学历者都难觅好工作的劳动力市场中，它还能同样奏效吗？

url:c5844b10d74f1416.abstract: This paper studies the effects that the revelation of information on the electorate's preferences has on voters' turnout decisions. The experimental data show that closeness in the division of preferences induces a significant increase in turnout. Moreover, for closely divided electorates (and only for these electorates) the provision of information significantly raises the participation of subjects supporting the slightly larger team relative to the smaller team. This behaviour contradicts the qualitative predictions of the unique quasi-symmetric Nash equilibrium of the theoretical model. We show that the heterogeneous effect of information on the participation of subjects in different teams is driven by the subjects' (incorrect) beliefs of casting a pivotal vote. Simply put, subjects overestimate the probability of casting a pivotal vote when they belong to the team with a slight majority, and choose the strategy that maximizes their utility based on their inflated probability assessment. Empirical evidence on gubernatorial elections in the U.S. between 1990 and 2005 is consistent with our main experimental result. Namely, we observe that the difference in the actual vote tally between the party leading according to the polls and the other party is larger than the one predicted by the polls only in closely divided electorates. We provide a behavioural model that explains the main findings of our experimental and empirical analyses.
url:c5844b10d74f1416.abstract_zh: 本文研究了选民偏好信息揭示对投票参与决策的影响。实验数据表明，偏好分歧的接近程度会显著提高投票率。此外，在偏好分歧较小的选民群体中（且仅针对此类群体），信息提供会显著提升支持略占优势阵营的参与者相对于支持较小阵营者的参与度。这一行为与理论模型中唯一拟对称纳什均衡的定性预测相悖。我们证明，信息对不同阵营参与者参与度的异质性影响源于参与者对自身投票成为关键票概率的（错误）信念。简言之，当参与者属于略占多数阵营时，会高估其投票成为关键票的概率，并基于这种膨胀的概率评估选择效用最大化的策略。1990年至2005年间美国州长选举的实证证据与我们的主要实验结果一致：仅在偏好分歧较小的选民群体中，实际投票结果中民调领先政党与其他政党之间的得票差异大于民调预测值。我们构建了一个行为模型来解释实验与实证分析的主要发现。

url:c58bbe0c2dc87372.abstract: Using monthly bilateral trade data for 50 countries at the HTS-10 product level, this paper finds that foreign exporters absorbed 40-50 percent of the tariff increases, consistent with optimal tariff theory. Absorption was highly unequal: dominant exporters absorbed 50–65 percent of the tariff shock through lower export prices, while smaller suppliers passed through most or all of the tariff. The results differ from previous studies finding near-complete pass-through for the 2025 tariff shock because of asymmetrical treatment of suppliers. Other studies evaluate whether the typical trade partner absorbed tariffs—it did not. But given trade is highly skewed, with the top exporting country in a product accounting for nearly 50 percent of trade on average, and the top 1 percent of products accounting for over 50 percent of trade, the focus here is on aggregate effects. Provided the largest suppliers are absorbing tariffs, consumer prices will rise by less. The results are robust to a wide range of controls.
url:c58bbe0c2dc87372.abstract_zh: 本文利用50个国家在HTS-10产品层面的月度双边贸易数据，发现外国出口商吸收了40%-50%的关税增长，这与最优关税理论一致。吸收程度高度不均：主导出口商通过降低出口价格吸收了50%-65%的关税冲击，而较小供应商则转嫁了大部分或全部关税。这一结果与先前研究发现2025年关税冲击近乎完全转嫁的结论不同，原因在于对供应商的非对称处理。其他研究评估了典型贸易伙伴是否吸收关税——结论是否定的。但由于贸易高度倾斜，产品层面最大出口国平均占贸易额近50%，且前1%的产品占贸易额超过50%，本文聚焦于总体效应。只要最大供应商吸收关税，消费者价格涨幅就会更小。该结果在广泛的控制变量下依然稳健。

url:c5a8cb23ea6ad473.abstract: Reported estimates of the size premium, the tendency of smaller firms to earn higher average returns than larger firms, vary widely across studies, countries, periods, and designs. We examine whether generalized trust and rule of law help account for that heterogeneity. Small firms are more opaque and more dependent on outside finance, so the enforcement and information environment should matter more for them than for large firms. We study 1,613 reported size-slope estimates from 105 studies and 31 countries. The meta-regressions control for study design, specification, precision, publication context, and market and macro-financial conditions; Bayesian model averaging assesses uncertainty over the control set. The more stable association is with rule of law, and it runs against the intuitive expectation that better legal institutions shrink the premium: stronger rule of law is associated with more negative reported size slopes, hence larger conventional size premia. The trust association is conditional and less precisely estimated: where rule of law is weak, higher generalized trust is linked to less negative reported slopes (and thus a weaker premium), and this link fades as rule of law strengthens. Formal and informal institutions thus help organize part of the disagreement in this literature, although the analysis concerns variation in reported estimates and does not identify causal effects.
url:c5a8cb23ea6ad473.abstract_zh: 关于规模溢价（即小公司平均回报率高于大公司的趋势）的估计结果，在不同研究、国家、时期及设计间差异显著。我们探讨了普遍信任与法治是否有助于解释这一异质性。小公司更为不透明，且更依赖外部融资，因此执法与信息环境对其影响应大于大公司。我们分析了来自105项研究、31个国家的1,613个规模斜率估计值。元回归分析控制了研究设计、规格、精确度、发表背景及市场与宏观金融条件；贝叶斯模型平均法评估了控制集的不确定性。与法治的关联更为稳定，且与直觉预期相反——更好的法律机构并未缩小溢价：更强的法治与更负的规模斜率报告值相关，从而对应更大的传统规模溢价。信任的关联则具有条件性且估计精度较低：在法治薄弱的环境中，较高的普遍信任与较不显著的负斜率报告值（即较弱的溢价）相关，而这一关联随法治加强而减弱。因此，正式与非正式制度有助于部分梳理该文献中的分歧，尽管分析涉及报告估计值的变异性，并未识别因果效应。
url:c5a8cb23ea6ad473.title: DP21840 Trust, Rule of Law, and the Size Premium: Evidence from a Meta-Analysis

url:c5b38ffa27223239.abstract: Artificial intelligence is already reshaping the economy and society. This column analyses how AI affects firms, markets, and workers using 380 trillion tokens of realised AI consumption. It calculates the sensitivity of stocks to growth in AI use and estimates a premium capturing how the equity market values that sensitivity. Firms with higher sensitivity earn higher subsequent returns. The AI premium is highest for developed markets, frontier models, experienced users, and complex tasks. Equity markets furthermore associate the AI transition more positively with work involving implementation, communication, and coordination than with analytical and scientific tasks.
url:c5b38ffa27223239.abstract_zh: 人工智能正在重塑经济与社会。本文基于380万亿个已实现的人工智能消费标记，分析了人工智能如何影响企业、市场与劳动者。研究计算了股票对人工智能使用增长的敏感度，并估算了股票市场对该敏感度定价的溢价。敏感度较高的企业后续获得了更高的回报。人工智能溢价在发达市场、前沿模型、经验丰富的用户以及复杂任务中最为显著。此外，相较于分析与科学类任务，股票市场将人工智能转型与涉及实施、沟通和协调的工作更积极地关联起来。
url:c5b38ffa27223239.title: The AI premium
