url:ccb861a48b43688e.abstract: We document the state-dependence of monetary policy transmission to output and core consumer prices in a sample of eleven large inflation-targeting emerging markets along three cyclical dimensions: the business cycle position, the monetary policy stance, and the level of trend inflation. We show that monetary policy has strong effects on output during recessions and after a period of loose monetary policy, but little to no impact during expansions or when monetary policy has been tight. In contrast, the response of prices is muted regardless of business cycle position or monetary policy stance. Transmission also depends on trend inflation: when trend inflation is low, monetary policy has a stronger impact on output and a weaker effect on prices, whereas a high-inflation environment dampens the output response and amplifies price adjustments. These findings are broadly consistent with the presence of financial frictions in the form of occasionally binding borrowing constraints, endogenous frequency of price adjustments, loss aversion preferences, and a convex Phillips Curve.
url:ccb861a48b43688e.abstract_zh: 本文基于11个大型通胀目标制新兴市场国家的样本，从三个周期性维度——经济周期位置、货币政策立场及趋势通胀水平——系统论证了货币政策向产出与核心消费价格传导的状态依赖性。研究表明：在经济衰退期及宽松货币政策实施后，货币政策对产出具有显著影响；但在经济扩张期或紧缩货币政策环境下，其影响微乎其微。相比之下，无论经济周期位置或货币政策立场如何，价格对货币政策的反应均较为平缓。传导效应还取决于趋势通胀水平：当趋势通胀较低时，货币政策对产出的影响更强，对价格的影响更弱；而高通胀环境则会抑制产出反应并放大价格调整幅度。这些发现与以下理论机制高度吻合：偶发性的借贷约束、价格调整的内生频率、损失厌恶偏好以及凸性菲利普斯曲线所体现的金融摩擦特征。

url:ccff7a8286f9330e.abstract: Focus Stablecoins – cryptoassets designed to maintain a stable value relative to a reference asset, most commonly the US dollar – have become the dominant medium of exchange within the crypto ecosystem. Their market capitalisation has expanded rapidly in recent years and is forecast to expand further, though projections vary widely. While a growing literature examines their implications for payment and financial systems, the macroeconomic consequences of broader stablecoin adoption remain underexplored.
url:ccff7a8286f9330e.abstract_zh: 焦点稳定币——旨在相对于参考资产（最常见的是美元）维持稳定价值的加密资产——已成为加密生态系统内的主导交换媒介。尽管预测差异较大，但其市值近年来迅速扩张，并预计将进一步增长。虽然越来越多的文献探讨了稳定币对支付和金融体系的影响，但更广泛采用稳定币的宏观经济后果仍未得到充分研究。

url:cd4cac38b53a74e7.abstract: Central banks lean on communication to anchor inflation expectations. But most households learn about the economy from the news rather than from policy statements, and in polarised societies, different outlets cover the same inflation very differently. Drawing on household panel data, television transcripts, and a randomised experiment in Turkey, this column shows that heavier inflation coverage on a viewer’s preferred channel raises their inflation expectations, an effect driven almost entirely by viewers of politically neutral channels. Partisan audiences barely respond, updating only to sources they already trust. Political segmentation of the media can therefore erode the common information base on which anchored expectations depend.
url:cd4cac38b53a74e7.abstract_zh: 中央银行倚重沟通来锚定通胀预期。然而，多数家庭是从新闻而非政策声明中了解经济状况，在极化社会中，不同媒体对同一通胀现象的报道方式大相径庭。基于家庭面板数据、电视节目文稿及在土耳其进行的一项随机实验，本专栏指出，观众偏好频道对通胀报道的增多会推高其通胀预期，这一效应几乎完全由观看政治中立频道的观众驱动。党派倾向的观众反应甚微，仅会依据其已信任的信息源进行调整。因此，媒体的政治分化可能侵蚀锚定预期所依赖的共同信息基础。

url:cd56ab605745c2d0.abstract: The secular rise in female labour force participation, highlighted in the recent macroeconomics literature on growth and structural change, has been associated with the declining price and wider availability of home appliances. This paper uses a new and unique country dataset on the price of home appliances to test its impact on female labour supply. We assess the role of the price of appliances in raising participation by comparing it to other structural determinants such as average male income. A decrease in the relative price of appliances - the ratio of the price of appliances to the consumer price index - leads to a substantial and statistically significant increase in female labour force participation. In the United Kingdom, for instance, the decline in the relative price of home appliances accounts alone for about 10 to 15 percent of the increase in female labour force participation from 1975 to 1999. This result is robust to the inclusion of additional controls, such as country dummies, time trend, government spending, capital to output ratio, and the growth rate of real GDP. To assess causality, we test for exogeneity and use the manufactured price index as an instrumental variable, confirming that lower appliance prices lead to increased female participation.
url:cd56ab605745c2d0.abstract_zh: 近期关于增长与结构变化的宏观经济学文献强调，女性劳动参与率的长期上升与家用电器价格下降及普及率提高密切相关。本文利用全新的国家层面家电价格数据集，检验其对女性劳动供给的影响。通过将家电价格与男性平均收入等其他结构性决定因素进行对比，我们评估了家电价格在提升女性劳动参与率中的作用。家电相对价格（即家电价格与消费者价格指数之比）的下降，显著且具有统计意义地提高了女性劳动参与率。以英国为例，1975年至1999年间，家用电器相对价格的下降单独解释了女性劳动参与率增长的10%至15%。在加入国家虚拟变量、时间趋势、政府支出、资本产出比及实际GDP增长率等额外控制变量后，该结果依然稳健。为评估因果关系，我们进行了外生性检验，并采用制造业价格指数作为工具变量，进一步证实了家电价格下降会促进女性劳动参与率提升。

url:cdf563fcfb821032.abstract: What costs do zombie banks impose on society? We analyze the effects of government and central bank interventions in 68 systemic banking crises since 1980, of which 28 are part of the recent global financial crisis. Our estimation approach controls for the correlation between intervention measures and the time-invariant component of unobservable crisis severity. We find that timely bank recapitalizations substantially reduce the duration of recessions, underscoring the distortions caused by zombie banks and the costs of regulatory forbearance.
url:cdf563fcfb821032.abstract_zh: 僵尸银行给社会带来了哪些成本？我们分析了自1980年以来68次系统性银行危机中政府和中央银行干预的效果，其中28次属于近期的全球金融危机。我们的估计方法控制了干预措施与危机严重程度中不随时间变化的不可观测成分之间的相关性。研究发现，及时的银行资本重组能显著缩短经济衰退的持续时间，凸显了僵尸银行造成的扭曲以及监管宽容的成本。

url:ce4f2fdfee785ff3.abstract: Using a variant of the Cagan model with rational expectations, this paper shows that expected stabilization can result in a budget deficit in excess of the maximum inflation tax. A cap on the deficit dampens inflation expectations and raises real balances, thus increasing the yield of the inflation tax for any given rate of inflation. This study extends the work of Drazen and Helpman (1990) by including a stochastic budgetary process and using option pricing theory. It uses parameter values of the semi-elasticity of demand for money to provide estimates of the maximum viable real deficit.
url:ce4f2fdfee785ff3.abstract_zh: 本文采用带有理性预期的卡甘模型变体，论证了预期稳定化可能导致预算赤字超过最大通胀税。赤字上限抑制了通胀预期并提高了实际货币余额，从而在给定通胀率下增加了通胀税的收益。本研究通过引入随机预算过程并运用期权定价理论，拓展了德拉曾与赫尔普曼（1990）的研究成果。基于货币需求半弹性参数值，本文提供了最大可行实际赤字的估算值。

url:ce5ff3354adca40b.abstract: Fertility is a complex amalgamation of human choice, economic conditions, and environmental factors. While the biological toxicity of wildfire-induced air pollution is well-documented to have severe detrimental effects on human health and the reproductive system, reproductive outcomes are not dictated by biology alone. They are profoundly shaped by human behavioral responses. This study analyzes the net effect of wildfire exposure, alongside economic shocks and non-parametric temperature extremes, on fertility in the United States. Utilizing a comprehensive county-monthyear panel dataset from 2010 to 2023, the analysis employs a Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood (PPML) regression incorporating high-dimensional county and year-month fixed effects. The primary findings reveal a statistically significant positive relationship between wildfire exposure and fertility. Utilizing SafeGraph mobility data, this study empirically isolates the behavioral mechanism driving this result: wildfires cause a highly significant increase in the proportion of the population sheltering completely at home, altering daily routines in a manner that overrides the biological detriments of smoke exposure. Furthermore, a continuous interaction analysis reveals a stark environmental justice divide: while the shelter-in-place "baby bump" occurs universally across income groups, economically vulnerable counties suffer severe fertility depressions from the economic anxiety accompanying disasters, significantly muting the behavioral bump. A 500iteration randomization inference (placebo) test confirms the causal robustness of these findings, yielding an empirical p-value of < 0.01.
url:ce5ff3354adca40b.abstract_zh: 生育是人类选择、经济状况与环境因素复杂交织的产物。尽管野火引发的空气污染在生物学上的毒性已被充分证实对人类健康及生殖系统具有严重不利影响，但生育结果并非仅由生物学因素决定，而是深受人类行为响应的塑造。本研究分析了野火暴露、经济冲击及非参数化温度极端事件对美国生育率的净效应。利用2010年至2023年间全面的县级-年月面板数据集，分析采用泊松伪极大似然（PPML）回归，并纳入高维县级及年月固定效应。主要发现揭示了野火暴露与生育率之间存在统计上显著的正相关关系。借助SafeGraph流动性数据，本研究实证分离了驱动这一结果的行为机制：野火导致完全居家庇护的人口比例显著增加，从而改变日常作息，其影响超越了烟雾暴露的生物学危害。此外，连续交互分析揭示了鲜明的环境正义鸿沟：尽管居家庇护引发的“婴儿潮”在各收入群体中普遍存在，但经济脆弱县因灾害伴随的经济焦虑而遭受严重的生育率抑制，显著削弱了行为性增长效应。一项500次迭代的随机化推断（安慰剂）检验证实了这些发现的因果稳健性，经验p值小于0.01。
url:ce5ff3354adca40b.title: Do Forests Burn Alone? The Role of Wildfire on Fertility in the United States
url:ce5ff3354adca40b.title_zh: 森林独自燃烧吗？野火对美国生育率的影响

url:ceb79d26918cbfc1.abstract: We develop an endogenous threshold VAR that addresses contemporaneous dependence between the threshold variable and reduced-form innovations— a pervasive issue when regime indicators are jointly determined with system dynamics. A regime-specific copula-based control function removes this dependence instrument-free, without parametric assumptions on the threshold’s marginal distribution, while preserving the linear regime-wise least-squares structure. We characterize the resulting misspecification through excess sensitivity and excess propagation errors in impulse responses, clarify structural and proxy-SVAR identification under endogenous regimes, and establish conditions under which Chan-type threshold asymptotics remain valid with generated controls. A Hermite sieve extension accommodates tail-dependent and asymmetric dependence. Monte Carlo evidence documents large distortions from ignoring endogeneity. Applied to monetary transmission, the framework avoids the price and persistence puzzles displayed by the linear VAR, delivers regime-dependent sacrifice ratios, and aligns estimated regimes with historical inflation episodes. JEL Classification: C32, C34, E52
url:ceb79d26918cbfc1.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个内生阈值向量自回归模型，该模型解决了阈值变量与简化形式新息之间的同期依赖问题——当体制指标与系统动态共同决定时，这是一个普遍存在的难题。通过采用基于体制特定连接函数的控制函数，我们无需工具变量即可消除这种依赖，无需对阈值的边际分布施加参数假设，同时保留了线性体制最小二乘结构。我们通过脉冲响应中的过度敏感性和过度传播误差来刻画由此产生的设定偏误，阐明了内生体制下的结构识别与代理SVAR识别，并建立了在生成控制变量条件下陈氏阈值渐近性质保持有效的条件。埃尔米特样条扩展方法可处理尾部依赖与非对称依赖。蒙特卡洛证据表明，忽略内生性会导致严重偏差。在货币政策传导的应用中，该框架避免了线性VAR模型呈现的价格谜题与持续性谜题，提供了依赖体制的牺牲比率，并使估计的体制与历史通胀阶段保持一致。JEL分类号：C32, C34, E52

url:ced006950eed6186.abstract: This paper examines the effects of early-life exposure to extreme heat on children's learning achievement in India. Exploiting within-district, across-cohort variation in early-life temperature exposure, we find that greater exposure to extreme heat significantly reduces reading, writing, and mathematics achievement in later childhood. These findings remain robust across a battery of robustness checks. We further show that early-life heat exposure adversely affects children's physical development, especially among children from households with limited coping capacity and those exposed to poorer disease environments, suggesting these channels play an important role in shaping later learning achievement. Finally, projections based on future climate scenarios indicate that continued warming is likely to exacerbate human capital losses in India. These findings highlight the persistent influence of early-life climate conditions on human capital formation and underscore the importance of incorporating climate resilience into education and early childhood policy in low- and middle-income countries.
url:ced006950eed6186.abstract_zh: 本文研究了印度儿童早期极端高温暴露对学业成就的影响。利用同一地区不同出生队列在早期温度暴露上的差异，我们发现极端高温暴露显著降低了儿童后期的阅读、写作和数学成绩。这一发现在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。进一步研究表明，早期高温暴露对儿童身体发育产生不利影响，尤其是在应对能力有限的家庭以及疾病环境较差的儿童中更为显著，这表明这些渠道在塑造后期学业成就方面发挥了重要作用。最后，基于未来气候情景的预测显示，持续变暖可能会加剧印度的人力资本损失。这些发现突显了早期气候条件对人力资本形成的持久影响，并强调了在中低收入国家将气候适应能力纳入教育和儿童早期政策的重要性。

url:cefd7911f263c42f.abstract: Students may hold stereotyped beliefs about subjects that distort subject choices. For example, economics is believed to be about money, not inequality or well-being, and this perception may attract some students to the subject, while deterring others. We report results from a UK-wide high school outreach program in which undergraduate champions delivered economics taster sessions to 5,000+ students. The sessions increase students’ reported likelihood of studying economics by ~20 per cent. We shed light on what drives this increase. The sessions broaden students’ understanding of what economics is about and this accounts for ~20 per cent of the increased likelihood. The sessions also change students’ beliefs about (different attributes of) studying economics. The most important drivers of the increased likelihood are students’ increased beliefs that they will do well in economics and that they will enjoy studying the subject.
url:cefd7911f263c42f.abstract_zh: 学生可能对学科持有刻板印象，从而扭曲其学科选择。例如，经济学被认为关乎金钱，而非不平等或福祉，这种认知可能吸引部分学生选择该学科，同时阻碍其他学生。我们报告了一项英国全国性高中外展项目的结果，在该项目中，本科生大使为5000多名学生提供了经济学体验课程。这些课程使学生报告的学习经济学可能性增加了约20%。我们揭示了这一增长背后的驱动因素。课程拓宽了学生对经济学内涵的理解，这解释了约20%的可能性增长。课程还改变了学生对学习经济学（不同方面）的信念。可能性增长的最重要驱动因素是学生对自己将在经济学上表现出色以及享受学习该学科的信心增强。

url:cf11bd42d334f962.abstract: this Paper we address this topic empirically, relying on a unique panel dataset that includes detailed credit-fie information on distressed lending relationships in Germany. In particular, it includes information on bank pools: a legal institution aimed at coordinating lender interests in borrower distress. We find that the existence of small bank pools increases the probability of workout success and that coordination costs are positively related to pool size. We identify major determinants of pool formation, in particular the distribution of lending shares among banks, the number of banks, and the severity of the distress shock to the borrower.
url:cf11bd42d334f962.abstract_zh: 本文基于一份独特的德国困境贷款关系面板数据集，对该主题进行了实证研究。该数据集特别包含了银行池的信息，这是一种旨在协调贷款人在借款人困境中利益的合法机构。我们发现，小型银行池的存在提高了重组成功的概率，且协调成本与银行池规模正相关。我们识别了银行池形成的主要决定因素，特别是银行间贷款份额的分布、银行数量以及借款人遭受困境冲击的严重程度。

url:cf4155ea9998cea0.abstract: Economists long considered money illusion to be largely irrelevant. Here we show, however, that money illusion has powerful effects on equilibrium selection. If we represent pay-offs in nominal terms, choices converge to the Pareto inefficient equilibrium; however, if we lift the veil of money by representing pay-offs in real terms, the Pareto efficient equilibrium is selected. We also show that strategic uncertainty about the other players? behaviour is key for the equilibrium selection effects of money illusion: even though money illusion vanishes over time if subjects are given learning opportunities in the context of an individual optimization problem, powerful and persistent effects of money illusion are found when strategic uncertainty prevails.
url:cf4155ea9998cea0.abstract_zh: 经济学家长期以来认为货币幻觉基本无关紧要。然而，本文表明货币幻觉对均衡选择具有显著影响。若以名义值表示收益，选择会收敛至帕累托低效均衡；但若通过实际值表示收益来揭开货币面纱，则会选择帕累托高效均衡。我们还发现，关于其他参与者行为的策略不确定性是货币幻觉产生均衡选择效应的关键：即便在个体优化问题情境下给予受试者学习机会时货币幻觉会随时间消退，但当策略不确定性占主导时，货币幻觉仍会产生强大且持续的影响。
url:cf4155ea9998cea0.title: Money Illusion and Coordination Failure

url:cf65ddcba206122f.abstract: This article develops a multi-period production model to examine the optimal dynamic behaviour of a large monopolistic value-maximizing firm that manipulates its valuation as well as the price of its output. In the pre-commitment equilibrium the firm?s output and labour demand are decreased, while the price of consumption is increased, as compared with its competitive counterpart. Profits and the firm's value can, however, be either increased or decreased. In the time-consistent equilibrium the firm?s output and labour demand are increased, while the price of consumption is decreased. More strikingly, the profits in every period are decreased, and may even go negative, while the firm's value can be either lower or higher than in the competitive benchmark. In the continuous-time limit, while the pre-commitment equilibrium retains its basic discrete-time structure, the time-consistent equilibrium tends to the limit of zero profits and hence zero firm's value.
url:cf65ddcba206122f.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个多期生产模型，以考察一个操纵自身估值及产出价格的大型垄断价值最大化企业的最优动态行为。在承诺均衡中，与竞争性基准情形相比，该企业的产出和劳动力需求下降，而消费品价格上升。然而，利润与企业价值可能上升或下降。在时间一致均衡中，企业的产出和劳动力需求上升，消费品价格下降。更显著的是，每一期的利润均下降，甚至可能为负，而企业价值可能低于或高于竞争性基准。在连续时间极限下，承诺均衡保留了其基本离散时间结构，而时间一致均衡则趋向于零利润极限，进而企业价值为零。
url:cf65ddcba206122f.title: Monopoly Power and the Firm's Valuation: A Dynamic Analysis of Short versus Long-Term Policies
url:cf65ddcba206122f.title_zh: 垄断势力与企业估值：短期与长期政策的动态分析

url:cf91b533b44c1b1e.abstract: We present the first large-scale field experiment evaluating the integration of generative AI into a national justice system. In partnership with Pakistan's judiciary, we built JudgeGPT, a custom generative AI assistant designed for Pakistan's trial courts, and randomized 1,559 judges serving across 118 courts into one of three arms: (i) access to the assistant with targeted training tailored to its use; (ii) access to AI with generic training on technology and law; and (iii) generic training without access to AI. Judges who received AI access together with targeted training on the use of the tool were more likely to adopt it, use it more intensively, and continue using it over time. Their attitudes toward AI also shift: they expect the tool and the targeted training to increase their productivity. Administrative records move in the same direction: districts with greater exposure to treated judges resolve more cases. At median-district exposure, introducing AI with targeted training corresponds to 1,848 additional cases resolved per year, a 6.3 percent increase over the mean. This increase does not appear to come at the expense of reduced quality, as measured by case appeals (which slightly decline) or text-based measures of judicial writing (which slightly improve). Chat-log-based usage patterns suggest that judges use AI mainly to clarify legal concepts and support drafting. Targeted training appears to shift use toward tasks where language models are likely to be more useful, such as text improvement, and away from more open-ended legal queries where responses are more costly to verify. Overall, the results suggest that generative AI can raise public-sector productivity, but that these gains may depend on targeted training that directs use toward tasks for which the tool is better suited.
url:cf91b533b44c1b1e.abstract_zh: 我们开展了首个大规模实地实验，评估将生成式人工智能整合进国家司法系统的效果。通过与巴基斯坦司法机构合作，我们构建了专为巴基斯坦初审法院设计的定制化生成式AI助手JudgeGPT，并将分布在118个法院的1559名法官随机分为三组：（i）获得AI助手并接受针对其使用的定向培训；（ii）获得AI助手并接受技术与法律通用培训；（iii）仅接受通用培训但无AI访问权限。结果显示，获得AI访问权限并接受定向培训的法官更倾向于采用该工具，使用频率更高且持续性更强。他们对AI的态度也发生转变：预期该工具及定向培训能提升自身工作效率。行政记录数据印证了这一趋势：接触过受训法官的地区案件处理量显著增加。在地区中位暴露水平下，引入AI并配合定向培训相当于每年多处理1848起案件，较均值提升6.3%。这种增长并未以质量下降为代价——案件上诉率（略有下降）和基于文本的司法文书质量指标（略有改善）均未出现负面变化。基于聊天日志的使用模式显示，法官主要利用AI澄清法律概念和辅助文书起草。定向培训促使使用行为从开放式法律咨询（此类回复验证成本较高）转向语言模型更擅长的任务（如文本优化）。总体而言，研究结果表明生成式AI能提升公共部门生产力，但这种提升可能取决于能否通过定向培训引导用户将工具应用于更适配的任务场景。

url:d025abd42081ba01.abstract: We estimate the causal impacts of GLP-1 treatment on labor market outcomes using linked Danish administrative data and a matched stacked difference-in-differences design. We compare patients who initiate GLP-1 treatment during the first two years of Semaglutide availability to observably similar patients who initiate four years later. We find that GLP-1 treatment reduces long-term sickness leave by 17.3%. We estimate total fiscal benefits of GLP-1 initiation of approximately 1.3–1.5% of annual labor income per employed individual. We do not detect statistically significant or economically meaningful impacts on income, labor force participation, or employment over four years.
url:d025abd42081ba01.abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦关联行政数据及匹配堆叠双重差分设计，评估了GLP-1治疗对劳动力市场结果的因果影响。我们将索马鲁肽上市前两年内开始GLP-1治疗的患者，与四年后开始治疗的观察特征相似的患者进行比较。研究发现，GLP-1治疗使长期病假减少了17.3%。我们估算，GLP-1治疗启动带来的总财政收益约为每位就业者年劳动收入的1.3%至1.5%。在四年期间，我们未检测到对收入、劳动力参与率或就业状况具有统计显著性或经济意义显著的影响。

url:d047d24f4be6aa10.abstract: Employing large language models to analyze official documents, we construct a comprehensive record of daily changes in de jure restrictions on cross-border flows worldwide since the 1950s. Our analysis uncovers the wide array of instruments used to regulate cross-border financial flows over the past seven decades, leveraging the fine granularity of the new measures to characterize cross-country and time-series variation across eight categories of restrictions —- distinguishing by flow, direction, instrument type, intensity, and overall policy stance. We exploit the high frequency nature of the new data to document novel patterns in the use of these restrictions, as well as their relationship to crises and political economy determinants.
url:d047d24f4be6aa10.abstract_zh: 利用大语言模型分析官方文件，我们构建了自20世纪50年代以来全球跨境流动法律限制每日变化的综合记录。通过新措施的高粒度特性，我们揭示了过去七十年间用于监管跨境资金流动的广泛工具组合，从八个限制类别（按流动类型、方向、工具种类、强度及整体政策立场区分）刻画了跨国与时间序列的差异。借助新数据的高频特征，我们记录了这些限制使用的新模式，及其与危机和政治经济决定因素之间的关联。

url:d057a29df50c8229.abstract: Authoritarian regimes shape citizens’ knowledge and beliefs through censorship and propaganda. We study which narratives they suppress and promote using a rare natural experiment: Ruwiki, created in 2023 by cloning Russian-language Wikipedia and selectively rewriting its 1.9 million articles under regime-aligned editorial control. We compare the two platforms twenty months after the fork, using within-Wikipedia changes as a placebo benchmark. We find that Ruwiki’s editing patterns resemble professional rather than volunteer-driven content production. An LLM-based comparison and machine-learning analyses of text deletions and insertions reveal a coherent ideology organized around three pillars: Russia’s image vis-àvis the rest of the world, domestic politics, and culture. The resulting narratives legitimize Russia’s past and present acts of aggression, suppress accounts of domestic opposition and human-rights violations, and promote traditional values. Culture’s centrality reveals how authoritarian information control penetrates domains far beyond formal politics, including morality, gender, family life, law, and psychology. Article deletions are rare and confined to topics that are difficult to reframe, while editing is broad, consistent with a preference for reframing existing content rather than leaving unanswered queries: 27% of articles undergo at least some change, 2.8% are heavily edited, and only 0.14% are deleted. Rewriting sensitive topics reduces readability, suggesting that ideological control is costly. An external benchmark using official high-school history textbooks confirms that Ruwiki’s revisions move articles on modern history toward state-sanctioned narratives. The results show how authoritarian information control constructs a regime-aligned account of the world and Russia’s place in it.
url:d057a29df50c8229.abstract_zh: 威权政权通过审查和宣传塑造公民的知识与信念。我们利用一项罕见的自然实验——Ruwiki（2023年通过克隆俄语维基百科并在亲政权编辑控制下选择性重写其190万篇文章创建而成）——研究其压制和推广的叙事。在分叉二十个月后，我们以维基百科内部变化作为安慰剂基准，对两个平台进行比较。研究发现，Ruwiki的编辑模式更接近专业内容生产而非志愿者驱动。基于大语言模型的比较以及对文本删除和插入的机器学习分析揭示了一套围绕三大支柱构建的连贯意识形态：俄罗斯相对于世界其他地区的形象、国内政治以及文化。由此产生的叙事将俄罗斯过去和现在的侵略行为合法化，压制国内反对派和人权侵犯的报道，并推广传统价值观。文化的核心地位揭示了威权信息控制如何渗透到远超正式政治领域的范畴，包括道德、性别、家庭生活、法律和心理学。文章删除极为罕见，仅限于难以重新框架化的主题；而编辑则广泛存在，这与偏好重新框架现有内容而非留下未解答疑问的倾向一致：27%的文章经历了至少某种程度的修改，2.8%被大幅编辑，仅0.14%被删除。对敏感话题的重写降低了可读性，表明意识形态控制代价高昂。使用官方高中历史教科书作为外部基准证实，Ruwiki的修订将现代史相关文章推向国家认可的叙事。研究结果展示了威权信息控制如何构建一套符合政权立场的世界叙事及俄罗斯在其中地位的图景。

url:d06c15cb3371589f.abstract: This paper challenges the widespread view that forward exchange premia contain little information regarding subsequent spot rate movements. Using weekly dollar/Deutschmark and dollar/sterling data, we show that spot and forward exchange rates are well represented by a vector error correction model and that the vector of forward premia form a basis for the cointegrating space. Dynamic forecasts indicate that the information in the forward premia can be used to reduce the root mean squared forecast error for the spot rate (relative to a random walk forecast) by at least 33% at a six-month horizon and by between 50% and 90% at a one-year horizon.
url:d06c15cb3371589f.abstract_zh: 本文挑战了普遍认为远期升水对后续即期汇率变动几乎不包含信息的观点。基于美元/德国马克和美元/英镑的周度数据，我们证明即期汇率与远期汇率可由向量误差修正模型良好刻画，且远期升水向量构成协整空间的一组基。动态预测表明，远期升水中的信息可将即期汇率均方根预测误差（相对于随机游走预测）在六个月期至少降低33%，在一年期降低50%至90%。

url:d0e1f40f1732efa6.abstract: We augment the two-country DSGE model from Mandelman and Zlate (2012) with endogenous migration of both skilled and unskilled labor, and analyze the economic impact of restricting migration for each type of labor on the migrants’ source and host countries. We calibrate the model with data for Guatemala and the U.S. as the source and host countries respectively. Restricting unskilled immigration has a more severe contractionary impact on the host economy than restricting skilled migration—reducing aggregate output by approximately 1 percent and consumption by 0.6 percent compared to the steady state—, given that in the steady state a lot more unskilled migrants are needed in the production function. Restricting unskilled immigration impacts negatively skilled immigration flows, but not vice versa, and it has a significant overall impact on the source economy, with aggregate consumption and income declining (mostly due to a fall in remittances). Our findings also highlight a key policy trade-off for the host economy: while a restrictive immigration policy (especially for unskilled labor) could reduce wage inequality by compressing the skill premium—raising host-country unskilled wages by 8 percent while lowering skilled wages by 1 percent compared to the steady state—, and could increase output per capita, it comes at the cost of lower overall economic activity and aggregate consumption. Moreover, by increasing the wage gap for unskilled labor between host and source economies, it also raises incentives for immigration, despite the increased cost of migration.
url:d0e1f40f1732efa6.abstract_zh: 我们在Mandelman和Zlate（2012）的双国DSGE模型中加入了技能与非技能劳动力的内生迁移，并分析了限制各类劳动力迁移对移民来源国和东道国经济的影响。我们利用危地马拉和美国分别作为来源国和东道国的数据对模型进行了校准。限制非技能移民对东道国经济的紧缩效应比限制技能迁移更为严重——与稳态相比，总产出减少约1%，消费减少0.6%——这是因为在稳态下，生产函数中需要更多的非技能移民。限制非技能移民对技能移民流动产生负面影响，但反之则不然，并且对来源国经济具有显著的整体影响，总消费和收入下降（主要归因于汇款减少）。我们的研究结果还凸显了东道国面临的一个关键政策权衡：虽然限制性移民政策（尤其是针对非技能劳动力）可能通过压缩技能溢价来降低工资不平等——与稳态相比，东道国非技能工资上升8%，而技能工资下降1%——并可能提高人均产出，但这是以降低整体经济活动和总消费为代价的。此外，通过扩大东道国与来源国之间非技能劳动力的工资差距，该政策也增加了移民的激励，尽管移民成本有所上升。

url:d0f75fad0c48fc48.abstract: We develop and validate a measure of class identity using naming decisions. Exploiting within-household variation, we show that migration patterns that increased the local share of culturally-distant workers reduced working class identification. Where migration increased the cultural distance of the working class, workers were less likely to join unions, voters were less likely to support the nascent Labour Party, and parliamentary candidates were less likely to target working class voters. By 1911, slower in-migration and rising local population growth reduced working class distance in urban areas, which also became strongholds of support for Labour. Migration alters social identity and creates political cleavages.
url:d0f75fad0c48fc48.abstract_zh: 我们利用命名决策开发并验证了一种衡量阶级认同的方法。通过利用家庭内部的差异，我们发现，移民模式增加了当地文化背景迥异的工人比例，从而削弱了工人阶级认同。在移民加剧了工人阶级文化距离的地区，工人加入工会的可能性降低，选民支持新兴工党的意愿减弱，议会候选人针对工人阶级选民的倾向也下降。到1911年，较慢的迁入移民和当地人口增长减缓了城市地区工人阶级的文化距离，这些地区也成为了工党的支持重镇。移民改变了社会认同，并造成了政治分歧。

url:d14403d6d699e3a9.abstract: We investigate the Pareto-efficiency of ordinal multiwinner voting rules, that is, voting rules based on ordinal preference profiles over candidates. Defining Pareto-optimality of a committee requires relating the voters’ rankings over individual candidates to their preferences over committees. We consider two well-known extension principles that extend rankings over candidates to preferences over committees: the responsive extension and the lexicographic extension. As the responsive extension outputs partial orders, we consider two Pareto-optimality notions: a committee is possibly (respectively, necessary) Pareto-optimal if it is Pareto-optimal for some (respectively, every) completion of these partial orders. As the lexicographic extension principle outputs a total order, it leads to only one Pareto-optimality notion. We then define several notions of Pareto-efficiency of multiwinner rules, depending on whether some (respectively, all) committees in the output are Pareto-optimal for one of the latter notions. We review what we believe to be a complete list of ordinal multiwinner rules that have been studied in the literature, and identify which Pareto-efficiency notions they satisfy. Our finding is that, somewhat surprisingly, these rules show a huge diversity: some satisfy the strongest notion, some do not even satisfy the weakest one, with many other rules at various intermediate levels.
url:d14403d6d699e3a9.abstract_zh: 本文研究了序数多赢家投票规则的帕累托效率，即基于候选人的序数偏好分布的投票规则。定义委员会的帕累托最优性需要将选民对单个候选人的排序与其对委员会的偏好联系起来。我们考虑两种广为人知的扩展原则，将候选人的排序扩展为对委员会的偏好：响应扩展和词典序扩展。由于响应扩展输出偏序，我们考虑两种帕累托最优性概念：一个委员会是可能（分别地，必然）帕累托最优的，如果它对于这些偏序的某些（分别地，所有）完备化是帕累托最优的。由于词典序扩展原则输出全序，它仅导致一种帕累托最优性概念。随后，我们根据输出中的某些（分别地，所有）委员会是否满足上述某种帕累托最优性概念，定义了多赢家规则的若干帕累托效率概念。我们回顾了文献中研究过的、我们认为完整的序数多赢家规则列表，并识别了它们满足哪些帕累托效率概念。我们的发现是，有些出人意料的是，这些规则表现出巨大的多样性：有些满足最强的概念，有些甚至不满足最弱的概念，而许多其他规则则处于各种中间水平。

url:d16c170d8e915219.abstract: China’s efforts to develop commodity futures markets and enhance its influence over commodity pricing are best understood as part of a broader strategy to reduce financial vulnerabilities and increase strategic autonomy within a hierarchical global financial system. Commodity pricing power – defined as the capacity to shape the infrastructures, regulation, participation and currency denomination of derivative markets through which prices are formed – has become an increasingly important component of geopolitical competition. For China, this is not about economic efficiency, but control over the terms under which strategically important commodities are valued and traded.
url:d16c170d8e915219.abstract_zh: 中国发展商品期货市场并增强其对大宗商品定价影响力的努力，应被理解为在层级化全球金融体系中减少金融脆弱性、提升战略自主性的更广泛战略的一部分。大宗商品定价权——即塑造价格形成所依赖的衍生品市场的基础设施、监管规则、参与主体及货币计价能力——已成为地缘政治竞争日益重要的组成部分。对中国而言，这并非关乎经济效率，而是对战略性大宗商品估值与交易条件的掌控。

url:d171ffe1eda04371.abstract: We study how Venezuelan refugee inflows affect healthcare outcomes and municipal public finances in Brazil's universal, decentralized public healthcare system. For identification, we exploit cross-municipality variation in refugee exposure and use distance to Brazil's only official border crossing with Venezuela as an instrument. A one-percentage-point increase in the local refugee share raises overall mortality by 4.2 percent and infant mortality by up to 9 percent. We show these effects operate through both the poorer baseline health of arriving refugees and congestion in local health facilities. Municipalities increase the share of spending on healthcare, but absent compensating federal transfers, they do so at the expense of education's budget share. These results highlight the limits of decentralized service provision in absorbing the health and fiscal costs of concentrated migration shocks.
url:d171ffe1eda04371.abstract_zh: 我们研究了委内瑞拉难民涌入如何影响巴西全民、分权式公共医疗体系中的医疗结果与市政公共财政。为识别因果关系，我们利用各市难民暴露程度的差异，并以距离巴西唯一官方委内瑞拉边境口岸的距离作为工具变量。当地难民比例每增加一个百分点，总死亡率上升4.2%，婴儿死亡率最高上升9%。研究表明，这些影响既源于抵达难民较差的初始健康状况，也源于当地医疗设施的拥挤。各市增加了医疗支出占比，但在缺乏联邦转移支付补偿的情况下，这一调整以牺牲教育预算份额为代价。这些结果凸显了分权式服务供给在吸收集中性移民冲击带来的健康与财政成本方面的局限性。

url:d1c0ea7f059387e6.abstract: The voluntary carbon market was built on a single promise: that one credit cancels one tonne. Most scrutiny has asked whether that promise holds on the supply side – whether the credits are real. This column asks a different question: what did the mere availability of offsets do to the firms that bought them? Using a buyer-linked dataset spanning the near-universe of offset retirements, and the 2023 integrity scandals as a natural experiment, the authors find that firms which walked away from offsetting cut their own operational emissions sharply more than firms that stayed. Even a market of flawless credits could still slow real decarbonisation.
url:d1c0ea7f059387e6.abstract_zh: 自愿性碳市场建立在一个单一承诺之上：一单位碳信用抵消一吨排放。多数审查关注的是这一承诺在供应端是否成立——即碳信用是否真实。本文提出一个不同的问题：仅仅是抵消机制的可获得性，对购买这些碳信用的企业产生了何种影响？利用覆盖近乎全部碳信用注销的买方关联数据集，并以2023年诚信丑闻作为自然实验，作者发现，放弃抵消的企业其自身运营排放的削减幅度显著大于继续参与抵消的企业。即便碳信用市场完美无瑕，仍可能延缓实际的脱碳进程。

url:d1f676a7f7ae82da.abstract: Anti-immigration policies often rest on the premise that immigrants worsen native-born employment and wages. This column uses data from 2000 to 2023 to estimate the impact of immigration to the US on national wages and employment, focusing on national rather than local impacts. The authors find that in these two decades, net immigration to the US was heavily college-intensive and raised the wages of less-educated natives. It also increased natives’ employment. Natives’ reallocation into higher-paying, communication-intensive occupations, complementary to those filled by immigrants, is one mechanism behind these gains.
url:d1f676a7f7ae82da.abstract_zh: 反移民政策往往基于一个前提，即移民会恶化本土出生者的就业和工资状况。本文利用2000年至2023年的数据，评估了美国移民对全国工资和就业的影响，重点关注全国层面而非地方层面的效应。作者发现，在这二十年里，美国净移民高度集中于受过大学教育的人群，并提升了教育程度较低的本土出生者的工资水平。同时，移民也增加了本土出生者的就业机会。本土出生者向薪酬更高、沟通密集型职业的重新配置，与移民所从事的职业形成互补，是这些收益背后的机制之一。

url:d20db684e68b6375.abstract: Business cycles are increasingly driven by global shocks, rather than the domestic demand shocks prominent in earlier decades, posing challenges for central banks seeking to meet domestic mandates and communicate their policy decisions. This paper analyzes the evolving influence and characteristics of global and domestic shocks in advanced economies from 1970-2024 using a new FAVAR model that decomposes movements in interest rates, inflation, and output growth into four global shocks (demand, supply, oil, and monetary policy) and three domestic shocks (demand, supply, and monetary policy). We find that the role of global shocks has increased sharply over time and that their characteristics differ from those of domestic shocks across multiple dimensions. Compared to domestic shocks, global shocks have a larger supply component, higher variance, more persistent effects on inflation, and are more asymmetric (contributing more to tightening than to easing phases of monetary policy). As global supply shocks have become more prominent, central banks have also been less willing to "look throughâ€ their effects on inflation than for comparable domestic shocks. The distinct characteristics and rising influence of global shocks-particularly global supply shocks-have significant implications for modeling monetary policy and designing central bank frameworks.
url:d20db684e68b6375.abstract_zh: 商业周期日益受到全球冲击的驱动，而非早期几十年中占据主导地位的国内需求冲击，这给寻求实现国内政策目标并传达其政策决策的中央银行带来了挑战。本文利用一种新的FAVAR模型，将利率、通胀和产出增长的变化分解为四种全球冲击（需求、供给、石油和货币政策）和三种国内冲击（需求、供给和货币政策），分析了1970-2024年发达经济体中全球与国内冲击的演变影响及特征。我们发现，全球冲击的作用随时间显著增强，且其特征在多个维度上与国内冲击不同。与国内冲击相比，全球冲击具有更大的供给成分、更高的方差、对通胀更持久的影响，并且更不对称（对货币政策紧缩阶段的贡献大于宽松阶段）。随着全球供给冲击日益突出，中央银行也更不愿意“忽略”其对通胀的影响，而相比之下对类似的国内冲击则更倾向于如此。全球冲击——尤其是全球供给冲击——的独特特征和日益增强的影响，对货币政策建模和中央银行框架设计具有重要启示。

url:d263369b21e858a3.abstract: We develop a dynamic model of bank lending to study how transition risk shapes the interaction between environmental regulation, monetary policy, and green credit allocation. Banks allocate lending between green and brown projects according to risk-adjusted lending margins, while environmental regulation endogenously affects the repayment risk of brown borrowers. The model generates state-dependent monetary-policy transmission: identical funding-cost shocks produce different lending responses depending on the level of transition risk. We identify a threshold level of transition risk at which monetary-policy transmission changes qualitatively and show that environmental regulation affects green lending both directly, through borrower risk, and indirectly, by altering the effectiveness of monetary policy. These effects operate along the transition path: the long-run green lending share is anchored by the emissions target, while regulation and monetary policy govern the speed and composition of the adjustment.
url:d263369b21e858a3.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个银行信贷动态模型，以研究转型风险如何塑造环境监管、货币政策与绿色信贷配置之间的相互作用。银行根据风险调整后的贷款利差在绿色与棕色项目之间分配信贷，而环境监管内生地影响棕色借款人的偿还风险。该模型产生了状态依赖的货币政策传导：相同的融资成本冲击，根据转型风险水平的不同，会导致不同的贷款反应。我们识别出一个转型风险的阈值水平，在此阈值处货币政策传导发生质变，并表明环境监管既通过借款人风险直接作用于绿色信贷，也通过改变货币政策的有效性间接产生影响。这些效应沿着转型路径发挥作用：长期绿色信贷份额由排放目标锚定，而监管与货币政策则调控调整的速度与结构。

url:d282535ace30b49e.abstract: This paper reports key findings from the Sub-Saharan Africa Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) and Digital Payments Survey, shedding light on the motivations, benefits, and challenges of CBDC adoption, as well as the developments of digital private money and crypto assets in sub-Saharan Africa. It emphasizes the pivotal role of collaboration and shared knowledge in navigating the intricate landscape of digital currencies and assets in sub-Saharan Africa. As this evolving digital frontier is explored, the experiences and aspirations of the region’s central banks, as expressed in the survey, will help harness the potential for digital currencies, assets, and payments, and foster cooperation among countries in sub-Saharan Africa. A forthcoming IMF Departmental Paper will focus on key issues for countries in sub-Saharan Africa pertaining to CBDCs, private digital payments, and crypto assets. It will provide a deeper discussion of the benefits, costs, and risks of these digital payment systems and present policy options to enhance financial digital development and inclusion, while safeguarding macroeconomic and financial stability.
url:d282535ace30b49e.abstract_zh: 本文报告了撒哈拉以南非洲中央银行数字货币（CBDC）与数字支付调查的关键发现，揭示了该地区CBDC采纳的动机、益处与挑战，以及私人数字货币和加密资产的发展动态。文章强调了合作与知识共享在应对撒哈拉以南非洲复杂数字货币与资产格局中的核心作用。随着这一不断演变的数字前沿被探索，调查中表达的该地区中央银行的经历与愿景，将有助于挖掘数字货币、资产及支付的潜力，并促进撒哈拉以南非洲各国间的合作。即将发布的国际货币基金组织部门论文将聚焦于撒哈拉以南非洲国家在CBDC、私人数字支付及加密资产方面的关键问题，深入探讨这些数字支付系统的益处、成本与风险，并提出政策选项，以促进金融数字化发展与包容性，同时维护宏观经济与金融稳定。

url:d2a721f5b93ad5e6.abstract: This study uses whole-of-population linked census-administrative data to examine gender gaps in educational outcomes from early primary school through early adulthood in Australia and to assess the contribution of socioeconomic factors to these gaps either at the mean and along the distribution of educational outcomes. Leveraging the richness and large size of the linked data and employing some of the most rigorous empirical approaches in the literature, including mother and twin fixed-effects models, we find that females outperform males as early as ages 5–6 across multiple developmental domains, and that this advantage persists through university. The gender gap in favour of females is larger among lower-performing students. We also find that boys benefit more than girls from growing up in more advantaged families, particularly among academically lower-performing boys. However, this advantage is observed only for outcomes measured in the early years of primary school. By contrast, for outcomes measured at the tertiary level, most indicators of socioeconomic advantage confer stronger benefits to females, especially among individuals at the lower end of the educational attainment distribution. Finally, having ruled out gender differences in birth weight—which favour males—we identify gender differences across siblings in school sector choice and early childhood health conditions, both favouring females, as potential mechanisms underlying these patterns.
url:d2a721f5b93ad5e6.abstract_zh: 本研究利用全人口关联普查与行政数据，考察澳大利亚从小学早期至成年早期的教育成果性别差距，并评估社会经济因素在均值及教育成果分布上对这些差距的贡献。借助关联数据的丰富性与大规模特征，并采用文献中最严谨的实证方法（包括母亲固定效应模型和双胞胎固定效应模型），我们发现：早在5-6岁阶段，女性在多个发展领域已优于男性，且这一优势持续至大学阶段。在学业表现较低的学生群体中，女性优势更为显著。同时，成长于更优越家庭环境的男性获益程度高于女性，尤其在学业表现较差的男性群体中更为明显。然而，这一优势仅体现在小学早期阶段的教育成果指标上。相比之下，在高等教育阶段，大多数社会经济优势指标对女性更为有利，尤其对教育成就分布底端的个体而言。最后，在排除出生体重（男性占优）的性别差异后，我们识别出兄弟姐妹间在学校类型选择及儿童早期健康状况上的性别差异（两者均有利于女性），这些差异构成了上述模式的潜在机制。

url:d33c035001212047.abstract: Based on hypothetical responses originating from a large-scale survey among about 6,000 German households, this study investigates the discrepancy in willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates for green electricity across single-binary-choice and open-ended valuation formats. Recognizing that respondents self-select into two groups distinguished by their belief in their answers’ consequences for policy making, we employ a switching regression model that accounts for the potential endogeneity of respondents’ belief in consequences and biases from sample selectivity. Contrasting with the received literature, we find WTP bids that tend to be higher among those respondents who obtained questions in the open-ended format, rather than single-binary-choice questions. JEL D03D12Q48Q50H41
url:d33c035001212047.abstract_zh: 基于对约6000户德国家庭的大规模调查所获得的假设性回答，本研究探讨了在单一二元选择与开放式估值格式下，绿色电力支付意愿（WTP）估计值的差异。鉴于受访者根据其对回答在政策制定中后果的信念，自我选择分为两组，我们采用切换回归模型，该模型考虑了受访者信念后果的潜在内生性以及样本选择性带来的偏差。与现有文献相反，我们发现，在开放式格式下接受问题的受访者所给出的WTP报价往往高于单一二元选择问题下的报价。JEL分类号：D03，D12，Q48，Q50，H41

url:d34e121c83540f5f.abstract: One way to measure the efficiency of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) is the extent to which gains in publicly supported health insurance reduced uninsured rates. Using data from the 2008–2024 American Community Survey, we examine time trends in rates of uninsured, public insurance coverage, and employer-sponsored insurance (ESI) by groups defined by the ratio of income to the Federal Poverty Line (FPL). We obtain estimates of associations between changes in public coverage and changes in uninsured and ESI exploiting state-by-year variation in ACA implementation. Importantly, we estimate the total effect of the ACA—including both the Medicaid expansion and Marketplace coverage—on uninsured and ESI rates. For adults in households below 150% of the federal poverty level (FPL), increases in public insurance coverage were associated with one-for-one decrease in uninsured and no change in ESI. For adults with incomes between 151%–400% FPL, each percentage point increase in public coverage was associated with about a 0.6 percentage point decrease in uninsured and a 0.4 decrease, or crowd out, in ESI. Crowd-out was larger among groups with higher pre-ACA ESI rates such as parents and married adults. Using variation from the Medicaid expansion alone to evaluate the ACA’s effect on ESI leads to overstating crowd-out among low-income adults (below 150% FPL) and understating crowd-out among higher-income adults (above 250% FPL). Our findings suggest that policies intended to subsidize health insurance of higher income groups, for example, the enhanced premium subsidies, are far less efficient than policies intended to further expand public insurance to low-income groups, for example, in non-expansion states.
url:d34e121c83540f5f.abstract_zh: 衡量《平价医疗法案》（ACA）效率的一个方法是，公共资助医疗保险的覆盖增长在多大程度上降低了未参保率。利用2008-2024年美国社区调查数据，我们按收入与联邦贫困线（FPL）之比划分群体，考察了未参保率、公共保险覆盖率以及雇主提供保险（ESI）的时间趋势。我们利用各州在ACA实施中的年度差异，估算了公共保险覆盖率变化与未参保率及ESI变化之间的关联。重要的是，我们评估了ACA的总体效应——包括医疗补助扩展和市场保险覆盖——对未参保率和ESI的影响。对于家庭收入低于联邦贫困线150%的成年人，公共保险覆盖率的增加与未参保率的一对一下降相关，而ESI无变化。对于收入在联邦贫困线151%-400%之间的成年人，公共保险覆盖率每增加一个百分点，未参保率下降约0.6个百分点，ESI下降0.4个百分点（即挤出效应）。在ACA实施前ESI率较高的群体（如父母和已婚成年人）中，挤出效应更大。仅利用医疗补助扩展的变异来评估ACA对ESI的影响，会导致低估低收入成年人（低于150% FPL）的挤出效应，而高估高收入成年人（高于250% FPL）的挤出效应。我们的研究结果表明，旨在补贴高收入群体医疗保险的政策（例如增强型保费补贴）远不如旨在进一步向低收入群体扩展公共保险的政策（例如在非扩展州）有效。

url:d3533725b799d30f.abstract: We develop a data-rich measure of expected macroeconomic skewness in the US economy. Expected macroeconomic skewness is strongly procyclical, mainly reflects the cyclicality in the skewness of real variables, is highly correlated with the cross-sectional skewness of firm-level employment growth, and is distinct from financial market skewness. Revisions in expected skewness deliver dynamics that are nearly indistinguishable from those produced by the main business cycle shock of Angeletos et al. (2020). This result is robust to controlling for macroeconomic volatility and uncertainty, and alternative macroeconomic shocks. Our findings highlight the importance of higher-order dynamics for business cycle theories.
url:d3533725b799d30f.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个基于丰富数据集的美国经济预期宏观偏度指标。预期宏观偏度呈现强烈的顺周期性，主要反映了实际变量偏度的周期性变化，与企业层面就业增长率的横截面偏度高度相关，且与金融市场偏度存在显著差异。预期偏度的修正所产生的动态效应，几乎与Angeletos等人（2020）所识别的主要商业周期冲击所引发的动态无法区分。这一结论在控制宏观经济波动性、不确定性及其他宏观经济冲击后依然稳健。我们的研究结果强调了高阶动态对商业周期理论的重要性。

url:d35ae9e3b2f71a3c.abstract: We examine the economic geography of gender wage gaps to understand the role that location plays in gender earning differences. Using panelised administrative data for the universe of French workers, our findings indicate that women benefit relatively more from density than men, with an urban wage premium (return to urban density) 48% higher than for men. We identify a number of factors that explain this gap, with a large share being explained by the structure of the local labour market, notably, the extent of occupational segregation. Another important factor is commuting patterns, while childcare availability plays only a moderate role.
url:d35ae9e3b2f71a3c.abstract_zh: 我们考察了性别工资差距的经济地理学，以理解地理位置在性别收入差异中的作用。利用法国全体劳动者的面板化行政数据，研究结果表明，女性从城市密度中获得的相对收益高于男性，其城市工资溢价（城市密度的回报率）比男性高出48%。我们识别出若干解释这一差距的因素，其中很大一部分归因于当地劳动力市场的结构，尤其是职业隔离的程度。另一个重要因素是通勤模式，而儿童保育的可获得性仅起到中等程度的作用。

url:d37eac95e2809af8.abstract: We document the effects of electronic invoicing (eInvoicing) on credit markets. By making invoices more standardized, verifiable, and harder to falsify, eInvoicing changes lenders’ information sets, facilitating invoice-based financing and credit risk assessment. We exploit a regional eInvoicing mandate and administrative credit data using a difference-in-differences design to provide three main insights. First, credit reallocates toward firms already relying on invoice-based credit (“invoice firms”) and away from non-invoice firms. Second, the cost of (non-)invoice credit falls (rises) for (non-)invoice firms, consistent with a supply-driven mechanism. Third, banks’ information production changes: eInvoicing widens (reduces) the dispersion of rates and banks’ risk assessments and improves (worsens) their predictive accuracy for (non-)invoice firms. Overall, eInvoicing reshapes credit market outcomes, with uneven effects across borrowers.
url:d37eac95e2809af8.abstract_zh: 本文研究了电子发票对信贷市场的影响。通过使发票更加标准化、可验证且难以伪造，电子发票改变了贷款人的信息集，促进了基于发票的融资和信用风险评估。我们利用地区性电子发票强制政策及行政信贷数据，采用双重差分法得出三项主要发现。第一，信贷资源向已依赖发票信贷的企业（"发票企业"）重新配置，同时从非发票企业流出。第二，发票企业（非发票企业）的（非）发票信贷成本下降（上升），这与供给驱动机制一致。第三，银行的信息生产发生变化：电子发票扩大了（缩小了）利率和银行风险评估的离散程度，并改善（恶化）了对发票企业（非发票企业）的预测准确性。总体而言，电子发票重塑了信贷市场格局，但对不同借款人的影响存在差异。
url:d37eac95e2809af8.title: Digitalization and Credit Markets: Evidence from eInvoicing
url:d37eac95e2809af8.title_zh: 数字化与信贷市场：来自电子发票的证据

url:d382ef37a58cc13b.abstract: In an ample-reserves framework, administered rates anchor money markets but suppress information from unsecured interbank trading. We recover that information by isolating the small interbank segment of the federal funds market. Using high-frequency bank-level data, we employ deposit shocks as an instrument for bank borrowing demand. Our analysis reveals that non-bank lenders, such as Federal Home Loan Banks, supply funds elastically, whereas bank lenders exhibit price inelasticity, which intensifies as their reserve balances decline, particularly for bankers’ banks. This interbank segment highlights distributional frictions in the federal funds market that emerge well before aggregate reserves become scarce and provides new evidence on monetary policy transmission in an ample-reserves regime.
url:d382ef37a58cc13b.abstract_zh: 在充足准备金框架下，管理利率锚定货币市场，但抑制了无担保银行间交易的信息。我们通过分离联邦基金市场中规模较小的银行间板块来恢复这些信息。利用高频银行层面数据，我们将存款冲击作为银行借款需求的工具变量。分析表明，非银行贷方（如联邦住房贷款银行）具有弹性资金供给，而银行贷方则表现出价格缺乏弹性，且随着其准备金余额下降（尤其是对银行家银行而言）这种缺乏弹性会加剧。这一银行间板块凸显了在总准备金变得稀缺之前就已出现的联邦基金市场分配摩擦，并为充足准备金制度下的货币政策传导提供了新证据。

url:d3bf2bc0afaa8ee1.abstract: Does Generative AI displace early-career workers? We provide population-wide evidence from Norwegian administrative registers, 2015 through March 2025, exploiting the November 2022 release of ChatGPT as an availability shock. Using the within-firm composition difference-in-differences employed in recent work, supplemented with a synthetic difference-in-differences at the occupation level and a firm-level shift-share design, we find no robust evidence of employment displacement among young workers in highly AI-exposed occupations, nor any robust response across other age cohorts or on incumbent labor-market outcomes. While estimated coefficients for young workers are negative, in line with the existing literature, they are small and statistically insignificant. A backdating exercise on the synthetic difference-in-differences yields larger absolute estimates than the actual treatment date across most age bands. This suggests the apparent post-2022 decline reflects, at least in part, pre-existing secular trends rather than a clean AI-period break.
url:d3bf2bc0afaa8ee1.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能是否取代了早期职业工作者？我们利用挪威行政登记数据（2015年至2025年3月）提供全人口层面的证据，以2022年11月ChatGPT的发布作为可得性冲击。采用近期研究中使用的企业内构成双重差分法，辅以职业层面的合成双重差分法和企业层面的份额转移设计，我们未发现年轻工作者在高人工智能暴露职业中存在就业替代的稳健证据，也未发现其他年龄群体或现有劳动力市场结果存在稳健反应。尽管年轻工作者的估计系数为负，与现有文献一致，但系数较小且统计上不显著。对合成双重差分法进行回溯检验发现，在大多数年龄段中，实际处理日期之前的绝对估计值大于实际处理日期之后的估计值。这表明2022年后的表面下降至少部分反映了既有的长期趋势，而非人工智能时期的明确结构性断裂。
url:d3bf2bc0afaa8ee1.title: Labor Market Consequences of Generative AI: Early Evidence from Norway

url:d3cfd591c933d8e0.abstract: Potential output and the natural rate of unemployment are commonly estimated through trend-cycle decompositions, where they are identified as underlying trends reflecting slow-moving supply factors. In this paper, we extend this framework to accommodate the possibility that cyclical disturbances affect trends endogenously through "scarring" effects. Two major changes occur relative to standard specifications. First, a significant share of business-cycle fluctuations is absorbed by endogenous movements in the trends rather than shifts in the cycle. Second, the estimated cycle--relieved of explaining the persistence in real variables--tracks inflation developments more closely, including through a steeper Phillips curve. While this steeper slope implies a strong co-movement between inflation and real activity in response to cyclical shocks, such strong co-movement is rarely apparent in the data. Consequently, the estimation shows a shift toward more sizable changes in the purely supply-driven components of the trends, mirrored by smaller innovations in the cycle process. In turn, this rebalancing entails different historical paths for the activity gaps, carrying important implications for the conduct of monetary policy.
url:d3cfd591c933d8e0.abstract_zh: 潜在产出与自然失业率通常通过趋势-周期分解进行估计，其中它们被识别为反映缓慢变动的供给因素的潜在趋势。在本文中，我们扩展了这一框架，以容纳周期性扰动通过“疤痕效应”内生地影响趋势的可能性。与标准设定相比，发生了两个重大变化。首先，商业周期波动的显著份额被趋势的内生变动所吸收，而非周期的变动。其次，估计出的周期——不再承担解释实际变量持续性的任务——更紧密地追踪通胀动态，包括通过更陡峭的菲利普斯曲线。尽管这一更陡峭的斜率意味着周期性冲击下通胀与实际活动之间存在强烈的联动，但这种强烈联动在数据中很少显现。因此，估计结果显示，趋势中纯供给驱动成分的变化幅度增大，而周期过程的创新幅度相应减小。这种再平衡反过来导致了活动缺口的不同历史路径，对货币政策的实施具有重要含义。
url:d3cfd591c933d8e0.title: Measuring Macroeconomic Stars: A Framework with Scarring Effects
url:d3cfd591c933d8e0.title_zh: 衡量宏观经济之星：具有疤痕效应的分析框架

url:d3d17c7ee733e2ee.abstract: we examine household decisions and parental altruism vis-a-vis their children. Contrary to Parsons and Goldin (1989), we find that parental location choices were dictated by constraints rather than the desire to exploit child labour opportunities. We also find signfiicant income effects on child labour supply, indicating that rising affluence played an important part in the secular decline of child labour. We also find that the effects of childrens' income on their own consumption are weak, once child labour is controlled for.
url:d3d17c7ee733e2ee.abstract_zh: 我们考察了家庭决策及其对子女的利他主义行为。与帕森斯和戈尔丁（1989）的观点相反，我们发现父母的区位选择是由约束条件决定的，而非出于利用童工机会的意愿。我们还发现收入对童工供给具有显著影响，这表明财富增长在童工现象的长期减少中发挥了重要作用。此外，在控制童工因素后，我们发现子女收入对其自身消费的影响较弱。

url:d3db6961c5ae4f26.abstract: In this Paper we argue that the political incentives that resource endowments generate are the key to understanding whether or not they are a curse. We show: (1) politicians tend to over-extract natural resources relative to the efficient extraction path because they discount the future too much; (2) resource booms improve the efficiency of the extraction path; (3) resource booms, however, by raising the value of being in power and by providing politicians with more resources which they can use to influence the outcome of elections, increase resource misallocation in the rest of the economy and (4) the overall impact of resource booms on the economy depends critically on institutions, since these determine the extent to which political incentives map into policy outcomes. Countries with good institutions tend to benefit from resource booms since these institutions mitigate the perverse political incentives that such booms create. Countries with bad institutions suffer a resource curse.
url:d3db6961c5ae4f26.abstract_zh: 本文认为，资源禀赋所产生的政治激励是理解其是否成为“诅咒”的关键。我们证明：（1）政治家倾向于过度开采自然资源，偏离有效开采路径，因为他们对未来过度折现；（2）资源繁荣会改善开采路径的效率；（3）然而，资源繁荣通过提升执政价值，并为政治家提供更多可用于影响选举结果的资源，加剧了经济其他领域的资源错配；（4）资源繁荣对经济的总体影响关键取决于制度，因为制度决定了政治激励在多大程度上转化为政策结果。制度良好的国家往往能从资源繁荣中受益，因为这些制度缓解了繁荣所引发的扭曲性政治激励；而制度不良的国家则会遭受资源诅咒。
url:d3db6961c5ae4f26.title: Political Foundations of the Resource Curse

url:d463b4ae865e36af.abstract: This study extended an existing Kuhn-Tucker (KT) model to integrate a mixture of discrete and continuous preference heterogeneity to address taste variations at individual and group levels. Specifically, we introduced random parameters into site quality attributes in a latent segmentation KT framework. In an empirical application to beach recreational demand, our proposed model statistically dominated other conventional specifications and revealed heterogeneous preferences for beach quality across and within groups. Our welfare analysis further showed that ignoring either the continuous or discrete component of the mixing distributions might lead to biased welfare estimates as well as opposite policy implications. JEL Q51C51
url:d463b4ae865e36af.abstract_zh: 本研究在现有Kuhn-Tucker（KT）模型基础上进行了扩展，融合了离散与连续偏好异质性，以应对个体及群体层面的品味差异。具体而言，我们在潜在分段KT框架中，将随机参数引入场地质量属性。在针对海滩休闲需求的实证应用中，我们提出的模型在统计上优于其他传统设定，并揭示了海滩质量偏好在群体间及群体内的异质性。福利分析进一步表明，忽略混合分布中的连续或离散成分可能导致福利估计偏差及相反的政策含义。JEL分类号：Q51，C51

url:d4894e78c5ca198e.abstract: This paper compares the “mental maps” of redistribution among politicians and citizens across seven parliaments, using original in-person surveys of sitting MPs and nationally representative citizen samples. Fairness beliefs and ideology are the strongest correlates of support for redistribution in both groups, while misperceptions of wealth concentration matter for citizens but much less for politicians. A central finding is that politicians hold markedly more polarized views on redistribution than citizens, including within the same party families. We also find systematic elite-voter gaps: left MPs are more supportive than their voters (notably on inheritance taxation), whereas right/liberal MPs are less supportive than theirs. These patterns point to a representation concern and to a narrower bargaining space among elites than in the electorate.
url:d4894e78c5ca198e.abstract_zh: 本文通过对比七个议会中政治人物与公民关于再分配的“心智地图”，采用了针对现任议员的原创面对面调查及具有全国代表性的公民样本。公平信念与意识形态是两组群体中支持再分配的最强相关因素，而对财富集中度的误解对公民影响显著，但对政治人物影响较小。一个核心发现是，政治人物在再分配问题上的观点比公民更为极化，即便在同一政党家族内部也是如此。我们还发现了系统性的精英-选民差距：左翼议员比其选民更支持再分配（尤其在遗产税方面），而右翼/自由派议员则比其选民更不支持。这些模式指向了一个代表性关切，以及精英阶层内部的谈判空间比选民群体更为狭窄。

url:d4aea1f8e4d087bc.abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model of firm dynamics with multiple labour skills to analyse the productivity implications of skill shortages. Firms employ cognitive, interpersonal, and manual skills in both operational and overhead tasks, with sectoral variation in skill intensities, and within sector firm size heterogeneity due to idiosyncratic technology draws. Calibrated to UK data, the model reveals that cognitive skills are a binding constraint on productivity. A reduction in the supply of cognitive skills lowers labour productivity at all levels -- firms, sectors, and in the aggregate. About half of the sectoral effects are due to changes in the within-sector distribution, whereby larger firms grow in relative size but become less productive. Sectoral heterogeneity in skill intensities amplifies these effects.
url:d4aea1f8e4d087bc.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含多种劳动技能的企业动态一般均衡模型，以分析技能短缺对生产率的影响。企业在运营任务和管理任务中同时使用认知技能、人际交往技能和操作技能，不同行业的技能密集度存在差异，且由于企业特有的技术冲击，同一行业内企业规模呈现异质性。基于英国数据校准的模型表明，认知技能是制约生产率的关键因素。认知技能供给的减少会降低企业、行业及总体层面的劳动生产率。行业层面约一半的影响源于行业内分布的变化——大型企业相对规模扩大，但生产率反而下降。行业间技能密集度的异质性进一步放大了这些效应。

url:d4e88f53e3074d05.abstract: Survey-based social science research increasingly depends on digital questionnaires, browserbased data collection, automated statistical workflows, and reproducible reports. Yet the integrity of the research objects that connect these stages remains weak in many projects. Questionnaire files, response datasets, analysis scripts, and reports are often stored as separate artefacts, and when any one of them is changed after fieldwork or after submission, reviewers and institutions may lack a simple way to verify whether the file is identical to the version used earlier. This paper proposes Social Science Research 6.0 as a proof-of-integrity framework for tamper-evident survey workflows. The framework uses SHA-256 hashing to assign verifiable digests to survey instruments, response datasets, analysis plans, scripts, and report outputs, and records them in a structured manifest that can be verified at any later point. The approach is demonstrated using surveyframe, an open-source R package that represents a questionnaire as a typed survey object, saves it as a hashed .sframe file, validates item and scale structure, reads response data, checks quality, scores scales, prepares analysis plans, and generates reproducible reports. A synthetic proof-of-concept confirms that the framework detects instrument modification, response tampering, and analysis-plan drift in all tested scenarios. The contribution is a low-cost, software-only method for improving trust, transparency, and auditability in digital social science research without requiring blockchain infrastructure or proprietary survey platforms.
url:d4e88f53e3074d05.abstract_zh: 基于问卷调查的社会科学研究日益依赖于数字化问卷、基于浏览器的数据收集、自动化统计工作流程以及可复现报告。然而，连接这些环节的研究对象完整性在许多项目中仍然薄弱。问卷文件、响应数据集、分析脚本和报告往往作为独立工件存储，当其中任何一个在实地调查后或提交后被修改时，审稿人和机构可能缺乏简单的方法来验证该文件是否与先前使用的版本一致。本文提出社会科学研究6.0（Social Science Research 6.0）作为防篡改调查工作流的完整性证明框架。该框架使用SHA-256哈希为调查工具、响应数据集、分析计划、脚本和报告输出分配可验证的摘要，并将其记录在结构化清单中，可在后续任何时间点进行验证。该方法通过surveyframe这一开源R包进行演示，该包将问卷表示为类型化的调查对象，保存为哈希化的.sframe文件，验证条目和量表结构，读取响应数据，检查质量，对量表进行评分，准备分析计划，并生成可复现报告。一项合成概念验证确认，该框架在所有测试场景中均能检测到工具修改、响应篡改和分析计划漂移。其贡献在于提供一种低成本、纯软件的方法，在不依赖区块链基础设施或专有调查平台的情况下，提升数字社会科学研究的可信度、透明度和可审计性。
url:d4e88f53e3074d05.title: Social Science Research 6.0: A Proof-of-Integrity Framework for Tamper-Evident Survey Instruments Using an Open-Source R Package
url:d4e88f53e3074d05.title_zh: 社会科学研究6.0：基于开源R包的可防篡改调查工具完整性证明框架

url:d560529406fb7aa7.abstract: This paper analyses a model of economic development in which international inequalities in the location of industry and income are supported by the agglomeration of industry in a subset of countries. Economic development may not be a gradual process of convergence by all countries, but instead involves countries moving sequentially from the group of poor countries to the group of rich countries. The role of trade policy in promoting industrialization is studied. While both import substitution and unilateral trade liberalization may be ?successful? in attracting industry, they attract different sectors and welfare levels are higher under trade liberalization.
url:d560529406fb7aa7.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个经济发展模型，其中产业与收入在国际间的不平等分布，源于产业在部分国家的集聚效应。经济发展并非所有国家逐步趋同的过程，而是各国依次从贫困国家群体向富裕国家群体转移的过程。本文研究了贸易政策在促进工业化中的作用。尽管进口替代与单边贸易自由化均可能“成功”吸引产业，但二者吸引的产业部门不同，且贸易自由化下的福利水平更高。

url:d585f40edea50592.abstract: Overemployment – working more hours than desired – affects nearly one-third of European workers, yet its consequences remain understudied. Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP, 1984-2019, N = 43,570) and individual fixed-effects models with leads and lags, we examine whether overemployment is associated with a deterioration in wellbeing and health, and whether potential adverse impacts persist as long as the overemployment state continues or whether people get used to working long hours. We find that overemployment is associated with a substantial decline in mental health, with impacts that intensify rather than attenuate over time. Specifically, the SF-12 mental health summary scale declines by 0.44 points in the first year of overemployment, deepening to between 0.80 and 1.13 points (8–11% of a standard deviation) thereafter. We obtain similar results for work, leisure time, health, and overall life satisfaction. Meanwhile, the association between overemployment and physical health is smaller and less consistent. Our findings suggest that overemployment may lead to an increased risk of persistent symptoms of poor mental health and low wellbeing, with implications for working time regulations and workplace wellbeing and health policies.
url:d585f40edea50592.abstract_zh: 过度就业——即工作时间超出个人期望——影响了近三分之一的欧洲劳动者，然而其后果仍未得到充分研究。利用德国社会经济面板数据（SOEP，1984-2019年，N=43,570）以及包含前置和滞后项的个体固定效应模型，我们考察了过度就业是否与身心健康恶化相关，以及潜在的不利影响是否在过度就业状态持续期间长期存在，还是人们会逐渐适应长时间工作。我们发现，过度就业与心理健康显著下降相关，且这种影响随时间推移而加剧而非减弱。具体而言，SF-12心理健康综合评分在过度就业的第一年下降0.44分，此后进一步加深至0.80至1.13分（标准差幅度的8%至11%）。我们在工作、闲暇时间、健康及整体生活满意度方面也获得了类似结果。与此同时，过度就业与身体健康之间的关联较小且一致性较弱。我们的研究结果表明，过度就业可能导致持续的心理健康不良和低幸福感症状风险增加，这对工作时间规制以及职场健康与福祉政策具有重要启示。
url:d585f40edea50592.title: Do people get used to working long hours?
url:d585f40edea50592.title_zh: 人们是否习惯了长时间工作？

url:d596c1886a32401b.abstract: This paper examines the economic origins and consequences of anti-missionary violence during the late Qing China (1860–1911). Using newly digitized data, we find that conflicts were attenuated by economic complementarities — such as access to Treaty Ports and public goods — rather than triggered by religious competition with Confucian elites. On the consequences part, we document negative economic spillovers of anti-missionary conflicts, through reduced foreign and domestic investments in modern firms and banks. These negative outcomes were reinforced by Western media coverage and persist today through lower FDI flows and increased autarkic attitudes among residents.
url:d596c1886a32401b.abstract_zh: 本文考察了晚清时期（1860-1911年）反传教士暴力的经济根源及其后果。利用新近数字化的数据，我们发现冲突因经济互补性——如通商口岸的可及性和公共品的提供——而有所缓和，而非由与儒家精英的宗教竞争所触发。在后果方面，我们记录了反传教士冲突通过减少外资及国内对现代企业和银行的投入，产生了负面的经济溢出效应。这些负面结果因西方媒体的报道而加剧，并持续至今，表现为较低的外商直接投资流入和居民中增强的自给自足倾向。
url:d596c1886a32401b.title: Religion and Conflict: Evidence from China, 1860–1911
url:d596c1886a32401b.title_zh: 宗教与冲突：来自中国1860—1911年的证据

url:d5db2ee916fc8fa1.abstract: Predictions about the workplace impact of artificial intelligence often begin with what the technology can do captured by occupations’ exposure to AI. Using representative data on German workers, this column shows that adoption also depends on whether AI is worth using relative to human labour. Comparative advantage is a much better predictor of AI adoption than absolute advantage based on exposure alone.
url:d5db2ee916fc8fa1.abstract_zh: 关于人工智能对职场影响的预测，往往始于技术能力，即通过职业对AI的暴露程度来衡量。利用德国工人的代表性数据，本专栏表明，AI的采纳还取决于相对于人类劳动，使用AI是否值得。比较优势比仅基于暴露度的绝对优势更能预测AI的采纳情况。
url:d5db2ee916fc8fa1.title: Beyond exposure: Predicting AI adoption based on comparative advantage
url:d5db2ee916fc8fa1.title_zh: 超越接触：基于比较优势预测人工智能采纳

url:d5dc9c2c1e2a7ebf.abstract: Many of the world's poor have experienced trauma. We argue that memories of this trauma interfere with the process of future simulation, diminishing the ability to see how actions today can improve outcomes tomorrow. We introduce guided mental experiencing (GME) -- an intervention in which participants mentally simulate pathways between their actions and desired economic outcomes -- as a response, and study GME's impact in two RCTs. In a population of Eritrean refugees in Ethiopia, GME increases the ability of refugees to see a positive future, increases their intent to stay in Ethiopia, increases labor force participation and improves self-reported welfare. In a population that has experienced violence and poverty in Colombia, a traditional entrepreneurial training program reduces the ability to imagine a future in business and worsens economic outcomes. Integrating GME into entrepreneurial training restores future thinking and removes these negative economic effects. The largest gains accrue to the most traumatized participants in our samples.
url:d5dc9c2c1e2a7ebf.abstract_zh: 世界上许多贫困人口都曾经历过创伤。我们认为，这些创伤的记忆会干扰未来模拟的过程，削弱个体认识到今日行动如何能改善明日结果的能力。我们引入引导式心理体验（GME）——一种干预措施，参与者在此过程中心理模拟从自身行动到期望经济结果之间的路径——作为应对方案，并在两项随机对照试验（RCT）中研究GME的影响。在埃塞俄比亚的厄立特里亚难民群体中，GME增强了难民展望积极未来的能力，提高了他们留在埃塞俄比亚的意愿，增加了劳动力参与率，并改善了自我报告的福利状况。在哥伦比亚经历过暴力与贫困的人群中，传统的创业培训项目降低了他们想象商业未来的能力，并使经济结果恶化。将GME整合进创业培训中，则恢复了未来思维，并消除了这些负面经济影响。在我们的样本中，获益最大的是那些受创伤最严重的参与者。
url:d5dc9c2c1e2a7ebf.title: Learning to See the World's Opportunities: Memory, Mental Experiencing, and the Economic Lives of the Vulnerable
url:d5dc9c2c1e2a7ebf.title_zh: 学会看见世界的机会：记忆、心理体验与弱势群体的经济生活

url:d5eadf6aae07ea21.abstract: Generative AT tools can help students complete assignments faster and achieve better scores. But completing these tasks is not the goal; learning from them is. This column uses data on over 25,000 7th to 12th grade students in China to examine how self-directed use of generative AI affects their learning. Time spent on homework for students who used AI went down and homework scores went up, but their exam scores fell. While the initial effect is small, it grows as students become more proficient with AI tools and as more course material is learned after adoption, suggesting that existing short-duration studies may underestimate the long-run learning costs of using generative AI.
url:d5eadf6aae07ea21.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能工具能帮助学生更快完成作业并取得更高分数。然而，完成这些任务并非目的，从中学习才是关键。本文基于中国超过25,000名7至12年级学生的数据，考察了自主使用生成式人工智能对其学习的影响。使用人工智能的学生在作业上花费的时间减少，作业成绩有所提升，但他们的考试成绩却出现下降。尽管初始影响较小，但随着学生对人工智能工具熟练度的提高以及采用后学习更多课程材料，这一影响逐渐增大，这表明现有短期研究可能低估了使用生成式人工智能的长期学习成本。
url:d5eadf6aae07ea21.title: The generative AI learning penalty in secondary school

url:d6015a49f1ef6bcf.abstract: We study how U.S. tariff hikes in 2025 have transmitted to import prices. Consistent with recent evidence, we find that duty-exclusive import prices at the variety (country-product) level do not adjust to tariffs, implying full pass-through to duty-inclusive prices at the border. At the product level, however, duty-exclusive aggregate import prices decline significantly with tariff increases. We show that this product-level decline is driven by within-product reallocation toward lower-priced sources—stronger in products facing larger tariff hikes—and operates primarily through the entry of lower-priced varieties and the exit of higher-priced ones. Estimates of variety appeal indicate that part of this reallocation reflects shifts toward lower-quality varieties, a channel that is also present in the 2018–19 U.S.–China tariff episode. These reallocation effects carry implications for consumer welfare and productivity through the quality of imported goods and inputs.
url:d6015a49f1ef6bcf.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2025年美国关税上调如何传导至进口价格。与近期证据一致，我们发现品种（国家-产品）层面的不含税进口价格并未随关税调整，这意味着关税完全传导至边境含税价格。然而在产品层面，不含税的总进口价格却随关税上升而显著下降。研究表明，这种产品层面的价格下降源于同一产品内部向低价来源的重新配置——在面临更大关税上调的产品中更为显著——主要通过低价品种的进入和高价品种的退出实现。品种吸引力估算表明，这种重新配置部分反映了向低质量品种的转移，这一渠道在2018-19年中美关税事件中同样存在。这些重新配置效应通过进口商品和投入品的质量渠道对消费者福利与生产率产生影响。
url:d6015a49f1ef6bcf.title: Tariff Pass-Through and Import Reallocation
url:d6015a49f1ef6bcf.title_zh: 关税传导与进口再配置

url:d60e12be9caea54d.abstract: We propose a static three-stage incentive-compatible, budget-balanced, execution-contingent scheme for a regulator to allocate biodiversity protection responsibilities across a landscape mosaic having multiple value-interdependent owners. The scheme motivates owners to truthfully report their opportunity costs of protection to the regulator and to comply with their assigned habitat protection responsibilities. url:d60e12be9caea54d.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种静态三阶段激励相容、预算平衡且执行依存的方案，供监管机构在具有多个价值相互依存的土地所有者的景观镶嵌体中分配生物多样性保护责任。该方案激励所有者向监管机构如实报告其保护的机会成本，并遵守其被分配的生境保护责任。JEL分类：C62D7Q21Q57 关键词：可交易预留要求；效率；相互依存的估值；机制设计；生物多样性

url:d6269555329721f7.abstract: We examine how lower search costs or better seller disclosure affects this interaction. Whereas a drop in search costs improves consumer surplus and decreases profit when the seller can resort to an optimal disclosure strategy, its impact is ambiguous if the seller is unable to provide information. When it is unlikely that the buyer's valuation is below marginal cost, the buyer does not benefit from optimal information disclosure if search costs are high. With such high search costs and no disclosure both parties can be better off than with lower search costs and optimal information disclosure. The seller then adopts a mass market strategy where she posts a low enough price so the buyer always purchases the product without search. By contrast, if it is sufficiently likely that the buyer's valuation is below marginal cost, then the buyer can benefit from sophisticated information disclosure for relatively low search costs. The corresponding outcome is better for both parties than an environment with higher search costs and no information disclosure. The optimal seller strategy targets a niche of high-valuation buyers and prevents wasteful search by buyers with low valuations.
url:d6269555329721f7.abstract_zh: 我们研究了搜索成本降低或卖方信息披露改善如何影响这一互动。当卖方能够采用最优信息披露策略时，搜索成本的下降会提升消费者剩余并降低利润；但若卖方无法提供信息，其影响则具有不确定性。当买方估值低于边际成本的可能性较小时，若搜索成本较高，买方无法从最优信息披露中获益。在此高搜索成本且无信息披露的情况下，双方境况可能优于低搜索成本配合最优信息披露的情形。此时卖方采取大众市场策略，设定足够低的价格使买方无需搜索即可直接购买产品。相反，若买方估值低于边际成本的可能性足够大，则买方可在相对较低的搜索成本下从精细化信息披露中获益。此情形下的结果对双方而言均优于高搜索成本且无信息披露的环境。卖方的最优策略是瞄准高估值买方的利基市场，同时避免低估值买方进行无效搜索。
url:d6269555329721f7.title: Sources of Consumer Information

url:d64face8f7a3f90b.abstract: We investigate the systemic risk contribution of 3,500 Money Market Funds (MMFs) in normal periods and during asset price bubbles in the US from January 2004 to December 2022. Using state-of-the-art statistical techniques for bubble detection and granular fund-level data, we show that MMF characteristics significantly influence systemic risk. Large MMFs and government MMFs, which invest exclusively in US Treasury securities, are associated with reduced systemic risk, while prime MMFs contribute to higher systemic risk. MMFs denominated in US dollars but domiciled offshore exhibit no significant differences from their US-domiciled counterparts.
url:d64face8f7a3f90b.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2004年1月至2022年12月期间，美国3500只货币市场基金在正常时期及资产价格泡沫期间的系统性风险贡献。运用前沿的泡沫检测统计技术与精细的基金层面数据，我们发现货币市场基金特征对系统性风险具有显著影响。大型货币市场基金及仅投资于美国国债的政府货币市场基金与较低的系统性风险相关，而优质货币市场基金则加剧了系统性风险。以美元计价但注册于离岸市场的货币市场基金，其表现与美国本土注册的同类基金无显著差异。

url:d67a475d0e8857c6.abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage, into which they may be reincarnated. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line. These findings suggest that high fertility in sub-Saharan Africa rests on moral foundations that standard, externally designed interventions tend to overlook.
url:d67a475d0e8857c6.abstract_zh: 传统人口模型系统性地高估了撒哈拉以南非洲地区的生育率下降趋势。本文提出一种基于普遍存在但研究不足的信仰体系的补充性解释：祖先能够影响现世生活，并寻求其血脉延续，后代可能成为祖先转世之身。在这种世界观中，生育子女成为植根于精神责任的道德与集体义务，旨在确保家族血脉的存续。通过运用一手数据、新颖的民族志资料以及历史与当代调查，本文证实了祖先信仰与生育率之间在跨时期、跨情境中均存在显著且数量级较大的正向关联。将子女视为家族公共品的简单模型，能够合理解释数据中呈现的规律：祖先信仰对生育率的影响集中于父系社会，且兄弟姐妹间因子女延续同一家族血脉而出现特定形式的搭便车行为。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲的高生育率建立在被标准外部干预措施所忽视的道德基础之上。

url:d69e7d975d212dad.abstract: Central banks are rethinking reserve portfolios as geopolitical fragmentation raises concerns about the accessibility of foreign-held assets, while dollar-funding stress keeps the US dollar at the centre of global financial stability. Using high-frequency US monetary policy surprises and minute-level exchange rates for 18 economies, this column shows that dollar and gold reserves are associated with smaller currency depreciations, especially where official dollar-liquidity backstops are absent and dollar liabilities are large. The findings highlight the importance of maintaining liquidity in the currencies where stress is likely, alongside sound domestic funding structures, credible policy frameworks, and prudent limits on unhedged foreign currency debt.
url:d69e7d975d212dad.abstract_zh: 随着地缘政治碎片化加剧，各国央行对境外持有资产的可及性产生担忧，而美元融资压力则使美元始终处于全球金融稳定的核心位置。本文利用高频美国货币政策冲击数据及18个经济体的分钟级汇率数据，发现美元与黄金储备与较小的货币贬值幅度相关，尤其在缺乏官方美元流动性支持且美元负债规模较大的经济体中更为显著。研究结果强调，在维持可能承压货币流动性的同时，还需构建稳健的国内融资结构、可信的政策框架，并对未对冲外币债务设置审慎限额。

url:d6aa892a1a7f39d1.abstract: Predictions of the effects of AI on the economy and society tend to focus on productivity growth, job losses, and shifts in the distribution of income. This column examines various potential scenarios for the macroeconomic effects of AI, using Congressional Budget Office projections to estimate their effects on the US federal budget, and discusses their implications for US fiscal policy. The conclusions show that the fiscal consequences of AI will depend not only on how much it raises national income, but also on who receives that income and how policymakers respond.
url:d6aa892a1a7f39d1.abstract_zh: 关于人工智能对经济和社会影响的预测，通常聚焦于生产率增长、就业损失以及收入分配的变化。本文利用国会预算办公室的预测，考察了人工智能对宏观经济影响的各种潜在情景，以估算其对美国联邦预算的影响，并探讨了这些影响对美国财政政策的启示。结论表明，人工智能的财政后果不仅取决于其提高国民收入的程度，还取决于谁获得这些收入以及政策制定者如何应对。

url:d6d3b3ff3d963e31.abstract: We investigate equity price reactions to these two events, which represent major realizations of climate policy transition risk. Our results highlight the heterogeneous nature of climate policy risk exposure. We find sizable reactions that differ by industry as well as across firm-level measures of greenness such as environmental scores and emission intensities. While the financial market response to the IRA was economically significant, it did not lead to instability or financial stress, suggesting that transition risks posed by climate policies even as ambitious as the IRA may be manageable.
url:d6d3b3ff3d963e31.abstract_zh: 我们研究了这两个事件对股票价格的反应，它们代表了气候政策转型风险的主要实现形式。我们的结果凸显了气候政策风险暴露的异质性特征。我们发现，不同行业以及企业层面的绿色程度指标（如环境评分和排放强度）之间存在显著的反应差异。尽管金融市场对《通胀削减法案》的反应在经济上意义重大，但并未引发不稳定或金融压力，这表明即使像IRA这样雄心勃勃的气候政策所带来的转型风险也可能是可控的。

url:d6fb91b798aceb73.abstract: Youth employment remains a critical issue in Sub-Saharan Africa. This study examines the impact of two large-scale governmental programmes in Cameroon and Madagascar that aim to promote self-employment in agriculture. Youth participated in vocational training and received technical support, inputs and mentoring to engage in crop, livestock or non-farming agricultural activities. We employ a quasi-experimental design to estimate the impact on the income of youth-led activities, and we address the limitations associated with such designs by carefully constructing a counterfactual. Our findings indicate that these integrated training and livelihoods programmes significantly enhance income from the targeted activities. We highlight the importance of providing regular support for participants during and after programme implementation.
url:d6fb91b798aceb73.abstract_zh: 青年就业仍是撒哈拉以南非洲地区的关键问题。本研究考察了喀麦隆和马达加斯加两项旨在促进农业领域自主创业的大型政府项目的影响。青年参与职业培训，并获得技术支持、物资投入和指导，从事作物种植、畜牧养殖或非耕作类农业活动。我们采用准实验设计来评估这些项目对青年主导活动收入的影响，并通过谨慎构建反事实框架来应对此类设计固有的局限性。研究结果表明，这些综合性的培训与生计项目显著提升了目标活动的收入水平。我们强调在项目实施期间及结束后为参与者提供持续支持的重要性。

url:d75fd97853e101e5.abstract: In a series of declarations throughout 2025 and into 2026, the United States announced higher tariffs on nearly all imports from most countries. The countries that make up the CAPDR region (Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama and El Salvador) are affected through sizeable direct trade linkages with the United States, and through indirect trade linkages with third countries. This paper explores the potential long-term economic effects of these tariff increases on CAPDR using a multi-region multi-industry model of the global economy. The modelling exercises suggest that CAPDR member countries will experience falls in real GDP to varying degrees, with the severity of the effect closely linked to direct export exposure to the United States. The most vulnerable industries are heavily trade-exposed manufactures, although exemptions – most importantly for textiles & apparel – may provide some scope for trade diversion to offset some of the GDP losses. Although ongoing legal challenges have introduced additional uncertainty regarding the ultimate extent of tariff changes, the results in this paper will remain broadly valid providing the tariffs remain in place.
url:d75fd97853e101e5.abstract_zh: 在2025年至2026年的一系列声明中，美国宣布对来自大多数国家的几乎所有进口商品加征更高关税。中美洲-多米尼加共和国地区（CAPDR）成员国（哥斯达黎加、多米尼加共和国、危地马拉、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜、巴拿马和萨尔瓦多）通过与美国直接且规模可观的贸易联系，以及与第三国的间接贸易联系而受到影响。本文运用全球经济多区域多产业模型，探讨了这些关税上调对CAPDR的潜在长期经济影响。模型测算表明，CAPDR成员国实际GDP将出现不同程度的下降，其影响严重程度与对美国的直接出口敞口密切相关。最脆弱的行业是高度依赖贸易的制造业，尽管豁免条款——最重要的是纺织品与服装——可能通过贸易转移在一定程度上抵消部分GDP损失。尽管持续的法律挑战为关税变动的最终幅度增添了额外不确定性，但只要关税措施持续实施，本文的研究结果将基本保持有效。
url:d75fd97853e101e5.title: Long-term Effects of US Tariff Increases on CAPDR
url:d75fd97853e101e5.title_zh: 美国关税上调对中美洲、巴拿马和多米尼加共和国（CAPDR）的长期影响
