url:d774ee1433a7e109.abstract: Extending health insurance coverage to previously uninsured populations can improve access to preventive services by relaxing financial barriers to health information and care, including those related to weight management. However, in the presence of ex-ante moral hazard, insurance coverage may weaken incentives for preventive effort, potentially increasing unhealthy behaviours. This paper examines this phenomenon using evidence from the introduction of a universal public insurance program, namely Mexico’s Seguro Popular (SP), in the 2000s. We exploit plausibly exogenous variation in the rollout of SP across municipalities generated by differential implementation speeds. We find no evidence that the rollout of SP modified individuals’ body mass index (BMI) or obesity status. Further, heterogeneity analysis suggests that SP exposure leads to a significant reduction in BMI among individuals who were already overweight at baseline, and a 2 percentage point decline in smoking prevalence, consistent with the hypothesis that SP increased access to preventative health information. These results suggest no evidence of ex-ante moral hazard in weight-related health behaviours after the expansion of universal insurance.
url:d774ee1433a7e109.abstract_zh: 将医疗保险覆盖范围扩展至此前未参保人群，可通过减轻获取健康信息与医疗服务（包括体重管理相关服务）的经济障碍，提升预防性服务的可及性。然而，在存在事前道德风险的情况下，保险覆盖可能削弱个体采取预防性行为的激励，从而增加不健康行为。本文利用21世纪初墨西哥实施全民公共医疗保险计划（即大众保险）的证据，研究这一现象。我们借助各城市因执行速度差异导致的大众保险推广进程中的外生变异，发现该保险推广并未改变个体的身体质量指数或肥胖状况。进一步异质性分析表明，大众保险的覆盖导致基线超重人群的身体质量指数显著下降，并使吸烟率降低2个百分点，这与保险覆盖增加了预防性健康信息可及性的假说一致。这些结果表明，在全民保险扩展后，体重相关健康行为中并未出现事前道德风险的证据。
url:d774ee1433a7e109.title: Ex-ante moral hazard? Overweight and health insurance expansion in Mexico
url:d774ee1433a7e109.title_zh: 事前道德风险？墨西哥的超重与健康保险扩展

url:d7761e9bf66bace3.abstract: Exchange rate movements have implications for the purchasing power of residents or voters. Given that the exchange rate is often seen as a barometer of government performance, there could be strong incentives to influence exchange rate valuation during elections. This paper investigates whether political economy factors affect Foreign Exchange Intervention (FXI) policy across countries. It investigates whether central banks tend to implement FX sales, leaning against depreciations, during electoral periods in a sample of 28 countries including both advanced (AEs) and emerging (EMs) economies over the period 2000-2019. The results show that EMs with competitive elections tend to implement more and larger FX sales in pre-electoral period, compared to post-election period, given their political popularity. Further, this result is driven by countries where political pressures on central bank governors are more prevalent. Furthermore, the paper also finds that monetary policy transparency has the potential to mitigate this politically driven FXI during electoral period. Finally, the paper discusses policy implications given that politically motivated FX sales could hamper the ability of central banks to effectively respond to large shocks.
url:d7761e9bf66bace3.abstract_zh: 汇率变动对居民或选民的购买力具有重要影响。鉴于汇率常被视为政府绩效的晴雨表，选举期间可能存在强烈动机干预汇率估值。本文研究政治经济因素是否会影响各国的外汇干预政策，基于2000-2019年涵盖28个经济体（包括发达经济体和新兴经济体）的样本，考察央行是否倾向于在选举期间实施外汇抛售以应对本币贬值压力。结果表明，具有竞争性选举的新兴经济体在选举前阶段，出于政治声望考量，会实施更多且规模更大的外汇抛售。进一步分析显示，这一结果在央行行长面临更普遍政治压力的国家尤为显著。此外，本文还发现货币政策透明度具有缓解选举期间政治驱动型外汇干预的潜力。最后，本文讨论了政策启示：出于政治动机的外汇抛售可能削弱央行有效应对重大冲击的能力。
url:d7761e9bf66bace3.title: The Political Economy of Foreign Exchange Interventions
url:d7761e9bf66bace3.title_zh: 外汇干预的政治经济学

url:d78fe003202e7335.abstract: Social movements are catalysts for crucial institutional changes. To succeed, they must coordinate members’ views (consensus building) and actions (mobilization). We study union leaders within Myanmar’s burgeoning labor movement. Union leaders are positively selected on both personality traits that enable them to influence others and ability but earn lower wages. In group discussions about workers’ views on an upcoming national minimum wage negotiation, randomly embedded leaders build consensus around the union’s preferred policy. In an experiment that mimics individual decision-making in a collective action set-up, leaders increase mobilization through coordination. Leaders empower social movements by building consensus that encourages mobilization.
url:d78fe003202e7335.abstract_zh: 社会运动是推动关键制度变革的催化剂。为了成功，它们必须协调成员的观点（共识构建）与行动（动员）。我们研究了缅甸蓬勃发展的劳工运动中的工会领袖。工会领袖在个性特质上具有正向选择性，这些特质使他们能够影响他人，同时他们也具备较高的能力，但薪资却较低。在关于工人对即将到来的全国最低工资谈判看法的团体讨论中，随机嵌入的领袖围绕工会偏好的政策构建共识。在一个模拟集体行动情境中个体决策的实验中，领袖通过协调增强了动员。领袖通过构建鼓励动员的共识来赋能社会运动。
url:d78fe003202e7335.title: Union Leaders: Experimental Evidence from Myanmar
url:d78fe003202e7335.title_zh: 工会领袖：来自缅甸的实验证据

url:d7da114e5042960b.abstract: This study is the first to use population-wide birth registration data spanning 18 years, linked to Census records, to examine the relationship between a comprehensive set of socioeconomic factors and the birth weight of more than 1.2 million children in Australia, both at the mean and across the distribution. Employing some of the most rigorous empirical approaches in the literature, including mother fixed-effects models, the study reports five main findings, several of which offer new insights for the literature. First, both maternal and paternal education are positively associated with children's birth weight, with stronger associations observed for maternal education and at the lower end of the birth weight distribution. Second, parental income exhibits a positive but non-linear association with birth weight, with larger effects among lower-birth-weight children. Third, relative to children living in rental housing, those born into families with mortgaged homes have higher average birth weights, whereas those born into families that own their homes outright have lower average birth weights. However, children from home-owning families exhibit higher birth weights at the lower end of the distribution but lower birth weights at the upper end. Fourth, more favourable local socioeconomic conditions are positively but non-linearly associated with birth weight, with stronger associations at the lower end of the distribution. Fifth, children born to mothers who migrated from low- or middle-income countries have lower birth weights than those born to mothers from high-income countries.
url:d7da114e5042960b.abstract_zh: 本研究首次利用覆盖18年的人口出生登记数据，并结合人口普查记录，考察了澳大利亚超过120万儿童出生体重与一系列社会经济因素在均值及分布层面的关联。通过采用文献中最严谨的实证方法（包括母亲固定效应模型），研究得出五项主要发现，其中多项为现有文献提供了新见解。第一，母亲与父亲的教育水平均与儿童出生体重呈正相关，其中母亲教育的关联性更强，且在出生体重分布的低端更为显著。第二，父母收入与出生体重呈正向但非线性的关联，对低出生体重儿童的影响更大。第三，相较于居住在租赁住房中的儿童，出生于有抵押贷款家庭的儿童平均出生体重更高，而出生于完全自有住房家庭的儿童平均出生体重更低。然而，来自完全自有住房家庭的儿童在出生体重分布低端呈现更高体重，但在高端则呈现更低体重。第四，更有利的本地社会经济条件与出生体重呈正向但非线性的关联，且在分布低端关联性更强。第五，出生于来自中低收入国家母亲的儿童，其出生体重低于出生于来自高收入国家母亲的儿童。

url:d7dc98b98a113c20.abstract: We use the granular model of international trade developed in Gaubert and Itskhoki (2021) to study the rationale and implications of three types of government interventions typically targeted at large individual firms - antitrust, trade and industrial policies. We find that in antitrust regulation, governments face an incentive to be overly lenient in accepting mergers of large domestic firms, which acts akin to beggar-thy-neighbor trade policy in sectors with strong comparative advantage. In trade policy, targeting large individual foreign exporters rather than entire sectors is desirable from the point of view of a national government. Doing so minimizes the pass-through of import tariffs into domestic consumer prices, placing a greater portion of the burden on foreign producers. Finally, we show that subsidizing `national champions' is generally suboptimal in closed economies as it leads to an excessive build-up of market power, but it may become unilaterally welfare improving in open economies. We contrast unilaterally optimal policies with the coordinated global optimal policy and emphasize the need for international policy cooperation in these domains.
url:d7dc98b98a113c20.abstract_zh: 我们运用Gaubert和Itskhoki（2021）提出的国际贸易颗粒模型，研究了三类通常针对大型个体企业的政府干预措施——反垄断、贸易和产业政策——的理论依据及其影响。研究发现，在反垄断监管中，政府倾向于对大型国内企业的合并过于宽容，这类似于在具有较强比较优势的行业中实施以邻为壑的贸易政策。在贸易政策方面，从国家政府的角度来看，针对大型外国出口企业而非整个行业更为可取。这样做能最小化进口关税向国内消费者价格的传导，将更大比例的负担转嫁给外国生产者。最后，我们表明，在封闭经济中补贴“国家冠军”企业通常并非最优选择，因为这会导致市场力量的过度积累，但在开放经济中，这种补贴可能单方面提升福利。我们将单方面最优政策与协调的全球最优政策进行对比，并强调在这些领域进行国际政策合作的必要性。
url:d7dc98b98a113c20.title: Government Policies in a Granular Global Economy
url:d7dc98b98a113c20.title_zh: 颗粒化全球经济中的政府政策

url:d85a9a8adf5f01bf.abstract: Evaluating optimized AI systems for asset pricing is fundamentally difficult for two reasons. First, models are trained on all data, implying that any backtest or analysis using historical data suffers from look-ahead bias. In addition, markets are reflexive — as investors adopt AI, prices adjust — which may erode the very patterns the AI system was trained to exploit. We introduce a real-time, out-of-sample benchmark designed to sidestep both problems. The benchmark measures how well AI systems can explain contemporaneous stock returns around earnings announcements using only information available at announcement time, including the text of the announcement itself. Applying this benchmark to a range of agentic AI systems — which extract structured signals from earnings call transcripts and optimize over those signals — we find that the best-optimized systems more than double the explained variation in returns relative to standard benchmarks (R2 increasing from 8% to close to 20%). We show that AI-based optimization can deliver efficiency gains relative to traditional machine learning methods while also improving interpretability as our approach produces human-readable economic mechanisms that explain price movements. These learned rules can be compared to the drivers of realized returns in existing asset pricing models to identify missing sources of variation in a data-driven, self-evolving way that integrates empirical learning with economic structure. We release an SDK for researchers to improve on our results. Saturating this benchmark would represent fundamental progress in understanding how capital markets process firm-level information.
url:d85a9a8adf5f01bf.abstract_zh: 评估针对资产定价优化的AI系统存在两个根本性困难。首先，模型基于全部数据训练，这意味着任何使用历史数据的回测或分析都存在前瞻性偏差。其次，市场具有反身性——随着投资者采用AI技术，价格会相应调整——这可能导致AI系统原本训练利用的模式逐渐消失。我们引入了一个实时、样本外的基准测试，旨在规避这两个问题。该基准衡量AI系统仅利用公告发布时可获取的信息（包括公告文本本身）来解释盈余公告期间同期股票收益的能力。将该基准应用于一系列智能体AI系统（这些系统从财报电话会议记录中提取结构化信号并对其进行优化），我们发现最优化的系统相较于标准基准，其解释的收益变异幅度提升了一倍以上（R²从8%提升至接近20%）。研究表明，基于AI的优化相较于传统机器学习方法能实现效率提升，同时增强可解释性——我们的方法可生成解释价格变动的人类可读经济机制。这些学习规则可与现有资产定价模型中已实现收益的驱动因素进行对比，以数据驱动、自我演进的方式识别缺失的变异来源，实现经验学习与经济结构的融合。我们发布了SDK供研究者改进现有成果。若该基准达到饱和，将标志着理解资本市场如何处理企业层面信息的根本性突破。
url:d85a9a8adf5f01bf.title: Assessing the Benefits of Optimized Agentic AI Systems for Asset Pricing
url:d85a9a8adf5f01bf.title_zh: 评估优化代理型人工智能系统对资产定价的益处

url:d876a7ada352a4cd.abstract: The regulatory cycles view, according to which periods of deregulation encourage greater risk-taking and credit booms, which culminate in financial crises and are followed by renewed regulation, rests largely on case studies of individual countries or particular crises. This column uses a new dataset covering 14 countries over the past century to show that the pattern observed after the Great Depression has been much weaker since the Global Financial Crisis. The authors argue that the reason is not simply a change in political priorities or regulatory philosophy. Increasing financial integration has made effective banking regulation at the national level progressively more difficult, shifting regulatory authority from national governments towards international coordination.
url:d876a7ada352a4cd.abstract_zh: 监管周期理论认为，放松管制时期会鼓励更大的风险承担和信贷繁荣，最终导致金融危机，随后迎来新一轮监管强化。这一观点主要基于对单个国家或特定危机的案例研究。本文利用覆盖14个国家过去一个世纪的新数据集，表明大萧条后观察到的这一模式自全球金融危机以来已显著弱化。作者认为，其原因并非仅仅是政治优先事项或监管理念的转变。日益加深的金融一体化使得国家层面的有效银行监管愈发困难，监管权力正从各国政府向国际协调机制转移。
url:d876a7ada352a4cd.title: Financial globalisation and the weakening of the regulatory cycle
url:d876a7ada352a4cd.title_zh: 金融全球化与监管周期的弱化

url:d88b73c27f6c86ea.abstract: This report presents an EU-wide stocktake of Integrated Territorial Development Strategies (ITDSs) implemented under Cohesion Policy 2021–2027, drawing on data from STRAT-Board, the JRC–DG REGIO platform monitoring integrated territorial approaches. The dataset covers 87 Managing Authorities, 110 programmes and 1, 426 strategies - around 70% of all ITDSs - representing the most comprehensive evidence available for this programming period. Integrated Territorial Development (ITD) accounts for EUR 41.3 billion (~11% of total EU Cohesion Policy contributions), with uptake varying considerably across Member States due to differences in governance systems, administrative capacity and strategic interpretation. Integrated Territorial Investment (ITI) is the most widely used delivery mechanism, followed by Other Territorial Tools (OTTs) and Community-led Local Development (CLLD). While Sustainable Urban Development (SUD) remains central, most strategies target small and medium-sized territories: 85% cover areas below 250, 000 inhabitants and nearly half focus on territories under 50, 000. Over half span mixed urban–rural geographies, reflecting the importance of functional territorial linkages. Financially, SUD strategies mobilise substantially higher per-capita investments than non-SUD strategies, which tend to support smaller-scale, community-oriented interventions. Thematic priorities concentrate on integrated territorial development, biodiversity, energy efficiency and sustainable mobility. Governance arrangements are generally formalised, though practices vary in strategy selection, project identification and monitoring. Overall, the findings highlight the growing importance and heterogeneous implementation of ITD, underscoring the need to strengthen local capacity and enhance place-based impact.
url:d88b73c27f6c86ea.abstract_zh: 本报告基于STRAT-Board（欧盟委员会联合研究中心与区域政策总司监测综合区域方法的平台）数据，对2021-2027年凝聚政策框架下实施的欧盟范围内综合区域发展战略（ITDSs）进行了全面评估。数据集涵盖87个管理机构、110个项目和1426项战略（约占全部ITDSs的70%），是本规划周期内可获得的最全面证据。综合区域发展（ITD）涉及413亿欧元资金（约占欧盟凝聚政策总投入的11%），各成员国因治理体系、行政能力和战略解读差异导致实施程度显著不同。综合区域投资（ITI）是最广泛采用的实施机制，其次为其他区域工具（OTTs）和社区主导地方发展（CLLD）。尽管可持续城市发展（SUD）仍居核心地位，但多数战略聚焦中小型区域：85%覆盖人口低于25万的区域，近半数关注人口不足5万的区域。超过半数战略涵盖城乡混合地理空间，反映出功能性区域关联的重要性。在资金配置方面，SUD战略的人均投资额显著高于非SUD战略，后者更倾向于支持小规模、社区导向的干预措施。主题优先领域集中于综合区域发展、生物多样性、能源效率和可持续交通。治理安排普遍实现规范化，但在战略选择、项目识别和监测环节存在实践差异。总体而言，研究结果凸显了ITD日益增长的重要性与实施异质性，强调需加强地方能力建设并提升基于地域的影响力。
url:d88b73c27f6c86ea.title: Integrated territorial development in action

url:d8d13cf93bf45d7b.abstract: In this Paper we incorporate the term structure of interest rates in a standard inflation forecast targeting framework. Learning about the transmission process of monetary policy is introduced by having heterogeneous agents - i.e. the central bank and private agents - who have different information sets about the future sequence of short-term interest rates. We analyse inflation forecast targeting in two environments. One in which the central bank has perfect knowledge, in the sense that it understands and observes the process by which private sector interest rate expectations are generated, and one in which the central bank has imperfect knowledge and has to learn the private sector forecasting rule for short-term interest rates. In the case of imperfect knowledge, the central bank has to learn about private sector interest rate expectations, as the latter affect the impact of monetary policy through the expectations theory of the term structure of interest rates. Here following Evans and Honkapohja (2001), the learning scheme we investigate is that of least-squares learning (recursive OLS) using the Kalman filter. We find that optimal monetary policy under learning is a policy that separates estimation and control. Therefore, this model suggests that the practical relevance of the breakdown of the separation principle and the need for experimentation in policy may be limited.
url:d8d13cf93bf45d7b.abstract_zh: 本文将利率期限结构纳入标准的通胀预测目标框架。通过引入异质性主体（即中央银行与私人部门），两者对未来短期利率序列拥有不同的信息集，从而引入货币政策传导过程的学习机制。我们在两种环境下分析通胀预测目标：其一，中央银行具备完全知识，即其理解并观测私人部门利率预期生成过程；其二，中央银行存在不完全知识，需学习私人部门短期利率预测规则。在不完全知识情形下，中央银行必须学习私人部门利率预期，因为后者通过利率期限结构的预期理论影响货币政策传导效果。此处遵循Evans和Honkapohja（2001）的研究，我们采用基于卡尔曼滤波的最小二乘学习（递归OLS）方案。研究发现，学习条件下的最优货币政策是分离估计与控制的政策。因此，本模型表明，分离原则失效及政策实验需求的实践相关性可能有限。

url:d8ea274241487da1.abstract: When demand aggregates both price-sensitive and price-insensitive behaviors, uniform pricing becomes a deficient market design that generates negative surplus during extreme-price events. We develop a price-control mechanism that efficiently resolves the tradeoff between protecting consumers and limiting rents. The mechanism implements a dynamic price cap that responds to demand adjustments and induces truthful supply through incentive payments. In a quantitative application to the French wholesale electricity market during the 2022–2023 energy crisis, the mechanism would have lowered expected procurement costs by roughly €200 billion, about two-thirds of total projected costs in this central scenario.
url:d8ea274241487da1.abstract_zh: 当需求同时包含价格敏感与价格不敏感行为时，统一定价成为有缺陷的市场设计，会在极端价格事件中产生负剩余。我们提出一种价格控制机制，能够有效解决消费者保护与租金限制之间的权衡。该机制实施动态价格上限，根据需求调整作出响应，并通过激励支付诱导真实供给。在2022-2023年能源危机期间法国电力批发市场的量化应用中，该机制将使预期采购成本降低约2000亿欧元，约占该基准情景下总预期成本的三分之二。
url:d8ea274241487da1.title: Pricing in Crisis

url:d90231e3c4828286.abstract: This research develops an expanded unified growth theory that incorporates the endogenous accumulation of physical capital, population, human capital, and technology. The model incorporates a complementarity between physical capital and human capital and can be extended to a multi-country setting with international technology diffusion. The analytical characterization of the mechanisms behind the observed patterns of long-run growth and comparative development delivers a consistent explanation for a large set of seemingly unrelated empirical facts. A quantitative multi-country version of the model matches various empirical regularities of long-run growth dynamics and comparative development patterns that have previously been studied in isolation. The findings also shed new light on the role of the demographic transition for convergence patterns, the specification of cross-country growth regressions, technology spillovers, and the secular stagnation debate.
url:d90231e3c4828286.abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个扩展的统一增长理论，该理论将物质资本、人口、人力资本和技术的内生积累纳入分析框架。模型引入了物质资本与人力资本之间的互补性，并可扩展至包含国际技术扩散的多国情境。通过对长期增长与比较发展模式背后机制的分析性刻画，该模型为一系列看似互不相关的经验事实提供了统一的解释。该模型的量化多国版本能够匹配此前被孤立研究的长期增长动态与比较发展模式的多项经验规律。研究结果还揭示了人口转型对趋同模式、跨国增长回归设定、技术溢出效应以及长期停滞争论的新启示。

url:d95a63cb58f33743.abstract: In theories of creative destruction, product innovation is a key driver of aggregate growth. This paper confronts the predictions of these theories about product dynamics with empirical patterns in product-level data on French manufacturing firms. We find that the process of product innovation frequently exhibits bursts—episodes in which firms rapidly add multiple products to their portfolio. As a result, 5% of firms are responsible for over 76% of product creation. Bursts lead to substantial shifts in revenue, and the process of product creation and destruction explains 88% of the variance in five-year firm growth. We introduce a model of firm product innovation that is compatible with the data while also nesting the canonical models of creative destruction. We show that innovation bursts alter the equilibrium composition of age, size, and innovation efficiency of firms, and explain the concentration of production among superstar firms. Our model thus enables the joint study of the determinants of industry concentration and growth in a setting consistent with the empirical patterns of product dynamics.
url:d95a63cb58f33743.abstract_zh: 在创造性破坏理论中，产品创新是总体增长的关键驱动力。本文将这些理论关于产品动态的预测与法国制造业企业产品层面数据的实证模式进行对比。我们发现，产品创新过程经常呈现爆发式特征——即企业快速向产品组合中添加多种产品的阶段。由此，5%的企业贡献了超过76%的新产品创造。产品创新爆发导致收入发生显著变化，而产品创造与淘汰过程解释了企业五年增长差异的88%。我们构建了一个与企业数据兼容且嵌套经典创造性破坏模型的企业产品创新模型。研究表明，创新爆发改变了企业年龄、规模和创新效率的均衡构成，并解释了超级明星企业生产集中度的形成。因此，本模型能够在与产品动态实证模式一致的框架下，联合研究行业集中度与增长的决定因素。

url:d9690315f6865288.abstract: We examine how reminders for self-set goals influence productivity by analyzing data from 10,187 volunteer agricultural extension workers in Rwanda. We elicited workers’ goals and experimentally varied their salience through text reminders. Due to unforeseen logistical delays, approximately half of the treatment group received reminders after completing their tasks. We find that goal reminders received during the regular working period increased a productivity index by 0.08 standard deviations, while reminders sent late had no effect. Further analysis of heterogeneity by goal ambition quartiles reveals an inverted U-shaped relationship: reminders are effective for goals in the second and third quartiles, but ineffective for low or excessively high goals. These results suggest that workers who set ambitious yet realistic goals are more likely to respond to reminders and increase productivity, consistent with prior evidence on externally set goals.
url:d9690315f6865288.abstract_zh: 我们通过分析卢旺达10,187名农业推广志愿者的数据，考察了自我设定目标的提醒如何影响生产率。我们收集了志愿者的目标，并通过短信提醒实验性地改变其显著性。由于不可预见的物流延误，约一半的干预组在完成任务后才收到提醒。研究发现，在正常工作期间收到的目标提醒使生产率指数提高了0.08个标准差，而延迟发送的提醒则无效果。进一步按目标抱负四分位数进行的异质性分析揭示了倒U型关系：提醒对第二和第三四分位数的目标有效，但对低目标或过高目标无效。这些结果表明，设定既有抱负又现实的目标的工人更可能对提醒做出反应并提高生产率，这与先前关于外部设定目标的证据一致。
url:d9690315f6865288.title: The Effect of Reminders for Self-Set Goals on Productivity

url:d981d10ff1c57598.abstract: We study situations in which players shape their own understanding of the game, as well as others’, through information acquisition, communication, and other forms of strategic cognition. We introduce the concept of expectation conformity: incentives to change cognition are stronger when others expect such changes and/or make similar changes themselves. Expectation conformity provides a revealed-preference characterization of equilibrium determinacy in cognitive games. When it fails, equilibrium cognition is unique, independently of cognitive costs. When it holds, suitable costs generate multiple equilibria. We illustrate the implications in two-player constant-sum and linear-quadratic-Gaussian games. The online supplement considers other forms of cognition.
url:d981d10ff1c57598.abstract_zh: 我们研究玩家通过信息获取、沟通及其他形式的策略认知来塑造自身及他人对博弈理解的情境。我们引入预期一致性概念：当他人预期此类认知变化或自身做出类似改变时，改变认知的激励会更强。预期一致性为认知博弈中的均衡确定性提供了显示偏好特征。当预期一致性不成立时，均衡认知具有唯一性，且独立于认知成本；当预期一致性成立时，适当的成本会产生多重均衡。我们通过两人常和博弈与线性二次高斯博弈阐释其含义。在线附录则探讨其他形式的认知。
url:d981d10ff1c57598.title: Expectation Conformity in Strategic Cognition

url:da10fc754e12f518.abstract: Large productivity differences across firms reflect substantial ex-ante heterogeneity at entry, yet the origins of this heterogeneity remain poorly understood. This paper shows that innovating spinouts—firms formed by inventors leaving incumbent innovators—are a key endogenous source of high-growth entrepreneurship and aggregate productivity growth. Using inventor mobility in patent data, we document that spinouts systematically outperform other entrants throughout their life cycle, their performance is strongly linked to parent-firm technological strength, and their formation temporarily depresses parent-firm innovation. We develop a Schumpeterian growth model that endogenizes spinout formation and the fundamental tradeoff between knowledge diffusion, creative destruction, and appropriability. Closely disciplined by rich microlevel data, the model implies that spinouts account for a disproportionate share of high-growth firms and nearly forty percent of aggregate productivity growth, but that inventor departures also impose sizable costs on incumbents, generating a fundamental policy tradeoff. Policy counterfactuals show that relaxing non-compete restrictions raises aggregate growth and welfare and amplifies the effectiveness of entry subsidies.
url:da10fc754e12f518.abstract_zh: 企业间巨大的生产率差异反映了进入时显著的先验异质性，然而这种异质性的根源至今仍知之甚少。本文表明，创新型衍生企业——即由离开在位创新企业的发明家所创立的企业——是高增长创业和总体生产率增长的一个关键内生来源。利用专利数据中的发明家流动性，我们记录了衍生企业在整个生命周期中系统性地优于其他进入者，其绩效与母体企业的技术实力密切相关，且其形成会暂时抑制母体企业的创新活动。我们构建了一个熊彼特增长模型，将衍生企业的形成以及知识扩散、创造性破坏与可占有性之间的根本权衡内生化。该模型受到丰富微观数据的严格约束，其结果表明，衍生企业在高增长企业中占据不成比例的份额，并贡献了总体生产率增长的近百分之四十，但发明家的离职也给在位企业带来了可观成本，从而产生根本性的政策权衡。政策反事实分析表明，放宽竞业限制条款会提高总体增长和福利，并增强进入补贴的有效性。
url:da10fc754e12f518.title: Born Different: Entrepreneurship through Inventor Mobility, Innovation, and Growth

url:da3c8737af3ec805.abstract: Over the past four decades, the U.S. healthcare system has shifted from hospital-based care toward outpatient and community-based services, fundamentally changing where and how frontline care is delivered. Using establishment-level data from the Longitudinal Business Database and American Community Survey (1980–2023), we examine trends across eight healthcare industries. While most frontline services expanded, physician offices declined sharply, particularly in rural areas, alongside a broader shift toward larger, multi-establishment firms. Rural healthcare is not simply declining but being reconfigured into a different mix of services, with greater reliance on outsourced care, especially for capital-intensive diagnostics. Employment-based access remains lower in non-metro counties across several frontline services. Provider presence is closely tied to payer mix, though these relationships are weaker in rural areas where structural constraints appear more binding. These patterns suggest the transition to outpatient care has redistributed access unevenly, contributing to growing geographic disparities and spatial mismatches in healthcare access.
url:da3c8737af3ec805.abstract_zh: 过去四十年间，美国医疗体系已从以医院为中心的照护模式转向门诊及社区基础服务，从根本上改变了前线医疗服务提供的地点与方式。利用纵向商业数据库及美国社区调查（1980-2023年）中的机构层面数据，我们考察了八个医疗行业的趋势。尽管大多数前线服务有所扩展，但医生诊所在农村地区尤其急剧缩减，同时伴随着向更大规模、多机构企业的整体转变。农村医疗并非简单衰退，而是被重构为不同的服务组合，更加依赖外包服务，尤其是资本密集型诊断服务。在多个前线服务领域，非都市县的就业基础获取渠道仍然较低。服务提供者的存在与支付方结构密切相关，但在农村地区，这些关系较弱，结构性约束似乎更具束缚力。这些模式表明，向门诊照护的转型不均衡地重新分配了获取渠道，加剧了医疗获取方面的地理差异与空间错配。
url:da3c8737af3ec805.title: Shifts in Frontline Healthcare Services and Rural Access to Care
url:da3c8737af3ec805.title_zh: 一线医疗服务转变与农村就医可及性

url:da9339f72b84e6e0.abstract: The climate crisis is an urgent, human-driven systemic challenge whose impacts are unfolding through increasingly frequent and severe extreme events. Although the 2015 Paris Agreement advanced global climate governance, implementation remains insufficient to limit warming to well below 2 °C and pursue 1.5 °C. Accelerating risks, interacting crises and potential tipping points suggest that climate change could become unmanageable if current GHGs emissions trajectories persist. This paper makes three contributions. First, it examines why we are failing to act decisively, highlighting a persistent awareness gap, competing priorities and weak political incentives for ambitious climate action. Second, it draws on NGFS climate-policy scenarios, the climate policy trilemma and a precautionary approach to clarify policymaking trade-offs under uncertainty. Third, it reviews policy, financial and technological levers to accelerate a just green transition. A new climate policy paradigm is needed: a systemic, precautionary, adaptive and incentive-compatible framework that can “tilt the odds” away from irreversible climate damage, even when probabilities are poorly known. JEL Classification: D81, E61, D62, Q54
url:da9339f72b84e6e0.abstract_zh: 气候危机是由人类活动驱动的系统性紧迫挑战，其影响正通过日益频繁和严重的极端事件显现。尽管2015年《巴黎协定》推动了全球气候治理，但当前实施力度仍不足以将升温控制在远低于2°C并力争1.5°C的目标范围内。风险加速累积、危机交互作用及潜在临界点表明，若当前温室气体排放轨迹持续，气候变化可能变得难以管控。本文做出三项贡献：第一，剖析人类未能果断行动的原因，揭示持续存在的认知差距、相互冲突的优先事项以及缺乏推动雄心气候行动的强有力政治激励；第二，借鉴NGFS气候政策情景、气候政策三难困境及预防性原则，阐明不确定性下的政策制定权衡；第三，梳理加速公正绿色转型的政策、金融与技术杠杆。研究提出需要构建新型气候政策范式——一个系统性、预防性、适应性且激励相容的框架，即便在概率认知不充分的情况下，也能"扭转概率"以避免不可逆的气候损害。JEL分类号：D81, E61, D62, Q54

url:dac9f1f99f096758.abstract: Public-health interventions often aspire to generate spillovers beyond the households they directly reach, but identifying who is exposed to whom within communities is challenging. Researchers frequently approximate social exposure using geographic proximity, even though the individuals who transmit health advice need not be nearby. We study this issue by conducting secondary analysis of a randomized maternal and child health counseling intervention in rural Honduras with geocoded households and mapped social networks. At our main 50-meter radius, geographic proximity captures only 30.8% of health-advice ties, while only 3.7% of geographically proximate household pairs are connected by advice-giving. The choice of exposure mapping matters for what the analysis detects. Exposure mappings based solely on geographic proximity yield a precise zero effect on diarrhea knowledge. By contrast, exposure through advice ties beyond 50 meters increases diarrhea knowledge, and the effect is statistically distinguishable from exposure through nearby non-advice contacts. The evidence suggests that simple, actionable illness-management knowledge diffuses through advice relationships that geographic proximity alone fails to capture. Reported diarrhea, indicating whether the respondent or any child had diarrhea in the previous four weeks, also increases with advice exposure outside 50m, consistent with greater recognition, recall, or reporting rather than higher underlying morbidity. We find no corresponding effects for respiratory knowledge or reported respiratory illness. Our results show that using geographic proximity as a proxy for social exposure can mask important channels of information transmission and could lead researchers to miss meaningful spillover effects.
url:dac9f1f99f096758.abstract_zh: 公共卫生干预措施往往期望在直接覆盖的家庭之外产生溢出效应，但识别社区内谁与谁接触具有挑战性。研究人员常以地理邻近性近似衡量社会接触，尽管传播健康建议的个体未必相邻。我们通过对洪都拉斯农村地区一项随机母婴健康咨询干预进行二次分析来研究这一问题，该干预包含地理编码家庭和映射社会网络数据。在主要50米半径范围内，地理邻近性仅捕捉到30.8%的健康建议联系，而仅有3.7%的地理邻近家庭对存在建议传递关系。暴露映射的选择会影响分析结果。仅基于地理邻近性的暴露映射显示对腹泻知识的影响精确为零。相反，通过50米外建议联系产生的暴露能提升腹泻知识，其效应在统计上显著区别于邻近非建议接触的暴露。证据表明，简单可行的疾病管理知识通过建议关系传播，而单纯地理邻近性无法捕捉这种关系。报告腹泻（反映受访者或任何儿童在过去四周内是否出现腹泻）也随50米外建议暴露增加而增加，这与更高的认知、回忆或报告率一致，而非潜在发病率上升。我们未发现呼吸系统知识或报告呼吸系统疾病存在相应效应。研究结果表明，将地理邻近性作为社会接触的代理变量可能掩盖重要的信息传播渠道，并导致研究者遗漏有意义的溢出效应。

url:db568bc1e46db2e4.abstract: We consider demand function competition with a finite number of agents and private information. We show that any degree of market power can arise in the unique equilibrium under an information structure that is arbitrarily close to complete information. Regardless of the number of agents and the correlation of payo¤ shocks, market power may be arbitrarily close to zero (the competitive outcome) or arbitrarily large (so there is no trade). By contrast, price volatility is always lower than the variance of the aggregate shock across all information structures. Alternative trading mechanisms lead to very distinct bounds as a comparison with Cournot competition establishes.
url:db568bc1e46db2e4.abstract_zh: 我们考虑在有限数量代理人及私人信息条件下的需求函数竞争。我们证明，在任意接近完全信息的信息结构下，唯一均衡中可出现任意程度的市场势力。无论代理人数量多少以及收益冲击的相关性如何，市场势力可能任意接近于零（竞争性结果），也可能任意大（以至于无交易发生）。相比之下，价格波动性在所有信息结构下始终低于总冲击的方差。与古诺竞争的比较表明，不同的交易机制会导致截然不同的界限。

url:dbbf5bafcc19486a.abstract: Expectations are typically modeled as functions of an agent’s information set. Using preregistered evidence, we show that beliefs depend instead on the information agents retrieve when forming them. Even after observing identical histories of inflation or stock returns, individuals recall different observations, and their beliefs track what they retrieve. Selective recall therefore generates disagreement, within-person belief instability, and heterogeneity in subjective uncertainty without any new information. We formalize these patterns in a parsimonious model in which agents store observed signals, retrieve each only probabilistically, and update optimally using recalled rather than objectively available information. The model yields sharp predictions for how beliefs vary with the composition of stored information, recall probabilities, and contextual cues. Large-scale experiments that hold information fixed and intervene only after exposure confirm these predictions, while survey evidence on macroeconomic and financial expectations supports their external relevance. Disagreement, instability, and uncertainty are thus structural features of belief formation rather than mere measurement error.
url:dbbf5bafcc19486a.abstract_zh: 预期通常被建模为个体信息集的函数。基于预注册实验证据，我们发现信念实际上取决于个体在形成预期时所提取的信息。即便观察完全相同的通胀或股票回报历史序列，不同个体回忆起的观测值也存在差异，而他们的信念恰恰与所回忆的内容保持一致。因此，选择性记忆会在无任何新信息输入的情况下，引发个体间信念分歧、个体内信念波动以及主观不确定性的异质性。我们通过一个简约模型将这些规律形式化：在该模型中，个体存储观测信号，仅以概率方式提取每个信号，并基于回忆信息（而非客观可用信息）进行最优更新。该模型对信念如何随存储信息构成、回忆概率及情境线索变化提供了精准预测。在固定信息集且仅在信息暴露后实施干预的大规模实验中，这些预测得到验证；而关于宏观经济与金融预期的调查证据则支持其外部有效性。由此表明，分歧、波动与不确定性是信念形成的结构性特征，而非单纯的测量误差。
url:dbbf5bafcc19486a.title: DP21766 Belief Disagreement, Instability, and Uncertainty under Stochastic Recall

url:dbe6659893475a85.abstract_zh: 在2010年金融危机期间，葡萄牙政府对其处方药报销制度实施了一系列改革。随后的三年里，零售药店中每位药剂师的人均附加值下降了三分之一，这反映了仿制药替代率的上升及处方药允许加成率的降低。这一巨大冲击导致在职药剂师薪酬削减，并为新入职者引入了两级薪酬体系，而就业增长几乎没有或完全没有放缓。我们利用来自“Quadros de Pessoal”数据库的详细纵向记录，结合集体谈判协议及企业层面的数据进行分析。

url:dc019968c0382f4f.abstract: This paper examines how acute pollution exposure in historical London (1892–1919) affected child health. I proxy acute, extreme pollution exposure using daily data on fog events, which reflect meteorological conditions where pollution emitted in the city was not dispersed across space leading to a sharp spike in pollution. I also use rich individual-level data on child health drawn from the Queen Charlotte Hospital, a maternity hospital, and the Foundling Hospital, an orphanage. I find no effect of pollution exposure at birth on birth or growth outcomes or on upper respiratory morbidity. However, exposure on the day of birth had persistent effects on health, increasing mortality risk in childhood and adolescence from respiratory diseases and raising incidence, prevalence and sickness duration of influenza and measles. There was no persistent effect of in utero and postnatal pollution exposures. These mixed results show that extreme pollution at birth had lasting impacts on specific, but also limited, dimensions of child health.
url:dc019968c0382f4f.abstract_zh: 本文考察了历史时期伦敦（1892-1919年）急性污染暴露对儿童健康的影响。我利用每日雾事件数据作为急性极端污染暴露的代理指标，这些雾事件反映了城市排放的污染物未能扩散至空间的气象条件，导致污染急剧飙升。同时，我采用了来自皇后夏洛特医院（一家妇产医院）和育婴堂医院（一家孤儿院）的丰富个体层面儿童健康数据。研究发现，出生时的污染暴露对出生结果、生长结果或上呼吸道发病率无显著影响。然而，出生当日的暴露对健康产生了持续性影响，增加了儿童期及青春期因呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡风险，并提高了流感和麻疹的发病率、患病率及病程持续时间。宫内及产后污染暴露未显示出持续性效应。这些混合结果表明，出生时的极端污染对儿童健康的特定维度产生了持久影响，但影响范围有限。
url:dc019968c0382f4f.title: Born in smog: immediate and persistent health consequences of acute air pollution exposure in historical London, 1892–1919
url:dc019968c0382f4f.title_zh: 生于雾霾：历史伦敦急性空气污染暴露的即时与持久健康后果，1892-1919

url:dc0b0c7d59cf591a.abstract: This paper presents results from a theory-guided experiment on fertilizer adoption among Ugandan farmers, finding that there exists a group of farmers with high returns to fertilizer, who would not adopt at the market price but can be induced to adopt with a 30% subsidy. Furthermore, consistent with adoption frictions due to liquidity constraints, the results indicate that a cash transfer is sufficient to eliminate the need for subsidies. These findings tie into broader ideas on second-best policymaking (Lipsey and Lancaster, 1956) and have important implications for fertilizer policy in Africa.
url:dc0b0c7d59cf591a.abstract_zh: 本文通过一项理论指导的实验，探讨了乌干达农民采用化肥的情况。研究发现，存在一群对化肥有高回报率的农民，他们在市场价格下不会采用化肥，但通过30%的补贴可以促使其采用。此外，与流动性约束导致的采用摩擦相一致，结果表明，现金转移足以消除补贴的需求。这些发现与次优政策制定的更广泛理念（Lipsey和Lancaster，1956）相呼应，并对非洲的化肥政策具有重要意义。

url:dc1ffbf8de37a5f3.abstract: We use the time series variation in the World Bank's ``distance to frontier'' estimates of the ease of doing business to assess the effects of changes in this variable on real GDP per capita. The use of Vector Autoregression techniques allows us to identify shocks to the ease of doing business that are initially uncorrelated with GDP, thus addressing an important endogeneity problem that affects the cross-sectional literature on this topic. The results are surprising. We report a robust finding that improvements to the ease of doing business have at least a temporary negative impact on GDP and find little evidence for a positive effect in the years following these improvements.
url:dc1ffbf8de37a5f3.abstract_zh: 我们利用世界银行“距离前沿”指标中关于营商环境便利度的时间序列变化，来评估该变量变动对实际人均GDP的影响。通过采用向量自回归技术，我们能够识别出与GDP初始不相关的营商环境便利度冲击，从而解决了该领域横截面研究中存在的重要内生性问题。结果令人意外。我们报告了一个稳健的发现：营商环境便利度的改善至少对GDP产生暂时性的负面影响，并且在改善后的几年内，几乎没有证据表明存在正面效应。

url:dc35c4e8f6990fab.abstract: We examine the importance of hospital quality, patient selection, and congestion in affecting equilibrium health outcomes, using Covid-19 pandemic data. Our main outcome is mortality, controlling for unobserved selection with distance instruments. Intensive care unit strain increased hospital mortality: without congestion, deaths would fall 9.6%. Patients value hospitals with high baseline quality, but their choices did not reflect capacity strain information. Equilibrium counterfactuals show that if patients were informed about capacity strain and believed quality signals were more precise, deaths would drop 3.8%. However, using more precise information but not accounting for congestion would cause Covid-19 deaths to rise 3.8%.
url:dc35c4e8f6990fab.abstract_zh: 我们利用新冠疫情数据，考察了医院质量、患者选择及拥挤程度对均衡健康结果的影响。主要结局指标为死亡率，并通过距离工具变量控制未观测到的选择偏差。重症监护病房的负荷增加了医院死亡率：若无拥挤，死亡人数将下降9.6%。患者倾向于选择基线质量较高的医院，但其选择并未反映容量压力信息。均衡反事实分析显示，若患者获知容量压力信息并认为质量信号更为精确，死亡人数将减少3.8%。然而，若仅使用更精确的信息而未考虑拥挤因素，则会导致新冠死亡人数上升3.8%。

url:dd08310080d4e638.abstract: In view of long-standing weaknesses in Greece’s labour markets, several labour market reforms were implemented during the economic adjustment programmes with two objectives. Firstly, to support the economy’s adjustment through more flexible labour markets and secondly, to enhance gains in cost competitiveness. In relation to their objectives, we find evidence that reforms largely fulfilled the second objective and partially the first, albeit left mostly unaddressed some of the long-standing weaknesses, such as low participation rate and high tax wedge. The analysis is backed by two distinct but complementary approaches. From a micro-founded analysis, while the 2014 reduction in social security contributions positively affected incentives for official sector labour participation, those appear to have decreased cumulatively during the overall programme period. From a top-down macroeconomic perspective, findings suggest that Greece’s 2012 labour market reforms had a positive impact on reducing the Unit Labour Cost (ULC), increasing the use of flexible forms of employment, slowing down unemployment rate dynamics and slightly accelerating employment growth trends. At the same time, it appears that the 2012 reforms did not improve labour participation rates, while they increased average working hours and inequality.
url:dd08310080d4e638.abstract_zh: 鉴于希腊劳动力市场长期存在的薄弱环节，经济调整计划期间实施了一系列劳动力市场改革，旨在实现两个目标：首先，通过提高劳动力市场的灵活性来支持经济调整；其次，增强成本竞争力的提升。就这些目标而言，我们发现改革在很大程度上实现了第二个目标，部分实现了第一个目标，但多数长期存在的问题仍未得到解决，如低参与率和高税收楔子。该分析基于两种不同但互补的方法。从微观基础分析来看，尽管2014年降低社会保障缴款对正规部门劳动力参与的激励产生了积极影响，但在整个计划期间，这些激励似乎累计下降。从自上而下的宏观经济视角来看，研究结果表明，希腊2012年的劳动力市场改革对降低单位劳动力成本（ULC）、增加灵活就业形式的使用、减缓失业率动态以及略微加速就业增长趋势产生了积极影响。同时，2012年的改革似乎并未改善劳动力参与率，反而增加了平均工作时间和不平等现象。
url:dd08310080d4e638.title: Evaluating the impact of labour market reforms in Greece during 2010-2018
url:dd08310080d4e638.title_zh: 评估2010-2018年希腊劳动力市场改革的影响

url:dd0f7ce2afd4c899.abstract: Large stocks of public and external debt tempt policymakers to extract resources from their creditors. This article characterizes three broad forms of financial repression that serve this purpose. The first consists of direct taxation of the financial sector through levies on financial transactions, banks’ income, or pension-fund assets. The second is a sudden and sufficiently persistent devaluation of the currency. The third raises the demand for the non-monetary services provided by different types of government liabilities while keeping their supply scarce, thereby creating yield discounts. Reviewing historical experience, including recent years, the article concludes that each of these revenue sources can occasionally be large, but that policies designed to exploit them often fail. Financial repression is an alluring but ultimately illusory temptation: yielding to it typically generates substantial efficiency losses while producing only limited revenue.
url:dd0f7ce2afd4c899.abstract_zh: 大量的公共和外债存量诱使政策制定者从债权人那里攫取资源。本文刻画了服务于这一目的的三种广泛形式的金融压制。第一种是通过对金融交易、银行收入或养老基金资产征税，对金融部门进行直接课税。第二种是货币突然且足够持久的贬值。第三种是在保持政府各类负债供给稀缺的同时，提升对其非货币服务的需求，从而产生收益率折价。回顾历史经验，包括近年来的情况，本文得出结论：这些收入来源每一种偶尔都可能规模可观，但旨在利用它们的政策往往以失败告终。金融压制是一种诱人但最终虚幻的诱惑：屈服于它通常会产生巨大的效率损失，而仅带来有限的收入。
url:dd0f7ce2afd4c899.title: Financial Repression in the XXIst Century

url:dd2c85a1567fee23.abstract: Governments around the world are increasingly mandating the digitalisation of business records, yet little is known about the effects of these policies beyond tax compliance. This column discusses how mandatory electronic invoicing reshapes credit markets by changing the information available to lenders. The evidence shows that eInvoicing reallocates credit toward firms that already rely on invoice-based financing and away from other firms, as banks become better at assessing the credit risk of the former relative to the latter.
url:dd2c85a1567fee23.abstract_zh: 世界各国政府日益强制推行商业记录数字化，然而，除税收合规外，这些政策的影响鲜为人知。本文探讨了强制电子发票如何通过改变贷款方可获取的信息来重塑信贷市场。证据表明，电子发票将信贷重新配置给已依赖发票融资的企业，而减少对其他企业的信贷，因为银行在评估前者相对于后者的信用风险方面变得更加擅长。
url:dd2c85a1567fee23.title: Digitalisation and credit markets: Evidence from eInvoicing
url:dd2c85a1567fee23.title_zh: 数字化与信贷市场：来自电子发票的证据

url:dd359ce1b348ccf6.abstract: Little is known about the impact on small-scale enterprises of a large negative shock that destroys assets and disrupts local markets. We document the short- and long-run impacts of the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami using longitudinal household survey data. We leverage topography-driven variation in exposure to the tsunami in coastal Aceh and North Sumatra, Indonesia. There are large short-run declines in business ownership, real profits, and real business assets among those exposed to the tsunami relative to comparison individuals who were not directly exposed. The gap in ownership rates disappears within two years in the non-agricultural sector but persists for 15 years in the agricultural sector. Profits and business assets of the exposed remain substantially lower through the long-term. Tsunami exposure led to increased short-duration transitions into and out of business ownership. Housing aid is linked to higher rates of non-agricultural business ownership and profits.
url:dd359ce1b348ccf6.abstract_zh: 关于大规模负面冲击对小型企业的影响——这种冲击会摧毁资产并扰乱当地市场——目前所知甚少。我们利用纵向家庭调查数据，记录了2004年印度洋海啸的短期与长期影响。我们借助地形驱动的暴露差异，分析了印度尼西亚亚齐省和北苏门答腊省沿海地区受海啸影响的程度。与未直接暴露的对照组个体相比，受海啸影响的个体在商业所有权、实际利润和实际商业资产方面出现了显著的短期下降。非农业部门的商业所有权差距在两年内消失，但农业部门的差距持续了15年。受冲击者的利润和商业资产在长期内仍显著较低。海啸暴露导致商业所有权的短期进出频率增加。住房援助与非农业商业所有权及利润率的提高相关。
url:dd359ce1b348ccf6.title: Reconstruction following Destruction: Entrepreneurship in the Aftermath of a Natural Disaster
url:dd359ce1b348ccf6.title_zh: 毁灭后的重建：自然灾害后的创业活动

url:dd5c1c0094674c61.abstract: Public employment guarantee schemes, which channeled graduates into lifetime positions in the civil service and state-owned enterprises, were central to state-led industrialization across the postcolonial world, yet they have remained far less studied than temporary workfare programs. This paper provides the first causal estimates of their labor market effects, exploiting the Arab Republic of Egypt's archetypal public employment guarantee, which from the early 1960s guaranteed public sector jobs to secondary and university graduates without competitive examination. The paper measures district-level exposure by secondary school supply on the eve of the reform (1959/60) and links it to individual-level census microdata from 1986, 1996, and 2006. Using an event-study design with continuous treatment intensity, the analysis compares cohorts that differed in age at the time of the public employment guarantee's introduction across districts with differing pre-reform school supply. The findings show that the public employment guarantee reallocated urban male wage employment away from the private sector and toward state-owned enterprises, with no comparable shift in rural districts, where state-owned enterprises were largely absent. The reallocation was concentrated in manufacturing and high-skilled white-collar occupations, consistent with the policy channeling educated workers into sectors that were central to the state's industrialization drive. The paper finds little evidence that the public employment guarantee raised educational attainment, indicating that it primarily redirected an already growing pool of educated workers rather than expanding the supply of schooling.
url:dd5c1c0094674c61.abstract_zh: 公共就业保障计划是后殖民世界国家主导工业化的核心举措，它将毕业生引入公务员和国有企业的终身职位，但相较于临时工作福利计划，其研究程度远为不足。本文首次对其劳动力市场效应进行因果估计，利用阿拉伯埃及共和国的典型公共就业保障制度——自20世纪60年代初起，该制度保证中学和大学毕业生无需竞争性考试即可获得公共部门职位。本文以改革前夕（1959/60年）的中学供给衡量地区级暴露程度，并将其与1986年、1996年和2006年的人口普查个体微观数据相关联。采用连续处理强度的事件研究设计，分析比较了在公共就业保障制度引入时年龄不同的队列，这些队列分布在改革前学校供给存在差异的地区。研究结果表明，公共就业保障将城市男性工资就业从私营部门重新配置到国有企业，而在国有企业基本缺失的农村地区则未出现类似转变。这种重新配置集中于制造业和高技能白领职业，与政策将受教育工人引导至国家工业化核心部门的逻辑一致。本文未发现公共就业保障显著提高教育程度的证据，表明其主要重新引导了本已增长的受教育工人群体，而非扩大教育供给。
url:dd5c1c0094674c61.title: Labor Market Effects of Public Employment Guarantee
url:dd5c1c0094674c61.title_zh: 公共就业保障的劳动力市场效应

url:dd6fd901f9334ff2.abstract: The literature assessing the effects of transportation infrastructure on how people and economic activity distribute themselves across a system of cities has three main parts. The theoretical literature makes robust predictions about how transportation infrastructure affects the internal structure of cities, but for systems of cities, theory does not let us rule much out. The city-level empirical literature establishes that improved urban transportation infrastructure causes suburban migration, but has only a small impact on city population. This literature is less helpful for understanding the effects of transportation infrastructure on the way people are distributed across a system of cities, but has made some progress. The small empirical literature looking at how transportation infrastructure affects systems of cities using cross-country data remains underdeveloped and is inconclusive.
url:dd6fd901f9334ff2.abstract_zh: 评估交通基础设施如何影响人口与经济活动在城市体系中的分布，相关文献主要包含三个部分。理论文献对交通基础设施如何影响城市内部结构做出了稳健的预测，但对于城市体系而言，理论并未能排除太多可能性。城市层面的实证研究表明，城市交通基础设施的改善会导致郊区迁移，但对城市人口规模的影响较小。这类文献在理解交通基础设施如何影响人口在城市体系中的分布方面帮助有限，但已取得一定进展。利用跨国数据研究交通基础设施如何影响城市体系的少量实证文献仍不成熟，且结论尚无定论。
url:dd6fd901f9334ff2.title: Transportation Infrastructure and Urban and Regional Development
url:dd6fd901f9334ff2.title_zh: 交通基础设施与城市及区域发展

url:dd9010e2f31d4f0d.abstract: Our results on the relationship between R&D spillovers and cooperation in R&D suggest that it is necessary to distinguish different aspects of external information flows. We construct firm-specific measures of incoming spillovers and appropriability from survey data on Belgian manufacturing firms. Incoming spillovers measure the importance of publicly available information for the innovation process of the firm. Appropriability is defined as the effectiveness of several protection mechanisms for appropriating the benefits of successful innovations. The decision to cooperate with research institutes is mainly affected by the level of incoming spillovers, while appropriability plays an important role for cooperating with suppliers or customers. Furthermore, we analyze what determines the levels of incoming spillovers and appropriability, including a possible simultaneous relation with cooperative agreements in R&D.
url:dd9010e2f31d4f0d.abstract_zh: 关于研发溢出与研发合作之间关系的研究结果表明，有必要区分外部信息流的不同方面。我们利用比利时制造业企业的调查数据，构建了企业层面的流入溢出与可占有性指标。流入溢出衡量的是公开可用信息对企业创新过程的重要性，而可占有性则定义为多种保护机制在获取成功创新收益方面的有效性。与科研机构合作的决策主要受流入溢出水平的影响，而与供应商或客户合作时，可占有性则起着重要作用。此外，我们分析了影响流入溢出与可占有性水平的因素，包括其与研发合作协议之间可能存在的同期关系。
url:dd9010e2f31d4f0d.title: R&D Cooperation and Spillovers: Some Empirical Evidence
url:dd9010e2f31d4f0d.title_zh: 研发合作与溢出效应：若干经验证据

url:ddb210b6252d080e.abstract: I study how the production network shapes monetary policy transmission to prices. Using U.S. data, I show that industries farther upstream from final demand exhibit larger cumulative price responses to monetary shocks, while downstream industries absorb shocks through output. A calibrated multi-sector New Keynesian model rationalizes these patterns: upstream sectors, which sell predominantly to other firms, reprice more frequently and therefore exhibit less price rigidity. A counterfactual decomposition of the price response shows that this heterogeneity in price rigidity---rather than cost-cascade propagation through input-output linkages---is the primary driver of the cross-sectional responses. The upstreamness differential is strongly asymmetric, large following expansionary shocks but nearly absent following contractionary ones, consistent with asymmetric price rigidity compounding across production stages. Together, these findings suggest that monetary policy
url:ddb210b6252d080e.abstract_zh: 本文研究生产网络如何塑造货币政策向价格的传导机制。基于美国数据，我发现距离最终需求越远的上游行业，其价格对货币冲击的累积响应幅度越大，而下游行业则通过产出吸收冲击。一个经过校准的多部门新凯恩斯模型解释了这一模式：上游行业主要向其他企业销售产品，其调价频率更高，因此价格刚性更弱。对价格响应的反事实分解表明，这种价格刚性的异质性——而非通过投入产出链的成本级联传导——是行业间价格响应差异的主要驱动因素。上游度差异呈现显著非对称性：在扩张性冲击后效应显著，而在紧缩性冲击后几乎消失，这与价格刚性在生产阶段间叠加放大的非对称特征一致。综合来看，这些发现表明货币政策
url:ddb210b6252d080e.title: Production Networks and the (Asymmetric) Transmission of Monetary Policy
url:ddb210b6252d080e.title_zh: 生产网络与货币政策的（非对称）传导

url:ddc052bf33033378.title_zh: 非信贷劳动力培训、行业证书与劳动力市场结果

url:ddcaee6d4a8b7f17.abstract: This paper examines the employment effects of multinational enterprises (MNEs) in Mexico, focusing on the labor market impacts of foreign tariff increases during 2018-2019. Using data from Mexicos National Survey of Occupations and Employment (ENOE) for 2014-2023 combined with sector-level tariff exposure measures based on Fajgelbaum et al. (2024), we construct a quarterly city-sector panel distinguishing employment in MNEs and domestic firms. We analyze employment outcomes across worker characteristics (education, age, gender) and firm attributes (size and location). Results indicate a positive employment effect in MNEs within the sectors most affected by the tariff increases, particularly for highly educated workers and small establishments. In contrast, there is no clear evidence of significant effects on wages.
url:ddcaee6d4a8b7f17.abstract_zh: 本文研究了墨西哥跨国企业的就业效应，重点关注2018-2019年外国关税上调对劳动力市场的影响。利用2014-2023年墨西哥国家职业与就业调查（ENOE）数据，结合基于Fajgelbaum等人（2024）构建的行业层面关税暴露指标，我们构建了一个区分跨国企业与国内企业就业的季度城市-行业面板数据。我们分析了不同工人特征（教育程度、年龄、性别）和企业属性（规模与区位）下的就业结果。结果表明，在受关税上调影响最大的行业中，跨国企业呈现出正向就业效应，尤其体现在高学历工人和小型企业中。相比之下，工资方面未发现显著影响的明确证据。
url:ddcaee6d4a8b7f17.title: Multinational Enterprises and Employment in Mexico
url:ddcaee6d4a8b7f17.title_zh: 跨国企业与墨西哥就业

url:ddce865831d7f3cf.title: Worker-Side Discrimination: Beliefs and Preferences
url:ddce865831d7f3cf.title_zh: 工人侧歧视：信念与偏好

url:dde02777212acce5.abstract: We study how the U.S.-China trade war affected manufacturing activity in third countries using a novel plant-level dataset covering millions of establishments in 50 major economies, including aliates of more than 200,000 multinational enterprises (MNEs). Combining establishment-level data with detailed tariff information, we estimate the effects of U.S. and Chinese punitive bilateral output and input tari s on sales, employment, and establishments across countries, industries, and stages of production. We find that third-country effects of the trade war are highly heterogeneous and largely offsetting, yielding moderately negative net effects overall. Most of the adjustment is driven by multinational enterprises reallocating activity across affiliate networks, while domestic firms respond much less.
url:dde02777212acce5.abstract_zh: 我们利用一项涵盖50个主要经济体中数百万家企业的新型工厂级数据集，包括超过20万家跨国企业（MNEs）的关联公司，研究了中美贸易战如何影响第三国的制造业活动。结合工厂级数据与详细的关税信息，我们估算了美国和中国惩罚性双边产出及投入关税对各国、各行业及各生产阶段销售、就业和工厂数量的影响。我们发现，贸易战对第三国的影响高度异质且大体相互抵消，总体净效应为适度负面。大部分调整由跨国企业在其关联网络间重新配置活动所驱动，而国内企业的反应则相对较小。
url:dde02777212acce5.title: DP21855 The U.S.-China Trade War and the Geography of Global Production
url:dde02777212acce5.title_zh: DP21855 中美贸易战与全球生产的地理格局

url:dde6a12a58ac9bf2.abstract: How do shifts in the global balance of power shape the world economy? We propose a theory of alignment-based "hegemonic globalization,â€ built on two central premises: countries differ in their preferences over policies (such as the rule of law or regulatory frameworks) and trade between any two countries increases with the degree of alignment in these policies. Hegemons promote policy alignment and thereby facilitate deeper trade integration. A unipolar world, dominated by a single hegemon, tends to support globalization. However, the transition to a multipolar world can trigger fragmentation, which is particularly costly for the declining hegemon and its closest allies. To test the theory, we use international treaties as a proxy for alignment and compile a novel "Global Treaty Database,â€ covering 77,000 agreements signed between 1800 and 2020. Consistent with the theory, we find that hegemons account for a disproportionate share of global treaty activity and that treaty-signing is a leading indicator of increasing bilateral trade.
url:dde6a12a58ac9bf2.abstract_zh: 全球权力格局的变迁如何塑造世界经济？本文提出一种基于政策协调的"霸权全球化"理论，其核心前提有二：各国对政策（如法治体系或监管框架）存在偏好差异，且两国间的贸易规模随政策协调程度提升而扩大。霸权国通过推动政策协调促进贸易深度融合。由单一霸权主导的单极世界往往有利于全球化进程，但向多极世界的转型可能引发体系碎片化，这对衰落中的霸权国及其核心盟友造成的代价尤为高昂。为验证该理论，我们以国际条约作为政策协调的代理变量，构建了涵盖1800年至2020年间7.7万项协定的新型"全球条约数据库"。实证结果与理论预测一致：霸权国在全球条约活动中占据不成比例的份额，且条约签署是双边贸易增长的先行指标。
url:dde6a12a58ac9bf2.title: Hegemonic Globalization

url:de0bdf11f09c5602.abstract: We fine-tune a large language model on expert ratings to construct a content-based, article-level measure of news slant, applied to the near universe of articles (∼1 million) published online by the top ∼100 U.S. outlets in 2019. 70% of the variation in slant occurs within rather than across outlets, leaving wide scope for within-outlet ideological selection. Consistent with this, polarization in news consumption on Facebook—the gap in average slant between articles Republicans and Democrats consume—equals 89% of the distance between the average New York Times and Fox News article and is 53% larger than outlet-level measures imply.
url:de0bdf11f09c5602.abstract_zh: 我们基于专家评分对大型语言模型进行微调，构建了一个基于内容、文章层面的新闻倾向度量指标，并将其应用于2019年美国前约100家媒体在线发布的近全部文章（约100万篇）。倾向性变异的70%发生在媒体内部而非媒体之间，这为媒体内部的意识形态选择留下了广阔空间。与此一致的是，Facebook上新闻消费的两极分化——共和党人与民主党人所消费文章的平均倾向差距——相当于《纽约时报》与福克斯新闻平均文章之间差距的89%，且比媒体层面度量所暗示的差距大53%。
url:de0bdf11f09c5602.title: DP19807 Article-level Slant and Polarization of News Consumption on Social Media
url:de0bdf11f09c5602.title_zh: 社交媒体新闻消费的文章级倾向与极化研究

url:de2d64dd3dd24f24.title_zh: 印度女性继承权的政治回报

url:de35a6cb9e8848e9.abstract: The US government’s demand for bank deposits is large and volatile and takes the form of the Treasury General Account (TGA) at the Federal Reserve. I study drivers of TGA volatility and how the Federal Reserve should adjust its balance sheet in response to this volatility. Using interest rate control, control of the Fed’s overall policy stance, and communication as criteria, an approach of backing the TGA with Treasury bills (or other short-maturity assets) and adjusting bill holdings with TGA fluctuations outperforms the current ample reserves policy of letting reserves plus overnight reverse repo balances adjust passively to TGA changes.
url:de35a6cb9e8848e9.abstract_zh: 美国政府对于银行存款的需求规模庞大且波动剧烈，其表现形式为美联储的财政部总账户（TGA）。我研究了TGA波动的驱动因素，以及美联储应如何调整其资产负债表以应对这种波动。以利率控制、美联储整体政策立场的掌控以及沟通作为标准，采用以国库券（或其他短期资产）支持TGA，并根据TGA波动调整国库券持有量的方法，优于当前允许准备金加隔夜逆回购余额被动适应TGA变化的充足准备金政策。
url:de35a6cb9e8848e9.title: DP21885 Fluctuations in the Treasury General Account and their effect on the Fed’s balance sheet
url:de35a6cb9e8848e9.title_zh: DP21885 财政部一般账户的波动及其对美联储资产负债表的影响

url:de55204f17e91d65.title: A New Keynesian Phillips curve estimation for a small open economy in the presence of structural changes: empirical evidence from Turkey
url:de55204f17e91d65.title_zh: 结构变化下小型开放经济体的新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线估计：来自土耳其的经验证据

url:de6d6019ca37ab54.abstract: Long-term care is costly. About 45 percent of 65-year-old Americans will require formal long-term care assistance during their lifetime and one in twelve will incur out-of-pocket expenses of $200,000 or more. Surprisingly, only 10 percent of retirees have private long-term care insurance. We use a quantitative structural model to show that an obstacle to increasing coverage is disagreement across the income distribution: scaling back Medicaid expands the private market and benefits the affluent but imposes large welfare losses on the poor, while universal public insurance does the opposite. We then show that making Medicaid the primary rather than the secondary payer of longterm care costs, while retaining its means tests, raises welfare for nearly all Americans. Private insurers respond by offering smaller, more profitable policies, and total coverage against long-term care risk rises with only a modest increase in public expenditures.
url:de6d6019ca37ab54.abstract_zh: 长期护理成本高昂。约45%的65岁美国人在其一生中将需要正式的长期护理援助，且每12人中就有1人将承担20万美元或以上的自付费用。令人惊讶的是，仅有10%的退休人员拥有私人长期护理保险。我们运用定量结构模型表明，扩大覆盖面的一个障碍在于收入分配上的分歧：缩减医疗补助计划会扩大私人市场并惠及富裕群体，但会给贫困群体带来巨大的福利损失，而全民公共保险则效果相反。随后，我们证明，若将医疗补助计划作为长期护理费用的主要支付方而非次要支付方，同时保留其经济状况调查，则几乎能提升所有美国人的福利。私人保险公司会相应提供更小但利润更高的保单，针对长期护理风险的总体保障水平将上升，而公共支出仅需适度增加。
url:de6d6019ca37ab54.title: How to Reform US Long-term Care
url:de6d6019ca37ab54.title_zh: 如何改革美国长期护理制度

url:de7f0e58aba2027c.abstract: Unlike the universal child allowances available in many advanced democracies, the largest child-specific income benefit in the United States, the Child Tax Credit (CTC), is a function of tax liabilities and earnings. As a result, it disproportionately reaches middle- and high-income families and leaves many low-income families ineligible. This study examines, from its enactment through present day, how legislative changes to the federal Child Tax Credit’s key parameters—including refundability, the earnings requirement, and the maximum credit amount—have impacted the share of children eligible for the full credit (overall and by subgroup), and how full-credit eligibility relates to the credit’s impact on child poverty and bottom-tail income inequality, including whether these three metrics move in tandem. We find that, in all years except 2021, at least 19% of children—and often, substantially more—were ineligible for the full CTC because their families had low or moderate incomes. The sizeable variation in full-credit ineligibility across years resulted from legislative changes that widened and narrowed eligibility over time. Furthermore, the credit’s impact on child poverty and income inequality does not always move in the same direction, depending on the type of policy change. Reforms that increased the credit value without substantial expansions to refundability left more children ineligible for the full credit and increased income inequality. By contrast, refundability expansions broadened full-credit eligibility while reducing poverty and inequality. Impacts on child poverty and inequality were greatest when full refundability was paired with higher credit amounts.
url:de7f0e58aba2027c.abstract_zh: 与许多发达民主国家普遍提供的儿童津贴不同，美国最大的专项儿童收入补助——儿童税收抵免（CTC）——取决于纳税义务和劳动收入。因此，该政策不成比例地惠及中高收入家庭，而许多低收入家庭则不具备资格。本研究考察了自该政策实施至今，联邦儿童税收抵免关键参数（包括可退还性、收入要求及最高抵免额度）的立法调整如何影响符合全额抵免资格的儿童比例（总体及分群体），以及全额抵免资格与该政策对儿童贫困和底层收入不平等的影响之间的关系，包括这三项指标是否同步变化。我们发现，除2021年外，所有年份中至少19%的儿童（且通常比例更高）因家庭收入较低或中等而无法获得全额CTC。不同年份间全额抵免资格的巨大差异源于立法调整随时间推移扩大或缩小了资格范围。此外，该政策对儿童贫困和收入不平等的影响并非总朝同一方向变化，具体取决于政策调整的类型。提高抵免额度但未大幅扩大可退还性的改革，导致更多儿童无法获得全额抵免，并加剧了收入不平等。相比之下，扩大可退还性则拓宽了全额抵免资格，同时减少了贫困和不平等。当全额可退还性与更高抵免额度相结合时，对儿童贫困和不平等的影响最为显著。
url:de7f0e58aba2027c.title: How the U.S. child tax credit has benefited children over time: historical trends in eligibility, poverty, and income inequality
url:de7f0e58aba2027c.title_zh: 美国儿童税收抵免如何长期惠及儿童：资格、贫困与收入不平等的历史趋势

url:de89f0c29b35057e.abstract: Worldwide, gambling can cause economic and health-related harm to individuals and communities. Policy responses to reduce these harms require evidence on the effects of features of the gambling environment. This study explores whether geographical accessibility to gambling venues impacts suicides. We construct a longitudinal spatial data set with information on the number of gambling venues and suicides in Australian neighbourhoods from 2001 to 2018, and exploit changes in accessibility induced by venue openings and closures. The closure of a gambling venue is estimated to decrease the number of suicides per year in that area by 9.8%. Effects of gambling venues in neighbouring areas are small and statistically insignificant, indicating that the relationship between venue access and suicide is concentrated close to the venue location.
url:de89f0c29b35057e.abstract_zh: 在全球范围内，赌博可能对个人和社区造成经济与健康方面的伤害。为减少这些伤害而制定的政策应对措施，需要基于赌博环境特征影响效应的证据。本研究探讨了赌博场所的地理可及性是否影响自杀行为。我们构建了一个纵向空间数据集，包含2001年至2018年间澳大利亚社区赌博场所数量及自杀情况的信息，并利用场所开业与关闭所引发的可及性变化进行分析。据估计，赌博场所的关闭可使该地区每年的自杀人数减少9.8%。邻近地区赌博场所的影响效应较小且统计上不显著，这表明赌博场所可及性与自杀之间的关系主要集中在场所位置附近。
url:de89f0c29b35057e.title: Geographical Accessibility to Gambling Venues and Suicide
url:de89f0c29b35057e.title_zh: 赌博场所的地理可达性与自杀

url:de98be851278acd4.title: Efficiency in producing life satisfaction: A stochastic frontier analysis
url:de98be851278acd4.title_zh: 生活满意度生产效率：随机前沿分析

url:de99d431b7b792cb.abstract: In this paper we compare expected loss minimization to worst-case or minimax analysis in the design of simple Taylor-style rules for monetary policy using a small model estimated for the euro area by Orphanides and Wieland (2000). We find that rules optimized under a minimax objective in the presence of general parameter and shock uncertainty do not imply extreme policy activism. Such rules tend to obey the Brainard principle of cautionary policy-making in much the same way as rules derived by expected loss minimization. Rules derived by means of minimax analysis are effective insurance policies limiting maximum loss over ranges of parameter values to be set by the policy-maker. In practice, we propose to set these ranges with an eye towards the cost of such insurance cover in terms of the implied increase in expected inflation variability.
url:de99d431b7b792cb.abstract_zh: 本文通过奥法尼德斯和维兰德（2000）估算的欧元区小型模型，比较了简单泰勒规则货币政策设计中预期损失最小化与最坏情况（即极小化极大分析）两种方法。研究发现，在存在一般参数和冲击不确定性的情况下，基于极小化极大目标优化的规则并不会导致极端的政策激进性。这类规则倾向于遵循布雷纳德审慎决策原则，其方式与通过预期损失最小化推导的规则高度相似。通过极小化极大分析推导的规则是有效的保险策略，能够将政策制定者设定的参数区间内的最大损失限制在可控范围内。在实践中，我们建议根据此类保险覆盖的成本（以隐含的预期通胀波动性增加来衡量）来设定这些参数区间。
url:de99d431b7b792cb.title: DP5019 Stochastic Optimization and Worst Case Analysis in Monetary Policy Design
url:de99d431b7b792cb.title_zh: DP5019 货币政策设计中的随机优化与最坏情况分析

url:de9dca2585cbeb80.title_zh: 极端天气事件与消费者食品反应

url:dea0e9bb276dddb7.abstract: This paper investigates the importance of the age composition for pandemic policy design. To do so, it introduces an economic framework with age heterogeneity, individual choice, and incomplete information, emphasizing the value of testing. Calibrating the model to the US Covid-19 pandemic reveals an 80% reduction in the death toll due to voluntary actions and the lockdown implemented in the US.
url:dea0e9bb276dddb7.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了年龄结构在疫情政策设计中的重要性。为此，引入了一个包含年龄异质性、个体选择及信息不完全的经济框架，并强调了检测的价值。通过将模型校准至美国新冠疫情数据，发现自愿行动与美国实施的封锁措施使死亡人数减少了80%。
url:dea0e9bb276dddb7.title: Optimal Age-based Policies for Pandemics: An Economic Analysis of Covid-19 and Beyond
url:dea0e9bb276dddb7.title_zh: 疫情最优年龄分层政策：基于新冠疫情及未来的经济学分析

url:debe556d825defdc.abstract: This paper compares two policies: trade cost reduction and firm relocation cost reduction using a three-country version of a heterogeneous-firms economic geography model, where the three countries have different market (population) size. We show how the effects of the two policies differ, in particular, for the country of intermediate size. Unless the intermediate country is very small, it will gain industry when relocation costs are reduced, but lose industry when trade costs are reduced. The smallest country loses industry in both cases, but only experiences lower welfare in the case of lower relocation costs. Thus, the ranking of the policies from the point of view of the two small and intermediate countries tends to be the opposite.
url:debe556d825defdc.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个包含三个国家的异质性企业经济地理模型，比较了贸易成本降低与企业迁移成本降低两种政策的效果。其中，三个国家具有不同的市场规模（人口规模）。我们揭示了这两种政策效应的差异，尤其聚焦于中等规模国家。除非中等规模国家非常小，否则当迁移成本降低时，该国将获得产业增长；而当贸易成本降低时，该国将面临产业流失。最小规模国家在两种情形下均会失去产业，但仅在迁移成本降低时遭遇福利下降。因此，从两个小国和中等规模国家的视角来看，两种政策的优劣排序往往呈现相反趋势。

url:decc6759c80f9519.abstract: This paper examines the causal relationship between student debt and mental health using the 2015 Dutch student finance reform as a natural experiment. The reform replaced a universal grant with income-contingent loans for higher-education students, leaving vocational students unaffected and serving as a natural comparison group. Low-income students were partly compensated through expanded targeted support. Using nationwide administrative data from Statistics Netherlands, we implement a difference-in-differences design comparing clinically diagnosed depression, anxiety, and broader mental health outcomes between higher education and vocational education students before and after the reform. We find no evidence of adverse mental health effects from the transition to debt-based financing. At the same time, students adjusted their behaviour by marginally increasing labour earnings and remaining longer in co-residence with their parents. These findings suggest that behavioural responses to the reform may have mitigated financial strain, although lenient repayment terms likely also cushioned the impact of the reform. Overall, the results indicate that the mental health impact of student debt may depend not only on financial exposure but also on institutional context and individuals' ability to adjust.
url:decc6759c80f9519.abstract_zh: 本文利用2015年荷兰学生资助改革作为自然实验，考察学生债务与心理健康之间的因果关系。该改革将高等教育学生的普遍性助学金替换为按收入比例偿还的贷款，而职业教育学生未受影响，作为自然对照组。低收入学生通过扩大定向支持得到部分补偿。利用荷兰统计局的全国行政数据，我们采用双重差分设计，比较改革前后高等教育与职业教育学生在临床诊断的抑郁症、焦虑症及更广泛心理健康结果上的差异。研究发现，转向债务型资助并未对心理健康产生不利影响的证据。同时，学生通过略微增加劳动收入并延长与父母同住的时间来调整自身行为。这些发现表明，对改革的应对行为可能缓解了经济压力，尽管宽松的还款条款也可能缓冲了改革的影响。总体而言，结果表明学生债务对心理健康的影响不仅取决于经济暴露程度，还取决于制度环境及个体的适应能力。

url:df21f401126cdfa6.abstract: Bipartisan doubts about the value of liberal trade in the US are shared by many populist European parties, who also question the value of deeper international economic integration. Yet for all the skeptical rhetoric-and real steps from the US and other advanced economies-globalization is not in retreat. Global trade continues to rise alongside global economic growth. If anything, trade has picked up since the pandemic. Widespread expectations that the global economy would fragment into rival blocks have not yet come to pass. Global flows related to corporate tax avoidance remain significant, cutting into US fiscal revenues. China's increasingly troubled domestic economy and its large-scale industrial policies risk leaving the US and its allies more, not less, reliant on Chinese supply in key sectors. The recent surge in China's trade surplus is evidence of ongoing globalization, and China's continued reliance on the world's big democracies for demand runs counter to any coherent definition of fragmentation. But increased global reliance on China for supply emerges more from China's own economic imbalances than from a healthy global division of labor. There is thus scope for policy reforms that support a healthier form of integration: notably, ending the perverse incentives in the US tax codes that undermine US production and revenues and harmonizing clean industrial policies to deepen trade among allies.
url:df21f401126cdfa6.abstract_zh: 美国两党对自由贸易价值的质疑，与许多欧洲民粹主义政党的观点不谋而合，后者同样对深化国际经济一体化的意义提出疑问。然而，尽管存在种种怀疑论调——以及美国及其他发达经济体采取的实际措施——全球化并未退潮。全球贸易持续随经济增长而攀升。若说有何变化，疫情后贸易反而有所加速。关于全球经济将分裂为对立集团的普遍预期尚未成为现实。与企业避税相关的全球资金流动依然庞大，侵蚀着美国的财政收入。中国国内经济日益面临的困境及其大规模产业政策，可能使美国及其盟友在关键领域对中国供应的依赖不减反增。近期中国贸易顺差的激增，正是全球化持续进行的体现，而中国对世界主要民主国家市场的持续依赖，与任何关于“碎片化”的严谨定义背道而驰。然而，全球对中国供应的依赖增强，更多源于中国自身的经济失衡，而非健康的全球分工。因此，政策改革存在空间，以支持一种更为健康的整合形式：尤为重要的是，消除美国税法中损害本国生产与财政收入的扭曲激励，并协调清洁产业政策，以深化盟友间的贸易往来。

url:df407a5266a52df7.abstract: Employing a novel daily dataset for 19 advanced-economy currencies over the years 1963–2025, we find that, contrary to the prevailing view, deviations from the covered interest parity (CIP) condition were both large and frequent over the long-run. The 2000–06 period immediately preceding the Global Financial Crisis when CIP held unusually closely is therefore the exception rather than the period that followed. The long-run pattern in CIP deviations maps closely to measures of intermediary frictions and FX swap market imbalances. Our findings indicate that intermediary frictions have been a persistent feature of international financial markets over the past six decades.
url:df407a5266a52df7.abstract_zh: 利用1963年至2025年间19种发达经济体货币的新型日度数据集，我们发现，与主流观点相反，长期来看，对抛补利率平价（CIP）条件的偏离既大且频繁。因此，全球金融危机前夕的2000-06年期间，CIP异常紧密成立，实属例外，而非后续时期的常态。CIP偏离的长期模式与中介摩擦及外汇掉期市场失衡的度量紧密对应。我们的研究结果表明，过去六十年间，中介摩擦一直是国际金融市场的持久特征。

url:df6bd4408bbc7634.abstract: International trade became much less multilateral during the 1930s. Previous studies, looking at aggregate trade flows, have argued that discriminatory trade policies had comparatively little to do with this. Using highly disaggregated information on the UK’s imports and trade policies, we find that policy can explain the majority of Britain’s shift towards Imperial imports in the 1930s. Trade policy mattered, a lot.
url:df6bd4408bbc7634.abstract_zh: 20世纪30年代，国际贸易的多边性显著减弱。以往基于总体贸易流量的研究认为，歧视性贸易政策对此影响相对有限。然而，利用英国进口及贸易政策的高度细分数据，我们发现政策能够解释20世纪30年代英国转向帝国进口的大部分原因。贸易政策在当时起到了至关重要的作用。

url:dfa32daf811eb771.abstract: We analyze how social-planner insurers split cost-sharing between consumers and firms (e.g. patients and doctors, or drivers and car mechanics). With no contracting frictions, firm cost-sharing can replace consumer cost-sharing other than “visit copays.” Optimal firm contracts depend on the marginal rate of substitution between consumer and firm cost-sharing. For Medicare physician services, paying physicians more up front but less as spending increases reduces risk for both patients and providers; in our calibration, net benefits are twice those from eliminating Medigap externality. For prescription drugs, a dollar of physician paperwork costs is 45–110 times more impactful than a dollar of consumer cost-sharing.
url:dfa32daf811eb771.abstract_zh: 我们分析了社会规划者保险公司如何在消费者与企业（如患者与医生，或驾驶员与汽车修理工）之间分配成本分担。在没有合同摩擦的情况下，企业成本分担可以替代除“就诊共付额”之外的消费者成本分担。最优企业合同取决于消费者与企业成本分担之间的边际替代率。对于医疗保险医生服务，预先支付医生更多费用但随支出增加而减少支付，可同时降低患者和提供者的风险；在我们的校准中，净收益是消除Medigap外部性收益的两倍。对于处方药，一美元的医生文书成本的影响是消费者成本分担一美元的45至110倍。

url:e0390822c17abccd.abstract: At the COVID-19 pandemic's onset, the federal government enacted substantial changes impacting both the revenues and expenditures connected to states' Medicaid programs through a pair of provisions in the March 2020 Families First Coronavirus Response Act. These included a 6.2 percentage point increase in states' Federal Medical Assistance Percentages (FMAP), which raised states' revenues, contingent on adherence to a continuous coverage requirement. The latter provision raised expenditures by preventing the disenrollment of individuals whose eligibility would otherwise have lapsed due to changes in income or other eligibility-relevant circumstances. While these provisions were ex-ante expected to result in expenditures and costs of similar magnitudes, the ex-post realizations remain unquantified. Nationwide, we estimate that states’ share of the continuous coverage provision's costs was $139.2 billion, which is roughly $11.0 billion less than the revenues states received, in aggregate, through increased FMAPs. Revenues and costs varied substantially across states, however, with costs exceeding revenues by as much as $594 per capita, and revenues exceeding costs by as much as $838 per capita. The baseline parameters governing the federal government's share of states' Medicaid expenditures emerge as a key driver of the extent to which the continuous coverage requirement can be viewed as an unfunded federal mandate.
url:e0390822c17abccd.abstract_zh: 在新冠疫情初期，联邦政府通过2020年3月《家庭优先新冠病毒应对法案》中的两项条款，对各州医疗补助计划的收入和支出实施了重大调整。其中一项条款将各州的联邦医疗援助比例（FMAP）提高了6.2个百分点，从而增加了各州收入，但前提是必须遵守持续参保要求。后一项条款则通过阻止因收入或其他资格相关条件变化而本应失去参保资格的个人退出计划，推高了支出。尽管这些条款在事前预期将产生规模相近的支出与成本，但事后实际结果尚未量化。在全美范围内，我们估算各州承担的持续参保条款成本为1392亿美元，这比各州通过提高FMAP获得的收入总额少约110亿美元。然而，各州的收入和成本差异显著：成本超过收入的部分最高达人均594美元，而收入超过成本的部分最高达人均838美元。决定联邦政府承担各州医疗补助支出份额的基准参数，是衡量持续参保要求能否被视为无资金支持的联邦指令的关键因素。

url:e05ab584482f9ec9.abstract: This paper examines macrofinancial linkages between property developers, financial institutions, and macroeconomic outcomes in China. Using a parsimonious vector autoregressive (VAR) model enabled by a machine learning algorithm, it quantifies how idiosyncratic shocks can propagate and be amplified across sectors, with potential implications for financial stability. Stress originating from privately owned developers and regionally focused financial institutions—though relatively limited in scale—can generate persistent spillovers through lending relationships, common exposures, shared markets, and changes in market sentiment. A decline in property prices may undermine investment, weaken consumer confidence, and adversely affect the health of both the property and financial sectors, thereby disrupting financial intermediation and weighing on broader economic growth. Policy considerations should take into account these feedback loops. Market- and exposure-based tools can be helpful for monitoring macrofinancial linkages and assessing the transmission of shocks.
url:e05ab584482f9ec9.abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国房地产开发商、金融机构与宏观经济结果之间的宏观金融关联。借助机器学习算法构建的简约向量自回归（VAR）模型，本文量化了异质性冲击如何通过部门间传导与放大，并对金融稳定产生潜在影响。源自私营开发商及区域性金融机构的压力——尽管规模相对有限——可通过信贷关系、共同风险敞口、共享市场及市场情绪变化，产生持续性的溢出效应。房价下跌可能削弱投资、打击消费者信心，并对房地产与金融部门的健康状况造成不利影响，进而扰乱金融中介功能，拖累整体经济增长。政策制定需充分考虑这些反馈循环。基于市场与风险敞口的工具，有助于监测宏观金融关联并评估冲击传导机制。

url:e07a63226db0621a.abstract: This paper analyzes how the “child penalty” associated with career interruptions for women after becoming a mother is influenced by preferences absorbed during childhood, and how the child penalty, in turn, is related to the quantity and quality (education) of her own children. Using linked administrative data on Israeli parents and children, the analysis shows that mothers who grew up in larger and more traditional families marry men from larger families, and together they have more children. Growing up with more siblings is also associated with a larger child penalty for a mother in earnings and employment, as well as in terms of commuting less and moving to “mother friendly” firms at the expense of higher wage firms. The results also indicate that the child penalty produces two opposing effects on child human capital – a negative impact due to the loss of parental income, and a positive influence of increased maternal time away from work. Overall, the evidence suggests that the family preferences and norms absorbed during childhood significantly influence a woman’s choices of spouse, fertility, and child penalty later in life – but with little overall impact on her children’s high school achievements.
url:e07a63226db0621a.abstract_zh: 本文分析了女性成为母亲后因职业中断所面临的“子女惩罚”如何受到童年时期吸收的偏好影响，以及这种子女惩罚反过来又如何与其自身子女的数量和质量（教育）相关联。利用以色列父母及其子女的关联行政数据，分析显示，在较大且更传统的家庭中成长的母亲，会与来自较大家庭的男性结婚，并且他们共同生育更多子女。成长于有更多兄弟姐妹的环境，也与母亲在收入和就业方面的更大子女惩罚相关，同时还包括通勤减少以及转向“母亲友好”型企业而牺牲高薪企业的现象。结果还表明，子女惩罚对子女人力资本产生两种相反效应——因父母收入损失带来的负面影响，以及母亲减少工作时间增加陪伴时间的正面影响。总体而言，证据表明，童年时期吸收的家庭偏好和规范显著影响女性日后对配偶、生育及子女惩罚的选择——但对其子女的高中成绩总体影响甚微。

url:e092a74f707c2b57.abstract: Pension funds have traditionally invested in global bond markets which offer predictable income and support stable portfolios. This column documents a recent shift in pension investing away from fixed-income securities and towards riskier and less liquid assets. A search for yield is an important reason for this change, along with the transition from defined benefit to defined contribution pension systems. This transformation presents opportunities for higher returns and more diversification, but also exposes bond markets and pension funds to more risk during volatile periods.
url:e092a74f707c2b57.abstract_zh: 养老基金传统上投资于全球债券市场，这些市场提供可预测的收入并支持稳定的投资组合。本文记录了养老基金投资近期从固定收益证券转向风险更高、流动性较低的资产的趋势。追求收益是这一变化的重要原因，同时伴随着从固定收益型向固定缴款型养老金体系的转变。这一转型带来了更高回报和更多元化的机会，但也使债券市场和养老基金在波动时期面临更多风险。
url:e092a74f707c2b57.title: Global pension asset allocations and debt markets
url:e092a74f707c2b57.title_zh: 全球养老金资产配置与债务市场

url:e0aff252823504cb.abstract: Innovation is a key driver of long-run economic growth. Studying innovation requires a clear view of the characteristics and behavior of the individuals who create new ideas. A general lack of rich, large-scale data has constrained such analyses. We address this by introducing a new dataset linking patent inventors to survey, census, and administrative microdata at the U.S. Census Bureau. We use this data to provide a first look at the demographic characteristics, employer characteristics, earnings, and employment dynamics of inventors. These linkages, which will be available to researchers with approved access, dramatically increase the scope of what can be learned about inventors and innovative activity. This is a preview of subscription content, log in via an institution to check access.
url:e0aff252823504cb.abstract_zh: 创新是长期经济增长的关键驱动力。研究创新需要清晰了解创造新思想的个体的特征与行为。然而，丰富的大规模数据普遍缺乏，制约了此类分析。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一个新数据集，将专利发明人与美国人口普查局的调查、人口普查及行政微观数据相连接。利用这些数据，我们首次揭示了发明人的人口统计特征、雇主特征、收入及就业动态。这些数据链接（经批准访问的研究人员可使用）将极大拓展对发明人及创新活动的认知范围。此为订阅内容预览，请通过机构登录以确认访问权限。
url:e0aff252823504cb.title: Measuring the characteristics and employment dynamics of U.S. inventors
url:e0aff252823504cb.title_zh: 美国发明者特征与就业动态的测度

url:e0b821f395246625.abstract: This paper extends the Cournot–Shapiro model to provide a tractable model of voluntary patent pool formation among standard essential patent holders. We assume that patent holders have complementary patents for a standard. We first show that the existence of a path of voluntary patent pool formation heavily depends on demand for patent licenses and that no such path exists in linear demand examples. Next, we extend our model to consist of two rival standards that are substitutable and compete à la Bertrand competition. We show that while a large patent pool benefits both patent holders and licensees, it is not provided voluntarily. Our analysis suggests that the presence of a rival standard may facilitate voluntary patent pool formation.
url:e0b821f395246625.abstract_zh: 本文扩展了古诺-夏皮罗模型，构建了一个可处理的标准必要专利持有人自愿组建专利池模型。我们假设专利持有人拥有互补性标准专利。首先证明，自愿组建专利池路径的存在性高度依赖于专利许可需求，在线性需求示例中不存在此类路径。其次，将模型扩展至包含两个可替代且进行伯川德竞争的标准。研究表明，尽管大型专利池对专利持有人和被许可方均有利，但该专利池无法通过自愿方式形成。我们的分析表明，竞争性标准的存在可能促进自愿专利池的组建。
url:e0b821f395246625.title: Patent pool formation between rival standards
url:e0b821f395246625.title_zh: 竞争标准间的专利池形成
