url:e0bab077a8e4005a.title_zh: 奶牛公牛性状的市场估值与选择指数的作用

url:e0bbc529a732a240.title: Are bank bailouts welfare improving?
url:e0bbc529a732a240.title_zh: 银行救助能否改善福利？

url:e0e64ee8185a843d.abstract: How do disruptive peers shape academic and career paths? We examine this question by leveraging the random assignment of students to classrooms in Greece and identifying the effects of peer disruptiveness on academic performance and career paths. Using suspension hours as a measure of disruptiveness, we find that students assigned to more disruptive classrooms have lower academic achievement, a higher risk of grade retention, and reduced likelihood of graduating from high school on time. They are also less likely to pursue competitive STEM fields or enroll in selective postsecondary programs. The adverse effects are more pronounced for students from low-income areas, in larger classrooms, or with fewer female peers. Using a lab-in-the-field experiment, we find that exposure to multiple disruptors, compared to just one, reduces students' study motivation, college aspirations, and readiness for science studies and careers, especially for those seated closer to disruptive peers.
url:e0e64ee8185a843d.abstract_zh: 破坏性同伴如何塑造学业与职业路径？我们利用希腊学生随机分配至班级的机制，考察同伴破坏性对学业表现及职业路径的影响。以停课小时数作为破坏性的衡量指标，我们发现，被分配至更具破坏性班级的学生，其学业成绩较低，留级风险更高，按时高中毕业的可能性降低。他们选择竞争激烈的STEM领域或进入选拔性高等教育项目的可能性也较小。不利影响在来自低收入地区、班级规模较大或女性同伴较少的学生中更为显著。通过一项实地实验，我们发现，与仅接触一名破坏者相比，接触多名破坏者会降低学生的学习动力、大学抱负及对科学学习和职业的准备程度，尤其是对座位靠近破坏性同伴的学生而言。
url:e0e64ee8185a843d.title: Disruptive Peers and Academic Performance: Short- and Long-Term Outcomes
url:e0e64ee8185a843d.title_zh: 干扰性同伴与学业表现：短期与长期结果

url:e0f3901d57acc989.abstract: We study free banking with tokenized money and ask whether competition among private issuers can deliver efficient allocations in rollover economies with and without financial frictions. Issuers finance long-term investments by issuing par-redeemable, bearer-like tokens that must be rolled over at an intermediate date. In frictionless environments, Bertrand competition can implement the first-best, but the rollover channel depends on the competitive margin: competition in yields supports active secondary trade, whereas competition in issuance discounts forces issuer-managed rollover. When some issuers secretly abscond with funds, revealed absconding triggers default and exit, concentrating savings on surviving issuers and lowering aggregate rollover needs. This funds-concentration effect shifts equilibrium refinancing rates and redistributes returns across cohorts, so even investors who enter only after misconduct is revealed bear part of its consequences. Finally, we provide a new perspective on how regulatory restrictions on token remuneration can create inefficiency, instability, and potentially market breakdown.
url:e0f3901d57acc989.abstract_zh: 本文研究代币化货币下的自由银行体系，探讨在存在与不存在金融摩擦的展期经济中，私人发行者之间的竞争能否实现有效配置。发行者通过发行以面值赎回、类似不记名形式的代币来为长期投资融资，这些代币必须在中间日期进行展期。在无摩擦环境中，伯特兰竞争可以实现最优配置，但展期渠道取决于竞争维度：收益率竞争支持活跃的二级市场交易，而发行折扣竞争则迫使发行者主导展期。当部分发行者秘密携款潜逃时，暴露的潜逃行为会引发违约和退出，从而将储蓄集中于幸存发行者，降低总体展期需求。这种资金集中效应会改变均衡再融资利率，并在不同代际间重新分配收益，因此即使在不当行为暴露后才进入市场的投资者也需承担部分后果。最后，本文为代币报酬的监管限制如何导致效率低下、不稳定乃至潜在市场崩溃提供了全新视角。
url:e0f3901d57acc989.title: DP21785 Free Banking with Tokenized Money
url:e0f3901d57acc989.title_zh: DP21785 代币化货币下的自由银行体系

url:e0fea996dc1e34a0.title: Nonresponse Bias in Household Inflation Expectations Surveys
url:e0fea996dc1e34a0.title_zh: 家庭通胀预期调查中的无应答偏差

url:e1023a1ebfba956b.abstract: We revisit fiscal sustainability through the lens of the government’s budget constraint. What constrains fiscal policy is not the stock of outstanding liabilities per se, but the fiscal cost of servicing debt. Using two centuries of U.S. fiscal data (1800–2023) and a long-run panel of advanced economies, we show that primary surpluses are systematically more closely associated with debt-service burdens, while debt ratios lose explanatory power when debt service is taken into account. Fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate, specifically when the interest-growth differential is positive. We rationalize these findings using a simple flow-based framework in which debt stabilization depends on the responsiveness of fiscal surpluses to financing pressures. The results suggest that fiscal sustainability depends less on debt thresholds than on financing regimes and governments’ ability to absorb debt-service burdens.
url:e1023a1ebfba956b.abstract_zh: 我们通过政府预算约束的视角重新审视财政可持续性问题。制约财政政策的并非未偿债务存量本身，而是偿债的财政成本。基于美国两个世纪（1800-2023年）的财政数据以及发达经济体的长期面板数据，我们表明：基本盈余与偿债负担之间存在系统性更强的关联，而当考虑偿债成本时，债务比率对财政行为的解释力显著下降。当融资条件恶化时——特别是当利率-增长率差值为正时——财政政策反应会显著增强。我们通过一个基于流量分析的简单框架对这些发现进行理论解释，该框架认为债务稳定取决于财政盈余对融资压力的响应程度。研究结果表明，财政可持续性更取决于融资机制及政府吸收偿债负担的能力，而非债务阈值本身。
url:e1023a1ebfba956b.title: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
url:e1023a1ebfba956b.title_zh: 从存量到流量：债务服务与财政可持续性

url:e10b96bd747b089f.title: Financial Inclusion via FinTech: From Digital Payments to Platform Investments
url:e10b96bd747b089f.title_zh: 金融科技推动的金融包容性：从数字支付到平台投资

url:e114b9b8916e3cba.abstract: Work requirements are a central feature of U.S. welfare program design. The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) imposes a time limit on benefit receipt for able-bodied adults without dependents (ABAWDs) who do not meet work requirements. This time limit was suspended nationally during the Great Recession and the COVID-19 pandemic, with staggered reimplementation occurring at the county level following each suspension. We construct a novel county-month panel dataset on ABAWD waiver status and pair it with American Community Survey microdata to estimate the effects of time limit reimplementation using a triple-difference design that exploits variation across counties and age groups on either side of the work requirement eligibility cutoff. We find that reimplementation significantly reduced SNAP participation among ABAWDs subject to work requirements following the Great Recession suspension and increased employment and labor force participation among these adults in both reimplementation periods. We also identify impacts on similar older adults who were not subject to the work requirements, especially in the form of reduced SNAP participation, suggesting the role of indirect costs of par- ticipation associated with work requirements. Estimates on ABAWD SNAP benefits and earned income are consistent with the participation and employment findings, and mechanism analysis suggests the participation decline is at least partly driven by ABAWDs moving to employment and exiting SNAP—the generally intended effect of work requirements.
url:e114b9b8916e3cba.abstract_zh: 工作要求是美国福利项目设计的核心特征之一。补充营养援助计划（SNAP）对不符合工作要求且无受抚养人的健全成年人（ABAWDs）领取福利设定了时间限制。这一时间限制在大萧条和新冠疫情期间在全国范围内暂停，每次暂停后各县在不同时间逐步恢复实施。我们构建了一个新颖的县-月面板数据集，涵盖ABAWD豁免状态，并将其与美国社区调查微观数据配对，利用三重差分设计估计时间限制重新实施的影响，该设计利用了各县及工作要求资格截止线两侧年龄组的差异。我们发现，在大萧条暂停后，重新实施工作要求显著降低了受工作要求约束的ABAWDs的SNAP参与率，并在两个重新实施期间提高了这些成年人的就业率和劳动力参与率。我们还识别出对不受工作要求约束的相近年龄较大成年人的影响，尤其是SNAP参与率下降，这表明工作要求相关的参与间接成本发挥了作用。关于ABAWDs的SNAP福利和劳动收入的估计结果与参与和就业发现一致，机制分析表明，参与率下降至少部分源于ABAWDs转向就业并退出SNAP——这通常是工作要求的预期效果。
url:e114b9b8916e3cba.title: The Effects of Reinstating ABAWD Work Requirements Following National Suspensions on SNAP Participation and Employment
url:e114b9b8916e3cba.title_zh: 全国暂停后恢复ABAWD工作要求对SNAP参与和就业的影响

url:e121e2da75d41504.abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model where loan securitization is an endogenous outcome in a credit market where information asymmetries lead to adverse selection across financial intermediaries. Securitization occurs when the resources saved by investors acquiring limited information about the risk-class of some borrowers outweigh the cost of being selected against by loan originators. This results in a time-varying market share of individually risk-priced loans held by banks, and of securitized loans held by the secondary market. We analyze the impact of conventional monetary policies and credit market policies in response to an increase in default risk, and discuss its welfare implications. Overall securitization allows more efficient funding of loans, at the expense of increased volatility in risky interest rates, consumption, and inflation over the business cycle.
url:e121e2da75d41504.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中贷款证券化是信贷市场中信息不对称导致金融中介机构之间逆向选择的内生结果。当投资者获取部分借款人风险等级信息所节省的资源超过其被贷款发起人逆向选择所付出的成本时，证券化便会产生。这导致银行持有的个别风险定价贷款与二级市场持有的证券化贷款的市场份额随时间动态变化。我们分析了常规货币政策与信贷市场政策在应对违约风险上升时的效果，并探讨其福利影响。总体而言，证券化能够更高效地为贷款提供资金，但代价是加剧了经济周期中风险利率、消费和通胀的波动性。
url:e121e2da75d41504.title: Prime vs. Subprime: Asymmetric Information and Equilibrium Securitization in a Business Cycle Model
url:e121e2da75d41504.title_zh: 优质与次级：商业周期模型中的信息不对称与均衡证券化

url:e12487c65ce1ee5a.abstract: Globally declining birth rates have, over the last seven decades, slowed population growth and raised average ages. This column argues that despite widespread economic pessimism, historical cross-country and US commuting zone data point to no impact of ageing populations on aggregate GDP or earnings growth. Countries with lower birth rates have higher GDP growth per working-age adult, and US commuting zones with lower birth rates have faster wage growth. The growth-reducing potential of demographic slowdowns is countered by faster technological change. While future demographic changes will occur at greater speed and scale, the economic record suggests that current pessimism is premature.
url:e12487c65ce1ee5a.abstract_zh: 过去七十年间，全球生育率持续下降，导致人口增长放缓、平均年龄上升。本文认为，尽管普遍存在经济悲观情绪，但历史跨国数据与美国通勤区数据表明，人口老龄化对总体GDP或收入增长并无显著影响。生育率较低的国家，其劳动年龄人口的人均GDP增速更高；生育率较低的美国通勤区，工资增长也更快。人口增速放缓对增长的潜在抑制作用，已被更快的技术变革所抵消。尽管未来人口结构变化的速度与规模将更为显著，但经济史实表明，当前的悲观情绪为时过早。
url:e12487c65ce1ee5a.title: Baby busts and GDP booms: Demographic change and the macroeconomy
url:e12487c65ce1ee5a.title_zh: 婴儿潮衰退与GDP繁荣：人口变迁与宏观经济

url:e13512c75f6ae067.title: Competing for influence in networks through strategic targeting
url:e13512c75f6ae067.title_zh: 通过战略目标定位在网络中竞争影响力

url:e13b592222335205.abstract: We study how supply disruptions interact with monopoly pricing, inventory management, and consumer stockpiling in a continuous-time model. Preemption incentives—consumers prefer to stock up before a price hike while the firm prefers to hike before consumers stock up—lead to an equilibrium with gradual stockpiling and endogenous uncertainty over the timing of a price hike, which can trigger a run at the disruption onset.
url:e13b592222335205.abstract_zh: 我们研究供应中断如何与垄断定价、库存管理及消费者囤积行为在连续时间模型中相互作用。抢先激励——消费者倾向于在价格上涨前囤货，而企业则倾向于在消费者囤货前提价——导致均衡中出现渐进式囤积及对涨价时点的内生不确定性，这种不确定性可能在供应中断初期引发抢购潮。
url:e13b592222335205.title: Stockups, Stockouts, and the Role for Strategic Reserves
url:e13b592222335205.title_zh: 囤货、缺货与战略储备的作用

url:e140ce9507fa2d19.title: Online platform entry and food safety risk: Evidence from the Chinese restaurant industry
url:e140ce9507fa2d19.title_zh: 在线平台进入与食品安全风险：来自中国餐饮业的证据

url:e15db948f6254cfc.abstract: After substantial growth in the 1990s and 2000s, enrollment in the U.S. Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) program has been declining since 2013. We use detailed administrative data to quantify the contributions of various factors to trends in SSDI enrollment, focusing especially on the decline in the 2010s. A statistical decomposition suggests that the vast majority of the decline in SSDI enrollment since 2013 is attributable to declines in application rates—and, to a lesser extent, award rates—within demographic groups. There is very little contribution from changes over time in demographic characteristics, eligibility, or exit from SSDI. The decline in SSDI enrollment rates is disproportionately driven by low-to-middle-skilled men who, over time, have become less likely to apply for SSDI and more likely to work. Consistent with this descriptive evidence, we present results from a causal analysis suggesting that improved labor market opportunity for less-skilled men is a key explanation for the decline in SSDI enrollment. We also investigate several other popular hypotheses for the decline in SSDI applications, including lower award rates at the appeals level, and find evidence at odds with them.
url:e15db948f6254cfc.abstract_zh: 在1990年代和2000年代经历了大幅增长后，美国社会保障残疾保险（SSDI）项目的参保人数自2013年起持续下降。我们利用详细的行政数据量化了各因素对SSDI参保趋势的贡献，重点关注2010年代的下降趋势。统计分解表明，2013年以来SSDI参保人数的下降绝大部分可归因于各人口群体内申请率的下降——以及较小程度上批准率的下降。人口特征、资格条件或退出SSDI的随时间变化对下降的贡献微乎其微。SSDI参保率的下降主要由中低技能男性群体驱动，他们随时间推移申请SSDI的可能性降低，而就业可能性上升。与这一描述性证据一致，我们通过因果分析表明，低技能男性劳动力市场机会改善是SSDI参保下降的关键解释。我们还检验了其他几种关于SSDI申请下降的流行假说（包括上诉阶段批准率降低），发现证据与这些假说相悖。
url:e15db948f6254cfc.title: Do Markets Deliver? Competition and Choice in European Healthcare Markets
url:e15db948f6254cfc.title_zh: 市场是否有效？欧洲医疗市场中的竞争与选择

url:e168cc2ea7a22e69.abstract: Real GDP per person is a widely used proxy for living standards, but it can be a poor welfare measure when new goods or quality improvements matter, when nonmarket goods are significant, and when preferences are nonhomothetic --- all of which are true in practice. We propose an alternative that is robust to these concerns: under weak conditions, the growth rate of the value of a statistical life (VSL), together with standard Euler-equation objects, identifies the growth rate of lifetime utility. The intuition is that people routinely trade off consumption against mortality risk, and their willingness to pay for small risk reductions reveals the value of remaining lifetime utility. Implementing this approach for the United States suggests that lifetime utility may have risen by more than a factor of five since 1940, whereas conventional consumption-based calculations using a stable log/CRRA flow utility imply much smaller gains, on the order of a doubling. This calculation is sensitive to measures of the growth rate of the VSL, the rate of time preference, and the interest rate. For example, if the correct interest rate is 4 percentage points higher than the T-bill rate, then lifetime utility would be measured to have declined by more than half since 1940.
url:e168cc2ea7a22e69.abstract_zh: 实际人均GDP是衡量生活水平的常用指标，但在新产品或质量改进重要、非市场商品显著以及偏好非齐次的情况下，它可能是一个不佳的福利度量——而这些情况在实践中均存在。我们提出了一种对这些担忧具有稳健性的替代方案：在较弱条件下，统计生命价值（VSL）的增长率，连同标准的欧拉方程对象，能够识别终身效用的增长率。其直觉在于，人们日常会在消费与死亡风险之间进行权衡，而他们为小幅风险降低所支付的意愿揭示了剩余终身效用的价值。将这一方法应用于美国，结果表明自1940年以来，终身效用可能增长了五倍以上，而基于稳定对数/CRRA流动效用的传统消费计算则显示增长幅度小得多，约为两倍。这一计算对VSL增长率、时间偏好率和利率的度量敏感。例如，如果正确的利率比国库券利率高出4个百分点，那么自1940年以来终身效用将被测为下降了一半以上。
url:e168cc2ea7a22e69.title: When GDP Misleads: Inferring Living Standards from the Value of a Statistical Life

url:e174b02a5d1b4cd7.abstract: The implementation and unwinding of the FFCRA's continuous coverage requirement generated historically large changes in Medicaid enrollment during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using a combination of descriptive and causal analyses, we examine the substantial cross-state differences in these changes, which remain little understood. We find that policies designed to ease unwinding frictions, as well as federal fiscal assistance to states, have little predictive power, suggesting limited roles for administrative design or liquidity constraints. Political preferences have modest predictive power during the unwinding period. Pandemic-era Medicaid expansions and more generous baseline eligibility thresholds are strongly associated with larger net enrollment gains.
url:e174b02a5d1b4cd7.abstract_zh: FFCRA连续覆盖要求的实施与解除，在COVID-19疫情期间引发了医疗补助（Medicaid）参保人数的历史性大幅变动。通过结合描述性与因果分析，我们考察了各州在这些变动中存在的显著差异，而这一差异至今仍鲜有理解。我们发现，旨在缓解解除摩擦的政策以及联邦对各州的财政援助，其预测能力甚微，这表明行政设计或流动性约束的作用有限。政治偏好仅在解除期间具有适度的预测能力。疫情期间的医疗补助扩展及更为宽松的基线资格门槛，与更大的净参保增长密切相关。
url:e174b02a5d1b4cd7.title: Understanding Cross-State Variations in Medicaid Enrollment During and After the COVID-19 Pandemic

url:e192dcc39d6ec51e.abstract: This paper studies how an unemployment-benefit reform in one member state of a monetary union affects savings, net foreign asset positions, and fiscal space across member states when households face incomplete insurance. Lower benefits reduce unemployment and increase fiscal space in the reforming country. Employed workers increase their precautionary savings to compensate for reduced public insurance. A portion of these savings is invested abroad, pushing the non-reforming country into a negative net foreign asset position and lowering its long-run consumption. Despite raising fiscal space and long-run average consumption in the reforming country, the reform may decrease ex-ante welfare because it reduces insurance and depresses consumption during the transition as households self-insure through higher savings. We discipline our proposed model with firm-level evidence on Germany’s post-reform tradable-sector expansion following the Hartz IV reform of unemployment benefits. In our simulation, this reform accounts for a substantial share of the observed post-reform open-economy adjustment, whereas the earlier wage moderation cannot explain most of the observed patterns.
url:e192dcc39d6ec51e.abstract_zh: 本文研究在一个货币联盟中，某一成员国的失业救济改革如何影响各成员国的储蓄、净外国资产头寸及财政空间，前提是家庭面临不完全保险。降低救济金减少了改革国的失业并扩大了其财政空间。就业工人增加预防性储蓄以弥补公共保险的减少。这部分储蓄的一部分投资于国外，使非改革国陷入负净外国资产头寸，并降低其长期消费。尽管改革提高了改革国的财政空间和长期平均消费，但由于减少了保险并在转型期间因家庭通过更高储蓄进行自我保险而抑制了消费，改革可能降低事前福利。我们利用德国哈茨四号失业救济改革后贸易部门扩张的企业层面证据来校准所提出的模型。在我们的模拟中，这项改革解释了观察到的改革后开放经济调整的相当大份额，而早前的工资节制则无法解释大部分观察到的模式。
url:e192dcc39d6ec51e.title: DP21866 Incomplete Insurance and Open-Economy Spillovers of Labor Market Reforms
url:e192dcc39d6ec51e.title_zh: DP21866 不完全保险与劳动力市场改革的开放经济溢出效应

url:e197afc1935993df.title: The impact of health shocks on housing instability: Evidence from urban Medicaid enrollees
url:e197afc1935993df.title_zh: 健康冲击对住房不稳定的影响：来自城市医疗补助参保者的证据

url:e19a44a4abf30234.abstract: This paper focuses on the relationship between regional agreements and the draft General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS), negotiated under the auspices of the Uruguay Round. Following a conceptual discussion of the political economy of regional as opposed to multilateral negotiations, I analyse existing data on trade and investment flows with a view to gaining some insight into the likely interest group preferences influencing the choice between alternative institutional arrangements to liberalize trade in services. Both the data and a comparison of the content of the major existing agreements suggest that service industries are more likely to see regional and multilateral liberalization as complements than substitutes.
url:e19a44a4abf30234.abstract_zh: 本文聚焦于区域协定与乌拉圭回合框架下谈判的《服务贸易总协定》（GATS）草案之间的关系。在从政治经济学角度对区域谈判与多边谈判进行概念性讨论后，我分析了现有的贸易与投资流动数据，以期洞察可能影响不同制度安排选择的利益集团偏好，从而推动服务贸易自由化。数据及对现有主要协定内容的比较均表明，服务业更可能将区域与多边自由化视为互补关系而非替代关系。
url:e19a44a4abf30234.title: DP749 Regional Versus Multilateral Liberalization of Trade in Services
url:e19a44a4abf30234.title_zh: DP749 服务贸易的区域自由化与多边自由化

url:e1a5d99993e2d07b.abstract: There is growing evidence that place-based industrial policies lead to positive economic effects. This column analyses the “Million-Rouble Plants” programme of the 1950s when the Soviet Union helped China build state-of-the-art industrial facilities. By tracking the locations that benefitted, it finds positive economic spillovers in the short and medium run. Although the Million-Rouble Plants themselves continued to thrive, the performance of other local establishments eventually declined, as increasing specialisation weakened knowledge spillovers and constrained local entrepreneurship. Policymakers may achieve more durable gains by fostering diversified local production structures that encourage knowledge spillovers, labour market resilience, and adaptation to technological and market shocks.
url:e1a5d99993e2d07b.abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，地方性产业政策能够带来积极的经济效应。本文分析了20世纪50年代苏联帮助中国建设先进工业设施的“百万卢布工厂”计划。通过追踪受益地区，研究发现该计划在短期和中期内产生了正向经济溢出效应。尽管“百万卢布工厂”本身持续繁荣，但其他本地企业的绩效最终出现下滑，原因在于日益增强的专业化削弱了知识溢出效应，并限制了本地创业活力。政策制定者若想实现更持久的收益，应培育多元化的地方生产结构，以促进知识溢出、增强劳动力市场韧性，并提升应对技术与市场冲击的适应能力。
url:e1a5d99993e2d07b.title: Place-based industrial policies in the long run
url:e1a5d99993e2d07b.title_zh: 长期视角下的地方产业政策

url:e1b2b8ba1cc865ba.abstract: Convergence is usually interpreted as evidence of catch-up: poorer economies grow faster because they are moving toward richer ones. This paper argues that the same empirical pattern can arise from a different source. If country-specific long-run trajectories shift over time, narrowing income gaps may reflect not only upward movement from below, but also adjustment from above. We develop a framework in which economies converge toward evolving rather than fixed steady-state paths, and construct empirical proxies for these paths using cross-country data. Economies above their predicted trajectories subsequently grow more slowly and are more likely to move downward within the world income distribution. Supporting evidence links positive overshooting to selected downside-adjustment episodes, especially banking-sector distress and loss of frontier position. The evidence suggests that observed convergence partly reflects compression from the top, not only catch-up from below.
url:e1b2b8ba1cc865ba.abstract_zh: 收敛通常被解读为追赶的证据：较贫穷的经济体因向较富裕经济体靠拢而增长更快。本文认为，同样的经验模式可能源于不同的原因。如果国家特定的长期轨迹随时间发生变动，收入差距的缩小可能不仅反映自下而上的追赶，也反映自上而下的调整。我们构建了一个框架，其中经济体向不断演变而非固定的稳态路径收敛，并利用跨国数据为这些路径构建经验代理指标。位于预测轨迹之上的经济体随后增长更慢，且更可能在世界收入分布中向下移动。支持性证据将正向过度偏离与特定的下行调整事件联系起来，尤其是银行业困境和前沿地位的丧失。证据表明，观察到的收敛部分反映了来自顶部的压缩，而不仅仅是来自底部的追赶。
url:e1b2b8ba1cc865ba.title: Convergence from Above: When Global Catch-Up Reflects Falling Back
url:e1b2b8ba1cc865ba.title_zh: 自上而下的趋同：当全球追赶反映为落后之时

url:e1bc02637a0283d2.abstract: We evaluate potential costs and benefits of Eastern enlargement of the EU. In addressing fiscal costs of enlargement in addition to tariff and non-tariff barriers, we arrive at important conclusions: 1) Overall, extending EU membership to Eastern applicants is more than worth its price to Austria. The (dynamic) gains from integration clearly outweigh the budgetary costs. 2) Somewhat surprisingly, the wage spread between skilled and unskilled labour is narrowed rather than widened. 3) Significant sectoral and intergenerational redistribution may nevertheless render EU enlargement difficult on political grounds, with the agricultural sector and the young losing out.
url:e1bc02637a0283d2.abstract_zh: 我们评估了欧盟东扩的潜在成本与收益。在考虑关税与非关税壁垒之外，进一步分析扩大的财政成本后，得出以下重要结论：1）总体而言，将欧盟成员资格扩展至东欧申请国对奥地利而言物超所值。一体化带来的（动态）收益明显超过预算成本。2）略令人意外的是，技能型与非技能型劳动力之间的工资差距趋于缩小而非扩大。3）然而，显著的部门间与代际再分配效应可能使欧盟东扩在政治层面面临困难，其中农业部门与年轻群体将成为利益受损方。
url:e1bc02637a0283d2.title: DP1786 Eastern Enlargement of the EU: How much is it Worth for Austria?
url:e1bc02637a0283d2.title_zh: DP1786 欧盟东扩：对奥地利价值几何？

url:e1c4aec8f21ef1a2.abstract: US labour productivity has accelerated since 2022. Output per hour grew around 2.5% per year from the end of 2022 to the start of 2026, exceeding its pre-pandemic pace by 1 percentage point. A natural conjecture is that artificial intelligence has raised production efficiency. This column argues that the data suggest otherwise. Higher utilisation – that is, more intense use of labour and capital already in place – accounts for much of the recent acceleration. AI may have contributed to the higher utilisation rate, but through strong demand and heightened uncertainty rather than through efficiency.
url:e1c4aec8f21ef1a2.abstract_zh: 自2022年以来，美国劳动生产率加速增长。从2022年底到2026年初，每小时产出年均增长约2.5%，较疫情前增速高出1个百分点。一个自然的猜想是人工智能提升了生产效率。但本专栏认为，数据表明情况并非如此。更高的利用率——即对现有劳动力和资本的更密集使用——是近期生产率加速的主要原因。人工智能可能对利用率提升有所贡献，但这是通过强劲需求和不确定性加剧实现的，而非通过效率提升。
url:e1c4aec8f21ef1a2.title: Higher utilisation explains the recent surge in productivity growth
url:e1c4aec8f21ef1a2.title_zh: 更高的利用率解释了近期生产率增长的激增

url:e1cf59d4ad89c20b.abstract: The increase in income per capita is accompanied, in virtually all countries, by two changes in the structure of the economy, namely an increase in the share of government spending in GDP and an increase in female labour force participation. This paper suggests that these two changes are causally related. We develop a growth model where the structure of the economy is endogenous so that participation in market activities and government size are causally related. Economic growth and rising incomes are accompanied by a greater incentive for women to engage in labour market activities as the opportunity cost of staying at home increases. We hypothesize that government spending decreases the cost of performing household chores such as, but not limited to, child rearing and child care so that couples decide to engage further in the labour market and chose a higher tax rate to finance more government spending. Using a wide cross-section of data for developed and developing countries, we show that higher participation by women in the labour market are indeed positively associated with larger governments. Furthermore, we investigate the causal link between the two variables using as instrumental variables a unique and novel dataset on the relative price of home appliances across OECD countries and over time. We find strong evidence of a causal link between participation in the labour market and government size: a 10 percent rise in participation in the labour market leads to a 7 to 8 percent rise in government size. This effect is robust to the country sample, time period, and a set of controls in the spirit of Rodrik (1998). The inclusion of an endogenous choice of government spending allows a considerable extension of the model in Galor and Weil (2000) so fertility can either rise or fall and phenomena like the baby boom and baby bust in Greenwood at el. (2002) can be addressed. In addition, the paper has important implications for the analysis of the secular as well as cross-country determinants of government size.
url:e1cf59d4ad89c20b.abstract_zh: 几乎所有国家的人均收入增长都伴随着经济结构的两种变化，即政府支出占GDP比重的上升和女性劳动参与率的提高。本文提出这两种变化存在因果关系。我们构建了一个经济结构内生的增长模型，使市场活动参与度与政府规模形成因果关联。随着经济增长和收入提高，女性因居家机会成本上升而更倾向于参与劳动力市场活动。我们假设政府支出降低了育儿等家务劳动成本，促使家庭选择更高税率以支持更多政府支出，从而进一步参与劳动力市场。基于发达国家与发展中国家的跨国截面数据，我们发现女性劳动参与率提高确实与政府规模扩大呈正相关。进一步地，我们利用OECD国家跨时期家电相对价格这一独特新颖数据集作为工具变量，探究两变量间的因果联系。研究证实劳动参与率与政府规模存在显著因果关系：劳动参与率每提升10%，政府规模将扩大7%-8%。该效应在罗德里克（1998）框架下对样本国家、时间跨度及控制变量组合均保持稳健。通过引入政府支出的内生选择，本文对Galor和Weil（2000）模型进行了重要拓展，使生育率既可上升也可下降，并能解释Greenwood等（2002）提出的婴儿潮与婴儿低谷现象。此外，本研究对分析政府规模的长期趋势及跨国决定因素具有重要启示。
url:e1cf59d4ad89c20b.title: Women Prefer Larger Governments: Growth, Structural Transformation and Government Size
url:e1cf59d4ad89c20b.title_zh: 女性偏好更大规模的政府：增长、结构转型与政府规模

url:e1d027b7e1f0802b.abstract: this paper we examine how central bankers communicate confidence and uncertainty in their narrative about the state of the economy when deciding policy, and how this communication relates to their policy decisions. We use text analysis techniques to construct forward and backward looking sentiment measures of policymakers' confirmation and surprise from the published Minutes of the Federal Reserve, the Bank of England and the European Central Bank. We show that the communication of confirmation and surprise has statistical power to explain monetary policy decisions, and that both types of communication convey signals. Our results suggest that policymakers signal policy easing when communicating higher uncertainty and surprise, and a lower likelihood of easing when confirming trends. The latter is explained by the intensity of the inflation topic in confirmation quotes, whereby a higher confirmation with regard to inflation indicates a higher confidence of policymakers to tighten policy.
url:e1d027b7e1f0802b.abstract_zh: 本文考察了央行行长在制定政策时如何在其对经济状况的叙述中传达信心与不确定性，以及这种沟通与其政策决策之间的关系。我们运用文本分析技术，从美联储、英格兰银行和欧洲央行的公开会议纪要中构建前瞻性和后顾性的政策制定者确认与惊喜情绪指标。研究表明，确认与惊喜的沟通在解释货币政策决策方面具有统计效力，且这两种类型的沟通均传递了信号。我们的结果显示，当沟通中体现出更高的不确定性和惊喜时，政策制定者倾向于释放政策宽松的信号；而在确认趋势时，则表明政策宽松的可能性较低。后者可通过确认性表述中通胀话题的强度来解释，即对通胀的更高确认表明政策制定者对收紧政策有更高的信心。
url:e1d027b7e1f0802b.title: Central Bank Communication of Uncertainty
url:e1d027b7e1f0802b.title_zh: 中央银行不确定性沟通

url:e24bf36e8d70e4e0.title_zh: 乌拉圭粗放型畜牧系统中可持续生产实践的偏好

url:e24bfe5bc4f68500.abstract: The erosion of the postwar international order has exposed a growing gap between the scale of contemporary global challenges and the capacity of existing governance arrangements to address them. This paper argues that the central challenge of global policymaking is no longer how to secure universal agreement among all major powers, but how to organize effective cooperation under conditions of fragmentation and partial non-cooperation. It proposes The New Alignment, a framework for “state-enabled polycentric governance” based on goal alignment, capacity alignment, and policy alignment. By orienting cooperation toward human flourishing through Solidarity, Agency, material Gain, and Environmental sustainability (SAGE), the framework provides a practical foundation for coalition-based collective action. The paper argues that future global governance will increasingly depend on Pivotal Power Coalitions operating within a broader polycentric system, enabling governments, businesses, international organizations, and civil society to coordinate around shared challenges. The New Alignment offers a pathway for transforming fragmented interdependence into cooperative pluralism and thereby provides a framework for effective global policymaking in the twenty-first century.
url:e24bfe5bc4f68500.abstract_zh: 战后国际秩序的侵蚀，暴露出当代全球挑战的规模与现有治理安排应对能力之间日益扩大的差距。本文认为，全球政策制定的核心挑战已不再是如何确保所有主要大国达成普遍共识，而是如何在碎片化与部分不合作的条件下组织有效合作。本文提出"新联盟"框架，这是一种基于目标对齐、能力对齐与政策对齐的"国家赋能的多中心治理"模式。该框架以团结、自主、物质增益与环境可持续性（SAGE）为导向，将合作聚焦于人类繁荣，为基于联盟的集体行动提供了实践基础。本文认为，未来全球治理将日益依赖在更广泛的多中心体系中运作的关键力量联盟，使政府、企业、国际组织与公民社会能够围绕共同挑战进行协调。"新联盟"为将碎片化的相互依存转化为合作多元主义提供了路径，从而为二十一世纪有效的全球政策制定提供了框架。
url:e24bfe5bc4f68500.title: Toward a New World Order: Conceiving The New Alignment
url:e24bfe5bc4f68500.title_zh: 迈向新世界秩序：构想新格局

url:e25cf49b42f29905.title: Trade Liberalisation and Agricultural Exports: Evidence From Afghanistan’s WTO Accessions
url:e25cf49b42f29905.title_zh: 贸易自由化与农产品出口：来自阿富汗加入WTO的证据

url:e2685fcf1344a7b4.abstract: This Paper uses annual data spanning 1870 to 1930 on a set of variables correlated with business conditions to construct an index of real economic activity in Switzerland. We extract an estimate of the common component of the data series using principal components analysis and the unobservable variables approach proposed by Stock and Watson (1989, 1991). The resulting index is similar to, but displays more variation over time than, that constructed by Andrist, Anderson and Williams (2000).
url:e2685fcf1344a7b4.abstract_zh: 本文利用1870年至1930年间与商业状况相关的一组变量的年度数据，构建了瑞士实际经济活动指数。我们采用主成分分析以及Stock与Watson（1989, 1991）提出的不可观测变量方法，提取了数据序列的共同成分估计值。所得指数与Andrist、Anderson和Williams（2000）构建的指数相似，但随时间呈现出更大的波动性。
url:e2685fcf1344a7b4.title: Estimates of Real Economic Activity in Switzerland, 1885-1930
url:e2685fcf1344a7b4.title_zh: 瑞士实际经济活动估算（1885-1930年）

url:e2724d7c32ad3501.abstract: The central trade-off for designing Disability Insurance (DI) is between providing insurance to those in need while maintaining incentives to work. This paper develops a novel revealed-preference approach to identify the insurance value of DI benefits. We show that comparing the DI take-up response to a change in benefits versus a change in wages identifies the insurance value. Implementing our framework in Canada, we estimate that increasing DI benefits by $1 creates an additional disincentive cost of $0.60 but creates an insurance value of $2.20. Thus, our approach suggests that DI benefits are not overly generous in the Canadian context.
url:e2724d7c32ad3501.abstract_zh: 设计残疾保险（DI）的核心权衡在于：既要为有需要者提供保障，又要维持工作激励。本文提出一种新颖的显示性偏好方法，用以识别DI福利的保险价值。研究表明，通过比较福利变化与工资变化对DI参保率的影响，即可识别其保险价值。在加拿大应用该框架后，我们估算出：每增加1美元DI福利，会产生0.60美元的额外抑制成本，但能创造2.20美元的保险价值。因此，我们的方法表明，在加拿大背景下，DI福利并未过度慷慨。

url:e2d0a53e9ac88fe9.abstract: Are foreign supply chains that service the US market still decoupling from China? If so, where are the new chains forming, how quickly is the process happening, and why is it unfolding the way it is? This paper provides an initial empirical assessment of the changing nature of product-level sourcing of US imports in the wake of the tariffs President Donald J. Trump imposed in 2018–19 and 2025. It establishes numerous stylized facts. For example, US imports of many consumer electronics—including smartphones, laptops, monitors, and video game consoles—did not decline sharply in 2025 despite US tariffs hitting Chinese production for the first time. Multinational firms had established alternative supply chains in India and Vietnam which they quickly sourced from instead. In contrast, US importers of clothing and footwear did not reorient their supply chains, in part perhaps because the resulting difference between US tariff increases on China and on third countries for those products was too small to motivate them to do so. Finally, much of the longer-term shift of US import sourcing toward Taiwan and Mexico reflected the increasing economic importance of imported inputs for the data center buildout for artificial intelligence, and not strictly decoupling supply chains with China.
url:e2d0a53e9ac88fe9.abstract_zh: 服务于美国市场的外国供应链是否仍在与中国脱钩？如果是，新的供应链正在何处形成？这一进程的速度如何？为何以当前方式展开？本文对唐纳德·J·特朗普总统在2018-2019年及2025年加征关税后，美国进口产品层面采购来源的变化进行了初步实证评估，并确立了若干典型事实。例如，尽管美国关税首次冲击中国生产的智能手机、笔记本电脑、显示器和视频游戏机等消费电子产品，但2025年美国对这些产品的进口并未大幅下降。跨国公司已在印度和越南建立了替代供应链，并迅速转向这些来源。相比之下，服装和鞋类进口商并未调整其供应链，部分原因可能是美国对中国及第三国此类产品关税增幅差异过小，不足以激励其调整。最后，美国进口采购长期向台湾和墨西哥转移，很大程度上反映了用于人工智能数据中心建设的进口投入品经济重要性上升，而非严格意义上的对华供应链脱钩。

url:e2f94d2284ce2f57.abstract: Firms in developing countries often avoid paying taxes by making informal payments to tax officials. These bribes may raise the cost of operating a business, and the price charged to consumers. To decrease these costs, we designed a feedback incentive scheme for business tax inspectors that rewards them according to the anonymous evaluation submitted by inspected firms. We show theoretically that feedback incentives decrease the equilibrium bribe amount, but make firms with more inelastic demand more attractive for inspectors. A tilted scheme that attaches higher weights to the evaluation of smaller firms limits the scope for targeting and decreases the bribe amount to a lesser extent. We evaluate both schemes in a field experiment in the Kyrgyz Republic and find evidence that is consistent with the model predictions. By decreasing bribes, our intervention reduces the average cost for firms and the price they charge to consumers. Since fewer firms substitute bribes for taxes, tax revenues increase. Our study highlights the role of firm heterogeneity and market structure in shaping the relationship between firms and tax inspectors, and provides clear evidence of pass-through of bribes to consumers.
url:e2f94d2284ce2f57.abstract_zh: 发展中国家的企业常通过向税务官员行贿来逃避纳税。这些贿赂可能提高企业运营成本，并转嫁给消费者。为降低这些成本，我们设计了一种针对企业税务检查员的反馈激励机制，依据被检查企业的匿名评价给予奖励。理论上，我们证明反馈激励能降低均衡贿赂金额，但会使需求弹性较小的企业更受检查员青睐。一种对小型企业评价赋予更高权重的倾斜方案，限制了针对特定企业的行为，但降低贿赂金额的效果较弱。我们在吉尔吉斯共和国进行了一项实地实验，评估了两种方案，结果与模型预测一致。通过减少贿赂，我们的干预降低了企业的平均成本及其向消费者收取的价格。由于以贿赂替代税收的企业减少，税收收入增加。我们的研究强调了企业异质性和市场结构在塑造企业与税务检查员关系中的作用，并提供了贿赂向消费者转嫁的明确证据。

url:e3502d6ad4715b53.abstract: We construct a Broad Market Factor (BMF), which is a proxy for the value-weighted equity return on all firms in the US economy (public and private). The BMF differs from the standard Value-weighted Market Factor (VMF), which reflects the value-weighted equity return on public firms. We define the difference between the VMF and the BMF to be the Idiosyncratic Financial Factor (IFF). The IFF carries no risk premium and is uncorrelated with all macroeconomic proxies for investor marginal utility we consider. CAPM betas and, consequently, discount rates are underestimated when measured with respect to the VMF compared to the BMF for most portfolios. Size factors become redundant and the size anomaly is resolved when the VMF is replaced by the BMF in standard factor models. The intertemporal risk-return relation is substantially stronger when one replaces the VMF with the BMF. The unifying explanation for these results is that the IFF adds unpriced risk to the VMF, distorting both cross-sectional and time-series estimates of exposure to priced market risk.
url:e3502d6ad4715b53.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个广义市场因子（BMF），用以代表美国经济中所有企业（包括上市公司与非上市公司）的价值加权股权回报。BMF与标准价值加权市场因子（VMF）存在差异，后者仅反映上市公司的价值加权股权回报。我们将VMF与BMF之间的差值定义为特质金融因子（IFF）。该IFF不包含风险溢价，且与我们考虑的所有投资者边际效用宏观经济代理变量均不相关。对于大多数投资组合而言，相较于基于BMF的测算，基于VMF的CAPM贝塔值及由此得出的贴现率均被低估。当标准因子模型中的VMF被BMF替代时，规模因子变得冗余，规模异象得以消除。用BMF替代VMF后，跨期风险-收益关系显著增强。这些结果的统一解释是：IFF为VMF增加了未定价风险，从而扭曲了横截面与时间序列上对定价市场风险暴露程度的估计。

url:e35a8dc216a7fbaf.abstract: Climate-driven displacement is widely expected to push millions across international borders. Drawing on monthly bilateral flows for 127 developing-country origins, this column finds the reverse: a temperature shock reduces emigration rather than raising it, because climate stress cuts origin incomes and poor households cannot finance a costly international move. On this evidence, the ‘climate refugee’ is the exception, and hardship more often traps poor populations in place than sets them moving.
url:e35a8dc216a7fbaf.abstract_zh: 气候驱动的流离失所现象被广泛预期将推动数百万人跨越国际边界。本文基于127个发展中国家来源地的月度双边人口流动数据，发现了相反的结果：温度冲击反而减少了移民数量，而非增加移民数量，原因是气候压力降低了来源地收入，贫困家庭无力承担高昂的国际迁移成本。基于这一证据，"气候难民"属于例外情况，而困境更常使贫困人口困在原地，而非促使他们迁移。
url:e35a8dc216a7fbaf.title: Trapped at home: Climate stress is more likely to immobilise the poor than to move them
url:e35a8dc216a7fbaf.title_zh: 困于家中：气候压力更可能使穷人无法迁移而非促其流动

url:e37246e464221f9f.abstract: In a closed competitive general equilibrium constant returns economy, consumer taxes separate consumer and producer prices of goods. Shadow prices appropriate for the evaluation of public sector projects are derived on alternative assumptions about what happens to taxes as public production changes. In some examples, equilibrium prices and shadow prices are computed, and these computations suggest both that shadow prices are quite sensitive to the precise specification of pre-existing distortions and also that partial equilibrium intuition about the relation between shadow prices and market prices may be seriously misleading. The possibility of extending the analysis to more realistic examples and models is discussed.
url:e37246e464221f9f.abstract_zh: 在封闭竞争性一般均衡的规模报酬不变经济中，消费税将商品的消费者价格与生产者价格分离。基于公共生产变化时税收调整的不同假设，推导出适用于公共部门项目评估的影子价格。通过若干算例计算均衡价格与影子价格，结果表明：影子价格对既有扭曲的具体设定高度敏感，且关于影子价格与市场价格关系的局部均衡直觉可能产生严重误导。本文进一步探讨了将该分析拓展至更现实案例与模型的可能性。

url:e37f14b7fb552b40.abstract: A substantial literature finds poor mental health is hump-shaped with respect to age, whilst subjective wellbeing is U-shaped. Recent cross-sectional studies indicate a change in this relationship driven by the declining mental health of the young. We contribute to this literature by re-examining the age patterns in subjective wellbeing and illbeing for individuals in five European countries (France, Germany, Italy, Spain and Sweden). We do so with fifteen waves of the COME-HERE (CH) panel survey for 2020-2025 plus data from the Global Minds (GM) surveys of 2020-2026 for the same countries. We show that wellbeing rises and illbeing declines in a roughly monotonic fashion with age. This is found both with cross-section data from the CH and GM data, and from longitudinal plots of person fixed effects by age in the CH data.
url:e37f14b7fb552b40.abstract_zh: 大量文献发现，心理健康状况随年龄呈倒U型分布，而主观幸福感则呈U型分布。近期横截面研究显示，这一关系正发生变化，其驱动因素为年轻人心理健康的下降。我们通过重新考察五个欧洲国家（法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和瑞典）个体主观幸福感与心理困扰的年龄模式，为这一文献领域做出贡献。我们利用2020-2025年十五轮COME-HERE（CH）面板调查数据，以及同一国家2020-2026年Global Minds（GM）调查数据进行分析。研究结果显示，幸福感随年龄大致呈单调上升趋势，而心理困扰则单调下降。这一结论在CH和GM数据的横截面分析中，以及CH数据中按年龄划分的个体固定效应纵向图中均得到验证。
url:e37f14b7fb552b40.title: Illbeing Among the Young in Europe: Evidence from the COME HERE Panel
url:e37f14b7fb552b40.title_zh: 欧洲年轻人的福祉困境：来自COME HERE面板数据的证据

url:e3a40af9659bbc7a.abstract: We consider the implications of gender homophily in Economics, which has persisted despite the significant increase in women in the field. As women remain underrepresented, gender homophily may serve as a constraint in collaboration. It could also lead to less gender diverse co-author teams than may be optimal in terms of generating high quality research papers. We show that gender homophily neither constrains collaboration nor prevents higher quality output. This implies that a mere increase in women in Economics will not be sufficient to erase existing gender inequalities.
url:e3a40af9659bbc7a.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了经济学中性别同质性的影响，尽管该领域女性人数显著增加，但性别同质性现象依然持续存在。由于女性仍处于代表性不足的状态，性别同质性可能成为合作中的制约因素。此外，它可能导致合著团队的性别多样性低于产出高质量研究论文的最优水平。我们证明，性别同质性既不会限制合作，也不会阻碍更高质量成果的产生。这意味着，仅靠增加经济学领域的女性人数并不足以消除现有的性别不平等现象。
url:e3a40af9659bbc7a.title: Gender Homophily, Collaboration, and Output
url:e3a40af9659bbc7a.title_zh: 性别同质性、合作与产出

url:e3a62ba24e3af6c1.abstract: The location of individuals determines their job opportunities, living amenities, and housing costs. We argue that it is useful to conceptualize the location choice of individuals as a decision to invest in a `location asset'. This asset has a cost equal to the location's rent, and a payoff through better job opportunities and, potentially, more human capital for the individual and her children. As with any asset, savers in the location asset transfer resources into the future by going to expensive locations with good future opportunities. In contrast, borrowers transfer resources to the present by going to cheap locations that offer few other advantages. As in a standard portfolio problem, holdings of this asset depend on the comparison of its rate of return with that of other assets. Differently from other assets, the location asset is not subject to borrowing constraints, so it is used by individuals with little or no wealth that want to borrow. We provide an analytical model to make this idea precise and to derive a number of related implications, including an agent's mobility choices after experiencing negative income shocks. The model can rationalize why low wealth individuals locate in low income regions with low opportunities even in the absence of mobility costs. We document the investment dimension of location, and confirm the core predictions of our theory with French individual panel data from tax returns.
url:e3a62ba24e3af6c1.abstract_zh: 个体的位置决定了其就业机会、生活便利设施及住房成本。我们认为，将个体的位置选择概念化为对“位置资产”的投资决策是有益的。该资产的成本等于该位置的租金，而其回报则通过更好的就业机会以及可能为个体及其子女带来的人力资本提升来实现。与任何资产一样，位置资产的储蓄者通过前往具有良好未来机会的高成本地区，将资源转移至未来。相反，借款者则通过前往成本低廉且其他优势甚微的地区，将资源转移至当前。如同标准投资组合问题，对该资产的持有取决于其回报率与其他资产回报率的比较。与其他资产不同，位置资产不受借贷约束限制，因此被那些财富极少或没有财富但希望借款的个体所利用。我们提供了一个分析模型来精确阐述这一观点，并推导出若干相关推论，包括个体在遭受负面收入冲击后的流动性选择。该模型能够解释为何低财富个体即使在没有迁移成本的情况下，也会选择位于机会较少的低收入地区。我们记录了位置的投资维度，并通过法国税务申报的个人面板数据验证了我们理论的核心预测。
url:e3a62ba24e3af6c1.title: DP13063 Location as an Asset

url:e3b7d0ff998e159d.abstract: This paper studies the merits of policy rules with escape clauses, analysing as an example fixed exchange rate systems that allow member countries the freedom to realign in periods of stress. Motivating this example is the debate within the European Monetary System over how quickly to move from the current regime of national currencies, linked by pegged but adjustable exchange rates, to a single European currency. The paper's main point is that while well-designed rules with escape clauses can raise society's welfare in principle, limited credibility makes it difficult for governments to implement such rules in practice. An EMS-type institution which presumably imposes a political cost on policy-makers who realign may lead to an optimal escape-clause equilibrium, but may just as well lead to alternative equilibria far inferior to an irrevocably fixed exchange rate. Countries can suffer periods in which no realignment occurs, yet unemployment, real wages, and ex post real interest rates remain persistently and sub-optimally high.
url:e3b7d0ff998e159d.abstract_zh: 本文研究了带有例外条款的政策规则的优劣，并以允许成员国在压力时期自由调整汇率的固定汇率制度为例进行分析。这一例子的动机源于欧洲货币体系内部关于应从当前由可调整钉住汇率联结的国家货币体系，以多快速度过渡到单一欧洲货币的争论。本文的核心观点是：尽管设计良好的例外条款规则在理论上能够提升社会福利，但有限的可信度使得政府在实践中难以实施此类规则。一个类似欧洲货币体系的制度安排，若对进行汇率调整的政策制定者施加政治成本，可能会产生最优的例外条款均衡，但也同样可能导致远不如不可撤销的固定汇率制度的替代均衡。各国可能经历无汇率调整的时期，但失业率、实际工资以及事后实际利率却持续处于次优的高位。
url:e3b7d0ff998e159d.title: DP518 Destabilizing Effects of Exchange-Rate Escape Clauses
url:e3b7d0ff998e159d.title_zh: DP518 汇率逃避条款的不稳定效应

url:e3c1f93eb63e0b36.abstract: Digital technologies have transformed the news landscape, shifting consumption from print media toward online providers. This has allowed news outlets to collect richer data on individual readers, and to use those data both to tailor the news a reader sees— which stories appear and how they are framed—and to sell more precisely targeted advertising. Online news outlets also increasingly recruit readers from social media, amplifying incentives to capture reader attention through sensationalized stories and other techniques to increase engagement. Generative AI is likely to accelerate this trend by lowering the cost of personalizing news. Whether cheaper production and finer personalization raise or lower consumer welfare depends on how closely the objectives firms maximize are aligned with the underlying preferences of consumers. This review studies how the shift toward online news consumption affects both the supply and the demand for news and draws potential implications for consumer welfare.
url:e3c1f93eb63e0b36.abstract_zh: 数字技术已深刻改变了新闻业的格局，将消费从纸质媒体转向在线提供商。这使得新闻机构能够收集关于个体读者的更丰富数据，并利用这些数据既定制读者所见的新闻——包括哪些报道出现及其呈现方式——又销售更精准定向的广告。在线新闻提供商还日益从社交媒体吸引读者，这加剧了通过耸人听闻的报道及其他提升参与度的技巧来捕捉读者注意力的激励。生成式人工智能可能通过降低新闻个性化成本而加速这一趋势。更廉价的生产与更精细的个性化是提升还是降低消费者福利，取决于企业所最大化的目标与消费者潜在偏好的契合程度。本综述考察了向在线新闻消费的转变如何影响新闻的供给与需求，并探讨其对消费者福利的潜在影响。
url:e3c1f93eb63e0b36.title: DP21868 News Consumption in the Digital Age

url:e3e65ead6512add2.abstract: We study a model of popular demand for anti-elite populist reforms that drain the swamp: replace experienced public servants with novices that will only acquire experience with time. Voters benefit from experienced public servants because they are more effective at delivering public goods and more competent at detecting emergency threats. However, public servants’ policy preferences do not always align with those of voters. This tradeoff produces two key forces in our model: public servants’ incompetence spurs disagreement between them and voters, and their effectiveness grants them more power to dictate policy. Both of these effects fuel mistrust between voters and public servants, sometimes inducing voters to drain the swamp in cycles of anti-elite populism. We study which factors can sustain a responsive democracy or induce a technocracy. When instead populism arises, we discuss which reforms may reduce the frequency of populist cycles, including recruiting of public servants and isolating them from politics. Our results support the view that a more inclusive and representative bureaucracy protects against anti-elite populism. We provide empirical evidence that lack of trust in public servants is a key force behind support for anti-elite populist parties and argue that our model helps explain the rise of anti-elite populism in large robust democracies.
url:e3e65ead6512add2.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种反精英民粹主义改革的大众需求模型，该改革旨在“排干沼泽”：用缺乏经验的新人替换有经验的公务员，而这些新人只能随时间积累经验。选民受益于有经验的公务员，因为他们在提供公共产品方面更高效，在发现紧急威胁方面更胜任。然而，公务员的政策偏好并不总是与选民一致。这种权衡在我们的模型中产生了两个关键力量：公务员的无能加剧了他们与选民之间的分歧，而他们的效率则赋予他们更大的政策主导权。这两种效应都加剧了选民与公务员之间的不信任，有时会诱使选民以反精英民粹主义的周期循环方式“排干沼泽”。我们研究了哪些因素能够维持回应型民主或催生技术官僚体制。当民粹主义出现时，我们讨论了哪些改革可能减少民粹主义周期的频率，包括公务员的招募以及使其与政治隔离。我们的结果支持这样一种观点：更具包容性和代表性的官僚体系能够抵御反精英民粹主义。我们提供了实证证据，表明对公务员缺乏信任是支持反精英民粹主义政党的关键力量，并认为我们的模型有助于解释反精英民粹主义在大型稳健民主国家中的兴起。
url:e3e65ead6512add2.title: Drain the Swamp: A Theory of Anti-Elite Populism
url:e3e65ead6512add2.title_zh: 排干沼泽：反精英民粹主义的一种理论

url:e3ee027747982b07.abstract: This paper investigates the role of administrative capacity in shaping procurement outcomes using rich Italian data on public works. We analyse the duration of the three main phases – planning, awarding, and execution – for observationally equivalent projects. First, we document substantial heterogeneity across contracting authorities: their fixed effects account for a sizeable share of the variation in procurement length, and delays tend to persist across all phases, pointing to structural differences in organizational capacity. These differences are strongly correlated with indicators of administrative quality. Second, we show that the identity of the procurement manager (RUP) matters, even within the same organization. Observable characteristics such as education or tenure explain only a limited fraction of the variation, highlighting the importance of unobservable factors such as tacit knowledge, effort, and managerial skills. Third, in the execution phase, both procuring authorities and firms play a crucial role: execution times are shorter when projects are awarded to more productive firms, and higher-ability managers are more likely to select such firms.
url:e3ee027747982b07.abstract_zh: 本文利用意大利公共工程的丰富数据，探究行政能力对采购结果的影响。我们分析了观察等价项目的三个主要阶段——规划、招标与执行——的持续时间。首先，我们记录了签约机构之间存在显著的异质性：其固定效应解释了采购时长变异的相当大一部分，且延误往往在所有阶段持续存在，这表明组织能力存在结构性差异。这些差异与行政质量指标高度相关。其次，我们证明采购经理（RUP）的身份至关重要，即使在同一个组织内部也是如此。教育背景或任职年限等可观测特征仅能解释有限比例的变异，这凸显了隐性知识、努力程度和管理技能等不可观测因素的重要性。第三，在执行阶段，采购机构与企业均发挥关键作用：当项目被授予生产率更高的企业时，执行时间更短，而能力更强的经理更倾向于选择此类企业。

url:e43d12684a2f01d2.abstract: Can localized weather shocks to upstream fuel suppliers undermine down-stream electricity reliability? Using administrative data linking South African power plants to contracted coal mines from 2015 to 2024, we combine plant operating records, mining-firm revenue data, and route-level traffic sensor data. Exploiting within-plant variation in supplier-mine rainfall, we find that rainfall shocks reduce mine output and lower coal plant availability. Daily traffic data confirm that rainfall reduces coal deliveries along contracted mine-to-plant routes. These disruptions propagate to the grid, contributing to rolling blackouts. Electricity security hinges on the resilience of coal supplyn contracts and logistics, not only on plant resilience.
url:e43d12684a2f01d2.abstract_zh: 局部天气冲击是否会通过上游燃料供应商传导至下游电力可靠性？利用2015至2024年间连接南非电厂与签约煤矿的行政数据，我们整合了电厂运行记录、矿业公司收入数据及路线级交通传感器数据。通过利用电厂内部供应商煤矿降雨量的变异，我们发现降雨冲击降低了煤矿产出，并减少了燃煤电厂的可用性。每日交通数据证实，降雨减少了签约煤矿至电厂路线的煤炭交付量。这些中断向电网传播，加剧了轮流停电现象。电力安全不仅取决于电厂自身的韧性，还依赖于煤炭供应合同及物流的恢复能力。

url:e4c0740c78be9c1c.abstract: Investors reward reform progress. Econometric results suggest that holistic reforms, fiscal spending discipline, and monetary policy credibility are associated with a tightening of Qatar’s external sovereign credit spreads. In particular, investors may view fiscal spending discipline as an integral part of Qatar’s holistic reform and economic diversification. Greater broad-based reform progress also boosts the resilience of sovereign credit spreads to external shocks. The findings support fiscal and monetary policy reforms as part of the broader reform agenda in a holistic manner, as planned under the Third National Development Strategy.
url:e4c0740c78be9c1c.abstract_zh: 投资者对改革进展给予回报。计量经济学结果表明，整体性改革、财政支出纪律和货币政策可信度与卡塔尔外部主权信用利差的收紧相关联。特别是，投资者可能将财政支出纪律视为卡塔尔整体改革和经济多元化不可或缺的一部分。更广泛的全面改革进展也增强了主权信用利差对外部冲击的韧性。研究结果支持将财政和货币政策改革作为更广泛改革议程的一部分，以整体方式推进，正如第三次国家发展战略所规划的那样。

url:e4f4c5a92a18e7a9.abstract: this paper, we revisit the question of how to manage financial crises using the framework proposed in Bianchi and Mendoza (2018). We show that this model economy exhibits a multiplicity of constrained-efficient equilibria, which arises because the private shadow value of collateral influences the forward-looking asset price. Among these equilibria, the specific one studied by Bianchi and Mendoza (2018) can be implemented using a tax/subsidy on debt alone. In that case, both the ex ante tax and ex post subsidy are quantitatively important for welfare under the optimal time-consistent policy. Limiting either component can lead to a welfare loss relative to the unregulated competitive equilibrium, highlighting the complementarity between crisis prevention and crisis resolution tools. We also show that, under certain conditions, all Pareto-dominant constrained-efficient equilibria entail the unconstrained allocation chosen by a social planner subject to the country budget constraint, and this allocation can be implemented with purely ex post policies.
url:e4f4c5a92a18e7a9.abstract_zh: 本文利用Bianchi和Mendoza（2018）提出的框架，重新探讨了如何管理金融危机的问题。我们证明，该模型经济中存在多重约束有效均衡，其产生原因在于抵押品的私人影子价值会影响前瞻性资产价格。在这些均衡中，Bianchi和Mendoza（2018）所研究的特定均衡可以通过仅对债务征收税收/补贴来实现。在此情况下，最优时间一致性政策下，事前税收和事后补贴对福利均具有显著的定量重要性。限制其中任一组成部分都可能导致相对于无监管竞争均衡的福利损失，这凸显了危机预防工具与危机化解工具之间的互补性。我们还证明，在特定条件下，所有帕累托占优的约束有效均衡均包含受国家预算约束的社会规划者所选择的非约束配置，且该配置可通过纯粹的事后政策实现。
url:e4f4c5a92a18e7a9.title: Managing Financial Crises

url:e51fe39083e2010d.abstract: In the context of the growing share of public workers in the Spanish labour force, this paper analyses opportunistic behaviour in sick leave duration and return-to-work probabilities among teachers. We use administrative microdata (2011-2019), transformed into an original monthly spell-level panel. The analysis employs a tailored regression within a difference-in-differences framework exploiting the academic calendar and comparing professional sick leaves among pre-university teachers in public and private schools. Results show that the timing of sick leave endings systematically responds to the school calendar. Public-school teachers display longer sick leave durations and lower return-to-work probabilities than private-school teachers, consistent with ex post moral hazard under more generous employment protection and sick leave coverage. Around the summer break, these differences become more pronounced: public-school teachers extend their leaves further relative to private-school teachers. Simultaneously, the usual gap in return-to-work probabilities temporarily reverses, with public-school teachers becoming more likely to end their leave immediately after summer. These patterns are especially strong among mid-career workers, women, and cases involving more subjective or difficult-to-diagnose injuries.
url:e51fe39083e2010d.abstract_zh: 在西班牙劳动力中公共部门工作者占比日益增长的背景下，本文分析了教师群体在病假时长与返岗概率中的机会主义行为。我们采用2011-2019年行政微观数据，将其转化为原创的月度个体面板数据。分析基于双重差分框架，利用学年周期进行定制化回归，比较公立与私立学校大学预科教师的职业病假情况。结果显示，病假结束时间系统性地响应学年周期。相较于私立学校教师，公立学校教师病假持续时间更长、返岗概率更低，这与更优厚的就业保障和病假覆盖下的事后道德风险一致。在暑假前后，这些差异更为显著：公立学校教师相对于私立学校教师进一步延长病假。同时，返岗概率的常规差距暂时逆转，公立学校教师在暑假结束后立即结束病假的可能性更高。这些模式在职业生涯中期工作者、女性以及涉及更主观或难以诊断的伤病案例中尤为突出。

url:e5264736d1b0406b.abstract: This paper investigates the transmission of oil price shocks to the banking sector in oil-dependent economies, using Oman as a case study. We develop a DSGE model featuring an integrated banking block with endogenous credit rationing and a sovereign wealth fund stabilization rule, calibrated to Omani institutional targets and disciplined by Bayesian methods. Our structural approach disentangles two primary transmission channels: the solvency channel, driven by credit risk and non-performing loans (NPLs), and the liquidity channel, driven by pro-cyclical government deposit withdrawals and sovereign debt issuance. The structural variance decomposition attributes over 54% of non-oil GDP variance and 53% of credit variance to oil price shocks, while bank capital shocks account for less than 0.1%, confirming the quantitative dominance of the liquidity channel. We identify a precautionary liquidity motive—a “liquidity buffer trap”—where banks maintain excess liquidity during booms to hedge against hydrocarbon volatility, structurally suppressing credit to the productive sector. Our counterfactual regime analysis reveals the stabilizing power of credit depth: banking conservatism protects long-term physical capital formation, and the ongoing financialization of the corporate sector— including the rapid growth of Islamic banking and sukuk markets—under Vision 2040 further amplifies this structural resilience. We acknowledge identification challenges inherent in small-sample structural estimation and discuss the sensitivity of results to key modeling assumptions.
url:e5264736d1b0406b.abstract_zh: 本文以阿曼为案例，研究石油价格冲击对石油依赖型经济体银行部门的传导机制。我们构建了一个包含内生信贷配给与主权财富基金稳定规则的银行模块的DSGE模型，该模型根据阿曼制度目标进行校准，并采用贝叶斯方法进行约束。我们的结构方法区分了两种主要传导渠道：由信用风险与不良贷款驱动的偿付能力渠道，以及由顺周期的政府存款提取与主权债券发行驱动的流动性渠道。结构方差分解显示，石油价格冲击解释了非石油GDP方差的54%以上及信贷方差的53%，而银行资本冲击的贡献率不足0.1%，证实了流动性渠道在数量上的主导地位。我们识别出一种预防性流动性动机——即"流动性缓冲陷阱"——银行在经济繁荣期持有超额流动性以对冲碳氢化合物波动，从而结构性抑制了对生产性部门的信贷供给。反事实制度分析揭示了信贷深度的稳定效应：银行保守主义保护了长期实物资本形成，而"2040愿景"下企业部门持续金融化——包括伊斯兰银行与苏库克市场的快速增长——进一步放大了这种结构性韧性。我们承认小样本结构估计中固有的识别挑战，并讨论了关键建模假设对结果的敏感性。
url:e5264736d1b0406b.title: Should Oil Economies Worry About Oil Shocks’ Impact on the Banking System? The Case of Oman
url:e5264736d1b0406b.title_zh: 石油经济体应担忧石油冲击对银行体系的影响吗？以阿曼为例

url:e5461e44ef29b9f6.abstract: Lebanon’s current economic crisis ranks among the worst in recent history. GDP has collapsed by 38% in real terms. The Lebanese lira, which was fixed to the dollar in 1997, has lost more than 98% of its value on the parallel market. The government has defaulted on its debt, and depositors are unable to access their funds held at commercial banks. Consolidated public sector debt, including both government debt and commercial banks’ claims on the Banque du Liban (BdL), represents more than seven times the current GDP. Public services delivery has crumbled. In short, the country is undergoing a debt crisis, a banking crisis, a currency crisis, and a growth collapse. Four years into the crisis, a resolution remains elusive, and each passing day increases the economic and social burdens faced by the population. Given the increasing cost of delaying a resolution, we propose a strategy for Lebanon’s economic recovery that addresses all the dimensions of the crisis while recognizing the need to rapidly kick-start the economic recovery.
url:e5461e44ef29b9f6.abstract_zh: 黎巴嫩当前的经济危机堪称近代史上最严重的危机之一。实际国内生产总值（GDP）暴跌38%。1997年与美元挂钩的黎巴嫩镑，在平行市场已贬值超过98%。政府债务违约，储户无法提取商业银行存款。包括政府债务及商业银行对黎巴嫩央行（BdL）债权在内的公共部门合并债务，已达当前GDP的七倍以上。公共服务体系全面崩溃。简言之，该国正同时经历债务危机、银行危机、货币危机与增长崩溃。危机爆发四年后，解决方案仍遥不可及，而每拖延一日，民众承受的经济与社会负担便愈发沉重。鉴于拖延解决的成本日益攀升，我们提出一项兼顾危机各维度、同时亟需快速启动经济复苏的黎巴嫩经济复苏战略。
url:e5461e44ef29b9f6.title: Towards a Sustainable Recovery for Lebanon’s Economy
url:e5461e44ef29b9f6.title_zh: 迈向黎巴嫩经济的可持续复苏

url:e55934962ee04637.abstract: This paper explores the impact of emissions standards on a firm’s output and abatement R&D investment decisions in a duopoly model, extending the work of Amir et al. (2023). It is shown that high upper limits on total emissions remove the firms’ incentives to invest in abatement R&D. This helps firms to coordinate on profit-increasing output levels relative to unregulated markets. Moreover, subsidies for abatement R&D may hurt firms, but improve welfare when the regulation is strict enough.
url:e55934962ee04637.abstract_zh: 本文在双寡头模型框架下，探讨了排放标准对企业产出及减排研发投资决策的影响，并扩展了Amir等人（2023）的研究。研究表明，较高的总排放上限会削弱企业投资于减排研发的动机，这有助于企业在相对于无管制市场时协调至利润提升的产出水平。此外，当管制足够严格时，对减排研发的补贴可能损害企业利益，但能改善社会福利。

url:e570247b57aa2db3.abstract: Firms introduce products in markets where they anticipate stronger demand, using information unobserved by researchers. This creates endogenous selection in demand estimation. In differentiated-product oligopolies, multidimensional demand unobservables and strategic entry can render the ordinary propensity score insufficient for selection correction. Existing approaches either restrict firms' information at entry or jointly estimate demand, pricing, and entry under strong supply-side assumptions. We derive a new mixture representation of the selection-bias function using latent propensity scores: entry probabilities conditional on observables and a latent market state generating dependence across entry decisions. This representation yields a convenient two-step semiparametric estimator that corrects for selection and price endogeneity while accommodating richer information at entry. The approach makes weaker supply-side assumptions and is simpler to implement because it avoids repeatedly solving the full model. Applied to the US airline industry, the method yields more elastic demand and less market power than estimates ignoring endogenous entry.
url:e570247b57aa2db3.abstract_zh: 企业在预期需求更强的市场中推出产品，这一决策基于研究者无法观测的信息。这导致需求估计中存在内生选择问题。在差异化产品寡头市场中，多维度的需求不可观测因素与策略性进入行为，使得普通倾向得分不足以修正选择偏差。现有方法要么限制企业进入时的信息集，要么在强供给端假设下联合估计需求、定价与进入决策。我们利用潜在倾向得分推导出选择偏差函数的新混合表示形式：即基于可观测变量与一个生成跨进入决策依赖性的潜在市场状态的条件进入概率。该表示形式可构建便捷的两步半参数估计量，在修正选择偏差与价格内生性的同时，允许企业进入时拥有更丰富的信息。该方法对供给端假设要求更弱，且因无需反复求解完整模型而更易实施。应用于美国航空业时，相较于忽略内生进入的估计结果，该方法得出更具弹性的需求与更低的市场势力。

url:e580f6aeef43ce69.abstract: We identify a novel channel of international financial contagion driven by investor expectations. Using a unique dataset linking investors' cross-country GDP growth expectations to their equity mutual fund investments and to funds' country allocations, we show that inflows into mutual funds respond strongly to fund-level expected growth, whereas funds' country allocations react only weakly to country-specific expectations. This asymmetry generates co-ownership spillovers: negative expectations about one country propagate mechanically to other countries held in the same funds, even in the absence of changes in the country
url:e580f6aeef43ce69.abstract_zh: 我们识别出一种由投资者预期驱动的国际金融传染新渠道。通过使用一个独特的数据集，将投资者对跨国GDP增长的预期与其股票共同基金投资以及基金的国家配置联系起来，我们表明，共同基金的资金流入对基金层面的预期增长反应强烈，而基金的国家配置对国家特定预期的反应则较弱。这种不对称性产生了共同所有权溢出效应：对某一国家的负面预期会机械地传导至同一基金持有的其他国家，即使这些国家的经济基本面未发生变化。

url:e59e342b25415430.abstract: We develop a new index of economic policy uncertainty (EPU) based on newspaper coverage frequency. Several types of evidence ? including human readings of 12,000 newspaper articles ? indicate that our index proxies for movements in policy-related economic uncertainty. Our US index spikes near tight presidential elections, Gulf Wars I and II, the 9/11 attacks, the failure of Lehman Brothers, the 2011 debt-ceiling dispute and other major battles over fiscal policy. Using firm-level data, we find that policy uncertainty raises stock price volatility and reduces investment and employment in policy-sensitive sectors like defense, healthcare, and infrastructure construction. At the macro level, policy uncertainty innovations foreshadow declines in investment, output, and employment in the United States and, in a panel VAR setting, for 12 major economies. Extending our US index back to 1900, EPU rose dramatically in the 1930s (from late 1931) and has drifted upwards since the 1960s.
url:e59e342b25415430.abstract_zh: 我们基于报纸报道频率构建了一个新的经济政策不确定性（EPU）指数。多种证据——包括对12,000篇报纸文章的人工解读——表明，该指数能够有效反映政策相关经济不确定性的变动。我们的美国指数在总统大选胶着期、第一次和第二次海湾战争、"9·11"恐怖袭击、雷曼兄弟破产、2011年债务上限争议以及其他重大财政政策博弈期间出现显著峰值。利用企业层面数据，我们发现政策不确定性会提高股票价格波动性，并减少国防、医疗保健和基础设施建设等政策敏感部门的投资与就业。在宏观层面，政策不确定性冲击预示着美国投资、产出和就业的下降，而在面板VAR模型中，这一结论对12个主要经济体同样成立。将美国指数回溯至1900年，EPU在20世纪30年代（自1931年末起）急剧攀升，并自20世纪60年代以来呈持续上升趋势。
url:e59e342b25415430.title: Measuring Economic Policy Uncertainty
url:e59e342b25415430.title_zh: 经济政策不确定性的测度

url:e59e7b5dc5f5b617.abstract: This paper studies the effects of wealth taxation on efficiency, equity, and welfare in a heterogeneous-agent model with incomplete markets and endogenous occupational and legal-form choice. Entrepreneurs choose between operating as pass-through businesses and C-corporations. While C-corporations face less favorable tax treatment and higher operating costs, they benefit from easier access to external finance. The choice of legal form therefore shapes both the after-tax return to entrepreneurial investment and the severity of financial constraints. Calibrating the model to the U.S. economy, we show that the effects of wealth taxation depend crucially on the endogenous reallocation of entrepreneurs across legal forms. Revenue-neutral reforms that encourage entrepreneurs to switch toward pass-through businesses tighten financial constraints, exacerbate capital misallocation within the entrepreneurial sector, and amplify the efficiency costs of wealth taxation. By contrast, reforms that encourage entrepreneurs to organize as C-corporations relax financial constraints, improve capital allocation, and can more than offset the aggregate distortions induced by the wealth tax. We further show that the distributional and welfare effects crucially depend on the design of the wealth tax itself. While a flat wealth tax does not lower wealth inequality, it generates aggregate welfare gains under all revenue-recycling schemes we consider. By contrast, a progressive wealth tax reduces inequality but may generate aggregate welfare losses because it more strongly discourages entrepreneurial investment.
url:e59e7b5dc5f5b617.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在不完全市场及内生职业与法律形式选择下的异质性主体模型中，财富税对效率、公平和福利的影响。企业家可以选择以穿透型企业或C型公司形式运营。尽管C型公司面临较不利的税收待遇和更高的运营成本，但它们更容易获得外部融资。因此，法律形式的选择既塑造了企业家投资的税后回报，也影响了金融约束的严重程度。通过将模型校准至美国经济，我们表明财富税的影响关键取决于企业家在法律形式间的内生重新配置。鼓励企业家转向穿透型企业的收入中性改革会收紧金融约束，加剧企业家部门内部的资本错配，并放大财富税的效率成本。相反，鼓励企业家组建C型公司的改革则能放松金融约束，改善资本配置，并可能超过财富税带来的总体扭曲。我们进一步表明，分配和福利效应关键取决于财富税本身的设计。虽然统一财富税并未降低财富不平等，但在我们考虑的所有收入循环方案下，它都能带来总体福利增益。相比之下，累进财富税减少了不平等，但可能因更强烈地抑制企业家投资而产生总体福利损失。
url:e59e7b5dc5f5b617.title: DP21822 Wealth Tax, Entrepreneurship, and the Legal Form of Business Organization
url:e59e7b5dc5f5b617.title_zh: DP21822 财富税、创业精神与企业组织的法律形式

url:e5a2fa21b2068d89.abstract: Do creditor rights amplify or dampen economic fluctuations? Using a panel of 39 countries from 1978 to 2019, we show that credit expansions in economies with strong creditor protection are followed by smaller output losses, fewer non-performing loans, and a greater reallocation of credit away from unproductive sectors. Firm-level evidence from Delaware’s adoption of antirecharacterization laws shows that well-protected creditors cut credit to low-productivity firms while easing borrowing constraints for productive ones. Overall, our findings indicate that stronger creditor rights dampen the output losses of credit booms by facilitating a more efficient reallocation of capital.
url:e5a2fa21b2068d89.abstract_zh: 债权人权利是放大还是抑制经济波动？利用1978年至2019年间39个国家的面板数据，我们发现，在债权人保护较强的经济体中，信贷扩张之后伴随的产出损失较小，不良贷款较少，且信贷从低效部门向高效部门的再配置更为显著。来自特拉华州采纳反定性法律的微观企业证据表明，受到良好保护的债权人会削减对低生产率企业的信贷，同时放宽对高生产率企业的融资约束。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，更强的债权人权利通过促进资本更有效的再配置，减轻了信贷繁荣带来的产出损失。

url:e5bd77e6921ede93.abstract: We model a stablecoin issuer that optimises capital, cash and bond holdings under persistent stablecoin flows. Absent regulation, the issuer holds little capital and favours interest-bearing but less-liquid bonds over cash. This exposes coin-holders to default risks and poses systemic spillovers via price impact of bond fire-sales. How can regulation mitigate these risks? We consider capital and liquidity thresholds as usable buffers. They can be breached in stress but discipline issuers by triggering additional redemptions, thus endogenising stablecoin flows. The thresholds work through asymmetric channels. While the liquidity threshold only raises cash holdings, the capital threshold increases both capital and cash. Both thresholds mitigate default and spillover risks, suggesting they are substitutes. However, they are complements for regulators targeting both risks. Using stablecoin flows and US Treasury market depth, we calibrate a two-way mapping that enables regulators to recover capital-liquidity threshold combinations implied by chosen risk targets (and vice-versa).
url:e5bd77e6921ede93.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个稳定币发行商的模型，该发行商在持续稳定的币流下优化资本、现金和债券持有量。在缺乏监管的情况下，发行商持有少量资本，并倾向于持有有息但流动性较低的债券而非现金。这使币持有者面临违约风险，并通过债券抛售的价格影响产生系统性溢出效应。监管如何缓解这些风险？我们考虑将资本和流动性阈值作为可用的缓冲机制。这些阈值在压力时期可能被突破，但通过触发额外赎回对发行商形成约束，从而内生化稳定币流动。阈值通过非对称渠道发挥作用：流动性阈值仅提高现金持有量，而资本阈值则同时增加资本和现金。两种阈值均能缓解违约和溢出风险，表明它们具有替代性。然而，对于同时针对这两种风险的监管者而言，它们又具有互补性。利用稳定币流动和美国国债市场深度数据，我们校准了一个双向映射关系，使监管者能够根据选定的风险目标反推出资本-流动性阈值的组合（反之亦然）。
url:e5bd77e6921ede93.title: Making stablecoins stabler(r): can regulation help?

url:e5c657ebe2c84ecf.abstract: We quantify the impact of perceived cancer risk on housing values using widely advertised national reclassifications of chemical carcinogenicity in the United States. Combining these information events with an empirical design that compares changes in house values closer to affected toxic plants against those farther away isolates the effect of cancer risk news from other local factors. Focusing on plants previously emitting reclassified carcinogenic chemicals, we estimate a 1-2% decline in housing values within a 3-mile radius compared to those located farther away. The effects are stronger in areas with higher media presence underscoring the role of salience as a mechanism.
url:e5c657ebe2c84ecf.abstract_zh: 我们利用美国广泛宣传的化学致癌性国家重新分类，量化了感知癌症风险对住房价值的影响。将这些信息事件与一种实证设计相结合，该设计比较了靠近受影响有毒工厂的房屋价值变化与远离这些工厂的房屋价值变化，从而将癌症风险新闻的影响与其他地方因素分离开来。聚焦于先前排放被重新分类致癌化学物质的工厂，我们估计在3英里半径内的住房价值相比更远地区下降了1-2%。在媒体曝光度更高的地区，这一效应更为显著，凸显了显著性作为机制的作用。

url:e5f01beb5af65f19.abstract: The rapid growth of private higher education institutions (PHEIs) in Morocco is an emerging phenomenon that brings several challenges, notably high staff turnover. In this context, attracting and retaining faculty members represent a strategic priority for PHEIs to ensure a sustainable competitive advantage and strengthen their employer brand. This brand relies on both an external dimension, oriented toward students (Whisman 2009; Nguyen et al. 2019), and an internal dimension focused on employees, which is recognized as essential (Chapleo et al. 2019). A review of the existing literature reveals a near-total absence of research addressing the link between employer branding in higher education institutions and the attraction and retention of top talent, whether in Morocco or elsewhere. This article explores the internal approach through a qualitative study involving 18 professors from two private business and engineering schools, using thematic content analysis. Our findings reveal that developing an employer brand within PHEIs is vital. However, other attractive attributes also influence teachers' decision-making processes regarding their choice of institution, such as work-life balance, ethical behavior, managerial style, compensation, and career development. Keywords: Employer brand, private higher education institution, work-life balance, ethical behavior, managerial style, compensation, career development.
url:e5f01beb5af65f19.abstract_zh: 摩洛哥私立高等教育机构的迅速增长是一个新兴现象，带来了诸多挑战，尤其是高员工流动率问题。在此背景下，吸引并留住教职员工成为私立高等教育机构确保可持续竞争优势、强化雇主品牌的一项战略优先事项。这一品牌既包含面向学生的外部维度（Whisman 2009; Nguyen et al. 2019），也包含聚焦于员工的内部维度，后者被认为是至关重要的（Chapleo et al. 2019）。对现有文献的回顾显示，无论是在摩洛哥还是其他地方，关于高等教育机构雇主品牌与顶尖人才吸引及保留之间联系的研究几乎完全缺失。本文通过一项涉及两所私立商业与工程学校的18位教授的定性研究，采用主题内容分析法，探讨了内部路径。我们的研究结果表明，在私立高等教育机构中发展雇主品牌至关重要。然而，其他具有吸引力的属性也影响着教师在选择院校时的决策过程，例如工作与生活的平衡、道德行为、管理风格、薪酬以及职业发展。关键词：雇主品牌，私立高等教育机构，工作与生活平衡，道德行为，管理风格，薪酬，职业发展。

url:e609170b9f30882f.abstract: How do households respond when deposit rates drop below zero? Using administrative micro data and exploiting cross-bank variation in interest rate policies, we study a major episode of negative deposit rates in Denmark affecting two thirds of household deposits. We find that households strongly reduced deposit balances when exposed to negative deposit rates, allocating funds to stock portfolios and consumption. In a large-scale survey, we document important roles for loss aversion, perceived unfairness, intertemporal substitution and return considerations in driving these responses. Our findings suggest that monetary policy can have strong consumption effects in negative territory.
url:e609170b9f30882f.abstract_zh: 当存款利率降至负值时，家庭如何应对？利用行政微观数据并借助银行间利率政策的差异，我们研究了丹麦一次影响三分之二家庭存款的重大负存款利率事件。研究发现，当家庭面临负存款利率时，其存款余额显著减少，资金被重新配置至股票投资组合和消费领域。通过大规模调查，我们证实损失厌恶、感知不公、跨期替代及收益考量在驱动这些行为中发挥重要作用。研究结果表明，货币政策在负利率区间可能对消费产生显著影响。

url:e6698481384f6fc5.abstract: Administrative barriers to trade such as customs procedures are well-documented sources of delays and costs in cross-border commerce, often prompting firms to outsource these tasks to specialist customs agents. This paper examines the role of customs agents in a key global trade facilitation policy—the Authorized Economic Operator Mutual Recognition Agreement (AEO-MRA)—which enables certified traders to benefit from simplified customs procedures with partner countries. Focusing on the 2012 EU-US AEO-MRA, and using UK transaction-level customs data from HMRC that uniquely identify the AEO status of agents filing on behalf of firms, we document the widespread use of customs agents in UK exports. Guided by a theoretical framework, we show that non-certified firms benefited indirectly from the policy through certified agents, leading to more US market entry, fewer product exits, and higher export values. These findings highlight the role of intermediaries in extending the reach of trade facilitation and offer timely evidence to inform policy design in an era of rising administrative frictions.
url:e6698481384f6fc5.abstract_zh: 诸如海关程序等行政性贸易壁垒，在跨境贸易中被充分证明是导致延误和成本的来源，常促使企业将这些任务外包给专业报关代理。本文考察了报关代理在一项关键的全球贸易便利化政策——经认证经营者互认协议（AEO-MRA）中的作用，该协议使认证贸易商能够享受与伙伴国简化的海关程序。聚焦于2012年欧盟-美国AEO-MRA，并利用英国税务海关总署（HMRC）提供的交易级海关数据，该数据独特地识别了代表企业申报的代理商的AEO状态，我们记录了报关代理在英国出口中的广泛使用。在理论框架的指导下，我们表明，未认证企业通过认证代理商间接受益于该政策，从而增加了进入美国市场的机会，减少了产品退出，并提高了出口价值。这些发现凸显了中介机构在扩大贸易便利化覆盖范围中的作用，并为行政摩擦上升时代政策设计提供了及时的证据。
url:e6698481384f6fc5.title: Customs Agents and Trade Facilitation
url:e6698481384f6fc5.title_zh: 海关代理与贸易便利化

url:e66c890492f884d3.abstract: We develop a quantitative dynamic general equilibrium model in which spreads arise from intermediation costs and market power. Calibrating to the Brazilian data, we show that, for equivalent levels of external financing, spreads have profound impacts on aggregate development, indeed more so than credit rationing does, and spreads yield firm dynamics that are consistent with observed patterns.
url:e66c890492f884d3.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个量化动态一般均衡模型，其中利差源于中介成本与市场势力。通过校准至巴西数据，我们表明，在同等外部融资水平下，利差对总体发展具有深远影响，其作用甚至超过信贷配给，并且利差产生的企业动态与观察到的模式相符。
url:e66c890492f884d3.title: Financing Costs and Development

url:e6ac01d6fccbfc18.abstract: This paper analyses the impact of cost competitiveness and technology on export performance using a very rich panel dataset of 12 manufacturing industries in 14 OECD countries for the period between 1970 and 1992. Consistent with standard models, we find that changes in relative unit labour costs are a robust determinant of changes in export market shares. In the long run a 10% increase in relative unit labour costs leads to a fall of between 2% and 3% of export market share. Despite this, the trends in national export performance cannot be fully explained by relative costs. This points to the importance of non-price factors, and extending the model to allow for technology effects (including R&D and patents) on quality provides some evidence for the importance of higher relative investment rates. Allowing for heterogeneity in the effect of relative costs in different industries, different countries and different time periods suggests that labour cost changes are less important in high technology industries, in periods of high demand and in countries within the European Monetary System.
url:e6ac01d6fccbfc18.abstract_zh: 本文利用1970年至1992年间14个OECD国家12个制造业行业的丰富面板数据集，分析了成本竞争力与技术对出口绩效的影响。与标准模型一致，我们发现相对单位劳动力成本的变化是出口市场份额变化的稳健决定因素。长期来看，相对单位劳动力成本每上升10%，将导致出口市场份额下降2%至3%。尽管如此，国家出口绩效的趋势并不能完全由相对成本解释。这表明非价格因素的重要性，而将模型扩展至考虑技术效应（包括研发与专利）对质量的影响，则为更高相对投资率的重要性提供了部分证据。允许不同行业、不同国家及不同时期相对成本效应的异质性表明，在高技术行业、高需求时期以及欧洲货币体系成员国中，劳动力成本变化的重要性较低。
url:e6ac01d6fccbfc18.title: Quantifying a Dangerous Obsession? Competitiveness and export performance in an OECD Panel of Industries
url:e6ac01d6fccbfc18.title_zh: 量化危险的执念？OECD行业面板中的竞争力和出口绩效

url:e6cf786db0ade9c3.abstract: this paper we introduce history-bound reelections. In their simplest form, they are embodied in a "Score-replication Rule". Under such rules an incumbent has to match the highest vote-share he/she has obtained in any previous election in order to be reelected. We develop a simple three-period model to examine Score-replication Rules. We show that suitable variants of such rules can improve welfare as they reduce the tendency of reelected incumbents to indulge in their own preferences. At the same time, they ensure that able office-holders are reelected. Candidates might offer their own Score-replication Rule in campaigns. We outline how political competition may be affected by such new forms of elections.
url:e6cf786db0ade9c3.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种历史约束型连任机制。其最简形式体现为“得票复制规则”。在此类规则下，现任者必须复制其在以往任何选举中所获得的最高得票率，方能成功连任。我们构建了一个简单的三期模型来考察得票复制规则。研究表明，此类规则的适当变体能够提升社会福利，因为它们减少了连任者沉溺于自身偏好的倾向。同时，这些规则确保有能力的在位者得以连任。候选人可能在竞选中提出自己的得票复制规则。我们概述了这种新型选举形式可能如何影响政治竞争。
url:e6cf786db0ade9c3.title: An Appraisal of History-bound Reelections

url:e6da4ebf66b83f99.title: Reshaping global trade: the immediate and long-term effects of bank failures
url:e6da4ebf66b83f99.title_zh: 重塑全球贸易：银行倒闭的即时与长期效应

url:e7275c04278df56b.abstract: The relative effectiveness of non-pharmaceutical interventions, such as lockdowns and work-from-home mandates, depends on whether individuals adjust their social behavior in response to infection risk when policy restrictions are absent. Exploiting geographic variation in COVID-19 exposure during the first wave, three key results emerge. First, we find evidence that areas with relatively high excess death rates during the first wave of the pandemic had relatively low excess death rates during the second wave. Second, using granular mobility data from GPS devices, we show that the same areas saw relatively high mobility during the second wave, which may suggest that the first finding is driven by an immunity effect. Finally, the heterogeneity analysis reveals that scarring, behavioral responses, and immunization may operate with varying intensity across municipalities with different age compositions, yielding observable differences in both second-wave mobility and mortality patterns.
url:e7275c04278df56b.abstract_zh: 非药物干预措施（如封锁和居家办公指令）的相对有效性，取决于在政策限制缺失时，个体是否会因感染风险而调整其社交行为。利用第一波疫情期间COVID-19暴露的地理差异，我们得出三个关键结果。首先，我们发现，在第一波疫情中超额死亡率相对较高的地区，在第二波疫情中的超额死亡率相对较低。其次，利用来自GPS设备的细粒度流动性数据，我们显示这些地区在第二波疫情中的流动性相对较高，这可能表明第一个结果是由免疫效应驱动的。最后，异质性分析揭示，疤痕效应、行为反应和免疫作用在不同年龄构成的城市中可能以不同强度运作，从而在第二波流动性和死亡率模式上产生可观察的差异。
url:e7275c04278df56b.title: Running the Risk: Immunity and Mobility in Response to a Pandemic
url:e7275c04278df56b.title_zh: 承担风险：疫情应对中的免疫与流动性

url:e72b5d06872c221a.abstract: Teams of inventors now produce over 80% of U.S. patents, up from just 45% in 1976. Over the same period, inventor employment has become increasingly concentrated in large firms, rising six times more than overall employment concentration. To explain these trends, we develop a new model of endogenous team formation within firms and embed it in a general equilibrium model of the inventor labor market. Teams increase firms' returns to scale by increasing the likelihood of productive matches between inventors. The value of these matches rise over time, possibly driven by increasing knowledge specialization. This causes large firms to expand and small firms to shrink in equilibrium, accounting for the observed increase in inventor employment concentration. Because firms do not internalize knowledge spillovers, there is misallocation of inventors across firms. The rise of team production amplifies this misallocation by a factor of six by reallocating inventors away from small firms that generate disproportionately large knowledge spillovers.
url:e72b5d06872c221a.abstract_zh: 如今，美国超过80%的专利由发明人团队产出，而1976年这一比例仅为45%。同期，发明人就业日益集中于大型企业，其集中度增幅是整体就业集中度的六倍。为解释这些趋势，我们构建了一个企业内团队形成的内生新模型，并将其嵌入发明人劳动力市场的一般均衡模型中。团队通过提高发明人之间有效匹配的可能性，增强了企业的规模报酬。这些匹配的价值随时间上升，可能源于知识专业化程度的加深。这导致均衡状态下大企业扩张、小企业收缩，从而解释了观察到的发明人就业集中度上升现象。由于企业未将知识溢出内部化，发明人在企业间的配置存在错配。团队生产的兴起通过将发明人从小企业重新分配出去，加剧了这种错配，其影响程度放大六倍，而小企业恰恰产生了不成比例的巨大知识溢出。
url:e72b5d06872c221a.title: DP21817 Ideas and Firm Dynamics When It Takes Two to Tango
url:e72b5d06872c221a.title_zh: DP21817 思想与公司动态：当合作需要双方共舞时
