url:f049d6530597a979.abstract: we develop a two-sector, small open-economy model featuring imperfect international risk-sharing and household heterogeneity, capturing both the supply-side and demand side effects of fragmentation. In the model, fragmentation takes the form of import-price increases or a decline in tradable-sector productivity. The sign and magnitude of its impact on inflationary pressures, and the appropriate policy response, depend not only on the direct effect of higher import prices or lower productivity on supply but also, crucially, on how aggregate demand adjusts to lower real incomes. In turn, this depends on the pace of fragmentation (gradual versus front-loaded) and other key structural factors highlighted by the model. We compare outcomes under Taylor-type monetary policy rules to a constrained-efficient allocation.

url:f064a2ba8c59bba5.abstract: The paper studies how high leverage and crises can arise as a result of changes in the income distribution. Empirically, the periods 1920-1929 and 1983-2007 both exhibited a large increase in the income share of the rich, a large increase in leverage for the remainder, and an eventual financial and real crisis. The paper presents a theoretical model where these features arise endogenously as a result of a shift in bargaining powers over incomes. A financial crisis can reduce leverage if it is very large and not accompanied by a real contraction. But restoration of the lower income group?s bargaining power is more effective.
url:f064a2ba8c59bba5.abstract_zh: 本文研究了收入分配变化如何导致高杠杆和危机的产生。实证分析表明，1920-1929年与1983-2007年两个时期均呈现以下特征：富裕阶层收入份额大幅上升，其余群体杠杆率显著提高，并最终引发金融与实体经济危机。本文构建了一个理论模型，揭示这些特征如何因收入议价能力的转变而内生形成。金融危机会在规模极大且未伴随实体经济收缩时降低杠杆率，但恢复低收入群体的议价能力更为有效。

url:f083118e7045ee57.abstract: We study how the design of subnational political borders shapes the salience of ethnicity in politics. We introduce a framework for measuring how political borders align with a country's ethnic geography at the micro level. We then leverage quasi-experimental variation in the alignment introduced by Kenya's 2010 constitutional reform, which divided the country's eight provinces into 47 counties. Our results suggest that ethnofederal reforms, i.e., reforms that increase the alignment between political borders and ethnic geography, would reduce ethnic voting in national elections. Finally, we evaluate alternative border designs and derive the design that would minimize ethnic voting.
url:f083118e7045ee57.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了地方政治边界的设计如何影响政治中族群性的显著性。我们提出了一种框架，用于在微观层面衡量政治边界与国家族群地理的契合度。随后，我们利用肯尼亚2010年宪法改革引入的准实验性变化，该改革将全国八个省划分为47个县。我们的研究结果表明，民族联邦制改革，即增强政治边界与族群地理契合度的改革，会减少全国选举中的族群投票现象。最后，我们评估了替代性的边界设计方案，并推导出能最小化族群投票的最优设计。

url:f1424a94e9ca2bf1.abstract: This paper examines whether financial incentives for general practitioners (GPs) can effectively replace patient cost-sharing within a gatekeeper healthcare system in which the GP regulates access to specialist care. We estimate the effects of incentives provided to GPs by exploiting a field experiment in which treated GPs received a share of the cost savings they achieved. There was also a set of control practices. The patient population includes about 26,000 individuals and is largely representative of the overall population in the Netherlands. We estimate the effects of incentives for patients provided by a deductible using a simulated instrumental variables approach. For both sets of analyses, we use the same measures of healthcare costs, the same time period, and the same population of patients. Our findings show that the incentives provided to GPs reduce costs by 4.3 percent, mainly by decreasing less-urgent specialist care. A small patient deductible of 375 euros per year reduces costs by 27.8 percent in each month in which patients still have to pay out-of-pocket and 10.4 percent at the annual level, impacting all types of care. In contrast, physicians discriminate by type and priority of care. We do not find clear patterns for the interaction of incentives provided to GPs and patients. Our results suggest that GP incentives may complement but not fully replace patient deductibles in managing healthcare costs effectively.
url:f1424a94e9ca2bf1.abstract_zh: 本文探讨在由全科医生（GP）控制专科医疗服务准入的守门人医疗体系中，对全科医生的经济激励能否有效替代患者费用共担机制。我们通过一项田野实验评估对全科医生的激励效果：实验组全科医生可获得其实现的成本节约份额，同时设置对照组。患者样本约2.6万人，在荷兰总体人口中具有较高代表性。我们采用模拟工具变量法，估计免赔额对患者的激励效应。两组分析均使用相同的医疗成本指标、时间区间及患者群体。研究结果表明：对全科医生的激励使医疗成本降低4.3%，主要通过减少非紧急专科服务实现；而每年375欧元的小额患者免赔额，在患者仍需自付费用的月份中每月降低27.8%的成本，年度层面降低10.4%，且影响所有类型的医疗服务。相比之下，医生会根据护理类型和优先级进行差异化调整。我们未发现全科医生与患者激励之间存在清晰的交互作用模式。研究结论表明，在有效管理医疗成本方面，全科医生激励措施可补充但无法完全替代患者免赔额制度。

url:f1459f7794f33200.abstract: We develop a small open economy model with overlapping generations to analyse the macroeconomic, distributional, and political economy effects of unilateral climate policy under an emissions cap. Carbon pricing lowers wages and thus human wealth, while financial assets continue to earn the world interest rate. This asymmetry generates sharp generational and cross country differences: in creditor economies the young lose most, whereas in debtor economies the old bear the heaviest burden as they must reduce their debt when incomes fall. We compare constant carbon taxes with efficient Hotelling price paths and show that delayed implementation dramatically raises the carbon price needed to meet a fixed emissions cap, especially in debtor economies. Hotelling pricing yields substantially lower near term welfare losses. Across all policies, carbon pricing depresses wages, reduces consumption and human wealth, and induces capital flight; labour supply responses differ by asset position. Public debt can be used to secure majority support for climate policy by shifting part of the burden to future generations—more easily so in creditor economies than debtor ones. Since labour tax cuts counteract the wage depression caused by climate policy, less debt is needed to obtain a political majority.
url:f1459f7794f33200.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含世代交叠的小型开放经济模型，以分析排放上限约束下单边气候政策的宏观经济效应、分配效应及政治经济学影响。碳定价会降低工资水平进而减少人力财富，而金融资产仍能获得世界利率回报。这种非对称性导致显著的代际与跨国差异：在债权经济体中，年轻群体损失最大；而在债务经济体中，老年群体因收入下降需削减债务而承受最重负担。我们比较了恒定碳税与霍特林最优价格路径，结果表明：延迟实施会显著推高满足固定排放上限所需的碳价，尤其在债务经济体中更为突出。霍特林定价能大幅降低短期福利损失。在所有政策情景下，碳定价均会压低工资、减少消费与人力财富，并引发资本外逃；劳动力供给反应则因资产持有状况而异。通过将部分负担转移至未来世代，公共债务可争取多数民众对气候政策的支持——这一策略在债权经济体中比债务经济体更容易实现。由于劳动税削减可抵消气候政策导致的工资下降效应，获取政治多数所需的债务规模将相应减少。
url:f1459f7794f33200.title: The Politics of Carbon Pricing: Young vs. Old, Debtors vs. Creditors

url:f14ea12b15501993.abstract: We estimate the long-term mental health impact of an alcohol policy experiment on individuals exposed to the policy in utero. The policy lasted for 8.5 months and significantly expanded access to alcohol, especially for those under age 21. Armed with administrative data on healthcare visits, drug prescriptions, and psychological assessments and applying a triple-differences strategy, we show that prenatal policy exposure had a substantial, early, and persistent impact on the mental health of the children of young mothers. The exposed cohorts conceived just before the policy started are 16% more likely to be diagnosed with a mental condition in midlife. We find effects on common midlife conditions such as depression and anxiety, on the ability to cope with psychologically stressful situations at age 18, and on neurodevelopmental disorders that manifest in early childhood. Among individuals with predicted mental health care needs, the impact of the policy on midlife earnings is significantly lower when they reside in areas with lower barriers to accessing mental health care, with a one-standard-deviation increase in local treatment intensity reducing the negative earnings effect by about one-third. Our findings indicate that policies increasing access to mental health treatments could substantially improve labor market outcomes, even for conditions with early-life origins.
url:f14ea12b15501993.abstract_zh: 我们估算了某项酒精政策实验对子宫内暴露个体的长期心理健康影响。该政策持续了8.5个月，显著扩大了酒精获取渠道，尤其对21岁以下人群影响显著。基于医疗就诊、处方药及心理评估的行政数据，并采用三重差分策略，我们证明产前政策暴露对年轻母亲子女的心理健康产生了显著、早期且持续的影响。在政策启动前受孕的暴露队列，中年时期被诊断出心理疾病的概率高出16%。我们发现该政策对常见中年疾病（如抑郁症和焦虑症）、18岁时应对心理压力情境的能力，以及儿童早期显现的神经发育障碍均存在影响。在预测有心理健康护理需求的个体中，当居住地获取心理护理的障碍较低时，政策对中年收入的影响显著减弱——当地治疗强度每增加一个标准差，负面收入效应约减少三分之一。我们的研究结果表明，增加心理治疗可及性的政策能够显著改善劳动力市场表现，即使对于源于生命早期的疾病也是如此。

url:f1771734d5ba1bc2.abstract: Aggregate productivity growth in Europe has disappointed over the last two decades, fuelling concerns about competitiveness. This column argues that firm-level evidence points to a more optimistic picture. Productivity differences between firms have stopped widening, and initially low-productivity firms have started moving up the productivity ladder. To speed up productivity convergence within industries, policies should reduce regulatory and administrative barriers to entry and expansion, strengthen competition enforcement, and deepen the Single Market. Investing in a European harmonised framework for firm-level data is also key for understanding productivity developments and devising economic policy.
url:f1771734d5ba1bc2.abstract_zh: 过去二十年，欧洲总体生产率增长令人失望，引发了对竞争力的担忧。本文认为，企业层面的证据指向了一个更为乐观的景象。企业间的生产率差距已停止扩大，起初生产率较低的企业开始向生产率阶梯的上方移动。为了加速行业内生产率的趋同，政策应减少进入和扩张的监管及行政障碍，加强竞争执法，并深化单一市场。投资于欧洲统一的企业层面数据框架，对于理解生产率动态和制定经济政策也至关重要。

url:f19ecb134715b030.abstract: This paper presents a model of the interaction between a bank and a supervisor. The bank privately chooses the risk of its investment portfolio and the supervisor collects nonverifiable information on the future solvency of the bank and, based on of this information, may decide on its early liquidation. The paper characterizes the liquidation decision of the supervisor and the risk-taking decision of the bank. In line with recent empirical literature, the paper shows that supervision is effective in ameliorating the bank's risk-shifting incentives, and that a tougher supervisor leads to lower risk-taking. It also shows that higher noise in the supervisory information may be conducive to lower risk-taking, but that it always reduces welfare.
url:f19ecb134715b030.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个银行与监管者互动的模型。银行私下选择其投资组合的风险水平，而监管者收集关于银行未来偿付能力的不可验证信息，并基于此信息可能决定是否提前清算银行。本文刻画了监管者的清算决策与银行的风险承担决策。与近期实证文献一致，本文表明监管在缓解银行风险转移激励方面是有效的，且更严格的监管者会导致更低的风险承担。同时，本文还指出，监管信息中更高的噪声可能有助于降低风险承担，但始终会降低社会福利。

url:f1a988f028875b14.abstract: This paper analyses the long-memory properties of sovereign bond spreads in 17 Latin American countries as well as two regional aggregates using daily EMBI (Emerging Markets Bond Index) data from April 2013 to January 2026 (3, 163 observations per series). Parametric methods show that all 19 series are characterized by fractional integration with estimated orders ranging from 0.97 (Uruguay) to 1.22 (Honduras) for the log-transformed spreads. Nine series have confidence bounds above unity, indicating that shocks have permanent effects; under autocorrelated errors (as in the Bloomfield model), Uruguay is the only country whose series exhibits mean reversion (as the confidence bands for the fractional parameter are below unity). The results are robust to making different assumptions about the error terms (white noise or autocorrelation) and to allowing for non-linear deterministic trends.
url:f1a988f028875b14.abstract_zh: 本文利用2013年4月至2026年1月期间（每序列3,163个观测值）的每日EMBI（新兴市场债券指数）数据，分析了17个拉丁美洲国家及两个区域总体的主权债券利差的长期记忆特性。参数方法表明，所有19个序列均呈现分数积分特征，对数转换后的利差估计阶数介于0.97（乌拉圭）至1.22（洪都拉斯）之间。其中9个序列的置信区间上限超过1，表明冲击具有持久性影响；在自相关误差假设下（如Bloomfield模型），乌拉圭是唯一一个序列呈现均值回归特征的国家（因其分数参数置信区间下限低于1）。上述结果在调整误差项假设（白噪声或自相关）以及允许非线性确定性趋势的情况下依然稳健。

url:f1f23892f5366004.abstract: The European Union's AI Act – the world’s most ambitious regulatory framework for artificial intelligence to date – was supposed to enter into full effect on 2 August 2026. But while the AI Act's transparency layer has come into effect, obliging providers to inform individuals when they interact with an AI system, its high-risk regime – covering biometric identification, recruitment systems, credit scoring, law enforcement, and border control – has been delayed. This column argues that the result is a double bind in which Europe loses regulatory sovereignty whether it enforces its own rules or retreats from them.
url:f1f23892f5366004.abstract_zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》——迄今为止全球最具雄心的AI监管框架——原定于2026年8月2日全面生效。然而，尽管该法案的透明度条款已生效，要求提供商在个人与AI系统互动时告知对方，但其高风险制度——涵盖生物识别、招聘系统、信用评分、执法及边境管控——已被推迟。本专栏认为，其结果是一种双重困境：无论欧洲是执行自身规则还是退让回避，都将丧失监管主权。

url:f2899682695049f0.abstract: Über Wähler:innen der AfD dominieren häufig vereinfachende Stereotype: Sie gelten entweder als sozial abgehängte Protestwähler:innen oder als geschlossen radikal rechtes Milieu. Beides greift zu kurz. Das vorliegende Policy Paper zeigt, dass die AfD-Wählerschaft zwar durch migrations- und kulturpolitische Restriktivität verbunden ist, zugleich aber unterschiedliche politische Profile umfasst. Diese unterscheiden sich darin, wie stark Zuwanderungsablehnung mit Autoritarismus, antisemitischen Ressentiments und pessimistischen Einschätzungen der deutschen Wirtschaftslage verknüpft ist. Die Ergebnisse sprechen dafür, im Umgang mit der AfD-Wählerschaft stärker zu differenzieren.
url:f2899682695049f0.abstract_zh: 关于德国选择党（AfD）选民，常常流行着过于简化的刻板印象：他们要么被视为社会边缘化的抗议选民，要么被视为铁板一块的激进右翼群体。这两种看法都失之偏颇。本政策文件表明，AfD选民虽然因移民和文化政策上的限制性立场而联结在一起，但同时也包含不同的政治面貌。这些差异体现在，对移民的排斥与威权主义、反犹怨恨情绪以及对德国经济形势的悲观评估之间的关联强度各不相同。研究结果支持在与AfD选民打交道时进行更细致的区分。
url:f2899682695049f0.title: Von kultureller Restriktion und autoritärer Radikalität: Eine typologische Analyse der AfD-Wählerschaft

url:f29d8e6509f7e5ef.abstract: Over 2 billion people worldwide travel long distances daily to fetch water that is often unsafe for human consumption. This paper studies how lack of water can limit economic development and how families adapt to permanent shifts in water provision in rural areas. It studies a policy providing 1 million rain-fed water cisterns in Brazil's poorest and most drought-prone areas. Using unique individual-level administrative data and a difference-in-differences design, we show that the program substantially improved family welfare. In ten years, household dependency on cash transfers decrease by as much as 19 percentage points while formal labor earnings increase by 15% driven by an increase in off-farm jobs. In turn, hospitalizations due to waterborne diseases declined by 16% among adults and 37% among children, and compliance with cash transfer conditionalities on child health and education improved. Additional evidence suggests that these gains were driven by a relaxation of time constraints: cisterns markedly reduced the time burden of water collection, enabling beneficiaries to allocate more time to productive activities. A cost-benefit analysis indicates a high marginal value of public funds relative to a broad range of public policies.
url:f29d8e6509f7e5ef.abstract_zh: 全球超过20亿人每天需要长途跋涉取水，而这些水往往不适合人类饮用。本文研究水资源匮乏如何制约经济发展，以及农村家庭如何适应供水条件的永久性变化。我们聚焦于一项在巴西最贫困且最易干旱地区推广100万个雨水收集蓄水池的政策。利用独特的个人层面行政数据与双重差分法，研究发现该政策显著提升了家庭福利。十年间，家庭对现金转移支付的依赖度下降高达19个百分点，正规劳动收入增长15%，主要源于非农就业岗位的增加。与此同时，成人因水传播疾病住院率下降16%，儿童下降37%，且家庭对现金转移支付中儿童健康与教育附加条件的遵守情况有所改善。进一步证据表明，这些收益源于时间约束的缓解：蓄水池大幅减少了取水时间负担，使受益者能将更多时间投入生产活动。成本收益分析显示，相较于广泛公共政策，该政策的公共资金边际价值较高。
url:f29d8e6509f7e5ef.title: Cisterns, Climate Adaptation, and Economic Development

url:f2a39cfee25dac25.abstract: An inflation and stabilization bias may arise as a result of the principal-agent nature of monetary policy. Both depend on the degree of political uncertainty and the type of relationship between central bankers and the incumbent political leaders. Specifically, our analysis indicates how a close relationship between central bankers and incumbent political leaders can lead to undesirable outcomes, particularly so during periods of electoral competition and political uncertainty. Various institutional proposals exist for resolving this problem. Our analysis shows that in contrast to Friedman-type policy rules or the appointment of `conservative' central bankers, personal independence of the central banker from government or performance-orientated compensation packages can achieve both optimal stabilization and the elimination of the inflation bias.
url:f2a39cfee25dac25.abstract_zh: 货币政策的委托-代理性质可能导致通胀偏差和稳定偏差。这两种偏差均取决于政治不确定性程度以及央行官员与现任政治领袖之间的关系类型。具体而言，我们的分析表明，央行官员与现任政治领袖之间的密切关系可能引发不良后果，在选举竞争和政治不确定性时期尤为显著。针对这一问题，现有多种制度性解决方案。我们的分析显示，与弗里德曼式政策规则或任命"保守型"央行官员不同，央行官员相对于政府的个人独立性或基于绩效的薪酬方案，既能实现最优稳定，又能消除通胀偏差。

url:f2cbff99edc51e1a.abstract: This paper examines how climate change and natural resource dynamics contribute to conflict, with a focus on the implications of the green transition. It reviews empirical evidence showing that extreme weather events - such as droughts, floods, and heatwaves - are linked to increased violence, particularly through economic disruptions, reduced agricultural productivity, and displacement. The analysis also explores the mechanisms through which climate shocks influence conflict, including opportunity costs, resource competition, and behavioral responses to environmental stress. The discussion then turns to the role of natural resource exploitation, especially in the context of rising demand for minerals essential to low-carbon technologies. The paper highlights how resource price and availability shocks can trigger conflict, often depending on the type of resource, extraction method, and local governance. It also addresses the overlap between climate- and resource-driven conflict risks, emphasizing that their interaction may amplify instability. Throughout, the paper identifies open research questions related to prediction, the effects of long-run environmental changes, and the design of policy responses. These include insurance schemes, climate adaptation strategies, infrastructure investment, and regulatory frameworks for resource governance. The findings point to the need for research that integrates climate and conflict dynamics, with the goal of informing policies that can mitigate the risks associated with environmental change and resource pressures.
url:f2cbff99edc51e1a.abstract_zh: 本文探讨气候变化与自然资源动态如何加剧冲突，重点关注绿色转型的影响。通过梳理实证证据，研究发现极端天气事件（如干旱、洪水和热浪）与暴力事件增加存在关联，其传导机制主要体现为经济紊乱、农业减产及人口迁移。分析进一步揭示了气候冲击影响冲突的传导路径，包括机会成本变化、资源竞争加剧以及环境压力下的行为响应。随后，研究转向自然资源开采的作用，尤其聚焦低碳技术所需关键矿产需求上升的背景。本文强调，资源价格与供给冲击可能触发冲突，其影响程度取决于资源类型、开采方式及地方治理水平。研究还指出气候驱动与资源驱动的冲突风险存在重叠，二者相互作用可能加剧不稳定。全文系统梳理了预测方法、长期环境变化效应及政策响应设计等未解研究问题，涵盖保险机制、气候适应策略、基础设施投资及资源治理监管框架。研究结论表明，亟需开展气候与冲突动态的整合研究，为制定缓解环境变化与资源压力相关风险的政策提供依据。
url:f2cbff99edc51e1a.title: Climate Change, Natural Resources, and Conflict
url:f2cbff99edc51e1a.title_zh: 气候变化、自然资源与冲突

url:f311a743eba17ee0.abstract: This paper provides first and second-order approximation methods for the solution of non-linear dynamic stochastic models in which the exogenous state variables follow conditionally-linear stochastic processes displaying time-varying risk. The first-order approximation is consistent with a conditionally-linear model in which risk is still time-varying but has no distinct role - separated from the primitive stochastic disturbances- in influencing the endogenous variables. The second-order approximation of the solution, instead, is sufficient to get this role. Moreover, risk premia, evaluated using only a first-order approximation of the solution, will be also time varying.
url:f311a743eba17ee0.abstract_zh: 本文提出了求解非线性动态随机模型的一阶和二阶近似方法，其中外生状态变量遵循具有时变风险的条件线性随机过程。一阶近似与条件线性模型一致，在该模型中风险虽仍具有时变性，但在影响内生变量方面并未发挥独立于原始随机扰动的独特作用。而解的二阶近似则足以体现这一作用。此外，仅使用解的一阶近似评估的风险溢价也将呈现时变性。
url:f311a743eba17ee0.title: Second Order Approximation of Dynamic Models with Time-Varying Risk
url:f311a743eba17ee0.title_zh: 时变风险动态模型的二阶近似

url:f32bfe019ee75f50.abstract: We estimate the global price of credit risk from a large cross section of global corporate bond returns. We show that a single factor, constructed as a nonlinear function of past credit spreads, equity market volatility, and their interactions, prices bond returns in both the time series and the cross section. The factor significantly outperforms alternative measures of global financial conditions, explaining up to 13% of variation in bond-level three-month-ahead returns. A high global price of credit risk further translates into deteriorations in local credit conditions, outflows from global funds, and higher expected returns to global funds.
url:f32bfe019ee75f50.abstract_zh: 我们基于全球公司债券收益的大截面数据，对信用风险的全球价格进行了估计。研究表明，一个由历史信用利差、股票市场波动性及其交互作用的非线性函数构成的单一因子，能够同时在时间序列和截面维度上为债券收益定价。该因子显著优于其他全球金融状况的替代指标，可解释债券层面未来三个月收益变动的13%。全球信用风险价格的高企进一步转化为本地信用状况的恶化、全球基金的资金外流以及全球基金预期收益率的上升。
url:f32bfe019ee75f50.title: The Global Credit Cycle

url:f331ef24edc646b4.abstract: This paper provides a first comprehensive assessment of industrial policy (IP) across Asia‑Pacific and its potential to enable structural transformation. Building an IP database for 2009–2024, paired with a rich dataset, the paper documents a large wave of IP interventions. Subsidies dominate, followed by import-limiting measures. Novel applications of machine‑learning and clustering approaches to assess IP targeting suggest that, ex-ante, about three-quarters of IP could align with structural transformation strategies, including relatively safe (“safe-bets”) and risky (“moonshots”) strategies promoting technological upgrading and diversification, and strategies to alleviate market‑frictions and distortions in key sectoral nodes. IP’s ex-post linkages to trade, competitiveness, and domestic firms’ indicators are small and short‑lived; sustained gains that could lead into structural transformation appear only sporadically. Our findings underscore the need for a more parsimonious and carefully‑designed IP—anchored to targeting clear market‑failure rationales and complemented by ambitious structural reforms—potentially enhancing effectiveness and lowering net costs.
url:f331ef24edc646b4.abstract_zh: 本文首次系统评估了亚太地区的产业政策及其推动结构性转型的潜力。通过构建2009-2024年产业政策数据库，并结合丰富的数据集，本文记录了大规模的产业政策干预浪潮。其中，补贴政策占据主导地位，其次为进口限制措施。采用机器学习与聚类分析等创新方法对产业政策靶向性进行评估后发现，事前来看，约四分之三的产业政策可能与结构性转型战略相契合，包括促进技术升级与多元化的相对稳健型策略及高风险策略，以及缓解关键行业节点市场摩擦与扭曲的策略。产业政策在事后与贸易、竞争力及国内企业指标的关联性较弱且持续时间短暂；能够持续推动结构性转型的收益仅零星出现。研究结果强调，需要制定更精简且精心设计的产业政策——以明确的市场失灵原因为靶向，并辅以雄心勃勃的结构性改革——从而可能提升政策有效性并降低净成本。
url:f331ef24edc646b4.title: A New Wave of Industrial Policy in Asia-Pacific: Could Resurgence lead to Structural Transformation?
url:f331ef24edc646b4.title_zh: 亚太地区产业政策新浪潮：复苏能否引领结构转型？

url:f348b5fa7468d282.abstract: This article examines how accelerating automation and the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in advanced economies reshape labor markets across the Global South through interconnected channels of production, migration, and remittances. Drawing on the theories and practices of economic geography, labor economics, and development studies, the analysis conceptualizes automation as a transnational shock that contracts demand for migrant labor while simultaneously amplifying employment precarity in labor-surplus economies. The article advances a geographically grounded framework linking technology adoption in core industries with labor displacement, youth unemployment, and urban labor saturation in South Asia and North Africa. It further highlights the macroeconomic vulnerabilities in developing countries arising from remittance dependence and the role of digital media in shaping youth mobilization and political unrest in their native countries. By integrating comparative regional field evidence with a technology–labor–space framework, the study contributes to economic geography by demonstrating how digital transformation reconfigures development patterns across regions and countries. The findings underscore the limits of technology-led growth strategies in labor-abundant contexts and call for employment-centered digital policies that are spatially differentiated and institutionally grounded. Keywords: automation, artificial intelligence, labor markets, remittances, youth unemployment, economic geography, Global South.
url:f348b5fa7468d282.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了发达经济体加速自动化和人工智能应用如何通过生产、移民和汇款等相互关联的渠道重塑全球南方的劳动力市场。基于经济地理学、劳动经济学和发展研究的理论与实践，本文将自动化概念化为一种跨国冲击，它既压缩了对移民劳动力的需求，同时加剧了劳动力过剩经济体的就业不稳定性。文章提出了一个基于地理视角的分析框架，将核心产业的技术采纳与南亚及北非地区的劳动力转移、青年失业和城市劳动力饱和联系起来。文章进一步强调了发展中国家因依赖汇款而产生的宏观经济脆弱性，以及数字媒体在塑造本国青年动员和政治动荡中的作用。通过将区域比较实地证据与技术—劳动力—空间框架相结合，本研究展示了数字化转型如何重构区域和国家间的发展模式，从而为经济地理学做出贡献。研究结论揭示了在劳动力充裕背景下技术驱动增长战略的局限性，并呼吁制定以就业为中心、具有空间差异性和制度基础的数字政策。关键词：自动化，人工智能，劳动力市场，汇款，青年失业，经济地理学，全球南方。

url:f369b83971d55c86.abstract: We develop a transferable-utility model in which the collapse of arable estate income reshaped the aristocratic marriage market. The model predicts two cash-for-prestige substitution channels: a durable senior shift toward American brides, especially liquid new-money fortunes, and a transitory junior shift toward British commercial commoners, whose wealth scaled only weakly with rank. Analyzing 6,018 aristocratic marriages over 1840–1913, we combine trend-adjusted time-series evidence with cross-sectional exposure gradients in estate value and family size. American marriages rise as real wheat prices fall, especially among senior, larger-estate, and larger-family peers; new-money brides rise from 20% to 60% of classified American matches.
url:f369b83971d55c86.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个可转移效用模型，其中农业地产收入的崩溃重塑了贵族婚姻市场。该模型预测了两种以金钱换取声望的替代渠道：一种是对美国新娘，特别是流动性强的新贵财富的持久性高级别转向；另一种是对英国商业平民的短暂性低级别转向，后者的财富与等级关联度较弱。通过分析1840年至1913年间6018桩贵族婚姻，我们结合了趋势调整的时间序列证据与地产价值和家庭规模方面的横截面暴露梯度。随着实际小麦价格下降，美国婚姻数量上升，尤其在高级别、大地产业和大家庭的贵族中更为显著；新贵新娘在分类的美国婚姻匹配中占比从20%升至60%。

url:f3ca8e3e7da4fa01.abstract: We study the pricing of bank deposits in the Euro area during 2007--2024. We document that the pass-through of policy rates to sight deposit rates is low, asymmetric, varies across countries, and decreases over time. We estimate an equilibrium model of bank deposit markets, and find that depositors' price sensitivity exhibits large heterogeneity across EU markets and over time. Rate-sensitive depositors switched to higher-yielding savings products, decreasing the rate-sensitivity of the remaining pool of sight deposits and increasing banks' market power, accounting for the sluggish pass-through following the 2022 European Central Bank's rate hikes.
url:f3ca8e3e7da4fa01.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2007至2024年欧元区银行存款的定价机制。我们记录到，政策利率向活期存款利率的传导呈现低水平、非对称性、跨国差异显著且随时间递减的特征。通过构建银行存款市场均衡模型进行估计，发现存款人的价格敏感度在欧盟各市场及不同时期存在显著异质性。对利率敏感的存款人转向收益率更高的储蓄产品，导致剩余活期存款池的利率敏感度下降，银行市场势力增强，这解释了2022年欧洲央行加息后传导机制迟滞的现象。

url:f41bf8f4889e877f.abstract: This paper provides a critical review of the Too Much Finance literature, both in its academic contribution and as response to the earlier finance and growth literature. We describe the academic origins and development of the finance and growth literature and discuss pitfalls with the commonly used indicators of financial development. We explore how the finance and growth research findings can be translated into policy recommendations including with respect to the trade-off between growth and stability. Finally, we argue that the the question of ‘can there be too much finance’ contains actually three questions: can there be too much credit, can there be too large a financial sector, and can there be too much financial development.
url:f41bf8f4889e877f.abstract_zh: 本文对“过度金融化”文献进行了批判性评述，既探讨其学术贡献，也将其视为对早期金融与增长文献的回应。我们描述了金融与增长文献的学术起源与发展脉络，并讨论了常用金融发展指标存在的缺陷。我们探究了金融与增长的研究发现如何转化为政策建议，包括在增长与稳定之间的权衡问题。最后，我们认为“是否存在过度金融化”这一问题实际上包含三个子问题：是否存在过度信贷、是否存在过大的金融部门、以及是否存在过度的金融发展。
url:f41bf8f4889e877f.title: Can there be too much finance? A complex answer to a simple question

url:f456f899dea000cd.abstract: We study the impact of a program designed to enhance data literacy on graduate students’ skills and academic outcomes in a large Italian university. The program (i.e. a minor) targets students who are expected to have weak quantitative competences and offers 120-hours training focused on improving the ability to interpret and process data, in addition to the regular courses of the master program in which students are enrolled (i.e. their major). The admission process to the minor is characterized by rationing, resolved by random assignment of available slots to applicants. Exploiting the resulting exogenous variation for identification, we find that the program largely improved digital literacy of participants with low pre-treatment levels of numeracy. Despite the additional effort required by the program, we can rule out any slowdown in the progress of the academic career in the major master program of participating students.
url:f456f899dea000cd.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一项旨在提升数据素养的项目对某大型意大利大学研究生技能及学业成果的影响。该项目（即辅修专业）针对预期定量能力较弱的学生，提供120小时的培训，重点提升其解读和处理数据的能力，同时不干扰学生所注册硕士主修专业的常规课程。辅修专业的录取过程存在名额限制，通过随机分配可用名额给申请者来解决。利用由此产生的外生变异进行识别，我们发现该项目显著提升了预处理阶段数值能力较低参与者的数字素养。尽管项目要求额外努力，我们可以排除参与学生在主修硕士项目中学业进展出现任何放缓的情况。

url:f48e58888a1e51e0.abstract: Sovereigns self-insure via reserve accumulation, prioritizing liquidity over yield. This practice imposes opportunity costs and can amplify the convenience premium on traditional reserve assets. This paper evaluates Synthetic Reserve Deposits (SRDs), a pooling mechanism designed to improve the return-liquidity trade-off. Participants would hold floating-value claims on a vehicle comprising a settlement buffer, an investment portfolio, and, in some designs, an optional collateralized liquidity window. The architecture separates the allocation of portfolio risk from the provision of short-term foreign-currency liquidity: market risk remains with SRD holders, while liquidity is provided through redemption at contemporaneous executable value or through secured advances. Simulations illustrate that the structure can shift the return-liquidity frontier outward under explicit downside-risk constraints. General equilibrium modeling suggests that, if implemented at sufficient scale and under appropriate conditions, reallocating reserve demand through this mechanism could increase the effective supply of reserve claims and affect the global financial cycle, creating aggregate welfare gains and possibly Pareto improvements depending on initial global asset positions.
url:f48e58888a1e51e0.abstract_zh: 主权国家通过积累外汇储备进行自我保险，优先考虑流动性而非收益。这种做法会产生机会成本，并可能放大传统储备资产的便利溢价。本文评估了合成储备存款（SRDs）这一旨在改善收益-流动性权衡的集合机制。参与者将持有对某一工具的可变价值债权，该工具包含结算缓冲池、投资组合，以及在某些设计中增设的可选抵押流动性窗口。该架构将组合风险配置与短期外币流动性供给相分离：市场风险由SRD持有者承担，流动性则通过按当前可执行价值赎回或通过担保垫款提供。模拟分析表明，在明确的下行风险约束下，该结构可将收益-流动性边界向外推移。一般均衡模型显示，若在适当条件下以足够规模实施，通过该机制重新配置储备需求可增加储备债权的有效供给，影响全球金融周期，产生总体福利收益，并可能根据初始全球资产头寸实现帕累托改进。
url:f48e58888a1e51e0.title: Upgrading the Global Financial Safety Net: Implications of a Synthetic Reserve Deposit
url:f48e58888a1e51e0.title_zh: 升级全球金融安全网：合成储备存款的影响

url:f49ee1f16d6397fb.abstract: We develop an efficient and easy-to-use computational method for solving a wide class of general equilibrium heterogeneous agent models with aggregate shocks, together with an open source suite of codes that implement our algorithms in an easy-to-use toolbox. Our method extends standard linearization techniques and is designed to work in cases when inequality matters for the dynamics of macroeconomic aggregates. We present two applications that analyze a two-asset incomplete markets model parameterized to match the distribution of income, wealth, and marginal propensities to consume. First, we show that our model is consistent with two key features of aggregate consumption dynamics that are difficult to match with representative agent models: (i) the sensitivity of aggregate consumption to predictable changes in aggregate income and (ii) the relative smoothness of aggregate consumption. Second, we extend the model to feature capital-skill complementarity and show how factor-specific productivity shocks shape dynamics of income and consumption inequality.
url:f49ee1f16d6397fb.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种高效且易于使用的计算方法，用于求解一类广泛的具有总体冲击的一般均衡异质性主体模型，并附带一套开源代码套件，以易于使用的工具箱形式实现我们的算法。我们的方法扩展了标准线性化技术，旨在处理不平等对宏观经济总量动态产生影响的情形。我们展示了两个应用，分析了一个参数化以匹配收入、财富和边际消费倾向分布的两资产不完全市场模型。首先，我们证明我们的模型与代表性主体模型难以匹配的总体消费动态的两个关键特征一致：（i）总体消费对可预测的总体收入变化的敏感性，以及（ii）总体消费的相对平滑性。其次，我们将模型扩展至包含资本-技能互补性，并展示要素特定生产率冲击如何塑造收入和消费不平等动态。
url:f49ee1f16d6397fb.title: When Inequality Matters for Macro and Macro Matters for Inequality
url:f49ee1f16d6397fb.title_zh: 当不平等对宏观重要，宏观对不平等也重要时

url:f4b497ce2aff5822.abstract: Using survey data from U.S. firms, we study the primitive beliefs for pricesetting: firms’ forecasts of their own marginal costs. These forecasts are disconnected from CPI expectations, (over)react to current and past costs systematically, and underreact to aggregate shocks until costs move. We show that under empirically realistic cost beliefs the New Keynesian Phillips curve is steeper and less forward-looking. Supply shocks are more inflationary because they hit costs quickly. Demand shocks are less inflationary because firms fail to anticipate future wage pressure. Forward guidance weakens at long horizons but strengthens in the near term.
url:f4b497ce2aff5822.abstract_zh: 利用美国企业的调查数据，我们研究了价格设定中的原始信念：企业对其自身边际成本的预测。这些预测与CPI预期脱节，系统性地对当前及过去的成本作出（过度）反应，并且对总体冲击反应不足，直至成本变动发生。我们表明，在经验上现实可行的成本信念下，新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线更为陡峭且前瞻性较弱。供给冲击更具通胀效应，因为它们迅速影响成本。需求冲击的通胀效应较弱，因为企业未能预见到未来的工资压力。前瞻指引在长期内效果减弱，但在短期内则增强。
url:f4b497ce2aff5822.title: How Firms Form Beliefs and the Implications for Inflation
url:f4b497ce2aff5822.title_zh: 企业如何形成信念及其对通货膨胀的影响

url:f4c629524adafb64.abstract: We examine the effects of legalizing fentanyl test strips (FTS), which identify the presence of fentanyl in recreational drugs, on overdose deaths. Using difference-in-differences methods, we find that purely increasing de jure access to fentanyl test strips (FTS), which can reduce information asymmetries regarding drug contents, had little effect on overdose mortality. We then examine the effects of multi-dimensional community-based interventions aimed at increasing de facto access to FTS and other harm reduction resources. These hands-on approaches were more effective in reducing overdose deaths. Together, these findings suggest that FTS are used at sub-optimal levels, and more active efforts to distribute them could reduce overdoses.
url:f4c629524adafb64.abstract_zh: 我们研究了将芬太尼试纸（FTS）合法化——这种试纸能识别娱乐性药物中芬太尼的存在——对过量致死的影响。采用双重差分方法，我们发现，仅从法律上增加芬太尼试纸的获取途径，虽能减少关于药物成分的信息不对称，但对过量死亡率影响甚微。随后，我们考察了旨在实际增加芬太尼试纸及其他减少伤害资源获取的多维度社区干预措施。这些实践性方法在降低过量死亡方面更为有效。综合来看，这些发现表明芬太尼试纸的使用未达最优水平，而更积极的推广分发努力或能减少过量事件。

url:f50f482794f2b427.abstract: We present a conceptual framework for the analysis of politically feasible tax reforms. First, we prove a median voter theorem for monotonic reforms of non-linear tax systems. This yields a characterization of reforms that are preferred by a majority of individuals over the status quo and hence politically feasible. Second, we show that every Pareto-efficient tax system is such that moving towards lower tax rates for below-median incomes and towards higher rates for above median incomes is politically feasible. Third, we develop a method for diagnosing whether a given tax system admits reforms that are politically feasible and/or welfare-improving
url:f50f482794f2b427.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个分析政治可行税制改革的概念框架。首先，我们证明了非线性税制单调改革的中间选民定理。这得出了多数个体相对于现状偏好且因此政治可行的改革特征。其次，我们表明，每个帕累托效率税制都使得向低于中位收入者降低税率、向高于中位收入者提高税率的变动在政治上是可行的。第三，我们开发了一种方法，用于诊断给定税制是否存在既政治可行又增进福利的改革。
url:f50f482794f2b427.title: DP13059 Politically feasible reforms of non-linear tax systems

url:f51357d36bc17dbd.abstract: This paper measures the causal effect of deficits on inflation using a “high frequency narrative approach”. We identify an event that released news about the 2021 deficits in the United States—the Georgia Senate election runoff. We calculate the size of the shock using new narrative data from investment banks. We then study the high frequency response of inflation forecasts from asset prices, in order to separate deficits from other factors affecting inflation. We estimate an “inflation multiplier” of 0.19% price level growth over two years, for a 1% deficit-to-GDP shock. Our estimate implies that the 2021 deficits caused around a third of the 2021-22 inflation—meaning deficits were important but not the only cause. A heterogeneous agent New Keynesian model quantitatively matches the size and dynamics of the inflation multiplier.
url:f51357d36bc17dbd.abstract_zh: 本文采用“高频叙事方法”衡量赤字对通胀的因果效应。我们识别出一个释放了2021年美国赤字相关新闻的事件——佐治亚州参议院决选。我们利用来自投资银行的新叙事数据计算冲击规模。随后，我们研究资产价格通胀预测的高频反应，以将赤字与其他影响通胀的因素区分开来。我们估计，对于1%的赤字占GDP比例冲击，两年内价格水平增长的“通胀乘数”为0.19%。我们的估计表明，2021年的赤字导致了2021-22年通胀的大约三分之一——这意味着赤字是重要因素，但并非唯一原因。一个异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型在数量上匹配了通胀乘数的大小和动态特征。
url:f51357d36bc17dbd.title: Do Deficits Cause Inflation? A High Frequency Narrative Approach

url:f578060ee3f7a916.abstract: Between 2025 and 2035, the largest-ever cohort of young people in emerging market and developing economies will reach working age. Slowing growth, overlapping crises, tight fiscal conditions, and weak job-creation capacity in many countries make creating enough good jobs for this generation one of the defining development challenges of the next decade. This column argues that, with determined policy action, this demographic wave can become a powerful engine of growth, poverty reduction, and development progress.
url:f578060ee3f7a916.abstract_zh: 2025年至2035年间，新兴市场和发展中经济体将迎来史上规模最大的青年群体进入劳动年龄。然而，多国面临增长放缓、危机叠加、财政紧缩及就业创造能力疲软等困境，如何为这一代人创造充足的优质就业岗位，将成为未来十年最具标志性的发展挑战。本文认为，若采取果断的政策行动，这一人口浪潮有望转化为推动经济增长、减贫与发展进程的强大引擎。
url:f578060ee3f7a916.title: A generational challenge: Turning a record youth surge into a jobs dividend
url:f578060ee3f7a916.title_zh: 代际挑战：将创纪录的青年人口激增转化为就业红利

url:f585f70cf36bf1a1.abstract: Over the past century, the United States has provided dollar liquidity abroad through both the US Treasury and the Federal Reserve, but the appropriate mode of liquidity injection depends on the economic, financial, and geopolitical contexts. The Treasury is the more appropriate lending conduit when geopolitical concerns dominate, while Fed dollar provision should primarily be targeted toward global stability objectives and be more insulated from short-term foreign policy motives. Up to now, political abuses of these foreign lending channels have been constrained to some degree by laws, norms, and intergovernmental understandings, but adherence can no longer be assumed, so more formal guardrails are needed.
url:f585f70cf36bf1a1.abstract_zh: 过去一个世纪以来，美国通过财政部和美联储向海外提供美元流动性，但适当的流动性注入模式取决于经济、金融和地缘政治背景。当地缘政治关切占主导地位时，财政部是更合适的贷款渠道，而美联储的美元供给应主要针对全球稳定目标，并更少受短期外交政策动机的影响。迄今为止，法律、规范和政府间谅解在一定程度上约束了这些对外贷款渠道的政治滥用，但已无法假定各方会继续遵守，因此需要更正式的防护措施。
url:f585f70cf36bf1a1.title: Taking geopolitically motivated US swap lines too far would harm the dollar and Fed independence

url:f59bb14fe5cd0416.abstract: On 28 January 2025 the second Trump administration issued a blanket stop-work order on the United States Agency for International Development (USAID), terminating the largest national bilateral aid programme worldwide. We use this natural experiment to estimate the impact of the aid cut on two outcomes in Africa: local economic activity, measured through nighttime light radiance around USAID project sites; and acute food insecurity, measured through the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) at the subnational level. First, the cessation of USAID activities produced a sharp and significant decline in nighttime light radiance within 500 m to 10 km of project sites, attenuating monotonically and undetectable at 25 km. Second, areas more exposed to USAID humanitarian assistance saw relative increases in population in IPC Phase 3 (Crisis) or worse and Phase 4 (Emergency), with effects building over the first post-shock year, amplified in higher-vulnerability regions and approximately fourteen times larger in less democratic countries. Third, both effects are driven by humanitarian-aid cuts; the nightlight effect is also driven by productive-sector cuts.
url:f59bb14fe5cd0416.abstract_zh: 2025年1月28日，第二届特朗普政府发布全面停工令，叫停美国国际开发署（USAID）业务，终止了全球规模最大的双边援助项目。我们利用这一自然实验，评估援助削减对非洲两项结果的影响：一是以USAID项目点周边夜间灯光亮度衡量的地方经济活动；二是以次国家级综合粮食安全阶段分类（IPC）衡量的严重粮食不安全状况。首先，USAID活动停止导致项目点周边500米至10公里范围内夜间灯光亮度急剧且显著下降，该效应随距离单调衰减，至25公里处已无法检测。其次，更依赖USAID人道主义援助的地区，其IPC第3阶段（危机）及以上、第4阶段（紧急）人口占比相对上升，该效应在冲击后第一年内持续累积，在高脆弱性地区被放大，且在民主程度较低的国家中约扩大十四倍。第三，上述两种效应均由人道主义援助削减驱动；夜间灯光效应还受到生产部门援助削减的影响。
url:f59bb14fe5cd0416.title: The Economic Impact of the USAID Shutdown
url:f59bb14fe5cd0416.title_zh: 美国国际开发署关闭的经济影响

url:f5ad55fc8f5ede63.abstract: we develop a simple theoretical framework showing how parent–child gaps can arise from information frictions and differences in reporting styles. We complement the model with a novel survey design that elicits both parental beliefs about children’s latent socio-emotional wellbeing and parental beliefs about children’s self-reports, allowing us to disentangle the different sources of the discrepancy. Using a new survey from Luxembourg, we estimate that approximately 70% of the observed gap is attributable to information frictions. Consistent with a Bayesian model of signal extraction, belief accuracy declines when children experience high levels of distress. The precision of second-order beliefs is negatively correlated with parental education, income, and employment, and—paradoxically—with more accurate priors about aggregate parental under-reporting, a pattern we refer to as the Capacity Paradox. As predicted by the model, a randomized information intervention shifts both first- and second-order beliefs only among parents with weak priors and generates heterogeneous effects on intended parental investments. These findings highlight the central role of second-order beliefs in understanding parental misperceptions and the potential for targeted information policies to improve parental awareness of children’s socio-emotional wellbeing.
url:f5ad55fc8f5ede63.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简洁的理论框架，揭示了信息摩擦与报告风格差异如何导致亲子认知差距。为补充该模型，我们设计了一项新颖的问卷调查，同时获取父母对子女潜在社会情感福祉的信念，以及父母对子女自我报告的信念，从而能够区分认知偏差的不同来源。基于卢森堡的一项新调查数据，我们估计约70%的观测差距可归因于信息摩擦。与贝叶斯信号提取模型一致，当儿童经历高度痛苦时，父母信念的准确性会下降。二阶信念的精确度与父母教育水平、收入及就业状况呈负相关，且与父母对总体低报现象的准确先验信念呈负相关——这种矛盾模式被称为“能力悖论”。正如模型所预测，一项随机信息干预仅对先验信念较弱的父母群体产生一阶与二阶信念的同步偏移，并对预期养育投入产生异质性影响。这些发现凸显了二阶信念在理解父母认知偏差中的核心作用，以及定向信息政策在提升父母对子女社会情感福祉认知方面的潜在价值。

url:f5be212f48d7ba4e.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between AI adoption and carbon emission intensity. Using micro-level data from Chinese firms, we find that carbon intensity decreases following the adoption of AI. The effect is particularly pronounced among large firms, those headquartered in AI hubs, and those in high-carbon intensity sectors. We investigate several mechanisms and find that AI adoption is also associated with increases in energy management processes, green innovation, inventory efficiency, overall productivity, and the share of specialized labor. We find that AI-induced carbon reductions are subject to a large rebound effect of approximately 70%.
url:f5be212f48d7ba4e.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了人工智能应用与碳排放强度之间的关系。基于中国企业层面的微观数据，我们发现企业在采用人工智能后，其碳排放强度有所下降。这一效应在大型企业、总部位于人工智能枢纽的企业以及高碳排放强度行业的企业中尤为显著。我们研究了若干机制，发现人工智能应用还与能源管理流程、绿色创新、库存效率、整体生产率以及专业劳动力占比的提升相关。此外，我们发现人工智能带来的碳减排效应存在约70%的大幅反弹效应。

url:f5c0e8c4350042d4.abstract: Global non-US banks have significant dollar exposure both on and off their balance sheet. We develop a model to analyze their adjustment to dollar funding shocks, whether from reduced direct lending or external dollar shortages. The model provides insight into banks' responses through borrowing, lending, and FX swap positions, as well as the impact on their net worth, their probability of default and CIP deviations. Implications of the model are confronted with data on the response of non-US global banks to major dollar funding shocks. We examine the benefits from buffering these shocks through central bank dollar swap lines or local currency lending by the central bank.
url:f5c0e8c4350042d4.abstract_zh: 全球非美国银行在表内和表外均持有大量美元敞口。我们构建了一个模型，分析这些银行如何应对美元融资冲击——无论是来自直接贷款减少还是外部美元短缺。该模型揭示了银行通过借款、贷款及外汇掉期头寸的调整机制，以及这些调整对其净资产、违约概率和抛补利率平价（CIP）偏离的影响。我们将模型推论与全球非美国银行应对重大美元融资冲击的实际数据进行了对比验证。此外，我们评估了通过央行美元互换额度或央行本币贷款缓冲此类冲击的潜在收益。

url:f5ebf61c056a7642.abstract: While extensive empirical research documents discrimination in labour and housing markets, comparative insights between these markets remain limited. We address this gap by juxtaposing levels of discrimination across five legally protected grounds - race and ethnicity, sex and gender, health and disability, sexual orientation, and social origin - in both markets. We apply hierarchical Bayesian meta-regressions to global data from correspondence audit studies conducted from 2000 to 2024. In doing so, we account for the metadata's multilevel structure, including study, group, location and time components. Our meta-analysis uncovers structural differences in discrimination, with racial and ethnic discrimination being greatest in the labour market and discrimination based on social origin being highest in the housing market. Frequentist robustness checks that address publication bias yield comparable findings.
url:f5ebf61c056a7642.abstract_zh: 尽管大量实证研究记录了劳动力和住房市场中的歧视现象，但这两个市场之间的比较性见解仍然有限。我们通过对比五个受法律保护领域——种族与民族、性别与性别认同、健康与残疾、性取向以及社会出身——在两个市场中的歧视程度来填补这一空白。我们采用分层贝叶斯元回归方法，对2000年至2024年间全球通信审计研究的数据进行分析。在此过程中，我们考虑了元数据的多层次结构，包括研究、群体、地点和时间等组成部分。我们的元分析揭示了歧视的结构性差异：种族与民族歧视在劳动力市场中最为严重，而基于社会出身的歧视则在住房市场中最为突出。针对发表偏倚的频率学稳健性检验也得出了类似的结果。

url:f618f5b4f4c172c5.abstract: We study how fluctuations in investor attention affect stock return synchronicity. For a sample of 734 stocks from 19 countries, we document that synchronicity increases when international soccer matches distract investors, suggesting that investors pay less attention to firm-specific news. Next, we show that synchronicity increases even more as matches become more important and when the national team is (closely) trailing rather than when it is leading during a match. These results are in line with Kahneman’s (1973) capacity model of attention, with loss aversion and with a role for suspense and underscore how fluctuations in investor attention affect price formation.
url:f618f5b4f4c172c5.abstract_zh: 我们研究了投资者注意力波动如何影响股票收益同步性。基于19个国家734只股票的样本，我们发现当国际足球比赛分散投资者注意力时，股票收益同步性会上升，这表明投资者对公司特定新闻的关注度降低。进一步研究表明，随着比赛重要性增加，以及当国家队在比赛中处于（微弱）落后而非领先状态时，同步性上升幅度更大。这些结果与卡尼曼（1973）的注意力容量模型、损失厌恶理论以及悬念的作用机制相吻合，并凸显了投资者注意力波动如何影响价格形成过程。

url:f62c757c0ccb5217.abstract: The Credit Surface along the leverage dimension gives the bond spread as a function of the loan-to-value ratio. Empirically, we show that uncertainty shocks typically increase spreads and steepen the credit surface, profoundly affecting the supply of credit. Theoretically, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for the convexity of the credit surface, and for changes in the anticipated distribution of collateral prices that lead to steepening of the credit surface. Finally, we show that the credit surface itself fully reveals the entire distribution of collateral prices, thus providing a new and vivid language with which to describe uncertainty and stochastic orders. Credit surface steepening itself is a new stochastic order that may better capture our intuitive notion of more uncertainty.
url:f62c757c0ccb5217.abstract_zh: 沿杠杆维度的信用曲面将债券利差表示为贷款价值比的函数。实证上，我们表明不确定性冲击通常会提高利差并使信用曲面变得更加陡峭，深刻影响信贷供给。理论上，我们推导出信用曲面凸性的充分必要条件，以及预期抵押品价格分布变化导致信用曲面陡峭化的条件。最后，我们证明信用曲面本身完全揭示了抵押品价格的整个分布，从而为描述不确定性和随机序提供了一种新颖而生动的语言。信用曲面陡峭化本身是一种新的随机序，可能更好地捕捉我们对更多不确定性的直觉概念。
url:f62c757c0ccb5217.title: Credit Surfaces and Economic Uncertainty

url:f6a6c2e0902b90b0.abstract: We study a platform that interacts with a major content provider, a long tail of independent providers, and consumers who allocate attention across competing content. By designing independent-provider compensation, the platform endogenously shapes its outside option and disciplines the major. This strategic use of long-tail compensation distorts entry relative to the first best. Allowing the platform to steer consumer attention improves entry incentives conditional on compensation, but affects bargaining incentives, and may thus increase or decrease welfare. We then consider regulation, showing that conservative minimum-compensation floors robustly improve welfare, while non-discrimination policies have ambiguous welfare effects.
url:f6a6c2e0902b90b0.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个平台，该平台与一个主要内容提供商、众多独立提供商（长尾）以及在不同竞争内容间分配注意力的消费者进行互动。通过设计对独立提供商的补偿机制，平台内生地塑造了其外部选择，并对主要提供商形成约束。这种对长尾补偿的策略性运用，相对于最优状态扭曲了市场进入。允许平台引导消费者注意力，在给定补偿条件下改善了进入激励，但会影响议价激励，从而可能增加或减少社会福利。随后我们考虑监管问题，发现保守的最低补偿下限能稳健地提升社会福利，而非歧视性政策则具有模糊的福利效应。

url:f6aaaccd2b5023e1.abstract: This paper is the first to examine how China’s Five-Year Plans ("Plans'") affect the production allocation of U.S. firms. The Plans represent the highest level of China’s industrial policy, identifying key sectors for state support. Using the U.S. Census Longitudinal Business Database and Plans issued in 2001, 2006, 2011, and 2016, we find significant production displacement among U.S. industries operating in the same sectors targeted by the Plans in China. Over the five years following a sector’s inclusion in a Plan, the corresponding U.S. industries experience a 3.6% reduction in output, a 5.1% drop in employment, a 6.1% decrease in investment, and a 1.0% uptick in factory closure rates. These effects were neither anticipated by the stock market nor reflected in forward-looking firm decisions such as investment and job postings at the time. Some U.S. firms, however, successfully adapt by reallocating production toward "beneficiary" industries — those upstream or downstream of the targeted sectors — or by offshoring to the favored sectors within China. Such adjustments are enabled by preexisting productivity, sectoral and geographic footprints, financial access, and labor market flexibility. This study contributes to the ongoing policy debate on how best to support domestic firms and the broader economy in the face of global shocks, particularly those driven by foreign government intervention.
url:f6aaaccd2b5023e1.abstract_zh: 本文首次考察中国五年规划（“规划”）如何影响美国企业的生产配置。规划代表了中国产业政策的最高层级，明确了国家支持的关键行业。利用美国人口普查纵向商业数据库及2001年、2006年、2011年和2016年发布的规划，我们发现，在中国规划所针对的同一行业内运营的美国产业，出现了显著的生产转移现象。在某一行业被纳入规划后的五年内，相应的美国产业产出下降3.6%，就业减少5.1%，投资下滑6.1%，工厂关闭率上升1.0%。这些效应既未被股市提前预期，也未在当时反映在投资和职位发布等前瞻性企业决策中。然而，部分美国企业通过将生产重新配置至“受益”行业——即目标行业的上游或下游行业——或将生产外包至中国受扶持的行业，成功实现了适应。这种调整得益于企业既有的生产率、行业和地理布局、融资渠道以及劳动力市场灵活性。本研究为当前关于如何在全球冲击（尤其是外国政府干预引发的冲击）下更好地支持国内企业和整体经济的政策辩论提供了参考。
url:f6aaaccd2b5023e1.title: How Do U.S. Firms Withstand Foreign Industrial Policies?
url:f6aaaccd2b5023e1.title_zh: 美国企业如何抵御外国产业政策？

url:f6b0fc1c2b817b17.abstract: How do international investors adjust portfolios in response to biodiversity risk? Using monthly data on investment fund portfolios, we show that the 2021 Kunming Declaration led fund managers to reallocate portfolios from high-biodiversity risk countries to less risky ones, while ultimate fund investors remained unresponsive. Fund managers reduced exposures to extremely high biodiversity risk without seizing low biodiversity risk as an opportunity for profit, characterizing biodiversity as downside risk factor. Investment funds drive cross-country spillovers as the reallocation triggers significant capital flows beneï¬ ting countries in the same geographic region, but outside of a fund
url:f6b0fc1c2b817b17.abstract_zh: 国际投资者如何根据生物多样性风险调整投资组合？利用投资基金的月度组合数据，我们发现2021年《昆明宣言》促使基金经理将投资组合从高生物多样性风险国家重新配置至风险较低的国家，而最终基金投资者对此并无反应。基金经理在未将低生物多样性风险视为盈利机会的情况下，减少了对极高生物多样性风险的敞口，从而将生物多样性界定为下行风险因素。投资基金通过这种重新配置引发显著的资本流动，使同一地理区域内但非基金所在国受益，从而驱动了跨国溢出效应。

url:f6c4c3e1f42ff2ec.abstract: The 2025 US university endowment tax hike, together with other financial pressures, is pushing the wealthiest universities to shrink their doctoral cohorts. This column exploits a novel sample of MIT Economics PhD applicants to shed light on the research value-added of elite doctoral programmes and the possible consequences of programme cutbacks. Holding applicant ability fixed, graduates of high-tax and other elite schools produce 60-75% more impact-weighted publications than comparable applicants. Neither peer effects nor home-journal favouritism explains this advantage. If elite PhD programmes add similar value in other disciplines, the endowment tax may well slow the pace of scientific progress.
url:f6c4c3e1f42ff2ec.abstract_zh: 2025年美国大学捐赠税上调，叠加其他财务压力，正迫使最富有的大学缩减博士生招生规模。本文利用麻省理工学院经济学博士申请者的新颖样本，揭示了精英博士项目的研究附加值以及项目缩减可能带来的后果。在控制申请者能力不变的情况下，高税负及其他精英学校的毕业生所产出的影响力加权论文数量，比同类申请者高出60%至75%。这种优势既不能用同伴效应解释，也不能用本校期刊偏好解释。如果精英博士项目在其他学科也能带来类似的附加值，那么捐赠税很可能会减缓科学进步的步伐。
url:f6c4c3e1f42ff2ec.title: Research value-added in elite economics PhD programmes
url:f6c4c3e1f42ff2ec.title_zh: 精英经济学博士项目的研究附加值

url:f6c6beb80ff2d273.abstract: Firms and policy makers are increasingly looking at friend-shoring to make supply chains less vulnerable to geopolitical tensions. We test whether these considerations are shaping FDI flows, using investment-level data on almost 300,000 instances of greenfield FDI between 2003 and 2022. Estimates from a gravity model, which controls for standard push and pull factors, show an economically significant role for geopolitical alignment in driving the geographical footprint of bilateral investments. This result is robust to the inclusion of standard bilateral drivers of FDI—such as geographic distance and trade flows—and the strength of the effect has increased since 2018, with the resurgence of trade tensions between the U.S. and China. Moreover, our results are not limited to greenfield FDI, but hold also for M&As.
url:f6c6beb80ff2d273.abstract_zh: 企业和政策制定者日益关注"友岸外包"，以降低供应链受地缘政治紧张局势影响的风险。我们利用2003年至2022年间近30万例绿地外商直接投资的项目层面数据，检验这些考量是否正在影响外商直接投资的流动。基于引力模型的估计（该模型控制了标准的推拉因素）表明，地缘政治一致性在驱动双边投资的地理布局中发挥着具有经济显著性的作用。这一结果在纳入标准双边外商直接投资驱动因素（如地理距离和贸易流动）后依然稳健，且自2018年美中贸易紧张局势再度升级以来，该效应的强度有所增强。此外，我们的结论不仅适用于绿地外商直接投资，对并购活动同样成立。

url:f6ef7bcf336135d2.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of free primary education (FPE) on parents' fertility decisions in sub-Saharan Africa and how these effects depend on prevailing gender norms. Leveraging the staggered rollout of FPE across 17 countries and a within-ethnicity design, we find that the reform reduced completed fertility by 0.25 births per woman. Reduced fertility coincides with both improved child survival and school enrollment. Linking these data with ethnic-level cultural norms of male dominance, we show that these effects arise exclusively among groups with low male dominance. Consistent with fertility reductions increasing women's autonomy, FPE also strengthens women's outside options and intra-household bargaining power. In low male-dominance settings, this is reflected in higher divorce probabilities, lower acceptance of intimate partner violence, greater participation in household decisions, and increased media engagement - changes absent in high male-dominance cultures. A simple model embedding the quantity - quality tradeoff within a limited-commitment household bargaining framework, where gender norms determine women's veto power over fertility, rationalizes these findings. Overall, the results underscore the central role of gender norms in shaping the effects of policy interventions on fertility and broader development outcomes.
url:f6ef7bcf336135d2.abstract_zh: 本文研究了撒哈拉以南非洲地区免费初等教育（FPE）对父母生育决策的影响，以及这些效应如何受主流性别规范的调节。利用17个国家分阶段推行FPE的政策差异及族群内部设计，我们发现该改革使每位女性的完成生育数减少0.25个。生育率下降与儿童存活率提升及入学率提高同步发生。通过将数据与反映男性主导地位的族群文化规范相关联，我们发现这些效应仅出现在男性主导程度较低的群体中。与生育率下降增强女性自主权相一致，FPE还提升了女性的外部选择权和家庭内部议价能力。在低男性主导环境中，这体现为离婚概率上升、对亲密伴侣暴力的接受度降低、家庭决策参与度提高以及媒体接触增加——而在高男性主导文化中则未观察到这些变化。一个嵌入数量-质量权衡且受有限承诺家庭议价框架约束的简单模型（其中性别规范决定女性对生育的否决权）可合理解释上述发现。总体而言，研究结果凸显了性别规范在塑造政策干预对生育及更广泛发展成果影响中的核心作用。
url:f6ef7bcf336135d2.title: Gender Norms and the Quantity-Quality Tradeoff: Evidence from Free Primary Education in Africa

url:f725c2744eaa543a.abstract: This study examines the long-term consequences of neonatal health using three birth anthropometric measures — weight, length, and head circumference — and analyzes their differential associations with outcomes across the life course. Using linked Swedish and Norwegian population registers with follow-up into adulthood, we compare birth measures of singletons and twins and further estimate within-twin-pair fixed-effects models that control for shared genetic and family environmental factors. Our samples comprise up to approximately 679,000 singletons and 10,400 twins in Sweden, and 347,841 singletons and 6,762 twins in Norway, followed into adulthood. We find that different birth measures capture distinct aspects of fetal development with varying predictive validity across outcome domains. Birth length emerges as the strongest predictor of health outcomes (infant mortality, adult height), consistent with its role as a cumulative indicator of skeletal growth throughout gestation. Birth weight retains stronger associations with cognitive and educational outcomes (grade point average [GPA], years of schooling) in conditional models. Head circumference shows weak and inconsistent associations across specifications. Using within-pair head circumference differences to classify twins as symmetrically versus asymmetrically growth restricted, we find that symmetric intrauterine growth restriction is associated with substantially worse long-term outcomes than asymmetric restriction. In Norwegian twin pairs, growth restriction is associated with lower general cognitive ability (measured at military enlistment) relative to the unaffected co-twin; this within-pair deficit is more than twice as large for symmetric as for asymmetric restriction. We also document significant intergenerational transmission of birth anthropometrics, suggesting both environmental and genetic contributions. Finally, our register-based design with near-complete population coverage minimizes selection bias and attrition while providing statistical power for within-pair analyses across multiple outcomes. Exclusive reliance on birth weight may obscure important information about early-gestation developmental insults.
url:f725c2744eaa543a.abstract_zh: 本研究利用出生时的三项人体测量指标——体重、身长和头围——考察新生儿健康的长期后果，并分析这些指标与生命历程中各阶段结果之间的差异化关联。通过使用瑞典和挪威的关联人口登记数据，并追踪至成年期，我们比较了单胎和双胞胎的出生测量值，并进一步估计了双胞胎对内固定效应模型，以控制共享的遗传和家庭环境因素。我们的样本包括瑞典约679,000名单胎和10,400名双胞胎，以及挪威347,841名单胎和6,762名双胞胎，均追踪至成年。研究发现，不同的出生测量指标捕捉了胎儿发育的不同方面，且在不同结果领域具有不同的预测效度。出生身长是健康结果（婴儿死亡率、成年身高）的最强预测因子，这与其作为整个妊娠期骨骼生长的累积指标的作用一致。在条件模型中，出生体重与认知和教育结果（平均绩点[GPA]、受教育年限）保持更强的关联。头围在不同规格下的关联较弱且不一致。利用双胞胎对内头围差异将双胞胎分类为对称性 versus 非对称性生长受限，我们发现对称性宫内生长受限与非对称性受限相比，与显著更差的长期结果相关。在挪威双胞胎对中，生长受限与相对于未受影响的同卵双胞胎较低的通用认知能力（在征兵时测量）相关；对称性受限的对内缺陷是非对称性受限的两倍以上。我们还记录了出生人体测量指标的显著代际传递，表明环境和遗传因素均有贡献。最后，我们的登记设计具有近乎完整的人口覆盖，最小化了选择偏差和流失，同时为跨多种结果的对内分析提供了统计功效。仅依赖出生体重可能掩盖关于早期妊娠发育损伤的重要信息。

url:f755bd5a00d48040.abstract: We investigate whether the market for ICOs in 2017-2018 showed signs of contagion from prices of the largest cryptocurrencies (Bitcoin and Ether). We find evidence that during phases of optimism, ICO daily returns display low correlations with those of Bitcoin or Ether. But when the bubble bursts, correlations jump to very high levels, signaling that the ICO market becomes a sideshow of the cryptocurrency dynamics. We show that the same dynamics were present in 2021 when Bitcoin and Ether went through a similar episode. We demonstrate that this high correlation was not present during the Nasdaq bubble in the 1990s, signaling that the price dynamics of digital tokens seems to be driven by a common factor, much more than in previous bubbles.
url:f755bd5a00d48040.abstract_zh: 我们考察了2017-2018年间首次代币发行（ICO）市场是否显示出受最大加密货币（比特币和以太币）价格传染的迹象。我们发现，在乐观情绪阶段，ICO的日回报率与比特币或以太币的相关性较低。然而，当泡沫破裂时，相关性急剧上升至非常高的水平，表明ICO市场成为加密货币动态的附属表现。我们进一步证明，在2021年比特币和以太币经历类似事件时，同样的动态再次出现。我们还表明，在1990年代的纳斯达克泡沫期间并未出现这种高相关性，这暗示数字代币的价格动态似乎受一个共同因素驱动，其程度远超以往泡沫时期。

url:f77b1f8a13af29f2.abstract: This paper examines the employment effects of multinational enterprises (MNEs) in Mexico, focusing on the labor market impacts of foreign tariff increases during 2018-2019. Using data from Mexicos National Survey of Occupations and Employment (ENOE) for 2014-2023 combined with sector-level tariff exposure measures based on Fajgelbaum et al. (2024), we construct a quarterly city-sector panel distinguishing employment in MNEs and domestic firms. We analyze employment outcomes across worker characteristics (education, age, gender) and firm attributes (size and location). Results indicate a positive employment effect in MNEs within the sectors most affected by the tariff increases, particularly for highly educated workers and small establishments. In contrast, there is no clear evidence of significant effects on wages.
url:f77b1f8a13af29f2.abstract_zh: 本文考察了墨西哥跨国企业的就业效应，重点关注2018-2019年外国关税上调对劳动力市场的影响。基于2014-2023年墨西哥国家职业与就业调查（ENOE）数据，结合Fajgelbaum等人（2024）提出的行业层面关税暴露指标，我们构建了区分跨国企业与本土企业就业的季度城市-行业面板数据。通过分析不同劳动者特征（教育程度、年龄、性别）及企业属性（规模与区位）的就业结果，研究发现：在受关税上调影响最严重的行业中，跨国企业呈现正向就业效应，尤其体现在高学历劳动者和小规模企业中。相比之下，工资水平未出现显著变化的明确证据。

url:f7c7b3e6bbaa2e48.abstract: We investigate the role of industrial relations for working from home during and after the COVID- 19 pandemic in Germany. Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP) for the years 2020 to 2023 and a special COVID sample (SOEP-CoV) for 2020 and 2021, we examine how collec- tive bargaining and plant-level co-determination are associated with the incidence and frequency of working from home. Controlling for worker, firm, occupation, and industry characteristics, we find that employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement are less likely to work from home and do so less frequently than uncovered employees. In contrast, the incidence and frequency of working from home are positively associated with the presence of a works council.
url:f7c7b3e6bbaa2e48.abstract_zh: 本文探究了新冠疫情期间及之后德国劳资关系对居家办公的影响。基于2020至2023年德国社会经济面板数据（SOEP）及2020至2021年新冠专项样本（SOEP-CoV），我们分析了集体谈判与工厂层面共同决策机制如何影响居家办公的发生率与频率。在控制劳动者、企业、职业及行业特征后，研究发现：受集体谈判协议覆盖的员工居家办公可能性更低且频率更少；相反，企业职工委员会的存在与居家办公的发生率及频率呈正相关。

url:f7e695a4053a0e4f.abstract: This paper documents that the traditional sovereign-bank nexus has morphed into a broader nexus that now also includes non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs): the sovereign-bank-NBFI nexus. The classical sovereign-bank nexus has been a major financial stability concern following the eurozone crisis. Since then, sovereign debt levels have increased substantially in many major economies, while NBFIs’ footprint in sovereign bond markets has grown significantly. This paper examines the transmission of risks among banks, sovereigns and NBFIs using European bank-level data and global country-level data. We find that banks’ direct sovereign exposures have recently become less important in explaining the co-movement between bank and sovereign risk. By contrast, banks’ exposures to NBFIs have become a significant determinant of the bank-sovereign risk co-movement. We also find evidence that NBFIs’ sovereign debt holdings have become important drivers of the co-movement between NBFI and sovereign risk.
url:f7e695a4053a0e4f.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了传统的“主权-银行”关联已演变为一个更广泛的关联网络，现亦纳入非银行金融机构（NBFIs）：即“主权-银行-NBFI”关联。在欧元区危机之后，经典的主权-银行关联一直是金融稳定关注的重点。自那时起，许多主要经济体的主权债务水平大幅上升，而NBFIs在主权利率市场中的参与度显著增强。本文利用欧洲银行层面的数据及全球国家层面的数据，考察了银行、主权国家与NBFIs之间的风险传导机制。研究发现，银行对主权的直接敞口在解释银行与主权风险联动方面的作用近期已减弱。相反，银行对NBFIs的敞口已成为银行-主权风险联动的重要决定因素。此外，证据表明，NBFIs持有的主权债务已成为NBFI与主权风险联动的重要驱动因素。

url:f80ddaad598b8975.abstract: This paper examines how the Iran-Israel conflict, and the Middle East tension in general, have affected the Pakistani economy in terms of trade, energy, and remittance. Being an energy-import dependent and export-oriented economy with a large diaspora in Gulf countries, Pakistan is prone to global oil price shocks, oil disruptions along important energy routes such as the Strait of Hormuz and possible drops in remittance inflows. Pakistan saw a potential resolution of an impact on retail fuel prices of about 20 percent in 2023-2026, with an increment of petrol and diesel of 55 per Pak rupee, which has increased inflation and aggravated the trade deficit. This paper illustrates the spread of global political events in domestic economic forces using international trade theory, macroeconomic shock theory and remittance development theory. In order to reduce the risk in the short run and increase resilience in the long-term, it is recommended to diversify the trade, establish energy security measures, formal remittance protection, and implement sound fiscal and monetary policies. The paper highlights the economic fragility of Pakistan to external shocks and outlines feasible measures to help it maintain a growth and stability in the current geopolitical instability.
url:f80ddaad598b8975.abstract_zh: 本文考察了伊朗-以色列冲突及整个中东紧张局势如何通过贸易、能源和侨汇渠道影响巴基斯坦经济。作为一个依赖能源进口、以出口为导向且在海湾国家拥有大量侨民的经济体，巴基斯坦易受全球油价冲击、霍尔木兹海峡等重要能源通道中断以及侨汇流入可能下降的影响。巴基斯坦预计在2023-2026年间零售燃油价格可能受到约20%的影响，汽油和柴油每巴基斯坦卢比上涨55%，这加剧了通货膨胀并恶化了贸易逆差。本文运用国际贸易理论、宏观经济冲击理论和侨汇发展理论，阐释了全球政治事件在国内经济力量中的传导机制。为降低短期风险并增强长期韧性，建议实现贸易多元化、建立能源安全措施、完善侨汇保障机制，并实施稳健的财政和货币政策。本文凸显了巴基斯坦对外部冲击的经济脆弱性，并提出了在当前地缘政治不稳定背景下帮助其维持增长与稳定的可行措施。

url:f843e28f2bf83fc0.abstract: When do labor-market shocks become lasting health inequality? We develop and estimate a continuous-time lifecycle model of wealth, health, and skill in which medical care combines smooth maintenance with threshold-crossing repair. Adverse wage shocks push financially fragile households toward subsistence, increase toxic labor effort, delay repair, and convert temporary earnings losses into persistent biological damage. Estimated with PSID, MEPS, and RAND HRS data, the model shows that skill-biased technical change generates concentrated lower-tail losses in health, survival, and welfare. A meaningful share of this damage reflects endogenous repair failure, and the mechanism remains visible in a parsimonious general-equilibrium environment.
url:f843e28f2bf83fc0.abstract_zh: 劳动力市场冲击何时会演变为持续的健康不平等？我们构建并估计了一个涵盖财富、健康与技能的连续时间生命周期模型，其中医疗护理结合了平滑维护与阈值跨越修复两种模式。不利的工资冲击使财务脆弱的家庭陷入生存困境，增加有害的劳动投入，延迟修复行为，并将暂时的收入损失转化为持久的生理损伤。基于PSID、MEPS和RAND HRS数据的估计结果显示，技能偏向型技术进步在健康、生存和福利方面产生了集中的低端损失。这种损伤中有相当一部分源于内生的修复失败，且该机制在简约的一般均衡环境中依然清晰可辨。

url:f863f507d77b7243.abstract: In fragile, conflict-affected, and violent contexts, decentralization is widely promoted to improve service delivery and strengthen the social contract by shifting power closer to citizens. However, empirical evidence on whether these reforms deliver in environments marked by weak state capacity and low institutional trust remains limited. This paper evaluates Mali’s Project for the Deployment of State Resources for the Improvement of Services program, which implemented performance-based conditional grants across 102 communes between 2021 and 2024. Drawing on administrative budget data and georeferenced Afrobarometer survey data, the study assesses the impacts of performance-based conditional grants on local fiscal performance, service delivery, and institutional legitimacy. The results show that a 1 percent increase in performance-based conditional grant allocations is associated with a 1.2 percent increase in investment expenditures and measurable improvements in budget balances. Expenditures were reallocated toward social sectors (education, health, water, and agriculture), consistent with program objectives. A difference-in-differences analysis points to statistically significant increases in citizen satisfaction with public services, particularly health (+2.6 percentage points), water and sanitation (+1.4), and education (+1.0), as well as an 18.4-point rise in trust in municipal counc ils. Institutional “spillover” effects extended to the national level, with trust in the presidency and parliament increasing by 9.1 and 7.3 points, respectively. A scenario-based cost-effectiveness analysis points to potentially substantial returns under the stated assumptions. Illustrative estimates suggest that observed trust gains could be associated with USD 57 million to USD 141 million in additional annual tax revenues, equivalent to 1.1 to 2.8 times the program’s total cost, through enhanced voluntary compliance—assuming a transmission of trust into compliance broadly consistent with parameters in the literature. These findings are consistent with the view that well-designed performance-based transfers may improve service outcomes and contribute to rebuilding public trust in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent contexts, with effects that appear to extend beyond the local level. Policy implications include considering institutionalization of the performance-based conditional grants within Mali’s fiscal architecture and the design of a medium-term roadmap for sustainability and possible scale-up.
url:f863f507d77b7243.abstract_zh: 在脆弱、受冲突影响和暴力环境中，权力下放被广泛推广，旨在通过将权力下放至公民层面来改善公共服务并强化社会契约。然而，关于此类改革在政府能力薄弱、制度信任度低的环境中是否有效的实证证据仍然有限。本文评估了马里2021至2024年间在102个市镇实施的"国家资源部署以改善服务项目"中的绩效导向有条件拨款计划。基于行政预算数据和地理参照的非洲晴雨表调查数据，本研究评估了绩效导向有条件拨款对地方财政绩效、公共服务供给及制度合法性的影响。结果显示：绩效导向有条件拨款每增加1%，投资支出相应增长1.2%，预算平衡状况出现可量化改善。支出向教育、卫生、水利和农业等社会领域重新配置，这与项目目标一致。双重差分分析表明，公民对公共服务的满意度出现统计显著提升，其中卫生服务满意度提高2.6个百分点、供水和卫生设施满意度提高1.4个百分点、教育满意度提高1.0个百分点，同时市镇议会信任度上升18.4个百分点。制度"溢出效应"延伸至国家层面，总统和议会信任度分别提升9.1和7.3个百分点。基于情景的成本效益分析显示，在既定假设条件下可能产生显著回报。估算表明，假设信任向税收遵从的传导效应与文献参数基本一致，观察到的信任提升可能通过增强自愿纳税遵从带来每年5700万至1.41亿美元的额外税收收入，相当于项目总成本的1.1至2.8倍。这些发现与以下观点一致：设计良好的绩效导向转移支付能够改善服务成效，并有助于在脆弱、受冲突影响和暴力环境中重建公众信任，其影响似乎超越地方层面。政策启示包括：考虑将绩效导向有条件拨款制度化纳入马里财政架构，并制定中期路线图以实现可持续发展和可能的规模扩展。
url:f863f507d77b7243.title: Decentralization, Service Delivery, and Legitimacy: The Case of Mali
url:f863f507d77b7243.title_zh: 分权、服务提供与合法性：以马里为例

url:f8665e09e1953427.abstract: Crises such as rapid population and demand growth, droughts, resource availability fluctuations, and supply-chain disruptions increasingly expose hidden fragilities in socio-technical systems. At the same time, they generate political momentum and practical urgency for institutional and governance innovation, as emergency measures often become prototypes for routine practice. This paper develops a national-scale, multi-sector water-energy-emissions (W-E-E) scenario model for Rwanda and uses it to test how demand growth, hydrological stress, and supply-side choices jointly shape future energy security and emissions trajectories through 2050. The analysis shows that, under SSP2 and especially SSP5 growth conditions, emissions remain strongly demand-driven; therefore, even ambitious demand-side and supply-side measures are best interpreted as pathways that moderate, rather than fully reverse, emissions growth. The contribution of the study is to identify which combinations of efficiency, electrification, renewable deployment, thermal retirement, and hydrological risk management most effectively reduce system stress and improve resilience under compound crises.
url:f8665e09e1953427.abstract_zh: 人口快速增长、需求激增、干旱、资源供应波动以及供应链中断等危机，日益暴露社会技术系统中隐藏的脆弱性。与此同时，这些危机催生了制度与治理创新的政治动力和现实紧迫性，因为应急措施往往成为常规实践的雏形。本文为卢旺达构建了一个国家尺度的多部门水-能源-排放（W-E-E）情景模型，并利用该模型检验需求增长、水文压力以及供给侧选择如何共同影响2050年前的能源安全与排放轨迹。分析表明，在SSP2尤其是SSP5增长条件下，排放仍主要由需求驱动；因此，即使是最为雄心勃勃的需求侧与供给侧措施，也最好被理解为减缓而非完全逆转排放增长的路径。本研究的贡献在于识别出哪些效率提升、电气化、可再生能源部署、火电退役以及水文风险管理组合，能在复合危机下最有效地降低系统压力并提升韧性。

url:f876d60a2b7709ec.abstract: We provide the first empirical evidence that common ownership can facilitate explicit collusion. Our unique setting, the population of legal cartels in Sweden, lets us observe cartel formation, duration, and dissolution without the sample-selection bias that plagues studies of detected cartels. Combining hand-collected ownership data with the universe of registered cartels, we compute firm-pair profit weights (κ) that measure how much one firm internalizes a rival's profits. Higher profit weights are associated with a greater likelihood of cartel participation, predict future cartel involvement, and are linked to longer cartel duration. Firms also reduce their profit weights immediately after a cartel dissolves. However, this relationship is concentrated among pairs in which the firm that internalizes the rival firm's profits colludes while the rival does not. Common ownership therefore complements a firm’s own participation in explicit collusion but substitutes for cartel participation by the rival whose profits it internalizes.
url:f876d60a2b7709ec.abstract_zh: 我们提供了首个经验证据，表明共同所有权能促进显性共谋。我们的独特研究背景——瑞典合法卡特尔全体样本，使我们能够观察卡特尔的形成、持续与解散，而避免了困扰已侦测卡特尔研究的样本选择偏差。结合手工收集的所有权数据与全部注册卡特尔，我们计算了企业配对利润权重（κ），该指标衡量一家企业在多大程度上内化竞争对手的利润。更高的利润权重与卡特尔参与可能性增大相关，能预测未来卡特尔参与，并与更长的卡特尔持续时间相关联。企业还在卡特尔解散后立即降低其利润权重。然而，这种关系集中在那些内化对手利润的企业参与共谋而对手未参与的企业配对中。因此，共同所有权补充了企业自身在显性共谋中的参与，但替代了其利润被内化的竞争对手的卡特尔参与。
url:f876d60a2b7709ec.title: DP21841 Common Ownership and Collusion

url:f877aeeb2fd4c8a8.title: Educational expansion and economic development: do they necessarily promote gender employment equity? Evidence from job satisfaction in Chinese universities
url:f877aeeb2fd4c8a8.title_zh: 教育扩张与经济发展：它们必然促进性别就业公平吗？——来自中国高校工作满意度的证据

url:f87a50fcb113f544.abstract: We develop a two-country model of trade and global pollution in which country A values environmental quality whereas country B does not. Governments choose emissions and commodity taxes non-cooperatively under autarky and free trade. Under autarky, the principle of targeting holds: country A levies a Pigouvian emissions tax, whereas neither country uses a commodity tax. Opening borders fundamentally changes the design of corrective taxation. Country A subsidizes the polluting good to shift production toward its cleaner firms. The optimal subsidy depends on the marginal social damage of emissions despite the presence of an emissions tax, implying a violation of the principle of targeting. Contrary to the conventional pollution-haven prediction, the environmentally unconcerned country need not be the exporter of the polluting good. As country A's valuation of environmental quality increases, or country B's production-cost advantage narrows, production shifts toward $A$, which eventually becomes the exporter. Beyond a critical threshold, trade reduces global emissions relative to autarky. Welfare effects are asymmetric: trade always benefits country B but may either increase or decrease welfare in country A.
url:f87a50fcb113f544.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个两国贸易与全球污染模型，其中A国重视环境质量，而B国不重视。在自给自足和自由贸易条件下，两国政府非合作地选择排放税和商品税。在自给自足状态下，目标原则成立：A国征收庇古式排放税，而两国均不采用商品税。开放边界从根本上改变了矫正性税收的设计。A国对污染性商品提供补贴，以将生产转向其更清洁的企业。尽管存在排放税，最优补贴仍取决于排放的边际社会损害，这违反了目标原则。与传统污染避难所预测相反，不关心环境的B国未必是污染性商品的出口国。随着A国对环境质量评价的提高，或B国生产成本优势的缩小，生产向A国转移，最终A国成为出口国。超过临界阈值后，贸易相对于自给自足降低了全球排放。福利效应不对称：贸易总是惠及B国，但可能提高或降低A国的福利。
url:f87a50fcb113f544.title: DP21879 Differing environmental preferences, fiscal competition, and taxation of goods and pollution
url:f87a50fcb113f544.title_zh: DP21879 环境偏好差异、财政竞争与商品及污染税收

url:f8824af545782535.abstract: We study the impact of large, successful manufacturing plants on other local producers in China, focusing on “Million-Rouble Plants” built in the 1950s during a brief alliance with the U.S.S.R. The ephemeral geopolitical situation and the locations of allied and enemy airbases provide exogenous variation in plant siting. We find a boom-and-bust pattern: Counties hosting these plants were 80% more productive than control counties in 1982 but 20% less productive by 2010. This decline reflects the performance of local establishments, which exhibit low productivity, limited innovation, and high markup. Specialization hindered spillovers, preventing the emergence of new clusters and local entrepreneurship.
url:f8824af545782535.abstract_zh: 本文研究了中国大型成功制造工厂对其他本地生产者的影响，重点关注20世纪50年代中苏短暂结盟期间建设的“百万卢布工厂”。短暂的地缘政治局势以及盟军与敌军空军基地的位置为工厂选址提供了外生变异。我们发现了一种“繁荣-萧条”模式：1982年，拥有这些工厂的县的生产率比对照组县高出80%，但到2010年却低了20%。这一下降反映了本地企业的表现，这些企业呈现出低生产率、有限创新和高加价的特点。专业化阻碍了溢出效应，阻止了新集群的形成和本地创业精神的发展。

url:f8e152a7b19d235d.abstract: An industrial economics analysis of China's quasi-monopoly on refined rare earth materials shows: even if China strictly maximizes national prosperity and abstains from geopolitical power play, a significant price differential emerges between the export price and the price for domestic users. The price differential itself is not evidence of geopolitical intentions. However, this equilibrium price gap widens if we assume that China views itself as contesting in a geopolitical, tournament-like situation against the United States. These two results are derived within the framework of a tournament model that imbeds the characteristics of a dominant supplier with a fringe - market, but adds geopolitical goals to the dominant supplier's objective.
url:f8e152a7b19d235d.abstract_zh: 对中国精炼稀土材料准垄断地位的产业经济学分析表明：即便中国严格以国家繁荣最大化为目标，不涉足地缘政治博弈，其出口价格与国内用户价格之间仍会出现显著价差。这一价差本身并不构成地缘政治意图的证据。然而，若假设中国视自身处于与美国的地缘政治竞赛情境中，这一均衡价格差距将进一步扩大。上述两项结论均基于一个锦标赛模型框架推导得出，该模型融合了主导供应商与边缘市场的特征，并在主导供应商的目标函数中加入了地缘政治考量。
url:f8e152a7b19d235d.title: China's rare earth policy: Prosperity maximization or great power geoeconomics?

url:f8e7a6a39c60ce72.abstract: We study the long-run effects of a large public expansion of pre-primary education in Argentina. Between 1993 and 1999, the federal government financed the construction of new preschool classrooms targeted to departments with low baseline enrollment and high poverty, creating roughly 186,000 additional places. We link administrative records on classroom construction to four population censuses and estimate difference-in-differences models that compare treated and untreated cohorts across high- and low-construction departments. An additional preschool seat per child increases post-kindergarten schooling by about 0.5 years, raising the probability of completing secondary school by 11.9 percentage points and of attaining any post-secondary education by 7.1 percentage points. For women, access to the program also reduces fertility: an additional seat lowers the number of live births per woman by 0.20. Across several checks using cohort sizes, household composition, province-of-birth restrictions, and direct migration measures, we find little evidence consistent with systematic selective migration, suggesting that migration is unlikely to be a major source of bias in our estimates. Our results show little impact on labor-market outcomes at the census date, consistent with beneficiaries still being in school or in the early stages of their careers. A benefit-cost analysis based on the estimated schooling gains, standard Mincer returns, and observed construction and operating costs yields a benefit-cost ratio of about 11 and an internal rate of return of 13\%. Our findings show that universal at-scale pre-primary expansions in middle-income countries can generate sizable improvements in human capital and demographic outcomes at relatively low fiscal cost.
url:f8e7a6a39c60ce72.abstract_zh: 本文研究了阿根廷大规模公立学前教育扩张的长期效应。1993年至1999年间，联邦政府资助新建了针对基线入学率低且贫困程度高的地区的学前教育教室，新增约18.6万个学位。我们将教室建设的行政记录与四次人口普查数据相关联，采用双重差分模型比较高建设密度与低建设密度地区中受政策影响与未受影响的群体。每增加一个儿童学前教育学位，可使幼儿园后的受教育年限提高约0.5年，高中毕业概率提升11.9个百分点，接受高等教育的概率提升7.1个百分点。对女性而言，该政策还降低了生育率：每增加一个学位可使每位女性的活产数减少0.20。通过使用队列规模、家庭构成、出生省份限制及直接迁移指标等多项检验，我们未发现系统性选择性迁移的显著证据，表明迁移不太可能成为估计偏差的主要来源。结果显示，该政策在普查时点对劳动力市场影响甚微，这与受益者仍处于在校或职业生涯早期阶段的情况相符。基于估算的教育收益、标准明瑟回报率以及实际建设与运营成本进行的成本收益分析表明，收益成本比约为11，内部收益率为13%。本研究表明，中等收入国家大规模普及学前教育能以相对较低的财政成本显著提升人力资本与人口结构指标。
url:f8e7a6a39c60ce72.title: DP21782 Long-run Effects of Universal Pre-Primary Education Expansion: Evidence from Argentina
url:f8e7a6a39c60ce72.title_zh: DP21782 普及学前教育扩张的长期效应：来自阿根廷的证据
